تَتَجَلَّى: tajallā — to become manifest, reveal oneself (verb V, imperf. 3fs)
وَتَبْدُوْ: وَ + تَبْدُو — badā, to appear, show oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs; verse spelling with an extra wāw)
تَخْجَلُ: khajila — to feel shame, blush (verb I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the non-human pl. aqmār); 'they are put to shame'
الْاَقْمَارْ: الـ + أَقْمَار — qamar, moon (m. pl. aqmār; verse pausal form)
تَسْجُدُ: sajada — to bow down, prostrate oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الْكَائِنَاتُ: الـ + كَائِنَات — kāʾin, existing thing, creature (act. part. of kāna; f. pl., nom.)
يَدَيْهَا: يَد (dual) + ـهَا — yad, hand (f. dual) + 3fs; 'her two hands'
حِينَ: ḥīna — when, at the time that (adv.)
تَبْدُو: badā — to appear, show oneself (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
وَتَهْتِكُ: وَ + تَهْتِكُ — hataka, to rend, tear away (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الْاَسْتَارْ: الـ + أَسْتَار — sitr, veil, curtain (m. pl. astār; verse pausal form)
وَاِذَا: وَ + إِذَا — idhā, when, whenever (particle; verse spelling)
اَوْمَضَتْ: awmaḍat — to flash, gleam (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
بُرُوقُ: بَرْق (pl.) — barq, lightning-flash (m. pl. burūq, nom.; iḍāfa first term)
حِمَاهَا: حِمَى + ـهَا — ḥimā, protected precinct, sanctuary (m.) + 3fs; 'her sanctuary' (see note)
اَهْطَلَتْ: ahṭalat — to pour down, rain heavily (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
بِالْمَدَامِعِ: بِـ + الـ + مَدَامِع — bi-, with (prep.) + madmaʿ, tear (m. pl. madāmiʿ, gen.); 'as tears'
الْاَمْطَارْ: الـ + أَمْطَار — maṭar, rain (m. pl. amṭār; verse pausal form)
إِلَيْهَا: إِلَى + ـهَا — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + 3fs; 'at her'
سِتَّ: sitt — mistress, lady (contracted colloquial form of sayyida; f., acc., vocative; iḍāfa first term)
الْحَرَائِرِ: الـ + حَرَائِر — ḥarāʾir, free/noble women (f. pl. of ḥurra; gen.; edition already prints the hamza, kept precomposed)
قَدِ: qad — indeed, already (particle before the perfect; -i before the following hamzat al-waṣl)
اخْتَطَفَتْكِ: ikhtaṭafat — to snatch away, abduct (verb VIII, perf. 3fs) + 2fs object suffix; 'it snatched you away' (see note — the grammatical subject is 'your wedding-night')
لَيْلَةَ: layla — night (f., acc., adverbial; iḍāfa first term)
عُرْسِكِ: عُرْس + ـكِ — ʿurs, wedding (m., gen.) + 2fs; 'your wedding'
أَنَامُ: nāma — to sleep (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s); 'I sleep' (see note on the dropped أَنْ)
قَلِيلًا: qalīl — little, a little while (adj. used adverbially; m., acc. indef.); also: after illā in a negative sentence where Classical has the nominative: lam yabqa minhu illā qalīlan, 'only a little of it remained' (accusative after illā, a habit of later Arabic)
الْجِنِّيَّ: الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni (m., acc.; subject of inna)
رَأْسَهُ: رَأْس + ـهُ — raʾs, head (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'his head'
رُكْبَةِ: rukba — knee (f., gen.; iḍāfa first term)
وَنَامَ: وَ + نَامَ — nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
فَرَفَعَتِ: فَ + رَفَعَتِ — rafaʿa, to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl); 'and she raised'
الصَّبِيَّةُ: الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., nom.); 'the girl' (subject)
رَأْسَهَا: رَأْس + ـهَا — raʾs, head (m., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her head'
فَرَأَتِ: فَ + رَأَتِ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl); 'and she saw'
الْمَلِكَيْنِ: الـ + مَلِكَيْن — malik, king (m. dual acc.); 'the two kings'
وَهُمَا: وَ + هُمَا — wa, and (here circumstantial, 'while') + humā, they two (3rd dual pron.); 'they [being]'
فَشَالَتْ: فَ + شَالَتْ — shāla, to lift, hoist, carry off (verb I hollow, colloquial; perf. 3fs); 'then she lifted'
رَأْسَ: raʾs — head (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْجِنِّيِّ: الـ + جِنِّيّ — jinniyy, jinni, genie (m., gen.; nisba-adjective of jinn used as a noun)
رُكْبَتِهَا: رُكْبَة + ـهَا — rukba, knee, lap (f., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'her knee'
وَوَضَعَتْهَا: وَ + وَضَعَتْ + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3fs obj. (here the māʾida, 'table', f.: 'and she set it'; elsewhere referring loosely to the masc. رَأْس, 'head' — see that night's note); 'and she put it'
الْأَرْضِ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, ground, earth (f., gen.)
وَوَقَفَتْ: وَ + وَقَفَتْ — waqafa, to stand, stop (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَقَالَتْ: وَ + قَالَتْ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
لَهُمَا: لِـ + ـهُمَا — li-, to, for (prep.) + 3rd dual suffix; 'to them two' Also with khabar, li- marks whom the news concerns: لَمْ أَسْمَعْ لَهُمَا خَبَرًا 'I heard no news of the two of them'. Also li- of benefit, 'for the two of them': an yuhayyiʾa lahumā arbaʿatan mina al-khayli, 'that four horses be made ready for them'.
بِالْإِشَارَةِ: بِـ + الـ + إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, gesture (f., gen.; verbal noun of IV ashāra); 'by gesture'
اِنْزِلَا: nazala — to go down, descend (verb I, imper. 2m dual; hamzat waṣl); 'come down, you two!'
تَخَافَا: khāfa — to fear (verb I hollow, jussive 2m dual after lā); 'do not fear'
الْعِفْرِيتِ: الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, ifrit, demon (m., gen.)
فَقَالَا: فَ + قَالَا — qāla (verb I hollow, perf. 3m dual); 'then the two said'
لَهَا: لِـ + ـهَا — li- + 3fs suffix; 'to her'; also 'of her', marking whose (lā adrī lahā atharan, 'I knew no trace of her'); also: with laysa, li- marks the possessor: laysa lahā qābiliyyatun, 'she had no appetite' Also 'for her': maḥabbatihi lahā, 'his love for her'; after amara, li- marks the one something is ordered for: amara lahā bi-…, 'he ordered … for her'. Also li- of possession, 'it has': ṭarrāḥatin … lahā wajhāni, 'a mattress that had two faces'.; also after dhalla, 'to humble oneself', li- marks the one humbled before: fa-dhalla lahā, 'he humbled himself before her' (Night 182); here also 'about her', after akhbara: ukhbiruhu lahā, 'I tell him about her' (li- marks what the news concerns; a loose use where bi- is usual); also after ḥaṣala, 'to happen', li- marks the one it befalls: ḥaṣala lahā junūnun, 'madness came upon her'; after maḍā, li- marks the one whose time passes: maḍā lahā thalāthu sinīna, 'three years have passed for her' (Night 193); also after yuqālu, li- marks what is named: madīnatan yuqālu lahā al-Ṭayrabu, 'a city called al-Ṭayrab'; after ṭāba, li- marks the one it is good for: ṭāba lahā al-rīḥu, 'the wind was fair for her (the ship)' (Night 194); here after jarā, 'to happen', li- marks the one it befalls: jarā lahā maʿa abīhā, 'happened to her with her father'
بِاللَّهِ: بِـ + اللَّه — Allāh, God (gen.); in an oath formula, bi- 'by God'; in lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-allāhi, bi- 'in, through God' Also after istaʿādha bi-, 'to seek refuge with', where bi- marks the one in whom refuge is sought: 'with God'.
عَلَيْكِ: عَلَى + ـكِ — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 2fs suffix; 'upon you' (oath formula, addressed to her); also baqiya ʿalayki, 'there remains (owing) upon you', one more point for you to settle; here after ṣaʿuba, 'hard on you'
اِعْفِي: ʿafā — to excuse, pardon, spare (verb I, imper. 2fs; hamzat waṣl); 'excuse! spare!'
عَنَّا: عَنْ + ـنَا — ʿan, from, about (prep.) + 1pl suffix; 'from us'
إِنْ: in — if (conditional particle, governs the jussive)
لَمْ: lam — not (neg. particle governing the jussive; negates the past or, colloquially, an immediate refusal)
تَنْزِلَا: nazala — to descend (jussive 2m dual after lam); 'you two do not come down'
نَبَّهْتُ: nabbaha — to rouse, alert, wake (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'I will rouse' (perfect used with threatening future force)
عَلَيْكُمَا: عَلَى + ـكُمَا — ʿalā + 2m dual suffix; 'against you two, upon you two'
الْعِفْرِيتَ: الـ + عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt (m., acc., object); also: acc. as the noun of anna: anna al-ʿifrīta Dahnashan, 'that the ifrit Dahnash' (Night 179)
يَقْتُلُكُمَا: قَتَلَ + ـكُمَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 2m dual obj.; 'he will kill you two'
شَرَّ: sharr — evil, worst (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the worst of'
قَتْلَةٍ: qatla — a killing, a death (f. noun of single instance, gen. indef.)
فَخَافَا: فَ + خَافَا — khāfa, to fear (perf. 3m dual); 'so the two feared'
وَنَزَلَا: وَ + نَزَلَا — nazala (perf. 3m dual); 'and the two came down'
فَقَامَتْ: فَ + قَامَتْ — qāma, to rise, stand up (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs)
وَقَالَتِ: وَ + قَالَتِ — qāla (perf. 3fs; kasra before the following hamzat waṣl)
اِرْصَعَا: irṣaʿā — obscure verb (imper. 2m dual); no dictionary attests the root ر-ص-ع in a sexual sense, but context leaves the general force in no doubt — see the note on this unit
عَنِيفًا: ʿanīf — violent, rough, forceful (adj. used adverbially, acc. indef.); 'forcefully'
أُنَبِّهُ: nabbaha — to rouse, alert (verb II, imperf. 1cs indic.); 'I will rouse'
لَكُمَا: لِـ + ـكُمَا — li- + 2m dual suffix; 'against you two' Also in hal lakumā fī, 'have you two a mind for', li- marking whose the wish is: hal lakumā fī shayʾin mina al-ṭaʿāmi, 'would you two like something to eat?'.
خَوْفِهِ: خَوْف + ـهِ — khawf, fear (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his fear'
افْعَلْ: faʿala — to do (verb I, imper. 2ms; hamzat waṣl); 'do!'
أَمَرْتُكَ: أَمَرَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I commanded you'
أَفْعَلْ: faʿala — to do (jussive 1cs after lam); 'I will [not] do'
قَبْلِي: قَبْلَ + ـِي — qabla, before (adv.) + 1cs suffix; 'before me'
وَأَخَذَا: وَ + أَخَذَا — akhadha, to take; [+ imperf.] to begin to (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two began'
يَتَغَامَزَانِ: taghāmaza — to wink at one another (verb VI, imperf. 3m dual); 'winking at each other'
نَيْكِهَا: نَيْك + ـهَا — nayk, the plain obscene word for sexual intercourse, the exact force of English 'fuck' (verbal noun, m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'having sex with her'
أَرَاكُمَا: رَأَى + ـكُمَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 2m dual obj.; 'I see you two'
تَتَغَامَزَانِ: taghāmaza — to wink at one another (imperf. 2m dual indic.); 'you two are winking at each other'
تَتَقَدَّمَا: taqaddama — to come forward, advance (verb V, jussive 2m dual after lam); 'you two come forward'
وَتَفْعَلَا: وَ + تَفْعَلَا — faʿala, to do (jussive 2m dual); 'and do [it]'
خَوْفِهِمَا: خَوْف + ـهِمَا — khawf, fear (m., gen.) + 3rd dual poss.; 'their fear'
اسْتَقْفَاهَا: اِسْتَقْفَى + ـهَا — istaqfā, to follow after, take one's turn with (verb X of qafā, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl) + 3fs obj.; 'he took his turn with her'
الِاثْنَانِ: اِثْنَانِ — ithnān, two, the two [of them] (m. dual nom.; hamzat waṣl)
فَرَغَا: faragha — to finish, be done (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'the two had finished'
أَفِيقَا: أَفَاقَ — afāqa, to recover, come to oneself (verb IV, imper. 2m dual); 'recover! come to yourselves!'
وَأَخْرَجَتْ: وَ + أَخْرَجَتْ — akhraja, to bring out, take out (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
جَيْبِهَا: جَيْب + ـهَا — jayb, bosom, the breast-fold of a garment used as a pocket (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'her bosom'
عِقْدًا: ʿiqd — string (of beads or rings), necklace (m., acc. indef.)
خَمْسُمِائَةٍ: خَمْسُ + مِائَةٍ — khamsumiʾa, five hundred (compound numeral, nom.); the second element مِائَة, 'hundred,' is spelled by the edition with a plain support-letter where the hamza's seat belongs, supplied here as a combining mark
وَسَبْعِينَ: وَ + سَبْعِينَ — sabʿūn, seventy (numeral); printed here in the oblique form where a strict grammar of this construction would expect the nominative سَبْعُونَ — vocalized as printed
خَاتَمًا: khātam — ring, seal-ring (m., acc. sg., as the specifying noun after the numeral)
أَتَدْرُونَ: أَ + تَدْرُونَ — a-, interrogative particle + darā, to know (verb I, imperf. 2mp indic.); 'do you know?'
هَؤُلَاءِ: hāʾulāʾi — these (dem. pron., common gender pl., invariable form; spelled precomposed, as in the edition)
أَصْحَابُ: أَصْحَاب — ṣāḥib, owner, companion (m. pl. aṣḥāb, nom.); 'the owners of'
الْخَوَاتِمِ: الـ + خَوَاتِم — khātam, ring (m. pl. khawātim, gen.)
كُلُّهُمْ: كُلّ + ـهُمْ — kull, each, all (m., nom.) + 3mp poss.; 'all of them, every one of them'
نَاكُونِي: نَاكَ + ـونِي — nāka, to have sex with (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp; the plain obscene verb) + 1cs obj.; 'they had sex with me'
قَرْنِ: qarn — horn (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فَأَعْطِيَانِي: فَ + أَعْطِيَا + ـنِي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imper. 2m dual) + 1cs obj.; 'so give me!'
خَاتَمَيْكُمَا: خَاتَمَيْ + ـكُمَا — khātam, ring (m. dual acc.) + 2m dual poss.; 'your two rings'
الْأَخَوَيْنِ: الـ + أَخَوَيْن — akh, brother (m. dual akhawayn, acc./gen.); 'the two brothers'
فَأَعْطَاهَا: فَ + أَعْطَى + ـهَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms — spelled singular though both brothers are meant, see note) + 3fs obj.; 'so he/they gave her'
أَيْدِيهِمَا: أَيْدِي + ـهِمَا — yad, hand (f., broken pl. aydin/aydī, gen.) + 3rd dual poss.; 'their two hands'
اخْتَطَفَنِي: اِخْتَطَفَ + ـنِي — ikhtaṭafa, to snatch away, abduct (verb VIII of khaṭafa, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl) + 1cs obj.; 'he snatched me away'
عُرْسِي: عُرْس + ـِي — ʿurs, wedding (m., gen.) + 1cs poss.; 'my wedding'
وَضَعَنِي: وَضَعَ + ـنِي — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he put me'
وَجَعَلَ: وَ + جَعَلَ — jaʿala, to put, make, place (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْعُلْبَةَ: الـ + عُلْبَة — ʿulba, box, casket (f., acc.)
الصُّنْدُوقِ: الـ + صُنْدُوق — ṣundūq, chest, box (m., gen.)
وَرَمَى: وَ + رَمَى — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I defective, perf. 3ms)
سَبْعَةَ: sabʿa — seven (numeral, f. form, acc., governing a gen. pl.)
أَقْفَالٍ: أَقْفَال — qufl, lock (m. pl. aqfāl, gen. indef.)
جَلِيٍّ: jaliyy — clear, bright, manifest (adj., gen. indef.; stays m. sg. rather than agreeing with the plural noun it describes)
وَجَعَلَنِي: وَ + جَعَلَ + ـنِي — jaʿala, to put, place (perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'and he put me'
الْعَجَّاجِ: الـ + عَجَّاج — ʿajjāj, roaring, raging, tumultuous (intensive adj. of ʿajja; m., gen.)
الْمُتَلَاطِمِ: الـ + مُتَلَاطِم — mutalāṭim, surging, clashing together [of waves] (act. part. of VI talāṭama; m., gen.)
بِالْأَمْوَاجِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْوَاج — mawj, wave (m. pl. amwāj, gen.); 'with the waves'
يَعْلَمْ: ʿalima — to know (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam)
الْمَرْأَةَ: الـ + مَرْأَة — marʾa, woman (f., acc.; subject of أَنَّ; the edition prints the hamza precomposed here)
مِنَّا: مِنْ + ـنَا — min + 1pl suffix; 'among us, from us'
أَرَادَتْ: أَرَادَ — arāda, to want, wish, desire (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
شَيًا: shayʾ — thing (m., acc. indef.); the edition drops the root's final hamza outright rather than merely its seat-letter — see the note on this unit; 'a thing, anything'
يَغْلِبْهَا: غَلَبَ + ـهَا — ghalaba, to overcome, prevail over (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam) + 3fs obj.; 'it overcomes her'
شَيٌ: shayʾ — thing (m., nom. indef.; hamza likewise dropped — see note); 'a thing, anything'; here the tanwīn ḍamma is printed, after ayy where Classical grammar wants the genitive shayʾin
بَعْضُهُمْ: بَعْض + ـهُمْ — baʿḍ, some, a part (m., nom.) + 3mp poss.; 'some of them, one of them'
اَوَمَا: a-wa-mā — interrogative a- + wa + mā (interrogative-negative combination); 'do you not...?'
تَرَى: raʾā — to see (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic.); here: 3fs subjunctive after li-ajli an, 'that she might see'
لِاِبْلِيسَ: لِـ + إِبْلِيس — li-, for, in the case of (prep.) + Iblīs, Satan, the Devil (proper name, gen. after لِـ)
خُرُوجَهُ: خُرُوج + ـهُ — khurūj, going-out, departure, expulsion (verbal noun of kharaja, m., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his going-out'
اَجْلِهِنْ: أَجْل + ـهِنْ — ajl, sake, cause (m., gen.) + 3fp poss.; مِنْ أَجْلِ = 'for the sake of, because of'; 'their [women's] sake'
وَبِكَ: وَ + بِـ + ـكَ — wa + bi-, through, by means of (prep.) + 2ms suffix; 'and through you, because of you'
اِنَّ: inna — indeed (particle, governs an acc. subject; verse spelling, no combining hamza mark)
الْمَلَامَ: الـ + مَلَام — malām, blame, reproach, censure (m., acc.; subject of inna)
يَقْوِي: qawiya — to grow strong, become powerful (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
الْمَلُومَا: الـ + مَلُوم — malūm, the one blamed, the reproached (pass. part. of lāma; m., acc. in pausal rhyme)
لَيْسَ: laysa — is not (defective verb functioning as a negative copula)
جُرْمِي: جُرْم + ـِي — jurm, crime, offense, fault (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my crime'
عَظِيمَا: ʿaẓīm — great, mighty (adj., acc. in pausal rhyme)
اَكُنْ: kāna — to be (verb I hollow, jussive 1cs after in); 'I am, I were'
عَاشِقًا: ʿāshiq — lover, one in love (act. part. of ʿashiqa; m., acc. indef.)
آتِ: أَتَى — atā, to come; [idiom] to do (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam); 'I have not done'
اِلَّا: illā — except, only (verse spelling, no combining hamza mark)
اَتَتْهُ: أَتَى + ـهُ — atā, to come, to do (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken pl. subject الرِّجَال, a legitimate Classical option for human broken plurals) + 3ms obj.; 'that which the men did'
الرِّجَالُ: الـ + رِجَال — rajul, man (m. pl. rijāl, nom.)
قَدِيمَا: qadīm — old, ancient (adj./adv., acc. in pausal rhyme); 'anciently, of old'
يَكْثُرُ: kathura — to be much, be many, increase (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
التَّعَجُّبُ: الـ + تَعَجُّب — taʿajjub, wonder, astonishment (verbal noun of V taʿajjaba; m., nom.)
مِمَّنْ: مِنْ + مَنْ — min, from, at (prep.) + man, whoever (rel./interrog. pron.), fused; 'at him who'
النِّسَاءِ: الـ + نِسَاء — nisāʾ, women (f. pl., gen.)
سَلِيمَا: salīm — safe, sound, unharmed, untouched (adj., acc. in pausal rhyme)
نَشَأْتُ: نَشَأَ — nashaʾa, to grow up, come of age, be raised (verb I, perf. 1cs)
اِنْ: in — if (conditional particle; verse spelling, no combining hamza mark)
سَمِعَا: samiʿa — to hear (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'the two heard'
الْمَلِكَانِ: الـ + مَلِكَانِ — malik, king (m. dual nom.); 'the two kings'
الْكَلَامَ: الـ + كَلَام — kalām, speech, words (m., acc.); 'the speech'
تَعَجَّبَا: taʿajjaba — to marvel, be amazed (verb V, perf. 3m dual)
الْعَجَبِ: الـ + عَجَب — ʿajab, amazement, wonder (m., gen.)
بَعْضُهُمَا: بَعْض + ـهُمَا — baʿḍ, some, one (m., nom.) + 3m dual suffix; 'one of the two'
بَعْضًا: baʿḍ — some, the other (m., acc. indef.); stands here for لِبَعْضٍ, 'to the other', with the preposition dropped (see note)
عِفْرِيتًا: ʿifrīt — demon, powerful jinni (m., acc. indef.)
وَجَرَى: وَ + جَرَى — jarā, to happen, befall (verb I final-weak, perf. 3ms)
عَلَيْنَا: عَلَى + ـنَا — ʿalā, upon + 1pl suffix; 'upon us'; here also after shawwasha ʿalā, 'to upset', and kadhaba ʿalā, 'to lie to': ʿalā marks the ones upset or lied to
شِي: shī — thing, something (colloquial word for shayʾ, printed without the Classical hamza-seat; see note)
يَجْرِ: yajri — to happen (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam)
لِأَحَدٍ: لِـ + أَحَدٍ — li-, to + aḥad, anyone, someone (m., gen. indef.); 'to anyone'
انْصَرَفَا: inṣarafā — to withdraw, depart (verb VII, perf. 3m dual)
سَاعَتِهِمَا: سَاعَة + ـهِمَا — sāʿa, hour, moment (f.) + 3m dual suffix; min sāʿatihimā = 'that very hour', idiom for immediacy
عَنْهَا: عَنْ + ـهَا — ʿan, from + 3fs suffix; 'from her'; also: after qāla, 'about her': taqūlu ʿanhā, 'you talk about' (Night 179); also after fattasha, 'to search for': fattashtu ʿanhā, 'I searched for her' (Night 182)
وَرَجَعَا: وَ + رَجَعَ — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, perf. 3m dual)
فَدَخَلَ: فَـ + دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3ms)
عُنُقَ: ʿunuq — neck (m./f., acc., first term of iḍāfa)
وَالْجَوَارِيَ: وَ + الـ + جَوَارِي — jāriya, slave-girl (f. pl. jawārī, acc.); 'and the slave-girls'
وَالْعَبِيدَ: وَ + الـ + عَبِيد — ʿabd, slave (m. pl. ʿabīd, acc.); 'and the slaves'
كُلَّ: kull — every, each (m., acc. adverbial); kulla laylatin = 'every night'; or acc. as the noun of anna (anna kulla mutanaṭṭiʿin, 'that every zealot')
وَجْهَهَا: وَجْه + ـهَا — wajh, face (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'her face' (ramat wajhahā ʿalayhi, 'she flung herself over him'); in one earlier passage taken as 'her maidenhead' (see the note there)
يَقْتُلُهَا: يَقْتُلُ + ـهَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'he kills her'
ثَلَٰثِ: thalāth — three (numeral, f. gen., first term of iḍāfa); the edition prints ثلث without the medial alif, restored here with a dagger alif
سَنَوَاتٍ: sana — year (f. pl. sanawāt, gen. indef.)
فَضَجَّ: فَـ + ضَجَّ — ḍajja, to clamor, cry out in uproar (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms)
النَّاسُ: الـ + نَاس — nās, the people (m. coll., nom.)
وَهَرَبُوا: وَ + هَرَبَ — haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 3mp)
بِبَنَاتِهِمْ: بِـ + بَنَات + ـهِمْ — bint, daughter (f. pl. banāt, gen.) + 3mp suffix; 'with their daughters'
يَبْقَ: yabqa — to remain (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam)
تَتَحَمَّلُ: taḥammala — to bear, endure (verb V, imperf. 3fs)
الْوَطْيَ: الـ + وَطْي — waṭy, coitus, the act (m., acc.); the edition prints يـ where Classical spelling has a hamza, الْوَطْء (see note)
أَمَرَ: amara — to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَأْتِيَهُ: يَأْتِيَ + ـهُ — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms) + 3ms suffix; atā bi- = 'to bring'; 'that he bring him'
بِبِنْتٍ: بِـ + بِنْتٍ — bi-, with + bint, girl (f., gen. indef.); atā bi-bint = 'brought a girl'
جَرْيِ: jary — course, running (m., gen., verbal noun of jarā); ʿalā jary ʿādatihi = 'as was his custom'
عَادَتِهِ: عَادَة + ـهِ — ʿāda, custom, habit (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his custom'
وَفَتَّشَ: وَ + فَتَّشَ — fattasha, to search (verb II, perf. 3ms)
يَجِدْ: yajid — to find (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam)
فَتَوَجَّهَ: فَـ + تَوَجَّهَ — tawajjaha, to set out toward, turn oneself (verb V, perf. 3ms)
مَنْزِلِهِ: مَنْزِل + ـهِ — manzil, house, dwelling (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix
مَغْبُونٌ: maghbūn — cheated, defrauded (pass. part. of ghabana; m. nom. indef.)
مَقْهُورٌ: maqhūr — overpowered, subdued (pass. part. of qahara; m. nom. indef.)
خَائِفٌ: khāʾif — fearful (act. part. of khāfa; m. nom. indef.)
وَزِيرُ: wazīr — vizier (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa)
الْكَبِيرَةُ: الـ + كَبِيرَة — kabīra, elder (adj. used as noun, f. nom.)
اسْمُهَا: اسْم + ـهَا — ism, name (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her name' (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl)
وَالصَّغِيرَةُ: وَ + الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīra, younger (adj. used as noun, f. nom.)
الْكُتُبَ: الـ + كُتُب — kitāb, book (m. pl. kutub, acc.)
وَالتَّوَارِيخَ: وَ + الـ + تَوَارِيخ — tārīkh, history, chronicle (m. pl. tawārīkh, acc.)
وَسِيَرَ: وَ + سِيَر — sīra, life-story, biography (f. pl. siyar, acc.)
الْمُلُوكِ: الـ + مُلُوك — malik, king (m. pl. mulūk, gen.)
الْمُتَقَدِّمِينَ: الـ + مُتَقَدِّمِين — mutaqaddim, former, of old (act. part. V; m. pl., gen.)
وَأَخْبَارَ: وَ + أَخْبَار — khabar, account, report (m. pl. akhbār, acc.)
الْمَاضِينَ: الـ + مَاضِين — māḍī, bygone, past (act. part. of maḍā; m. pl., gen.)
قِيلَ: qīla — it was said (verb I hollow, passive perf. 3ms)
أَنَّهَا: أَنَّ + ـهَا — anna, that (particle) + 3fs suffix; 'that she'
جَمَعَتْ: jamaʿat — to gather, collect (verb I, perf. 3fs)
كِتَابٍ: kitāb — book (m., gen. indef., counted noun after alf)
كُتُبِ: kutub — books (m. pl., gen., first term of iḍāfa)
التَّوَارِيخِ: الـ + تَوَارِيخ — tārīkh, history (m. pl., gen.)
الْمُتَعَلِّقَةِ: الـ + مُتَعَلِّقَة — mutaʿalliqa, relating to, concerning (act. part. V of taʿallaqa; f., gen.)
بِالْأُمَمِ: بِـ + الـ + أُمَم — umma, nation (f. pl., gen.); 'with/concerning the nations'
وَالْمُلُوكِ: وَ + الـ + مُلُوك — malik, king (m. pl., gen.)
الْخَالِيَةِ: الـ + خَالِيَة — khāliya, past, gone by (act. part. of khalā; f., gen.)
وَالشُّعَرَاءِ: وَ + الـ + شُعَرَاء — shāʿir, poet (m. pl. shuʿarāʾ, gen.)
لِأَبِيهَا: لِـ + أَب + ـيهَا — li-, to + ab, father (m., one of the 'five nouns') + 3fs suffix; 'to her father'
مَغْبُونًا: maghbūn — cheated (pass. part.; m., acc. as ḥāl)
حَامِلَ: ḥāmil — carrying, bearing (act. part. of ḥamala; m., acc. as ḥāl, first term of iḍāfa)
الْهَمِّ: الـ + هَمّ — hamm, worry, care (m., gen.)
وَالْأَحْزَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَحْزَان — ḥuzn, grief (m. pl. aḥzān, gen.)
فِى: fī — in, on, concerning (prep.; the edition prints it with alif maqṣūra, ى, instead of the usual dotted يـ)
الْمَعْنَى: الـ + مَعْنَى — maʿnā, meaning, theme (m., gen.)
قُلْ: qul — say! (verb I, imper. 2ms; opens the quoted verse); also (Night 202): qul — say! (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms of qāla); qul lahu, 'say to him'
لِمَنْ: لِـ + مَنْ — li-, to + man, whoever (rel./interrog. pron.); 'to whoever'; here: li- marks the one for whom it is a temptation: fitnatun li-man yarāhu, 'a temptation for whoever sees it' ; also: li- marks the object of a participle: muḥibban … li-man taʿshaquhā, 'a lover of the one you love'
يَحْمِلُ: yaḥmilu — to carry, bear (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'charge (upon)'
يَدُومُ: yadūmu — to last, endure (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
مِثْلُ: mithlu — like, just as (noun used adverbially, nom.); here: nom., the topic after ammā, mithlu mā ḍammat ḍulūʿī, 'the like of what my ribs enclose'
تَفْنَى: tafnā — to perish, pass away (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
الْمَسَرَّه: الـ + مَسَرَّة — masarra, gladness, joy (f.; the edition prints the final ة as plain ه, read in pause as -ah)
الْهُمُومُ: الـ + هُمُوم — hamm, worry (m. pl. humūm, nom.)
مِنِ: min — from (with the helping vowel -i before the following hamzat al-waṣl)
ابْنَتِهِ: اِبْنَة + ـهِ — ibna, daughter (f.) + 3ms suffix; 'his daughter' (initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl)
حَكَى: ḥakā — to relate, tell (verb I, perf. 3ms). Also 'to resemble, imitate': ḥakā al-qamara, 'resembled the moon'.
الْآخِرِ: الـ + آخِر — ākhir, last, end (m., gen.)
أَبَتِ: abati — 'O my father' (old vocative form of ab, father, with the possessive marked by a vowelled tāʾ rather than yāʾ; see note)
زَوِّجْنِي: زَوِّجْ + ـنِي — zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (verb II, imper. 2ms) + 1s obj.; 'marry me [to]'
فَإِمَّا: فَـ + إِمَّا — fa- + immā, either (particle, paired with wa-immā, 'either... or...')
أَعِيشَ: ʿāsha — to live (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 1s)
أَكُونَ: kāna — to be (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s)
فِدًي: fidan — ransom (m., acc. indef.; the edition prints the final -an on يـ rather than the usual alif maqṣūra ى)
لِأَوْلَادِ: لِـ + أَوْلَاد — walad, child (m. pl. awlād, gen.); 'for the children of'
الْمُسْلِمِينَ: الـ + مُسْلِمِين — muslim, Muslim (m. pl., gen.)
وَخَلَاصِهِمْ: وَ + خَلَاص + ـهِمْ — khalāṣ, deliverance, release (m., gen.) + 3mp suffix
يَدَيْهِ: يَد (dual) + ـهِ — yad, hand (f. dual yadayn, gen.) + 3ms suffix; min bayni yadayhi = 'from before him' Also acc., object: ṭalaba an yaghsila yadayhi, 'asked to wash his hands'.
تُخَاطِرِي: tukhāṭirī — to risk, endanger (verb III, imperf. jussive 2fs, negated by lā)
بِنَفْسِكِ: بِـ + نَفْس + ـكِ — nafs, self (f., gen.) + 2fs suffix; 'with yourself'; also: after rafaqa, 'to be gentle', bi- marks the one treated gently: urfuqī bi-nafsiki, 'be gentle with yourself'
لَابُدَّ: لَا + بُدَّ — lā budda, 'there is no escape, it must be' (fixed negation idiom; the edition prints it as one word)
يَتِمَّ: yatimma — to be completed, come to pass (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after an)
لَكِ: لِـ + ـكِ — li- + 2fs suffix; 'for you, to you'
تَمَّ: tamma — to be completed, come to pass (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَالثَّوْرِ: وَ + الـ + ثَوْر — thawr, ox, bull (m., gen.)
صَاحِبِ: ṣāḥib — owner, master of (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa)
الزَّرْعِ: الـ + زَرْع — zarʿ, crop, sown field (m., gen.)
حِكَايَةُ: ḥikāya — story, tale (f., nom.); 'the tale of'
الثَّوْرِ: الـ + ثَوْر — thawr, bull, ox (m., gen.)
لِبَعْضِ: لِـ + بَعْض — baʿḍ, some, a certain (m., gen.); 'to a certain one of'
التُّجَّارِ: الـ + تُجَّار — tājir, merchant (m. pl. tujjār; gen.)
أَمْوَالٌ: amwāl — māl, wealth, possessions (m. pl.; nom. indef.)
وَمَواشٍ: وَ + مَوَاشٍ — māshiya, head of livestock (f. pl. mawāshī, defective; nom. indef.)
وَأَوْلَادٌ: وَ + أَوْلَاد — walad, child, son (m. pl. awlād; nom. indef.)
تَعَالَى: taʿālā — (1) to be exalted (verb VI, perf. 3ms, frozen as an epithet after Allāh, '[He is] exalted'); (2) come! (frozen imperative; Classical distinguishes taʿāla m. / taʿālay f., but the edition prints this same masculine-looking form for a woman too)
أَعْطَاهُ: aʿṭā + -hu — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he gave him'
لُغَاتِ: لُغَات — lugha, language, tongue (f. pl. lughāt; gen.)
أَلْسُنِ: أَلْسُن — lisān, tongue (m. pl. alsun, construct state, no article; gen.); 'tongues of'
الْحَيَوَانَاتِ: الـ + حَيَوَانَات — ḥayawān, animal (m. pl.; gen.)
وَالطُّيُورِ: وَ + الـ + طُيُور — ṭāʾir, bird (m. pl. ṭuyūr; gen.)
مَسْكَنُ: maskan — dwelling, abode (m., nom.); 'the dwelling of'
الْأَرْيَافَ: الـ + أَرْيَاف — rīf, countryside, rural district (m. pl. aryāf; acc., predicate of kāna)
دَارِهِ: dār + -hi — dār, house (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his house'
وَثَوْرٌ: وَ + ثَوْر — thawr, bull, ox (m., nom. indef.)
فَأَتَى: فَـ + أَتَى — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَوْمًا: yawm — day (m., acc. as adverbial); 'one day' Also acc. sg. as the counted noun after a number from eleven to ninety-nine: khamsata ʿashara yawman, 'fifteen days'.; also acc. as the predicate of kāna: wa-kāna yawman ʿaẓīman, 'and it was a great day' (Night 198)
الثَّوْرُ: الـ + ثَوْر — thawr, bull, ox (m., nom.)
فَوَجَدَهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ـهُ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he found him'
مَكْنُوسًا: maknūs — swept (pass. part. of kanasa; m., acc.)
مَرْشُوشًا: marshūsh — sprinkled, watered down (pass. part. of rashsha; m., acc.)
مِعْلَفِهِ: miʿlaf + -ihi — miʿlaf, manger, feed-trough (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his manger'
مُغَرْبَلٌ: mughrabal — sifted, sieved (pass. part. of the quadriliteral gharbala; m., nom. indef.)
وَتِبْنٌ: وَ + تِبْن — tibn, straw, chaff (m., nom. indef.)
رَاقِدٌ: rāqid — lying down (act. part. of raqada; m., nom. indef.)
مُسْتَرِيحٌ: mustarīḥ — resting, at ease (act. part. of X istarāḥa; m., nom. indef.)
الْأَوْقَاتِ: الـ + أَوْقَات — waqt, time (m. pl. awqāt; gen.)
يَرْكَبُهُ: yarkabu + -hu — rakiba, to ride, mount (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he rides him'
صَاحِبُهُ: ṣāḥib + -hu — ṣāḥib, owner, companion (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his master'; here: 'his friend, his companion'
لِحَاجَةٍ: لِـ + حَاجَة — ḥāja, need (f., gen. indef.); 'for a need'
تَعْرِضُ: taʿriḍu — ʿaraḍa, to present itself, arise (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
وَيَرْجِعُ: وَ + يَرْجِعُ — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
حَالِهِ: ḥāl + -ihi — ḥāl, state, condition (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his state'
الثَّوْرَ: الـ + ثَوْر — thawr, bull, ox (m., acc.)
يَقُولُ: yaqūlu — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
لِلْحِمَارِ: لِـ + الـ + حِمَار — ḥimār, donkey (m., gen.); the article's alif is dropped in writing after li-
هَنِيًّا: hanīʾan — wholesome, may-it-do-you-good (elliptical acc. in the fixed exclamation hanīʾan laka); also as a plain adjective for hanīʾ, pleasant, wholesome (m., acc. indef.; print هنيا, the hamza read as a doubled yāʾ): ʿayshan haniyyan, 'a pleasant life'
تَعْبَانُ: taʿbān — weary, tired (adj., m., nom.; diptote pattern faʿlān)
تَأْكُلُ: taʾkulu — akala, to eat (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
مُغَرْبَلًا: mughrabal — sifted (pass. part.; m., acc. as ḥāl, 'sifted')
وَيَخْدُمُكَ: وَ + يَخْدُمُ + ـكَ — khadama, to serve (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 2ms object; 'he serves you'
يَرْكَبُكَ: yarkabu + -ka — rakiba, to ride (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 2ms object; 'he rides you'
دَائِمًا: dāʾim — lasting, continual (act. part. of dāma; m., acc. as adv., 'always')
لِلْحَرْثِ: لِـ + الـ + حَرْث — li-, for (prep.) + ḥarth, ploughing, tillage (m., gen.)
وَالطَّحِينِ: وَ + الـ + طَحِين — ṭaḥīn, flour, grinding (m., gen.)
تَخْرُجُ: takhruju — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
الْغَيْطِ: الـ + غَيْط — ghayṭ, field (m., gen.; the everyday word for cultivated land)
وَيَجْعَلُونَ: وَ + يَجْعَلُونَ — jaʿala, to put, place (verb I, imperf. 3mp)
رَقَبَتِكَ: raqaba + -tika — raqaba, neck (f., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your neck'
فَارْقُدْ: فَـ + اِرْقُدْ — raqada, to lie down, sleep (verb I, imper. 2ms)
وَلَوْ: وَ + لَوْ — law, if, even if (conditional particle)
ضَرَبُوكَ: ḍarabū + -ka — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 2ms object; 'they beat you'
تَقُمْ: taqum — qāma, to rise, stand (verb I hollow, jussive 2ms after lā)
وَقُمْ: وَ + قُمْ — qāma, to rise (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms)
وَارْقُدْ: وَ + اِرْقُدْ — raqada, to lie down (verb I, imper. 2ms)
يَرْجِعُونَ: yarjiʿūna — rajaʿa, to return, bring back (verb I, imperf. 3mp)
بِكَ: بِـ + ـكَ — bi-, with + 2ms suffix; 'with you, bringing you'; after anzala, bi- marks the one it falls on (yunzilu bika al-dhull, 'he will bring abasement down on you') Also after murtahana, 'held in pledge', bi- marks the one who holds the pledge: rūḥī murtahanatun bika, 'my soul is pledged to you'. Also after istaʾnasa, bi- marks the companion who comforts: li-astaʾnisa bika, 'that I may take comfort in your company'. Also after ijtimāʿ, 'meeting', bi- marks the person met: ijtimāʿī bika, 'my meeting with you'. Also after istabshara, 'to take heart, rejoice at', bi- marks the source of the good hope: istabshartu bika, 'I took heart from you'. Also after fariḥa, 'to rejoice', bi- marks the one rejoiced in: wa-afraḥa bika, 'and have joy of you'.
وَيُوضَعُونَ: وَ + يُوضَعُونَ — waḍaʿa, to put, set down (verb I, imperf. pass. 3mp); a passive verb agreeing in the plural with the unstated agent rather than with its own singular subject
فَلَا: فَـ + لَا — lā, not (neg. particle: with the jussive, prohibitive; with the indicative, plain negation; with a noun, 'there is no')
تَأْكُلْهُ: taʾkul + -hu — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā) + 3ms object; 'do not eat it'
كَأَنَّكَ: ka-anna + -ka — ka-anna, as though (particle) + 2ms pronoun as its subject; 'as though you'
ضَعِيفٌ: ḍaʿīf — weak, feeble (adj., m., nom. indef.)
وَامْتَنِعْ: وَ + اِمْتَنِعْ — imtanaʿa, to abstain, refrain (verb VIII, imper. 2ms)
وَالشُّرْبِ: وَ + الـ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (m., gen.)
ثَلٰثَةً: thalātha — three (f. numeral, acc.); prints without its medial alif (ثلثة), pointed with a dagger alif
فَتَسْتَرِيحُ: فَـ + تَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa, to rest (verb X, imperf. 2ms)
التَّعَبِ: الـ + تَعَب — taʿab, fatigue, weariness (m., gen.)
وَالْجَهْدِ: وَ + الـ + جَهْد — jahd, toil, exertion (m., gen.)
يَسْمَعُ: yasmaʿu — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
كَلَامَهُمَا: kalām + -humā — kalām, speech, talk (m., acc.) + 3md suffix; 'their (two) talk'
السَّوَّاقُ: الـ + سَوَّاق — sawwāq, drover, driver (intensive noun of agent, m., nom.)
بِعَشَاءِهِ: بِـ + عَشَاء + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.; atā/jāʾa bi- = come with, i.e. bring) + ʿashāʾ, evening meal, evening feed (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix
شَيْأً: shayʾan — shayʾ, thing (m., acc. indef.); 'a little, something' — printed شيأ, the hamza on the accusative alif instead of a yāʾ seat (Classical شيئا)
يَسِيرًا: yasīr — small, slight (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'a little'
وَأَصْبَحَ: وَ + أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa, to come to be, to do in the morning (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يَأْخُذُ: yaʾkhudhu — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
فَوَجَادَهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ـهُ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; prints with an extra plene alif (فوجاده) not seen in the identical phrase earlier, but read the same way
فَحَزِنَ: فَـ + حَزِنَ — ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَقَٰلَ: وَ + قَالَ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); printed defectively قل
قَدَرَ: qadara — to be able (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَشْغُلُ: yashghulu — shaghala, to work, be occupied (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
الْحَرْثِ: الـ + حَرْث — ḥarth, ploughing, tillage (m., gen.)
مُتَقَصِّرٌ: mutaqaṣṣir — falling short, remiss, off his feed (act. part. of V taqaṣṣara; m., nom. indef.)
يَأْكُلْ: yaʾkul — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam)
اللَّيْلَةَ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., acc. as adv.); 'this night'
ذَاقَ: dhāqa — to taste (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَوْلَايَ: mawlā + -ya — mawlā, master, lord (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my master'
اِمْضِ: imḍi — maḍā, to go, proceed (verb I, imper. 2ms); 'go!'
وَخُذِ: وَ + خُذِ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imper. 2ms, irregular, without hamzat waṣl)
وَحَرْثُهُ: وَ + حَرْث + ـهُ — ḥarth, ploughing (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his ploughing' — a nominal clause, not a further imperative
مَكَانَهُ: makān + -ahu — makān, place (m., acc. as adv.) + 3ms suffix; 'in his place, his stead'; also: object of ʿarafa, 'his whereabouts': aʿrifu makānahu, 'I know where he is'
الْيَوْمَ: الـ + يَوْم — yawm, day (m., acc. as adv.); 'today'; also: after dhālika, acc. of time: dhālika al-yawma, 'on that day, all that day'
كُلَّهُ: kull + -ahu — kull, all, whole (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'all of it'
آخِرَ: ākhir — end, last part (m., acc.); 'at the end of'
حَرَثَهُ: ḥaratha + -hu — ḥaratha, to plough (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he ploughed it'
شَكَرَهُ: shakara + -hu — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he thanked him'
تَفَضُّلَاتِهِ: تَفَضُّلَات + ـهِ — tafaḍḍul, favor, kindness (m. pl. tafaḍḍulāt; gen.) + 3ms suffix
أَرَاحَهُ: arāḥa + -hu — arāḥa, to give rest, relieve (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; masculine although its antecedent تَفَضُّلَاتِهِ is a feminine plural
يَرُدَّ: yaruddu — radda, to return, give back (verb I geminate, jussive 3ms after lam); also subj. after an ('to give back an answer')
وَنَدِمَ: وَ + نَدِمَ — nadima, to regret, repent (verb I, perf. 3ms)
شِدَّةَ: shidda — intensity (f., acc. as adv. intensifier); 'with the utmost of'
أَوْيَوْمَيْنِ: أَوْ + يَوْمَيْنِ — printed fused with no space in the edition (unlike its second occurrence right after, او ثلثة, printed separately); aw, 'or' + yawmayn, two days (dual, acc.); 'or two days'
فَلَمَّاكَانَ: فَـ + لَمَّا + كَانَ — fa-, so/then + lammā, when + kāna, to be, was (perf. 3ms); 'and when it was' (printed by the edition with no space between lammā and kāna, kept as printed)
ثَانِيَ: thānī, second (ordinal adj., m. acc. as khabar kāna, in idāfa with yawm); 'the second (of a)'; here thāniya marratin, 'a second time', adverbial accusative
يَوْمٍ: yawm — day (m., gen. sg. as second term of the idāfa); ثاني يوم, 'the next day'
الزَّرَّاعُ: الـ + زَرَّاع — zarrāʿ, sower, ploughman, farmer (intensive noun of profession; m., nom.)
وَأَخَذَ: وَ + أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَحَرَثَهُ: وَ + حَرَثَ + ـهُ — ḥaratha, to plow (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'and he plowed with him'
آخِرِ: ākhir — end, last part (m., gen. as first term of idāfa); 'the end of'
فَمَا: فَـ + مَا — fa-, so/and + mā, not (neg. particle) Also fa- + mā, what? (interrog.): fa-mā alladhī tushīru bihi ʿalayya, 'so what is it that you advise me?'.
مَسْلُوخَ: maslūkh — flayed, skinned (pass. part. of salakha; m. acc., first term of idāfa, no tanwīn since idāfa); 'flayed-of'
الرَّقَبَةِ: الـ + رَقَبَة — raqaba, neck (f., gen. as second term of idāfa); مَسْلُوخَ الرَّقَبَةِ, 'flayed-of-neck'
مَيِّتًا: mayyit — dead (act. part. of māta; m. acc. indef., ḥāl)
فَتَأَمَّلَهُ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلَ + ـهُ — taʾammala, to regard closely, contemplate (verb V, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix; 'so he regarded him closely'
فَشَكَرَهُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + ـهُ — shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
وَمَدَحَهُ: وَ + مَدَحَ + ـهُ — madaḥa, to praise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms suffix
قَاعِدًا: qāʿid — sitting, seated (act. part. of qaʿada; m. acc. indef., khabar kāna)
بِطُولِي: بِـ + طُول + ـي — bi-, in/by + ṭūl, length, extent (m., gen.) + 1cs suffix; idiom 'sitting at my ease, minding my own time'
خَلَّانِي: khallā — to leave, let be (verb II); perf. 3ms + 1cs object suffix khallānī, 'it left me (alone)'
فُضُولِي: فُضُول + ـي — fuḍūl, meddling, nosiness, prying (m.) + 1cs suffix; 'my meddling'
أَنِّي: أَنَّ + ـِي — anna, that (particle governing the acc.) + 1cs suffix as its subject; 'that I'
نَاصِحٌ: nāṣiḥ — advisor, well-wisher (act. part. of naṣaḥa; m. nom. indef., khabar)
سَمِعْتُ: samiʿtu — I heard (samiʿa, perf. 1cs) Also with min, 'to listen to, heed': samiʿtu min wālidī, 'I had listened to my father'.
أُسْتَاذَنَا: أُسْتَاذ + ـنَا — ustādh, master, teacher (m., acc.) + 1cp suffix; 'our master'
يَقُمِ: yaqum — he rises, gets up (qāma, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam; -i- helping vowel before the following al-)
مَوْضِعِهِ: مَوْضِع + ـهِ — mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his place'
أَعْطُوهُ: aʿṭū — give! (verb IV aʿṭā, imper. 2mp) + 3ms object suffix; 'give him!'
لِلْجَزَّارِ: لِـ + الـ + جَزَّار — jazzār, butcher (intensive noun of profession; m., gen.); 'to the butcher'
يَذْبَحُهُ: yadhbaḥu — he slaughters (dhabaḥa, imperf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix
وَيَعْمَلُ: وَ + يَعْمَلُ — yaʿmalu, he makes, turns (ʿamila, imperf. 3ms)
جِلْدَهُ: جِلْد + ـهُ — jild, hide, skin (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his hide'
قِطَعًا: qiṭaʿ — pieces (m. pl. of qiṭʿa; acc. indef., second complement of yaʿmalu); also after qaṭṭaʿa, acc. of the result: qaṭṭaʿa laḥmahumā qiṭaʿan, 'cut their flesh into pieces' (Night 201)
نَصَحْتُكَ: naṣaḥtu — I advised (naṣaḥa, perf. 1cs) + 2ms object suffix; 'I have advised you'
كَلَامَ: kalām — speech, words (m., acc., first term of idāfa)
بُكْرَهْ: bukrah — early morning, tomorrow morning (f. time-adverb; the edition prints the word with plain hāʾ, بكره, rather than the expected tāʾ marbūṭa of بُكْرَة, kept as printed); 'tomorrow'
أَسْرَحُ: asraḥu — I go out to pasture (saraḥa, imperf. 1cs)
مَعَهُمْ: مَعَ + ـهُمْ — maʿa, with + 3mp suffix; 'with them'
عَلَفَهُ: عَلَف + ـهُ — ʿalaf, fodder (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fodder'
بِتَمَامِهِ: بِـ + تَمَام + ـهِ — bi-, with/in + tamām, completeness (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'in its entirety'
الْمِذْوَدَ: الـ + مِذْوَد — midhwad, manger, feeding-trough (m., acc.; instrument/place noun of pattern mifʿal)
بِلِسَانِهِ: بِـ + لِسَان + ـهِ — bi-, with + lisān, tongue (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix
وَصَاحِبُهُمْ: وَ + صَاحِب + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + ṣāḥib, companion, owner, master (m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'and their master'
كَلَامَهُمْ: كَلَام + ـهُمْ — kalām, speech (m., acc.) + 3mp suffix; 'their speech'
طَلَعَ: ṭalaʿa — to go up, climb, ascend, rise (verb I, perf. 3ms) — of a person climbing, or of the day breaking; with ilā + a person, idiomatically 'to go in to, be brought before'; also 'to turn out, prove to be', with an accusative predicate like kāna (colloquial): in ṭalaʿa maʿshūqī aḥsana, 'if my beloved turns out more beautiful'
خَرَجَ: kharaja — to go out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَزَوْجَتُهُ: وَ + زَوْجَة + ـهُ — wa-, and + zawja, wife (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix
دَارِ: dār — house, dwelling (f., gen. as first term of idāfa)
الْبَقَرِ: الـ + بَقَر — baqar, cattle, oxen (coll., m., gen.); دَارِ الْبَقَرِ, 'the cattle-house, byre'
فَجَاءَ: فَـ + جَاءَ — fa-, then + jāʾa, to come (perf. 3ms)
أُسْتَاذَهُ: أُسْتَاذ + ـهُ — ustādh, master (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his master'
طَرْطَرَ: ṭarṭara — to flick, whisk (about) (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms; of a tail)
ذَيْلَهُ: ذَيْل + ـهُ — dhayl, tail (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix
وَضَرَطَ: وَ + ضَرَطَ — wa-, and + ḍaraṭa, to fart (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَبَرْطَعَ: وَ + بَرْطَعَ — wa-, and + barṭaʿa, to caper, frisk about (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَضَحِكَ: فَـ + ضَحِكَ — fa-, so + ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اسْتَلْقَى: istalqā — to lie back, fall backward (verb X, perf. 3ms; hamzat waṣl, initial alif unmarked)
قَفَاهُ: قَفَا + ـهُ — qafā, nape, back of the neck (m., defective noun) + 3ms suffix
زَوْجَتُهُ: زَوْجَة + ـهُ — zawja, wife (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his wife'
أَيِّ: ayy — which (interrog./indef. noun, gen. as first term of idāfa with shayʾ)
رَأَيْتُهُ: raʾaytu — I saw (raʾā, perf. 1cs; the edition already prints the hamza here, kept precomposed) + 3ms object suffix; in Night 168 (P808L09) the print has the misprint رأبته, corrected to رأيته
وَسَمِعْتُهُ: وَ + سَمِعْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + samiʿtu, I heard (perf. 1cs) + 3ms object suffix
أَبُوحُ: abūḥu — I disclose, reveal (bāḥa, imperf. 1cs, measure I)
فَأَمُوتَ: فَـ + أَمُوتَ — fa-, so/or else + amūta, I die (māta, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after fa- of result)
تُخْبِرَنِي: tukhbira — you inform (akhbara, imperf. 2ms subjunctive, measure IV) + 1cs object suffix
وَبِسَبَبِ: وَ + بِـ + سَبَب — wa-, and + bi-, by reason of + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.)
ضَحِكِكَ: ضَحِك + ـكَ — ḍaḥik, laughing, laughter (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your laughing'
تَمُوتُ: tamūtu — you die, dying (māta, imperf. 2ms, khabar kunta)
أُبِيحَ: ubīḥa — I disclose, reveal (abāḥa, imperf. 1cs subjunctive, measure IV)
خَوْفًا: khawf — fear (m., acc. indef., object for the sake of which); 'for fear'; also: the verb's own noun as object, strengthening it: khāfat … khawfan ʿaẓīman, 'she was sorely afraid' (Night 192)
إِنَّهَا: إِنَّ + ـهَا — inna, indeed (particle) + 3fs suffix as its subject; 'indeed she'
تَزَلْ: tazal — she ceases (zāla, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam; lam tazal, 'she did not cease'); also: 2ms, 'you cease', jussive after lam: wa-lam tazal ʿalā tilka al-ḥālati, 'and keep on in that state' (Night 192)
تُلِحُّ: tuliḥḥu — she presses, insists (alaḥḥa, imperf. 3fs, measure IV of laḥḥa)
وَتَلِجُّ: وَ + تَلِجُّ — wa-, and + talijju, she persists stubbornly (lajja, imperf. 3fs)
غُلِبَ: ghuliba — he was overcome, overpowered (ghalaba, perf. 3ms pass.)
وَضَجِرَ: وَ + ضَجِرَ — wa-, and + ḍajira, to grow weary, exasperated (verb I, perf. 3ms)
فَأَحْضَرَ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ — fa-, so + aḥḍara, to summon, bring (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَوْلَادَهُ: أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — awlād, children, sons (m. pl.; acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
وَأَرْسَلَ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ — wa-, and + arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَحْضِرِ: aḥḍir — bring! (verb IV aḥḍara, imper. 2ms; -i helping vowel before the following al-)
الْقَاضِيَ: الـ + قَاضِي — qāḍī, judge (m., defective noun, acc. as object of aḥḍir)
وَالشُّهُودَ: وَ + الـ + شُهُود — wa-, and + shuhūd, witnesses (m. pl. of shāhid; acc., coordinated with al-qāḍiya)
وَأَرَادَ: وَ + أَرَادَ — wa-, and + arāda, to wish, intend (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يُوصِيَ: yūṣiya — he make his testament, bequeath (awṣā, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, measure IV)
وَيُبِيحَ: وَ + يُبِيحَ — wa-, and + yubīḥa, he disclose (abāḥa, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, measure IV)
بِالسِّرِّ: بِـ + الـ + سِرّ — bi-, with + sirr, secret (m., gen.)
وَيَمُوتَ: وَ + يَمُوتَ — wa-, and + yamūta, he die (māta, imperf. 3ms subjunctive)
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـهُ — li-, because + anna, that (particle) + 3ms suffix as its subject; 'because he'
يُحِبُّهَا: yuḥibbu — he loves (aḥabba, imperf. 3ms, measure IV) + 3fs object suffix
مَحَبَّةً: maḥabba — love, affection (f., acc.; cognate object of yuḥibbu, or specification after a verb of increase: yazdādāni maḥabbatan, 'growing in love')
عَظِيمَةً: ʿaẓīma — great, mighty (adj., f. sg. acc. agreeing with maḥabba) Also agreeing with ṣarkha: ṣarkhatan ʿaẓīmatan, 'a great shriek'.; also: agreeing with raghba: raghbatan ʿaẓīmatan, 'a great desire'
بِنْتُ: bint — daughter (f., nom., first term of idāfa)
عَمِّهِ: عَمّ + ـهِ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his paternal uncle'
وَأُمُّ: وَ + أُمُّ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., nom., first term of idāfa)
أَوْلَادِهِ: أَوْلَاد + ـهِ — awlād, children (m. pl., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
عُمِّرَ: ʿummira — he was granted long life, he lived to (ʿammara, perf. 3ms pass., measure II)
الْعُمُرِ: الـ + عُمُر — ʿumur, age, lifetime (m., gen.)
مِأْيَةً: miʾya — hundred (f., acc. as a numeral in a time-duration phrase; the edition spells the word with the hamza on the alif rather than on the yāʾ, as in the ordinary spelling مِائَة/مِئَة — kept as printed and read as 'a hundred')
وَعِشْرِينَ: وَ + عِشْرِينَ — wa-, and + ʿishrīn, twenty (numeral, acc./gen. form)
أَبُو: abū — father of (m., nom. of the 'five nouns', first term of an iḍāfa, in apposition to zawjuki)
أَبِيهَا: أَب + ـهَا — ab, father (m.; one of the 'five nouns', oblique form abī) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
أَحْضَرَ: aḥḍara — to have brought, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
أَرْجِعُ: arjiʿu — rajaʿa, to turn back, return (verb I, imperf. 1s)
أَسَرِّ: asarr — happiest, most delightful (elative of sārr; m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); fī asarri l-aḥwāl = 'in the happiest of conditions', a fixed idiom
أَفْعَلُ: afʿalu — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 1s); 'I will do' — not the imperative
أَقُولَ: aqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s after ḥattā)
أَمْرَهُ: أَمْر + ـهُ — amr, affair, matter (m., acc. as object) + 3ms poss.; 'his affair'
أَهْلِهَا: أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., gen. as second term of jamīʿ's iḍāfa) + 3fs poss.; 'her people'
أَوْلَادِكِ: أَوْلَاد + ـكِ — walad, child, son (m. pl. awlād; gen.) + 2fs poss.; 'your children'
أُرَاضِي: urāḍī — rāḍā, to please, keep content (verb III, imperf. 1s)
أُغْمِيَ: ughmiya — aghmā ʿalā, to overcome, cause to faint (verb IV, passive perf. 3ms); ughmiya ʿalayhā = 'she fainted'
ابْنَةُ: ibna — daughter (f., nom., hamzat waṣl, first term of an iḍāfa)
اتْرُكِي: تَرَكَ — taraka, to leave, abandon (verb I, imper. 2fs, hamzat waṣl); 'leave (it)!'
التَّاجِرَ: الـ + تَاجِر — tājir, merchant (m., acc. as subject of inna)
التُّوتِ: الـ + تُوت — tūt, mulberry (m., gen.); ʿīdān al-tūt = mulberry rods, switches for beating
الدَّوَابِّ: الـ + دَوَابّ — dābba, beast, animal (f. broken pl. dawābb; gen.); dār al-dawābb = the stable
الدِّيكَ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., acc. as object)
الدِّيكُ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., nom. as subject)
الدِّيكِ: الـ + دِيك — dīk, rooster (m., gen. after ʿalā)
الْأَحْوَالِ: الـ + أَحْوَال — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f. pl. aḥwāl; gen.)
الْجَمَاعَةُ: الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, company, group, party (f., nom. as subject)
الْخِزَانَةَ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., acc. as object)
الْخِزَانَةِ: الـ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, closet, storeroom (f., gen.)
الْعَقْلِ: الـ + عَقْل — ʿaql, mind, reason, wit (m., gen.)
الْقِصَّةَ: الـ + قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبَ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., acc. as object)
الْكَلْبُ: الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., nom. as subject)
الْمَمَاتِ: الـ + مَمَات — mamāt, death (m., gen. after ilā)
بَابَ: bāb — door, gate (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
بَاسَتْ: bāsat — bāsa, to kiss (verb I, perf. 3fs)
بِالضَّرْبِ: بِـ + الـ + ضَرْب — bi-, with (prep. of instrument or manner, 'with the striking'), or bi- of cause ('by reason of the blows', rajaʿū bi-al-ḍarbi) + al-, the + ḍarb, beating, striking (m., gen.)
بِزَوْجَتِهِ: بِـ + زَوْجَة + ـهِ — zawja, wife (f., gen. after bi-) + 3ms poss.; 'with his wife'
بِهَا: بِـ + هَا — bi-, with, in (prep.) + hā, it/her (f.sg.); (1) locative, 'in it' (of a place: فَارْتَاحَ بِهَا خَاطِرِي, 'my mind found rest in it'); (2) instrumental, 'with it' (ضَرَبْتُهُ بِهَا, 'I struck it with it'); (3) 'with her'; (4) after atā/jāʾa, 'bring' (atat bihā, 'she brought it'); here: (1) in aqāma bihā, 'stay in it' (the city of Basra), and (2) in yatawaṣṣalu bihā, 'make his way by means of it' (the ruse, ḥīla); here: after dakhala, 'to bring in': dakhalat bihā dāra al-jawhariyyi, 'she brought her into the jeweller's house' Also after shughifa, 'to be smitten', bi- marks the one loved: man shughifta bihā, 'the one you are smitten with'. Also after samaḥa, 'to grant, be generous', bi- marks the thing granted: laylatan samaḥa al-zamānu lanā bihā, 'a night that Time granted us'; and after sakana, 'to dwell', bi- is 'in': sākinun bihā, 'living in it'.; also: of an affliction resting on someone: mimmā kāna bihā, 'from what was upon her, what ailed her' Also after wakkala, 'to set over', bi- marks the one guarded: wakkala bihā ʿishrīna khādiman, 'set twenty eunuchs over her'; and after ijtamaʿa, 'to meet with': lam ajtamiʿ bihā, 'I have not met with her'.; also after atā, 'to come', bi- marks what is brought: taʾtiya bihā, 'bring her'; also: after zawwaja, 'to marry (someone) to', and zawāj, 'marriage', bi- marks the bride: zawwijnī bihā, 'marry me to her'; zawājī bihā, 'my marrying her'; after tamallā, 'to enjoy to the full', bi- marks what is enjoyed: li-atamallā bihā, 'that I may take my fill of her'; also: after imtaḥana, 'to test', bi- marks the means of the trial: li-yamtaḥinanī bihā, 'to test me with her' Also after tazawwaja, 'to marry', bi- marks the bride: an atazawwaja bihā, 'to marry her' (Night 188).; also: after ightarra, 'to be deceived', bi- marks what deceives: fa-ightararta bihā, 'and you were deceived by them (the nights)' (Night 192); also after zāda, 'to grow', bi- marks the one it grows in: zāda bihā al-wajdu, 'passion grew in her'; after mutaʿalliq, 'attached', bi- marks what one clings to: mutaʿalliqan bihā, 'set on her'; after ʿalima, 'to know', bi- marks what is known of: wa-lā yaʿlamu bihā aḥadun, 'with no one knowing of her' (Night 193); also after marra, 'to pass', bi- marks what is passed: yamurru bihā, 'passes by it (a city)' (Night 194); here: of the cause, 'through her, on her account': in qutiltu bihā jawan, 'if I am slain through her by passion'; also of time, 'for which, on which': al-laylati allatī akhadhnā bihā minhu al-idhna, 'the night for which we took leave of him' (Night 201); here after zawwaja bi-, bi- marks the bride: 'to her'
تَتُوبَ: tatūba — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَسْأَلُهُ: تَسْأَلُ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; the edition already prints the hamza seat here
تَعُودَ: taʿūda — ʿāda, to return, go back (to doing something) (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs)
تَمُوتَ: tamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3fs after an (here an tamūta) or ḥattā)
تُبْتُ: tubtu — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I repent'
جَارَتِهِ: جَارَة + ـهِ — jāra, female neighbor (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his (female) neighbor'
جَمِيعُ: jamīʿ — all, the whole of (m., nom. as subject, first term of an iḍāfa)
حَضَرَهَا: حَضَرَ + ـهَا — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'was present with her'
حِكَايَةٌ: ḥikāya — tale, story (f., nom. indef., delayed subject of the nominal sentence)
خِزَانَةٍ: khizāna — closet, storeroom, cabinet (f., gen. indef. after ilā)
دَجَاجَةً: dajāja — hen (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsūna)
دَخَلَ: dakhala — to enter, go in (verb I, perf. 3ms)
دِيكٌ: dīk — rooster, cock (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
رَائِحٌ: rāʾiḥ — going, departing (act. part. I of rāḥa; m. nom.); with a following imperfect, 'going to, about to'
زَوْجَةً: zawja — wife (f., acc. sg. as the counted noun after khamsīna)
زَوْجَةٍ: zawja — wife (f., gen. indef., second term of the iḍāfa with fardu)
زَوْجُكِ: زَوْج + ـكِ — zawj, husband (m., nom. as subject) + 2fs poss.; 'your husband'
سَمِعَتِ: samiʿati — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3fs; final vowel -i as liaison before the following hamzat waṣl)
سِرِّهِ: سِرّ + ـهِ — sirr, secret (m., gen. after ʿalā) + 3ms poss.; 'his secret'
شَهْرَزَادَ: Shahrazād — the vizier's daughter's name (proper name, diptote, -a for acc. or gen.: object of adraka in the closing formula; gen. in apposition elsewhere)
شَيْ: shayʾ — thing, anything; the edition's colloquial spelling drops the word's final hamza entirely, shay for shayʾ
عَلَيْهَا: عَلَى + ـهَا — ʿalā, upon, against, to (prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'on her, against her'; with aqbala, 'came up to her'; with qaṣṣa, 'related to her' Also with radda al-salāma, ʿalā marks the one greeted: radda ʿalayhā al-salāma, 'he returned her greeting'; here: after ghalaba ʿalā, 'overcome', ʿalā marks the one overcome: 'overcome her'; here: radda ʿalayhā jawāban, 'gave her an answer', ʿalā marking the one answered; here: 'on it' (sat on the mattress), and after qāla, 'about her': qultu ʿalayhā, 'I told about her' Also after ʿaraḍa, 'to lay before', ʿalā marks the one asked to consider: ʿaraḍat ʿalayhā al-kalāma, 'she put the proposal to her'. Also after fattasha, 'to search', ʿalā marks what is sought (Middle Arabic for ʿan): وَأُفَتِّشُ عَلَيْهَا 'and search for her'.; also: after al-dukhūl, 'going in to': al-dukhūli ʿalayhā, 'going in to her'; also: after karrara, the one addressed; after iḥtaraqa qalbuhu, the one feared for: iḥtaraqa qalbuhu ʿalayhā, 'his heart burned for her'; after rasama, the one guarded; after ghaḍbān, the one he is angry with (Night 179); after ghāra, 'to be jealous', ʿalā marks the woman one is jealous over: yaghāru ʿalayhā, 'is jealous over her' (Night 179); here also: after hāja, 'to surge', ʿalā marks the one overcome: hājat ʿalayhā al-shahwatu, 'desire surged up in her'
عَنْهُ: عَنْ + ـهُ — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'from it'; here also: 'about him', after saʾala, which takes ʿan for the one asked about; and 'from him' after takhalluf and inqaṭaʿa Also after ʿiwaḍ, 'replacement', ʿan marks what is replaced: ʿiwaḍan ʿanhu, 'in return for it'.; also after ghāba, 'to be absent', ʿan marks the one left: ghibnā ʿanhu, 'we stay away from him' (Night 201)
عِنْدِهِمْ: عِنْدَ + ـهِمْ — ʿinda, at, with, among (prep.) + 3mp suffix; 'from among them'
عِيدَانِ: عِيدَان — ʿūd, stick, rod (m. pl. ʿīdān; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَأَعَادَ: فَـ + أَعَادَ — aʿāda, to repeat, do again (verb IV, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'to recount to'
فَدَخَلَتْ: فَـ + دَخَلَتْ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she entered'
فَرْحَانُ: farḥān — joyful, glad (adj. of the faʿlān pattern, m. nom., predicate of anta)
فَرْدُ: fard — single, sole (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
فَسَكَتُوا: فَـ + سَكَتُوا — sakata, to fall silent (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَسَمِعَ: فَـ + سَمِعَ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَامَ: qāma — to rise, get up (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
قَفَلَ: qafala — to lock, bolt (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلِيلُ: qalīl — little, scant (adj., m. nom., first term of an iḍāfa, predicate of inna); qalīl al-ʿaql = 'scant of wit, foolish'
لِئَلَّا: لِـ + أَلَّا — li- + allā (an + lā), so that not; 'lest'
لِابْنَتِهِ: لِـ + ابْنَة + ـهِ — ibna, daughter (f., gen. after li-, hamzat waṣl) + 3ms poss.; 'to his daughter'
لِلْكَلْبِ: لِـ + الـ + كَلْب — kalb, dog (m., gen. after li-)
مَاتَ: māta — to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
مَعَكِ: مَعَ + ـكِ — maʿa, with (prep.) + 2fs suffix; 'with you'
مَقَالَةَ: maqāla — saying, speech, utterance (f., acc. as object, first term of an iḍāfa); here: acc. saying what kind of speaking it was: fa-qālat … maqālata man …, 'she said, in the words of one who …'
مِثْلَ: mithla — like, the equal of (adv. acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
وَأَدَعَهُ: وَ + أَدَعَ + ـهُ — wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let be (verb I, defective in the perfect, imperf. subjunctive 1s) + 3ms obj.; 'and I leave him'
وَأَمُوتَ: وَ + أَمُوتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 1s)
وَأَهْلَ: وَ + أَهْل — ahl, people, family (m., acc., coordinate object of aḥḍara, first term of its own iḍāfa)
وَأَهْلُهَا: وَ + أَهْل + ـهَا — ahl, people, family (m., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her people'
وَأُسْتَاذُنَا: وَ + أُسْتَاذ + ـنَا — ustādh, master (m., nom. as topic) + 1pl poss.; 'and our master'
وَأُصَالِحُ: وَ + أُصَالِحُ — ṣālaḥa, to make peace with, reconcile with (verb III, imperf. 1s)
وَإِنَّهُ: وَ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms subject; 'and indeed he/it'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُ — iyyā-, the independent object-pronoun base + 3ms suffix; 'and him'
وَتَابَتْ: وَ + تَابَتْ — tāba, to repent, turn back (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَتَحْتَهُ: وَ + تَحْتَ + ـهُ — taḥta, under, beneath (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'and under him'
وَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَ — tawajjaha, to make one's way, set out (verb V, perf. 3ms)
وَخَبَأَهُمْ: وَ + خَبَأَ + ـهُمْ — khabaʾa, to hide, conceal (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; the edition already prints this hamza; 'and hid them'
وَخَرَجَتْ: وَ + خَرَجَتْ — kharaja, to go out, leave (verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَرِجْلَيْهِ: وَ + رِجْل (dual) + ـهِ — rijl, foot (f. dual acc. rijlayn) + 3ms poss.; 'and his two feet'
وَفَرِحُوا: وَ + فَرِحُوا — fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَقَعَدُوا: وَ + قَعَدُوا — qaʿada, to sit, settle, remain (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَنَزَلَ: وَ + نَزَلَ — nazala, to come down, descend (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā bi-, 'to set upon with' Also with bi- of company, 'to lead down': nazala bī fī darbin, 'he led me down into a lane'.
وَيَدْخُلْ: وَ + يَدْخُلْ — dakhala, to enter, go in (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms, coordinate with yaʾkhudh under lam)
وَيَسُبُّ: وَ + يَسُبُّ — sabba, to curse, revile (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَضْرِبْهَا: وَ + يَضْرِبْ + ـهَا — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and beat her'
وَيَقُولُ: وَ + يَقُولُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms)
وَيَمُوتُ: وَ + يَمُوتُ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms)
يَأْخُذْ: yaʾkhudh — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. jussive 3ms after lam); the edition prints يأخذ with its hamza seat already in place
يَتَوَضَّى: tawaḍḍā — to perform ablution, wash (verb V, imperf. 3ms); the edition drops the verb's usual final hamza (Classical tawaḍḍaʾa), spelling it as a final-weak verb
يَسُوسُ: yasūsu — sāsa, to manage, govern, administer (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); here as a bare complement verb after yaʿrifu, 'know how to manage'
يَعْرِفُ: yaʿrifu — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
يَقُولَ: yaqūla — qāla, to say, tell (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā)
يَمُوتَ: yamūta — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. subjunctive 3ms after li-allā)
يَمُوتُ: yamūtu — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. indic. 3ms); 'he dies'
يَنْظُرَنِي: yanẓuranī — naẓara, to look, see (verb I, imperf. subjunctive 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'see me'
يُخَاطِبُ: yukhāṭibu — khāṭaba, to address, speak to (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
يُنَادِي: yunādī — nādā, to call out, cry aloud (verb III, imperf. 3ms)
فَجَهَّزَهَا: فَ + جَهَّزَ + هَا — jahhaza, to make ready, equip, prepare (a bride) (v. II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he made her ready'
وَطَلَعَ: وَ + طَلَعَ — ṭalaʿa, to go up, ascend; here loosely 'go in to' (v. I, perf. 3ms) Also of the day or the sun, 'to rise': wa-ṭalaʿa al-nahāru, 'and the day rose'.
أَوْصَتْ: awṣat — awṣā, to charge, instruct, enjoin (v. IV, perf. 3fs); 'she had instructed'
أُخْتَهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'her sister'
الصَّغِيرَةَ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., acc.)
تَوَجَّهْتُ: tawajjahtu — tawajjaha, to set out, head toward, proceed (v. V, perf. 1cs); 'I have gone, I proceed'
أُرْسِلُ: ursilu — arsala, to send (v. IV, imperf. 1cs); 'I send, I will send'
أَطْلُبُكِ: أَطْلُبُ + كِ — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for, send for (v. I, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I summon you'
فَإِذَا: فَ + إِذَا — fa-, so, then + idhā, when; 'then when'
جِئْتِ: jiʾti — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'you have come'
وَرَأَيْتِ: وَ + رَأَيْتِ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 2fs); 'and you have seen'
قَضَى: qaḍā — to accomplish, fulfill, finish (v. I, perf. 3ms); here of God, 'to decree': idhā qaḍā amran, 'when He decrees a thing'
حَاجَتَهُ: حَاجَة + هُ — ḥāja, need, want (f., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his need'; also: qaḍā ḥājatahu, 'he fulfilled his need', i.e. relieved himself
مِنِّي: مِنْ + ي — min, from (prep.) + 1cs; 'from me' Also after fazaʿ, 'fear', min marks what is feared: fazaʿun ʿaẓīmun minnī, 'a great fear of me'.
تَقُولِي: taqūlī — qāla, to say (v. I, imperf./juss. 2fs, without the final nūn); 'you shall say'
أُخْتِي: أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'my sister'
حَدِّثِينِي: حَدِّثِي + نِي — ḥaddatha, to tell, narrate, relate (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1cs obj.; 'tell me'
حَدِيثًا: ḥadīthan — ḥadīth, an account, a tale, a discourse (m., indef. acc.)
وَكَلَامًا: وَ + كَلَامًا — kalām, speech, talk, conversation (m., indef. acc.)
نَقْطَعُ: naqṭaʿu — qaṭaʿa, to cut (v. I, imperf. 1pl); with bi-, 'we while away, pass (the time)'
وَالسَّهَرَ: وَ + الـ + سَهَر — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc.)
أُحَدِّثُكِ: أُحَدِّثُ + كِ — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (v. II, imperf. 1cs) + 2fs obj.; 'I shall tell you'
شَاءَ: shāʾa — to will, wish (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْخَلَاصُ: الـ + خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape, release (m., nom.)
أَبَاهَا: أَب + هَا — ab, father (m., irregular noun, acc. as ism of inna) + 3fs poss.; 'her father'
رَآهُ: رَأَى + هُ — raʾā, to see (v. I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'he saw him'
فَرِحَ: fariḥa — to rejoice, be glad (v. I, perf. 3ms)
أَتَيْتَ: atayta — atā, to come, bring (v. I, perf. 2ms); 'you have brought'
بِحَاجَتِي: بِـ + حَاجَة + ي — ḥāja, need (f., gen. after bi-) + 1cs poss.; 'with my need'
يَدْخُلَ: yadkhula — dakhala, to enter, go in (v. I, imperf. subj. 3ms)
فَبَكَتْ: فَ + بَكَتْ — bakā, to weep (v. I, perf. 3fs)
مَالَكِ: مَا + لَـ + كِ — mā, what (interrog.) + li- + 2fs; 'what is with you, what ails you' (printed by the edition as one word)
أَيُّهَا: ayyuhā — O (vocative particle used before a following definite noun)
صَغِيرَةً: ṣaghīratan — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., indef. acc.)
وَأُرِيدُ: وَ + أُرِيدُ — arāda, to want, wish (v. IV, imperf. 1cs)
أُوَدِّعَهَا: وَدَّعَ + هَا — waddaʿa, to bid farewell to, take leave of (v. II, subj. 1cs after an) + 3fs obj.; 'that I bid her farewell'
فَأَرْسَلَ: فَ + أَرْسَلَ — arsala, to send (v. IV, perf. 3ms)
فَجَاءَتْ: فَ + جَاءَتْ — jāʾa, to come (v. I, perf. 3fs)
أُخْتِهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3fs poss.
وَعَانَقَتْهَا: وَ + عَانَقَتْ + هَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (v. III, perf. 3fs) + 3fs obj.
وَجَلَسَتْ: وَ + جَلَسَتْ — jalasa, to sit (v. I, perf. 3fs)
السَّرِيرِ: الـ + سَرِير — sarīr, bed, couch (m., gen.)
فَقَامَ: فَ + قَامَ — qāma, to rise, stand up (v. I, perf. 3ms)
بَكَارَتَهَا: بَكَارَة + هَا — bakāra, virginity, maidenhead (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.
يَتَحَدَّثُونَ: yataḥaddathūna — taḥaddatha, to converse, talk together (v. V, imperf. 3mp)
أُخْتُهَا: أُخْت + هَا — ukht, sister (f., nom.) + 3fs poss.
الصَّغِيرَةُ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīr, young, little (adj., f. sg., nom.)
حَدِّثِينَا: حَدِّثِي + نَا — ḥaddatha, to tell (v. II, imper. 2fs) + 1pl obj.; 'tell us'
سَهَرَ: sahara — sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
لَيْلَتِنَا: لَيْلَة + نَا — layla, night (f., gen.) + 1pl poss.; 'our night'
حُبًّا: ḥubban — ḥubb, love, fondness (m., indef. acc. of manner); with wa-karāmatan, the fixed idiom 'gladly'
أَذِنَ: adhina — to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
الْمُهَذَّبُ: الـ + مُهَذَّب — muhadhdhab, refined, courteous, well-bred (pass. part. of II hadhdhaba; m., nom.)
مِنْهُمَا: مِنْ + هُمَا — min, from (prep.) + 3rd dual pron.; 'from the two of them'; here: after tamakkana min, 'take firm hold of', min marks what is held: 'of the two of them'
قَلِقًا: qaliqan — qaliq, restless, uneasy, anxious (adj., m., indef. acc.)
لِسَمَاعِ: لِـ + سَمَاعِ — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) + samāʿ, hearing, listening (verbal noun of samiʿa; m., gen.)
الْحَدِيثِ: الـ + حَدِيث — ḥadīth, account, story, talk (m., gen.)
فَأَذِنَ: فَ + أَذِنَ — adhina, to give leave, permit (v. I, perf. 3ms)
