الْوَسْوَاسُ: الـ + وَسْوَاس — al-, the (article) + waswās, whispering, obsessive doubt (m., verbal noun of وَسْوَسَ); nominative subject of زَادَ Also subject of laḥiqa: laḥiqahu al-waswāsu, 'anxious thoughts came upon him'.
كِدْتُ: كِدْتُ — kidtu, to nearly do, be about to (verb I, root ك-و-د, perf. 1cs); كِدْتُ أَنْ, 'I nearly…'
أَجُنَّ: أَجُنَّ — ajunna, to go mad (verb I, root ج-ن-ن, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after أَنْ)
أَجِدْ: أَجِدْ — ajid, to find (verb I, root و-ج-د, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ)
فَرَجًا: فَرَجًا — farajan, relief, deliverance (m.), accusative object of أَجِدْ
دُونَ: دُونَ — dūna, short of, without, other than (prep.)
سَافَرْتُ: سَافَرْتُ — sāfartu, to travel, journey (verb III, root س-ف-ر, perf. 1cs)
أَبِي: أَب + ي — ab, father (m.) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my father' Also abī, genitive of abū, 'father of', in the name Abū al-Ḥasan: bayna yaday Abī al-Ḥasani, 'before Abū al-Ḥasan'.
فَسَاعَةَ: فَـ + سَاعَةَ — fa-, so (conj.) + sāʿata, hour, moment (f.), accusative of time; 'at the moment of'
وُصُولِي: وُصُول + ي — wuṣūl, arrival (m., verbal noun of وَصَلَ) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my arrival'
جَمَاعَةٌ: جَمَاعَةٌ — jamāʿatun, group, party (f.); nominative subject of نَهَضَ
وَكَتَّفُونِي: وَ + كَتَّفُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + kattafū, to pinion, bind the arms of (verb II, root ك-ت-ف, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'and they pinioned me'
سُلْطَانِ: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan, ruler (m.); genitive, construct with الْمَدِينَةِ
خَدَمُ: خَدَم — khadamu, servants (m. pl. of خَادِم); nominative predicate
وَغِلْمَانِي: وَ + غِلْمَان + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ghilmān, pages, young servants (m. pl. of غُلَام) + -ī, my (1cs suffix); 'and my pages'
فَلَحِقَنِي: فَـ + لَحِقَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'so it overtook me'
خَوْفٌ: خَوْفٌ — khawfun, fear (m.); nominative subject (e.g. of فَلَحِقَنِي, or of yaḥṣulu); 'fear'
زَائِدٌ: زَائِدٌ — zāʾidun, excessive, extra (m. sg. active participle of زَادَ); nominative adjective, agreeing with خَوْفٌ
تُرَى: تُرَى — turā, might it be seen (verb I, root ر-أ-ي, imperf. 3fs passive); يَا تُرَى, fixed exclamation, 'I wonder…'
وَأَسْأَلُ: وَ + أَسْأَلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + asʾalu, to ask (verb I, root س-أ-ل, imperf. 1cs); used here for immediate intention, 'and I will ask'
مَسَكُونِي: مَسَكُوا + نِي — masakū, to seize, lay hold of (verb I, root م-س-ك, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'they seized me'
يَرُدُّوا: يَرُدُّوا — yaruddū, to return, give back (verb I, root ر-د-د, imperf. 3mp jussive after لَمْ)
عَلَىَّ: عَلَى + ي — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -ī/-ya, me (1cs suffix); رَدَّ عَلَيَّ, 'to answer me'; the edition spells عَلَيَّ with the letter ى in place of a word-final يّ
حِينٍ: حِينٍ — ḥīnin, a while, a time (m.); genitive after بَعْدَ
خَادِمًا: خَادِمًا — khādiman, a servant (m. sg. active participle of خَدَمَ), accusative predicate of كَانَ Also as the counted noun after a number from eleven to ninety-nine, accusative singular: ʿishrīna khādiman, 'twenty servants' (in a palace, eunuchs). Also acc. object of jaʿala, 'to place, set': jaʿalū ʿalā bābi al-qāʿati khādiman, 'they set a servant at the door of the hall'.
أَبَاكَ: أَب + كَ — ab, father (m.) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); accusative, subject of the نّ-clause; 'your father'
غَدَرَ: غَدَرَ — ghadara, to betray, deal treacherously (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الزَّمَانُ: الـ + زَمَان — al-, the (article) + zamān, time, fortune (m.); nominative subject of غَدَرَ; also subject of taʿaddā ʿalā ('Time has wronged me')
وَخَامَرَ: وَ + خَامَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + khāmara, to conspire, plot (verb III, root خ-م-ر, perf. 3ms)
وَقَتَلَهُ: وَ + قَتَلَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (3ms obj.); 'and he killed him'
نَتَرَقَّبُ: نَتَرَقَّبُ — nataraqqabu, to watch for, await (verb V, root ر-ق-ب, imperf. 1cp)
بِأَمْرِهِ: بِـ + أَمْر + هِ — bi-, by (prep.) + amr, order, command (m.) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'by his order'
فَأَخَذُونِي: فَـ + أَخَذُوا + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadhū, to take, seize (verb I, root أ-خ-ذ, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'so they seized me'
غَائِبٌ: غَائِبٌ — ghāʾibun, absent (m. sg. active participle of غَابَ); nominative predicate; here also ghāʾib ʿan al-wujūd, 'absent from existence', i.e. senseless, unconscious
سَمِعْتُهَا: سَمِعْتُ + هَا — samiʿtu, to hear (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it/her (3fs obj.); 'I heard it'
تَمَثَّلْتُ: تَمَثَّلْتُ — tamaththaltu, to present oneself, stand (verb V, root م-ث-ل, perf. 1cs); تَمَثَّلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ, 'to stand before someone'
وَبَيْنَ: وَ + بَيْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + bayna, between (prep.)
عَدَاوَةٌ: عَدَاوَةٌ — ʿadāwatun, enmity, hostility (f.); nominative subject of كَانَ
قَدِيمَةٌ: قَدِيمَةٌ — qadīmatun, old, ancient (f. sg. adj.); nominative, agreeing with عَدَاوَةٌ
وَسَبَبُ: وَ + سَبَبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sababu, cause, reason (m.); nominative, topicalized
الْعَدَاوَةِ: الـ + عَدَاوَة — al-, the (article) + ʿadāwah, enmity (f.); genitive, construct with سَبَبُ
مُولَعًا: مُولَعًا — mūlaʿan, fond, enamored (m. sg. passive participle of أَوْلَعَ), accusative predicate of كُنْتُ
بِطَائِرٍ: بِـ + طَائِرٍ — bi-, (marking what suddenly appears, after وَإِذَا) + ṭāʾirin, a bird (m. sg. active participle of طَارَ), indefinite genitive; 'and behold, a bird'
فَأَرَدْتُ: فَـ + أَرَدْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + aradtu, to want, wish (verb IV, root ر-و-د, perf. 1cs)
أَضْرِبَ: أَضْرِبَ — aḍriba, to strike, shoot (verb I, root ض-ر-ب, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after أَنْ)
الطَّيْرَ: الـ + طَيْر — al-, the (article) + ṭayr, bird (m. collective); accusative object of أَضْرِبَ
بِالْبُنْدُقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + بُنْدُقَة — bi-, with (prep., marking what suddenly appears after وَإِذَا) + al-, the (article) + bunduqah, pellet (f. sg. of بُنْدُق); 'and behold, the pellet'
أَخْطَأَتْ: أَخْطَأَتْ — akhṭaʾat, to miss, err, go astray (verb IV, root خ-ط-أ, perf. 3fs)
عَيْنِ: عَيْن — ʿayn, eye (f.); genitive, construct with الْوَزِيرِ
قَلَعْتُهَا: قَلَعْتُ + هَا — qalaʿtu, to pull out, put out, gouge out (verb I, root ق-ل-ع, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it/her (3fs obj., referring to الْعَيْن, 'the eye'); 'I put it (the eye) out'
بِالْقَضَا: بِـ + الـ + قَضَا — bi-, by (prep.) + al-, the (article) + qaḍā, decree (m., here spelled without the final hamza of الْقَضَاء); 'by decree'
وَالْقَدَرِ: وَ + الـ + قَدَرِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (article) + qadar, destiny, fate (m.); genitive, coordinated with الْقَضَا
الْمَاضِيَةِ: الـ + مَاضِيَة — al-, the (article) + māḍiyah, past, bygone (f. sg. adj.); genitive, agreeing with الْأَمْثَالِ Also of a night: fī al-laylati al-māḍiyati, 'last night'.
مَشَيْنَاهَا: مَشَيْنَا + هَا — mashaynā, to walk (verb I, root م-ش-ي, perf. 1cp) + -hā, them/it (3fs obj., referring to خُطًى, 'paces'); 'we walked them'
خُطًا: خُطًا — khuṭan, paces, steps (m./f. pl. of خُطْوَة), accusative object; printed without its final alif maqṣūra dot-pattern, as خُطًى usually appears
مَشَاهَا: مَشَا + هَا — mashā, to walk (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, them/it (3fs obj.); 'he walked them'
مَنِيَّتُهُ: مَنِيَّة + هُ — maniyyah, death, fate (f.) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); nominative predicate of كَانَتْ; 'his death'
بِاَرْضٍ: بِـ + اَرْضٍ — bi-, in (prep.) + arḍin, land, earth (f., indef. gen.; the edition points the vowel a hamza would carry but omits the hamza sign, copied here exactly as printed); two senses in this poem's two occurrences: (1) locative, 'in a land'; (2) 'in place of / in exchange for a land'
اَرْضٍ: اَرْضٍ — arḍin, land, earth (f.), indefinite genitive; here too printed with the hamza's vowel but not its sign
سِوَاهَا: سِوَى + هَا — siwā, other than (noun used as prep.) + -hā, it (3fs suffix, referring to أَرْض); 'other than it'
اِنْقَلَعَتْ: اِنْقَلَعَ — inqalaʿa, to be plucked out, torn out (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) was plucked out'
عَيْنُ: ʿayn, eye (f., nom.; construct, 'the eye of…')
يَتَكَلَّمَ: takallama/yatakallamu — to speak (verb V, imperf. 3ms subj., complement of يَقْدِرْ with أَنْ omitted); 'to speak' Also subjunctive after an: arāda an yatakallama, 'he wanted to speak'.
مُكَتَّفٌ: كَتَّفَ → مُكَتَّف — mukattaf, bound/pinioned at the arms (pass. part. of form II كَتَّفَ, nom. indef.); 'bound'
عُنُقِي: عُنُق + ي — ʿunuq, neck (gen.) + -ī, my; 'my neck'
بِأَيِّ: بِـ + أَيِّ — bi-, by, for (prep., marking the interrogative complement of the verb 'to kill for…') + ayyi, which, what (interrog., gen. after بِـ); 'for what'
عَيْنِهِ: عَيْن + ـهِ — ʿayn, eye (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his eye'
الْمَقْلُوعَةِ: الـ + مَقْلُوعَة — maqlūʿa, plucked-out (pass. part. of قَلَعَ, f., gen.); 'the plucked-out one'
فَعَلْتُهُ: فَعَلْتُ + ـهُ — faʿaltu (faʿala/yafʿalu, to do; perf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I did it'
خَطَأً: khaṭaʾ, error, mistake (m., indef. acc.); 'by mistake'
فَعَلْتَهُ: فَعَلْتَ + ـهُ — faʿalta (faʿala, perf. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'you did it'
أَفْعَلُهُ: أَفْعَلُ + ـهُ — afʿalu (faʿala/yafʿalu, imperf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I do it'
قَدِّمُوهُ: قَدِّمُوا + ـهُ — qaddimū (qaddama, form II, to bring forward; imper. 2mp) + -hu, him; 'bring him forward!'
فَقَدَّمُرْنِي: فَـ + قَدَّمُرْنِي — fa-, so + [apparently a misprint for qaddamūnī] (qaddama, form II of ق‑د‑م, to bring forward; perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; the printed ر stands where و is expected; 'so they brought me forward'
فَمَدَّ: فَـ + مَدَّ — fa-, so + madda/yamuddu, to extend, stretch out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he extended'
أُصْبُعَهُ: أُصْبُع + ـهُ — uṣbuʿ, finger (acc.) + -hu, his; 'his finger'
الْيُمْنَى: الـ + يُمْنَى — yumnā, the right (f. adj., counterpart of أَيْمَن); 'the right one'
قَلَعَهَا: قَلَعَ + ـهَا — qalaʿa (qalaʿa/yaqlaʿu, to pluck out, tear out; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'he plucked it out'
أَعْوَرَ: aʿwar, one-eyed (adj., colour/defect pattern أَفْعَل, acc. predicate); 'one-eyed'
نَرَوْنِی: [apparently a misprint for] تَرَوْنِي — tarawnī (raʾā/yarā, to see; imperf. 2mp) + -nī, me; 'you (all) see me' — the printed ن stands where تـ is expected
كَتَفَنِي: كَتَفَ + نِي — kataf(a) (verb I, to bind the arms behind the back; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he pinioned me'
وَحَطَّنِي: وَ + حَطَّ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥaṭṭa (ḥaṭṭa/yaḥuṭṭu, to put down, place; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he put me'
لِلْسَّيَّافِ: لِـ + الـ + سَيَّاف — li-, to, for (prep., marks the addressee of قال) + al- (assimilated before the sun letter س, shown by the shadda) + sayyāf, swordsman, executioner (m., gen.); 'to the executioner'
وَأَشْهِرْ: وَ + أَشْهِرْ — wa-, and + ashhir (ashhara, form IV of ش‑ه‑ر, to draw, unsheathe; imper. 2ms); 'and draw!'
حُسَامَكَ: حُسَام + ـكَ — ḥusām, sword, blade (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your sword'
وَخُذْهُ: وَ + خُذْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + khudh (akhadha, irregular imper. 2ms, drops the hamza; to take) + -hu, him; 'and take him'
وَاِذْهَبْ: وَ + اِذْهَبْ — wa-, and + idhhab (dhahaba/yadhhabu, to go; imper. 2ms); 'and go'
بَرِّ: barr, open country, mainland (m., gen.; construct, 'the open country of…')
وَاُقْتُلْهُ: وَ + اُقْتُلْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + uqtul (qatala/yaqtulu, to kill; imper. 2ms) + -hu, him; 'and kill him'
وَدَعِ: وَ + دَعِ — wa-, and + daʿi (wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let alone; imper. 2ms, with the helping kasra before the following al-); 'and leave!'
الْوُحُوشَ: الـ + وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh, m., acc.)
وَالطُّيُورَ: وَ + الـ + طُيُور — wa-, and + al- + ṭuyūr, birds (pl. of ṭayr, m., acc.)
تَأْكُلُهُ: تَأْكُلُ + ـهُ — taʾkulu (akala/yaʾkulu, to eat; imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the collective الوحوش والطيور) + -hu, him; 'it/they eat him'
وَأَخْرَجَنِي: وَ + أَخْرَجَ + نِي — wa-, and + akhraja (form IV of خ‑ر‑ج, to take out; perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he took me out'
مُكَتَّفُ: mukattaf, bound, pinioned (pass. part. of form II كَتَّفَ, nom.; construct, 'bound of…')
الْيَدَيْنِ: الـ + يَدَيْن — yadayn, the two hands (dual of yad, gen.)
مَغْلُولُ: maghlūl, fettered, shackled (pass. part. of غَلَّ, nom.; construct, 'fettered of…')
الرِّجْلَيْنِ: الـ + رِجْلَيْن — rijlayn, the two feet (dual of rijl, gen.)
يَعْصِبَ: yaʿṣiba — ʿaṣaba/yaʿṣibu, to bind, blindfold (imperf. 3ms subj. after أَنْ); 'to blindfold'
فَبَكَيْتُ: فَـ + بَكَيْتُ — fa-, so + bakaytu (bakā/yabkī, to weep; perf. 1cs); 'so I wept'
بُكَاءًا: bukāʾ, weeping (m., indef. acc.); the extra alif after the tanwīn is the regular spelling for accusative tanwīn on a noun ending in hamza-on-the-line; 'a weeping'
أَبْكَيْتُهُ: أَبْكَيْتُ + ـهُ — abkaytu (form IV of ب‑ك‑ي, to make weep; perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I made him weep'
وَنَظَرْتُ: وَ + نَظَرْتُ — wa-, and + naẓartu (naẓara/yanẓuru, to look; perf. 1cs); 'and I looked'
أَنْشَدْتُ: وَ + أَنْشَدْتُ — wa-, and + anshadtu (form IV of ن‑ش‑د, to recite verse; perf. 1cs); 'and I recited'
الْأَبْيَاتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses, lines of poetry (broken pl. of bayt, acc.)
حَسِبْتُكُمْ: حَسِبْتُ + كُمْ — ḥasibtu (ḥasiba/yaḥsibu, to reckon, suppose; perf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I reckoned you'
دِرْعًا: dirʿ, coat of mail, armour (f., indef. acc.); 'a coat of mail'
لِتَمْنَعُوا: لِـ + تَمْنَعُوا — li-, so that (purpose-lām + subj.) + tamnaʿū (manaʿa/yamnaʿu, to prevent, ward off; imperf. 2mp subj.); 'so that you might ward off'
سِهَامَ: sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, acc.; construct, 'the arrows of…')
الْعِدَا: الـ + عِدَا — ʿidā, enemies (collective pl. of ʿaduww); 'the enemies'
فَكُنْتُمْ: فَـ + كُنْتُمْ — fa-, but, so + kuntum (kāna, perf. 2mp); 'but you became, were'
نِصَالَهَا: نِصَال + ـهَا — niṣāl, arrowheads, blades (pl., acc.) + -hā, their (f.); 'their arrowheads'
ارْتَجِيكُمْ: اِرْتَجِي + كُمْ — artajī (irtajā, form VIII of ر‑ج‑و, to hope for; imperf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I hope in you'
مُلِمَّةٍ: mulimma, misfortune, calamity (used as noun from the part. of alamma; f., indef. gen.)
اَعْوَزَتْ: aʿwazat — aʿwaza, form IV of ع‑و‑ز, to be in need of, lack (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) lacked'
شِمَالَهَا: شِمَال + ـهَا — shimāl, the left hand (m., acc.) + -hā, its (f.); 'its left'
دَعُوا: daʿū — wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let alone (imper. 2mp); 'leave!'
قِصَّةَ: qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., acc.; construct, 'the story of…')
الْعُذَّالِ: الـ + عُذَّال — ʿudhdhāl, those who blame, the reproachers (active part. pl. of ʿadhala, gen.)
بِمَعْزِلٍ: بِـ + مَعْزِلٍ — bi-, at, in (prep., idiomatically 'apart, aside') + maʿzil, a place apart (m., indef. gen.); together 'apart, at a remove'
وَخَلُّوا: وَ + خَلُّوا — wa-, and + khallū (khallā, form II of خ‑ل‑و, to leave, let; imper. 2mp); 'and let!'
يَرْمُوا: yarmū — ramā/yarmī, to throw, cast (imperf. 3mp, jussive-looking after the imperative خَلُّوا); 'let them throw'
نِبَالَهَا: نِبَال + ـهَا — nibāl, arrows, darts (pl., acc.) + -hā, their (f.); 'their arrows'
تَنْصُرُونِي: تَنْصُرُونَ + ي — tanṣurūna (naṣara/yanṣuru, to help, aid; imperf. 2mp) + -nī, me; 'you help me'
سَكَتُّمْ: sakattum — sakata/yaskutu, to be silent (perf. 2mp); 'you were silent'
وَإِخْوَانٍ: وَ + إِخْوَانٍ — wa-, and + ikhwān, brothers (broken pl. of akh, indef. gen.); 'and brothers'
حَسِبْتُهُمْ: حَسِبْتُ + هُمْ — ḥasibtu (ḥasiba, to reckon; perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'I reckoned them'
دُرُوعاً: durūʿ, coats of mail (pl. of dirʿ, indef. acc.)
فَكَانُوهَا: فَـ + كَانُوا + هَا — fa-, so + kānū (kāna, perf. 3mp) + -hā, it (f.; durūʿ is referred to as f. collective); 'and they became it'
لِلْاَعَادِي: لِـ + الـ + أَعَادِي — li-, for, belonging to (prep., 'in the service of') + al- + aʿādī, enemies (broken pl. of ʿaduww, gen.); 'for the enemies'
وَظَنَنْتُهُمْ: وَ + ظَنَنْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ẓanantu (ẓanna/yaẓunnu, to think, suppose; perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'and I thought them'
سِهَاماً: sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, indef. acc.)
صَائِبَاتٍ: ṣāʾibāt, true-aimed, accurate (active part. f. pl. of ṣāba, indef. gen.)
شِعْرِي: شِعْر + ي — shiʿr, poem, verse (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my poem'; also: shiʿr, knowing (verbal noun of shaʿara, 'to perceive'), in layta shiʿrī, 'would that I knew' (lit. 'would that my knowing …'), acc. after layta under the -ī
سَيَّافَ: sayyāf, executioner (m., acc.; predicate of كَانَ; construct, 'executioner of…')
أَبِي: أَب + ي — ab, father (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my father'
الْإِحْسَانُ: الـ + إِحْسَان — iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (verbal noun of form IV أَحْسَنَ, nom.)
مَأْمُورٌ: maʾmūr, commanded, one under orders (pass. part. of أَمَرَ, nom. indef.)
فُزْ: fuz — fāza/yafūzu, to attain, escape safely (with something); imper. 2ms; 'save yourself, escape'
بِعُمْرِكَ: بِـ + عُمْر + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep., marking the means of فُزْ) + ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your life'
تَجْعَلْ: tajʿal — jaʿala/yajʿalu, to make, put (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَا); 'you make'
فَتَهْلَكَ: فَـ + تَهْلَكَ — fa-, lest (introducing a result clause after a negative imperative) + tahlaka (halaka/yahliku, to perish; imperf. 2ms subj.); 'lest you perish'
وَتُهْلِكَنِي: وَ + تُهْلِكَ + نِي — wa-, and + tuhlika (form IV of ه‑ل‑ك, to destroy; imperf. 2ms subj.) + -nī, me; 'and destroy me'
وَنَفْسَكَ: وَ + نَفْس + ـكَ — wa-, and + nafs, self, soul (f., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your soul'
صِبْتَ: ṣibta — ṣāba/yaṣību, to strike, befall (perf. 2ms); 'you were struck by, you met with'
تَنْعَى: tanʿā — naʿā/yanʿī, to mourn, announce a death (imperf. 3fs, agreeing with الدَّار); 'it (f.) mourns'
بَنَاهَا: بَنَى + ـهَا — banā (banā/yabnī, to build; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'built it'
فَانَّكَ: فَـ + اَنَّ + ـكَ — fa-, for, indeed (conj.) + anna, that, indeed (particle; printed without its hamza mark) + -ka, you; 'for indeed you'
وَاجِدٌ: wājid, one who finds (active part. of wajada, nom. indef.)
اَرْضاً: أَرْضاً — arḍan, a land (f., indef. acc.; printed without the hamza mark)
تَجِدْ: tajid — wajada/yajidu, to find (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَمْ); 'you find'; here: 3fs jussive, lam tajid, 'she did not find'
نَفْساً: nafsan, a soul, self (f., indef. acc.)
عَجِبْتُ: ʿajibtu — ʿajiba/yaʿjabu, to marvel, be amazed (perf. 1cs); 'I marvelled'
بِدَارِ: بِـ + دَارِ — bi-, in (prep.) + dār, house (f., gen.; construct, 'in a house of…'); 'in a house of'
وَاَرْضُ: وَ + أَرْضُ — wa-, and + arḍu (arḍ, land; f., nom.; printed without the hamza mark; construct, 'the earth of…')
وَاسِعَةٌ: wāsiʿa, wide, vast (adj. f., indef. nom.)
فَلَاهَا: فَـ + لَاهَا — fa-, so + lāhā, obscure (perhaps a form meaning 'shun it, forsake it'?) + -hā, it (f.); the reading is uncertain — the word looks chosen chiefly for the rhyme (see note on the verse)
تَبْعَثْ: tabʿath — baʿatha/yabʿathu, to send (imperf. 2ms juss. after لَا); 'you send'
رَسُولَكَ: رَسُول + ـكَ — rasūl, messenger (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your messenger'
لِلنَّفْسِ: لِـ + الـ + نَفْسِ — li-, to, for (prep., 'belonging to') + al- (assimilated before the sun letter ن) + nafs, self, soul (f., gen.); 'for the self'
نَاصِحَةٌ: nāṣiḥa, an adviser, counselor (active part. f., indef. nom.)
خَلَاهَا: خَلَا + ـهَا — khalā, apart from, other than (exceptive prep./particle) + -hā, it (f.); 'apart from itself'
غَلُظَتْ: ghaluẓat — ghaluẓa/yaghluẕu, to become thick, strong (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) grew thick, strong'
رِقَابُ: riqāb, necks (broken pl. of raqaba, nom.; construct, 'the necks of…')
الْأُسْلِ: الـ + أُسْل — usl, spear-shafts, lances (poetic collective, gen.)
بِأَنْفُسِهَا: بِـ + أَنْفُس + ـهَا — bi-, by, with (prep., marking means, 'by themselves') + anfus, selves (pl. of nafs) + -hā, their (f.); 'by themselves'
تَوَلَّتْ: tawallat — tawallā/yatawallā, form V, to turn away (perf. 3fs); 'it (f.) turned away'
عَنَاهَا: عَنَى + ـهَا — ʿanā (ʿanā/yaʿnī, to concern, trouble, weary; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it/them (f.); 'wearied it/them'
وَهَانَ: وَ + هَانَ — wa- + hāna, to become easy (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَلْعُ: qalʿ — the plucking-out, extraction (verbal noun, m., nom.)
بِنَجَاتِي: بِـ + نَجَاة + ـِي — bi-, with (prep.) + najāh, deliverance (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'with my deliverance'
وَسَافَرْتُ: وَ + سَافَرْتُ — wa- + sāfara, to travel, journey (verb III, perf. 1cs)
فَدَخَلْتُ: فَ + دَخَلْتُ — fa- + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cs)
وَأَعْلَمْتُهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمْتُ + ـهُ — wa- + aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'and I informed him'
قَلْعِ: qalʿ — plucking-out, extraction (verbal noun, m., gen. after min)
وَغَمًّا: وَ + غَمّ — wa- + ghamm, grief (m., acc. indef.)
غَمِّي: غَمّ + ـِي — ghamm, grief (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my grief'
فَإِنَّ: فَ + إِنَّ — fa-, for (conj.) + inna, indeed, verily (particle putting its subject in the acc.); here: fa- answering ammā, 'as for … then'; also (Night 202): فَ + إِنَّ — fa-, for (conj., giving the reason) + inna, indeed (particle putting its noun in the acc.); 'for indeed'
عَمِّكَ: عَمّ + ـكَ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.) + 2ms poss.; ibn ʿammika, 'your paternal cousin'
عَالِمٌ: ʿālim — one who knows, a knower (act. part., m., nom. indef.)
يُخْبِرْنِي: يُخْبِرْ + ـنِي — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. jussive 3ms yukhbir, after lam) + 1cs obj.; 'he informs/informed me'
بِخَبَرِهِ: بِـ + خَبَر + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + khabar, news (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'with news of him' Also after akhbara, 'tell', bi- marks what is told: fa-akhbarahu bi-khabarihi, 'and he told him his story'.
وَبَكَي: وَ + بَكَى — wa- + bakā, to weep (verb I, perf. 3ms); the edition spells this final-weak verb with dotted yāʾ where Classical orthography uses alif maqṣūra (بكى); read here as bakā
أُغْمِيَ: ughmiya — to be overcome, made to faint (verb IV أَغْمَى, pass. perf. 3ms); ughmiya ʿalayhi, 'he fainted'
فَحَزِنْتُ: فَ + حَزِنْتُ — fa- + ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 1cs)
فَأَرَادَ: فَ + أَرَادَ — fa- + arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
يَحُطَّ: yaḥuṭṭa — to put, lay down (verb I ḥaṭṭa, impf. subjunctive 3ms, after an)
فَرَآهَا: فَ + رَآهَا — fa- + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and he saw it'
بِرُوحِكَ: بِـ + رُوح + ـكَ — bi-, by (prep.) + rūḥ, soul, spirit (f.) + 2ms poss.; 'by your soul'
يُمْكِنِي: يُمْكِنُ + ـِي — amkana, to be possible (verb IV, impf. 3ms yumkinu) + 1cs obj.; the edition drops the geminate نّ expected before the suffix (يُمْكِنِّي); 'it is possible for me'
وَلَدُهُ: وَلَد + ـهُ — walad, son (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
فَأَعْلَمْتُهُ: فَ + أَعْلَمْتُ + ـهُ — fa- + aʿlamtu, I informed (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I informed him'
اِبْنِهِ: اِبْن + ـهِ — ibn, son (m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
أِرِنِي: أَرِ + ـنِي — arā, to show (verb IV, imper. 2ms ari) + 1cs obj.; 'show me'
مَكَانَهَا: مَكَان + ـهَا — makān, place (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its place'
رُحْتُ: ruḥtu — I went (verb I rāḥa, perf. 1cs)
مِرَارًا: mirār — times, repeatedly (m. pl., acc. adverbial)
وَعَمِّي: وَ + عَمِّي — wa- + ʿammī, my uncle; 'and my uncle'
وَشِمَالًا: وَ + شِمَال — wa- + shimāl, the left (side) (m., acc. adverbial)
فَرِحْنَا: فَرِحَ + ـنَا — fariḥa, to rejoice (verb I, perf. 1cp naḥnu); 'we rejoiced'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iyyā-, particle used to coordinate an independent object pronoun + 3ms suffix; 'and he' (lit. 'and him')
وَشَلْنَا: وَ + شَلْنَا — wa- + shāla, to lift, carry off, clear away (verb I, colloquial, perf. 1cp)
رَفَعْنَا: رَفَعَ + ـنَا — rafaʿa, to lift, raise (verb I, perf. 1cp)
الطَّابِقَ: الـ + طَابِق — al- + ṭābiq, here the flagstone or slab covering the vault (m., acc.)
وَنَزَلْتُ: وَ + نَزَلْتُ — wa- + nazala, to descend, go down (verb I, perf. 1cs)
دَرَجَةً: darajat — a step, degree (f., acc. indef., specifier after the numeral)
وَصَلْنَا: وَ + وَصَلْنَا — wa- + waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 1cp)
بِدُخَانٍ: بِـ + دُخَان — bi-, [marking what appears] (prep., after the idhā of surprise) + dukhān, smoke (m., gen. indef.); 'there was smoke'
غَشَى: ghashā — to cover, envelop, overspread (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition spells this final-weak verb with alif maqṣūra, the fatḥa-type pattern)
أَبْصَارَنَا: أَبْصَار + ـنَا — abṣār, sights, eyesight (m. pl. of baṣar) + 1cp poss.; 'our sights'
يَخْجَلُ: yakhjalu — he is ashamed, feels shame (verb I khajila, impf. 3ms)
قَائِلُهَا: قَائِل + ـهَا — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part., m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its speaker'
مَشَيْنَا: mashaynā — we walked (verb I mashā, perf. 1cp)
بِقَاعَةٍ: بِـ + قَاعَةٍ — bi-, in (prep.) + qāʿah, hall, chamber (f., gen. indef.)
مَلَانَةٍ: malānat — full (adj., f., gen. indef.); the colloquial form of the adjective, without the root hamza of Classical malʾā/mumtaliʾa
دَقِيقًا: daqīq — flour (m., acc.; specifying what the hall was full of)
الْحُبُوبِ: الـ + حُبُوب — al- + ḥubūb, grains (m. pl. of ḥabb, gen.)
وَالْمَأْكُولِ: وَ + الـ + مَأْكُول — wa- + al- + maʾkūl, food, that which is eaten (pass. part. I akala, m., gen.)
بِشَخَّانَةٍ: بِـ + شَخَّانَةٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + shakhkhānah (f., gen. indef.); an obscure word, not in the standard lexicons — perhaps a canopy or curtain over the couch, or a heating-vessel (root sh-kh-n, 'to warm')
مُرْخَاةٍ: murkhāt — let down, lowered (pass. part. IV arkhā, f., gen. indef.)
فَوَجِلَ: فَ + وَجِلَ — fa- + wajila, to be terrified, afraid (verb I, perf. 3ms)
اِبْنُهُ: اِبْن + ـهُ — ibn, son (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'his son'
صَارَا: ṣārā — the two of them became (verb I ṣāra, perf. 3md)
مُتَعَانِقَيْنِ: mutaʿāniqayn — embracing one another (act. part. VI taʿānaqa, m. dual, acc.)
أُلْقِيَا: ulqiyā — the two of them were thrown, cast (verb IV alqā, pass. perf. 3md)
تَسْتَاهِلُ: tastāhilu — you deserve [it] (verb X, impf. 2ms; the colloquial form of Classical tastaʾhilu)
خِنْزِيرُ: khinzīr — pig, swine (m., nom., in address/vocative)
عَذَابُ: ʿadhāb — punishment, torment (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْآخِرَةِ: الـ + آخِرَة — al- + ākhirah, the hereafter, the next life (f., gen.)
أَشَدُّ: ashaddu — more severe, more intense (comparative adj., nom.)
وَأَقْوَى: وَ + أَقْوَى — wa- + aqwā, stronger, more powerful (comparative adj.)
الْقَرَنْدَلِيَّ: الـ + قَرَنْدَلِيّ — qarandalī, Qalandar, wandering dervish (m., acc.; subject of أَنَّ) — a Persian loanword treated as a declinable nisba noun
لِلصَّبِيَّةِ: لِـ + الـ + صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., gen.); li-, to (prep., marking the addressee of قَالَ) Also li- of belonging, 'of the girl': lam ajid li-al-ṣabiyyati atharan, 'I found no trace of the girl' (Night 191).
وَالْجَمَاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + جَمَاعَة — jamāʿa, company, group (f., nom.; subject of a circumstantial clause with يَسْمَعُونَ)
يَسْمَعُونَ: samiʿa/yasmaʿu — to hear, listen (verb I, imperf. 3mp); plural verb with the collective الجماعة
وَالْخَلِيفَةُ: وَ + الـ + خَلِيفَة — khalīfa, caliph, vicegerent (m., nom.)
ضَرَبَ: ḍaraba — to strike, beat (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَلَدَهُ: وَلَد + ـهُ — walad, son, child (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'his son'
بِالزَّرْبُونِ: بِـ + الـ + زَرْبُون — zarbūn, shoe, slipper (m., gen.; a Middle Arabic/Ottoman-derived loanword); bi-, with (prep., instrumental)
فُحِّمَ: fuḥḥima — was charred, turned to coal (pass., verb II of faḥm, 'charcoal'; perf. 3ms)
سُوِّدَ: suwwida — was blackened (pass., verb II of aswad/sawād, 'black'; perf. 3ms)
فِعْلِهِ: فِعْل + ـهِ — fiʿl, deed, act (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 3ms; 'his deed'; also gen. after ʿalā: shakara … ʿalā fiʿlihi, 'thanked him for his deed' (Night 201)
وَحَزِنْتُ: وَ + حَزِنْتُ — ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, perf. 1cs)
زَوِّلْ: zawwil — remove, dispel! (imper. 2ms, verb II of zāla, 'to depart, cease'; causative, taking a direct object)
قَلْبِكَ: قَلْب + ـكَ — qalb, heart (m., gen. after عَنْ) + 2ms Also gen. after ʿalā: shafaqatī ʿalā qalbika, 'my pity for your heart'.
غُصَّةً: ghuṣṣa — a choking lump, distress (f., acc.; object of زَوِّلْ)
لَقَدِ: لَـ + قَدِ — la-, indeed (emphatic particle) + qad (marks a completed perfect)
وَخَاطِرِي: وَ + خَاطِر + ـي — khāṭir, thought, mind (m., nom., coordinated with سِرِّي) + 1cs
وَاغْتَمَيْتُ: وَ + اِغْتَمَيْتُ — ightamā/ightamma, to be grieved, distressed (verb VIII, perf. 1cs; this text's spelling of Classical اغْتَمَمْتُ, the geminate root's second radical written with a yāʾ)
وَلَدِكَ: وَلَد + ـكَ — walad, son (m., gen. after عَلَى) + 2ms
وَلَدُكَ: وَلَد + ـكَ — walad, son (m., nom.; subject of بَقِيَ) + 2ms
كَفَاهُمْ: كَفَى + ـهُمْ — kafā, to suffice, be enough for (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.
ضَرَبْتَهُ: ضَرَبْتَ + ـهُ — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
صِغَرِهِ: صِغَر + ـهِ — ṣighar, smallness, childhood (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 3ms
بِحُبِّ: بِـ + حُبّ — ḥubb, love (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., governed by مُولَعٌ بِـ, 'infatuated with')
أُخْتِهِ: أُخْت + ـهِ — ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3ms; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اخته
أَنْهَاهُ: أَنْهَى + ـهُ — nahā, to forbid (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; hamza supplied, edition prints bare انهاه
دُولْ: dūl — these (colloquial Egyptian demonstrative, pl.; not Classical هَؤُلَاءِ, kept as printed)
صِغَارٌ: ṣighār — young ones, children (pl. of ṣaghīr, m., nom.; predicate of an implied 'they are')
كَبِرَا: kabira — to grow up, become older (verb I, perf. 3md)
الْقَبِيحُ: الـ + قَبِيح — qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj. used substantively, m., nom.; subject of وَقَعَ); also: adjective agreeing with al-kalām: hādhā al-kalāmu al-qabīḥu, 'these ugly words' (Night 192)
وَسَمِعْتُ: وَ + سَمِعْتُ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 1cs)
أُصَدِّقْ: ṣaddaqa/yuṣaddiqu — to believe, deem true (verb II, imperf. 1cs jussive after لَمْ); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اصدق
فَمَسَكْتُهُ: فَ + مَسَكْتُ + ـهُ — masaka, to seize, take hold of (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
وَزَجَرْتُهُ: وَ + زَجَرْتُ + ـهُ — zajara, to rebuke, reprove (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
زَجْرًا: zajr — a rebuking, reproof (verbal noun, m., acc.; cognate accusative of زَجَرَ)
بَلِيغًا: balīgh — eloquent, forceful, vehement (adj., m., acc.; modifying زَجْرًا)
الْخُدَّامُ: الـ + خُدَّام — khādim, servant (m. broken pl., nom.; subject of قَالُوا, following the verb — see n on this unit)
احْذَرْ: iḥdhar — beware! (imper. 2ms of ḥadhira, 'to be wary')
الْقَبِيحَةِ: الـ + قَبِيحَة — qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj., f. sg. agreeing with the non-human pl. الفعال, gen.)
فَعَلَهَا: فَعَلَ + ـهَا — faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَتَبْقَى: وَ + تَبْقَى — baqiya/tabqā, to remain (verb I, imperf. 2ms)
بِالْمَعِيرَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَعِيرَة — maʿīra, reproach, taunting (f., gen.; a Middle Arabic nominal form beside مُعَايَرَة); bi-, in (prep., marking the state one remains in)
وَالنُّقْصَانِ: وَ + الـ + نُقْصَان — nuqṣān, deficiency, diminishment (m., gen., coordinated with المعيرة)
وَتَشِيعُ: وَ + تَشِيعُ — shāʿa/tashīʿu, to spread abroad, become known (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
أَخْبَارُنَا: أَخْبَار + ـنَا — khabar, news (m. pl., nom.; subject of تَشِيعُ) + 1cp
الرُّكْبَانِ: الـ + رُكْبَان — rākib, rider (m. pl., gen.); 'the riders, travelers'
وَإِيَّاكَ: وَ + إِيَّاكَ — iyyā-, independent object-pronoun base + 2ms; used in the warning formula إِيَّاكَ أَنْ, 'beware lest'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اياك
تَصْدُرَ: ṣadara/taṣduru — to proceed, issue forth (verb I, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after أَنْ)
الْفِعَالُ: الـ + فِعَال — fiʿāl, deeds, doings (broken pl. of fiʿl, nom.); mā hādhā al-fiʿālu, 'what are these doings?'
أَسْخَطُ: sakhiṭa/askhaṭu — to be angry, wrathful (verb I, imperf. 1cs); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اسخط
وَأَقْتُلُكَ: وَ + أَقْتُلُ + ـكَ — qatala/aqtulu, to kill (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; hamza supplied, edition prints bare واقتلك
وَحَجَبْتُهُ: وَ + حَجَبْتُ + ـهُ — ḥajaba, to seclude, veil, screen off (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.
وَحَجَبْتُهَا: وَ + حَجَبْتُ + ـهَا — ḥajaba, to seclude (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.
تُحِبُّهُ: تُحِبُّ + ـهُ — aḥabba/yuḥibbu, to love (verb IV, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.
أَعْمَالَهُمَا: أَعْمَال + ـهُمَا — ʿamal, deed (m. pl., acc.; object of زَيَّنَ) + 3md
حَجَبْتُهُمَا: حَجَبْتُ + ـهُمَا — ḥajaba, to seclude (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3md obj.
فِعْلًا: fiʿl — deed, act; here an accusative-of-manner adverb, 'indeed, in fact' (see n on this unit for the difficulty of this reading)
وَسَوَّاهُ: وَ + سَوَّى + ـهُ — sawwā, to level, make ready, fashion (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.
الْمَأْكُولَ: الـ + مَأْكُول — maʾkūl, food (pass. part. of akala, 'to eat', m., acc.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare الماكول
تَرَاهُ: تَرَى + ـهُ — raʾā/tarā, to see (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.
وَاسْتَغْفَلَنِي: وَ + اِسْتَغْفَلَ + ـنِي — istaghfala, to catch off guard, take unawares (verb X of ghafala, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.
الْمَكَانَ: الـ + مَكَان — makān, place (m., acc.; direct object of أَتَى) Also acc. as the noun of anna: li-anna dhālika al-makāna, 'because that place'.
فَغَارَ: فَ + غَارَ — ghāra, to be jealous, zealously protective (verb I, perf. 3ms; with عَلَى)
الْحَقُّ: الـ + حَقّ — ḥaqq, the Truth, i.e. God (m., nom.); here 'the truth' (m., nom., subject of lā yaṣʿub ʿalayki, 'let not the truth be hard on you')
وَأَحْرَقَهُمَا: وَ + أَحْرَقَ + ـهُمَا — aḥraqa, to burn (verb IV of ḥaraqa, perf. 3ms) + 3md obj.
وَعَذَابُ: وَ + عَذَاب — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., nom.)
الْآخِرَةِ: الـ + آخِرَة — ākhira, the Hereafter, the world to come (f., gen.); hamza-with-madda supplied, edition prints bare الاخرة
أَشَدُّ: ashadd — more/most severe (elative, m., nom.; predicate)
وَأَقْوَى: وَ + أَقْوَى — aqwā, mightier, stronger (elative, m., nom., coordinated with أَشَدُّ)
وَبَكَيْتُ: وَ + بَكَيْتُ — bakā, to weep (verb I, perf. 1cs)
عِوَضٌ: ʿiwaḍ — a substitute, replacement (m., nom.; predicate)
وَتَفَكَّرْتُ: وَ + تَفَكَّرْتُ — tafakkara, to reflect, ponder (verb V, perf. 1cs)
وَحَوَادِثِهَا: وَ + حَوَادِث + ـهَا — ḥawādith, events, happenings (pl. of ḥādith, f. agreement, gen.) + 3fs
وَقَلَعَ: وَ + قَلَعَ — qalaʿa, to gouge out, uproot; also to pull off, take off (clothes, a cross from the neck) (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he pulled off'
وَلَدِ: walad — son (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa, 'the son of')
الْحَوَادِثِ: الـ + حَوَادِث — ḥawādith, events (pl. of ḥādith, gen. after مِنَ)
الْغَرِيبَةِ: الـ + غَرِيبَة — gharīb, strange (adj., f. agreement with the pl., gen.)
صَعِدْنَا: ṣaʿida — to go up, ascend (verb I, perf. 1cp)
رَدَّيْنَا: raddaynā — we put back, returned (something) (verb I, perf. 1cp of radda; this text's spelling for Classical رَدَدْنَا, the geminate root's second radical written with a yāʾ)
وَالتُّرَابَ: وَ + الـ + تُرَاب — turāb, earth, dust (m., acc.)
وَعَمِلْنَا: وَ + عَمِلْنَا — ʿamila, to make, do (verb I, perf. 1cp)
مَنْزِلِنَا: مَنْزِل + ـنَا — manzil, dwelling, house (m., gen. after إِلَى) + 1cp
يَسْتَقِرَّ: istaqarra/yastaqirru — to settle, become steady (verb X, imperf. 3ms jussive after لَمْ)
حِسَّ: ḥiss — sound, noise (m., acc.; object of سَمِعْنَا, governing the genitive chain that follows)
وَبُوقَاتٍ: وَ + بُوقَات — būqāt, trumpets, horns (pl. of būq, gen.)
وَكُوسَاتٍ: وَ + كُوسَات — kūsāt, kettledrums (pl. of kūs, gen.)
وَرَمْحِ: وَ + رَمْح — ramḥ, lance, spear (m., gen.; collective singular standing for the class)
أَبْطَالٍ: abṭāl — champions, heroes (pl. of baṭal, gen.)
وَزَمْجَرَةِ: وَ + زَمْجَرَة — zamjara, a roaring, clamor (verbal noun, f., gen.)
وَقَعْقَعَةِ: وَ + قَعْقَعَة — qaʿqaʿa, a clattering, jangling (verbal noun, f., gen.)
اللُّجُمِ: الـ + لُجُم — lujum, bits, bridles (pl. of lijām, gen.)
وَصَهِيلِ: وَ + صَهِيل — ṣahīl, neighing (verbal noun, m., gen.)
انْطَبَقَتِ: inṭabaqat — closed up, shut (verb VII of ṭabaqa, perf. 3fs)
بِالْعَجَاجِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجَاج — ʿajāj, dust-cloud (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., instrumental)
وَالْغُبَارِ: وَ + الـ + غُبَار — ghubār, dust (m., gen.)
حَوَافِرِ: ḥawāfir — hooves (pl. of ḥāfir, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فَحَارَتْ: فَ + حَارَتْ — ḥāra, to be bewildered, perplexed (verb I, perf. 3fs)
عُقُولُنَا: عُقُول + ـنَا — ʿaql, mind (m. pl., nom.; subject of حَارَتْ) + 1cp
تَعْرِفِ: ʿarafa/taʿrifu — to know (verb I, imperf. 3fs jussive after لَمْ)
فَسَأَلْنَا: فَ + سَأَلْنَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 1cp); the edition itself prints this hamza precomposed, سألنا
الْخَبَرِ: الـ + خَبَر — khabar, news (m., gen. after a preposition such as عَنِ or بِـ)
فَقِيلَ: فَ + قِيلَ — qāla/qīla, to say (pass., perf. 3ms); 'and it was said'
مَمْلَكَةَ: mamlaka — kingdom, realm (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
أَبِيكَ: أَب + ـكَ — ab, father (m., gen.) + 2ms; one of the 'five nouns', showing the gen. form أَبِي before a 2nd/3rd person suffix
جَهَّزَ: jahhaza — to equip, make ready (verb II, perf. 3ms)
الْعَسَاكِرَ: الـ + عَسَاكِر — ʿasākir, troops (pl. of ʿaskar, acc.)
الْجُيُوشَ: الـ + جُيُوش — juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh, acc.)
وَاسْتَخْدَمَ: وَ + اِسْتَخْدَمَ — istakhdama, to employ, take into service (verb X of khadama, perf. 3ms)
الْعُرْبَانَ: الـ + عُرْبَان — ʿurbān, Bedouin, desert Arabs (pl., acc.)
وَجَاءَنَا: وَ + جَاءَ + ـنَا — jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cp obj.; the edition itself prints this hamza precomposed, جاءنا
بِعَسَاكِرَ: بِـ + عَسَاكِر — ʿasākir, troops (pl., gen.); bi-, with (prep.)
كَعَدَدِ: كَـ + عَدَد — ʿadad, number (m., gen.); ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison)
الرِّمَالِ: الـ + رِمَال — rimāl, sands (pl. of raml, gen.)
عَدَدٌ: ʿadad — number (m., nom.; subject of يُحْصَى)
يَقْوَى: qawiya/yaqwā — to be strong, have power (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
هَجَمُوا: hajama — to storm, attack (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَأَهْلُ: وَ + أَهْل — ahl, people, folk (m., nom.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اهل
طَاقَةٌ: ṭāqa — power, strength, capacity (f., nom.; subject of يَكُنْ)
فَضَلَّ: فَ + ضَلَّ — ḍalla, to go astray, be lost (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَهَرَبْتُ: وَ + هَرَبْتُ — wa-, and + haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 1cs)
قَتَلَنِي: قَتَلَ + ـنِي — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'he kills/will kill me'
وَتَجَدَّدَتْ: وَ + تَجَدَّدَتْ — tajaddada, to be renewed (verb V, perf. 3fs)
الْأَحْزَانُ: الـ + أَحْزَان — aḥzān, griefs, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn, nom.; subject of تَجَدَّدَتْ); hamza supplied, edition prints bare الاحزان
وَتَذَكَّرْتُ: وَ + تَذَكَّرْتُ — tadhakkara, to remember, call to mind (verb V, perf. 1cs)
الْحَوَادِثَ: الـ + حَوَادِث — ḥawādith, events (pl. of ḥādith, acc.)
حَدَثَتْ: ḥadatha — to happen, occur (verb I, perf. 3fs)
لِأَبِي: لِـ + أَب + ـي — ab, father (m.) + 1cs; li-, to, upon (prep., marking the recipient); hamza supplied, edition prints bare لابي
ظَهَرْتُ: ẓahara — to appear, show oneself (verb I, perf. 1cs)
عَرَفُونِي: عَرَفُوا + ـنِي — ʿarafa, to know, recognize (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 1cs obj.; plural verb though its subject follows — see n on this unit
وَعَسْكَرُ: وَ + عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army, troops (m., nom.)
وَهَلَاكِي: وَ + هَلَاك + ـي — halāk, destruction, ruin (m.) + 1cs
أَنْجُو: najā/anjū — to be saved, escape (verb I, imperf. 1cs); hamza supplied, edition prints bare انجو
حَلْقَ: ḥalq — shaving (verbal noun, m., acc.; second term of the exception)
وَشَوَارِبِي: وَ + شَوَارِب + ـي — wa-, and + shawārib, mustaches (m. pl. of shārib; gen.) + 1cs; 'and my mustaches'
فَحَلَقْتُهَا: فَ + حَلَقْتُ + ـهَا — ḥalaqa, to shave (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj. (referring to ذقني وشواربي taken together); 'so I shaved them'
وَغَيَّرْتُ: وَ + غَيَّرْتُ — ghayyara, to change (verb II, perf. 1cs)
أَثْوَابِي: أَثْوَاب + ـي — thawb, garment (m. broken pl., acc.) + 1cs; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اثوابي
وَخَرَجْتُ: وَ + خَرَجْتُ — kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 1cs)
وَقَصَدْتُ: وَ + قَصَدْتُ — qaṣada, to make for, head toward, intend (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I made for, headed toward'
يُوصِلُنِي: يُوصِلُ + ـنِي — awṣala, to bring, convey, cause to arrive (verb IV of waṣala; imperf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'that he might bring me'
أَمِيرِ: amīr — commander, prince (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); amīr al-muʾminīn, 'Commander of the Faithful'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare امير
الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — muʾmin, believer (act. part. of IV āmana; m. pl., gen.); the edition prints the bare seat و with no hamza (مومنين), supplied here on that same seat
وَخَلِيفَةِ: وَ + خَلِيفَة — khalīfa, vicegerent, caliph (m., gen.; second term coordinated with amīr)
أَحْكِيَ: aḥkiya — I relate, recount (imperf. 1cs of ḥakā, subjunctive after ḥattā)
وَأَبُثَّ: وَ + أَبُثَّ — baththa, to spread abroad, pour out (verb I, imperf. 1cs subjunctive); 'and [that I might] pour out'
فَوَصَلْتُ: فَـ + وَصَلْتُ — waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 1cs)
حَائِرًا: ḥāʾir — bewildered, perplexed (act. part. of ḥāra; m., acc. as ḥāl); the edition prints the hamza-bearing ي without its dots (حايرا), supplied on that same seat
أَمْضِي: amḍī — I go, proceed (imperf. 1cs of maḍā); hamza supplied, edition prints bare امضي
الْقَرَنْدَلِيِّ: الـ + قَرَنْدَلِيّ — qarandalī, qalandar, wandering dervish (m., gen.); the edition's spelling, a variant ordering of the commoner قَلَنْدَرِيّ
فَسَلَّمْتُ: فَـ + سَلَّمْتُ — fa-, so + sallamtu (sallama, to greet, verb II, perf. 1cs); 'so I greeted'
بِرَفِيقِنَا: بِـ + رَفِيق + ـنَا — bi-, with (prep., marking what appears after idhā) + rafīq, companion (m., gen.) + 1cp; 'with our companion'
الثَّالِثِ: الـ + ثَالِث — thālith, third (m., gen.; adj. of hādhā rafīqinā)
فَقُلْنَا: فَـ + قُلْنَا — qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 1cp)
فَمَشَيْنَا: فَـ + مَشَيْنَا — mashā, to walk (verb I, perf. 1cp)
هَجَمَ: hajama — to fall upon, assail, attack (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الظَّلَامُ: الـ + ظَلَام — ẓalām, darkness (m., nom. as subject)
فَسَاقَنَا: فَـ + سَاقَ + ـنَا — sāqa, to drive, lead (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 1cp obj.; 'so it drove us'
رَاسَكَ: رَاس + ـكَ — rās, head (colloquial for Classical raʾs, without the hamza; m., acc.) + 2ms; 'your head'
فَتَعَجَّبُوا: فَـ + تَعَجَّبُوا — taʿajjaba, to marvel, be amazed (verb V, perf. 3mp); with min
وُلِدْتُ: wulidtu — I was born (pass. perf. 1cs of walada)
وَقَرَأْتُ: وَ + قَرَأْتُ — qaraʾtu, I read, recited (perf. 1cs of qaraʾa); already printed with its hamza in the edition
الْقُرْآنَ: الـ + قُرْآن — Qurʾān, the Qur'ān (m., acc.); already printed with its hamza (madda) in the edition
سَبْعِ: sabʿ — seven (f. numeral, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
رِوَايَاتٍ: riwāyāt — readings, transmissions (f. pl. of riwāya, gen. with tanwīn); sabʿ riwāyāt, the Seven Canonical Readings of the Qur'ān
وَعَرَضْتُهَا: وَ + عَرَضْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ʿaraḍa, to present, lay before (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'and I presented them'
مَشَايِخِ: mashāyikh — elders, masters (m. pl. of shaykh; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْعِلْمِ: الـ + عِلْم — ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m., gen.)
عِلْمَ: ʿilm — science, knowledge (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
النُّجُومِ: الـ + نُجُوم — nujūm, stars (m. pl. of najm; gen.); ʿilm al-nujūm, astrology/astronomy
وَكَلَامَ: وَ + كَلَامَ — wa-, and + kalām, speech, discourse (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الشُّعَرَاءِ: الـ + شُعَرَاء — shuʿarāʾ, poets (m. pl. of shāʿir, gen.); the edition already prints the final hamza
وَاجْتَهَدْتُ: وَ + اجْتَهَدْتُ — wa-, and + ijtahada, to strive, exert oneself (verb VIII, perf. 1cs); hamzat waṣl, unmarked
فُقْتُ: fuqtu — I surpassed, excelled (perf. 1cs of fāqa, hollow verb); with a direct object
أَهْلَ: ahl — people, folk (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); hamza supplied, edition prints bare اهل
زَمَانِي: زَمَان + ـي — zamān, time, age, era (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my time, my age'
وَفَاقَ: وَ + فَاقَ — wa-, and + fāqa, to surpass, excel (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā
خَطِّي: خَطّ + ـي — khaṭṭ, handwriting, penmanship (m., nom.) + 1cs; 'my handwriting'
الْكَتَبَةِ: الـ + كَتَبَة — kataba, scribes, copyists (m. pl. of kātib; gen.)
وَشَاعَ: وَ + شَاعَ — wa-, and + shāʿa, to spread abroad, become known (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
ذِكْرِي: ذِكْر + ـي — dhikr, mention, fame, renown (m., nom.) + 1cs; 'my fame'
الْأَقَالِيمِ: الـ + أَقَالِيم — aqālīm, provinces, regions (m. pl. of iqlīm; gen.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare الاقاليم
وَالْبُلْدَانِ: وَ + الـ + بُلْدَان — wa-, and + buldān, lands, countries (m. pl. of balad; gen.)
هَدَايَا: hadāyā — gifts (f. pl. of hadiyya, acc.)
وَتُحَفًا: وَ + تُحَفًا — wa-, and + tuḥaf, rarities, curios (f. pl. of tuḥfa, acc. with tanwīn)
تَصْلُحُ: taṣluḥu — is fit, suitable (imperf. 3fs of ṣaluḥa; agrees with hadāyā wa-tuḥaf)
لِلْمُلُوكِ: لِـ + الـ + مُلُوك — li-, for (prep.) + mulūk, kings (gen.); 'fit for kings'
فَجَهَّزَنِي: فَـ + جَهَّزَ + ـنِي — jahhaza, to equip, outfit, fit out (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'so he equipped me'
سِتَّةِ: sitta — six (f. numeral, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
مَرَاكِبَ: marākib — ships, vessels (m. pl. of markab, gen., diptote — no tanwīn)
وَسِرْنَا: وَ + سِرْنَا — wa-, and + sāra, to travel, journey (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp)
فَوَصَلْنَا: فَـ + وَصَلْنَا — waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 1cp)
وَأَخْرَجْنَا: وَ + أَخْرَجْنَا — wa-, and + akhraja, to bring out, take out (verb IV, perf. 1cp)
وَشَدَّيْنَا: وَ + شَدَّيْنَا — wa-, and + shadda, to bind, tie, load (verb I geminate, perf. 1cp); the edition's colloquial conjugation shaddaynā for Classical شَدَدْنَا, see n on this sentence
جِمَالٍ: jimāl — camels (m. pl. of jamal, gen. with tanwīn as the numeral's tamyīz)
وَمَشَيْنَا: وَ + مَشَيْنَا — wa-, and + mashā, to walk (verb I, perf. 1cp)
بِغُبَارٍ: بِـ + غُبَار — bi-, with (prep., marking what appears after wa-idhā) + ghubār, dust (m., gen.)
عَلَا: ʿalā — it rose, mounted up (perf. 3ms of ʿalā/yaʿlū)
وَثَارَ: وَ + ثَارَ — wa-, and + thāra, to stir, rise up, swirl (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
سَدَّ: sadda — it blocked, closed off, dammed (perf. 3ms of sadda, geminate)
الْأَقْطَارَ: الـ + أَقْطَار — aqṭār, regions, quarters, horizons (m. pl. of quṭr; acc.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare الاقطار
الْغُبَارُ: الـ + غُبَار — ghubār, dust (m., nom. as subject)
وَبَانَ: وَ + بَانَ — wa-, and + bāna, to appear, become visible (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
فَارِسًا: fāris — a horseman, knight (m., acc. as the tamyīz of a number from 11 to 99)
لُيُوثٌ: luyūth — lions (m. pl. of layth, nom.; predicate in apposition to fārisan)
عَوَابِسُ: ʿawābis — frowning, scowling, grim (act. part. pl. of ʿabasa; m., nom.; adj. of luyūth); sajʿ rhyme with lawābis
بِحَدِيدٍ: بِـ + حَدِيدٍ — bi-, in, with (prep., material) + ḥadīd, iron (m., gen.)
لَوَابِسُ: lawābis — clad, wearing (act. part. pl. of labisa; m., nom.); sajʿ rhyme with ʿawābis
فَتَأَمَّلْنَاهُمْ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلْنَا + ـهُمْ — taʾammala, to look closely at, contemplate (verb V, perf. 1cp) + 3mp obj.; 'so we looked closely at them'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare تاملناهم
قُطَّاعُ: quṭṭāʿ — cutters (m. pl. of qāṭiʿ; nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); quṭṭāʿ ṭarīq, 'highwaymen'
طَرِيقٍ: ṭarīq — a road, way (m./f., gen. with tanwīn)
رَأَوْنَا: رَأَوْ + ـنَا — raʾaw, they saw (perf. 3mp of raʾā) + 1cp obj.; 'they saw us'
نَفَرٌ: nafar — a band, small company (m., nom.; predicate)
أَجْمَالٍ: ajmāl — camels (m. pl. of jamal, gen. with tanwīn); an alternate plural to jimāl used earlier in this tale (P81L19), for the same animals; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اجمال
لِمَلِكِ: لِـ + مَلِكِ — li-, for (prep.) + malik, king (gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
دَمَجُوا: damajū — they closed in, bore down, set upon (perf. 3mp of damaja, base sense 'to enter into, be inserted'; the exact shade here is uncertain, see n on this sentence)
السِّنَانَ: الـ + سِنَان — sinān, spear-point, lance-head (m., acc.)
أَيْدِينَا: أَيْدِي + نَا — aydī, hands (m. pl. of yad, gen.) + 1cp; 'our hands'; bayna aydīnā, 'before us'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare ايدينا
فَأَشَرْنَا: فَـ + أَشَرْنَا — ashāra, to point, gesture, signal (verb IV, perf. 1cp); with ilā and bi-
بِالْأَصَابِعِ: بِـ + الـ + أَصَابِع — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + aṣābiʿ, fingers (m. pl. of iṣbaʿ; gen.); hamza supplied, edition prints bare بالاصابع
وَقُلْنَا: وَ + قُلْنَا — wa-, and + qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 1cp)
رُسُلُ: rusul — envoys, messengers (m. pl. of rasūl, nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
تُؤْذُونَا: تُؤْذُو + نَا — tuʾdhū, you (pl.) harm (imperf. 2mp jussive of IV ādhā) + 1cp obj.; 'do not harm us'; the edition already prints the hamza
لَسْنَا: lasnā — we are not (perf. 1cp of laysa)
أَرْضِهِ: أَرْض + ـهِ — arḍ, land (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'his land'
بَعْضَ: baʿḍ — some, part (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْغِلْمَانِ: الـ + غِلْمَان — ghilmān, servant-boys, pages (m. pl. of ghulām; gen.)
وَهَرَبَ: وَ + هَرَبَ — wa-, and + haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْبَاقُونَ: الـ + بَاقُونَ — bāqūn, the remaining ones (act. part. pl. of baqiya; m., nom.)
انْجَرَحْتُ: injaraḥtu — I was wounded, cut (verb VII, perf. 1cs of jaraḥa); hamzat waṣl, unmarked
جُرْحًا: jurḥ — a wound (m., acc. as the cognate-type object of injaraḥtu)
بَلِيغَةً: balīgh(a) — grievous, severe (adj. of balagha; acc.); the edition prints the feminine ending though jurḥ is masculine, see n on this sentence
وَاشْتَغَلَتْ: وَ + اشْتَغَلَتْ — wa-, and + ishtaghalat, it/she became occupied, busied itself (verb VIII, perf. 3fs of shaghala); hamzat waṣl, unmarked
الْعَرَبُ: الـ + عَرَب — ʿarab, the Arabs, the raiders (coll. n., nom. as subject)
بِالْمَالِ: بِـ + الـ + مَال — bi-, with (prep.) + māl, money, property (m., gen.)
وَالْهَدَايَا: وَ + الـ + هَدَايَا — wa-, and + hadāyā, gifts (f. pl. of hadiyya, gen.)
أَدْرِي: adrī — I know (imperf. 1cs of daraytu darā)
عَزِيزًا: ʿazīz — mighty, dear, powerful (m., acc. as predicate of kuntu)
ذَلِيلًا: dhalīl — abject, lowly, humbled (m., acc. as predicate of ṣirtu)
سِرْتُ: سِرْتُ — sāra, to go, travel, walk on (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I went, I walked on'
رَاسَ: rās — head, top (colloquial for Classical raʾs, without the hamza; m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); see n on مَلِّسْ عَلَى رَاسَكَ above
فَأَوَيْتُ: فَـ + أَوَيْتُ — awaytu, I took shelter, took refuge (perf. 1cs of awā); with ilā
مَغَارَةٍ: maghāra — a cave (f., gen. with tanwīn)
أَمِينَةٍ: amīna — secure, trustworthy, safe (f., gen.; adj. of madīna); hamza supplied, edition prints bare امينة
حَصِينَةٍ: ḥaṣīna — fortified, well-defended (f., gen.; adj. of madīna)
الشِّتَاءُ: الـ + شِتَاء — shitāʾ, winter (m., nom. as subject); the edition already prints its final hamza
بِبَرْدِهِ: بِـ + بَرْد + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + bard, cold (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with its cold'
وَأَقْبَلَ: وَ + أَقْبَلَ — wa-, and + aqbala, to come, approach, draw near (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
الرَّبِيعُ: الـ + رَبِيع — rabīʿ, spring (the season; m., nom. as subject)
بِوَرْدِهِ: بِـ + وَرْد + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + ward, rose(s) (m., gen.) + 3ms; 'with its roses'
وَأَطْلَعَتْ: وَ + أَطْلَعَتْ — wa-, and + aṭlaʿat, it put forth, brought out (verb IV, perf. 3fs of ṭalaʿa); see n on this sentence for the subject
أَزْهَارَهَا: أَزْهَار + ـهَا — azhār, flowers, blossoms (m. pl. of zahr, acc.) + 3fs; 'its blossoms'
وَتَدَفَّقَتْ: وَ + تَدَفَّقَتْ — wa-, and + tadaffaqat, it gushed, flowed freely (verb V, perf. 3fs of dafaqa)
أَنْهَارُهَا: أَنْهَار + ـهَا — anhār, rivers (m. pl. of nahr, nom.) + 3fs; 'its rivers'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare انهارها
وَتَغَرَّدَتْ: وَ + تَغَرَّدَتْ — wa-, and + taghurradat, it warbled, sang (verb V, perf. 3fs of gharrada)
أَطْيَارُهَا: أَطْيَار + ـهَا — aṭyār, birds (m. pl. of ṭāʾir/ṭayr, nom.) + 3fs; 'its birds'; hamza supplied, edition prints bare اطيارها
مَدِينَةٌ: madīna — a city (f., nom.; topic of the verse)
لِسَاكِنِهَا: لِـ + سَاكِن + ـهَا — li-, for (prep.) + sākin, dweller, inhabitant (act. part. of sakana; m., gen.) + 3fs; 'for its dweller'
مُرَوَّعٌ: murawwaʿ — one made afraid, terrified (pass. part. of II rawwaʿa; m., nom.; the thing negated by mā)
وَالْأَمَانُ: وَ + الـ + أَمَان — wa-, and + amān, safety, security (m., nom. as subject)
صَاحِبُهَا: صَاحِب + ـهَا — ṣāḥib, companion, owner (m., nom.; predicate) + 3fs; 'its companion'
كَأَنَّهَا: كَأَنَّ + ـهَا — kaʾanna, as though, as if (particle, putting its subject in the acc.) + 3fs; 'as though it'
جَنَّةٌ: janna — a garden, paradise-garden (f., nom.; predicate of kaʾanna)
مُزَخْرَفَةٌ: muzakhrafa — adorned, embellished (pass. part. of II zakhrafa; f., nom.; adj. of janna)
لِأَهْلِهَا: لِـ + أَهْل + ـهَا — li-, for (prep.) + ahl, people, folk (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'for its people'
بَدَتْ: badat — it appeared, became visible (perf. 3fs of badā)
عَجَائِبُهَا: عَجَائِب + ـهَا — ʿajāʾib, wonders, marvels (f. pl. of ʿajība, nom.) + 3fs; 'its wonders'
فَرِحْتُ: fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I rejoiced'
بِوُصُولِي: بِـ + وُصُول + ـي — bi-, at (prep.) + wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala) + 1s suffix; 'at my arrival'
تَعِبْتُ: taʿiba, to grow weary, tired (verb I, perf. 1cs)
الْمَشْيِ: الـ + مَشْي — mashy, walking (verbal noun of mashā; m., gen.)
وَعَلَانِيَ: وَ + عَلَا + ـنِيَ — wa-, and + ʿalā, to overcome, come over (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and ... came over me'
الْهَمُّ: الـ + هَمّ — hamm, care, worry, grief (m., nom.)
الِاصْفِرَارُ: الـ + اِصْفِرَار — iṣfirār, paleness, turning yellow (verbal noun of iṣfarra, verb IX; m., nom.); coordinated, with the preceding وَ, with الْهَمُّ; elsewhere (Night 110) subject of ʿalāhu, ‘the pallor came over him’
فَتَغَيَّرَتْ: فَـ + تَغَيَّرَتْ — fa-, so + taghayyarat (taghayyara, to change, verb V, perf. 3fs); 'so it changed'
أَسْلُكُ: asluku — salaka, to take (a path), go along (verb I, impf. 1cs)
فَاجْتَزْتُ: فَـ + اجْتَزْتُ — fa-, so + ijtāza, to pass by, traverse (verb VIII of jāza, perf. 1cs); 'so I passed by'
خَيَّاطًا: khayyāṭ — tailor (intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl, from khāṭa, 'to sew'; m. acc. indef.)
وَرَحَّبَ: وَ + رَحَّبَ — wa-, and + raḥḥaba, to welcome (verb II, perf. 3ms)
وَانْبَسَطَ: وَ + انْبَسَطَ — wa-, and + inbasaṭa, to be open, expansive, cheerful (verb VII of basṭ, perf. 3ms); 'and he was open (with me)'
آنَسَنِي: آنَسَ + ـنِي — ānasa, to make friendly, put at ease (verb IV of uns, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'he put me at ease'
وَسَأَلَنِي: وَ + سَأَلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and he asked me'
غُرْبَتِي: غُرْبَة + ـي — ghurba, estrangement, exile, being a stranger (f.) + 1s suffix; 'my exile'
فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ: فَـ + أَخْبَرْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I told him'
أَوَّلِهِ: أَوَّل + ـهِ — awwal, first, beginning (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'its beginning'
فَاغْتَمَّ: فَـ + اغْتَمَّ — fa-, so + ightamma, to grieve, be distressed (verb VIII of ghamm, perf. 3ms); 'so he grieved'
لِأَجْلِي: لِـ + أَجْل + ـي — li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake (m.) + 1s suffix; 'for my sake'
تُظْهِرْ: tuẓhir — aẓhara, to show, reveal (verb IV, impf. 2ms jussive after لَا)
مَلِكِ: malik, king (m., gen., first term of construct)
وَإِنَّهُ: وَ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + inna, indeed (particle) + 3ms suffix, subject of the following predicate; 'and indeed he'
أَكْبَرُ: أَكْبَر — akbar, greater/greatest (elative of kabura; m. nom., predicate of إِنَّ); 'the greatest of'
أَعْدَاءِ: أَعْدَاء — ʿaduww/aʿdāʾ, enemy/enemies (m. broken pl., gen.; made definite by the following construct, so it takes the regular case ending rather than the diptote fatḥa); 'the enemies of'
أَبِيكَ: أَبِي + ـكَ — ab, father (m., one of the 'five nouns', oblique/gen. stem abī) + 2ms suffix; 'your father'
أَحْضَرَ: aḥḍara — to bring, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَمَشْرُوبًا: وَ + مَشْرُوبًا — wa-, and + mashrūb, something drunk, a drink (pass. part. of shariba; m., acc. indef.); 'and a drink'
فَأَكَلْتُ: فَـ + أَكَلْتُ — fa-, so + akaltu (akala, perf. 1cs); 'so I ate'
وَأَكَلَ: وَ + أَكَلَ — wa-, and + akala (to eat, perf. 3ms); 'and he ate'
وَتَحَادَثْتُ: وَ + تَحَادَثْتُ — wa-, and + taḥādatha, to converse together (verb VI of ḥadīth, perf. 1cs); 'and I conversed'
وَأَفْرَدَ: وَ + أَفْرَدَ — wa-, and + afrada, to set apart, single out (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he set aside'
حَانُوتِهِ: حَانُوت + ـهِ — ḥānūt, shop, stall (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his shop'
وَأَتَانِي: وَ + أَتَى + ـنِي — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; أَتَى بِـ = 'to bring'; 'and he brought me'
احْتَاجَ: iḥtāja — to need, be in need of (verb VIII of ḥāja, perf. 3ms; construed with ilā); printed as 3ms though the sense wants 1cs, see the note on this unit
وَلِحَافٍ: وَ + لِحَاف — wa-, and + liḥāf, coverlet, quilt (m., gen. indef.); 'and a coverlet'
فَأَقَمْتُ: فَـ + أَقَمْتُ — fa-, so + aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'so I stayed'
ثَلَاثَةَ: thalātha, three (f.-form number counting a m. noun, by the polarity rule; acc. adverbial); thalāthata ayyāmin = 'three days'
تَكْتَسِبُ: taktasibu — iktasaba, to earn, gain (verb VIII of kasaba, impf. 2ms)
فَقِيهٌ: faqīh — jurist, one learned in fiqh (n. of relation to fiqh; m. nom. indef.)
كَاتِبٌ: kātib — scribe, writer (act. part. of kataba; m. nom. indef.)
حَاسِبٌ: ḥāsib — reckoner, accountant (act. part. of ḥasaba; m. nom. indef.)
خَطَّاطٌ: khaṭṭāṭ — calligrapher (intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl, from khaṭṭa; m. nom. indef.)
صَنْعَتُكَ: صَنْعَة + ـكَ — ṣanʿa, craft, trade (f., nom.) + 2ms suffix; 'your craft'
كَاسِدَةٌ: kāsida — unsalable, at a standstill, in no demand (act. part. of kasada; f., nom.)
بِلَادِنَا: بِلَاد + ـنَا — bilād, country, land (f. pl.) + 1pl suffix; 'our country'
مَدِينَتِنَا: مَدِينَة + ـنَا — madīna, city (f., gen.) + 1pl suffix; 'our city'
الْكَسْبِ: الـ + كَسْب — kasb, earning, gain, livelihood (m., gen.)
ذَكَرْتُهُ: ذَكَرْتُ + ـهُ — dhakara, to mention, recall (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I mentioned it'
شُدَّ: shudda — shadda, to tie, gird, tighten (verb I doubled, imper. 2ms); 'gird!'
وَسَطَكَ: وَسَط + ـكَ — wasaṭ, waist, middle (m., acc.) + 2ms suffix; 'your waist'
وَخُذْ: وَ + خُذْ — wa-, and + khudh (akhadha, to take; irregular imper. 2ms dropping the root hamza); 'and take!'
وَحَبْلًا: وَ + حَبْلًا — wa-, and + ḥabl, rope (m., acc. indef.); 'and a rope'
وَاحْتَطِبْ: وَ + احْتَطِبْ — wa-, and + iḥtaṭaba, to gather firewood (verb VIII of ḥaṭab, imper. 2ms); 'and gather firewood!'
تَتَقَوَّتُ: tataqawwatu — taqawwata, to nourish oneself, subsist (verb V of qūt, impf. 2ms); 'you subsist'
يُفَرِّجَ: yufarrija — farraja, to relieve, dispel distress (verb II, impf. 3ms subjunctive after أَنْ) Also subjunctive after ḥattā, 'until', with ʿan of the one relieved: ḥattā yufarrija Allāhu ʿanka hādhihi al-kurbata, 'until God lifts this distress from you' (Night 191).
تُعَرِّفْهُمْ: تُعَرِّفْ + ـهُمْ — ʿarrafa, to make known, acquaint (verb II, impf. 2ms jussive after لَا) + 3mp obj.; 'make yourself known to them'
بِنَفْسِكَ: بِـ + نَفْس + ـكَ — bi-, with, of (prep.) + nafs, self, soul (f.) + 2ms suffix; 'of yourself' (with ʿarrafa bi-, 'make known of'); here: muʿjaban bi-nafsika, bi- marks what one is pleased with, 'pleased with yourself'; also (Night 202): بِـ + نَفْس + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep.) + nafs, self, soul (f.) + 2ms suffix; after ʿarrafa, 'to acquaint with', bi- marks what is made known: ʿarrifhā bi-nafsika, 'make yourself known to her'; after khāṭara, 'to risk', bi- marks what is staked: lā tukhāṭir bi-nafsika, 'do not risk your life'; here after khāṭara bi-, bi- marks what is staked: 'your life'
يَقْتُلُوكَ: يَقْتُلُوا + ـكَ — yaqtulū (qatala, to kill, impf. 3mp jussive, jawāb al-ṭalab) + 2ms obj.; 'they will kill you'
وَسَلَّمَنِي: وَ + سَلَّمَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + sallama, to hand over, deliver (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and he handed me over'
الْحَطَّابِينَ: الـ + حَطَّابِين — ḥaṭṭāb, woodcutter (m. sound pl., gen.; intensive noun of profession, pattern faʿʿāl); 'the woodcutters'
وَأَوْصَاهُمْ: وَ + أَوْصَى + ـهُمْ — awṣā, to charge, commend, instruct (verb IV of waṣiyya, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; 'and he charged them'
احْتَطَبْتُ: iḥtaṭaba — to gather firewood (verb VIII of ḥaṭab, perf. 1cs); 'I gathered firewood'
نَهَارِي: نَهَار + ـي — nahār, daytime (m., acc. adverbial) + 1s suffix; 'my day'
فَأَتَيْتُ: فَـ + أَتَيْتُ — fa-, and so + ataytu (atā, perf. 1cs); 'and so I came'
بِحِمْلٍ: بِـ + حِمْل — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥiml, load, burden (m., gen. indef.); 'with a load'
فَبِعْتُهُ: فَـ + بِعْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + biʿtu (bāʿa, to sell, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I sold it'
بِنِصْفِ: بِـ + نِصْف — bi-, for (prep., of price) + niṣf, half (m., gen.); 'for half of'
بِبَعْضِهِ: بِـ + بَعْض + ـهِ — bi-, with, off (prep.) + baʿḍ, part (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'off part of it'
وَأَبْقَيْتُ: وَ + أَبْقَيْتُ — wa-, and + abqā, to leave, keep back (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I kept back'
بَعْضَهُ: بَعْض + ـهُ — baʿḍ, part, some (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'part of it'
مِلَّةَ: milla, religious community, creed (f., acc.); printed here where مُدَّة, 'a period, space of time', is meant — see the note on this unit
وَاسْتَغْرَقْتُ: وَ + اسْتَغْرَقْتُ — wa-, and + istaghraqa, to become immersed, go deep into (verb X of gharaqa, perf. 1cs); 'and I plunged deep'
غَوْطَةَ: ghawṭa, hollow, wooded dell, low tract with many trees (f., acc. indef.)
أَشْجَارٍ: أَشْجَار — shajar/ashjār, trees (m. broken pl. of shajara; gen. indef.)
الْغَوْطَةَ: الـ + غَوْطَة — ghawṭa, hollow, dell (f., acc., now definite); 'the hollow'
أَصْلَ: أَصْل — aṣl, root, base (m., acc., first term of construct); 'the root of'
غَلِيظَةٍ: ghalīẓa, thick, stout (adj., f., gen. indef.); agreeing with شَجَرَة
فَحَفَرْتُ: فَـ + حَفَرْتُ — fa-, so + ḥafartu (ḥafara, to dig, perf. 1cs); 'so I dug'
حَوْلَهَا: حَوْلَ + ـهَا — ḥawla, around (adv./prep.) + 3fs suffix; 'around it'
وَأَزَلْتُ: وَ + أَزَلْتُ — wa-, and + azāla, to remove, take away (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I removed'
فَعَثَرَتِ: فَـ + عَثَرَتِ — fa-, then + ʿatharat (ʿathara, to stumble, strike upon, verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with الْفَأْسُ; -i linking vowel before the article); 'then it (f.) struck upon'
فَنَظَّفْتُ: فَـ + نَظَّفْتُ — fa-, so + naẓẓaftu (naẓẓafa, to clean, verb II, perf. 1cs); 'so I cleaned'
فَكَشَفْتُهُ: فَـ + كَشَفْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + kashafa, to uncover, reveal (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I uncovered it'
أَسْفَلِ: أَسْفَل — asfal, lowest, bottom (elative of safula; m. gen., first term of construct); 'the bottom of'
فَدَخَلْتُهُ: فَـ + دَخَلْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, so + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I entered it'
أَحْسَنِ: أَحْسَن — aḥsan, better/best (elative of ḥasuna, 'to be good'; m. gen., first term of construct); 'the best of'
مُشَيَّدَةَ: mushayyada — well-built, firmly raised (pass. part. of shayyada, verb II; f., acc.); see the note on this unit's gender agreement
صَبِيَّةً: ṣabiyya, young girl, maiden (f., acc. indef.)
كَالدُّرَّةِ: كَـ + الـ + دُرَّة — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + durra, pearl (f., gen.); 'like the pearl'
السَّنِيَّةِ: الـ + سَنِيَّة — saniyy(a), lofty, radiant, sublime (adj., f., gen.); agreeing with الدُّرَّة
تَنْفِي: tanfī — nafā, to banish, drive away, deny (verb I defective, impf. 3fs)
وَغَمٍّ: وَ + غَمّ — wa-, and + ghamm, sorrow, distress (m., gen. indef.); 'and sorrow'
وَبَلِيَّهْ: وَ + بَلِيَّة — baliyya, affliction, calamity (f.); printed with ـه for the tāʾ marbūṭa, see the note on this unit; 'and an affliction'
كَلَامُهَا: كَلَام + ـهَا — kalām, speech, words (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her speech'
يَشْفِي: yashfī — shafā, to heal, cure (verb I defective, impf. 3ms)
الْكُرُوبَ: الـ + كُرُوب — karb/kurūb, distress, anguish (m. pl., acc.)
وَيَتْرُكُ: وَ + يَتْرُكُ — wa-, and + yatruku (taraka, to leave, impf. 3ms); 'and leaves'
الْعَاقِلَ: الـ + عَاقِل — ʿāqil, sensible, rational (act. part. of ʿaqala; m., acc.); 'the sensible man'
اللَّبِيبَ: الـ + لَبِيب — labīb, intelligent, sagacious (adj., m., acc.); agreeing with الْعَاقِلَ
مَسْلُوبْ: maslūb — plundered, robbed, stripped (pass. part. of salaba; here printed without the expected accusative ending, see the note on this unit)
خُمَاسِيَّةَ: خُمَاسِيَّة — khumāsiyya, five-part(ed), of five spans (rel. adj. from khamsa, 'five'; f. acc.); idiom for a tall, well-proportioned figure
قَاعِدَةَ: qāʿida — lit. sitting, firmly-based (act. part. of qaʿada; f., acc.); idiom for a firm, well-set bosom
نَاعِمَةَ: nāʿima — soft, smooth, delicate (adj., f., acc.)
مُشْرِقَةَ: mushriqa — radiant, shining (act. part. of ashraqa, verb IV; f., acc.)
مَلِيحَةَ: malīḥa, pretty, comely, lovely (adj., f., acc.)
الْكَوْنِ: الـ + كَوْن — kawn, being, form, existence (m., gen.); 'form, shape'
أَشْرَقَ: ashraqa — to shine forth, rise radiantly (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
وَجْهُهَا: وَجْه + ـهَا — wajh, face (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her face'
لَيْلِ: layl, night (m., gen., first term of construct); layli al-dhawāʾibi = 'the night of the locks'
الذَّوَائِبِ: الـ + ذَوَائِب — dhuʾāba/dhawāʾib, forelock, lock of hair (f. pl., gen.); 'the locks of hair'
وَلَمَعَ: وَ + لَمَعَ — wa-, and + lamaʿa, to gleam, flash, shine (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and gleamed'
ثَغْرُهَا: ثَغْر + ـهَا — thaghr, mouth, opening (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her mouth'
صَفَحَاتِ: صَفْحَة/صَفَحَات — ṣafḥa, surface, flat expanse (f. pl., gen., first term of construct); 'the surfaces of'
التَّرَائِبِ: الـ + تَرَائِب — tarība/tarāʾib, collarbone, upper breastbone (f. pl., gen.); 'the collarbones, the bosom'
دُجُوجِيَّةُ: dujūjiyya — dark as night, raven-black (rel./intensive adj. from دُجَى, 'darkness'; f., nom., first term of construct); with الْفَرْعَيْنِ, 'dark of the two locks'
الْفَرْعَيْنِ: الـ + فَرْعَيْنِ — farʿ, branch, lock of hair (m. dual, gen.); 'the two locks'
مَهْضُومَةُ: mahḍūma — lit. digested, wasted thin (pass. part. of haḍama; f., nom., first term of construct); idiom for a slender waist
الْحَشَا: الـ + حَشَا — ḥashā, belly, inside (m., gen.)
كَثِيبَةُ: kathība — dune-like, full and rounded (adj. from kathīb, 'sand dune'; f., nom., first term of construct)
بَانِيَةُ: bāniya — firmly built, well-shaped (act. part. of banā, 'to build'; f., nom., first term of construct)
اَرْبَعَةٌ: arbaʿa, four (f.-form number, counting a m. pl. by the polarity rule; nom. indef., subject of the following relative clause)
اجْتَمَعَتْ: ijtamaʿat — ijtamaʿa, to gather, come together (verb VIII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with أَرْبَعَة)
قَطُّ: qaṭṭu — never, (not) at all (adv., used with a negated perfect); here reinforcing the negation in مَا اجْتَمَعَتْ; also: with lam + jussive, lam ākulhu qaṭṭu, 'I never ate it'
اِذًا: idhan — then, in that case (particle); its force here is obscure, apparently reinforcing قَطُّ, 'never, at all' — possibly a corruption of أَبَدًا, see the note on this unit; printed with no points at all, vocalised here like prose
الّا: illā — except, but (exceptive particle); printed with the shadda alone and no hamza, as often in vocalised print
عَلى: ʿalā — on, upon, against (prep.); here 'at the cost of' (printed with a single mark, less fully pointed than عَلَى elsewhere in this slice, but already pointed all the same and so kept exactly as printed)
مَهجَتي: مُهْجَة + ي — muhja, heart's blood, the vital spirit (f.) + 1s suffix; 'my heart's blood'
وسَفكِ: وَ + سَفْك — wa-, and + safk, shedding, spilling (verbal noun of safaka; m., gen., coordinated with مَهْجَتِي)
دَمي: دَم + ي — dam, blood (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my blood'
ضَوءُ: ḍawʾ, light, brightness (m., nom., first term of construct)
ولَيلُ: وَ + لَيْل — wa-, and + layl, night (m., nom., first term of construct); coordinated with ضَوْءُ
طُرَّتِه: طُرَّة + ـه — ṭurra, forelock, lock of hair (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix (printed 'his', though the poem describes a woman — probably for طُرَّتِهَا, 'her forelock'; see the note on this unit); 'her forelock'
ووَردُ: وَ + وَرْد — wa-, and + ward, rose(-red hue) (m., nom., first term of construct)
خَلٍ: khāl (printed defectively without the alif — see the note on this unit) — mole, beauty-spot (m., gen. indef.)
وضَوى: وَ + ضَوًى — wa-, and + ḍawan, leanness, sickly thinness (m. invariable noun, first term of construct)
جِسم: jism, body (m.; printed without a case ending, see the note on this unit)
سَجَدْتُ: سَجَدَ + تُ — sajada, to prostrate oneself; 1st sg. perfect, 'I prostrated'
لِخَالِقِهَا: لِـ + خَالِق + هَا — li-, to (prep., marking the object of سجد) + khāliq, creator (act. part. of خَلَقَ) + hā, her; 'to her Creator'
أَبْدَعَ: أَبْدَعَ — abdaʿa, to devise, fashion admirably (form IV of بدع); 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'He fashioned'
فِيهِمَا: فِي + هِمَا — fī, in (prep.) + 3rd dual suffix; 'in the two of them'; here: after qāla, 'about the two of them'
تَكُونُ: تَكُونُ — takūnu, to be (imperfect of كَانَ); 2nd m. sg., 'you are'; also 3rd f. sg.: 'it (f.) will be'
إِنْسِيٌّ: إِنْسِيّ — insiyy, human (relative adj. from إِنْس, 'mankind')
أَوْصَلَكَ: أَوْصَلَ + كَ — awṣala, to bring, convey (form IV of وصل); 3rd m. sg. perfect + 2nd m. sg. object suffix, 'brought you'
خَمْسَةً: خَمْسَة — khamsa, five; accusative, first part of the compound numeral 'twenty-five'
إِنْسِيًّا: إِنْسِيّ + ـًا — insiyy, human; indefinite accusative, object of رأيت
فَوَقَدْ: ف + و + قَدْ — fa-, and + wa-, and + qad, already, indeed (particle marking completed action); two conjunctions stacked before qad, 'and indeed'
وَجَدْتُتْ: وَجَدَ + تُ (+ stray ت) — wajada, to find; 1st sg. perfect, printed with an extra, unexplained ت; 'I found'
لِكَلَامِهَا: لِـ + كَلَام + هَا — li-, to/for (prep., marking what the quality belongs to) + kalām, speech (m.) + hā, her; 'to/for her speech'
عُذُوبَةً: عُذُوبَة — ʿudhūba, sweetness (f., verbal noun of عَذُبَ, 'to be sweet'); accusative predicate of وجدت
بِمَجَامِعِ: بِـ + مَجَامِع — bi-, by/with (prep., marking what was seized, in the idiom أَخَذَ بِـ 'to take hold of') + majāmiʿ, gathering-places (pl. of مَجْمَع); 'by the gathering-places of'
سَيِّدَتِي: سَيِّدَة + ي — sayyida, lady, mistress (f. of سَيِّد) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my lady'; here: after yā, vocative, 'O my lady'
مَنَازِلِي: مَنَازِل + ي — manāzil, stations, degrees (pl. of مَنْزِل) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my stations'
لَهَابِ: لَهَاب — lahāb, a blazing, intense flame (intensive noun from لَهَب, 'flame'); genitive, 'of the blazing'
وَغَمِّي: و + غَمّ + ي — wa-, and + ghamm, grief, distress (m.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'and my grief'
وَحَكَيْتُ: و + حَكَيْتُ — ḥakā, to recount, narrate; 1st sg. perfect, 'and I recounted'
الْآخِرِ: الـ + آخِر — ākhir, last, final (m.); 'the last, the end'
فَصَعُبَ: ف + صَعُبَ — ṣaʿuba, to become difficult, hard; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'so it grew hard'
أُعْلِمُكَ: أُعْلِمُ + كَ — aʿlama, to inform (form IV of عَلِمَ); 1st sg. imperfect + 2nd m. sg. object suffix, 'I inform you'
بِقِصَّتِي: بِـ + قِصَّة + ي — bi-, of/with (prep., marking the object of أُعْلِمُ) + qiṣṣa, story (f.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'of my story'
أَفِيتَامُوسَ: أَفِيتَامُوس — Afītāmūs, proper name, the princess's father; genitive/apposition, an indeclinable foreign name
جَزِيرَةِ: جَزِيرَة — jazīra, island (f.); construct, 'the Isle of'
زَوَّجَنِي: زَوَّجَ + نِي — zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (someone) (form II of زوج) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he married me'
فَلَيْلَةَ: ف + لَيْلَةَ — fa-, then + layla, night (f.); accusative of time, 'then on the night of'
زِفَافِي: زِفَاف + ي — zifāf, wedding, nuptials (m.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my wedding'
خْتَطَفَنِي: اِخْتَطَفَ + نِي — ikhtaṭafa, to snatch away, abduct (form VIII of خطف); printed without its initial alif (see the note on this sentence) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he snatched me away'
جِرْجِيسُ: جِرْجِيس — Jirjīs, proper name, the efrit; nominative, predicate of اسمه
رِجْمُوسَ: رِجْمُوس — Rijmūs, proper name, the efrit's father; genitive
خَالَةِ: خَالَة — khāla, maternal aunt (f.); construct, 'the maternal aunt of'
إِبْلِيسَ: إِبْلِيس — Iblīs, the Devil (proper name); genitive
فَطَارَ: ف + طَارَ — ṭāra, to fly; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'so he flew'
وَالْحُلِيِّ: و + الـ + حُلِيّ — wa-, and + ḥuliyy, jewelry, ornaments (pl. of حَلْي)
وَالْقُمَاشِ: و + الـ + قُمَاش — wa-, and + qumāsh, cloth, fabric (m.)
وَالْمَتَاعِ: و + الـ + مَتَاع — wa-, and + matāʿ, goods, furnishings (m.)
وَالطَّعَامِ: و + الـ + طَعَام — wa-, and + ṭaʿām, food (m.)
وَالشَّرَابِ: و + الـ + شَرَاب — wa-, and + sharāb, drink (m.)
يَأْتِينِي: يَأْتِي + نِي — yaʾtī, to come (imperfect of أَتَى) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'he comes to me'
يَنَامُ: يَنَامُ — yanāmu, to sleep (imperfect of نَامَ); 'he sleeps'
لَيْلَةً: laylatan — layla, night (f., acc., adverbial of time); 'a night' Also acc. after yā in an exclamation: yā laylatan samaḥa al-zamānu lanā bihā, 'O night that Time granted us!'.
لِحَالِ: لِـ + حَال — li-, to (prep.) + ḥāl, state (m.); construct, in the idiom لِحَالِ سَبِيلِهِ, 'on his way'
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + هُ — li-, because (prep. governing the causal clause) + anna, that + 3rd m. sg. suffix; -hu, he/it, or the pronoun of the fact ('because it is so that…'); 'because he/it; because'
أَخَذَنِي: أَخَذَ + نِي — akhadha, to take; 3rd m. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'he took me' (printed twice; see the note on this sentence)
رِضًى: رِضًى — riḍan, consent, contentment (m.; a maqṣūr noun spelled invariantly with tanwīn fatḥa over the final ى regardless of case)
وَعَاهَلَ: و + عَاهَلَ — printed for the expected عَاهَدَ, 'he made a covenant' (form III of عهد); 3rd m. sg. perfect (see the note on this sentence)
أَوْ: أَوْ — aw, or (disjunctive); printed already pointed in the verse, with precomposed hamza on alif as the edition has it
أَلْمِسَ: أَلْمِسَ — almisa, to touch (1st sg. subjunctive of لَمَسَ); 'that I touch'
السَّطْرَيْنِ: الـ + سَطْرَيْنِ — saṭrayn, two lines (dual of سَطْر, oblique); 'the two lines'
الْمَكْتُوبَيْنِ: الـ + مَكْتُوبَيْنِ — maktūbayn, written (dual pass. part. of كَتَبَ, oblique); 'the written'
أُشِيلُ: أُشِيلُ — ushīlu, to lift, raise (colloquial verb, imperfect of شَالَ, in place of Classical أَرْفَعُ); 'I lift'
وَأَرَاهُ: و + أَرَى + هُ — wa-, and (in the idiom مَا…إِلَّا وَ) + arā, to see (1st sg. imperfect of رَأَى) + 3rd m. sg. object suffix; 'than I see him'
تُقِيمَ: تُقِيمَ — tuqīma, to stay, reside (subjunctive of أَقَامَ, form IV of قام); 'you stay'
وَتَنْصَرِفَ: و + تَنْصَرِفَ — tanṣarifa, to depart, leave (subjunctive of اِنْصَرَفَ, form VII of صرف); 'and you depart'
بِيَوْمٍ: بِـ + يَوْم — bi-, by (prep., measure of difference) + yawm, day (m.); 'by a day'; also after wa-law, 'even if (only) for a day': bi- marks the span
حَبَّذَا: حَبَّذَا — ḥabbadhā, how excellent a thing! (fixed exclamatory particle of approval)
صَحَّتِ: صَحَّتْ — ṣaḥḥat, to prove true, sound; 3rd f. sg. perfect of صَحَّ
الْأَحْلَامُ: الـ + أَحْلَام — aḥlām, dreams (pl. of حُلْم); nominative subject
وَنَهَضَتْ: و + نَهَضَتْ — nahaḍat, to rise, get up; 3rd f. sg. perfect
أَقْدَامِهَا: أَقْدَام + هَا — aqdām, feet (pl. of قَدَم) + 3rd f. sg. suffix; 'her feet'
فَمَسَكَتْنِي: ف + مَسَكَتْ + نِي — masaka, to seize, take hold of; 3rd f. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'so she took hold of me'
وَأَدْخَلَتْنِي: و + أَدْخَلَتْ + نِي — adkhalat, to bring in (3rd f. sg. perfect, form IV of دخل) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'and she brought me in'
مُقَنْطَرٍ: مُقَنْطَر — muqanṭar, arched, vaulted (pass. part. of the quadriliteral قَنْطَرَ)
وَانْتَهَتْ: و + اِنْتَهَتْ — intahat, to arrive at last (3rd f. sg. perfect, form VIII of اِنْتَهَى)
قَلَعَتْ: قَلَعَتْ — qalaʿat, to take off, remove; 3rd f. sg. perfect, 'she took off'
ثِيَابِي: ثِيَاب + ي — thiyāb, clothes (pl. of ثَوْب) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my clothes'
فَغَسَلَتْ: ف + غَسَلَتْ — ghasalat, to wash; 3rd f. sg. perfect
فَجَلَسَتْ: ف + جَلَسَتْ — jalasat, to sit; 3rd f. sg. perfect
وَأَجَاسَتْنَى: و + أَجَاسَتْ + نَى — printed for the expected أَجْلَسَتْنِي, 'she seated me' (causative, form IV of جَلَسَ) + 1st sg. object suffix, here spelled with a final ى in place of ي (see the note on this sentence)
جَانِبِهَا: جَانِب + هَا — jānib, side (m.) + 3rd f. sg. suffix; 'her side'
بِسُكَّرٍ: بِـ + سُكَّر — bi-, with (prep.) + sukkar, sugar (m.); 'with sugar(-syrup)'
وَسَقَتْنِي: و + سَقَتْ + نِي — saqā, to give to drink; 3rd f. sg. perfect + 1st sg. object suffix, 'and she gave me to drink'
وَتَحَادَثْنَا: و + تَحَادَثْنَا — taḥādathnā, to converse together; 1st pl. perfect (form VI of حدث)
وَاسْتَرِحْ: و + اِسْتَرِحْ — istariḥ, rest! (2nd m. sg. imperative, form X of رَاحَ)
نَسِيتُ: نَسِيتُ — nasītu, I forgot (1st sg. perfect of نَسِيَ; printed twice, see the note on this sentence)
اسْتَيْقَظْتُ: اِسْتَيْقَظْتُ — istayqaẓtu, I awoke (1st sg. perfect, form X of يقظ)
وَجَدْتُهَا: وَجَدْتُ + هَا — wajadtu, I found + 3rd f. sg. object suffix; 'I found her'
تَكْبِسُ: تَكْبِسُ — takbisu, to press, knead (3rd f. sg. imperfect of كَبَسَ)
رِجْلِي: رِجْل + ي — rijl, leg, foot (f.) + 1st sg. suffix; 'my leg'
فَدَعَوْتُ: ف + دَعَوْتُ — daʿawtu, I called, invoked (1st sg. perfect of دَعَا); 'so I prayed, invoked blessing'
نَتَحَادَثُ: نَتَحَادَثُ — nataḥādathu, we converse (1st pl. imperfect, form VI); circumstantial, 'conversing'
ضَيِّقَةَ: ضَيِّقَة — ḍayyiqa, narrow, straitened (f. adj. of ضَيِّق); accusative predicate
وَحْدِي: وَحْد + ي — waḥd, alone + 1st sg. suffix; 'alone'
يُؤْنِسُنِي: يُؤْنِسُ + نِي — yuʾnisu, to keep company, comfort (imperfect, form IV of أَنِسَ) + 1st sg. object suffix; 'keep me company'
فَالْحَمْدُ: ف + الـ + حَمْد — fa-, so + al-ḥamd, the praise (m., verbal noun of حَمِدَ); 'so praise'
أَرْسَلَكَ: أَرْسَلَ + كَ — arsala, to send (form IV of رَسِلَ) + 2nd m. sg. object suffix; 'sent you'
فَعَمَدَتْ: ف + عَمَدَتْ — ʿamadat, to go purposefully to; 3rd f. sg. perfect of عَمَدَ
خُرُسْتَانَ: خُرُسْتَان — khurustān, a store-closet, pantry (uncertain word; see the note on this sentence)
وَأَخْرَجَتْ: و + أَخْرَجَتْ — akhrajat, to bring, take out; 3rd f. sg. perfect, form IV of خَرَجَ
شَرَابًا: شَرَاب — sharāb, wine, drink (m.); indefinite accusative
مَخْتُومًا: مَخْتُوم — makhtūm, sealed (pass. part. of خَتَمَ)
خُضْرَةً: خُضْرَة — khuḍra, a green (thing), greenery (f.); indefinite accusative, probably a green cloth spread for the wine
فَأَخَذَتْ: ف + أَخَذَتْ — akhadhat, to take; 3rd f. sg. perfect
عَلِمْنَا: عَلِمْنَا — ʿalimnā, we knew (1st pl. perfect of عَلِمَ)
قُدُومَكُمْ: قُدُوم + كُمْ — qudūm, coming, arrival (m., verbal noun of قَدِمَ) + 2nd pl. suffix; 'your coming'
لَنَشَرْنَا: لَـ + نَشَرْنَا — la-, verily (emphatic particle introducing the apodosis of law) + nasharnā, we would have strewn, scattered (1st pl. perfect of نَشَرَ)
مُهْجَةَ: مُهْجَة — muhja, the heart's blood, the life-essence (f.); construct, accusative object
سَوَادَ: سَوَاد — sawād, blackness (m.); construct, accusative, coordinated with مُهْجَةَ
الْعُيُونِ: الـ + عُيُون — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عَيْن); genitive; idiom سَوَادُ الْعُيُونِ, 'the black of the eyes', i.e. the pupils
وَفَرَشْنَا: و + فَرَشْنَا — farashnā, we would have spread (1st pl. perfect of فَرَشَ)
خُدُودَنَا: خُدُود + نَا — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of خَدّ) + 1st pl. suffix; 'our cheeks'
لِلِقَاكُمْ: لِـ + لِقَاء + كُمْ — li-, for (prep., purpose) + liqāʾ, meeting (verbal noun of لَقِيَ) + 2nd pl. suffix; 'for meeting you'
لِيَكُونَ: لِـ + يَكُونَ — li-, so that (purpose particle governing the subjunctive) + yakūna, it be (subjunctive of كَانَ); 'that it might be'
الْمَسِيرُ: الـ + مَسِير — masīr, journey, passage (m., verbal noun of سَارَ); nominative subject
الْجُفُونِ: الـ + جُفُون — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of جَفْن); genitive
شَعْرِهَا: شَعْر + ـهَا — shaʿr, hair (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'her hair' — distinct from شِعْر 'poetry' later in this slice: identical consonants, different vowels
شَكَرْتُهَا: شَكَرَ + تُ + هَا — shakara, to thank (verb I) + 1cs perf. + 3fs obj.; 'I thanked her'
تَمَكَّنَتْ: تَمَكَّنَ (form V of makana, 'to become firmly established') + تْ (3fs); 'it became firmly established'
مَحَبَّتُهَا: مَحَبَّة + ـهَا — maḥabba, love, affection (f., verbal noun of aḥabba) + 3fs poss.; 'her love', i.e. love for her
ذَهَبَ: dhahaba — dhahaba, to go, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'it went, departed'
مُنَادَمَةٍ: مُنَادَمَة — munādama, boon-companionship, intimate conversation (f., verbal noun of III nādama 'to keep company drinking/conversing'; gen. after فِي)
فَبِتُّ: فَـ + بِتُّ — fa- + bittu (bāta, to spend the night; verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I spent the night'
مِثْلَهَا: مِثْل + ـهَا — mithl, like, similar (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'its like'
وَأَصْبَحْنَا: وَ + أَصْبَحْنَا — aṣbaḥa, to become; here a 'sister of kāna' followed by an imperfect predicate, giving 'we went on doing X'; 1st pl. perf.
نَصِلُ: naṣilu — waṣala, to continue, keep up (verb I; here impf. 1st pl., predicate of aṣbaḥnā); 'we continue, keep up'
السُّرُورَ: الـ + سُرُور — surūr, joy, delight (m., acc., object of naṣilu)
فَسَكِرْتُ: فَـ + سَكِرْتُ — fa- + sakirtu (sakira, to become drunk; verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I became drunk'
سُكْرًا: sukran — sukr, drunkenness (m., acc., cognate object of sakirtu); 'a drunkenness' (intensifying)
