أَلْبَثْ: أَلْبَثْ — albath, 1st sg. jussive of لَبِثَ, "I tarry, delay" (after لم); archive spells it without the initial hamza mark, supplied here.
اللَّٰهُ: Allāh(u) — "God"; also occurs accusative اللَّٰهَ as the object of a verb (e.g. سميت اللهَ, لا تسمِّ اللهَ).
القَوْسَ: al-qaws(a) — "the bow" (accusative here; also occurs genitive القَوْسِ and nominative القَوْسُ depending on its grammatical role).
زَوْرَقًا: زَوْرَق — zawraq, skiff, small boat; acc. indef., object of ra'aytu
قَاصِدًا: قَاصِد — qāṣid, heading, making for (act. part. of qaṣada); acc., circumstantial (ḥāl) describing the skiff
الزَّوْرَقِ: الـ + زَوْرَق — zawraq, skiff; gen. after ilā
شَخْصًا: شَخْص — shakhṣ, figure, person; acc. indef., object of wajadtu Also as the noun of inna: inna shakhṣan bi-al-bābi, 'someone is at the door'.
لَوْحًا: لَوْح — lawḥ, tablet, plaque; acc. indef., further object of wajadtu, in apposition to shakhṣan
مَنْقُوشً: مَنْقُوش — manqūsh, inscribed, engraved (pass. part. of naqasha); acc., adjective of lawḥan (the archive omits the usual tanwīn-alif here, so the accusative is marked by the fatḥatan alone)
بِأَسْمَاءٍ: بِـ + أَسْمَاء — bi-, with (prep., marking the content of the inscription) + asmāʾ, names (pl. of ism); 'inscribed with names'
وَطِلَسْمَاتٍ: وَ + طِلَسْمَات — wa-, "and" + ṭilasmāt, "talismans" (pl. of ṭilasm); coordinated with أَسْمَاء under the same بِـ ("with") governing both, continuing "...inscribed with names and talismans."
سَاكِتٌ: سَاكِت — sākit, silent, quiet (act. part. of sakata); nom., predicate of anā
أَنْكَلِمُ: أَنْكَلِمُ — ankalimu, I speak (Form VII, infaʿala, of root k-l-m; Middle Arabic for Classical atakallamu, 'to speak')
فَقَذَفَ: فَـ + قَذَفَ — fa-, then (conj.) + qadhafa, to cast, hurl, throw; 'then it cast/hurled [onward]' Also of rowing a boat, with bi- of those carried: fa-qadhafa binā al-mallāḥu, 'and the boatman rowed us on'.
الشَّخْصُ: الـ + شَخْص — shakhṣ, figure, person; nom., subject
أَوَّلَ: أَوَّل — awwal, first; acc., time adverbial 'awwala yawmin', on the first day
العَشَرَةِ: الـ + عَشَرَة — ʿasharah, ten; gen., in construct with tamām
فَنَظَرْتُ: فَـ + نَظَرَ — fa-, then (conj.) + naẓara, to look; 'then I looked' Also with a direct object, 'and I saw': fa-naẓartu mā lam anẓuri, 'and I saw what I had never seen'.
وَرَأَيْتُ: وَ + رَأَى — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see; 'and I saw' (hamza printed in the edition, kept precomposed as printed)
جَزَائِرَ: جَزَائِر — jazāʾir, islands (pl. of jazīra); acc., in construct with al-salāmati
فَرَحِي: فَرَح + ـِي — faraḥ, joy + -ī, my; gen. after shiddati
ذَكَرْتُ: ذَكَرَ — dhakara, to remember, mention, invoke; 'I invoked, called to mind'
وَسَمَّيْتُ: وَ + سَمَّى — wa-, and (conj.) + sammā, to name, pronounce (God's) name; idiom for 'to say the basmala'
وَهَلَّلْتُ: وَ + هَلَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + hallala, to proclaim 'lā ilāha illā allāh' (the tahlīl)
وَكَبَّرْتُ: وَ + كَبَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + kabbara, to proclaim 'Allāhu akbar' (the takbīr)
قَذَفَنِي: قَذَفَ + ـنِي — qadhafa, to cast, hurl + -nī, me; 'it cast me'
الزَّوْرَقُ: الـ + زَوْرَق — zawraq, skiff; nom., subject
وَانْقَلَبَ: وَ + انْقَلَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + inqalaba, to overturn, capsize (Form VII of qalaba)
فَكُنْتُ: فَـ + كُنْتُ — fa-, and (conj.) + kuntu, I was (kāna, 1st sg. perfect)
العَوْمَ: الـ + عَوْم — ʿawm, swimming; acc., object of aʿrifu
فَعُمْتُ: فَـ + عُمْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿumtu, I swam (ʿāma, yaʿūmu, 1st sg. perfect)
فَخَذَلَتْ: فَـ + خَذَلَتْ — fa-, then (conj.) + khadhalat, [it/she] failed, forsook (khadhala, 3fs perfect); 'failed me'
سَوَاعِدِي: سَوَاعِد + ـِي — sawāʿid, forearms (pl. of sāʿid) + -ī, my
وَكَلَّتْ: وَ + كَلَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + kallat, [it/she] grew weary (kalla, 3fs perfect)
وَتَعِبْتُ: وَ + تَعِبْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʿibtu, I grew tired (taʿiba, 1st sg. perfect)
الهَلَكَاتِ: الـ + هَلَكَات — halakāt, perils, mortal dangers (pl. of halakah); gen. after fī
تَشَهَّدْتُ: تَشَهَّدَ — tashahhada, to recite the profession of faith (shahāda), esp. facing death; 'I made my profession of faith'
بِالمَوْتِ: بِـ + الـ + مَوْت — bi-, of (prep., governed by ayqana) + mawt, death; 'certain of death'
البَحْرُ: الـ + بَحْر — baḥr, sea; nom., subject
مَوْجَةٌ: مَوْجَة — mawjah, a wave; nom. indef., subject of jā'at
كَالقَلْعَةِ: كَـ + الـ + قَلْعَة — ka-, like (prep.) + qalʿah, fortress, citadel; gen. after ka-
العَظِيمَةِ: الـ + عَظِيمَة — ʿaẓīmah, great, mighty (f.); gen., adjective of al-qalʿati
فَحَمَلَتْنِي: فَـ + حَمَلَتْ + ـنِي — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥamalat, [it/she] carried (ḥamala, 3fs) + -nī, me
وَقَذَفَتْنِي: وَ + قَذَفَتْ + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + qadhafat, [it/she] cast (3fs) + -nī, me
قَذْفَةً: قَذْفَة — qadhfah, a single cast, throw; acc., cognate object of qadhafatnī
البَرِّ: الـ + بَرّ — barr, [dry] land, shore; gen. after fawqa
البَرَّ: الـ + بَرّ — barr, [dry] land, shore; acc., object of ṭalaʿtu
وَعَصَرْتُ: وَ + عَصَرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaṣartu, I wrung out, squeezed (ʿaṣara, 1st sg. perfect)
وَنَشَّفْتُهَا: وَ + نَشَّفَ + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + nashshafa, to dry (Form II of nashifa) + -hā, them (f.); 'I dried them'
وَنَشَرْتُهَا: وَ + نَشَرَ + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + nashara, to spread out + -hā, them (f.); 'I spread them out'
وَبِتُّ: وَ + بِتُّ — wa-, and (conj.) + bittu, I spent the night (bāta, 1st sg. perfect)
أَصْبَحَتُ: أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa, to enter the morning, come to be (Form IV of ṣabaḥa); 1st sg. perfect, 'morning came upon me'
لَبِسْتُ: لَبِسَ — labisa, to wear, put on; 1st sg. perfect
أَمْشِي: أَمْشِي — amshī, I walk, go (mashā, 1st sg. imperf.)
غُوطَةً: غُوطَة — ghūṭah, a fertile hollow, wooded depression; acc. indef., object of wajadtu
فَجِئْتُهَا: فَـ + جِئْتُ + ـهَا — fa-, so (conj.) + jiʾtu, I came (jāʾa, 1st sg. perfect) + -hā, it (f.)
وَدُرْتُ: وَ + دُرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + durtu, I went around, circled (dāra, 1st sg. perfect)
المَوْضِعَ: الـ + مَوْضِع — mawḍiʿ, place, location; acc., object of wajadtu
جَزِيرَةً: جَزِيرَة — jazīrah, island; acc., second object/predicate of wajadtu
وَالبَحْرُ: وَ + الـ + بَحْر — wa-, and (conj.) + baḥr, sea; nom., subject of a new circumstantial clause
مُحِيطٌ: مُحِيط — muḥīṭ, surrounding, encompassing (act. part. of aḥāṭa); nom., predicate
أَخْلُصُ: أَخْلُصُ — akhluṣu, I escape, get free (khalaṣa, 1st sg. imperf.)
بَلِيَّةٍ: بَلِيَّة — baliyyah, calamity, affliction; gen. indef. after min
أَقَعُ: أَقَعُ — aqaʿu, I fall (waqaʿa, 1st sg. imperf.) Also with ʿalā, 'to come upon': لَعَلِّي أَقَعُ عَلَى خَبَرِهَا 'in case I come upon news of her'.
أَعْظَمَ: أَعْظَم — aʿẓam, greater, greatest (elative of ʿaẓīm); gen. (diptote) after fī Also: أَعْظَمَ — aʿẓama, to make great (verb IV of ʿaẓuma, perf. 3ms used as a wish): aʿẓama Allāhu ajraki, 'may God make your reward great', the formula of condolence. Also aʿẓam, greater, greatest (elative of ʿaẓīm); gen. (diptote) after fī
أَمْرِي: أَمْر + ـِي — amr, matter, situation + -ī, my
أَتَمَنَّى: أَتَمَنَّى — atamannā, I wish, long for (tamannā, Form V, 1st sg. imperf.)
المَوْتَ: الـ + مَوْت — mawt, death; acc., object of atamannā
الجَزِيرَةِ: الـ + جَزِيرَة — jazīrah, island; gen. after ilā
وَقَعَدْتُ: وَ + قَعَدْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qaʿadtu, I sat (qaʿada, 1st sg. perfect)
بِالمَرْكَبِ: بِـ + الـ + مَرْكَب — bi-, [marks the noun introduced by idhā al-mufājaʾa, 'and behold…'] + markab, ship; gen. after bi-; 'there was the ship'
الْتَصَقَ: اِلْتَصَقَ — iltaṣaqa, to stick fast, cling, come to rest against (Form VIII of laṣiqa); here, the ship had grounded, come alongside
وَمَعَهُمْ: وَ + مَعَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + maʿa, with + -hum, them; 'and with them'
مَسَاحِي: مَسَاحِي — masāḥī, mattocks, spades (invariable Middle Arabic plural of miṣḥāh; Classical would inflect as masāḥin here); predicate, 'with them were mattocks'
فَحَفَرُوا: فَـ + حَفَرُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥafarū, they dug (ḥafara, 3mp perfect)
وَكَشَفُوا: وَ + كَشَفُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + kashafū, they uncovered, revealed (kashafa, 3mp perfect); kashafa ʿan, 'to uncover [to reveal]'
طَابِقٍ: طَابِق — ṭābiq, a slab, trapdoor (covering a vault); gen. indef. after ʿan
فَشَالُوا: فَـ + شَالُوا — fa-, and (conj.) + shālū, they lifted, carried (shāla, 3mp perfect; Middle Arabic/colloquial verb, Classical rafaʿa/ḥamala)
وَفَتَحُوا: وَ + فَتَحُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + fataḥū, they opened (fataḥa, 3mp perfect)
بَابَهُ: بَاب + ـهُ — bāb, door + -hu, its; acc., object Also -hu, his: fa-daqqa bābahu, 'he knocked at his door'.
عَادُوا: عَادَ + ـوا — ʿāda, to return + -ū, they (3mp perfect)
المَرْكَبِ: الـ + مَرْكَب — markab, ship; gen. after ilā
وَنَقَلُوا: وَ + نَقَلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + naqalū, they carried, transported (naqala, 3mp perfect)
وَدَقِيقًا: وَ + دَقِيق — wa-, and (conj.) + daqīq, flour; acc. indef.
وَسَمْنًا: وَ + سَمْن — wa-, and (conj.) + samn, clarified butter, ghee; acc. indef.
وَعَسَلًا: وَ + عَسَل — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿasal, honey; acc. indef.
وَأَغْنَامًا: وَ + أَغْنَام — wa-, and (conj.) + aghnām, sheep, livestock (pl. of ghanam); acc. indef.
وَآلَاتٍ: وَ + آلَات — wa-, and (conj.) + ālāt, tools, implements (pl. of ālah); acc. indef. (sound f. pl., kasra ending; the edition itself prints the initial madda ʾalif, آ, kept as printed)
السَّاكِنُ: الـ + سَاكِن — sākin, dweller, resident (act. part. of sakana); nom., subject of yaḥtāju
طَالِعِينَ: طَالِعِينَ — ṭāliʿīn, going up, ascending (act. part. pl. of ṭalaʿa); acc., circumstantial (ḥāl)
يُحَوِّلُونَ: يُحَوِّلُونَ — yuḥawwilūna, they transfer, move [things] (ḥawwala, Form II, 3mp imperf.)
وَيَنْزِلُونَ: وَ + يَنْزِلُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yanzilūna, they go down, descend (nazala, 3mp imperf.)
نَقَلُوا: نَقَلُوا — naqalū, they carried, transported (naqala, 3mp perfect)
الحُفْرَةِ: الـ + حُفْرَة — ḥufrah, pit, hole; gen. after ilā
العَبِيدُ: الـ + عَبِيد — ʿabīd, slaves; nom., subject
ثِيَابٌ: ثِيَاب, pl. of ثَوْب — thiyāb, clothes, garments (m. pl.)
أَحْسَنُ: أَحْسَنُ — aḥsan, elative of حَسَن, 'more/most beautiful, best'; in أَحْسَنُ مَا يَكُونُ, a frozen idiom, 'the finest it could be'
وَعَرَكَهُ: وَ + عَرَكَ + هُ — wa-, and + ʿaraka, to rub, wear down (v.) + hu, him
الدَّهْرُ: الـ + دَهْر — al-, the + dahr, time, fate
وَاِسْتَبْقَى: وَ + اِسْتَبْقَى — wa-, and + istabqā, Form X of بقي (hamzat waṣl, kasra); here intransitive, 'endured, lingered on' (also possible: 'preserved, spared')
كَأَنَّهُ: كَأَنَّ + هُ — ka-anna, as though (particle) + hu, he
مُفْنًي: مُفْنًي — pass. part. of أَفْنَى (archive spells the final radical with ya, not alif maqsura), 'spent, consumed, worn to nothing'
مُلْقًى: مُلْقًى — pass. part. of أَلْقَى, 'thrown, cast down'
خِرْقَةِ: خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, tattered cloth (f.); construct, muḍāf
زُرْقَةٍ: زُرْقَة — zurqa, blueness (f.); muḍāf ilayh: خِرْقَةِ زُرْقَةٍ, lit. 'a rag of blueness' = a blue rag
تَمُرُّ: تَمُرُّ — marra/yamurru, to pass, 3rd sg. f. pres.; 'passes, blows through'
وَشَرْقًا: وَ + شَرْقًا — wa-, and + sharqan, eastward (acc. of place)
الشَّاعِرُ: الـ + شَاعِر — al-, the + shāʿir, poet
أَرْعَشَ: أَرْعَشَ — arʿasha, Form IV, 'made tremble, shook'
ايّ: for Classical أَيّ, exclamatory 'what a—!' (governs a following genitive); printed here without its initial hamza, kept exactly as archived (see n)
وَالدَّهْرُ: وَ + الـ + دَهْر — wa-, and + al-, the + dahr, time, fate (nom., mubtadaʾ)
رَعْشٍ: رَعْش — raʿsh, trembling, a shudder; muḍāf ilayh of exclamatory أَيّ
وَبَطْشٍ: وَ + بَطْش — wa-, and + baṭsh, violence, a violent grip
وَلَسْتُ: وَ + لَسْتُ — wa-, and + lastu, 'I am not' (neg. of كان)
أَعْيَى: أَعْيَى — ʿayiya/aʿyā, Form IV, 'to be weary, unable', 1st sg. pres.; 'I tire'
وَالْيَوْمَ: وَ + الـ + يَوْم — wa-, and + al-, the + yawm, day; 'today' (acc. of time)
وَيْلَ: وَيْلَ — wayl, woe (frozen exclamatory noun, acc.); وَيْلَ الشَّيْخِ, 'woe is the old man's'
الشَّيْخِ: الـ + شَيْخ — al-, the + shaykh, old man (gen.)
أُفْرِغَ: أُفْرِغَ — pass. of أَفْرَغَ, Form IV of فَرَغَ, 'was poured, was cast'
قَالَبِ: قَالَب — qālab, mold, cast (gen. after فِي)
الجَمَالِ: الـ + جَمَال — al-, the + jamāl, beauty (gen., muḍāf ilayh)
وَالبَهَاءِ: وَ + الـ + بَهَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + bahāʾ, radiance, splendor (gen.)
الكَمَالِ: الـ + كَمَال — al-, the + kamāl, perfection (gen.)
أَنَّهُ: أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (particle) + hu, he
يُضْرَبُ: يُضْرَبُ — pass. of ضَرَبَ, 3rd sg. m. pres.; with بِـ, 'a proverb is coined for'; also simply 'is struck': yuḍrabu ʿunuquhu, 'his neck is struck', he is beheaded (Night 193)
بِحُسْنِهِ: بِـ + حُسْن + هِ — bi-, by means of (marks the cause after يُضرَب) + ḥusn, beauty + hi, his
الأمْثَالُ: الـ + أَمْثَال, pl. of مَثَل — al-, the + amthāl, proverbs (nom., subject)
كَالقَضِيبِ: كَـ + الـ + قَضِيب — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + qaḍīb, twig, rod (gen. after كَـ)
الرَّطِيبِ: الـ + رَطِيب — al-, the + raṭīb, moist, tender (adj., gen.)
يَسْحَرُ: يَسْحَرُ — saḥara/yasḥaru, to bewitch, 3rd sg. m. pres.
قَلْبٍ: قَلْب — qalb, heart (gen. indef., muḍāf ilayh)
بِجَمَالِهِ: بِـ + جَمَال + هِ — bi-, with (instrumental) + jamāl, beauty + hi, his; here: after tamallā, bi- marks what one takes one's fill of
وَيَسْلُبُ: وَ + يَسْلُبُ — wa-, and + salaba/yaslubu, to steal away, rob, 3rd sg. m. pres.
لُبٍّ: لُبّ — lubb, mind, intellect (gen. indef., muḍāf ilayh)
بِدَلَالِهِ: بِـ + دَلَال + هِ — bi-, with (instrumental) + dalāl, coquetry, coy charm + hi, his
جِيءَ: جِيءَ — pass. of جَاءَ, 'was brought' (hamza on the line, as printed)
بِالحُسْنِ: بِـ + الـ + حُسْن — bi-, [as the thing] brought (with جِيء بـ, 'X was brought') + al-, the + ḥusn, Beauty
يُقَايِسَهُ: يُقَايِسَ + هُ — qāyasa/yuqāyisu, Form III, 'to measure, compare against', subjunctive after كَي + hu, him
فَنَكَّسَ: فَـ + نَكَّسَ — fa-, so (particle) + nakkasa, Form II, 'bowed, lowered'
الحُسْنُ: الـ + حُسْن — al-, the + ḥusn, Beauty (personified, nom.)
رَأْسَهُ: رَأْس + هُ — raʾs, head + hu, his (hamza already printed on the line, kept as printed)
خَجَلًا: خَجَلًا — khajalan, out of shame, bashfully (acc. of cause)
حُسْنُ: حُسْنُ — ḥusn, Beauty (personified; vocative, mabnī on damma)
مَاشِينَ: مَاشِي + ـينَ — māshin, walking, going (act. part. of مَشَى), acc. pl. m.; 'walking'
أَتَوْا: أَتَى + ـوْا — atā/yaʾtī, to come, 3rd pl. m. perfect; 'they came'
وَغَابُوا: وَ + غَابُوا — wa-, and + ghāba/yaghību, to be absent, disappear, 3rd pl. m. perfect; 'and they were gone'
أَكْثَرَ: akthar, more (elative of كَثِير); 'or more' Also before a definite plural, 'most of': akthara al-amtiʿati, 'most of the goods'.
يَطْلَعِ: طَلَعَ/يَطْلُعُ — ṭalaʿa, to come up, jussive after لَمْ (kasra to break the meeting of two sukūns before الصبي); 'did not come up'
الصَّبِيُّ: الـ + صَبِيّ — ṣabiyy (with the doubled y shown by the shadda), "boy, youth, lad" (m., nom.); "the boy."
رَدُّوا: رَدَّ + ـوا — radda/yaruddu, to put back, close, return (something), 3rd pl. m. perfect; 'they closed/put back' Also radda ilā, 'to give back to': raddū ilayya akthara al-amtiʿati, 'they gave me back most of the goods'.
الرَّدْمِ: الـ + رَدْم — radm, a mound of earth heaped up to conceal something (m.); gen.
وَنَبَشْتُ: وَ + نَبَشْتُ — wa-, and + nabasha/yanbushu, to dig up, unearth, 1st sg. perfect; 'and I dug up'
وَنَقَلْتُهُ: وَ + نَقَلْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + naqala/yanqulu, to move, carry off, 1st sg. perfect + -hu, it; 'and I carried it off'
وَطَوَّلْتُ: وَ + طَوَّلْتُ — wa-, and + ṭawwala/yuṭawwilu, to lengthen, prolong, 1st sg. perfect; idiom طَوَّلْتُ رُوحِي, lit. 'I prolonged my soul' = 'I toiled on, persisted'
شِلْتُ: شَالَ + ـتُ — shāla/yashīlu, to carry, lift, remove (colloquial-flavored, beside Classical حَمَلَ), 1st sg. perfect; 'I carried away'
فَانْكَشَفَ: فَ + انْكَشَفَ — fa-, so + inkashafa/yankashifu, to become uncovered, revealed (Form VII of كَشَفَ), 3rd sg. m. perfect; 'and so it lay uncovered'
الطَّابَقُ: الـ + طَابَق — ṭābaq, vault, underground chamber (m.); nom., subject
خَشَبٌ: khashab, wood, a wooden (cover) (m.); nom., indef.
وَسِعَ: wasiʿa/yasaʿu, to hold, contain, be capacious enough for, 3rd sg. m. perfect; 'held, was wide enough for'
فِلْقَةَ: filqah, a piece, split part (of something) (f.); acc., construct with حجر الطاحون, 'a piece of the millstone'
فَشِلْتُهَا: فَ + شِلْتُ + ـهَا — fa-, so + shāla/yashīlu, 1st sg. perfect (see شِلْتُ) + -hā, it (f., the wooden cover); 'so I lifted it away'
عُقَلٌ: عُقْلَة، pl. عُقَل — ʿuqal, joints, knots (as of a jointed cane) (m.); reduplicated in apposition, 'joint upon joint' (tightly jointed); reading uncertain, possibly a colloquial intensifier instead
لِذَلِكَ: لِ + ذَلِكَ — li-, at (prep.) + dhālika, that; 'at that'
انْتَهَيْتُ: اِنْتَهَى + ـتُ — intahā/yantahī, to reach the end, finish (Form VIII of نَهَى), 1st sg. perfect; 'I reached the end'
بُنْيَانًا: bunyān, a building, structure (m.); acc., indef.
مَفْرُوشًا: مَفْرُوش — mafrūsh, spread, furnished (pass. part. of فَرَشَ); acc., indef.; 'spread (with)'
بِأَنْوَاعِ: بِـ + أَنْوَاع — bi-, with (prep., after مفروشا) + anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of نَوْع); 'with (all) kinds of'
الْبُسُطِ: الـ + بُسُط — busuṭ, "carpets, rugs" (pl. of بِسَاط); genitive as the second term of the construct أَنْوَاعِ الْبُسُطِ, "kinds of carpets," itself governed by the بِـ ("with") of مَفْرُوشًا بِأَنْوَاعِ..., "spread with kinds of...".
وَالْحَرِيرِ: وَ + الـ + حَرِير — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥarīr, silk (m.); gen.
عَالِيَةٍ: ʿāliyah, high, raised (adj., f.); gen., indef.
مُتَّكِئٌ: muttakiʾ, leaning, reclining (act. part. of اِتَّكَأَ); nom., indef., predicate
مِدْوَرَةٍ: midwarah, a round cushion, bolster (f.); gen., indef., after عَلَى
مِرْوَحَةٌ: mirwaḥah, a fan (f.); nom., indef., subject of the verbless clause 'in his hand (is) a fan'
مَشْمُومٌ: مَشْمُوم — mashmūm, a thing smelled, a bunch of fragrant herbs, a nosegay (pass. part. of شَمَّ); nom., indef.
وَرَيَاحِينُ: وَ + رَيَاحِين — wa-, and + rayāḥīn, sweet basil, sweet herbs (pl. of رَيْحَان); nom., indef.
وَحْدَهُ: وَحْدَ + ـهُ — waḥda, alone + -hu, his; 'by himself, alone'
اصْفَرَّ: اِصْفَرَّ — iṣfarra, to turn yellow, pale (Form IX of صَفِرَ, verbs of color/defect), 3rd sg. m. perfect, hamzat waṣl; 'he turned pale'
أَوٰنُهُ: أَوَان + ـه — awān, time/moment (defective spelling, missing medial alif, restored with dagger alif) + hu, his; 'his time/moment'
طَمِّنْ: طَمِّنْ — imperative of طَمَّنَ, to reassure/set at ease; 'set at rest!' (said of رَوْع, fright)
هُدَّ: hudda, imperative of هَدَّ, to break/quash/subdue; 'quash!' (said of رَوْع, fright)
رَوْعَكَ: رَوْع + ك — rawʿ, fright/alarm (m.) + ka, your; 'your fright'
بَأْسَ: بَأْس — baʾs, harm/distress (m.), mabnī on fatḥa after لَا of negation; 'no harm'
مِثْلُكَ: مِثْل + ك — mithl, like/similar to (n.) + ka, you; 'like you'
أُونِسُكَ: أُونِسُ + ك — ūnisu, I keep company (form IV of وَنِسَ) + ka, you
وَحْدِكَ: وَحْد + ك — waḥd, alone-ness (n.) + ka, your; 'your being alone, i.e. by yourself'
وَحْدَكَ: وَحْد + ك — waḥd, alone-ness + ka, your; 'alone, by yourself'
جِنْسِهِ: جِنْس + ه — jins, kind/species (m.) + hi, his; 'his kind'
رَدَّ: radda, it returned (trans., 'brought back'); here: radd, the verbal noun, 'returning', in radd al-jawāb, 'the answer (to a letter)'
قَرَّبَنِي: قَرَّبَ + نِي — qarraba II, to bring near + nī, me; 'he brought me near'
أَخِي: أَخ + ي — akh, brother (m.) + ī, my; 'my brother'
جَوْهَرِيٌّ: جَوْهَرِيّ — jawharīy, jeweler/dealer-in-gems (nisbah from جَوْهَر, gem)
الْمَرَاكِبِ: الـ + مَرَاكِب — marākib, ships/vessels (pl. of مَرْكَب)
بِالتِّجَارَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + تِجَارَات — tijārāt, goods/merchandise (pl.); bi- of accompaniment, 'with the goods'
جِمَالَاتٌ: جِمَالَات — jimālāt, herds/strings of camels (extended pl. of جَمَل)
أَمْوَالٌ: وَ + أَمْوَال — wa-, and + amwāl, wealth/riches (pl. of مَال)
يُرْزَقْ: يُرْزَقْ — passive jussive, 'he was/would be granted' (after لم)
يُرْزَقُ: يُرْزَقُ — passive indicative, 'he is/would be granted'
عُمُرِهِ: عُمُر + ه — ʿumur, life/age (m.) + hi, his; 'his lifetime'
قِصَرٌ: قِصَر — qiṣar, shortness (n.); predicate, 'a shortness [would be] in his life'
فَأَصْبَحَ: فَ + أَصْبَحَ — aṣbaḥa IV, to come to be/become + fa-, so; 'so he became' Also (Night 196): فَـ + أَصْبَحَ — fa-, then + aṣbaḥa, to come into the morning (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and in the morning he'
صَرِيخٍ: صَرِيخ — ṣarīkh, a crying-out/wailing for help (m.); the rasm spells this with يـ, a genuine classical variant of صُرَاخ, not a slip
الْقَابِلَةُ: الـ + قَابِلَة — qābilah, following/next (f. active participle of قَبِلَ)
عَلِقَتْ: عَلِقَتْ — ʿaliqat, she conceived/became pregnant (root ع-ل-ق, 'to cling')
فَأَرَّخَ: فَ + أَرَّخَ — arrakha II, to date/record the date of + fa-, so
تَارِيخَ: تَارِيخ — tārīkh, date/record (m.), object of أرّخ
حَبَلِهَا: حَبَل + هَا — ḥabal, pregnancy (m.) + hā, her; 'her pregnancy'
انْقَضَتْ: inqaḍat VII, it elapsed/ran its course (f.) (hamzat waṣl)
أَيَّامُهَا: أَيَّام + هَا — ayyām, days (pl.) + hā, her; 'her days'
فَوَلَدَتْنِي: فَ + وَلَدَتْ + نِي — waladat, she gave birth to + nī, me
أَوْلَمَ: وَ + أَوْلَمَ — awlama IV, to hold a (wedding) feast + wa-, and
الْوَلَائِمَ: الـ + وَلَائِم — walāʾim, feasts (pl. of وَلِيمَة), object of أولم
أَطْعَمَ: وَ + أَطْعَمَ — aṭʿama IV, to feed + wa-, and
الْفُقَرَاءَ: الـ + فُقَرَاء — fuqarāʾ, the poor (pl. of فَقِير)
الْمَسَاكِينَ: الـ + مَسَاكِين — masākīn, the destitute (pl. of مِسْكِين)
فَجَمَعَ: فَ + جَمَعَ — jamaʿa, he gathered + fa-, so
الْمُنَجِّمِينَ: الـ + مُنَجِّمِين — munajjimīn, astrologers (pl. of مُنَجِّم)
التَّقَاوِيمِ: الـ + تَقَاوِيم — taqāwīm, almanacs/calendars (pl. of تَقْوِيم)
أَصْحَابَ: وَ + أَصْحَابَ — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, masters/possessors of (pl. of صَاحِب)
الْمَوَالِيدِ: الـ + مَوَالِيد — mawālīd, nativities/horoscopes (pl. of مَوْلِد)
فَكَشَفُوا: فَ + كَشَفُوا — kashafū, they uncovered/examined (astrological sense: cast a horoscope)
مِيلَادِي: مِيلَاد + ي — mīlād, birth (m.) + ī, my; 'my birth'
قَطْعٌ: قَطْع — qaṭʿ, a cutting-off (n.); here, a fatal crisis/danger
زَمَانًا: زَمَانًا — zamānan, a time/period (accusative of duration)
مَوْتِهِ: مَوْت + ه — mawt, death (m.) + hi, his; 'his death'
الْهَلَكَاتِ: الـ + هَلَكَات — halakāt, perils/perditions (pl. of هَلَكَة)
فَرَسِهِ: فَرَس + ه — faras, horse (m.) + hi, his; 'his horse'
يَرْمِى: يَرْمِي — yarmī, he shoots (edition spells the final long vowel with alif maqṣūrah ى, kept as printed)
الْفَارِسَ: الـ + فَارِسَ — al-fāris, the horseman (accusative, object of يرمي)
رَبَّانِي: رَبَّى + نِي — rabbā II, he raised/reared + nī, me
تَرْبِيَتِى: تَرْبِيَة + ي — tarbiyah, upbringing/rearing (f.) + ī, my; 'my upbringing' (edition spells the final ي with alif maqṣūrah ى here, kept as printed)
لِأَبِي: لِـ + أَب + ي — li-, to (prep., of the recipient) + ab, father + ī, my; 'to my father' Also abī as the gen. of abū in the name Abū al-Ḥasan, with li- marking the recipient or the one spoken to: li-Abī al-Ḥasani, 'to Abū al-Ḥasan'.
خَصِيبٍ: خَصِيب — Khaṣīb, proper name (the father); cf. خَضِيب above
فَخَافَ: فَ + خَافَ — khāfa, he feared + fa-, so
فَنَقَلَنِي: فَ + نَقَلَ + نِي — naqala, he moved/transferred + nī, me + fa-, so
وَحْدَتِي: وَحْدَة + ي — waḥdah, solitude/aloneness (f.) + ī, my; 'my solitude'
قِصَّتَهُ: قِصَّة + ه — qiṣṣah, story (f.) + hu, his; 'his story'
أَقْتُلُهُ: أَقْتُلُ + ه — aqtulu, I kill + hu, him; 'I kill him'
كُفِيتَ: كُفِيتَ — passive, you have been spared/sufficed (against)
أَخْدُمُكَ: وَ + أَخْدُمُ + ك — wa-, and + akhdumu, I serve + ka, you
وَأَرْجِعُ: وَ + أَرْجِعُ — wa-, and + arjiʿu, I return
سَبِيلِي: سَبِيل + ي — sabīl, way/path (m.) + ī, my; 'my way'
تُوصِلُنِي: تُوصِلُ + نِي — tūṣilu, you convey/deliver (form IV of وَصَلَ) + nī, me
بِلَادِي: بِلَاد + ي — bilād, country/lands (pl.) + ī, my; 'my country'
أُحَدِّثُهُ: أُحَدِّثُ + -hu — ḥaddatha (Form II, not III as one slice had it), "to converse with, tell" + -hu, "him"; "conversing with him."
وَعَمَّرْتُ: وَ + عَمَّرْتُ — ʿammartu II, I filled/tended + wa-, and
الْقَنَادِيلَ: الـ + قَنَادِيلَ — al-qanādīl, the lamps (pl. of قِنْدِيل)
مَدَّيْنَا: مَدَّيْنَا — maddaynā, we spread out (Middle Arabic form of مَدَدْنَا; see note)
مَدَّيْتُ: مَدَّيْتُ — maddaytu, I spread out (see note at U29)
فَتَحَلَّيْنَا: فَ + تَحَلَّيْنَا — taḥallaynā V, we had something sweet/dessert
بَعْضُنَا: بَعْضُ + نَا — baʿḍu, some/one (of) + nā, us; 'one another' (reciprocal, بعضنا بعضاً abbreviated)
أَكْثَرُهُ: أَكْثَر + ه — akthar, most/greater part (of) + hu, it; 'the greater part of it'
فَنَامَ: فَ + نَامَ — fa-, then + nāma, he slept
فَغَطَّيْتُهُ: فَ + غَطَّيْتُ + ه — ghaṭṭaytu II, I covered + hu, him + fa-, and
أَصْبَحْتُ: أَصْبَحْتُ — aṣbaḥtu, I awoke/came to be (in the morning)
وَسَخَّنْتُ: وَ + سَخَّنْتُ — sakhkhantu II, I warmed/heated + wa-, and
أَوْلَمَ: awlama IV, to hold a (wedding) feast
أَحْسَنَ: aḥsana IV, he did well/made excellent
اَلْمَاءَ: الـ + مَاء — māʾ, water (m.); 'the water' (accusative, the trailing object of a verb from the previous slice)
وَنَبَّهْتُهُ: وَ + نَبَّهْتُ + هُ — nabbaha (II), to rouse, wake (someone); 'and I roused him'
بِرِفْقٍ: بِـ + رِفْق — bi-, with (prep. of manner) + rifq, gentleness; 'with gentleness'
فَاسْتَيْقَظَ: فَـ + اسْتَيْقَظَ — istayqaẓa (X), to wake up; 'and he awoke'
فَأنَيْتُهُ: فَـ + أنيته + هُ — textually obscure: read here as a form-IV verb of ء-ن-ي/و-ن-ي ('to bring something once ready'), though it may be a corruption of فأتيته, 'I came to him with' (أتى بـ, to bring); + هُ, him; 'and I brought him'
الْمُسَخَّنِ: الـ + مُسَخَّن — sakhkhana (II), to heat; مُسَخَّن, heated (pass. part.); 'the heated'
فَغَسَلَ: فَـ + غَسَلَ — ghasala, to wash; 'and he washed'
وَجْهَهُ: وَجْه + هُ — wajh, face (m.) + hu, his; 'his face'
جُزِيتَ: جُزِيتَ — jazā (I), pass. juziya, to be repaid, rewarded; 'you have been rewarded' (a thanking formula)
سَلِمْتُ: سَلِمْتُ — salima, to be safe, be delivered; 'I am delivered'
خَلَّيْتُ: خَلَّيْتُ — khallā (II), to let, allow; 'I will let'
يُكَافِئُكَ: يُكَافِئُ + كَ — kāfaʾa (III), to reward, repay + ka, you; 'he reward you'
فَالسَّلَامُ: فَـ + الـ + سَلَام — fa-, then (introducing the result) + al-salām, the greeting, farewell; 'then farewell'
يُصِيبُكَ: يُصِيبُ + كَ — aṣāba (IV), to befall, strike + ka, you; 'befalls you'
يَوْمِي: يَوْم + ي — yawm, day (m.) + ī, my; 'my day'
يَوْمِكَ: يَوْم + كَ — yawm, day (m.) + ka, your; 'your day'
قَدَّمْتُ: قَدَّمْتُ — qaddama (II), to set out, serve; 'I set out'
فَطَابَ: فَـ + طَابَ — ṭāba, to become good, fragrant, pleasant; 'and it grew fragrant'; also of a wind, 'to be fair': fa-ṭāba lahā al-rīḥu, 'and the wind was fair for her' (Night 194)
وَصَنَعْتُ: وَ + صَنَعْتُ — ṣanaʿa, to make, craft; 'and I made'
مِنْقَلَةً: مِنْقَلَة — minqalah, a board for a game (perhaps mancala/backgammon-type); the same root also yields 'portable brazier', but the game that follows favors 'game-board' here; 'a game-board'
وَلَعِبْتُ: وَ + لَعِبْتُ — laʿiba, to play; 'and I played'
وَلَعِبْنَا: وَ + لَعِبْنَا — laʿiba, to play; 'and we played'
الْمَصَابِيحَ: الـ + مَصَابِيح — miṣbāḥ, lamp (m.), pl. maṣābīḥ; 'the lamps'
وَقَدَّمْتُ: وَ + قَدَّمْتُ — qaddama (II), to set out, serve; 'and I set out'
وَغَطَّيْتُهُ: وَ + غَطَّيْتُ + هُ — ghaṭṭā (II), to cover + hu, him; 'and I covered him'
وَسَلَوْتُ: وَ + سَلَوْتُ — salā (I), to be consoled, forget one's grief; 'and [my worry] was consoled'
الْمُنَجِّمُونَ: الـ + مُنَجِّمُونَ — najjama (II), munajjim, astrologer, pl. munajjimūn; 'the astrologers'
أَخْدُمُهُ: أَخْدُمُ + هُ — khadama, to serve + hu, him; 'I serve him'
وَأُنَادِمُهُ: وَ + أُنَادِمُ + هُ — nādama (III), to keep company as a boon-companion + hu, him; 'and I keep him company'
وَأُحَادِثُهُ: وَ + أُحَادِثُ + هُ — ḥādatha (III), to converse with + hu, him; 'and I converse with him'
وَثَلٰثِينَ: وَ + ثَلٰثِينَ — thalāthūn, thirty (obl.); 'and thirty' (the archive spells this without its medial long vowel, ثلثين; pointed here with a dagger alif rather than an inserted letter)
وَلَيْلَةَ: وَ + لَيْلَةَ — laylah, night (f.), construct; 'and the night of'
نَجَّانِي: نَجَّى (II) + نِي — najjā, to save, rescue + nī, me; 'has saved me'
بِبَرَكَتِكَ: بِـ + بَرَكَة + كَ — bi-, by, through (prep. of cause) + barakah, blessing (f.) + ka, your; 'by your blessing'
وَبَرَكَةِ: وَ + بَرَكَةِ — barakah, blessing (f.), construct; 'and the blessing of'
قُدُومِكَ: قُدُوم + كَ — qudūm, coming, arrival (m.) + ka, your; 'your coming'
وَأَسْأَلُ: وَ + أَسْأَلُ — saʾala, to ask; 'and I ask'
يَرُدَّكَ: يَرُدَّ + كَ — radda, to return, send back + ka, you; 'that He return you'
تُسَخِّنَ: تُسَخِّنَ — sakhkhana (II), to heat; 'that you heat'
أَغْتَسِلُ: أَغْتَسِلُ — ightasala (VIII), to bathe (oneself); 'I may bathe'
وَأَغْسِلُ: وَ + أَغْسِلُ — ghasala, to wash; 'and I wash'
بِكَثْرَةٍ: بِـ + كَثْرَة — bi-, with, in (prep. of manner) + kathrah, abundance; 'in abundance'
وَغَسَلْتُ: وَ + غَسَلْتُ — ghasala, to wash; 'and I washed'
جَسَدَهُ: جَسَد + هُ — jasad, body (m.) + hu, his; 'his body'
غَسْلًا: غَسْل — ghasl, a washing; 'a washing' (cognate accusative)
وَدَلَكْتُهُ: وَ + دَلَكْتُ + هُ — dalaka, to rub, massage + hu, him; 'and I rubbed him down'
وَخَلَعْتُهُ: وَ + خَلَعْتُ + هُ — khalaʿa, to take off, undress + hu, him; 'and I undressed him'
أَثْوَابً: أَثْوَاب — thawb, garment (m.), pl. athwāb; 'garments' (the archive omits the usual supporting alif for the accusative tanwīn here; the ending is kept as printed, with the fatḥatān placed on the final letter itself)
وَاسْتَلْقَى: وَ + اسْتَلْقَى — istalqā (X), to lie back, recline; 'and lay down'
الِاسْتِحْمَامِ: الـ + اسْتِحْمَام — istiḥmām (X, verbal noun), bathing; 'the bathing'
وَذَوِّبْ: وَ + ذَوِّبْ — dhawwaba (II), to melt, dissolve; 'and melt'
فَلَقِيتُ: فَـ + لَقِيتُ — laqiya, to meet, come upon; 'and I came upon'
وَوَجَدْتُهَا: وَ + وَجَدْتُ + هَا — wajada, to find + hā, it (f.); 'and I found it'
فَكَسَرْتُهَا: فَـ + كَسَرْتُ + هَا — kasara, to break + hā, it (f.); 'and I broke it open'
رَأْسِي: رَأْس + ي — raʾs, head (m.) + ī, my; 'my head' (the archive itself prints this hamza precomposed, so it is kept precomposed rather than written combining)
مُسْتَعْجِلٌ: مُسْتَعْجِل — istaʿjala (X), musta ʿjil, in a hurry; 'in a hurry'
وَمَسَكْتُهَا: وَ + مَسَكْتُ + هَا — masaka, to grip, hold + hā, it (f.); 'and I gripped it'
نِصَالِهَا: نِصَال + هَا — naṣl, blade, pl. niṣāl (m.) + hā, its; 'its blade'
فَعَثَرَتْ: فَـ + عَثَرَتْ — ʿathara, to stumble; 'and [my foot] stumbled'
وَانْبَطَشْتُ: وَ + انْبَطَشْتُ — inbaṭasha (VII), to pitch, fling oneself down; 'and I pitched down'
الصَّبِيِّ: الـ + صَبِيّ — ṣabiyy, boy, lad (genitive, object of ʿalā); 'the boy' Also gen. after min: min hādhā al-ṣabiyyi al-majnūni, 'from this mad boy' (Night 188).
وَالسِّكِّينُ: وَ + الـ + سِكِّين — sikkīn, knife; 'while the knife [was]'
فَشَرَعَتِ: فَـ + شَرَعَتِ — sharaʿa, to begin, go into; 'and [the knife] went'
السِّكِّينُ: الـ + سِكِّين — sikkīn, knife (nominative, subject); 'the knife'
وَانْغَرَزَتْ: وَ + انْغَرَزَتْ — inghazara (VII), to plunge, be driven in; 'and plunged'
قَلْبِ: قَلْب — qalb, heart, construct; 'the heart of'
نَحْبَهُ: نَحْب + هُ — naḥb, vow (m.) + hu, his; 'his vow' (Qur'anic euphemism for death, 33:23)
صَرَخْتُ: صَرَخْتُ — ṣarakha, to cry out; 'I cried out'
وَلَطَمْتُ: وَ + لَطَمْتُ — laṭama, to strike, slap; 'and I struck'
وَشَقَيْتُ: وَ + شَقَيْتُ — spelled here as if from a weak root (classical شَقَقْتُ, from the doubled root ش-ق-ق, shaqqa, to tear); 'and I tore'
الْقَطْعِ: الـ + قَطْع — qaṭʿ, cutting, here the allotted term or portion of a life; 'the allotted term'
خَبَّرُوا: خَبَّرُوا — khabbara (II), to inform, tell; 'they had told'
وَالْحُكَمَاءُ: وَ + الـ + حُكَمَاء — ḥakīm, wise man, pl. ḥukamāʾ; 'and the wise men'
أَجَلُ: أَجَل — ajal, appointed term (of death); 'the appointed death'
الْمَلِيحِ: الـ + مَلِيح — malīḥ, handsome, beautiful; 'this handsome one'
لَيْتَنِي: لَيْتَ + نِي — layta, would that (particle) + nī, I; 'I wish'
أَقْطَعْ: أَقْطَعْ — qaṭaʿa, to cut, 1st-person jussive; 'I cut' (hamzat qaṭʿ here, the 1st-person imperfect prefix — unlike the imperative 'iqṭaʿ' earlier in this night, which takes hamzat waṣl)
لِيَقْضِيَ: لِـ + يَقْضِيَ — li-, so that (purpose particle) + yaqḍiya, that He accomplish; 'that God might accomplish'; in Night 131 the subject is a servant: 'so that he might settle'
مَفْعُولًا: مَفْعُول — mafʿūl, done, accomplished (pass. part.); 'destined' (echoes Qur'an 8:42)
لَطَمَ: laṭama, to strike/slap (verb I), perf. 3ms; 'he struck'
السَّادِسَةَ: الـ + سَادِسَة — sādis, sixth (ordinal adj., f., acc.); agrees with اللَّيْلَة
عَجِيبً: ʿAjīb, proper name of the third qalandar, revealed here for the first time (m., acc.; the tanwīn's alif is omitted as printed) — the very name Night 15's horoscope gave for the boy's killer
تَيَقَّنْتُ: تَيَقَّنْتُ — tayaqqana, to become certain (verb V) + 1cs; 'I became certain'
وَرَدَيْتُ: وَ + رَدَيْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + radaytu (for classical radadtu), radda, to put back, return (verb I) + 1cs, the doubled root spelled as a weak one; 'and I put back'
تَشُقُّ: tashuqqu, shaqqa, to cleave, cut through (verb I, impf. 3fs, agreeing with الْمَرْكَب, treated as fem. by sense as a vessel)
ضَارِبَةً: ḍāriba, striking, heading for (act. part. I, f., acc., ḥāl — of a ship making for the shore)
الْبَرَّ: الـ + بَرّ — barr, (dry) land, shore (m., acc.)
فَخِفْتُ: فَ + خِفْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + khiftu, khāfa, to fear (verb I, hollow) + 1cs; 'so I was afraid'
يَجِيئُونَ: yajīʾūna, jāʾa, to come (verb I, impf. 3mpl); 'they will come'
يُصِيبُونَ: yuṣībūna, aṣāba, to hit upon, find (verb IV, impf. 3mpl); 'they will find'
وَلَدَهُمْ: وَلَد + هُمْ — walad, child, son (m., acc.) + 3mpl poss.; 'their child'
مَقْتُولًا: maqtūl, slain, killed (pass. part. I, m., acc., ḥāl)
فَيَعْرِفُونَ: فَ + يَعْرِفُونَ — fa-, so (conj.) + yaʿrifūna, ʿarafa, to know (verb I, impf. 3mpl); 'so they will know'
فَيَقْتُلُونِي: فَ + يَقْتُلُونِي — fa-, so (conj.) + yaqtulūnī, qatala, to kill (verb I, impf. 3mpl) + 1cs obj.; the archive keeps only one نـ where classical يَقْتُلُونَنِي doubles it before the suffix
فَعَمَدْتُ: فَ + عَمَدْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿamadtu ilā, ʿamada, to make for, head straight for (verb I) + 1cs
وَطَلَعْتُهَا: وَ + طَلَعْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭalaʿtu, ṭalaʿa, to climb, go up (verb I) + 1cs + 3fs obj. (the tree)
وَاسْتَتَرْتُ: وَ + اسْتَتَرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + istatartu, istatara, to hide, conceal oneself (verb X) + 1cs
بِأَوْرَاقِهَا: بِـ + أَوْرَاق + هَا — bi-, with (prep.) + awrāq, leaves (pl. of waraqa, f.) + 3fs poss.
اسْتَقْرَيْتُ: اسْتَقْرَيْتُ — istaqraytu (for classical istaqrartu), istaqarra, to settle, come to rest (verb X) + 1cs, the doubled root spelled as a weak one, like رَدَيْتُ above
مَعَهُمُ: مَعَ + هُمُ — maʿa, with (prep.) + 3mpl obj. (linking vowel -u before the following al-)
أَبُو: abū, father (of) (construct form of أَب, m., nom.)
أَزَالُوا: وَ + أَزَالُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + azālū, azāla, to remove (verb IV) + 3mpl
فَنَزَلُوا: فَ + نَزَلُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + nazalū, nazala, to go down, descend (verb I) + 3mpl
وَوَجْهُهُ: وَ + وَجْه + هُ — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial) + wajh, face (m., nom.) + 3ms poss. Also simple wa-, 'and', joining a second subject: takallala jabīnuhu wa-wajhuhu, 'his brow and his face were beaded'.
يُضِيءُ: yuḍīʾu, aḍāʾa, to shine (verb IV, impf. 3ms)
ثِيَابًا: thiyāb, garments (pl. of thawb, m., acc.)
نِظَافًا: niẓāf, clean (broken pl. adj. of naẓīf, acc., agreeing with ثِيَابًا)
مَغْرُوزَةٌ: maghrūza, thrust, embedded (pass. part. I, f., nom., agreeing with السِّكِّين treated as fem.)
فَصَرَخُوا: فَ + صَرَخُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + ṣarakhū, ṣarakha, to cry out (verb I) + 3mpl
وَلَطَمُوا: وَ + لَطَمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + laṭamū, laṭama, to strike, slap (verb I) + 3mpl
وُجُوهِهِمْ: وُجُوه (pl. of وَجْه) — face (m.) + هِمْ their; 'their faces' (gen. after على)
وَدَعَوْا: وَ + دَعَوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + daʿaw, daʿā bi-, to call out (with), invoke (verb I) + 3mpl; the بِـ of the next word marks what is called out
بِالْوَيْلِ: بِـ + الـ + وَيْل — bi-, with (prep., marking what is invoked or cried out, after دَعَا, نَادَى or صَاحَ) + al-, the + wayl, woe (m., gen.); 'with "woe"', 'cried out woe'
وَالثُّبُورِ: وَ + الـ + ثُبُور — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + thubūr, perdition, ruin (m., gen.)
وَغُشِيَ: وَ + غُشِيَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghushiya ʿalā, to fall into a swoon, faint (verb I, impersonal passive)
الْعَبِيلَ: الـ + عَبِيل — printed for الْعَبِيد, the slaves; a ل/د misprint (see the note), acc.
بَعْلَ: printed for بَعْدَ, after; a ل/د misprint (see the note), acc.
وَلَدِهِ: وَلَد + هِ — walad, son (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
وَلَفُّوا: وَ + لَفُّوا — wa-, and (conj.) + laffū, laffa, to wrap (verb I) + 3mpl
وَأَرْخَوْا: وَ + أَرْخَوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + arkhaw, arkhā, to let down, loosen (verb IV) + 3mpl
خَلْفَهُمْ: خَلْفَ + هُمْ — khalfa, behind (adv./prep., acc.) + 3mpl obj.
مَمْدُودًا: mamdūd, stretched out (pass. part. I, m., acc., ḥāl)
رَأْسِهِ: رَأْس + هِ — raʾs, head (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.
وَتَفَكَّرَ: وَ + تَفَكَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tafakkara fī, to ponder, brood over (verb V)
بُكَاؤُهُ: بُكَاء + هُ — bukāʾ, weeping (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.
بِمَقْطَعِ: بِـ + مَقْطَع — bi-, with (prep.) + maqṭaʿ, a length, a cut piece (of cloth) (m., gen.)
وَمَلُّوا: وَ + مَلُّوا — wa-, and (conj.) + printed for مَدُّوا, they stretched out, laid flat (madda, verb I) + 3mpl; a ل/د misprint (see the note)
الْمَقْعَدِ: الـ + مَقْعَد — maqʿad, seat, couch (m., gen.)
يَجْرِى: yajrī, jarā, to happen, run (verb I, impf. 3ms); archive's alif-maqsūra spelling of يَجْرِي
وَقَلْ: وَ + قَلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + printed for قَدْ, indeed, already (particle); a ل/د misprint (see the note)
شَابَ: shāba, to turn grey, white (verb I, hollow)
يَشِيبَ: yashība, shāba, to turn grey (verb I, hollow, subj. after أَنْ)
قَاسَيْتُ: qāsaytu, qāsā, to suffer, endure (verb III) + 1cs
الْهُمُومِ: الـ + هُمُوم — humūm, cares, worries (pl. of hamm, m., gen.)
وَالْأَحْزَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَحْزَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn, m., gen.)
يَدِقُّ: yadiqqu, daqqa ʿan, to be too subtle, too fine for (verb I, impf. 3ms)
خَفَاهُ: خَفَا + هُ — khafā, hiddenness, secrecy (m., nom.) + 3ms poss. (referring to لُطْف)
الذَّكِى: الـ + ذَكِيّ — dhakiyy, clever, sharp-witted (adj., m., gen.); archive's alif-maqsūra spelling for -iyy
تُسَاءُ: tusāʾu, sāʾa, to grieve, distress (someone) (verb I, pass. impf. 2ms)
صَبَاحًا: ṣabāḥ, morning (m., acc. of time); 'in the morning'
فَتَأْتِيكَ: فَ + تَأْتِيكَ — fa-, so, yet (conj.) + taʾtīka, atā, to come (verb I, impf. 3fs) + 2ms obj.
الْمَسَرَّةُ: الـ + مَسَرَّة — masarra, gladness, joy (f., nom.)
بِالْعَشِى: بِـ + الـ + عَشِيّ — bi-, in (prep., time) + al-, the + ʿashiyy, evening (m., gen.); archive's alif-maqsūra spelling for -iyy
يُسْرٍأَتَي: يُسْر + أَتَى — yusr, ease (m., indef. gen. after كَمْ) + atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms); the two words run together with no space in the archive (see the note); 'an ease came'
بَعْلِ: printed for بَعْدِ, after; a ل/د misprint (see the note), indef. gen.
فَفَرَّجَ: فَ + فَرَّجَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + farraja, to relieve, dispel (verb II)
الشَّجِى: الـ + شَجِيّ — shajiyy, grieving, sorrowful (adj., m., gen.); archive's alif-maqsūra spelling for -iyy
يَزَلِ: yazali, zāla (lam yazal), to cease (verb I, hollow, jussive after لَمْ; linking vowel -i before al-)
غَشْوَتِهِ: غَشْوَة + هِ — ghashwa, a swoon (f., gen.) + 3ms poss.
الْمَغْرِبُ: الـ + مَغْرِب — maghrib, sunset, the west (m., nom.)
اسْتَفَاقَ: istafāqa, to awaken, come to (verb X)
خَافَ: khāfa, to fear (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَرَأْسَهُ: وَ + رَأْس + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾs, head (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.
مُنْصَدِعٌ: munṣadiʿ, riven, split apart (act. part. VII, m., nom.)
الْآمَاقِ: الـ + آمَاق — āmāq, the inner corners of the eyes (m. pl., gen.); the archive prints this hamza precomposed (آ), kept as printed
تَنْهَمِلُ: tanhamilu, inhamala, to pour down, stream (verb VII, impf. 3fs, of tears)
شَطَّ: shaṭṭa, to become remote, far off (verb I)
الْمَرَامُ: الـ + مَرَام — marām, the thing desired, one's aim (m., nom.)
بَعْلًا: printed for بَعْدًا, far off (adv. acc.); a ل/د misprint (see the note)
فَوَا: فَ + وَا — fa-, so (conj.) + wā, oh! alas! (interjection of lament)
أَسَفِي: أَسَف + ي — asaf, sorrow, grief (m.) + 1cs poss.; 'my sorrow'
حِيلَتِي: حِيلَة + ي — ḥīla, recourse, means, device (f.) + 1cs poss.
الْقَوْلُ: الـ + قَوْل — qawl, the saying, speech (m., nom.)
فَلَيْتَنِي: فَ + لَيْتَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + layta, would that (particle of wish) + 1cs
نَظَرْتُهُمْ: نَظَرْتُ + هُمْ — naẓartu, naẓara, to look at, see (verb I) + 1cs + 3mpl obj.
سَادَتِي: سَادَة + ي — sāda, masters, lords (pl. of sayyid, m.) + 1cs poss.; here an endearment for those lost, not literal masters
ضَاقَتْ: ḍāqat, ḍāqa, to grow strait, narrow (verb I, hollow, perf. 3fs)
بِى: بِـ + ي — bi-, at, upon (prep., of what closes in on someone) + 1cs obj.; archive's alif-maqsūra spelling of بِي
السُّبُلُ: الـ + سُبُل — subul, ways, paths (pl. of sabīl, m., nom.)
السُّلُوُّ: الـ + سُلُوّ — sulūw, forgetting, consolation (verbal noun, m., nom.)
بِسُلْوَانٍ: بِـ + سُلْوَان — bi-, by, through (prep., means) + sulwān, consolation (m., indef. gen.)
بِعَوَادِي: بِـ + عَوَادِي — bi-, through (prep.) + ʿawādī, obscure — perhaps 'my inmost being' or 'my wonted ways' (see the note) + 1cs poss.
تَشْتَعِلُ: tashtaʿilu, ishtaʿala, to blaze, flare up (verb VIII, impf. 3fs)
يَمَّمَتْ: yammamat, yammama, to make straight for, head toward (verb II, perf. 3fs)
الْمَنُونِ: الـ + مَنُون — manūn, Fate, Death, personified as a mistress who claims the living (m./f., gen.)
وَبَيْنَهُمْ: وَ + بَيْنَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + bayna, between (prep., acc.) + 3mpl obj.
يَنْفَصِلُ: yanfaṣilu, infaṣala, to be severed, separated (verb VII, impf. 3ms)
سَأَلْتُكَ: سَأَلْتُ + كَ — saʾaltu, saʾala, to ask (verb I) + 1cs + 2ms obj. Also in an entreaty, the perfect for an act done in speaking: saʾaltuka bi-Allāhi, 'I beg you by God'.
وَاشِي: wāshī, tale-bearer, slanderer (act. part. I, m., nom./voc. — the stock rival of lovers in Arabic verse)
فَكُنْ: فَ + كُنْ — fa-, so (conj.) + kun, kāna, to be (verb I, imper. 2ms)
فَجَمْعُ: فَ + جَمْع — fa-, for (conj.) + jamʿ, the gathering, union (m., nom.)
شَمْلِي: شَمْل + ي — shaml, one's scattered state, union (m.) + 1cs poss.
مُشْتَمِلُ: mushtamil, encompassing, entire, unbroken (act. part. VIII, m., nom.)
أَحْسَنَنَا: aḥsananā, aḥsana, how good, how fine (exclamatory verb of wonder, perf. 3ms) + 1cpl obj.; 'how good we were!'
وَالدَّارُ: وَ + الـ + دَار — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial) + al-, the + dār, house, home (f., nom.)
تَجْمَعُنَا: تَجْمَعُ + نَا — tajmaʿu, jamaʿa, to gather (verb I, impf. 3fs) + 1cpl obj.
غِبْطَةٍ: ghibṭa, happiness, an enviable state (f., indef. gen.)
مُتَّصِلُ: muttaṣil, continuous, unbroken (act. part. VIII, m., nom.)
رُمِينَا: rumīnā, ramā, to shoot, strike with (verb I, pass. perf.) + 1cpl
بِسَهْمِ: بِـ + سَهْم — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + sahm, arrow (m., gen.)
الْبَيْنِ: الـ + بَيْن — bayn, separation, parting (m., gen.)
فَرَّقَنَا: فَرَّقَ + نَا — farraqa, to separate, part (verb II) + 1cpl obj.
لِسِهَامِ: لِـ + سِهَام — li-, against, for (prep., marking what is endured after يَحْتَمِل) + sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, m., gen.)
يَحْتَمِلُ: yaḥtamilu, iḥtamala, to bear, endure (verb VIII, impf. 3ms)
صَابَنَا: ṣābanā, ṣāba, to befall, strike (verb I) + 1cpl obj.
عَزِيزِ: ʿazīz, dear one, precious one (m., gen.)
الْقَوْمِ: الـ + قَوْم — qawm, people, folk (m., gen.)
فَرِيدِ: farīd, the unique one, peerless one (m., gen.)
عَصْرٍ: ʿaṣr, an age, era (m., indef. gen.)
غَدَا: ghadā, to become, grow to be (verb I, sister of kāna)
بِالْحُسْنِ: بِـ + الـ + حُسْن — bi-, in (prep.) + al-, the + ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.)
مُكْتَمِلُ: muktamil, made perfect, complete (act. part. VIII, m., nom.)
أَنْشَدْتُهُ: أَنْشَدْتُ + هُ — anshadtu, anshada, to recite (verb IV) + 1cs + 3ms obj. (the boy)
يَسْبِقُنِي: yasbiqunī, sabaqa, to outrun, get ahead of (verb I, impf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.
الْأَجَلُ: الـ + أَجَل — ajal, the appointed term, hour of death (m., nom.)
لُقْيَاكُمْ: لُقْيَا + كُمْ — luqyā, a meeting (verbal noun, f.) + 2mpl poss.
نَفْدِيكَ: nafdīka, fadā, to ransom (verb I, impf. 1cpl) + 2ms obj.
قُبِلْ: qubila, qabila, to accept (verb I, pass. perf. 3ms)
غَارِبَةٌ: ghāriba, setting (act. part. I, f., nom., agreeing with الشَّمْس)
الْبَدْرَ: الـ + بَدْر — badr, the full moon (m., acc.)
أَفَلْ: afala, to set, go down (of sun, moon or star) (verb I)
لَهْفِي: لَهْف + ي — lahf, grief, distress (m.) + 1cs poss.
يَشْتَغِلُ: yashtaghilu, ishtaghala, to be occupied, turn one's mind (elsewhere) (verb VIII, impf. 3ms)
أَبُوكَ: أَبُو + كَ — abū, father (of) (construct form of أَب, m., nom.) + 2ms poss.; 'your father'
أَضْحَى: aḍḥā, to become, grow to be (verb IV, hollow, sister of kāna)
حَلَّ: ḥalla, to alight, come to pass, befall (verb I) Also with the place as direct object, 'to settle in, lodge in': ḥalla al-fuʾāda, 'he has made the heart his home'.; here: to be lawful, permitted: kayfa ḥalla lahā damī, 'how my blood became lawful to her'
الْحِيَلُ: الـ + حِيَل — ḥiyal, means, resources, stratagems (pl. of ḥīla, f., nom.)
الْحَوَاسِدِ: الـ + حَوَاسِد — ḥawāsid, the envious ones (pl. of ḥāsid, m., gen.)
يَلْقَوْنَ: yalqawna, laqiya, to meet with, encounter (verb I, impf. 3mpl)
صَنَعُوا: ṣanaʿū, ṣanaʿa, to do, make (verb I) + 3mpl
بِئْسَ: biʾsa, how evil is...!, evil indeed is (verb of dispraise, frozen 3ms)
عَائِبَةٌ: ʿāʾiba, a fault, blemish, calamity (f., nom.); the hamza here rides on a bare ya in the archive (عايبة), supplied per the house rule
شَهَقَ: شَهَقَ — shahaqa, to gasp / cry out (v. I, 3ms perf.); 'he gasped'
شَهْقَةً: شَهْقَةً — shahqa, a gasp (n., cognate accusative of شَهَقَ); 'a gasp'
فَارَقَتْ: فَارَقَتْ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (v. III, 3fs perf.); 'it (his soul) parted'
رُوحُهُ: رُوح + هُ — rūḥ, soul (f. here) + -hu, his (poss. suffix); nom. subject; 'his soul'
سَيِّدَاهْ: سَيِّد + اه — sayyid, master, lord (m.) + the lengthened lament-suffix -āh; 'master! (in lament)'
وَأَخَذُوا: وَ + أَخَذُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, to take (v. I, 3mp perf.); 'and they took'
رُؤُسِهِمْ: رُؤُس(defective for رُؤُوس) + هِمْ — ra's, head, pl. ruʾūs (m., here spelled without the plural's second wāw — see note) + -him, their; 'their heads'
وَزَادُوا: وَ + زَادُوا — wa-, and + zāda, to increase (v. I, 3mp perf.); 'and they increased'
لِسَيِّدِهِمْ: لِـ + سَيِّد + هِمْ — li-, to (prep.) + sayyid, master (m.) + -him, their; 'to their master'
وَأَرْخَوْا: وَ + أَرْخَوْا — wa-, and + arkhā, to slacken, let down (v. IV, 3mp perf.); 'and they slackened'
قِلْعَ: قِلْعَ — qilʿ, sail (m., construct); acc. object; 'the sail of'
فَغَابُوا: فَ + غَابُوا — fa-, and + ghāba, to vanish, disappear (v. I, 3mp perf.); 'and they vanished'
فَأَنْشَدْتُ: فَ + أَنْشَدْتُ — fa-, and + anshada, to recite (verse) (v. IV, 1cs perf.); 'and I recited'
أَرَى: أَرَى — raʾā, to see (v. I, 1cs impf. arā); 'I see'
آثَارَهُمْ: آثَار + هُمْ — athar, trace, mark, pl. āthār (m.) + -hum, their; acc. object; 'their traces'
فَأَذُوبُ: فَ + أَذُوبُ — fa-, and + dhāba, to melt (v. I, 1cs impf. adhūbu); 'and I melt'
وَأَسْكُبُ: وَ + أَسْكُبُ — wa-, and + sakaba, to pour (v. I, 1cs impf. askubu); 'and I pour'
مَوَاطِنِهِمْ: مَوَاطِن + هِمْ — mawṭin, home, dwelling-place, pl. mawāṭin (m.) + -him, their; gen. after في; 'their dwelling-places'
وَأَسْأَلُ: وَ + أَسْأَلُ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (v. I, 1cs impf. asʾalu); 'and I ask'
بِالْبُعْدِ: بِـ + الـ + بُعْدِ — bi-, marking the content of قضى, 'decreed X' (prep.) + al-, the + buʿd, distance, separation (m.); 'the separation'
عَنْهُمْ: عَنْ + هُمْ — ʿan, from + -hum, them; 'from them'
يَمُنَّ: يَمُنَّ — manna ʿalā, to bestow a favour on (v. I, 3ms subjunctive, أَنْ elided before it under poetic license); 'that He grant'
الطَّابِقِ: الـ + طَابِقِ — al-, the + ṭābiq, vault (m.); gen. after من; 'the vault'
الطَّوْفَ: الـ + طَوْفَ — al-, the + ṭawf, roaming, going about (m., verbal noun); acc., predicate of كان (see note); 'the roaming'
الْجَزِيرَةِ: الـ + جَزِيرَةِ — al-, the + jazīra, island (f.); gen. after في; 'the island'
وَبِاللَّيْلِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + لَّيْلِ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep.) + al-, the + layl, night (m.); 'and by night'
أَنْزِلُ: أَنْزِلُ — nazala, to go down (v. I, 1cs impf. anzilu); 'I go down'
الْقَاعَةَ: الـ + قَاعَةَ — al-, the + qāʿa, hall, underground chamber (f.); acc. (bare object, see note at الطابق); 'the hall' Also acc. as the noun of anna (anna hādhā al-burja wa-hādhihi al-qāʿata).
طَرَفِ: طَرَفِ — ṭaraf, edge (m., construct); gen., object of إلى; 'the edge of'
يَنْشَفُ: يَنْشَفُ — nashafa, to dry up, absorb (v. I, 3ms impf.); 'dries up'
وَانْقَطَعَ: وَ + انْقَطَعَ — wa-, and + inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off (v. VII, 3ms perf.; initial hamzat waṣl, elided in connected speech); 'and was cut off'
تَيَّارُهُ: تَيَّار + هُ — tayyār, current (m.) + -hu, its; nom. subject; 'its current'
الشَّهْرُ: الـ + شَهْرُ — al-, the + shahr, month (m.); nom. subject; 'the month'
نَشَفَ: نَشَفَ — nashafa, to dry up (v. I, 3ms perf.); 'dried up'
النَّاحِيَةِ: الـ + نَاحِيَةِ — al-, the + nāḥiya, side, direction (f.); gen. after من; 'the side'
وَأَيْقَنْتُ: وَ + أَيْقَنْتُ — wa-, and + ayqana, to be certain (v. IV, 1cs perf.); 'and I became certain'
خُضْتُ: خُضْتُ — khāḍa, to wade (v. I, 1cs perf.); 'I waded'
الْأَصِيلِ: الـ + أَصِيلِ — al-, the + aṣīl, firm, genuine (adj., m.); gen., agreeing with البر; 'the firm (mainland)'
كِيمَانَ: كِيمَانَ — kīmān, mounds, hills (irregular pl. of kawm, m.); acc. object; 'mounds of'
تَغُوصُ: تَغُوصُ — ghāṣa, to sink (v. I, 3fs impf.); 'sinks'
رِجْلُ: رِجْلُ — rijl, foot (f., construct); nom. subject; 'the foot of'
الْجَمَلِ: الـ + جَمَلِ — al-, the + jamal, camel (m.); gen.; 'the camel'
الرُّكَبِ: الـ + رُكَبِ — al-, the + rukba, knee, pl. rukab (f., plural drops the tāʾ marbūṭa); gen. after إلى, idiom 'up to the knee(s)'; 'the knees'
فَقَوِيَتْ: فَ + قَوِيَتْ — fa-, and + qawiya, to grow strong (v. I, 3fs perf.); 'and grew strong'
بِنَارٍ: بِـ + نَارٍ — bi-, marking what appears after إذا (prep.) + nār, fire (f.); 'with a fire'
تَلُوحُ: تَلُوحُ — lāḥa, to gleam, appear (v. I, 3fs impf.); 'gleaming'
اشْتِعَالًا: اشْتِعَالًا — ishtiʿāl, a blazing (m., verbal noun of ishtaʿala; initial hamzat waṣl); acc., cognate object; 'a blazing'
فَقَصَدْتُهَا: فَ + قَصَدْتُ + هَا — fa-, and + qaṣada, to make for (v. I, 1cs perf.) + -hā, it (f., referring to النار); 'and I made for it'
أَجِلُ: أَجِلُ — obscure; the sense wants 'I may find' (perhaps for أَجِدُ, wajada, to find, v. I, 1cs impf.; dāl/lām easily confused in this print — see note); pointed as printed; 'I might find'
يَلْوِي: يَلْوِي — lawā, to turn, twist (v. I, 3ms impf.); 'turns'
عِنَانَهُ: عِنَان + هُ — ʿinān, rein (m.) + -hu, its; acc. object; 'its rein'
يَسْعِفُ: يَسْعِفُ — asʿafa, to assist, further (v. IV, 3ms impf.); 'furthers'
آمَالِي: آمَال + ي — amal, hope, pl. āmāl (m.) + -ī, my; acc. object; 'my hopes'
يَقْضِي: يَقْضِي — qaḍā, to fulfil, accomplish (v. I, 3ms impf.); 'fulfils'; here: after ṣāra, 'began': yaqḍī maṣāliḥahu, 'settling his affairs'
حَوَائِجِي: حَوَائِج + ي — ḥāja, need, pl. ḥawāʾij (f.) + -ī, my; acc. object; 'my needs'
تُحْدِثُ: تُحْدِثُ — aḥdatha, to bring about, cause (v. IV, 3fs impf.); 'brings about'
بَعْدِ: بَعْدِ — baʿd, after (m., construct); gen. after من; 'after'
الْأُمُورِ: الـ + أُمُورِ — al-, the + amr, matter, affair, pl. umūr (m.); gen. after بعد; 'the matters'
أُمُورٌ: أُمُورٌ — umūr, matters, affairs (pl. of amr, m.); nom. subject, indefinite; 'matters'
قَصَدْتُ: قَصَدْتُ — qaṣada, to make for, head toward (v. I, 1cs perf.); 'I made for'
النَّارَ: الـ + نَارَ — al-, the + nār, fire (f.); acc. object; 'the fire'
قَرُبْتُ: قَرُبْتُ — qaruba, to draw near (v. I, 1cs perf.); 'I drew near'
بِقَصْرٍ: بِـ + قَصْرٍ — bi-, marking what appears after إذا (prep.) + qaṣr, palace (m.); 'a palace'
بَابُهُ: بَاب + هُ — bāb, door (m.) + -hu, its; nom. subject; 'its door'
الْأَصْفَرِ: الـ + أَصْفَرِ — al-, the + aṣfar, yellow (adj., m.); gen., agreeing with النحاس; 'the yellow'
أَشْرَقَتْ: أَشْرَقَتْ — ashraqa, to shine (v. IV, 3fs perf.); 'shone'
أَضَاءَ: أَضَاءَ — aḍāʾa, to gleam, shine (v. IV, 3ms perf.); 'it gleamed'
يُرَى: يُرَى — raʾā (passive), to be seen (3ms impf.); 'is seen'
كَأَنَّهُ: كَأَنَّ + هُ — kaʾanna, as though (particle) + -hu, it (ism of كأنّ); 'as though it'
بِرُؤْيَتِهِ: بِـ + رُؤْيَة + هِ — bi-, at (prep.) + ruʾya, sight (f.) + -hi, its; 'at the sight of it'
جَلَسْتُ: جَلَسْتُ — jalasa, to sit (v. I, 1cs perf.); 'I sat'
مُقَابِلًا: مُقَابِلًا — muqābil, facing (active part. of qābala, v. III, m.); acc. of state; 'facing'
شَبَابٍ: شَبَابٍ — shabāb, young men (coll., m.); gen., indefinite, specifier of عشرة; 'young men'
لَابِسِينَ: لَابِسِينَ — lābis, wearing (active part. of labisa, m. pl. acc.); acc. of state; 'wearing'
الْأَثْوَابَ: الـ + أَثْوَابَ — al-, the + thawb, garment, pl. athwāb (m.); acc. object; 'the garments'
الْمُفْتَخِرَةَ: الـ + مُفْتَخِرَةَ — al-, the + muftakhira, splendid, glorious (active part. of iftakhara, v. VIII, f.); acc. adjective; 'splendid'
الشَّبَابَ: الـ + شَبَابَ — al-, the + shabāb, young men (m.); acc., ism of أنّ; 'the young men'
بِصِفَتِهِمْ: بِـ + صِفَة + هِمْ — bi-, at (prep.) + ṣifa, description, appearance (f.) + -him, their; 'at their appearance'
إِنْفَاقِهِمْ: إِنْفَاق + هِمْ — infāq, spending, outlay (m., verbal noun of anfaqa, v. IV) + -him, their; 'their spending'
عَوَرِهِمْ: عَوَر + هِمْ — ʿawar, one-eyedness (m., verbal noun) + -him, their; gen. after في; 'their one-eyedness'
رَأَوْنِي: رَأَوْا + نِي — raʾā, to see (v. I, 3mp perf.) + -nī, me; 'they saw me'
سَلَّمُوا: سَلَّمُوا — sallama, to greet (v. II, 3mp perf.); 'they greeted'
سَأَلُونِي: سَأَلُوا + نِي — saʾala, to ask (v. I, 3mp perf.) + -nī, me; 'they asked me'
فَحَكَيْتُ: فَ + حَكَيْتُ — fa-, and + ḥakā, to relate, tell (v. I, 1cs perf.); 'and I related'
الْمَصَائِبِ: الـ + مَصَائِبِ — al-, the + muṣība, calamity, pl. maṣāʾib (f.); gen. after من; 'the calamities'
لِحَدِيثِي: لِـ + حَدِيث + ي — li-, at (prep.) + ḥadīth, account, talk (m.) + -ī, my; 'at my account'
أَخَذُونِي: أَخَذُوا + نِي — akhadha, to take (v. I, 3mp perf.) + -nī, me; 'they took me'
أَطْلَعُونِي: أَطْلَعُوا + نِي — aṭlaʿa, to bring up, take up into (v. IV, 3mp perf.) + -nī, me; 'they brought me up'
تُخُوتٍ: تُخُوتٍ — takht (Persian loanword), couch, divan, pl. tukhūt (m.); gen., indefinite, specifier; 'couches'
تَخْتٍ: تَخْتٍ — takht, couch (m.); gen., indefinite, construct; 'a couch'
فِرَاشُهُ: فِرَاش + هُ — firāsh, mattress, bedding (m.) + -hu, its; nom. predicate; 'its mattress'
لِحَافُهُ: لِحَاف + هُ — liḥāf, coverlet, quilt (m.) + -hu, its; nom., coordinated with فراشه; 'its coverlet'
أَزْرَقُ: أَزْرَقُ — azraq, blue (adj., m.); nom. predicate; 'blue'
التُّخُوتِ: الـ + تُخُوتِ — al-, the + takht, couch, pl. tukhūt (m.); gen.; 'the couches'
تَخْتٌ: تَخْتٌ — takht, couch (m.); nom. subject, indefinite; 'a couch'
كُلِّهِمْ: كُلّ + هِمْ — kull, all (m.) + -him, them; gen., emphatic apposition to هم; 'all of them'
شَابٍّ: شَابٍّ — shābb, young man (m.); gen., indefinite, specifier of كل; 'a young man'
تَخْتِهِ: تَخْت + هِ — takht, couch (m.) + -hi, his; gen. after على; 'his couch'
التَّخْتِ: الـ + تَخْتِ — al-, the + takht, couch (m.); gen. after على; 'the couch'
اجْلِسْ: اجْلِسْ — jalasa, to sit (v. I, imper. 2ms; initial hamzat waṣl, elided in connected speech); 'sit'
أَحْوَالِنَا: أَحْوَال (pl. of حَال) — condition, state (m.) + نَا our; 'our conditions'
عَوَرِ: ʿawar — one-eyedness, being blind in one eye (m., gen.)
أَعْيُيْنِنَا: أَعْيُن (pl. of عَيْن) — eye (f.) + نَا our; 'our eyes' — printed with an extra ي (أعييننا) beyond the expected أعيننا; kept as printed
يَسْأَلُونِي: يَسْأَلُونَ + ـي — yasʾalūna, they ask (verb I, impf. 3mp) + -nī, me; printed with a single ن before the object suffix (يسألوني) rather than the fuller يسألونني; 'they ask me'
أَحْوَالِي: أَحْوَال (pl. of حَال) — condition (m.) + ـي my; 'my conditions'
جَرِئَ: printed for جَرَى, jarā, to happen (verb I def., perf. 3ms), with a hamza-seat ئ where the ordinary alif maqṣūra ى is expected (compare جَرَى later in this slice, spelled normally); 'what happened'
أُخْبِرُهُمْ: أُخْبِرُ + هُمْ — ukhbiru, I inform (verb IV of خ-ب-ر, impf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'I tell them'
أَكْثَرُ: akthar — most, the greater part (elative of كَثِير, nom.)
الشَّبَابُ: الـ + شَبَاب — shabāb, young men, youths (coll. m., nom.)
تُقَدِّمُ: tuqaddimu — you serve, bring (verb II of ق-د-م, impf. 2ms); 'will you not bring'
رَاتِبَنَا: رَاتِب — ration, wage, allowance (m.) + نَا our; 'our ration' (acc.)
فَقٰلَ: فَـ + قٰلَ — fa-, then (conj.) + qāla, he said (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); the edition's own defective spelling قل for قال, pointed here with the dagger alif per house convention
أَطْبَاقٍ: أَطْبَاق (pl. of طَبَق) — tray, dish (m., gen.)
مُغَطًّى: mughaṭṭan — covered (pass. part. II of غ-ط-و, m. sg.)
بِغِطَاءٍ: بِـ + غِطَاءٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + ghiṭāʾ, cover (m., gen.); 'with a cover'
فَقَدَّمَ: فَـ + قَدَّمَ — fa-, then (conj.) + qaddama, he served, set before (verb II, perf. 3ms)
أَوْقَدَ: awqada — to light, kindle (verb IV of و-ق-د, perf. 3ms)
وَأَغْرَزَ: وَ + أَغْرَزَ — wa- and (conj.) + aghraza, he stuck, planted (verb IV of غ-ر-ز, perf. 3ms)
كَشَفَ: kashafa — to uncover, disclose (verb I, perf. 3ms)
الْأَغْطِيَةَ: الـ + أَغْطِيَة (pl. of غِطَاء) — cover (m., acc.)
الْأَطْبَاقِ: الـ + أَطْبَاق (pl. of طَبَق) — tray (m., gen.)
وَدَقُّ: وَ + دَقُّ — wa- and (conj.) + daqq, crushing, pounding (verbal noun I of د-ق-ق, m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'crushed [charcoal]'
وَسَوَادُ: وَ + سَوَادُ — wa- and (conj.) + sawād, blackness, soot (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa)
فَشَمَّرَ: فَـ + شَمَّرَ — fa-, then (conj.) + shammara ʿan, to roll up, bare (verb II of ش-م-ر, perf. 3ms, + عَنْ 'off')
سَوَاعِدِهِمْ: سَوَاعِد (pl. of سَاعِد) — forearm (m.) + هِمْ their; 'their forearms'
وَانْتَحَبُوا: وَ + انْتَحَبُوا — wa- and (conj.) + intaḥabū, they sobbed (verb VIII of ن-ح-ب, perf. 3mp)
وَسَخَّمُوا: وَ + سَخَّمُوا — wa- and (conj.) + sakhkhamū, they blackened, sooted (verb II of س-خ-م, perf. 3mp)
وُجُوهَهُمْ: وُجُوه (pl. of وَجْه) — face (m.) + هُمْ their; 'their faces' (acc.)
خَبَطُوا: khabaṭū — they struck, beat (verb I, perf. 3mp)
أَثْوَابَهُمْ: أَثْوَاب (pl. of ثَوْب) — garment (m.) + هُمْ their; 'their garments' (acc.)
وَدَقُّوا: وَ + دَقُّوا — wa- and (conj.) + daqqū, they beat, pounded (verb I, perf. 3mp)
صُدُورِهِمْ: صُدُور (pl. of صَدْر) — chest, breast (m.) + هِمْ their; 'their chests'
وَعَارُوا: وَ + عَارُوا — wa- and (conj.) + ʿārū, they were overcome with shame, recoiled in shame (verb I hollow ʿ-w/y-r, perf. 3mp); read here rather than a form of عَرِيَ 'be naked', which the same consonants (وعاروا) would also allow
قَاعِدِينَ: qāʿidīn — sitting (act. part. I, m. pl. acc., predicate of كنا)
بِطُولِنَا: بِـ + طُولِ + نَا — bi-, at, in (prep.) + ṭūl, length, extent (m., gen.) + -nā, our; idiom 'at our leisure, at our ease'
خَلَّانَا: خَلَّى + نَا — khallā, to leave, let be (verb II of خ-ل-و, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us; 'left us [alone]'
فُضُولُنَا: فُضُول — meddling, prying, curiosity (m., nom.) + نَا our; 'our own curiosity' (subject of خلانا)
قُرْبِ: qurb — nearness, vicinity (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'near'
الصُّبْحِ: الـ + صُبْح — ṣubḥ, dawn, morning (m., gen.)
وَسَخَّنَ: وَ + سَخَّنَ — wa- and (conj.) + sakhkhana, he heated (verb II of س-خ-ن, perf. 3ms)
فَغَسَلُوا: فَـ + غَسَلُوا — fa-, then (conj.) + ghasalū, they washed (verb I, perf. 3mp)
وَلَبِسُوا: وَ + لَبِسُوا — wa- and (conj.) + labisū, they wore, put on (verb I, perf. 3mp)
أَثْوَابًا: أَثْوَاب (pl. of ثَوْب) — garment (m., acc. indef.)
سَنَاهْ: an address to the lady of the house, the tale's present listener; the printed letters (سناه) do not match a known word for 'lady' — kept exactly as printed rather than emended (e.g. to يا سِتّاه), and rendered on sense in the idiomatic layer
عَقْلِي: عَقْل — mind, reason (m.) + ـي my; 'my mind'
وَاشْتَعَلَ: وَ + اشْتَعَلَ — wa- and (conj.) + ishtaʿala, to blaze, flare up (verb VIII of ش-ع-ل, perf. 3ms)
أَسْتَطِعِ: astaṭiʿ — I am able (verb X hollow of ط-و-ع, juss. 1cs after لم); kasra on the final letter is a liaison vowel before the following al-
وَسَأَلْتُهُمْ: وَ + سَأَلْتُ + هُمْ — wa- and (conj.) + saʾaltu, I asked (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hum, them
أَوْجَبَ: awjaba — to necessitate, make binding (verb IV of و-ج-ب, perf. 3ms)
انْشِرَاحِنَا: اِنْشِرَاح — ease, cheerfulness, delight (verbal noun VII of ش-ر-ح, m., gen.) + نَا our
وَتَعَبِنَا: وَ + تَعَبِ + نَا — wa- and (conj.) + taʿab, fatigue, toil (m., gen.) + -nā, our
وَأَنْتُمْ: وَ + أَنْتُمْ — wa- and (conj.) + antum, you (m. pl., indep. pron.)
بِحَمْدِ: بِـ + حَمْدِ — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥamd, praise (m., gen.); bi-ḥamdi Allāh, 'praise be to God'
فِيكُمْ: فِي + كُمْ — fī, in (prep.) + -kum, you (m. pl.)
تَامٌّ: tāmm — complete, perfect (adj., m., nom. indef.)
الْأَفْعَالُ: الـ + أَفْعَال (pl. of فِعْل) — deed, act (m., nom.)
يَفْعَلُهَا: يَفْعَلُ + هَا — yafʿalu, does (verb I, impf. 3ms) + -hā, them (f.)
الْمَجَانِينِ: الـ + مَجَانِين (pl. of مَجْنُون) — madman (m., gen.)
فَأَسْأَلُكُمْ: فَـ + أَسْأَلُ + كُمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + asʾalu, I ask, adjure (verb I of س-أ-ل, impf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.)
بِأَعَزِّ: بِـ + أَعَزِّ — bi-, by (prep., of an oath/adjuration) + aʿazz, dearest (elative of عَزِيز, gen., first term of iḍāfa)
الْأَشْيَاءِ: الـ + أَشْيَاء (pl. of شَيْء) — thing (f. pl., gen.)
قُلْتُمْ: qultum — you (pl.) said (verb I hollow, perf. 2mp)
خَبَرَكُمْ: خَبَر — news, story (m.) + كُمْ your; 'your news' (acc.)
وَسَبَبَ: وَ + سَبَبَ — wa- and (conj.) + sabab, reason, cause (m., acc.)
أَعْيُنِكُمْ: أَعْيُن (pl. of عَيْن) — eye (f.) + كُمْ your; 'your eyes'
وَسَخَامَةَ: وَ + سَخَامَةَ — wa- and (conj.) + sakhāma, sootiness, blackness (f., acc.)
وُجُوهِكُمْ: وُجُوه (pl. of وَجْه) — face (m.) + كُمْ your; 'your faces'
بِالرَّمَادِ: بِـ + الـ + رَمَاد — bi-, with (prep.) + ramād, ash (m., gen.); 'with the ash'
وَالسَّوَادِ: وَ + الـ + سَوَاد — wa- and (conj.) + sawād, blackness (m., gen.)
فَالْتَفَتُوا: فَـ + الْتَفَتُوا — fa-, then (conj.) + iltafatū, they turned (verb VIII of ل-ف-ت, perf. 3mp)
يَغُرَّكَ: يَغُرُّ + كَ — yaghurru, deceives (verb I of غ-ر-ر, impf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'let ... deceive you'
وَاعْدِلْ: وَ + اعْدِلْ — wa- and (conj.) + iʿdil, turn away! (imper. I of ع-د-ل, 2ms)
الْمَأْكُولِ: الـ + مَأْكُول — maʾkūl, eaten, food (pass. part. I of أ-ك-ل, m., gen.)
أَكَلْنَا: akalnā — we ate (verb I of أ-ك-ل, perf. 1cp)
وَانْشَالَتِ: وَ + انْشَالَتِ — wa- and (conj.) + inshālat, was lifted away, removed (verb VII of ن-ش-ل, perf. 3fs)
الْأَوَانِي: الـ + أَوَانِي (pl. of إِنَاء) — vessel, dish (m. pl., nom.)
وَأَوْقَدَ: وَ + أَوْقَدَ — wa- and (conj.) + awqada, he lit (verb IV of و-ق-د, perf. 3ms)
الْأَكْلَ: الـ + أَكْل — akl, food, eating (m., acc.)
وَالشُّرْبَ: وَ + الـ + شُرْب — wa- and (conj.) + shurb, drink, drinking (m., acc.)
لِلْمُحَادَثَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مُحَادَثَة — li-, for (prep.) + muḥādatha, conversation (verbal noun III of ح-د-ث, f., gen.)
لِلشَّيْخِ: لِـ + الـ + شَيْخ — li-, to (prep.) + shaykh, old man (m., gen.)
بِالْأَطْبَاقِ: بِـ + الـ + أَطْبَاق (pl. of طَبَق) — bi-, with (prep.) + ṭabaq, tray (m., gen.)
وَفِيهِمُ: وَ + فِي + هِمُ — wa- and (conj.) + fī, in (prep.) + -him, them
يُسَخِّمُونَ: yusakhkhimūna — they blacken, soot (verb II of س-خ-م, impf. 3mp)
وَيَغْسِلُونَ: وَ + يَغْسِلُونَ — wa- and (conj.) + yaghsilūna, they wash (verb I, impf. 3mp)
وَيُغَيِّرُونَ: وَ + يُغَيِّرُونَ — wa- and (conj.) + yughayyirūna, they change (verb II of غ-ي-ر, impf. 3mp)
أَتَعَجَّبُ: ataʿajjabu — I marvel, am astonished (verb V of ع-ج-ب, impf. 1cs)
وَازْدَادَ: وَ + ازْدَادَ — wa- and (conj.) + izdāda, to increase (verb VIII hollow of ز-ي-د, perf. 3ms)
وَسْوَاسِي: وَسْوَاس — anxious brooding, obsessive whispering (m.) + ـي my
امْتَنَعْتُ: imtanaʿtu — I abstained, refrained (verb VIII of م-ن-ع, perf. 1cs)
الْفِتْيَانُ: الـ + فِتْيَان (pl. of فَتًى) — young man (m., voc. nom.)
تُزِيلُوا: tuzīlū — you (pl.) remove (verb IV of ز-و-ل, juss. 2mp after لم)
وَتُخْبِرُونِي: وَ + تُخْبِرُونَ + ـي — wa- and (conj.) + tukhbirūna, you (pl.) tell (verb IV of خ-ب-ر, impf. 2mp) + -nī, me
تَسْخِيمِ: taskhīm — blackening, sooting (verbal noun II of س-خ-م, m., gen.)
كِتْمَانُ: kitmān — concealment, keeping secret (verbal noun I of ك-ت-م, m., nom.)
أَصْلَحُ: aṣlaḥ — more fitting, better (elative of صَالِح, m., nom.)
فَبَقِيتُ: فَـ + بَقِيتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + baqītu, I remained (verb I def., perf. 1cs)
مُتَحَيِّرًا: mutaḥayyir — bewildered, perplexed (act. part. V of ح-ي-ر, m., acc.)
أُمُورِهِمْ: أُمُور (pl. of أَمْر) — affair, matter (m.) + هِمْ their
أَمْتَنِعُ: amtaniʿu — I abstain, refrain (verb VIII of م-ن-ع, impf. 1cs)
بُدَّأَنْ: بُدَّ + أَنْ — budda, escape, alternative (acc., after لا النافية للجنس) + an, that (subordinating particle); idiom لا بُدَّ أَنْ, 'it must be that'; the edition runs the two words together as one (بدان), without even a hamza sign for أَنْ — kept and vocalized as one token
تُخْبِرُونِي: تُخْبِرُونَ + ـي — tukhbirūna, you (pl.) tell (verb IV of خ-ب-ر, impf. 2mp) + -nī, me
لِأَنَّكَ: لِـ + أَنَّ + كَ — li-anna, because (compound particle) + -ka, you; the لِـ here marks the causal clause, 'because'
تَبْقَى: tabqā — you remain, stay (verb I def., impf. 2ms)
دَعُونِي: دَعُوا + ـنِي — daʿū, leave, let (imper. I of و-د-ع, 2mp) + -nī, me; 'let me'
أُسَافِرُ: usāfiru — I travel (verb III of س-ف-ر, impf. 1cs)
وَأَسْتَرِيحُ: وَ + أَسْتَرِيحُ — wa- and (conj.) + astarīḥu, I rest, find relief (verb X hollow of ر-و-ح, impf. 1cs)
وَالْمَثَلُ: وَ + الـ + مَثَل — wa- and (conj.) + mathal, proverb, saying (m., nom.)
بُعَادِي: بُعَاد — distance, being far (m.) + ـي my
أَجْمَلُ: ajmal — more/most beautiful (elative of جَمِيل, m., nom.)
وَأَحْسَنُ: وَ + أَحْسَنُ — wa- and (conj.) + aḥsan, better, more excellent (elative of حَسَن, m., nom.)
تَنْبَظِرُ: printed form, otherwise unattested; almost certainly a corruption of تُبْصِرُ, tubṣiru, 'sees' (verb IV of ب-ص-ر, impf. 3fs) — this is the common proverb عَيْنٌ لَا تُبْصِر قَلْبٌ لَا يَحْزَن, quoted here; kept and vocalized as printed
ذَبَحُوهُ: ذَبَحُوا + هُ — dhabaḥū, they slaughtered (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, it
وَسَلَخُوهُ: وَ + سَلَخُوا + هُ — wa- and (conj.) + salakhū, they skinned (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, it
الْجِلْدَ: الـ + جِلْد — jild, skin, hide (m., acc.); 'the skin'
وَادْخُلْ: وَ + ادْخُلْ — wa-, and + dakhala (verb I, to enter); imp. 2ms; 'and enter!'
الْجِلْدِ: الـ + جِلْد — jild, skin (m., gen. after fī); 'the skin'
وَخَيِّطْهُ: وَ + خَيَّطَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + khayyaṭa (verb II, to sew, stitch); imp. 2ms + 3ms obj.; 'and sew it'
يَأْتِيكَ: atā (verb I, to come); imperf. 3ms + 2ms obj.; 'it will come to you'
الرُّخُّ: الـ + رُخّ — rukhkh, the Rukh (the giant fabulous bird of these tales); proper name
وَيَشِيلُكَ: وَ + شَالَ + ـكَ — wa-, and + shāla (verb I, colloquial, to lift, carry); imperf. 3ms + 2ms obj.; 'and it will carry you off'
وَيَحُطُّكَ: وَ + حَطَّ + ـكَ — wa-, and + ḥaṭṭa (verb I, to set down, alight); imperf. 3ms + 2ms obj.; 'and it will set you down'
فَشُقَّ: فَـ + شُقَّ — fa-, then + shaqqa (verb I, to split, tear); imp. 2ms; 'then tear!'
فَيَخَافُ: فَـ + يَخَافُ — fa-, so/and + khāfa (verb I, to fear); imperf. 3ms; 'and it will fear'
وَيُخَلِّيكَ: وَ + خَلَّى + ـكَ — wa-, and + khallā (verb II, to leave, let be); imperf. 3ms + 2ms obj.; 'and leave you'
فَامْشِ: فَـ + امْشِ — fa-, then + mashā (verb I, to walk); imp. 2ms; 'then walk!'
تَلْقَي: laqiya (verb I, to meet, find); imperf. 2ms; 'you will find' (printed تلقي, with ي where ى is expected — see note on this sentence)
قُدَّامَكَ: قُدَّامَ + ـكَ — quddām, in front of (adv./prep., colloquial) + 2ms; 'before you'
غَرِيبَ: gharīb, strange (adj., m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa-like compound); 'strange of'
فَادْخُلْ: فَـ + ادْخُلْ — fa-, then + dakhala (verb I, to enter); imp. 2ms; 'then enter!'
مُنَاكَ: مُنًى + ـكَ — munan (munā), wish, desired thing (f., acc.) + 2ms; 'your wish'
فَدُخُولُنَا: فَـ + دُخُول + ـنَا — fa-, as for/so + dukhūl, entering (verbal noun, m., nom.) + 1cp; 'as for our entering'
سَخَامَةِ: sakhāma, soot-blackness (f., gen.; second term of one iḍāfa, first term of the next); 'the blackening of'
عُيُونِنَا: عُيُون + ـنَا — ʿuyūn (pl. of ʿayn), eyes (gen.) + 1cp; 'our eyes'
حَكَيْنَا: ḥakā (verb I, to relate, tell); perf. 1cp; 'we told'
شَرْحُنَا: شَرْح + ـنَا — sharḥ, explanation, account (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'our account'
وَحَمَلَنِي: وَ + حَمَلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + ḥamala (verb I, to carry); perf. 3ms + 1cs obj.; 'and it carried me'
كَالْأَقْمَارِ: كَـ + الـ + أَقْمَار — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + qamar (pl. aqmār), moon (gen.); 'like the moons'
يَشْبَعُ: shabiʿa (verb I, to be sated); imperf. 3ms; 'he is sated'
يَنْظُرُ: naẓara (verb I, to look); imperf. 3ms; 'he looks'
وَسَهْلًا: وَ + سَهْلًا — wa-, and + sahl, easy, smooth (m., acc., paired in the greeting formula); 'and ease!'
وَمَرْحَبًا: وَ + مَرْحَبًا — wa-, and + marḥaban, welcome (acc., greeting formula); 'and welcome!'
انْتِظَارِكَ: اِنْتِظَار + ـكَ — intiẓār, waiting (verbal noun of form VIII, m., gen.) + 2ms; 'your waiting'
يَسْتَحِقُّنَا: اِسْتَحَقَّ + ـنَا — istaḥaqqa (verb X, to deserve); imperf. 3ms + 1cp obj.; 'deserves us'
نَسْتَحِقُّهُ: اِسْتَحَقَّ + ـهُ — istaḥaqqa (verb X, to deserve) + 3ms obj.; imperf. 1cp — "we deserve him"
أَجْلَسُونِي: أَجْلَسَ + ـونِي — ajlasa (verb IV, to seat); perf. 3mp + 1cs obj.; 'they seated me'
وَالْحَاكِمُ: وَ + الـ + حَاكِم — wa-, and + ḥākim, ruler (act. part., m., nom.); 'and the ruler'
جَوَارِكَ: جَوَارِي (pl. of jāriya) + ـكَ — jawāri, slave-girls (construct form) + 2ms; 'your slave-girls'
وَتَحْتَ: وَ + تَحْتَ — wa-, and + taḥta, under (prep.); 'and under'
طَاعَتِكَ: طَاعَة + ـكَ — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., gen.) + 2ms; 'your obedience'
فَأْمُرْ: فَـ + أْمُرْ — fa-, so + amara (verb I, to command); imp. 2ms (hamza kept after fa-); 'so command!'
بِحُكْمِكَ: بِـ + حُكْم + ـكَ — bi-, by/with (prep.) + ḥukm, judgment (m., gen.) + 2ms; 'by your judgment'
فَعَجِبْتُ: فَـ + عَجِبْتُ — fa-, and + ʿajiba (verb I, to marvel, wonder); perf. 1cs; 'and I marveled'
أَحْوَالِهِنَّ: أَحْوَال (pl. of ḥāl) + ـهِنَّ — aḥwāl, states, conditions (gen.) + 3fp; 'their (f.) states'
وَأَتَوْنِي: وَ + أَتَوْا + ـنِي — wa-, and + atā (verb I, to come); perf. 3mp + 1cs obj.; 'and they came to me'
بِطَعَامٍ: بِـ + طَعَامٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + ṭaʿām, food (m., gen. indef.); 'with food'
وَإِيَّاهُمْ: وَ + إِيَّا + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + iyyā- (particle carrying object-pronoun suffixes) + 3mp; 'and them'
وَاجْتَمَعْنَ: وَ + اِجْتَمَعْنَ — wa-, and + ijtamaʿa (verb VIII, to gather); perf. 3fp; 'and they (f.) gathered'
فَرَشُوا: farasha (verb I, to spread out); perf. 3mp; 'they spread'
الْمَشْمُومِ: الـ + مَشْمُوم — mashmūm, sweet-smelling herb(s) (pass. part., m., gen.); 'the sweet herbs'
وَالنُّقْلِ: وَ + الـ + نُقْل — wa-, and + nuql, dried fruit, dessert nuts (m., gen.); 'and the dried fruit'
كَثِيرَةً: kathīra, many, much (f. adj., acc. indef.); 'many'
وَأَحْضَرُوا: وَ + أَحْضَرُوا — wa-, and + aḥḍara (verb IV, to bring); perf. 3mp; 'and they brought'
فَجَلَسْنَا: فَـ + جَلَسْنَا — fa-, then + jalasa (verb I, to sit); perf. 1cp; 'then we sat'
وَدَارَتِ: وَ + دَارَتْ — wa-, and + dāra (verb I, to go round); perf. 3fs; 'and went round'
الْكُؤُسُ: الـ + كُؤُوس — kuʾūs (pl. of kaʾs), cups (nom.); 'the cups'
وَالطَّاسَاتُ: وَ + الـ + طَاسَات — wa-, and + ṭāsāt (pl. of ṭāsa, a Persian loanword), bowls (nom.); 'and the bowls'
أَنْسَانِي: أَنْسَى + ـنِي — ansā (verb IV, to make forget); perf. 3ms + 1cs obj.; 'made me forget'
هُمُومَ: هُمُوم (pl. of hamm) — humūm, cares, worries (acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the cares of'
الْعَيْشُ: الـ + عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., nom.); 'the life'
زِلْتُ: zāla (verb I, in the frame lā yazālu/mā zila, 'to continue to be'); perf. 1cs; 'I ceased' (with the preceding لا: 'I did not cease')
تَخْتَارُ: اِخْتَارَ (verb VIII, to choose); imperf. 2ms; 'you choose'
فَاخْتَارَتْ: فَـ + اِخْتَارَتْ — fa-, so + ikhtāra (verb VIII, to choose); perf. 3fs; 'so she chose (herself)'
دَعْجَةُ: daʿja, intense (eye-)blackness (f., nom.; here transferred to hair); 'raven-dark of'
فَلَمْجَةُ: root ل-م-ج, unattested in this sense (see note on this sentence); (f., nom.); 'uncertain epithet of'
الثَّغْرِ: الـ + ثَغْر — thaghr, mouth, front teeth (m., gen.); 'the mouth'
كَامِلَةُ: kāmila, complete, perfect (f. adj., nom.); 'perfect in'
الْفُنُونِ: الـ + فُنُون — funūn (pl. of fann), arts, accomplishments (gen.); 'the arts'
بِحَاجِبٍ: بِـ + حَاجِبٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + ḥājib, eyebrow (m., gen. indef.); 'with an eyebrow'
مَقْرُونٍ: maqrūn, joined, coupled (pass. part., m., gen. indef.); 'joined'
خَوْطَانِ: khawṭ (dual khawṭān), twig, slender bough (m. dual, nom.); 'two twigs'
قَضِيبُ: qaḍīb, rod, twig, spray (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a spray of'; also 'rod, wand': qaḍību khayzurānin, 'a stem of cane'
تُدْهِشُ: adhasha (verb IV, to astonish); imperf. 3fs; 'she bewilders'
وَتُحَيِّرُ: وَ + حَيَّرَ — wa-, and + ḥayyara (verb II, to confound); imperf. 3fs; 'and confounds'
الْخَاطِرَ: الـ + خَاطِر — khāṭir, mind, thought (m., acc.); 'the mind'
نُشَبِّهُ: shabbaha (verb II, to liken); imperf. 1cp; 'we liken'
جَهَالَةً: jahāla, ignorance (f., acc. of cause); 'out of ignorance'
وَحَاشَا: وَ + حَاشَا — wa-, and + ḥāshā, far be it, God forbid (particle/frozen verb of exception); 'but far be it'
مَعَايِنَهَا: مَعَايِن (colloquial broken pl. of ʿayn) + ـهَا — maʿāyin, eyes (acc.) + 3fs; 'her eyes'
بِالظِّبَى: بِـ + الـ + ظِّبَى — bi-, to (prep.) + ẓibāʾ (here spelled defectively ظبى), gazelles (gen.); 'to gazelles'
لِلظَّبْيِ: لِـ + الـ + ظَّبْي — li-, to/for (prep.) + ẓaby, gazelle (m., gen.); 'for the gazelle'
الْعَزِيزِ: الـ + عَزِيز — ʿazīz, precious, mighty (m. adj., gen.); 'the precious'
قَوَامُهَا: قَوَام + ـهَا — qawām, stature, figure (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'her stature'
وَمَشْرَبُهَا: وَ + مَشْرَب + ـهَا — wa-, and + mashrab, drinking-place, mouth (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'and her drinking-place'
الْمَعْسُولُ: الـ + مَعْسُول — maʿsūl, honeyed (pass. part., m., nom.); 'the honeyed'
مَشْرَبَا: mashrab, drinking-place (m., acc. of specification); 'as a drinking-place'
وَأَعْيُنُهَا: وَ + أَعْيُن (pl. of ʿayn) + ـهَا — wa-, and + aʿyun, eyes (nom.) + 3fs; 'and her eyes'
النُّجْلُ: الـ + نُجْل — nujl (pl. of najlāʾ), wide, languid-eyed (adj., nom.); 'the wide (eyes)'
الْقَوَاتِلُ: الـ + قَوَاتِل — qawātil (pl. of qātila), deadly, killing (act. part., nom.); 'the deadly (ones)'
سَبَيْنَ: sabā (verb I, to take captive); perf. 3fp; 'they (f.) took captive'
الْقَتِيلَ: الـ + قَتِيل — qatīl, slain (pass. part./noun, m., acc.); 'the slain one'
الْمُسْتَهَامَ: الـ + مُسْتَهَام — mustahām, love-maddened (pass. part. of form X, m., acc.); 'the love-maddened'
الْمُعَذَّبَا: الـ + مُعَذَّب — muʿadhdhab, tormented (pass. part. of form II, m., acc.); 'the tormented'
صَبَوْتُ: ṣabā (verb I, to yearn, feel passion); perf. 1cs; 'I yearned'
صَبْوَةً: ṣabwa, a yearning, infatuation (f., acc. as cognate object); 'a yearning'
جَاهِلِيَّةً: jāhiliyya, reckless, of the (pre-Islamic) 'Ignorance' (f. adj., acc.); 'reckless'
عَجَبَ: ʿajab, wonder (m., in the frozen phrase lā ʿajaba, 'no wonder'); 'wonder'
لِلْمُدْنَفِ: لِـ + الـ + مُدْنَف — li-, for (prep.) + mudnaf, wasted by love-sickness (pass. part. of form IV, m., gen.); 'for the love-sick'
الصَّبِّ: الـ + صَبّ — ṣabb, ardent lover (m., gen.); 'the lover'
صَبَا: ṣabā (verb I, to yearn); perf. 3ms; 'he should yearn'
وَأَنْشَلْتُهَا: وَ + printed root ن-ش-ل + ـهَا — wa-, and + (sense requires anshadtu, 'I recited', from anshada; see note on this sentence); perf. 1cs + 3fs obj.; 'and I recited to her'
قَوْلَ: qawl, saying, words (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the saying of'
الْقَائِلِ: الـ + قَائِل — qāʾil, speaker, sayer (act. part., m., gen.); 'the speaker'
لِغَيْرِ: لِـ + غَيْرِ — li-, to/upon (prep.) + ghayr, other than (m., gen.); 'upon (any) other than'
جَمَالِكُمْ: جَمَال + ـكُمْ — jamāl, beauty (m., gen.) + 2mp; 'your (pl., of respect) beauty'
وَسِوَاكُمْ: وَ + سِوَى + ـكُمْ — wa-, and + siwā, other than (m.) + 2mp; 'and other than you'
يَخْطُرُ: khaṭara (verb I, to cross the mind); imperf. 3ms; 'crosses'
هَوَاكُمْ: هَوَى + ـكُمْ — hawā, love (m., gen.) + 2mp; 'your love'
مَحَبَّتِكُمْ: مَحَبَّة + ـكُمْ — maḥabba, love (f., gen.) + 2mp; 'your love'
أَمُوتُ: māta (verb I, to die); imperf. 1cs; 'I shall die'
وَأُحْشَرُ: وَ + أُحْشَرُ — wa-, and + ḥashara (verb I, passive, to be gathered, resurrected); imperf. pass. 1cs; 'and I shall be raised'
وَنِمْتُ: وَ + نِمْتُ — wa-, and + nāma (verb I, to sleep); perf. 1cs; 'and I slept'
أَصْبَحَتْ: aṣbaḥa (verb IV, to become [morning]); perf. 3fs; 'it became morning'; also: of a person, 'she reached the morning': fa-lammā aṣbaḥat al-ṣabāḥa, 'when morning came (for her)'
دَخَلْنَ: dakhala (verb I, to enter); perf. 3fp; 'they (f.) took (me) in' (fem.-pl. ending, unlike the verbs just after it)
فَغَسَّلُونِي: فَـ + غَسَّلُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and + ghassala (verb II, to wash, bathe); perf. 3mp + 1cs obj.; 'and they washed me'
وَأَلْبَسُونِي: وَ + أَلْبَسُوا + ـنِي — wa-, and + albasa (verb IV, to clothe); perf. 3mp + 1cs obj.; 'and they clothed me'
أَفْخَرِ: afkhar, finest, most splendid (elative, m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the finest of'
الثِّيَابِ: الـ + ثِيَاب — thiyāb (pl. of thawb), garments (gen.); 'the garments'
وَالشَّرَابَ: وَ + الـ + شَرَاب — wa-, and + sharāb, drink (m., acc.); 'and the drink'
فَشَرِبْنَا: فَـ + شَرِبْنَا — fa-, so + shariba (verb I, to drink); perf. 1cp; 'so we drank'
اخْتَرْتُ: اِخْتَارَ (verb VIII, to choose); perf. 1cs; 'I chose'
لَيِّنَةَ: layyina, soft, supple (f. adj., acc.); 'supple of'
الْأَعْطَافِ: الـ + أَعْطَاف — aʿṭāf (pl. of ʿiṭf), sides, flanks (gen.); 'sides'
حُقّانِ: dual of حُقّ — ḥuqq, box, casket (m.); 'two [sealed] caskets' (nom., subj. of the passive verb)
خُتِمَا: خَتَمَ - يُخْتَمُ (pass.) — khatama, to seal; dual passive 'the two were sealed'
بِمِسْكَةٍ: بِـ + مِسْكَة — bi-, with (instrumental prep.) + miskah, a musk-mark/seal (f.); 'with a musk-seal'
تَمْنَعُ: مَنَعَ - يَمْنَعُ — mana'a, to prevent, forbid; 'it (f.) prevents'
الْعُشَّاقَ: الـ + عُشَّاق (pl. of عَاشِق) — al-, the + 'āshiq, lover; 'the lovers' (acc., object)
ضَمَّهُمَا: ضَمّ + هُمَا — ḍamm, embracing (masdar, acc. object) + humā, them both; 'their embracing [of] them both'
تَحْرُسُهُمَا: حَرَسَ - يَحْرُسُ + هُمَا — ḥarasa, to guard + humā, them both; 'she guards them both'
بِسِهَامٍ: بِـ + سِهَام (pl. of سَهْم) — bi-, with (instrumental) + sahm, arrow; 'with arrows'
لَوَاحِظِهَا: لَوَاحِظ (pl. of لاحِظَة) + هَا — lāḥiẓah, glance + her; 'her glances'
يَعْتَدِيهَا: اِعْتَدَى - يَعْتَدِي (form VIII of ع-د-و) + هَا — i'tadā, to transgress against + hā, her; 'whoever transgresses against her'
أَصَابَتْهُ: أَصَابَ - تُصِيبُ (form IV of ص-و-ب) + هُ — aṣāba, to strike/hit + hu, him; 'it (f., the arrow) struck him' (archive prints bare alif for this hamza)
بِسَهْمَيْهِمَا: بِـ + سَهْمَي (dual constr. of سَهْم) + هِمَا — bi-, with (instrumental) + sahmay, the two arrows of + himā, them both; 'with their two arrows'
بِأَجْمَلِ: بِـ + أَجْمَل (elative of جَمِيل) — bi-, in/with (prep.) + ajmal, most beautiful; 'in the most beautiful of'
وَبِالِاخْتِصَارِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + اِخْتِصَار — wa-, and + bi-, in (prep.) + al-, the + ikhtiṣār, abridgement (masdar); 'and in short'
سَيِّدَتَاهْ: سَيِّدَة + ا + هْ (nudba/exclamatory-vocative suffix) — sayyidah, lady (f.) + the emphatic-address ending; 'O my lady!'
أَقَمْتُ: أَقَامَ - يُقِيمُ (form IV of ق-و-م) — aqāma, to stay/dwell (past 1cs); 'I stayed' (archive prints bare alif)
عِنْدَهُنَّ: عِنْدَ + هُنَّ — 'inda, with (prep.) + hunna, them (f.); 'with them'
