أَرْغَلِ: elative-looking form on the letters ا-ر-غ-ل; almost certainly a misprint for أَرْغَد, arghad, 'most comfortable/pleasant' (from رَغِيد); 'in the most pleasant [life]' — genitive after فِي (archive prints bare alif for the initial hamza either way)
مَاعَرَفْنَاكَ: مَا + عَرَفْنَا (عَرَفَ - يَعْرِفُ) + كَ — mā, not (neg. particle) + 'arafnā, we knew + ka, you; 'we did not know you' (printed run together in the archive)
حَالِكَ: حَال + كَ — ḥāl, condition (f.) + ka, your; 'your condition'
إِنَّنَا: إِنَّ + نَا — inna, indeed (emphatic particle) + nā, we; 'indeed we' (archive prints bare alif)
بَنَاتُ: pl. of بِنْت — bint, daughter; 'daughters of' (idafa, nom.)
مُجْتَمِعِينَ: اِجْتَمَعَ - يَجْتَمِعُ (form VIII of ج-م-ع), active part. — ijtama'a, to gather; 'gathered' (predicate; the rasm shows the -īna ending even in this predicate role — a Middle-Arabic collapse of the classical case distinction, kept as printed) Also as the second object of wajada, where -īna is the regular Classical accusative: فَوَجَدْتُ أَهْلِي مُجْتَمِعِينَ حَوْلِي 'I found my family gathered round me'.
نَغِيبُ: غَابَ - يَغِيبُ — ghāba, to be absent (impf. 1cp, indic.); 'we are absent'
أَرْبَعِينَ: arba'īna, forty (oblique; archive prints bare alif)
وَنَقْعُدُ: وَ + نَقْعُدُ (قَعَدَ - يَقْعُدُ) — wa-, and + qa'ada, to sit/settle/stay (impf. 1cp); 'and we stay'
نَأْكُلُ: أَكَلَ - يَأْكُلُ — akala, to eat (impf. 1cp); 'we eat' (archive prints bare alif, cf. house example ياكل)
نَشْرَبُ: shariba, to drink (verb I, impf. 1cp); 'we drink'
وَنَلَذُّ: وَ + نَلَذُّ (لَذَّ - يَلَذُّ) — wa-, and + ladhdha, to take pleasure (impf. 1cp); 'and we take our pleasure'
وَنَطْرَبُ: وَ + نَطْرَبُ (طَرِبَ - يَطْرَبُ) — wa-, and + ṭariba, to be merry/delighted (impf. 1cp); 'and we make merry'
دَأْبُنَا: دَأْب + نَا — da'b, custom, wont (m.) + nā, our; 'our custom' (archive prints bare alif)
تُخَالِفُنَا: خَالَفَ - يُخَالِفُ (form III of خ-ل-ف) + نَا — khālafa, to go against/contradict + nā, us; 'you go against us'
نَغِيبَ: غَابَ - يَغِيبَ (subjunctive after أَنْ) — ghāba, to be absent (impf. 1cp, subj.); 'that we be absent'
نَأْمُرُكَ: أَمَرَ - يَأْمُرُ (يَأْمُرُ بِـ, 'command [someone] to') + كَ — amara, to command + ka, you; 'we command you' (archive prints bare alif)
نُسَلِّمُ: سَلَّمَ - يُسَلِّمُ (form II of س-ل-م) — sallama, to hand over/deliver (impf. 1cp); 'we hand over'
مَفَاتِيحَ: pl. of مِفْتَاح — miftāḥ, key; 'keys' (acc. object)
وَفِيهِ: وَ + فِي + هِ — wa-, and + fī, in + hi, it; 'and in it'
فَأَنْتَ: فَـ + أَنْتَ — fa-, so + anta, you; 'so you' (archive prints bare alif)
تَفْتَحُ: فَتَحَ - يَفْتَحُ — fataḥa, to open (impf. 2ms, indic.); 'you open'
التِّسْعَةَ: الـ + تِسْعَة — al-, the + tis'ah, nine (acc.)
الْحَذَرَ: الـ + حَذَرَ — al-, the + ḥadhar, caution (acc. of warning/taḥdhīr, an implied verb dropped); 'beware!'
تَفْتَحَ: فَتَحَ - يَفْتَحَ (subjunctive after أَنْ) — fataḥa, to open (impf. 2ms, subj.); 'that you open'
فَتُفَارِقَنَا: فَـ + تُفَارِقَ (فَارَقَ - يُفَارِقُ, form III of ف-ر-ق) + نَا — fa-, so/lest + fāraqa, to part from (subj.) + nā, us; 'lest you part from us'
أَفْتَحُهُ: فَتَحَ - أَفْتَحُ + هُ — fataḥa, to open (impf. 1cs) + hu, it; 'I open it' (archive prints bare alif)
مُفَارَقَتُكُمْ: مُفَارَقَة (masdar of فَارَقَ, form III) + كُمْ — mufāraqah, parting/separation (f.) + kum, your; 'your parting [from you]' (nom., subject of كَانَ)
تَقَدَّمَتْ: تَقَدَّمَ - يَتَقَدَّمُ (form V of ق-د-م) — taqaddama, to come forward (past 3fs); 'she came forward'
وَعَانَقَتْنِي: وَ + عَانَقَتْنِي (عَانَقَ - يُعَانِقُ, form III) — wa-, and + 'ānaqat, she embraced + nī, me; 'and she embraced me'
لَئِنْ: لَـ + إِنْ — la-, indeed (emphatic prefix) + in, if; 'if indeed' (archive already prints the hamza on يا-seat, ئ, kept)
التَّنَائِي: الـ + تَنَائِي (masdar of تَنَاءَى, form VI of ن-أ-ي) — al-, the + tanā'ī, mutual estrangement/remoteness (archive already prints the hamza on yā'-seat, ئ, kept)
تَقَرُّبٌ: masdar of تَقَرَّبَ (form V of ق-ر-ب) — taqarrub, a drawing-near (nom., delayed subject of ضَمَّنَا)
تَبَسَّمَ: تَبَسَّمَ - يَتَبَسَّمُ (form V of ب-س-م) — tabassama, to smile (past 3ms)
قُطُوبِهِ: قُطُوب + هِ — quṭūb, frown, scowl (m.) + hi, its; 'its frown' (referring to Time)
كَحَلَتْ: كَحَلَ - يَكْحُلُ — kaḥala, to apply kohl (to); past 3fs, agreeing in gender only with the following dual subject; 'were kohled/adorned'
بِنَظْرَةٍ: بِـ + نَظْرَة — bi-, with (instrumental prep.) + naẓrah, a glance; 'with a glance'
غَفَرْتُ: غَفَرَ - يَغْفِرُ — ghafara, to forgive (past 1cs); 'I would forgive'
لِدَهْرِي: لِـ + دَهْر + ي — li-, to (prep. marking the indirect object of غَفَرَ لِـ 'forgive [something] to [someone]') + dahr, Time + ī, my; '[to] my Time'
سَالِفَاتِ: pl. of سَالِفَة — sālifah, a past [thing]; 'past [sins]' (acc., idafa)
ذُنُوبِهِ: ذُنُوب + هِ — dhunūb, sins (pl.) + hi, its; 'its sins' (referring to Time)
تَدَانَتْ: تَدَانَى - يَتَدَانَى (form VI of د-ن-و) — tadānā, to draw close/near (past 3fs); 'she drew near'
وَقَلْبُهُمَا: وَ + قَلْب + هُمَا — wa-, and + qalb, heart (m.) + humā, their (dual); 'and their two hearts'
حَلِيفَانِ: dual of حَلِيف — ḥalīf, ally, confederate; 'two allies' (nom. predicate)
لِلصَّبَابَةِ: لِـ + الـ + صَبَابَة — li-, to/for (prep.) + al-, the + ṣabābah, passionate love/yearning; 'to passionate love'
وَالْوَجْدَا: وَ + الـ + وَجْد + ا (poetic alif of prolongation, iṭlāq, for the rhyme) — wa-, and + al-, the + wajd, [passionate] longing; 'and longing'
لُؤْلُؤًا: lu'lu'an, pearls (acc.; archive keeps the first hamza precomposed [ؤ] but prints the second bare, as plain و — supplied here with combining hamza on the wāw-seat)
وَفَاضَتْ: وَ + فَاضَتْ (فَاضَ - يَفِيضُ) — wa-, and + fāḍat, it (f.) overflowed
مَدَامِعِي: pl. of مَدْمَع + ي — madma', a tear (m.) + ī, my; 'my tears' (nom., subject)
نَحْرِهَا: نَحْر + هَا — naḥr, throat/bosom (m.) + hā, her; 'her throat'
وَوَدَّعْتُهَا: وَ + وَدَّعْتُ (وَدَّعَ - يُوَدِّعُ, form II of و-د-ع) + هَا — wa-, and + wadda'a, to bid farewell to + hā, her; 'and I bade her farewell'
وَخَرَجُوا: وَ + خَرَجُوا (خَرَجَ - يَخْرُجُ) — wa-, and + kharajū, they went out
طَارُوا: طَارَ - يَطِيرُ — ṭāra, to fly (past 3mp); 'they flew'
الْمَسَاءُ: الـ + مَسَاء — al-, the + masā', evening (nom.; archive already prints this hamza, kept)
وَدَخَلْتُهَا: وَ + دَخَلْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + dakhaltu, I entered + hā, it; 'and I entered it'
فَوَجِلْتُ: فَـ + وَجِلْتُ — fa-, so + [by its letters, وَجِلَ - يَوْجَلُ, 'to fear']; almost certainly a misprint for فَوَجَدْتُ (وَجَدَ, 'to find'), 'so I found' — the same د/ل substitution as أَرْغَل and وَأَنْشَلَتْ above (contrast the correctly-spelled فَوَجَدْتُ later in this slice)
الْجَنَّةُ: الـ + جَنَّة — al-, the + jannah, Paradise, garden (nom., predicate of كَأَنَّ)
أَشْجَارُهُ: أَشْجَار (pl. of شَجَرَة) + هُ — ashjār, trees + hu, its; 'its trees' (nom.; archive prints bare alif)
مُخْضَرَّةٌ: form IX participle of خ-ض-ر — mukhḍarrah, green (f.)
وَثِمَارُهُ: وَ + ثِمَار (pl. of ثَمَرَة) + هُ — wa-, and + thimār, fruits + hu, its; 'and its fruits'
يَانِعَةٌ: active part. of يَنَعَ — yāni'ah, ripe (f.)
وَأَطْيَارُهُ: وَ + أَطْيَار (pl. of طَائِر) + هُ — wa-, and + aṭyār, birds + hu, its; 'and its birds' (archive prints bare alif)
صَادِحَةٌ: active part. of صَدَحَ — ṣādiḥah, singing, warbling (f.)
وَمِيَاهُهُ: وَ + مِيَاه (pl. of مَاء) + هُ — wa-, and + miyāh, waters + hu, its; 'and its waters'
مُتَدَفِّقَةٌ: form V participle of د-ف-ق — mutadaffiqah, flowing, gushing (f.)
فَارْتَاحَ: فَـ + اِرْتَاحَ (form VIII of ر-و-ح) — fa-, so + irtāḥa, to find rest/ease; 'so it found ease'
وَتَمَشَّيْتُ: وَ + تَمَشَّيْتُ (تَمَشَّى - يَتَمَشَّى, form V of م-ش-ي) — wa-, and + tamashshaytu, I walked about
الْأَشْجَارِ: الـ + أَشْجَار — al-, the + ashjār, trees (gen. after بَيْنَ; archive prints bare alif)
وَشَمَمْتُ: وَ + شَمَمْتُ (شَمَّ - يَشُمُّ) — wa-, and + shamamtu, I smelled
رَوَائِحَ: pl. of رَائِحَة — rā'iḥah, scent (f.); 'scents' (acc.; archive already prints this hamza, kept)
الْأَزْهَارِ: الـ + أَزْهَار (pl. of زَهْرَة) — al-, the + azhār, flowers (gen., idafa; archive prints bare alif)
غِنَاءَ: ghinā', singing (acc.; archive already prints this hamza, kept)
الْأَطْيَارِ: الـ + أَطْيَار — al-, the + aṭyār, birds (gen., idafa; archive prints bare alif)
تُسَبِّحُ: سَبَّحَ - يُسَبِّحُ (form II of س-ب-ح) — sabbaḥa, to glorify
الْوَاحِدَ: الـ + وَاحِد — al-, the + wāḥid, the One (acc., epithet of God)
الْقَهَّارَ: الـ + قَهَّار — al-, the + qahhār, the All-Compelling, All-Dominant (acc., epithet of God)
التُّفَّاحِ: الـ + تُفَّاح — al-, the + tuffāḥ, apples (gen., idafa)
اِحْمِرَارٍ: masdar of اِحْمَرَّ (form IX of ح-م-ر) — iḥmirār, redness, reddening (gen. after بَيْنَ; hamzat waṣl, not a true hamza-consonant, so no combining-hamza mark is used, only the connecting-vowel kasra)
لَوْنَيْنِ: dual of لَوْن — lawn, color; 'two colors' (acc., object)
خِلْقَتُهَا: خِلْقَة + هَا — khilqah, nature, formation, complexion (f.) + hā, its; 'its complexion' (nom., subject)
الْحَبِيبِ: الـ + حَبِيب — al-, the + ḥabīb, beloved (gen.)
الصَّائِمِ: الـ + صَائِم — al-, the + ṣā'im, the fasting one (gen., idafa; archive already prints this hamza, kept)
السَّفَرْجَلِ: الـ + سَفَرْجَل — al-, the + safarjal, quince (gen. after إِلَى)
وَاسْتَرْوَحْتُ: وَ + اِسْتَرْوَحْتُ (اِسْتَرْوَحَ - يَسْتَرْوِحُ, form X of ر-و-ح) — wa-, and + istarwaḥa, to catch/breathe in the scent of
عَرْفَهُ: عَرْف + هُ — 'arf, fragrance, scent (m.) + hu, its; 'its fragrance'
الْمُزْرِيَ: active part. of أَزْرَى (form IV of ز-ر-ي) — al-muzrī, that which shames/outdoes [by comparison]
بِرَائِحَةِ: بِـ + رَائِحَة — bi-, with (instrumental prep.) + rā'iḥah, scent (f.); 'with the scent of' (archive already prints this hamza, kept)
الْمِسْكِ: الـ + مِسْك — al-, the + misk, musk (gen.)
وَأَخْبَرَ: وَ + أَخْبَرَ (form IV of خ-ب-ر) — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform, tell (archive prints bare alif)
السَّفَرْجَلُ: الـ + سَفَرْجَل — al-, the + safarjal, quince (nom., subject)
لَذَّاتِ: pl. of لَذَّة — ladhdhah, pleasure; 'pleasures of' (acc., idafa)
فَغَدَا: فَـ + غَدَا (غَدَا - يَغْدُو) — fa-, and + ghadā, it became
الْفَوَاكِهِ: الـ + فَوَاكِه (pl. of فَاكِهَة) — al-, the + fawākih, fruits (gen. after عَلَى)
بِالتَّفْضِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + تَفْضِيل — bi-, in (prep.) + al-, the + tafḍīl, excellence, preference (masdar of form II)
مَشْهُورًا: pass. part. of شَهَرَ — mashhūran, renowned (acc., predicate)
كَالرَّاحِ: كَـ + الـ + رَاح — ka-, like (comparative prep.) + al-, the + rāḥ, wine; 'like wine'
وَنَشْرُ: وَ + نَشْر — wa-, and [like, by ellipsis of a further كَـ] + nashr, the diffusion of (nom.)
رَائِحَةً: rā'iḥatan, in scent, fragrance (acc. of specification; archive already prints this hamza, kept)
وَالتِّبْرُ: وَ + الـ + تِبْر — wa-, and [like] + al-, the + tibr, [pure, unminted] gold (nom.)
وَشَكْلُ: وَ + شَكْل — wa-, and [like] + shakl, the shape of (nom., idafa)
الْبَدْرِ: الـ + بَدْر — al-, the + badr, full moon (gen.)
تَنْوِيرًا: masdar of نَوَّرَ (form II) — tanwīran, in radiance, illumination (acc. of specification)
يَرُوقُ: رَاقَ - يَرُوقُ — rāqa, to delight, please
الْعَيْنَ: الـ + عَيْن — al-, the + 'ayn, eye (acc., object)
حُسْنُهُ: حُسْن + هُ — ḥusn, beauty (m.) + hu, its; 'its beauty' (nom., subject)
مَخْلُوقٌ: pass. part. of خَلَقَ — makhlūq, created (nom., adj.)
وَأَغْلَقْتُ: وَ + أَغْلَقْتُ (form IV of غ-ل-ق) — wa-, and + aghlaqtu, I closed, shut (archive prints bare alif)
الْغَدُ: الـ + غَد — al-, the + ghad, the morrow, next day (nom.)
وَنَهْرٌ: وَ + نَهْر — wa-, and + nahr, a river (nom.)
جَارٍ: active part. of جَرَى — jārin, flowing (nom., adj.)
وَأَشْجَارُ: وَ + أَشْجَار — wa-, and + ashjār, trees of (nom., idafa; archive prints bare alif)
الْوَرْدِ: الـ + وَرْد — al-, the + ward, rose(s) (gen., idafa)
وَالْيَاسَمِينِ: وَ + الـ + يَاسَمِين — wa-, and + al-, the + yāsamīn, jasmine (gen.)
وَالْبَرَدَقُوشِ: وَ + الـ + بَرَدَقُوش — wa-, and + al-, the + baradaqūsh, marjoram (gen.; loanword)
وَالنَّسْرِينِ: وَ + الـ + نَسْرِين — wa-, and + al-, the + nasrīn, eglantine, wild rose (gen.)
وَالنَّرْجِسِ: وَ + الـ + نَرْجِس — wa-, and + al-, the + narjis, narcissus (gen.)
وَالْمَنْشُورِ: وَ + الـ + مَنْشُور — wa-, and + al-, the + manshūr, lit. 'the spread-out/published one' (pass. part. of نَشَرَ), gen.; almost certainly a misprint for المَنْثُور (with ث), a garden flower conventionally paired with narcissus — kept as printed
مَفْرُوشَةٌ: pass. part. of فَرَشَ — mafrūshah, spread, strewn, carpeted (f., nom., predicate)
بِحَافَتِهِ: بِـ + حَافَة + هِ — bi-, along (prep.) + ḥāfah, edge, bank (f.) + hi, its; 'along its edge'
وَقَلَّ: وَ + قَلَّ — wa-, and + qalla, to be little, rare; 'and seldom [did]' Also 'to grow little, run short': wa-qalla ṣabrī, 'and my patience ran short'.
هَبَّتِ: هَبَّ - يَهُبُّ — habba, to blow (past 3fs); 'it (the wind) blew'
الرِّيَاحُ: الـ + رِيَاح (pl. of رِيح) — al-, the + riyāḥ, winds (nom., subject)
آخَرُ: آخَر — ākhar, other, another (m.sg. adj., nom.); 'another [manger]' Also standing alone, 'another (man)': faʿala ākharu, 'another did the same'.
اللُّؤْلُؤِ: الـ + لُؤْلُؤ — lu'lu', pearl (m., collective n.); 'pearl' (gen. after مِنَ)
اَلأَبْوَابِ: الـ + أَبْوَاب — bāb, door (m.), pl. أَبْوَاب; 'the doors' (gen., second term of the idafa مُفَتَّحَة الأبواب, 'open as to the doors')
اَلأَبْيَضِ: الـ + أَبْيَض — abyaḍ, white (m.sg. color-adj., pattern أَفْعَل); 'the white [crystal]'
اَلأَحْمَرِ: الـ + أَحْمَر — aḥmar, red (m.sg. color-adj.); 'the red [gold]'
اَلأَشْيَاءِ: الـ + أَشْيَاء — shay', thing, pl. أَشْيَاء; 'the things'
اَلأَمْوَالُ: الـ + أَمْوَال — māl, wealth, property (m.), pl. أَمْوَال; 'the wealth' (subj.)
اَلتَّامُّ: الـ + تَامّ — tāmm, complete, perfect (act. part. of تَمَّ, m.sg. adj.); 'the complete [joy]'
اَلثَّالِثَةِ: الـ + ثَالِثَة — thālith, third (ordinal adj., f.sg.); 'the third [storeroom]'
اَلذَّهَبِ: الـ + ذَهَب — dhahab, gold (m.); 'of the gold'
اَلرَّائِحَةُ: الـ + رَائِحَة — rā'iḥah, scent, smell (act. part. of رَاحَ used as noun, f.); 'that scent' (subj.)
اَلرَّابِعَةِ: الـ + رَابِعَة — rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal adj., f.sg.); 'the fourth [storeroom]'
اَلرَّيَاحِينِ: الـ + رَيَاحِين — rayḥān, sweet basil, fragrant herb (m.), pl. رَيَاحِين; 'the sweet basils' (continuing a list from before this slice)
اَلسَّمَاءِ: الـ + سَمَاء — samā', sky, heaven (f.); 'of the sky' (gen., second term of جَوّ السماء 'the vault of the sky')
اَلسُّرُورُ: الـ + سُرُور — surūr, joy, delight (m.); 'the joy' (subj. of حَصَلَ)
اَلصَّبَاحِ: الـ + صَبَاح — ṣabāḥ, morning (m.); 'the morning' (gen. after إِلَى 'until')
اَلصَّنْدَلِ: الـ + صَنْدَل — ṣandal, sandalwood (m.); 'of the sandalwood'
اَلطِّيبُ: الـ + طِيب — ṭīb, perfume, fragrance (m.); 'that fragrance' (subj. of اِنْتَشَرَ)
اَللَّهِ: اَللَّه — Allāh, God; 'of God' (gen., idafa second term after فَضْل)
اَلنَّفِيسَةِ: الـ + نَفِيسَة — nafīs, precious, valuable (f.sg. adj.); 'the precious [gems]'
اَلَّتِي: اَلَّتِي — allatī, who, which (f.sg. relative pronoun); 'which'
اَلْآنَ: الـ + آن — al-āna, 'now' (fixed adverbial idiom, from آن 'moment, time'); 'now'
اَلْأَبْصَارِ: الـ + أَبْصَار — baṣar, sight, eye, pl. أَبْصَار; 'sight' (gen. after عَنِ, lit. 'from every eye')
اَلْبَيْتِ: الـ + بَيْت — bayt, house, chamber (m.); 'that chamber' (gen. after فِي)
اَلْبِلَارِ: الـ + بِلَار — bilār, crystal, glass (m.; archive's spelling of the usual بِلَّوْر/billawr); 'of crystal'
اَلْخَزَائِنَ: الـ + خَزَائِن — khizānah, storeroom (f.), pl. خَزَائِن; 'the storerooms' (acc. obj.)
اَلْعُودِ: الـ + عُود — ʿūd, aloeswood (m.); 'of the aloeswood'
اَلْفَاخِرَةِ: الـ + فَاخِرَة — fākhir, splendid, costly (act. part. of فَخُرَ, f.sg. adj.); 'the splendid [stones]'
اَلْقَاصِفِ: الـ + قَاصِف — qāṣif, crashing, roaring (act. part. of قَصَفَ, m.sg. adj.); 'the crashing [thunder]'
اَلْمَذْكُورَةِ: الـ + مَذْكُورَة — madhkūr, aforementioned, mentioned (pass. part. of ذَكَرَ, f.sg. adj.); 'the aforementioned [storeroom]'
اَلْمَكَانُ: الـ + مَكَان — makān, place (m.); 'the place' (subj. of تَعَطَّرَ)
اَلْمَكَانِ: الـ + مَكَان — makān, place (m.); 'that place' (gen. after فِي/مِنْ)
اَلْمُثَمَّنَةِ: الـ + مُثَمَّنَة — muthamman, priced, precious (pass. part. of ثَمَّنَ, f.sg. adj.); 'the precious [metals]'
اَلْمُدَّةِ: الـ + مُدَّة — muddah, period, duration (f.); 'this period' (gen. after فِي)
اَلْمُغَرِّدِ: الـ + مُغَرِّد — mugharrid, melodiously singing (act. part. of غَرَّدَ, m.sg. adj.); 'the melodious-singing [dove]'
اَلْمُلَوَّنِ: الـ + مُلَوَّن — mulawwan, colored, many-colored (pass. part. of لَوَّنَ, m.sg. adj.); 'the colored [marble]'
اَلْمُلُوكِ: الـ + مُلُوك — malik, king, pl. مُلُوك; 'kings' (gen. after مِنَ)
اَلْمِقْرَعَةَ: الـ + مِقْرَعَة — miqraʿah, whip, riding-crop (f.); 'the whip' (acc. obj.)
اَلْمِيعَادِ: الـ + مِيعَاد — mīʿād, appointed time, term (m.); 'the appointed term' (gen. after مِنَ)
اَلْهَزَارِ: الـ + هَزَار — hazār, nightingale (m., loanword); 'the nightingale'
اِنْفَرَجَ: اِنْفَرَجَ — Form VII (اِنْفَعَلَ) of ف ر ج, infaraja, to be eased, relieved (3ms past); 'was eased' — printed as its own separate word, the و of وانفرج falling at the end of the previous archive line
أَتَفَرَّجُ: أَتَفَرَّجُ — Form V (أَتَفَعَّلُ) of ف ر ج, atafarraju, I go about, look around, amuse myself (1cs impf.); 'I kept going about'
أَحَسَّ: أَحَسَّ — Form IV (أَفْعَلَ) of ح س س, aḥassa, to feel, perceive (3ms past); 'it felt'
أَحَلُّ: أَحَلّ — elative of حَلَّ 'be lawful, permitted' (pattern أَفْعَل); 'more entitled, more permitted'
أَدْهَمَ: أَدْهَم — adham, jet-black (color-adj., pattern أَفْعَل, acc.); 'jet-black'
أَرْضَهَا: أَرْض + هَا — arḍ, ground, floor (f.) + -hā, its (f.sg. suffix); 'its floor'
أَسْتَرْوِحْ: أَسْتَرْوِحْ — Form X (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) of ر و ح, istarwaḥa, to inhale, enjoy a fragrance (1cs juss. after لَمْ); 'I had [never] smelled'
أَظُنُّ: أَظُنُّ — Form I of ظ ن ن, aẓunnu, I think, suppose (1cs impf.); 'I think'
أَظْلَمَ: أَظْلَمَ — Form IV (أَفْعَلَ) of ظ ل م, aẓlama, to grow dark (3ms past); 'it grows dark'
أَفْتَحَهَا: أَفْتَحَ + هَا — aftaḥa, I open (1cs subj. after بِأَنْ) + -hā, it (f.sg. obj.); 'that I open it'
أَقْفَاصٌ: أَقْفَاص — qafaṣ, cage (m.), pl. أَقْفَاص (indef. nom.); 'cages'
بَابَهَا: بَابَ + هَا — bāb, door (m., acc.) + -hā, its (f.sg.); 'its door'
بَابِهَا: بَابِ + هَا — bāb, door (m., gen. after عَنْ) + -hā, its (f.sg.); 'its door'
بِالرُّخَامِ: بِـ + الـ + رُخَام — bi-, with (prep.) + rukhām, marble (m.); 'with marble'
بِالزَّعْفَرَانِ: بِـ + الـ + زَعْفَرَان — bi-, with (prep.) + zaʿfarān, saffron (m.); 'with saffron'
بِالضَّرْبَةِ: بِـ + الـ + ضَرْبَة — bi-, with (prep., after أَحَسَّ بِـ 'to feel/perceive by means of') + ḍarbah, blow, strike (f.); 'the blow'
بِتِلْكَ: بِـ + تِلْكَ — bi-, with (prep.) + tilka, that (f.sg. demonstrative); 'with that'; also ṣāra bi-, ‘came to be in’: bi-tilka al-ḥālati, ‘in that state’ (Night 110) Also bi- chosen by the verb: aqarra bi-, 'to own to' (aqarra lī bi-tilka al-ṣabiyyati, 'he owned to me about that girl'); imtaḥana bi-, 'to test with'; zawwaja bi-, 'to marry (someone) to' (Night 188).
بِصَوْتٍ: بِـ + صَوْتٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + ṣawt, voice, sound (m., indef.); 'with a voice'
تَتَّقِدُ: تَتَّقِدُ — Form VIII (اِفْتَعَلَ) of و ق د, tattaqidu, to blaze, burn (3fs impf., agreeing with the lamps); 'they blazed'
تَعَطَّرَ: تَعَطَّرَ — Form V (تَفَعَّلَ) of ع ط ر, taʿaṭṭara, to become perfumed (3ms past); 'became perfumed'
تُغَنِّي: تُغَنِّي — Form II (فَعَّلَ) of غ ن ي, tughannī, to sing (3fs impf., agreeing with the birds as a collective); 'singing' Also of a woman singing: kānat tughannī maʿahu, 'she was singing with him'.
تُوجَدُ: تُوجَدُ — Form I passive of و ج د, tūjadu, to be found (3fs impf.); 'are [not] to be found'
جَنَاحَيْنِ: جَنَاحَيْنِ — janāḥ, wing (m.), dual acc. جَنَاحَيْنِ; 'two wings'
جَوَادًا: جَوَادًا — jawād, horse, steed (m., indef. acc.); 'a horse'
جَوِّ: جَوِّ — jaww, air, open expanse (m., idafa first term, gen. after فِي); 'the vault of'
حِينَئِذٍ: حِينَ + إِذٍ — ḥīna'idhin, then, at that time (fixed adverbial compound of ḥīn, 'time' + idh); 'then'
خِزَانَةِ: خِزَانَةِ — khizānah, storeroom (f., indef. gen. after فِي); 'a storeroom'
ذَكِيَّةً: ذَكِيَّةً — dhakiyy, fragrant, sharp-scented (f.sg. adj., indef. acc.); 'fragrant'
سَطْحٍ: سَطْحٍ — saṭḥ, rooftop, surface (m., indef. gen. after عَلَى); 'a rooftop'
شَأْنٍ: شَأْنٍ — sha'n, matter, affair, importance (m., indef. gen. after مِنْ); 'importance, significance'
صَهَلَ: صَهَلَ — Form I of ص ه ل, ṣahala, to neigh (3ms past, of a horse); 'it neighed'
عَرَفِهِمَا: عَرَفِ + هِمَا — ʿaraf, scent, fragrance (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -himā, the two of them (dual); 'the scent of the two of them'
عَصْرِي: عَصْرِ + ي — ʿaṣr, age, era (m.) + -ī, my (1cs); 'my age'
عَظِيمَتَيْنِ: عَظِيمَتَيْنِ — ʿaẓīmah, great (f.sg. adj.), dual acc. عَظِيمَتَيْنِ; 'two great [censers]'
عَنْلَهُمْ: عَنْ + لَ + هُمْ (archive's rasm, as printed) — likely a corruption of عَلَيْهِمْ 'upon them' (parallel to عَلَيَّ 'upon me' below); kept as printed since the letters are not ours to correct; 'upon them'
عَنْلِي: عَنْ + لِي (archive's rasm, as printed) — likely a corruption of عَلَيَّ 'upon me' (cf. the correctly-spelled عَلَيَّ a few lines later, and the parallel عَنْلَهُمْ for عَلَيْهِمْ); kept as printed; 'upon me'
فَاندَهَشَ: فَـ + اِندَهَشَ — fa-, and, so (conj.) + indahasha, Form VIII (اِفْتَعَلَ) of د ه ش, to be astonished (3ms past); 'and so [my mind] was astonished'
فَانْتَشَرَ: فَـ + اِنْتَشَرَ — fa-, and (conj.) + intashara, Form VII (اِنْفَعَلَ) of ن ش ر, to spread, diffuse (3ms past); 'and it spread'
فَأَخْرَجْتُهُ: فَـ + أَخْرَجْتُ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + akhrajtu, Form IV of خ ر ج, I brought out (1cs past) + -hu, it (m.sg.); 'so I brought it out'
فَبَقِيَ: فَـ + بَقِيَ — fa-, and (conj.) + baqiya, Form I of ب ق ي, to remain (3ms past); 'and [my mind] remained'
فَتْحِ: فَتْحِ — fatḥ, opening (verbal noun of فَتَحَ, m., gen. after عَنْ); 'opening'
فَرَفَسْتُهُ: فَـ + رَفَسْتُ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + rafastu, Form I of ر ف س, I kicked (1cs past) + -hu, it (m.sg.); 'so I kicked it'
فَضْلِ: فَضْلِ — faḍl, bounty, grace (m., idafa first term, gen. after مِنْ); 'the bounty of'
قَاعَةً: قَاعَةً — qāʿah, hall, large room (f., indef. acc.); 'a hall'
قَوَّيْتُ: قَوَّيْتُ — Form II (فَعَّلَ) of ق و ي, qawwaytu, I strengthened, fortified (1cs past); 'I fortified'
كَالرَّعْدِ: كَـ + الـ + رَعْد — ka-, like (prep.) + raʿd, thunder (m.); 'like the thunder'
كَسَوَادِ: كَـ + سَوَادِ — ka-, like (prep.) + sawād, blackness (m., gen., idafa first term); 'like the blackness of'
مَشْدُودٌ: مَشْدُودٌ — mashdūd, bound, tethered (pass. part. of شَدَّ, m.sg., indef. nom.); 'tethered'
مَفْرُوشَةً: مَفْرُوشَةً — mafrūsh, spread, paved, carpeted (pass. part. of فَرَشَ, f.sg. indef. acc.); 'spread, paved'
مَقْشُورٌ: مَقْشُورٌ — maqshūr, peeled, husked (pass. part. of قَشَرَ, m.sg. indef. nom.); 'husked'
مَكَانِهِ: مَكَانِ + هِ — makān, place (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -hi, its (m.sg.); 'its place'; here: gen. after fī, -hi, his: fī makānihi, 'in his place'
مَمْلُوَّةٌ: مَمْلُوَّةٌ — mamluww(ah), filled, full (pass. part. of مَلَأَ, f.sg. indef. nom.); the archive prints مملوة, dropping the hamza letter of the expected مملوءة entirely (a Middle Arabic spelling), pointed here to read mamluwwah since no hamza-bearing letter is printed to mark; 'full'
مَنَعُونِي: مَنَعُوا + نِي — manaʿū, Form I of م ن ع, they forbade (3mpl past) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'they forbade me'
مُشْتَغِلًا: مُشْتَغِلًا — mushtaghil, occupied, busied (act. part. of Form VIII اِشْتَغَلَ, م.sg. indef. acc. ḥāl); 'occupied'
مُفَتَّحَةَ: مُفَتَّحَةَ — mufattaḥah, opened, thrown open (pass. part. of فَتَّحَ, Form II, f.sg. acc., idafa first term with الأبواب); 'open as to'
مُلَجَّمٌ: مُلَجَّمٌ — mulajjam, bridled (pass. part. of لَجَّمَ, Form II, m.sg. indef. nom.); 'bridled'
مُمَسَّكٌ: مُمَسَّكٌ — mumassak, musk-scented (pass. part. of مَسَّكَ, Form II, m.sg. indef. nom.); 'musk-scented'
مِبْخَرَتَيْنِ: مِبْخَرَتَيْنِ — mibkharah, censer (f.), dual acc. مِبْخَرَتَيْنِ; 'two censers'
مِعْلَفٌ: مِعْلَفٌ — miʿlaf, manger, trough (m., indef. nom.); 'a manger'
نَشْرُ: نَشْرُ — nashr, spreading, diffusion; fragrance (verbal noun of نَشَرَ, m., idafa first term, nom.); 'the fragrance of'
نُورًا: نُورًا — nūr, light (m., indef. acc. tamyīz/ḥāl); 'with light'
وَالأَحْجَارِ: وَ + الـ + أَحْجَار — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥajar, stone (m.), pl. أَحْجَار (gen.); 'and the stones'
وَالزَّبَرْجَلِ: وَ + الـ + زَبَرْجَل — wa-, and (conj.) + zabarjal, chrysolite, peridot (m.; archive's spelling of the usual زَبَرْجَد/zabarjad, gen.); 'and chrysolite'
وَالزُّمُرُّذِ: وَ + الـ + زُمُرُّذ — wa-, and (conj.) + zumurrudh, emerald (m.; archive's spelling of the usual زُمُرُّد/zumurrud, gen.); 'and emerald'
وَالشُّحْرُورِ: وَ + الـ + شُحْرُور — wa-, and (conj.) + shuḥrūr, blackbird (m., gen.); 'and the blackbird'
وَالنُّوبِيِّ: وَ + الـ + نُوبِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + nūbiyy, Nubian (nisbah adj., m., gen.); 'and the Nubian [dove]'
وَالْجَوَادُ: وَ + الـ + جَوَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + jawād, horse (m., nom.); 'and the horse'
وَالْجَوَاهِرِ: وَ + الـ + جَوَاهِر — wa-, and (conj.) + jawhar, gem, jewel (m.), pl. جَوَاهِر (gen.); 'and the gems'
وَالْعَنْبَرِ: وَ + الـ + عَنْبَر — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿanbar, ambergris (m., gen.); 'and ambergris'
وَالْعُودِ: وَ + الـ + عُود — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿūd, aloeswood (m., gen.); 'and aloeswood'
وَالْقُمْرِيِّ: وَ + الـ + قُمْرِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + qumriyy, turtledove (m., gen.); 'and the turtledove'
وَالْمَعَادِنِ: وَ + الـ + مَعَادِن — wa-, and (conj.) + maʿdin, mineral, metal (m.), pl. مَعَادِن (gen.); 'and metals'
وَالْمُطَوَّقِ: وَ + الـ + مُطَوَّق — wa-, and (conj.) + muṭawwaq, ring-necked, collared (pass. part. of طَوَّقَ, m., gen., used as a bird name, the ring-dove); 'and the ring-dove'
وَالْمُعَسَّلِ: وَ + الـ + مُعَسَّل — wa-, and (conj.) + muʿassal, 'honeyed' [substance] (pass. part. of عَسَّلَ, m., gen.); exact referent uncertain, kept literal; 'and a honeyed [perfume]'
وَالْيَاقُوتِ: وَ + الـ + يَاقُوت — wa-, and (conj.) + yāqūt, ruby, sapphire (m., gen.); 'and ruby'
وَأَضَلَّنِي: وَ + أَضَلَّ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + aḍalla, Form IV of ض ل ل, to lead astray (3ms past) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); 'and led me astray'
وَثَلَٰثُونَ: وَ + ثَلَٰثُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + thalāthūn, thirty (numeral, nom.); archive's defective (alif-less) spelling ثلثون, pointed with a dagger alif; 'and thirty'
وَحَصَلَ: وَ + حَصَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaṣala, Form I of ح ص ل, to come about, result (3ms past); 'and there came about'
وَخَامَرَتْ: وَ + خَامَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + khāmarat, Form III (فَاعَلَ) of خ م ر, to overpower, steal over (3fs past, of the scent overpowering his mind); 'and it overpowered'
وَرَكِبْتُهُ: وَ + رَكِبْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + rakibtu, Form I of ر ك ب, I mounted (1cs past) + -hu, it (m.sg.); 'and I mounted it'
وَزَالَ: وَ + زَالَ — wa-, and (conj.) + zāla, Form I of ز ي ل, to vanish, cease (3ms past); 'and vanished'
وَسَرْجُهُ: وَ + سَرْجُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sarj, saddle (m., nom.) + -hu, its (m.sg.); 'and its saddle'
وَضَرَبْتُهُ: وَ + ضَرَبْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍarabtu, I struck (1cs past) + -hu, it (m.sg.); 'and I struck it'
وَقَنَادِيلَ: وَ + قَنَادِيلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qindīl, lamp (m.), pl. قَنَادِيل (indef. acc.); 'and lamps'
وَقُدَّامَهُ: وَ + قُدَّامَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + quddām, in front of (adv.) + -hu, it (m.sg.); 'and before it'
وَمَشْمُومًا: وَ + مَشْمُومًا — wa-, and (conj.) + mashmūm, something smelled, a perfume (pass. part. of شَمَّ, m.sg. indef. acc.); 'and a scented [thing]'
وَمِعْلَفٌ: وَ + مِعْلَفٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + miʿlaf, manger (m., indef. nom.); 'and a manger'
يَبْرَحْ: يَبْرَحْ — Form I of ب ر ح, yabraḥ, to depart, budge (3ms juss. after لَمْ); 'it did not budge'
يَتَحَرَّكْ: يَتَحَرَّكْ — Form V (تَفَعَّلَ) of ح ر ك, yataḥarrak, to move (3ms juss. after لَمْ); 'it did not move'
يَضُوعُ: يَضُوعُ — Form I of ض و ع, yaḍūʿu, to waft, diffuse (of scent) (3ms impf.); 'wafts'
يُوصَفُ: يُوصَفُ — Form I passive of و ص ف, yūṣafu, to be described (3ms impf.); 'can be described'
ائْتِنِي: اِئْتِ + ـنِي — atā, to come (irreg. imper. m.s. of hamzated hollow I, used transitively) + 1cs obj.; 'bring me!'
احْكُوا: اُحْكُوا — ḥakā, to tell, narrate (imper. m.pl. I); 'tell (ye)!'
الرَّشِيدِ: الـ + رَشِيد — rashīd, rightly-guided (epithet, gen.); part of the name al-Rashīd
الزُّقَاقِ: الـ + زُقَاق — zuqāq, lane, alley (m., gen.)
السَّطْحِ: الـ + سَطْح — saṭḥ, roof, flat rooftop (m., gen.)
السَّفَّاحِ: الـ + سَفَّاح — Saffāḥ, 'the Blood-shedder' (intensive adj./epithet, gen.); laqab of the first Abbasid caliph
السَّلَامَةَ: الـ + سَلَامَة — salāma, safety, soundness (f., acc.)
السَّوَادِ: الـ + سَوَاد — sawād, blackness; black substance, soot (m., gen.)
الْأَسْتَارِ: الـ + أَسْتَار (pl. of سِتْر) — sitr, curtain, veil (m. pl., gen.); printed الاستار, bare alif for the plural's hamza
الْأَمْرُ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., nom.)
الْإِحْسَانِ: الـ + إِحْسَان — iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (verbal noun IV, gen.)
الْعَبَّاسِ: al-ʿAbbās — the caliph's ancestor, eponym of the Abbasid line (proper name, gen.)
الْعُورِ: الـ + عُور (pl. of أَعْوَر) — aʿwar, one-eyed (m. pl., gen.)
الْمَمْلَكَةِ: الـ + مَمْلَكَة — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., gen.)
الْمَنْصُورِ: الـ + مَنْصُور — Manṣūr, 'the Victorious' (pass. part., gen.); epithet al-Manṣūr
الْمَهْدِيِّ: الـ + مَهْدِيّ — mahdī, rightly-guided one (pass. part., gen.); epithet al-Mahdī
الْهَادِي: الـ + هَادِي — hādī, guide, rightly-guiding (act. part., m.); epithet/name al-Hādī
الْهَارُونِ: الـ + هَارُون — Hārūn (proper name, gen.); the caliph's given name, unusually given the article here
الْوَاقِفَيْنِ: الـ + وَاقِفَيْنِ — wāqif, standing (act. part. I, m. dual acc.)
أَخْ: أَخْ — akh, brother; the expected construct forms أَخُو/أَخَا/أَخِي are levelled to invariable أَخْ here — see the note on this sentence
أَرْبَابُ: أَرْبَاب (pl. of رَبّ) — rabb, lord, master (m. pl., nom.); arbāb al-dawla 'the men of state'
أَسْتَمُّ: أَسْتَمُّ — root and form uncertain; printed استم (four letters, ا-س-ت-م) matches no attested root, vocalized only to be pronounceable; sense 'blacken' supplied from context — see note
أَسْلَفْتُمْ: أَسْلَفْتُمْ — aslafa, to do/advance beforehand (verb IV, perf. 2mp)
أَمِيرِ: أَمِيرِ — amīr, commander, prince (m., gen.); amīr al-muʾminīn
أَنْزَلَنِي: أَنْزَلَنِي — anzala, to set/bring down, put up (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.
أُعَرِّفُكُمْ: أُعَرِّفُ + ـكُمْ — ʿarrafa, to make known, inform (verb II, imperf. 1cs) + 2mp obj.; 'I make known to you' (read as II 'inform' rather than I 'know', since an identity is being revealed)
بَاكِيَ: بَاكِيَ — bākī, weeping (act. part. I, m. acc. as ḥāl, construct with الْعَيْنِ)
بَنِى: بَنِي (pl. constr. of اِبْن) — ibn, son (m. sound pl. construct بَنُو/بَنِي, gen.); 'sons of'; printed with alif maqṣūra بنى, a common spelling variant of بني
بِالثَّلٰثَةِ: بِـ + الـ + ثَلٰثَة — bi-, with (prep.) + al- + thalātha, three; '[bring me] the three'
بِذَيْلِهِ: بِـ + ذَيْل + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.) + dhayl, hem, tail, skirt (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'with his hem'
بِلَادِ: بِلَاد (pl. of بَلَد) — balad, land, country (f. pl., gen.); 'the lands of'
تَعْرِفُونَا: تَعْرِفُونَ + ـا — ʿarafa, to know, recognize (verb I, imperf. 2mp) + 1pl obj.; 'you (all) knew us'
تَقَدَّمَتِ: تَقَدَّمَتِ — taqaddama, to come forward, advance (verb V, perf. 3fs)
تُخْبِرُوهُ: تُخْبِرُوا + ـهُ — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imperf. juss. 2mp after لَا) + 3ms obj.
تُعْطُونِي: تُعْطُونَ + ـي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imperf. 2mp) + 1cs obj.
حَائِرَيْنِ: حَائِرَيْنِ — ḥāʾir, bewildered, at a loss (act. part. I, m. dual acc.)
حَزِينَ: حَزِينَ — ḥazīn, sad, sorrowful (adj., m. acc. as ḥāl, construct with الْقَلْبِ)
خَبَرِكُمْ: خَبَر + ـكُمْ — khabar, news, report, story (m., gen.) + 2mp suffix
خَفِيفَةً: خَفِيفَةً — khafīfa, light, at ease, untroubled (f. adj., acc. of state)
سَيِّدَنَا: سَيِّد + ـنَا — sayyid, lord, master (m.) + 1pl suffix
سِيرُوا: سِيرُوا — sāra, to travel, proceed, go (verb I hollow, imper. m.pl.)
شَبَابَ: شَبَاب — shabāb, young men (m. pl./collective, acc. construct)
شَهْرَ: شَهْر — Shahr-, first element of the name Shahrazād where the print splits it (شَهْرَ زَادُ); the first element stays -a and the case is shown on زاد (here vocative, يَا شَهْرَ زَادُ); see زَادُ.; here: object of adraka, 'overtook Shahrazād'; here also shahr, month (m., acc. of time, first term of an iḍāfa): shahra zamānin, 'for a month's time'
صَارُوا: صَارُوا — ṣāra, to become, to end up (being) (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp) Also with an imperfect, 'began to': صَارُوا يَسْأَلُونَهُ 'they began asking him'.
صَبَايَا: صَبَايَا (pl. of صَبِيَّة) — ṣabiyya, young woman (f. pl., acc.)
طَاقَةَ: طَاقَةَ — ṭāqa, a piece, wisp, lump (of something) (f., acc.)
طَرَدُونِي: طَرَدُوا + ـنِي — ṭarada, to drive away, expel (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 1cs obj.
عَفَوْنَا: عَفَوْنَا — ʿafā, to pardon, forgive (verb I, perf. 1pl)
فَامْتَثَلَ: فَـ + اِمْتَثَلَ — imtathala, to comply with, carry out (verb VIII, perf. 3ms)
فَأَجِدُ: فَـ + أَجِدُ — wajada, to find (verb I, imperf. 1cs, historic present)
فَأَدْخَلَ: فَـ + أَدْخَلَ — adkhala, to bring/let in (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
فَحَلَقْتُ: فَـ + حَلَقْتُ — ḥalaqa, to shave (verb I, perf. 1cs)
فَخَرَجُوا: فَـ + خَرَجُوا — kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 3mp)
فَنَهَضَ: فَـ + نَهَضَ — nahaḍa, to rise, get up (verb I, perf. 3ms)
قَالَهَا: قَالَ + ـهَا — qāla (perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'he told it (the story)'
قَلَعَ: قَلَعَ — qalaʿa, to pluck out, tear out (verb I, perf. 3ms)
لَاحَ: لَاحَ — lāḥa, to appear, gleam, shine (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms)
لَصَارَ: لَـ + صَارَ — la-, indeed (emphatic particle, apodosis of law) + ṣāra, to become
لِبَعْضِكُمْ: لِـ + بَعْض + ـكُمْ — li-, to (prep.) + baʿḍ, some, part + 2mp suffix; 'to some of you', i.e. to one another
مَاجَرَى: مَا + جَرَى — mā, what/that which (rel.) + jarā, to happen (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'what had happened/befallen' (idiom: مَا جَرَى عَلَى نَاصِيَتِي, 'what fate had written on my brow'); here: with ʿalā, of what falls on someone (mā jarā ʿalā waladī), and with li- (mā jarā lanā)
مُوسَي: مُوسَى — Mūsā, Moses/Mūsā (proper name, invariable); printed with a dotted yāʾ for the final alif maqṣūra, a common Egyptian typesetting variant
مِثْلَكُمْ: مِثْل + ـكُمْ — mithl, like (m.) + 2mp suffix; 'like you'
نَاصِيَتِي: نَاصِيَة + ـي — nāṣiya, forelock (f.) + 1cs suffix; idiom for one's fortune/fate
نَذْهَبُ: نَذْهَبُ — dhahaba, to go (verb I, imperf. 1pl)
نُؤَرِّخُ: نُؤَرِّخُ — arrakha, to date, put on record (verb II, imperf. 1pl); printed نورخ, bare wāw for the hamza
وَاتَّفَقْنَا: وَ + اِتَّفَقْنَا — ittafaqa, to agree, come to terms (verb VIII, perf. 1pl)
وَالْفَجْرُ: وَ + الْفَجْرُ — wa- (circumstantial 'while') + al-fajr, dawn (m., nom.)
وَالْقَرَنْدَلِيَّةِ: وَ + الْقَرَنْدَلِيَّةِ — wa- + al-qarandaliyya, the qalandars (gen.)
وَالْكَلْبَتَيْنِ: وَ + الْكَلْبَتَيْنِ — wa- + al-kalbatayn, the two she-dogs (f. dual, gen.)
وَاِلْتَفَتَ: وَ + اِلْتَفَتَ — iltafata, to turn (verb VIII, perf. 3ms)
وَأَحْضَرَهُمْ: وَ + أَحْضَرَ + ـهُمْ — aḥḍara, to bring, produce (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.
وَأَحْضِرْهُمْ: وَ + أَحْضِرْ + ـهُمْ — aḥḍara, to bring, produce (verb IV, imper. 2ms) + 3mp obj.
وَأَشْتَهِي: وَ + أَشْتَهِي — ishtahā, to desire, wish for (verb VIII, imperf. 1cs)
وَبَاتُوا: وَ + بَاتُوا — bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow). As imper. 2mp, coordinate with سِيرُوا; as perf. 3mp, 'and they spent the night' (with a participle, 'spent the night doing')
وَتَجْعَلُونِي: وَ + تَجْعَلُونَ + ـي — jaʿala, to make, put, let (verb I, imperf. 2mp) + 1cs obj.
وَحَكَى: وَ + حَكَى — ḥakā, to tell, narrate (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَذَهَبَ: وَ + ذَهَبَ — dhahaba, to go, go away (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَسَيَّلَهَا: وَ + سَيَّلَ + ـهَا — sayyala, to make flow (verb II of hollow سال/سيل, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.
وَطُفْتُ: وَ + طُفْتُ — ṭāfa, to wander, roam (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs)
وَمَسْرُورٍ: وَ + مَسْرُورٍ — wa- + Masrūr (proper name, gen.)
وَنَشَّنِي: وَ + نَشَّ + ـنِي — nashsha, root and sense uncertain (Classical دictionaries know it mainly of water drying up); taken here as 'wiped' from context (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj. — a genuine crux, see note
وَنَصِيحَةً: وَ + نَصِيحَةً — naṣīḥa, counsel, advice (f., acc.)
وَهَبْتُكُمْ: وَهَبْتُ + ـكُمْ — wahaba, to grant, give (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 2mp obj.
يَعْتَرِهِ: يَعْتَرِ + ـهِ — iʿtarā, to befall, come over (verb VIII final-weak, imperf. juss. 3ms after لَمْ) + 3ms obj.
يَنْتَصِحُ: يَنْتَصِحُ — intaṣaḥa, to seek, take counsel (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms)
السَّابِعَةَ: الْـ + سَابِعَة — sābiʿ, seventh (f.), al-, the; accusative, agreeing with the fixed ...ةَ عَشَرَ number; 'the seventh'
هَاتَيْنِ: هَاتَيْنِ — hātayni, these two (f. dual demonstrative, acc./gen.); 'these two'
أَخَوَاتِي: أَخَوَات + ي — akhawāt, sisters (pl. of ukht), -ī, my; nom. predicate of أَنَّ; 'my sisters'
أَخَوَاتٍ: أَخَوَات — akhawāt, sisters (f. pl. of ukht), genitive indef. after the number; 'sisters'
شَقَائِقَ: شَقَائِق — shaqāʾiq, full-sisters, germane (pl. of shaqīqa; here sisters of the same father and mother), acc. indef. (diptote); 'full-sisters'
أُمٍّ: أُمّ — umm, mother (f.), genitive indef. after مِنْ; 'a mother'
وَأَبٍ: وَ + أَب — wa-, and (conj.) + ab, father (m.), genitive indef. after مِنْ; 'and a father'
الْبِنْتَيْنِ: الْـ + بِنْتَيْنِ — bint, girl, daughter (f.), dual (acc./gen.), al-, the; 'the two girls'
الْوَاحِدَةَ: الْـ + وَاحِدَة — wāḥida, one (f.), al-, the; acc. in apposition to الْبِنْتَيْنِ; 'the one'
وَالْأُخْرَى: وَ + الْـ + أُخْرَى — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ukhrā, other (f. of ākhar); 'and the other (one)'
الْخُوشْكَاشَةَ: الْـ + خُوشْكَاشَة — khūshkāsha, apparently a foreign word (perhaps Persian) for a half-sister or the like (uncertain), al-, the; acc. in apposition; 'the khūshkāsha'
وَالِدُنَا: وَالِد + نَا — wālid, father (m.), nom. subject, -nā, our; 'our father'
حِصَّتَهُ: حِصَّة + هُ — ḥiṣṣa, share, portion (f.), acc. object, -hu, his; 'his share'
الْمِيرَاثِ: الْـ + مِيرَاث — mīrāth, inheritance (m.), al-, the; genitive after مِنْ; 'the inheritance'
وَالَّتِي: وَ + الَّتِي — wa-, and (conj.) + allatī, she who, the one who (f. sg. relative pronoun); 'and she who'
خَلَّفَتْ: خَلَّفَ — khallafa, to leave behind (form II, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'she left'
بِنْتٍ: بِنْت — bint, girl, daughter (f.), genitive indef. after كُلُّ; 'girl'
مِيرَاثَهَا: مِيرَاث + هَا — mīrāth, inheritance (m.), acc. object, -hā, her; 'her inheritance'
أَصْغَرَهُمْ: أَصْغَر + هُمْ — aṣghar, smaller, youngest (elative of ṣaghīr, acc. predicate of كُنْتُ), -hum, of them (gen. pron.); 'the youngest of them'
سِنًّا: سِنّ — sinn, age, years (m.), acc. indef. of specification (tamyīz); 'in age'
فَتَجَهَّزُوا: فَ + تَجَهَّزُوا — fa-, so, then (connecting particle) + tajahhazū, tajahhaza, to make oneself ready, get outfitted (form V, perfect 3 m. pl. -ū); 'so they made ready'
وَتَزَوَّجَتْ: وَ + تَزَوَّجَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tazawwajat, tazawwaja, to marry (form V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and she married'
عَمِلَ: عَمِلَ — ʿamila, to do, make (perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he made'
مَتْجَرًا: مَتْجَر — matjar, trade, trading venture, business (m.), acc. indef. object; 'a business'
رَمَوْنِي: رَمَى + نِي — ramā, to throw, cast (perfect 3 m. pl. -aw) + -nī, me (obj. pron.); 'they threw me'
وَضَيَّعَ: وَ + ضَيَّعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍayyaʿa, to lose, waste (form II, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and he wasted'
أَزْوَاجُهُمُ: أَزْوَاج + هُمُ — azwāj, husbands, spouses (pl. of zawj), nom. subject, -humu, their (with mīm-damma before الْ); 'their husbands'
الْمَالَ: الْـ + مَال — māl, money, property (m.), al-, the; acc. object; 'the money'
وَانْكَسَرُوا: وَ + انْكَسَرُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + inkasarū, inkasara, to be broken, go bankrupt (form VII, perfect 3 m. pl. -ū); 'and they were ruined'
وَتَرَكُوهُمْ: وَ + تَرَكُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tarakū, taraka, to leave (perfect 3 m. pl. -ū) + -hum, them (obj. pron.); 'and they left them'
خَمْسِ: خَمْس — khams, five, genitive after بَعْدَ, in construct with سِنِينَ; 'five'
جَاءَتْنِي: جَاءَ + تْ + نِي — jāʾa, to come (perfect 3 f. sg. -at) + -nī, me (obj. pron.); 'she came to me'
شَحَّاذَةٍ: شَحَّاذَة — shaḥḥādha, beggar (f.), genitive indef.; 'a beggar-woman'
مُشَرْمَطَةٌ: مُشَرْمَطَة — musharmaṭa, tattered, in shreds (f. adj., colloquial-looking), nom. indef.; 'tattered'
وَإِزَارٌ: وَ + إِزَار — wa-, and (conj.) + izār, wrap, loincloth (m.), nom. indef.; 'and a wrap'
أَنْجَسِ: أَنْجَس — anjas, filthiest, most unclean (elative of najis), genitive in construct with الْأَحْوَالِ; 'the filthiest of'
ذَهَلْتُ: ذَهَلَ — dhahila, to be bewildered, stunned (perfect 1 sg. -tu); 'I was bewildered'
عَرَفْتُهَا: عَرَفَ + تُ + هَا — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (perfect 1 sg. -tu) + -hā, her; 'I knew her'
أُخْتَنَا: أُخْت + نَا — ukht, sister (f.), acc. after يَا (annexed), -nā, our; 'our sister'
الْكَلَامُ: الْـ + كَلَام — kalām, speech, talk (m.), al-, the; nom. subject; 'the talk'
يُفِيدُ: أَفَادَ — afāda, to benefit, be of use (form IV, imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'it avails'
الْقَلَمُ: الْـ + قَلَم — qalam, pen (m.), al-, the; nom. subject; 'the pen'
فَأَرْسَلْتُهَا: فَ + أَرْسَلْتُ + هَا — fa-, so, then (connecting particle) + arsaltu, arsala, to send (form IV, perfect 1 sg. -tu) + -hā, her; 'so I sent her'
وَأَلْبَسْنَاهَا: وَ + أَلْبَسْنَا + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + albasnā, albasa, to clothe (form IV, perfect 1 pl. -nā) + -hā, her (first object); 'and we clothed her'
عِوَضُ: عِوَض — ʿiwaḍ, replacement, substitute (m.), nom. predicate, construct with أَبِي; 'replacement of'
وَأُمِّي: وَ + أُمّ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + umm, mother (f.), -ī, my; 'and my mother'
وَالْإِرْثُ: وَ + الْـ + إِرْث — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + irth, inheritance (m.); nom., topic of the clause; 'and the inheritance'
نَابَنِي: نَابَ + نِي — nāba, to fall to one's lot, befall (perfect 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me (obj. pron.); 'it fell to me'
الْبَرَكَةَ: الْـ + بَرَكَة — baraka, blessing (f.), al-, the; acc. object; 'the blessing'
أُزَكِّي: زَكَّى — zakkā, to give zakāt, pay the alms-tax (form II, imperfect 1 sg.); 'I pay zakāt'
وَأَحْوَالِي: وَ + أَحْوَال + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥwāl, circumstances (pl. of ḥāl), -ī, my; 'and my circumstances'
جَلِيلَةٌ: جَلِيلَة — jalīla, grand, ample (f. adj.), nom. predicate; 'grand'
سَوَاءٌ: سَوَاء — sawāʾ, equal, alike (adj./noun), nom. predicate; 'alike'
وَأَحْسَنْتُ: وَ + أَحْسَنْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥsantu, aḥsana, to do good, be kind (form IV, perfect 1 sg. -tu); 'and I was kind'
خَاطِرُنَا: خَاطِر + نَا — khāṭir, mind, thought (m.), nom. subject, -nā, our; 'our mind'
أُخْتِنَا: أُخْت + نَا — ukht, sister (f.), genitive after عَلَى, -nā, our; 'our sister'
بِزِيٍّ: بِـ + زِيّ — bi-, in, with (prep.; here 'in the garb of') + ziyy, garb, dress (m.); 'in a garb'
الْأُخْتُ: الْـ + أُخْت — al-, the + ukht, sister (f.); nom. subject; 'the sister'
فَعَمِلْتُ: فَ + عَمِلْتُ — fa-, so, then (connecting particle) + ʿamiltu, ʿamila, to do (perfect 1 sg. -tu); 'so I did'
إِنَّهُمَا: إِنَّ + هُمَا — inna, indeed (emphatic particle, governs acc.) + -humā, they two (dual pron. as its subject); 'indeed the two of them'
أُخْتَاهُ: أُخْت + ا + هُ — ukht, sister (f.), -ā, lengthening of the call 'O my sister!' + -h, pausal ending; 'O my sister!'
نُرِيدُ: أَرَادَ — arāda, to want, wish (form IV, imperfect 1 pl. nu-); 'we want'
الزَّوَاجَ: الْـ + زَوَاج — zawāj, marriage (m.), al-, the; acc. object; 'marriage' Also acc. as the noun of anna/inna: inna al-zawāja shayʾun lā afʿaluhu, 'marriage is a thing I will not do'.
الْقُعُودِ: الْـ + قُعُود — quʿūd, sitting, staying (m. verbal noun), al-, the; genitive after عَلَى; 'the sitting'
زَوْجٍ: زَوْج — zawj, husband, spouse (m.), genitive indef. after بِلَا; 'a husband'
عُيُونِي: عُيُون + ي — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn), -ī, my; 'my eyes', term of endearment
ازْدِوَاجٍ: ازْدِوَاج — izdiwāj, marriage, pairing (m. verbal noun of form VIII), genitive indef. after فِي; 'marriage'
الْجَمِيلُ: الْـ + جَمِيل — jamīl, fine, good (adj.), al-, the; nom., describing الرَّجُلُ; 'the fine'
عَزِيزُ: عَزِيز — ʿazīz, dear, rare (adj.), nom. predicate, construct with الْوُجُودِ; 'dear (rare) of'
أَرَ: رَأَى — raʾā, to see (imperfect 1 sg. jussive after لَمْ, apocopated; the edition prints أَرَ); 'I see'
ذَكَرْتُمْ: ذَكَرَ + تُمْ — dhakara, to mention (perfect 2 m. pl. -tum); 'you mentioned'
صَلَاحًا: صَلَاح — ṣalāḥ, goodness, soundness (m.), acc. indef. object; 'goodness'
جَرَّبْتُمُ: جَرَّبَ + تُمُ — jarraba, to try, experience (form II, perfect 2 m. pl. -tum, with mīm-damma before الْ); 'you tried'
يَتَقَبَّلُوا: yataqabbalū, they accept (V, jussive after لَمْ, plural ending without ن); root ق-ب-ل, taqabbala 'accept, receive'
وَتَزَوَّجُوا: وَ + تَزَوَّجُوا — wa-, and (conj.); tazawwajū, they married (V, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'and they married'
رِضَائِي: riḍāʾ + ـِي — riḍāʾ, consent, satisfaction (m.; gen. as annexed to غَيْر); ـِي my; 'my consent'
فَجَهَّزْتُهُمْ: فَ + جَهَّزْتُ + هُمْ — fa-, so (conj.); jahhaza, equip, fit out (II), ـتُ I; ـهُمْ them; 'so I equipped them'
وَسَتَرْتُهُمْ: وَ + سَتَرْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); satara, cover, shelter (I), ـتُ I; ـهُمْ them; 'and I covered/sheltered them'
وَمَضَوْا: وَ + مَضَوْا — wa-, and (conj.); maḍā, go off, depart (I, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'and they went off'
أَزْوَاجِهِمْ: أَزْوَاجِ + هِمْ — azwāj, husbands, spouses (pl. of zawj; gen. after مَعَ); ـهِمْ their; 'their husbands'
فَقَعَدُوا: فَ + قَعَدُوا — fa-, then (conj.); qaʿada, sit, stay (I, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'then they stayed'
يَسِيرَةً: yasīra, small, short (f. adj. of yasīr; acc. agreeing with مُدَّةً); 'a short (while)'
وَلَعِبُوا: وَ + لَعِبُوا — wa-, and (conj.); laʿiba, play (I, perfect 3 m.pl.; with عَلَى 'play upon, trick'); 'and they tricked' Also without ʿalā, to play, make merry: 'and they made merry'.
أَزْوَاجُهُمْ: أَزْوَاجُ + هُمْ — azwāj, husbands (pl.; nom., subject following the verb); ـهُمْ their; 'their husbands'
أَخَذُوا: أَخَذُوا — akhadha, take (I, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'they took'
وَسَافَرُوا: وَ + سَافَرُوا — wa-, and (conj.); sāfara, travel (III, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'and they travelled'
خَزَايَا: khazāyā, abashed, ashamed (pl. of khazyān; diptote); 'abashed'
اعْتَذَرُوا: اعْتَذَرُوا — iʿtadhara, make excuse, apologise (VIII, perfect 3 m.pl.); 'they made excuse'
تُؤَاخِذِينَا: تُؤَاخِذِي + نَا — ta-, you (f.sg.) (imperfect prefix); ākhadha, hold to account, blame (III; jussive after لَا 'do not'); -īna, ending of the 2nd-f.sg. before the pronoun; ـنَا us; 'do not blame us'
فَأَنْتِ: فَ + أَنْتِ — fa-, for, since (conj. giving reason); anti, you (f.sg.); 'for you'
أَصْغَرُ: aṣghar, smaller, younger (elative of ṣaghīr; nom., predicate)
وَأَكْمَلُ: وَ + أَكْمَلُ — wa-, and (conj.); akmal, more complete, fuller (elative of kāmil; nom.); 'and more complete'
وَمَابَقِينَا: وَ + مَا + بَقِينَا — wa-, and (conj.); mā, not (negative particle); baqīnā, we remained (I, perfect 1 pl. of baqiya) with a following present verb; printed as one run with no space; 'and we no longer (mention)'
نَذْكُرُ: na-, we (imperfect prefix); dhakara, mention, speak of (I; present, ind.); 'we mention'
زَوَاجَ: zawāj, marriage (m.; acc., written without tanwīn as printed, object of نَذْكُرُ after إِلَّا); 'marriage'
فَاتَّخِذِينَا: فَ + اتَّخِذِي + نَا — fa-, so (conj., leading to a request); ittakhadha, take (as), adopt (VIII; imperative f.sg.) with -ī(na) f.sg. ending; ـنَا us; 'so take us'
جَوَارِيَ: jawārī, slave-girls, handmaids (pl. of jāriya; acc., second object of اتَّخِذِينَا; diptote); 'as slave-girls'
عِنْدَكِ: عِنْدَ + كِ — ʿinda, at, with (prep.) + ـكِ you (f.sg.); 'with you; in your keeping'
لُقْمَتَنَا: luqma + نَا — luqma, morsel, bite (f.; acc., object of نَأْكُلُ); ـنَا our; 'our morsel'
وَقَبِلْتُهُمْ: وَ + قَبِلْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); qabila, accept, receive (I), ـتُ I; ـهُمْ them (masc. for the sisters); 'and I received them'
وَزِدْتُهُمْ: وَ + زِدْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); zāda, increase (I; takes two objects), ـتُ I; ـهُمْ them; 'and I increased them'
إِكْرَامًا: ikrām, honour, generous treatment (m.; acc. tanwīn, second object); 'in honour'
نَزَلْ: na-, we; zāla, cease (I; jussive after لَمْ; with a following phrase 'go on being'); 'we did not cease'
أُجَهِّزَ: u-, I (imperfect prefix); jahhaza, equip, fit out (II; subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that I equip'
الْبَصْرَةِ: الْـ + بَصْرَة — al-, the (definite article, part of the name); Baṣra, the city of Basra (f.; gen. after إِلَى); 'to Basra'
فَجَهَّزْتُ: فَ + جَهَّزْتُ — fa-, so (conj.); jahhaza, equip (II), ـتُ I; 'so I equipped'
وَحَمَلْتُ: وَ + حَمَلْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥamala, load, carry (I), ـتُ I; 'and I loaded'
وَالْمَتَاجِرَ: وَ + الْـ + مَتَاجِر — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; matājir, trade-goods, merchandise (pl. of matjar; acc.); 'and the merchandise'
نَحْتَاجُ: na-, we (imperfect prefix); iḥtāja, need (VIII; with إِلَى); 'we need'
تَقْعُدُوا: ta-, you (imperfect prefix); qaʿada, sit, stay (I; subjunctive after أَنْ, pl.); 'you stay'
أُسَافِرَ: u-, I (imperfect prefix); sāfara, travel (III; subjunctive after حَتَّى); 'I travel'
وَأَرْجِعَ: وَ + أَرْجِعَ — wa-, and (conj.); arjiʿa, I return (I; subjunctive, continuing حَتَّى); 'and I return' Also subjunctive continuing an: أَنْ أَتَّصِلَ تِلْكَ النَّاحِيَةَ وَأَرْجِعَ 'to go over to that quarter and come back'.
تَأْنُوا: ta-, you (imperfect prefix); printed root أ-ن-ي/ن (subjunctive pl.); very likely a slip for تَأْتُوا, 'you come'; read as printed it would be from أَنَى 'be slow, be patient'; here 'you come'
نُسَافِرُ: nu-, we (imperfect prefix); sāfara, travel (III; present ind.); 'we travel'
فَإِنَّا: فَ + إِنَّ + نَا — fa-, for, since (conj. giving reason); inna, indeed (particle; introduces a noun clause) + ـنَا we; 'for we'
نُطِيقُ: nu-, we (imperfect prefix); āqa (aṭāqa), be able to bear, endure (IV; present ind.); 'we bear'
فِرَاقَكَ: فِرَاق + كَ — firāq, separation, parting (m.; acc., object); ـكَ your; 'your separation'
فَأَخَذْتُهُمَا: فَ + أَخَذْتُ + هُمَا — fa-, so (conj.); akhadha, take (I), ـتُ I; ـهُمَا the two of them (dual); 'so I took the two of them'
قَسَمْتُ: qasama, divide (I), ـتُ I; 'I divided' (after كُنْتُ, pluperfect 'I had divided')
النِّصْفَ: الْـ + نِصْف — al-, the (definite article); niṣf, half (acc., object); 'the half'
وَالنِّصْفُ: وَ + الْـ + نِصْف — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; niṣf, half (nom., topic); 'and the half'
أَوْدَعْتُهُ: أَوْدَعْتُ + هُ — awdaʿa, deposit, leave in trust (IV), ـتُ I; ـهُ it (resuming the topic); 'I deposited it'
رُبَّمَا: rubbamā, perhaps, it may be that (particle rubba + mā, before a verb)
يُصِيبُ: yu-, it (imperfect prefix); aṣāba, befall, strike (IV; present ind.); 'befalls'
الْعُمْرِ: الْـ + عُمْر — al-, the (definite article); ʿumr, life, lifespan (m.; gen. after فِى); 'the life' Also after ʿalā, 'over': ʿalā al-ʿumri yanqaḍī, 'over life passing away'. Also 'age, years of life': ṣāra lahu mina al-ʿumri khamsa ʿashrata sanatan, 'he reached the age of fifteen'.
مُدَّةٌ: mudda, a span, time (f.; nom. tanwīn, subject of يَكُونُ); 'a span (of time)'
نَجِدُ: na-, we (imperfect prefix); wajada, find (I; present ind.); 'we find'
يَنْفَعُنَا: يَنْفَعُ + نَا — ya-, it (imperfect prefix); nafaʿa, benefit, avail (I; present ind.; describes شَيْئًا); ـنَا us; 'that benefits us'
تَلَاطَمَتْ: talāṭama, dash together, be tossed (VI; perfect 3 f.sg. ـتْ); 'it was tossed'
غَفَلَ: غَفَلَ — ghafala, be heedless, lose track (I, perfect 3 m.sg.; with عَنْ); '... lost heed'
الرَّئِيسُ: الْـ + رَئِيس — al-, the (definite article); raʾīs, captain, chief (m.; nom.); 'the captain'
بَحْرًا: baḥr, sea (m.; acc. tanwīn, object); 'a sea'
نُرِيدُ؛: nu-, we (imperfect prefix); arāda, want, intend (IV; present ind.); 'we want'
نَعْلَمْ: na-, we (imperfect prefix); ʿalima, know (I; jussive after لَمْ); 'we know'
وَطَابَتْ: وَ + طَابَتْ — wa-, and (conj.); ṭāba, be good, pleasant (I, perfect 3 f.sg. ـتْ); 'and it was good'
النَّاطُورُ: الْـ + نَاطُور — al-, the (definite article); nāṭūr, lookout, watchman (m.; nom.); 'the lookout'
الْبِشَارَةَ: الْـ + بِشَارَة — al-, the (definite article); bishāra, glad tidings (f.; acc., an exclamation with omitted verb); 'the glad tidings!'
الْحَمَامَةِ: الْـ + حَمَامَة — al-, the (definite article); ḥamāma, dove, pigeon (f.; gen. as annexed to مِثْلُ); 'the dove'
لَاحَتْ: lāḥa, appear, come into view (I, perfect 3 f.sg. ـتْ); 'appeared'
بُعْدٍ: bu'd, distance (m.; gen. tanwīn after عَلَى); 'a distance'
لِلرَّئِيسِ: لِـ + الْـ + رَئِيس — li-, to (prep.; the person spoken to) + al-, the (definite article; the lām assimilates to the ر: لِلرَّئِيسِ); raʾīs, captain (gen.); 'to the captain'
أَشْرَفْنَا: ashrafa, overlook, come in sight of (IV; with عَلَى), ـنَا we; 'we came upon'
رَأَيْتُهَا: رَأَيْتُ + هَا — raʾā, see (I), ـتُ I; ـهَا it (f., the city); 'I saw it' (printed with أ) Also with -hā for a woman: لَمَّا رَأَيْتُهَا 'when I saw her'.
سَلَكْتُ: salaka, travel along, traverse (I), ـتُ I; 'I sailed/travelled'
بِسَلَامَةٍ: بِـ + سَلَامَة — bi-, with (prep.; manner, 'in the state of') + salāma, safety (f.; gen. tanwīn); 'with safety'
تَدْخُلُوا: ta-, you (imperfect prefix); dakhala, enter (I; subjunctive after أَنْ, pl.); 'you enter'
وَانْظُرُوا: وَ + انْظُرُوا — wa-, and (conj.); unẓur, look at, see to (I; imperative m.pl.); 'and see to'
بَضَائِعَكُمْ: بَضَائِع + كُمْ — baḍāʾiʿ, wares, goods (pl.; acc., object); ـكُمْ your; 'your wares'
بَيْعٌ: bayʿ, sale, selling (m.; nom. tanwīn, subject); 'a sale'
بِيعُوا: bīʿū, sell (I, imperative m.pl. of bāʿa); 'sell'
وَتَسَوَّقُوا: وَ + تَسَوَّقُوا — wa-, and (conj.); tasawwaqa, trade, do business, buy and sell (V; imperative m.pl.); 'and trade'
يَحْصُلْ: ya-, it (imperfect prefix); ḥaṣala, come about (I; jussive after لَمْ); 'comes about'
نَرْتَاحُ: na-, we (imperfect prefix); irtāḥa, rest, take ease (VIII; present ind., the result clause); 'we rest'
وَنَتَزَوَّدُ: وَ + نَتَزَوَّدُ — wa-, and (conj.); na-, we; tazawwada, take provisions (V; present ind.); 'and we take provisions'
وَنُسَافِرُ: وَ + نُسَافِرُ — wa-, and (conj.); nu-, we; sāfara, travel (III; present ind.); 'and we travel'
وَأتَى: وَ + أَتَى — atā, to come (perfect 3 m.s.); wa-, and (conj.): 'and (he) came'
إلَيْنَا: إِلَى + نَا — ilā, to (prep.); -nā, us: 'to us'
قُومُوا: qāma, to rise, stand up (imperative m. pl.); 'rise!'
اُطْلُعُوا: ṭalaʿa, to go up, ascend (imperative m. pl.); 'go up!'
إلَى: ilā, to, towards (prep.; governs the genitive)
وَتَعَجَّبُوا: وَ + تَعَجَّبُوا — wa-, and (conj.); taʿajjaba, to marvel (imperative m. pl., form V): 'and marvel!'
صُنْعِ: ṣunʿ, making, workmanship (m.); genitive after فِي, and first term of an annexation: 'the making of'
خَلْقِهِ: خَلْق + هِ — khalq, creation, created things (m.), genitive after فِي; -hi, his (pron.): 'His creation'
وَاسْتَعِيذُوا: وَ + اسْتَعِيذُوا — wa-, and (conj.); istaʿādha, to seek refuge (imperative m. pl., form X; takes مِنْ for what one flees): 'and seek refuge!'
سَخَطِهِ: سَخَط + هِ — sakhaṭ, wrath, displeasure (m.), genitive after مِنْ; -hi, his: 'from His wrath'
فَطَلَعْنَا: فَ + طَلَعْنَا — fa-, so, then (conj. of sequence); ṭalaʿa, to go up (perfect 1 pl.; -nā, we): 'so we went up'
أتَيْتُ: atā, to come to, reach (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I; takes its object directly); 'I came to'
أنَاسًا: unās, people, folk (m. pl., collective); accusative, object of رَأَيْتُ: 'people'
بِأَيْدِيهِمْ: بِـ + أَيْدِي + هِمْ — bi-, with, in (prep.: 'in/with'; here in the idiom 'in their hands' = 'they held'); ayd, plural of yad, hand (f.); -him, their: 'in their hands' Also bi- of instrument after ashāra, 'to point': ashārū bi-aydīhim, 'they pointed with their hands'.
عِصِيٌّ: ʿiṣiyy, staves, sticks (pl. of ʿaṣā, f.); nominative indefinite, subject of the nominal sentence whose predicate is 'in their hands': 'staves'
فَدَنَوْتُ: فَ + دَنَوْتُ — fa-, so (conj. of sequence); danā, to draw near (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I): 'so I drew near'
وَإذَا: وَ + إِذَا — wa-, and (conj.); idhā, behold, lo (particle of surprise marking what is suddenly found): 'and behold'
مَسْخُوطِينَ: maskhūṭ, cursed, smitten with wrath (passive participle of sakhiṭa, m. pl. oblique -īna as printed, where the Classical predicate after إِذَا هُمْ would be nominative -ūna): 'cursed ones'
أَحْجَارًا: aḥjār, stones (pl. of ḥajar, m.); accusative as the second predicate of صَارَ: 'stones'
مَسْخُوطًا: maskhūṭ, cursed (passive participle of sakhiṭa, m. s.); accusative as the object's complement ('found him cursed'): 'cursed'
دِيَارٌ: diyār, dweller, inhabitant of a dwelling (m., from dār, house; nominative indefinite after لَا): 'a dweller'
نَافِخُ: nāfikh, blower (active participle of nafakha, to blow, m.); first term of an annexation with نَار: 'a blower of'
فَانْدَهَشْنَا: فَ + انْدَهَشْنَا — fa-, so (conj.); indahasha, to be astounded (perfect 1 pl., form VII; -nā, we): 'so we were astounded'
فَشَقَقْنَا: فَ + شَقَقْنَا — fa-, so (conj.); shaqqa, to cleave, pass through (perfect 1 pl.; the doubled qāf is undone before -nā): 'so we passed through'
الْأَسْوَاقَ: الْـ + أَسْوَاق — al-, the; aswāq, markets (pl. of sūq, m.); accusative object: 'the markets'
بَاقِيَةً: bāqiya, remaining, still there (active participle of baqiya, f. s.); accusative as the object's complement: 'remaining'
الذَّهَبَ: الْـ + ذَهَب — al-, the; dhahab, gold (m.); accusative, object: 'the gold'
وَالْفِضَّةَ: وَ + الْـ + فِضَّة — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; fiḍḍa, silver (f.); accusative, object: 'and the silver'
حَالِهَا: حَال + هَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m.), genitive after عَلَى; -hā, its/their: 'their state'; also: 'her state', gen. after ʿan (ukhbiruka ʿan ḥālihā, 'I shall tell you about her state'); also after ilā in inṣarafat ilā ḥālihā, 'she went off to her affairs', i.e. 'she went her way'
فَتَعَجَّبْنَا: فَ + تَعَجَّبْنَا — fa-, so (conj.); taʿajjaba, to marvel (perfect 1 pl., form V; -nā, we): 'so we marvelled'
فَتَفَرَّقْنَا: فَ + تَفَرَّقْنَا — fa-, so (conj.); tafarraqa, to scatter, disperse (perfect 1 pl., form V; -nā, we): 'so we scattered'
شَوَارِعِ: shawāriʿ, streets (pl. of shāriʿ, m.); first term of an annexation, genitive after فِي: 'the streets of'
رَفِيقِهِ: رَفِيق + هِ — rafīq, companion (m.), genitive after عَنْ; -hi, his: 'his companion'; also gen. after ʿalā: iltahaba ʿalā rafīqihi, 'burned with desire for his companion' (Night 182)
بِالْكَسْبِ: بِـ + الْـ + كَسْب — bi-, with (prep.; اشْتَغَلَ takes بِـ for what one is busy with: 'busied himself with'); al-, the; kasb, gain, earnings (m.): 'with gain'
وَالْمَالِ: وَ + الْـ + مَال — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; māl, wealth, money (m.), genitive (coordinated with الكسب): 'and money'
الْقَلْعَةِ: الْـ + قَلْعَة — al-, the; qalʿa, citadel, fortress (f.); genitive after إِلَى: 'the citadel' Also gen. as the second term of an iḍāfa: abrāji al-qalʿati, 'the towers of the citadel'.
مُحْكَمَةً: muḥkam, firmly built, strongly made (passive participle of aḥkama, f. s.); accusative as the object's complement: 'strongly built'
الْأَوَانِي: الْـ + أَوَانِي — al-, the; awānī, vessels, utensils (pl. of ināʾ, m.); genitive, second term of the annexation: 'the vessels'
وَعِنْدَهُ: وَ + عِنْدَ + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial conj.: 'while'); ʿinda, at, with (prep.); -hu, him: 'and with him'
حُجَّابُهُ: حُجَّاب + هُ — ḥujjāb, chamberlains, doorkeepers (pl. of ḥājib, m.); nominative (delayed subject); -hu, his: 'his chamberlains'
وَنُوَّابُهُ: وَ + نُوَّاب + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); nuwwāb, deputies, viceroys (pl. of nāʾib, m.); -hu, his: 'and his deputies'
وَوُزَرَاؤُهُ: وَ + وُزَرَاء + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); wuzarāʾ, viziers, ministers (pl. of wazīr, m.); -hu, his: 'and his viziers'
الْمَلَابِسِ: الْـ + مَلَابِس — al-, the; malābis, garments, clothes (pl. of malbas, m.); genitive after مِنْ: 'the garments'
يُحَيِّرُ: ḥayyara, to bewilder, perplex (imperfect 3 m. s., form II, here in a relative clause qualifying 'a thing'): 'bewilders'
الْفِكْرُ: الْـ + فِكْر — al-, the; fikr, thought, mind (m.); nominative subject of يُحَيِّرُ: 'the mind'; in Night 131 'the thought, brooding' (nom., subject)
قَدِمْتُ: qadima, to come (to), arrive (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I; takes إِلَى for the person approached): 'I came'
وَجَدْتُهُ: وَجَدْتُ + هُ — wajada, to find (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I); -hu, him: 'I found him'
مُرَصَّعٍ: muraṣṣaʿ, inlaid, studded (passive participle of raṣṣaʿa, form II, m.); genitive, adjective of كُرْسِيّ: 'inlaid'
بِالدُّرِّ: بِـ + الْـ + دُرّ — bi-, with (prep., instrument/material: 'inlaid with'); al-, the; durr, pearls (m., collective): 'with pearls'
بَدْلَةٌ: badla, suit of clothes, costume (f.); nominative indefinite, delayed subject: 'a suit'
جَوْهَرَةٍ: jawhara, a jewel, gem (f., singular of jawhar); genitive, second term of 'kull': 'jewel'
تُضِيءُ: aḍāʾa, to shine, give light (imperfect 3 f. s., form IV): 'shines'
النَّجْمَةِ: الْـ + نَجْمَة — al-, the; najma, star (f.); genitive after مِثْلَ: 'the star'
وَوَاقِفٌ: وَ + وَاقِف — wa-, and (conj.); wāqif, standing (active participle of waqafa, m. s.; the participle stands before its plural subject): 'and standing'
أَنْوَاعَ: anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of nawʿ, m.); accusative as the participle's object, first term of an annexation: 'kinds of'
أَيْدِيهِمُ: أَيْدِي + هِمُ — ayd, hands (pl. of yad, f.), genitive after فِي; -himu, their (with a helping vowel before the article of the next word): 'their hands'
السُّيُوفُ: الْـ + سُيُوف — al-, the; suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, m.); nominative, subject of the nominal sentence: 'the swords'
مُجَرَّدَةً: mujarrad, drawn, unsheathed (passive participle of jarrada, form II, f. s.; agreeing with the plural non-human 'swords'); accusative, hal: 'drawn'
دَهِشَ: dahisha, to be bewildered (perfect 3 m. s.): 'was dazed'
قَاعَةَ: qāʿa, hall, chamber (f.); accusative, object, and first term of an annexation: 'the hall of'
الْحَرِيمِ: الْـ + حَرِيم — al-, the; ḥarīm, the women's apartments, harem (m.); genitive, second term: 'the harem'
حِيطَانِهَا: حِيطَان + هَا — ḥīṭān, walls (pl. of ḥāʾiṭ, m.), genitive after فِي; -hā, its (the hall's): 'its walls'
سَتَائِرَ: satāʾir, curtains, hangings (pl. of sitr/sātir, diptote); accusative object of وَجَدْتُ: 'curtains'
مَنْقُوشَةً: manqūsh, embroidered, decorated (passive participle of naqasha, f. s.); accusative, hal or adjective of the curtains: 'embroidered'
بِقُضْبَانِ: بِـ + قُضْبَان — bi-, with (prep., instrument: 'embroidered with'); quḍbān, rods, threads (pl. of qaḍīb, m.); first term of an annexation, genitive: 'with rods of'
وَوَجَدْتُ: وَ + وَجَدْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); wajada, to find (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I): 'and I found'
الْمَلِكَةَ: الْـ + مَلِكَة — al-, the; malika, queen (f.); accusative, object: 'the queen'; here: acc. after anna (anna al-malikata Budūra)
الرَّطْبِ: الْـ + رَطْب — al-, the; raṭb, fresh, moist (adjective m.); genitive, qualifying اللؤلؤ: 'the fresh'
رَأْسِهَا: رَأْس + هَا — raʾs, head (m.), genitive after عَلَى; -hā, her: 'her head'
الْفُصُوصِ: الْـ + فُصُوص — al-, the; fuṣūṣ, gems, precious stones (pl. of faṣṣ, m.); genitive, second term: 'the gems'
عُنُقِهَا: عُنُق + هَا — ʿunuq, neck (m.), genitive after فِي; -hā, her: 'her neck'
قَلَائِدُ: qalāʾid, necklaces (pl. of qilāda, f.; diptote); nominative, delayed subject: 'necklaces'
وَعُقُودٌ: وَ + عُقُود — wa-, and (conj.); ʿuqūd, necklaces, strings of beads (pl. of ʿiqd, m.); nominative: 'and collars'
الْمَلْبُوسِ: الْـ + مَلْبُوس — al-, the; malbūs, clothing, what is worn (passive participle of labisa, m.); genitive after مِنْ: 'the clothing'
وَالْمَصَاغِ: وَ + الْـ + مَصَاغ — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; maṣāgh, jewellery, wrought ornaments (m.); genitive: 'and the jewellery'
مَسْخُوطَةٌ: maskhūṭa, cursed, smitten (passive participle of sakhiṭa, f. s.); nominative, predicate: 'cursed'
حَجَرًا: ḥajar, stone (m.); accusative, hal or second predicate: 'a stone'
مَفْتُوحًا: maftūḥ, open, opened (passive participle of fataḥa, m.); accusative, complement: 'open'
فَصَعِدْتُ: فَ + صَعِدْتُ — fa-, so (conj.); ṣaʿida, to climb, go up (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I): 'so I climbed'
إلَيْهِ: إِلَى + هِ — ilā, to (prep.; ilay- before a pronoun); -hi, it: 'to it'
مَكَانٌ: makān, place, spot (m.); nominative, predicate: 'a place'; also nom. as subject: bāna lahumā makānun, 'a place appeared to them' (Night 201)
بِسَبْعِ: بِـ + سَبْع — bi-, with (prep.: 'having, by means of'); sabʿ, seven (f.), first term of an annexation, genitive: 'with seven'
دَرَجٍ: daraj, steps, stairs (pl./collective of daraja, m.); genitive as the counted noun after the numeral (here as printed, unlike Classical which would use a plural of paucity): 'steps'
فَوَجَدْتُهُ: فَ + وَجَدْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.); wajada, to find (perfect 1 s.; -tu, I); -hu, it: 'and I found it'
مَوْضِعٌ: mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m.); nominative as printed (Classical: accusative), second object of وَجَدْتُ: 'a place' Also regular nom., subject of a passive verb: mā yusaddu ʿalayka mawḍiʿun, 'no place is shut against you'.
مُرَخَّمٌ: murakhkham, paved with marble (passive participle of rakhkhama, form II, m.); nominative, adjective: 'marble-paved'
بِالْبُسُطِ: بِـ + الْـ + بُسُط — bi-, with (prep.: 'spread with'); al-, the; busuṭ, carpets, rugs (pl. of bisāṭ, m.): 'with the carpets'
الْمُذَهَّبَةِ: الْـ + مُذَهَّبَة — al-, the; mudhahhaba, gilded, gold-worked (passive participle of dhahhaba, form II, f.); genitive, adjective of البسط: 'the gilded'
سَرِيرًا: sarīr, bed, couch (m.); accusative, object of وَجَدْتُ: 'a bed' Also acc. object of naṣaba, 'to set up': naṣabū … sarīran, 'they set up a bed'.
رُمَّانَيْنِ: رُمَّان + َيْنِ — rummān, pomegranate (m.) with the dual oblique ending -ayni: 'two pomegranates'
الزُّمُرُّدِ: الْـ + زُمُرُّد — al-, the; zumurrud, emerald (m.); genitive after مِنْ (material): 'the emerald'
بَشْخَانَةٌ: bashkhāna, canopy, curtained alcove over a bed (f.; from Persian); nominative indefinite, delayed subject: 'a canopy'
مُرْخِيَةٌ: murkhiya, let down, hanging loose (active participle of arkhā, form IV, f.); nominative, adjective: 'let down'
مَنْظُومَةٌ: manẓūma, strung, threaded (passive participle of naẓama, f.); nominative, adjective: 'strung'
بِاللُّؤْلُؤِ: بِـ + الْـ + لُؤْلُؤ — bi-, with (prep.: 'strung with'); al-, the; luʾluʾ, pearls (m., collective): 'with pearls'
خَارِجًا: khārij, going out, issuing (active participle of kharaja, m.); accusative, complement: 'issuing'
الْبَشْخَانَةِ: الْـ + بَشْخَانَة — al-, the; bashkhāna, canopy (f.); genitive, second term of an annexation: 'the canopy'
جَوْهَرَةً: jawhara, jewel, gem (f.); accusative, object of وَجَدْتُ: 'a jewel'
بَيْضَةِ: bayḍa, egg (f.); first term of an annexation, genitive: 'the egg of'
الْأَوَزَّةِ: الْـ + أَوَزَّة — al-, the; awazza, goose (f.); genitive, second term: 'the goose'
صَغِيرٍ: ṣaghīr, small (adjective m.); genitive, adjective of كُرْسِيّ: 'small' Also of a boat: fī zawraqin ṣaghīrin, 'in a small skiff'.
يُوقِدُ: awqada, to blaze, burn brightly (imperfect 3 m. s., form IV; here intransitive, 'it blazes'): 'blazes'
كَالشَّمْعَةِ: كَـ + الْـ + شَمْعَة — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison; governs the genitive); al-, the; shamʿa, candle (f.): 'like the candle'
وَنُورُهَا: وَ + نُور + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); nūr, light (m.), nominative subject; -hā, its (the jewel's): 'and its light'
سَاطِعٌ: sāṭiʿ, radiant, shining, dazzling (active participle of saṭaʿa, m.); nominative, predicate: 'dazzling'
وَمَفْرُوشٌ: وَ + مَفْرُوش — wa-, and (conj.); mafrūsh, spread out, laid (passive participle of farasha, m.); nominative, fronted predicate: 'and spread'
أَنْوَاعِ: anwāʿ, kinds (pl. of nawʿ, m.); genitive after مِنْ: 'kinds of'
النَّاظِرَ: الْـ + نَاظِر — al-, the; nāẓir, looker, beholder (active participle of naẓara, m.); accusative, object of يُحَيِّرُ: 'the beholder'
شُمُوعًا: shumūʿ, candles (pl. of شَمْعَة), accusative object of رَأَيْتُ; 'candles'
مُوقَدَةً: muqad, lit, kindled (f. sg. passive participle of أَوْقَدَ, IV), agreeing with the plural شُمُوع (fem. sg. as adjective of a non-human plural); 'lit'
أَوْقَدَ: awqada, to kindle, light (IV; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he lit'
غَيْرِهِ: غَيْر + هِ — ghayr, other than (m.; first term of an iḍāfa, genitive) + -hi, his/its (3rd m. sg. suffix); 'other than it', i.e. 'another'
أُفَتِّشُ: fattasha, to search, rummage (II; 1st sg. imperfect); 'I search'
وَأَدُورُ: وَ + أَدُورُ — wa-, and (conj.) + dāra, to go around (1st sg. imperfect); 'and I go about'
الْأَمَاكِنِ: الْـ + أَمَاكِن — al-, the + amākin, places (pl. of مَكَان), genitive after فِي; 'the places'
لَحِقَنِي: لَحِقَ + نِي — laḥiqa, to overtake, befall (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'overtook me'
وَغَرِقْتُ: وَ + غَرِقْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + gharia, to sink, be drowned (1st sg. perfect); 'and I was sunk'
أَعْرِفِ: ʿarafa, to know, recognise (1st sg. jussive after لَمْ; kasra joins the following الْـ); 'I did (not) know'
وَتِهْتُ: وَ + تِهْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tāha, to lose one's way (1st sg. perfect); 'and I lost my way'
الشَّمْعُ: الْـ + شَمْع — al-, the + shamʿ, wax, candles (m. collective), nominative subject; 'the candles'
مَوْقُودٌ: mawqūd, lit (m. sg. passive participle of وَقَدَ); the printed text does not make it agree with a plural subject; 'lit'
وَتَغَطَّيْتُ: وَ + تَغَطَّيْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taghaṭṭā, to cover oneself (V; 1st sg. perfect); 'and I covered myself'
بِلِحَافٍ: بِـ + لِحَاف — bi-, with (prep.: 'with/in') + liḥāf, quilt, coverlet (m.), genitive; 'with a quilt'
الْقُرْآنِ: الْـ + قُرْآن — al-, the + qurʾān, the Qurʾān (m.), genitive after مِنَ or as second term of an iḍāfa; 'the Qurʾān'
النَّوْمَ: الْـ + نَوْم — al-, the + nawm, sleep (m.), accusative object; 'sleep'
أَسْتَطِعْ: istaṭāʿa, to be able (X; 1st sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'I was (not) able'
وَلَحِقَنِي: وَ + لَحِقَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + laḥiqa, to overtake (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (object suffix); 'and it overtook me'
الْقَلَقُ: الْـ + قَلَق — al-, the + qalaq, restlessness, anxiety (m.), nominative subject; 'the restlessness'
انْتَصَفَ: intaṣafa, to reach the middle (VIII; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'reached its middle'
تِلَاوَةَ: tilāwa, recitation (f.; verbal noun of تَلَا), accusative object and first term of an iḍāfa with الْقُرْآن; 'the recitation of'
حَسَنٍ: ḥasan, good, beautiful (m. adj.), genitive agreeing with صَوْتٍ; 'beautiful'
لَكِنَّهُ: لَكِنَّ + هُ — lākinna, but (particle, takes accusative) + -hu, it/he (3rd m. sg. suffix, subject); 'but it'
ضَعِيفُ: ḍaʿīf, weak, faint (m. adj.), predicate and first term of an iḍāfa with الصَّوْت ('faint of voice'); 'faint'
وَتَبِعْتُ: وَ + تَبِعْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tabiʿa, to follow (1st sg. perfect); 'and I followed'
الصَّوْتَ: الْـ + صَوْت — al-, the + ṣawt, sound, voice (m.), accusative object; 'the voice'
مَرْدُودًا: mardūd, pushed to, ajar (m. sg. passive participle of رَدَّ), accusative as a state/second object; 'pushed to'
مَعْبَدٌ: maʿbad, temple, place of worship (m.), nominative predicate; 'a place of worship'
وَمِحْرَابٌ: وَ + مِحْرَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + miḥrāb, prayer niche (m.), nominative; 'and a prayer-niche'
قَنَادِيلُ: qanādīl, lamps (pl. of قِنْدِيل; diptote), nominative, delayed subject; 'lamps'
مُعَلَّقَةٌ: muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (f. sg. passive participle of عَلَّقَ, II), adjective of the plural قَنَادِيل; 'hung'
مَوْقُودَةٌ: mawqūda, lit (f. sg. passive participle of وَقَدَ), adjective of قَنَادِيل; 'lit' Also of a candle: shamʿatun mawqūdatun, 'a lighted candle'.
وَشَمْعَتَانِ: وَ + شَمْعَتَانِ — wa-, and (conj.) + shamʿatān, two candles (dual nom. of شَمْعَة); 'and two candles'
سَجَّادَةٌ: sajjāda, prayer-rug (f.), nominative, delayed subject; 'a prayer-rug'
حَسَنُ: ḥasan, good, beautiful (m. adj.), first term of an iḍāfa with الْمَنْظَر ('fair of appearance'); 'fair'
خَتْمَةٌ: khatma, a complete copy of the Qurʾān (f.), nominative, delayed subject; 'a complete Qurʾān'
مُكَرَّسَةٌ: mukarrasa, uncertain: perhaps 'made up in quires/leaves' (f. sg. passive participle of كَرَّسَ, II, from كُرَّاسَة, quire); adjective of خَتْمَة; 'in quires'
يَقْرَأُ: qaraʾa, to read, recite (3rd m. sg. imperfect); 'he reads'
بَصَرَهُ: بَصَر + هُ — baṣar, sight, gaze (m.), accusative object + -hu, his (3rd m. sg. suffix); 'his gaze'; here: 'his eyes', raised to look
وَرَدَّ: وَ + رَدَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + radda, to return (a greeting) (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and returned'; here: radda jawāban, 'to return an answer', reply
أَسْأَلُكَ: saʾala, to ask (1st sg. imperfect) + -ka, you (2nd m. sg. object suffix); 'I ask you'
تَلَوْتَهُ: تَلَوْتَ + هُ — talā, to recite (2nd m. sg. perfect) + -hu, it (3rd m. sg. object suffix); 'you recited'
كِتَابِ: kitāb, book (m.), genitive after مِنْ, first term of an iḍāfa with الله; 'the book of'
اللهِ: Allāh, God (proper name), genitive (second term of the iḍāfa); 'God'
أَجَبْتَنِي: أَجَبْتَ + نِي — ajāba, to answer (IV; 2nd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'you answer me'
سُؤَالِي: سُؤَال + ـِي — suʾāl, question (m.; verbal noun of سَأَلَ), genitive after عَنْ + -ī, my (1st sg. suffix); 'my question'
وَيَتَبَسَّمُ: وَ + يَتَبَسَّمُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tabassama, to smile (V; 3rd m. sg. imperfect); 'and smiles'
الْأَمَةُ: الْـ + أَمَة — al-, the + ama, slave-girl, handmaid (f.), nominative in the vocative phrase أَيَّتُهَا الْأَمَةُ; 'girl'
أَخْبِرِينِي: أَخْبِرِي + نِي — akhbara, to inform (IV; imperative f. sg. — the ـِي is the fem. ending) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'tell me'
دُخُولِكِ: دُخُول + كِ — dukhūl, entering (m.; verbal noun of دَخَلَ), genitive, first term of an iḍāfa + -ki, your (2nd f. sg. suffix); 'your entering'
أُخْبِرُكِ: أُخْبِرُ + كِ — akhbara, to inform (IV; 1st sg. imperfect) + -ki, you (2nd f. sg. object suffix); 'I will tell you'
خَلَاصِي: خَلَاص + ـِي — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m.) + -ī, my (1st sg. suffix); 'my escape'
بِخَبَرِي: بِـ + خَبَر + ـِي — bi-, of, about (prep.; أَخْبَرَ بِـ 'inform of') + khabar, news, account (m.) + -ī, my (1st sg. suffix); 'of my story'
سَأَلْتُهُ: سَأَلْتُ + هُ — saʾala, to ask (1st sg. perfect) + -hu, him (3rd m. sg. object suffix); 'I asked him'
أَمْهِلِينِي: أَمْهِلِي + نِي — amhala, to give time, let wait (IV; imperative f. sg.) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'give me a moment'
طَبَّقَ: ṭabbaqa, to close (a book), fold shut (II; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he shut'
الْخَتْمَةَ: الْـ + خَتْمَة — al-, the + khatma, the complete Qurʾān copy (f.), accusative object; 'the Qurʾān-copy'
وَشَالَهَا: وَ + شَالَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + shāla, to lift, carry off (colloquial Arabic; 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hā, it (3rd f. sg. object suffix); 'and lifted it'
كِيسِ: kīs, bag, pouch (m.), genitive after فِي, first term of an iḍāfa; 'a bag of'
أَجْلَسَنِي: أَجْلَسَ + نِي — ajlasa, to make sit, seat (IV; 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'he seated me'
لَيِّنُ: layyin, soft, supple (m. adj.), first term of an iḍāfa with الْأَعْطَاف; 'supple'
قَالَبُ: qālab, mould, block (m.; Persian-derived), nominative predicate of كَأَنَّهُ, first term of an iḍāfa with سُكَّر; 'a block of'
مُعْتَدِلُ: muʿtadil, well-proportioned, straight (m. sg. active participle of اِعْتَدَلَ, VIII), first term of an iḍāfa with الْقَوَام; 'well-proportioned'
الْقَوَامِ: الْـ + قَوَام — al-, the + qawām, stature, build (m.), genitive; 'the stature'
الْأَبْيَاتُ: الْـ + أَبْيَات — al-, the + abyāt, verses (pl. of بَيْت), nominative subject (of قِيلَ; of the participle maktūb, 'written were these verses'); 'the verses'
رَصَدَ: raṣada, he kept watch (perf. 3rd m. sg., form I of رَصَدَ) — 'he kept watch'
الْمُنَجِّمُ: الْـ + مُنَجِّم — al-, the (def. article) + munajjim, astrologer (m.; active part. form II of نَجَّمَ, from نَجْم star); 'the astrologer'
فَبَدَا: فَـ + بَدَا — fa-, and so, then (marks what follows) + badā, it appeared (perf. 3rd m. sg. of بَدَا); 'and there appeared'
قَلُّ: قَلُّ — printed قل, read as qaddu, stature, figure (m.; printed ل for د, see note), nom. as subject of بَدَا, first term of the construct قَدُّ الْمَلِيحِ; 'the stature of'
بُرْدَيْهِ: بُرْدَيْهِ = بُرْدَ + يْ + هِ — burd, mantle, striped cloak (m.), dual gen. (-ayn) + -hi, his; 'in his two mantles'
وَأَقَامَهُ: وَ + أَقَامَهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqāma-hu, he set up, raised (perf. 3rd m. sg. of form IV أَقَامَ) + -hu, it/him (3rd m. sg. object); 'and he set it up'
زحلُ: zuḥalu, Saturn (proper name of the planet, m.), nom. as subject, vowel printed in the edition
السوادِ: الْـ + سَوَاد — al-, the + sawād, blackness (m.); gen. as second term of the construct زُحَلُ السَّوَادِ, vowel printed in the edition; 'the blackness'
بِشَعْرِهِ: بِـ + شَعْر + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., marks the instrument) + shaʿr, hair (m.) + -hi, his; 'with his hair'
وَحَبَاهُ: وَ + حَبَاهُ — wa-, and + ḥabā-hu, he endowed, gave (perf. 3rd m. sg. of حَبَا) + -hu, him; 'and he endowed him'
صُدْغَيْهِ: صُدْغَيْهِ = صُدْغَ + يْ + هِ — ṣudgh, temple (of the head; m.), dual gen. after فِي + -hi, his; 'in his two temples'
الْمِرِّيخِ: الْـ + مِرِّيخ — al-, the + Mirrīkh, Mars (m., planet), gen. after مِنَ; 'from Mars'
حُمْرَةُ: ḥumratu, redness (f.), nom. as subject of جَرَى, first term of the construct حُمْرَةُ خَدِّهِ; 'the redness of'
وَالْقَوْسُ: وَ + الْـ + قَوْس — wa-, and (here: while) + al-, the + qaws, bow (m.; also Sagittarius); 'and the Bow'
النَّبْلَ: الْـ + نَبْل — al-, the + nabl, arrows (collective, f./m.), acc. as object; 'the arrows'
جَفْنَيْهِ: جَفْنَيْهِ = جَفْنَ + يْ + هِ — jafn, eyelid (m.), dual gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'from his two eyelids'
وَعُطَارِدُ: وَ + عُطَارِد — wa-, and + ʿUṭārid, Mercury (proper name, m.), nom.; 'and Mercury'
أَعْطَاهُ: أَعْطَاهُ = أَعْطَى + هُ — aʿṭā, he gave (perf. 3rd m. sg., form IV of عَطَا) + -hu, him (3rd m. sg. indirect object); 'he gave him'
فَرْطَ: farṭa, excess, abundance (m.), acc. as direct object, first term of the construct; 'an excess of'
ذَكَائِهِ: ذَكَاءِ + هِ — dhakāʾ, quickness of wit, cleverness (m.), gen. as second term of the construct + -hi, his; 'his cleverness'
وَأَبَى: وَ + أَبَى — wa-, and + abā, he refused (perf. 3rd m. sg. of أَبَى); 'and refused'
السُّهَا: الْـ + سُهَا — al-, the + Suhā, the faint star Alcor in the Great Bear (m.), nom. as subject; 'Suhā'
الْوُشَاةِ: الْـ + وُشَاة — al-, the + wushāt, slanderers, tale-bearers (pl. of وَاشٍ), gen. as second term of the construct; 'the slanderers'
وَالْبَدْرُ: وَ + الْـ + بَدْر — wa-, and + al-, the + badr, full moon (m.), nom.; 'and the full moon'
بَاسَ: bāsa, he kissed (perf. 3rd m. sg. of بَاسَ يَبُوسُ, form I); 'he kissed'
أَلْبَسَهُ: أَلْبَسَهُ = أَلْبَسَ + هُ — albasa, he clothed (perf. 3rd m. sg., form IV of لَبِسَ) + -hu, him (first object); 'he clothed him'
حُلَّةَ: ḥullata, robe, suit of clothes (f.), acc. as second object, first term of the construct; 'a robe of'
الْكَمَالِ: الْـ + كَمَال — al-, the + kamāl, perfection (m.), gen. as second term of the construct; 'of perfection'
وَطَرَّزَهَا: وَ + طَرَّزَ + هَا — wa-, and + ṭarraza, he embroidered (perf. 3rd m. sg., form II of طَرَّزَ) + -hā, it (3rd f. sg., referring to حُلَّة); 'and he embroidered it'
عِذَارِهِ: عِذَارِ + هِ — ʿidhār, the down on the cheek, where the beard begins (m.), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his cheek-down'
بِالْبَهَاءِ: بِـ + الْـ + بَهَاء — bi-, with, by means of (prep., marks what the robe is embroidered with) + al-, the + bahāʾ, radiance, splendour (m.); 'with radiance'
قَسَمًا: qasaman, an oath (m.), acc. indefinite as absolute/adverbial object ('I swear an oath'); 'an oath'
بِنَشْوَةِ: بِـ + نَشْوَة — bi-, by (prep. of oath: 'by …') + nashwa, intoxication, languor (f.), gen.; first term of the construct; 'by the intoxication of'
جَفْنِهِ: جَفْن + هِ — jafn, eyelid (m.), gen. as second term of the construct + -hi, his; 'his eyelid'
وَبِنَصْرِهِ: وَ + بِـ + نَصْر + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + naṣr, victory, help (m.; reading uncertain, see note) + -hi, his; 'and by his victory'
