وَبَاسِمِهِ: وَ + بِـ + بَاسِم + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + bāsim, smiling, one who smiles (act. part. of بَسَمَ), also 'smiling mouth' + -hi, his; 'and by his smiling one'
رَاشَهَا: rāsha-hā, he feathered, fledged (perf. 3rd m. sg. of رَاشَ, said of arrows; reading uncertain) + -hā, it (3rd f. sg.); 'he has feathered it'
وَبِلِينِ: وَ + بِـ + لِين — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + līn, softness, suppleness (m.), gen.; 'and by the softness of'
عِطْفَيْهِ: عِطْفَيْهِ = عِطْفَ + يْ + هِ — ʿiṭf, side, flank (m.), dual gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his two flanks'
وَمُرْهَفِ: وَ + مُرْهَف — wa-, and (governing the oath genitive as if بِـ were repeated) + murhaf, keen, sharp (pass. part. form IV of أَرْهَفَ), gen., first term of the construct; 'and the keen edge of'
لَحْظِهِ: لَحْظِ + هِ — laḥẓ, glance (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his glance'
وَبَيَاضِ: وَ + بَيَاض — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive, as if bi- were repeated; no bi- is written) + bayāḍ, whiteness (m.), gen., first term of the construct; 'and (by) the whiteness of'
غُرَّتِهِ: غُرَّة + هِ — ghurra, forehead, blaze (f.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his forehead'
وَأَسْوَدِ: وَ + أَسْوَد — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + aswad, blackest, black (elative/adj. of سَوَادٌ), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the blackness of'
وَبِحَاجِبٍ: وَ + بِـ + حَاجِب — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ḥājib, eyebrow, brow (m.), gen. indefinite; 'and by a brow'
مَنَعَ: manaʿa, it forbade, prevented (perf. 3rd m. sg. of مَنَعَ), governing two objects; 'it forbade'
الْكَرَي: الْـ + كَرَى — al-, the + karā, sleep, drowsiness (m.), acc. as first object; 'sleep'
وَسَطَا: وَ + سَطَا — wa-, and + saṭā, he assaulted, pounced upon (perf. 3rd m. sg. of سَطَا, takes عَلَى); 'and assaulted'
بِنَهْيِهِ: بِـ + نَهْي + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., marks the means of assault) + nahy, prohibition (m.) + -hi, his; 'with his prohibition'
وَبِأَمْرِهِ: وَ + بِـ + أَمْر + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, with, by means of (prep., as in the preceding word) + amr, command (m.) + -hi, his; 'and with his command'
وَبِوَرْدِ: وَ + بِـ + وَرْد — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ward, roses, rose (m., collective), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and by the rose of'
خَدَّيْهِ: خَدَّيْهِ = خَدَّ + يْ + هِ — khadd, cheek (m.), dual gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his two cheeks'
وَآسِ: وَ + آس — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + ās, myrtle (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the myrtle of'
وَعَقِيقِ: وَ + عَقِيق — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + ʿaqīq, carnelian, red agate (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the carnelian of'
مَبْسَمِهِ: مَبْسَم + هِ — mabsam, mouth, smiling mouth (m.; place of بَسَمَ) , gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his mouth'
وَلُؤْلُؤِ: وَ + لُؤْلُؤ — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + luʾluʾ, pearl(s) (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the pearl of'
ثَغْرِهِ: ثَغْر + هِ — thaghr, front teeth, mouth (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his teeth'; here, after qabbala fī, 'on his mouth'
وَبِجِيدٍ: وَ + بِـ + جِيد — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + jīd, neck (m.), gen. indefinite; 'and by a neck'
وَبِحُسْنِ: وَ + بِـ + حُسْن — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ḥusn, beauty (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and by the beauty of'
قَامَتِهِ: قَامَة + هِ — qāma, stature, height (f.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his stature'
أَطْلَعَتْ: أَطْلَعَتْ = أَطْلَعَ + تْ — aṭlaʿa, he raised, made rise (perf., form IV of طَلَعَ) + -at, she (3rd f. sg. ending; subject التي/قامة); 'she has raised'
رَايَتَهُ: رَايَة + هُ — rāya, banner, standard (f.), acc. as object + -hu, his; 'his banner'
وَبِرِدْفِهِ: وَ + بِـ + رِدْف + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ridf, hindquarters, buttocks (m.) + -hi, his; 'and by his hindquarters'
الرَّجْرَجِ: الْـ + رَجْرَج — al-, the + rajraj, quivering, wobbling (adj., m.; printed without the middle alif), gen. in agreement with رِدْفِهِ; 'the quivering'
حَرَكَاتِهِ: حَرَكَات + هِ — ḥarakāt, movements (f. pl. of حَرَكَة), gen. after فِي + -hi, his; 'his movements'
وَسُكُونِهِ: وَ + سُكُون + هِ — wa-, and + sukūn, stillness, rest (m.) + -hi, his; 'and his stillness'
وَبَرْقِهِ: وَ + بَرْق + هِ — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + barq, gleam, lightning (m.) + -hi, his; 'and his gleam'
خَصْرِهِ: خَصْر + هِ — khaṣr, waist (m.), gen. after فِي + -hi, his; 'his waist'
وَحَرِيرِ: وَ + حَرِير — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + ḥarīr, silk (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the silk of'
مَلْمَسِهِ: مَلْمَس + هِ — malmas, touch, feel (m.) , gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his touch'
وَخِفَّةِ: وَ + خِفَّة — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + khiffa, lightness (f.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the lightness of'
رُوحِهِ: رُوح + هِ — rūḥ, spirit (m./f.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his spirit'
حَوَاهُ: ḥawā-hu, he contained, comprised (perf. 3rd m. sg. of حَوَى) + -hu, it (3rd m. sg. object); 'he holds it'
بِأَسْرِهِ: بِـ + أَسْر + هِ — bi-, in, with (prep.) + asr, totality (m., lit. 'binding') + -hi, its; بِأَسْرِهِ 'in its entirety'
وَبِجُودِ: وَ + بِـ + جُود — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + jūd, generosity (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and by the generosity of'
رَاحَتِهِ: رَاحَة + هِ — rāḥa, palm of the hand (f.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his palm'
وَصِدْقِ: وَ + صِدْق — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + ṣidq, truthfulness (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the truth of'
لِسَانِهِ: لِسَان + هِ — lisān, tongue (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his tongue' Also gen. after min: min ʿathratin min lisānihi, 'from a slip of his tongue'.
وَبِطِيبِ: وَ + بِـ + طِيب — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ṭīb, goodness, excellence (m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and by the goodness of'
مَوْلِدِهِ: مَوْلِد + هِ — mawlid, birth, birthplace (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his birth'
وَعَالِي: وَ + عَالِي — wa-, and (continuing the oath genitive) + ʿālī, high, lofty (act. part. of عَلَا, m.), gen. as first term of the construct; 'and the loftiness of'
قَدْرِهِ: قَدْر + هِ — qadr, rank, worth (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his rank'
الْمِسْكُ: الْـ + مِسْك — al-, the + misk, musk (m.), nom. as subject; 'musk'
عَرَفُوهُ: عَرَفُوا + هُ — ʿarafū, they knew, recognised (perf. 3rd m. pl. of عَرَفَ) + -hu, it/him (3rd m. sg. object); 'they knew it'
إِلَّاعَرْفَهُ: إِلَّا + عَرْف + هُ — illā, except, but (particle of exception; printed joined to the next word, without a space) + ʿarf, fragrance, scent (m.), acc. + -hu, his; 'except his fragrance'
وَالرِّيحُ: وَ + الْـ + رِّيح — wa-, and + al-, the + rīḥ, wind, breeze (f.), nom.; 'and the wind'
عَنْبَرٌ: ʿanbarun, ambergris (m.), nom. indefinite as predicate; 'ambergris'
نَشْرُهَا: نَشْر + هَا — nashr, scent, fragrance (m.), nom. as subject + -hā, its (3rd f. sg., referring to الرِّيح); 'its scent'
نَشْرِهِ: نَشْر + هِ — nashr, scent (m.), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his scent'
الْمُنِيرَةُ: الْـ + مُنِيرَة — al-, the + munīra, shining, luminous (act. part. form IV of أَنَارَ, f.), nom., adjective of الشَّمْس; 'the shining'
حَكَتْهُ: حَكَتْ + هُ — ḥakat, she imitated, resembled (perf. 3rd f. sg. of حَكَى) + -hu, it/him (3rd m. sg. object); 'she has imitated him'
قُلَامَةٌ: qulāmatun, a paring, clipping (f.), nom. indefinite as subject of حَكَتْ; 'a paring'
ظُفْرِهِ: ظُفْر + هِ — ẓufr, fingernail (m.), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his fingernail'
اعْلَمِي: iʿlam-, to know (imperative, wasl alif) + -ī, feminine singular ending, addressing a woman; 'know (f.)'
السَّعَادَةُ: الـ + سَعَادَة — al-, the; saʿāda, happiness, good fortune (f., nom. subject); 'good fortune'
الظَّاهِرِ: الـ + ظَاهِر — al-, the; ẓāhir, the outward, visible (m., gen. after fī); 'the outward'
الْأَمَانَةِ: الْـ + أَمَانَة — al-, the; amāna, trustworthiness, honesty (f., gen. after min); 'the honesty'
الْأَمْرَ: الْـ + أَمْر — al-, the; amr, matter, affair (m., acc. object); 'the matter' Also acc. as the noun of anna: anna hādhā al-amra, 'that this matter'.; also: amr, command, as the noun of inna: al-amra amruki, 'the command is yours' (Night 179)
الْبَاطِنِ: الْـ + بَاطِن — al-, the; bāṭin, the inner, hidden (m., gen. after fī); 'the inward'
الْجَبَّارِ: الْـ + جَبَّار — al-, the; jabbār, the Compeller, the Almighty (m., gen., apposition); 'the Almighty'
الْعَجُوزُ: الْـ + عَجُوز — al-, the; ʿajūz, old woman (f., nom.); 'the old woman'
الْمَلِكَةُ: الْـ + مَلِكَة — al-, the; malika, queen (f., nom.); 'the queen'
الْوُضُوءِ: الْـ + وُضُوء — al-, the; wuḍūʾ, ablution (m., gen. after min); 'the ablution'
اُكْتُمْ: uktum, conceal (imperative m. sg. of katama; wasl alif)
أَحْوَالَ: aḥwāl, conditions, states, ways (plural of ḥāl; acc. object, first term of construct); 'the ways of'
أَخْبِرْنِي: akhbara, to inform (form IV; imperative m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'inform me'
أَعْقَبَتْنِي: aʿqaba, to leave behind as a consequence (form IV, 3rd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'it left me (as sequel)'
أَمَةَ: ama, female slave, maidservant (f., acc. as vocative construct); 'maidservant (of)'
أَهْلِهَا: ahl, people, household (m., gen. as second term) + -hā, her; 'her people'
إِكْرَامِهَا: ikrām, honouring (verbal noun of form IV, m., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'honouring her'
بِخِدْمَتِهِ: بِـ + خِدْمَة + هِ — bi-, to, with (prep.; qāma bi-, 'attend to, see to') + khidma, service (f.) + -hi, his; 'to his service'
بِمَحَبَّتِهِ: بِـ + مَحَبَّة + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; here with taʿallaqa 'cling', the verb chooses it: 'cling to') + maḥabba, love (f.) + -hi, his; 'to love of him'
تَرْبِيَتَهُ: tarbiya, upbringing, rearing (f., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his upbringing'
تَعْبُدِي: ʿabada, to worship (jussive, 2nd f. sg.; the -ī ending addresses a woman, final -na dropped); 'do (f.) worship'
تَمَّمْتُ: tamma, to complete (form II, perfect 1st sg. -tu); 'I completed'
تُؤْمِنُ: āmana, to believe (form IV; imperfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she believes'
تُعْلِمْهُ: aʿlama, to let know, inform (form IV, jussive 2nd m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'inform him'
حَسْرَةٍ: ḥasra, regret, grief (f., gen. as second term of the construct); 'of regret'
خُذِيهِ: akhadha, to take (imperative f. sg.; the ī ending addresses a woman) + -hi, him; 'take him'
دِينَ: dīn, religion (m., acc. object, first term of construct); 'the religion of'
دِينِنَا: dīn, religion (gen. as second term of construct) + -nā, our; 'our religion'
دِينِهِ: dīn, religion (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his religion'
رَبِّيهِ: rabbā, to rear (form II, imperative f. sg.) + -hi, him; 'raise him'
سَأَلْتُكَ: saʾala, to ask (perfect, 1st sg. -tu) + -ka, you (m. sg. object); 'I asked you'
سَبَقَتْ: sabaqa, to go before, precede (perfect, 3rd f. sg. -at); 'it went before'
سَلَّمَنِي: sallama, to hand over, entrust (form II, 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he handed me over'
طَاعِنَةٌ: ṭāʿina, thrusting, piercing (active participle f. of ṭaʿana; with fī al-sinn, 'advanced in years'); 'advanced'
عَلَي: ʿalā, on, upon (prep.; written with ي as printed)
فَأَخَذَتْنِي: فَ + أَخَذَتْ + نِي — fa-, so; akhadha, to take (perfect 3rd f. sg. -at) + -nī, me; 'so she took me'
فَرَبَّانِي: فَ + رَبَّانِي — fa-, and so; rabbā, to bring up, rear (form II, 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and so he raised me'
فَكَتَمْتُهُ: فَ + كَتَمْتُ + هُ — fa-, so; katama, to conceal (perfect 1st sg. -tu) + -hu, it; 'so I concealed it'
كَبِرْتُ: kabira, to grow big, grow up (perfect, 1st sg. -tu); 'I grew up'
كُفْرِهِمْ: kufr, unbelief, infidelity (m., gen. after fī) + -him, their; 'their unbelief'
مَجُوسٌ: majūs, Magians, fire-worshippers (collective, nom. tanwīn, predicate); 'Magians'
مَدِينَةُ: madīna, city (f., nom., first term of construct); 'city (of)'
مُسْلِمَةٌ: muslima, a Muslim woman (f., nom. tanwīn); 'a Muslim'
مُنَادِيًا: munādī, a caller, crier (active participle of form III nādā; acc. tanwīn, object); 'a crier'
نَشَأْتُ: nashaʾa, to grow up (perfect, 1st sg. -tu); 'I grew up'
نَظَرْتِيهَا: naẓara, to see (perfect 2nd f. sg., long -tī as printed) + -hā, her; 'you (f.) saw her'
نَظَرْتِيهِ: naẓara, to look at, see (perfect, 2nd f. sg. -ti with the Middle Arabic long -tī before the suffix) + -hi, him; 'you (f.) saw him'
نَظْرَةً: naẓra, a look, a glance (f., acc. tanwīn; cognate object of 'I looked'); 'a look'
وَالصَّلَوٰةِ: وَ + الـ + صَلَوٰة — wa-, and; al-, the; ṣalāt, prayer (f., dagger alif marks the ā of the defective spelling; gen.); 'and the prayer'
وَالظِّلِّ: وَ + الـ + ظِلّ — wa-, and; al-, the; ẓill, shade (m., gen.); 'and the shade'
وَالنُّورِ: وَ + الـ + نُور — wa-, and; al-, the; nūr, light (m., gen. after bi-, continuing the oath); 'and the light'
وَالْعِفَّةِ: وَ + الْـ + عِفَّة — wa-, and; al-, the; ʿiffa, chastity, continence (f., gen.); 'and the chastity'
وَالْفَلَكِ: وَ + الْـ + فَلَك — wa-, and; al-, the; falak, sphere, heavenly orbit (m., gen.); 'and the sphere'
وَأَحْسِنِي: وَ + أَحْسِنِي — wa-, and; aḥsana, to do well (form IV, imperative f. sg.); 'and do well'
وَتَعَلَّقَ: وَ + تَعَلَّقَ — wa-, and; taʿallaqa, to hang on, cling (form V, 3rd m. sg.); 'and (it) clung'
وَتُوَافِقُ: وَ + تُوَافِقُ — wa-, and; wāfaqa, to agree with (form III, imperfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she agrees with'
وَحَفَّظَتْنِي: وَ + حَفَّظَتْ + نِي — wa-, and; ḥaffaẓa, to make (someone) memorise (form II, 3rd f. sg. -at) + -nī, me; 'and she made me memorise'
وَرُزِقَ: وَ + رُزِقَ — wa-, and; ruziqa, to be provided with, granted (passive, 3rd m. sg.); 'and he was granted'
وَعَلَّمَتْنِي: وَ + عَلَّمَتْ + نِي — wa-, and; ʿallama, to teach (form II, 3rd f. sg. -at) + -nī, me; 'and she taught me'
وَعَلِّمِيهِ: وَ + عَلِّمِي + هِ — wa-, and; ʿallama, to teach (form II, imperative f. sg.) + -hi, him; 'and teach him'
عُتُوِّهِمْ: عُتُوّ + هِمْ — ʿutuww, insolence, arrogance (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'their insolence'
وَغُلُوِّهِمْ: وَ + غُلُوّ + هِمْ — wa-, and; ghuluww, excess, extremism (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'and their excess'
وَقُومِي: وَ + قُومِي — wa-, and; qāma, to stand, attend (imperative f. sg.); 'and attend'
وَيَزِيدُ: وَ + يَزِيدُ — wa-, and; zāda, to increase (imperfect 3rd m. sg.); 'and he increases'
يَدُورُ: dāra, to turn, revolve (imperfect 3rd m. sg.); 'it turns' Also of a person, 'to go round, wander about': lam yazal yadūru min makānin ilā makānin, 'he kept going from place to place'.
يَرَي: raʾā, to see (imperfect 3rd m. sg.; dropped hamza, alif maqsūra written ي as printed); 'he sees'
يَعْبُدُونَ: ʿabada, to worship (imperfect, 3rd m. pl. -ūna); 'they worship'
يَعْتَقِدُ: iʿtaqada, to hold a belief, trust (form VIII, imperfect 3rd m. sg.); 'he believes, trusts'
يَقْتُلَكَ: qatala, to kill (subjunctive after li-allā, 3rd m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'he kill you'
يُقْسِمُونَ: aqsama, to swear an oath (form IV; imperfect 3rd m. pl. -ūna); 'they swear'
يُكْرِمُهَا: akrama, to honour (form IV, imperfect 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'he honours her'
فَرَائِضِ: فَرَائِض — farāʾiḍ, obligations (plural of farīḍa); genitive as second term of construct after الْوُضُوءِ… 'the obligations of'
بِأَ: بِـ + أَ — bi-, at, with (prep., here of the pitch of the voice) + a-; together with the next word the phrase reads bi-aʿlā, 'at the highest of'
عْلَى: ʿlā, the rest of أَعْلَى aʿlā, highest (elative of ʿālin), printed as a separate word; 'the highest'
صَوْتِهِ: صَوْت + هِ — ṣawt, voice (m.), genitive after aʿlā; hi, his; 'his voice'
الرَّعْدِ: الْـ + رَعْد — al-, the + raʿd, thunder (m.), genitive after mithla; 'the thunder'
الْقَاصِفِ: الْـ + قَاصِف — al-, the + qāṣif, crashing, thunderous (active participle of qaṣafa, to break, crash), genitive adjective of al-raʿd; 'the crashing'
سَمِعَهُ: سَمِعَ + هُ — samiʿa, he/it heard (verb) + hu, it (object); 'heard it'
الْقَرِيبُ: الْـ + قَرِيب — al-, the + qarīb, near (adj.), nominative subject; 'the near one'
وَالْبَعِيدُ: وَ + الْـ + بَعِيد — wa-, and + al-, the + baʿīd, far (adj.); 'and the far one'
ارْجِعُوا: rajaʿa, to return; irjiʿū, return! turn back! (imperative, m. pl.); 'turn back'
عِبَادَةِ: ʿibāda, worship (f.), construct, genitive after ʿalā; 'worship of'
وَاعْبُدُوا: وَ + اعْبُدُوا — wa-, and + iʿbudū, worship! (imperative m. pl. of ʿabada); 'and worship'
اللَّٰهَ: Allāh, God, accusative as object of iʿbudū
الرَّحْمَٰنَ: الْـ + رَحْمَٰن — al-, the + raḥmān, merciful (intensive adj., m.), accusative in apposition; 'the Merciful'
فَزَعٌ: fazaʿ, terror, fear (m.), nominative (subject of ḥaṣala); 'a terror'
وَاجْتَمَعُوا: وَ + اجْتَمَعُوا — wa-, and + ijtamaʿū, they gathered (verb VIII, 3rd m. pl. of jamaʿa); 'and they gathered'
الصَّوْتُ: الْـ + صَوْت — al-, the + ṣawt, voice, sound (m.), nominative subject; 'the voice'
الْمُزْعِجُ: الْـ + مُزْعِج — al-, the + muzʿij, disquieting, alarming (active participle IV of azʿaja, to disturb); 'the disquieting'
سَمِعْنَاهُ: سَمِعْ + نَا + هُ — samiʿa, to hear + -nā, we (subject) + hu, it (object); 'we heard it'
فَدَهِشْنَا: فَ + دَهِشْنَا — fa-, so, and so (consequence) + dahisha, to be bewildered, stunned + -nā, we; 'so we were bewildered'
فَزَعِهِ: فَزَع + هِ — fazaʿ, terror (m.), genitive after shiddati + hi, its/his (the voice's); 'its terror'
يَهُولَنَّكُمُ: يَهُولَ + نَّ + كُمُ — yahūla, let it alarm (imperfect of hāla, to alarm, with negative lā) + emphatic nūn (-nna) + kum, you (object, m. pl.; the vowel u before al- is a linking vowel); 'let it not alarm you'
يُخَوِّفْكُمْ: يُخَوِّفْ + كُمْ — yukhawwif, let it frighten (jussive of khawwafa, II, to frighten) + kum, you (m. pl. object); 'let it frighten you'
يَرُدَّكُمْ: يَرُدَّ + كُمْ — yaruddu, let it turn back (jussive of radda, to turn back, repel) + kum, you (m. pl. object); 'let it turn you back'
دِينِكُمْ: دِين + كُمْ — dīn, religion, faith (m.), genitive after ʿan + kum, your (m. pl.); 'your religion'
فَمَالَتْ: فَ + مَالَتْ — fa-, so, then (sequential) + mālat, she/it inclined (verb, 3rd f. sg. of māla, to incline); 'so it inclined'
قُلُوبُهُمْ: قُلُوب + هُمْ — qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb), nominative subject + hum, their; 'their hearts'
قَوْلِ: qawl, saying, word (m.), construct, genitive after ilā; 'the word of'
مُكِبِّينَ: mukibbīn, bent over, devoted (active participle IV of akabba ʿalā, to apply oneself to), accusative pl. as predicate; 'devoted'
طُغْيَانِهِمْ: طُغْيَان + هِمْ — ṭughyān, rebellion, transgression (m.), genitive after fī + him, their; 'their rebellion'
لِمِيعَادِ: لِـ + مِيعَاد — li-, to, for (prep., here 'up to, corresponding to') + mīʿād, appointed time (m.), construct, genitive; 'to the appointed time of'
الْأَوَّلَ: الْـ + أَوَّل — al-, the + awwal, first (adj.), accusative; 'the first'
فَظَهَرَ: فَ + ظَهَرَ — fa-, then, so (sequential) + ẓahara, it appeared, became manifest (verb, 3rd m. sg.); 'so it appeared'
فَسَمِعُوهُ: فَ + سَمِعُوا + هُ — fa-, so, and (sequential) + samiʿū, they heard + hu, it (object); 'and they heard it'
عَاكِفِينَ: ʿākifīn, devoted, clinging (active participle of ʿakafa ʿalā, to devote oneself to), accusative pl. as predicate; 'devoted'
الْمَقْتُ: الْـ + مَقْت — al-, the + maqt, abhorrence, hatred (m.), nominative subject of nazala; 'the abhorrence'
وَالسَّخَطُ: وَ + الْـ + سَخَط — wa-, and + al-, the + sakhaṭ, wrath, displeasure (m.), nominative; 'and the wrath'
طُلُوعِ: ṭulūʿ, rising (m., verbal noun of ṭalaʿa), construct, genitive after baʿda; 'the rising of'
فَسُخِطُوا: فَ + سُخِطُوا — fa-, so, and so (consequence) + sukhiṭū, they were wrathed, were struck with wrath (passive of sakhiṭa, to be angry at; here 'were turned by wrath into'); 'so they were changed'
وَدَوَابَّهُمْ: وَ + دَوَابَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + dawābb, beasts, riding animals (pl. of dābba), accusative + hum, their; 'and their beasts'
وَأَنْعَامَهُمْ: وَ + أَنْعَام + هُمْ — wa-, and + anʿām, cattle, livestock (pl. of naʿam), accusative + hum, their; 'and their cattle'
الْحَرَكَةُ: الْـ + حَرَكَة — al-, the + ḥaraka, movement, commotion (f.), nominative subject; 'the movement, the event'
صَلَٰوةٍ: ṣalāt, prayer (f.), genitive tanwīn after fī (spelt صلوة with waw; dagger alif); 'prayer'
وَصِيَامٍ: وَ + صِيَام — wa-, and + ṣiyām, fasting (m.), genitive; 'and fasting'
تِلَاوَةِ: تِلَاوَة — tilāwa, recitation (f.), construct, genitive; 'recitation of'
قُرْآنٍ: qurʾān, Qurʾān, recitation (m.), genitive tanwīn; 'a Qurʾān'
عِيلَ: ʿīla, it was exhausted (passive of ʿāla, to overburden, exhaust; ʿīla ṣabruhu = 'his patience gave out')
الْوَحْدَةِ: الْـ + وَحْدَة — al-, the + waḥda, aloneness, solitude (f.), genitive after min; 'the aloneness'
يُؤْنِسُنِي: يُؤْنِسُ + نِي — yuʾnisu, he keeps company, cheers (imperfect IV of ānasa) + nī, me (object); 'who keeps me company'
سُلِبَ: suliba, it was taken away, plundered (passive of salaba); 'was carried off'
لُبِّي: لُبّ + ـِي — lubb, mind, wits, understanding (m.), nominative (subject of sulib) + ī, my; 'my wits'
تَرُوحَ: tarūḥa, you go (subjunctive of rāḥa, to go, depart, 2nd m. sg.); 'you go'
وَتَنْظُرَ: وَ + تَنْظُرَ — wa-, and + tanẓura, you look (subjunctive of naẓara, to look, 2nd m. sg., governed by an); 'and you look'
الْعُلَمَاءِ: الْـ + عُلَمَاء — al-, the + ʿulamāʾ, scholars, the learned (pl. of ʿālim), genitive after ilā; 'the learned'
وَالْفُقَهَاءِ: وَ + الْـ + فُقَهَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + fuqahāʾ, jurists (pl. of faqīh), genitive; 'and the jurists'
وَتَزْدَادَ: وَ + تَزْدَادَ — wa-, and + tazdāda, you increase (subjunctive of izdāda, VIII, to grow), 2nd m. sg.; 'and you grow'
وَفَهْمًا: وَ + فَهْم — wa-, and + fahm, understanding (m.), accusative tanwīn of specification; 'and in understanding'
وَفِقْهًا: وَ + فِقْه — wa-, and + fiqh, jurisprudence, discernment (m.), accusative tanwīn of specification; 'and in law'
سَيِّدَةُ: sayyida, lady, mistress (f.), construct, nominative predicate; 'the lady of'; here: sayyid + ة (for ـهُ) — sayyidahu, 'his master' (m., acc., object of akhbara; the print writes the pronoun with ة)
قَوْمِهَا: قَوْم + هَا — qawm, people, tribe (m.), genitive after sayyidatu + hā, her; 'her people'
وَحَاكِمَةٌ: وَ + حَاكِمَة — wa-, and + ḥākima, ruler, governor (f. active participle of ḥakama), nominative; 'and a ruler'
وَغِلْمَانٍ: وَ + غِلْمَان — wa-, and + ghilmān, lads, boys (pl. of ghulām), genitive; 'and lads'
مَرْكَبٌ: markab, ship, vessel (m.), nominative (subject of ʿindī); 'a ship'
مَوْثُوقٌ: mawthūq, bound fast, secured (passive participle of wathiqa/awthaqa), nominative, adjective of markab; 'made fast, secured'
بِالتُّجَّرِ: بِـ + الْـ + تُجَّر — bi-, with, by (prep., here 'with, by means of') + al-, the + tujjar, merchants (pl. of tājir; the reading is uncertain); 'with the merchants'
رَمَتْنَا: رَمَتْ + نَا — ramat, she cast, threw (verb, 3rd f. sg. of ramā) + nā, us (object); 'cast us'
اطِّلَاعِنَا: اطِّلَاع + نَا — iṭṭilāʿ, being informed, becoming aware (m., verbal noun VIII of ṭalaʿa), genitive after fī + nā, our; 'our becoming aware'
الْأُمُورِ: الْـ + أُمُور — al-, the + umūr, matters, affairs (pl. of amr), genitive; 'the matters'
النَّصِيبُ: الْـ + نَصِيب — al-, the + naṣīb, lot, portion, destiny (m.), nominative subject of kāna; 'the lot'
اجْتِمَاعِنَا: اجْتِمَاع + نَا — ijtimāʿ, meeting, gathering (m., verbal noun VIII of jamaʿa), genitive after fī + nā, our; 'our meeting'
أُحَسِّنُ: uḥassinu, I make fair, make good (imperfect II of ḥassana, 1st sg.), 'I make seem good'
التَّوَجُّهَ: الْـ + تَوَجُّه — al-, the + tawajjuh, going, setting out (m., verbal noun V of wajjaha), accusative object; 'the going'
وَأُلَاطِفُهُ: وَ + أُلَاطِفُ + هُ — wa-, and + ulāṭifu, I treat gently (imperfect III of lāṭafa, 1st sg.) + hu, him (object); 'and I was gentle with him'
وَأَتَحَايَلُ: وَ + أَتَحَايَلُ — wa-, and + ataḥāyalu, I contrive, use stratagems (imperfect VI of taḥāyala, 1st sg.); 'and I contrived'
قَبِلَ: qabila, he accepted, consented (verb, 3rd m. sg.); 'he accepted'
وَأَنْعَمَ: وَ + أَنْعَمَ — wa-, and + anʿama, he said yes, agreed (verb IV, 3rd m. sg.; anʿama bihi, 'he agreed to it'); 'and he agreed'
الثَّامِنَةَ: الـ + ثَامِنَة — thāmin, eighth (f.), acc.; 'the eighth'
قَٰلَتْ: قَالَتْ — qāla, to say (f. perf. 3rd), written قل in the edition (dagger alif for the missing alif); 'she said'
تُحَسِّنُ: ḥassana, to make fair, to make good-looking to someone (II, impf. 3rd f.); 'she makes fair, urges'
لِلشَّابِّ: لِـ + الـ + شَابّ — li-, to (marks the person one speaks to or persuades, dative) + shābb, youth (m.); 'to the youth'
قُمْنَا: qāma, to rise, stand up (perf. 1st pl.); 'we rose'
الْخَزَائِنِ: الـ + خَزَائِن — khazāʾin, treasuries, storehouses (pl. of khizāna, f.), gen. after إِلَى; 'the treasuries'
وَأَخَذْنَا: وَ + أَخَذْنَا — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (perf. 1st pl.); 'and we took'
خَفَّ: khaffa, to be light (perf. 3rd m.); 'was light'
حَمْلُهُ: حَمْل + هُ — ḥaml, carrying (m., verbal noun), nom. + -hu, its; 'its carrying' (خَفَّ حَمْلُهُ, 'light to carry')
وَغَلَا: وَ + غَلَا — wa-, and + ghalā, to be dear, costly (perf. 3rd m.; written with alif); 'and was dear'
ثَمَنُهُ: ثَمَن + هُ — thaman, price (m.), nom. + -hu, its; 'its price'
وَنَزَلْنَا: وَ + نَزَلْنَا — wa-, and + nazala, to go down (perf. 1st pl.); 'and we went down'
فَقَابَلَنَا: فَـ + قَابَلَ + نَا — fa-, so, and so + qābala, to meet, face (III, perf. 3rd m.) + -nā, us; 'and they met us'
وَالرَّئِيسُ: وَ + الـ + رَئِيس — wa-, and + raʾīs, head, chief, ship's captain (m.), nom.; 'and the captain'
يُفَتِّشُونَ: fattasha, to search (II, impf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they search' (circumstantial, 'searching')
رَأَوْنِي: raʾā, to see (perf. 3rd m. pl. raʾaw) + -nī, me; 'they saw me'
فَرِحُوا: fariḥa, to rejoice (perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they rejoiced'
وَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ: وَ + أَخْبَرْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform (IV, perf. 1st sg.) + -hum, them; 'and I informed them'
قِصَّةِ: قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story (f.), gen. after عَلَى (construct with الشَّابِّ); 'the story of'
سَخَطِ: سَخَط — sakhaṭ, wrath, anger (m.), gen. in construct; 'the wrath of'
جَرَا: jarā, to happen, run (perf. 3rd m.; printed with alif for yāʾ); 'happened'
وَمَعِي: وَ + مَعَ + ي — wa-, and + maʿa, with (prep.) + -ī, me; 'and with me'
حَسَدُونِي: ḥasada, to envy (perf. 3rd m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'they envied me'
غَيْظٍ: ghayẓ, rage, wrath (m.), gen. after فِي; 'rage'
وَأَضْمَرُوا: وَ + أَضْمَرُوا — wa-, and + aḍmara, to hide inwardly (IV, perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'and they hid'
الْمَكْرَ: الـ + مَكْر — makr, plot, guile (m.), acc.; 'the plot'
طَائِرِينَ: ṭāʾir, flying (act. part. of ṭāra), m. pl. acc. (predicate); 'flying'
أَكْثَرُ: aktharu, most, greater (elative), nom.; 'the greatest part' Also 'more' with min, 'than': aktharu mina al-mawti, 'more than death'.
بِالشَّابِّ: بِـ + الـ + شَابّ — bi-, in, on account of (prep.) + shābb, youth (m.), gen.; 'in the youth'
نَنْتَظِرُ: intaẓara, to wait for (VIII, impf. 1st pl.); 'waiting' (with أَقَامَ, 'we stayed waiting')
فَرَفَعْنَا: فَـ + رَفَعْنَا — fa-, so, and so + rafaʿa, to raise (perf. 1st pl.); 'and we raised'
الْقُلُوعَ: الـ + قُلُوع — qulūʿ, sails (pl. of qilʿ, m.), acc.; 'the sails'
أَخَوَانِي: أَخَوَان + ي — akhawān, two brothers (dual, m.) + -ī, my; printed for أَخَوَاتِي 'my sisters'
وَصِرْنَا: وَ + صِرْنَا — wa-, and + ṣāra, to become, to begin (perf. 1st pl.); 'and we began'
نَتَحَدَّثُ: taḥaddatha, to converse (V, impf. 1st pl.); 'we converse' (with صَارَ, 'we began conversing')
فَقَالَتَا: فَـ + قَالَتَا — fa-, so, and so + qāla, to say (perf. 3rd f. dual); 'and the two said'
تَصْنَعِينَ: ṣanaʿa, to do, make (impf. 2nd f. sg.); 'you do'
الْحَسَنِ: الـ + حَسَن — ḥasan, handsome, fair (adj.), gen.; 'the handsome' Also al-Ḥasan, the second part of the name Abū al-Ḥasan (gen.): 'Abū al-Ḥasan'.
قَصْدِي: قَصْد + ي — qaṣd, intention (m.), nom. + -ī, my; 'my intention'
أَتَّخِذُهُ: ittakhadha, to take (VIII, impf. 1st sg.) + -hu, him; 'I take him'
وَأَقْبَلْتُ: وَ + أَقْبَلْتُ — wa-, and + aqbala, to approach, turn toward (IV, perf. 1st sg.); 'and I approached'
لَاتُخَالِفْنِي: لَا + تُخَالِفْ + نِي — lā, do not (prohibition) + khālafa, to oppose (III, jussive 2nd m.) + -nī, me; printed as one word, 'do not oppose me'
أُقَدِّمُ: qaddama, to present (II, impf. 1st sg.); 'I present'
بِرَسْمِ: بِـ + رَسْم — bi-, by way of, for (prep.; 'for the purpose of') + rasm, purpose, designation (m.), gen.; 'for the purpose of'
الْحَرَمِ: الـ + حَرَم — ḥaram, harem, the women's quarters (m.), gen.; 'the harem'
وَأَكُونُ: وَ + أَكُونُ — wa-, and + kāna, to be (impf. 1st sg.); 'and I will be'
فَقُلْنَ: فَـ + قُلْنَ — fa-, so, and so + qāla, to say (perf. 3rd f. pl.); 'and they said'
فَعَلْتِ: faʿala, to do (perf. 2nd f. sg.); 'you did'
لَكِنَّهُمْ: لَكِنَّ + هُمْ — lākinna, but (particle governing acc.) + -hum, they (m. pl.); 'but they'
أَضْمَرُوا: aḍmara, to hide inwardly (IV, perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they hid'
سَائِرِينَ: sāʾir, going, travelling (act. part. of sāra), m. pl. acc. (state); 'going on'
وَطَابَ: وَ + طَابَ — wa-, and + ṭāba, to be good (perf. 3rd m.); 'and it was good'
خَرَجْنَا: kharaja, to go out (perf. 1st pl.); 'we came out'
الْأَمَانَ: الـ + أَمَان — amān, safety (m.), acc. (object of دَخَلَ); 'safety'
وَلَاحَتْ: وَ + لَاحَتْ — wa-, and + lāḥa, to shine, appear (perf. 3rd f.); 'and they appeared'
أَسْوَارُهَا: أَسْوَار + هَا — aswār, walls (pl. of sūr, m.), nom. + -hā, its; 'its walls'
فَأَدْرَكَنَا: فَـ + أَدْرَكَ + نَا — fa-, so, and so + adraka, to overtake (IV, perf. 3rd m.) + -nā, us; 'and it overtook us'
أَخَذَنَا: أَخَذَ + نَا — akhadha, to take (perf. 3rd m.) + -nā, us; 'it took us'
النَّوْمُ: الـ + نَوْم — nawm, sleep (m.), nom.; 'the sleep'
بِفِرَاشِي: بِـ + فِرَاش + ي — bi-, with, together with (prep., accompaniment) + firāsh, bedding (m.) + -ī, my; 'with my bedding'
وَرَمَتْنِي: وَ + رَمَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ramā, to throw (perf. 3rd f.) + -nī, me; 'and she threw me'
فَغَرِقَ: فَـ + غَرِقَ — fa-, so, and so + ghariqa, to drown (perf. 3rd m.); 'so he drowned'
وَكَتَبَهُ: وَ + كَتَبَ + هُ — wa-, and + kataba, to write, record (perf. 3rd m.) + -hu, him; 'and He wrote him'
الشُّهَدَاءِ: الـ + شُهَدَاء — shuhadāʾ, martyrs, witnesses (pl. of shahīd, m.), gen. after مِنَ; 'the martyrs'
السَّالِمِينَ: الـ + سَالِم — sālim, safe (act. part.), m. pl. gen. after مِنَ; 'the safe ones'
رَزَقَنِي: رَزَقَ + نِي — razaqa, to provide, grant (perf. 3rd m.) + -nī, me; 'he provided me'
بِقِطْعَةِ: بِـ + قِطْعَة — bi-, with (prep.; رَزَقَ بِـ marks what is given) + qiṭʿa, piece (f.), gen. in construct; 'with a piece of'
فَرَكِبْتُهَا: فَـ + رَكِبْتُ + هَا — fa-, so, and so + rakiba, to ride, mount (perf. 1st sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and I mounted it'
وَضَرَبَتْنِي: وَ + ضَرَبَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ḍaraba, to strike (perf. 3rd f.) + -nī, me; 'and it struck me'
رَمَتْنِي: رَمَتْ + نِي — ramā, to throw (perf. 3rd f.) + -nī, me; 'they threw me'; here: 'have shot me', of glances, with bi- of the arrows: qad ramatnī bi-ashumi
سَاحِلِ: سَاحِل — sāḥil, shore (m.), gen. after عَلَى in construct; 'the shore of'
مُشِىَ: mashā, to walk (I, passive perf. 3rd m. mushiya; printed with ى); 'walked-on'
قَدْرِ: قَدْر — qadr, measure, size (m.), gen. after عَلَى in construct; 'the measure of'
قَدَمِ: قَدَم — qadam, foot (f.), gen. in construct; 'the foot of'
آدَمَ: Ādam, Adam, gen. (diptote); 'ابن آدم, son of Adam, a human being'
مُتَّصِلَةً: muttaṣil, connected (act. part. VIII), f. sg. acc. (state, agreeing with ṭarīq as f.); 'connected'
فَنَشَّفْتُ: فَـ + نَشَّفْتُ — fa-, so, and so + nashshafa, to dry (II, perf. 1st sg.); 'so I dried'
الشَّمْسِ: الـ + شَمْس — shams, sun (f.), gen. after فِي; 'the sun'
وَأَكَلْتُ: وَ + أَكَلْتُ — wa-, and + akala, to eat (perf. 1st sg.); 'and I ate'
ثِمَارِ: ثِمَار — thimār, fruits (pl. of thamar, m.), gen. after مِنْ in construct; 'the fruits of' (مِنْ 'some of')
سَائِرَةً: sāʾir, going (act. part. of sāra), f. sg. acc. (state, speaker female); 'going'
سَاعَتَيْنِ: sāʿa, hour (f.), dual oblique (printed for the nom. dual); 'two hours'
بِحَيَّةٍ: بِـ + حَيَّة — bi-, with (marks what appears, after إِذَا of surprise: 'and behold, I was with a...') + ḥayya, serpent (f.), gen.; 'a serpent'
عَامِلَةٍ: ʿāmil, working, acting (act. part. of ʿamila), f. sg. gen. (adj. of ḥayya); 'working, bearing down'
غِلَظِ: غِلَظ — ghilaẓ, thickness (m.), gen. after فِي in construct; 'the thickness of'
النَّخْلَةِ: الـ + نَخْلَة — nakhla, palm-tree (f.), gen. in construct; 'the palm-tree'
تَسْعَى: saʿā, to run, hasten (impf. 3rd f.); 'she runs'; here: 2ms, 'you strive'; saʿā fī, 'to work at, strive for'
سَعْيًا: saʿy, running, hastening (m., verbal noun), acc. (cognate); 'a running'
نَحْوِي: نَحْو + ي — naḥwa, toward (prep. acc.) + -ī, me; 'toward me'
فَرَأَيْتُهَا: فَـ + رَأَيْتُ + هَا — fa-, so, and so + raʾā, to see (perf. 1st sg.) + -hā, her; 'and I saw her'
تَأْخُذُ: akhadha, to take (impf. 3rd f.); 'taking' (أَخَذَ يَمِينًا 'to take (a way to) the right', swerving)
بِلِسَانِهَا: بِـ + لِسَان + هَا — bi-, marks what appears, after إِذَا of surprise + lisān, tongue (m./f.), gen. + -hā, her; 'her tongue'
تَدَلَّى: tadallā, to hang down (V, perf. 3rd m.); 'had hung down'
شِبْرٍ: shibr, span (of the hand) (m.), gen. in construct; 'a span'
وَتَجْرُفُ: وَ + تَجْرُفُ — wa-, and + jarafa, to sweep, scrape (impf. 3rd f.); 'and she sweeps'
بِطُولِهَا: بِـ + طُول + هَا — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + ṭūl, length (m.), gen. + -hā, her; 'with her length' Also bi- of extent, 'throughout': fī tilka al-laylati bi-ṭūlihā, 'all that night long'.
ثُعْبَانٌ: thuʿbān, great snake (m.), nom.; 'a great snake'
طَارَدَهَا: طَارَدَ + هَا — ṭārada, to chase (III, perf. 3rd m.) + -hā, her; 'chasing her'
هَارِبَةٌ: hārib, fleeing (act. part.), f. sg. nom. (predicate); 'fleeing'
تَلْتَفِتُ: iltafata, to turn, glance about (VIII, impf. 3rd f.); 'turning'
ذَنَبَهَا: ذَنَب + هَا — dhanab, tail (m.), acc. + -hā, her; 'her tail'
دَمْعَهَا: دَمْع + هَا — damʿ, tears (m.), acc. (printed so; Classical nom.) + -hā, her; 'her tears'
لِسَانُهَا: لِسَان + هَا — lisān, tongue (m./f.), nom. + -hā, her; 'her tongue'
الْهَرَبِ: الـ + هَرَب — harab, flight (m.), gen. in construct; 'the flight'
الشَّفَقَةُ: الـ + شَفَقَة — shafaqa, pity, compassion (f.), nom.; 'the pity'
وَأَلْقَيْتُهُ: وَ + أَلْقَيْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + alqā, to throw (IV, perf. 1st sg.) + -hu, it; 'and I threw it'
الثُّعْبَانِ: الـ + ثُعْبَان — thuʿbān, great snake (m.), gen. in construct; 'the great snake'
فَفَتَحَتِ: فَـ + فَتَحَتِ — fa-, so, and so + fataḥa, to open (perf. 3rd f., with helping kasra before the article); 'and she opened'
غَابَتْ: ghāba, to vanish, be absent (perf. 3rd f.); 'she vanished'
مَوْضِعِي: مَوْضِع + ي — mawḍiʿ, place (m.), acc. (adverb) + -ī, my; 'in my place'
أَفَقْتُ: afāqa, to wake, come to (IV, perf. 1st sg.); 'I woke'
رِجْلَيَّ: رِجْل + ي — rijl, foot (f.), dual, gen. after تَحْتَ + -ī, my (dual + -ī gives -ayya); 'my two feet'
فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ: فَـ + اسْتَحْيَيْتُ — fa-, so, and so + istaḥyā, to be ashamed, shy (X, perf. 1st sg.); 'so I was ashamed'
تَكُونِي: kāna, to be (impf. 2nd f., printed without the final nūn); 'you are'
نَسِيتِنِي: نَسِيتِ + نِي — nasiya, to forget (perf. 2nd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'you forgot me'
عَمِلْتِ: ʿamila, to do (perf. 2nd f. sg.); 'you did'
وَزَرَعْتِ: وَ + زَرَعْتِ — wa-, and + zaraʿa, to sow (perf. 2nd f. sg.); 'and you sowed'
وَقَتَلْتِ: وَ + قَتَلْتِ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (perf. 2nd f. sg.); 'and you killed'
عَلْوِي: ʿAlwī, a name (of the snake-jinn), acc.; 'ʿAlwī'
خَلَّصْتِنِي: خَلَّصْتِ + نِي — khallaṣa, to deliver, save (II, perf. 2nd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'you delivered me'
الثُّعْبَانُ: الـ + ثُعْبَان — thuʿbān, great snake (m.), nom.; 'the great snake'
نَجَاتِي: نَجَاة + ي — najāh, deliverance, escape (f.), nom. + -ī, my; 'my deliverance'
بِكِ: بِـ + كِ — bi-, by means of, through (prep., marks the agent of the rescue) + -ki, you (f.); 'through you' ; also: after faʿala, 'to do to', bi- marks the one something is done to: ayya shayʾin faʿala biki, 'whatever he does to you'
نَجَّيْتِنِي: نَجَّيْتِ + نِي — najjā, to save (II, perf. 2nd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'you saved me'
الرِّيحِ: الـ + رِيح — rīḥ, wind (f./m.), gen. after فِي; 'the wind'
وَرُحْتُ: وَ + رُحْتُ — wa-, and + rāḥa, to go (perf. 1st sg.); 'and I went'
رَمَوْكِ: رَمَوْا + كِ — ramā, to throw (perf. 3rd m. pl.) + -ki, you (f.); 'they threw you'
أَخَوَاتُكِ: أَخَوَات + كِ — akhawāt, sisters (f. pl.), nom. + -ki, your (f.); 'your sisters'
فَنَقَلْتُ: فَـ + نَقَلْتُ — fa-, so, and so + naqala, to move, transport (perf. 1st sg.); 'and I moved'
بَيْتِكِ: بَيْت + كِ — bayt, house (m.), gen. after إِلَى + -ki, your (f.); 'your house'
وَغَرَّقْتُهَا: وَ + غَرَّقْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + gharraqa, to sink (II, perf. 1st sg.) + -hā, it; 'and I sank it'
فَجَعَلْتُهُمَا: فَـ + جَعَلْتُ + هُمَا — fa-, so, and so + jaʿala, to make (perf. 1st sg.) + -humā, them two; 'and I made them'
وَرَمَتْنَا: وَ + رَمَتْ + نَا — wa-, and + ramā, to throw (perf. 3rd f.) + -nā, us; 'and she threw us'
الْأَمْوَالِ: الـ + أَمْوَال — amwāl, wealth, goods (pl. of māl, m.), gen. after مِنَ; 'the wealth'
يَضِعْ: ḍāʿa, to be lost (jussive 3rd m.); 'was lost'
الْحَيَّةَ: الـ + حَيَّة — ḥayya, serpent (f.), acc.; 'the serpent'
النَّقْشِ: الـ + نَقْش — naqsh, engraving, inscription (m.), gen.; 'the engraving'
تَضْرِبِي: ḍaraba, to beat (jussive 2nd f. sg.); 'you beat'
ثَلَٰثَمِائَةَ: thalāthamiʾa, three hundred (defective spelling; alif supplied by dagger), acc. (second object of ضَرَبَ); 'three hundred'
سَوْطٍ: sawṭ, lash, whip-stroke (m.), gen. after the number; 'lashes'
وَجَعَلْتُكِ: وَ + جَعَلْتُ + كِ — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make (perf. 1st sg.) + -ki, you (f.); 'and I will make you'
مِثْلَهُمَا: مِثْل + هُمَا — mithl, like, the likeness of (m.), acc. (second object) + -humā, the two of them; 'like the two of them'
أَضْرِبُهُمَا: أَضْرِبُ + هُمَا — ḍaraba, to beat (impf. 1st sg.) + -humā, the two of them; 'beating them'
الضَّرْبَ: الـ + ضَرْب — ḍarb, beating (m.), acc.; 'the beating'
وَأُشْفِقُ: وَ + أُشْفِقُ — wa-, and + ashfaqa, to pity (IV, impf. 1st sg.); 'and pitying'
ضَرْبِهِمَا: ضَرْب + هِمَا — ḍarb, beating (m.), gen. after فِي + -himā, their (dual); 'their beating'
وَيَقْبَلَانِ: وَ + يَقْبَلَانِ — wa-, and + qabila, to accept (impf. 3rd dual); 'and they accept'
وَهَذِةِ: وَ + هَذِهِ — wa-, and + hādhihi, this (f.; printed with ة); 'and this'
وَحِكَايَتِي: وَ + حِكَايَة + ي — wa-, and + ḥikāya, tale (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my tale'
الْحِكَايَةِ: الـ + حِكَايَة — ḥikāya, tale (f.), gen. in construct; 'the tale'
الثَّانِيَةِ: الـ + ثَانِيَة — thāniya, second (f.), gen. (adj.); 'the second' Also 'the other (of two)': rajaʿa ilā dārihi al-thāniyati allatī huwa sākinun bihā, 'he went back to his other house, the one he lived in'.
وَأَنْتِ: وَ + أَنْتِ — wa-, and, as for + anti, you (f. sg.); 'and you'
فَتُوُفِّيَ: فَـ + تُوُفِّيَ — fa-, so, and so + tuwuffiya, to die (V, passive perf. 3rd m.); 'and he died'
وَتَزَوَّجْتُ: وَ + تَزَوَّجْتُ — wa-, and + tazawwaja, to marry (V, perf. 1st sg.); 'and I married'
أَسْعَدِ: as'ad, happiest, most fortunate (elative), gen. in apposition, in construct; 'the happiest of'
فَوَرِثْتُ: فَـ + وَرِثْتُ — fa-, so, and so + waritha, to inherit (perf. 1st sg.); 'so I inherited'
ثَمَانِينَ: thamānīn, eighty (m. pl. oblique), acc. after a numeral; 'eighty'
حِصَّتِي: حِصَّة + ي — ḥiṣṣa, share (f.), nom. + -ī, my; 'my share'
بِالْفَرِيضَةِ: بِـ + الـ + فَرِيضَة — bi-, by, according to (prep.) + farīḍa, ordained share, legal ordinance (f.), gen.; 'by the ordinance'
الشَّرْعِيَّةِ: الـ + شَرْعِيَّة — sharʿiyya, legal, of the sharia (f. adj.), gen.; 'the legal'
وَفُقْتُ: وَ + فُقْتُ — wa-, and + fāqa, to excel (perf. 1st sg.); 'and I excelled'
خَبَرِي: خَبَر + ي — khabar, report, news (m.), nom. + -ī, my; 'my report'
عَشْرَ: ʿashra, ten (m. num.; here with a feminine plural), acc.; 'ten'
بَدْلَةٍ: badla, suit (f.), gen. in construct (كُلَّ بَدْلَةٍ, 'each suit'); 'suit'
بِأَلْفِ: بِـ + أَلْف — bi-, at, for (prep.; marks the price) + alf, thousand (m.), gen.; 'at a thousand'
جَالِسَةٌ: jālis, sitting (act. part.), f. sg. nom. (predicate); 'sitting'
بِخَدٍّ: بِـ + خَدّ — bi-, with, having (prep., marks a feature) + khadd, cheek (m.), gen.; 'with a cheek'
مَشْمُوطٍ: mashmūṭ, streaked, plucked (passive part., meaning uncertain), gen.; 'streaked (?)'
وَحَاجِبٍ: وَ + حَاجِب — wa-, and (continuing 'with') + ḥājib, eyebrow (m.), gen.; 'and a brow'
مَمْقُوطٍ: mamqūṭ, plucked (passive part., meaning uncertain), gen.; 'plucked (?)'
مُغْبَرَّةٍ: mughbarr, dusty, dust-coloured (act. part. IX/quadriliteral), f. sg. gen.; 'dusty'
وَأَسْنَانٍ: وَ + أَسْنَان — wa-, and + asnān, teeth (pl. of sinn, f.), gen.; 'and teeth'
مُكَسَّرَةٍ: mukassar, broken (passive part. II), f. sg. gen.; 'broken'
وَوَجْهٍ: وَ + وَجْه — wa-, and + wajh, face (m.), gen.; 'and a face'
وَلَحْظٍ: وَ + لَحْظ — wa-, and + laḥẓ, glance (m.), gen.; 'and a glance'
وَرَأْسٍ: وَ + رَأْس — wa-, and + raʾs, head (m.), gen.; 'and a head'
مُجَصَّصٍ: mujaṣṣaṣ, plastered with gypsum, chalk-white (passive part. II), gen.; 'plastered white'
وَشَعْرٍ: وَ + شَعْر — wa-, and + shaʿr, hair (m.), gen.; 'and hair'
وَجِسْمٍ: وَ + جِسْم — wa-, and + jism, body (m.), gen.; 'and a body'
وَقَلٍّ: وَ + قَلّ — wa-, and + qall (printed so; read qadd, stature, m.), gen.; 'and a stature'
وَلَوْنٍ: وَ + لَوْن — wa-, and + lawn, colour, complexion (m.), gen.; 'and a colour'
وَمُخَاطٍ: وَ + مُخَاط — wa-, and + mukhāṭ, nasal mucus (m.), gen.; 'and snot'
الْقَائِلُ: الـ + قَائِل — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part. of qāla), nom.; 'the speaker, the poet'
عَجُوزُ: عَجُوز — ʿajūz, old woman, hag (f.); nominative, first term of the annexation 'hag of ill-luck'
النَّحْسِ: الـ + نَحْس — naḥs, ill-luck, misfortune; 'the ill-luck' (genitive after ʿajūz)
يُرْحَمُ: يُرْحَمُ — passive of raḥima, to pity; 'is pitied'
صِبَاهَا: صِبَا + هَا — ṣibā, youth, youthfulness; + hā, her; 'her youth'
يُغْفَرُ: يُغْفَرُ — passive of ghafara, to forgive; 'is forgiven'
السِّيَاسَةِ: الـ + سِيَاسَة — siyāsa, statecraft, management, cunning; 'the cunning', genitive after min
بَغْلٍ: بَغْل — baghl, mule (m.); genitive after the number, 'of mule(s)'
نَفَرُوا: نَفَرُوا — nafara, to shy, bolt, flee; 3rd m. pl. perfect, 'they bolt'
بِخَيْطِ: بِـ + خَيْط — bi-, at/from (with nafara, 'shy at'); khayṭ, thread (m.); 'at the thread of'
الْعَنْكَبُوتِ: الـ + عَنْكَبُوت — ʿankabūt, spider (m.); 'the spider', genitive in annexation
دَخَلَتِ: دَخَلَتْ — dakhala, to enter; 3rd f. sing. perfect (with helping kasra before al-)
سَلَّمَتْ: سَلَّمَتْ — sallama (II), to greet; 3rd f. sing. perfect, 'she greeted'
وَبَاسَتِ: وَ + بَاسَتْ — wa-, and; bāsa (yabūsu), to kiss (Middle Arabic; Cl. qabbala); 3rd f. sing. perfect
يَدَيَّ: يَدَيْ + يَ — yad, hand (f.), dual in construct 'two hands of' + -ya 'my'; 'my two hands'
بِنْتٌ: بِنْت — bint, girl, daughter (f.); indefinite nominative
وَاللَّيْلَةَ: وَ + الـ + لَيْلَة — wa-, and; layla, night (f.); 'and tonight', accusative of time
عُرْسَهَا: عُرْس + هَا — ʿurs, wedding (m.); + hā, her; 'her wedding'
وَجِلَاهَا: وَ + جِلَا + هَا — wa-, and; jilā (read as jilāʾ), bridal display, unveiling; + hā, her; 'and her display'
نَعْرِفُ: نَعْرِفُ — ʿarafa, to know; 1st pl. imperfect, 'we know'
انْكَسَرَتْ: انْكَسَرَتْ — inkasara (VII), to be broken; 3rd f. sing. perfect, 'have been broken'
قُلُوبُنَا: قُلُوب + نَا — qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb); + nā, our; 'our hearts'
فَارْجِى: فَـ + ارْجِي — fa-, so; irjī, imperative f. sing. of rajā, to hope for, seek; 'so hope for' (or arjū, 'I hope', printed with ى)
وَالثَّوَابَ: وَ + الـ + ثَوَاب — wa-, and; thawāb, recompense (m.); 'and the recompense'
بِأَنَّكِ: بِـ + أَنَّ + كِ — bi-, by/through (prep., 'by reason that'); anna, that; -ki, you (f.); 'in that you'
تَحْضُرِي: تَحْضُرِي — ḥaḍara, to attend; 2nd f. sing. imperfect, printed without -na (Middle Arabic): 'you attend'
جِلَاهَا: جِلَا + هَا — jilā (read jilāʾ), bridal display; + hā, her; 'her display', object of taḥḍurī
اسِتَّاتُ: سِتَّات — sittāt, ladies (pl. of sitt, from sayyida), printed with a prothetic alif; nominative, subject of tasmaʿū
حَضَرْتِي: حَضَرْتِ — ḥaḍara, to attend; 2nd f. sing. perfect with a long -ī in Middle Arabic; 'you have attended'
فَيَحْضُرْنَ: فَـ + يَحْضُرْنَ — fa-, so that; yaḥḍurna, 3rd f. pl. subjunctive/imperfect, 'they attend'
فَتَكُونِي: فَـ + تَكُونِي — fa-, and so; takūnī, 2nd f. sing. subjunctive of kāna, 'you be' (-na dropped)
جَبْرَةَ: جَبْرَة — jabra, a mending, consoling (from jabara, to set, mend); accusative predicate
خَاطِرِهَا: خَاطِر + هَا — khāṭir, heart, mind (m.); + hā, her; 'her heart'
مَكْسُورَةُ: مَكْسُورَة — maksūra, broken (f., pass. part. of kasara)
الْخَاطِرِ: الـ + خَاطِر — khāṭir, heart; 'the heart', genitive, 'broken of heart'; here: 'mind', in mushawwash al-khāṭir, 'troubled of mind'
وَجَعَلَتْ: وَ + جَعَلَتْ — wa-, and; jaʿala, to begin (to), set about; 3rd f. sing. perfect ; also: jaʿala, to make, with two objects: wa-jaʿalat nafsahā burghūthan, 'and she made herself a flea'; also 'to put, place': jaʿalat yadahu fī yadihā, 'she put his hand in hers' (Night 193)
حُضُورُكُمْ: حُضُور + كُمْ — ḥuḍūr, presence, attendance (m.); + kum, your (pl.)
بِذَٰلِكَ: بِـ + ذَٰلِكَ — bi-, of (with iʿtarafa, 'acknowledge of/to'); dhālika, that; 'that'
نَعْتَرِفُ: نَعْتَرِفُ — iʿtarafa (VIII), to acknowledge (bi-); 1st pl. imperfect, 'we acknowledge'
غِبْتُمْ: غِبْتُمْ — ghāba, to be absent; 2nd m. pl. perfect, 'you are absent'
الرَّحْمَةُ: الـ + رَحْمَة — raḥma, mercy, pity (f.); 'the pity'
وَالرَّأْفَةُ: وَ + الـ + رَأْفَة — wa-, and; raʾfa, compassion (f.); 'and the compassion'
مَشِيئَةِ: مَشِيئَة — mashīʾa, will (f.); in annexation 'the will of'
أُجَلِّيهَا: أُجَلِّي + هَا — jallā (II), to display, present a bride; 1st sing. imperfect; -hā, her; 'I display her'
بِحُلَلِي: بِـ + حُلَل + ـي — bi-, in/with (prep.; 'except in'); ḥulal, robes (pl. of ḥulla); -ī, my; 'in my robes'
وَمَصَاغِي: وَ + مَصَاغ + ـي — wa-, and; maṣāgh, jewellery, ornaments (m.); -ī, my; 'and my jewellery'
تَرَاكِبِي: تَرَاكِب + ـي — tarākib (uncertain), settings or fittings of jewels; -ī, my; 'my settings'
فَفَرِحَتِ: فَـ + فَرِحَتْ — fa-, so; fariḥa, to rejoice; 3rd f. sing. perfect (with helping kasra before al-)
وَطَأْطَأَتْ: وَ + طَأْطَأَتْ — wa-, and; ṭaʾṭaʾa (quadriliteral), to bow low; 3rd f. sing. perfect
تُقَبِّلُهُمْ: تُقَبِّلُ + هُمْ — qabbala (II), to kiss; 3rd f. sing. imperfect (circumstantial, 'kissing'); -hum, them
يُجَازِيكِ: يُجَازِي + كِ — jāzā (III), to repay, reward; 3rd m. imperfect (wish: 'may He repay'); -ki, you (f.)
وَيَجْبُرُ: وَ + يَجْبُرُ — wa-, and; jabara, to set, mend; 3rd m. imperfect, 'and (may He) mend'
قَلْبَكِ: قَلْب + كِ — qalb, heart (m.); -ki, your (f.); 'your heart'
جَبَرْتِ: جَبَرْتِ — jabara, to mend; 2nd f. sing. perfect, 'you mended'
تَكَلَّفِي: تَكَلَّفِي — takallafa (V), to put oneself to trouble (over); 2nd f. sing. jussive (after lā), 'do not trouble yourself over'
خِدْمَتَكِ: خِدْمَة + كِ — khidma, service, attendance (f.); -ki, your (f.); 'your service'
تَجَهَّزِي: تَجَهَّزِي — tajahhaza (V), to get ready; imperative f. sing., 'make yourself ready'
لِلْعَشَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + عَشَاء — li-, for (prep.); ʿashāʾ, evening, supper (m.); 'for the supper'
أَجِيءَ: أَجِيءَ — jāʾa, to come; 1st sing. subjunctive after ḥattā, 'I come'
آخُذَكِ: آخُذُ + كِ — akhadha, to take; 1st sing. subjunctive; -ki, you (f.); 'I take you'
وَذَهَبَتْ: وَ + ذَهَبَتْ — wa-, and; dhahaba, to go; 3rd f. sing. perfect, 'and she went'
عَلَّنْتُ: عَلَّنْتُ — (obscure) Form II of ʿalana, 'to make plain', or a garble for 'I made ready'; 1st sing. perfect
وَحَالِي: وَ + حَال + ـي — wa-, and; ḥāl, state, condition (m.); -ī, my; 'and my condition'
بِالْعَجُوزِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجُوز — bi-, only marks what appears after idhā of surprise ('behold, the old woman'); ʿajūz, old woman
سِتَّاتِ: سِتَّات — sittāt, ladies (pl. of sitt); accusative/annexed, 'the ladies of'
الْبَلَدِ: الـ + بَلَد — balad, town, land (m.); 'the town'
حَضَرْنَ: حَضَرْنَ — ḥaḍara, to attend; 3rd f. pl. perfect, 'they have come'
أَخْبَرْتُهُمْ: أَخْبَرْتُ + هُمْ — akhbara (IV), to inform; 1st sing. perfect; -hum, them; 'I informed them'
بِحُضُورِكِ: بِـ + حُضُور + كِ — bi-, of/about (akhbara bi-, 'inform of'); ḥuḍūr, presence, attendance; -ki, your (f.)
فَفَرِحُوا: فَـ + فَرِحُوا — fa-, and so; fariḥa, to rejoice; 3rd m. pl. perfect
انْتِظَارِكِ: انْتِظَار + كِ — intiẓār, waiting (m.); -ki, you (f.); 'their waiting for you', governed by fī
مُتَطَلِّعِينَ: مُتَطَلِّعِينَ — mutaṭalliʿ, looking out for, watching for (act. part. of V), accusative pl. (ḥāl)
قُدُومَكِ: قُدُوم + كِ — qudūm, coming, arrival (m.); -ki, your (f.); 'your coming', object of the participle
تَأَزَّرْتُ: تَأَزَّرْتُ — taʾazzara (V), to put on the izār (outer wrap); 1st sing. perfect, 'I wrapped myself'
أَتَيْنَا: أَتَيْنَا — atā, to come; 1st pl. perfect, 'we came'
مَكْنُوسٍ: مَكْنُوس — maknūs, swept (pass. part. of kanasa)
مَرْشُوشٍ: مَرْشُوش — marshūsh, sprinkled (with water; pass. part. of rashsha)
هَبَّ: هَبَّ — habba, to blow; 3rd m. perfect
وَرَاقَ: وَ + رَاقَ — wa-, and; rāqa, to be pleasant, clear; 3rd m. perfect
فَقَدِمْنَا: فَـ + قَدِمْنَا — fa-, so; qadima, to come to; 1st pl. perfect, 'we came'
بِقُبَّةٍ: بِـ + قُبَّة — bi-, with (prep.; 'arched with'); qubba, dome (f.); 'with a dome'
الرُّخَامِ: الـ + رُخَام — rukhām, marble (m.); 'the marble', genitive after min
شَدِيدَةِ: شَدِيدَة — shadīda, strong, severe (f.); genitive, describing qubba
تَعَلَّقَ: تَعَلَّقَ — taʿallaqa (V), to hang, cling; 3rd m. perfect
بِالسَّحَابِ: بِـ + الـ + سَحَاب — bi-, to/by (taʿallaqa bi-, 'cling to'); saḥāb, clouds (m.); 'to the clouds'
بُنِيتُ: بُنِيتُ — passive of banā, to build; 1st sing. perfect, 'I was built'
لِلْأَفْرَاحِ: لِـ + الـ + أَفْرَاح — li-, for (prep.; purpose); afrāḥ, joys, weddings (pl. of faraḥ); 'for the joys'
دَهْرِي: دَهْر + ـي — dahr, age, time (m.); -ī, my; 'my age'
لِلْبَسْطِ: لِـ + الـ + بَسْط — li-, for (prep.; purpose); basṭ, expansion, cheer (m.); 'for cheer'
وَبِوَسْطِي: وَ + بِـ + وَسْط + ـي — wa-, and; bi-, in (prep.); wasṭ, middle (m.); -ī, my; 'and in my middle'
تَتَدَفَّقُ: تَتَدَفَّقُ — tadaffaqa (V), to gush; 3rd f. sing. imperfect
بِمِيَاهٍ: بِـ + مِيَاه — bi-, with (prep.); miyāh, waters (pl. of māʾ); 'with waters'
بِالْأَتْرَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + أَتْرَاح — bi-, loosely 'with' (a pleonastic bi- after azāla); atrāḥ, griefs (pl. of tarah); 'the griefs'
زُهُورُ: زُهُور — zuhūr, flowers (pl. of zahr); first term of the annexation 'flowers of'
وَنَرْجِسٍ: وَ + نَرْجِس — wa-, and; narjis, narcissus (m.)
وَأُقَاحِ: وَ + أُقَاح — wa-, and; uqāḥ, camomile (m.)
طَرَقَتْهُ: طَرَقَتْ + هُ — ṭaraqa, to knock; 3rd f. sing. perfect; -hu, it (m.)
فَفُتِحَ: فَـ + فُتِحَ — fa-, and so; passive of fataḥa, to open; 3rd m. perfect, 'it was opened'
دِهْلِيزًا: دِهْلِيز — dihlīz, vestibule, entrance passage (m.); accusative
وَمُعَلَّقٌ: وَ + مُعَلَّق — wa-, and; muʿallaq, hung (pass. part. of II ʿallaqa); nominative as printed
وَشُمُوعٌ: وَ + شُمُوع — wa-, and; shumūʿ, candles (pl. of shamʿa)
مَصْفُوفَةٌ: مَصْفُوفَة — maṣfūfa, set in rows (f., pass. part. of ṣaffa)
الْجَوَاهِرُ: الـ + جَوَاهِر — jawāhir, jewels (pl. of jawhara)
وَالْمَعَادِنُ: وَ + الـ + مَعَادِن — wa-, and; maʿādin, metals, minerals (pl. of maʿdin)
الدِّهْلِيزِ: الـ + دِهْلِيز — dihlīz, vestibule; 'the vestibule'; also 'passage', of a palace corridor
بِالْفِرَاشِ: بِـ + الـ + فِرَاش — bi-, with (prep.; 'spread with'); firāsh, bedding, carpeting (m.)
الْجَوْهَرِ: الـ + جَوْهَر — jawhar, jewels, gems (m.); 'the jewels', genitive after wa-
بَشْخَانَةُ: بَشْخَانَة — bashkhāna, curtained canopy, pavilion (f.; from Persian); first term of annexation
مُزَرَّرٍ: مُزَرَّر — muzarrar, buttoned, fastened with loops (pass. part. of II zarrara)
نَشْعُرْ: نَشْعُرْ — shaʿara, to perceive; 1st pl. jussive, 'we perceived'
أَكْمَلُ: أَكْمَل — akmal, more perfect (elative of kāmil)
كَالصُّبْحِ: كَـ + الـ + صُبْح — ka-, like (prep.); ṣubḥ, dawn (m.); 'like the dawn'
الْقَصَرَاتِ: الـ + قَصَرَات — qaṣarāt (uncertain), halls or palaces; 'the halls', genitive after ʿalā
الْقَيْصَرِيَّاتِ: الـ + قَيْصَرِيَّات — qayṣariyyāt, Caesarean, Roman (f. pl.); 'the Caesarean ones'
الْخَفِرَاتِ: الـ + خَفِرَات — khafirāt, modest maidens (f. pl.); 'the modest ones', genitive after min
الْكِسْرَوِيَّاتِ: الـ + كِسْرَوِيَّات — kisrawiyyāt, Chosroan, Persian (f. pl.); 'the Chosroan ones'
دَلَائِلُ: دَلَائِل — dalāʾil, tokens, signs (pl. of dalīl)
مُوَرَّدَةً: مُوَرَّدَة — muwarrada, rose-tinted (f., pass. part. of II warrada); accusative (ḥāl)
يَاحُسْنَ: يَا + حُسْنَ — yā, O (exclamation); ḥusn, beauty (m.); 'O the beauty of', printed as one word
الْعَنْدَمِيَّاتِ: الـ + عَنْدَمِيَّات — ʿandamiyyāt, red as dragon's blood (f. pl.; ʿandam = dragon's blood); 'the flushed ones'
فَاتِرَةُ: فَاتِرَة — fātira, languid (f.); first term of annexation
الْأَلْحَاظِ: الـ + أَلْحَاظ — alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ); 'of glances'
حَازَتْ: حَازَتْ — ḥāza, to gain, acquire; 3rd f. sing. perfect
الْمَلَاحَاتِ: الـ + مَلَاحَات — malāḥāt, comelinesses (pl. of malāḥa)
كَأَنَّ: كَـ + أَنَّ — ka-, like; anna, that; 'as if'
طُرَّتَهَا: طُرَّة + هَا — ṭurra, forelock, fringe (f.); hā, her
غُرَّتِهَا: غُرَّة + هَا — ghurra, blaze, forehead (f.); hā, her
لَيْلُ: لَيْل — layl, night (m.); in annexation 'night of'
عَلَيٰ: عَلَى — ʿalā, upon (prep.), printed with ي
صُبْحِ: صُبْح — ṣubḥ, morning, dawn (m.); in annexation
الْمَسَرَّاتِ: الـ + مَسَرَّات — masarrāt, joys (pl. of masarra)
بِالْأُخْتِ: بِـ + الـ + أُخْت — bi-, (greeting) 'to, in the case of' (names the person greeted); ukht, sister (f.)
وَأَلْفَ: وَ + أَلْف — wa-, and; alf, thousand; accusative, 'and a thousand (welcomes)'
زَارَهَا: زَارَ + هَا — zāra, to visit; 3rd m. perfect; -hā, it (f.)
وَاسْتَبْشَرَتْ: وَ + اسْتَبْشَرَتْ — wa-, and; istabshara (X), to be glad; 3rd f. sing. perfect
بِلِسَانِ: بِـ + لِسَان — bi-, with, by means of (prep.); lisān, tongue (m.)
قَائِلَةً: قَائِلَة — qāʾila, saying (f., act. part. of qāla); accusative (ḥāl)
بِأَهْلِ: بِـ + أَهْل — bi-, (greeting) 'to, in the case of'; ahl, people; 'to the people of'
وَالْكَرَمِ: وَ + الـ + كَرَم — wa-, and; karam, nobility, bounty (m.); 'and the nobility'
أَخًا: أَخ — akh, brother (m.); accusative after inna
رَأَكِ: رَأَى + كِ — raʾā, to see; 3rd m. perfect (printed without the long vowel), -ki, you (f.); 'he saw you'
الْأَفْرَاحِ: الـ + أَفْرَاح — afrāḥ, weddings, joyful feasts (pl. of faraḥ); 'the weddings'
وَالْمَوَاسِمِ: وَ + الـ + مَوَاسِم — wa-, and; mawāsim, festivals (pl. of mawsim)
حَبَّكِ: حَبَّ + كِ — ḥabba, to love; 3rd m. perfect; -ki, you (f.)
لِأَنَّكِ: لِـ + أَنَّ + كِ — li-, for, because (li-anna, 'because'); anna, that; -ki, you (f.)
حُزْتِ: حُزْتِ — ḥāza, to gain, acquire; 2nd f. sing. perfect
أَوْفَى: أَوْفَى — awfā, fullest, most complete (elative of wāfī); here: 'more faithful' (elative of wafiyy, 'faithful'), with min, 'than'
نَصِيبٍ: نَصِيب — naṣīb, share, portion (m.); genitive in annexation 'the fullest share'
وَسَمِعَ: وَ + سَمِعَ — wa-, and; samiʿa, to hear; 3rd m. perfect
أَنَّكِ: أَنَّ + كِ — anna, that; -ki, you (f.); 'that you'
قَوْمِكِ: قَوْم + كِ — qawm, people, tribe (m.); -ki, your (f.)
سَيِّدُ: سَيِّد — sayyid, lord, chief (m.); in annexation 'lord of'
قَوْمِهِ: قَوْم + هِ — qawm, people; -hi, his; 'his people'
يَصِلَ: يَصِلَ — waṣala, to join, connect; 3rd m. subjunctive after an, 'to join'
بِحَبْلِكِ: بِـ + حَبْل + كِ — bi-, with (prep.; 'join to'); ḥabl, rope; -ki, your (f.); 'to your rope'
اجْتِمَاعِي: اجْتِمَاع + ـي — ijtimāʿ, meeting, coming together (m.); -ī, my; 'my meeting'
وَيُرِيدُ: وَ + يُرِيدُ — wa-, and; arāda (IV), to want; 3rd m. imperfect
بِسُنَّةِ: بِـ + سُنَّة — bi-, according to, in accordance with (prep.); sunna, custom, path (f.)
الْحَلَالِ: الـ + حَلَال — ḥalāl, the lawful (m.); 'the lawful'
عَيْبٍ: عَيْب — ʿayb, fault, blemish (m.); genitive after min ('any')
نَجَوَّبَتْ: نَجَوَّبَتْ — (obscure) 3rd f. sing. perfect of a verb I cannot identify; perhaps a garble of tajawwabat, 'was entered, was pierced through'
وَصَفَّقَتْ: وَ + صَفَّقَتْ — wa-, and; ṣaffaqa (II), to clap; 3rd f. sing. perfect
مَلِيحُ: مَلِيح — malīḥ, fair, comely (m.); first term of annexation
الشَّبَابِ: الـ + شَبَاب — shabāb, youth (m.); 'fair of youth'; also collective, 'young men': aḥsana mā yakūnu mina al-shabābi, 'the handsomest of young men' (Night 194)
نَقِيُّ: نَقِيّ — naqiyy, clean, pure (m.); first term of annexation
الْأَثْوَابِ: الـ + أَثْوَاب — athwāb, garments (pl. of thawb); 'clean of garments'
وَحُسْنٍ: وَ + حُسْن — wa-, and; ḥusn, beauty (m.)
وَرَخِيمُ: وَ + رَخِيم — wa-, and; rakhīm, soft, tender (m.); first term of annexation
الدَّلَالِ: الـ + دَلَال — dalāl, coquettishness, charm (m.); 'soft of coquetry'
كَقَوْسِ: كَـ + قَوْس — ka-, like (prep.); qaws, bow (f.); 'like the bow of'
نَبَّالٍ: نَبَّال — nabbāl, archer, arrow-maker (m.); 'of an archer'
تَخْتَلِسُ: تَخْتَلِسُ — ikhtalasa (VIII), to snatch, steal; 3rd f. sing. imperfect
الْقُلُوبَ: الـ + قُلُوب — qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb); 'the hearts'
بِالسِّحْرِ: بِـ + الـ + سِحْر — bi-, with, by means of (prep.); siḥr, magic (m.); 'with the magic'
وَاصِفِيهِ: وَاصِفِي + هِ — wāṣifī, those who describe (pl. act. part. of waṣafa, in annexation); -hi, him; 'his describers'
وَجْهٌ: وَجْه — wajh, face (m.), nom. indef.; 'a face'
كَوَجْهِ: كَـ + وَجْه — ka-, like (prep., 'like', governs the genitive) + wajh, face (m.), gen. in idāfa; 'like the face of'
الْهِلَالِ: الـ + هِلَال — hilāl, crescent moon (m.); 'the crescent'
وَآثَارُ: وَ + آثَار — wa-, and + āthār, traces, marks (pl. of athar); 'and the traces of'
كَاللَّآلِي: كَـ + الـ + لَآلِي — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + laʾālī, pearls (pl. of luʾluʾa); 'like pearls'
قَائِلِهِ: قَائِل + هِ — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part. of qāla), gen. + -hi, its; 'its sayer'
تَبَارَكَ: تَبَارَكَ — tabāraka, he is blessed (VI perf.); 'blessed is'
بِحُسْنٍ: بِـ + حُسْن — bi-, in, in respect of (prep.) + ḥusn, beauty (m.); 'in beauty'
جَلَّ: جَلَّ — jalla, he is exalted (perf.); 'exalted is'
صَاغَهُ: صَاغَ + هُ — ṣāgha, he fashioned (perf.) + -hu, him; 'fashioned him'
مُنْفَرِدًا: مُنْفَرِد — munfarid, alone, unique (VII act. part.), acc. of state; 'alone'
جَمَالِهِ: جَمَال + هِ — jamāl, beauty (m.), gen. after fī + -hi, his; 'in his beauty'
تَاهُوا: تَاهَ + وا — tāha, he is lost, bewildered (perf.) + -ū, they; 'are lost in wonder'
الْحُسْنُ: الـ + حُسْن — ḥusn, beauty (m.), nom. subject; 'beauty'
وَجْنَتِهِ: وَجْنَة + هِ — wajna, cheek (f.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his cheek'
أَشْهَدُأَنْ: أَشْهَدُ + أَنْ — ashhadu, I bear witness (impf. 1sg) + an, that (conj.), printed as one word; 'I bear witness that'
مَلِيحَ: مَلِيح — malīḥ, handsome, fair (adj.), acc. after lā; 'handsome one'
وَحَبَّبْتُهُ: وَ + حَبَّبَ + تُ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥabbaba, he made dear (II perf.) + -tu, I + -hu, him; 'and I grew fond of him'
بِجَانِبِي: بِـ + جَانِب + ي — bi-, at, beside (prep. of place) + jānib, side (m.) + -ī, my; 'at my side'
وَتَحَدَّثْتُ: وَ + تَحَدَّثَ + تُ — wa-, and + taḥaddatha, he conversed (V perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I talked'
صَفَّقَتِ: صَفَّقَ + تِ — ṣaffaqa, he clapped his hands (II perf.) + -t, fem. ending; 'clapped'
بِخُرَسْتَانٍ: بِـ + خُرَسْتَان — bi-, after idhā of surprise this marks only what suddenly appears + khurastān, closet, cupboard (Persian-derived word); 'a closet'
قَاضٍ: قَاضٍ — qāḍin, judge, qadi (m., defective noun), nom. indef.; 'a judge'
شُهُودٍ: شُهُود — shuhūd, witnesses (pl. of shāhid), gen. in idāfa; 'witnesses'
انْصَرَفُوا: انْصَرَفَ + وا — inṣarafa, he departed (VII perf.) + -ū, they; 'they went away'
مُبَارَكَةٌ: مُبَارَكَة — mubāraka, blessed (III pass. part., f.); 'blessed'
أَشْرِطُ: أَشْرِطُ — ashriṭu, I stipulate, lay as a condition (impf. 1sg of sharaṭa); 'I lay'
الشَّرْطُ: الـ + شَرْط — sharṭ, condition (m.), nom.; 'the condition'
وَأَحْضَرَ: وَ + أَحْضَرَ — wa-, and + aḥḍara, he brought (IV perf.); 'and brought'
مُصْحَفًا: مُصْحَف — muṣḥaf, codex, copy of the Qurʾan (m.), acc.; 'a Qurʾan-codex'
احْلِفِي: احْلِفِي — iḥlifī, swear! (imper. f.s. of ḥalafa); 'swear'
لَاتَنْظُرِي: لَا + تَنْظُرِي — lā, not (neg.), printed fused + tanẓurī, you (f.) look (impf. 2fs, the final -na dropped, Middle Arabic); 'you do not look'
تَمِيلِي: تَمِيلِي — tamīlī, you (f.) incline (impf. 2fs of māla, final -na dropped); 'incline'
فَحَلَفْتُ: فَ + حَلَفَ + تُ — fa-, and so + ḥalafa, he swore + -tu, I; 'so I swore'
وَعَانَقَنِي: وَ + عَانَقَ + نِي — wa-, and + ʿānaqa, he embraced (III perf.) + -nī, me; 'and embraced me'
مَحَبَّتُهُ: مَحَبَّة + هُ — maḥabba, love (f.), nom. + -hu, of him (objective genitive); 'love of him'
مَجَامِعَ: مَجَامِع — majāmiʿ, gathering-places, all the parts (pl. of majmaʿ), acc. object, first term of idāfa; 'the very places of'
اكْتَفَيْنَا: اكْتَفَى + نَا — iktafā, he was satisfied (VIII perf.) + -nā, we; 'we were satisfied'
فَأَخَذَنِي: فَ + أَخَذَ + نِي — fa-, and so + akhadha, he took + -nī, me; 'and took me'
هَنَأٍ: هَنَأ — hanaʾ, ease, comfort (for هَنَاء, printed with hamza and no alif), gen. after fī; 'ease'
وَسُرُورٍ: وَ + سُرُور — wa-, and + surūr, gladness (m.), gen.; 'and gladness'
اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ: اسْتَأْذَنَ + تُ + هُ — istaʾdhana, he asked leave (X perf.) + -tu, I + -hu, him; 'I asked his leave'
أَسِيرُ: أَسِيرُ — asīru, I go (impf. 1sg of sāra); 'I go'
وَأَشْتَرِي: وَ + أَشْتَرِي — wa-, and + ashtarī, I buy (VIII impf. 1sg); 'and buy'
قُمَاشٍ: قُمَاش — qumāsh, cloth, stuff (m.), gen. indef. in idāfa; 'cloth'
الرَّوَاحِ: الـ + رَوَاح — rawāḥ, going, going out (m.), gen. after fī; 'the going'
فَتَزَيَّرْتُ: فَ + تَزَيَّرْ + تُ — fa-, and so + tazayyara, printed for tazayyana, to adorn oneself (V perf.) + -tu, I; 'so I adorned myself'
الْعَجُوزَ: الـ + عَجُوز — ʿajūz, old woman (f.), acc. (object, or subject after inna); 'the old woman'
وَجَارِيَةً: وَ + جَارِيَة — wa-, and + jāriya, slave-girl, maid (f.), acc.; 'and a maid'
تَاجِرٍ: تَاجِر — tājir, merchant (m.), gen. adjective/apposition; 'a merchant'
تَعْرِفُهُ: تَعْرِف + هُ — taʿrifu, she knows (impf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'knew him'
أَبُوهُ: أَب + هُ — ab, father (nom., abū in construct) + -hu, his; 'his father'
مَتْجَرٌ: مَتْجَر — matjar, trade, store (m.), nom. indef.; 'a store'
طَلَبْتِهِ: طَلَبَ + تِ + هُ — ṭalaba, he sought (perf.) + -ti, you (f.) + -hu, it (resumptive); 'you seek it'
تَجِدُهُ: تَجِد + هُ — tajidu, you find (impf. 2sg) + -hu, it; 'you will find it'
قُمَاشِهِ: قُمَاش + هِ — qumāsh, cloth (m.), gen. after min + -hi, his; 'his cloth'
أَعَزَّ: أَعَزّ — aʿazz, most precious, dearest (elative of ʿazīz), acc. object, first term of idāfa; 'the dearest'
الْقُمَاشِ: الـ + قُمَاش — qumāsh, cloth (m.), gen. after min; 'the cloth'
لِهَذِهِ: لِـ + هَذِهِ — li-, for (marks who the goods are for) + hādhihi, this (f.); 'for this'
فَشَكَرَتْ: فَ + شَكَرَتْ — fa-, and so + shakarat, she thanked, praised (perf. 3fs); 'so she praised'
بِشُكْرِكِ: بِـ + شُكْر + كِ — bi-, for, of (prep.; ḥāja bi- 'need of') + shukr, thanks, praise (m.), gen. + -ki, you (f.); 'of your praise'
وَمُرَادُنَا: وَ + مُرَاد + نَا — wa-, and + murād, wish, aim (m.), nom. + -nā, our; 'and our wish'
نَأْخُذُ: نَأْخُذُ — naʾkhudhu, we take (impf. 1pl.), without an: 'is that we take'
حَاجَتَنَا: حَاجَة + نَا — ḥāja, need, what we need (f.), acc. + -nā, our; 'our need'
وَنَعُودُ: وَ + نَعُودُ — wa-, and + naʿūdu, we return (impf. 1pl. of ʿāda); 'and return'
فَأَخْرَجَ: فَ + أَخْرَجَ — fa-, and so + akhraja, he brought out (IV perf.); 'so he brought out'
مَاطَلَبْنَاهُ: مَا + طَلَبَ + نَا + هُ — mā, what (printed fused) + ṭalaba, asked for + -nā, we + -hu, it; 'what we asked for'
وَأَخْرَجْنَا: وَ + أَخْرَجَ + نَا — wa-, and + akhraja, brought out + -nā, we; 'and we brought out'
الدَّرَاهِمَ: الـ + دَرَاهِم — darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of dirham), acc. object; 'the dirhams'
فَأَبَى: فَ + أَبَى — fa-, and so + abā, he refused (perf.); 'but he refused'
ضِيَافَتُكُمُ: ضِيَافَة + كُمْ — ḍiyāfa, hospitality (f.), nom. + -kum, your (pl.); 'your hospitality'
أُعْطِيهِ: أُعْطِي + هِ — uʿṭī, I give (IV impf. 1sg) + -hi, him (dative); 'I give him'
آخُذُ: آخُذُ — ākhudhu, I take (impf. 1sg; printed with آ); 'I take'
هَدِيَّةٌ: هَدِيَّة — hadiyya, gift (f.), nom. indef.; 'a gift'
بَوْسَةٍ: بَوْسَة — bawsa, a kiss (f.), gen. after fī; 'kiss'
يُفِيدُكَ: يُفِيد + كَ — yufīdu, he/it benefits (IV impf. 3ms) + -ka, you (m.); 'profits you'
الْبَوْسَةِ: الـ + بَوْسَة — bawsa, kiss (f.), gen. after min; 'the kiss'
سَمِعْتِ: سَمِعَ + تِ — samiʿa, he heard + -ti, you (f.); 'you have heard'
يُصِيبُكِ: يُصِيب + كِ — yuṣību, it befalls (IV impf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'befalls you'
بَوْسَةً: بَوْسَة — bawsa, kiss (f.), acc. object; 'a kiss'
وَتَأْخُذِي: وَ + تَأْخُذِي — wa-, and + taʾkhudhī, you (f.) take (impf. 2fs, final -na dropped); 'and you take'
تَطْلُبِيهِ: تَطْلُبِي + هِ — taṭlubī, you (f.) seek (impf. 2fs, -na dropped) + -hi, it; 'you seek'
حَالِفَةٌ: حَالِفَة — ḥālifa, one who has sworn (act. part. f. of ḥalafa); 'one who has sworn'
خَلِّيهِ: خَلِّي + هِ — khallī, let! (imper. of khallā, II) + -hi, him; 'let him'
يَبُوسُكِ: يَبُوس + كِ — yabūsu, he kisses (impf. 3ms of bāsa) + -ki, you (f.); 'kiss you'
زَٰلَتْ: زَٰلَتْ — zālat, she ceased (perf. 3fs of zāla, spelled without alif so a dagger alif is added); 'lā zālat: she did not cease'
أَدْخَلْتُ: أَدْخَلَ + تُ — adkhala, he put in (IV perf.) + -tu, I; 'I put in'
الْجِرَابَ: الـ + جِرَاب — jirāb, bag, sack (m.), acc. (second object); 'the bag'
وَرَضِيتُ: وَ + رَضِيَ + تُ — wa-, and + raḍiya, he was content (perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I agreed'
غَطَّيْتُ: غَطَّى + تُ — ghaṭṭā, he covered (II perf.) + -tu, I; 'I covered'
وَدَارَيْتُ: وَ + دَارَى + تُ — wa-, and + dārā, he shielded, screened (III perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I shielded'
بِطَرَفِ: بِـ + طَرَف — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + ṭaraf, edge, end (m.), gen., first term of idāfa; 'with the edge of'
إِزَارِي: إِزَار + ي — izār, wrap, cloak (m.), gen. + -ī, my; 'my wrap'
حَدِّي: حَدّ + ي — ḥadd, edge (m.), gen. after ʿalā + -ī, my; printed for khaddī 'my cheek'; 'my cheek'
بَاسَنِى: بَاسَ + نِي — bāsa, he kissed (perf.) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'he kissed me'
عَضَّنِي: عَضَّ + نِي — ʿaḍḍa, he bit (perf.) + -nī, me; 'bit me'
اللَّحْمَةَ: الـ + لَحْمَة — laḥma, piece of flesh (f.), acc. object; 'the flesh'
فَغُشِيَ: فَ + غُشِيَ — fa-, and so + ghushiya, it was covered (pass. of ghashiya), with ʿalayya 'I swooned'; 'and I fainted'
أَخَذَتْنِي: أَخَذَ + تْ + نِي — akhadha, took + -at, she + -nī, me; 'took me'
حِضْنِهَا: حِضْن + هَا — ḥiḍn, lap, bosom (m.), gen. after fī + -hā, her; 'her lap'; here: akhadhathu fī ḥiḍnihā, 'she took him into her arms'
الدُّكَّانَ: الـ + دُكَّان — dukkān, shop (m., here treated as f.), acc. object; 'the shop'
مَقْفُولَةً: مَقْفُولَة — maqfūla, locked, shut (pass. part. f. of qafala, colloquial form), acc. of state; 'shut'
وَالْعَجُوزُ: وَ + الـ + عَجُوز — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while') + al-, the + ʿajūz, old woman (f.), nom.; 'while the old woman'
الْحُزْنَ: الـ + حُزْن — ḥuzn, grief (m.), acc. object; 'grief'
دَفَعَ: دَفَعَ — dafaʿa, he warded off, repelled (perf.); 'has warded off'
وَشُدِّي: وَ + شُدِّي — wa-, and + shuddī, brace, tighten! (imper. f.s. of shadda); 'and brace'
رُوحَكِ: رُوح + كِ — rūḥ, soul (f.), acc. object + -ki, your; 'your soul, yourself'
تَنْفَضِحِي: تَنْفَضِحِي — tanfaḍiḥī, you (f.) are disgraced (VII subj. 2fs); 'you be shamed'
وَصَلْتِ: وَصَلَ + تِ — waṣala, he arrived (perf.) + -ti, you (f.); 'you arrive'
ارْقُدِي: ارْقُدِي — irqudī, lie down! (imper. f.s. of raqada); 'lie down'
وَتَضَاعَفِي: وَ + تَضَاعَفِي — wa-, and + taḍāʿafī, imper. f.s. of a form VI verb, obscure; read 'make yourself out to be'; 'and pretend'
مَرِيضَةً: مَرِيضَة — marīḍa, sick (f.), acc. of state; 'sick'
وَارْمِي: وَ + ارْمِي — wa-, and + irmī, throw, cast! (imper. f.s. of ramā); 'and throw'
الْغَطَا: الـ + غَطَا — ghaṭā, cover, coverlet (for al-ghiṭāʾ), acc. object; 'the cover'
بِدَوَاءٍ: بِـ + دَوَاء — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi- 'bring') + dawāʾ, medicine (m.), gen.; 'with a medicine (bringing one)'
تُدَاوِي: تُدَاوِي — tudāwī, you treat, heal (III impf. 2sg); 'you treat'
الْعَضَّةَ: الـ + عَضَّة — ʿaḍḍa, bite (f.), acc. object; 'the bite'
فَتَبْرَىءُ: فَ + تَبْرَىءُ — fa-, and so + tabraʾu, it (the bite) heals (impf. 3fs of bariʾa; printed with ى before the hamza); 'and it will heal'
مَكَانِي: مَكَان + ي — makān, place (m.), gen. after min + -ī, my; 'my place'; also: acc. of place, 'in my place' (lam azal mulqan makānī, 'I have lain cast down where I am')
الْفِكْرِ: الـ + فِكْر — fikr, thought, anxiety (m.), gen.; 'anxiety'
وَاشْتَدَّ: وَ + اشْتَدَّ — wa-, and + ishtadda, it grew strong (VIII perf.); 'and grew strong'
الْبَيْتَ: الـ + بَيْت — bayt, house (m.), acc.; 'the house' Also 'room': an yafrishū al-bayta, 'to spread the room (with furnishings)'.
بِزَوْجِي: بِـ + زَوْج + ي — bi-, after idhā of surprise, marks the one who appears + zawj, husband (m.) + -ī, my; 'my husband'
أَصَابَكِ: أَصَابَ + كِ — aṣāba, it befell (IV perf.) + -ki, you (f.); 'befell you'
الْخَرْجَةِ: الـ + خَرْجَة — kharja, outing, going out (f.); 'the outing'
طَيِّبَةٌ: طَيِّبَة — ṭayyiba, well, in good health (f.); 'well'
وَجَعٌ: وَجَع — wajaʿ, pain (m.), nom. indef.; 'a pain'
فَأَوْقَدَ: فَ + أَوْقَدَ — fa-, and so + awqada, he lit (IV perf.); 'and lit'
وَقَرَّبَ: وَ + قَرَّبَ — wa-, and + qarraba, he drew near (II perf.); 'and came near'
الْجُرْحُ: الـ + جُرْح — jurḥ, wound (m.), nom.; 'the wound'
خَدِّكِ: خَدّ + كِ — khadd, cheek (m.), gen. after fī + -ki, your (f.); 'your cheek'
النَّاعِمِ: الـ + نَاعِم — nāʿim, soft, tender (adj.), gen.; 'the tender'
اسْتَأْذَنْتُكَ: اسْتَأْذَنَ + تُ + كَ — istaʾdhana, asked leave of (X perf.) + -tu, I + -ka, you (m.); 'I asked your leave'
أَشْتَرِي: أَشْتَرِي — ashtarī, I buy (VIII impf. 1sg), used for purpose without a particle; 'to buy'
الْقُمَاشَ: الـ + قُمَاش — qumāsh, cloth (m.), acc. object; 'the cloth'
زَاحَمَنِي: زَاحَمَ + نِي — zāḥama, he jostled (III perf.) + -nī, me; 'jostled me'
جَمَلُ: جَمَل — jamal, camel (m.), nom., first term of idāfa; 'a camel'
حَطَبٍ: حَطَب — ḥaṭab, firewood (m.), gen. in idāfa; 'of firewood'
فَشَرْمَطَ: فَ + شَرْمَطَ — fa-, and so + sharmaṭa, he tore to shreds (quadriliteral perf.); 'and it shredded'
نِقَابِي: نِقَاب + ي — niqāb, veil (m.), acc. object + -ī, my; 'my veil'
وَجَرَحَ: وَ + جَرَحَ — wa-, and + jaraḥa, he wounded (perf.); 'and wounded'
كَمَاتَرَى: كَـ + مَا + تَرَى — ka-, as (prep. with mā, 'as') + mā, what, printed fused + tarā, you see (impf. 2sg); 'as you see'
ضَيِّقٌ: ضَيِّق — ḍayyiq, narrow, cramped (adj.), nom. predicate; 'cramped'
لِلْحَاكِمِ: لِـ + الـ + حَاكِم — li-, to (prep. of direction; rāḥa li- 'go to') + al-, the + ḥākim, ruler, governor (act. part. of ḥakama); 'to the governor'
يَشْنُقُ: يَشْنُقُ — yashnuqu, he hangs (impf. 3ms of shanaqa; bare present in place of a command 'let him hang'); 'to hang'
حَطَّابٍ: حَطَّاب — ḥaṭṭāb, woodcutter (m.), gen. in idāfa after kull; 'woodcutter'
تَحْتَمِلْ: تَحْتَمِلْ — taḥtamil, you bear, take on (VIII jussive after lā); 'do not take on'
خَطِيئَةَ: خَطِيئَة — khaṭīʾa, sin, guilt (f.), acc. object, first term of idāfa; 'the guilt of'
رَكِبْتُ: رَكِبَ + تُ — rakiba, he rode (perf.) + -tu, I; 'I rode'
فَعَثَرَ: فَ + عَثَرَ — fa-, and so + ʿathara, he stumbled (perf.); 'and it stumbled'
فَصَادَفَنِي: فَ + صَادَفَ + نِي — fa-, and so + ṣādafa, he chanced on (III perf.) + -nī, me; 'and it met me'
جَرَحَنِي: جَرَحَ + نِي — jaraḥa, he wounded + -nī, me; 'wounded me'
أَطْلَعُ: أَطْلَعُ — aṭlaʿu, I go up (impf. 1sg of ṭalaʿa); 'I go up'
الْبَرْمَكِيِّ: الـ + بَرْمَكِيّ — Barmakī, of the Barmakids, Barmakid (nisba), gen.; 'the Barmakid'
وَأَحْكِي: وَ + أَحْكِي — wa-, and + aḥkī, I relate (impf. 1sg of ḥakā); 'and tell'
فَيَقْتُلُ: فَ + يَقْتُلُ — fa-, and so, then + yaqtulu, he kills (impf. 3ms); 'and he will kill'
تُضِيعُ: تُضِيعُ — tuḍīʿu, you destroy, ruin (IV impf. 2ms of ḍāʿa); 'ruin'
كُلَّهُمْ: كُلّ + هُمْ — kull, all (m.), acc. apposition + -hum, them; 'all of them'
بِقَضَاءِ: بِـ + قَضَاء — bi-, by, through (prep. of agency) + qaḍāʾ, decree (m.), gen., first term of idāfa; 'by the decree of'
وَقَدَرِهِ: وَ + قَدَر + هِ — wa-, and + qadar, ordaining, fate (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'and his ordaining'
وَلَحَّ: وَ + لَحَّ — wa-, and + laḥḥa, he pressed, insisted (perf.); 'and he pressed'
بِالْكَلَامِ: بِـ + الـ + كَلَام — bi-, with (prep.; laḥḥa ʿalā bi- 'press upon someone with') + al-, the + kalām, talk (m.); 'with talk' Also bi- of the means: yusallī nafsahu … bi-al-kalāmi, 'diverting himself with talk'. Also after lawwaḥa, 'to hint', bi- marks the means: lawwaḥat lahu bi-al-kalāmi, 'she let fall hints to him in her talk'.
فَنَفَرْتُ: فَ + نَفَرَ + تُ — fa-, and so + nafara, he shied away (perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I shrank'
وَأَغْلَظْتُ: وَ + أَغْلَظَ + تُ — wa-, and + aghlaẓa, he made harsh (IV perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I made harsh'
بِحَالِى: بِـ + حَال + ى — bi-, of (prep.; ʿalima bi- 'learn of, know about') + ḥāl, state, condition (m.), gen. + -ī, my (printed ى); 'of my condition'
خُنْتِى: خُنْتِى — khunti, you (f.) betrayed, broke (perf. 2fs of khāna; the -ī is printed with ى); 'you have broken'
الْيَمِينَ: الـ + يَمِين — yamīn, oath (f.), acc. object; 'the oath'
صَيْحَةً: صَيْحَة — ṣayḥa, cry (f.), acc. cognate object; 'a cry'
فَانْفَتَحَ: فَ + انْفَتَحَ — fa-, and so + infataḥa, it opened (VII perf.); 'and opened'
سُودٍ: سُود — sūd, black (pl. of aswad), gen. adjective; 'black'
وَأَمَرَهُمْ: وَ + أَمَرَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + amara, he commanded (perf.) + -hum, them; 'and he commanded them'
فَسَحَبُونِي: فَ + سَحَبَ + وا + نِي — fa-, and so + saḥaba, he dragged (perf.) + -ū, they + -nī, me; 'and they dragged me'
فِرْشِي: فِرْش + ي — firsh, bedding (m.), gen. after min + -ī, my (printed for firāshī); 'my bedding'
وَرَمَوْنِي: وَ + رَمَى + وا + نِي — wa-, and + ramā, he threw (perf.) + -ū, they + -nī, me; 'and they threw me'
يُمْسِكَنِي: يُمْسِكَ + نِي — an yumsika-nī, that he hold: yumsika, he holds (IV subj.) + -nī, me; 'to hold me'
وَيَجْلِسَ: وَ + يَجْلِسَ — wa-, and + yajlisa, that he sit (subj. 3ms); 'and sit'
يَجْلِسَ: يَجْلِسَ — yajlisa, that he sit (subj. 3ms); 'to sit'
وَيُمْسِكَ: وَ + يُمْسِكَ — wa-, and + yumsika, that he hold (IV subj.); 'and hold'
اضْرِبْهَا: اضْرِبْ + هَا — iḍrib, strike! (imper.) + -hā, her; 'strike her'
اقْسِمْهَا: اقْسِمْ + هَا — iqsim, divide! (imper. of qasama) + -hā, her; 'divide her'
يَرْمِيهَا: يَرْمِي + هَا — yarmī, he throws (impf. of ramā) + -hā, it; 'throws it'
الدِّجْلَةِ: الـ + دِجْلَة — Dijla, the Tigris (with al-), gen. in idāfa; 'the Tigris'
يَأْكُلُهَا: يَأْكُلُ + هَا — yaʾkulu, he eats (impf. of akala) + -hā, it; 'eat it'
جَزَاءُ: جَزَاء — jazāʾ, recompense (m.), nom., first term of idāfa; 'the recompense of'
يَخُونُ: يَخُونُ — yakhūnu, he betrays (impf. of khāna); 'betrays'
وَالْمَوَدَّةَ: وَ + الـ + مَوَدَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + mawadda, affection (f.), acc.; 'and the affection'
غَضَبُهُ: غَضَب + هُ — ghaḍab, anger (m.), nom. + -hu, his; 'his anger'
أُحِبُّ: أُحِبُّ — uḥibbu, I love (imperf. 1st sg., form IV, root ح ب ب); 'I love'
مُشَارِكًا: مُشَارِكًا — mushārikan, sharer, partner (act. part. form III, acc. as predicate of كَانَ)
مَنَعْتُ: مَنَعْتُ — manaʿtu, I forbade, denied (perfect 1st sg.; takes two accusatives); also: with min for what is prevented and the persons kept out marked by li- (a Middle Arabic use): manaʿtu anā li-al-jawārī mina al-dukhūli, 'I kept the slave-girls from going in'
وَلَوْا: وَ + لَوْ — wa-, and + law, even if (conditional); the final alif is printed as part of the run, see note; 'and even if'
تَلَفَهُ: تَلَفَ + هُ — talaf, ruin, destruction (read with the preceding alif as أَتْلَفَهُ, 'destroyed it'); see note
وَجْدِي: وَجْد + ي — wajd, passionate longing (m.) + -ī, my; 'my longing'
مُوتِي: مُوتِي — mūtī, die! (imperative f. sg. of مَاتَ, addressed to the soul)
كَرِيمَةً: كَرِيمَةً — karīma, noble, generous (f., acc. as a state); 'nobly'
خَيْرَ: خَيْر — khayr, good (m., acc. after لَا of total negation)
حُبٍّ: حُبّ — ḥubb, love (m., gen. after فِي)
ضِدٍّ: ضِدّ — ḍidd, opposite, contrary, adversary (m., gen.); 'an opposite'
سَعْدُ: سَعْد — Saʿd, a personal name (nom. after يَا), presumably the slave
اذْكُرِي: اُذْكُرِي — udhkurī, mention, pronounce! (imperative f. sg. of ذَكَرَ, root ذ ك ر)
الشَّهَادَةَ: الـ + شَّهَادَة — al-, the + shahāda, testimony, profession of faith; also martyrdom (death as a witness for the faith: ṭalabtu al-shahādata, 'I sought martyrdom') (f., acc. as object); 'the testimony'
وَمَاكَانَ: وَ + مَا + كَانَ — wa-, and + mā, not (negative) + kāna, was (printed run together): wa-mā kāna li-nafsin an tamūta, 'and it is not for any soul to die' (Qurʾān 3:145). Elsewhere mā, what (rel., 'that which'): 'and what there was'
الْحَوَائِجِ: الـ + حَوَائِج — al-, the + ḥawāʾij, needs, wants (pl. of حَاجَة, f., gen. after مِنَ); 'of the needs'
أَخْبِرِينَابِهِ: أَخْبِرِي + نَا + بِـ + هِ — akhbirī, tell! (imperative f. sg., form IV) + -nā, us + bi-, of/about (prep.; the verb أَخْبَرَ takes بِـ for the thing told) + -hi, it; 'tell us of it'
آخِرُ: آخِر — ākhir, last, end (m., nom.; the archive prints آ); 'the last'
حَيَوٰتِكِ: حَيَوٰة + ِكِ — ḥayāt, life (f., printed with ت and pointed with a dagger alif, like صَلَوٰة) + -ki, your (f.); 'of your life'
عَبْدَ: عَبْد — ʿabd, slave, servant (m., acc. because it is the first term of an annexation after يَا)
تَمَهَّلْ: تَمَهَّلْ — tamahhal, take your time, wait! (imperative, form V, root م ه ل)
أُوصِيَكَ: أُوصِي + كَ — ūṣī, I charge, give a last instruction (imperf. 1st sg., form IV, root و ص ي; subjunctive after أَنْ (here an ūṣiyaka) or حَتَّى) + -ka, you (m.); 'I charge you'
فَرَفَعْتُ: فَ + رَفَعْتُ — fa-, and so + rafaʿtu, I raised (perfect 1st sg.); 'so I raised'
الذُّلِّ: الـ + ذُّلّ — al-, the + dhull, abasement, humiliation (m., gen. after فِي); 'abasement'
فَجَرَتْ: فَ + جَرَتْ — fa-, and so + jarat, it ran, flowed (perfect 3rd f. sg. of جَرَى); 'and so ran'
عَبْرَتِي: عَبْرَة + ي — ʿabra, tear (f.) + -ī, my; 'my tear'
بِعَيْنِ: بِـ + عَيْن — bi-, with (prep., manner: 'with an eye of') + ʿayn, eye (f., gen., first term of annexation); 'with the eye of'
الْغَضَبِ: الـ + غَضَب — al-, the + ghaḍab, anger (m., gen. as second term of annexation); 'of anger'
مَلَّ: مَلَّ — malla, he grew weary of (perfect 3rd m. sg., root م ل ل; takes a direct object)
وَصْلَنَا: وَصْل + نَا — waṣl, joining, union (m.; acc. object) + -nā, our; 'our joining'
وَجَفَانَا: وَ + جَفَا + نَا — wa-, and + jafā, he shunned (perfect 3rd m. sg., root ج ف و) + -nā, us; 'and shunned us'
وَارْتَضَى: وَ + ارْتَضَى — wa-, and + irtaḍā, he was content with, chose (perfect 3rd m. sg., form VIII, root ر ض و); 'and was content'
خَلِيلًا: خَلِيل — khalīl, close friend, lover (m., acc. object); 'a friend'
سِوَانَا: سِوَى + نَا — siwā, other than, besides (acc., takes a genitive) + -nā, us; 'other than us'
بْٔسُنَا: بَأْس + نَا — baʾs, distress, hardship (m.; the archive prints no hamza, see note) + -nā, our; 'our distress'
بْٔسِكَ: بَأْس + كَ — baʾs, distress (m., gen. after قَبْلَ) + -ka, your (m.); 'your distress'
كَفَانَا: كَفَى + نَا — kafā, it sufficed (perfect 3rd m. sg., root ك ف ي) + -nā, us; 'sufficed us'
سَمِعْتُهُ: سَمِعْتُ + هُ — samiʿtu, I heard (perfect 1st sg.) + -hu, him; 'I heard him'; also with -hu for a thing: alladhī samiʿtuhu, 'which I heard' (the news) (Night 193)
هَذِةِ: هَذِهِ — hādhihi, these (f. demonstrative, agreeing with a non-human plural; the archive prints ة for the final ه); 'these'; also singular: 'this' (f. sg.)
أَقَمْتُمْ: أَقَمْتُمْ — aqamtum, you set up, raised (perfect 2nd m. pl., form IV, root ق و م)
فِرَاقِي: فِرَاق + ي — firāq, parting, separation (m., acc. object) + -ī, my; 'my parting'
وَقَعَدْتُمْ: وَ + قَعَدْتُمْ — wa-, and + qaʿadtum, you sat (perfect 2nd m. pl.); 'and you sat'
وَأَسْهَرْتُمْ: وَ + أَسْهَرْتُمْ — wa-, and + asharhtum, you kept awake (perfect 2nd m. pl., form IV, root س ه ر); 'and you kept awake'
جَفْنِي: جَفْن + ي — jafn, eyelid (m.) + -ī, my; 'my eyelid'
الْقَرِيحَ: الـ + قَرِيح — al-, the + qarīḥ, wounded, sore (adj., acc., agreeing with جَفْنِي); 'the sore'
