وَنِمْتُمْ: وَ + نِمْتُمْ — wa-, and + nimtum, you slept (perfect 2nd m. pl. of نَامَ); 'and you slept'
وَأَلْفَيْتُمْ: وَ + أَلْفَيْتُمْ — wa-, and + alfaytum, you found, met with (perfect 2nd m. pl., form IV, root ل ف ي); 'and you found'
السُّهَادِ: الـ + سُّهَاد — al-, the + suhād, sleeplessness (m., gen.); 'the sleeplessness'
وَنَاظِرِي: وَ + نَاظِر + ي — wa-, and + nāẓir, eye, the seeing part (act. part., m.) + -ī, my; 'and my eye'
يَسْلَاكُمْ: يَسْلَا + كُمْ — yaslā, he forgets, is consoled for (imperf. 3rd m. sg., root س ل و) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'forgets you'
الدَّمْعُ: الـ + دَّمْع — al-, the + damʿ, tears, tear (m.); 'the tear'
وَعَاهَدْتُمُونِي: وَ + عَاهَدْتُمُو + نِي — wa-, and + ʿāhadtumū, you made a covenant with (perfect 2nd m. pl., form III, with the archaic long ending -ū) + -nī, me; 'and you pledged to me'
أَنَّكُمْ: أَنَّ + كُمْ — anna, that (introducing a clause) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'that you'
تُحْسِنُوا: تُحْسِنُوا — tuḥsinū, you do well, keep (imperf. 2nd m. pl., form IV, root ح س ن; the final nūn is missing in print); 'you would keep'
تَمَلَّكْتُمْ: تَمَلَّكْتُمْ — tamallaktum, you took possession of (perfect 2nd m. pl., form V, root م ل ك)
فُؤَادِي: فُؤَاد + ي — fuʾād, heart (m.) + -ī, my; 'my heart'
غَدَرْتُمْ: غَدَرْتُمْ — ghadartum, you betrayed (perfect 2nd m. pl.)
عَشِقْتُكُمْ: عَشِقْتُ + كُمْ — ʿashiqtu, I loved passionately (perfect 1st sg.) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I loved you'
طِفْلًا: طِفْل — ṭifl, child (m., acc. as a state); 'as a child'
أَدْرِ: أَدْرِ — adri, I know (jussive of أَدْرِي after لَمْ, root د ر ي)
تَقْتُلُونِي: تَقْتُلُو + نِي — taqtulū, you kill (imperf. 2nd m. pl., jussive form after لَا of prohibition) + -nī, me; 'do not kill me'
إِنَّنِي: إِنَّ + نِي — inna, indeed (emphatic particle) + -nī, me; 'indeed I'
مُتَعَلِّمُ: مُتَعَلِّم — mutaʿallim, learner, one who is learning (act. part. form V; pointed with the rhyme-vowel damma)
سَأَلْتُكُمُوا: سَأَلْتُ + كُمُوا — saʾaltu, I asked (perfect 1st sg.) + -kumū, you (m. pl., archaic long form); 'I ask you'
فَاكْتُبُوا: فَ + اكْتُبُوا — fa-, then (introducing the result of the condition) + uktubū, write! (imperative m. pl., root ك ت ب); 'then write'
لَوْحِ: لَوْح — lawḥ, tablet, board (m., gen. after عَلَى)
مُتَيَّمُ: مُتَيَّم — mutayyam, enslaved by love, love-struck (pass. part. form II; pointed with the rhyme-vowel damma)
شَجِيًّا: شَجِيّ — shajiyy, sorrowful, grieved (adj., acc. after لَعَلَّ); 'a sorrowful one'
عَارِفًا: عَارِف — ʿārif, knowing (act. part., acc. as an adjective, taking an object); 'who knows'
لَوْعَةَ: لَوْعَة — lawʿa, anguish, burning of love (f., acc. object of عَارِفًا, first term of annexation)
يَمُرُّ: يَمُرُّ — yamurru, he passes (imperf. 3rd m. sg. of مَرَّ; takes عَلَى 'past'); also with bi-, 'pass by': yamurru bihā (Night 194)
الْمُحِبِّ: الـ + مُحِبّ — al-, the + muḥibb, lover (act. part. form IV, m., gen., second term of annexation); 'of the lover'; here: gen. after min, 'from the lover'
فَيَرْحَمُ: فَ + يَرْحَمُ — fa-, and then + yarḥamu, he has mercy (imperf. 3rd m. sg., root ر ح م); 'and takes pity'
ازْدَادَ: اِزْدَادَ — izdāda, he increased, grew (perfect 3rd m. sg., form VIII, root ز ي د)
غَيْظِهِ: غَيْظ + هِ — ghayẓ, rage (m., gen. after عَلَى) + -hi, his; 'upon his rage' Also gen. after fī: wa-huwa fī ghayẓihi, 'and he in his rage'.
حَبِيبَ: حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved (m., acc. object, first term of annexation)
مَلَالَةٍ: مَلَالَة — malāla, weariness, boredom (f., gen., indefinite); 'weariness'
جَنَى: جَنَى — janā, he committed, perpetrated (perfect 3rd m. sg., root ج ن ي)
يُؤَدِّي: يُؤَدِّي — yuʾaddī, it leads (imperf. 3rd m. sg., form II, root أ د ي; takes إِلَى 'to'); the archive prints ؤ
التَّرْكِ: الـ + تَّرْك — al-, the + tark, leaving, abandonment (m., gen. after إِلَى); 'to the leaving'
شَرِيكًا: شَرِيك — sharīk, partner (m., acc. object); 'a partner'
وَإِيمَانُ: وَ + إِيمَان — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + īmān, faith (m., nom.; the archive prints إ); 'while the faith of'
الشِّرْكِ: الـ + شِّرْك — al-, the + shirk, associating partners with God, polytheism (m., gen. after إِلَى); 'to polytheism'
شِعْرِةِ: شِعْر + هِ — shiʿr, poetry (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -hi, his (the archive prints ة for ه); 'his poetry'
اخْدَعِيهِ: اِخْدَعِي + هِ — ikhdaʿī, deceive! (imperative f. sg., root خ د ع; self-address) + -hi, him; 'deceive him'
لَعَلَّهُ: لَعَلَّ + هُ — laʿalla, perhaps (governs an accusative) + -hu, he/him; 'perhaps he'
يُعْتِقُنِي: يُعْتِقُ + نِي — yuʿtiqu, he frees, sets free (imperf. 3rd m. sg., form IV, root ع ت ق) + -nī, me; 'will free me'
أَمْلِكُ: أَمْلِكُ — amliku, I own (imperf. 1st sg., root م ل ك); 'that I own'
شَكَوْتُ: شَكَوْتُ — shakawtu, I complained (perfect 1st sg. of شَكَا; takes إِلَى 'to')
أَجِدُهُ: أَجِدُ + هُ — ajidu, I find, experience (imperf. 1st sg., root و ج د) + -hu, it; 'I was finding'
وَحَقِّكَ: وَ + حَقّ + كَ — wa-, by (wāw of oath: 'by') + ḥaqq, right, truth (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your right'
أَنْصَفْتَنِي: أَنْصَفْتَ + نِي — anṣafta, you dealt justly (perfect 2nd m. sg., form IV, root ن ص ف) + -nī, me; 'you had dealt justly with me'
قَتَلْتَنِي: قَتَلْتَ + نِي — qatalta, you killed (perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; after in, 'if', a condition: in qataltanī, 'if you kill me'
مُنْصِفُ: مُنْصِف — munṣif, one who deals justly (act. part. form IV; pointed with the rhyme-vowel damma)
وَحَمَّلْتَنِي: وَ + حَمَّلْتَ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥammalta, you burdened (perfect 2nd m. sg., form II, root ح م ل) + -nī, me; 'and you burdened me'
ثِقْلَ: ثِقْل — thiql, weight, burden (m., acc. object, first term of annexation)
الْغَرَامِ: الـ + غَرَام — al-, the + gharām, passion, consuming love (m., gen.); 'of passion'
لَأَعْجَزُ: لَ + أَعْجَزُ — la-, indeed (emphatic prefix on the predicate after إِنَّ) + aʿjazu, I am unable, more helpless (imperf. 1st sg., root ع ج ز); 'I am truly unable'
حَمْلِ: حَمْل — ḥaml, carrying (m., verbal noun, gen. after عَنْ, first term of annexation)
الْقَمِيصِ: الـ + قَمِيص — al-, the + qamīṣ, shirt (m., gen. second term of annexation); 'of a shirt'
وَأَضْعَفُ: وَ + أَضْعَفُ — wa-, and + aḍʿafu, I am weaker (elative of ضَعِيف, root ض ع ف); 'and weaker'
عَجَبِي: عَجَب + ي — ʿajab, wonder, astonishment (m.) + -ī, my; 'my wonder'
إِتْلَافُ: إِتْلَاف — itlāf, destruction, ruin (m., verbal noun of form IV, first term of annexation)
لِجِسْمِي: لِـ + جِسْم + ي — li-, at, over (prep.: with عَجِبَ it marks what one wonders at) + jism, body (m.) + -ī, my; 'at my body'
بَعْدَكُمْ: بَعْدَ + كُمْ — baʿda, after (prep.) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'after you'
يُعْرَفُ: يُعْرَفُ — yuʿrafu, it is known, is recognised (imperf. 3rd m. sg. passive, root ع ر ف)
فَنَظَرَنِي: فَ + نَظَرَ + نِي — fa-, and then + naẓara, he looked (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me (direct object, where Classical would use إِلَيَّ); 'and he looked at me'
وَنَهَرَنِي: وَ + نَهَرَ + نِي — wa-, and + nahara, he rebuked, scolded (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and rebuked me'
وَشَتَمَنِي: وَ + شَتَمَ + نِي — wa-, and + shatama, he abused, cursed (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and abused me'
وَإِنَّنِي: وَ + إِنَّ + نِي — wa-, and + inna, indeed (emphatic particle) + -nī, me; 'and indeed I'
تَشَاغَلْتُمْ: tashāghaltum: تَشَاغَلَ (VI), busy oneself, be occupied; + تُمْ 'you (m. pl.)'; 'you busied yourselves'
بِصُحْبَةِ: بِـ + صُحْبَة — bi-, with, in the company of (prep.); ṣuḥba, company (f.), genitive after the prep.; 'with the company of'
غَيْرِنَا: غَيْر + نَا — ghayr, other than, someone else (n.), genitive (construct); -nā 'us'; 'other than us'
وَأَظْهَرْتُمُ: و + أَظْهَرْتُمُ — wa-, and; aẓhartum, 'you showed' (IV of ظَهَرَ), with the -u of the linking vowel before الـ; 'and you showed'
الْهِجْرَانَ: الـ + هِجْرَان — al-, the; hijrān, desertion, estrangement (m.), accusative object; 'the desertion'
سَأَتْرُكُمْ: سَـ + أَتْرُكُ + كُمْ — sa-, future particle 'shall'; atruku 'I leave' (تَرَكَ) + -kum 'you (m. pl.)'; the doubled kāf is printed once; 'I shall leave you'
تَرَكْتُمُوا: taraktumū: تَرَكَ 'to leave' + تُمُوا 'you (m. pl.)', with the long -ū the verse keeps; 'you left'
وَنَصْبِرُ: و + نَصْبِرُ — wa-, and; naṣbiru 'we are patient' (صَبَرَ); 'and we are patient'
حَقَّ: ḥaqqa, due, right, what is owed (m.), accusative; 'the due of'
صَبْرِكُمْ: صَبْر + كُمْ — ṣabr, patience (m.), genitive (construct); -kum 'your (m. pl.)'; 'your patience'
وَنَشْغَلُ: و + نَشْغَلُ — wa-, and; nashghalu 'we are occupied/turn away' (شَغَلَ, here 'be busy'); 'and we are occupied'
شُغِلْتُمْ: shughiltum: شَغَلَ, passive, + تُمْ 'you (m. pl.)'; 'you were occupied'
بِغَيْرِنَا: بِـ + غَيْر + نَا — bi-, with (prep.), marking what one is occupied with; ghayr, other than (genitive); -nā 'us'; 'with others than us'
وَنَجْعَلُ: و + نَجْعَلُ — wa-, and; najʿalu 'we make, set' (جَعَلَ); 'and we make'
قَطْعَ: qaṭʿa, cutting, severing (m.), accusative object, in construct; 'the cutting of'
الْوَصْلِ: الـ + وَصْل — al-, the; waṣl, union, connection (m.), genitive; 'the union'
وَسِّطْهَا: وَسِّطْ + هَا — wassiṭ, imperative II of وَسَطَ, 'cut in the middle, cut in two'; -hā 'her'; 'cut her in two'
وَرَيِّحْنَا: و + رَيِّحْ + نَا — wa-, and; rayyiḥ, imperative II of رَاحَ/رَوَّحَ, 'give rest, relieve'; -nā 'us'; 'and give us rest'
فَائِدَةٌ: fāʾida, benefit, use, advantage (f.), nominative indefinite; subject of laysa; 'any use'
نَتَشَاجَرُ: natashājaru: تَشَاجَرَ (VI), quarrel with one another; 'we quarrel'
بِالْأَشْعَارِ: بِـ + الـ + أَشْعَار — bi-, with (prep.), the means by which they quarrel; al-, the; ashʿār, verses, poems (plural of شِعْر); 'with verses'; here bi- marks the means of cheering, after sallā: yusallīhi bi-al-ashʿāri, 'cheers him with poems'
وَأَيِسْتُ: و + أَيِسَ + تُ — wa-, and; ayisa, he despaired (also يَئِسَ, here printed without hamza on ي) + -tu 'I'; 'and I despaired'
الْحَيَوٰةِ: الـ + حَيَوٰة — al-, the; ḥayāt, life (f.), genitive; spelled with و, dagger alif supplies the ā; 'the life'
وَرَمَتْ: و + رَمَتْ — wa-, and; ramat: رَمَى 'throw', fem. past; 'and she threw'
أَقْدَامِ: aqdām, feet (plural of قَدَم), genitive in construct after عَلَى; 'the feet of'
وَبَاسَتْهُمْ: و + بَاسَ + تْ + هُمْ — wa-, and; bāsa, kiss (بَاسَ = قَبَّلَ), fem. past; -hum 'them' (m. pl., for the feet); 'and she kissed them'
تَرْبِيَتِي: تَرْبِيَة + ي — tarbiya, rearing, upbringing (f.), genitive; -ī 'my'; 'my rearing (of you)'
وَخِدْمَتِي: و + خِدْمَة + ي — wa-, and; khidma, service (f.), genitive; -ī 'my'; 'and my service'
تَعْفُو: taʿfū: عَفَا 'pardon' (imperfect, 2nd sg. m.), used as a request; 'you pardon'
إِثْمِهَا: إِثْم + هَا — ithm, sin, guilt (m.), genitive after فِي; -hā 'her'; 'her sin, the guilt of it'
وَأَيْشِ: و + أَيْش — wa-, and; ayshi, what? (colloquial contraction of أَيُّ شَيْءٍ); 'and what?'
الْوَسِخَةُ: الـ + وَسِخَة — al-, the; wasikha, filthy woman (f.), nominative; 'the filthy one'
اتْرُكْهَا: utruk + hā: تَرَكَ 'leave', imperative m. sg. + -hā 'her'; 'leave her'
بَالِكَ: بَال + كَ — bāl, mind, thought (m.), genitive after عَنْ; -ka 'your'; 'your mind'
وَقَلْبِكَ: و + قَلْب + كَ — wa-, and; qalb, heart (m.), genitive after عَنْ; -ka 'your'; 'and your heart'
أَثَرًا: athar, mark, trace (m.), accusative indefinite; 'a mark'
عُمْرِهَا: عُمْر + هَا — ʿumr, lifetime, life (m.), genitive; -hā 'her'; 'her life'
الْعَبِيدَ: الـ + عَبِيد — al-, the; ʿabīd, slaves (plural of عَبْد), accusative object; 'the slaves'
فَجَذَبُونِي: فَـ + جَذَبُوا + نِي — fa-, and so; jadhabū, they pulled (جَذَبَ); -nī 'me'; 'so they pulled me'
وَمَدُّونِي: و + مَدُّوا + نِي — wa-, and; maddū, they stretched out (مَدَّ); -nī 'me'; 'and stretched me out'
جَرَّدُونِي: jarradū + nī: جَرَّدَ (II), strip, bare; -nī 'me'; 'they stripped me'
وَجَاسَتِ: و + جَاسَتِ — wa-, and; jāsat, 'went about, trod' (جَاسَ), fem.; -i is the linking vowel before الْـ; 'and went about'
الْغُلَامُ: الـ + غُلَام — al-, the; ghulām, young man, lad (m.); 'the young man'; here: the page, a serving boy
قَضِيبًا: qaḍīb, rod, cane (m.), accusative indefinite; 'a rod'
فَتَرَجَّلَ: فَـ + تَرَجَّلَ — fa-, and so; tarajjala (V), go on foot, dismount; 'then he went on foot'
يَضْرِبُنِي: يَضْرِبُ + نِي — yaḍribu, he strikes (ضَرَبَ); -nī 'me'; 'striking me'
وَأَجْنَابِي: و + أَجْنَاب + ي — wa-, and; ajnāb, sides (plural of جَنْب), genitive after عَلَى; -ī 'my'; 'and my sides'
حَيَوٰتِي: حَيَوٰة + ي — ḥayāt, life (f.), genitive after مِنْ, or after فِي: fī ḥayātī, 'while I live'; -ī 'my'; 'my life'
يَحْمِلُونِي: يَحْمِلُونَ + ي — yaḥmilūna, they carry (حَمَلَ); -nī 'me'; 'they carry me'
وَيَأْخُذُوا: و + يَأْخُذُوا — wa-, and; yaʾkhudhū, they take (أَخَذَ), printed without the final nūn; 'and take'
تَدُلُّهُمْ: تَدُلُّ + هُمْ — tadullu, she guides (دَلَّ 'point out the way to'); -hum 'them'; 'guiding them'
وَيَرْمُونِي: و + يَرْمُونَ + ي — wa-, and; yarmūna, they throw (رَمَى); -nī 'me'; 'and throw me'
أَمَرَهُمْ: أَمَرَ + هُمْ — amara, he ordered; -hum 'them'; 'he ordered them'
سَيِّدُهُمْ: سَيِّد + هُمْ — sayyid, master (m.), nominative; -hum 'their'; 'their master'
وَرَاحُوا: و + رَاحُوا — wa-, and; rāḥū, they went off, departed (رَاحَ); 'and went away'
وَلَازَمْتُ: و + لَازَمْتُ — wa-, and; lāzamtu: لَازَمَ (III), stay with, keep to + -tu 'I'; 'and I stayed with'
غَشْوَتِي: غَشْوَة + ي — ghashwa, swoon, faint (f.), genitive after فِي; -ī 'my'; 'my swoon'
وَالصَّبَاحُ: و + الـ + صَبَاح — wa-, and, marking a circumstance; al-, the; ṣabāḥ, morning (m.), nominative; 'and the morning'
فَلَاطَفْتُ: فَـ + لَاطَفْتُ — fa-, and so; lāṭaftu: لَاطَفَ (III), treat gently + -tu 'I'; 'so I treated gently'
الْمَرَاهِمِ: الـ + مَرَاهِم — al-, the; marāhim, salves (plural of مَرْهَم); 'the salves'
وَالْأَدْوِيَةِ: و + الـ + أَدْوِيَة — wa-, and; al-, the; adwiya, medicines (plural of دَوَاء); 'and the medicines'
وَدَاوَيْتُ: و + دَاوَيْتُ — wa-, and; dāwaytu: دَاوَى (III), treat medically + -tu 'I'; 'and I doctored'
جِسْمِي: جِسْم + ي — jism, body (m.), accusative object; -ī 'my'; 'my body'; also as the subject of yuʿrafu: jismī … yuʿrafu, 'my body is (still) known' (Night 182)
وَبَقِيَتْ: و + بَقِيَتْ — wa-, and; baqiyat: بَقِيَ 'remain', fem. past; 'and remained'
أَضْلَاعِي: أَضْلَاع + ي — aḍlāʿ, ribs (plural of ضِلَع/ضِلْع), nominative; -ī 'my'; 'my ribs'
مَضْرُوبَةٌ: maḍrūba, beaten (passive participle of ضَرَبَ, f.); 'beaten'
بِالْمَقَارِعِ: بِـ + الـ + مَقَارِع — bi-, with (prep.), the instrument; al-, the; maqāriʿ, scourges, rods (plural of مِقْرَعَة); 'with the scourges'
ضَعِيفَةً: ḍaʿīfa, weak (f.), accusative, state (ḥāl) of the narrator; 'weak' Also adjective of a feminine noun: kaffan ḍaʿīfatan, 'a feeble hand'.
طَرِيحَةَ: ṭarīḥa, thrown down, laid low (f.), accusative in construct (ḥāl); 'laid low on'
أُدَاوِي: udāwī: دَاوَى (III), treat, tend, 1st sg. imperfect; 'tending'
أَشْهُرٍ: ashhur, months (plural of شَهْر), genitive after the number; 'months'
اسْتَفَقْتُ: istafaqtu: اسْتَفَاقَ (X), come to one's senses, recover + تُ 'I'; 'I recovered'
شُفِيتُ: shufītu: شَفَى 'heal', passive + تُ 'I'; 'I was healed'
خَرَابًا: kharāb, ruin (m.), accusative indefinite, second object; 'a ruin'
وَالزُّقَاقَ: و + الـ + زُقَاق — wa-, and; al-, the; zuqāq, lane, alley (m.), accusative (second object of wajadtu); 'and the lane'
وَصَارَتِ: و + صَارَتِ — wa-, and; ṣārat: صَارَ 'become', fem. past; -i linking vowel before الْـ; 'and became'
كِيمَانًا: kīmān, mounds, heaps of rubble (plural of كَوْم), accusative indefinite; 'heaps'
خَبَرَهَا: خَبَر + هَا — khabar, news, report (m.), accusative object; -hā 'its'; 'news of it'
هَانَيْنِ: hānayni, these two (f. dual, printed with ن for the ت of هَاتَيْنِ); 'these two'
وَأَخْبَرْتُهَا: و + أَخْبَرْتُ + هَا — wa-, and; akhbartu: أَخْبَرَ (IV), inform, tell; -hā 'her'; 'and I told her'
وَجَمِيعِ: و + جَمِيع — wa-, and; jamīʿ, all, the whole (m.), genitive (joined to بِـ); 'and all of'
نَكَبَاتِ: nakabāt, calamities (plural of نَكْبَة), genitive in construct after مِنْ; 'the calamities of'
فَاصْطَبِرْ: فَـ + اصْطَبِرْ — fa-, so; iṣṭabir: اصْطَبَرَ (VIII), be patient, imperative m. sg.; 'so be patient'
رُزِيتَ: ruziyta: رُزِئَ 'be afflicted' (printed without the hamza), passive + تَ 'you'; 'you are afflicted'
فِرَاقِ: firāq, parting, separation (m.), genitive in construct; 'the parting of'
حَبِيبِ: ḥabīb, beloved, friend (m.), genitive; the final -i follows the rhyme; 'a beloved'
أَخْبَرَتْنِي: أَخْبَرَتْ + نِي — akhbarat: أَخْبَرَ (IV), inform, fem. past; -nī 'me'; 'she informed me'
بِخَبَرِهَا: بِـ + خَبَر + هَا — bi-, of (prep.), أَخْبَرَ بِـ 'inform of'; khabar, news (m.); -hā 'her'; 'of her news'
الزَّوَاجِ: الـ + زَوَاج — al-, the; zawāj, marriage (m.); 'marriage'
أَلْسِنَتِنَا: أَلْسِنَة + نَا — alsina, tongues (plural of لِسَان), genitive after عَلَى; -nā 'our'; 'our tongues'
صَاحِبَتُنَا: صَاحِبَة + نَا — ṣāḥiba, female companion (f.), nominative; -nā 'our'; 'our companion'
الْمَصَالِحِ: الـ + مَصَالِح — al-, the; maṣāliḥ, needs, useful things (plural of مَصْلَحَة); 'the needs'; here: affairs, matters of business; fī baʿḍi al-maṣāliḥi, 'on some business'
يَوْمِنَا: يَوْم + نَا — yawm, day (m.), genitive after فِي; -nā 'our'; 'our day'
وَلَيْلَتِنَا: و + لَيْلَة + نَا — wa-, and; layla, night (f.); -nā 'our'; 'and our night'
أُخْتُنَا: أُخْت + نَا — ukht, sister (f.), nominative; -nā 'our'; 'our sister'
عَادَتِهَا: عَادَة + هَا — ʿāda, habit, custom (f.), genitive; -hā 'her'; 'her habit'
بِمَجِئِ: بِـ + مَجِئ — bi-, with, through (prep.), marking the cause/accompaniment; majiʾ, coming, arrival (m.), genitive; 'with the coming of'
وَهَؤُلَاءِ: و + هَؤُلَاءِ — wa-, and; hāʾulāʾi, these (pl.), genitive with the preceding bi-; 'and these'
الثَّلَٰثَةِ: الـ + ثَلَٰثَة — al-, the; thalātha, three (with a masc. noun), genitive; 'the three'
فَتَحَادَثْنَا: فَـ + تَحَادَثْنَا — fa-, and so; taḥādathnā: تَحَادَثَ (VI), converse + نَا 'we'; 'so we conversed'
وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ: و + أَدْخَلْنَا + هُمْ — wa-, and; adkhalnā: أَدْخَلَ (IV), bring in, admit + -nā 'we'; -hum 'them'; 'and we brought them in'
وَأَكْرَمْنَاهُمْ: و + أَكْرَمْنَا + هُمْ — wa-, and; akramnā: أَكْرَمَ (IV), honour + -nā 'we'; -hum 'them'; 'and we honoured them'
يَذْهَبْ: yadhhab: ذَهَبَ 'go, pass', jussive after لَمْ; 'did not pass'
بُرْهَةٌ: burha, a while, short time (f.), nominative; 'a while'
اجْتَمَعْنَا: ijtamaʿnā: اجْتَمَعَ (VIII), meet, gather + نَا 'we'; 'we met'
بِثَلَٰثَةِ: بِـ + ثَلَٰثَة — bi-, with (prep.), اجْتَمَعَ بِـ 'meet with' chooses it; thalātha, three (f. in form), genitive in construct; 'with three'
تُجَّارٍ: tujjār, merchants (plural of تَاجِر), genitive indefinite; 'merchants'
مُحْتَشِمِينَ: muḥtashimīn, dignified, respectable (VIII participle, m. pl. genitive); 'dignified'
الْمَوْصِلِ: الـ + مَوْصِل — al-, the; Mawṣil, Mosul (city), genitive after مِنْ; 'Mosul'
وَحَكَوْنَا: و + حَكَوْا + نَا — wa-, and; ḥakaw, they related (حَكَى); -nā 'us' (as object, for 'to us'); 'and they told us'
حَدِيثَهُمْ: حَدِيث + هُمْ — ḥadīth, tale, account (m.), accusative object; -hum 'their'; 'their tale'
فَخَالَفُونَا: فَـ + خَالَفُوا + نَا — fa-, and so; khālafū: خَالَفَ (III), contravene, act against + -nā 'us'; 'and they went against us'
فَإِنَّنَا: فَـ + إِنَّ + نَا — fa-, and so; inna, indeed + -nā 'we'; 'and so we'
قَابَلْنَاهُمْ: قَابَلْنَا + هُمْ — qābalnā: قَابَلَ (III), meet, requite + نَا 'we'; -hum 'them'; 'we requited them'
مُخَالَفَتِهِمْ: مُخَالَفَة + هِمْ — mukhālafa, contravention (f.), genitive after عَلَى; -him 'their'; 'their breach'
وَاسْتَخْبَرْنَاهُمْ: و + اسْتَخْبَرْنَا + هُمْ — wa-, and; istakhbarnā: اسْتَخْبَرَ (X), ask for news + نَا 'we'; -hum 'them'; 'and we asked them'
فَحَكَوْا: فَـ + حَكَوْا — fa-, and so; ḥakaw, they related; 'so they told'
حِكَايَتَهُمْ: حِكَايَة + هُمْ — ḥikāya, story (f.), accusative object; -hum 'their'; 'their story'
فَعَفَوْنَا: فَـ + عَفَوْنَا — fa-, and so; ʿafawnā: عَفَا 'pardon' + نَا 'we'; 'so we pardoned'
وَانْفَصَلُوا: و + انْفَصَلُوا — wa-, and; infaṣalū: انْفَصَلَ (VII), part, separate; 'and they parted'
نَشْعُرُ: nashʿuru: شَعَرَ 'perceive, be aware', 1st pl. imperfect; 'we perceive'
حَضَرْنَا: ḥaḍarnā: حَضَرَ 'be present, come' + نَا 'we'; 'we were present'
وَهَٰذِةْ: و + هَٰذِةْ — wa-, and; hādhih, this (f.), printed with ة for هَٰذِهِ, read with a pausal ending; 'and this'
حِكَايَتُنَا: حِكَايَة + نَا — ḥikāya, story (f.), nominative; -nā 'our'; 'our story'
تَارِيخًا: tārīkh, dated record, chronicle (m.), accusative indefinite; 'a record'
خِزَانَتِهِ: خِزَانَة + هِ — khizāna, treasury, library, archive (f.), genitive after فِي; -hi 'his'; 'his treasury'
التَّاسِعَةَ: الـ + تَاسِعَة — tāsiʿ, ninth (f.); the first half of the compound 'nineteenth', fixed in -a
أَمَرَأَنْ: أَمَرَ + أَنْ — amara, command (3 m. sg. perf.), run together with an, that (+ subjunctive); 'he commanded that'
تُكْتَبَ: كَتَبَ — kataba, write; passive subjunctive 3 f. sg. (tuktaba); 'be written'
الْقِصَّةُ: الـ + قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., nom.); 'the story'
الدَّوَاوِينِ: الـ + دَوَاوِين — dawāwīn, pl. of dīwān, registers, record-books (gen.); 'the registers'
وَيَجْعَلُوهَا: وَ + يَجْعَلُوا + هَا — wa-, and; jaʿala, put, place (3 m. pl. subj., nūn dropped after an) + her/it; 'and they put it'
خَبَرٌ: خَبَر — khabar, news, report (m., nom. indef.); 'news'
الْعِفْرِيتَةِ: الـ + عِفْرِيتَة — ʿifrīta, she-ifrit, female demon (f., gen.); 'the she-ifrit'
إِخْوَانَكِ: إِخْوَان + كِ — ikhwān, brothers, siblings (pl., acc.) + your (f. sg.); 'your brothers'
أَعْطَتْنِي: أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, give (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.) + me; 'she gave me'
وَقَٰلَتْ: وَ + قَٰلَتْ — wa-, and; qāla, say (3 f. sg. perf.), printed قلت without alif, read qālat; 'and she said'
أَرَدْتِي: أَرَادَ — arāda, want, wish (IV, 2 f. sg. perf.), printed with an extra final ي; 'you (f.) wish'
حُضُورِي: حُضُور + ي — ḥuḍūr, presence (n. of ḥaḍara) + my; 'my presence'
فَأَحْرِقِي: فَ + أَحْرِقِي — fa-, then, so (introduces the command); aḥraqa, burn (IV, imp. 2 f. sg.); 'then burn'
الشَّعْرَ: الـ + شَعْر — shaʿr, hair (coll., acc.); 'the hair'
فَأَحْضُرَ: فَ + أَحْضُرَ — fa-, and so (of consequence after a command); ḥaḍara, be present (1 sg. subj.); 'and I shall come'
إِلَيْكِ: إِلَى + كِ — ilā, to (prep.) + you (f. sg.); 'to you'
أَحْضِرِي: أَحْضَرَ — aḥḍara, bring (IV, imp. 2 f. sg.); 'bring'
فَأَحْضَرَتْهُ: فَ + أَحْضَرَتْ + هُ — fa-, so; aḥḍara, bring (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.) + it; 'so she brought it'
فَأَخَذَةُ: فَ + أَخَذَ + ةُ — fa-, so; akhadha, take (3 m. sg. perf.) + ـهُ (printed ة), it; 'so he took it'
وَحَرَقَهُ: وَ + حَرَقَ + هُ — wa-, and; ḥaraqa, burn (3 m. sg. perf.) + it; 'and burned it'
رَائِحَتُهُ: رَائِحَة + هُ — rāʾiḥa, smell, scent (f., nom.) + its; 'its smell'
الْقَصْرُ: الـ + قَصْر — qaṣr, palace (m., nom.); 'the palace'
وَسَمِعُوا: وَ + سَمِعُوا — wa-, and; samiʿa, hear (3 m. pl. perf.); 'and they heard'
دَوِيًّا: دَوِيّ — dawiyy, rumbling, din (acc. indef.); 'a rumbling'
وَقَرْقَعَةً: وَ + قَرْقَعَة — wa-, and; qarqaʿa, clatter, crashing (imitative n., acc. indef.); 'and a clatter'
بِالْجِنِّيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + جِنِّيَّة — bi-, (after idhā of surprise) only marks what appears + jinniyya, she-jinn (f., gen.); 'behold, the she-jinni'
حَضَرَتْ: حَضَرَ — ḥaḍara, be present, arrive (3 f. sg. perf.); 'she had arrived'
مُسْلِمَةً: مُسْلِمَة — muslima, Muslim woman (f., acc. predicate); 'a Muslim'
خَلِيفَةَ: خَلِيفَة — khalīfa, caliph, deputy (m., acc. construct, vocative); 'caliph of'
وَعَلَيْكُمُ: وَ + عَلَى + كُمُ — wa-, and; ʿalā, upon + you (pl.), with helping vowel before the article; 'and upon you'
رَحْمَةُ: رَحْمَة — raḥma, mercy (f., nom. construct); 'the mercy of'
وَبَرَكَانُهُ: وَ + بَرَكَان + هُ — wa-, and; barakāt, blessings (printed with ن) + his; 'and his blessings'
زَرَعَتْ: زَرَعَ — zaraʿa, sow, plant (3 f. sg. perf.); 'she sowed'
مَعِيَ: مَعَ + ي — maʿa, with (prep.) + me; 'with me'
أَقْدِرُ: قَدَرَ — qadara, be able (1 sg. impf.); 'I am able'
أُكَافِيهَا: كَافَأَ — kāfaʾa, requite, repay (III, 1 sg. impf.; hamza written ي) + her; 'I repay her'
أَنْقَذَتْنِي: أَنْقَذَ — anqadha, rescue (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.) + me; 'she rescued me'
وَقَتَلَتْ: وَ + قَتَلَتْ — wa-, and; qatala, kill (3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she killed'
أَخَوَاتُهَا: أَخَوَات + هَا — akhawāt, sisters (f. pl., nom.) + her; 'her sisters'
أَنْتَقِمُ: اِنْتَقَمَ — intaqama, take vengeance (VIII, 1 sg. impf.); 'I take revenge'
وَأَسْحَرُهُمْ: وَ + أَسْحَرُ + هُمْ — wa-, and; saḥara, enchant (1 sg. impf.) + them; 'and I enchant them'
كِلَابًا: كِلَاب — kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb, acc. indef.); 'dogs'
أَرَدْتُ: أَرَادَ — arāda, want (IV, 1 sg. perf.); 'I wanted'
قَتْلَهُمْ: قَتْل + هُمْ — qatl, killing (n., acc.) + their; 'their killing'
فَخَشِيتُ: فَ + خَشِيتُ — fa-, so, then; khashiya, fear (1 sg. perf.); 'so I feared'
يَصْعُبَ: صَعُبَ — ṣaʿuba, be hard, be difficult (3 m. sg. subj.); 'be hard'
خَلَاصَهُمْ: خَلَاص + هُمْ — khalāṣ, deliverance (n., acc.) + their; 'their deliverance'
أُخَلِّصْهُمْ: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, deliver, free (II, 1 sg. jussive) + them; 'I free them'
خَلِّصِيهِمْ: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, free (II, imp. 2 f. sg.) + them; 'free them'
نَشْرَعُ: شَرَعَ — sharaʿa, begin, proceed (1 pl. impf.); 'we begin'
الْمَضْرُوبَةِ: الـ + مَضْرُوبَة — maḍrūba, beaten (f. pass. part. of ḍaraba, gen.); 'the beaten one'
وَنَفْحَصُ: وَ + نَفْحَصُ — wa-, and; faḥaṣa, examine, inquire (1 pl. impf.); 'and we inquire'
ظَهَرَلِي: ظَهَرَ + لِـ + ي — ẓahara, appear (3 m. sg. perf.), run together with li-, to (prep.) + me; 'appears to me'
صِدْقُهَا: صِدْق + هَا — ṣidq, truthfulness (n., nom.) + her; 'her truthfulness'
ثَرْهَا: ثَرْ + هَا — printed without the alif for ثَأْر thaʾr, blood-vengeance, + her; 'her vengeance'
ظَلَمَهَا: ظَلَمَ + هَا — ẓalama, wrong (3 m. sg. perf.) + her; 'he wronged her'
الْعِفْرِينَةُ: الـ + عِفْرِينَة — printed for ʿifrīta, she-ifrit (f., nom.); 'the she-ifrit'
أُخَلِّصُهُمْ: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, free (II, 1 sg. impf.) + them; 'I free them'
وَأَدُلُّكَ: وَ + أَدُلُّ + كَ — wa-, and; dalla, guide, show (1 sg. impf.) + you (m. sg.); 'and I guide you'
بِهَذِةِ: بِـ + هَذِةِ — bi-, to (prep. that faʿala takes for the one done to: 'did to') + hādhihi, this (f.); 'to this'
وَظَلَمَهَا: وَ + ظَلَمَ + هَا — wa-, and; ẓalama, wrong + her; 'and wronged her'
مَالَهَا: مَال + هَا — māl, property, wealth (m., acc.) + her; 'her property'
أَقْرَبُ: أَقْرَب — aqrab, nearest (elative, nom. construct); 'nearest of' Also as a predicate with ilā, 'nearer to': anā ilā al-mawti aqrabu, 'I am nearer to death'.
الْعِفْرِيتَةَ: الـ + عِفْرِيتَة — ʿifrīta, she-ifrit (f., acc.); 'the she-ifrit'
أَفْهَمُ: فَهِمَ — fahima, understand (1 sg. impf.); 'I understand'
وَجْهَ: وَجْه — wajh, face (m., acc. construct); 'the face of'
صُورَتِكُمُ: صُورَة + كُمُ — ṣūra, form, shape (f., gen.) + your (pl.), helping vowel before the article; 'your form'
الْبَشَرِيَّةِ: الـ + بَشَرِيَّة — basharī, human (f. adj., gen.); 'the human'
فَعَادُوا: فَ + عَادُوا — fa-, so; ʿāda, return (3 m. pl. perf.); 'so they returned'
صُورَتِهِمُ: صُورَة + هِمُ — ṣūra, form, shape (f., gen.) + their, helping vowel before the article; 'their form'
قَٰلَتِ: قَالَتْ — qāla, say (3 f. sg. perf.), printed قلت without alif, kasra before the article; 'she said'
الْعِفْرِيتَةُ: الـ + عِفْرِيتَة — ʿifrīta, she-ifrit (f., nom.); 'the she-ifrit'
الْأَمِينُ: الـ + أَمِين — amīn, trustworthy; al-Amīn, Hārūn's son Muḥammad (nom.)
أَخُ: أَخ — akh, brother (nom. construct, printed short for أَخُو); 'brother of'
الْمَأْمُونِ: الـ + مَأْمُون — maʾmūn, trusted; al-Maʾmūn, Hārūn's other son (gen.)
بِحُسْنِهَا: بِـ + حُسْن + هَا — bi-, of (prep. required by samiʿa bi-, 'hear of') + ḥusn, beauty (gen.) + her; 'of her beauty' ; also: after tamallā, 'to take one's fill of', bi- marks what is enjoyed: atamallā bi-ḥusnihā, 'I take my fill of her beauty'
وَنَصَبَ: وَ + نَصَبَ — wa-, and; naṣaba, set up (3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he set up'
حِيلَةً: حِيلَة — ḥīla, stratagem, ruse (f., acc. indef.); 'a ruse'
وَتَزَوَّجَهَا: وَ + تَزَوَّجَ + هَا — wa-, and; tazawwaja, marry (V, 3 m. sg. perf.) + her; 'and married her'
بِالْحَلَالِ: بِـ + الـ + حَلَال — bi-, by, in (prep. of means or manner) + ḥalāl, the lawful (gen.); 'lawfully'
مَالَهُ: مَا + لِـ + هُ — mā, not (Middle Arabic negation of a nominal clause); li-, to, for (prep. of possession, 'he has') + him; 'he has no' Also māl + -hu, 'his wealth' (acc.): akhadhū mālahu, 'they took his money'.
ضَرْبِهَا: ضَرْب + هَا — ḍarb, beating (n., gen.) + her; 'her beating'
اشْتَرَطَ: اِشْتَرَطَ — ishtaraṭa, stipulate (VIII, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'he stipulated'
وَحَلَّفَهَا: وَ + حَلَّفَ + هَا — wa-, and; ḥallafa, make swear (II, 3 m. sg. perf.) + her; 'and made her swear'
أَيْمَانًا: أَيْمَان — aymān, oaths (pl. of yamīn, acc. indef.); 'oaths'
تَفْعَلَ: فَعَلَ — faʿala, do (3 f. sg. subj.); 'she do'
خَانَتِ: خَانَ — khāna, betray, break faith with (3 f. sg. perf.), kasra before the article; 'she betrayed'
فَضَرَبَهَا: فَ + ضَرَبَ + هَا — fa-, so; ḍaraba, beat + her; 'so he beat her'
وَأَعَادَهَا: وَ + أَعَادَ + هَا — wa-, and; aʿāda, return, send back (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.) + her; 'and sent her back'
مَكَانِهَا: مَكَان + هَا — makān, place (m., gen.) + her; 'her place'
قِصَّةُ: قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story (f., nom. construct); 'the story of'
الْبِنْتِ: الـ + بِنْت — bint, girl, daughter (f., gen.); 'the girl'
قَتْلَهَا: قَتْل + هَا — qatl, killing (n., acc.) + her; 'her killing'
كَلَامِ: kalām, speech, words (gen. after min); here gen. after ilā, first term of the iḍāfa kalāmi ahli al-madīnati, 'the talk of the townspeople'
وَتَخَلَّصَ: وَ + تَخَلَّصَ — wa-, and + takhallaṣa, he got free (V perf.); here with an object, 'and freed' (for khallaṣa)
وَالْعَذَابِ: وَ + الـ + عَذَاب — wa-, and + ʿadhāb, torment (gen.); 'and the torment'
وَمَنَّ: وَ + مَنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + manna, he bestowed a favour (perf.); 'and he favoured'
لَأَعْمَلَنَّ: لَـ + أَعْمَلَنَّ — la-, surely (emphatic, answers an oath) + aʿmalanna, I will do (impf. 1 s. with emphatic nūn, ʿamila); 'I will surely do'
يُكْتَبُ: yuktabu, it is written (impf. pass. 3 m.s.)
الْأَمِينَ: الـ + أَمِين — Amīn, 'the trustworthy', al-Amīn, the caliph's son (proper name; acc.)
الْقُضَاةَ: الـ + قُضَاة — quḍāt, judges (pl. of qāḍī; acc.)
الثَّلَٰثَةَ: الـ + ثَلَٰثَة — thalātha, three (m.; edition's defective spelling; acc.); 'the three'
وَأَخَوَاتِهَا: وَ + أَخَوَات + هَا — wa-, and + akhawāt, sisters (pl. of ukht; gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her sisters'
كَانَتَا: kānatā, they two were (perf. 3 f. dual)
مَسْحُورَتَيْنِ: masḥūratayni, bewitched (pass. part., f. dual; predicate)
وَزَوَّجَ: وَ + زَوَّجَ — wa-, and + zawwaja, he married (someone) off (II perf.); 'and he married off'
الثَّلَٰتَ: الـ + ثَلَٰث — thalāth, three (f.; printed with tāʾ for thāʾ; acc.); 'the three (women)'
لِلثَّلَٰثَةِ: لِـ + الـ + ثَلَٰثَة — li-, to, for (prep.; here marks the one married to) + thalātha, three (m.; gen.); 'to the three'
أَخْبَرُوا: akhbarū, they told, declared (IV perf. 3 m.pl.)
مُلُوكًا: mulūk, kings (pl. of malik; acc. predicate)
وَعَمِلَهُمْ: وَ + عَمِلَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ʿamila, he made (Middle Arabic for jaʿala) + -hum, them; 'and made them'
أَعْطَاهُمْ: أَعْطَى + هُمْ — aʿṭā, he gave (IV perf.) + -hum, them; 'he gave them'
وَأَجْرَى: وَ + أَجْرَى — wa-, and + ajrā, he made run, assigned (IV perf.); 'and he assigned'
جَرَايَاتٍ: jarāyāt, allowances, rations (pl. of jarāya; acc.)
وَأَنْزَلَهُمْ: وَ + أَنْزَلَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + anzala, he lodged (IV perf.) + -hum, them; 'and lodged them'
الْمَضْرُوبَةَ: الـ + مَضْرُوبَة — maḍrūba, beaten (pass. part. f.; acc.); 'the beaten one'
لِوَلَدِهِ: لِـ + وَلَد + هِ — li-, to (prep.; marks the one affected: jarā li-waladihi, 'befell his son'; elsewhere the one to whom someone is returned) + walad, son (gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his son' Also after qāla, li- marks the one spoken to: qāla li-waladihi, 'said to his son'.
الْأَمِينِ: الـ + أَمِين — Amīn, al-Amīn, the caliph's son (proper name; gen.)
وَجَدَّدَ: وَ + جَدَّدَ — wa-, and + jaddada, he renewed (II perf.); 'and renewed'
كِتَابَهُ: كِتَاب + هُ — kitāb, writing, contract (acc.) + -hu, his; 'his writing'
وَأَعْطَاهَا: وَ + أَعْطَى + هَا — wa-, and + aʿṭā, he gave (IV perf.) + -hā, her; 'and gave her'; here: -hā is the letter, 'and gave it', with lahā, 'to her', following
تُبْنَى: tubnā, it is built (impf. pass. subj. 3 f.s.)
بِالْخُشْكَاشَةِ: بِـ + الـ + خُشْكَاشَة — bi-, with, to (prep.; tazawwaja bi- is Middle Arabic for 'marry') + Khushkāsha, a woman's epithet or name, meaning uncertain (gen.); 'married the Khushkāsha'
وَجَوَارِيَ: وَ + جَوَارِي — wa-, and + jawārī, slave-girls, maidservants (pl. of jāriya; acc. diptote); 'and maidservants'
لِخِدْمَتِهَا: لِـ + خِدْمَة + هَا — li-, for (prep.; purpose) + khidma, service (gen.) + -hā, her; 'for her service'
وَرَتَّبَ: وَ + رَتَّبَ — wa-, and + rattaba, he arranged, appointed (II perf.); 'and arranged'
رَوَاتِبَ: rawātib, regular allowances, stipends (pl. of rātib; acc. diptote)
بِسَرَارِيهِ: بِـ + سَرَارِي + هِ — bi-, with, among (prep.) + sarārī, concubines (pl. of surriyya; gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his concubines'
وَسَمَاحَةِ: وَ + سَمَاحَة — wa-, and + samāḥa, liberality (gen.); 'and the liberality of'
وَحِكْمَتِهِ: وَ + حِكْمَة + هِ — wa-, and + ḥikma, wisdom (gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his wisdom'
يُؤَرِّخُوا: yuʾarrikhū, they record, date, chronicle (II impf. subj. 3 m.pl.)
جَمِيعِهِمْ: جَمِيع + هِمْ — jamīʿ, all (gen., in apposition) + -him, them; 'all of them'
لَطِيفَةٌ: laṭīfa, delicate, graceful (f. adj.; nom. indef.)
يُسْمَعُ: yusmaʿu, it is heard (impf. pass. 3 m.s.)
مِثْلُهَا: مِثْل + هَا — mithl, the like, the equal (nom.) + -hā, her, its; 'the like of it'
وَلَكِنِ: وَ + لَكِنِ — wa-, and + lākin, but (kasra before the following hamzat al-waṣl); 'but'
أُخْرَيٰ: ukhrā, another (f. of ākhar; printed with yāʾ, read as alif maqṣūra)
لِنَقْضِيَ: لِـ + نَقْضِيَ — li-, so that, in order to (purpose; takes the subjunctive) + naqḍiya, we pass, spend (impf. subj. 1 pl. of qaḍā); 'so that we spend'
أَدِنَ: adina, he gave permission (perf.); printed with dāl for dhāl, read adhina
قِصَّتَكِ: قِصَّة + كِ — qiṣṣa, story (acc.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your story'
وَأَعْجِلِي: وَ + أَعْجِلِي — wa-, and + aʿjilī, make haste! (IV imperative f.s.); 'and hurry'
وَصَاحِبَ: وَ + صَاحِب — wa-, and + ṣāḥib, master, owner (acc. in the vocative construct); 'and master of'
وَالْأَوَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَوَان — wa-, and + awān, time, season (gen.); 'and the epoch'
الرَّشِيدَ: الـ + رَشِيد — Rashīd, 'rightly guided', al-Rashīd (epithet; acc.)
الْعَامَّةَ: الـ + عَامَّة — ʿāmma, the common people (acc.)
أَحْوَالِ: aḥwāl, conditions, affairs (pl. of ḥāl; gen.)
الْحُكَّامِ: الـ + حُكَّام — ḥukkām, governors, rulers (pl. of ḥākim; gen.)
الْمُتَوَلِّينَ: الـ + مُتَوَلِّين — mutawallīn, those in charge, in office (V act. part. m.pl.; gen.)
شَكَوْامِنْهُ: شَكَوْا + مِنْ + هُ — shakaw, they complained (perf. 3 m.pl. of shakā) + min, about (prep.) + -hu, him; printed as one word; 'they complained of him'
عَزَلْنَاهُ: عَزَلْ + نَا + هُ — ʿazala, he dismissed + -nā, we + -hu, him; 'we dismissed him'
أَوْلَیْنَاهُ: أَوْلَى + نَا + هُ — awlā, he conferred, gave (IV) + -nā, we + -hu, him; 'we confer (office) on him'
وَشَقُّوا: وَ + شَقُّوا — wa-, and + shaqqū, they cut through, made their way through (perf. 3 m.pl. of shaqqa)
الْأَسْوَاقِ: الـ + أَسْوَاق — aswāq, markets (pl. of sūq; gen.)
الشَّوَارِعِ: الـ + شَوَارِع — shawāriʿ, streets (pl. of shāriʿ; gen.)
فَاجْتَازُوا: فَـ + اجْتَازُوا — fa-, and so + ijtāzū, they passed through (VIII perf. 3 m.pl.)
فَرَأَوْا: فَـ + رَأَوْا — fa-, and so + raʾaw, they saw (perf. 3 m.pl.)
وَقُفَّةٌ: وَ + قُفَّة — wa-, and + quffa, basket (nom. indef.); 'and a basket'
مَاشٍ: māshin, walking (act. part. of mashā; nom. indef.)
مَهْلِهِ: مَهْل + هِ — mahl, leisure, slowness (gen.) + -hi, his; عَلَى مَهْلِهِ 'at his leisure'
الْوَرِي: الـ + وَرَى — warā, mankind, creation (written with yāʾ) (gen., after بَيْنَ); 'the creation, mankind'
بِعِلْمِكَ: بِـ + عِلْم + كَ — bi-, in, as regards (prep.) + ʿilm, knowledge, + your; 'in your knowledge'
كَاللَّيْلَةِ: كَـ + الـ + لَيْلَة — ka-, like (prep.: comparison) + al- + layla, night; 'like the night'
الْمُقْمِرَةِ: الـ + مُقْمِرَة — muqmira, moonlit (f. adj., active participle of aqmara) (gen.); 'the moonlit (night)'
أَقْوَالِكُمْ: أَقْوَال + كُمْ — aqwāl, sayings (pl. of qawl), + your (pl.); 'your sayings'
الْمَقْدِرَةِ: الـ + مَقْدِرَة — maqdira, ability, means (gen., after مَعَ); 'the means'
رَهَنُونِي: رَهَنُوا + نِي — rahana, to pawn; 3rd m. pl. perfect + me; 'they pawned me'
وَعِلْمِي: وَ + عِلْم + ي — wa-, with, and (conj.: circumstantial) + ʿilm, knowledge, + my; 'with my knowledge'
اللِّفَا: الـ + لِفَا — lifā, unclear (perhaps from lifāfa, wrapping); the text may be corrupt; 'the wrapping(s)?'
تَرْوِ: tarwi — perhaps from rawiya, to be quenched, or corrupt; 2nd m. sg.; obscure
الْمِحْبَرَةِ: الـ + مِحْبَرَة — miḥbara, inkwell (gen., for the rhyme); 'the inkwell'
قُوتِ: qūt, food, sustenance (gen., first term of an idafa); 'the food of'
فَرُدَّ: فَ + رُدَّ — fa-, then (conj.) + rudda, to return (passive), 3rd m. sg. perfect passive; 'then is returned'
الرِّهَانُ: الـ + رِهَان — rihān, pledge, pawn (nom.); 'the pledge'
وَارْمُوا: وَ + ارْمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + irmū, throw (ramā); imperative m. pl.; 'and throw'
الْقِصَّةِ: الـ + قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story; perhaps corrupt (gen., after إِلَى); 'the story?'; here: 'the affair', the love-story of ʿAlī and Shams al-Nahār: aṣl al-qiṣṣa, 'how the affair began'; also 'the story', gen. after ḥakā ʿalā, 'told of'
الْمَقَرَّةِ: الـ + مَقَرَّة — maqarra, resting place (cf. maqarr, abode); obscure, perhaps corrupt (gen.); 'the abode?'
فَأَ: فَ + أَ — fa-, so, and so (conj.) + a-, the hamza-alif of أَمَّا, printed split from its mā; read together with مَّا as fa-ammā, 'as for'
مَّا: mmā, the mā of أَمَّا, printed as a separate word after فَأَ; read fa-ammā, 'as for'
الْفَقِيرُ: الـ + فَقِير — faqīr, poor man (nom.); 'the poor man'
وَحَالُ: وَ + حَال — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāl, state, condition (nom., first term of an idafa); 'and the state of'
الْفَقِيرِ: الـ + فَقِير — faqīr, poor man (gen., second term of an idafa); 'the poor man'
وَعَيْشُ: وَ + عَيْش — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaysh, life, livelihood (nom., first term of an idafa); 'and the life of'
أَكْدَرَهُ: مَا + أَكْدَرَ + هُ — akdara, the exclamatory form of kadir, murky, turbid, + it; 'how murky it is'
وَفِى: وَ + فِى — wa-, and (conj.) + fī, in (prep.); 'and in'
الصَّيْفِ: الـ + صَيْف — ṣayf, summer (gen., after فِى); 'the summer'
يَعْجِزُ: yaʿjizu — ʿajaza ʿan, to be unable (to reach); 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'he is unable'
قُوتِهِ: قُوت + هِ — qūt, food, sustenance, + his (gen., after عَنْ); 'his food'
يَدْفِي: yadfī — colloquial dafiya, to be warm (Classical dafiʾa), written with yāʾ; 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'he warms himself'
الْمِجْمَرَةِ: الـ + مِجْمَرَة — mijmara, brazier, censer (gen., after عَلَى); 'the brazier'
تَقُومُ: taqūmu — qāma, to stand (with ʿalā, 'set upon'); 3rd f. sg. imperfect; 'stand over'
كِلَابُ: kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb) (nom., first term of an idafa); 'the dogs of'
لَئِيمٍ: laʾīm, base, mean (gen., second term of an idafa); 'base one'
بِذَا: بِـ + ذَا — bi-, on account of, for (prep.) + dhā, this (dem.); 'for this'
يَنْهَرُهُ: يَنْهَرُ + هُ — yanharu, to rebuke, drive off (nahara); 3rd m. sg. imperfect + him; 'rebukes him'
شَكَى: shakā — to complain (written with yāʾ/alif maqṣūra); 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'he complained'
حَالَهُ: حَال + هُ — ḥāl, state, condition, + his (acc., object); 'his condition'
لِامْرِئٍ: لِـ + امْرِئ — li-, to (prep., indirect object) + imrʾ, man, person (gen.); 'to a man'
الْبَرِيَّةِ: الـ + بَرِيَّة — bariyya, creation, mankind (gen., after فِي); 'the creation' Also after min: min hādhihi al-bariyyati, 'of this creation'.
يَعْذِرُهُ: يَعْذِرُ + هُ — yaʿdhiru, to excuse (ʿadhara); 3rd m. sg. imperfect + him; 'excuses him'
حَيَوةَ: ḥayāt, life (older spelling with wāw) (acc., predicate of كَانَ); 'the life of'
فَأَصْلَحُ: فَ + أَصْلَح — fa-, then (conj., apodosis) + aṣlaḥ, most fitting (elative of ṣāliḥ); 'then the most fitting'
الْمَقْبَرَةِ: الـ + مَقْبَرَة — maqbara, graveyard (gen., after فِى); 'the graveyard'
إِنْشَادَهُ: إِنْشَاد + هُ — inshād, reciting (verbal noun of anshada), + his (acc., object of سَمِعَ); 'his reciting'
وَانْظُرْ: وَ + انْظُرْ — wa-, and (conj.) + unẓur, look (naẓara); imperative m. sg.; 'and look'
يَدُلُّ: yadullu — dalla ʿalā, to point to, indicate; 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'it points to'
أَحْبَابِهِ: أَحْبَاب + هِ — aḥbāb, loved ones (pl. of ḥabīb/ḥibb), + his (gen., after nothing but the idafa); 'his loved ones'; probably a misprint for آدَابِهِ 'his good breeding'
يَاشَيْخُ: يَا + شَيْخ — yā, O (vocative particle; printed run together) + shaykh, old man, elder (nom.); 'O old man'
وَعِنْدِى: وَ + عِنْدَ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿinda, at, with (prep., expresses possession) + me; 'and I have'
عِيلَةٌ: ʿīla, household of dependents, family (colloquial for ʿāʾila; cf. Classical ʿayla 'want') (nom., indef.); 'a family'
يَقْسِمِ: yaqsimi — qasama, to apportion, allot; 3rd m. sg. jussive (after لَمْ), with kasra before Allāh; 'he has allotted'
أَقُوتُ: aqūtu — qāta, to sustain, feed; 1st sg. imperfect; 'I sustain, I feed'
عِيَالِي: عِيَال + ي — ʿiyāl, dependents, family (acc., object of أَقُوتُ), + my; 'my dependents'; here: gen. as second term after ʿirḍ, 'the honour of my household'
كَرِهْتُ: karihtu — kariha, to loathe; 1st sg. perfect; 'I loathed'
تَرْجِعَ: tarjiʿa — rajaʿa, to return; 2nd m. sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'you return'; here 3fs subjunctive after li- (continuing li-tanẓurahā): thumma tarjiʿa, 'then (that) she return' (Night 193)
وَتَقِفَ: وَ + تَقِفَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taqifa, to stand (waqafa); 2nd m. sg. subjunctive; 'and stand'
شَاطِئِ: shāṭiʾ, bank, shore (gen., first term of an idafa); 'the bank of'
وَتَرْمِيَ: وَ + تَرْمِيَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tarmiya, to cast (ramā); 2nd m. sg. subjunctive; 'and cast'
شَبَكَتَكَ: شَبَكَة + كَ — shabaka, net, + your (acc.); 'your net'
بَخْتِي: بَخْت + ي — bakht, luck, fortune (Persian loan), + my (gen., after عَلَى); 'my luck'
أَشْتَرِيهِ: أَشْتَرِي + هِ — ishtarā, to buy; 1st sg. imperfect + it; 'I buy it'
بِمِائَةِ: بِـ + مِائَة — bi-, for (prep., price) + miʾa, hundred (first term of an idafa); 'for a hundred'
أَرْجِعُ: arjiʿu — rajaʿa, to return; 1st sg. imperfect; 'I return, I will go back'
جَذَبَ: jadhaba — to pull; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'he pulled'
الْخَيْطَ: الـ + خَيْط — khayṭ, thread, cord (acc.); 'the cord'
وَجَرَّ: وَ + جَرَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + jarra, to drag; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he dragged'
مَقْفُولٌ: maqfūl, locked (colloquial passive participle of qafala; Classical muqfal) (nom.); 'locked'
ثَقِيلُ: thaqīl, heavy (adj., nom., first term of an idafa); 'heavy of'
الْوَزْنِ: الـ + وَزْن — wazn, weight (gen., second term of an idafa); 'the weight'
نَظَرَهُ: نَظَرَ + هُ — naẓara, to look at; 3rd m. sg. perfect + it; 'he looked at it'
جَسَّهُ: جَسَّ + هُ — jassa, to feel, touch; 3rd m. sg. perfect + it; 'he felt it'
وَحَمَلَ: وَ + حَمَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥamala, to carry; with ʿalā, to charge, attack; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and (he) carried', 'and (he) charged'
وَأَوْقَدُوا: وَ + أَوْقَدُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + awqada, to kindle, light (IV); 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they lit'
وَالصُّنْدُوقُ: وَ + الـ + صُنْدُوق — wa-, while, and (conj.: circumstantial) + al- + ṣundūq, chest (nom.); 'while the chest'
وَكَسَرُوا: وَ + كَسَرُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + kasarū, to break; 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they broke'
قُفَّةَ: quffa, basket (acc., first term of an idafa); 'a basket of'
خُوصٍ: khūṣ, palm leaves (gen., second term of an idafa); 'of palm-leaf'
مَخِيطَةً: makhīṭa, sewn (f., acc. adj., passive participle of khāṭa); 'sewn'
صُوفٍ: ṣūf, wool (gen., second term of an idafa); 'of wool'
فَقَطَعُوا: فَ + قَطَعُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + qaṭaʿa, to cut; 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they cut'
فَرْدَةَ: farda, a single piece, one of a pair (acc., first term of an idafa); 'a piece of'
بِسَاطٍ: bisāṭ, carpet (gen., second term of an idafa); 'of carpet'
الْفَرْدَةَ: الـ + فَرْدَة — farda, a single piece, one of a pair (acc.); 'the piece'
فَوَوَجَدُوا: فَ + وَ + وَجَدُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + wa-, and (conj.) + wajada, to find; 3rd m. pl. perfect; the doubled waw is probably a printer's error for فَوَجَدُوا; 'and so they found'
إِزَارًا: izār, a wrap, wrapper, sheet (acc., indef.); 'a wrapper'
وَجَدُوا: wajadū — wajada, to find; 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'they found'
سَبِيكَةُ: sabīka, ingot (nom., first term of an idafa); 'an ingot of'
فِضَّةٍ: fiḍḍa, silver (gen., second term of an idafa); 'of silver'; also (Night 202): فِضَّة — fiḍḍa, silver (f.); gen. after min of the material: min fiḍḍatin, 'of silver'
مَقْتُولَةً: maqtūla, killed, murdered (f., acc., circumstantial); 'murdered'; also: predicate of kāna: kuntu maqtūlatan lā maḥālata, 'I was a dead woman beyond doubt'
مُقَطَّعَةً: muqaṭṭaʿa, cut into pieces (f., acc., passive participle of qaṭṭaʿa, II); 'cut to pieces'
نَظَرَهَا: نَظَرَ + هَا — naẓara, to look at; 3rd m. sg. perfect + her (object without preposition); 'he looked at her'
وَجَرَتْ: وَ + جَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + jarat, to flow, run (jarā); 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'and (they) ran'
خَدَّةِ: khadd, cheek; printed with tā marbūṭa for hāʾ, so read khaddihi (gen., after عَلَى); 'his cheek'
وَالْتَفَتَ: وَ + الْتَفَتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + iltafata, to turn (VIII); 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he turned'
كَلْبَ: kalb, dog (acc., vocative, first term of an idafa); 'you dog of'
الْوُزَرَا: الـ + وُزَرَا — wuzarā, viziers (printed without the final hamza of wuzarāʾ, pl. of wazīr) (gen., second term of an idafa); 'the viziers'
الْقَتْلَى: الـ + قَتْلَى — qatlā, the slain (pl. of qatīl) (nom.); 'the slain'
زَمَنِي: زَمَن + ي — zaman, time, + my (gen., after فِي); 'my time'
وَيَرْمُوهُمْ: وَ + يَرْمُوهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + yarmūhum, they throw them (ramā, 3rd m. pl. imperfect, without the final nūn) + hum; 'and they throw them'
وَيَصِيرُونَ: وَ + يَصِيرُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaṣīrūna, to become (ṣāra); 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'and they become'
مُتَعَلِّقِينَ: mutaʿalliqīna, clinging, attached (pl. acc., active participle of taʿallaqa, V); 'clinging'
بِذِمَّتِي: بِـ + ذِمَّة + ي — bi-, to (prep., the object of تَعَلَّقَ 'cling to') + dhimma, charge, responsibility, + my; 'to my charge'
آخُذَ: ākhudha — akhadha, to take; 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'that I take'
قَتَلَهَا: قَتَلَ + هَا — qatala, to kill; 3rd m. sg. perfect + her; 'he killed her'
وَلَأَ: وَ + لَ + أَ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-, the oath lām (introduces the emphatic verb: 'surely') + a-, the hamza-alif of the verb أَقْتُلَنَّهُ, printed here and continued in the next word; read together as wa-la-uqtulannahu, 'and I shall surely kill him'
قْتُلَنَّهُ: qtulannahu — qatala, to kill; 1st sg. emphatic (nūn al-tawkīd) + him; the qāf is the second half of the split-off word, its hamza-alif being printed at the end of وَلَأَ; 'I shall surely kill him'
اتِّصَالِ: ittiṣāl, connection, kinship (verbal noun of ittaṣala) (gen., first term of an idafa); 'connection'
نَسَبِى: نَسَب + ي — nasab, lineage, + my (gen., second term of an idafa); 'my lineage'
بِالْخَلِيفَةِ: بِـ + الـ + خَلِيفَة — bi-, with (prep.: connected with) + al- + khalīfa, caliph; 'with the caliph' Also bi- only marking what appears after idhā of surprise: wa-idhā bi-al-khalīfati qadima, 'and behold, the caliph arrived'.
تَأْتِنِي: تَأْتِ + نِي — atā, to come, bring (with bi-); 2nd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ + me; 'you bring me'
بِالَّذِى: بِـ + الَّذِى — bi-, with (prep.: bring someone with x), + alladhī, the one who (relative pron., m. sg.); 'with the one who' (after تَأْتِنِي, 'bring me the one who'); after ʿalima, 'know', bi- marks what is known: a-mā ʿalimtum bi-alladhī, 'do you not know (of) the one who'
لِأُ: لِـ + أُ — li-, so that (lām of purpose) + u-, the hamza-alif of أُنْصِفَهَا, printed at the end of this word; read with نْصِفَهَا as li-unṣifahā, 'so that I may do her justice'
نْصِفَهَا: nṣifahā — anṣafa, to deal justly with, do justice to (IV); 1st sg. subjunctive + her; the nūn is the split-off second half of the word whose hamza-alif is printed at the end of لِأُ; 'I do her justice'
شَنَقْتُكَ: شَنَقْتُ + كَ — shanaqa, to hang; 1st sg. perfect + you; 'I hang you' (apodosis of the conditional)
وَأَرْبَعِينَ: وَ + أَرْبَعِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + arbaʿīna, forty (acc., co-object); 'and forty'
الشَّنْقِ: الـ + شَّنْق — shanq, hanging (verbal noun of شَنَقَ, gen.); 'the hanging'
الْإِذْنَ: الـ + إِذْن — idhn, permission, leave (acc.); 'the permission'
الْإِشَارَةُ: الـ + إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, signal (f., nom.); 'the signal'
الْحَارَاتِ: الـ + حَارَات — ḥārāt, quarters, lanes of a city (pl. of حَارَة, gen.); 'the quarters'
الْحُجَّابِ: الـ + حُجَّاب — ḥujjāb, chamberlains (pl. of حَاجِب, gen.); 'the chamberlains'
الْخَشَبَ: الـ + خَشَب — khashab, wood, timber; here the gallows (acc.); 'the wood'
الْخَطِيرُ: الـ + خَطِير — khaṭīr, of high rank, eminent (nom.); 'the eminent'
الْخَلَائِقِ: الـ + خَلَائِق — khalāʾiq, created beings, the people (pl. of خَلِيقَة, gen.); 'the creatures'
الْخَلْقُ: الـ + خَلْق — khalq, creation, creatures, the crowd (nom.); 'the crowd'
الْخِطَابِ: الـ + خِطَاب — khiṭāb, address, speech (gen.); 'the address'
الْفُرْجَةَ: الـ + فُرْجَة — furja, spectacle, sight, entertainment (f., acc.); 'the spectacle'
الْفُقَرَاءِ: الـ + فُقَرَاء — fuqarāʾ, the poor (pl. of فَقِير, gen.); 'the poor'
الْقَتِيلَةَ: الـ + قَتِيلَة — qatīla, slain woman, murder victim (f., acc.); 'the slain woman'
الْوَقْفَةِ: الـ + وَقْفَة — waqfa, standing, a stand (f., gen.); 'the standing'
أَبْدَاهُ: أَبْدَى + ـهُ — abdā, to show, put forth (IV, perfect 3rd m. sg.) + him/it; 'he showed it'
أَحْضَرْتُ: أَحْضَرَ — aḥḍara, to bring, cause to be present (IV, perfect 1st sg.); 'I brought'
أَحْوَرَ: أَحْوَر — aḥwar, with intensely black and white eyes, dark-eyed (gen.); 'wide dark'
أَخْضَرَ: أَخْضَر — akhḍar, green; of cheek-down, dark (gen.); 'green'
أَفْدِيكَ: أَفْدِي + ـكَ — afdī, to ransom (imperfect 1st sg.) + you (m.); 'I ransom you'
أَمْنَعُ: أَمْنَعُ — amnaʿu, to prevent, ward off (imperfect 1st sg.); 'I ward off'
أَمْهَلْتُكَ: أَمْهَلَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — amhala, to grant respite (IV, perfect) + I + you (m.); 'I have granted you respite'
أَمْهِلْنِي: أَمْهِلْ + ـنِي — amhil, grant respite (IV imperative m. sg.) + me; 'grant me respite'
أَنَافَاشْنُقْنِي: أَنَا + فَـ + اشْنُقْ + ـنِي — anā, I; fa-, so, and so (introduces the command); ashnuq, hang (imperative of شَنَقَ) + me; 'I (am he); so hang me'. Printed as one word.
أَوْلَادِ: أَوْلَاد — awlād, sons, children (pl. of وَلَد, gen. in construct); 'sons of'
أُحْضِرَهُ: أُحْضِرَ + ـهُ — uḥḍiru, to bring (IV imperfect 1st sg., pointed subjunctive) + him; 'I bring him'
أُطَالِبُكَ: أُطَالِبُ + ـكَ — uṭālibu, to demand of, call to account (III imperfect 1st sg.) + you (m.); 'I shall demand of you'
بَرْمَكِيًّا: بَرْمَكِيّ — Barmakī, Barmakid (acc. sg. singular after number forty); 'Barmakid'
بَعْدَهَا: بَعْدَ + هَا — baʿda, after (prep.) + -hā, her, it (f.); 'after her', 'after it' (of a f. noun such as sana, 'year')
بِخَلَاصِ: بِـ + خَلَاص — bi-, at (prep.; فَرِحَ بِـ 'rejoice at') + khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (gen.); 'at the deliverance of'
بِشَابٍّ: بِـ + شَابّ — bi-, marks what appears after وَإِذَا ("behold") + shābb, youth (gen., indefinite); 'behold, a youth'
بِشَنْقِهِ: بِـ + شَنْق + ـهِ — bi-, marks the object of the verb أَمَرَ بِـ 'order (something)' + shanq, hanging (gen.) + his; 'the hanging of him'
بِشَنْقِي: بِـ + شَنْق + ـي — bi-, with (عَجِّلْ بِـ 'hasten with') + shanq, hanging (gen.) + my; 'with my hanging'
بِشَيْخٍ: بِـ + شَيْخ — bi-, marks what appears after وَإِذَا ("behold") + shaykh, old man (gen., indefinite); 'behold, an old man'
تَشْتَهِي: تَشْتَهِي — tashtahī, to desire, crave (VIII imperfect 2nd m. sg., defective); 'you desire' Also 3rd f. sg.: annahā tashtahī, 'that she desires'.
تُصَدِّقْ: تُصَدِّقْ — tuṣaddiq, to believe (II imperfect 2nd m. sg., jussive after لَا); 'believe'
حَسَنِ: حَسَن — ḥasan, handsome, good (gen. in construct); 'handsome of'
حَقَّهَا: ḥaqq, right, due (m., acc.; the redress owed for her death) + -hā, her; 'her due'
حَيَوٰةَ: حَيَوٰة — ḥayāh, life (f., acc. after لَا; older spelling with wāw); 'life'
خَرْفَانُ: خَرْفَان — kharfān, senile, doddering (colloquial form; Classical خَرِف, nom.); 'senile'
ذِمَّتِي: ذِمَّة + ـي — dhimma, obligation, responsibility, account (f., gen.) + my; 'my obligation'
سَلَامَتَكَ: سَلَامَة + ـكَ — salāma, safety, well-being (f., acc., elliptical wish) + your (m.); 'your safety'
سَيِّدَ: سَيِّد — sayyid, lord, master (acc., vocative in construct); 'lord of'
شَبِعْتُ: شَبِعَ + ـتُ — shabiʿa, to be satiated (perfect) + I; 'I have had my fill'
شَنْقِ: شَنْق — shanq, hanging (verbal noun of شَنَقَ, gen. in construct); 'hanging of'
شَنْقِهِمْ: شَنْق + ـهِمْ — shanq, hanging (gen.) + their; 'their hanging'
طَاعِنٍ: طَاعِن — ṭāʿin, piercing, thrusting; طَاعِنٌ فِى السِّنِّ 'advanced in age' (gen.); 'advanced'
عَرِيفَ: عَرِيف — ʿarīf, headman, overseer (acc. as predicate of كَانَ, in construct); 'overseer of'
فَلْيَخْرُجْ: فَـ + لِـ + يَخْرُجْ — fa-, so (conjunction); li-, let (lām of command, with jussive); yakhruj, to go out (imperfect 3rd m. sg., jussive); 'so let him go out'
قَاتِلَهَا: قَاتِل + هَا — qātil, killer (active participle of قَتَلَ, acc.) + her; 'her killer'
قَاتِلُ: قَاتِل — qātil, killer (active participle of قَتَلَ, nom. in construct); 'killer of'
قُرْصُ: قُرْص — qurṣ, disc, round cake (nom. in construct); 'disc of'
مُتَعَلِّقًا: مُتَعَلِّق — mutaʿalliq, attached, hanging upon (V participle, acc.); 'attached'
نَقِيِّ: نَقِيّ — naqiyy, clean, pure (gen. in construct); 'clean of'
وَاغْتَاظَ: وَ + اغْتَاظَ — wa-, and (conjunction); ightāẓa, to be enraged (VIII perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'and he was enraged'
وَالسَّيِّدُ: وَ + الـ + سَّيِّد — wa-, and (conjunction); sayyid, lord, master (nom., after ayyuhā); 'and the lord'
وَالشَّابِّ: وَ + الـ + شَّابّ — wa-, and (conjunction); shābb, youth (gen.); 'and the youth'
وَأَفْدِي: وَ + أَفْدِي — wa-, and (conjunction); afdī, to ransom (imperfect 1st sg.); 'and I ransom'
وَأَوْقَفُوهُمْ: وَ + أَوْقَفَ + وا + هُمْ — wa-, and; awqafa, to make stand (IV perfect) + they + them; 'and they made them stand'
وَبَنِي: وَ + بَنِي — wa-, and (conjunction); banī, sons of (pl. construct of ابْن, gen.); 'and the sons of'
وَجَبِينٍ: وَ + جَبِين — wa-, and (conjunction); jabīn, brow, forehead (gen., indefinite); 'and a brow'
وَجَدْتُمُوهَا: وَجَدَ + ـتُمْ + وهَا — wajada, to find (perfect) + you (m. pl.) + her; 'you found her'
وَحَزِنَ: وَ + حَزِنَ — wa-, and (conjunction); ḥazina, to grieve (perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'and he grieved'
وَشَامَةٍ: وَ + شَامَة — wa-, and (conjunction); shāma, mole, beauty-spot (f., gen., indefinite); 'and a mole'
وَشَنْقِ: وَ + شَنْق — wa-, and (conjunction); shanq, hanging (gen. in construct); 'and the hanging of'
وَطَرْفٍ: وَ + طَرْف — wa-, and (conjunction); ṭarf, eye, glance (gen., indefinite); 'and an eye'
وَعِذَارٍ: وَ + عِذَار — wa-, and (conjunction); ʿidhār, down on the cheek, first beard (gen., indefinite); 'and a cheek-down'
وَكَهْفَ: وَ + كَهْف — wa-, and (conjunction); kahf, cave, refuge (acc., vocative in construct); 'and refuge of'
وَنَصَبُوا: وَ + نَصَبَ + وا — wa-, and (conjunction); naṣaba, to set up, erect (perfect) + they; 'and they set up'
وَيَشُقُّ: وَ + يَشُقُّ — wa-, and (conjunction); yashuqqu, to split, cleave (imperfect 3rd m. sg.); 'and he cleaves'
يَتَبَاكَوْنَ: يَتَبَاكَوْنَ — yatabākawna, to weep together, weep (VI imperfect 3rd m. pl.); 'they weep'
يَتَفَرَّجْ: يَتَفَرَّجْ — yatafarraj, to watch a spectacle (V imperfect 3rd m. sg., jussive); 'let him watch'
يَدْرِي: يَدْرِي — yadrī, to know (imperfect 3rd m. sg., defective); 'he knows'
يَطْلُبُهُ: يَطْلُبُ + ـهُ — yaṭlubu, to seek, summon (imperfect 3rd m. sg.) + him; 'seeking him'
يَفْسَحُ: يَفْسَحُ — yafsaḥu, to make room, open a way (imperfect 3rd m. sg.); 'making way'
يَنْتَظِرُونَ: يَنْتَظِرُونَ — yantaẓirūna, to await (VIII imperfect 3rd m. pl.); 'awaiting'
أَوْلَادِ: awlād, sons, children (pl. of وَلَد, gen. in construct); 'sons of'
وَالشَّيْخَ: و + الـ + شَيْخ — shaykh, old man, elder (m., acc.); 'and the elder'
أَحْضَرْنَا: aḥḍarnā, we brought (perf. 1 pl., form IV of ḥaḍara)
قَاتِلَ: qātil, killer, slayer (m., acc. in construct; active participle of qatala); 'the killer of'
الْقَاتِلُ: الـ + قَاتِل — qātil, killer (m., nom.); 'the killer'
يُكَذِّبُهُ: يُكَذِّبُ + هُ — yukadhdhibu, he calls a liar (imperf. 3 m.s., form II of kadhaba) + -hu, him; 'he calls him a liar'
خُذِ: khudhi, take! (imperative m.s. of akhadha; the kasra is the linking vowel before الِاثْنَيْنِ)
وَاشْنُقْهُمَا: و + اشْنُقْ + هُمَا — wa-, and + ushnuq, hang! (imperative m.s. of shanaqa) + -humā, the two of them; 'and hang them both'
أَحَدُهُمَا: أَحَد + هُمَا — aḥad, one (m., nom.) + -humā, of the two of them; 'one of the two'
فَشَنْقُ: فَـ + شَنْق — fa-, then (introduces the result clause) + shanq, hanging (verbal noun, nom., in construct); 'then the hanging of'
السَّمَاءَ: الـ + سَمَاء — samāʾ, sky, heaven (f., acc.); 'the sky'
وَبَسَطَ: و + بَسَطَ — wa-, and + basaṭa, he spread out (perf. 3 m.s.); 'and he spread'
وَأَدَّى: و + أَدَّى — wa-, and + addā, he delivered, gave (perf. 3 m.s., form II); 'and he gave'
أَمَارَةَ: amāra, sign, token, mark (f., acc. in construct); 'the sign of'
قِتْلَتِهَا: قِتْلَة + هَا — qitla, manner of killing (f., gen. in construct) + -hā, her; 'the manner of her killing' (the printed قتلتها might also be read qataltuhā 'I killed her')
وَوَصَفَ: و + وَصَفَ — wa-, and + waṣafa, he described (perf. 3 m.s.); 'and he described'
وَجَدَهُ: وَجَدَ + هُ — wajada, he found (perf. 3 m.s.) + -hu, it; 'he found it'
قِصَّتِهِمَا: قِصَّة + هِمَا — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., gen. after مِنْ) + -himā, of the two of them; 'their two story'
وَأَيْشْ: و + أَيْش — wa-, and + aysh (colloquial contraction of أَيُّ شَيْءٍ), what?; 'and what?'
إِقْرَارِكَ: إِقْرَار + كَ — iqrār, confession (verbal noun of form IV, gen. in construct) + -ka, your; 'your confessing'
بِالْقَتْلِ: بِـ + الـ + قَتْل — bi-, to, in (prep.; here marks what one confesses) + qatl, killing; 'to the killing'
ضَرْبٍ: ḍarb, beating, striking (verbal noun, gen. indef.)
وَمَجِيئِكَ: و + مَجِيء + كَ — wa-, and + majīʾ, coming (verbal noun, gen. in construct) + -ka, your; 'and your coming'
خُذُوا: khudhū, take! (imperative m. pl. of akhadha)
أَبُوهَا: أَب + هَا — ab, father (m., nom., long-form construct) + -hā, her; 'her father'
فَرَزَقَنِي: فَـ + رَزَقَ + نِي — fa-, and then + razaqa, he provided (perf. 3 m.s.) + -nī, me; 'and (he) provided me'
أَوْلَادٍ: awlād, children, sons (m. pl. of walad, gen. indef.)
ذُكُورٍ: dhukūr, males (pl. of dhakar, gen. indef.)
وَتَخْدُمُنِي: و + تَخْدُمُ + نِي — wa-, and + takhdumu, she serves (imperf. 3 f.s.) + -nī, me; 'and serves me'
أُحِبُّهَا: أُحِبُّ + هَا — uḥibbu, I love (imperf. 1 s.) + -hā, her; 'I loved her'
فَمَرِضَتْ: فَـ + مَرِضَتْ — fa-, and then + mariḍat, she fell ill (perf. 3 f.s.); 'and she fell ill'
فَأَحْضَرْتُ: فَـ + أَحْضَرْتُ — fa-, and then + aḥḍartu, I brought (perf. 1 s., form IV); 'and I brought'
الْأَطِبَّاءَ: الـ + أَطِبَّاء — aṭibbāʾ, physicians (m. pl. of ṭabīb, acc.); 'the physicians'
فَتَوَجَّهَتْ: فَـ + تَوَجَّهَتْ — fa-, and then + tawajjahat, she turned toward (perf. 3 f.s., form V); 'and (health) turned toward'
أُدْخِلَهَا: أُدْخِلَ + هَا — udkhila, I take in, make enter (subjunctive 1 s., form IV of dakhala, after أَنْ) + -hā, her; 'to take her in'
دُخُولِ: dukhūl, entering (verbal noun, gen. in construct); 'the entering of'
اشْتَهَيْتُهُ: اشْتَهَيْتُ + هُ — ishtahaytu, I craved (perf. 1 s., form VIII of shahiya) + -hu, it; 'I have craved it'
أَشْتَهِى: ashtahī, I crave (imperf. 1 s., form VIII of shahiya; printed with final ى)
أَشُمُّهَا: أَشُمُّ + هَا — ashummu, I smell (imperf. 1 s. of shamma) + -hā, it; 'I smell it'
وَأَعَضُّ: و + أَعَضُّ — wa-, and + aʿaḍḍu, I bite (imperf. 1 s. of ʿaḍḍa); 'and I bite'
سَاعَتِي: سَاعَة + ي — sāʿa, hour, moment (f., gen. after مِنْ, in construct) + -ī, my; 'my moment' (min sāʿatī, 'that very moment')
أَجِدْهُ: أَجِدْ + هُ — ajid, I find (jussive 1 s. of wajada) + -hu, it; 'I did not find it'
بِدِينَارٍ: بِـ + دِينَار — bi-, for, at the price of (prep.) + dīnār, dinar (m., gen. indef.); 'for a dinar'
لَاشْتَرَيْتُهَا: لَـ + اشْتَرَيْتُ + هَا — la-, (particle answering law, 'would') + ishtaraytu, I bought (perf. 1 s., form VIII of sharā) + -hā, it; 'I would have bought it'
فَشَقَّ: فَـ + شَقَّ — fa-, and so + shaqqa, it was hard (perf. 3 m.s.; shaqqa ʿalā, 'weigh heavily on'); 'and it was hard'
يَابِنْتَ: يَا + بِنْت — yā, O (vocative, joined in the printed text) + bint, daughter (f., acc. in construct after yā); 'O daughter of (my uncle)'
مَالَقِيتُ: مَا + لَقِيتُ — mā, not (particle, joined in the printed text) + laqītu, I found, met (perf. 1 s. of laqiya); 'I did not find'
فَتَشَوَّشْتُ: فَـ + تَشَوَّشْتُ — fa-, and then + tashawwashtu, I was troubled (perf. 1 s., form V, post-Classical); 'and I was troubled'
الضَّعْفُ: الـ + ضَعْف — ḍaʿf, weakness (m., nom.); 'the weakness'
الْبَسَاتِينِ: الـ + بَسَاتِين — basātīn, orchards, gardens (pl. of bustān, gen.); 'the orchards'
فَامْ: فَـ + ام — printed for فَلَمْ (fa-, and then + lam, did not), the lām evidently dropped; 'and not'
خُولِيٌّ: khūlī, steward, head gardener (Egyptian; m., nom. indef.)
فَسَأَلْتُهُ: فَـ + سَأَلْتُ + هُ — fa-, and then + saʾaltu, I asked (perf. 1 s.) + -hu, him; 'and I asked him'
يُوجَدَ: yūjada, be found (passive subjunctive 3 m.s. of wajada, after أَنْ)
مَعْلُومٌ: maʿlūm, known (passive participle of ʿalima, m., nom. indef.)
الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: الـ + مُؤْمِنِينَ — muʾmin, believer (m. pl., gen. or acc.); 'the believers' (amīr al-muʾminīn, Commander of the Faithful)
الْخُولِيِّ: الـ + خُولِيّ — khūlī, steward, head gardener (m., gen. after عِنْدَ); 'the gardener'
يَدَّخِرُهُ: يَدَّخِرُ + هُ — yaddakhiru, he stores, keeps (imperf. 3 m.s., form VIII of dhakhara) + -hu, it; 'he stores it'
مَحَبَّتِي: مَحَبَّة + ي — maḥabba, love (f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my love'
وَمَوَدَّتِى: و + مَوَدَّة + ي — wa-, and + mawadda, affection (f., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with final ى); 'and my affection'
وَهَيَّأْتُ: و + هَيَّأْتُ — wa-, and + hayyaʾtu, I made ready, prepared (perf. 1 s., form II; the edition prints the precomposed أ)
الذَّهَابِ: الـ + ذَهَاب — dhahāb, going (verbal noun, gen. after فِى); 'the going'
وَالْإِيَابِ: و + الـ + إِيَاب — wa-, and + iyāb, returning (verbal noun, gen.); 'and the returning'
تُفَّاحَاتٍ: tuffāḥāt, apples (f. pl. of tuffāḥa, gen. indef. in the number construction)
اشْتَرَيْتُهُمْ: اشْتَرَيْتُ + هُمْ — ishtaraytu, I bought (perf. 1 s., form VIII of sharā) + -hum, them (m. pl., where Classical has the feminine); 'I bought them'
خُولِيِّ: khūlī, steward, head gardener (m., gen. in construct after مِنْ); 'the gardener of'
وَنَاوَلْتُهُمْ: و + نَاوَلْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + nāwaltu, I handed (perf. 1 s., form III) + -hum, them; 'and I handed them'
تَفْرَحْ: tafraḥ, she rejoices (jussive 3 f.s. of fariḥa, after lam)
وَتَرَكْتُهُمْ: و + تَرَكْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + taraktu, I left (perf. 1 s.) + -hum, them; 'and I left them'
وَالْحُمَّى: و + الـ + حُمَّى — wa-, and + ḥummā, fever (f., nom.); 'and the fever'
ضَعْفِهَا: ضَعْف + هَا — ḍaʿf, weakness (m., gen. after فِي) + -hā, her; 'her weakness'
عُوفِيَتْ: ʿūfiyat, she was restored to health (passive perf. 3 f.s. of ʿāfā, form III)
وَذَهَبْتُ: وَ + ذَهَبْتُ — dhahaba, go; 'and I went'
بَيْعِي: بَيْعِي — bayʿ, selling (verbal noun) + ـِي, my; gen. after فِي
وَشِرَائِي: وَ + شِرَائِي — shirāʾ, buying + ـِي, my; 'and my buying'
بِعَبْدٍ: بِـ + عَبْد — ʿabd, slave (m.); bi- here only marks what appears after إِذَا of surprise: 'and behold, a slave'
فَائِتٌ: فَائِتٌ — fāʾit, passing by (act. part. of fāta), as printed; nom.
تُفَّاحَةٌ: تُفَّاحَةٌ — tuffāḥa, an apple (f.); nom. indef.
التُّفَّاحَاتِ: الْـ + تُفَّاحَات — tuffāḥāt, apples (pl. of tuffāḥa); gen. as annexed term
الثَّلٰثِ: الْـ + ثَلٰث — thalāth, three, printed short for ثَلَاث; agrees in the genitive
التُّفَّاحَةَ: الْـ + تُفَّاحَة — tuffāḥa, apple (f.); acc. after the verb
أَخَذْتُهَا: أَخَذْتُ + هَا — akhadha, take; -tu, I; hā, it (f.); 'I took it'
حَبِيبَتِي: حَبِيبَتِي — ḥabība, beloved, sweetheart (f.) + ـِي, my; gen. after مِنْ
غَائِبًا: غَائِبًا — ghāʾib, absent (act. part. of ghāba); acc. predicate
وَعِنْدَهَا: وَ + عِنْدَ + هَا — ʿinda, at, with; 'and with her (were)'
الْقَرْنَانَ: الْـ + قَرْنَان — qarnān, cuckold (Lane); acc. apposition; 'the cuckold'
شَانِهِمُ: شَانِهِمُ — shān, sake, matter (colloquial for shaʾn) + هُمْ, them; with مِنْ 'for their sake'
الْبَصْرَةَ: الْبَصْرَةَ — al-Baṣra, Basra; acc. of goal
اشْتَرَاهُمْ: اِشْتَرَاهُمْ — ishtarā, buy + هُمْ, them; 'he bought them'
بِثَلٰثَةِ: بِـ + ثَلٰثَة — thalātha, three, printed short; bi-, for, at the price of; 'for three'
عَادِمُ: عَادِمُ — ʿādim, lacking (act. part. of ʿadima); nom. in the annex
أَجِدِ: أَجِدِ — wajada, find; jussive, 'I (did) not find'
فَتَحَقَّقْتُ: فَـ + تَحَقَّقْتُ — taḥaqqaqa (form V), verify, hold as certain; 'so I made certain of'
خَلْفِهَا: خَلْفِهَا — khalf, behind + هَا, her; gen. after مِنْ, 'from behind her'
كَلَّمْتُهَا: كَلَّمْتُ + هَا — kallama (form II), speak to; 'I spoke to her'
وَنَحَرْتُهَا: وَ + نَحَرْتُ + هَا — naḥara, slit the throat, strike at the base of the throat (Lane); 'and I cut her throat'
بِالسِّكِّينِ: بِـ + الْ + سِكِّين — bi-, with (prep., instrument); 'with the knife'
وَقَطَعْتُ: وَ + قَطَعْتُ — qaṭaʿa, cut off; 'and I cut off'
رَأْسَهَا: رَأْسَ + هَا — raʾs, head + hā, her; printed with precomposed أ; acc. object
وَحَطَّيْتُهَا: وَ + حَطَّيْتُ + هَا — ḥaṭṭa (form II, colloquial), put, set down; 'and I put her'
الْقُنَّةِ: الْـ + قُنَّة — qunna, as printed (a vessel, or a misprint for قُفَّة, basket); gen. after فِى
بِسُرْعَةٍ: بِـ + سُرْعَة — bi-, with (prep., manner); surʿa, speed; 'with speed, quickly'
وَغَطَّيْتُهَا: وَ + غَطَّيْتُ + هَا — ghaṭṭā (form II), cover; 'and I covered her'
بِالْإِزَارِ: بِـ + الْ + إِزَار — bi-, with (prep., means); izār, wrap, sheet (m.); 'with the wrap'
وَخَيَّطْتُهَا: وَ + خَيَّطْتُ + هَا — khayyaṭa (form II), stitch, sew; 'and I stitched it (her)'
الْبِسَاطِ: الْـ + بِسَاط — bisāṭ, carpet (m.); gen. after مِنَ, 'of the carpet'
وَأَنْزَلْتُهَا: وَ + أَنْزَلْتُ + هَا — anzala (form IV), lower; 'and I lowered her'
وَقَفَلْتُهُ: وَ + قَفَلْتُ + هُ — qafala, lock; 'and I locked it'
وَحَمَلْتُهَا: وَ + حَمَلْتُ + هَا — ḥamala, carry, load; 'and I loaded her'
بَغْلَتِي: بَغْلَتِي — baghla, she-mule + ـِي, my; gen. after عَلَى
وَرَمَيْتُهَا: وَ + رَمَيْتُ + هَا — ramā, throw; 'and I threw her'
مُطَالَبَتِهَا: مُطَالَبَتِهَا — muṭālaba, claim, demand (verbal noun of form III) + هَا, her; gen. after مِنْ
الْقِيٰمَةِ: الْـ + قِيٰمَة — qiyāma, resurrection, printed short for قِيَامَة; gen.
رَمَيْتُهَا: رَمَيْتُ + هَا — ramā, throw; 'I threw her'
وَلَدِى: وَلَدِى — walad, son + my; printed with ى; acc. object; here nom., subject of tuwuffiya (hal tuwuffiya waladī, 'has my son died?'), and gen. after amri (amri waladī)
الْكَبِيرَ: الْـ + كَبِير — kabīr, big, eldest; great, grand (in a title: al-ḥājib al-kabīr, 'the Grand Chamberlain'); acc. adjective
أُمِّهِ: أُمِّ + هِ — umm, mother + hu, his; gen. after فِي, 'to his mother'
خَطَفَهَا: خَطَفَ + هَا — khaṭafa, snatch; 'he snatched it'
جَاءَتْكَ: جَاءَتْ + كَ — jāʾa, come; -at, she (it); ka, you; 'it came to you'
أَجْلِ: أَجْلِ — ajl, sake; gen.; with مِنْ 'for the sake of'
أَخَذَهَا: أَخَذَ + هَا — akhadha, take; 'he took it' ; also: of a feeling, to seize + -hā, her: akhadhahā al-huyāmu, 'love-madness seized her'
يَلْتَفِتْ: يَلْتَفِتْ — iltafata (form VIII), turn, pay attention; jussive after لَمْ
وَضَرَبَنِي: وَ + ضَرَبَ + نِي — ḍaraba, strike; nī, me; 'and he struck me'
شَانِ: شَانِ — shān, matter, cause (colloquial for shaʾn); gen.; with مِنْ 'because of'
فَغِبْتُ: فَـ + غِبْتُ — ghāba, be away; 'so I stayed away'
خَوْفِهَا: خَوْفِ + هَا — khawf, fear + hā, her; gen. after مِنْ
أَمْسَى: أَمْسَى — amsā (form IV), come to evening
تَزْدَادُ: تَزْدَادُ — izdāda (form VIII), increase, grow; 'she grows'
ضَعْفًا: ضَعْفًا — ḍaʿf, weakness; acc. of specification
افْتَرَى: افْتَرَى — iftarā (form VIII), forge, invent (a lie)
الْكَذِبَ: الْكَذِبَ — al-kadhib, the lie (noun used adjectivally); acc.
بِنْتِ: بِنْتِ — bint, daughter; gen. annex after عَلَى; also (Night 202): بِنْت — bint, daughter (f.); gen. in apposition to al-malikati, first term of a construct: binti al-maliki, 'daughter of the king'
قُتِلَتْ: قُتِلَتْ — qutila, be killed (passive); -at, she; 'she was killed'
ظُلْمًا: ظُلْمًا — ẓulm, wrong, injustice; acc. adverb, 'wrongfully'
وَالِدُهَا: وَالِدُ + هَا — wālid, father + hā, her; 'her father'
الْعَزَا: الْعَزَا — al-ʿazā, mourning, printed for الْعَزَاءِ; acc. object
نَتَأَسَّفُ: نَتَأَسَّفُ — taʾassafa (form V), grieve, lament; printed with precomposed أ
رَأْسِ: رَأْسِ — raʾs, head; printed with precomposed أ; gen. annex
الْبُعْدِ: الْـ + بُعْد — buʿd, distance, as printed (evidently a misprint for الْعَبْد, the slave); gen.; in Night 131 plainly buʿd, distance: mina al-buʿd, 'from afar'
فَبِحُرْمَةِ: فَـ + بِـ + حُرْمَة — fa-, so; bi-, by (oath-preposition); ḥurma, sanctity; 'so by the sanctity of'
أَجْدَادِكَ: أَجْدَادِ + كَ — ajdād, forefathers, grandfathers + ka, your (m.)
بِقَتْلِي: بِـ + قَتْلِي — bi-, with (after عَجِّلْ 'hasten with'); qatl, killing + ī, my; 'with my killing'
حَيٰوةَ: حَيٰوَة — ḥayāh, life, printed with wāw (older spelling)
وَخُذْحَقَّهَا: وَ + خُذْ + حَقَّ + هَا — printed as one run-together word; khudh, take (imperative of akhadha); ḥaqq, right, due; hā, her; 'and take her due'
الْمَلْعُونَ: الْـ + مَلْعُون — malʿūn, accursed (pass. part. of laʿana); acc.
عْمَلُ: عْمَلُ — (a)ʿmalu, 'I do', the أ of أَعْمَلُ merged into the preceding لَا; see the note in the unit
الْعَلِيلُ: الْـ + عَلِيل — ʿalīl, sick, ailing; nom.
وَيَرْضَى: وَ + يَرْضَى — raḍiya, be pleased; 'and is pleased'
الْعِشْرُونَ: الـ + عِشْرُون — ʿishrūn, twenty (nom.; ordinal use 'the twentieth')
حَلَفَ: ḥalafa, to swear (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he swore'
مَعْذُورٌ: maʿdhūr, excused, blameless (passive part. of ʿadhara, to excuse; m., nom. sg.)
أَحْضِرْ: aḥḍara, to bring, cause to be present (verb IV, imper. 2ms); 'bring'
الْقَضِيَّةُ: الـ + قَضِيَّة — qaḍiyya, affair, case (f., nom. sg.)
تُحْضِرْهُ: ḥaḍara, to be present; aḥḍara, to bring (verb IV, impf. 2ms jussive) + 3ms object suffix ـهُ; 'you bring him'
عِوَضُهُ: عِوَض + ـهُ — ʿiwaḍ, replacement, substitute (m., nom. sg.) + 3ms suffix; 'his replacement'
حَضِّرْ: ḥaḍḍara, to prepare, make ready (verb II, imper. 2ms; the print is bare, a perf. 3ms is also possible); 'prepare'
مَوْتَتَيْنِ: مَوْتَة — mawta, a death, one dying (f., dual acc./gen.); 'two deaths'
تَسْلَمُ: salima, to be safe, come through unharmed (verb I, impf. 3fs); 'it is safe'
الْجَرَّةُ: الـ + جَرَّة — jarra, jar, pitcher (f., nom. sg.)
يُسَلِّمُنِي: sallama, to save (verb II, impf. 3ms) + 1s object suffix ـنِي; 'he will save me'
وَاللهِ: وَ + اللهِ — wa-, by (oath particle) + Allāh, God (gen. after the oath); 'by God'
أَخْرُجُ: kharaja, to go out (verb I, impf. 1s); 'I go out'
وَالْحَقُّ: وَ + الـ + حَقّ — wa-, and + al-ḥaqq, the Real, the True (a name of God; nom.); 'and the Real'
أَقَامَ: aqāma, to stay, dwell (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); 'he stayed' Also with ʿalā, 'to remain on': aqāma ʿalā kursiyyi mamlakatihi, 'he stayed on the throne of his kingdom'.
أَوْلَادَهُ: أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — awlād, children (pl. of walad, acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
بِرَسُولِ: بِـ + رَسُول — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise (not translated) + rasūl, messenger (m., gen. in construct); 'and behold, a messenger'
أَشَدِّ: ashadd, most severe, strongest (elative of shadīd; gen. in construct)
بِطَلَبِكَ: بِـ + طَلَب + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep.; arsala bi-, 'send for') + ṭalab, request, summons (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'for your summons', 'for you'
مَشْنُوقٌ: mashnūq, hanged (passive part. of shanaqa; m., nom. indef.)
أَوْلَادُهُ: أَوْلَاد + ـهُ — awlād, children (nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
وَعَبِيدُهُ: وَ + عَبِيد + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿabīd, slaves, servants (pl. of ʿabd, nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his servants'
التَّوْدِيعِ: الـ + تَوْدِيع — tawdīʿ, bidding farewell (verbal noun of waddaʿa, verb II; m., gen.)
إِىٰ: ilā, to (prep.; the print has اى, without the lam, read ilā)
الصَّغِيرَةِ: الـ + صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīra, small, little (adj., f., gen. sg.)
لِيُوَدِّعَهَا: لِـ + يُوَدِّعَ + ـهَا — li-, in order to (with subjunctive) + waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, impf. 3ms subj.) + 3fs object suffix; 'to bid her farewell'
أَوْلَادِهِ: أَوْلَاد + ـهِ — awlād, children (gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his children'
فَضَمَّهَا: فَـ + ضَمَّ + ـهَا — fa-, so + ḍamma, to clasp, press (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object suffix; 'so he clasped her'
وَبَاسَهَا: وَ + بَاسَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + bāsa, to kiss (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object suffix; 'and kissed her'
فِرَاقِهَا: فِرَاق + ـهَا — firāq, parting, separation (verbal noun of fāraqa; m., gen.) + 3fs suffix; 'parting from her'
مُكَتَّبًا: mukattab, inscribed, written upon (form II passive part. of kattaba; m., acc.; the print lacks the waw of maktūb)
جَيْبِكِ: جَيْب + ـكِ — jayb, pocket (m., gen.) + 2fs suffix; 'your pocket'
أَبَتِ: abat, my father (vocative with the ـتِ of address, from ab + ـī); 'father!'
عَبْدُنَا: عَبْد + ـنَا — ʿabd, slave (m., nom.) + 1pl suffix; 'our slave'
أَعْطَا: aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms; the print has final alif for ى); 'he gave'
هَانِي: هَا + نِي — hā, it (3fs object suffix, written apart) + nī, to me (1s); 'it to me'
وَالتُّفَّاحَةِ: وَ + الـ + تُفَّاحَة — wa-, and + tuffāḥa, apple (f., gen.); 'and the apple'
جَيْبِ: جَيْب — jayb, pocket (m., gen. in construct)
فَعَرَفَهَا: فَـ + عَرَفَ + ـهَا — fa-, and so + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object suffix; 'and recognised it'
قَرِيبَ: qarīb, near (acc. in construct, vocative); here: acc. used as a preposition, 'near'
الْفَرَجِ: الـ + فَرَج — faraj, relief, deliverance (m., gen. sg.)
الْكَذِبُ: الـ + كَذِب — kadhib, lying, falsehood (m., nom.)
أَنْجَا: anjā, more saving (elative of najā, to be saved; printed with alif for ى)
فَالصِّدْقُ: فَـ + الـ + صِّدْق — fa-, then (apodosis) + al-ṣidq, truth, truthfulness (m., nom.); 'then truth'
وَأَنْجَا: وَ + أَنْجَا — wa-, and + anjā, more saving; 'and more saving still'
سَرَقْتُهَا: سَرَقَ + ـتُ + ـهَا — saraqa, to steal (verb I, perf. 1s) + 3fs object suffix; 'I stole it'
الْحَضْرَةِ: الـ + حَضْرَة — ḥaḍra, the Presence (honorific for the caliph or his court; f., gen.)
إِنَّمَا: إِنَّمَا — innamā, only, but rather (restrictive particle: it puts the weight on what follows); 'rather, it is only'
أَزِقَّةِ: أَزِقَّة — aziqqa, lanes, alleys (pl. of zuqāq; gen. in construct)
صِغَارًا: ṣighār, small ones, children (pl. of ṣaghīr; acc.)
وَمَعَ: وَ + مَعَ — wa-, and + maʿa, with (prep.); 'and with'
فَخَطَفْتُهَا: فَـ + خَطَفَ + ـتُ + ـهَا — fa-, so + khaṭafa, to snatch (verb I, perf. 1s) + 3fs object suffix; 'so I snatched it'
لِأُمِّي: لِـ + أُمّ + ـي — li-, for, belonging to (prep.) + umm, mother (f., gen.) + 1s suffix; 'for my mother'
مَرِيضَةٌ: marīḍa, ill, sick (adj., f., nom. indef.)
اشْتَهَتْ: ishtahā, to crave, desire (verb VIII defective, perf. 3fs); 'she craved'
أَبِى: أَب + ـي — ab, father (m., gen.) + 1s suffix; 'my father'; ishtahā ʿalā, 'crave of (someone)' Also ab, father (gen.) as the first part of the name Abū al-Ḥasan: min amri Abī al-Ḥasani, 'of the affair of Abū al-Ḥasan' (the print writes final ى). Also abī, genitive of abū in a kunya, printed with final ى: ilā Abī al-Ḥasani, 'to Abū al-Ḥasan'.
فَسَرَقْتُ: فَـ + سَرَقْتُ — fa-, so + saraqa, to steal (perf. 1s); 'so I stole'
فَامَ: fa-mā, so not (printed فام, a misprint with the letters reversed for فَمَا)
وَأَخَذْتُهَا: وَ + أَخَذَ + ـتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 1s) + 3fs object suffix; 'and I took it'
بِدِينَارَيْنِ: بِـ + دِينَارَيْنِ — bi-, for, at the price of (prep.) + dīnāray, two dinars (dual gen.); 'for two dinars'
لِكَوْنِ: لِـ + كَوْن — li-, because of, at (prep. of cause) + kawn, being, the fact (verbal noun of kāna; m., gen. in construct); 'because of the fact (that)'
الْفِتْنَةَ: الـ + فِتْنَة — fitna, strife, trial, sedition (f., acc. after anna)
وَقَتْلَ: وَ + قَتْل — wa-, and + qatl, killing (verbal noun of qatala; m., acc. in construct); 'and the killing of'
عَبْدِهِ: عَبْد + ـهِ — ʿabd, slave (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his slave'
لِنِسْبَةِ: لِـ + نِسْبَة — li-, because of, at (prep. of cause) + nisba, relation, attribution (f., gen. in construct); 'at the relation of'
الْمُصِيْبَةُ: الـ + مُصِيبَة — muṣība, calamity, misfortune (f., nom.)
غُلَامٍ: ghulām, boy, young servant (m., gen. indef.)
فَتَجْعَلُهُ: فَـ + تَجْعَلُ + ـهُ — fa-, then (apodosis) + jaʿala, to make, put (verb I, impf. 2ms) + 3ms object suffix; 'then you make him'
لِنَفْسِكَ: لِـ + نَفْس + ـكَ — li-, for (prep.) + nafs, self (f., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'for yourself'
فِدَاهَا: فِدَاء + ـهَا — fidāʾ, ransom (m., gen.; printed without the final hamza) + 3fs suffix; 'its ransom'
فَاِنَّكَ: فَـ + اِنَّ + ـكَ — fa-, for, then + inna, indeed + 2ms suffix; 'for indeed you'
وَنَفْسُكَ: وَ + نَفْس + ـكَ — wa-, but, and + nafs, self (f., nom.) + 2ms suffix; 'but your self'
مَسَكَ: masaka, he seized, took hold (I, perf. 3ms)
أَوَّلِهَا: أَوَّل + ـهَا — awwal, first, beginning (m.) + 3fs; 'its beginning', gen. after min
وَضَحِكَ: وَ + ضَحِكَ — wa-, and + ḍaḥika, he laughed (I, perf. 3ms)
انْقَلَبَ: inqalaba, he overturned, toppled over (VII, perf. 3ms); here with fī ṣūrati, 'turned (himself) into the form of'
أَمَرَانْ: أَمَرَ + أَنْ — amara, he ordered (I, perf. 3ms) + an, that (subjunctive particle), run together in print; 'he ordered that'
تُؤَرَّخَ: tuʾarrakha, be dated, be recorded in the annals (II passive, subj. 3fs; from ʾarrakha, to date, chronicle)
الْحِكَايَةُ: الـ + حِكَايَة — ḥikāya, tale, story (f.); nom., subject of the passive verbs
وَتُجْعَلَ: وَ + تُجْعَلَ — wa-, and + tujʿala, be made (I passive, subj. 3fs)
سِيَرًا: siyar, chronicles, biographies (pl. of sīra); acc., the second object of 'make'
تَعْجَبْ: taʿjab, do not marvel (I, jussive 2ms after lā, prohibition; from ʿajiba)
فَمَاهِيَ: فَ + مَا + هِيَ — fa-, for, then + mā, not (negation) + hiya, she/it (3fs); 'for it is not'
أَعْجَبُ: aʿjab, more marvellous (elative of ʿajīb), nom. predicate
نُورِالدِّينِ: نُور + الـ + دِين — Nūr al-Dīn, 'light of the faith' (name), gen.; printed as one word
نُورِ: nūr, light (m.); gen. in the name Nūr al-Dīn
وَأَخِيهِ: وَ + أَخ + ـهِ — wa-, and + akh, brother (m.) + 3ms; 'and his brother', gen.
وَشَمْسِ: وَ + شَمْس — wa-, and + shams, sun (f.); first half of the name Shams al-Dīn, gen. Also in the name Shams al-Nahār: wa-Shamsi al-Nahāri, 'and Shams al-Nahār'.
أَخِيهِ: أَخ + ـهِ — akh, brother (m.) + 3ms; 'his brother', gen. in apposition
تُعْتِقَ: tuʿtiqa, you free, emancipate (IV, subj. 2ms, after an)
عَبْدِي: عَبْد + ـي — ʿabd, slave (m.) + 1s; 'my slave', acc. object
أَعْجَبَ: aʿjaba, more marvellous (elative, diptote acc.), predicate of kāna
بِأ: بِـ + أ — bi-, with, in the way of (prep., here the predicate of a negated kāna) + a, the first letter of aʿjab, split from it in print; together bi-aʿjaba 'more marvellous'
عْجَبَ: ʿjaba, the rest of aʿjab, more marvellous (elative, diptote gen.), split off in print
عَبْدَكَ: عَبْد + ـكَ — ʿabd, slave (m.) + 2ms; 'your slave', acc. object
سَالِفِ: sālif, past, bygone (act. part. of salafa, m.); gen. in construct
سُلْطَانٌ: sulṭān, sultan (m.); nom., subject of kāna (indefinite after 'that he was')
وَأَمَانٍ: وَ + أَمَان — wa-, and + amān, security, safe-keeping (m.); gen.
وَيُجَالِسُ: وَ + يُجَالِسُ — wa-, and + yujālisu, he sits with, keeps company with (III, impf. 3ms)
