الْعُلَمَاءَ: الـ + عُلَمَاء — ʿulamāʾ, scholars, the learned (pl. of ʿālim; acc. object)
وَالتَّدْبِيرِ: وَ + الـ + تَدْبِير — wa-, and + al- + tadbīr, management, administration (m., verbal noun II); 'and of management'
وَلَدَ: walad, child, son (m.); first part of the dual walad-āni 'two sons', split in print
انِ: -āni, the dual ending (nom.), split off in print; 'two (sons)'
يُرَ: yura, is seen (I passive, jussive 3ms of raʾā, after lam)
مِثْلُهُمَا: مِثْل + هُمَا — mithl, like, the equal of (m.) + 3 dual; 'their like', nom. subject of the passive
الْكَبِيرِ: الـ + كَبِير — kabīr, big, great, elder; chief (m., gen.); al-khādim al-kabīr, 'the chief eunuch'
شَمْسُ: shams, sun (f.); first half of the name Shams al-Dīn, nom.; also: first part of the name Shams al-Nahār, nom. (samiʿat Shamsu al-Nahāri)
وَاسْمُ: وَ + اسْم — wa-, and + ism, name (m.), nom. in construct
نُورُالدِّينِ: نُور + الـ + دِين — Nūr al-Dīn, 'light of the faith' (name), nom.; printed as one word
أَمْيَزَ: amyaz, more distinguished, more outstanding (elative of mayyiz, from mayyaza; acc. diptote), predicate of kāna
الصَّبَاحَةِ: الـ + صَبَاحَة — ṣabāḥa, radiance, comeliness (f.); gen.
وَالْمَلَاحَةِ: وَ + الـ + مَلَاحَة — wa-, and + malāḥa, charm, comeliness (f.); gen., rhyming with ṣabāḥa; also gen. after bi-, rhyming with al-faṣāḥa: kamula bi-al-faṣāḥati wa-al-malāḥati, 'perfect in eloquence and comeliness'
الْبُلْدَانِ: الـ + بُلْدَان — buldān, lands, towns (pl. of balad); gen.
تَسَامَعُوا: tasāmaʿū, they heard of him from one another (VI, perf. 3mp)
فَسَافَرُوا: فَ + سَافَرُوا — fa-, and so + sāfarū, they travelled (III, perf. 3mp)
رُؤْيَةِ: ruʾya, seeing, sight (f., verbal noun of raʾā); gen. in construct (printed with ؤ); also: 'look, appearance': ghayru ruʾyati al-ʿawāmm, 'not the look of common folk'
فَاتَّفَقَ: فَ + اتَّفَقَ — fa-, so + ittafaqa, it happened (VIII, perf. 3ms)
وَالِدَهُمْ: وَالِد + هُمْ — wālid, father (act. part. of walada, m.) + 3mp; 'their father', acc. after anna
الْوَلَدَيْنِ: الـ + وَلَد — walad, son (m.), dual gen./acc.; 'the two sons'
وَقَرَّبَهُمَا: وَ + قَرَّبَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + qarraba, he drew near (II, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual; 'and drew them near'
وَأَخْلَعَ: وَ + أَخْلَعَ — wa-, and + akhlaʿa, he bestowed a robe of honour (IV, perf. 3ms; Classical khalaʿa ʿalā)
مَرْتَبَةِ: martaba, rank, station (f.); gen. in construct
أَبِيكُمْ: أَب + كُمْ — ab, father (m.) + 2mp; 'your father', gen.
تُكَدِّرْ: tukaddir, do (you) trouble, disturb (II, jussive after lā; the plural -ū is printed on the next word)
وَاخَوَاطِرَكُمْ: وَا + خَوَاطِر + كُمْ — wā, the plural -ū of the verb, run onto this word in print + khawāṭir, thoughts, minds (pl. of khāṭir) + 2mp; 'your minds' (read tukaddirū khawāṭirakum, 'do not trouble your minds')
وَعَمِلُوا: وَ + عَمِلُوا — wa-, and + ʿamilū, they made, performed (I, perf. 3mp)
لِأَبِيهِمْ: لِـ + أَب + هِمْ — li-, for (prep.; 'for, on behalf of') + ab, father (m.) + 3mp; 'for their father'
إِتْمَامِ: itmām, completion (m., verbal noun IV of tamma); gen. after ilā
الْوِزَارَةِ: الـ + وِزَارَة — wizāra, vizierate, office of vizier (f.); gen. after fī
بِأَيْدِيهِمَا: بِـ + أَيْدِي + هِمَا — bi-, in, by (prep.; 'in the hands of') + aydī, hands (pl. of yad) + 3 dual; 'in their two hands'
أَبِيهِمَا: أَب + هِمَا — ab, father (m.) + 3 dual; 'their father', gen. in construct
السَّفَرَ: الـ + سَفَر — safar, travel, journey (m.); acc. object
سَفَرُالْكَبِيرِ: سَفَر + الـ + كَبِير — safar, travel, journey (m.) + al- + kabīr, the elder; 'the elder's trip/turn', nom.; printed as one word, with a feminine kānat before it
لِلصَّغِيرِ: لِـ + الـ + صَغِير — li-, to (prep.) + al- + ṣaghīr, the younger; 'to the younger'
أَتَزَوَّجَ: atazawwaja, I marry (V, subj. 1s, after an)
مُوَافِقُكَ: مُوَافِق + ـكَ — muwāfiq, agreeing (act. part. III of wāfaqa, m.) + 2ms; 'agreeing with you'
مَاتَقُولُ: مَا + تَقُولُ — mā, what + taqūlu, you say (I, impf. 2ms, hollow); printed as one word; 'what you say'
فَاتَّفَقُوا: فَ + اتَّفَقُوا — fa-, so + ittafaqū, they agreed (VIII, perf. 3mp)
لِأَخِيهِ: لِـ + أَخ + ـهِ — li-, to (prep.) + akh, brother (m.) + 3ms; 'to his brother'
قَدَّرَاللَّهُ: قَدَّرَ + اللَّه — qaddara, he decreed (II, perf. 3ms) + Allāh, God, nom. subject; printed as one word; 'God decrees'
وَخَطَبْنَا: وَ + خَطَبْنَا — wa-, and + khaṭabnā, we asked in marriage, we proposed for (I, perf. 1pl)
وَوَضَعَتَا: وَ + وَضَعَتَا — wa-, and + waḍaʿatā, they two bore, gave birth (I, perf. 3 dual f.)
وَأَرَادَ: وَ + أَرَادَ — wa-, and + arāda, he willed, wanted (IV, perf. 3ms, hollow)
بِصَبِيٍّ: بِـ + صَبِيّ — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi- 'come with, bring, produce') + ṣabī, boy (m.), gen.; 'with a boy'
نُزَوِّجُهُمَا: نُزَوِّجُ + هُمَا — nuzawwiju, we marry off (II, impf. 1pl of zawwaja) + 3 dual; 'we marry them'
لِبَعْضِهِمَا: لِـ + بَعْض + هِمَا — li-, to (prep.: after a verb of saying, the one addressed; zawwaja X li- Y 'marry X to Y') + baʿḍ, part, one (m.) + 3 dual; 'to each other'
وَيَصِيرَا: وَ + يَصِيرَا — wa-, and + yaṣīrā, they two become (I, impf. 3 dual m., hollow; the final n is dropped, as in the subjunctive)
أَوْلَادَ: awlād, children, sons (pl. of walad); acc., predicate of yaṣīrā, in construct
عَمٍّ: ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.); gen.; awlād ʿamm 'cousins'
مَهْرِ: mahr, dowry, bride-price (m.); gen. in construct
بِنْتِكَ: بِنْت + ـكَ — bint, daughter (f.) + 2ms; 'your daughter', gen.
لِبِنْتِي: لِـ + بِنْت + ـي — li-, for (prep.; 'for the sake of') + bint, daughter (f.) + 1s; 'for my daughter'
ثَلٰثَةَ: thalātha, three (numeral, f. form before a masc. noun; printed ثلثة, with the dagger alif); acc. object, in construct; also (Night 202): thalātha, three (numeral, f. form before a masc. noun; printed ثلثة, read with the dagger alif); acc. of time, in construct: thalāthata ayyāmin, 'for three days', also giving the measure of muhlatan
وَثَلٰثَ: وَ + ثَلٰثَ — wa-, and + thalātha, three (printed ثلث, with the dagger alif; before a fem./pl. noun)
سَاتِينَ: sātīn, gardens (read for basātīn, pl. of bustān, with the first letter dropped in print); gen.
ضِيَاعٍ: ḍiyāʿ, estates, landholdings (pl. of ḍayʿa); gen.
يَصِحُّ: yaṣiḥḥu, it is valid, sound (I, impf. 3ms)
الْمَهْرُ: الـ + مَهْر — mahr, dowry (m.); nom. predicate
بِالشَّرْطِ: بِـ + الـ + شَرْط — bi-, with, by way of (prep.) + al- + sharṭ, condition (m.); 'by the condition', i.e. as a stipulated condition
بِفَضْلِ: بِـ + فَضْل — bi-, by, through (prep.) + faḍl, favour, grace (m.), gen. in construct; 'by the favour of'; also bi-, with (instrument) + faḍl, excess, the part that hangs over: bi-faḍli al-kummi, 'with the overhang of the sleeve', the loose end beyond the hand
وُزَرَاءُ: wuzarāʾ, viziers (pl. of wazīr); nom. predicate
مَقَامٍ: maqām, station, rank (m.); gen. after fī
الْوَاجِبُ: الـ + وَاجِب — wājib, obligatory, duty (act. part. of wajaba, m.); 'the duty', nom.
تُقَدِّمَ: tuqaddima, you present, offer (II, subj. 2ms, after an)
ابْنَتَكَ: ابْنَة + ـكَ — ibna, daughter (f.) + 2ms; 'your daughter', acc. object
لِوَلَدِي: لِـ + وَلَد + ـي — li-, to (prep.) + walad, son (m.) + 1s; 'to my son'
فَتَجْعَلُ: فَ + تَجْعَلُ — fa-, then (introducing the command) + tajʿalu, you make (I, impf. 2ms), used for the imperative
مَعْلُومًا: maʿlūm, known, stated (pass. part. of ʿalima, m.); acc.
لِيَظْهَرَ: لِـ + يَظْهَرَ — li-, so that (introducing a purpose, with the subjunctive) + yaẓhara, it appear (I, subj. 3ms)
الذَّكَرَ: الـ + ذَكَر — dhakar, male (m.); acc. after anna
أَفْضَلُ: afḍal, better (elative of fāḍil; m.), nom. predicate
الْأُنْثَى: الـ + أُنْثَى — unthā, female (f.); gen. after min
وَوَلَدِي: وَ + وَلَد + ـي — wa-, and + walad, son (m.) + 1s; 'and my son', nom.
وَنُذْكَرُبِهِ: وَ + نُذْكَرُ + بِـ + ـهِ — wa-, and + nudhkaru, we are mentioned, remembered (I passive, impf. 1pl of dhakara) + bi-, by, through (prep.) + 3ms; 'and through him we are remembered' (printed as one word)
بِخِلَافِ: بِـ + خِلَاف — bi-, with (prep.) + khilāf, contrast, opposite (m.), gen. in construct; 'in contrast to'
وَمَالَهَا: وَ + مَا + لِـ + هَا — wa-, and + mā, what + li-, to, for (prep.) + 3fs; 'and what is with her?', 'what is wrong with her?'
نُذْكَرُبِهَا: نُذْكَرُ + بِـ + هَا — nudhkaru, we are mentioned (I passive, impf. 1pl) + bi-, by, through (prep.) + 3fs; 'we are remembered through her' (printed as one word)
تُرِيدُانْ: تُرِيدُ + أَنْ — turīdu, you want (IV, impf. 2ms) + an, that (particle), run together in print; 'you want to'
تَدَّمَ: taddama, he came forward to (read for taqaddama, V, with the qāf dropped in print)
أَصْحَابِهِ: أَصْحَاب + ـهِ — aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of ṣāḥib) + 3ms; 'his friends', gen.
فَقَصَدَهُ: فَ + قَصَدَ + هُ — fa-, and so + qaṣada, he sought out, went to (I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and so he went to him'
حَاجَتَكَ: حَاجَة + ـكَ — ḥāja, need, request (f.) + 2ms; 'your need', acc. object
فَأَنْشَدَ: فَ + أَنْشَدَ — fa-, and so + anshada, he recited (a poem), (IV, perf. 3ms)
الْجَوَابِ: الـ + جَوَاب — jawāb, answer, reply (m.); gen. after fī
الْحَاجَاتِ: الـ + حَاجَات — ḥājāt, needs, requests (pl. of ḥāja); gen. after fī
فَذَاكَ: فَ + ذَاكَ — fa-, then (introducing the result) + dhāka, that (m. demonstrative); 'then that'
طَرْدًا: ṭard, driving away, rebuff (m., verbal noun of ṭarada); acc. predicate
أَرَاكَ: أَرَى + كَ — arā, I see (impf. 1st sg. of ra'ā, 'to see'; here with two objects) + -ka, you; 'I see you'
تُقَصِّرُ: taqṣīr — qaṣṣara, to fall short, be remiss (II, impf. 2nd m. sg.); 'you fall short'
وَتَعْمَلُ: وَ + تَعْمَلُ — wa-, and + taʿmalu, you do, make (impf. 2nd m. sg. of ʿamila); 'and you make'
بِنْتَكَ: بِنْت + كَ — bint, daughter (f., acc., object of taʿmalu) + -ka, your; 'your daughter'
أَفْضَلَ: afḍal — better, superior (elative of faḍl; acc., second object, 'as better')
لَاشَكَّ: لَا + شَكَّ — lā, no, not (neg.) + shakk, doubt (m., acc. after lā of total negation; printed as one word); 'no doubt'
نَاقِصُ: nāqiṣ — deficient, lacking (act. part. of naqaṣa; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَلَالَكَ: وَ + لَا + لِـ + كَ — wa-, and; lā, not; li-, to (prep., of possession) + -ka, you; 'and you have not' ('and not to you')
أَخْلَاقٌ: akhlāq — manners, character (pl. of khuluq; nom.); 'manners'
تَذْكُرُ: dhakara — to mention (impf. 2nd m. sg.); 'you mention'
شِرْكَةَ: shirka — partnership, sharing (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
أَدْخَلْتُكَ: adkhaltuka — ا^َدْخَلَ + تُ + كَ: adkhala, to bring in (IV perf.) + -tu, I + -ka, you; 'I brought you in'
تُسَاعِدُنِي: tusāʿidu + nī — sāʿada, to help (III, impf. 2nd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'you help me'
وَنَكُونُ: وَ + نَكُونُ — wa-, and + nakūnu, we are (impf. 1st pl. of kāna); 'and we are' (sense probably 'you will be')
مُعِينًا: muʿīn — helper, supporter (m., acc. as predicate of nakūnu); 'a helper'
بِخَاطِرِكَ: بِـ + خَاطِر + كَ — bi-, in, at (prep.; here it makes the idiom 'break at someone's heart' = hurt his feelings) + khāṭir, mind, heart, feelings (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your feelings'
وَحَيْثُمَا: وَ + حَيْثُمَا — wa-, and + ḥaythumā, where(ever); here 'since, seeing that' (Middle Arabic sense); 'and since'
قَوْلُكَ: قَوْل + كَ — qawl, saying (m., nom., predicate) + -ka, your; 'your saying'
أُزَوِّجُ: uzawwiju — zawwaja, to marry off, give in marriage (II, impf. 1st sg.); 'I marry off'
لِوَلَدِكَ: لِـ + وَلَد + كَ — li-, to (prep.; marks the man to whom a girl is married) + walad, son, child (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'to your son'
وَزَنْتَ: wazanta — wazana, to weigh (perf. 2nd m. sg.); 'you weighed'
ثِقْلَهَا: ثِقْل + هَا — thiql, weight (m., acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her weight'
ذَهَبًا: dhahab — gold (m., acc. of specification, 'in gold')
اغْتَاظَ: ightāẓa — to be enraged (VIII perf. of ghāẓa); 'he was enraged'
أَرْضَاءَ: arḍā(ʾ) — obscure form: probably ا^َرْضَاهُ 'I accept him' or ا^َرْضَى 'I accept' (arḍā, 1st sg. impf. of raḍiya) with a stray ء; see the note
فَرَجٌ: faraj — relief, ease (m., nom. with tanwīn); here perhaps 'then comes the relief'; obscure, see the note
أُرِيكَ: ا^ُرِي + كَ — urī, I show (impf. 1st sg. of IV arā) + -ka, you; 'I show you'
مَاتَقْتَضِي: مَا + تَقْتَضِي — mā, what (rel.) + taqtaḍī, it requires, demands (impf. 3rd f. sg. of VIII iqtaḍā; printed as one word); 'what demands'
مُرُوَّتِي: مُرُوَّة + ـي — muruwwa, manliness, honour (f., nom., subject of taqtaḍī) + -ī, my; 'my manliness'
امْتَلَأَ: imtalaʾa — to be filled (VIII perf. of malaʾa; spelled امتلا as printed); 'he was filled'
وَكَتَمَ: وَ + كَتَمَ — wa-, and + katama, he concealed (perf.); 'and he hid'
نَاحِيَةٍ: nāḥiya — side, quarter, part (f., gen. with tanwīn after fī); 'in a side' Also after ilā, 'toward': ashārū ilā nāḥiyatin, 'they pointed to one side'; and after fī ayyi, 'quarter': fī ayyi nāḥiyatin, 'in which quarter'.
بَرَزَ: baraza — he came forth, went out (perf.)
وَغَدَا: وَ + غَدَا — wa-, and + ghadā, he went out at morning (perf. of ghadā); 'and he set out early'
الْجِيزَةِ: الـ + جِيزَة — Jīza, Giza (f., gen. after fī); 'the Giza'
وَقَصَدَ: وَ + قَصَدَ — wa-, and + qaṣada, he made for; he intended, aimed at (perf. 3ms): qaṣada bi-dhālika an, 'by that he meant that'
الْأَهْرَامَ: الـ + ا^َهْرَام — ahrām, pyramids (pl. of haram; m., acc., object); 'the pyramids'
وَصَحِبَهُ: وَ + صَحِبَ + هُ — wa-, and + ṣaḥiba, he accompanied (perf.) + -hu, him; 'and accompanied him'
فَبَاتَ: فَـ + بَاتَ — fa-, then (opens the main clause after ammā) + bāta, he spent the night (perf.); 'then he passed the night' Also simple fa- of sequence, 'so': fa-bāta al-maliku tilka al-laylata mutashawwisha al-khāṭiri, 'so the king spent that night troubled in mind' (bāta with its predicate in the accusative).
وَصَلَّى: وَ + صَلَّى — wa-, and + ṣallā, he prayed (II perf.)
الصُّبْحَ: الـ + صُبْح — ṣubḥ, dawn, the dawn prayer (m., acc.); 'the dawn'
وَعَمَدَ: وَ + عَمَدَ — wa-, and + ʿamada, he made for, headed (perf.); with ilā, 'made for'
وَمَلَأَهُ: وَ + مَلَأَ + هُ — wa-, and + malaʾa, he filled (perf.) + -hu, it (the saddlebag); 'and filled it'
وَتَذَكَّرَ: وَ + تَذَكَّرَ — wa-, and + tadhakkara, he remembered (V perf.)
وَحَقَارَتَهُ: وَ + حَقَارَة + هُ — wa-, and + ḥaqāra, contempt, littleness (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his contempt'
سَافِرْ: sāfir — sāfara, to travel (III imper. m. sg.); 'travel'
عِوَضًا: ʿiwaḍ — compensation, replacement (m., acc. with tanwīn, object); 'a replacement'; here: adverbial, ʿiwaḍan ʿan, 'in place of'
تُفَارِقُهُ: tufāriqu + hu — fāraqa, to part from (III impf. 2nd m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'you part from him'
وَانْصَبْ: وَ + انْصَبْ — wa-, and + inṣab, toil (imper. of naṣiba, to labour); 'and labour'
فَانَّ: فَـ + ا_ِنَّ — fa-, for (gives reason) + inna, indeed (takes acc.); 'for indeed'
لَذِيذَ: ladhīdh — sweet, delightful (m., acc., noun of inna; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْعَيْشِ: الـ + عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the life'
النَّصَبِ: الـ + نَصَب — naṣab, toil, labour (m., gen. after fī); 'the toil'
الْمَقَرَارَى: الـ + مَقَرَارَى — obscure, probably corrupt; apparently a form of maqarr, place of staying; 'the staying-place'; see the note
عِزًّا: ʿizz — honour, might (m., acc. with tanwīn)
اَرَبًا: arab — need, purpose, gain (m., acc. with tanwīn; also ʾarab)
الْعَنَا: الـ + عَنَا — ʿanā, hardship, trouble (m., gen. after siwā; the final ʾ dropped in ʿanāʾ)
فَدَعِ: فَـ + دَعِ — fa-, so + daʿi, leave (imper. of wadaʿa; kasra before the article)
الْاَوْطَانَ: الـ + اَوْطَان — awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan; acc., object); 'the homelands'
وَاغْتَرِبِ: وَ + اغْتَرِبِ — wa-, and + ightarib, go abroad, become a stranger (VIII imper. of gharaba)
اِنِّي: اِنَّ + ـي — inna, indeed + -ī, I; 'indeed I'; here: after taḥsabū, 'think', where prose would have annī, 'that I': lā taḥsabū innī qutiltu, 'do not think that I was slain'
رَايْتُ: raʾaytu — raʾā, to see (perf. 1st sg.; printed with bare alif); 'I saw'
وُقُوفَ: wuqūf — standing still, stagnation (m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa)
يُفْسِدُهُ: yufsidu + hu — afsada, to spoil (IV impf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'spoils it'
سَاحَ: sāḥa — it flowed, ran (perf. 3rd m. sg.)
يَطِبِ: yaṭib — ṭāba, to be good (jussive 3rd m. sg., after lam; kasra for the rhyme)
لَوْلَا: lawlā — if it were not for, were it not that
اُفُولٌ: ufūl — setting, vanishing (m., nom. with tanwīn)
مَانَظَرَتْ: مَا + نَظَرَتْ — mā, not + naẓarat, she/it looked (perf. 3rd f. sg. of naẓara; printed as one word)
مُرْتَقِبِ: murtaqib — watcher, one who waits and watches (act. part. of VIII irtaqaba; m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa)
وَالْاُسْدُ: وَ + الـ + اُسْد — wa-, and + al-, the + usd, lions (pl. of asad; m., nom.); 'and the lions'
فِرَاقُ: firāq — parting, leaving (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْغَابِ: الـ + غَاب — ghāb, thicket, forest (m., gen.); 'the thicket'
اقْتَنَصَتْ: iqtanaṣat — iqtanaṣa, to hunt, catch game (VIII perf. 3rd f. pl. as agreeing with a pl., 'they hunted')
وَالسَّهْمُ: وَ + الـ + سَهْم — wa-, and + al-, the + sahm, arrow (m., nom.); 'and the arrow'
الْقَوْسِ: الـ + قَوْس — qaws, bow (f., gen.); 'the bow'
يُصِبِ: yuṣib — aṣāba, to hit the mark (IV jussive 3rd m. sg., after lam)
كَالتُّرْبِ: كَـ + الـ + تُرْب — ka-, like, as (prep.; comparison) + al-, the + turb, dust, earth (m., gen.); 'like the dust'
مَعَادِنِهِ: مَعَادِن + هِ — maʿādin, mines (pl. of maʿdin; gen. after fī) + -hi, its; 'its mines'
وَالْعُودُ: وَ + الـ + عُود — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿūd, aloe-wood, the fragrant wood (m., nom.)
اَرْضِهِ: اَرْض + هِ — arḍ, land, earth (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, its; 'its land'
نَوْعٌ: nawʿ — kind, sort (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'a kind'
الْحَطَبِ: الـ + حَطَب — ḥaṭab, firewood (m., gen. after min); 'the firewood'
فَانْ: فَـ + اِنْ — fa-, and so, then + in, if (conditional); 'so if'
تَغَرَّبَ: tagharraba — to go abroad, be a stranger (V perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'he/it goes abroad'
مَطْلَبُهُ: مَطْلَب + هُ — maṭlab, quest, object of seeking (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its seeking'
غِلْمَانِهِ: غِلْمَان + ـهِ — ghilmān, lads, young servants (pl. of ghulām; gen. in iḍāfa); 'his lads'
يَشُدَّ: yashudda, to bind, tighten, saddle (a mount) (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an)
بَغْلَةَ: baghla, she-mule (f., acc. as object; first term of an iḍāfa)
النُّوبَةِ: الـ + نُوبَة — Nūba, Nubia (gen. in iḍāfa); 'the Nubia', i.e. Nubian
بِسَرْجِهَا: بِـ + سَرْج + ـهَا — bi-, with, along with (prep.) + sarj, saddle (m., gen. after bi-) + -hā, her; 'with her saddle'
الْمُضَرَّبِ: الـ + مُضَرَّب — muḍarrab, quilted, stitched (pass. part. of II ḍarraba; m., gen., adj. of sarj); 'the quilted'
زُورِيَّةٌ: zūriyya — second half of zurzūriyya, from zurzūr, starling; 'starling-coloured' (f., nom., adj.)
الظَّهْرِ: الـ + ظَهْر — ẓahr, back (m., gen.); 'the back'
سَرْجُهَا: سَرْج + ـهَا — sarj, saddle (m., nom. subject) + -hā, her; 'her saddle'
ذَهَبٌ: dhahab, gold (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate)
وَرِكَابَاتُهَا: وَ + رِكَابَات + ـهَا — wa-, and + rikābāt, stirrups (f. pl., nom.) + -hā; 'and her stirrups'
هِنْدِيَّةٌ: hindiyya, Indian (f., nom., adj. from Hind, India)
عَبَاءَةٌ: ʿabāʾa, cloak, wrap (f., nom. with tanwīn)
كِسْرَوِيَّةٌ: kisrawiyya, Khosrow-like, Chosroan (f., nom., adj. from Kisrā, the Persian king); 'royal'
مُجَلَّيَةٌ: mujallaya, displayed, adorned (pass. part. of II jallā; f., nom., adj.); read with a yāʾ as printed
يَجْعَلَ: yajʿala, to put, place, make (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an)
بِسَاطًا: bisāṭ, carpet, spread (m., acc. with tanwīn, object)
حَرِيرًا: ḥarīr, silk (m., acc. with tanwīn, adj. of bisāṭ); 'silk' (a silken carpet)
وَسَجَّادَةً: وَ + سَجَّادَة — wa-, and + sajjāda, prayer rug, rug (f., acc. with tanwīn); 'and a rug'
الْخُرْجَ: الـ + خُرْج — khurj, saddlebag (m., acc.); 'the saddlebag'
السَّجَّادَةِ: الـ + سَجَّادَة — sajjāda, rug (f., gen.); 'the rug'
لِلْغُلَامِ: لِـ + الـ + غُلَام — li-, to (prep., with qāla, marking the one addressed) + ghulām, lad, boy (m., gen.); 'to the lad'
وَالْعَبِيدِ: وَ + الـ + عَبِيد — wa-, and + ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of ʿabd; gen.); 'and the slaves'
خَارِجَ: khārija, outside (act. part. of kharaja used as adverb; m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَأَرُوحُ: وَ + أَرُوحُ — wa-, and + arūḥu, to go (verb I, imperf. 1s, indicative; here with a direct object); 'and I go to'
نَوَاحِيَ: nawāḥī, districts, regions (pl. of nāḥiya; acc. object, first term of an iḍāfa)
الْقَلْيُوبِيَّةِ: الـ + قَلْيُوبِيَّة — Qalyūbiyya, the Qalyubiyya district north of Cairo (gen.)
وَأَبَاتُ: وَ + أَبَاتُ — wa-, and + abātu, to spend the night (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s, indicative); 'and I spend the night'
لَيَالٍ: layālin, nights (pl. of layla; f., gen. with tanwīn, counted noun after three)
يَتْبَعُنِي: يَتْبَعُ + ـنِي — yatbaʿu, to follow (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative where classical would use the jussive) + -nī, me; 'follows me'
ضِيقَ: ḍīq, narrowness, tightness (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); ḍīq ṣadr, 'narrowness of chest', distress
صَدْرٍوَأَ: صَدْر + وَ + أَ — ṣadr, chest, breast (m., gen., 2nd term of iḍāfa) + wa-, and + a-, the alif of أَسْرَعَ; printed run together as صدروا; 'chest, and ...'
سْرَعَ: sraʿa, the rest of أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa, to hurry, make haste (verb IV, perf. 3ms); the alif is the one at the end of the previous word; 'he hastened'
وَاسْتَقْبَلَ: وَ + اِسْتَقْبَلَ — wa-, and + istaqbala, to face, set out toward (verb X, perf. 3ms); 'and he faced'
الظُّهْرُ: الـ + ظُهْر — ẓuhr, noon, midday (m., nom.); 'the noon'
بِلْبِيسَ: Bilbīs, Bilbays, a town east of Cairo on the road to Syria (gen. diptote; second term of an iḍāfa)
بَغْلَتِهِ: بَغْلَة + ـهِ — baghla, she-mule (f., gen. after ʿan/ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his mule'
وَاسْتَرَاحَ: وَ + اِسْتَرَاحَ — wa-, and + istarāḥa, to rest, take rest (verb X hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he rested'
وَرَيَّحَ: وَ + رَيَّحَ — wa-, and + rayyaḥa, to give rest to, let (an animal) rest (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he rested (the mule)'
فَأَكَلَهُ: فَـ + أَكَلَ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and ate it'
يَأْكُلُهُ: يَأْكُلُ + ـهُ — ya'kulu, to eat (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative; the relative clause after mā) + -hu, it (obj.); 'what he eats'
يَعْلِفُهُ: يَعْلِفُ + ـهُ — yaʿlifu, to feed with fodder (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative) + -hu, it (obj.); 'what he feeds (as fodder)'
بَلَدًا: balad, town, land (m., acc. with tanwīn, object)
السَّعْدِيَهْ: الـ + سَعْدِيَة — Saʿdiyya, a town (the name is printed with final h for tāʾ marbūṭa); 'al-Saʿdiyya'
أَكَلَهُ: أَكَلَ + ـهُ — akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'he ate it' (a relative clause with no relative pronoun)
وَفَرَشَ: وَ + فَرَشَ — wa-, and + farasha, to spread out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he spread'
الْبِسَاطَ: الـ + بِسَاط — bisāṭ, carpet (m., acc.); 'the carpet'
وَالْغَيْظُ: وَ + الـ + غَيْظ — wa-, and (conj.; circumstantial 'while') + ghayẓ, rage, anger (m., nom.); 'while the rage'
غَالِبٌ: ghālib, overcoming, prevailing (act. part. of ghalaba; m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); with ʿalā, 'prevailing over'
يَسُوقُ: yasūqu, to drive (animals) (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms, indicative; circumstantial 'driving')
حَلَبَ: Ḥalab, Aleppo (city; gen. diptote, after ilā)
الْخَانَاتِ: الـ + خَانَات — khānāt, khans, inns (pl. of khān; gen.); 'the khans'
وَأَقَامَ: وَ + أَقَامَ — wa-, and + aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he stayed'
اسْتَرَاحَ: istarāḥa, to rest (verb X hollow, perf. 3ms)
وَشَمَّ: وَ + شَمَّ — wa-, and + shamma, to smell, breathe in (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he breathed'
الْهَوَاءَ: الـ + هَوَاء — hawāʾ, air (m., acc.); 'the air'
عَزَمَ: ʿazama, to resolve, be determined (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'resolve upon'
بَغْلَتَهُ: بَغْلَة + ـهُ — baghla, she-mule (f., acc. as object) + -hu, his; 'his mule'
مُسَافِرًا: musāfir, travelling (act. part. of III sāfara; m., acc. with tanwīn, circumstantial ḥāl); 'travelling'
سَائِرًا: sāʾir, travelling, going (act. part. of sāra; m., acc. with tanwīn); 'travelling'
فَأَنْزَلَ: فَـ + أَنْزَلَ — fa-, so (conj.) + anzala, to take down, unload (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'so he took down'
السَّجَّادَةَ: الـ + سَجَّادَة — sajjāda, rug (f., acc.); 'the rug'
بِعُدَّتِهَا: بِـ + عُدَّة + ـهَا — bi-, with, together with (prep., accompaniment) + ʿudda, equipment, gear (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her gear'
لِلْبَوَّابِ: لِـ + الـ + بَوَّاب — li-, to (prep., marking the recipient of aʿṭā) + bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., gen.); 'to the doorkeeper'
يُسَيِّرُهَا: يُسَيِّرُ + ـهَا — yusayyiru, to make go, walk (an animal) (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indicative; purpose with no an) + -hā, her; 'to walk her'
وَسَيَّرَهَا: وَ + سَيَّرَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + sayyara, to make go, walk (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and walked her'
وَزِيرَ: wazīr, vizier (m., acc. as subject after anna; first term of an iḍāfa)
شُبَّاكِ: shubbāk, window, lattice (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْعُدَّةِ: الـ + عُدَّة — ʿudda, equipment, gear (f., gen.); 'the gear'
الْمُنَمَّةِ: الـ + مُنَمَّة — munamma, adorned, embellished (pass. part. of II; f., gen., adj.); the form is obscure, perhaps for munammaqa; 'the adorned'
فَظَنَّهَا: فَـ + ظَنَّ + ـهَا — fa-, so + ẓanna, to suppose, think (verb I, perf. 3ms; with two objects) + -hā, her; 'so he took her for'
مَوْكِبٍ: mawkib, procession, cavalcade (m., gen. with tanwīn, 2nd term of an iḍāfa); 'of procession'
وَمَرْكُوبَ: وَ + مَرْكُوب — wa-, and (conj.) + markūb, mount, riding-animal (m., acc., second object of ẓanna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and a mount of'
وُزَرَاءَ: wuzarāʾ, viziers (pl. of wazīr; gen. diptote)
فَتَفَكَّرَ: فَـ + تَفَكَّرَ — fa-, so + tafakkara, to ponder, reflect (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'so he pondered'
بِهَٰذَا: بِـ + هَٰذَا — bi-, with (prep.; required by the verb ātā bi- 'bring') + hādhā, this (m. demonstrative); 'with this'
الْبَوَّابِ: الـ + بَوَّاب — bawwāb, doorkeeper, porter (m., gen.); 'the doorkeeper'
فَذَهَبَ: فَـ + ذَهَبَ — fa-, so + dhahaba, to go (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he went'
وَأَتَى: وَ + أَتَى — wa-, and + atā, to come; with bi-, 'bring' (verb I, perf. 3ms)
بِالْبَوَّابِ: بِـ + الـ + بَوَّاب — bi-, with (prep.; required by atā bi- 'bring') + bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., gen.); 'with the doorkeeper', i.e. 'brought the doorkeeper'
الْبَوَّابُ: الـ + بَوَّاب — bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., nom.); 'the doorkeeper'
وَبَاسَ: وَ + بَاسَ — wa-, and + bāsa, to kiss (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he kissed'
صِفَاتُهُ: صِفَات + ـهُ — ṣifāt, attributes, qualities (pl. of ṣifa; f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his qualities'
ظَرِيفُ: ẓarīf, graceful, elegant (adj., m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الشَّمَائِلِ: الـ + شَمَائِل — shamāʾil, traits, bearing, qualities (pl. of shimāl/shamīla; gen.); 'graceful of bearing'
هَيْبَةٌ: hayba, awe, majesty (f., nom. with tanwīn)
وَوَقَارٌ: وَ + وَقَار — wa-, and + waqār, dignity, gravity (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'and dignity'
حَيْلِهِ: حَيْل + ـهِ — ḥayl, strength, power (m., gen. after ʿalā; colloquial form) + -hi, his; qāma ʿalā ḥaylihi, 'got up briskly'; here waqafa ʿalā ḥaylihi, 'he was up on his feet again', of a man recovered
رأَى: raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms; defective, hamza and final alif-maqṣūra); 'he saw'
نُورَالدِّينِ: Nūr al-Dīn — name, 'light of the faith' (m., acc.; printed as one word نور + الدين, kept joined)
قَادِمٌ: qādim, arriving, coming (act. part. of qadima; m. sg.); uninflected circumstantial, 'coming'
فَرَحَّبَ: فَـ + رَحَّبَ — raḥḥaba, to welcome (verb II, perf. 3ms; with بِـ); 'so he welcomed'
جَوَادِهِ: جَوَاد + ـهِ — jawād, swift horse, steed (m., gen., after a preposition such as ʿalā or ʿan) + -hi, his; 'his steed'
احْتَضَنَهُ: iḥtaḍana, to embrace, hold to the bosom (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + -hu, 3ms object; 'he embraced him'
وَأَجْلَسَهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + ـهُ — ajlasa, to seat (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he seated him'
وَزِيرٍ: wazīr, vizier (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'of a vizier'
انْتَقَلَ: intaqala, to move, pass over (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'he moved, passed'
رَحْمَةِ: raḥma, mercy (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'mercy of'
الْمُبْتَدَأِ: الـ + مُبْتَدَأ — mubtadaʾ, beginning, start (m., gen.; pass. part. of VIII ibtadaʾa used as noun; printed without final hamza); 'the beginning'
الْمُنْتَهَى: الـ + مُنْتَهَى — muntahā, end, termination (m., gen.; part. of VIII intahā); 'the end'
عَزَمْتُ: ʿazama, to resolve, be determined (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I have resolved'
أَعُودُ: aʿūdu, to return (verb I hollow, impf. 1s); 'I return' (indicative after anna, as printed) Also in quoted speech, the plain imperfect for the future: aʿūdu ilayka, 'I will come back to you' (Night 188).
أَشُقَّ: ashuqqa, to split, cleave, make one's way across (verb I, impf. 1s subj.; geminate); 'I traverse'
الْمُدُنِ: الـ + مُدُن — mudun, cities (pl. of madīna; gen.); 'the cities'
لَاتُطَاوِعِ: لَا + تُطَاوِعِ — lā, not (prohibitive, with jussive) + ṭāwaʿa, to obey, yield to (verb III, impf. 2ms jussive; printed joined); 'do not obey'
النَّفْسَ: الـ + نَفْس — nafs, self, soul, desire (f., acc.); 'the soul'
فَتَرْمِيَكَ: فَـ + تَرْمِيَ + ـكَ — fa-, so, lest (fa- of consequence after a prohibition, with subjunctive) + ramā, to throw (verb I defective, impf. 3fs subj.) + 2ms object; 'lest it throw you'
عَوَاقِبِ: ʿawāqib, consequences, outcomes (pl. of ʿāqiba; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'consequences of'
خُرْجَهُ: خُرْج + ـهُ — khurj, saddlebag (m., acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his saddlebag'
وَالسَّجَّادَةَ: وَ + الـ + سَجَّادَة — sajjāda, prayer rug (f., acc.); 'and the prayer rug'
وَأَنْزَلَهُ: وَ + أَنْزَلَ + ـهُ — anzala, to lodge, bring down (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he lodged him'
مَكَانٍ: makān, place (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'a place'
وَأَكْرَمَهُ: وَ + أَكْرَمَ + ـهُ — akrama, to honour, treat generously (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he honoured him'
وَأَحْسَنَ: وَ + أَحْسَنَ — aḥsana, to do good (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with إِلَى, 'to someone'); 'and he treated kindly' Also the elative aḥsan, 'better', here accusative: anfaʿa wa-aḥsana min kitmānihi, 'more useful and better than hiding it'.
وَحَبَّهُ: وَ + حَبَّ + ـهُ — ḥabba, to love (verb I, perf. 3ms; geminate; Middle Arabic for أَحَبَّ) + 3ms object; 'and he loved him'
تُعَادِلُكَ: تُعَادِلُ + ـكَ — ʿādala, to equal, match (verb III, impf. 3fs) + 2ms object; 'she equals you'
وَمُنِعَتْ: وَ + مُنِعَتْ — manaʿa, to prevent, keep away (verb I, perf. passive 3fs); 'and were kept away'
خُطَّابٌ: khuṭṭāb, suitors (pl. of khāṭib; nom. with tanwīn)
حُبُّكَ: حُبّ + ـكَ — ḥubb, love (m., nom.) + 2ms poss.; 'love of you, your love'
تَقْبَلَ: taqbala, to accept (verb I, impf. 2ms subj.); 'you accept'
لِخِدْمَتِكَ: لِـ + خِدْمَة + ـكَ — li-, for, to (prep., purpose) + khidma, service (f., gen.) + 2ms poss.; 'for your service'
وَتَكُونَ: وَ + تَكُونَ — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, impf. 2ms subj.); 'and that you be'
تَقْبَلُ: taqbalu, to accept (verb I, impf. 2ms); 'you accept'
وَأَقُولُلَهُ: وَ + أَقُولُ + لَهُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, impf. 1s) + li-, to (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'and I say to him' (printed joined)
وَلَدُ: walad, son (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'son of'
وَأُوصِلُكَ: وَ + أُوصِلُ + ـكَ — awṣala, to bring, convey (verb IV, impf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'and I bring you'
أَجْعَلَكَ: أَجْعَلَ + ـكَ — jaʿala, to make, appoint (verb I, impf. 1s subj.) + 2ms object; 'I make you'
وَأَلْزَمَ: وَ + أَلْزَمَ — lazima, to stay, keep to (verb I, impf. 1s subj.); 'and I stay'
وَزِيرِالْبَصْرَةِ: وَزِير + الـ + بَصْرَة — wazīr, vizier (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa) + Baṣra, Basra; 'vizier of Basra' (printed as one word)
أَطْرَقَ: aṭraqa, to lower, bow (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'he bowed'
بِرَأْسِهِ: بِـ + رَأْس + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.; optional with aṭraqa; after atā/jāʾa, 'come with' = 'bring': ataytu bi-raʾsihi, 'I brought his head'; after sāwā, marks what is brought level: 'levelled his head with') + raʾs, head (m., gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'his head, with his head' Also after ramā, 'to throw', bi- marks what is flung away: tarmī bi-raʾsihi, 'flings away his head', i.e. costs him his life. ; also: after dāra, 'to turn', bi- marks what is turned: dāra bi-raʾsihi, 'he turned his head' Also after ḥarraka, 'to move', and aṭraqa, 'to bow', bi- marks the part moved: ḥarraka bi-raʾsihi, 'he shook his head'.
غِلْمَانَهُ: غِلْمَان + ـهُ — ghilmān, boys, servants (pl. of ghulām; acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his servants'
يَضَعُوا: yaḍaʿū, to put, set down (verb I, impf. 3mpl subj.); 'that they set'
وَأَنْ: وَ + أَنْ — an, that (conj., with subjunctive); 'and that'
يُزَيِّنُواقَاعَةَ: يُزَيِّنُوا + قَاعَة — zayyana, to adorn (verb II, impf. 3mpl subj.) + qāʿa, hall (f., acc.); 'that they adorn the hall' (printed as one word)
الْجُلُوسِ: الـ + جُلُوس — julūs, sitting, session (m., gen.); قَاعَةُ الْجُلُوسِ 'the sitting-hall'
الْكَبِيرَةَ: الـ + كَبِيرَة — kabīra, great, large (f., acc. adj.); 'the large'
تُرْسَمُ: tursamu, to ordain, prescribe, mark out (verb I, impf. passive 3fs); 'are ordained, are held'
أَعْرَاسُالْأُمَرَاءِ: أَعْرَاس + الـ + أُمَرَاء — aʿrās, weddings (pl. of ʿurs; nom.; first term of an iḍāfa) + umarāʾ, princes, emirs (pl. of amīr; gen.); 'the weddings of the princes' (printed as one word)
جَمَعَ: jamaʿa, to gather (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he gathered'
أَصْحَابَهُ: أَصْحَاب + ـهُ — aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of ṣāḥib; acc.) + 3ms poss.; 'his companions'
وَتُجَّارَ: وَ + تُجَّار — tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir; acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the merchants of'
فَحَضَرُوا: فَـ + حَضَرُوا — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend (verb I, perf. 3mpl); 'so they attended' Also with bi-, 'to come with', i.e. 'to bring': fa-ḥaḍarū lahu bi-al-māʾi, 'they brought him the water'.
بِالدِّيَارِ: بِـ + الـ + دِيَار — bi-, in (prep., place) + diyār, lands, abodes (pl. of dār; gen.); 'in the lands'
الْمِصْرِيَّةِ: الـ + مِصْرِيَّة — miṣriyya, Egyptian (f. adj., gen.); 'the Egyptian'
وَرَزَقَهُ: وَ + رَزَقَ + ـهُ — razaqa, to provide, bestow (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and He granted him'
تَعْلَمُونَ: taʿlamūna, to know (verb I, impf. 2mpl); 'you know'
أَوْصَانِي: أَوْصَى + ـنِي — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'he charged me'
لِأَحَدِ: لِـ + أَحَد — li-, to (prep.; marks the person to whom the daughter is married, زَوَّجَ لِـ) + aḥad, one (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'to one of'
فَأَجَبْتُهُ: فَـ + أَجَبْتُ + ـهُ — ajāba, to answer, comply with (verb IV hollow, perf. 1s) + 3ms object; 'so I complied with him'
اسْتَحَقَّ: istaḥaqqa, to deserve, be due (verb X, perf. 3ms); 'he deserved, it was due'
الْحَاضِرُ: الـ + حَاضِر — ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara; m., nom.); 'the one present'
فَلَمَّاجَاءَنِي: فَـ + لَمَّا + جَاءَ + ـنِي — fa-, so + lammā, when + jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'so when he came to me' (printed as one word)
أَكْتُبَ: aktuba, to write (verb I, impf. 1s subj.); 'I write'
وَيَدْخُلَ: وَ + يَدْخُلَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, impf. 3ms subj.); 'and that he enter'
أَوْلَى: awlā, more fitting, more worthy (elative of walī; m.); 'more fitting'
الْغَرِيبِ: الـ + غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger, outsider (m., gen.); 'the stranger'
يَقْعُدُ: yaqʿudu, to sit, stay (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'he stays'
أُسَيِّرُ: usayyiru, to dispatch, send on (verb II, impf. 1s); 'I send off'
أَبِيهِ: أَب + ـيهِ — ab, father (m., gen. after ilā; ـيهِ with long form of the stem) + 3ms poss.; 'his father' Also gen. after bayna yaday, quddāma, min and maʿa: quddāma abīhi, 'before his father'; maʿa abīhi, 'with his father'.
وَنَظَرُوا: وَ + نَظَرُوا — naẓara, to look (verb I, perf. 3mpl; with إِلَى); 'and they looked'; also: with a direct object, 'to look at': naẓarū mā ʿalayya, 'they looked at what I had on'
رَأَوْهُ: رَأَوْا + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mpl) + 3ms object; 'they saw him'
فَأَحْضَرَ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ — aḥḍara, to bring, summon (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'so he summoned'
الشُّهُودَ: الـ + شُهُود — shuhūd, witnesses (pl. of shāhid; acc.); 'the witnesses'
وَالْقُضَاةَ: وَ + الـ + قُضَاة — quḍāt, judges (pl. of qāḍī; acc.); 'and the judges'
وَأَطْلَقُوا: وَ + أَطْلَقُوا — aṭlaqa, to release, let loose (verb IV, perf. 3mpl); 'and they released' (incense, i.e. set it burning)
السُّكَّرَ: الـ + سُكَّر — sukkar, sugar, sweet drink (m., acc.); 'the sweet drink, sherbet'
وَرَشُّوا: وَ + رَشُّوا — rashsha, to sprinkle (verb I geminate, perf. 3mpl); 'and they sprinkled'
وَانْصَرَفُوا: وَ + انْصَرَفُوا — inṣarafa, to depart, go away (verb VII, perf. 3mpl); 'and they departed'
يَأْخُذُوا: yaʾkhudhū, to take (verb I, impf. 3mpl subj.); 'that they take'
وَيُدْخِلُوا: وَ + يُدْخِلُوا — adkhala, to bring in (verb IV, impf. 3mpl subj.); 'and that they bring in'
خَاصِّ: khāṣṣ, special, choice (adj./noun; m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the choicest of'
مَلْبُوسِهِ: مَلْبُوس + ـهِ — malbūs, clothing, what is worn (m., gen.; pass. part. of labisa) + 3ms poss.; 'his clothing'
الْمَنَاشِفَ: الـ + مَنَاشِف — manāshif, towels (pl. of minshafa; acc.); 'the towels'
وَالطَّاسَاتِ: وَ + الـ + طَاسَات — ṭāsāt, bowls, basins (pl. of ṭāsa; gen./acc.); 'and the bowls'
وَمَجَامِرَ: وَ + مَجَامِر — majāmir, incense burners, censers (pl. of mijmar; acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and censers of'
فَلَمَّاخَرَجَ: فَـ + لَمَّا + خَرَجَ — fa-, so + lammā, when + kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so when he came out' (printed as one word)
الْبِدْلَةَ: الـ + بِدْلَة — bidla, suit of clothes (f., acc.); 'the suit'
إِنَّمَا: innamā — only, just (restrictive particle: inna + mā); opens the explanation, 'it is just that, the fact is'
الْحَادِيَةُ: الـ + حَادِيَة — ḥādiya, first (f. ordinal, 'the first-and-'); 'the first'
وَالْعِشْرُونَ: و + الـ + عِشْرُون — wa-, and + ʿishrūn, twenty (nom. pl.); 'and the twenty'
قُمِ: قُمِ — qāma, rise (imper. m. sg., kasra before hamzat wasl); 'arise'
زَوْجَتِكَ: زَوْجَة + كَ — zawja, wife (f.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your wife'
وَأَرْجُولَكَ: و + أَرْجُو + لَـ + كَ — wa-, and + arjū, hope (1st sg. impf.) + la-, for (prep., of benefit) + -ka, you; 'and I hope for you'
فِىالسَّفَرِ: فِى + الـ + سَفَر — fī (printed فى), in (prep.) + safar, journey (m.), run together in print; 'on the journey'
أَخَاهُ: أَخَا + هُ — akhā (acc. of akh), brother + -hu, his; 'his brother'
فَسَأَلَ: ف + سَأَلَ — fa-, so + saʾala, ask (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'so he asked'
الْخُدَّامَ: الـ + خُدَّام — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim), acc. object; 'the servants'
بِعُدَّةِ: بِـ + عُدَّة — bi-, with (prep., of accompaniment: 'in/with the gear of') + ʿudda, equipment, gear (f.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'with the gear of'
الْمَوْكِبِ: الـ + مَوْكِب — mawkib, procession, cavalcade (m.); 'the procession'
نَاحِيَةَ: نَاحِيَةَ — nāḥiya, side, district (f.), acc. of direction; 'toward'
أَغِيبُ: أَغِيبُ — ghāba, be absent (1st sg. impf.); 'I shall be away'
أَوْيَوْمَيْنِ: أَوْ + يَوْمَيْنِ — aw, or (conj.) + yawmayn, two days (dual, acc.), run together in print; 'or two days'
خُرُوجِهِ: خُرُوج + هِ — khurūj, going out, departure (m.) + -hi, his; 'his going out'
نَسْمَعْ: نَسْمَعْ — samiʿa, hear (1st pl. jussive); 'we have heard'
فَتَشَوَّشَ: ف + تَشَوَّشَ — fa-, so + tashawwasha, be disturbed, distraught (V, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'so he was distraught'
وَاغْتَمَّ: و + اغْتَمَّ — wa-, and + ightamma, be grieved (VIII, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he grieved'
لِفَقْدِهِ: لِـ + فَقْد + هِ — li-, because of, on account of (prep.) + faqd, loss (m.) + -hi, his; 'for his loss'
نَهَرْتُهُ: نَهَرْتُ + هُ — nahara, rebuke, scold (1st sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'I rebuked him'
خَاطِرِهِ: خَاطِر + هِ — khāṭir, heart, mind (m.) + -hi, his; 'his heart' (akhadha ʿalā khāṭirihi, 'took offence')
أُرْسِلَ: أُرْسِلَ — arsala, send (IV, 1st sg. subjunctive); 'I send'
وَأَعْلَمَ: و + أَعْلَمَ — wa-, and + aʿlama, inform (IV, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he informed'; also: wa- + aʿlama, I know (ʿalima, verb I, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā): ḥattā asʾalaka … wa-aʿlama, 'that I may ask you … and learn'
بِطَاقَاتٍ: بِطَاقَات — biṭāqāt, slips, notes, letters (pl. of biṭāqa, f.), acc.; the بِـ is part of the word, not a preposition; 'letters'
الْبَرِيدَ: الـ + بَرِيد — barīd, post, courier (m.), acc. object; 'the post'
نُوَّابِهِ: نُوَّاب + هِ — nuwwāb, deputies (pl. of nāʾib) + -hi, his; 'his deputies'
وَنُورُا: و + نُورُ — wa-, and + Nūr, first part of the name Nūr al-Dīn, printed with the alif of al- attached; 'and Nūr (al-Dīn)'
لدِّينِ: (ا)ل + دِّين — the article's lām + dīn, faith (m.): the second half of Nūr al-Dīn, whose alif was printed with the word before; 'al-Dīn'
الْعِشْرِينَ: الـ + عِشْرِين — ʿishrīn, twenty (gen./acc.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'the twenty'
غَابُوهَا: غَابُوا + هَا — ghāba, be absent (3rd m. pl. perf.) + -hā, it, them (f.); 'they were absent through them'
بِلَادًا: بِلَادًا — bilād, lands (pl. of balad), acc. object; 'lands'
بَعِيدَةً: بَعِيدَةً — baʿīd, far, distant (f. agreeing with the pl. bilād), acc.; 'distant'
فَفَتَّشُوا: ف + فَتَّشُوا — fa-, so + fattashū, search (II, 3rd m. pl. perf.); 'so they searched'
يَقَعُوالَهُ: يَقَعُوا + لَـ + هُ — yaqaʿū, light upon, find (waqaʿa ʿalā, 3rd m. pl. jussive) + la-, for (prep.) + -hu, him; 'they found for him'
خَبَرٍ: خَبَرٍ — khabar, news (m.), gen. after ʿalā; 'news'
فَرَجَعُوا: ف + رَجَعُوا — fa-, so + rajaʿū, return (3rd m. pl. perf.); 'so they returned'
وَأَيِسَ: و + أَيِسَ — wa-, and + ayisa, despair (by-form of yaʾisa, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he despaired'
فَرَّطْتُ: فَرَّطْتُ — farraṭa, be remiss, neglect (II, 1st sg. perf.; farraṭa fī, 'be remiss regarding'); 'I was remiss'
بِكَلَامِي: بِـ + كَلَام + ي — bi-, by, through (prep., of cause) + kalām, speech (m.) + -ī, my; 'through my speaking'
زَوَاجِ: زَوَاج — zawāj, marriage (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'marriage of'
الْأَوْلَادِ: الـ + أَوْلَاد — awlād, children (pl. of walad); 'the children'
قِلَّةِ: قِلَّة — qilla, fewness, scantiness (f.), gen. after min; 'littleness of'
وَعَدَمِ: و + عَدَم — wa-, and + ʿadam, absence, lack (m.), gen.; 'and lack of'
تَدْبِيرِي: تَدْبِير + ي — tadbīr, management, foresight (m.) + -ī, my; 'my management'
يَسِيرَةٍ: يَسِيرَةٍ — yasīr, small, short (adj. f.), gen.; 'short'
خَطَبَ: خَطَبَ — khaṭaba, ask in marriage, betroth (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he asked for the hand of'
تُجَّارِ: تُجَّارِ — tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir), gen. after min; 'merchants of'
شَمْسِ: شَمْسِ — shams, sun (f.), gen. in iḍāfa (Shams al-Dīn); 'Shams' Also in the name Shams al-Nahār: جَارِيَةُ شَمْسِ النَّهَارِ 'Shams al-Nahār's slave-girl'.
بِإِرَادَةِ: بِـ + إِرَادَة — bi-, by (prep., of agency) + irāda, will (f.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'by the will of'
يُنَفِّذَ: يُنَفِّذَ — nafadha II, carry out, execute (3rd m. sg. subjunctive); 'he carries out'
حُكْمَهُ: حُكْم + هُ — ḥukm, decree, judgement (m.) + -hu, his, acc. object; 'his decree'
قَالَاهُ: قَالَا + هُ — qāla, say (3rd m. dual perf.) + -hu, it; 'the two said it'
وَحَمَلُوا: و + حَمَلُوا — wa-, and + ḥamalū (ḥamala, verb I, perf. 3mp): conceive, become pregnant (plural agreement Middle Arabic; 'and they conceived'); carry ('and they carried'); with ʿalā, charge, attack ('and they charged')
وَقَدْوَضَعَتْ: و + قَدْ + وَضَعَتْ — wa-, and + qad, indeed + waḍaʿat, give birth (3rd f. sg. perf.), run together in print; 'and she had given birth'
زَوْجَةُ: زَوْجَةُ — zawja, wife (f.), nom. in iḍāfa; 'the wife of'
وَوَضَعَتْ: و + وَضَعَتْ — wa-, and + waḍaʿat, give birth (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she gave birth'; here: waḍaʿa, to put, place: 'and she put'
لَايُرَى: لَا + يُرَى — lā, not + yurā, is seen, run together in print; 'is not seen'
الشَّاعِرَا: الـ + شَّاعِر + ا — shāʿir, poet (m.), with a stray final alif in the print; 'the poet'
تَغْدُو: تَغْدُو — ghadā, go about, go forth at morning (3rd f. sg. impf.); 'goes about'
وَضِي: وَضِي — printed cut short, presumably for wa- + ḍiyāʾ, light, radiance (m.); 'and light'
الخَالَ: الـ + خَال — khāl, mole, beauty spot (m.), acc. object; 'the mole'
يُقَاسَ: يُقَاسَ — qāsa, measure, compare (passive 3rd m. sg. subjunctive); 'be measured'
يَنْكُسُ: يَنْكُسُ — nakasa, lower, bow down (3rd m. sg. impf.); 'bows'
رَسَهُ: رَسَهُ — printed for raʾsahu: raʾs, head (m.) + -hu, his, acc. object, the hamza dropped in the print; 'his head'
خَجِلًا: خَجِلًا — khajil, ashamed, shy (adj. m.), acc. ḥāl; 'ashamed'
اَمَّا: اَمَّا — ammā, as for (particle introducing a topic); 'as for'
فَسَمَّاهُ: فَـ + سَمَّى + هُ — sammā, to name (II); fa-, and so (sequence) + him; 'so he named him'
بَدْرَالدِّينِ: بَدْر + الـ + دِّين — badr, full moon; al-dīn, the faith; the name Badr al-Dīn ('full moon of the faith'), acc. as first term and object of sammā, printed as one word
حَسَنٌ: ḥasan, good, beautiful (adj.); the name Ḥasan (printed without alif, so read as a bare name); 'Ḥasan'
جَدُّهُ: جَدّ + هُ — jadd, grandfather (m.) + his; 'his grandfather'
وَزِيرُالْبَصْرَةِ: وَزِير + الـ + بَصْرَة — wazīr, vizier (m.), in construct with al-Baṣra, Basra (city); 'the vizier of Basra' (printed as one word)
أَسْمِطَا: أَسْمِطَة — asmiṭa, spreads, banquet tables (pl. of simāṭ, m.), printed with final alif; 'spreads'
لِأَوْلَادِ: لِـ + أَوْلَاد — li-, for (prep.; here 'fit for') + awlād, children, sons (pl. of walad, m.); 'for the sons of'
وَزِيرَالْبَصْرَةِ: وَزِير + الـ + بَصْرَة — wazīr, vizier, in construct with al-Baṣra, Basra; acc. after inna; 'the vizier of Basra' (printed as one word)
فَصِيحَ: faṣīḥ, eloquent (adj.), acc. as predicate of kāna, in construct with al-lisān; 'eloquent of'
ثَابِتَ: thābit, firm, steadfast (act. part. of thabata), acc., in construct; 'firm of'
الْجَنَانِ: الـ + جَنَان — janān, heart, mind (m.); 'the heart'
وَإِحْسَانٍ: وَ + إِحْسَان — iḥsān, doing good, kindness (m.), gen.; 'and kindness'
الْاِنْعَامُ: الـ + اِنْعَام — inʿām, bestowing of favour (m., verbal noun of IV); 'the favours'
يَاسَيِّدِي: يَا + سَيِّد + ي — yā, O (vocative particle); sayyid, master, lord (m.) + my; 'O my lord' (printed as one word)
وَدُمْتَ: وَ + دُمْتَ — wa-, and; dāma, to last, 2nd m. sing. perf.; 'and may you last'
دَامَ: dāma, to last (I), 3rd m. sing. perf.; '(it) lasted'
الدُّجَا: الـ + دُّجَا — dujā, darkness, gloom of night (f.); 'the darkness'
وَالفَجْرُ: وَ + الـ + فَجْر — wa-, and; fajr, dawn (m.); 'and the dawn'
ذُكِرَتْ: dhukirat, passive of dhakara, to mention (I), 3rd f. sing. perf.; 'was mentioned'
هِمَّتُهُ: هِمَّة + هُ — himma, resolve, high aim, ambition (f.) + his; 'his high aim'
وَصَفَّقَ: وَ + صَفَّقَ — ṣaffaqa, to clap the hands (II); 'and (it) clapped'
أَخِيكَ: أَخ + كَ — akh, brother (m.; gen. akhī-) + your (m. sing.); 'your brother'
فَالْكَبِيرُ: فَـ + الـ + كَبِير — fa-, so, then; kabīr, big, elder (adj.); 'then the elder'
مَكَانَ: makān, place (m.), acc., in construct; makān wālidihi 'in his father's place'
وَالِدِهِ: وَالِد + هِ — wālid, father (act. part. of walada; gen. after fī ḥaqqi) + his; 'his father' Also gen. after ʿalā: dakhala ʿalā wālidihi, 'he went in to his father' (ʿalā marks the person visited).
وَحَلَفْتُ: وَ + حَلَفْتُ — ḥalafa, to swear (I), 1st sing. perf.; 'and I swore'
زَوَّجْتُهُ: زَوَّجْتُ + هُ — zawwaja, to marry (someone) off (II), 1st sing. perf. + him; 'I married him off'
وَعَجَزَ: وَ + عَجَزَ — ʿajaza, to be unable, to fail (I); 'and (it) failed'
وَالْقَصْدُ: وَ + الـ + قَصْد — qaṣd, aim, purpose, intention (m.); 'and the aim'
يَجْعَلَهُ: يَجْعَلَ + هُ — jaʿala, to make, place (I), 3rd m. sing. subjunctive + him; 'that he make him'
مَرْتَبَتِي: مَرْتَبَة + ي — martaba, rank, post (f.) + my; 'my rank'
وَزَوْجُ: وَ + زَوْج — zawj, husband, spouse (m.), in construct; 'and husband of'
أَهْلٌ: ahl, worthy, fit (adj.); ahl li-, 'worthy of'; 'worthy'
لِلْوِزَارَةِ: لِـ + الـ + وِزَارَة — li-, for (prep.; ahl li-, 'worthy of') + al-, the + wizāra, vizierate, office of vizier (f.); 'for the vizierate'
وَتَدْبِيرٍ: وَ + تَدْبِير — tadbīr, management, judgement (m.), gen.; 'and management'
فَلَاقَ: فَـ + لَاقَ — lāqa, to befit, suit (I; lāqa bi-, 'be pleasing to'); fa-, and so; 'so (he) suited'
بِخَاطِرِهِ: بِـ + خَاطِر + هِ — bi-, to (prep.; lāqa bi-, 'be pleasing to') + khāṭir, mind, thought (m.) + his; 'to his mind'
أَرَادَهُ: أَرَادَ + هُ — arāda, to want, desire (IV) + it; '(he) wanted it'
وَقَدَّمَهُ: وَ + قَدَّمَ + هُ — qaddama, to advance, promote (II) + him; 'and (he) promoted him'
وَأَسَرَّلَهُ: وَ + أَسَرَّ + لِـ + هُ — asarra (uncertain, perhaps a misprint; the sense needed is 'bestowed', cf. asbagha/asbala); li-, to/for (prep.; marks the recipient) + him; 'and (he) bestowed on him'
بِخِلْعَةٍ: بِـ + خِلْعَة — bi-, with (prep.; marks what is bestowed) + khilʿa, robe of honour (f.); 'with a robe of honour'
بِبَغْلَةٍ: بِـ + بَغْلَة — bi-, (prep.; amara li-X bi-Y, 'order Y for X', so 'a mule') + baghla, mule (f.); 'a mule' Also after atā, 'come with' = 'bring': fa-atāhu ghilmānuhu bi-baghlatin, 'his servants brought him a mule'.
مَرْكُوبِهِ: مَرْكُوب + هِ — markūb, mount, riding animal (m.) + his; 'his mounts'
وَعَيَّنَ: وَ + عَيَّنَ — ʿayyana, to appoint, assign (II); 'and (he) assigned'
وَالْجَوَامِكَ: وَ + الـ + جَوَامِك — jawāmik, salaries (pl. of jāmakiyya, f.); 'and the salaries'
وَصِهْرُهُ: وَ + صِهْر + هُ — ṣihr, father-in-law, relative by marriage (m.) + his; 'and his father-in-law'
مَنْزِلِهِمَا: مَنْزِل + هِمَا — manzil, dwelling, house (m.) + their (dual); 'their house'
بِكَعْبِ: بِـ + كَعْب — bi-, by, through (prep. of cause) + kaʿb, heel, ankle (m.), here an idiom for good luck; 'by the luck of'
الْمَوْلُودِ: الـ + مَوْلُود — mawlūd, newborn, one born (pass. part. of walada, m.); 'the newborn'
سَعَادَاتٌ: saʿādāt, felicities, happinesses (pl. of saʿāda, f.), nom. tanwīn; 'felicities'
تُجَدِّدُ: tujaddidu, (it) renews (jaddada, II), 3rd f. sing. imperf.; 'renewing'
وَاِنْبَانٌ: وَ + اِنْبَان — inbān, obscure (perhaps a misprint; intiṣār, 'victory', is a guess); 'and a (?) over'
كَيْدِ: kayd, plot, guile, scheming (m.), gen., in construct; 'the scheming of'
الْحَسُودِ: الـ + حَسُود — ḥasūd, envious, an envier (m.); 'the envier'
الْاَيَّامُ: الـ + أَيَّام — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm, m.); 'the days'
بِيْضٌ: bīḍ, white (pl. of abyaḍ, adj.), nom.; 'white' (= happy)
وَاَيَّامُ: وَ + أَيَّام — wa-, and; ayyām, days, in construct; 'and the days of'
عَادَاكَ: عَادَى + كَ — ʿādā, to be hostile to (III), 3rd m. sing. perf. + you (m. sing.); '(he) was hostile to you'
سُودُ: sūd, black (pl. of aswad, adj.); 'black' (= unhappy)
فَأَمَرَهُ: فَـ + أَمَرَ + هُ — amara, to command (I) + him; fa-, and so; 'so (he) commanded him'
وَتَعَاطَى: وَ + تَعَاطَى — taʿāṭā, to undertake, take in hand (VI); 'and (he) took in hand'
أُمُورَ: umūr, affairs, matters (pl. of amr, m.), acc., in construct; 'the affairs of'
خِدْمَتِهِ: خِدْمَة + هِ — khidma, service, office (f.) + his; 'his office'; also: fī khidmatihi, 'in his service, in attendance on him'
أُمُورِهِمْ: أُمُور + هِمْ — umūr, affairs (pl. of amr, m.) + their; 'their affairs'
وَأَحْكَامِهِمْ: وَ + أَحْكَام + هِمْ — aḥkām, judgements, legal cases (pl. of ḥukm, m.) + their; 'and their cases'
عَادَةُ: ʿāda, custom, habit (f.), in construct; 'the custom of'
وَيَتَعَجَّبُ: وَ + يَتَعَجَّبُ — yataʿajjabu, he marvels (taʿajjaba, V; taʿajjaba min, 'marvel at'); 'and marvelling'
أَمْرِهِ: أَمْر + هِ — amr, affair, matter, bearing (m.) + his; 'his affair'
وَعَقْلِهِ: وَ + عَقْل + هِ — ʿaql, intellect (m.) + his; 'and his intellect'
وَتَدْبِيرِهِ: وَ + تَدْبِير + هِ — tadbīr, management, judgement (m.) + his; 'and his judgement'
وَتَصْرِيفِهِ: وَ + تَصْرِيف + هِ — taṣrīf, management, conduct of affairs (m.) + his; 'and his handling of affairs'
فَحَبَّهُ: فَـ + حَبَّ + هُ — ḥabba, to love (I) + him; fa-, and so; 'so (he) loved him'
لِصِهْرِهِ: لِـ + صِهْر + هِ — li-, to (prep.; ḥakā li-, 'tell to') + ṣihr, father-in-law (m.) + his; 'to his father-in-law'
يُفَارِقُ: yufāriqu, he parts from, leaves (fāraqa, III, imperf.)
لَافِي: لَا + فِي — lā, not, neither; fī, in; 'neither in' (printed as one word)
وَزَادَلَهُ: وَ + زَادَ + لِـ + هُ — zāda, to increase (I, here transitive), 3rd m. sing. perf.; li-, for (prep.; marks the one benefited) + him; 'and (he) increased for him' (printed as one word)
الْجَوَامِكَ: الـ + جَوَامِك — jawāmik, salaries (pl. of jāmakiyya, f.), acc.; 'the salaries'
وَالْجَرَايَاتِ: وَ + الـ + جَرَايَات — jarāyāt, rations, allowances (pl. of jirāya, f.); 'and the rations'
اتَّسَعَ: ittasaʿa, to become wide, grow broad (VIII); '(it) grew broad'
حَالٌ: ḥāl, condition, state of affairs, fortunes (m.), nom.; 'a condition'
تُسَافِرُ: tusāfiru, they travel, sail (sāfara, III), 3rd f. sing. imperf. (agrees with a plural of things); 'sailing'
وَمَمَالِيكُ: وَ + مَمَالِيك — mamālīk, mamluks, slaves (pl. of mamlūk, m.), nom.; 'and mamluks'
أَمْلَاكًا: amlāk, estates, properties (pl. of milk, m.), acc.; 'estates'
وَدَوَالِبَ: وَ + دَوَالِب — dawālīb, wheels (pl. of dūlāb, m.), here probably water-wheels or mills; 'and water-wheels'
وَبَسَاتِينَ: وَ + بَسَاتِين — basātīn, gardens, orchards (pl. of bustān, m.); 'and gardens'
عُمْرُ: ʿumr, age, lifetime (m.), nom., in construct; 'the age of'
وَالزَّوْجَةُ: وَ + الـ + زَّوْجَة — zawja, wife (f.); 'and the wife' (see the note on this sentence)
فَأَخْرَجَهُ: فَـ + أَخْرَجَ + هُ — akhraja, to bring out (IV) + him; fa-, and so; 'so (he) brought him out'
خَرْجَةً: kharja, outing, procession (f.), acc.; here a funeral procession
وَوَارَاهُ: وَ + وَارَى + هُ — wārā, to bury, conceal (III) + him; 'and (he) buried him'
بِتَرْبِيَةِ: بِـ + تَرْبِيَة — bi-, with (prep.; ishtaghala bi-, 'busy oneself with') + tarbiya, upbringing, education (f.), in construct; 'with the upbringing of'
فَقِيهًا: faqīh, jurist, teacher of law (m.), acc.; 'a jurist'
يُقْرِئُهُ: يُقْرِئُ + هُ — yuqriʾu, he makes (someone) recite (aqraʾa, IV, imperf.) + him; 'who teaches him to recite'
وَأَوْصَاهُ: وَ + أَوْصَى + هُ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (IV) + him; 'and (he) charged him'
بِتَعْلِيمِهِ: بِـ + تَعْلِيم + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; awṣā bi-, 'charge with') + taʿlīm, teaching (m.) + his; 'with teaching him'
وَأَدَبِهِ: وَ + أَدَب + هِ — adab, manners, good breeding (m.) + his; 'and his manners'
تَرْبِيَتِهِ: تَرْبِيَة + هِ — tarbiya, upbringing (f.) + his; 'his upbringing'
فَقَرَأَهُ: فَـ + قَرَأَ + هُ — qaraʾa, to read, recite (I) + it; fa-, and so; 'so (he) read it'
وَحَفِظَهُ: وَ + حَفِظَ + هُ — ḥafiẓa, to memorise, guard (I) + it; 'and (he) memorised it'
فَوَائِدَ: fawāʾid, benefits, useful points (pl. of fāʾida, f.), acc.; 'benefits'
وَعَادَالْقُرْآنَ: وَ + عَادَ + الـ + قُرْآن — ʿāda, to return to, go back over (I); al-qurʾān, the Qurʾān (m.), acc.; 'and (he) went over the Qurʾān again' (printed as one word; perhaps for wa-aʿāda)
وَقَدًّا: وَ + قَدّ — qadd, stature, build (m.), acc.; 'and in stature'
وَاعْتِدَالًا: وَ + اعْتِدَال — iʿtidāl, evenness, symmetry (m.), acc.; 'and in symmetry'
كَا: kā, as (a short spelling of kamā)
سَمَاءِ: samāʾ, sky (f.), in construct; 'the sky of'
وَالشَّمْسُ: وَ + الـ + شَّمْس — shams, sun (f.); 'and the sun'
شَقَائِقِ: shaqāʾiq, anemones, poppies (pl. of shaqīqa, f.), in construct; 'the anemones of'
بِاَسْرِهِ: بِـ + أَسْر + هِ — bi-, with, in (prep.) + asr, capture, binding (m.) + his; bi-asrihi, 'in its entirety'
فَكَاَنَّمَا: فَـ + كَـ + أَنَّ + مَا — fa-, so; ka-, like (kāf of comparison) + anna, that + mā; ka-annamā, 'as though'
كُلُّهَا: كُلّ + هَا — kull, all (m.) + her/its; 'all of it'
رَبَّاهُ: رَبَّاهُ — rabbā, raise, bring up (verb II, past 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'he raised him'
الْفَقِيهُ: الْفَقِيهُ — الـ + فَقِيه — faqīh, jurist, man learned in religious law, here the boy's tutor (m.; nom.); 'the jurist / tutor'
قَصْرِأَبِيهِ: قَصْرِ + أَبِيهِ run together — qaṣr, palace (m.; gen. in annexation) + ab, father (gen. after قَصْر) + -hi, his; 'in the palace of his father'
نَشَأَ: نَشَأَ — nashaʾa, grow up (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'he grew up'
يَخْرُجْ: يَخْرُجْ — yakhruju, go out (verb I, jussive 3 m.s. after لَمْ); 'he did not go out'
قَصْرِالْوِزَارَةِ: قَصْرِ + الْوِزَارَةِ run together — qaṣr, palace (m.; gen. in annexation) + الـ + wizāra, vizierate, the office of vizier (f.; gen.); 'the palace of the vizierate'
أَخَذَهُ: أَخَذَهُ — akhadha, take (verb I, past 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'he took him'
وَالِدُهُ: وَالِدُهُ — wālid, father, begetter (m.; nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his father'
وَأَلْبَسَهُ: وَ + أَلْبَسَهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + albasa, clothe (verb IV, past 3 m.s.; takes two objects) + -hu, him; 'and he clothed him'
وَرَكَّبَهُ: وَ + رَكَّبَهُ — wa-, and + rakkaba, mount, set on a riding-animal (verb II, past 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'and he mounted him'
بِغَالِهِ: بِغَالِهِ — bighāl, mules (pl. of baghl; gen. in annexation) + -hi, his; 'his mules'
حَسَنَ: حَسَنَ — Ḥasan, 'beautiful' (personal name; acc., in apposition to Badr al-Dīn)
فَأَعْجَبَهُ: فَ + أَعْجَبَهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿjaba, please, delight (verb IV, past 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'and he pleased him'
طَالِعٌ: طَالِعٌ — ṭāliʿ, going up (active participle of ṭalaʿa; m.; nom., indef.); 'going up'
فَانْبَهَتُوا: فَ + انْبَهَتُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + inbahata, be stunned, struck dumb (verb VII, past 3 m.pl.; a Middle Arabic form from bahata); 'and they were struck dumb'
حُسْنِهِ: حُسْنِهِ — ḥusn, beauty (m.; gen. after مِنْ) + -hi, his; 'his beauty'; also gen. after fī, 'over, on account of': fī ḥusnihi, 'over his beauty'
عَوْدَةً: عَوْدَةً — ʿawda, return, coming back (f.; acc., indef., object of yantaẓirūna; printed without a pronoun); 'a return'
لِيَتَفَرَّجُوا: لِ + يَتَفَرَّجُوا — li-, so that, in order to (particle of purpose, governing the subjunctive) + yatafarraja, gaze at, look on with pleasure (verb V, subjunctive 3 m.pl.); 'so that they might gaze'
وَجَمَالِهِ: وَ + جَمَالِهِ — wa-, and + jamāl, loveliness, comeliness (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'and his loveliness'; also (Night 202): وَ + جَمَال + ـهِ — wa-, and + jamāl, loveliness, comeliness (m.; gen., joined to ḥusnihi after min) + -hi, his; 'and his loveliness'
وَقَدِّهِ: وَ + قَدِّهِ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'and his stature'; also (Night 202): وَ + قَدّ + ـهِ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m.; gen., joined to ḥusnihi after min; the shadda is printed) + -hi, his; 'and his stature'
وَاعْتِدَالِهِ: وَ + اعْتِدَالِهِ — wa-, and + iʿtidāl, evenness, symmetry (verbal noun of VIII; m.; gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his symmetry'
قَدُّ: قَدُّ — qadd, stature, figure (m.; nom., in annexation, subject of badā); 'the stature of'
يَتِيهُ: يَتِيهُ — yatīhu, strut proudly, be conceited (verb I, present 3 m.s.; here a circumstance); 'strutting'
وَتَاَمَّلَ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ — wa-, and + taʾammala, ponder, contemplate (verb V, past 3 m.s.); 'and [it] pondered'
الْجَوْزَاءُ: الْجَوْزَاءُ — الـ + jawzāʾ, Gemini, the constellation (f.; nom., subject); 'Gemini'
نَشَرَتْ: نَشَرَتْ — nashara, spread out, unfold (verb I, past 3 f.s.; its subject is Gemini) ; 'it spread out'; here: she (the beloved) let down, nasharat … min shaʿrihā, 'she let down … of her hair'
حُسْنَ: حُسْنَ — ḥusn, beauty (m.; acc., object of nasharat; in annexation); 'the beauty of'
وَاَتَى: وَ + أَتَى — wa-, and + atā, bring (verb I, past 3 m.s.; with لِـ and a direct object); 'and [he] brought'
زُحَلُ: زُحَلُ — Zuḥal, Saturn (proper name of the planet; m.; nom.); 'Saturn'
السَّوَادَ: السَّوَادَ — الـ + sawād, blackness (m.; acc., object); 'the blackness'
اَهْدَى: أَهْدَى — ahdā, give, present (verb IV, past 3 m.s.); 'he gave'
الْمِرِّيخُ: الْمِرِّيخُ — الـ + Mirrīkh, Mars (proper name of the planet; m.; nom.); 'Mars'
حُمْرَةَ: حُمْرَةَ — ḥumra, redness (f.; acc., object; in annexation); 'the redness of'
وَعُطَارِدٌ: وَ + عُطَارِدٌ — wa-, and + ʿUṭārid, Mercury (proper name of the planet; m.; nom., indef. as printed); 'and Mercury'
اَعْطَاهُ: أَعْطَاهُ — aʿṭā, give (verb IV, past 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'he gave him'
وَاَبَا: وَ + أَبَا — wa-, and + abā, father, owner of (m.; acc., in the construct 'father of'; here the first part of the name Abā al-Suhā, probably the star Alcor); 'and Abā [al-Suhā]'
فَبَقِي: فَ + بَقِيَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + baqiya, remain, stay (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'so he remained'
حَائِراً: حَائِراً — ḥāʾir, bewildered, perplexed (active participle of ḥāra; m.; acc., indef., a state); 'bewildered'
مِمَّارَاَى: مِمَّا + رَأَى run together — min, from, at (prep.) + mā, what (relative) + raʾā, see (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'at what he saw'
وَسَعَى: وَ + سَعَى — wa-, and + saʿā, hasten, run (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'and he hastened'
الاَرْضَ: الْأَرْضَ — الـ + arḍ, earth, ground (f.; acc., object); 'the ground'
أَنْعَمَ: أَنْعَمَ — anʿama, bestow favour, be gracious (verb IV, past 3 m.s.); 'he bestowed favour' (the sense continues with عَلَيْهِ, printed separately)
وَقَلٰ: وَ + قَلٰ — wa-, and + qalā, a defective spelling of qāla, say (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'and he said'
لَازِمٌ: لَازِمٌ — lāzim, necessary, binding (active participle of lazima; m.; nom., indef.); 'necessary'
يُحْضِرُهُ: يُحْضِرُهُ — yuḥḍiru, bring, cause to be present (verb IV, present 3 m.s., as printed; the sense wants 'you bring') + -hu, him; 'he/you bring him'
السَّمْعُ: السَّمْعُ — الـ + samʿ, hearing (verbal noun, m.; nom.); 'hearing'
وَالطَّاعَةُ: وَ + الطَّاعَةُ — wa-, and + الـ + ṭāʿa, obedience (f.; nom.); 'and obedience'; the formula 'with hearing and obedience'
بِوَلَدِهِ: بِ + وَلَدِهِ — bi-, with (prep.; here 'taking along', after ʿāda) + walad, son, child (m.; gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his son'
فَضَعُفَ: فَ + ضَعُفَ — fa-, then (conj.) + ḍaʿufa, grow weak, become feeble (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'then he grew weak'
دَارُ: دَارُ — dār, house, abode (f.; nom., predicate, in annexation); 'a house of'
فَنَاءٍ: فَنَاءٍ — fanāʾ, passing away, perishing (m.; gen., indef.); 'passing away'
وَالْآخِرَةَ: وَ + الْآخِرَةَ — wa-, and + الـ + ākhira, the hereafter, the next world (f.; acc., joined to the noun of anna); 'and the hereafter'
بَقَاءٍ: بَقَاءٍ — baqāʾ, remaining, lasting (m.; gen., indef.); 'lasting' (the printed text has دَارُ, 'house of', as a separate word before it)
وَصَايَا: وَصَايَا — waṣāyā, charges, counsels (pl. of waṣiyya; acc., indef.); 'counsels'
فَافْهَمْ: فَ + افْهَمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ifham, understand (verb I, imperative m.s.); 'so understand'
وَأَصْغِ: وَ + أَصْغِ — wa-, and + aṣghi, incline, lend (verb IV, imperative m.s.; اَصْغَى); 'and incline'
ذِهْنَكَ: ذِهْنَكَ — dhihn, mind, understanding (m.; acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your mind'
يُوصِيهِ: يُوصِيهِ — yūṣī, charge, counsel (verb IV, present 3 m.s.) + -hi, him; 'he counsels him'
حُسْنِ: حُسْنِ — ḥusn, goodness, beauty (m.; gen., in annexation); 'good' (حُسْنِ عِشْرَةِ, 'good company'; حُسْنِ تَرْبِيَتِهِ, 'good upbringing') or 'the beauty of' (حُسْنِ هَذَا الشَّابِّ)
عِشْرَةِ: عِشْرَةِ — ʿishra, companionship, social dealings (f.; gen. in annexation); 'companionship with'
وَأَوْطَانَهُ: وَ + أَوْطَانَهُ — wa-, and + awṭān, homelands, native places (pl. of waṭan; acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his homelands'
وَبِلَادَهُ: وَ + بِلَادَهُ — wa-, and + bilād, lands, towns (pl. of balad; acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his lands'
وَمَسَحَ: وَ + مَسَحَ — wa-, and + masaḥa, wipe (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'and he wiped'
دُمُوعَهُ: دُمُوعَهُ — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ; acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his tears'
بُعْدًا: بُعْدًا — buʿd, distance, remoteness (m.; acc., indef.); 'of distance'
مَايُؤَدِّي: مَا + يُؤَدِّي run together — mā, what, that which (relative) + yuʾaddī, convey, deliver (verb II, present 3 m.s.); 'what conveys'
اَثْبَتَ: أَثْبَتَ — athbata, prove, establish (verb IV, past 3 m.s.); 'has proved'
بَقِي: بَقِيَ — baqiya, remain (verb I, past 3 m.s.); 'there remains'
مُحِبٌّ: مُحِبٌّ — muḥibb, lover (active participle of aḥabba; m.; nom., indef.); 'a lover'
وَحَنِينًا: وَ + حَنِينًا — wa-, and + ḥanīn, yearning, longing (m.; acc., indef.); 'and yearning'
وَدُمُوعًا: وَ + دُمُوعًا — wa-, and + dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ; acc., indef.); 'and tears'
غَائِبِينَ: غَائِبِينَ — ghāʾib, absent (active participle of ghāba; m.; acc. pl., vocative with an added phrase); 'absent ones'
اَتَرَاكُمْ: أَتَرَاكُمْ — a-, interrogative particle + tarā, see, reckon (verb I, present 2 m.s.) + -kum, you (pl., as object); 'do you suppose'
اَنْتُمُ: أَنْتُمُ — antum, you (pl.; with the long vowel -u kept); 'you'
اَنَّ: أَنَّ — anna, that (particle governing the accusative)
عَهْدِي: عَهْدِي — ʿahd, covenant, pledge (m.; acc., noun of anna, annexed) + -ī, my; 'my pledge'
طُولِ: طُولِ — ṭūl, length (m.; gen. after عَلَى, printed separately; in annexation); 'the length of'
يَحُولُ: يَحُولُ — yaḥūlu, change, shift (verb I, present 3 m.s.); 'does it change'
صَبًّا: صَبًّا — ṣabb, a lover, one in love (m.; acc., indef., object); 'a lover'
شَفَى: شَفَى — shafā, bring to the brink, or heal (verb I, past 3 m.s.; the sense is uncertain); 'has brought to the brink'
الْبُكَاءُ: الْبُكَاءُ — الـ + bukāʾ, weeping (m.; nom.); 'the weeping'
وَالنُّحُولُ: وَ + النُّحُولُ — wa-, and + الـ + nuḥūl, emaciation, wasting (m.; nom.); 'and the wasting'
اِنَّا: إِنَّا — inna, indeed (particle governing the accusative) + -nā, we; 'indeed we'
وَاِيَّاكُمُ: وَ + إِيَّاكُمُ — wa-, and, together with (conj.) + iyyā, the carrier of an object pronoun + -kum, you (pl.); 'and you'
الْحَيُّ: الْحَيُّ — الـ + ḥayy, tribe, encampment (m.; nom., subject); 'the tribe'
وَبُكَائِهِ: و + بُكَاء + هِ — wa-, and + bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'and his weeping'
أُوصِيكَ: أُوصِي + كَ — ūṣī, أَوْصَى, to charge, enjoin (verb IV impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (m.); 'I charge you'
عَمٌّ: ʿamm — paternal uncle (m., nom. as printed, subject of 'you have')
بِمِصْرَ: بِـ + مِصْر — bi-, in (prep. of place) + Miṣr, Egypt (proper noun, gen., diptote); 'in Egypt'
فَارَقْتُهُ: فَارَقَ + تُ + هُ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III perf.) + -tu, I + -hu, him; 'I parted from him'
رِضَاهُ: رِضَا + هُ — riḍā, satisfaction, approval (m., gen.) + -hu, his; 'his approval'
تَأْخُذُ: taʾkhudhu — أَخَذَ, to take (verb I impf. 2 m. sg.); 'you take'; here: 3fs, 'she takes', after annahā
دَرْجًا: darj — scroll, roll of paper (m., acc. indef.); 'a scroll'
وَتَكْتُبُ: و + تَكْتُبُ — wa-, and + taktubu, kataba, to write (verb I impf. 2 m. sg.); 'and you write'
فَأخَذَ: فَـ + أَخَذَ — fa-, so, then (narrative sequence) + akhadha, to take (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he took'
بَدْرُالدِّينِ: Badr al-Dīn — 'full moon of the faith', proper name (m., nom., printed as one word); Badr al-Dīn Ḥasan, the son
الْوَرَقِ: الـ + وَرَق — al-, the + waraq, paper, leaves of paper (m., gen. after min); 'the paper'
فَأمْلَأَهُ: فَـ + مَلَأَ + هُ — fa-, so + malaʾa, to fill (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.; the printed spelling has an extra alif, perhaps for أَمْلَى, 'dictate') + -hu, it (the scroll); 'so he filled it'
زَوَاجِهِ: زَوَاج + هِ — zawāj, marriage (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his marriage'
وَدُخُولِهِ: و + دُخُول + هِ — wa-, and + dukhūl, entering, going in to a bride (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his going in'
وَتَارِيخَ: و + تَارِيخ — wa-, and + tārīkh, date (m., acc., coordinated with the first tārīkha; first term of iḍāfa); 'and the date of'
وُصُولِهِ: وُصُول + هِ — wuṣūl, arrival (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his arrival'
وَاجْتِمَاعِهِ: و + اجْتِمَاع + هِ — wa-, and + ijtimāʿ, meeting, coming together (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his meeting'
بِوَزِيرِهِ: بِـ + وَزِير + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; ijtimāʿ bi-, 'meeting with') + wazīr, vizier (gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his vizier'; also after daʿā, bi- marks the one sent for: daʿā al-maliku bi-wazīrihi, 'the king sent for his vizier'
عُمْرَهُ: عُمْر + هُ — ʿumr, age, lifetime (m., acc. after anna) + -hu, his; 'his age'
النِّزَاعِ: الـ + نِزَاع — al-, the + nizāʿ, dispute, quarrel (m., gen.); 'the dispute'
كِتَابِي: كِتَاب + ي — kitāb, letter, writing (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my letter'
خَلِيفَتِي: خَلِيفَة + ي — khalīfa, successor, deputy (nom.) + -ī, my; 'my deputy, the one who stands in my place'
طَوَاهَا: طَوَى + هَا — ṭawā, to fold (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f., the scroll); 'he folded it'
وَخَتَمَهَا: و + خَتَمَ + هَا — wa-, and + khatama, to seal (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he sealed it'
احْفَظِ: iḥfaẓi — حَفِظَ, to guard, keep (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.; the kasra joins the following al-); 'keep!'
الْوَصِيَّةَ: الـ + وَصِيَّة — al-, the + waṣiyya, charge, testament (f., acc.); 'the charge'
الرُّقْعَةَ: الـ + رُقْعَة — al-, the + ruqʿa, note, scrap of writing (f., acc. after inna); 'the note'
أَصْلُكَ: أَصْل + كَ — aṣl, origin, root (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your origin'
وَحَسَبُكَ: و + حَسَب + كَ — wa-, and + ḥasab, merit, inherited standing (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your standing'
وَنَسَبُكَ: و + نَسَب + كَ — wa-, and + nasab, lineage, descent (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your lineage'
أَصَابَكَ: أَصَابَ + كَ — aṣāba, to befall, strike (verb IV perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'it befell you'
فَاعْمِدْ: فَـ + اعْمِدْ — fa-, then (apodosis) + iʿmid, ʿamada ilā, to make for, head for (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.); 'then make for'
وَاسْأَلْ: و + اسْأَلْ — wa-, and + isʾal, saʾala, to ask (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.); 'and ask'
وَاسْتَدِلَّ: و + اسْتَدِلَّ — wa-, and + istadilla, istadalla ʿalā, to find one's way to, seek guidance to (verb X impv. 2 m. sg.); 'and find your way'
وَأَعْلِمْهُ: و + أَعْلِمْ + هُ — wa-, and + aʿlim, aʿlama, to inform (verb IV impv. 2 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and tell him'
مُشْتَاقًا: mushtāq — longing, yearning (m., acc. indef., ḥāl; participle VIII of shāqa); 'longing'
وَطَوَاهَا: و + طَوَى + هَا — wa-, and + ṭawā, to fold (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he folded it'
وَخَيَّطَهَا: و + خَيَّطَ + هَا — wa-, and + khayyaṭa, to sew, stitch (verb II perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'and he sewed it'
الْبِطَانَةِ: الـ + بِطَانَة — al-, the + biṭāna, lining (f., gen. after bayna); 'the lining'
وَالظِّهَارَةِ: و + الـ + ظِهَارَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ẓihāra, outer cloth, outer layer (f., gen.); 'and the outer cloth'
وَلَفَّ: و + لَفَّ — wa-, and + laffa, to wind, wrap (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he wound'
شَاشَهُ: شَاش + هُ — shāsh, turban cloth, muslin (m., acc., object of laffa) + -hu, his (printed ه, possibly for ة); 'his turban-cloth'
فِرَاقِهِ: فِرَاق + هِ — firāq, parting, separation (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his parting'
بِخَمْسَةِ: بِـ + خَمْسَة — bi-, with (prep.; awṣā bi-, 'charge with') + khamsa, five (numeral, f. form, gen.); 'with five'
آوَّلُهَا: أَوَّل + هَا — awwal, first (m., nom.; the print has آ for أ) + -hā, them (f. pl. of things); 'the first of them'
لَاتُعَاشِرَ: لَا + تُعَاشِرَ — lā, not (neg.) + tuʿāshira, ʿāshara, to keep company with (verb III impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive); printed as one word; 'you not keep company'
تَسْلَمْ: taslam — سَلِمَ مِنْ, to be safe from (verb I impf. 2 m. sg., jussive, answering the command); 'you will be safe'
الْعُزْلَةِ: الـ + عُزْلَة — al-, the + ʿuzla, seclusion, solitude (f., gen. after fī); 'the seclusion'
تُخَالِطَهُ: تُخَالِطَ + هُ — tukhāliṭa, khāliṭa, to mingle with (verb III impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'you mingle with him'
تُبَاشِرَهُ: تُبَاشِرَ + هُ — tubāshira, bāshara, to deal with at close quarters (verb III impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'you have dealings with him'
الشَّاعِرَ: الـ + شَاعِر — al-, the + shāʿir, poet (m., acc., object); 'the poet'
مَافِي: مَا + فِي — mā, not (neg.) + fī, in (prep.); printed as one word; 'not in'
زَمَانِكَ: زَمَان + كَ — zamān, time, age (m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your; 'your time'
تَرْجُو: tarjū — رَجَا, to hope for (verb I impf. 2 m. sg.); 'you hope for'
مَوَدَّتُهُ: مَوَدَّة + هُ — mawadda, affection (f., nom. as printed) + -hu, his; 'his affection'
جَارَ: jāra — جَارَ, to be unjust, wrong (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'it wrongs'
فَعِشْ: فَـ + عِشْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿish, ʿāsha, to live (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.); 'so live'
فَرِيدًا: farīd — alone, solitary (m., acc. indef., ḥāl); 'alone'
تَرْكَنْ: tarkan — رَكَنَ إِلَى, to lean on, rely on (verb I impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after lā); 'lean'
آلثَّانِيَةُ: الـ + ثَانِيَة — al-, the + thāniya, second (f., nom.; the print has آ for أ); 'the second (counsel)'
لَاتَجُورْ: لَا + تَجُورْ — lā, not + tajūr, jāra ʿalā, to wrong, oppress (verb I impf. 2 m. sg., jussive, long vowel kept as printed); printed as one word; 'do not wrong'
يَجُورْ: yajūr — جَارَ عَلَى, to wrong (verb I impf. 3 m. sg., jussive, long vowel kept; answer clause); 'will wrong'
فَالدَّهْرُ: فَـ + الـ + دَهْر — fa-, for (conj.) + al-, the + dahr, time, fate (m., nom.); 'for Time'
وَيَوْمٌ: و + يَوْمٌ — wa-, and + yawm, day (m., nom. indef.); 'and a day'
بِوَفَاءٍ: بِـ + وَفَاء — bi-, with, accompanied by (prep.) + wafāʾ, repayment, fulfilment (m., gen.); 'with repayment', i.e. 'repaid in full'
تَانَّ: tānna — for تَأَنَّ, taʾannā, to be deliberate, go slowly (verb V impv. 2 m. sg.; printed without the hamza); 'be deliberate!'
تَعْجَلْ: taʿjal — عَجِلَ, to hasten (verb I impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after lā); 'hasten'
لِاَمْرٍ: لِـ + أَمْر — li-, at, for (prep.; ʿajila li-, 'rush at') + amr, matter, affair (m., gen.); 'at a matter'
تُرِيدُهُ: تُرِيدُ + هُ — turīdu, arāda, to want (verb IV impf. 2 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'you want it'
وَكُنْ: و + كُنْ — wa-, and + kun, kāna, to be (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.); 'and be'
رَاحِمًا: rāḥim — merciful (m., acc. indef., active participle of raḥima)
تُدْعَى: tudʿā — دَعَا, to call (verb I impf. passive 2 m. sg.); 'you will be called'
بِرَاحِمِ: بِـ + رَاحِم — bi-, by (prep.; 'called by the name') + rāḥim, merciful (m., gen., printed without tanwīn, for the rhyme); 'by "merciful"'
يَدٍ: yad — hand (f., gen. indef. after min; مِنْ here strengthens the negative, 'any')
يَدُ: yad — hand (f., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the hand of'
ظَالِمٍ: ẓālim — wrongdoer, oppressor (m., gen. indef.; active participle of ẓalama)
سَيُبْلَى: سَـ + يُبْلَى — sa-, will (future particle) + yublā, ublia bi-, to be afflicted by, tried by (verb IV impf. passive 3 m. sg.); 'will be afflicted'
بِظَالِمِ: بِـ + ظَالِم — bi-, by (prep.; ublia bi-, 'be afflicted by') + ẓālim, wrongdoer (m., gen., printed without tanwīn, for the rhyme); 'by a wrongdoer'
آلْوَصِيَّةُ: الـ + وَصِيَّة — al-, the + waṣiyya, charge, counsel (f., nom.; the print has آ for أ); 'the charge'
اِلْزَمِ: ilzami — لَزِمَ, to cling to, keep to (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.; the kasra joins the following al-); 'hold to'
الصَّمْتَ: الـ + صَمْت — al-, the + ṣamt, silence (m., acc.); 'the silence'
وَاشْتَغِلْ: و + اشْتَغِلْ — wa-, and + ishtaghil, ishtaghala bi-, to busy oneself with (verb VIII impv. 2 m. sg.); 'and busy yourself'
بِعَيْبِكَ: بِـ + عَيْب + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; ishtaghala bi-, 'be occupied with') + ʿayb, fault, defect (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your fault'
عُيُوبِ: ʿuyūb — faults, defects (pl. of ʿayb, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'the faults of'
لَزِمَ: lazima — to cling to, keep to (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he held to'
الصَّمْتُ: الـ + صَمْت — al-, the + ṣamt, silence (m., nom.); 'silence'
وَالسُّكُوتُ: و + الـ + سُّكُوت — wa-, and + al-, the + sukūt, quiet, keeping silent (m., nom.); 'and the quiet'
فَاِذَا: فَـ + اِذَا — fa-, so (conj.) + idhā, when (conj.); 'so when'
نَطَقْتَ: naṭaqta — نَطَقَ, to speak (verb I perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you speak'
مِهْذَارًا: mihdhār — babbler, chatterer (m., acc. indef.; predicate of takun)
فَلَئِنْ: فَـ + لَـ + إِنْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + la-, indeed (emphatic particle) + in, if (conditional particle); 'and if indeed'
نَدِمْتَ: nadimta — نَدِمَ عَلَى, to regret (verb I perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you regret'
سُكُوتِكَ: سُكُوت + كَ — sukūt, silence (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your silence'
فَلَتَنْدَمَنَّ: فَـ + لَـ + تَنْدَمَنَّ — fa-, then (conj.) + la-, indeed (emphatic particle opening the answer) + tandamanna, nadima ʿalā, to regret (verb I impf. 2 m. sg., with the emphatic -anna ending); 'then you will surely regret'
آلرَّابِعَةُ: الـ + رَابِعَة — al-, the + rābiʿa, fourth (f., nom.; the print has آ for أ); 'the fourth'
أُحَذِّرُكَ: أُحَذِّر + كَ — uḥadhdhiru, ḥadhdhara min, to warn against (verb II impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you; 'I warn you'
شُرْبِ: shurb — drinking (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa after min); 'the drinking of'
الْخَمْرِ: الـ + خَمْر — al-, the + khamr, wine (m./f., gen.); 'wine'
الْخَمْرَ: الـ + خَمْر — al-, the + khamr, wine (m./f., acc. after inna); 'wine'
رأْسُ: raʾs — head, chief (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the head of'
فِتْنَةٍ: fitna — temptation, trial, strife (f., gen. indef.)
وَالْخَمْرُ: و + الـ + خَمْر — wa-, and + al-, the + khamr, wine (m./f., nom.); 'and wine'
مُذْهِبُ: mudhhib — taker-away, destroyer (m., nom., active participle IV of dhahaba, first term of iḍāfa); 'that which takes away'
الْعُقُولِ: الـ + عُقُول — al-, the + ʿuqūl, minds, wits (pl. of ʿaql, gen.); 'the minds'
النَّبِيذَ: الـ + نَبِيذ — al-, the + nabīdh, fermented drink, wine (m., acc.); 'the wine'
وَشُرَّابَهُ: و + شُرَّاب + هُ — wa-, and + shurrāb, drinkers (pl. of shārib, acc.) + -hu, its; 'and its drinkers'
حَلِيفًا: ḥalīf — ally, confederate (m., acc. indef.; predicate of ṣirtu); 'an ally'
عَابَهُ: عَابَ + هُ — ʿāba, to censure, find fault with (verb I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'he censured it'
يُضِلُّ: yuḍillu — أَضَلَّ, to lead astray (verb IV impf. 3 m. sg.); 'it leads astray'
الْهُدَى: الـ + هُدَى — al-, the + hudā, guidance (m., gen.); 'guidance'
وَيَفْتَحُ: و + يَفْتَحُ — wa-, and + yaftaḥu, fataḥa, to open (verb I impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it opens'
لِلشَّرِّ: لِـ + الـ + شَّرّ — li-, for, to (prep.; 'open for') + al-, the + sharr, evil (m., gen.); 'for evil'
اَبْوَابَهُ: أَبْوَاب + هُ — abwāb, doors (pl. of bāb, acc.) + -hu, its; 'its doors'
وَالْخَامِسَةُ: و + الـ + خَامِسَة — wa-, and + al-, the + khāmisa, fifth (f., nom.); 'and the fifth'
يَصُونُكَ: يَصُونُ + كَ — yaṣūnu, ṣāna, to protect, preserve (verb I impf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'it protects you'
احْفَظْ: iḥfaẓ — حَفِظَ, to guard, keep (verb I impv. 2 m. sg.); 'guard!'
مَالَكَ: مَال + كَ — māl, wealth (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your wealth'; here: مَا + لَـ + كَ, mā laka, 'what is to you?', 'what ails you?' (li-, to, marking the one concerned; printed as one word)
يَحْفَظْكَ: يَحْفَظْ + كَ — yaḥfaẓ, ḥafiẓa, to guard (verb I impf. 3 m. sg., jussive, answer clause) + -ka, you; 'it will guard you'
تُفَرِّطْ: tufarriṭ — فَرَّطَ فِي, to be negligent or prodigal with (verb II impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after lā); 'you squander'
تَحْتَاجْ: taḥtāj — احْتَاجَ إِلَى, to need (verb VIII impf. 2 m. sg., long vowel kept as printed; consequence clause); 'you will need'
أَقَلِّ: aqall — least, fewest (elative of qalīl, m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'the least of'
الدَّرَاهِمِ: الـ + دَرَاهِم — al-, the + darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of dirham, gen. after min); 'the dirhams'
الْمَرَاهِمُ: الـ + مَرَاهِم — al-, the + marāhim, salves, ointments (pl. of marham, nom.); 'the salves'
فَلَاخِلَّ: فَـ + لَا + خِلّ — fa-, then (apodosis) + lā, no (neg. of the genus) + khill, friend (m., acc. without tanwīn); 'then no friend'
يُصَاحِبُنِي: يُصَاحِبُ + نِي — yuṣāḥibu, ṣāḥaba, to keep company with (verb III impf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'keeps company with me'
فَكُلُّ: فَـ + كُلّ — fa-, then (apodosis) + kull, all (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'then all'
خُلَّانِي: خُلَّان + ي — khullān, friends (pl. of khalīl, nom.) + -ī, my; 'my friends'
فَكَمْ: فَـ + كَمْ — fa-, for, and so (conj.) + kam, how many (exclamatory, with a gen. singular); 'for how many a'
صَدِيقٍ: ṣadīq — friend (m., gen. indef., after kam)
لِبَذْلِ: لِـ + بَذْل — li-, for, for the sake of (prep.) + badhl, spending, giving (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'for the spending of'
صَاحَبَنِي: صَاحَبَ + نِي — ṣāḥaba, to befriend, accompany (verb III perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he befriended me'
وَصَاحِبِي: و + صَاحِب + ي — wa-, and + ṣāḥib, companion (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my companion'
يُوصِي: يُوصِي — awṣā, to charge, enjoin, give counsel to (IV, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'he charges, counsels'
وَدَفَنُوهُ: و + دَفَنُوا + هُ — wa-, and; dafana, to bury (perf. 3 m. pl.); -hu, him; 'and they buried him'
شَهْرَيْنِ: شَهْرَيْن — shahr, month (m., dual gen., second term of the idafa); 'two months'
يَرْكَبْ: يَرْكَبْ — rakiba, to ride (jussive 3 m. sg.); 'he did not ride out'
الدِّيوَانَ: الـ + دِيوَان — al-, the + dīwān, court, council hall, the ruler's office (m., acc.); 'the court'
يُقَابِلِ: يُقَابِلِ — qābala, to meet, call upon (III, jussive 3 m. sg., with a helping kasra before الـ); 'he met'
