فَأَقَامَ: ف + أَقَامَ — fa-, so, then; aqāma, to set up, appoint (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he set up'; also to stay, remain: 'so he stayed'
يَخْتِمَ: يَخْتِمَ — khatama, to seal, put a seal on (subjunctive 3 m. sg.); with عَلَى 'on', 'to put the seal on'
أَمَاكِنِ: أَمَاكِن — amākin, places, premises (pl. of مَكَان, gen., first term of the idafa); 'the premises of'
وَعِمَارَتِهِ: و + عِمَارَة + هِ — wa-, and; ʿimāra, building(s), edifice, estate (f., gen.); -hi, his; 'and his buildings'
وَأَمْلَاكِهِ: و + أَمْلَاك + هِ — wa-, and; amlāk, properties, possessions (pl. of مِلْك, gen.); -hi, his; 'and his estates'
الْجَدِيدُ: الـ + جَدِيد — al-, the + jadīd, new (adj., nom., agreeing with الْوَزِيرُ); 'the new'
يَخْتِمُ: يَخْتِمُ — khatama, to seal (impf. 3 m. sg., indicative, giving a circumstantial or purpose sense); 'sealing, to seal'
وَيَقْبِضُ: و + يَقْبِضُ — wa-, and; qabaḍa ʿalā, to seize, arrest (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and seizing'
بَدْرِالدِّينِ: بَدْرِ + الدِّينِ — badr, full moon (gen., in apposition to the preceding noun) + al-dīn, the faith (gen.); Badr al-Dīn, printed as one word
وَيَطْلَعُ: و + يَطْلَعُ — wa-, and; ṭalaʿa bi-, to go up with, bring up (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and bringing up'
يَقْتَضِي: يَقْتَضِي — iqtaḍā, to require, call for (VIII, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'requires'
رَأْيُهُ: رَأْي + هُ — raʾy, opinion, judgement (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his opinion'
مَمْلُوكٌ: مَمْلُوك — mamlūk, slave-soldier, owned man (m., nom. indef.); 'a mamluk'
مَمَالِيكِ: مَمَالِيك — mamālīk, mamluks (pl. of مَمْلُوك, gen., first term of the idafa); 'the mamluks of'
الْمُتَوَفَّى: الـ + مُتَوَفًّى — al-, the + mutawaffā, deceased (passive part. of V, tawaffā, 'to die' lit. 'be taken in full'; adj., gen.); 'the late, the deceased'
الْقَضِيَّةِ: الـ + قَضِيَّة — al-, the + qaḍiyya, affair, matter, case (f., gen.); 'the affair'
سَاقَ: سَاقَ — sāqa, to drive, urge on (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he drove, spurred'
جَرَادَهُ: جَرَاد + هُ — jarād, locust (m., acc.) + -hu, his; as printed 'his locust', almost surely a misprint for جَوَاد 'steed', so 'his steed'
مُنَكِّسُ: مُنَكِّس — munakkis, one who lowers, hangs down (active part. of II, nakkasa; nom., first term of the idafa); 'lowering'
الرَّأْسِ: الـ + رَأْس — al-, the + raʾs, head (m., gen.); 'the head'
مُنْكَسِرُ: مُنْكَسِر — munkasir, broken (active part. of VII, inkasara; nom., first term of the idafa); 'broken of'
الْمَمْلُوكُ: الـ + مَمْلُوك — al-, the + mamlūk, mamluk (m., nom.); 'the mamluk'
وَقُبِّلَتْ: و + قُبِّلَتْ — wa-, and; qubbilat, was kissed (passive of II, qabbala; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and was kissed'
يَدُهُ: يَد + هُ — yad, hand (f., nom., subject of the passive) + -hu, his; 'his hand'
وَابْنَ: و + ابْنَ — wa-, and; ibn, son (m., vocative acc., first term of the idafa); 'and O son of'
الْعَجَلَ: الـ + عَجَل — al-, the + ʿajal, haste (m., acc. of urging, repeated); 'haste!, hurry!'
حُلُولِ: حُلُول — ḥulūl, arrival, the falling due (verbal noun of ḥalla; gen., first term of the idafa); 'the arrival of'
الْأَجَلِ: الـ + أَجَل — al-, the + ajal, appointed term, the fixed end of a life (m., gen.); 'the term, the hour of death'
فَارْتَجَفَ: ف + اِرْتَجَفَ — fa-, so; irtajafa, to tremble, shake (VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he trembled'
غَضِبَ: غَضِبَ — ghaḍiba, to be angry (perf. 3 m. sg.), with عَلَى 'at, with'; 'he became angry'
وَرَسَمَ: و + رَسَمَ — wa-, and; rasama bi-, to decree, order (something) (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he decreed'; also: rasama ʿalā, to set (keepers) over someone: rasama ʿalayhā ʿasharata ʿajāʾiza, 'he set ten old women over her' (Night 179)
بِالْحَوْطَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حَوْطَة — bi-, with (prep.; rasama bi-, 'decree, order (something)', the verb chooses the preposition) + al-, the + ḥawṭa, custody, seizure of property (f., gen.); 'ordered the seizure'
وَالْبَلَاءُ: و + الـ + بَلَاء — wa-, and; al-, the + balāʾ, affliction, calamity (m., nom.); 'and the calamity'
يَجِي: يَجِي — jāʾa, to come (impf. 3 m. sg., spelled without its hamza, Middle Arabic for يَجِيءُ); 'comes'
فَفُزْ: ف + فُزْ — fa-, so; fuz, win, escape (imper. m. sg. of fāza, with بِـ 'obtain, get away with'); 'so save'
أَدْخُلَ: أَدْخُلَ — dakhala, to enter (subjunctive 1 sg., after حَتَّى); 'that I enter'
أَصْحَبَ: أَصْحَبَ — ṣaḥiba, to accompany, take along (subjunctive 1 sg., continuing the purpose); 'take along'
أَسْتَعِينَ: أَسْتَعِينَ — istaʿāna bi-, to seek help with, make use of (X, subjunctive 1 sg.); 'that I may seek help'
الْغُرْبَةِ: الـ + غُرْبَة — al-, the + ghurba, exile, being far from home (f., gen.); 'the exile'
وَهُوَيَقُولُ: و + هُوَ + يَقُولُ — wa-, and (introducing a circumstantial clause); huwa, he; yaqūlu, he says (qāla, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he saying'; printed as one word
ضَيْمًا: ضَيْم — ḍaym, wrong, injustice, oppression (m., acc. indef.); 'wrong'
فَإِنَّكَ: ف + إِنَّ + كَ — fa-, for, since; inna, indeed (particle); -ka, you (m.); 'for indeed you'
اَرْضًا: أَرْض — arḍ, land, earth, country (f., acc. indef.), printed with a bare-alif hamza; 'a land'
الْاُسْدِ: الـ + أُسْد — al-, the + usd, lions (pl. of أَسَد, gen.), printed with a bare-alif hamza; 'the lions'
بِاَنْفُسِهَا: بِـ + أَنْفُس + هَا — bi-, by, through (prep., 'by oneself, in person') + anfus, selves (pl. of نَفْس, gen.), printed with a bare-alif hamza; -hā, their (f. pl., agreeing with رِقَاب); 'by their own selves'
غَطَّى: غَطَّى — ghaṭṭā, to cover (II, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he covered'
يَمْشِي: يَمْشِي — mashā, to walk (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'walking, on foot'
الْجَدِيدَ: الـ + جَدِيد — al-, the + jadīd, new (adj., acc.); 'the new'
وَزِيرِهِ: وَزِير + هِ — wazīr, vizier (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his vizier'
وَأَمَاكِنِهِ: و + أَمَاكِن + هِ — wa-, and; amākin, places, premises (pl. of مَكَان, gen.); -hi, his; 'and his premises'
لِيَقْتُلَهُ: لِـ + يَقْتُلَ + هُ — li-, in order to, so that (conj. + subjunctive, of purpose); qatala, to kill (subjunctive 3 m. sg.); -hu, him; 'so that he might kill him'
فَتَأَسَّفَ: ف + تَأَسَّفَ — fa-, so; taʾassafa, to grieve, be sorry (V, perf. 3 m. sg.), with عَلَى 'over'; 'so he grieved'
سَاقَتْهُ: سَاقَتْ + هُ — sāqa, to drive, bring (perf. 3 f. sg.); -hu, him; 'drove him'
تُرْبَةِ: تُرْبَة — turba, tomb, grave (f., gen., first term of the idafa, after عَلَى 'to, upon'); 'the tomb of'
الْمَقْبَرَةَ: الـ + مَقْبَرَة — al-, the + maqbara, cemetery (f., acc.); 'the cemetery'
الْقُبُورِ: الـ + قُبُور — al-, the + qubūr, graves (pl. of قَبْر, gen.); 'the graves'
قَبْرِ: قَبْر — qabr, grave, tomb (m., gen., first term of the idafa); 'the tomb of'
وَأَرْخَى: و + أَرْخَى — wa-, and; arkhā, to let down, let fall (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he let down'
فَرَجِيَّتِهِ: فَرَجِيَّة + هِ — farajiyya, a long outer robe (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his robe'
مَنْسُوجَةً: مَنْسُوجَة — mansūja, woven (passive part. of nasaja; f., acc. indef., predicate of كَانَتْ); 'woven'
بِطِرَازِ: بِـ + طِرَاز — bi-, with (prep., 'with, in the form of') + ṭirāz, embroidered band, often inscribed (m., gen., first term of the idafa); 'with a band of'
شَرِيقُ: شَرِيق — sharīq, shining(?) (adj., nom.; an obscure form, perhaps from sharaqa/ashraqa, 'to shine'); 'shining'
الْكَوَاكِبَ: الـ + كَوَاكِب — al-, the + kawākib, stars, planets (pl. of كَوْكَب, acc.); 'the stars'
وَالنَّدَا: و + الـ + نَّدَا — wa-, and; al-, the + nadā, dew; bounty, generosity (m.); 'and the dew (or bounty)'
لَازَالَ: لَا + زَالَ — lā, not; zāla, to cease (perf. 3 m. sg.); lā zāla + noun, an optative, 'may it never cease to be'
عِزُّكَ: عِزّ + كَ — ʿizz, might, glory (m., nom.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your might'
وَعُلُوُّ: و + عُلُوّ — wa-, and; ʿuluww, loftiness, height (m., nom., first term of the idafa); 'and the loftiness of'
مَجْدِكَ: مَجْد + كَ — majd, glory, eminence (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your glory'
سَرْمَدَا: سَرْمَد — sarmad, everlasting, eternal (adj., acc. indef., predicate); 'everlasting'
قَدِمَ: qadima, he arrived, came (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
صَيْرَ: first half of صَيْرَفِيّ, ṣayrafī, money-changer (m.), printed split in two words; see the next entry
فِيٌّ: second half of صَيْرَفِيّ, ṣayrafī, money-changer; the printed pair صَيْرَ فِيٌّ reads 'a money-changer'
الْيَهُودِيُّ: الـ + يَهُودِيّ — al-, the + yahūdiyy, Jew (m.); 'the Jew'
الْبَصْرِيِّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — al-, the + Baṣrī, of Basra, Basran (nisba); 'the Basran'
مَانِي: obscure; apparently colloquial mā-nī, 'how is it that I ...?' (perhaps for مَا لِي or مَا بَالِي); in context 'why do I ...?'
مُتَغَيِّرًا: mutaghayyir, changed, altered (act. part. V), acc. as predicate/state; 'changed'
هَذِهِالسَّاعَةِ: هَذِهِ + الـ + سَاعَة — hādhihi, this (f.) + al-, the + sāʿa, hour, moment (f.), printed as one word; 'this hour', i.e. 'just now'
يُعَاتِبُنِي: يُعَاتِبُ + نِي — yuʿātibu, he reproaches, rebukes (verb III, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he reproaches me'
عَدَمِ: ʿadam, non-existence, lack, absence (m.), in construct, gen.; 'lack of', 'not having'
زِيَارَتِي: زِيَارَة + ي — ziyāra, visit, visiting (f.) + -ī, my; 'my visiting'
مَرْعُوبٌ: marʿūb, terrified, frightened (pass. part. of رَعَبَ), indefinite nom.; 'terrified'
وَخِفْتُ: وَ + خَافَ — wa-, and + khāfa, to fear (verb I), perf. 1 sg. -tu; 'and I feared'
يَفُوتَ: yafūta, it passes away, escapes, is lost (verb I, subj. 3 m. sg. after أَنْ); 'that it should pass'
أَزُرْهُ: أَزُرْ + هُ — azur, I visit (verb I, juss. 1 sg. after لَمْ) + -hu, him; 'I have not visited him'
فَيَكُونَ: فَـ + يَكُونَ — fa-, and so, with the result that (introduces a consequence) + yakūna, it be (verb I, subj. 3 m. sg.); 'and so it would be'; here: the subjunctive is still governed by the an of an yankashifa: an yankashifa amruhumā fa-yakūna dhālika sababan, 'that their affair be uncovered and that this be a cause'
صَعْبًا: ṣaʿb, hard, difficult (adj.), acc. as predicate; 'hard'
لِلتِّجَارَةِ: لِـ + الـ + تِجَارَة — li-, for, for the purpose of (prep.) + al-, the + tijāra, trade, commerce (f.); 'for trade'
وَقَدِمَ: وَ + قَدِمَ — wa-, and + qadima, he/it arrived (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and arrived'
الْبَعْضُ: الـ + بَعْض — al-, the + baʿḍ, part, some (m.); 'some'
وَمُرَادِي: وَ + مُرَاد + ي — wa-, and + murād, intention, wish (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my wish'
وَسْقَ: wasq, a load, cargo, shipload (m.), here in construct, acc.; 'the cargo of'
مَرْكَبٍ: markab, ship, vessel (m.), indefinite gen.; 'a ship'
الْأَلْفِ: الـ + أَلْف — al-, the + alf, thousand (m.), gen. after بِـ; 'the thousand'
وَعَدَّمِنْهُ: وَ + عَدَّ + مِنْ + هُ — wa-, and + ʿadda, he counted (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + min, from, out of (prep.) + -hu, it; printed as one word; 'and counted out of it'
اُكْتُبْ: uktub, write! (verb I, imper. m. sg.)
وَرَقَةً: waraqa, a sheet of paper, a document (f.), indefinite acc.; 'a paper', i.e. 'a deed' Also 'a letter': katabat lahu waraqatan, 'she wrote him a letter'.
كَاتِبُهَا: كَاتِب + هَا — kātib, writer (act. part.) + -hā, its (the paper's); 'its writer'
لِإِسْحَاقَ: لِـ + إِسْحَاق — li-, to (prep.; indirect object of بَاعَ: 'sold to') + Isḥāq, Isaac, proper name (diptote); 'to Isḥāq'
الْيَهُودِيِّ: الـ + يَهُودِيّ — al-, the + yahūdiyy, Jew (m.), gen. in apposition; 'the Jew'
وَسْقِ: wasq, a load, cargo (m.), in construct, gen.; 'the cargo of'
يَدْخُلُ: yadkhulu, he/it enters (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg.); with ʿalā, 'come in upon'; of a ship, 'enter (port)'
وَقَبَضَ: وَ + قَبَضَ — wa-, and + qabaḍa, he received, took possession of (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he received' Also 'and he seized, grasped', with a direct object: wa-qabaḍa liḥyatahu, 'and he seized his beard' (Night 188).
التَّعْجِيلِ: الـ + تَعْجِيل — al-, the + taʿjīl, hastening, advance payment (m., verbal noun II), gen.; 'the advance-payment'
الْوَرَقَةَ: الـ + وَرَقَة — al-, the + waraqa, paper, document (f.), acc.; 'the paper'
وَيَتَذَكَّرُ: وَ + يَتَذَكَّرُ — wa-, and + yatadhakkaru, he remembers, recalls (verb V, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and remembers'
وَيُنْشِدُ: وَ + يُنْشِدُ — wa-, and + yunshidu, he recites (verse) (verb IV, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and recites'
بِالدَّارِ: بِـ + الـ + دَار — bi-, in (prep., locative) + al-, the + dār, house, abode (f.); 'in the house'
مُذْغِبْتُمْ: مُذْ + غِبْتُمْ — mudh, since (conj.) + ghibtum, you (m. pl.) were absent, went away (verb I, perf. 2 m. pl.), printed as one word; 'since you went away'
وَلَاالْجَارُ: وَ + لَا + الـ + جَار — wa-, and + lā, nor, not (negation) + al-, the + jār, neighbour (m.), printed as one word; 'and not the neighbour'
الْاَنِيسُ: الـ + أَنِيس — al-, the + anīs, companion, intimate friend (m.); 'the companion'
اَعْهَدُهُ: أَعْهَدُ + هُ — aʿhadu, I know, am familiar with (verb I, impf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'I used to know him'
اَنِيسِي: أَنِيس + ي — anīs, companion, friend (m.) + -ī, my; 'my companion'
الْاَقْمَارُ: الـ + أَقْمَار — al-, the + aqmār, moons (pl. of قَمَر, m.); 'the moons'
اَقْمَارُ: aqmār, moons (pl. of qamar, m.), nom.; 'moons'
فَاَوْحَشْتُمُ: فَـ + أَوْحَشْتُمُ — fa-, and so + awḥashtum, you made desolate, left lonely (verb IV, perf. 2 m. pl.) + the printed final -u; 'and so you made desolate'
بِبُعْدِكُمُ: بِـ + بُعْد + كُمُ — bi-, by, through, because of (prep., of cause) + buʿd, distance, absence (m.) + -kum (printed -kumu), your (m. pl.); 'by your distance'
وَاَظْلَمَتْ: وَ + أَظْلَمَتْ — wa-, and + aẓlamat, it grew dark (verb IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and grew dark'
رَحْبًا: raḥb, wide, spacious (adj.), here as a noun 'wide land, expanse'; indefinite acc. as printed
وَاَقْطَارُ: وَ + أَقْطَار — wa-, and + aqṭār, regions, quarters (pl. of قُطْر, m.), nom.; 'and regions'
الْغُرَابَ: الـ + غُرَاب — al-, the + ghurāb, raven, crow (m.), acc. after لَيْتَ; 'the raven'
نَادَى: nādā, he called, cried out (verb III, perf. 3 m. sg.)
بِفُرْقَتِنَا: بِـ + فُرْقَة + نَا — bi-, with, of (prep.; نَادَى بِـ 'call out, proclaim something') + furqa, parting, separation (f.) + -nā, our; 'proclaimed our parting'
يُعْرَا: yuʿrā, he is stripped, made bare (verb I, passive, impf. 3 m. sg., printed with alif for يُعْرَى); 'be stripped'
الرِّيشِ: الـ + رِيش — al-, the + rīsh, feathers, plumage (m., collective); 'the feathers'
تَحْوِيهِ: تَحْوِي + هِ — taḥwī, she/it holds, contains (verb I, impf. 3 f. sg.; subject 'nests') + -hi, him; 'holds him'
اَوْكَارُ: awkār, nests (pl. of وَكْر, m.), nom.; 'nests'
وَاَضْنِي: وَ + أُضْنِيَ — wa-, and + uḍniya, he was worn out, wasted (verb IV, passive, perf. 3 m. sg.), printed with fatḥa; 'and was worn out'
تَهَتَّكَ: tahattaka, it was torn open, laid bare (verb V, perf. 3 m. sg.)
اَسْتَارُ: astār, curtains, veils (pl. of سِتْر, m.), nom.; 'veils'
تَعُودُ: taʿūdu, she/it returns (verb I, impf. 3 f. sg.); 'will return'
لَيَالِينَا: لَيَالِي + نَا — layālī, nights (pl. of لَيْلَة, f.) + -nā, our; 'our nights'
سَلَفَتْ: salafat, she/it passed, went before (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'which passed'
عَهِدْنَا: ʿahidnā, we knew, were familiar with (verb I, perf. 1 pl.); 'we knew (them)'
وَتَجْمَعُ: وَ + تَجْمَعُ — wa-, and + tajmaʿu, she/it gathers, unites (verb I, impf. 3 f. sg.); 'and will gather'
أَبَاهَا: أَبَ (acc.) + هَا — ab, father (m.), with 'her'; 'her father' (one of the 'five nouns', long ā in the accusative)
أَبِيهَا: أَبِي (gen.) + هَا — ab, father (m.), with 'her'; 'her father', after عَلَى; also: gen. after ilā: arsala … ilā abīhā, 'sent to her father' (Night 179)
أَخْطُبُهَا: أَخْطُبُ + هَا — khaṭaba, ask (a woman) in marriage, 1st sg. imperfect, with 'her'; 'I ask for her hand'
أَرَدْتِ: أَرَدْتِ — arāda, wish, want; 2nd f. sg. perfect; 'you wished'
أَشْبَهُ: ashbah, more like (elative, from shabiha, resemble); 'most like'
أَنْفِكَ: أَنْفِ + كَ — anf, nose (m.), with 'your'; 'your nose'
أُحَدِّثَكِ: أُحَدِّثَ + كِ — ḥaddatha, tell, speak to (II); 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ, with 'you' (f.); 'that I tell you'
أُزَوِّجُهَا: أُزَوِّجُ + هَا — zawwaja, give in marriage (II), 1st sg. imperfect, with 'her'; 'I marry her off'
أُمُّهَا: أُمُّ + هَا — umm, mother (f.), with 'her'; 'her mother'
إِقْلِيمِ: iqlīm, region, province (m.), in construct, genitive after فِي; 'the region of'
اسْمِ: ism, name (m.), in construct, genitive after عَلَى; 'the name of'; also gen. after ʿan: saʾala ʿani ismi madīnatihi, 'asked the name of his city' (Night 194)
اعْتِدَالٌ: iʿtidāl, evenness, symmetry, balance (m., from iʿtadala, VIII)
الدَّايَاتِ: الـ + دَايَات — dāya (Persian), nurse (f.), plural dāyāt; 'the nurses'
السِّنَّ: الـ + سِنّ — sinn, age (m.), accusative object; 'the age'
النَّائِمِ: الـ + نَائِم — nāʾim, sleeping (active part. of nāma), genitive; 'the sleeping (one)'
الْأَحْدَبِ: الـ + أَحْدَب — aḥdab, hunchbacked; genitive; 'the hunchback'
الْقَمَرِ: الـ + قَمَر — qamar, moon (m.), genitive after فِى; 'the moon'
الْمَقْبَرَةُ: الـ + مَقْبَرَة — maqbara, cemetery (f.), nominative; 'the cemetery'
بَارِدَةٍ: bārida, cold (f. adj.), genitive; 'cold, feeble (of an excuse)'
بَتَاعِ: bitāʿ (Egyptian colloquial), belonging to, of (m.), here in construct; 'of, belonging to'
بِإِحْضَارِهِ: بِـ + إِحْضَار + هِ — bi-, with the verb أَمَرَ 'command' (أَمَرَ بِـ 'order [something]') + iḥḍār, bringing (m.; verbal noun of aḥḍara IV) + 'him'; 'to bring him'
بِالْقَهْرِ: بِـ + الـ + قَهْر — bi-, by means of (prep.) + qahr, force, compulsion (m.); 'by force'
بِحَدْبَةٍ: بِـ + حَدْبَة — bi-, with (prep., of a feature someone has) + ḥadba, hump (f.); 'with a hump'
بِحُجَّةٍ: بِـ + حُجَّة — bi-, with, by means of (prep., after iḥtajja 'plead') + ḥujja, plea, pretext (f.); 'with a plea'
تَرَكْتُهُ: تَرَكْتُ + هُ — taraka, leave; 1st sg. perfect, with 'him'; 'I left him'
تَطُوفُ: taṭūfu, ṭāfa, circle, go around; 3rd f. sg. imperfect; 'she circles'
تَعَجَّبَتْ: taʿajjabat, taʿajjaba, marvel (V); 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she marvelled'
تَمْنَهَا: تَمْنَ + هَا — obscure: probably a misprint for تَمْنَعُهَا tamnaʿuhā, manaʿa 'withhold', 2nd m. sg. imperfect, with 'her'; 'you withhold her'
تَنْظُرَ: tanẓura, naẓara, look; 2nd m. sg. subjunctive after حَتَّى; 'that you look'
جَاوَزَتْ: jāwazat, jāwaza, pass beyond (III); 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she passed'
جِبِّيَّةٌ: jibbiyya, as printed; evidently a misprint for jinniyya, a female jinni (f.), nominative; 'a female jinni'
حَالِفٌ: ḥālif, swearing (active part. of ḥalafa), nominative; 'swearing, having sworn'
حَرَجَتْ: ḥarajat, as printed; probably a misprint for kharajat, kharaja 'come out'; 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she/it came out'
خَدَمِي: خَدَمِ + ي — khadam, servants (collective pl.), in construct with 'my', genitive; 'my servants'
رَأَتْهُ: رَأَتْ + هُ — raʾā, see; 3rd f. sg. perfect, with 'him'; 'she saw him'
رَأَيْتَ: raʾayta, raʾā, see; 2nd m. sg. perfect; 'you saw'
رَأْسُهُ: رَأْسُ + هُ — raʾs, head (m.), nominative, with 'his'; 'his head'
رَسَمُوا: rasamū, rasama, decree, put an order (here uncertain: 'lay an order, put under guard'); 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'they ordered'
زَوَاجِي: زَوَاجِ + ي — zawāj, marriage (m.), with 'my'; 'my marriage'
شَبِيهَ: shabīh, like, equal (m.), accusative after لَا; 'no like'
شَرِيكِي: شَرِيكِ + ي — sharīk, partner (m.), with 'my'; 'my partner'
طَائِرًا: ṭāʾir, flying (active part. of ṭāra), accusative (ḥāl); 'flying'
طَارَتْ: ṭārat, ṭāra, fly; 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she flew'
عَمِّهَا: عَمِّ + هَا — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.), with 'her'; 'her uncle'
عَٰدَتِهَا: عَادَتِ + هَا — ʿāda, custom, habit (f.; printed without alif, pointed with dagger alif), genitive after عَلَى, with 'her'; 'her custom'
عُمْرِكَ: عُمْرِ + كَ — ʿumr, lifetime, age (m.), with 'your', genitive after فِي; 'your lifetime'
عِنْدِنَا: عِنْدِ + نَا — ʿinda, with, by (prep.), with 'us'; 'from us (after مِنْ)'
فَأَدْرَكَهُ: فَـ + أَدْرَكَ + هُ — fa-, and so (sequence) + adraka, overtake (IV); 3rd m. sg. perfect, with 'him'; 'and it overtook him'
فَرَأَتْ: فَـ + رَأَتْ — fa-, and so (sequence) + raʾā, see; 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'and she saw'
فَكَانَ: فَـ + كَانَ — fa-, and so (sequence) + kāna, be; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and it was'; here: fa-, then (the result), with an imperfect after it: fa-kāna amruka yankashifu, 'then your affair would come to light'
قَبْرَأَبِيهِ: قَبْرَ + أَبِي + هِ — qabr, grave (m.), accusative in construct + ab, father, with 'his' (printed as one word); 'his father's grave'
لَأُزَوِّجُ: لَا أُزَوِّجُ — lā, not + uzawwiju, zawwaja 'give in marriage'; 1st sg. imperfect (one alif in the print serves both); 'I will not marry off'
لَايَحْضُرُهَا: لَا + يَحْضُرُ + هَا — lā, not + yaḥḍuru, ḥaḍara 'attend, be present with'; 3rd m. sg. imperfect, with 'her' (printed as one word); 'he does not attend her'
لِأَخِي: لِـ + أَخِ + ي — li-, for (prep., 'in honour of') + akh, brother, with 'my'; 'for my brother'
لِأَقَلِّ: لِـ + أَقَلّ — li-, to (prep., 'marry to') + aqall, least, lowest (elative); 'to the least'
لِابْنِ: لِـ + ابْن — li-, to (prep., 'give in marriage to') + ibn, son; 'to the son of'
لِغَيْظِهِ: لِـ + غَيْظ + هِ — li-, for (prep., 'a cause for') + ghayẓ, rage, with 'his'; 'for his rage'
لِمَوْلَانَا: لِـ + مَوْلَى + نَا — li-, for (prep., of possession: 'our master has') + mawlā, master, with 'our'; 'to our master'
مِثْلِكَ: مِثْلِ + كَ — mithl, like, the like of, with 'you', genitive after مِنْ; 'one like you'
نَعْلَمُ: naʿlamu, ʿalima, know; 1st pl. imperfect; 'we know'
وَأَرَّخْتُ: و + أَرَّخْتُ — wa-, and + arrakhtu, arrakha 'date, record the date of' (II); 1st sg. perfect (uncertain; perhaps for akhkhartu 'I delayed'); 'and I dated'
وَأَسْنَدَ: و + أَسْنَدَ — wa-, and + asnada, lean, rest (something on) (IV); 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he leaned'
وَأَصْلُ: و + أَصْل — wa-, and + aṣl, origin, root (m.), nominative, in construct; 'and the root of'
وَأَمَرَأَنْ: و + أَمَرَ + أَنْ — wa-, and + amara, command (3rd m. sg. perfect) + an, that (printed as one word); 'and he commanded that'
وَارْحَمْ: و + ارْحَمْ — wa-, and + irḥam, have mercy on; imperative of raḥima; 'and have mercy on'
وَاقِدُونَ: و + اقِدُون — wa-, and (here part of the form) wāqidūna, as printed (probably for mūqidūna 'kindling'), active part. m. pl. nominative; 'kindling'
وَالْأَوْلَادِ: و + الـ + أَوْلَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + awlād, children (pl. of walad), genitive; 'and the children'
وَالْبَنَاتُ: و + الـ + بَنَات — wa-, and + al-, the + banāt, girls (pl. of bint), nominative; 'and the girls'
وَالْمَوَاشِطِ: و + الـ + مَوَاشِط — wa-, and + al-, the + mawāshiṭ, bridal hairdressers (pl. of māshiṭa); 'and the bridal attendants'
وَبَهَاءٌ: و + بَهَاء — wa-, and + bahāʾ, radiance, splendour (m.), nominative; 'and radiance'
وَتَحْتَجُّ: و + تَحْتَجُّ — wa-, and + taḥtajju, iḥtajja 'plead, make an excuse' (VIII); 2nd m. sg. imperfect; 'and you plead'
وَجَا: و + جَا — wa-, and + jā (colloquial for jāʾa), come; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and (it) came'
وَجَمَالٌ: و + جَمَال — wa-, and + jamāl, comeliness, grace (m.), nominative; 'and grace'
وَحَبْوَةِ: و + حَبْوَة — wa-, by (wāw of oath) + ḥabwa, as printed (apparently for ḥayāt 'life'), in construct, genitive; 'by the life of'
وَحَدَّثْتُهُ: و + حَدَّثْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥaddathtu, ḥaddatha 'speak to' (II), 1st sg. perfect, with 'him'; 'and I spoke to him'
وَحَدْبَةٍ: و + حَدْبَة — wa-, and + ḥadba, hump (f.), genitive after بِ; 'and a hump'
وَحَمْلَ: و + حَمْل — wa-, and + ḥaml, pregnancy (m.), accusative; 'and the pregnancy of'
وَرَاءِهَا: وَرَاءِ + هَا — warāʾ, behind (m.), with 'it', genitive after مِنْ; 'behind it'
وَعُمْرُهَا: و + عُمْرُ + هَا — wa-, and + ʿumr, age (m.), nominative, with 'her'; 'and her age'
وَقَدٌّ: و + قَدّ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m.), nominative; 'and stature'
وَكَمَالٌ: و + كَمَال — wa-, and + kamāl, perfection (m.), nominative; 'and perfection'
وَلَدَتْهَا: و + لَدَتْ + هَا — walada, bear, give birth to; 3rd f. sg. perfect, with 'her' (the initial و is the root letter, not 'and'); 'she bore her'
وَهِىَ: و + هِىَ — wa-, and + hiya, she (printed with yā); 'and she'
وَوِلَادَةَ: و + وِلَادَة — wa-, and + wilāda, birth, childbirth (f.), accusative, in construct; 'and the birth of'
وَيَتَمَسْخَرُونَ: و + يَتَمَسْخَرُونَ — wa-, and + yatamaskharūna, tamaskhara 'mock' (colloquial, V); 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'and they mock'
وَيَعْمَلَ: و + يَعْمَلَ — wa-, and + yaʿmala, ʿamila 'make, do'; 3rd m. sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'and that (he) make'
وِلْدَ: wild, first part of وِلْدَان wildān, 'youths' (m. pl.; the print splits the word at the line end); with انِ 'youths of'
يَخْطُبُ: yakhṭubu, khaṭaba 'ask in marriage'; 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'he asks for'
شِ: shiʿr (poetry), first fragment — the print leaves a dash where the ʿayn was lost, شِ—رًا for شِعْرًا; read the two fragments together as 'in verse'
رًا: shiʿr (poetry), final fragment — the print's شِ—رًا stands for شِعْرًا, acc. 'in verse' (see شِ)
حَكَٰي: حَكَى — ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); printed حكي, read with dagger alif; 'he told'
لِلْجِنِّيَّةِ: لِـ + الـ + جِنِّيَّة — li-, to (prep.; marks the person told); jinniyya, she-jinni (f., gen.); 'to the jinniyya'
كِتَابَهَا: كِتَاب + هَا — kitāb, writing, here the marriage-contract (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her contract'
السَّائِسِ: الـ + سَائِس — sāʾis, groom of horses, stableman (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the groom'
شَبِيهًا: شَبِيه — shabīh, like, match, equal (m., acc. indef.); 'a match'
الْجِنِّيَّةُ: الـ + جِنِّيَّة — jinniyya, she-jinni (f., nom.); 'the jinniyya'
فَرَدَّهَا: فَ + رَدَّ + هَا — fa-, and (narrative sequence); radda, to return, turn back, answer (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and he answered her'
فَإِنَّهُمَا: فَ + إِنَّ + هُمَا — fa- (after ammā it opens the main clause; elsewhere 'for, since') + inna, indeed + -humā, the two of them (acc. dual); 'the two of them'
أَخَوَاتٌ: أَخَوَات — akhawāt, sisters (f. pl., nom.), here loosely 'siblings'
وَأَوْلَادُ: وَ + أَوْلَاد — wa-, and; awlād, sons, children (pl. of walad, nom. in annexation); 'and sons of'
يَاخَسَارَ: يَا + خَسَار — yā, O (vocative); khasār, loss, pity (m.); 'O the loss of'; the printed word divides oddly (see the note)
تَهَامَعَ: ت + هَا + مَعَ — probably the -t of khasāra-t-hā fallen onto the next word, + -hā, her + maʿa, with (prep.); 'her with'
يَاخِي: يَا + أَخ + ي — yā, O (vocative); akh, brother (m.) + -ī, my; 'O my brother'
دَعْنَا: دَعَ + نَا — daʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let (verb I, imperative m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'let us', with a following jussive
نَدْخُلْ: دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, 1 pl. jussive after daʿnā); 'we enter'
وَنَحْمِلْهُ: وَ + نَحْمِلْ + هُ — wa-, and; ḥamala, to carry, lift (verb I, 1 pl. jussive) + -hu, him; 'and we carry him'
وَنَرُوحْ: وَ + نَرُوحْ — wa-, and; rāḥa/yarūḥu, to go, go off (verb I, 1 pl. jussive, written with a long ū); 'and we go'
وَنَنْظُرْ: وَ + نَنْظُرْ — wa-, and; naẓara, to look (verb I, 1 pl. jussive); 'and we look'
صَوَابٌ: صَوَاب — ṣawāb, right, correct (m., nom. indef.; adj.); 'right'
الرَّأْيِ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, plan (m., gen. after min, in apposition to hādhā); 'the opinion'
أَحْمِلُهُ: أَحْمِلُ + هُ — ḥamala, to carry (verb I, imperf. 1 sg. indic.) + -hu, him; 'I carry him'
حَمَلَهُ: حَمَلَ + هُ — ḥamala, to carry (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'he carried him'
وَطَارَبِهِ: وَ + طَارَ + بِـ + هِ — wa-, and; ṭāra, to fly (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); bi-, with (prep.; ṭāra bi-, 'fly off with') + -hi, him; 'and flew with him'
رِكَابِهِ: رِكَاب + هِ — rikāb, stirrup (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his stirrup'
تُحَاذِيهِ: تُحَاذِي + هِ — ḥādhā (III), to be abreast of, keep level with (imperf. 3 f. sg.) + -hi, him; 'keeping abreast of him'
مِصْرَوَحَطَّهُ: مِصْر + وَ + حَطَّ + هُ — Miṣr, Egypt / Cairo (gen., diptote); wa-, and; ḥaṭṭa, to set down (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; the print joins two words: 'Miṣr, and set him down'
مَصْطَبَةٍ: مَصْطَبَة — maṣṭaba, bench, stone seat (f., gen. indef.); 'a bench'
وَنَبَّهَهُ: وَ + نَبَّهَ + هُ — wa-, and; nabbaha (II), to wake, rouse (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and woke him'
عَلَٰي: عَلَى — ʿalā, on, upon (prep.); printed علي, read with dagger alif; 'upon'
لَايَجِدُ: لَا + يَجِدُ — lā, not (negative particle) + wajada, to find (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); printed as one word; 'not finding / he finds not'
يَعِيطَ: عَيَّطَ — ʿayyaṭa, to shout, cry out (colloquial; here subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an); 'to cry out'
فَوَكَزَهُ: فَ + وَكَزَ + هُ — fa-, and, then; wakaza, to jab, punch (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and jabbed him'
بِحُلَّةٍ: بِـ + حُلَّة — bi-, with (prep.; after atā 'bring': the thing brought); ḥulla, robe, suit of clothes (f., gen. indef.); 'with a robe'
فَاخِرَةٍ: فَاخِرَة — fākhira, splendid, magnificent (f. adj., gen. indef.); 'splendid'
وَأَوْقَدَ: وَ + أَوْقَدَ — wa-, and; awqada (IV), to kindle, light (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and lit'
جِبْتُكَ: جِبْ + تُ + كَ — jib-, colloquial for ji'-, 'bring' (jāʾa; perf. stem) + -tu, I (subject) + -ka, you; 'I brought you'
الشَّمْعَةَ: الـ + شَمْعَة — shamʿa, candle (f., acc.); 'the candle'
وَاخْتَلِطْ: وَ + اخْتَلِطْ — wa-, and; ikhtalaṭa (VIII), to mingle (imperative m. sg.); 'and mingle'
بِالنَّاسِ،: بِـ + الـ + نَاس — bi-, with (prep.; ikhtalaṭa bi-, 'mingle with') ; nās, people (m. collective, gen.); 'with the people'; the comma is printed
تَنْزِلْ: نَزَلَ — nazala, to come down, descend (verb I, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā); 'you descend'
تَصِلَ: وَصَلَ — waṣala, to arrive, reach (verb I, subjunctive 2 m. sg. after an); 'you arrive'
قَاعَةِ: قَاعَة — qāʿa, hall (f., gen. in annexation); 'hall of'
الْعَرُوسَةِ: الـ + عَرُوسَة — ʿarūsa, bride (f., gen.); 'the bride'
فَاسْبِقْ: فَ + اسْبِقْ — fa-, then, so; sabaqa, to go ahead, outstrip (verb I, imperative m. sg.); 'then get ahead'
وَادْخُلِ: وَ + ادْخُلِ — wa-, and; dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperative m. sg.; -i linking vowel before the article); 'and enter'
تَخْشَ: خَشِيَ — khashiya, to fear (verb I, jussive 2 m. sg. after lam); 'you fear'
دَخَلْتَ: دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you entered'
فَقِفْ: فَ + قِفْ — fa-, then; waqafa, to stand, stop (verb I, imperative m. sg.); 'then stand'
يَمِينِ: يَمِين — yamīn, right (side) (m., gen. in annexation); 'right of'
الْعَرِيسِ: الـ + عَرِيس — ʿarīs, bridegroom (m., gen.); 'the bridegroom'
مَاجَاءَ: مَا + جَاءَ — mā, that, which (relative / conj. making kulla mā 'whenever') + jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'comes'
كَ: كَ — -ka, you (object pron.), printed as a separate word after jāʾa; 'to you'
الْمَوَاشِطُ: الـ + مَوَاشِط — mawāshiṭ, hairdressers, women who adorn a bride (pl. of māshiṭa, nom.); 'the dressers'
وَالْمَغَانِي: وَ + الـ + مَغَانِي — wa-, and; maghānī, singing-women (f. pl. of mughanniya; nom.); 'and the singing-women'
وَالدَّايَاتُ: وَ + الـ + دَايَات — wa-, and; dāyāt, nurses, midwives (pl. of dāya, nom.); 'and the nurses'
حُطَّ: حَطَّ — ḥaṭṭa, to put, place (verb I, imperative m. sg.); 'put'
جَيْبِكَ: جَيْب + كَ — jayb, pocket (m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your; 'your pocket'
تَجِدْهُ: تَجِدْ + هُ — wajada, to find (verb I, jussive 2 m. sg., as a result clause) + -hu, it; 'you will find it'
مَلْآنَ: مَلْآن — malʾān, full (adj., m., acc. diptote, in annexation); 'full of'
فَاكْمُشْ: فَ + اكْمُشْ — fa-, then; kamasha, to grab a handful (colloquial; verb I, imperative m. sg.); 'then grab a handful'
وَلَاتَتَوَهَّمْ: وَ + لَا + تَتَوَهَّمْ — wa-, and; lā, not (prohibitive particle with the jussive; printed joined to the verb); tawahhama (V), to imagine (jussive 2 m. sg.); 'and do not imagine'
لَاتُدْخِلُ: لَا + تُدْخِلُ — lā, not (negative particle; printed joined to the verb) + adkhala (IV), to put in (imperf. 2 m. sg. indic.); 'you do not put in'
إِلَّاتَجِدُهُ: إِلَّا + تَجِدُ + هُ — illā, except, unless (particle of exception) + wajada, to find (imperf. 2 m. sg.) + -hu, it; printed as one word; 'without finding it'
فَنَقِّطْ: فَ + نَقِّطْ — fa-, then; naqqaṭa (II), to give coins as a gift, tip (imperative m. sg.); 'then tip'
بِالْحَفْنَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حَفْنَة — bi-, with (prep.; instrument, 'by means of'); ḥafna, handful (f., gen.); 'with the handful'
وَتَوَكَّلْ: وَ + تَوَكَّلْ — wa-, and; tawakkala (V), to put one's trust, rely (imperative m. sg.); 'and put your trust'
خَلَقَكَ: خَلَقَ + كَ — khalaqa, to create (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'created you'
بِحَوْلِكَ: بِـ + حَوْل + كَ — bi-, by, through (prep.; means or agency); ḥawl, power, strength (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your power'
بِأَمْرِ: بِـ + أَمْر — bi-, by (prep.; agency); amr, command (m., gen. in annexation); 'by the command of' Also bi-, chosen by akhbara, 'to tell of', marking the thing told + amr, matter, affair: yukhbiranī bi-amri al-ṣabiyyati, 'tell me about the girl' (Night 188).
تُرَٰي: تُرَى — turā, to be thought, to appear (passive of ra'ā, imperf. 3/2); yā turā, 'I wonder'; printed تري
الْأَحْدَبَ: الـ + أَحْدَب — aḥdab, hunchback (m., acc.); 'the hunchback'
رَاكِبَ: رَاكِب — rākib, riding, rider (active participle of rakiba, m., acc. in annexation; circumstantial); 'riding'
وَالصُّورَةِ: وَ + الـ + صُورَة — wa-, and; ṣūra, form, appearance (f., gen.); 'and the form'
الْحَسَنَةِ: الـ + حَسَنَة — ḥasana, beautiful, fine (f. adj., gen.); 'the beautiful'
ذَكَرْنَا: ذَكَرَ + نَا — dhakara, to mention (verb I, perf.) + -nā, we; 'we mentioned'
الطَّرْبُوشُ: الـ + طَرْبُوش — ṭarbūsh, tarbush, fez (m., nom.); 'the tarbush'
وَالشَّاشُ: وَ + الـ + شَاش — wa-, and; shāsh, muslin cloth wound as a turban (m., nom.); 'and the muslin'
وَالْفَرَجِيَّةُ: وَ + الـ + فَرَجِيَّة — wa-, and; farajiyya, a long wide-sleeved robe (f., nom.); 'and the farajiyya-robe'
الْمَنْسُوجَةُ: الـ + مَنْسُوجَة — mansūja, woven (passive participle of nasaja, f., nom. adj.); 'the woven'
بِالذَّهَبِ: بِـ + الـ + ذَهَب — bi-, with (prep.; of the material); dhahab, gold (m., gen.); 'with gold'
مَاشِيًا: مَاشِي — māshī, walking (active participle of mashā, m., acc. indef.); 'walking'
الزِّينَةِ: الـ + زِينَة — zīna, adornment, festive display (f., gen. after fī); 'the procession'
وَقَفَتِ: وَقَفَ + تِ — waqafa, to stop (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'stopped'
وَالنَّاسُ: وَ + الـ + نَاس — wa-, and (circumstantial); nās, people (m. collective, nom.); 'and the people'; here: plain 'and', opening a saying: wa-al-nāsu bi-al-nāsi, 'and people are by people'
يُنَقِّطُ: نَقَّطَ — naqqaṭa (II), to give coins as a gift (imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'he tips'
وَيَحُطُّ: وَ + يَحُطُّ — wa-, and; ḥaṭṭa, to put (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and puts'
جَيْبِهِ: جَيْب + هِ — jayb, pocket (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his pocket'
يَلْقَاهُ: لَقِيَ + هُ — laqiya, to find, meet (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'he finds it'
فَيَكْمُشُ: فَ + يَكْمُشُ — fa-, and so; kamasha, to grab a handful (colloquial; imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'and grabs'
وَيَرْمِي: وَ + يَرْمِي — wa-, and; ramā, to throw (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'and throws'
الطَّارِ: الـ + طَار — ṭār, tambourine, frame-drum (m., gen. after fī); 'the tambourine'
الْمُغَنِّيَةِ: الـ + مُغَنِّيَة — mughanniya, singing-woman, female singer (f., gen.); 'the singing-woman'
فَيَمْلَأُ: فَ + يَمْلَأُ — fa-, and so; malaʾa, to fill (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'and fills'
الطَّارَ: الـ + طَار — ṭār, tambourine (m., acc.); 'the tambourine'
فَاخْتَرَعَتْ: فَ + اخْتَرَعَ + تْ — fa-, and; ikhtaraʿa (VIII), to originate, invent (perf. 3 f. sg.); the form is obscure here (see the note); 'and (were) invented'
عُقُولُ: عُقُول — ʿuqūl, minds, wits (pl. of ʿaql, nom. in annexation); 'minds of'
فَرَدَّتِ: فَ + رَدَّ + تِ — fa-, and; radda, to turn back, send back (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'and turned back'
وَمَنَعُوهُمْ: وَ + مَنَعَ + وا + هُمْ — wa-, and; manaʿa, to prevent, hold back (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hum, them; 'and they held them back'
عَمَّرَنَا: عَمَّرَ + نَا — ʿammara (II), to make prosperous, fill (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'he enriched us'
بِإِحْسَانِهِ: بِـ + إِحْسَان + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.); iḥsān, kindness, bounty (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his bounty'
نَجْلِي: جَلَا — jalā, to unveil, display a bride (verb I, imperf. 1 pl. indic.); 'we unveil'
الْعَرُوسَةَ: الـ + عَرُوسَة — ʿarūsa, bride (f., acc.); 'the bride'
وَأَجْلَسُوهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + وا + هُ — wa-, and; ajlasa (IV), to seat (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and seated him'
وَاصْطَفَّتْ: وَ + اصْطَفَّ — wa-, and; iṣṭaffa (VIII), to line up, form rows (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and lined up'
نِسَاءِ: نِسَاء — nisāʾ, women, wives (pl., gen. in annexation); 'women of'
وَالْوُزَرَاءِ: وَ + الـ + وُزَرَاء — wa-, and; wuzarāʾ, viziers (pl. of wazīr, gen.); 'and the viziers'
شَمْعَةٌ: شَمْعَة — shamʿa, candle (f., nom. indef.); 'a candle'
ضَارِبَةَ: ضَارِبَة — ḍāriba, striking (active participle of ḍaraba, f., acc. in annexation; circumstantial); 'striking, drawing'
وَهُنَّ: وَ + هُنَّ — wa-, and; hunna, they (f. pl. pron.); 'and they'
صُفُوفٌ: صُفُوف — ṣufūf, rows, ranks (pl. of ṣaff, nom. indef.); 'rows'
الْمِنَصَّةِ: الـ + مِنَصَّة — minaṣṣa, dais, platform (f., gen.); 'the dais'
الْعَرُوسَةُ: الـ + عَرُوسَة — ʿarūsa, bride (f., nom.); 'the bride'
نَظَرَتِ: نَظَرَ + تِ — naẓara, to look at (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'looked at'
الْهِلَالُ: الـ + هِلَال — hilāl, crescent, new moon (m., nom.); 'the crescent'
فَمِلْنَ: فَ + مَالَ + نَ — fa-, and; māla, to incline, lean toward (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they inclined'
لِلنِّسَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + نِسَاء — li-, to (prep.; marks those addressed); nisāʾ, women (pl., gen.); 'to the women'
الْحَاضِرَاتِ: الـ + حَاضِرَات — ḥāḍirāt, present (f. pl. adj., gen.); 'the present ones'
اعْلَمْنَ: عَلِمَ + نَ — ʿalima, to know (verb I, imperative f. pl.); 'know (you women)'
مَانَقَّطَنَا: مَا + نَقَّطَ + نَا — mā, not (negative particle) + naqqaṭa (II), to give coins as a gift (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; printed as one word; 'he did not tip us'
تُقَصِّرْنَ: قَصَّرَ + نَ — qaṣṣara (II), to fall short, be remiss (jussive 2 f. pl.); 'you fall short'
وَأَطِعْنَهُ: وَ + أَطِعْنَ + هُ — wa-, and; aṭāʿa (IV), to obey (imperative f. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and obey him'
فَازْدَحَمَتِ: فَ + ازْدَحَمَ + تِ — fa-, and; izdaḥama (VIII), to crowd (perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'and crowded'
بِالشَّمْعِ: بِـ + الـ + شَمْع — bi-, with (prep.; 'bearing, with'); shamʿ, candles, wax (m. collective, gen.); 'with the candles'
نَظَرْنَ: نَظَرَ + نَ — naẓara, to look (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'they looked'
وَحَسَدْنَهُ: وَ + حَسَدَ + نَ + هُ — wa-, and; ḥasada, to envy (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and envied him'
تَوَدُّأَنْ: تَوَدُّ + أَنْ — wadda, to wish, long (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg. indic.) + an, that (particle with the subjunctive); printed as one word; 'she wishes to'
تَكُونَ: كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb I, subjunctive 3 f. sg. after an); 'she be' Also 2ms, 'you be': an takūna muʿāwinī, 'that you be my helper'.
حِضْنِهِ: حِضْن + هِ — ḥiḍn, lap, embrace (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his arms'
فَأَرْخَيْنَ: فَ + أَرْخَى + نَ — fa-, and; arkhā (IV), to let down, let fall (perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they let down'
وُجُوهِهِنَّ: وُجُوه + هِنَّ — wujūh, faces (pl. of wajh, gen. after ʿalā) + -hinna, their (f.); 'their faces'
عَنْهُنَّ: عَنْ + هُنَّ — ʿan, from (prep.) + -hunna, them (f.); 'from them'
الْأَلْبَابُ: الـ + أَلْبَاب — albāb, minds, wits (pl. of lubb, nom.); 'the wits'
وَقُلْنَ: وَ + قَالَ + نَ — wa-, and; qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they said'
هَنِيأً: هَنِيء — hanīʾ, wholesome, happy (adj., acc. indef., used as an exclamation: 'happy!')
دَعَوْنَ: دَعَا + نَ — daʿā, to pray, invoke (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'they prayed'
الْمَلِيحَةَ: الـ + مَلِيحَة — malīḥa, the fair one (f., acc., object of the verbal noun); 'the fair one'
وَصِرْنَ: وَ + صَارَ + نَ — wa-, and; ṣāra, to become (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they became'
لِبَدْرِالدِّينِ: لِـ + بَدْر + الـ + دِين — li-, for (prep.; daʿā li-, 'pray for'); Badr al-Dīn (gen.), printed as one word; 'for Badr al-Dīn'
الْمَغَانِيَ: الـ + مَغَانِي — maghānī, singing-women (f. pl.; acc. after inna); 'the singing-women'
ضَرَبْنَ: ضَرَبَ + نَ — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'they struck'
بِالدُّفُوفِ: بِـ + الـ + دُفُوف — bi-, with (prep.; ḍaraba bi-, 'strike with / beat'); dufūf, tambourines (pl. of duff, gen.); 'the tambourines'
وَزَعَقْنَ: وَ + زَعَقَ + نَ — wa-, and; zaʿaqa, to cry out shrilly (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they cried out'
بِالْمَوَاصِلِ: بِـ + الـ + مَوَاصِل — bi-, with (prep.; 'with, in') ; mawāṣil, a kind of song or strain (pl.; obscure, perhaps 'joined' strains); 'with the mawāṣil'
وَأَقْبَلَتِ: وَ + أَقْبَلَ + تِ — wa-, and; aqbala (IV), to approach, come forward (perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'and came forward'
طَيَّبُوهَا: طَيَّبَ + وا + هَا — ṭayyaba (II), to perfume (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'they perfumed her'
وَعَطَّرُوهَا: وَ + عَطَّرَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and; ʿaṭṭara (II), to scent (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and scented her'
وَحَسَّنُوا: وَ + حَسَّنَ + وا — wa-, and; ḥassana (II), to beautify (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and beautified'
وَبَخَّرُوهَا: وَ + بَخَّرَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and; bakhkhara (II), to fumigate with incense (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and fumigated her'
وَأَلْبَسُوهَا: وَ + أَلْبَسَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and; albasa (IV), to clothe someone in (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and clothed her'
الْحُلِيَّ: الـ + حُلِيّ — ḥuliyy, jewellery, ornaments (pl. of ḥalī, acc.); 'the jewels'
وَالْحُلَلَ: وَ + الـ + حُلَل — wa-, and; ḥulal, robes (pl. of ḥulla, acc.); 'and the robes'
لِبَاسِ: لِبَاس — libās, clothing (m., gen. in annexation); 'clothing of'
الْأَكَاسِرَةِ: الـ + أَكَاسِرَة — akāsira, the Khosrows, Persian kings (pl. of kisrā, gen.); 'the Chosroes'
جُمْلَةِ: جُمْلَة — jumla, totality, sum (f., gen. in annexation); 'the sum of'; min jumlati, 'among'
ثَوْبٌ: ثَوْب — thawb, garment, robe (m., nom. indef.); 'a robe'
صُوَرُ: صُوَر — ṣuwar, images, figures (pl. of ṣūra, nom. in annexation); 'images of'
الْوُحُوشِ: الـ + وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh, gen.); 'the beasts'
مَسْبُولٌ: مَسْبُول — masbūl, let down, hanging loose (passive participle of sabala, m., nom. indef.); 'let down'
حَوَائِجِهَا: حَوَائِج + هَا — ḥawāʾij, things, garments (pl. of ḥāja, gen. in annexation) + -hā, her; 'her garments'
وَقَلَّدُوهَا: وَ + قَلَّدَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and; qallada (II), to put a necklace on someone (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and they put a necklace on her'
بِعِقْدٍ: بِـ + عِقْد — bi-, with (prep.; qallada bi-, 'adorn with'); ʿiqd, necklace (m., gen. indef.); 'with a necklace'
يَمَنِيٍّ: يَمَنِيّ — yamanī, Yemeni (adj. m., gen. indef.); 'Yemeni'
يُسَاوِى: سَاوَى — sāwā (III), to be worth, equal (imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); printed with final ى; 'is worth'
الْأُلُوفَ: الـ + أُلُوف — ulūf, thousands (pl. of alf, acc.); 'the thousands'
حَوَى: حَوَى — ḥawā, to contain, hold (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'it held'
فَصِّ: فَصّ — faṣṣ, gem, stone of a ring or setting (m., gen. in annexation); 'stone of'
جَوْهَرٍ: جَوْهَر — jawhar, jewel, gem (m., gen. indef.); 'a jewel'
مَاحَازَ: مَا + حَازَ — mā, not (negative particle) + ḥāza, to possess (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'did not possess'
مِثْلَهُ: مِثْل + هُ — mithl, the like (m., acc. in annexation) + -hu, it; 'the like of it'
تُبَّعٌ: تُبَّع — Tubbaʿ, title of the old Himyarite kings of South Arabia (m., nom.); 'Tubbaʿ'
وَالْعَرُوسَةُ: وَ + الـ + عَرُوسَة — wa-, and; ʿarūsa, bride (f., nom.); 'and the bride'
حُورِيَّةٌ: حُورِيَّة — ḥūriyya, houri, nymph of Paradise (f., nom. indef.); 'a houri'
خَلَقَهَا: خَلَقَ + هَا — khalaqa, to create (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'created her'
بَهِيَّةً: بَهِيَّة — bahiyya, radiant, splendid (f., acc. indef.; circumstantial); 'radiant'
وَأَحْدَقُوا: وَ + أَحْدَقَ + وا — wa-, and; aḥdaqa (IV), to surround, encircle (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they surrounded'
فَصِرْنَ: فَ + صَارَ + نَ — fa-, and so; ṣāra, to become (verb I, perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they became'
كَالنُّجُومِ: كَـ + الـ + نُجُوم — ka-, like (prep. prefix, 'in the manner of'); nujūm, stars (pl. of najm, gen.); 'like the stars'
كَلْقَمَرِ: كَـ + الـ + قَمَر — ka-, like (prep. prefix); al-qamar, the moon (m., gen.), the article's alif not printed; 'like the moon'
انْجَلَا: انْجَلَى — injalā (VII), to clear, be revealed (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'it cleared'
عِنْدَالْغَيْمِ: عِنْدَ + الـ + غَيْم — ʿinda, at, among (prep., acc.); ghaym, clouds (m. collective, gen.); printed as one word; 'out of the clouds'
الْبَصْرِيُّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — baṣrī, of Basra, Basran (adj. m., nom.); 'the Basran'
نَاظِرُونَ: نَاظِرُون — nāẓirūn, looking (active participle of naẓara, m. pl. nom.); 'looking'
فَخَطَرَتِ: فَ + خَطَرَ + تِ — fa-, and; khaṭara, to walk with a swaying, proud gait (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; -i before the article); 'and swayed forward'
وَتَمَايَلَتْ: وَ + تَمَايَلَ + تْ — wa-, and; tamāyala (VI), to sway (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and swayed'
السَّائِسُ: الـ + سَائِس — sāʾis, groom of horses (m., nom.); 'the groom'
الْأَحْدَبُ: الـ + أَحْدَب — aḥdab, hunchbacked (adj., nom.); 'the hunchback'
لِيُقَبِّلَهَا: لِـ + يُقَبِّلَ + هَا — li-, in order to (particle with the subjunctive: purpose); qabbala (II), to kiss (subjunctive 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'to kiss her'
فَأَعْرَضَتْ: فَـ + أَعْرَضَتْ — fa-, and so, then; aʿraḍat, turn away (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.; takes ʿan, 'from'); 'and she turned away'
وَانْفَتَلَتْ: وَ + انْفَتَلَتْ — wa-, and; infatalat, twist round, turn aside (VII, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she twisted round'
رَأَوْهَا: رَأَوْا + هَا — raʾā, see (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'they saw her'
مَالَتْ: mālat — lean, incline (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'she inclined'
نَحْوَحَسَنٍ: نَحْوَ + حَسَنٍ — naḥwa, towards (acc. noun used as prep.) + ḥasan, Ḥasan (gen.); the print runs the two words together; 'towards Ḥasan'
ضَجَّتِ: ضَجَّتِ — ḍajjat, cry out, clamour (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.; the final kasra links to al-); 'cried out' (feminine verb with the collective al-nās)
وَصَرَخَتِ: وَ + صَرَخَتِ — wa-, and; ṣarakhat, shriek, scream (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'and shrieked'
الْمَغَانِي: الـ + مَغَانِي — al-, the + maghānī, singing-women (f. pl.; see the note); 'the singing-women'
وَكَمَشَ: وَ + كَمَشَ — wa-, and; kamasha, gather up, clutch a handful (verb I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and grabbed a handful'
طِيرَانِ: ṭīrān — frame-drums, tambourines (pl. of ṭār; gen. in the construct); 'the tambourines of ...'
نَشْتَهِي: nashtahī — desire, long for (verb VIII, imperf. 1 pl.); 'we desire'
فَتَبَسَّمَ: فَـ + تَبَسَّمَ — fa-, and so; tabassama, smile (V, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he smiled'
أَحْدَ: first half of أَحْدَقُوا, aḥdaqū (IV, ḥ-d-q, 'surround, encircle'; 3 m. pl. perf.), which the print splits after the د
قُوا: second half of أَحْدَقُوا, aḥdaqū, 'they surrounded'
قِرْدُو: qird — ape, monkey (m.); the final و is the print's addition, either a slip or a fossil ending, for qirdan; 'an ape'
قَدُوا: second half of أَوْقَدُوا, awqadū, 'they lit'
صَوْتٌ: ṣawt — voice, sound (m., nom. indef.); 'a voice'
الظَّلَامِ: الـ + ظَّلَام — al-, the + ẓalām, darkness (m., gen. after fī); 'the darkness'
وَيَنْظُرُ: وَ + يَنْظُرُ — wa-, and; yanẓuru, look, consider (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he looks'
شُمُوعٌ: shumūʿ — candles (pl. of shamʿa; nom. indef.)
أَيْدِي: aydī — hands (pl. of yad; gen. after fī, in the construct)
مُحْدِقِينَ: muḥdiqīn — surrounding, encircling (active part. IV of ḥ-d-q, m. pl. acc., ḥāl)
الْمُوقَدَةَ: الـ + مُوقَدَة — al-, the + mūqada, kindled, lit (passive part. IV, f. sg.; acc.); 'the lit (ones)'
تَحَيَّرَ: taḥayyara — be bewildered, be at a loss (V, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'he was bewildered'
ابْنَتَ: ibnat — daughter (f., acc., object; in the construct, written with ت rather than ة); 'daughter of'
وَاسْتَبْشَرَ: وَ + اسْتَبْشَرَ — wa-, and; istabshara, be glad at good news, take heart (X, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and was glad'
وَقَدْأَ: وَ + قَدْ + أَ — wa-, and; qad, indeed, already (with the perfect, 'had'); plus the alif of the following verb (e.g. أَشْرَقَ, أَقْبَلَ), which the print runs on to qad
شْرَقَ: the rest of أَشْرَقَ, ashraqa, shine, be radiant (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.), whose alif the print has attached to the word before; 'it shone' (her face)
بِالنُّورِ: بِـ + الـ + نُّورِ — bi-, with, in (prep. of means); al-, the + nūr, light (m., gen.); 'with light'
وَأَزْهَرَ: وَ + أَزْهَرَ — wa-, and; azhara, bloom, shine brightly (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and bloomed'
لَاسِيَّمَا: لَا + سِيَّ + مَا — lā, no + siyya, equal, like + mā, what; lā siyyamā, especially, above all (one word here)
الْبَدْلَةُ: الـ + بَدْلَة — al-, the + badla, suit of clothes, outfit (f., nom.); 'the suit'
الْأَطْلَسُ: الـ + أَطْلَس — al-, the + aṭlas, satin (m., nom., in apposition); 'the satin'
فَجَلَوْهَا: فَـ + جَلَوْا + هَا — fa-, and so; jalaw, display, unveil (a bride) (verb I, 3 m. pl. perf.) + -hā, her; 'and they displayed her'
خِلْعَةٍ: khilʿa — robe, dress given or worn as a mark of honour (f., gen. indef.); 'robe'
الطَّلْعَةِ: الـ + طَّلْعَة — al-, the + ṭalʿa, appearance, countenance (f., gen.); 'the aspect'
فَتَعَاجَبَتْ: فَـ + تَعَاجَبَتْ — fa-, and so; taʿājabat, marvel, show wonder (VI, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she preened'
وَأَذْهَاتْ: وَ + أَذْهَاتْ — wa-, and; the print's form of أَذْهَلَتْ, adhhalat, bewilder, daze (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she bewildered'
عُقُولَ: ʿuqūl — minds, wits (pl. of ʿaql; acc., in the construct); 'the minds of'
وَالرِّجَالِ: وَ + الـ + رِّجَالِ — wa-, and; al-, the + rijāl, men (pl. of rajul; gen.); 'and the men'
فَكَانَتْ: فَـ + كَانَتْ — fa-, and so; kānat, be (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she was'
الْمِفْضَالُ: الـ + مِفْضَال — al-, the + mifḍāl, very bountiful, generous (intensive adj. from faḍl; m., nom.)
شِـــــــعْـــــــرًا: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m.; acc. indef., adverbial); 'in verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
وَشَمْسٍ: وَ + شَمْسٍ — wa-, and (here 'and many a'); shams, sun (f., gen. after the wāw)
كَثِيبٍ: kathīb — sand-dune, heap of sand (m., gen.)
تَبَدَّتْ: tabaddat — appear, show oneself (V, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'she appeared'
جُلَّنَارِ: julnār — pomegranate blossom (Persian gul-anār; m., gen. in the construct); 'of pomegranate-blossom red'
سَقَتْنِي: سَقَتْ + نِي — saqat, give to drink (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.) + -nī, me; 'she gave me to drink'
رِيقَ: rīq — saliva, spittle (m., acc., in the construct)
خَمْرَتِهَا: خَمْرَة + هَا — khamra, wine (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her wine'
وَجَادَتْ: وَ + جَادَتْ — wa-, and; jādat, be generous, bestow (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she was generous'
بِوَجْنَتِهَا: بِـ + وَجْنَة + هَا — bi-, with (prep.; jāda bi- 'be lavish with'); wajna, cheek (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her cheek'
فَاطْفَتْ: فَـ + اطْفَتْ — fa-, and so; aṭfat, put out, extinguish (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.; the print omits the hamza of aṭfaʾat); 'and so she put out'
جُلَّ: julla — the greater part, most (m., acc., in the construct)
وَغَيَّرُوا: وَ + غَيَّرُوا — wa-, and; ghayyarū, change, alter (II, 3 m. pl. perf.); 'and they changed'
ثَوْبًا: thawb — garment (m., acc. indef., second object); 'a garment'
فَطَلَعَتْ: فَـ + طَلَعَتْ — fa-, and so; ṭalaʿat, go up, rise, come forth (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she came forth'
وَخَدٍّنَا: وَ + خَدٍّ + نَا — wa-, and; khadd, cheek (m., gen. indef.) + nā-, the first part of نَاعِمٍ, nāʿim, which the print splits
عِمٍ: the second part of نَاعِمٍ, nāʿim, soft, delicate (active part., m., gen.); 'soft'
وَثَغْرٍ: وَ + ثَغْرٍ — wa-, and; thaghr, mouth, front teeth (m., gen. indef.); 'and a mouth'
وَنَهْدٍ: وَ + نَهْدٍ — wa-, and; nahd, breast, rising breast (m., gen. indef.); 'and a breast'
قَائِمٍ: qāʾim — standing, firm (active part., m., gen.)
رَابِيَةُ: rābiya — swelling, plump (active part. of rabā; f., nom., in the construct)
الْأَطْرٰفِ: الـ + أَطْرَاف — al-, the + aṭrāf, extremities, hands and feet (pl. of ṭaraf; gen.); the print drops the alif, which the dagger alif restores
وَالْمَعَاصِمِ: وَ + الـ + مَعَاصِمِ — wa-, and; al-, the + maʿāṣim, wrists (pl. of miʿṣam; gen.); 'and the wrists'
وَجَلَوْهَا: وَ + جَلَوْا + هَا — wa-, and; jalaw, display (the bride) (verb I, 3 m. pl. perf.) + -hā, her; 'and they displayed her'
الْخِلْعَهَ: الـ + خِلْعَة — al-, the + khilʿa, robe (f., acc.); the print writes the ending with ه here
أَصْحَابُ: aṣḥāb — owners, possessors, men of (pl. of ṣāḥib; nom., in the construct)
الْهِمَمِ: الـ + هِمَمِ — al-, the + himam, aspirations, resolves (pl. of himma; gen.)
شِـــــــعْـــــــرٌ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., nom. indef.); 'verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
اَقْبَلَتْ: aqbalat — approach, come on (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'she came on'
لَازَوَرْدِيَّةٍ: lāzawardiyya — lapis-lazuli (Persian lājward; nisba adjective, f., gen.); 'lapis-blue'
كَلَوْنِ: كَـ + لَوْنِ — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison, governs the genitive); lawn, colour (m., gen. in the construct); 'like the colour of'
فَتَامَّلْتُ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلْتُ — fa-, and so; taʾammaltu, gaze at, contemplate (V, 1 sg. perf.; the print omits the hamza); 'and I gazed'
الْغَلَالَةِ: الـ + غَلَالَةِ — al-, the + ghalāla, shift (f., gen.; the same word as ghulāla with the vowels changed)
قَمَرُ: qamar — moon (m., nom., in the construct); 'a moon of'; also nom., first part of the name Qamar al-Zamān: fa-waqaʿa Qamaru al-Zamāni, 'Qamar al-Zamān fell'
لَيَالِي: layālī — nights (pl. of layla; gen. in the construct)
الشِّتَاءِ: الـ + شِّتَاءِ — al-, the + shitāʾ, winter (m., gen.)
بِبَدْلَةٍ: بِـ + بَدْلَةٍ — bi-, for, in exchange for (prep.; ghayyara X bi-Y 'change X for Y'); badla, suit (f., gen. indef.); 'for a suit'
غَيْرِهَا: غَيْرِ + هَا — ghayr, other than, different from (m., gen., in the construct) + -hā, it; 'other than it', i.e. 'a different one'
وَلَثَّمُوهَا: وَ + لَثَّمُوا + هَا — wa-, and; laththamū, veil the lower face, muffle (II, 3 m. pl. perf.) + -hā, her; 'and they muffled her'
بِفَاضِلِ: بِـ + فَاضِلِ — bi-, with (prep. of means); fāḍil, surplus, what is left over (active part.; m., gen., in the construct); 'with the surplus of'
أَرْخَوْا: arkhaw — let down, let hang loose (IV, 3 m. pl. perf.); 'they let down'
ذَوَائِبَهَا: ذَوَائِبَ + هَا — dhawāʾib, locks, plaits (pl. of dhuʾāba; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her locks'
السُّودَ: الـ + سُّودَ — al-, the + sūd, black (pl. of aswad; acc.); 'the black (ones)'
الطِّوَالَ: الـ + طِّوَالَ — al-, the + ṭiwāl, long (pl. of ṭawīl; acc.); 'the long (ones)'
فَأَشْبَهَ: فَـ + أَشْبَهَ — fa-, and so; ashbaha, resemble (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and so resembled'
سَوَادُهَا: سَوَادُ + هَا — sawād, blackness (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her blackness'
وَطُولُهَا: وَ + طُولُ + هَا — wa-, and; ṭūl, length (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her length'
اعْتَكَرَ: iʿtakara — grow dense, be pitch-dark (VIII, 3 m. sg. perf.; said of night); 'had grown dense'
بِسِهَامِ: بِـ + سِهَامِ — bi-, with (prep. of means); sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm; gen., in the construct); 'with arrows of'
الْحَدَقِ: الـ + حَدَقِ — al-, the + ḥadaq, eyes, pupils (pl. of ḥadaqa; gen.); 'the eyes'
النَّافِثَةِ: الـ + نَّافِثَةِ — al-, the + nāfitha, blowing, casting a spell (active part., f., gen.; agrees with ḥadaq)
الثَّالِثَهَ: الـ + ثَّالِثَةَ — al-, the + thālitha, third (f., acc.); the print again writes the ending with ه
شِعْـــــــــــــــــرٌ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., nom. indef.); 'verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
وَمُلْتَثِمٌ: وَ + مُلْتَثِمٌ — wa-, and (here 'and many a'); multathim, muffled, veiled over the mouth (active part. VIII; m., nom. indef.); 'a muffled one'
بِالشَّعْرِ: بِـ + الـ + شَّعْرِ — bi-, with (prep. of means: 'muffled with'); al-, the + shaʿr, hair (m., gen.)
غَدَتْ: ghadat — go, become (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'it became'
فِتْنَةً: fitna — temptation, trial, seduction (f., acc. indef.)
شَبَّهْتُها: شَبَّهْتُ + ها — shabbahtu, liken, compare (II, 1 sg. perf.) + -hā, it; 'I likened it'
بِحُمَاتِ: بِـ + حُمَاتِ — bi-, to (prep.; shabbaha bi- 'liken to'); ḥumāt, stings (pl. of ḥuma; gen.) or perhaps 'guardians'; 'to stings'
سَتَرْتَ: satarta — veil, hide (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you have veiled'
لَانِ: لِـ + أَنِّي — li-, because (causal prep.) + annī, that I; the print gives lāni, shortened; 'because I'
سَتَــرْتُ: satarta — veil, hide (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you have veiled'
بِالظُّلُمَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + ظُّلُمَاتِ — bi-, with (prep. of means); al-, the + ẓulumāt, darknesses (pl. of ẓulma; gen.); 'with the darknesses'
فَأَقْبَلَتْ: فَـ + أَقْبَلَتْ — fa-, and so; aqbalat, come forward, approach (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she came forward'
كَالشَّمْسِ: كَـ + الـ + شَّمْسِ — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison, governs the genitive); al-, the + shams, sun (f.); 'like the sun'
الطَّالِعَةِ: الـ + طَّالِعَةِ — al-, the + ṭāliʿa, rising (active part. of ṭalaʿa; f., gen.); 'the rising'
وَتَلَفَّتَتْ: وَ + تَلَفَّتَتْ — wa-, and; talaffatat, turn the head, look about (V, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she turned about'
كَتَلَفُّةِ: كَـ + تَلَفُّةِ — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison); talaffuta, turning the head to look about (V verbal noun; the print writes ة where talaffut would have ت); 'like the turning about of'
الْغِزْلَانِ: الـ + غِزْلَانِ — al-, the + ghizlān, gazelles (pl. of ghazāl; gen.); 'the gazelles'
وَرَشَقَتِ: وَ + رَشَقَتِ — wa-, and; rashaqat, pelt, shoot at (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'and she pelted'
أَجْفَانِهَا: أَجْفَانِ + هَا — ajfān, eyelids (pl. of jafn; gen.) + -hā, her; 'her eyelids'
بِنِبَالٍ: بِـ + نِبَالٍ — bi-, with (prep. of means); nibāl, arrows (pl. of nabl; gen. indef.); 'with arrows'
الْوَاصِفُ: الـ + وَاصِفُ — al-, the + wāṣif, describer (active part. of waṣafa; m., nom.)
شِـــــــــــــعْــــــــــرٌ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., nom. indef.); 'verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
وَشَمْسُ: وَ + شَمْسُ — wa-, and; shams, sun (f., nom., in the construct); 'and a sun of'
تَنْظُرُها: تَنْظُرُ + ها — tanẓuru, look at (verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'you look at her'
تَزْهُو: tazhū — glow, be radiant and proud (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'she glows'
بِحُسْنِ: بِـ + حُسْنِ — bi-, with, in (prep. of accompaniment); ḥusn, beauty (m., gen., in the construct); 'with the beauty of'
زَانَهُ: زَانَ + هُ — zāna, adorn (verb I, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hu, it; 'adorned it'
خَفَــرُ: khafar — modesty, shyness (m., nom., subject of zāna); the print stretches the word with kashida
وَاجَهَتْ: wājahat — face, confront (III, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'she faced'
بِمُحَيَّاهَا: بِـ + مُحَيَّا + هَا — bi-, with (prep.; wājaha bi- 'confront with'); muḥayyā, face, countenance (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her face'
وَمَبْسِمِــها: وَ + مَبْسِمِ + ها — wa-, and; mabsim, smiling mouth (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her smiling mouth' (kashida in the print)
شَمْسَ: shams — sun (f., acc., object, in the construct) Also the name Shams al-Nahār, acc. as the subject of anna: anna Shamsa al-Nahāri, 'that Shams al-Nahār'. Also acc. after yā, the name being a construct: yā Shamsa al-Nahāri, 'O Shams al-Nahār'.
النَّهارِ: الـ + نَّهارِ — al-, the + nahār, day (m., gen.); 'of the day'
بِالْغَيْمِ: بِـ + الـ + غَيْمِ — bi-, with (prep. of means, 'by means of'); al-, the + ghaym, cloud (m., gen.); 'with cloud'
تَسْتَتِرُ: tastatiru — veil oneself, hide (VIII, imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'to hide itself'
الْخِلْعَةِ: الـ + خِلْعَةِ — al-, the + khilʿa, robe (f., gen.); 'the robe'
الْخَامِسَةِ: الـ + خَامِسَةِ — al-, the + khāmisa, fifth (f., gen.); 'the fifth'
كَالصَّبِيَّةِ: كَـ + الـ + صَّبِيَّةِ — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison, governs the genitive); al-, the + ṣabiyya, young girl (f.); 'like the young girl'
الْأَنِيسَةِ: الـ + أَنِيسَةِ — al-, the + anīsa, friendly, sociable, gentle (f., gen.); 'the sociable'
قَضِيبَ: qaḍīb — slender branch (m., acc., predicate of kaʾanna, in the construct); 'a branch of'
بَانٍ: bān — the ban tree (moringa), whose supple branch is a stock image of a slender body (m., gen.)
دَبَّتْ: dabbat — creep, crawl (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'crept'
عَقَارِبُهَا: عَقَارِبُ + هَا — ʿaqārib, scorpions (pl. of ʿaqrab; nom.) + -hā, her; 'her scorpions', the curled locks at her temples
وَأَبْدَتْ: وَ + أَبْدَتْ — wa-, and; abdat, show, reveal (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she showed'
عَجَائِبَهَا: عَجَائِبَ + هَا — ʿajāʾib, wonders, marvels (pl. of ʿajība; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her marvels'
وَهَزَّتْ: وَ + هَزَّتْ — wa-, and; hazzat, shake, make sway (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she shook'
أَرْدَافَهَا: أَرْدَافَ + هَا — ardāf, hips, buttocks (pl. of ridf; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her hips'
وَأَشْهَرَتْ: وَ + أَشْهَرَتْ — wa-, and; ashharat, bring into the open, display (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she displayed'
سَوَالِفَهَا: سَوَالِفَ + هَا — sawālif, side-locks, or the sides of the neck (pl. of sālifa; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her side-locks'
وَاصِفِيهَا: وَاصِفِي + هَا — wāṣifī, describers (pl. active part. of waṣafa, in the construct; the oblique -ī form, though it is the subject) + -hā, her; 'her describers'
شِـــــــــــعْـــــــــرٌ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., nom. indef.); 'verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
كَبَدْرِ: كَـ + بَدْرِ — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison, governs the genitive); badr, full moon (m., gen., in the construct); 'like the full moon of'
التِّمِّ: الـ + تِّمِّ — al-, the + timm, fullness, completion (m., gen.); 'the fullness'
لَيْلَةِ: layla — night (f., gen., in the construct); 'a night of'
السَّعْدِ: الـ + سَّعْدِ — al-, the + saʿd, good fortune, felicity (m., gen.); 'of good fortune'
مُنَعَّمَةَ: munaʿʿama — delicate, softly nurtured (II passive part., f., acc., ḥāl, in the construct); 'soft of'
الاَطْرَافِ: الـ + أَطْرَافِ — al-, the + aṭrāf, extremities, limbs (pl. of ṭaraf; gen.); the print marks the alif with fatḥa only
مَمْشُوقَــةَ: mamshūqa — slender, shapely (passive part. of mashaqa; f., acc., ḥāl, in the construct); the print stretches the word with kashida
لِها: لِـ + ها — li-, to, for (prep. of possession); -hā, her; 'she has' (the print marks only the lām)
مُقْلَةٌ: muqla — eye, the eyeball (f., nom. indef.); 'an eye'
تَسْبِي: tasbī — take captive, captivate (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'that captivates'
الْاَنَامَ: الـ + أَنَامَ — al-, the + anām, mankind, creatures (m., acc.); the print marks the alif with fatḥa only
بِحُسْنِها: بِـ + حُسْنِ + ها — bi-, with, by (prep. of means); ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'by her beauty'
حَكَتِ: ḥakat — imitate, resemble (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'it has imitated'
الْيَاقُوتَ: الـ + يَاقُوتَ — al-, the + yāqūt, ruby (m., acc.); 'the ruby'
حُمْرَةِ: ḥumra — redness (f., gen., in the construct); 'redness of'
تَحَدَّرُ: taḥaddaru — descend, hang down (V, imperf. 3 f. sg., short for tataḥaddaru); 'descends'
الرِّدْفِ: الـ + رِّدْفِ — al-, the + ridf, buttocks, hips (m., gen.); 'the hips'
اَسْوَدَ: aswad — black (m., acc., in the construct; here 'the black of'); 'her black'
شَعْرِها: شَعْرِ + ها — shaʿr, hair (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her hair'
فَإِيَّاكَ: فَـ + إِيَّاكَ — fa-, and so; iyyāka, beware, mind yourself (warning, 'you!' in the accusative); 'so beware'
وَالْحَيَّاتِ: وَ + الـ + حَيَّاتِ — wa-, and; here 'of' (iyyāka wa-X 'beware of X'); al-, the + ḥayyāt, snakes (pl. of ḥayya; acc.); 'of the snakes'
الْجَعْدِ: الـ + جَعْدِ — al-, the + jaʿd, curly (adj., m., gen.); 'the curly'
لَانَتِ: lānat — grow soft, supple (verb I root l-y-n, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'have softened'
الْاَعْطَافُ: الـ + أَعْطَافُ — al-, the + aʿṭāf, flanks, sides (pl. of ʿiṭf; nom.); the print marks the alif with fatḥa only
مِنْها: مِنْ + ها — min, from, of (prep.) + -hā, her; 'of her'
وَقَلْبُها: وَ + قَلْبُ + ها — wa-, and; qalb, heart (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her heart'
لِينِها: لِين + ها — līn, softness (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her softness'
اَقْسَى: aqsā — harder, more pitiless (elative of qāsin; m.); 'harder'
الْحَجَرِ: الـ + حَجَرِ — al-, the + ḥajar, stone (m., gen.); 'the stone'
الصَّلْدِ: الـ + صَّلْدِ — al-, the + ṣald, hard and smooth (adj., m., gen.); 'the hard'
وَتُرْسِلُ: وَ + تُرْسِلُ — wa-, and; tursilu, send, shoot (IV, imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she sends'
سَهْمَ: sahm — arrow (m., acc., in the construct); 'the arrow of'
اللَّحْظِ: الـ + لَّحْظِ — al-, the + laḥẓ, glance (m., gen.); 'the glance'
يُخْطِي: yukhṭī — miss, err (IV, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'it misses'
وَإِنْ: وَ + إِنْ — wa-, and, even; in, if (conditional); 'even if'
اعْتَنَقْنَا: iʿtanaqnā — embrace, throw one's arms around (VIII, perf. 1 pl.); 'we embrace'
وَالْتَزَمْتُ: وَ + الْتَزَمْتُ — wa-, and; iltazamtu, cling to, hold fast (VIII, perf. 1 sg.); 'and I cling to'
وِشَاحَها: وِشَاحَ + ها — wishāḥ, sash, jewelled belt (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her sash'
يُدَافِعُنِي: يُدَافِعُ + نِي — yudāfiʿu, push away, ward off (III, imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'pushes me away'
ضَمِّها: ضَمِّ + ها — ḍamm, clasping, embracing (m., verbal noun, gen.) + -hā, her; 'from clasping her'
حُسْنَها: حُسْنَ + ها — ḥusn, beauty (m., acc., vocative in the construct) + -hā, her; 'O her beauty'
فَاقَ: fāqa — surpass (verb I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'it has surpassed'
مُلَاحَــةٍ: mulāḥa — comeliness, beauty (f., gen. indef.); the print stretches the word with kashida
قَدَّها: قَدَّ + ها — qadd, stature, figure (m., acc., vocative) + -hā, her; 'O her figure'
اَزْرَيْتَ: azrayta — put to shame, disparage (IV, perf. 2 m. sg.; takes bi-); 'you have put to shame'
الْمُلْدِ: الـ + مُلْدِ — al-, the + muld, soft, tender (a plural form of amlad, 'soft, smooth', here of the branch; gen.); 'the tender'
السَّادِسَهَ: الـ + سَّادِسَةَ — al-, the + sādisa, sixth (f., acc.); the print writes the ending with ه here
فَأَزْرَتْ: فَـ + أَزْرَتْ — fa-, and so; azrat, put to shame, outdo (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she put to shame'
بِقَوَامِهَا: بِـ + قَوَامِ + هَا — bi-, with, by (prep. of means); qawām, stature, shapely figure (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'by her figure'
الصَّعْدَةَ: الـ + صَّعْدَةَ — al-, the + ṣaʿda, a straight lance-shaft, spear (f., acc.); 'the lance'
السَّمْرَاءَ: الـ + سَّمْرَاءَ — al-, the + samrāʾ, brown, tawny (f., acc.); 'the brown'
وَفَاقَتْ: وَ + فَاقَتْ — wa-, and; fāqat, surpass (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she surpassed'
بِجَمَالِهَا: بِـ + جَمَالِ + هَا — bi-, with, by (prep. of means); jamāl, beauty (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'by her beauty'
مِلَاحَ: milāḥ — fair ones, beauties (pl. of malīḥ; acc., object, in the construct); 'the fair ones of'
الْآفَاقِ: الـ + آفَاقِ — al-, the + āfāq, horizons, regions of the earth (pl. of ufq; gen.); 'the horizons'
وَأَزْهَرَتْ: وَ + أَزْهَرَتْ — wa-, and; azharat, bloom, shine brightly (IV, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she bloomed'
بِإِشْرَاقِ: بِـ + إِشْرَاقِ — bi-, with (prep. of means); ishrāq, radiance, shining (m., gen., in the construct); 'with the radiance of'
بَدْرِ: badr — full moon (m., gen., in the construct); 'the full moon of'
الْإِشْرَاقِ: الـ + إِشْرَاقِ — al-, the + ishrāq, radiance, shining (m., gen.); 'the radiance'
وَنَالَتْ: وَ + نَالَتْ — wa-, and; nālat, attain, obtain (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she attained'
أَمَانِيَهَا: أَمَانِيَ + هَا — amānī, wishes, desires (pl. of umniya; acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her wishes'
وَسَبَتِ: وَ + سَبَتِ — wa-, and; sabat, take captive, captivate (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'and she captivated'
الْغُصُونَ: الـ + غُصُونَ — al-, the + ghuṣūn, branches (pl. of ghuṣn; acc.); 'the branches'
بِأَيْنِهَا: بِـ + أَيْنِ + هَا — bi-, with (prep. of means); ayn, languor, fatigue (m., gen.; see the note) + -hā, her; 'with her languor'
وَتَثَنِّيهَا: وَ + تَثَنِّي + هَا — wa-, and; tathannī, bending, swaying (V verbal noun, m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her bending'
وَفَتَّتِ: وَ + فَتَّتِ — wa-, and; fattat, break into pieces, crumble (II, 3 f. sg. perf.; linking kasra before al-); 'and she crumbled'
الْكُبُودَ: الـ + كُبُودَ — al-, the + kubūd, livers (pl. of kabid; acc.), the seat of feeling; 'the livers'
مَعَانِيهَا: مَعَانِي + هَا — maʿānī, meanings, subtle graces (pl. of maʿnā; gen.) + -hā, her; 'her subtleties'; also nom. as subject, 'its meanings' (aṣābat maʿānīhā maqātilī, 'its meanings struck my mortal parts')
شِعْـــــــرٌ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., nom. indef.); 'verse' (the print stretches the word with kashida)
وَجَارِيَةٍ: وَ + جَارِيَةٍ — wa-, and (here 'and many a'); jāriya, girl, young slave-girl (f., gen. after the wāw)
اَدَّبَتْهَا: اَدَّبَتْ + هَا — addabat, train, discipline, give manners to (II, 3 f. sg. perf.) + -hā, her; 'has trained her'
الشَّطَارَة: الـ + شَّطَارَة — al-, the + shaṭāra, cleverness, roguish wit (f., nom.; printed without the vowel)
خَدِّهَا: خَدِّ + هَا — khadd, cheek (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her cheek'
مُسْتَعَارَة: musʿāra — borrowed (passive part. X; f., acc., predicate); 'borrowed'
اَتَتْ: atat — come (verb I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'she came'
اَخْضَـرِ: akhḍar — green (adj., m., gen.); the print stretches the word with kashida
سَتَرَ: satara — cover, veil (verb I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'veiled'
بِالْجُلَّنَارَة: بِـ + الـ + جُلَّنَارَة — bi-, with (prep. of means; the construction is loose: the leaves 'veil', and the blossom is what they veil); al-, the + julnāra, pomegranate blossom (f., gen.; printed without the vowel)
اللِّبَاس: الـ + لِّبَاس — al-, the + libās, clothing, garment (m., gen.; printed without the vowel)
الْعِبَارَة: الـ + عِبَارَة — al-, the + ʿibāra, phrase, expression, wording (f., gen.; printed without the vowel); 'the phrase'
شَقَقْنَا: shaqaqnā — split, cleave (verb I, perf. 1 pl.); 'we split'
مَرَا: first half of مَرَائِرَ, marāʾir, gall-bladders (pl. of marāra; acc., object), which the print splits
نُسَمِّيهِ: نُسَمِّي + هِ — nusammī, name, call (II, imperf. 1 pl.) + -hi, it; 'we call it'
الْمَرَارَة: الـ + مَرَارَة — al-, the + marāra, gall-bladder, gall (f., gen.; printed without the vowel); 'the gall'
السَّابِعَةِ: الـ + سَابِعَة — sābiʿa, seventh (f. adjective, gen.)
مُعَصْفَرٍ: muʿaṣfar — dyed with safflower, yellow-red (passive participle of a quadriliteral verb; gen. after bayna)
وَمُزَعْفَرٍ: وَ + مُزَعْفَر — wa-, and; muzaʿfar, dyed with saffron, yellow (gen.)
وَاصِفِهَا: وَاصِف + هَا — wāṣif, describer (active participle of waṣafa, 'to describe'; m., gen. in annexation) + hā, her; 'her describer'
وَتَمِيسُ: وَ + تَمِيسُ — wa-, and; māsa/yamīsu, to sway, strut (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg. indic.; root م-ي-س); 'and she sways'
وَمُعَصْفَرِ: وَ + مُعَصْفَر — wa-, and; muʿaṣfar, dyed with safflower (gen.)
وَمُعَنْبَرٍ: وَ + مُعَنْبَر — wa-, and; muʿanbar, scented with ambergris (from ʿanbar; gen.)
وَمُمَسَّكٍ: وَ + مُمَسَّك — wa-, and; mumassak, perfumed with musk (passive participle of verb II; gen.)
وَمُصَنْدَلِ: وَ + مُصَنْدَل — wa-, and; muṣandal, scented with sandalwood (from ṣandal; gen.)
انْهَضِي: inhaḍa, to rise, get up (VII, imper. 2 f. sg.); 'rise!'
رَوَادِفُها: رَوَادِف + ها — rawādif, hips, haunches (pl. of rādifa; nom.) + -hā, her (the pronoun is unpointed in the print); 'her hips'
اقْعُدِي: uqʿud — qaʿada, to sit (I, imper. 2 f. sg.; ī marks the feminine); 'sit!'
وَتَمَهَّلِي: وَ + تَمَهَّلِي — wa-, and; tamahhala, to take one's time, go slowly (V, imper. 2 f. sg.); 'and take your time'
سَالَتْ: sa'ala, to ask (I, perf. 3 f. sg.; printed without hamza); 'she asked'
الْوَصْلَ: الـ + وَصْل — waṣl, union, joining, (lovers') meeting (m., acc., object)
جَمَالُهَا: جَمَال + هَا — jamāl, beauty (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
جُودِي: jāda/yajūdu, to be generous, give freely (I, imper. 2 f. sg.); 'be generous!'
دَلَالُهَا: دَلَال + هَا — dalāl, coquetry, flirtatious coyness (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her coquetry'
لَاتَفْعَلِي: لَا + تَفْعَلِي — lā, not (with the jussive, prohibition) + tafʿalī, faʿala, to do (I, jussive 2 f. sg.); printed as one word; 'do not (do it)'
فَتَحَتْ: fataḥa — to open (I, perf. 3 f. sg.)
عَيْنَهَا: عَيْن + هَا — ʿayn, eye (f., acc.) + hā, her; 'her eye(s)'
بَعْلِي: بَعْل + ي — baʿl, husband, lord (m., acc., second object of jaʿala) + -ī, my; 'my husband'
وَأَرِحْنِي: وَ + أَرِحْ + نِي — wa-, and; arāḥa, to give rest to, relieve (IV, imper. 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and relieve me'
يَجْلُوا: jalā — to display a bride (I, imperf. 3 m. pl.; the final nūn is not written)
السَّبْعِ: الـ + سَبْع — sabʿ, seven (f. numeral; gen., annexed to khilaʿ; the article stands on the number); also: gen. after ilā, with the m. quṣūr and without -a (Middle Arabic): ilā al-sabʿi quṣūrin, 'into the seven palaces' (Night 179)
وَالسَّائِسُ: وَ + الـ + سَائِس — wa-, and; here 'while' (circumstantial); sāʾis, groom (m., nom.)
فَرَغُوا: faragha — to finish, be done (I, perf. 3 m. pl.)
أَذِنُوا: adhina — to permit, give leave (I, perf. 3 m. pl.; the person takes li-)
بِالِانْصِرٰفِ: بِـ + الـ + اِنْصِرَاف — bi-, to, for (prep.; marks the thing allowed: 'leave for...') + inṣirāf, departure (verbal noun of VII, m., gen.; printed without the alif, read inṣirāf); 'to depart'
الْمَوَاشِطَ: الـ + مَوَاشِط — mawāshiṭ, bride's dressers, hairdressers (pl. of māshiṭa; acc.)
أَدْخَلُوا: adkhala — to bring in (IV, perf. 3 m. pl.)
لِيُغَيِّرُوا: لِـ + يُغَيِّرُوا — li-, in order to (prep. + subjunctive; purpose) + ghayyara, to change (II, subjunctive 3 m. pl.); 'in order to change'
الْحُلِيِّ: الـ + حُلِيّ — ḥuliyy, jewellery, ornaments (pl. of ḥalī; gen.)
وَالْحُلَلِ: وَ + الـ + حُلَل — wa-, and; ḥulal, robes, suits of clothes (pl. of ḥulla; gen.)
لِلْعَرِيسِ: لِـ + الـ + عَرِيس — li-, for (prep.; 'ready for') + ʿarīs, bridegroom (m., gen.); 'for the bridegroom'
آنَسْتَنَا: آنَسَ + تَ + نَا — ānasa, to keep company, cheer (IV, perf.) + -ta, you (2 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'you kept us company'
وَغَمَرْتَنَا: وَ + غَمَرَ + تَ + نَا — wa-, and; ghamara, to overwhelm, flood (I, perf.) + -ta, you + -nā, us; 'and you overwhelmed us'
بِإِحْسَانِكَ: بِـ + إِحْسَان + كَ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your kindness'
فَلَقِيَهُ: فَ + لَقِيَ + هُ — fa-, and; laqiya, to meet, encounter (I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and met him'
الرَّاحَةِ: الـ + رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, ease (f., gen.); bayt al-rāḥa, 'house of ease', the privy
تَتَوَقَّفْ: tawaqqafa — to hesitate, hold back (V, jussive 2 m. sg.)
وَاجْلِسْ: وَ + اجْلِسْ — wa-, and; jalasa, to sit (I, imper. 2 m. sg.)
الـ + بَشْخَانَة — bashkhāna, a room of the house, here the chamber where bride and groom meet (obscure word; f., gen. after fī) + the full stop
أَقْبَلَتِ: aqbala — to approach, come on (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra before the article)
رَأَيْتِهِ: رَأَى + تِ + هِ — raʾā, to see (I, perf.) + -ti, you (f. sg.) + -hi, him; 'you saw him'
سُيَّا: suyyā- — the first part of سُيَّاسِنَا, 'our grooms' (suyyās, colloquial plural of sāʾis), split by a space in the print
سِنَا: سِ + نَا — the last س of suyyās (gen. after min, with its kasra) + -nā, our; the second part of the split word سُيَّاسِنَا, 'our grooms'
أَقْبِلْ: aqbala — to turn to, approach (IV, imper. 2 m. sg.); with ʿalā, 'turn towards'
وَاكْشِفْ: وَ + اكْشِفْ — wa-, and; kashafa, to uncover, unveil (I, imper. 2 m. sg.)
لَحِقَتْنَا: laḥiqa — to overtake, befall (I, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -nā, us; 'it overtook us'
الْغَيْرَةُ: الـ + غَيْرَة — ghayra, jealousy; protective zeal, the passion to defend one's own (f., nom.)
بِالسَّائِسِ: بِـ + الـ + سَائِس — bi-, (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears: 'and behold, the groom') + sāʾis, groom (m., gen.)
خَارِجٌ: khārij — going out (active participle of kharaja; m., nom. indef.)
الْحَوْضِ: الـ + حَوْض — ḥawḍ, basin, tank (m., gen.)
حَالُكَ: حَال + كَ — ḥāl, state, condition (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your state'
فَكَبُرَ: فَ + كَبُرَ — fa-, and then; kabura, to grow big (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
وَكَبُرَ: وَ + كَبُرَ — wa-, and + kabura, grew big
فَزِعَ: faziʿa — to be terrified, take fright (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
اخْسَأْ: khasaʾa — to slink off; as an imperative, 'begone!' (said to a dog) (I, imper. 2 m. sg.)
مَشُومُ: mashūm — ill-omened, accursed (m.; the print's spelling of mashʾūm; nom., vocative)
وَالْكَلْبُ: وَ + الـ + كَلْب — wa-, and (here 'and then the...'); kalb, dog (m., nom.)
كَبُرَ: kabura — to grow big (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
وَانْتَفَخَ: وَ + انْتَفَخَ — wa-, and; intafakha, to swell up (VII, perf. 3 m. sg.)
جَحْشًا: jaḥsh — donkey foal, young ass (m., acc. predicate)
وَنَهَقَ: وَ + نَهَقَ — wa-, and; nahaqa, to bray (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
فَانْزَعَجَ: فَ + انْزَعَجَ — fa-, and; inzaʿaja, to be startled, thrown into alarm (VII, perf. 3 m. sg.)
اِلْحَقُونِي: اِلْحَقُوا + نِي — laḥiqa, to catch up with, come to the aid of (I, imper. 2 m. pl.; the final nūn of the plural is absorbed by -nī) + -nī, me; 'come to me, help me'
بِالْحِمَارِ: بِـ + الـ + حِمَار — bi-, (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears: 'and behold, the donkey') + ḥimār, donkey (m., gen.)
الْجَامُوسَةِ: الـ + جَامُوسَة — jāmūsa, water-buffalo cow (f., gen.)
وَسَدَّ: وَ + سَدَّ — wa-, and; sadda, to block, stop up (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
وَتَكَلَّمَ: وَ + تَكَلَّمَ — wa-, and; takallama, to speak (V, perf. 3 m. sg.)
آدَمَ: Ādam — Adam (gen., diptote); ibn Ādam, 'a human being'
أَنْتَنُ: antan — stinkier, most foul-smelling (elative; nom., vocative)
لَحِقَتْهُ: لَحِقَ + تْ + هُ — laḥiqa, to overtake, seize (I, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'it seized him'
الْبَطْنُ: الـ + بَطْن — baṭn, belly, bowels (m., but here with a feminine verb; nom.)
الْمَلَاقِي: الـ + مَلَاقِي — malāqī, plural of malqā, 'place where something is thrown'; here apparently the privy hole or seat (obscure; gen. after ʿalā)
بِأَثْوَابِهِ: بِـ + أَثْوَاب + هِ — bi-, with, along with (prep.; 'in his clothes') + athwāb, garments (pl. of thawb; gen.) + -hi, his; 'in his clothes'
وَاشْتَبَكَتْ: وَ + اشْتَبَكَتْ — wa-, and; ishtabaka, to interlock, clench together (VIII, perf. 3 f. sg.)
أَسْنَانُهُ: أَسْنَان + هُ — asnān, teeth (pl. of sinn; nom.) + -hu, his; 'his teeth'
بَعْضُهَا: baʿḍ + hā — baʿḍ, some, part (m., nom., in apposition) + -hā, of them; 'some of them'
وَجَدْتَ: wajada — to find (I, perf. 2 m. sg.)
تَتَزَوَّجُ: tazawwaja — to marry (V, imperf. 2 m. sg.; second verb with no 'an')
بِمَعْشُوقَتِي: بِـ + مَعْشُوقَة + ي — bi-, with (prep.; the Middle Arabic way of saying tazawwaja bi- 'marry') + maʿshūqa, beloved, object of passion (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my beloved'; also bi-, to (after ashbah, 'more like': shabaha takes bi- for the one resembled): ashbahu al-khalqi bi-maʿshūqatī, 'the most like, of all creatures, to my beloved'
رُدَّالْجَوَابَ: رُدَّ + الـ + جَوَاب — radda, to give back, return (I, imper. 2 m. sg.) + jawāb, answer (m., acc.); printed as one word; 'give back the answer', that is, reply
أَسْكَنْتُكَ: أَسْكَنَ + تُ + كَ — askana, to lodge, make dwell (IV, perf.) + -tu, I + -ka, you; 'I will lodge you'
مَايِ: mā-y — printed ماي; probably mā lī, 'I have not' with the lām dropped, or 'mā ayyu'; the sense is 'there is no... of mine'
غَصَبُونِي: غَصَبُوا + نِي — ghaṣaba, to force, take by force (I, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'they forced me'
عُشَّاقَ: ʿushshāq — lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq; acc., noun of anna)
جَوَامِيسَ: jawāmīs — buffaloes (pl. of jāmūs; diptote, gen.; in apposition to 'lovers')
تَائِبٌ: tāʾib — repentant (active participle of tāba; m., nom. indef.)
أُقْسِمُ: aqsama — to swear, adjure (IV, imperf. 1 sg.)
خَرَجْتَ: kharaja — to go out (I, perf. 2 m. sg.)
الْوَقْتَ: الـ + وَقْت — waqt, time (m., acc. of time); hādhā al-waqta, 'at this time'
تَكَلَّمْتَ: takallama — to speak (V, perf. 2 m. sg.)
تَطْلُعَ: ṭalaʿa — to rise (I, subjunctive 3 f. sg.)
تَعُدْ: ʿāda — to return (I, jussive 2 m. sg.)
وَقَلَبَ: وَ + قَلَبَ — wa-, and; qalaba, to turn over, upend (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
تَحْتُ: taḥt — below, down (adv.; ilā taḥt 'downward', with a final damma)
أُخَلِّيكَ: خَلَّى + كَ — khallā, to leave, let be (II, imperf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you; 'I leave you'
حَارِسُكَ: حَارِس + كَ — ḥāris, guard, watchman (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your guard'
خَلَّى: khallā — to leave, let be (II, perf. 3 m. sg.)
وَالْعِفْرِيتَ: وَ + الـ + عِفْرِيت — wa-, and; ʿifrīt, ifrit (acc.)
يَتَخَاصَمَانِ: takhāṣama — to quarrel with each other (VI, imperf. 3 m. dual; a circumstantial: 'quarrelling')
بِالْعَرُوسَةِ: بِـ + الـ + عَرُوسَة — bi-, (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears: 'and behold, the bride') + ʿarūsa, bride (f., gen.)
أَبَا: abā — father (m., acc. in annexation; vocative: 'O father of...', abū-x as a nickname)
وَدَاعَةَ: wadāʿa — a thing left in trust, a trust (f., acc., object; also 'quietness')
وَلَّتِ: wallā — to turn away, depart (II, perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra before the article)
