وَدَخَلَتِ: وَ + دَخَلَتِ — wa-, and; dakhala, entered (perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra before the article)
وَقَلْبُهَا: وَ + قَلْب + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + qalb, heart (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her heart'
مَكْسُورٌ: maksūr — broken (passive participle of kasara; m., nom. indef.)
أُمَكِّنُهُ: مَكَّنَ + هُ — makkana, to give power or access to (II, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'I will let him'
وَلِلسَّائِسِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + سَائِس — wa-, and; li-, to, for (prep.; marks possession: 'the groom has') + sāʾis, groom (gen.); 'and the groom has'
بَدْرُ: badr — full moon (m., nom.; first part of the name, printed here as a separate word)
أَوْصَلَ: awṣala — to bring to, convey to (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.)
فِيكِ: فِي + كِ — fī, in (prep.) + -ki, you (f.); 'in you'
يَاسِتَّ: يَا + سِتَّ — yā, O (vocative) + sitt, lady (f., acc. in the vocative, in annexation); printed as one word; 'O lady'
عَمِلْنَا: عَمِلَ + نَا — ʿamila, to do, make (I, perf.) + -nā, we; 'we did'
مَسْخَرَةً: maskhara — jest, mockery (f., acc.; 'as a jest')
لِضَحْكٍ: لِـ + ضَحْك — li-, for, in order to (prep.; purpose) + ḍaḥk, laughing (verbal noun of ḍaḥika; m., gen.); 'for laughing'
وَأَهْلُكِ: وَ + أَهْل + كِ — wa-, and; ahl, family, kin (m., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your family'
بِجَلْوِكِ: بِـ + جَلْو + كِ — bi-, in, at (prep.; 'in your being displayed') + jalw, displaying, unveiling of a bride (verbal noun of jalā; m., gen.) + -ki, your; 'in displaying you'
أَبَاكِ: أَب + اكِ — ab, father (m., acc., noun of anna) + -ki, your (f.); 'your father'; also: acc. as the object of balagha: yablughu abāki, 'reaches your father' (Night 192)
اكْتَرَاهُ: iktarā — to hire (VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.; root k-r-y) + -hu, him; 'hired him'
بِعَشَرَةِ: بِـ + عَشَرَة — bi-, for, at the price of; after atā/yaʾtī 'come with' = 'bring' (yaʾtīnā bi-ʿasharati ālāfi fārisin, 'bring us ten thousand horsemen') (prep.) + ʿashara, ten (f. numeral; gen. in annexation); 'for ten, with ten'
يَصْرِفَ: ṣarafa — to turn away, avert (I, subjunctive 3 m. sg.)
وَقَدْرَاحَ: وَ + قَدْ + رَاحَ — wa-, and; qad, indeed (with perf.); rāḥa, to go away (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'and he has gone'
تَبَسَّمَتْ: tabassama — to smile (V, perf. 3 f. sg.)
وَفَرِحَتْ: وَ + فَرِحَتْ — wa-, and; fariḥa, to rejoice, be glad (I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and was glad'
وَضَحِكَتْ: وَ + ضَحِكَتْ — wa-, and; ḍaḥika, to laugh (I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she laughed'
ضَحْكًا: ضَحْكًا — ḍaḥk, laughter (m., acc.; cognate object of ḍaḥikat); 'a laugh'
أَطْفَأْتَ: أَطْفَأْتَ — aṭfaʾa, to extinguish, put out (IV, 2 m. sg. perf.); 'you have put out'
نَارِي: نَارِ + ي — nār, fire (f., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my fire'
فَبِا: فَ + بِـ + ا — fa-, so, then; bi-, by (oath preposition, as in bi-allāhi) + the alif of al- (the print splits فبالله into فبا + لله); 'so, by (God)'
للَّٰهِ: لـ + لَّٰهِ — the rest of الله after the print's split (the two lāms of al-lāh + h): Allāh, God (gen. after the bi- of the preceding word); 'God'
خُذْنِي: خُذْ + نِي — khudh, take (imper. 2 m. sg. of akhadha) + -nī, me; 'take me'
وَضُمَّنِي: وَ + ضُمَّ + نِي — wa-, and; ḍumma, clasp, press (imper. 2 m. sg. of ḍamma) + -nī, me; 'and press me'
حِضْنِكَ: حِضْنِ + كَ — ḥiḍn, bosom, lap (m., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your (m.); 'your bosom'
غَيْرِلِبَاسٍ: غَيْرِ + لِبَاسٍ — ghayr, other than, without (m., gen. after min) + libās, drawers, underclothes (m., gen.; the li- is part of the root l-b-s, not a preposition); printed as one word; 'without drawers'
وَكَشَفَتْ: وَ + كَشَفَتْ — wa-, and; kashafa, to uncover, lift (I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she lifted'
ثَوْبَهَا: ثَوْبَ + هَا — thawb, garment (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her garment'
رَقَبَتِهَا: رَقَبَةِ + هَا — raqaba, neck (f., gen. after ilā) + -hā, her; 'her neck'
كُسُّهَا: كُسُّ + هَا — kuss, vulva (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her vulva'
وَرِدْفُهَا: وَ + رِدْفُ + هَا — wa-, and; ridf, rump, buttocks (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her rump'
تَحَرَّكَتْ: تَحَرَّكَتْ — taḥarraka, to be moved, stir (V, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'stirred'
الشَّهْوَةُ: الْـ + شَّهْوَةُ — al-, the + shahwa, desire, lust (f., nom.); 'the desire'
وَحَلَّ: وَ + حَلَّ — wa-, and; ḥalla, to untie, undo (I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he undid'
لِبَاسَهُ: لِبَاسَ + هُ — libās, drawers (m., acc.; the li- is part of the root l-b-s) + -hu, his; 'his drawers'
الْكِيسُ: الْـ + كِيسُ — al-, the + kīs, bag, purse (m., nom.; the topic, picked up by the pronoun in laffahu); 'the bag'
الذَّهَبُ: الْـ + ذَّهَبُ — al-, the + dhahab, gold (m., nom., apposition); 'the gold'
الْأَلْفُ: الْـ + أَلْفُ — al-, the + alf, thousand (m., nom.); 'the thousand'
لَفَّهُ: لَفَّ + هُ — laffa, to wrap (I, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hu, it; 'he wrapped it'
سِرْوَالِهِ: سِرْوَالِ + هِ — sirwāl, drawers, trousers (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his drawers'
ذَيْلِ: ذَيْلِ — dhayl, hem, skirt, edge (m., gen. in annexation); 'the edge of'
الطَّرَّاحَةِ: الْـ + طَّرَّاحَةِ — al-, the + ṭarrāḥa, mattress, cushion (f., gen.); 'the mattress'
بِالْقَمِيصِ: بِـ + الْـ + قَمِيصِ — bi-, in (prep.; 'in the shirt', i.e. wearing it) + al-, the + qamīṣ, shirt (m., gen.); 'in the shirt'
الرَّفِيعِ: الْـ + رَّفِيعِ — al-, the + rafīʿ, fine, thin (adj., m., gen.); 'the fine'
مُطَرَّزًا: مُطَرَّزًا — muṭarraz, embroidered (passive participle of II ṭarraza; acc., predicate of kāna); 'embroidered'
وَجَذَبَتْهُ: وَ + جَذَبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and; jadhaba, to pull, draw (I, 3 f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and she drew him'
وَعَانَقَهَا: وَ + عَانَقَ + هَا — wa-, and; ʿānaqa, to embrace (III, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hā, her; 'and he embraced her'
الذَّخِيرَةَ: الْـ + ذَّخِيرَةَ — al-, the + dhakhīra, ammunition, store, charge (f., acc.); 'the ammunition'
فَانْطَلَقَ: فَ + انْطَلَقَ — fa-, and so; inṭalaqa, to go off, be let loose (VII, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and went off'
الْمِدْفَعُ: الْـ + مِدْفَعُ — al-, the + midfaʿ, cannon (m., nom.); 'the cannon'
هَدَمَ: هَدَمَ — hadama, to demolish, pull down (I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'it demolished'
الْبُرْجَ: الْـ + بُرْجَ — al-, the + burj, tower (m., acc.); 'the tower'
ثُقِبَتْ: ثُقِبَتْ — thuqiba, to be pierced (I passive, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'was pierced'
وَمَطِيَّةً: وَ + مَطِيَّةً — wa-, and; maṭiyya, mount, riding-beast (f., acc.); 'and a mount'
لِغَيْرِهَا: لِـ + غَيْرِ + هَا — li-, for (prep.; the person for whom the mount was ridden, 'ridden for another') + ghayr, other than (gen.) + -hā, her/it; 'for anyone but her'
رُكِبَتْ: رُكِبَتْ — rukiba, to be ridden (I passive, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'was ridden'
فَزَالَ: فَ + زَالَ — fa-, and so; zāla, to pass away, be gone (I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and went'
بَكَارَتُهَا: بَكَارَةُ + هَا — bakāra, virginity (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her virginity'
وَتَمَلَّى: وَ + تَمَلَّى — wa-, and; tamallā, to take one's fill of, enjoy at length (V, 3 m. sg. perf.; takes bi-); 'and he took his fill'
بِشَبَابِهَا: بِـ + شَبَابِ + هَا — bi-, of (prep.; the one that tamallā takes, 'to enjoy fully of') + shabāb, youth (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her youth'
سَلَّهُ: سَلَّ + هُ — salla, to draw out (as a sword) (I, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hu, it; 'he drew it out'
وَرَدَّنَهُ: وَ + رَدَّ + نَهُ — wa-, and; radda, to put back, return (I, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hu, it; the extra -na- is unexplained, probably a misprint for وَرَدَّهُ; 'and put it back'
أَعَادَهُ: أَعَادَ + هُ — aʿāda, to repeat, do again (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.) + -hu, it; 'he did it again'
فَعَلِقَتْ: فَ + عَلِقَتْ — fa-, and so; ʿaliqa, to conceive (I, 3 f. sg. perf.); 'and she conceived'
وَضَعَ: وَضَعَ — waḍaʿa, to put, place (I, 3 m. sg. perf.); 'he put'
الْأُخْرَيٰ: الْـ + أُخْرَيٰ — al-, the + ukhrā, other (f.; the print writes ي for ى); 'the other one'

صِرْتَ: ṣāra — to become (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you have become'; also (Night 202): ṣāra — to come to be (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms; future sense after idhā); ṣirta ʿindahā, 'you are with her'
وَحَدِيثٌ: وَ + حَدِيث — wa-, and; ḥadīth, report, tale (m., nom. indef.); 'and a tale'
مَابِكَ: مَا + بِـ + كَ — mā, what (relative) + bi-, with (prep., 'what is with you') + -ka, you; 'what ails you' Also with mā as the negative: mā bika junūnun, 'there is no madness in you' (bi-, in, of what afflicts) (Night 191).
وَاقْعُدْ: وَ + اقْعُدْ — wa-, and; uqʿud, to sit, stay (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'and sit'
وَأَتَّخِذُكَ: وَ + أَتَّخِذُ + كَ — wa-, and; attakhidhu, to take, adopt (verb VIII, imperf. 1sg) + -ka, you; 'and I take you (as)'
يَاعَمِّ: يَا + عَمّ — yā, O (vocative particle) + ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.; polite address to an older man); 'O uncle'
أَقْمِشَةً: أَقْمِشَة — aqmisha, cloths, stuffs, garments (pl. of qumāsh; acc. indef.); 'cloths'
مُفْتَخِرَةً: مُفْتَخِرَة — muftakhira, splendid, magnificent (f. adj., from iftakhara; acc. indef.); 'splendid'
وَأَلْبَسَهَا: وَ + أَلْبَسَ + هَا — wa-, and; albasa, to clothe, put on (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, them (the cloths); 'and he clothed (him) in them' Also (Night 196): وَ + أَلْبَسَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + albasa, to put (something) on (someone) (verb IV, perf. 3ms, two objects) + 3fs, the first object; 'and he put on her'
وَأَشْهَرَ: وَ + أَشْهَرَ — wa-, and; ashhara, to make public, declare (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and declared'
اشْتَهَرَ: ishtahara — to become well known (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'became known'
حَالُهُ: حَال + هُ — ḥāl, state, condition (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his condition'
جَرَيٰ: jarā — to happen, run (verb I, perf. 3ms, defective; printed with a dotted ya); 'happened'
أَمْرِسِتِّ: أَمْر + سِتّ — amr, affair (m., gen., construct) + sitt, lady (f., construct; the print joins the two words); 'the affair of Lady'
فَأَنَّهُ: فَ + أَنَّ + هُ — fa-, then (answering ammā); anna, that (particle) + -hu, it (the situation); 'then it was that'
وَانْتَبَهَتْ: وَ + انْتَبَهَتْ — wa-, and; intabahat, to wake up (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'and she woke'
فَاعْتَقَدَتْ: فَ + اعْتَقَدَتْ — fa-, so; iʿtaqadat, to believe, suppose (verb VIII, perf. 3fs); 'and she supposed'
الْمِرْحَاضَ: الـ + مِرْحَاض — mirḥāḍ, privy, lavatory (m., acc.); 'the privy'
تَنْتَظِرُهُ: تَنْتَظِرُ + هُ — tantaẓiru, to wait for (verb VIII, imperf. 3fs; circumstantial) + -hu, him; 'waiting for him'
بِأَبِيهَا: بِـ + أَب + ي + هَا — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after idhā (not 'with'; 'behold, ...') + ab, father (m., in the long-vowel construct) + -hā, her; 'and behold, her father'
مَهْمُومٌ: مَهْمُوم — mahmūm, grieved, anxious (passive participle of hamma; nom. indef.); 'grieved'
غَصَبَهُ: غَصَبَ + هُ — ghaṣaba, to take by force, coerce (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he coerced him'
قِطْعَةُ: قِطْعَة — qiṭʿa, piece, lump (f., nom., construct; contemptuous); 'a piece of'
سَائِسٍ: سَائِس — sāʾis, groom, stable-hand (m., gen. indef.); 'a groom'
أَحْدَبَ: أَحْدَب — aḥdab, hunchbacked (adj., gen. indef. diptote); 'hunchbacked'
أَقْتُلُ: aqtulu — to kill (verb I, imperf. 1sg); 'I shall kill'
مَكَّنَتْ: makkana — to give power, give access (verb II, perf. 3fs); with min nafsihā, 'let (him) have her'
لَبَّيْكَ: labbayka — 'here I am, at your service' (formula for answering a summons; dual-form noun with -ka)
تَتَمَايَلُ: tatamāyalu — to sway, swing (verb VI, imperf. 3fs); 'swaying'
قَبَّلَتِ: qabbalat — to kiss (verb II, perf. 3fs, kasra before the article); 'she kissed'
وَجَمَالًا: وَ + جَمَال — wa-, and; jamāl, beauty (m., acc. indef., of respect); 'and in beauty'
بِعِنَاتِهَا: بِـ + عِنَات + هَا — bi-, by, from (prep., of cause) + ʿināt (obscure; perhaps a misprint for ʿināq, 'embracing') + -hā, her; 'by her embracing (?)'
الْغَزَالَ: الـ + غَزَال — ghazāl, gazelle (m., acc.; a lover or beauty); 'the gazelle'
وَالِدِهَا: وَالِد + هَا — wālid, father (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her father'
وَقٰلَتْ: وَ + قَالَتْ — wa-, and; qālat, to say (verb I, perf. 3fs; printed قلت, with the dagger alif for the long vowel); 'and she said'
يَكْفِي: yakfī — to suffice (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'it suffices, enough'
يَضْحَكُونَ: yaḍḥakūna — to laugh (verb I, imperf. 3mp); with ʿalā, 'laugh at'
وَيُعَايِرُونِي: وَ + يُعَايِرُونَ + نِي — wa-, and; yuʿāyirūna, to taunt, reproach (verb III, imperf. 3mp; the plural ending and pronoun run together as -ūnī) + me; 'and they taunt me'
يَجِيئُ: yajīʾu — to come (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with fī, 'amount to, come to the measure of'
قُلَامَةِ: قُلَامَة — qulāma, parings, clippings (f., gen., construct); 'a paring of'
ظُفْرِ: ظُفْر — ẓufr, fingernail, nail (m., gen., construct); 'the nail of'
الْبَارِحَةِ: الـ + بَارِحَة — bāriḥa, last night, yesterday evening (f., gen.); 'last night'
تَهْزَأْبِي: تَهْزَأْ + بِـ + ي — tahzaʾ, to mock (verb I, imperf. 2ms, jussive) + bi-, at (prep.; hazaʾa bi-, 'mock at') + -ī, me; 'mock me'
وَتَذْكُرْلِي: وَ + تَذْكُرْ + لِـ + ي — wa-, and; tadhkur, to mention (verb I, imperf. 2ms, jussive) + li-, to (prep.; indirect object) + -ī, me; 'and mention to me'
امْتَزَجَ: imtazaja — to be mixed, blended (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'he was mixed'
بِالْغَضَبِ: بِـ + الـ + غَضَب — bi-, with (prep.; 'mixed with') + ghaḍab, anger (m., gen.); 'with anger'
وَازْرَقَّتْ: وَ + ازْرَقَّتْ — wa-, and; izraqqat, to turn blue (verb IX, perf. 3fs); 'and turned blue'
عَيْنَاهُ: عَيْنَان + هُ — ʿaynān, two eyes (dual, nom.; the nūn drops in construct) + -hu, his; 'his two eyes'
تَذْكُرْهُ: تَذْكُرْ + هُ — tadhkur, to mention (verb I, imperf. 2ms, jussive) + -hu, him; 'do not mention him'
أَبَاهُ: أَب + هُ — ab, father (m., acc., in the long-vowel construct) + -hu, his; 'his father'
مِزَاحَ: مِزَاح — mizāḥ, joking, jest (m., acc.; printed without alif, so a bare fatḥa); 'jesting'
أُجْرَتَهُ: أُجْرَة + هُ — ujra, wage, pay (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his wage'
الْبَشْخَانَةَ: الـ + بَشْخَانَة — bashkhāna, the room where the bride is displayed (f., acc.); 'the bridal chamber'
جَلَوْنِي: جَلَوْا + نِي — jalā, to display a bride (verb I, perf. 3mp; plural before the subject) + -nī, me; 'they displayed me'
وَنَقَّطَ: وَ + نَقَّطَ — wa-, and; naqqaṭa, to scatter, shower (coins) (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he showered'
الْفُقَرَأَ: الـ + فُقَرَاء — fuqarāʾ, the poor (pl. of faqīr; acc.); 'the poor'
وَقَدْبِتُّ: وَ + قَدْ + بِتُّ — wa-, and; qad, already, with the perfect; bittu, to spend the night (verb I, perf. 1sg); 'and I have spent the night'
حِضْنِ: حِضْن — ḥiḍn, bosom, embrace (m., gen., construct); 'the bosom of'
الْخَفِيفِ: الـ + خَفِيف — khafīf, light, nimble, agreeable (adj., gen.); 'the light-spirited'
وَالْحَوَاجِبِ: وَ + الـ + حَوَاجِب — wa-, and; ḥawājib, eyebrows (pl. of ḥājib; gen.); 'and the eyebrows'
الْمَقْرُونَةِ: الـ + مَقْرُونَة — maqrūna, joined, meeting (passive participle of qarana, f. adj., gen.); 'the joined'
ظَلَامَ: ظَلَام — ẓalām, darkness (m., acc., predicate of ṣāra; printed without alif, so a bare fatḥa); 'darkness'
فَاجِرَةُ: فَاجِرَة — fājira, wanton, depraved (f., vocative); 'shameless woman'
عَقْلُكِ: عَقْل + كِ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your mind'
فَبَسْكَ: فَ + بَسْ + كَ — fa-, so; bass, enough (colloquial) + -ka, you; 'so enough of you'
تَنْتَاقَلُ: tantāqalu — to be heavy, make oneself a burden (obscure; perhaps for tatathāqalu, verb VI, imperf. 2ms); 'you weigh heavily'
زَوْجِى: زَوْج + ى — zawj, husband (m., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with a dotless ya); 'my husband'
عَلِقْتُ: ʿaliqtu — to conceive (verb I, perf. 1sg); 'I have conceived'
الْخَلَاءِ: الـ + خَلَاء — khalāʾ, empty place, privy (m., gen., construct); 'the empty place' (bayt al-khalāʾ, the privy)
فَبَهِتَ: فَ + بَهِتَ — fa-, so; bahita, to be stupefied, dumbfounded (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he was dumbfounded'
هُوَالْأَحْدَبُ: هُوَ + الـ + أَحْدَب — huwa, he (independent pronoun) + aḥdab, hunchback (m., nom.; the print joins them); 'he, the hunchback'
تَغُومْ: taghūm — obscure; perhaps a slurred taqūm, 'you rise' (verb I, imperf. 2ms), perhaps a babble of fear; left as printed
مَايُكَلِّمُهُ: مَا + يُكَلِّمُ + هُ — mā, not (negative; with illā, 'only') + yukallimu, to speak to (verb II, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'none speaks to him'
فَعَيَّطَ: فَ + عَيَّطَ — fa-, so; ʿayyaṭa, to shout (colloquial; verb II, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'shout at'; 'and he shouted'
حِينِ: حِين — ḥīn, time, moment (m., gen., construct after min); 'the time of'
جَعَلْتَنِي: جَعَلْتَ + نِي — jaʿalta, to put, place (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'you put me'
رَفَعْتُ: rafaʿtu — to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 1sg); 'I have raised'
ارْفُقْ: urfuq — to be gentle, show kindness (verb I, imperative 2ms); with bi-, 'be gentle with'
بَسْكَ: بَسْ + كَ — bass, enough (colloquial) + -ka, you; 'enough of you'
رَابِحٌ: رَابِح — rābiḥ, gaining, profiting (active participle of rabiḥa; nom. indef.; perhaps for rāyiḥ, 'going to'); 'a gainer'
فَرُحْ: فَ + رُحْ — fa-, so; ruḥ, go (colloquial imperative of rāḥa, verb I, 2ms); 'so go'
حَلِّ: حَلّ — ḥall, loosing, release (m., gen., construct); 'the loosing of'
يَأْتِيَكَ: yaʾtiya — to come (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an) + -ka, you; 'comes to you'
الْفِعَالَ: الـ + فِعَال — fiʿāl, deeds (pl. of fiʿl; acc.); 'the deeds'
فَأَنْتُمْ: فَ + أَنْتُمْ — fa-, for, so; antum, you (m. pl.); 'for you'
جِبْتُمْ: jibtum — to bring (colloquial, for jiʾtum bi-; perf. 2mp); 'you brought'
تُزَوِّجُونِي: تُزَوِّجُونَ + نِي — tuzawwijūna, to marry off (verb II, imperf. 2mp; the plural ending and pronoun run together as -ūnī) + -nī, me; 'you marry me'
بِمَعْشُوقَةِ: بِـ + مَعْشُوقَة — bi-, to (prep.; zawwaja bi-, 'marry (someone) to') + maʿshūqa, beloved, sweetheart (f., gen., construct); 'to the sweetheart of'
الْجَوَامِيسِ: الـ + جَوَامِيس — jawāmīs, buffaloes (pl. of jāmūs; gen.); 'the buffaloes'
وَمَعْشُوقَةِ: وَ + مَعْشُوقَة — wa-, and; maʿshūqa, beloved, sweetheart (f., gen., construct); 'and the sweetheart of'
فَلَعَنَ: فَ + لَعَنَ — fa-, so; laʿana, to curse (verb I, perf. 3ms; as a wish); 'so may he curse'
وَلَعَنَ: وَ + لَعَنَ — wa-, and; laʿana, to curse (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and may he curse'
السَّبَبَ: الـ + سَبَب — al-, the + sabab, cause, reason (m., acc., predicate of kāna); 'the cause'
فَتَّتْتَ: fattatta — to crumble, break into pieces (verb II, perf. 2ms; the print spells it with three tāʾs); 'you have crumbled'
مُكْرَي: مُكْرَى — mukrā, hired (passive participle of akrā, printed with a dotted ya); 'hired'
بِالنَّاسِ: بِـ + الـ + نَّاس — bi-, with, among (prep.; 'mingle with', after اِخْتَلَطَ) + al-nās, the people (m., gen.); 'with the people'; here: bi- of means, in the saying al-nāsu bi-al-nāsi, 'people (live) by people', i.e. depend on one another
يُحَدِّثُ: يُحَدِّثُ — ḥaddatha, to converse with, tell (form II; 3 m. sg. imperfect); 'he converses with'
وَالِدَ: وَالِد — wālid, father (m.; acc. in construct); 'father of'
إِذْنِ: إِذْن — idhn, permission (m.; gen. in construct); 'permission of'
فَطَلَعَتِ: فَـ + طَلَعَتِ — fa-, and/then (conj.) + ṭalaʿa, to rise (3 f. sg. perfect; kasra from the article that follows); 'and has it risen'
الشَّمْسُنْ: الـ + شَمْس + نْ — shams, sun (f.); 'the sun', with a stray ن in the print (a slip, not a nunation), pointed with sukūn
لِأَقْضِيَ: لِـ + أَقْضِيَ — li-, in order to (prep./particle with subjunctive) + qaḍā, to accomplish (1 sg. subjunctive); 'to accomplish'
حَاجَتِى: حَاجَة + ى — ḥāja, need, want (f.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my need'
وَأُزِيلَ: وَ + أُزِيلَ — wa-, and + azāla, to remove, do away with (form IV; 1 sg. subjunctive); 'and to remove'
ضَرُورَتِي: ضَرُورَة + ي — ḍarūra, necessity, need (f.) + -ī, my; 'my necessity'
بِفَارَةٍ: بِـ + فَارَة — bi-, with (marks what appears after وَإِذَا, 'behold') + fāra, mouse (f.; colloquial for fa'ra); 'a mouse'
وَعَيَّطَ: وَ + عَيَّطَ — wa-, and + ʿayyaṭa, to cry out, shriek (colloquial, form II; 3 m. sg. perfect); 'and it cried out'
يَكْبُرُ: يَكْبُرُ — kabura, to grow large (3 m. sg. imperfect); 'it grows large'
أُذْنِى: أُذْن + ى — udhn, ear (f.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my ear'
فَخَلَّانِي: فَـ + خَلَّا + نِي — fa-, and (conj.) + khallā, to leave, let go (form II, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'and it left me'
وَأَخْرَجَهُ: وَ + أَخْرَجَ + هُ — wa-, and + akhraja, to bring out (form IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and brought him out'
الْمِرْحَاضِ: الـ + مِرْحَاض — mirḥāḍ, privy, latrine (m.); 'the privy'
وَأَعْلَمَهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمَ + هُ — wa-, and + aʿlama, to inform (form IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and he informed him'
حَائِرُ: حَائِرُ — ḥāʾir, bewildered, perplexed (active part. of ḥāra; m.; in construct); 'bewildered of'
خَبَرَكِ: خَبَر + كِ — khabar, news, account (m.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your news'
أَنْجَلِي: أَنْجَلِي — injalā, to be displayed, unveiled (form VII, 1 sg. imperfect; of a bride shown to the groom); 'I am displayed'
وَعَلِقْتُ: وَ + عَلِقْتُ — wa-, and + ʿaliqa, to conceive (1 sg. perfect); 'and I conceived'
تُصَدِّقْنِي: تُصَدِّقْ + نِي — ṣaddaqa, to believe (form II, 2 m. sg. jussive) + -nī, me; 'you believe me' Also 3fs: fa-lam tuṣaddiqnī, 'and she did not believe me'.
شَاشُهُ: شَاش + هُ — shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (m.) + -hu, his; 'his turban-cloth'
بِلَفْتِهِ: بِـ + لَفْت + هِ — bi-, with, in (prep.) + lafta, a winding, a wrap (n. of unity from lafa, to wind; m.) + -hi, its; 'in its winding'
وَلِبَاسُهُ: وَ + لِبَاس + هُ — wa-, and + libās, clothing, drawers (m.) + -hu, his; 'and his drawers'
الْفَرْشِ: الـ + فَرْش — farsh, bedding, spread (m.); 'the bedding'; also: collective, 'furnishings, carpets and cushions', with a singular adjective: anwāʿi al-farshi al-fākhiri, 'kinds of splendid furnishings' (Night 179)
مَلْفُوفٌ: مَلْفُوف — malfūf, wrapped up (passive part. of laffa; m.); 'wrapped'
مَاهُوَ: مَا + هُوَ — mā, what (interrog.) + huwa, it, he (the print runs the two together); 'what it is'
الْبَشْخَانَهْ: الـ + بَشْخَانَهْ — bashkhāna, a chamber or hall (Persian-derived; f.; the print has ه for ة, pointed with a pausal -ah); 'the bashkhana'
شَاشَ: شَاشَ — shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (m.; acc. in construct); 'the turban-cloth of'
وَقَلَّبَهُ: وَ + قَلَّبَ + هُ — wa-, and + qallaba, to turn over (form II, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, it; 'and turned it over'
وُزَرَٰأَ: وُزَرَٰأَ — wuzarāʾ, viziers (pl. of wazīr; the print has وزرأ for وزراء, with the printed hamza kept and a dagger alif for the long ā); 'of viziers'
لِأَنَّهَا: لِـ + أَنَّ + هَا — li-, because (prep. li- + anna, 'because') + -hā, it (f.); 'because it' Also 'because she': li-annahā jāriyatu Shamsi al-Nahāri, 'because she is Shams al-Nahār's slave-girl'; li-annahā kānat tamīlu, 'because she used to incline'.
مَوْصِلِيَّةٌ: مَوْصِلِيَّة — mawṣiliyya, of Mosul, a Mosul muslin (f. adj., nisba of al-Mawṣil); 'Mosuli'
حِرْزٍ: حِرْزٍ — ḥirz, amulet, charm (m.; gen. after إِلَى; here the object looked at: naẓara ilā); 'an amulet'
مَخِيطٍ: مَخِيطٍ — makhīṭ, sewn (passive adj., from khāṭa; m.; gen.); 'sewn'
طَرْبُوشِهِ: طَرْبُوش + هِ — ṭarbūsh, tarbush, a brimless felt cap (m.) + -hi, his; 'his tarbush'
فَأَخَذَهُ: فَـ + أَخَذَ + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, to take (3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him/it; 'and he took him/it'
وَفَتَقَهُ: وَ + فَتَقَ + هُ — wa-, and + fataqa, to rip open (3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, it; 'and ripped it open'
اللِّبَاسَ: الـ + لِبَاس — libās, clothing, drawers (m.); 'the drawers'
فَقَرَأَهَا: فَـ + قَرَأَ + هَا — fa-, and (conj.) + qaraʾa, to read (3 m. sg. perfect; hamza printed precomposed, kept) + -hā, it; 'and he read it'
مُبَايَعَةَ: مُبَايَعَةَ — mubāyaʿa, sale, bill of sale (f.; acc. in construct); 'the sale-contract of'
وَاسْمَ: وَ + اسْمَ — wa-, and + ism, name (m.; acc., object of wajada); 'and the name of'
وَوَجَدَ: وَ + وَجَدَ — wa-, and + wajada, to find (3 m. sg. perfect); 'and he found'
الْأَلْفَ: الـ + أَلْف — alf, thousand (m.; acc.); 'the thousand'
وَخَرَّ: وَ + خَرَّ — wa-, and + kharra, to fall down (3 m. sg. perfect); 'and he fell'
مَضْمُونَ: مَضْمُونَ — maḍmūn, contents, purport (passive part. of ḍamina; m.; acc. in construct); 'the contents of'
إِلَهَ: إِلَهَ — ilāh, god (m.; acc. after lā, 'no god'); 'god'
الْقَادِرُ: الـ + قَادِر — qādir, able, powerful (active part. of qadara; m.); 'the Able'
شَيٍّ: شَيٍّ — shayy, thing (m.; the print has شي for شَيْء, hamza dropped; gen.); 'thing'
تَعْرِفِينَ: تَعْرِفِينَ — ʿarafa, to know (2 f. sg. imperfect; a question without particle); 'do you know'
مَنِ: مَنِ — man, who (interrog.; with al- following); 'who'; here relative after kull: kullu mani iltahaba, 'everyone who blazed up' (kasra of joining before the next word)
عَمِّكِ: عَمّ + كِ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.; gen. in construct) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your uncle'
مَهْرُكِ: مَهْر + كِ — mahr, dower, bride-price (m.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your dower'
فَلَيْتَ: فَـ + لَيْتَ — fa-, and (conj.) + layta, would that (particle, takes acc.); 'and would that'
اتَّفَقَتْ: اتَّفَقَتْ — ittafaqa, to come about, happen (form VIII, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'it came about'
الْحِرْزَ: الـ + حِرْز — ḥirz, amulet (m.; acc.); 'the amulet'
الْمَخِيطَ: الـ + مَخِيط — makhīṭ, sewn (passive adj.; m.); 'the sewn'
مَكْتُوبَةً: مَكْتُوبَةً — maktūb, written (passive part. of kataba; f.; acc., agreeing with 'paper'); 'written'
وَمَكْتُوبٌ: وَ + مَكْتُوبٌ — wa-, and + maktūb, written (passive part.; m.; nom.); 'and written'
بِخَطِّ: بِـ + خَطِّ — bi-, in, by (prep.) + khaṭṭ, handwriting (m.; gen. in construct); 'in the handwriting of'
نَظَرَخَطَّ: نَظَرَ + خَطَّ — naẓara, to look at (3 m. sg. perfect) + khaṭṭ, handwriting (m.; acc. in construct); the print runs the two together; 'he looked at the handwriting of'
اَرِي: اَرِي — a-rā, I see (1 sg. imperfect of raʾā; the print has kasra, giving 'arī'); 'I see'
فَاَذُوبُ: فَـ + اَذُوبُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + a-dhūbu, to melt (1 sg. imperfect; hamza unwritten in the print); 'and so I melt'
وَاَسْكُبُ: وَ + اَسْكُبُ — wa-, and + a-skubu, to pour out (1 sg. imperfect; hamza unwritten in the print); 'and I pour out'
وَاَسْاَلُ: وَ + اَسْاَلُ — wa-, and + a-sʾalu, to ask (1 sg. imperfect; hamza unwritten in the print); 'and I ask'
بِفُرْقَتِهِمْ: بِـ + فُرْقَة + هِمْ — bi-, with, by (prep.; 'by means of') + furqa, separation, parting (f.; gen.) + -him, their; 'by their parting'
رَمَانِي: رَمَا + نِي — ramā, to throw, strike, cast (3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'cast me'
يَمُنُّ: يَمُنُّ — manna, to bestow a favour (3 m. sg. imperfect; here in a wish, 'may he grant'); 'he grants'
يَوْماً: يَوْماً — yawm, day (m.; acc., adverbial 'some day'); 'one day'
دُخُولِهِ: دُخُول + هُ — dukhūl, entering, going in (to the bride) (m. verbal noun of دَخَلَ); gen. in iḍāfa; -hu, his; 'his going in'
مَوْلِدِ: مَوْلِد — mawlid, birth, birth-time (m.); gen. in iḍāfa; 'the birth of'
وَفَاتِهِ: وَفَاة + هُ — wafāt, death (f.); gen. in iḍāfa; -hu, his; 'his death'
وَقَابَلَ: وَ + قَابَلَ — wa-, and (conj.); qābala, he compared, set face to face (verb III, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and compared'
جَرَٰي: جَرَى — jarā, it happened, it befell, it ran (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.; printed with ي, read with dagger alif)
سَوَاءً: سَوَاء — sawāʾ, equal, alike (adj.); acc. (second object / state) in the idiom سَوَاءً بِسَوَاءٍ; also adverbially, 'all together, as one' (lā takhrujūna illā sawāʾan, 'do not go out except all together')
بِسَوَاءٍ: بِـ + سَوَاء — bi-, by, with (prep.; here 'by' in the idiom 'like by like'); sawāʾ, equal, alike; gen.; 'exactly alike'
وَزَوَاجُهُ: وَ + زَوَاج + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); zawāj, marriage (m.); nom.; -hu, his; 'and his marriage'
وَزَوَاجُ: وَ + زَوَاج — wa-, and (conj.); zawāj, marriage (m.); nom., first term of an iḍāfa; 'and the marriage of'
الْآخَرِ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other, another (adj./noun); gen. in iḍāfa; the print has a bare alif, the madda mark is ours; 'the other'
مُتَوَافِقَيْنِ: مُتَوَافِق + يْنِ — mutawāfiq, agreeing, coinciding (act. part. VI); dual -ayni, 'the two agreeing'; accusative/oblique form, kept as printed
وَالدُّخُولُ: وَ + الـ + دُّخُول — wa-, and (conj.); dukhūl, entering, going in (to the bride) (m.); nom.; 'and the going in'
وَوِلَادَةُ: وَ + وِلَادَة — wa-, and (conj.); wilāda, birth, childbirth (f.); nom., first term of an iḍāfa; 'and the birth of'
وَبِنْتِهِ: وَ + بِنْت + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); bint, daughter (f.); gen. (joined to Badr al-Dīn in the iḍāfa); -hu, his; 'and of his daughter'
سِتِّ: سِتّ — sitt, lady, mistress (f.; used in names, 'Sitt al-Ḥusn'); gen. in apposition
مُوَافِقًا: مُوَافِق — muwāfiq, agreeing, in accord (act. part. III); acc., singular (where the plural would be expected), kept as printed
يُؤَرَّخَ: يُؤَرَّخَ — yuʾarrakha, be dated, be recorded (verb II, passive imperf. subjunctive 3 m. sg., from أَرَّخَ); 'be recorded'
يَنْتَظِرُ: يَنْتَظِرُ — yantaẓiru, he waits for (verb VIII, imperf. 3 m. sg., from نَظَرَ); 'waiting'
وَثَالِثَ: وَ + ثَالِث — wa-, and (conj.); thālith, third (ordinal, m.); acc. of time; 'and the third'
سَبْعَةِ: سَبْعَة — sabʿa, seven (f. form, with a masculine counted noun); gen. after إِلَى, first term of an iḍāfa
سَبَقَنِي: سَبَقَ + نِي — sabaqa, he preceded, was ahead of (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); -nī, me (object); 'preceded me'
دَوَاةً: دَوَاة — dawāt, inkwell (f.); acc., object; 'an inkwell'
وَقَلَمًا: وَ + قَلَم — wa-, and (conj.); qalam, pen (m.); acc., object; 'and a pen'
نَصْبِ: نَصْب — naṣb, setting up, erecting, laying out (m. verbal noun of نَصَبَ); gen. in iḍāfa; 'the setting-up of, the arrangement of'
الْخَشْخَانَةَ: الـ + خَشْخَانَة — khashkhāna, a chamber or alcove of the house (f.; sense uncertain); acc., subject after أَنَّ; 'the khashkhana'
مَوْضِعُ: مَوْضِع — mawḍiʿ, place, position (m.); nom., predicate, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the place of'
وَالسِّتَارَةَ: وَ + الـ + سِّتَارَة — wa-, and (conj.); sitāra, curtain (f.); acc., subject after the preceding أَنَّ; 'and the curtain'
الْفُلَانِيَّةَ: الـ + فُلَانِيَّة — fulāniyya, 'so-and-so', the nisba of فُلَان (adj., f.); acc., adjective; 'the so-and-so'
طَوَى: طَوَى — ṭawā, he folded, rolled up (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
بِشَيْلِ: بِـ + شَيْل — bi-, with (prep.; أَمَرَ بِ 'command (something)'); shayl, lifting, carrying off (m. verbal noun of شَالَ, colloquial); gen.; 'to the lifting of'
الشَّاشَ: الـ + شَّاش — shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (m.); acc., object; 'the muslin'
وَالطَّرْبُوشَ: وَ + الـ + طَّرْبُوش — wa-, and (conj.); ṭarbūsh, tarboosh, a brimless cap (m.); acc., object; 'and the tarboosh'
الْفَرَجِيَّةَ: الـ + فَرَجِيَّة — farajiyya, a long loose robe (f.); acc., object; 'the farajiyya'
وَالْكِيسَ: وَ + الـ + كِيس — wa-, and (conj.); kīs, purse, bag (m.); acc., object; 'and the purse'
وَشَالَهُمْ: وَ + شَالَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); shāla, he lifted, carried off (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., colloquial); -hum, them (object); 'and put them away'
وَقَفَلَهُمْ: وَ + قَفَلَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); qafala, he locked (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); -hum, them (object); 'and locked them'
بِقُفْلٍ: بِـ + قُفْل — bi-, with (prep.; instrument); qufl, lock (m.); gen.; 'with a lock'
فَتَمَّتْ: فَـ + تَمَّتْ — fa-, and so (answers أَمَّا); tammat, it was completed (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., from تَمَّ); 'were completed'
أَشْهُرُهَا: أَشْهُر + هَا — ashhur, months (pl. of شَهْر); nom., subject; -hā, her; 'her months'
وَوَلَدَتْ: وَ + وَلَدَتْ — wa-, and (conj.); waladat, she bore (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she bore'
وَالْكَمَالِ: وَ + الـ + كَمَال — wa-, and (conj.); kamāl, perfection (m.); gen. after فِي; 'and the perfection'; also (Night 202): وَ + الـ + كَمَال — wa-, and + al-, the + kamāl, perfection (m.); gen. after min; 'and the perfection'
وَالْبَهَاءِ: وَ + الـ + بَهَاء — wa-, and (conj.); bahāʾ, splendour, radiance (m.); gen.; 'and the splendour'
سُرَّتَهُ: سُرَّة + هُ — surra, navel, navel-cord (f.); acc., object; -hu, his; 'his navel-cord'
وَكَحَّلُوا: وَ + كَحَّلُوا — wa-, and (conj.); kaḥḥalū, they applied kohl to (verb II, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they kohled'
مُقْلَنَهُ: مُقْلَة + هُ — muqla, eye (f.), here printed مقلنه, a slip for مقلته; acc., object; -hu, his; 'his eye'
وَسَلَّمُوهُ: وَ + سَلَّمُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); sallamū, they handed over (verb II, perf. 3 m. pl.); -hu, him (object); 'and they handed him'
وَسَمَّوْهُ: وَ + سَمَّوْا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); sammaw, they named (verb II, perf. 3 m. pl.); -hu, him (object); 'and they named him'
عَجِيبًا: عَجِيب — ʿAjīb ('wondrous, strange'), personal name (m.); acc., second object; 'ʿAjīb'; also: ʿajīb, wondrous, marvellous (adj., m., acc. indef.): amran ʿajīban, 'a wondrous thing' (Night 179)
يَوْمُهُ: يَوْم + هُ — yawm, day (m.); nom., subject; -hu, his; 'his day'
بِشَهْرٍ: بِـ + شَهْر — bi-, with (prep.; here 'equal to, worth'); shahr, month (m.); gen.; 'as a month'
شَهْرُهُ: شَهْر + هُ — shahr, month (m.); nom.; -hu, his; 'his month'
بِسَنَةٍ: بِـ + سَنَة — bi-, with (prep.; here 'equal to, worth'); sana, year (f.); gen.; 'as a year'
لِفَقِيهٍ: لِـ + فَقِيه — li-, to (prep.; after أَعْطَى 'give to'); faqīh, jurist, schoolmaster (m.); gen.; 'to a schoolmaster'
وَوَصَّاهُ: وَ + وَصَّى + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); waṣṣā, he charged, enjoined (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.); -hu, him (object); 'and charged him'
يُرَبِّيَهُ: يُرَبِّيَ + هُ — yurabbiya, he rears, brings up (verb II, subjunctive 3 m. sg., from رَبَّى); -hu, him; 'to rear him'
وَيُقْرِئَهُ: وَ + يُقْرِئَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); yuqriʾa, he teaches to read, makes recite (verb IV, subjunctive, from قَرَأَ); -hu, him; 'and teach him to read'
وَيُحْسِنَ: وَ + يُحْسِنَ — wa-, and (conj.); yuḥsina, he does well, makes good (verb IV, subjunctive 3 m. sg.); 'and do well'
الْمَكْتَبِ: الـ + مَكْتَب — maktab, school, elementary school (m.); gen. after فِي / in iḍāfa; 'the school'
سَبَوَاتٍ: سَبَوَات — sabawāt, printed for سَنَوَات sanawāt, years (pl. of سَنَة); gen. in iḍāfa; 'years'
يُقَاتِلُ: يُقَاتِلُ — yuqātilu, he fights (verb III, imperf. 3 m. sg.); صَارَ يُقَاتِلُ 'began to fight'
وَيَسُبُّهُمْ: وَ + يَسُبُّ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); yasubbu, he curses, abuses (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg.); -hum, them (object); 'and abuses them'
الْأَوْلَادُ: الـ + أَوْلَاد — awlād, boys, children (pl. of وَلَد); nom., subject (with a feminine singular verb); 'the boys'
يَشْكُونَ: يَشْكُونَ — yashkūna, they complain (verb I, imperf. 3 m. pl., from شَكَا; يَشْكُونَ لِـ 'complain to'); 'complaining'
لِلْعَرِيفِ: لِـ + الـ + عَرِيف — li-, to (prep.; شَكَا لِـ 'complain to'); ʿarīf, monitor, overseer (m.); gen.; 'to the monitor'
قَاسَوْهُ: قَاسَوْا + هُ — qāsaw, they suffered, endured (verb III, perf. 3 m. pl., from قَاسَى); -hu, it (relative object); 'they suffered'
عَجِيبٍ: عَجِيب — ʿAjīb, personal name (m.); gen. after مِنْ ('from'); 'ʿAjīb'
الْعَرِيفُ: الـ + عَرِيف — ʿarīf, monitor, overseer (m.); nom., subject; 'the monitor'; ʿarīf is the headman of a trade or market: 'the headman'
لَمَّايَجِي: لَمَّا + يَجِي — lammā, when (conj.); yajī, he comes (colloquial for يَجِيءُ); run together in the print; 'when he comes'
أُعَلِّمُكُمْ: أُعَلِّمُ + كُمْ — uʿallimu, I teach (verb II, imperf. 1 sg.); -kum, you (m. pl., object); 'I will teach you'
تَقُولُوهُ: تَقُولُوا + هُ — taqūlū, you say (verb I, imperf. 2 m. pl., final -na dropped in this relative clause); -hu, it (object); 'you say it'
فَيَتُوبَ: فَـ + يَتُوبَ — fa-, so that (conj. + subjunctive, expressing result); yatūba, he repents, gives up (verb I, subjunctive 3 m. sg., from تَابَ); 'so that he gives up'
الْمَجِي: الـ + مَجِي — majī, coming (m. verbal noun, colloquial spelling of مَجِيء); gen.; 'the coming'
لِلْمَكْتَبِ: لِـ + الـ + مَكْتَب — li-, to (prep.; here 'to the school'); maktab, school (m.); gen.; 'to the school'
فَاقْعُدُوا: فَـ + اقْعُدُوا — fa-, then (conj., apodosis of إِذَا); iqʿudū, sit (verb I, imperative m. pl., from قَعَدَ); 'then sit'
وَقُولُوا: وَ + قُولُوا — wa-, and (conj.); qūlū, say (verb I, imperative m. pl.); 'and say'
اللُّعْبَةَ: الـ + لُّعْبَة — luʿba, game, play (f.); acc., object; 'the game'
وَأَبِيهِ: وَ + أَب + هِ — wa-, and (conj.); ab, father (m.; construct form abī- before a suffix); gen.; -hi, his; 'and his father'
يَعْرِفِ: يَعْرِفِ — yaʿrifi, he knows (verb I, jussive 3 m. sg., from عَرَفَ; -i before al-); 'does not know'
اسْمَ: اسْم — ism, name (m.); acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the name of'
حَرَامٍ: حَرَام — ḥarām, forbidden, unlawful (m.); gen. in iḍāfa; ابْنُ حَرَامٍ 'bastard'
يَلْعَبْ: يَلْعَبْ — yalʿab, he plays (verb I, jussive 3 m. sg.); 'play'
وَحَضَرَ: وَ + حَضَرَ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥaḍara, he was present, arrived (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and arrived'
فَأَحَاطَتْ: فَـ + أَحَاطَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.); aḥāṭat, she/it surrounded (verb IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and surrounded'
نَلْعَبُ: نَلْعَبُ — nalʿabu, we play (verb I, imperf. 1 pl.)
لُعْبَةً: لُعْبَة — luʿba, game (f.); acc., object; 'a game'
اسْمِي: اسْم + ي — ism, name (m.); nom., -ī, my; 'my name'
مَاجِدٌ: مَاجِد — Mājid ('glorious'), personal name (m.); nom., predicate
عَلَوِيَّهْ: عَلَوِيَّة — ʿAlawiyya, personal name (f.); printed with final ه; nom., predicate
عِزُّالدِّينِ: عِزّ + الـ + دِّين — ʿIzz al-Dīn ('might of the faith'), personal name (m.); written as one word in the print; nom., predicate
قَوْلِهِ: قَوْل + هِ — qawl, saying, speech (m.); gen. in iḍāfa after مِثْلَ; -hi, his; 'his saying'
الدَّوْرُ: الـ + دَّوْر — dawr, turn, round (m.); nom., subject; 'the turn'
وَأَبِي: وَ + أَب + ي — wa-, and (conj.); ab, father (m.); -ī, my; 'and my father'
حَقِيقٌ: حَقِيق — ḥaqīq, true, real (adj.; perhaps for ḥaqīqī); nom.; 'truly'
الْأَوْلَادُ: الـ + أَوْلَاد — awlād, boys, children (pl. of وَلَد); nom., subject (with a feminine singular verb); 'the boys'
أَبٌ: أَب — ab, father (m.); nom., indefinite; 'a father'
تَفَرَّقَتِ: تَفَرَّقَتِ — tafarraqat, she/it dispersed (verb V, perf. 3 f. sg., with a helping kasra before al-); 'dispersed'
حَوْلِهِ: حَوْل + هِ — ḥawl, around (m. noun/prep.); gen. after مِنْ; -hi, him; 'from around him'
وَتَضَا: وَ + تَضَا — wa-, and (conj.); taḍā-, first half of تَضَاحَكُوا taḍāḥakū, 'they laughed together' (verb VI), which the print splits in two
حَكُوا: حَكُوا — -ḥakū, second half of تَضَاحَكُوا (see وَتَضَا); 'they laughed together (at him)'
فَضَاقَ: فَـ + ضَاقَ — fa-, and so (conj.); ḍāqa, it became narrow, tight (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and was tight'
وَانْخَنَقَ: وَ + انْخَنَقَ — wa-, and (conj.); inkhanaqa, he was choked (verb VII, perf. 3 m. sg., from خَنَقَ); 'and was choked'
جَدَّكَ: جَدّ + كَ — jadd, grandfather (m.); acc., object; -ka, your (m.); 'your grandfather'
أُمِّكَ: أُمّ + كَ — umm, mother (f.); gen. in iḍāfa; -ka, your; 'your mother'
زَوَّجَهَا: زَوَّجَ + هَا — zawwaja, he married off (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.); -hā, her (object); 'married her off'
لِلْأَحْدَبِ: لِـ + الـ + أَحْدَب — li-, to (prep.; زَوَّجَ لِـ 'marry off to'); aḥdab, hunchbacked (adj./noun, m.); gen.; 'to the hunchback'
وَجَاءَتِ: وَ + جَاءَتِ — wa-, and (conj.); jāʾat, she/it came (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., with a helping kasra before al-); 'and came'
الْجِنُّ: الـ + جِنّ — jinn, the jinn (pl. collective); nom., subject; 'the jinn'
نَامُوا: نَامُوا — nāmū, they slept (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl., from نَامَ)
تَقِيسُ: تَقِيسُ — taqīsu, you measure (yourself against) (verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg., from قَاسَ; sense uncertain); 'vying with'
صِغَارَ: صِغَار — ṣighār, small ones, little ones (pl. of صَغِير); acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the little ones of'
تَعْرِفَ: تَعْرِفَ — taʿrifa, you know (verb I, subjunctive 2 m. sg.); 'you know'
أَبًا: أَب — ab, father (m.); acc., object; 'a father'
وَإِلَّابَقِيتَ: وَ + إِلَّا + بَقِيتَ — wa-, and (conj.); illā, if not, otherwise (= وَإِلَّا, 'and if not'); baqīta, you remained (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.); run together in the print; 'and if not, you would remain'
وَلَدَزِنًا: وَلَد + زِنًا — walad, child, boy (m.); acc., predicate of بَقِيتَ; zinan, fornication (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; written as one word, 'a child of fornication, a bastard'
أَلَاتَرَٰي: أَ + لَا + تَرَى — a-, interrogative particle; lā, not; tarā, you see (verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg., from رَأَى); run together in the print; 'do you not see'
الْبَيَّاعِ: الـ + بَيَّاع — bayyāʿ, seller, vendor (m.); gen. in iḍāfa; 'the seller'
بِأَبِيهِ: بِـ + أَب + هِ — bi-, by (prep.; يُعْرَفُ بِ 'be known by'); ab, father (m.; construct form abī-); -hi, his; 'by his father'
جَدُّكَ: جَدّ + كَ — jadd, grandfather (m.); nom., subject; -ka, your; 'your grandfather'
نَعْرِفُهُ: نَعْرِفُ + هُ — naʿrifu, we know (verb I, imperf. 1 pl.); -hu, him (object); 'we know him'
فَاصْحَ: فَـ + اصْحَ — fa-, so (conj.); iṣḥa, wake up, come to your senses (verb I, imperative m. sg., from صَحَا); 'so wake up'
الْعَرِيفِ: الـ + عَرِيف — ʿarīf, monitor (m.); gen. after مِنْ; 'the monitor'
تَعْيِيرَهُمْ: تَعْيِير + هُمْ — taʿyīr, taunting, reproaching (m. verbal noun of عَيَّرَ); acc., object; -hum, their; 'their taunting'
وَالِدَتِهِ: وَالِدَة + هُ — wālida, mother (f.); gen. after عَلَى; -hu, his; دَخَلَ عَلَى 'go in to'; 'his mother'; also gen., second term of an iḍāfa: bayti wālidatihi, 'his mother's house' (Night 194)
وَشَكَى: وَ + شَكَى — wa-, and (conj.); shakā, he complained (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.; printed with ى); 'and complained'
أُمُّهُ: أُمّ + هُ — umm, mother (f.); nom., subject; -hu, his; 'his mother'
وَبُكَاءَهُ: وَ + بُكَاء + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); bukāʾ, weeping (m.); acc., object; -hu, his; 'and his weeping'
الْتَهَبَ: الْتَهَبَ — iltahaba, it caught fire, blazed (verb VIII, perf. 3 m. sg., from لَهَبَ)
قَلْبُهَا: قَلْب + هَا — qalb, heart (m.); nom., subject; -hā, her; 'her heart'
أَبْكَاكَ: أَبْكَى + كَ — abkā, he made weep (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg., from بَكَى); -ka, you (object); 'made you weep'
فَاحْكِ: فَـ + احْكِ — fa-, so (conj.); iḥki, tell, relate (verb I, imperative m. sg., from حَكَى); 'so tell'
قِصَّتَكَ: قِصَّة + كَ — qiṣṣa, story, tale (f.); acc., object; -ka, your; 'your story'
هُوَيَا: هُوَ + يَا — huwa, he (3 m. sg. pron.); yā, O (vocative); run together in the print; 'is he, O'
وَزِبْرُ: وَزِير — wazīr, vizier (m.), here misprinted وزبر with ب for ي; nom., predicate, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the vizier of'
تُخْبِرِينِي: تُخْبِرِي + نِي — tukhbirī, you inform (verb IV, jussive 2 f. sg., from أَخْبَرَ); -nī, me (object); 'you tell me'
بِالصَّحِيحِ: بِـ + الـ + صَّحِيح — bi-, with (prep.; أَخْبَرَ بِ 'inform of'); ṣaḥīḥ, true, sound (adj./noun); gen.; 'of the truth'
الْخَنْجَزِ: الـ + خَنْجَز — khanjar, dagger (m.), here misprinted الخنجز with ز for ر; gen., in apposition after هَذَا; 'the dagger'
وَالِدَتُهُ: وَالِدَة + هُ — wālida, mother (f.); nom., subject; -hu, his; 'his mother'
لِلذِّكْرِ: لِـ + الـ + ذِّكْر — li-, at (prep., 'on account of'); dhikr, mention, remembrance (m.); gen.; the article is the print's; 'at the mention'
وَتَذَكَّرَتْ: وَ + تَذَكَّرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.); tadhakkarat, she remembered (verb V, perf. 3 f. sg., from ذَكَرَ); 'and she remembered'
وَمَاجَرَٰي: وَ + مَا + جَرَى — wa-, and (conj.); mā, what (rel.); jarā, it happened (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); run together in the print; 'and what happened'
اَقَامُوا: aqāma (IV), to set up, establish; -ū, 3 m. pl. perfect: 'they set up' (the print has bare اقاموا, here pointed)
الْوَجْدَ: al- + wajd, longing, passion (m.); acc. object: 'the longing'
وَسَارُوْا: wa-, and + sāra, to go, set out; -ū, they (3 m. pl. perf.; the final و is printed with sukūn and the alif is silent): 'and they departed'
شَطَتْ: shaṭṭa (shaṭat), to be far, grow distant; 3 f. sg. perfect, agreeing with al-diyār (f. by agreement as a plural of things): 'it has grown distant'
اَهْوَى: ahwā, I love (I form, hawiya) 1 sg. imperf.: 'I love'
الدِّيَارُ: al- + diyār, homes, abodes (pl. of dār, f.): 'the abodes'
تَجَلُّدِي: tajallud + -ī, my fortitude, steadfastness (m., vn. of V tajallada): 'my fortitude'
بَانُوْا: bānū, they went away, parted (bāna + -ū, 3 m. pl. perf.; final و printed with sukūn): 'they departed'
وَفَارَقَنِي: wa-, and + fāraqa (III), to leave, part from + -nī, me (obj.): 'and left me'
وَعَزَّ: wa-, and + ʿazza, to be dear, rare, hard to find (3 m. sg. perf.): 'and became rare'; here: imperative, 'and be mighty!' (verse; answered by ahun, 'I am humbled')
الاِصْطِبَارُ: al- + iṣṭibār, patience (m., vn. VIII): 'the patience'
سَارُوْا: sārū, they went, set out (3 m. pl. perf.; final و with sukūn)
عُلِمَ: ʿulima, to be known (passive of ʿalima, 3 m. sg. perf.): 'it is known'
الْقَرَارُ: al- + qarār, abiding, rest, settled state (m.): 'the abiding'
قَرَارُ: qarār, abiding, rest; indefinite after lā: 'abiding'
وَاَجْرَوْا: wa-, and + ajrā (IV), to make flow + -w, they (3 m. pl. perf.; final و printed with sukūn and alif): 'and they made flow'
فَاَدْ: fa- + ad, a word divided in the print; most likely fa- + admuʿ (pl. of dam', 'tears'), i.e. 'so its tears'; uncertain, possibly corrupt: 'so ... (the tears)'
مَعْهَا: maʿ, with (prep.) + -hā, it (f.); the print splits the word, so possibly -muʿ-hā 'its tears': 'with it'
بِبُعْدِهِمْ: bi-, by, through (prep.) + buʿd, distance, absence (m.) + -him, their: 'through their distance'
غِزَارُ: ghizār, abundant, copious (pl. of ghazīra or adj. m. sg.): 'copious, torrential'
اشْتَقْتُ: ishtāqa (VIII), to long for, yearn + -tu, I (1 sg. perf.): 'I longed'
اَرَاهُمْ: arā, I see (1 sg. imperf., subj.) + -hum, them (obj.): 'to see them'
وَطَالَ: wa-, and + ṭāla, to be long, to last (3 m. sg. perf.): 'and grew long'
حَنِينٌ: ḥanīn, longing, yearning (m.), nom. tanwīn: 'a longing'
وَانْتِظَارُ: wa-, and + intiẓār, waiting, expectation (m., vn. VIII): 'and waiting'
اَتَمَثَّلُ: atamaththalu, I picture, imagine (V tamaththala), 1 sg. imperf.: 'I picture'
شَخْصَهُمْ: shakhṣ, person, figure, form (m.) + -hum, their: 'their figure'
غَرَامٌ: gharām, passion, ardent love (m.), nom. tanwīn: 'passion'
وَاشْتِيَاقٌ: wa-, and + ishtiyāq, longing, yearning (m., vn. VIII): 'and longing'
وَافْتِكَارُ: wa-, and + iftikār, thought, brooding (m., vn. VIII): 'and brooding'
:اَضْحَى: aḍḥā, to become (IV, 3 m. sg. perf.); the colon before the word is a stray mark in the print: 'has become'
حُبَّا: ḥubb, love (m.), here ḥubbā with fatḥatān, acc.: 'love'; obscure, perhaps corrupt
هَوَيْ: hawā (hawy in the print), love, passion (m.); the last letter is printed ي: 'passion'
اَحِبَّتَنَا: aḥibba, beloved ones (pl. of ḥabīb) + -nā, our (vocative): 'our beloved ones'
التَّمَادِي: al- + tamādī, persistence, obstinacy (m., vn. VI tamādā): 'the persisting'
التَّبَاعُدُ: al- + tabāʿud, distance, estrangement (m., vn. VI): 'the distance'
وَالنِّفَارُ: wa-, and + al- + nifār, aversion, shunning (m.): 'and the aversion'
وَلَدُهَا: wa-, and + walad, son, child (m.) + -hā, her: 'and her son'
بُكَائِهِمَا: bukāʾ, weeping (m., vn. of bakā) + -himā, their (dual, gen.): 'their weeping' (the print has the precomposed ئ)
احْتَرَقَ: iḥtaraqa (VIII), to burn, be scorched (3 m. sg. perf.): 'burned'
يُبْكِيكُمَا: yubkī, he makes weep (IV bakā, 3 m. sg. imperf.) + -kumā, you two (obj.): 'what makes you two weep'; mā is the interrogative 'what' in the previous word
فَأخْبَرَتْهُ: fa-, and, so + akhbara (IV), to inform, tell + -at, she (3 f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him: 'and she told him'
لِوَلَدِهَا: li-, for, to (prep.) + walad, son + -hā, her: 'to her son'
صِغَارِ: ṣighār, small ones, boys (pl. of ṣaghīr) in construct: 'the small ones of'
أخَاهُ: akh, brother (m.), acc. in the long form akhā + -hu, his: 'his brother'
بَاطِنِ: bāṭin, inside, interior (m.), in construct (the print's mā fī bāṭin 'what is in the inside of'): 'inside of'
فَفِى: fa-, and, so + fī, in (prep.) (the print ففى, with final ى for ي): 'so in'
وَأخْبَرَهُ: wa-, and + akhbara (IV), to inform + -hu, him: 'and informed him'
وَيَعْبُرُ: wa-, and + yaʿburu, to cross, pass through (3 m. sg. imperf., indicative where the Classical is subjunctive): 'and he crosses'
مَدِينَةَ: madīna, city (f.), acc. in construct: 'the city of'
وَيَسْأَلُ: wa-, and + yasʾalu, to ask (3 m. sg. imperf., indicative where the Classical is subjunctive): 'and he asks'
يَكْتُبَ: yaktuba, he writes (3 m. sg. subjunctive after an): 'that he write'
مَرَاسِيمَ: marāsīm, decrees, orders (pl. of marsūm, m.), acc.: 'decrees'
أيَّ: ayy, which, any, whichever (m.), acc. here as an adverbial phrase of place: 'whichever'
وَجَدَ: wajada, to find (3 m. sg. perf.): 'he found'
يَأْخُذُهُ: yaʾkhudhu, to take (3 m. sg. imperf., indicative) + -hu, him: 'he takes him, he take him'
فَرَقَّ: fa-, so, and + raqqa, to be soft, be moved (3 m. sg. perf.): 'so he was softened'
الْأقَالِيمِ: al- + aqālīm, regions, provinces (pl. of iqlīm, m.): 'the regions'
وَالْبِلَادِ: wa-, and + al- + bilād, lands: 'and the lands'
وَدَعٰي: wa-, and + daʿā, to pray, invoke (3 m. sg. perf., spelled دعي in the print): 'and he prayed'
لِلسُّلْطَانِ: li-, for (prep.) + al- + sulṭān, sultan: 'for the sultan'
وَوَدَّعَهُ: wa-, and + waddaʿa (II), to bid farewell + -hu, him: 'and bade him farewell'
وَأخَذَ: wa-, and + akhadha, to take (3 m. sg. perf.): 'and he took'
مَايَحْتَاجُ: mā, what (rel.) + yaḥtāju, he needs (VIII, 3 m. sg. imperf.), printed as one word: 'what he needs'
وَبِنْتَهُ: wa-, and + bint, daughter (f.) + -hu, his: 'and his daughter'
وَوَلَدَهُ: wa-, and + walad, son, boy (m.) + -hu, his: 'and his boy'
عَجِيبَ: ʿajīb, ʿAjīb, a personal name (m.; acc., second object, printed without the alif): 'ʿAjīb'
أوَّلَ: awwal, first (m.), acc. in construct: 'the first of'
إىٰ: ilā, to, until (prep.) (spelled اى in the print, with the lām dropped): 'until, to'
أشْجَارٍ: ashjār, trees (pl. of shajar, m.), gen. tanwīn: 'trees'
وَأنْهَارٍ: wa-, and + anhār, rivers (pl. of nahr, m.), gen. tanwīn: 'and rivers'
وَلَيْلَتِي: wa-, and + layla, night (f.) + -tī, my: 'and my night'
بِمِثْلِهَا: bi-, by (prep., in an oath) + mithl, like, the like of (m.) + -hā, it (f.): 'by the like of it'
لَايَغْلَطِ: lā-, not + yaghlaṭi, he errs, makes a mistake (3 m. sg. imperf.; final kasra is the rhyme vowel): 'he will not err'
بِتْنَا: bitnā, to spend the night (bāta; 1 pl. perf.): 'we spent the night'
وَجِنْحُ: wa-, and + jinḥ, wing, side (m.), in construct: 'and the wing of'
غَفَلَاتِهِ: fī, in (prep.) + ghafalāt, heedless moments, carelessness (pl. of ghafla) + -hi, its: 'in its heedlessness'
وَالصُّبْحُ: wa-, and + al- + ṣubḥ, dawn, morning (m.): 'and the dawn'
بِفَرْعِ: bi-, with (prep.) + farʿ, branch, lock of hair, head of hair (m.), in construct: 'with the lock of'
اَشْمَطِ: ashmaṭ, grey-haired (adj., black and white mixed hair, diptote; kasra for the rhyme): 'a grizzled one'
وَالظِّلُّ: wa-, and + al- + ẓill, shade (m.): 'and the shade'
:الْغُصُونِ: al- + ghuṣūn, branches (pl. of ghuṣn, m.): 'the branches'
كَاَنَّهُ: ka-, like (prep.) + anna, that (conj.) + -hu, it: 'as though it'
دُرٌّ: durr, pearls (coll., m.), nom. tanwīn with shadda: 'pearls'
يُصَافِحُهُ: yuṣāfiḥu, to clasp hands with (III, 3 m. sg. imperf.) + -hu, it: 'clasps hands with it'
فَيَسْقُطِ: fa-, so, and + yasquṭu, to fall (3 m. sg. imperf.; final kasra is the rhyme vowel): 'so it falls'
وَالطَّيْرُ: wa-, and + al- + ṭayr, bird, birds (coll., m.): 'and the bird'
تَقْرَاُ: taqraʾu, to read (3 f. sg. imperf.; the print marks a bare hamza as a damma on alif): 'it reads'
وَالْغَدِيرُ: wa-, and + al- + ghadīr, brook, pool (m.): 'and the brook'
صَحِيفَةٌ: ṣaḥīfa, page, sheet (f.), nom. tanwīn: 'a page'
تَكْتُبُ: taktubu, to write (3 f. sg. imperf.): 'it writes'
وَالْغَمَامُ: wa-, and + al- + ghamām, cloud (coll., m.): 'and the cloud'
يُنَقِّطِ: yunaqqiṭu, to dot (II, 3 m. sg. imperf.; final kasra is the rhyme vowel): 'it dots (marks with points)'
مَيْدَانِ: مَيْدَان — maydān, open field, parade-ground (m., gen. after fī; first term of the genitive phrase); 'the field of'
الْحَصَى: الـ + حَصًى — ḥaṣā, pebbles, gravel (coll. m., gen.); 'the pebbles'; with the preceding word, the Pebble Field, a place outside Damascus
الرَّاحَةَ: الـ + رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, repose (f., acc. object); al-, the; 'the rest'
الْغِلْمَانُ: الـ + غِلْمَان — ghilmān, lads, servants (broken pl. of غُلَام, nom. subject); al-, the; 'the lads'
لِقَضَاءِ: لِـ + قَضَاء — qaḍāʾ, accomplishing, fulfilling (v.n. of قَضَى, gen. after li-); li-, for (prep. of purpose); 'for the fulfilling of'
حَوَائِجِهِمْ: حَوَائِج + هِمْ — ḥawāʾij, needs, errands (pl. of حَاجَة, gen., second term of the genitive phrase) + -him, their (3 m. pl.); 'their needs'
يَبِيعُ: يَبِيعُ — bāʿa, to sell (v., present 3 m. sg.); 'sells'
يَشْتَرِي: يَشْتَرِي — ishtarā, to buy (v., form VIII, present 3 m. sg.); 'buys'
جَامِعَ: جَامِع — jāmiʿ, congregational mosque (m., acc. object, first term of the genitive phrase); 'the mosque of'
أُمَيَّةَ: أُمَيَّة — Umayya, the name of the ancestor of the Umayyads (proper name, diptote, gen.); jāmiʿ banī umayya is the Great Mosque of Damascus; 'Umayya'
وَخَادِمُهُ: وَـ + خَادِم + هُ — khādim, servant (here the eunuch, m., nom.) + -hu, his; wa-, and (joining the second subject); 'and his servant'
وَالْخَادِمُ: وَـ + الـ + خَادِم — khādim, servant, eunuch (m., nom.); al-, the; wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while'); 'and the servant'
بِبَنْبُوتٍ: بِـ + بَنْبُوت — banbūt, club, heavy staff (m., gen.; possibly a form of نَبُّوت); bi-, with (preposition of instrument); 'with a club'
ضُرِبَ: ضُرِبَ — ḍaraba, to strike (v., past passive 3 m. sg.); 'were struck'
جَمَلٌ: جَمَل — jamal, camel (m., nom. indef., subject of the passive); 'a camel'
تَارَ: تَارَ — tāra, to rise up, stir (v., past 3 m. sg.; printed ت for ثَارَ); after لَوْ, 'it would (not) rise'
وَاعْتِدَا: وَـ + اِعْتِدَا(ل) — iʿtidāl, evenness, symmetry (v.n. of form VIII of عَدَلَ); wa-, and; the print splits the word with a space, and this is the first half, completed by the next word; 'and his symmetry'
لِهِ: (اِعْتِدَا)لِ + هِ — the second half of the split word iʿtidāl: the final lām with its gen. vowel + -hi, his; read together with the previous word, 'his symmetry'
وَبَهَائِهِ: وَـ + بَهَاء + هِ — bahāʾ, radiance, splendour (m., gen.) + -hi, his; wa-, and; 'and his radiance'
غُلَامٌ: غُلَام — ghulām, lad, boy (m., nom. indef., predicate); 'a lad'; also nom. as the subject of kāna: kāna ghulāmun bāʾitan ʿindī, 'a lad spent the night with me' (Night 193)
بَدِيعُ: بَدِيع — badīʿ, wondrous, marvellous (adj., m., nom., first term of the genitive phrase); 'wondrous of'
رَخِيمُ: رَخِيم — rakhīm, soft, sweet, tender (adj., m., nom.); 'soft of'
أَلْطَفُ: أَلْطَف — alṭaf, gentler, finer (elative of لَطِيف, nom.); 'gentler'
نَسِيمِ: نَسِيم — nasīm, breeze (m., gen. after min); 'the breeze of'
الشَّمَالِ: الـ + شَّمَال — shamāl, north, north wind (m., gen.); al-, the; 'the north'
وَأَحْلَى: وَـ + أَحْلَى — aḥlā, sweeter (elative of حُلْو, nom.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and sweeter'
الزُّلَالِ: الـ + زُّلَال — zulāl, sweet, cool and fresh (of water; adj., gen.); al-, the; 'the fresh'
لِلظَّمْآنِ: لِـ + الـ + ظَّمْآن — ẓamʾān, thirsty (adj., m., gen.); li-, for (prep. marking the one benefited); al-, the; 'for the thirsty'
وَأَلَذُّ: وَـ + أَلَذّ — aladhdh, more delicious, more pleasing (elative of لَذِيذ, nom.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and more delicious'
الْعَافِيَهِ: الـ + عَافِيَة — ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f., gen. after min; printed with ه for ة); al-, the; 'the health'
لِصَاحِبِ: لِـ + صَاحِب — ṣāḥib, owner, possessor (m., gen.); li-, for (prep. marking the one benefited); 'for the owner of'
السَّقَامِ: الـ + سَّقَام — saqām, illness (m., gen.); al-, the; 'the illness' (so 'for the sick')
تَبِعَهُ: تَبِعَ + هُ — tabiʿa, to follow (v., past 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'followed him'
جَمٌّ: جَمّ — jamm, multitude, throng (m., nom. indef.); with غَفِير 'a great crowd'
غَفِيرٌ: غَفِير — ghafīr, abundant, great (adj., m., nom.); jamm ghafīr, 'a great throng'
وَتَسْبِقُهُ: وَـ + تَسْبِقُ + هُ — sabaqa, to outstrip, get ahead of (v., present 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; wa-, and (conj.); 'and outstripping him'
يَجِيءَ: يَجِيءَ — jāʾa, to come (v., present 3 m. sg., subj.); 'he comes'
وَيَنْظُرُوهُ: وَـ + يَنْظُرُوا + هُ — naẓara, to look at (v., present 3 m. pl., subj. with the final nūn dropped) + -hu, him; wa-, and (conj.); 'and they look at him'
ذَقْنُهُ: ذَقْن + هُ — dhaqn, chin, beard (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his beard'
وَتَكَامَلَ: وَـ + تَكَامَلَ — takāmala, to become complete, reach fullness (v., form VI, past 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and had come to completeness'
الِاثْنَيْ: الـ + اِثْنَيْ — ithnay, two (m. construct form in the numeral 'twelve'); al-, the (the article on the number is non-Classical); 'the twelve'
وَدُكَّانَهُ: وَـ + دُكَّان + هُ — dukkān, shop (m., acc. object) + -hu, his; wa-, and (conj.); 'and his shop'
اعْتَرَفَ: اِعْتَرَفَ — iʿtarafa, to acknowledge, confess (v., form VIII, past 3 m. sg.); 'he acknowledged'
الْقُضَاةِ: الـ + قُضَاة — quḍāt, judges (pl. of قَاضٍ, gen.); al-, the; 'the judges'
وَالشُّهُودِ: وَـ + الـ + شُّهُود — shuhūd, witnesses (pl. of شَاهِد, gen.); al-, the; wa-, and; 'and the witnesses'
إِى: إِى — ilā, to, at (prep.), here printed إى with the lam dropped (a slip); 'at'
فَخَفَقَ: فَـ + خَفَقَ — khafaqa, to throb, flutter (v., past 3 m. sg.); fa-, and so; 'so (it) throbbed'
فُؤَادُهُ: فُؤَاد + هُ — fuʾād, heart (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his heart'
وَحَنَّ: وَـ + حَنَّ — ḥanna, to yearn, feel tenderness (v., past 3 m. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (it) yearned'
الدَّمُ: الـ + دَّم — dam, blood (m., nom.); al-, the; 'the blood'
الدَّمِ: الـ + دَّم — dam, blood (m., gen. after ilā); al-, the; 'the blood'
طَبَخَ: طَبَخَ — ṭabakha, to cook (v., past 3 m. sg.); 'cooked'
مُحَلَّي: مُحَلَّى — muḥallā, sweetened (pass. part. of form II of حَلَّى, adj., acc.; printed with ي); 'sweetened'
وَهَاجَتْ: وَـ + هَاجَتْ — hāja, to be stirred up, rise (v., past 3 f. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (it) was stirred'
الْمَحَبَّةُ: الـ + مَحَبَّة — maḥabba, love (f., nom.); al-, the; 'the love'
الْآلٰهِيَّةُ: الـ + إِلٰهِيَّة — ilāhiyya, divine (f. adj. from إِلٰه, 'god', nom.; printed with a madda, الآلهية); al-, the; 'the divine'
وَفُؤَادِي: وَـ + فُؤَاد + ي — fuʾād, heart, inner heart (m., acc.) + -ī, my; wa-, and (conj.); 'and my heart-core'
وَتَجْبُرَ: وَـ + تَجْبُرَ — jabara, to mend (a bone), set right, console (v., present 2 m. sg., subj.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (you) mend'
وَتَأْكُلَ: وَـ + تَأْكُلَ — akala, to eat (v., present 2 m. sg., subj.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (you) eat'
طَعَامِي: طَعَام + ي — ṭaʿām, food (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; 'my food'
دَمَعَتْ: دَمَعَتْ — damaʿa, to shed tears, stream (v., past 3 f. sg.); 'ran (with tears)'
وَافْتَكَرَ: وَـ + اِفْتَكَرَ — iftakara, to remember, reflect (v., form VIII, past 3 m. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he remembered'
وَمَاهُوَ: وَـ + مَا + هُوَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + huwa, he is (3 m. sg. pron.), printed as one word; wa-, and (conj.); 'and what he is'
الْخَادِمِ: الـ + خَادِم — khādim, servant (m., gen. after ilā); al-, the; 'the servant'; in a palace usually the eunuch: here 'the eunuch', to whom the king hands Qamar al-Zamān
وَكَأَنَّهُ: وَـ + كَـ + أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (conj.) + -hu, he; ka-, like, as (prep.; ka-anna, 'as if'); wa-, and (conj.); 'and as if he'
فَارَقَ: فَارَقَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (v., form III, past 3 m. sg.); 'had parted from'
لِنَجْبُرَ: لِـ + نَجْبُرَ — jabara, to mend, console (v., present 1 pl., subj.; na-, we); li-, so that (prep. of purpose, with the subjunctive); 'so that we mend'
قَلْبَهُ: قَلْب + هُ — qalb, heart (m., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his heart' ; also: vocative (first term of iḍāfa, acc.) after yā: yā qalbahu, 'O his heart'
وَنَأْكُلَ: وَـ + نَـ + أْكُلَ — akala, to eat (v., present 1 pl., subj.; na-, we; the hamza is printed precomposed); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (we) eat'
ضِيَافَتَهُ: ضِيَافَة + هُ — ḍiyāfa, hospitality, guest-feast (f., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his hospitality'
بِفِعْلِنَا: بِـ + فِعْل + نَا — fiʿl, deed, action (m., gen.) + -nā, our; bi-, by, through (prep. of cause); 'through our deed'
شَمْلَنَا: شَمْل + نَا — shaml, union, being together (m., acc. object) + -nā, our; jamaʿa shamlahu, 'bring a family together'; 'our union'
بِأَبِينَا: بِـ + أَبِي + نَا — abī, father (gen. form of abū) + -nā, our; bi-, with (jamaʿa bi-, 'unite with'); 'with our father'
الْخَادِمُ: الـ + خَادِم — khādim, servant (m., nom.); al-, the; 'the servant'; in a palace usually the eunuch who keeps the women's quarters or the door: 'the eunuch' (Night 193)
تَبْقَٰي: تَبْقَٰى — baqiya, to remain, become (v., present 2 m. sg.; colloquial 'to be'; printed with ي); 'you remain'
وَتَأْكُلُ: وَـ + تَأْكُلُ — akala, to eat (v., present 2 m. sg., indic.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (you) eat'
أَحْجُبُ: أَحْجُبُ — ḥajaba, to screen, keep out of sight, hold back (v., present 1 sg.); 'I screen'
الْعَصَا: الـ + عَصَا — ʿaṣā, staff, stick (f.); al-, the; 'the staff'
يَنْظُرُوا: يَنْظُرُوا — naẓara, to look (v., present 3 m. pl., subj. after an, without final nūn); 'they look'
الْنَفَتَ: اِلْنَفَتَ — iltafata, to turn (v., form VIII, past 3 m. sg.); the print has ن for ت, a slip; 'turned'
وَدُمُوعُهُ: وَـ + دُمُوع + هُ — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع, nom.) + -hu, his; wa-, and (circumstantial, 'with'); 'with his tears'
لِلْخَادِمِ: لِـ + الـ + خَادِم — khādim, servant (m., gen.); li-, to (prep. marking the person addressed); al-, the; 'to the servant'
أَحَبَّهُ: أَحَبَّ + هُ — aḥabba, to love (v., form IV, past 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'loved him'
تَدْخُلْ: تَدْخُلْ — dakhala, to enter (v., present 2 m. sg., jussive); 'you enter'
كَبِيرُ: كَبِير — kabīr, big, elder (adj., m.; yā kabīr, 'O elder', a respectful address); 'elder' Also in construct, 'great of': kabīru al-sinni, 'old in years'.
لَايْشْ: لَايْشْ — lāysh, why (colloquial, from li-ayyi shayʾin, 'for what thing'); 'why'
مَاتَجْبُرُ: مَا + تَجْبُرُ — mā, not (neg. particle; mā + imperfect, colloquial present negative) + tajburu, you mend (v., present 2 m. sg., indic., of جَبَرَ), printed as one word; 'you do not mend'
تَدْخُلُ: تَدْخُلُ — dakhala, to enter (v., present 2 m. sg., indic.); 'you enter'
قَسْطَلٌ: قَسْطَل — qasṭal, (probably a chestnut, black outside and white within; the meaning is uncertain) (m., nom. indef.)
وَأَوْجِزْ: وَـ + أَوْجِزْ — awjiz, be brief! (imperative 2 m. sg., form IV of وَجَزَ); wa-, and (conj.); 'and be brief'
تَأَدُّبُهُ: تَأَدُّب + هُ — taʾaddub, good breeding, courtesy (v.n. of form V of أَدَبَ, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his good manners'
وَحُسْنُ: وَـ + حُسْن — ḥusn, beauty, excellence (m., nom., first term of the genitive phrase); wa-, and (conj.); 'and the excellence of'
ثِقَاتِهِ: ثِقَات + هِ — thiqāt, trusted ones, trustworthiness (pl. of ثِقَة; possibly a slip for ثَقَافَتِهِ, 'his cultivation'), gen. + -hi, his; 'his trustworthiness'

فَيَالَهُ: فَـ + يَا + لَـ + هُ — yā, O (exclamatory particle) + la-, to, for (prep.) + -hu, him; fa-, and so; 'what a one he is!', an exclamation of wonder
خَادِمٍ: خَادِم — khādim, servant (m., gen. indef. after min); 'as a servant' Also the counted noun after miʾa: miʾati khādimin, 'a hundred servants', in a palace eunuchs.; here: gen. after ilā, ilā khādimin lahu, 'to a servant of his'
خَدَمَتْهُ: خَدَمَتْ + هُ — khadama, to serve (v., past 3 f. sg.; amlāk takes a feminine verb) + -hu, him; 'served him'
أَمْلَاكُ: أَمْلَاك — amlāk, angels (pl. of مَلَك, nom.; first term of the genitive phrase); 'the angels of'
السَّمَا: الـ + سَّمَا — samā, heaven, sky (the hamza of سَمَاء dropped; gen.); al-, the; 'the heaven'
فَغَرَفَ: فَـ + غَرَفَ — gharafa, to ladle, scoop (v., past 3 m. sg.); fa-, and so; 'so he ladled'
زُبْدِيَّةَ: زُبْدِيَّة — zubdiyya, deep bowl, dish (f., acc. object, first term); 'a bowl of'
حَبِّ: حَبّ — ḥabb, grains, seeds (coll. m., gen., second term); 'seeds'
بِلَوْزٍ: بِـ + لَوْز — lawz, almonds (coll. m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., 'made with'); 'with almonds'
وَسُكَّرٍ: وَـ + سُكَّر — sukkar, sugar (m., gen.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and sugar'
آنَسْتُمُونَا: آنَسْتُمُونَا — ānasa, to cheer, keep company, put at ease (v., past 2 m. pl., ānastum + connecting -ū- + -nā, us; the madda printed); 'you have cheered us with your company'
فَكُلُوا: فَـ + كُلُوا — kulū, eat! (imperative 2 m. pl. of أَكَلَ); fa-, and so; 'so eat'
مَرِيئًا: مَرِيئًا — marīʾ, agreeable, good for digestion (adj., acc. as an adverb); 'healthfully'
لِوَالِدِهِ: لِـ + وَالِد + هِ — wālid, father (m., gen.) + -hi, his; li-, to (prep. marking the person addressed); 'to his father'
اقْعُدْ: اُقْعُدْ — uqʿud, sit! (imperative 2 m. sg. of قَعَدَ); 'sit'
كُلْ: كُلْ — kul, eat! (imperative 2 m. sg. of أَكَلَ); 'eat'
يَجْمَعُنَا: يَجْمَعُ + نَا — jamaʿa, to gather, bring together (v., present 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'will gather us'
صِغَرِ: صِغَر — ṣighar, smallness, youth (m., gen. after ʿalā, first term); 'the smallness of'
سِنِّكَ: سِنّ + كَ — sinn, age (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your age'
بِفُرْقَةِ: بِـ + فُرْقَة — furqa, parting, separation (f., gen., first term); bi-, with (balā bi-, 'be afflicted with'); 'with the parting from'
عَمِّ: عَمّ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., voc.; yā ʿamm, polite address to an older man); 'uncle'
بِفِرَاقِ: بِـ + فِرَاق — firāq, parting, separation (m., gen.); bi-, with, by (prep. of cause); 'by the parting from'

نَطُوفُ: نَطُوفُ — ṭāfa, to go round (v., present 1 pl.; ṭāfa ʿalā, 'go round seeking'); 'we go round'
فَوَاحَسْرَتَاهُ: فَـ + وَا + حَسْرَتَا + هُ — ḥasra, grief, regret (f., acc. in the exclamation, ḥasratā) + -hu, the lament hāʾ; wā, ah, oh (exclamatory particle); fa-, and so; 'so, oh my grief!'
جَمْعِ: جَمْع — jamʿ, gathering (v.n. of جَمَعَ, gen. after ʿalā); 'the gathering of'
لِفِرَاقِهِ: لِـ + فِرَاق + هِ — firāq, parting (m., gen.) + -hi, his; li-, at, because of (prep. of cause); 'at his parting'
وَبُكَاءِهِ: وَـ + بُكَاء + هِ — bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen.) + -hi, his; wa-, and (conj.); 'and his weeping'
فُرْقَةَ: فُرْقَة — furqa, parting (f., acc. object, first term); 'the parting of'
وَبُعْدَهُ: وَـ + بُعْد + هُ — buʿd, distance, absence (m., acc.) + -hu, his; wa-, and (conj.); 'and his distance'
وَوَالِدَتِهِ: وَـ + وَالِدَة + هِ — wālida, mother (f., gen.) + -hi, his; wa-, and (conj.); 'and his mother'
وَأَكَلُوا: وَـ + أَكَلُوا — akalū, they ate (v., past 3 m. pl. of أَكَلَ); wa-, and (conj.); 'and they ate'
اكْتَفَوْا: اِكْتَفَوْا — iktafā, to be satisfied, have enough (v., form VIII, past 3 m. pl.); 'they had enough'
فَحَسَّ: فَـ + حَسَّ — ḥassa, to feel, sense (v., past 3 m. sg.; colloquial); fa-, and so; 'so he felt'
لَحْظَةً: لَحْظَة — laḥẓa, moment, glance (f., acc. as an adverb of time, tanwīn); 'a moment'
فَقَفَلَ: فَـ + قَفَلَ — qafala, to lock (v., past 3 m. sg.; colloquial); fa-, and so; 'so he locked'
وَتَبِعَهُمْ: وَـ + تَبِعَ + هُمْ — tabiʿa, to follow (v., past 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; wa-, and (conj.); 'and followed them'
لَايَعْلَمُ: لَا + يَعْلَمُ — lā, not (neg. particle) + yaʿlamu, he knows (v., present 3 m. sg. of عَلِمَ), printed as one word; 'he does not know'
وَأَسْرَعَ: وَـ + أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa, to hurry (v., form IV, past 3 m. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he hurried'
مَشْيِهِ: مَشْي + هِ — mashy, walking, pace (m., gen. after fī; v.n. of مَشَى) + -hi, his; 'his walking'
لَحِقَهُمْ: لَحِقَ + هُمْ — laḥiqa, to catch up with, overtake (v., past 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'he overtook them'
يَخْرُجُوا: يَخْرُجُوا — kharaja, to go out (v., present 3 m. pl., subj. after an, without final nūn); 'they go out'
الطَّوَاشِيُّ: الـ + طَّوَاشِيّ — ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., nom.); al-, the; 'the eunuch'
نَزَلْتُمْ: نَزَلْتُمْ — nazala, to descend, come down (v., past 2 m. pl.); 'you came down'
حَسِيتُ: حَسِيتُ — ḥasaytu, I felt (v., past 1 sg., colloquial form of ḥassa); 'I felt'
أُرَافِقَكُمْ: أُرَافِقَ + كُمْ — rāfaqa, to accompany (v., form III, present 1 sg., subj. after an) + -kum, you (2 m. pl.); 'I accompany you'
حَتَّٰي: حَتَّى — ḥattā, until (conj. with the subjunctive; printed with ي); 'until'
لِعَجِيبٍ: لِـ + عَجِيب — ʿAjīb, the boy's name (proper name, gen.); li-, to (prep. marking the person addressed); 'to ʿAjīb'
خَائِفًا: خَائِف — khāʾif, afraid (act. part. of خَافَ, acc., predicate of kāna, tanwīn); 'afraid'
لُقْمَةً: لُقْمَة — luqma, mouthful, morsel (f., acc. object, tanwīn); 'a morsel'
مَشُومَةً: مَشُومَة — mashūma, ill-omened (adj. f., acc. predicate, tanwīn); 'ill-omened'
مَكْرُمَةً: مَكْرُمَة — makruma, noble act, favour done (f., acc., tanwīn); here, a favour for which we are now in debt (the sense is uncertain); 'an obligation of courtesy'

تَابِعُنَا: تَابِع + نَا — tābiʿ, follower, following (act. part. of تَبِعَ, nom.) + -nā, us; 'following us'
فَلَقِيَ: فَـ + لَقِيَ — laqiya, to meet, find (v., past 3 m. sg.); fa-, and so; 'so he found'
دَعْهُ: دَعْ + هُ — daʿ, leave! (imperative 2 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'leave him'
طَرِيقِ: طَرِيق — ṭarīq, road, way (m., gen. after fī, first term); 'the road of'
قَإِذَا: قَـ + إِذَا — idhā, when, if (conj.); qa-, a slip for fa-, and (conj.); 'and when'
خِيَامِنَا: خِيَام + نَا — khiyām, tents (pl. of خَيْمَة, gen. after ilā) + -nā, our; 'our tents'
وَعَرَفْنَا: وَـ + عَرَفْنَا — ʿarafa, to know (v., past 1 pl.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and we know'
تَبِعَنَا: تَبِعَ + نَا — tabiʿa, to follow (v., past 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'followed us'
نَطْرُدُهُ: نَطْرُدُ + هُ — ṭarada, to drive away (v., present 1 pl.) + -hu, him; 'we drive him off'
فَأَطْرَقَ: فَـ + أَطْرَقَ — aṭraqa, to bow, lower (the head) (v., form IV, past 3 m. sg.); fa-, and so; 'so he lowered'
فَتَبِعَهُمْ: فَـ + تَبِعَ + هُمْ — tabiʿa, to follow (v., past 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; fa-, and so; 'so he followed them'
وَقَرُبُوا: وَـ + قَرُبُوا — qaruba, to draw near (v., past 3 m. pl.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and they drew near'
وَخَافَ: وَـ + خَافَ — khāfa, to fear (v., past 3 m. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he feared'
الطَّوَاشِيِّ: الـ + طَّوَاشِيّ — ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., gen. after min); al-, the; 'the eunuch'
يُخْبِرَ: يُخْبِرَ — akhbara, to inform, tell (v., form IV, present 3 m. sg., subj. after an); 'he tells'
جَدَّهُ: جَدّ + هُ — jadd, grandfather (m., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his grandfather'

خَائِنٌ: خَائِن — khāʾin, traitor, villain (act. part. of khāna; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'a traitor'

تَيَسَّرَ: تَيَسَّرَ — tayassara, to be made easy, be available (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'what has been easy'
وَابْقِ: وَ + ابْقِ — wa-, and + abqā, to keep, leave remaining (verb IV defective, imper. 2ms; hamza unmarked in the print); 'and keep'
نَاحِيَةً: نَاحِيَة — nāḥiya, side, quarter (f., acc. indef., adverbial); 'aside'
كَدَرٍ: كَدَر — kadar, turbidity, murk, trouble (m., gen. indef. after مِنْ); 'some murk'

اسْتَمَرَّ: اسْتَمَرَّ — istamarra, to continue, go on (verb X, perf. 3ms); 'he went on'
عَمُّهُ: عَمّ + ـهُ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., nom., apposed to al-wazīr) + 3ms suffix; 'his uncle'
أَقَامَ: أَقَامَ — aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms)
أَبَّامٍ: أَبَّام — printed ابام, a slip for أَيَّام, ayyām, days (pl. of yawm; gen. after the number); read 'ayyāmin'
رَحَلَ: رَحَلَ — raḥala, to set out, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms)
طَالِبَ: طَالِب — ṭālib, seeker, one seeking (act. part. of ṭalaba; m., in construct as a ḥāl); 'seeking'
حِمْصَ: حِمْص — Ḥimṣ, Homs (city; diptote, acc. as object of ṭālib)
سَيْرِهِ: سَيْر + ـهِ — sayr, journey, travel (verbal noun of sāra; m., gen. after فِي) + 3ms suffix; 'his journey'

سَأَلَهُ: سَأَلَ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he asked him'

وَأَنَّ: وَ + أَنَّ — wa-, and + anna, that (conj. governing the accusative); 'and that'
عَلِي: عَلِي — ʿAlī (proper name, part of Nūr al-Dīn's full name); the verb that should follow is missing

أَعْتَابَهَا: أَعْتَاب + هَا — aʿtāb, thresholds (pl. of ʿataba; acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'its thresholds'

وَجَعَا: وَجَعَا — wajaʿ, pain, ache (m., acc.), with the rhyme's long ā in place of tanwīn; 'pain'

فَكَذَا: فَـ + كَذَا — fa-, so + kadhā, thus, so; 'so (too)'
فِرَاقُكُمْ: فِرَاق + كُمْ — firāq, parting, separation (m., nom.) + 2mpl suffix; 'your parting'
قَطَعْنَا: قَطَعْنَا — qaṭaʿa, to cut, cross (verb I, perf. 1pl.); 'we have cut'
قِطَعَا: قِطَعَا — qiṭaʿ, pieces, stretches (pl. of qiṭʿa; m., acc.), with the rhyme's long ā; 'pieces, stretches'
تَمَنَّوْا: تَمَنَّوْا — tamannā (ʿalā), to wish for, desire (verb V defective, perf. 3mpl.); 'they wished'

جَمَعَا: جَمَعَا — jamaʿa, to gather, join (verb I, perf. 3ms), with the rhyme's long ā; 'it gathered'

غَيْبَةِ: غَيْبَة — ghayba, absence (f., gen. in construct); 'the absence of'

وَالنَّهَارِ: وَ + الـ + نَهَار — wa-, and + nahār, day (m., gen.); 'and the day'
طَالَتْ: طَالَتْ — ṭāla, to be long, grow long (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'grew long'
السِّنِينَ: الـ + سِنِين — sinīn, years (pl. of sana; oblique form used as subject, Middle Arabic); 'the years'
عَمِلَتْ: عَمِلَتْ — ʿamila, to make, do (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she made'
لَاتَنَامُ: لَا + تَنَامُ — lā, not (negative) + nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, impf. 3fs); printed as one word; 'she does not sleep'
مَسْكَنِهَا: مَسْكَن + هَا — maskan, dwelling (m., gen. after إِلَى) + 3fs suffix; 'her dwelling'
حِسَّهَا: حِسّ + هَا — ḥiss, sound, faint noise (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'her sound'
فَسَمِعَهَا: فَـ + سَمِعَ + هَا — fa-, and + samiʿa, to hear (perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and he heard her'
تُنْشِدُ: تُنْشِدُ — anshada, to recite verse (verb IV, impf. 3fs, ḥāl); 'reciting'
مَحَاسِنُهُ: مَحَاسِن + هُ — maḥāsin, fair features, beauties (broken pl. of ḥusn; f.sg. agreement; nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fair features'
تَغَيَّرَ: تَغَيَّرَ — taghayyara, to change (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'has changed'
يَاقَبْرُ: يَا + قَبْرُ — yā, O (vocative) + qabr, tomb (nom.); printed as one word; 'O tomb'
اَنْتَ: اَنْتَ — anta (printed without hamza): you (independent pron. 2ms)
لَارَوْضٌ: لَا + رَوْضٌ — lā, not (negative; lā ... wa-lā, 'neither ... nor') + rawḍ, garden (m., nom. indef.); printed as one word; 'not a garden'
الْغُصْنُ: الـ + غُصْن — ghuṣn, branch, bough (m., nom.); 'the bough'
وَأَعْلَمَهَا: وَ + أَعْلَمَ + هَا — wa-, and + aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and he informed her'
زَوْجِهَا: زَوْج + هَا — zawj, husband (m., gen. in construct) + 3fs suffix; 'her husband'
أَخْبَرَهَا: أَخْبَرَ + هَا — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'he told her'
وَكَشَفَ: وَ + كَشَفَ — wa-, and + kashafa, to uncover, lay open (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he laid open'
ابْنَهَا: ابْن + هَا — ibn, son (m., acc. after أَنَّ) + 3fs suffix; 'her son'
وَفُقِدَ: وَ + فُقِدَ — wa-, and + faqada, to lose (verb I; perf. passive 3ms); 'and he was lost'
حَمَلَتْ: حَمَلَتْ — ḥamala (verb I, perf. 3fs): (1) conceive, become pregnant, 'she conceived'; (2) with ʿalā, charge, attack ('a band that charged upon him')
وَلَدِكِ: وَلَد + كِ — walad, son (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 2fs suffix; 'your son'
وَلَدُكِ: وَلَد + كِ — walad, child (m., nom., predicate of أَنَّ) + 2fs suffix; 'your child'
وَأَنَّهُ: وَ + أَنَّ + هُ — wa-, and + anna, that (conj.) + 3ms suffix; 'and that he'
وَوَلَدُ: وَ + وَلَدُ — wa-, and + walad, child (m., nom. in construct); 'and the child of'
حَيٌّ: حَيٌّ — ḥayy, alive, living (m., nom. indef., predicate); here: nom. indef., a subject, 'a living one' (ḥayyun wa-maytu, 'living and dead')
وَرَأَتْ: وَ + رَأَتْ — wa-, and + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs); printed ورات; 'and she saw'
سِلْفَهَا: سِلْف + هَا — silf, husband's brother, brother-in-law (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'her husband's brother'
أَقْدَامِهِ: أَقْدَام + هِ — aqdām, feet (pl. of qadam; gen. after عَلَى) + 3ms suffix; 'his feet'
وَقَبَّلَتْهَا: وَ + قَبَّلَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3fs) + 3fs object; 'and she kissed them'
وَأَنْشَدَتْ: وَ + أَنْشَدَتْ — wa-, and + anshada, to recite verse (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and she recited'
لِلّٰهِ: لِـ + اللّٰه — li-, to, for (prep.; li-llāhi darru ..., 'to God belongs the excellence of ...', an exclamation of admiration) + Allāh (gen.); 'to God'
مُبَشِّرِي: مُبَشِّر + ي — mubashshir, bringer of glad tidings (act. part. of bashshara, verb II; m., nom. in construct) + 1s suffix; 'my bearer of glad tidings'
بِقُدُومِهِمْ: بِـ + قُدُوم + هِمْ — bi-, of (prep.; 'glad tidings of') + qudūm, arrival (m., gen.) + 3mpl suffix; 'of their coming'
اَتَى: اَتَى — atā (printed without hamza): to come (verb I defective, perf. 3ms); 'he has come'
طَائِبِ: طَائِب — ṭāʾib, repenting (act. part. of ṭāba); here obscure, probably for طَيِّب or طِيب, 'goodness' (m., gen. in construct after يَا); 'O ... of'
الْمَسْمُوعِ: الـ + مَسْمُوع — masmūʿ, what is heard, the tidings (pass. part. of samiʿa; m., gen.); 'the heard'
يَقْنَعُ: يَقْنَعُ — qaniʿa (bi-), to be content with (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'he is content'
بِالْخَلِيعِ: بِـ + الـ + خَلِيع — bi-, with (prep.; qaniʿa bi-, 'be content with') + khalīʿ, cast off, disowned, wretched (m., gen.); 'with the cast-off one'
وَهَبْتُهُ: وَهَبْتُ + هُ — wahaba, to give, bestow (verb I, perf. 1s; apodosis of لَوْ) + 3ms object; 'I would give him'
قَلْبًا: قَلْبًا — qalb, heart (m., acc. indef.); 'a heart'
تَقَطَّعَ: تَقَطَّعَ — taqaṭṭaʿa, to be cut to pieces (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'was torn to pieces'
جَدَّتُهُ: جَدَّة + ـهُ — jadda, grandmother (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his grandmother'
وَاعْتَنَقَتْهُ: وَ + اعْتَنَقَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtanaqat, to embrace (VIII, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she embraced him'
شَمْسُالدِّينِ: شَمْس + الـ + دِّين — Shams al-Dīn, 'Sun of the Faith', personal name (m., nom.); the print runs the two words together
تَجْهِيزِكِ: تَجْهِيز + كِ — tajhīz, outfitting, preparing (masdar of jahhaza, II; gen. in annexation) + -ki, your (f.); 'your preparing'
عَسَىاللَّهُ: عَسَى + اللَّه — ʿasā, perhaps, it may be that (verb of hope) + Allāh, God (nom.); the print runs the two words together; 'perhaps God'
وَشَمْلَكِ: وَ + شَمْل + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + shaml, union + -ki, your (f.); 'and your union'
بِوَالِدِكِ: بِـ + وَالِد + كِ — bi-, with (prep.; 'unite with') + wālid, parent, father (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your father' (see the note)
وَقْتِهَا: وَقْت + هَا — waqt, time, moment (m., gen.) + -hā, her; مِنْ وَقْتِهَا 'at once, there and then'
وَجَمَعَتْ: وَ + جَمَعَتْ — wa-, and + jamaʿat, to gather (I, perf. 3fs); 'and she gathered'
مَصَالِحَهَا: مَصَالِح + هَا — maṣāliḥ, needful things, belongings (pl. of maṣlaḥa; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her belongings'
وَذَخَائِرَهَا: وَ + ذَخَائِر + هَا — wa-, and + dhakhāʾir, stores, treasures (pl. of dhakhīra; acc.) + -hā, her; 'and her treasures'
وَجَوَارِهَا: وَ + جَوَارِ + هَا — wa-, and + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya; acc.; printed without the final yā, read jawārīhā) + -hā, her; 'and her slave-girls'
وَفِىالْحَالِ: وَ + فِي + الـ + حَال — wa-, and + fī, in (prep.; ى printed for ي, run together with the article) + ḥāl, state, moment (m., gen.); 'and at once'
تَجَهَّزَتْ: tajahhazat — tajahhaza, to make oneself ready (V, perf. 3fs); 'she got ready'
فَبَعَثَ: فَـ + بَعَثَ — fa-, and so + baʿatha, to send (I, perf. 3ms); 'and so he sent'
وَتُحَفْ: وَ + تُحَف — wa-, and + tuḥaf, rarities, curios (pl. of tuḥfa; accusative in sense, but the print has no alif for -an, so the word is left uninflected); 'and rarities'
فِىالْقَانُونِ: فِي + الـ + قَانُون — fī, in (ى printed for ي, run together with the article) + al-Qānūn, a place-name, apparently an open ground at Damascus where travellers halt (my reading, uncertain); 'at the Qānūn'
الْخِيَامَ: الـ + خِيَام — khiyām, tents (pl. of khayma; acc.); ضَرَبَ الْخِيَامَ 'pitched the tents'
نُقِيمُ: nuqīmu — aqāma, to stay, remain (IV, impf. 1pl., indic.); 'we shall stay'
جُمْعَةً: jumʿa, week (f., acc. of duration); 'a week'
نَشْتَرِيَ: nashtariya — ishtarā, to buy (VIII defective, impf. 1pl., subjunctive after an); 'we buy'
لِلطَّوَاشِي: لِـ + الـ + طَوَاشِي — li-, to (prep.; after qāla, 'said to') + ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., gen.; the final -ī is invariable); 'to the eunuch'
لَايِقُ: Lāʾiq, 'fitting', the eunuch's name (m., nom. vocative); printed without the hamza-seat (lāyiq)
الْفُرْجَةِ: الـ + فُرْجَة — furja, sightseeing, diversion, outing (f., gen. after ilā); 'for an outing'
نَنْزِلْ: nanzil — nazala, to go down (I, jussive 1pl., after an imperative: 'let us go down'); 'let us go down'
إِلَىالسُّوقِ: إِلَى + الـ + سُوق — ilā, to (prep.; the print runs it into the article) + sūq, market (m., gen.); 'to the market'
وَنَعْبُرْ: وَ + نَعْبُرْ — wa-, and + naʿbur, ʿabara, to pass through, cross (I, jussive 1pl.); 'and pass through'
وَشَجَيْنَا: وَ + شَجَيْنَا — wa-, and + shajaynā, shajja, to wound the head, split (I, perf. 1pl.); 'and we wounded'
أَسَأْنَاهُ: أَسَأْنَا + هُ — asāʾa, to treat badly, wrong (IV, perf. 1pl.) + -hu, him; 'wronged him'
