وَحَرَّكَتْهُ: وَ + حَرَّكَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥarrakat, to move, stir (II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and ... stirred him'
الْقَرَابَةُ: الـ + قَرَابَة — qarāba, kinship, blood-tie (f., nom.); 'the kinship'
إِلَىالْمَدِينَةِ: إِلَى + الـ + مَدِينَة — ilā, to (prep.; run together with the article) + madīna, city (f., gen.); 'to the city'
فِىالدُّكَّانِ: فِي + الـ + دُكَّان — fī, in (ى printed for ي, run together with the article) + dukkān, shop (m., gen.); 'in the shop'
وَافَقَ: wāfaqa, to agree with, suit (III, perf. 3ms): wāfaqa gharaḍahā, 'it suited her purpose'; to coincide, fall out: wāfaqa al-amru anna, 'it so happened that'
قَرُبَا: qarubā — qaruba, to draw near (I, perf. 3 dual); 'the two drew near'
الضَّرْبَةِ: الـ + ضَرْبَة — ḍarba, blow, stroke (f., gen.); 'the blow'
جَبِينِهِ: جَبِين + هِ — jabīn, brow, forehead (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his brow'
تَقَلْقَلَتْ: taqalqalat — taqalqala, to be shaken, stirred up (quadriliteral V, perf. 3fs); 'were shaken'
أَحْشَاؤُهُ: أَحْشَاء + هُ — aḥshāʾ, entrails, innards (pl. of ḥashan; nom.) + -hu, his; 'his entrails'
وَخَفَقَ: وَ + خَفَقَ — wa-, and + khafaqa, to throb, flutter (I, perf. 3ms); 'and throbbed'
وَأَطْرَقَ: وَ + أَطْرَقَ — wa-, and + aṭraqa, to bow the head, look down (IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he bowed'
أَرَادَأَنْ: أَرَادَ + أَنْ — arāda, to want (IV, perf. 3ms) + an, that (conj. + subjunctive); the print runs the two words together; 'wanted to'
يُدِيرَ: yudīra — adāra, to turn (IV, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); 'turn'
خَاضِعًا: khāḍiʿ, submissive, abject (act. part. of khaḍaʿa, m. acc., ḥāl); 'submissive'
مُتَذَلِّلًا: mutadhallil, abasing himself (act. part. of tadhallala, V; m. acc., ḥāl); 'humbling himself'
الْأَبْيَابَ: الـ + أَبْيَاب — printed for الْأَبْيَات, abyāt, verses (pl. of bayt; acc.); the print has a bāʾ where the sense needs a tāʾ; 'the verses'
تَمَنَّيْتُ: tamannaytu — tamannā, to wish for, long for (V defective, perf. 1cs); 'I longed for'
رَاَيْتُهُ: raʾaytuhu — raʾaytu, raʾā, to see (I, perf. 1cs; the hamza is not written) + -hu, him; 'I saw him'
اَمْلِكْ: amlik — malaka, to possess, control (I, jussive 1cs); 'I had mastery of'
طَرْفَا: ṭarf, eye, glance (m., acc. indef.; printed with fatḥa and alif, without a tanwīn sign); 'an eye'
وَاَطْرَقْتُ: wa- + aṭraqtu — wa-, and + aṭraqa, to bow the head, look down (IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I lowered'
اِجْلَالاً: ijlāl, reverence, honouring (masdar of ajalla, IV; acc., reason); 'in reverence'
وَمَهَــابَةً: wa- + mahāba — wa-, and + mahāba, awe, dread (f. masdar, acc., reason); the print stretches the word with a tatweel; 'and awe'
وَحَاوَلْتُ: wa- + ḥāwaltu — wa-, and + ḥāwala, to try, attempt (III, perf. 1cs); 'and I tried'
اُخْفِىَ: ukhfiya — akhfā, to hide, conceal (IV defective, impf. 1cs, subjunctive; the yā is printed ى); 'I hide'
يَخْفَى: yakhfā — khafiya, to be hidden (I defective, impf. 3ms; the jussive yakhfa is expected after lam); 'it was hidden'
لِلْعِتَابِ: li- + al- + ʿitāb — li-, for (prep.) + al-, the + ʿitāb, reproach, blame (m., gen.); 'for reproach'
دَفَاتِرُ: dafātir — daftar, register, notebook (m., pl. dafātir, nom. indef.); 'registers'
نَطَقْتُ: naṭaqtu — naṭaqa, to speak, utter (I, perf. 1cs); 'I uttered'
حَرْفاً: ḥarf, letter, a single letter (m., acc. indef.); 'a letter'
اجْبُرُوا: ujburū — jabara, to mend, make good, console (I, imper. 2m pl.); 'console'
وَكُلُوا: وَ + كُلُوا — wa-, and + kulū, akala, to eat (I, imper. 2m pl.; the hamza of uʾkulū is dropped, as always in this imperative); 'and eat'
طَعَــامِي: طَعَام + ـِي — ṭaʿām, food (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; the print stretches the word with a tatweel; 'my food'
تَبِعْتُكَ: تَبِعْتُ + كَ — tabiʿtu, tabiʿa, to follow (I, perf. 1cs) + -ka, you (m.); 'I followed you'
إِلَّاوَأَنَا: إِلَّا + وَ + أَنَا — illā, except + wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + anā, I; the print runs the words together; 'except while I (was)'
لَزِمَتْنَا: لَزِمَتْ + نَا — lazimat, lazima, to cleave to, be binding on (I, perf. 3fs) + -nā, us; 'it has bound us'
عَقِبَهَا: عَقِب + هَا — ʿaqib, the wake, the time after (m., acc. adverbial) + -hā, it (the morsel); 'in its wake' (one could also read ʿuqbahā, 'its consequence')
وَأَرَدْتَ: وَ + أَرَدْتَ — wa-, and + aradta, arāda, to want (IV, perf. 2ms); 'and you wanted'
تَهْتِكُنَا: تَهْتِكُ + نَا — tahtiku, hataka, to rend, expose, disgrace (I, impf. 2ms, indic.; no 'to' joins it to aradta) + -nā, us; 'to disgrace us'
لَانَا: لَا + نَا — lā, not (neg. particle) + nā-, first part of nākulu 'we eat', whose second half is the next word; the print splits نَأْكُلُ in two and drops the hamza
كُلُ: -kulu, second part of nākulu, 'we eat' (akala, I, impf. 1pl.); see the previous word
أَكْلًا: akl, eating (masdar, acc. indef.; absolute object, 'any eating at all')
تَحْلِفَ: taḥlifa — ḥalafa, to swear (I, impf. 2ms, subjunctive after an); 'you swear'
وَرَاءَنَا: وَرَاء + نَا — warāʾ, behind, after (prep., acc.) + -nā, us; 'behind us'
تَتْبَعُنَا: تَتْبَعُ + نَا — tatbaʿu, tabiʿa, to follow (I, impf. 2ms, indic.) + -nā, us; 'follow us'
لَانَعُودُ: لَا + نَعُودُ — lā, not + naʿūdu, ʿāda, to return (I hollow, impf. 1pl., indic.); the print runs the two together; 'we shall not return'
وَقْتِنَا: وَقْت + نَا — waqt, time (m., gen.) + -nā, our; مِنْ وَقْتِنَا هَذَا 'from this very time, from now on' Also fī waqtinā, 'then and there': فَنَهْلِكُ فِي وَقْتِنَا 'and we should perish on the spot'.
مُقِيمُونَ: muqīm, staying (act. part. of aqāma, IV; m. nom. pl.); 'staying'
جَدِّي: جَدّ + ـِي — jadd, grandfather (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my grandfather'
يُفَرِّجُ: yufarriju — farraja, to relieve, deliver (II, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'will relieve'
بَاهِتٌ: bāhit, stupefied, staring (act. part. of bahita, m. nom. indef., predicate); 'dazed'
وَجَوَارِحُهُ: وَ + جَوَارِح + هُ — wa-, and + jawāriḥ, limbs (pl. of jāriḥa; nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his limbs'
عَاشِقٌ: ʿāshiq, lover, one in love (act. part. of ʿashiqa; m. nom. indef.); 'a lover'
ثَقِيلٌ: thaqīl, heavy, tiresome (adj. m. nom. indef.); 'tiresome'
فَحَسْبُكَ: فَـ + حَسْب + كَ — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥasb, enough, sufficiency (m., nom.) + -ka, you (m.); 'so enough for you'
النَّظَرَ: الـ + نَظَر — naẓar, gazing, looking (m. masdar, acc.); 'the gazing'
يَقُ—ولُ: yaqūlu — qāla, to say (I hollow, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'saying'; the print has a dash set inside the word, a printing flaw; the letters are يقول
الْقُلُوبِ: al- + qulūb — al-, the + qalb, heart (m., pl. qulūb, gen.); 'the hearts'
سَرِيرَةٌ: sarīra, secret, inmost thought (f., nom. indef.); 'a secret'
تَظْهَرُ: taẓharu — ẓahara, to appear, show (I, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'it appears'
مَطْوِيَّةٌ: maṭwiyya, folded, tucked away (f. pass. part. of ṭawā, nom. indef.); 'folded away'
مَكْنُونَةٌ: maknūna, hidden, guarded (f. pass. part. of kanna, nom. indef.); 'hidden'
تُنْشَرُ: tunsharu — nashara, to spread out, unroll (I, impf. pass. 3fs); 'it is unrolled'
يَافَاضِحَ: yā + fāḍiḥa — yā, O (vocative; run together with the next word) + fāḍiḥ, one who disgraces, puts to shame (act. part. of faḍaḥa; m., acc. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'O shamer of'
الْمُنِيرِ: al- + munīr — al-, the + munīr, shining, bright (act. part. of anāra, IV; m. gen., adj.); 'the shining'
يُحْكَى: yuḥkā — ḥakā, to imitate, relate (I defective), impf. passive 3ms; 'is imitated, is likened'
الْمُسْفِرُ: al- + musfir — al-, the + musfir, shining forth (act. part. of asfara, IV; m. nom., adj.); 'the radiant'
وَجْهِكَ: wajh + ka — wajh, face (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your face'
مَارِبٌ: mārib — printed for ma'ārib (pl. of maʾrab), desires, needs (m., nom. indef.; the hamza not written); 'desires'
تَنْقَضِي: tanqaḍī — inqaḍā, to come to an end (VII defective, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'it ends'
وَمَعَاهِدٌ: wa- + maʿāhid — wa-, and + maʿhad, place frequented, haunt, memory (m., pl. maʿāhid, nom. indef.); 'and haunts'
اَبَدًا: abad, ever, forever (m., acc. of time); 'ever'
تَزِيدُ: tazīdu — zāda, to increase (I hollow, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'they increase'
وَتَكْثُرُ: wa- + taktharu — wa-, and + kathura, to be many (I, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'and multiply'
اَذُوبُ: adhūbu — dhāba, to melt (I hollow, impf. 1cs); 'I melt'
وَوَجْهُكَ: wa- + wajh + ka — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + wajh, face (nom.) + -ka, your; 'while your face'
جَنَّتِي: janna + ī — janna, garden, paradise (f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my paradise'
وَاَمُوتُ: wa- + amūtu — wa-, and + māta, to die (I hollow, impf. 1cs); 'and I die'
وَرِيقُكَ: wa- + rīq + ka — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + rīq, saliva (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'while your saliva'
كَوْثَرُ: kawthar, abundance; al-Kawthar, a river of Paradise (m., nom., predicate); 'Kawthar'
يُلَقِّمُ: yulaqqimu — laqqama, to feed with morsels (II, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'feeds morsels to'
وَيُلَقِّمُ: وَ + يُلَقِّمُ — wa-, and + yulaqqimu, laqqama, to feed with morsels (II, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'and feeds'
اكْتَفَوْاوَ: اكْتَفَوْا + وَ — iktafaw, iktafā, to have enough, be content (VIII defective, perf. 3m pl.) + wa-, and (conj.); the print attaches the wāw to this verb instead of to the next word; 'they had enough and'
أَيْدِيهِمَا: أَيْدِي + هِمَا — aydī, hands (pl. of yad; gen.) + -himā, them both (dual); 'their two hands'
فُوطَةَ: fūṭa, towel, waist-cloth (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَرَشَّ: وَ + رَشَّ — wa-, and + rashsha, to sprinkle (I, perf. 3ms); 'and sprinkled'
الْمَاوَرْدَ: الـ + مَاوَرْد — māward, rosewater (contracted from māʾ ward; m., acc.); 'the rosewater'
بِقُلَّةِ: بِـ + قُلَّة — bi-, with (prep.; ʿāda bi- 'come back with, bring') + qulla, jug (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with a jug of'
شَرْبَاتٍ: sharbāt, sherbets, drinks (pl. of sharba; gen.); 'sherbets'
مَمْزُوجَةٍ: mamzūja, mixed (pass. part. of mazaja; f. gen. indef., qualifying qulla); 'mixed'
بِالْمَاوَرْدِ: بِـ + الـ + مَاوَرْد — bi-, with (prep.; 'mixed with') + māward, rosewater (m., gen.); 'with the rosewater'
الْمُمَسَّكِ: الـ + مُمَسَّك — mumassak, scented with musk (pass. part. of massaka, II; m. gen., adj.); 'the musked'
أَتِمُّوا: atimmū — atamma, to complete (IV, imper. 2m pl.); 'complete'
إِحْسَانَكُمْ: إِحْسَان + كُمْ — iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (m., acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your kindness'
الْخَادِمَ: الـ + خَادِم — khādim, servant, here the eunuch (m., acc.); 'the servant'
وَتَنَاوَلُوا: وَ + تَنَاوَلُوا — wa-, and + tanāwalū, tanāwala, to take in turn, partake (VI, perf. 3m pl.); 'and they partook'
امْتَلَأَتْ: imtalaʾat — imtalaʾa, to be filled (VIII, perf. 3fs); 'were filled'
بُطُونُهُمْ: بُطُون + هُمْ — buṭūn, bellies (pl. of baṭn; nom.) + -hum, their; 'their bellies'
وَشَبِعُوا: وَ + شَبِعُوا — wa-, and + shabiʿū, shabiʿa, to be sated (I, perf. 3m pl.); 'and were sated'
عَادَتِهِمْ: عَادَة + هِمْ — ʿāda, habit, custom (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'their habit'
وَأَسْرَعُوا: وَ + أَسْرَعُوا — wa-, and + asraʿū, asraʿa, to hasten (IV, perf. 3m pl.); 'and hurried'
مَشْيِهِمْ: مَشْي + هِمْ — mashy, walking, pace (m. masdar, gen.) + -him, their; 'their walking'
خِيَامِهِمْ: خِيَام + هِمْ — khiyām, tents (gen.) + -him, their; 'their tents'
جَدَّتِهِ: جَدَّة + هِ — jadda, grandmother (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his grandmother'
أُمِّ: umm, mother (f., gen. in apposition; first term of an iḍāfa); 'mother of'
فَقَبَّلَتْهُ: فَـ + قَبَّلَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so + qabbalat, to kiss (II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she kissed him'
وَافْتَكَرَتْ: وَ + افْتَكَرَتْ — wa-, and + iftakarat, iftakara, to remember, call to mind (VIII, perf. 3fs); 'and she remembered'
وَلَدَهَا: وَلَد + هَا — walad, son (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her son'
فَتَنَهَّدَتْ: فَـ + تَنَهَّدَتْ — fa-, and so + tanahhadat, to sigh (V, perf. 3fs); 'and she sighed'
كُنتُ: kuntu — kāna, to be (I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'I was'
اَرْجُو: arjū — rajā, to hope (I defective, impf. 1cs); 'I hope'
الشَّمْلَ: al- + shaml — al-, the + shaml, union, togetherness (m., acc. after anna); 'the union'
يَجْتَمِعُ: yajtamiʿu — ijtamaʿa, to be gathered, come together (VIII, impf. 3ms); 'would come together'; here: with ʿalā, 'to gather before (someone)'
حَيوتِي: حَيَاة + ي — ḥayāt, life (f.; the print spells it with a wāw for the long ā, حيوة, in the old style; read ḥayāt; gen.) + -ī, my; 'my life'
كُمْ: -kum, you (pl.; the print writes the suffix as a separate word); 'you'
طَمَعُ: ṭamaʿ, desire, hope, greed (m., nom.); 'any desire'
اَقْسَمْتُ: aqsamtu — aqsama, to swear (IV, perf. 1cs); 'I swore'
حُبِّكُمُ: ḥubb + kum — ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -kum, your (pl.; the final -u is a metrical helping vowel); 'your love'
وَاللّٰهُ: wa- + Allāh — wa-, and (conj.) + Allāh, God (nom.); 'and God'
الْاَسْرَارِ: al- + asrār — al-, the + sirr, secret (m., pl. asrār, gen.); 'the secrets'
مُطَّلِعُ: muṭṭaliʿ, aware, informed (act. part. of iṭṭalaʿa, VIII; m. nom. indef., predicate; iṭṭalaʿa ʿalā 'be aware of'); 'aware of'
طَعَامٍ: ṭaʿām, food (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa, 'a bowl of food'); 'of food'
سَيِّدِكَ: سَيِّد + كَ — sayyid, master (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your master'
مَالَنَا: مَا + لَنَا — mā, not (neg. particle) + la-nā, to us (li-, to + -nā, us); 'we have not'; the print runs the words together
نَفْسٌ: nafs, soul, appetite, inclination (f., nom. indef.); 'appetite'
نَاكُلُ: nākulu — akala, to eat (I, impf. 1pl.); the hamza of نَأْكُلُ is not written; 'to eat'
بَطْنُهُ: بَطْن + هُ — baṭn, belly (m., here treated as f.; nom.) + -hu, his; 'his belly'
مَلْآنَةً: malʾāna, full (f. of malʾān; acc. indef., predicate of kānat); 'full'
وَغَمَسَهَا: وَ + غَمَسَ + هَا — wa-, and + ghamasa, to dip (I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the morsel, f.); 'and dipped it'
الرُّمَّانِ: الـ + رُمَّان — rummān, pomegranate (m. coll., gen.); 'the pomegranate'
الْحَلَاوَهِ: الـ + حَلَاوَه — ḥalāwa, sweetness (f., gen.); the print writes ه for ة; 'the sweetness'
شَبْعَانَ: shabʿān, sated (m., diptote, acc., predicate of kāna); 'full-fed'
أُفُوهْ: ufūh, ugh! (interjection of disgust, cf. أُفٌّ); the form is the print's and the reading is uncertain; 'ugh!'
الطَّعَامُ: الـ + طَعَام — ṭaʿām, food (m., nom.); 'the food'
الْوَحْشُ: الـ + وَحْش — waḥsh, foul, vile (colloquial, lit. 'wild'; m. nom., adj.); 'the foul'
تَعِيبُ: taʿību — ʿāba, to find fault (I hollow, impf. 2ms, indic.); عَابَ عَلَى 'find fault with'; 'you find fault'
طَبِيخِي: طَبِيخ + ـِي — ṭabīkh, cooking, cooked food (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; 'my cooking'
طَبَخْتُهُ: طَبَخْتُ + هُ — ṭabakhtu, ṭabakha, to cook (I, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I cooked it'
الطَّبْخَ: الـ + طَبْخ — ṭabkh, cooking (m. masdar, acc.); 'cooking'
مِثْلِى: مِثْل + ـِي — mithl, like, the equal of (m., acc. adverbial) + -ī, me; the print writes ى for ي; 'like me'
وَالِدُكَ: وَالِد + كَ — wālid, father (m., nom.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your father'
يَاسِتِّي: يَا + سِتِّي — yā, O (vocative; the print runs it into the next word) + sitt, lady, mistress (f.) + -ī, my; 'O my lady'
طَبِيخَكِ: طَبِيخ + كِ — ṭabīkh, cooking (m., acc. after inna) + -ki, your (f.); 'your cooking'
وَحْشٌ: waḥsh, foul, vile (colloquial, lit. 'wild'; m. nom. indef., predicate); 'foul'
رَابَنَا: رَابَ + نَا — printed for رَأَيْنَا, raʾaynā, 'we saw' (raʾā, I, perf. 1pl.); as pointed it reads rāba + -nā, 'it troubled us'; see the note
طَعَامُهُ: طَعَام + هُ — ṭaʿām, food (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his food'
يُشْتَهَي: yushtahā — ishtahā, to desire (VIII defective), impf. passive 3ms; the final yā is printed for alif maqṣūra; 'is desired'
يُوكَلَ: yūkala — printed for يُؤْكَلَ, yuʾkala, akala, to eat (I), impf. passive 3ms, subjunctive; the hamza is not written; 'be eaten'
طَعَامُكِ: طَعَام + كِ — ṭaʿām, food (m., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your food'
اغْتَاظَتْ: ightāẓat — ightāẓa, to be enraged (VIII hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she was enraged'
وَنَظَرَتْ: وَ + نَظَرَتْ — wa-, and + naẓarat, naẓara, to look (I, perf. 3fs); 'and she looked'
الْمُـــــــبَـــــــاحِ: الـ + مُبَاح — mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (pass. part. of abāḥa, IV; m. gen., adj.); 'the permitted'; the print stretches the word with tatweel
الْفُوْءَادَ: الـ + فُؤَاد — fuʾād, heart (m., acc. after اِنَّ); 'the heart' (printed with a stray colon before it, and the verse's own pointing)
ولُ: -ūlu — the second half of يَقُ—ولُ, yaqūlu, 'he says', split by a printed dash
يَقُ: yaqu- — the first half of يَقُ—ولُ, yaqūlu, 'he says', split by a printed dash
ي: ي — stray sign after وَأَنْشَدَ in the print, not a word; left as printed
جَدَّةَ: jadda, grandmother (f., acc. as subject of أَنَّ; first term of an iḍāfa)
أَفْسَدْتَ: afsadta — أَفْسَدَ, to spoil, ruin (IV, perfect, 2 m. sg.); 'you ruined'
لِأَنَّكَ: لِـ + أَنَّ + كَ — li-, because (prep. + anna, introducing the reason) + -ka, you (m., subject of anna); 'because you'
دَكَاكِينِ: dakākīn, shops (m., broken pl. of دُكَّان, gen. after إِلَى, first term of an iḍāfa; diptote form)
الطَّبَّاخِينَ: الـ + طَبَّاخِين — ṭabbākh, cook (m. sound pl., gen.); 'the cooks'
وَأَنْكَرَ: وَ + أَنْكَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ankara, to deny (IV, perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and he denied'
جُزْنَا: juznā — جَازَ, to pass (perfect, 1 pl.); 'we passed'
جَوَازًا: jawāz, passing (m., acc. as absolute object, intensifying the verb); 'a passing, merely passing'
وَهُوَا: وَ + هُوَ + ا — wa-, and (conj.) + huwa, he, it (pron.); the final alif is the first letter of the next word, read wa-huwa aḥsanu; 'and it is'
طَعَامِكَ: طَعَام + كَ — ṭaʿām, food (m., gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your food'
وَأَخْبَرَتْ: وَ + أَخْبَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhbarat, akhbara, to inform (IV, perfect, 3 f. sg.); 'and she told'
أَخُوزَوْجِهَا: أَخُو + زَوْج + هَا — akhū, brother (m., first term of an iḍāfa, the 'u' ending, acc. object as printed) + zawj, husband (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her husband's brother' (the vizier)
وَأَغْرَتْهُ: وَ + أَغْرَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aghrat, aghrā, to incite (IV, perfect, 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she set him'
شَبِعْنَا: shabiʿnā — شَبِعَ, to be full, to eat one's fill (perfect, 1 pl.); 'we were full'
وَأَسْقَانَا: وَ + أَسْقَى + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + asqā, to give to drink (IV, perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us (obj. pron.); 'and he gave us to drink'
أَقْسَمَا: aqsamā — obscure, perhaps corrupt: as printed, أَقْسَمَ 'to swear' (IV, perfect, 3 dual); the sense needed is a drink or sherbet; read as printed
بِثَلْجٍ: بِـ + ثَلْج — bi-, with (prep., 'made with') + thalj, ice, snow (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'with ice'
غَضَبُ: ghaḍab, anger (m., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa)
سَأَلَهُ: سَأَلَ + هُ — saʾala, to ask (perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'he asked him'
فَأَنْكَرَ: فَـ + أَنْكَرَ — fa-, and (conj.) + ankara, to deny (IV, perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and he denied'
كَلَامُكَ: كَلَام + كَ — kalām, speech, words (m., nom., subject of kāna) + -ka, your; 'your words'
صَحِيحًا: ṣaḥīḥ — true, sound (adj., m., acc. as predicate of kāna, with tanwīn); 'true'
فَانْعَدْ: فَـ + انْعَدْ — fa-, then (conj. introducing the main clause of a condition) + inʿad, a misprint for iqʿud (اقعد), 'sit' (imperative, m. sg.); pointed as printed, read 'sit'
وَكُلْ: وَ + كُلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + kul, أَكَلَ 'to eat' (imperative, m. sg., the hamza dropped); 'and eat'
قُدَّ: qudd — first half of the split spelling of قُدَّامَنَا (quddāmanā), 'in front of us'
امَنَا: -āmanā — second half of the split spelling of قُدَّامَنَا: with the preceding word, 'in front of us' (quddāma, in front of + -nā, us)
قَدَمَ: qadama — to go forward, advance (perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'he came forward'
وَأَرَادَانْ: وَ + أَرَادَ + أَنْ — wa-, and (conj.) + arāda, to want (IV, perfect, 3 m. sg.) + an, that (conj. with the subjunctive), run together in the print; 'and he wanted to'
يَأْكُلَ: yaʾkula — أَكَلَ, to eat (imperfect, 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'eat'
اللُّقْمَةَ: الـ + لُقْمَة — luqma, morsel, mouthful (f., acc., object); 'the morsel'
شَبْعَانُ: shabʿān — full, sated (adj., m., nom. as predicate; diptote)
فَعَرَفَ: فَـ + عَرَفَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know (perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and so he knew'
الْعَبِيدَانْ: الـ + عَبِيد + أَنْ — al-, the + ʿabīd, slaves (m., pl., acc. object) + an, that, run together in the print; 'the slaves, that'
يَطْرَحُوهُ: يَطْرَحُوا + هُ — yaṭraḥū, طَرَحَ 'to throw down' (imperfect, 3 m. pl., subjunctive after an, the nūn dropped) + -hu, him; 'throw him down'
فَطَرَحُوهُ: فَـ + طَرَحُوا + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + ṭaraḥū, to throw down (perfect, 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they threw him down'
الْوَجِيعِ: الـ + وَجِيع — wajīʿ, painful (adj., m., gen., agreeing with الضرب); 'the painful'
فَاسْتَغَاثَ: فَـ + اسْتَغَاثَ — fa-, and (conj.) + istaghātha, to cry for help (X, perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and he cried for help'
تَضْرِبْنِي: تَضْرِبْ + نِي — taḍrib, ضَرَبَ 'to beat' (imperfect, 2 m. sg., jussive after lā) + -nī, me; 'do not beat me'
الصَّحِيحَ: الـ + صَحِيح — ṣaḥīḥ, true, the truth (adj. used as a noun, m., acc., object); 'the truth'
فَتَبَطَّلَ: فَـ + تَبَطَّلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tabaṭṭala, to stop, let up (V, perfect, 3 m. sg.; colloquial); 'and so it stopped'
انْطِقْ: inṭiq — نَطَقَ, to speak (imperative, m. sg.); 'speak'
بِالْحَقِّ: بِـ + الـ + حَقّ — bi-, with (prep.; with نَطَقَ, 'speak with, speak') + ḥaqq, truth (m., gen.); 'the truth'; here also after aqarra bi-, 'to confess': bi- marks what is owned to, 'confessed the truth'
يَطْبُخُ: yaṭbukhu — طَبَخَ, to cook (imperfect, 3 m. sg.); 'cooks, was cooking'
أَكَلْتُ: akaltu — أَكَلَ, to eat (perfect, 1 sg.); 'I have eaten'
ذُقْتُ: dhuqtu — ذَاقَ, to taste (perfect, 1 sg.); 'I have tasted'
فَغَضِبَتْ: فَـ + غَضِبَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ghaḍibat, to be angry (perfect, 3 f. sg.); 'and so she grew angry'
أُمُّ: umm, mother (f., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa)
لَابُدَّانْ: لَا + بُدَّ + أَنْ — lā budda, there is no escape (idiom) + an, that (conj. with the subjunctive), run together in the print; 'it must be that'
وَتَجِيبْلَنَا: وَ + تَجِيبْ + لِـ + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + tajīb, جَابَ 'to bring' (imperfect, 2 m. sg.; colloquial) + li-, for (prep., 'for the benefit of') + -nā, us; 'and bring us'
وَتُرِيَهُ: وَ + تُرِيَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + turiya, أَرَى 'to show' (IV, imperfect, 2 m. sg., subjunctive, continuing the command) + -hu, him; 'and show it'
لِسَيِّدِكَ: لِـ + سَيِّد + كَ — li-, to (prep., marking the one shown to) + sayyid, master (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'to your master'
أَيُّهُمَا: أَيّ + هُمَا — ayy, which (interrogative, m., nom.) + -humā, the two of them (dual pron.); 'which of the two'
وَأَطْيَبُ: وَ + أَطْيَبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭyab, tastier, better (comparative of طَيِّب, nom., diptote); 'and tastier'
زُبْدِيَّةً: zubdiyya, bowl (f., acc. with tanwīn, object); 'a bowl'
وَنِصْفَ: وَ + نِصْف — wa-, and (conj.) + niṣf, half (m., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and half'
فَمَضَى: فَـ + مَضَى — fa-, and so (conj.) + maḍā, to go on, depart (perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and so he went'
لِلطَّبَّاخِ: لِـ + الـ + طَبَّاخ — li-, to (prep., marking the one addressed after قَالَ) + ṭabbākh, cook (m., gen.); 'to the cook'
تَرَاهَنَّا: tarāhannā — تَرَاهَنَ, to make a wager with one another (VI, perfect, 1 pl.); 'we wagered'
فَهَاتِ: فَـ + هَاتِ — fa-, so (conj., introducing a command) + hāti, to give, bring (imperative, m. sg.; the everyday 'bring!'); 'so bring'
النِّصْفِ: الـ + نِصْف — niṣf, half (m., gen.); 'the half'
وَاجْعَلْ: وَ + اجْعَلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ijʿal, جَعَلَ 'to make, put' (imperative, m. sg.); 'and make'
الْمُوجِعَ: الـ + مُوجِع — mūjiʿ, painful (act. part. of IV أَوْجَعَ, m., acc.); 'the painful'
طَبِيخِكَ: طَبِيخ + كَ — ṭabīkh, cooking, cooked food (m., gen., after ʿalā) + -ka, your; 'your cooking'
يُحْسِنُهُ: يُحْسِنُ + هُ — yuḥsinu, أَحْسَنَ 'to do well, be skilled at' (IV, imperfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'does it well, can make it'
وَوَالِدَتِي: وَ + وَالِدَة + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + wālida, mother (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my mother'
وَهِى: وَ + هِيَ — wa-, and, while (circumstantial wa-) + hiya (printed with ى), she (pron.); 'and she'
بَعِيدَةٍ: baʿīda — far, distant (adj., f., gen. with tanwīn, agreeing with بِلَاد as a feminine plural); 'far-off'
غَرَفَ: gharafa — to ladle, scoop (perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'he ladled'
الزُّبْدِيَّةَ: الـ + زُبْدِيَّة — zubdiyya, bowl (f., acc., object); 'the bowl'
وَأَخَذَهَا: وَ + أَخَذَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, to take (perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and took it'
بِالْمِسْكِ: بِـ + الـ + مِسْك — bi-, with (prep., of the means) + misk, musk (m., gen.); 'with musk'
وَالْمَاوَرْدِ: وَ + الـ + مَاوَرْد — wa-, and (conj.) + māward, rose water (m., gen., from ماء الورد); 'and rose water'
وَالِدَةُ: wālida, mother (f., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَذَاقَتْهَا: وَ + ذَاقَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + dhāqat, to taste (perfect, 3 f. sg.) + -hā, it; 'and she tasted it'
طَعْمِهَا: طَعْم + هَا — ṭaʿm, taste, flavour (m., gen.) + -hā, its; 'its taste'
وَجَوْدَةَ: وَ + جَوْدَة — wa-, and (conj.) + jawda, excellence, quality (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the excellence of'
طَبْخِهَا: طَبْخ + هَا — ṭabkh, cooking (m., verbal noun, gen.) + -hā, its; 'its cooking'
فَعَرَفَتْ: فَـ + عَرَفَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ʿarafat, to know, recognise (perfect, 3 f. sg.); 'and so she knew'
طَبَّاخَهَا: طَبَّاخ + هَا — ṭabbākh, cook (m., acc., object) + -hā, its; 'its cook'
فَصَرَخَتْ: فَـ + صَرَخَتْ — fa-, and (conj.) + ṣarakhat, to cry out (perfect, 3 f. sg.); 'and she cried out'
فَبُهِتَ: فَـ + بُهِتَ — fa-, and (conj.) + buhita, to be dumbfounded (passive perfect, 3 m. sg.); 'and was astonished'
الْمَاوَرْدُ: الـ + مَاوَرْد — māward, rose water (m., nom., passive subject); 'the rose water'
أَفَاقَتْ: afāqat — أَفَاقَ, to recover, regain consciousness (IV, perfect, 3 f. sg.); 'she came to'
إِنْكَانَ: إِنْ + كَانَ — in, if (conditional) + kāna, to be (perfect, 3 m. sg.), run together in the print; 'if it be that'
طَعَامٌ: ṭaʿām — food, a dish (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'a dish'
يَطْبُخُهُ: يَطْبُخُ + هُ — yaṭbukhu, طَبَخَ 'to cook' (imperfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'cooks it'
عَلَّمْتُهُ: عَلَّمْتُ + هُ — ʿallamtu, عَلَّمَ 'to teach' (II, perfect, 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'I taught him'
طَبِيخَهُ: طَبِيخ + هُ — ṭabīkh, cooking, cooked dish (m., acc., second object) + -hu, his; 'his cooking, how to cook it'
وَاشَوْقَاهُ: وَا + شَوْق + ا + هُ — wā, alas (exclamation) + shawq, longing (m.) + -ā, the lament ending + -hu, the pausal hāʾ; 'alas, my longing!'
رُؤْبَةِ: ruʾba — as printed, a misprint for رُؤْيَة 'sight, seeing' (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the sight of'
أَتُرَيٰ: أَ + تُرَيٰ — a-, interrogative particle + turā, passive of أَرَى 'to show' (IV; 'are you shown?'), the stock interjection; 'I wonder, will it be'
تَجْمَعُ: tajmaʿu — جَمَعَ, to gather, unite (imperfect, 3 f. sg.); 'will gather'; also 2ms addressing God in a prayer, tajmaʿu baynanā, '(may) you bring us together'
الْأَيَّامُ: الـ + أَيَّام — ayyām, days (m., broken pl. of يَوْم, nom., subject); 'the days'
شَمْلَنَابِهِ: شَمْل + نَا + بِـ + هِ — shaml, union, togetherness (m., acc., object) + -nā, our + bi-, with (prep.) + -hi, him; 'our union with him'
نَطْلُبُ: naṭlubu — طَلَبَ, to seek, ask for (imperfect, 1 pl.); 'we seek'
الِاجْتِمَاعَ: الـ + اجْتِمَاع — ijtimāʿ, meeting, gathering (VIII verbal noun, m., acc., object); 'the meeting'
وَاهْدِمُوهُ: وَ + اهْدِمُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ihdimū, هَدَمَ 'to demolish' (imperative, m. pl.) + -hu, it; 'and demolish it'
وَكَتِّفُوهُ: وَ + كَتِّفُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + kattifū, كَتَّفَ 'to bind the arms' (II, imperative, m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and bind him'
بِعِمَامَتِهِ: بِـ + عِمَامَة + هِ — bi-, with (prep., of the instrument) + ʿimāma, turban (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his turban'
وَجُرُّوهُ: وَ + جُرُّوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jurrū, جَرَّ 'to drag' (imperative, m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and drag him'
أَذِيَّةٍ: adhiyya, harm, injury (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'harm'
تَحْصُلُلَهُ: تَحْصُلُ + لِـ + هُ — taḥṣulu, حَصَلَ 'to befall, occur' (imperfect, 3 f. sg.) + li-, to (prep., marking the one affected) + -hu, him, run together; 'that befalls him'
دَارِالسَّعَادَةِ: دَار + الـ + سَعَادَة — dār, house (f., gen. after ilā) + saʿāda, felicity (f., gen.); 'the Dār al-Saʿāda', the governor's residence, printed as one word
بِنَائِبِ: بِـ + نَائِب — bi-, with (prep.; with اجْتَمَعَ, 'meet with') + nāʾib, deputy, governor (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the governor of'
وَأَطْلَعَهُ: وَ + أَطْلَعَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭlaʿa, to make aware, show (IV, perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and he showed him'; here also 'and brought him up', of hauling a man out of a well (the everyday sense of aṭlaʿa); here 'and brought him up' (to the king)
الْكُتُبِ: الـ + كُتُب — kutub, letters, books (m., pl. of كِتَاب, gen. after ʿalā); 'the letters'
فَوَضَعَهُمْ: فَـ + وَضَعَ + هُمْ — fa-, and (conj.) + waḍaʿa, to put, place (perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and he put them'
تَقْلِيبِهِمْ: تَقْلِيب + هِمْ — taqlīb, turning over (II verbal noun, m., gen.) + -him, them; 'turning them over'
غَرِيمُكَ: غَرِيم + كَ — gharīm, adversary, debtor/creditor (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your adversary'
أَمَرَحُجَّا: أَمَرَ + حُجَّا — amara, to command (perfect, 3 m. sg.) + ḥujjā-, probably حُجَّابَهُ, 'his chamberlains', with the print splitting the word, so that بِهِ follows; read as printed; 'he ordered the chamberlains (?)'
يَذْهَبُوا: yadhhabū — ذَهَبَ, to go (imperfect, 3 m. pl., subjunctive after an); 'go'
فَذَهَبُوا: فَـ + ذَهَبُوا — fa-, and (conj.) + dhahabū, to go (perfect, 3 m. pl.); 'and they went'
مُهَدَّ: muhadda — obscure, perhaps corrupt: probably مَهْدُومًا, 'demolished'; read as printed
شَيْئٍ: shayʾ, thing (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term; printed with the precomposed ئ); 'thing'
جَمَاعَتُهُ: جَمَاعَة + هُ — jamāʿa, band, company (f., nom., in apposition to the subject) + -hu, his; 'his band'
مُنْتَظِرِينَ: muntaẓirīn — waiting (act. part. of VIII intaẓara, m. pl., acc., circumstantial); 'waiting'
مَجِىءَ: majīʾ — coming, arrival (m., acc., object of the participle; first term of an iḍāfa; printed with ى then ء)
وَبَدْرُالدِّينِ: وَ + بَدْر + الـ + دِين — wa-, and, while (circumstantial wa-) + badr, full moon (m., nom.) + al-dīn, the faith (m., gen.); 'and Badr al-Dīn', printed as one word
يَاتُرَيٰ: يَا + تُرَيٰ — yā, O (particle) + turā, 'one is shown', the colloquial interjection يا ترى, 'I wonder'
رَأَوْا: raʾaw — رَأَى, to see (perfect, 3 m. pl.); 'they saw'
حَضَرَالْوَزِيرُ: حَضَرَ + الـ + وَزِير — ḥaḍara, to attend, come (perfect, 3 m. sg.) + wazīr, vizier (m., nom.), run together in the print; 'the vizier came'
نَائِبِ: nāʾib, deputy, governor (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa; printed with the precomposed ئ)
أَخْذِ: akhdh, taking (m., verbal noun, gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
غَرِيمِهِ: غَرِيم + هِ — gharīm, adversary (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his adversary'
وَيُسَافِرَ: وَ + يُسَافِرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yusāfira, سَافَرَ 'to travel' (III, imperfect, 3 m. sg., subjunctive as if after an; no an is printed); 'and to travel'
فَأَحْضَرُوهُ: فَـ + أَحْضَرُوا + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aḥḍarū, أَحْضَرَ 'to bring' (IV, perfect, 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they brought him' Also of a thing, 'it': aḥḍarūhu, 'they brought it (the food)'.
مُكَتَّفًا: mukattaf — bound, with the arms tied (pass. part. of II kattafa, m., acc. with tanwīn, circumstantial); 'bound'; here of a servant standing with arms folded across the chest, awaiting orders
بَكَي: bakā — he wept (I, perf. 3 m. sg., root ب-ك-ي; the print writes the final ā with ي)
مَوْلَاىَ: مَوْلَى + ـيَ — mawlā, master, lord (m.; after yā) + -ya, my; 'O my master'
طَبَخْتَ: ṭabakhta — you cooked (I ṭabakha, perf. 2 m. sg.)
وَجَدْتُمْ: wajadtum — you (pl.) found (I wajada, perf. 2 m. pl.)
شَيْءً: shayʾ — thing (m., acc. indef. with fatḥatān on the hamza, object of wajadtum; printed with no alif); 'something'
جَزَائِكَ: جَزَاء + ـِكَ — jazāʾ, requital, recompense (m., gen. as second term; the print has the hamza precomposed) + -ka, your; 'your requital'
مَاتُعَرِّفُنِي: مَا + تُعَرِّفُ + ـنِي — mā, not (negative particle, making a question 'won't you...?'); tuʿarrifu, you make known (II ʿarrafa, imperf. 2 m. sg.; with بِـ, 'inform of') + -nī, me; printed run together; 'won't you let me know'
بِذَبْنِي: بِـ + ذَبْن + ـِي — bi-, of, about (prep.; after ʿarrafa it introduces the thing made known); dhabn, printed for dhanb, offence (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my offence'
الْجِمَالَ: الـ + جِمَال — jimāl, camels (m. pl. of jamal, acc., object of hātū); 'the camels'
وَأَدْخَلُوهُ: وَ + أَدْخَلُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); adkhalū, they put in (IV adkhala, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they put him in'
وَقُفِلَ: وَ + قُفِلَ — wa-, and (conj.); qufila, it was locked (I qafala, passive perf. 3 m. sg.; the print has no vowels, and qafala, 'he locked', is possible); 'and it was locked'
فَحَطُّوا: فَـ + حَطُّوا — fa-, and so, then (conj.); ḥaṭṭū, they halted, set down their loads (I ḥaṭṭa, perf. 3 m. pl.; colloquial); 'and they halted'
وَأَخْرَجُوا: وَ + أَخْرَجُوا — wa-, and (conj.); akhrajū, they brought out (IV akhraja, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they brought out'
أَطْعَمُوهُ: أَطْعَمُوا + هُ — aṭʿamū, they fed (IV aṭʿama, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'they fed him' (no 'and' in the print)
وَعَادُوهُ: وَ + عَادُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); ʿādū, they put back (I ʿāda used for IV aʿāda, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they put him back'
قَمْرَةَ: Qamra — a place-name (diptote, gen. without tanwīn after ilā); I cannot identify it
فَأَخْرَجُوا: فَـ + أَخْرَجُوا — fa-, and so, then (conj.); akhrajū, they brought out (IV akhraja, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they brought out'
قَيِّدُوهُ: قَيِّدُوا + هُ — qayyidū, fetter! (II qayyada, imperative m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'fetter him'
فَقَيَّدُوهُ: فَـ + قَيَّدُوا + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.); qayyadū, they fettered (II qayyada, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they fettered him'
مِصْرَوَ: مِصْر + وَ — Miṣr, Egypt (here the city, Cairo; f. proper name, diptote, acc. after waṣalū) + wa-, and (the conjunction, printed run on to the name); 'Egypt, and'
فَى: fī — in, at (prep.); the print writes it with ى; 'at'
الزَّبْدَانِيَّةِ: الـ + زَّبْدَانِيَّة — al-Zabdāniyya, a place-name as printed (f., gen. after fī), where the party camps; 'al-Zabdāniyya'
بِإِخْرَاجِ: بِـ + إِخْرَاج — bi-, (ordered) with (prep.; the verb أَمَرَ chooses بِـ for the thing ordered); ikhrāj, bringing out (IV verbal noun, gen. after bi-, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the bringing out of'
نَجَّارٍ: najjār — carpenter (m., gen. indef., second term of the iḍāfa); 'a carpenter'
اصْنَعْ: iṣnaʿ — make! (I ṣanaʿa, imperative m. sg.)
لِهَذَ: لِـ + هَذَ — li-, for (prep.; marks who it is for); hādha, this (m. demonstrative; the print drops the final alif); 'for this one'
الْعَبَةَ: الـ + عَبَة — the print's spelling of al-laʿba (اللعبة, 'the frame, contraption'), a lām short; acc., object of iṣnaʿ; 'the frame'; obscure phrase, my reading is a best guess
أَشْنُقُكَ: أَشْنُقُ + كَ — ashnuqu, I hang (I shanaqa, imperf. 1 sg.; the bare imperfect has future sense) + -ka, you (m.); 'I will hang you'
وَأُسَمِّرُكَ: وَ + أُسَمِّرُ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.); usammiru, I nail (II sammara, imperf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (m.); 'and I will nail you'
اللَّعْبَةِ: الـ + لَّعْبَة — laʿba, frame, contraption (lit. 'plaything'; f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the frame'
أَيِّ: ayy — which, what (interrogative, first term of an iḍāfa; gen. after ʿalā); 'what'; here: gen. after ilā, ilā ayyi jihatin, 'to which quarter' Also gen. after fī: fī ayyi nāḥiyatin, 'in which quarter'; fī ayyi al-ḥārāti, 'in which of the quarters'.
نَحْسِ: naḥs — ill-luck, wretchedness (m., gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wretchedness of'
طَبْخِكَ: طَبْخ + كَ — ṭabkh, cooking (m. verbal noun of ṭabakha, gen., first term of an iḍāfa; governs ḥabba as object) + -ka, your; 'your cooking'
طَبَخْتَهُ: طَبَخْتَ + هُ — ṭabakhta, you cooked (I, perf. 2 m. sg.) + -hu, it (m.); 'you cooked it'
عَاوِزٌ: ʿāwiz — wanting, needing (colloquial act. part., = ʿāyiz; m., nom. as predicate, as printed); 'lacking'
فُلْفُلٌ: fulful — pepper (m., nom. indef. as printed, the thing wanted); 'pepper'
وَلِكَوْنِهِ: وَ + لِـ + كَوْن + هِ — wa-, and (conj.); li-, because of (prep., giving the reason); kawn, being (m. verbal noun of kāna, gen.) + -hi, its; 'and because of its being'
كَفَاكَ: كَفَى + كَ — kafā, it sufficed (I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you (m.); 'was enough for you'; here: a perfect used as a wish: kafāka Allāhu sharra …, 'may God spare you the harm of …'
حَبْسِي: حَبْس + ـِي — ḥabs, imprisonment (m. verbal noun of ḥabasa, nom. as subject of kafā) + -ī, my; 'my imprisonment'
تُطْعِمُونِي: تُطْعِمُو + نِي — tuṭʿimū, you (pl.) feed (IV aṭʿama, imperf. 2 m. pl.; the final nūn of the verb is merged with the object pronoun) + -nī, me; 'you feed me'
أَكْلَةً: akla — a meal, one eating (f., acc. indef., second object of tuṭʿimūnī); 'a meal'
جَزَاؤُكَ: جَزَاء + ـُكَ — jazāʾ, requital (m., nom. as subject; the print has the hamza precomposed, in the form jazāʾ-u-ka) + -ka, your; 'your requital'
الْقَتْلُ: الـ + قَتْل — qatl, killing, death (m. verbal noun, nom. as predicate); 'death'
تُفَكِّرُ: tufakkiru — you think, reflect (II fakkara, imperf. 2 m. sg.); 'you think'
الْقِشْرَوِيَّةِ: الـ + قِشْرَوِيَّة — qishrawiyya, husk-like (relative adj. from qishr, rind, husk; the -awī ending is colloquial; f., gen., agreeing with ʿuqūl as a broken plural); 'husk-like, shallow'
عَقْلِكَ: عَقْل + كَ — ʿaql, mind, sense (m., gen. as second term) + -ka, your; 'your mind'
نُؤْذِيَكَ: نُؤْذِي + كَ — nuʾdhī, we hurt (IV ādhā, imperf. 1 pl.; subjunctive after an; the print has no hamza sign) + -ka, you (m.); 'we hurt you'
لِمِثْلِهِ: لِـ + مِثْل + هِ — li-, to (prep.; taʿūda li-, 'return to, do again'); mithl, the like (m., gen.) + -hi, it; 'to the like of it'
أَقَلُّ: aqall — least, smallest (elative, nom., first term of an iḍāfa with shayʾ); 'the least'
أَذِيَّتِي: أَذِيَّة + ـِي — adhiyya, hurt, injury (f., nom. as predicate) + -ī, my; 'my hurt'
شَنْقِكَ: شَنْق + كَ — shanq, hanging (m. verbal noun of shanaqa, gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your hanging'
وَالنَّجَّارُ: وَ + الـ + نَّجَّار — wa-, and, while (circumstantial wāw); najjār, carpenter (m., nom.); 'while the carpenter'
يُصْلِحُ: yuṣliḥu — he prepares, mends (IV aṣlaḥa, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'he prepares'
غَدٍيَكُونُ: غَدٍ + يَكُونُ — ghad, tomorrow (m., gen. indef. after fī; fī ghadin, 'tomorrow') + yakūnu, it will be (I kāna, imperf. 3 m. sg.); printed run together; 'tomorrow it will be'
لِا: لِـ + ا — li-, to (prep.; marks the person addressed) + the alif of ابنته, printed as a separate word; together with the next word, li-ibnatihi, 'to his daughter'
بْنَتِهِ: (ا)بْنَة + هِ — ibna, daughter (f., gen. after li-; its initial alif is printed on the preceding لا) + -hi, his; 'his daughter'
شَمْلَكِ: شَمْل + كِ — shaml, union, gathered state (m., acc., object of jamaʿa; jamaʿa shamlahu, 'reunited') + -ki, your (f.); 'your reunion'
اِفْرُشِى: ifrushī — spread, furnish! (I farasha, imperative f. sg.; the print has ى for ي)
نَصْبَتِهِ: نَصْبَة + هِ — naṣba, arrangement, setting-up (f., gen.) + -hi, its; 'its arrangement'
الْجِلَاءِ: الـ + جِلَاء — jilāʾ, the unveiling of the bride (m., gen. as second term); 'the unveiling'
الْمُصَوَّرَةَ: الـ + مُصَوَّرَة — muṣawwara, drawn, with a picture (pass. part. of II ṣawwara, f., acc., agreeing with al-waraqa); 'the drawn'
صَوَّرَهَا: صَوَّرَ + هَا — ṣawwara, he drew, depicted (II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'he had drawn it'
بِنَصْبَةِ: بِـ + نَصْبَة — bi-, with, showing (prep.) + naṣba, arrangement (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'showing the arrangement of'
وَضَعُوا: waḍaʿū — they placed (I waḍaʿa, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they put'
شَىْ: shay — thing (m.; the print's spelling of shayʾ, hamza dropped, read shay; second term of kull); 'thing'; kulla shay, 'everything'
الرَّائِيَ: الـ + رَّائِي — rāʾī, one who sees, beholder (act. part. of I raʾā, m., acc. after anna); 'the beholder'
إِذَارَأَي: إِذَا + رَأَي — idhā, when, if (conj.; with a perfect); raʾā, he saw (I, perf. 3 m. sg.; the print writes the final ā with ي); printed run together; 'when he saw'
لَايَشُكُّ: لَا + يَشُكُّ — lā, not (negative particle); yashukku, he doubts (I shakka, imperf. 3 m. sg.); printed run together; 'does not doubt'
لَيْلَةُ: layla — night (f., nom. as predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the night of'
يَحُطُّوا: yaḥuṭṭū — they put, set down (I ḥaṭṭa, imperf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after an; colloquial); 'they put'
حَطَّهُ: حَطَّ + هُ — ḥaṭṭa, he put, laid down (I, perf.; colloquial) + -hu, it; 'he put it'
السِّرْوَالَ: الـ + سِّرْوَال — sirwāl, trousers (m., acc., object (of yaḥuṭṭū, understood)); 'the trousers'
أَمَرَا: amara — to order, command (verb I, perf. 3ms); the final alif is a printed slip, not part of the verb; 'he ordered'
بِنْتَهُ: bint + هُ — bint, daughter (f., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his daughter'
تُخَفِّفَ: khaffafa, to lighten, make light (verb II, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after an); 'she lighten'; the sense is uncertain, see the note
الْجَلَاءِ: الـ + جَلَاء — jalāʾ, unveiling, display of the bride (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the unveiling'
الْخَلْوَةِ: الـ + خَلْوَة — khalwa, seclusion, privacy (f., gen. after fī); 'the seclusion, in private'
فَقُولِي: فَـ + قُولِي — fa-, then, so (conj.) + qūlī, say! (imperative 2fs of qāla); 'then say'
أَبْطَأْتَ: abṭaʾa, to be slow, delay (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you were slow'
عُبُورِكَ: ʿubūr + كَ — ʿubūr, crossing, passing (verbal noun of ʿabara, m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your (m.); 'your crossing'
وَدَعِيهِ: وَ + دَعِي + هِ — wa-, and + daʿī, let, leave (imperative 2fs of wadaʿa/daʿa) + -hi, him; 'and let him'
يَبَاتَ: yabāt, to spend the night (colloquial form of yabīt, from bāta; 3ms, here subjunctive in the sense 'let him spend the night')
وَتُحَدِّثِينَ: وَ + تُحَدِّثِينَ — wa-, and + ḥaddatha, to converse, tell (verb II, imperf. 2fs indicative); 'and you converse'
نَكْشِفُ: kashafa, to uncover, reveal (verb I, imperf. 1pl.); 'we reveal' (the purpose is implied: 'so that we reveal')
التَّارِيخَ: الـ + تَارِيخ — tārīkh, history, account, date (m., acc., object of nakshifu); 'the story'
فَكَّ: fakka, to loosen, undo (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he loosed'
الْقَيْدَ: الـ + قَيْد — qayd, fetter, shackle (m., acc., object); 'the fetter'
وَقَلَعَهُ: وَ + قَلَعَ + هُ — wa-, and + qalaʿa, to pull off, strip (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he stripped him (of)'
بِقَمِيصِ: بِـ + قَمِيص — bi-, in, wearing (prep.; of dress, 'clad in') + qamīṣ, shirt (m., gen. after bi-, first term of an iḍāfa); 'in the shirt (of)'
زَفِيعٌ: zafīʿ — obscure, perhaps 'stripped, bare' (m., nom. indef.; not in the standard lexicons; see the note)
تَنَبَّهَ: tanabbaha, to wake up, become alert (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he woke'
دِهْلِيزِ: dihlīz, vestibule, entrance passage (m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa)
نُورٍ: nūr, light (m., gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa; possibly a name); 'of light'
أَضْغَاثِ: aḍghāth, bundles of mixed stalks, hence confused things (pl. of ḍighth, m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
أَحْلَامٍ: aḥlām, dreams (pl. of ḥulm, m., gen. indef.); aḍghāth aḥlām, 'a jumble of dreams'
تَمَشَّى: tamashshā, to walk along, go on foot (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he walked'
انْجَلَتْ: injalat, injalā, to be unveiled, displayed (verb VII, perf. 3fs; of a bride shown to the groom); 'she was unveiled'
وَالْكُرْسِيِّ: وَ + الـ + كُرْسِيّ — wa-, and + kursī, chair, seat (m., gen. in apposition); 'and the chair'
وَحَوَائِجَهُ: وَ + حَوَائِج + هُ — wa-, and + ḥawāʾij, needs, belongings (pl. of ḥāja, m., acc. diptote) + -hu, his; 'and his belongings'
بَهِتَ: bahita, to be dumbfounded, struck dumb (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he was struck dumb'
يُقَدِّمُ: qaddama, to put forward, advance (verb II, imperf. 3ms); 'he advances'
رِجْلًا: rijl, foot, leg (f., acc. indef., object); 'a foot'
وَيُؤَخِّرُ: وَ + يُؤَخِّرُ — wa-, and + akhkhara, to put back, delay (verb II, imperf. 3ms); 'and he draws back'
يَقْظَانُ: yaqẓān, awake, wakeful (adj., m., nom. diptote); 'awake'
يَمْسَحُ: masaḥa, to wipe, rub (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he wipes'
جَبِينَهُ: jabīn + هُ — jabīn, forehead, brow (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his forehead'
مَكَانُ: makān, place (m., nom., predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the place of'
فَيْنْ: fayn — where? (colloquial, Egyptian fēn, from fī + ayn); 'where?'
بِسِتِّ: بِـ + سِتّ — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise ('and behold, ...'), not a true 'with' + sitt, lady (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa; title of address, used also in the name Sitt al-Ḥusn); 'behold, Sitt'
رَفَعَتْ: rafaʿa, to raise, lift (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she lifted'
ضَحِكَ: ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he laughed'
إِتْنِي: itnī — printed for innanī or innī, 'indeed I' (inna + -nī); the ت is a slip for ن; the sense is 'I (am)'
وَتَنَهَّدَ: وَ + تَنَهَّدَ — wa-, and + tanahhada, to sigh (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he sighed'
وَتَحَيَّرَ: وَ + تَحَيَّرَ — wa-, and + taḥayyara, to be bewildered (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he was bewildered'
وَأَشْكَلَتْ: وَ + أَشْكَلَتْ — wa-, and + ashkala, to be ambiguous, perplexing (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and it was perplexing'
قَضِينَهُ: qaḍīna + هُ — printed for qaḍiyyatuhu, qaḍiyya, case, affair (f.), with ن for ت, + -hu, his; 'his case'
وَسِرْوَالَهُ: وَ + سِرْوَال + هُ — wa-, and + sirwāl, trousers (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his trousers'
تَتَعَجَّبُ: taʿajjaba, to marvel, be amazed (verb V, imperf. 2ms); 'you marvel'
وَتَبْهَتُ: وَ + تَبْهَتُ — wa-, and + bahita, to be struck dumb (verb I, imperf. 2ms); 'and you are dumbfounded'
عَنْكِ: عَنْ + كِ — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + -ki, you (f.); 'from you'; also 'about you', after samiʿa: al-khabaru alladhī samiʿtuhu ʿanki, 'the news I heard about you' (Night 193)
حَوَالَيْكَ: ḥawāl + ـَيْ + كَ — ḥawālay, around (dual of ḥawl, m., acc.; adverb of place) + -ka, you; 'around you'
وَتَرْجِعُ: وَ + تَرْجِعُ — wa-, and + rajaʿa, to return (verb I, imperf. 2ms); 'and return'
عَدِمَ: ʿadima, to be lost, lacking (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'it is lost'
عَقْلُكَ: ʿaql + كَ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'your mind'
صَدَقْتِ: ṣadaqa, to speak the truth, be right (verb I, perf. 2fs); 'you are right'
رُوحِى: rūḥ + ي — rūḥ, spirit, self (f.; the print has ى for ي) + -ī, my; 'my self'
وَحَلَمْتُ: وَ + حَلَمْتُ — wa-, and + ḥalama, to dream (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I dreamed'
وَأَقَمْتُ: وَ + أَقَمْتُ — wa-, and + aqāma, to stay, reside (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I stayed'
وَكَأَنِّي: وَ + كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — wa-, and + ka-anna, as though, it seems that (particle) + -nī, I; 'and as though I'
جَاءَنِي: jāʾa + نِي — jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he came to me'
الْأَكَابِرِ: الـ + أَكَابِر — akābir, great ones, notables (pl. of akbar, m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the great'
مَسَّ: massa, to touch (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he touched'
حَقٌّلِأَنَّهُ: حَقٌّ + لِـ + أَنَّ + هُ — ḥaqq, true, truth (m., nom. indef.) + li-, because, for (prep.; with anna, 'because') + anna, that + -hu, he; 'true, because he'; the print joins the words
ضَرَبَنِي: ضَرَبَ + نِي — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he struck me'
جَبِينِي: jabīn + ي — jabīn, forehead (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; 'my forehead'
فَشَجَّهُ: فَـ + شَجَّ + هُ — fa-, and so + shajja, to split, wound the head (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and he split it'
فَكَأَنَّهُ: فَـ + كَأَنَّ + هُ — fa-, so + ka-anna, as though + -hu, it; 'so as though it'
الْيَقَظَةِ: الـ + يَقَظَة — yaqaẓa, wakefulness (f., gen. after fī); 'the waking state'
مَاتَعَانَقْتُ: مَا + تَعَانَقْتُ — mā, since, when (conj.) + taʿānaqa, to embrace one another (verb VI, perf. 1cs; 1sg here where the plural is expected, colloquial); 'since I embraced'; the print joins the words
وَنِمْنَا: وَ + نِمْنَا — wa-, and + nāma, to sleep (verb I, perf. 1pl.); 'and we slept'
فَكَأَنِّي: فَـ + كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — fa-, and so + ka-anna, as though + -nī, I; 'and as though I'
وَرَأَيْتُ: وَ + رَأَيْتُ — wa-, and + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I saw'
طَرْبُوشٍ: ṭarbūsh, tarbush, brimless felt cap, fez (m., gen. indef. after bi-lā); 'a tarbush'
وَلَاسِرْوَالٍ: وَ + لَا + سِرْوَال — wa-, and + lā, no, without + sirwāl, trousers (m., gen. indef.); 'and no trousers'; the print joins the words
طَبَخْتُ: ṭabakha, to cook (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I cooked'
وَفُلْفُلُهُ: وَ + فُلْفُل + هُ — wa-, and, while (circumstantial wāw) + fulful, pepper (m., nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'and its pepper (was)'
مَاكَأَنِّي: مَا + كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — mā, not + ka-anna, as though + -nī, I; mā ka-annī illā, 'it is as if only I', 'nothing but that I'; the print joins the words
وَأَيْشَ: وَ + أَيْشَ — wa-, and + aysh, what? (colloquial, from ayyu shayʾin; acc. as object of raʾayta); 'and what?'
تَنَبَّهْتُ: tanabbaha, to wake up (verb V, perf. 1cs); 'I woke up'
لَكَانُوا: لَ + كَانُوا — la-, would (introduces the result of a conditional) + kāna, to be (verb I, perf. 3mpl.); la-kānū, 'they would have'
سَمَّرُونِي: سَمَّرُوا + نِي — sammara, to nail, pin (verb II, perf. 3mpl.) + -nī, me; 'they nailed me'
لُعْبَةِ: luʿba, toy, plaything (f., gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'a toy of'
فُلْفُلِ: fulful, pepper (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the pepper of'
كَأَنَّهُمْ: كَأَنَّ + هُمْ — ka-anna, as though, it seems that + -hum, they; 'as though they'
خَرَّبُوا: kharraba, to ruin, wreck (verb II, perf. 3mpl.); 'they wrecked'
وَكَسَّرُوا: وَ + كَسَّرُوا — wa-, and + kassara, to smash, break to pieces (verb II, perf. 3mpl.); 'and they smashed'
مَوَاعِينِي: mawāʿīn + ي — mawāʿīn, utensils, vessels (pl. of māʿūn, m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my utensils'
وَحَطُّونِي: وَ + حَطُّوا + نِي — wa-, and + ḥaṭṭa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3mpl., colloquial) + -nī, me; 'and they put me'
وَجَاوُأ: وَ + جَاؤُوا — wa-, and + jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3mpl.); the print writes جاوأ with the hamza on the final alif; 'and they came'
بِالنَّجَّارِ: بِـ + الـ + نَجَّار — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi-, 'to bring') + al-, the + najjār, carpenter (m., gen.); 'with the carpenter, (they brought) the carpenter'
يَصْنَعُ: ṣanaʿa, to make (verb I, imperf. 3ms; a clause with no connecting word); 'he makes'
خَشَبَةً: khashaba, beam, plank, here the gallows-beam (f., acc. indef., object); 'a beam'
لِأَنَّهُمْ: لِـ + أَنَّ + هُمْ — li-, because (prep. before anna) + anna, that + -hum, they; 'because they'
أَرَادُوا: arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, perf. 3mpl.); 'they wanted'
شَنْقِي: shanq + ي — shanq, hanging (verbal noun of shanaqa, m., acc., object) + -ī, my; 'to hang me'
وَضَمَّتْهُ: وَ + ضَمَّتْ + هُ — wa-, and + ḍamma, to clasp, draw to oneself (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she clasped him'
وَضَمَّهَا: وَ + ضَمَّ + هَا — wa-, and + ḍamma, to clasp (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he clasped her'
تَفَكَّرَ: tafakkara, to reflect, think (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he reflected'
مَاكَأَنَّهُ: مَا + كَأَنَّ + هُ — mā, not + ka-anna, as though + -hu, it; mā ka-annahu illā, 'it was nothing but, it can only have been'; the print joins the words
مُتَحَيِّرٌ: mutaḥayyir, bewildered (act. part. V of taḥayyara, m., nom. indef., circumstantial); 'bewildered'
تَارَةً: tāra, time, turn (f., acc. indef., adverbial); tāratan ... tāratan, 'now ... now'
حَلَمْتُ: ḥalama, to dream (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I dreamed'
وَتَارَةً: وَ + تَارَةً — wa-, and + tāra, time, turn (f., acc. indef.); 'and now'
وَلَازَالَ: وَ + لَا + زَالَ — wa-, and + lā, not + zāla, to cease (verb I, perf. 3ms); lā zāla, 'he did not cease, he remained'; the print joins the words
أَمَرْتَ: amara, to order, command (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you ordered'
بِتَكْنِيفِي: بِـ + تَكْنِيف + ي — bi-, of, with (prep.; amara bi-, 'to command something') + taknīf, binding, tying up (verbal noun; perhaps a slip for taktīf, gen. after bi-) + -ī, my; 'to bind me'
وَتَسْمِيرِي: وَ + تَسْمِير + ي — wa-, and + tasmīr, nailing, pinning (verbal noun of sammara, gen.) + -ī, my; 'and to nail me'
وَتَخْرِيبِ: وَ + تَخْرِيب — wa-, and + takhrīb, wrecking, ruining (verbal noun of kharraba, gen. after bi-, first term of an iḍāfa); 'and to wreck'
عَاوِزْ: ʿāwiz, wanting (colloquial Egyptian, for Classical yurīdu; act. part., m.); 'wanting'
فَافِلْ: fāfil — printed for fulful, 'pepper'; read as pepper from the sense; 'pepper'
ظَهَرَ: ẓahara, to appear, come to light (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'it appeared'
مُخْتَفِي: mukhtafī, hidden, concealed (act. part. VIII of ikhtafā, m., without tanwīn as printed); 'hidden'
لِكَوْنِكَ: لِـ + كَوْن + كَ — li-, because of (prep.) + kawn, being (gen.) + -ka, you; 'because you'
عَرَفْتَ: ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you knew'
وَعَرَفْتَ: وَ + عَرَفْتَ — wa-, and + ʿarafa, to know (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'and you knew'
شَاشَكَ: shāsh + كَ — shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your turban-cloth'
وَسِرْوَا: وَ + سِرْوَا — wa-, and + sirwā, first part of sirwāl, trousers; the print splits the word, and لَكَ completes it; 'and (your) trousers'
وَذَهَبَكَ: وَ + ذَهَب + كَ — wa-, and + dhahab, gold (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your gold'
بِخَطِّكَ: بِـ + خَطّ + كَ — bi-, in (prep.; 'written in') + khaṭṭ, handwriting (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your handwriting'
كَتَبَهَا: كَتَبَ + هَا — kataba, to write (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it; 'he wrote it'
رَأَيْتُكَ: رَأَيْتُ + كَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -ka, you; 'I saw you'
وَمَاكُنْتُ: وَ + مَا + كُنْتُ — wa-, and + mā, not + kāna, to be (perf. 1cs); 'and I was not'; the print joins the words
أَعْرِفُكَ: أَعْرِفُ + كَ — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -ka, you; 'I know you'
أُمَّكَ: umm + كَ — umm, mother (f., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your mother'
جِبْتُهَا: جِبْتُ + هَا — jibtu, I brought (colloquial for jiʾtu bi-hā) + -hā, her; 'I brought her'
وَعَانَقَ: وَ + عَانَقَ — wa-, and + ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'and he embraced'
عَمَّهُ: ʿamm + هُ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his uncle'
وَالِدِكَ: wālid + كَ — wālid, father (m., gen. in the annexation) + -ka, your; 'your father'
بَيْنَهُ: bayna + هُ — bayna, between + -hu, him; 'between him'
سَفَرِ: safar, journey (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the journey of'
تَفَرُّقٍ: tafarruq — scattering, separation (m. verbal noun V, gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa)
شَمْلِنَا: شَمْل + نَا — shaml, union, gathered company (m., gen.); -nā, our; 'our union'
قَدْرًا: qadr — measure, extent (m., acc.); adverbial, 'to such a degree'
اَفَاضَ: afāḍa — to make overflow (IV perf. 3 m.s.); 'it made overflow'
الدَّمْعَ: الـ + دَمْع — damʿ, tears (m., acc. object); 'the tears'
اَجْفَانِي: جَفْن + ـِي — jafn, eyelid (m., broken pl. ajfān, gen. after min); -ī, my; 'my eyelids'
وَنَذَرْتُ: و + نَذَرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); nadhara, to vow (perf. 1 s.); 'and I vowed'
يَلُمُّنَا: lamma — to gather, bring together (imperf. 3 m.s.) + نَا, us; 'gather us'
بِلِسَانِي: بِـ + لِسَان + ـِي — bi-, with, by means of (prep.); lisān, tongue (m.); -ī, my; 'with my tongue'
السُّرُورُ: الـ + سُرُور — surūr, joy (m., nom.); 'the joy'
اَنَّنِي: أَنَّ + نِي — anna, that (conj.) + -nī, me; 'that I'
عِظَمِ: ʿiẓam — greatness, bigness (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa)
سَرَّنِي: sarra — to gladden (perf. 3 m.s.) + نِي, me; 'gladdened me'
اَبْكَانِي: abkā — to make weep (IV perf. 3 m.s.) + نِي, me; 'it made me weep'
بِوَالِدَتِهِ: بِـ + وَالِدَة + ـهِ — bi-, after idhā of surprise only marks what appears; wālida, mother (f.); -hi, his; 'and behold, his mother'
أَنْشَدَتْ: anshada — to recite (verse) (IV perf. 3 f.s.); 'she recited'
اِشْتَكَيْنَا: ishtakā — to complain (VIII perf. 1 pl.); 'we complained'
الشِّكْوَى: الـ + شِكْوَى — shikwā, complaint (f., nom.); 'the complaint'
عَلَىٰ: ʿalā — on, upon (prep.); printed with a superscript alif
رَسُولْ: rasūl — messenger (m., gen.); final sukun printed for the pause
إِنَّ: inna — indeed (particle that introduces a clause and puts its subject in the accusative)
وَالِدَتَهُ: وَالِدَة + هُ — wālida, mother (f., acc. after inna); -hu, his; 'his mother'
حَكَتْ: ḥakā — to relate, tell (perf. 3 f.s.); 'she told'
قَاسَاهُ: قَاسَى + هُ — qāsā, to suffer, endure (III perf. 3 m.s.); -hu, it; 'he suffered it'
فَشَكَرُوا: فَـ + شَكَرُوا — fa-, and so (sequence); shakara, to thank (perf. 3 m.pl.); 'so they thanked'
اجْتِمَاعِ: ijtimāʿ — gathering, coming together (m. verbal noun VIII, gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa); here gen. after baʿda, printed with a single kasra where ijtimāʿin is meant
شَمْلِهِمْ: شَمْل + هِمْ — shaml, union (m., gen.); -him, their; 'their union'
الدِّينِ: الـ + دِين — dīn, religion, faith (m., gen.); 'the faith'
السُّلْطَانِ: الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., gen.); 'the sultan'
بِيَوْمَيْنِ: بِـ + يَوْمَيْن — bi-, by (marks the margin, 'by two days'); yawm, day (m., dual gen.); 'two days (after)'
وَحَيَّاهُ: و + حَيَّاهُ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥayyā, to greet (II perf. 3 m.s.); -hu, him; 'and greeted him'
بِتَحِيَّةِ: بِـ + تَحِيَّة — bi-, with (of the means); taḥiyya, greeting (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the greeting of'
السُّلْطَانُ: الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., nom.); 'the sultan'
وَبَشَّ: و + بَشَّ — wa-, and (conj.); bashsha, to beam, look glad (perf. 3 m.s.); 'and beamed'
وَحْهِهِ: وَجْه + هِ — wajh, face (m., gen.); -hi, his; printed with ح for ج; 'in his face'
وَأَدْنَاهُ: و + أَدْنَاهُ — wa-, and (conj.); adnā, to bring near (IV perf. 3 m.s.); -hu, him; 'and drew him near'
اسْتَخْبَرَهُ: istakhbara, to ask for news (X perf. 3 m.s.) + هُ, him; 'he asked him for news'
عَمَّا: عَنْ + مَا — ʿan, about, concerning (prep.) + mā, what (rel.); 'about what'
سَفْرَتِهِ: سَفْرَة + هِ — safra, journey (f., gen. after fī); -hi, his; 'his journey'
بِالْقِصَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + قِصَّة — bi-, of, about (أَخْبَرَ بِـ 'tell of', the verb chooses the preposition); qiṣṣa, story (f.); 'of the story'
أَوَّلِهَا: أَوَّل + هَا — awwal, first, beginning (m., gen. after min); -hā, its; 'its beginning'
لِلَّهِ: لِـ + اللَّه — li-, to, belonging to (prep.); Allāh, God (gen.); 'praise (be) to God'; also لِلَّهِ أَبُوكَ 'to God (belongs) your father', an exclamation of admiration (as in 'what a father you had')
ظَفَرِكَ: ظَفَر + كَ — ẓafar, winning, success (m. verbal noun, gen. after ʿalā); -ka, your; 'your winning'
بِالْمُرَادِ: بِـ + الـ + مُرَاد — bi-, of (ظَفَرَ بِـ 'win', the verb chooses the preposition); murād, the desired, what one wants (m., pass. part. IV); 'of what you desired'
وَرُجُوعِكَ: و + رُجُوع + كَ — wa-, and (conj.); rujūʿ, returning (m. verbal noun, gen.); -ka, your; 'and your return'
سَالِمًا: sālim — safe, unharmed (act. part., m., acc. as hāl); 'safe'
الْأَهْلِ: الـ + أَهْل — ahl, family, people (m., gen. after ilā); 'the family'
وَالْأَ: و + الـ + أَ — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; a-, the first letter of أَوْلَاد; first part of وَالْأَوْلَادِ, split by a stray space (see the next entry)
وْلَادِ: second part of وَالْأَوْلَادِ: wlād, from awlād, children (m. pl. of walad, gen. after ilā); the و is the second letter of أَوْلَاد; 'the children' (with the preceding part)
وَلَابُدَّ: و + لَا + بُدَّ — wa-, and (conj.); lā budda, 'there is no escape' (lā of absolute negation + budd, escape); printed as one word; lā budda min 'it is unavoidable that', i.e. 'I must'
أَخِيكَ: أَخ + كَ — akh, brother (m., gen.; akhī- in the construct); -ka, your; ibn akhīka 'your brother's son, your nephew'
الْبَصْرِيَّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — baṣrī, of Basra (nisba adj., acc.); 'the Basran'
فَأْتِ: فَـ + أْتِ — fa-, so (sequence, here after a command); ʾti, imperative of atā, to come; أَتَى بِـ 'bring'; 'so bring'
الدِّيوَانِ: الـ + دِيوَان — dīwān, court, council hall (m., gen. after ilā); 'the court'
يَحْضُرُ: ḥaḍara — to be present, attend (imperf. 3 m.s.); 'he will attend' Also with bi-, 'to come with', i.e. 'to bring': mā yaḥḍuru bihi illā anta, 'none but you will bring him'.
عَبْدُكَ: عَبْد + كَ — ʿabd, servant, slave (m., nom.); -ka, your; 'your servant', a courtly self-reference
شَاءَاللَّهُ: شَاءَ + اللَّهُ — shāʾa, to will (perf. 3 m.s.); Allāh, God (nom., subject); printed as one word; إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ 'if God wills'
بِاشْتِيَاقِ: بِـ + اشْتِيَاق — bi-, of, about (أَخْبَرَ بِـ 'tell of'); ishtiyāq, longing (m. verbal noun VIII, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the longing of'
الْبَصْرِيُّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — baṣrī, of Basra (nisba adj., nom.); 'the Basran'
مُنْقَادٌ: munqād — submissive, obedient (VII act. part., m., nom. predicate); 'obedient'
لِأَمْرِ: لِـ + أَمْر — li-, to (with مُنْقَاد 'obedient to'); amr, command (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'to the command of'
مَوْلَاهُ: مَوْلَى + هُ — mawlā, master, lord (m., gen.); -hu, his; 'his master'
وَالْحَاصِلُ: و + الـ + حَاصِل — wa-, and (conj.); ḥāṣil, the result, upshot (m., act. part., nom.); 'and the upshot', i.e. 'in short'
أَنَّهُ: أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (conj.) + -hu, he; 'that he'
حَضْرَةِ: ḥaḍra — presence (f., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the presence of'
عَمِّهِ: عَمّ + هِ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen. after maʿa); -hi, his; 'his uncle'
وَلَمَّا: و + لَمَّا — wa-, and (conj.); lammā, when (conj., + perfect); 'and when'
حَيَّاهُ: ḥayyā — to greet (II perf. 3 m.s.) + هُ, him; 'he greeted him'
بِأَكْمَلِ: بِـ + أَكْمَل — bi-, with (of the means); akmal, most complete (elative, m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the most perfect of'
التَّحِيَّاتِ: الـ + تَحِيَّات — taḥiyyāt, greetings (f. sound pl., gen.); 'the greetings'
وَأَفْضَلِهَا: و + أَفْضَل + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); afḍal, best, most excellent (elative, m., gen.); -hā, them; 'and the best of them'
شِــــعْر: shiʿr — verse, poetry (m.); the heading the print sets before a poem, here stretched with kashīda strokes
يُقَبِّلُ: qabbala — to kiss (II imperf. 3 m.s.); 'he kisses'
الْارْضَ: الـ + اَرْض — arḍ, earth, ground (f., acc.); 'the ground'
عَزَّتْ: ʿazza — to be mighty, precious (perf. 3 f.s.)
مَرَاتِبُهُ: مَرَاتِب + هُ — marātib, ranks, degrees (broken pl., nom.); -hu, his; 'his ranks'
وَبِالنُّجْحِ: و + بِـ + الـ + نُجْح — wa-, and (conj.); bi-, with, by means of; najḥ, success (m.); 'and with success'
مَطَالِبُهْ: مَطَالِب + هُ — maṭālib, aims, desires (m. broken pl., nom.); -hu, his (printed with sukun); 'his aims'
اُولُوا: ulū — possessors of, lords of (m. pl. nom., used only in a construct); first term of an iḍāfa
الْمَجْدِ: الـ + مَجْد — majd, glory (m., gen.); 'the glory'
يُحْظَى: ḥaẓiya — to be fortunate; yuḥẓā, passive (imperf. 3 m.s.), 'is favoured'
يُؤَمِّلُكُمْ: ammala — to hope in (II imperf. 3 m.s.) + كُمْ, you; 'who hopes in you'
نَا: nā — obscure; perhaps a stray syllable, or '-nā, our' (see the note)
مَنَا: manā — first part of مَنَاصِب (manāṣib, ranks, offices), split by a stray space; with the next word 'his ranks'
صِبُهْ: ṣib + hu — rest of مَنَاصِبُهُ (manāṣibuhu), 'his ranks' (printed with sukun)
فَتَبَسَّمَ: فَـ + تَبَسَّمَ — fa-, and so (sequence); tabassama, to smile (V perf. 3 m.s.); 'and smiled'
بِقُرْبِ: بِـ + قُرْب — bi-, at, by (prep.); qurb, nearness (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'beside'; also after istabshara, 'to rejoice at good news', bi- marks the cause of joy: istabshara bi-qurbi al-diyāri, 'took heart at the nearness of the land' (Night 201)
سَأَلَهُ: saʾala — to ask (perf. 3 m.s.) + هُ, him; 'he asked him'
اسْمِهِ: اسْم + هِ — ism, name (m., gen.); -hi, his; 'his name'
أَحْقَرُ: aḥqar — humblest, most insignificant (elative, m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
بِحَسَنِ: بِـ + حَسَن — bi-, as, by the name (مَعْرُوف بِـ 'known as'); Ḥasan, personal name (gen.); 'as Ḥasan'
الْبَصْرِىِّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — baṣrī, of Basra (nisba adj., gen.); ى printed for ي; 'the Basran'
الدَّاعِي: الـ + دَاعِي — dāʿī, one who prays, a supplicant (act. part. of daʿā, m., nom.); 'the one who prays'
فَأَعْجَبَ: فَـ + أَعْجَبَ — fa-, and so (sequence); aʿjaba, to please, delight (IV perf. 3 m.s.); 'and it pleased'
السُّلْطَانَ: الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., acc. object); 'the sultan'
كَلَامُهُ: كَلَام + هُ — kalām, speech (m., nom.); -hu, his; 'his speech'
وَأَرَادَأَنْ: و + أَرَادَ + أَنْ — wa-, and (conj.); arāda, to want, wish (IV perf. 3 m.s.); an, that (+ subjunctive); printed as one word; 'and he wished to'
يَمْتَحِنَهُ: imtaḥana — to test (VIII subj. 3 m.s.) + هُ, him; 'that he test him'
شَأْنُ: shaʾn — matter, standing, rank (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
عِلْمِهِ: عِلْم + هِ — ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m., gen.); -hi, his; 'his learning'
وَأَدَبِهِ: و + أَدَب + هِ — wa-, and (conj.); adab, culture, good breeding (m., gen.); -hi, his; 'and his breeding'
تَحْفَظُ: ḥafiẓa — to memorise, know by heart (imperf. 2 m.s.); 'you know by heart'
وَصْفِ: waṣf — description (m. verbal noun, gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْخَالِ: الـ + خَال — khāl, mole, beauty-spot (m., gen.); 'the mole'; the same word also means 'maternal uncle'
شِـــعْــر: shiʿr — verse, poetry (m.); the heading before a poem, stretched with kashīda strokes
فَكَّرْتُ: fakkara — to think, reflect (II perf. 1 s.); 'I thought'
تَوَالَتْ: tawālā — to follow one another in succession (VI perf. 3 f.s.); 'followed one another'
نَحِيبِي: نَحِيب + ـِي — naḥīb, sobbing (m., nom.); -ī, my; 'my sobbing'
خَالٌ: khāl — mole, beauty-spot (m., nom. indef.); 'a mole'
وَلَوْنًا: و + لَوْن — wa-, and (conj.); lawn, colour (m., acc.); 'and in colour'
فَاسْتَحْسَنَ: فَـ + اسْتَحْسَنَ — fa-, and so (sequence); istaḥsana, to approve, find good (X perf. 3 m.s.); 'and he admired'
غَيْرَهُمَا: غَيْر + هُمَا — ghayr, other than (m., acc.); -humā, them both; 'other than the two'
أَبُوكَ: أَب + كَ — ab, father (m., nom.; abū- in the construct); -ka, your; 'your father'
فُضَّ: fuḍḍa — to be broken, shattered (I pass. perf. 3 m.s.); 'may it not be broken'
فُوكَ: فُو + كَ — fū, mouth (m., nom.; the construct form of fam); -ka, your; 'your mouth'
شِعْر: shiʿr — verse, poetry (m.); the heading the print sets before a poem
وَنُقْطَةِ: و + نُقْطَة — wa-, 'many a' (the wāw of rubba, taking the genitive); nuqṭa, dot, spot (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and (many) a dot of'
شَبَّهُوهَا: شَبَّهُوا + هَا — shabbaha, to liken (II perf. 3 m.pl.); -hā, it; 'they likened it'
بِحَبَّةٍ: بِـ + حَبَّة — bi-, to (شَبَّهَ بِـ 'liken to', the verb chooses the preposition); ḥabba, a grain (f., gen.); 'to a grain'
لِقَوْلِ: لِـ + قَوْل — li-, at (عَجِبَ لِـ 'marvel at'); qawl, saying (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'at the saying of'
شَبَّهْ: shabbaha — to liken, compare (II perf. 3 m.s.; printed with final sukun); 'compared'
لِوَجْهٍ: لِـ + وَجْه — li-, at (اعْجَبْ لِـ 'marvel at'); wajh, face (m., gen. indef.); 'at a face'
الْحُسْنَ: الـ + حُسْن — ḥusn, beauty (m., acc.); 'the beauty'
كُلَّهُ: كُلّ + هُ — kull, all (m., acc.); -hu, it; 'all of it'
فَاتَهُ: فَاتَ + هُ — fāta, to escape, elude (perf. 3 m.s.); -hu, it; 'escaped it' Also -hu, him: mā fātahu, 'what had passed him by', i.e. the prayers he had missed.
حَبَّهْ: ḥabba — a grain (f.; printed with final sukun, for the rhyme); وَلَا حَبَّهْ 'nor a grain'
فَاهْتَزَّ: فَـ + اهْتَزَّ — fa-, and so (sequence); ihtazza, to be stirred, to shake (VIII perf. 3 m.s.); 'and was stirred'
طَرَبًا: ṭarab — delight, rapture (m., acc. of state); 'with delight'
زِدْنِي: زِدْ + نِي — zid, increase (imperative of zāda) + -nī, me; 'give me more'
اللَّهُ: Allāh — God (nom., subject); بَارَكَ اللَّهُ 'may God bless', شَاءَ اللَّهُ 'God willed'
الْخَالَ: الـ + خَال — khāl, mole (m., acc. object); 'the mole'
نُقْطَةُ: nuqṭa — dot, spot (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
قُوتَهْ: (1) in يَا قُوتَهْ, the second half of يَاقُوت, yāqūt, ruby (printed as two words, with pause-sukun); (2) in وَيَا قُوتَهْ, qūt, sustenance, food (m.) + -hu, its (the heart's); 'its sustenance'
اَنْعِمْ: anʿama — to grant favour (IV imperative); 'grant favour'
بِوَصْلِي: بِـ + وَصْل + ـِي — bi-, with, by (اَنْعِمْ بِـ 'favour with'); waṣl, union, meeting (m.); -ī, my; 'with my union'
اَلَّا: an + lā — that not (conj. + neg.); 'so that you not'
قَاسِيًا: qāsin — cruel, hard (act. part., m., acc. predicate of kāna); 'cruel'
مُنْيَةَ: munya — wish, desire (f., acc. vocative; first term of an iḍāfa); 'wish of'
أَحْسَنْتَ: aḥsana — to do well (IV perf. 2 m.s.); 'you did well'
وَأَجَدْتَ: و + أَجَدْتَ — wa-, and (conj.); ajāda, to excel (IV perf. 2 m.s.); 'and you excelled'
الْإِ: الـ + إِ — al-, the; i-, the first part of الإِجَادَة, 'the excelling', split by a stray space (see the next entry)
جَادَةِ: second part of الْإِجَادَةِ: ijāda, excelling, doing well (f. verbal noun IV, gen.); 'the excelling'
بَيِّنْ: bayyana — to make clear, explain (II imperative); 'explain'
لَنَاكَمْ: لِـ + نَا + كَمْ — li-, to, for (prep.); -nā, us; kam, how many (interrog.); printed as one word; 'to us how many'
لِلَفْظِ: لِـ + لَفْظ — li-, for, belonging to (prep.); lafẓ, word, utterance (m., gen.); 'for the word'
مَعْنًى: maʿnan — meaning, sense (m., indef.); gen. after min in مِنْ مَعْنًى, acc. as the counted noun after fifty
فِىاللُّغَةِ: فِى + الـ + لُغَة — fī, in (prep.), ى printed for ي; lugha, language (f., gen.); printed run together; 'in the language'
أَيَّدَ: ayyada — to support, strengthen (II perf. 3 m.s.); 'may He support', in the optative
وَقِيلَ: و + قِيلَ — wa-, and (conj.); qīla, it was said (pass. perf. 3 m.s. of qāla); 'and it was said', i.e. 'and some say'
أَلَكَ: أَ + لَ + كَ — a-, question particle ('do?'); li-, to (prep.); -ka, you; 'do you have'
بِتَفْصِيلِ: بِـ + تَفْصِيل — bi-, of (عِلْم بِـ 'knowledge of'); tafṣīl, detailing, particulars (m. verbal noun II, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the particulars of'
الصَّبَاحَةُ: الـ + صَبَاحَة — ṣabāḥa, radiance, brightness of face (f., nom.); 'the radiance'
فِىالْوَجْهِ: فِى + الـ + وَجْه — fī, in (prep.), ى printed for ي; wajh, face (m.); printed run together; 'in the face'
الْوَضَاءَةُ: الـ + وَضَاءَة — waḍāʾa, lustre, clear brightness (f., nom.); 'the lustre'
فِىالْبَشَرَةِ: فِى + الـ + بَشَرَة — fī, in (prep.); bashara, skin (f.); 'in the skin'
الْجَمَالُ: الـ + جَمَال — jamāl, beauty (m., nom.); 'the beauty'
فِىالْأَنْفِ: فِى + الـ + أَنْف — fī, in (prep.); anf, nose (m.); 'in the nose'
الْحَلَاوَةُ: الـ + حَلَاوَة — ḥalāwa, sweetness (f., nom.); 'the sweetness'
فِىالْعَيْنَيْنِ: فِى + الـ + عَيْنَيْن — fī, in (prep.); ʿayn, eye (f., dual gen.); 'in the two eyes'
الْمَلَاحَةُ: الـ + مَلَاحَة — malāḥa, charm, piquancy (f., nom.); 'the charm'
فِىالْفَمِ: فِى + الـ + فَم — fī, in (prep.); fam, mouth (m.); 'in the mouth'
الظَّرْفُ: الـ + ظَرْف — ẓarf, elegance, refined wit (m., nom.); 'the elegance'
فِىاللِّسَانِ: فِى + الـ + لِسَان — fī, in (prep.); lisān, tongue (m.); 'in the tongue'
الرَّشَاقَةُ: الـ + رَشَاقَة — rashāqa, slenderness, lightness (f., nom.); 'the slenderness'
فِىالْقَدِّ: فِى + الـ + قَدّ — fī, in (prep.); qadd, stature, figure (m.); 'in the stature'
اللَّبَاقَةُ: الـ + لَبَاقَة — labāqa, grace, tact (f., nom.); 'the grace'
فِىالشَّمَائِلِ: فِى + الـ + شَمَائِل — fī, in (prep.); shamāʾil, dispositions, qualities, manners (pl.); 'in the manners'
كَمَالُ: kamāl — perfection (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فِىالشَّعْرِ: فِى + الـ + شَعْر — fī, in (prep.); shaʿr, hair (m.); 'in the hair'
الشِّهَابُ: الـ + شِهَاب — shihāb, flame, shooting star (m., nom.); here part of a poet's name, 'al-Shihāb'
الْحِجَازِيُّ: الـ + حِجَازِيّ — ḥijāzī, of the Hijaz (nisba adj., nom.); 'the Hijazi'
أَبْيَاتٍ: abyāt — verses (pl. of bayt, gen. indef.); 'verses'
الرَّجَزِ: الـ + رَجَز — rajaz, the rajaz metre (m., gen.); 'the rajaz'
صَبَاحَةُ: ṣabāḥa — radiance, brightness of face (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَالْبَشَرَةْ: و + الـ + بَشَرَة — wa-, and (conj.); bashara, skin (f.; printed with pause-sukun); 'and the skin'
تَبْصِرَهْ: tabṣira — insight, discernment (f.; printed with pause-sukun)
وَبِالْجَمَالِ: و + بِـ + الـ + جَمَال — wa-, and (conj.); bi-, with, by (of what marks a thing out); jamāl, beauty (m.); 'and by beauty'
الْاَنْفُ: الـ + اَنْف — anf, nose (m., nom.); 'the nose'
وَبِالْحَلَاوَةِ: و + بِـ + الـ + حَلَاوَة — wa-, and (conj.); bi-, with, by; ḥalāwa, sweetness (f.); 'and by sweetness'
الْعُيُونُ: الـ + عُيُون — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, nom.); 'the eyes'
تُعْرَفُ: ʿarafa — to know; tuʿrafu, passive (imperf. 3 f.s.), 'are known'
لِلْفَمِ: لِـ + الـ + فَم — li-, for, belonging to (prep.); fam, mouth (m.); 'for the mouth'
الْمَلَاحَهْ: الـ + مَلَاحَة — malāḥa, charm, piquancy (f.; printed with pause-sukun); 'the charm'
فَافْهَمْهُ: فَـ + افْهَمْ + هُ — fa-, so (after a command); ifham, understand (imperative of fahima); -hu, it; 'so understand it'
لَاعَدِمْتَ: لَا + عَدِمْتَ — lā, not (before a perfect, a wish); ʿadima, to lack (perf. 2 m.s.); printed as one word; 'may you never lack'
الرَّاحَهْ: الـ + رَاحَة — rāḥa, ease, rest (f.; printed with pause-sukun); 'the ease'
وَالظَّرْفُ: و + الـ + ظَرْف — wa-, and (conj.); ẓarf, elegance, refined wit (m., nom.); 'and the elegance'
وَالرَّشَاقَهْ: و + الـ + رَشَاقَة — wa-, and (conj.); rashāqa, slenderness, lightness (f.; printed with pause-sukun); 'and the slenderness'
لِلْمَقَلِ: لِـ + الـ + مَقَل — li-, for, belonging to (prep.); maqal, eyes (pl. of maqla, the eyeball); 'for the eyes'
وَالشَّمَائِلُ: و + الـ + شَمَائِل — wa-, and (conj.); shamāʾil, dispositions, manners (pl., nom.); 'and the manners'
اللَّبَاقَهْ: الـ + لَبَاقَة — labāqa, grace, tact (f.; printed with pause-sukun); 'the grace'
فَاصْغِ: فَـ + اصْغِ — fa-, so (after a command); iṣghi, incline, listen (imperative of aṣghā, IV); 'so listen'
عَذَرْ: ʿadhara — to excuse, forgive (perf. 3 m.s.; printed with pause-sukun); 'excused'
فَسُرَّ: فَـ + سُرَّ — surra, was pleased, was gladdened (pass. perf. of sarra, I); fa-, 'and so' (follows on the story); 'and was pleased'
بِكَلَامِهِ: بِـ + كَلَام + هِ — kalām, speech, talk (m., gen. after bi-) + -hi, his; bi-, 'with, at' (what gave the pleasure); 'with his speech'
وَاسْتَأْنَسَ: وَ + اسْتَأْنَسَ — istaʾnasa, took pleasure, felt at ease (X); wa-, 'and'; 'and took comfort'
مَعْنَى: maʿnā — meaning, sense (m., nom.; the final alif is the case-bearer, no mark)
قَوْلِهِمْ: قَوْل + هِمْ — qawl, saying (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa to maʿnā) + -him, their; 'their saying'
شُرَيْحٌ: Shurayḥ — personal name (m., nom.), the judge of Kūfa, proverbial for shrewdness
أَدْهَى: adhā — more cunning, shrewder (elative of dāhin, from d-h-y; diptote); 'more cunning'
الثَّعْلَبِ: الـ + ثَعْلَب — thaʿlab, fox (m., gen.); 'the fox'
أَيَّدَكَ: أَيَّدَ + كَ — ayyada, he supported, strengthened (II; optative perf., 'may he support') + -ka, you; 'may he support you'
شُرَيْحًا: Shurayḥ — personal name (m., acc., subject after anna)
أَيَّامَ: ayyām — days (pl. of yawm; acc. adverbial, first term of iḍāfa); 'during the days of'; also: acc. as the predicate of kāna: kānat tilka al-ayyāmu ayyāma bardin, 'those days were days of cold'
الطَّاعُونِ: الـ + طَاعُون — ṭāʿūn, plague, pestilence (m., gen.); 'the plague'
النَّجَفِ: الـ + نَجَف — najaf, al-Najaf, the raised ground by Kūfa (place name, gen. after ilā)
يُصَلِّى: yuṣallī — he prays (imperf. of ṣallā, II); printed with ى
فَيَقِفُ: فَـ + يَقِفُ — fa-, 'and then' + yaqifu, he stands, halts (imperf. of waqafa, I); 'and stands'
تُجَاهَهُ: تُجَاه + هُ — tujāh, opposite, facing (prep.-noun, acc.) + -hu, him; 'facing him'
وَيُحَاكِيهِ: وَ + يُحَاكِي + هِ — wa-, 'and'; yuḥākī, he imitates, mimics (imperf. of III, ḥ-k-y) + -hi, him; 'and imitates him'
فَيَشْغَلُهُ: فَـ + يَشْغَلُ + هُ — fa-, 'and so' (result); yashghalu, he occupies, distracts (imperf. of shaghala, I) + -hu, him; 'and so distracts him'
صَلَوتِهِ: صَلَوت + هِ — ṣalawt, prayer (f., gen.; the print spells ṣalāh with و and ت) + -hi, his; 'his prayer'
نَزَعَ: nazaʿa — he took off, pulled off (perf. of I); here: with ʿan, 'to pull off from'
فَجَعَلَهُ: فَـ + جَعَلَ + هُ — fa-, 'and' (next step); jaʿala, he put, set (perf. of I) + -hu, it; 'and put it'
قَصَبَةٍ: qaṣaba — a reed, cane (f., gen. indef., after ʿalā)
كُمَّيْهِ: كُمَّيْ + هِ — kumm, sleeve (m.; dual acc. kummayn, here kummay- before the suffix) + -hi, its; 'its two sleeves'
وَنَصَبَهَا: وَ + نَصَبَ + هَا — wa-, 'and'; naṣaba, he set up, erected (perf. of I) + -hā, it; 'and set it up'
الثَّعْلَبُ: الـ + ثَعْلَب — thaʿlab, fox (m., nom.); 'the fox'
بِإِزَائِهِ: بِـ + إِزَاء + هِ — bi-, at, in (prep.) + izāʾ, a position opposite (m., gen.) + -hi, it; bi-izāʾihi, 'opposite it'
خَلْفِهِ: خَلْف + هِ — khalf, back, rear (m., gen. after min) + -hi, its; 'from behind it'
لِعَمِّهِ: لِـ + عَمّ + هِ — li-, to (prep.; with qāla, the one addressed); ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his uncle'
كَامِلٌ: kāmil — perfect, accomplished (act. part. of kamula, m., nom. predicate)
فَنِّ: fann — art, branch of skill (m., gen., after fī)
الْأَدَبِ: الـ + أَدَب — adab, polite letters, literary culture and manners (m., gen.); 'the literary art'
قُعُودَ: quʿūd — sitting (m., acc. cognate verbal noun; first term of iḍāfa); 'the sitting of'
اطَّلَعَ: iṭṭalaʿa — he became aware of, learned (perf. of VIII of ṭ-l-ʿ; takes ʿalā); 'he learned of'
مَاتَحَصَّلَ: مَا + تَحَصَّلَ — mā, what (rel.) + taḥaṣṣala, it accrued, was acquired (perf. of V of ḥ-ṣ-l); printed as one word; 'what had accrued'
لِحَسَنِ: لِـ + حَسَن — li-, to, for (prep.; taḥaṣṣala li-, 'accrued to') + Ḥasan, personal name (m., gen.); 'to Ḥasan'
دَبِيَّةِ: دَبِيَّة — rest of the split الأدبية: adabiyya, literary, of adab (f. nisba adj., gen.; the initial أَ is on the previous piece); 'the literary (sciences)'
خِلْعَةً: khilʿa — robe of honour (f., acc. indef.)
فَاخِرَةً: fākhira — splendid, magnificent (act. part., f., acc. adj.)
وَقَلَّدَهُ: وَ + قَلَّدَ + هُ — wa-, 'and'; qallada, he invested, entrusted (lit. hung on the neck; perf. of II) + -hu, him; 'and invested him'
يَسْتَعِينُ: yastaʿīnu — he seeks help, avails himself (imperf. of X of ʿ-w-n); 'he might use'
وَدَعَالَهُ: وَ + دَعَا + لِـ + هُ — wa-, 'and'; daʿā, he prayed, called (perf. of I) + li-, for (daʿā li-, 'pray for') + -hu, him; printed as one word; 'and prayed for him'
بِالْعِزِّ: بِـ + الـ + عِزّ — bi-, 'with' (daʿā bi-, 'pray for something'); ʿizz, glory, might (m., gen.); 'with glory'
الدَّائِمِ: الـ + دَائِم — dāʾim, lasting, perpetual (act. part. of dāma, m., gen.); 'the lasting'
وَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ: وَ + اسْتَأْذَنَ + هُ — wa-, 'and'; istaʾdhana, he asked leave of (perf. of X of ʾ-dh-n) + -hu, him; 'and asked his leave'
لِلذَّهَابِ: لِـ + الـ + ذَهَاب — li-, 'for' (purpose: what the leave was asked for); dhahāb, going, departure (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'for the going'
وَعَمُّهُ: وَ + عَمّ + هُ — wa-, 'and' + ʿamm, uncle (m., nom., joined to the subject) + -hu, his; 'and his uncle'
الطَّعَامَ: الـ + طَعَام — ṭaʿām, food (m., acc.); 'the food'
فَأَكَلَا: فَـ + أَكَلَ + ا — fa-, 'and then'; akala, he ate (perf. of I) + -ā, they two (dual ending); 'and they two ate'
يَسَّرَاللَّهُ: يَسَّرَ + اللَّه — yassara, he made easy, provided (perf. of II) + Allāh, God (nom.); printed as one word; mā yassara Allāhu, 'what God provided'
الْفَرَاغِ: الـ + فَرَاغ — farāgh, being finished, free (m. verbal noun of faragha, gen.); baʿda al-farāghi min, 'after finishing'
مَجْلِسَ: majlis — sitting-room, place of sitting (m., acc.; first term of iḍāfa)
امْرَأَتِهِ: امْرَأَة + هِ — imraʾa, woman, wife (f., gen.; the print gives the hamza) + -hi, his; 'his wife'
وَأَخْبَرَهَا: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + هَا — wa-, 'and'; akhbara, he informed (perf. of IV) + -hā, her; 'and told her'
يَجْعَلَكَ: يَجْعَلَ + كَ — yajʿala, he makes (subj. imperf. of jaʿala, I) + -ka, you; 'he make you'
نَدِيمًا: nadīm — boon-companion, cup-companion of a ruler (m., acc., second object of yajʿala)
وَيُوَفِّرَ: وَ + يُوَفِّرَ — wa-, 'and'; yuwaffira, he multiplies, provides abundantly (subj. imperf. of II of w-f-r); 'and he provide abundantly'
الصِّلَاتِ: الـ + صِلَات — ṣilāt, gifts, rewards (f. pl. of ṣila, acc.); 'the gifts'
وَالْهِبَاتِ: وَ + الـ + هِبَات — wa-, 'and'; hibāt, bounties, donations (f. pl. of hiba, acc.); 'and the bounties'
كَالنَّهْرِ: كَـ + الـ + نَهْر — ka-, like (prep.); nahr, river (m., gen.); 'like the river'
عْظَمِ: عْظَم — the rest of the split الأعظم: aʿẓam, greatest, mightiest (elative, gen., adj. of al-nahr; the initial الأَ is on the previous piece); 'the mightiest'
