تَسْطَعُ: tasṭaʿu — it shines, rises brightly (imperf. of saṭaʿa, I; f. with plural of non-persons)
أَنْوَارُكَمَا: أَنْوَار + كَمَا — anwār, lights (pl. of nūr, nom.) + kamā-, the beginning of kamālika, 'your perfection'; the print runs two words together, and I read anwāru kamālika, 'the lights of your perfection'
لِكَ: لِكَ — the end of the split كَمَالِكَ: -lika, the last syllable of kamālika, 'your perfection' (kamāl, perfection + -ka, your); read with the previous word
حَيْثُمَا: ḥaythumā — wherever (conj. with the perfect or jussive)
وَبَحْرٍ: وَ + بَحْر — wa-, 'and'; baḥr, sea (m., gen.); 'and sea'
أُرِيدُأَنْ: أُرِيدُ + أَنْ — urīdu, I want (imperf. of IV of r-w-d) + an, that (subjunctive particle); printed as one word; 'I want to'
أَقُولَ: aqūla — I say (subj. imperf. of qāla, after an); 'to say, to compose'
تَصِيدَةً: taṣīda — print's ت for ق: qaṣīda, ode, poem (f., acc. indef.); 'an ode'
مَدْحِهِ: مَدْح + هِ — madḥ, praise (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his praise'
لِتَزْدَادَ: لِـ + تَزْدَادَ — li-, so that, in order that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + tazdāda, it increases (subj. imperf. of VIII of z-y-d); 'so that it increase'
قَاتْ: qāt — print for qālat (ل dropped): she said (f. perf. of qāla); read 'she said'
أَصَبْتَ: aṣabta — you were right, you hit the mark (perf. of IV of ṣ-w-b; 2nd m. sing.)
نَوَيْتَ: nawayta — you intended (perf. of nawā, I; 2nd m. sing.)
فَجَوِّدِ: فَـ + جَوِّدِ — fa-, 'so' (consequence); jawwidi, make good, perfect! (imper. of II of j-w-d; kasra to avoid a cluster before al-); 'so perfect'
الْفِكْرَةَ: الـ + فِكْرَة — fikra, thought, idea (f., acc.); 'the thought'
وَتَأَنَّقْ: وَ + تَأَنَّقْ — wa-, 'and'; taʾannaq, take pains, be elegant (imper. of V of ʾ-n-q); 'and take pains'
أَرَاهُ: أَرَى + هُ — ara, I see, consider (imperf. of raʾā, I) + -hu, him; 'I see him'
انْفَرَدَ: infarada — he withdrew, went apart (perf. of VII of f-r-d)
وَنَمَّقَ: وَ + نَمَّقَ — wa-, 'and'; nammaqa, he embellished, wrote elegantly (perf. of II of n-m-q); 'and polished'
أَبْيَاتًا: abyātan — verses (pl. of bayt, acc., tanwīn); 'verses'
رَشِيقَةَ: rashīqata — graceful, elegant (f., acc., adj. of abyāt; first term of iḍāfa)
الْمَبَانِي: الـ + مَبَانِي — mabānī, structures, forms (pl. of mabnā, gen.); 'the structures'
حَسَنَةَ: ḥasanata — fair, fine (f., acc., adj. of abyāt; first term of iḍāfa)
الْمَعَانِي: الـ + مَعَانِي — maʿānī, meanings (pl. of maʿnā, gen.); 'the meanings'
هُمَامٌ: humām — magnanimous lord, great-hearted man (m., nom.)
قَدْسَمَا: قَدْ + سَمَا — qad, 'has indeed' (with the perfect) + samā, he rose, soared (perf. of samā, I); printed as one word
اَوْجَ: awj — summit, zenith (m., acc.; first term of iḍāfa)
الْعُلَى: الـ + عُلَى — ʿulā, the heights, eminence (f. pl. of ʿulyā, gen.); 'the heights'
وَهْوَ: وَ + هُوَ — wa-, 'and'; huwa, he (the print marks h with sukūn, as the metre reads it); 'and he'
نَهْجِ: nahj — path, road (m., gen.; first term of iḍāfa)
الْغُرِّ: الـ + غُرّ — ghurr, radiant, illustrious (pl. of aghar, gen., adj. of al-kirām); 'the radiant'
سَالِكْ: sālik — one who travels, follows a road (act. part. of salaka, m., nom. predicate; sukūn for the rhyme)
اَمَّرَ: ammara — he set in command, made an emirate of (perf. of II of ʾ-m-r); obscure and perhaps a misprint for ʿammara, 'made flourish'
الاَقْطَارَ: الـ + أَقْطَار — aqṭār, regions, lands (pl. of quṭr, acc.); 'the regions'
عَدْلُهُ: عَدْل + هُ — ʿadl, justice (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his justice'
اَعْدَائِهِ: أَعْدَاء + هِ — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿadūw, gen.) + -hi, his; 'his enemies'
الْمَسَالِكْ: الـ + مَسَالِك — masālik, roads, passes (pl. of maslak, acc.; sukūn for the rhyme); 'the roads'; the sense with salla is obscure
شَهْمٌ: shahmun — spirited, keen, bold (adj., m., nom.)
فَهْوَ: فَـ + هُوَ — fa-, 'then' (opens the answer to in) + huwa, he; 'then he is'
كَذلِكْ: كَـ + ذَلِك — ka-, like (prep.) + dhālik, that; 'just so'; sukūn for the rhyme
الْعَافِي: الـ + عَافِي — ʿāfī, one who seeks favour, a suppliant, beggar (act. part. of ʿafā, m., nom.); 'the suppliant'
غَنِيًّا: ghaniyyan — rich (adj., m., acc. tanwīn, state)
تَرُمْ: tarum — you seek, aim at (jussive of rāma, I; 2nd m. sing.)
وَصْفَهُ: وَصْف + هُ — waṣf, description (m., acc., object of tarum) + -hu, his; 'his description'
تَعْجِزُ: taʿjizu — you are unable, powerless (imperf. of ʿajaza, I; answer to in)
مَقَالِكْ: مَقَال + كَ — maqāl, speech (m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your; sukūn for the rhyme; 'in your speech'
مُسْفِرٌ: musfirun — shining, bright, breaking (act. part. of IV of s-f-r, m., nom.)
الْعَطَا: الـ + عَطَا — ʿaṭā, giving, gift (m., gen.; the print drops the final hamza of ʿaṭāʾ); 'the giving'
الْوَغَى: الـ + وَغَى — waghā, battle, the din of war (m., gen.); 'the battle'
كَاللَّيْلِ: كَـ + الـ + لَيْل — ka-, like (prep.); layl, night (m., gen.); 'like the night'
حَالِكْ: ḥālik — pitch-black (adj., m., nom. predicate; sukūn for the rhyme)
الاَعْنَاقَ: الـ + أَعْنَاق — aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq, acc.); 'the necks'
جُودُهُ: جُود + هُ — jūd, generosity (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his generosity'
بِالاِحْسَانِ: بِـ + الـ + إِحْسَان — bi-, by (prep.: means); iḥsān, beneficence, kindness (m., gen.); 'by beneficence'
لِلاَحْرَارِ: لِـ + الـ + أَحْرَار — li-, of, over (marks the owned: mālik li-, 'master of'); aḥrār, free men, the noble (pl. of ḥurr, gen.); 'of the free'
مَالِكْ: mālik — owner, master (act. part. of malaka, m., nom. predicate; sukūn for the rhyme)
وَوَقَاهُ: وَ + وَقَى + هُ — wa-, 'and'; waqā, he guarded, shielded (perf. of I of w-q-y; optative) + -hu, him; 'and shield him'
اَحْدَاثِ: aḥdāth — mishaps, events, calamities (pl. of ḥadath, gen.)
الْمَهَالِكْ: الـ + مَهَالِك — mahālik, perils, places of destruction (pl. of mahlaka, gen.; sukūn for the rhyme); 'the perils'
تَحْرِيرِهَا: تَحْرِير — taḥrīr, writing out, composing (verbal noun of II, m., gen. after min) + هَا — -hā, its (the tale's); 'its writing'
صُحْبَةَ: صُحْبَة — ṣuḥba, company (f., acc. as adverb, first term of an iḍāfa); 'in the company of'
عَبِيدِ: عَبِيد — ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of ʿabd, gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the slaves of'
فَاطَّلَعَ: فَـ + اطَّلَعَ — fa-, and so (sequence) + iṭṭalaʿa, look into, examine (VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.; takes ʿalā); 'and he looked over'
وَسُرَّ: وَ + سُرَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + surra, be gladdened, be pleased (passive perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and was pleased'
خَاطِرُهُ: خَاطِر — khāṭir, mind, heart, mood (m., nom., subject of surra) + هُ — -hu, his; 'his mind' Also subject of inzaʿaja: inzaʿaja khāṭiruhu, 'his mind was agitated'.
وَقَرَاَهَا: وَ + قَرَأَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + qaraʾa, read (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f., the tale); 'and he read it'
لِلْحَاضِرِينَ: لِـ + الـ + حَاضِرِين — li-, to, for (prep.; with qaraʾa, 'read to') + al- + ḥāḍirīn, those present (m. pl. act. participle of ḥaḍara, gen.); 'to those present'
فَأَثْنَوْا: فَـ + أَثْنَوْا — fa-, and so (sequence) + athnaw, praise (IV, perf. 3 m. pl.; the final alif is silent); 'and they praised'
ثَنَاءً: ثَنَاء — thanāʾ, praise (m., acc., internal obj. of athnaw); 'praise'
اسْتَدْعَاهُ: اسْتَدْعَى — istadʿā, summon, call for (X, perf. 3 m. sg.) + هُ — -hu, him (obj.); 'he summoned him'
مَجْلِسِهِ: مَجْلِس — majlis, session, audience-hall, court (m., gen. after ilā) + هِ — -hi, his; 'his court'
عَيَّنْتُ: عَيَّنَ — ʿayyana, appoint, assign (II, perf.) + تُ — -tu, I (subject); 'I have appointed'
دِرْهَمٍ: دِرْهَم — dirham, silver coin (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after alf); 'dirhams'
قَلَّدْتُكَ: قَلَّدَ — qallada, invest, bestow on (II, perf.) + تُ — -tu, I + كَ — -ka, you (obj.); 'I invested you'
وَطُولِ: وَ + طُول — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭūl, length (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the length of'
الْبَقَاءِ: الـ + بَقَاء — baqāʾ, remaining, lasting, life (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the lasting'
حَسَنً: حَسَن — Ḥasan, Ḥasan (name, acc. after inna; the print has no alif for the tanwīn, so I point it as printed); 'Ḥasan'
الْبَصْرِيَّ: الـ + بَصْرِيّ — Baṣrī, of Basra (adj. of nisba, m., acc., apposition to ḥasanan); 'the Basran'
قَدْرُهُ: قَدْر — qadr, rank, standing (m., nom., subject of ʿalā) + هُ — -hu, his; 'his rank'
صِيتُهُ: صِيت — ṣīt, renown, fame (m., nom., subject of ṭāra) + هُ — -hu, his; 'his renown'
أَجْمَلِ: أَجْمَل — ajmal, most beautiful (elative of jamīl; first term of an iḍāfa, gen. after fī); 'the finest of'
حَالٍ: حَال — ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after ajmal); 'state' Also in ʿalā kulli ḥālin, 'in any case, whatever happens'. Also gen. after fī: fī ḥālin lā yasurru ḥabīban, 'in a state that gladdens no friend'; fī ḥālin aʿẓama min ḥālihi, 'in a worse state than his'.
وَأَرْغَدِ: وَ + أَرْغَد — wa-, and (conj.) + arghad, most abundant, most comfortable (elative of raghīd, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the most easeful of'
وَأَهْلِهِ: وَ + أَهْل + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ahl, family, kin (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his family'
أَدْرَكَتْهُ: أَدْرَكَ — adraka, reach, overtake (IV, perf.) + تْ — -at, she (f. subject: al-wafāt) + هُ — -hu, him (obj.); 'it overtook him'
الْوَفَاةُ: الـ + وَفَاة — wafāt, death (f., nom., subject of adrakat); 'the death'
هَٰرُونُ: هَارُون — Hārūn, Hārūn (the caliph; the print omits the alif, the dagger alif supplies the ā; nom., subject of samiʿa); 'Hārūn'
الْأَحَادِيثُ: الـ + أَحَادِيث — aḥādīth, tales, reports (pl. of ḥadīth, m., nom.; with hādhihi, fem. sg. agreement); 'the tales'
أَطْلَقَ: أَطْلَقَ — aṭlaqa, let go, release, set free (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he released, let go'
وَأَمَرَبِأَنْ: وَ + أَمَرَ + بِـ + أَنْ — wa-, and (conj.) + amara, command, order (perf. 3 m. sg.) + bi-, with (prep.; the verb amara takes bi- before the thing commanded) + an, that (conj., takes the subjunctive); printed as one word; 'and he ordered that'
يُعَيَّنَ: يُعَيَّنَ — yuʿayyana, be appointed, be allotted (II passive impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'be allotted'
عَيْشُهُ: عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., nom., subject of yaṭību) + هُ — -hu, his; 'his life'
وَالْأَحْدَبِ: وَ + الـ + أَحْدَب — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + aḥdab, hunchback (m., gen.); 'and the hunchback'
وَالْيَهُودِيِّ: وَ + الـ + يَهُودِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + yahūdī, Jew (nisba, m., gen.); 'and the Jew'
وَالشَّاهِدِوَا: وَ + الـ + شَّاهِد + وَا — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + shāhid, witness, one who attests (m., gen.) + wā, the first half of the next word's wa-al- (the print's space is misplaced, والشاهد والنصراني); 'and the witness'
لنَّصْرَانِيِّ: الـ + نَّصْرَانِيّ — (wa-)al- + naṣrānī, Christian (nisba, m., gen.); the print puts the space inside wa-al-, so this word keeps only the ل of the article; 'the Christian'
الصِّينِ: الـ + صِين — Ṣīn, China (gen., second term of an iḍāfa with madīna); 'China'; also: after jazāʾir: jazāʾiri al-Ṣīni, 'the islands of China' (Night 179)
خَيَّاطٌ: خَيَّاط — khayyāṭ, tailor (m., nom., apposition to rajul); 'a tailor'
مَبْسُوطُ: مَبْسُوط — mabsūṭ, spread out, outstretched (passive participle of basaṭa, m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa with al-anāmil); 'spread of'
الْأَنَامِلِ: الـ + أَنَامِل — anāmil, fingertips (pl. of anmula, f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa with mabsūṭ); 'the fingertips'
اللَّهْوَ: الـ + لَهْو — lahw, diversion, idle pleasure (m., acc., obj. of yuḥibbu); 'the diversion'
وَالطَّرَبَ: وَ + الـ + طَرَب — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + ṭarab, merriment, delight in music (m., acc., obj. of yuḥibbu); 'and the merriment'
الْأَحْيَانِ: الـ + أَحْيَان — aḥyān, times, occasions (pl. of ḥīn, gen., second term of an iḍāfa after baʿḍ); 'the times'
التَّفَرُّجَاتِ: الـ + تَفَرُّجَات — tafarruj, amusement, outing, sight-seeing (pl. of tafarruj, gen. after ʿalā); 'the amusements'
وَرَجَعُوا: وَ + رَجَعُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + rajaʿū, return (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they returned'
آخِرَهُ: آخِر — ākhir, last part, end (m., acc. as adverb of time) + هُ — -hu, his/its (poss.); 'its end' (the end of the day)
مَنْزِلِهِمْ: مَنْزِل — manzil, home, dwelling (m., gen. after ilā) + هِمْ — -him, their; 'their home'
الْمَسَاءِ: الـ + مَسَاء — masāʾ, evening (m., gen. after ʿinda); 'the evening'; also gen. after ilā: ilā al-masāʾi, 'until evening' (Night 201)
طَرِيقِهِمْ: طَرِيق — ṭarīq, road, way (m., gen. after fī) + هِمْ — -him, their; 'their road'
رُؤْيَتُهُ: رُؤْيَة — ruʾya, sight, seeing (f., nom., subject of tuḍḥiku) + هُ — -hu, his; 'the sight of him'
تُضْحِكُ: تُضْحِكُ — tuḍḥiku, make laugh (IV, impf. 3 f. sg., indic.; subject ruʾyatuhu, 'his sight'); 'it makes laugh'
الْمَغْبُونَ: الـ + مَغْبُون — maghbūn, cheated, wronged, low-spirited (passive participle of ghabana, m., acc., obj. of tuḍḥik); 'the cheated, the downcast'
وَتُزِيلُ: وَ + تُزِيلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tuzīlu, remove (IV, impf. 3 f. sg., indic.; subject ruʾyatuhu); 'and it removes'
الْمَحْزُونِ: الـ + مَحْزُون — maḥzūn, grieved, sorrowful (passive participle of ḥazina, m., gen. after ʿan); 'the grieved'
الْخَيَّاطُ: الـ + خَيَّاط — khayyāṭ, tailor (m., nom.); 'the tailor'
عَزَمُوا: عَزَمَ — ʿazama, resolve; with عَلَى, urge, press (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they urged'
يَرُوحَ: يَرُوحَ — yarūḥa, go, go off (impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'he go'
بَيْتِهِمْ: بَيْت — bayt, house (m., gen. after ilā) + هِمْ — -him, their; 'their house'
لِيُنَادِمَهُمْ: لِـ + يُنَادِمَ + هُمْ — li-, so that (introduces purpose; takes the subjunctive) + yunādima, keep company with, be a boon companion to (III, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive) + -hum, them; 'so that he keep them company'
فَأَجَابَهُمْ: فَـ + أَجَابَ + هُمْ — fa-, and so (sequence) + ajāba, answer, agree (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them (obj.); 'and he agreed with them'
مَقْلِيًّا: مَقْلِيّ — maqlī, fried (passive participle of qalā, m., acc., adj. of samak); 'fried'
وَخُبْزًا: وَ + خُبْز — wa-, and (conj.) + khubz, bread (m., acc., obj. of ishtarā); 'and bread'
وَلِيمُونًا: وَ + لِيمُون — wa-, and (conj.) + līmūn, lemon (m., acc., obj. of ishtarā); 'and lemons'
وَعَقِيدًا: وَ + عَقِيد — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaqīd, thickened sweet syrup (m., acc., obj. of ishtarā); 'and thickened syrup'
يَحْلُو: يَحْلُو — yaḥlū, be sweet, turn sweet (impf. 3 m. sg., indic.; subject the meal, with bihi 'with it'); 'it turns sweet'; also: of life, lā yaḥlū liya al-ʿayshu, 'life is not sweet to me'
امْرَأَةُ: امْرَأَة — imraʾa, woman, wife (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with al-khayyāṭ); 'the woman of (the tailor's wife)'
جَزْلَةَ: جَزْلَة — jazla, big piece, chunk (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa with samak); 'a chunk of'
سَمَكٍ: سَمَك — samak, fish (collective, m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after jazla); 'of fish'
وَلَقَّمَتْهَا: وَ + لَقَّمَ + تْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + laqqama, feed a morsel to (II, perf.) + -at, she + -hā, it (the chunk); 'and she fed it'
وَسَدَّتْ: وَ + سَدَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + saddat, stop up, close (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she stopped'
بِكَفِّهَا: بِـ + كَفّ + هَا — bi-, with (instrument) + kaff, palm, hand (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her palm'
تَأْكُلُهَا: تَأْكُلُ — taʾkulu, eat (impf. 2 m. sg., indic.) + هَا — -hā, it (f., the fish-piece); 'you eat it'
دَفْعَةً: دَفْعَة — dafʿa, one push, one go, gulp (f., acc., adverbial); 'in one go'
فَرْدِ: فَرْد — fard, single, one (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa after fī); 'a single'
نَفَسٍ: نَفَس — nafas, breath (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after fard); 'breath'
أُمْهِلُكَ: أُمْهِلُ — umhilu, give respite, grant time (IV, impf. 1 sg., indic.) + كَ — -ka, you (obj.); 'I give you respite'
تَمْضَغَهَا: تَمْضَغَ — tamḍagha, chew (impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive after ḥattā) + هَا — -hā, it; 'you chew it'
فَبَلَعَهَا: فَـ + بَلَعَ + هَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + balaʿa, swallow (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f., the piece); 'and he swallowed it'
شَوْكَةٌ: شَوْكَة — shawka, thorn, here a fish-bone (f., nom., subject of kānat); 'a thorn, a bone'
قَوِيَّةٌ: قَوِيّ — qawī, strong (f. qawīya, nom., adj. of shawka); 'strong'
فَانْشَبَكَتْ: فَـ + انْشَبَكَتْ — fa-, and so (sequence) + inshabakat, become entangled, get stuck (VII of shabaka, perf. 3 f. sg.; subject shawka); 'and it stuck'
حَلْقِهِ: حَلْق — ḥalq, throat (m., gen. after fī) + هِ — -hi, his; 'his throat'
انْقِضَاءِ: انْقِضَاء — inqiḍāʾ, ending, running out (VII verbal noun, m., gen. after maʿa); 'the ending of'
أَجَلِهِ: أَجَل — ajal, appointed term, the fixed time of death (m., gen. after maʿa-inqiḍāʾ, in iḍāfa) + هِ — -hi, his; 'his appointed term'
لَقَّمَتِ: laqqama, to feed a morsel to (verb II, perf. 3fs); takes the person fed and the morsel as two objects; 'she fed a morsel'
لِسَاعَتِهِ: لِـ + سَاعَة + ـهِ — sāʿa, hour, moment (f.) + 3ms; li-, at/on (prep.) marks the time of the event: 'at his hour, on the spot'
لَاحَوْلَ: لَا + حَوْل — lā, no (negating particle with the acc. without tanwīn) + ḥawl, power, might; printed glued; 'no power'
وَلَاقُوَّةَ: وَ + لَا + قُوَّة — wa-, and; lā, no; quwwa, strength (f., acc. without tanwīn); printed glued; 'and no strength'
مَوْتُهُ: مَوْت + ـهُ — mawt, death (m., nom. subject) + 3ms; 'his death'
أَيْدِينَا: يَد (pl. أَيْدٍ) + ـنَا — yad, hand (f.; broken pl. aydī, gen. after ʿalā or bayna; bayna aydīnā, 'before us, right here') + 1pl; 'our hands'
الْمَرْأَةُ: الـ + مَرْأَة — marʾa, woman (f., nom. subject); 'the woman'
التَّوَانِي: الـ + تَوَانِي — tawānī, dawdling, delay, slackness (verbal noun of VI tawānā; m., nom. predicate); 'the dawdling'
أَمَاسَمِعْتَ: أَ + مَا + سَمِعْتَ — a-, interrogative particle (yes/no question); mā, not; samiʿta, to hear (verb I, perf. 2ms); printed glued; 'have you not heard'
زَوْجُهَا: زَوْج + هَا — zawj, husband (m., nom. subject) + 3fs; 'her husband'
أَفْعَلُهُ: fa-ʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 1s) + ـهُ, it; 'I do it'
وَاحْمِلْهُ: وَ + احْمِلْ + ـهُ — wa-, and; ḥamala, to carry (verb I, imperative 2ms) + 3ms object; 'and carry him'
وَانْشُرْ: وَ + انْشُرْ — wa-, and; nashara, to spread out (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'and spread'
وَرَائِي: وَرَاء + ـِي — warāʾ, behind (prep./adv.; here printed with the hamza on the line) + 1s; 'behind me'
رَايِحِينَ: rāyiḥ, going (colloquial act. part. of rāḥa; m. pl. acc./gen. -īna as predicate of a state); 'going'
الطَّبِيبِ: الـ + طَبِيب — ṭabīb, physician, doctor (m., gen. after ilā); 'the doctor'
يَرَاهُ: رَأَى + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3ms yarā; indicative and subjunctive alike) + -hu, him/it; 'he sees him/it'; here: in a relative clause, li-man yarāhu, 'for whoever sees it'
فَلَمَّاسَمِعَ: فَـ + لَمَّا + سَمِعَ — fa-, and; lammā, when; samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed glued; 'and when he heard'
يُوجِعُكَ: awjaʿa, to cause pain (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + ـكَ, you; 'it pains you'
الْجُدَرِيُّ: الـ + جُدَرِيّ — judarī, smallpox, pox (m., nom.); 'the smallpox'
رَآهُمْ: raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition prints the long ā as آ) + ـهُمْ, them; 'saw them'
طِفْلٌ: ṭifl, child, little boy (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a child'
طَارِحَانِ: ṭāriḥ, laying down, throwing (act. part. of ṭaraḥa; m. dual, nom.); obscure, perhaps for ṭarīḥ 'laid low, ill'; 'two laying (him) low (?)'
يَسْأَلُونَ: saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3mpl); 'they ask'
مَنْزِلِ: manzil, dwelling, house (m., gen. first term of an iḍāfa); 'the house of'; also second term after kull: fī kulli manzili, 'in every dwelling', printed with bare kasra for manzilin (Night 193, verse)
فَدَلُّوهُمْ: فَـ + دَلُّوا + هُمْ — fa-, so; dalla, to guide (verb I, perf. 3mpl) + 3mpl object; 'and they guided them'
طَبِيبٍ: ṭabīb, physician (m., gen. with tanwīn, indefinite iḍāfa); 'a physician'
يَهُودِيٍّ: yahūdī, Jewish, a Jew (m., gen. adj.); 'a Jewish (physician)'
فَقَرَعُوا: فَـ + قَرَعُوا — fa-, and; qaraʿa, to knock (verb I, perf. 3mpl); 'and they knocked'
جَارِيَةٌ: jāriya, slave-girl, girl servant (f., nom. with tanwīn); 'a slave-girl'
سَوْدَاءُ: sawdāʾ, black (f. adj., diptote, nom.; the edition prints the hamza); 'black'
بِإِنْسَانٍ: بِـ + إِنْسَان — bi- after idhā of surprise only marks what appears: 'and behold, a man'; insān, person, man (m., gen. with tanwīn)
حَامِلٍ: ḥāmil, carrying (act. part. of ḥamala; m., gen. as adj.); 'carrying'
صَغِيرً: ṣaghīr, small, little one (m., acc. object of the participle; tanwīn without the alif, which the edition does not print); 'a little one'
وَامْرَأَةٍ: وَ + امْرَأَة — wa-, and; imraʾa, woman (f., gen. with tanwīn, joined to bi-insān; the edition prints the hamza); 'and a woman'
مَاخَبَرُكَ: مَا + خَبَر + ـكَ — mā, what (interrogative); khabar, news, business (m., nom.) + 2ms; printed glued; 'what is your news'
مُرَادُنَا: مُرَاد + ـنَا — murād, wish, aim (m., nom.) + 1pl; 'our wish'
يَنْظُرُهُ: naẓara, to look at, examine (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative without a particle) + ـهُ; 'he looks at him; that he look at him'
الطَّبِيبُ: الـ + طَبِيب — ṭabīb, physician (m., nom. subject); 'the doctor'
فَخُذِي: فَـ + خُذِي — fa-, so; akhadha, to take (verb I, imperative 2fs, addressed to the girl); 'so take'
الرُّبْعَ: الـ + رُبْع — rubʿ, quarter (m., acc. object; here with the article as in the colloquial 'quarter-dinar'); 'the quarter'
دِينَارٍوَ: دِينَار + وَ — dīnār, dinar, gold coin (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa) + wa-, and, which the print runs on to this word instead of the next; 'of a dinar, and'
لِسَيِّدِكِ: لِـ + سَيِّد + ـكِ — li-, to, for (prep., marks the recipient: 'give it to ...'); sayyid, master (m., gen.) + 2fs; 'to your master'
وَخَلِّيهِ: وَ + خَلِّي + ـهِ — wa-, and; khallā, to let, leave (verb II, imperative 2fs) + 3ms object; 'and let him'
يَنْزِلُ: nazala, to come down (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he comes down'
لَحِقَهُ: laḥiqa, to overtake, befall (verb I, perf. 3ms) + ـهُ, him; 'overtook him'
ضَعْفٌ: ḍaʿf, weakness, feebleness (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a weakness'
الْعَتَبَةِ: الـ + عَتَبَة — ʿataba, threshold, doorstep (f., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'the threshold'
لِزَوْجِهَا: لِـ + زَوْج + هَا — li-, to (prep., marks the person spoken to); zawj, husband (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'to her husband'
اتْرُكِ: taraka, to leave (verb I, imperative 2ms, with -i before the article); 'leave'
وَخَلِّنَا: وَ + خَلِّ + نَا — wa-, and; khallā, to let (verb II, imperative 2ms) + 1pl; 'and let us'
نَفُوزُ: fāza, to win, succeed, escape (verb I, imperf. 1pl); 'we win through'
بِأَنْفُسِنَا: بِـ + نَفْس (pl. أَنْفُس) + نَا — bi-, with (prep.; fāza bi- 'win through with, get off with'); nafs, self (f.; pl. anfus) + 1pl; 'with ourselves, with our own skins'
فَأَوْقَفَهُ: فَـ + أَوْقَفَ + هُ — fa-, so; awqafa, to make stand (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he stood him up'
وَأَسْنَدَهُ: وَ + أَسْنَدَ + هُ — wa-, and; asnada, to prop, lean (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he propped him'
الْحَائِطِ: الـ + حَائِط — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m., gen. after ilā; the edition prints the hamza); 'the wall'
لِلْيَهُودِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + يَهُودِيّ — li-, to (prep.; the colloquial 'entered to', i.e. went in to him); yahūdī, a Jew (m., gen.); 'to the Jew'
رَجُلً: rajul, man (m., acc. as subject of inna; tanwīn without the alif, which the edition does not print); 'a man'
حُرْمَةٌ: ḥurma, woman (colloquial; properly 'what is held inviolable'; f., nom. with tanwīn); 'a woman'
أَعْطَوْنِي: aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3mpl) + ـنِي, me; 'they gave me'
رُبْعَ: rubʿ, quarter (m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a quarter of'
تَشُوفُهُ: shāfa, to see (colloquial for ra'ā; verb I, imperf. 2ms) + ـهُ; 'you look at him'
وَتَصِفُ: وَ + تَصِفُ — wa-, and; waṣafa, to describe, prescribe (verb I, imperf. 2ms); 'and you prescribe'
يُوَافِقُهُ: wāfaqa, to suit, agree with (verb III, imperf. 3ms) + ـهُ; 'suits him'
فَأَوَّلَ: فَـ + أَوَّل — fa-, and so; awwal, first (m., acc. as adverb of time; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the first (time)'
مَاحَطَّ: مَا + حَطَّ — mā, what, that which; ḥaṭṭa, to set down (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed glued; 'that he set down'
رِجْلَهُ: رِجْل + ـهُ — rijl, foot, leg (f., acc. object) + 3ms; 'his foot'
عَثَرَ: ʿathara, to stumble (verb I, perf. 3ms); takes bi- for the thing stumbled on; 'he stumbled'
بِالْأَحْدَبِ: بِـ + الـ + أَحْدَب — bi-, on, over (prep.; ʿathara bi- 'stumble over'); aḥdab, hunchback (m., gen.); 'over the hunchback'
مَيِّتٌ: mayyit, dead (adj., m., nom. with tanwīn); 'dead'
لَلْعُزَيْرِ: لَـ + الـ + عُزَيْر — la-, to, for (the lām of appeal, with fatḥa, after yā; marks the one called on); ʿUzayr, Ezra (m., gen.); 'O Ezra!'
لَمُوسَى: لَـ + مُوسَى — la-, to (the lām of appeal, with fatḥa, after yā; marks the one called on); Mūsā, Moses (diptote, gen.); 'O Moses!'
وَالْعَشْرِ: وَ + الـ + عَشْر — wa-, and / by (here the wa- of oath, with the gen.); ʿashr, ten (f., gen.); 'and by the ten'
كَلِمَاتٍ: kalima, word (f. sound pl., gen. with tanwīn, counted noun after ʿashr); 'words'
رُونَ: Hārūn, Aaron (here printed in two parts: لها + رون; diptote, gen. after la-); 'Aaron'
وَيُوشَعَ: وَ + يُوشَع — wa-, and; Yūshaʿ, Joshua (diptote, acc. as a name called on); 'and Joshua'
نُونٍ: Nūn, Nun (name; gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'Nun'
عَثَرْتُ: ʿathara, to stumble (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I stumbled'
الْمَرِيضِ: الـ + مَرِيض — marīḍ, sick person, patient (m., gen. after fī); 'the sick man'
بِقَتِيلٍ: بِـ + قَتِيل — bi-, with (prep.; kharaja bi- 'go out with, bring out'); qatīl, one killed, a corpse (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'with a corpse'
فَحَمَلَهُ: فَـ + حَمَلَ + هُ — fa-, so; ḥamala, to carry, lift (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he carried him'
قُعُودُكَ: قُعُود + ـكَ — quʿūd, sitting, staying (verbal noun of qaʿada; m., nom.) + 2ms; 'your sitting'
قَعَدْتَ: qaʿada, to sit, stay (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you sit'
أَرْوَاحُنَا: رُوح (pl. أَرْوَاح) + ـنَا — rūḥ, soul, spirit (f./m.; pl. arwāḥ, nom.) + 1pl; 'our souls'
نَطْلَعُ: ṭalaʿa, to go up (verb I, imperf. 1pl; indicative used as 'let us'); 'we go up'
السَّطْحَ: الـ + سَطْح — saṭḥ, roof (m., acc. of destination); 'the roof'
وَنَرْمِيهِ: وَ + نَرْمِي + هِ — wa-, and; ramā, to throw (verb I, imperf. 1pl) + 3ms; 'and we throw him'
جَارِنَا: جَار + نَا — jār, neighbour (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa) + 1pl; 'our neighbour'
الْمُسْلِمِ: الـ + مُسْلِم — muslim, Muslim (m., gen. adj.); 'the Muslim'
شَاهِدًا: shāhid, steward, overseer (m., acc. with tanwīn; here an official title, not 'witness'); 'a steward'
مُشْرِفًا: mushrif, overlooking, supervising (act. part. of IV ashrafa; m., acc.); 'overseeing'; here: acc. of state, with ʿalā, 'on the brink of': mushrifan ʿalā al-mawti, 'at the point of death'
مَطْبَخِ: maṭbakh, kitchen (m., gen. first term of an iḍāfa); 'the kitchen of'
بِالدُّهْنِ: بِـ + الـ + دُهْن — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- 'bring (something)'); duhn, fat, grease (m., gen.); 'the fat (that he brings)'
الْقِطَطُ: الـ + قِطَط — qiṭaṭ, cats (pl. of qiṭṭa; nom.); 'the cats'
وَالْفِيرَانُ: وَ + الـ + فِيرَان — wa-, and; fīrān, mice, rats (colloquial pl. of fāra; nom.); 'and the mice'
طَرَفُ: ṭaraf, edge, end, portion (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); the sense here is uncertain; 'a portion of'
الْكِلَابُ: الـ + كِلَاب — kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb; nom.); 'the dogs'
السُّطُوحِ: الـ + سُطُوح — suṭūḥ, roofs (pl. of saṭḥ; gen.); 'the roofs'
وَيَجُرُّونَهُ: وَ + يَجُرُّونَ + هُ — wa-, and; jarra, to drag (verb I, imperf. 3mpl) + 3ms object; 'and they drag it'
آذَوْهُ: ādhā, to harm (verb IV, perf. 3mpl; the edition prints the long ā as آ) + ـهُ, him; 'they harmed him'
حَامِلِينَ: ḥāmil, carrying (act. part. of ḥamala; m. pl. in -īna, Middle Arabic; Classical hāmilān or hāmilūna); 'carrying'
وَأَنْزَلُوهُ: وَ + أَنْزَلُوا + هُ — wa-, and; anzala, to lower, bring down (verb IV, perf. 3mpl) + 3ms; 'and they lowered him'
بِيَدَيْهِ: بِـ + يَدَيْ + هِ — bi-, by (prep.; marks what they held or lowered him by); yad, hand (f. dual, gen.) + 3ms; 'by his hands' Also bi- of the instrument, 'with his two hands': yaṣfaʿuhu ʿalā qafāhu bi-yadayhi, 'slapping him on the nape with both hands' (Night 188).
وَخَلَّوْهُ: وَ + خَلَّوْا + هُ — wa-, and; khallā, to leave (verb II, perf. 3mpl) + 3ms; 'and they left him'
مُلَاصِقَ: mulāṣiq, adjoining, flush with (act. part. of III lāṣaqa; m., acc. as a state; first term of an iḍāfa); 'adjoining'
وَمَالَحِقُوا: وَ + مَا + لَحِقُوا — wa-, and; mā, not; laḥiqa, to have time to, manage (verb I, perf. 3mpl); printed glued; 'and they had not managed'
يُنْزِلُونَ: anzala, to lower (verb IV, imperf. 3mpl); 'they lower'
وَالشَّاهِدُ: وَ + الـ + شَاهِد — wa-, and (circumstantial, after illā: 'when'); shāhid, steward, overseer (m., nom.); 'and the steward'
وَفَتَحَهُ: وَ + فَتَحَ + هُ — wa-, and; fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he opened it'
زَاوِيَةٍ: zāwiya, corner (f., gen. with tanwīn after fī); 'a corner'
الْبَادِ: الـ + بَاد — bād, first half of the Persian bādhanj, wind-catcher (gen., in apposition to al-bāb); 'the wind-' (the word is printed in two parts)
هَنْجِ: hanj, second half of the Persian bādhanj, wind-catcher, air-shaft (gen.); '-catcher'
الشَّاهِدُ: الـ + شَاهِد — shāhid, steward (m., nom. subject); 'the steward'
وَاهْ: wāh, ah! aha! (colloquial interjection of surprise); 'ah!'
حَرَامِيٌّ: ḥarāmī, thief (colloquial, from ḥarām 'forbidden'; m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate of inna); 'a thief'
هُوَإِلَّا: هُوَ + إِلَّا — huwa, he; illā, except; printed glued; 'he (is) except'
اللَّحْمِ: الـ + لَحْم — laḥm, meat, flesh (m., gen., after li-hādhā); 'the meat'
وَالدُّهْنِ: وَ + الـ + دُهْن — wa-, and; duhn, fat, grease (m., gen.); 'and the fat'
تَأْخُذُهُ: akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + ـهُ; 'you take it'; here: 3fs, in a clause describing shayʾan, 'that she might take'
أَحْسِبُهُ: aḥsibu, to reckon, count (verb I, imperf. 1s) + ـهُ, it; 'I reckon it'
الْقِطَطِ: الـ + قِطَط — qiṭaṭ, cats (pl. of qiṭṭa; gen. after min); 'the cats'
وَالْكِلَابِ: وَ + الـ + كِلَاب — wa-, and; kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb; gen.); 'and the dogs'
قِطَطَ: qiṭaṭ, cats (pl. of qiṭṭa; acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the cats of'
الْحَارَةِ: الـ + حَارَة — ḥāra, quarter, lane (f., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'the quarter'
وَكِلَابَهَا: وَ + كِلَاب + هَا — wa-, and; kilāb, dogs (pl.; acc.) + 3fs; 'and its dogs'
خَطِيئَتِهِمْ: خَطِيئَة + هِمْ — khaṭīʾa, sin, fault (f., gen. after fī; the edition prints the hamza) + 3mpl; 'their sin'
مِطْرَقَةً: miṭraqa, mallet, hammer (f., acc. with tanwīn); 'a mallet'
وَهَمَزَ: وَ + هَمَزَ — wa-, and; hamaza, to prod, jab, thrust (verb I, perf. 3ms); the sense here is uncertain; 'and he thrust'
الدُّهْنَ: الـ + دُهْن — duhn, fat, grease (m., acc. object); 'the fat'
وَاللِّيَةَ: وَ + اللِّيَة — wa-, and; alya, fat tail of a sheep, printed here with the article run in (f., acc. object); 'and the tail-fat'
مَنِيَّةُ: maniyya, fate, doom, death (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the doom of'
مَايَكْفِى: مَا + يَكْفِى — mā, not (here 'does it not?'); yakfī, to suffice (verb I, imperf. 3ms; the edition prints the final ى); printed glued; 'does it not suffice'
تَصِيرَ: ṣāra, to become (verb I, subjunctive 2ms); 'you become'
وَتَسْرِقَ: وَ + تَسْرِقَ — wa-, and; saraqa, to steal (verb I, subjunctive 2ms, after ḥattā); 'and steal'
اللَّحْمَ: الـ + لَحْم — laḥm, meat (m., acc. object); 'the meat'
وَالدُّهْنَ: وَ + الـ + دُهْن — wa-, and; duhn, fat (m., acc.); 'and the fat'
يَاسَتَّارُ: يَا + سَتَّار — yā, O (vocative); sattār, concealer, veiler, a name of God (m., nom. in vocative); printed glued; 'O Concealer'
اسْتُرْنِي: satara, to cover, veil (verb I, imperative 2ms) + ـنِي, me; 'cover me'
بِسِتْرِكَ: بِـ + سِتْر + كَ — bi-, with (prep., marks the means); sitr, covering, veil (m., gen.) + 2ms; 'with your covering'
أَىْ: ay, that is (explanatory particle), perhaps a slip for ilā 'as far as'; the edition prints ى; 'that is'
عَطْفَةٍ: ʿaṭfa, side-lane, turning (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'a lane'
وَتَرَكَهُ: وَ + تَرَكَ + هُ — wa-, and; taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms; 'and he left him'
مَالِيْ: مَا + لِـ + ـيْ — mā, what (interrogative) + li-, to, for (prep.) + 1s: 'what is to me, why do I' Also with negative mā, li- marking the possessor: mā lī siwāhu khalīlun, 'I have no friend but him'.
اُسَلِّي: sallā, to console, divert (verb II, imperf. 1s; printed with ḍamma on the alif); 'I console'
نَفْسِيْ: نَفْس + ـيْ — nafs, self, soul (f., acc. object) + 1s; 'my self'
بِالْمُحَالِ: بِـ + الـ + مُحَال — bi-, with (prep.; 'console with, comfort oneself with'); muḥāl, impossible thing (m., gen.); 'with the impossible'
اَلْتَقِي: iltaqā, to meet (verb VIII, imperf. 1s; printed with a long -ī); 'I meet'
حَبِيبٍ: ḥabīb, beloved, friend (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'a beloved'
يَحْمِلَ: ḥamala, to carry, bear (verb I, imperf. 3ms; printed with fatḥa); 'who bears, to bear'
احْزَانِي: حُزْن (pl. أَحْزَان) + ـِي — ḥuzn, sorrow (m.; pl. aḥzān, acc. object) + 1s; 'my sorrows'
الجُلُوسُ: الـ + جُلُوس — julūs, sitting (verbal noun of jalasa; m., nom.); 'the sitting'
خَمَدَتْ: khamada, to die down, be extinguished (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'it has died down'
الجُلُوسَ: الـ + جُلُوس — julūs, sitting (m., acc. after inna); 'the sitting'
النِيرَانِ: الـ + نِيرَان — nīrān, fires, flames (pl. of nār; gen.); 'the fires'
خُسْرَانُ: khusrān, loss, ruin (m., nom. with the printed ḍamma; predicate of inna); 'loss'
بِنَصْرَانِيٍّ: بِـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — naṣrānī, Christian (m.); the bi- after إِذَا of surprise only marks what appears: 'and behold, a Christian'
سِمْسَارِ: سِمْسَار — simsār, broker, middleman (m.), genitive in apposition: 'broker (of)'
فَقَالَلَهُ: فَـ + قَالَ + لَـ + هُ — fa-, so + qāla, he said + li-, to (marks the person addressed) + -hu, him; 'and (it) said to him' (glued in print)
سُكْرُهُ: سُكْر + هُ — sukr, drunkenness (m.) + -hu, his; 'his drunkenness'
التَّسْبِيحَ: الـ + تَسْبِيح — tasbīḥ, glorification of God, the pre-dawn chant (m.); 'the glorification'
وَيَتَمَايَلُ: و + يَتَمَايَلُ — wa-, and + yatamāyalu, he sways, lurches (form VI of myl); 'and swaying'
قُبَالَهُ: قُبَالَة + هُ — qubāla, opposite, facing (prep.) + -hu, him; 'opposite him'
فَلَاحَتْ: فَـ + لَاحَتْ — fa-, so + lāḥat, she appeared, showed (lwḥ); 'so ... showed'
الْتِفَاتَةٌ: الْتِفَاتَة — iltifāta, a glance, turning of the head (f.), form VIII verbal noun; 'a glance'
بِوَاحِدٍ: بِـ + وَاحِد — wāḥid, one, someone (m.); the bi- after إِذَا of surprise only marks what appears: 'someone'
وَاقِفٍ: وَاقِف — wāqif, standing (act. part. of wqf); 'standing'
خَطَفُوا: خَطَفُوا — khaṭafū, they snatched (khṭf), plural for the impersonal 'people'; 'they had snatched'
اعْتَقَدَأَنَّهُ: اِعْتَقَدَ + أَنَّ + هُ — iʿtaqada, he believed (form VIII of ʿqd) + anna, that + -hu, he; 'he believed that he' (two words glued in print)
يَخْطِفُ: يَخْطِفُ — yakhṭifu, he snatches (khṭf); 'to snatch' (no أَنْ before it)
فَطَبَّقَ: فَـ + طَبَّقَ — fa-, so + ṭabbaqa, he closed, clenched (form II of ṭbq); 'so he clenched'
وَلَكَمَ: و + لَكَمَ — wa-, and + lakama, he punched (lkm); 'and he punched'
خَفِيرِ: خَفِير — khafīr, watchman, guard (m.), in construct; 'the watchman of'
سُكْرِهِ: سُكْر + هِ — sukr, drunkenness (m.) + -hi, his; 'his drunkenness'
يَلْكُمُهُ: يَلْكُمُ + هُ — yalkumu, he punches (lkm) + -hu, him; 'punching him'
وَيَخْنُقُهُ: و + يَخْنُقُ + هُ — wa-, and + yakhnuqu, he throttles (khnq) + -hu, him; 'and throttling him'
خَنْقًا: خَنْق — khanq, throttling (m. verbal noun), accusative as cognate object; 'a throttling'
النَّصْرَانِيَّ: الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — naṣrānī, Christian (m.), accusative; 'the Christian'
بَارِكْ: بَارِك — bārik, kneeling, crouching (act. part. of brk), printed without the accusative alif; 'crouched'
مَالِهَذَا: مَا + لِـ + هَذَا — mā, what? + li-, for, concerning + hādhā, this one; 'what is the matter with this one?' (glued in print)
يَخْطِفَ: يَخْطِفَ — yakhṭifa, he snatch (subjunctive after أَنْ) (khṭf); 'to snatch'
عِمَا: عِمَا — ʿimā-, first half of عِمَامَتِي, 'my turban', split by the print
مَتِي: مَتِي — -matī, second half of عِمَامَتِي: ـمَة 'turban' + -ī, my; 'my turban' (split by the print)
وَكَتَّفَهُ: و + كَتَّفَ + هُ — wa-, and + kattafa, he bound the arms of (form II of ktf, from كَتِف 'shoulder') + -hu, him; 'and tied him up'
وَالنَّصْرَانِيُّ: و + الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while') + al-naṣrānī, the Christian; 'and the Christian'
لَكْمَةٍ: لَكْمَة — lakma, a punch, blow with the fist (f.); 'a punch'
فَرَاحَتِ: فَـ + رَاحَتِ — fa-, so + rāḥat, she went away (rwḥ); 'so ... went'
السَّكْرَةُ: الـ + سَكْرَة — sakra, drunkenness, intoxication (f.); 'the drunkenness'
الْفِكْرَةُ: الـ + فِكْرَة — fikra, thought, reflection (f.); 'sober thought'
السِّمْسَارَ: الـ + سِمْسَار — simsār, broker (m.), accusative; 'the broker'
وَالْأَحْدَبَ: و + الـ + أَحْدَب — wa-, and + al-aḥdab, the hunchback; 'and the hunchback'
وَالنَّصْرَانِيَّ: و + الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — wa-, and + al-naṣrānī, the Christian; 'and the Christian'
وَأَصْبَحَ: و + أَصْبَحَ — wa-, and + aṣbaḥa, he entered the morning (form IV of ṣbḥ); 'and in the morning'
بِشَنْقِ: بِـ + شَنْق — bi-, with: amara bi- 'command (something)', the verb choosing the preposition + shanq, hanging (m. verbal noun), in construct; 'the hanging of'
الْقَاتِلِ: الـ + قَاتِل — qātil, killer (act. part. of qtl); 'the killer'
الْمَشَاعِلِيَّ: الـ + مَشَاعِلِيّ — mashʿalī, torchbearer, executioner (m.), accusative; 'the executioner'
يُنَادِيَ: يُنَادِيَ — yunādiya, he proclaim (subjunctive, form III of ndy); 'to proclaim'
نَصَبَ: نَصَبَ — naṣaba, he set up, erected (nṣb); 'he set up'
لِلنَّصْرَانِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — li-, for (marks the one for whom it is set up) + al-naṣrānī, the Christian; 'for the Christian'
وَأَوْقَفَهُ: و + أَوْقَفَ + هُ — wa-, and + awqafa, he made stand (form IV of wqf) + -hu, him; 'and stood him'
الْمَشَاعِلِيُّ: الـ + مَشَاعِلِيّ — mashʿalī, torchbearer, executioner (m.); 'the executioner'
النَّصْرَانِيِّ: الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — naṣrānī, Christian (m.), genitive; 'the Christian'
وَأَرَادَأَنْ: و + أَرَادَ + أَنْ — wa-, and + arāda, he wanted + an, that (with subjunctive); 'and he wanted to' (glued in print)
يُعَلِّقَهُ: يُعَلِّقَ + هُ — yuʿalliqa, he hang (subjunctive, form II of ʿlq) + -hu, him; 'to hang him'
بِالشَّاهِدِ: بِـ + الـ + شَاهِد — shāhid, steward, overseer (m.); the bi- after إِذَا of surprise only marks what appears: 'and behold, the steward'
يُشْنَقُ: يُشْنَقُ — yushnaqu, he is hanged (passive of shnq); 'be hanged'
فَفَسَحَ: فَـ + فَسَحَ — fa-, so + fasaḥa, he made room, cleared (fsḥ); 'so he cleared'
لِلْمَشَاعِلِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + مَشَاعِلِيّ — li-, to (marks the person addressed) + al-mashʿalī, the executioner; 'to the executioner'
قَتَلْتَهُ: قَتَلْتَ + هُ — qatalta, you killed + -hu, him; 'you killed him'
الْبَادْ: الـ + بَاد — first half of الباد هنج, the bādhanj: bād (Persian, 'wind'); 'the wind-' (split by the print)
وَسَرَقَ: و + سَرَقَ — wa-, and + saraqa, he stole (srq); 'and steal'
رَحْلِي: رَحْل + ي — raḥl, baggage, gear, belongings (m.) + -ī, my; 'my belongings'
فَضَرَبْتُهُ: فَـ + ضَرَبْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + ḍarabtu, I struck (ḍrb) + -hu, him; 'so I struck him'
بِمِطْرَقَةٍ: بِـ + مِطْرَقَة — bi-, with (instrument) + miṭraqa, hammer (f.); 'with a hammer'
فَحَمَلْنَهُ: فَـ + حَمَلْنَ + هُ — fa-, so + ḥamalna, they (f.) carried (ḥml), as printed (sense wants ḥamaltuhu, 'I carried him') + -hu, him; 'and I carried him'
وَأَوْقَفْتُهُ: و + أَوْقَفْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + awqaftu, I made stand (form IV of wqf) + -hu, him; 'and I stood him'
عَطْفَةِ: عَطْفَة — ʿaṭfa, turning, side-lane, alley (f.), in construct; 'the alley of'
مَاكَفَانِي: مَا + كَفَى + نِي — mā, not (opening a rhetorical question) + kafā, it sufficed (kfy) + -nī, me; 'was it not enough for me' (glued in print)
أَقْتُلَ: أَقْتُلَ — aqtula, I kill (subjunctive after حَتَّى); 'I should kill'
الشَّاهِدِ: الـ + شَاهِد — shāhid, steward, overseer (m.), genitive; 'the steward'
بِاعْتِرَافِهِ: بِـ + اعْتِرَاف + هِ — bi-, by (marks the ground: 'on the strength of') + iʿtirāf, confession (m.) + -hi, his; 'on his confession'
وَوَضَعَهُ: و + وَضَعَ + هُ — wa-, and + waḍaʿa, he put (wḍʿ) + -hu, it; 'and put it'
الْخَشَبَةِ: الـ + خَشَبَة — khashaba, timber, gallows (f.); 'the gallows'
بِالْيَهُودِيِّ: بِـ + الـ + يَهُودِيّ — yahūdī, Jew (m.); the bi- after إِذَا of surprise only marks what appears: 'and behold, the Jew'
شَقَّا: شَقَّا — shaqqā, as printed: شق 'he cleaved' with a stray alif (for شَقَّ الـ?); 'he pushed through'
نَاسَ: نَاس — nās, people (m. pl.), printed without the article; 'the people'
الْمَشَاعِلِيِّ: الـ + مَشَاعِلِيّ — mashʿalī, executioner (m.), genitive; 'the executioner'
وَامْرَأَةٍ: و + اِمْرَأَة — wa-, and + imraʾa, woman (f.); 'and a woman'
دَقُّوا: دَقُّوا — daqqū, they knocked (dqq), plural for two people; 'knocked'
دَفَعُوا: دَفَعُوا — dafaʿū, they paid, handed over (dfʿ); 'they had paid'
عَلَّمَتْنِي: عَلَّمَتْ + نِي — ʿallamat, she told, informed (form II of ʿlm; perhaps for أَعْلَمَتْ) + -nī, me; 'she told me'
وَأَعْطَتْنِي: و + أَعْطَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + aʿṭat, she gave (form IV of ʿṭw) + -nī, me; 'and gave me'
إِيَّاهُ: إِيَّا + هُ — iyyā-, the carrier of an object pronoun + -hu, him; 'him' Also of a thing, 'it': aʿṭānī iyyāhu jamīʿan, 'he gave me all of it'.
وَالْمَرْأَةُ: و + الـ + مَرْأَة — wa-, and + al-marʾa, the woman (f.); 'and the woman'
فَأَدْخَلَاهُ: فَـ + أَدْخَلَا + هُ — fa-, so + adkhalā, they two brought in (form IV of dkhl) + -hu, him; 'so they brought him in'
وَوَضَعَاهُ: و + وَضَعَا + هُ — wa-, and + waḍaʿā, they two placed (wḍʿ) + -hu, him; 'and set him'
عَلَيْ: عَلَيْ — ʿalay, the print's spelling of عَلَى, on (read ʿalā); 'on'
وَذَهَبَا: و + ذَهَبَا — wa-, and + dhahabā, they two went (dhhb); 'and they left'
لِأَ: لِـ + أَ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + a-, I (the first-person prefix of the verb, which the print sets as a separate word: لِأَ بِيعَهُ 'that I may sell it', لِأَنْظُرَهُ elsewhere); 'in order that I'; here: li-anqula, 'so that I may bring', the print setting لا نقل
نْظُرَهُ: نْظُرَ + هُ — -nẓura, I look (subjunctive, nẓr), the rest of لِأَنْظُرَهُ + -hu, him; 'look at him' (split by the print)
سْفَلَ: سْفَل — -sfala, below, the bottom (second half of لِأَسْفَلَ, 'to below'); 'to the bottom' (split by the print)
فَحَمَلْنَاهُ: فَـ + حَمَلْنَا + هُ — fa-, so + ḥamalnā, we carried (ḥml) + -hu, him; 'and we carried him'
وَدَارُ: و + دَار — wa-, and (circumstantial) + dār, house (f.), in construct; 'and the house of'
بِجِوَارِ: بِـ + جِوَار — bi-, at, by + jiwār, neighbourhood, proximity (m.); 'next to'
فَأَرْخَيْنَا: فَـ + أَرْخَيْنَا — fa-, so + arkhaynā, we let down, lowered (form IV of rkhy); 'so we lowered'
بِتَاعِ: بِتَاع — bitāʿ, belonging to, of (colloquial Egyptian possessive); 'of'
فَاعْتَقَدَ: فَـ + اِعْتَقَدَ — fa-, so + iʿtaqada, he believed (form VIII of ʿqd); 'and believed'
فَضَرَبَهُ: فَـ + ضَرَبَ + هُ — fa-, so + ḍaraba, he struck + -hu, him; 'so he struck him'
كَفَانِي: كَفَى + نِي — kafā, it sufficed (kfy) + -nī, me; 'it was enough for me'
عِلْمِي: عِلْم + ي — ʿilm, knowledge (m.) + -ī, my; 'my knowledge'
وَآخُذُ: و + آخُذُ — wa-, and + ākhudhu, I take (ʾkhdh); 'and I take'
بِعِلْمِي: بِـ + عِلْم + ي — bi-, with (marks the manner: 'with') + ʿilm, knowledge + -ī, my; 'with my knowledge, knowingly'
أَطْلِقِ: أَطْلِقِ — aṭliqi, release! (imperative of form IV of ṭlq, with a vowel before the article); 'release'
الشَّاهِدَ: الـ + شَاهِد — shāhid, steward, overseer (m.), accusative; 'the steward'
وَاشْنُقِ: و + اُشْنُقِ — wa-, and + ushnuqi, hang! (imperative of shnq, with a vowel before the article); 'and hang'
الْيَهُودِيَّ: الـ + يَهُودِيّ — yahūdī, Jew (m.), accusative; 'the Jew'
لَاتَفْعَلْ: لَا + تَفْعَلْ — lā, not (prohibition) + tafʿal, you do (jussive); 'do not do (it)' (glued in print)
الْعِشَاءَ: الـ + عِشَاء — ʿishāʾ, evening (m.), accusative of time; 'in the evening'
سَكْرَانًا: سَكْرَان — sakrān, drunk (adj.), accusative of state, with the alif printed; 'drunk'
وَهُوَيُغَنِّي: و + هُوَ + يُغَنِّي — wa-, and (circumstantial) + huwa, he + yughannī, he sings (form II of ghny); 'and he was singing' (glued in print)
بِعَزْمِهِ: بِـ + عَزْم + هِ — bi-, with, in the act of + ʿazm, inviting, resolve (m.) + -hi, his; 'hinting at an invitation' (obscure)
فَعَزَمْتُ: فَـ + عَزَمْتُ — fa-, so + ʿazamtu, I invited (ʿzm); with عَلَى 'invite someone'; 'so I invited'
وَجِبْتُهُ: و + جِبْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + jibtu, I brought (colloquial, for جِئْتُ بِـ) + -hu, him; 'and I brought him'
قِطْعَةَ: قِطْعَة — qiṭʿa, piece (f.), in construct; 'a piece of'
وَلُقْمَةً: و + لُقْمَة — wa-, and + luqma, morsel, mouthful (f.); 'and a morsel'
وَدَسَّتْهَا: و + دَسَّتْ + هَا — wa-, and + dassat, she shoved, thrust (dss) + -hā, it; 'and shoved it'
حَنَكِهِ: حَنَك + هِ — ḥanak, palate, jaw, throat (m.) + -hi, his; 'his throat'
فَازْوَرَّ: فَـ + اِزْوَرَّ — fa-, so + izwarra, he turned aside, veered (form IX of zwr); 'and ... lodged crosswise'
بَعْضُهُ: بَعْض + هُ — baʿḍ, part, some (m.) + -hu, of it; 'part of it'
فَأَخَذْنَاهُ: فَـ + أَخَذْنَا + هُ — fa-, so + akhadhnā, we took + -hu, him; 'so we took him'
وَجِئْنَا: و + جِئْنَا — wa-, and + jiʾnā, we came; 'and we came'
وَرَجُلٌ: و + رَجُل — wa-, and + rajul, man (m.); 'and a man'
وَمَعَهُمَا: و + مَعَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + maʿa, with + -humā, them two; 'and with them'
تَعَالَ: تَعَالَ — taʿāla, come! (imperative of form VI of ʿlw); 'come'
اُنْظُرْهُ: اُنْظُرْ + هُ — unẓur, look! (imperative of nẓr) + -hu, him; 'look at him'
وَأَعْطَيْتُ: و + أَعْطَيْتُ — wa-, and + aʿṭaytu, I gave (form IV of ʿṭw); 'and I gave'
لِسَيِّدِهَا: لِـ + سَيِّد + هَا — li-, to (marks the one she went to) + sayyid, master + -hā, her; 'to her master'
لِرَأْسِ: لِـ + رَأْس — li-, to, up to (marks the goal) + raʾs, head, top (m.), in construct; 'to the head of'
وَأَسْنَدْتُهُ: و + أَسْنَدْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + asnadtu, I propped (form IV of snd) + -hu, him; 'and propped him'
وَمَضَيْتُ: و + مَضَيْتُ — wa-, and + maḍaytu, I went away (mḍy); 'and I went away'
لِلْوَالِي: لِـ + الـ + وَالِي — li-, to, toward (marks the one turned to) + al-wālī, the governor; 'to the governor'
وَاشْنُقْنِي: و + اشْنُقْ + نِي — wa-, and + ushnuq, hang! + -nī, me; 'and hang me'
يُؤَرَّخُ: يُؤَرَّخُ — yuʾarrakhu, it is dated, recorded (passive of form II of ʾrkh); 'to be written down'
فَقَدَّمَهُ: فَـ + قَدَّمَ + هُ — fa-, so + qaddama, he brought forward (form II of qdm) + -hu, him; 'so he brought him forward'
تَعِبْنَا: تَعِبْنَا — taʿibnā, we are tired (tʿb); 'we are worn out'
نُقَدِّمُ: نُقَدِّمُ — nuqaddimu, we bring forward (form II of qdm); 'bringing forward'
وَنُؤَخِّرُ: و + نُؤَخِّرُ — wa-, and + nuʾakhkhiru, we put back (form II of ʾkhr); 'and putting back'
وَلَايُشْنَقُ: و + لَا + يُشْنَقُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yushnaqu, he is hanged (passive of shnq); 'and no one is hanged' (glued in print)
حْدَبِ: حْدَب — -ḥdab, second half of الأحدب, 'the hunchback' (split by the print)
يُفَارِقَةْ: يُفَارِقَ + ةْ — yufāriqu, he parts from (form III of frq), the print's ـة for the pronoun ـه, 'him' (compositor's slip); 'part from him'
وَثَانِي: و + ثَانِي — wa-, and + thānī, second (m.); 'and the second'
قَاتِلِهِ: قَاتِل + هِ — qātil, killer (m.) + -hi, his; 'his killer'
الْقَاتِلَ: الـ + قَاتِل — qātil, killer (m.), accusative; 'the killer'
وَثَالِثٌ: و + ثَالِث — wa-, and + thālith, third (m.); 'and a third'
الْمَوَالِي: الـ + مَوَالِي — mawālī, masters, clients (pl. of مَوْلَى); in print apparently for الوالي, 'the governor'
الْحَاجِبِ: الـ + حَاجِب — ḥājib, chamberlain (m.; gen. after عَلَى); 'the chamberlain'
انْزِلْ: انْزِلْ — inzil, go down (imper. m. sg. of nazala)
وَاِئْتِنِي: و + اِئْتِ + نِي — wa-, and + iʾti, bring (imper. of atā, 'to come'; here with بِـ 'with', 'bring') + -nī, me (obj. pron. 1 sg.); 'and bring me'
الْحَاجِبُ: الـ + حَاجِب — ḥājib, chamberlain (m.; nom., subject); 'the chamberlain'
وَأَعْلِمِ: و + أَعْلِمِ — wa-, and + aʿlimi, inform (imper. of Form IV aʿlama, 'to let know'; the person informed is the object, the matter takes بِـ); 'and inform'
الْوَالِيَ: الـ + وَالِي — wālī, governor (m.; acc., object of أَعْلِمِ); 'the governor'
بِقِصَّةِ: بِـ + قِصَّة — bi-, with (prep.; after أَعْلِمْ 'inform', introduces the thing told, 'of, about') + qiṣṣa, story (f.); 'of the story' Also after akhbara, 'to tell', bi- marks the thing told: ukhbiraka bi-qiṣṣati al-ṣabiyyati, 'and tell you the girl's story' (Night 188).
حْدَبَ: حْدَبَ — -ḥdab, second half of aḥdab, hunchbacked (acc.); 'hunchback', completes الا
مَحْمُولًا: مَحْمُولًا — maḥmūl, carried (pass. part. of ḥamala; acc. circumstantial); 'carried'
وَالْخَيَّاطَ: و + الـ + خَيَّاط — wa-, and + al-, the + khayyāṭ, tailor (m.); 'and the tailor'
وَالْيَهُودِيَّ: و + الـ + يَهُودِيّ — wa-, and + al-, the + yahūdī, Jew (m.; acc.); 'and the Jew'
وَالشَّاهِدَ: و + الـ + شَاهِد — wa-, and + al-, the + shāhid, steward, overseer (m.; acc.); 'and the steward'
بِالْجَمِيعِ: بِـ + الـ + جَمِيع — bi-, with (prep.; after طلع 'go up' it marks accompaniment: 'went up with') + al-, the + jamīʿ, all; 'with everyone'
تَمَثَّلَ: تَمَثَّلَ — tamaththala, to present oneself, stand (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he stood (before)'
وَأَخَذَهُ: و + أَخَذَ + هُ — wa-, and + akhadha, took + -hu, him; 'and it took him'
الطَّرَبُ: الـ + طَرَب — ṭarab, delight, joy (m.); 'the delight'
سَمِعْتُمْ: سَمِعْتُمْ — samiʿtum, you (m. pl.) heard (perf. 2 m. pl.); 'have you heard'
أَذِنْتَ: أَذِنْتَ — adhinta, to permit (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you permit'
حَدَّثْتُكَ: حَدَّثْتُ + كَ — ḥaddathtu, I told (Form II perf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj. pron. m.); 'I will tell you' (answer of the condition)
وَأَغْرَبُ: و + أَغْرَب — wa-, and + aghrab, stranger (elative); 'and stranger'
وَأَطْرَبُ: و + أَطْرَب — wa-, and + aṭrab, more delightful (elative); 'and more delightful'
حَدِّثْنَا: حَدِّثْ + نَا — ḥaddith, tell (imper. Form II) + -nā, us; 'tell us'
الدِّيَارَ: الـ + دِيَار — diyār, lands, homes (broken pl. of dār, house); 'the lands'
وَأَوْقَعَنِي: و + أَوْقَعَ + نِي — wa-, and + awqaʿa, to cast down (Form IV perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and (it) cast me'
الْمَقْدُورُ: الـ + مَقْدُور — maqdūr, the decreed, fate (pass. part. of qadara); 'the decreed (thing)'
مَوْلِدِي: مَوْلِد + ي — mawlid, birth, birthplace (m.) + -ī, my; 'my birth'
قِبْطِهَا: قِبْط + هَا — qibṭ, Copts (collective, m.) + -hā, its/her; 'its Copts' (the Copts of Egypt)
وَتَرَبَّيْتُ: و + تَرَبَّيْتُ — wa-, and + tarabbaytu, I was raised (Form V perf. 1 sg.); 'and I was brought up'
سِمْسَارًا: سِمْسَار — simsār, broker, agent (m.; acc.); 'a broker'
مَبْلَغَ: مَبْلَغ — mablagh, the point reached, extent (m., in construct); 'the reaching (of)'
مَلْبُوسٍ: مَلْبُوس — malbūs, clothing, what is worn (m.); 'clothing'
رَاكِبٌ: رَاكِب — rākib, riding (act. part. of rakiba); 'riding'
سَلَّمَ: سَلَّمَ — sallama, to greet (Form II perf.); with عَلَى 'greet'; 'he greeted'; with an object and li-, 'hand over to' (Night 131); also of God, 'to keep safe, preserve', a wish in the perfect: sallama Allāhu laka waladaka, 'may God keep your son safe for you' (Night 198)
تَعْظِيمًا: تَعْظِيم — taʿẓīm, honouring, reverence (verbal noun, acc.); 'in honour'
مِنْدِيلًا: مِنْدِيل — mindīl, kerchief, handkerchief (m.; acc.); 'a kerchief'
قَدْرُ: قَدْر — qadr, amount, measure (m.); 'a quantity of'
الْأَرْدَبُّ: الـ + أَرْدَبّ — ardabb, the ardabb, a large Egyptian dry measure (m.); 'the ardabb'
التَّرَّاسِينَ: الـ + تَرَّاسِين — tarrāsīn, porters (colloquial pl.); 'the porters'
وَالْكَيَّالِينَ: و + الـ + كَيَّالِين — wa-, and + al-, the + kayyālīn, measurers (those who measure grain, pl.); 'and the measurers'
وَاعْمِدَا: و + اِعْمِدَا — wa-, and + iʿmidā, make for, head toward (dual imper. of ʿamada); 'and make for (you two)'
النَّصْرِ: الـ + نَصْر — naṣr, victory (m.); Bāb al-Naṣr, 'the Gate of Victory'
الْجَوَالِي: الـ + جَوَالِي — Jawālī, proper name of the inn (Khān al-Jawālī); 'al-Jawālī'
تَجِدْنِي: تَجِدْ + نِي — tajid, you will find (jussive of wajada, as result of the preceding command) + -nī, me; 'you will find me'
وَتَرَكَنِي: و + تَرَكَ + نِي — wa-, and + taraka, to leave (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and he left me'
وَأَعْطَانِي: و + أَعْطَى + نِي — wa-, and + aʿṭā, to give (Form IV perf.) + -nī, me; 'and he gave me'
بِمِنْدِيلِهِ: بِـ + مِنْدِيل + هِ — bi-, with, together with (prep., of accompaniment) + mindīl, kerchief + -hi, his; 'with his kerchief'
فَدُرْتُ: فَـ + دُرْتُ — fa-, so + durtu, I went around (perf. 1 sg. of dāra); 'so I went around'
الْمُشْتَرِينَ: الـ + مُشْتَرِين — mushtarīn, buyers (act. part. pl., gen.); 'the buyers'
فَجَابَ: فَـ + جَابَ — fa-, so + jāba, to fetch, bring in (colloquial for jāʾa bi-); 'so it fetched'
أَرْدَبٍّ: أَرْدَبّ — ardabb, the Egyptian dry measure; 'ardabb'
مِايَةٌ: مِايَة — māya, hundred (f.), Middle Arabic spelling of مائة; 'a hundred'
انْتِظَارِي: انْتِظَار + ي — intiẓār, waiting (verbal noun) + -ī, my; 'in waiting for me'
الْمَخْزَنِ: الـ + مَخْزَن — makhzan, storeroom (m.; gen. after إِلَى); 'the storeroom'
الْمَخْزَنُ: الـ + مَخْزَن — makhzan, storeroom (m.; nom., subject of فَرَغَ); 'the storeroom'
فَكِيلْنَاهُ: فَـ + كِيلْ + نَا + هُ — fa-, so + kayl-, to measure by volume (perf., the yāʾ spells the long ī: Classical kilnā) + -nā, we + -hu, it; 'so we measured it'
أَرْدَ: أَرْد — ard-, first half of أَرْدَبًّا (ardabban); the print splits the word with a space; 'ardabb', first half
بًّا: بًّا — -bban, second half of ardabban (acc. tanwīn); completes ارد; 'ardabb'
سَمْسَرَتِكَ: سَمْسَرَة + كَ — samsara, brokerage (f.) + -ka, your; 'your brokerage'
وَاقْبِضِ: و + اِقْبِضِ — wa-, and + iqbiḍi, take in hand, collect (imper. of qabaḍa); 'and take'
آلَافٍ: آلَاف — ālāf, thousands (pl. of alf; gen., tanwīn); 'thousands'
وَخَمْسَمِائَةِ: و + خَمْس + مِائَة — wa-, and + khams, five + miʾa, hundred; 'and five hundred'
أَفْرُغُ: أَفْرُغ — afrughu, I am free, I finish (imperf. 1 sg. of faragha); 'I finish'
بَيْعِ: بَيْع — bayʿ, selling, sale (verbal noun); 'the selling of'
حَوَاصِلِي: حَوَاصِل + ي — ḥawāṣil, goods in store, produce (pl.) + -ī, my; 'my goods'
الْمَبْلَغَ: الـ + مَبْلَغ — mablagh, amount, sum (m.); 'the sum'
الدَّرَاهِمُ: الـ + دَرَاهِم — darāhim, dirhams (broken pl.; nom., after أَيْنَ); 'the dirhams'
تَأْكُلَ: تَأْكُلَ — taʾkula, you eat (subjunctive 2 m. sg. of akala, after an 'that'); هَلْ لَكَ أَنْ 'would you care to'
احْضِرْلِي: أَحْضِرْ + لِـ + ي — aḥḍir, bring (Form IV imper.) + li-, for (prep.; marks who gets what is brought) + -ī, me; 'bring me', printed as one word
أَمْضِيَ: أَمْضِيَ — amḍiya, I go (subjunctive 1 sg. of maḍā, after ḥattā); 'that I go'
وَأَجِيءَ: و + أَجِيءَ — wa-, and + ajīʾa, I come (subjunctive 1 sg.); 'and I come'
آخُذَهُمْ: آخُذَ + هُمْ — ākhudha, I take + -hum, them; 'I take them'
وَأَحْضَرْتُ: و + أَحْضَرْتُ — wa-, and + aḥḍartu, I brought (Form IV perf. 1 sg.); 'and I brought'
أَنْتَظِرُهُ: أَنْتَظِر + هُ — antaẓiru, I wait for (Form VIII imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'I waited for him'
تَأْكُلَ: تَأْكُلَ — taʾkula, you eat (subjunctive 2 m. sg.), printed without hamza; 'you eat'
كَامِلُ: كَامِل — kāmil, complete, perfect (act. part.; in construct); 'perfect in'
كَالْقَمَرِ: كَـ + الـ + قَمَر — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + qamar, moon (m.); 'like the moon'
تَمَامِهِ: تَمَام + هِ — tamām, completeness (m.) + -hi, its; 'its fullness'
اَلْبَدْرُ: الـ + بَدْر — badr, full moon (m.; nom.); 'the full moon'
بُرْجٍ: بُرْج — burj, tower; sign of the zodiac (m.); 'a sign (of the zodiac)' Also 'a tower' (gen. indef.): fī burjin min abrāji al-qalʿati, 'in one of the towers of the citadel'; ilā burjin ʿatīqin, 'into an old tower'.
اجْتَمَعَا: اجْتَمَعَا — ijtamaʿā, they (two) came together (Form VIII perf. 3 dual); 'they conjoined'
وَالْإِقْبَالِ: و + الـ + إِقْبَال — wa-, and + al-, the + iqbāl, good fortune, favour (verbal noun of aqbala); 'and good fortune'
طَلَعَا: طَلَعَا — ṭalaʿā, they (two) rose (perf. 3 dual); 'they rose'
اَظْهَرَا: أَظْهَرَا — aẓharā, they (two) displayed (Form IV perf. 3 dual); 'they showed'
حُسْنَهُمْ: حُسْن + هُمْ — ḥusn, beauty + -hum, their (m. pl.); 'their beauty'
النُّفُوسِ: الـ + نُفُوس — nufūs, souls, selves (pl. of nafs); 'the souls'
عِنْدَمَا: عِنْدَ + مَا — ʿinda, at + mā, what; ʿindamā, when, at the time that; 'when'
دَاعِي: دَاعِي — dāʿī, caller, summoner (act. part. of daʿā); 'the summoner of'
وَرِدْعَا: و + رِدْع — wa-, and + ridʿ, a stain, esp. of saffron or blood (m.), printed pointed ridʿā for the rhyme; the reading is uncertain; 'and a (saffron) stain'
وَالظَّرْفِ: و + الـ + ظَرْف — wa-, and + al-, the + ẓarf, grace, elegance (m.); 'and grace'
تَمَّتْ: تَمَّتْ — tammat, to be complete (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'were complete'
وَزَانَهَا: و + زَانَ + هَا — wa-, and + zāna, to adorn (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them (f. pl.); 'and adorned them'
الْعَقْلُ: الـ + عَقْل — ʿaql, reason, intellect (m.); 'the intellect'
وَالْحَيَاءُ: و + الـ + حَيَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥayāʾ, modesty (m.); 'and modesty'
بُرِعَا: بُرِعَا — burʿā, they (two) were excellent (perf. 3 dual, pointed passively); 'were perfected'
مَخْلُوقًا: مَخْلُوق — makhlūq, created being (pass. part. of khalaqa; acc.); 'as a creature'
صَنَعَا: صَنَعَ — ṣanaʿa, to make (perf. 3 m. sg.), printed with final alif for the rhyme (ṣanaʿā); 'he made'
وَدَعَوْتُ: وَ + دَعَا + ـتُ — wa-, and + daʿā, to call, to pray (perf.), -tu I; 'and I prayed' (for him, with لَهُ)
تَقْبِضُ: قَبَضَ — qabaḍa, to seize, to take possession of, to collect (imperf. 2nd m. sg.); 'you collect'
دَرَاهِمَكَ: دَرَاهِم + ـكَ — darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of dirham), -ka your; 'your dirhams'
الْعَجَلَةُ: الـ + عَجَلَة — al-, the + ʿajala, haste (f.), nom.; 'the haste'
أَفْرُغَ: فَرَغَ — faragha, to finish, to be free of (imperf. 1st sg., subj. after حَتَّى); 'I finish'
مَصَالِحِي: مَصَالِح + ـِي — maṣāliḥ, affairs, interests (pl. of maṣlaḥa), -ī my; 'my affairs'
وَآخُذَهَا: وَ + آخُذ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ākhudha, to take (imperf. 1st sg., subj. after حَتَّى), -hā it/them (f. sg.); 'and I take them'
أَعْزِمَ: عَزَمَ — ʿazama, to resolve; ʿazama ʿalā to urge someone (to accept an invitation) (imperf. 1st sg., subj.); 'I urge'
لِكَوْنِى: لِـ + كَوْن + ـِي — li-, because of (prep., giving the reason) + kawn, being + -ī my; 'because of my being', i.e. 'because I had ...'
اتَّجَرْتُ: اِتَّجَرَ + ـتُ — ittajara, to trade (form VIII, perf.), -tu I; 'I traded'
دَرَاهِمِهِ: دَرَاهِم + ـِهِ — darāhim, dirhams, gen. after فِي, -hi his; 'his dirhams'
وَحَصَّلْتُ: وَ + حَصَّلَ + ـتُ — wa-, and + ḥaṣṣala, to gain, to acquire (form II, perf.), -tu I; 'and I gained'
يَنْزِلَ: نَزَلَ — nazala, to alight, to lodge (imperf. 3rd m. sg., subj. after أَنْ); 'he alights, he stays'
وَيَأْكُلَ: وَ + يَأْكُلَ — wa-, and + akala, to eat (imperf. 3rd m. sg., subj. after أَنْ); 'and he eats'
ضِيَافَتِي: ضِيَافَة + ـِي — ḍiyāfa, hospitality, entertainment (f.), -ī my; 'my hospitality'
تُنْفِقُهُ: أَنْفَقَ + ـهُ — anfaqa, to spend (form IV, imperf. 2nd m. sg.), -hu it; 'you spend it'
مَالِى: مَال + ـِي — māl, money (m.), -ī my (printed with ى); 'my money'
وَأَجْلَسْنَهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + ـنَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ajlasa, to seat (form IV), the printed -na (evidently for -tu, 'I') + -hu him; 'and I seated him' (printed with ن, see note)
هَيَّأْتُ: هَيَّأَ + ـتُ — hayyaʾa, to prepare (form II, perf.), -tu I; 'I prepared'
الْأَطْعِمَةِ: الـ + أَطْعِمَة — al-, the + aṭʿima, foods (pl. of ṭaʿām), gen. after مِنْ ('of'); 'the foods'
وَالْأَشْرِبَةِ: وَ + الـ + أَشْرِبَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ashriba, drinks (pl. of sharāb), gen.; 'and the drinks'
وَجِبْتُ: وَ + جِبْتُ — wa-, and + jibtu, 'I brought' (colloquial, for جِئْتُ بِهِ, with the object understood); 'and I brought (it)'
لِلْمَائِدَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مَائِدَة — li-, to, towards (prep.; colloquial for إِلَى) + al-, the + māʾida, table, spread (f.); 'to the table'
وَمَدَّيَدَهُ: وَ + مَدَّ + يَدَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + madda, to stretch out (perf. 3rd m. sg.) + yad, hand (f.), acc. + -hu his; glued in print; 'and he stretched out his hand'
الشِّمَالَ: الـ + شِمَال — al-, the + shimāl, the left (side/hand), acc. (apposition to the hand); 'the left'
مَعِى: مَعَ + ـِي — maʿa, with (prep.) + -ī me (printed ى); 'with me'
غَسَلْتُ: غَسَلَ + ـتُ — ghasala, to wash (perf.), -tu I; 'I washed'
وَنَاوَلْتُهُ: وَ + نَاوَلَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + nāwala, to hand over (form III, perf.), -tu I, -hu him; 'and I handed him'
لِلْحَدِيثِ: لِـ + الـ + حَدِيث — li-, for, for the purpose of (prep.) + al-, the + ḥadīth, talk, conversation (m.), gen.; 'for the conversation'
الْحَلْوَى: الـ + حَلْوَى — al-, the + ḥalwā, sweets, sweetmeats (f.); 'the sweets'
فَرِّجْ: فَرَّجَ — farraja, to relieve, to lift (form II, imper. m. sg.); 'relieve'
كُرْبَةً: كُرْبَة — kurba, distress, grief (f.), acc. tanwīn (object of فَرِّجْ); 'a distress'
أَكَلْتَ: أَكَلَ + ـتَ — akala, to eat (perf.), -ta you (m. sg.); 'you ate'
يَدِكَ: يَد + ـِكَ — yad, hand (f.), gen. after فِي, -ka your; 'your hand'
يُؤْلِمُكَ: آلَمَ + ـكَ — ālama, to pain, to hurt (form IV, imperf. 3rd m. sg.), -ka you; 'it pains you'
شِـــــعْـــــرٌ: شِعْر — shiʿr, verse, poetry (m.), nom. tanwīn; printed with spaced-out strokes as a heading; 'verse'
كُمِّهِ: كُمّ + ـِهِ — kumm, sleeve (m.), gen. after مِنْ, -hi his; 'his sleeve'
مَقْطُوعَةُ: مَقْطُوعَة — maqṭūʿa, cut off (pass. part. f. sg.), nom., in iḍāfa with the next word; 'cut off (at)'
زَنْدٍ: زَنْد — zand, wrist, forearm (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'the wrist'
بــلا: بِـ + لَا — bi-, with (prep.) + lā, no, not; 'bi-lā' = 'without'
كَفٍّ: كَفّ — kaff, palm, hand (f./m.), gen. tanwīn after بِلَا; 'a palm, a hand'
بِيَدِيَ: بِـ + يَد + ـِيَ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.: instrument) + yad, hand (f.), gen. + -iya my; 'with my hand'
لِقَطْعِ: لِـ + قَطْع — li-, for (prep.: 'for the cutting off, there is ...') + qaṭʿ, cutting off (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'for the cutting off of'
وَمَاسَبَبُ: وَ + مَا + سَبَب — wa-, and + mā, what? + sabab, cause (m.), nom. in iḍāfa; glued in print; 'and what is the cause of'
وَوَالِدِي: وَ + وَالِد + ـِي — wa-, and + wālid, father (m.), -ī my; 'and my father'
أَكَابِرِهَا: أَكَابِر + ـهَا — akābir, great ones, notables (pl. of akbar), gen. after مِنْ, -hā its (the city's); 'its notables'
السَّيَّاحِينَ: الـ + سَيَّاحِين — al-, the + sayyāḥīn, travellers, wanderers (sound pl., acc.); 'the travellers'
وَالْمُسَافِرِينَ: وَ + الـ + مُسَافِرِين — wa-, and + al-, the + musāfirīn, voyagers (sound pl., acc., from sāfara, to travel); 'and the voyagers'
وَالتُّجَّارَ: وَ + الـ + تُجَّار — wa-, and + al-, the + tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir), acc.; 'and the merchants'
أَمْوَالًا: أَمْوَال — amwāl, wealth, goods (pl. of māl), acc. tanwīn; 'wealth'
وَعَبَّيْتُ: وَ + عَبَّى + ـتُ — wa-, and + ʿabbā (colloquial for ʿabbaʾa), to pack up (form II, perf.), -tu I; 'and I packed'
بَغْدَادِىٍّ: بَغْدَادِيّ — baghdādī, of Baghdad, Baghdadi (adj., printed with ى), gen. tanwīn; 'Baghdadi'
وَمَوْصِلِيٍّ: وَ + مَوْصِلِيّ — wa-, and + mawṣilī, of Mosul, Mosuli (adj.), gen. tanwīn; 'and Mosuli'
وَسَرَّيْتُ: وَ + سَرَّى + ـتُ — wa-, and + sarrā (form II, root uncertain; read 'to dispatch, to get under way'), -tu I; 'and I dispatched'
وَسَفَرْتُ: وَ + سَفَرَ + ـتُ — wa-, and + safara, to go forth, to set out on a journey (perf.), -tu I; 'and I set out'
مَدِينَتَكُمْ: مَدِينَة + ـكُمْ — madīna, city (f.), acc. (object), -kum your (pl.); 'your city'
وْلُ: وْلُ — ūlu, the second half of يَقُول (yaqūlu), split across a line-end; 'saying' (with the previous part)
خَلِيلَيَّ: خَلِيل + ـَيَّ — khalīl, friend (m.), dual (acc./voc.) in iḍāfa with -ya my; 'my two friends' (a vocative address)
تَسَالْ: سَأَلَ — saʾala, to ask (imperf. 2nd m. sg., jussive; the printed alif has no hamza); '(do not) ask'
بِمُهْجَتِي: بِـ + مُهْجَة + ـِي — bi-, in, within (prep.) + muhja, heart's blood, the soul (f.) + -ī my; 'in my heart's blood'
اللَّوْعَةِ: الـ + لَوْعَة — al-, the + law'a, burning passion, ardour of love (f.), gen. after مِنْ; 'the burning passion'
الْحَرَّا: الـ + حَرَّى — al-, the + ḥarrā, burning, thirsty (fem. adj., printed الحرّا for الحرّى); 'the burning'
فَتُظْهِرَ: فَـ + تُظْهِرَ — fa-, so that (fa- of consequence) + uẓhira, to make appear, to bring out (form IV, imperf. 2nd m. sg., subj.); 'so that you bring out'
اَسْقَامِي: أَسْقَام + ـِي — asqām, sicknesses, maladies (pl. of saqam), -ī my (printed with bare alif); 'my sicknesses'
صَاحَبْتُ: صَاحَبَ + ـتُ — ṣāḥaba, to keep company with (form III, perf.), -tu I; 'I kept company with'
سَلْمَى: سَلْمَى — Salmā, a woman's name; here perhaps a stand-in for the left hand; 'Salmā'
بِدِيَانَةٍ: بِـ + دِيَانَة — bi-, in, out of (prep.: the ground or manner) + diyāna, religion, piety (f.), gen. tanwīn; 'out of piety'
بِلَيْلَى: بِـ + لَيْلَى — bi-, in place of, in exchange for (prep.: the substitution) + Laylā, a woman's name; here perhaps a stand-in for the right hand; 'in place of Laylā'
لِلضَّرُورَةِ: لِـ + الـ + ضَرُورَة — li-, for (prep.: 'for necessity there are ...') + al-, the + ḍarūra, necessity (f.), gen.; 'for necessity'
اَحْكَامِ: أَحْكَام — aḥkām, rulings, judgments (pl. of ḥukm), nom. (printed with a final kasra); 'rulings'
يَسْلَمُ: سَلِمَ — salima, to be safe, to escape (imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'is safe, escapes'
الْمُطْمِسُ: الـ + مُطْمِس — al-, the + muṭmis, one whose eyes are blotted out, a blind man (m.), nom.; 'the blind man'
حُفْرَةٍ: حُفْرَة — ḥufra, pit, hole (f.), gen. tanwīn after مِنْ; 'a pit'
وَيَقَعُ: وَ + يَقَعُ — wa-, and + waqaʿa, to fall (imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and falls'
الْبَاصِرُ: الـ + بَاصِر — al-, the + bāṣir, seeing one (act. part. of baṣura) (m.), nom.; 'the seeing man'
النَّاظِرُ: الـ + نَاظِر — al-, the + nāẓir, gazing one (act. part. of naẓara) (m.), nom.; 'the one who gazes'
وَيَسْلَمُ: وَ + يَسْلَمُ — wa-, and + salima, to be safe (imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and is safe'
الْجَاهِلُ: الـ + جَاهِل — al-, the + jāhil, ignorant one (m.), nom.; 'the ignorant man'
لَفْطَةٍ: لَفْطَة — lafṭa, printed with ط; probably for لَفْظَة, an utterance, a slip of speech (f.), gen. tanwīn; 'a slip'
وَيَهْلَكُ: وَ + يَهْلَكُ — wa-, and + halaka, to perish (imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and perishes'
الْعَالِمُ: الـ + عَالِم — al-, the + ʿālim, learned one, scholar (m.), nom.; 'the learned man'
الْمَاهِرُ: الـ + مَاهِر — al-, the + māhir, skilled one (m.), nom.; 'the skilled man'
وَيُعْسِرُ: وَ + يُعْسِرُ — wa-, and + aʿsara (form IV), to be in difficulty (imperf. 3rd m. sg., as pointed in print); 'and is in difficulty'
الْمُؤْمِنُ: الـ + مُؤْمِن — al-, the + muʾmin, believer (m.), nom.; 'the believer'
رِزْقِهِ: رِزْق + ـِهِ — rizq, provision, livelihood (m.), gen. after فِي, -hi his; 'his provision'
وَيُرْزَقُ: وَ + يُرْزَقُ — wa-, and + razaqa, to provide for (imperf. pass. 3rd m. sg.); 'and is provided for'
الْكَافِرُ: الـ + كَافِر — al-, the + kāfir, unbeliever (m.), nom.; 'the unbeliever'
وَالْفَاجِرُ: وَ + الـ + فَاجِر — wa-, and + al-, the + fājir, wicked one, libertine (m.), nom.; 'and the wicked man'
الْمَرْءِ: الـ + مَرْء — al-, the + marʾ, man, person (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'the man'
مِصْرَو: مِصْر — Miṣr, Cairo/Egypt (acc.) + وَ — wa-, 'and' (conj.), printed on this word though it belongs to the next one, نَزَّلْتُ
نَزَّلْتُ: nazzaltu, I unloaded, set down (Form II of nazala, descend; perf. 1s.); 'I unloaded'
مَسْرُورٍ: Masrūr, a personal name (gen.); 'the khan of Masrūr'
وَفَكَيْتُ: وَ + فَكَيْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fakaytu, I undid, unpacked (colloquial for fakaktu; perf. 1s.); 'and I undid'
أَحْمَالِي: aḥmāl, loads, bales (pl. of ḥiml; acc.) + ي — -ī, my; 'my loads'
دَرَاهِمَ: darāhim, dirhams (pl. of dirham; acc., second object)
نَأكُلُهُ: nākuluhu, we eat (imperf. 1pl. of akala) + هُ — -hu, it (obj.); 'that we may eat'
الْقَصْرَيْنِ: الـ + قَصْرَيْنِ — al-, the + qaṣrayn, two palaces (dual gen. after bayna); 'between the two palaces', a street in Cairo
فَرْدَةً: fardah, a bale, one of a pair of packs (f., acc.) + tan — with tanwīn; 'a bale'
أَشُقُّ: ashuqqu, I will cleave, make my way through (imperf. 1s. of shaqqa)
وَأَنْظُرُ: وَ + أَنْظُرُ — wa-, and + anẓuru, I will look at (imperf. 1s. of naẓara); 'and I will look at'
وَحَمَلْتُهُ: وَ + حَمَلْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥamaltu, I loaded, I carried + -hu, it; 'and I loaded it'
غِلْمَانِي: ghilmān, boys, servants (pl. of ghulām; gen.) + ـي — -ī, my; 'my boys'
قَيْصَرِيَّةَ: qayṣariyya, covered market hall, bazaar (f., acc.)
جِرْجِسَ: Jirjis, George, a personal name (gen. in idāfa); 'the Qayṣariyya of Jirjis'
فَاسْتَقْبَلَنِي: فَـ + اسْتَقْبَلَ + نِي — fa-, so/and + istaqbala, he met, went to receive (perf. 3m.s., Form X) + -nī, me; 'and (they) met me'
السِّمَا: الـ + سِّمَا — al-, the + simā-, the first half of simāsira, 'brokers' (pl. of simsār), split off by a space in the print
سِرَةُ: سِرَةُ — -sirah, the second half of simāsirah, brokers (nom. pl., subject of 'met me'); together 'the brokers'
وَكَانُوا: وَ + كَانُوا — wa-, and + kānū, they were (perf. 3m.pl. of kāna), here an auxiliary: 'and they had' Also plain 'they were', with a predicate: wa-kānū ʿishrīna, 'and they were twenty'.
عَلِمُوا: ʿalimū, they knew, they had learned (perf. 3m.pl.)
بِمَجِئِي: بِـ + مَجِيء + ي — bi-, of, about (prep.; ʿalima bi- 'know of') + majīʾ, coming, arrival (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my coming'
فَأَخَذُوا: فَـ + أَخَذُوا — fa-, so + akhadhū, they took (perf. 3m.pl.); 'so they took'; with fī, 'set about' (akhadhū fī al-isrāʿ, 'they set about hurrying')
يَجِبْ: yajib, it is due, it reaches (jussive 3m.s. of wajaba)
رَأْسُ: raʾs, head, principal, capital (m., nom., in idāfa)
فَاغْتَمَيْتُ: فَـ + اغْتَمَيْتُ — fa-, so + ightamaytu, I was distressed, grieved (Form VIII of ghamma; perf. 1s., colloquial for ightamamtu); 'so I was grieved'
شَيْخُ: shaykh, elder, head (m., nom., in idāfa)
الدَّلَّالِينَ: الـ + دَّلَّالِينَ — al-, the + dallālīna, auctioneers, criers (pl. of dallāl; gen.); 'the head of the auctioneers'
تَسْتَفِيدُ: tastafīdu, you profit, benefit (imperf. 2m.s., Form X of fāda)
التُّجَّا: الـ + تُّجَّا — al-, the + tujjā, merchants (printed without the final ر, for التُّجَّار; nom. pl. of tājir); 'the merchants'
وَتَبِيعُ: وَ + تَبِيعُ — wa-, and + tabīʿu, you sell (imperf. 2m.s. of bāʿa); 'and you sell'
مَتْجَرَكَ: matjar, merchandise, stock in trade (m., acc.) + ـكَ — -ka, your; 'your goods'
مَعْلُومَةٍ: maʿlūma, known, fixed (f. adj., gen.); 'fixed months'
بِكَاتِبٍ: بِـ + كَاتِب — bi-, with, in the presence of (prep.) + kātib, clerk, scribe (m., gen.); 'with a clerk'
وَشَاهِدٍ: وَ + شَاهِد — wa-, and + shāhid, witness (m., gen.); 'and a witness'
وَصَيْرَفِيٍّ: وَ + صَيْرَفِيّ — wa-, and + ṣayrafī, money-changer, banker (m., gen.); 'and a money-changer'
وَتَأْخُذُ: وَ + تَأْخُذُ — wa-, and + taʾkhudhu, you take, collect (imperf. 2m.s.); 'and you take'
اثْنَيْنِ: ithnayn — two (m., gen./acc. dual); also yawm al-ithnayn, Monday, 'the second day' (gen.)
فَتَكْسِبُ: فَـ + تَكْسِبُ — fa-, and so + taksibu, you earn, gain (imperf. 2m.s.); 'and so you earn'
وَزِيَادَةً: وَ + زِيَادَة — wa-, and + ziyāda, increase, addition (f., acc.); 'and an addition'
نِيلِهَا: نِيل + هَا — nīl, the Nile (m.; gen.) + -hā, its/her; 'and its Nile'
رَأْيٌ: raʾy, opinion, view (m., nom.; here 'advice'); also 'plan, proposal'
الْقَيْصَرِيَّةِ: الـ + قَيْصَرِيَّةِ — al-, the + qayṣariyya, covered market hall (f., gen.); 'to the market hall'; 'the market hall, covered market'
وَبِعْتُهُ: وَ + بِعْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + biʿtu, I sold (perf. 1s. of bāʿa) + -hu, it; 'and I sold it'
لِلصَّيْرَفِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + صَّيْرَفِيِّ — li-, to (prep.; marks the recipient) + al-, the + ṣayrafī, money-changer (m., gen.); 'to the money-changer'
الْخَانَ: الـ + خَانَ — al-, the + khān, khan (acc.; goal of the verb without a preposition); 'to the khan'
أَيَّا: ayyām, days (pl. of yawm; acc.), printed split from the tanwīn-bearing second part
مًا: مًا — -man, the ending of ayyāman, 'days' (acc. tanwīn), printed as a separate word
أُفْطِرُ: ufṭiru, I break my fast, have breakfast (imperf. 1s., Form IV of afṭara)
شَرَابٍ: sharāb, drink, wine (m., gen.); 'a cup of drink (wine)'
وَأُحْضِرُ: وَ + أُحْضِرُ — wa-, and + uḥḍiru, I bring, I have brought (imperf. 1s., Form IV of ḥaḍara); 'and I bring'
الضَّانِيَ: الـ + ضَّانِيَ — al-, the + ḍānī, of sheep (adj., acc.); 'sheep's meat'
وَالْحَلْوِيَاتِ: وَ + الـ + حَلْوِيَّاتِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥalwiyyāt, sweets, sweetmeats (f. pl., acc.); 'and the sweets'
اسْتَحْقَيْتُ: istaḥqaytu, I was entitled to, I had a right to (Form X, colloquial perf. 1s. for istaḥqaqtu)
الْجِبَايَةَ: الـ + جِبَايَةَ — al-, the + jibāya, collecting, collection of what is owed (f., acc.); 'the collection'
وَاثْنَيْنِ: وَ + اثْنَيْنِ — wa-, and + ithnayn, Monday (gen.); 'and Monday'
الْقَيْصَرِيَّةَ: الـ + قَيْصَرِيَّةَ — al-, the + qayṣariyya, market hall (acc.; enter without preposition); 'the market hall'
التُّجَّارِوَ: الـ + تُّجَّارِوَ — al-, the + tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir; gen.) + wa, and (conj.), printed on this word though it belongs to the next, يَمْضِي; 'the merchants, and'
الصَّيْرَفِيُّ: الـ + صَّيْرَفِيُّ — al-, the + ṣayrafī, money-changer (nom.); 'the money-changer'
وَالْكَاتِبُ: وَ + الـ + كَاتِبُ — wa-, and + al-, the + kātib, clerk (nom.); 'and the clerk'
يَجِيبُونَ: yajībūna, they bring (colloquial imperf. 3m.pl. of jāba)
فَأَحْسُبُهَا: فَـ + أَحْسُبُ + هَا — fa-, so, then + aḥsubu, I count (imperf. 1s.) + -hā, them (the dirhams); 'then I count them'
وَأَخْتِمُهَا: وَ + أَخْتِمُ + هَا — wa-, and + akhtimu, I seal (imperf. 1s.) + -hā, them; 'and I seal them'
وَآخُذُهَا: وَ + آخُذُ + هَا — wa-, and + ākhudhu, I take (imperf. 1s., printed with آ for أَ) + -hā, them; 'and I take them'
وَأَنْصَرِفُ: وَ + أَنْصَرِفُ — wa-, and + anṣarifu, I depart, go off (imperf. 1s., Form VII); 'and I go away'
وَفَطَرْتُ: وَ + فَطَرْتُ — wa-, and + faṭartu, I broke my fast (perf. 1s. of faṭara, for afṭartu); 'and I breakfasted'
وَانْتَبَهْتُ: وَ + انْتَبَهْتُ — wa-, and + intabahtu, I woke up (perf. 1s., Form VIII); 'and I woke'
وَتَعَطَّرْتُ: وَ + تَعَطَّرْتُ — wa-, and + taʿaṭṭartu, I perfumed myself (Form V; perf. 1s.); 'and I put on perfume'
لِلدُّكَّانِ: لِـ + الـ + دُّكَّانِ — li-, to (prep.; goal of dhahabtu) + al-, the + dukkān, shop (m., gen.); 'to the shop (of)'
الْبُسْتَانِيُّ: الـ + بُسْتَانِيُّ — al-, the + bustānī, gardener, orchardman (nom.); 'the gardener'
السُّوقُ: الـ + سُّوقُ — al-, the + sūq, market (m., nom.); 'the market stood up', i.e. was busy
بِأمْرَأَةٍ: بِـ + امْرَأَةٍ — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise: 'and behold, a woman' + imraʾa, woman (f., gen.) + tan — with tanwīn
مَيَّاسَةِ: mayyāsa, swaying, swaggering (f. adj., gen. in idāfa)
مَشْيِهَا: مَشْي + هَا — mashy, walking, gait (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'in her walk'
بِعُصْبَةٍ: بِـ + عُصْبَةٍ — bi-, with (prep.; here 'in/with', of what she wore) + ʿuṣba, headband, head-cloth (f., gen.) + tan — with tanwīn
هَائِلَةٍ: hāʾila, awesome, magnificent (f. adj., gen.); 'a magnificent headband'
وَرَوَائِحَ: وَ + رَوَائِحَ — wa-, and + rawāʾiḥ, scents, fragrances (pl. of rāʾiḥa; gen., diptote, governed by bi-); 'and with scents'
وَرَفَعَتِ: وَ + رَفَعَتِ — wa-, and + rafaʿat(i), she raised, lifted (perf. 3f.s.); 'and she lifted'
الشِّعْرِيَّةَ: الـ + شِّعْرِيَّةَ — al-, the + shiʿriyya, the fine mesh face-veil (f., acc.); 'the veil'
أَحْدَاقٍ: aḥdāq, eyes, eyeballs (pl. of ḥadaq; gen.)
فَسَلَّمَتْ: فَـ + سَلَّمَتْ — fa-, and + sallamat, she greeted (Form II; perf. 3f.s.); 'and she greeted'
وَتَحَدَّثَ: وَ + تَحَدَّثَ — wa-, and + taḥaddatha, he conversed (Form V; perf. 3m.s.); 'and he talked'
تَمَكَّنَ: tamakkana, it took hold, became established (Form V; perf. 3m.s.)
حُبُّهَا: ḥubb, love (m., nom.) + هَا — -hā, her; 'love of her'
تَفْصِيلَةٌ: tafṣīla, a length of cloth cut for a dress (f., nom.) + tun — with tanwīn
طَرْدُ: ṭard, chase, hunting (m., nom.), here the hunting-scene design
مُقَصَّبٌ: muqaṣṣab, gold-threaded, brocaded with gold wire (m. passive part., Form II; nom.)
طَرْشٌ: ṭarsh, obscure: perhaps the name of a weave or pattern; read as printed (nom.)
تَفْصِيلَةً: tafṣīla, dress-length (f., acc.) + tan — with tanwīn; 'a dress-length'
التَّفَاصِيلِ: الـ + تَّفَاصِيلِ — al-, the + tafāṣīl, dress-lengths (pl. of tafṣīla; gen.); 'from the dress-lengths'
اشْتَرَاهَا: ishtarā + hā — ishtarā, he bought (perf. 3m.s., Form VIII) + -hā, them (the lengths); 'which he bought'
فَبَايَعْتُهُ: فَـ + بَايَعْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + bāyaʿtu, I bargained, made a deal with (Form III; perf. 1s.) + -hu, him; 'so I struck a bargain with him'
بِأَلْفٍ: بِـ + أَلْفٍ — bi-, for, at (prep.; marks the price) + alf, a thousand (m., gen.) + tin; 'for a thousand'
وَمِائَتَيْنِ: وَ + مِائَتَيْنِ — wa-, and + miʾatayn, two hundred (dual gen.; printed with ئ); 'and two hundred'
لِلتَّاجِرِ: لِـ + الـ + تَّاجِرِ — li-, to (prep.; marks the person addressed) + al-, the + tājir, merchant (m., gen.); 'to the merchant'
التَّفْصِيلَةَ: الـ + تَّفْصِيلَةَ — al-, the + tafṣīla, dress-length (f., acc.); 'the dress-length'
وَأَذْهَبُ: وَ + أَذْهَبُ — wa-, and + adhhabu, I go (imperf. 1s.); 'and I go'
أُرْسِلُ: ursilu, I send (imperf. 1s., Form IV of arsala)
ثَمَنَهَا: thaman, price (m., acc.) + هَا — -hā, its/her; 'its price'
لَايُمْكِنُ: lā yumkinu, it is not possible (negative lā + imperf. 3m.s. of amkana, Form IV), printed as one word
قِسْطٌ: qisṭ, instalment, part-payment due (m., nom.); 'an instalment (due)'
قِطْعَةِ: qiṭʿa, piece, length (f., gen. in idāfa)
بِجُمْلَةٍ: بِـ + جُمْلَةٍ — bi-, for, at (prep.; marks the price) + jumla, sum, lump sum (f., gen.) + tin; 'for a sum'
وَأُفِيدُكَ: وَ + أُفِيدُ + كَ — wa-, and + ufīdu, I benefit, profit (imperf. 1s., Form IV of fāda) + -ka, you (m.); 'and I benefit you'
مَاتُرِيدُ: mā turīdu, what you want (mā + imperf. 2m.s. of arāda), printed as one word
وَأُرْسِلُ: وَ + أُرْسِلُ — wa-, and + ursilu, I send (imperf. 1s.); 'and I send'
وَلَكِنِّي: وَ + لَكِنَّ + ـي — wa-, and + lākinna, but + -ī, I (lākinnī); 'but I'
مُضْطَرٌّ: muḍṭarr, compelled, in need (passive part., Form VIII; nom.) + tun — with tanwīn
الثَّمَنِ: الـ + ثَّمَنِ — al-, the + thaman, price, money (m., gen.); 'the money'
طَائِفَتُكُمْ: ṭāʾifa, sort, kind, tribe (f., nom.) + -kum, your (m.pl.); 'your kind'
لِأَحَدٍقِيمَةً: لِـ + أَحَدٍ + قِيمَةً — li-, for (prep.; marks whose value) + aḥad, anyone (gen.) + tin + qīma, value, worth (f., acc.) + tan; printed as one word: 'for anyone a value'
مُوَايَةً: muwāya, turning away (apparently for muwalliya; f. act. part., acc. ḥāl) + tan; 'turning away'
فَحَسَيْتُ: فَـ + حَسَيْتُ — fa-, and so + ḥasaytu, I felt (colloquial perf. 1s. for ḥasastu); 'and so I felt'
وَأَوْقَفْتُهَا: وَ + أَوْقَفْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + awqaftu, I made stop (Form IV; perf. 1s.) + -hā, her; 'and I stopped her'
يَاسَيِّدَتِي: yā, O (vocative) + sayyida, lady, mistress (f.) + tī, my; printed as one word: 'O my lady'
تَصَدَّقِي: taṣaddaqī, be charitable, show kindness (imperative 2f.s., Form V)
وَارْجِعِي: وَ + ارْجِعِي — wa-, and + irjiʿī, return (imperative 2f.s. of rajaʿa); 'and return'
لِخُطُوَاتِكِ: لِـ + خُطُوَاتِ + كِ — li-, for the sake of, with (prep.) + khuṭuwāt, steps (pl. of khuṭwa; gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your steps'
الْكَرِيمَةِ: الـ + كَرِيمَةِ — al-, the + karīma, noble, gracious (f. adj., gen.); 'noble'
فَرَجَعَتْ: فَـ + رَجَعَتْ — fa-, so + rajaʿat, she returned (perf. 3f.s.); 'so she came back'
وَتَبَسَّمَتْ: وَ + تَبَسَّمَتْ — wa-, and + tabassamat, she smiled (Form V; perf. 3f.s.); 'and she smiled'
جْلِكِ: جْلِكِ — -jlīki, the rest of li-ajlīki: ajl, sake, cause (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); together 'for your sake'
قُصَادِي: quṣādī, opposite me (colloquial quṣād, 'in front of' + -ī, me)
التَّفْصِيلَةُ: الـ + تَّفْصِيلَةُ — al-, the + tafṣīla, dress-length (nom.); 'the dress-length'
شِرَاؤُهَا: shirāʾ, buying, purchase price (m., nom.) + -hā, its; 'its purchase'
أَلْفٌ: alf, a thousand (m., nom.) + tun — with tanwīn
وَمِائَةُ: وَ + مِائَةُ — wa-, and + miʾa, hundred (f., nom.; printed with ئ); 'and a hundred'
فَائِدَةً: fāʾida, profit, gain (f., acc.) + tan; 'as profit'
أَكْتُبْ: aktub, I write (imperf. 1s., jussive of purpose: 'that I may write')
بِخَطِّي: بِـ + خَطّ + ـي — bi-, with, in (prep.; instrument) + khaṭṭ, handwriting (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'in my hand'
وَأَعْطَيْتُهَا: وَ + أَعْطَيْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + aʿṭaytu, I gave (Form IV; perf. 1s.) + -hā, her (first object); 'and I gave her'
شِئْتِ: shiʾti, you wished (perf. 2f.s. of shāʾa), 'you wish'
