بِالسُّوقِ: بِـ + الـ + سُّوقِ — bi-, at, in (prep.; of time/place) + al-, the + sūq, market (m., gen.); 'at the market'
الْآتِي: الـ + آتِي — al-, the + ātī, coming, next (act. part. of atā; gen.); 'the next'
جَزَاكَ: jazā + ka — jazā, he rewarded (perf. 3m.s., wish) + -ka, you (m.); 'may (God) reward you'
وَرَزَقَكَ: وَ + رَزَقَ + كَ — wa-, and + razaqa, he provided (perf. 3m.s., wish) + -ka, you; 'and give you'
وَجَعَلَكَ: وَ + جَعَلَ + كَ — wa-, and + jaʿala, he made (perf. 3m.s., wish) + -ka, you; 'and make you'
دُعَاءَهَا: duʿāʾ, prayer, supplication (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her prayer'
وَلَكِ: وَ + لَـ + كِ — wa-, and + la-, for + -ki, you (f.); 'and for you'
وَدَعِينِي: وَ + دَعِي + نِي — wa-, and + daʿī, let, leave! (imperative 2f.s. of daʿa) + -nī, me; 'and let me'
أَنْظُرْ: anẓur, I look at (imperf. 1s. jussive); 'that I look at'
بِمَحَبَّتِهَا: بِـ + مَحَبَّة + هَا — bi-, with, by (prep.; taʿallaqa bi- 'be attached to') + maḥabba, love (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'to love of her'
لَاأَمْلِكُ: lā amliku, I do not own (lā + imperf. 1s. of malaka), printed as one word
لَاتُوحِشْنِي: lā tūḥishnī, do not make me desolate, do not leave me lonely (lā + jussive 2m.s. of Form IV awḥasha, 'make desolate' + -nī, me), printed as one word
وَقَدْوَلَّتْ: وَ + قَدْ + وَلَّتْ — wa-, and + qad, already (particle) + wallat, she turned away (Form II; perf. 3f.s.), printed as one word; 'and she had gone away'
غَائِبُ: ghāʾib, absent (act. part., nom.; in idāfa)
مَاحَصَلَ: mā ḥaṣala, what happened, what befell (mā + perf. 3m.s. of ḥaṣala), printed as one word
الْحُبِّ: الـ + حُبِّ — al-, the + ḥubb, love (gen.); 'of love'
وَسَأَلْتُ: وَ + سَأَلْتُ — wa-, and + saʾaltu, I asked (perf. 1s.); 'and I asked'
مَالٍ: māl, wealth (m., gen.) + -in; 'a woman of wealth'
مَالًاكَثِيرًا: māl, wealth (acc.) + an and kathīr, much (adj., acc.) + an; printed as one word: 'much wealth'
فَوَدَّعْتُهُ: فَـ + وَدَّعْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + waddaʿtu, I bade farewell (Form II; perf. 1s.) + -hu, him; 'so I took leave of him'
وَانْصَرَفْتُ: وَ + انْصَرَفْتُ — wa-, and + inṣaraftu, I departed (Form VII; perf. 1s.); 'and I left'
لِلْخَانِ: لِـ + الـ + خَانِ — li-, to (prep.; goal of jiʾtu, colloquial for ilā) + al-, the + khān, khan (gen.); 'to the khan'
الْعَشَاءَ: الـ + عَشَاءَ — al-, the + ʿashāʾ, supper (m., acc.); 'the supper'
فَافْتَكَرْتُهَا: فَـ + افْتَكَرْتُ + هَا — fa-, so + iftakartu, I thought of, brooded on (Form VIII; perf. 1s.) + -hā, her; 'so I thought of her'
آكُلْ: ākul, I eat (jussive 1s. of akala, printed with آ for أْ)
يَجِئْنِي: yajiʾnī, it comes to me (jussive 3m.s. of jāʾa + -nī, me)
فَسَهِرْتُ: فَـ + سَهِرْتُ — fa-, so + sahirtu, I stayed awake (perf. 1s.); 'so I stayed awake'
غَيْرَالَّتِي: غَيْر + الَّتِي — ghayr, other than, not (acc.) + allatī, the one which (f. rel. pron.); 'other than the one which'; printed as one word
قَدَحَ: qadaḥ, cup, drinking-bowl (m.), first term of a construct; 'a cup of'
بِدْلَةٌ: bidla, suit of clothes (f.), nom. (subject of the nominal clause); 'a suit'
وَسَلَّمَتْ: وَ + سَلَّمَ (sallama, greet) — 'and she greeted' (f. 3rd sg.)
أَعْذَبَ: aʿdhab, sweeter (comparative of عَذْب, sweet), acc.; 'sweeter'
وَلَاحْلَا: وَ + لَا + أَحْلَى — wa- 'and', lā 'not', aḥlā 'sweeter, lovelier' (comparative of حُلْو), with the hamza-alif lost and ى printed ا; 'and not lovelier'
وَالْمِائَتَيْنِ: وَ + الـ + مِائَتَيْنِ — wa- 'and' + mi'atayn, two hundred (dual of مِائَة, hundred); 'and the two hundred'
ثَمَنَ: thaman, price (m.), acc. in apposition to the sum; 'the price of'
التَّفْصِيلَةِ: الـ + تَفْصِيلَة — tafṣīla, cut length of cloth for a garment (f.), gen. in construct; 'the cut length of cloth'
لَاعَدِ: lā ʿadi-, first half of لَا عَدِمْنَاكَ 'may we not lose you' (ʿadima, lose, be deprived of); printed split from the rest
مْنَاكَ: -mnāka, second half of لَا عَدِمْنَاكَ: -nā 'we', -ka 'you'; 'may we never lose you' (a polite thank-you)
وَنَاوَلَتْنِي: وَ + نَاوَلَ (nāwala, hand over) + نِي — 'and she handed me'; -nī 'me'
أَتَحَدَّثُ: taḥaddatha, converse, talk — 'I talk, I chat' (1st sg. impf.), a circumstantial verb after قَعَدْتُ
فَأَوْمَيْتُ: فَـ + أَوْمَى — fa- 'so, then' + awmā, make a sign (for أَوْمَأَ), 'I signalled'
وِصَالَهَا: wiṣāl, union, meeting (m.), acc. object + هَا 'her'; 'union with her', here sexual
عَجَلٍ: ʿajal, haste (m.), gen. after عَلَى; عَلَى عَجَلٍ 'in haste'
وَاسْتَوْحَشَتْ: وَ + اسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥasha, feel strange, recoil) — 'and she recoiled'
مُتَعَلِّقٌ: mutaʿalliq, attached, clinging (active part. of تَعَلَّقَ), nom. predicate; 'attached'
أَثَرِهَا: athar, trace, track (m.) + هَا 'her'; 'in her track, after her'
أَتَتْنِي: atā, come — 'she came' + نِي 'to me'; 'she came to me'
مَايَعْرِفُنِي: مَا + يَعْرِفُ + نِي — mā, not + yaʿrifu, know ('he knows') + nī, me; 'does not know me'; printed as one word
مَانَسِيتَهَا: مَا + نَسِيَ + هَا — mā + nasiya, forget ('you forgot', -ta) + 'her'; 'that you forgot her'; printed as one word
فُلَانٍ: fulān, so-and-so, a certain man (stands for a name)
الصَّيْرَفِيِّ: الـ + صَيْرَفِيّ — ṣayrafī, money-changer (m.), gen. after إِلَى; 'the money-changer'
رَأَتْنِي: raʾā, see — 'she saw' + نِي 'me'; 'she saw me'
أَزْوَتْنِي: azwā (for زَوَى, draw in, gather) — 'she drew' + نِي 'me'; 'she drew me'
لِجَانِبِهَا: لِـ + جَانِب + هَا — li-, to, toward (prep.) + jānib, side (m.) + 'her'; 'to her side'
وَقَعْتَ: waqaʿa, fall, occur — 'you fell' (2nd m. sg.); here: waqaʿta ʿalā, 'you came upon, found'; the print itself marks the fatḥa of -ta, 'you'
بِخَاطِرِي: بِـ + خَاطِر + ـي — bi-, in, into (prep.; وقع بِـ 'fall into') + khāṭir, mind, heart (m.) + 'my'; 'into my mind'
وَتَمَكَّنَ: وَ + تَمَكَّنَ — tamakkana, take hold, be firmly established; 'and took hold'
سَاعَةِ: sāʿa, hour, moment (f.), gen. after مِنْ, in construct; 'the hour'
مَاهَنِي: مَا + هَنِيَ — mā, not + hanīya, be pleasant, wholesome (for هَنِئَ); 'was not pleasant'; printed as one word
وَلَاشُرْبٌ: وَ + لَا + شُرْب — wa- 'and', lā 'not', shurb, drinking (m.), nom.; printed as one word
أَضْعَافُ: aḍʿāf, multiples, many times (pl. of ضِعْف), nom. in construct; 'multiples of'
وَالْحَالُ: وَ + الـ + حَال — wa- 'and' + ḥāl, state, condition (m.); 'and the state'; here: wa-al-ḥālu anna, 'and the situation is that'
يُغْنِي: aghnā, suffice, make needless — 'it suffices' (m. 3rd sg. impf.)
يَاحَبِيبِي: يَا + حَبِيب + ـي — yā, O + ḥabīb, beloved + 'my'; 'my darling'; printed as one word
وَمَالِي: وَ + مَا + لِي — wa- 'and' + mā, not, or the interrogative 'what?' + li-, to (prep.) + 'me'; 'and I have not'; printed as one word; also wa-mā lī lā …, 'and what is the matter with me that I do not …', i.e. 'why do I not …' Also wa-mā lī arāka, 'and what is it with me that I see you', that is, 'why do I see you'.
يَأْوِينِي: ʾāwā, give shelter — 'it shelters' (m. 3rd sg. impf.) + نِي 'me'; 'that shelters me'
الْخَانُ: الـ + خَان — khān, inn, caravanserai (m.), nom. (substitute after a negative); 'the inn'
تَصَدَّقْتِ: taṣaddaqa, give alms, be kind — 'you gave alms', 2nd f. sg.; 'if you would be so kind'
لَكِنِ: lākin, but (with kasra before the article)
الْجُمُعَةِ: الـ + جُمُعَة — jumuʿa, Friday (f.), gen. in construct; 'Friday'
الصَّلٰوةِ: الـ + صَلَاة — ṣalāh, prayer (f.), gen.; printed with و; 'the prayer'
حِمَارَكَ: ḥimār, donkey (m.), acc. object + ـكَ 'your'; 'your donkey'
الْجَبَّانِيَةِ: الـ + جَبَّانِيَة — al-Jabbāniya, a quarter of Cairo by the cemeteries (jabbāna, cemetery), gen. after عَنِ; 'the Jabbāniyya'
فَاسْأَلْ: فَـ + اسْأَلْ — fa- 'then' + saʾala, ask — imperative 'ask!'
بَرَكَاتٍ: Barakāt, a man's name (barakāt, blessings), gen. in construct
النَّقِيبِ: الـ + نَقِيب — naqīb, marshal, officer (m.), gen., apposition; 'the marshal'
بِأَبِي: بِـ + أَبِي — bi-, by the name of (prep.; معروف بِـ 'known as') + abī, father of (gen.); 'as Abū'
شَامَةَ: Shāma, a name (shāma, beauty-spot), gen. in construct (diptote); 'Shāma'
سَاكِنَةٌ: sākina, dwelling, living (f. act. part. of سَكَنَ), nom.; 'living'
وَلَاتُبْطِىءْ: وَ + لَا + تُبْطِئْ — wa- 'and', lā 'do not', abṭaʾa, be slow (jussive, 'you be slow'); printed as one word with ى
إِنْتِظَارِكَ: intiẓār, waiting (m.) + ـكَ 'your'; فِي انْتِظَارِكَ 'waiting for you'
زَائِدًا: zāʾid, excessive, increasing (act. part. of زَادَ), acc.; 'excessive'
سَهْرَانَ: sahrān, sleepless, wakeful (m. adj.), acc. hāl (diptote)
الْفَجْرَ: الـ + فَجْر — fajr, dawn (m.), acc. after أَنَّ; 'the dawn'
مَلْبُوسِي: malbūs, clothing, what is worn (m.) + ـي 'my'; 'my clothes'
وَتَطَيَّبْتُ: وَ + تَطَيَّبَ (taṭayyaba, put on scent) — 'and I scented myself'
مِنْدِيلٍ: mindīl, kerchief, cloth (m.), gen. after فِي; 'a kerchief'
زُوَيْلَةَ: Zuwayla, name of a Cairo gate (diptote, gen. in construct); 'Zuwayla'
فَرَكِبْتُ: فَـ + رَكِبَ (rakiba, ride, mount) — 'so I mounted'
لِصَاحِبِهِ: لِـ + صَاحِب + هِ — li-, to (prep., with a verb of saying) + ṣāḥib, owner, companion (m.) + 'its'; 'to its owner'
لَحْظَةٍ: laḥẓa, moment, glance (f.), gen. after فِي; 'a moment'
دَرْبٍ: darb, alley, lane (m.), gen. after عَلَى; 'an alley'
دَرْبُ: darb, alley (m.), nom. in construct; 'the alley of'
الْمِنْقَرِيِّ: الـ + مِنْقَرِيّ — al-Minqarī, a man's name (nisba), gen. in construct
ادْخُلِ: dakhala, enter — imperative 'enter!' (kasra before the article)
الدَّرْبَ: الـ + دَرْب — darb, alley (m.), acc. object; 'the alley'
بَاكِرْ: bākir, early, tomorrow morning (colloquial, imperative of بَكَّرَ 'rise early')
تَجِيئُنِي: تَجِيءُ + نِي — jāʾa, come ('you come') + nī 'to me'; 'you come to me'
وَتُوَدِّينِي: وَ + تُوَدِّي + نِي — wa- 'and' + waddā, take, convey (colloquial) 'you take' + nī 'me'; 'and take me'
الْمُكَارِي: الـ + مُكَارِي — mukārī, donkey-hirer, muleteer (m.); 'the donkey-man'
فَنَاوَلْتُهُ: فَـ + نَاوَلْتُ + هُ — nāwala, hand over, 'I handed' + 'him'
فَخَرَجَتَا: فَـ + خَرَجَتَا — kharaja, go out, 'they (two, f.) came out'
صَبِيَّتَيْنِ: ṣabiyya, young girl (f.), dual oblique; 'two girls'
كَأَنَّهُنَّ: كَـ + أَنَّ + هُنَّ — ka-, like + anna 'that' (together 'as though') + hunna 'they' (f. pl.); 'as though they'; kept as printed with its hamza
قْمَارُ: -qmār, second part of الأقمار, aqmār, moons (pl. of قَمَر), nom.; 'moons'
تَنَمِ: nāma, sleep — jussive 'she slept' (kasra before the article)
لِفَرَحِهَا: لِـ + فَرَح + هَا — li-, because of, for (prep., giving the reason) + faraḥ, joy (m.) + 'her'; 'for her joy'
مُعَلَّقَةٍ: muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (pass. part. of عَلَّقَ, f.), gen.; 'hung'
بِسَبْعَةِ: بِـ + سَبْعَة — bi-, with (prep.) + sabʿa, seven, in construct; 'with seven'
وَدَائِرُهَا: وَ + دَائِر + هَا — wa- 'and' + dāʾir, circuit, circumference (act. part. of دَارَ) + 'its'; 'and all around it'
مُطِلَّةٌ: muṭilla, overlooking (f. act. part. of أَطَلَّ), nom.; 'overlooking'
بُسْتَانٍ: bustān, garden (m.), gen. after عَلَى; 'a garden'
أَلْوَانٌ: alwān, colours, kinds (pl. of لَوْن), nom.; 'colours, kinds'
وَبِهِ: وَ + بِـ + هِ — wa- 'and' + bi-, in (prep.) + 'it'; 'and in it'; also wa- + bi-, by (marking the cause, after maftūn 'bewitched') + -hi, him: wa-bihi maftūnātun, 'and by him (we are) bewitched'
أَنْهَارٌ: anhār, rivers, streams (pl. of نَهْر), nom.; 'streams'
دَافِقَةٌ: dāfiqa, gushing, flowing (f. act. part. of دَفَقَ), nom.; 'gushing'
وَطُيُورُهَا: وَ + طُيُور + هَا — wa- 'and' + ṭuyūr, birds (pl. of طَيْر) + 'its'; 'and its birds'
نَاطِقَةٌ: nāṭiqa, speaking, singing (f. act. part. of نَطَقَ), nom.; 'speaking'
مُبَيَّضَةٌ: mubayyaḍa, whitened, whitewashed (f. pass. part. of بَيَّضَ), nom.; 'whitewashed'
بِبَيَاضٍ: بِـ + بَيَاض — bi-, with (prep.) + bayāḍ, whiteness, whitewash (m.); 'with whiteness'
الْإِنْسَانُ: الـ + إِنْسَان — insān, person, human being (m.), subject; 'the person'
وَسَقْفُهَا: وَ + سَقْف + هَا — wa- 'and' + saqf, ceiling (m.) + 'its'; 'and its ceiling'
مُقَرْبَصٌ: muqarbaṣ, vaulted (?; pass. part. of قَرْبَصَ, rare), nom.; 'vaulted'
بِذَهَبٍ: بِـ + ذَهَب — bi-, with (prep.) + dhahab, gold (m.); 'with gold'
وَطِرَازَاتٌ: وَ + طِرَازَات — wa- 'and' + ṭirāzāt, bands of ornament or inscription (pl. of طِرَاز), nom.; 'and bands'
مَكْتُوبَةٌ: maktūba, written, inscribed (f. pass. part. of كَتَبَ), nom.; 'inscribed'
بِاللَّازَوَرْدِ: بِـ + الـ + لَازَوَرْد — bi-, with (prep.) + lāzawar, lapis lazuli (m.); 'with lapis lazuli'
حَرَتْ: ḥarat, as printed; probably a misprint for حَوَتْ, ḥawā, gather, contain — 'it had gathered'
أَوْصَافًا: awṣāf, qualities, descriptions (pl. of وَصْف), acc.; 'qualities'
وَأَضَاءَتْ: وَ + أَضَاءَتْ — wa- 'and' + aḍāʾa, shine (intrans.), 'it shone'
لِلنَّاظِرِينَ: لِـ + الـ + نَاظِرِينَ — li-, for (prep.) + nāẓirīn, beholders (m. pl. act. part. of نَظَرَ); 'for the beholders'
وَأَرْضُهَا: وَ + أَرْض + هَا — wa- 'and' + arḍ, floor, ground (f.) + 'its'; 'and its floor'
الْمُجَزَّعِ: الـ + مُجَزَّع — mujazzaʿ, veined, streaked (adj.), gen.; 'the veined'
نَسْقِيَةٌ: nasqiya, as printed; evidently فَسْقِيَة, fountain basin (f.), nom.; 'a basin'
أَرْكَانِ: arkān, corners, sides (pl. of رُكْن), gen. in construct; 'the corners of'
الْفَسْقِيَةِ: الـ + فَسْقِيَة — fasqiya, fountain basin (f.), gen.; 'the fountain basin'
بِالدُّرِّوَا: بِـ + الـ + دُرّ + وَا — bi-, with, of (prep.) + durr, pearls (m.) + wa-, and, with the alif of الـ of the next word; 'with pearls and'
لْجَوْهَرِ: -l-jawhar, the lām of الـ + jawhar, jewel, gem (m.), gen.; 'the jewel'
الْمُلَوَّنِ: الـ + مُلَوَّن — mulawwan, coloured (pass. part. of لَوَّنَ), gen.; 'the coloured'
وَالْمَرَاتِبِ: وَ + الـ + مَرَاتِب — wa- 'and' + marātib, mattresses, cushioned seats (pl. of مَرْتَبَة); 'and the mattresses'
الْ—احِ: الْمُبَاحِ with letters missing in the print (— marks the gap): al-mubāḥ, permitted (pass. part. of أَبَاحَ), gen.; 'the permitted'
احِ: stray fragment — the last word of the printed closing formula, broken as ال—اح, for الْمُبَاحِ (al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted'), the dash standing for the dropped مب; read here as the genitive ending -iḥ after the article الْ
أَشْعُرْ: شَعَرَ — shaʿara, to be aware, to notice (1 sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'I was not aware'
مُنَقَّشَةٌ: مُنَقَّشَة — munaqqasha, ornamented, painted, embroidered (passive part. of naqqasha; f., nom. indef.)
مُكَتَّبَةٌ: مُكَتَّبَة — mukattaba, inscribed, covered with writing (passive part. of kattaba; f., nom. indef.); uncertain sense
وَحَضَنَتْنِي: وَ + حَضَنَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥaḍana, to embrace, hold to the breast (3 f. sg. past) + -nī, me; 'and she embraced me'
وَوَضَعَتْنِي: وَ + وَضَعَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + waḍaʿa, to put, lay (3 f. sg. past) + -nī, me; 'and she laid me'
فَمِي: فَم + ي — fam, mouth (m., gen. after عَلَى) + -ī, my; 'my mouth'
تَمُصُّ: مَصَّ — maṣṣa, to suck (3 f. sg. present, here after جَعَلَتْ); 'she sucks, she began to suck'
أَتَيْتَ: أَتَى — atā, to come (2 m. sg. past); 'you came'
لَذَّلِي: لَذَّ + لِـ + ي — ladhdha, to be sweet, pleasant (3 m. sg. past) + li-, to, for (prep., marks the person pleased) + -ī, me; 'was sweet to me' (printed as one word)
هَنَى: هَنَأَ — hanaʾa, to be wholesome, agreeable (3 m. sg. past; printed with yā for the hamza); 'was pleasant'
مُطْرِقٌ: مُطْرِق — muṭriq, bowing, lowering the head (act. part. of aṭraqa; m., nom. indef., circumstantial); 'bowing'
بِرَأْسِي: بِـ + رَأْس + ي — bi-, with (prep.; أَطْرَقَ takes بِـ of the thing lowered) + raʾs, head (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my head' (the thing lowered)
حَيَاءً: حَيَاء — ḥayāʾ, modesty, shyness (m., acc. tanwīn, adverbial); 'out of shyness'
لَبِثْتُ: لَبِثَ — labitha, to stay, linger, wait (1 sg. past); 'I lingered'
إِلَّاقُدِّمَتْ: إِلَّا + قُدِّمَتْ — illā, except, but + qaddama, to set before (3 f. sg. past passive); 'except was set before'; printed as one word, so 'I had hardly waited before… was set'
سُفْرَةٌ: سُفْرَة — sufra, spread, table-cloth, food laid out (f., nom. indef., subject of the passive); 'a spread'
أَلْوَانِ: أَلْوَان — alwān, colours, kinds (pl. of لَوْن; m., gen. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'kinds of'
سِكْبَاجَهْ: سِكْبَاجَة — sikbāj, a stew of meat in vinegar (f.; printed with final ه for ة, gen. after مِنْ); 'a sikbāj'
وَقُرْبُوسٍ: وَ + قُرْبُوس — wa-, and + qurbūs, literally 'pommel of a saddle', here a cut or piece of meat (m., gen., second item after مِنْ); 'and a qurbūs'; exact meaning uncertain
مَقْلِيٍّ: مَقْلِيّ — maqliyy, fried (passive part. of qalā; m., gen. indef., describes قُرْبُوس); 'fried'
مُنَزَّلٍ: مُنَزَّل — munazzal, let down, soaked (passive part. of nazzala; m., gen. indef.); 'steeped'
عَسَلِ: عَسَل — ʿasal, honey (m., gen. as first term of an iḍāfa after فِي); 'honey of'
وَدَجَاجٍ: وَ + دَجَاج — wa-, and + dajāj, fowl, chicken (collective, m., gen., third item after مِنْ); 'and fowl'
مَحْشِيٍّ: مَحْشِيّ — maḥshiyy, stuffed (passive part. of ḥashā; m., gen. indef.); 'stuffed'
وَاكْتَفَيْنَا: وَ + اكْتَفَى + نَا — wa-, and + iktafā, to have enough, be satisfied (1 pl. past); 'and we had enough'
فَقَدَّ: فَـ + قَدَّ — fa-, and then + qaddama (read; the printed letters give qadda, one م lost), to bring forward (3 m. sg. past); 'and brought forward'; the print is damaged
مَوَالِي: مَوَالِي — mawālī, servants, retainers, freedmen (pl. of مَوْلَى; m., nom. subject); 'the servants'
الطَّشْتَ: الـ + طَشْت — ṭasht, basin (m., acc. object; Persian loan, also طَسْت); 'the basin'
وَالْإِ: وَ + الـ + إِ — wa-, and + al-, the + i-, the first letters of إِبْرِيق, ewer; 'and the ewe-' (first piece of a word the print breaks in two)
بْرِبْقَ: بْرِيق — -brīq, ewer, jug (m., acc.; the printed letters lack the yā), second piece of إِبْرِيق; '-r, the ewer'
فَغَسَلْتُ: فَـ + غَسَلْتُ — fa-, and then + ghasala, to wash (1 sg. past); 'and I washed'
تَطَيَّبْنَا: تَطَيَّبَ — taṭayyaba, to perfume oneself (1 pl. past); 'we perfumed ourselves'
فَأَنْشَدَتْ: فَـ + أَنْشَدَتْ — fa-, and then + anshada, to recite (verse) (3 f. sg. past); 'and she recited'
الْأَبْ—يَ—اتِ: الـ + أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses (pl. of بَيْت; gen. in apposition); printed broken by dashes; 'the verses'
سَوَادِ: سَوَاد — sawād, blackness, dark part (m., gen. after مَعَ, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the blackness of'
الْجُفُونُ: الـ + جُفُون — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of جَفْن; m., gen., printed with ḍamma at the rhyme); 'the eyelids'
تَشْكُو: شَكَا — shakā, to complain (3 f. sg. present); 'she complains'
مَالَاقَتْ: مَا + لَاقَتْ — mā, what (relative) + lāqā, to meet, suffer (3 f. sg. past); 'what she met with'; printed as one word
أَشْكُولَهَا: أَشْكُو + لَـ + هَا — shakā, to complain (1 sg. present) + li-, to (prep., marks the person complained to) + -hā, her; 'I complain to her'; printed as one word
مَالَا: مَا + لَا — mā, what (relative) + lā-, first part of لَاقَيْتُ, 'I met'; printed apart from its end
قَيْتُ: -قَيْتُ — -qaytu, the end of لَاقَيْتُ, lāqā, to meet, suffer (1 sg. past; the yā is lost in the print): 'I met'
أَخَذْنَا: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (perf. 1p): 'we took, we have taken'; with a following imperfect, 'we began'
وَنَتَهَارَشُ: وَ + نَتَهَارَشُ — wa-, and + tahārasha, to scratch or tussle with one another (1 pl. present); 'and we tussle'
وَنَتَبَاوَسُ: وَ + نَتَبَاوَسُ — wa-, and + tabāwasa, to kiss one another (1 pl. present; from colloquial bāsa); 'and we kiss'
فَقَدَّمُوا: فَـ + قَدَّمُوا — fa-, and then + qaddama, to set before, bring forward (3 m. pl. past); 'and they set before'
الْجَوَارِ: الـ + جَوَارِ — jawārī, slave girls (pl. of جَارِيَة; f.; printed without the final yā); 'the slave girls'
وَالْمُدَامَ: وَ + الـ + مُدَام — wa-, and + mudām, wine (f., acc. object); 'and the wine'
حَضْرَةٌ: حَضْرَة — ḥaḍra, presence, company, session (f., nom. indef., predicate); 'a gathering'
اضْطَجَعْنَا: اضْطَجَعَ — iḍṭajaʿa, to lie down (1 pl. past); 'we lay down'
فَمَارَأَيْتُ: فَـ + مَا + رَأَيْتُ — fa-, and/so (connective); mā, not (neg.); raʾaytu, I saw (past 1sg of رَأَى, to see); printed as one word; 'and I never saw'
الْمِنْدِيلَ: الـ + مِنْدِيل — al-, the; mindīl, handkerchief, kerchief (m.); accusative, object of رَمَيْتُ
الدَّنَانِيرُ: الـ + دَنَانِير — al-, the; danānīr, dinars, gold coins (pl. of دِينَار); nominative, subject of the verbless clause
وَدَّعْتُهَا: وَدَّعْتُ + هَا — waddaʿtu, I bade farewell (past 1sg of II وَدَّعَ, to take leave of); -hā, her; 'I bade her farewell'
الْحَسَنَ: الـ + حَسَن — al-, the; ḥasan, fair, beautiful (adj. m.); agrees with الْوَجْهَ
أَكُونُ: أَكُونُ — akūnu, I shall be (pres. 1sg of كَانَ); 'I will be'
أَصَبْتُ: أَصَبْتُ — aṣabtu, I found, I came upon (past 1sg of IV أَصَابَ)
جَابَنِي: جَابَ + نِي — jāba, he brought (colloquial contraction of جَاءَ بِـ, 'he came with'); -nī, me; 'he brought me'
بِالْأَمْسِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْس — bi-, with/on (prep.); al-, the; amsi, yesterday (m.); 'the day before, yesterday'
يَنْتَظِرُنِي: يَنْتَظِرُ + نِي — yantaẓiru, he waits for (pres. 3sg m. of VIII اِنْتَظَرَ); -nī, me; 'waiting for me'
الْغُرُوبِ: الـ + غُرُوب — al-, the; ghurūb, setting (of the sun), sunset (m.); genitive: 'the time of sunset'
فَفَطَرْتُ: فَـ + فَطَرْتُ — fa-, and; faṭartu, I breakfasted, I broke my fast (past 1sg of فَطَرَ; a colloquial use)
أُطَالِبُ: أُطَالِبُ — uṭālibu, I demand, I press for (pres. 1sg of III طَالَبَ); takes بِـ for the thing demanded
بِثَمَنِ: بِـ + ثَمَن — bi-, for (prep.; طَالَبَ بِـ, 'to demand'); thaman, price (m.); 'for the price of'
خَرُوفًا: خَرُوف — kharūf, lamb, young sheep (m.); accusative (tanwīn), object of عَمِلْتُ
مَشْوِيًّا: مَشْوِيّ — mashwī, roasted, grilled (adj., pass. part. of شَوَى); accusative, qualifying خَرُوفًا
حَلَاوَةً: حَلَاوَة — ḥalāwa, sweetmeats, sweets, confectionery (f.); accusative (tanwīn)
دَعَوْتُ: دَعَوْتُ — daʿawtu, I called, I summoned (past 1sg of دَعَا)
وَوَضَعْتُهُ: وَ + وَضَعْتُ + هُ — wa-, and; waḍaʿtu, I put, I placed (past 1sg of وَضَعَ); -hu, it; 'and I put it'
الْمَحْمَلِ: الـ + مَحْمَل — al-, the; maḥmal, carrier, carrying-frame (m.; usually a litter, here a porter's frame, doubtful); genitive after فِي
وَأَعْطَيْتُهُ: وَ + أَعْطَيْتُ + هُ — wa-, and; aʿṭaytu, I gave (past 1sg of IV أَعْطَى); -hu, him; 'and I gave him'
أَشْغَالِي: أَشْغَال + ـِي — ashghāl, occupations, business, affairs (pl. of شُغْل); -ī, my; genitive after فِي ('in my business')
فَجَاءَنِي: فَـ + جَاءَ + نِي — fa-, and; jāʾa, he came (past 3sg m. of جَاءَ); -nī, me; 'and he came to me'; also: singular verb before a plural subject: fa-jāʾanī al-ʿayyārūna, 'and the rogues came upon me'
الْمَغْرِبِ: الـ + مَغْرِب — al-, the; maghrib, the setting, sunset, evening (m.); genitive: 'at the time of sunset'
وَجَعَلْتُهُمْ: وَ + جَعَلْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and; jaʿaltu, I put, I made (past 1sg of جَعَلَ); -hum, them (m. pl., used for the dinars); 'and I put them'
فَوَجَدْتُهُمْ: فَـ + وَجَدْتُ + هُمْ — fa-, and; wajadtu, I found (past 1sg of وَجَدَ); -hum, them; 'and I found them'
مَسَحُوا: مَسَحُوا — masaḥū, they wiped (past 3pl m. of مَسَحَ)
الرُّخَامَ: الـ + رُخَام — al-, the; rukhām, marble (m.); accusative, object
وَجَلَوُا: وَ + جَلَوُا — wa-, and; jalawū, they polished, they scoured (past 3pl m. of جَلَا)
النُّحَاسَ: الـ + نُحَاس — al-, the; nuḥās, copper, brass (m.); accusative, object
وَعَمَّرُوا: وَ + عَمَّرُوا — wa-, and; ʿammarū, they filled (the lamps) (past 3pl m. of II عَمَّرَ; 'to fill with oil')
وَغَرَفُوا: وَ + غَرَفُوا — wa-, and; gharafū, they ladled out, they dished up (past 3pl m. of غَرَفَ)
وَرَوَّقُوا: وَ + رَوَّقُوا — wa-, and; rawwaqū, they strained, they cleared (past 3pl m. of II رَوَّقَ; of wine)
أَوْحَشْتَنِي: أَوْحَشْتَ + نِي — awḥashta, you made lonely, you made desolate (past 2sg m. of IV أَوْحَشَ); -nī, me; 'I missed you'
قُدِّمَتِ: قُدِّمَتِ — quddimat, were presented, were served (past 3sg f. passive of II قَدَّمَ), with a linking kasra before الـ
الْمَوَائِدُ: الـ + مَوَائِد — al-, the; mawāʾid, tables, spreads (pl. of مَائِدَة); nominative, subject of the passive; ئ printed precomposed in the edition
وَشَالَتِ: وَ + شَالَتِ — wa-, and; shālat, she lifted away, she carried off (past 3sg f. of شَالَ; colloquial), with a linking kasra before الـ
الْمَائِدَةَ: الـ + مَائِدَة — al-, the; māʾida, table, spread (f.); accusative, object; ئ printed precomposed in the edition
وَقَدَّمْنَ: وَ + قَدَّمْنَ — wa-, and; qaddamna, they presented, they brought (past 3pl f. of II قَدَّمَ)
فَقُمْنَا: فَـ + قُمْنَا — fa-, and; qumnā, we rose (past 1pl of قَامَ)
مَجْلِسِ: مَجْلِس — majlis, sitting-place, chamber, room (m.); genitive after إِلَى, first term of the construct
فَنِمْنَا: فَـ + نِمْنَا — fa-, and; nimnā, we slept (past 1pl of نَامَ)
وَنَاوَلْتُهَا: وَ + نَاوَلْتُ + هَا — wa-, and; nāwaltu, I handed (past 1sg of III نَاوَلَ); -hā, her; 'and I handed her'
الْخَمْسِينَ: الـ + خَمْسِين — al-, the; khamsīn, fifty (m.); accusative, object: 'the fifty'
الْعَادَةِ: الـ + عَادَة — al-, the; ʿāda, custom, habit (f.); genitive after عَلَى; 'عَلَى الْعَادَةِ', 'as usual, according to custom'
عِنْدِهَا: عِنْد + هَا — ʿind, at, with (here a noun after مِنْ); -hā, her; 'from her place, from her'
خَانٍ: خَان — khān, inn, khan (m.); genitive (tanwīn) after إِلَى; printed without the article, 'a khan'; also (Night 202): خَان — khān, inn, caravanserai (m.); gen. indef. after fī: fī khānin, 'in an inn'
جَوْزًا: جَوْز — jawz, walnuts (or 'a pair'; doubtful here) (m.); accusative (tanwīn), object
وَلَوْزًا: وَ + لَوْز — wa-, and; lawz, almonds (m.); accusative (tanwīn)
وَتَحْتَهُمْ: وَ + تَحْتَ + هُمْ — wa-, and; taḥta, under (prep., here the predicate placed first); -hum, them; 'and beneath them'
رُزٌّ: رُزّ — ruzz, rice (m.); nominative (tanwīn), subject of the verbless clause
مُفَلْفَلٌ: مُفَلْفَل — mufalfal, peppered (pass. part. of quadriliteral فَلْفَلَ, from فُلْفُل, pepper); nominative, qualifying رُزٌّ
قُلْقَاسًا: قُلْقَاس — qulqās, taro, colocasia (a root vegetable) (m.); accusative (tanwīn), object
وَنُقْلًا: وَ + نُقْل — wa-, and; nuql, nuts and sweets eaten with wine (m.); accusative (tanwīn)
وَأَرْسَلْتُهُمْ: وَ + أَرْسَلْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and; arsaltu, I sent (past 1sg of IV أَرْسَلَ); -hum, them; 'and I sent them'
وَرَكِبْتُ: وَ + رَكِبْتُ — wa-, and; rakibtu, I rode (past 1sg of رَكِبَ)
وَأَصْبَحْتُ: وَ + أَصْبَحْتُ — wa-, and; aṣbaḥtu, I became, I found myself in the morning (past 1sg of IV أَصْبَحَ)
فِعْلِ: فِعْل — fiʿl, doing, deed (m.); genitive after مِنْ, first term of the construct
الشَّيْطَانِ: الـ + شَيْطَان — al-, the; shayṭān, Satan, the devil (m.); genitive: 'the doing of Satan', 'like the devil', 'the party of the devil'
فَقْرُ: فَقْر — faqr, poverty (m.); nominative, subject, first term of the construct
الْغَنِىّ: الـ + غَنِيّ — al-, the; ghaniyy, rich, wealthy (adj. m.); genitive, second term of the construct, printed with ى and shadda; 'the rich man's poverty'
يُذْهِبُ: يُذْهِبُ — yudhhibu, he removes, he takes away (pres. 3sg m. of IV أَذْهَبَ)
اَنْوَارَهُ: أَنْوَار + هُ — anwār, lights, radiance (pl. of نُور); accusative, object; -hu, his; 'his lights'; the print writes the initial alif without hamza
اصْفِرَارُ: اِصْفِرَار — iṣfirār, yellowing, turning pale (m.; verbal noun of IX اِصْفَرَّ); nominative, first term of the construct
الْمَغِيبِ: الـ + مَغِيب — al-, the; maghīb, setting, going down (m.); genitive after عِنْدَ; 'at the setting'; rhyme-word with printed kasra
لَايُذْكَرُ: لَا + يُذْكَرُ — lā, not (neg.); yudhkaru, he is mentioned (pres. 3sg m. passive of ذَكَرَ); printed as one word, 'he is not mentioned'
الْحَيِّ: الـ + حَيّ — al-, the; ḥayy, quarter, neighbourhood, tribe (m.); genitive after فِى; 'in the quarter'
نَصِيبِ: نَصِيب — naṣīb, share, portion (m.); the print gives a rhyme kasra (nominative نَصِيبٌ expected): 'no share'
الْاَسْوَاقِ: الـ + أَسْوَاق — al-, the; aswāq, markets (pl. of سُوق); genitive after فِى; printed with a plain alif
مُسْتَخْفِيًا: مُسْتَخْفِي — mustakhfī, hiding himself, concealing himself (act. part. of X اِسْتَخْفَى); accusative (ḥāl): 'in hiding'
الْفَلَا: الـ + فَلَا — al-, the; falā, wilderness, open desert (m.; the print's form of الْفَلَاة); genitive after فِى; 'in the wild'; here: gen., second term of an iḍāfa, waḥsha al-falā, 'the wild beasts of the desert'
بِدَمْعٍ: بِـ + دَمْع — bi-, with (prep. of means); damʿ, tears, tear (m.); genitive (tanwīn): 'with tears'
صَبِيبِ: صَبِيب — ṣabīb, poured, streaming (adj., 'poured out'); genitive (tanwīn dropped), qualifying دَمْع; rhyme kasra
الْاِنْسَانُ: الـ + إِنْسَان — al-, the; insān, human being, man (m.); nominative, subject; printed with a plain alif
بُلِي: بُلِيَ — buliya, he was afflicted, he was tried (past 3sg m. passive of بَلَا/بَلِيَ), with بِـ for the affliction
بِالْفَقْرِ: بِـ + الـ + فَقْر — bi-, with (prep.; بُلِيَ بِـ, 'be afflicted with'); al-, the; faqr, poverty (m.); 'with poverty'
غَرِيبِ: غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger, foreigner (m.); in verse the print gives a rhyme kasra (nominative غَرِيبٌ expected): 'a stranger'; also adj., strange, rare (min gharībi ʿamali, 'of the rare work of')
أمْشِي: أَمْشِي — amshī, I walk (imperfect, first person; mashā, walk)
ازْدِحَامٍ: اِزْدِحَام — izdiḥām, crowding, throng (m.), gen. after fī: 'in a crush'
مَسْدُودٌ: مَسْدُود — masdūd, blocked, stopped up (passive part. of sadda); 'blocked'
بِالْأمْرِ: بِـ (bi-, by, by means of, prep.) + الـ + أَمْر — amr, command, matter, decree (m.); 'by the command'
جُنْدِىًّ: جُنْدِي — jundī, soldier (m.), spelled with final ى and read accusative, without the alif of tanwīn: 'a soldier'
فَزَاحَمْتُهُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + زَاحَمَ — zāḥama, jostle (I) + تُ (-tu, I) + هُ (-hu, him); 'and I jostled him'
اخْتِيَارِى: اِخْتِيَار — ikhtiyār, choice, free will (m.), + ي (-ī, my), spelled with final ى: 'my choice'
صُرَّةً: صُرَّة — ṣurra, purse, bundle (f.), acc. tanwīn: 'a purse'
فَعَلِمْتُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + عَلِمَ — ʿalima, know (I) + تُ (-tu, I); 'and I knew'
إنَّهَا: إِنَّ (inna, indeed, that, after a verb of knowing) + هَا (-hā, she/it, f.); 'that it'
مُتَّصِلَةٌ: مُتَّصِلَة — muttaṣila, joined, attached (f. active part. of ittaṣala); 'joined' (obscure; see note)
الصُّرَّةِ: الـ + صُرَّة — ṣurra, purse (f.), gen. after the demonstrative's preposition; 'the purse'
فَأخَذْتُهَا: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + أَخَذَ — akhadha, take (I) + تُ (-tu, I) + هَا (-hā, it, f.); 'and I took it'
بِأنَّ: بِـ (bi-, after ḥassa 'sense, feel': the verb takes بِـ for the thing perceived) + أَنَّ (anna, that); 'that'
جَيْبَهُ: جَيْب — jayb, pocket (m., acc. as subject of anna) + هُ (-hu, his); 'his pocket'
وَشَالَ: وَ (wa-, and) + شَالَ — shāla, lift, raise (colloquial; he); 'and he raised'
بِاللَّ: بِـ (bi-, with, by means of, prep.) + الـ + لَبُّوس — labbūs, club, cudgel; the print splits the word and this is its first part: 'with the labbūs'
بُّوسِ: بُّوس — the second part of the split word al-labbūs (see previous entry)
فَسَقَطْتُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + سَقَطَ — saqaṭa, fall (I) + تُ (-tu, I); 'and I fell'
الْأرْضِ: الـ + أَرْض — arḍ, earth, ground (f.), gen. after ilā; 'the ground'
فَأحَاطُوا: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + أَحَاطَ — aḥāṭa, surround, encircle (form IV; they, -ū); 'and they surrounded'
وَمَسَكُوا: وَ (wa-, and) + مَسَكَ — masaka, grip, seize (colloquial; they, -ū); 'and they gripped'
لِجَامَ: لِجَام — lijām, bridle (m.), in construct: 'the bridle of'
فَرَسِ: فَرَس — faras, horse, mare (m.), in construct; 'the horse of'
الْجُنْدِيِّ: الـ + جُنْدِي — jundī, soldier (m.), gen.; 'the soldier'
لِأجْلِ: لِـ (li-, for, because of, prep.) + أَجْل — ajl, sake, cause (m., in construct); 'for the sake of'
الزَّحْمَةِ: الـ + زَّحْمَة — zaḥma, crush, crowding (f.); 'the crowd, the jostling'
الضَّرْبَةَ: الـ + ضَّرْبَة — ḍarba, a blow, stroke (f., acc.); 'the blow'
مَلْعُونٌ: مَلْعُون — malʿūn, cursed, accursed (passive part. of laʿana; m.); 'accursed'
فَبَعْضُهُمْ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + بَعْض — baʿḍ, some, part (m., in construct) + هُمْ (-hum, them); 'some of them'
يُصَدِّقُ: يُصَدِّقُ — yuṣaddiqu, he believes, accepts as true (form II; he); 'believes'
وَبَعْضُهُمْ: وَ (wa-, and) + بَعْض — baʿḍ, some (m.) + هُمْ (-hum, them); 'and some of them'
يُكَذِّبُ: يُكَذِّبُ — yukadhdhibu, he calls a liar, disbelieves (form II; he); 'disbelieves'
جَذَبُونِي: جَذَبَ — jadhaba, pull, draw (they, -ū) + نِي (-nī, me); 'they pulled me'
وَأرَادُواخَلَاصِي: وَ (wa-, and) + أَرَادَ — arāda, want, wish (form IV; they, -ū) + خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, release (m., in construct) + ي (-ī, my); the print runs these together: 'and they wanted my deliverance'
لْأمْرِ: لْأَمْر — the rest of the split word: ال + أَمْر, amr, command, decree (m.); 'the command' (read with the previous entry: 'and by the command')
بِالْوَالِي: بِـ (bi-, here only marks what appears after wa-idhā 'and behold'; it adds no further meaning) + الـ + وَالِي — wālī, governor (m.); 'the governor'
وَالظَّلَمَةِ: وَ (wa-, and) + الـ + ظَّلَمَة — ẓalama, wrongdoers, oppressors (pl. of ẓālim); here the governor's bailiffs and officers; 'and the bailiffs'
خَوَنْدُ: خَوَنْد — khawand, lord, master (Persian-Turkish title of respect); vocative
كِيسٌ: كِيس — kīs, purse, bag (m.), nom. tanwīn: 'a purse'
فَأخَذَهُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + أَخَذَ — akhadha, take (he) + هُ (-hu, it); 'and he took it'
وَأنَا: وَ (wa-, and, circumstantial: 'while') + أَنَا — anā, I; 'and I [was]'
فِىَ: فِي (fī, in, prep.), spelled with final ى
الزِّحَامِ: الـ + زِّحَام — zihām/zaḥām, crush, crowd (m.); 'the crush'
لِلْجُنْدِيِّ: لِـ (li-, to, for, prep.; with qāla 'say to') + الـ + جُنْدِي — jundī, soldier (m.); 'to the soldier'
أحَدٌ: أَحَد — aḥad, anyone, one (m.), nom. tanwīn; 'anyone'
لَافَصَرَخَ: لَا (lā, no) + فَـ (fa-, and so) + صَرَخَ — ṣarakha, shout (he); the print writes these as one word: 'no; and he shouted'
الْمُقَدَّمِ: الـ + مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, chief, captain (m.), gen. after ʿalā; 'the captain'
فَمَسَكَنِي: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + مَسَكَ — masaka, grip, seize (colloquial; he) + نِي (-nī, me); 'and he seized me'
السِّتْرُ: الـ + سِّتْر — sitr, covering, veil, protection (m.); 'the covering'
عَرِّهِ: عَرِّ — ʿarri, strip, make bare (imperative of ʿarrā, form II) + هُ (-hu, him); 'strip him'
عَرَّوْنِي: عَرَّى — ʿarrā, strip (form II; they, -ū) + نِي (-nī, me); 'they stripped me'
أخَذَهُ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, take (he) + هُ (-hu, it); 'took it'
وَعَدَّهُ: وَ (wa-, and) + عَدَّ — ʿadda, count (he) + هُ (-hu, it); 'and counted it'
الْمُقَدَّمِينَ: الـ + مُقَدَّمِينَ — muqaddamīn, chiefs, captains (pl. of muqaddam; gen.); 'the captains'
فَقَدَّمُونِي: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + قَدَّمَ — qaddama, bring forward, present (form II; they, -ū) + نِي (-nī, me); 'and they brought me forward'
صَبِيُّ: صَبِيّ — ṣabī, boy, lad (m.); with yā, 'O boy'
قُلِ: قُلْ — qul, say (imperative of qāla), pointed with the kasra qul-i before al-
الْحَقَّ: الـ + حَقّ — ḥaqq, truth, right (m., acc.); 'the truth'
فَأطْرَقْتُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + أَطْرَقَ — aṭraqa, lower the head, bow (form IV; I, -tu); 'and I bowed'
بِرَأْسِي: بِـ (bi-, with, prep.; aṭraqa bi-raʾsihi 'lower with one's head') + رَأْس — raʾs, head (m.) + ي (-ī, my); 'with my head'
سَرَقْتُ: سَرَقْتُ — saraqtu, I stole (saraqa, steal; -tu, I)
أخْرَجْتُهُ: أَخْرَجَ — akhraja, bring out (form IV; I, -tu) + هُ (-hu, it); 'I brought it out'
وَإنْ: وَ (wa-, and) + إِنْ — in, if (conditional particle); 'and if'
سَرَقْتُهُ: سَرَقَ — saraqa, steal (I, -tu) + هُ (-hu, it); 'I stole it'
الْعَنَاءِ: الـ + عَنَاء — ʿanāʾ, hardship, toil, misery (m.); 'the hardship'
فَشَلْتُ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + شَالَ — shāla, lift, raise (colloquial; I, -tu); 'and I lifted'
أخَذْتُهُ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, take (I, -tu) + هُ (-hu, it); 'I took it'
بِالشُّهُودِ: بِـ (bi-, for; daʿā bi- 'call for, send for') + الـ + شُّهُود — shuhūd, witnesses (pl. of shāhid); 'for the witnesses'
وَشَهِدُوا: وَ (wa-, and) + شَهِدَ — shahida, testify, bear witness (they, -ū); 'and they bore witness'
مَنْطِقِي: مَنْطِق — manṭiq, speech, utterance (m.), + ي (-ī, my); 'my speech'
فَأمَرَ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + أَمَرَ — amara, command, order (he); 'and he ordered'
الْمَشَا: الـ + مَشَا — the first half of the split word al-mashāʿilī, 'the torch-bearer, executioner'
عِلِىَّ: عِلِيّ — the second half of the split word al-mashāʿilī (see previous entry), read accusative as object of amara
يَدِىَ: يَد — yad, hand (f.) + ي (-ī, my); 'my hand'
فَشَفَعَ: فَـ (fa-, and so/then) + شَفَعَ — shafaʿa, intercede (he); 'and he interceded'
وَبَقِيَتِ: وَ (wa-, and) + بَقِيَ — baqiya, remain (she, -at; the collective nās takes a feminine singular verb); 'and remained'
وَسَقَوْنِي: وَ (wa-, and) + سَقَى — saqā, give to drink (they, -ū) + نِي (-nī, me); 'and they gave me to drink'
وَأمَّا: وَ (wa-, and) + أَمَّا — ammā, as for (introduces a topic; its answer takes fa-); 'and as for'
الْجُنْدِىُّ: الـ + جُنْدِي — jundī, soldier (m.), spelled with final ى; 'the soldier'
فَإنَّهُ: فَـ (fa-, and so, answering ammā) + إِنَّ (inna, indeed) + هُ (-hu, he); 'then indeed he'
أعْطَانِي: أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, give (form IV; he) + نِي (-nī, me); 'he gave me'
لِصًّا: لِصّ — liṣṣ, thief (m.), acc. tanwīn after takūna: 'a thief'
إنِّي: إِنَّ (inna, indeed, that) + ي (-ī, me); 'indeed I'
أنْشَدْتُ: أَنْشَدَ — anshada, recite (poetry; form IV; I, -tu); 'I recited'
وَاللّٰهِ: و + اللّٰه — Allāh, God (gen.); wa-, by (oath particle, governs the genitive): 'by God'
مَاكُنْتُ: مَا + كُنْتُ — kāna, to be (1st sg. perfect) with mā, not (negation); two words run together: 'I was not'
اَخَاثِقَةِ: أَخَا + ثِقَةٍ — akh, brother (m., acc. in the vocative, 'brother-of') + thiqa, trust, confidence (f., gen. iḍāfa); two words run together: 'O man of trust'
سَارِقٌ: سَارِق — sāriq, thief, stealer (m., active participle of سَرَقَ, nom. sg. as predicate); 'a thief'
وَوَسْوَاسِي: و + وَسْوَاس + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + waswās, whisperings, misgivings, dark fears (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my fears'
وَافْلَاسِي: و + إِفْلَاس + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + iflās, penury, bankruptcy (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my penury' (printed without hamza)
وَلَكِنَّ: و + لَكِنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but indeed (conj. that takes an accusative noun); 'but'
الاِلَهَ: الـ + إِلَه — ilāh, god, deity (m., acc. after لَكِنَّ); 'the Deity' (printed with the article's alif unpointed)
سَهْمًا: سَهْم — sahm, arrow (m., acc. sg. with tanwīn, object of رَمَى); 'an arrow'
فَطَيَّرَ: فَ + طَيَّرَ — fa-, and so (conj. of result) + ṭayyara, to make fly, send flying (II, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and sent flying'
تَاجَ: تَاج — tāj, crown (m., acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the crown of'
فَتَرَكَنِي: فَ + تَرَكَ + نِي — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + taraka, to leave, let go (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (object); 'and so he left me'
أَعْطَانِي: أَعْطَى + نِي — aʿṭā, to give (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect, defective) + -nī, me (object); 'he gave me'
وَلَفَفْتُ: و + لَفَفْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + laffa, to wrap, bind (1st sg. perfect, -tu); 'and I wrapped'
خِرْقَةٍ: خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, piece of cloth (f., gen. after فِي, tanwīn); 'a rag'
وَأَدْخَلْتُهَا: و + أَدْخَلْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + adkhala, to put in, insert (IV, 1st sg. perfect, -tu) + -hā, it, her (f. object, the hand being f.); 'and I put it in'
عُبِّي: عُبّ + ي — ʿubb, bosom, the front fold of a garment (m., acc., object-of-place after أَدْخَلْتُهَا) + -ī, my; 'my bosom'
تَغَيَّرَتْ: تَغَيَّرَتْ — taghayyara, to change (V, 3rd f. sg. perfect, -at); 'it had changed'
وَاصْفَرَّلَوْنِي: و + اِصْفَرَّ + لَوْن + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + iṣfarra, to turn yellow, go pale (IX, 3rd m. sg. perfect) + lawn, colour, complexion (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; two words run together: 'and my colour turned sallow'
فَتَمَشَّيْتُ: فَ + تَمَشَّى — fa-, so (conj. of sequence) + tamashshā, to walk slowly, saunter (V, 1st sg. perfect, -tu); 'so I walked slowly'
اسْتِوَاءٍ: اِسْتِوَاء — istiwāʾ, evenness, level, composure (m., gen. in iḍāfa, tanwīn); 'evenness'
فَنَظَرَتْنِي: فَ + نَظَرَتْ + نِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + naẓara, to look at, see (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (direct object); 'and she looked at me'
اللَّوْنَ: الـ + لَوْن — lawn, colour, complexion (m., acc., specification); 'in colour'
وَجَعُكَ: وَجَع + كَ — wajaʿ, pain, ailment (m., nom., predicate) + -ka, your (m.); 'your pain'
حَالَتَكَ: حَالَة + كَ — ḥāla, state, condition (f., acc., object of أَرَى) + -ka, your (m.); 'your state'
يُوجِعُنِي: يُوجِعُ + نِي — awjaʿa, to cause pain (IV, 3rd m. sg. imperfect) + -nī, me (object); 'it pains me'
وَتَشَوَّشَتْ: و + تَشَوَّشَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tashawwasha, to be disturbed, troubled (V, 3rd f. sg. perfect, -at); 'and she was troubled'
لَاتُحْرِقْ: لَا + تُحْرِقْ — lā, do not (prohibition) + aḥraqa, to burn (IV, 2nd m. sg. jussive); two words run together: 'do not burn'
وَشُلْ: و + شُلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + shāla, to lift (2nd m. sg. imperative, colloquial); 'and lift'
رَأْسَكَ: رَأْس + كَ — raʾs, head (m., acc., object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your head'
وَحَدِّثْنِي: و + حَدِّثْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (II, 2nd m. sg. imperative) + -nī, me (object); 'and tell me'
قَدْتَمَّ: قَدْ + تَمَّ — qad, already (with the perfect, 'has') + tamma, to be completed, to befall (3rd m. sg. perfect); two words run together: 'has befallen'
بَانَ: بَانَ — bāna, to be clear, appear (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'it appeared' Also bāna, to go away, be parted (root b-y-n): bāna ahluhā, 'her people departed'; and, after ilā, the noun bān, the ben-tree, which the print points bāna where bāni is meant: ilā bāni al-Ḥijāzi, 'toward the ben-trees of the Ḥijāz'.
دَعِينِي: دَعِي + نِي — daʿa, to leave, let alone (2nd f. sg. imperative, -ī) + -nī, me (object); 'leave me'
كَأَنَّكَ: كَأَنَّ + كَ — ka-anna, as though, it seems that (conj., takes an accusative) + -ka, you (m.); 'as though you'
غَرَضُكَ: غَرَض + كَ — gharaḍ, aim, purpose, desire (m., nom., subject) + -ka, your (m.); 'your aim'
فَسَكَتُّ: فَ + سَكَتُّ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + sakata, to fall silent (1st sg. perfect, -tu, assimilated); 'and I fell silent'
تُحَدِّثُنِي: تُحَدِّثُ + نِي — ḥaddatha, to talk with, tell (II, 3rd f. sg. imperfect) + -nī, me (object); 'she talks to me'
أُجِيبُهَا: أُجِيبُ + هَا — ajāba, to answer (IV, 1st sg. imperfect) + -hā, her (object); 'I answer her'
فَقَدَّمَتْ: فَ + قَدَّمَتْ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + qaddama, to present, set before (II, 3rd f. sg. perfect, -at); 'and she set before'
فَامْتَنَعْتُ: فَ + اِمْتَنَعْتُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + imtanaʿa, to hold back, refrain (VIII, 1st sg. perfect, -tu); 'and I held back'
وَخَشِيتُ: و + خَشِيتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + khashiya, to fear (1st sg. perfect, -tu); 'and I feared'
آكُلُ: آكُلُ — akala, to eat (1st sg. imperfect, indicative; printed آكُلُ with madda; here after أَنْ in 'تَرَانِي آكُلُ', a circumstantial verb, 'eating'); 'I eat, eating'
لَاأَشْتَهِي: لَا + أَشْتَهِي — lā, not (negation) + ishtahā, to desire, wish (VIII, 1st sg. imperfect); two words run together: 'I do not desire'
آكُلَ: آكُلَ — akala, to eat (1st sg. imperfect, subjunctive after أَنْ; printed with madda); 'that I eat'
وَمَالَكَ: و + مَا + لَ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + mā, what (interrog.) + li-, to, for (prep., of possession) + -ka, you (m.); 'and what is it to you?', hence 'and why are you?'
وَمَكْسُورُالْخَاطِرِ: و + مَكْسُور + الـ + خَاطِر — wa-, and (conj.) + maksūr, broken (m., passive participle of كَسَرَ, nom.) + khāṭir, mind, spirit (m., gen. in iḍāfa); two words run together: 'and broken of mind'
وَالْقَلْبِ: و + الـ + قَلْب — wa-, and (conj.) + qalb, heart (m., gen. in coordination with الْخَاطِرِ); 'and of the heart'
أُحَدِّثُكِ: أُحَدِّثُ + كِ — ḥaddatha, to tell (II, 1st sg. imperfect, indicative) + -ki, you (f. object); 'I will tell you'
مَهَلِي: مَهَل + ي — mahal, leisure, slowness (m., gen. after عَلَى) + -ī, my; 'my leisure'
يُزِيلُ: يُزِيلُ — azāla, to remove, dispel (IV, 3rd m. sg. imperfect); 'it removes'
هَمَّكَ: هَمّ + كَ — hamm, care, anxiety (m., acc., object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your care'
بُدَّأَنْ: بُدَّ + أَنْ — budd, escape, avoidance (m.; lā budda, 'there is no escape from', acc. after لَا) + an, that (conj. with the subjunctive); two words run together: 'no escape from'
تَشْرَبَ: تَشْرَبَ — shariba, to drink (2nd m. sg. imperfect, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'you drink'
وَتُحَدِّثَنِي: و + تُحَدِّثَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaddatha, to tell (II, 2nd m. sg. imperfect, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -nī, me (object); 'and you tell me'
بِخَبَرِكَ: بِـ + خَبَر + كَ — bi-, of, about (prep.; with حَدَّثَ بِـ 'tell of') + khabar, news, account (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'of your news'
فَاسْقِينِي: فَ + اِسْقِي + نِي — fa-, then (conj. introducing the main clause after the condition) + saqā, to give to drink (2nd f. sg. imperative, -ī) + -nī, me (object); 'then give me to drink'
بِيَدِكِ: بِـ + يَد + كِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., of the instrument) + yad, hand (f., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your hand'
فَمَلَأَتِ: فَ + مَلَأَتِ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + malaʾa, to fill (3rd f. sg. perfect, -at, with the kasra before the article); 'and she filled'
وَمَلَأَتْهُ: و + مَلَأَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + malaʾa, to fill (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, it (object); 'and she filled it'
فَتَنَاوَلْتُهُ: فَ + تَنَاوَلْتُ + هُ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + tanāwala, to take, receive (VI, 1st sg. perfect, -tu) + -hu, it (object); 'and I took it'
وَفَرَّتِ: و + فَرَّتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + farra, to flee, run off, burst out (3rd f. sg. perfect, with the kasra before the article); 'and fled, sprang'
الدُّمُوعُ: الـ + دُمُوع — dumūʿ, tears (f. broken pl. of دَمْع, nom., subject); 'the tears'
فَأَنْشَدْتُ: فَ + أَنْشَدْتُ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + anshada, to recite (verse) (IV, 1st sg. perfect, -tu); 'and I recited'
أَقُ—ولُ: أَقُولُ — qāla, to say (1st sg. imperfect, indicative; the print breaks the word with a dash); 'I say, saying'
اَذَا: إِذَا — idhā, if, when (conj.); printed اَذَا — 'if'
ارَادَ: أَرَادَ — arāda, to wish, will (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he willed'
اَمْرًا: أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., acc. with tanwīn, object); 'a matter'
لِامْرِاً: لِـ + اِمْرِئ — li-, for (prep., of the person to whom something is willed) + imruʾ, man, person (m., gen.); 'for a man' (the print spells the ending with alif)
ذَاعَقْلٍ: ذَا + عَقْلٍ — dhū, possessor of (m., acc. as predicate of كَانَ) + ʿaql, mind, reason (m., gen. in iḍāfa); two words run together: 'possessing mind'
وَسَمْعٍ: و + سَمْع — wa-, and (conj.) + samʿ, hearing (m., gen., in coordination); 'and hearing'
وَبَصَرْ: و + بَصَر — wa-, and (conj.) + baṣar, sight (m., gen., in coordination; pausal form); 'and sight'
اَصَمَّ: أَصَمَّ — aṣamma, to make deaf (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'He made deaf'
اُذْنَاهُ: أُذْن + اهُ — udhn, ear (f., dual, printed nom. -ā where the syntax wants the acc. -ayn) + -hu, his; 'his ears'
وَاَعْمَى: و + أَعْمَى — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿmā, to make blind (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect, defective); 'and made blind'
وَسَلَّ: و + سَلَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + salla, to draw out, pull out (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and drew out'
الشَّعَرْ: الـ + شَعَر — shaʿar, hair (m., gen. in iḍāfa; pausal form); 'the hair'
انْفَلَّ: اِنْفَلَّ — infalla, to be notched, broken (VII, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'was broken off'; perhaps a misprint for اِنْفَذَّ 'was carried out'
حُكْمُهُ: حُكْم + هُ — ḥukm, decree, judgement (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his decree'
لِيَعْتَبِرْ: لِـ + يَعْتَبِرْ — li-, so that, in order that (conj. of purpose, with the jussive) + iʿtabara, to take warning, learn a lesson (VIII, 3rd m. sg. imperfect, jussive); 'so that he may take heed'
تَنَاوَلْتُ: تَنَاوَلَ + تُ — tanāwala, to take hold of, take (perfect, 1st sg.); 'I took'
وَصَرَخْتُ: وَ + صَرَخَ + تُ — wa-, and + ṣarakha, to cry out, shriek (perfect, 1st sg.); 'and I cried out'
صَرْخَةٌ: ṣarkha, a cry, a shriek (f., one instance of ṣurākh); 'a cry'
بُكَاءِكَ: بُكَاء + كَ — bukāʾ, weeping (m.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your weeping' (the ء is printed as a letter and takes the genitive vowel)
أَحْرَقْتَ: أَحْرَقَ + تَ — aḥraqa, to burn (form IV, perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'you have burned'
تَنَاوَلْتَ: تَنَاوَلَ + تَ — tanāwala, to take hold of (perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'you took' (that you should take)
أَخْرِجْهَا: أَخْرِجْ + هَا — akhrij, bring out (imperative, form IV of kharaja, 2nd m. sg.) + -hā, it (f., referring to the ḥabba); 'bring it out'
أَفْقَعْهَا: أَفْقَعْ + هَا — afqaʿ, I burst/lance (1st sg. jussive, after an imperative: 'that I may…') + -hā, it; 'let me burst it'
فَقْعِهَا: فَقْع + هَا — faqʿ, bursting, lancing (verbal noun, m., gen. in iḍāfa) + -hā, its; 'its bursting'
تُطِيلِي: تُطِيلُ + ي — tuṭīlī, you (f. sg.) lengthen (form IV of ṭāla, jussive 2nd f. sg., after lā: prohibition); 'do not prolong'
أُخْرِجُ: أَخْرَجَ → أُخْرِجُ — ukhriju, I bring out (form IV of kharaja, imperfect 1st sg.); 'I bring out'
شَرِبْتُ: شَرِبَ + تُ — shariba, to drink (perfect, 1st sg.); 'I drank'
تَسْقِينِي: تَسْقِي + نِي — tasqī, she gives to drink (imperfect 3rd f. sg. of saqā) + -nī, me; 'giving me to drink' (the verb after lam tazal, 'kept on pouring for me')
فَأَبْصَرَتْ: فَـ + أَبْصَرَ + تْ — fa-, and so + abṣara, to see, catch sight of (form IV, perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she saw'
يَدِيَ: يَد + ي — yad, hand (f.) + -ī, my; 'my hand', acc. object of abṣarat
بِلَاكَفٍّ: بِـ + لَا + كَفّ — bi-, with (prep.) + lā, no/without (here forming 'without') + kaff, palm, hand (f.), gen.; 'without a hand' (printed as one word: 'hand-less')
فَفَتَّشَتْنِي: فَـ + فَتَّشَ + تْ + نِي — fa-, and so + fattasha, to search thoroughly (form II, perfect 3rd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and she searched me'
تَتَأَ: تَتَأَ(لَّمُ) — first part of tataʾallamu, she suffers (form V of alima, imperfect 3rd f. sg.), cut by a space in the print; see next
لَّمُ: (تَتَأ)لَّمُ — second part of tataʾallamu, she suffers pain; with the preceding 'tatā': 'she suffers, she is in pain'
هَيَّأَتْ: هَيَّأَ + تْ — hayyaʾa, to prepare, make ready (form II, perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she had prepared'
مَسْلُوقَةً: مَسْلُوقَة — maslūqa, boiled (f. passive participle of salaqa), acc. as object, here a noun; 'a boiled (dish)'
وَقَدَّمَتْهَا: وَ + قَدَّمَ + تْ + هَا — wa-, and + qaddama, to present, set before (form II, perfect 3rd f. sg.) + -hā, it; 'and she set it before (me)'
أَطْيَارٍ: aṭyār, birds (plural of ṭayr, gen. pl. after a number 3–10, indefinite); 'birds'
دَجَاجٍ: dajāj, chickens, fowls (collective, m.), gen. in apposition to aṭyār; 'chickens'
رَائِعٌ: rāʾiʿ, startled, alarmed (active participle of rāʿa, nom. indef.); as printed; possibly a misprint for rāʾiḥ, 'going off'; 'in alarm' / 'going'
أَذْهَبُ: ذَهَبَ → أَذْهَبُ — adhhabu, I go (imperfect 1st sg.); 'I go'
تَرُحْ: رَاحَ → تَرُحْ — taruḥ, you go off (jussive 2nd m. sg. of rāḥa, after lā); 'do not go'
وَبَلَغَتْ: وَ + بَلَغَ + تْ — wa-, and + balagha, to reach (perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and (it) reached'
مَحَبَّتُكَ: مَحَبَّة + كَ — maḥabba, love (f.) + -ka, your; 'your love'
صَرَفْتَ: صَرَفَ + تَ — ṣarafa, to spend, expend (perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'you spent'
وَعَدِمْتَ: وَ + عَدِمَ + تَ — wa-, and + ʿadima, to lose, be bereft of (perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'and you lost'
كَفَّكَ: كَفّ + كَ — kaff, palm, hand (f.) + -ka, your; 'your hand'
أُشْهِدُكَ: أُشْهِدُ + كَ — ushhidu, I call to witness (form IV of shahida, imperfect 1st sg.) + -ka, you; 'I make you witness'
وَسَتَرَى: وَ + سَ + تَرَى — wa-, and + sa-, will (future prefix) + tarā, you see (imperfect 2nd m. sg. of raʾā); 'and you will see'
قَوْلِي: قَوْل + ي — qawl, saying, word (m.) + -ī, my; 'my word'
وَأَرْسَلَتْ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ + تْ — wa-, and + arsala, to send (form IV, perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she sent'
الشُّهُودِ: الـ + شُهُود — al-, the + shuhūd, witnesses (plural of shāhid), gen. after khalf; 'the witnesses'
اكْتُبُو: كَتَبَ → اكْتُبُو — uktubū, write (imperative, 2nd m. pl.); the final alif of -ū is not printed here (it has slipped onto the next word); 'write'
اكِتَابِي: (ا) + كِتَاب + ي — kitāb, document, contract (m.) + -ī, my, printed with a stray alif in front (displaced from the end of the preceding verb); 'my contract'
وَاشْهَدُوا: وَ + اشْهَدُ + وا — wa-, and + ishhadū, bear witness (imperative, 2nd m. pl. of shahida); 'and bear witness'
قَبَضْتُ: قَبَضَ + تُ — qabaḍa, to take, receive (perfect, 1st sg.); 'I received'
الْمَهْرَ: الـ + مَهْر — al-, the + mahr, dower, bride-price (m.), acc. object; 'the dower'
فَكَتَبُوا: فَـ + كَتَبَ + وا — fa-, and so + kataba, to write (perfect 3rd m. pl.); 'and they wrote'
غَلَيْهَا: عَلَى + هَا — ʿalā, upon/with (prep.) + -hā, her, printed غليها, a misprint of ʿalayhā; 'with her'
اشْهَدُوا: ishhadū, bear witness (imperative 2nd m. pl.); 'bear witness'
وَالْجَوَارِ: وَ + الـ + جَوَار — wa-, and + al-, the + jawār, slave-girls (printed without the final yāʾ for al-jawārī, plural of jāriya), gen. after min; 'and the slave girls'
فَشَهِدُوا: فَـ + شَهِدَ + وا — fa-, and so + shahida, to witness, testify (perfect 3rd m. pl.); 'and they testified'
وَقَبِلْتُ: وَ + قَبِلَ + تُ — wa-, and + qabila, to accept (perfect, 1st sg.); 'and I accepted'
التَّمْلِيكَ: الـ + تَمْلِيك — al-, the + tamlīk, conveying of ownership, making over (m. verbal noun of form II), acc. object; 'the transfer of ownership'
وَأَخَذَتْنِي: و + أَخَذَ + تْ + نِي — akhadha, take (perf. 3 f. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); -nī, me (obj.); 'and she took me'
وَأَوْقَفَتْنِي: و + أَوْقَفَ + تْ + نِي — awqafa, make stand, stop (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); wa-, and; -nī, me; 'and she stood me'
صُنْدُوقًا: صُنْدُوق — ṣundūq, chest, box (m.); indef. acc., object; 'a chest'
مَلْأَنُ: مَلْأَن — malʾān (the print's spelling of مَلْآن), full (adj.); nom. predicate; 'full'
مِنَا: مَنَا — manā, first half of the word مَنَادِيل split by the print (see دِيلَ); 'handkerchiefs' when joined with دِيلَ; the printed مِنَا reads 'manā'
دِيلَ: دِيل — dīl, second half of مَنَادِيل, mandīl, handkerchief, cloth (m. pl. manādīl); gen. (diptote) after the idea of 'full of'; 'handkerchiefs'
مَالُكَ: مَال + كَ — māl, wealth, money (m.), nom. predicate; -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your wealth'
أَخَذْتُهُ: أَخَذَ + تُ + هُ — akhadha, take (perf. 1 sg.); -hu, it (obj.); 'I took it'
فَكُلَّمَا: ف + كُلَّمَا — fa-, and so (conj.); kullamā, every time that, whenever (conj.); 'and every time'
أَعْطَيْتَنِي: أَعْطَى + تَ + نِي — aʿṭā, give (IV, perf. 2 m. sg.); -nī, me (obj.); 'you gave me'
أُولِّفُهُ: أُؤَلِّفُ + هُ — ʾallafa, put together, bundle, join (II; the print writes the hamza as أو), pres. 1 sg.; -hu, it; 'I bundled it, I would bundle it' (habitual present)
وَأَرْمِيهِ: و + أَرْمِي + هِ — ramā, throw (pres. 1 sg.); wa-, and; -hi, it; 'and I would throw it'
عَزِيرٌ: عَزِير — the print's spelling of ʿazīz (ز misprinted ر), dear, precious, honoured (adj.); nom. predicate; 'dear'
الْقَضَاءُ: الـ + قَضَاء — al-, the; qaḍāʾ, decree, fate (m.); nom., subject; 'the decree, fate'
عَدِمْتَ: عَدِمَ + تَ — ʿadima, lose, be deprived of (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you lost'
يَمِينَكَ: يَمِين + كَ — yamīn, right hand (f.); acc., object; -ka, your; 'your right hand'
أَقْدِرُا: أَقْدِرُ — aqdiru, I am able (qadara, be able, pres. 1 sg.), the print adds a stray final alif that belongs to the next verb (أُكَافِئَكَ); 'I am able'
كَافِئَكَ: كَافِئ + كَ — kāfiʾ, the print's spelling of ukāfiʾ, repay, requite (III, pres. 1 sg.), whose initial alif is the stray alif on the preceding word; -ka, you (obj.); '(that) I repay you'
بَذَلْتُ: بَذَلَ + تُ — badhala, spend, give up, lavish (perf. 1 sg.); 'I spent, I gave up'
الْفَضْلُ: الـ + فَضْل — al-, the; faḍl, favour, grace, merit (m.); nom., subject; 'the favour'
صُنْدُوقَهَا: صُنْدُوق + هَا — ṣundūq, chest (m.), acc., object; -hā, her; 'her chest'
صُنْدُوقِي: صُنْدُوق + ِي — ṣundūq, chest (m.), gen. after إِلَى; -ī, my; 'my chest'
مَالِهَا: مَال + هَا — māl, wealth (m.), gen. after إِلَى; -hā, her; 'her wealth'
أَعْطَيْتُهُ: أَعْطَى + تُ + هُ — aʿṭā, give (IV, perf. 1 sg.); -hu, it (obj.); 'I gave it' Also with -hu of a person, 'I gave him': man kāna lahu ʿindī shayʾun aʿṭaytuhu ʿiwaḍan, 'whoever had anything with me, I gave him its worth'.
قَبَّلْتُهَا: قَبَّلَ + تُ + هَا — qabbala, kiss (II, perf. 1 sg.); -hā, her (obj.); 'I kissed her'
وَشَكَرْتُ: و + شَكَرَ + تُ — shakara, thank (perf. 1 sg.); wa-, and; 'and I thanked'
بَذَلْتَ: بَذَلَ + تَ — badhala, spend, give up (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you gave up'
مُكَافَأَتِكَ: مُكَافَأَة + كَ — mukāfaʾa, repayment, requital (f., verbal noun of III kāfaʾa); gen. after عَلَى ('able to ...'); -ka, your; 'your repayment, to repay you'
لَوْبَذَلْتُ: لَوْ + بَذَلْتُ — law, if (contrary-to-fact); badhala, spend (perf. 1 sg.); the print runs the two words together; 'if I gave up'
مَحَبَّتِكَ: مَحَبَّة + كَ — maḥabba, love (f.), gen. after فِي; -ka, your; 'love of you'; here: -ka is the lover, fī maḥabbatika, 'in your loving'
بِوَاجِبِ: بِـ + وَاجِب — bi-, with (prep.), required by the verb قَامَ بِـ 'discharge'; wājib, due, duty, what is owed (m.); 'the due of'
حَقِّكَ: حَقّ + كَ — ḥaqq, right, claim (m.), gen. in construct; -ka, your; 'your right, your claim'
كَتَبَتْ: كَتَبَ + تْ — kataba, write, and with لِـ 'make over in writing, convey by deed' (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she wrote over' Also simply 'she wrote': katabat lahu waraqatan, 'she wrote him a letter' (li- of the person written to).
تَمْلِكُ: مَلَكَ — malaka, own, possess (pres. 3 f. sg.); 'she owns'
ثِيَابِ: ثِيَاب — thiyāb, clothes, garments (pl. of thawb); gen. after مِنْ, in construct; 'clothes of'
بَدَنِهَا: بَدَن + هَا — badan, body (m.), gen. in construct; -hā, her; 'her body'
وَصِيغَتِهَا: و + صِيغَة + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); ṣīgha, jewellery, gold-work (f.); -hā, her; 'and her jewellery'
وَأَسْبَا: و + أَسْبَاب — wa-, and (conj.); first half of أَسْبَابِهَا asbābihā, effects, belongings (pl. of sabab), split in the print (see بِهَا); 'and her effects' when joined with بِهَا
مَهْمُومَةً: مَهْمُوم + ة — mahmūm, worried, grieved (pass. part. of hamma, to worry); -a, f.; acc. as a state; 'worried'
أَقَلَّ: أَقَلّ — aqall, less, fewer (comparative of qalīl); acc. as an adverb of time; 'less (than)'
وَقَوِيَ: و + قَوِيَ — qawiya, become strong, prevail (perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and grew strong'
الْمَرَضُ: الـ + مَرَض — al-, the; maraḍ, sickness, illness (m.); nom., subject; 'the sickness'
مَكَثَتْ: مَكَثَ + تْ — makatha, stay, remain (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she stayed'
فَجَهَّزْتُهَا: ف + جَهَّزَ + تُ + هَا — fa-, so (conj.); jahhaza, prepare, equip (II, perf. 1 sg.); -hā, her; 'so I prepared her (for burial)'
وَوَارَيْتُهَا: و + وَارَى + تُ + هَا — wārā, cover, bury (III, perf. 1 sg.); wa-, and; -hā, her; 'and I buried her'
خَتْمَاتٍ: خَتْمَة — khatma, a complete recitation of the Qurʾan (f., pl. -āt); indef. acc.; 'completed recitations'
وَتَصَدَّقْتُ: و + تَصَدَّقَ + تُ — taṣaddaqa, give alms (V, perf. 1 sg.); wa-, and; 'and I gave alms'
جَزِيلًا: جَزِيل — jazīl, abundant, great (adj.); indef. acc.; 'abundant'
وَأَمْلَاكًا: و + أَمْلَاك — wa-, and (conj.); amlāk, estates, possessions (pl. of milk); indef. acc.; 'and estates'
وَعَقَارَاتٍ: و + عَقَارَات — wa-, and (conj.); ʿaqārāt, real estate, landed properties (pl. of ʿaqār); indef. acc.; 'and landed properties'
الْمَخَازِنِ: الـ + مَخَازِن — al-, the; makhāzin, storehouses (pl. of makhzan); gen.; 'the storehouses'
مَخْزَنُ: مَخْزَن — makhzan, storehouse, warehouse (m.); nom., in construct; 'the storehouse of'
السِّمْسِمِ: الـ + سِمْسِم — al-, the; simsim, sesame (m.); gen. in construct; 'the sesame'
بِعْتُ: بَاعَ + تُ — bāʿa, sell (perf. 1 sg.); 'I sold'
اشْتِغَالِي: اشْتِغَال + ِي — ishtighāl, being busy, occupation (m., verbal noun of VIII); -ī, my; 'my being busy'
الْمُدَّةَ: الـ + مُدَّة — al-, the; mudda, period, span of time (f.); acc. of time; 'the period'
الْحَوَاصِلِ: الـ + حَوَاصِل — al-, the; ḥawāṣil, stored goods, produce (pl. of ḥāṣil); gen.; 'the stock'
أَفْرُغْ: فَرَغَ — faragha, finish, be done (jussive 1 sg.); 'I have not finished'
قَبْضِ: قَبْض — qabḍ, receiving, collecting (m., verbal noun); gen. after مِنْ, in construct; 'receiving'
وَإِنَّكَ: و + إِنَّ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.); inna, indeed, that (particle); -ka, you (attached subject); 'and (see that) you'; the print may intend وَأَنْ
تُخَالِفُنِي: خَالَفَ + نِي — khālafa, oppose, contradict (III, pres. 2 m. sg.); -nī, me (obj.); 'you oppose me'
زَادَكَ: زَاد + كَ — zād, provisions for a journey (m.); acc., object; -ka, your; 'your provisions'
وَهَبْتُكَ: وَهَبَ + تُ + كَ — wahaba, give, bestow (perf. 1 sg.); -ka, you (indirect obj.); 'I have given you'
قَطْعِ: قَطْع — qaṭʿ, cutting (m., verbal noun); gen., in construct; 'the cutting of'
وَأَكْلِي: و + أَكْل + ِي — wa-, and (conj.); akl, eating (m., verbal noun); -ī, my; 'and my eating'
وَتَفَضَّلْتَ: و + تَفَضَّلَ + تَ — tafaḍḍala, show favour, be gracious (V, perf. 2 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and shown favour'
اشْتَرَيْتُ: اشْتَرَى + تُ — ishtarā, buy (VIII, perf. 1 sg.); 'I bought'
وَإِسْكَنْدَرَانِيًّا: و + إِسْكَنْدَرَانِيّ — wa-, and (conj.); iskandarānī, of Alexandria, Alexandrian (adj.); indef. acc.; 'and Alexandrian'
تُصَاحِبَنِي: صَاحَبَ + نِي — ṣāḥaba, accompany, keep company with (III, subj. 2 m. sg.); -nī, me (obj.); 'you accompany me'
وَأَوْعَدْتُهُ: و + أَوْعَدَ + تُ + هُ — awʿada, make an appointment with (IV, Middle Arabic for wāʿada, III), perf. 1 sg.; wa-, and; -hu, him; 'and I made an appointment with him'
بِلَادُكُمْ: بِلَاد + كُمْ — bilād, country (m.); nom., predicate; -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your country'
فَبَاعَ: ف + بَاعَ — fa-, and so (conj.); bāʿa, sell (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he sold'
مَتْجَرَهُ: مَتْجَر + هُ — matjar, merchandise (m.); acc., object; -hu, his; 'his merchandise'
عِوَضَهُ: عِوَض + هُ — ʿiwaḍ, exchange, substitute (m.); acc., 'in exchange'; -hu, it; 'in exchange for it'
بِلَادِكُمْ: بِلَاد + كُمْ — bilād, country, land (f. pl.); gen. (after a preposition); -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your country'
قِسْمِي: قِسْم + ِي — qism, portion, lot, fate (m.); nom., subject of كَانَ; -ī, my; 'my lot'
قُعَادِي: قُعَاد + ِي — quʿād, sitting, staying (m., Middle Arabic verbal noun, Classical quʿūd); gen. after فِي; -ī, my; 'my staying'
يَامَلِكَ: يَا + مَلِك — yā, O (vocative particle); malik, king (m.); acc. in vocative construct; the print runs the words together; 'O king of'
شَنْقِكُمْ: شَنْق + كُمْ — shanq, hanging (m., verbal noun), gen. after مِنْ; -kum, you (m. pl., obj.); 'hanging you'
كُلِّكُمْ: كُلّ + كُمْ — kull, all, every (m.); gen., apposition to the -kum of the preceding word; -kum, you (m. pl.); 'all of you'
الْمُبَ—ا—حِ: الـ + مُبَاح — al-, the; mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (pass. part. of IV abāḥa); the print puts a dash on each side of the alif; 'the permitted'
اتِ: fragment of al-abyāt, 'the verses' (-āt, fem. pl. ending, gen.; the print breaks the word with dashes); '-ses'
الْمُبَ: الـ + مُبَاح — fragment of al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted' (the print breaks the word with dashes: المب—ا—ح, the stock close of a night); 'the per-'
حِ: fragment of al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted' (-ḥ, the last letter of the word broken by the print's dashes); '-mitted'
الْأَبْ: الـ + أَبْيَات — fragment of al-abyāt, 'the verses' (the print breaks the word with dashes: الاب—ي—ات); 'the ve-'
أَقُ: fragment of aqūlu, 'I say' (verb, impf. 1st sg. of qāla; the print breaks it with dashes: اق—ول); 'I sa-'
أيُّهَا: ayyuhā, O (vocative particle with a definite noun), 'O'
أذِنْتَ: adhinta, you gave permission (adhina li-, to permit; perf. 2nd m. sg.)
أجِدَ: ajida, I find (wajada, to find; imperf. 1st sg. subjunctive)
أعْجَبَ: aʿjab, more wondrous (elative of ʿajīb, wondrous)
أرْوَاحَنَا: أَرْوَاح + نَا — arwāḥ, spirits, souls (pl. of rūḥ); -nā, our; 'our lives'
أعْلَمْ: iʿlam, know! (ʿalima, to know; imperative m. sg.)
أنِّي: أَنَّ + ي — anna, that + -ī, me; 'that I'
عَمِلُوا: ʿamilū, they made, did (ʿamila, to do, make; perf. 3rd m. pl.)
خَتْمَةً: khatma, a completion; a gathering at which a recitation of the Qurʾān is completed (f.)
وَجَمَعُوا: و + جَمَعُوا — wa-, and + jamaʿū, they gathered (jamaʿa, to gather; perf. 3rd m. pl.)
أفُقَهَاءَ: fuqahāʾ, jurists (pl. of faqīh); printed with a stray initial alif, probably a slip for al-fuqahāʾ
الْمُقْرِئُونَ: الـ + مُقْرِئُون — muqriʾ, reciter of the Qurʾān (m.); pl. -ūn, 'the reciters'
وَفَرَغُوا: و + فَرَغُوا — wa-, and + faraghū, they finished (faragha, to finish; perf. 3rd m. pl.)
مُدَّ: mudda, it was stretched out (madda, to stretch; passive perf. 3rd m. sg.)
قَدَّمُوا: qaddamū, they presented, set out (II form of qadama; perf. 3rd m. pl.)
زِيرْبَاجَةً: zīrbāja, a dish of meat in a sweet-and-sour sauce (f.)
فَتَقَدَّمْنَا: فَـ + تَقَدَّمْنَا — fa-, so (conj., sequence) + taqaddamnā, we came forward (V form of qadama; perf. 1st pl.)
نَأكُلُ: naʾkulu, we eat (akala, to eat; imperf. 1st pl.); 'to eat', following taqaddamnā without a linking particle
الزِّيرْ: الـ + زِّيرْ — zīr, first part of zīrbāja (printed as two words)
بَاجَةِ: bāja, second part of zīrbāja; genitive after min
فَتَأخَّرَ: فَـ + تَأَخَّرَ — fa-, but, so (conj.) + taʾakhkhara, he held back (V form of akhkhara; perf. 3rd m. sg.)
وَاحِدٌمِنَّا: وَاحِد + مِنْ + نَا — wāḥid, one (m.) + min, from, of (prep.) + -nā, us; 'one of us' (printed as a single word)
وَامْتَنَعَ: و + امْتَنَعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + imtanaʿa, he refrained (VIII form of manaʿa; perf. 3rd m. sg.)
الْأكْلِ: الـ + أَكْل — akl, eating (verbal noun of akala); 'the eating'
فَحَلَفْنَا: فَـ + حَلَفْنَا — fa-, so (conj., sequence) + ḥalafnā, we swore (ḥalafa, to swear; perf. 1st pl.)
فَأقْسَمَ: فَـ + أَقْسَمَ — fa-, and (conj., sequence) + aqsama, he swore (IV form of qasama; perf. 3rd m. sg.)
لَايَأكُلَ: لَا + يَأْكُلَ — lā, not (negative particle) + yaʾkula, he eats (akala; imperf. 3rd m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'that he would not eat' (printed as one word)
فَألْزَمْنَاهُ: فَـ + أَلْزَمْنَا + هُ — fa-, so (conj., sequence) + alzamnā, we pressed (IV form of lazima; perf. 1st pl.) + -hu, him; 'so we pressed him'
تَغْصِبُونِي: taghṣibū + nī — taghṣibū, you (pl.) force (ghaṣaba, to seize by force; jussive 2nd m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'do not force me'
فَكَفَانِي: فَـ + كَفَى + نِي — fa-, for, so (conj., giving the reason) + kafā, it sufficed (perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'it suffices me'
أكْلِهَا: أَكْل + هَا — akl, eating (verbal noun of akala); -hā, her, it (f.); 'her eating', i.e. 'eating it'
أنْشَدَ: anshada, he recited (IV form of nashada; perf. 3rd m. sg.), of verse
مِلْيحًا: milyḥan, printed with this odd pointing; read as malīḥ, handsome, fair, or salted (accusative object)
كَتِفِكَ: كَتِف + كَ — katif, shoulder (f.); -ka, your (m.); 'your shoulder'
وَارْتَحِلْ: و + ارْتَحِلْ — wa-, and (conj.) + irtaḥil, depart! (VIII form of raḥala; imperative m. sg.)
يَطِبْ: yaṭib, it is pleasant (ṭāba, to be good, pleasant; jussive 3rd m. sg. after in); also jussive after lam: 'was not pleasant'
اكْتَحِلْ: iktaḥil, apply kohl! (VIII form of kaḥala; imperative m. sg.)
قُلْنَا: qāla, to say (1 pl. perf.); 'we said'
امْتِنَاعِكَ: امْتِنَاع + كَ — imtināʿ, refraining, abstaining (v.n. VIII, root m-n-ʿ), gen. in construct + -ka, your (m.s.); 'your refraining'
بَاجَهْ: bāja, second half of zīr-bāja, a meat stew; printed here with final ه, gen. after min; '-bāja'
وَلَابُدَّأَنْ: وَ + لَا بُدَّ + أَنْ — wa-, and (here continues the conditional) + lā budda, there is no escape (lā + budd 'a way out'), 'it is unavoidable' + an, that (particle taking the subjunctive); 'and it is unavoidable that'. Printed as one word
الْآنَ: الـ + آنَ — al-, the + ān, moment, time; 'the-now', al-ān 'now' (acc. adverbial)
أَغْسِلُ: ghasala, to wash (1 s. imperf. indic.); 'I wash'
بِالصَّابُونِ: بِـ + الـ + صَابُون — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + ṣābūn, soap (m.); 'with the soap'
بِالْأُشْنَانِ: بِـ + الـ + أُشْنَان — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + ushnān, potash, saltwort ash (a cleansing agent); 'with the potash'
بِالسُّعْدِ: بِـ + الـ + سُعْد — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + suʿd, cyperus, sedge root (a sweet-smelling plant used in washing); 'with the cyperus'
جُمْلَتُهُمْ: جُمْلَة + هُمْ — jumla, sum, total (f.), nom. + -hum, their (m.pl.); 'their total'
الدَّعْوَةِ: الـ + دَعْوَة — al-, the + daʿwa, invitation, banquet (f.); gen. in construct; ṣāḥib al-daʿwa 'owner of the invitation', the host
طَلَبَهُ: ṭalaba, to ask for, request (3 m.s. perf.) + -hu, it (the thing asked for); 'he asked for it'
مُتَكَرِّهٌ: mutakarrih, reluctant, unwilling, constraining himself (act. part. V, root k-r-h), nom. indef. predicate; 'reluctant'
وَمَدَّيَدَةُ: وَ + مَدَّ + يَدَهُ — wa-, and + madda, to stretch out (3 m.s. perf.) + yad, hand (f., object) + -hu, his (spelled ة); 'and he stretched out his hand'. Printed as one word
الْخَائِفِ: الـ + خَائِف — al-, the + khāʾif, afraid, fearful (act. part. of khāfa); gen. in construct; 'the fearful one'
وَغَمَسَ: وَ + غَمَسَ — wa-, and + ghamasa, to dip, plunge (3 m.s. perf.); 'and he dipped'
يَدَةُ: yad, hand (f.); acc. object + -hu, his (the edition spells the pronoun with ة); yadahu 'his hand'
يَأْكُلُ: yaʾkulu, to eat (3 m.s. imperf. indic., from akala); 'he eats'
مُتَغَصِّبٌ: mutaghaṣṣib, forcing himself, or choking (act. part. V); obscure: either from ghaṣaba 'to take by force' (compelling himself) or a slip for mutaghaṣṣiṣ 'choking'; nom. indef. predicate
نَتَعَجَّبُ: nataʿajjabu, to marvel (V; 1 pl. imperf. indic., root ʿ-j-b); 'we marvel'
وَيَدُةُ: وَ + يَدُهُ — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'while') + yad, hand (f.), nom. + -hu, his (spelled ة); 'and his hand'
تَرْتَعِدُ: tartaʿidu, to tremble, shake (VIII; 3 f.s. imperf. indic., agrees with yad f.); 'it trembles' Also of a person: wa-hiya tartaʿidu, 'trembling' (she).
فَنَصَبَ: فَـ + نَصَبَ — fa-, and/so + naṣaba, to set up, raise (3 m.s. perf.); 'and he raised'
إِبْهَامَ: ibhām, thumb, also big toe (m.); acc. object, first term of a construct: 'the thumb of …'
يَدِةِ: yad, hand (f.), gen. in construct + -hi, his (spelled ة); 'of his hand'
مَقْطُوعٌ: maqṭūʿ, cut off (pass. part. of qaṭaʿa); nom. indef. predicate; 'cut off'
أَصَابِعَ: aṣābiʿ, fingers (broken pl. of iṣbaʿ); gen., diptote; 'fingers'
مَالِإِبْهَا: مَا + لِـ + إِبْهَا(مِكَ) — mā, what + li-, to, for (prep.: mā li-X 'what is (wrong) with X?') + ibhā-, the first part of ibhāmika 'your thumb'; the print splits the word and mā li-ibhā-mika reads 'what (is) with your thumb?'
مِكَ: -mi-ka — the remainder of ibhāmika: the final m of ibhām (gen. after li-) + -ka, your (m.s.); printed detached; 'your' (thumb)
هٰكَذَا: هَا + كَـ + ذَا — hā, lo + ka-, like (prep.) + dhā, this; hākadhā 'thus, like this'
خِلْقَةُ: khilqa, natural make, creation, constitution (f.); nom., first term of a construct: 'the creation of …'
أَصَابَهُ: aṣāba, to befall, strike (IV; 3 m.s. perf.) + -hu, him/it; here mimmā aṣābahu, 'at what had befallen him'; elsewhere 'it befell it' (the thumb)
حَادِثٌ: ḥādith, accident, event (m.; act. part. of ḥadatha used as noun); nom. indef., subject; 'an accident'
إِخْوَانِي: إِخْوَان + ي — ikhwān, brothers (pl. of akh) + -ī, my; 'my brothers' (vocative)
الْإِبْهَامُ: الـ + إِبْهَام — al-, the + ibhām, thumb (m.); nom.; 'the thumb'
إِبْهَامِي: إِبْهَام + ي — ibhām, thumb (m.) + -ī, my; 'my thumb'
وَرِجْلَايَ: وَ + رِجْلَا + يَ — wa-, and + rijl, foot (f.), dual nom. -ā + -ya, my; 'and my two feet'
تَرَ: tara, to see, here the first part of tarawā, 'you (pl.) see' (jussive/subjunctive of raʾā, 2 m.pl.); the print splits tarawā from thumma; also: tara, 'she sees', jussive 3fs of raʾā after lam: fa-lam tara, 'and she did not see' (Night 192)
وْاثُمَّ: -wā + thumma — the -wā of tarawā, 2 m.pl. ending, then thumma, then (conj.); the print has the alif displaced; 'you see, then'
فَوَجَدْنَاهُ: فَـ + وَجَدْنَا + هُ — fa-, and/so + wajada, to find (1 pl. perf.) + -hu, it; 'and we found it'
وَكَذٰلِكَ: وَ + كَـ + ذٰلِكَ — wa-, and + ka-, like (prep.) + dhālika, that; wa-kadhālika 'and likewise'
رِجْلَاهُ: رِجْلَا + هُ — rijl, foot (f.), dual nom. -ā + -hu, his; 'his two feet'; here: 'his two legs'
إِبْهَامَيْنِ: ibhām, thumb/big toe; ibhāmayn dual oblique, gen. after bi-lā; 'two thumbs, two big toes'
رَأَيْنَاهُ: raʾā, to see (1 pl. perf.; the print has no hamza) + -hu, him; 'we saw him'
ازْدَدْنَا: izdāda, to increase, grow (VIII, root z-y-d; 1 pl. perf.); 'we increased'
حَدِيثِكَ: ḥadīth, tale, talk, account (m.), gen. after ʿalā + -ka, your (m.s.); 'your tale'
إِبْهَامَيْكَ: إِبْهَامَيْ + كَ — ibhāmay, two thumbs (dual oblique, construct) + -ka, your (m.s.); 'your two thumbs'
غَسْلِ: ghasl, washing (v.n. of ghasala); gen. in construct; 'the washing of'
اِعْلَمُوا: iʿlamū, to know (imper. 2 m.pl. of ʿalima); 'know!'
تَاجِرًا: tājir, merchant (m.); acc. predicate of kāna; 'a merchant'
الْكِبَارِ: الـ + كِبَار — al-, the + kibār, big, great (broken pl. of kabīr), adj. of al-tujjār; 'the great ones'
أَيَّامِ: ayyām, days (pl. of yawm); gen. in construct after ʿalā: ʿalā ayyām 'in the days of'
بِشُرْبِ: بِـ + شُرْب — bi-, of, with (prep. required by mūlaʿ: mūlaʿ bi- 'fond of') + shurb, drinking (v.n. of shariba), gen.; 'of drinking'
وَسَمَاعِ: وَ + سَمَاع — wa-, and + samāʿ, hearing, listening (v.n. of samiʿa), gen. (coordinated with shurb, under bi-); 'and of listening to'
الْعُودِ: الـ + عُود — al-, the + ʿūd, lute (also 'wood'); gen. in construct; 'the lute'
وَآلَاتِ: وَ + آلَات — wa-, and + ālāt, instruments (pl. of āla; precomposed آ in the print), gen. (under bi-), construct; 'and of the instruments of'
الْمَلَاهِي: الـ + مَلَاهِي — al-, the + malāhī, amusements, diversions, instruments of revelry (pl. of malhā); gen.; 'the revelries'
فَهَيَّأْتُهُ: فَـ + هَيَّأَ + هُ — fa-, and/so + hayyaʾa, to prepare, make ready (II; the print omits the hamza; 1 s. perf. hayyaʾtu) + -hu, him; 'and I prepared him' (for burial)
دُكَّانَهُ: دُكَّان + هُ — dukkān, shop, stall (m.), acc. object + -hu, his; 'his shop'; here: treated as f., with the f. maqfūlatan, 'locked': fa-wajadtu dukkānahu maqfūlatan
خَلَّفَ: khallafa, to leave behind (II; 3 m.s. perf.); 'he had left'
إِلَّايَسِيرًا: إِلَّا + يَسِير — illā, except (prep./particle; printed together with the next word) + yasīr, little, small, easy (adj.), acc. after illā; 'except a little'
دُيُونًا: duyūn, debts (broken pl. of dayn), acc. object; 'debts'
فَصَبَّرْتُ: فَـ + صَبَّرْتُ — fa-, and/so + ṣabbara, to make (someone) patient, urge to patience (II; 1 s. perf.); 'and I asked patience of'
الدُّيُونِ: الـ + دُيُون — al-, the + duyūn, debts; gen. in construct; 'the debts'
وَطَيَّبْتُ: وَ + طَيَّبْتُ — wa-, and + ṭayyaba, to make good, sweeten, soothe (II; 1 s. perf.); 'and I soothed'
خَوَاطِرَهُمْ: خَوَاطِر + هُمْ — khawāṭir, minds, hearts, thoughts (pl. of khāṭir); acc. object + -hum, their; ṭayyaba al-khāṭir 'to set (someone's) mind at ease'
أَبِيعُ: abīʿu, to sell (1 s. imperf. indic. of bāʿa); 'I sell'
الْجُمْعَةِ: الـ + جُمْعَة — al-, the + jumʿa, Friday, also week (f.); gen. after min; min al-jumʿa ilā al-jumʿa 'from Friday to Friday' = week by week
وَأُعْطِي: وَ + أُعْطِي — wa-, and + uʿṭī, to give (IV, 1 s. imperf. indic.); 'and I give'
وَفَّيْتُ: waffā, to pay in full, discharge (II; 1 s. perf. waffaytu); 'I paid off'
الدُّيُونَ: الـ + دُيُون — al-, the + duyūn, debts; acc. object; 'the debts'
وَزِدْتُ: وَ + زِدْتُ — wa-, and + zāda, to increase, add (1 s. perf.); 'and I added'
إِلَّاوَصَبِيَّةٌ: إِلَّا + وَ + صَبِيَّة — illā, except + wa-, and (the wa- of sudden event after illā) + ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f.), nom.; printed as one word; 'but suddenly a girl'
تَرَعَيْنِي: تَرَ + عَيْن + ي — tara, to see (jussive after lam, 3 f.s., agrees with ʿayn f.) + ʿayn, eye (f.), nom. + -ī, my; 'my eye saw' (printed with lam as 'lam tara ʿaynī'); printed as one word
حُلِيٌّ: ḥuliyy, jewels, ornaments (pl. of ḥalī); nom. indef.; 'jewels'
وَحُلَلٌ: وَ + حُلَل — wa-, and + ḥulal, robes, fine garments (pl. of ḥulla); nom.; 'and robes'
رَاكِبَةً: rākiba, riding, mounted (act. part. f. of rakiba); acc. circumstantial; 'riding'
أَمَّهَا: amma, to go before, lead (3 m.s. perf.) + -hā, her; 'had gone before her'
وَوَرَاءَهَا: وَ + وَرَاءَ + هَا — wa-, and + warāʾa, behind, after (prep., acc.) + -hā, her; 'and behind her'
اُخْرُجِي: ukhruj, to go out (imper. f.s. -ī of kharaja); 'go out'
تُعْلِمِي: tuʿlimī, to inform, let know (IV; 2 f.s. jussive after lā); 'do not inform'
فَتُطْلِقِي: فَـ + تُطْلِقِي — fa-, lest, so that (fa- of consequence after a prohibition, takes the subjunctive) + tuṭliqī, to let loose, release (IV; 2 f.s. subjunctive); 'lest you let loose'
حَجَبَهَا: ḥajaba, to screen, veil, shield (3 m.s. perf.) + -hā, her; 'he screened her'
فَتَمَشَّتْ: فَـ + تَمَشَّتْ — fa-, and/so + tamashshā, to walk along, stroll (V; 3 f.s. perf.); 'and she walked'
كَشَفَتْ: kashafa, to uncover (3 f.s. perf.); 'she uncovered'
أُكَرِّرُ: ukarriru, to repeat (II; 1 s. imperf. indic.); 'I repeat'
لِلْمَلِيحَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مَلِيحَة — li-, to (prep., marks the addressee of qul 'say to') + al-, the + malīḥa, fair one, pretty woman (f.); 'to the fair one'
الْخِمَارِ: الـ + خِمَار — al-, the + khimār, woman's veil, headcloth (m.); gen. after fī; 'the veil'
الْفَاخِتِي: الـ + فَاخِتِيّ — al-, the + fākhitī, dove-grey (adj., from fākhita, ring-dove; final -ī as printed, for the rhyme); 'the dove-grey'
اَلْمَوْتُ: الـ + مَوْت — al-, the + mawt, death (m.); nom.; 'death'
عَذَابِكِ: عَذَاب + كِ — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); gen. after min; 'your torment'
رَاحَتِي: رَاحَة + ي — rāḥa, rest, relief; also the palm of the hand (f.) + -ī, my; 'my rest' (first line), 'my palm' (second)
بِوَصْلٍ: بِـ + وَصْل — bi-, with (prep.; jāda bi- 'be generous with, bestow') + waṣl, union, joining (m.); gen. indef.; 'with union'; here: jāʾa bi-, 'to bring', bi- marking what the messenger brought; 'with (news of) union'
عَلَّنِي: عَلَّ + نِي — ʿalla, perhaps, that (particle taking the acc.) + -nī, I/me; 'perhaps I'
اُحْيَى: uḥyā, I be given life (aḥyā, give life, Form IV; passive imperf. 1 sg., subj.; printed with damma); 'I be kept alive'
مَدَدْتُ: madda, stretch out (perf. 1 sg. -tu); 'I stretched out / have stretched out'
نَوَالِكِ: نَوَال + كِ — nawāl, bounty, gift (m.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); gen. after ilā; 'your bounty'
مِتِي: mitī, as printed; apparently a misprint for مني minnī, 'from me' (min, from + -nī, me); read so, 'from me'
أَحَابَتْنِي: أَحَابَتْ + نِي — aḥāba, printed with ح for ج: ajāba, answer (perf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me (object); 'she answered me'
اصْطِبَارِي: اصْطِبَار + ي — iṣṭibār, patience, endurance (m., verbal noun of Form VIII) + -ī, my; 'my patience'
اَسْلَاكُمُ: أَسْلَا + كُمُ — aslā, I forget (salīya; imperf. 1 sg.) + -kumu, you (m. pl., object; final -u as printed); 'I forget you'
وَاِنَّ: وَ + اِنَّ — wa-, and (continues the thought) + inna, indeed (particle taking the acc.); 'and indeed'
وَان: وَ + اِنْ — wa-, and + in, if (conditional particle; the print marks only the waw); 'and if'
حُسْنِكُمْ: حُسْن + كُمْ — ḥusn, beauty (m.) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your beauty'
سَرَّهَا: سَرَّ + هَا — sarra, please, gladden (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her/it (the eye, object); 'may it please her'
الْبِعَادِ: الـ + بِعَاد — al-, the + biʿād, distance, separation (m.); gen. after baʿda; 'the distance'; here: after ʿalā, 'in spite of the distance'
لِقَاكُمُ: لِقَا + كُمُ — liqā, meeting (m., written without the hamza of liqāʾ) + -kumu, you (m. pl.); 'meeting you'
حَلَفْتُ: ḥalaftu, I swore (ḥalafa, swear; perf. 1 sg.); 'I swore'
اَسْلَا: aslā, I forget (see aslākumu); final ā as printed; 'I forget'
هَوَاكُمُ: هَوَى + كُمُ — hawā, love (m.) + -kumu, your (m. pl.); 'love of you'
مُعْجَبٌ: muʿjab, delighted, charmed (passive part. of aʿjaba, Form IV); nom. indef.; 'delighted'
بِلِقَاكُمُ: بِـ + لِقَا + كُمُ — bi-, with, at (prep.; muʿjab bi- 'delighted with') + liqā, meeting + -kumu, you (m. pl.); 'with meeting you'
سَقَانِي: سَقَى + نِي — saqā, give to drink (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'it gave me to drink'
كَاسًا: kāsan, a cup (kaʾs, drinking-cup, f.; printed without hamza; acc. indef.); 'a cup'
مُتْرَعًا: mutraʿan, brim-full (passive part. of atraʿa, Form IV, fill to the brim; acc. indef. adj.); 'brim-full'
فَيَالَيْتَهُ: فَـ + يَا + لَيْتَ + هُ — fa-, and so + yā, oh (exclamation) + layta, would that (particle taking the acc.) + -hu, it (= love, al-hawā); 'oh, would that it'
سَقَاكُمُ: سَقَى + كُمُ — saqā, gave to drink (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -kumu, you (m. pl.); 'it gave you to drink'
