الْجِسْمَ: الـ + جِسْم — al-, the + jism, body (m.); acc. object; 'the body'
سِرْتُمُ: sirtumu, you went (sāra, go, travel; perf. 2 m. pl. -tum, extra -u as printed); 'you go / went'
وَاَيْنَ: وَ + أَيْنَ — wa-, and + ayna, wherever; 'and wherever' Also interrogative: wa-ayna, 'and where?' (wa-ayna al-ṣabru, 'and where is patience?').
حَلَلْتُمْ: ḥalaltum, you alight, settle (ḥalla; perf. 2 m. pl.); 'you alight'
وَنَادُوا: وَ + نَادُوا — wa-, and + nādū, call out! (nādā; imperative m. pl.); 'and call'
يُجِيبَكُمْ: يُجِيبَ + كُمْ — yujību, answers (ajāba, Form IV; imperf. 3 m. sg., as the result of the commands) + -kum, you (m. pl., object); 'it answers you'
اَنِينُ: anīn, groaning, moaning (m.); nom. subject, in idāfa with ʿiẓāmī; 'the moan of'
وَقْعِ: waqʿ, falling, sound of a fall or blow (m.); gen. after ʿinda; 'the falling of'
نِدَاكُمُ: نِدَا + كُمُ — nidā, call, calling (m.; written without hamza of nidāʾ) + -kumu, your (m. pl.); 'your calling'
فَلَوْقِيلَ: فَـ + لَوْ + قِيلَ — fa-, and so (resumes) + law, if (hypothetical) + qīla, it was said (passive of qāla); 'and if it were said'
لَقُلْتُ: لَـ + قُلْتُ — la-, (introduces the result of law: 'then') + qultu, I said (perf. 1 sg.); 'I would say'
رِضَى: riḍā, good pleasure, favour (m.); in idāfa with al-Raḥmān; 'the good pleasure of'
رِضَاكُمُ: رِضَا + كُمُ — riḍā, good pleasure + -kumu, your (m. pl.); 'your good pleasure'
يَافَتًى: يَا + فَتًى — yā, O (vocative particle) + fatan, youth, young man (m.); 'O young man'
تَفَاصِيلُ: tafāṣīl, pieces cut to length, cut cloths (pl. of tafṣīl, m.); nom.; 'cut-lengths (of cloth)'
مِلَاحٌ: milāḥ, fine, handsome (pl. of malīḥ, here describing the lengths); 'fine-ones'
مَمْلُوكُكِ: مَمْلُوك + كِ — mamlūk, slave, owned-one (m.) + -ki, your (f. sg., addressing the lady); 'your slave', a polite 'I'
اصْبِرِي: iṣbirī, be patient (imperative f. sg., from ṣabara, bear patiently); 'be patient!'
التُّجَّارُ: الـ + تُجَّار — al-, the + tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir); nom.; 'the merchants'
دَكَاكِينَهُمْ: دَكَاكِين + هُمْ — dakākīn, shops (pl. of dukkān) + -hum, their (m. pl.); acc. object; 'their shops'
وَأَجِيبَ: وَ + أَجِيبَ — wa-, and + ajība, I bring (jāba, bring, Middle Arabic Form I imperf. 1 sg., subj. after ḥattā); 'and I bring'
تُرِيدِينَهُ: تُرِيدِينَ + هُ — turīdīna, you want (irāda, want; imperf. 2 f. sg.) + -hu, it (object, referring back to mā); 'you want it'
غَارِقٌ: ghāriq, drowning, sunk (act. part. of gharaqa, drown); nom. indef.; 'drowning'
مَحَبَّتِهَا: مَحَبَّة + هَا — maḥabba, love (f.) + -hā, her; gen.; 'her love'
تَائِهٌ: tāʾih, lost, wandering, bewildered (act. part. of tāha); nom. indef.; 'lost'
عِشْقِهَا: عِشْق + هَا — ʿishq, passionate love (m.) + -hā, her; gen. after fī; 'her passion'
فَتَحَتِ: fataḥa, open (perf. 3 f. sg. -at, with kasra on the t before al-: fataḥati); 'opened' (fem. verb, plural merchants) Also with a singular subject: fataḥati al-jāriyatu, 'the slave-girl opened'.
طَلَبَتْهُ: طَلَبَتْ + هُ — ṭalaba, request (perf. 3 f. sg. -at) + -hu, it (object); 'she requested it'
ثَمَنُ: thaman, price (m.); nom. (subject of kāna), in idāfa with dhālika; 'the price of'
فَرَكِبَتْ: فَـ + رَكِبَتْ — fa-, and/then + rakibat, she rode, mounted (rakiba; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she mounted'
تَذْكُرْلِي: تَذْكُرْ + لِي — tadhkur, she mention (dhakara, mention; jussive 3 f. sg., after lam) + lī: li-, to (prep., the one told) + -ī, me (printed joined to the verb); 'she did not mention to me'
وَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ: وَ + اسْتَحْيَيْتُ — wa-, and + istaḥyaytu, I was ashamed, shy (istaḥyā, Form X; perf. 1 sg.); 'and I was ashamed'
أَذْكُرُ: adhkuru, I mention (dhakara; imperf. 1 sg., indicative); 'I mention'
وَالْتَزَمَتِ: وَ + الْتَزَمَتْ — wa-, and + iltazamat, bound herself to, took upon herself (iltazama, Form VIII; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and undertook'
بِالثَّمَنِ: بِـ + الـ + ثَمَن — bi-, for, as to (prep.; iltazama bi- 'take responsibility for') + al-, the + thaman, price; 'for the price'; also waffā bi-, ‘pay in full’: the verb chooses bi-, which marks what is paid; ‘(paid) the price in full’ (Night 110)
وَاسْتَلَمْتُ: وَ + اسْتَلَمْتُ — wa-, and + istalamtu, I took delivery of (istalama, Form X; perf. 1 sg.); 'and I took delivery of'
الْغِرَاسَةَ: الـ + غِرَاسَة — al-, the + ghirāsa, obscure: from ghirās, plants, saplings; here evidently the purchased lot, perhaps a misprint (e.g. al-kirrāsa, the bundle); 'the goods'
فَقَٰلَ: فَـ + قَالَ — fa-, and/then + qāla, said (printed قل, the long vowel unwritten; pointed with dagger alif); 'and said'
مَوَالِيَّ: مَوَالِيَّ — mawālī (pl. of mawlā), masters, patrons, household-folk + -ī, my; nom. subject; 'my masters, my people'
حُسْنَهَا: حُسْن + هَا — ḥusn, beauty (m.) + -hā, her; acc. object; 'her beauty'
وَجَمَالَهَا: وَ + جَمَال + هَا — wa-, and + jamāl, comeliness, loveliness (m.) + -hā, her; acc.; 'and her loveliness'
أَنَامَ: anāma, I sleep (nāma, sleep; imperf. 1 sg., subj. after an); 'I sleep'
فَطَالَبُونِي: فَـ + طَالَبُوا + نِي — fa-, 'so, then' (narrative connective); ṭālaba, to press, dun (for: بِـ); -ūna, they (m. pl.); -nī, me; 'so they pressed me'
بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ: بِـ + أَمْوَال + هِمْ — bi-, 'for' (the verb طالب takes بِـ for the thing demanded); amwāl, monies, goods (pl. of māl); -him, their; 'for their money'
فَصَبَّرْتُهُمْ: فَـ + صَبَّرْ + تُ + هُمْ — fa-, 'so'; ṣabbara (II), to make (someone) patient, put off; -tu, I; -hum, them; 'so I put them off'
وَعَبْدَيْنِ: وَ + عَبْد + يْنِ — wa-, 'and'; ʿabd, slave (m.); -ayn, dual oblique (Classical nominative -ān); 'and two slaves'
أَبْطَأْنَا: أَبْطَأْنَا — abṭaʾa (IV), to be slow, late; -nā, we; 'we have been slow'
الصَّيْرَفِيَّ: الـ + صَيْرَفِيّ — al-, 'the'; ṣayrafī, money-changer, banker (m.); acc., object of hāti; 'the money-changer'
فَقَبَضْتُهُ: فَـ + قَبَضْ + تُ + هُ — fa-, 'so'; qabaḍa, to seize, receive; -tu, I; -hu, it; 'and I took it'
خُذْلِي: خُذْ + لِـ + ي — khudh, take! (imperative of akhadha); li-, 'for' (benefactive); -ī, me; 'take for me'
وَكَذَا: وَ + كَذَا — wa-, 'and'; kadhā, such; 'and such'
أَرَادَتْ: أَرَادَتْ — arāda (IV), to want; -at, she; 'she wanted'
تُخَاطِبْنِي: تُخَاطِبْ + نِي — tukhāṭib, she addresses (III, jussive after lam); -nī, me
ثَمَنِهِ: ثَمَن + هِ — thaman, price (m.); gen. after fī; -hi, its; 'its price'
نَدِمْتُ: نَدِمْ + تُ — nadima, to regret; -tu, I; 'I regretted'
أَلَافِ: أَلَاف — ālāf, thousands (pl. of alf); gen. after the number
فَحَسِيتُ: فَـ + حَسِيتُ — fa-, 'so'; ḥasītu, I felt (Middle Arabic for aḥsastu); 'so I felt'
مَالِ: مَال — māl, money, wealth (m.); gen. after min, first term of the iḍāfa
يَعْرِفُوا: يَعْرِفُوا — yaʿrifū, they know (jussive 3 m. pl. after lam); silent final alif
إِلَّامُحْتَالَةً: إِلَّا + مُحْتَالَة — illā, except, only; muḥtāla, trickster, cheat (f., VIII act. part. of iḥtāla); acc. predicate of kānat after mā…illā; printed as one word
خَدَعَتْنِي: خَدَعَ + تْ + نِي — khadaʿa, to deceive; -at, she; -nī, me; 'she deceived me'
وَرَأَتْنِي: وَ + رَأَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, 'and'; raʾā, to see; -at, she; -nī, me; 'and she saw me'
أَسْأَلْهَا: أَسْأَلْ + هَا — asʾal, I ask (jussive after lam); -hā, her; 'I ask her'
مَنْزِلِهَا: مَنْزِل + هَا — manzil, dwelling, house (m.); gen. after ʿan; -hā, her; 'her dwelling'
وَسْوَاسٍ: وَسْوَاس — waswās, whispering, obsessive worry (m.); gen. tanwīn after fī
وَطَالَتْ: وَ + طَالَتْ — wa-, 'and'; ṭāla, to be long, drag on; -at, she/it
غَيْبَتُهَا: غَيْبَة + هَا — ghayba, absence (f.); nom., subject; -hā, her; 'her absence'
وَشَدَّدُوا: وَ + شَدَّدُوا — wa-, 'and'; shaddada (II), to be severe, press hard; -ū, they; 'and they were severe'
فَقَدَّمْتُ: فَـ + قَدَّمْ + تُ — fa-, 'so'; qaddama (II), to put forward, offer; -tu, I
عَقَارِي: عَقَار + ي — ʿaqār, real property, land (m.); -ī, my
لِلْمَبِيعِ: لِـ + الـ + مَبِيع — li-, 'for, toward' (purpose); al-, 'the'; mabīʿ, sale (m.); 'for the sale'
وَأَضْمَرْتُ: وَ + أَضْمَرْتُ — wa-, 'and'; aḍmartu, I concealed, resolved secretly (IV perf. 1 sg.)
تَعَدَّتْ: تَعَدَّتْ — taʿaddat, she/it passed beyond, went past (V perf. 3 f. sg.); obscure, possibly for qaʿadtu 'I sat'
نَازِلَةٌ: نَازِلَة — nāzila, descending, dismounting (f. act. part. of nazala); nom. tanwīn, predicate after wa-hiya
وَأَقْبَلَتْ: وَ + أَقْبَلَتْ — wa-, 'and'; aqbalat, she approached, set about (IV perf.); with imperfect 'began'
بِحَدِيثِهَا: بِـ + حَدِيث + هَا — bi-, 'with, in' (manner/means; ḥaddatha bi- 'tell with'); ḥadīth, talk, speech (m.); -hā, her; 'with her talk'
وَأَوْزِنْ: وَ + أَوْزِنْ — wa-, 'and'; awzin, have weighed out, weigh (IV imperative of wazana); Classical zin
فَأَعْطَتْنِي: فَـ + أَعْطَتْ + نِي — fa-, 'so'; aʿṭat, she gave (IV); -nī, me
أَخَذَتْهُ: أَخَذَ + تْ + هُ — akhadha, to take; -at, she; -hu, it; 'she took it'
بِزِيَادَةٍ: بِـ + زِيَادَة — bi-, 'with' (accompaniment); ziyāda, increase, extra (f.); gen.; 'with an extra'
انْبَسَطَتْ: اِنْبَسَطَتْ — inbasaṭat, she expanded, became at ease (VII perf. 3 f. sg.)
فَكِدْتُ: فَـ + كِدْ + تُ — fa-, 'so'; kāda, to almost do (with imperfect); -tu, I; 'so I nearly'
وَسُرُورًا: وَ + سُرُور — wa-, 'and'; surūr, joy (m.); acc. tanwīn
لَاأَعْرِفُ: لَا + أَعْرِفُ — lā, not (negates the imperfect); aʿrifu, I know (imperf. of ʿarafa), here also 'know carnally'; printed as one word
امْرَأَةً: اِمْرَأَة — imraʾa, woman (f.); acc. tanwīn, object; printed with precomposed hamza
الدَّنَانِيرِ: الـ + دَنَانِير — al-, 'the'; danānīr, dinars (pl. of dīnār); gen., second term of the iḍāfa
وَسَأَلْتُهُ: وَ + سَأَلْ + تُ + هُ — wa-, 'and'; saʾala, to ask; -tu, I; -hu, him; 'and I asked him'
يَتَوَسَّطَ: يَتَوَسَّطَ — yatawassaṭa, he mediates, intercedes (V subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an)
عَاشِقَةٌ: عَاشِقَة — ʿāshiqa, lover, in love (f. act. part. of ʿashiqa); nom. tanwīn, predicate
بِالْقُمَاشِ: بِـ + الـ + قُمَاش — bi-, 'of, for' (ḥāja bi- 'a need of'); al-, 'the'; qumāsh, cloth (m.); 'of the cloth'
اشْتَرَتْهُ: اِشْتَرَى + تْ + هُ — ishtarā (VIII), to buy; -at, she; -hu, it; 'she bought it'
فَخَاطِبْهَا: فَـ + خَاطِبْ + هَا — fa-, 'so'; khāṭib, speak to! (III imperative of khāṭaba); -hā, her
تُخَالِفُكَ: تُخَالِفُ + كَ — tukhālifu, she opposes (III imperf. 3 f. sg.); -ka, you; 'she opposes you'
فَرَأَتْنِي: فَـ + رَأَ + تْ + نِي — fa-, 'so'; raʾā, to see; -at, she; -nī, me; 'so she saw me'
أُعْطِي: أُعْطِي — uʿṭī, I give (IV imperf. 1 sg.)
الدَّنَانِيرَ: الـ + دَنَانِير — al-, 'the'; danānīr, dinars; acc., second object
مَمْلُوكِكِ: مَمْلُوك + كِ — mamlūk, slave, one owned (m.); gen. after ʿalā; -ki, your (f.); 'your slave'
وَاسْمَحِي: وَ + اِسْمَحِي — wa-, 'and'; ismaḥī, be generous, forgive! (imperative f. sg. of samaḥa, IV)
حَدَّثْتُهَا: حَدَّثْ + تُ + هَا — ḥaddatha (II), to tell; -tu, I; -hā, her; 'I told her'
فَأَجَابَتْ: فَـ + أَجَابَتْ — fa-, 'so'; ajāba (IV), to answer, grant; -at, she
تَأْتِي: تَأْتِي — taʾtī, you come, bring (imperf. 2 m. sg. of atā); printed with precomposed hamza Also 3fs, 'she comes', of a past habit: allatī taʾtī, 'who used to come'.
بِرِسَالَتِي: بِـ + رِسَالَة + ي — bi-, 'with' (atā bi- 'bring'); risāla, message (f.); -tī, my; 'with my message'
اعْمَلْ: اِعْمَلْ — iʿmal, do, act! (imperative of ʿamila)
اَلتُّجَّارَ: الـ + تُجَّار — al-, the (def. art.); tājir, merchant, pl. tujjār (acc., indirect object); 'the merchants'
أمْوَا: amwā, printed fragment of أَمْوَال, amwāl, pl. of māl, wealth, goods; the print splits the word as اموا + لهم, to be read together as أَمْوَالَهُمْ, 'their goods'
اَلرِّبْحُ: الـ + رِبْح — al-, the (def. art.); ribḥ, profit, gain (m., nom.); 'the profit'
اَلنَّدَمُ: الـ + نَدَم — al-, the (def. art.); nadam, regret (m., nom.); 'the regret'
اِنْقِطَاعِ: inqiṭāʿ, cutting off, breaking off (VII verbal noun, m., gen. after min); 'the cutting-off'
خَبَرِهَا: خَبَر + هَا — khabar, news, tidings (m., gen. as first term of a construct) + hā, her (3 f.s. suffix); 'news of her'
أنَمْ: أَنَمْ — nāma, sleep (1 s. jussive after lam); 'I slept' (negated: 'I did not sleep')
فَمَاكَانَ: فَـ + مَا + كَانَ — fa-, and so, and (connective); mā, not; kāna, was (3 m.s.); written as one word; with illā, 'it was only'
خَادِمُهَا: خَادِم + هَا — khādim, servant (m., nom.) + hā, her; 'her servant'
فَأكْرَمْتُهُ: فَـ + أَكْرَمْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (sequence); akrama, honour, treat generously (IV 1 s. perf.); hu, him (3 m.s. object); 'and I honoured him'
وَسَألْتُهُ: و + سَأَلْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); saʾala, ask (1 s. perf.); hu, him; 'and I asked him'
أمْرَهَا: أَمْر + هَا — amr, matter, affair (m., acc. object) + hā, her; 'her affair'
اَلصَّبِيَّهُ: الـ + صَبِيَّة — al-, the; ṣabiyya, girl (f.), printed with ه for ة (nom.); 'the girl'
رَبَّتْهَا: رَبَّتْ + هَا — rabbā, rear, bring up (II 3 f.s. perf.); hā, her (3 f.s. object); 'reared her'
اَلسِّتُّ: الـ + سِتّ — al-, the; sitt, lady, mistress (f., colloquial form of sayyida; nom.); 'the Lady'
زُبَيْدَةُ: Zubayda, proper name (f.), wife of Hārūn al-Rashīd (nom.); 'Zubayda'
اَلْخَلِيفَةِ: الـ + خَلِيفَة — al-, the; khalīfa, caliph, successor (gen. in construct); 'the caliph'
اَلرَّشِيدِ: الـ + رَشِيد — al-, the; rashīd, rightly guided (epithet, gen.); 'the Rightly-Guided'
جَوَارِهَا: جَوَارِ + هَا — jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya; the print drops the yāʾ of جواريها); hā, her; 'her slave-girls'
اِشْتَهَتْ: ishtahā, desire, crave (VIII 3 f.s. perf.); 'she craved'
سَيِّدَتِهَا: سَيِّدَة + هَا — sayyida, mistress (f., gen. after ʿalā) + hā, her; 'her mistress' Also gen. as second term of an iḍāfa: salāma sayyidatihā, 'her lady's greeting'.
اَلْخُرُوجَ: الـ + خُرُوج — al-, the; khurūj, going out (verbal noun, m., acc.); 'the going-out'
وَالدُّخُولَ: و + الـ + دُخُول — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; dukhūl, going in, entering (verbal noun, acc.); 'and the going-in'
فَوَصَلَتْ: فَـ + وَصَلَتْ — fa-, and so, then (sequence); waṣala, arrive, advance (3 f.s. perf.); 'and she advanced'
قَهْرَمَانَةً: qahramāna, stewardess, housekeeper (f., acc. tanwīn, predicate of ṣārat); 'a stewardess'
حَدَّثَتْ: ḥaddatha, speak to, tell (II 3 f.s. perf.); 'she spoke to'
اَلسِّتَّ: الـ + سِتّ — al-, the; sitt, lady (f., acc. object); 'the Lady'
وَسَألَتْهَا: و + سَأَلَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); saʾala, ask (3 f.s. perf.); hā, her (object); 'and she asked her'
تُزَوِّجَهَا: تُزَوِّجَ + هَا — zawwaja, marry off, give in marriage (II 3 f.s. subj. after an); hā, her (object); 'that she marry her off'
أفْعَلُ: faʿala, do (1 s. imperf.); 'I do' (negated: 'I will not do')
أنْظُرَ: naẓara, look at, see (1 s. subj. after ḥattā); 'I see'
اَلشَّابَّ: الـ + شَابّ — al-, the; shābb, young man (acc. object); 'the young man'
يُشْبِهُكِ: يُشْبِهُ + كِ — ashbaha, resemble, be like (IV 3 m.s. imperf.); ki, you (2 f.s. suffix; the print has no gender mark); 'he resembles you'
زَوَّجْتُكِ: زَوَّجْتُ + كِ — zawwaja, marry off (II 1 s. perf.); ki, you (2 f.s.); 'I married you (off)', i.e. 'I will marry you'
اَلسَّاعَةَ: الـ + سَاعَة — al-, the; sāʿa, hour, moment (f., acc. of time); 'the hour', i.e. 'at this hour, now'
اَلدَّارَ: الـ + دَار — al-, the; dār, house (f., acc. object); 'the house'
وَصَّلْتُ: waṣṣala, bring through, carry through (II 1 s. perf.; the perfect stands for the future in a result clause); 'I brought through', i.e. 'I will carry through'; uncertain: waṣaltu is possible
تَزْوِيجَكَ: تَزْوِيج + كَ — tazwīj, marrying off (II verbal noun, m., acc. object) + ka, your (2 m.s.); 'your being married off'
أمْرُكَ: أَمْر + كَ — amr, matter, affair (m., nom., subject) + ka, your (2 m.s.); 'your affair'
رَقَبَتَكَ: رَقَبَة + كَ — raqaba, neck (f., acc. object) + ka, your; 'your neck'
ذَاتَقُولُ: ذَا + تَقُولُ — dhā, this (the second part of mā dhā, 'what'); qāla, say (2 m.s. imperf.); printed as one word; 'do you say'
أرُوحُ: rāḥa, go, set out (1 s. imperf.); 'I go'
وَأصْبِرُ: و + أَصْبِرُ — wa-, and (conj.); ṣabara, be patient (1 s. imperf.); 'and I am patient'
اَلْأمْرِ: الـ + أَمْر — al-, the; amr, matter (gen. after ʿalā); 'the matter'
اَلَّذِي: alladhī, who, which (relative pronoun, m.s.); 'which, the one who'
حَدَّثْتَنِي: حَدَّثْتَ + نِي — ḥaddatha, tell (II 2 m.s. perf.); nī, me (object); 'you told me'
اَلْخَادِمُ: الـ + خَادِم — al-, the; khādim, servant (nom.); 'the servant'
اَللَّيْلَةَ: الـ + لَيْلَة — al-, the; layla, night (f., acc. of time); 'the night', hādhihi al-layla 'tonight'
فَامْضِ: فَـ + امْضِ — fa-, then (introduces an imperative after a condition); imḍi, go (imper. m.s. of maḍā); 'then go' Also fa- of consequence after a statement: fa-imḍi binā, 'so take us (elsewhere)'.
اَلْمَسْجِدِ: الـ + مَسْجِد — al-, the; masjid, mosque (m., gen. after ilā); 'the mosque'
وَصَلِّ: و + صَلِّ — wa-, and (conj.); ṣallā, pray (II imper. m.s.); 'and pray'
وَبِتْ: و + بِتْ — wa-, and (conj.); bāta, spend the night (imper. m.s., short form); 'and spend the night'
اَلْمَسْجِدُ: الـ + مَسْجِد — al-, the; masjid, mosque (nom.); 'the mosque'
بَنَتْهُ: بَنَتْ + هُ — banā, build (3 f.s. perf.); hu, it (3 m.s. object); 'built it'
اَلْلَ: printed fragment: the first piece of الل جلة, likely a misprint for الدجلة, al-Dijla, 'the Tigris' (the dāl replaced by lām, with a stray space); read together with جَلَة; uncertain
جَلَة: printed fragment: the second piece of الل جلة; see اَلْلَ; 'the Tigris' (candidate)
اَلْعِشَاءُ: الـ + عِشَاء — al-, the; ʿishāʾ, evening, nightfall (m., nom.); 'the evening'
اِى: printed for إِلَى (ilā, to, toward, prep.), with the lām missing; 'to'
وَصَلَّيْتُ: و + صَلَّيْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); ṣallā, pray (II 1 s. perf.); 'and I prayed'
اَلسَّحَرِ: الـ + سَحَر — al-, the; saḥar, the last part of the night before dawn (m., gen.); 'the pre-dawn'
بِخَادِمَيْنِ: بِـ + خَادِمَيْنِ — bi-, marks what appears after wa-idhā of surprise ('and behold, two servants') and is not translated; khādim, servant, dual -ayn (gen./acc.); 'two servants'
أقْبَلَا: aqbala, approach, come on (IV 3 m. dual perf.); 'the two came on'
زَوْرَقٍ: zawraq, small boat, skiff (m., gen. tanwīn after fī); 'a boat'
صَنَادِيقُ: ṣundūq, chest, box; broken pl. ṣanādīq (diptote, nom.); 'chests'
فَارِغَةٌ: fāriġ, empty (adj.), f.s. nom. tanwīn (agreeing with a plural of things); 'empty'
فَأدْخَلُوهَا: فَـ + أَدْخَلُوا + هَا — fa-, and so, then (sequence); adkhala, bring in (IV 3 m.pl. perf.); hā, them (3 f.s. for a plural of things); 'and they brought them in'
اَلْمَسْجِدَ: الـ + مَسْجِد — al-, the; masjid, mosque (acc., the place into which); 'the mosque'
وَتَأخَّرَ: و + تَأَخَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.); taʾakhkhara, stay behind, linger (V 3 m.s. perf.); 'and (he) stayed behind'
فَتَأمَّلْتُهُ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (sequence); taʾammala, look closely at (V 1 s. perf.); hu, him (object); 'and I scrutinised him'
وَاسِطَةً: wāsiṭa, intermediary, go-between (f., acc. tanwīn, predicate of kāna); 'a go-between'
وَبَيْنَهَا: و + بَيْنَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); bayna, between (prep.); hā, her; 'and between her' Also 'and between it', of a feminine noun such as dār: baynaka wa-baynahā, 'between you and it (the palace)'.
صَعِدَتْ: ṣaʿida, go up, ascend (3 f.s. perf.); 'she came up'
اَلْجَارِيَةُ: الـ + جَارِيَة — al-, the; jāriya, slave-girl, girl (f., nom.); 'the girl'
صَاحِبَتِي: صَاحِبَة + ي — ṣāḥiba, female companion (f., nom., apposition) + ī, my (1 s.); 'my companion'
أقْبَلَتْ: aqbala, approach, draw near (IV 3 f.s. perf.); 'she drew near'
وَعَانَقْتُهَا: و + عَانَقْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); ʿānaqa, embrace (III 1 s. perf.); hā, her (object); 'and I embraced her'
فَقَبَّلَتْنِي: فَـ + قَبَّلَتْ + نِي — fa-, and so, then (sequence); qabbala, kiss (II 3 f.s. perf.); nī, me (object); 'and she kissed me'
وَتَحَدَّثْنَا: و + تَحَدَّثْنَا — wa-, and (conj.); taḥaddatha, converse (V 1 pl. perf.); 'and we conversed'
فَأخَذَتْنِي: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ + نِي — fa-, and so, then (sequence); akhadha, take (3 f.s. perf.); nī, me (object); 'and she took me'
وَأغْلَقَتْهُ: و + أَغْلَقَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); aghlaqa, shut, lock (IV 3 f.s. perf.); hu, it (object); 'and she shut it'
وَأقْبَلَتْ: و + أَقْبَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.); aqbala ʿalā, turn to, address oneself to (IV 3 f.s. perf.); 'and she turned to'
اَلْخَادِمِ: الـ + خَادِم — al-, the; khādim, servant (gen. after ʿalā); 'the servant'
شَئٌْ: shayʾ, thing (m., nom. tanwīn); printed شي, without the hamza; 'a thing, something'
اَلْأمْتِعَةِ: الـ + أَمْتِعَة — al-, the; amtiʿa, goods, baggage (pl. of matāʿ; gen. after min); 'the goods'
وَتُعَبِّي: و + تُعَبِّي — wa-, and (conj.); ʿabbā, pack, fill (II 3 f.s. imperf., yāʾ form; Classical ʿabbaʾa); 'and she packs'
اَلصَّنَادِيقِ: الـ + صَنَادِيق — al-, the; ṣanādīq, chests (pl. of ṣundūq; gen. after fī); 'the chests'
وَتُغْلِقُ: و + تُغْلِقُ — wa-, and (conj.); aghlaqa, shut (IV 3 f.s. imperf.); 'and she shuts'
عَبَّتِ: ʿabbā, pack (II 3 f.s. perf.; printed without hamza/yāʾ, Classical ʿabbaʾat); final kasra joins it to al-; 'she packed'
اَلْجَمِيعَ: الـ + جَمِيع — al-, the; jamīʿ, all, the whole (m., acc. object); 'the whole, all of it'
وَضَعُوهُمْ: وَضَعُوا + هُمْ — waḍaʿa, put (3 m.pl. perf.); hum, them (m.pl., here the chests); 'they put them'
اَلزَّوْرَقِ: الـ + زَوْرَق — al-, the; zawraq, boat (gen. after fī); 'the boat'
وَأخَذُوا: و + أَخَذُوا — wa-, and (conj.); akhadha, take, set off (3 m.pl. perf.); 'and they set off'
طَالِبِينَ: ṭālib, seeking (act. part., m.pl. acc., circumstantial); 'seeking, making for'
مَنْزِلَ: manzil, dwelling, abode (m., acc. object, construct state; the genitive follows in the next slice); 'the dwelling of'
اَلسِّتِّ: الـ (al-, the) + سِتّ — sitt, lady (colloquial for sayyida; f.), here genitive; 'the Lady'
زُبَيْدَةَ: زُبَيْدَة — Zubayda, a woman's name; here genitive (diptote)
هَلَكْتُ: هَلَكَ — halaka, perish, be ruined + ـتُ (-tu, I); 'I have perished'
شَهْوَتِي: شَهْوَة — shahwa, desire, lust (f.) + ـِي (-ī, my); 'my desire'
تَحْصُلُ: حَصَلَ — ḥaṣala, come about, be obtained; imperfect 3rd f. sing. 'it comes about'
وَأَدْعُو: وَ (wa-, and) + أَدْعُو — daʿā, call upon, pray to; imperfect 1st sing. 'I call upon'
يُخَلِّصَنِي: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, deliver, rescue (II); subjunctive 3rd m. + نِي (-nī, me); 'that he deliver me'
بِالصَّنَادِيقِ: بِـ (bi-, with, bringing: وَصَلَ بِـ 'arrive with') + الـ (al-, the) + صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests (pl. of ṣundūq); 'with the chests'
الَّذِى: الَّذِي — alladhī, who, which, that (relative, m. sing.); printed with ى
جُمْلَتِهِمْ: جُمْلَة — jumla, totality (f.) + هِمْ (-him, their); 'their totality'; with min 'among them'
فَاجْتَازَتْ: فَـ (fa-, so, then) + اجْتَازَتْ — ijtāza, pass by, pass through (VIII); 3rd f. sing.; 'so there passed'
طَائِفَةٌ: طَائِفَة — ṭāʾifa, group, company (f.); nominative; 'a company'
الْخُدَّامِ: الـ (al-, the) + خُدَّام — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim); genitive after min
الْمُوَكَّلِينَ: الـ (al-, the) + مُوَكَّلِينَ — muwakkalīn, those entrusted (passive participle of wakkala, II; m. pl. gen.); 'the entrusted-ones' Also with bi-, 'set over': al-muwakkalīna bi-al-bābi, 'the men set over the gate', the gatekeepers.
بِالْحَرِيمِ: بِـ (bi-, with: the thing entrusted, 'in charge of') + الـ (al-, the) + حَرِيم — ḥarīm, harem, women's quarters (m.); 'with the harem'
وَأَصْحَابِ: وَ (wa-, and) + أَصْحَاب — aṣḥāb, owners, keepers (pl. of ṣāḥib); genitive, coordinated; 'and the keepers'
السَّتَائِرِ: الـ (al-, the) + سَتَائِر — satāʾir, curtains (pl. of sitāra); 'of the curtains'
الصَّنَادِيقِ: الـ (al-, the) + صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests; genitive after hādhihi (apposition)
مَلْأَنِينَ: مَلْأَن — malʾān, full (adj.), Middle Arabic sound m. pl.; 'full-ones'
أَمْتِعَةً: أَمْتِعَة — amtiʿa, goods, wares (pl. of matāʿ); accusative of specification; 'of goods'; also: acc. indef., object: istaʿarta amtiʿatan, 'you borrowed goods'
لِلسِّتِّ: لِـ (li-, for, belonging to) + الـ (al-, the) + سِتّ — sitt, lady; 'for the Lady'
افْتَحِي: فَتَحَ — fataḥa, open; imperative f. sing.; 'open!' (to the woman)
وَاحِدٌ!: وَاحِد — wāḥid, one (m.); printed with '!' after it (a misprint, probably for the alif of wāḥidan); 'one'
تَفْتَحُهُمْ: فَتَحَ — fataḥa, open; imperfect 2nd m. sing. + هُمْ (-hum, them); 'you open them'
لَاتُطِيلِي: لَا (lā, do not) + تُطِيلِي — aṭāla, prolong (IV); jussive 2nd f. sing.; joined in print; 'do not prolong'
بَدَأَ: بَدَأَ — badaʾa, begin; 3rd m. sing.; 'he began'
بِفَتْحِ: بِـ (bi-, with: بَدَأَ بِـ 'begin with') + فَتْح — fatḥ, opening; 'with the opening of' Also bi- taking the thing ordered after amara: amara bi-fatḥi al-qubbati, 'he ordered the opening of the dome'.
وَبُلْتُ: وَ (wa-, and) + بُلْتُ — bāla, urinate; 1st sing. (-tu, I); 'and I urinated'
بَوْلِى: بَوْل — bawl, urine (m.) + ـِي (-ī, my); printed with ى; 'my urine'
خَارِجِ: خَارِج — khārij, outside (m.); construct, genitive after min; 'the outside of'; here: after ilā: ilā khāriji al-dāri, 'out of the house'
لِلْمُقَدَّمِ: لِـ (li-, to: the person spoken to) + الـ (al-, the) + مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, chief, commander (m.); 'to the chief'
مُقَدَّمُ: مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, chief; vocative, nominative form; 'chief'; also: nom., subject, in construct: muqaddamu al-khayyāla, 'the captain of the horsemen'
أَهْلَكْتَنِي: أَهْلَكَ — ahlaka, destroy, ruin (IV); 2nd m. sing. (-ta, you) + نِي (-nī, me); 'you destroyed me'
وَأَهْلَكْتَ: وَ (wa-, and) + أَهْلَكْتَ — ahlaka, destroy; 2nd m. sing.; 'and you destroyed'
وَأَفْسَدْتَ: وَ (wa-, and) + أَفْسَدْتَ — afsada, spoil, ruin (IV); 2nd m. sing.; 'and you spoiled'
مُلَوَّنَاتٌ: مُلَوَّنَات — mulawwanāt, coloured (passive participle of lawwana, II; f. pl.); 'coloured'
وَأَرْبَعَةَ: وَ (wa-, and) + أَرْبَعَة — arbaʿa, four (f.); construct, accusative; 'and four'
أَمْنَانٍ: أَمْنَان — amnān, maunds (pl. of mann, a weight of about two pounds); genitive after the number
زَمْزَمَ: زَمْزَم — Zamzam, the sacred well at Mecca; genitive (diptote)
انْفَكَّتْ: انْفَكَّ — infakka, come undone, be loosed (VII); 3rd f. sing.; 'it came undone'
وَالسَّاعَةَ: وَ (wa-, and) + الـ (al-, the) + سَاعَة — sāʿa, hour; accusative adverb; 'and now'
تَنْفَسِخُ: انْفَسَخَ — infasakha, be undone, dissolve, be spoiled (VII); imperfect 3rd f. sing.; 'it will be ruined'
أَلْوَ: أَلْوَان — alwān, colours (pl. of lawn); first part of a word the print splits (أَلْوَ + انُهَا)
انُهَا: ـان (-ān, second part of the split word أَلْوَانُهَا) + هَا (-hā, their/its); with the first part 'their colours'
الطَّوَا: الـ (al-, the) + طَوَاشِي — ṭawāshī, eunuch of rank (m.); first part of a word the print splits (الطَّوَا + شِي)
صَنَادِيقَكِ: صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests (pl.) + كِ (-ki, your, f.); accusative object; 'your chests'
وَاذْ: وَ (wa-, and) + اذْ — first part of the split imperative اذْهَبِي (idh-habī, go), 'and go'
هَبِى: ـهَبِي — second part of the split imperative اذْهَبِي (dhahaba, go; 2nd f. sing.); printed with ى
فَحَمَلَتِ: فَـ (fa-, so, then) + حَمَلَتِ — ḥamala, carry; 3rd f. sing. (agrees with the collective khuddām); 'so they carried'
وَتَلَا: وَ (wa-, and) + تَلَا — first part of the split verb تَلَاحَقَتْ (talāḥaqa, follow close upon one another)
حَقَتِ: ـحَقَتِ — second part of the split verb تَلَاحَقَتْ (VI); 3rd f. sing.; with the first part 'they followed closely'
الصَّنَادِيقُ: الـ (al-, the) + صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests; nominative subject; 'the chests'
بِصُنْدُوقِي: بِـ (bi-, with, up to: تَلَاحَقَ بِـ 'catch up with') + صُنْدُوق — ṣundūq + ـِي (-ī, my); 'with my chest'
ذَاهِبِينَ: ذَهَبَ — dhahaba, go; active participle m. pl., accusative (Middle Arabic for dhāhibūn); 'going'
أُذُنِي: أُذُن — udhun, ear (f.) + ـِي (-ī, my); 'my ear'
وَيْلَاهُ: وَيْل — wayl, woe (m.) + ā + هُ (-hu, pausal exclamation ending); 'alas!'
جِلْدِي: جِلْد — jild, skin (m.) + ـِي (-ī, my); genitive after fī; 'my skin'
مُصِيبَةٌ: مُصِيبَة — muṣība, calamity, disaster (f.); nominative; 'a calamity'
عَمِلْتُهَا: عَمِلَ — ʿamila, do, make; 1st sing. (-tu, I) + هَا (-hā, it, f.); 'I did it'
صَنَادِيقِكِ: صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests + كِ (-ki, your, f.); genitive after fī; 'your chests'
صَنَادِيقِي: صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests + ـِي (-ī, my); genitive after fī; 'my chests'
ثِيَابُ: ثِيَاب — thiyāb, garments; construct, nominative; 'garments of'
إِيَّاهُمْ: إِيَّا (iyyā, detached object pronoun base) + هُمْ (-hum, them); 'them'
الْمَوْتَةَ: الـ (al-, the) + مَوْتَة — mawta, a death, one act of dying (f.); accusative (cognate object); 'the death'
الْكَامِلَةَ: الـ (al-, the) + كَامِلَة — kāmila, complete (adj. f.); accusative; 'the complete'
أَيَّامِي: أَيَّام — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm) + ـِي (-ī, my); genitive; 'my days'
أَتَزَوَّجُ: تَزَوَّجَ — tazawwaja, marry (V); imperfect 1st sing.; 'I marry'
ضُرِبَتْ: ضَرَبَ — ḍaraba, strike; passive 3rd f. sing.; 'was struck'
مُحَمَّدً: مُحَمَّد — Muḥammad; accusative (the tanwin-alif is displaced onto the next printed word)
ارَسُولُ: ـا (a stray alif, the displaced tanwin-alif of muḥammadan) + رَسُول — rasūl, messenger (m.); nominative predicate in construct; 'messenger of'
وَدَاعَةٌ: وَدَاعَة — wadāʿa, as printed 'gentleness, ease' (f.), nom. indefinite; probably a slip for wadīʿa, 'a deposit, a thing in trust'
وَشَيٌّ: وَ + شَيّ — wa-, and + shayy, thing (for shayʾ, printed شي), nom. indefinite; 'and a thing'
وَتُرِيدَانِ: وَ + أَرَادَ — wa-, and + arāda, to want (2 dual or 3 f. dual imperfect, as printed); obscure, perhaps for turīdu; 'and you two want'
يَطَّلِعُ: اطَّلَعَ — iṭṭalaʿa ʿalā, to look upon, peer at (3 m. sg. imperfect, indicative as printed); 'looks upon'; here: iṭṭalaʿa ʿalā, 'to be acquainted with, know about' (an affair)
فَتْحِهِمْ: فَتْح + هِمْ — fatḥ, opening (verbal noun), gen. after min + -him, them; 'their opening'
قَدِّمُوا: قَدَّمَ — qaddama, to bring forward (m. pl. imperative); 'bring forward'
الصَّنَادِيقَ: الـ + صَنَادِيق — ṣanādīq, chests, acc. (object); 'the chests'
فَأَيْقَنْتُ: فَـ + أَيْقَنَ — fa-, so, then + ayqana, to be certain (1 sg. perfect); 'so I was certain'
وَلَامَحَالَةَ: وَ + لَا + مَحَالَة — wa-, and + lā maḥāla, 'without fail, inevitably' (maḥāla, a turning-away, acc. after lā), written as one word; 'and beyond doubt'
فَجَعَلَتِ: فَـ + جَعَلَ — fa-, so + jaʿala, to begin to (3 f. sg. perfect, before a plural subject); 'so they began'
يُقَدِّمُونَ: قَدَّمَ — qaddama, to bring forward (3 m. pl. imperfect); 'bringing forward'
فِيهِمُ: فِي + هِمُ — fī, in + -him, them (-ū before the next word); 'in them'
الْعِطْرَ: الـ + عِطْر — ʿiṭr, perfume (m.), acc.; 'the perfume'
وَالثِّيَابَ: وَ + الـ + ثِيَاب — wa-, and + thiyāb, garments, acc.; 'and the garments'
يَفْتَحُونَ: فَتَحَ — fataḥa, to open (3 m. pl. imperfect); 'opening'
وَغَيْرِهَا: وَ + غَيْر + هَا — wa-, and + ghayr, other than + -hā, them; 'and other than them'
الصُّنْدُوقُ: الـ + صُنْدُوق — ṣundūq, chest (m.), nom.; 'the chest'
وَمَدُّوا: وَ + مَدَّ — wa-, and + madda, to stretch out (3 m. pl. perfect); 'and they stretched'
لِيَفْتَحُوهُ: لِـ + فَتَحَ + هُ — li-, to, in order to (with subjunctive) + yaftaḥū, they open (3 m. pl. subjunctive) + -hu, it; 'to open it'
فَأَسْرَعَتِ: فَـ + أَسْرَعَ — fa-, then + asraʿa, to hurry (3 f. sg. perfect); 'then she hurried'
لِلْخَلِينَةِ: لِـ + الـ + خَلِينَة — li-, to (marking the one approached after atā) + al-khalīna, as printed, evidently a slip for al-khalīfa, 'the caliph', gen.; 'to the caliph'
زُبَيْدَهْ: زُبَيْدَة — Zubayda, printed with final hāʾ (زبيده), gen.; 'Zubayda'
سِرُّهَا: سِرّ + هَا — sirr, secret (m.), nom. + -hā, her; 'her secret'
بِإِدْخَالِ: بِـ + إِدْخَال — bi-, with, of (the preposition chosen by amara bi-, 'order'; it marks what is ordered) + idkhāl, bringing in (verbal noun), gen.; 'the bringing in of'
فَأَتَوُا: فَـ + أَتَى — fa-, then + atā, to come (3 m. pl. perfect, plural before its subject); 'then they came'
بِالصُّنْدُوقِ: بِـ + الـ + صُنْدُوق — bi-, together with, in (accompaniment: 'chest and all') + ṣundūq, chest, gen.; 'with the chest'
وَوَضَعُونِي: وَ + وَضَعَ + نِي — wa-, and + waḍaʿa, to set down (3 m. pl. perfect) + -nī, me; 'and they set me'
نَشِفَ: نَشِفَ — nashifa, to be dry (3 m. sg. perfect); 'was dry'
رِيقِى: رِيق + ي — rīq, saliva, spittle (m.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my spittle'
فَأَخْرَجَتْنِي: فَـ + أَخْرَجَ + نِي — fa-, then + akhraja, to bring out (3 f. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'then she brought me out'
بَأْسٌ: بَأْس — baʾs, harm, hardship (m.), nom. indefinite (mā ʿalayka baʾsun 'you have no harm')
وَلَاخَوْفٌ: وَ + لَا + خَوْف — wa-, and + lā, no, not + khawf, fear (m.), nom. indefinite, printed as one word; 'and no fear'
فَاشْرَحْ: فَـ + شَرَحَ — fa-, so + sharaḥa, to open, expand (m. sg. imperative); 'so open'
صَدْرَكَ: صَدْر + كَ — ṣadr, breast, chest (m.), acc. + -ka, your; 'your breast'
وَطَيِّبْ: وَ + طَيَّبَ — wa-, and + ṭayyaba, to make good, sweeten (m. sg. imperative); 'and make good'
قَلْبَكَ: قَلْب + كَ — qalb, heart (m.), acc. + -ka, your; 'your heart'
تَأْتِيَ: أَتَى — atā, to come (3 f. sg. subjunctive after ḥattā); 'she comes'
نَصِيبٌ: نَصِيب — naṣīb, share, portion, fortune (m.), nom. indefinite
جَوَارٍ: جَوَارٍ — jawārin, girls (pl. of jāriya), gen. indefinite (defective pl.); 'girls'
كَأَنَّهُنَّ: كَـ + أَنَّ + هُنَّ — ka-, as (in kaʾanna 'as though') + anna, that + -hunna, they (f. pl.); 'as though they'
قَدْأَ: قَدْ + أَ — qad, already, (particle of completion) + a-, the initial a- of the following verb (e.g. aqbalna, adrakathu), printed attached to qad (قدا قبلن, قدا دركته); 'had'
قْبَلْنَ: قْبَلْنَ — -qbalna, rest of aqbalna, from aqbala, to come forward (3 f. pl. perfect); 'they came forward'
وَاصْطَفَيْنَ: وَ + اصْطَفَّ — wa-, and + iṣṭaffa, to range oneself in a row (3 f. pl. perfect; printed with yāʾ, read iṣṭafayna); 'and they ranged themselves'
مُقَابِلِينَ: مُقَابِل — muqābil, facing (m. pl. acc.), agreeing with the five girls; 'facing'
لِخَمْسَةٍ: لِـ + خَمْسَة — li-, to, toward (after muqābil, 'facing') + khamsa, five, gen.; 'toward five'
بِعِشْرِينَ: بِـ + عِشْرِين — bi-, (1) marking what suddenly appears (after wa-idhā, 'and behold'); (2) after atā/ātī, 'come with, bring' + ʿishrīn, twenty, gen.; 'twenty' / 'with twenty'
نُهَّدٌ: نُهَّد — nuhhad, full-breasted, firm-breasted girls (pl. of nāhid), nom. indefinite
أَبْكَارٌ: أَبْكَار — abkār, virgins (pl. of bikr), nom. indefinite
وَبَيْنَهُمُ: وَ + بَيْن + هِمُ — wa-, and + bayna, between (acc. as preposition, here a predicate) + -him, them; 'and among them'
تَقْدِرْ: قَدَرَ — qadara, to be able (3 f. sg. jussive after lam); 'was able'
حَوَا: حَوَا — first part of ḥawālayhā, 'around her', broken in the print (حوا ليها)
لَيْهَا: لَيْ + هَا — -layhā, rest of ḥawālayhā: -lay (dual of ḥawl, 'around') + -hā, her; 'around her'
وَقَبَّلْتُ: وَ + قَبَّلَ — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (1 sg. perfect); 'and I kissed'
شَرَعَتْ: شَرَعَ — sharaʿa, to begin (3 f. sg. perfect)
تَسْأَلُنِى: سَأَلَ + نِى — saʾala, to ask (3 f. sg. imperfect) + -nī, me (printed ى); 'asking me'
وَتَسْأَلُ: وَ + سَأَلَ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (3 f. sg. imperfect); 'and asking'
نَسَبِي: نَسَب + ي — nasab, lineage, descent (m.), gen. + -ī, my; 'my lineage'
فَأَجَبْتُهَا: فَـ + أَجَابَ + هَا — fa-, so + ajāba, to answer (1 sg. perfect) + -hā, her; 'so I answered her'
سَأَلَتْنِي: سَأَلَ + نِي — saʾala, to ask (3 f. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'she asked me'
خَابَتْ: خَابَ — khāba, to fail, be disappointed (3 f. sg. perfect)
تَرْبِيَتُنَا: تَرْبِيَة + نَا — tarbiya, upbringing, rearing (f.), nom. + -nā, our; 'our upbringing'
بِمَنْزِلَةِ: بِـ + مَنْزِلَة — bi-, in (bi-manzilat 'in the position of') + manzila, rank, position (f.), gen.; 'in the rank of'
وَدِيعَةُ: وَدِيعَة — wadīʿa, deposit, thing entrusted (f.), nom. in iḍāfa; 'the trust of'
قُدَّامَهَا: قُدَّام + هَا — quddām, before (acc.) + -hā, her; 'before her'
بِزَوَاجِي: بِـ + زَوَاج + ي — bi-, with (the preposition chosen by raḍiya bi-, 'be content with') + zawāj, marriage (m.), gen. + -ī, my; 'with my marriage'
أَمَرَتْنِى: أَمَرَ + نِى — amara, to command (3 f. sg. perfect) + -nī, me (printed ى); 'she bade me'
أُقِيمَ: أَقَامَ — aqāma, to stay, dwell (1 sg. subjunctive after an); 'I stay'
لَارَى: لَا + أَرَى — lā arā, 'I do not see' (lā + arā, raʾā to see, 1 sg. imperfect), printed as one word; 'I do not see'
الْوَصَائِفِ: الـ + وَصَائِف — waṣāʾif, maidservants (pl. of waṣīfa), gen.; 'the maidservants'
تَأْتِينِى: أَتَى + نِى — atā, to come (3 f. sg. imperfect; with bi-, 'bring') + -nī, me (printed ى); 'brings me'
بِالْغَدَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + غَدَاء — bi-, with (atā bi- 'come with, bring') + ghadāʾ, midday meal, lunch (m.), gen.; 'with the lunch'
وَالْعَشَاءِ: وَ + الـ + عَشَاء — wa-, and + ʿashāʾ, evening meal, supper (m.), gen.; 'and the supper'
شَاوَرَتِ: شَاوَرَ — shāwara, to consult (3 f. sg. perfect, with epenthetic kasra)
جَارِيَتِهَا: جَارِيَة + هَا — jāriya, girl, maid (f.), gen. + -hā, her; 'her maid'
فَأَرْسَلَتِ: فَـ + أَرْسَلَ — fa-, so + arsala, to send (3 f. sg. perfect); 'so she sent'
وَالْقَاضِي: وَ + الـ + قَاضِي — wa-, and + qāḍī, judge (m.), gen.; 'and the judge'
الْحَلْوِيَّاتِ: الـ + حَلْوِيَّات — ḥalwiyyāt, sweets, sweetmeats (f. pl.), acc.; 'the sweets'
وَالْأَ: وَ + الـ + أَ — wa-, and + al- + a-, first part of the word broken in the print al-aṭʿima (والا طعمة), 'and the foods'
طْعِمَةَ: طْعِمَة — -ṭʿima, rest of broken al-aṭʿima: aṭʿima, foods, dishes (pl. of ṭaʿām), acc.; 'foods'
وَفَرَّقُوا: وَ + فَرَّقَ — wa-, and + farraqa, to distribute (3 m. pl. perfect); 'and they distributed'
الْبُيُوتِ: الـ + بُيُوت — buyūt, houses (pl. of bayt), gen.; 'the houses'
وَمَكَثُوا: وَ + مَكَثَ — wa-, and + makatha, to stay, remain (3 m. pl. perfect); 'and they remained'
خُونْجَهْ: خُونْجَة — khūnja, tray (Persian khwānča), acc. as printed with final hāʾ (خونجه); 'a tray'
جُمْلَتِهِ: جُمْلَة + هِ — jumla, sum, totality (f.), gen. after min + -hi, it; 'its sum' (min jumlatihi 'among it')
خَافِقِيَّةٌ: خَافِقِيَّة — khāfiqiyya, a kind of dish or covering for one (obscure, not identified), nom. indefinite
زِيرْبَاجَةٌ: زِيرْبَاجَة — zīrbāja, a Persian dish of meat in sweet-and-sour sauce, nom. indefinite
مَحْشِيَّةٌ: مَحْشِيَّة — maḥshiyya, stuffed (f. adj.), nom. indefinite
بِالسُّكَّرِ: بِـ + الـ + سُكَّر — bi-, with (marks the stuffing: 'stuffed with') + sukkar, sugar (m.), gen.; 'with sugar'
الْمُمَسَّكُ: الـ + مُمَسَّك — mumassak, musk-scented (m. adj.), nom.; 'the musked'
صُدُورُ: صُدُور — ṣudūr, breasts (pl. of ṣadr), nom. in iḍāfa; 'breasts of'
الدَّجَاجِ: الـ + دَجَاج — dajāj, fowl, chickens (collective, m.), gen.; 'the fowl'
الْمُحَمَّرَةِ: الـ + مُحَمَّرَة — muḥammara, browned, roasted (f. adj.), gen., agreeing with the collective; 'the browned'
وَبَقِيَّةُ: وَ + بَقِيَّة — wa-, and + baqiyya, remainder (f.), nom. in iḍāfa; 'and the remainder of'
الْأَلْوَانِ: الـ + أَلْوَان — alwān, colours, kinds, dishes (pl. of lawn), gen.; 'the kinds'
مِمَّايُدْهِشُ: مِنْ + مَا + أَدْهَشَ — min, of, such as + mā, that which + yudhishu (adhasha/dahasha, to astound, 3 m. sg. imperfect), printed as one word; 'of the sort that dazzles'
الْعُقُولَ: الـ + عُقُول — ʿuqūl, minds (pl. of ʿaql), acc. (object); 'the minds'
أَمْهَلْتُ: أَمْهَلَ — amhala, to delay, linger (1 sg. perfect); 'I delayed'
بَرَكْتُ: بَرَكَ — baraka, to kneel, settle down (1 sg. perfect); 'I knelt'
الزِّيرْبَاجَةِ: الـ + زِيرْبَاجَة — zīrbāja, the dish, gen. after ʿalā; 'the zīrbāja'
بِحَسَبِ: بِـ + حَسَب — bi-, according to + ḥasab, measure, sufficiency (m.), gen.; 'according to'
الْكِفَايَةِ: الـ + كِفَايَة — kifāya, sufficiency, enough (f.), gen.; 'the sufficiency'
وَمَسَحْتُ: و + مَسَحْتُ — masaḥa, wipe (v.), 1st sg. perfect; 'and I wiped'
أَغْسِلَهُمَا: أَغْسِلَ + هُمَا — ghasala, wash (v.), 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ + -humā, them two (the two hands); 'that I wash them'
وَتَمَيْتُ: و + تَمَيْتُ — tamayta, Middle Arabic for tammaytu / tamamtu, remain, stay on (v.), 1st sg. perfect; 'and I remained'
وَأُوقِدَتِ: و + أُوقِدَتِ — awqada, kindle, light (IV v.), 3rd f. sg. passive perfect (with linking kasra before الـ); 'and were lit'
يَجْلُونَ: يَجْلُونَ — jalā, display, unveil (a bride) (v.), 3rd m. pl. imperfect indicative; 'they were displaying'
وَيُنَقِّطُونَ: و + يُنَقِّطُونَ — naqqaṭa, scatter coins as wedding-gift, shower with nuqūṭ (II v.), 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'and showering (her) with coins'
طَافَتِ: طَافَتِ — ṭāfa, go round, circle (v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect (linking kasra before الـ), subject the bride; 'she went around'
أَقْبَلُوا: أَقْبَلُوا — aqbala, advance, bring forward (IV v.), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'they brought (her) in'; also intransitive 'come forward, arrive', with ʿalā, 'come up to, reach' ('they came out at')
وَخَفَّفُوا: و + خَفَّفُوا — khaffafa, lighten, relieve (II v.), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they lightened'
خَلَوْتُ: خَلَوْتُ — khalā, be alone, be private (v.), 1st sg. perfect; 'I was alone'
أُصَدِّقْ: أُصَدِّقْ — ṣaddaqa, believe, credit (II v.), 1st sg. jussive after لَمْ; 'I did not believe'
بِوِصَالِهَا: بِـ + وِصَال + هَا — bi-, in (prep.; ṣaddaqa bi- 'believe in, trust to') + wiṣāl, union, meeting (m.) + -hā, her; 'in (the reality of) her union' ; also: after fāza, 'to win', bi- marks the prize: afūza bi-wiṣālihā, 'I win union with her'
شَمَّتْ: شَمَّتْ — shamma, smell (v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she smelled'
رَائِحَةَ: رَائِحَةَ — rāʾiḥa, smell, scent (f.), accusative, first term of a genitive phrase; 'the smell of'
شَمَّتِ: شَمَّتِ — shamma, smell (v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect (with linking kasra before الـ); 'she smelled'
الرَّائِحَةَ: الـ + رَّائِحَةَ — rāʾiḥa, smell (f.), accusative; 'the smell'
فَارْتَجَفْتُ: فَـ + ارْتَجَفْتُ — fa-, so (consecutive) + irtajafa, tremble, quake (VIII v.), 1st sg. perfect; 'so I trembled'
لَهُنَّ: لَ + هُنَّ — li-, to (prep.; dative of the person addressed) + -hunna, them (f.); 'to them'
الْمَجْنُونَ: الـ + مَجْنُونَ — majnūn, madman (m.), accusative object; 'the madman'
أَحْسِبُ: أَحْسِبُ — ḥasiba, reckon, suppose (v.), 1st sg. imperfect; 'I reckon, I supposed'
مَجْنُونُ: مَجْنُونُ — majnūn, madman (m.), vocative with ḍamma; 'O madman'
تَغْسِلْ: تَغْسِلْ — ghasala, wash (v.), 2nd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ; 'you did not wash'
لَأُجَازِيكَ: لَ + أُجَازِي + كَ — la-, surely (emphatic particle opening the oath's answer) + jāzā, requite, repay (III v.), 1st sg. imperfect + -ka, you (m.); 'I will surely repay you'
فِعْلِكَ: فِعْل + كَ — fiʿl, deed, act (m.), genitive + -ka, your (m.); 'your deed'
أَمِثْلُكَ: أَ + مِثْلُ + كَ — a-, interrogative particle + mithl, the like of (m.), nominative + -ka, you; 'does one like you'
تَنَاوَلَتْ: تَنَاوَلَتْ — tanāwala, take, take up (VI v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she took'
مَضْفُورًا: مَضْفُورًا — maḍfūr, plaited (pass. part. of ḍafara), accusative adj.; 'plaited'
مَقَاعِدِي: مَقَاعِد + ي — maqāʿid (sing. maqʿad), seat, buttocks (m.), genitive after عَلَى + -ī, my; 'my backside'
لِلْجَوَارِ: لِـ + الـ + جَوَارِ — li-, to (prep., dative of the person addressed) + jawārī, slave-girls (pl.), genitive; 'to the girls'
خُذُوهُ: خُذُ + وهُ — akhadha, take (v.), 2nd m. pl. imperative + -hu, him; 'take him'
وَامْضُوا: و + امْضُوا — wa-, and + maḍā, go, go off (v.), 2nd m. pl. imperative; 'and go off'
مُتَوَلِّى: مُتَوَلِّى — mutawallī, governor (act. part. of V tawallā, 'take charge'), genitive, first term of construct, ي printed ى; 'the governor of'
الزِّيرْبَاجَةَ: الـ + زِّيرْبَاجَةَ — zīrbāja, zīrbāja (f.), accusative object; 'the zīrbāja'
يَغْسِلْهَا: يَغْسِلْ + هَا — ghasala, wash (v.), 3rd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ + -hā, it (the hand); 'he did not wash it'
تُقْطَعُ: تُقْطَعُ — quṭiʿa, be cut off (v. passive of qaṭaʿa), 3rd f. sg. imperfect passive; 'is cut off'
أَكْلِ: أَكْلِ — akl, eating (m. verbal noun), genitive in construct; 'eating'
وَلَاغَسَلْتُهَا: و + لَا + غَسَلْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + lā, not (neg.) + ghasala, wash (v.), 1st sg. perfect + -hā, it (the hand), printed as one word; 'and not having washed it'
فَدَخَلْنَ: فَـ + دَخَلْنَ — fa-, so (consecutive) + dakhala, enter (v.), 3rd f. pl. perfect; 'so (they) entered'
تُؤَاخِذِيهِ: تُؤَاخِذِي + هِ — wākhadha, hold to account, blame (III v.), 2nd f. sg. jussive (prohibition) + -hi, him; 'do not hold him to account'
بِفِعْلِهِ: بِـ + فِعْل + هِ — bi-, for (prep.; wākhadha bi- 'take to task for') + fiʿl, deed (m.), genitive + -hi, his; 'for his deed'
أَطْرَافِهِ: أَطْرَاف + هِ — aṭrāf (sing. ṭaraf), extremities, limbs (m. pl.), genitive after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'of his extremities'
الْعَشَرَةِ: الـ + عَشَرَةِ — ʿashara, ten (f.), genitive after بَعْدَ; the article is on the number (not Classical); 'the ten'
أُصْلِحُ: أُصْلِحُ — aṣlaḥa, set right, mend (IV v.), 1st sg. imperfect; colloquial 'I'll fix, I'll sort out'
فَكَتَّفُونِي: فَـ + كَتَّفُوا + نِي — fa-, so (consecutive) + kattafa, bind the arms of, truss (II v.), 3rd m. pl. perfect + -nī, me; 'so they bound me'
مُوسَى: مُوسَى — mūsā, razor (f./m.), accusative with tanwīn omitted (indeclinable -ā); 'a razor' Also the proper name Mūsā, Moses (indeclinable): ilāhi Mūsā wa-Ibrāhīma, 'God of Moses and Abraham' (Night 190).
ضِيًا: ضِيًا — ḍiyan, second half of māḍiyan, 'sharp' (mā printed separately; ma + ḍiyan = māḍiyan), accusative adj. agreeing with مُوسَى; 'sharp'
وَقَطَعَتْ: و + قَطَعَتْ — wa-, and + qaṭaʿa, cut off (v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'and she cut off'
إِبْهَا: إِبْهَا — ibhā, first half of ibhāmātī, 'my thumbs' (ibhām, thumb, f.), printed as two words; 'thumbs'
مَاتِي: مَاتِي — mātī, second half of ibhāmātī (ibhām-āt, thumbs, pl. + -ī, my); 'my thumbs'
تَرَوْنَ: تَرَوْنَ — raʾā, see (v.), 2nd m. pl. imperfect indicative; 'you see'
ذَرَّتْ: ذَرَّتْ — dharra, sprinkle (v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'she sprinkled'
بِالذَّرُورِ: بِـ + الـ + ذَّرُورِ — bi-, with (prep.; dharra ʿalā X bi-Y: the bi- names the powder sprinkled) + dharūr, styptic powder (m.); 'the powder'
فَانْقَطَعَ: فَـ + انْقَطَعَ — fa-, so (consecutive) + inqaṭaʿa, stop, be cut off (VII v.), 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'so stopped'
أَغْسِلَ: أَغْسِلَ — ghasala, wash (v.), 1st sg. subjunctive after حَتَّى; 'I wash'
مِيثَاقًا: مِيثَاقًا — mīthāq, covenant, solemn pledge (m.), accusative with tanwīn; 'a pledge'
الزِّبْرِبَاجَةَ: الـ + زِّبْرِبَاجَةَ — zibribāja, the printed (likely slipped) spelling of zīrbāja (f.), accusative; 'the zīrbāja'
غَصَبْتُمْ: غَصَبْتُمْ — ghaṣaba, compel, use force (v.), 2nd m. pl. perfect; with ʿalā, 'you forced me'
لَابُدَّأَنْ: لَابُدَّأَنْ — lā, no + budd, escape (m.) + an, that (conj.), printed as one word; 'there is no avoiding that'
أُوفِيَ: أُوفِيَ — awfā, fulfil (IV v.), 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'that I fulfil'
الْحَاضِرُونَ: الـ + حَاضِرُونَ — ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara), nominative m. pl., used as a noun; 'the company present'
الْخِلَافَةِ: الـ + خِلَافَةِ — khilāfa, caliphate (f.), genitive, second term; 'the caliphate'
يَحْسُنُ: يَحْسُنُ — ḥasuna, be fitting, be good (v.), 3rd m. sg. imperfect; with لَا, 'it is not fitting'
مَقَامُنَا: مَقَام + نَا — maqām, staying, abode (m.), nominative + -nā, our; 'our staying'
غَيْرُكَ: غَيْرُ + كَ — ghayr, other than, besides (m.), nominative, first term of construct + -ka, you (m.); 'other than you'
وَمَادَ: و + مَاد — wa-, and + mād, first half of mā dakhal(tu), 'did not enter'; mā + the verb's first syllable, printed split; 'and I did not'
خَلْتُ: خَلْتُ — khalta, second half of dakhaltu (dakhala, enter, 1st sg. perfect), printed as a split; 'enter'
بِعِنَايَةِ: بِـ + عِنَايَةِ — bi-, through, by means of (prep.) + ʿināya, care, favor (f.), genitive, first term of construct; 'through the favor of'
وَاشْتَرِ: و + اشْتَرِ — wa-, and + ishtarā, buy (VIII v.), 2nd m. sg. imperative; 'and buy'
دَارًا: دَارًا — dār, house (f.), accusative with tanwīn; 'a house'
فَسِيحَةً: فَسِيحَةً — fasīḥ, spacious, roomy (adj.), f. accusative; 'spacious'
وَنَقَلْتُ: و + نَقَلْتُ — wa-, and + naqala, move, transfer (v.), 1st sg. perfect; 'and I moved'
النِّعَمِ: الـ + نِّعَمِ — niʿam (sing. niʿma), blessings, comforts (f. pl.), genitive after مِنَ; 'the comforts'
ادَّخَرَتْهُ: ادَّخَرَتْ + هُ — iddakhara, store up, lay by (VIII v.), 3rd f. sg. perfect + -hu, it (relative-clause pronoun); 'she had laid by'
وَالتُّحَفِ: و + الـ + تُّحَفِ — wa-, and + tuḥaf (sing. tuḥfa), rarities, curios (f. pl.), genitive; 'and the curios'
وَانْصَرَفْنَا: و + انْصَرَفْنَا — wa-, and + inṣarafa, depart (VII v.), 1st pl. perfect; 'and we departed'
بِأَعْذَبَ: بِـ + أَعْذَبَ — bi-, marking the predicate after the negative mā that ends the preceding unit (mā hādhā bi-, 'this is not'); aʿdhab, sweeter, more pleasant (elative of عَذْب, sweet); 'sweeter than'
حَدِيثُ: حَدِيث — ḥadīth, tale (m.); nominative subject in construct; 'the tale of'
أَعْذَبُ: أَعْذَبُ — aʿdhab, sweeter, more pleasant (elative of عَذْب); nominative predicate; 'sweeter'
أَنْتُمُ: أَنْتُمُ — antum, you (m. pl. independent pronoun), here repeated for emphasis; 'you yourselves'
بِحَدِيثٍ: بِـ + حَدِيث — bi-, with (the preposition ḥaddatha takes for the tale told, 'tell with a tale'); ḥadīth, tale (m.), genitive indefinite; 'a tale'
مَاعِنْدَكَ: مَا + عِنْدَ + كَ — mā, what (relative); ʿinda, at, with (prep. of possession); -ka, you (m. sing.); 'what you have'
شَبَابِي: شَبَاب + ي — shabāb, youth (m.); -ī, my; 'my youth'
وَتَعَلَّمْتُ: و + تَعَلَّمْتُ — wa-, and + taʿallamtu, I learned, studied (V, 1st sing. perf. of تَعَلَّمَ); 'and I studied'
الصَّاحِبِ: الـ + صَاحِب — al-, the + ṣāḥib, companion, lord; title of a vizier or great official (m.); genitive in construct; 'the Ṣāḥib'
بِدِمَشْقَ: بِـ + دِمَشْق — bi-, in (prep. of place) + Dimashq, Damascus (diptote); 'in Damascus'
وَتَوَجَّهْتُ: و + تَوَجَّهْتُ — wa-, and + tawajjahtu, I turned my face, set out (V, 1st sing. perf. of تَوَجَّهَ); 'and I set out'
مَرِيضٌ: مَرِيض — marīḍ, sick, ill (m.); nominative adjective; 'sick'
وَهُوَشَابٌّ: و + هُوَ + شَابّ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + huwa, he (independent pronoun) + shābb, youth, young man (m.), predicate; the print joins the three; 'and he a youth'
يُرَأَحْسَنُ: يُرَ + أَحْسَنُ — yura, was seen (jussive, passive of رَأَى, to see; the final long vowel dropped) + aḥsan, more beautiful, finer (elative of حَسَن; nominative, subject of the passive); the print joins the two; 'none fairer was seen'
عِنْدَرَأْسِهِ: عِنْدَ + رَأْس + هِ — ʿinda, at, by (prep.); raʾs, head (m.), genitive in construct; -hi, his; the print joins the three; 'at his head'
بِالشِّفَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + شِفَاء — bi-, for (prep.; the object prayed for after daʿā lahu) + al-, the + shifāʾ, healing, recovery (m.); 'for healing'
بِسَلَامَتِكَ: بِـ + سَلَامَة + كَ — bi-, with, by (prep.; polite formula 'if you please') + salāma, safety, well-being (f.) + -ka, your (m. sing.); 'if you please'
الْيُسْرَى: الـ + يُسْرَى — al-, the + yusrā, left (f. of أَيْسَر), accusative adjective; 'the left'
وَنَاقِصُ: و + نَاقِص — wa-, and + nāqiṣ, lacking, deficient (active participle of نَقَصَ; m.), nominative in construct; 'and lacking in'
أَدَبٍ: أَدَب — adab, manners, good breeding (m.), genitive in construct; 'manners'
جَسَيْتُ: جَسَيْتُ — jasaytu, I felt, palpated (I, 1st sing. perf.; vernacular final-weak form of جَسَّ, Classical jasastu); 'I felt'
مَفَاصِلَهُ: مَفَاصِل + هُ — mafāṣil, joints (pl. of مَفْصِل), accusative object; -hu, his; 'his joints'
أَتَرَدَّدُ: أَتَرَدَّدُ — ataraddadu, I go back and forth, visit repeatedly (V, impf. 1st sing. of تَرَدَّدَ); 'going to and fro'
تَعَافَى: تَعَافَى — taʿāfā, to recover (VI, 3rd m. sing. perf. of تَعَافَى); 'he recovered'
وَاغْتَسَلَ: و + اغْتَسَلَ — wa-, and + ightasala, he washed himself (VIII, 3rd m. sing. perf. of اِغْتَسَلَ); 'and washed'
فَخَلَعَ: فَـ + خَلَعَ — fa-, and then + khalaʿa, to pull off, take off (verb I, perf. 3ms): khalaʿa al-bāba, 'he wrenched off the door'; khalaʿa ʿalā, 'to confer a robe of honour on'; 'and he pulled off'
مُبَاشِرًا: مُبَاشِر — mubāshir, overseer, supervisor (active participle of بَاشَرَ, III), accusative; 'an overseer'
الْمَارِسْتَانِ: الـ + مَارِسْتَان — al-, the + māristān, hospital (m.; Persian loanword), genitive after fī; 'the hospital'
بِدِ: بِـ + دِ(مَشْق) — bi-, in (prep. of place) + di-, first part of Dimashq, Damascus, split from the rest by the print; 'in Da-'
مَشْقَ: (دِ)مَشْقَ — -mashq-, second part of Dimashq, Damascus (diptote), split in the print: bid + mashq read as bi-Dimashq; '-mascus'
جَمِيعَهُ: جَمِيع + هُ — jamīʿ, all, whole (m.), accusative in apposition; -hu, it (the bath); 'all of it'
الْخَدَمُ: الـ + خَدَم — al-, the + khadam, servants (collective, treated as f. sing.), nominative; 'the servants'
تَعَرَّى: تَعَرَّى — taʿarrā, to strip, be naked (V, 3rd m. sing. perf. of تَعَرَّى); 'he was stripped'
قُطِعَتْ: قُطِعَتْ — quṭiʿat, was cut off (I passive, 3rd f. sing. perf. of قَطَعَ, to cut); 'was cut off'
ضَعْفِهِ: ضَعْف + هِ — ḍaʿf, weakness (m.), genitive in construct; -hi, his; 'his weakness'
حَزِنْتُ: حَزِنْتُ — ḥazintu, I grieved (I, 1st sing. perf. of حَزِنَ); 'I grieved'
آثَارَ: آثَار — āthār, traces, marks (pl. of أَثَر), accusative object in construct; 'marks of'
مَقَارِعَ: مَقَارِع — maqāriʿ, whips, scourges (pl. of مِقْرَعَة), diptote genitive; 'whips'
وَاسْتَعْمَلَ: و + اسْتَعْمَلَ — wa-, and + istaʿmala, to use, apply (X, 3rd m. sing. perf.); 'and had used'
الْأَدْهَانَ: الـ + أَدْهَان — al-, the + adhān, ointments, salves (pl. of دُهْن), accusative object; 'the salves'
جْلِ: (أَ)جْلِ — -jl-, rest of ajl, sake, reason (m.), genitive after li-; the split li-a|jl reads li-ajli dhālika, 'because of that'; 'sake'
فَتَوَسْوَسْتُ: فـ + تَوَسْوَسْتُ — fa-, and so + tawaswastu, I became uneasy (Iq, 1st sing. perf. of تَوَسْوَسَ, from وَسْوَسَ, to whisper); 'and I was uneasy'
وَفَهِمَ: و + فَهِمَ — wa-, and + fahima, he understood (I, 3rd m. sing. perf. of فَهِمَ); 'and understood'
لَى: لِـ + ي — li-, to (prep.) + -ī, me (spelt with ى in the print); 'to me'
حَكِيمَ: حَكِيم — ḥakīm, wise man, physician (m.), accusative in construct (vocative); 'physician of'
لَاتَعْجَبْ: لَا + تَعْجَبْ — lā, do not (prohibitive) + taʿjab, you marvel (jussive, 2nd m. sing. of عَجِبَ, to marvel); the print joins the two; 'do not marvel'
فَسَوْفَ: فـ + سَوْفَ — fa-, for, and so + sawfa, soon, shall (future particle before an imperfect); 'for soon'
بِحَدِيثِي: بِـ + حَدِيث + ي — bi-, with (the preposition ḥaddatha takes for the tale told) + ḥadīth, tale + -ī, my; 'my tale'
تَخْرُجَ: تَخْرُجَ — takhruja, you go out (subjunctive after ḥattā, 2nd m. sing. of خَرَجَ); 'you go out'
وَأَتَيْنَا: و + أَتَيْنَا — wa-, and + atayna, we came (I, 1st pl. perf. of أَتَى); 'and came'
وَاسْتَرَحْنَا: و + اسْتَرَحْنَا — wa-, and + istaraḥnā, we rested (X, 1st pl. perf. of اسْتَرَاحَ); 'and rested'
تَتَفَرَّجَ: تَتَفَرَّجَ — tatafarraja, you take your ease, look about (subjunctive after an, V, 2nd m. sing. of تَفَرَّجَ); 'take your ease'
الْغُرْفَةِ: الـ + غُرْفَة — al-, the + ghurfa, upper room, chamber (f.), genitive after fī; 'the upper room'
يُطْلِعُوا: يُطْلِعُوا — yuṭliʿū, they bring up, carry up (subjunctive after an, IV, 3rd m. pl. of أَطْلَعَ); 'carry up'
الْفُرُشَ: الـ + فُرُش — al-, the + furush, furnishings, carpets and bedding (pl. of فِرَاش), accusative object; 'the furnishings'
فَوْقٍ: فَوْق — fawq, above, up (adv.), genitive after ilā; ilā fawq, 'upstairs'; 'up above'
يَشْوُ: يَشْوُ — yashwū, they roast (subjunctive after an, I, 3rd m. pl. of شَوَى, to roast), the plural -wā cut off in the print; 'roast'
وْاخَرُوفًا: وْا + خَرُوف — -wā, plural ending (wāw and silent alif) belonging to yashwū, landed on the next word by the print; kharūf, lamb, sheep (m.), accusative object; 'a lamb'
يَأْتُوا: يَأْتُوا — yaʾtū, they come (subjunctive after an, I, 3rd m. pl. of أَتَى); 'to come'
بِفَاكِهَةٍ: بِـ + فَاكِهَة — bi-, with (atā bi-, 'bring') + fākiha, fruit (f.), genitive indefinite; 'with fruit'
بِالْفَاكِهَةِ: بِـ + الـ + فَاكِهَة — bi-, with (atā bi-, 'bring') + al-, the + fākiha, fruit (f.); 'with the fruit'
بِحَدِيثِكَ: بِـ + حَدِيث + كَ — bi-, with (ḥaddatha takes bi- for the tale told) + ḥadīth, tale + -ka, your (m. sing.); 'your tale'
أَنَّنِي: أَنَّ + نِي — anna, that (taking the accusative) + -nī, me; 'that I'
حَكِيمُ: حَكِيم — ḥakīm, wise man, physician (m.), in the vocative (nominative) after yā; 'physician'
أَكْبَرَهُمْ: أَكْبَر + هُمْ — akbar, eldest, greatest (elative of كَبِير), accusative predicate of kāna in construct; -hum, their; 'the eldest of them'
إِخْوَتُهُ: إِخْوَة + هُ — ikhwa, brothers (pl. of أَخ), nominative; -hu, his; 'his brothers'
التِّسْعَةُ: الـ + تِسْعَة — al-, the + tisʿa, nine (f. form), nominative in apposition; 'the nine'
يُرْزَقُوا: يُرْزَقُوا — yurzaqū, they are provided (I passive, jussive 3rd m. pl. of رَزَقَ); 'they were granted'
بِأَوْلَادٍ: بِـ + أَوْلَاد — bi-, with (ruziqa bi-, 'be granted') + awlād, children (pl. of وَلَد), genitive indefinite; 'children'
فَكَبِرْتُ: فـ + كَبِرْتُ — fa-, and so + kabirtu, I grew up (I, 1st sing. perf. of كَبِرَ); 'and I grew up'
أَعْمَامِي: أَعْمَام + ي — aʿmām, paternal uncles (pl. of عَمّ), genitive after bayna; -ī, my; 'my uncles'
وَبَلَغْتُ: و + بَلَغْتُ — wa-, and + balaghtu, I reached (I, 1st sing. perf. of بَلَغَ); 'and I reached'
جَامِعِ: جَامِع — jāmiʿ, congregational mosque (m.), genitive in construct; 'the great mosque of'
وَصَلَّيْنَا: و + صَلَّيْنَا — wa-, and + ṣallaynā, we prayed (II, 1st pl. perf. of صَلَّى); 'and we prayed'
الْجُمُعَةَ: الـ + جُمُعَة — al-, the + jumuʿa, Friday (prayer) (f.), accusative object; 'the Friday prayer'
وَأَعْمَامِي: و + أَعْمَام + ي — wa-, and + aʿmām, paternal uncles + -ī, my; 'and my uncles'
عَجَائِبِ: عَجَائِب — ʿajāʾib, wonders (pl. of عَجِيبَة), genitive in construct; 'the wonders of'
وَغَرَائِبِ: و + غَرَائِب — wa-, and + gharāʾib, strange things, marvels (pl. of غَرِيبَة), genitive in construct; 'and the marvels of'
ذَكَرُوا: ذَكَرُوا — dhakarū, they mentioned (I, 3rd m. pl. perf. of ذَكَرَ); 'they mentioned'
الْمُسَافِرُونَ: الـ + مُسَافِرُونَ — al-, the + musāfirūn, travellers (active participle pl. of سَافَرَ, III), nominative; 'the travellers'
وَنِيلِهَا: و + نِيل + ـهَا — wa-, and + Nīl, the Nile (m.), gen. after min + -hā, its/her (referring to Miṣr); 'and its Nile'
تَشَوَّقْتُ: تَشَوَّقَ — tashawwaqa (V), long for, yearn; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); 'I longed (for)'
الْمِصْرَ: الـ + مِصْر — al-, the + miṣr, Egypt (with the article, as printed); acc. object; 'Egypt'
تُرَابُهَا: تُرَاب + ـهَا — turāb, dust, earth (m.), nom. subject + -hā, its; 'its dust'
وَنِيلُهَا: و + نِيل + ـهَا — wa-, and + Nīl, the Nile (m.), nom. subject + -hā, its; 'and its Nile'
وَنِسَاؤُهَا: و + نِسَاء + ـهَا — wa-, and + nisāʾ, women (pl. of imraʾa), nom. subject + -hā, its; 'and its women'
حُورٌ: حُور — ḥūr, houris, black-eyed beauties (pl. of ḥawrāʾ); nom. predicate; 'houris'
وَبُيُوتُهَا: و + بُيُوت + ـهَا — wa-, and + buyūt, houses (pl. of bayt), nom. subject + -hā, its; 'and its houses'
قُصُورٌ: قُصُور — quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr); nom. predicate; 'palaces'
وَهَوَا: و + هَوَا — wa-, and + hawā, air (m.); first half of the printed hawāʾuhā, split in the print; 'and its air'
ؤُهَا: ؤُ + ـهَا — second half of the printed hawāʾuhā (the hamza-on-wāw -u, nom. ending) + -hā, its; 'its'
مُعْتَدِلٌ: مُعْتَدِل — muʿtadil, temperate, balanced (act. part. VIII of ʿadala); nom. predicate; 'temperate'
يَفُوقُ: فَاقَ — fāqa, surpass, excel; imperf. 3m.sg. (indic.); 'it surpasses'
عَرْفُهُ: عَرْف + ـهُ — ʿarf, fragrance, scent (m.), nom. subject + -hu, its; 'its fragrance'
الْكِبَا: الـ + كِبَا — al-, the + kibā, aloes-wood, eaglewood incense (kibāʾ, printed without hamza); acc. object; 'the aloes-wood'
وَيُخْجِلُ: و + يُخْجِلُ — wa-, and + akhjala (IV), make ashamed, put to shame; imperf. 3m.sg. (indic.); 'and puts to shame'
وَلِلَّهِ: و + لِـ + اللَّه — wa-, and + li-, to / belonging to (prep.) + Allāh, God; 'and to God (belongs)'
شِ—رٌ: ش—ر — shiʿr, verse, poetry (m.) (the print has a dash for the ʿayn); tanwīn, as the object of qāla (the quoted words); 'verse'
اَاَرْحَلُ: أَ + أَرْحَلُ — a-, interrogative particle (a-, 'shall I?') + raḥala, depart; imperf. 1sg.; 'shall I depart'
وَطِيبِ: و + طِيب — wa-, and + ṭīb, goodness, sweetness (m.); gen. in construct; 'and the sweetness of'
نَعِيمِهَا: نَعِيم + ـهَا — naʿīm, bliss, ease (m.), gen. in construct + -hā, its; 'its bliss'
وَاَيُّ: و + أَيّ — wa-, and + ayyu, which / what (interrog., m.); nom. before makān; 'and what'
هَالِيَ: هَالِيَ — hāliya (obscure): perhaps hā lī, 'this, for me', or a slip for ḥālī, 'my state'; 'after this (state of) mine'
شَائِقُ: شَائِق — shāʾiq, alluring, delightful (act. part. of shāqa); nom. predicate of ayyu; 'alluring'
وَاَتْرُكُ: و + أَ + أَتْرُكُ — wa-, and + a-, interrogative 'shall I?' + taraka, leave; imperf. 1sg. (indic.); 'and shall I leave'
اَوْطَانًا: أَوْطَان — awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan); acc. object, tanwīn; 'homelands'
تَرَاهَا: تَرَى + ـهَا — tarā, see, regard; imperf. 2m.sg. (indic.) + -hā, them (f.); 'you see them'
لِنَا: لِـ + نَا — li-, for (prep.), first part of li-nāshiq, split by the print; 'for a (smeller)'
شِقِ: شِقِ — shiqi, second part of nāshiqin, printed li-nā shiqi; 'sniffer'
هُوَالطِّيبُ: هُوَ + الطِّيبُ — huwa, he/it (pron. 3m.) + al-, the + ṭīb, perfume, fragrance (m.); nom. (printed as one word); 'it is the perfume'
لَامَا: لَا + مَا — lā, not (neg., contrasting) + mā, what (rel.); 'not what'
ضَمَّنَتْهُ: ضَمَّنَ + ـهُ — ḍammana (II), contain, enclose; perf. 3f.sg. (-at) + -hu, it; 'it contains'
الْمَفَارِقُ: الـ + مَفَارِق — al-, the + mafāriq, hair-partings (pl. of mafriq); nom. subject; 'the partings (of the hair)'
اَضْحَتْ: أَضْحَى — aḍḥā (IV), become, come to be; perf. 3f.sg. (-at); 'it became'
جَنَّةً: جَنَّة — janna, garden (f.); acc. predicate (tanwīn); 'a garden'
زَرَابِيُّهَا: زَرَابِيّ + ـهَا — zarābiyy, carpets (pl. of zarbiyya), nom. + -hā, its; 'its carpets'
مَبْثُوثَةٌ: مَبْثُوثَة — mabthūtha, spread abroad, scattered (pass. part. of baththa); nom. f.; 'spread abroad'
وَالنَّمَارِقُ: و + الـ + نَمَارِق — wa-, and + al-, the + namāriq, cushions (pl. of numruqa); nom.; 'and the cushions'
بِلَادٌ: بِلَاد — bilād, lands, countries (pl. of balad); nom. (here, an appositive); 'lands'
تَشُوقُ: تَشُوقُ — shāqa, allure, delight; imperf. 3f.sg. (indic.); 'it allures'
وَالْقَلْبَ: و + الـ + قَلْب — wa-, and + al-, the + qalb, heart (m.); acc.; 'and the heart'
بَهْجَةً: بَهْجَة — bahja, splendour, radiance (f.); acc. of respect; 'with splendour'
وَفَاسِقُ: و + فَاسِق — wa-, and + fāsiq, sinner, transgressor (act. part. of fasaqa); nom.; 'and the sinner'
وَاِخْوَانُ: و + إِخْوَان — wa-, and + ikhwān, brothers (pl. of akh); gen.-acc. in construct; 'and brothers of'
صِدْقٍ: صِدْق — ṣidq, truth, sincerity (m.); gen. in construct; 'truth'
شَمْلَهُمْ: شَمْل + هُمْ — shaml, company, union (m.), acc. object + -hum, their; 'their company'
مَجَالِسُهُمْ: مَجَالِس + هُمْ — majālis, gatherings (pl. of majlis), nom. + -hum, their; 'their gatherings'
حَوَوْهُ: حَوَى + وْا + هُ — ḥawā, enclose, contain; -ū, they (perf. 3m.pl.) + -hu, it; 'they contain'
حَدَائِقُ: حَدَائِق — ḥadāʾiq, gardens (pl. of ḥadīqa, diptote); nom. predicate; 'gardens'
اَسُكَّانَ: أَ + سُكَّان — a-, vocative 'O' (particle) + sukkān, dwellers (pl. of sākin); acc. in construct; 'O dwellers of'
مِصْرَانْ: مِصْر + إِنْ — Miṣr, Egypt (acc.) + in, if, run together as printed (Miṣra in); 'Egypt, if'
بِالنَّوَى: بِـ + الـ + نَوَى — bi-, with/by (prep., instrument of the decree) + al-, the + nawā, parting, separation (f.); 'with parting'
فَتَمَّ: فَـ + تَمَّ — fa-, then (apodosis particle) + tamma, be complete, be fulfilled; perf. 3m.sg.; 'then stand fulfilled'
عُهُودٌ: عُهُود — ʿuhūd, covenants (pl. of ʿahd); nom.; 'covenants'
وَمَوَاثِقُ: و + مَوَاثِق — wa-, and + mawāthiq, pledges (pl. of mīthāq, diptote); nom.; 'and pledges'
تَذْكُرُوهَا: ذَكَرَ + هَا — dhakara, mention; imperf. 2m.pl. (jussive) + -hā, her; 'mention her'
لِلنَّسِيمِ: لِـ + الـ + نَسِيم — li-, to (prep., addressee) + al-, the + nasīm, breeze (m.); 'to the breeze'
فَاِنَّهُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + ـهُ — fa-, for (causal) + inna, indeed + -hu, it (the breeze); 'for it'
لِاَمْثَالِهَا: لِـ + أَمْثَال + ـهَا — li-, for (prep.), 'of the like(s)' + amthāl, likes (pl. of mithl) + -hā, her; 'of the likes of her'
نَفْحَةِ: نَفْحَة — nafḥa, waft, breath (f.); gen. in construct; 'the waft of'
الرَّوْضِ: الـ + رَوْض — al-, the + rawḍ, meadow, garden (m.); gen. in construct; 'the meadow'
سَارِقُ: سَارِق — sāriq, thief (act. part. of saraqa); nom. predicate; 'a thief'
رَأَيْتُمْ: رَأَى — raʾā, see; -tum, you (pl.) (perf. 2m.pl.); 'you had seen'
رِيَاضَهَا: رِيَاض + ـهَا — riyāḍ, gardens, meadows (pl. of rawḍa); acc. object + -hā, its; 'its gardens'
بِالْأَ: بِـ + الـ + أَ — bi-, in/at (prep., time) + al-, the + a- (first part of aṣāʾil, split by the print); 'in the (late afternoons)'
صَائِلِ: صَائِل — ṣāʾil, second part of al-aṣāʾil, plural of aṣīl, late afternoon (m.); gen. after bi- 'in' (of time: bi-al-aṣāʾil, 'in the late afternoons'); 'afternoons'
مَائِلٌ: مَائِل — māʾil, leaning, slanting (act. part. of māla); nom. predicate; 'leaning'
لَشَاهَدْتُمْ: لَـ + شَاهَدَ — la-, then (apodosis particle after law) + shāhada (III), behold, witness; -tum, you (pl.) (perf. 2m.pl.); 'you would have beheld'
وَمِلْتُمْ: و + مِلْتُمْ — wa-, and + māla, incline; -tum, you (pl.) (perf. 2m.pl.); 'and you would have inclined'
يُوَصِّفُونَ: وَصَّفَ — waṣṣafa (II), describe at length; imperf. 3m.pl. (-ūna); 'they describe'
وَنِيلَهَا: و + نِيل + ـهَا — wa-, and + Nīl, the Nile (m.), acc. + -hā, its; 'and its Nile'
الْأَوْصَافَ: الـ + أَوْصَاف — al-, the + awṣāf, descriptions, attributes (pl. of waṣf); acc. object; 'the descriptions'
يَأْتِنِي: أَتَى — atā, come; imperf. 3m.sg. (jussive after lam); + -nī, to me (the object suffix, with the verb's nūn al-wiqāya); 'did not come to me'
شَغَفِي: شَغَف + ـِي — shaghaf, passion, ardent love (m.), gen. after min + -ī, my; 'my passion'
يَهْنَئُ: هَنَأَ — hanaʾa, be wholesome, pleasant; imperf. 3m.sg. (indic.), printed yahniʾ; 'is pleasant'
تَجَهَّزَ: تَجَهَّزَ — tajahhaza (V), equip oneself, make ready; perf. 3m.sg.; 'he made ready'
جَهَّزَلِي: جَهَّزَ + لِـ + ـِي — jahhaza (II), equip, fit out (perf. 3m.sg.) + li-, for (prep.) + -ī, me (printed as one word); 'he equipped for me'
تَدَعُوهُ: وَدَعَ — wadaʿa, leave, let; imperf. 2m.pl. after lā (prohibitive, jussive) + -hu, him; 'do not let him'
وَدَعُوهُ: و + دَعُوهُ — wa-, and + daʿa, leave, let (imper. 2m.pl.) + -hu, him; 'and let him'
وَوَدَّعْتُ: و + وَدَّعَ — wa-, and + waddaʿa (II), bid farewell to; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); 'and I bade farewell to'
وَخَرَجْنَا: و + خَرَجَ — wa-, and + kharaja, go out; -nā, we (perf. 1pl.); 'and we went out'
زِلْنَا: زَالَ — zāla, cease; -nā, we (perf. 1sg.→1pl.); mā zāla + part. = 'keep on being'; 'we kept on'
فَأَقَمْنَا: فَـ + أَقَامَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + aqāma (IV), stay, reside; -nā, we (perf. 1pl.); 'so we stayed'
فَرَأَيْنَاهَا: فَـ + رَأَى — fa-, so/then (connective) + raʾā, see; -nā, we (perf. 1pl.) + -hā, it/her (f.); 'so we saw it'
وَأَنْهَارٍ: و + أَنْهَار — wa-, and + anhār, rivers (pl. of nahr); gen.; 'and rivers'
وَأَثْمَارٍ: و + أَثْمَار — wa-, and + athmār, fruits (pl. of thamar); gen.; 'and fruits'
وَأَطْيَارٍ: و + أَطْيَار — wa-, and + aṭyār, birds (pl. of ṭayr); gen.; 'and birds'
فَاكِهَةٍ: فَاكِهَة — fākiha, fruit (f.); gen. in construct; 'fruit'
فَنَزَلْنَا: فَـ + نَزَلَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + nazala, alight, put up; -nā, we (perf. 1pl.); 'so we put up' Also of leaving a boat, 'to go ashore': fa-nazalnā ʿalā al-barri, 'and we went ashore'.
وَوَقَفُوا: و + وَقَفَ — wa-, and + waqafa, stand; with a following verb, set about; -ū, they (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and they stood'
عُوا: عُوا — ʿū, second part of bāʿū, the perf. 3m.pl. of bāʿa, sell (ending -ū); 'sold'
وَاشْتَرَوْا: و + اشْتَرَى — wa-, and + ishtarā (VIII), buy; -ū, they (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and bought'
وَبَاعُوا: و + بَاعَ — wa-, and + bāʿa, sell; -ū, they (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and they sold'
فَرَبِحَ: فَـ + رَبِحَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + ribḥa, profit, gain; perf. 3m.sg.; 'so it made a profit'
الدِّرْهَمُ: الـ + دِرْهَم — al-, the + dirham, silver coin (m.); nom. subject; 'the dirham'
بِالرِّبْحِ: بِـ + الـ + رِبْح — bi-, in/over (prep., object of the rejoicing) + al-, the + ribḥ, profit (m.); 'in the profit'
وَتَوَجَّهُوا: و + تَوَجَّهَ — wa-, and + tawajjaha (V), head for; -ū, they (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and they set off'
بَعْدَهُمْ: بَعْد + هُمْ — baʿd, after, behind (adv./prep.), acc. + -hum, them; 'after them'
وَمَكَثْتُ: و + مَكَثَ — wa-, and + makatha, stay, dwell; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); 'and I dwelt'
مَلِيحَةِ: مَلِيحَة — malīḥa, fine, handsome (f. adj.); gen. in adjectival construct with al-bunyān; 'fine (of)'
وَصْفِهَا: وَصْف + ـهَا — waṣf, describing (verbal noun, m.), gen. after ʿan + -hā, it (f.); 'describing it'; also: gen. after fī: ikhtaṣartu fī waṣfihā, 'I have been brief in describing her' (Night 179)
اللِّسَانُ: الـ + لِسَان — al-, the + lisān, tongue (m.); nom. subject; 'the tongue'
آجَرْتُهَا: آجَرَ — ājara (III), hire, rent (as printed with madda); -tu, I (perf. 1sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'I rented it'
وَأَشْرَبُ: و + أَشْرَبُ — wa-, and + shariba, drink; imperf. 1sg. (indic.); 'and I drink'
بِصَبِيَّةٍ: بِـ + صَبِيَّة — bi-, marks what appears after idhā (not a prep. of meaning; see wa-idhā) + ṣabiyya, young woman, girl (f.); gen.; 'a young woman'
رَأَتْ: رَأَى — raʾā, see; perf. 3f.sg. (-at), subject ʿaynī (printed with precomposed hamza); 'saw'; here: subject Budūr
فَغَمَزْتُ: فَـ + غَمَزَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + ghamaza, wink, make a sign; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); 'so I winked'
قَصَّرَتْ: قَصَّرَ — qaṣṣara (II), fall short, hold back; perf. 3f.sg.; 'she held back'
فَرَدَدْتُ: فَـ + رَدَّ — fa-, so/then (connective) + radda, shut, push back; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); 'so I shut' Also radda, to return, give back: fa-radadtu ʿalayhā al-salāma, 'and I returned her greeting'.
نِقَابَهَا: نِقَاب + ـهَا — niqāb, face-veil (m.), acc. object + -hā, her; 'her veil'
إِزَارَهَا: إِزَار + ـهَا — izār, wrap, outer garment (m.), acc. object + -hā, her; 'her wrap'
بَدِيعَةً: بَدِيعَة — badīʿa, wondrous, marvellous (f. adj.); acc. state; 'wondrous'
فَتَمَكَّنَ: فَـ + تَمَكَّنَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + tamakkana (V), take firm hold; perf. 3m.sg.; 'and it took hold'
خُوبَخَهْ: خُوبَخَه — khūbakha (obscure, perhaps corrupt), perhaps a spread of food or a basket; acc. object; '(a spread)'
أَطْيَبِ: أَطْيَب — aṭyab, choicest, best (elative of ṭayyib); gen. in construct; 'the choicest of'
الْمَأْكُولِ: الـ + مَأْكُول — al-, the + maʾkūl, what is eaten, food (pass. part. of akala); gen.; 'the foods'
وَالْفَاكِهَةِ: و + الـ + فَاكِهَة — wa-, and + al-, the + fākiha, fruit (f.); gen.; 'and the fruit'
الْمَقَامُ: الـ + مَقَام — al-, the + maqām, occasion, situation (m.); nom. subject; 'the occasion'
وَأَتَيْتُ: و + أَتَى — wa-, and + atā, come; -tu, I (perf. 1sg.); with bi-, 'bring'; 'and I brought' Also without bi-, simply 'I came': وَأَتَيْتُ إِلَى دَارِي 'and I came to my house'.
اللَّعِبِ: الـ + لَعِب — al-, the + laʿib, play, sport (verbal noun, m.); gen. in construct; 'the sport'
سَكِرْنَا: سَكِرَ — sakira, be drunk; -nā, we (perf. 1pl.); 'we were drunk'
فَعَبَسَتْ: فَـ + عَبَسَ — fa-, so/then (connective) + ʿabasa, frown, scowl; perf. 3f.sg.; 'so she frowned'
وَقَطَّبَتْ: و + قَطَّبَ — wa-, and + qaṭṭaba (II), knit (the brows); perf. 3f.sg.; 'and she knit'
حَاجِبَيْهَا: حَاجِب + ـهَا — ḥājib, eyebrow (m.), dual acc. (-ayhā) + -hā, her; 'her brows'
وَزَعِلَتْ: و + زَعِلَ — wa-, and + zaʿila, be vexed, angry (colloquial); perf. 3f.sg.; 'and she was vexed'
أُفٍّ: uff — interjection of disgust, 'fie, ugh' (indef. gen., the tanwīn of the exclamation)
يَامُوَاصِلَةُ: يَا + مُوَاصِلَةُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + muwāṣila, those who keep up a connection, company-keepers (obscure; read as pl. of muwāṣil, nom.; the word may be corrupt); printed as one word; 'O company-keepers'
تَظُنُّ: ta- + ẓunnu — ẓanna, to think, suppose (impf. 2nd m. sg., indic.); 'you think'
طَامِعَةٌ: ṭāmiʿa, covetous, greedy (f. sg. act. part. of ṭamiʿa, indef. nom.; predicate)
أَخْرَجَتْ: akhraja, to bring out, take out (IV, perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'she brought out'
قَمِيصِهَا: qamīṣ + -hā — qamīṣ, shirt (m., gen. second term of iḍāfa) + her; 'her shirt'
وَخَلَّتْ: و + خَلَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + khallā, to leave, set down (II, perf. 3rd f. sg.; colloquial-leaning); 'and she left, laid down'
تَأْخُذْهَا: ta- + akhudh + -hā — akhadha, to take (impf. 2nd m. sg., jussive after lam) + them (f., the dinars); 'you take them'
أَعُدْ: a- + ʿud — ʿāda, to return (impf. 1st sg., jussive after lam, short vowel by the hollow root); 'I return'
فَقَبِلْتُهَا: فَـ + قَبِلْ + تُ + هَا — fa-, so, and so (conj. of sequence) + qabila, to accept (perf.) + -tu, I + -hā, them (the dinars); 'so I accepted them'
انْتَظِرْنِي: intaẓir + -nī — intaẓara, to wait for (VIII, imper. m. sg.; takes a direct object) + me; 'wait for me'
ثَلٰثَةِ: thalātha, three (numeral, gen. before 'days'; the edition prints ثلثة without the medial alif, restored with a dagger alif); here: here the print itself sets the dagger alif (ثلٰثة); gen. after baʿda; also gen. after ilā: ilā thalāthati ayyāmin, 'for up to three days' (Night 201)
وَالْعِشَاءِ: و + الـ + عِشَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿishāʾ, nightfall, the night prayer-time (m., gen.); 'and nightfall'
وَعَبِّ: و + عَبِّ — wa-, and + ʿabbi, to fill, pack, make ready, stock up (II, imper. m. sg.; colloquial)
بِهَٰذِهِ: بِـ + هَٰذِهِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., the means of stocking) + hādhihi, this (f. sg. demonstrative; the print has هذه); 'with these'
وَوَدَّعَتْنِي: و + وَدَّعَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + waddaʿa, to bid farewell to (II, perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and she bade me farewell'
وَانْصَرَفَتْ: و + انْصَرَفَتْ — wa-, and + inṣarafa, to go away, depart (VII, perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'and she left'
مَضَتِ: maḍat — maḍā, to pass, go by (perf. 3rd f. sg.; the final -i is the helping vowel before the article of the next word)
الْمُزَرْكَشِ: الـ + مُزَرْكَش — al-, the + muzarkash, gold-embroidered cloth (m., pass. part., gen. after min); 'the embroidered stuff'
أَعْظَمُ: aʿẓam, greater, grander (elative, m., nom. diptote; the subject 'something' that was on her); also: first term of a construct with an indefinite noun, with min 'than': laysa lī aʿẓamu rāḥatin mina al-mawti, 'I have no greater relief than death' Also as an adjective with min: janāzatun aʿẓamu minhā, 'a funeral greater than it'.
عَبَّيْتُ: ʿabbā, to fill, stock, make ready (II, perf. 1st sg.; colloquial); 'I stocked, prepared'
تَحْضُرَ: ta- + ḥḍur — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend, arrive (impf. 3rd f. sg., subjunctive after an); 'she arrive'
خَمْسَهَ: khamsa, five (numeral, acc., part of 'fifteen'; the print has final hāʾ, ه)
وَاعَدَتْنِي: wāʿadat + -nī — wāʿada, to make an appointment with, promise (III, perf. 3rd f. sg.; the initial wāw is part of the stem, no separate 'and') + me; 'she made an appointment with me'
تَحْضُرُ: ta- + ḥḍuru — ḥaḍara, to attend, come (impf. 3rd f. sg., indic.); 'she would come'
مَلِيحَةٌ: malīḥa, pretty, lovely (f. sg. adj., indef. nom.; predicate); also of a plan, 'fine, clever': ḥīlatun malīḥatun, 'a fine ruse' (Night 201)
تَأْذَنُ: ta- + ʾdhanu — adhina, to permit, give leave (impf. 2nd m. sg., indic.; the edition prints the precomposed hamza); 'you permit'
أَجِيبَ: a- + jība — jāba, to bring (colloquial, for Classical jāʾa bi-; impf. 1st sg., subjunctive after an); 'I bring'
وَأَصْغَرَ: و + أَصْغَرَ — wa-, and + aṣghara, smaller, younger (elative, diptote acc.); 'and younger'
سِنًّامِنِّي: sinnan + minnī — sinn, age, years (m., indef. acc. of specification, tamyīz) + min, than (prep.) + -ī, me; the print runs the two words together; 'in age than I'
وَتَضْحَكَ: و + تَضْحَكَ — wa-, and + ta- + ḍḥaka — ḍaḥika, to laugh (impf. 3rd f. sg., subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and she laugh'
وَإِيَّا: و + إِيَّا — wa-, and + iyyā, the base of the independent object pronoun; left without its verb, the text is elliptical or corrupt; with the next word, 'and her'
وَتَنْشَرِحَ: و + تَنْشَرِحَ — wa-, and + ta- + nshariḥa — insharaḥa, to be opened up, be eased, be cheered (VII, impf. 3rd f. sg., subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and be eased'
مَحْزُونَةٌ: maḥzūna, sorrowful, grieved (f. sg. pass. part. of ḥazina, indef. nom.; predicate)
وَتَبَاتَ: و + تَبَاتَ — wa-, and + ta- + bāta — bāta, to spend the night (impf. 3rd f. sg., subjunctive; the long-ā shape is spoken-style, Classical tabīta); 'and spend the night'
عَشْرَةَ: ʿashra, ten (numeral, acc., part of 'fifteen'; the print has tāʾ marbūṭa with the sukūn-form of ʿashr)
زِدْ: zid — zāda, to increase, add (imper. m. sg.; hollow root); 'add, increase'
الرَّابِعُ: الـ + رَابِع — al-, the + rābiʿ, fourth (m., nom., ordinal adjective); 'the fourth'
مَلْفُوفَةٌ: malfūfa, wrapped (f. sg. pass. part. of laffa, indef. nom.; describing wāḥida)
فَدَخَلُوا: فَـ + دَخَلُوا — fa-, so, and so (conj. of sequence) + dakhala, to enter (perf. 3rd m. pl.; plural for the two women); 'so they entered'
شِعْرً: shiʿr, poetry, verses (m., indef. acc. object; the print has شعر without alif); 'verse'
اَطْيَبَ: aṭyaba, how sweet (elative in an exclamation, mā aṭyaba, 'how sweet!'; the print puts fatḥa on a bare alif)
وَقْتَنَا: waqt + -nā — waqt, time, hour (m., acc. object of the exclamation) + our; 'our time'
وَاهْنَى: و + اهْنَى — wa-, and + ahnā, how pleasant (elative, mā aṭyaba ... wa-ahnā), 'and how delightful'
وَالْعَاذِلُ: و + الـ + عَاذِل — wa-, and (circumstantial: while) + al-, the + ʿādhil, blamer, scolder (act. part. of ʿadhala, m., nom.); 'while the blamer'
وَغَافِل: و + غَافِل — wa-, and + ghāfil, heedless, unaware (m. act. part.; the kasra is for the rhyme)
وَمَسَرَّةٌ: و + مَسَرَّة — wa-, and + masarra, gladness, delight (f., indef. nom.)
وَسُكْرُ: و + سُكْر — wa-, and + sukr, drunkenness (m., nom.; the print gives no tanwīn)
اَلْعَقْلُ: الـ + عَقْل — al-, the + ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.; the print has fatḥa on the bare alif)
بِبَعْضِ: بِـ + بَعْض — bi-, by, through (prep., of the cause) + baʿḍ, part, some (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'by some of'
زَائِلْ: zāʾil, gone, departed, perishing (m. act. part. of zāla; the kasra and sukūn are for the rhyme)
قِنَاعٍ: qināʿ, head-veil, covering (m., indef. gen. after fī)
وَالْغُصْنُ: و + الـ + غُصْن — wa-, and + al-, the + ghuṣn, branch, bough (m., nom.); the branch is the beloved's slender body
غَلَائِل: ghalāʾil, under-robes, light shifts (pl. of ghilāla, f., gen. after fī; diptote, the kasra is as printed)
وَالْوَرْدُ: و + الـ + وَرْد — wa-, and + al-, the + ward, rose (m. coll., nom.)
غَضٌّ: ghaḍḍ, fresh, tender (m., indef. nom.; predicate)
وَالنَّرْجِسُ: و + الـ + نَرْجِس — wa-, and + al-, the + narjis, narcissus (m. coll., nom.); the narcissus is the poets' image of the eye
ذَابِل: dhābil, withered, languid, drooping (m. act. part. of dhabala; the kasra is for the rhyme)
اُحِبُّ: uḥibbu — aḥabba, to love (IV, impf. 1st sg., indic.; the print puts ḍamma on a bare alif, no hamza); 'I love'
وَالْاُنْسُ: و + الـ + اُنْس — wa-, and + al-, the + uns, intimacy, companionship (m., nom.; the print puts ḍamma on a bare alif)
كَامِل: kāmil, perfect, complete (m. act. part. of kamula; the kasra is for the rhyme)
وَأَوْقَدْتُ: و + أَوْقَدْتُ — wa-, and + awqada, to light, kindle (IV, perf. 1st sg.); 'and I lit'
الشَّمْعَ: الـ + شَمْع — al-, the + shamʿ, wax, candles (m. coll., acc. object); 'the candles'
وَالْتَقَيْتُهُمْ: و + الْتَقَيْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + iltaqā, to meet (VIII, perf. 1st sg.; takes a direct object) + -hum, them; 'and I met them'
بِالْفَرَحِ: بِـ + الـ + فَرَح — bi-, with, in (prep., of manner) + al-, the + faraḥ, joy (m., gen.); 'with joy'
وَكَشَفَتِ: و + كَشَفَتِ — wa-, and + kashafa, to uncover (perf. 3rd f. sg.; the final -i is the helping vowel before the article); 'and she uncovered'
الْجَدِيدَةُ: الـ + جَدِيدَة — al-, the + jadīda, new (f. adj., nom.); 'the new'
أَرَأَحْسَنَ: a- + ra + aḥsana — raʾā, to see (impf. 1st sg., jussive after lam, short form 'ara') + aḥsana, better, lovelier (elative, diptote acc.); the print runs the two words together; 'I saw none lovelier'
