كْلَ: kl, the second part of الأكل (akl, eating, food) split off in the print; read together with the previous word, 'the food'
أُلْقِمُ: u- + lqimu — alqama, to put a morsel into the mouth of (IV, impf. 1st sg., indic.); 'I feed with morsels'
الْجَدِيدَةَ: الـ + جَدِيدَة — al-, the + jadīda, new (f. adj., acc.); 'the new'
وَأَمْلَاءُ: و + أَمْلَاءُ — wa-, and + amlaʾu, malaʾa, to fill (impf. 1st sg., indic.; the print writes a hamza after the alif); 'and I fill'
فَغَارَتِ: فَـ + غَارَتِ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ghāra, to be jealous (perf. 3rd f. sg.; the final -i is the helping vowel before the article); 'so she grew jealous'
أَظْرَفُ: aẓraf, more charming, more graceful (elative, m., nom. diptote; predicate)
تَنَامَ: ta- + nāma — nāma, to sleep (impf. 2nd m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'you sleep'
وَفَرَشَتْ: و + فَرَشَتْ — wa-, and + farasha, to spread out (bedding) (perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'and she spread'
فَتَحَرَّكْتُ: فَـ + تَحَرَّكْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + taḥarraka, to move, stir (V, perf. 1st sg.); 'so I stirred'
عَرَقٍ: ʿaraq, sweat (m., indef. gen. after fī)
فَحَسِبْتُ: فَـ + حَسِبْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥasiba, to reckon, suppose (perf. 1st sg.); 'and I supposed'
عَرْقَانُ: ʿarqān, sweating, soaked with sweat (m. adj. of the faʿlān pattern, nom.; predicate of annī)
أُنَبِّهُ: u- + nabbihu — nabbaha, to wake, rouse (II, impf. 1st sg., indic.); 'I rouse'
وَهَزَيْتُ: و + هَزَيْتُ — wa-, and + hazā, to shake (colloquial form of hazza, perf. 1st sg.); 'and I shook'
أَكْتَافَهَا: aktāf + -hā — aktāf, shoulders (pl. of katif, m., acc. object) + her; 'her shoulders'
فَتَدَ: فَـ + تَدَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tada-, the first part of tadaḥraja, 'rolled', split from its ending by a space in the print; read with the next word
حْرَجَتْ: ḥrajat — the second part of tadaḥrajat, tadaḥraja, to roll along (quadriliteral V, perf. 3rd f. sg.), split in the print; with fa-tada, 'and rolled'
الْوِسَادَةِ: الـ + وِسَادَة — wisāda, pillow, cushion (f.); gen. after min; 'the pillow'; here: gen. after ʿalā, 'on the cushion'
جَمِيلَ: jamīl, beautiful, fair (adj.), acc. as vocative in a construct; 'O fair of'
سِتْرَكَ: سِتْر + كَ — sitr, covering, veil (m.) + -ka, your (to God); acc. as a cry of petition; 'Your covering!'
مَذْبُوحَةً: madhbūḥa, slaughtered (pass. part. of dhabaḥa, f.), acc. as predicate/state; 'slaughtered'
فَنَهَضْتُ: فَـ + نَهَضْتُ — fa-, and so + nahaḍa, to rise (perf. 1 s.); 'and so I rose'
حَيْلِي: حَيْل + ي — ḥayl, strength, force (m.) + -ī, my; 'my strength'
وَطَلَبْتُ: وَ + طَلَبْتُ — wa-, and + ṭalaba, to seek (perf. 1 s.); 'and I sought'
الْقَدِيمَةَ: الـ + قَدِيمَة — qadīma, old, former (adj. f.), acc.; 'the former'
أَجِدْهَا: أَجِدْ + هَا — wajada, to find (impf. jussive 1 s.) + -hā, her; 'I find her'
ذَبَحَتِ: dhabaḥa, to slaughter, cut the throat (perf. 3 f.s.), kasra before a following lām; 'she slaughtered'
غَيْرَتِهَا: غَيْرَة + هَا — ghayra, jealousy (f.) + -hā, her; gen. after min (previous word); 'her jealousy'
إِلَّابِاللهِ: إِلَّا + بِـ + اللهِ — illā, except, save + bi-, with, in (prep.) + Allāh, God; printed joined; 'save in God'
عَمَلِي: عَمَل + ي — ʿamal, action, doing (m.) + -ī, my; 'my action'
فَتَفَكَّرْتُ: فَـ + تَفَكَّرْتُ — fa-, and so + tafakkara, to ponder (Form V perf. 1 s.); 'and so I pondered'
وَحَفَرْتُ: وَ + حَفَرْتُ — wa-, and + ḥafara, to dig (perf. 1 s.); 'and I dug'
حَفْرَةً: حَفْرَة — ḥafra, a digging, excavation (f.; the usual word for 'pit' is ḥufra, as pointed at its next mention); acc. as object; 'a pit'
مُصَاغِهَا: مُصَاغ + هَا — muṣāgh, wrought jewellery (m.) + -hā, her; gen. after maʿa; 'her jewellery'
وَجَعَلْتُهَا: وَ + جَعَلْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + jaʿala, to put, set (perf. 1 s.) + -hā, her; 'and I put her'
الْحُفْرَةِ: الـ + حُفْرَة — ḥufra, pit (f.); gen. after fī; 'the pit'
وَالرُّخَامَ: وَ + الـ + رُّخَام — wa-, and + rukhām, marble (m.), acc. as object; 'and the marble'
نَظِيفَةً: naẓīfa, clean (adj. f.), acc.; 'clean' (agreeing with the plural of a thing)
وَشَجَّعْتُ: وَ + شَجَّعْتُ — wa-, and + shajjaʿa, to embolden (Form II perf. 1 s.); 'and I emboldened'
وَدَفَعْتُ: وَ + دَفَعْتُ — wa-, and + dafaʿa, to pay (perf. 1 s.); 'and I paid'; here: 'and I handed' (dafaʿa li-, to hand over to someone)
أُجْرَةَ: ujra, wage, rent (f.), acc. as object, in a construct; 'the rent of'
وَاجْتَمَعْتُ: وَ + اجْتَمَعْتُ — wa-, and + ijtamaʿa, to meet (Form VIII perf. 1 s.; takes bi- of the person met); 'and I met'
بِأَعْمَامِي: بِـ + أَعْمَام + ي — bi-, with (after ijtamaʿa, 'meet with') + aʿmām, uncles + -ī, my; 'with my uncles'
وَوَجَدْتُهُمْ: وَ + وَجَدْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + wajada, to find (perf. 1 s.) + -hum, them; 'and I found them'
مَتْجَرِهِمْ: مَتْجَر + هِمْ — matjar, merchandise, trade (m.) + -him, their; 'their merchandise'
مَجِيئِكَ: مَجِىء + كَ — majīʾ, coming (m.) + -ka, your; gen. in a construct; 'your coming'
أُعْلِمْهُمْ: أُعْلِمْ + هُمْ — aʿlama, to inform (Form IV impf. jussive 1 s.) + -hum, them; 'inform them'
وَآكُلُ: وَ + آكُلُ — wa-, and + akala, to eat (impf. 1 s.), printed with madda; 'and eating'
سَفَرُ: safar, journey, departure (m.); nom. as subject; 'the departure of'
فَهَرَبْتُ: فَـ + هَرَبْتُ — fa-, and so + haraba, to flee (perf. 1 s.); 'and so I fled'
وَاخْتَفَيْتُ: وَ + اخْتَفَيْتُ — wa-, and + ikhtafā, to hide (Form VIII perf. 1 s.); 'and I hid'
يَسْمَعُولِي: يَسْمَعُو + لِـ + ي — yasmaʿū, to hear (impf. jussive 3 m.pl.) + li-, for (hear of, about) + -ī, me; printed joined; 'hear of me'
أُجْرَتَهَا: أُجْرَة + هَا — ujra, rent, wage (f.), acc. as object + -hā, its (the hall's); 'its rent'
الثَّلَٰثِ: الـ + ثَّلَٰث — thalāth, three (numeral) with the article, printed الثلث; 'the three'
أُجْرَةُ: ujra, rent (f.); nom. as subject, in a construct; 'the rent of'
الْمَخَازِنَ: الـ + مَخَازِن — makhāzin, storerooms (pl. of makhzan, diptote), acc.; 'the storerooms'
مُقَفَّلَةً: muqaffala, locked (pass. part. of Form II qaffala, f.), acc. as state; 'locked'
فَفَتَحْتُهَا: فَـ + فَتَحْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so + fataḥa, to open (perf. 1 s.) + -hā, them; 'and so I opened them'
وَأَخْرَجْتُ: وَ + أَخْرَجْتُ — wa-, and + akhraja, to bring out (Form IV perf. 1 s.); 'and I took out'
طَوْقَ: ṭawq, collar, necklace (m.), acc. as object of wajadtu, in a construct; 'a collar of'; also: the neck-opening of a garment, object of fataḥa: ṭawqa qamīṣihā, 'the neck of her shift'
مُرَصَّعًا: muraṣṣaʿ, set, studded (pass. part. of Form II raṣṣaʿa, m.), acc. as adj. of ṭawq; 'set'
بِجَوَاهِرَ: بِـ + جَوَاهِر — bi-, with (the stones studding it) + jawāhir, jewels (pl. of jawhar, diptote); 'with jewels'
فَأَخَذْتُهُ: فَـ + أَخَذْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so + akhadha, to take (perf. 1 s.) + -hu, it; 'and so I took it'
وَمَسَحْتُهُ: وَ + مَسَحْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + masaḥa, to wipe (perf. 1 s.) + -hu, it; 'and I wiped it'
الْمَذْبُوحَةِ: الـ + مَذْبُوحَة — madhbūḥa, slaughtered (pass. part., f.); gen. adj.; 'the murdered'
وَتَأَمَّلْتُهُ: وَ + تَأَمَّلْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + taʾammala, to gaze at (Form V perf. 1 s.) + -hu, it; 'and I gazed at it'
فَوَسْوَسَ: فَـ + وَسْوَسَ — fa-, and so + waswasa, to whisper (quadriliteral perf. 3 m.s.); 'and so he whispered'
إِنْفَاذِ: infādh, carrying out, execution (m.; Form IV verbal noun of nafadha); gen. in a construct; 'the carrying out of'
الْقَدَرِ: الـ + قَدَر — qadar, decree, fate (m.); gen. in a construct; 'the decree'
عِقْدَ: ʿiqd, necklace (m.), acc. as object, in a construct; 'the necklace of'
لِلدَّلَّالِ: لِـ + الـ + دَّلَّال — li-, to (marks the recipient) + dallāl, broker, auctioneer (m.); 'to the broker'
وَأَجْلَسَنِي: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + نِي — wa-, and + ajlasa, to seat (Form IV perf. 3 m.s.) + -nī, me; 'and seated me'
عَمَرَ: ʿamara, to be full, thrive (perf. 3 m.s.); 'filled'
الدَّلَّالُ: الـ + دَّلَّال — dallāl, broker (m.); nom. as subject; 'the broker'
الْعِقْدُ: الـ + عِقْد — ʿiqd, necklace (m.); nom. as subject; 'the necklace'
مُثَمَّنٌ: muthamman, appraised, priced (pass. part. of Form II thamman, m.), nom.; a best guess from the unpointed print; 'appraised'
جَابَ: jāba, to bring, fetch (colloquial perf. 3 m.s., for jāʾa bi-); 'fetched'
أَلْفَيْنِ: alfayn, two thousand (dual of alf); acc. object; 'two thousand'
عِقْدُ: ʿiqd, necklace (m.); nom. as predicate, in a construct; 'a necklace of'
مَصْنُوعٌ: maṣnūʿ, made (pass. part. of ṣanaʿa, m.), nom.; 'made'
صَنْعَةَ: ṣanʿa, craft, make, manner (f.), acc. as adverbial in a construct; 'in the manner of'
الْإِ: الـ + إِ — al-, the (def. article) + i-, first syllable of Ifranj, printed as the separate word الا; 'the Fr-'
فْرَنْجِ: (i)franj, the Franks, Europeans; second half of al-Ifranj, gen. in a construct; '-anks'
صُغْنَاهُ: صُغْنَا + هُ — ṣāgha, to fashion (perf. 1 pl.) + -hu, it; 'we fashioned it'
لِوَاحِدَةٍ: لِـ + وَاحِدَة — li-, for (prep., the person it was intended for) + wāḥida, one (f.), here 'a woman'; 'for a woman'; also: li- of ownership: lam takun li-wāḥidatin mina al-mughanniyāti, 'never belonged to any singing-girl'
وَوَرِثَتْهُ: وَ + وَرِثَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + wirtha, to inherit (perf. 3 f.s.) + -hu, it; 'and she inherited it'
فَأَرَدْنَا: فَـ + أَرَدْنَا — fa-, and so + arāda, to want (Form IV perf. 1 pl.); 'and so we wanted'
بَيْعَهُ: بَيْع + هُ — bayʿ, sale (m.) + -hu, its; acc. as object of arāda; 'to sell it'
أَقْبِضُ: aqbiḍu, to receive, take (impf. 1 s.); 'I shall take'
فَلَمَّاكَانَتِ: فَـ + لَمَّا + كَانَتِ — fa-, so (conj.) + lammā, when (temporal conj.) + kānat, she/it was (3 f. sg. perfect of kāna, be; the print runs the words together); 'so when it was'
اِقْبِضِ: اِقْبِضِ — qabaḍa, seize, take hold of; iqbiḍ, m. sg. imperative (with a helping kasra before al-); 'take!'
قَضِيَّتَهُ: قَضِيَّة + هُ — qaḍiyya, case, affair + -hu, his (acc., subject of anna); 'his case'
مُشْكِلَةٌ: مُشْكِلَة — mushkila, problematic, difficult (f. act. participle of ashkala, be confusing); 'problematic'
بِالْعِقْدِ: بِـ + الـ + عِقْد — bi-, with (prep.; maḍā bi- 'go off with') + ʿiqd, necklace (m.); 'with the necklace'
كَبِيرِ: كَبِير — kabīr, chief, elder (gen., first term of an idafa); 'chief of'
الْوَالِى: الـ + وَالِى — wālī, governor, chief of police (final ى as printed); 'the governor'
سُرِقَ: سُرِقَ — saraqa, steal; suriqa, 3 m. sg. passive perfect; 'was stolen'
وَوَجَدْنَا: وَ + وَجَدَ + نَا — wa-, and + wajada, find (perfect) + -nā, we; 'and we found'
الْحَرَامِيَّ: الـ + حَرَامِيّ — ḥarāmī, thief (colloquial, from ḥarām, forbidden; acc.); 'the thief'
لُبْسَ: لُبْس — lubs, clothing, dress (acc., object of lābis); 'the dress of'
أَشْعُرُ: أَشْعُرُ — shaʿara, perceive, be aware; ashʿuru, 1 sg. imperfect; 'I perceive'
أِلَّا: إِلَّا — illā, except, but, until (after a negative)
وَالظَّلَمَةُ: وَ + الـ + ظَلَمَة — wa-, and (here introducing a circumstance, 'when') + ẓalama, oppressors, the governor's men (pl. of ẓālim); 'and the oppressors'
أَحَاطُوابِي: أَحَاطُوا + بِـ + ي — aḥāṭū, they surrounded (IV, 3 m. pl. perfect; the alif is the plural alif, printed run together) + bi-, (prep.; aḥāṭa bi- 'surround') + -ī, me; 'surrounded me'
وَوَدُّونِي: وَ + وَدُّوا + نِي — wa-, and + waddū, they conveyed, took away (3 m. pl. perfect of wadda, Middle Arabic for waddā) + -nī, me; 'and they took me'
لِلْوَالِى: لِـ + الـ + وَالِى — li-, to (prep., direction) + wālī, governor; 'to the governor'
فَسَأَلَنِي: فَـ + سَأَلَ + نِي — fa-, then + saʾala, ask (3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'then he asked me'
مَاهَذَا: مَا + هَذَا — mā, not (negative; printed run together) + hādhā, this; 'this is not'; in Night 131 mā is interrogative: 'what is this?'
تَعَرَّيْتُ: تَعَرَّيْتُ — taʿarrā, strip oneself, be stripped (V); taʿarraytu, 1 sg. perfect; 'I was stripped'
وَضُرِبْتُ: وَ + ضُرِبْتُ — wa-, and + ḍuribtu, I was beaten (1 sg. passive perfect of ḍaraba); 'and I was beaten'
أَجْنَابِي: أَجْنَاب + ي — ajnāb, sides (pl. of janb) + -ī, my; 'my sides'
فَحَرَقَنِي: فَـ + حَرَقَ + نِي — fa-, and so + ḥaraqa, burn, scorch (3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'so it burned me'
صَاحِبَتَهُ: صَاحِبَة + هُ — ṣāḥiba, owner, mistress, female companion (f.) + -hu, his/its (acc., subject of anna); 'its owner'
مَقْتُولَةٌ: مَقْتُولَة — maqtūla, killed, murdered (f. passive participle of qatala); 'killed'
وَقَلَوْهَا: وَ + قَلَوْا + هَا — wa-, and + qalaw, they fried, seared (3 m. pl. perfect of qalā) + -hā, it (the hand, f.); 'and they seared it'
فَسَقَوْنِي: فَـ + سَقَوْا + نِي — fa-, then + saqaw, they gave to drink (3 m. pl. perfect) + -nī, me; 'then they gave me to drink'
مَاجَرَي: مَا + جَرَى — mā, what (relative) + jarā, happen, occur (3 m. sg. perfect; final yā as printed, run together with mā); 'what happened'
وَانْظُرْلَكَ: وَ + انْظُرْ + لَكَ — wa-, and + unẓur, look! look out for (m. sg. imperative of naẓara) + li-, for (prep.) + -ka, you; 'and look out for yourself'
مُتَّهَمٌ: مُتَّهَم — muttaham, accused, suspected (passive participle of ittahama); 'suspected'
بِالْحَرَامِ: بِـ + الـ + حَرَام — bi-, of (prep.; muttaham bi- 'accused of') + ḥarām, the forbidden, here theft; 'of the forbidden'
اصْبِرْ: اصْبِرْ — ṣabara, be patient; iṣbir, m. sg. imperative; 'be patient'
أَنْظُرَأَيَّ: أَنْظُرَ + أَيَّ — anẓura, I look (1 sg. subjunctive after ḥattā) + ayya, any, some (printed as one word; obscure, perhaps for anẓura lī, 'I look out for myself'); 'I look [at] any'
مَقْطُوعُ: مَقْطُوع — maqṭūʿ, cut off (passive participle of qaṭaʿa; first term of an idafa); 'cut-off of'
بَرِيٌّ: بَرِيّ — barī, innocent (Classical barīʾ; printed without hamza); 'innocent'
يُحْدِثُ: يُحْدِثُ — aḥdatha, bring about, cause to happen; yuḥdithu, 3 m. sg. imperfect; 'brings about'
الظَّلَمَةِ: الـ + ظَلَمَة — ẓalama, oppressors, the governor's men (gen.); 'the oppressors'
وَكَبِيرُ: وَ + كَبِير — wa-, and + kabīr, chief, elder (nom., first term of an idafa); 'and the chief of'
فَادَّعَى: فَـ + ادَّعَى — fa-, and + iddaʿā, claim, allege (VIII, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'and he claimed'
يُمْهِلُونِي: يُمْهِلُوا + نِي — amhala, give respite (IV); yumhilū, 3 m. pl. jussive after lam (the nūn drops) + -nī, me; 'they did not give me respite'
كَتَّفُونِي: كَتَّفُوا + نِي — kattafū, they bound (II, 3 m. pl. perfect of kattafa, tie the arms) + -nī, me; 'they bound me'
وَرَمَوْافِي: وَ + رَمَوْا + فِي — wa-, and + ramaw, they threw (3 m. pl. perfect of ramā; the alif is the plural alif, printed run together) + fī, in, around (prep.); 'and they threw around'
وَوَزِيرِهَا: وَ + وَزِير + هَا — wa-, and + wazīr, vizier + -hā, its (f.); 'and its vizier'
وَحَاكِمِهَا: وَ + حَاكِم + هَا — wa-, and + ḥākim, ruler, governor (act. participle of ḥakama) + -hā, its; 'and its ruler'
غَطَسَ: غَطَسَ — ghaṭasa, dive, plunge, sink (3 m. sg. perfect); 'sank'
رُوحُكَ: رُوح + كَ — rūḥ, soul, life (f.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your soul'
لَامَحَالَةَ: لَا + مَحَالَة — lā, no + maḥāla, way of escape (acc., absolute negation; printed run together); 'without fail'
أَحْكِىَ: أَحْكِيَ — ḥakā, tell, relate; aḥkiya, 1 sg. subjunctive after an (final ى as printed); 'I tell'
لِلصَّاحِبِ: لِـ + الـ + صَاحِب — li-, to, at (prep.; waṣala li- 'arrive at') + ṣāḥib, master; 'at the master'
فَأِنْ: فَـ + إِنْ — fa-, and so + in, if; 'so if'
وَأِنْ: وَ + إِنْ — wa-, and + in, if; 'and if'
أَوْقَفَنِي: أَوْقَفَ + نِي — awqafa, make stand (IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'he made me stand'
أِلَيَّ: إِلَى + ي — ilā, to, at (prep.) + -ī, me; 'at me'
بِطَرْفِ: بِـ + طَرْف — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + ṭarf, glance, corner of the eye (gen., first term of an idafa); 'with the corner of'
قَطَعْتُمْ: قَطَعْتُمْ — qaṭaʿa, cut; qaṭaʿtum, 2 m. pl. perfect; 'you cut'
ظَلَمْتُمُوهُ: ظَلَمَ + تُمْ + وُ + هُ — ẓalama, wrong, oppress + -tum, you (m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'you have wronged him'
بِقَطْعِكُمْ: بِـ + قَطْع + كُمْ — bi-, by, through (prep.) + qaṭʿ, cutting + -kum, your (pl.); 'by your cutting'
قَلْبِى: قَلْب + ي — qalb, heart + -ī, my (final ى as printed); 'my heart'
بِسَارِقٍ: بِـ (bi-, a particle that marks the predicate after a negated لَيْسَ) + سَارِق — sāriq, thief (m., act. part. of saraqa); gen. after بِـ; 'a thief'
اتَّهَمُونِى: اتَّهَمَ — ittahama, to accuse (VIII), 3 m.pl. perfect + نِي, me; 'they accused me'
التُّهْمَةِ: الـ + تُهْمَة — tuhma, accusation, charge (f.); gen., in apposition to هَذِهِ; 'the accusation'
الْعَظِيمَةِ: الـ + عَظِيمَة — ʿaẓīma, great, grave (f.); 'the great'
وَضَرَبُونِي: و + ضَرَبَ — wa-, and; ḍaraba, to strike, beat; 3 m.pl. + نِي, me; 'and they beat me'
بَطْنِ: baṭn, belly, middle (m.); in construct, 'in the midst of'
وَحَكَمُوا: و + حَكَمَ — wa-, and; ḥakama, to judge, rule; 3 m.pl.; 'and they ruled'
أُقِرَّ: أَقَرَّ — aqarra, to confess, admit (IV), 1 sg. subjunctive; 'I confess'
فَكَذَبْتُ: ف + كَذَبَ — fa-, so (sequence); kadhaba, to lie; 1 sg. perfect; 'so I lied'
وَاعْتَرَفْتُ: و + اعْتَرَفَ — wa-, and; iʿtarafa, to confess, acknowledge (VIII); 1 sg.; 'and I confessed'
بِالسَّرِقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + سَرِقَة — bi-, to (iʿtarafa bi- 'confess to'); sariqa, theft (f.); 'to the theft'
بَرِيِّى: بَرِيء — barīʾ, innocent (m.) as printed with an extra yāʾ; the pointing is a best guess; 'innocent'
لَابَأْسَ: لَا + بَأْس — lā, no (negating the genus) + baʾs, harm, distress (m.); printed joined; 'no harm'
كَبِيرَالسُّوقِ: كَبِير + الـ + سُوق — kabīr, great one, chief (m.); sūq, market; printed joined; 'the chief of the market'
أَعْطِ: أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, to give (IV), imperative m.sg. (short form); 'give'
دِيَةَ: diya, blood-money, compensation (f.), acc.; in construct, 'the blood-price of'
أَشْنُقُكَ: شَنَقَ — shanaqa, to hang; 1 sg. imperfect + -ka, you; 'I will hang you'
فَأَخَذُوهُ: ف + أَخَذَ — fa-, so; akhadha, to seize, take; 3 m.pl. + -hu, him; 'so they seized him'
وَجَرُّوهُ: و + جَرَّ — wa-, and; jarra, to drag; 3 m.pl. + -hu, him; 'and dragged him'
وَالصَّاحِبُ: و + الـ + صَاحِب — wa-, and, together with; ṣāḥib, lord (m.); 'and the lord'
الْجِنْزِيرَ: الـ + جِنْزِير — jinzīr, chain (m.; a form of zanjīr), acc. object; 'the chain'
بِإِذْنِهِ: بِـ + إِذْن + هِ — bi-, with, by (prep.); idhn, permission (m.) + -hi, his; 'by his leave'
وَحَلُّوا: و + حَلَّ — wa-, and; ḥalla, to untie, loosen; 3 m.pl.; 'and they loosed'
كِتَافِى: كِتَاف + ي — kitāf, bonds, cords for binding (m.) + -ī, my; 'my bonds'
اصْدُقْنِي: صَدَقَ — ṣadaqa, to speak the truth; imperative m.sg. + نِي, me; 'be true to me'
ش—: ش— : printed fragment; the word is cut off by a dash after shīn and is probably shiʿr, 'verse' (compare شِعْرٌ above); 'verse (?)'
بِالصِّــدْقِ: بِـ + الـ + صِدْق — bi-, to (ʿalayka bi- 'hold fast to'); ṣidq, truth, truthfulness (m.), with line-justification stroke; 'to truthfulness'
اَنَّهُ: أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (+ acc.) + -hu, it, the pronoun of the matter; printed with bare alif; 'that it'; in Night 182 printed اَنَّهُ where the sense wants innahu, 'for he' (jūdī … innahu in dhāqa …)
اَحْرَقَكَ: أَحْرَقَ — aḥraqa, to burn (IV), 3 m.sg. + -ka, you; printed with bare alif; 'it burned you'
بِنَارِ: بِـ + نَار — bi-, with (prep., instrument); nār, fire (f.); in construct, 'with the fire of' Also bi- governed by takaffala, 'take on, undertake': takaffala shawquhā bi-nāri qirāhu, 'her longing took on the fire of its guest-meal'.
الْوَعِيـــدِ: الـ + وَعِيد — waʿīd, threat, menace (m.), with line-justification stroke; 'the threat'
حَدَّثْتُهُ: ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (II), 1 sg. + -hu, him; 'I told him'
تْنِي: تْ + نِي — -t, 3 f.sg. ending + -nī, me; the second half of the split جَاءَتْنِي; 'she ... me'
بِالثَّانِيَةِ: بِـ + الـ + ثَانِيَة — bi-, with (jāʾa bi- 'come with, bring'); thāniya, second (f.); 'with the second'
ذَبَحْتُهَا: dhabaḥa, to slaughter, cut the throat of; 1 sg. + -hā, her; 'I slaughtered her'
وَذَكَرْتُ: و + ذَكَرَ — wa-, and; dhakara, to mention, recount; 1 sg.; 'and I recounted'
الْحَدِيثَ: الـ + حَدِيث — ḥadīth, story, account (m.), acc. object; 'the story'
مِنْدِيلَهُ: مِنْدِيل + هُ — mindīl, kerchief (m.), acc. + -hu, his; 'his kerchief'
وَأَنْشَاءَ: و + أَنْشَأَ — wa-, and; anshaʾa, to begin (IV), here + imperfect 'begin to'; printed انشاء with an alif before the final hamza; 'and he began'
آرِي: as printed with madda and kasra; the sense and metre want arā, 'I see' (raʾā, to see), 1 sg. imperfect; 'I see'
عِلَلَ: ʿilal, ailments, defects (pl. of ʿilla), acc. object; in construct, 'the ailments of'
كَثِيــرَةً: kathīra, many, abundant (f.), acc. (predicate or state), with line-justification stroke; 'many'
وَصَاحِبُهَا: و + صَاحِب + هَا — wa-, and; ṣāḥib, companion, possessor (m.) + -hā, its (the world's); 'and its companion'
عَلِيــلُ: ʿalīl, sick, ailing (m.), with line-justification stroke; 'sick'
اجْتِمَاعٍ: ijtimāʿ, gathering, meeting (m., verbal noun VIII of jamaʿa); 'a meeting'
خَلِيلَيْنِ: خَلِيل — khalīl, friend (m.), dual gen. -ayni; 'two friends'
أَحْجُرُ: ḥajara, to confine, put under restraint; 1 sg. imperfect; 'I used to confine'
حَجْرًا: ḥajr, confinement, restraint (m.); cognate acc.; 'a confinement'
بَلَغَتْ: balagha, to reach, come of age; 3 f.sg.; 'she came of age'
أَرْسَلْتُهَا: arsala, to send (IV), 1 sg. + -hā, her; 'I sent her'
لِوَلَدِ: لِـ + وَلَد — li-, to, for (prep.; here marks the husband, where Classical has a direct object); walad, son (m.); in construct, 'to the son of'
الْقُبْحَ: الـ + قُبْح — qubḥ, ugliness, vileness (m.), acc.; 'the vileness'
أَوْلَادِ: awlād, sons, children (pl. of walad); in construct, 'sons of'
وَجَاءَتْكَ: و + جَاءَ + تْ + كَ — wa-, and; jāʾa, to come; -at, 3 f.sg. + -ka, you; 'and she came to you'
بِأُخْتِهَا: بِـ + أُخْت + هَا — bi-, with (jāʾa bi- 'come with, bring'); ukht, sister (f.) + -hā, her; 'with her sister'
وَالِاثْنَانِ: و + الـ + اثْنَان — wa-, and; ithnān, two (m.), nom.; 'and the two'
شَقِيقَتَانِ: شَقِيقَة — shaqīqa, full sister (f.), dual nom. -āni; 'two full sisters'
وَكَانَتَا: و + كَانَ — wa-, and; kāna, to be; 3 f. dual; 'and the two were'
تُحِبَّانِ: aḥabba, to love (IV); 3 f. dual imperfect; 'loving'
لِلْكَبِيرَةِ: لِـ + الـ + كَبِيرَة — li-, to (prep.; 'befell to'); kabīra, elder (f.); 'to the elder'
أَخْرَجَتْ: akhraja, to bring out, disclose (IV); 3 f.sg.; 'she disclosed'
سِرَّهَا: سِرّ + هَا — sirr, secret (m.), acc. + -hā, her; 'her secret'
فَطَلَبَتِ: ف + طَلَبَ — fa-, and so; ṭalaba, to ask for, request; 3 f.sg.; 'so she asked for'
الذَّهَابَ: الـ + ذَّهَاب — dhahāb, going (m., verbal noun), acc.; 'to go'
رَجَعَتْ: rajaʿa, to return; 3 f.sg.; 'she returned' Also with a feminine thing as subject, 'it returned': rajaʿat ilā sayyidinā ʿāfiyatuhu, 'his health has come back to our master'.
فَسَأَلْتُهَا: ف + سَأَلَ — fa-, and so; saʾala, to ask; 1 sg. + -hā, her; 'so I asked her'
فَوَجَدْ: ف + وَجَدَ — fa-, and so; wajada, to find; first half of the split فَوَجَدْتُهَا, 'so I found her'
تُهَا: -tu, 1 sg. ending + -hā, her; second half of the split فَوَجَدْتُهَا; 'I ... her'
لِأُمِّهَا: لِـ + أُمّ + هَا — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed); umm, mother (f.) + -hā, her; 'to her mother'
بِحَضْرَتِي: بِـ + حَضْرَة + ي — bi-, in (prep.); ḥaḍra, presence (f.) + -ī, my; 'in my presence'
أَزَالُ: zāla, to cease; 1 sg. imperfect; with lā 'I shall not cease'
أَمُوتَ: māta, to die; 1 sg. subjunctive after ḥattā; 'I die'
فَانْظُرْ: ف + انْظُرْ — fa-, so; unẓur, naẓara, to look, consider; imperative m.sg.; 'so consider' Also with ilā, 'so look at': fa-unẓur ilā al-khātami, 'look at the ring' (Night 191).
أَشْتَهِي: ishtahā, to desire, wish (VIII); 1 sg. imperfect; 'I desire'
أَقُولُهُ: qāla, to say; 1 sg. imperfect + -hu, it; 'I say'
أُزَوِّجُكَ: zawwaja, to marry off (II); 1 sg. imperfect + -ka, you; 'I marry you to'
ابْنَتِى: ابْنَة + ي — ibna, daughter (f.; ibnat before a suffix) + -ī, my; 'my daughter'
شَقِيقَةً: shaqīqa, full sister (f.), acc. predicate; 'a full sister'
آخُذْ: akhadha, to take; 1 sg. jussive after lam (printed with madda); 'I take'
رَاتِبًا: rātib, stipend, regular allowance (m.), acc.; 'an allowance'
نَصِلَ: waṣala, to arrive; 1 pl. subjunctive after ḥattā; 'we arrive'
لِلْقَاضِي: لِـ + الـ + قَاضِي — li-, for (arsala li- 'send for'); qāḍī, judge (m.); 'for the judge'
وَأَخَذَلِي: و + أَخَذَ + لِـ + ي — wa-, and; akhadha, to take; 3 m.sg.; li-, for (prep., benefit) + -ī, me; printed joined; 'and he took for me'
لًا: لًا — second half of مَالًا, māl, wealth (m.), acc. indef., printed split from مَا; with مَا 'wealth'
أَعَزِّ: aʿazz, most dear, most honoured (elative of ʿazīz); gen. in annexation; 'most honoured'
الْعَامِ: الـ + عَام — ʿām, year (m.); gen.; 'the year'
بَرِيدًا: barīd, courier, post-rider, messenger (m.); acc. indef.; 'a courier'
بِمَالِي: بِـ + مَال + ـي — bi-, with (prep.; chosen by the verb: أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + māl, wealth, money (m.) + -ī, my; 'with my wealth', so 'brought me my wealth' Also bi- of accompaniment after safar, 'travel with': yurīdu al-safara bi-mālī, 'he means to go off with my money'.
خَلَّفَهُ: خَلَّفَ + هُ — khallafa, leave behind (perf. 3 m. sg., form II) + -hu, it; 'he left it behind'
أَرْغَدِ: arghad, most comfortable, most abundant (elative of raghd, comfortable); gen. in annexation; 'most comfortable'
بَلَدِكُمْ: بَلَد + كُمْ — balad, town, city, country (m.) + -kum, your (pl.); gen. after ilā; 'your city'
فَطَابَتْ: فَـ + طَابَتْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ṭāba, be good, be pleasant (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'so became pleasant'
الْمَعِيشَةُ: الـ + مَعِيشَة — maʿīshah, livelihood, way of life (f.); nom.; 'the livelihood'
لَابُدَّلِي: لَا + بُدَّ + لِـ + ـي — lā, no (neg.) + budd, escape, alternative + li-, for (prep.) + -ī, me, printed as one word; 'there is no escape for me', hence 'I must' (followed by min 'from')
خَطِيئَةٍ: khaṭīʾah, sin, fault (f.); gen. indef.; 'a sin'
خَيَّاطُ: khayyāṭ, tailor (m.); nom. as a vocative with yā; 'O tailor'
ذُنُوبَكُمْ: ذُنُوب + كُمْ — dhunūb, sins, offences (pl. of dhanb) + -kum, your (pl.); acc. object; 'your sins'
أَجْتَمِعَ: أَجْتَمِعَ — ajtamiʿa, meet, assemble (impf. 1 sg. subj., form VIII; ijtamaʿa bi- 'meet with'); 'I meet'
وَلِيمَةٍ: walīmah, banquet, feast (f.); gen. indef. after fī; 'a feast'
أَصْحَابِي: أَصْحَاب + ـي — aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of ṣāḥib) + -ī, my; gen. in annexation; 'my friends'
نَفَرًا: nafar, person, individual, man (m.); acc. indef. after a number; 'persons'
وَفِينَا: وَ + فِي + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + fī, in, among (prep.) + -nā, us; 'and among us'
صَنَايِعَ: ṣanāyiʿ, crafts, trades (pl. of ṣanʿah/ṣināʿah; diptote); gen. in annexation; 'crafts'
خَيَّاطِينَ: khayyāṭīn, tailors (pl. of khayyāṭ), printed with -īn in apposition; 'tailors'
وَقَزَّازِينَ: وَ + قَزَّازِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qazzāz, silk-dealer, silk-worker (m.), pl. with -īn; 'and silk-merchants'
وَنَجَّارِينَ: وَ + نَجَّارِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + najjār, carpenter (m.), pl. with -īn; 'and carpenters'
وَغَيْرَ: وَ + غَيْرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghayr, other than, not (noun); acc. in annexation; وَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ 'and other than that', 'and so on'
مُدَّلَنَا: مُدَّ + لِـ + نَا — mudda, be stretched, be spread (perf. 3 m. sg. passive of مَدَّ) + li-, for (prep.) + -nā, us, printed as one word; 'was spread for us'
لِنَأْكُلَ: لِـ + نَأْكُلَ — li-, so that (introduces purpose) + na-ʾkula, eat (impf. 1 pl. subj. of أَكَلَ); 'that we might eat'
غَيْرَأَنَّهُ: غَيْرَ + أَنَّ + هُ — ghayra, other than (noun, acc.) + anna, that + -hu, he, printed as one word; 'except that he'
يَجْلِسُ: yajlisu, sit (impf. 3 m. sg. of جَلَسَ); 'he sits', here 'to sit'
إِنْسَانًا: insān, person, human being, man (m.); acc. indef.; 'a person'
مُزَيِّنًا: muzayyin, barber (m.; lit. 'one who adorns'); acc. indef.; 'a barber'
فَامْتَنَعَ: فَـ + امْتَنَعَ — fa-, so (conj.) + imtanaʿa, refrain, refuse (perf. 3 m. sg., form VIII; imtanaʿa min 'refrain from'); 'so he refrained'
يَخْرُجَ: yakhruja, go out (impf. 3 m. sg. subj. of خَرَجَ), after an; 'he go out', 'to leave'
فَمَسَكْنَاهُ: فَـ + مَسَكْنَا + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + masaka, seize, hold (perf. 1 pl.; spoken form for أَمْسَكَ) + -hu, him; 'so we held him'
وَمَسَكَ: وَ + مَسَكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + masaka, hold, seize (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he held'
وَخُرُوجِكَ: وَ + خُرُوج + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + khurūj, going out (verbal noun of خَرَجَ) + -ka, your; 'and your going out'
لَاتَتَعَرَّضْ: لَا + تَتَعَرَّضْ — lā, do not (negative imperative) + tataʿarraḍ, expose oneself to, meddle, press upon (impf. 2 m. sg. jussive, form V), printed as one word; 'do not press'
رُجُوعِي: رُجُوع + ـي — rujūʿ, returning, turning back (verbal noun of رَجَعَ) + -ī, my; gen. in annexation; 'my returning'
الْمُزَيِّنُ: الـ + مُزَيِّن — muzayyin, barber (m.); nom. as predicate of inna; 'the barber'
النَّحْسُ: الـ + نَحْس — naḥs, ill-omened, unlucky, inauspicious (adj.); nom.; 'the ill-omened'
وَتَشَوَّشَ: وَ + تَشَوَّشَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tashawwasha, be disturbed, be troubled (perf. 3 m. sg., form V); 'and was disturbed'
الْمُزَيِّنِ: الـ + مُزَيِّن — muzayyin, barber (m.); gen. after min; 'the barber'
اِحْكِ: iḥki, relate, tell (imper. m. sg. of حَكَى); 'tell'
غَيْظِكَ: غَيْظ + كَ — ghayẓ, rage, anger (m.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); gen. in annexation; 'your anger'
مَجْرًى: majran, happening, course of events (from jarā); acc. indef., subject-like object of an impersonal jarā; 'an affair'
عَرَجِي: عَرَج + ـي — ʿaraj, lameness (m.) + -ī, my; gen. in annexation; 'my lameness'
وَكَسْرِ: وَ + كَسْر — wa-, and (conj.) + kasr, breaking (verbal noun of كَسَرَ); gen. in annexation; 'and the breaking of'
أُجَالِسُهُ: أُجَالِسُ + هُ — ujālisu, sit with, keep company with (impf. 1 sg., form III) + -hu, him; 'I sit with him'
قَاطِنٌ: qāṭin, dwelling, resident (active participle of قَطَنَ); nom. indef.; 'dwelling'
وَرَحَلْتُ: وَ + رَحَلْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + raḥala, depart, set out (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I departed'
وَسَكَنْتُ: وَ + سَكَنْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sakana, dwell, settle (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I settled'
أَبَاتُ: abātu, spend the night (impf. 1 sg. of بَاتَ), printed with alif where Classical has abītu; 'I spend the night'
يَرْزُقْهُ: يَرْزُقْ + هُ — yarzuq, provide, grant (impf. 3 m. sg. jussive of رَزَقَ) + -hu, him; 'he provided him', after lam 'did not grant him'
رَحْمَهِ: رَحْمَة — raḥma, mercy (f.); the final ة is printed ه; gen. after ilā, in construct with Allāh
وَخَدَمًا: و + خَدَم — wa-, and; khadam, servants, attendants (coll.); 'and servants'
وَحَشَمًا: و + حَشَم — wa-, and; ḥasham, retinue, household dependants; 'and a retinue'
أَلْبَسُ: أَ + لَبِسَ — a-, I (impf. 1 sg.); labisa, wear (clothes); 'I wear'
أَبْغَضَنِي: أَبْغَضَ + نِي — abghaḍa, make hateful, make (one) hate; -nī, me; 'made me hate'
مَاشِى: مَاشٍ — māshin, walking (act. part. of mashā); printed with final ى
بِجَمَاعَةِ: بِـ + جَمَاعَة — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after idhā, 'behold, a ...'; jamāʿa, group, company (f.); in construct
النِّسْوَةِ: الـ + نِسْوَة — niswa, women (f. pl. coll.); gen. in construct
تَعَرَّضْنَ: تَعَرَّضَ + نَ — taʿarraḍa, come in the way of, present oneself to; -na, they (f. pl.); 'they came across'
زُقَاقًا: زُقَاق — zuqāq, alley, lane (m.); acc. object
يَنْفُذُ: يَ + نَفَذَ — ya-, it (impf. 3 m.sg.); nafadha, pass through; 'it does not pass through'
وَارْتَكَنْتُ: و + ارْتَكَنَ + تُ — wa-, and; irtakana, lean on, rest against; -tu, I; 'and I leaned'
أَقْعُدْ: أَ + قَعَدَ — a-, I (jussive 1 sg.); qaʿada, sit; 'I did not sit'
بِطَاقَةِ: بِـ + طَاقَة — bi-, marks what suddenly appears after idhā, 'behold, a ...'; ṭāqa, window, opening (f.); in construct
فُتِحَتْ: فُتِحَ + تْ — futiḥa, passive of fataḥa 'open'; -at, she/it (f.); 'it was opened'
الطَّاقَةِ: الـ + طَاقَة — ṭāqa, window (f.); gen. after ʿalā
وَقَفَلَتِ: و + قَفَلَ + تِ — wa-, and; qafala, close, lock; -at, she (with joining kasra before al-); 'and she shut'
الطَّاقَةَ: الـ + طَاقَة — ṭāqa, window (f.); acc. object
فَانْطَلَقَتْ: فَ + انْطَلَقَ + تْ — fa-, and so; inṭalaqa, be loosed, break loose; -at, it (f.); 'so it broke loose'
الْبَغْضَةُ: الـ + بَغْضَة — baghḍa, hatred, aversion (f.); nom. subject
بِقَاضِى: بِـ + قَاضٍ — bi-, marks what appears after idhā, 'behold, ...'; qāḍin, judge (m.); printed with final ى
رَاكِبٍ: رَاكِب — rākib, riding (act. part.); gen., qualifying the judge
أَمَّهُ: أَمَّ + هُ — amma, go before, lead; -hu, him; 'went before him'
عَبِيدُو: عَبِيد + و — ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of ʿabd); the final -ū is printed for -uhu 'his'; 'his slaves'
فَعَرَفْتُ: فَ + عَرَفَ + تُ — fa-, and so; ʿarafa, know, recognise; -tu, I; 'so I knew'
مَنْزِلِي: مَنْزِل + ـي — manzil, home, dwelling (m.); -ī, my; gen. after ilā
مَكْرُوبٌ: مَكْرُوب — makrūb, distressed (pass. part. of karaba); nom. predicate
وَوَقَعْتُ: و + وَقَعَ + تُ — wa-, and; waqaʿa, fall; -tu, I; 'and I fell'
جَوَارِي: جَوَارِي — jawārī, girls, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya); possibly 'my girls'
وَقَعَدْنَ: و + قَعَدَ + نَ — wa-, and; qaʿada, sit; -na, they (f. pl.); 'and they sat'
حَوْلِى: حَوْل + ـي — ḥawl, around (prep.); -ī, me; 'around me'
يَعْرِفْنَ: يَ + عَرَفَ + نَ — ya-...-na, they (f. pl., jussive); ʿarafa, know; 'they did not know'
أُبَلِ: أُ + بَالَى — u-, I (jussive 1 sg.); bālā, heed, care for (ubālī, here shortened); 'I did not heed'
خِطَابًا: خِطَاب — khiṭāb, speech, address (m.); acc. object
فَبَكَيْنَ: فَ + بَكَى + نَ — fa-, and so; bakā, weep; -na, they (f. pl.); 'so they wept'
وَتَأَسَّفْنَ: و + تَأَسَّفَ + نَ — wa-, and; taʾassafa, grieve, be sorry; -na, they (f. pl.); 'and they grieved'
خَفِيَ: خَفِيَ — khafiya, be hidden; 'it was hidden'
وَلَاطَفَتْنِي: و + لَاطَفَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and; lāṭafa, be gentle with, treat kindly; -at, she; -nī, me; 'and she was kind to me'
خَبَرَكَ: خَبَر + كَ — khabar, news, account (m.); -ka, your; acc. object
وَصْلَتِكَ: وَصْلَة + كَ — waṣla, joining, union, meeting (f.); -ka, your; gen. in construct
قَاضِي: قَاضٍ — qāḍin, judge (m.); gen. in construct
الْحَجْرُ: الـ + حَجْر — ḥajr, restraint, confinement, interdiction (m.); nom.
وَالْمَوْضِعُ: و + الـ + مَوْضِع — wa-, and; mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m.); nom. subject; 'and the place'
رَأَيْتَهَا: رَأَى + تَ + هَا — raʾā, see; -ta, you (m.sg.); -hā, her; 'you saw her'
طَبَقَتُهَا: طَبَقَة + هَا — ṭabaqa, storey, upper room (f.); -hā, her; nom. predicate; 'her upper room'
وَأَبُوهَا: و + أَب + هَا — wa-, and; ab, father (m.; abū- in construct); -hā, her; 'and her father'
كَثِيرَمَا: كَثِيرًا مَا — kathīr + mā, often; printed as one word
إلَّامِنِّي: إلَّا + مِنْ + ـي — illā, except; min, from (prep.); -ī, me; printed as one word; 'except from me'
فَشُدَّ: فَ + شَدَّ — fa-, and so; shadda, tighten, brace; imperative m.sg.; 'so brace'
حَيْلَكَ: حَيْل + كَ — ḥayl, strength, resolve (m.); -ka, your; acc. object
فَشَدَدْتُ: فَ + شَدَّ + تُ — fa-, and so; shadda, tighten, brace; -tu, I; 'so I braced'
حَدِيثَهَا: حَدِيث + هَا — ḥadīth, talk, account (m.); -hā, her; 'her talk'
طَيِّبًا: طَيِّب — ṭayyib, well, good (m.); acc. predicate
فَمَضَتِ: فَ + مَضَى + تِ — fa-, and so; maḍā, go away; -at, she (with joining kasra before al-); 'so she went away'
وَرَجَعَتْ: و + رَجَعَ + تْ — wa-, and; rajaʿa, return; -at, she; 'and she returned'
وَوَجْهُهَا: و + وَجْه + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial); wajh, face (m.); -hā, her; 'with her face'
مُنْغَيِّرٌ: مُنْغَيِّر — munghayyir, changed (as printed; cf. mutaghayyir, or min ghayr 'other than'); nom. predicate
تَسْكُتِي: تَ + سَكَتَ + ي — ta-...-ī, you (f.sg., jussive); sakata, be silent; 'you keep silent'
عَجُوزَ: عَجُوز — ʿajūz, old woman (f.); acc. vocative, in construct
لَأَ: لَـ + أَ — la-, emphatic oath particle; a-, I (impf. 1 sg.); first half of la-afʿalanna, split by the print; e.g. la-atbaʿu, 'I will surely follow' (oath la- + a- of the 1s imperfect, indicative), split by the print as لا تبع; la-ashkiyannaka, 'I will surely complain of you', split as لا شكينك (Night 138)
فْعَلَنَّ: فَعَلَ + نَّ — faʿala, do; -anna, emphatic ending; second half of la-afʿalanna; 'I will surely do'
تَسْتَحِقِّينَ: تَ + اسْتَحَقَّ + ـِينَ — ta-...-īna, you (f.sg.); istaḥaqqa, deserve; 'you deserve'
أَرْجِعَ: أَ + رَجَعَ — a-, I (subj. 1 sg.); rajaʿa, return, go back; 'that I return'
ازْدَدْتُ: ازْدَادَ + تُ — izdāda, increase, grow; -tu, I; 'I increased'
أَتَتِ: أَتَى + تِ — atā, come; -at, she (with joining kasra before al-); 'she came'
رُدَّتْ: رُدَّ + تْ — ruddat, passive of radda 'return'; -at, it (f.); 'it was returned'; here: of the spirit, 'was given back'
مُنْكَسِرَةُ: مُنْكَسِر — munkasir, broken (act. part. of inkasara; f.); nom. predicate, in construct
بَاكِيَةُ: بَاكِيَة — bākiya, weeping (f. act. part.); nom. predicate, in construct
خَالَتِي: خَالَة + ـي — khāla, maternal aunt (f.), polite address to an older woman; -ī, my
أَرَاكِ: أَ + رَأَى + كِ — a-, I (impf. 1 sg.); raʾā, see; -ki, you (f.); 'I see you'
أَتَيْتُكِ: أَتَى + تُ + كِ — atā, come to; -tu, I; -ki, you (f.); 'I came to you'
فَتًى: فَتًى — fatā, youth, young man (m.); indef.
يَهْوَاكِ: يَهْوَى + كِ — yahwā, he loves, desires (hawiya, I, imperf. 3 m.s.) + -ki, you (f.s.); 'who loves you'
مُشْرِفٌ: مُشْرِف — mushrif, on the brink of, overlooking (act. part. of أَشْرَفَ, IV); ashrafa ʿalā 'be on the verge of'; nom. indef.
أَجْلِكِ: أَجْل + كِ — ajl, cause, sake (m.) + -ki, your (f.s.); min ajli-ki 'for your sake'; gen.
وَتَدْرُقُ: و + تَدْرُقُ — wa-, and + tadruqu, a verb I cannot place with certainty (3 f.s. imperf.); see the note
ذَكَرْتِهِ: ذَكَرْتِ + هِ — dhakara, mention (I), perf. 2 f.s. + -hi, him; 'you mentioned him' (resumptive pronoun)
وَثَمَرَةُ: و + ثَمَرَة — wa-, and + thamara, fruit (f.); 'and the fruit of'; nom. in construct
وَرَآكِ: و + رَآ + كِ — wa-, and + raʾā, he saw (raʾā, I, perf. 3 m.s.) + -ki, you (f.s.); 'and he saw you'
زَرْعَكِ: زَرْع + كِ — zarʿ, crops, sown plants (m.) + -ki, your (f.s.); acc. object
وَرَأَى: و + رَأَى — wa-, and + raʾā, he saw (I, perf. 3 m.s.)
فَهَامَ: ف + هَامَ — fa-, and so + hāma, he wandered distracted, was wildly in love (I, perf. 3 m.s.)
عِشْقًا: عِشْق — ʿishq, passionate love (m.); acc. tanwīn; 'in love'
أَعْلَمْتُهُ: أَعْلَمْتُ + هُ — aʿlama, inform (IV), perf. 1 s. + -hu, him; 'I informed him'
مَرَضُهُ: مَرَض + هُ — maraḍ, illness (m.) + -hu, his; nom.
وَلَزِمَ: و + لَزِمَ — wa-, and + lazima, he kept to, clung to (I, perf. 3 m.s.)
الْوِسَادَةَ: الـ + وِسَادَة — wisāda, pillow, cushion (f.); lazima al-wisāda 'took to his bed'; acc.
فَمَاذَاتُرِيدِينَ: ف + مَاذَا + تُرِيدِينَ — fa-, so + mādhā, what + turīdīna, you want (arāda, IV, imperf. 2 f.s.); 'so what do you want?'; printed as one word
اِمْضِي: اِمْضِي — imḍī, go! (maḍā, I, imper. 2 f.s.)
وَأَقْرِئِيهِ: و + أَقْرِئِي + هِ — wa-, and + aqriʾī, make (him) read, convey (aqraʾa, IV, imper. 2 f.s.) + -hi, him; aqriʾ-hu al-salām 'give him my greeting'
وَقُولِي: و + قُولِي — wa-, and + qūlī, say! (qāla, I, imper. 2 f.s.)
مَاعِنْدَهُ: مَا + عِنْدَ + هُ — mā, what + ʿind, at, with + -hu, him; 'what he has'; printed as one word
الصَّلَوٰةِ: الـ + صَّلَاة — ṣalāh, prayer (f.; printed ṣlwh, the Qurʾānic-style spelling, read with dagger alif); 'the prayer'; gen.
يَأْتِي: يَأْتِي — yaʾtī, he comes (atā, I, imperf. 3 m.s.)
الدَّارِفَإِذَا: الـ + دَار + ف + إِذَا — dār, house (f.) 'the house'; gen. after ilā; fa-idhā 'and when'; printed as one word
أَنْزِلُ: أَنْزِلُ — anzilu, I go down, come down (nazala, I, imperf. 1 s.; indicative, a future)
وَأَفْتَحُ: و + أَفْتَحُ — wa-, and + aftaḥu, I open (fataḥa, I, imperf. 1 s.)
وَأُطْلِعُهُ: و + أُطْلِعُ + هُ — wa-, and + uṭliʿu, I bring up, let up (aṭlaʿa, IV, imperf. 1 s.) + -hu, him; 'and bring him up'
وَأَجْتَمِعُ: و + أَجْتَمِعُ — wa-, and + ajtamiʿu, I meet, come together (ijtamaʿa, VIII, imperf. 1 s.)
الْعَجُوزِ: الـ + عَجُوز — ʿajūz, old woman, crone (f.); 'the old woman'; gen. in construct
لَمِ: لَم — second part of الْأَلَم al-alam, pain, ache (m.; see الْأَ); the word is printed split; gen. after min
لَهَالَمْ: لَهَا + لَمْ — lahā, to her (li-, to + -hā, her) + lam, not (with jussive); printed as one word
وَتَبَاشَرَ: و + تَبَاشَرَ — wa-, and + tabāshara, they rejoiced, gave one another glad tidings (VI, perf. 3 m.s.; singular verb before its subject)
وَأَصْحَابِي: و + أَصْحَاب + ي — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of ṣāḥib) + -ī, my; 'and my friends'
لِعَا: لِـ + عَا — li-, for, at, because of (prep.) + first part of عَافِيَتِي ʿāfiyatī, 'my health', printed split as لعا فيتي
فِيَتِي: فِيَة + ي — second part of عَافِيَتِي (see لِعَا): ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f.) + -ī, my; gen. after li-; printed split
وَسَأَلَتْنِي: و + سَأَلَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + saʾalat, she asked (saʾala, I, perf. 3 f.s.) + -nī, me; 'and she asked me'
فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا: ف + أَخْبَرْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so + akhbartu, I informed (akhbara, IV, perf. 1 s.) + -hā, her; 'and I told her'
وَعَافِيَةٍ: و + عَافِيَة — wa-, and + ʿāfiya, health, soundness (f.); gen. (coordinate with khayr)
أَنْتَظِرُ: أَنْتَظِرُ — antaẓiru, I wait for (intaẓara, VIII, imperf. 1 s.)
فُسْحَةً: فُسْحَة — fusḥa, spare room, leeway, leisure (f.); acc. (noun of inna)
مَضَيْتَ: مَضَيْتَ — maḍayta, you went (maḍā, I, perf. 2 m.s.)
وَأَزَلْتَ: و + أَزَلْتَ — wa-, and + azalta, you removed (azāla, IV, perf. 2 m.s.)
شَعْرَكَ: شَعْر + كَ — shaʿr, hair (m.) + -ka, your (m.s.); acc. object
سَلَاحَلَا: سَلَاحَلَا — a printed word I cannot read with certainty (perhaps salāḥ/ṣalāḥ 'soundness, benefit' with a stray ending); kept as printed; see the note
الصَّوَابُ: الـ + صَوَاب — ṣawāb, the right thing, correct course (m.); nom. predicate
أَحْلِقُ: أَحْلِقُ — aḥliqu, I shave (ḥalaqa, I, imperf. 1 s.)
وَأَعُودُ: و + أَعُودُ — wa-, and + aʿūdu, I return (ʿāda, I, imperf. 1 s.)
أَرْسَلْتُ: أَرْسَلْتُ — arsaltu, I sent (arsala, IV, perf. 1 s.)
يَحْلِقُ: يَحْلِقُ — yaḥliqu, he shaves (ḥalaqa, I, imperf. 3 m.s.); 'to shave'
وَأْتِنِي: و + أْتِ + نِي — wa-, and + ʾti, bring! (atā, I, imper. 2 m.s.) + -nī, me; 'and bring me'; printed with أ
بِمُزَيِّنٍ: بِـ + مُزَيِّن — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- 'bring') + muzayyin, barber (m.); 'bring a barber'; gen. indef.
وَقَايِلَ: و + قَايِل — wa-, and + qāyil, as printed; very likely a misspelling of qalīl 'little, scant'; acc. in construct with al-fuḍūl
الْفُضُولِ: الـ + فُضُول — fuḍūl, officiousness, meddling (m.; plural of faḍl used as an abstract); 'the meddling'; gen. in construct
يُصَدِّعُ: يُصَدِّعُ — yuṣaddiʿu, he splits, gives a headache to (ṣaddaʿa, II, imperf. 3 m.s.)
رَأْسِى: رَأْس + ي — raʾs, head (m.) + -ī, my; printed with ى; 'my head'
بِكَثْرَةِ: بِـ + كَثْرَة — bi-, by, with (prep.; 'by reason of') + kathra, abundance, much (f.); 'by the abundance of'; gen; here: after maʿrūf bi-, 'known for', bi- marks what one is known for: 'known for much (dealing)'
السُّوؤِ: الـ + سُوء — sūʾ, evil, badness (m.); 'the evil'; printed with a doubled wāw/hamza spelling; gen. in apposition; al-shaykh al-sūʾ 'the wretched old man'
نَاحِلَ: نَاحِل — nāḥil, wasted, emaciated (act. part. of نَحَلَ); acc. (predicate of 'you', in construct)
الْجِسْمِ: الـ + جِسْم — jism, body (m.); 'the body'; gen. in construct
مَرِيضًا: مَرِيض — marīḍ, ill, sick (adj.); acc. indef. (predicate of kāna)
أَذْهَبَ: أَذْهَبَ — (1) adhhaba, he took away, removed (IV, perf. 3 m.s.), optative; (2) adhhaba, that I go (I dhahaba, imperf. 1cs subj., after ḥattā/an)
وَغَمَّكَ: و + غَمّ + كَ — wa-, and + ghamm, grief, gloom (m.) + -ka, your; acc.
وَالْبَأْسَ: و + الـ + بَأْس — wa-, and + al-, the + baʾs, distress, hardship, harm (m.); acc. coordinate
وَالْأَحْزَانَ: و + الـ + أَحْزَان — wa-, and + al-, the + aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn); acc. coordinate
تَقَبَّلَ: تَقَبَّلَ — taqabbala, he accepted (V, perf. 3 m.s.); optative here
أَبْشِرْ: أَبْشِرْ — abshir, rejoice! be of good cheer (abshara, IV, imper. 2 m.s.)
تَقْصِيرَ: تَقْصِير — taqṣīr, shortening, trimming (verbal noun of قَصَّرَ, II; m.); acc. object, in construct
شَعْرِكَ: شَعْر + كَ — shaʿr, hair (m.) + -ka, your (m.s.); gen. in construct
تُخْرِجُ: تُخْرِجُ — tukhriju, you draw out (akhraja, IV, imperf. 2 m.s.)
وَرَدَ: وَرَدَ — warada, it came down, was reported (I, perf. 3 m.s.)
عَبَّاسٍ: عَبَّاس — ʿAbbās (proper name; ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbbās, Companion of the Prophet and early Qurʾān scholar, d. c. 687); gen.
رَضِىَ: رَضِيَ — raḍiya, he was pleased (I, perf. 3 m.s.); printed with ى; raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu 'may God be pleased with him'
صَرَفَ: صَرَفَ — ṣarafa, he turned away, averted (I, perf. 3 m.s.; the subject, God, is understood) Also 'sent away, dismissed': ṣarafa ghilmānahu, 'he dismissed his pages'.
دَاءً: دَاء — dāʾ, disease, ailment (m.); acc. tanwīn (specifying 'seventy')
وَرُوِيَ: و + رُوِيَ — wa-, and + ruwiya, it was related (rawā, I, perf. passive 3 m.s.)
اِحْتَجَمَ: اِحْتَجَمَ — iḥtajama, he had himself cupped, bled (VIII, perf. 3 m.s.)
أَمِنَ: أَمِنَ — amina, he was safe, secure (I, perf. 3 m.s.)
ذَهَابِ: ذَهَاب — dhahāb, going, loss (verbal noun of ذَهَبَ; m.); gen. in construct
دَعْ: دَعْ — daʿ, leave! let be! (wadaʿa, I, imper. 2 m.s.)
وَقُمِ: و + قُمْ — wa-, and + qum, get up! (qāma, I, imper. 2 m.s.), with kasra before wasl
اِحْلِقْ: اِحْلِقْ — iḥliq, shave! (ḥalaqa, I, imper. 2 m.s.)
صَفَائِحَ: صَفِيحَة (pl. صَفَائِح) — ṣafāʾiḥ, plates, flat discs (f. pl.); diptote gen. after sabʿ; 'plates'
مُطَعَّمٌ: مُطَعَّم — muṭaʿʿam, inlaid (passive part. II of ṭaʿʿama), m.s. nom.; 'inlaid'
بِالْفِضَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + فِضَّة — bi-, with (prep., of material); fiḍḍa, silver (f.); 'with silver'
شُعَاعِ: شُعَاع — shuʿāʿ, ray, beam (m.), gen. in annexion; 'the ray of'
يَوْمِنَاهَذَا: يَوْم + نَا + هَذَا — yawm, day (m.), gen. after min; -nā, our; hādhā, this (m. demonstrative); printed run together; 'this our day'
عَاشِرُ: عَاشِر — ʿāshir, tenth (m.), nom. in annexion; 'the tenth of'
صَفَرٍ: صَفَر — Ṣafar, the second month of the Islamic calendar (diptote, here printed gen. with tanwīn); 'Ṣafar'
سَنَةَ: سَنَة — sana, year (f.), acc. in annexion (date adverb); 'the year of'
ثَلٰثٍ: ثَلٰث — thalāth, three (f.), gen.; the dagger alif marks the defective printed ثلث for ثلاث; 'three'
وَخَمْسِينَ: و + خَمْسِينَ — wa-, and (conj.); khamsīna, fifty (gen.); 'and fifty'
وَسِتِّمِائَةٍ: و + سِتّ + مِائَة — wa-, and (conj.); sitt, six (f.); miʾa, hundred (f.), gen.; 'and six hundred'
الْهِجْرَةِ: الـ + هِجْرَة — hijra, the Hijra, Muḥammad's emigration to Medina (f.), gen.; 'the Hijra'
النَّبَوِيَّةِ: الـ + نَبَوِيَّة — nabawiyya, prophetic, of the Prophet (f. adj.), gen.; 'the Prophetic'
صَاحِبِهَا: صَاحِب + هَا — ṣāḥib, master, companion (m.), gen. after ʿalā; -hā, its (the Hijra's); 'its master' (the Prophet)
وَالسَّلَامِ: و + الـ + سَّلَام — wa-, and (conj.); salām, peace (m.), gen.; 'and peace'
وَسَبْعِ: و + سَبْع — wa-, and (conj.); sabʿ, seven, gen. in annexion; 'and seven'
وَثَلٰثِمِائَةٍ: و + ثَلٰث + مِائَة — wa-, and (conj.); thalāth, three; miʾa, hundred (f.), gen., printed ماية (the ya carries the hamza); 'and three hundred'
تَارِيخِ: تَارِيخ — tārīkh, era, date, chronology (m.), gen. in annexion; 'the era of'
الْإِسْكَنْدَرِ: الـ + إِسْكَنْدَر — Iskandar, Alexander (the Great) (m.), gen.; 'Alexander'
وَالطَّالِعُ: و + الـ + طَّالِع — wa-, and (conj.); ṭāliʿ, the ascendant, the rising sign (act. part. of ṭalaʿa, m.), nom.; 'and the ascendant'
أَوْجَبَ: أَوْجَبَ — awjaba, to require, make necessary (IV, perfect 3rd m.s.); 'required'
عِلْمُ: عِلْم — ʿilm, knowledge, science (m.), nom. in annexion; 'the science of'; here 'knowledge of': ʿindī ʿilmu hādhā, 'I know of this' (the ḍamma is printed)
ثَمَانِ: ثَمَان — thamān, eight; printed with a following singular-looking counted noun; 'eight'
دَقَائِقَ: دَقِيقَة (pl. دَقَائِق) — daqāʾiq, minutes (of arc) (f. pl.), diptote gen.; printed دقايق; 'minutes'
قَارَنَهُ: قَارَنَ + هُ — qārana, to be in conjunction with (III, perfect 3rd m.s.); -hu, it (Mars); 'was conjoined with it'
وَدَلَّ: و + دَلَّ — dalla, to indicate, show (perfect 3rd m.s.); 'and it showed'
الِاتِّصَالَ: الـ + اِتِّصَال — ittiṣāl, joining, getting in touch (VIII verbal noun, m.), acc.; 'the joining'
بِشَخْصٍ: بِـ + شَخْص — bi-, with (prep., the object of ittiṣāl 'joining with'); shakhṣ, person (m.), gen.; 'with a person'
مَسْعُودٌ: مَسْعُود — Masʿūd, a proper name, 'fortunate' (m.), nom.; 'Masʿūd'
أَذْكُرُهُ: أَذْكُرُ + هُ — adhkuru, to mention (imperfect 1st s., indicative of dhakara); -hu, it; 'I mention it'
أَضْجَرْتَنِي: أَضْجَرْتَ + نِي — aḍjara, to weary, annoy (IV, perfect 2nd m.s.); -nī, me; 'you have wearied me'
وَصَغَّرْتَ: و + صَغَّرْتَ — ṣaghghara, to make small, belittle (II, perfect 2nd m.s.); 'and you have made small'
وَقَوَّلْتَ: و + قَوَّلْتَ — qawwala, to make words, pronounce (II, perfect 2nd m.s.), a reading of the printed قولت (possibly qulta, 'you said'); 'and you have pronounced'
بِفَالٍ: بِـ + فَأْل — bi-, with (prep., the object of the speech 'pronounce an omen over'); fāl, omen (m.), gen., printed without hamza; 'an omen'
مَلِيحٍ: مَلِيح — malīḥ, good, fair, auspicious (m. adj.), gen. indefinite; 'good'
طَلَبْتُكَ: طَلَبْتُ + كَ — ṭalaba, to seek, send for (perfect 1st s.); -ka, you (m.s.); 'I sought you'
لِتَحْلِقَ: لِـ + تَحْلِقَ — li-, in order to (purpose); taḥliqa, you shave (imperfect 2nd m.s., subjunctive of ḥalaqa); 'that you shave'
وَاحْلِقْ: و + اِحْلِقْ — wa-, and (conj.); iḥliq, shave! (imperative of ḥalaqa); 'and shave'
تُطَوِّلْ: تُطَوِّلْ — tuṭawwil, to lengthen, prolong (II, imperfect 2nd m.s., jussive); 'you prolong' Also with ʿalā, 'to keep someone waiting long': lā tuṭawwil ʿalayya, 'do not keep me waiting long'.
أُشِيرُ: أُشِيرُ — ushīru, to point out, advise (IV, imperfect 1st s., indicative of ashāra); 'I advise'
حِسَابِ: حِسَاب — ḥisāb, reckoning (m.), gen. in annexion; 'the reckoning of'
عِلْمِ: عِلْم — ʿilm, knowledge, science (m.), gen.; 'the science of'; here 'knowledge' in min ghayri ʿilmi, 'without the knowledge of'
لَكِنِّى: لَكِنَّ + ي — lākinna, but indeed (particle); -ī, I (acc. suffix), printed ى; 'but I'
أَدْرِى: أَدْرِي — adrī, to know, be aware (imperfect 1st s. of darā, defective, printed with ى); 'I know'
وَأَعْلَمُ: و + أَعْلَمُ — wa-, and (conj.); aʿlamu, to know (imperfect 1st s., indicative of ʿalima); 'and I know'
كَثِيرُ: كَثِير — kathīr, much, many (m.), nom. in annexion; 'much of'
الْخُزَعْبَلَاتِ: الـ + خُزَعْبَلَات — khuzaʿbalāt, trifles, idle tales, nonsense (f. pl.), gen.; 'the nonsense'
دَعَوْتُكَ: دَعَوْتُ + كَ — daʿā, to call, summon (perfect 1st s.); -ka, you (m.s.); 'I called you'
لِتُزَيِّنَ: لِـ + تُزَيِّنَ — li-, in order to (purpose); tuzayyina, you adorn, dress, barber (II, imperfect 2nd m.s., subjunctive); 'that you dress'
فَجِئْتَنِى: فَـ + جِئْتَ + نِي — fa-, so, then; jāʾa, to come (perfect 2nd m.s.); -nī, me (printed ى), 'you came to me, you brought me'; 'and you brought me'
بِهَذَالْكَلَامِ: بِـ + هَذَا + الـ + كَلَام — bi-, with (prep., 'bring (someone) with'); hādhā, this; kalām, talk (m.), gen.; printed run together; 'with this talk'
الْفَاسِدِ: الـ + فَاسِد — fāsid, corrupt, rotten, vile (act. part. of fasada, m.), gen. adj.; 'the corrupt'
أَتُرِيدُ: أَ + تُرِيدُ — a-, interrogative particle; turīdu, to want (imperfect 2nd m.s., indicative); 'do you want'
أَزِيدُ: أَزِيدُ — azīdu, to add, increase (imperfect 1st s., indicative of zāda); 'I add'
مُنَجِّمٍ: مُنَجِّم — munajjim, astrologer (act. part. II of najjama, m.), gen. indefinite; 'an astrologer'
عَالِمٍ: عَالِم — ʿālim, learned, knowing (act. part. of ʿalima, m.), gen. indefinite; 'learned'
بِصَنْعَةِ: بِـ + صَنْعَة — bi-, in (prep., 'knowing in/of'); ṣanʿa, craft, art (f.), gen. in annexion; 'in the craft of'
وَالسِّيمِيَاءِ: و + الـ + سِّيمِيَاء — wa-, and (conj.); sīmiyāʾ, talismanic or occult science (f.), gen.; 'and occult science'
وَالنَّحْوِ: و + الـ + نَّحْو — wa-, and (conj.); naḥw, grammar, syntax (m.), gen.; 'and grammar'
الصَّرْفِ: الـ + صَّرْف — ṣarf, pure, unmixed (also morphology) (m.), gen.; 'the pure'
وَاللُّغَةِ: و + الـ + لُّغَة — wa-, and (conj.); lugha, language, philology (f.), gen.; 'and language'
وَعِلْمِ: و + عِلْم — wa-, and (conj.); ʿilm, science (m.), gen.; 'and the science of'
وَالْبَيَانِ: و + الـ + بَيَان — wa-, and (conj.); bayān, clarity, the branch of rhetoric on figures (m.), gen.; 'and eloquence'
وَالْحِسَابِ: و + الـ + حِسَاب — wa-, and (conj.); ḥisāb, reckoning, arithmetic (m.), gen.; 'and arithmetic'
وَالْهَيْئَةِ: و + الـ + هَيْئَة — wa-, and (conj.); hayʾa, form, astronomy (f.), gen.; 'and astronomy'
وَالْهَنْدَسَةِ: و + الـ + هَنْدَسَة — wa-, and (conj.); handasa, geometry (f.), gen.; 'and geometry'
وَالْفِقْهِ: و + الـ + فِقْه — wa-, and (conj.); fiqh, jurisprudence, law (m.), gen.; 'and law'
وَالْحَدِيثِ: و + الـ + حَدِيث — wa-, and (conj.); ḥadīth, the Prophet's Traditions (m.), gen.; 'and the Traditions'
وَالتَّفْسِيرِ: و + الـ + تَّفْسِير — wa-, and (conj.); tafsīr, Qurʾānic commentary (m.), gen.; 'and commentary'
وَدَرَسْتُهَا: و + دَرَسْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); darasa, to study (perfect 1st s.); -hā, them (f. pl. as f.s.); 'and I studied them'
وَمَارَسْتُ: و + مَارَسْتُ — māras, to practise, be versed in (III, perfect 1st s.); 'and I practised'
الْأُمُورَ: الـ + أُمُور — umūr, affairs, matters (m. pl. of amr), acc.; 'the affairs'
وَعَرَفْتُهَا: و + عَرَفْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); ʿarafa, to know (perfect 1st s.); -hā, them; 'and I knew them'
وَأَتْقَنْتُهَا: و + أَتْقَنْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); atqana, to master, perfect (IV, perfect 1st s.); -hā, them; 'and I mastered them'
الصَّنْعَةَ: الـ + صَّنْعَة — ṣanʿa, craft, art (f.), acc.; 'the craft'
وَأَحْكَمْتُهَا: و + أَحْكَمْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); aḥkama, to make firm, perfect (IV, perfect 1st s.); -hā, it; 'and I perfected it'
وَدَبَّرْتُ: و + دَبَّرْتُ — dabbara, to manage, contrive (II, perfect 1st s.); 'and I managed'
الْأَشْيَاءِ: الـ + أَشْيَاء — ashyāʾ, things (pl. of shayʾ), diptote gen.; 'the things'
وَرَكَّبْتُهَا: و + رَكَّبْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); rakkaba, to put together, compound (II, perfect 1st s.); -hā, them; 'and I put them together'
يُحِبُّنِى: يُحِبُّ + نِي — yuḥibbu, to love (IV, imperfect 3rd m.s., indicative); -nī, me (printed ى); 'loves me'
لِقِلَّةِ: لِـ + قِلَّة — li-, for, because of (prep., cause); qilla, fewness, scarcity (f.), gen. in annexion; 'for the fewness of'
وَلِهَذَا: و + لِـ + هَذَا — wa-, and (conj.); li-, for, because of (prep., cause); hādhā, this; 'and for this'
خِدْمَتِى: خِدْمَة + ي — khidma, service (f.), nom.; -ī, my (printed ى); 'my service'
فَرْضٌ: فَرْض — farḍ, duty, obligation (m.), nom. indefinite predicate; 'a duty'
لَاكَمَازَعَمْتَ: لَا + كَـ + مَا + زَعَمْتَ — lā, not (negation); ka-, as, like (prep.); mā, what (rel.); zaʿama, to claim (perfect 2nd m.s.); printed as one word; 'not as you claimed'
أُدْعَى: أُدْعَى — udʿā, to be called (passive imperfect 1st s. of daʿā, defective); 'I am called'
بِالصَّامِتِ: بِـ + الـ + صَّامِت — bi-, with, by (prep., 'called by (the name)'); ṣāmit, silent (act. part. of ṣamata, m.), gen.; 'the Silent'
الرَّزِينِ: الـ + رَّزِين — razīn, sedate, grave (m. adj.), gen.; 'the Sedate'
سَبِيلُكَ: سَبِيل + كَ — sabīl, way, course (m.), nom.; -ka, your (m.s.); 'your way'
تَحْمَدَ: تَحْمَدَ — taḥmada, to praise (imperfect 2nd m.s., subjunctive of ḥamida); 'you praise'
وَشَفْقَانُ: و + شَفْقَان — wa-, and (conj.); shafqān, compassionate, pitying (m. adj., colloquial for mushfiq), nom.; 'and compassionate'
وَأَوَدُّأَنْ: و + أَوَدُّ + أَنْ — wa-, and (conj.); awaddu, to wish, like (imperfect 1st s. of wadda); an, that, to (conj., with subjunctive); printed run together; 'and I would like to'
أَكُونَ: أَكُونَ — akūna, to be (imperfect 1st s., subjunctive of kāna); 'I be'
خِدْمَتِكَ: خِدْمَة + كَ — khidma, service (f.), gen. after fī; -ka, your (m.s.); 'your service'
وَتَقُومُ: و + تَقُومُ — wa-, and (conj.); taqūmu, to stand, attend (imperfect 2nd m.s., indicative of qāma); 'and you attend'
بِحَقِّي: بِـ + حَقّ + ي — bi-, with, to (prep., with qāma 'attend to, discharge'); ḥaqq, right, due (m.); -ī, my; 'to my due'
أُجْرَةً: أُجْرَة — ujra, wage, fee (f.), acc. indefinite; 'a wage'
إِنَّكَ: إِنَّ + كَ — inna, indeed (particle, after qāla); -ka, you (m.s., acc.); 'indeed you'
قَاتِلِي: قَاتِل + ي — qātil, killer (act. part. of qatala, m.), nom.; -ī, my; 'my killer'
الْمُ—احِ: الـ + مُ—اح — mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (pass. part. IV of abāḥa, m.), gen.; the printed word has a dash for a hidden letter (probably ب); 'the permitted'
الْمُوفِيَةُ: الـ + مُوفِيَة — mūfiya, fem. act. part. of awfā (IV), completing, making up the full count (f., nom., adj.); 'the completing one'
لِلثَّلٰثِينَ: لِـ + الـ + ثَلٰثِين — li-, of, for (prep.; the night that completes the thirty); thalāthīn, thirty (sound masc. pl. form, gen.); printed without the alif of ثلاثين, hence the dagger alif; 'to the thirty, of the thirty'
يُسَمُّونِي: يُسَمُّون + ي — sammā, to name, call (verb II, impf. 3mp, with -ūna of 'they' although the subject follows) + -ī, me; 'they call me'
الصَّامِتَ: الـ + صَامِت — ṣāmit, silent (act. part. of ṣamata, m., acc. as second object of sammā); 'the Silent'
السِّتَّةِ: الـ + سِتَّة — sitta, six (numeral, gen., placed after the noun as an adjective of ikhwatī); 'the six'
الْبَقْبُوقُ: الـ + بَقْبُوق — al-Baqbūq, nickname, from baqbaqa, to babble, gurgle (m., nom.); 'the Babbler'
الْهَدَّارُ: الـ + هَدَّار — al-Haddār, nickname, from hadara, to rumble, talk loudly (intens. form, m., nom.); 'the Loud-talker'
وَالثَّالِثُ: وَ + الـ + ثَالِث — wa-, and (conj.); thālith, third (ordinal, m., nom.); 'and the third'
فَنِيقٌ: فَنِيق — Fanīq, a name; in the lexicons a stallion camel (m., nom.); obscure here, a nickname
وَالرَّابِعُ: وَ + الـ + رَابِع — wa-, and (conj.); rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal, m., nom.); 'and the fourth'
الْكُوزُالْأَ: الـ + كُوز + الـ + أَ — al-Kūz al-A…, printed run together with the next word: kūz, jug (m.) + the start of al-Aswānī, 'of Aswān'; see the note; 'the Aswān jug'
سْوَانِيُّ: سْوَانِيّ — the rest of al-Aswānī, nisba from Aswān (m., nom.), split off by a misplaced space in the print; 'Aswānī, of Aswān'
وَالْخَامِسُ: وَ + الـ + خَامِس — wa-, and (conj.); khāmis, fifth (ordinal, m., nom.); 'and the fifth'
النَّشَّارُ: الـ + نَشَّار — al-Nashshār, sawyer (intens. form of nashara, to saw, m., nom.); 'the Sawyer'
وَالسَّادِسُ: وَ + الـ + سَادِس — wa-, and (conj.); sādis, sixth (ordinal, m., nom.); 'and the sixth'
شَغَاشِقُ: شَغَاشِق — Shaghāshiq, a name or nickname (m., nom., diptote); obscure
وَالسَّابِعُ: وَ + الـ + سَابِع — wa-, and (conj.); sābiʿ, seventh (ordinal, m., nom.); 'and the seventh'
الصَّامِتُ: الـ + صَامِت — ṣāmit, silent (act. part., m., nom., predicate of ismuhu); 'the Silent'
مَرَارَتِي: مَرَارَة + ي — marāra, gall bladder, gall (f., nom., subject), seat of courage; -ī, my; 'my gall bladder'
انْفَطَرَتْ: انْفَطَرَتْ — infaṭara, to split, burst (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'it split, burst'
أَعْطِهِ: أَعْطِ + هِ — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imper. 2ms) + -hi, him; 'give him'
وَدَعْهُ: وَ + دَعْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); daʿ, imper. 2ms of wadaʿa/dhāʿa 'to leave, let' + -hu, him; 'and let him'
يَنْصَرِفْ: يَنْصَرِفْ — inṣarafa, to go away, depart (verb VII, impf. 3ms, jussive after daʿhu); 'go away'
حَاجَةَ: حَاجَة — ḥāja, need (f., acc. after lā of absolute negation); 'need'
بِحِلَاقَةِ: بِـ + حِلَاقَة — bi-, of (prep., ḥāja bi-, 'a need of'); ḥilāqa, shaving (f. verbal noun of ḥalaqa, gen. in annexion); 'of the shaving of'
الْمَقَالُ: الـ + مَقَال — maqāl, saying, speech, talk (m., nom., predicate); 'the talk'
لَآخُذُ: لَا + آخُذُ — lā, not (negative particle, run into the next word by the print) + ākhudhu, akhadha to take (verb I, impf. 1s); 'I will not take'
أَخْذُ: أَخْذُ — akhdhu as printed: very probably the start of akhdumaka, 'I serve you', garbled by the print (ذ for د, stray space; see note); 'I [serve]'
مَكَ: مَكَ — maka as printed: very probably the end of akhdumaka, the object suffix -ka, 'you' (see note); '[you]'
وَاجِبٌ: وَاجِب — wājib, obligatory, a duty (act. part. of wajaba, m., nom., predicate placed first); 'obligatory'
خِدْمَتُكَ: خِدْمَة + كَ — khidma, service (f., nom., subject placed after the predicate) + -ka, your (m.); 'your service'
وَقَضَاءُ: وَ + قَضَاء — wa-, and (conj.); qaḍāʾ, fulfilment, discharging (m. verbal noun of qaḍā, nom., first term of an annexion); 'and the fulfilment of'
حَاجَتِكَ: حَاجَة + كَ — ḥāja, need, want (f., gen. in annexion) + -ka, your (m.); 'your need'
أُبَالِي: أُبَالِي — bālā, to care, mind (verb III, impf. 1s, defective); 'I care, I mind'
لَاتَعْرِفُ: لَا + تَعْرِفُ — lā, not (negative particle, run into the verb by the print) + taʿrifu, ʿarafa to know (verb I, impf. 2ms); 'you do not know'
قَدْرَكَ: قَدْر + كَ — qadr, worth, rank (m., acc., object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your worth'
رَحِمَهُ: رَحِمَ + هُ — raḥima, to have mercy on (verb I, perf. 3ms, optative: 'may He have mercy on') + -hu, him; 'may He have mercy on him'
كَرِيمًا: كَرِيم — karīm, generous, noble (adj. m., acc. as predicate of kāna, tanwīn); 'generous'
بِمِثْلِ: بِـ + مِثْل — bi-, on, at (prep., marking the time) ; mithl, like, the like of (m., gen. in annexion); 'on the like of'
الْمُبَارَكِ: الـ + مُبَارَك — mubārak, blessed (pass. part. of bāraka III, m., gen., adjective of al-yawm); 'the blessed'
أَخْرِجْ: أَخْرِجْ — akhraja, to bring out, draw out (verb IV, imper. 2ms); 'bring out, draw'
الِاصْطُرْلَابَ: الـ + اصْطُرْلَاب — iṣṭurlāb, astrolabe, astronomer's instrument (m., from Greek, acc., object); 'the astrolabe'
الِارْتِفَاعَ: الـ + ارْتِفَاع — irtifāʿ, rising, altitude of a star above the horizon (m., verbal noun of irtafaʿa VIII, acc., object); 'the altitude'
الطَّالِعَ: الـ + طَالِع — ṭāliʿ, ascendant, rising point of the zodiac (act. part. of ṭalaʿa, m., acc., object); 'the ascendant'
نَحْسًا: نَحْس — naḥs, ill omen, unlucky (m., acc. as second object/predicate, indef.); 'unlucky'
وَإِخْرَاجُ: وَ + إِخْرَاج — wa-, and (conj.); ikhrāj, drawing out (verbal noun of akhraja IV, m., nom., first term of an annexion); 'and the drawing out of'
صَعْبٌ: صَعْب — ṣaʿb, difficult, hard (adj. m., nom., predicate); 'difficult'
مَدْحِ—هِ: مَدْح + هِ — madḥ, praise (m., verbal noun of madaḥa, gen. after fī, split by a printed dash) + -hi, him; 'in praise of him'
اَتَيْتُ: اَتَيْتُ — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 1s; alif printed without hamza); 'I came'
الْمَوْلَى: الـ + مَوْلَى — mawlā, master, lord (m., gen. after ilā); 'the master'
لِاِنْقَاصِ: لِـ + اِنْقَاص — li-, in order to, for (prep., purpose); inqāṣ, diminution, reduction (m. verbal noun of anqaṣa IV, gen.); 'for the reducing of'
اَرَوْقَتًا: اَرَ + وَقْتًا — ara, ra'ā to see (verb I, jussive 1s after lam, printed as one word with the next) + waqtan, time, hour (m., acc., object, indef.); 'I saw no time'
احَدِّثُهُ: احَدِّثُ + هُ — uḥaddithu, ḥaddatha to tell, narrate (verb II, impf. 1s; alif printed without hamza) + -hu, him; 'telling him'
عَجِيبَةٍ: عَجِيبَة — ʿajība, marvel, wondrous thing (f., gen., indef.); 'marvel'
اَنْشُرُ: اَنْشُرُ — anshuru, nashara to spread out, unfold (verb I, impf. 1s; alif printed without hamza); 'I spread out'
الْعِلْمَ: الـ + عِلْم — ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m., acc., object); 'the knowledge'
فَهْمِي: فَهْم + ي — fahm, understanding, intelligence (m., gen. after min, verbal noun of fahima) + -ī, my; 'my understanding'
فَاَعْجَبَهُ: فَـ + اَعْجَبَ + هُ — fa-, and so (connective); aʿjaba, to please, delight (verb IV, perf. 3ms; alif printed without hamza) + -hu, him; 'and it pleased him'
السَّمَاعُ: الـ + سَمَاع — samāʿ, hearing, listening (m., nom., subject of aʿjabahu); 'the hearing'
تَجَاوَزْتَ: تَجَاوَزْتَ — tajāwaza, to exceed, go beyond (verb VI, perf. 2ms); 'you have exceeded'
حَدَّ: حَدّ — ḥadd, limit, boundary (m., acc., object, first term of an annexion); 'the limit of'
الْفَهْمِ: الـ + فَهْم — fahm, understanding (m., gen. in annexion); 'understanding'
يَامَعْدِنَ: يَا + مَعْدِن — yā, O (vocative particle, printed joined) + maʿdin, mine, source (m., acc., vocative annexed); 'O mine of'
لَوْلَاكَ: لَوْلَا + كَ — lawlā, were it not for (particle, introducing a condition; takes the pronoun in -ka) ; 'were it not for you'
اَفَضْتَ: اَفَضْتَ — afāḍa, to pour out, bestow abundantly (verb IV, perf. 2ms; alif printed without hamza); 'you poured out'
الْفَهْمَ: الـ + فَهْم — fahm, understanding (m., acc., object); 'the understanding'
زَادَنِي: زَادَ + نِي — zāda, to increase (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms, here transitive) + -nī, me; 'it increased me'
كَاَنَّكَ: كَـ + اَنَّ + كَ — ka-, like, as (prep.) + anna, that, indeed (alif printed without hamza) + -ka, you; 'as if you were'
الْفَضْلِ: الـ + فَضْل — faḍl, bounty, excellence (m., gen. in annexion); 'bounty'
وَالْجُودِ: وَ + الـ + جُود — wa-, and (conj.); jūd, generosity (m., gen. in a coordination); 'and generosity'
وَالْعَطَا: وَ + الـ + عَطَا — wa-, and (conj.); ʿaṭāʾ, giving, gift (m., gen.; printed without the final hamza); 'and giving'
وَكُنْزُ: وَ + كَنْز — wa-, and (conj.); kanz, treasure (m., nom., predicate, first term of an annexion); 'and the treasure of'
وَالْفَهْمِ: وَ + الـ + فَهْم — wa-, and (conj.); fahm, understanding (m., gen.); 'and understanding'
وَالْحِلْمِ: وَ + الـ + حِلْم — wa-, and (conj.); ḥilm, forbearance, clemency (m., gen.); 'and forbearance'
فَانْطَرَبَ: فَـ + انْطَرَبَ — fa-, and so (connective); inṭaraba, to be moved to delight (verb VII, perf. 3ms, a post-classical form of ṭariba); 'and he was delighted'
وَخِلْعَةً: وَ + خِلْعَة — wa-, and (conj.); khilʿa, robe of honour (f., acc., indef.); 'and a robe of honour'
فَأَعْطَانِي: فَـ + أَعْطَى + نِي — fa-, and so (connective); aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he gave me'
حَمِيدَةٌ: حَمِيدَة — ḥamīda, praiseworthy, favourable (adj. f., nom.); 'a praiseworthy, auspicious'
الدَّمَ: الـ + دَم — dam, blood (m., acc., object); 'the blood'
خَالَفَنِي: خَالَفَ + نِي — khālafa, to oppose, contradict (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he opposed me'
وَشَكَرَنِى: وَ + شَكَرَ + نِى — wa-, and (conj.); shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'and he thanked me'
وَشَكَرُونِي: وَ + شَكَرُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3mp, plural verb before its subject) + -nī, me; 'and they thanked me'
خُرُوجِ: خُرُوج — khurūj, going out, coming out (verbal noun of kharaja, m., gen. in annexion); 'the going out of'
قَوْلَكَ: قَوْل + كَ — qawl, saying (m., verbal noun of qāla, acc., object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your saying'
دِينَارٌ: دِينَار — dīnār, dinar (m., nom., indef., in a verbless clause); 'a dinar'
حَقُّ: حَقّ — ḥaqq, due, right, rightful payment (m., nom., predicate, first term of an annexion); 'the due of'
النِّجَامَةِ: الـ + نِجَامَة — nijāma, astrology, star-reckoning (f., from nujūm, gen. in annexion; pointing provisional); 'the astrology'
وَدِينَارٌ: وَ + دِينَار — wa-, and (conj.); dīnār, dinar (m., nom., indef.); 'and a dinar'
الْمُسَامَرَةِ: الـ + مُسَامَرَة — musāmara, evening conversation, entertaining talk (f. verbal noun of sāmara III, gen. in annexion); 'the evening talk'
الْحِجَامَةِ: الـ + حِجَامَة — ḥijāma, cupping, bloodletting (f. verbal noun, gen. in annexion); 'the cupping, bloodletting'
وَالْمِائَةُ: وَ + الـ + مِائَة — wa-, and (conj.); miʾa, a hundred (f., nom.; the article before the counted noun is a Middle Arabic habit); 'and the hundred'
وَالْخِلْعَةُ: وَ + الـ + خِلْعَة — wa-, and (conj.); khilʿa, robe of honour (f., nom.); 'and the robe of honour'
مَدْحِكَ: مَدْح + كَ — madḥ, praise (m., verbal noun of madaḥa, gen. in annexion) + -ka, your (m.); 'your praise'
رَحِمَ: رَحِمَ — raḥima, to have mercy on (verb I, perf. 3ms, optative); 'may He have mercy'
مِثْلَكَ: مِثْل + كَ — mithl, the like of (m., acc., object, first term of an annexion) + -ka, you (m.); 'the like of you' Also adverbial acc., 'like you, as you do': wa-anā al-ākharu mithlaka arkabu maʿaka, 'and I too will ride with you, as you do'.
رَسُولُاللَّهِ: رَسُول + اللَّه — rasūl, messenger (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa) + Allāh (gen.); 'the Messenger of God' (printed as one word)
يُغَيِّرُ: ghayyara, to change, alter (form II; impf. 3 m. sg.); 'he changes'
يَتَغَيَّرُ: taghayyara, to be changed, to alter oneself (form V; impf. 3 m. sg.); 'he is changed'
أَظُنُّكَ: أَظُنُّ + كَ — ẓanna, to think (impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I think you'
لَكِنَّكَ: لَكِنَّ + كَ — lākinna, but (+ acc.) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'but you'
خَرِفْتَ: kharifa, to dote, to become senile (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you have grown doting'
كِتَابِهِ: كِتَاب + هِ — kitāb, book (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his/His; 'in His book'
وَالْكَاظِمِينَ: وَ + الـ + كَاظِمِين — wa-, and + kāẓim, one who restrains/swallows (act. part. of kaẓama, m. sound pl., acc. here, governing the next word); 'and the restrainers of'
الْغَيْظَ: الـ + غَيْظ — ghayẓ, rage, anger (m., acc., object of kāẓim); 'the rage'
وَالْعَافِينَ: وَ + الـ + عَافِين — wa-, and + ʿāfī, one who pardons (act. part. of ʿafā, m. sound pl.); 'and the pardoners'
عَجَلَتِكَ: عَجَلَة + كَ — ʿajala, haste (f., gen.; second term) + -ka, your; 'your haste'
وَجَدَّكَ: وَ + جَدّ + كَ — wa-, and + jadd, grandfather (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your grandfather'
مَاكَانَا: مَا + كَانَا — mā, not + kāna, to be (perf. 3 m. dual); 'they (two) were not' (printed as one word)
يَفْعَلَانِ: faʿala, to do (impf. 3 m. dual, nom.); with kāna 'they used to do'
بِمَشُورَتِي: بِـ + مَشُورَة + ي — bi-, with, by (prep.; here 'with, by means of') + mashūra, counsel, advice (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my counsel'
الْمُسْتَشَارَ: الـ + مُسْتَشَار — mustashār, one who is consulted (pass. part. of istashāra, form X; m., acc. after inna); 'the consulted one'
مُؤْتَمَنٌ: muʾtaman — entrusted, trusted (pass. part. of iʾtamana, form VIII; m., nom. indef., predicate)
وَمَاخَابَ: وَ + مَا + خَابَ — wa-, and + mā, not + khāba, to fail, be disappointed (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he has not failed' (printed as one word)
اسْتَشَارَ: istashāra, to ask counsel, consult (form X; perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he sought counsel'
بِكَبِيرٍ: بِـ + كَبِير — bi-, redundant particle on the predicate of laysa (adds emphasis only, no meaning of its own) + kabīr, great, elder (m., gen.); 'an elder at all'
عَزَمْتَ: ʿazama, to resolve, be determined (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you resolved'
فَشَاوِرْ: فَـ + شَاوِرْ — fa-, then, so (introducing the command that answers the condition) + shāwir, to consult (form III; imper. 2 m. sg.); 'then consult'
تَعْصِهِ: تَعْصِ + هِ — taʿṣi, to disobey (ʿaṣā; impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after lā) + -hi, him; 'disobey him'
تَجِدُ: wajada, to find (impf. 2 m. sg.); 'you find'
أَعْرَفَ: aʿraf — more knowing (elative of ʿārif/ʿarafa; m., acc. diptote); 'more knowing'
أَقْدَامِي: أَقْدَام + ي — aqdām, feet (pl. of qadam; gen. after ʿalā; first term) + -ī, my; 'my feet'
أَخْدِمُكَ: أَخْدِمُ + كَ — khadama, to serve (impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I serve you'
ضَجِرْتُ: ḍajira, to be weary, annoyed (perf. 1 sg.); 'I grew weary'
ضَجِرْتَ: ḍajira, to be weary (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you grew weary'
أَصْبِرُ: ṣabara, to be patient (impf. 1 sg.); with عَلَى, 'bear with'
مَالِأَبِيكَ: مَا + لِـ + أَب + كَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + li-, to, belonging to (prep.; marks possession) + ab, father (gen.) + -ka, your; 'what your father has' (printed as one word)
ذَنَبَ: dhanab — tail (m., acc. as vocative in an iḍāfa; first term); 'tail of'
أَطَلْتَ: aṭāla, to lengthen, prolong (form IV; perf. 2 m. sg.); with عَلَى, 'you went on at (me) too long'
الْخِطَابَ: الـ + خِطَاب — khiṭāb, address, speech (m., acc.); 'the address'
وَزِدْتَ: وَ + زِدْتَ — wa-, and + zāda, to add, increase (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'and you added'
الْمَقَالِ: الـ + مَقَال — maqāl, speech, saying (m., gen.); 'the speech'
تَحْلِقَ: ḥalaqa, to shave (impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'that you shave'
بَلَّ: balla, to wet, moisten (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he wetted'
دَخَلَكَ: دَخَلَ + كَ — dakhala, to enter (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'it entered you'
الضَّجَرُ: الـ + ضَجَر — ḍajar, weariness, annoyance (m., nom.); 'the weariness'
أُؤَاخِذُكَ: أُؤَاخِذُ + كَ — ākhadha / muʾākhadha, to take to task, hold accountable (form III; impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I hold it against you'
عَقْلَكَ: عَقْل + كَ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your mind'
وَمَتَى: وَ + مَتَى — wa-, and + matā, when (conj./interrog.); 'and when'
أَحْمِلُكَ: أَحْمِلُ + كَ — ḥamala, to carry (impf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I carried you'
كَتِفِى: كَتِف + ي — katif, shoulder (f., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my (printed with final ى); 'my shoulder'
وَأَمْضِي: وَ + أَمْضِي — wa-, and + maḍā, to go, proceed (impf. 1 sg.); 'and I went'
يَاأَخِي: يَا + أَخ + ي — yā, O (vocative) + akh, brother (m.) + -ī, my; 'O my brother' (printed as one word)
أَقْضِىَ: qaḍā, to accomplish, finish (impf. 1 sg., subjunctive after ḥattā; printed with ى); 'I finish'
شُغْلِي: شُغْل + ي — shughl, business, occupation (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my business'
شَقَقْتُ: shaqqa, to tear, rend (perf. 1 sg.; shaqaqtu); 'I tore'
الْمُوسَى: الـ + مُوسَى — mūsā, razor (m., acc.); 'the razor'
وَسَنَّهُ: وَ + سَنَّ + هُ — wa-, and + sanna, to whet, sharpen (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it (obj.); 'and he whetted it'
يَسُنُّهُ: يَسُنُّ + هُ — sanna, to whet (impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'he whets it'
كَادَ: kāda, to be about to, nearly (perf. 3 m. sg.); with an imperfect, 'almost'
عَقْلِى: عَقْل + ي — ʿaql, mind (m., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with final ى); 'my mind'
يُفَارِقُنِى: يُفَارِقُ + نِي — fāraqa, to leave, part from (form III; impf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me (obj.; printed with ى); 'leaves me'
وَحَلَقَ: وَ + حَلَقَ — wa-, and + ḥalaqa, to shave (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he shaved'
وَالتَّأَنِّي: وَ + الـ + تَّأَنِّي — wa-, and + taʾannī, deliberation, taking one's time (maṣdar of taʾannā, form V; m., nom.; printed without hamza); 'and deliberation'
لِامْرٍ: لِـ + أَمْر — li-, for, in the matter of (prep.; with ʿajila, 'hasten over') + amr, matter, affair (m., gen. indef.; printed with bare alif); 'in a matter'
تُبْلَى: balā / ibtalā, to try, test (pass. impf. 2 m. sg.; here 'you will be tried'); read tublā
بِمَنْزِلَتِي: بِـ + مَنْزِلَة + ي — bi-, of, about (prep.; after ʿarafa it marks what is known, a loose Middle Arabic use) + manzila, station, rank (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my station'
تَقَعُ: waqaʿa, to fall, light upon (impf. 3 f. sg.); 'it falls'
رُوُسِ: رُؤُوس — ruʾūs, heads (pl. of raʾs; m., gen.; printed without hamza, first term of an iḍāfa); 'heads of'
وَالْأُمَرَاءِ: وَ + الـ + أُمَرَاء — wa-, and + umarāʾ, emirs, commanders (pl. of amīr; gen.); 'and the emirs'
وَالْحُكَمَاءِ: وَ + الـ + حُكَمَاء — wa-, and + ḥukamāʾ, sages, wise men (pl. of ḥakīm; gen.); 'and the sages'
وَالنُّضَلَاءِ: وَ + الـ + نُضَلَاء — wa-, and + al-nuḍalāʾ, as printed (probably a misprint for الفُضَلَاء, fuḍalāʾ, the learned, pl. of fāḍil; gen.); 'and the learned (?)'
الصَّنَائِعِ: الـ + صَّنَائِع — ṣanāʾiʿ, crafts, trades (pl. of ṣanīʿa/ṣināʿa; gen.); 'the crafts'
الْعُقُودِ: الـ + عُقُود — ʿuqūd, necklaces / strings of beads (pl. of ʿiqd; also 'contracts'; gen.); 'the necklaces'
السُّلُوكِ: الـ + سُّلُوك — sulūk, threads, strings (pl. of silk; gen.; if the pointing is right); 'the threads'
فَيَعْلُو: فَـ + يَعْلُو — fa-, so, and so (consequence) + ʿalā, to rise above, be high (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he rises'
رُوُسُ: رُؤُوس — ruʾūs, heads (pl. of raʾs; m., nom.; printed without hamza, first term of an iḍāfa); 'heads of'
يَعْنِيكَ: يَعْنِي + كَ — yaʿnī, to concern, mean to (verb I, impf. 3ms, jussive-less after lā) + -ka, you (obj.); 'concerns you'
ضَيَّقْتَ: ضَيَّقَ + تَ — ḍayyaqa, to make narrow, tighten, vex (verb II, perf.) + -ta, you (2ms); 'you have narrowed'
وَأَشْغَلْتَ: وَ + أَشْغَلْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ashghalta (ashghala, to occupy, busy; verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'and you have occupied'
مُسْتَعْجِلًا: مُسْتَعْجِل — mustaʿjil, hasty, in a hurry (act. part. of X istaʿjala; m., acc. indef. as second object); 'hasty'
الْعَجَلَةَ: الـ + عَجَلَة — al-, the + ʿajala, haste (f., acc. as subject of inna); 'the haste'
تُورِثُ: تُورِثُ — tūrithu, to bequeath, leave as an inheritance (waritha IV, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'it bequeaths'
النَّدَامَةَ: الـ + نَدَامَة — al-, the + nadāma, regret, remorse (f., acc. obj.); 'the regret'
وَالْحِرْمَانَ: وَ + الـ + حِرْمَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥirmān, deprivation, loss (m., acc.); 'and the deprivation'
الصَّلَوةُ: الـ + صَلَوة — al-, the + ṣalāh (spelled ṣalāt), prayer, blessing (f., nom.); 'the blessing'
خَيْرُ: khayr — best, good (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa; elative sense); 'best of'
تَأَنِّى: تَأَنٍّ — taʾannin, deliberation, patience (verbal noun of V taʾannā; m. indef.), printed with final ى; 'deliberation'
رَابَنِي: رَابَ + نِي — rāba, to cause doubt or misgiving (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (obj.); 'it has made me uneasy'
أَمْرُكَ: أَمْر + كَ — amr, matter, affair, doing (m., nom., subject) + 2ms; 'your affair'
فَأَشْتَهِي: فَـ + أَشْتَهِي — fa-, so (conj.) + ashtahī, I desire (ishtahā, verb VIII, impf. 1cs, final ي as printed); 'so I desire'
تُعَرِّفَنِي: تُعَرِّفَ + نِي — tuʿarrifa, to let know, inform (ʿarrafa, verb II, impf. 2ms subjunctive after an) + -nī, me (obj.); 'that you let me know'
قَصَدْتَ: قَصَدَ + تَ — qaṣada, to aim at, intend (verb I, perf.) + -ta, you (2ms); 'you have intended'
أَخْشَي: أَخْشَى — akhshā, I fear (khashiya, verb I defective, impf. 1cs), final ي as printed; 'I fear'
شَيْأً: shayʾan — shayʾ, thing (m., acc. indef. as predicate of kāna); printed شيأ with the hamza on a bare seat; 'something'
لِوَقْتِ: لِـ + وَقْت — li-, until, for (prep., marking the point the remaining time runs to) + waqt, time (m., gen.); 'until the time of'
الصَّلَوةِ: الـ + صَلَوة — al-, the + ṣalāh (spelled ṣalāt), prayer (f., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the prayer'
سَا: sā — first half of سَاعَات, 'hours', printed split; read together with the next word as sāʿāt
عَاتٍ: ʿāt + -in — second half of سَاعَات, sāʿa, hour (f. pl., gen. indef.); read with the preceding word as 'hours'
شَكٍّ: شَكّ — shakk, doubt (m., gen. indef. after fī); 'doubt'; here after min ghayri: min ghayri shakkin, 'without doubt'
التَّحْقِيقِ: الـ + تَحْقِيق — al-, the + taḥqīq, verification, certainty (verbal noun of II ḥaqqaqa; m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the verification'; ʿalā al-taḥqīq 'for certain, exactly'
رَجْمًا: رَجْم — rajm, stoning, throwing stones; conjecture (verbal noun of rajama; m., acc. indef. as predicate of kāna); 'a stoning'
بِالْغَيْبِ: بِـ + الـ + غَيْب — bi-, at, with (prep., here ‘at/against’, completing the phrase rajm bi-al-ghayb) + al-, the + ghayb, the unseen (m., gen.); 'at the unseen'
عَيْبٌ: عَيْب — ʿayb, fault, blemish (m., nom. indef., subject of the sentence with fīhi predicate); 'a fault'
لِمِثْلِي: لِـ + مِثْل + ـي — li-, for, in the case of (prep.) + mithl, the like of (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'for one like me'
وَاشْتَهَرَ: وَ + اشْتَهَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ishtahara, to become famous (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and became famed'
فَضْلِي: فَضْل + ـي — faḍl, excellence, merit (m., nom.) + 1cs; 'my excellence'
فَمَايَنْبَغِي: فَـ + مَا + يَنْبَغِي — fa-, so (conj.) + mā, not (negation) + yanbaghī, it is fitting (inbaghā, verb VII, impf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'so it is not fitting'
أَتَكَلَّمَ: أَتَكَلَّمَ — atakallama, to speak (verb V, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'that I speak'
حَدْسًا: حَدْس — ḥads, conjecture, guesswork (m., acc. indef. of manner); 'by guess'
تَتَكَلَّمُ: تَتَكَلَّمُ — tatakallamu, to speak (verb V, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'she speaks'
عَامَّةُ: عَامَّة — ʿāmma, the common people, the generality (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the common run of'
الْاصْطُرْلَابَ: الـ + اصْطُرْلَاب — al-, the + iṣṭurlāb, astrolabe (m., acc. obj.; from Greek); 'the astrolabe'
مَدِيدَةً: مَدِيدَة — madīda, long, extended (f. adj., acc. indef., agreeing with mudda); 'long'
لَاتَزِيدُ: لَا + تَزِيدُ — lā, not (negating the imperfect) + tazīdu, to increase (zāda, verb I hollow, impf. 3fs, indic.); printed as one word; 'it does not increase'
وَلَاتَنْقُصُ: وَ + لَا + تَنْقُصُ — wa-, and + lā, not + tanquṣu, to decrease (naqaṣa, verb I, impf. 3fs, indic.); printed as one word; 'and does not decrease'
اسْكُتْ: uskut — sakata, to be silent (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'be silent'
فَتَّتَّ: fattatta — fattata, to crumble, shatter (verb II, perf. 2ms; the stem’s t and the subject’s -ta written as one letter); 'you have crumbled'
