فَلَوْأَطْلَعْتَنِي: فَـ + لَوْ + أَطْلَعْتَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + law, if (counterfactual) + aṭlaʿta, to let know, inform (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'so if you had informed me'
سَبَبِهَا: سَبَب + هَا — sabab, cause, reason (m., gen. after ʿalā) + 3fs; 'its cause'
خَيْرًالَكَ: خَيْرًا + لَ + كَ — khayran, better (acc. indef., predicate of kāna) + li-, for (prep., marking who benefits) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'better for you'
خَلَاصٌ: خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m., nom. indef.); 'deliverance'
وَأُرِيدُأَنْ: وَ + أُرِيدُ + أَنْ — wa-, and (conj.) + urīdu, I want (arāda, verb IV, impf. 1cs) + an, to (subjunctive particle); printed as one word; 'and I want to'
تَأَخَّرْتُ: تَأَخَّرَ + تُ — taʾakhkhara, to be late, delayed (verb V, perf.) + -tu, I; 'I am late'
لَأَدْرِي: لَا + أَدْرِي — lā, not + adrī, I know (darā, verb I defective, impf. 1cs); the print has one alif for both; 'I do not know'
الدُّخُولِ: الـ + دُخُول — al-, the + dukhūl, entering (verbal noun of dakhala; m., gen. after ilā); 'the entering'; here: gen. after fī, adhina lahu fī al-dukhūli, 'gave him leave to enter'
أَوْجِزْوَدَعْ: أَوْجِزْ + وَ + دَعْ — awjiz, be brief (wajaza IV, imperative 2ms) + wa-, and (conj.) + daʿ, leave! (wadaʿa, imperative 2ms); printed as one word; 'be brief and leave'
وَالْفُضُولَ: وَ + الـ + فُضُول — wa-, and + al-, the + fuḍūl, excess, meddling, officiousness (m., acc.); 'and the meddling'
دَعْوَةٍ: دَعْوَة — daʿwa, invitation, banquet (f., gen. indef. after ilā); 'an invitation'
يَوْمُكَ: يَوْم + كَ — yawm, day (m., nom. subject) + 2ms; 'your day'
أَصْلِ: aṣl — root, origin, source (m., gen. after min); printed apart from the next word in aṣl qāʾī, which is probably a misprint for aṣdiqāʾī 'my friends'
قَائِي: qāʾī — printed as a separate word after aṣl; as printed, perhaps a damaged form of أَصْدِقَائِي 'my friends'; the sense, 'my friends', is taken from that
أَهْتَمَّ: أَهْتَمَّ — ahtamma, to care, take pains (ihtamma, verb VIII, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'that I take care'
يَأكُلُونَهُ: يَأْكُلُونَ + هُ — yaʾkulūna, to eat (akala, verb I, impf. 3mp, indic.) + -hu, it (obj.); 'they eat it' (the edition prints the hamza)
افْتَكَرْتُ: افْتَكَرَ + تُ — iftakara, to think of, call to mind (verb VIII, perf.) + -tu, I; 'I remembered'
وَافَضِيحَتَاهْ: وَا + فَضِيحَة + ـاهْ — wā, oh! (particle of lament) + faḍīḥa, disgrace, scandal (f.) + -āh, the lament’s closing; 'oh, the shame of it!'
لَاتَهْتَمَّ: لَا + تَهْتَمَّ — lā, do not (prohibition) + tahtamma, to trouble oneself (ihtamma, verb VIII, jussive 2ms); printed as one word; 'do not trouble yourself'
تَعْرِيفِكَ: تَعْرِيف + كَ — taʿrīf, making known, informing (verbal noun of II ʿarrafa; m., gen.) + -ka, you (as the object); 'informing you'
وَشَرَابٍ: وَ + شَرَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + sharāb, drink (m., gen. indef.); 'and drink'
فَهُوَلَكَ: فَـ + هُوَ + لَ + كَ — fa-, then (opening the main clause) + huwa, it (indep. pron. 3ms) + li-, to, belonging to (prep.) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'then it is yours'
أَنْجَزْتَ: أَنْجَزَ + تَ — anjaza, to complete, accomplish (verb IV, perf.) + -ta, you (2ms); 'you complete'
وَعَجَّلْتَ: وَ + عَجَّلَ + تَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿajjala, to hasten (verb II, perf.) + -ta, you; 'and you hasten'
حِلَاقَةَ: حِلَاقَة — ḥilāqa, shaving (verbal noun, f., acc. obj.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the shaving of'
صِفْ: ṣif — waṣafa, to describe (verb I assimilated, imperative 2ms); 'describe!'
لِأَضْيَافِي: لِـ + أَضْيَاف + ـي — li-, for, for the sake of (prep.) + aḍyāf, guests (pl. of ḍayf; gen.) + 1cs; 'for my guests'
أَعْرِفَهُ: أَعْرِفَ + هُ — aʿrifa, to know (ʿarafa, impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā) + -hu, it (obj.); 'that I know it'
خَمْسَةُ: خَمْسَة — khamsa, five (numeral, nom., first term of a construct with a plural genitive); 'five'
وَعَشْرُ: وَ + عَشْر — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿashr, ten (numeral, nom., first term of a construct); 'and ten'
دَجَاجَاتٍ: دَجَاجَات — dajājāt, chickens, hens (sound f. pl. of dajāja; gen. indef.); 'chickens'
مُحَمَّرَاتٍ: مُحَمَّرَات — muḥammarāt, browned, fried (pass. part. of II ḥammara; f. pl., gen. indef.); 'browned'
وَخَرُوفٌ: وَ + خَرُوف — wa-, and (conj.) + kharūf, lamb (m., nom. indef.); 'and a lamb'
مَشْوِيٌّ: مَشْوِيّ — mashwiyy, roasted (pass. part. of shawā; m., nom. indef.); 'roasted'
أَحْضِرْهُمْ: أَحْضِرْ + هُمْ — aḥḍir, bring! (aḥḍara, verb IV, imperative 2ms) + -hum, them (3mp, obj.); 'bring them'
عَايَنَهُ: عَايَنَ + هُ — ʿāyana, to inspect, see with the eyes (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (obj.); 'he inspected it'
أَحْضِرْهُ: أَحْضِرْ + هُ — aḥḍir, bring! (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + -hu, it (obj.); 'bring it' Also of a person, 'bring him': aḥḍirhu bayna yadayka, 'bring him before you'.
فَأَحْضَرْتُهُ: فَـ + أَحْضَرْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aḥḍartu, I brought (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'so I brought it'
دَرُّكَ: دَرّ + كَ — darr, milk, flow of milk (m., nom., subject of the stock cry) + 2ms; lillāhi darruka, 'to God your milk', i.e. 'God bless you'
أَكْرَمَ: أَكْرَمَ — akrama, how generous! (elative-form exclamation mā akrama, from karuma; perf. 3ms form); 'how generous'
الْبَخُورُ: الـ + بَخُور — al-, the + bakhūr, incense (m., nom. subject of baqiya); 'the incense'
وَالطِّيبُ: وَ + الـ + طِيب — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭīb, perfume, scent (m., nom.); 'and the perfume'
دُرْجَانِيَّةَ: دُرْجَانِيَّة — durjāniyya, a small casket or chest with drawers (f., acc. obj.; first term of an iḍāfa; form uncertain, cf. durj 'casket'); 'a casket of'
نَدٍّ: نَدّ — nadd, a compounded perfume of aloes-wood, musk and ambergris (m., gen. indef.); 'nadd'
وَعُودٍ: وَ + عُود — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿūd, aloes-wood (m., gen. indef.); 'and aloes-wood'
وَعَنْبَرٍ: وَ + عَنْبَر — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿanbar, ambergris (m., gen. indef.); 'and ambergris'
وَمِسْكٍ: وَ + مِسْك — wa-, and (conj.) + misk, musk (m., gen. indef.); 'and musk'
بِحَيَاةِ: بِـ + حَيَاة — bi-, by (prep. of oath: 'by the life of …') + ḥayāt, life (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the life of'
آخُذُهُ: آخُذُ + هُ — ākhudhu, I take (akhadha, verb I, impf. 1cs, indic., the hamza-ā contracted) + -hu, it (obj.); 'I take it'
فَأَمَرْتُ: فَـ + أَمَرْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + amartu, I ordered (amara, verb I, perf. 1cs; here with a direct object); 'so I ordered'
الْغُلَامَ: الـ + غُلَام — al-, the + ghulām, boy, young servant (m., acc. obj.); 'the boy'
فَرَمَى: فَـ + رَمَى — fa-, and then (conj.) + ramā, to throw, let fall (perf. 3ms); 'and he threw'
يُقَلِّبُ: يُقَلِّبُ — yuqallibu, to turn over, rummage through (qallaba, verb II, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'turning over'
الطِّيبَ: الـ + طِيب — al-, the + ṭīb, perfume (m., acc. obj.); 'the perfume'
وَالْبَخُورَ: وَ + الـ + بَخُور — wa-, and + al-, the + bakhūr, incense (m., acc.); 'and the incense'
يَنْشُو: yanshū — nashā, to grow up (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms); 'he grows up'
الْاُصُولَ: الـ + أُصُول — uṣūl, roots, origins (pl. of aṣl, m., acc. after inna); 'the roots'; the verse prints the initial alif without a hamza sign
يَنْبُتُ: yanbutu — nabata, to sprout, grow (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'it grows'
أَشْكُرُكَ: أَ + أَشْكُرُ + كَ — the question 'do I thank you?' (the interrogative a- is not written separately from the verb's prefix) + ashkuru, shakara, to thank (imperf. 1cs) + -ka, you (obj.); 'whether I thank you'
أَشْكُرُ: am — or (conj. joining the two halves of an alternative question)
وَالِدَكَ: وَالِد + كَ — wālid, father (m., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your father'
دَعْوَتِي: دَعْوَة + ـي — daʿwa, invitation, feast (f.; the subject, nom.) + -ī, my; 'my invitation'
وَإِحْسَانِكَ: وَ + إِحْسَان + ـكَ — wa-, and + iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (m., gen., verbal noun of aḥsana) + -ka, your; 'and your kindness'
سَادَةٌ: sāda — lords, gentlemen (pl. of sayyid, m., nom. indef.; tanwīn on a broken plural); 'gentlemen'
مُحْتَرَمُونَ: muḥtaram — respected, honoured (passive part. of Form VIII iḥtarama; m. sound pl. nom.); 'respected'
زَنْتُوتٍ: Zantūt — a personal name (m., gen. indef.); 'Zantūt'
الْحَمَّامِيِّ: الـ + حَمَّامِيّ — ḥammāmī, bath-keeper (nisba of ḥammām, a public bath; m., gen., in apposition); 'the bath-keeper'
وَصُلَيْعٍ: وَ + صُلَيْع — wa-, and + Ṣulayʿ, a personal name (diminutive form, gen. indef.); 'and Ṣulayʿ'
الْفَامِيِّ: الـ + فَامِيّ — fāmī, seller of fūm (grain, wheat or garlic, uncertain; nisba of fūm; m., gen., apposition); 'the fūm-seller'
وَسِيلَتٍ: وَ + سِيلَت — wa-, and + Sīlat, a personal name of uncertain form (gen. indef.); 'and Sīlat'
الْفَوَّالِ: الـ + فَوَّال — fawwāl, seller of fūl, broad beans (intensive trade-noun; m., gen., apposition); 'the bean-seller'
عَكْرَنَةَ: ʿAkarna — a personal name (f.-looking ending, treated as diptote, gen. with fatḥa); 'ʿAkarna' (juxtaposed with the next noun)
الْبَقَّالِ: الـ + بَقَّال — baqqāl, grocer (trade-noun from baql, herbs; m., gen., apposition); 'the grocer'
وَحَمِيدٍ: وَ + حَمِيد — wa-, and + Ḥamīd, a personal name (m., gen. indef.); 'and Ḥamīd'
الزَّبَّالِ: الـ + زَبَّال — zabbāl, dustman, refuse-collector (trade-noun from zibl, refuse; m., gen., apposition); 'the dustman'
وَسَعِيدٍ: وَ + سَعِيد — wa-, and + Saʿīd, a personal name (m., gen. indef.); 'and Saʿīd'
الْجَمَّٰلِ: الـ + جَمَّال — jammāl, camel-driver, camel-man (m., gen., apposition); the edition prints الجمل without alif, read with the dagger alif; 'the camel-driver'
وَسُوَيْلِمٍ: وَ + سُوَيْلِم — wa-, and + Suwaylim, a personal name (diminutive of Salīm, gen. indef.); 'and Suwaylim'
الْعَتَّالِ: الـ + عَتَّال — ʿattāl, porter (m., gen., apposition); 'the porter'
وَأَبُو: وَ + أَبُو — wa-, and + abū, father of (kunya, in the nominative form even where a genitive would be expected); 'and Abū'
مَكَارِشٍ: Makārish — a personal name, second element of the kunya Abū Makārish (gen. indef.); 'Makārish'
الْبَلَّانِ: الـ + بَلَّان — ballān, bath-attendant (m., gen., apposition); 'the bath-attendant'
وَقَسِيمٍ: وَ + قَسِيم — wa-, and + Qasīm, a personal name (m., gen. indef.); 'and Qasīm'
الْحَارِسِ: الـ + حَارِس — ḥāris, guard, watchman (active part. of ḥarasa; m., gen., apposition); 'the watchman'
وَكَرِيمٍ: وَ + كَرِيم — wa-, and + Karīm, a personal name (m., gen. indef.); 'and Karīm'
مُعَرْبِدٌ: muʿarbid — rowdy, quarrelsome in drink (active part. of Form IV iʿrabada; m., nom. indef.); 'a brawler'
فُضُولِيٌّ: fuḍūlī — meddler, busybody (nisba of fuḍūl, superfluity; m., nom. indef.); 'a busybody'
مُنَكِّدٌ: munakkid — spoil-joy, one who vexes (active part. of Form II nakkada; m., nom. indef.); 'a spoiler of the mood'
وَلِكُلِّ: وَ + لِـ + كُلّ — wa-, and + li-, for, belonging to (prep. of possession: 'there is for ...') + kull, each (m., gen.); 'and for each'
رَقْصَةٌ: raqṣa — a dance (f. noun of unity from raqṣ; nom. indef.); 'a dance'
يَرْقُصُهَا: يَرْقُصُ + هَا — yarquṣu, from raqaṣa, to dance (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, it (3fs, the dance, cognate object); 'he dances it'
وَأَبْيَاتٌ: وَ + أَبْيَات — wa-, and + abyāt, lines of verse (pl. of bayt, m.; nom. indef. tanwīn); 'and verses'
يُنْشِدُهَا: يُنْشِدُ + هَا — yunshidu, from anshada, to recite (Form IV, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, them (3fs, the verses); 'he recites them'
وَأَحْسَنُ: وَ + أَحْسَنُ — wa-, and + aḥsan, best (elative of ḥasan, m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the best of' Also as a predicate, 'better', with no iḍāfa: astaru lanā wa-aḥsanu, 'safer for us, and better'.
خَادِمِكَ: خَادِم + كَ — khādim, servant (active part. of khadama; m., gen. second term of the iḍāfa mithlu) + -ka, your; 'your servant'
كَثْرَةَ: كَثْرَة — kathra, abundance, much (f., acc., object); 'much of'
الْفُضُولَ: الـ + فُضُول — fuḍūl, meddling, superfluity (m., acc., object of yaʿrifūna); 'the meddling'
الْحَمَّامِيُّ: الـ + حَمَّامِيّ — ḥammāmī, bath-keeper (m., nom., topic after ammā); 'the bath-keeper'
يُغَنِّي: yughannī — ghannā, to sing (Form II defective, imperf. 3ms); 'he sings'
الدَّرْبَلَةِ: الـ + دَرْبَلَة — darbala, a drum of some kind (f., gen. after ʿalā), vowels uncertain; 'the drum'
السَّمْرُو: الـ + سَمْرُو — samrū, a tune or dance of unknown identity (m., gen.); 'the samrū'
يَرْقُصُ: yarquṣu — raqaṣa, to dance (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he dances'
أَنَارَائِحٌ: أَنَا + رَائِح — anā, I + rāʾiḥ, going away, setting out (active part. of rāḥa; m., nom. indef.); 'I am going'; the print runs the two words together
امْلِى: imlī — malaʾa, to fill (verb I, imperative fem. sg.; the print writes final ى and drops the hamza); 'fill!'
جَرَّتِي: جَرَّة + ـي — jarra, jar, pitcher (f., acc., object) + -ī, my; 'my jar'
الْفَامِيُّ: الـ + فَامِيّ — fāmī, seller of fūm (m., nom., topic after ammā); 'the fūm-seller'
يَجِئُ: yajīʾu — jāʾa, to come, bring (verb I, imperf. 3ms, hollow with final hamza, written with ئ in the edition); 'he comes'
بِالْمَعْرِفَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَعْرِفَة — bi-, with (prep.: he comes with, i.e. produces, performs) + maʿrifa, knowledge, know-how (f., gen.); 'with know-how'; sense uncertain
وَيَرْقُصُ: وَ + يَرْقُصُ — wa-, and + yarquṣu, raqaṣa, to dance (imperf. 3ms); 'and he dances'
نَائِحَةُ: nāʾiḥa — wailing woman, mourner (active part. fem. of nāḥa; vocative, nom. -u); 'O mourner'
مَاقَصَّرْتِ: مَا + قَصَّرْتِ — mā, not (neg. particle before a perfect) + qaṣṣarti, qaṣṣara, to fall short (Form II, perf. 2fs); 'you have not fallen short'; the print runs them together and itself marks the kasra of the final tā'
يُخَلِّي: yukhallī — khallā, to leave, let be (Form II defective, imperf. 3ms); 'he leaves'
فُؤَادًا: fuʾād — heart (m., acc. indef.; second object of yukhallī); spelled precomposed ؤ, as in the edition
الضَّحِكِ: الـ + ضَحِك — ḍaḥik, laughing (verbal noun of ḍaḥika; m., gen.); 'the laughing'
الزَّبَّالُ: الـ + زَبَّال — zabbāl, dustman (m., nom., topic after ammā); 'the dustman'
فَيُوقِفُ: فَـ + يُوقِفُ — fa-, and so (result) + yūqifu, awqafa, to make stop (Form IV, imperf. 3ms); 'and so he halts'
الْأَطْيَارَ: الـ + أَطْيَار — aṭyār, birds (pl. of ṭayr, m., acc., object of yūqifu); 'the birds'
مِقْدَارٌ: miqdār — measure, size, amount (m., nom. indef.); 'a size'
الْفِدَاءُ: الـ + فِدَاء — fidāʾ, ransom (m., nom., predicate); 'the ransom'
لِزَبَّالٍ: لِـ + زَبَّال — li-, for the sake of, on behalf of (prep., with fidāʾ: 'ransom for') + zabbāl, dustman (m., gen. indef.); 'for a dustman'
شُغِفْتُ: shughiftu — shughifa, to be smitten with passion (verb I passive, perf. 1cs); 'I was smitten'
حُلْوُ: ḥulw — sweet, pleasing (adj., m., nom. indef., first term of an iḍāfa); 'sweet of'
الْغُصْنَ: الـ + غُصْن — ghuṣn, branch, bough (m., acc., object); 'the bough'
مَيَّادَا: mayyād — swaying (intensive adj. of māda, to sway; m., acc. as ḥāl; rhyme-alif printed); 'swaying'
جَادَ: jāda — to be generous, to yield freely (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'was generous'
يَنْقُصُ: yanquṣu — naqaṣa, to diminish, grow less (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with minnī, 'wears me down'
زَادَا: zāda — to increase, grow (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; rhyme-alif printed); 'it grew'
أَضْرَمْتَ: aḍramta — aḍrama, to kindle, set alight (Form IV, perf. 2ms); 'you kindled'
نَارًا: nāran — nār, fire (f., acc. indef.; object); 'a fire'
فَجَاوَبَنِي: فَـ + جَاوَبَ + نِي — fa-, and so + jāwaba, to answer (Form III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (obj.); 'and so he answered me'
غَرْوَ: gharwa — gharw, cause for wonder (m., acc. without tanwīn after lā of absolute negation); lā gharwa, 'no wonder'
أَصْبَحَ: aṣbaḥa — to become (Form IV, 'to enter the morning'; a sister of kāna, perf. 3ms)
وَقَّادَا: waqqād — stoker, kindler of fire (intensive of wāqid; m., acc. as predicate of aṣbaḥa; rhyme-alif printed); 'a stoker'
كَمُلَ: kamula — to be complete, perfect (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'is perfected'
كُلِّوَاحِدٍ: كُلّ + وَاحِد — kull, each + wāḥid, one (m., gen. after fī); the print runs them together; 'each one'
يُلْهِى: yulhī — alhā, to divert, distract (Form IV defective, imperf. 3ms; final yā' printed ى); 'it diverts'
وَالْمَضْحَكَةِ: وَ + الـ + مَضْحَكَة — wa-, and + maḍḥaka, laughing-matter, comedy (f., gen.); 'and comedy'
كَالْعِيَانِ: كَـ + الـ + عِيَان — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison) + ʿiyān, seeing with one's own eyes (m., gen.); 'like eyewitness'
فَإِنِ: فَـ + إِنِ — fa-, so (resuming after the previous clause) + in, if (conditional particle; kasra to avoid a cluster before the wasl-alif); 'so if'
اخْتَرْتَ: ikhtarta — ikhtāra, to choose (Form VIII hollow, perf. 2ms); 'you chose'
أَحَبُّ: aḥabb — dearer, more beloved (elative of ḥabīb; m., nom., predicate); with ilā, 'dearer to'
وَإِلَيْنَا: وَ + إِلَى + نَا — wa-, and + ilā, to (prep.) + -nā, us; 'and to us'
وَاتْرُكْ: وَ + اتْرُكْ — wa-, and + utruk, taraka, to leave, give up (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'and leave'
رَوَاحَكَ: رَوَاح + كَ — rawāḥ, going off, setting out (verbal noun of rāḥa; m., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your going'
أَصْدِقَائِكَ: أَصْدِقَاء + كَ — aṣdiqāʾ, friends (pl. of ṣadīq; m., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your; 'your friends'
عَوَّلْتَ: ʿawwalta — ʿawwala, to rely (on: ʿalā) (Form II, perf. 2ms; the shadda is the edition's own); 'you relied'
أَثَرَ: athara — athar, trace, mark, sign (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa; 'upon you [is] the trace of' is a fronted-predicate sentence, and the acc. is as printed, where Classical would have the nom. athar); 'the trace of'
وَرُبَّمَا: وَ + رُبَّمَا — wa-, and + rubbamā, perhaps, it may be that (rubba + mā); 'and perhaps'
تَمْضِي: tamḍī — maḍā, to go, go away (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms, indic.); 'you go'
أَقْوَامٍ: aqwām — peoples, folk (pl. of qawm; m., gen. indef. after ilā); 'people'
كَثِيرِينَ: kathīrīna — kathīr, many, much (adj., here a plural with -īna; gen. in agreement, but the nūn is kept before the following noun); 'many (in) speech'
يَتَكَلَّمُونَ: yatakallamūna — takallama, to speak (Form V, imperf. 3mp, indic.); 'they speak'
صَغَّرْتَ: ṣaghgharta — ṣaghghara, to make small, diminish (Form II, perf. 2ms); 'you made small' (sense uncertain)
وَضَحِكْتُ: وَ + ضَحِكْتُ — wa-, and + ḍaḥiktu, ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I laughed'
اقْضِ: iqḍi — qaḍā, to accomplish, finish (verb I defective, imperative 2ms; printed without final yā'); 'finish!'
وَأَسِيرُ: وَ + أَسِيرُ — wa-, and + asīru, sāra, to go, travel (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs, indic. where Classical would use the jussive/subjunctive after an imperative); 'and I go'
أَمَانِ: أَمَان — amān, safety, safe-keeping (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the keeping of'
وَتَمْضِي: وَ + تَمْضِي — wa-, and + tamḍī, maḍā, to go (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms); 'and you go'
أَصْحَابِكَ: أَصْحَاب + كَ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; m., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your; 'your companions'
فَإِنَّهُمْ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُمْ — fa-, so, for (conj., here 'for') + inna, indeed (particle governing the accusative) + -hum, they/them (3mp suffix); 'for indeed they'
قُدُومَكَ: قُدُوم + كَ — qudūm, arrival, coming (m. verbal noun of qadima, acc. as object) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your arrival'
يَامَوْلَايَ: يَا + مَوْلَى + ـيَ — yā, O (vocative) + mawlā, master, lord (m., acc. after yā as a first term) + -ya, my (1s); 'O my master' (printed as one word)
طَلَبْتُ: ṭalabtu — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I sought'
أُعَاشِرَكَ: أُعَاشِرَ + كَ — ʿāshara, to associate with, keep company with (verb III, impf. 1s subj.) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'that I bring you into company'
بِهَؤُلَاءِ: بِـ + هَؤُلَاءِ — bi-, with (prep.; ʿāshara bi-, 'bring into company with') + hāʾulāʾi, these (demonstrative, pl. common, gen.); 'with these'
الْأَقْوَامِ: الـ + أَقْوَام — qawm, folk, people (m., broken pl. aqwām, gen. after the demonstrative); 'the folk'
الْأَكْيَاسِ: الـ + أَكْيَاس — kayyis, clever, shrewd (adj., broken pl. akyās, gen. in apposition); 'the clever ones'
مُذْنَشَأْتُ: مُذْ + نَشَأْتُ — mudh, since (prep.) + nasha'a, to grow up (verb I, perf. 1s); 'since I grew up' (printed as one word)
أَقْدِرُأُعَا: أَقْدِرُ + أُعَا(شِرُ) — qadara, to be able (verb I, impf. 1s) + first part of uʿāshiru (see next entry), written together in print; 'I am able to keep company'
شِرُطْ: (أُعَا)شِرُ + ط — the rest of uʿāshiru, I keep company (verb III, impf. 1s) with a stray ط; misprint or stray letter, see note; 'keep company'
أُعَاشِرُ: uʿāshiru — ʿāshara, to keep company with (verb III, impf. 1s, indicative); 'I keep company with'
فَإِنَّكَ: فَـ + إِنَّ + كَ — fa-, for + inna, indeed + -ka, you (2ms); 'for indeed you'
لَوْعَاشَرْتَهُمْ: لَوْ + عَاشَرْتَ + هُمْ — law, if (hypothetical particle, 'if (contrary to fact)') + ʿāshara, to keep company with (verb III, perf. 2ms) + -hum, them (3mp obj.); 'if you kept their company' (printed as one word)
وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ: وَ + رَأَيْتَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hum, them (3mp obj.); 'and saw them'
أَصْحَابِكَ: أَصْحَاب + كَ — aṣḥāb, companions, friends (m., broken pl. of ṣāḥib, gen.) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your companions'
تَمَّمَ: tammama — to complete, perfect (verb II, perf. 3ms, here optative); 'may he complete'
سُرُورَكَ: سُرُور + كَ — surūr, gladness, delight (m. verbal noun, acc. as object) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your gladness'
وَلَابُدَّلِي: وَ + لَا بُدَّ + لِ + ي — wa-, and + lā budda, there is no escape (idiom: 'it is unavoidable') + li-, for (prep., dative of the person concerned: 'for me') + -ī, me (1s); 'and I must' (printed as one word)
أَحْضُرَ: aḥḍura — ḥaḍara, to attend, be present (verb I, impf. 1s subj., after an); 'that I attend'
أَرَدْتُ: aradtu — arāda, to want, desire (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'I wanted'
تَمْضِيَ: tamḍiya — maḍā, to go, go on (verb I defective, impf. 2ms subj., after an); 'that you go'
أَصْدِقَائِي: أَصْدِقَاء + ـي — aṣdiqāʾ, friends (m., broken pl. of ṣadīq, gen. after ilā) + -ī, my (1s); 'my friends'
أَمْضِيَ: amḍiya — maḍā, to go, go off (verb I defective, impf. 1s subj. after daʿnī); 'that I go'
بِمَاتَفَضَّلْتَ: بِـ + مَا + تَفَضَّلْتَ — bi-, with (prep.; amḍī bi-, 'go off with') + mā, what (rel.) + tafaḍḍalta, to bestow graciously (verb V, perf. 2ms; tafaḍḍala bi-, 'bestow'); 'with what you have graciously bestowed' (printed as one word)
بُدَّلَكَ: بُدَّ + لَكَ — budda, escape, alternative (m., acc.; in lā budda, 'no escape') + li-, for (prep., 'for you') + -ka, you (2ms); 'escape for you' (lā budda laka, 'you must')
الرَّوَاحُ: الـ + رَوَاح — rawāḥ, going out, setting out towards evening (m. verbal noun of rāḥa, nom., subject of lā budda); 'the going forth'
أَصْدِقَائِكَ: أَصْدِقَاء + كَ — aṣdiqāʾ, friends (m., broken pl., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your friends'
أَكْرَمْتَنِي: أَكْرَمْتَ + نِي — akrama, to honour, treat generously (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'you honoured me'
وَأَدَعُهُ: وَ + أَدَعُ + هُ — wa-, and + wadaʿa/daʿa, to leave (verb I, impf. 1s) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'and I leave it'
عِنْدَأَ: عِنْدَ + أَ(صْحَابٍ) — ʿinda, with, at (prep., acc.) + the first letter of aṣḥābin, printed apart because of a misplaced word-break; 'with'
صْحَابٍ: (أَ)صْحَاب — aṣḥāb, companions, friends (m., broken pl. of ṣāḥib, gen. with tanwīn after ʿinda; the initial a- is at the end of the previous word); 'companions'
يَأْكُلُونَ: yaʾkulūna — akala, to eat (verb I, impf. 3mp, indicative; relative/descriptive clause); 'who eat'
وَيَشْرَبُونَ: وَ + يَشْرَبُونَ — wa-, and + shariba, to drink (verb I, impf. 3mp); 'and drink'
يَنْتَظِرُونِي: يَنْتَظِرُونَ + ـنِي — intaẓara, to wait for (verb VIII, impf. 3mp, indicative with lā) + -nī, me (1s obj.; the nūn of the verb and the nūn al-wiqāya run together); 'they wait for me'
وَأَمْضِي: وَ + أَمْضِي — wa-, and + maḍā, to go (verb I defective, impf. 1s); 'and go'
أَصْدِقَايَ: أَصْدِقَاء + ـيَ — aṣdiqāʾ, friends (m., broken pl., gen. after bayna) + -ya, my (1s), here printed aṣdiqāy without the hamza-seat; 'my friends'
حِشْمَةٌ: ḥishma — reserve, formality, constraint (f., nom. with tanwīn; subject of laysa, the predicate being the preceding bayna phrase); 'any reserve'
تَمْنَعُنِي: تَمْنَعُ + نِي — manaʿa, to prevent, hinder (verb I, impf. 3fs, indicative; agrees with ḥishma) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'that prevents me'
تَرْكِهِمْ: تَرْك + هِمْ — tark, leaving, abandoning (m. verbal noun of taraka, gen. after ʿan) + -him, them (3mp obj.); 'leaving them'
تَوَجَّهْتَ: tawajjahta — tawajjaha, to head toward, turn to (verb V, perf. 2ms); 'you head'
وَدَعْنِي: وَ + دَعْ + نِي — wa-, and + daʿ, leave, let (imperative 2ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'and let me'
وَأَكُونَ: وَ + أَكُونَ — wa-, and + kāna, to be (verb I hollow, impf. 1s subj.); 'and be'
أَدَعُكَ: أَدَعُ + كَ — daʿa/wadaʿa, to leave, let (verb I, impf. 1s) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'I let you'
أَنَالَيْهِ: أَنَا + (إِ)لَيْهِ — anā, I (1s pronoun) + ilayhi, to him/it (ilā + -hi, with the initial alif dropped in print); 'I to it'
أَحَدٌأَنْ: أَحَدٌ + أَنْ — aḥad, anyone, any one (m., nom. with tanwīn after a negative) + an, that (conj.), printed together; 'anyone … that'
غَيْرِى: غَيْر + ـي — ghayr, other than, except (m., nom., an exception after lā yaqdiru) + -ī, me (1s), printed with dotless yā'; 'other than me'
أَظُنُّكَ: أَظُنُّ + كَ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I, impf. 1s) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'I suppose you'
مِيعَادِ: mīʿād — appointment, rendezvous (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'an appointment of'
تَأْخُذُنِي: تَأْخُذُ + نِي — akhadha, to take (verb I, impf. 2ms, indicative) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'you would take me'
أَحَقُّ: aḥaqq — more right, more deserving (elative of ḥaqq, m., nom. as predicate); 'more deserving'
وَأُسَاعِلُكَ: وَ + أُسَاعِلُ + كَ — wa-, and + usāʿilu, apparently for usāʿidu, to help (verb III, impf. 1s; ل for د, see note) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'and I help you'
أَخَافُ: akhāfu — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, impf. 1s); 'I fear'
اِمْرَأَةٍ: imraʾa — woman (f., gen. with tanwīn after ʿalā; the alif is a connecting alif); 'a woman'
أَجْنَبِيَّةٍ: ajnabiyya — foreign, unrelated (f. adj., gen. with tanwīn, agreeing with imraʾa); 'a strange, unrelated'
فَتَرُوحَ: فَـ + تَرُوحَ — fa-, and so (consequence; takes the subjunctive) + rāḥa, to go away, depart (verb I hollow, impf. 3fs subj.); 'and so goes off'
شَيْأً: shayʾan — thing, anything (m., acc. with tanwīn, object of yaʿmalu); printed shayan with the tanwīn on the alif; 'anything'
الْأَ: الـ + أَ(شْيَاءِ) — the article and the first alif of ashyāʾ, printed apart from the rest of the word; 'the'
شْيَاءِ: (أَ)شْيَاء — shayʾ, thing (m., irregular pl. ashyāʾ, gen. after min hādhihi; the initial a- is at the end of the previous word); 'things'
وَالِي: wālī — governor (m., agent noun of walā, nom. in the iḍāfa; the yā' final is written but pronounced); 'the governor of'
صَارِمٌ: ṣārim — sharp, stern, severe (m. adj., nom. with tanwīn, predicate), 'stern'; used as a noun, a sharp sword, keen blade ('a keen blade')
يَاشَيْخَ: يَا + شَيْخَ — yā, O (vocative) + shaykh, old man, elder (m., acc. as first term of a vocative iḍāfa); 'O old man' (printed as one word)
السُّوءِ: الـ + سُوء — sūʾ, evil, badness (m., gen. as second term); 'the evil' (shaykh al-sūʾ, 'wretched old man')
اِنْقَلِعْ: inqaliʿ — inqalaʿa, to be uprooted, go away (verb VII, imperative 2ms); 'be off' (vowels as printed)
لَايْشِ: لِـ + أَيّ + شَيْء — li-, for, because of (prep.) + ayy, which + shayʾ, thing, colloquially contracted lāysh; 'why, for what'
بَارِدُ: bārid — cold, insipid, dull (m. adj., nom.; vocative with yā); 'dull fellow'
أَسْتَحْيِي: astaḥyī — istaḥyā, to be ashamed (verb X, impf. 1s, as printed; possibly for istaḥyayta, 'have you shame'); 'I am ashamed'
وَتُخْفِي: وَ + تُخْفِي — wa-, and + akhfā, to hide, conceal (verb IV, impf. 2ms); 'and you hide'
وَتَحَقَّقْتُهُ: وَ + تَحَقَّقْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + taḥaqqaqa, to verify, ascertain (verb V, perf. 1s) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'and ascertained it'
وَإِنَّمَا: وَ + إِنَّمَا — wa-, and + innamā, only, merely (restrictive particle); 'and only'
تَسْمَعَ: tasmaʿa — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, impf. 3fs subj., after an; agrees with the plural ahlī wa-jīrānī); 'that they hear'
بِمَقَالَةِ: بِـ + مَقَالَة — bi-, of, about (prep.; samiʿa bi-, 'hear of') + maqāla, utterance, speech (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the speech of'
سُكُوتًا: sukūtan — silence (m. verbal noun of sakata, acc. with tanwīn, cognate object); 'a silence'
وَأَدْرَكَنَا: وَ + أَدْرَكَ + نَا — wa-, and + adraka, to overtake, reach (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us (1p obj.); 'and it overtook us'
الْخُطْبَةِ: الـ + خُطْبَة — khuṭba, sermon (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the sermon'
حَلْقُ: ḥalq — shaving (m. verbal noun of ḥalaqa, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the shaving of'
امْضِ: imḍi — maḍā, to go (verb I defective, imperative 2ms; connecting alif); 'go!'
أَنْتَظِرُكَ: أَنْتَظِرُ + كَ — intaẓara, to wait for (verb VIII, impf. 1s) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'I wait for you'
وَتَمْضِيَ: وَ + تَمْضِيَ — wa-, and + maḍā, to go (verb I defective, impf. 2ms subj.); 'and go'
أُدَاهِنُهُ: أُدَاهِنُ + هُ — dāhana, to flatter, coax (verb III, impf. 1s) + -hu, him (3ms obj.); 'I coaxed him'
وَأَخْدَعُهُ: وَ + أَخْدَعُ + هُ — wa-, and + khadaʿa, to deceive (verb I, impf. 1s) + -hu, him (3ms obj.); 'and deceived him'
يَمْضِيَ: yamḍiya — maḍā, to go (verb I defective, impf. 3ms subj.); 'goes away'
تُخَادِعُنِي: تُخَادِعُ + نِي — khādaʿa, to beguile, deceive (verb III, impf. 2ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'you are beguiling me'
وَتَرْمِي: وَ + تَرْمِي — wa-, and + ramā, to throw (verb I defective, impf. 2ms); 'and you throw'
مُصِيبَةٍ: muṣība — calamity, disaster (f., gen. with tanwīn after fī); 'a calamity'
لَاخَلَاصَ: لَا + خَلَاص — lā, no (absolute negation) + khalāṣ, escape (m., acc. without tanwīn); 'no escape' (printed as one word)
فَاللَّهَ: فَـ + اللَّهَ — fa-, so + Allāh, God (acc. in an exhortation, 'mind God'); 'by God'
لَاتَرُحْ: لَا + تَرُحْ — lā, do not (prohibitive, with the jussive) + rāḥa, to go away (verb I hollow, jussive 2ms); 'do not go off' (printed as one word)
أَعُودَ: aʿūda — ʿāda, to return (verb I hollow, impf. 1s subj., after ḥattā); 'I return'
وَأَمْضِيَ: وَ + أَمْضِيَ — wa-, and + maḍā, to go (verb I defective, impf. 1s subj.); 'and go'
أَعْلَمَ: aʿlama — ʿalima, to know (verb I, impf. 1s subj., after ḥattā); 'I know, I see'
أَمْرِكَ: أَمْر + كَ — amr, matter, affair (m., gen. after min) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your affair'
تُبْطِى: tubṭī — abṭaʾa, to be slow, delay (verb IV, jussive 2ms after lā; final -ī printed with dotless yā', the hamza lost); 'do not delay'
أَعْطَيْتُهُ: أَعْطَيْتُ + هُ — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 1s) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'I gave him' (the object -hu is the thing, the following lahu the recipient)
وَسَلَّمَهُ: وَ + سَلَّمَ + هُ — wa-, and + sallama, to hand over, deliver (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'and handed it over'; here 'and handed him over' (Qamar al-Zamān, to the eunuch)
حَمَّالٍ: ḥammāl — porter (m., gen. with tanwīn after ilā); 'a porter'
وَدَّاهُ: وَدَّى + هُ — waddā, to convey, take (verb II defective, perf. 3ms, colloquial) + -hu, it (3ms obj.); 'who conveyed it' (shadda as printed)
وَأَخْفَى: وَ + أَخْفَى — wa-, and + akhfā, to hide, conceal (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms); 'and hid'
الْأَزِقَّاتِ: الـ + أَزِقَّات — zuqāq, lane, alley (m., double pl. azziqāt, gen.); 'the lanes'
فَلَبِسْتُ: فَـ + لَبِسْتُ — fa-, and so, then (sequencing conj.) + labisa, to put on, wear (v. I, perf. 1 sg.); 'so I put on'
وَوَقَفْتُ: وَ + وَقَفْتُ — wa-, and + waqafa, to stand, stop (v. I, perf. 1 sg.); 'and I stood'
وَاقِفَةً: wāqif, standing (act. part. of waqafa; f. sg., acc., circumstantial); 'standing'
تَنْتَظِرُنِي: تَنْتَظِرُ + نِي — intaẓara (VIII), to wait for, await (imperf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'waiting for me' (circumstantial)
الطَّبَقَةِ: الـ + طَبَقَة — ṭabaqa, storey, floor, layer (f., gen.); 'the storey'
دَخَلْتُهَا: دَخَلْتُ + هَا — dakhala, to enter (v. I, perf. 1 sg.) + -hā, it (direct object); 'I entered it'
وَأَغْلَقَ: وَ + أَغْلَقَ — wa-, and + aghlaqa (IV), to shut, bolt (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he bolted'
فَأَشْرَفْتُ: فَـ + أَشْرَفْتُ — fa-, so + ashrafa (IV), to look out or down from a height (perf. 1 sg.); 'so I looked out'
الطَّاقِ: الـ + طَاق — ṭāq, arch, arched window or niche (m., gen.); 'the arch'
الْمُزَيِّنَ: الـ + مُزَيِّن — muzayyin, barber (act. part. of zayyana II, to adorn, to groom; m., acc.); 'the barber'
لَعْنَةُ: laʿna, curse (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the curse of'
لِأَمْرٍ: لِـ + أَمْر — li-, for, on account of (prep., giving the ground or purpose here) + amr, matter, affair (m., gen., indef.); 'for a matter'
هَتْكِ: hatk, tearing open, rending, exposing (vn. of hataka; m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the exposing of'
سِتْرِي: سِتْر + ـي — sitr, veil, covering, privacy (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my veil'
جَارِيَةَ: jāriya, girl, slave-girl (f., acc., subject of anna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the slave-girl of' Also acc. as a vocative in construct: yā jāriyata al-khayri, 'O good girl'.
نَبَتْ: nabat — from nabā, to recoil, prove unsuitable, fall short (v. I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she recoiled, displeased' (see note)
عَبْدُهُ: عَبْد + هُ — ʿabd, slave, servant (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his slave'
لِيُخَلِّصَهَا: لِـ + يُخَلِّصَ + هَا — li-, in order to (+ subjunctive; purpose) + khallaṣa (II), to free, rescue (subj. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'to free her'
فَاعْتَقَلَ: فَـ + اعْتَقَلَ — fa-, so + iʿtaqala (VIII), to seize, hold fast (perf. 3 m. sg.); as printed, probably for iʿtaqada, 'to hold (an opinion), come to believe' (see note); 'so he took it into his head'
وَخَرَقَ: وَ + خَرَقَ — wa-, and + kharaqa, to tear, rend (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he tore'
وَحَثَا: وَ + حَثَا — wa-, and + ḥathā, to throw, scatter in handfuls (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he threw'
رَأسِهِ: رَأْس + هِ — raʾs, head (m., gen.; printed with precomposed hamza) + -hi, his; 'his head'
يَصْرُخُ: ṣarakha, to shout, scream (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'he screams'
وَيَسْتَغِيثُ: وَ + يَسْتَغِيثُ — wa-, and + istaghātha (X), to call for help (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and calls for help'
سَيِّدِى: سَيِّد + ـي — sayyid, master, lord (m., vocative; the suffix is printed with final ى) + -ī, my; 'O my master'
دَرَيْتُ: darā, to know, be aware (v. I, perf. 1 sg.); 'I knew'
مُخَرِّقِينَ: mukharriq, tearing to shreds (act. part. of kharraqa II; m. pl., acc., circumstantial); 'tearing'
الثِّيَابَ: الـ + ثِيَاب — thawb, garment, pl. thiyāb (m. pl., acc.); 'the clothes'
وَحَالِّينَ: وَ + حَالِّين — wa-, and + ḥāll, loosing, undoing (act. part. of ḥalla; m. pl., acc., circumstantial); 'and loosing'
شُعُورَهُمْ: شُعُور + هُمْ — shaʿr, hair, pl. shuʿūr (m. pl., acc., object of ḥāllīna) + -hum, their; 'their hair'
يَصِيحُونَ: ṣāḥa, to cry out (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'they cry out'
وَاسَيِّدَاهْ: وَا + سَيِّد + اهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament, nudba) + sayyid, master + -āh, lament ending; 'O my master!, alas for our master!'
أَمَّهُمْ: أَمَّ + هُمْ — amma, to lead, go in front of (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'he had led them'
مُخَرِّقَ: mukharriq, tearing to shreds (act. part. of kharraqa II; m. sg., acc., circumstantial; first term of an iḍāfa); 'tearing (the) …'
أَهْلِى: أَهْل + ـي — ahl, people, family (m., nom.; the suffix is printed with final ى) + -ī, my; 'my people, my household'
يَصْرُخُونَ: ṣarakha, to shout, scream (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'they scream'
أَوَائِلِهِمْ: أَوَائِل + هِمْ — awāʾil, firsts, foremost ones (pl. of awwal; gen.) + -him, their; 'in their forefront'
وَاقَتِيلَاهْ: وَا + قَتِيل + اهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament, nudba) + qatīl, slain one, victim (m.) + -āh, lament ending; 'O the slain one!'
وَهَمُّوا: وَ + هَمُّوا — wa-, and + hamma, to set about, make for (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they set out'
الضَّجَّةَ: الـ + ضَجَّة — ḍajja, uproar, clamour (f., acc.); 'the uproar'
بَابِهِ: بَاب + هِ — bāb, door (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his door'
سَيِّدِهِ: سَيِّد + هِ — sayyid, master, lord (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his master'
أَزْيَدُ: azyad, more (elative of zāda, to increase; m., nom.); 'more than'
نَفْسٍ: nafs, soul, person (f., gen., indef.); 'persons, souls'
وَامْرَأَةُ: وَ + امْرَأَة — wa-, and + imraʾa, woman (f.; printed with a damma, so nom., where a genitive would be expected); 'and a woman'
وَيُشِيرُونَ: وَ + يُشِيرُونَ — wa-, and + ashāra (IV), to point, gesture (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they point'
دَارِنَا: دَار + نَا — dār, house (f., gen.) + -nā, our; 'our house'
عَظُمَ: ʿaẓuma, to be great, grow heavy (v. I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'it grew great'
جَمْعًا: jamʿ, gathering, crowd (m., acc., indef.); 'a crowd'
قَتَلْتَ: qatala, to kill (v. I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you killed, you have killed'
سَيِّدُكُمْ: سَيِّد + كُمْ — sayyid, master (m., nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your master'
يَأكُلُونَهُ: يَأْكُلُونَ + هُ — yaʾkulūna, to eat (akala, verb I, impf. 3mp, indic.) + -hu, it (obj.); 'they eat it' (the edition prints the hamza)
مَدْحِ: مَدْح — madḥ, praise (m., verbal noun of madaḥa, gen. after fī); first half of the word the edition breaks with a filler dash (see next)
هِ: ـهِ — -hi, his (3ms suffix, gen.); second half of مَدْحِ—هِ, 'in praise of him', the edition's line-end filler dash splitting the word
وَالثَّلٰثُونَ: وَ + الـ + ثَلٰثُون — wa-, and (joins the unit to the tens); thalāthūn, thirty (sound m. pl. form, nom.; printed without the alif of ثلاثون, hence the dagger alif); 'and the thirtieth'
بَلَغَنِى: بَلَغَ + نِى — balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.; printed with ى); 'it reached me'
لِلْغِلْمَانِ: لِـ + الـ + غِلْمَان — li-, to (prep., marks the persons spoken to); ghilmān, lads, young servants (m. pl. of ghulām, gen.); 'to the lads' (the article's alif elides after li-)
أَيْدِيكُمْ: أَيْدِي + كُمْ — aydī, hands (broken pl. of yad, f., gen. after bayna) + -kum, your (2mp poss.); 'your hands'; بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ = 'before you'
عِيَاطَهُ: عِيَاط + هُ — ʿiyāṭ, shouting, outcry (m., acc. as object; a word of the spoken language) + -hu, his; 'his shouting'
أَدْخَلَهُ: أَدْخَلَ + هُ — adkhala, to bring in, let enter (verb IV, perf. 3ms, causative of dakhala) + -hu, him; 'he made him enter'
لَاتَكُنْ: لَا + تَكُنْ — lā, not (prohibitive, takes the jussive); takun, kāna, to be (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive, hollow, shortened); printed as one word; 'do not be'
بِنْتُكَ: بِنْت + كَ — bint, daughter, girl (f., nom. as subject) + -ka, your (2ms poss.); 'your daughter'
تَعْشَقُهُ: تَعْشَقُ + هُ — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'she loves him'
يَعْشَقُهَا: يَعْشَقُ + هَا — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (imperf. 3ms) + -hā, her (3fs obj.); 'he loves her'
دَارَكَ: دَار + كَ — dār, house (f., acc. as object of dakhala) + -ka, your (2ms poss.); 'your house'
غِلْمَانَكَ: غِلْمَان + كَ — ghilmān, lads, servants (m. pl., acc. as object) + -ka, your; 'your lads'
فَضَرَبُوهُ: فَـ + ضَرَبُوا + هُ — fa-, and so, and then (narrative connective); ḍaraba, to strike, beat (perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they beat him'
تُخْرِجَ: akhraja — to bring out, take out (verb IV, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after aw 'unless'); 'you bring out'
أَهْلُهُ: أَهْل + هُ — ahl, family, kin (m., nom. as subject) + -hu, his; 'his family'
قَبْلِ: qabl — before (m., gen. after min; first term of a construct); مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ = 'before'
وَأُخْرِجَهُ: وَ + أُخْرِجَ + هُ — wa-, and; akhraja, to bring out (verb IV, imperf. 1s subjunctive, continuing an) + -hu, him; 'and I bring him out'
وَتَخْجَلَ: وَ + تَخْجَلَ — wa-, and; khajila, to be ashamed (verb I, imperf. 2ms subjunctive, continuing an); 'and you are put to shame'
الْتَجَمَ: iltajama — to be bridled, reined in (verb VIII of lajama, perf. 3ms, passive in sense); 'he was bridled'
وَتَغْتَمُّ: وَ + تَغْتَمُّ — wa-, and; ightamma, to be grieved, distressed (verb VIII, imperf. with prefix ت as printed, perhaps a misprint for وَاغْتَمَّ); 'and (he was) distressed'
بِالْحَيَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + حَيَاء — bi-, with, from (prep. of cause); ḥayāʾ, shame, modesty (m., gen.); 'with shame'
صَادِقًا: ṣādiq — truthful (act. part. of ṣadaqa, 'to speak the truth'; m., acc. indef. as predicate of kāna); 'truthful'
وَأَخْرِجْهُ: وَ + أَخْرِجْ + هُ — wa-, and; akhrij, imperative of akhraja (verb IV, 'bring out') + -hu, him; 'and bring him out'
فَهَمَزَ: فَـ + هَمَزَ — fa-, and then (narrative connective); hamaza, to prod, goad, spur (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he bounded forward'
لِلْخُرُوجِ: لِـ + الـ + خُرُوج — li-, for (prep. of purpose); khurūj, going out, exit (verbal noun of kharaja, m., gen.); 'for going out'
وَالْهُرُوبِ: وَ + الـ + هُرُوب — wa-, and; hurūb, fleeing, escape (verbal noun of haraba, m., gen.); 'and fleeing'
أَجِدْدُونَ: أَجِدْ + دُونَ — wajada, to find (verb I, imperf. 1s jussive after lam) + dūna, short of, other than (prep./adv., acc.); two words run together in the print; 'I did not find … short of'
الْغِطَاءَ: الـ + غِطَاء — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (m., acc. as object); 'the lid'
نَفَسِي: نَفَس + ي — nafas, breath (m., acc. as object) + -ī, my (1s poss.); قَطَعْتُ نَفَسِي = 'I held my breath'
يَدْ: يَدْ — first half of يَدْخُلْهَا (yadkhulhā) split by a stray space in the print; not the noun yad, 'hand'; 'he enters' (3ms jussive after lam, with خُلْهَا)
خُلْهَا: خُلْ + هَا — second half of يَدْخُلْهَا: (-dkhul), from dakhala, to enter, jussive after lam + -hā, it (3fs, the hall); فَلَمْ يَدْ خُلْهَا = 'he had not entered it'
وَاطَّلَعَ: وَ + اطَّلَعَ — wa-, and; iṭṭalaʿa, to look out over, survey (verb VIII, perf. 3ms; takes ʿalā); 'and he surveyed'
فِيــهِ: فِي + هِ — fī, in (prep.) + -hi, it (3ms); the print draws the word out with a tatweel; 'in it'
لِلصُّنْدُوقِ: لِـ + الـ + صُنْدُوق — li-, to, toward (prep., the goal of taqaddama); ṣundūq, chest (m., gen.); 'toward the chest'
رُشْدِي: رُشْد + ي — rushd, right mind, good sense (m., nom. as subject) + -ī, my (1s poss.); 'my wits'
يَتْرُكُنِي: يَتْرُكُ + نِي — taraka, to leave, let go (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.); with mā 'he is not leaving me'
جَذَبْتُ: جَذَبَ + تُ — jadhaba, to pull, drag (verb I, perf.) + -tu, I; 'I pulled'
أَرْضٍ: arḍ — earth, ground (f., gen. indef. after ilā); 'the ground'
فَانْكَسَرَتْ: فَـ + انْكَسَرَتْ — fa-, and so; inkasara, to break (verb VII, perf. 3fs, intransitive); 'and (it) broke'
فَشَاهَدْتُ: فَـ + شَاهَدَ + تُ — fa-, and then; shāhada, to see, behold (verb III, perf.) + -tu, I; 'and I saw'
خَلْقًا: khalq — creation, creatures, people (m. collective, acc. indef. as object); 'a crowd'
كُمِّي: كُمّ + ي — kumm, sleeve (m., gen. after fī) + -ī, my (1s poss.); 'my sleeve'
أَعْدَدْتُهُ: أَعَدَّ + تُ + هُ — aʿadda, to prepare, set aside (verb IV, perf., doubled; stem aʿdad-) + -tu, I + -hu, it; 'I had prepared it'
لِمِثْلِ: لِـ + مِثْل — li-, for (prep. of purpose); mithl, the like of, such as (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'for the like of'
وَمِثْلِ: وَ + مِثْل — wa-, and; mithl, the like of (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'and the like of'
فَجَعَلْتُ: فَـ + جَعَلَ + تُ — fa-, and so; jaʿala, to begin, set about (verb I, perf.; before an imperfect 'I began to…') + -tu, I; 'and I began'
أَنْثُرُ: nathara — to scatter (verb I, imperf. 1s, indic.); 'I scatter'
لِيَشْتَغِلُوا: لِـ + يَشْتَغِلُوا — li-, so that, in order that (purpose; takes the subjunctive); ishtaghala, to be busy, occupied (verb VIII, imperf. 3mp subjunctive); 'so that they be busy'
فَأَخَذُوهُ: فَـ + أَخَذُوا + هُ — fa-, and so; akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, it; 'and they took it'
وَاشْتَغَلُوا: وَ + اشْتَغَلُوا — wa-, and; ishtaghala, to be busy (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and they were busy'
أَجْرِي: jarā — to run (verb I, imperf. 1s, final-weak); 'I run'
وَأَيُّ: وَ + أَيّ — wa-, and; ayy, which, whichever (nom., first term of a construct, the subject); 'and whichever'
خَلْفِى: خَلْف + ى — khalf, behind (adv./prep., acc.) + -ī, me (1s; printed with ى); 'behind me'
يُفَجِّعُونِي: يُفَجِّعُونَ + نِي — fajjaʿa, to afflict with loss, bereave (verb II, imperf. 3mp) + -nī, me (1s obj.; the plural nūn drops before the pronoun); 'they bereave me'
نَصَرَنِي: نَصَرَ + نِي — naṣara, to help, give victory to (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'he gave me victory'
يَسُؤُنِي: يَسُؤُ + نِي — sāʾa, to grieve, displease (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.; the print has no hamza sign) + -nī, me (1s obj.); 'it grieves me'
تَدْبِيرُكَ: تَدْبِير + كَ — tadbīr, planning, management, scheming (m., verbal noun of dabbara II; nom. as subject) + -ka, your (2ms poss.); 'your scheming'
فَلَوْلَا: فَـ + لَوْلَا — fa-, and so; lawlā, if not for, had it not been for (particle; followed by a nominative noun); 'and had it not been for'
مَنُّ: mann — favour, kindness (m., nom. after lawlā; noun of manna ʿalā, 'to show favour to'; the print gives the nūn a shadda); 'the favour of'
خَلَصْتَ: خَلَصَ + تَ — khalaṣa, to escape, be delivered (verb I, perf.) + -ta, you; مَا كُنْتَ خَلَصْتَ = 'you would not have escaped'
الْمُصِيبَةِ: الـ + مُصِيبَة — muṣība, calamity, misfortune (f., gen.); 'the calamity'
يَرْمُونَكَ: يَرْمُونَ + كَ — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I, imperf. 3mp) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'they cast you'
تَخْلُصُ: khalaṣa — to escape, be delivered (verb I, imperf. 2ms, indic.); 'you escape'
ؤَكَمْ: ؤ + كَمْ — ؤ is the print's misprint for وَـ, wa-, and; kam, how much, how many, how long (interrog.); 'and how long'
أُخَلِّصَكَ: أُخَلِّصَ + كَ — khallaṣa, to rescue, deliver (verb II, imperf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'I rescue you'
بِسُوءِ: بِـ + سُوء — bi-, by means of, through (prep.); sūʾ, badness, evil (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'through the badness of'
تَدْبِيرِكَ: تَدْبِير + كَ — tadbīr, planning, scheming (m., gen., second term of the construct) + -ka, your (2ms poss.); 'your scheming'
وَكُنْتَ: وَ + كَانَ + تَ — wa-, and; kāna, to be (verb I, perf., hollow; stem kun-) + -ta, you (2ms); 'and you were'
نُوأَخِذُكَ: نُوأَخِذُ + كَ — muʾākhadha (verb III), to hold to account, take to task (imperf. 1p; the print's نوأخذ stands for نُؤَاخِذُ) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'we hold you to account'
جَهْلِكَ: جَهْل + كَ — jahl, ignorance, folly (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your (2ms poss.); 'your folly'
عَجُولٌ: ʿajūl — hasty, rash (intensive adj. of ʿajila, 'to hurry'; m., nom. indef.); 'hasty'
تَجْرِيَ: jarā — to run (verb I, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after ḥattā, final-weak); 'you run'
وَرَآيَ: وَ + رَآ + يَ — the print's spelling of وَرَائِي: wa-, and (part of the word here: warāʾ, behind, adv./prep., acc.) + -ī, me (1s); 'behind me' (read warāya)
وَتَتَكَلَّمَ: وَ + تَتَكَلَّمَ — wa-, and (continues the clause after ḥattā); takallama, to speak (verb V, imperf. 2ms subjunctive); 'and you speak'
وَكَادَتْ: وَ + كَادَتْ — wa-, and; kāda, to be on the point of, nearly (verb I, hollow, perf. 3fs; with an imperfect 'nearly did'); 'and … nearly'
تَذْهَقُ: dhahaqa — to pass away, depart (of the soul) (verb I, imperf. 3fs; the usual verb is zahaqa); 'departs'
غَيْظِي: غَيْظ + ي — ghayẓ, rage, anger (m., gen., second term of the construct) + -ī, my (1s poss.); 'my rage'
دُكَّانًا: دُكَّان — dukkān, shop, stall (m., acc. tanwīn, object of the verb); 'a shop'
السُّوقِ: الـ + سُوق — sūq, market (m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the market'
وَاسْتَجَرْتُ: وَ + اِسْتَجَارَ + تُ — istajāra (form X of jāra), to seek protection (perf. 1cs); wa-, and, joins the next act; 'and I sought protection'
بِالْحَائِكِ: بِـ + الـ + حَائِك — ḥāʾik, weaver (m.); bi- is required by istajāra, 'seek the protection of': 'with the weaver'
فَمَنَعَهُ: فَـ + مَنَعَ + هُ — manaʿa, to prevent, keep off (perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (object); fa-, and so, with the result that; 'and he kept him off'
مَخْزَنٍ: مَخْزَن — makhzan, storeroom, warehouse (m., gen. tanwīn after fī); 'a storeroom'
عُلْتُ: عُلْتُ — ʿultu, as printed (perf. 1cs of ʿāla, to be burdensome, to support); the print's ل is surely a misprint for د: مَا عُدْتُ 'I no longer (can)'; here pointed as the letters stand
أَفْتَرِقُ: أَفْتَرِقُ — iftaraqa (form VIII of faraqa), to part, separate (imperf. 1cs, indicative, again with no أَنْ); 'I part (from)'
الْمُزَيِّنِ: الـ + مُزَيِّن — muzayyin, barber (m., gen. after min; the one who 'beautifies', from zayyana); 'the barber'
فِّي: فِّي — printed with the shadda on the fāʾ, a slip for فِيَّ, fiyya = fī, in (prep.) + -ya, me (the shadda belongs to the yā'); 'in me'
رَمَقٌ: رَمَق — ramaq, last breath, remaining strength (m., nom. tanwīn, subject of baqiya); 'a breath of life'
خَلْقَتِهِ: خَلْقَة + هِ — khalqa, make, build, appearance (f., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his appearance'
فَأَرْسَلْتُ: فَـ + أَرْسَلَ + تُ — arsala (form IV of rasala), to send (perf. 1cs); fa-, and so; 'and I sent'
الشُّهُودَ: الـ + شُهُود — shuhūd, witnesses (pl. of shāhid; m., acc., object); 'the witnesses'
وَصِيَّةً: وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, testament, will (f., acc. tanwīn, object); 'a will'
لِأَهْلِي: لِـ + أَهْل + ـِي — li-, for, on behalf of (prep., marks the beneficiary) + ahl, family, people (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my family'
وَفَرَّقْتُ: وَ + فَرَّقَ + تُ — farraqa (form II of faraqa), to distribute, divide up (perf. 1cs; the doubled middle radical makes it intensive: 'divide among many'); wa-, and; 'and I distributed'
نَاظِرًا: نَاظِر — nāẓir, overseer, steward, trustee (act. part. of naẓara; m., acc. tanwīn, the thing made: ʿamiltu ʿalayhim nāẓiran); 'an overseer'
وَأَمَرْتُهُ: وَ + أَمَرَ + تُ + هُ — amara, to command (perf. 1cs) + -hu, him (object); wa-, and; 'and I commanded him'
يَبِيعَ: يَبِيعَ — bāʿa, to sell (imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'he sell'
الدَّارَ: الـ + دَار — dār, house, dwelling (f., acc., object); 'the house'
وَالْعَقَارَاتِ: وَ + الـ + عَقَارَات — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿaqārāt, landed properties, real estate (f. sound pl. of ʿaqār; acc.); 'and the estates'
وَوَصَّيْتُهُ: وَ + وَصَّى + تُ + هُ — waṣṣā (form II of waṣā), to charge, commend (perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; wa-, and; takes بِـ for the thing entrusted; 'and I charged him'
بِالْكِبَارِ: بِـ + الـ + كِبَار — bi-, with, in respect of (waṣṣā takes bi- for what is entrusted) + kibār, big ones, elders (pl. of kabīr; m., gen.); 'with the big ones'
وَالصِّغَارِ: وَ + الـ + صِغَار — wa-, and + ṣighār, small ones, little children (pl. of ṣaghīr; gen., after bi-); 'and the small ones'
أَتَخَلَّصَ: أَتَخَلَّصَ — takhallaṣa (form V of khalaṣa), to be delivered, get free (imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'I be rid of'
الْقَوَّادِ: الـ + قَوَّاد — qawwād, pimp, procurer (m., gen. in apposition to hādhā; intensive form of qāda, to lead); 'the pimp'
سَكَنْتُ: سَكَنَ + تُ — sakana, to dwell, live (perf. 1cs), set beside جِئْتُ with no conjunction; 'I settled'
مُدَّةٌ: مُدَّة — mudda, a span of time, a while (f., nom. tanwīn, the thing possessed: lī fīhā muddatun); 'a while'
عَزَمْتُمْ: عَزَمَ + تُمْ — ʿazama, to resolve; with عَلَى, 'press someone (to come)' (perf. 2mp); 'you pressed'
الْقَوَّادَ: الـ + قَوَّاد — qawwād, pimp, procurer (m., acc., in apposition to the object); 'the pimp'
وَمَقَامِي: وَ + مَقَام + ـِي — wa-, and (joins a second subject) + maqām, staying, abode (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my staying'
وَانْكَسَرَتْ: وَ + اِنْكَسَرَ + تْ — inkasara (form VII of kasara), to be broken (perf. 3fs, agreeing with rijl); wa-, and; 'and was broken'
بِسَبَبِهِ: بِـ + سَبَب + هِ — bi-, by, through (prep., instrument or cause) + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'because of him'
الشَّابَّ: الـ + شَابّ — shābb, young man (m., acc., subject after inna); 'the young man'
امْتَنَعَ: اِمْتَنَعَ — imtanaʿa (form VIII of manaʿa), to refuse, hold back (perf. 3ms); 'refused'
لِلْمُزَيِّنِ: لِـ + الـ + مُزَيِّن — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed after qāla; the alif of al- drops in writing) + al-, the + muzayyin, barber (m., gen.); 'to the barber'
أَحَقٌّ: أَ + حَقّ — a-, interrogative particle, 'is it?' + ḥaqq, truth, true (m., nom. tanwīn, predicate placed first); 'is it true?'
بِمَعْرِفَتِي: بِـ + مَعْرِفَة + ـِي — bi-, by, by means of (prep., instrument or reason) + maʿrifa, knowledge, discernment (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'by my knowledge'
وَعَقْلِي: وَ + عَقْل + ـِي — wa-, and + ʿaql, mind, intellect, good sense (m., gen., joined to the previous noun) + -ī, my; 'and my mind'
وَمُرُوَّتِي: وَ + مُرُوَّة + ـِي — wa-, and + muruwwa, manliness, chivalry, sense of honour (f., gen.; the print is مروة without the second wāw sound shown) + -ī, my; 'and my honour'
لَهَلَكَ: لَ + هَلَكَ — la-, the particle that begins the answer to law-lā ('then, indeed') + halaka, to perish (perf. 3ms); 'he would have perished'
نَجَاتِهِ: نَجَاة + هِ — najāt, rescue, deliverance (f., gen., second term) + -hi, his; 'his rescue'
الَّذِى: الَّذِى — alladhī, who, which, that which (rel. pron., m. sg.; printed with ى); 'that which'
أَصَابَ: أَصَابَ — aṣāba (form IV of ṣāba), to strike, befall (perf. 3ms); 'befell'
رِجْلِهِ: رِجْل + هِ — rijl, foot, leg (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his leg'
كَثِيزَ: كَثِيزَ — printed كثيز, a misprint (zāy for rā') for كَثِير, kathīr, much, many (acc. as predicate of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'much of'
تُصَدِّقُوا: تُصَدِّقُوا — ṣaddaqa (form II of ṣadaqa), to believe, hold true (imperf. 2mp, subjunctive after ḥattā; the final alif is not pronounced); 'you believe'
أَنِّي: أَنَّ + ـِي — anna, that (conj., puts its subject in the accusative) + -nī/-ī, me (doubled nūn: annī); 'that I'
فُضُولٌ: فُضُول — fuḍūl, surplus; in speech of a person 'meddlesomeness, impertinence' (m., nom. tanwīn, subject of mā ʿindī); 'meddling'
دُونِ: دُون — dūn, below, apart from (m., gen. after min); مِنْ دُونِ, 'as distinct from, unlike'
السِّتَّةِ: الـ + سِتَّة — sitta, six (numeral, f. in form with a m. noun; gen., as an adjective of ikhwatī); 'the six'
بِبَغْدَادَ: بِـ + بَغْدَاد — bi-, in (prep. of place) + Baghdād, Baghdad (proper name, gen., diptote so no tanwīn); 'in Baghdad'
زَمَنِ: زَمَن — zaman, time, period, age (m., gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the time of'
الْمُسْتَنْصِرِ: الـ + مُسْتَنْصِر — al-Mustanṣir, 'the one who asks for help/victory' (act. part. of form X istanṣara; m., gen. in an iḍāfa; the caliph's name); 'al-Mustanṣir'
بِاللَّهِ: بِـ + اللَّه — bi-, through, by (prep.; part of the caliph's regnal title, 'seeking victory through God') + Allāh, God (gen.); 'bi-Allāh'
الْمُسْتَضِى: الـ + مُسْتَضِى — al-Mustaḍī, as printed, for al-Mustaḍīʾ, 'the one who seeks light' (act. part. of form X istaḍāʾa; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); name of an earlier caliph
يَوْمَئِذٍ: يَوْم + إِذٍ — yawm, day (m., acc. adverbial) + idhin, then (tanwīn on idh, 'at that time'); written يومئذ with the hamza on the yā' in the edition; 'at that time'
يُحِبُّ: يُحِبُّ — aḥabba (form IV of ḥabba), to love (imperf. 3ms, indicative; the doubled bb is assimilated); 'he loved'
وَالْمَسَاكِينَ: وَ + الـ + مَسَاكِين — wa-, and + masākīn, the destitute, the needy (pl. of miskīn; m., acc., object); 'and the needy'
وَالصَّالِحِينَ: وَ + الـ + صَالِحِين — wa-, and + ṣāliḥīn, the righteous, pious (m. sound pl. of ṣāliḥ; acc.); 'and the righteous'
فَاتَّفَقَ: فَـ + اِتَّفَقَ — fa-, and so, and then (begins the story) + ittafaqa (form VIII of wafaqa), to happen, come about (perf. 3ms); 'and it happened'
نَفَرٍ: نَفَر — nafar, a group of men, persons (m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'persons, men'
الْمُتَوَلِّيَ: الـ + مُتَوَلِّي — mutawallī, the one in charge, prefect, governor (act. part. of form V tawallā; m., acc., object; the defective ending ī keeps its form); 'the prefect'
يَأْتِيَهُ: يَأْتِيَ + هُ — yaʾtī, to bring (āta bi- 'come with, bring') (imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hu, him; 'that he bring him'
عِيدٍ: عِيد — ʿīd, feast, festival (m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa, indefinite); 'a feast'
لُصُوصًا: لُصُوص — luṣūṣ, thieves (pl. of liṣṣ; m., acc. tanwīn, predicate of kāna); 'thieves'
قَطَّاعِينَ: قَطَّاعِين — qaṭṭāʿīn, cutters, robbers (intensive of qaṭaʿa; m. sound pl., acc., in apposition to luṣūṣan); 'cutters'
لِلطَّرِيقِ: لِـ + الـ + طَرِيق — li-, for, of (prep.; here replaces the genitive link: qaṭṭāʿīn li-al-ṭarīq = 'cutters of the road') + ṭarīq, road (m., gen.); 'of the road'
مُتَوَلِّي: مُتَوَلِّي — mutawallī, the one in charge, prefect (act. part. of form V; m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'prefect of'
فَنَظَرْتُهُمْ: فَـ + نَظَرَ + تُ + هُمْ — fa-, and so + naẓara, to look at (perf. 1cs; transitive here) + -hum, them (object); 'and I looked at them'
اجْتَمَعُوا: اِجْتَمَعَ + وا — ijtamaʿa (form VIII of jamaʿa), to gather, assemble (perf. 3mp); مَا اجْتَمَعُوا إِلَّا, 'they have gathered only'
لِوَلِيمَةٍ: لِـ + وَلِيمَة — li-, for, on account of (prep., purpose) + walīma, banquet, feast (f., gen. tanwīn); 'for a feast'
وَأَظُنُّهُمْ: وَ + أَظُنُّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ẓanna, to think, suppose (imperf. 1cs, indicative) + -hum, them (object); 'and I suppose them'
يَقْطَعُونَ: يَقْطَعُونَ — qaṭaʿa, to cut; 'to pass (time)' (imperf. 3mp, indicative), 'they will pass'; with a road or land as object, 'travel, cross, cover': yaqṭaʿūna al-ṭuruqāti, 'travelling the roads'; yaqṭaʿūna al-arḍa, 'crossing the land'
نَهَارَهُمْ: نَهَار + هُمْ — nahār, day (m., acc., object) + -hum, their; 'their day'
الزَّوْرَقِ: الـ + زَوْرَق — zawraq, skiff (m., gen. after fī); 'the skiff'
نَدِيمَهُمْ: نَدِيم + هُمْ — nadīm, boon-companion, drinking friend (m., acc., predicate of yakūnu) + -hum, their; 'their companion'
مُرُوَّتِي: مُرُوَّة + ـِي — muruwwa, manliness, chivalry (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my honour'
وَرَزَانَةِ: وَ + رَزَانَة — wa-, and + razāna, steadiness, gravity, sound judgement (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the steadiness of'
وَاخْتَلَطْتُ: وَ + اِخْتَلَطَ + تُ — wa-, and + ikhtalaṭa (form VIII of khalaṭa), to mingle (perf. 1cs; takes بِـ for the group); 'and I mingled'
فَعَبَرُوا: فَـ + عَبَرَ + وا — fa-, and so + ʿabara, to cross (perf. 3mp); 'and they crossed'
الْجَانِبِ: الـ + جَانِب — jānib, side, bank (m., gen. after ilā); 'the side'
الْآخَرِ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other (m., gen., adjective of al-jānib; the print has the madda alif); 'the other' Also after qawl: wa-qawlu al-ākhari, 'and the saying of another (poet)'.
شُرْطِيَّةٌ: شُرْطِيَّة — shurṭiyya, police force, body of police (f., nom. tanwīn, collective noun); 'a police force'
وَأَعْوَانٌ: وَ + أَعْوَان — wa-, and + aʿwān, helpers, officers (pl. of ʿawn; m., nom. tanwīn); 'and officers'
بِالْجَنَازِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + جَنَازِير — bi-, with, carrying (prep.; the police came 'with' the chains) + janāzīr, chains (pl. of jinzīr, Persian zanjīr; gen.); 'with the chains'
وَرَمَوْهُمْ: وَ + رَمَى + وْا + هُمْ — wa-, and + ramā, to throw, cast (perf. 3mp, defective verb) + -hum, them (object; sense requires 'them' = the chains); 'and they cast them'
رِقَا: رِقَا — the first part of رِقَابِهِمْ: riqāb, necks (pl. of raqaba; f., gen. after fī), cut short before its final letter by a stray space in the print; with the following بِهِمْ, 'in their necks'
وَرَمَوْا: وَ + رَمَى + وْا — wa-, and + ramā, to throw, cast (perf. 3mp); 'and they cast'
جِنْزِيرًا: جِنْزِير — jinzīr, chain (Persian zanjīr; m., acc. tanwīn, object); 'a chain'
مُرُوَّتِى: مُرُوَّة + ـِى — muruwwa, manliness, chivalry (f., gen. after min) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my honour'
وَقِلَّةِ: وَ + قِلَّة — wa-, and + qilla, fewness, scarcity (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the fewness of'
كَلَامِى: كَلَام + ـِى — kalām, speech, talk (m., gen., second term) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my talk'
سَكَتُّ: سَكَتَّ — sakata, to be silent (perf. 1cs; the print has only a damma on the tā', here with the shadda added: sakattu); 'I was silent'
أَتَكَلَّمُ: أَتَكَلَّمُ — takallama (form V of kalama), to speak (imperf. 1cs, indicative, without a linking أَنْ); 'I speak'
فَأَخَذُونَا: فَـ + أَخَذَ + وا + نَا — fa-, and so + akhadha, to take (perf. 3mp) + -nā, us (object, with the helping nūn: akhadhūnā); 'and they took us'
وَقَدَّمُونَا: وَ + قَدَّمَ + وا + نَا — wa-, and + qaddama (form II of qadama), to bring forward, present (perf. 3mp) + -nā, us; 'and they brought us forward'
رِقَابِ: رِقَاب — riqāb, necks (pl. of raqaba; f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa and first term of the next); 'necks of'
فَتَقَدَّمَ: فَـ + تَقَدَّمَ — fa-, and so + taqaddama (form V of qadama), to step forward (perf. 3ms); 'and he stepped forward'
السَّيَّافُ: الـ + سَيَّاف — sayyāf, swordsman, executioner (intensive of sayf, sword; m., nom.); 'the executioner'
أَجْلَسَنَا: أَجْلَسَ + نَا — ajlasa (form IV of jalasa), to make sit, seat (perf. 3ms) + -nā, us (object); 'he seated us'
نِطْعِ: نِطْع — niṭʿ, leather mat (spread under the condemned; m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the mat of'
الدَّمِ: الـ + دَم — dam, blood (m., gen., second term); 'the blood'
وَجَرَّدَ: وَ + جَرَّدَ — wa-, and + jarrada (form II of jarada), to strip, draw (a sword) (perf. 3ms); 'and he drew'
لِلسَّيَّافِ: لِـ + الـ + سَيَّاف — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed after qāla; alif of al- dropped in writing) + sayyāf, executioner (m., gen.); 'to the executioner'
ضَرَبْتَ: ضَرَبَ + تَ — ḍaraba, to strike (perf. 2ms -ta); 'you struck'
رِقَابَ: رِقَاب — riqāb, necks (pl. of raqaba; f., acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the necks of'
مَعَاذَاللَّهِ: مَعَاذَ + اللَّه — maʿādh, refuge (m., acc., object of an understood 'I seek') + Allāh, God (gen.), written as one word in the print; 'God forbid'
تَأْمُرَ: تَأْمُرَ — amara, to command (imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); takes بِـ for the thing ordered; 'you order'
فَأَضْرِبَ: فَـ + أَضْرِبَ — fa-, and so, with the result that (sequence after a wish; takes the subjunctive) + aḍriba, I strike (imperf. 1cs, subjunctive); 'and I strike'
أَظُنُّكَ: أَظُنُّ + كَ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (imperf. 1cs, indicative) + -ka, you (2ms, object); مَا أَظُنُّكَ, 'I do not suppose you ...'; 'I think you'
هُوَالْعَاشِرُ: هُوَ + الـ + عَاشِر — huwa, he (3ms indep. pron., the separating pronoun) + al-, the + ʿāshir, tenth (ordinal; m., nom., predicate), the print runs them together; 'he is the tenth'
وَحَقِّ: وَ + حَقّ — wa-, by (oath particle) + ḥaqq, right, due (m., gen. after the oath wāw, first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the right of'
إِنَّهُمْ: إِنَّ + هُمْ — inna, indeed (particle putting its subject in the accusative) + -hum, they; 'indeed they'
إِلَىَّ: إِلَىَّ — ilā, to (prep.) + -ya, me (1cs; ilayya, the shadda put on the printed ى; the print writes it الى); نَظَرَ إِلَيَّ, 'look at me'
حَمَلَكَ: حَمَلَ + كَ — ḥamala, to carry, bring (perf. 3ms) + -ka, you (object); مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى, 'what led you to ...'
أَصْحَابِ: أَصْحَاب — aṣḥāb, companions, owners, people of (pl. of ṣāḥib; m., gen. after maʿa, first term of an iḍāfa); أَصْحَابُ الدَّمِ, 'the men of blood'
الزَّوْرَقَ: الـ + زَوْرَق — zawraq, skiff, small boat (m., acc. as object of qāṣidīn); 'the skiff'
السِّتَّةُ: الـ + سِتَّة — sitta, six (f., nom. in apposition); 'the six'
الشَّفَتَيْنِ: الـ + شَفَتَيْن — shafatayn, the two lips (f. dual, gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the two lips'
الَّتِى: allatī — who, which, that (rel. pron. f. sg.; the print ends in ى)
الْأَعْوَانُ: الـ + أَعْوَان — aʿwān, helpers, officers, guards (m. broken pl. of ʿawn, nom. as subject); 'the officers'
الْأَهْوَالِ: الـ + أَهْوَال — ahwāl, terrors, dangers (m. broken pl. of hawl, gen. after min); 'the terrors'
الْأُذُنِ: الـ + أُذُن — udhun, ear (f., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the ear'
الْجَنَازِيرَ: الـ + جَنَازِير — janāzīr, chains (broken pl. of janzīr, acc. as object; diptote); 'the chains'
الْحِكْمَةُ: الـ + حِكْمَة — ḥikma, wisdom (f., nom.); 'the wisdom'
الْحِكْمَةِ: الـ + حِكْمَة — ḥikma, wisdom (f., gen. after min); 'the wisdom'
الْخَايِفَةُ: الـ + خَايِفَة — al- the + the print's khāyifa, a slip for khalīfa, caliph (m., nom.; in the print the lām is replaced by yā); 'the caliph'
الْعِلْمُ: الـ + عِلْم — ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m., nom.); 'the learning'
الْمَنْخِرِ: الـ + مَنْخِر — mankhir, nostril, nose (m., gen.); 'the nostril'
الْمُرُوَّةِ: الـ + مُرُوَّة — murūwa, manliness, chivalry (f., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the chivalry'
أَتَكَلَّمْ: takallama, to speak (form V imperf. jussive 1st sg., after lam); 'I speak'
أَمِيرَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — amīr, commander (m., acc. after the vocative; the print joins the two words) + al-, the + muʾminīn, believers (m. sound pl., gen.); 'O Commander of the Faithful'
أَمِيرِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — amīr, commander (m., gen. in an iḍāfa after khiṭāb) + al-, the + muʾminīn, believers (m. sound pl., gen.); 'the Commander of the Faithful' (a title of the caliph; printed as one word)
أَوْقَفُونَا: awqafa, to make stand, to halt someone (form IV perf. 3rd m. pl.) + -nā, us (1st pl. suffix); 'they made us stand'
أُعَرِّفْكُمْ: ʿarrafa, to make known, inform (form II imperf. jussive 1st sg., after lam) + -kum, you (m. pl. suffix, here the respectful address to the Caliph); 'I make known to you'
إِخْوَتُكَ: إِخْوَة + كَ — ikhwa, brothers (m. pl. of akh, nom. as subject) + -ka, your (m. sg. suffix); 'your brothers'
إِلَيْهِمُ: إِلَى + هِمُ — ilā, to, towards (prep., with y- before a suffix) + -himu, them (3rd m. pl. suffix, with damma before al-); 'to them, upon them'
إِلَّامُرُوَّةٌ: إِلَّا + مُرُوَّةٌ — illā, but, except (particle of exception) + murūwa, manliness, chivalry (f., nom. indef., predicate); 'but chivalry' (printed as one word)
بَاكِرِ: bākir — early (act. part. of bakara, to be early; m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the early-part of'
بِأَوْحَشِ: بِـ + أَوْحَش — bi-, with, by (prep. of means: kāfaʾa bi- 'repay with') + awḥash, most desolate, most savage (elative, m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'with the vilest of'
بِعَاهَةٍ: بِـ + عَاهَة — bi-, with (prep.: ṣāra bi- 'become afflicted with') + ʿāha, blemish, disability (f., gen. indef.); 'with a defect'
تُقَارِنَ: qārana, to join, compare (form III imperf. subjunctive 2nd m. sg., after an); 'you compare'
خَلَّصْتُهُ: khallaṣa, to deliver, rescue (form II perf. 1st sg. -tu) + -hu, him (3rd m. sg. object suffix, resumptive of alladhī); 'I rescued him'
خِطَابَ: khiṭāb — address, speech (m., acc. as object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the address of'
ذَمَّيْتَنِي: dhamma, to blame, disparage (Middle Arabic form of dhamamta, built like a weak verb: perf. 2nd m. sg. -ta) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix); 'you have blamed me'
رَزَانَةُ: razāna — steadiness, gravity, sobriety (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the steadiness of'
رِقَابِهِمُ: رِقَاب + هِمُ — riqāb, necks (m. broken pl. of raqaba, gen. after fī) + -himu, their (3rd m. pl. suffix, with damma before al-); 'their necks'
سَكَتَّ: sakata, to be silent (perf.; the print marks the final consonant with fatḥa and shadda, as for 2nd m. sg. -ta, where the sense is 1st sg. -tu); 'I was silent'
شَارَكْتُهُمْ: shāraka, to share with, partake with (form III perf. 1st sg. -tu) + -hum, them (3rd m. pl. suffix, object); 'I shared with them'
ضَحِكًا: ḍaḥik — laughing, a laugh (verbal noun, m., acc. indef. as cognate accusative); 'a laugh'
فَاخْتَلَطْتُ: فَـ + اخْتَلَطْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ikhtalaṭa, to mingle, mix (form VIII perf. 1st sg. -tu); 'and so I mingled'
فَأَمَرْتَ: فَـ + أَمَرْتَ — fa-, and then (conj.) + amara, to command (perf. 2nd m. sg. -ta); 'and you commanded'
فَمِنْهُمْ: فَـ + مِنْ + هُمْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + min, from, of (prep.) + -hum, them (3rd m. pl. suffix); 'and of them'
فُلِجَ: fulija — he was paralysed, struck with palsy (passive perf. 3rd m. sg. of falija; the print has only the consonants)
قِلَّةُ: qilla — fewness, scarcity (f., nom. in the print's "wa qillatu", with the separated wa- as a conj.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the fewness of'
لَابَقُوا: لَا + بَقُوا — lā, not (negative particle with the perfect in a wish) + baqiya, to remain, endure (perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'may they not remain' (printed as one word)
لَاعَاشُوا: لَا + عَاشُوا — lā, not (negative particle with the perfect in a wish) + ʿāsha, to live (perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'may they not live' (printed as one word)
مُرُوَّةٌ: murūwa — manliness, chivalry, generosity (f., nom. indef.); 'a chivalry'
مُرُوَّتِهِمْ: مُرُوَّة + هِمْ — murūwa, manliness, chivalry (f., gen. in an iḍāfa) + -him, their (3rd m. pl. suffix); 'their chivalry'
مُزَيِّنٌ: muzayyin — barber (act. part. of zayyana, to adorn, to dress the hair; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'a barber'
مُكَافَاتٍ: mukāfāt — repayments, requitals (f. sound pl. of mukāfāʾa, gen. indef.; the print has no hamza); 'returns'
نَهَارُ: nahār — day, daytime (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the day of'
نِهَايَةَ: nihāya — end, limit (f., acc. indef. after the negative lā, no tanwīn); 'no end'
وَجَعَلُوا: وَ + جَعَلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + jaʿala, to put, place (perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'and they put'
وَجَوْدَةُ: وَ + جَوْدَة — wa-, and (conj.) + jawda, excellence, goodness (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the excellence of'
وَصَنْعَتِي: وَ + صَنْعَة + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣanʿa, craft, trade (f., nom.) + -ī, my (1st sg. suffix); 'and my trade'
وَظَنَنْتُ: وَ + ظَنَنْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ẓanna, to think, suppose (perf. 1st sg. -tu); 'and I supposed'
وَعَقْلُكَ: وَ + عَقْل + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.) + -ka, your (m. sg. suffix); 'and your mind'
وَقِلَّةُ: وَ + قِلَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + qilla, fewness, scarcity (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the fewness of'
وَلَايَنْبَغِي: وَ + لَا + يَنْبَغِي — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, not (negative) + yanbaghī, it is fitting, proper (form VII imperf. 3rd m. sg.; impersonal); 'and it is not fitting' (printed as one word)
وَوَاحِدًا: وَ + وَاحِدًا — wa-, and (conj.) + wāḥid, one (m., acc. indef. as printed); 'and one'
يَاصَامِتُ: يَا + صَامِت — yā, O (vocative particle) + ṣāmit, silent (act. part. of ṣamata, to be silent; m., nom. in the vocative); 'O Silent' (printed as one word)
يَزْعُمُ: zaʿama, to claim, allege (imperf. indic. 3rd m. sg.); 'he claims'
يُكَافِئُونَنِي: yukāfiʾu, to repay, requite (form III imperf. 3rd m. pl. -ūna) + -nī, me (1st sg. object suffix, with the nūn of -ūna doubled in the print); 'they repay me'
لَاتَحْسَبْ: لَا + تَحْسَبْ — lā, not (negative particle, here prohibition with the jussive) + taḥsab, to reckon, think (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive, ḥasiba/yaḥsabu); printed as one word; 'do not think'
أُبَيِّنَ: أُ + بَيِّنَ — u-, I (1cs imperf. prefix) + bayyana, to make clear, show (verb II, root ب-ي-ن), subjunctive after an; 'that I show'
مُرُوَّةً: muruwwa, manliness, chivalry, decency (f., acc. of specification, tamyīz; printed without the hamza of classical muruʾa); 'in manliness'
اِتَّفَقَتْ: ittafaqat — ittafaqa, to happen, befall (verb VIII, root و-ف-ق; perf. 3fs, agreeing with ḥikāya); 'it befell'
صَارَفِيهِ: صَارَ + فِي + هِ — ṣāra, to become, come to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + fī, in (prep.) + -hi, him (3ms suffix); printed as one word; 'there came to be in him'
عَاهَةٌ: ʿāha, blemish, defect, infirmity (f., nom. indef.); 'a defect'
أَحْكِى: aḥkī — ḥakā/yaḥkī, to relate, tell (verb I, root ح-ك-ي; imperf. 1cs; the weak final letter printed ى); 'I relate'
صَنْعَتُهُ: صَنْعَة + ـهُ — ṣanʿa, craft, trade (f., nom., subject of kāna) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his trade'
الْخِيَاطَةَ: الـ + خِيَاطَة — al-, the + khiyāṭa, sewing, tailoring (f. verbal noun of khāṭa; acc. as predicate of kāna); 'the sewing, tailoring'
يَخِيطُ: yakhīṭu — khāṭa, to sew (verb I hollow, root خ-ي-ط; imperf. 3ms); 'he sews, was sewing'
اِسْتَأْجَرَهَا: اِسْتَأْجَرَ + هَا — ista'jara, to rent, hire (verb X, root أ-ج-ر; perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (3fs suffix, resuming dukkān, treated as feminine; no relative pronoun); 'he rented it'
كَثِيرِ: kathīr, many, much (adj., m., gen. agreeing with rajul; first term of an iḍāfa); 'abundant in'
سَاكِنًا: sākin, dwelling, resident (act. part. of sakana, to dwell; m., acc. as predicate of kāna); 'dwelling'
طَاحُونًا: ṭāḥūn, mill (m./f.; printed in the accusative, where classical grammar would have the nominative as subject of kāna); 'a mill'
يَّامِ: ayyām, days (pl. of yawm; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); the second half of الا يام, broken by a space in the print; 'of the days', baʿḍ al-ayyām 'one day'
اِمْرَأَةً: imraʾa, woman (f., acc. indef., object; printed with the hamza on the alif seat); 'a woman'
الطَّالِعِ: الـ + طَّالِع — al-, the + ṭāliʿ, rising (act. part. of ṭalaʿa, to rise; m., gen., adjective of badr); 'the rising'
رَوْشَنِ: rawshan, bay window, balcony (from Persian; m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the bay window of'
رَآهَا: رَآ + هَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms; printed with madda) + -hā, her/it (3fs suffix); 'he saw her/it'
بِحُبِّهَا: بِـ + حُبّ + هَا — bi-, to, with (prep.; the verb taʿallaqa chooses bi- for the thing clung to) + ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'to love of her'; after mashghūl (Night 107), bi- marks what occupies one: mashghūlan bi-ḥubbihā, 'taken up with love of her'
فَبَطَّلَ: فَـ + بَطَّلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + baṭṭala, to put out of work, leave idle (verb II, root ب-ط-ل; perf. 3ms); 'and he left off'
خِيَاطَتَهُ: خِيَاطَة + ـهُ — khiyāṭa, sewing (f., acc., object of baṭṭala) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his sewing'
قَعَدَ: qaʿada — qaʿada, to sit down, sit (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed after a detached و, 'and he sat'
غَرَزَ: gharaza — to prick, stick in, sew a stitch (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he pricked'
غَرْزَةً: gharza, stitch (f., acc., object; noun of unity from gharz); 'a stitch'
الرَّوْشَنِ: الـ + رَّوْشَن — al-, the + rawshan, bay window (m., gen. after ilā); 'the bay window'
فَرَآهَا: فَـ + رَآ + هَا — fa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'and he saw her'
حُبُّهُ: حُبّ + ـهُ — ḥubb, love (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his love'
هَيَامُهُ: هَيَام + ـهُ — hayām/hiyām, love-madness, frenzy of longing (m., nom. coordinated with ḥubbuhu) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his frenzy'
فَرَأَنْهُ: فَـ + رَأَنْ + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + raʾan, saw (printed ن where ت is expected: read fa-raʾat-hu) + -hu, him (3ms suffix); the print's slip for فرأته, 'and she saw him'
الْامْرَأَةُ: الـ + اِمْرَأَة — al-, the + imraʾa, woman (f., nom., subject; article attached to the full form imraʾa, classical al-marʾa); 'the woman'
وَعَلِمَتْ: وَ + عَلِمَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿalimat, to know (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she knew'
أَسِيرًا: asīr, captive, prisoner (m., acc. as predicate of ṣāra); 'a captive'
لِحُبِّهَا: لِـ + حُبّ + هَا — li-, to, in thrall to (prep.; asīr li- 'captive to') + ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'to love of her'
جَارِيَتَهَا: جَارِيَة + هَا — jāriya, girl, slave-girl, maid (f., acc., object) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'her maid'
بُقْشَةٌ: buqsha, bundle wrapped in cloth (from Turkish; f., nom. indef., the subject of the verbless phrase); 'a bundle'
طَاقَةُ: ṭāqa, length or bolt of cloth (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'a length of'
مُشَجَّرٍ: mushajjar, patterned with branch designs, figured (pass. part. of shajjara, form II; m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'figured stuff'
تُقْرِئُكَ: تُقْرِئ + كَ — tuqriʾu, to make read, convey (verb IV of قرأ, root ق-ر-أ; imperf. 3fs, with the greeting as second object) + -ka, you (2ms suffix); tuqriʾuka al-salām 'sends you greetings'
فَصِّلْ: faṣṣil — faṣṣala, to cut out (cloth), cut to pattern (verb II, root ف-ص-ل; imperative 2ms); 'cut out'
قَمِيصًا: qamīṣ, shirt (m., acc. indef., object); 'a shirt'
خَيِّطْ: khayyiṭ — khayyaṭa, to sew (verb II of خاط, root خ-ي-ط; imperative 2ms); printed after a detached و; 'sew'
خِيَاطَةً: khiyāṭa, sewing (f., acc. as cognate object); 'a sewing'
فَصَّلَ: faṣṣala — to cut out (cloth), cut to pattern (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he cut out'
وَأَتَمَّ: وَ + أَتَمَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + atamma, to complete, finish (verb IV, root ت-م-م; perf. 3ms); 'and he completed'
الْغَدِ: الـ + غَد — al-, the + ghad, tomorrow, the morrow (m., gen. after min); 'the morrow'
بَاكَرَتْهُ: بَاكَرَتْ + هُ — bākarat, to come early to (verb III, root ب-ك-ر; perf. 3fs) + -hu, him (3ms suffix, object); 'she came to him early'
تُسَلِّمُ: tusallimu — sallama, to greet, give a greeting (verb II, root س-ل-م; imperf. 3fs; sallama ʿalā 'greet'); 'she greets'
مَبِيتُكَ: مَبِيت + كَ — mabīt, spending the night, night's lodging (m. noun of place/time from bāta; nom., subject of kāna) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your night'
قَتِ: qati — second part of dhāqat (dhāqa, to taste, verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); the final kasra is a helping vowel before al-; completes the broken word mā dhāqat
شُغْلِ: shughl, occupation, preoccupation; also work, workmanship (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the preoccupation of', 'of the work of'
قَلْبِهَا: قَلْب + هَا — qalb, heart (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'her heart'
أَصْفَرَ: aṣfar, yellow (adj., m., diptote gen., adjective of aṭlas); 'yellow'
سِرْوَالَيْنِ: sirwāl, trousers, breeches (m.; dual acc., object); 'two pairs of trousers'
وَخَيِّطْهُمَا: وَ + خَيِّطْ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + khayyiṭ, sew (verb II of خاط; imperative 2ms) + -humā, them both (3 dual suffix, object); 'and sew them both'
سَلِّمِي: sallimī — sallama, to greet (verb II; imperative 2fs, addressed to the maid); 'give greeting'
لِأَمْرِكِ: لِـ + أَمْر + كِ — li-, to (prep.; munqād li- 'submissive to') + amr, command, order (m., gen.) + -ki, your (2fs suffix); 'to your command'
حْكُمِي: iḥkumī — ḥakama, to rule, give judgement (verb I, root ح-ك-م; imperative 2fs); printed split from fa- with the alif left on the previous piece; 'rule, decree'
التَّفْصِيلِ: الـ + تَّفْصِيل — al-, the + tafṣīl, cutting out (of cloth) (m. verbal noun of faṣṣala; gen. after fī); 'the cutting'
وَاجْتَهَدَ: وَ + اِجْتَهَدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ijtahada, to exert oneself, strive (verb VIII, root ج-ه-د; perf. 3ms); 'and he exerted himself'
خِيَاطَةِ: khiyāṭa, sewing (f., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the sewing of'
السِّرْوَالَيْنِ: الـ + سِّرْوَالَيْن — al-, the + sirwālayn, two pairs of trousers (dual gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the two pairs of trousers'
تَطَلَّعَتْ: taṭallaʿat — taṭallaʿa, to look out, peer (verb V, root ط-ل-ع; perf. 3fs); 'she looked out'
الشُّبَّاكِ: الـ + شُّبَّاك — al-, the + shubbāk, lattice window (m., gen. after min); 'the lattice window'
بِالْإِيمَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + إِيمَاء — bi-, by, with (prep. of means) + al-, the + īmāʾ, signalling, gesture (m. verbal noun of form IV awmaʾa; gen.); 'by the signal, with a gesture'
تَغُضُّ: taghuḍḍu — ghaḍḍa, to lower (the eyes), cast down (verb I geminate, imperf. 3fs); 'she lowers'
طَرْفَهَا: طَرْف + هَا — ṭarf, glance, eye (m., acc., object) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'her glance'
تَتَبَسَّمُ: tatabassamu — tabassama, to smile (verb V, root ب-س-م; imperf. 3fs); 'she smiles'
سَيَظْفَرُ: سَـ + يَظْفَرُ — sa-, will (future particle prefixed to the imperfect) + yaẓfaru, ẓafira, to succeed, win (verb I; imperf. 3ms; ẓafira bi- 'gain, win'); 'he will win'
فَأَخَذَتْهُمَا: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ + هُمَا — fa-, and (conj.) + akhadhat, to take (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -humā, both of them (3 dual suffix, object); 'and she took them both'
انْطَرَحَ: inṭaraḥa — to throw oneself down (verb VII, root ط-ر-ح; perf. 3ms); 'he threw himself'
يَتَقَلَّبُ: yataqallabu — taqallaba, to toss and turn (verb V, root ق-ل-ب; imperf. 3ms); 'tossing and turning'
يَدْعُوكَ: يَدْعُو + كَ — yadʿū, to call, summon (verb I, root د-ع-و; imperf. 3ms) + -ka, you (2ms suffix, object); 'he is calling you'
شَعَرَتِ: shaʿarat — shaʿara, to perceive, be aware (verb I, perf. 3fs; shaʿara bi- 'become aware of'); helping kasra before al-; 'she became aware'
بِخَوْفِهِ: بِـ + خَوْف + هِ — bi-, of (prep.; shaʿara chooses bi- for what is perceived) + khawf, fear (m., gen.) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'of his fear'
لَابَأْسَ: لَا + بَأْسَ — lā, no (absolute negation, with the accusative) + baʾs, harm, evil (m., acc.); printed as one word; lā baʾsa ʿalayka 'no harm to you', 'have no fear'
إِلَّالِخَيْرٍ: إِلَّا + لِـ + خَيْر — illā, except, but (particle of exception) + li-, for (prep.; marks the purpose, 'for good') + khayr, good (m., gen. indef.); printed as one word; 'except for good'
جَعَلَتْ: jaʿalat — jaʿala, to make, set (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she has made'
مَعْرِفَةً: maʿrifa, acquaintance, knowledge (f., acc. indef., second object of jaʿala); 'an acquaintance'
سَيِّدِهَا: سَيِّد + هَا — sayyid, master (m., gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'her master'
