زَوْجِ: zawj, husband, spouse (m., gen., in apposition to sayyidihā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'husband of'
سِتِّهَا: سِتّ + هَا — sitt, lady, mistress (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her (3fs suffix); 'her lady'
نَاوَلَهُ: نَاوَلَ + هُ — nāwala, to hand, give (verb III, root ن-و-ل; perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (3ms suffix, indirect object); 'he handed him'
يُفَصِّلُ: yufaṣṣilu — faṣṣala, to cut out (cloth) (verb II, imperf. 3ms); 'cutting out'
الْعِشَاءِ: الـ + عِشَاء — al-, the + ʿishāʾ, evening, evening meal (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the evening meal'; also: 'nightfall', the hour of the last evening prayer: mina al-ʿishāʾi, 'from nightfall' (Night 192)
يَذُقْ: yadhuq — dhāqa, to taste (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam); 'he did not taste'
تَأْخُذْ: taʾkhudh — akhadha, to take (verb I, root أ-خ-ذ; imperf. 2ms jussive after lā); 'do not take'
بَرٍّ: barr, open country, the outside (m., gen. after ilā; the shadda is printed); 'outside'
مُحْتَاجًا: مُحْتَاج — muḥtāj, needy, in need (m., act. part. of Form VIII احْتَاجَ إِلَى, acc. as predicate of kāna); 'needy'
فَلْسٍ: فَلْس — fals, fils, small copper coin (m., gen. after ilā); 'a copper coin'
لَايَأْ: لَا + يَأْ — lā, not (neg. particle) + ya-, he (imperf. prefix of يَأْكُلُ, the alif carrying the hamza and sukūn); first half of the printed pair لايا كل, 'he does not eat'
الْقَلِيلَ: الـ + قَلِيل — al-, the + qalīl, little, a few (adj. used as noun, acc. as the thing excepted after illā); 'the little'
اجْتِهَادِهِ: اجْتِهَاد + هِ — ijtihād, exertion, effort (m. verbal noun of Form VIII اجْتَهَدَ, gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'his exertion'
الْخِيَاطَةِ: الـ + خِيَاطَة — al-, the + khiyāṭa, sewing, tailoring (f. verbal noun of خَاطَ, gen. after fī); 'the tailoring'
وَأَتَي: وَ + أَتَي — wa-, and + atā, he came (perf. 3 m. sg. of أَتَى; the print writes it with a final ي); 'and he came'
عَرَّفَتْ: عَرَّفَتْ — ʿarrafat, she made known, informed (perf. 3 f. sg. of Form II عَرَّفَ; takes the person as object and the matter with bi-); 'she had informed'
زَوْجَهَا: زَوْج + هَا — zawj, husband (m., acc. as object) + -hā, her; 'her husband'
بِحَالِ: بِـ + حَال — bi-, of, about (prep. introducing the matter told, after ʿarrafa) + ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen. first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the state of'
وَأَخِي: وَ + أَخ + ـِي — wa-, and (here: while, introducing a circumstantial clause) + akh, brother + -ī, my; 'and my brother, while my brother'
وَاتَّفَقَتْ: وَ + اتَّفَقَتْ — wa-, and + ittafaqat, she agreed (perf. 3 f. sg. of Form VIII اتَّفَقَ); 'and she agreed'
هِىَ: هِىَ — hiya, she (3 f. sg. independent pronoun; the print writes هى); 'she'
وَزَوْجُهَا: وَ + زَوْج + هَا — wa-, and (here: together with) + zawj, husband (m., nom. joined to the subject) + -hā, her; 'and her husband'
اسْتِعْمَالِ: اسْتِعْمَال — istiʿmāl, employing, putting to use (m. verbal noun of Form X, gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the employing of'
شَئٍْ: شَيْء — shayʾ, thing (m., gen. after bi-lā; the print has شي without hamza); 'a thing', so 'without anything, for nothing'
وَيَضْحَكُونَ: وَ + يَضْحَكُونَ — wa-, and + yaḍḥakūna, they laugh (imperf. 3 m. pl. of ضَحِكَ, indic.); 'and they laugh'
فَأَتَتْ: فَـ + أَتَتْ — fa-, and then (conj. of sequence) + atat, she came (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and (she) came'
تُفَصِّلَ: تُفَصِّلَ — tufaṣṣila, you cut out (imperf. 2 m. sg. of Form II فَصَّلَ, subj. after an); 'that you cut out'
فَرَجِيَّاتٍ: فَرَجِيَّات — farajiyyāt, farajiyyas, long wide-sleeved robes (f. sound pl. of فَرَجِيَّة, gen. after khamsa); 'robes'
فَفَصَّلَ: فَـ + فَصَّلَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + faṣṣala, he cut out (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form II); 'and he cut out'
خَيَّطَ: خَيَّطَ — khayyaṭa, he sewed (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form II); 'he sewed'
الْفَرَجِيَّاتِ: الـ + فَرَجِيَّات — al-, the + farajiyyāt, the robes (f. sound pl., acc. as object of khayyaṭa); 'the robes'
وَادَّعَى: وَ + ادَّعَى — wa-, and + iddaʿā, he called for (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form VIII ادَّعَى; with bi- 'to call for something'; elsewhere 'he claimed'); 'and he called for'
بِكِيسٍ: بِـ + كِيس — bi-, for (prep.; with ادَّعَى, 'call for something') + kīs, purse, bag (m., gen. after bi-); 'for a purse'
دَرَاهِمُ: دَرَاهِم — darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of دِرْهَم; nom., diptote); 'dirhams'
لَاتَأْخُذَ: لَا + تَأْخُذَ — lā, not (neg., after an: 'that not') + taʾkhudha, you take (imperf. 2 m. sg. of أَخَذَ, subj. after an); printed as one word; 'that you not take'
لِلرَّجُلِ: لِـ + الـ + رَجُل — li-, to (prep., marking the one addressed after قَالَ) + al-, the + rajul, man (m., gen.); 'to the man'
لَاتَعْجَلْ: لَا + تَعْجَلْ — lā, do not (neg. imperative particle) + taʿjal, you hasten (jussive 2 m. sg. of عَجِلَ); printed as one word; 'do not hurry'
فَالزَّمَانُ: فَـ + الـ + زَمَان — fa-, for, since (conj. giving a reason) + al-, the + zamān, time (m., nom.); 'for time'
مُوَانِي: مُوَانِي — muwānī, accommodating, gentle (act. part. of Form III وَانَى, m., nom. as predicate; obscure, possibly corrupt); 'accommodating'
أَذَلُّ: أَذَلّ — adhall, more abject, more humble (elative of ذَلِيل, m., nom. as predicate); 'more abject'
وَإِفْلَاسٌ: وَ + إِفْلَاس — wa-, and + iflās, bankruptcy, penury (m. verbal noun of Form IV أَفْلَسَ, nom.); 'and penury'
وَجُوعٌ: وَ + جُوع — wa-, and + jūʿ, hunger (m., nom.); 'and hunger'
وَعُرْىٌ: وَ + عُرْى — wa-, and + ʿurī, nakedness (m., nom.; the print writes it with a ى); 'and nakedness'
وَتَعَبٌ: وَ + تَعَب — wa-, and + taʿab, weariness (m., nom.); 'and weariness'
يُشَجِّعُ: يُشَجِّعُ — yushajjiʿu, he encourages, makes brave (imperf. 3 m. sg. of Form II شَجَّعَ, indic.); 'he heartens'
أَشْغَالِهِمْ: أَشْغَال + هِمْ — ashghāl, jobs, works (pl. of شُغْل, gen. after jamīʿ) + -him, their; 'their jobs'
وَزَوَّجُوهُ: وَ + زَوَّجُوا + هُ — wa-, and + zawwajū, they married off (perf. 3 m. pl. of Form II زَوَّجَ) + -hu, him; 'and they married him'
بِجَارِيَتِهِمْ: بِـ + جَارِيَة + هِمْ — bi-, to, with (prep.; after زَوَّجَ, it marks the bride: 'marry him to') + jāriya, girl, slave-girl (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'to their slave-girl'
بِتِ: بِتْ — bit, spend the night (imperative m. sg. of بَاتَ, shortened; kasra links it to al-); 'spend the night'
عْتَقَدَ: عْتَقَدَ — iʿtaqada, he believed, took it that (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form VIII; its alif is printed on the previous word); 'he believed'
الطَّحَّانَ: الـ + طَحَّان — al-, the + ṭaḥḥān, miller (m., acc. as object); 'the miller'
يُدَوِّرُهُ: يُدَوِّرُ + هُ — yudawwiru, he makes go round (imperf. 3 m. sg. of Form II دَوَّرَ, here indic.) + -hu, him; 'he make him go round'
الطَّحَّانُ: الـ + طَحَّان — al-, the + ṭaḥḥān, miller (m., nom.); 'the miller'
بَطَلَ: بَطَلَ — baṭala, it stopped working, was idle (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'has stopped working'
وَلَابَقِيَ: وَ + لَا + بَقِيَ — wa-, and + lā, not (neg.) + baqiya, he remained (perf. 3 m. sg.); with a following imperfect, 'no longer'; printed as one word; 'and no longer'
وَالْقَمْحُ: وَ + الـ + قَمْح — wa-, and (here: while, circumstantial) + al-, the + qamḥ, wheat (m., nom.); 'and the wheat'
مَلَأَ: مَلَأَ — malaʾa, he filled (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he filled'
الْقَادُوسَ: الـ + قَادُوس — al-, the + qādūs, bucket, hopper (m., acc. as object); 'the hopper'
قَمْحًا: قَمْح — qamḥ, wheat (m., acc., of material after 'fill'); 'with wheat'
حَبْلٌ: حَبْل — ḥabl, rope (m., nom., indef.); 'a rope'
هَيَّا: هَيَّا — hayyā, come on! (exclamation, used to urge on an animal); 'come on!'
دُرْ: دُرْ — dur, go round (imperative m. sg. of دَارَ, shortened); 'go round'
الْقَمْحِ: الـ + قَمْح — al-, the + qamḥ, wheat (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the wheat'
مُرَادُكَ: مُرَاد + كَ — murād, wish, desire (m., nom.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your wish'
تَخْرَاً: تَخْرَاً — takhrā, you shit (imperf. 2 m. sg. of خَرِئَ/خَرَى; the print has a tanwīn fatḥa on the alif, odd and possibly corrupt); 'you shit'
وَتَبُولُ: وَ + تَبُولُ — wa-, and + tabūlu, you urinate (imperf. 2 m. sg. of بَالَ, indic.); 'and you piss'
وَيَصِيحُ: وَ + يَصِيحُ — wa-, and + yaṣīḥu, he cries out (imperf. 3 m. sg. of صَاحَ, indic.); 'and cries out'
مُغِيثًا: مُغِيث — mughīth, helper, one who rescues (m., act. part. of Form IV أَغَاثَ, acc. as object, indef.); 'a helper'
يَنْطَحِنُ: يَنْطَحِنُ — yanṭaḥinu, it is ground, gets ground (imperf. 3 m. sg. of Form VII انْطَحَنَ, indic.); 'is being ground'
قَرِيبِ: قَرِيب — qarīb, near, close (adj. used as noun, gen. after ilā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'near'
مُعَلَّقًا: مُعَلَّق — muʿallaq, hung, suspended (m., pass. part. of Form II عَلَّقَ, acc. as the state of the object); 'hanging'
بَاكِرَ: بَاكِر — bākir, early (m., adv. acc. of time, first term of an iḍāfa); 'early in'
يَعِزُّ: يَعِزُّ — yaʿizzu, it is hard, grievous (imperf. 3 m. sg. of عَزَّ, indic.; with عَلَى, 'it pains someone'); 'it pains'
وَسِتِّي: وَ + سِتّ + ـِي — wa-, and (here: together with) + sitt, lady, mistress (f., colloquial for سَيِّدَة) + -ī, my; 'and my lady'
حَمَلْنَا: حَمَلْنَا — ḥamalnā, we carried, took on (perf. 1 pl. of حَمَلَ); 'we have taken on'
لِسَانٌ: لِسَان — lisān, tongue (m., nom., indef.); 'a tongue'
يَرُدُّ: يَرُدُّ — yaruddu, he returns, gives back (imperf. 3 m. sg. of رَدَّ, indic.); 'to give back'
وَالتَّعَبِ: وَ + الـ + تَعَب — wa-, and + al-, the + taʿab, weariness (m., gen.); 'and the weariness'
بِالْمُعَلِّمِ: بِـ + الـ + مُعَلِّم — bi-, with (prep.; after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears: 'behold, the master') + al-, the + muʿallim, master, teacher (m., act. part. of Form II, gen.); 'the master'
حَيَّاكَ: حَيَّا + كَ — ḥayyā, he gave life to, greeted (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form II حَيَّا) + -ka, you (m. sg., obj.); 'may he greet you, give you life'
النَّعِيمِ: الـ + نَعِيم — al-, the + naʿīm, bliss, delight (m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'bliss'
لَالِ: لَالِ — lāli, obscure; perhaps for لَيَالٍ layālin, nights (pl. of لَيْلَة), the yā lost in the print; 'nights (?)'
وَالْعِنَاقُ: وَ + الـ + عِنَاق — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿināq, embracing (m. verbal noun of عَانَقَ, nom.); 'and the embracing'
الِي: إِلَى — ilā, to, until (prep.; the print writes الي, with no hamza and a yā for the alif maqṣūra); 'until'
الْكَاذِبَ: الـ + كَاذِب — al-, the + kādhib, liar (m., act. part. of كَذَبَ, acc. as object); 'the liar'
قَرْنَانٍ: قَرْنَان — qarnān, cuckold (m., gen. after alf); 'cuckolds'
طَحْنَ: طَحْن — ṭaḥn, grinding (m. verbal noun of طَحَنَ, acc.); 'grinding'
فَحَدَّثَهُ: فَـ + حَدَّثَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + ḥaddatha, he told (perf. 3 m. sg. of Form II) + -hu, him; 'and he told him'
نَجْمُكَ: نَجْم + كَ — najm, star (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your star'
نَجْمَهَا: نَجْم + هَا — najm, star (m., acc. as object) + -hā, her; 'her star'
شِئْتَ: شِئْتَ — shiʾta, you wished (perf. 2 m. sg. of شَاءَ); 'you wish'
أُغَيِّرُلَكَ: أُغَيِّرُ + لَ + كَ — ughayyiru, I change (imperf. 1 sg. of Form II غَيَّرَ, indic.) + la-, for (prep. li-, marking the beneficiary) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'I change for you'
تَرَكَهُ: تَرَكَ + هُ — taraka, he left (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'he left him'
بِشُغْلٍ: بِـ + شُغْل — bi-, with (prep.; أَتَى بِـ 'to bring') + shughl, work, job (m., gen.); 'with a job, bringing work'
يَتَقَوَّتُ: يَتَقَوَّتُ — yataqawwatu, he sustains himself (imperf. 3 m. sg. of Form V تَقَوَّتَ, indic.); 'by which he lives'
بِالْجَارِيَةِ: بِـ + الـ + جَارِيَة — bi-, with (prep.; after idhā huwa of surprise it only marks what appears) + al-, the + jāriya, girl (f., gen.); 'the girl (behold)' Also after dhahaba, bi- is 'with', and dhahaba bi- is 'to take along': dhahaba bi-al-jāriyati, 'he took the girl'. Also after jarā, 'to happen', bi- marks the one it happens to: kayfa jarā bi-al-jāriyati, 'how did it go with the slave-girl?'.
سِتِّكِ: سِتّ + كِ — sitt, lady, mistress (f., gen.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your mistress'
مُعَامَلَةٌ: مُعَامَلَة — muʿāmala, dealing, transaction (f. verbal noun of Form III عَامَلَ, nom.); 'dealings'
وَأَعْلَمَتْ: وَ + أَعْلَمَتْ — wa-, and + aʿlamat, she informed (perf. 3 f. sg. of Form IV أَعْلَمَ); 'and she told'
سِتَّهَا: سِتّ + هَا — sitt, lady (f., acc. as object) + -hā, her; 'her mistress'
دَرَي: دَرَى — darā, he knew, perceived (perf. 3 m. sg. of دَرَى; the print writes it with a ي); 'he knew'
فَحَلَفَتْ: فَـ + حَلَفَتْ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + ḥalafat, she swore (perf. 3 f. sg. of حَلَفَ); 'and she swore'
بِاخْتِيَارِهَا: بِـ + اخْتِيَار + هَا — bi-, by, with (prep.; of means or accord) + ikhtiyār, choice (m. verbal noun of Form VIII, gen.) + -hā, her; 'by her choice'
وَأَنَّهَا: وَ + أَنَّ + هَا — wa-, and + anna, that (conj.) + -hā, she (acc. suffix: the subject); 'and that she'
بَرِيئَةٌ: بَرِيئَة — barīʾa, innocent (adj. f., nom. as predicate; the print has the precomposed ئ); 'innocent'
نَظَرَأَخِي: نَظَرَ + أَخ + ـِي — naẓara, he looked (perf. 3 m. sg. of نَظَرَ) + akh, brother + -ī, my; the print runs them together; 'my brother looked'
وَقَبِلَ: وَ + قَبِلَ — wa-, and + qabila, he accepted (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he accepted'
عُذْرَهَا: عُذْر + هَا — ʿudhr, excuse (m., acc. as object) + -hā, her; 'her excuse'
بِرُؤْيَتِهَا: بِـ + رُؤْيَة + ـهَا — ruʾya, seeing, sight (f.); bi-, at, on account of (prep., here with a verb of rejoicing: the cause of the gladness); -hā, her (gen. suffix, objective: the seeing of her); 'at the sight of her'
خِيَاطَتِهِ: خِيَاطَة + ـهِ — khiyāṭa, tailoring, sewing (f.); -hi, his (gen. suffix after fī); 'in his tailoring'
سَتِّي: سَتِّي — sitt, lady, mistress (f., nom.) + -ī, my (1 sg. suffix); 'my lady' (subject of تُسَلِّمُ)
إنَّ: إِنَّ — inna, indeed, that (particle introducing reported speech, takes the accusative of its subject)
أنَّهُ: أَنَّ + هُ — anna, that (particle, introduces a clause, takes the accusative); -hu, he/him (the subject of the clause); 'that he'
يَبِيتُ: يَبِيتُ — bāta, to pass the night, spend the night (verb, I, hollow, impf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'he spends the night, he will spend the night'
أصْلِ: أَصْل + ـِ — aṣl, origin, root, base (m., gen. as first term of an iḍāfa, after ʿinda); 'the origin of' (with the obscure قَائِهِ)
قَائِهِ: قَائِهِ — qāʾ-, obscure: the print gives قائه; read here as qāʾ + -hi, his (gen. suffix); possibly a misprint for a word meaning 'family' or 'town'; 'his qāʾ(?)'
فَإذَا: فَ + إِذَا — idhā, when, if (conj.); fa-, so, and (conj., links to the preceding clause); 'so when'
هُوَعِنْدَهُمْ: هُوَ + عِنْدَ + هُمْ — printed as one word; huwa, he (pron. 3 m. sg.); ʿinda, at the place of (prep.); -hum, them (m. pl. suffix); 'he, at their place'
وَتَبِيتُ: وَ + تَبِيتُ — bāta, to spend the night (verb, I, hollow, impf. 2 m. sg. indic.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and you will spend the night'
سِتِّى: سِتِّى — sitt, lady, mistress (f., gen.) + -ī, my (1 sg. suffix; printed with final ى); 'my lady' (gen. after maʿa)
رُجُوعِهِ: رُجُوع + هِ — rujūʿ, returning, turning back (m., gen. maṣdar after fī; verb noun of رَجَعَ); -hi, his; 'in his turning back'
دَعْنِي: دَعْ + نِي — daʿ, leave, let (imperative of وَدَعَ, 2 m. sg.); -nī, me (1 sg. object suffix); 'leave me, let me'
أحْتَالَ: أَحْتَالَ — iḥtāla, to contrive, use guile (verb, VIII, hollow, impf. 1 sg., subjunctive as printed with the alif; a jussive would be aḥtal); 'that I contrive'
بِحِيلَةٍ: بِـ + حِيلَة + ٍ — ḥīla, trick, stratagem (f., gen. indef.); bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument); 'with a trick'
أخْرَى: أُخْرَى — ukhrā, another, other (f. sg. of آخَر, gen.; agrees with حِيلَةٍ); 'another'
وَأشَهِّرَهُ: وَ + أُشَهِّرَ + هُ — shahhara, to make notorious, hold up to public shame (verb, II, impf. 1 sg., subjunctive); wa-, and (conj.); -hu, him (object); 'and make him notorious'
وَأخِي: وَ + أَخِي — wa-, and (conj., here introducing a circumstance); akh, brother (m.) + -ī, my (1 sg. suffix); 'and my brother'
جَاءَتْهُ: جَاءَ + تْ + هُ — jāʾa, to come (verb, I, perf. 3 f. sg.); -hu, him (object suffix: 'came to him'); 'she came to him'
وَأخَذَتْ: وَ + أَخَذَتْ — akhadha, to take (verb, I, perf. 3 f. sg. -at); wa-, and (conj.); 'and she took'
أخِي: أَخِي — akh, brother (m., acc., object of أَخَذَتْ) + -ī, my (1 sg. suffix); 'my brother'
رَأَتِ: رَأَتِ — raʾā, to see (verb, I, perf. 3 f. sg. -at; the print rāt has no hamza; the final kasra is the helping vowel before الـ); 'she saw'
بِأخِي: بِـ + أَخِي — bi-, with, at (prep.; after raʾā its sense is hard to define: perhaps 'in the company of' or just pleonastic, so 'saw my brother'); akh, brother + -ī, my; 'seeing my brother'
مُشْتَاقَةٌ: مُشْتَاقَة + ٌ — mushtāqa, longing, yearning (f. sg. active participle of اشْتَاقَ, VIII, nom. indef.); 'longing'
إلَيْكَ: إِلَى + كَ — ilā, to (prep.; with اشْتَاقَ, 'long for, yearn to'); -ka, you (m. sg. suffix); 'for you'
عَجِّلِي: عَجِّلِي — ʿajjala, to hasten, be quick (verb, II, imperative 2 f. sg.); 'hurry (f.)'
بِقُبْلَةٍ: بِ + قُبْلَة + ٍ — qubla, kiss (f., gen. indef.); bi-, with (prep., 'hurry with, bring quickly'); 'with a kiss' Also, after أَنْعَمَ عَلَى, bi- marks the gift bestowed: أَنْعِمْ عَلَيَّ بِقُبْلَةٍ 'grant me a kiss'.
شَئٍ: شَيٍ — shayʾ, thing (m., gen. indef.; the print has شي with no hamza, supplied as a hamza on the yāʾ); 'thing'; 'before every thing', 'before anything else'
إلَّاوَحَضَرَ: إِلَّا + وَ + حَضَرَ — illā, except (particle; the print runs it together with the next word); wa-, and (conj., introduces the sudden event after illā); ḥaḍara, to be present, arrive (verb, I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'except that there came'
لِأخِي: لِ + أَخِي — li-, to (prep., marks the one addressed); akh, brother (m.) + -ī, my (1 sg.); 'to my brother'
الشُّرْطَةِ: الـ + شُّرْطَة + ِ — shurṭa, police (f., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); al-, the (art., assimilated to sh-); ṣāḥib al-shurṭa, 'chief of police'
فَتَضَرَّعَ: فَ + تَضَرَّعَ — taḍarraʿa, to beg humbly, supplicate (verb, V, perf. 3 m. sg.); fa-, so (conj.); 'so he begged'
يَسْمَعْهُ: يَسْمَعْ + هُ — samiʿa, to hear, listen to (verb, I, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, 'did not hear'); -hu, him (object); 'he heard him'
بِالسِّيَاطِ: بِ + الـ + سِّيَاط — siyāṭ, whips (m. pl. of سَوْط, gen.); bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument); al-, the (art.); 'with the whips'
جَمَلًا: جَمَل + ًا — jamal, camel (m., acc. indef.; second object of رَكَّبَ); 'on a camel'; also plain object: akhadha … jamalan, 'he took a camel' (Night 201)
وَدَوْرَةَ: وَ + دَوْرَة + َ — wa-, and (conj.); dawra, a circuit, turn, going-round (f., acc. as printed with ة; the sense is the verb dawwarahu 'he took him round'); 'and a circuit of'
يُنَادُونَ: يُنَادُونَ — nādā, to call, cry out, proclaim (verb, III, impf. 3 m. pl. indic., -ūna 'they'); 'they cry out'
يَهْجُمُ: يَهْجُمُ — hajama, to rush upon, assault, break in (verb, I, impf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'he assaults'
حَرِيمِ: حَرِيم + ِ — ḥarīm, the women's quarters, the inviolable household, the women of a household (m., gen. first term of an iḍāfa); 'the harem of'
وَنُفِيَ: وَ + نُفِيَ — nafā, to banish, expel (verb, I, passive perf. 3 m. sg., 'he was banished'); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he was banished'
فَلَحِقْتُهُ: فَ + لَحِقْتُ + هُ — laḥiqa, to catch up with, overtake (verb, I, perf. 1 sg. -tu); fa-, so, and (conj.); -hu, him (object); 'and I caught up with him'
وَرَدَّتُهُ: وَ + رَدَّتُ + هُ — radda, to turn back, bring back (verb, I, doubled; the print writes it with one د, read raddtuhu; 'I turned him back'); wa-, and (conj.); -tu, I (1 sg. ending); -hu, him (object)
وَأجْلَسْتُهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسْتُ + هُ — ajlasa, to make sit, seat (verb, IV, perf. 1 sg. -tu); wa-, and (conj.); -hu, him (object); 'and I seated him'
الْآنِ: الْآنِ — al-, the (art.) + ān, now, the present moment (m.); the print has الان, with a madda added; after ilā, 'until now, to this day'
أحْسَنْتَ: أَحْسَنْتَ — aḥsana, to do well (verb, IV, perf. 2 m. sg. -ta); 'you have done well'
صَامِتُ: صَامِت + ُ — ṣāmit, silent, the Silent One (m., nom. active participle of صَمَتَ; vocative after yā with a name); 'Silent One'
وَأمَرَ: وَ + أَمَرَ — amara, to command, order (verb, I, perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he ordered'
بِجَائِزَةٍ: بِ + جَائِزَة + ٍ — jāʾiza, prize, reward, gift (f., gen. indef.); bi-, with, of (prep., required by أَمَرَ: 'order [something]'); 'a reward'
وَانْصِرَافٍ: وَ + انْصِرَاف + ٍ — inṣirāf, departure, dismissal, leave to go (m., gen. indef.; verb noun of انْصَرَفَ, VII); wa-, and (conj., second object of bi-); 'and a dismissal'
أقْبَلُ: أَقْبَلُ — qabila, to accept (verb, I, impf. 1 sg. indic.); 'I accept'; lā aqbalu, 'I will not accept'
أحْكِيَ: أَحْكِيَ — ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb, I, defective, impf. 1 sg. subjunctive after an); 'that I relate'
لِبَقِيَّةِ: لِ + بَقِيَّة + ِ — li-, to, for (prep.: after qāla, the one addressed; after verbs of happening, the one it befell) + baqiyya, remainder, rest (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'to the rest of'
إخْوَتِي: إِخْوَة + ِ + ي — ikhwa, brothers (m. pl. of أَخ, gen. second term of an iḍāfa); -ī, my (1 sg. suffix); 'my brothers'
تَحْسِبْ: تَحْسِبْ — ḥasiba, to reckon, think (verb, I, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā of prohibition); 'think'
بَقْبَاتَهْ: بَقْبَاتَهْ — Baqbāta(h), proper name of the second brother (obscure, perhaps a variant of baqbūq, 'babbler'); the final -h is read as a plain sukūn
الْمَفْلُوجُ: الـ + مَفْلُوج — mafluj, paralysed, palsied (m., passive participle of فَلَجَ, nom. predicate); 'the paralysed one'
بِعَجُوزٍ: بِـ + عَجُوز — bi-, with (prep.; after وَإِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears) + ʿajūz, old woman (f., gen. tanwīn); 'and behold, an old woman'
اسْتَقْبَلَتْهُ: اسْتَقْبَلَتْ + هُ — istaqbalat, she met, she came to meet (past, 3rd f. sg., form X of قَبِلَ / قَبَلَ) + -hu, him; 'she had met him'
أَعْرِضَ: أَعْرِضَ — aʿriḍa, I present, I set out (present subjunctive, 1st sg., عَرَضَ, after حَتَّى); 'I present'
أَعْجَبَكَ: أَعْجَبَ + كَ — aʿjaba, it pleased, it delighted (past, 3rd m. sg., form IV of عَجِبَ, with the unspoken subject 'the matter') + -ka, you (object); 'it pleased you'
فَاقْضِهِ: فَ + اقْضِ + هِ — fa-, then (apodosis marker) + iqḍi, carry out, accomplish (imperative, قَضَى) + -hi, it (the linking i of -hi after the kasra); 'then carry it out'
وَاسْتَخِرِاللَّهَ: وَ + اسْتَخِرِ + اللَّه — wa-, and + istakhir, imperative of form X اسْتَخَارَ, ask for the best choice (the kasra is the linking vowel before the article) + Allāh, God (acc. object); 'and ask God for the best choice'
وَأُرْشِدُكَ: وَ + أُرْشِدُ + كَ — wa-, and + urshidu, I guide (present, 1st sg., form IV of رَشَدَ) + -ka, you (object); 'and I guide you'
أِلَيْهِ: إِلَى + هِ — ilā, to (prep.; with أَرْشَدَ, 'to guide to') + -hi, it, him; 'to it'
كَلَامَكِ: كَلَام + كِ — kalām, speech (m., acc. object) + -ki, your (2nd f. sg.); 'your speech'
حَسَنَةٍ: حَسَنَة — ḥasana, beautiful, fine (f., gen., adjective); 'beautiful'
وَرَوْضَةٍ: وَ + رَوْضَة — wa-, and + rawḍa, garden, meadow (f., gen. tanwīn); 'and a garden'
طَيِّبَةٍ: طَيِّبَة — ṭayyiba, good, pleasant (f., gen., adjective); 'pleasant'
مَاؤُهَا: مَاء + هَا — mā', water (m., nom., the printed ماؤها keeps its precomposed hamza) + -hā, her, its; 'its water'
وَفَاكِهَةٍ: وَ + فَاكِهَة — wa-, and + fākiha, fruit (f., gen. tanwīn); 'and fruit'
تُعَانِقُهُ: تُعَانِقُ + هُ — tuʿāniqu, you embrace (present, 2nd m. sg., form III of عَنَقَ) + -hu, him, it (the face); 'you embrace it'
الْخَيْرَ: الـ + خَيْر — khayr, good, goodness (m., acc. object); 'the good'
قَصَدْتِنِي: قَصَدْتِ + نِي — qaṣadti, you aimed at, you chose (past, 2nd f. sg., قَصَدَ) + -nī, me (object); 'you chose me'
أَجْمَعِينَ: أَجْمَعِينَ — ajmaʿīn, all together (m. pl., gen., corroborative adjective); 'all of them'
فَأَيْشْ: فَ + أَيْشْ — fa-, so, then + aysh, what (colloquial contraction of أَيُّ شَيْءٍ); 'so what'
أَعْجَبَكِ: أَعْجَبَ + كِ — aʿjaba, it pleased (past, 3rd m. sg., form IV) + -ki, you (f., object); 'pleased you'
وَاسْكُتْ: وَ + اسْكُتْ — wa-, and + uskut, be silent! (imperative, 2nd m. sg., سَكَتَ; the alif of connection carries no mark); 'and be silent'
وَامْضِ: وَ + امْضِ — wa-, and + imḍi, go! (imperative, 2nd m. sg., مَضَى); 'and go'
تَابِعُهَا: تَابِع + هَا — tābiʿ, following, follower (active participle of تَبِعَ, m., nom. predicate) + -hā, her (object of the participle); 'following her'
طَمَعًا: طَمَعًا — ṭamaʿ, greed, hope of gain (m., acc. of purpose / accusative of cause); 'out of greed'
وَصَفَتْ: وَصَفَتْ — waṣafat, she described (past, 3rd f. sg., وَصَفَ); 'she described'
كَثِيرَةَ: كَثِيرَةَ — kathīra, many, abundant (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'many-of'
الْخَدَمِ: الـ + خَدَم — khadam, servants (collective, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the servants' Also gen. after min, which picks out the group: aḥadan … mina al-khadami, 'any of the servants'.
أَدْنَى: أَدْنَى — adnā, lowest, nearest (elative of دَنَا, gen., diptote); 'the lowest'
ظَرِيفًا: ظَرِيفًا — ẓarīf, elegant, graceful (m., acc. adjective); 'elegant'
اُسْكُتُوا: اُسْكُتُوا — uskutū, be silent! (imperative, 2nd m. pl., سَكَتَ); 'be silent'
تُكَدِّرُوا: تُكَدِّرُوا — tukaddirū, you (pl.) trouble, cloud (jussive after لَا, 2nd m. pl., form II of كَدِرَ); 'do not trouble'
فَأِنَّهُ: فَ + إِنَّ + هُ — fa-, for, because (connective) + inna, indeed (particle, takes the accusative) + -hu, he (3rd m. sg.); 'for he'
صَانِعٌ: صَانِعٌ — ṣāniʿ, craftsman, artisan (m., nom., active participle of صَنَعَ); 'a craftsman' Also as a participle, 'doing, about to do': fa-iṣnaʿ mā anta ṣāniʿun, 'do whatever you mean to do'.
مُحْتَاجُونَ: مُحْتَاجُونَ — muḥtājūna, in need (m. nom. pl., active participle of form VIII احْتَاجَ); 'in need'
مَشَتْ: مَشَتْ — mashat, she walked, she went (past, 3rd f. sg., مَشَى); 'she walked'
غُرْفَةٍ: غُرْفَةٍ — ghurfa, room, chamber (f., gen. tanwīn, after إِلَى from the previous clause); 'a room'
مُزَيَّنَةٍ: مُزَيَّنَةٍ — muzayyana, adorned, decorated (f., gen., passive participle of form II زَيَّنَ); 'adorned'
الْغُرْفَةَ: الـ + غُرْفَة — ghurfa, room (f., acc. object); 'the room'
النِّسْوَانُ: الـ + نِّسْوَان — niswān, women (pl., colloquial/Classical plural of نِسَاء, nom.); 'the women'
وَرَحَّبْنَ: وَ + رَحَّبْنَ — wa-, and + raḥḥabna, they welcomed (past, 3rd f. pl., form II of رَحُبَ); 'and they welcomed'
بِجَنْبِهِمْ: بِـ + جَنْب + هِمْ — bi-, at, by (prep., 'at, beside') + janb, side (m., gen.) + -him, their (3rd m. pl. used for women); 'at their side'
يَلْبَثْ: يَلْبَثْ — yalbath, he lingers (jussive, 3rd m. sg., لَبِثَ); 'lingered'
أِذْ: إِذْ — idh, when, at the time that (conj.); 'when'
جَلَبَةً: جَلَبَةً — jalaba, clamour, uproar (f., acc. object, indef.); 'a clamour'
بِجَوَارٍ: بِـ + جَوَارٍ — bi-, with (prep.; after وَإِذَا of surprise only marks what appears) + jawārin, girls, slave-girls (pl. of جَارِيَة, gen. tanwīn, defective); 'with girls, and behold girls'
أَقْبَلْنَ: أَقْبَلْنَ — aqbalna, they came forward, they approached (past, 3rd f. pl., form IV of قَبَلَ); 'came forward'
وَسْطِهِنَّ: وَسْط + هِنَّ — wasṭ, middle (m., gen.) + -hinna, them (3rd f. pl.); 'amid them'
أِلَيْهَا: إِلَى + هَا — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + -hā, her; 'toward her'
وَخَدَمَهَا: وَ + خَدَمَ + هَا — wa-, and + khadama, he served (past, 3rd m. sg., خَدَمَ) + -hā, her (object); 'and served her, paid her homage'
فَرَحَّبَتْ: فَ + رَحَّبَتْ — fa-, so + raḥḥabat, she welcomed (past, 3rd f. sg., form II); 'so she welcomed'
وَأَمَرَتْهُ: وَ + أَمَرَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + amarat, she ordered, commanded (past, 3rd f. sg., أَمَرَ) + -hu, him (object); 'and ordered him'
أَعَزَّكَ: أَعَزَّ + كَ — aʿazza, he made mighty, he honoured (past, 3rd m. sg., form IV of عَزَّ, optative) + -ka, you; 'may he honour you'
الْخَيْرُ: الـ + خَيْر — khayr, good (m., nom., subject); 'the good'
أَمَرَتْ: أَمَرَتْ — amarat, she ordered (past, 3rd f. sg.); 'she ordered'
وَالْجَارِيَةُ: وَ + الْ + جَارِيَة — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + al-, the + jāriya, girl (f., nom.); 'while the girl'
لَاتَهْتَدِي: لَا + تَهْتَدِي — lā, not (negative) + tahtadī, she is guided, she finds the way (present, 3rd f. sg., form VIII اهْتَدَى); printed as one word; 'is not guided'
وَتُظْهِرُ: وَ + تُظْهِرُ — wa-, and + tuẓhiru, she shows, she displays (present, 3rd f. sg., form IV of ظَهَرَ); 'and she showed'
الْمَوَدَّةَ: الـ + مَوَدَّة — mawadda, affection, love (f., acc. object); 'the affection'
وَتَمْزَحُ: وَ + تَمْزَحُ — wa-, and + tamzaḥu, she jokes, she teases (present, 3rd f. sg., مَزَحَ); 'and she joked'
وَأَخِى: وَ + أَخِى — wa-, and, while + akh, brother (m., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'while my brother'
يَفْهَمُ: يَفْهَمُ — yafhamu, he understands (present, 3rd m. sg., فَهِمَ); 'understands'
الشَّوْقُ: الـ + شَّوْق — shawq, longing, yearning (m., nom., subject); 'longing'
يَعْتَقِدُأَنَّ: يَعْتَقِدُ + أَنَّ — yaʿtaqidu, he believes (present, 3rd m. sg., form VIII اعْتَقَدَ) + anna, that (particle); printed as one word; 'he believes that'
تُبَلِّغُهُ: تُبَلِّغُ + هُ — tuballighu, she brings, she conveys (present, 3rd f. sg., form II of بَلَغَ) + -hu, him; 'will bring him'
مُنَاهُ: مُنَا + هُ — munā, desires, wishes (pl. of مُنْيَة / مُنًى, here acc. after إِلَى) + -hu, his; 'his desire'
عَشْرُ: عَشْر — ʿashr, ten (f. numeral, first term of an iḍāfa, nom.); 'ten of'
أَقْمَارٌ: أَقْمَارٌ — aqmār, moons (pl. of قَمَر, nom. predicate); 'moons'
وَبِأَيْدِيهِنَّ: وَ + بِـ + أَيْدِي + هِنَّ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + bi-, in, with (prep.; here 'in their hands') + aydī, hands (pl. of يَد, gen., defective) + -hinna, their (3rd f. pl.); 'and in their hands'
الْعِيدَانُ: الـ + عِيدَان — ʿīdān, lutes (pl. of عُود, nom.); 'the lutes'
ذَوَاتُ: ذَوَات — dhawāt, possessors of (f. pl. of ذُو, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'having, with'
الْأَوْتَارِ: الـ + أَوْتَار — awtār, strings (pl. of وَتَر, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the strings'
فَجَعَلْنَ: فَ + جَعَلْنَ — fa-, so + jaʿalna, they began (past, 3rd f. pl., جَعَلَ, as an auxiliary 'begin to'); 'so they began'
يُغَنِّينَ: يُغَنِّينَ — yughanninā, they sing (present, 3rd f. pl., form II of غَنَّى); 'to sing'
صَوْتٍ: صَوْتٍ — ṣawt, voice, tune, song (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'tune'
شَجِيٍّ: شَجِيٍّ — shajiyy, melancholy, touching, plaintive (m., gen., adjective); 'plaintive'
فَغَلَبَ: فَ + غَلَبَ — fa-, so + ghalaba, it overcame (past, 3rd m. sg.); 'so it overcame'
وَتَنَاوَلَ: وَ + تَنَاوَلَ — wa-, and + tanāwala, he took, he reached for (past, 3rd m. sg., form VI); 'and he took'
قَدَحًا: قَدَحًا — qadaḥ, cup, drinking-cup (m., acc. object, indef.); 'a cup'
فَشَرِبَهُ: فَ + شَرِبَ + هُ — fa-, and then + shariba, he drank (past, 3rd m. sg., شَرِبَ) + -hu, it; 'and he drank it'
صِحَّةً: صِحَّةً — ṣiḥḥa, health (f., acc., elliptical wish: 'health!'); 'health!'; also acc. indef. object of a verb (mā ʿaraftu ṣiḥḥatan, 'I never knew health')
أَسْقَتْهُ: أَسْقَتْ + هُ — asqat, she gave to drink (past, 3rd f. sg., form IV of سَقَى) + -hu, him (object); 'she gave him to drink'
وَصَفَعَتْهُ: وَ + صَفَعَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + ṣafaʿat, she slapped (past, 3rd f. sg., صَفَعَ) + -hu, him; 'and she slapped him'
خُرُوجٍ: خُرُوجٍ — khurūj, going out, exit (m., verbal noun of خَرَجَ, gen. tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa); 'a going-out'
فَتَبِعَتْهُ: فَ + تَبِعَتْ + هُ — fa-, so + tabiʿat, she followed (past, 3rd f. sg., تَبِعَ) + -hu, him; 'so she followed him'
تَغْمِزُهُ: تَغْمِزُ + هُ — taghmizu, she winks, she signals (present, 3rd f. sg., غَمَزَ) + -hu, him; 'to wink at him'
ارْجِعْ: ارْجِعْ — irjiʿ, go back! (imperative, 2nd m. sg., رَجَعَ); 'go back'
فَأَمَرَتْهُ: فَ + أَمَرَتْ + هُ — fa-, so + amarat, she ordered (past, 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'so she ordered him'
يَنْطِقْ: يَنْطِقْ — yanṭiq, he speaks (jussive, 3rd m. sg., نَطَقَ); 'speak'
فَعَادَتِ: فَ + عَادَتِ — fa-, so + ʿādat, she/it returned (past, 3rd f. sg., عَادَ; the kasra is the linking vowel before the article); 'so it returned'
الصَّفْعُ: الـ + صَّفْع — ṣafʿ, slapping, a slap (m., verbal noun of صَفَعَ, nom., subject); 'the slapping'
كَفَاهَا: كَفَا + هَا — kafā, it sufficed (past, 3rd m. sg., كَفَى) + -hā, her (object); 'sufficed her'
يَصْفَعُوهُ: يَصْفَعُوا + هُ — yaṣfaʿū, they slap (subjunctive, 3rd m. pl., صَفَعَ, after أَنْ) + -hu, him; 'that they slap him'
لِلْعَجُوزِ: لِـ + الْ + عَجُوز — li-, to (prep., marks the person spoken to) + al-, the + ʿajūz, old woman (f., gen.); 'to the old woman'
فَتَقُولُ: فَ + تَقُولُ — fa-, and so + taqūlu, she says (present, 3rd f. sg., قَالَ); 'and she says'
وَحَقِّكِ: وَ + حَقّ + كِ — wa-, by (preposition of oath) + ḥaqq, right, truth (m., gen.) + -ki, your (2nd f. sg.); 'by your right'
مَوْلَاتِي: مَوْلَاتِي — mawlāt, mistress, lady (f., voc. in the iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my lady'
فَصَفَعَتْهُ: فَـ + صَفَعَتْ + هُ — ṣafaʿa, to slap, smack (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect; the subject is the maids) + -hu, him; fa-, and so, then (links the sequence); 'and so they slapped him'
الْجَوَارِإِلَى: الـ + جَوَارِ(ي) + إِلَى — jāriya, girl, slave-girl, maid (f.; pl. jawārī, the print drops the final yā', the kasra stands for it; nom. subject) + ilā, to, until (prep.); two printed words run together: 'the maids, until'
حَاجَتِهِ: حَاجَة + هِ — ḥāja, need, want, necessity (f., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his need' (qaḍāʾ al-ḥāja is the polite phrase for relieving oneself)
تَبْلُغْ: balagha, to reach, attain (form I, 2nd m. sg. imperfect jussive, as the result of the imperative before it); 'you will reach'
أَهَاأَخِي: أَهَا + أَخِي — ahā, ah! (interjection, probably) + akh, brother (m.) + -ī, my; 'ah, my brother' (two words run together; the form is uncertain)
الصَّفْعِ: الـ + صَفْع — ṣafʿ, slapping, smacking (m. verbal noun, gen. after min); 'the slapping'
سَكِرَتْ: sakira, to be drunk (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect, referring to the lady); 'she is drunk, she gets drunk'
مُرَادَكَ: مُرَاد + كَ — murād, aim, wish, what one wants (m., acc., from arāda) + -ka, your; 'your desire'
فَأَمَرَتْهُمْ: فَـ + أَمَرَتْ + هُمْ — amara, to command, order (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hum, them (m. pl.); fa-, and so, then; 'and so she ordered them'
يُبَخِّرُوهُ: يُبَخِّرُوا + هُ — bakhkhara, to fumigate with incense (form II, 3rd m. pl. imperfect subjunctive after an, final nūn dropped) + -hu, him; 'that they perfume him with incense'
يَرُشُّوا: rashsha, to sprinkle (form I, 3rd m. pl. imperfect subjunctive after an); 'that they sprinkle'
الْمَا: الـ + مَا(ء) — māʾ, water (m.; the print drops the hamza); 'the water' (first term of the iḍāfa al-mā wardin, 'rose-water')
فَفَعَلْنَ: فَـ + فَعَلْنَ — faʿala, to do (form I, 3rd f. pl. perfect, the maids); fa-, and so, then; 'and so they did'
مَنْزِلِى: مَنْزِل + ى — manzil, house, dwelling (m., acc. object) + -ī, my (the print writes the ending with ى); 'my house'
وَصَبَرْتَ: وَ + صَبَرْتَ — ṣabara, to be patient, endure (form I, 2nd m. sg. perfect); wa-, and; 'and you have been patient'
شَرْطِي: شَرْط + ي — sharṭ, condition, stipulation (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; 'my condition'
طَرَدْتُهُ: طَرَدْتُ + هُ — ṭarada, to drive out, expel (form I, 1st sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'I drove him out'
مُرَادَهُ: مُرَاد + هُ — murād, aim, wish (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his desire'
طَبَقَةِ: ṭabaqa, layer, stratum, rank (f., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the layer of'
يَدِكِ: يَد + كِ — yad, hand (f., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa) + -ki, your (f.); 'your hand'
أَشْغَفَنِي: أَشْغَفَ + نِي — ashghafa, to make passionately fond (form IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect, causative of shaghafa) + -nī, me; 'he made me passionately fond'
أَطَاعَنِي: أَطَاعَ + نِي — aṭāʿa, to obey (form IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'he obeyed me'
نَالَ: nāla, to obtain, get (form I, 3rd m. sg. perfect, answer to man); 'he obtains'
مَايُرِيدُ: مَا + يُرِيدُ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + arāda, to want (form IV, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative); 'what he wants' (two words printed as one)
أَمَرَتِ: amara, to command, order (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect, with kasra before the article); 'she ordered'
الْجَوَارِأَنْ: الـ + جَوَارِ(ي) + أَنْ — jāriya, girl, maid (f.; pl. jawārī, the final yā' dropped in print) + an, that (conj. with the subjunctive); 'the maids, that' (two words printed as one)
بِأَصْوَاتٍ: بِـ + أَصْوَات — ṣawt, voice, sound (m.; pl. aṣwāt, gen. tanwīn); bi-, with (prep. of means or manner); 'with voices'; after وَإِذَا of surprise the bi- only marks what appears: wa-idhā bi-aṣwātin, 'and behold, voices'
طَرِبَ: ṭariba, to be moved with delight, to be stirred by music (form I, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'was stirred with delight'
الْمَجْلِسُ: الـ + مَجْلِس — majlis, sitting-place, assembly, company (m., nom.); 'the company, the assembly'
سَيِّدَكِ: سَيِّد + كِ — sayyid, master, lord (m., acc. object) + -ki, your (f. sg., the maid addressed); 'your master'
وَاقْضِي: وَ + اقْضِي — qaḍā, to fulfil, accomplish (form I, f. sg. imperative); wa-, and; 'and fulfil'
وَائْتِينِي: وَ + ائْتِي + نِي — atā, to come (form I, f. sg. imperative, ʾtī, 'come with' means 'bring') + -nī, me; wa-, and; 'and bring me'
أَخِى: أَخ + ى — akh, brother (m., acc. object) + -ī, my (the print writes ى); 'my brother'
لَايَدْرِي: لَا + يَدْرِي — lā, not (negative) + darā, to know (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative); 'not knowing' (two words printed as one)
فَرَاقَ: فَـ + رَاقَ — rāqa, to be clear, bright, pleasing (form I, 3rd m. sg. perfect); fa-, and so; 'and (it) cleared'
فَدَيْتُكَ: فَدَيْتُ + كَ — fadā, to ransom (form I, 1st sg. perfect, as a wish or endearment) + -ka, you; 'I would ransom you, I would give my life for you'
تَصْبُغُ: ṣabagha, to dye (form I, 3rd f. sg. imperfect indicative); 'she dyes'
حَوَاجِبَكَ: حَوَاجِب + كَ — ḥājib, eyebrow (m.; pl. ḥawājib, acc. object) + -ka, your; 'your eyebrows'
وَتَقُصُّ: وَ + تَقُصُّ — qaṣṣa, to clip, trim (form I, 3rd f. sg. imperfect indicative); wa-, and; 'and she clips'
سِبَالَكَ: سِبَال + كَ — sibāl, moustache hairs, whiskers (m. pl. of sabala, acc. object) + -ka, your; 'your moustache'
صَبْغُ: ṣabgh, dyeing (m. verbal noun, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the dyeing of'
الْحَوَاجِبِ: الـ + حَوَاجِب — ḥājib, eyebrow (m.; pl. ḥawājib, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the eyebrows'
فَيَزُولُ: فَـ + يَزُولُ — zāla, to pass away, disappear (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative); fa-, then, so (opens the comment after ammā); 'then it passes away'
بِالْغَسْلِ: بِـ + الـ + غَسْل — ghasl, washing (m. verbal noun, gen.); bi-, with, by means of (prep. of means); 'by the washing, with washing'
نَتْفُ: natf, plucking (m. verbal noun, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the plucking of'
السِّبَالِ: الـ + سِبَال — sibāl, moustache hairs (m. pl., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the moustache'
يُؤْلِمُ: ālama, to hurt, pain (form IV, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative, yuʾlimu; the print gives the damma but not the hamza); 'it hurts'
تُخَالِفَهَا: تُخَالِفَ + هَا — khālafa, to oppose, cross (form III, 2nd m. sg. imperfect, subjunctive as if after an) + -hā, her; 'lest you cross her'
فَصَبَرَ: فَـ + صَبَرَ — ṣabara, to be patient, endure (form I, 3rd m. sg. perfect); fa-, and so, then; 'and so he endured'; here: with ʿalā, 'to wait patiently over, tend'
صُبِغَتْ: ṣabagha, to dye (form I passive, 3rd f. sg. perfect); 'was dyed'
حَوَاجِبُهُ: حَوَاجِب + هُ — ḥājib, eyebrow (m.; pl. ḥawājib, nom. subject of the passive) + -hu, his; 'his eyebrows'
وَنُتِفَتْ: وَ + نُتِفَتْ — natafaa, to pluck (form I passive, 3rd f. sg. perfect); wa-, and; 'and was plucked'
سِبَالُهُ: سِبَال + هُ — sibāl, moustache hairs (m. pl., nom. subject of the passive) + -hu, his; 'his moustache'
وَمَضَتِ: وَ + مَضَتِ — maḍā, to go away, go on (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect, with kasra before the article); wa-, and; 'and went'
وَأَخْبَرَتْهَا: وَ + أَخْبَرَتْ + هَا — akhbara, to inform (form IV, 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hā, her; wa-, and; 'and she informed her'
تَحْلِقِي: ḥalaqa, to shave (form I, 2nd f. sg. imperfect subjunctive after an, final nūn dropped); 'that you shave'
ذَقْنَهُ: ذَقْن + هُ — dhaqn, chin, beard (m., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his chin, his beard'
يَصِيرَ: ṣāra, to become (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect subjunctive after ḥattā); 'he becomes'
أَمْرَدًا: amrad, beardless, smooth-faced (adj., acc. tanwīn, predicate of ṣāra); 'beardless'
وَأَخْبَرَتْهُ: وَ + أَخْبَرَتْ + هُ — akhbara, to inform (form IV, 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; wa-, and; 'and she informed him'
سَيِّدَتُهَا: سَيِّدَة + هَا — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., nom. subject) + -hā, her; 'her mistress'
الْأَحْمَقُ: الـ + أَحْمَق — aḥmaq, foolish, a fool (m., nom., in apposition to akhī); 'the fool'
فَضِيحَتِي: فَضِيحَة + ي — faḍīḥa, disgrace, scandal (f., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my disgrace'; here: after yā, a cry: fa-yā faḍīḥatī, 'oh, my disgrace!'
لِتَبْقَى: لِـ + تَبْقَى — baqiya, to remain (form I, 2nd m. sg. imperfect subjunctive); li-, in order that, so that (introduces a purpose clause with the subjunctive); 'so that you remain'
ذَقَنٍ: dhaqan, chin, beard (m., gen. tanwīn after bi-lā); 'a beard'
يَبْقَى: baqiya, to remain (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative); 'remains'
يَشُكُّهَا: يَشُكُّ + هَا — shakka, to pierce, prick (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect indicative; the print has no shadda, the other possibility is 'make her doubt') + -hā, her; 'pricks her'
فَاصْبِرْ: فَـ + اصْبِرْ — ṣabara, to be patient (form I, m. sg. imperative); fa-, so, then; 'so be patient'
الْمُنَا: الـ + مُنَا — munā, wishes, desires (f. pl. of munya; the print writes alif, classical al-munā); 'the wishes'
وَطَاوَعَ: وَ + طَاوَعَ — ṭāwaʿa, to obey, comply with (form III, 3rd m. sg. perfect); wa-, and; 'and he complied with'
وَأَخْرَجَتْهُ: وَ + أَخْرَجَتْ + هُ — akhraja, to bring out (form IV, 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; wa-, and; 'and she brought him out'
مَخْضُوبُ: makhḍūb, dyed (passive participle of khaḍaba, m., nom. predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'dyed of'
الْحَاجِبَيْنِ: الـ + حَاجِبَيْنِ — ḥājib, eyebrow (m., dual gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the two eyebrows'
مَقْصُوصُ: maqṣūṣ, clipped, trimmed (passive participle of qaṣṣa, m., nom. predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'clipped of'
الشَّارِبَيْنِ: الـ + شَارِبَيْنِ — shārib, moustache (m., dual gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the two moustaches'
مَحْلُوقُ: maḥlūq, shaved (passive participle of ḥalaqa, m., nom. predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'shaved of'
الذَّقْنِ: الـ + ذَّقْن — dhaqn, chin, beard (m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the chin'
مُحْمَرُّ: muḥmarr, reddened, red (participle of iḥmarra, m., nom. predicate, first term of an iḍāfa); 'red of'
فَفَزِعَتْ: فَـ + فَزِعَتْ — faziʿa, to be frightened, startled (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect); fa-, and so, then; 'and so she was startled'
اسْتَلْقَتْ: istalqā, to lie on one's back, fall backwards (form X, 3rd f. sg. perfect); 'she fell on her back'
قَفَاهَا: قَفَا + هَا — qafā, nape, back of the neck (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her nape'
مَلَكْتَنِي: مَلَكْتَ + نِي — malaka, to possess, take possession of (form I, 2nd m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'you have possessed me'
الْأَخْلَاقِ: الـ + أَخْلَاق — akhlāq, character, manners, qualities (m. pl. of khuluq, gen. after bi-); 'the qualities'
حَلَّفَتْهُ: حَلَّفَتْ + هُ — ḥallafa, to make swear, put on oath (form II, 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'she made him swear'
بِحَيَاتِهَا: بِـ + حَيَاة + هَا — ḥayāt, life (f., gen. after bi-) + -hā, her; bi-, by (the oath preposition); 'by her life'
يَقُومَ: qāma, to rise, stand up (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect subjunctive after an); 'that he rise'
وَيَرْقُصَ: وَ + يَرْقُصَ — raqaṣa, to dance (form I, 3rd m. sg. imperfect subjunctive after an); wa-, and; 'and dance'
وَرَقَصَ: وَ + رَقَصَ — raqaṣa, to dance (form I, 3rd m. sg. perfect); wa-, and; 'and he danced'
تَدَعْ: wadaʿa, to leave (form I, 3rd f. sg. imperfect jussive after lam, hollow-root shortened); 'she left'
مِخَدَّةً: mikhadda, cushion, pillow (f., acc. tanwīn); 'a cushion'
يَضْرِبُونَهُ: يَضْرِبُونَ + هُ — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (form I, 3rd m. pl. imperfect indicative) + -hu, him; 'they beat him'
نَارَنْجَةٍ: nāranja, bitter orange, orange (f., gen. tanwīn, second term of the iḍāfa); 'an orange'
وَلَيْمُونَةٍ: وَ + لَيْمُونَة — laymūna, lemon (f., gen. tanwīn); wa-, and; 'and a lemon'
الرَّجْمِ: الـ + رَّجْم — rajm, stoning, pelting (m. verbal noun, gen., coordinated with al-ḍarb); 'the pelting'
فَقَلٰتْ: فَـ + قَلٰتْ — qāla, to say (form I, 3rd f. sg. perfect; the print spells it قلت without the alif, which we mark with the dagger alif, 'qālat'); fa-, and so, then; 'and so she said'
عَادَتِنَا: عَادَة + نَا — ʿāda, custom, habit (f., gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'our custom'
لَاتُمَكِّنُ: لَا + تُمَكِّنُ — lā, not (negative) + makkana, to enable, give power or access to (form II, 3rd f. sg. imperfect indicative); 'she does not give access to' (two words printed as one)
تَقْلَعَ: qalaʿa, to pull off, strip off (form I, 3rd f. sg. imperfect subjunctive after ḥattā); 'she strips off'
سَرَاوِيلَهَا: سَرَاوِيل + هَا — sarāwīl, trousers, drawers (f. pl., acc. object, diptote) + -hā, her; 'her drawers'
زَلَطًا: zalaṭ, bare, stark (colloquial, acc. tanwīn; the vowelling is our guess); 'stark'
تَأْمُرُكَ: تَأْمُرُ + كَ — amara, to command, order (form I, 3rd f. sg. imperfect indicative) + -ka, you; 'she orders you'
بِقَلْعِ: بِـ + قَلْع — qalʿ, stripping off, removal (m. verbal noun, gen.); bi-, to, with (prep.; amara bi-, 'order to do'); 'to strip off'
ثِيَابِكَ: ثِيَاب + كَ — thawb, garment (m.; pl. thiyāb, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa) + -ka, your; 'your clothes'
فَتُمَكِّنُكَ: فَـ + تُمَكِّنُ + كَ — makkana, to enable, give power or access to (form II, 3rd f. sg. imperfect indicative; the print has the shadda) + -ka, you; fa-, and so, then; 'and so she gives you access'
اقْلَعْ: qalaʿa, to pull off, strip off (form I, m. sg. imperative; hamzat al-waṣl); 'strip off'
ثِيَابَكَ: ثِيَاب + كَ — thawb, garment (m.; pl. thiyāb, acc. object) + -ka, your; 'your clothes'
عُرْيَانًا: ʿuryān, naked (adj., m., acc. tanwīn, predicate of baqiya); 'naked'
ال—ب—اح: الـ + [...] — the printed fragment of al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted' (m. passive participle of abāḥa, the usual rhyme with al-ṣabāḥ); the dashes and missing letters are the edition's; 'the permitted (speech)'
ب: ب — the middle fragment of ال—ب—اح, a damaged printing of al-mubāḥ (see that entry); the letter bāʾ, left unpointed
السَّعِيدَأَنَّ: الـ + سَعِيد + أَنَّ — saʿīd, fortunate, happy; anna, that (conj.); 'the fortunate, that'. The print runs the two words together.
أَخٰ: أَخٰ — akh, brother; accusative after anna, with the alif of أخا missing in the print (supplied as a dagger alif)
اِقْلَعْ: اِقْلَعْ — qalaʿa, pull off, take off; imperative (m.s.) 'take off'
فَقَلَعَ: فَـ + قَلَعَ — fa-, and then; qalaʿa, pull off (3 m.s. perfect); 'and he took off'
وَاجْرِ: وَ + اجْرِ — wa-, and; jarā, run; imperative (m.s.), 'and run'
وَأَجْرِي: وَ + أَجْرِي — wa-, and; jarā, run; 1 s. imperfect, 'and I run'
تَعَرَّتْ: تَعَرَّتْ — taʿarrā, strip oneself (form V); 3 f.s. perfect, 'she stripped'
فَتَبِعَهَا: فَـ + تَبِعَ + هَا — fa-, and then; tabiʿa, follow; 3 m.s. perfect; -hā, her; 'and he followed her'
وَزُبُّهُ: وَ + زُبّ + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'with ...'); zubb, penis; -hu, his; 'and his penis'
قَائِمٌ: قَائِم — qāʾim, standing, upright (active participle of qāma)
مُظْلِمٍ: مُظْلِم — muẓlim, dark (active participle of aẓlama)
فَدَاسَ: فَـ + دَاسَ — fa-, and then; dāsa, tread on, trample; 3 m.s. perfect
رَقِيقًا: رَقِيق — raqīq, thin, flimsy; accusative tanwīn (adjective of mawḍiʿan)
فَانْخَسَفَ: فَـ + انْخَسَفَ — fa-, and then; inkhasafa (form VII), cave in, give way; 3 m.s. perfect
الْجَلَّادِينَ: الـ + جَلَّادِين — jallād, dealer in hides and skins (from jild, hide; also 'flogger'); genitive plural
الْجُلُودِ: الـ + جُلُود — julūd, hides (pl. of jild)
وَيَشْتَرُونَ: وَ + يَشْتَرُونَ — wa-, and; ishtarā (form VIII), buy; 3 m.pl. imperfect
وَيَبِيعُونَ: وَ + يَبِيعُونَ — wa-, and; bāʿa, sell; 3 m.pl. imperfect
قَائِمُ: قَائِمُ — qāʾim, standing; first term of the annexation قَائِمُ الْأَيْرِ 'standing of penis'
الْأَيْرِ: الـ + أَيْر — ayr, penis (a blunt word); genitive in annexation
اللِّحَيْنِ: الـ + لِحَيْن — liḥayn, read as a dual 'the two sides of the beard' (cheeks and jaws); possibly a misprint for لِحْيَة 'beard'; genitive after maḥlūq
صَاحُوا: صَاحُوا — ṣāḥa, shout, cry out; 3 m.pl. perfect
بِالْجُلُودِ: بِـ + الـ + جُلُود — bi-, with (instrument); julūd, hides; 'with the hides'
وَحَمَلُوهُ: وَ + حَمَلُوا + هُ — wa-, and; ḥamala, carry; 3 m.pl. perfect + -hu, him
وَدَّوْهُ: وَدَّوْا + هُ — waddā (form II), take, bring (colloquial); 3 m.pl. perfect (plural alif dropped before the suffix) + -hu, him; 'they took him'
فَصَفَعَهُ: فَـ + صَفَعَ + هُ — fa-, and then; ṣafaʿa, slap, strike; 3 m.s. perfect + -hu, him
دِرَّةٍ: دِرَّة — dirra, whip, lash (the strap used for flogging)
نَفَاهُ: نَفَى + هُ — nafā, banish, exile; 3 m.s. perfect + -hu, him (ثُمَّ نَفَاهُ 'then he banished him')
وَأَدْخَلْتُهُ: وَ + أَدْخَلْتُ + هُ — wa-, and; adkhala (form IV), make enter, bring in; 1 s. perfect + -hu, him
رَتَّبْتُ: رَتَّبْتُ — rattaba (form II), arrange, appoint; 1 s. perfect, 'I arranged'
يَقْتَاتُ: يَقْتَاتُ — iqtāta (form VIII), live on, subsist; 3 m.s. imperfect; takes bi- for what sustains
أَحْتَمِلُ: أَحْتَمِلُ — iḥtamala (form VIII), bear, endure; 1 s. imperfect
فَاسْمُهُ: فَـ + اسْم + هُ — fa-, then (answers ammā); ism, name; -hu, his; 'then his name'
فَسَاقَهُ: فَـ + سَاقَ + هُ — fa-, and so; sāqa, drive, lead; 3 m.s. perfect + -hu, him
يُكَلِّمَهُ: يُكَلِّمَ + هُ — kallama (form II), speak to; 3 m.s. subjunctive after an + -hu, him
فَيَسْأَ: فَـ + يَسْأَ — fa-, so (followed by the subjunctive, giving the result); saʾala, ask; 3 m.s. subjunctive. The print cuts the word فيسأله after the hamza; the pronoun is the next word.
يُكَلِّمْهُ: يُكَلِّمْ + هُ — kallama (form II), speak to, answer; 3 m.s. jussive after lam + -hu, him
فَسَمِعَهُ: فَـ + سَمِعَ + هُ — fa-, and so; samiʿa, hear; 3 m.s. perfect + -hu, him
عَالِي: عَالِي — ʿālī, loud, high (printed with the full yā; Classical عَالٍ)
مَشْيَهُ: مَشْي + هُ — mashy, walking, footsteps; -hu, his; 'his walking'
ضَرِيرٌ: ضَرِير — ḍarīr, blind (also 'afflicted'); the polite word for a blind person
فَنَا: فَـ + نَا — the first part of فَنَاوَلَهُ 'and he handed him', split by the print: fa-, and then; nāwala, hand, give
يُعْطِيهِ: يُعْطِي + هِ — aʿṭā (form IV), give; 3 m.s. imperfect + -hi, him; 'he gives him'
شَيْــأً: شَيْأً — shayʾ, thing; accusative tanwīn, 'something'. The print has an elongation stroke (ـ) inside the word.
فَأَدْخَلَهُ: فَـ + أَدْخَلَ + هُ — fa-, and then; adkhala (form IV), make enter; 3 m.s. perfect + -hu, him
يَصْعَدُ: يَصْعَدُ — ṣaʿida, ascend, climb; 3 m.s. imperfect; bihi 'taking him up'
سُطُوحٍ: سُطُوح — suṭūḥ, roofs (pl. of saṭḥ); genitive plural
يُطْعِمُهُ: يُطْعِمُ + هُ — aṭʿama (form IV), feed; 3 m.s. imperfect + -hu, him
انْتَهَى: انْتَهَى — intahā (form VIII), come to an end, arrive; 3 m.s. perfect
ضَرِيرُ: ضَرِيرُ — ḍarīr, blind man; vocative, 'O blind man'
تَقُــولُ: تَقُولُ — qāla, say; 2 m.s. imperfect, 'you say'; the print puts an elongation stroke (ـ) inside the word
أَسْفَلُ: أَسْفَلُ — asfal, lower, below (elative of سافل; adv., diptote); 'below'
سَفِلَةُ: سَفِلَة — safila, the base, riffraff (collective; nom. after يَا); 'O scum'
السَّلَا: الـ + سَلَا — al-, the; first half of سلالم, salālim, stairs (plural of سُلَّم), split by the print; 'the stairs (first half)'
لِمِ: لِمِ — second half of سلالم, salālim, stairs, with the genitive ending after إِلَى; '(stairs, second half)'
الطَّرِيقُ: الـ + طَرِيق — al-, the; ṭarīq, road, way (m., nom.); 'the way'
فَزَلِقَتْ: فَـ + زَلِقَتْ — zaliqa, he slipped (verb I, perfect 3 f. sg.; -at, she/it); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and slipped'
رِجْلُهُ: رِجْل + هُ — rijl, foot, leg (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his foot'
فَلَحِقَهُ: فَـ + لَحِقَ + هُ — laḥiqa, he caught up with (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.; takes a direct object) + -hu, him; fa-, and, then (conj.); 'and caught up with him'
رُفْقَتِهِ: رُفْقَة + هِ — rufqa, company, companions (f., collective, gen. in annexation) + -hi, his; 'his company'
الْعُمْيَانُ: الـ + عُمْيَان — al-, the; ʿumyān, blind ones (plural of أَعْمَى), nom. in apposition; 'the blind'
فَحَدَّثَهُمْ: فَـ + حَدَّثَ + هُمْ — ḥaddatha, he told (verb II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and he told them'
أُخْرِجَ: أُخْرِجَ — akhraja, I took out (verb IV, subjunctive 1 sg. after أَنْ); 'I take out'
بَقِيَتْ: بَقِيَتْ — baqiya, it remained (verb I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'remained'
وَأُنْفِقَ: و + أُنْفِقَ — wa-, and (conj.); anfaqa, I spend (verb IV, subjunctive 1 sg., continues أَنْ); 'and I spend'
الدَّارِتَا: الـ + دَار + تَا — al-, the; dār, house (f., gen.); tā, the first syllable of تَابِعَهُ, printed attached to this word; 'the house' (+ tā-)
بِعَهُ: بِعَ + هُ — rest of تَابِعَهُ, tābiʿahu: tābiʿ, following (active participle of تبع, acc. in annexation) + -hu, him; 'following him'
وَسَامِعَ: و + سَامِعَ — wa-, and (conj.); sāmiʿ, hearing (active participle of سمع, acc. in annexation, annexed to the next noun); 'and listening to'
بِالرَّجُلِ: بِـ + الـ + رَجُل — bi-, of (prep.; دَرَى بِـ 'be aware of', the verb chooses the preposition); al-, the; rajul, man (m.); 'of the man'
وَرَفِيقِهِ: و + رَفِيق + هِ — wa-, and (conj.); rafīq, companion (m., gen., joined to the man by و) + -hi, his; 'and his companion'
لَايَشْعُرُ: لَا + يَشْعُرُ — lā, not (negative particle) + yashʿuru, he is aware (shaʿara, verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg.), printed as one word; 'he does not notice'
رُفَقَاءَهُ: رُفَقَاء + هُ — rufaqāʾ, companions (plural of رَفِيق, acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his companions'
اغْلِقُوا: اغْلِقُوا — aghlaqa, he locked (verb IV; here imperative 2 m. pl. with a connecting alif); 'lock'
وَفَتِّشُوا: و + فَتِّشُوا — wa-, and (conj.); fattasha, he searched (verb II, imperative 2 m. pl.); 'and search'
كَيْلَا: كَيْ + لَا — kay, so that (conj.; takes the subjunctive) + lā, not; 'so that not, lest'
فَلَمَّــا: فَـ + لَمَّا — lammā, when (conj. with the perfect; the print stretches it with a tatweel); fa-, and (conj.); 'and when'
بِحَبْلٍ: بِـ + حَبْل — bi-, to, on (prep.; تَعَلَّقَ بِـ 'cling to', the verb chooses the preposition); ḥabl, rope (m., gen. indef.); 'to a rope'
السَّقْفِ: الـ + سَقْف — al-, the; saqf, ceiling, roof (m., gen. after في); 'the ceiling'
فَطَافُوا: فَـ + طَافُوا — ṭāfa, he went round (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and they went round'
رَجَعُوا: رَجَعُوا — rajaʿa, he returned (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they returned'
أَخْرَجُوا: أَخْرَجُوا — akhraja, he took out (verb IV, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they took out'
وَعَدُّوهَا: و + عَدُّوا + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); ʿadda, he counted (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.) + -hā, it (f. sg., for the plural dirhams); 'and counted them'
اثْنَىْ: اثْنَىْ — ithnay, two (oblique form, used in 'twelve'); the print's form in the nominative place; 'twelve (first part)'
فَتَرَكُوهَا: فَـ + تَرَكُوا + هَا — taraka, he left (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.) + -hā, it (f.); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and they left it'
زَاوِيَةِ: زَاوِيَة — zāwiya, corner (f., gen. after فِي, annexed to the next noun); 'a corner of'
وَطَرَحُوا: و + طَرَحُوا — wa-, and (conj.); ṭaraḥa, he threw (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they threw'
يَأْكُلُونَ: يَأْكُلُونَ — akala, he ate (verb I, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'eating'
اِىٰ: اِىٰ — the print's spelling of إِلَى, ilā, to (prep.), with the lām missing; 'to'
مَضْغًا: مَضْغ — maḍgh, chewing (m., acc. indef., object of سَمِعَ); 'a chewing'
لِأَصْحَابِهِ: لِـ + أَصْحَاب + هِ — li-, to (prep.; marks the person spoken to); aṣḥāb, companions (plural of صَاحِب, gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his companions'
مَدَّ: مَدَّ — madda, he stretched out (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he stretched out'
فَتَعَلَّقَ: فَـ + تَعَلَّقَ — taʿallaqa, he clung to, seized (verb V, perfect 3 m. sg.; takes بِـ); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and he seized'
فَوَقَعُوا: فَـ + وَقَعُوا — waqaʿa, he fell (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and they fell'
لِصٌّ: لِصّ — liṣṣ, thief (m., nom. indef.); 'a thief'
يُرِيدُأَنْ: يُرِيدُ + أَنْ — arāda, he wants (verb IV, imperfect 3 m. sg.; yu-, he) + an, that, to (conj., takes the subjunctive); the print runs the two together; 'he wants to'
فَاجْتَمَعَ: فَـ + اجْتَمَعَ — ijtamaʿa, it gathered (verb VIII, perfect 3 m. sg.); fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and gathered'
خَلْقٌ: خَلْق — khalq, creation, created beings (m. collective, nom. indef.); 'a crowd (of people)'; also 'anyone, any creature' after a negative: fa-mā yadfaʿu khalqun, 'no creature wards off'
ادَّعَوْا: ادَّعَوْا — iddaʿā, he claimed (verb VIII, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they claimed'
وَغَمَّضَ: و + غَمَّضَ — wa-, and (conj.); ghammaḍa, he shut (verb II, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and shut'
مِثْلَهُمْ: مِثْل + هُمْ — mithl, like, the same as (acc.) + -hum, them; 'like them'
يَشُكُّ: يَشُكُّ — shakka, he doubted (verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'doubts'
وَبِالسُّلْطَانِ: و + بِـ + الـ + سُلْطَان — wa-, and (conj.); bi-, by, to (prep.; same appeal as the previous بِاللَّهِ); al-, the; sulṭān, sultan (m.); 'and to the Sultan'
وَالْوَالِي: و + الـ + وَالِي — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; wālī, governor (m., participle of ولي); 'and the governor'
نَصِيحَةٍ: نَصِيحَة — naṣīḥa, sincerity, honest counsel (f., gen. indef. after مَعَ); 'sincerity'
شَعَرَ: شَعَرَ — shaʿara, he perceived (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he perceived'
أَحَاطُوا: أَحَاطُوا — aḥāṭa, he surrounded (verb IV, perfect 3 m. pl.; takes بِـ); 'they surrounded'
وَسَاقُوا: و + سَاقُوا — wa-, and (conj.); sāqa, he drove (verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they drove'
فَأَحْضَرَهُمْ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ + هُمْ — aḥḍara, he brought, had brought (verb IV, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; fa-, and, so (conj.); 'and had them brought'
خَبَرُكُمْ: خَبَر + كُمْ — khabar, news, story (m., nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your story'
يُبَانُ: يُبَانُ — abāna, he made clear (verb IV, imperfect 3 m. sg., passive); 'is made clear'
شَىً: شَيْء — shayʾ, thing (m.), the print omits the hamza and marks a fathatan (shayʾan); 'a thing, anything'
بِالْعُقُوبَةِ: بِـ + الـ + عُقُوبَة — bi-, by means of (prep.); al-, the; ʿuqūba, punishment (f.); 'by punishment'
وَأَوَّلُ: و + أَوَّل — wa-, and (conj.); awwal, first (nom., annexed to مَا); 'and the first of'
تَبْدَأُ: تَبْدَأُ — badaʾa, he began (verb I, imperfect 2 m. sg.); 'you begin'
اِبْدَأْبِي: اِبْدَأْ + بِي — badaʾa, he began (verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.); bi-, with (prep.; بَدَأَ بِـ 'begin with') + -ī, me; the print runs the two together; 'begin with me'
وَعَاتِبْنِى: و + عَاتِبْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); ʿātiba, he reproached (verb III, imperative 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and reproach me, chastise me'
قَائِدِي: قَائِد + ي — qāʾid, leader, guide (m., active participle of قاد) + -ī, my; 'my guide'
وَأَوْمَى: و + أَوْمَى — wa-, and (conj.); awmā, he signalled (verb IV, perfect 3 m. sg., the print's spelling for أَوْمَأَ); 'and he motioned'
فَمَدُّوا: فَـ + مَدُّوا — fa-, so/and then (conj.) + madda, to stretch out (3 m. pl. past); 'and they stretched out'
وَضَرَبُوهُ: و + ضَرَبُوا + هُ — wa-, and; ḍaraba, to strike, beat (3 m. pl. past); -hu, him; 'and they beat him'
أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ: أَرْبَعَ + مِائَة — arbaʿa, four + miʾa, hundred; 'four hundred', written as one word and followed by the counted noun in the genitive
ثَقْبِهِ: ثَقْب + هِ — thaqb, hole, here the anus (m.); -hi, his; 'on his hole'
فَأَوْجَعَهُ: فَـ + أَوْجَعَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.); awjaʿa, to cause pain to (IV, 3 m. sing. past); -hu, him; 'and it hurt him'
زَادُوا: زَادَ — zāda, to increase, add (3 m. pl. past); 'they added'
أَعْطِنِى: أَعْطِ + نِى — aʿṭi, give! (imperative of أَعْطَى, IV); -nī, me; the print ends it in ى; 'give me'
خَاتَمَ: خَاتَم — khātam, ring, seal (m.); first term of a construct; object; 'the seal of'
الْأَمَانِ: الـ + أَمَان — amān, safety, safe-conduct, amnesty (m.); second term of the construct, genitive; 'of safety'
أَرْبَعَةٌ: أَرْبَعَة — arbaʿa, four (f. form used with male persons); predicate; 'four'
أَرْوَاحَنَا: أَرْوَاح + نَا — arwāḥ, spirits (pl. of رُوح); -nā, our; 'our spirits' = 'ourselves'; object
عُمْيَانٌ: عُمْيَان — ʿumyān, blind people (pl. of أَعْمَى); predicate, 'blind men'
وَنُغِيرُ: و + نُغِيرُ — wa-, and (conj.); nughīru, we raid (1 pl. imperfect of أَغَارَ عَلَى, IV); 'and we raid'
وَنَدْخُلُ: و + نَدْخُلُ — wa-, and; nadkhulu, we enter (1 pl. imperfect of دَخَلَ); 'and we enter'
الْبُيُوتَ: الـ + بُيُوت — buyūt, houses (pl. of بَيْت); object; 'the houses'
وَنَنْظُرُ: و + نَنْظُرُ — wa-, and; nanẓuru, we look at (1 pl. imperfect of نَظَرَ); 'and we look at'
وَنَعْمَلُ: و + نَعْمَلُ — wa-, and; naʿmalu, we work, act (1 pl. imperfect of عَمِلَ); 'and we work'
خَسَارَتِهِمْ: خَسَارَة + هِمْ — khasāra, loss, ruin (f.); -him, their; 'their ruin'
مَكْسَبٌ: مَكْسَب — maksab, gain, profit (m.); subject; 'a profit'
لِرِفْقَتِى: لِـ + رِفْقَة + ـِى — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed); rifqa, company, companions (f.); -ī, my; 'to my companions'
أَعْطُونِي: أَعْطُوا + نِي — aʿṭū, give! (imperative pl. of أَعْطَى, IV); -nī, me; 'give me'
حَقِّي: حَقّ + ـِي — ḥaqq, right, due, share (m.); -ī, my; object; 'my due'
مُسْتَجِيرٌ: مُسْتَجِير — mustajīr, one seeking refuge (active participle of اسْتَجَارَ, X); predicate; 'one seeking refuge'
أَحَقُّ: أَحَقّ — aḥaqq, more entitled (elative of حَقّ); predicate; 'more entitled'
بِقِسْمِي: بِـ + قِسْم + ـِي — bi-, to, in respect of (prep., after أَحَقُّ 'entitled to'); qism, portion, share (m.); -ī, my; 'to my share'
وَأَنَاأَشْتَهِي: و + أَنَا + أَشْتَهِي — wa-, and; anā, I; ashtahī, I desire (1 sing. imperfect of اشْتَهَى, VIII); printed as one word; 'and I desire'
صِدْقَ: صِدْق — ṣidq, truth (m.); object, first term of a construct; 'the truth of'
ضَرَبْتَنِي: ضَرَبْتَ + نِي — ḍarabta, you struck (2 m. sing. past of ضَرَبَ); -nī, me; 'you struck me'
أَمَرَالْوَالِي: أَمَرَ + الـ + وَالِي — amara, he ordered (3 m. sing. past of أَمَرَ) + al-, the + wālī, governor; printed as one word; 'the governor ordered'
بِعُقُوبَتِهِمْ: بِـ + عُقُوبَة + هِمْ — bi-, with, for (prep.; أَمَرَ بِـ 'order something'); ʿuqūba, punishment (f.); -him, their; 'their punishment'
وَأَوَّلَ: و + أَوَّل — wa-, and (conj.); awwal, first (m.); adverbial accusative, first term of a construct; 'and the first of'
بِأَخِي: بِـ + أَخ + ـِي — bi-, with (prep.; بَدَأَ بِـ 'begin with'); akh, brother; -ī, my; 'with my brother'; after faʿala, 'do', bi- marks the one it is done to: faʿala bi-akhī, 'did to my brother'
فَشَدُّوهُ: فَـ + شَدُّوا + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.); shaddū, they bound (3 m. pl. past of شَدَّ); -hu, him; 'and they tied him'
فَسَقَةُ: فَسَقَة — fasaqa, sinners, reprobates (pl. of فَاسِق); vocative; 'O sinners'
تَجْحَدُونَ: تَجْحَدُونَ — tajḥadūna, you deny (2 m. pl. imperfect of جَحَدَ); 'you deny'
نِعْمَةَ: نِعْمَة — niʿma, favour, blessing (f.); object, first term of a construct; 'the favour of'
وَتَدَّعُونَ: و + تَدَّعُونَ — wa-, and (conj.); tadaʿʿūna, you claim (2 m. pl. imperfect of ادَّعَى, VIII); 'and you claim'
بَصِيرٌ: بَصِير — baṣīr, sighted, seeing (m.); 'one who sees'
يُفِيقَ: يُفِيقَ — yufīqa, he comes to (3 m. sing. subjunctive of أَفَاقَ, IV, after حَتَّى); 'he recovers'
وَأَعِيدُوا: و + أَعِيدُوا — wa-, and (conj.); aʿīdū, repeat! (imperative pl. of أَعَادَ, IV); 'and repeat'
ثَلٰثِمِائَةِ: ثَلٰثِ + مِائَة — thalāthi, three (with the dagger alif added) + miʾa, hundred; 'three hundred', one word in the print
وَالْبَصِيرُ: و + الـ + بَصِير — wa-, and, while (conj.); baṣīr, sighted one (m.); 'and the seeing one'
افْتَحُوا: افْتَحُوا — iftaḥū, open! (imperative pl. of فَتَحَ); 'open'
عُيُونَكُمْ: عُيُون + كُمْ — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عَيْن); -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your eyes'
وَإِلَّاجَدَّدَ: و + إِلَّا + جَدَّدَ — wa-, and (conj.); illā, otherwise, or else (= إِنْ لَا); jaddada, he renewed (3 m. sing. past of جَدَّدَ, II); printed as one word; 'or else he will renew'
يَأْ: يَأْتِي — yaʾtī, he comes (3 m. sing. imperfect of أَتَى); first half of a word the print splits in two; 'brings' with the next part
تِيكَ: ـتِي + كَ — second half of the split word يَأْتِيكَ: -tī, end of yaʾtī, + -ka, you (m. sing.); with بِـ below 'brings you'
هٰؤُلَاءِ: هٰؤُلَاءِ — hāʾulāʾi, these (pl. demonstrative, used of persons)
عُيُونَهُمْ: عُيُون + هُمْ — ʿuyūn, eyes; -hum, their; 'their eyes'
وَيَخَافُونَ: و + يَخَافُونَ — wa-, and (conj.); yakhāfūna, they fear (3 m. pl. imperfect of خَافَ); 'and they fear'
فَضِيحَةِ: فَضِيحَة — faḍīḥa, disgrace, scandal (f.); first term of a construct, genitive after مِنْ; 'the disgrace of'
قِسْمَهُ: قِسْم + هُ — qism, portion, share (m.); -hu, his; apposition to the sum; 'his share'
مَازَعَمَ: مَا + زَعَمَ — mā, what (rel.) + zaʿama, he claimed (3 m. sing. past of زَعَمَ); printed as one word; 'what he claimed'
الْبَاقِيَ: الـ + بَاقِي — bāqī, remaining (active participle of بَقِيَ); object; 'the remainder'
وَنَفَى: و + نَفَى — wa-, and (conj.); nafā, he banished (3 m. sing. past of نَفَى); 'and he banished'
الثَّلٰثَةَ: الـ + ثَلٰثَة — thalātha, three (with the dagger alif added); object; 'the three'
وَلَحِقْتُ: و + لَحِقْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); laḥiqtu, I overtook (1 sing. past of لَحِقَ); 'and I caught up with'
فَأَخْبَرَنِي: فَـ + أَخْبَرَ + نِي — fa-, and (conj.); akhbara, to inform (IV, 3 m. sing. past); -nī, me; 'and he told me'
وَرَتَّبْتُ: و + رَتَّبْتُ — wa-, and (conj.); rattabtu, I arranged (1 sing. past of رَتَّبَ, II); 'and I arranged'
الْخُفْيَةِ: الـ + خُفْيَة — khufya, secrecy (f.); genitive after فِي; 'the secrecy'
جَائِزَةً: جَائِزَة — jāʾiza, reward, gift (f.); object; 'a reward'
لِأَمِيرِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: لِـ + أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — li-, to (prep., marks the person told); amīr, commander; al-, the; muʾminīn, believers; printed as one word; 'to the Commander of the Faithful'
لِإِخْوَتِي: لِـ + إِخْوَة + ـِي — li-, to, for (prep.; جَرَى لِـ 'happen to') + ikhwa, brothers (pl. of أَخ); -ī, my; 'to my brothers'
الْأَعْوَرُ: الـ + أَعْوَر — aʿwar, one-eyed (m.); predicate after 'and he'; 'the one-eyed'
جَزَّارًا: جَزَّار — jazzār, butcher (m.); predicate of كَانَ; 'a butcher'
وَيُرَبِّي: و + يُرَبِّي — wa-, and (conj.); yurabbī, he raises (3 m. sing. imperfect of رَبَّى, II); 'and raising'
الْكِبَاشَ: الـ + كِبَاش — kibāsh, rams (pl. of كَبْش); object; 'the rams'
يَقْصِدُونَهُ: يَقْصِدُونَ + هُ — yaqṣidūna, they seek (3 m. pl. imperfect of قَصَدَ); -hu, him; 'they seek him out'
الْكِبَارُ: الـ + كِبَار — kibār, great ones, grandees (pl. of كَبِير); subject; 'the great men'
وَأَصْحَابُ: و + أَصْحَاب — wa-, and (conj.); aṣḥāb, owners, possessors (pl. of صَاحِب); first term of a construct; 'and the owners of'
يَشْتَرُونَ: يَشْتَرُونَ — yashtarūna, they buy (3 m. pl. imperfect of اشْتَرَى, VIII); 'they buy'
فَكَسَبَ: فَـ + كَسَبَ — fa-, so (conj.); kasaba, he earned (3 m. sing. past); 'so he earned'
وَاقْتَنَى: و + اقْتَنَى — wa-, and (conj.); iqtanā, he acquired (3 m. sing. past of اقْتَنَى, VIII); 'and he acquired'
الدَّوَابَّ: الـ + دَوَابّ — dawābb, beasts (pl. of دَابَّة); object; 'the beasts'
وَالدُّورَ: و + الـ + دُور — wa-, and (conj.); dūr, houses (pl. of دَار); object; 'and the houses'
زَمَنًا: زَمَن — zaman, time, period (m.); adverbial accusative; 'a time'
هُوَذَاتَ: هُوَ + ذَاتَ — huwa, he (pronoun) + dhāta, (a) time of (adverbial accusative); printed as one word; 'he, one'
مَابَدَأَ: مَا + بَدَأَ — mā, what (rel.) + badaʾa, he began (3 m. sing. past of بَدَأَ); printed as one word; 'what he began'
وَسَأَلْتُهُ: و + سَأَلْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); saʾaltu, I asked (1 sing. past of سَأَلَ); -hu, him; 'and I asked him'
إِذْوَقَفَ: إِذْ + وَقَفَ — idh, when (conj.) + waqafa, to stand, stop (perf. 3 m. sg.), printed as one word; 'when ... stood'
اللِّحْيَةِ: الـ + لِحْيَة — liḥya, beard (f.); 'the beard'; gen. second term of the idāfa, 'great of beard'
وَدَفَعَ: وَ + دَفَعَ — wa-, and (conj.); dafaʿa, to pay (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he paid' Also dafaʿa bi-, 'to push off (a boat) with': wa-dafaʿa bihimu al-mallāḥu, 'and the boatman pushed off with them'.
فَتَأَمَّلَ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلَ — fa-, and so (conj.); taʾammala, to look closely, study (form V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and so he looked closely'
فِضَّةِ: فِضَّة — fiḍḍa, silver (f.), gen. as the first term of an idāfa after fī; 'the silver of'
دَرَاهِمَهُ: دَرَاهِم + هُ — dirhams (acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his dirhams'
بَيَاضُهَا: بَيَاض + هَا — bayāḍ, whiteness (m., nom.) + -hā, their (the dirhams, f. sg. for things); 'their whiteness'
فَعَزَلَهَا: فَـ + عَزَلَ + هَا — fa-, and so; ʿazala, to set apart, separate (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them (f. sg., for a plural of things); 'and set them apart'
يَتَرَدَّدُ: يَتَرَدَّدُ — yataraddadu, to go back and forth, visit repeatedly (form V impf. 3 m. sg.); 'going back and forth'
يَطْرَحُ: يَطْرَحُ — yaṭraḥu, to throw, cast (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'throws'
يُخْرِجَهَا: يُخْرِجَ + هَا — yukhrija, to bring out, take out (form IV subj. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them (f. sg., for things); 'take them out'
وَيَشْتَرِيَ: وَ + يَشْتَرِيَ — wa-, and (conj.); yashtariya, to buy (form VIII subj. 3 m. sg., under أَنْ); 'and buy'
غَنَمًا: غَنَم — ghanam, sheep (and goats), small livestock (collective, acc. object); 'sheep'
وَرَقٌ: وَرَق — waraq, paper, leaves (coll. m., nom.); 'paper'
مُقَصَّصٌ: مُقَصَّص — muqaṣṣaṣ, cut up, clipped into pieces (pass. part. of form II قَصَّصَ, m. sg.); 'cut up'
فَلَطَمَ: فَـ + لَطَمَ — fa-, and so (conj.); laṭama, to slap, strike with the palm (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he slapped'
بِحَدِيثِهِ: بِـ + حَدِيث + هِ — bi-, with, of (prep.; ḥaddatha bi- 'tell of something', the thing told); ḥadīth, story, account (m.) + -hi, his; 'of his story'
فَذَبَحَ: فَـ + ذَبَحَ — fa-, and so (conj.); dhabaḥa, to slaughter (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and slaughtered'
كَبْشًا: كَبْش — kabsh, ram (m., acc. object); 'a ram'
وَعَلَّقَهُ: وَ + عَلَّقَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); ʿallaqa, to hang up, suspend (form II perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and hung it'
الْفِضَّةُ: الـ + فِضَّة — fiḍḍa, silver (f., nom.); 'the silver'
وَاسْمَعُوا: وَ + اسْمَعُوا — wa-, and (conj.); isma'ū, to hear (imper. m. pl.); 'and hear'
الْفَاجِرِ: الـ + فَاجِر — fājir, wicked, dissolute (act. part. of فَجَرَ, m., gen. after maʿa); 'the scoundrel'
أَيُّمَا: أَيّ + مَا — ayy, which (interrogative, nom.) + mā, emphasising particle; 'which'
تَتَنَحَّى: تَتَنَحَّى — tatanaḥḥā, to move aside, withdraw (form V impf. 2 m. sg.), without an introducing 'an; 'you move aside'
أَفْضَحُكَ: أَفْضَحُ + كَ — afḍaḥu, to expose, shame (impf. 1 sg. of فَضَحَ) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'I expose you'
بِأَيِّ: بِـ + أَيّ — bi-, with, by (prep., 'on what ground'); ayy, which (interrogative, gen. after bi-); 'with what'; here: ayy as an indefinite, bi-ayyi ḥīlatin kānat, 'by any means whatever'
شَيُّ: شَيّ — shayy, thing (m., the colloquial form of shayʾ; the print's damma is kept; gen. in sense after ayy); 'thing'
تَفْضَحُنِي: تَفْضَحُ + نِي — tafḍaḥu, to expose (impf. 2 m. sg. of فَضَحَ) + -nī, me; 'you expose me'
بِأَنَّكَ: بِـ + أَنَّ + كَ — bi-, with, by (prep.: 'with this, that') + anna, that (conj.) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'with the fact that you'
لَحْمَ: لَحْم — laḥm, flesh, meat (m., acc. object, first term of an idāfa); 'the flesh of'
بِأَنَّهُ: بِـ + أَنَّ + هُ — bi-, as, under the label (prep.) + anna, that (conj.) + -hu, it; 'passing it off as'; also after khabar, 'news', bi- introduces what the news says: khabara … bi-annahu marīḍun, 'news that he was sick' (Night 194)
لَحْمُ: لَحْم — laḥm, flesh, meat (m., nom., predicate, first term of an idāfa); 'flesh of'
غَنَمٍ: غَنَم — ghanam, sheep (coll., gen., second term of the idāfa); 'sheep'
كَذَبْتَ: كَذَبْتَ — kadhabta, to lie (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you lied'
فَمَالِى: فَـ + مَال + ي — fa-, then (apodosis marker after the conditional); māl, wealth, property (m., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'then my property'
حَلَالٌ: حَلَال — ḥalāl, lawful, permitted (adj., predicate of two nouns, sg. m.); 'lawful'
مَعَاشِرَ: مَعَاشِر — maʿāshir, companies, assemblies (pl. of مَعْشَر, vocative, first term of an idāfa); 'assembled people of'
أَرَدْتُمْ: أَرَدْتُمْ — aradtum, to want (form IV perf. 2 m. pl.); 'you want'
تَحْقِيقَ: تَحْقِيق — taḥqīq, verification, proof (verbal noun of form II, acc., first term of an idāfa); 'verification of'
وَصِدْقِي: وَ + صِدْق + ي — wa-, and (conj.); ṣidq, truth, truthfulness (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my truthfulness'
اُدْخُلُوا: اُدْخُلُوا — udkhulū, to enter (imper. m. pl.); 'enter'
فَهَجَمَ: فَـ + هَجَمَ — fa-, and so (conj.); hajama, to rush in, burst in (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and rushed'
فَرَأَوْا: فَـ + رَأَوْا — fa-, and (conj.); raʾaw, to see (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they saw'
الْكَبْشَ: الـ + كَبْش — kabsh, ram (acc. object); 'the ram'
تَعَلَّقُوا: تَعَلَّقُوا — taʿallaqū, to cling, seize hold (form V perf. 3 m. pl., takes bi- for the person); 'they seized'
وَصَاحُوا: وَ + صَاحُوا — wa-, and (conj.); ṣāḥū, to cry out (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they cried out'
كَافِرِيَا: كَافِر + يَا — kāfir, unbeliever (act. part. of كَفَرَ, m., gen. in the print) + yā, O (vocative particle), printed as one word; 'unbeliever, O'
فَاجِرُ: فَاجِر — fājir, wicked, depraved (act. part., m., vocative); 'wicked one'
وَصَارَا: وَ + صَارَ + (أ) — wa-, and (conj.); ṣāra, to become, begin (perf. 3 m. sg.), with the initial alif of the next word, أَعَزُّ, attached to it in the print; 'and began'
عَزُّ: (أ)عَزّ — aʿazz, dearer, dearest (elative of عَزِيز, m., first term of an idāfa), its initial alif printed at the end of the previous word; 'dearest'
يَضْرِبُهُ: يَضْرِبُ + هُ — yaḍribu, to strike, beat (impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'beating him'
وَيَلْطِمُهُ: وَ + يَلْطِمُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); yalṭimu, to slap (impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and slapping him'
تُطْعِمُنَا: تُطْعِمُ + نَا — tuṭʿimu, to feed (form IV impf. 2 m. sg.) + -nā, us (first object); 'you feed us'
وَلَطَمَهُ: وَ + لَطَمَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); laṭama, to slap (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and struck him'
وَحَمَلَتِ: وَ + حَمَلَتِ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥamalat, to carry (perf. 3 f. sg., agreeing with a collective or broken plural such as النَّاس or الْكُفَّار; the kasra is the linking vowel before الـ), 'and carried'; with ʿalā, to charge, attack, 'and (they) charged upon'
الْمَذْبُوحَ: الـ + مَذْبُوح — madhbūḥ, slaughtered (pass. part. of ذَبَحَ, m., acc. object); 'the slaughtered one'
الْأَمِيرُ: الـ + أَمِير — amīr, emir, commander (m., nom.: vocative, or subject); 'the emir'
يَذْبَحُ: يَذْبَحُ — yadhbaḥu, to slaughter (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'slaughters'
وَيَبِيعُ: وَ + يَبِيعُ — wa-, and (conj.); yabīʿu, to sell (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and sells'
لَحْمَهُمْ: لَحْم + هُمْ — laḥm, flesh (acc. object) + -hum, their; 'their flesh'
أَتَيْنَاكَ: أَتَيْنَا + كَ — ataynā, to come (perf. 1 pl.) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'we have come to you'
وَاقْضِ: وَ + اقْضِ — wa-, and (conj.); iqḍi, to judge, carry out (imper. m. sg. of قَضَى); 'and carry out' Also of money, 'to settle, pay for': iqḍi minhu mā yaḥtāju ilayhi al-ḥālu, 'pay out of it for whatever the occasion needs'.
عَزَّوَجَلَّ: عَزَّ + وَ + جَلَّ — ʿazza, to be mighty (perf. 3 m. sg.) + wa-, and + jalla, to be exalted (perf. 3 m. sg.), printed as one word; 'mighty and exalted' (the formula said after God's name)
فَدَافَعَ: فَـ + دَافَعَ — fa-, and (conj.); dāfaʿa, to defend, plead (form III perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he defended'
بِضَرْبِهِ: بِـ + ضَرْب + هِ — bi-, the thing ordered (prep., chosen by amara 'order') + ḍarb, beating (verbal noun, m.) + -hi, his; 'his beating'
خَمْسَمِائَةِ: خَمْس + مِائَة — khams, five + mi'a, hundred (f., printed as one word; first term of an idāfa, gen. here); 'five hundred'
الْمَالُ: الـ + مَال — māl, wealth, money (m., nom. after law-lā); 'the money' Also nom. as subject of a clause with no verb: ʿalayhi al-mālu, 'on it (was) the money'.
لَقَتَلُوهُ: لَـ + قَتَلُوا + هُ — la-, would (particle opening the answer to law-lā); qatalū, to kill (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'they would have killed him'
جَا: جَا — jā, second part of the same doubtful word (perhaps هَائِجًا); the sense 'frantic' is a guess
يَعْمَلَ: يَعْمَلَ — yaʿmala, to work (impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'work'
إِسْكَافِيًّا: إِسْكَافِيّ — iskāfī, cobbler, shoemaker (m., acc. of state); 'as a cobbler'
اتَّقُوا: ittaqū — fear! (imperative pl. of ittaqā, form VIII); 'fear'
الْغِلْمَانَ: الـ + غِلْمَان — ghilmān, lads, servants (pl. of ghulām), acc. as the object; 'the lads'
الْهُرُوبِ: الـ + هُرُوب — hurūb, flight, fleeing (m. verbal noun), gen. after ʿalā; 'fleeing'
أَثْوَا: athwā — garments (the first part of athwābihi, 'his clothes' (pl. of thawb), as the print divides it); 'garments'
أَجْنَابِهِ: أَجْنَاب + هِ — ajnāb, sides, flanks (pl. of janb) + -hi, his, gen. after ʿalā; 'his sides'
أَحْضَرُوا: aḥḍarū — they brought, had (someone) brought (perfect 3rd m. pl. form IV of ḥaḍara); 'they brought'
أَذَقْتَنَا: أَذَقْتَ + نَا — adhaqta, you made taste (perfect 2nd m. sg. form IV of dhāqa) + -nā, us; 'you made us taste'
أَعُوذُ: aʿūdhu — I take refuge (imperfect 1st sg. of ʿādha); 'I seek refuge'
أَعْوَرَ: aʿwar — one-eyed (adj. m., diptote, gen. fatḥa after ilā; acc. as predicate after kāna); 'one-eyed'
أَفْقَرْتَهُ: أَفْقَرْتَ + هُ — afqarta, you made poor (perfect 2nd m. sg. form IV of faqura) + -hu, him; 'you impoverished him'
أَمْرُ: amr — command, decree (m.), nom. as subject and first term of an iḍāfa; 'the decree of'
أَمْرُكُمْ: أَمْر + كُمْ — amr, affair, matter (m.), nom. as predicate + -kum, your (pl.); 'your affair'
أَمْكَنَنَا: أَمْكَنَ + نَا — amkana, he gave power (perfect form IV; with min 'gave power over') + -nā, us; 'has given us power'
إِنْسَانٍ: insān — a person, someone (m.), indefinite gen. after ilā; 'a man, a person'
بِالْيُمْنَى: بِـ + الـ + يُمْنَى — bi-, in respect of (prep.) + yumnā, right (f.); 'in the right (eye)'
بِبَابٍ: بِـ + بَاب — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise (prep.; not 'with') + bāb, door (m.), gen. tanwīn; 'a door'
بِذُنُوبِي: بِـ + ذُنُوب + ي — bi-, because of (prep.; marks the cause) + dhunūb, sins (pl. of dhanb) + -ī, my; 'through my sins'
تَذْبَحُ: tadhbaḥu — you slaughter, cut the throat of (imperfect indicative of dhabaḥa; no 'an' before it, as Middle Arabic); 'to slaughter'
تَفْضَحُنَا: تَفْضَحُ + نَا — tafḍaḥu, you disgrace, expose (imperfect indicative of faḍaḥa; no 'an' before it, as Middle Arabic) + -nā, us; 'to disgrace us'
تُغِيرُ: tughīru — you raid, attack (imperfect indicative form IV of ghāra); 'you raid'
تُهَدِّدُنَا: تُهَدِّدُ + نَا — tuhaddidu, you threaten (imperfect indicative form II of haddada) + -nā, us; 'you threaten us'
حَاشِيَةِ: ḥāshiya — retinue, entourage (f.), gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the retinue of'
خَلَّيْتَنَا: خَلَّيْتَ + نَا — khallayta, you let, left (perfect 2nd m. sg. form II of khalā) + -nā, us; 'you let us'
خَيْلٌ: khayl — horse(s), horsemen, cavalry (collective, m.); nom. with tanwīn (the case is a guess, since the governing word is outside this slice)
شَرِّ: sharr — evil (m.), gen. after min and first term of an iḍāfa; 'the evil of'
عَدُ: ʿadu — enemy (the first part of ʿaduww, 'enemy', as the print wrongly divides it: يا عد والله = yā ʿaduwwa Allāh); 'enemy'
عِنَانَ: ʿinān — rein, bridle (m.), acc. as object and first term of an iḍāfa; 'the rein of'
فَجَعَلَ: فَـ + جَعَلَ — fa-, and (conj.) + jaʿala, he began (perfect; followed by an imperfect it means 'began to'); 'and he began'
فَطَلَبَ: فَـ + طَلَبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ṭalaba, he sought (perfect); 'and so sought'
فَلَحِقُوا: فَـ + لَحِقُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + laḥiqū, they overtook, caught up with (perfect 3rd m. pl. of laḥiqa); 'and they caught up with'
فَوَقَعَتْ: فَـ + وَقَعَتْ — fa-, and then (conj.) + waqaʿat, it fell (perfect 3rd f. sg. of waqaʿa; agrees with ʿayn, f.); 'and then fell'
لِأَخِى: لِـ + أَخِى — li-, to (prep.; marks the person spoken to) + akhī, my brother (the print spells it with ى); 'to my brother'
مَغْلُوقٍ: maghlūq — closed, shut (passive participle of ghalaqa; m.), gen. tanwīn agreeing with bāb; 'closed'
نَهْدِي: nahdī — we rest, are still (the print's spelling of nahda'u, imperfect of hada'a); 'rest'
