وَاثْنَى: وَ + اثْنَى — wa-, and (conj.) + ithnā, he turned back (perfect; the print's form of Classical thanā, with a prefixed alif); 'and he turned'
وَاعْلَمُوا: وَ + اعْلَمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿlamū, know! (imperative pl. of ʿalima); 'and know'
وَأَصْحَابُكَ: وَ + أَصْحَاب + كَ — wa-, and (conj.; joins them to the 'you' in afqarta) + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your companions'
وَتَحَوَّلَ: وَ + تَحَوَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥawwala, he moved, changed place (perfect form V); 'and moved'
وَتُدَبِّرُ: وَ + تُدَبِّرُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tudabbiru, you plan, plot (imperfect form II of dabbara); 'and you plot'
وَجِيعًا: wajīʿ — painful, severe (adj.), acc. agreeing with ḍarban; 'painful'
وَخَرَّقُوا: وَ + خَرَّقُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + kharraqū, they tore to pieces (perfect 3rd m. pl. form II); 'and they tore'
وَرَجُلَانِ: وَ + رَجُلَانِ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'and behold') + rajulān, two men (m. dual, nom.); 'and two men'
وَفَتَّشُوهُ: وَ + فَتَّشُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fattashū, they searched (perfect 3rd m. pl. form II) + -hu, him; 'and they searched him'
وَقَالَا: وَ + قَالَا — wa-, and (conj.) + qālā, they (two) said (perfect 3rd m. dual); 'and they said'
وَقَصَّ: وَ + قَصَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + qaṣṣa, he related, narrated (perfect); 'and recounted'
يَتَفَرَّجُ: yatafarraju — he amuses himself, strolls for pleasure (imperfect form V of faraja); a circumstantial verb with no connecting word; 'strolling'
يَدْرِ: yadri — he knows (jussive of darā, after lam, 3rd m. sg.); 'know'
يَسْتَتِرُ: yastatiru — he hides himself, takes cover (imperfect form X of satara); relative clause on mawḍiʿan; 'to hide'
يَعْرِفُهُ: يَعْرِفُ + هُ — yaʿrifu, he knows (imperfect indicative of ʿarafa) + -hu, him; relative clause on aḥad; 'who knew him'
يُخَلِّصُنِي: يُخَلِّصُ + نِي — yukhalliṣu, he delivers, saves (imperfect form II of khallaṣa) + -nī, me; 'delivers me'
يُطِيقُ: yuṭīqu — he can bear, is able to stand (imperfect form IV of ṭāqa); 'he can bear'
يُطْلِقُوهُ: يُطْلِقُوا + هُ — yuṭliqū, they release, set free (subjunctive 3rd m. pl. of aṭlaqa, after an) + -hu, him; 'they would release him'
يُعْتِقُهُ: يُعْتِقُ + هُ — yuʿtiqu, he sets free, lets off (imperfect form IV of ʿataqa) + -hu, him; 'he lets him go'
دَارَهُمْ: دَار + هُمْ — dār, house (f.), accusative object; -hum, their; 'their house'
نَسْمَعُ: ن + سَمِعَ — samiʿa, hear; 1st plural imperfect, 'we hear' (here a scornful question)
لِصٍّ: لِصّ — liṣṣ, thief (m.); genitive, second term of the annexation كَلَامَ لِصٍّ, 'the speech of a thief' (the لِ is part of the noun, not a preposition)
أَفْقَرَ: فَقَرَ — afqara, make poor, impoverish (form IV); 3rd m. sing. perfect
جُرْمٍ: جُرْم — jurm, crime, offence (m.); genitive after عَنْ; 'a crime'
مِائَةِ: مِائَة — miʾa, hundred (f.); genitive, first term of an annexation, 'a hundred of'
حَمَلُوهُ: حَمَلَ + وا + هُ — ḥamala, carry, set; 3rd m. plural perfect; -hu, him; 'they set him'
جَمَلٍ: جَمَل — jamal, camel (m.); genitive after عَلَى; 'a camel'
أُجْزِيَ: جَزَى — jazā, repay; here taken as a passive 'is repaid' (ujziya); the printed form is obscure, see the note
بُيُوتَ: بُيُوت — buyūt, houses (pl. of بَيْت); accusative object of يَهْجُمُ, first term of an annexation
بِإِخْرَاجِهِ: بِـ + إِخْرَاج + هِ — bi-, marks the thing ordered; ikhrāj, expelling (m., verbal noun of form IV); -hi, his/him; 'that he be expelled'; also after iltazama bi-, 'to undertake': iltazamtu laki bi-ikhrājihi, 'I undertake to get him out for you'
وَاسْتَخْبَرْتُهُ: وَ + اِسْتَخْبَرَ + تُ + هُ — wa-, and; istakhbara, ask for news (form X); -tu, I; -hu, him; 'and I questioned him'
دَائِرًا: دَائِر — dāʾir, going round (active participle of دَارَ); accusative of state, 'going about'
سَيَّبُوهُ: سَيَّبَ + وا + هُ — sayyaba, let loose, set free (form II); 3rd m. plural perfect; -hu, him; 'they let him go'
وَأَخَذْتُهُ: وَ + أَخَذَ + تُ + هُ — wa-, and; akhadha, take; -tu, I; -hu, him; 'and I took him'
مَايَأْ: مَا + يَأْكُلُ (first part) — mā, what (relative) + ya-ʾ, the first letters of يَأْكُلُ, 'he eats'; the print splits the word as مايا كل, see the note
الْخَامِسُ: الـ + خَامِس — khāmis, fifth (ordinal); nominative, 'the fifth'
مَقْطُوعَ: مَقْطُوع — maqṭūʿ, cut off (passive participle of قَطَعَ); accusative predicate of كَانَ, first term of a half-annexation
الْأُذُنَيْنِ: الـ + أُذُن — udhun, ear (f.), dual genitive, 'the two ears'; 'with the ears cut off'
يَسْأَلُ: ي + سَأَلَ — saʾala, ask, beg of; 3rd m. sing. imperfect; with كَانَ, habitual 'he used to beg'
وَيُنْفِقُ: وَ + ي + أَنْفَقَ — wa-, and; anfaqa, spend (form IV); 3rd m. sing. imperfect, 'and spends'
فَاعْتَلَّ: فَـ + اِعْتَلَّ — fa-, and so; iʿtalla, fall ill (form VIII); 3rd m. sing. perfect
فَخَلَّفَ: فَـ + خَلَّفَ — fa-, and; khallafa, leave behind (form II); 3rd m. sing. perfect
سَبْعَمِائَةِ: سَبْع + مِائَة — sabʿ, seven + miʾa, hundred; 'seven hundred' (written as one word), genitive as first term of an annexation
نَوْعٍ: نَوْع — nawʿ, kind, sort (m.); genitive; 'of every kind'
وَيَنْتَفِعُ: وَ + ي + اِنْتَفَعَ — wa-, and; intafaʿa, profit, benefit (form VIII); 3rd m. sing. imperfect
بِثَمَنِهِ: بِـ + ثَمَن + هِ — bi-, by means of (prep.; اِنْتَفَعَ بِـ 'profit from'); thaman, price (m.); -hi, its; 'from its price'
بِالْمِائَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مِائَة — bi-, with (the price, after اِشْتَرَى); miʾa, hundred (f.); 'with the hundred'
وَبِجَانِبِهِ: وَ + بِـ + جَانِب + هِ — wa-, and; bi-, at/by (prep. of place); jānib, side (m.); -hi, his; 'and beside him'
حَائِطٌ: حَائِط — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m.); nominative, subject of a nominal clause
فَأَسْنَدَ: فَـ + أَسْنَدَ — fa-, and so; asnada, lean something (form IV); 3rd m. sing. perfect
ظَهْرَهُ: ظَهْر + هُ — ẓahr, back (m.), accusative object; -hu, his; 'his back'
مُتَفَكِّرًا: مُتَفَكِّر — mutafakkir, thinking (active participle of تَفَكَّرَ); accusative of state, 'musing'
رَأْسَ: رَأْس — raʾs, head, principal (m.); accusative (object, or after إِنَّ), first term of رَأْسُ الْمَالِ 'capital'
الزُّجَاجِ: الـ + زُجَاج — zujāj, glass (m.); genitive in apposition to the demonstrative; 'the glass'
أَبِيعُهُ: أ + بَاعَ + هُ — bāʿa, sell; 1st sing. imperfect; -hu, it; 'I sell it'
بِمِائَتَيْنِ: بِـ + مِائَتَيْنِ — bi-, for, at the price of (prep. of price); miʾatayn, two hundred (dual genitive)
وَأَبِيعُهُ: وَ + أَبِيعُهُ — wa-, and; abīʿuhu, 'I sell it' (see أَبِيعُهُ)
بِأَرْبَعِمِائَةِ: بِـ + أَرْبَع + مِائَة — bi-, for, at the price of; arbaʿ, four + miʾa, hundred; 'four hundred'
أَزَالُ: أ + زَالَ — zāla, cease; 1st sing. imperfect, with لَا 'I do not cease'
فَأَشْتَرِيَ: فَـ + أ + اِشْتَرَى — fa-, and then; ishtarā, buy; 1st sing., subjunctive after فَـ of sequence in a planned future; 'then I buy'
وَالْعَطْرِفَأَرْبَحَ: وَ + الـ + عَطْر + فَـ + أَرْبَحَ — wa-, and; ʿaṭr, perfume (m.), genitive; fa-, and so; arbaḥa, make a profit (form IV), 1st sing. subjunctive; 'and the perfumes, and so I make a profit' (run together in the print)
رِبْحًا: رِبْح — ribḥ, profit (m.); accusative, cognate object, 'a profit'
الْمَمَالِيكَ: الـ + مَمَالِيك — mamālīk, mamluks, slave-servants (pl. of مَمْلُوك); accusative object; 'the mamluks'
وَالْخَيْلَ: وَ + الـ + خَيْل — wa-, and; khayl, horses (coll.); accusative; 'and the horses'
وَسُرُوجَ: وَ + سُرُوج — wa-, and; surūj, saddles (pl. of سَرْج); accusative, first term of an annexation
وَآكُلُ: وَ + آكُلُ — wa-, and; ākulu, I eat (the verb أَكَلَ, 1st sing. imperfect with madda for أَأْكُلُ)
أُخَلِّي: أ + خَلَّى — khallā, leave, let be (form II); 1st sing. imperfect, 'I leave'; with لَا 'I leave no'
مُغَنِّيًا: مُغَنٍّ — mughannī, singer (active participle of غَنَّى), accusative; 'a male singer'
مُغَنِّيَةً: مُغَنِّيَة — mughanniya, female singer (f.), accusative; 'a woman singer'
أَجِيبَهَا: أ + جَابَ + هَا — jāba, bring (colloquial: for جَاءَ بِـ); 1st sing., subjunctive after حَتَّى; -hā, her; 'I bring her'
وَأَعْمَلُ: وَ + أ + عَمِلَ — wa-, and; ʿamila, make, do; 1st sing. imperfect, 'and I make'; here ʿamila maʿa, 'to do for': wa-aʿmalu maʿakumā, 'and I shall do for you both'
أَلْفِ: أَلْف — alf, thousand (m.); genitive, first term of an annexation
يَحْسُبُ: ي + حَسَبَ — ḥasaba, reckon, calculate; 3rd m. sing. imperfect, 'he reckons'
وَقَفَصُ: وَ + قَفَص — wa-, and (circumstantial); qafaṣ, crate, cage (m.); first term of an annexation
مَطْرُوحٌ: مَطْرُوح — maṭrūḥ, thrown down, set down (passive participle of طَرَحَ); predicate, nominative
أَبْعَثُ: أ + بَعَثَ — baʿatha, send; 1st sing. imperfect, 'I send'
الدَّلَّالَاتِ: الـ + دَلَّالَة — dallāla, woman broker, go-between (f.); accusative plural; 'the women brokers'
خِطْبَةِ: خِطْبَة — khiṭba, asking in marriage, betrothal-seeking (f.); genitive after فِي, 'the asking for marriage'
وَأَخْطُبُ: وَ + أ + خَطَبَ — wa-, and; khaṭaba, ask in marriage; 1st sing. imperfect, 'and I ask for'
بَدِيعَةٍ: بَدِيعَة — badīʿa, a marvel, a wonder (f., gen. indef.); 'of a marvel'
وَأُمْهِرُهَا: و + أُمْهِرُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); amhara, to give a dowry (imperfect, 1st s.; future in sense), + ـهَا, her; 'and I give her a dowry'
يَرْضَ: يَرْضَ — yarḍā, to consent (jussive after lam, 3rd m.s.); 'he does (not) consent'
قَهْرًا: قَهْر — qahr, force, subjugation (m., acc. indef., adverbial); 'by force'
أَنْفِهِ: أَنْف + هِ — anf, nose (m., gen.), + ـهِ, his; 'his nose'
خُدَّامٍ: خُدَّام — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim, gen. indef.); 'servants'
صِغَارٍ: صِغَار — ṣighār, small, young (pl. of ṣaghīr, gen. indef.); 'young'
كِسْوَةً: كِسْوَة — kiswa, garment, robe (f., acc. indef.); 'a robe'
كَسَاوِي: كَسَاوِي — kasāwī, robes (pl. of kiswa, gen. in construct); 'the robes of'
وَالسَّلَاطِينِ: و + الـ + سَلَاطِين — wa-, and, + sulṭān pl., sultans (gen.); 'and the sultans'
وَأَصْنَعُ: و + أَصْنَعُ — wa-, and, + ṣanaʿa, to make (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I have made'
سَرْجَ: سَرْج — sarj, saddle (m., acc. in construct); 'a saddle of'
وَأُرَصِّعُهُ: و + أُرَصِّعُ + هُ — wa-, and, + raṣṣaʿa, to inlay, set with gems (imperfect, 1st s.), + ـهُ, it/him; 'and I inlay it'
الْمُثَمَّنَةِ: الـ + مُثَمَّنَة — muthamman (f.), valued, costly (passive participle of thammana; gen. adj. of jewels); 'the costly (ones)'
أَرْكَبُ: أَرْكَبُ — rakiba, to ride (imperfect, 1st s.); 'I ride'
وَمَعِى: و + مَعِى — wa-, and (circumstantial), + maʿa, with, + ـي, me (printed ى); 'and with me'
وَقُدَّ: و + قُدَّ — wa-, and, + quddām (first part), in front; printed split from the second part امي; 'and in front (of)'
امِي: امِي — -āmī, the rest of quddāmī, in front of me (second part of the split word, ـي, my/me); '(in front of) me'
وَيَدْعُونَ: و + يَدْعُونَ — wa-, and, + daʿā, to pray (for) (imperfect, 3rd m.pl.); 'and pray'
أَبُوالْبِنْتِ: أَبُو + الـ + بِنْت — abū, father of (m., nom.), + bint, girl, daughter (f., gen.); printed as one word; 'the father of the girl'
وَالْمَمَالِيكُ: و + الـ + مَمَالِيك — wa-, and (circumstantial), + mamālīk, mamluks (nom.); 'with the mamluks'
وَقُدَّامِي: و + قُدَّام + ي — wa-, and, + quddām, in front (prep.), + ـي, me; 'and in front of me'
شِمَالِي: شِمَال + ي — shimāl, left (side) (m., gen.), + ـي, my; 'my left'
الْوَزِيرُإِلَيَّ: الـ + وَزِير + إِلَى + ي — wazīr, vizier (m., nom.), + ilā, to (prep.), + ـي, me; printed run together; 'the vizier to me'
وَأَقْعَدَنِي: و + أَقْعَدَ + نِي — wa-, and, + aqʿada, to seat (perfect, 3rd m.s.), + ـنِي, me; 'and seats me'
وَيَقْعُدُ: و + يَقْعُدُ — wa-, and, + qaʿada, to sit (imperfect, 3rd m.s.); 'and sits'
دُونِي: دُون + ي — dūn, below, beneath (prep.), + ـي, me; 'below me'
صِهْرِي: صِهْر + ي — ṣihr, relative by marriage, in-law (m., nom. predicate), + ـي, my; 'my in-law'
خَادِمَيْنِ: خَادِم — khādim, servant (m.), dual oblique form (-ayni, here used as subject); 'two servants'
بِكِيسَيْنِ: بِـ + كِيس — bi-, with, carrying (prep.), + kīs, purse, bag (m.), dual gen.; 'with two purses'
فَأُعْطِيهِ: فَـ + أُعْطِي + هِ — fa-, so/and (conj.), + aʿṭā, to give (imperfect, 1st s.), + ـهِ, him; 'and I give him'
مَهْرَ: مَهْر — mahr, dowry (m., acc. in construct); 'as the dowry of'
بِنْةِ: بِنْة — bint, girl (the print has ة for ت; gen.), 'the girl'
وَأُهْدِي: و + أُهْدِي — wa-, and, + ahdā, to give as a gift (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I give as a gift'
وَكَرَمِي: و + كَرَم + ي — wa-, and, + karam, generosity (m.), + ـي, my; 'and my generosity'
وَكِبَرَ: و + كِبَر — wa-, and, + kibar, greatness (m., acc. in construct); 'and the greatness of'
وَصِغَرَ: و + صِغَر — wa-, and, + ṣighar, smallness (m., acc. in construct); 'and the smallness of'
خَاطَبَنِي: خَاطَبَ + نِي — khāṭaba, to address (perfect, 3rd m.s.), + ـنِي, me; 'he addresses me'
بِعَشْرِ: بِـ + عَشْر — bi-, with, in (prep.; 'in the form of'), + ʿashr, ten (gen.); 'with ten' Also, after وَإِذَا of surprise, bi- only marks what appears: وَإِذَا بِعَشْرِ جَوَارٍ 'and behold, ten slave-girls'.
أَجَبْتُهُ: أَجَبْتُ + هُ — ajāba, to answer (perfect, 1st s.), + ـهُ, him; 'I answer him'
بِكَلِمَتَيْنِ: بِـ + كَلِمَتَيْنِ — bi-, with (prep.; the means of the answer), + kalima dual gen., two words; 'with two words'
أَنْصَرِفُ: أَنْصَرِفُ — inṣarafa, to depart (imperfect, 1st s.); 'I go back'
امْرَأَتِي: امْرَأَة + ي — imraʾa, wife, woman (f., precomposed أ as printed), + ـي, my; 'my wife'
وَخَلَعْتُ: و + خَلَعْتُ — wa-, and, + khalaʿa, to take off; khalaʿa ʿalā, to bestow a robe on (perfect, 1st s.); 'and I bestow'
رَدَّيْتُهَا: رَدَّيْتُ + هَا — raddā (for radda), to send back (perfect, 1st s., spoken-style form), + ـهَا, it (f.); 'I return it'
أَقْبَلْهَا: أَقْبَلْ + هَا — qabila, to accept (jussive, 1st s.), + ـهَا, it; 'I accept it'
مَوْضِعِهَا: مَوْضِع + هَا — mawḍiʿ, place (m., gen.), + ـهَا, its/her; 'its place'
بِإِ: بِـ + إِ — bi-, with (prep.; 'with the doing of'), + i-, the first part of iṣlāḥ, printed split from صلاح; 'with (the) i-'
صْلَاحِ: صْلَاحِ — -ṣlāḥ, the rest of iṣlāḥ, setting right (m., gen.); '(the) setting right'
شَأْنِي: شَأْن + ي — shaʾn, affair, matter (m., gen.), + ـي, my; 'my affair'
أَمَرْتُهُمْ: أَمَرْتُ + هُمْ — amara, to command (perfect, 1st s.), + ـهُمْ, them; 'I command them'
بِزِفَا: بِـ + زِفَا — bi-, to, with (prep.; amara bi-, 'command to do'), + zifā, bringing-in of a bride (obscure, perhaps zifāf); 'to (do) the bringing-in'
وَأُصْلِحُ: و + أُصْلِحُ — wa-, and, + aṣlaḥa, to put right (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I put right'
بَيِّنًا: بَيِّن — bayyin, clear, evident (m., acc. indef.); 'evident'
الدِّيبَاجِ: الـ + دِّيبَاج — dībāj, brocade, silk (m., gen.); 'the brocade'
مُتَّكِئًا: مُتَّكِئ — muttaki', reclining (active participle, m., acc. indef., circumstantial; the edition's ئ); 'reclining'
أَلْتَفِتُ: أَلْتَفِتُ — iltafata, to turn (the head) (imperfect, 1st s.); 'I turn'
شِمَالًا: شِمَال — shimāl, left (side) (m., acc. indef., adverbial); 'to the left'
لِكِبَرِ: لِـ + كِبَر — li-, because of, on account of (prep.), + kibar, greatness (m., gen. in construct); 'because of the greatness of'
قَائِمَةً: قَائِمَة — qāʾima, standing (f., acc. indef.; the edition's ئ); 'standing'
حُلِيِّهَا: حُلِيّ + هَا — ḥuliyy, ornaments, jewellery (pl., gen.), + ـهَا, her; 'her jewels'
وَحُلَلِهَا: و + حُلَل + هَا — wa-, and, + ḥulal, robes (pl. of ḥulla, gen.), + ـهَا, her; 'and her robes'
عُجْبًا: عُجْب — ʿujb, self-admiration, delight (m., acc. indef., adverbial; the edition's damma); 'in vain delight'
وَتِيهًـا: و + تِيه — wa-, and, + tīh, pride, haughtiness (m., acc. indef.; with the edition's stroke); 'and in pride'
حَضَرَنَا: حَضَرَ + نَا — ḥaḍara, to be present (perfect, 3rd m.s.), + ـنَا, us; 'were present with us'
امْرَأَنُكَ: امْرَأَة (misprint) + كَ — imraʾa, wife (printed with ن for ت), + ـكَ, your; 'your wife'
وَجَارِيَتُكَ: و + جَارِيَة + كَ — wa-, and, + jāriya, slave girl (f., nom.), + ـكَ, your; 'and your slave girl'
قَائِمَةٌ: قَائِمَة — qāʾima, standing (f., nom. indef., predicate); 'standing'
فَأَنْعِمْ: فَـ + أَنْعِمْ — fa-, so (conj.), + anʿama, to show favour (imperative, m.s.); 'so favour'
أَضَرَّبِهَا: أَضَرَّ + بِـ + هَا — aḍarra, to harm (perfect, 3rd m.s.; printed with its shadda), + bi-, (prep.; aḍarra bi-, 'harm'), + ـهَا, her; 'has harmed her'
الْقِيَامُ: الـ + قِيَام — qiyām, standing (m., nom., verbal noun); 'the standing'
يَبُوسُونَ: يَبُوسُونَ — bāsa, to kiss (imperfect, 3rd m.pl.); 'they kiss'
أَرْفَعُ: أَرْفَعُ — rafaʿa, to raise (imperfect, 1st s.); 'I raise'
نَظْرَةًوَاحِدَةً: نَظْرَةً + وَاحِدَة — naẓra, a look (acc. indef.), + wāḥida, one (f.); printed as one word; 'one look'
أُطْرِقُ: أُطْرِقُ — aṭraqa, to lower the head or eyes (imperfect, 1st s.); 'I lower'
فَيَمْضُونَ: فَـ + يَمْضُونَ — fa-, and so (conj.), + maḍā, to go off (imperfect, 3rd m.pl.); 'and they go'
امَنَامِ: امَنَام — (a)l-manām, sleep, bed (m., gen.; the print drops the lām); 'the sleeping place'
وَأَقُومُ: و + أَقُومُ — wa-, and, + qāma, to get up (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I get up'
وَأُغَيِّرُ: و + أُغَيِّرُ — wa-, and, + ghayyara, to change (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I change'
قُمَاشِي: قُمَاش + ي — qumāsh, cloth, clothes (m., acc.), + ـي, my; 'my clothes'
وَأَلْبَسُ: و + أَلْبَسُ — wa-, and, + labisa, to wear (imperfect, 1st s.); 'and I wear'
يَسْأَلُونِي: يَسْأَلُونِي — saʾala, to ask (imperfect, 3rd m.pl., subjunctive after ḥattā), + ـي, me; 'they ask me'
جِلَاؤُهَا: جِلَاؤُ + هَا — jilāʾ, unveiling (m., nom.; the edition's ؤ), + ـهَا, her; 'her unveiling'
آ: stray آ (ā) before أَمُرُ — a printer's doubling of the verb's initial hamza; no meaning of its own
احْتِقَارًالِأَنْ: احْتِقَارًا + لِـ + أَنْ — iḥtiqār, contempt (m.), acc. of manner 'in contempt'; li-, for (prep.) + an, that: 'so that' (printed run together)
ادْفَعْ: ادْفَعْ — imperative of dafaʿa, to give, push; 'give!'
الثَّٰلِثَةُ: الـ + ثَالِثَة — thālitha, third (f.); 'the third' (ā written with the dagger alif)
الزُّجَاجَاتِ: الـ + زُجَاجَات — zujājāt, glass pieces, bottles (f. pl.); 'the glassware'
الصَّلَوةَ: الـ + صَلَوة — ṣalāt, prayer (f.); 'the prayer' (acc. after أَنَّ)
الِانْقِبَــاضَ: الـ + انْقِبَاض — inqibāḍ, contraction, withdrawal, reserve (m.); 'the reserve' (acc.)
الْهِمْيَانِ: الـ + هِمْيَان — himyān, money-belt (m.); 'the money-belt' (gen. after فِي)
انْكَسَرَ: انْكَسَرَ — inkasara, form VII of kasara, to break; 'it was broken'
أَتَوَضَّأَ: أَ + تَوَضَّأَ — a-, I (1st sg. impf.) + tawaḍḍaʾa (form V), to perform ablution; 'that I perform ablution' (subj. after حَتَّى)
أَخَ: أَخ — akh, brother (m.); 'brother', acc. after أَنَّ, the long ā of أَخَا not written
أَرُدُّ: أَ + رُدُّ — a-, I (1st sg. impf.) + radda, to return, give back; 'I return'
أَمُرُ: أَ + مُرُ — a-, I + amara, to command; 'I command' (the initial hamza of the doubled آ)
أُكَلِّمُهَا: أُ + كَلِّمُ + هَا — u-, I + kallama (form II), to speak to + -hā, her; 'I speak to her'
أُكَلِّمُهَـــا: أُ + كَلِّمُ + هَا — u-, I + kallama (form II), to speak to + -hā, her; 'I speak to her' (printed with an elongating stroke)
إِلَي: إِلَى — ilā, to (prep.), printed with ي
بَسْمَةً: بَسْمَة — basma, smile (f.); 'a smile' (acc.); a doubtful word here, uncertain in this phrase
بِالدَّنَانِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + دَنَانِير — bi-, in, over (prep., the cause of the joy) + al-, the + danānīr, dinars (pl.); 'in the dinars'; also 'with, as regards the dinars' (fa-anti wa-shaʾnuki bi-al-danānīri, 'so the dinars are your affair')
بِالدُّعَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + دُعَاء — bi-, to, with (prep., chosen by أَقْبَلَ 'turn to') + al-, the + duʿāʾ, prayer, invocation (m.); 'to praying' Also after khatama bi-, 'to close with', where bi- marks what one ends on: 'with the supplication'.
بِخَاطِرِهَا: بِـ + خَاطِر + هَا — bi-, with (prep., chosen by جَبَرَ 'console') + khāṭir, mind, heart (m.) + -hā, her; 'her feelings'
بِرِجْلِي: بِـ + رِجْل + ـِي — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + rijl, foot (f.) + -ī, my; 'with my foot'
بِسَرْجِ: بِـ + سَرْج — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment) + sarj, saddle (m.); 'with a saddle (of)'
بِنْتَهَا: بِنْت + هَا — bint, daughter, girl (f.) + -hā, her; 'her daughter' (acc. after إِنَّ)
تَتَوَضَّأَبِهِ: تَ + تَوَضَّأَ + بِـ + هِ — ta-, she + tawaḍḍaʾa (form V), to perform ablution; bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + -hi, it; 'that she perform ablution with it' (printed as one word)
تَرَكْتُهَا: تَرَكَ + تُ + هَا — taraka, to leave + -tu, I + -hā, her; 'I leave her'
تَرُدَّ: تَ + رُدَّ — ta-, you (m.) + radda (jussive after لَا), to return, refuse; 'do not refuse'
تَشْتَهِى: تَ + شْتَهِى — ta-, she + ishtahā (form VIII), to desire; 'she desires'
تَقُـولُ: تَ + قُولُ — ta-, she + qāla, to say; 'she says' (printed with an elongating stroke)
تَقُولَ: تَ + قُولَ — ta-, she + qāla, to say (subj. after حَتَّى); 'she says'
تُحْضَرَا: تُ + حْضَرَا — tu-, she (3rd f. passive) + aḥḍara (form IV), to bring; 'she is brought' (the final alif is stray; uncertain)
تُقَدِّمُهُ: تُ + قَدِّمُ + هُ — tu-, she + qaddama (form II), to bring forward, offer + -hu, it; 'she brings it forward'
تُوَسِّعَ: تُ + وَسِّعَ — tu-, you (m.) + wassaʿa (form II, subj.), to make wide; 'you make room'
جَاءَتْنِى: جَاءَتْ + نِى — jāʾat, she came (jāʾa, to come) + -nī, me; 'she came to me'
جَارِيَتَكَ: جَارِيَة + كَ — jāriya, slave-girl, handmaid (f.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your handmaid' (acc.)
جَارِيَتِكَ: جَارِيَة + كَ — jāriya, slave-girl, handmaid (f.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your handmaid' (gen.)
حُبِّكَ: حُبّ + كَ — ḥubb, love (m.) + -ka, your; 'your love' (gen. after مِنْ)
خَاطِرُهَا: خَاطِر + هَا — khāṭir, heart, mind (m.) + -hā, her; 'her heart'
دَفَعَهُ: دَفَعَ + هُ — dafaʿa, to give, hand over + -hu, it; 'he gave it'
دُعَاءً: دُعَاء — duʿāʾ, prayer, invocation (m.); 'a prayer' (acc., cognate object)
رَائِحُونَ: رَائِح — rāʾiḥ, going, going out (active part. of rāḥa) + -ūn (m. pl.); 'going'
رَاكِبَةٌ: رَاكِب — rākib, riding (active part. of rakiba) + -a (f.); 'riding'
رَأَتْ: رَأَى + تْ — raʾā, to see + -at, she; 'she saw'
شُرْبِهِ: شُرْب + هِ — shurb, drinking (m.) + -hi, it; 'drinking it'
صَرَّهَا: صَرَّ + هَا — ṣarra, to tie up, bundle + -hā, them (the dinars); 'he tied them up'
طَائِرٌ: طَائِر — ṭāʾir, flying (active part. of ṭāra, to fly) (m.); 'flying'
عَظِيمُ: عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great (m.); 'great (of)', in construct with الشَّأْنِ
عِدَّةُ: عِدَّة — ʿidda, number, a number of (f.); 'a number (of)'
فَاجْبُرْ: فَ + اجْبُرْ — fa-, so (conj.) + imperative of jabara, to mend, console; 'so console!'
فَانْكَسَرَ: فَ + انْكَسَرَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + inkasara (form VII), to break; 'and it broke'
فَأَصَابَهُ: فَ + أَصَابَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aṣāba (form IV), to befall, strike + -hu, him; 'and there befell him'
فَأَنْفُضُ: فَ + أَ + نْفُضُ — fa-, then (conj.) + a-, I + nafaḍa, to shake, flick; 'then I shake'
فَتَكَسَّرَ: فَ + تَكَسَّرَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + takassara (form V), to be shattered; 'and was smashed'
فَتُقَبِّلُ: فَ + تُقَبِّلُ — fa-, and then (conj.) + qabbala (form II), to kiss; 'and she kisses'
فَتُلِحُّ: فَ + تُلِحُّ — fa-, so (conj.) + alaḥḥa (form IV), to insist; 'so she insists'
فَمِلْ: فَ + مِلْ — fa-, so (conj.) + imperative of māla, to incline; 'so incline!'
فَنَادَتْ: فَ + نَادَتْ — fa-, and (conj.) + nādat, she called (nādā); 'and she called'
قَرُبَتْ: قَرُبَ + تْ — qaruba, to be near + -at, she/it; 'it has come near'
قُرْبَكَ: قُرْب + كَ — qurb, nearness (m.) + -ka, your; 'your nearness'
لِلْمَوَاشِطِ: لِـ + الـ + مَوَاشِط — li-, to (prep., marking the one given to) + al-, the + mawāshiṭ, hairdressers, brides' attendants (pl. of māshiṭa); 'to the hairdressers'
مَاتَرَيْنَ: مَا + تَرَيْنَ — mā, what + tarayna, you (f.) see (raʾā); 'what you see' (printed as one word)
مَارَأَتْ: مَا + رَأَتْ — mā, not + raʾat, she saw; 'she has not seen' (printed as one word)
مَاشِيَةٌ: مَاشِي + ة — māshī, walking, going (active part. of mashā) (f.); 'going, walking'
مَنْزِلَكَ: مَنْزِل + كَ — manzil, house (m.) + -ka, your; 'your house'
مُتَّكِىً: مُتَّكِئ — muttakiʾ, reclining (active part. of ittakaʾa, form VIII) (m.); 'reclining' (acc., state; printed with ى and a tanwīn mark)
مُدَوَّرَةٍ: مُدَوَّرَة — mudawwara, round (f.), 'a round (cushion)'; the exact object is unsure
مِنِّى: مِنْ + ـِي — min, from (prep.) + -ī, me (printed with ى); 'from me'
مْرَأَةٍ: مْرَأَة — mraʾa, woman (f.), the rest of امرأة after the split بِا; 'woman' (gen.)
نَظَرْتَ: نَظَرَ + تَ — naẓara, to look + -ta, you (m.); 'you looked'
وَآمُرُهُمْ: وَ + آمُرُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + āmuru, I command (amara) + -hum, them; 'and I command them'
وَالثَّلَٰثُونَ: وَ + الـ + ثَلَاثُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + thalāthūn, thirty (nom.); 'and the thirty'
وَالرِّبْحُ: وَ + الـ + رِبْح — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ribḥ, profit (m.); 'and the profit'
وَالْقَفَصُ: وَ + الـ + قَفَص — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + qafaṣ, crate (m.); 'and the crate'
وَأَرْفُسُهَا: وَ + أَ + رْفُسُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + a-, I + rafasa, to kick + -hā, her; 'and I kick her'
وَأَمَرَهَا: وَ + أَمَرَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + amara, to command + -hā, her; 'and he told her' ; also: with bi- of what is ordered: amarahā bi-al-niyāmi, 'he ordered her to sleep'
وَأُحِبُّ: وَ + أُ + حِبُّ — wa-, and (conj.) + u-, I + aḥabba (form IV), to like; 'and I like'
وَتَجِيئُ: وَ + تَجِيئُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tajīʾu, she comes (jāʾa); 'and she comes'
وَتُحْضِرُلِي: وَ + تُحْضِرُ + لِـ + ـِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tuḥḍiru, she brings (aḥḍara) + li-, to, for (prep.) + -ī, me; 'and she brings me' (printed as one word)
وَحَالِ: وَ + حَال — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāl, state (m.); 'and the state (of)'
وَرَحِمَهُ: وَ + رَحِمَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + raḥima, to pity + -hu, him; 'and pitied him'
وَرَقَّ: وَ + رَقَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + raqqa, to grow tender; 'and grew tender' Also of bones, 'to grow thin, frail' with age: wa-raqqa ʿaẓmuhu, 'and his bones grew thin'.
وَسَأَلَتْ: وَ + سَأَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + saʾalat, she asked (saʾala); 'and she asked'
وَصَلَّتْ: وَ + صَلَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣallat, she prayed (ṣallā, form II); 'and she prayed'
وَفَرَغَتِ: وَ + فَرَغَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + faraghat, she finished (faragha); 'and she finished'
وَكَلِّمْهَا: وَ + كَلِّمْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + imperative of kallama (form II), to speak to + -hā, her; 'and speak to her'
وَمِنْهُمْ: وَ + مِنْ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + min, from, among (prep.) + -hum, them; 'and among them'
وَيَدَيَّ: وَ + يَدَيَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + yad, hand (f.), dual + -ya, my; 'and my two hands'
وَيَلْطِمُ: وَ + يَلْطِمُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yalṭimu, he strikes (laṭama); 'and strike (himself)'
يَتَعَيَّشُ: يَ + تَعَيَّشُ — ya-, he + taʿayyasha (form V), to make a living; 'he lives, makes his living'
يَرْمِيَ: يَرْمِيَ — yarmiya, he throws (ramā), subj. after أَنْ; 'that he throw'
يَعْرِفُهَا: يَعْرِفُ + هَا — yaʿrifu, he knows (ʿarafa) + -hā, her; 'he knows her'
يَفُوحُ: يَفُوحُ — yafūḥu, it wafts, gives off scent (fāḥa); 'wafts'
يَلْرِي: يَلْرِي — yalrī, an unclear form, possibly a misprint for يَدَيَّ 'my hands'; see the note
يَنْظُرُونَ: يَ + نْظُرُ + ونَ — ya-, they + naẓara, to look + -ūna (m. pl.); 'they look'
يُدْخِلُونِي: يُ + دْخِلُ + ون + نِي — yu-, they + adkhala (form IV), to bring in + -ūn (m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'they bring me in'
يُفَكِّرْ: يُ + فَكِّرْ — yu-, he + fakkara (form II, jussive after لَمْ), to think; 'he thinks (not)'
يُقَالَ: يُقَالَ — yuqāla, it is said (passive of qāla, subj. after لِـ أَنْ); 'it be said'
الصُّعَالِيكِ: الـ + صُعَالِيك — al-, the + ṣuʿlūk (pl. ṣaʿālīk), pauper, vagabond (m.); 'the vagabonds' (fragment: the clause begins before this slice)
وَارْدُدْهُ: و + اُرْدُدْ + هُ — wa-, and + urdud, imperative of radda, give back + -hu, it; 'and return it'
الاِجْتِمَاعَ: الـ + اِجْتِمَاع — al-, the + ijtimāʿ, coming together, meeting (m.; verbal noun of VIII); acc.
أَعْطَتْكَ: أَعْطَتْ + كَ — aʿṭat, 3 f.sg. perf. of aʿṭā, give + -ka, you; 'she gave you'
الْحِيلَةُ: الـ + حِيلَة — al-, the + ḥīla, device, stratagem, way (f.)
تَمِيلُ: تَمِيلُ — tamīlu, 3 f.sg. imperf. of māla, incline, lean; 'she inclines'
مُوسِرٍ: مُوسِرٍ — mūsir, well-off, wealthy (act. part. of IV); gen., adj.
دُلَّكَ: دُلَّ + كَ — duLLa, 1 sg. subj. of dalla, guide, show (second half of the split word) + -ka, you; 'that I guide you'
الْمُرَادِ: الـ + مُرَاد — al-, the + murād, the desired thing, aim (m.; pass. part. of arāda)
اجْتَمَعْتَ: اجْتَمَعْتَ — ijtamaʿta, 2 m.sg. perf. of VIII ijtamaʿa, meet, come together; 'you met'
تُخْلِي: تُخْلِي — tukhlī, 2 m.sg. imperf. of IV akhlā, leave empty, omit (final -ī for the jussive)
الْمُلَاطَفَةِ: الـ + مُلَاطَفَة — al-, the + mulāṭafa, gentle dealing, kindness (f.; verbal noun of III)
وَالْكَلَامِ: و + الـ + كَلَام — wa-, and + al-, the + kalām, speech, talk (m.)
وَتَفْعَلُهُ: و + تَفْعَلُ + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'but that you do it') + tafʿalu, 2 m.sg. imperf. of faʿala, do + -hu, it
تَنَالُ: تَنَالُ — tanālu, 2 m.sg. imperf. of nāla, obtain, get; 'you will obtain'
جَمَالِهَا: جَمَال + هَا — jamāl, beauty (m.) + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
لِهَا: لِهَا — second half of the split مَا لِهَا = مَالِهَا: māl, wealth (m.) + -hā, her; 'her wealth'
وَهُوَلَا: و + هُوَ + لَا — wa-, and + huwa, he + lā, not; written as one word; 'and he not'
فَدَقَّتْهُ: فَ + دَقَّتْ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + daqqat, 3 f.sg. perf. of daqqa, knock + -hu, it; 'and she knocked at it'
رُومِيَّةٌ: رُومِيَّةٌ — rūmiyya, Rūmī, Byzantine, Greek (f. adj. from Rūm)
وَأَمَرَتْ: و + أَمَرَتْ — wa-, and + amarat, 3 f.sg. perf. of amara, command, bid; takes bi- for the thing commanded
وَمَجْلِسٍ: و + مَجْلِس — wa-, and + majlis, sitting-room, hall (m.); gen.
مَفْرُوشٍ: مَفْرُوشٍ — mafrūsh, spread, furnished (pass. part. of faraśha); gen., adj. of majlis
أَرْضُهُ: أَرْض + هُ — arḍ, floor, ground (f.) + -hu, its; 'its floor' (subject of mafrūsh)
بِالزَّوَالِى: بِـ + الـ + زَوَالِي — bi-, with (prep.; 'spread with') + al-, the + zawālī, carpets (pl. of zūliyya/zilliyya, rug)
الْعَجِيبَةِ: الـ + عَجِيبَة — al-, the + ʿajība, wondrous, marvellous (f. adj.)
وَسُتُورٍ: و + سُتُورٍ — wa-, and + sutūr, curtains (pl. of sitr); gen.
رُكْبَتِهِ: رُكْبَة + هِ — rukba, knee (f.) + -hi, his; 'his knee'
وَجَارِيَةٌ: و + جَارِيَةٌ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + jāriya, girl (f.); nom.
مَارَأَتِ: مَا + رَأَتِ — mā, not + raʾat, 3 f.sg. perf. of raʾā, see (-i before al-); written as one word
الرَّاؤُنَ: الـ + رَاؤُنَ — al-, the + rāʾūn, beholders, seers (m. pl. act. part. of raʾā; printed without the wāw)
بِسَةٌ: بِسَةٌ — second half of the split لَا بِسَةٌ = lābisa, wearing (f. act. part. of labisa, wear); first half is lā
فَأُغْلِقَ: فَ + أُغْلِقَ — fa-, so (conj.) + ughliqa, 3 m.sg. perf. passive of IV aghlaqa, lock, shut
مُنْفَرِدَةٍ: مُنْفَرِدَةٍ — munfarida, apart, secluded (f. act. part. of VII infarada); gen., adj.
فَدَخَلَاهَا: فَ + دَخَلَا + هَا — fa-, so (conj.) + dakhalā, 3 dual perf. of dakhala, enter + -hā, it; 'they both entered it'
عَبَتْهُ: عَبَتْ + هُ — second half of the split wa-lāʿabat-hu: ʿabat (3 f.sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'she played with him'
تَبْرَحْ: تَبْرَحْ — tabraḥ, 2 m.sg. jussive of bariḥa, depart, leave; 'do not leave'
مَكَانِكَ: مَكَان + كَ — makān, place (m.) + -ka, your; 'your place'
أَجِيْ: أَجِيْ — ajī, 1 sg. subj. of jāʾa, come (hamza dropped; sukūn as printed)
الْخِلْقَةِ: الـ + خِلْقَة — al-, the + khilqa, build, bodily make (f.); 'huge of build'
مُجَرَّدٌ: مُجَرَّدٌ — mujarrad, drawn, bare (m. pass. part. of II jarrada)
وَانْعَقَدَ: و + انْعَقَدَ — wa-, and + inʿaqada, 3 m.sg. perf. of VII inʿaqada, be tied, knotted
لِسَانُهُ: لِسَان + هُ — lisān, tongue (m.) + -hu, his; 'his tongue'
وَعَرَّاهُ: و + عَرَّا + هُ — wa-, and + ʿarrā, 3 m.sg. perf. of II ʿarrā, strip + -hu, him; 'and stripped him'
سَطْحًا: سَطْحًا — saṭḥ, flat, flatly (m.) + -an, acc. adverbial; 'with the flat (of the blade)'
الأَرْضِ: الـ + أَرْض — al-, the + arḍ, ground, earth (f.)
وَاعْتَقَدَ: و + اعْتَقَدَ — wa-, and + iʿtaqada, 3 m.sg. perf. of VIII iʿtaqada, believe, suppose
الْمَمْلَحَةُ: الـ + مَمْلَحَة — al-, the + mamlaḥa, salt-cellar, salt-vessel (f.; a place/vessel noun of malaḥa; reading uncertain)
قْبَلَتْ: قْبَلَتْ — second part of the split fa-aqbalat: (a)qbalat, 3 f.sg. perf. of IV aqbala, come forward
يَحْشُو: يَحْشُو — yaḥshū, 3 m.sg. imperf. of ḥashā, stuff, fill
جِرَاحَاتِ: جِرَاحَاتِ — jirāḥāt, wounds (f. pl. of jirāḥa); acc., annexed
يَتَحَرَّكُ: يَتَحَرَّكُ — yataḥarraku, 3 m.sg. imperf. of V taḥarraka, move
خِيفَةً: خِيفَةً — khīfa, fear (f.) + -an, acc. of cause; 'for fear'
فَيَقْتُلَهُ: فَ + يَقْتُلَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + yaqtula, 3 m.sg. subj. of qatala, kill + -hu, him
وَيُرَوِّحَ: و + يُرَوِّحَ — wa-, and + yurawwiḥa, 3 m.sg. subj. of II rawwaḥa, make go away, dispatch
الْمُسَرْدِيبَةِ: الـ + مُسَرْدِيبَة — al-, the + musardība, obscure (perhaps from sirdāb, cellar); read as a name or epithet
وَجَرَّتْهُ: و + جَرَّتْ + هُ — wa-, and + jarrat, 3 f.sg. perf. of jarra, drag + -hu, him; 'and she dragged him'
سِرْدَابٍ: سِرْدَابٍ — sirdāb, cellar, underground chamber (m.); gen. after ilā
فَرَمَتْهُ: فَ + رَمَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ramat, 3 f.sg. perf. of ramā, throw + -hu, him; 'and threw him'
جَمَاعَةِ: جَمَاعَةِ — jamāʿa, company, group (f.); gen., annexed
قَتْلَى: قَتْلَى — qatlā, slain, killed (m. pl. of qatīl)
مَقَامَهُ: مَقَام + هُ — maqām, place, standing-place (m.) + -hu, his; 'in his place'
الْمِلْحَ: الـ + مِلْح — al-, the + milḥ, salt (m.)
حَيَاتِهِ: حَيَاة + هِ — ḥayāt, life (f.) + -hi, his; 'his life'
الْقُوَّةَ: الـ + قُوَّة — al-, the + quwwa, strength (f.); acc.
الْحَرَكَةِ: الـ + حَرَكَة — al-, the + ḥaraka, movement (f.)
السِّرْدَابِ: الـ + سِرْدَاب — al-, the + sirdāb, cellar (m.)
طَابِقَهُ: طَابِق + هُ — ṭābiq, hatch, trap-door (m.; reading uncertain) + -hu, its; 'its hatch'
بَرٍّ: بَرٍّ — barr, open land, the outside (m.); gen. after ilā
وَاخْتَفَى: و + اخْتَفَى — wa-, and + ikhtafā, 3 m.sg. perf. of VIII ikhtafā, hide oneself
الْهَلِيزِ: الـ + هَلِيز — al-, the + halīz, vestibule, entrance-passage (m.; colloquial for dihlīz, from Persian)
صَيْدٍ: صَيْدٍ — ṣayd, game, prey (m.); gen., annexed
إِثْرِهَا: إِثْر + هَا — ithr, track, footsteps (m.) + -hā, her; 'in her track'
يُعَالِجُ: يُعَالِجُ — yuʿāliju, 3 m.sg. imperf. of III ʿālaja, treat, tend (a wound or sickness)
بَرِئَ: بَرِئَ — bariʾa, 3 m.sg. perf. of bariʾa, recover, be healed
يَتَعَهَّدُ: يَتَعَهَّدُ — yataʿahhadu, 3 m.sg. imperf. of V taʿahhada, look after, keep watch on
وَتُؤَدِّيهِمْ: و + تُؤَدِّي + هِمْ — addā (II), to deliver, convey; tu-, 'you / she' (3fs or 2ms); -hum, them; 'and deliver them'
وَقُوَّتُهُ: و + قُوَّة + ـهُ — wa-, and; quwwa, strength; -hu, his; 'and his strength'
عَمَدَ: ʿamada, he set out for, betook himself to
وَمَلَاءَهُ: و + مَلَأَ + هُ — malaʾa, to fill; -hu, it; 'and filled it' (printed with the hamza as a separate letter)
وَشَدَّهُ: و + شَدَّ + هُ — shadda, to bind, tie; 'and bound it'
وَتَنَكَّرَ: و + تَنَكَّرَ — tanakkara (V), to disguise oneself; 'and he disguised himself'
يَعْرِفَهُ: يَعْرِفَ + هُ — lā, not; yaʿrifa, he know (subjunctive after ḥattā); -hu, him; 'so that he not know him'
عَجُوزَانَا: عَجُوز + أَنَا — ʿajūz, old woman, with anā, I, printed run together; 'O old woman, I (am)'
مِيزَانٌ: mīzān, a balance, pair of scales
أَهَبُكِ: أَهَبُ + ـكِ — ahabu, I give (wahaba); -ki, you (f.), direct object; 'I will give you'
سَائِرُ: sāʾir, all, the whole of; construct
الْمَوَازِينِ: الـ + مَوَازِين — mawāzīn, scales, balances (pl. of mīzān); genitive; 'the scales'
يَزِنَ: yazina, he weighs (wazana); subjunctive after ḥattā
ذَهَبَكَ: ذَهَب + ـكَ — dhahab, gold; -ka, your (m.); 'your gold'
فَسَارَتْ: فَـ + سَارَتْ — fa-, so; sāra, to walk, go; -at, she; 'and she went on'
فَضَحِكَتِ: فَـ + ضَحِكَتِ — fa-, and; ḍaḥika, to laugh; -at, she; 'and laughed'
بِلَحْمَةٍ: بِـ + لَحْمَة — bi-, with (atā bi- means 'bring'); laḥma, a piece of meat; 'with / bringing a piece of meat'
وَأَدْ: و + أَدْ — wa-, and; ad, the first part of adkhala, he / she brought in, printed split from the rest (see next)
خَلَتْهُ: khalat, the rest of adkhalat, she brought in; -hu, him; read together, 'she brought him in'
الْمَنْزِلَ: الـ + مَنْزِل — manzil, dwelling, house; accusative; also a halting-place, caravan stage (Night 110)
إِلَّاوَهَذَا: إِلَّا + و + هَذَا — illā, except ('but that'); wa-, and, introducing what suddenly happens; hādhā, this (m.); printed as one word
وَالْعَبْدُ: و + الـ + عَبْد — wa-, and, here 'when / that'; ʿabd, slave; 'and the slave'
الْمُجَرَّدُ: الـ + مُجَرَّد — mujarrad, drawn, bare (from jarrada); 'the drawn'
أَمَامَهُ: أَمَام + هُ — amām, in front of; -hu, him; 'before him'
سَيْفِهِ: سَيْف + هِ — sayf, sword; -hi, his; 'his sword'
فَأَطَاحَ: فَـ + أَطَاحَ — fa-, and; aṭāḥa (IV), to make fly off; 'and he sent flying'
وَسَحَبَهُ: و + سَحَبَ + هُ — wa-, and; saḥaba, to drag; -hu, him; 'and dragged him'
الْمُمَلِّحَةُ: الـ + مُمَلِّحَة — al-, the + mumalliḥa, salt-cellar (read as mimlaḥa, as at the earlier مَمْلَحَة; or 'the woman who salts'; uncertain)
الطَّبَقُ: الـ + طَبَق — ṭabaq, tray, platter; nominative
فَلَمَّارَأَتْ: فَـ + لَمَّا + رَأَتْ — fa-, and; lammā, when; raʾat, she saw; printed as one word; 'and when she saw'
وَالسَّيْفُ: و + الـ + سَيْف — wa-, and, 'with' (circumstantial); sayf, sword; 'and the sword'
وَلَّتْ: wallat, she turned away (wallā, II); -at, she
هَارِبَةً: hāriba, fleeing (act. participle, f.); accusative, a circumstantial 'fleeing'
أَطَاحَ: aṭāḥa (IV), he made fly off, struck off
أَتَعْرِفِينَنِي: أَ + تَعْرِفِينَ + نِي — a-, introduces a question; taʿrifīna, you (f.) know; -nī, me; 'do you know me?'
وَصَايَتِ: و + صَايَتِ — wa-, and; ṣāyat, probably for ṣallayti, you (f.) prayed; the form is obscure
وَأَوْقَعْتِنِي: و + أَوْقَعْتِ + نِي — wa-, and; awqaʿa (IV), to make fall; -ti, you (f.); -nī, me; 'and you made me fall'
اِتَّقِ: ittaqi, fear! (imperative of ittaqā, VIII); here with the linking -i
وَتَرَاجَعْ: و + تَرَاجَعْ — wa-, and; tarājaʿ (VI imperative), draw back, relent; 'and relent'
قِطَعٍ: qiṭaʿ, pieces (pl. of qiṭʿa); genitive after the number
عَقْلُهَا: عَقْل + هَا — ʿaql, mind, wits; -hā, her; 'her wits'
فَأَمَّنَهَا: فَـ + أَمَّنَ + هَا — fa-, and; ammana (II), to grant safety; -hā, her; 'and gave her quarter'
أَوْقَعَكِ: أَوْقَعَ + كِ — awqaʿa (IV), to make fall, land; -ki, you (f.); 'brought you'
تَتَرَدَّدُ: tataraddadu, she goes back and forth, calls often (taraddada, V)
فَآنَسْتُ: فَـ + آنَسْتُ — fa-, and so; ānastu, I became friendly (from anisa); -tu, I; 'and I took to'
مَارَى: ما + رَأَى — mā, not; raʾā, he saw, written without the hamza; printed as one word
أَدْخَلَتْنِي: أَدْخَلَتْ + نِي — adkhala (IV), to bring in; -at, she; -nī, me; 'she brought me in'
الْأَسْوَدُ: الـ + أَسْوَد — aswad, black, a black man; nominative
بِحِيلَةِ: بِـ + حِيلَة — bi-, by, through (means); ḥīla, trick, stratagem; 'by the trick of'
شَيْءءٌ: shayʾ, a thing, anything (printed with a doubled hamza)
نَقْلِهِ: نَقْل + هِ — naql, carrying, moving; -hi, it; 'moving it'
فَانْقُلْهُ: فَـ + انْقُلْ + هُ — fa-, then; unqul, carry! (naqala); -hu, it; 'then carry it'
وَاسْتَخِرِ: و + اسْتَخِرِ — wa-, and; istakhir, ask for the best (istakhāra, X imperative)
صَنَادِيقَ: ṣanādīq, chests, boxes (pl. of ṣundūq); accusative
وَأَكْرَى: و + أَكْرَى — wa-, and; akrā (IV), to hire; 'and he hired'
وَلَاأَرَى: و + لَا + أَرَى — wa-, and + lā, not + arā, I see (I; printed run together); 'and I see not' (perhaps for yarā, see note)
وَلَاالْأَكْيَاسَ: و + لَا + الـ + أَكْيَاس — wa-, and + lā, nor + akyās, purses (pl. of kīs); 'and nor the purses' (printed run together)
إِلَّاشَيْئًا: إِلَّا + شَيْئًا — illā, except + shayʾan, a thing (acc.); 'except a thing' (printed run together)
فَعَلِمَ: فَـ + عَلِمَ — fa-, so + ʿalima, he knew (I); 'so he knew'
خَدَعَتْهُ: خَدَعَ + تْ + هُ — khadaʿa, deceive (I) + -at, she (perf.) + -hu, him; 'she deceived him'
الْخَزَائِنَ: الـ + خَزَائِن — khazāʾin, storerooms, chests (pl. of khizāna); 'the storerooms', acc.
مَافِيهَا: مَا + فِي + هَا — mā, what + fī, in (prep.) + -hā, them (f.pl./it); 'what is in them' (printed run together)
شَئْاً: shayʾ, thing (m.), acc. (the hamza is ours; the print carries only the tanwīn); 'a thing'
جُنْدِيًّا: jundī, soldier (m.), acc. sg. after numeral; 'soldiers'
لِيَعْبُرَ: لِـ + يَعْبُرَ — li-, in order that (purpose, with subjunctive) + yaʿbura, he crosses over (I); 'that he might cross'
يُمْهِلُوهُ: yumhilū + -hu — amhala, give respite (IV), jussive after lam, they + him; 'they did not give him respite'
يَرْجِعَ: yarjiʿa, he returns (I), subjunctive after an; 'return'
فَوَعَدَهُمْ: فَـ + وَعَدَ + هُمْ — fa-, so + waʿada, promise (I) + -hum, them; 'so he promised them'
فَأَبَوْا: فَـ + أَبَوْا — fa-, so + abaw, they refused (I); 'so they refused'
رَبَطُوهُ: rabaṭū + -hu — rabaṭa, bind, tie (I), they + him; 'they bound him'
رَبْطًا: rabṭ, binding (verbal noun), acc. cognate; 'a binding'
شَدِ: first half of شَدِيدًا (shadī-dan), 'tight, severe'; printed split from يدًا
يدًا: second half of شَدِيدًا (shadī-dan); printed split from شَدِ; with it 'tightly'
وَتَدَخَّلَ: وَ + تَدَخَّلَ — wa-, and + tadakhkhala, pleaded (V); 'and pleaded'
وَيُسَاعِدَهُ: وَ + يُسَاعِدَ + هُ — wa-, and + yusāʿida, he helps (III, subj.) + -hu, him; 'and help him'
خَلَاصِهِ: خَلَاص + هِ — khalāṣ, deliverance, release (m.) + -hi, his; 'his release'
وَسَأَلَهُمْ: وَ + سَأَلَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + saʾala, ask (I) + -hum, them; 'and asked them'
قِصَّتِهِ: قِصَّة + هِ — qiṣṣa, story, case (f.) + -hi, his; 'his story'
قَدْحَكَمَ: قَدْ + حَكَمَ — qad, (has) already + ḥakama ʿalā, he ruled/ordered against (I; printed run together); 'has ruled'
نُحْضِرَهُ: nuḥḍira + -hu — aḥḍara, bring, produce (IV), we (subj.) + him; 'that we bring him'
ذَاهِبُونَ: dhāhibūn, going (act. part. of dhahaba, m.pl.); 'going'
فَالْتَمَسَ،: فَـ + الْتَمَسَ + ، — fa-, so + iltamasa, he requested, begged (VIII), with the edition's comma; 'so he begged'
يُخَلِّصُوهُ: yukhalliṣū + -hu — khallaṣa, deliver, set free (II), they (subj.) + him; 'that they free him'
وَيُعْطِيهِمْ: وَ + يُعْطِي + هِمْ — wa-, and + yuʿṭī, he gives (IV, indicative) + -him, them; 'and he gives them'
رَجَعْتُمْ: rajaʿtum — rajaʿa, return (I), -tum, you (m.pl.) perf.; 'you return'
فَقُولُوا: فَـ + قُولُوا — fa-, then (apodosis) + qūlū, say! (imper. pl.); 'then say'
مَالَقِينَاهُ: مَا + لَقِينَا + هُ — mā, not + laqīnā, we met (I) + -hu, him; 'we did not meet him' (printed run together)
فَأَعْرَضُوا: فَـ + أَعْرَضُوا — fa-, so + aʿraḍū ʿan, they turned away from (IV); 'so they disregarded'
وَأَخَذُوهُ: وَ + أَخَذُوا + هُ — wa-, and + akhadhū, they took + -hu, him; 'and took him'
مَسْحُوبًا: masḥūb, dragged (pass. part. of saḥaba), acc. as hāl; 'dragged'
أَحْضَرُوهُ: aḥḍarū + -hu — aḥḍara, bring (IV), they + him; 'they brought him'
الْقُمَاشُ: الـ + قُمَاش — qumāsh, cloth (m.); 'the cloth', nom.
وَالْمَالُ: وَ + الـ + مَال — wa-, and + māl, money; 'and the money', nom.
مِنْدِيلَ: mindīl, handkerchief, kerchief (m.), acc. in construct
بِمَاجَرَى: بِـ + مَا + جَرَى — bi-, with/of (verbs of telling, ḥaddatha and akhbara, take bi- for what is told) + mā, what + jarā, it happened (I); 'about what happened' (printed run together)
وَمَاوَقَعَ: وَ + مَا + وَقَعَ — wa-, and + mā, what + waqaʿa, it befell (I); 'and what befell' (printed run together)
وَهُرُوبِ: وَ + هُرُوب — wa-, and + hurūb, flight, escape (m.), gen. (joined to bi-mā); 'and the flight of'
أَخَذْتَهُ: akhadhta + -hu — akhadha, take, + -ta, you (m.sg.) + him; 'you took'
مَاشِئْتَ: مَا + شِئْتَ — mā, what + shiʾta, you wished (I); 'what you wish' (printed run together)
أَتَقَوَّتُ: ataqawwatu — taqawwata bi-, subsist on (V), 1st sg. imperf.; 'I subsist'
وَالْمَالَ: وَ + الـ + مَال — wa-, and + māl, money; 'and the money', acc.
يَبْلُغَ: yablugha, he/it reaches (I), subjunctive after an; 'reach'
وَإِلَّاشَنَقَكَ: وَ + إِلَّا + شَنَقَ + كَ — wa-, and + illā, if not (otherwise) + shanaqa, he hanged (I, perf. in threat) + -ka, you; 'or else he hangs you' (printed run together)
اللُّصُوصُ: الـ + لُصُوص — luṣūṣ, thieves, robbers (pl. of liṣṣ); 'the robbers', nom.
فَعَرَّوْهُ: فَـ + عَرَّوْا + هُ — fa-, so + ʿarraw, they stripped (II) + -hu, him; 'so they stripped him'
وَقَطَعُوا: وَ + قَطَعُوا — wa-, and + qaṭaʿū, they cut off (I); 'and cut off'
أُذُنَيْهِ: أُذُنَيْ + هِ — udhun, ear (f.), dual acc. + -hi, his; 'his two ears'
يَسْلُبُهُ: يَسْلُبُ + هُ — yaslubu, he strips (I) + -hu, him; 'strips him of' (probably a corruption, see note)
رَمَقَهُ: رَمَق + هُ — ramaq, last breath, scrap of life (m.), acc. + -hu, his; 'his last breath'
الطُّرُقِ: الـ + طُرُق — ṭuruq, roads, streets (pl. of ṭarīq); 'the streets'
إِذْرَى: إِذْ + رَى — idh, when (conj.) + rā, he saw (rā for raʾā, alif of raʾā missing in print); 'when he saw'
وَنَهْيٌ: وَ + نَهْي — wa-, and + nahy, prohibition (m.), nom.
لِإِنْسَانٍ: لِـ + إِنْسَان — li-, belonging to (prep.; 'is for/owned by') + insān, person, man (m.); 'to a man'
الْبَرَامِكَةِ: الـ + بَرَامِكَة — barāmika, the Barmakids (pl. of Barmakī), the vizier family; 'the Barmakids'
الْبَوَّابِينَ: الـ + بَوَّابِين — bawwābīn, doorkeepers (pl. of bawwāb), gen.; 'the doorkeepers'
وَسَاهُمْ: وَ + سَاهُمْ — wa-, and + sāhum (printed so; apparently saʾalahum, 'asked them'); 'and asked them'
صَاحِبِنَا: صَاحِب + نَا — ṣāḥib, master, owner (m.), gen. after min + -nā, our; 'our master'
الدِّهْلِيزَ: الـ + دِهْلِيز — dihlīz, vestibule (m.); 'the vestibule', acc.
فَوَصَلَ: فَـ + وَصَلَ — fa-, so + waṣala ilā, he arrived at (I); 'so he came'
الْمَلَاحَةِ: الـ + مَلَاحَة — malāḥa, elegance, charm (f.); 'the elegance', gen. after min
وَالطُّرَفِ: وَ + الـ + طُرَف — wa-, and + ṭuraf, rarities, curiosities (pl. of ṭurfa); 'and rarities' (perhaps for ẓarf 'refinement')
وَسُتُورُهَا: وَ + سُتُور + هَا — wa-, and + sutūr, curtains (pl. of sitr), nom. + -hā, its; 'and its curtains'
يَتَّصِلُ: yattaṣilu, he proceeds, makes his way (VIII, imperf.)
وَاللِّحْيَةِ: وَ + الـ + لِحْيَة — wa-, and + liḥya, beard (f.); 'and the beard'
مُحْتَاجٌ: muḥtāj, needy (act. part. of VIII), nom.
فَخَرَقَهَا: فَـ + خَرَقَ + هَا — fa-, so + kharaqa, tear (I) + -hā, them (f.); 'so he tore them'
بِبَلَدٍ: بِـ + بَلَد — bi-, in (prep.) + balad, town, land (m.); 'in a town'
جَائِعٌ: jāʾiʿ, hungry (act. part. of jāʿa), nom.
لَاصَبْرَ: لَا + صَبْرَ — lā, no (of absolute negation) + ṣabra, patience (m., acc.); 'no patience' (printed run together)
وَوَعَدَهُ: وَ + وَعَدَ + هُ — wa-, and + waʿada, he promised + -hu, him; 'and he promised him'
تُمَاكِلَنِي: tumākila + -nī — mākala, eat together with (III; Classical muʾākala), 2nd m.sg. subj. + me; 'that you eat with me'
لَشَدِيدُ: لَـ + شَدِيدُ — la-, indeed (emphatic, on the predicate after inna) + shadīd, severe (adj.), nom. in construct; 'severely'
الْجُوعِ: الـ + جُوع — jūʿ, hunger (m.); 'the hunger', gen.
غُلَامُ: ghulām, boy, servant (m.), nom. vocative; 'boy'; here: nom., predicate, construct: ghulāmu ʿAliyyin, 'the page of ʿAlī'
بْرِيقَ: بْرِيق — rest of إِبْرِيق ibrīq, ewer (m.), acc.; completes 'the ewer'
يَاضَيْفِي: يَا + ضَيْف + ـِي — yā, O (vocative); ḍayf, guest (m.); -ī, my; 'O my guest'
تَقَدَّمْ: تَقَدَّمَ — taqaddama, step forward (V), imv. m.s.; 'come forward'
وَاغْسِلْ: وَ + اغْسِلْ — wa-, and; ghasala, wash, imv. m.s.; 'and wash'
لِيَغْسِلَ: لِـ + يَغْسِلَ — li-, in order to (purpose; takes the subjunctive); yaghsilu, wash; 'to wash'
فَمَارٰى: فَـ + مَا + رٰى — fa-, and so/but; mā, not (negates the perfect); rā, saw (defective spelling of رَأَى); 'but he saw not'
طَشْتًا: طَشْت — ṭasht, basin (m.), acc. indef.; 'a basin'
وَلَابْرِيقًا: وَ + لَا + إِبْرِيق — wa-, and; lā, nor/not; ibrīq, ewer (m.), acc. indef. (the two alifs are written as one); 'nor an ewer'
يَرَأَخِي: يَرَ + أَخِي — yara, see (jussive after لم, shortened from يَرَى) run together with akhī, my brother; 'my brother saw not'
تَفَضَّلْ: تَفَضَّلَ — tafaḍḍala, be so kind, deign (V), imv. m.s.; 'pray, be so kind'
أَكْلِكَ: أَكْل + كَ — akl, eating (m.), gen. in annexation; -ka, your (m.s.); 'your eating'
لَاتُقَصِّرْ: لَا + تُقَصِّرْ — lā, do not (prohibition); qaṣṣara, fall short, hold back (II), jussive 2 m.s.; 'do not hold back'
كْلِ: ـكْلِ — remainder of الأَكْل al-akl, the eating (m.), gen. after fī; 'the eating'
يُومِي: أَوْمَى — awmā, gesture (impf. 3 m.s., Middle Arabic form of يُومِئُ); 'makes signs'
الْخُبْزِ: الـ + خُبْز — khubz, bread (m.), gen.; 'the bread'
وَبَيَاضِهِ: وَ + بَيَاض + هِ — wa-, and; bayāḍ, whiteness (m.); -hi, its; 'and its whiteness'
لَايَرَى: لَا + يَرَى — lā, not; raʾā, see (impf. 3 m.s.); 'sees not'
يَهْزَؤُ: هَزَأَ — hazaʾa, mock (impf. 3 m.s.; indicative where Classical would have the subjunctive); 'mocks'
بَيَاضِهِ: بَيَاض + هِ — bayāḍ, whiteness (m.); -hi, its; 'its whiteness'
أَلَذَّمِنْهُ: أَلَذّ + مِنْ + هُ — aladhdh, more delicious (elative); min, than (prep.); -hu, it; 'more delicious than it' (space lost in the print)
خَبَزَتْهُ: خَبَزَ + تْ + هُ — khabaza, bake (perf.) + -at, she + -hu, it; 'she baked it'
اِشْتَرَيْتُهَا: اشْتَرَى — ishtarā, buy (VIII) perf. 1 s. + -hā, her; 'I bought her'
بِخَمْسِمِائَةِ: بِـ + خَمْسِمِائَة — bi-, for, at the price of (prep.); khamsmiʾa, five hundred, gen.; 'for five hundred'
قَدِّمِ: قَدَّمَ — qaddama, present, bring forward (II), imv. m.s. (kasra before al-); 'bring'
الْهَرِيسَةَ: الـ + هَرِيسَة — harīsa, dish of pounded wheat and meat (f.), acc.; 'the harīsa'
وَأَكْثِرْ: وَ + أَكْثِرْ — wa-, and; akthara, increase, put plenty (IV), imv. m.s.; 'and put plenty'
ضَيْفِي: ضَيْف + ـِي — ḍayf, guest (m.); -ī, my; 'my guest'
الطَّيِّبَ: الـ + طَيِّب — ṭayyib, good, tasty (m.), acc.; here meaning 'the better' (comparative sense); 'the finer'
فَبِحَيَاتِي: فَـ + بِـ + حَيَاة + ـِي — fa-, and so; bi-, by (oath); ḥayāt, life (f.); -ī, my; 'by my life'
السِّكْبَاجَ: الـ + سِكْبَاج — sikbāj, meat stew in vinegar (m.), acc.; 'the sikbāj'
الْمُسَمَّنُ: الـ + مُسَمَّن — musammin/musamman, fattened (II, pass. part.), nom.; 'the fattened'
وَمُحْتَاجٌ: وَ + مُحْتَاج — wa-, and; muḥtāj, in need (VIII act. part.), nom. indef.; 'and in need'
حَنَكُهُ: حَنَك + هُ — ḥanak, palate, jaw (m.), nom.; -hu, his; 'his jaw'
وَيَمْضَغُ: وَ + يَمْضَغُ — wa-, and; maḍagha, chew (impf. 3 m.s.); 'and chews'
يَسْتَدْعِي: اسْتَدْعَى — istadʿā, call for, summon (X), impf. 3 m.s.; 'calling for'
لَوْنٍ: لَوْن — lawn, colour, kind of dish (m.), gen. indef.; 'a dish'
يَأْمُرُ: أَمَرَ — amara, bid, order (impf. 3 m.s.); 'he orders'
بِالْأَكْلِ: بِـ + الـ + أَكْل — bi-, to (amara bi-: the verb takes this preposition for the thing commanded); akl, eating (m.); 'to eat'
يَاغُلَامُ: يَا + غُلَام — yā, O; ghulām, boy (m.), vocative; 'O boy'
الْفَرَارِيجَ: الـ + فَرَارِيج — farārīj, chickens (pl. of farrūj), acc.; 'the chickens'
الْمَحْشُوَّةَ: الـ + مَحْشُوَّة — maḥshuww, stuffed (pass. part.) f., acc.; 'the stuffed'
بِالْفُسْتُقِ: بِـ + الـ + فُسْتُق — bi-, with (stuffed with); fustuq, pistachio (coll.); 'with pistachios'
وَحَيَاتِكَ: وَ + حَيَاة + كَ — wa-, by (oath particle); ḥayāt, life (f.); -ka, your; 'by your life'
الْفَرَارِيجُ: الـ + فَرَارِيج — farārīj, chickens, nom.; 'the chickens'
سُمِّنَتْ: سَمَّنَ — sammana, fatten (II), pass. perf. 3 f.s.; 'have been fattened'
فَكُلْ: فَـ + كُلْ — fa-, so/then; kul, eat (imv.); 'so eat'
يُلْقِمُهُ: أَلْقَمَ — alqama, feed a morsel to (IV), impf. 3 m.s. + -hu, him; 'feeds him a morsel'
يُعَدِّدُ: عَدَّدَ — ʿaddada, enumerate, count off (II), impf. 3 m.s.; 'enumerates'
الْأَلْوَانَ: الـ + أَلْوَان — alwān, colours, kinds of dishes (pl. of lawn), acc.; 'the dishes'
وَيَصِفُهَا: وَ + يَصِفُ + هَا — wa-, and; waṣafa, describe (impf. 3 m.s.); -hā, them; 'and describes them'
فَاشْتَدَّ: فَـ + اشْتَدَّ — fa-, so; ishtadda, grow intense (VIII, perf. 3 m.s.); 'and so grew fierce'
جُوعُهُ: جُوع + هُ — jūʿ, hunger (m.), nom.; -hu, his; 'his hunger'
بِشَهْوَةِ: بِـ + شَهْوَة — bi-, in (state of: 'in craving of'); shahwa, craving, appetite (f.), gen.; 'in craving for'
رَغِيفِ: رَغِيف — raghīf, round loaf (m.), gen. in annexation; 'a loaf of'
أَبَازِيرِ: أَبَازِير — abāzīr, spices (pl. of ابزار), gen. in annexation; 'the spices of'
طْعِمَةِ: ـطْعِمَة — remainder of الأَطْعِمَة al-aṭʿima, the foods (pl. of طَعَام), gen.; 'the foods'
جَوِّدِ: جَوَّدَ — jawwada, do well, make good (II), imv. m.s. (kasra before al-); 'do well'
اكْتَفَيْتُ: اكْتَفَى — iktafā, be satisfied (VIII), perf. 1 s.; 'I have had enough'
شِيلُوا: شَالَ — shāla, lift, carry off (colloquial imv. m.pl. شِيلُوا); 'take away'
وَقَدِّمُوا: وَ + قَدِّمُوا — wa-, and; qaddama, bring (II), imv. m.pl.; 'and bring'
الْحَلَاوَاتِ: الـ + حَلَاوَات — ḥalāwāt, sweets (pl. of ḥalwā), acc. (fem. pl.); 'the sweets'
جَيِّدٌ: جَيِّد — jayyid, good, fine (m.), nom. indef.; 'fine'
الْقَطَائِفِ: الـ + قَطَائِف — qaṭāʾif, syrup-soaked pancakes (pl. of qaṭīfa), gen.; 'the qaṭāʾif'
الْقَطِيفَةَ: الـ + قَطِيفَة — qaṭīfa, one syrup-soaked pancake (f.), acc.; 'the pancake'
الْجُلَّابُ: الـ + جُلَّاب — jullāb, rose-water syrup (m.), nom.; 'the syrup'
لَاعَلِمْتُكَ: لَا + عَلِمْتُ + كَ — lā, no/not; ʿalima, know (perf. 1 s.) + -ka, you; 'no — I have not known you' (obscure; see note)
يَسْأَلُهُ: سَأَلَ — saʾala, ask (impf. 3 m.s.) + -hu, him; 'asking him'
يَصْنَعُونَ: صَنَعَ — ṣanaʿa, make, prepare (impf. 3 m.pl.); 'they make' (indefinite 'they')
مِثْقَالًا: مِثْقَال — mithqāl, a small weight (m.), acc. indef.; 'a mithqāl'
يُحَرِّكُ: حَرَّكَ — ḥarraka, move, shake (II), impf. 3 m.s.; 'moves'
وَفَمَهُ: وَ + فَم + هُ — wa-, and; fam, mouth (m.), acc.; -hu, his; 'and his mouth'
وَيَلْعَبُ: وَ + يَلْعَبُ — wa-, and; laʿiba, play, work (impf. 3 m.s.); 'and plays'
بِأَشْدَاقِهِ: بِـ + أَشْدَاق + هِ — bi-, with (instrument: 'play with'); ashdāq, jaws, cheeks (pl. of shidq); -hi, his; 'with his jaws'
اللَّوْزِ: الـ + لَوْز — lawz, almonds (coll.), gen.; 'the almonds'
وَلَاتَسْتَحِي: وَ + لَا + تَسْتَحِي — wa-, and; lā, do not; istaḥyā, be shy (X), 2 m.s.; 'and do not be shy'
قُدْرَةٌ: قُدْرَة — qudra, ability, power (f.), nom. indef.; 'power'
وَتَتَفَرَّجَ: وَ + تَتَفَرَّجَ — wa-, and; tafarraja, look on at your ease, take pleasure (V), subjunctive 2 m.s.; 'and enjoy yourself'
جَائِعًا: جَائِع — jāʾiʿ, hungry, acc. indef. (predicate of kāna); 'hungry'
كُلِّهَا: كُلّ + هَا — kull, all (m.), gen. in annexation; -hā, them (f.); 'all of them' Also -hā of a singular feminine, 'all of it': hādhihi al-fitnati kullihā, 'all this trouble' (Night 191).
اِفْتَكَرَ: افْتَكَرَ — iftakara, reflect, ponder (VIII, perf. 3 m.s.); 'reflected'
أُتَّوِّبُهُ: تَوَّبَ — tawwaba, make repent (II), impf. 1 s. + -hu, him; the print puts a shadda on the tāʾ, probably misplaced (see note); 'I shall make him repent'
فَحَرَّكُوا: فَـ + حَرَّكُوا — fa-, and so; ḥarraka, move (II), perf. 3 m.pl.; 'and so they moved'
فَعَرِّفْنِي: فَـ + عَرِّفْ + نِي — fa-, then; ʿarrafa, let know (II), imv. + -nī, me; 'then tell me'
طَيِّبُ: طَيِّب — ṭayyib, good, sweet (m.), nom., in annexation; 'sweet of'
الرَّائِحَةِ: الـ + رَائِحَة — rāʾiḥa, scent (f.), gen.; 'the scent'
لَكِنَّنِي: لَكِنَّ + نِي — lākinna, but; -nī, me/I; 'but I'
تَعَوَّدْتُ: تَعَوَّدَ — taʿawwada, become accustomed (V), perf. 1 s.; 'I have grown used'
النَّبِيذِ: الـ + نَبِيذ — nabīdh, wine (m.), gen.; 'the wine'
الْعَتِيقِ: الـ + عَتِيق — ʿatīq, old, aged (m.), gen.; 'the aged'
دُقْ: ذَاقَ — dhāqa, taste, imv. m.s. (spelled with د for ذ); 'taste'
آلَانَ: آلَانَ — ālāna, now?! (interrogative أَ a- fused with الآن al-ān, 'now'; printed آلان)
احْتَوَى: احْتَوَى — iḥtawā, he comprised, took possession of (iḥtawā ʿalā)
اكْتَفَيَا: اكْتَفَيَا — iktafayā, the two had enough (iktafā, to be satisfied; dual)
الزَّادَ: الـ + زَاد — al-, the; zād, provisions, victuals (m.); acc.
الطَّرِيقَ: الـ + طَرِيق — al-, the; ṭarīq, road (m.); acc.
الْأَصْحَابِ: الـ + أَصْحَاب — al-, the; aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib); gen.
الْأَقْمَارُ: الـ + أَقْمَار — al-, the; aqmār, moons (pl. of qamar); nom.
الْأَلْحَانِ: الـ + أَلْحَان — al-, the; alḥān, melodies, airs (pl. of laḥn); gen.
الْبَدَوِيُّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — al-, the; badawī, Bedouin (m.); nom.
الْحَقِيقَةِ: الـ + حَقِيقَة — al-, the; ḥaqīqa, truth, reality (f.); gen. after ʿalā; ʿalā al-ḥaqīqa, 'in truth'; here also after fī: wa-fī al-ḥaqīqati, 'and in truth'
الْعَتِيقَ: الـ + عَتِيق — al-, the; ʿatīq, old, aged (adj.); acc., 'the old (wine)'
الْمَذْكُورَةِ: الـ + مَذْكُورَة — al-, the; madhkūra, mentioned (f. pass. part. of dhakara); gen., 'the aforementioned'
الْمَطَابِخِ: الـ + مَطَابِخ — al-, the; maṭābikh, kitchens (pl. of maṭbakh); gen. after fī
انْتَقَلَا: انْتَقَلَا — intaqalā, the two moved over (intaqala; dual)
أَسَرَهُ: أَسَرَ + هُ — asara, he took captive; -hu, him
أَسِيرُكَ: أَسِير + كَ — asīr, captive (m.); -ka, your; 'your captive'
أَسْخَرُ: أَسْخَرُ — askharu, I mock (sakhira bi-, to make fun of)
أَنْعَمْتَ: أَنْعَمْتَ — anʿamta, you showed favour (anʿama ʿalā, to be gracious to; -ta, you m. sg.)
أُمُورِي: أُمُور + ي — umūr, affairs (pl. of amr); -ī, my; 'my affairs'
إِبْطِهِ: إِبْط + هِ — ibṭ, armpit (m.); -hi, his; gen. in construct, 'his armpit'
إِحْسَانِكَ: إِحْسَان + كَ — iḥsān, kindness, benevolence (m.); -ka, your; gen. after min; 'of your kindness'
بَيَاضُ: بَيَاض — bayāḍ, whiteness (m.); nom., in construct
بِالْأَمْوَالِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْوَال — bi-, with, by means of (prep.: 'with money'); al-, the; amwāl, wealth, riches (pl. of māl)
بِالْمَدِينَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَدِينَة — bi-, into, with (dakhala bi-, 'enter'; the place takes bi- here); al-, the; madīna, city (f.)
بِزَوْجِهَا: بِـ + زَوْج + هَا — bi-, (after idhā of surprise, only marks what appears: 'behold, ...'); zawj, husband (m.); -hā, her
بِشَرْبِهِ: بِـ + شَرْب + هِ — bi-, at, in (prep.: 'at the drinking'); sharb, drinking (m.); -hi, it; 'at the drinking of it'
بِصَفْعَةٍ: بِـ + صَفْعَة — bi-, with (prep.: thannā ʿalayhi bi-, 'followed him up with'); ṣafʿa, a slap; gen.
تَتَعَرَّضُ: تَتَعَرَّضُ — tataʿarraḍu, she presents herself, makes advances (taʿarraḍa li-)
تَوَسَّطَ: تَوَسَّطَ — tawassaṭa, he reached the middle of

سُؤَا: suʾā, first half of سُؤَالُكَ suʾāluka, 'your question'; the print divides the word in two (m., nom.)
لُكَ: -luka, second half of the divided word سُؤَالُكَ, 'your question'; -ka, your
سُؤَالِي: suʾāl, question, asking (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my asking'
اتَّهَمُونِي: ittahama, to accuse (verb VIII, perf. 3mpl.) + -nī, me; 'they accused me'
الشَّاءِ—رُ: الـ + شَاء—ر — printed for الشَّاعِر, al-shāʿir, 'the poet' (m., nom.); the print has a hamza and a dash where ʿayn is expected
وَقَلَّمَا: وَ + قَلَّمَا — wa-, and + qallamā, seldom, rarely (qalla, to be few, + mā, a particle that frees the verb to be used adverbially); 'and seldom'
اَبْصَرَتْ: abṣara, to see, perceive (verb IV, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the dual 'eyes'); 'saw'
عَيْنَاكَ: ʿayn, eye (f. dual, nom.) + -ka, your; 'your two eyes'
ذَالَقَبٍ: ذَا + لَقَب — dhā, possessor of (m., acc.) + laqab, surname, epithet (m., gen.); the print joins the two words; 'one having a surname'
وَمَعْنَاهُ: وَ + مَعْنَى + ـهُ — wa-, and + maʿnā, meaning (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and its meaning'
فَتَّشْتَ: fattasha, to search, probe (verb II, perf. 2ms); 'you search'
لَقَبِهِ: laqab, surname, epithet (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his surname'
اشْرَجُوا: ishraja, printed for اشْرَحُوا ishraḥū, 'explain!' (imperative pl. of sharaḥa, to explain); ج is a misprint for ح
لِلْمُزَيِّنِ: لِـ + الـ + مُزَيِّن — li-, to, for (prep.; the beneficiary of the telling) + muzayyin, barber (m., gen.); 'to the barber'
حَالَ: ḥāl, state, condition (f., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the state of'
الشَّاهِلُ: الـ + شَاهِل — printed for الشَّاهِد al-shāhid, 'the witness' (m., nom.); ل is a misprint for د
فَحَرَّكَ: فَـ + حَرَّكَ — fa-, so, then + ḥarraka, to move, shake (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he shook'
لَعَجِيبٌ: لَـ + عَجِيب — la-, indeed, surely (emphatic lām after inna) + ʿajīb, strange, wondrous (adj., m., nom.); 'surely strange'
اكْشِفُوالِي: اكْشِفُوا + لِـ + ـي — ikshifū, uncover! (imperative pl. of kashafa, to uncover) + li-, for (prep.) + -ī, me; 'uncover for me' (the print joins the three)
لْأَحْدَبِ: الـ + أَحْدَب — aḥdab, hunchback (m., gen.); the print drops the first alif of الأحدب; 'the hunchback'
وَمَوْتَةُ: وَ + مَوْتَة — wa-, and + mawta, death (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the death of'
فَبَهِتَتِ: فَـ + بَهِتَتِ — fa-, so, then + bahita, to be dumbfounded (verb I, perf. 3fs, with helping vowel); 'and was dumbfounded'
كَذِبَ: kadhib, lie, falsehood (m., acc., after the negative lā); 'no lie'
الرُّوحُ: الـ + رُوح — rūḥ, spirit, breath of life (m. or f., nom.); 'the spirit'
حِرْمَدَانَ: ḥirmadān, small case, box (m., acc.; a rare word, perhaps Persian-derived); 'a case'
وَدَهَنَ: وَ + دَهَنَ — wa-, and + dahana, to anoint (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he anointed'
وَعُرُوقَهَا: وَ + عُرُوق + هَا — wa-, and + ʿurūq, veins (broken pl. of ʿirq, acc.) + -hā, its; 'and its veins'
بِعَظْمِهَا: بِـ + عَظْم + هَا — bi-, with (prep.; of accompaniment) + ʿaẓm, bone (m., gen.) + -hā, its; 'with its bone'
مَغْمُوسَةٌ: maghmūsa, dipped, soaked (pass. part. of ghamasa; f., nom.)
وَالْأَحْدَبُ: وَ + الـ + أَحْدَب — wa-, and + aḥdab, hunchback (m., nom.); 'and the hunchback'
عَطَسَ: ʿaṭasa, to sneeze (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he sneezed'
عَطْسَةً: ʿaṭsa, a sneeze (f., acc., cognate object); 'a sneeze'
نَطَّ: naṭṭa, to leap, spring (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he leapt'
وَمَلَّسَ: وَ + مَلَّسَ — wa-, and + mallasa, to smooth, stroke (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he stroked'
وَأَشْهَدُ: وَ + أَشْهَدُ — wa-, and + ashhadu, I bear witness (verb I, imperf. 1sg.); 'and I bear witness'
وَالْحَاضِرُونَ: وَ + الـ + حَاضِرُون — wa-, and + ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara; m. sound pl., nom.); 'and those present'
أَعْرَبَ: aʿrab, as printed (elative; read as أَغْرَب aghrab, 'stranger'; m., acc.); 'more [strange]'
أَعَسْكَرُ: أَ + عَسْكَر — a, O (vocative particle) + ʿaskar, army, soldiery (m., vocative); 'O soldiers' (the reading is a guess)
عُمْرَكُمْ: ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., acc. of time) + -kum, your (pl.); 'in your lives'
يَحْيَى: ḥayiya, to live, come to life (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'come to life'
رَزَقَهُ: razaqa, to provide, grant (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he provided him'
لِحَيَاةِ: لِـ + حَيَاة — li-, for, to (prep.; of the beneficiary) + ḥayāh, life (f., gen.; the possessive pronoun seems to be missing); 'for the life [of him]'
لَكَٰنَ: لَـ + كَانَ — la-, would (the lām of the apodosis after lawlā) + kāna, to be (verb I, perf. 3ms; the print omits the alif and the form is vocalised with the dagger alif); 'he would have'
فَأَرَّخُوهَا: فَـ + أَرَّخُوا + هَا — fa-, so, then + arrakha, to record (verb II, perf. 3mpl.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and they recorded it'
جَعَلُوهَا: jaʿala, to put, make (verb I, perf. 3mpl.) + -hā, it (f.); 'they placed it'
خَلَعَ: khalaʿa, to take off; khalaʿa ʿalā, 'bestow a robe of honor upon' (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ: وَ + الـ + نَصْرَانِيّ — wa-, and + naṣrānī, Christian (m., gen.); 'and the Christian'
وَالشَّاهِدِ: وَ + الـ + شَاهِد — wa-, and + shāhid, witness (act. part. of shahida; m., gen.); 'and the witness'
وَأَصْلَحَ: وَ + أَصْلَحَ — wa-, and + aṣlaḥa, to set right, reconcile (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he reconciled'
نَدِيمَهُ: nadīm, boon companion (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his boon companion'
جَامَكِيَّةً: jāmakiyya, stipend, salary (f., acc.; of Persian origin); 'a stipend'
مُزَيِّنَ: muzayyin, barber (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَنَدِيمَهُ: وَ + نَدِيم + هُ — wa-, and + nadīm, boon companion (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his boon companion'
يَزَٰلُوا: zāla, to cease (verb I, imperf. 3mpl., jussive after lam; the print omits the alif, vocalised with the dagger alif); 'they ceased'
وَأَهْنَاهُ: وَ + أَهْنَى + ـهُ — wa-, and + ahnā, most pleasant, happiest (elative of hanī', m., gen.) + -hu, of it; 'and the most pleasant of it'
أَتَاهُمْ: atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them; 'came to them'
هَادِمُ: hādim, destroyer (act. part. of hadama; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
اللَّذَّاتِ: الـ + لَذَّات — ladhdha, pleasure, delight (f., pl., gen.); 'of delights'
وَمُفَرِّقُ: وَ + مُفَرِّق — wa-, and + mufarriq, parter, divider (act. part. of II farraqa; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the sunderer of'
الْجَمَاعَاتِ: الـ + جَمَاعَات — jamāʿa, company (f., pl., gen.); 'companies'
الْوَزِيرَيْنِ: الـ + وَزِير — wazīr, vizier, minister (m. dual, gen.); 'the two viziers'
وَأَنِيسِ: وَ + أَنِيس — wa-, and + Anīs, a proper name; first part of the name Anīs al-Jalīs (gen.); 'and Anis'
الْجَلِيسِ: الـ + جَلِيس — jalīs, companion (m., gen.); 'al-Jalīs, the companion'
وَالصَّعَالِيكَ: وَ + الـ + صَعَالِيك — wa-, and; ṣaʿālīk, penniless vagabonds (broken pl. of ṣuʿlūk, acc.); 'and the vagabonds'
وَيُحِبُّ: وَ + يُحِبُّ — wa-, and + aḥabba, to love (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'and he loves'
الرَّعِيَّةَ: الـ + رَعِيَّة — raʿiyya, flock, subjects (f., acc., object); 'the subjects'
وَيَهَبُ: وَ + يَهَبُ — wa-, and + wahaba, to give, bestow (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and he gives'
يُؤْمِنُ: āmana, to believe (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'he believes'
بِمُحَمَّدٍ: بِـ + مُحَمَّد — Muḥammad, the Prophet (gen.); bi-, in (prep.; āmana bi-, 'believe in'): 'in Muhammad'
جَالَتْ: jāla, to wheel, move about (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'wheeled about'
مَوَاكِبٌ: mawākib — processions, troops of riders (broken pl. of mawkib, nom., indef.)
اَرَبَ: araba — to cut off (a limb at the joint) (verb I, perf. 3ms; Lane); the reading is doubtful
الْعِدَاةَ: الـ + عِدَاة — ʿidāt, enemies (pl., acc.); 'the enemies'
عَضْبٍ: ʿaḍb — sharp, cutting (adj., gen.); a keen sword, a blade
اَنْتَرِى: antarī — obscure; may be corrupt; left as printed (possibly a proper name or a form of ntr/ntarī)
وَيَخُطُّ: وَ + يَخُطُّ — wa-, and + khaṭṭa, to draw a line, write (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and he draws'
خَطًّا: khaṭṭ — line, stroke (m., acc., indef.; internal object); 'a line'
الصُّدُورِ: الـ + صُدُور — ṣudūr, breasts, chests (broken pl. of ṣadr, gen.); 'the breasts'
سَطَا: saṭā — to assault, attack (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he assaults'
الْفَوَارِسِ: الـ + فَوَارِس — fawāris, horsemen, riders (broken pl. of fāris, gen.); 'the horsemen'
مُفْتَرِي: muftarī — one who rends (act. part. of VIII iftarā from farā, to cut, split; nom., indef.); could also be 'inventor, slanderer'
مُحَمَّدُ: Muḥammad — personal name (nom.; first term of 'Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān')
الزَّيْنِيُّ: الـ + زَيْنِيّ — Zaynī, a nisba (relational name, m., nom.), 'of the Zayn line'
وَزِيرَيْنِ: وَزِير — wazīr, vizier, minister (m. dual, oblique -ayn, used where the nom. -ān is expected); 'two viziers'
الْمُعِينُ: الـ + مُعِين — Muʿīn, helper, a personal name (m., nom.); 'al-Muʿīn'
خَاقَانَ: Khāqān — a Turkic title and name, 'khagan' (gen., diptote), in 'ibn Khāqān'
السِّيرَةِ: الـ + سِيرَة — sīra, conduct, way of life (f., gen.); 'the conduct'
أَجْمَعَتِ: ajmaʿa, to unite, agree on (verb IV, perf. 3fs, with the sukūn lifted before al-); 'agreed'
مَحَبَّتِهِ: مَحَبَّة + ـهِ — maḥabba, love (f., gen.); 'love of him' Also 'his love' (he is the lover): maḥabbatihi lahā, 'his love for her'.
وَأَجْمَعَتِ: وَ + أَجْمَعَتِ — wa-, and + ajmaʿa, to agree (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and they agreed'
مَشُورَتِهِ: مَشُورَة + ـهِ — mashūra, counsel, advice (f., gen.); 'consulting him, his counsel'
وَالْكُلُّ: وَ + الـ + كُلّ — wa-, and; kull, all, everyone (m., nom.); 'and everyone'
يَدْعُونَ: daʿā, to pray (verb I, imperf. 3mpl); 'they pray'
مُدَّتِهِ: مُدَّة + ـهِ — mudda, term, span of time (f., gen.); 'his term, his life'
مَحْضُ: maḥḍ — pure, sheer (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'pure'
مُزِيلُ: muzīl — remover (act. part. of IV azāla, to remove; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
الشَّرِّ: الـ + شَرّ — sharr, evil (m., gen.); 'the evil'
وَالضَّيْرِ: وَ + الـ + ضَيْر — wa-, and; ḍayr, harm, injury (m., gen.); 'and the harm'
يَكْرَهُ: karaha, to hate, dislike (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he hates'
مَحْضَ: maḥḍ — pure, sheer (m., acc., predicate of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'pure'
شِعْ: shiʿ — printed cut short for shiʿr, verse (vocalised as printed)
لُذْ: lādha bi-, to take refuge with (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'take refuge'
بِالْكِرَامِ: بِـ + الـ + كِرَام — bi-, with, at (prep.; lādha bi-, 'take refuge with') + kirām, noble ones (broken pl. of karīm, gen.); 'with the noble'
فَإِنَّمَا: فَ + إِنَّمَا — fa-, for, so + innamā, indeed, only (particle); 'for it is only'
تَلِدُ: walada, to beget, give birth to (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'beget'
الْكِرَامُ: الـ + كِرَام — kirām, noble ones (broken pl., nom.); 'the noble'
كِرَامًا: kirām — noble ones (broken pl. of karīm, acc., indef.); 'noble ones'
اللِّئَامَ: الـ + لِئَام — liʾām, base, ignoble ones (broken pl. of laʾīm, acc., object); 'the base'
اللِّئَامِ: الـ + لِئَام — liʾām, base ones (broken pl. of laʾīm, gen.); 'the base'
اللِّئَامُ: الـ + لِئَام — liʾām, base ones (broken pl., nom.); 'the base'
لِئَامًا: liʾām — base ones (broken pl. of laʾīm, acc., indef.); 'base ones'
مَحَبَّتِهِمْ: مَحَبَّة + ـهِمْ — maḥabba, love (f., gen.) + their; 'their love'
لِلْفَضْلِ: لِـ + الـ + فَضْل — li-, for, toward (prep., marks the object of love) + al-Faḍl (gen.); 'for al-Faḍl'
بُغْضِهِمْ: بُغْض + ـهِمْ — bughḍ, hatred (m., gen.) + their; 'their hatred'
لِلْمُعِينِ: لِـ + الـ + مُعِين — li-, for, toward (prep., marks the object of hatred) + al-Muʿīn (gen.); 'for al-Muʿīn'
وَبِقُدْرَةِ: وَ + بِـ + قُدْرَة — wa-, and; bi-, by (prep., oath/instrument) + qudra, power (f., gen.); 'and by the power of'
الزَّيْنِيَّ: الـ + زَيْنِيّ — Zaynī, nisba (m., acc., after anna)
وَحَوْلَهُ: وَ + حَوْلَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥawla, around (prep./adv., acc.) + him; 'and around him'
إِذْنَادَى: idh, when (conj.) + nādā, to call (verb III, perf. 3ms), printed as one word; 'when he called'
الْفَضْلَ: الـ + فَضْل — Faḍl, a personal name (m., acc.); 'al-Faḍl'; here: not the name but faḍl, merit, credit, precedence (m., acc. as the print points it, after qultu): al-faḍla li-al-mutaqaddimi, 'the credit (goes) to the one who went first'
زَمَنِهَا: زَمَن + ـهَا — zaman, time (m., gen.) + her; 'in her time'
فَائِقَةً: fāʾiqa — surpassing, excelling (act. part. of fāqa, f., acc., indef., ḥāl); 'surpassing'
الاِعْتِدَالِ: الـ + اِعْتِدَال — iʿtidāl, evenness, due proportion of figure (m., gen.); 'the proportion'
حَمِيدَةَ: ḥamīda — praiseworthy (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa, ḥāl); 'praiseworthy of'
الْخِصَالِ: الـ + خِصَال — khiṣāl, qualities, traits (broken pl. of khaṣla, gen.); 'the qualities'
لَاتُوجَدُ: lā + tūjadu — not (negative) + wajada, to find (verb I passive, imperf. 3fs); 'is not found'
زَعَقَ: zaʿaqa — to cry out, shout (verb I, perf. 3ms)
خَازِنْدَارٍ: khāzindār — treasurer (Persian title, m., gen. after ʿalā); 'a treasurer'
دَارَالْفَضْلِ: dār + الـ + فَضْل — dār, house (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa; printed run together with al-Faḍl); 'the house of al-Faḍl'
الْخَازِنْدَارُ: الـ + خَازِنْدَار — khāzindār, treasurer (m., nom.); 'the treasurer'
أَمْرَالسُّلْطَانِ: amr + الـ + سُلْطَان — amr, command (m., acc., object; printed run together with al-sulṭān); 'the sultan's command'
مَارَسَمَ: mā + rasama — what (rel.) + to decree, prescribe (verb I, perf. 3ms), printed as one word; 'what he decreed'
يَعْمِدَاِلَى: yaʿmida + ilā — ʿamada ilā, to betake oneself to (verb I, subjunctive 3ms + prep.), printed as one word; 'that he go to'
وَيُوصِىَ: وَ + يُوصِىَ — wa-, and + awṣā, to charge, instruct (verb IV, subjunctive 3ms); 'and instruct'
السَّمَاسِرَةَ: الـ + سَمَاسِرَة — samāsira, brokers, agents (broken pl. of simsār, acc.); 'the brokers'
ذَكَرْنَاهُ: dhakara, to mention (verb I, perf. 1pl.) + ـهُ, it; 'we mentioned it'
لَاتُبَاعَ: lā + tubāʿa — not (negative) + bāʿa, to sell (verb I passive, subjunctive 3fs); 'not be sold'
ثَمَنُهَا: ثَمَن + ـهَا — thaman, price (m., nom.) + her; 'her price'
تُعْرَضَ: ʿaraḍa, to show, present (verb I passive, subjunctive 3fs); 'she is shown'
تَبِعِ: bāʿa, to sell (verb I, jussive 3fs, with the sukūn lifted before al-); 'sell'
السَّمَاسِرَةُ: الـ + سَمَاسِرَة — samāsira, brokers (broken pl. of simsār, nom.); 'the brokers'
يَعْرِضُونَهَا: ʿaraḍa, to show, present (verb I, imperf. 3mpl, indicative as printed) + ـهَا, her; 'they show her'
يُعْجِبْهَا: aʿjaba, to please (verb IV, jussive 3ms) + ـهَا, her; 'did not please (him)'; note the pronoun picks up 'every girl'
فَنِي: fī — in (prep.), printed with a stray ن (probably for fī); 'in'
بِالسِّمْسَارِ: بِـ + الـ + سِمْسَار — bi- (follows idhā of surprise and only marks what appears: 'and behold, a broker') + simsār, broker (m., gen.)
دَارَالْوَزِيرِ: dār + الـ + وَزِير — dār, house (f., gen. after ilā; printed run together with al-wazīr); 'the vizier's house'
الْمَسِيرِ: الـ + مَسِير — masīr, going, journey (m., gen.); 'the going'
لِقَصْرِ: لِـ + قَصْر — li-, to, toward (prep.) + qaṣr, palace (m., gen.); 'to the palace of'
رِكَا: rikā — stirrup (rikāb), printed split from its last letter
بِ: b — the last letter of the split rikāb, perhaps rikābihi, 'his stirrup' (printer's cut)
اعَادَ: aʿāda — to bring back, restore (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
سُومَ: sūm — obscure: perhaps sawm, 'price, worth' (or a corruption of rasm, 'established way'); left as printed (acc., first term of an iḍāfa)
مَنْشُوراً: manshūr — spread out, unfurled (pass. part. of nashara; m., acc., indef.); 'spread out'
لَازِلْتَ: lā + zilta — not (negative) + zāla, to cease (verb I, perf. 2ms); lā zila, 'never cease', i.e. 'have never ceased'
اَحْيَيْتَ: aḥyaytā — to give life to, revive (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you revived'
سَعْيُكَ: سَعْي + ـكَ — saʿy, striving, effort (m., nom.) + your; 'your striving'
مَشْكُورًا: mashkūr — thanked, commended (pass. part. of shakara; m., acc., indef.); 'thanked'
سَبَقَ: sabaqa — precede, go before (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); with به, 'went before concerning him'
الْمَرْسُومُ: الـ + مَرْسُوم — marsūm, decree, written order (m., nom.); 'the decree'
الْكَرِيمُ: الـ + كَرِيم — karīm, noble, generous (adj., m., nom.); 'the noble'
بِطَلَبِهِ: بِـ + طَلَب + ـهِ — ṭalab, request, asking-for (m., verbal noun, gen.); bi-, in/with (prep.) 'in the asking-for him'; 'to summon him'
رَشِيقَةُ: rashīqa — slender, graceful (adj., f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'slender-of'
بِطَرْفٍ: بِـ + طَرْف — ṭarf, glance, eye (m., indef., gen.); bi-, with (prep., of an attribute she has); 'with a glance'
وَخَلَاخِيلَ: وَ + خَلَاخِيل — khalākhīl, anklets (broken pl. of khalkhāl; diptote, gen. as part of the 'with' series after bi-); 'and anklets'
وَخَصْرٍ: وَ + خَصْر — khaṣr, waist (m., gen. in the 'with' series); 'and a waist'
وَرِدْفٍ: وَ + رِدْف — ridf, hip, buttocks (m., gen. in the 'with' series); 'and a hip'
وَثِيَابٍ: وَ + ثِيَاب — thiyāb, garments (broken pl. of thawb; gen. in the 'with' series); 'and garments'
وَرُضَابٍ: وَ + رُضَاب — ruḍāb, sweet saliva, dew of the mouth (m., gen.); 'and sweet saliva'
أَحْلَى: aḥlā — sweeter (elative of ḥulw, diptote; followed by min, 'than')
الْجُلَّابِ: الـ + جُلَّاب — julāb, julep, rose-water syrup (m., gen. after min); 'the julep'
وَقَوَامٍ: وَ + قَوَام — qawām, stature, shapely figure (m., gen.); 'and a figure'
أَعْدَلَ: aʿdal — more upright, straighter (elative of ʿādil/muʿtadil; diptote, gen.)
الْغُصُونِ: الـ + غُصُون — ghuṣūn, branches (pl. of ghuṣn; gen. after min); 'the branches'
الْمَائِلَةِ: الـ + مَائِلَة — māʾila, bending, leaning (act. part. f., gen.); 'the bending (ones)'
أَرَقَّ: araqq — finer, softer (elative of raqīq; diptote, gen.)
الْأَسْحَارِ: الـ + أَسْحَار — asḥār, the hours before dawn (pl. of saḥar; gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the dawns'
————————ر: the print's own ruled line ending in a lone ر, set after the word shiʿr 'verse' to introduce a poem; not a word
عَجِيبَةُ: ʿajība — wonder, marvel (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a wonder of'
عَزِيزَةُ: ʿazīza — dear, precious (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a dear one of'
وَرَبْرَبِ: وَ + رَبْرَب — rabrab, a herd of wild cattle, here probably a name; wa-, and (conj.); 'and Rabrab'
عَطَاهَا: عَطَا + هَا — ʿaṭā, gave (colloquial short form of aʿṭā, perf. 3 m. sg.) + hā, her (obj.); 'gave her'
اِلَهُ: ilāh — god, God (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); printed with short i- and no long ā
الْعَرْشِ: الـ + عَرْش — ʿarsh, throne (m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the Throne'
عِزّاً: ʿizz — glory, might (m., acc. indef., second object)
وَرِفْعَةً: وَ + رِفْعَة — rifʿa, loftiness, eminence (f., acc.); 'and loftiness'
وَظَرْفاً: وَ + ظَرْف — ẓarf, charm, elegance (m., acc.); 'and charm'
وَمَعْنًى: وَ + مَعْنًى — maʿnā, meaning, significance, grace (m., acc.); 'and meaning'
قَدّاً: qadd — stature, slender build (m., acc. indef.)
مُقْضَبِ: muqḍab — cut slender, trim (pass. part. of qaḍaba, 'cut off a branch', adj.); the kasra is for the rhyme
كَوَاكِبَ: kawākib — stars (broken pl. of kawkab; diptote, gen. in an iḍāfa)
حُرَّاسٌ: ḥurrās — guards, watchmen (pl. of ḥāris; nom. indef.)
مَرْقَبِ: marqab — lookout, watch-post (m., gen. in an iḍāfa)
رَامَ: rāma — seek, set out to (I, perf. 3 m. sg.)
يُسَارِقُ: yusāriqu — try to steal (III sāraqa, imperf. 3 m. sg.)
شَيَاطِينُ: shayāṭīn — devils (broken pl. of shayṭān; nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
لَفْظٍ: lafẓ — utterance, speech (m., gen. in an iḍāfa)
اَحْرَقَتْهُ: aḥraqat + hu — IV aḥraqa, burn (perf. 3 f. sg.) + hu, him (obj.); 'burned him'
بِكَوْكَبِ: بِـ + كَوْكَب — kawkab, star (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., of instrument); 'with a star'
الْوَزِيرَا: الـ + وَزِير — wazīr, vizier (m.); printed with a stray final alif, vocalised as it stands; 'the vizier'
عَجَّبَتْهُ: ʿajjabat + hu — II ʿajjaba, astonish, fill with wonder (perf. 3 f. sg.) + hu, him (obj.); 'astonished him'
سِعْرُهَا: siʿr + hā — price, rate (m., nom.) + hā, her; 'her price'
تَجِيْ: tajī — jāʾa, come (I, jussive after lam, with the ي kept and marked); with a price, 'come to, amount to'
الْفَرَا: الـ + فَرَا — farā, obscure: perhaps a slip for القِرى 'provisions, guest-fare', or farāʾ 'wild ass'; read by sense as 'her keep'
رِبْحَ: ribḥ — profit, gain, worth (m., acc., in apposition)
أَكَلَتْهَا: akalat + hā — I akala, eat (perf. 3 f. sg.) + hā, it (rel. obj.); 'she ate it'
خَلَعَتْهَا: khalaʿat + hā — I khalaʿa, bestow a robe of honour (perf. 3 f. sg.; with ʿalā, 'upon') + hā, it (rel. obj.)
مُعَلِّمِيهَا: muʿallim + ī + hā — II act. part. muʿallim, teacher (m. pl., gen., -ī- before the pronoun) + hā, her; 'her teachers'
وَالنَّحْوَ: وَ + الـ + نَحْو — naḥw, grammar (lit. 'way, manner'; m., acc.); 'and the grammar'
اللُّغَةَ: الـ + لُغَة — lugha, language, lexicography (f., acc.); 'the language'
وَالتَّفْسِيرَ: وَ + الـ + تَفْسِير — tafsīr, commentary, exegesis (m., acc.); 'and the commentary'
وَأُصُولَ: وَ + أُصُول — uṣūl, roots, principles (pl. of aṣl; acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the roots of'
الْفِقْهِ: الـ + فِقْه — fiqh, jurisprudence (m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the jurisprudence'
وَالدِّينَ: وَ + الـ + دِين — dīn, religion (m., acc.); 'and religion'
وَالطِّبَّ: وَ + الـ + طِبّ — ṭibb, medicine (m., acc.); 'and medicine'
وَالتَّقْوِيمَ: وَ + الـ + تَقْوِيم — taqwīm, calendar, astronomical reckoning (lit. 'setting straight'; m., acc.); 'and the calendar'
وَالضَّرْبَ: وَ + الـ + ضَرْب — ḍarb, striking, playing (an instrument) (verbal noun, m., acc.); 'and the striking'
بِالْآلَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + آلَات — ālāt, instruments (pl. of āla; gen.); bi-, with/on (prep.; الضرب بـ 'to play on'); 'on the instruments'
الْمُطْرِبَةِ: الـ + مُطْرِبَة — muṭriba, delight-giving, stirring (IV act. part. f., gen.); 'the delight-making (ones)'
بِسَيِّدِهَا: بِـ + سَيِّد + هَا — bi-, 'bring [her/him]' in عَلَيَّ بِـ (the bi- marks the thing to be brought) + sayyid, master (gen.) + -hā, her; 'her master'
فَأَحْضَرَهُ: فَـ + أَحْضَرَ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.); IV aḥḍara, bring (perf. 3 m. sg.); + hu, him (obj.); 'so he brought him'
وَالسَّاعَةِ: وَ + الـ + سَاعَة — sāʿa, hour (f., gen.); 'and the hour'
وَعَارَكَهُ: وَ + عَارَكَ + هُ — wa-, and; III ʿāraka, wrestle with, rub hard (perf. 3 m. sg.); + hu, him (obj.)
وَاسْتَبْقَى: وَ + اسْتَبْقَى — wa-, and; X istabqā, spare, keep alive (perf. 3 m. sg.)
————————ز: the print's own ruled line ending in a lone ز, set after the word shiʿr 'verse' to introduce a poem; not a word
