اَرْ: ar — first half of the verb arʿashanī, 'made me tremble', printed with a space after it (IV arʿasha, make tremble)
عَشَنِي: ʿashanī — second half of the verb arʿashanī (printed split): ʿash + nī, 'me' (obj.)
اَيْ: ayy — what, which (exclamatory); اَيَّ رَعْشٍ 'what a trembling!'
وَالدَّهْرُ: وَ + الـ + دَهْر — dahr, Time, fate (m., nom.); wa-, and (conj.); 'and Time'
قُوَّةٍ: quwwa — strength (f., gen. in an iḍāfa)
وَبَطْشِ: وَ + بَطْش — baṭsh, violence, a forceful grip (m., gen.); 'and violence'
اَعْيَى: aʿyā — I ʿayiya, be weary, be unable to go on (imperf. 1 sg.)
رَضِيتَ: raḍīta — I raḍiya, be content (perf. 2 m. sg.); a question, 'are you content?'
تَأْخُذَ: taʾkhudha — I akhadha, take (subjunctive 2 m. sg., after an)
مُحَمَّدِ: Muḥammad — personal name (m., gen. in apposition to al-sulṭān)
الزَّيْنِيِّ: الـ + زَيْنِيّ — Zaynī, a name by nisba (gen.); 'al-Zaynī'
قَدَّ: qadd — first half of qaddamtuhā 'I presented her', printed with a space inside the word (II qaddama, present)
مْتُهَا: mtuhā — second half of qaddamtuhā (printed split): the stem's last letters + tu, 'I' + hā, 'her'
احِبًا: wājiban — wājib, incumbent, obligatory (act. part., m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); printed with ح for ج and as a separate word after وَ
عَلَّيَ: ʿalayya — ʿalā, upon + ya, me; 'upon me'; the print puts the shadda on the lam
أَمَرَالْوَزِيرُ: amara + al-wazīru — printed as one word: I amara, command (perf. 3 m. sg.; takes bi-) + al-wazīr, 'the vizier' (nom.)
فَأُحْضِرَتْ: فَـ + أُحْضِرَتْ — fa-, so (conj.); IV pass. uḥḍirat, were brought (perf. 3 f. sg.; the monies, a plural of things, take the feminine singular)
فَوُزِنَتْ: فَـ + وُزِنَتْ — fa-, so (conj.); I pass. wuzinat, were weighed out (perf. 3 f. sg.)
لِلْعَجَمِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + عَجَمِيّ — ʿajamī, non-Arab, Persian (m., gen.); li-, for (prep., of the receiver); 'for the Persian'
النَّخَّاسُ: الـ + نَخَّاس — nakhkhās, slave-dealer (m., nom.); 'the slave-dealer'
الرَّأْيَ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m., acc., subject after anna); 'the opinion'
لَاتَطْلَعَ: lā + taṭlaʿa — printed as one word: lā, not (neg. particle) + I ṭalaʿa, go up (subjunctive 2 m. sg. after an; with bi-, 'go up with, take up')
قَادِمَةٌ: qādima — coming, arriving (act. part. f., nom. indef.; predicate)
وَاخْتَلَفَ: وَ + اخْتَلَفَ — wa-, and; VIII ikhtalafa, differ, vary (perf. 3 m. sg.; with ʿalā, 'upon', 'disagree with, upset')
وَدَعَكَهَا: وَ + دَعَكَ + هَا — wa-, and; I daʿaka, rub hard, knead (perf. 3 m. sg.); + hā, her (obj.)
السَّفَرُ: الـ + سَفَر — safar, journey, travel (m., nom.); 'the journey'
خَلِّهَا: khalli + hā — II khallā, leave, let be (imperative 2 m. sg.) + hā, her
لَمَّاتُرَدَّ: lammā + turadda — printed as one word: lammā, until (conj.) + I pass. turadda, be returned, be restored (3 f. sg.)
أَدْخِلْهَا: adkhil + hā — IV adkhala, make enter, put in (imperative 2 m. sg.) + hā, her
وَأَلْبِسْهَا: وَ + أَلْبِسْ + هَا — wa-, and; IV albasa, clothe (imperative 2 m. sg.) + hā, her (first obj.)
وَاطْلَعْ: وَ + اطْلَعْ — wa-, and; I iṭlaʿ, go up (imperative 2 m. sg.; with bi-, 'go up with, take up')
الْأَوْفَرُ: الـ + أَوْفَر — awfar, more abundant, fullest (elative, m., nom.); 'the fuller (share)'
النَّخَّاسِ: الـ + نَخَّاس — nakhkhās, slave-dealer (m., gen. in an iḍāfa); 'the slave-dealer's'
صَوَابًا: ṣawāb — right, correct (m., acc. indef., second object of wajada); 'right'; also: second object of raʾā, 'saw it (to be) right' (Night 192)
فَأَتَى: فَـ + أَتَى — fa-, so (conj.); I atā, come (perf. 3 m. sg.); with bi-, 'bring'
وَأَخْلَى: وَ + أَخْلَى — wa-, and; IV akhlā, vacate, clear out (perf. 3 m. sg.)
مَقْصُورَةً: maqṣūra — a closed-off chamber, private apartment (f., acc. indef.)
تَحْتَاجُ: taḥtāju — VIII iḥtāja, need (imperf. 3 f. sg.; with ilā, 'to', 'need')
فَمَكَثَتْ: فَـ + مَكَثَتْ — fa-, so (conj.); I makatha, stay, remain (perf. 3 f. sg.)
كَنُقْطَةِ: كَـ + نُقْطَة — nuqṭa, dot, spot (f., gen. in an iḍāfa); ka-, like, as (prep.); 'like a dot of'
بِعِذَارٍ: بِـ + عِذَار — ʿidhār, the line of first beard along the cheek (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., of what accompanies); 'with a down-line'
وَلَاقَصْرَ: wa- + lā + qaṣra — printed as one word: wa-, and; lā, no (neg. of the genus) + qaṣr, shortfall, falling short (uncertain reading)
يَفْتِكُ: yaftiku — I fataka, slay, strike down (imperf. 3 m. sg.)
بِاللَّوَاحِظِ: بِـ + الـ + لَوَاحِظ — lawāḥiẓ, glances (pl. of lāḥiẓa; gen.); bi-, with (prep., of instrument); 'with the glances'
رَنَا: ranā — I ranā, gaze (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'gazed'
يُفَتِّتُ: yufattitu — II fattata, crumble, shatter (imperf. 3 m. sg.)
بِالْقِوَامِ: بِـ + الـ + قِوَام — qiwām, stature, bearing (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., of instrument); 'with the stature'
اْنْثَنَى: inthanā — VII inthanā, bend, sway (perf. 3 m. sg.); printed with a mark on the alif
زَنْجِيُّ: zanjī — of the Zanj, black (nisba, m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
اللَّوَائِبِ: الـ + لَوَائِب — lawāʾib, obscure; perhaps ذَوَائِب 'locks of hair' (gen.)
عَسْجَدِيُّ: ʿasjadī — golden (nisba of ʿasjad, gold; m., nom.)
قَدُّهُ: qadd + hu — stature, slender build (m., nom.) + hu, his; 'his stature'
الْقَنَا: الـ + قَنَا — qanā, lances (pl. of qanāh; acc.); 'the lances'
قَبْلَهُ: قَبْلَ + هُ — qabla, before (adv. acc.) + -hu, him; 'before him' (uqtulnī qablahu, 'kill me before him'); in one earlier passage the print's قبله is taken as a slip for qalbahu, 'his heart' (see the note there); here: 'before him (the drowning man)'
الْقَاسِي: الـ + قَاسِي — qāsī, hard, harsh (act. part. of qasā; m., nom./gen.); 'the hard (one)'
وَرِقَّةَ: وَ + رِقَّة — riqqa, delicacy, slenderness (f., acc. in a vocative); wa-, and (conj.); 'and (O) delicacy of'
نُقِلْتَ: nuqilta — I pass. naqala, move, transfer (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'were you moved'
رِقَّةُ: riqqa — delicacy, slenderness (f., nom., subject of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa)
جَنَا: janā — I janā, commit an offence (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'offended'
عَاذِلِي: ʿādhil + ī — ʿādhil, one who blames (act. part., m., vocative, first term) + ī, my; 'O my censurer'
حُبِّهِ: ḥubb + hi — love (m., gen. after fī) + hi, him; 'love of him' Also 'his love' with -hi as the one who loves: ziyādata ḥubbihi lahu, 'the excess of his love for him'.
عَاذِرِي: ʿādhir + ī — ʿādhir, one who excuses (act. part., m., predicate) + ī, my; 'my excuser'
بِجِسْمٍ: بِـ + جِسْم — jism, body (m., gen. indef.); bi- in مَنْ لِي بِـ, 'who is there for me with/who will help me with'; 'with a body'
تَمَلَّكَهُ: tamallaka + hu — V tamallaka, take possession of (perf. 3 m. sg.) + hu, him (obj.)
الضَّنَى: الـ + ضَنَى — ḍanā, wasting illness, emaciation (m., nom.); 'the wasting'
لِلْفُوَادِ: لِـ + الـ + فُوَاد — fuwād, heart (m., gen.; printed without the hamza); li-, belonging to (prep., 'the fault is li- the heart'); 'for/with the heart'
وَخَلِّنِي: وَ + خَلِّ + نِي — wa-, and; II khallā, leave (imperative 2 m. sg.) + nī, me (obj.)
قَضِيَّةَ: qaḍiyya — matter, affair, case (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the affair of'
اشْتَرَيْتُكِ: اِشْتَرَى + تُ + كِ — ishtarā, to buy (form VIII perf.) + -tu, I + -ki, you (f.); 'I bought you'
سَرِيَّةً: سَرِيَّة — sarriyya, concubine (f., acc. indef.; the print marks the shadda on the yāʾ); 'a concubine'
خَلَى: khalā — to be alone with (perf. 3ms; here followed by bi-)
فَاجْعَلِي: فَـ + اِجْعَلِي — fa-, so (conj.) + ijʿalī, put, make! (imper. 2fs of jaʿala); 'so put'
بَالَكِ: بَال + كِ — bāl, mind, attention (m., acc.) + -ki, your (f.); with minhu, 'be on your guard'
وَاحْذَرِي: وَ + اِحْذَرِي — wa-, and + iḥdharī, beware! (imper. 2fs of ḥadhira)
تُرْبِهِ: تُرْبِ + هِ — tur(y)i-, you show (subj. 2fs of IV arā; printed with bāʾ for yāʾ) + -hi, him; 'that you show him'
تُسْمِعِيهِ: تُسْمِعِي + هِ — tusmiʿī, you make hear (subj. 2fs of IV asmaʿa) + -hi, him; 'you let him hear'
تَرَكَهَا: تَرَكَ + هَا — taraka, to leave (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'he left her'
الْمُقَدَّرَأَنَّ: الـ + مُقَدَّر + أَنَّ — muqaddar, decreed, fated (pass. part. of II qaddara; m., gen.) run together with anna, that (conj.); 'the decreed, that'
غَسَلَهَا: غَسَلَ + هَا — ghasala, to wash (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'washed her'
وَلَبِسَتِ: وَ + لَبِسَتِ — wa-, and + labisat, she put on, wore (perf. 3fs of labisa; linking kasra)
فَتَزَايَدَ: فَـ + تَزَايَدَ — fa-, so + tazāyada, to increase, grow greater (form VI perf. 3ms)
حُسْنُهَا: حُسْن + هَا — ḥusn, beauty (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
وَجَمَالُهَا: وَ + جَمَال + هَا — wa-, and + jamāl, beauty, grace (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her grace'
فَبَاسَتْ: فَـ + بَاسَتْ — fa-, and so + bāsat, she kissed (perf. 3fs of bāsa, colloquial for qabbala)
نَعِيمٌ: naʿīm — delight, bliss (m., nom.); an exclamation to one fresh from the bath, 'delight!'
أَنِيسَ: Anīs — 'friend', first part of the name Anīs al-Jalīs (voc., first term of an iḍāfa)
مُحْتَاجَةً: مُحْتَاج — muḥtāj, in need (act. part. of VIII iḥtāja; f., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'needing'
لِحُضُورِكِ: لِـ + حُضُور + كِ — li-, for (prep.; مَا ... إِلَّا لِـ 'nothing except for') + ḥuḍūr, presence (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'for your presence'
لِلْجَوَارِي: لِـ + الـ + جَوَارِي — li-, to (prep.; with قَالَ, 'said to') + al- + jawārī, slave-girls (gen.); 'to the slave-girls'
وَنَهَضْنَ: وَ + نَهَضْنَ — wa-, and + nahaḍna, they rose (perf. 3fp of nahaḍa)
وَالسِّتُّ: وَ + الـ + سِتّ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + sitt, lady (f., nom.); 'and the lady (being)'
وَكَّلَتْ: wakkalat — she appointed, put in charge (form II perf. 3fs of wakkala; takes bi- of the place)
الْمَقْصُورَةِ: الـ + مَقْصُورَة — maqṣūra, closed chamber, private room (f., gen.); 'the chamber'
أَنِيسُ: Anīs — 'friend', first part of the name Anīs al-Jalīs (nom.)
صَغِيرَتَيْنِ: صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīra, small, young (adj. f., dual, acc.); 'two young'
تُمَكِّنَا: tumakkinā — you two permit, give leave (form II of makkana; jussive 2md, 'do not (you two) let'; the print marks the shadda)
قَاعِدَةٌ: قَاعِد — qāʿid, sitting (act. part. of qaʿada; f., nom. indef., predicate); 'sitting'
بِالْمَقْصُورَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَقْصُورَة — bi-, in (prep., of place) + al- + maqṣūra, chamber (f., gen.); 'in the chamber'
وَسَأَلَ: وَ + سَأَلَ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (perf. 3ms)
وَعَنِ: وَ + عَنِ — wa-, and + ʿan, about (prep.; linking kasra before al-); 'and about'
الْعَائِلَةِ: الـ + عَائِلَة — ʿāʾila, household, family (f., gen.); 'the household'
الْجَارِيَتَانِ: الـ + جَارِيَة — jāriya, slave-girl (f., dual, nom.); 'the two slave-girls'
مَاشَأْنُ: مَا + شَأْن — mā, what? + shaʾn, affair, condition (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa), printed run together; 'what is the affair of'
خَلىَّ: khalla/khalā — to be alone with (perf. 3ms; the print marks a shadda on the final ى, kept); 'was alone with'
أَنْظُرَهُ: أَنْظُرَ + هُ — an, that + anẓura, I look (subj. 1s of naẓara) + -hu, him; 'that I look at him'
وَتَقَدَّمَتْ: وَ + تَقَدَّمَتْ — wa-, and + taqaddamat, she advanced (form V perf. 3fs of qaddama)
فَأَوْرَثَتْهَا: فَـ + أَوْرَثَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so + awrathat, to bequeath, leave as a legacy (form IV perf. 3fs) + -hā, her; 'so it left her'
النَّظْرَةُ: الـ + نَظْرَة — naẓra, glance, look (f., nom.); 'the glance'
أَوْرَثَتْهُ: أَوْرَثَتْ + هُ — awrathat, bequeathed (form IV perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'it left him'
وَوَقَعَ: وَ + وَقَعَ — wa-, and + waqaʿa, to fall (perf. 3ms)
شَرَكِ: sharak — snare, net (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the snare of'
هَوَى: hawā — love, passion (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the love of'
الْجَارِيَتَيْنِ: الـ + جَارِيَة — jāriya, slave-girl (f., dual, gen.); 'the two slave-girls'
فَهَرَبَتَا: فَـ + هَرَبَتَا — fa-, and so + harabatā, the two (f.) fled (perf. 3fd of haraba)
وَوَقَفَتَا: وَ + وَقَفَتَا — wa-, and + waqafatā, the two (f.) stood (perf. 3fd of waqafa)
وَتَنْظُرُ: وَ + تَنْظُرُ — wa-, and + tanẓuru, she looks (imperf. 3fs)
اشْتَرَاكِ: اِشْتَرَى + كِ — ishtarā, to buy (form VIII perf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'he bought you'
تَقَلَّمَ: taqallama — printed for taqaddama, 'he advanced' (form V perf. 3ms); the print has lām for dāl
السُّكْرِ: الـ + سُكْر — sukr, drunkenness (m., gen.); 'the drunkenness'
وَعَمِلَهَا: وَ + عَمِلَ + هَا — wa-, and + ʿamila, to make, do (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and set her'
شَبَّكَتْ: shabbakat — she interlaced, clasped (form II perf. 3fs of shabbaka)
عُنُقِهِ: عُنُق + هِ — ʿunuq, neck (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his neck'
وَاسْتَقْبَلَتْهُ: وَ + اِسْتَقْبَلَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + istaqbalat, to receive, meet (form X perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she received him'
بِبَوْسٍ: بِـ + بَوْس — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment, 'with') + baws, kissing (m., gen.); 'with kissing'
وَشَهِيقٍ: وَ + شَهِيق — wa-, and + shahīq, a drawn gasping breath (m., gen.); 'and gasping'
وَغَنَجٍ: وَ + غَنَج — wa-, and + ghanaj, languor, coquetry (m., gen.); 'and coquetry'
وَمَصَّ: وَ + مَصَّ — wa-, and + maṣṣa, to suck (perf. 3ms)
لِسَانَهَا: لِسَان + هَا — lisān, tongue (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her tongue'
وَمَصَّتْ: وَ + مَصَّتْ — wa-, and + maṣṣat, she sucked (perf. 3fs of maṣṣa)
وَأَزَالَ: وَ + أَزَالَ — wa-, and + azāla, to remove, take away (form IV perf. 3ms)
الصَّغِيرَ: الـ + صَغِير — ṣaghīr, small, young (adj. m., acc.); 'the young'
أَنِيسِ: Anīs — 'friend', first part of the name Anīs al-Jalīs (gen.)
صَرَخَتَا: ṣarakhatā — the two (f.) screamed (perf. 3fd of ṣarakha)
وَعَيَّطَتَا: وَ + عَيَّطَتَا — wa-, and + ʿayyaṭatā, the two (f.) shouted (form II perf. 3fd of ʿayyaṭa; colloquial)
وَلِلنَّجَاةِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + نَجَاة — wa-, and + li-, for (prep.; the object sought) + al- + najāh, escape, deliverance (f., gen.); 'and for escape'
وَفَرَّ: وَ + فَرَّ — wa-, and + farra, to flee (perf. 3ms)
عَقِبَ: ʿaqiba — after, in the wake of (prep.-noun, acc.)
عَيَاطَ: ʿayāṭ — shouting, outcry (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the outcry of'
وَالْعَرَقُ: وَ + الـ + عَرَق — wa-, and (circumstantial) + ʿaraq, sweat (m., nom.); 'with the sweat'
الْعَيَاطُ: الـ + عَيَاط — ʿayāṭ, shouting, outcry (m., nom.); 'the outcry'
أَقْعَدَ: aqʿada — to seat, make sit (form IV perf. 3ms); the print splits aqʿadat-humā in two
تْهُمَا: ت + هُمَا — -t, she (3fs ending of aqʿada-t) + -humā, the two of them; 'she had seated them (two)'
وَيْلَكُمَا: وَيْل + كُمَا — wayl, woe (m., acc.) + -kumā, to you two; 'woe to you two!' (a scolding)
رَأَتَاهَا: رَأَتَا + هَا — raʾatā, the two (f.) saw (perf. 3fd of raʾā) + -hā, her; 'the two saw her'
قَالَتَاأَنَّ: قَالَتَا + أَنَّ — qālatā, the two (f.) said (perf. 3fd of qāla) run together with anna, that (conj.); 'the two said that'
ضَرَبَنَا: ضَرَبَ + نَا — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (perf. 3ms) + -nā, us; 'he beat us'
فَهَرَبْنَا: فَـ + هَرَبْنَا — fa-, and so + harabnā, we fled (perf. 1p of haraba) Also with ʿinda, apparently 'to take refuge with': فَهَرَبْنَا عِنْدَهُمْ 'and took refuge with them'.
صَيَّحْنَا: ṣayyaḥnā — we cried out (form II perf. 1p of ṣayyaḥa; with ʿalā, 'called out to')
جَمِيلٍ: jamīl — handsome, beautiful (adj. m., gen. indef.)
اعْتَقَدْتُ: iʿtaqadtu — I believed, thought (form VIII perf. 1s of iʿtaqada)
كَلَّمَكِ: كَلَّمَ + كِ — kallama, to speak to (form II perf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'did he speak to you'
بِشَيٌ: بِـ + شَيْء — bi-, with, by (prep.) + shayʾ, thing (m.; the print marks a tanwīn of damma on the yāʾ, kept as printed); 'with a thing, (or) something'
بَوْسَاتٍ: بَوْسَة — bawsa, a kiss (f. pl., gen. indef.); 'of kisses'
تَرَكَكِ: تَرَكَ + كِ — taraka, to leave (perf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'he left you'
افْتِضَاضٍ: iftiḍāḍ — deflowering (verbal noun of form VIII iftaḍḍa; m., gen. indef.)
وَلَطَمَتْ: وَ + لَطَمَتْ — wa-, and + laṭamat, she struck, slapped (perf. 3fs of laṭama)
خَوْفَاعَلَى: خَوْفًا + عَلَى — khawf, fear (m., acc. indef.; 'fearing') run together with ʿalā, for, over (prep.; 'in fear for')
يَذْبَحَهُ: يَذْبَحَ + هُ — yadhbaḥa, he slaughters, cuts the throat of (subj. 3ms of dhabaḥa) + -hu, him; 'that he slaughter him'
فَبَيْنَاهُمْ: فَـ + بَيْنَا + هُمْ — fa-, and so + baynā, while (conj.) + -hum, they; 'while they (were)'
تَسْمَعُهُ: تَسْمَعُ + هُ — tasmaʿu, you hear (imperf. 2ms of samiʿa) + -hu, it; 'you hear it'
وَخَرَّقَ: وَ + خَرَّقَ — wa-, and + kharraqa, to tear, rend (form II perf. 3ms)
تَقْتُلْ: taqtul — you kill (jussive 2ms of qatala; with lā, 'do not kill')
أُعْطِيكَ: أُعْطِي + كَ — uʿṭī, I give (imperf. 1s of IV aʿṭā) + -ka, you (m.); 'I will give you'
بِثَمَنِهَا: بِـ + ثَمَن + هَا — bi-, of, for (prep.; حَاجَةٌ بِـ 'need of') + thaman, price (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her price'
الْعَدُوَّ: الـ + عَدُوّ — ʿaduww, enemy (m., acc., after anna); 'the enemy'
الشَّاءِ: الـ + شَاء — printed شاء—ر for الشاعر, with the ʿayn lost to a dash; 'the (poet)' (the word is completed by the ر that follows the dash)
ز: ز — a stray letter printed after the dash that stands for the word شعر 'poetry' (a compositor's mark, not a word)
لِزَوْجَتِهِ: li-, to (prep., with qāla) + zawja, wife (f.) + -hi, his; 'to his wife'
الْعِلْ: al- + ʿil — the + ʿil; probably a truncated al-ʿilj, 'the churl, brute' (an abusive word); the print is obscure, uncertain
وَمَتَي: wa- + matā — wa-, and + matā, when (written with a dotted yā' as printed); 'and when'
يُحِبُّكَ: aḥabba, love (IV, 3 m.s. imperfect) + -ka, you; 'he loves you'
أَعْجَبَتْهُ: aʿjaba, please (IV, 3 f.s. perfect) + -hu, him; 'she pleased him'
لِابْنِهِ: li-, to (prep., with qāla) + ibn, son + -hi, his; 'to his son'
خُذْهَا: khudh, take (imperative of akhadha) + -hā, her; 'take her'
فَيَقُولُ: fa- + yaqūlu — fa-, and, then + qāla, say (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and says'
أَهْجُمْ: hajama, rush upon, make a raid (1 s. imperfect); 'let me rush upon'
وَآتِيكَ: wa- + ātī + -ka — wa-, and + ātī, I bring (IV of atā, 1 s. imperfect) + -ka, you; 'and bring you'
فَيَرْسُمُ: fa- + yarsumu — fa-, and so + rasama, decree, command (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and he orders'
فَيَكْبِسُ: fa- + yakbisu — fa-, and so + kabasa, burst into, raid (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and raids'
وَيَأْخُذُ: wa- + yaʾkhudhu — wa-, and + akhadha, take (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and takes'
وَيُحْضِرُهَا: wa- + yuḥḍiru + -hā — wa-, and + aḥḍara, bring (IV, 3 m.s. imperfect) + -hā, her; 'and brings her'
يَسْأَلُهَا: saʾala, ask (3 m.s. imperfect) + -hā, her; 'asks her'
تُنْكِرُ: ankara, deny (IV, 3 f.s. imperfect, following taqdiru without an); 'to deny'
حَظٌّ: ḥaẓẓ, portion, share, good fortune, nominative indefinite
فَيُمَثِّلُ: fa- + yumaththilu — fa-, and so + mathhala (II), mutilate, make an example of (3 m.s. imperfect)
فَتَرُوحُ: fa- + tarūḥu — fa-, and so + rāḥa, go off, depart (3 f.s. imperfect, subject rūḥ); 'and goes off'
لَاتُعْلِمْ: lā + tuʿlim — lā, do not (prohibition) + aʿlama, inform (IV, 2 m.s. jussive); 'do not inform' (printed as one word)
وَسَلِّمْ: wa- + sallim — wa-, and + sallama (II), hand over, entrust (imperative)
وَيَأْتِي: wa- + yaʾtī — wa-, and + atā, come (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and comes'
لِأُمِّهِ: li-, to (prep.) + umm, mother + -hi, his; 'to his mother'
وَيَقُومُ: wa- + yaqūmu — wa-, and + qāma, rise (3 m.s. imperfect); 'and rises'
نَعْدَمُ: ʿadima, lose, be bereft of (1 pl. imperfect); 'we lose'
هَجَّ: hajja, bolt, run off (3 m.s. perfect; colloquial verb; the print marks the shadda)
اِسْهَرْ: sahira, stay awake, keep watch (imperative 2 m.s.)
وَاصْطَلِحْ: wa- + iṣṭaliḥ — wa-, and + iṣṭalaḥa (VIII), make peace, be reconciled (imperative)
وَأَعْطِهِ: wa- + aʿṭi + -hi — wa-, and + aʿṭā, give (IV, imperative) + -hi, him; 'and give him'
أَمْسَكَهُ: amsaka (IV), seize (3 m.s. perfect) + -hu, him; 'he seized him'
نَحْرَهُ: naḥr, cutting the throat, slaughter (verbal noun), accusative + -hu, his; 'to cut his throat'
فَأَدْرَكَتْهُ: fa- + adrakat + -hu — fa-, and so + adraka (IV), overtake, catch up with (3 f.s. perfect) + -hu, him
أَذْبَحُهُ: dhabaḥa, slaughter (1 s. imperfect) + -hu, him; 'I slaughter him, I will slaughter him'
فَتَغَرْ: fa- + taghar — fa-, and then + taghar-, first part of tagharghara (II quadriliteral, 'fill with tears'), printed split in two
غَرَتْ: -gharat, second part of tagharghara (3 f.s. perfect); read with the preceding word as 'welled'
ذَهَابُ: dhahāb, going, going away, loss (verbal noun), nominative in construct
وَرُوحِي: wa- + rūḥ + -ī — wa-, and + rūḥ, soul, life + my
هَبْنِي: hab (imperative of wahaba in the sense 'reckon, suppose') + -nī, me; 'suppose me'
جَنَيْتُ: janā, commit an offence (1 s. perfect); 'I have offended'
لِلْجَانِي: li- + al- + jānī — li-, to (prep.) + the + jānī, offender (active participle of janā)
شَامِلَا: shāmil, all-embracing, complete (active participle), accusative, with the final alif of rhyme
ذَاعَسَى: dhā + ʿasā — dhā, this (in mā dhā 'what?') + ʿasā, perhaps, it may be that (the print joins the two)
وَهْوَفِي: wa- + huwa + fī — wa-, while, and + huwa, he + fī, in (the print joins the three); 'while he is in'
دَرْكِ: darak, depth, bottom, genitive in construct
الْحَضِيضِ: al- + ḥaḍīḍ — the + ḥaḍīḍ, lowest ground, abyss; genitive
وَأَنْتَ: wa- + anta — wa-, while, and + anta, you
مَنْزِلَا: manzil, station, rank, accusative of specification, with the final alif of rhyme
تُنْصِفُ: تُنْصِفُ — anṣafa (IV), to treat justly; 2nd m. sg. imperfect, 'you treat justly'
وَهَبْتُهَا: وَهَبْتُ + هَا — wahaba, to give, bestow; 1st sg. perfect, 'I gave'; -hā, her: 'I gave her'
أُنْصِفُهَا: أُنْصِفُ + هَا — anṣafa (IV), to treat justly, deal fairly with; 1st sg. imperfect 'I deal fairly'; -hā, her: 'deal fairly with her'
تَتَزَوَّجْ: تَتَزَوَّجْ — tazawwaja (V), to marry; 2nd m. sg. jussive after لَا, 'do not marry'
تُضَارَّهَا: تُضَارَّ + هَا — ḍārra (III), to harm, wrong; 2nd m. sg. jussive after لَا, 'do not harm'; -hā, her
تَبِعْهَا: تَبِعْ + هَا — bāʿa, to sell; jussive 2nd m. sg., after لَا 'do not sell'; -hā, her: 'do not sell her'
أَحْلِفُ: أَحْلِفُ — ḥalafa, yaḥlifu, to swear (an oath); 1st sg. imperfect, 'I swear'
أَبِيعُهَا: أَبِيعُ + هَا — bāʿa, yabīʿu, to sell; 1st sg. imperfect, 'I sell/shall sell'; -hā, her; 'I shall sell her'
فَحَلَفَ: فَـ + حَلَفَ — fa-, and so (consecutive particle) + ḥalafa, to swear; 3rd m. sg. perfect: 'and he swore' Also with ʿalā + a person, 'to adjure, press someone with an oath': fa-ḥalafa ʿalā ṣāḥibihi, 'he pressed his friend with an oath'.
وَأَنْسَى: وَ + أَنْسَى — wa-, and (conj.) + ansā (IV), to make forget; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'and he made forget' (takes two objects)
فَبَلَغَهُ: فَـ + بَلَغَ + هُ — fa-, and so (consecutive particle) + balagha, to reach; 3rd m. sg. perfect; -hu, him: 'and it reached him'
لِمَنْزِلَةِ: لِـ + مَنْزِلَة — manzila, rank, standing (f.); li-, because of, on account of (prep.): 'because of the rank of'
فَضْلُ: فَضْل — faḍl, excellence, grace (m.); in فَضْلُ الدِّينِ 'Faḍl al-Dīn', 'Excellence of the Faith', a title/name of the vizier
فَضَرَّ: فَـ + ضَرَّ — fa-, and so (consecutive particle) + ḍarra, to harm; 3rd m. sg. perfect: 'and it harmed' (the object follows as بِهِ)
الْهَوَاءُ: الـ + هَوَاء — hawāʾ, air, wind (m.); 'the air'
فَلَزِمَ: فَـ + لَزِمَ — fa-, and so (consecutive particle) + lazima, to cleave to, keep to; 3rd m. sg. perfect: 'and he kept to'
الْوِسَادَ: الـ + وِسَاد — wisād, pillow, cushion (m.); 'the pillow'; لَزِمَ الْوِسَادَ 'took to his bed'
السُّهَادُ: الـ + سُهَاد — suhād, sleeplessness, wakefulness (m.); 'the sleeplessness'
وَتَسَلْسَلَ: وَ + تَسَلْسَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasalsala (quadriliteral V), to be linked in a chain, follow in a series; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'and it chained on'
عَلِيَّ: عَلِيّ — ʿAlī, proper name (m.), lit. 'high, exalted'; in نُورُ الدِّينِ عَلِيٌّ; here: acc., object of aʿjaba: ʿAliyya ibna Bakkārin; also: acc., object of istakhbirī, the one asked about: istakhbirī minhu ʿAliyya ibna Bakkārin, 'ask him for news of ʿAlī ibn Bakkār' Also acc. as the noun of inna: thumma inna ʿAliyya ibna Bakkārin amara, 'then ʿAlī ibn Bakkār ordered'.
مَقْسُومٌ: مَقْسُوم — maqsūm, apportioned, divided (passive participle of قَسَمَ); 'apportioned'
وَالْأَجَلَ: وَ + الـ + أَجَل — wa-, and (conj.) + ajal, appointed term, life-span (m.); al-, the: 'and the appointed term'
مَحْتُومٌ: مَحْتُوم — maḥtūm, decreed, ordained (passive participle of حَتَمَ); 'decreed'
نَسَمَةٍ: نَسَمَة — nasama, living soul, breath (f.); 'a soul', genitive after كُلّ
فَجَلَّ: فَـ + جَلَّ — fa-, so, hence (particle of consequence) + jalla, to be great, exalted; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'so exalted is'
مُوتُ: مُوتُ — māta, yamūtu, to die; 1st sg. imperfect (after سا for سأموت), 'I shall die'
مُلْكٌ: مُلْك — mulk, kingdom, dominion, sovereignty (m.); 'a kingdom'
الْمُلْكُ: الـ + مُلْك — mulk, kingdom, dominion, sovereignty (m.); al-, the: 'the kingdom/sovereignty'
مُلْكُ: مُلْك — mulk, kingdom, dominion, sovereignty (m.); 'a kingdom'
وَصِيَّةٌ: وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, charge, bequest, instruction (f.); 'a charge'
تَقْوَى: تَقْوَى — taqwā, fear of God, piety (f.), construct: 'fear of'
وَالْوَصِيَّةُ: وَ + الـ + وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, charge, bequest, instruction (f.); wa-, and (conj.); al-, the: 'and the charge'
بِفِعْلِ: بِـ + فِعْل — fiʿl, doing, deed (m.); bi-, for, by (prep.; مَعْرُوفًا بِـ 'known for'): 'known for the doing of'
وَالدُّعَاءِ: وَ + الـ + دُعَاء — duʿāʾ, prayer, supplication (m.); wa-, and (conj.); al-, the: 'and the prayer'
الْمَنَابِرِ: الـ + مَنَابِر — pl. of مِنْبَر, minbar, pulpit; 'the pulpits'
أَرْجُو: أَرْجُو — rajā, yarjū, to hope; 1st sg. imperfect, 'I hope'
نَطَقَ: نَطَقَ — naṭaqa, to utter, speak; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'he uttered'
بِالشَّهَادَتَيْنِ: بِـ + الـ + شَهَادَتَيْن — shahāda, testimony, dual shahādatayn, the two testimonies of faith; bi-, with (prep.; نَطَقَ بِـ 'pronounce, utter'): 'he pronounced the two testimonies'
فَكُتِبَ: فَـ + كُتِبَ — fa-, and so (consecutive particle) + kutiba, passive of kataba, to write; 3rd m. sg. perfect passive: 'and it was written'
بِالْعِيَاطِ: بِـ + الـ + عِيَاط — ʿiyāṭ, wailing (colloquial); bi-, with, amid (prep.): 'with the wailing' Also after qāma, bi- marks the thing set about: قَامُوا بِالْعِيَاطِ 'they broke into wailing'.
وَانْصَلَ: وَ + اِنْصَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + inṣala, apparently for ittaṣala (VIII), to reach, be connected; 3rd m. sg. perfect, 'and it reached' (see note)
بِالسُّلْطَانِ: بِـ + الـ + سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan; bi-, to/with (here the verb اِنْصَلَ is joined 'to' it): 'reached the sultan'
وَسَمِعَتْ: وَ + سَمِعَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + samiʿa, to hear; 3rd f. sg. perfect, 'and heard'
بِوَفَاةِ: بِـ + وَفَاة — wafāt, death, decease (f.); bi-, of (prep.; سَمِعَ بِـ 'hear of'): 'of the death of'
الصِّبْيَانُ: الـ + صِبْيَان — pl. of صَبِيّ, ṣabī, boy; 'the boys' (schoolboys, here)
مَكَاتِبِهَا: مَكَاتِب + هَا — pl. of مَكْتَب, maktab, school; -hā, its (the city's): 'its schools'
نُورُ: نُور — nūr, light (m.), construct: 'light of'; in the name Nūr al-Dīn, 'Light of the Faith'
وَجَهَّزَهُ: وَ + جَهَّزَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jahhaza (II), to prepare, equip (a corpse for burial); 3rd m. sg. perfect; -hu, him: 'and he prepared him'
وَحَضَرَتِ: وَ + حَضَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaḍara, to be present; 3rd f. sg. perfect (verb before its plural subject), 'and were present'
الْأُمَرَاءُ: الـ + أُمَرَاء — pl. of أَمِير, amīr, emir, commander; al-, the: 'the emirs'
وَأَهْلُ: وَ + أَهْل — wa-, and (conj.) + ahl, people, folk (m.), construct: 'and the people of'
الْجَنَازَةَ: الـ + جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, bier (f.); 'the funeral', accusative object of حَضَرَ
جَنَازَتِهِ: جَنَازَة + هِ — janāza, bier, funeral procession (f.) + -hi, his: 'his bier'
اَحْبَابِي: أَحْبَابِي — pl. of حَبِيب, ḥabīb, beloved; -ī, my: 'my loved ones'
وَغَسَّلُونِي: وَ + غَسَّلُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ghassala (II), to wash (a corpse); 3rd m. pl. perfect; -nī, me: 'and they washed me'
وَجَرَّدُونِي: وَ + جَرَّدُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + jarrada (II), to strip; 3rd m. pl. perfect, 'they stripped'; -nī, me: 'and they stripped me'
لَابِسَهَا: لَابِس + هَا — lābis, wearing (active participle of لَبِسَ) + -hā, it (pl. things): 'wearing them'
وَاَلْبَسُونِي: وَ + أَلْبَسُونِي — wa-, and (conj.) + albasa (IV), to clothe; 3rd m. pl. perfect, 'they clothed'; -nī, me: 'and they clothed me'
اَثْوَابِي: أَثْوَابِي — pl. of ثَوْب, thawb, garment, robe; -ī, my: 'my robes'
وَحَمَّلُونِي: وَ + حَمَّلُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥammala (II), to cause to carry, load; 3rd m. pl. perfect; -nī, me: 'and they made me be carried, and they bore me'
اَعْنَاقِ: أَعْنَاق — pl. of عُنُق, ʿunuq, neck; construct, 'necks of'
اَرْبَعَةٍ: أَرْبَعَة — arbaʿa, four (fem. form, before a masc. pl.: 'four men'), genitive after 'necks of'
الْمُصَلَّى: الـ + مُصَلَّى — muṣallā, place of prayer (n. of place from صَلَّى); 'the place of prayer' (the open ground outside the city for funeral prayer)
وَبَعْضُ: وَ + بَعْض — wa-, and (conj.) + baʿḍ, some (m.), construct: 'and some of'
صَلَّوْا: صَلَّوْا — ṣallā (II), to pray; 3rd m. pl. perfect, 'they prayed'
صَلَاةً: صَلَاة — ṣalāt, prayer (f.); 'a prayer' (accusative cognate object)
سُجُودَ: سُجُود — sujūd, prostration (verbal noun of سَجَدَ); 'prostration'
اَصْحَابِي: أَصْحَابِي — pl. of صَاحِب, ṣāḥib, companion; -ī, my: 'my companions'
وَشَيَّعُونِي: وَ + شَيَّعُوا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + shayyaʿa (II), to escort, accompany to the grave; 3rd m. pl. perfect; -nī, me: 'and they escorted me'
مُقَنْطَرَةٍ: مُقَنْطَرَة — muqanṭara, vaulted, arched (passive participle of قَنْطَرَ); 'vaulted' (feminine, qualifying دَار)
يَفْنَى: يَفْنَى — fanā, yafnā, to perish, pass away; 3rd m. sg. imperfect, 'passes away'
يُفْتَحُ: يُفْتَحُ — fataḥa, to open; 3rd m. sg. imperfect passive, 'is opened'
بَابِي: بَابِي — bāb, door, gate (m.) + -ī, my: 'my door' (also the rhyme word)
وَارَاهُ: وَارَى + هُ — wārā (form III), to cover, bury; -hu, him; 'he buried him'
وَرَجَعَتِ: و + رَجَعَتِ — wa-, and + rajaʿat, she/it returned (3 f. sg. perfect of رَجَعَ), with kasra before al-; 'and ... returned'
الْأَهْلُ: الـ + أَهْل — ahl, family, household (m.); nominative
وَالْأَصْحَابُ: و + الـ + أَصْحَاب — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of صَاحِب); nominative
رَحَلُوا: رَحَلُوا — raḥalū, they departed (3 m. pl. perfect of رَحَلَ, to set out, depart)
فَوَدَّعْتُهُمْ: فـ + وَدَّعْتُ + هُمْ — fa-, and so + waddaʿtu (form II), I bade farewell (1 sg. perfect of وَدَّعَ) + hum, them
اسْتَقَلُّوا: اسْتَقَلُّوا — istaqallū (form X), they set out, rose to depart (3 m. pl. perfect)
وَدَّعُوا: وَدَّعُوا — waddaʿū, they bade farewell (3 m. pl. perfect of وَدَّعَ)
تَوَلَّوْا: تَوَلَّوْا — tawallaw (form V), they turned away, went off (3 m. pl. perfect of تَوَلَّى)
رَاحَتِ: رَاحَتِ — rāḥat, she went off, departed (3 f. sg. perfect of رَاحَ), kasra before al-
النَّفْسُ: الـ + نَّفْس — nafs, soul, self (f.); nominative, subject
ارْجِعِي: ارْجِعِي — irjiʿī, return! (f. sg. imperative of رَجَعَ), addressed to the soul
اَرْجِعُ: أَرْجِعُ — arjiʿu, I return, shall I return (1 sg. imperfect of رَجَعَ)
جَسَدٍ: جَسَدٍ — jasad, body (m.); genitive after إِلَى, indefinite
رُوحٌ: رُوحٌ — rūḥ, spirit, breath of life (m./f.); nominative indefinite
عَظْمَةٌ: عَظْمَةٌ — ʿaẓma, a bone (f. unit noun from عَظْم); nominative indefinite
تَتَقَعْقَعُ: تَتَقَعْقَعُ — tataqaʿqaʿu (quadriliteral form II), it rattles, clatters (3 f. sg. imperfect)
وَعَيْنَايَ: وَ + عَيْنَا + يَ — wa-, and + ʿaynā, two eyes (nom. dual of عَيْن, eye, f.) + -ya, my; 'and my two eyes'
اَعْمَا: أَعْمَا — aʿmā, he/it blinded (3 m. sg. perfect, form IV of عَمِيَ, to be blind), with the object pronoun following
شِدَّةُ: شِدَّةُ — shidda, intensity, violence (f.); nominative, first term of construct
وَاُذْنِي: وَ + أُذْنِي — wa-, and + udhn, ear (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my ear'
صَمَّاءَ: صَمَّاءَ — ṣammāʾ, deaf (f. adj.); accusative as predicate
تَسْمَعُ: تَسْمَعُ — tasmaʿu, she hears (3 f. sg. imperfect of سَمِعَ); also 2ms, 'you hear'; with min, 'listen to, heed': amā tasmaʿu minnī, 'will you not listen to me?'
مَكَثَ: مَكَثَ — makatha, he stayed, remained (3 m. sg. perfect)
شَدِيدَ: شَدِيد — shadīd, severe, intense (adj.); accusative as a state, in construct with the next word
إذْ: إِذْ — idh, when, suddenly; after بَيْنَمَا it introduces the interruption
طَرَقَ: طَرَقَ — ṭaraqa, he knocked (3 m. sg. perfect)
طَارِقٌ: طَارِق — ṭāriq, a knocker, one who knocks (active participle of طَرَقَ); nominative indefinite, subject
نُدَمَاءِ: نُدَمَاء — nudamāʾ, boon-companions, drinking-companions (pl. of نَدِيم); genitive after مِنْ, in construct
وَأَصْحَابِهِ: و + أَصْحَاب + هِ — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of صَاحِب) + -hi, his; genitive; 'and his companions'
مَصِيرُ: مَصِير — maṣīr, end, destination, final lot (m.); nominative in construct
الْأَوَّلِينَ: الـ + أَوَّلِين — awwalīn, the first ones, the ancients (pl. of أَوَّل); genitive plural
وَالْآخِرِينَ: و + الـ + آخِرِين — wa-, and + ākhirīn, the last ones (pl. of آخِر); genitive; 'the first and the last' is a title of the Prophet
لِلْجُلُوسِ: لِـ + الـ + جُلُوس — li-, for (prep.) + al-, the + julūs, sitting (verbal noun of جَلَسَ); 'for sitting'
إلَيْهَا: إِلَى + هَا — ilā, to + -hā, her/it; 'to it' (إِلَى takes -ay- before a suffix)
يَحْتَاجُهُ: يَحْتَاجُ + هُ — yaḥtāju, he needs (3 m. sg. imperfect of احْتَاجَ, form VIII) + -hu, it; 'what he needed'
أَصْحَاب + هُ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of صَاحِب) + -hu, his; nominative; the full stop is the edition's
جَارِيَتَهُ: جَارِيَة + هُ — jāriya, slave-girl, girl (f.) + -hu, his; accusative; 'his slave-girl'
إنَّهُ: إِنَّ + هُ — inna, indeed, that (particle introducing a clause) + -hu, he; 'that he'
وَجَلُدَ: و + جَلُدَ — wa-, and + jaluda, he was steadfast, held out (3 m. sg. perfect); the sense 'kept on' suits the context, though the print may be a slip for جَلَسَ, 'sat'
مَقَا: مَقَا — maqā, first part of مَقَامًا (maqām, session, sitting-place), split from its ending by a stray space in the print
وَيَتَكَرَّمُ: و + يَتَكَرَّمُ — wa-, and + yatakarramu (form V), he acts generously, lavishes (3 m. sg. imperfect of تَكَرَّمَ)
وَكِيلُهُ: وَكِيل + هُ — wakīl, steward, agent (m.) + -hu, his; nominative; 'his steward'
بَعْضِهِمْ: بَعْض + هِمْ — baʿḍ, some, part of (m.) + -him, them; 'some of them'; genitive
يُنْفِقْ: يُنْفِقْ — yunfiq, he spends (3 m. sg. jussive of أَنْفَقَ, form IV), after مَنْ of condition
يَحْسِبْ: يَحْسِبْ — yaḥsib, he reckons, counts (3 m. sg. jussive of حَسِبَ)
وَالشَّا: و + الـ + شَّا — wa-, and + al-, the + shā, first part of الشاعر (al-shāʿir, the poet), split from its ending in the print
عَرِيَقُ—ولُ: عَرِ + يَقُولُ — ʿari, the end of الشاعر (shāʿir, poet; here genitive form ʿari before a space), and yaqūlu, he says; the print runs the two words together and breaks them with a dash: 'the poet says'
اَصُونُ: أَصُونُ — aṣūnu, I guard, protect (1 sg. imperfect of صَانَ)
دَرَاهِمِي: دَرَاهِم + ي — darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of دِرْهَم) + -ī, my
وَاَذُبُّ: وَ + أَذُبُّ — wa-, and + adhubbu, I defend, ward off (1 sg. imperfect of ذَبَّ)
لِعِلْمِي: لِـ + عِلْم + ي — li-, because of, for (prep.; 'on account of') + ʿilm, knowing + -ī, my; 'because I know'
اَنَّهَا: أَنَّ + هَا — anna, that + -hā, they/it; 'that they'
وَنُرْسِي: وَ + نُرْس + ي — wa-, and + nurs, shield (m.) + -ī, my
اَبْذُلْهَا: أَبْذُلْهَا — abdhul + hā, shall I lavish, give away? (1 sg. jussive/subjunctive of بَذَلَ) + -hā, them; an obscure line, taken as a rhetorical question
اَعْلَى: أَعْلَى — aʿlā, highest, loftiest (elative of عَالٍ)
الْاَعَادِي: الـ + أَعَادِي — aʿādī, enemies (pl. of عَدُوّ); genitive
وَابْذُلِ: وَ + ابْذُلِ — wa-, and + ibdhuli, and shall I spend? (jussive of بَذَلَ)
فَاَكُلُهَا: فَـ + أَكُلُهَا — fa-, and so + akuluhā, I eat them (1 sg. imperfect of أَكَلَ, jussive/short form) + -hā, them
وَاَشْرِبُهَا: وَ + أَشْرِبُهَا — wa-, and + ashribuhā, I drink them (1 sg. imperfect of شَرِبَ) + -hā
اَشْكُو: أَشْكُو — ashkū, I complain (1 sg. imperfect of شَكَا)
بِفَلْسِ: بِـ + فَلْس — bi-, for/about (prep.) + fals, a fals, a copper coin of small value (m.)
وَاَحْفَظُ: وَ + أَحْفَظُ — wa-, and + aḥfaẓu, I keep, guard (1 sg. imperfect of حَفِظَ)
دِرْهَمِي: دِرْهَم + ي — dirham, silver coin (m.) + -ī, my
لَئِيمِ: لَئِيم — laʾīm, base, mean (adj.); genitive in construct
الطَّبْعِ: الـ + طَّبْع — ṭabʿ, nature, character (m.); genitive
يَصْفُو: يَصْفُو — yaṣfū, he is clear, pure, sincere (3 m. sg. imperfect of صَفَا)
لِاِنْسِي: لِـ + إِنْس + ي — li-, toward, for (prep.) + insī, a human being (nisba adj. of إِنْس, mankind)
اَحَبُّ: أَحَبّ — aḥabb, dearer, more beloved (elative of حَبِيب)
اِلَيَّ: إِلَى + يَّ — ilā, to (prep.) + -ya, me; 'to me'
لِنَذْلٍ: لِـ + نَذْل — li-, to (prep.) + nadhl, a base, vile fellow (m.)
اَنِلْنِي: أَنِلْ + نِي — anil, give! (m. sg. imperative, form IV of نَالَ) + -nī, me; 'grant me'
لِغَدٍ: لِـ + غَد — li-, until, for (prep.) + ghad, tomorrow (m.)
فَيَعْرِضُ: فَـ + يَعْرِضُ — fa-, and so + yaʿriḍu, he turns aside (3 m. sg. imperfect of عَرَضَ)
وَيَصُدُّ: وَ + يَصُدُّ — wa-, and + yaṣuddu, he turns away, shuns (3 m. sg. imperfect of صَدَّ)
فَتَبْقَى: فَـ + تَبْقَى — fa-, and so + tabqā, she remains (3 f. sg. imperfect of بَقِيَ)
فَيَاذُلَّ: فَـ + يَا + ذُلَّ — fa-, and so + yā, O (vocative) + dhull, abasement, humiliation (m.); 'O the abasement of ...!'
وَلَوْكَانَتْ: وَ + لَوْ + كَانَتْ — wa-, and + law, even if + kānat, she was (3 f. sg. perfect of كَانَ); written as one word in the print: 'even if they were'
فَضَائِلُهُمْ: فَضَائِل + هُمْ — faḍāʾil, merits, virtues (pl. of فَضِيلَة) + -hum, their
كَشَمْسِ: كَـ + شَمْس — ka-, like, as (prep.) + shams, sun (f.)
النَّفَقَةُ: الـ + نَّفَقَة — nafaqa, spending, expenditure (f.); nominative
الْجَزِيلَةُ: الـ + جَزِيلَة — jazīla, abundant, large (f. adj.); nominative
وَالْمَوَاهِبُ: و + الـ + مَوَاهِب — wa-, and + mawāhib, gifts (pl. of مَوْهِبَة); nominative
الْعَظِيمَةُ: الـ + عَظِيمَة — ʿaẓīma, great, vast (f. adj.); nominative
تُفْنِى: تُفْنِى — tufnī, she exhausts, brings to an end (3 f. sg. imperfect of أَفْنَى, form IV); the hamza of the form is not printed, and the verb is singular after two subjects
وَكِيلِهِ: وَكِيل + هِ — wakīl, steward (m.) + -hi, his; genitive after مِنْ
قُلْتَهُ: قُلْتَ + هُ — qulta, you said (2 m. sg. perfect of قَالَ) + -hu, it; 'what you said'
فَإنِّي: فـ + إِنَّ + ي — fa-, for, because + inna, indeed + -ī, I; 'for I'
الشَّــاعِرَ: الـ + شَّاعِر — shāʿir, poet (m.); accusative, object of 'heard'; the print has an extra stretching-stroke (tatwīl) inside the word
يَقُــولُ: يَقُولُ — yaqūlu, he says (3 m. sg. imperfect of قَالَ); with the print's stretching-stroke (tatwīl)
شِعْـر—ر: شِعْر — shiʿr, verse, poetry (m.); the print breaks it with a dash and a stray ر
مَلَكْتُ: مَلَكْتُ — malaktu, I possess, have taken hold of (1 sg. perfect of مَلَكَ)
اَجُدْ: أَجُدْ — ajud, I give generously (1 sg. jussive of جَادَ)
سَلِمَتْ: سَلِمَتْ — salimat, she was safe, kept whole (3 f. sg. perfect of سَلِمَ)
تُوا: تُوا — tū, second part of the split word; together فَمَا تُوا probably stands for فَهَاتُوا, 'so bring!'
بَخِيلاً: بَخِيلًا — bakhīl, miser, stingy (adj./noun); accusative indefinite
مَجْدًا: مَجْدًا — majd, glory, honour (m.); accusative indefinite
بِبُخْلِهِ: بِـ + بُخْل + هِ — bi-, by means of (prep.) + bukhl, miserliness + -hi, his; 'by his miserliness'
وَهَاتُوا: وَ + هَاتُوا — wa-, and + hātū, bring! (m. pl. imperative of هَاتَى)
اَرُونِي: أَرُونِي — arūnī, show me! (m. pl. imperative, form IV of رَأَى + -nī, me)
بَاذِلاً: بَاذِلًا — bādhil, one who gives lavishly (active participle of بَذَلَ); accusative indefinite
بِالْبَذْلِ: بِـ + الـ + بَذْل — bi-, from, by reason of (prep.) + al-, the + badhl, giving, lavishing (verbal noun); 'of giving'
الْوَكِيلُ: الـ + وَكِيل — wakīl, steward (m.); nominative, vocative
فَضَلَ: فَضَلَ — faḍala, it remained over, was left (3 m. sg. perfect of فَضَلَ)
غَدَائِي: غَدَاء + ي — ghadāʾ, midday meal, lunch (m.) + -ī, my
لَاتُحَمِّلَنِي: لَا + تُحَمِّلَ + نِي — lā, not + tuḥammila, you load, burden (2 m. sg. subjunctive, form II of حَمَلَ) + -nī, me; 'that you not burden me'
هَمَّ: هَمّ — hamm, care, worry (m.); accusative, second object; the print puts a shadda on the م
عَشَائِي: عَشَاء + ي — ʿashāʾ, evening meal, supper (m.) + -ī, my
فَوَلَّى: فـ + وَلَّى — fa-, and so + wallā (form II), he turned away, withdrew (3 m. sg. perfect)
نُدَمَائِهِ: نُدَمَاء + هِ — nudamāʾ, boon-companions (pl. of نَدِيم) + -hi, his; genitive after مِنْ
الشَّيْ: الـ + شَّيْء — shayʾ, thing (m.); the print has الشي, without the hamza
هُوَلَكَ: هُوَ + لَكَ — huwa, it/he + laka, to you (li- + -ka); written as one word in the print: 'it is yours'
الْفُلَانِيَّةُ: الـ + فُلَانِيَّة — fulāniyya, so-and-so, such-and-such (f. adj. from فُلَان); nominative
مَقَامًا: مَقَام — maqām, session, gathering (m.); accusative indefinite
فَبَيْنَمَاهُوَ: فـ + بَيْنَمَا + هُوَ — fa-, and so + baynamā, while + huwa, he; written as one word in the print
مَايَاْتِي: مَايَاْتِي — mā, what + yaʾtī, it comes (3 m. sg. imperfect of أَتَى; the print writes the hamza as a sukun-marked alif, يَاْتِي)
وَسَالَمَتْكَ: وَ + سَالَمَتْ + كَ — wa-, and + sālamat, she made peace with (3 f. sg. perfect, form III of سَلِمَ) + -ka, you
فَاغْتَرَرْتَ: فَـ + اغْتَرَرْتَ — fa-, and so + ightarartā, you were deceived (2 m. sg. perfect, form VIII of غَرَّ)
صَفْوِ: صَفْوِ — ṣafw, clearness, purity (m.); genitive in construct
يَحْدُثُ: يَحْدُثُ — yaḥduthu, it happens, occurs (3 m. sg. imperfect of حَدَثَ)
الْكَدِرُ: الْكَدِرُ — al-kadir, turbidity, murk, trouble (m.); nominative, subject
جُلَسَائِهِ: جُلَسَاء — julasāʾ, pl. of جَلِيس jalīs, table-companion, (gen. in construct) + هِ, his; 'his companions'
غَيْرِأَنْ: غَيْر + أَنْ — ghayr, other than (gen. after مِنْ) + an, that (conj. + subjunctive); مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ 'without (his) —ing'; the print joins the two words
وَكِيلَهُ: وَكِيل — wakīl, agent, steward (acc. as object) + هُ, his; 'his steward'
الدَّفَاتِرُ: الـ + دَفَاتِر — al-, the + dafātir, account-books, ledgers (pl. of دَفْتَر daftar; nom.); 'the ledgers'
مَوْجُودَةٌ: مَوْجُود — mawjūd, present, found (pass. part. of وَجَدَ; f. nom. agreeing with the pl. of a thing); 'present, to hand'
بِالْمَصْرُوفِ: بِـ + الـ + مَصْرُوف — bi-, with, along with (prep.; 'recording') + al-, the + maṣrūf, expenditure, outlay (from صَرَفَ), gen. after بِـ; 'with the expenditure'
الَّذَىٰ: الَّذِي — alladhī, who, which (relative pronoun, m.sg.); the print spells it with ى, shown by the dagger alif
صَرَفْتَهُ: صَرَفَ + هُ — ṣarafa, to spend; 2 m.sg. perfect, 'you spent' + -hu, it; 'you spent'
وَدَفَاتِرُ: و + دَفَاتِر — wa-, and + dafātir, ledgers (nom., in construct); 'and the ledgers of'
بِرَأْسِهِ: بِـ + رَأْس + هِ — bi-, with, by (prep.; 'with his head') + raʾs, head (gen. after بِـ) + -hi, his; 'with his head'
لِيَتَسَلَّلَ: لِـ + يَتَسَلَّلَ — li-, in order to (purpose, + subjunctive) + yatasallala, to slip stealthily (form V; subjunctive 3 m.sg.), 'in order that he slip'
انْظُرُوا: نَظَرَ — naẓara, to look; imperative 2 m.pl., 'look'
تَعْمَلُونَ: عَمِلَ — ʿamila, to do; imperfect 2 m.pl., 'you are doing'
أَفْلَسَ: أَفْلَسَ — aflasa, to become bankrupt, be penniless (from فَلْس fals, a copper coin); 3 m.sg. perfect, 'he has gone bankrupt'
تَبَيَّنَ: تَبَيَّنَ — tabayyana, to become plain, be evident (form V); 3 m.sg. perfect, 'it became plain'
الْغَمُّ: الـ + غَمّ — al-, the + ghamm, grief, gloom (nom.); 'the gloom'
النُّدَمَاءِ: الـ + نُدَمَاء — al-, the + nudamāʾ, boon-companions (pl. of نَدِيم nadīm; gen. after مِنْ); 'the companions'
تَأْذَنَ: أَذِنَ — adhina, to permit, give leave; subjunctive 2 m.sg. after أَنْ, 'you permit'
لِمَاذَا: لِـ + مَاذَا — li-, for, because of (prep.) + mādhā, what (interrog.); 'why'
الِانْصِرَافُ: الـ + اِنْصِرَاف — al-, the + inṣirāf, departure (nom.); 'the departure'
تَلِدُو: وَلَدَ — walada, to give birth (cf. تَلِدُ talidu, imperfect 3 f.sg., 'she is giving birth'); the print has a final و, pointed as printed
لَايُمْكِنُنِي: لَا + يُمْكِنُ + نِي — lā, not + yumkinu, it is possible (imperfect of أَمْكَنَ, form IV, 3 m.sg.) + -nī, for me (nūn of protection + ī); 'it is not possible for me'; the print joins the words
أَتَخَلَّفَ: تَخَلَّفَ — takhallafa, to lag behind, stay away (form V); subjunctive 1 sg. after أَنْ, 'I stay away'
وَأَنْظُرَهَا: و + أَنْظُرَ + هَا — wa-, and (continuing the subjunctive of the previous أَنْ) + anẓura, to look, look to (naẓara; subjunctive 1 sg.) + -hā, her; 'and look to her'
أَحْضُرَ: حَضَرَ — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend; subjunctive 1 sg. after أَنْ, 'I attend'
يُطَاهِرُ: طَاهَرَ — ṭāhara, to circumcise (colloquial for Classical طَهَّرَ ṭahhara, 'purify, circumcise'); imperfect 3 m.sg., 'he is circumcising'
صَارَيَسْتَأْذِنُهُ: صَارَ + يَسْتَأْذِنُ + هُ — ṣāra, to become, begin to (aux.; 3 m.sg. perfect) + yastaʾdhinu, to ask leave (istaʾdhana, form X; imperfect 3 m.sg.) + -hu, him; 'began asking his leave'; the print joins the two verbs
وَيَذْهَبُ: و + يَذْهَبُ — wa-, and + dhahaba, to go; imperfect 3 m.sg., 'and goes'
دَعَىٰ: دَعَا — daʿā, to call, summon; 3 m.sg. perfect, 'he called'; the print spells it with ى, shown by the dagger alif
تَنْظُرِينَ: نَظَرَ — naẓara, to see, look; imperfect 2 f.sg., 'you see'
هَمَمْتُ: هَمَّ — hamma, to be minded, intend; 1 sg. perfect, 'I was minded'
فَسَمِعْتُكَ: فَـ + سَمِعَ + تُ + كَ — fa-, and, then (conj.) + samiʿa, to hear; 1 sg. perfect (-tu, I) + -ka, you; 'and I heard you'
شِـــعْـــرٌ: شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry, verse (nom. tanwīn); the rubric that introduces the lines; the print stretches the word with tatweel
جَادَتِ: جَادَ — jāda, to be generous, give freely; 3 f.sg. perfect, 'she gave freely' (with a helping kasra before الْ)
فَجُدْبِهَا: فَـ + جُدْ + بِـ + هَا — fa-, then, so (conj.) + jud, be generous (imperative of جَادَ) + bi-, with, of (prep.; جَادَ بِـ 'be lavish with') + -hā, it (the world); 'then be lavish with it'
تَتَفَلَّتِ: تَفَلَّتَ — tafallata, to slip away, escape (form V); subjunctive 3 f.sg. after أَنْ, 'it slip away' (helping kasra for the rhyme and the rhyme-letter)
الْجُودُ: الـ + جُود — al-, the + jūd, generosity (nom.); 'generosity'
يُفْنِيهَا: أَفْنَى + هَا — afnā, to destroy, use up (form IV); imperfect 3 m.sg. (يُفْنِي) + -hā, it (the world); 'uses it up'
الشُّحُّ: الـ + شُحّ — al-, the + shuḥḥ, miserliness, avarice (nom.); 'miserliness'
يُبْقِيهَا: أَبْقَى + هَا — abqā, to keep, preserve (form IV); imperfect 3 m.sg. (يُبْقِي) + -hā, it (the world); 'keeps it'
سَمِعْتُكَ: samiʿa, hear (perf.) + -tu, I + -ka, you (m.); 'I heard you'
سَكَتُّ: sakata, fall silent (perf. 1 sg.); 'I fell silent'
أُبْدِلَكَ: two words run together: ubdi, I show, give out (abdā, IV, jussive 1 sg.) + la-ka, li-, to (prep.) + -ka, you (m.); 'I did not give to you'
عَلِىُّ: ʿAlī, proper name, nom. (the print ends the name in ى)
أَوْهَبْتُ: awhaba (IV), bestow, give away (perf. 1 sg.); 'I bestowed'
خَلَّوْنِي: khallā (II), leave (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'they have left me'
بِلَاشَيٍ: bi-, with (prep.) + lā, no + shayʾ, thing; 'with nothing'
وَأَظُنُّهُمْ: wa-, and + aẓunnu, think, suppose (impf. 1 sg.) + hum, them; 'and I suppose them'
لَايَتْرُكُونَنِي: lā, not + yatrukūna, leave (impf. 3 m. pl.) + -nī, me (the -n- of the plural plus the support-nūn), printed as one word
مُوَاسَاةٍ: muwāsāh, consolation, sharing of one's goods with another (verbal noun of wāsā, III), gen.
يَنْفَعُونَكَ: nafaʿa, benefit (impf. 3 m. pl.) + -ka, you (m.); 'they benefit you'
أَبْوَا: abwā-, first part of abwābihim, split in the print: abwāb, doors (pl. of bāb)
يَحْصُلَ: ḥaṣala, come about, accrue (subj. 3 m. sg.)
فَأَجْعَلَهُ: fa-, and so + ajʿala, put, make (subj. 1 sg.) + -hu, it; 'and I put it'
وَأَتْرُكَ: wa- + atruka, leave, give up (subj. 1 sg.)
وَاللَّعِبَ: wa-, and + al- + laʿib, play, sport (acc.)
سَائِرً: sāʾir, going, walking (act. part.), acc. (the alif that carries its tanwīn stands apart in the print)
احَتَّى: ḥattā, until (the stray alif belongs to the preceding word, sāʾiran)
سَاكِنِينَ: sākin, dwelling (act. part. of sakana), acc. pl.
وَطَرَقَهُ: wa-, and + ṭaraqa, knock (perf. 3 m. sg.) + hu, it
اقِفٌ: (wa)āqif, standing (act. part. of waqafa), the rest of wāqifun; together 'standing'
وَمُنْتَظِرٌ: wa-, and + muntaẓir, waiting (act. part. of VIII intaẓara)
اِرْجِعِي: irjiʿī, return, go back (imper. f. sg.)
فَخَيْرُهُ: fa-, then + khayr, good, best + hu, his; read as printed, probably for فغيره 'then another than he' (see note)
بِبَابِهِمْ: bi-, at (prep.) + bāb, door + hum, their; 'at their door'
مَنُّوا: manna ʿalā, bestow a favour upon (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they favoured'
بِاَنْعُمٍ: bi-, with (prep.) + anʿum, pl. of niʿma, favour, bounty; 'with bounties'
أَعْتِنُهُمْ: obscure form (see note) + hum, them; probably 'I try them, put them to the test'
مَقَامَ: maqām, place, standing (acc., construct); qāma maqāma, 'stand in the place of'
لِلدَّارِ: li-, for (prep.) + al- + dār, house; 'for the household'
رَاهُ: printed rāhu; sense wants arāhu, 'showed him' (arā, IV, + hu), see note
وَلَاكَسَرَ: wa- + lā, nor + kasara, break (perf. 3 m. sg.), printed as one word
يَقُـــــــولُ: yaqūlu, say (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'saying' (the print stretches the word)
الْاِقْبَالِ: al- + iqbāl, prosperity, good fortune (lit. 'turning towards one')
كَالشَّجَرَةْ: ka-, like (prep.) + al- + shajara, tree (pausal form); 'like the tree'
حَوْلِهَا: ḥawl, around + hā, it; min ḥawlihā, 'from around it', 'around it'
مَادَامَتْ: mā dāmat, as long as it remains (dāma, remain, perf. 3 f. sg.)
لِلثَّمَرَةْ: li-, for (prep.) + al- + thamara, fruit; 'for the fruit', i.e. as long as there is fruit
حِمْلُهَا: ḥiml, load, burden + hā, its; 'its load (of fruit)'
وَخَفُّوهَا: wa-, and + khaffū-, obscure, perf. 3 m. pl. + hā, it; perhaps for khallafūhā 'they left it behind'; 'and they leave it' (see note)
تَبًّا: tabban, ruin, shame (acc. of imprecation); 'woe to'
لِاَبْنَاءِ: li-, to, for (prep.) + abnāʾ, sons (pl. of ibn)
كُلِّهِــمِ: kull, all + him, them (stretched); 'all of them'
أَرَانِي: arā, show (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + nī, me; 'showed me'
وَآنِيَتِهِ: wa-, and + āniya, vessels (pl. of ināʾ) + hi, its
وَأَنْفِقْ: wa- + anfiq, spend (anfaqa, IV, imper. m. sg.)
بِأَوَّلٍ: bi-, with, by (prep.) + awwal, first; awwalan bi-awwalin, 'first by first', i.e. little by little
شَيُ: shayʾ, thing (nom.; the print marks the final letter with a damma only)
وَتَنْزِلَ: wa- + tanzila, go down (nazala, subj. 2 m. sg.)
وَتَبِيعَنِي: wa- + tabīʿa, sell (subj. 2 m. sg.) + nī, me
اِشْتَرَانِي: ishtarā (VIII), buy (perf. 3 m. sg.) + nī, me
بِاجْتِمَا: bi-, by, through (prep.) + ijtimā(ʿ), gathering together (verbal noun of VIII ijtamaʿa); first half of bi-ijtimāʿinā, split in the print
عِنَا: (ijtimā)ʿ-inā, the end of the verbal noun + -nā, our; 'our gathering', with the preceding
نَجْتَمِعُ: najtamiʿu, come together (VIII impf. 1 pl.); 'we come together'
تُلْجِي: tuljī, compel, force (aljaʾa, IV, impf. 3 f. sg.)
يَلِيقُ: yalīqu, be fitting, become (impf. 3 m. sg.)
بِالْاَدَبِ: bi-, with (prep. after yalīqu, 'befit') + al- + adab, good manners
بِالسَّبَبِ: bi-, with (prep.) + al- + sabab, the cause; 'befits the cause' Also after aʿlama, 'to inform', bi- marks what one is told: lam uʿlimhā bi-al-sababi, 'I have not told her the cause'.
قِفُوا: qifū, stop! (imp. 2 m. pl.; root w-q-f)
زَوِّدُونِي: zawwidū + -nī: zawwada, to provision (form II), imp. 2 m. pl.; -nī, me; 'provision me'
بَيْنِكُمْ: bayn, parting, separation (m.), gen. + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your parting'
اُعَلِّلُ: uʿallilu, I console, beguile (impf. 1 sing., form II; root ʿ-l-l)
بِالْبَيْنِ: bi-, at, because of (prep.) + al- + bayn, parting; 'at the parting'
كُنْتُمُو: kuntumū, you are (perf. 2 m. pl. of kāna, root k-w-n; poetic long -ū added to -tum)
تَلْقَوْنَ: talqawna, you find (impf. 2 m. pl.; root l-q-y)
أَمُتْ: amut, may I die (jussive 1 sing.; root m-w-t), jussive in reply to the imperative 'leave me'
وَجْدًا: wajd, passion, grief of love (m., acc. indef.; 'of passion')
تَتَكَلَّفُ: tatakallafu, you trouble yourself (impf., form V; root k-l-f); singular in form though the address is plural
كَالْمَطَرِ: ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al- + maṭar, rain; 'like the rain'
شِعْـــــــــرًا: shiʿr, poetry, verse (m.), acc. indef.; printed with tatweel strokes
وَسَلَّمَهَا: wa-, and (conj.) + sallama, he handed over (perf. 3 m. sing., form II; root s-l-m) + -hā, her
حَاجُّ: ḥājj, pilgrim (one who has made the ḥajj), a title
اعْرِفْ: iʿrif, know! (imp. 2 m. sing.; root ʿ-r-f)
تُنَادِى: tunādī, you cry out for sale (impf. 2 m. sing., form III; root n-d-y)
الْأَصُولُ: al- + uṣūl, principles, rules (pl. of aṣl, root; nom.)
مَحْفُوظَةٌ: maḥfūẓa, kept, safeguarded (pass. part. f. sing.; root ḥ-f-ẓ)
بِسَائِرِ: bi-, with (prep.: 'packed with') + sāʾir, all, the whole of (gen. in iḍāfa)
أَجْنَاسِ: ajnās, kinds, races (pl. of jins), gen. in iḍāfa
تُرْكِيَّةٍ: turkiyya, a Turkish woman (f. nisba adj.), gen. after min
وَأَفْرَنْجِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + afranjiyya, a Frankish (European) woman
وَشَرْكَسِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + sharkasiyya, a Circassian woman
وَحَبَشِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + ḥabashiyya, an Abyssinian woman
وَنُوبِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + nūbiyya, a Nubian woman
وَتَكْرُورِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + takrūriyya, a woman from Takrūr (West Africa)
وَرُومِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + rūmiyya, a Rūmī (Greek or Byzantine) woman
وَتَتَرِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + tatariyya, a Tatar woman
وَجُرْجِيَّةٍ: wa-, and (conj.) + jurjiyya, a Georgian woman
نَظَرَا: naẓarā, probably a slip for naẓara, he looked (perf. 3 m. sing.; root n-ẓ-r); printed with a final alif
احْتَبَكَ: iḥtabaka, it became tightly packed (perf. 3 m. sing., form VIII; root ḥ-b-k)
تُجَّارِيَا: tujjārīyā, probably 'O my merchants': tujjār, merchants + -ī, my + -ā of address (obscure form)
مْوَالِ: -mwāl, second part of amwāl, wealth, goods (pl. of māl), gen. in iḍāfa
مُسْتَطِيلَةٍ: mustaṭīla, oblong, elongated (act. part. f., form X; root ṭ-w-l)
أُنَادِي: unādī, I cry out for sale (impf. 1 sing., form III; root n-d-y)
نَادِ: nādi, cry! (imp. 2 m. sing.; final -ī dropped; root n-d-y)
بِأَرْبَعَةِ: bi-, at (prep.: 'at the price of') + arbaʿa, four, gen.
الْمُنَادِي: al- + munādī, crier, auctioneer (act. part., form III)
الْمُعِينِ: الْ + مُعِين — al-, the + Muʿīn, proper name (from aʿāna, help; 'helper'); gen., in apposition to al-wazīr
عَابِرٌ: عَابِر — ʿābir, act. part. of عَبَرَ ʿabara, cross, pass; 'passing' (nom., predicate after إِذَا بِـ)
مَابَالُ: مَا + بَال — mā, what + bāl, state, concern (here a construct, 'what is the concern of ...'), printed joined
أَبَقِيَ: أَ + بَقِيَ — a-, interrogative particle, 'is it so that?' + baqiya, perf. 3 m.s., remain; 'has there remained?'
الْعِلْقِ: الـ + عِلْق — al-, the + ʿilq, properly 'a precious thing' (Lane); in later speech a coarse insult for a man, 'catamite'; see note
الْجَوَارِيَ: الـ + جَوَارِي — al-, the + jawārī, pl. of جَارِيَة jāriya, slave-girl (acc. with the full ending -ya)
الْمُنَادِيَ: الْ + مُنَادِي — al-, the + munādī, crier, caller (act. part. III of نَادَى nādā); acc.
وَالتُّجَّارُ: و + الـ + تُّجَّار — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'with') + al-, the + tujjār, pl. of تَاجِر tājir, merchant; 'with the merchants'
أَظُنُّهُ: أَظُنُّ + هُ — aẓunnu, imperf. 1 s., think + -hu, him; 'I think him'
لِيَبِيعَهَا: لِـ + يَبِيعَ + هَا — li-, in order that (+ subjunctive) + yabīʿa, subj. 3 m.s. of بَاعَ bāʿa, sell + -hā, her; 'to sell her'
بَرْدَهَا: بَرْد + هَا — bard, coolness + -hā, its/her; 'its coolness' (exclamation; the print marks the vowels of بَرْدَها)
دَعَا: دَعَا — daʿā, perf. 3 m.s., call, summon; 'he called'
تُنَادِي: تُنَادِي — tunādī, imperf. 2 m.s. III, cry out (for sale); 'you cry'
أَمْكَنَهُ: أَمْكَنَ + هُ — amkana, perf. 3 m.s. IV, be possible + -hu, him; 'it was possible for him'
وَأَعْرَضَهَا: و + أَعْرَضَ + هَا — wa-, and + aʿraḍa, perf. 3 m.s. IV (for ʿaraḍa), present, show + -hā, her; 'and he presented her'
فَأَعْجَبَتْهُ: فَـ + أَعْجَبَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so + aʿjabat, perf. 3 f.s. IV, please + -hu, him; 'and she pleased him'
وَخَمْسُمِائَةِ: و + خَمْس + مِائَة — wa-, and + khams, five + mi'a, hundred (gen. construct); 'and five hundred'
نَدَرَ: نَدَرَ — nadara, perf. 3 m.s., stand out, be rare; with an, 'dare to, venture to'
يُزَوِّدَ: يُزَوِّدَ — yuzawwida, subj. 3 m.s. II of زَوَّدَ (?), add to; see note
تَأَخَّرُوا: تَأَخَّرُوا — taʾakhkharū, perf. 3 m.p. V of أَخَّرَ, hold back; 'they held back'
يَعْلَمُونَ: يَعْلَمُونَ — yaʿlamūna, imperf. 3 m.p., know; 'they know'
الدَّلَّالِ: الـ + دَّلَّال — al-, the + dallāl, crier, broker, auctioneer (from دَلَّ, show); gen. after ilā
وُقُوفُكَ: وُقُوف + كَ — wuqūf, standing (verbal noun of waqafa) + -ka, your; 'your standing'
رُحْ: رُحْ — ruḥ, imper. m.s. of رَاحَ rāḥa, go (colloquial, short form); 'go'
وَشَاوِرْ: و + شَاوِرْ — wa-, and + shāwir, imper. m.s. III of شَاوَرَ, bid, make an offer; 'and bid'
خَمْسُمِائَةِ: خَمْس + مِائَة — khams, five + mi'a, hundred (gen. construct); 'five hundred'
فَتَحْنَا: فَتَحْ + نَا — fataḥ, perf. of فَتَحَ, open + -nā, we; 'we opened'
بَهَا: بَ + هَا — ba, second half of بَاب bāb, door (with acc. ending -a) + -hā, her/its; 'her door'
وَخَمْسُمِائَهْ: و + خَمْس + مِائَهْ — wa-, and + khams, five + mi'a, hundred (the print spells the pausal -ah for ة); 'and five hundred'
الظَّالِمُ: الـ + ظَّالِم — al-, the + ẓālim, wrongdoer, tyrant (act. part. of ظَلَمَ); 'the tyrant'
وَعَبَرَ: و + عَبَرَ — wa-, and + ʿabara, perf. 3 m.s., cross, pass through; 'and he crossed'
السُّوقَ: الـ + سُّوق — al-, the + sūq, market (acc., object of ʿabara)
شَاوِرْ: شَاوِرْ — shāwir, imper. m.s. III, bid; 'bid'
خَمْسُمِائَةٍ: خَمْس + مِائَة — khams, five + mi'a, hundred (gen. construct, tanwīn); 'five hundred'
ظُلْمِهِ: ظُلْم + هِ — ẓulm, wrongdoing + -hi, his; 'his tyranny'
حَوَالَةً: حَوَالَةً — ḥawāla, draft, order of payment (acc., apposition)
عُمَّالِهِ: عُمَّال + هِ — ʿummāl, pl. of عَامِل ʿāmil, agent, governor + -hi, his; 'his agents'
يُرْسِلُ: يُرْسِلُ — yursilu, imperf. 3 m.s. IV, send; 'he sends'
خَلْفَكَ: خَلْف + كَ — khalf, behind, after + -ka, you; 'after you'
تُعْطُوهُ: تُعْطُوهُ — tuʿṭū, imperf. 2 m.p. jussive, IV, give + -hu, him; 'do not give him'
رُحْتَ: رُحْتَ — ruḥta, perf. 2 m.s. of rāḥa, go; here 'you go (and)'
تُطَالِبُهُمْ: تُطَالِبُ + هُمْ — tuṭālibu, imperf. 2 m.s. III, demand of, press + -hum, them; 'you press them'
نُعْطِيكَ: نُعْطِي + كَ — nuʿṭī, imperf. 1 pl. IV, give + -ka, you; 'we give you'
وَيَعْمَلُونَ: و + يَعْمَلُونَ — wa-, and + yaʿmalūna, imperf. 3 m.p., do, make; 'and they do'
عَزِيرُ: عَزِيرُ — ʿazīr (printed), probably a slip for ʿazīz, proud, dignified (construct before al-nafs); see note
يَضِجُّوا: يَضِجُّوا — yaḍijjū, imperf. 3 m.p. subj., weary, grow tired; 'they grow weary'
طَلَبِكَ: طَلَب + كَ — ṭalab, asking, demanding (verbal noun) + -ka, your; 'your demanding' Also 'seeking you, asking for you': fī ṭalabika, 'asking for you, wanting you brought to him'.
أَرِنَا: أَرِ + نَا — arī, imper. m.s. IV of رَأَى, show + -nā, us; 'show us'
قَطَعُوهَا: قَطَعُو + هَا — qaṭaʿū, perf. 3 m.p., cut, tear + -hā, it (f.); 'they tear it up'
أُشَوِّرُ: أُشَوِّرُ — ushawwiru, imperf. 1 s. II (of شَارَ, as أَشَارَ عَلَى), advise, counsel; 'I advise'
بِمَشُورَةٍ: بِـ + مَشُورَة — bi-, with (cognate object: 'advise with a counsel') + mashūra, counsel, advice (gen.); 'with a counsel'
قَبِلْتَ: قَبِلْتَ — qabilta, perf. 2 m.s., accept; 'you accept'
تَجِي: تَجِي — tajī, you come (colloquial imperf. 2 m.s. of جَاءَ, from tajīʾ); 'you come'
وَتَلْطُمُهَا: و + تَلْطُمُ + هَا — wa-, and + talṭumu, imperf. 2 m.s., slap, strike + -hā, her; 'and you slap her'
يَاكُورَةُ: يَاكُورَةُ — yā, O + kūra, obscure term of abuse (?), 'wretch'; see note (joined by the print)
فَدَيْتُ: فَدَيْتُ — fadaytu, perf. 1 s. of فَدَى fadā, redeem, ransom; 'I have redeemed'
إِخْرَاجِكِ: إِخْرَاج + كِ — ikhrāj, bringing out (verbal noun IV of kharaja) + -ki, you (f.); 'your being brought out'
وَمُنَادَاةِ: و + مُنَادَاة — wa-, and + munādāt, crying out, calling (verbal noun III of nādā; gen.); 'and the crying of'
تَنْطَلِقُ: تَنْطَلِقُ — tanṭaliqu, imperf. 3 f.s. VII of ṭalaqa, go forth, pass; of a trick, 'it goes through'
وَيَعْتَقِدُونَ: و + يَعْتَقِدُونَ — wa-, and + yaʿtaqidūna, imperf. 3 m.p. VIII, believe; 'and they believe'
نَزَلْتَ: نَزَلْتَ — nazalta, perf. 2 m.s., come down; 'you brought down'
إِبْرَارِ: إِبْرَار — ibrār, fulfilling, keeping (verbal noun IV of barra; gen. construct); 'fulfilment of'
الدَّلَّالَ: الـ + دَّلَّال — al-, the + dallāl, crier (acc. after inna): al-dallāla
فَارَقَهُ: فَارَقَ + هُ — fāraqa, perf. 3 m.s. III, leave, part from + -hu, him; 'he left him'
وَأَشَارَ: و + أَشَارَ — wa-, and + ashāra, perf. 3 m.s. IV, point, signal; 'and he pointed'
يَامَوْلَاىَ: يَا + مَوْلَاىَ — yā, O + mawlā, master, lord + -ya, my; 'my lord' (the print ends it with ى)
لِكُهَا: لِكُ + هَا — likuhā, second half of مَالِكُهَا mālikuhā, 'her owner', split by the print (mā + likuhā): mālik, owner (act. part.) + -hā, her
وَنَزَعَ: و + نَزَعَ — wa-, and + nazaʿa, perf. 3 m.s., pull out, snatch; 'and he snatched'
وَلَكَمَهَا: و + لَكَمَ + هَا — wa-, and + lakama, perf. 3 m.s., punch, strike with the fist + -hā, her; 'and he struck her'
فِدَاءِ: فِدَاءِ — fidāʾ, redeeming, ransom (verbal noun of fadā; gen. construct); 'the redeeming of'
تَعُودِي: تَعُودِي — taʿūdī, imperf. 2 f.s. jussive of ʿāda, return, go back (to doing); 'do not again'
تُخَالِفِينِي: تُخَالِفِينِي — tukhālifīnī, imperf. 2 f.s. III of khālafa, oppose, disobey + -nī, me; 'oppose me'
ثَمَنِكِ: ثَمَن + كِ — thaman, price + -ki, your (f.); 'your price'
أَبِيعَكِ: أَبِيعَ + كِ — abīʿa, subj. 1 s. of bāʿa, sell + -ki, you (f.); 'I should sell you'
أَثَاثَ: أَثَاثَ — athāth, household furniture, furnishings (acc., construct); 'the furnishings of'
يُبَاعُ: yubāʿu — to be sold (impf. passive 3ms of bāʿa); 'is sold'
يُشْتَرَى: yushtarā — to be bought (impf. passive 3ms of ishtarā, with alif maqṣūra); 'is bought'
الْمُعِينَ: الـ + مُعِين — muʿīn, helper (m., nom.), here the vizier's name al-Muʿīn; 'the Muʿīn'
يَبْطِشَ: yabṭisha — to seize violently, assault (impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); 'to lay violent hands'
يُحِبُّونَهُ: يُحِبُّونَ + ـهُ — aḥabba, to love (impf. 3mp, form IV) + -hu, him; 'they love him'
عَرَفْتُمْ: ʿarafta + -tum — ʿarafa, to know (perf.) with 2mp ending -tum; 'you have known'
ظُلْمَهُ: ظُلْم + ـهُ — ẓulm, wrong, injustice, tyranny (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his wrongdoing'
لَقَتَلْتُهُ: لَـ + قَتَلْتُ + ـهُ — la-, (introduces the result clause after law-lā; 'would') + qatala, to kill (perf. 1s) + -hu, him; 'I would have killed him'
أَشَارُ: ashāra — to point, signal (form IV perf.); printed as ashāru with the plural wāw displaced into the next word, read as ashārū, 'they signalled'
وَاكُلُّهُمْ: وا + كُلُّ + هُمْ — the printed word begins with the plural -wā of the preceding verb (stray alif unvowelled, see the note), then kull, all (m., nom.) + -hum, them; 'all of them'
الْإِشَارَةِ: الـ + إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, signal (f., gen.); 'the signal'
افْتَصِلْ: iftaṣil — to settle matters, take one's due (imperative 2ms, form VIII; root uncertain, perhaps faṣala or qaṣṣa); 'have your satisfaction'
أَحَدٌمِنَّا: أَحَدٌ + مِنَّا — aḥad, anyone, one (m., nom. indef.) + min, of (prep.) + -nā, us (1p), written together; 'one of us'
شُجَاعًا: shujāʿ — brave (adj. m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'brave'
سَرْجِهِ: سَرْج + ـهِ — sarj, saddle (m., gen. in annexation) + -hi, his; 'his saddle'
مَعْجَنَةُ: maʿjana — kneading-trough, vessel for mixing (f.; here nom., first term of annexation with ṭīn); 'a kneading-trough of'
طِينٍ: ṭīn — clay, mud (m.); gen. indef. after maʿjana ('of clay') and nom. indef. in the list of colours ('clay, mud')
وَسْطِهَا: وَسْط + هَا — wasṭ, middle (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, its (f.); 'the middle of it'
وَيَلْكُمُهُ: وَ + يَلْكُمُ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + lakama, to punch (impf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and punching him'
لَكْمَةٌ: lakma — a punch, blow with the fist (f., nom. indef.); 'a punch'
أَسْنَانِهِ: أَسْنَان + ـهِ — asnān, teeth (pl. of sinn, m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his teeth'
فَاخْتَضَبَتْ: فَـ + اخْتَضَبَتْ — fa-, and so (connective) + ikhtaḍaba, to be dyed, stained (form VIII perf. 3fs); 'and was dyed'
لِحْيَةُ: liḥya — beard (f., nom., first term of annexation); 'the beard of'
بِدَمِهِ: بِـ + دَم + ـهِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., of the dye) + dam, blood (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his blood'
مَمَالِيكَ: mamālīk — mamluks, slave-soldiers (pl. of mamlūk, gen. with the numeral); 'ten mamluks'
سَيِّدَهُمْ: سَيِّد + هُمْ — sayyid, master (m., acc., object) + -hum, their; 'their master'
فُعِلَ: fuʿila — to be done (perf. passive 3ms of faʿala); 'was done'. (The same print, read active, would be faʿala, 'he did'; see the note.)
مَقَابِضِ: maqābiḍ — hilts, handles (pl. of maqbiḍ, gen. in annexation); 'the hilts of'
سُيُوفِهِمْ: سُيُوف + هِمْ — suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, gen.) + -him, their; 'their swords'
وَأَرَادُوا: وَ + أَرَادُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + arāda, to want, intend (perf. 3mp, form IV); 'and they wanted'
يُجَرِّدُوهَا: يُجَرِّدُوا + هَا — jarrada, to draw, unsheathe (form II impf. 3mp, subjunctive after an) + -hā, it (f.; the swords); 'to draw them'
وَيَهْجُمُوا: وَ + يَهْجُمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + hajama, to rush, attack (impf. 3mp, subjunctive); 'and to fall upon'
لِيَقْطَعُوهُ: لِـ + يَقْطَعُوا + ـهُ — li-, in order to (particle + subjunctive, purpose) + qaṭaʿa, to cut, cut down (impf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'in order to cut him down'
لِلْمَمَالِيكِ: لِـ + الـ + مَمَالِيك — li-, to (prep., marks the addressee of qālū) + al-, the + mamālīk, mamluks (pl., gen.); 'to the mamluks'
اصْطَلَحَا: iṣṭalaḥā — to be reconciled, make peace (form VIII perf. 3md); 'the two make peace'
وَقْتًا: waqt — time (m., acc. indef., adverbial); 'at a time'
فَتَصِيرُونَ: فَـ + تَصِيرُونَ — fa-, and so (connective, result) + ṣāra, to become (impf. 2mp); 'and you become'
مَبْغُوضِينَ: mabghūḍīn — hated (pass. part. of baghaḍa, m. pl. acc., predicate of ṣāra); 'hated'
كُلٍّ: kull — each, every, all (m.); gen. indef. after ʿinda ('each'), nom. in kullu man ('everyone who')
ضَرْبَةٌ: ḍarba — a blow, stroke (f., nom. indef.); 'a blow'
فَتَمُوتُونَ: فَـ + تَمُوتُونَ — fa-, and so (connective, result) + māta, to die (impf. 2mp); 'and you die'
أَقْبَحَ: aqbaḥ — ugliest, foulest (elative, acc., first term of annexation; an accusative of manner); 'the foulest of'
الْمَوْتَاتِ: الـ + مَوْتَات — mawta, death (f., pl. mawtāt, gen.); 'the deaths'
الرَّأْىِ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, sound counsel (m., gen.); 'the counsel' (min al-raʾyi an, 'it is wise that')
قُمَاشُهُ: قُمَاش + ـهُ — qumāsh, clothes, stuff (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his clothing'
طِينٌ: ṭīn — clay, mud (m.); gen. indef. after maʿjana ('of clay') and nom. indef. in the list of colours ('clay, mud')
وَدَمٌ: وَ + دَم — wa-, and (conj.) + dam, blood (m., nom. indef.); 'and blood'
وَرَمَادٌ: وَ + رَمَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + ramād, ashes, ash (m., nom. indef.); 'and ashes'
بَرْشًا: barsh — a coarse mat (m., acc. indef., object of akhadha; the word is obscure); 'a mat'
تِينٍ: tīn — fig(s) (m., gen. indef., second term of annexation); in this passage probably the second half of ʿaqlatayn, 'two cords' (print obscure)
فَتَأَمَّلَهُ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلَ + ـهُ — fa-, and (connective) + ta'ammala, to scrutinise (form V perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he scrutinised him'
وَانْتَحَبَ: وَ + انْتَحَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + intaḥaba, to sob aloud (form VIII perf. 3ms); 'and he sobbed'
اَيَظْلِمُنِى: أَ + يَظْلِمُ + نِي — a-, interrogative particle ('does?') + ẓalama, to wrong (impf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'does it wrong me?'
وَاَنْتَ: وَ + أَنْتَ — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + anta, you (ms); 'while you are'
وَتَأْكُلُنِى: وَ + تَأْكُلُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + akala, to eat (impf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural dhiyāb) + -nī, me; 'and (do) they devour me'
الذِّيَابُ: الـ + ذِيَاب — dhiyāb, wolves (printed for ذئاب, pl. of dhiʾb, m., nom.); 'the wolves'
لَيْثُ: layth — lion (m., nom. indef., predicate); 'a lion'
وَيُرْوَى: وَ + يُرْوَى — wa-, and (conj.) + rawiya (form IV passive), to be watered, quenched (impf. 3ms); 'and is watered'
حِيَاضِكَ: حِيَاض + كَ — ḥiyāḍ, cisterns, pools (pl. of ḥawḍ, gen. after min) + -ka, your (ms); 'your cisterns'
ظَامٍ: ẓāmin — thirsty one (act. part. of ẓamiʾa, m., gen. indef., defective ending; after kull); 'thirsty'
وَأَظْمَأُ: وَ + أَظْمَأُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ẓamiʾa, to thirst (impf. 1s); 'and I thirst'
حِمَاكَ: حِمَى + كَ — ḥimā, protection, preserve (m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your (ms); 'your protection'
غَيْثُ: ghayth — rain, succour (m., nom. indef., predicate); 'rain'
حُرْمَتُكَ: حُرْمَة + كَ — ḥurma, sanctity, inviolability (f.), nom. + -ka, your; 'your inviolability'
حُرْمَتِي: حُرْمَة + ي — ḥurma, sanctity + -ī, my, gen. after min; 'my inviolability'
أَشْتَرِيهَا: ashtarī + hā — I buy, I would buy (impf. 1 sg. of ishtarā) + -hā, her; 'I buy her'
فَسَأَلْتُ: فَـ + سَأَلْتُ — fa-, and so + saʾaltu, I asked (perf. 1 sg. of saʾala); 'and I asked'
لِعَلِيِّ: لِـ + عَلِيّ — li-, to, belonging to (prep. of possession) + ʿAlī (proper name), gen.; 'belongs to ʿAlī' Also li- marking the recipient after a verb of giving: aʿṭathu li-ʿAliyyi ibni Bakkārin, 'she gave it to ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'. Also li- of the one a thing is meant for: istadʿā bi-māʾin li-ʿAliyyi ibni Bakkārin, 'he called for water for ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'. Also li- marking the one spoken to after qāla: fa-qāla li-ʿAliyyi ibni Bakkārin, 'and he said to ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'. Also after jarā, 'to happen', li- marks the one it befalls: بِمَا جَرَى لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ بَكَّارٍ 'of what had happened to ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'.
أَعْطَى: aʿṭā, he gave (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV of ʿ-ṭ-w)
لِيَشْتَرِيَ: لِـ + يَشْتَرِيَ — li-, in order that (final particle) + yashtariya, he buys (subj. 3 m. sg.); 'that he buy'
فَبَخِلَ: فَـ + بَخِلَ — fa-, and so + bakhila, he was stingy (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he grudged'
فَأَعْطَاهَا: فَـ + أَعْطَى + هَا — fa-, and so + aʿṭā, he gave + -hā, her; 'and he gave her'
ابْنُهُ: ابْن + هُ — ibn, son, nom. + -hu, his; 'his son'
مْلَاكِ: -mlāk, second part of amlāk, properties (plur. of milk), gen.; the print splits the word
وَالْبَسَاتِينِ: و + الـ + بَسَاتِين — wa-, and + al-, the + basātīn, gardens (plur. of bustān), gen.; 'and the gardens'
وَانِي: -wānī, second part of awānī, vessels (plur. of ināʾ), gen.; the print splits the word
يَبِيعَهَا: يَبِيعَ + هَا — yabīʿa, he sells (subj. 3 m. sg. of bāʿa) + -hā, her; 'that he sell her'
وَتَزَايَدَتِ: و + تَزَايَدَتِ — wa-, and + tazāyadat, increased, bid up (perf. 3 f. sg., form VI of z-y-d; final kasra before al-); 'and ... increased'
النُّجَّارُ: الـ + نُجَّار — nujjār, 'carpenters' (plur. of najjār) as printed, evidently for tujjār, merchants; nom.; 'the carpenters/merchants'
لِعَقْلِي: لِـ + عَقْل + ي — li-, to (prep.) + ʿaql, mind, reason (m.), gen. + -ī, my; 'to my mind'
لِلْيَهُودِ: لِـ + الـ + يَهُود — li-, to (prep.) + al-, the + yahūd, Jews (plur.), gen.; 'to the Jews'
وَالنَّصَارَى: و + الـ + نَصَارَى — wa-, and + al-, the + naṣārā, Christians (plur.); 'and the Christians'
لِنَفْسِي: لِـ + نَفْس + ي — li-, for (prep.) + nafs, self (f.), gen. + -ī, my; 'for myself'
وَلِيُّ: walī, patron, guardian (m.), nom. in construct
نِعْمَتِنَا: نِعْمَة + نَا — niʿma, favour, bounty (f.), gen. + -nā, our; 'our bounty'
وَجَذَبَنِي: و + جَذَبَ + نِي — wa-, and + jadhaba, he pulled (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and pulled me'
وَرَمَانِي: و + رَمَى + نِي — wa-, and + ramā, he threw (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and threw me'
الْجَوَادِ: الـ + جَوَاد — jawād, fine horse (m.), gen.; 'the horse'
وَلَكَمَنِي: و + لَكَمَ + نِي — wa-, and + lakama, he punched (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and punched me'
تَرَكَنِي: taraka + nī — he left (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'left me'
أَوْقَعَنِي: awqaʿa + nī — he made fall (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV of w-q-ʿ) + -nī, me; 'made me fall'
أَرْمَى: armā, he threw (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV of r-m-y, non-Classical for ramā)
وَيَرْتَعِدُ: و + يَرْتَعِدُ — wa-, and + yartaʿidu, he trembles (impf. 3 m. sg., form VIII of r-ʿ-d); 'and trembles'
حَالَتِهِ: حَالَة + هِ — ḥāla, state, condition (f.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his state'
مَقَالَتَهُ: مَقَالَة + هُ — maqāla, saying, speech (f.), acc. + -hu, his; 'his words'
أَرْبَابِ: arbāb, lords, masters (plur. of rabb), gen. in construct
بِأَرْبَعِينَ: بِـ + أَرْبَعِينَ — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise (not translated) + arbaʿīn, forty; 'behold, forty'
ضَارِبِينَ: ḍāribīn, strikers, men bearing (act. part. plur. of ḍaraba), acc. circumstantial
سُيُوفًا: suyūf, swords (plur. of sayf), acc. indefinite
انْزِلُوا: inzilū, go down (imper. 2 m. pl. of nazala)
وَانْهَبُوهَا: و + انْهَبُوا + هَا — wa-, and + inhabū, plunder (imper. 2 m. pl. of nahaba) + -hā, it; 'and plunder it'
وَاهْدِمُوهَا: و + اهْدِمُوا + هَا — wa-, and + ihdimū, demolish (imper. 2 m. pl. of hadama) + -hā, it; 'and demolish it'
وَائْتُونِي: و + ائْتُوا + نِي — wa-, and + ʾtū, bring (imper. 2 m. pl. of atā; atā bi-, 'bring') + -nī, me; 'and bring me'
وَبِالْجَارِيَةِ: و + بِـ + الـ + جَارِيَة — wa-, and + bi-, governed by atā, 'bring' + al-, the + jāriya, slave-girl, gen.; 'and the slave-girl'
مُكَتَّفِينَ: mukattafīn, bound (pass. part. plur. of form II kattafa, 'tie the arms'), acc. state
وَاسْحَبُوهُمَا: و + اسْحَبُوا + هُمَا — wa-, and + isḥabū, drag (imper. 2 m. pl. of saḥaba) + -humā, them both; 'and drag them both'
وُجُوهِهِمَا: وُجُوه + هِمَا — wujūh, faces (plur. of wajh), gen. after ʿalā + -himā, their (dual); 'their faces'
وَأْتُوابِهِمَا: و + ائْتُوا + بِـ + هِمَا — wa-, and + ʾtū, bring (imper. 2 m. pl.) + bi-, governed by atā, 'bring' + -himā, them both; the print joins the words; 'and bring them both'
لَبِسُوا: labisū, they put on (perf. 3 m. pl. of labisa)
الْعُدَدَ: الـ + عُدَد — ʿudad, equipment, gear (plur. of ʿudda), acc.; 'the gear'
وَعَوَّلُو: و + عَوَّلُو — wa-, and + ʿawwalū, they resolved (perf. 3 m. pl., form II of ʿ-w-l; printed without final alif); 'and resolved'
وَآلِ: و + آل — wa-, and + āl, family, household (m.), gen. in construct; 'and the household of'
انْتَقَلَتْ: intaqalat, it moved (perf. 3 f. sg., form VIII of n-q-l)
مَنْزِلَتُهُ: مَنْزِلَة + هُ — manzila, rank, standing (f.), nom. + -hu, his; 'his rank'
عَمَّلَهُ: عَمَّلَ + هُ — ʿammala, he appointed as an officer (perf. 3 m. sg., form II of ʿ-m-l) + -hu, him; 'made him'
مَرْسُومَ: marsūm, decree, order (m.), acc. in construct
الْأَعْدَاءَ: الـ + أَعْدَاء — aʿdāʾ, enemies (plur. of ʿadūw), acc.; 'the enemies'
تَجَهَّزُوا: tajahhazū, they equipped themselves (perf. 3 m. pl., form V of j-h-z)
مَاهَانَ: مَا + هَانَ — mā, not + hāna, it was light (perf. 3 m. sg. of hāna); printed joined with the next word; 'it was not light'
قُدَّامِ: quddām, front, presence (m.), gen. after min; 'before'
فَطَرَقَ: فَـ + طَرَقَ — fa-, and so + ṭaraqa, he knocked (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and knocked'
عَرَفَهُ: ʿarafa + hu — he knew (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'knew him'
وَاسْمَعْ: و + اسْمَعْ — wa-, and + isma', hear (imper. 2 m. sg. of samiʿa); 'and hear'
عَلَمَ: ʿAlam (proper name), voc. acc. in construct; also ʿalam, banner, standard (m., acc., object of tarā): ʿalama al-khilāfati, ‘the banner of the caliphate’ (Night 110)
انْهَضْ: inhaḍ, rise (imper. 2 m. sg. of nahaḍa)
وَفُزْ: و + فُزْ — wa-, and + fuz, win through, escape (imper. of fāza); 'and escape'
وَقَعْتُمَا: waqaʿtumā — you two fell (perf. 2 dual of waqaʿa)
قَتَلَكُمَا: قَتَلَ + كُمَا — qatala, he killed (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -kumā, you two; 'he kills you'
سَيَّرَ: sayyara, he sent (perf. 3 m. sg., form II of s-y-r)
ضَارِبًا: ḍārib, striker, swordsman (act. part. of ḍaraba), acc. singular after the numeral
وَالرَّأْيُ: و + الـ + رَأْي — wa-, and + al-, the + raʾy, opinion, counsel (m.), nom.; 'and the opinion'
تَهْرُبَا: tahrubā, you two flee (subj. 2 dual of haraba)
بِكُمَا: بِـ + كُمَا — bi-, on, upon (prep.; ḥalla bi-, 'befall') + -kumā, you two; 'upon you two' Also bi- chosen by ʿalima, 'know of': yaʿlama bikumā, '(that he) learn of you two'.
مَدَّيَدَهُ: مَدَّ + يَد + هُ — madda, he stretched (perf. 3 m. sg.) + yad, hand (f.), acc. + -hu, his; printed as one word; 'stretched his hand'
صُولَتِهِ: صُولَة + هِ — ṣūla, assault (f.), gen. + -hi, his; as printed, evidently a slip for ṣurra, purse; 'his purse (?)'
وَأَعْطَاهُمْ: و + أَعْطَى + هُمْ — wa-, and + aʿṭā, he gave (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and gave them'
وَسَافِرْ: و + سَافِرْ — wa-, and + sāfir, travel (imper. 2 m. sg., form III of s-f-r); 'and travel'
لَأَعْطَيْتُكَ: لَـ + أَعْطَيْتُ + كَ — la-, introduces the apodosis of law, 'would' + aʿṭaytu, I gave (perf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you; 'I would have given you'
مُعَاتَبَةٍ: muʿātaba, mutual reproach, blame (f., form III verbal noun), gen. indefinite
وَأَعْلَمَهَا: و + أَعْلَمَ + هَا — wa-, and + aʿlama, he informed (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV) + -hā, her; 'and told her'
فَتَخَبَّلَتْ: فَـ + تَخَبَّلَتْ — fa-, and so + takhabbalat, she was stricken, crippled (perf. 3 f. sg., form V of kh-b-l; obscure); 'and she was stricken'
الـ + مَدِينَة — madīna, city (f.), gen.; 'the city' (the print has a full stop)
وَأَسْبَلَ: و + أَسْبَلَ — wa-, and + asbala, he let down (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV of s-b-l); 'and let down'
سِتْرَهُ: سِتْر + هُ — sitr, veil, covering (m.), acc. + -hu, his; 'His veil'
وَمَشَيَا: و + مَشَيَا — wa-, and + mashayā, they two walked (perf. 3 dual of mashā); 'and they walked'
فَوَجَدَا: فَـ + وَجَدَا — fa-, and so + wajadā, they two found (perf. 3 dual); 'and they found'
زَادِهِ: زَاد + هِ — zād, provisions (m.), gen. after min + -hi, his; 'his provisions'
فَلْيَأْتِ: فَـ + لِـ + يَأْتِ — fa-, then + li-, let (imperative particle) + yaʾti, he brings (jussive 3 m. sg. of atā); 'then let him bring'
مُتَوَجِّهُونَ: mutawajjihūn, heading out (act. part. plur. of form V tawajjaha), nom.
لِجَمَاعَتِهِ: لِـ + جَمَاعَة + هِ — li-, to (prep.) + jamāʿa, group, crew (f.), gen. + -hi, his; 'to his crew'
حُلُّوا: ḥullū, loosen, untie (imper. 2 m. pl. of ḥalla)
الْأَطْرَافَ: الـ + أَطْرَاف — aṭrāf, ends, ropes (plur. of ṭaraf), acc.; 'the ropes'
وَاقْلَعُوا: و + اقْلَعُوا — wa-, and + iqlaʿū, pull up (imper. 2 m. pl. of qalaʿa); 'and pull up'
الْأَوْتَادَ: الـ + أَوْتَاد — awtād, pegs, stakes (plur. of watad), acc.; 'the stakes'
يَارَئِيسُ: يَا + رَئِيس — yā, O (vocative) + raʾīs, captain; printed as one word; 'O captain'
فُزْبِهَا: فُزْ + بِـ + هَا — fuz, win through (imper. 2 m. sg. of fāza) + bi-, with (prep.; fāza bi-, 'win through with') + -hā, it; printed as one word; 'win through with it'
بَنَا: banā, he built (perf. 3 m. sg. of banā)
وَاجِدُ: wājid, finder (act. part. of wajada), nom. in construct
بِاَرْضِ: بِـ + اَرْض — bi-, for, in exchange for (prep.) + arḍ, land, gen.; 'for land'
شِعْـر: شِعْر — shiʿr, verse (m.); the rubric introducing a poem, here printed with a tatweel ('verse')
عَرِيَقُ: the edition's broken printing of عَرِيق (ʿarīq), 'rooted, of long standing'? — the line is garbled (والشا عريق—ول) and run into a stray catch-fragment; read as the poet-rubric 'and the poet says' (wa-al-shāʿir yaqūl)
فَأَخَذَهَا: فَـ + أَخَذَ + هَا — akhadha, take (3rd m. sg. perfect) + her; 'so he took her' (fa-, then/so, narrative sequence)
وَنَعْدَمُ: وَ + نَعْدَمُ — ʿadima, lose, be bereft of (1st pl. imperfect, 'we'); 'and we lose' (wa-, and)
الرَّئِيسَ: الـ + رَئِيس — al-, the + raʾīs, captain, head (m.), accusative as subject after أَنَّ; 'the captain'
لِعَلِيٍّ: لِـ + عَلِيّ — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed after قَالَ) + ʿAlī (personal name); 'to ʿAlī'
وَعَوَّمُوا: وَ + عَوَّمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿawwamū, set afloat, push off (II, 3 m. pl. perf.; colloquial); 'and they pushed off'
وَأَرْخَوُا: وَ + أَرْخَوُا — wa-, and (conj.) + arkhaw, let out, slacken (IV, 3 m. pl. perf.; final -u before al-); 'and they let out'
بِجَنَاحَيْهِ: بِـ + جَنَاحَيْ + هِ — bi-, with, on (prep., of the instrument) + janāḥay, two wings (dual, genitive) + -hi, its; 'with its two wings'
شِعْرَ: شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry, verse (m.), accusative; 'in verse' (no alif in the print, so no tanwīn) ; also: acc. object of samiʿa, first term of iḍāfa: shiʿra Maymūnata, 'Maymūna's verse'
لِهَؤُلَاءِ: لِـ + هَؤُلَاءِ — li-, to, for (prep.; 'what happened to') + hāʾulāʾi, these (demonstrative pl.; print has precomposed ؤ); 'to these'
