يُسْبِيكَ: يُسْبِي + كَ — yusbī, captivate, enchant (3 m. sg. imperf., printed with damma) + -ka, you; 'captivates you'
مَنْظَرُهُ: مَنْظَر + هُ — manẓar, sight, appearance (m.) + -hu, its; 'its sight'
تُسَابِقُ: تُسَابِقُ — tusābiqu, race, outstrip (III, 3 f. sg. imperf.); 'she outstrips'
سَيْرٍ: سَيْر — sayr, going, travelling (m.), genitive after fī; 'in going'
وَمَجْرَاءِ: وَ + مَجْرَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + majrāʾ, running, course (for majrā, printed with hamza; genitive after fī); 'and in running'
كَانَّهُ: كَ + أَنَّ + هُ — ka-anna, as if (conj.; print has bare alif) + -hu, it; 'as if it'
اَجْنِحَةً: اَجْنِحَة — ajniḥa, wings (pl. of janāḥ), accusative object; 'wings'
مُنْقَضًّا: مُنْقَضّ — munqaḍḍ, swooping down (active part. of VII inqaḍḍa), accusative of state; 'swooping'
الذَّهَبِ: الـ + ذَهَب — al-, the + dhahab, gold (m.); genitive after مِنْ: 'the gold'
الرَّبِيعِ: الـ + رَبِيع — al-, the + rabīʿ, spring (the season); genitive: 'of spring'
الرَّشِيدِ: الـ + رَشِيد — al-, the + rashīd, rightly-guided; part of the name Hārūn al-Rashīd, genitive in apposition
الزُّقَاقِ: الـ + زُقَاق — al-, the + zuqāq, lane, alley (m.); genitive: 'of the lane'
السَّمْعُ: الـ + سَمْع — al-, the + samʿ, hearing (m.); nominative: 'the hearing' (in السمع والطاعة, 'hearing and obedience')
الشَّبَابِيكَ: الـ + شَبَابِيك — al-, the + shabābīk, windows (pl. of شُبَّاك, shubbāk); accusative object: 'the windows'
الشَّيْخُ: الـ + شَيْخ — al-, the + shaykh, elder, old man; nominative: 'the Shaykh' (title before a name)
الشِّتَاءُ: الـ + شِتَاء — al-, the + shitāʾ, winter (m.); nominative: 'the winter'
الطَّلَبُ: الـ + طَلَب — al-, the + ṭalab, search, pursuit (m.); nominative: 'the search'
النَّاسِ: الـ + نَاس — al-, the + nās, people (collective); genitive: 'of the people'
النَّدِيمِ: الـ + نَدِيم — al-, the + nadīm, boon-companion, drinking and conversation partner; genitive in apposition: 'the boon-companion'
النَّكَالِ: الـ + نَكَال — al-, the + nakāl, exemplary punishment; genitive after مِنَ: 'of the punishment'
النُّزْهَةِ: الـ + نُزْهَة — al-, the + nuzha, delight, pleasant outing; genitive: 'of Delight' (in بُسْتَانَ النُّزْهَةِ, 'Garden of Delight')
الْأَبْوَابَ: الـ + أَبْوَاب — al-, the + abwāb, doors (pl. of بَاب); accusative object: 'the doors'
الْأَمَاكِنَ: الـ + أَمَاكِن — al-, the + amākin, places (pl. of مَكَان); accusative object: 'the places'
الْأَيَّامِ: الـ + أَيَّام — al-, the + ayyām, days (pl. of يَوْم); genitive after بَعْض: 'of the days'
الْبُسْتَانُ: الـ + بُسْتَان — al-, the + bustān, garden, orchard (m.); nominative: 'the garden'
الْخَوْلِيُّ: الـ + خَوْلِيّ — al-, the + khawlī, keeper or gardener of an estate; nominative in apposition: 'the keeper'
الْقَصَّابِ: الـ + قَصَّاب — al-, the + qaṣṣāb, butcher; genitive: 'of the butcher'
الْمَسَاطِبِ: الـ + مَسَاطِب — al-, the + masāṭib, benches (pl. of مَصْطَبَة, maṣṭaba); genitive: 'the benches'
الْمُتَفَرِّجِينَ: الـ + مُتَفَرِّجِين — al-, the + mutafarrijīn, onlookers, sightseers (pl. of مُتَفَرِّج, from تَفَرَّجَ, to look on at a sight); accusative object: 'the sightseers'
اُطْلُبُوهُمَا: اُطْلُبُوا + هُمَا — imperative plural of طَلَبَ, ṭalaba, to seek + -humā, them both (dual); 'seek them both'
اِقْعُدْ: اِقْعُدْ — imperative of قَعَدَ, qaʿada, to sit; 'sit!'
أَخْفَاهُ: أَخْفَى + هُ — akhfā, he hid (IV of خَفِيَ, to be hidden) + -hu, him; 'hides him'
أَشْجَارُهَا: أَشْجَار + هَا — ashjār, trees (pl. of شَجَرَة) + -hā, its/her (the city's); 'its trees'
أَصَبْتَهُ: أَصَبْتَ + هُ — aṣabta, you found, struck on (IV of صَابَ, أَصَابَ) + -hu, him; 'you find him'
أَمِينَةٌ: أَمِينَة — amīna, safe, secure, trustworthy (f.); indefinite nominative: 'secure'
أَنْهَارُهَا: أَنْهَار + هَا — anhār, rivers (pl. of نَهْر) + -hā, its/her; 'its rivers'
أَوْعَرَفَ: أَوْ + عَرَفَ — aw, or + ʿarafa, he knew (عَرَفَ); printed as one word: 'or knows'
أَيُّ: أَيّ — ayy, which, whichever (nominative, before مَنْ); أَيُّ مَنْ, 'whoever'
أَيِّ: أَيّ — ayy, which, whatever (m.); genitive after مِنْ, in construct: 'whichever'
إِبْرَاهِيمَ: إِبْرَاهِيم — Ibrāhīm, Abraham; the name Ibrāhīm, genitive (diptote) after بْنِ: 'Ibrāhīm' (father of Isḥāq)
إِبْرَاهِيمُ: إِبْرَاهِيم — Ibrāhīm, Abraham; the name Ibrāhīm, nominative: 'Ibrāhīm' (the keeper, Shaykh Ibrāhīm)
إِذْنٌ: إِذْن — idhn, permission, leave (m.); nominative: 'a permission'
بُسْتَانَ: بُسْتَان — bustān, garden (m.); accusative in construct (second object of يُسَمَّى): 'Garden of'
بِالسَّلَامَةِ: بِـ + الـ + سَلَامَة — bi-, in, with (prep.: expresses the state or manner) + al-, the + salāma, safety, soundness; 'in safety'
بِإِسْحَاقَ: بِـ + إِسْحَاق — bi-, for/regarding (prep.: governed by أَمَرَ بِـ 'to command the bringing of') + Isḥāq, Isaac, the name of the boon-companion (diptote); 'for Isḥāq'
بِشَارَكَ: بِشَارَ + كَ — bishāra, glad tidings, the gift for bringing good news (printed without the tā' of بِشَارَتِك) + -ka, your; 'your bishāra'
بِمَسَاطِبَ: بِـ + مَسَاطِب — bi-, with (prep.: what the place is furnished with) + masāṭib, benches (pl. of مَصْطَبَة), diptote genitive; 'with benches'
جَلَّ: جَلَّ — jalla, he is exalted, great (جَلَّ، يَجِلُّ), perfect used in praise; جَلَّ مَنْ لَا يَنَامُ 'exalted is he who does not sleep'
حِسْنٌ: حِسْن — as printed; evidently حِسّ ḥiss, trace, sound, sign, with a stray ن; indefinite nominative: 'a trace'
خَوْلِيٌّ: خَوْلِيّ — khawlī, keeper or gardener of an estate; indefinite nominative: 'a keeper'
دَخَلَهُ: دَخَلَ + هُ — dakhala, he entered (دَخَلَ، يَدْخُلُ) + -hu, it; takes a direct object: 'he entered it'
رَاحَةً: رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, ease, repose (f.); accusative object: 'rest'
شَمْعَدَانٌ: شَمْعَدَان — shamʿadān, candlestick, candelabrum (from شَمْع 'wax, candle'); indefinite nominative: 'a candelabrum'
شَنِيعًا: شَنِيع — shanīʿ, hideous, shocking, dreadful; accusative adjective of ضَرْبًا: 'fearful'
شُبَّاكًا: شُبَّاك — shubbāk, window, lattice; accusative of specification after the number ثَمَانُونَ: 'windows'
طَيِّبٌ: طَيِّب — ṭayyib, good, fine; exclamation of grim pleasure; 'good!'
طُولَانِيَّةٍ: طُولَانِيَّة — ṭūlāniyya, long, oblong (colloquial adj. from طُول, length; f.); indefinite genitive adjective of مَسَاطِبَ: 'long'
عَرَضَتْ: عَرَضَتْ — ʿaraḍat, it presented itself, occurred (عَرَضَ، يَعْرِضُ), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'it arose'
عَرَفَا: عَرَفَا — ʿarafā, they two knew (عَرَفَ), 3rd dual m. perfect; 'they two knew'
عَلِىٌّ: عَلِيّ — ʿAlī, a proper name (the print's final ى kept, ʿAlī); nominative: 'ʿAlī'
عَلِيٌّ: عَلِيّ — ʿAlī, a proper name; nominative: 'ʿAlī'
عَلِيٍّ: عَلِيّ — ʿAlī, a proper name; genitive: 'ʿAlī'
غَسَلَا: غَسَلَا — ghasalā, they two washed (غَسَلَ، يَغْسِلُ), 3rd dual perfect; 'they two washed'
فَإِنَّهُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُ — fa-, then, so (introducing the consequence) + inna, indeed + -hu, he/it; 'then indeed he'
فَإِنَّهُمَا: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُمَا — fa-, and (turning to the other party) + inna, indeed + -humā, they two; 'indeed the two'
فَإِنَّهُمْ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُمْ — fa-, and (following the ammā clause) + inna, indeed + -hum, they; 'indeed they'
فَجَاءَا: فَـ + جَاءَا — fa-, and then (sequence) + jāʾā, they two came (جَاءَ); 'and the two came'
فَدَعَى: فَـ + دَعَى — fa-, and so (sequence) + daʿā (printed with ى), he prayed, called (دَعَا، يَدْعُو), here 'he prayed for'; 'and he prayed'
فَرَمَتْهُمَا: فَـ + رَمَتْ + هُمَا — fa-, and (sequence) + ramat, she threw, cast (رَمَى، يَرْمِي), 3rd f. sg. perfect + -humā, them two; 'and cast them'
فَصْلُ: فَصْل — faṣl, season, section (m.); nominative in construct: 'the season of'
فَطَلَعَا: فَـ + طَلَعَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + ṭalaʿā, they two went up (طَلَعَ); 'so the two climbed up'
فَكَسَرُوا: فَـ + كَسَرُوا — fa-, and (sequence) + kasarū, they broke (كَسَرَ، يَكْسِرُ), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and broke'
فَنَامَا: فَـ + نَامَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + nāmā, they two slept (نَامَ، يَنَامُ), 3rd dual perfect; 'and the two fell asleep'
فَهَدَمُوا: فَـ + هَدَمُوا — fa-, and so (sequence) + hadamū, they demolished (هَدَمَ، يَهْدِمُ), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'so they pulled down'
فَوَجَدَاهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَا + هُ — fa-, and (sequence) + wajadā, they two found (وَجَدَ) + -hu, it; 'and the two found it'
فَيَغْضَبُ: فَـ + يَغْضَبُ — fa-, and then (sequence) + yaghḍabu, he becomes angry (غَضِبَ، يَغْضَبُ); 'and he would be angry'
فَيَنْشَرِحَ: فَـ + يَنْشَرِحَ — fa-, so that (result, takes the subjunctive) + yanshariḥa, it opens, expands (VII of شَرَحَ; انْشَرَحَ صَدْرُهُ 'his heart was eased'); 'so that it was eased'
قَصْرٌ: قَصْر — qaṣr, palace (m.); indefinite nominative: 'a palace'
قَصْرُ: قَصْر — qaṣr, palace (m.); nominative in construct (the name): 'the Palace of'
قِنْدِيلًا: قِنْدِيل — qindīl, lamp (m.); accusative of specification after ثَمَانُونَ: 'lamps'
كَافَّةً: كَافَّة — kāffa, all together, altogether; accusative adverb: 'one and all'
لَقِيتُهُ: لَقِيتُ + هُ — laqītu, I met (لَقِيَ، يَلْقَى), 1st sg. perfect + -hu, him; 'I meet him'
لِلرَّئِيسِ: لِـ + الـ + رَئِيس — li-, to (prep.: marks the recipient of أَعْطَى) + al-, the + raʾīs, captain; 'to the captain'
لِلْبُسْتَانِ: لِـ + الـ + بُسْتَان — li-, to, belonging to (prep.: in كَانَ لِـ 'there was') + al-, the + bustān, garden; 'the garden had'
مَحَلٌّ: مَحَلّ — maḥall, place, spot (m.); indefinite nominative: 'a place'
مَغْلُوقٌ: مَغْلُوق — maghlūq, shut, bolted (colloquial passive participle of غَلَقَ; Classical مُغْلَق); indefinite nominative: 'shut'
مُعَلَّقَةٍ: مُعَلَّقَة — muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (passive participle of عَلَّقَ; f.); indefinite genitive adjective: 'hanging'
مُعَلِّمَ: مُعَلِّم — muʿallim, master, foreman, teacher; accusative in construct (مُعَلِّمَ الْقَصَّابِ): 'master of'
مُغَطِّيَيْنِ: مُغَطِّيَيْن — mughaṭṭiyayn, covering, covered (participle of غَطَّى, to cover; dual, oblique); 'covered'
مُكَعَّبٌ: مُكَعَّب — mukaʿʿab, cubed, latticed (participle of كَعَّبَ); here cane-work in a lattice, a trellis; indefinite nominative: 'a lattice'
نَائِمَيْنِ: نَائِم — nāʾim, sleeping (active participle of نَامَ; dual, oblique); accusative circumstantial: 'asleep'
نَأْخُذْ: نَأْخُذْ — naʾkhudh, we take (أَخَذَ، يَأْخُذُ), 1st pl. jussive; 'let us take'
نُورُالدِّينِ: نُورُ الدِّين — Nūr al-Dīn, 'light of the faith', a name; printed as one word; nominative: 'Nūr al-Dīn'
نُورِالدِّينِ: نُورِ الدِّين — Nūr al-Dīn, 'light of the faith', a name; printed as one word; genitive: 'Nūr al-Dīn'
هَمُّهُ: هَمّ + هُ — hamm, care, worry, grief (m.) + -hu, his; nominative subject: 'his care'
وَاطْمَأَنَّ: وَ + اطْمَأَنَّ — wa-, and (conjunction) + iṭmaʾanna, he grew tranquil, was at ease (IV-form quadriliteral اطْمَأَنَّ); 'and was at ease'
وَالتَّمَاثِيلِ: وَ + الـ + تَمَاثِيل — wa-, and (conjunction) + al-, the + tamāthīl, images, statues, figures (pl. of تِمْثَال); genitive: 'and the Statues'
وَالطَّاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + طَاعَة — wa-, and (conjunction) + al-, the + ṭāʿa, obedience (f.); nominative: 'and obedience'
وَالْبَقَاءِ: وَ + الـ + بَقَاء — wa-, and (conjunction) + al-, the + baqāʾ, permanence, continuance (m.); genitive: 'and lasting'
وَأَعْلَمُوا: وَ + أَعْلَمُوا — wa-, and (conjunction) + aʿlamū, they informed (IV of عَلِمَ), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and informed'
وَأَمَّا: وَ + أَمَّا — wa-, and (conjunction) + ammā, as for (topic-turning particle, followed by فَـ); 'and as for'
وَأَيْدِيَهُمَا: وَ + أَيْدِي + هُمَا — wa-, and (conjunction) + aydī, hands (pl. of يَد) + -humā, their two; accusative object: 'and their hands'
وَجَارِيَتُهُ: وَ + جَارِيَة + هُ — wa-, and (conjunction) + jāriya, slave-girl (f.) + -hu, his; nominative: 'and his slave-girl'
وَجَارِيَتِهِ: وَ + جَارِيَة + هِ — wa-, and (conjunction) + jāriya, slave-girl (f.) + -hi, his; genitive: 'and his slave-girl'
وَسَارَا: وَ + سَارَا — wa-, and (conjunction) + sārā, they two walked, went on (سَارَ، يَسِيرُ), 3rd dual perfect; 'and walked on'
وَضَرَبَهُمَا: وَ + ضَرَبَ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conjunction) + ḍaraba, it struck (ضَرَبَ، يَضْرِبُ) + -humā, them two; 'and struck them'
وَطَافُوا: وَ + طَافُوا — wa-, and (conjunction) + ṭāfū, they went round, searched (طَافَ، يَطُوفُ), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and went round'
وَفَوْقَهُ: وَ + فَوْقَ + هُ — wa-, and (conjunction) + fawqa, above (prep.) + -hu, it; 'and above it'
وَقَوَادِيسَ: وَ + قَوَادِيس — wa-, and (conjunction) + qawādīs, water-jars (pl. of قَادُوس, jar or pipe for water); diptote genitive after بِمَسَاطِبَ: 'and water-jars'
وَلَّى: وَلَّى — wallā, he turned away (II of وَلِيَ; وَلَّى عَنْ 'turn away from'), 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'has turned away'
وَمَرْسُومٌ: وَ + مَرْسُوم — wa-, and (conjunction) + marsūm, decree, ordinance (m.); nominative: 'and a decree'
وَمُعَلَّقٌ: وَ + مُعَلَّق — wa-, and (conjunction) + muʿallaq, hung, suspended (passive participle of عَلَّقَ); 'and hanging'
وَيَزُولَ: وَ + يَزُولَ — wa-, and (conjunction) + yazūla, it vanishes (زَالَ، يَزُولُ), 3rd m. sg. subjunctive (continuing the فَـ result clause); 'and vanished'
وُجُوهَهُمَا: وُجُوه + هُمَا — wujūh, faces (pl. of وَجْه) + -humā, their two; accusative object: 'their faces'
وُجِدَ: وُجِدَ — wujida, it was found (passive of وَجَدَ); 'was found'
يَاسَيِّدِي: يَا + سَيِّد + ي — yā, O (vocative particle) + sayyid, lord, master + -ī, my; printed as one word: 'O my lord'
يَتَقَرَّبَ: يَتَقَرَّبَ — yataqarraba, he draws near (V of قَرُبَ), 3rd m. sg. subjunctive after حَتَّى لَا; 'draws near'
يَسْتَحِقُّ: يَسْتَحِقُّ — yastaḥiqqu, he deserves (X of حَقَّ), 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'he deserves'
يَفْعُوا: يَفْعُوا — yafʿū, as printed; a slip for يَقْعُوا yaqaʿū, they light upon (وَقَعَ), 3rd m. pl. jussive after لَمْ: 'they find'
يُخْبِرْ: يُخْبِرْ — yukhbir, he informs, reports (IV of خَبَرَ), 3rd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ; with بِـ 'inform about': 'inform'
يُسَمَّى: يُسَمَّى — yusammā, he/it is named (passive of سَمَّى, to name), 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'is called'
يُغَنُّوا: يُغَنُّوا — yughannū, they sing (II of غَنَّى, to sing), 3rd m. pl. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'sing'
الدَّمْعَةُ: الـ + دَمْعَة — al-, the; damʿa, tear (f.), nom., subject; 'the tear'
السَّبِيلِ: الـ + سَبِيل — al-, the; sabīl, road, way (m.), gen.; أَبْنَاءِ السَّبِيلِ 'sons of the road' = wayfarers
النَّبِيَّ: الـ + نَبِيّ — al-, the; nabiyy, prophet (m.), acc. as subject after أَنَّ; 'the Prophet' (Muhammad)
الْإِزَارَ: الـ + إِزَار — al-, the; izār, wrapper, sheet, cloth (m.), acc. as object; 'the wrapper'
الْبُسْتَانَ: الـ + بُسْتَان — al-, the; bustān, garden, orchard (m.), acc. object; 'the garden'
أَبْنَاءِ: أَبْنَاء — abnāʾ, sons (m. pl., plural of ابْن), gen. as first term of a construct; 'sons of'
أَضْرِبَهُمَا: أَضْرِبَ + هُمَا — aḍriba, I strike (subjunctive 1 s. after أَنْ); -humā, them both; 'that I strike them'
أَكْشِفُ: أَكْشِفُ — akshifu, I uncover, lay bare (pres. 1 s. of كَشَفَ); 'I will uncover'
أَوْصَى: أَوْصَى — awṣā, to enjoin, charge, bequeath (past 3 m.s., form IV of وَصَى); 'he enjoined'
إِكْرَامِ: إِكْرَام — ikrām, honouring, hospitality (verbal noun, form IV, m.), gen. after عَلَى and first term of a construct; 'the honouring of'
بَيَاضِ: بَيَاض — bayāḍ, whiteness (m.), gen. as first term of a construct; 'the whiteness of'
تَضْرِبُهُمَا: تَضْرِبُ + هُمَا — taḍribu, you strike (pres. 2 m.s. of ضَرَبَ); -humā, them both; 'you strike them'
تَعْبُرُ: تَعْبُرُ — taʿburu, you cross over, come across (pres. 2 m.s. of عَبَرَ); 'you cross'
جَرِيدَةً: جَرِيدَة — jarīda, palm-frond stripped of leaves, a switch (f.), acc. indef.; 'a palm-rod'
حَالَهُمَا: حَال + هُمَا — ḥāl, state, condition (f./m.), acc.; -humā, their (dual); 'their condition'
حَسَنَانِ: حَسَن — ḥasan, fair, handsome (adj.), dual nom. as predicate; 'two comely ones'
صَدْرُكَ: صَدْر + كَ — ṣadr, breast, chest (m.), nom.; -ka, your; 'your breast'
ضَرْبَهُمَا: ضَرْب + هُمَا — ḍarb, striking, beating (verbal noun, m.), acc. as object of أَرَادَ; -humā, them both; 'the striking of the two'
عِنْدِهِمَا: عِنْد + هِمَا — ʿinda, at, by, near (prep.), here after إِلَى (Middle Arabic 'to at') = 'to where they were'; -humā, them both (dual); 'to where the two were'
غَرِيبَيْنِ: غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger, foreigner (m.), dual acc. as predicate of يَكُونَانِ; 'two strangers'
فَاسْتَحَى: فَ + اسْتَحَى — fa-, 'then, and so'; istaḥā, to feel shame, be abashed (past 3 m.s., form X of حَيِيَ); 'then he was abashed'
فَغَطَّى: فَ + غَطَّى — fa-, 'then, and so'; ghaṭṭā, to cover (past 3 m.s., form II); 'then he covered'
قَصْدُ: قَصْد — qaṣd, intention, purpose (m.), nom. as subject (first term of a construct); 'the intention of'
لِرِجْلِ: لِـ + رِجْل — li-, to (prep.; with تَقَدَّمَ 'advance to'); rijl, foot (f.), gen.; 'to the foot of'
هَذَانِ: هَذَانِ — hādhāni, these two (m. dual demonstrative, nom.)
هُنَافَأَنَا: هُنَا + فَ + أَنَا — hunā, here (adv.); fa-, 'so, therefore'; anā, I (pron.); print joins the three; 'here; so I'
وَأَخَذَيَدَ: وَ + أَخَذَ + يَدَ — wa-, 'and'; akhadha, to take (past 3 m.s.); yada, hand of (f., acc., first term of a construct); print joins the three; 'and he took the hand of'
وَتَتَفَرَّجُ: وَ + تَتَفَرَّجُ — wa-, 'and'; tatafarraju, you amuse yourself, stroll for pleasure (pres. 2 m.s. of تَفَرَّجَ, form V); 'and you stroll'
وَرَمَتْهُمَا: وَ + رَمَتْ + هُمَا — wa-, 'and'; ramat, to throw, cast (past 3 f.s. of رَمَى); -humā, them both; 'and (the fates) have cast them'
وَرِثْتُهُ: وَرِثْتُ + هُ — warithtu, I inherited (past 1 s. of وَرِثَ); -hu, it (m.); 'I inherited it'
وَفَٰرَتِ: وَ + فَارَتِ — wa-, 'and'; fārat, to well up, gush (past 3 f.s. of فَارَ; print has defective فرت, dagger alif supplied), with kasra before the following الـ; 'and (the tear) welled'
وَيَعْبُرَا: وَ + يَعْبُرَا — wa-, 'and'; yaʿburā, they two cross (subjunctive 3 m. dual of عَبَرَ, after أَنْ); 'and cross'
يَطْمَئِنَّا: يَطْمَئِنَّا — yaṭmaʾinnā, they two be at ease, be reassured (subjunctive 3 m. dual of اِطْمَأَنَّ, form IX, after أَنْ); 'that they be at ease'
يَكُونَانِ: يَكُونَانِ — yakūnāni, they two are/may be (pres. 3 m. dual of كَانَ)
يَكْبِسُهَا: يَكْبِسُ + هَا — yakbisu, he presses, kneads, massages (pres. 3 m.s. of كَبَسَ); -hā, it/her (f.), here the foot; 'he kneads it'
امَهُمَا: امَ + هُمَا — second half of the split قُدَّامَ (quddām, in front of, before); -humā, them both (dual pronoun); with the previous word, 'in front of them both'
مُقَنْطَرٌ: مُقَنْطَرٌ — muqanṭar, vaulted, arched (passive participle II of qanṭara, to arch over; m.); 'vaulted'
كُرُومٌ: كُرُومٌ — kurūm, vines (pl. of karm; m.), nominative indefinite; 'vines'
وَأَعْنَابُهُ: وَ + أَعْنَابُ + هُ — wa-, and; aʿnāb, grapes (pl. of ʿinab), nominative; -hu, its; 'and its grapes'

مُرَصَّعَةً: muraṣṣaʿatan, studded, inlaid (pass. part. of II رصّع, f. sg., acc. indef., qualifying the vessels); 'studded'
بِأَصْنَافِ: بِـ + أَصْنَاف — bi-, with (prep., instrument/material) + aṣnāf, kinds, sorts (pl. of صنف, gen. in construct); 'with kinds of'
فَأَخْرَجَهَا: فَ + أَخْرَجَ + هَا — fa-, and then (conj.) + akhraja, bring out (perf. 3 m. sg., IV of خرج) + -hā, them (f. sg. for non-human pl.); 'and he brought them out'
وَرَصَّهَا: وَ + رَصَّ + هَا — wa-, and + raṣṣa, set in order, arrange closely (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them; 'and set them in order'
وَسَكَبَ: وَ + سَكَبَ — wa-, and + sakaba, he poured (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he poured'
الْبَوَاطِي: الـ + بَوَاطِي — al-, the + bawāṭī, bowls, large cups (pl. of باطية); 'the bowls'
وَالْقَنَانِي: وَ + الـ + قَنَانِي — wa-, and + al-, the + qanānī, flasks, bottles (pl. of قنينة); 'and the flasks'
بِمَارَأَى: بِـ + مَا + رَأَى — bi-, at, because of (prep.; فرح بِـ 'rejoice at') + mā, what (rel.) + raʾā, he saw; printed as one word; 'at what he saw'
وَانْدَهَشَ: وَ + انْدَهَشَ — wa-, and + indahasha, he was bewildered, dazzled (perf. 3 m. sg., VII of دهش); 'and he was dazzled'
وَالْمَشْمُومِ: وَ + الـ + مَشْمُوم — wa-, and + al-, the + mashmūm, things smelled, fragrant herbs and flowers (pass. part. of شمّ); 'and the fragrant flowers'
بَعِيدً: baʿīdan, far, at a distance (adj. used as adv., acc.); the print leaves the alif of the tanwīn to the next token
اعَنْهُمَا: ا (the alif of tanwīn in بعيدا) + عَنْ + هُمَا — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + -humā, them two; 'from them'
وَانْبَسَطَا: وَ + انْبَسَطَ + ا — wa-, and + inbasaṭa, become expansive, merry (perf., VII of بسط) + -ā, dual (they two); 'and the two grew merry'
تَحَكَّمَ: taḥakkama, he took control, got mastery (perf. 3 m. sg., V of حكم)
مَعَهُمَا: مَعَ + هُمَا — maʿa, with (prep.) + -humā, them two; here 'with them, over them'
الشَّرَابُ: الـ + شَرَاب — al-, the + sharāb, drink, wine (m., nom.); 'the drink'
وَاحْمَرَّتْ: وَ + احْمَرَّتْ — wa-, and + iḥmarrat, she/it turned red (perf. 3 f. sg., IX of حمر); 'and reddened'
خُدُودُهُمَا: خُدُود + هُمَا — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of خدّ, nom.) + -humā, their (two); 'their cheeks'
وَتَغَازَلَتْ: وَ + تَغَازَلَتْ — wa-, and + taghāzalat, they flirted with each other (perf. 3 f., VI of غزل); 'and flirted'
عُيُونُهُمَا: عُيُون + هُمَا — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عين, nom.) + -humā, their (two); 'their eyes'
وَأَسْبَلَتْ: وَ + أَسْبَلَتْ — wa-, and + asbalat, it let down, hung loose (perf. 3 f., IV of سبل); 'and hung loose'
شُعُورُهُمَا: شُعُور + هُمَا — shuʿūr, hair, locks (pl. of شعر, nom.) + -humā, their (two); 'their locks'
وَتَبَدَّلَتْ: وَ + تَبَدَّلَتْ — wa-, and + tabaddalat, it changed (perf. 3 f., V of بدل); 'and changed'
أَلْوَانُهُمَا: أَلْوَان + هُمَا — alwān, colours (pl. of لون, nom.) + -humā, their (two); 'their colours'
عِنْدَهُمَا: عِنْدَ + هُمَا — ʿinda, at, beside (prep.) + -humā, them two; 'beside them'
أَلْتَقِي: altaqī, I meet, encounter (impf. 1 sg., VIII of لقي); printed التقي
حَضْرَتِي: حَضْرَة + ي — ḥaḍra, presence, court (f.) + -ī, my; 'my presence'
اللَّذَيْنِ: alladhayni, who, which (dual relative, m., gen./acc.); 'the two who'
كَأَنَّهُمَا: كَأَنَّ + هُمَا — ka-anna, as though, as if (particle, from كَـ 'like' + أَنَّ 'that') + -humā, they two; 'as though they were'
يوَانِ: second piece of the split word الايوان: the ī (carried by ي) and -wān; with the preceding piece, al-īwān, 'the alcove' (genitive in construct)
فَمَلَأَ: فَ + مَلَأَ — fa-, so, then (narrative sequence) + malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he filled'; the print itself has the hamza (precomposed)
طَعْمُهُ: طَعْم + ـهُ — ṭaʿm, taste (m.) + -hu, its/his; 'its taste'
عَشَرَسَنَةً: ʿashara + sana — ten (m. form in compound numeral) + year (f.), printed fused as one word; with the preceding ثلثة, 'thirteen years'; accusative
فَتَغَافَلَ: فَ + تَغَافَلَ — fa-, so, then (narrative sequence) + taghāfala, to feign heedlessness, pretend not to notice (verb VI, perf. 3ms); 'so he paid no heed'
فَيَشْرَبُ: فَ + يَشْرَبُ — fa-, and so, then (sequence) + shariba, to drink (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'and he drinks'
وَيَنَامُ: وَ + يَنَامُ — nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, impf. 3ms); 'and he sleeps'
وَأَبْقَى: وَ + أَبْقَى — baqiya, to remain (verb I defective, impf. 1s abqā); 'and I remain'
يُنَادِمُنِي: يُنَادِمُ + نِي — nādama, to keep someone company in drinking (verb III, impf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'who drinks with me'
قَدَ: first piece of the split word قدحي: qada- (the print has قد حي); read with the next piece as qadaḥī, 'my cup'
حِي: second piece of the split word قدحي: -ḥī, with -ī, 'my'; read with the preceding piece as qadaḥī, 'my cup'
أُغَنِّي: ghannā — to sing (verb II defective, impf. 1s ughannī); 'I sing'
قَدَحِهِ: قَدَح + ـِهِ — qadaḥ, cup (m.) + -hi, his; genitive after عَلَى; 'his cup'
حَنَّتْ: ḥanna — to yearn, long (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she/it yearned'; here with a plural non-person subject
أَعْضَاؤُهُ: أَعْضَاء + ـُهُ — aʿḍāʾ, limbs, members (m. pl. of ʿuḍw) + -hu, his; nominative; 'his limbs'; the print itself has the hamza seat (ؤ)
وَمَالَتْ: وَ + مَالَتْ — māla, to incline, lean (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and it inclined'; here: mālat ʿalayhi, 'she leaned over him'
نَفْسُهُ: نَفْس + ـُهُ — nafs, soul, self (f.) + -hu, his; nominative; 'his soul, his heart'
مَلَأَتْ: malaʾa — to fill (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she filled'; the print itself has the hamza (precomposed)
وَشَرِبْتَهُ: وَ + شَرِبْتَ + هُ — shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'and you drank it'
تَرُدَّهُ: radda — to send back, refuse (verb I geminate, jussive 2ms after لَا, prohibition) + -hu, it; 'do not send it back'
وَاجْبُرْ: وَ + اجْبُرْ — jabara, to mend, set right, console (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'and mend'
وَشَرِبَهُ: وَ + شَرِبَ + هُ — shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and he drank it'
وَمَلَأَتْ: وَ + مَلَأَتْ — malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she filled'; the print itself has the hamza (precomposed)
الشَّمْعَةِ: الـ + شَمْعَة — shamʿa, candle (f.); genitive after عَلَى; 'the candle'
أَشْرَبَهُ: أَشْرَبَ + هُ — shariba, to drink (verb I, subjunctive 1s after أَنْ) + -hu, it; 'that I drink it'
شَرِبْتُهُ: شَرِبْتُ + هُ — shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hu, it; 'I drank it'
يَشْرَبَهُ: يَشْرَبَ + هُ — shariba, to drink (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after أَنْ) + -hu, it; 'that he drink it'
بِنُورِالدِّينِ: بِـ + نُورِالدِّينِ — bi-, a particle only marking what suddenly appears after إِذَا (not 'with') + Nūr al-Dīn, a personal name, printed as one word; 'and lo, Nūr al-Dīn'
فَأَبَيْتَ: فَ + أَبَيْتَ — fa-, and (conj.) + abā, to refuse (verb, 2 m. sg. perfect); 'and you refused'
وَقُلْتَ: وَ + قُلْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qāla, to say (verb, 2 m. sg. perfect, qul-ta); 'and you said'
اسْتَحْيَى: اِسْتَحْيَى — istaḥyā, to be ashamed, to feel shy (verb, form X, 3 m. sg. perfect; the print spells it with final ى); 'he was ashamed'
لِلْمُنَادَمَهْ: لِـ + الـ + مُنَادَمَة — li-, for, to (prep., here 'for/to the purpose of') + al-, the + munādama, carousing, drinking together (f., gen.; the print spells the tāʾ marbūṭa with ه); 'for the carousing'
تَحْلِفْ: تَحْلِفْ — ḥalafa, to swear (verb, 2 m. sg. jussive after lā); 'swear'
أُفَرِّجَكَ: أُفَرِّجَ + كَ — farraja, to make someone see, show a spectacle (verb, form II, 1 sg. subjunctive after ḥattā) + -ka, you (object suffix); 'I make you see (a show)'
تَمْلَأُ: تَمْلَأُ — malaʾa, to fill (verb, 3 f. sg. present, indicative; the print has the hamza written); 'she fills'
وَتَسْقِي: وَ + تَسْقِي — wa-, and (conj.) + saqā, to give to drink (verb, 3 f. sg. present); 'and gives to drink'
وَسَيِّدُهَا: وَ + سَيِّدُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial) + sayyid, master (m., nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'and her master'
يَمْلَأُ: يَمْلَأُ — malaʾa, to fill (verb, 3 m. sg. present; the print has the hamza written); 'he fills'
وَيَسْقِيهَا: وَ + يَسْقِي + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + saqā, to give to drink (verb, 3 m. sg. present) + -hā, her (object); 'and gives her to drink'
الْمُعَاشَرَةُ: الـ + مُعَاشَرَة — muʿāshara, company, companionship, intimate society (f., nom.); 'the companionship, this company'
بَطْنًا: بَطْنًا — baṭn, belly (m., acc. with tanwīn; accusative of respect, or a stock expression 'one and all', uncertain); 'belly'
دُورِنَا: دُور + نَا — dūr, houses (pl. of dār, f., gen. after fī) + -nā, our; 'in our houses'
مُبَارَكُ: مُبَارَك — mubārak, blessed (adj., m., voc.); used as a friendly address, 'my good man'
فَضَحِكَا: فَ + ضَحِكَا — fa-, and (conj.) + ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb, 3 m. dual perfect); 'and the two laughed'
اسْتَلْقَيَا: اِسْتَلْقَيَا — istalqā, to lie back, fall on one's back (verb, form X, 3 m. dual perfect); 'the two lay back'
ظُهُورِهِمَا: ظُهُور + هِمَا — ẓuhūr, backs (pl. of ẓahr, m., gen. after ʿalā) + -himā, their (dual); 'their backs'
شَرِبَا: شَرِبَا — shariba, to drink (verb, 3 m. dual perfect); 'the two drank'
وَسَقَيَاهُ: وَ + سَقَيَا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + saqā, to give to drink (verb, 3 m. dual perfect) + -hu, him (object); 'and gave him to drink'
ثُلُثِ: ثُلُث — thulth, third, one-third (m., gen. after ilā, first term of an annexation); 'a third'
وَأُوقِدُ: وَ + أُوقِدُ — wa-, and (conj.) + awqada, to light, kindle (verb, form IV, 1 sg. present); 'and I light'
الشَّمْعِ: الـ + شَمْع — shamʿ, wax, candles (collective, m., gen.); 'the candles'
الْمَصْفُوفِ: الـ + مَصْفُوف — maṣfūf, ranged, set in rows (passive participle, m., gen., adj. of al-shamʿ); 'the ranged, set in rows'
أَهَا: أَهَا — ahā, aha (interjection of consent or surprise)
تُوقِدِي: تُوقِدِي — awqada, to light (verb, form IV, 2 f. sg. jussive after lā); 'light'
فَنَهَضَتْ: فَ + نَهَضَتْ — fa-, and (conj.) + nahaḍa, to rise, get up (verb, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she rose'
ابْتَدَأَتْ: اِبْتَدَأَتْ — ibtadaʾa, to begin (verb, form VIII, 3 f. sg. perfect; the print has the hamza written); 'she began'
أَوْقَدَتِ: أَوْقَدَتِ — awqada, to light (verb, form IV, 3 f. sg. perfect), with kasra before al-; 'she lit'
الثَّمَانِينَ: الـ + ثَمَانِين — thamānīn, eighty (acc. sg. of the sound pl. form, with al-); 'the eighty'
قَعَدَتْ: قَعَدَتْ — qaʿada, to sit (verb, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'she sat'
تُخَلِّينِي: تُخَلِّي + نِي — khallā, to let, leave (verb, form II, 2 m. sg. present; the final ī is kept as in colloquial speech) + -nī, me (object); 'you let me'
أُوقِدُ: أُوقِدُ — awqada, to light (verb, form IV, 1 sg. present); 'I light'
الْقَنَادِيلِ: الـ + قَنَادِيل — qanādīl, lamps (pl. of qindīl, gen. after min); 'the lamps'
وَأَوْقِدْ: وَ + أَوْقِدْ — wa-, and (conj.) + awqada, to light (verb, form IV, 2 m. sg. imperative); 'and light!'
تَتَثَاقَلْ: تَتَثَاقَلْ — tathāqala, to be sluggish, hang back (verb, form VI, 2 m. sg. jussive after lā); 'be sluggish'
الْآخِرُ: الـ + آخِر — ākhir, other, last (m., nom.; the print has the madda written); 'the other, the last'
وَابْتَدَأَ: وَ + اِبْتَدَأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ibtadaʾa, to begin (verb, form VIII, 3 m. sg. perfect; the print has the hamza written); 'and he began'
أَجْرَعُ: أَجْرَعُ — ajraʿ, more gulping, a better drinker (elative of jarʿ/jariʿa, diptote, nom. predicate); 'more able to gulp'
الشَّبَابِيكَ: الـ + شَبَابِيك — shubbāk, window (pl. shabābīk, m., acc., object); 'the windows'
وَيَتَنَاشَدُونَ: وَ + يَتَنَاشَدُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tanāshada, to recite verses to one another (verb, form VI, 3 m. pl. present); 'and recite verses to each other'
الْأَشْعَارَ: الـ + أَشْعَار — ashʿār, poems, verses (pl. of shiʿr, m., acc., object); 'the poems'
أَرْهَجَ: أَرْهَجَ — arhaja, to be stirred, astir (verb, form IV, 3 m. sg. perfect; rare, meaning taken from context: the root is 'dust, commotion'); 'it was astir'
فَقَدَّرَ: فَ + قَدَّرَ — fa-, and (conj.) + qaddara, to decree, ordain (verb, form II, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'and he decreed'
تَفَقَّدَ: تَفَقَّدَ — tafaqqada, to go round inspecting, to look in on (verb, form V, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'he made his rounds'
ضَوْءَ: ضَوْءَ — ḍawʾ, light (m., acc., object of a verb such as naẓara, awqaʿa or raʾā; first term of an annexation); 'the light of'; in the name Ḍawʾ al-Makān
الْقِنْدِيلِ: الـ + قِنْدِيل — qindīl, lamp (m., gen., second term of an annexation; collective singular); 'the lamp, the lamps'
وَالشُّمُوعِ: وَ + الـ + شُمُوع — wa-, and (conj.) + shumūʿ, candles (pl. of shamʿa, gen.); 'and the candles'
سَاطِعًا: سَاطِعًا — sāṭiʿ, shining, rising brightly (active participle, m., acc. with tanwīn, ḥāl); 'shining'
يَرْهَجُ: يَرْهَجُ — rahija / rahaja, to glow, be astir (verb, 3 m. sg. present; rare, meaning taken from context); 'is aglow, is in a stir'
بِجَعْفَرٍ: بِـ + جَعْفَرٍ — bi-, with, by (prep.; after ʿalayya, 'upon me (be) …', i.e. 'bring me') + Jaʿfar, a proper name (gen.); 'Jaʿfar'
الْبَرْ: الـ + بَرْ — al-Bar, first half of the nisba al-Barmakī, printed in two words (the name Barmak)
مَكِيِّ: مَكِيّ — makī, second half of the nisba al-Barmakī (gen., apposed to Jaʿfar); 'the Barmakid'
إِلَّاوَقَدْ: إِلَّا + وَقَدْ — illā, except (exceptive) + wa-, and (conj.) + qad, already, indeed; written as one word in the print; mā kāna illā wa-qad, 'it was not but that (he) had …'
أَتَأْخُذُ: أَ + تَأْخُذُ — a-, (interrogative particle) + akhadha, to take (verb, 2 m. sg. present); 'do you take?'
تُعْلِمُنِي: تُعْلِمُ + نِي — aʿlama, to inform (verb, form IV, 2 m. sg. present, after wa-lā: 'and do you not inform') + -nī, me (object); 'inform me'
أُخِذَتْ: أُخِذَتْ — akhadha, to take (verb, 3 f. sg. perfect passive); 'was taken'
التَّمَاثِيلِ: الـ + تَمَاثِيل — tamāthīl, statues, images (pl. of timthāl, gen.); 'the statues'; qaṣr al-tamāthīl, 'the Palace of Statues'
يَتَوَقَّدُ: يَتَوَقَّدُ — tawaqqada, to blaze, be kindled (verb, form V, 3 m. sg. present); 'is blazing'
بِالْقَنَادِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + قَنَادِيل — bi-, with (prep., 'is lit with') + al-, the + qanādīl, lamps (gen.); 'with the lamps'
وَانْفَتَحَتْ: وَ + اِنْفَتَحَتْ — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial) + infataḥa, to be opened (verb, form VII, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and (its windows) opened'
شَبَابِيكُهُ: شَبَابِيك + هُ — shabābīk, windows (pl.; f. agreement, nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'its windows'
يَسْتَجْرِي: يَسْتَجْرِي — istajrā, to dare, be bold (verb, form X, 3 m. sg. present); 'dares'
ارْتَعَدَتْ: اِرْتَعَدَتْ — irtaʿada, to tremble (verb, form VIII, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'trembled'
أَخْبَرَكَ: أَخْبَرَ + كَ — akhbara, to inform (verb, form IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -ka, you (object); 'informed you'
بِأَنَّ: بِـ + أَنَّ — bi-, of, about (prep., after akhbara 'inform of') + anna, that (conj.); 'that'
وَنَظَرْنَا: وَ + نَظَرْنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + naẓarnā, 'we looked' as printed; the sense is wa-naẓara, 'and he looked', with the nā of the next word wrongly joined here (the intended phrase is wa-naẓara nāḥiyata); 'and he looked'
حِيَةَ: حِيَةَ — ḥiya, as printed; the intended word is nāḥiya, side, quarter (f., acc., first term of an annexation), whose initial nā fell on to the previous word; 'toward the side of'
يَشْتَعِلُ: يَشْتَعِلُ — ishtaʿala, to blaze, catch fire (verb, form VIII, 3 m. sg. present, ḥāl); 'blazing'
بِالْمَصَابِيحِ: بِـ + الـ + مَصَابِيح — bi-, with (prep., 'blazing with') + al-, the + maṣābīḥ, lamps (pl. of miṣbāḥ, gen.); 'with the lamps'
حِنْدِسِ: حِنْدِسِ — ḥindis, pitch-dark night, utter darkness (m., gen. after fī, first term of an annexation); 'the pitch-darkness of'
يَعْتَذِرَ: yaʿtadhiru, to make excuse, plead (verb VIII, subj. 3ms after أَنْ); with عَنْ, 'make excuse on behalf of'
بِإِذْنِهِ: بِـ + إِذْن + ـهِ — idhn, permission, leave (m., gen. after bi-); bi-, with, by (prep.); 'with his permission'; ـهِ 3ms poss.
لِمَارَأَى: لِـ + مَا + رَأَى — li-, for, because of (prep.) + mā, what (rel. pron.) + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'because of what he saw'; the print joins the three words
الْمَصْلَحَةِ: الـ + مَصْلَحَة — maṣlaḥa, benefit, advantage, interest (f., gen. after مِنَ); 'the benefit'
أُفْرِحَ: ufriḥa, to gladden, make glad (verb IV, subj. 1s after أَنْ); here 'give a feast of joy for', as at a circumcision
حَيَاةِ: ḥayāt, life (f., gen. in construct after fī); 'in the life of'
مَرْسُومًا: marsūm, decree, edict (m., acc. as object; passive part. of رَسَمَ 'to write, command'); 'a decree'
بِأَنِّي: بِـ + أَنَّ + ـي — bi-, with, as to (prep.; here introducing the content of the decree) + anna, that (conj.) + 1s pron.; 'that I'
أُطَاهِرُ: uṭāhiru, to purify, circumcise (verb III, imperf. 1s indic.); ṭāhara 'circumcise'; 'I circumcise'
طَاهِرْهُمْ: طَاهِرْ + ـهُمْ — ṭāhir, circumcise! (imperative 2ms of ṭāhara, verb III) + 3mp obj.; 'circumcise them'
أَجْتَمِعُ: ajtamiʿu, to meet, assemble (verb VIII, imperf. 1s indic.); with بِـ 'meet with'
وَأُعْلِمُهُ: وَ + أُعْلِمُ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + uʿlimu, to inform (verb IV, imperf. 1s indic.) + 3ms obj.; 'and I inform him'
فَرَاحَ: فَـ + رَاحَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + rāḥa, to go away (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and so he went'
أُعْلِمَكَ: uʿlima + ـكَ — to inform (verb IV, subj. 1s after أَنْ) + 2ms obj.; 'that I inform you'
ذَنْبَانِ: dhanbān — two faults (dual nom. of dhanb, subject of ṣāra); 'two faults'
أَخْطَأْتَ: akhṭaʾta, to err, make a mistake (verb IV, perf. 2ms); the print writes the hamza on an alif seat; 'you erred'
وَجْهَيْنِ: wajh, face, aspect, respect (m., dual gen. after min); 'two respects'
الْوَجْهُ: الـ + وَجْه — wajh, face, respect (m., nom.); 'the respect'
أَعْلَمْتَنِي: aʿlamtanī, to inform (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1s obj. (-nī); 'you informed me'
وَالْوَجْهُ: وَ + الـ + وَجْه — wa-, and (conj.) + al-wajh, the respect (nom.); 'and the respect'
بَلَّغْتَ: ballaghta, to cause to reach, convey (verb II, perf. 2ms); 'you caused to reach, you secured'
مَقْصُودَهُ: مَقْصُود + ـهُ — maqṣūd, aim, intent (m., acc. as second object; passive part. of قَصَدَ 'to aim') + 3ms poss.; 'his aim'
تَعْرِيضًا: taʿrīḍ, hint, oblique allusion (verbal noun of II ʿarraḍa; acc. adverbial of manner); 'as a hint'
لِطَلَبِ: لِـ + طَلَب — li-, for, in order to (prep., indicating purpose) + ṭalab, seeking, request (verbal noun, m., gen.); 'for the seeking of'
شَئاً: shayʾ, thing (m., acc. indef.); the print writes شياً, without the hamza; 'anything'
آبَائِي: آبَاء + ـي — ābāʾ, fathers (broken pl. of أَب) + 1s poss.; the print writes the hamza on a yā' seat; 'my fathers'
وَأَجْدَادِي: وَ + أَجْدَاد + ـي — wa-, and (conj.) + ajdād, grandfathers, forefathers (broken pl. of جَدّ) + 1s poss.; 'and my forefathers'
أَتِمُّ: atimmu, to complete (verb I, imperf. 1s indic.; tamma); 'I complete'
صَالِحٌ: ṣāliḥ, righteous, pious (act. part. of صَلَحَ, m. nom. indef.); 'righteous'
بِالْمَشَائِخِ: بِـ + الـ + مَشَائِخ — bi-, to, upon (prep., qāma bi- 'attend to') + al-mashāʾikh, the elders (pl. of شَيْخ, gen.); 'to the elders'
وَالْفُقَرَاءِ: وَ + الـ + فُقَرَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + al-fuqarāʾ, the poor, dervishes (broken pl. of فَقِير, gen.); 'and the poor'
وَيُعِزُّهُمْ: وَ + يُعِزُّ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuʿizzu, to honour (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 3mp obj.; 'and honours them'
وَيَكُونُونَ: وَ + يَكُونُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yakūnūna, they are (kāna, imperf. 3mp indic.); 'and they are'
دَعْوَةُ: daʿwa, prayer, supplication (f., nom. in construct); 'the prayer of'
يَحْصُلُ: yaḥṣulu, to come about, accrue (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'comes to pass'
لَنَابِهَا: لَـ + نَا + بِـ + هَا — li-, for, to (prep.) + -nā, us (1p pron.) + bi-, by, through (prep.) + -hā, it (3fs, the prayer); 'for us through it'; the print joins li-nā bi-hā
وَالْآخِرَةِ: وَ + الـ + آخِرَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ākhira, the hereafter (f., gen.); 'and the hereafter'
مَصَالِحُ: maṣāliḥ, benefits, interests (broken pl. of مَصْلَحَة; nom., predicate in an inverted sentence); 'benefits'
بِحُضُورِى: بِـ + حُضُور + ـي — bi-, through, by reason of (prep.) + ḥuḍūr, presence (verbal noun, gen.) + 1s poss.; 'through my presence'
وَيَفْرَحُ: وَ + يَفْرَحُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yafraḥu, to rejoice (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'and he will rejoice'
أَوَقْتُ: أَ + وَقْت — a-, interrogative particle ('is it?') + waqt, time, hour (m., nom.); 'is it a time'
فُرُوغٍ: furūgh, finishing, being done (verbal noun of فَرَغَ, m., gen. after ʿalā); 'finishing'
لَايَدْرِى: لَا + يَدْرِي — lā, not + yadrī, to know (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'not knowing'; the print joins the words
مَايَفْعَلُ: مَا + يَفْعَلُ — mā, what (rel./interrog. pron.) + yafʿalu, to do (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'what he does'; the print joins the words
الثَّلَٰثَةُ: الـ + ثَلَٰثَة — thalātha, three (the print omits the alif; dagger alif added); 'the three' (nom., in apposition to the subject)
مُتَنَكِّرِينَ: mutanakkir, disguised (act. part. V of تَنَكَّرَ, m. pl. acc., circumstantial); 'disguised'
يَشُقُّونَ: yashuqqūna, to split, cleave, make one's way through (verb I geminate, imperf. 3mp indic.); 'they cleaved their way'
الْأَزِقَّاتِ: الـ + أَزِقَّات — aziqqāt, alleys (pl. of أَزِقَّة / زُقَاق, f. pl. gen.); the print's form of the plural; 'the alleys'
الْمَذْكُورِ: الـ + مَذْكُور — madhkūr, mentioned (passive part. of ذَكَرَ, m. gen., adj.); 'the aforementioned'
عَادَتُهُ: عَادَة + ـهُ — ʿāda, habit, custom (f., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'his habit'
انْتَهَوْا: intahaw, to reach, come to an end (verb VIII defective, perf. 3mp); 'they reached'
أَتَسَلَّلَ: atasallala, to slip in, creep (verb V, subj. 1s after أَنْ); 'that I creep'
أَطْلَعَ: aṭlaʿa, to go up, ascend (verb I, subj. 1s after أَنْ); 'that I go up'
وَأَنْظُرَ: وَ + أَنْظُرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + anẓura, to look (subj. 1s); 'and look'
الْمَشَائِخِ: الـ + مَشَائِخ — mashāʾikh, elders, sheikhs (broken pl. of شَيْخ; gen. after ilā); 'the elders'
أَسْمَعْ: asmaʿ, to hear (verb I, jussive 1s after lam); 'I have heard'
حِسًّا: ḥiss, sound, noise (m., acc. indef.); the print writes حسا; 'a sound'
شَجَرَةَ: shajara, tree (f., acc. in construct, object of raʾā); 'a tree of'
جَوْزٍ: jawz, walnut, nuts (m., gen. in construct); 'walnut'
جَعْفَرُأُ: جَعْفَرُ + أُ — Jaʿfar (vocative, nom. with damma) + the alif of the following أُرِيدُ (urīdu, 'I want'), which the print has attached to this word; 'O Jaʿfar, I …'
رِيدُ: ـرِيدُ — rīdu, the remainder of أُرِيدُ (urīdu, to want, verb IV hollow, imperf. 1s indic.), its alif having been printed on the previous word; 'want'
فُرُوعَهَا: فُرُوع + هَا — furūʿ, branches (broken pl. of فَرْع, m., acc. after inna) + 3fs poss.; 'its branches'
قَرِيبَةٌ: qarība, near, close (f. nom. indef., predicate; agreeing with the non-human plural); 'close'
الشُّبَا: الـ + شُبَا — al-shubā, the first part of الشبابيك (shubbāk, window, pl. shabābīk), as the print splits it; gen. after min; 'the windows'
بِيكِ: ـبِيكِ — bīki, the second part of شبابيك (al-shabābīk, windows), split from the previous word in the print; 'the windows'
يَتَعَلَّقُ: yataʿallaqu, to cling, hang on (verb V, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'clinging'
فَرْعٍ: farʿ, branch (m., gen. indef. after min / ilā); 'a branch'
يُقَابِلُ: yuqābilu, to face, be opposite (verb III, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'faces'
الشَّبَّاكَ: الـ + شَبَّاك — shabbāk, window (m., acc. object); 'the window'
وَصَبِيًّا: وَ + صَبِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣabiyy, boy, youth (m., acc. indef.); 'and a youth'
خَلَقَهُمَا: خَلَقَ + هُمَا — khalaqa, to create (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3rd dual obj.; 'created them both'
وَصَوَّرَ: وَ + صَوَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣawwara, to form, shape (verb II, perf. 3ms); the print has a shadda on the و; 'and formed'
الشُّرْبُ: الـ + شُّرْب — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of شَرِبَ, m., nom., subject); 'the drinking'
طَرَبٍ: ṭarab, delight, music (m., gen. indef.); 'delight, music'
فَلَاحٌ: falāḥ, success, well-being (m., nom. indef., predicate); 'success'
آدِرْهَا: آدِرْ + هَا — ādir, pass round! (imperative 2ms of ādara / adāra, verb IV, 'to pass round, make circulate') + 3fs obj. (the cup of wine); 'pass it round'
بِالْكَبِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + كَبِير — bi-, to, for (prep.; here marking those the cup is passed to) + al-kabīr, the great, the old (adj. used as noun, gen.); 'to the great'
وَبِالصَّغِيرِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + صَغِير — wa-, and (conj.) + bi-, to, for (as before) + al-ṣaghīr, the small, the young (gen.); 'and to the small'
وَخُذْهَا: وَ + خُذْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + khudh, take! (imperative 2ms of akhadha, verb I) + 3fs obj.; 'and take it'
تَشْرَبْ: tashrab, to drink (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā, prohibition); 'do not drink' (with the preceding وَلَا)
بِلَاطَرَبٍ: بِـ + لَا + طَرَب — bi-, with (prep.) + lā, no, without + ṭarab, delight, music (m., gen.); 'without music'; the print joins the words
فَانِي: فَـ + إِنِّي — fa-, for (conj.) + inna + 1s pron. ('indeed I'), printed without hamza and with a kasra on the alif; 'for I'
الْخَيْلَ: الـ + خَيْل — khayl, horses (collective, f., acc. as object); 'the horses'
بِالصَّفِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + صَّفِير — bi-, to, at (prep.) + al-ṣafīr, the whistle, whistling (m., gen.); 'to the whistle'
عَايَنَ: ʿāyana — he beheld, saw with his own eyes (verb III, perfect, 3rd m. sg.)
الصَّالِحِينَ: الـ + صَالِحِين — ṣāliḥ, righteous, pious (m. sound pl., acc. as object); 'the righteous'
فَاطْلَعْ: فَـ + اطْلَعْ — fa-, so, then (conj., introducing a command) + iṭlaʿ, go up, climb (verb I, imperative m. sg.); 'so climb'
تَفُوتَكَ: تَفُوتَ + كَ — tafūta, it escapes, passes (verb I, imperfect subj., 3rd f. sg., after li-allā) + -ka, you (obj.); 'lest it escape you'
بَرَكَاتُ: barakāt — blessings (f. pl. of baraka; nom., subject of tafūta; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَالْجَارِيَةَ: وَ + الـ + جَارِيَة — wa-, and + al-, the + jāriya, slave-girl, girl (f., acc. as object); 'and the girl'
الْقَدَحُ: الـ + قَدَح — qadaḥ, drinking cup, goblet (m., nom., subject of the clause); 'the cup'
الْحَالَةَ: الـ + حَالَة — ḥāla, state, condition, scene (f., acc. as object); 'the state'
وَنَزَلُو: وَ + نَزَلُو — wa-, and + nazala, he came down (verb I, perfect), printed with a stray final و; 'and he came down'
جَعَلَنَا: جَعَلَ + نَا — jaʿala, he made, appointed (verb I, perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'made us'
الْمُتَّبِعِينَ: الـ + مُتَّبِعِين — muttabiʿ, follower, adherent (active part. of verb VIII ittabaʿa; m. sound pl., gen. after min); 'the followers'
لِظَاهِرِ: لِـ + ظَاهِر — li-, a particle linking the participle to its object ('follow(ing) …') + ẓāhir, the outward part, the surface (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the outward of'
الشَّرِيعَةِ: الـ + شَرِيعَة — sharīʿa, the revealed law, the Law (f., gen.); 'the Law'
الْخَجَلِ: الـ + خَجَل — khajal, shame, embarrassment (m., gen.); 'the shame'
تَرِي: tarā — you see (verb I raʾā, imperfect 2nd m. sg.; the print here writes the final ā with ي); yā tarā, 'I wonder', literally 'O, you see'
أَدْخَلَهُمْ: أَدْخَلَ + هُمْ — adkhala, he made enter, let in (verb IV, perfect, 3rd m. sg.; takes two objects) + -hum, them; 'let them into'
عَيْنِى: عَيْن + ي — ʿayn, eye (f., nom., subject) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my eye'
جَعْفَرُوَقَدِ: جَعْفَرُ + وَ + قَدِ — Jaʿfaru, Jaʿfar (nom., subject of qāla) + wa-, and (circumstantial) + qadi, already, had (particle with a perfect, before the following verb); printed as one word; 'Jaʿfar — and he had …'
اسْتَرْجَى: istarjā — he hoped for, sought (verb X, perfect, 3rd m. sg.; the form is obscure, the sense 'sought, hoped for' is a guess from context)
رِضَاءَ: riḍāʾ — contentment, favour (m., acc. as object; the print spells riḍā with a hamza; first term of an iḍāfa)
هَرُونَ: Hārūn — Aaron / Harun, a personal name (diptote, gen. in apposition; printed without alif)
اطْلَعْ: iṭlaʿ — go up, climb (verb I, imperative m. sg.)
مُقَابِلُهُمْ: مُقَابِل + هُمْ — muqābil, facing, opposite (active part. of verb III qābala; m., nom.) + -hum, them; 'facing them'
لِنَتَفَرَّجَ: لِـ + نَتَفَرَّجَ — li-, so that (introducing purpose) + natafarraja, we take our ease, look on for pleasure (verb V, imperfect subj., 1st pl.); 'so that we may look on at leisure'
الْاِثْنَانِ: الـ + اثْنَانِ — ithnān, two (m. dual numeral, nom.); 'the two'
وَنَظَرَا: وَ + نَظَرَا — wa-, and + naẓarā, they two looked (verb I, perfect, 3rd m. dual); 'and the two looked'
فَسَمِعَا: فَـ + سَمِعَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + samiʿā, they two heard (verb I, perfect, 3rd m. dual); 'and heard'
الْوَقَارَ: الـ + وَقَار — waqār, dignity, gravity (m., acc. as object); 'the dignity'
الْعُقَارِ: الـ + عُقَار — ʿuqār, wine (m., gen.); 'the wine'
وَلَايَلَذُّ: وَ + لَا + يَلَذُّ — wa-, and + lā, not (negative) + yaladhdhu, it is sweet, pleasant (verb I, imperfect, 3rd m. sg.); printed as one word; 'and it is not pleasant'
إِلَّابِنَغَمَاتِ: إِلَّا + بِـ + نَغَمَات — illā, except (particle of exception) + bi-, with (prep.; 'except with') + naghamāt, notes, melodies (f. pl. of naghma; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); printed as one word; 'except with the notes of'
مُرُورُنَا: مُرُور + نَا — murūr, passing (verbal noun of marra; m., nom.; the print's reading, probably a slip for surūr, delight) + -nā, our; 'our passing / our (delight)'
أَيْشِ: ayshi — what? (colloquial contraction of ayyu shayʾin, 'which thing?')
عُودُ: ʿūd — lute (m., nom. as predicate; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the lute of'
إِسْحَاقَ: Isḥāq — Isaac, a personal name (diptote, gen.); kunya Abū Isḥāq
النَّدِيمِ: الـ + نَدِيم — nadīm, boon-companion, drinking-companion at court (m., gen. in apposition); 'the boon-companion'
غَنَّتْ: ghannat — she sang (verb II, perfect, 3rd f. sg.; after in, 'if she sings')
وَحْشًا: waḥsh — wild, coarse, ugly (m., acc., here adverbial after ghannat: 'sings badly'); 'ugly(ly)'
لَأَصْلُبَنَّكُمْ: لَ + أَصْلُبَنَّ + كُمْ — la-, the oath particle opening the result clause + aṣlubanna, I will crucify (verb I, imperfect with the emphatic nūn, 1st sg.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I will surely crucify you'
كُلَّكُمْ: كُلّ + كُمْ — kull, all, the whole (m., acc. in emphatic apposition) + -kum, you (pl.); 'all of you'
وَأَصْلُبُكَ: وَ + أَصْلُبُ + كَ — wa-, and + aṣlubu, I crucify (verb I, imperfect, 1st sg.) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'and I will crucify you'
اجْعَلْهَا: اجْعَلْ + هَا — ijʿal, make (verb I, imperative m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'make her'
تَصْلُبَنَا: تَصْلُبَ + نَا — taṣluba, you crucify (verb I, imperfect subj., 2nd m. sg., after an) + -nā, us; 'that you crucify us'
كُلَّنَا: كُلّ + نَا — kull, all (m., acc. in emphatic apposition) + -nā, us; 'all of us'
نُؤْنِسُ: nuʾnisu — we keep company with, we give companionship to (verb IV, imperfect, 1st pl.); printed with ؤ
الْبَعْضَ: الـ + بَعْض — baʿḍ, some, part (m., acc., object); 'the other'; baʿḍunā al-baʿḍa, 'each other'
وَافْتَقَدَتْهُ: وَ + افْتَقَدَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + iftaqadat, she examined, inspected (verb VIII, perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and examined it'
وَأَصْلَحَتْ: وَ + أَصْلَحَتْ — wa-, and + aṣlaḥat, she put right, tuned (verb IV, perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and tuned'
تَارَهُ: تَار + هُ — the second part of the split word awtār (pl. of watar, string; acc. as object), with -hu, its; read together with the preceding word, 'its strings'
فَتَشَوَّقَتِ: فَـ + تَشَوَّقَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tashawwaqat, she was stirred with longing (verb V, perfect, 3rd f. sg.; kasra before the following al-)
شِعْ—رًا: shiʿran — verse, poetry (m., acc., tanwīn; the print breaks the word with a dash: شع—را); 'in verse'
نَاصِرِينَ: nāṣirīna — helpers, supporters (active part. of nāṣara/naṣara; m. sound pl., voc.); 'O helpers'
مَسَاكِينَا: masākīnā — poor ones, wretches (pl. of miskīn; here with a rhyme alif, acc. in apposition); 'poor wretches'
مُحِبِّينَا: muḥibbīnā — lovers (active part. of verb IV aḥabba; m. sound pl., with a rhyme alif); 'lovers'
الْاَشْوَاقِ: الـ + أَشْوَاق — ashwāq, longings, passions (pl. of shawq; m., gen., joined by wa- to al-maḥabba); 'the longings'
تَكْوِينَا: takwīnā — it brands us (verb I kawā, imperfect 3rd f. sg. takwī, 'brands, sears' + -nā, us, with a lengthened rhyme vowel); 'it brands us'
فَعَلْتُمْ: faʿaltum — you did (verb I, perfect, 2nd m. pl.); 'you do'
فَكُنَّا: فَـ + كُنَّا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + kunnā, we were (verb I kāna, perfect, 1st pl.); 'so we were'
مُسْتَحِقِّينَا: mustaḥiqqīnā — deserving (active part. of verb X istaḥaqqa; m. sound pl., acc. predicate with rhyme alif); 'deserving'
اسْجُرْنَا: usjurnā — we are set ablaze (verb I sajara, 'to kindle, fire up', as printed: passive 1st pl. perhaps for usjirnā); 'we are kindled'
تَشْمُتُوا: tashmutū — you gloat (verb I shamita, imperfect jussive after lā, 2nd m. pl.); lā tashmutū fīnā, 'do not gloat over us'
فَاِنَّنَا: فَـ + إِنَّ + نَا — fa-, for (conj.) + inna, indeed + -nā, we; 'for indeed we'
اَهْلُ: ahl — people, folk, possessors (m., nom., predicate; first term of an iḍāfa); 'people of'
مَسْكَنَةٍ: maskana — wretchedness, poverty, helplessness (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'wretchedness'
تَشَاءُوهُ: تَشَاءُو + هُ — tashāʾū, you wish (verb I shāʾa, imperfect, 2nd m. pl., after mahmā) + -hu, it; 'you wish (it)'
فَافْعَلُوا: فَـ + افْعَلُوا — fa-, so (conj., introducing a command) + ifʿalū, do (verb I, imperative 2nd m. pl.); 'so do'
الْفَخْرُ: الـ + فَخْر — fakhr, boast, glory, pride (m., nom.); 'the glory'
تَقْتُلُوْنَا: تَقْتُلُو + نَا — taqtulū, you kill (verb I, imperfect subj., 2nd m. pl., after an) + -nā, us; 'that you kill us'
مَنَازِلِكُمْ: مَنَازِل + كُمْ — manāzil, dwellings, houses (pl. of manzil; m., gen. after fī) + -kum, your; 'your dwellings'
وَاِنَّمَا: وَ + إِنَّمَا — wa-, and + innamā, but, only (limiting particle); 'but only'
خَوْفُنَا: خَوْف + نَا — khawf, fear (m., nom.) + -nā, our; 'our fear'
تَا: tā — the first part of ta'thamū (you incur sin), printed as a separate word; read with the next word
ثَمُوا: thamū — the second part of the split word taʾthamū, from verb V taʾaththama, 'to incur sin'; read together with the preceding word, 'you sin'
نَقَالَ: نَقَالَ — print's ن for ف, read as فَـ + قَالَ: fa-, and (conj.) + qāla, to say (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he said'; vocalised on the letters as printed
مَاسَمِعْتُ: مَا + سَمِعْتُ — mā, not (neg.) + samiʿtu, to hear (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I have not heard'; printed as one word
صَوْتًا: ṣawt — voice, sound (m., acc. indef., object of 'heard'); 'a voice'
مُطْرِبًا: muṭrib — delighting, enrapturing (act. part. of verb IV aṭraba, from ṭarab, delight in song; m., acc. indef., adj.); 'delighting'
وَاجْلِسَ: وَ + اجْلِسَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlisa, to sit (verb I, impf. 1s subj., continuing after an); 'and sit'
وَاسْمَعَ: وَ + اسْمَعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + asmaʿa, to hear (verb I samiʿa, impf. 1s subj. after an); 'and hear'
فُدَّامِي: فُدَّام + ـِي — print's ف for ق, read qudām (colloquial): in front of, before (prep./adv.) + -ī, me; 'before me, in front of me'
طَلَعْتَ: ṭalaʿta — to go up (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you go up'
رُبَّمَــا: rubba + mā — rubbamā, perhaps, it may be that (particle); printed with kashida strokes
تَكَدَّرُوا: takaddarū — to be clouded, troubled (verb V, impf. 3mp; the final nūn is missing in the print); 'they may be put out'
فَيَمُـــوتُ: فَـ + يَمُوتُ — fa-, then (answering ammā) + yamūtu, to die (verb I hollow, impf. 3ms indic.); 'then he will die'; printed with kashida strokes
أَتَحَيَّلَ: ataḥayyala — to contrive, use a ruse (verb V, impf. 1s subj. after an); 'that I contrive'
وَأَدْخُلَ: وَ + أَدْخُلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + adkhula, to enter (verb I, impf. 1s subj.); 'and enter'
يَشْعُرُ: yashʿuru — to perceive, notice (verb I, impf. 3mp): the first half of يشعروا yashʿurū, split by the print; the plural ending is printed at the start of the next token; here: a whole word: yashʿuru, 3ms impf. indic., 'is aware'; shaʿara bi-, 'to be aware of', the verb choosing bi-
وابِي: وا + بِـ + ـِي — wā, the plural ending -ū with its silent alif, printed apart from يَشْعُرُ + bi-, (shaʿara) of / at the thing noticed (the verb takes bi-) + -ī, me; 'they notice me'
وَجَعْفَرَ: وَ + جَعْفَر — wa-, and (conj.) + Jaʿfar (proper name, m., acc. as part of the subject after inna; bare fatḥa, as the print has no alif for the tanwīn)
ذَهَبَا: dhahabā — to go (verb I, perf. 3 dual); 'the two went'
مُتَفَكِّرَانِ: mutafakkirān — pondering, reflecting (act. part. of verb V; m. dual nom., ḥāl); 'both pondering'
بِصَيَّادٍ: بِـ + صَيَّاد — bi- (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears, 'and behold, a fisherman') + ṣayyād, fisherman (m., gen. indef.)
اقِفٍ: اقِف — āqif, the second part of واقف wāqif, standing (act. part. of verb I, m., gen. indef., adj.), whose opening و the print has split off; 'standing'
يَصْطَادُ: yaṣṭādu — to fish, hunt (verb VIII, impf. 3ms indic.); 'fishing'
شَبَابِيكِ: shabābīk — windows, lattices (m. broken pl. of shubbāk; gen. in an iḍāfa after taḥta); 'windows of'
الْحِسُّ: الـ + حِسّ — ḥiss, sound, noise (m., nom.); 'the noise'
صَوْتُ: ṣawt — voice, sound (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the voice of'
صَيَّادِينَ: ṣayyād — fisherman (m. sound pl. ṣayyādīn, gen. in the iḍāfa; the nūn is kept)
وَامْنَعْهُمْ: وَ + امْنَعْ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + imnaʿ, to prevent, forbid (verb I, imper. 2ms) + -hum, them; 'and keep them away'
فَامْتَنَعَتِ: فَـ + امْتَنَعَتِ — fa-, so (conj. of sequence) + imtanaʿat, to refrain, keep away (verb VIII, perf. 3fs, kasra for sandhi before al-); a feminine verb with a plural subject
الصَّيَّادُونَ: الـ + صَيَّادُون — ṣayyād, fisherman (m. sound pl., nom., subject); 'the fishermen'
اِغْتَنِمْ: ightanim — to seize, profit by (verb VIII, imper. 2ms; or أَغْتَنِمُ 'I will seize'); 'seize!'
صَيْدَ: ṣayd — catching, hunting (m., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the catching of'
اقِفَ: اقِف — āqif, the second part of واقف wāqif, standing (act. part. of verb I, m., acc., ḥāl; the print has no alif for the tanwīn), whose opening و the print splits off; 'standing'
فَعَرَفَهُ: فَـ + عَرَفَ + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he recognised him'
يَاكَرِيمُ: يَا + كَرِيم — yā, O (vocative particle) + Karīm, proper name (m., nom.); printed as one word
يُسَمِّيهِ: yusammī + hi — samma, to name, call (verb II, impf. 3ms) + -hi, him; 'naming him'
سْمِهِ: (i)sm + hi — ism, name (m., gen. after bi-) + -hi, his; the second half of بِاسْمِهِ
أَمِيرَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — amīr, commander (m., acc. in the vocative) + al-muʾminīn, the believers (m. sound pl., gen.); 'O Commander of the Faithful'; printed as one word
اسْتِهْزَاءً: istihzāʾ — mockery, ridicule (m., acc. indef.; maṣdar of verb X, used adverbially); 'in mockery'
بِالْمَرْسُومِ: بِـ + الـ + مَرْسُوم — bi-, of, towards (prep., here with istihzāʾ 'mockery of') + marsūm, decree, edict (m., pass. part.; gen.); 'of the decree'
وَلَٰكِنِ: وَ + لَٰكِنِ — wa-, and (conj.) + lākin, but (conj.; the dagger alif supplies the missing alif, the kasra is sandhi before al-); 'but'
الْفَقْرُ: الـ + فَقْر — faqr, poverty (m., nom.); 'the poverty'
وَالْعَيْلَةُ: وَ + الـ + عَيْلَة — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿayla, want, neediness (f., nom.); 'and the want'
حَمَلَانِي: ḥamalā + nī — ḥamala, to carry, impel (verb I, perf. 3 dual) + -nī, me; 'the two have driven me'
اِصْطَلْ: iṣṭal — as printed; probably a slip for اِصْطَدْ iṣṭad, 'fish!' (verb VIII, imper. 2ms)
حَدَّهَا: حَدّ + هَا — ḥadd, limit, extent (m., acc., object) + -hā, its; 'its limit'
الْقَرَارِ: الـ + قَرَار — qarār, bottom, resting place (m., gen. after fī); 'the bottom'
كَرِيمُ: Karīm — proper name (m., nom. in the vocative after yā)
جُبَّةٌ: jubba — gown, long outer robe (f., nom. indef.)
رُقْعَةٍ: ruqʿa — patch (f., gen. indef., second term of the iḍāfa); 'of patch'
الصُّوفِ: الـ + صُوف — ṣūf, wool (m., gen. after min); 'the wool'
الْخَشِنِ: الـ + خَشِن — khashin, rough, coarse (adj., m., gen., agreeing with ṣūf); 'the coarse'
الْقَمْلِ: الـ + قَمْل — qaml, lice (coll. m., gen. after min); 'the lice'
الْمُذْنِبِ: الـ + مُذْنِب — mudhnib, offending, sinful (act. part. of verb IV; m., gen., adj.); 'the sinful'; possibly مُذَنَّب 'tailed'
ثَلَٰثُ: thalāth — three (m./f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); the dagger alif supplies the missing alif of ثلاث
حَلَّهَا: حَلَّ + هَا — ḥalla, to untie, undo (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the turban); 'he undid it'
إِلَّاكُلَّ: إِلَّا + كُلَّ — illā, except (particle) + kulla, every (m., acc. adverbial); 'except every time'; printed as one word
خِرْقَةً: khirqa — rag, scrap of cloth (f., acc. indef., object); 'a rag'
خَيَّطَهَا: خَيَّطَ + هَا — khayyaṭa, to sew (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it; 'he sewed it'
الْجُبَّةَ: الـ + جُبَّة — jubba, gown, long outer robe (f., acc., object); 'the gown'
وَالْعِمَامَةَ: وَ + الـ + عِمَامَة — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿimāma, turban (f., acc., object); 'and the turban'
ثَوْبَيْنِ: thawb — garment (m. dual thawbayn, acc. object); 'two garments'
سَكَنْدَرِيٍّ: sakandariyy — of Alexandria (nisba adj., m., gen. indef., apposition); the print lacks the initial alif of إسكندري; 'Alexandrian'
وَبَعْلَبَكِّيٍّ: وَ + بَعْلَبَكِّيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + baʿlabakkiyy, of Baalbek (nisba adj., m., gen. indef.); 'and a Baalbeki'
وَمَلُوطَةً: وَ + مَلُوطَة — wa-, and (conj.) + malūṭa, a kind of outer cloak (f., acc. indef.); 'and a cloak'
وَفَرَجِيَّةً: وَ + فَرَجِيَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + farajiyya, a long robe with wide sleeves (f., acc. indef.); 'and a robe'
وَالْبَسْهُمْ: وَ + الْبَسْ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ilbas, to wear, put on (verb I labisa, imper. 2ms) + -hum, them; 'and put them on'
جُبَّةَ: jubba — gown, long outer robe (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the gown of'
وَعِمَامَتَهُ: وَ + عِمَامَة + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿimāma, turban (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his turban'
لِثَامَ: lithām — face-veil (m., acc. indef.; the print has no alif for the tanwīn, so bare fatḥa); 'a veil'
شُغْلِكَ: شُغْل + كَ — shughl, work, business (m., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your; 'your business'
رِجْلَ: rijl — foot (f., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the foot of'
وَشَكَرَهُ: وَ + شَكَرَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he thanked him'
نُعْمَى: nuʿmā — favour, benefit, boon (f., indef.); 'a boon'
ابُوحُ: abūḥu — to divulge, declare openly (verb I bāḥa, hollow, impf. 1s); the print marks the damma on the bare alif
بِشُكْرِهَا: بِـ + شُكْر + هَا — bi-, with, for (prep.; bāḥa takes bi- for the thing declared) + shukr, thanks (m., gen.) + -hā, its; 'of its thanks'
وَكَفَيْتَنِي: وَ + كَفَيْتَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + kafayta, to suffice, spare (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'and you spared me'
بِاَسْرِهَا: بِـ + أَسْر + هَا — bi-, in, with (prep.) + asr, binding, capture (m., gen.) + -hā, its; bi-asrihā, idiom 'in their entirety, all together'; the print has a plain alif with fatḥa
شَكَرْتَنَّكَ: shakartanna-ka — as printed, a perfect 2ms with energetic nūn and -ka, 'you'; read as فَلَأَشْكُرَنَّكَ la-ashkuranna-ka, 'I shall surely thank you' (verb I shakara)
حَيِيتُ: ḥayītu — to live (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I live' (with the mā of duration, 'as long as I live')
امُتْ: amut — to die (verb I hollow māta, impf. 1s jussive after in); the print marks the damma on the bare alif; 'I die'
شَكَرْتُكَ: شَكَرْتُ + كَ — shakartu, to thank (verb I, perf. 1s) + -ka, you; 'I (have) thanked you'
اعْظُمِي: aʿẓum + ī — aʿẓum, bones (broken pl. of ʿaẓm; m.) + -ī, my; 'my bones'; the print gives a plain alif
قَبْرِهَا: قَبْر + هَا — qabr, grave (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, its; 'their grave' Also -hā 'her': ilā qabrihā, 'to her grave'.
دَبَّ: dabba — to creep, crawl (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'crept'
الْقَمْلُ: الـ + قَمْل — qaml, lice (coll. m., nom., subject); 'the lice'
وَالشِّمَالِ: وَ + الـ + شِمَال — wa-, and (conj.) + shimāl, left (adj.; gen., apposition); 'and the left'
وَيَرْمِيهِ: وَ + يَرْمِي + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + yarmī, to throw (verb I, impf. 3ms, final-weak) + -hi, it (the lice, a collective); 'and throwing them'
قَمْلٌ: qaml — lice (coll. m., nom. indef., predicate); 'lice'
الْجُبَّةِ: الـ + جُبَّة — jubba, gown (f., gen. after fī); 'the gown'
تُحِسُّ: tuḥissu — to feel, sense (verb IV, impf. 2ms, doubled root); 'you feel'
تَتَعَلَّمَ: tataʿallama — to learn (verb V, impf. 2ms subj. after an); 'that you learn'
الصَّيْدَ: الـ + صَيْد — ṣayd, fishing, hunting (m., acc., object); 'the fishing'
صَنْعَةٌ: ṣanʿa — craft, trade (f., nom. indef.); 'a craft'
تَنْفَعُكَ: تَنْفَعُ + كَ — tanfaʿu, to benefit, profit (verb I, impf. 3fs) + -ka, you; 'that profits you'
فَيُنَا: فَـ + يُنَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + yunā, the first piece of يُنَاسِبُ yunāsibu, to suit (verb III), split by the print; completed by the next token
سِبُكَ: (yunā)sibu + ka — the rest of يُنَاسِبُكَ: -sibu (impf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'it suits you'
الْجُبَّةُ: الـ + جُبَّة — jubba, gown (f., nom., subject of yunāsibu); 'the gown'
أَحْسَنْتَ: أَحْسَنْتَ — aḥsanta, you did well (IV aḥsana, 2ms perfect; precomposed أ as printed in the verse); 'you did well'
أَنْمُلُهَا: أَنْمُل + هَا — anmula, fingertip (pl. of unmula; m., nom., subject of masakat; the print has precomposed أ) + her; 'her fingertips'
السَّارِقِ: الـ + سَارِق — sāriq, thief (act. part. of saraqa; m., gen., adj. of al-liṣṣ); 'the robber'
السَّمَاعَ: الـ + سَمَاع — samāʿ, hearing, listening (m., acc., predicate of kāna's negated clause after illā); 'the hearing'
الْبَرَكَةِ: الـ + بَرَكَة — baraka, blessing (f., gen. second term of iḍāfa after ḥasab); 'the blessing'
الْجَسِّ: الـ + جَسّ — jass, touch, feeling with the fingers (verbal noun of jassa; m., gen. after ʿinda); 'the touch'
الْخُضْرَةِ: الـ + خُضْرَة — khuḍra, greenery, green stuff (f., gen. after min); 'the greenery'
الْخُونِيِّ: الـ + خُونِيّ — khūniyy, of uncertain meaning; read as a nisba, perhaps 'of the table' (khwān); 'the khūnī'
الْعَمِيمَةِ: الـ + عَمِيمَة — ʿamīm, abundant, all-embracing (f. adj., gen., agreeing with tafaḍḍulāt); 'the abundant'
الْفَقْرِ: الـ + فَقْر — faqr, poverty (m., gen. second term of iḍāfa); 'the poverty'
الْمَكَانُونَ: الـ + مَكَانُون — makānūn, as printed, apparently the hearth or brazier (cf. kānūn); acc. object of taqaddama; 'the hearth'
الْمَوْزِ: الـ + مَوْز — mawz, banana (collective, m., gen. second term of iḍāfa); 'the banana'
الْمُقَا: الـ + مُقَا — the beginning of al-muqāmir, 'the gambler', cut by the line-break (the ending -mir is printed with the next word); 'the gambler' (in part)
اِعْذُرْنِي: اعْذُرْ + نِي — ʿadhara, to excuse (I; imperative 2ms) + me (1sg. object suffix); 'excuse me'
اِنْجُ: اِنْجُ — inju, save yourself, escape! (imperative 2ms of najā); 'save'
أَتَيْتَنَا: أَتَيْتَ + نَا — atā, to come (perfect 2ms) + us (1pl. object); with bi- (see bi-faḍīla) 'you brought us'; 'you came to us'
أَرْنَا: أَرِ + نَا — arā, to show (IV; imperative 2ms, the print marks fatḥa on the alif) + us (1pl. object); 'show us'
أَسْمَعَهَا: أَسْمَعَ + هَا — samiʿa, to hear (imperfect 1sg., subj. after ḥattā) + her (3fs object); 'I hear her'
أَصْلَحَتْ: أَصْلَحَتْ — aṣlaḥat, she set right, tuned (IV perfect 3fs); 'she tuned'
أَضْيَافًا: أَضْيَاف — ḍayf, guest (m., broken pl. aḍyāf, acc. with tanwīn, object of the idea of 'have': inna ʿindaka); 'guests'
أَقْلِيهِ: أَقْلِي + هِ — qalā, to fry (imperfect 1sg., indicative) + him/it (3ms object); 'I fry it'
بِالسَّلَامِ: بِـ + الـ + سَلَام — bi-, with (prep.; ibtadaʾa bi- 'begin with') + al-salām, peace, greeting (m., gen.); 'with the greeting' Also after awmaʾa ilā, bi- marks what the sign conveys: awmaʾat ilayhi bi-al-salāmi, 'she signed a greeting to him'.
بِاللِّصِّ: بِـ + الـ + لِصّ — bi-, to (prep., as in ahlan bi- 'welcome to') + al-liṣṣ, thief (m., gen.); 'to the thief'
بِالْحَيَوٰةِ: بِـ + الـ + حَيَوٰة — bi-, with (prep.; after fa-idhā it only marks what appears) + al-ḥayāh, life (f., gen.; print's spelling with wāw, dagger alif for ā); 'behold, with life, alive'
بِفَضِيلَةٍ: بِـ + فَضِيلَة — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- 'bring') + faḍīla, excellence, favour (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'with a favour'
تَفَضُّلَاتِكَ: تَفَضُّلَات + كَ — tafaḍḍul, favour, graciousness (verbal noun of V; f. sound pl., gen. after min) + your; 'your favours'
جَعَلَهُ: جَعَلَ + هُ — jaʿala, to put, make (perfect 3ms) + him/it (3ms object); 'he put it'
حَاضِرْ: حَاضِر — ḥāḍir, present, ready (act. part.; colloquial 'at your service'); 'at hand'
حَسَبِ: حَسَب — ḥasab, measure, according to (m., gen. after ʿalā; ʿalā ḥasab 'according to'); 'according to'
خَاطِرِ: خَاطِر — khāṭir, mind, feelings, heart (m., gen. second term of min shān khāṭir); 'the feelings of'
خَرَسُ: خَرَس — kharas, dumbness (m., nom. subject of bihi); 'dumbness'
خَفِيفًا: خَفِيف — khafīf, light, gentle (adj. m., acc. of ṭarqan); 'light'
خُصِّ: خُصّ — khuṣṣ, hut, shed (m., gen. first term of iḍāfa after ilā); 'the hut of'
رَأَكَ: رَأَى + كَ — raʾā, to see (perfect 3ms; print has precomposed أ) + you (2ms object); 'he sees you'
رَقَبَتُكَ: رَقَبَة + كَ — raqaba, neck (f., nom., subject of rāḥat) + your; 'your neck'
رَمَاهُمْ: رَمَى + هُمْ — ramā, to throw (perfect 3ms) + them (3mpl. object); 'he threw them'
سِيرَةَ: سِيرَة — sīra, tale, account, mention (f., acc., object of samiʿa; first term of iḍāfa); 'the mention of'
صَمَمُ: صَمَم — ṣamam, deafness (m., nom. subject of bihi); 'deafness'
طَالَبُوا: طَالَبُوا — ṭālabū, they demanded (III ṭālaba, perfect 3mpl.); 'they demanded'
طَرْقًا: طَرْقًا — ṭarqan, a knock, knocking (acc. with tanwīn, cognate accusative of ṭaraqa); 'a knocking'
عَرَفْتَنِي: عَرَفْتَ + نِي — ʿarafa, to know (perfect 2ms) + me (1sg. object); 'you knew me'
غَسَلُوا: غَسَلُوا — ghasalū, they washed (perfect 3mpl. of ghasala); 'they washed'
غَنِّي: غَنِّي — ghannī, sing! (II imperative 2fs of ghannā); 'sing'
غِنَاهَا: غِنَاء + هَا — ghināʾ, singing, song (m., nom., subject of abrā) + her; 'her song'
فَابْرَى: فَـ + ابْرَى — fa-, and so (conj. of result) + abrā, healed (IV abraʾa, perfect 3ms; the print has a bare alif, no hamza); 'and healed'
فَأَرَاهُمْ: فَـ + أَرَى + هُمْ — fa-, and so + arā: (1) arā, I see (verb I raʾā, imperf. 1s), 'so I see them'; or (2) arā, he showed (verb IV perf. 3ms), 'and he showed them'
قَلْيًا: قَلْي — qalī, frying (verbal noun of qalā; m., acc. cognate accusative); 'a frying'
كَرِيمٌ: كَرِيم — Karīm, personal name, 'generous' (m., nom. predicate of anna); 'Karīm'
لِأَيْشْ: لِـ + أَيْشْ — li-, for (prep.) + aysh, what? (colloquial for ayyu shayʾin); 'why' (lit. 'for what')
لِلْعُودِ: لِـ + الـ + عُود — li-, on, at (prep.; masaka li- 'grip') + al-ʿūd, the lute (m., gen.); 'upon the lute'
مَرَارَةَ: مَرَارَة — marāra, bitterness, gall (f., acc., object of nazaʿtu; first term of iḍāfa); 'the bitterness of'
مَسَكَتْ: مَسَكَتْ — masakat, she/it gripped, held (perfect 3fs; subject anmuluhā); 'gripped'
مَقْلِيٌّ: مَقْلِيّ — maqliyy, fried (pass. part. of qalā; m., nom., printed without a final alif); 'fried'
مُرَادُ: مُرَاد — murād, aim, intention (pass. part./verbal noun of IV arāda; m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the aim of'
مِرْتَعَالَ: مِرْ + تَعَالَ — mir, the last two letters of al-muqāmir, 'gambler' (cut off by the line-break) + taʿāla, come! (VI imperative 2ms); 'come!'
مِقْطَفَ: مِقْطَف — miqṭaf, basket for gathering (m., acc., object of akhadha; first term of iḍāfa); 'the basket of'
نَزَعْتُ: نَزَعْتُ — nazaʿtu, I removed, pulled out (perfect 1sg. of nazaʿa); 'I removed'
نَظَرُوهُ: نَظَرُوا + هُ — naẓarū, they looked (perfect 3mpl.) + it (3ms object, used directly); 'they looked at it'
نَفْيًا: نَفْي — nafy, as printed, apparently a garden herb (perhaps mint); acc. with tanwīn, object of akhadha; 'nafy'
هَانَّهُ: هَا + إِنَّ + هُ — hā, lo, behold (particle) + inna-hu, indeed it (alif lost in the print); 'here it is'
وَاقْلِهِ: وَ + اقْلِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iqli, fry! (imperative 2ms of qalā) + it (3ms object); 'and fry it'
وَالزَّعْفَرَانَ: وَ + الـ + زَعْفَرَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-zaʿfarān, saffron (m., acc.); 'and the saffron'
وَالصَّعْتَرَ: وَ + الـ + صَعْتَر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ṣaʿtar, thyme (colloquial for zaʿtar; m., acc.); 'and the thyme'
وَأَجِيئُهُ: وَ + أَجِيئُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajīʾu, I come, bring (imperfect 1sg. of jāʾa; ʾ as printed) + it (3ms object); 'and I bring it'
وَإِيَّاكَ: وَ + إِيَّا + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + iyyā, carrier of a pronoun (here 'you', after wa-) + you (2ms); 'and you' Also (Night 196): وَ + إِيَّا + ـكَ — wa-, and + iyyā, carrier of an object pronoun + 2ms; with an, 'beware of (doing)'; 'and beware'
وَبَاسَهُمْ: وَ + بَاسَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + bāsa, he kissed (perfect 3ms) + them (3mpl. object); 'and kissed them'
وَتُرْبَةِ: وَ + تُرْبَة — wa-, by (wāw of oath, governing the genitive) + turba, grave, tomb (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'and by the grave of'
وَرَقِ: وَرَق — waraq, leaf, leaves (collective, m., gen. after ʿalā; first term of iḍāfa); 'the leaves of'
وَعَلَّقَ: وَ + عَلَّقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿallaqa, he hung, set up (II perfect 3ms); 'and set'
وَغَادَةٍ: وَ + غَادَة — wa-, and (many) a (wāw of rubba) + ghāda, lovely girl, soft-bodied young woman (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'and many a lovely girl'
وَقَلَاهُ: وَ + قَلَا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qalā, he fried (perfect 3ms) + it (3ms object); 'and fried it'
وَهَاتِهِ: وَ + هَاتِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + hāti, bring! (colloquial imperative 2ms) + it (3ms object); 'and bring it'
يَاجَعْفَرُ: يَا + جَعْفَرُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Jaʿfar (nom. vocative); 'O Jaʿfar'
يَاصَيَّادُ: يَا + صَيَّادُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + ṣayyād, fisherman (nom. vocative); 'O fisherman'
يَسْمَعَكِ: يَسْمَعَ + كِ — yasmaʿa, he hear (imperfect 3ms, subj. after an) + you (2fs object); 'he hear you'
يَعْرِفُنِي: يَعْرِفُ + نِي — yaʿrifu, he knows (imperfect 3ms) + me (1sg. object); 'he know me'
يَقْلِيهِ: يَقْلِي + هِ — yaqlī, he fries (imperfect 3ms of qalā) + it (3ms object); 'fries it'
ضَرَبَتْ: ضَرَبَ — ḍaraba, strike, play (an instrument) (I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she struck / played'
بَدِيعًا: بَدِيع — badīʿ, wondrous, novel, marvellous (adj., m., acc. with tanwīn, agreeing with ḍarban)
أَذْهَلَتِ: أَذْهَلَ — adhhala, bewilder, stupefy (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); the final -i is a helping vowel before al-; 'she bewildered'
الْأَبْيَاتِ: الـ + أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses, lines of poetry (pl. of bayt; gen. in apposition to hādhihi); 'the verses'
شِعْـــرَ: شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry, verse (m., acc. bare, no tanwīn written); 'in verse'. The print stretches the word and gives no final alif
وَلَقَــدْ: وَ + لَقَدْ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-qad, indeed (emphatic lām + qad, particle of certainty before a perfect); 'and indeed'. The print stretches the word with a tatweel
شُرِفْنَا: شَرُفَ — sharufa, be noble, honoured (I, perf. passive 1 pl. shurifnā, impersonal-passive, 'we have been honoured')
اَرْضَنَا: أَرْض + نَا — arḍ, land, earth (f., acc., object of nazaltum) + -nā, our; 'our land'
وَمَحَا: وَ + مَحَا — wa-, and (conj.) + maḥā, efface, wipe out (I, perf. 3 m. sg., defective verb); 'and it effaced'
سَنَاكُمْ: سَنًا + كُمْ — sanā, radiance, brightness (m., nom., subject; alif maqṣūra) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your radiance'
ظُلْمَةَ: ظُلْمَة — ẓulma, darkness (f., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa)
الدَّيْجُورِ: الـ + دَيْجُور — daymūr/daywūr, pitch-dark night, gloom (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'the gloom'
فَحَقٌّ: فَـ + حَقّ — fa-, so, then (conj., introducing a consequence) + ḥaqq, right, due, fitting (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate placed first); 'so it is right'
اُخَلِّقُ: خَلَّقَ — khallaqa, perfume with khalūq, anoint with perfume (II, imperf. 1 sg. indic.); 'I perfume'
وَالْمَا: وَ + الـ + مَا(ء) — wa-, and + al-, the + mā', water (m., gen.; the print omits the hamza); first term of 'rose-water'; 'and the water'
وَرْدِ: وَرْد — ward, rose (m., gen.); second term of an iḍāfa with al-mā, 'rose-water'
الْكَافُورِ: الـ + كَافُور — kāfūr, camphor (m., gen.); 'the camphor'
وَغَلَبَ: وَ + غَلَبَ — wa-, and + ghalaba, overcome, prevail (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it overcame'
الْوَجْدُ: الـ + وَجْد — wajd, ecstasy, passion, transport (m., nom., subject); 'the ecstasy'
يَتَمَالَكْ: تَمَالَكَ — tamālaka, contain oneself, keep control (VI, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam); 'he did not contain'
أَعْجَبَتْكَ: أَعْجَبَ + كَ — aʿjaba, please, delight (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -ka, you (m. sg., object); 'she pleased you'
هِبَةَ: هِبَة — hiba, gift (f., acc. as a cognate/absolute accusative, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the gift of'
كَرِيمٍ: كَرِيم — karīm, generous, noble (adj. used as noun, m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa); 'of a generous man'
لَايُرَدُّ: لَا + يُرَدُّ — lā, not (negation) + radda, turn back, refuse (I, imperf. passive 3 m. sg.); the print joins the two words; 'who is not turned back'
عَطَائِهِ: عَطَاء + هِ — ʿaṭāʾ, giving, gift (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his giving'. The print gives the hamza on a yāʾ-seat
هِبَتِهِ: هِبَة + هِ — hiba, gift (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his gift' (with rajaʿa fī, 'take back his gift')
مُلُوطَةً: مُلُوطَة — mulūṭa, a cloak, mantle (f., acc. with tanwīn, object); the word is rare
وَرَمَاهَا: وَ + رَمَى + هَا — wa-, and + ramā, throw (I, perf. 3 m. sg., defective) + -hā, it/her (3 f. sg., object, the cloak); 'and he threw it'
وَيَرُوحَ: وَ + رَاحَ — wa-, and + rāḥa, go off, depart (I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an); 'and go off'
وَدَاعٍ: وَدَاع — wadāʿ, farewell (m., gen. with tanwīn, after bi-lā); 'farewell' Also, a different word: wa- + dāʿin, caller (act. part. of daʿā; the wāw rubba of verse, 'many a', in effect 'a'): wa-dāʿin daʿānī, 'a caller called me'.
أُوَدِّعَكَ: وَدَّعَ + كَ — waddaʿa, bid farewell (II, subjunctive 1 sg. after ḥattā) + -ka, you (m. sg., object); 'I bid you farewell'
وَأَشْرَحُ: وَ + أَشْرَحُ — wa-, and + sharaḥa, explain, set out (I, imperf. 1 sg.; the print gives the ḥāʾ a damma, so indicative); 'and I explain'
الشَّوْقِ: الـ + شَوْق — shawq, longing, yearning (m., gen. after min); 'the longing'
وَالتَّذْكَارِ: وَ + الـ + تَذْكَار — wa-, and + al-, the + tadhkār, remembrance, recollection (m., gen.); 'and the remembrance'
وَالْبَرَحَا: وَ + الـ + بَرَح — wa-, and + al-, the + baraḥ, distress, anguish (m., gen.; written with the rhyme alif); 'and the anguish'
مَاصَيَّرَ: مَا + صَيَّرَ — mā, what, that which (relative) + ṣayyara, turn into, make (II, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'what has made'. The print joins the words
شَبَحًا: شَبَح — shabaḥ, phantom, shadow, spectre (m., acc. with tanwīn; second object of ṣayyara); 'a phantom'
اَحْبَابَنَا: أَحْبَاب + نَا — aḥbāb, beloved ones (pl. of ḥabīb; vocative, acc. as first term of an iḍāfa) + -nā, our; 'O our beloved ones'
تَقُولُوا: قَالَ — qāla, say (I, jussive 2 m. pl. after lā of prohibition); 'do not say'
سَلُوتَكُمْ: سَلْوَة + كُمْ — salwa (here written salūwa), forgetting, solace, consolation (f., acc., quoted as the thing said) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your forgetting'
بِالْحَالِ: بِـ + الـ + حَال — bi-, with, as (prep.: 'the state is as the state', unchanged) + al-, the + ḥāl, state (m., gen.); 'as the state'
وَالتَّبْرِيحُ: وَ + الـ + تَبْرِيح — wa-, and + al-, the + tabrīḥ, torment, anguish (m., nom., subject; verbal noun of II barraḥa); 'and the torment'
مَابَرِحَا: مَا + بَرِحَ — mā, not (negation of the perfect) + bariḥa, cease, leave (I, perf. 3 m. sg., with the rhyme alif); 'has not ceased'. The print joins the words
يَسْبَحُ: سَبَحَ — sabaḥa, swim (I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'he swims'
مَدَامِعِهِ: مَدَامِع + هِ — madāmiʿ, tears, tear-ducts (pl. of maʿmaʿ/madmaʿ; gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his tears'
اَوَّلَ: أَوَّل — awwal, first (m., acc. as predicate of kuntu; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the first'
دَمْعِهِ: دَمْع + هِ — damʿ, tears, weeping (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his tears'
سَبَحَا: سَبَحَ — sabaḥa, swim (I, perf. 3 m. sg., with the rhyme alif); 'swam'
مَحَبَّتُكُمْ: مَحَبَّة + كُمْ — maḥabba, love (f., nom., subject of taḥakkama) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your love'
مَزْجُ: مَزْج — mazj, mixing, blending (m., nom., subject; verbal noun of I mazaja; first term of an iḍāfa)
بِالْقَدَحَا: بِـ + الـ + قَدَح — bi-, over, in (prep., after taḥakkama, marking the thing controlled) + al-, the + qadaḥ, cup, goblet (m., gen.; written with the rhyme alif); 'in the cup'
اَحْذَرُهُ: حَذِرَ + هُ — ḥadhira, beware of, dread (I, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, it (object); 'I dread it'
هَوَاهُ: هَوًى + هُ — hawā, love, passion, desire (m., nom.; alif maqṣūra) + -hu, his; 'his love'
بِقَلْبِي: بِـ + قَلْب + ـي — bi-, in (prep.) + qalb, heart (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'in my heart'; also: after mashghūf bi-, 'smitten with', bi- marks the beloved: 'with my heart'
وَالْحَشَا: وَ + الـ + حَشًا — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥashā, vitals, entrails, belly (m., gen., with 'in'); 'and the vitals'
مَزَحَا: مَزَحَ — mazaḥa, jest, play, sport (I, perf. 3 m. sg., with the rhyme alif); 'it sported'. The sense in the line is uncertain
سُولِي: سُول + ـي — sūl (suʾl), wish, desire (m., voc. as first term of an iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my wish'
اَمَلِي: أَمَل + ـي — amal, hope (m., voc. in iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my hope'
بَرِحَا: بَرِحَ — bariḥa, cease, leave (I, perf. 3 m. sg., with the rhyme alif); with mā, 'has not left'
عَادَيْتَ: عَادَى — ʿādā, treat as an enemy, be hostile to (III, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you were hostile'
وَسَيِّدَنَا: وَ + سَيِّد + نَا — wa-, and + sayyid, lord (m., acc., object) + -nā, our; 'and our lord'
لِاَجْلِي: لِـ + أَجْل + ـي — li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake (m., gen.; li-ajli, 'for the sake of') + -ī, my; 'for my sake'
وَعُدْتَ: وَ + عَادَ — wa-, and + ʿāda, return, turn, depart (I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'and you went / turned'
الْاَوْطَانِ: الـ + أَوْطَان — awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan; gen.); 'the homelands'
مُنْتَزِحَا: مُنْتَزِح — muntaziḥ, far away, distant (act. part. of VIII intazaḥa; m., acc. with the rhyme alif, ḥāl); 'far removed'
