اَوْحَشَ: أَوْحَشَ — awḥasha, make desolate, bereave (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); after lā, a prayer 'may he not make desolate'
فَقْدِي: فَقْد + ـي — faqd, loss, losing (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; 'my loss'
وَهَبْتَنِي: وَهَبَ + نِي — wahaba, give, bestow (I, perf. 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me (object); 'you gave me'
لِكَرِيمٍ: لِـ + كَرِيم — li-, to, for (prep.; with wahaba, 'give to') + karīm, generous one (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'to a generous man'
ظَلَّ: ظَلَّ — ẓalla, remain, continue (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he remained'
مُمْتَدِحَا: مُمْتَدِح — mumtadiḥ, praising (act. part. of VIII imtadaḥa; m., acc. with the rhyme alif, predicate of ẓalla); 'praising'
أَجَابَهَا: أَجَابَ + هَا — ajāba, answer (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her (object); 'he answered her'
شِعْـــــرًا: شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry, verse (m., acc. with tanwīn); 'in verse'. The print stretches the word with tatweels
وَدَّعَتْنِي: وَدَّعَ + نِي — waddaʿa, bid farewell (II, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me (object); 'she bade me farewell'
وَهْيَ: وَ + هْيَ — wa-, and, while (circumstantial wāw) + hya (contracted hiya), she (3 f. sg.); 'and she (was)'
لَوْعَةِ: لَوْعَة — law'a, burning pain, ache (of love) (f., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْاِشْتِيَاقِ: الـ + اشْتِيَاق — ishtiyāq, longing, yearning (m., gen., verbal noun of VIII ishtāqa); 'of the longing'
بَاقِ: بَاقٍ — bāqin, remaining, surviving (act. part. of I baqiya; m., sg., written without its tanwīn in the rhyme position); 'remaining'
قَوْلَهَا: قَوْل + هَا — qawl, saying, words (m., acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her saying'
الْكَرِيمَ: الـ + كَرِيم — karīm, generous one (m., acc., the object of wahabtanī as printed); 'the generous one'
رَغْبَتُهُ: رَغْبَة + هُ — raghba, desire, longing (f., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his desire'
وَصَعُبَ: وَ + صَعُبَ — wa-, and + ṣaʿuba, be hard, difficult (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it was hard'
التَّفْرِيقُ: الـ + تَفْرِيق — tafrīq, separating, parting (m., nom., verbal noun of II farraqa); 'the separating'
الْمُصْبِي: الـ + مُصْبِي — al-, the + muṣbī (as printed; probably a misprint for الصَّيَّاد, 'the fisherman') (m., nom., subject); 'the fisherman'
قَٰلْ: قَدْ — qad (as printed قل, with dagger alif; read 'has' before dhakarat) — a misprint for qad; 'has'
ذَكَرَتْ: ذَكَرَ — dhakara, mention (I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she mentioned'
مَلَكَهَا: مَلَكَ + هَا — malaka, own, possess (I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her (object); 'owned her'
فَأَخْبِرْنِي: فَـ + أَخْبِرْ + نِي — fa-, so (conj., introducing a command) + akhbir, inform (IV, imperative 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'so tell me'
طَلَبٌ: طَلَب — ṭalab, claim, demand, request (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a claim'
وَلِهَذِهِ: وَ + لِـ + هَذِهِ — wa-, and + li-, to, for (prep.) + hādhihi, this (f.); 'and to this'
تُحَدِّثُنَا: حَدَّثَ + نَا — ḥaddatha, tell, relate (II, imperf. 2 m. sg. indic.) + -nā, us (object); 'you tell us'
وَتُعَرِّفُنَا: وَ + عَرَّفَ + نَا — wa-, and + ʿarrafa, make known to, inform (II, imperf. 2 m. sg. indic.) + -nā, us (object); 'and you make us know'
فَرَجَ: فَرَج — faraj, relief (m., acc. after inna; first term of an iḍāfa)
حَدِيثَنَا: حَدِيث + نَا — ḥadīth, tale (m., acc., object) + -nā, our; 'our tale'
نَظْمًا: نَظْم — naẓm, verse, arrangement in verse (m., acc. with tanwīn, ḥāl); 'in verse'
نَثْرًا: نَثْر — nathr, prose (m., acc. with tanwīn, ḥāl); 'in prose'
النَّثْرُ: الـ + نَثْر — nathr, prose (m., nom., subject); 'the prose'
وَالشِّعْرُ: وَ + الـ + شِعْر — wa-, and + al-, the + shiʿr, poetry (m., nom., subject); 'and the poetry'
نِظَامٌ: نِظَام — niẓām, order, string (of pearls) (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'order'
شِــعْـــرَ: شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry (m., acc., bare); 'in verse'. The print stretches the word with tatweels and gives no final alif
يَاخَلِيلِي: yā + khalīl + ī — yā, O (vocative particle, written joined to the noun); khalīl, friend (m.); ī, my (1sg. suffix); 'O my friend'
رُقَادِي: ruqād + ī — ruqād, sleep (m., object of hajartu) + ī, my; 'my sleep'
وَتَزَايَدَ: wa- + tazāyada — wa-, and (conj.); tazāyada (VI), increase, swell (perf. 3m.sg.); 'and grew greater'
لِبُعْدِ: li- + buʿd — li-, because of, on account of (prep.) + buʿd, distance, being far (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'because of the distance of'
وَالِدُ: wālid — father (m.); printed with damma and no tanwīn, 'a father (I had)'
شَفُوقَا: shafūq — compassionate, tender (adj., m.; acc. predicate of kāna, with printed alif of the accusative)
وَجَاوَرَ: wa- + jāwara — wa-, and (conj.); jāwara (III), dwell next to, neighbour (perf. 3m.sg.); 'and neighboured'
الْاَلْحَادِ: al- + alḥād — al-, the + alḥād, graves (pl. of laḥd, a niche-grave; gen., object of jāwara in the print); 'the graves'
فَاتَتْ: fa- + atat — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + atat (ata, come, perf. 3f.sg.), printed without hamza; read 'then came upon'; the print could also be fātat (fāta, pass, escape)
اُمُورٌ: umūr — affairs, matters (pl. of amr; nom. tanwīn, subject of the verb)
مُفَتِّتَ: mufattit — one who breaks into pieces (II act. part. of fattata, m.; acc. as second predicate of ṣirtu, first term of an iḍāfa); 'a shatterer of'
الْاَكْبَادِ: al- + akbād — al-, the + akbād, livers (pl. of kabid; the liver as seat of feeling; gen.); 'the livers'
خُودًا: khūd — fair young woman, a soft slender girl (f.; acc. tanwīn, object of ishtarā); 'a fair maid'
قَدُّهَا: qadd + hā — qadd, stature, figure (m., nom., subject) + hā, her; 'her figure'
الْمَيَّادِ: al- + mayyād — al-, the + mayyād, swaying (intensive adj. of māda, 'sway'; agrees with qaddu-hā; printed gen. for the rhyme); 'the swaying'
فَصَرَفْتُ: fa- + ṣarafa — fa-, and so (conj.); ṣarafa, spend, expend (perf. 1sg., -tu); 'and so I spent'
وَتَكَرَّمْتُ: wa- + takarramtu — wa-, and (conj.); takarrama (V), act nobly, be lavish (perf. 1sg.); 'and I was lavish'
الْاَجْوَادِ: al- + ajwād — al-, the + ajwād, the generous, open-handed (pl. of jawād; gen.); 'the open-handed'
سِمْتُهَا: sāma + hā — sāma, offer, put up (for sale) (perf. 1sg., -tu) + hā, her (first object); 'I offered her'
الْبَيْعَ: al- + bayʿ — al-, the + bayʿ, sale (m., acc., second object); 'for sale'
وَجَوَى: wa- + jawā — wa-, and (conj.); jawā, inward burning, anguish (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the anguish of'
بِمُرَادِي: bi- + murād + ī — bi-, by, in accordance with (prep.; 'by my wish') + murād, wish, intention (m., gen.) + ī, my; 'by my wish'
مَادَ: mā + d(aʿā) — mā, a particle after idhā (idhā mā, 'when') and د, the first letter of daʿā, 'call', which the print cuts off from its remaining letters; read mā-daʿā
عَا: ʿā — the rest of daʿā (دعا), call (perf. 3m.sg.), completing the preceding word; the print leaves a space inside the word
اِلَيْهَا: ilā + hā — ilā, to (prep.) + hā, her; 'to her' (call toward her)
مُنَادٍ: munādin — crier, herald, auctioneer (III act. part., m., nom.; indef., defective noun); 'a crier'
الْفَسَادِ: al- + fasād — al-, the + fasād, corruption, vileness (m., gen.); 'abounding in vileness'
فَلِهَذَا: fa- + li- + hādhā — fa-, and so (conj.); li-, for, because of (prep.) + hādhā, this (m.); 'and for this reason'
اِغْتَظْتُ: ightāẓa — be enraged (VIII perf. 1sg., -tu); 'I was enraged'
وَنَتَرْتُ: wa- + nataratu — wa-, and (conj.); natara, snatch, jerk away (perf. 1sg., -tu); 'and I snatched'
الْاَوْغَادِ: al- + awghād — al-, the + awghād, base fellows, riffraff (pl. of waghd; gen.); 'the base ones'
فَلَكَمَنِي: fa- + lakama + nī — fa-, and so (conj.); lakama, punch, strike with the fist (perf. 3m.sg.) + nī, me (object); 'and he punched me'
اللَّئِيمُ: al- + laʾīm — al-, the + laʾīm, base, mean (adj., m., nom.); 'the vile one'
بِغَيْظٍ: bi- + ghayẓ — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + ghayẓ, rage, fury (m., gen. tanwīn); 'in fury'
قَادَتْ: qādat — printed with alif; apparently qadat (from waqada / qada, blaze), perf. 3f.sg.; 'blazed' (the print may intend this; the subject laẓā is fem.)
لَظَى: laẓā — blazing fire, flame (m./f.; indecl., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa; also a name of Hell); 'the flame of'
الْاِلْحَادِ: al- + ilḥād — al-, the + ilḥād, deviation, impiety, wrongdoing (IV verbal noun; gen.); 'impiety'
فَلَكَمْتُهُ: fa- + lakamtu + hu — fa-, and so (conj.); lakama, punch (perf. 1sg., -tu) + hu, him; 'and I punched him'
حُرْقَتِي: ḥurqa + tī — ḥurqa, burning, searing pain (f.; gen. after min, 'from my burning') + ī, my; 'my burning'
بِيَمِينِي: bi- + yamīn + ī — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + yamīn, right hand (f., gen.) + ī, my; 'with my right hand'
وَشِمَالِي: wa- + shimāl + ī — wa-, and (conj.; 'and with') + shimāl, left hand (m.; gen., after an understood bi-) + ī, my; 'and my left'
لِدَارِي: li- + dār + ī — li-, to (prep., of direction) + dār, house (f., gen.) + ī, my; 'to my house'
وَتَغَيَّبْتُ: wa- + taghayyabtu — wa-, and (conj.); taghayyaba (V), absent oneself, hide (perf. 1sg.); 'and I hid'
خِيفَةَ: khīfa — fear, dread (f.; acc., of reason; first term of an iḍāfa); 'for fear of'
الْاَضْدَادِ: al- + aḍdād — al-, the + aḍdād, adversaries, foes (pl. of ḍidd; gen.); 'the foes'
فَاَمَرَ: fa- + amara — fa-, and so (conj.); amara, command (perf. 3m.sg.); amara bi-, 'command (that) …'
حَاكِمُ: ḥākim — ruler, governor (m., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa)
بِمَسْكِي: bi- + masik + ī — bi-, the preposition amara chooses for what is commanded + masik, seizing, arresting (verbal noun, gen.) + ī, me; 'that I be seized'
فَاَتَى: fa- + atā — fa-, and so (conj.); atā, come (perf. 3m.sg.); 'and there came'
الْكَثِيرُ: al- + kathīr — al-, the + kathīr, much, abounding (adj., m., nom.; qualifies al-ḥājib)
السَّدَادِ: al- + sadād — al-, the + sadād, rectitude, right judgement (m., gen.); 'abounding in rectitude'
رَامِزَالِي: rāmiz + an + li- + ī — rāmiz, one who signals, hints (act. part., acc. ḥāl, the -an written as a joined alif) + li-, to (prep.) + ī, me; 'hinting to me'
اَسِيرُ: asīru — sāra, go, travel (impf. 1sg., after anna); 'that I go'
وَاَغِيبُ: wa- + aghību — wa-, and (conj.); ghāba, be absent, vanish (impf. 1sg.); 'and I vanish'
وَاكْمُدُ: wa- + akmudu — wa-, and (conj.); kamada, grieve, be sad (impf. 1sg., printed with damma); sense 'and (so) I distress', taking al-ḥussād as object
الْحُسَّادِي: al- + ḥussād (+ ī) — al-, the + ḥussād, enviers, the envious (pl. of ḥāsid; acc. object); the final ī is a stray yā in the print, perhaps the pronoun 'my' or only the rhyme vowel; 'the envious'
جِنْحَ: jinḥ — a part of the night, the dark of night (m.; acc. as adverb of time; first term of an iḍāfa); 'at the dark of'
طَالِبِينَا: ṭālib + īnā — ṭālib, seeker (act. part., m.), pl. acc. ending -īna lengthened with -ā in the print (ḥāl, 'we seeking')
بَغْدَادِ: Baghdād — Baghdad (city; gen. after fī, written without the article)
الذَّخَائِرِ: al- + dhakhāʾir — al-, the + dhakhāʾir, stores, treasures (pl. of dhakhīra; gen. after min); 'the treasures'
اُعْطِيكَ: uʿṭī + ka — aʿṭā (IV), give (impf. 1sg.) + ka, you (m.sg., first object); 'that I give you'
صَيَّادِ: ṣayyād — fisherman (m.; vocative, with kasra in the print); 'O fisherman'
مُحْبُوبَ: maḥbūb — beloved (m.; passive part. of aḥabba; acc. object of uʿṭīka, first term of an iḍāfa)
فَتَيَقَّنْ: fa- + tayaqqan — fa-, so (conj.); tayaqqana (V), be certain (imperative 2m.sg.); 'so be certain'
فُؤادِي: fuʾād + ī — fuʾād, heart (m.) + ī, my; 'my heart' (the print has no mark on the alif)
مُبْتَدَأِ: mubtadaʾ — beginning, starting point (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa; precomposed hamza as printed); 'the beginning of'
مُنْتَهَاهُ: muntahā + hu — muntahā, end, limit (m., gen. after ilā, with alif maqṣūra) + hu, its; 'its end'
دَهَمَ: dahama — overwhelm, come suddenly upon (perf. 3m.sg.); 'struck, overcame'
تَفْصِلُ: tafṣilu — faṣala, depart, set out (impf. 2m.sg.); 'you go out'
بِلَادُاللَّهِ: bilādu Allāhi — bilād, lands (pl. of balad; nom., subject, first term of an iḍāfa) + Allāh, God (gen., second term), written joined; 'God's lands'
تُؤَدِّيهَا: tuʾaddī + hā — tuʾaddī, from addā (II), deliver, convey (impf. 2m.sg.; the print omits the hamza) + hā, it (the letter); 'you deliver it'
قَرَأَهَا: qaraʾa + hā — qaraʾa, read (perf. 3m.sg.; the precomposed hamza is the print's) + hā, it (f., the letter); 'he reads it'
يَضُرَّكَ: yaḍurra + ka — yaḍurra, from ḍarra, harm (jussive 3m.sg., with the doubled r; after lam) + ka, you; 'he will not harm you'
يُؤْذِيكَ: yuʾdhī + ka — yuʾdhī, from ādhā (IV), hurt, injure (impf. 3m.sg.; the print marks the yā with damma and omits the hamza) + ka, you; 'and he will not hurt you'
الْمُـــــــــــــبَـــــــــــــــاحِ: al- + mubāḥ — al-, the + mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (IV pass. part., m., gen., adj.); the print stretches the word with tatweels; 'the permitted'
لِنُورِالدِّينِ: لِـ + نُورِالدِّين — li-, to (prep., marking the person addressed after قَالَ) + Nūr al-Dīn, 'light of the faith' (personal name, gen.; printed as one word); 'to Nūr al-Dīn'
أَكْتُبُ: kataba, to write (I, imperfect 1s, indicative); 'I write, I will write'
يَضُرُّكَ: ḍarra, to harm (I, imperfect 3ms) + ـكَ, you (2ms object); 'he will harm you'
بِشَئٌ: بِـ + شَيْء — bi-, in, with (prep.; with a negative, 'at all, in any way') + shayʾ, thing (m.; the print marks the ya with tanwīn damma, kept, where a genitive would be expected); 'in any thing'
يُكَاتِبُ: kātaba, to correspond with (III, imperfect 3ms, indicative; describing the fisherman); 'who writes to, corresponds with'
الْمُلُوكَ: الـ + مُلُوك — mulūk, kings (m. broken pl. of malik, acc., object); 'the kings'
شَئٌ: shayʾ, thing (m.; the print marks the ya with tanwīn damma, here nom., predicate of inna); 'a thing'
مَكْتَبٍ: maktab, school, place of writing (m., gen. after fī, indef.); 'a school'
فَقِيهٍ: faqīh, jurist, schoolmaster (m., gen., indef.); 'a jurist, a teacher'
عَرِيفَهُ: ʿarīf, monitor, senior pupil in charge of a class (m., acc., predicate of kāna) + ـهُ, his (3ms); 'his monitor'
نَقَلَنِي: naqala, to move, transfer (I, perfect 3ms) + ـنِي, me (1s object); 'moved me'
أُرْسِلْ: arsala, to send (IV, jussive 1s, after lam); 'I did not send'
إِلَّاقَضَاهَا: إِلَّا + قَضَى + ـهَا — illā, except, but (particle) + qaḍā, to fulfil, settle (I, perfect 3ms) + hā, it (3fs, the need); printed as one word; 'except he fulfilled it'
وَلَوْأَرْسَلْتُ: وَ + لَوْ + أَرْسَلْتُ — wa-, and + law, 'if' (contrary-to-fact conditional particle) + arsala, to send (IV, perfect 1s); printed as one word; 'and if I sent'
لَقَضَاهَا: لَـ + قَضَى + ـهَا — la-, emphatic prefix introducing the answer to law ('would') + qaḍā, to fulfil (I, perfect 3ms) + hā, it (3fs); 'he would fulfil it'
طَيِّبْ: ṭayyib, good, fine (adj., colloquial; used as an interjection with sukun); 'all right'
الْبَسْمَلَةِ: الـ + بَسْمَلَة — basmala, the formula 'In the name of God …' (f., gen. after baʿda); 'the basmala'
بَعْدُ: baʿdu — after (adv., construct without a following noun, fixed on damma); with أَمَّا, 'as to what follows'
الْمَشْمُولِ: الـ + مَشْمُول — mashmūl, enveloped, encompassed (pass. part. of I shamila; m., gen., adj. of Muḥammad); 'the one enveloped'
بِنِعْمَتِي: بِـ + نِعْمَة + ـي — bi-, by, in (prep., marking what envelops him) + niʿma, favour (f., gen.) + ī, my (1s); 'in my favour'
جَعَلْتُهُ: jaʿala, to make (I, perfect 1s) + ـهُ, him (3ms object); 'I made him'
نَائِبًا: nāʾib, deputy, viceroy (m., acc. tanwīn; second object of jaʿala; the print writes the hamza); 'a deputy'
مَمْلَكَتِي: mamlaka, kingdom (f., gen.) + ـي, my (1s); 'my kingdom'
الْوَاصِلَ: الـ + وَاصِل — wāṣil, one arriving (act. part. of I waṣala; m., acc., subject of inna); 'the one arriving, the bearer'
عِنْدِكُمُ: ʿind, at, with (prep.; gen. after ilā in the print's double preposition) + ـكُم, you (2mp, addressed as 'you' of a ruler) with linking vowel before انْزِعْ; 'at your place'
انْزِعْ: nazaʿa, to pull off, strip (I, imperative 2ms); 'strip off'
وَوَلِّهِ: وَ + وَلِّ + ـهِ — wa-, and + wallī, to install, invest (II, imperative 2ms; the print marks the vowels on this word) + hi, him (3ms object); 'and install him'
تُخَالِفْ: khālafa, to oppose, disobey (III, jussive 2ms, after lā); 'oppose'
وَبَاسَهُ: وَ + بَاسَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + bāsa, to kiss (I, perfect 3ms; colloquial) + hu, it (3ms, the letter); 'and kissed it'
الصَّيَّادِينَ: الـ + صَيَّادِين — ṣayyād, fisherman (m. sound pl., gen.); 'the fishermen'
أَحْقَرَ: aḥqar, most despicable (elative, m., acc. in the vocative construct; first term of an iḍāfa); 'most despicable of'
سَمَكَتَيْنِ: samaka, a fish (n. of unity, f.; dual acc. -tayn, object of jiʾta); 'two fish'
تُسَاوِيَانِ: sāwā, to be worth, equal (III, imperfect 3fd, indicative, describing the two fish); 'worth'
نِصْفًا: niṣf, half (here the nuṣf, a half-dirham coin; m., acc. tanwīn, specification after twenty); 'halves'
فَأَشْهَرَ: فَـ + أَشْهَرَ — fa-, and so (consequence) + ashhara, to make conspicuous, make public; with sword, 'draw' (IV, perfect 3ms); 'and so he showed'
صِبْيَانِ: ṣibyān, boys (m. broken pl. of ṣabī, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'boys of'
لِبَوَّابِ: لِـ + بَوَّاب — li-, to (prep., recipient of the message) + bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'to the doorkeeper of'
بَدْلَةَ: badla, suit of clothes (f., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the suit of'
بِالْبَدْلَةِ: بِـ + الـ + بَدْلَة — bi-, with (prep.; with ṭalaʿa, 'come up with, bringing') + badla, suit (f., gen.); 'with the suit'
يَدَىِ: yadayi — yad, hand (f., dual construct, gen. after bayna; the print writes ya with ى); 'the two hands of'
سَاهِيًا: sāhin, absent-minded, dazed (act. part. of I sahā; m., acc. tanwīn; predicate/hāl); 'dazed'
يَعَضُّ: ʿaḍḍa, to bite (I, imperfect 3ms, indicative; circumstantial); 'biting'
أَنَامِلَهُ: anāmil, fingertips (f. broken pl. of anmala, acc., object) + ـهُ, his (3ms); 'his fingertips'
سَكْرِهِ: sukr, drunkenness (m., gen. after min) + ـهِ, his (3ms); 'his drunkenness'
جِنَايَةَ: jināya, misdeed, offence (f., acc., object of hab); 'a misdeed'
مَازَلَتْ: مَا + زَلَّتْ — mā, which, what (relative; printed as one word) + zalla, to slip (I, perfect 3fs); 'which slipped'
الْقَدَمُ: الـ + قَدَم — qadam, foot (f., nom., subject of zallat); 'the foot'
فَالْعَبْدُ: فَـ + الـ + عَبْد — fa-, for, since (gives the reason) + ʿabd, servant, slave (m., nom.); 'for the servant'
سَادَاتِهِ: sāda, masters (m. broken pl. of sayyid, gen. after min) + ـهِ, his (3ms); 'his masters'
الْكَرَمُ: الـ + كَرَم — karam, generosity (m.; the print points it with damma as the verse-end, object of yaṭlubu); 'generosity'
يَقْتَضِيهِ: iqtaḍā, to require, demand (VIII, imperfect 3ms, indicative) + ـهِ, it (3ms, referring to mā); 'requires it'
مُعْتَرِفًا: muʿtarif, confessing (act. part. of VIII iʿtarafa; m., acc. tanwīn; hāl); 'confessing'
فَايْنَ: فَـ + أَيْنَ — fa-, so, then (introduces the question) + ayna, where? (interrogative; the print has bare alif); 'so where'
وَالْكَرَمُ: وَ + الـ + كَرَم — wa-, and + karam, generosity (m., nom.); 'and the generosity'
فَعَفَى: فَـ + عَفَى — fa-, and so (conj. of narrative sequence) + ʿafā, to pardon (verb I defective, perf. 3 m. sg.; printed with final ى); 'and so he pardoned'
تُحْمَلَ: تُحْمَلَ — tuḥmala, to be carried (verb I passive, imperf. 3 f. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that she be carried'
مَنْزِلًا: مَنْزِلًا — manzil, lodging, dwelling (m., acc. indef., object of أَفْرَدَ); 'a house'
وَوَكَّلَ: وَ + وَكَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + wakkala, to appoint, put in charge (form II, perf. 3 m. sg.; takes بِـ); 'and he appointed'
يَخْدُمُهَا: يَخْدُمُ + هَا — yakhdumu, to serve (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.) + -hā, her; 'serves her'
نُرْسِلُ: نُرْسِلُ — nursilu, to send (form IV, imperf. 1 pl. indic.); 'we send'
وَنَرَ: وَ + نَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + nara, apparently 'we see' (verb I, imperf. 1 pl., apocopated form of رَأَى; obscure and possibly corrupt); 'and we see (to)'
مُلْكَ: مُلْكَ — mulk, kingdom, kingship (m., acc., tanwīn not written; obscure here); 'a kingdom'
فَطَلَبَهُ: فَـ + طَلَبَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + ṭalaba, to seek, send for (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and so he sent for him'
عُنْوَانَ: عُنْوَانَ — ʿunwān, address, superscription (m., acc., object of رَأَى, first term of iḍāfa); 'the address of'
وَقَبَّلَهَا: وَ + قَبَّلَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + qabbala, to kiss (form II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f., the letter); 'and he kissed it'; also 'and he kissed her' (Dahnash kissing Budūr, Night 182)
وَلِأَمِيرِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: وَ + لِـ + أَمِيرِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, to (prep.; 'is due to') + amīr al-muʾminīn, Commander of the Faithful (printed with the lām joined to the title as one word); 'and to the Commander of the Faithful'
الْأَرْبَعَةَ: الـ + أَرْبَعَة — arbaʿa, four (m., acc., in agreement with القضاة); 'the four'
وَالْأُمَرَاءَ: وَ + الـ + أُمَرَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + umarāʾ, emirs, commanders (pl. of amīr, acc.); 'and the emirs'
يَخْلَعَ: يَخْلَعَ — yakhlaʿa, to remove, depose (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that he remove'
وَمَضَغَهَا: وَ + مَضَغَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + maḍagha, to chew (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he chewed it'
وَأَمَاهَا: وَ + أَمَاهَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + amāha, apparently form IV of māha 'to dissolve, liquefy' (perf. 3 m. sg.; obscure) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he dissolved it'
عَاقٌّ: عَاقٌّ — ʿāqq, disobedient, undutiful (active participle of ʿaqqa; m., nom. indef.); 'an undutiful wretch'
شَيْطَانٌ: شَيْطَانٌ — shayṭān, devil (m., nom. indef.); 'a devil'
مَكَّارٌ: مَكَّارٌ — makkār, deceitful, crafty (intensive adj. from makara; m., nom. indef.); 'cunning'
بِوَرَقَةٍ: بِـ + وَرَقَة — bi-, upon (prep.; waqaʿa bi- 'light upon, come across') + waraqa, sheet of paper (f., gen.); 'upon a paper'
بِطَالَةٍ: بِطَالَةٍ — biṭāla, idleness, worthlessness (f., gen. indef.), used as an adjective of the paper; the reading is uncertain (cf. بَطَّالَة); 'idle, worthless'
فَعَمِلَ: فَـ + عَمِلَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + ʿamila, to do, work, carry out (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and so he worked'
غَرَضَهُ: غَرَضَ + هُ — gharaḍ, aim, purpose (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his purpose'
يُرْسِلْ: يُرْسِلْ — yursil, to send (form IV, imperf. 3 m. sg., jussive: after لَمْ 'he did not send', or continuing a command, 'let him send')
السَّلْطَنَةَ: الـ + سَلْطَنَة — salṭana, sultanate, rule (f., acc., object); 'the sultanate'
خَطٌّ: خَطٌّ — khaṭṭ, writ, handwriting (m., nom. indef.); 'a writ'
تَعْلِيقٌ: تَعْلِيقٌ — taʿlīq, a commission, written order (m., nom. indef.); 'a commission'
وَلَاجَاءَ: وَ + لَا + جَاءَ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, not (negative particle) + jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'and he did not come'
لَأَرْسَلَ: لَـ + أَرْسَلَ — la-, emphatic particle opening the result clause of لَوْ ('would') + arsala, to send (form IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he would have sent'
وَأَتَسَلَّمُهُ: وَ + أَتَسَلَّمُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + atasallamu, to receive, take delivery of (form V, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'and I receive him'
وَأُرْسِلُهُ: وَ + أُرْسِلُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ursilu, to send (form IV, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'and I send him'
يَأْتِينَا: يَأْتِي + نَا — yaʾtī, to come, bring (verb I defective, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.; أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + -nā, us; 'he brings us'
بِخَطٍّ: بِـ + خَطّ — bi-, with (prep.; أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + khaṭṭ, writ, handwriting (m., gen. indef.); 'with a writ'
شَرِيفٍ: شَرِيفٍ — sharīf, noble, august (adj., gen. indef.; khaṭṭ sharīf, a ruler's own signed writ); 'noble'
وَتَقْلِيدٍ: وَ + تَقْلِيدٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + taqlīd, investiture, patent of appointment (m., gen., coordinated with خَطٍّ after بِـ); 'and a patent of investiture'
يَأْتِ: يَأْتِ — yaʾti, to come, bring (verb I defective, imperf. 3 m. sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'he did not bring'
غَرِيمِي: غَرِيمِ + ي — gharīm, adversary, one's debtor or creditor (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -ī, my; 'my adversary'
فَتَسَلَّمَهُ: فَـ + تَسَلَّمَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + tasallama, to receive, take delivery of (form V, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and so he took him over'
دَرَاهِ: دَرَاهِ — a misprint for دَارِهِ: dār, house (f., gen. after إِلَى) + -hi, his; 'his house'
فَمَدُّوهُ: فَـ + مَدُّوا + هُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + maddū, to stretch out (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and so they stretched him out'
قَيْدًا: قَيْدًا — qayd, fetter, shackle (m., acc. indef.); 'a fetter'
السَّجَّانِ: الـ + سَّجَّان — sajjān, jailer (m., gen. after عَلَى; the print marks the shadda on the jīm); 'the jailer'
السَّجَّانُ: الـ + سَّجَّان — sajjān, jailer (m., nom. subject; the print marks the shadda on the jīm); 'the jailer'
قُطَيْطٌ: قُطَيْطٌ — Quṭayṭ, the jailer's name (m., nom.)
يَاقُطَيْطُ: يَا + قُطَيْطُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Quṭayṭ, the jailer's name (vocative); printed as one word; 'O Quṭayṭ'
وَتَرْمِيَهُ: وَ + تَرْمِيَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tarmiya, to throw (verb I defective, imperf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive, continuing أَنْ) + -hu, him; 'and throw him'
مَطْمُورَةٍ: مَطْمُورَةٍ — maṭmūra, underground pit, dungeon (f., gen. indef. after فِي); 'a pit'
الْمَطَامِيرِ: الـ + مَطَامِير — maṭāmīr, underground pits (pl. of maṭmūra, gen. after مِنَ); 'the pits'
وَتُعَاقِبَهُ: وَ + تُعَاقِبَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tuʿāqiba, to punish (form III, imperf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive, continuing أَنْ) + -hu, him; 'and punish him'
السَّجَّانُ: الـ + سَّجَّان — sajjān, jailer (m., nom. subject); 'the jailer'
السَّجَّانَ: الـ + سَّجَّان — sajjān, jailer (m., acc., object of يُوصِي or noun of إِنَّ); 'the jailer'
أَدْخَلَ: أَدْخَلَ — adkhala, to bring in (form IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he brought in'
السِّجْنَ: الـ + سِّجْن — sijn, prison (m., acc., object of أَدْخَلَ); 'the prison'
وَقَفَلَ: وَ + قَفَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qafala, to lock (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he locked'
بِكَنْسِ: بِـ + كَنْس — bi-, (amara bi-) 'order' (prep.; the verb chooses it for the thing ordered) + kans, sweeping (m., gen.); 'the sweeping of'
وَفَرَشَهَا: وَ + فَرَشَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + farasha, to spread, furnish (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he spread it'
بِمَقْعَدٍ: بِـ + مَقْعَد — bi-, with (prep.; farasha bi- 'spread with') + maqʿad, seat, cushion (m., gen.); 'with a seat'
وَنِطْعٍ: وَ + نِطْعٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + niṭʿ, leather mat (m., gen. indef.); 'and a leather mat'
وَأَجْلَسَ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlasa, to seat (form IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he seated'
وَفَكَّ: وَ + فَكَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + fakka, to loosen, strike off (verb I doubled, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he loosed'
قَيْدَهُ: قَيْدَ + هُ — qayd, fetter (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his fetter'
وَالسَّجَّانُ: وَ + الـ + سَّجَّان + ُ — wa-, and (conj., new subject) + sajjān, jailer (m., nom.); 'and the jailer'
يُدَافِعُ: يُدَافِعُ — yudāfiʿu, to defend, put off (form III, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic.); 'he defends, puts off'
الْحَادِي: الـ + حَادِي — ḥādī, first, 'one-' (ordinal from wāḥid, nom.); 'the first'; also a different word: al-ḥādī, the camel-driver who sings to urge the camels on (act. part. of ḥadā, verb I defective); ʿalā ghināʾi al-ḥādī, 'to the camel-driver's song' (Night 182)
وَالْأَرْبَعُونَ: وَ + الـ + أَرْبَعُونَ — wa-, and (conj.; joins the units to the tens in an ordinal) + arbaʿūn, forty (nom.); 'and the forty', that is, 'forty-first'
فَشَاوَرَ: فَـ + شَاوَرَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + shāwara, to consult (form III, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and so he consulted'
الْوُزَرَاءَ: الـ + وُزَرَاء — wuzarāʾ, viziers (pl. of wazīr, acc., diptote); 'the viziers'
أَمْرِهَا: أَمْرِ + هَا — amr, matter, affair (m., gen.) + -hā, her/its; 'her affair, its matter'
بَعْضٌ: بَعْضٌ — baʿḍ, some, one (m., nom. indef., colloquially 'one of them'); 'one of them'
الْهَدِيَّةَ: الـ + هَدِيَّة — hadiyya, gift (f., acc., noun of لَعَلَّ); 'the gift'
الْجَدِيدِ: الـ + جَدِيد — jadīd, new (adj., gen.); 'the new'
الْمُنَاسِبَ: الـ + مُنَاسِب — munāsib, suitable, fitting (active participle of form III nāsaba; acc., predicate of كَانَ); 'the fitting thing'
قَتْلُهُ: قَتْلُ + هُ — qatl, killing (m., nom., subject of كَانَ) + -hu, his; 'his killing'
قُدُومِهِ: قُدُومِ + هِ — qudūm, arrival (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his arrival'
ذَكَّرْتَنِي: ذَكَّرْتَ + نِي — dhakkarta, to remind (form II, perf. 2 m. sg.; takes بِـ for the thing recalled) + -nī, me; 'you reminded me'
هَاتِهِ: هَاتِ + هِ — hāti, bring! (imperative of hāti) + -hi, him; 'bring him'
وَاضْرِبْ: وَ + اضْرِبْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḍrib, strike (verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.); 'and strike'
أُنَادِيَ: أُنَادِيَ — unādiya, to call out, proclaim (form III, imperf. 1 sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that I proclaim'
يَتَفَرَّجَ: يَتَفَرَّجَ — yatafarraja, to watch as a spectacle (form V, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ; takes عَلَى); 'that he watch'
فَيَأْتِيَ: فَـ + يَأْتِيَ — fa-, and so (conj.; result after a command) + yaʾtiya, to come (verb I defective, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive); 'so that there come'
التَّابِعُ: الـ + تَابِع — tābiʿ, follower (active participle of tabiʿa, nom.); 'the follower'
وَالْمَتْبُوعُ: وَ + الـ + مَتْبُوع — wa-, and (conj.) + matbūʿ, followed one (passive participle of tabiʿa, nom.); 'and the followed'
لِيَتَفَرَّجَ: لِـ + يَتَفَرَّجَ — li-, so that (prep./particle of purpose, with subjunctive) + yatafarraja, to watch as a spectacle (form V, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive); 'so that he watch'
وَأَشْفِيَ: وَ + أَشْفِيَ — wa-, and (conj.; continues the purpose) + ashfiya, to heal, satisfy (form IV, imperf. 1 sg., subjunctive); 'and I heal'
وَأَكْمِدَ: وَ + أَكْمِدَ — wa-, and (conj.; continues the purpose) + akmida, to mortify, sadden (form IV, imperf. 1 sg., subjunctive); 'and I mortify'
حُسَّادِي: حُسَّادِ + ي — ḥussād, enviers (pl. of ḥāsid, acc., object) + -ī, my; 'my enviers'
حَزِنُوا: حَزِنُوا — ḥazinū, to grieve (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they grieved'
الصِّغَارُ: الـ + صِّغَار — ṣighār, little ones (pl. of ṣaghīr, nom. after حَتَّى 'even'); 'the little ones'
الْمَكَاتِبِ: الـ + مَكَاتِب — makātib, schools (pl. of maktab, gen. after فِى); 'the schools'
وَالسُّوقَةُ: وَ + الـ + سُّوقَة — wa-, and (conj.) + sūqa, common people, market folk (collective, nom.); 'and the common folk'
الدَّكَاكِينِ: الـ + دَّكَاكِين — dakākīn, shops (pl. of dukkān, gen. after فِى); 'the shops'
وَتَسَابَقَ: وَ + تَسَابَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasābaqa, to race one another (form VI, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and raced'
يَأْخُذُونَ: يَأْخُذُونَ — yaʾkhudhūna, to take (verb I, imperf. 3 m. pl. indic.; circumstantial 'taking'); 'taking'
أَمَاكِنَ: أَمَاكِنَ — amākin, places (pl. of makān, acc., diptote); 'places'
مَاتَطْلُبُ: مَا + تَطْلُبُ — mā, what (interrogative) + taṭlubu, to seek, want (verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg. indic.); printed as one word; 'what do you want'
أَحْضِرْلِي: أَحْضِرْ + لِـ + ي — aḥḍir, bring (form IV, imperative 2 m. sg.) + li-, to, for (prep.; marks the one benefited) + -ī, me; printed as one word; 'bring me'
الْعَلَقَ: الـ + عَلَق — ʿalaq, leeches (collective; here as abuse for the prisoner, acc.); 'the leech'
إِيشِمْ: إِيشِمْ — īshim, 'what a …', apparently ايش 'what' (colloquial) with a contracted ما; obscure and a guess
ضَرَبْتُهُ: ضَرَبْتُ + هُ — ḍarabtu, to beat (verb I, perf. 1 sg.) + -hu, him; 'I beat him'
يُسَاعِدُنِي: yusāʿidu, he helps (Form III impf. 3m.sg. of سَاعَدَ, sāʿada, to help) + ـنِي, me (obj. pron., with nūn of protection)
بَلْوَائِي: balwā, affliction, trial (f.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron., after the hamza) — 'my affliction'
دَائِي: dāʾ, sickness, disease (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my sickness'
دَوَائِي: dawāʾ, remedy, medicine (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my remedy'
وَالْهَجْرُ: wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (def. art.) + hajr, separation, estrangement (m.)
اَضْنَى: aḍnā, he wore down, wasted (Form IV perf. 3m.sg. of أَضْنَى, from ضَنِيَ, to be worn with sickness); printed without hamza
مُهْجَتِي: muhja, heart's-blood, life (f.) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my heart's-blood'
وَحَشَاشَتِي: wa-, and (conj.) + ḥashāsha, the last remnant of life, last breath (f.) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'and my last breath'
احِبَّتِي: aḥibba, loved ones, friends (pl. of حَبِيب, ḥabīb, beloved) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.); printed without hamza — 'my loved ones'
اَعْدَائِي: aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of عَدُوّ, ʿaduww) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my enemies'; printed without hamza
مُشْفِقٌ: mushfiq, compassionate, tender (act. part. Form IV of أَشْفَقَ, to be tender-hearted), nom. indef.
يَرْثِي: yarthī, he pities, grieves for (impf. 3m.sg. of رَثَى, to pity)
لِحَالِي: li-, for, to (prep.; with رَثَى, 'pity for') + ḥāl, state, condition (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'for my state'
نِدَائِي: nidāʾ, call, cry (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my call'
فَالْمَوْتُ: fa-, for, and so (conj.) + al-, the (def. art.) + mawt, death (m.)
سَكَرَاتِهِ: sakarāt, throes, pangs (pl. of سَكْرَة, sakra, intoxication, agony) + ـهِ, its (poss. pron. 3m.) — 'its throes'
طِيبِ: ṭīb, goodness, sweetness (m.), gen. in iḍāfa
رَجَائِي: rajāʾ, hope (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my hope'
بِالْهَادِى: bi-, by (prep. of oath or entreaty, 'by the sake of') + al-, the (def. art.) + hādī, the guide (act. part. of هَدَى, to guide), printed with final ى
الْبَشِيرِ: al-, the (def. art.) + bashīr, bearer of good news (m.), gen., in apposition
الْمُصْطَفَى: al-, the (def. art.) + muṣṭafā, the chosen one (pass. part. Form VIII of صَفَا, 'to choose'), gen. in apposition
وَسَيِّدِ: wa-, and (conj.) + sayyid, lord, master (m.), gen. in iḍāfa
الشُّفَعَاءِ: al-, the (def. art.) + shufaʿāʾ, intercessors (pl. of شَفِيع, shafīʿ)
اَدْعُوكَ: adʿū, I call (impf. 1sg. of دَعَا, to call upon, pray to) + ـكَ, you (obj. pron. 2m.sg.); printed without hamza — 'I call upon You'
تُنْقِذُنِي: tunqidhu, you rescue (Form IV impf. 2m.sg. of أَنْقَذَ, to save), indic. for subjunctive as printed + ـنِي, me (obj. pron.) — 'that You rescue me'
وَتَغْفِرُ: wa-, and (conj.) + taghfiru, you forgive (impf. 2m.sg. of غَفَرَ, to forgive)
زَلَّتِي: zalla, slip, lapse, fault (f.) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my slip'
شِقْوَتِي: shiqwa, wretchedness, misery (f.) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my wretchedness'
وَعَنَائِي: wa-, and (conj.) + ʿanāʾ, toil, trouble (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'and my toil'
النَّظِيفَةَ: al-, the (def. art.) + naẓīfa, clean (f.sg. adj.), acc., agreeing with the broken plural as a feminine singular
وَسِخَيْنِ: wasikh, dirty (adj.), in the dual (ـَيْنِ), acc., agreeing with ثَوْبَيْنِ — 'two dirty ones'
فَنَظَرَهُ: fa-, and (conj., sequencing) + naẓara, he looked at (perf. 3m.sg. of نَظَرَ, here with a direct object) + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.)
بِعَدُوِّهِ: bi-, with (prep.; after فَإِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears — 'and behold, his enemy') + ʿaduww, enemy (m.) + ـِهِ, his (poss. pron.)
الشَّاعِرِ: al-, the (def. art.) + shāʿir, poet (m.), gen.
الْاَكَاسِرَةُ: al-, the (def. art.) + akāsira, the Chosroes, Persian emperors (pl. of كِسْرَى, Kisrā), nom.; printed without hamza
الْجَبَابِرَةُ: al-, the (def. art.) + jabābira, tyrants, mighty ones (pl. of جَبَّار, jabbār), nom., in apposition
الْاُلَى: al-, the (def. art.) + ulā, those, the ones (rel. pron. pl., 'the former ones' in context); printed without hamza
كَنَزُوا: kanazū, they hoarded (perf. 3m.pl. of كَنَزَ, to hoard, store up)
الْكُنُوزَ: al-, the (def. art.) + kunūz, treasures (pl. of كَنْز, kanz), acc.
بَقِينَ: baqīna, they (f.pl.) remained (perf. 3f.pl. of بَقِيَ, to remain), referring to the treasures
بَقُوا: baqū, they (m.pl.) remained (perf. 3m.pl. of بَقِيَ), referring to the kings
الْفَعَّالُ: al-, the (def. art.) + faʿʿāl, doer, one who does much (intensive of فَاعِل, from فَعَلَ, to do), nom. predicate
عَلِيُّ: ʿAlī (m. name), voc. after يَا — 'O ʿAlī' Also nom., as subject: ʿAliyyu ibnu Bakkārin, 'ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'.
أَتُخَوِّفُنِي: a-, interrogative hamza + tukhawwifu, you frighten (Form II impf. 2m.sg. of خَوَّفَ, to frighten) + ـنِي, me (obj. pron.)
أُفَكِّرْ: ufakkir, I think, reflect (Form II jussive 1sg. of فَكَّرَ, to think)
الْأَيَّامَ: al-, the (def. art.) + ayyām, days (pl. of يَوْم, yawm), acc. — 'the days', i.e. fate
نُصْحِكَ: nuṣḥ, advice, counsel (m.) + ـكَ, your (poss. pron. 2m.sg.) — 'your counsel'
دَعِ: daʿi, leave! let! (imper. 2m.sg. of وَدَعَ, to leave, with the linking kasra before the article)
الْاَيَّامَ: al-, the (def. art.) + ayyām, days (pl. of يَوْم), acc.; printed without hamza
وَطِبْ: wa-, and (conj.) + ṭib, be good, be at ease (imper. 2m.sg. of طَابَ, to be good)
يَحْمِلُوهُ: yaḥmilū, they carry, put (subj. 3m.pl. of حَمَلَ, to carry) + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.), the nūn dropped after أَنْ
صَعُبَ: ṣaʿuba, it was hard (perf. 3m.sg. of صَعُبَ, to be hard)
نَرْجُمْهُ: narjum, we stone (jussive 1pl. of رَجَمَ, to stone), after the imperative + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.)
وَنَقْطَعْهُ: wa-, and (conj.) + naqṭaʿ, we cut (jussive 1pl. of قَطَعَ, to cut) + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.)
تَفْعَلُوا: tafʿalū, you (pl.) do (jussive 2m.pl. of فَعَلَ, to do) — 'do not do'
مَحْتُومَةٍ: maḥtūma, decreed, fixed (pass. part. f. of حَتَمَ, to decree), gen. indef.
اَيَّامُهَا: ayyām, days (pl. of يَوْم), nom. + ـهَا, its (poss. pron. 3f.sg.), referring to the term; printed without hamza
اَدْخَلَتْنِى: adkhalat, she brought in (Form IV perf. 3f.sg. of أَدْخَلَ, to bring in), subject the lions + ـنِى, me (obj. pron.), printed with final ى; printed without hamza
الْاُسْدُ: al-, the (def. art.) + usd, lions (pl. of أَسَد, asad), nom.; printed without hamza
غَابَاتِهَا: ghābāt, thickets, forests, lairs (f.pl. of غَابَة, ghāba), gen. + ـهَا, their (poss. pron. 3f.sg.), 'their forests'
تَفْنِهَا: tafni, they (f.) destroy (jussive 3f.pl./sg. of فَنِيَ/أَفْنَى, to destroy) + ـهَا, it (obj. pron. 3f.sg.), referring to the term of life — 'would not finish it'
نَادَوْا: nādaw, they called out, proclaimed (Form III perf. 3m.pl. of نَادَى, to call)
جَزَاءِ: jazāʾ, recompense, reward (m.), gen. in iḍāfa
يُزَوِّرُ: yuzawwiru, he forges, fabricates (Form II impf. 3m.sg. of زَوَّرَ, to forge)
بِالْبَاطِلِ: bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + al-, the (def. art.) + bāṭil, falsehood, the false (m.) — 'with falsehood'
يَطُوفُونَ: yaṭūfūna, they go around, parade (impf. 3m.pl. of طَافَ, to circle)
أَوْقَفُوهُ: awqafū, they made stand, halted (Form IV perf. 3m.pl. of أَوْقَفَ, to stop) + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.)
وَعَلَّقُوهُ: wa-, and (conj.) + ʿallaqū, they hung, fixed (Form II perf. 3m.pl. of عَلَّقَ, to hang) + ـهُ, him (obj. pron.)
مَأْمُورٌ: maʾmūr, commanded, under orders (pass. part. of أَمَرَ), nom. indef.
أَقْضِيَهَا: aqḍiya, I fulfil (subj. 1sg. of قَضَى, to fulfil) + ـهَا, it (obj. pron. 3f.sg.)
يُخْرِجُ: yukhriju, he puts out, brings out (Form IV impf. 3m.sg. of أَخْرَجَ, to bring out); the damma and sukun are printed
وَخَلْفًا: wa-, and (conj.) + khalf, behind, back (m.), acc. indef. as adverb — 'behind'
اَرَى: arā, I see (impf. 1sg. of رَأَى, to see); printed without hamza
وَالسَّيَّافَ: wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (def. art.) + sayyāf, swordsman, executioner (m.), acc.
وَالنِّطْعَ: wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the (def. art.) + niṭʿ, leather execution mat (m.), acc.
اَحْضِرُوا: aḥḍirū, they brought (Form IV perf. 3m.pl. of أَحْضَرَ, to bring), 'they have been brought'; printed without hamza
فَنَادَيْتُ: fa-, and so (conj.) + nādaytu, I called out (Form III perf. 1sg. of نَادَى, to call out)
ذُلِّي: dhull, humiliation, abasement (m.) + ـي, my (poss. pron.), voc. after يَا — 'O my humiliation'
وَعِظَمَ: wa-, and (conj.) + ʿiẓam, greatness, magnitude (m.), acc. as part of the call (voc.)
مَصَائِبِي: maṣāʾib, calamities (pl. of مُصِيبَة, muṣība), gen. in iḍāfa + ـي, my (poss. pron.) — 'of my calamities'
خلًّا: khill, close friend (m.), acc. indef., printed with shadda and tanwīn but without a vowel on the first letter
شَفُوقًا: shafūq, tender, compassionate (adj. m.), acc. indef., agreeing with خلًّا
يُعِينُنِي: yuʿīnu, he helps (Form IV impf. 3m.sg. of أَعَانَ, to help) + ـنِي, me (obj. pron.)
سَأَلْتُكُمُوا: saʾaltu, I asked (perf. 1sg. of سَأَلَ, to ask) + ـكُمُوا, you (pl., obj. pron., the old long form with wāw)
رُدُّوا: ruddū, give back! (imper. 2m.pl. of رَدَّ, to return)
جَوَابِي: jawāb, answer (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my answer'
وَحَانَتْ: wa-, and (conj.) + ḥānat, she came due, drew near (perf. 3f.sg. of حَانَ, to come to be time)
مَنِيَّتِي: maniyya, death, appointed hour (f.) + ـتِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my death'
رَاحِمٌ: rāḥim, merciful (act. part. of رَحِمَ, to have mercy), nom. indef.
يَنَالُ: yanālu, he obtains, gains (subj. 3m.sg. of نَالَ, to obtain)
ثَوَابِي: thawāb, reward (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.), 'my reward', here meaning the reward from God
وَيَكْشِفُ: wa-, and (conj.) + yakshifu, he uncovers, lifts away (impf. 3m.sg. of كَشَفَ, to uncover)
بِشِرْبَةِ: bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + shirba, drink, draught (f.) — 'with a draught'
يَهُونَ: yahūna, it becomes easy, light (subj. 3m.sg. of هَانَ), 'may become light'; the printed form ends in نَ
عَذَابِي: ʿadhāb, torment (m.) + ـِي, my (poss. pron.) — 'my torment'
فَتَبَاكَتِ: فَـ + تَبَاكَتِ — fa-, and/so (conj., continuing the narrative) + tabākat, 3rd f. sg. perfect of تَبَاكَى (VI), to weep together / feign weeping; kasra on the final tā for the following article; 'and wept'
شَرْبَةَ: شَرْبَة — sharba, a drink, draught (f., acc., first term of an idafa; object of أَخَذَ)
قُلَّةَ: قُلَّة — qulla, jug, pitcher (f., acc., first term of an idafa; the print marks it with vowels)
فَكَسَرَهَا: فَـ + كَسَرَ + هَا — fa-, and so/then (conj.) + kasara, 3rd m. sg. perfect of كَسَرَ, to break + -hā, it (f. pron. suffix, the jug)
عَيْنَيْ: عَيْن — ʿayn, eye (f.) in the dual acc. construct (-ay); first term of an idafa; 'the two eyes of'
فَزَعَقَتِ: فَـ + زَعَقَتِ — fa-, and so (conj.) + zaʿaqat, 3rd f. sg. perfect of زَعَقَ, to shout, cry out (colloquial); kasra for the following article
سُؤَالُ: سُؤَال — suʾāl, asking, questioning (verbal noun, nom., first term of an idafa)
قَدْعَلَا: قَدْ + عَلَا — qad, already/had (particle with the perfect; printed joined to the verb) + ʿalā, 3rd m. sg. perfect of عَلَا, to rise; 'had risen'
وَعَجَاجٍ: وَ + عَجَاج — wa-, and + ʿajāj, thick dust, haze (m., gen., coordinated with غبار after بِـ)
مَلَأً: مَلَأَ + ً — malaʾa, 3rd m. sg. perfect of مَلَأَ, to fill (the print has a fatḥatān mark on the final alif, kept; read as plain 'filled')
الْجَوَّ: الـ + جَوّ — al-, the + jaww, air, sky (m., acc., object of ملأ)
وَالْخَلَا: وَ + الـ + خَلَا — wa-, and + al-, the + khalā, empty land, open country (m., acc., written with alif for the final -ʾ/-ā; pause form)
نَضْرِبَ: نَضْرِبَ — naḍriba, 1st pl. subjunctive of ضَرَبَ, to strike (after حَتَّى)
غُبَارَ: غُبَار — ghubār, dust (m., acc., predicate of كان and first term of an idafa)
مَجِيئِهِمْ: مَجِيء + هِمْ — majīʾ, coming (verbal noun of جَاءَ, gen. after فِي or in an iḍāfa; the hamza is printed on the yā) + -him, their (pron. suffix)
ثَلَٰثِينَ: ثَلَٰثِين — thalāthīna, thirty (acc. after مَكَثَ; printed ثلثين without the alif, marked with the dagger alif)
يَتَذَكَّرْ: يَتَذَكَّرْ — yatadhakkar, 3rd m. sg. jussive of تَذَكَّرَ (V), to remember
وَامْ: وَ + ام — wa-, and + am, printed for لم (lam), 'not' (the print has a stray alif where lām is expected; kept as printed); read 'and not'
يَذْكُرْهَا: يَذْكُرْ + هَا — yadhkur, 3rd m. sg. jussive of ذَكَرَ, to mention + -hā, it (f. pron. suffix, the story)
مَقْصُورَةِ: مَقْصُورَة — maqṣūra, closet, private chamber (f., gen. after إِلَى, first term of an idafa)
بُكَاءَهَا: بُكَاء + هَا — bukāʾ, weeping (verbal noun, acc., object) + -hā, her (pron. suffix)
خَيَالُكَ: خَيَال + كَ — khayāl, phantom, image (m., nom., subject) + -ka, your (m. sg. pron. suffix)
التَّبَاعُلِ: الـ + تَّبَاعُل — al-, the + tabāʿul, as printed (probably for تَبَاعُد 'being far apart'; a form of the verbal noun of تَبَاعَلَ); here 'remoteness' (gen. after فِي)
وَالتَّدَانِيْ: وَ + الـ + تَّدَانِي — wa-, and + al-, the + tadānī, being near to one another (verbal noun of تَدَانَى, gen. after فِي; final yā with sukun as printed)
وَذِكْرُكَ: وَ + ذِكْر + كَ — wa-, and + dhikr, remembrance, mention (m., nom.) + -ka, your (pron. suffix)
لِسَانِيْ: لِسَان + ي — lisān, tongue (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my (pron. suffix; final yā with sukun as printed)
بُكَاؤُهَا: بُكَاء + هَا — bukāʾ, weeping (m., nom., subject; hamza printed on the wāw) + -hā, her (pron. suffix)
الْمَقْصُورَةَ: الـ + مَقْصُورَة — al-, the + maqṣūra, closet, private chamber (f., acc.)
ثَلَٰتَ: ثَلَٰث — thalāta, three (acc., first term of an idafa; printed ثلت with tā for the final thāʾ, dagger alif supplied)
زَكَى: زَكَى — zakā, 3rd m. sg. perfect of زَكَا, to be pure, thrive
اَصْلاً: اَصْل — aṣl, origin, stock (m., acc. tanwīn, specification); 'pure as to origin'
وِلَادَةً: وِلَادَة — wilāda, birth (f., acc. tanwīn, specification); 'good as to birth'
وَاثْمَرَ: وَ + اَثْمَرَ — wa-, and + athmara, 3rd m. sg. perfect of أَثْمَرَ (IV), to bear fruit (printed without the hamza)
غُصْنًا: غُصْن — ghuṣn, branch (m., acc. tanwīn; with يانعًا, 'a ripe branch', object of أثمر)
يَانِعًا: يَانِع — yāniʿ, ripe, fresh (active participle of يَنَعَ, m., acc. tanwīn)
وَزَكَى: وَ + زَكَى — wa-, and + zakā, 3rd m. sg. perfect of زَكَا, to be pure
غَرْسًا: غَرْس — gharsan, planting, what is planted, stock (m., acc. tanwīn, specification); 'pure as to planting'
اُذَكِّرُكَ: اُذَكِّرُ + كَ — udhakkiru, 1st sg. imperfect of ذَكَّرَ (II), to remind + -ka, you (m. sg. pron. suffix, object)
الْوَعْدَ: الـ + وَعْد — al-, the + waʿd, promise (m., acc., second object of ذكّر)
الَّذِيْ: الَّذِي — alladhī, which, that (m. sg. relative pron.)
سَمَحَتْ: سَمَحَتْ — samaḥat, 3rd f. sg. perfect of سَمَحَ, to grant, be generous; with بِـ 'consent to, grant'
مَحَاسِنُكَ: مَحَاسِن + كَ — maḥāsin, fair qualities, excellences (pl., nom., subject) + -ka, your (pron. suffix)
الْحُسْنَى: الـ + حُسْنَى — al-, the + ḥusnā, fairest (f. elative of حَسَن, nom., describing محاسن)
وَحَاشَاكَ: وَ + حَاشَا + كَ — wa-, and + ḥāshā, far be it (exclamation, 'God forbid') + -ka, from you (pron. suffix)
تُنْسَى: تُنْسَى — tunsā, 3rd f. sg. imperfect passive of نَسِيَ, to forget; 'be forgotten' (subject is the promise, f. by agreement)
هَدِيَّةُ: hadiyya — gift, present (f., nom., predicate; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the gift of'
وَأُرِيدُإِ: وَ + أُرِيدُ + إِ — wa-, and (conj.) + urīdu, from arāda (IV), want, wish (impf. 1sg.) + i-, the initial alif of injāz, printed attached to the previous word by a misdivision; 'and I want'
نْجَازَ: njāz — the rest of إِنْجَاز injāz, accomplishment, fulfilment (verbal noun of anjaza IV, m., acc. object of urīdu), the initial alif of which the print attaches to the preceding word; 'the fulfilment of'
الْوَعْدِ: الْـ + وَعْد — al-, the + waʿd, promise (m., verbal noun of waʿada, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the promise'
وَعَدْتَنِي: وَعَدْتَ + نِي — waʿadta, from waʿada, promise (perf. 2m.sg.) + nī, me (1sg. object suffix, with the nūn of protection); 'you promised me'
تُرْسِلُنِي: تُرْسِلُ + نِي — tursilu, from arsala (IV), send (impf. 2m.sg., indicative, after anna) + nī, me (1sg. object suffix); 'you send me'
التَّشْرِيفِ: الْـ + تَشْرِيف — al-, the + tashrīf, conferring of honour, robe of honour (verbal noun of sharrafa II, m., gen. after maʿa); 'with the honouring'
ثَلَٰثُونَ: thalāthūn — thirty (numeral, nom. masc. plural ending -ūna; the print omits the alif of ثلاثون, marked here with a dagger alif); 'thirty'
أَذُقْ: adhuq — dhāqa, taste (impf. 1sg., jussive after lam); 'I have not tasted'
طَعْمَ: ṭaʿm — taste, flavour (m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the taste of'
الْبَرْمَكِيَّ: الْـ + بَرْمَكِيّ — al-, the + Barmakī, Barmakid, of the Barmak family (nisba adj., m., acc., in apposition to Jaʿfar); 'the Barmakid'
وَحَيَوٰةِ: وَ + حَيَاة — wa-, by (the particle of oath, governing the genitive) + ḥayāt, life (f., gen.; printed with wāw in place of the alif, marked here with a dagger alif; first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the life of'
مَكْرُوهٌ: makrūh — hateful, disliked, unpleasant (pass. part. of kariha, m., nom. indef., adj. of amr); 'a hateful (matter), a harm'
لَأُ: لَـ + أُ — la-, the oath-lām (introducing the oath answer 'I swear that I will') + u-, the first-person prefix of uhlikanna, whose hamza and ḍamma the print writes on the alif of the particle lā, separated by a misdivision from the verb; 'surely I'
هْلِكَنَّ: hlikanna — the rest of أُهْلِكَنَّ uhlikanna, from ahlaka (IV), destroy, bring to ruin (impf. 1sg., with the emphatic ending -anna of an oath); 'will destroy'
وَتَأْتِيَ: وَ + تَأْتِيَ — wa-, and (conj.; continuing the subjunctive 'and that you') + taʾtiya, from atā, come (impf. 2m.sg., subjunctive after an); with bi-, 'bring'
بِأَخْبَارِ: بِـ + أَخْبَار — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- means 'come with, bring') + akhbār, news, reports (broken pl. of khabar, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the news of, news of'
غِبْتَ: ghibta — ghāba, be absent, be gone (perf. 2m.sg., hollow verb); 'you are gone, you stay away'
مَسَافَةِ: masāfa — distance, stretch (f., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa; first term of another); 'the distance of'
وَأَنِّي: وَ + أَنَّ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + anna, that (conj.) + ī, I (1sg. suffix, acc.); 'and that I'
أَرْسَلْتُهُ: أَرْسَلْتُ + هُ — arsaltu, from arsala (IV), send (perf. 1sg.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix); 'I sent him'
بِكِتَابِي: بِـ + كِتَاب + ي — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + kitāb, letter, writing (m., gen.) + ī, my (1sg. suffix); 'with my letter'
عَمَلَ: ʿamal — deed, action, work (m., verbal noun of ʿamila, acc., object of wajadta; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the doing of, the conduct of'
فَاحْمِلْهُ: فَـ + احْمِلْ + هُ — fa-, then, so (conj. introducing the main clause after the conditional) + iḥmil, from ḥamala, carry, bring (imperative 2m.sg.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix); 'then bring him'
وَاحْمِلِ: وَ + احْمِلِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḥmili, from ḥamala, carry, bring (imperative 2m.sg., with kasra before the article); 'and bring'
الْهَيْئَةِ: الْـ + هَيْئَة — al-, the + hayʾa, state, condition, appearance (f., gen. after ʿalā; the print's own precomposed hamza); 'the state'
تَجِدُهُمْ: تَجِدُ + هُمْ — tajidu, wajada, find (impf. 2m.sg.) + hum, them (3m.pl. object suffix); 'you find them'
وَلَاتَغِيبْ: وَ + لَا + تَغِيبْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, do not (negative particle, written joined) + taghīb, ghāba, be absent (impf. 2m.sg., kept with its yā and sukun as printed); 'and do not be gone'
السَّمْعَ: الْـ + سَمْع — al-, the + samʿ, hearing (m., acc., verbal noun standing in for a verb); 'hearing'
وَالطَّاعَةَ: وَ + الْـ + طَاعَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṭāʿa, obedience (f., acc., coordinated with al-samʿa); 'and obedience'
تَسَابَقَتِ: tasābaqati — tasābaqa (VI), race one another, hasten (perf. 3f.sg., with kasra before the article); 'raced'
الْأَخْبَارُ: الْـ + أَخْبَار — al-, the + akhbār, news, reports (broken pl. of khabar, nom., subject); 'the reports'
بِحُضُورِ: بِـ + حُضُور — bi-, of, with, regarding (prep.) + ḥuḍūr, presence, arrival (verbal noun of ḥaḍara, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the arrival of'
الْهَرْجَ: الْـ + هَرْج — al-, the + harj, tumult, confusion (m., acc., object; part of the rhyming pair al-harj wa-al-marj); 'the tumult'
وَالْمَرْجَ: وَ + الْـ + مَرْج — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + marj, confusion, disorder (m., acc., a rhyming echo of al-harj); 'and the disorder'
وَالزِّحَامَ: وَ + الْـ + زِحَام — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + zihām, crowding, throng (m., acc., coordinated); 'and the crowd'
الِازْدِحَامُ: الْـ + ازْدِحَام — al-, the + izdiḥām, crowding, crush (verbal noun of izdaḥama VIII, m., nom., predicate); 'this crowd'
فَذَكَرُوا: فَـ + ذَكَرُوا — fa-, and so (conj. continuing the narrative) + dhakarū, dhakara, mention, tell (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and they told'
مَاهُمْ: مَا + هُمْ — mā, what (relative pron.) + hum, they (3m.pl. pron., written joined); 'what they (were)'
بِالطُّلُوعِ: بِـ + الْـ + طُلُوع — bi-, with, in (prep.; asraʿa bi- 'hasten to do') + al-, the + ṭulūʿ, going up, ascending (verbal noun of ṭaliʿa, gen.); 'to go up'
وَأَنَّهُ: وَ + أَنَّ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + anna, that (conj.) + hu, he, it (3m.sg., acc. suffix; here the 'pronoun of the matter'); 'and that'
وَالْوَزِيرِ: وَ + الْـ + وَزِير — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + wazīr, vizier (m., gen., coordinated with a preceding genitive); 'and the vizier'
وَأَحْبَسَهُمَا: وَ + أَحْبَسَ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥbasa, imprison, confine (IV, perf. 3m.sg., an uncommon form of ḥabasa) + humā, them both (3 dual object suffix); 'and he imprisoned them both'
بِإِطْلَاقِ: بِـ + إِطْلَاق — bi-, the preposition amara chooses for what is commanded + iṭlāq, release, setting free (verbal noun of aṭlaqa IV, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the release of'
الضِّيَافَةِ: الْـ + ضِيَافَة — al-, the + ḍiyāfa, hospitality, guest-right (f., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of hospitality'
صُبْحُ: ṣubḥ — morning, dawn (m., nom., subject of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the morning of'
سَايْمَانَ: Sāymān — the print's spelling of the name Sulaymān, with the lam printed as an alif (proper name, diptote, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of Sulaymān'
تَجَهَّزْ: tajahhaz — tajahhaza (V), make oneself ready (imperative 2m.sg.); 'get ready'
نُصَلِّى: nuṣallī — ṣallā (II), pray (impf. 1pl.; the print's final ى); 'we pray'
وَنَرْكَبُ: وَ + نَرْكَبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + narkabu, rakiba, ride, mount (impf. 1pl.); 'and we ride'
وَرَكِبُوا: وَ + رَكِبُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + rakibū, rakiba, ride (perf. 3m.pl.); 'and they rode'
وَمَعَهُمُ: وَ + مَعَ + هُمُ — wa-, and (conj.; introducing a circumstantial clause) + maʿa, with (prep.) + humu, them (3m.pl. suffix, with ḍamma before the article); 'and with them'
حَكَوْالَهُ: حَكَوْا + لَهُ — ḥakaw, ḥakā, relate, tell (perf. 3m.pl.) + la-hu, to him (li-, to + hu, him 3m.sg.), written joined; 'they told him'
وَجَدُوهُ: وَجَدُوا + هُ — wajadū, wajada, find (perf. 3m.pl.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix); 'they found him'
وَاضْرِبْهُ: وَ + اضْرِبْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḍrib, ḍaraba, strike (imperative 2m.sg.) + hu, it (3m.sg. suffix, the sword, 'with it'); 'and strike with it'
عَدُوِّكَ: عَدُوّ + كَ — ʿaduww, enemy (m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa) + ka, your (2m.sg. suffix); 'your enemy'
بِلَبَنِي: بِـ + لَبَن + ي — bi-, according to, by (prep.; ʿamila bi- 'act in accordance with') + laban, milk (m., gen.; here upbringing, nature) + ī, my (1sg. suffix); 'according to my milk, my nature'
فَاعْمَلْ: فَـ + اعْمَلْ — fa-, so, then (conj. answering the first clause) + iʿmal, ʿamila, act, do (imperative 2m.sg.); 'so act'
بِلَبَنِكَ: بِـ + لَبَن + كَ — bi-, according to, by (prep.) + laban, milk, upbringing (m., gen.) + ka, your (2m.sg. suffix); 'according to your milk, your nature'
خَدَ: khada — the first part of خَدَعَنِي khada'anī, split by the print into خد + عني, from khadaʿa, deceive; perf. 3m.sg.; 'he deceived'
عَنِي: ʿanī — the second part of خَدَعَنِي, split by the print: the ʿayn of the verb + nī, me (1sg. object suffix); together with the preceding word, 'he deceived me'
فَخَلَّ: فَـ + خَلَّ — fa-, and so (conj. continuing the line) + khalla (II), let go, release (perf. 3m.sg.; with ʿan, 'let go of'); 'and he let go'
بِخَدِيعَةٍ: بِـ + خَدِيعَة — bi-, by, by means of (prep.) + khadīʿa, deceit, trick (f., verbal noun of khadaʿa, gen. indef.); 'by a trick'
وَالْحُرُّ: وَ + الْـ + حُرّ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥurr, free man, noble (m., nom., topic, resumed by -hu in the verb); 'and the free man'
يُخْدِعُهُ: يُخْدِعُ + هُ — yukhdiʿu, from akhdaʿa (IV), deceive, beguile (impf. 3m.sg.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix, resuming al-ḥurr); 'deceives him'
الطَّيِّبُ: الْـ + طَيِّب — al-, the + ṭayyib, good, sweet, pleasant (adj., m., nom., qualifies al-kalām); 'the sweet'
اتْرُكْهُ: اتْرُكْ + هُ — utruk, taraka, leave, let alone (imperative 2m.sg.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix); 'leave him'
لِمَسْرُورٍ: لِـ + مَسْرُور — li-, to (prep., marking the one addressed; qāla li- 'say to') + Masrūr, Masrūr (proper name, the caliph's executioner, gen.); 'to Masrūr'
مَسْرُورُ: Masrūr — Masrūr (proper name, m., nom. as vocative or subject); 'Masrūr'
بِمُلْكِ: بِـ + مُلْك — bi-, with, for (prep.; ḥāja bi- 'need of') + mulk, kingship, rule (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the kingship of'
أَتَشَرَّفَ: atasharrafa — tasharrafa (V), be honoured (impf. 1sg., subjunctive after an); with bi-, 'be honoured by'; 'that I be honoured'
بِخِدْمَتِكَ: بِـ + خِدْمَة + كَ — bi-, with, by (prep.; tasharrafa bi- 'be honoured with') + khidma, service, attendance (f., gen.) + ka, your (2m.sg. suffix); 'with serving you'
وَأُشَاهِدَ: وَ + أُشَاهِدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ushāhida, shāhada (III), behold, look upon (impf. 1sg., subjunctive after an); 'and behold'
فَحَضَرَتْ: فَـ + حَضَرَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥaḍarat, ḥaḍara, be present, come (perf. 3f.sg.); 'and she came'
وَأَعْطَاهُمَا: وَ + أَعْطَى + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭā (IV), give (perf. 3m.sg.) + humā, them both (3 dual object suffix); 'and he gave them both'
قُصُورِ: quṣūr — palaces (broken pl. of qaṣr, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the palaces of'
مُرَتَّبَاتٍ: murattabāt — murattab, regular allowance, stipend (pass. part. of rattaba II, f. pl., acc. indef., object); 'stipends'
نُدْمَانِهِ: نُدْمَان + هِ — nudmān, boon companions, drinking-companions (pl. of nadīm, gen., after min) + hi, his (3m.sg. suffix); 'his boon companions'
مُقِيمًا: muqīm — residing, staying (act. part. of aqāma IV, m., acc. indef., ḥāl); 'residing'
الذَّعِيشِ: الْـ + ذَعِيش — al-, the + dhaʿīsh, a form printed with an unwanted ذ, probably a misprint for al-ʿaysh, life, living (m., gen. after fī); 'in the (good) life'
أَدْرَكَهُ: أَدْرَكَ + هُ — adraka (IV), overtake, reach (perf. 3m.sg.) + hu, him (3m.sg. object suffix); 'overtook him'
وَأَوْلَادِهِ: وَ + أَوْلَاد + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + awlād, children, sons (broken pl. of walad, gen.) + hi, his (3m.sg. suffix); 'and his children'
وَانِ: wāni — the rest of أَوَان awān, era, time (m., gen.), after the print's misdivision; with the preceding word, 'and of the era'
كَأنَّهُ: كَأَنَّ + هُ — ka-anna, as if, as though (particle, with the print's own precomposed hamza; takes its subject in the accusative) + hu, he (3m.sg., acc. suffix); 'as if he were'
فَصِيحُ: faṣīḥ — eloquent, fluent (adj., m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'eloquent of'
غَانِمُ: Ghānim — Ghānim (proper name, m., nom.; 'winning, gaining')
أَيُّوبَ: Ayyūb — Ayyūb, Job (proper name, diptote, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of Ayyūb'
الْمُتَيَّمُ: الْـ + مُتَيَّم — al-, the + mutayyam, enthralled by love, love-struck (pass. part. of tayyama II, m., nom., epithet of Ghānim); 'the love-enthralled'
الْمَسْلُوبُ: الْـ + مَسْلُوب — al-, the + maslūb, plundered, bereft (pass. part. of salaba, m., nom., epithet); 'the plundered'
فِتْنَةُ: Fitna — Fitna, 'temptation, enchantment' (proper name, f., nom., predicate)
فَرِيدَةٌ: farīda — unique, peerless (adj., f., nom. indef., describing the sister); 'unique'
وَجَمَا: وَ + جَمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + jamā, the first part of جَمَالِهَا jamālihā, loveliness, split by the print into جما + لها; together with the next word, 'and her loveliness'; also split from جَمَالِهِمَا, jamālihimā, as وجما + لهما: 'and their (two) loveliness'
وَالِدُهُمَا: وَالِد + هُمَا — wālid, father (act. part. of walada, m., nom., subject) + humā, their (3 dual suffix); 'their father'
السَّعِيدُأَنَّ: السَّعِيدُ + أَنَّ — al-saʿīd, fortunate, happy (adj., m.), 'the fortunate' + anna, that (introducing a clause), the print joining the two as one word; 'fortunate, that'
حِمْلٍ: حِمْل — ḥiml, load, burden (m.), gen. after miʾa; 'of a load'
الْخَزِّ: الـ + خَزّ — khazz, silk (a fine silk-wool stuff) (m.); 'the silk'
وَالدِّيبَاجِ: و + الـ + دِيبَاج — wa-, and (conj.) + dībāj, brocade (m.); 'and the brocade'
وَنَوَافِحِ: و + نَوَافِح — wa-, and + nawāfiḥ, pods (of musk), pl. of nāfija (f.), in construct, gen.; 'and pods of'
الْأَحْمَالِ: الـ + أَحْمَال — aḥmāl, loads, pl. of ḥiml (m.), gen. after ʿalā; 'the loads'
عُمِلَ: عَمِلَ — ʿamila, to make, do, work (passive 3rd m. sg., ʿumila; the print itself marks the damma on ʿayn); 'was made'
نِيَّتُهُ: نِيَّة + هُ — niyya, intention (f.) + -hu, his; 'his intention'
تَوَفَّاهُ: تَوَفَّى + هُ — tawaffā, to take in death, to cause to die (form V, perfect 3rd m. sg.; God is the subject) + -hu, him; 'took him (in death)'
الْأَحْمَالَ: الـ + أَحْمَال — aḥmāl, loads, pl. of ḥiml (m.), acc.; 'the loads'
أُمَّهُ: أُمّ + هُ — umm, mother (f.) + -hu, his; 'his mother', acc.
وَأَقَارِبَهُ: و + أَقَارِب + هُ — wa-, and + aqārib, relatives, pl. (m.) + -hu, his; 'and his relatives', acc.
وَأَهْلَ: و + أَهْل — wa-, and + ahl, people, family (m.), in construct, acc.; 'and the people of'
بَلْدَتِهِ: بَلْدَة + هِ — balda, town (f.) + -hi, his; 'his town'
مُتَوَكِّلًا: مُتَوَكِّل — mutawakkil, relying, trusting (active participle, form V), acc., as hāl (state); 'relying'
فَاكْتَرَى: فَـ + اكْتَرَى — fa-, and so (conj.) + iktarā, to hire, rent (form VIII perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'so he hired'
حَسَنَهْ: حَسَنَة — ḥasana, good, fine (f. adj.), printed with final hāʾ and read in pause as a Middle Arabic spelling; 'fine'
وَالْوَسَائِدِ: و + الـ + وَسَائِد — wa-, and + wasāʾid, cushions, pl. of wisāda (f.); 'and the cushions'
السُّتُورَ: الـ + سُتُور — sutūr, curtains, pl. of sitr (m.); 'the curtains', acc.
وَأَنْزَلَ: و + أَنْزَلَ — wa-, and + anzala, to lodge, cause to alight (form IV perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'and he lodged'
وَالْبِغَالَ: و + الـ + بِغَال — wa-, and + bighāl, mules, pl. of baghl (m.); 'and the mules', acc.
وَالْجِمَالَ: و + الـ + جِمَال — wa-, and + jimāl, camels, pl. of jamal (m.); 'and the camels', acc.
وَأَكَابِرُ: و + أَكَابِر — wa-, and + akābir, great ones, notables, pl. of akbar (m.), nom., in construct; 'and the notables of'
بُقْجَةً: بُقْجَة — buqja, bundle, parcel (f.; Turkish bohça); acc. indefinite; 'a bundle'
تَفَاصِيلَ: تَفَاصِيل — tafāṣīl, cuts, lengths (of cloth), pl. of tafṣīla (f.), gen. diptote; 'lengths'
النَّفِيسِ: الـ + نَفِيس — nafīs, precious, costly (adj.); 'the precious'
مَكْتُوبٍ: مَكْتُوب — maktūb, written (passive participle of kataba); here describing tafāṣīl; 'written' Also impersonal, describing a feminine noun: bi-ruqʿatin maktūbin fīhā, 'with a note in which was written'.
فَتَلَقَّوْهُ: فَـ + تَلَقَّوْا + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + talaqqaw, to meet, receive (form V perfect, 3rd m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'so they met him'
بِالتَّرْحِيبِ: بِـ + الـ + تَرْحِيب — bi-, with (prep.) + tarḥīb, welcome (m., verbal noun); 'with welcome'
وَسَلَّمُوا: و + سَلَّمُوا — wa-, and + sallamū, to greet (form II perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'and they greeted'
وَأَكْرَمُوهُ: و + أَكْرَمُوا + هُ — wa-, and + akramū, to honour (form IV perfect, 3rd m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they honoured him'
شَيْخِ: شَيْخ — shaykh, elder, head (m.), in construct, gen.; 'head of'
الْبُقْشَةَ: الـ + بُقْشَة — buqsha, bundle (f.; variant of buqja, Turkish bohça); 'the bundle', acc.
فَفَتَحَهَا: فَـ + فَتَحَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + fataḥa, to open (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'so he opened it'
التَّفَاصِيلَ: الـ + تَفَاصِيل — tafāṣīl, lengths of cloth (pl.); 'the lengths', acc.
غَانِمٌ: غَانِم — Ghānim, personal name (the winner, 'one who gains'), nom.
وَالتَّفَاصِيلَ: و + الـ + تَفَاصِيل — wa-, and + tafāṣīl, lengths of cloth (pl.); 'and the lengths', acc.
فَسَأَلَ: فَـ + سَأَلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + saʾala, to ask (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'so he asked'
تَكْسِبَ: كَسَبَ — kasaba, to earn (subjunctive, 2nd m. sg.); 'that you earn'
أَجْرًا: أَجْر — ajr, reward (m.), acc. indefinite; 'a reward'
وَتَمْشِيَ: و + تَمْشِيَ — wa-, and + mashā, to walk (subjunctive, 2nd m. sg.); 'and walk'
الْجَنَازَةِ: الـ + جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, bier (f.); 'the funeral'
وَصَلَّوْا: و + صَلَّوْا — wa-, and + ṣallaw, to pray (form II perfect, 3rd m. pl.; ṣallā ʿalā, 'pray over'); 'and they prayed'
حَيَاءٍ: حَيَاء — ḥayāʾ, shyness, bashfulness (m.), gen. indefinite; 'out of shyness'
بِالْجَنَازَةِ: بِـ + الـ + جَنَازَة — bi-, with (prep.; here 'carrying, with') + janāza, funeral, bier (f.); 'with the bier'
الْمَدْفَنِ: الـ + مَدْفَن — madfan, burial place (m.); 'the burial place'
نَصَبُوا: نَصَبَ — naṣabū, to pitch, set up (perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'they pitched'
الْخَيْمَةَ: الـ + خَيْمَة — khayma, tent (f.); 'the tent', acc.
دَفَنُوا: دَفَنَ — dafana, to bury (perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'they buried'
الْمَيِّتَ: الـ + مَيِّت — mayyit, dead man (m.); 'the dead man', acc.
الْقُرَّاءُ: الـ + قُرَّاء — qurrāʾ, reciters (of the Qurʾān), pl. of qāriʾ (m.); 'the reciters'
يَقْرَءُونَ: قَرَأَ — qaraʾa, to read, recite (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'reading', as hāl
الْحَيَاءُ: الـ + حَيَاء — ḥayāʾ, shyness, modesty (m.); 'the shyness', nom. Also 'shame': ishtadda bihi al-ḥayāʾu, 'shame weighed on him'.
أُفَارِقَهُمْ: فَارَقَ + هُمْ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (form III subjunctive, 1st sg.) + -hum, them; 'that I leave them'
أَنْصَرِفَ: انْصَرَفَ — inṣarafa, to depart, go away (form VII subjunctive, 1st sg., after ḥattā); 'until I depart'
فَتَوَضَّأَ: فَـ + تَوَضَّأَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tawaḍḍaʾa, to perform ablution (form V perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'so he made his ablutions'
وَالْحَلْوَى: وَ + الـ + حَلْوَى — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥalwā, sweet, sweetmeat (f.); 'and the sweets'
وَغَسَلُوا: وَ + غَسَلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ghasala, to wash; 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they washed'
مَكَانَهُمْ: مَكَان + هُمْ — makān, place, spot (m.), accusative of place + -hum, their; 'their place'
فَاشْتَغَلَ: فَـ + اشْتَغَلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ishtaghala, to be occupied, busy (form VIII); 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'so was occupied'
خَاطِرُ: خَاطِر — khāṭir, mind, thought, heart (m.); nominative, in the construct 'the mind of'
غَانِمٍ: غَانِم — Ghānim, a man's name ('winner, gainer'); genitive, in the construct 'of Ghānim'
بِمَكَانِهِ: بِـ + مَكَان + ـهِ — bi-, with, over, about (prep.; here after اشْتَغَلَ 'be occupied with') + makān, place + -hi, his; 'with his place'
وَبِضَاعَتِهِ: وَ + بِـ + بِضَاعَة + ـهِ — wa-, and + bi-, with (prep., as above) + biḍāʿa, merchandise, wares (f.) + -hi, his; 'and with his merchandise'
اللُّصُوصِ: الـ + لُصُوص — luṣūṣ, thieves (pl. of liṣṣ); genitive after مِنَ 'from the thieves'
أَنَارَجُلٌ: أَنَا + رَجُل — anā, I (pron.) + rajul, man (m.); nominative predicate; printed as one word; 'I am a man'
وَمُتَّهَمٌ: وَ + مُتَّهَم — wa-, and (conj.) + muttaham, accused, suspected (passive participle of ittahama, form VIII); 'and suspected'
وَالْأَحْمَالِ: وَ + الـ + أَحْمَال — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aḥmāl, loads, bales (pl. of ḥiml); 'and the loads'
مَتَاعِهِ: مَتَاع + ـهِ — matāʿ, goods, belongings (m.) + -hi, his; 'his belongings'
وَاسْتَأْذَنَهُمْ: وَ + اسْتَأْذَنَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + istaʾdhana, to ask leave (form X); 3rd m. sg. perfect + -hum, them; 'and he asked their leave'
وَيَتْبَعُ: وَ + يَتْبَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tabiʿa, to follow; 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'and follows'
غَادِيًا: غَادِيًا — ghādin, going out in the morning (active participle of ghadā); accusative (hal), tanwīn fatḥ
رَائِحًا: رَائِحًا — rāʾiḥ, going in the evening, returning (active participle of rāḥa); accusative (hal), tanwīn fatḥ
يَنْبَحُونَ: يَنْبَحُونَ — nabaḥa, to bark; 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'they bark/barking'
وَالذِّيَابِ: وَ + الـ + ذِيَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + dhiyāb, wolves (colloquial pl. of dhiʾb, Classical dhiʾāb, written without the hamza); genitive; 'and the wolves'
بِاللَّٰهِ: بِـ + اللّٰه — bi-, by, with, through (prep.) + Allāh, God; 'through God'
جْلِهِ: جْلِ + هِ — the rest of أَجْلِهِ: ajl, sake, account (m.), genitive + -hi, its; 'its sake' (printed apart from the preceding لا)
مُحَوَّطَةً: مُحَوَّطَة — muḥawwaṭa, walled, enclosed (passive participle, form II of ḥāṭa; f.); accusative, tanwīn fatḥ
حِيطَانٍ: حِيطَان — ḥīṭān, walls (pl. of ḥāʾiṭ); genitive, 'four walls'
نَخْلَةٌ: نَخْلَة — nakhla, palm tree (f.); nominative, indefinite
مَفْتُوحٌ: مَفْتُوح — maftūḥ, open (passive participle of fataḥa); nominative, indefinite, describing 'a door'
فَدَخَلَهَا: فَـ + دَخَلَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + dakhala, to enter; 3rd m. sg. perfect + -hā, it (f.), direct object; 'so he entered it'
يَنَامَ: يَنَامَ — nāma, to sleep; 3rd m. sg. imperfect, subjunctive after أَنْ; 'that he sleep'
يَجِئْهُ: يَجِئْ + هُ — jāʾa, to come; 3rd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ + -hu, to him/him; 'came to him'
رَجْفَةٌ: رَجْفَة — rajfa, trembling, shaking (f.); nominative, subject
وَوَحْشَةٌ: وَ + وَحْشَة — wa-, and (conj.) + waḥsha, loneliness, dread, desolation (f.); nominative; 'and a dread'
بِنُورٍ: بِـ + نُور — bi-, with (prep.; after إِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears) + nūr, light (m.); 'and behold, a light'
فَرَأيٰ: فَـ + رَأَىٰ — fa-, and so (conj.) + raʾā, to see; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'so he saw' (printed with ي, read with a dagger alif)
النُّورَ: الـ + نُور — nūr, light (m.); accusative object, 'the light'
تُؤَدِّي: تُؤَدِّي — addā, to lead, convey (form II); 3rd f. sg. imperfect; 'it leads' (the print omits the hamza; ṭarīq is treated as feminine)
وَتَدَارَى: وَ + تَدَارَىٰ — wa-, and (conj.) + tadārā, to hide oneself, take cover (form VI); 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he hid'
النُّورُ: الـ + نُور — nūr, light (m.); nominative, subject, 'the light'
يَتَقَرَّبُ: يَتَقَرَّبُ — taqarraba, to draw near (form V); 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'draws near/drawing near'
فَشَيْئًا: فَـ + شَيْئًا — fa-, and then (conj.) + shayʾan, a little; 'and then a little', i.e. 'bit by bit'
شَائِلَانِ: شَائِلَانِ — shāʾil, lifting, carrying (active participle of shāla); dual nominative; 'two carrying'
وَوَاحِدٌ: وَ + وَاحِد — wa-, and (conj.) + wāḥid, one (m.); nominative; 'and one'
وَفَأْسٌ: وَ + فَأْس — wa-, and (conj.) + faʾs, axe (m.); nominative; 'and an axe'
فَحِينَ: فَـ + حِينَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥīna, when, at the time that (conj., accusative); 'so when'
قَرُبُوا: قَرُبُوا — qaruba, to draw near; 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'they drew near'
أَحَدُ: أَحَد — aḥad, one (m.); nominative, in the construct 'one of'
الْعَبْدَيْنِ: الـ + عَبْدَيْنِ — ʿabd, slave (m.), dual genitive in the construct, 'the two slaves'
شَائِلِينَ: شَائِلِينَ — shāʾil, carrying (active participle of shāla); m. pl. oblique in the ending -īna (non-Classical here, for the nominative dual); 'carrying'
يَاصَوَابُ: يَا + صَوَاب — yā, O (vocative particle) + Ṣawāb, a slave's name ('right, correct'); printed as one word
كَافُورُ: كَافُور — Kāfūr, a slave's name ('camphor'); nominative after the vocative
وَخَلَّيْنَا: وَ + خَلَّيْنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + khallā, to leave, let be (colloquial form II); 1st pl. perfect; 'and we left'
هَاهُوَ: هَا + هُوَ — hā, behold (particle) + huwa, it/he (pron.); printed as one word; 'here it is'
مُتَرْبَسٌ: مُتَرْبَس — mutarbas, bolted, barred (a colloquial participle; the root is uncertain, possibly from a word for a bolt or bar; the vocalisation is a guess)
حَامِلُ: حَامِل — ḥāmil, bearer, carrying (active participle of ḥamala); nominative, in the construct 'bearer of'
الْفَأْسِ: الـ + فَأْس — faʾs, axe (m.); genitive, in the construct 'the axe'
بُخَيْتًا: بُخَيْت — Bukhayt, a slave's name (diminutive of bakht, 'luck'); accusative as the predicate of كَانَ, tanwīn fatḥ
عَقْلَكُمَا: عَقْل + كُمَا — ʿaql, mind, sense (m.), accusative object + -kumā, your (two); 'your two minds'
تَعْرِفَانِ: تَعْرِفَانِ — ʿarafa, to know; 2nd m. dual imperfect; 'you two know'
يَخْرُجُونَ: يَخْرُجُونَ — kharaja, to go out; 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'they go out'
وَيَرْعَوْنَ: وَ + يَرْعَوْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + raʿā, to pasture, graze (their animals); 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'and they pasture'
فَيُمْسِي: فَـ + يُمْسِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + amsā, to enter the evening (form IV); 3rd m. sg. imperfect; 'so (the evening) comes upon'
فَيَدْخُلُونَ: فَـ + يَدْخُلُونَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + dakhala, to enter; 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'so they enter'
وَيُغْلِقُونَ: وَ + يُغْلِقُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aghlaqa, to lock, shut (form IV); 3rd m. pl. imperfect; 'and they lock'
يَأْخُذُوهُمْ: يَ + أْخُذُوا + هُمْ — akhadha, to take, seize; ya-…-ū, they (m. pl.), subjunctive after أَنْ; -hum, them; 'that they seize them'
وَيَشْوُوهُمْ: وَ + يَشْوُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and; shawā, to roast, grill; ya-…-ū, they (subjunctive); -hum, them; 'and (that) they roast them'
وَيَأْ: وَ + يَأْ — wa-, and; yaʾ-, the first syllable of the verb yaʾkulūhum 'they eat them', cut off by the print's word-space; read with the next word
كُلُوهُمْ: (يَأْ)كُلُوهُمْ — akala, to eat; -ū, they; -hum, them; second half of the split verb 'and they eat them'
إِنَّكُمْ: إِنَّ + كُمْ — inna, indeed (particle opening a statement); -kum, you (m. pl.); 'indeed you'
تُصَدِّقُونِي: تُ + صَدِّقُ + ونَ + نِي — ṣaddaqa, to believe, hold true (form II); tu-…-ūna, you (m. pl.); -nī, me; 'you believe me'
وَنَجِدَ: وَ + نَجِدَ — wa-, and; wajada, to find; na-, we; subjunctive continuing the حَتَّى clause; 'and we find'
لَمَّارَأَى: لَمَّا + رَأَى — lammā, when (conj. + past verb); raʾā, to see; 'when he saw' (the print joins the two words)
وَرَأَانَا: وَ + رَأَا + نَا — wa-, and; raʾā, to see; -nā, us; 'and (he) saw us' (the print runs the letters together)
أَلْعَنَ: alʿan, most accursed (elative of the root laʿana 'to curse'); accusative, first term of a vocative construct
وَلَابِهَذَا: وَ + لَا + بِـ + هَذَا — wa-, and; lā, not; bi-, with, by (prep.; the verb, such as 'bless', is left unsaid); hādhā, this (m.); 'and not with this'
وَلَابِهَذِهِ: وَ + لَا + بِـ + هَذِهِ — wa-, and; lā, not; bi-, with, by (prep.; verb left unsaid); hādhihi, this (f.); 'and not with this'
الْمَعْرِفَةِ: الـ + مَعْرِفَة — maʿrifa, knowledge, cleverness (f.); genitive
أَيْش: aysh, what? (colloquial contraction of أَيُّ شَيْءٍ 'which thing')
قَالَا: qāla + ā — qāla, to say; -ā, they two (dual); 'the two said'
الْفَاسُ: الـ + فَاس — fās, axe, pickaxe (m.); nominative, subject of 'is with him'
تَعَلَّقْ: taʿallaq, hang on, climb up (imperative of تَعَلَّقَ, form V 'to cling')
وَافْتَحْ: وَ + اِفْتَحْ — wa-, and; iftaḥ, open! (imperative of فَتَحَ); 'and open'
بَخِيتُ: Bakhīt, personal name (from colloquial bakht, 'luck'); vocative
شَيْلِ: shayl, carrying, lifting (colloquial verbal noun of شَالَ); genitive in construct
رِقَابِنَا: رِقَاب + نَا — riqāb, necks (pl. of رَقَبَة); -nā, our; 'our necks'
فَتَحْتَ: fataḥa, to open; -ta, you (m. sg.); 'you open/opened'
نُمْسِكُهُمْ: نُ + مْسِكُ + هُمْ — amsaka, to seize, catch (form IV); nu-, we; -hum, them; 'we catch them'
وَنَقْلِيهِ: وَ + نَقْلِي + هِ — wa-, and; qalā, to fry; na-, we; -hi, him; 'and we fry him'
بِصَنْعَةٍ: بِـ + صَنْعَة — bi-, with (prep., of manner); ṣanʿa, craft, skill (f.); 'with skill'
لَايَضِيعُ: لَا + يَضِيعُ — lā, not; ḍāʿa, to be lost, go to waste; ya-, it; 'is not lost'
دُهْنِهِ: دُهْن + هِ — duhn, fat, grease (m.); -hi, his; 'his fat'
اِفْتَكَرْتُهُ: iftakara, to think of, recall (form VIII, colloquial); -tu, I; -hu, it; 'that I thought of'
نَرْمِى: ramā, to throw; na-, we; 'we throw'
وَرَاءِ: warāʾ, behind, beyond (m.); genitive in construct
ذَخِيرَتُنَا: ذَخِيرَة + نَا — dhakhīra, stored goods, treasure, provision (f.); -nā, our; nominative, predicate
رَمَيْنَاهُ: رَمَى + نَا + هُ — ramā, to throw; -nā, we; -hu, it; 'we throw it'
يَنْكَسِرْ: inkasara, to break, be broken; ya-, it; jussive in the apodosis; 'it will break'
جَوَّالتُّرْبَةِ: جَوَّ + الـ + تُرْبَة — jawwa, inside, interior (colloquial); accusative of place; turba, tomb (f.), genitive; 'inside the tomb' (the print runs it into one word)
الْحَرَامِيَّةُ: الـ + حَرَامِيَّة — ḥarāmiyya, thieves, robbers (colloquial pl. of حَرَامِي, from حَرَام 'unlawful'); nominative
يَقْتُلُونَ: qatala, to kill; ya-…-ūna, they (m. pl.); 'they kill'
وَيَسْرِقُونَ: وَ + يَسْرِقُونَ — wa-, and; saraqa, to steal; ya-…-ūna, they; 'and they steal'
الْأَشْيَاءَ: الـ + أَشْيَاء — ashyāʾ, things, goods (pl. of شَيْء); accusative, object
وَيَقْسِمُونَ: وَ + يَقْسِمُونَ — wa-, and; qasama, to divide, share out; ya-…-ūna, they; 'and they share out'
مَايَكُونُ: مَا + يَكُونُ — mā, what, whatever (rel.); yakūnu, is (kāna 'to be'); 'whatever is'
الْحَامِلَانِ: الـ + حَامِلَانِ — ḥāmilān, carriers, bearers (dual nominative of حَامِل)
يَقْدِرُونَ: qadara, to be able; ya-…-ūna, they; 'they are able'
حَمَلَا: ḥamala, to carry, lift; -ā, they two; 'the two lifted'
وَتَعَلَّقَا: وَ + تَعَلَّقَا — wa-, and; taʿallaqa, to cling, scramble up (form V); -ā, they two; 'and they climbed'
وَفَتَحَا: وَ + فَتَحَا — wa-, and; fataḥa, to open; -ā, they two; 'and they opened'
بِالْفَانُوسِ: بِـ + الـ + فَانُوس — bi-, with (prep.; here 'holding'); fānūs, lantern (m.)
وَالْفَاسِ: وَ + الـ + فَاس — wa-, and; fās, axe (m.); genitive
وَالْمِقْطَفِ: وَ + الـ + مِقْطَف — wa-, and; miqṭaf, basket (m.); genitive
الْجِبْسِ: الـ + جِبْس — jibs, gypsum, plaster (m.); genitive
وَقَفَلُوا: وَ + قَفَلُوا — wa-, and; qafala, to lock; -ū, they; 'and they locked'
وَالشَّيْلِ: وَ + الـ + شَيْل — wa-, and; shayl, carrying (colloquial verbal noun); genitive
وَالْحَطِّ: وَ + الـ + حَطّ — wa-, and; ḥaṭṭ, putting down, setting down (verbal noun of حَطَّ); genitive
وَفَتْحِ: وَ + فَتْح — wa-, and; fatḥ, opening (verbal noun of فَتَحَ); genitive in construct
وَقَفْلِهِ: وَ + قَفْل + هِ — wa-, and; qafl, locking; -hi, its; 'and locking it'
نِصْفُ: niṣf, half (m.); nominative, first term of a construct
نَرْتَاحَ: irtāḥa, to rest, take ease (form VIII); na-, we; subjunctive after حَتَّى; 'we rest'
سَاعَاتٍ: sāʿāt, hours (pl. of سَاعَة); genitive after a numeral
نَقُومَ: qāma, to rise, get up; na-, we; subjunctive; 'we rise'
وَنَقْضِيَ: وَ + نَقْضِيَ — wa-, and; qaḍā, to accomplish, fulfil; na-, we; subjunctive; 'and we fulfil'
تَطْوِيشِهِ: taṭwīsh, making (someone) a eunuch (verbal noun of ṭawwasha) + -hi, his; 'his being made a eunuch'
الْمُبْتَدَأِ: الـ + مُبْتَدَأ — al-, the + mubtadaʾ, beginning (m.); 'the beginning'
فَوَاتِ: fawāt, passing away, being missed (verbal noun of fāta); 'the passing of'
وَنَأْخُذُ: و + نَأْخُذُ — wa-, and + naʾkhudhu, we take (imperf. of akhadha); 'and we take'
الْفَانُوسِ: الـ + فَانُوس — al-, the + fānūs, lantern (m.); 'the lantern'
وَاسْمُهُ: و + اِسْم + هُ — wa-, and + ism, name (m.) + -hu, his; 'and his name'
بَخِيتٌ: Bakhīt, a man's name (from bakht, luck, fortune); 'Bakhīt'
أَحْكِي: aḥkī, I tell, relate (imperf. of ḥakā); 'I tell'
تَالَمْ: tālam, printed form, apparently a slip for takallam (imperative of takallama), 'speak!'
أَجَاءَ: ajāʾa, he brought, drove (form IV of jāʾa); here 'brought' (with bi-)
الْجَلَّابُ: الـ + جَلَّاب — al-, the + jallāb, slave-dealer, importer (m.); 'the slave-dealer'
فَبَاعَنِي: فَـ + بَاعَ + نِي — fa-, and so + bāʿa, he sold (perf. of bāʿa) + -nī, me; 'and he sold me'
جَاوِيشٍ: jāwīsh, sergeant (Turkish çavuş), genitive in apposition; 'a sergeant'
فَتَرَبَّيْتُ: فَـ + تَرَبَّيْتُ — fa-, and so + tarabbaytu, I was brought up (form V of rabā); 'and so I was raised'
أُلَاعِبُ: ulāʿibu, I play with (imperf. of form III lāʿaba); 'I play with'
وَأَرْقُصُ: و + أَرْقُصُ — wa-, and + arquṣu, I dance (imperf. of raqaṣa); 'and I dance'
وَأُغَنِّي: و + أُغَنِّي — wa-, and + ughannī, I sing (imperf. of form II ghannā); 'and I sing'
أَخَذُونِي: أَخَذُوا + نِي — akhadhū, they took (perf. of akhadha) + -nī, me; 'they took me'
لِأَبِيهَا: لِـ + أَبِي + هَا — li-, to (prep.; with dhakara, 'mention to') + abī, father (m., genitive) + -hā, her; 'to her father'; also: li- marking the one addressed after qālat, 'said to her father', and the one sent to after arsalat, 'sent to her father' (Night 179)
لِمَحَبَّتِهِمْ: لِـ + مَحَبَّة + هِمْ — li-, for the sake of (prep.) + maḥabba, love (f.) + -him, their; 'for their love'
أُمَّهَا: umm, mother (f.), accusative after inna + -hā, her; 'her mother'
خَطَبَتْ: khaṭabat, she asked in marriage, sought as a bride (perf. of khaṭaba), with la-: 'for'; 'she sought a match'
يُزَيِّنُ: yuzayyinu, he adorns, grooms, barbers (imperf. of form II zayyana); 'he used to barber'
وَأَمْهَرَتْهَا: و + أَمْهَرَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + amharat, she gave a marriage-portion (perf. of form IV amhara) + -hā, her; 'and she paid the bride-price for her'
