وَجَهَّزَتْهَا: و + جَهَّزَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + jahhazat, she equipped (perf. of form II jahhaza) + -hā, her; 'and she outfitted her'
بِحَالِهَا: بِـ + حَال + هَا — bi-, of, about (prep.; with ʿalima, 'know of') + ḥāl, state, condition (m.) + -hā, her; 'of her condition'; also after aʿlama, 'to inform', bi- marks the news: aʿlamūhu bi-ḥālihā, 'they told him of her state' (Night 193)
يَجْتَهِدُونَ: yajtahidūna, they strive, exert themselves (imperf. of form VIII ijtahada); 'striving'
تَحْصِيلِ: taḥṣīl, procuring, acquiring (verbal noun of form II ḥaṣṣala), genitive in construct; 'the procuring of'
أَمْسَكُونِي: أَمْسَكُوا + نِي — amsakū, they seized (perf. of form IV amsaka) + -nī, me; 'they seized me'
وَطَوَّشُونِي: و + طَوَّشُوا + نِي — wa-, and + ṭawwashū, they made a eunuch (perf. of form II ṭawwasha, from ṭawāshī, eunuch) + -nī, me; 'and they made me a eunuch'
زَفُّوهَا: زَفُّوا + هَا — zaffū, they conducted a bride in procession (perf. of zaffa) + -hā, her; 'they led her in procession'
جَعَلُونِي: جَعَلُوا + نِي — jaʿalū, they made, appointed (perf. of jaʿala) + -nī, me; 'they made me'
طَوَّاشِيًّا: ṭawwāshī, eunuch attendant (m.), accusative as second object; 'a eunuch attendant'
امَهَا: ā + -mahā, second half of the misspaced quddāmahā, 'in front of her'
رَوَاحُهَا: rawāḥ, going, going away (verbal noun of rāḥa) + -hā, her; 'her going'
سَتَرُوا: satarū, they covered, concealed (perf. of satara); 'they concealed'
أَمْرَهَا: amr, matter, affair (m.), accusative + -hā, her; 'her affair'
الدُّخْلَةِ: الـ + دُخْلَة — al-, the + dukhla, the going-in, the wedding night (f.); 'the wedding night'
ذَبَحُوا: dhabaḥū, they slaughtered, cut the throat of (perf. of dhabaḥa); 'they slaughtered'
حَمَامَةٍ: ḥamāma, dove, pigeon (f.), genitive in construct; 'of a pigeon'
أَتَمَلَّى: atamallā, I take my fill, enjoy fully (imperf. of form V tamallā, with bi-); 'I enjoy to the full'
وَرُقَادٍ: و + رُقَاد — wa-, and + ruqād, lying down, sleeping (m.); 'and lying beside her'
وَأُمُّهَا: و + أُمّ + هَا — wa-, and + umm, mother (f.) + -hā, her; 'and her mother'
ارْتَفَقْتُ: irtafaqtu, I took comfort, benefit (perf. of form VIII irtafaqa, with bi-); 'I have found comfort'
إِحْلِيلِي: iḥlīl, urethra (m.), here the male organ + -ī, my; 'my member'
ابْتِدَاءِ: ابْتِدَاء — ibtidāʾ, beginning (m.), here genitive after فِي
أَكْذِبُ: كَذَبَ — kadhaba, to lie; 1st sg. imperfect, 'I lie'
الْجَلَّابَةِ: الـ — al-, the + جَلَّاب — jallāb, slave-dealer, importer (m.), plural جَلَّابَة, genitive after عَلَى; 'the dealers'
كَذْبَةً: كَذْبَة — kadhba, a lie (f.), accusative object; 'a lie'
يَقَعُوا: وَقَعَ — waqaʿa, to fall; 3rd masc. pl. subjunctive after حَتَّى (the nūn is dropped); 'they fall'
فَقَلِقَ: فَ + قَلِقَ — fa-, so, then (conj.), qaliqa, to be uneasy, restless; 3rd masc. sg. perfect; 'and he grew uneasy'
وَأَنْزَلَنِي: وَ + أَنْزَلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + anzala, to cause to descend, put (IV, perfect 3rd masc. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and he put me'
يَشْتَرِ: اشْتَرَى — ishtarā, to buy (VIII); 3rd masc. sg. jussive (the final yā' dropped after مَنْ); 'whoever buys'
عَيْبِهِ: عَيْب — ʿayb, fault, defect (m.) + ـِهِ — his; 'his fault'
عَيْبُهُ: عَيْب — ʿayb, fault (m.) + ـُهُ — his; 'his fault' (nominative, predicate of مَا)
يَكْذِبُ: كَذَبَ — kadhaba, to lie; 3rd masc. sg. imperfect, 'he lies'
أَعْطَوْا: أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, to give (IV); 3rd masc. pl. perfect, 'they gave'
سِتُّمِائَةِ: سِتّ — sitt, six + مِائَة — miʾa, hundred (f.), written as one word and in construct; 'six hundred'
الْجَلَّابِ: الـ + جَلَّاب — jallāb, dealer (m.), genitive; 'the dealer'
وَأَوْصَلَنِي: وَ + أَوْصَلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + awṣala, to cause to arrive, conduct (IV, 3rd masc. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'and he took me'
دَلَالَتَهُ: دَلَالَة — dalāla, the crier's fee, brokerage (f.), accusative object + ـهُ — his; 'his fee'
فَكَسَانِي: فَ + كَسَا + ـنِي — fa-, then + kasā, to clothe (3rd masc. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'and he clothed me'
يُنَا: يُنَاسِبُنِي (first part) — yunāsibunī, 'it suits me', printed divided as يُنَا + سِبُنِي; the first half of the one word
سِبُنِي: يُنَاسِبُنِي (second part) — yunāsibunī, from نَاسَبَ — nāsaba, to suit, befit (III) + -nī, me; 'suits me'; the second half of the word printed divided
سَنَتِي: سَنَة — sana, year (f.) + ـِي — my; 'my year'
هَلَّتِ: هَلَّ — halla, to appear (of a new moon or season), come in; 3rd fem. sg. perfect, 'came in' (with the vowel before the article)
بِالْخَيْرِ: بِـ + الـ + خَيْر — bi-, with, in (prep.) + al-, the + khayr, good (m.); 'with good fortune'
مُخْصِبَةً: مُخْصِب — mukhṣib, fertile, abundant (adj.), fem. accusative
بِالنَّبَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + نَبَات — bi-, with (prep.; 'rich in') + al-, the + nabāt, plants, vegetation (m.); 'with greenery'
يَعْمَلُونَ: عَمِلَ — ʿamila, to do, make; 3rd masc. pl. imperfect, 'they make'
عَزُومَةً: عَزُومَة — ʿazūma, banquet, invitation (f.; Egyptian for عَزِيمَة), accusative object
جَاتِ: جَاءَتْ (colloquial spelling) — jāʾat, she came (جَاءَ, 3rd fem. sg. perfect); 'came'
الْعَزُومَةُ: الـ + عَزُومَة — ʿazūma, invitation, banquet (f.), nominative; 'the banquet'
غَيْطِ: غَيْط — ghayṭ, field, garden (Egyptian; m.), construct genitive after فِي; 'a garden of'
بَرَّالْبَلَدِ: بَرّ — barr, outside, the open country + الـ + بَلَد — balad, town (m.); written as one word, 'outside the town'
فَجَلَسُوا: فَ + جَلَسَ + وا — fa-, then + jalasa, to sit (perfect) + -ū, 3rd masc. pl.; 'and they sat'
كُلُونَ: يَأْكُلُونَ (second part) — from أَكَلَ — akala, to eat; 3rd masc. pl. imperfect, 'they eat'; the second half of the word printed divided
وَيَتَنَادَمُونَ: وَ + يَتَنَادَمُونَ — wa-, and + yatanādamūna, they keep company over wine, carouse (تَنَادَمَ, VI; 3rd masc. pl. imperfect); 'and they carouse'
فَاحْتَاجَ: فَ + احْتَاجَ — fa-, and then + iḥtāja, to need (VIII, 3rd masc. sg. perfect); 'and he needed'
مَصْلَحَةٍ: مَصْلَحَة — maṣlaḥa, need, errand, thing wanted (f.), genitive after إِلَى
ارْكَبِ: رَكِبَ — rakiba, to ride, mount; imperative masc. sg., 'ride' (kasra to avoid a double sukūn before the article)
الْحَاجَةَ: الـ + حَاجَة — ḥāja, thing, need (f.), accusative object; 'the thing'
فَامْتَثَلْتُ: فَ + امْتَثَلَ + تُ — fa-, so + imtathala, to comply with (VIII) + -tu, I; 'and I complied with'
أَمْرَهُ: أَمْر — amr, command (m.), accusative object + ـهُ — his; 'his command'
وَأَرْخَيْتُ: وَ + أَرْخَى + تُ — wa-, and + arkhā, to let loose, let flow (IV) + -tu, I; 'and I let flow'
الدُّمُوعَ: الـ + دُمُوع — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع), accusative object; 'the tears'
كِبَارًا: كِبَار — kibār, big ones (pl. of كَبِير), accusative of state; 'great ones'
وَصِغَارًا: وَ + صِغَار — wa-, and + ṣighār, small ones (pl. of صَغِير), accusative of state; 'and small ones'
حِسِّي: حِسّ — ḥiss, sound, voice (m.) + ـِي — my; 'my voice'
وَبَنَاتُهُ: وَ + بَنَات — wa-, and + banāt, daughters (pl. of بِنْت) + -hu, his; 'and his daughters'
فَفَتَحُوالِي: فَ + فَتَحُوا + لِـ + ـي — fa-, and so + fataḥū, they opened (فَتَحَ, 3rd masc. pl. perfect) + li-, for, to (prep.) + -ī, me; 'and they opened for me'; printed as one word
وَسَأَلُونِي: وَ + سَأَلُونِي — wa-, and + saʾalū, they asked (سَأَلَ, 3rd masc. pl. perfect) + -nī, me; 'and they asked me'
حَائِظٍ: حَائِظ — ḥāʾiẓ, wall (the print's spelling of حَائِط; m., here treated as f.), genitive
وَأَصْحَابُهُ: وَ + أَصْحَاب — wa-, and, with (conj.) + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of صَاحِب) + -hu, his; 'and his companions'
لِأُخْبِرَكُمْ: لِـ + أُخْبِرَ + كُمْ — li-, in order to (prep. with the subjunctive) + ukhbira, I inform (أَخْبَرَ, IV, 1st sg. subjunctive) + -kum, you (pl.); 'in order to tell you'
بَنَانُهُ: بَنَان — banān, fingertips (as printed); a slip for بَنَاتُهُ 'his daughters', with -hu, his
وَزَوْجَنُهُ: وَ + زَوْجَن + ـُهُ — wa-, and + zawjan, as printed; a slip for زَوْجَتُهُ 'his wife' (-hu, his)
صَرَخُوا: صَرَخَ — ṣarakha, to cry out; 3rd masc. pl. perfect, 'they cried out'
فَانَتْ: فَ + انَتْ — fa-, and, then (conj.) + 'anat', as printed; probably a slip for أَتَتْ 'she came' (3rd fem. sg. perfect of أَتَى); 'and they came'
الْجِيرَانُ: الـ + جِيرَان — jīrān, neighbours (pl. of جَار), nominative; 'the neighbours'
قَلَبَتْ: قَلَبَ — qalaba, to overturn; 3rd fem. sg. perfect, 'she overturned'
وَأَخْرَبَتْ: وَ + أَخْرَبَتْ — wa-, and + akhrabat, she ruined (أَخْرَبَ, IV, 3rd fem. sg. perfect); 'and she wrecked'
رُفُوفَهُ: رُفُوف — rufūf, shelves (pl. of رَفّ), accusative object + ـهُ — its; 'its shelves'
وَكَسَرَتْ: وَ + كَسَرَتْ — wa-, and + kasarat, she broke (كَسَرَ, 3rd fem. sg. perfect); 'and she broke'
طَيْقَانَهُ: طَيْقَان — ṭayqān, niches in a wall (pl. of طَاقَة; Egyptian) + ـهُ — its; 'its niches'
وَشَبَابِيكَهُ: وَ + شَبَابِيك + ـهُ — wa-, and + shabābīk, windows (pl. of شُبَّاك) + -hu, its; 'and its windows'
وَسَخَّمَتْ: وَ + سَخَّمَتْ — wa-, and + sakhkhamat, she blackened, smeared (سَخَّمَ, II, 3rd fem. sg. perfect); 'and she smeared'
حِيطَانَهُ: حِيطَان — ḥīṭān, walls (pl. of حَائِط) + ـهُ — its; 'its walls'
بِطِينٍ: بِـ + طِين — bi-, with (prep.; instrument) + ṭīn, mud, clay (m.); 'with mud'
وَنِيلَةٍ: وَ + نِيلَة — wa-, and + nīla, indigo (f.); 'and indigo'
وَأَخْرِبْ: وَ + أَخْرِبْ — wa-, and + akhrib, ruin! (أَخْرَبَ, IV, imperative masc. sg.); 'and ruin'
الدَّوَالِيبَ: الـ + دَوَالِيب — dawālīb, cupboards (pl. of دُولَاب), accusative object; 'the cupboards'
وَكَسِّرْ: وَ + كَسِّرْ — wa-, and + kassir, smash! (كَسَّرَ, II, imperative masc. sg.); 'and smash'
الأَوَانِيَ: الـ + أَوَانِي — awānī, vessels (pl. of إِنَاء), accusative object; 'the vessels'
وَالصِّينِيَّ: وَ + الـ + صِينِيّ — wa-, and + al-, the + ṣīniyy, china, porcelain (collective; from الصِّين); 'and the china'
وَغَيْرَهُ: وَ + غَيْر + ـَهُ — wa-, and + ghayr, other than + -hu, it; 'and the rest'
وَأَخْرَبْتُ: وَ + أَخْرَبْتُ — wa-, and + akhrabtu, I ruined (IV, 1st sg. perfect); 'and I wrecked'
رُفُوفَ: رُفُوف — rufūf, shelves (pl. of رَفّ), accusative object, construct; 'the shelves of'
السُّقُوفِ: الـ + سُقُوف — suqūf, ceilings, roofs (pl. of سَقْف), genitive; 'the ceilings'
أُخْرِبُهُ: أَخْرَبَ — akhraba, to ruin (IV); 1st sg. imperfect + ـهُ — it; 'I ruin it'
الصِّينِيِّ: الـ + صِينِيّ — ṣīniyy, china, porcelain (m.), genitive after مِنَ; 'the china'; also: as adj., 'Chinese', gen. agreeing with al-ḥadīd: al-ḥadīdi al-ṣīniyyi, 'Chinese iron' (Night 179)
أَخْرَبْتُ: أَخْرَبَ — akhraba, to ruin (IV); 1st sg. perfect, 'I ruined'
أَصِيحُ: صَاحَ — ṣāḥa, to cry out; 1st sg. imperfect, 'I cry out'
مَكْشُوفَةَ: مَكْشُوف — makshūf, uncovered (pass. part. of كَشَفَ), fem. accusative (state), construct; 'bare of'
بِغِطَاءِ: بِـ + غِطَاء — bi-, with (prep.) + ghiṭāʾ, covering, cloth (m.), construct; 'with a covering of'
لَاغَيْرَ: لَا — lā, not, no + غَيْر — ghayr, other; written as one word, 'and nothing else'
وَالأَوْلَادُ: وَ + الـ + أَوْلَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + awlād, children, boys (pl. of وَلَد), nominative; 'and the children'
قُدَّا: قُدَّام — quddām, in front of (prep.), first part of the word printed divided as قدا + منا; 'in front of'
وَأَرِنَا: وَ + أَرِ + نَا — wa-, and + arī, show! (أَرَى, IV, imperative masc. sg.) + -nā, us; 'and show us'
نُخْرِجَهُ: أَخْرَجَ — akhraja, to bring out (IV); 1st pl. subjunctive after حَتَّى + ـهُ — him; 'we bring him out'
وَنَحْمِلَهُ: وَ + نَحْمِلَ + هُ — wa-, and + naḥmila, we carry (حَمَلَ, 1st pl. subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'and carry him'
تَابُوتٍ: تَابُوت — tābūt, coffin, chest (m.), genitive after فِي; 'a coffin'
وَنَجِيً: وَ + نَجِيءَ — wa-, and + najīʾa, we bring (جَاءَ بِـ, 1st pl. subjunctive); the print marks the final yā' with a tanwīn sign; 'and we bring'
فَنُخْرِجَهُ: فَ + نُخْرِجَهُ — fa-, and so (conj. of consequence, takes the subjunctive) + nukhrijahu, we take him out (أَخْرَجَ, IV, 1st pl. subjunctive + -hu, him); 'and so we bring him out'
خُرْجَةً: خُرْجَة — khurja, a going out, procession (f.), accusative of manner; 'a procession'
مَكْشُوفُونَ: مَكْشُوف — makshūf, uncovered, bare, sound masc. plural nominative (state); 'uncovered'
الْوُجُوهِ: الـ + وُجُوه — wujūh, faces (pl. of وَجْه), genitive of respect; 'the faces'
وَالرُّوُسِ: وَ + الـ + رُوس — wa-, and + al-, the + rūs, heads (the print's form of رُؤُوس, pl. of رَأْس), genitive; 'and the heads'
لَامِنَ: لَا + مِنَ — lā, not, neither (neg.) + mina, of, from (prep.); written as one word, 'neither of'
وَلَامِنَ: وَ + لَا + مِنَ — wa-, and + lā, nor + mina, of; written as one word, 'nor of'
الصِّبْيَانِ: الـ + صِبْيَان — ṣibyān, boys (pl. of صَبِيّ), genitive; 'the boys'
إِلَّاجَاءَ: إِلَّا + جَاءَ — illā, except (particle) + jāʾa, he came (جَاءَ, 3rd masc. sg. perfect); written as one word, 'without having come'
يَلْطِمُونَ: لَطَمَ — laṭama, to strike; 3rd masc. pl. imperfect, 'they beat (their faces)'
فَشَقَّيْتُ: فَ + شَقَّيْتُ — fa-, then + shaqqaytu, I cleft, cut a way through (شَقَّى, a doubled colloquial form of شَقَّ, 1st sg. perfect); 'and I led them through'
فَسأَلَ: فَ + سَأَلَ — fa-, then + saʾala, to ask (3rd masc. sg. perfect); 'and asked'
فَأَخْبَرُوهُمْ: فَ + أَخْبَرُوا + هُمْ — fa-, and so + akhbarū, they informed (أَخْبَرَ, IV, 3rd masc. pl. perfect) + -hum, them; 'and they told them'
إِلَّارَجُلٌ: إِلَّا + رَجُلٌ — illā, except + rajulun, a man (m.); written as one word, 'only a man'
امْضِي: مَضَى — maḍā, to go on, proceed; imperative, written with a final yā' as printed; 'go on'
وَنُخْبِرُهُ: وَ + نُخْبِرُهُ — wa-, and + nukhbiruhu, we inform him (أَخْبَرَ, IV, 1st pl. imperfect + -hu, him); 'and we will tell him'
وَأَخْبَرُوهُ: وَ + أَخْبَرُوا + هُ — wa-, and + akhbarū, they informed (IV, 3rd masc. pl. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and they told him'
الْمُب—احِ: الـ + مُب—اح — damaged in print for الْمُبَاحِ al-mubāḥ, permitted (pass. part. of أَبَاحَ, IV), genitive; 'the permitted'
،: ، — Arabic comma, printed here before ولا
أَبَانَا: أَب + ـنَا — ab, father (m., voc. after yā; the long form أَبَا + nā); 'our father'
أَبَتَاهْ: أَبَ + ـتَا + ـهْ — abatāh, 'O my father!' (vocative with tā' of address and lengthening, lament-form)
أَتَانِي: أَتَى + ـنِي — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'he came to me'
أَثَرٌ: أَثَر — athar, trace, mark (m., nom.); 'a trace'
أَثَرِي: أَثَر + ـي — athar, track, footprint (m., acc. as object of the participle تَابِعِينَ) + 1s; 'my track'
أَرَانَا: أَرَى + ـنَا — arā, to show (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1pl object; 'he showed us'
أَرْسَلْتَنِي: أَرْسَلَ + ـتَ + ـنِي — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1s object; 'you sent me'
أَرْكَبُهَا: أَرْكَبُ + ـهَا — rakiba, to ride (verb I, impf. 1s) + 3fs object; 'I ride her'; also: of a man with a woman, 'I mount her', that is, lie with her (Night 179)
أَلْطِمُ: أَلْطِمُ — laṭama, to slap, strike (verb I, impf. 1s); 'I slap'
أَنْفُسَهُمْ: أَنْفُس + هُمْ — nafs, self (f., pl. anfus, acc. object) + 3mpl; 'themselves'
أَوْلَادَاهْ: أَوْلَاد + ـاهْ — walad, child, pl. awlād (m.) with lament-ending -āh; 'O my children!'
ا: ا — ā, bare alif printed as an interjection of grief (vocalisation conjectural)
اذْهَبْ: اذْهَبْ — dhahaba, to go (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'go!'
اشْتَرَيْتَنِي: اشْتَرَى + ـتَ + ـنِي — ishtarā, to buy (verb VIII, perf. 2ms) + 1s object; 'you bought me'
الزَّانِيَةِ: الـ + زَانِيَة — zāniya, fornicatress, whore (f., act. part. of zanā; gen. in iḍāfa); 'the whore'
الشَّرْطِ: الـ + شَرْط — sharṭ, condition, stipulation (m., gen., in apposition to هَذَا, governed by bi-, 'on': bi-hādhā al-sharṭ 'on this condition'); 'the condition'
اللَّطْمِ: الـ + لَطْم — laṭm, slapping, beating (verbal noun of laṭama; m., gen. in iḍāfa after شِدَّة); 'the slapping'
الْآخَرَ: الـ + آخَر — ākhar, other (adj., m., acc., agreeing with the noun it follows: نِصْفَهَا, الرَّجُلَ); 'the other'
الْإِصْطَبْلِ: الـ + إِصْطَبْل — iṣṭabl, stable (m., gen. in iḍāfa after حِيطَان); 'the stable'
الْحَائِطَ: الـ + حَائِط — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m./f.; acc. object of رَأَى); 'the wall'
الْغَنَمُ: الـ + غَنَم — ghanam, sheep, flock (coll. m., nom.); 'the sheep'
الْغَنَمِ: الـ + غَنَم — ghanam, sheep (coll. m., gen. after عَلَى); 'the sheep'
الْفَعَلَةَ: الـ + فَعَلَة — fāʿil, worker; pl. faʿala (m., acc. object); 'the workmen'
الْكُسَاحُ: الـ + كُسَاح — kusāḥ, lameness, crippling (m., nom.); 'the lameness'
الْمُقْبِلِينَ: الـ + مُقْبِلِين — muqbil, approaching one (act. part. of IV aqbala; m. pl., gen. after إِلَى هَؤُلَاءِ); 'the approaching-ones'
الْوَقَٰئِعُ: الـ + وَقَائِع — waqāʾiʿ, events, doings (pl. of waqīʿa/waqʿa; the print drops the alif); 'the events'
انْدَهَشَتْ: انْدَهَشَ + ـتْ — indahasha, to be bewildered (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'she was bewildered'
انْطَبَقَتْ: انْطَبَقَ + ـتْ — inṭabaqa, to close over, collapse upon (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'it collapsed'
بِالْمَسَاحِي: بِـ + الـ + مَسَاحِي — misḥāh (pl. masāḥī), hoe, spade (f.); bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment/instrument) 'with the hoes'
بِغَبْرَةٍ: بِـ + غَبْرَة — ghabra, cloud of dust (f., gen.); bi- marks what appears after وَإِذَا هُمْ ('behold they were met by'), 'with a dust-cloud'
تَابِعِينَ: تَابِعِين — tābiʿ, following (act. part. of I tabiʿa; m. pl., acc. as ḥāl); 'following'
جِلْدَكَ: جِلْد + ـكَ — jild, skin (m., acc. object) + 2ms; 'your skin'
حَالُكُمْ: حَال + ـكُمْ — ḥāl, state, condition (m., nom.) + 2mpl; 'your state'
حُرٌّ: حُرّ — ḥurr, free (adj., m., nom. predicate); 'free'
حِيطَانَ: حِيطَان — ḥāʾiṭ, wall; pl. ḥīṭān (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'walls of'
خَارِجُونَ: خَارِجُونَ — khārij, going out (act. part. of I kharaja; m. pl., nom.); 'going out'
دَارَنَاشَيْ: دَار + ـنَا + شَيْء — dār, house (f., acc. object) + 1pl; 'our house'; joined with shayʾ, 'anything' (nom., subject of أَصَابَ), hamza dropped as in speech
دَاهِيَةٌ: دَاهِيَة — dāhiya, calamity, disaster (f., nom. predicate); 'a calamity'
رَآوْهُ: رَأَى + ـوا + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mpl) + 3ms object; 'they saw him'
رُفَقَاؤُهُ: رُفَقَاء + ـهُ — rafīq, companion; pl. rufaqāʾ (m., nom., in apposition to التُّجَّار) + 3ms; 'his companions'
زَائِدٍ: زَائِد — zāʾid, excessive, surpassing (act. part. of I zāda; m., gen.; epithet of بُكَاء); 'excessive'
سَالَ: سَالَ — sāla, to flow (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'flowed'
سَالِمَةٌ: سَالِمَة — sālim, safe, unharmed (act. part. of I salima; f., nom. predicate); 'safe'
سَلَامَتُكَ: سَلَامَة + ـكَ — salāma, safety, welfare (f., nom.) + 2ms; 'your safety'
سَيِّدَتِى: سَيِّدَة + ـي — sayyida, mistress, lady (f., gen. after بَعْد; acc. after إِنَّ, the case hidden by -ī) + 1s; 'my mistress'; here: after yā, vocative, yā sayyidatī, 'O my lady'
سَيِّدُكَ: سَيِّد + ـكَ — sayyid, master (m., nom.) + 2ms; 'your master'
سُكَّانٌ: سُكَّان — sākin, dweller; pl. sukkān (m., nom., indef.); 'inhabitants'
سِتُّكَ: سِتّ + ـكَ — sitt, lady (f., colloquial title; nom.) + 2ms; 'your lady'
سْلُخَنَّ: سَلَخَ — salakha, to flay (verb I, impf. 1s with nūn of emphasis); the second half of the split لا سلخن (la- + a-slukhanna), 'I will flay'
شَدِيدٍ: شَدِيد — shadīd, intense (adj., m., gen.; epithet of بُكَاء); 'intense'
ظَهْرُهُ: ظَهْر + ـهُ — ẓahr, back (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'his back' Also ishtadda ẓahruhu, 'his back grew strong', of strength and spirit returning.
عَظْمِكَ: عَظْم + ـكَ — ʿaẓm, bone (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 2ms; 'your bone'
عَمِلْتَهَا: عَمِلَ + ـتَ + ـهَا — ʿamila, to do (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3fs object; 'you did it'
عَيْبِي: عَيْب + ـي — ʿayb, defect, fault (m., gen. after عَلَى) + 1s; 'my defect'
غَيْرَأَنَّ: غَيْرَ + أَنَّ — ghayr, other than (acc., adverbial 'except'); anna, that; joined in print, 'except that'
فَأَقْبَلْتُ: فَـ + أَقْبَلَ + ـتُ — fa-, so, then (conj.); aqbala, to approach (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'so I approached'
فَأَكَلَهُمُ: فَـ + أَكَلَ + هُمُ — fa-, so, (apodosis after وَأَمَّا); akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mpl object; 'they ate them'
فَجَرَيْتُ: فَـ + جَرَى + ـتُ — fa-, so (conj.); jarā, to run (verb I, perf. 1s); 'so I ran'
فَرَآنِي: فَـ + رَأَى + ـنِي — fa-, so, and (conj. of sequence); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'and saw me'
فِدَاءً: فِدَاء — fidāʾ, ransom (m., acc. predicate of كُنْتُ); 'a ransom'
كَافُورَ: كَافُور — Kāfūr, the slave's name (m., acc. after أَنَّ... ʿabdaka); 'Kāfūr'
كَذَبْتُ: كَذَبَ + ـتُ — kadhaba, to lie (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I lie' (here a future sense after فَإِذَا كَمُلَتِ)
كَذْبَةٌ: كَذْبَة — kadhba, a lie (f., nom.); 'a lie'
كَذْبَةٍ: كَذْبَة — kadhba, a lie (f., gen. in iḍāfa after نِصْف); 'of a lie'
كَمُلَتِ: كَمُلَ + ـتِ — kamula, to be complete (verb I, perf. 3fs, with connecting kasra); 'was complete'
كُومَ: كُوم — kūm, heap (m., acc. predicate of صَارُوا); 'a heap of'
لَاقَى: لَاقَى — lāqā, to meet (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'met'
لَحْمَكَ: لَحْم + ـكَ — laḥm, flesh (m., acc. object) + 2ms; 'your flesh'
لَحْمِكَ: لَحْم + ـكَ — laḥm, flesh (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 2ms; 'your flesh'
لِصِيَاحِهِ: لِـ + صِيَاح + ـهِ — ṣiyāḥ, crying out (verbal noun, m., gen.) + 3ms; li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) 'at his crying out'
لِلْأَرْبَعِينَ: لِـ + الـ + أَرْبَعِين — arbaʿūn, forty (num., gen.); li-, of, belonging to (prep.) 'of the forty'
لِمَارَأَتْهُ: لِـ + مَا + رَأَى + ـتْ + ـهُ — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause); mā, what (rel. pron.); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms object; the print joins li-, mā and raʾat into one word; 'at what she saw of him'
مَخْرُوقَةٌ: مَخْرُوقَة — makhrūq, torn (pass. part. of I kharaqa; f., nom. predicate); 'torn'
مَكْشُوفُ: مَكْشُوف — makshūf, uncovered, bare (pass. part. of I kashafa; m., nom. predicate; first term of an iḍāfa); 'bare-of'
مَلْعُونَ: مَلْعُون — malʿūn, accursed (pass. part. of I laʿana; m., acc. vocative first term of an iḍāfa); 'accursed of'
مُخَرَّقُ: مُخَرَّق — mukharraq, torn to pieces (pass. part. of II kharraqa; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'torn of'
نِصْفَهَا: نِصْف + ـهَا — niṣf, half (m., acc. object) + 3fs; 'its half'
وَأَبْكِي: وَ + أَبْكِي — wa-, and (conj.); bakā, to weep (verb I, impf. 1s); 'and I weep'
وَأَحْثُو: وَ + أَحْثُو — wa-, and (conj.); ḥathā, to throw, scatter (verb I, impf. 1s); 'and I throw'
وَأَحْثُوا: وَ + أَحْثُو — wa-, and (conj.); ḥathā, to throw (verb I, impf. 1s; the print adds an alif after the wāw); 'and I throw'
وَأَصْحَابَهُ: وَ + أَصْحَاب + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.); ṣāḥib, companion; pl. aṣḥāb (m., acc.) + 3ms; 'and his companions'
وَأَقْطَعَنَّ: وَ + أَقْطَعَنَّ — wa-, and (conj.); qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, impf. 1s) with nūn of emphasis (oath lām understood); 'and I will cut'
وَأَكَلَهُمُ: وَ + أَكَلَ + هُمُ — wa-, and (conj.); akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mpl object; 'and they ate them'
وَأَلْطِمُ: وَ + أَلْطِمُ — wa-, and (conj.); laṭama, to slap (verb I, impf. 1s); 'and I slap'
وَأَوْلَادَهَا: وَ + أَوْلَاد + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.); walad, child; pl. awlād (m., nom. in the print's loose case after إِنَّ) + 3fs; 'and her children'
وَأَوْلَادُهَا: وَ + أَوْلَاد + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.); walad, child; pl. awlād (m., nom.) + 3fs; 'and her children'
وَأَوْلَادِهَا: وَ + أَوْلَاد + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.); walad, child; pl. awlād (m., gen. after عَلَى) + 3fs; 'and her children'
وَاءْ: وَاء — wāʾ, woe (interjection of grief; vocalisation conjectural)
وَازَوْجَتَاهْ: وَا + زَوْجَة + ـاهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament); zawja, wife (f.) + lament-ending -āh; 'O my wife!'
وَاسِتَّاهْ: وَا + سِتّ + ـاهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament); sitt, lady (f., colloquial title) + lament-ending -āh; 'O my lady!'
وَالدَّجَاجُ: وَ + الـ + دَجَاج — wa-, and (conj.); dajāj, chickens (coll. m., nom.); 'and the chickens'
وَالشُّهُودُ: وَ + الـ + شُهُود — wa-, and (conj., introducing a circumstantial clause); shāhid, witness; pl. shuhūd (m., nom.); 'and the witnesses'
وَالْأَوَزُّ: وَ + الـ + أَوَزّ — wa-, and (conj.); awazz, geese (coll. m., nom.); 'and the geese'
وَالْأَوَزِّو: وَ + الـ + أَوَزّ + و — awazz, geese (coll. m., gen.); wa- 'and'; the print has a stray final و (printed with a shadda on the zāy), the conjunction that belongs before الدجاج; 'and the geese'
وَالْخَلْقُ: وَ + الـ + خَلْق — wa-, and (conj.); khalq, creation, folk (m., nom.); 'and the folk'
وَالْعَالَمُ: وَ + الـ + عَالَم — wa-, and (conj.); ʿālam, world, people (m., nom.); 'and the world'
وَالْقُفَفِ: وَ + الـ + قُفَف — wa-, and (conj.); quffa, basket; pl. qufaf (f., gen., coordinated with الْمَسَاحِي under the same bi-, 'with'); 'and the baskets'
وَالْكِلَابُ: وَ + الـ + كِلَاب — wa-, and (conj.); kalb, dog; pl. kilāb (m., nom.); 'and the dogs'
وَالْمُقَدَّمِينَ: وَ + الـ + مُقَدَّمِين — wa-, and (conj.); muqaddam, officer (pass. part. of II qaddama; m. pl., here in oblique form); 'and the officers'
وَامُصِيبَتَاهْ: وَا + مُصِيبَة + ـاهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament); muṣība, calamity (f.) + lament-ending -āh; 'O my calamity!'
وَانْطَبَقَتْ: وَ + انْطَبَقَ + ـتْ — wa-, and (conj.); inṭabaqa, to close over, collapse (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'and collapsed'
وَانْكَسَرَ: وَ + انْكَسَرَ — wa-, and (conj.); inkasara, to break (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'and broke'
وَاوْلَادِسِتَّاهْ: وَا + وْلَاد + سِتّ + ـاهْ — wā, O! (particle of lament); wlād, children (colloquial form of awlād; m.); sitt, lady + lament-ending -āh; 'O my lady's children!'
وَتَعَلَّقَتْ: وَ + تَعَلَّقَ + ـتْ — wa-, and (conj.); taʿallaqa, to cling (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and clung'
وَثَبَتَ: وَ + ثَبَتَ — wa-, and (conj.); thabata, to steady oneself, stand firm (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and steadied'
وَجْهَكَ: وَجْه + ـكَ — wajh, face (m., acc. object) + 2ms; 'your face'
وَحِيطَانَ: وَ + حِيطَان — wa-, and (conj.); ḥāʾiṭ, wall; pl. ḥīṭān (m., coordinated); 'and walls of'
وَرَآنِي: وَ + رَأَى + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'and saw me'
وَرَاءَهُمْ: وَ + رَاءَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); warāʾ, behind (prep.-noun, acc.) + 3mpl; 'and behind them'
وَرَثَوْالِحَالِهِ: وَ + رَثَى + ـوا + لِـ + حَال + ـهِ — wa-, and (conj.); rathā, to pity (verb I, perf. 3mpl); li-, for, at (prep. after rathā 'pity'); ḥāl, state (m., gen.) + 3ms; the print joins the three: 'and they pitied his state'
وَسَبَقْتُهُمْ: وَ + سَبَقَ + ـتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.); sabaqa, to outstrip (verb I, perf. 1s) + 3mpl object; 'and I outstripped them'
وَصَاحُواوَا: وَ + صَاحَ + ـوا + وَا — wa-, and (conj.); ṣāḥa, to cry out (verb I, perf. 3mpl); wā, O! (particle of lament); the print joins them, 'and they cried: O…!'
وَصِيَاحٍ: وَ + صِيَاح — wa-, and (conj.); ṣiyāḥ, shouting (verbal noun, m., gen.); 'and shouting'
وَعِمَا: وَ + عِمَا(مَتِي) — wa-, and (conj.); the first half of the split ʿimāmatī, 'my turban'
وَعِيَاطٍ: وَ + عِيَاط — wa-, and (conj.); ʿiyāṭ, clamour, outcry (colloquial verbal noun, m., gen.); 'and clamour'
وَفَالَ: وَ + قَالَ — wa-, and (conj.); qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 3ms); the print has fāʾ for qāf, a slip; 'and he said'
وَمَاتُوا: وَ + مَاتَ + ـوا — wa-, and (conj.); māta, to die (verb I, perf. 3mpl); 'and they died'
وَمَاحَالُ: وَ + مَا + حَال — wa-, and (conj.); mā, what (interrog.); ḥāl, state (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); the print joins them; 'and what of the state of'
وَنَنَفَ: وَ + نَنَفَ — wa-, and (conj.); nanafa, to pluck (verb I, perf. 3ms; obscure, perhaps for natafa); 'and plucked'
وَيَصِيحُونَ: وَ + يَصِيحُونَ — wa-, and (conj.); ṣāḥa, to cry out (verb I, impf. 3mpl); 'and crying out'
يَتَمَالَكُ: يَتَمَالَكُ — tamālaka, to control oneself (verb VI, impf. 3ms); 'hold'
يَشْهَدُونَ: يَشْهَدُونَ — shahida, to bear witness (verb I, impf. 3mpl); 'they bear witness'
يَعِيطُونَ: يَعِيطُونَ — ʿayyaṭa/ʿāṭa, to wail, cry out (colloquial verb, impf. 3mpl); 'they wail'
يَقْدِرْأَنْ: يَقْدِرْ + أَنْ — qadara, to be able (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam); an, that (conj., subjunctive); the print joins them as يقدران; 'able to'
يَلْطِمُ: يَلْطِمُ — laṭama, to slap (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'he slaps'
أَعْتَقْتَنِي: أَعْتَقْتَ + ـنِي — aʿtaqa, to free, manumit (IV, perf. 2ms) + me; 'you freed me'
أُعْتِقُكَ: أُعْتِقُ + كَ — uʿtiqu, I free (imperf. 1s of IV aʿtaqa) + you (2ms); 'I free you'
تَكْمُلَ: تَكْمُلَ — takmula, to be complete (I, imperf. 3fs subj. after ḥattā)
وَأَكْذِبَ: وَ + أَكْذِبَ — wa-, and + akdhiba, I lie (imperf. 1s subj. after ḥattā, continued by wa-); 'and I lie'
الْكَذْبَةِ: الـ + كَذْبَة — kadhba, a lie (f., gen. second term of the iḍāfa); 'of the lie'
الْبَاقِيَةِ: الـ + بَاقِيَة — bāqiya, remaining (act. part. of bāqiya, to remain; f., gen., adj.); 'the remaining'
أُتِمَّهَا: أُتِمَّ + هَا — utimma, I complete (IV atamma, imperf. 1s subj.) + her/it (3fs); 'I complete it'
فَانْزِلْ: فَـ + انْزِلْ — fa-, then (introduces the main clause after 'after…') + inzil, go down (imperative 2ms of nazala); 'then take down'
وَبِعْنِي: وَ + بِعْ + ـنِي — wa-, and + biʿ, sell (imperative 2ms of bāʿa) + me; 'and sell me'
تُعْتِقْنِي: تُعْتِقْ + ـنِي — tuʿtiq, free (IV aʿtaqa, imperf. 2ms jussive after lā) + me; 'free me'
أَقْتَاتُ: أَقْتَاتُ — aqtātu, I live on, subsist (VIII iqtāta, imperf. 1s; relative clause with no relative word); 'I live by'
الْمَسْئَلَةُ: الـ + مَسْئَلَة — masʾala, question, point (f., nom., spelled with yā-hamza as printed); 'the question'
ذَكَرْتُهَالَكَ: ذَكَرْتُ + هَا + لَـ + كَ — dhakara, to mention (perf. 1s) + it (3fs) + li-, to (prep.) + you (2ms), printed as one word; 'I mentioned it to you'
شَرْعِيَّةٌ: شَرْعِيَّة — sharʿī, legal, lawful (nisba adj., f., nom. indef., predicate); 'legal'
ذَكَرَهَا: ذَكَرَ + هَا — dhakara, to mention (perf. 3ms) + it (3fs); 'he mentioned it'
الْفُقَهَاءُ: الـ + فُقَهَاء — faqīh, jurist (m., broken pl. fuqahāʾ, nom., subject); 'the jurists'
الْعِتْقِ: الـ + عِتْق — ʿitq, manumission, freeing (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'of manumission'
بِالْخَلَائِقِ: بِـ + الـ + خَلَائِق — bi-, marks what appears after idhā (not 'with') + khalāʾiq, creatures, crowds (pl. of khalīqa, gen.); 'behold the crowds'
وَالنَّاسِ: وَ + الـ + نَاس — wa-, and + nās, people (m. coll., gen. with the preceding); 'and the people'
وَأَهْلِ: وَ + أَهْل — wa-, and + ahl, people, folk (m., gen. in the same series; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the folk of'
وَرِجَالٍ: وَ + رِجَال — wa-, and + rijāl, men (pl. of rajul, gen. indef.); 'and men'
عَتُهُ: عَة + ـهُ — second part of jamāʿatuhu, the printed split of جماعته, jamāʿa 'company, group' (f., nom.) + his
وَأَعْلَمُوهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمُوا + هُ — wa-, and + aʿlamū, they informed (IV aʿlama, perf. 3mpl.) + him; 'and informed him'
بِالْقَضِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + قَضِيَّة — bi-, of, about (prep., the verb aʿlama takes bi- for the matter told) + qaḍiyya, case, matter (f., gen.); 'of the case'
اسْتَعْظَمُوا: اسْتَعْظَمُوا — istaʿẓamū, they thought great, deemed monstrous (X istaʿẓama, perf. 3mpl.)
الْكَذْبَةَ: الـ + كَذْبَة — kadhba, a lie (f., acc. object); 'the lie'
فَلَعَنُونِي: فَـ + لَعَنُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and so + laʿanū, they cursed (perf. 3mpl.) + me; 'so they cursed me'
وَشَتَمُونِي: وَ + شَتَمُوا + ـنِي — wa-, and + shatamū, they reviled (perf. 3mpl.) + me; 'and reviled me'
أَضْحَكُ: أَضْحَكُ — aḍḥaku, I laugh (imperf. 1s of ḍaḥika; ḥāl clause)
يَقْتُلُنِي: يَقْتُلُ + ـنِي — yaqtulu, he kills (imperf. 3ms of qatala) + me; 'he kill me'
اشْتَرَانِي: اشْتَرَى + ـنِي — ishtarā, to buy (VIII, perf. 3ms) + me; 'he bought me'
الْعَيْبِ: الـ + عَيْب — ʿayb, flaw, defect (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the flaw'
مُعْظَمَهُ: مُعْظَم + هُ — muʿẓam, the greater part, bulk (m., acc. object) + its; 'most of it'
وَأَكْثَرَهُ: وَ + أَكْثَر + هُ — wa-, and + akthar, the most, the greater number (elative, m., acc.) + its; 'and the greater part of it'
وَكَسَرْتُ: وَ + كَسَرْتُ — wa-, and + kasartu, I broke (perf. 1s of kasara)
كَافُورًا: كَافُور — Kāfūr, the slave's name (m., acc. after inna), lit. 'camphor'
هُوَالَّذِي: هُوَ + الَّذِي — huwa, he (3ms pronoun) + alladhī, who, printed as one word; 'he is the one who'
الْأَوَانِيَ: الـ + أَوَانِي — āniya, vessels (pl. of ināʾ; acc. defective); 'the vessels'
غَيْظُهُ: غَيْظ + هُ — ghayẓ, rage (m., nom., subject) + his; 'his rage'
يَدًا: يَد — yad, hand (f., acc. indef.); 'a hand'
زِنًا: زِنًا — zinā, fornication, illicit sex (m., gen. indef.); 'walad zinā, a bastard'
أَغْرَبَ: أَغْرَبَ — aghraba, as printed (IV, perf. 3ms; probably a slip for akhraba, he ruined); here 'he would have ruined'
مَدِينَتَيْنِ: مَدِينَتَيْن — madīna, city (f. dual, acc.); 'two cities'
وَأَطْعَمَنِي: وَ + أَطْعَمَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + aṭʿama, to feed, make eat (IV, perf. 3ms) + me; 'and fed me'
عَلَقَةً: عَلَقَة — ʿalaqa, a beating, drubbing (f., acc. indef., second object); 'a thrashing'
غَشْيَتِي: غَشْيَة + ـي — ghashya, swoon, faint (f., gen. after fī) + my; 'my swoon'
فَخَصَانِي: فَـ + خَصَى + ـنِي — fa-, and so + khaṣā, to castrate (perf. 3ms) + me; 'so he castrated me'
وَكَوَانِي: وَ + كَوَى + ـنِي — wa-, and + kawā, to cauterise, brand with fire (perf. 3ms) + me; 'and cauterised me'
إِلَّاوَجَدْتُ: إِلَّا + وَجَدْتُ — illā, except, but (printed joined) + wajadtu, I found (perf. 1s of wajada); 'than I found'
طَوَاشِيًا: طَوَاشِي — ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., acc. indef., second object; Turkish-derived)
أَحْرَقْتُ: أَحْرَقْتُ — aḥraqtu, I burned (IV aḥraqa, perf. 1s)
الْأَعْضَاءِ: الـ + أَعْضَاء — aʿḍāʾ, limbs, organs (pl. of ʿuḍw; gen.); 'of limbs'
وَبَاعَنِي: وَ + بَاعَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + bāʿa, to sell (perf. 3ms) + me; 'and sold me'
بِأَغْلَى: بِـ + أَغْلَى — bi-, for (prep. of price) + aghlā, dearest, highest (elative of ghālin; gen., defective); 'for the highest'
ثَمَنٍ: ثَمَن — thaman, price (m., gen. indef., second term); 'price'
أَلْقَى: أَلْقَى — alqā, I meet, encounter (imperf. 1s of laqiya)
الْفِتَنَ: الـ + فِتَن — fitan, trials, troubles (pl. of fitna; acc. object); 'the troubles'
أُبَاعُ: أُبَاعُ — ubāʿu, I am sold (passive imperf. 1s of bāʿa)
وَأَنْتَقِلُ: وَ + أَنْتَقِلُ — wa-, and + antaqilu, I move, pass (VIII intaqala, imperf. 1s)
أَمِيرٍإِلَى: أَمِير + إِلَى — amīr, emir (m., gen. indef. after min) + ilā, to (prep.), printed as one word; 'from an emir to'
أَىِّ: أَيّ — ayy, printed اى, any, whichever (m.; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'any'. Possibly a dropped lām for ilā, 'to'
أُبَاعُ: أُبَاعُ — ubāʿu, I am sold (passive imperf. 1s of bāʿa), printed with damma on the alif
وَأُشْرَى: وَ + أُشْرَى — wa-, and + ushrā, I am bought (passive imperf. 1s of sharā, to buy), printed with damma on the alif
وَأَبَتْ: وَ + أَبَتْ — wa-, and + abat, it refused (perf. 3fs of abā)
حِيَلِي: حِيَل + ـي — ḥiyal, devices, resources (pl. of ḥīla; f. coll., nom.) + my; 'my devices'
وَعَدِمْتُ: وَ + عَدِمْتُ — wa-, and + ʿadimtu, I lacked, lost (perf. 1s of ʿadima)
خُصَايَ: خُصَا + ـيَ — khuṣā, testicles (pl. of khuṣya; printed in a Middle Arabic form for خُصْيَيَّ) + my; 'my testicles'
الْعَبْدَانِ: الـ + عَبْدَان — ʿabd, slave (m. dual, nom.); 'the two slaves'
ضَحِكَا: ضَحِكَا — ḍaḥikā, they (two) laughed (perf. 3md of ḍaḥika)
خُرْوٌ: خُرْو — khurw, dung (m., nom. indef., predicate; Middle Arabic spelling of khurʾ); 'dung'
خُرْءٍ: خُرْء — khurʾ, dung (m., gen. indef., second term); 'dung'
كَذِبًا: كَذِب — kadhib, a lie, falsehood (m. verbal noun, acc. indef., cognate object); 'a lie'
قُلْتُمُوهُ: قَالَ + تُمْ + وُ + هُ — qāla, to say (verb I; perf.) + -tum, you (m. pl.) + -hu, it, with the glide ū; 'you said it'
بَطَّالٌ: بَطَّال — baṭṭāl, idle, worthless, futile (adj./intensive form of baṭala; m., predicate); 'idle talk'
أَسْتَاهِلُ: أَسْتَاهِلُ — astāhilu, to deserve (colloquial form X of root أ-ه-ل; imperf. 1st sg.); 'I deserve, I was deserving'
نِكْتُ: نِكْتُ — nikt, I fucked (verb I nāka, root ن-و-ك; perf. 1st sg.); 'I fucked, I had fucked'
وَالْحِكَايَةُ: وَ + الـ + حِكَايَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥikāya, tale, story (f., nom.); 'and the story'
طَوِيلَةٌ: طَوِيلَة — ṭawīla, long (adj., f. sg., nom. indefinite, predicate); 'long'
حِكَايَتِهَا: حِكَايَة + هَا — ḥikāya, telling, tale (f., gen.) + -hā, its; 'the telling of it'
الصَّبَاحَ: الـ + صَبَاح — ṣabāḥ, morning (m., acc. after anna); 'the morning'; also: acc. of time after aṣbaḥat: fa-lammā aṣbaḥat al-ṣabāḥa, 'when she reached the morning'
فَنَبْقَى: فَـ + نَبْقَى — fa-, so (conj.; subjunctive consequence) + nabqā, to remain, stay (verb I, root ب-ق-ي; subj. 1st pl.); 'so we remain'
مَفْضُوحِينَ: مَفْضُوحِين — mafḍūḥ, exposed, disgraced (pass. part. of faḍaḥa; m. sound pl., acc. as predicate of nabqā); 'exposed'
وَتَرُوحَ: وَ + تَرُوحَ — wa-, and (conj.) + rāḥa, to go, go away (colloquial verb I, root ر-و-ح; subj. 3rd f. sg.); 'and goes (is lost)'
فَدُونَكُمْ: فَـ + دُونَ + كُمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + dūna, before, in front of (prep. used as an urging imperative) + -kum, you (pl.); 'so, here you have; get to it'
فَتْحَ: فَتْح — fatḥ, opening (m., verbal noun of fataḥa; acc., object of dūnakum); 'the opening of'
فَتَحْنَاهُ: فَتَحَ + نَا + هُ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, root ف-ت-ح; perf.) + -nā, we + -hu, it; 'we opened it'
وَرُحْنَا: وَ + رَاحَ + نَا — wa-, and + rāḥa, to go (colloquial verb I, hollow root ر-و-ح; perf.) + -nā, we; 'and we went'
قَصْرِنَا: قَصْر + نَا — qaṣr, palace (m., gen. after ilā) + -nā, our; 'our palace'
وَحَفَرُوا: وَ + حَفَرُوا — wa-, and + ḥafara, to dig (verb I, root ح-ف-ر; perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'and they dug'
حُفْرَةً: حُفْرَة — ḥufra, hole, pit (f., acc. indefinite, object); 'a pit'
وَعَرْضِهِ: وَ + عَرْض + هُ — wa-, and + ʿarḍ, width (m., gen., joined to ṭūl by wa-) + -hu, its; 'and its width'
قُبُورٍ: قُبُور — qubūr, tombs, graves (pl. of qabr; gen. after a number, indefinite); 'tombs'
يَحْفِرُ: يَحْفِرُ — yaḥfiru, to dig (verb I; imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'digging'
وَصَوَابُ: وَ + صَوَاب — wa-, and + Ṣawāb, a slave's name (lit. 'what is right'); nom.
بِالْقُفَفِ: بِـ + الـ + قُفَف — bi-, in, by means of (prep.; of the container or instrument) + al-, the + qufaf, baskets (pl. of quffa); 'in the baskets'
حَفَرُوا: حَفَرُوا — ḥafara, to dig (verb I; perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they dug' (the perfect after ilā an is Middle Arabic)
حَطُّوا: حَطُّوا — ḥaṭṭa, to put down, lower (verb I; perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they lowered'
وَرَدُّوا: وَ + رَدُّوا — wa-, and + radda, to return, put back, shut (verb I, root ر-د-د; perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'and they put back'
غَانِمِ: غَانِم — Ghānim, a man's name (lit. 'winning, gaining'); gen. in the iḍāfa
وَخَلَا: وَ + خَلَا — wa-, and + khalā, to be empty, clear (verb I, root خ-ل-و; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and was empty'; here khalā bi-, 'to be alone with', bi- marking the companion: khalā Marzawānu bi-Qamari al-Zamāni, 'Marzawān was alone with Qamar al-Zamān'
لِغَانِمٍ: لِـ + غَانِم — li-, for, to (prep.; marks the one for whom the place was empty: 'for Ghānim') + Ghānim (gen.)
سِرُّهُ: سِرّ + هُ — sirr, inmost thought, secret (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his inmost mind'
بَرَقَ: بَرَقَ — baraqa, to flash, gleam (verb I, root ب-ر-ق; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'it flashed'
ضِيَاؤُهُ: ضِيَاء + هُ — ḍiyāʾ, light, brightness (m., nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'its light'
النَّخْلَهِ: الـ + نَخْلَة — nakhla, palm tree (f.; the print spells the final -a with ه), gen. after min ʿalā; 'the palm'
وَخَلَّصَهُ: وَ + خَلَّصَ + هُ — wa-, and + khallaṣa, to free, clear (verb II, root خ-ل-ص; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and freed it'
الْقُفْلَ: الـ + قُفْل — qufl, lock (m., acc., object); 'the lock'
فَكَسَرَهُ: فَـ + كَسَرَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.; result) + kasara, to break (verb I, root ك-س-ر; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and broke it'
نَائِمَةٌ: نَائِمَة — nāʾima, sleeping (act. part. of nāma, f. sg., nom. indefinite); 'asleep'
مُبَنَّجَةٌ: مُبَنَّجَة — mubannaja, drugged with bang (pass. part. of verb II bannaja, root ب-ن-ج; f. sg., nom. indefinite); 'drugged'
وَنَفَسُهَا: وَ + نَفَس + هَا — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + nafas, breath (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her breath'
نَازِلٌ: نَازِل — nāzil, going down (act. part. of nazala; m., nom. indefinite); 'falling'
وَمَصَاغُ: وَ + مَصَاغ — wa-, and + maṣāgh, worked gold or silver, jewellery (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the work of'
وَقِلَا: وَ + قِلَا — wa-, and + qilā-, the first half of the split word qilābid (printed وقلا بد), a plural of qilāda, necklace
بِدُ: بِدُ — -bidu, the second half of the split qilābid, 'necklaces' (nom., first term of the iḍāfa with al-jawāhir, 'necklaces of jewels')
يَفِي: يَفِي — yafī, to suffice, be enough (verb I, root و-ف-ي; imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'meets'
تَغَامَزُوا: تَغَامَزُوا — taghāmazū, to wink at one another, conspire (verb VI, root غ-م-ز; perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they plotted together'
وَبَنَّجُوهَا: وَ + بَنَّجَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and + bannaja, to drug with bang (verb II, root ب-ن-ج; perf.) + -ū, they + -hā, her; 'and drugged her'
عَالَجَ: عَالَجَ — ʿālaja, to work at, treat, labour over (verb III, root ع-ل-ج; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'he worked'
أَخْرَجَهَا: أَخْرَجَ + هَا — akhraja, to bring out, take out (verb IV, root خ-ر-ج; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'he took her out'
وَأَرْقَدَهَا: وَ + أَرْقَدَ + هَا — wa-, and + arqada, to lay down, put to sleep (verb IV, root ر-ق-د; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and laid her down'
اسْتَنْشَقَتِ: اِسْتَنْشَقَتِ — istanshaqat, to breathe in, inhale (verb X, root ن-ش-ق; perf. 3rd f. sg.; final kasra before the article); 'she breathed in'
الْأَرْيَاحَ: الـ + أَرْيَاح — aryāḥ, winds, breezes, airs (pl. of rīḥ; f., acc., object); 'the breezes'
أَنْفِهَا: أَنْف + هَا — anf, nose (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her nose'
وَمَنَافِسِهَا: وَ + مَنَافِس + هَا — wa-, and + manāfis, breathing places, air passages (pl. of manfas; gen., joined to anfihā) + -hā, her; 'and her breathing-passages'
عَطَسَتْ: عَطَسَ + تْ — ʿaṭasa, to sneeze (verb I, root ع-ط-س; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'she sneezed'
شَرِقَتْ: شَرِقَ + تْ — shariqa, to choke (on one's spittle) (verb I, root ش-ر-ق; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'she choked'
وَسَعَلَتْ: وَ + سَعَلَ + تْ — wa-, and + saʿala, to cough (verb I, root س-ع-ل; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'and she coughed'
حَلْقِهَا: حَلْق + هَا — ḥalq, throat (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her throat'
بَنْجٍ: بَنْج — banj, bang, a narcotic (henbane or hemp) (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of bang'
إِقْرِيطِشِيٍّ: إِقْرِيطِشِيّ — iqrīṭishī, Cretan, of Crete (nisba adj. from Iqrīṭish; m., gen. indefinite, agrees with banjin); 'Cretan'
لَوْشَمَّهُ: لَوْ + شَمَّ + هُ — law, if (particle of unreal condition; the print joins it to the verb) + shamma, to smell (verb I, root ش-م-م; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'if (an elephant) smelled it'
الْفِيلُ: الـ + فِيل — fīl, elephant (m., nom., subject of shamma); 'the elephant'
لَرَقَدَ: لَـ + رَقَدَ — la-, would have (particle introducing the apodosis after law) + raqada, to sleep, lie down (verb I, root ر-ق-د; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'it would have slept'
فَفَتَحَتْ: فَـ + فَتَحَ + تْ — fa-, then (conj.; sequence) + fataḥa, to open (verb I; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'then she opened'
وَأَدَارَتْ: وَ + أَدَارَ + تْ — wa-, and + adāra, to turn, make go round (verb IV, root د-و-ر; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'and she turned'
يَارِيحُ: يَا + رِيح — yā, O (vocative particle; the print runs it into the noun) + rīḥ, wind (f., nom.); 'O wind'
رِيٌّ: رِيّ — riyy, quenching, a drink that satisfies (m., nom. indefinite, subject; the negative mā precedes); 'quenching'
لِلْعَطْشَانِ: لِـ + الـ + عَطْشَان — li-, for (prep.; of the one who benefits: 'for the thirsty') + al-, the + ʿaṭshān, thirsty (m., gen., diptote written with kasra after li-); 'for the thirsty'
أُنْسٌ: أُنْس — uns, companionship, familiarity, ease (m., nom. indefinite); 'companionship'
لِلرَّيَّانِ: لِـ + الـ + رَيَّان — li-, for (prep.; of the one who benefits) + al-, the + rayyān, well-watered, sated (adj., m., gen.); 'for the sated'
زَهْرُ: زَهْر — zahr, blossoms, flowers (collective m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the blossoms of'
يُجَاوِبْهَا: يُجَاوِب + هَا — yujāwib, to answer (verb III, root ج-و-ب; jussive 3rd m. sg. after lam) + -hā, her; 'answer her'
يَاصَبِيحَةُ: يَا + صَبِيحَة — yā, O (vocative; the print runs it into the name) + Ṣabīḥa, a girl's name (lit. 'the bright one'); nom.
الدُّرِّ: الـ + دُرّ — durr, pearls (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of pearls'
نَجْمَةَ: نَجْمَة — najma, star (f., acc. as vocative muḍāf; first term of Najmat al-Ṣubḥ, 'Star of the Morning', a girl's name)
نُزْهَةُ: نُزْهَة — Nuzha, a girl's name (lit. 'pleasure outing'); nom. as vocative
حُلْوَةُ: حُلْوَة — Ḥulwa, a girl's name (lit. 'sweet one'); nom. as vocative
ظَرِيفَةُ: ظَرِيفَة — Ẓarīfa, a girl's name (lit. 'charming one'); nom. as vocative
تَكَلَّمُوا: تَكَلَّمُوا — takallamū, to speak (verb V, root ك-ل-م; imperative 2nd m. pl.); 'speak!'
يُجِبْهَا: يُجِب + هَا — yujib, to answer (verb IV, root ج-و-ب; jussive 3rd m. sg. after lam) + -hā, her; 'answer her'
فَجَالَتْ: فَـ + جَالَ + تْ — fa-, then (conj.; sequence) + jāla, to rove, roam (verb I, hollow root ج-و-ل; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'then she let roam'
وَيْلِي: وَيْل + ـِي — wayl, woe, ruin (m.; in an exclamation) + -ī, my; 'woe is me'
تَقْبِرِينِي: تَقْبِر + ينِي — taqbir, to bury (verb I qabara, root ق-ب-ر; imperf. 2nd f. sg. with -īn, the nūn of the ending) + -nī, me; 'you bury me'
مَافِى: مَا + فِى — mā, what (rel. pron.) + fī, in (prep.; spelled with final ى as printed; the print runs the two together); 'what is in'
وَيُجَازِي: وَ + يُجَازِي — wa-, and + yujāzī, to repay, requite (verb III, root ج-ز-ي; imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and repays'
الْبَعْثِ: الـ + بَعْث — baʿth, resurrection, raising of the dead (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of the resurrection'
وَالنُّشُورِ: وَ + الـ + نُشُور — wa-, and + al-, the + nushūr, rising from the dead (m., gen.); 'and the rising'
السُّتُورِ: الـ + سُتُور — sutūr, curtains, veils (pl. of sitr; gen. in iḍāfa); 'the curtains'
وَالْخُدُورِ: وَ + الـ + خُدُور — wa-, and + al-, the + khudūr, women's chambers, screened litters (pl. of khidr; gen.); 'and the bowers'
وَغَانِمٌ: وَ + غَانِم — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + Ghānim, a man's name (nom.); 'and Ghānim'
لَاخُدُورَ: لَا + خُدُورَ — lā, no (negation of the whole class; takes the acc.) + khudūr, bowers, chambers (m. pl.; the print runs the two together); 'no bowers'
قُصُورَ: قُصُور — quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr; acc. after lā, here with the wa- and lā before); 'palaces'
قُبُورَ: قُبُور — qubūr, tombs, graves (pl. of qabr; acc. after lā); 'tombs'
سَاقَهُ: سَاقَ + هُ — sāqa, to drive, bring (verb I, hollow root س-و-ق; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'drove him'
عَلَّامُ: عَلَّام — ʿallām, all-knowing, one who knows thoroughly (intensive form; m., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the Knower of'
الْغُيُوبِ: الـ + غُيُوب — ghuyūb, unseen things, hidden matters (pl. of ghayb; gen. in iḍāfa); 'the unseen things'
يُنَجِّيَكِ: يُنَجِّي + كِ — yunajjī, to deliver, save (verb II, root ن-ج-و; subj. 3rd m. sg., after ḥattā) + -ki, you (f. sg.); 'that He deliver you'
الْكُرُوبِ: الـ + كُرُوب — kurūb, troubles, distresses (pl. of karb; gen. after min); 'the troubles'
وَيُحَصِّلَ: وَ + يُحَصِّلَ — wa-, and + yuḥaṣṣila, to procure, bring about (verb II, root ح-ص-ل; subj. 3rd m. sg.); 'and bring about'
الْمَطْلُوبِ: الـ + مَطْلُوب — maṭlūb, that which is sought, desire (pass. part. of ṭalaba; m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'what is wished'
وَسَكَتَ: وَ + سَكَتَ — wa-, and + sakata, to fall silent (verb I, root س-ك-ت; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he fell silent'
تَحَقَّقَتِ: تَحَقَّقَتِ — taḥaqqaqat, to make sure of, grasp (verb V; perf. 3rd f. sg.; the kasra is before the article); 'she made sure of'
آلَهَ: إِلَٰه — ilāh, god (m., acc. after lā); the print writes it with a madda, آله
الْتَفَتَتْ: اِلْتَفَتَ + تْ — iltafata, to turn (verb VIII, root ل-ف-ت; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'she turned'
وَضَعَتْ: وَضَعَ + تْ — waḍaʿa, to place, put (verb I, root و-ض-ع; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg.; 'she put' Also of a woman, 'to give birth to': waḍaʿat waladan dhakaran, 'she bore a male child'.
الْمُبَارَكُ: الـ + مُبَارَك — mubārak, blessed (pass. part. of verb III bāraka, root ب-ر-ك; m., nom., adj.); 'blessed'
قَدَا: قَدْ + أ — qad, already, indeed (particle) + the initial a- of afaqtu, run on by the print (قدا فقت = قد أفقت)
فَقْتُ: فَقْتُ — -faqtu, remaining half of afaqtu, 'I came to, woke' (verb IV afāqa, hollow root ف-و-ق; perf. 1st sg.); the print drops the alif onto qad
ثَلَٰثَةُ: ثَلَاثَة — thalātha, three (f. numeral; the print drops the long ā, so a dagger alif is written; nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'three'
خَصِيُّونَ: خَصِيُّون — khaṣī, eunuch (m. sound pl., nom., adj. in apposition); 'eunuchs'
حَامِلُونَ: حَامِلُون — ḥāmil, carrying (act. part. of ḥamala; m. sound pl., nom.); 'carrying'
لْمَسَاءُ: لْ + مَسَاء — l-, misprint for the article al- (alif lost) + masāʾ, evening (m., nom., subject); 'the evening'
سَلَامَتِهَا: سَلَامَة + هَا — salāma, safety, deliverance (f., gen. in iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her safety'
بِغُصَّتِهَا: بِـ + غُصَّة + هَا — bi-, of, from (prep.; of the cause: 'died of') + ghuṣṣa, choking, a morsel stuck in the throat (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her choking'
أَسْأَلَهَا: أَسْأَلَ + هَا — asʾala, to ask (read as sa'ala, verb I, root س-أ-ل; perf. 3rd m. sg.; the initial alif is spurious or a Middle Arabic form IV) + -hā, her; 'he asked her'
وَخَبَرِهَا: وَ + خَبَر + هَا — wa-, and + khabar, news, account (m., gen., joined to ḥikāyatihā) + -hā, her; 'and her news'
فَقُمِ: فَـ + قُمِ — fa-, so (conj.; draws a consequence) + qum, get up (verb I, hollow root ق-و-م; imperative 2nd m. sg., with kasra before the article); 'so get up'
وَحُطَّنِي: وَ + حُطَّ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥuṭṭa, to put (verb I, root ح-ط-ط; imperative 2nd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and put me'
وَبَدْتَ: وَبَدْتَ — wajadta, to find (verb I, root و-ج-د; perf. 2ms), printed with ب for ج (a misprint); the wāw is a root letter, not 'and'; 'you find'
مُكَارِيًا: مُكَارِي — mukārī, muleteer, hirer of animals (m., acc. indefinite, object); 'a muleteer'
بَغَّالًا: بَغَّال — baghghāl, mule-driver, owner of mules (m., acc. indefinite); 'a mule-driver'
فَاكْتَرِهِ: فَـ + اِكْتَرِ + هِ — fa-, then (conj.; main clause after a condition) + iktari, hire (verb VIII, root ك-ر-ي; imperative 2nd m. sg.) + -hi, him; 'then hire him'
لِحَمْلِ: لِـ + حَمْل — li-, for, in order to (prep.; of the purpose) + ḥaml, carrying (m., verbal noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'for the carrying of'
وَوَصِّلْنِي: وَ + وَصِّلْ + نِي — wa-, and + waṣṣil, to convey, make arrive (verb II, root و-ص-ل; imperative 2nd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and take me'
بَيْتِكَ: بَيْت + كَ — bayt, house (m., gen. after ilā) + -ka, your; 'your house'
فَذَا: فَـ + ذَا — fa-, so (conj.) + dhā, misprint for idhā, if, when (the alif is lost from إذا); 'and if'
أَنَافِي: أَنَا + فِي — anā, I (pron. 1st sg.) + fī, in (prep.); the print runs the two together: 'I in'
دَارِكَ: دَار + كَ — dār, house, dwelling (f., gen. after fī) + -ka, your; 'your house'
وَأُخْبِرُكَ: وَ + أُخْبِر + كَ — wa-, and + ukhbir, to inform, relate to (verb IV, root خ-ب-ر; imperf. 1st sg.) + -ka, you; 'and I will tell you'
وَيَحْصُلُ: وَ + يَحْصُلُ — wa-, and + yaḥṣulu, to come about, accrue (verb I, root ح-ص-ل; imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and will accrue'
جِهَتِي: جِهَة + ـِي — jiha, side, direction (f., gen. after min) + -ī, my; min jihatī 'from my side, through me'
شَعْشَعَ: شَعْشَعَ — shaʿshaʿa, to spread light, shine brightly (quadriliteral verb, root ش-ع-ش-ع; perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'it shone'
الْجَوُّ: الـ + جَوّ — jaww, air, sky, atmosphere (m., nom., subject); 'the air'
بِالْأَنْوَارِ: بِـ + الـ + أَنْوَار — bi-, with, in (prep.; of the manner: 'shone with') + al-, the + anwār, lights (pl. of nūr; gen.); 'with the lights'
وَخَرَجَتِ: وَ + خَرَجَ + تِ — wa-, and + kharaja, to go out (verb I; perf.) + -at, 3rd f. sg. (kasra before the article); 'and went out'
بِبَغْلٍ: بِـ + بَغْل — bi-, with (prep.; of accompaniment: 'a man with a mule') + baghl, mule (m., gen. indefinite); 'with a mule'
وَسَارَبِهَا: وَ + سَارَ + بِـ + هَا — wa-, and + sāra, to go, travel (verb I, hollow root س-ي-ر; perf. 3rd m. sg.) + bi-, with (prep.; sāra bi- 'go off with, take along') + -hā, her; the print runs the words together; 'and he went off with her'
يَصِلُ: يَصِلُ — yaṣilu, to arrive (verb I, root و-ص-ل; imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'he would arrive'
غَانِمَ: غَانِمَ — غَانِم — Ghānim, a proper name (from ghānim, 'one who gains, winner'), accusative after أَنَّ, with tanwīn dropped before بْن
لصُّنْدُوقِ: لصُّنْدُوقِ — ل + صُّنْدُوق — the remainder of الصندوق after the print's stray space: the lām of the article (silent, assimilated to the ṣād) + ṣundūq, chest (m.), genitive after بِـ; read with بِا: 'with the chest'
فَتَحَهُ: فَتَحَهُ — فَـ + فَتَحَ + هُ — fa-, and then (narrative sequence) + fataḥa, to open (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, it/him (object); 'and he opened it'
لْوَانِ: لْوَانِ — لْوَان + ـِ — the rest of أَلْوَان (alwān, colours, pl. of lawn), genitive by coordination with 'the carpets'; read with وَالْأَ: 'and the colours'
الْمُفَرِّحَةِ: الْمُفَرِّحَةِ — الـ + مُفَرِّحَة — mufarriḥa, gladdening, cheering (active participle f., form II of faraḥ 'joy'), genitive, agreeing with the plural ألوان; 'the cheering (ones)'
وَرَأَتْ: وَرَأَتْ — وَ + رَأَى + تْ — wa-, and + raʾā, to see (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she saw'
قُمَاشًا: قُمَاشًا — قُمَاش — qumāsh, goods, stuff, merchandise (m.), accusative object with tanwīn; 'goods'
مَحْزُومًا: مَحْزُومًا — مَحْزُوم — maḥzūm, tied up, bundled (passive participle of ḥazama, 'to bind'), accusative agreeing with قماشا; 'bundled'
وَأَحْمَالًا: وَأَحْمَالًا — وَ + أَحْمَال — wa-, and + aḥmāl, loads, bales (pl. of ḥiml), accusative; 'and loads'
فَعَلِمَتْ: فَعَلِمَتْ — فَـ + عَلِمَ + تْ — fa-, and so + ʿalima, to know (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she knew'
أَمْوَالٍ: أَمْوَالٍ — أَمْوَال — amwāl, wealth, goods (pl. of māl), genitive as the second term of the annexation; 'of wealth'
كَثِيرَةٍ: كَثِيرَةٍ — كَثِيرَة — kathīra, abundant, much (adj. f.), genitive agreeing with أموال (a non-human plural takes the f. sg.); 'abundant'
فَكَشَفَتْ: فَكَشَفَتْ — فَـ + كَشَفَ + تْ — fa-, and then + kashafa, to uncover (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she uncovered'
رَأَتْهُ: رَأَتْهُ — رَأَى + تْ + هُ — raʾā, to see (perfect 3rd f. sg., -at) + -hu, him (object); 'she saw him'
أَحَبَّتْهُ: أَحَبَّتْهُ — أَحَبَّ + تْ + هُ — aḥabba, to love (form IV perfect 3rd f. sg., from ḥ-b-b) + -hu, him; 'she loved him'
وَصَحْنَ: وَصَحْنَ — وَ + صَحْن — wa-, and + ṣaḥn, dish, platter (m.), accusative (first term of an annexation); 'and a dish of'
حَلَاوَةٍ: حَلَاوَةٍ — حَلَاوَة — ḥalāwa, sweetness, sweetmeats (f.), genitive as second term of the annexation; 'sweetmeats'
نُقْلًا: نُقْلًا — نُقْل — nuql, dessert nuts and sweets served with drinking (m.), accusative object; 'dessert-nuts'
وَشَمْعًا: وَشَمْعًا — وَ + شَمْع — wa-, and + shamʿ, wax, wax-candles (m.), accusative; 'and candles'
نَبِيذًا: نَبِيذًا — نَبِيذ — nabīdh, date- or raisin-wine (m.), accusative object with tanwīn; 'wine'
آلَةِ: آلَةِ — آلَة — āla, apparatus, equipment (f.), genitive after من, first term of an annexation; 'the equipment of'
الْمَشْرُوبِ: الْمَشْرُوبِ — الـ + مَشْرُوب — mashrūb, drink, drinkable (passive participle of shariba, 'to drink', used as a noun), genitive; 'the drinkables'
بِالْحَوَائِجِ: بِالْحَوَائِجِ — بِـ + الـ + حَوَائِج — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment: 'entered with, bringing') + al-ḥawāʾij, the necessities, provisions (pl. of ḥāja, 'need'); 'with the provisions'
وَقَبَّلَتْهُ: وَقَبَّلَتْهُ — وَ + قَبَّلَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (form II perfect 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she kissed him'
تُلَاطِفُهُ: تُلَاطِفُهُ — تُ + لَاطِفُ + هُ — tu-, she (3rd f. sg. imperfect prefix) + lāṭafa, to treat kindly, caress (form III imperfect) + -hu, him; 'caressing him'
فَازْدَادَتْ: فَازْدَادَتْ — فَـ + ازْدَادَ + تْ — fa-, and so + izdāda, to increase, grow (form VIII perfect 3rd f. sg., from z-y-d); 'and so grew'
وَاحْتَوَتْ: وَاحْتَوَتْ — وَ + احْتَوَى + تْ — wa-, and + iḥtawā, to take possession, contain (form VIII perfect 3rd f. sg.; iḥtawā ʿalā = 'take possession of'); 'and took possession'
أَكَلَا: أَكَلَا — أَكَلَ + ا — akala, to eat (perfect, with the dual ending -ā, 'the two of them'); 'the two ate'
أَحَبَّ: أَحَبَّ — أَحَبَّ — aḥabba, to love (form IV perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'loved'
لِأَنَّهُمَا: لِأَنَّهُمَا — لِـ + أَنَّ + هُمَا — li-, for, because (prep. joined with anna: li-anna = 'because') + anna, that + -humā, the two of them; 'because they two'
سِنٍّ: سِنٍّ — سِنّ — sinn, age (m.), genitive with tanwīn after في; 'an age'
فَأَضَاءَ: فَأَضَاءَ — فَـ + أَضَاءَ — fa-, and so + aḍāʾa, to shine, be lit (form IV perfect 3rd m. sg., intransitive here); 'and so shone'
آلَةَ: آلَةَ — آلَة — āla, apparatus, equipment (f.), accusative object, first term of an annexation; 'the equipment of'
الْحَضْرَةَ: الْحَضْرَةَ — الـ + حَضْرَة — ḥaḍra, presence, company-gathering (f.), accusative object; here 'the spread of the drinking-session'
يَمْلَأً: يَمْلَأً — يَ + مْلَأُ — ya-, he (3rd m. sg. imperfect prefix) + malaʾa, to fill (imperfect; the print marks tanwīn on the hamza-seat alif); 'he fills'
تَمْلَأً: تَمْلَأً — تَ + مْلَأُ — ta-, she (3rd f. sg. imperfect prefix) + malaʾa, to fill (imperfect; the print marks tanwīn on the hamza-seat alif); 'she fills'
وَتَسْقِيهِ: وَتَسْقِيهِ — وَ + تَ + سْقِي + هِ — wa-, and + ta-, she + saqā, to give to drink (imperfect) + -hi, him; 'and gives him to drink'
يَلْعَبَانِ: يَلْعَبَانِ — يَ + لْعَبَ + انِ — ya-, they (3rd person imperfect prefix) + laʿiba, to play, sport (imperfect) + -āni, dual ending; 'play (the two)'
وَيَضْحَكَانِ: وَيَضْحَكَانِ — وَ + يَ + ضْحَكَ + انِ — wa-, and + ya- + ḍaḥika, to laugh (imperfect) + -āni, dual ending; 'and laugh (the two)'
وَيُنْشِدَانِ: وَيُنْشِدَانِ — وَ + يُ + نْشِدَ + انِ — wa-, and + yu- (form IV imperfect prefix) + anshada, to recite (verse) + -āni, dual ending; 'and recite (the two)'
الْفَرَحُ: الْفَرَحُ — الـ + فَرَح — faraḥ, joy, gladness (m.), nominative subject; 'the joy'
الْبَعْضِ: الْبَعْضِ — الـ + بَعْض — baʿḍ, part, other (m.), genitive in apposition (the reciprocal 'one another'); 'the other'
مُؤَلِّفِ: مُؤَلِّفِ — مُؤَلِّف — muʾallif, uniter, joiner (active participle of form II allafa, 'to join'), genitive, second term of the annexation; 'the Joiner of'
وَخُضْرَةٍ: وَخُضْرَةٍ — وَ + خُضْرَة — wa-, and + khuḍra, greenery, vegetables (f.), genitive; 'and greens'
وَلَحْمٍ: وَلَحْمٍ — وَ + لَحْم — wa-, and + laḥm, meat (m.), genitive; 'and meat'
وَخَمْرٍ: وَخَمْرٍ — وَ + خَمْر — wa-, and + khamr, wine (m./f.), genitive; 'and wine'
يَأْكُلَانِ: يَأْكُلَانِ — يَ + أْكُلَ + انِ — ya-, they (3rd person imperfect prefix) + akala, to eat (imperfect) + -āni, dual ending; 'eating (the two)'
أَحْضَرَا: أَحْضَرَا — أَحْضَرَ + ا — aḥḍara, to bring (form IV perfect, dual -ā); 'the two brought'
وَشَرِبَاوْ: وَشَرِبَاوْ — وَ + شَرِبَ + ا + و — wa-, and + shariba, to drink (perfect) + dual -ā, followed by a stray waw of the print (as if شربوا); read sharibā, 'and the two drank'
لَعِبَا: لَعِبَا — لَعِبَ + ا — laʿiba, to play, sport (perfect, dual -ā); 'the two played'
احْمَرَّتْ: احْمَرَّتْ — احْمَرَّ + تْ — iḥmarra, to turn red (form IX perfect 3rd f. sg., from the colour aḥmar); 'reddened'
وَجَنَاتُهُمَا: وَجَنَاتُهُمَا — وَجَنَات + هُمَا — wajanāt, cheeks (f. pl. of wajna), nominative subject + -humā, their (the two); 'their cheeks'
وَاسْوَدَّتْ: وَاسْوَدَّتْ — وَ + اسْوَدَّ + تْ — wa-, and + iswadda, to turn black, dark (form IX perfect 3rd f. sg., from aswad); 'and grew dark'
وَاشْتَاقَتْ: وَاشْتَاقَتْ — وَ + اشْتَاقَ + تْ — wa-, and + ishtāqa, to long, yearn (form VIII perfect 3rd f. sg.; with إلى 'to long for'); 'and longed'
تَقْبِيلِ: تَقْبِيلِ — تَقْبِيل — taqbīl, kissing (verbal noun of form II qabbala), genitive after إلى ('longed for the kissing of'); 'kissing'
وَالنَّوْمِ: وَالنَّوْمِ — وَ + الـ + نَّوْم — wa-, and + al-nawm, the sleeping, lying (with her) (m.), genitive coordinated with 'kissing'; 'and the sleeping'
إِئْذَنِي: إِئْذَنِي — إِئْذَنِ + ي — i-ʾdhan, permit! (imperative of adhina, 'to permit', m.) + -ī, the f. singular ending addressing the girl; 'permit (you f.)'
لَعَلَّهَا: لَعَلَّهَا — لَعَلَّ + هَا — laʿalla, perhaps (particle that puts its subject in the accusative) + -hā, it (the kiss, f.); 'perhaps it'
تُبَرِّدُ: تُبَرِّدُ — تُ + بَرِّدُ — tu-, she/it (3rd f. sg. imperfect prefix) + barrada, to cool (form II imperfect); 'will cool'
نَارَ: نَارَ — نَار — nār, fire (f.), accusative object, first term of an annexation; 'the fire of'
أَسْكَرَ: أَسْكَرَ — أَ + سْكَرَ — a-, I (1st sg. imperfect prefix) + sakira, to get drunk (subjunctive after ḥattā); 'I become drunk'
وَأَغِيبَ: وَأَغِيبَ — وَ + أَ + غِيبَ — wa-, and + a-, I + ghāba, to be absent, lose consciousness (subjunctive); 'and I lose my senses'
وَخُذْلَكَ: وَخُذْلَكَ — وَ + خُذْ + لَ + كَ — wa-, and + khudh, take! (imperative of akhadha) + la-, for (prep., benefit) + -ka, you (m.), joined by the print into one word; 'and take for yourself'
قُبْلَةً: قُبْلَةً — قُبْلَة — qubla, kiss (f.), accusative object with tanwīn; 'a kiss'
قَبَّلْتَنِي: قَبَّلْتَنِي — قَبَّلَ + تَ + نِي — qabbala, to kiss (form II perfect) + -ta, you (m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'you kissed me'
وَخَلَعَتْ: وَخَلَعَتْ — وَ + خَلَعَ + تْ — wa-, and + khalaʿa, to take off (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'and she took off'
رَفِيعٍ: رَفِيعٍ — رَفِيع — rafīʿ, fine, thin (adj.), genitive agreeing with قميص; 'fine'
وَكُوفِيَّةِ: وَكُوفِيَّةِ — وَ + كُوفِيَّة — wa-, and + kūfiyya, head-cloth, kerchief (f.), genitive, first term of an annexation; 'and a head-cloth of'
تَحَرَّكَتِ: تَحَرَّكَتِ — تَحَرَّكَ + تِ — taḥarraka, to stir, be moved (form V perfect 3rd f. sg., with kasra before the article); 'stirred'
تَسْمَحِينَ: تَسْمَحِينَ — تَ + سْمَحِينَ — ta-, you (2nd person imperfect prefix) + samaḥa, to grant, allow (imperfect) + -īna, the f. singular ending (you f.); 'you allow'
دِكَّةِ: دِكَّةِ — دِكَّة — dikka, the waist-cord of drawers (a variant of tikka; dakka 'bench' is the other possible reading), genitive after على, first term of an annexation; 'the cord of'
لِبَاسِي: لِبَاسِي — لِبَاس + ي — libās, drawers, under-garment (m.), genitive + -ī, my; 'my drawers'
قَوْلٌ: قَوْلٌ — قَوْل — qawl, saying, utterance (m.), nominative (the thing written); 'a saying'
الْغَرَامُ: الْغَرَامُ — الـ + غَرَام — gharām, passion, consuming love (m.), nominative subject; 'the passion'
الْمَطْلُوبُ: الْمَطْلُوبُ — الـ + مَطْلُوب — maṭlūb, the sought thing/person (passive participle of ṭalaba, 'to seek'), nominative; 'the object sought'
سَأَلْتُ: سَأَلْتُ — سَأَلَ + تُ — saʾala, to ask (perfect) + -tu, I; 'I asked'
أَمْرَضَنِي: أَمْرَضَنِي — أَمْرَضَ + نِي — amraḍa, to make ill (form IV perfect 3rd m. sg., from maraḍ 'illness') + -nī, me; 'made me sick'
قُبْلَةٍ: قُبْلَةٍ — قُبْلَة — qubla, kiss (f.), genitive with tanwīn after فِي ('for a kiss'); 'a kiss'
تَشْفِي: تَشْفِي — تَ + شْفِي — ta-, she/it (3rd f. sg. imperfect prefix) + shafā, to heal, cure (imperfect); 'that heals'
الْأَلَمْ: الْأَلَمْ — الـ + أَلَم — alam, pain (m.), accusative object, with the vowel dropped in pause (rhyme); 'the pain'
بِالرِّضَى: بِالرِّضَى — بِـ + الـ + رِّضَى — bi-, with, in (prep., manner) + al-riḍā, consent, willingness; 'with consent'
حَلَالًا: حَلَالًا — حَلَال — ḥalāl, lawful, permitted (adj.), accusative with tanwīn (a state: 'lawfully'); 'lawfully'
وَابْتَسَمْ: وَابْتَسَمْ — وَ + ابْتَسَمَ — wa-, and + ibtasama, to smile (form VIII perfect 3rd m. sg.; the vowel dropped in pause for the rhyme); 'and he smiled'
وَكَرَمْ: وَكَرَمْ — وَ + كَرَم — wa-, and + karam, generosity (m.), vowel dropped in pause for the rhyme; 'and generosity'
تَسَلْ: تَسَلْ — تَ + سَلْ — ta-, you (2nd person imperfect prefix) + saʾala, to ask (jussive after lā; the hamza and the vowel dropped: tasal for tasʾal); 'ask'
وَاسْتَغْفِرِ: وَاسْتَغْفِرِ — وَ + اسْتَغْفِرِ — wa-, and + istaghfir, ask forgiveness! (form X imperative of ghafara, 'to forgive', with kasra before the article); 'and ask pardon of'
فَظُنَّ: فَظُنَّ — فَـ + ظُنَّ — fa-, so + ẓunna, think! suppose! (imperative of ẓanna, 'to think'); 'so think'
فَالْحُبُّ: فَالْحُبُّ — فَـ + الـ + حُبّ — fa-, for, since (giving the reason) + al-ḥubb, the love (m.), nominative; 'for love'
بِالتُّهَمْ: بِالتُّهَمْ — بِـ + الـ + تُّهَم — bi-, by, through (prep., means) + al-tuham, the suspicions, accusations (pl. of tuhma), vowel dropped in pause; 'through suspicions'
اُبَالِي: اُبَالِي — أُ + بَالِي — u-, I (1st sg. imperfect prefix) + bālā, to care, mind (form III imperfect); 'I care'
بَاحَ: بَاحَ — بَاحَ — bāḥa, to divulge, disclose (perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'divulged'
ضِدٌّ: ضِدٌّ — ضِدّ — ḍidd, adversary, enemy (m.), nominative subject; 'a foe'
كَتَمْ: كَتَمْ — كَتَمَ — katama, to conceal, keep secret (perfect 3rd m. sg.; the vowel dropped in pause for the rhyme); 'concealed'
زَادَتْ: زَادَتْ — زَادَ + تْ — zāda, to increase (form I perfect) + -at, she/it (3rd fem. sg.); 'it increased'
وَانْطَلَقَتِ: وَانْطَلَقَتِ — و + انْطَلَقَتِ — wa-, and + inṭalaqa, to be loosed/let go (form VII perfect) + -at, she/it (the fem. plural noun النِّيرَان takes a fem. sg. verb) with kasra before al-; 'and were loosed'
مُهْجَتِهِ: مُهْجَتِهِ — مُهْجَة + هِ — muhja, heart's blood, life-blood, heart (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his heart'
تَتَمَنَّعُ: تَتَمَنَّعُ — تَتَمَنَّعُ — ta-, she (3rd fem. imperfect prefix) + tamanna'a, to hold oneself back, refuse (form V); 'she holds herself aloof'
وُصُولٌ: وُصُولٌ — wuṣūl, reaching, access (nom. indef.); 'a reaching'
عِشْقِهِمَا: عِشْقِهِمَا — عِشْق + هِمَا — ʿishq, passionate love (m., gen. after fī) + -himā, their (dual); 'in their love'
وَمُنَادَ: وَمُنَادَ — و + مُنَادَ (مُنَادَمَة) — wa-, and + munādama, drinking-companionship (first half of a word printed split); 'and the carousing (of)'
مَتِهِمَا: مَتِهِمَا — مَة + هِمَا — -mat, remaining half of the split word munādamat (f. verbal noun of form III nādama, to drink with) + -himā, their (dual); '(their carousing) together'
وَغَانِمُ: وَغَانِمُ — و + غَانِم — wa-, and + Ghānim, personal name (nom.), 'winner, gainer'; 'and Ghānim'
غَرِيقٌ: غَرِيقٌ — غَرِيق — gharīq, drowned, submerged (adj., nom. indef.; fa'īl form of gharaqa); 'drowned'
الْهُيَامِ: الْهُيَامِ — الـ + هُيَام — al-, the + huyām, love-madness, passionate thirst (gen., second term of the construct); 'of the passion'
ازْدَادَتْ: ازْدَادَتْ — ازْدَادَ + تْ — izdāda, to increase (form VIII perfect of zāda) + -at, she; 'she increased'
قَسْوَةً: قَسْوَةً — قَسْوَة — qaswa, harshness, hardness (accusative of specification, tanwīn fatḥ); 'in harshness'
وَاحْتِشَامًا: وَاحْتِشَامًا — و + احْتِشَام — wa-, and + iḥtishām, modesty, reserve (verbal noun of form VIII iḥtashama; acc. of specification); 'and in reserve'
بِالظَّلَامِ: بِالظَّلَامِ — بِـ + الـ + ظَلَام — bi-, with (prep.; of accompaniment, 'with, in') + al-, the + ẓalām, darkness (gen. after bi-); 'with darkness'
وَأَشْعَلَ: وَأَشْعَلَ — و + أَشْعَلَ — wa-, and + ashʿala, to kindle (form IV perfect); 'and kindled'
وَالْحَضْرَةَ: وَالْحَضْرَةَ — و + الـ + حَضْرَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥaḍra, presence, company, (royal) assembly (acc.); 'and the presence'
وَقَبَّلَهُمَا: وَقَبَّلَهُمَا — و + قَبَّلَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (form II perfect) + -humā, them two (object); 'and kissed them'
الزُّبْدِ: الزُّبْدِ — الـ + زُبْد — al-, the + zubd, butter, fresh cream (gen.); 'butter'
الطَّرِيِّ: الطَّرِيِّ — الـ + طَرِيّ — al-, the + ṭariyy, fresh, soft (adj., gen., nisba form); 'the fresh'
فَمَرَّغَ: فَمَرَّغَ — فَ + مَرَّغَ — fa-, then + marragha, to rub, make wallow (form II perfect); 'then he rubbed'
ارْحَمِي: ارْحَمِي — ارْحَمْ + ي — irḥam, have mercy (imper. of raḥima; alif wasl) + -ī, you (f. sg. imper. ending); 'have mercy'
أَسِيرَ: أَسِيرَ — أَسِير — asīr, captive, prisoner (acc. as vocative-object of irḥamī, in construct); 'captive of' Also asīra, (that) I go: sāra, to go, travel (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs, subj. after an); lā aqdiru an asīra, 'I cannot go'.
هَوَاكِ: هَوَاكِ — هَوَى + كِ — hawā, passion, love (gen. in construct) + -ki, your (f.); 'your love'
وَقَتِيلَ: وَقَتِيلَ — و + قَتِيل — wa-, and + qatīl, slain, killed (acc., in construct, coordinated with asīr); 'and the slain of'
عَيْنَيْكِ: عَيْنَيْكِ — عَيْن + يْ + كِ — ʿayn, eye (f.; dual gen. -ayn) + -ki, your (f.); 'your two eyes'
سَلِيمَ: سَلِيمَ — سَلِيم — salīm, sound, unharmed, whole (adj. used as predicate, acc., in construct); 'sound of'
لَوْلَاكِ: لَوْلَاكِ — لَوْلَا + كِ — lawlā, were it not for (particle) + -ki, you (f.); 'were it not for you'
وَنُورَ: وَنُورَ — و + نُور — wa-, and + nūr, light (acc., vocative in construct); 'and light of'
وَاثِقَةٌ: وَاثِقَةٌ — وَاثِقَة — wāthiqa, trusting, confident (f. act. part. of wathiqa bi-, nom. indef.); 'trusting'
تَصِلُ: تَصِلُ — ta-, you (imperf. prefix) + waṣala yaṣilu, to arrive, reach (imperf.; with ilā 'reach to'); 'you will reach'
الْمَانِعُ: الْمَانِعُ — الـ + مَانِع — al-, the + māniʿ, preventer, obstacle (act. part. of manaʿa, nom.); 'the obstacle'
مَعْذِرَتِي: مَعْذِرَتِي — مَعْذِرَة + ي — maʿdhira, excuse (f., acc. object) + -ī, my; 'my excuse'
تَرَامَتْ: تَرَامَتْ — تَرَامَى + تْ — tarāmā, to cast oneself, throw oneself (form VI perfect) + -at, she; 'she threw herself'
وَطَوَّقَتْ: وَطَوَّقَتْ — و + طَوَّقَ + تْ — wa-, and + ṭawwaqa, to encircle, put around (form II perfect, from ṭawq, ring) + -at, she; 'and put around'
وَأَوْعَدَتْهُ: وَأَوْعَدَتْهُ — و + أَوْعَدَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + awʿada, to promise (form IV perfect; takes bi- for the thing promised) + -at, she + -hu, him; 'and she promised him'
يَنَامَانِ: يَنَامَانِ — ya-, they two + nāma yanāmu, to sleep + -āni, dual; 'sleeping'
الْوِصَالَ: الْوِصَالَ — الـ + وِصَال — al-, the + wiṣāl, union (acc. object); 'union'
تَتَعَزَّزُ: تَتَعَزَّزُ — ta-, she (imperf. prefix) + taʿazzaza, to hold oneself dear, be hard to get (form V); 'she holds herself aloof'
وَهُوَرَا: وَهُوَرَا — و + هُوَ + رَا — wa-, and + huwa, he + rā-, first half of a split word (rāqid, 'lying down', see next) ; 'and he lying'
قِدٌ: قِدٌ — قِد — -qid, second half of the split word rāqid (rāqid, act. part. of raqada, to lie down, nom. indef.); '(lying down)'
سَكْرَانَانِ: سَكْرَانَانِ — سَكْرَان + انِ — sakrān, drunk (adj.) + -āni, dual (colloquial form, not Classical); 'drunk, both'
جَسَدِهَا: جَسَدِهَا — جَسَد + هَا — jasad, body (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her body'
مَرَّبِيَدِهِ: مَرَّبِيَدِهِ — مَرَّ + بِـ + يَد + هِ — marra, to pass (perfect) + bi-, with (prep.; marra bi-yadihi: 'pass with one's hand') + yad, hand (gen.) + -hi, his; 'he passed with his hand' (marra and bi-yadihi printed as one word)
بَطْنِهَا: بَطْنِهَا — بَطْن + هَا — baṭn, belly (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her belly'
سُرَّتِهَا: سُرَّتِهَا — سُرَّة + هَا — surra, navel (f., gen. after ilā) + -hā, her; 'her navel'
فَانْتَبَهَتْ: فَانْتَبَهَتْ — فَ + انْتَبَهَ + تْ — fa-, so + intabaha, to wake up (form VIII perfect) + -at, she; 'so she woke'
حَيْلِهَا: حَيْلِهَا — حَيْل + هَا — ḥayl, strength, effort, power (colloquial ḥayl for Classical ḥayl/ḥawl; gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her strength' ; also: istawat qāʿidatan ʿalā ḥaylihā, 'she sat bolt upright'
وَتَعَهَّدَتِ: وَتَعَهَّدَتِ — و + تَعَهَّدَ + تِ — wa-, and + taʿahhada, to examine, check on (form V perfect) + -at, she (kasra before al-); 'and checked'
فَوَجَدَتِ: فَوَجَدَتِ — فَ + وَجَدَ + تِ — fa-, and so + wajada, to find + -at, she (kasra before al-); 'and found'
مَرْبُوطًا: مَرْبُوطًا — مَرْبُوط — marbūṭ, tied (passive part. of rabaṭa, acc. predicate/ḥāl); 'tied'
فَنَامَتْ: فَنَامَتْ — فَ + نَامَ + تْ — fa-, so + nāma, to sleep + -at, she; 'so she slept'
فَمَلَّسَ: فَمَلَّسَ — فَ + مَلَّسَ — fa-, so + mallasa, to stroke; 'so he stroked'
سِرْ: سِرْ — sir-, first half of the split word sirwāl, drawers; '(trousers)'
وَالِهَا: وَالِهَا — و + الِ + هَا — wālihā, second half of the split word sirwālihā, 'her drawers' (sirwāl, trousers, gen. after ilā + -hā, her); '(her trousers)'
دِكَّتِهَا: دِكَّتِهَا — دِكَّة + هَا — dikka, the casing/hem through which a drawstring runs (f.; printed with a separate و before it) + -hā, her; 'her waist-casing'
أَنَامُ: أَنَامُ — a-, I (imperf. prefix) + nāma yanāmu, to sleep (here subjunctive-like, without an); 'I sleep'
وَاتِّصَافِي: وَاتِّصَافِي — و + اتِّصَاف + ي — wa-, and + ittiṣāf, being joined, being at one (verbal noun of form VIII; sense uncertain) + -ī, my; 'and my union (?)'
الْآنَّ: الْآنَّ — الـ + آن — al-, the + ān, moment, time (the print gives shadda on the nūn; read al-ān, 'the present'); 'now'
أُوَضِّحُ: أُوَضِّحُ — a-, I (imperf. prefix) + wuḍḍiḥ, to make clear (form II waḍḍaḥa); 'I make clear'
وَيَنْكَشِفُ: وَيَنْكَشِفُ — و + يَنْكَشِفُ — wa-, and + ya-, it (imperf. prefix) + inkashafa, to be uncovered (form VII); 'and is laid bare'
وَيَظْهَرُ: وَيَظْهَرُ — و + يَظْهَرُ — wa-, and + ya-, it + ẓahara yaẓharu, to appear; 'and appears'
وَمَدَّتْ: وَمَدَّتْ — و + مَدَّ + تْ — wa-, and + madda, to stretch out (perfect) + -at, she; 'and stretched out'
تِكَّةِ: تِكَّةِ — تِكَّة — tikka, cord, drawstring of drawers (f., gen. after ilā, in construct); 'the cord of'
لِبَاسِهَا: لِبَاسِهَا — لِبَاس + هَا — libās, garment, drawers (m., gen. in construct) + -hā, her; 'her drawers'
أَتَرَا: أَتَرَا — أَ + تَرَى — a-, interrogative particle (introduces a yes/no question) + tarā, you see (ra'ā yarā, to see; the final yā' is printed as alif); 'do you see?'
التِكَّةِ: التِكَّةِ — الـ + تِكَّة — al-, the + tikka, cord (gen. in construct; printed with shadda on kāf); 'the cord'
مَرْقُومًا: مَرْقُومًا — مَرْقُوم — marqūm, inscribed, written (passive part. of raqama; acc. ḥāl, masc. though tikka is fem.); 'inscribed'
أَنَالَكَ: أَنَالَكَ — أَنَا + لَكَ — anā, I (pronoun) + li-, for, belonging to (prep.) + -ka, you; 'I am yours' (printed as one word)
النَّبِيِّ: النَّبِيِّ — الـ + نَبِيّ — al-, the + nabiyy, prophet (gen.); 'the Prophet'
نَشَرَيَدَهُ: نَشَرَيَدَهُ — نَشَرَ + يَد + هُ — nashara, to spread out (perfect) + yad, hand (acc. object) + -hu, his; 'he spread out his hand' (printed as one word; reading uncertain)
خَبَرِكِ: خَبَرِكِ — خَبَر + كِ — khabar, news, account (m., gen. after ʿan) + -ki, your (f.); 'your news'
مَحْظِيَّةُ: مَحْظِيَّةُ — مَحْظِيَّة — maḥẓiyya, favourite (f., nom., in construct); 'favourite of'
وَاسْمِي: وَاسْمِي — و + اسْم + ي — wa-, and + ism, name (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my name'
قُوتُ: قُوتُ — قُوت — qūt, sustenance, food (nom. in construct); 'food of'
وَكَبِرْتُ: وَكَبِرْتُ — و + كَبِرَ + تُ — wa-, and + kabira, to grow up, grow old (perfect) + -tu, I; 'and I grew up'
صِفَاتِي: صِفَاتِي — صِفَات + ي — ṣifāt, qualities, attributes (pl. of ṣifa, gen. after ilā) + -ī, my; 'my qualities'
فَأَحَبَّنِي: فَأَحَبَّنِي — فَ + أَحَبَّ + نِي — fa-, so + aḥabba, to love (form IV perfect) + -nī, me; 'so he loved me'
زَائِدَةً: زَائِدَةً — زَائِدَة — zāʾida, excessive, increasing (f. act. part. of zāda, acc., adjective of maḥabba); 'excessive'
وَأَخَذَنِي: وَأَخَذَنِي — و + أَخَذَ + نِي — wa-, and + akhadha, to take + -nī, me; 'and took me'
وَأَسْكَنَنِي: وَأَسْكَنَنِي — و + أَسْكَنَ + نِي — wa-, and + askana, to lodge (form IV perfect) + -nī, me; 'and lodged me'
مَقْصُورَةٍ: مَقْصُورَةٍ — مَقْصُورَة — maqṣūra, enclosed apartment, closed room (f., gen. after fī); 'a private apartment' Also gen. after farshi: bi-farshi maqṣūratin, 'that a private apartment be furnished'.
يَخْدُمْنَنِي: يَخْدُمْنَنِي — ya-, they (imperf. prefix) + khadama yakhdumu, to serve + -na, they (fem. pl.) + -nī, me; 'serving me'
الْمَصَاغَ: الْمَصَاغَ — الـ + مَصَاغ — al-, the + maṣāgh, jewellery, ornaments (acc.); 'the jewellery'
الْجَوَارِى: الْجَوَارِى — الـ + جَوَارِى — al-, the + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya, gen.; printed with alif maqṣūra); 'the slave-girls'
خِدْمَتِي: خِدْمَتِي — خِدْمَة + ي — khidma, service (f., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my service'
سِتُّكِ: سِتُّكِ — سِتّ + كِ — sitt, lady (nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your lady'
فَحُطِّي: فَحُطِّي — فَ + حُطِّ + ي — fa-, then (apodosis) + ḥuṭṭ, put! (imper. of ḥaṭṭa, colloquial for 'to put') + -ī, you (f.); 'then put'
الْقِطْعَةَ: الْقِطْعَةَ — الـ + قِطْعَة — al-, the + qiṭʿa, piece (f., acc. object); 'the piece'
خِيرِهَا: خِيرِهَا — خِير + هَا — -khīr, second half of manākhīr (pl. of minkhar, nostril, gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her nostrils'
شَرَابِهَا: شَرَابِهَا — شَرَاب + هَا — sharāb, drink (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her drink'
يَكْفِيكِ: يَكْفِيكِ — ya-, it (imperf. prefix) + kafā yakfī, to suffice + -ki, you (f.); 'suffices you'
وَلِأَنَّهَا: وَلِأَنَّهَا — و + لِـ + أَنَّ + هَا — wa-, and + li-, because (prep. before anna) + anna, that + -hā, she; 'and because she'
شَرَابِي: شَرَابِي — شَرَاب + ي — sharāb, drink (gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my drink'
الْبَنْجُ: الْبَنْجُ — الـ + بَنْج — al-, the + banj, bhang (nom.); 'the bhang'
جَوْفِي: جَوْفِي — جَوْف + ي — jawf, inside, belly (m., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my inside'
دُنْيَا: دُنْيَا — dunyā, world (f.); also the princess's name, al-sayyida dunyā, 'the Lady Dunyā'
وَإِنَّهَا: وَإِنَّهَا — و + إِنَّ + هَا — wa-, and + inna, indeed + -hā, she; 'and indeed she'
حِيلَتُهَا: حِيلَتُهَا — حِيلَة + هَا — ḥīla, stratagem, trick (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her scheme'
حَطَّتْنِي: حَطَّتْنِي — حَطَّ + تْ + نِي — ḥaṭṭa, to put, set down (perfect; colloquial) + -at, she + -nī, me; 'she put me'
وَأَحْضَرَتِ: وَأَحْضَرَتِ — و + أَحْضَرَ + تِ — wa-, and + aḥḍara, to bring, summon (form IV perfect) + -at, she (kasra before al-); 'and brought'
وَبَرْطَلَتْهُمْ: وَبَرْطَلَتْهُمْ — و + بَرْطَلَ + تْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + barṭala, to bribe (quadriliteral verb; colloquial) + -at, she + -hum, them; 'and bribed them'
وَأَرْسَلَتْنِي: وَأَرْسَلَتْنِي — و + أَرْسَلَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and + arsala, to send (form IV perfect) + -at, she + -nī, me; 'and sent me'
مَارَأَيْتَ: مَارَأَيْتَ — مَا + رَأَيْتَ — mā, what (relative) + raʾā, to see, + -ta, you (m.); 'what you saw' (printed as one word)
وَأَحْسَنْتَ: وَأَحْسَنْتَ — و + أَحْسَنَ + تَ — wa-, and + aḥsana, to do well, treat kindly (form IV perfect; takes ilā) + -ta, you; 'and you did well'
غَيْبَتِي: غَيْبَتِي — غَيْبَة + ي — ghayba, absence (f., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my absence'
فَاعْرِفْ: فَاعْرِفْ — فَ + اعْرِفْ — fa-, so + iʿrif, know! (imper. of ʿarafa; alif wasl); 'so know'
تُشْهِرْ: تُشْهِرْ — tu-, you (imperf. prefix) + ashhara, to make public, divulge (form IV) in the jussive after lā; 'do (not) make public'
وَتَحَقَّقَ: وَتَحَقَّقَ — و + تَحَقَّقَ — wa-, and + taḥaqqaqa, to be certain, verify (form V perfect); 'and was certain'
تَأَخَّرَ: تَأَخَّرَ — taʾakhkhara, to draw back, withdraw (form V perfect); 'he drew back'
وَرَائِهِ: وَرَائِهِ — وَرَاء + هِ — warāʾ, behind (gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'behind him'
وَأَلْحَقَتْهُ: وَأَلْحَقَتْهُ — و + أَلْحَقَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + alḥaqa, to overtake, cause to reach (form IV) + -at, she/it + -hu, him; 'and overtook him'
هَيْبَةُ: هَيْبَةُ — هَيْبَة — hayba, awe, majesty (f., nom., in construct); 'the awe of'
نَوَاحِى: نَوَاحِى — نَوَاحِى — nawāḥī, sides, corners (pl. of nāḥiya, gen.; printed with alif maqṣūra); 'the corners'
يُعَاتِبُ: يُعَاتِبُ — yu-, he (imperf. prefix) + ʿātaba, to reproach (form III); 'he reproaches'
وَيَتَفَكَّرُ: وَيَتَفَكَّرُ — و + يَتَفَكَّرُ — wa-, and + ya-, he + tafakkara, to ponder (form V); 'and pondering'
أَمْرِةِ: أَمْر + ة — amr, affair (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his, the pronoun spelled with ة (امرة for امره), a habit of the print; fī amrihi, 'in his affair' (ḥāra fī amrihi, iḥtāra fī amrihi, 'he was at a loss what to do') Also after min: mā kāna min amrihi, 'what befell him'.
وَيُصَبِّرُ: وَيُصَبِّرُ — و + يُصَبِّرُ — wa-, and + yu-, he + ṣabbara, to make patient, console (form II); 'and steadying'
عِشْقِ: عِشْقِ — عِشْق — ʿishq, passionate love (gen. after fī, in construct); 'love of'
وَشَكَا: وَشَكَا — و + شَكَا — wa-, and + shakā, to complain (perfect; takes min 'complain of'); 'and complained'
تَحَامُلِ: تَحَامُلِ — تَحَامُل — taḥāmul, bearing down on, oppression (verbal noun of form VI, gen. after min); 'the oppression of'
وَمَالَهُ: وَمَالَهُ — و + مَا + لَهُ — wa-, and + mā, what + la-hu, to him (li-, belonging to + -hu, him); 'and what is his' (printed as one word)
الْعُدْوَانِ: الْعُدْوَانِ — الـ + عُدْوَان — al-, the + ʿudwān, hostility, aggression (gen. after min); 'of the aggression'
أَشْغَلَ: أَشْغَلَ — ashghala, to occupy, preoccupy (form IV perfect); 'occupied'
