بِالْمَحَبَّةِ: بِالْمَحَبَّةِ — بِـ + الـ + مَحَبَّة — bi-, with (prep.; ashghala bi-, 'occupy with') + al-, the + maḥabba, love (gen.); 'with love'
وَالْمَحْبُوبِ: وَالْمَحْبُوبِ — و + الـ + مَحْبُوب — wa-, and + al-, the + maḥbūb, beloved (passive part. of aḥabba, gen.); 'and the beloved'
الْاحْبَابِ: الْاحْبَابِ — الـ + أَحْبَاب — aḥbāb, beloved ones (broken pl. of حَبِيب, gen. after عَلَى); 'the beloved ones'
مَتْعُوبُ: مَتْعُوبُ — مَتْعُوب — matʿūb, wearied, worn out (colloquial pass. part. of تَعِبَ; m.); 'wearied'
وَعَقْلُهُ: وَعَقْلُهُ — و + عَقْل + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his mind'
بَدِيعِ: بَدِيعِ — بَدِيع — badīʿ, wondrous, marvellous (m., gen. after مَعَ, first term of iḍāfa 'wondrous of beauty'); the epithet of the beloved
مَنْهُوبُ: مَنْهُوبُ — مَنْهُوب — manhūb, plundered, despoiled (pass. part. of نَهَبَ, m.); 'plundered'
طَعْمُ: طَعْمُ — طَعْم — ṭaʿm, taste (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the taste of'
عَذْبٌ: عَذْبٌ — عَذْب — ʿadhb, sweet, pleasant (adj., m., nom. predicate); 'sweet'
تَعْذِيبُ: تَعْذِيبُ — تَعْذِيب — taʿdhīb, torment, torture (verbal noun of عَذَّبَ, m., nom.); 'torment'
وَاحْتَضَنَتْهُ: وَاحْتَضَنَتْهُ — و + احْتَضَنَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḥtaḍana, to embrace, clasp to one's bosom (Form VIII, 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she embraced him'
وَبَاحَتْ: وَبَاحَتْ — و + بَاحَتْ — wa-, and + bāḥa, to divulge, disclose (3 f. sg.; it governs its object with بِـ); 'and she divulged'
بِسِرِّهَا: بِسِرِّهَا — بِـ + سِرّ + ها — bi-, with, here marking the thing divulged after بَاحَ بِـ 'to lay bare (a secret)' + sirr, secret (m.) + -hā, her; 'her secret (she laid bare)'
بِيَدَيْهَا: بِيَدَيْهَا — بِـ + يَدَيْ + ها — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + yadayn, two hands (dual, gen., the nūn dropped in iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'with her two hands'
يَتَمَنَّعُ: يَتَمَنَّعُ — yatamannaʿu, to hold oneself back, refuse, be unapproachable (Form V, 3 m. sg. imperfect; followed by عَنْ); 'he holds himself aloof'
تَحَدَّثَا: تَحَدَّثَا — taḥaddatha, to converse, talk together (Form V, 3 m. dual perfect, -ā the dual ending); 'the two talked'
غَرِيقَانِ: غَرِيقَانِ — غَرِيقَان — gharīqān, drowned, sunk (غَرِيق, dual, nom. predicate); 'two drowned ones'
مَحَبَّتِهِمَا: مَحَبَّتِهِمَا — مَحَبَّة + هِمَا — maḥabba, love (f., gen. after بَحْرِ) + -himā, their (dual); 'their love'
كَعَادَتِهِ: كَعَادَتِهِ — كَـ + عَادَة + هِ — ka-, like, as (prep.) + ʿāda, custom, habit (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'as is his custom'
قُوتَ: قُوتَ — قُوت — qūt, sustenance, food (m., acc. as object of وَجَدَ; first term of the name قُوتُ الْقُلُوبِ)
بَطَّلَتِ: بَطَّلَتِ — baṭṭala, to put a stop to, suspend (Form II, 3 f. sg.; the final tāʾ takes kasra before the article's alif-lām); 'she stopped'
مَحْبُوبَ: مَحْبُوبَ — مَحْبُوب — maḥbūb, beloved (pass. part. of حَبَّ/أَحَبَّ, m.; here acc. as vocative in iḍāfa 'O beloved of'); 'beloved'
غِبْتَهَا: غِبْتَهَا — غِبْتَ + ها — ghāba, to be absent (2 m. sg. perfect, -ta, you) + -hā, it, i.e. the hour (acc. of time); 'you were absent (during) it'
كَسَنَةٍ: كَسَنَةٍ — كَـ + سَنَة — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison) + sana, year (f., gen.); 'like a year'
فِرَاقِكَ: فِرَاقِكَ — فِرَاق + كَ — firāq, parting, separation (m., gen. after أَجْلِ) + -ka, your (m.); 'your parting' Also gen. after ʿalā: lā yaqdiru ʿalā firāqika, 'he cannot bear parting from you' (the -ka is the one parted from).
بَيَّنْتُ: بَيَّنْتُ — bayyana, to make clear, explain (Form II, 1 sg. perfect, -tu, I); 'I have made plain'
وَلَعِي: وَلَعِي — وَلَع + ي — walaʿ, infatuation, passionate attachment (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my passion'
أَرَبَكَ: أَرَبَكَ — أَرَب + كَ — arab, desire, need, purpose (m., acc. object) + -ka, your; قَضَى أَرَبَهُ مِنْ 'to satisfy one's desire of'; 'your desire'
بِاللَّهِ،: بِاللَّهِ، — بِـ + اللَّه — bi-, in, with (prep.; عَاذَ بِـ 'seek refuge in/with') + Allāh, God (gen.); 'in God'. The printed comma is kept with the word.
السَّبُعِ: السَّبُعِ — الـ + سَبُع — sabuʿ, beast of prey, lion (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the lion'
لِلْمَوْلَى: لِلْمَوْلَى — لِـ + الـ + مَوْلَى — li-, for, belonging to (prep., expressing possession) + al-, the + mawlā, master, lord (m.); 'for the master, the master's'
الْحَصِيرَةِ: الْحَصِيرَةِ — الـ + حَصِيرَة — ḥaṣīra, mat (of reed, f., gen. after عَلَى); 'the mat'
وَزَادَتْ: وَزَادَتْ — و + زَادَتْ — wa-, and + zāda, to increase, grow (3 f. sg. perfect); 'and it increased'
مْتِنَاعِهِ: مْتِنَاعِهِ — امْتِنَاع + هِ — imtināʿ, refraining, holding back (verbal noun of Form VIII اِمْتَنَعَ, m., gen. after بِـ) + -hi, his; the printed word lacks its initial alif, which is joined to the preceding بِا; 'his holding back'
وَنَادَمَتْهُ: وَنَادَمَتْهُ — و + نَادَمَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + nādama, to be a drinking companion, carouse with (Form III, 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she caroused with him'
فَسَكِرَا: فَسَكِرَا — فَـ + سَكِرَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + sakira, to be drunk (3 m. dual perfect, -ā); 'and they two became drunk'
وَهَامَتْ: وَهَامَتْ — و + هَامَتْ — wa-, and + hāma, to rave, be distracted with love (3 f. sg. perfect; takes بِـ); 'and she was crazed'
بِالْافْتِضَاحِ: بِالْافْتِضَاحِ — بِـ + الـ + افْتِضَاح — bi-, with, by (prep.; هَامَ بِـ 'to rave about, be mad for') + al-, the + iftiḍāḥ, disgrace, exposure (verbal noun of Form VIII, m., gen.); 'with/for shame'; the sense is uncertain (see the note)
فَغَنَّتْ: فَغَنَّتْ — فَـ + غَنَّتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ghannat, to sing (Form II, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she sang'
الْمُتَيَّمِ: الْمُتَيَّمِ — الـ + مُتَيَّم — mutayyam, love-enthralled, love-sick (pass. part. of Form II تَيَّمَ, m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the love-enthralled'
كَادَانْ: كَادَانْ — كَادَ + أَنْ — kāda, to be on the point of (3 m. sg. perfect) + an, that (particle with subjunctive), printed as one word; 'nearly'
يَتَفَتَّتَا: يَتَفَتَّتَا — يَتَفَتَّتَ + ا — yatafattata, to crumble to bits (Form V, 3 m. sg. subjunctive after أَنْ) + the rhyme alif; 'to crumble'
فَاِلَى: فَاِلَى — فَـ + إِلَى — fa-, so, then (conj.) + ilā, to, until (prep.); فَإِلَى مَتَى 'so until when?'
جِنَايَةٍ: جِنَايَةٍ — جِنَايَة — jināya, offence, wrong (f., gen. in iḍāfa); 'offence'
فَعَوَائِدُ: فَعَوَائِدُ — فَـ + عَوَائِد — fa-, for, so (conj., explaining) + ʿawāʾid, habits, customs (pl. of عَادَة, nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'for the habits of'
تَتَلَفَّتَا: تَتَلَفَّتَا — تَتَلَفَّتَ + ا — tatalaffata, to glance back, turn round (Form V, 3 f. sg. subjunctive after أَنْ) + the rhyme alif; 'to glance back'
صَدٌّ: صَدٌّ — صَدّ — ṣadd, rebuff, repulse (verbal noun of صَدَّ, m., nom., predicate list); 'rebuff'
وَإِبْعَادٌ: وَإِبْعَادٌ — و + إِبْعَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + ibʿād, banishment, removal (verbal noun of Form IV, m., nom.); 'and banishment'
وَهَجْرٌ: وَهَجْرٌ — و + هَجْر — wa-, and + hajr, desertion, abandonment (m., nom.); 'and desertion'
دَائِمٌ: دَائِمٌ — دَائِم — dāʾim, constant, continual (adj., m., nom., in the print with precomposed ئ); 'constant'
الْامْرِ: الْامْرِ — الـ + أَمْر — amr, matter, affair (m., gen. in iḍāfa after كُلُّ هَذَا); 'the matter, thing'; the print has bare alif, read with hamza
يَحْمِلُهُ: يَحْمِلُهُ — يَحْمِلُ + هُ — yaḥmilu, to bear, carry (3 m. sg. imperfect) + -hu, it; 'bears it'
لِبُكٰئِهِ: لِبُكٰئِهِ — لِـ + بُكَٰء + هِ — li-, for, because of (prep. of cause) + bukāʾ, weeping (verbal noun, m., gen.; defective spelling of بُكَاء, the dagger alif supplies the long ā) + -hi, his; 'because of his weeping'
يَشْرَبَانِ: يَشْرَبَانِ — yashrabāni, to drink (3 m. dual imperfect); 'drinking'
فَرْشَيْنِ: فَرْشَيْنِ — فَرْشَيْن — farshayn, two beds, two sets of bedding (dual of فَرْش, acc. object); 'two beds'
فَرْشٍ: فَرْش — farsh, bedding, bed (m., gen. indef., after a preposition such as fī, or in iḍāfa after kull); 'bed'
الْفَرْشُ: الْفَرْشُ — الـ + فَرْش — farsh, bed, bedding (m., nom.); 'the bed'
لَانَنَامُ: لَانَنَامُ — لَا + نَنَامُ — lā, not (negative particle) + nanāmu, to sleep (1 pl. imperfect of نَامَ), printed as one word; 'we do not sleep'
النَّمَطِ: النَّمَطِ — الـ + نَمَط — namaṭ, way, manner, fashion (m., gen. in iḍāfa/apposition after عَلَى هَذَا); 'the fashion'
الْمَسِيدِ: الْمَسِيدِ — الـ + مَسِيد — as printed, al-masīd, a spelling slip for لِلسَّيِّدِ (li-al-sayyid, 'to the master', prep. li- + al- + sayyid, master, gen.); read 'belongs to the master'
وَقَدَرٍ: وَقَدَرٍ — و + قَدَر — wa-, and (conj.) + qadar, divine ordinance, destiny (m., gen.); 'and destiny'
فَانْطَلَقَتِ: فَانْطَلَقَتِ — فَـ + انْطَلَقَتِ — fa-, and so (conj.) + inṭalaqa, to be let loose, to break out (Form VII, 3 f. sg. perfect; the final tāʾ takes kasra before the article's alif-lām); 'and it broke loose'
غَرَامُهَا: غَرَامُهَا — غَرَام + ها — gharām, ardent passion (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her passion'
إِلَّاسَوَاءً: إِلَّاسَوَاءً — إِلَّا + سَوَاءً — illā, except (particle) + sawāʾ, equal, alike (m., acc. as adverb 'equally, together'), printed as one word; 'except together'
مَعَاذَاللَّهِ: مَعَاذَاللَّهِ — مَعَاذَ + اللَّهِ — maʿādh, refuge (m., acc. as verbal noun 'I seek refuge') + Allāh, God (gen. in iḍāfa), printed as one word; 'God's refuge, God forbid'
وَحْدَةً: وَحْدَةً — وَحْدَة — waḥda, aloneness (f., acc. as adverb); as printed ending in ة, for the usual وَحْدَهُ 'by himself'; 'alone'
الْعِشْقُ: الْعِشْقُ — الـ + عِشْق — ʿishq, passionate love (m., nom. subject); 'the passion'
وَالْغَرَامُ: وَالْغَرَامُ — و + الـ + غَرَام — wa-, and + al-, the + gharām, ardent love, ardour (m., nom.); 'and the ardour'
وَالْهَيَامُ: وَالْهَيَامُ — و + الـ + هِيَام — wa-, and + al-, the + hiyām, frenzied love, distraction (m., nom.); 'and the frenzy'
وَأَقَامَا: وَأَقَامَا — و + أَقَامَا — wa-, and + aqāma, to stay, remain (Form IV, 3 m. dual perfect, -ā); 'and the two stayed'
طِوَالٍ: طِوَالٍ — طِوَال — ṭiwāl, long (broken pl. of طَوِيل, gen., describing أَشْهُرٍ); 'long'
تَقَرَّبَتْ: تَقَرَّبَتْ — taqarraba, to draw near (Form V, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'she drew near'
كُلُّمَا: كُلُّمَا — كُلُّ + مَا — printed as one word for كُلُّ مَا (kullu mā, 'all that, whatever', subject of فَهُوَ); 'whatever'
لِلسَّيِّدِ: لِلسَّيِّدِ — لِـ + السَّيِّد — li-, to, belonging to (prep. li- of possession) + al-, the + sayyid, master (m., gen.); 'the master's'
الْمِطَالُ: الْمِطَالُ — الـ + مِطَال — miṭāl, procrastination, putting off (m., nom.); 'the delay'
الْمَسْلُوبِ: الْمَسْلُوبِ — الـ + مَسْلُوب — maslūb, despoiled, bereft (pass. part. of سَلَبَ, m., gen., adj.); 'the despoiled'
الشُّجُونُ: الشُّجُونُ — الـ + شُجُون — shujūn, cares, griefs (pl. of شَجْن, nom.); 'the cares'
وَالْكُرُوبُ: وَالْكُرُوبُ — و + الـ + كُرُوب — wa-, and + al-, the + kurūb, distresses (pl. of كَرْب, nom.); 'and the distresses'
فُؤَادٍ: فُؤَادٍ — فُؤَاد — fuʾād, heart (m., gen. after مِنْ); مِنْ فُؤَادٍ 'from a heart'; 'heart'
مَتْعُوبٍ: مَتْعُوبٍ — مَتْعُوب — matʿūb, wearied, worn out (colloquial pass. part. of تَعِبَ; m.); 'wearied'
بَدِيعَ: بَدِيعَ — بَدِيع — badīʿ, wondrous, marvellous (m., acc. as vocative construct 'O wondrous of beauty')
التَّجَنِّي: التَّجَنِّي — الـ + تَجَنِّي — tajannī, fault-finding, imputing an offence (verbal noun of Form V تَجَنَّى, m., nom., defective); 'the fault-finding'
اَغْرَاكَ: اَغْرَاكَ — أَغْرَى + كَ — aghrā, to incite, urge on (Form IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -ka, you; 'incited you'
بِالْاِعْرَاضِ: بِالْاِعْرَاضِ — بِـ + الـ + إِعْرَاض — bi-, to, towards (prep.; أَغْرَى بِـ 'to incite to') + al-, the + iʿrāḍ, turning away (verbal noun of Form IV, gen.); 'to the turning away'
الرَّشَاقَةِ: الرَّشَاقَةِ — الـ + رَشَاقَة — rashāqa, grace, elegance (f., gen. after مِنْ); 'the grace'
وَحُزْتَ: وَحُزْتَ — و + حُزْتَ — wa-, and + ḥāza, to acquire, win (2 m. sg. perfect, -ta, you); 'and you have won'
وَاَجْرَيْتَ: وَاَجْرَيْتَ — و + أَجْرَيْتَ — wa-, and + ajrā, to set running, make flow (Form IV, 2 m. sg. perfect, -ta, you); 'and you set running'
الْغَرَامَ: الْغَرَامَ — الـ + غَرَام — gharām, ardent passion (m., acc. object); 'the passion'
وَوَكَّلْتَ: وَوَكَّلْتَ — و + وَكَّلْتَ — wa-, and + wakkala, to appoint, put in charge (Form II, 2 m. sg. perfect, -ta, you); 'and you appointed'
جَفْنِ: جَفْنِ — جَفْن — jafn, eyelid, eye (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'eyelid'
وَاَعْرِفُ: وَاَعْرِفُ — و + أَعْرِفُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿrifu, to know (1 sg. imperfect of عَرَفَ); 'and I know'
الْاَغْصَانُ: الْاَغْصَانُ — الـ + أَغْصَان — aghṣān, branches (pl. of غُصْن, nom.); 'the branches'
تُجْنَى: تُجْنَى — tujnā, to be plucked, picked (passive of جَنَى, 3 f. sg. imperfect); 'are plucked'
غُصْنَ: غُصْنَ — غُصْن — ghuṣn, branch, bough (m., acc. vocative in iḍāfa); 'branch'; also: acc. of state (ḥāl) after mālat, a noun standing for a likeness: mālat ghuṣna bānin, 'she swayed as a bough of bān'
الْاَرَاكِ: الْاَرَاكِ — الـ + أَرَاك — arāk, the toothbrush tree, Salvadora persica (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of the arāk'
اَرَاكَ: اَرَاكَ — أَرَى + كَ — arā, to see (1 sg. imperfect) + -ka, you; 'I see you'
تَجْنِي: تَجْنِي — tajnī, to pluck (fruit), also to commit an offence (3/2 sg. imperfect of جَنَى); 'you pluck, you offend'
وَعَهْدِي: وَعَهْدِي — و + عَهْد + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿahd, acquaintance, what one knows (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my knowledge'
بِالظِّبَا: بِالظِّبَا — بِـ + الـ + ظِبَا — bi-, with, concerning (prep.; عَهْدِي بِـ 'my knowledge of') + al-, the + ẓibā, gazelles (pl. of ظَبْيَة, gen., the final -ya reduced); 'of the gazelles'
صَيْدًا: صَيْدًا — صَيْد — ṣayd, game, quarry (m., acc. as predicate/state); 'as quarry'
فَمَالِي: فَمَالِي — فَـ + مَا + لِي — fa-, so (conj.) + mā, what? (interrogative) + li-, for, to (prep.) + -ī, me; 'so what is it with me?'
تَصِيدُ: تَصِيدُ — taṣīdu, to hunt (2 m. sg. imperfect of صَادَ); 'you hunt'
اَرْبَابَ: اَرْبَابَ — أَرْبَاب — arbāb, masters, lords (pl. of رَبّ, acc. object, first term of iḍāfa); 'masters of'
الْمِجَنِّ: الْمِجَنِّ — الـ + مِجَنّ — mijann, shield (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the shield'
وَاَعْجَبُ: وَاَعْجَبُ — و + أَعْجَبُ — wa-, and + aʿjab, most wondrous (elative of عَجِيب, m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'and the most wondrous'
اُحَدِّثُ: اُحَدِّثُ — أُحَدِّثُ — uḥaddithu, to relate, tell (Form II, 1 sg. imperfect); 'I relate'
فُتِنْتُ: فُتِنْتُ — futina, to be bewitched, driven distracted by love (passive of فَتَنَ, 1 sg. perfect, -tu, I); 'I am bewitched'
تَعْلَمْ: تَعْلَمْ — taʿlam, to know (2 m. sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'you know'
بِاَنِّي: بِاَنِّي — بِـ + أَنَّ + ي — bi-, (with) that, introducing the object clause after عَلِمَ (prep.) + anna, that (particle) + -ī, me; 'that I'
تَسْمَحْ: تَسْمَحْ — tasmaḥ, to grant, be generous (2 m. sg. jussive after لَا; with بِـ 'to grant X'); 'grant'
بِوَصْلِكَ: بِوَصْلِكَ — بِـ + وَصْل + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; سَمَحَ بِـ 'grant, give up something') + waṣl, union, meeting (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your union'
فَاِنِّي: فَاِنِّي — فَـ + إِنَّ + ي — fa-, for, because (conj. giving the reason) + inna, indeed (particle) + -ī, me; 'for I'
اَغَارُ: اَغَارُ — أَغَارُ — aghāru, to be jealous (1 sg. imperfect of غَارَ; takes عَلَى 'for, over' and مِنْ 'of'); 'I am jealous'
دُمْتُ: دُمْتُ — dāma, to remain, continue (1 sg. perfect, -tu, I); مَا دُمْتُ 'as long as I remain'
حَيًّا: حَيًّا — حَيّ — ḥayy, alive, living (adj., m., acc. as state); 'alive'
التِّبْنَ: التِّبْنَ — الـ (the) + تِبْن (tibn, chopped straw, chaff), accusative object of يَنْشُرُوا; 'the chaff'
الدَّهَا: الدَّهَا — الـ + دَهَا, first half of the split plural دَهَالِيز (dahālīz, pl. of دِهْلِيز dihlīz, corridor); read with لِيزِ; 'the corridors'
النَّجَّارَ: النَّجَّارَ — الـ + نَجَّار (najjār, carpenter), accusative object of أَمَرَتْ; 'the carpenter'
الْأَسْوَدَ: الْأَسْوَدَ — الـ + أَسْوَد (aswad, black), accusative object of يَلْبَسُوا, standing for black clothes; 'the black'
الْأَكْفَانِ: الْأَكْفَانِ — الـ + أَكْفَان (akfān, pl. of كَفَن kafan, shroud); genitive after إِزَالَةَ; 'the shrouds'
الْبُسُطَ: الْبُسُطَ — الـ + بُسُط (busuṭ, pl. of بِسَاط bisāṭ, carpet), accusative; 'the carpets'
الْخُتُومَاتِ: الْخُتُومَاتِ — الـ + خُتُومَات (khutūmāt, pl. of خَتْمَة khatma, a complete recitation of the Qurʾān); accusative/genitive; 'the Qurʾān-recitations'
الْفَرْطُ: الْفَرْطُ — الـ + فَرْط (farṭ, what slips past, lapse, loss; see فَرَطَ), nominative subject; 'the lapse'
الْفُقَهَاءِ: الْفُقَهَاءِ — الـ + فُقَهَاء (fuqahāʾ, pl. of فَقِيه faqīh, jurist), genitive after بِإِحْضَارِ; 'the jurists'
الْقَصْرَانِ: الْقَصْرَانِ — الـ + قَصْرَان (qaṣrān, dual of قَصْر palace), printed with nominative dual ending after فِى where Classical has -ayn; 'the two palaces'
الْكَفَنَ: الْكَفَنَ — الـ + كَفَن (kafan, shroud), accusative object of رَآى; 'the shroud'
الْمُبَ—احِ: الْمُبَ—احِ — الـ + مُبَاح (mubāḥ, permitted, passive participle of أَبَاحَ), genitive adjective after الْكَلَامِ; the dash is a print artefact; 'the permitted'
الْمُفْتَخِرَةِ: الْمُفْتَخِرَةِ — الـ + مُفْتَخِرَة (muftakhira, f. active participle of اِفْتَخَرَ, to boast; here 'splendid'), genitive adjective of الْأَكْفَانِ; 'the splendid'
الْهُيَامُ: الْهُيَامُ — الـ + هُيَام (huyām, frenzy of love, passionate madness), nominative subject of غَلَبَ; 'the frenzy'; here: subject of akhadha
الْوَرْطَةِ: الْوَرْطَةِ — الـ + وَرْطَة (warṭa, predicament, quagmire), genitive after مِنْ; 'the predicament'
أَجْرَكَ: أَجْرَكَ — ajr (reward, recompense) + كَ (-ka, your, m.sg.), accusative object of عَظَّمَ; 'your reward'
أَرْسِلِي: أَرْسِلِي — imperative f.sg. of أَرْسَلَ (IV), to send; the ي is the f. ending; 'send!'
أَعْطَتْهَا: أَعْطَتْهَا — aʿṭat, 3rd f.sg. perfect of أَعْطَى (IV), to give + هَا (-hā, her, indirect object); 'she gave her'; here: -hā is the thing given, 'she gave it' (the letter), with li- for the receiver (aʿṭathā lī)
إِزَالَةَ: إِزَالَةَ — izāla, removal (verbal noun of أَزَالَ IV, to remove), accusative object of أَرَادَ; 'removal'
بِالْأَكْفَانِ: بِالْأَكْفَانِ — بِـ + الـ + أَكْفَان (akfān, shrouds); bi- 'in, with' (the instrument/covering); 'in the shrouds'
بِإِخْرَاجِهَا: بِإِخْرَاجِهَا — بِـ + إِخْرَاج (ikhrāj, taking out; verbal noun of أَخْرَجَ IV) + هَا (-hā, her); bi- is required by أَمَرَ بِـ 'order'; 'the taking-out of her'
بِثِيَابِ: بِثِيَابِ — بِـ + ثِيَاب (thiyāb, pl. of ثَوْب, garment, clothes); bi- 'in, clad in'; 'in the clothes of'
بِحَفْرِ: بِحَفْرِ — بِـ + حَفْر (ḥafr, digging; verbal noun of حَفَرَ); bi- required by أَمَرَ بِـ 'order'; 'the digging of'
بِقُوتِ: بِقُوتِ — بِـ + قُوت (qūt, nourishment, sustenance; first part of the name قُوتُ الْقُلُوبِ); bi- 'to, toward' after فَعَلَ (faʿala bi-, 'do (something) to'); 'to Qūt'
بِمَوْتِ: بِمَوْتِ — بِـ + مَوْت (mawt, death); bi- required by أَخْبَرَ بِـ 'inform of'; 'of the death of'
تَفْزَعِي: تَفْزَعِي — 2nd f.sg. imperfect of فَزِعَ (faziʿa), to be alarmed, with the nūn dropped after لَا (jussive/negative command); 'do not be alarmed'
تَمْنَعُهُ: تَمْنَعُهُ — 3rd f.sg. imperfect of مَنَعَ (manaʿa), to prevent + هُ (-hu, him); 'she prevents him'
جَوَارِيكِ: جَوَارِيكِ — jawārī (pl. of جَارِيَة jāriya, slave girl) + كِ (-ki, your, f.sg.), accusative object of the imperative; 'your slave girls'
دَفَنَتْهَا: دَفَنَتْهَا — dafanat, 3rd f.sg. perfect of دَفَنَ (dafana), to bury + هَا (-hā, her); 'she buried her'
دَفَنْتُهَا: دَفَنْتُهَا — dafantu, 1st sg. perfect of دَفَنَ, to bury + هَا (-hā, her/it); 'I buried her'
رَآى: رَآى — raʾā, 3rd m.sg. perfect of رَأَى, to see (printed with آى); 'he saw'
رُؤْيَةُ: رُؤْيَةُ — ruʾya, seeing, sight (verbal noun of رَأَى), nominative subject; 'the seeing of'
رُدُّوهَا: رُدُّوهَا — imperative m.pl. of رَدَّ (radda), to return, put back + هَا (-hā, her); 'put her back!'
سَعَتْ: سَعَتْ — saʿat, 3rd f.sg. perfect of سَعَى (saʿā), to strive, exert oneself (فِى 'for, toward'); 'she strove'
سَيِّدَتِنَا: سَيِّدَتِنَا — sayyida (mistress, lady, f. of سَيِّد) + نَا (-nā, our), genitive after عِنْدَ; 'our mistress'
سِرِّهَا: سِرِّهَا — sirr, secret + هَا (-hā, her), genitive after عَلَى; 'her secret'
شَاءَاللَّهُ: شَاءَاللَّهُ — shāʾa (3rd m.sg. perfect of شَاءَ, to will) + اللَّهُ (Allāh, God), printed as one word; in the formula إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ 'if God wills'
شَكَرَهَا: شَكَرَهَا — shakara, 3rd m.sg. perfect of شَكَرَ (shakara), to thank + هَا (-hā, her); 'he thanked her'
صُورَةً: صُورَةً — ṣūra, figure, likeness, accusative with tanwīn (object of يَعْمَلَ); 'a figure'
عَوْرَتِهَا: عَوْرَتِهَا — ʿawra, nakedness, parts that must be covered + هَا (-hā, her), genitive; 'her nakedness'
غَانِمًا: غَانِمًا — ghānim, Ghānim (proper name), accusative object of يَمْنَعُ; 'Ghānim'
غَيْبَتِهِ: غَيْبَتِهِ — ghayba, absence + هِ (-hi, his), genitive after مِنْ; 'his absence'
غِيرَتِهَا: غِيرَتِهَا — ghīra, jealousy + هَا (-hā, her), genitive after مِنْ; 'her jealousy'
فَامْنَعِيهِ: فَامْنَعِيهِ — فَـ (fa-, then, so) + imperative f.sg. of مَنَعَ (manaʿa), to prevent + هِ (-hi, him); the alif is hamzat al-waṣl; 'then prevent him'
فَأَخْبَرُوهُ: فَأَخْبَرُوهُ — فَـ (fa-, and so) + أَخْبَرُوا (3rd m.pl. perfect of أَخْبَرَ IV, to inform) + هُ (-hu, him); 'and they informed him'
فَخَلَعَتْ: فَخَلَعَتْ — فَـ (fa-, and) + خَلَعَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of خَلَعَ, to take off; خَلَعَ عَلَيْهِ خِلْعَةً 'bestow a robe of honour on'); 'and she bestowed'
فَدَعَتْ: فَدَعَتْ — فَـ (fa-, so) + دَعَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of دَعَا, to call; دَعَا بِـ 'call for, send for'); 'so she called'
فَرَجَفَ: فَرَجَفَ — فَـ (fa-, and) + رَجَفَ (3rd m.sg. perfect of رَجَفَ, to quake, tremble); 'and it quaked'
فَرَطَ: فَرَطَ — faraṭa, 3rd m.sg. perfect of فَرَطَ (faraṭa), to go before, slip past, be lost (see الْفَرْطُ); obscure here; 'has slipped away'
فَكَفَّنَتْهَا: فَكَفَّنَتْهَا — فَـ (fa-, and) + كَفَّنَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of كَفَّنَ II, to shroud) + هَا (-hā, it/her); 'and she shrouded her'
فَهِمَتِ: فَهِمَتِ — fahimat, 3rd f.sg. perfect of فَهِمَ (fahima), to understand; the final kasra is before the article الـ; 'she understood'
فَيَأْمُرُ: فَيَأْمُرُ — فَـ (fa-, then) + يَأْمُرُ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of أَمَرَ, to order; takes بِـ for the thing ordered); 'then he orders'
فَيَرَاهَا: فَيَرَاهَا — فَـ (fa-, and) + يَرَى (3rd m.sg. imperfect of رَأَى, to see) + هَا (-hā, her/it); 'and he sees it'
فَيُصَدِّقُ: فَيُصَدِّقُ — فَـ (fa-, then) + يُصَدِّقُ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of صَدَّقَ II, to believe, hold true); 'then he believes'
فَيُعِيدُهَا: فَيُعِيدُهَا — فَـ (fa-, and) + يُعِيدُ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of أَعَادَ IV, to return, put back) + هَا (-hā, her); 'and he puts her back'
فُؤَادُ: فُؤَادُ — fuʾād, heart, nominative subject in construct; 'the heart of'
فِعْلِكِ: فِعْلِكِ — fiʿl, deed + كِ (-ki, your, f.sg.), genitive after عَلَى; 'your deed'
قَصْرِهَا: قَصْرِهَا — qaṣr, palace + هَا (-hā, her), genitive after فِي; 'her palace'
قِدَ: قِدَ — second half of the split word نُوقِدَ (nūqida, 'we light'): from أَوْقَدَ (IV, to kindle); read with وَنُو; 'light'
كَبَنِي: كَبَنِي — كَـ (ka-, like, as) + بَنِي (banī, sons of; construct form of بَنُون, pl. of ابْن); ka- 'like': 'like the sons of'
لَابِسَةً: لَابِسَةً — lābisa, wearing (f. active participle of لَبِسَ, to wear), accusative ḥāl; 'wearing'
لِلسَّوَادِ: لِلسَّوَادِ — لِـ (li-, here a pleonastic lām introducing the object of لَابِسَة) + الـ + سَوَاد (sawād, black clothing); 'the black'
لِيزِ: لِيزِ — second half of the split plural الدَّهَالِيز: dahā + līz (see الدَّهَا); genitive after فِى; 'corridors'
لِيَرَاهَا: لِيَرَاهَا — لِـ (li-, in order to, purpose) + يَرَى (subjunctive of رَأَى, to see) + هَا (-hā, her); 'in order to see her'
لِيَزُورَهَا: لِيَزُورَهَا — لِـ (li-, in order to, purpose) + يَزُورَ (subjunctive of زَارَ, to visit) + هَا (-hā, her); 'in order to visit her'
لِيَنْظُرَهَا: لِيَنْظُرَهَا — لِـ (li-, in order to, purpose) + يَنْظُرَ (subjunctive of نَظَرَ, to look at) + هَا (-hā, her); 'in order to look at her'
مَجِيءَ: مَجِيءَ — majīʾ, coming, arrival (verbal noun of جَاءَ); accusative after أَنَّ, in construct; 'the coming of'
مَعَزَّتِهَا: مَعَزَّتِهَا — maʿazza, dearness, fondness + هَا (-hā, her), genitive after مِنْ; 'her dearness'
مَيِّتٍ: مَيِّتٍ — mayyit, dead (person), genitive with tanwīn; 'of a dead one'
مُصَدِّقٍ: مُصَدِّقٍ — muṣaddiq, believing (active participle of صَدَّقَ II), genitive with tanwīn after بَيْنَ; 'a believer'
مُكَفَّنَةٌ: مُكَفَّنَةٌ — mukaffana, shrouded (f. passive participle of كَفَّنَ II), nominative predicate/ḥāl; 'shrouded'
هَلَاكِ: هَلَاكِ — halāk, destruction, perishing, genitive in construct after فِي; 'destruction of'; here gen. after ʿalā: istaʿjala ʿalā halāki nafsihi, 'to hurry to one's own ruin'
وَأْمُرِيهِ: وَأْمُرِيهِ — و (wa-, and) + imperative f.sg. of أَمَرَ (to order) + هِ (-hi, him); 'and order him'
وَالشُّمُوعَ: وَالشُّمُوعَ — و (wa-, and) + الـ + شُمُوع (candles), accusative; 'and the candles'
وَالْأُخْرَى: وَالْأُخْرَى — و (wa-, and) + الـ + أُخْرَى (ukhrā, other, f. of آخَر); 'and the other (woman)'
وَالْخَوْفُ: وَالْخَوْفُ — و (wa-, and, circumstantial 'while') + الـ + خَوْف (khawf, fear), nominative; 'and the fear'
وَالْخُدَّامَ: وَالْخُدَّامَ — و (wa-, and) + الـ + خُدَّام (khuddām, pl. of خَادِم khādim, servant), accusative; 'and the servants'
وَالْمُقْرِئِينَ: وَالْمُقْرِئِينَ — و (wa-, and) + الـ + مُقْرِئِين (muqriʾīn, pl. of مُقْرِئ muqriʾ, Qurʾān reciter), genitive; 'and the reciters'
وَأَخْرَجَهَا: وَأَخْرَجَهَا — و (wa-, and) + أَخْرَجَ (3rd m.sg. perfect of أَخْرَجَ IV, to take out) + هَا (-hā, her); 'and he took her out'
وَأَطْلَعَتْهَا: وَأَطْلَعَتْهَا — و (wa-, and) + أَطْلَعَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of أَطْلَعَ IV, to inform, let know; أَطْلَعَهُ عَلَى 'let him in on') + هَا (-hā, her); 'and let her in on'
وَأَمَرَتِ: وَأَمَرَتِ — و (wa-, and) + أَمَرَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of أَمَرَ, to order; takes a direct object of the person and أَنْ + subjunctive); the final kasra is before the article; 'and she ordered'
وَأَمَرَتْهَا: وَأَمَرَتْهَا — و (wa-, and) + أَمَرَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of أَمَرَ, to order) + هَا (-hā, her); 'and she ordered her'
وَأَوْقَدَتِ: وَأَوْقَدَتِ — و (wa-, and) + أَوْقَدَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of أَوْقَدَ IV, to kindle, light); the final kasra is before the article; 'and she lit'
وَأْمُرِي: وَأْمُرِي — و (wa-, and) + imperative f.sg. of أَمَرَ (to order); 'and order'
وَتَأْمُرِي: وَتَأْمُرِي — و (wa-, and) + تَأْمُرِي (2nd f.sg. imperfect subjunctive of أَمَرَ, to order; the final nūn is dropped); 'and (that) you order'
وَتَخْلُصِينَ: وَتَخْلُصِينَ — و (wa-, and) + تَخْلُصِينَ (2nd f.sg. imperfect of خَلَصَ, to get free, escape); 'and you will escape'
وَتَعْمَلِي: وَتَعْمَلِي — و (wa-, and) + تَعْمَلِي (2nd f.sg. imperfect subjunctive of عَمِلَ, to make, do; the final nūn is dropped); 'and (that) you make'
وَدَفَنَتْهَا: وَدَفَنَتْهَا — و (wa-, and) + دَفَنَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of دَفَنَ, to bury) + هَا (-hā, her/it); 'and she buried it'
وَسَأَلَ: وَسَأَلَ — و (wa-, and) + سَأَلَ (3rd m.sg. perfect of سَأَلَ, to ask); 'and asks'
وَعَظَّمَ: وَعَظَّمَ — و (wa-, and, here the optative 'may') + عَظَّمَ (3rd m.sg. perfect of عَظَّمَ II, to make great); the perfect expresses a wish; 'and may (He) magnify'
وَفَرَشَتِ: وَفَرَشَتِ — و (wa-, and) + فَرَشَتْ (3rd f.sg. perfect of فَرَشَ, to spread out); the final kasra is before the article; 'and she spread'
وَقُوتُ: وَقُوتُ — و (wa-, and, circumstantial 'when, while') + قُوت (qūt, first part of the name قُوتُ الْقُلُوبِ); 'while Qūt'
وَمُكَذِّبٍ: وَمُكَذِّبٍ — و (wa-, and) + مُكَذِّب (mukadhdhib, disbelieving, active participle of كَذَّبَ II) with tanwīn, genitive; 'and a disbeliever'
وَنَحْفِرَلَهَا: وَنَحْفِرَلَهَا — و (wa-, and) + نَحْفِرَ (1st pl. imperfect subjunctive of حَفَرَ, to dig) + لَـ (la-, for = لِـ, 'for') + هَا (-hā, her/it); printed as one word; 'and we dig for it'
وَنَدْفِنَهَا: وَنَدْفِنَهَا — و (wa-, and) + نَدْفِنَ (1st pl. imperfect subjunctive of دَفَنَ, to bury) + هَا (-hā, her/it); 'and we bury it'
وَنُو: وَنُو — و (wa-, and) + نُو, first half of the split word نُوقِدَ (see قِدَ), 1st pl. of أَوْقَدَ 'we light'; 'and we (light)'
وَيَسْهَرُ: وَيَسْهَرُ — و (wa-, and) + يَسْهَرُ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of سَهِرَ, to stay awake, keep vigil); 'and he keeps vigil'
وَيَشْكُرُكِ: وَيَشْكُرُكِ — و (wa-, and) + يَشْكُرُ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of شَكَرَ, to thank) + كِ (-ki, you, f.sg.); 'and he thanks you'
وَيَطْلُعُونَ: وَيَطْلُعُونَ — و (wa-, and) + يَطْلُعُونَ (3rd m.pl. imperfect of طَلَعَ, to go up; طَلَعَ عَلَى 'come upon, find'); 'and they come upon'
وَيَعِزُّ: وَيَعِزُّ — و (wa-, and) + يَعِزُّ (3rd m.sg. imperfect of عَزَّ ʿazza, to be dear, hard (on)); يَعِزُّ عَلَيْهِ 'it grieves him'; 'and it grieves'
يَحْفِرُونَ: يَحْفِرُونَ — 3rd m.pl. imperfect of حَفَرَ (ḥafara), to dig; after لَمَّا, 'when they dig'
يَلْبَسُوا: يَلْبَسُوا — 3rd m.pl. imperfect subjunctive of لَبِسَ (labisa), to wear, put on (final nūn dropped); 'they wear'
يَلْبَسْنَ: يَلْبَسْنَ — 3rd f.pl. imperfect subjunctive of لَبِسَ, to wear, put on, after أَنْ; 'they (f.) wear'
يَمْنَعُ: يَمْنَعُ — 3rd m.sg. imperfect of مَنَعَ (manaʿa), to prevent, hold back (from: عَنْ); 'he prevents, preventing'
يَنْشُرُوا: يَنْشُرُوا — 3rd m.pl. imperfect subjunctive of نَشَرَ (nashara), to spread, scatter, after أَنْ; 'they scatter'
يُزِيلَهُ: يُزِيلَهُ — 3rd m.sg. imperfect subjunctive of أَزَالَ (IV), to remove, after أَنْ + هُ (-hu, it); 'he remove it'
الْحَرِيمَ: الـ + حَرِيم — ḥarīm, harem, women's quarters (m., acc.); 'the harem'
انْصِرَافِ: انْصِرَافِ — inṣirāf, departure, going away (verbal noun of VII inṣarafa; m., gen. in iḍāfa after baʿda)
بُيُوتِهِمْ: بُيُوت + هِمْ — buyūt, houses (broken pl. of bayt, gen. after ilā) + ـhim, their (3mp); 'their houses'
تُرَوِّحُهُ: تُرَوِّحُ + هُ — rawwaḥa, to fan (verb II, imperf. 3fs; the shadda is printed in the edition) + ـhu, him (3ms obj.); 'fanning him'
بِالْمِرْوَحَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مِرْوَحَة — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + mirwaḥah, fan (f., gen.); 'with the fan'
تَكْبِسُهُ: تَكْبِسُ + هُ — kabasa, to press, to knead, to massage (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + ـhu, him (3ms obj.); 'massaging him'
وَانْتَبَهَ: وَ + انْتَبَهَ — wa-, and + intabaha, to wake up (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and he woke'
وَغَمَّضَهُمَا: وَ + غَمَّضَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + ghammaḍa, to shut the eyes, to close (verb II, perf. 3ms) + ـhumā, them two (3 dual obj.); 'and he shut them'
يَاخَيْزُرَانُ: يَا + خَيْزُرَانُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Khayzurān, woman's name, 'rattan, bamboo' (nom. on damma, vocative); printed as one word
يَسْهَرُ: يَسْهَرُ — sahira, to stay awake, to keep vigil (verb I, imperf. 3ms)
إِلَّاخَشَبَةٌ: إِلَّا + خَشَبَةٌ — illā, except (particle) + khashabah, plank, piece of wood (f., nom. tanwīn); printed as one word, 'except a plank'
مُنَجَّرَةٌ: مُنَجَّرَةٌ — munajjarah, planed, hewn, worked (pass. part. of II najjara; f., nom. tanwīn, adj. of khashabah); 'planed'
النَّجَّارِ: الـ + نَجَّار — najjār, carpenter (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the carpenter'
أَىُّ: أَىُّ — ayy, which, what (interrogative, nom.; the edition prints the final yāʾ dotless); 'what'
أَصَابَهَا: أَصَابَ + هَا — aṣāba, to befall, to strike (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + ـhā, her (3fs obj.); 'befell her'
السِّتَّ: الـ + سِتّ — sitt, lady, mistress (f., acc., subject of anna; short for sayyidah); 'the lady'; also: acc. object of raʾā, the title set before the name: al-sitta Budūra, 'the Lady Budūr'
أَرْسَلَتْ: أَرْسَلَتْ — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'she sent'; also: f. sg. agreeing with jamīʿu mulūki, 'all the kings' (a verb before a broken plural): arsalat jamīʿu mulūki, 'all the kings sent' (Night 179)
قُرْصَ: قُرْصَ — qurṣ, disc, round cake, pill (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa, object of arsalat); 'a disc of'
وَبَنَّجَتْهَا: وَ + بَنَّجَ + تْ + هَا — wa-, and + bannaja, to drug (verb II, perf.) + ـat, she (3fs) + ـhā, her (3fs obj.); 'and she drugged her'
جَعَلَتْهَا: جَعَلَتْ + هَا — jaʿala, to put, to place (verb I, perf. 3fs) + ـhā, her (3fs obj.); 'she put her'
وَأَرْسَلَتْهَا: وَ + أَرْسَلَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + ـhā, her (3fs obj.); 'and she sent her'
وَكَافُورٍ: وَ + كَافُورٍ — wa-, and + Kāfūr, a man's name, 'camphor' (gen. tanwīn after maʿa); 'and Kāfūr'
وَأَمَرَتْهُمَا: وَ + أَمَرَ + تْ + هُمَا — wa-, and + amara, to command (verb I, perf.) + ـat, she (3fs) + ـhumā, them two (3 dual obj.); 'and she commanded them'
يَرْمِيَاهَا: يَرْمِيَا + هَا — ramā, to throw, to cast (verb I, subjunctive 3 dual; the nūn dropped after an) + ـhā, her (3fs obj.); 'that the two cast her'
خَيْزُرَانُ: خَيْزُرَانُ — Khayzurān, woman's name, 'rattan' (nom. subject of qālat)
هَلِ: هَلِ — hal, interrogative particle (the kasra is a helping vowel before al-); 'is it that'
سَلَامَةُ: سَلَامَةُ — salāmah, safety, soundness (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'safety of'
شَبَابِهَا: شَبَاب + هَا — shabāb, youth (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + ـhā, her (3fs); 'her youth'
الدِّمَشْقِيُّ: الـ + دِمَشْقِيّ — Dimashqī, of Damascus (nisba adj. from Dimashq; nom., apposition to Ghānim); 'the Damascene'
شُهُورٍ: شُهُورٍ — shuhūr, months (broken pl. of shahr; gen. tanwīn after a number); 'months'
وَسَيِّدُنَا: وَ + سَيِّد + نَا — wa-, and (here 'while') + sayyid, lord, master (m., nom.) + ـnā, our (1p); 'and our lord'
اللَّيَالِيَ: الـ + لَيَالِيَ — layālī, nights (pl. of laylah; acc., adverbial of time); 'through the nights'
وَصَارَتَا: وَ + صَارَتَا — wa-, and + ṣāra, to become, to come to be (verb I, perf. 3 dual fem); 'and the two became'
تَتَحَدَّثَانِ: تَتَحَدَّثَانِ — taḥaddatha, to converse, to talk (verb V, imperf. 3 dual fem); 'conversing'
زُورٌ: زُورٌ — zūr, falsehood, sham (m., nom. tanwīn, predicate); 'a sham'
وَمُحَالٌ: وَ + مُحَالٌ — wa-, and + muḥāl, absurd, impossible (adj./noun m., nom. tanwīn); 'and an absurdity'
أُمَرَاءِ: أُمَرَاءِ — umarāʾ, emirs (broken pl. of amīr; gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); dakhala ʿalā, 'go in to, enter the presence of'
مَكِيُّ: مَكِيُّ — makī, second half of al-Barmakī, 'of the Barmakids' (nisba, nom.); together with al-Bar, the Barmakid
بِجَمَاعَةٍ: بِـ + جَمَاعَةٍ — bi-, with, accompanied by (prep.) + jamāʿah, group, company (f., gen. tanwīn); 'with a company'
وَاكْبِسُوا: وَ + اكْبِسُوا — wa-, and + ikbisū, raid! press in upon! (verb I, imperative 2mp); 'and raid'
دَارَهُ: دَار + هُ — dār, house, dwelling (f., acc.) + ـhu, his (3ms); 'his house'
وَايْتُونِي: وَ + ائْتُوا + نِي — wa-, and + ʾtū, bring! (verb I, imperative 2mp of atā; written with yāʾ as the seat of the hamza, hence pointed ايْتُونِي) + ـnī, me (1s obj.); 'and bring me'
بِجَارِبَتِي: بِـ + جَارِيَتِي — bi-, with (prep.; ʾatā bi- means 'bring' something) + jāriyah, slave-girl (f., gen.) + ـī, my (1s); the print has ب for ي in the middle, a slip; 'my slave-girl'
بُدَّلِي: بُدَّلِي — budd, escape, alternative (m., fatḥa for the negated noun) + li-, for (prep.) + ـī, me (1s); printed joined; lā budda lī, 'I must'
أُعَذِّبَهُ: أُعَذِّبَ + هُ — ʿadhdhaba, to torment, to punish (verb II, subjunctive 1s after أَنْ) + ـhu, him (3ms obj.); 'that I punish him'
فَأَجَابَهُ: فَ + أَجَابَ + هُ — fa-, and so + ajāba, to answer (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + ـhu, him (3ms obj.); 'and he answered him'
بِقِدْرَةِ: بِـ + قِدْرَةِ — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi- means 'bring') + qidrah, cooking-pot (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with a pot of'
يَمُدَّيَدَهُ: يَمُدَّ + يَدَهُ — madda, to stretch out (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after an) + yad, hand (f., acc.) + ـhu, his (3ms); printed as one word, 'extend his hand'
لِيَأْكُلَ: لِـ + يَأْكُلَ — li-, in order to (prep./particle of purpose, governing the subjunctive) + akala, to eat (verb I, subjunctive 3ms); 'in order to eat'
الْبَلَاءَ: الـ + بَلَاء — balāʾ, affliction, calamity (m., acc.); 'the calamity', object of wajadat
أَحَاطَ: أَحَاطَ — aḥāṭa, to encircle, surround (IV perfect, 3rd m. sg.); with bi-, 'surrounded (something)'
وَالْوَزِيرُ: وَ + الـ + وَزِير — wa-, and (conj.) + al-wazīr, the vizier (m., nom.); 'and the vizier'
بِسُيُوفٍ: بِـ + سُيُوف — bi-, with (prep., of accompaniment: 'armed with') + suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, gen.); 'with swords'
مَسْلُولَةٍ: مَسْلُولَة — maslūla, drawn (f. sg. passive participle of salla 'to draw a sword', gen., agreeing with suyūf); 'drawn'
مُجَرَّدَةٍ: مُجَرَّدَة — mujarrada, bared, stripped (f. sg. passive participle of jarrada, gen.); 'bared'
بِالسَّوَادِ: بِـ + الـ + سَّوَاد — bi-, round, about (yadūru bi- 'goes round') + al-sawād, blackness, the black of the eye; 'around the black'
فَأَيْقَنَتْ: فَـ + أَيْقَنَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ayqana, to be certain (IV perfect, 3rd f. sg.); used with bi-, 'she was certain of'
وَتَغَيَّرَتْ: وَ + تَغَيَّرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taghayyara, to be changed (V perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and were altered'
مَحَاسِنُهَا: مَحَاسِنُ + هَا — maḥāsin, fair features, beauties (pl., nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'her charms'
وَرِزْقِي: وَ + رِزْقِ + ي — wa-, and + rizq, provision, livelihood (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my livelihood'
لَاتَمْكُثْ: لَا + تَمْكُثْ — lā, do not (prohibitive particle) + tamkuth, from makatha 'to linger, tarry' (imperfect, 2nd m. sg., jussive); 'do not linger' (the print joins the two words)
وَيَذْهَبَ: وَ + يَذْهَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhahaba, to go, go away (imperfect, 3rd m. sg., subjunctive, continuing li-allā); 'and go away'
يَاحَبِيبَتِي: يَا + حَبِيبَةِ + ي — yā, O (vocative) + ḥabība, beloved (f., vocative in the genitive form before -ī) + -ī, my; 'my beloved' (the print joins yā to the noun)
أَصْنَعُ: أَصْنَعُ — ṣanaʿa, to do, make (imperfect, 1st sg., indicative); 'shall I do'
لَاتَخَفْ: لَا + تَخَفْ — lā, do not (prohibitive) + takhaf, from khāfa 'to fear' (imperfect, 2nd m. sg., jussive, short vowel); 'do not fear' (the print joins the two words)
وَقَلَعَتْهُ: وَ + قَلَعَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qalaʿa, to pull off, strip (perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she stripped him'
وَأَلْبَسَتْهُ: وَ + أَلْبَسَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + albasa, to clothe someone (IV perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she clothed him'
بَالِيَةً: بَالِيَة — bāliya, worn-out, threadbare (f. sg. active participle of baliya 'to wear out', acc.; a non-human plural takes the f. sg. adjective); 'worn-out'
بِالْقِدْرَةِ: بِـ + الـ + قِدْرَة — bi-, with (jāʾa bi- 'come with, bring') + al-qidra, the cooking-pot (f.; Middle Arabic form of qidr); 'the pot'
اللَّحْمُ: الـ + لَّحْم — laḥm, meat (m., nom., subject of kāna); 'the meat'
حَوَالِيهَا: حَوَالِي + هَا — ḥawālī, surroundings, vicinity (gen. after fī; Classical dual ḥawālay-) + -hā, it (the pot); 'around it, in its surroundings'
كِسْرَةَ: كِسْرَةَ — kisra, piece, crust (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'a crust of'
خُبْزٍ: خُبْزٍ — khubz, bread (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'bread'
وَزُبْدِيَّةَ: وَ + زُبْدِيَّةَ — wa-, and (conj.) + zubdiyya, bowl, small dish (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and a bowl of'
وَوَضَعَتْهُمْ: وَ + وَضَعَتْ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + waḍaʿa, to put (perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + -hum, them (m. pl.; used for the objects, Middle Arabic); 'and she put them'
مِقْطَفٍ: مِقْطَف — miqṭaf, basket (m., gen. after fī, indefinite); 'a basket'
الْمِقْطَفَ: الـ + مِقْطَف — miqṭaf, basket (m., acc., object of the participle); 'the basket'
بِمَافِيهِ: بِـ + مَا + فِي + هِ — bi-, with (prep.: 'together with') + mā, what + fī, in + -hi, it; 'with what is in it' (the print joins the words)
السَّتَّارُ: الـ + سَّتَّار — al-sattār, the Concealer, the All-Concealing (m., nom.; a name of God, subject of satara); 'the Concealer'
وَنَجَامِنَ: وَ + نَجَا + مِنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + najā, to escape (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + min, from (prep., fatḥa before al-); 'and escaped from' (the print joins the words)
الْمَكَائِدِ: الـ + مَكَائِد — makāʾid, plots, stratagems (pl. of makīda, gen. after min); 'the plots'
وَالْإِضْرَارِ: وَ + الـ + إِضْرَار — wa-, and + al-iḍrār, harming, injury (m., verbal noun of IV aḍarra, gen.); 'and the harm'
بِبَرَكَةِ: بِـ + بَرَكَةِ — bi-, by, through (prep., of cause) + baraka, blessing (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the blessing of'
نِيَّتِهِ: نِيَّةِ + هِ — niyya, intention, purpose (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his intention'
تَرَجَّلَ: تَرَجَّلَ — tarajjala, to dismount (V perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'he dismounted'
حِصَانِهِ: حِصَانِ + هِ — ḥiṣān, stallion, horse (m., gen. after ʿan) + -hi, his; 'his horse'
تَزَيَّنَتْ: تَزَيَّنَتْ — tazayyana, to adorn oneself (V perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'she had adorned herself'
وَتَبَهْرَجَتْ: وَ + تَبَهْرَجَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tabahraja, to deck oneself in finery (V perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and decked herself out'
وَعَبَّتْ: وَ + عَبَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿabba, to pack, fill (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; the print lacks the hamza of Classical ʿabbaʾa); 'and she packed'
مِمَّاخَفَّ: مِنْ + مَا + خَفَّ — min, of, from (prep., partitive) + mā, what (relative) + khaffa, to be light (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'of such as is light' (the print joins the words)
وَرَآهَا: وَ + رَآ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see (perfect, 3rd m. sg.; printed with the madda) + -hā, her; 'and saw her'
وَقَبَّلَتِ: وَ + قَبَّلَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + qabbala, to kiss (II perfect, 3rd f. sg.; kasra on the t before al-); 'and she kissed'
الْقِدَمِ: الـ + قِدَم — qidam, eternity, pre-existence (m., verbal noun of qadima, gen. after min); 'the eternity'
بِقَبْضِ: بِـ + قَبْضِ — bi-, with, to (awṣā bi- 'charge someone with something') + qabḍ, seizing, arrest (m., verbal noun of qabaḍa, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the seizing of'
عَبَّى: عَبَّى — ʿabbā, to pack (perfect, 3rd m. sg.; Middle Arabic for Classical ʿabbaʾa); 'he packed'
تِجَارَاتٍ: تِجَارَاتٍ — tijārāt, trade, merchandise (f. sound pl. of tijāra, acc., indefinite); 'trade-goods'
تَحْفَظَ: تَحْفَظَ — ḥafiẓa, to keep, guard (imperfect, 2nd m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'you keep'
تُسَلِّمَهُ: تُسَلِّمَ + هُ — tusallima, from sallama 'to hand over' (II imperfect, 2nd m. sg., subjunctive after an) + -hu, it; 'you hand it over'
بِحَمْلِهِ: بِـ + حَمْلِ + هِ — bi-, with, of (amara bi- 'order something done') + ḥaml, carrying (m., verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, it; 'its carrying'
مُكَرَّمَةٌ: mukarrama, honoured (f. passive participle, form II of karuma; nom. predicate)
مُعَزَّزَةٌ: muʿazzaza, esteemed, cherished (f. passive participle, form II of ʿazza; nom.)
نَهَبُوا: nahabū, they plundered (nahaba, 3 m.pl. perfect; the final alif is silent); 'they plundered'
لِقُوتِ: لِـ + قُوت — li-, for (the person for whom something is ordered) + qūt, nourishment (first term of the name Qūt al-Qulūb); 'for Qūt'
بِمَكَانٍ: بِـ + مَكَان — bi-, marking the thing ordered (amara bi- 'order [something]') + makān, place (m., gen.); 'a place'
وَأَسْكَنَهَا: وَ + أَسْكَنَ + هَا — wa-, and + askana, he lodged, housed (form IV, 3 m.s.) + -hā, her; 'and lodged her'
عَجُوزًا: ʿajūz, old woman (f. noun, acc. object); 'an old woman'
حَاجَتِهَا: حَاجَة + هَا — ḥāja, need (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her need'
فَسَقَ: fasaqa, he fornicated, committed debauchery (3 m.s.)
وَرَاقَدَهَا: وَ + رَاقَدَ + هَا — wa-, and + rāqada, he lay with, bedded (form III of raqada) + -hā, her; 'and lay with her'
لِلْأَمِيرِ: لِـ + الـ + أَمِير — li-, to (the addressee) + amīr, emir (gen.); 'to the emir'
وَمَضْمُونُهُ: وَ + مَضْمُون + هُ — wa-, and + maḍmūn, contents, purport (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and its purport'
وُصُولِ: wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala, gen.)
الْمَرْسُومِ: الـ + مَرْسُوم — marsūm, decree (gen./nom. as the context requires); 'the decree'
تَقْبِضَ: taqbiḍa, you seize (qabaḍa ʿalā 'seize', 2 m.s. subjunctive after an)
وَتُرْسِلَهُ: وَ + تُرْسِلَ + هُ — wa-, and + tursila, you send (form IV, 2 m.s. subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'and send him'
قَبَّلَهُ: قَبَّلَ + هُ — qabbala, he kissed (form II, 3 m.s.) + -hu, it; 'he kissed it'
أَرَادَانْ: أَرَادَ + أَنْ — arāda, he wished (3 m.s.) + an, to; the print runs the two words together; 'wished to'
يَنْهَبَ: yanhaba, he plunders (3 m.s. subjunctive after an); 'to plunder'
فَعَلَيْهِ: فَ + عَلَى + هِ — fa-, then (opening the apodosis) + ʿalā, upon + -hi, him; 'then upon him [be it]'
أُمَّ: umm, mother (f., acc. object, first term of an annexation)
وَأُخْتَهُ: وَ + أُخْت + هُ — wa-, and + ukht, sister (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his sister'
صَنَعَتَا: ṣanaʿatā, they two (f.) made (3 f. dual perfect)
وَقَعَدَتَا: وَ + قَعَدَتَا — wa-, and + qaʿadatā, they two (f.) sat (3 f. dual perfect); 'and the two sat'
تَبْكِيَانِ: tabkiyāni, they two (f.) weeping (imperfect dual of bakā; circumstantial)
فَمَسَكُوهُمَا: فَ + مَسَكُوا + هُمَا — fa-, and so + masakū, they seized (masaka, Middle Arabic for amsaka; 3 m.pl.) + -humā, the two of them; 'and seized them'
وَنَهَبُوا: وَ + نَهَبُوا — wa-, and + nahabū, they plundered; 'and plundered'
تَعْلَمَا: taʿlamā, they two (f.) know (jussive dual after lam); 'they knew'
أَحْضَرُوهُمَا: أَحْضَرُوا + هُمَا — aḥḍarū, they brought (form IV of ḥaḍara, 3 m.pl.) + -humā, the two of them; 'they brought them'
سَأَلَهُمَا: سَأَلَ + هُمَا — saʾala, he asked (3 m.s.) + -humā, the two of them; 'he asked them'
وَلَدِهِمَا: وَلَد + هِمَا — walad, son, child (m., gen. in apposition) + -himā, their (dual); 'their son'
وَقَفْنَا: waqafnā, we stood, came upon (waqafa; waqafa ʿalā 'find out about'; 1 pl. perfect)
فَرَدُّ: فَ + رَدُّ(وا) — fa-, and so + raddū, they sent back (radda, 3 m.pl. perfect; the print splits the word after its stem)
وهُمَا: (the -ū of raddū) + هُمَا — humā, the two of them (acc.); the print writes the pieces apart: fa-raddū-humā, 'and sent them back'
مَكَانِهِمَا: مَكَان + هِمَا — makān, place (m., gen. after ilā) + -himā, their (dual); 'their place'
أَمْرِهِمَا: أَمْر + هِمَا — amr, affair, matter (m., gen. after min) + -himā, of the two; 'their affair'
سُلِبَتْ: sulibat, it was taken away (salaba, passive 3 f.s. perfect)
نِعْمَتُهُ: نِعْمَة + هُ — niʿma, bounty, prosperity (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his fortune'
انْفَطَرَ: infaṭara, it burst, was rent (form VII of faṭara, 3 m.s.)
وَأَضَرَّبِهِ: وَ + أَضَرَّ + بِـ + هِ — wa-, and + aḍarra, he harmed (form IV) + bi-, to (aḍarra bi- 'harm someone') + -hi, him; the print joins the words; 'and harmed him'
الْمَشْيُ: الـ + مَشْي — mashy, walking (m., nom.); 'the walking'
دَخَلَهَا: دَخَلَ + هَا — dakhala, he entered (3 m.s.) + -hā, it (the town); 'he entered it'
بُرْشٍ: bursh, mat, rug (m., gen. after ʿalā); the word and its vowel are uncertain; 'a mat'
حَائِطِ: ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m., gen. after ilā, first term); 'the wall of'
الْمَسْجِدِ: الـ + مَسْجِد — masjid, mosque (m., gen.); 'the mosque'
وَارْتَمَى: وَ + ارْتَمَى — wa-, and + irtamā, he threw himself down (form VIII of ramā, 3 m.s.); 'and sank down'
جِلْدِهِ: جِلْد + هِ — jild, skin (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his skin'
الْعَرَقِ: الـ + عَرَق — ʿaraq, sweat (m., gen. after min); 'the sweat'
زَفِرَةً: zafira, foul-smelling (f. adj., acc. predicate of ṣārat); possibly zafra 'sigh'; 'foul'
أَحْوَالُهُ: أَحْوَال + هُ — aḥwāl, conditions (pl. of ḥāl, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his conditions'
يُصَلُّونَ: yuṣallūna, they pray (form II, 3 m.pl. imperfect; circumstantial); 'praying'
مَطْرُوحًا: maṭrūḥ, cast down, thrown (passive participle of ṭaraḥa, acc.); 'cast down'
آثَارُ: āthār, traces, marks (pl. of athar, nom., first term); 'the traces of'
النِّعْمَةِ: الـ + نِعْمَة — niʿma, bounty, ease (f., gen.); 'the comfort'
لَائِحَةً: lāʾiḥa, visible, evident (f. act. participle of lāḥa; acc. ḥāl); 'visible'
وَأَقْبَلُوا: وَ + أَقْبَلُوا — wa-, and + aqbalū, they turned toward (form IV; aqbala ʿalā 'turn to'); 'and turned'
فَأَعْطَوْهُ: فَ + أَعْطَوْا + هُ — fa-, and so + aʿṭaw, they gave (form IV of ʿaṭā) + -hu, him; 'and gave him'
بَلِيَتْ: baliyat, it wore out (baliya, 3 f.s. perfect)
أَكْمَامُهُ: أَكْمَام + هُ — akmām, sleeves (pl. of kumm, nom.) + -hu, its; 'its sleeves'
يَاغَرِيبُ: يَا + غَرِيب — yā, O (vocative particle) + gharīb, stranger (m., nom.); the print joins them; 'O stranger'
ضَعْفِكَ: ضَعْف + كَ — ḍaʿf, weakness (m., gen.) + -ka, your (2 m.s.); 'your weakness'
جَيْعَانُ: jayʿān, hungry (Middle Arabic for classical jawʿān; nom. predicate)
بِسُكُرُّجَةِ: بِـ + سُكُرُّجَة — bi-, with (atā bi- 'bring', literally 'come with') + sukurruja, small dish, saucer (f., gen., first term); 'with a saucer of'
وَرَغِيفَيْنِ: وَ + رَغِيفَيْنِ — wa-, and + raghīf, loaf (dual gen., coordinated with the bi- phrase); 'and two loaves'
شْغَا: (أَ)شْغَا(لِهِمْ) — middle piece of ashghāl, occupations, business (pl. of shughl)
لِهِمْ: (شْغَا)لِهِمْ — last piece: the lām of ashghāl + -hi-m, their; the whole is li-ashghālihim, 'to their occupations'
وَالْمَرَضُ: وَ + الـ + مَرَض — wa-, and + maraḍ, sickness (m., nom.); 'and the sickness'
فَبَكَوْا: فَ + بَكَوْا — fa-, and so + bakaw, they wept (3 m.pl.); 'and they wept'
وَتَعَطَّفُوا: وَ + تَعَطَّفُوا — wa-, and + taʿaṭṭafū, they showed tenderness (form V, 3 m.pl.); 'and took pity'
وَتَشَاوَرُوا: وَ + تَشَاوَرُوا — wa-, and + tashāwarū, they took counsel together (form VI); 'and consulted'
يُوصِلُوهُ: يُوصِلُوا + هُ — yūṣilū, they convey (form IV of waṣala, 3 m.pl. subjunctive after an) + -hu, him; 'convey him'
الْمَارَسْتَانِ: الـ + مَارَسْتَان — mārastān, hospital (Persian-derived, m., gen. after ilā); 'the hospital'
فَبَيْنَمَاهُمْ: فَ + بَيْنَ + مَا + هُمْ — fa-, and + bayna, between + mā (makes bayna a conjunction, 'while') + hum, they; 'and while they'
بِامْرَأَتَيْنِ: بِـ + امْرَأَتَيْنِ — bi-, marks what appears after idhā of surprise (no sense of 'with'); imraʾa, woman (f.), dual gen./acc.; 'and behold, two women'
شَحَّاذَتَيْنِ: شَحَّاذَة — shaḥḥādha, beggar (f.), dual gen./acc., adjective of the two women; 'two beggars'
دَخَلَتَا: دَخَلَ — dakhala, to enter (perf. 3 f. dual); 'the two entered'
رَآهُمَا: رَأَى + هُمَا — raʾā, to see (perf. 3 m. s.) + them two; 'he saw them'
أَعْطَاهُمَا: أَعْطَى + هُمَا — aʿṭā, to give (IV, perf. 3 m. s.) + to them two; 'he gave them'
الْخُبْزَ: الـ + خُبْز — khubz, bread (m., acc.); 'the bread'
وَنَامَتَا: و + نَامَ — nāma, to sleep (perf. 3 f. dual); 'and the two slept'
يَعْرِفْهُمَا: عَرَفَ + هُمَا — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (imperf. jussive 3 m. s. after lam) + them two; 'he did not know them'
الْقَرْيَةِ: الـ + قَرْيَة — qarya, village (f., gen.); 'of the village'
لِلْجَمَّالِ: لِـ + الـ + جَمَّال — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed); jammāl, camel-driver (m.); 'to the camel-driver'
اِحْمِلْ: حَمَلَ — ḥamala, to carry, load (imperative m. s.); 'carry'
الْمَرِيضَ: الـ + مَرِيض — marīḍ, sick, sick person (m., acc.); 'the sick man'
تَحُطُّهُ: حَطَّ + هُ — ḥaṭṭa, to set down, lower (imperf. 2 m. s.) + him; 'you set him down'
يَتَدَاوَى: تَدَاوَى — tadāwā, to be treated, take medicine (VI, imperf. 3 m. s.); 'he is treated'
وَيَتَعَانَى: و + يَتَعَانَى — wa-, and; yataʿānā, obscure; I take it as 'be tended, mend' (perhaps for يتعافى, 'recover')
الْأَجْرُ: الـ + أَجْر — ajr, reward (m., nom.); 'the reward'
بِالْبَرْشِ: بِـ + الـ + بَرْش — bi-, with, together with (prep.); barsh, mat (m.; uncertain word); 'with the mat'
وَجَاتْ: و + جَاتْ — jāt, came (perf. 3 f. s.; Middle Arabic spelling of جاءت); 'and she came'
وَأُخْتُهُ: و + أُخْت + ـهُ — ukht, sister (f., nom.) + his; 'and his sister'
يَتَفَرَّجَانِ: تَفَرَّجَ — tafarraja, to watch, look on at (V, imperf. 3 dual, circumstantial); 'looking on'
تَعْلَمَابِهِ: تَعْلَمَا + بِـ + هِ — ʿalima, to know (imperf. jussive 3 f. dual, after lam; printed run together with the next word); bi-, of (prep., chosen by ʿalima); him; 'they did not know of him'
نَظَرَتَا: نَظَرَ — naẓara, to look (perf. 3 f. dual; with ilā, 'look at'); 'the two looked'
وَتَأَمَّلَتَاهُ: و + تَأَمَّلَ + هُ — taʾammala, to examine, study (V, perf. 3 f. dual) + him; 'and they studied him'
وَقَالَتَا: و + قَالَ — qāla, to say (perf. 3 f. dual); 'and the two said'
شَبِيهٌ: shabīh — like, resembling (m., nom. with tanwīn)
ابْنِنَا: ابْن + نَا — ibn, son (m., gen. in apposition) + our; 'our son'
فَيَاتُرَى: فَـ + يَا تُرَى — fa-, so; yā turā, colloquial 'I wonder' (literally 'O, it is seen'); 'so one wonders'
الضَّعِيفُ: الـ + ضَعِيف — ḍaʿīf, weak, feeble (m., nom.); 'the feeble one'
مَحْمُولٌ: maḥmūl — carried (pass. part. of ḥamala; m., nom. with tanwīn)
وَاشْتَكَى: و + اشْتَكَى — ishtakā, to complain, moan (VIII, perf. 3 m. s.); 'and he moaned'
الْقَرْيَهْ: الـ + قَرْيَه — qarya, village (f.), printed with final ه for ة and read pausally, no case ending; 'the village'
تَعْرِفَابِهِ: تَعْرِفَا + بِـ + هِ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (imperf. jussive 3 f. dual, after lam; printed run together); bi- (prep. of the construction, 'know of'); him; 'they did not recognise him'
سَافَرَتْ: سَافَرَ — sāfara, to travel (III, perf. 3 f. s.); 'travelled'
الْجَمَّالُ: الـ + جَمَّال — jammāl, camel-driver (m., nom.); 'the camel-driver'
فَمَازَالَ: فَـ + مَا زَالَ — fa-, so; mā zāla, to keep on (perf. 3 m. s., negative + zāla; printed run together)
سَائِرًابِهِ: سَائِرًا + بِـ + هِ — sāʾir, going, travelling (act. part. of sāra; acc., predicate of mā zāla; printed run together); bi-, with (prep., 'taking him along'); him; 'going on with him'
جَمَلَهُ: جَمَل + هُ — jamal, camel (m., acc.) + his; 'his camel'
انْدَرَجَتِ: اِنْدَرَجَ — indaraja, to go about, set out (VII, perf. 3 f. s.; read by the sense; the final kasra is the connecting vowel)
نَظَرُوا: نَظَرَ — naẓara, to look (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they looked'
صَارَرِقَّ: صَارَ + رِقَّ — ṣāra, to become (perf. 3 m. s.) + riqq, thinness (acc.); printed run together; obscure; 'had become thin'
الْخِلَالِ: الـ + خِلَال — khilāl, interstices, gaps (m., gen.); obscure; perhaps a slip for الحال; 'of body'
وَأَزَاحَ: و + أَزَاحَ — azāḥa, to remove, drive back (IV, perf. 3 m. s.); 'and he drove back'
أَكْسِبُ: كَسَبَ — kasaba, to earn, win (imperf. 1 s.); 'I earn'
الْجَنَّةَ: الـ + جَنَّة — janna, garden, Paradise (f., acc.); 'Paradise'
أَدْخَلُوهُ: أَدْخَلَ + هُ — adkhala, to put in, bring in (IV, perf. 3 m. pl.) + him; 'they put him in'
الْمَارِسْتَانَ: الـ + مَارِسْتَان — mārisitān, hospital (m., acc.); 'the hospital'
قَتَلُوهُ: قَتَلَ + هُ — qatala, to kill (perf. 3 m. pl.) + him; 'they kill him' (conditional sense after matā)
صِبْيَانَهُ: صِبْيَان + هُ — ṣibyān, boys, lads, servants (m. pl., acc.) + his; 'his lads'
فَحَمَلُوهُ: فَـ + حَمَلَ + هُ — fa-, so; ḥamala, to carry (perf. 3 m. pl.) + him
اِخْدِمِيهِ: خَدَمَ + هُ — khadama, to serve, wait on (imperative f. s.) + him; 'wait on him'
بِنُصْحٍ: بِـ + نُصْح — bi-, with (prep., manner); nuṣḥ, sincerity, true care (m., gen.); 'with true care'
تَشَمَّرَتْ: تَشَمَّرَ — tashammara, to tuck up one's sleeves, gird oneself (V, perf. 3 f. s.)
وَسَخَّنَتْ: و + سَخَّنَ — sakhkhana, to heat (II, perf. 3 f. s.); 'and she heated'
وَبَدَنَهُ: و + بَدَن + هُ — badan, body (m., acc.) + his; 'and his body'
لُبْسِ: lubs — clothing, garments (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); pointed by the sense
جَوَارِيهَا: جَوَارِي + هَا — jawārī, slave-girls (f. pl., gen.) + her; 'her slave-girls'
وَأَسْقَتْهُ: و + أَسْقَى + هُ — asqā, to give to drink (IV, perf. 3 f. s.) + him; 'and she gave him to drink'
فَأَفَاقَ: فَـ + أَفَاقَ — fa-, so; afāqa, to revive (IV, perf. 3 m. s.); 'and he revived'
مَحْبُوبَتَهُ: مَحْبُوبَة + هُ — maḥbūba, beloved (f., acc.) + his; 'his beloved'
فَزَادَتْ: فَـ + زَادَ — fa-, so; zāda, to increase (perf. 3 f. s.); 'and so grew'
الْكُرُوبُ: الـ + كُرُوب — kurūb, griefs, distresses (f. broken pl., nom.); 'the sorrows'
لْمَلِكُ: [ا]لْـ + مَلِك — al-malik with the alif dropped in print: al-, the + malik, king (m., nom., vocative); 'the king'
الْمُظْلِمِ: الـ + مُظْلِم — muẓlim, dark (m., gen., adj. agreeing with the place); 'the dark'
وَتَمَّتْ: وَ + تَمَّ — wa-, and; tamma, last, continue (perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and she remained'
أَحْسَنَكَ: أَحْسَنَ + كَ — aḥsana, be how good (exclamatory form of ḥasuna) + -ka, you (acc. obj. of the exclamation); 'how good you are'
أَعَفَّ: أَعَفَّ — aʿaffa, be how chaste (exclamatory form of ʿaffa, abstain from the unlawful); 'how chaste'
وَحَفِظْتَ: وَ + حَفِظَ + تَ — wa-, and; ḥafiẓa, guard, protect (perfect) + -ta, you (subject); 'and you guarded'
حُرْمَةَ: حُرْمَة — ḥurma, sanctity, inviolability, honour (f., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa)
ضَيَّعَ: ضَيَّعَ — ḍayyaʿa, squander, neglect, lose (II perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'he squandered'
حُرْمَتَكَ: حُرْمَة + كَ — ḥurma, sanctity, honour (f., acc. object) + -ka, your (possessor); 'your honour'
حَرِيمَهُ: حَرِيم + هُ — ḥarīm, women of the house, harem, inviolable precinct (m., acc. object) + -hu, his (possessor); 'his women'
سَبَاكَ: سَبَى + كَ — sabā, take captive (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -ka, you (acc. object); 'he took you captive'
وَسَبَى: وَ + سَبَى — wa-, and; sabā, take captive (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'and he took captive'
أَهْلَكَ: أَهْل + كَ — ahl, family, people (m., acc. object) + -ka, your (possessor); 'your family'
تَقِفَ: وَقَفَ — waqafa, stand (imperfect, 2nd m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'you stand'
وَأَمِيرَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: وَ + أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — wa-, and (joins him to the subject); amīr, commander (m., acc. as coordinate with the subject); al-muʾminīn, the believers (m. sound pl., gen. in iḍāfa); 'and the Commander of the Faithful'
حَاكِمٍ: حَاكِم — ḥākim, judge, ruler (m., gen. tanwīn, second term of the iḍāfa); 'a judge'
عَادِلٍ: عَادِل — ʿādil, just, equitable (m., gen. tanwīn, adj. agreeing with a judge); 'just'
وَتَنْتَصِفَ: وَ + تَنْتَصِفَ — wa-, and; intaṣafa, take one's due, obtain justice (VIII imperfect, 2nd m. sg., subjunctive coordinated with an taqifa); 'and you obtain justice'
وَالشُّهُو: وَ + الـ + شُهُو[د] — wa-, and; al-, the; shuhū(d), witnesses, plural of shāhid, with the final dāl split off in the print; 'and the witnesses'
دْهُمُ: [ش‌هُو]دْ + هُمُ — d, the final dāl of shuhūd, printed detached; hum, they (3rd m. pl. pron.); 'they'
الْمَلَائِكَةُ: الـ + مَلَائِكَة — malak, angel (m., broken pl. malāʾika, nom. predicate); 'the angels'
شَكْوَاهَا: شَكْوَى + هَا — shakwā, complaint (f., acc. object) + -hā, her; 'her complaint'
مَظْلُومَةٌ: maẓlūma, wronged, treated unjustly (f. passive participle of ẓalama, nom. predicate of anna); 'wronged'
مَسْرُورَ: Masrūr, name of the Caliph's chief eunuch (m., acc. object of arsala; printed without the alif of tanwīn)
أَطْرَقَتْ: aṭraqat, to lower the head, to look down (verb IV, perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she bowed down'
بِرَأْسِهَا: بِـ + رَأْس + هَا — bi-, with (prep.; here marks what she lowered, 'with her head') + raʾs, head (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her head', 'her head'
حَزِينَةُ: ḥazīna, sad, sorrowful (f. adjective, nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'sorrowful of ...'
تَتَظَلَّمِينَ: tazallama, to complain of wrong (verb V, imperfect 2nd f. sg., with ya-/ta- prefix and -īna ending); 'you complain of wrong'
وَتَنْسِبِينَنِي: وَ + تَنْسِبِينَ + نِي — wa-, and; nasaba, to ascribe, to attribute (verb I, imperfect 2nd f. sg.); -nī, me (object); 'and you attribute to me'
الظُّلْمِ: الـ + ظُلْم — ẓulm, wrong, injustice (m. verbal noun, gen. after ilā); 'the injustice'
وَتَزْعُمِينَ: وَ + تَزْعُمِينَ — wa-, and; zaʿama, to claim, to allege (verb I, imperfect 2nd f. sg.); 'and you claim'
أَسَأْتُ: asāʾa, to do ill, to act badly (verb IV, perfect 1st sg.; takes li- of the person); 'I did ill'
حَفِظَ: ḥafiẓa, to guard, to preserve (verb I, perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'he guarded'
وَأْنَتَهَكْتُ: وَ + اِنْتَهَكْتُ — wa-, and (here circumstantial, 'while') + intahaka, to violate (verb VIII, perfect 1st sg.); 'and I violated'
حُرْمَتَهُ: حُرْمَة + هُ — ḥurma, inviolability, honour (f., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his honour'
حَرِيمِي: حَرِيم + ي — ḥarīm, the women of a household, harem (m., acc. object) + -ī, my; 'my harem'
وَسَبَيْتُ: وَ + سَبَيْتُ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while'); sabā, to take captive (verb I, perfect 1st sg.); 'and I took captive'
يَقْرَبْنِي: يَقْرَبْ + نِي — qariba, to approach, to come near (verb I, jussive 3rd m. sg. after lam; takes bi- of the thing offered) + -nī, me; 'he came near me'
بِفَاحِشَةٍ: بِـ + فَاحِشَة — bi-, with (prep.; qariba bi-, 'to approach with (an act)') + fāḥisha, indecency, lewd act (f., gen.); 'with an indecency'
إِلَّابِاللَّهِ: إِلَّا + بِـ + اللَّه — illā, except, save (particle); bi-, by, through (prep.; 'power through God'); Allāh, God (gen.); printed fused; 'save through God'
تَمَنَّيْ: tamannā, to wish, to desire (verb V, imperative 2nd f. sg.); 'wish!'
تُعْطَىْ: tuʿṭā, to be given (verb IV passive, imperfect 2nd f. sg., read as jussive in the result clause); 'you will be given'
أَتَمَنَّى: أَتَمَنَّى — atamannā, to wish (verb V, imperfect 1st sg.; initial a- is the first-person prefix with hamza); 'I wish'
مَحْبُوبِي: مَحْبُوب + ي — maḥbūb, beloved (m., acc. object of atamannā) + -ī, my; 'my beloved'; also nom., subject: bal maḥbūbī aḥsanu, 'no, my beloved is fairer' (Night 182)
امْتَثَلَ: imtathala, to comply with, to carry out (verb VIII, perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'he complied with'
أَحْضَرْتَهُ: أَحْضَرْتَ + هُ — aḥḍara, to bring, to have (someone) present (verb IV, perfect 2nd m. sg.) + -hu, him (object); 'you bring him'
تَهَبُنِي: تَهَبُ + نِي — wahaba, to give (verb I, imperfect 2nd m. sg., here indicative in the result clause; the initial w- drops) + -nī, me; 'you give me'
وَهَبْتُكِ: وَهَبْتُ + كِ — wahaba, to give (verb I, perfect 1st sg., used performatively as a promise) + -ki, you (f. sg. object); 'I give you'
لَايَرُدُّ: لَا + يَرُدُّ — lā, not (negates the indicative); radda, to turn back, to take back (verb I, imperfect 3rd m. sg.); printed fused; 'who does not take back' Also radda jawāban, 'to give an answer': وَلِسَانُهُ لَايَرُدُّ جَوَابًا بِسُرْعَةٍ 'and his tongue was slow to give an answer'.
يَاأَمِيرَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ: يَا + أَمِير + الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — yā, O (vocative particle); amīr, commander (m., acc. in vocative); al-, the; muʾminīn, believers (m. sound pl., gen.); printed fused; 'O Commander of the Faithful'
أَذِنْ: adhina, to permit, give leave (verb I, read as imperative 2nd m. sg., Classical idhan; takes li- of the person); 'permit'
أَدُورَ: adūra, to go round, to circulate (verb I, imperfect 1st sg. subjunctive after an); 'that I go about'
يَجْمَعُنِي: يَجْمَعُ + نِي — jamaʿa, to gather, to unite (verb I, imperfect 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'will gather me'
إِفْعَلِي: ifʿalī, to do (verb I, imperative 2nd f. sg. of faʿala); 'do!'
مَابَدَالَكِ: مَا + بَدَا + لَكِ — mā, what, whatever (rel.); badā, to appear, to seem (verb I, perfect 3rd m. sg.); la-ki = li- (to, for) + -ki (you, f. sg.); printed fused; 'what seemed good to you'
فَزَارَتِ: فَ + زَارَتِ — fa-, and then (conj.) + zārat, she visited (verb I, past 3 f. sg.; zāra, to visit); the final kasra is the link vowel before al-
الْمَشَائِخَ: الـ + مَشَائِخ — al-, the + mashāʾikh, elders, sheikhs (m. broken pl., acc.; Middle Arabic form of mashāyikh)
وَتَصَدَّقَتْ: وَ + تَصَدَّقَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taṣaddaqat, she gave alms (verb V, past 3 f. sg.; taṣaddaqa, to give charity)
وَأَعْطَتْ: وَ + أَعْطَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭat, she gave (verb IV, past 3 f. sg.; aʿṭā, to give)
تَصَدَّقْ: تَصَدَّقْ — taṣaddaq, give alms! (verb V, imperative m. sg.; taṣaddaqa)
الْغُرَبَاءِ: الـ + غُرَبَاء — al-, the + ghurabāʾ, strangers, foreigners (m. broken pl. of gharīb, gen.); 'the strangers'
جُمْعَةٍ: جُمْعَة — jumʿa, week (here; also Friday) (f., gen. second term of an iḍāfa with thānī); 'the second week, the following week'; also: 'week', gen. after kull: fī kulli jumʿatin, 'in every week' (Night 192)
سُوقَ: سُوق — sūq, market (m./f., acc. as object; first term of an iḍāfa)
الصَّاغَةِ: الـ + صَاغَة — al-, the + ṣāgha, goldsmiths (m. coll. pl. of ṣāʾigh, gen.); 'of the goldsmiths'
وَسُوقَ: وَ + سُوقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + sūq, market (m./f., acc. object, first term of an iḍāfa)
الْجَوْهَرِيَّةِ: الـ + جَوْهَرِيَّة — al-, the + jawharīya, jewellers (pl. of jawharī, dealer in jewels, gen.); 'of the jewellers'
بِالْعَرِيفِ: بِـ + الـ + عَرِيف — bi-, for, to (prep.; nādā bi- = call for someone) + al-, the + ʿarīf, overseer, headman of a market or quarter (m., gen.); 'for the overseer'
فَدَفَعَتْ: فَ + دَفَعَتْ — fa-, and then (conj.) + dafaʿat, she handed over, paid (verb I, past 3 f. sg.)
وَقَانَتْ: وَ + قَانَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + qānat, as printed, a slip for qālat, she said (verb I, past 3 f. sg.)
تَذْهَبِي: تَذْهَبِي — tadhhabī, you go (verb I, 2 f. sg. subjunctive after an; the nūn dropped; dhahaba, to go)
وَتَنْظُرِي: وَ + تَنْظُرِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tanẓurī, you look (verb I, 2 f. sg. subjunctive, joined to an)
أَظْرَفَهُ: أَظْرَفَ + هُ — aẓrafa, how charming (exclamatory form of ẓarīf, charming) + -hu, he/him; 'how charming he is'
أَكْمَلَهُ: أَكْمَلَ + هُ — akmala, how perfect (exclamatory form of kāmil, perfect) + -hu, he/him; 'how perfect he is'
الْمُتَيَّمَ: الـ + مُتَيَّم — al-, the + mutayyam, love-enslaved, besotted (m., verb II passive participle of tayyama, acc. in apposition)
الْمَسْلُوبَ: الـ + مَسْلُوب — al-, the + maslūb, despoiled, robbed (m., passive participle of salaba, acc. in apposition)
الْعَرِيفَ: الـ + عَرِيف — al-, the + ʿarīf, overseer (m., acc. as noun of lākinna)
مَعْرِفَةٌ: مَعْرِفَة — maʿrifa, knowledge, acquaintance (f., nom. subject of laysa)
مَدْيُونٌ: مَدْيُون — madyūn, indebted, in debt (adj., nom.; passive participle of dāna)
أَحِبَّتَهُ: أَحِبَّة + هُ — aḥibba, beloved ones (m. broken pl. of ḥabīb, acc. object; form with tāʾ marbūṭa, 'loved ones') + -hu, his; 'his loved ones'
وَتَقَلْقَلَتْ: وَ + تَقَلْقَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taqalqalat, it was shaken, shook (quadriliteral verb V, past 3 f. sg.; qalqala, to shake)
أَحْشَاؤُهَا: أَحْشَاء + هَا — aḥshāʾ, innards, bowels (m. broken pl. of ḥashan, nom., takes feminine agreement) + -hā, her; 'her innards'
أَسِلْ: أَسِلْ — asil, as printed, a slip for arsil, send! (verb IV, imperative m. sg.; arsala, to send)
صَبِيًّا: صَبِيّ — ṣabī, boy (m., acc. object, with tanwīn)
فَأَوْصَلَهَا: فَ + أَوْصَلَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + awṣala, he brought, conveyed (verb IV, past 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and he brought her'
الْغَرِيبُ: الـ + غَرِيب — al-, the + gharīb, stranger (m., nom. subject)
فَشَكَرَتْهُ: فَـ + شَكَرَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj., continuing the story) + shakarat, she thanked (shakara, to thank; perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him (object suffix); 'so she thanked him'
وَصَلَتِ: وَصَلَتْ — waṣalat, she arrived, reached (waṣala, to arrive at; perf. 3 f. sg.), vocalised with kasra before the wasl of الـ
عَرَفَتْهَا: عَرَفَتْ + هَا — ʿarafat, she knew, recognised (ʿarafa, to know a person; perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her (object suffix); 'she knew her'
وَنَظَرَتْهُ: وَ + نَظَرَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + naẓarat, she looked at (naẓara, to look; perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him (object suffix, taken directly)
بِذَاتِهِ: بِـ + ذَات + هِ — bi-, in, by (prep., 'in the very ...') + dhāt, self, essence (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'in his very self'
وَرَأَتْهُ: وَ + رَأَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + raʾat, she saw (raʾā; perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him (object suffix)
اخْتَفَى: ikhtafā — he vanished, hid himself, wasted away (ikhtafā, form VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.)
نُحُولُهُ: نُحُول + هُ — nuḥūl, emaciation, wasting (m. verbal noun, nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his wasting'
كَالْخِلَالِ: كَـ + الـ + خِلَال — ka-, like, as (prep., introducing the comparison) + al-, the + khilāl, toothpick, splinter (m., gen. after ka-); 'like the toothpick'
وَانْبَهَمَ: وَ + انْبَهَمَ — wa-, and + inbahama, it became obscure, hidden, blurred (inbahama, form VII, perf. 3 m. sg.)
أَمْرُهُ: أَمْر + هُ — amr, matter, affair, condition (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his case'
تَتَحَقَّقْ: tataḥaqqaq — she made sure, ascertained (taḥaqqaqa, form V; jussive 3 f. sg. after lam)
أَخَذَتْهَا: أَخَذَتْ + هَا — akhadhat, it took, seized (akhadha, to take; perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her (object suffix); 'took hold of her'; also 'she took it' (fa-lammā akhadhathā, the slave-girl taking the letter)
الْغُرَبَاءَ: الـ + غُرَبَاء — ghurabāʾ, strangers, foreigners (broken pl. of gharīb, acc. after inna); 'the strangers'
مَسَاكِينُ: masākīn — poor, wretched ones (broken pl. of miskīn, nom. predicate of inna, diptote)
أُمَرَاءَ: umarāʾ — princes, emirs (broken pl. of amīr, acc. as predicate of kāna, diptote)
بِلَادِهِمْ: بِلَاد + هِمْ — bilād, lands, countries (pl. of balad, m., gen. after fī; the bi- is part of the noun's stem, not a prefix) + -him, their (possessive suffix); 'their lands'
وَقَدْتَعَنَّتَ: وَ + قَدْ + تَعَنَّتَ — wa-, and + qad, already (particle) + taʿannata, it was hard, troublesome (taʿannata ʿalā, form V; perf. 3 m. sg.), printed as one word; 'and it had been hard'
وَجَعَهَا: وَجَعَ + هَا — waja'a, it pained, hurt (wajaʿa, perf. 3 m. sg.; used transitively here) + -hā, her (object suffix); 'it pained her'
وَرَتَّبَتْ: وَ + رَتَّبَتْ — wa-, and + rattabat, she arranged, set in order (rattaba, form II; perf. 3 f. sg.)
وَالْأَدْوِيَةَ: وَ + الـ + أَدْوِيَة — wa-, and + al-, the + adwiya, medicines (pl. of dawāʾ, acc., object coordinated with al-sharāb); 'and the medicines'
رَكِبَتْ: rakibat — she rode, mounted (rakiba, to ride; perf. 3 f. sg.)
تَطْلَعُ: taṭlaʿu — she goes up, goes out to (ṭalaʿa; imperf. 3 f. sg., indicative; takes سُوق directly as its goal)
سُوقٍ: sūq — market (m./f., gen., indefinite second term of the iḍāfa); 'market'
التَّفْتِيشِ: الـ + تَفْتِيش — taftīsh, searching, inquiry (m. verbal noun of form II, gen. in the iḍāfa); 'the searching'
قَدْأَتَى: قَدْ + أَتَى — qad, 'had' (before the perfect, marks the action as done) + atā, he came (perf. 3 m. sg., root ʾ-t-y); printed as one word; 'he had come'
بِأُمِّهِ: بِـ + أُمّ + ـهِ — bi-, with (the prep. that atā takes for 'bring': atā bi- 'come with, bring') + umm, mother (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his mother'
وَأُخْتِهِ: وَ + أُخْت + ـهِ — wa-, and + ukht, sister (f., gen. after the bi- that governs the pair) + -hi, his; 'and his sister'
فِتْنَةَ: Fitna, a name (f.), lit. 'temptation, enchantment'; in apposition to the sister, acc. (diptote)
سَيِّدَةَ: سَيِّدَة — sayyida, lady, mistress (f.; acc. as vocative first term of an iḍāfa); 'O mistress of'
الْمُحْسِنَاتِ: الـ + مُحْسِنَات — al-, the + muḥsināt, women who do good (f. sound pl. act. part. of IV aḥsana; gen. as second term of iḍāfa); 'the benefactresses'
إِمْرَأَةٌ: imraʾa, woman (f., nom. indef., subject of dakhala); 'a woman'
وَبِنْتُهَا: وَ + بِنْت + هَا — wa-, and + bint, daughter (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her daughter'
وُجُوهٌ: wujūh, faces (pl. of wajh, m., nom. indef., predicate)
وَعَلَيْهِمَا: وَ + عَلَى + هِمَا — wa-, and + ʿalā, upon (prep.; the 'ʿalā' takes ya- before a pronoun) + -humā, them both; 'and upon them'
وَالسَّعَادَةِ: وَ + الـ + سَعَادَة — wa-, and + al-, the + saʿāda, happiness, felicity (f., gen., coordinated); 'and the happiness'
لَائِحَةٌ: lāʾiḥa, showing, plainly visible (f. act. part. of lāḥa 'to appear'; nom. indef., predicate); 'manifest'
لَكِنَّهُمَا: لَكِنَّ + هُمَا — lākinna, but, yet (particle; takes accusative) + -humā, they both; 'but they'
لَابِسَتَانِ: lābisatān, wearing (f. dual nom. act. part. of labisa, root l-b-s); 'wearing'
الشَّعَرِ: الـ + شَعَر — al-, the + shaʿar, hair, hair-cloth (m., gen. after min); 'the hair'
مُعَلِّقَةٌ: muʿallaqa, hung, suspended (f. pass. part. of II ʿallaqa; nom. indef., predicate); 'hung'
مِخْلَاةٌ: mikhlāh, wallet, bag (properly a nose-bag; f., nom. indef., subject of the clause); 'a wallet'
وَعُيُونُهُمَا: وَ + عُيُون + هُمَا — wa-, and + ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, f., nom.) + -humā, their (dual); 'and their eyes'
بَاكِيَةٌ: bākiya, weeping (f. act. part. of bakā; nom. indef., predicate)
وَقُلُوبُهُمَا: وَ + قُلُوب + هُمَا — wa-, and + qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb, m., nom.) + -humā, their (dual); 'and their hearts'
حَزِينَةٌ: ḥazīna, sad, sorrowful (f. of ḥazīn; nom. indef., predicate)
لِتَأْوِيهِمَا: لِـ + تَأْوِي + هِمَا — li-, so that (introduces a purpose clause, takes the subjunctive) + taʾwī, you (f.) shelter (subj. 2 f. sg. of awā, root ʾ-w-y; the ī is the f. ending) + -himā, them both; 'that you may shelter them'
وَتَصُونِيهِمَا: وَ + تَصُونِي + هِمَا — wa-, and + taṣūnī, you (f.) guard (subj. 2 f. sg. of ṣāna, root ṣ-w-n; continues the li- purpose clause) + -himā, them both; 'and keep them'
الشَّحَاذَةِ: الـ + شَحَاذَة — al-, the + shaḥādha, begging, mendicancy (f., gen. after ʿan); 'begging'
لَيْسَتَا: laysatā, they both are not (neg. verb 'to be', 3 f. dual; takes accusative predicate)
لِلشَّحَاذَةِ: لِـ + الـ + شَحَاذَة — li-, for (prep. of fitness, 'worthy for') + al-, the + shaḥādha, begging (f., gen.); 'for begging'
وَإِنَّنَا: وَ + إِنَّ + نَا — wa-, and + inna, indeed (particle) + -nā, we (attached subject pron. in the accusative); 'and indeed we'
شَوَّقْتَنِي: شَوَّقْ + تَ + نِي — shawwaqa, to make long for, whet the desire of (II, root sh-w-q; perf. 2 m. sg. -ta, you) + -nī, me; 'you have made me long'
يُدْخِلَهُمَا: يُدْخِلَ + هُمَا — yudkhila, he bring in, admit (subj. 3 m. sg. of IV adkhala, root d-kh-l, after an) + -humā, them both; 'that he bring them in'
نَظَرَتْهُمَا: نَظَرَتْ + هُمَا — naẓarat, she looked at (perf. 3 f. sg. of naẓara, root n-ẓ-r) + -humā, them both (direct object); 'she looked at them'
ذَاتَا: dhātā, possessors of (f. dual nom. of dhāt, 'owner of', first term of iḍāfa); 'possessing'
جَمَالٍ: jamāl, beauty (m., gen. indef., second term of iḍāfa)
أَوْلَادُ: awlād, children, sons (pl. of walad, m., nom., predicate, first term of iḍāfa); 'children of'
نِعْمَةٍ: niʿma, favour, ease, comfort (f., gen. indef., second term of iḍāfa); 'of comfort'
وَيَلُوحُ: وَ + يَلُوحُ — wa-, and + yalūḥu, it shows, appears (impf. 3 m. sg. of lāḥa, root l-w-ḥ); 'and there shows'
الْغِنَى: الـ + غِنَى — al-, the + ghinā, wealth, riches (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'the wealth'
نُحِبُّ: nuḥibbu, we love (impf. 1st pl. of IV aḥabba, root ḥ-b-b)
الثَّوَابِ: الـ + ثَوَاب — al-, the + thawāb, reward (from God; m., gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'the reward'
الظَّلَمَةُ: الـ + ظَلَمَة — al-, the + ẓalama, oppressors, tyrants (pl. of ẓālim, m., nom., subject); 'the oppressors'
وَسَلَبُوا: وَ + سَلَبُوا — wa-, and + salabū, they stripped, plundered (perf. 3 m. pl. of salaba, root s-l-b); 'and they stripped'
نِعْمَتَهُمَا: نِعْمَة + هُمَا — niʿma, favour, comfort (f., acc. object) + -humā, their (dual); 'their comfort'
وَأَخْرَبُوا: وَ + أَخْرَبُوا — wa-, and + akhrabū, they laid waste (perf. 3 m. pl. of IV akhraba, root kh-r-b); 'and they ruined'
دِيَارَهُمَا: دِيَار + هُمَا — diyār, dwellings, homes (pl. of dār, f., acc. object) + -humā, their (dual); 'their homes'
بَكَتَابُكَاءً: بَكَتَا + بُكَاءً — bakatā, they both wept (perf. 3 f. dual, root b-k-y) + bukāʾ, weeping (m., acc. indef., cognate object, adds intensity); printed as one word; 'they wept a weeping'
وَافْتَكَرَتَا: وَ + افْتَكَرَتَا — wa-, and + iftakaratā, they both recalled, called to mind (perf. 3 f. dual of VIII iftakara, root f-k-r); 'and they recalled'
بَقَتَافِيهِ: بَقَتَا + فِيهِ — baqatā, they both became (perf. 3 f. dual; colloquial baqā 'to become', root b-q-y; the print drops the yāʾ) + fīhi, in it; printed as one word; 'they had become in it'
وَالْحُزْنِ: وَ + الـ + حُزْن — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥuzn, grief, sorrow (m., gen., coordinated); 'and the grief'
وَتَفَكَّرَتَا: وَ + تَفَكَّرَتَا — wa-, and + tafakkaratā, they both pondered, thought of (perf. 3 f. dual of V tafakkara, root f-k-r); 'and they thought of'
بَكَتَا: bakatā, they both wept (perf. 3 f. dual, root b-k-y)
لِبُكَائِهِمَا: لِـ + بُكَاء + هِمَا — li-, at, because of (prep. of cause) + bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen.) + -himā, their (dual); 'at their weeping'
نَسْأَلُ: nasʾalu, we ask (impf. 1st pl. of saʾala, root s-ʾ-l)
يَجْمَعَنَا: يَجْمَعَ + نَا — yajmaʿa, he gather, bring together (subj. 3 m. sg. of jamaʿa, root j-m-ʿ, after an) + -nā, us; 'that he bring us together'
نُرِيدُهُ: نُرِيدُ + هُ — nurīdu, we want (impf. 1st pl. of IV arāda, root r-w-d) + -hu, him; 'we want'
عَلِمَتْ: ʿalimat, she knew (perf. 3 f. sg., root ʿ-l-m)
مَعْشُوقِهَا: مَعْشُوق + هَا — maʿshūq, beloved (pass. part. of ʿashiqa, root ʿ-sh-q; m., gen., second term of iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her beloved'
أَخْتُهُ: أُخْت + هُ — ukht, sister (f., nom. predicate) + -hu, his; 'his sister'
سَعَادَتِكُمَا: سَعَادَة + كُمَا — saʿāda, happiness (f., gen.) + -kumā, your (dual); 'your happiness'
شَقَاوَتِكُمَا: شَقَاوَة + كُمَا — shaqāwa, wretchedness, misery (f., gen.) + -kumā, your (dual); 'your misery'
تَحْزَنَا: taḥzanā, you both grieve (jussive 2 dual of ḥazina, root ḥ-z-n, after lā)
الْمُــــــبَاحِ: الـ + مُبَاح — al-, the + mubāḥ, permitted, licit (pass. part. of IV abāḥa, root b-w-ḥ; m., gen. adj.); the stretched letters are the printer's tatweel; 'the permitted'
وَيُخَلِّيَ: وَ + يُخَلِّي — wa-, and + khallā (II), to let, leave (3rd m. sg. subjunctive, after an); 'and let'
تُدْخِلَهُمَا: تُدْخِل + هُمَا — adkhala (IV), to bring in (3rd f. sg. subjunctive, in a loose purpose clause) + -humā, them (dual); 'she bring them in'
وَتُلْبِسَهُمَا: وَ + تُلْبِس + هُمَا — wa-, and + albasa (IV), to clothe (3rd f. sg. subjunctive) + -humā, them (dual); 'and clothe them'
وَتَتَوَصَّي: وَ + تَتَوَصَّى — wa-, and + tawaṣṣā (V), to take care, charge oneself (3rd f. sg. subjunctive); the final letter is printed yāʾ; 'and take care'
وَتُكْرِمَهُمَا: وَ + تُكْرِم + هُمَا — wa-, and + akrama (IV), to honour (3rd f. sg. subjunctive) + -humā, them (dual); 'and honour them'
وَأَعْطَتْهُ: وَ + أَعْطَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + aʿṭā (IV), to give (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and she gave him' Also with -hu as the thing given and the recipient after li-: wa-aʿṭathu li-ʿAliyyi ibni Bakkārin, 'and she gave it to ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'.
وَشَكَرَتْ: وَ + شَكَرَتْ — wa-, and + shakara, to thank (3rd f. sg. perfect); 'and she thanked'
إِحْسَانَهَا: إِحْسَان + هَا — iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (m., verbal noun of IV); acc. object + -hā, her; 'her kindness'
وَقَدَا: وَ + قَد — wa-, and + qad (particle, 'had') with a stray alif, the first letter of the verb adkhalat, run into this word by a misplaced space; 'and had'
دَخَلَتْهُمَا: دَخَلَتْ + هُمَا — the rest of adkhalat (IV), to make enter, take in (3rd f. sg. perfect; its initial alif is attached to the preceding word) + -humā, them (dual); '(she) had taken them in'
وَغَيَّرَتْ: وَ + غَيَّرَتْ — wa-, and + ghayyara (II), to change (3rd f. sg. perfect); 'and she changed'
فَظَهَرَتْ: فَـ + ظَهَرَتْ — fa-, so (conj., result) + ẓahara, to appear (3rd f. sg. perfect); 'and so there appeared'
تُحَادِثُهُمَا: تُحَادِث + هُمَا — ḥādatha (III), to converse with (3rd f. sg. imperfect, circumstantial 'chatting') + -humā, them (dual); 'conversing with them'
سَأَلَتْ: سَأَلَتْ — saʾala, to ask (3rd f. sg. perfect; the hamza printed by the edition); 'she asked'
زَوْجَةَ: زَوْجَة — zawja, wife (f.); acc. object, first term of an iḍāfa; 'wife of'
بِحَالِهِ: بِـ + حَال + هِ — bi-, in (prep.; 'in a state of') + ḥāl, state, condition (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'in his state, as he was' Also after the elative adrā, 'more knowing', bi- marks what is known: adrā bi-ḥālihi, 'better acquainted with his state'.
نُطِلَّ: aṭalla (IV), to look in on (1st pl. subjunctive, purpose clause); 'let us look in'
وَنَعُودَهُ: وَ + نَعُود + هُ — wa-, and + ʿāda, to visit the sick (1st pl. subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'and visit him'
وَزَوْجَةُ: وَ + زَوْجَة — wa-, and + zawja, wife (f.); nom., first term of an iḍāfa; 'and the wife of'
وَأُمُّ: وَ + أُمّ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f.); nom., first term of an iḍāfa; 'and the mother of'
وَدَخَلْنَ: وَ + دَخَلْنَ — wa-, and + dakhala, to enter (3rd f. pl. perfect); 'and they entered'
وَجَلَسْنَ: وَ + جَلَسْنَ — wa-, and + jalasa, to sit (3rd f. pl. perfect); 'and they sat'
سَمِعَهُنَّ: سَمِعَ + هُنَّ — samiʿa, to hear (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'he heard them'
يَذْكُرْنَ: dhakara, to mention (3rd f. pl. imperfect); circumstantial clause, 'as they mentioned'
انْتَحَلَ: intaḥala (VIII), to waste away, grow lean (of the body; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'wasted'
عَظْمُهُ: عَظْم + هُ — ʿaẓm, bone (m.), nom. + -hu, his; 'his bone'
الْمِخَدَّةِ: الـ + مِخَدَّة — mikhadda, pillow, cushion (f.); gen., second term; 'the pillow'; here: gen. after ʿalā
