يَاقُوتَ: يَا + قُوت — yā, O (vocative particle) + Qūt, 'sustenance', first part of the name, acc. as vocative construct; 'O Qūt'
وَتَحَقَّقَتْهُ: وَ + تَحَقَّقَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + taḥaqqaqa (V), to make sure of, scrutinise (3rd f. sg. perfect, transitive) + -hu, him; 'and she scrutinised him'
فَعَرَفَتْهُ: فَـ + عَرَفَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and so she recognised him'
وَصَاحَتْ: وَ + صَاحَتْ — wa-, and + ṣāḥa, to cry out (3rd f. sg. perfect); 'and she cried out'
بِقَوْلِهَا: بِـ + قَوْل + هَا — bi-, with/by (prep.) + qawl, saying (m.) + -hā, her; 'by her saying'
اقْرَبِى: اقْرَبِ + ى — iqrab, come near (imp. f. sg. of qaruba) with printed final ى; 'come near, you (f.)'
أُخْتُهُ: أُخْت + هُ — ukht, sister (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his sister'
وَأُمُّهُ: وَ + أُمّ + هُ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his mother'
صَاحَتَا: صَاحَتَا — ṣāḥatā, they (two f.) cried out (ṣāḥa, to cry out)
بِقَوْلِهِمَا: بِـ + قَوْل + هِمَا — bi-, with (prep.) here introducing what they cried + qawl, saying + -himā, their (two); 'with their saying'
وَافَرْحَتَاهُ: وَا + فَرْحَة + ا + هُ — wā, O (exclamatory particle of lament/cry) + farḥa, joy (f.) + -ā, the lengthening of the cry + -hu, his; 'Oh, his joy!'
وَوَقَعَتَا: وَ + وَقَعَتَا — wa-, and + waqaʿatā, they (two f.) fell
اسْتَفَاقَتَا: اسْتَفَاقَتَا — istafāqatā, they (two f.) recovered, came to (form X of fāqa)
وَبِأُمِّكَ: وَ + بِـ + أُمّ + كَ — wa-, and + bi-, through (repeated) + umm, mother + -ka, your; 'and through your mother'
وَأُخْتِكَ: وَ + أُخْت + كَ — wa-, and + ukht, sister (gen., after the bi- carried over) + -ka, your; 'and your sister'
فَتَقَدَّمَتْ: فَـ + تَقَدَّمَتْ — fa-, and then + taqaddamat, she came forward (form V of qadama)
وَحَكَتْ: وَ + حَكَتْ — wa-, and + ḥakat, she related, told (ḥakā)
فَصَدَّقَ: فَـ + صَدَّقَ — fa-, so + ṣaddaqa, he believed (form II of ṣadaqa)
وَرَضِيَ: وَ + رَضِيَ — wa-, and + raḍiya, he was pleased (raḍiya, to be pleased)
يَتَمَنَّى: يَتَمَنَّى — yatamannā, he wishes, longs (form V of manā)
يَرَاكَ: يَرَا + كَ — yarā, he sees (subj. of raʾā) + -ka, you (m.); 'that he see you'
أَخْبَرَتْهُ: أَخْبَرَتْ + هُ — akhbarat, she informed (form IV of khabara) + -hu, him; 'she informed him'
وَهَبَنِي: وَهَبَ + نِي — wahaba, he gave (as a gift) + -nī, me; 'he gave me'
لَاتَبْرَحُوا: لَا + تَبْرَحُوا — lā, not (prohibition with the jussive) + tabraḥū, you (pl.) leave, depart (bariḥa); 'do not leave' (printed joined)
وَسَاعَتِهَا: وَ + سَاعَة + هَا — wa-, and + sāʿa, hour (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her hour'; with the previous word it means 'at once'
وَانْطَلَقَتْ: وَ + انْطَلَقَتْ — wa-, and + inṭalaqat, she set off (form VII of ṭalaqa)
كَوَامِلَ: kawāmil, complete (pl. of kāmila, diptote adjective in the acc.)
وَبِغَانِمٍ: وَ + بِـ + غَانِم — wa-, and + bi-, with (repeated) + Ghānim, Ghānim (gen., fully inflected); 'and with Ghānim'
بِغَسْلِهِمْ: بِـ + غَسْل + هِمْ — bi-, with/for (prep.; amara takes bi- for the thing ordered) + ghasl, washing (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'ordered their washing'
الْخُولَنْجَانِ: الـ + خُولَنْجَان — khūlanjān, galangal (a medicinal root; gen.); 'the galangal'
بَعْدَأَنْ: بَعْدَ + أَنْ — baʿda, after (prep./conj.) + an, that; printed as one word; 'after that'
وَأَقَامَتْ: و + أَقَامَتْ — aqāma, to stay, reside (IV, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she stayed'
تُطْعِمُهُمْ: تُطْعِمُ + هُمْ — aṭʿama, to feed (IV, 3 f. sg. imperfect) + them; 'she was feeding them'
وَالْمَسَالِيقَ: و + الـ + مَسَالِيق — masālīq, boiled meats, broths (acc.); 'and the boiled meats'
وَتَسْقِيهِمُ: و + تَسْقِي + هِمُ — saqā, to give to drink (3 f. sg. imperfect) + them (vowel before الـ); 'and she gave them to drink'
الْمُكَرَّرَ: الـ + مُكَرَّر — mukarrar, refined (passive participle of II; acc., adjective); 'the refined'
أَرْوَاحُهُمْ: أَرْوَاح + هُمْ — arwāḥ, spirits (pl. of rūḥ; nom.) + their; 'their spirits'
فَأَدْخَلَتْهُمُ: فَـ + أَدْخَلَتْ + هُمُ — fa-, then + adkhala, to make enter, take in (IV, 3 f. sg. perfect) + them (vowel before الـ); 'then she took them in'
وَخَلَّتْهُمْ: و + خَلَّتْ + هُمْ — khallā, to leave, let be (II, 3 f. sg. perfect) + them; 'and she left them'
فَاسْتَأْذَنَتِ: فَـ + اسْتَأْذَنَتِ — fa-, then + istaʾdhana, to ask leave of (X, 3 f. sg. perfect; kasra before الـ); 'and she asked leave of'
وَأَعْلَمَتْهُ: و + أَعْلَمَتْ + هُ — aʿlama, to inform (IV, 3 f. sg. perfect) + him; 'and she informed him'
سَيِّدُهَا: سَيِّد + هَا — sayyid, master (m.; nom.) + her; 'her master'
حَضَرَتَا: حَضَرَ + تَا — ḥaḍara, to arrive (3 f. dual perfect); 'they (two women) have arrived'
لِلْخُدَّامِ: لِـ + الـ + خُدَّام — li-, to (prep.; marks the one addressed) + khuddām, servants, attendants (pl.); 'to the servants'
بِغَانِمٍ: بِـ + غَانِم — bi-, with (prep.; here the elliptical command 'bring ... !') + Ghānim; 'Ghānim!'
سَبَقَتْهُ: سَبَقَتْ + هُ — sabaqa, to precede, go ahead of (3 f. sg. perfect) + him; 'preceded him'
فَأَوْصَتْهُ: فَـ + أَوْصَتْ + هُ — fa-, so + awṣā, to charge, enjoin (IV, 3 f. sg. perfect) + him; 'so she charged him'
بِفَصَاحَةِ: بِـ + فَصَاحَة — bi-, with (prep.; with أَوْصَى 'charge someone with') + faṣāḥa, eloquence (f.; gen., first term of construct); 'with eloquence of'
وَتَثْبِيتِ: و + تَثْبِيت — tathbīt, steadying, making firm (verbal noun of II; gen., first term of construct); 'and steadying of'
جَنَانِهِ: جَنَان + هِ — janān, heart (m.; gen.) + his; 'his heart'
وَعُذُوبَةِ: و + عُذُوبَة — ʿudhūba, sweetness (f.; gen., first term of construct); 'and sweetness of'
حُلَّةً: حُلَّة — ḥulla, robe, suit of clothes (f.; acc. tanwīn, second object); 'a robe'
كَثِّرِ: كَثِّرْ — kaththara, to multiply, increase (II, imperative; kasra before الـ); 'multiply!'
الْبَذْلَ: الـ + بَذْل — badhl, giving, bounty (verbal noun; acc. object); 'the giving'
دَاخِلٌ: دَاخِل — dākhil, entering (active participle; nom. tanwīn, predicate of أَنْتَ); 'entering'
النُّوبِيَّةِ: الـ + نُوبِيَّة — nūbiyya, Nubian (f. adjective; gen.); 'the Nubian'
وَقَابَلَهُ: و + قَابَلَ + هُ — qābala, to meet, face (III, 3 m. sg. perfect) + him; 'and he met him'
كَوْكَبُ: كَوْكَب — kawkab, star (m.; nom., first term of construct); 'star of'
سَعْدِهِ: سَعْد + هِ — saʿd, felicity, good fortune (gen.) + his; 'his good fortune'
وَأَضَاءَ: و + أَضَاءَ — aḍāʾa, to shine (IV, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'and shone'
وَمَازَالَا: و + مَا + زَالَا — wa-, and + mā, not (negative) + zāla, to cease (3 m. dual perfect), printed as one word; مَا زَالَ 'they ceased not' = 'they kept on'
دَخَلَا: دَخَلَا — dakhala, to enter (3 m. dual perfect); 'the two entered'
الصَّوْلَةِ: الـ + صَوْلَة — ṣawla, onslaught, might, power (f.); 'the might'
وَفَصَاحَتَهُ: و + فَصَاحَة + هُ — wa-, and; faṣāḥa, eloquence (f.); -hu, his; 'and his eloquence'
حُبِيتَ: حُبِيتَ — ḥubīta, passive perf. 2 m.s. of ḥabā, to give, favour with; 'you were favoured'
عَظِيمِ: عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great (adj.); 'great' (first term of construct)
الشَّانِ: الـ + شَأْن — shaʾn, standing, rank, affair (m.); 'the standing'; printed شَانِ without hamza
مُتَتَابِعِ: مُتَتَابِع — mutatābiʿ, successive, following one after another (part. of form VI); 'successive in'
الْحَسَنَاتِ: الـ + حَسَنَات — ḥasanāt, good deeds (f. pl.); 'the good deeds'
وَالْاِحْسَانِ: و + الـ + إِحْسَان — wa-, and; iḥsān, beneficence, kindness (m.); 'and the beneficence'; the print has plain alif with kasra
يُلْهَجُونَ: يُلْهَجُونَ — yulhajūna, passive imperf. 3 m.pl. of lahija, to be devoted to, to chatter of (form IV/I, uncertain); 'they are made devoted'
قَيْصَرٍ: قَيْصَر — Qayṣar, Caesar, the Byzantine emperor; 'Caesar'
ذَاالْمَقَامِ: ذَا + الْمَقَامِ — dhā, this (m. demonstrative, written joined to the next word); al- + maqām, station, standing place (m.); 'this station'
وَصَاحِبِ: و + صَاحِب — wa-, and; ṣāḥib, master, owner, lord (m.); 'and lord of'
الْاِيوَانِ: الـ + إِيوَان — īwān, vaulted hall; the Īwān of Ctesiphon, the Persian royal seat (m.); 'the Īwān'; the print has plain alif with kasra
تَضَعُ: تَضَعُ — taḍaʿu, imperf. 3 f.s. of waḍaʿa, to put, lay down; 'lays'
الْمُلُوكُ: الـ + مُلُوك — mulūk, kings (pl. of malik); 'the kings' (nom.)
ثَرَى: ثَرَى — tharā, damp earth, dust (m.); 'dust of'
اَعْتَابِهِ: أَعْتَاب + هِ — aʿtāb, thresholds (pl. of ʿataba); -hi, his; 'his thresholds'
عِنْدَالسَّلَامِ: عِنْدَ + السَّلَامِ — ʿinda, at, when (prep.); al- + salām, greeting, salutation (m.); 'at the greeting', written joined
جَوَاهِرُ: جَوَاهِر — jawāhir, jewels (pl. of jawhar); 'jewels of' (printed with nom. ending)
التِّيجَانِ: الـ + تِيجَان — tījān, crowns (pl. of tāj); 'the crowns'
بَصُرَتْ: بَصُرَتْ — baṣurat, to see, perceive (perf. 3 f.s., agreeing with a plural non-human subject); 'saw'
اَبْصَارُهُمْ: أَبْصَار + هُمْ — abṣār, eyes, sight (pl. of baṣar); -hum, their; 'their eyes'
خَرُّوا: خَرُّوا — kharrū, to fall down (perf. 3 m.pl.); 'they fell'
لِهَيْبَتِهِ: لِـ + هَيْبَة + هِ — li-, for, because of (prep., marks the cause); haybat, awe, dread (f.); -hi, his; 'for awe of him'
الْاَذْقَانِ: الـ + أَذْقَان — adhqān, chins (pl. of dhaqan); 'the chins'; the print has plain alif with fatḥa
وَيُفِيدُهُمْ: و + يُفِيدُ + هُمْ — wa-, and; yufīdu, imperf. 3 m.s. of afāda, to bestow, benefit; -hum, them; 'and it bestows on them'
ذَالَ: ذَالَ — dhāla, that (m. demonstrative), printed for ذَلِكَ or ذَاكَ; 'that'
الرِّضَى: الـ + رِضَى — riḍā, favour, contentment (m.); 'the favour' (printed with ى)
رُتَبَ: رُتَب — rutab, ranks, degrees (pl. of rutba); 'ranks of'
وَجَلَالَةَ: و + جَلَالَة — wa-, and; jalāla, majesty (f.); 'and majesty of'
بِعَسْكَرِكَ: بِـ + عَسْكَر + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; ضَاقَ بِـ means 'be too narrow for, be cramped by'); ʿaskar, army (m.); -ka, your; 'for your army'
الْفَيَافِي: الـ + فَيَافِي — fayāfī, deserts, wastelands (pl. of fayfā); 'the deserts'
وَالْوَرَى: و + الـ + وَرَى — wa-, and; warā, creation, mankind (m.); 'and mankind'
خِيَامَكَ: خِيَام + كَ — khiyām, tents (pl. of khayma); -ka, your; 'your tents'
ذُرَى: ذُرَى — dhurā, peaks, summits (pl. of dhirwa); 'peaks of'
اَبْقَاكَ: أَبْقَاكَ — abqā-ka, form IV perf. of baqiya, to keep, preserve; -ka, you; 'may he preserve you' (optative)
لِيكَ: لِيكَ — līka, printed fragment of مالك; read together with مَا as 'master of'
بِعَنْوَةٍ: بِـ + عَنْوَة — bi-, by, with (prep.; manner); ʿanwa, force, submission (f.); 'by force', obscure here
تَدْبِيرٍ: تَدْبِير — tadbīr, management, ordering of affairs (m.); 'management'
وَثَبْتُ: و + ثَبْت — wa-, and; thabt, steadiness, firmness (m.); 'and steadiness of'
وَنَشَرْتَ: و + نَشَرْتَ — wa-, and; nasharta, to spread out (perf. 2 m.s.); 'and you spread'
عَدْلَكَ: عَدْل + كَ — ʿadl, justice (m.); -ka, your; 'your justice'
الْبَسِيطَةِ: الـ + بَسِيطَة — basīṭa, the broad earth (f.); 'the earth'
الْقَاصِي: الـ + قَاصِي — qāṣī, far, distant (active part.); 'the far'
وَالدَّانِي: و + الـ + دَانِي — wa-, and; dānī, near (active part.); 'and the near'
وَأَعْجَبَهُ: و + أَعْجَبَ + هُ — wa-, and; aʿjaba, form IV perf., to please, delight; -hu, him; 'and it pleased him'
وَعُذُوبَةُ: و + عُذُوبَة — wa-, and; ʿudhūba, sweetness (f.); 'and sweetness of' (construct, nom.)
مَنْطِقِهِ: مَنْطِق + هِ — manṭiq, speech, utterance (m.); -hi, his; 'his speech'
وَوَلَدِهِ: وَ + وَلَد + ـهِ — wa-, and (conj.) + walad, son, child (m., gen., coordinated with ḥikāya) + 3ms possessive; 'and of his son'
الْعَجَائِبِ: الـ + عَجَائِب — ʿajāʾib, wonders (pl. of ʿajība, f., diptote, gen. after min; hamza printed by the edition); 'the wonders'
تَصَرُّفَاتِ: taṣarrufāt — turnings, workings, vicissitudes (f. sound pl. of taṣarruf, gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the turnings of'
وَكِتَابُ: وَ + كِتَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + kitāb, contract (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the contract of'
كِتَابُ: kitāb — document, contract (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the contract of'
وَالْعَطَايَاتِ: وَ + الـ + عَطَايَات — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaṭiyya, gift, grant (f., pl. ʿaṭāyā with added sound plural ending, gen.); 'and the gifts'
يُفْرَدَ: yufrada — to set apart (verb IV, passive subjunctive 3ms, from أَفْرَدَ); 'be set apart'
وَأَخْذِ: وَ + أَخْذ — wa-, and (conj., continuing the bi- of 'of what befell') + akhdh, taking (m., verbal noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and of the taking of'; here: continuing li- of li-halākī, 'a cause for my ruin and for the taking of'
وَحَدَّثَ: وَ + حَدَّثَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaddatha, to relate, tell (verb II, perf. 3ms; the matter told takes بِـ); 'and he related'
اُدْنُ: udnu — draw near, come close (verb I, imperative 2ms, from دَنَا; initial alif of connection)
يُخَلَّدَ: yukhallada — to make eternal, preserve (verb II, passive subjunctive 3ms, from خَلَّدَ); 'be preserved'
يُؤَرَّخَ: yuʾarrakha — to date, record in a chronicle (verb II, passive subjunctive 3ms, from أَرَّخَ; hamza supplied by us); 'be chronicled'
وَالْغَرَائِبِ: وَ + الـ + غَرَائِب — wa-, and (conj.) + gharāʾib, strange things, marvels (pl. of gharība, f., diptote, gen.; hamza printed by the edition); 'and the marvels'
الْجَوَامِكِ: الـ + جَوَامِك — jawāmik, stipends, regular pay (pl. of jāmakiyya, gen. after min); 'the stipends'
يَدَاهُ: يَدَا + هُ — yad, hand (f., dual nom., the nūn dropped before the pronoun) + 3ms possessive; 'his two hands'
فِتْنَةٌ: fitna — temptation, enchantment, trial; source of strife (f., nom., predicate); 'a temptation'
عُمَرَ: ʿUmar — personal name (diptote, gen. with fatḥa)
خَالِقِ: khāliq — creator (act. part. of khalaqa, m., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the creator of'
وَبِنِيَامِهِ: وَ + بِـ + نِيَام + ـهِ — wa-, and (conj.) + bi-, of, about (prep., continuing the bi- of 'of what befell') + niyām, sleep, sleeping (m., verbal noun used for Classical nawm, gen.) + 3ms; 'and of his sleeping'
مَلَكَتْ: malaka, to own, possess (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with يَدَاهُ); 'owned'
ذَهَبُوا: dhahaba, to go away (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they went'
فَأَبْرَأَ: فَـ + أَبْرَأَ — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + abraʾa, to clear, release (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and so he cleared'
آخِرَةِ: ākhira — end (f.-spelled; printed with tāʾ marbūṭa where آخِرِهِ, 'its end', is meant; gen. after ilā); 'its end'
أَبْرِئْ: abriʾ — to clear, acquit, release (verb IV, imperative 2ms); with dhimma, 'clear (my account)'
بِأُخْتِهِ: بِـ + أُخْت + ـهِ — bi-, of, about (prep.; with samiʿa, 'hear of') + ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3ms possessive; 'of his sister'
يَقْرَأَهُ: يَقْرَأَ + هُ — yaqraʾa, to read (verb I, subjunctive 3ms, after ḥattā) + 3ms object; 'reads it'
ذِمَّتَهُ: ذِمَّة + ـهُ — dhimma, obligation, liability (f., acc. as object) + 3ms possessive; 'his liability'
وَنَظْمُهُ: وَ + نَظْم + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + naẓm, ordering, composition, fine phrasing (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'and his fine phrasing'
وَيُفَوِّضَ: وَ + يُفَوِّضَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yufawwiḍa, to entrust, commit (verb II, subjunctive 3ms; takes ilā for the one entrusted to); 'and commit'
فَدَنَا: فَـ + دَنَا — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + danā, to draw near (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he drew near'
قْدَارِ: qdār — second half of الأَقْدَار (al-aqdār), pl. of qadar, decree, fate (m., gen.), split off by a space in the print; 'the decrees'
الْكِتَابَيْنِ: الـ + كِتَاب — kitāb, document, contract (m., dual acc.); 'the two contracts'
فَخَطَبَهَا: فَـ + خَطَبَ + هَا — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + khaṭaba, to ask in marriage, woo (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and he asked for her hand'
صَادِقٌ: ṣādiq — truthful, honest (act. part. of ṣadaqa, m., nom.); 'truthful'
شَرْكَانَ: Sharrukān — personal name (diptote: gen. with fatḥa; also acc., e.g. after anna or inna, or in apposition to an accusative)
فَقَعَدَ: فَـ + قَعَدَ — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + qaʿada, to sit (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he sat'
وَأُمَّهُ: وَ + أُمّ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + umm, mother (f., acc. as object) + 3ms possessive; 'and his mother'
فَيَتَعَجَّبَ: فَـ + يَتَعَجَّبَ — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + yataʿajjaba, to marvel, wonder (verb V, subjunctive 3ms, continuing ḥattā); 'and so marvel'
فَصَاحَتُهُ: فَصَاحَة + ـهُ — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., nom., subject of أَعْجَبَ) + 3ms possessive; 'his eloquence'
وَأَطْلِعْنِي: وَ + أَطْلِعْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭliʿ, to inform, acquaint (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; 'and acquaint me'
أُخْتَهُ: أُخْت + ـهُ — ukht, sister (f., acc. as object) + 3ms possessive; 'his sister'
لِسَيِّدِهِ: لِـ + سَيِّد + ـهِ — li-, to, for (prep.; here it marks ownership, 'belong to') + sayyid, master, lord (m., gen.) + 3ms possessive; 'to his master, belonging to his master'
نَقَلَهُ: نَقَلَ + هُ — naqala, to move, transfer (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he moved him'
تِي: tī — second half of يَأْتِي (yaʾtī), 'comes', split off by a space in the print
حِكَايَتُهُمْ: حِكَايَة + ـهُمْ — ḥikāya, tale, story (f., nom.) + 3mp 'their'; 'their story'
بِمَدِينَةِ: بِـ + مَدِينَة — madīna, city (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); bi-, in, at (prep.); 'in the city of'
خِلَافَةِ: khilāfa — caliphate, succession (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the caliphate of'
عَبْدِ: ʿabd — servant (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa), in the name ʿAbd al-Malik; 'ʿAbd'
الْجَبَابِرَةِ: الـ + جَبَابِرَة — jabbār, tyrant, mighty one (m. broken pl., gen. after min); 'the tyrants, the mighty'
قَهَرَ: qahara — to overpower, subdue (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he subdued'
كَاسِرَةَ: kāsira — the remainder of akāsira, Khosroes, Sasanian emperors (pl. of kisrā, acc.); read with the preceding fragment, 'the Chosroes'
وَالْقَيَاصِرَةَ: و + الـ + قَيَاصِرَة — qayāṣira, Caesars, Byzantine emperors (pl. of qayṣar, acc.); 'and the Caesars'
يُصْطَلَى: iṣṭalā — to warm oneself at a fire; to face a fire (verb VIII, passive imperf. 3ms, here 'be faced'); 'is [not] approached'
يُجَارِيهِ: jārā — to run alongside, rival (verb III, imperf. 3ms) + ـهِ 'him'; 'rivals him'
مِضْمَارٍ: miḍmār — racecourse, arena (m., gen. indef.); 'a racecourse'
مَنْخِرَيْهِ: مَنْخِر + ـهِ — minkhar, nostril (m. dual, gen., ـَيْـ dual oblique) + 3ms 'his'; 'his two nostrils'
الْأَقْطَارِ: الـ + أَقْطَار — aqṭār, regions, countries (m. broken pl. of quṭr, gen.); 'the regions'
وَأَطَاعَ: و + ا^َطَاعَ — wa-, and; aṭāʿa, to make obey, make submit (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and made submissive'
نَفَذَ: nafadha — to pass, take effect (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'took effect'
الْأَمْصَارِ: الـ + ا^َمْصَار — amṣār, cities (m. broken pl. of miṣr, gen.); 'the cities'
وَوَصَلَتْ: و + وَصَلَتْ — wa-, and; waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and [they] arrived'
عَسَاكِرُهُ: عَسَاكِر + ـهُ — ʿasākir, armies (f./m. broken pl. of ʿaskar, nom.) + 3ms 'his'; 'his armies'
الْمَشْرِقُ: الـ + مَشْرِق — mashriq, east, the Orient (m., nom.); 'the East'
وَالْمَغْرِبُ: و + الـ + مَغْرِب — maghrib, west (m., nom.); 'and the West'
وَالسِّنْدِ: و + الـ + سِنْد — Sind, the Indus country (gen.); 'and Sind'
وَأَرْضِ: و + ا^َرْض — wa-, and; arḍ, land, country (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the land of'
الْحِجَازِ: الـ + حِجَاز — Ḥijāz, the western Arabian province (gen.); 'the Hijaz'
وَبِلَادِ: و + بِلَاد — wa-, and; bilād, lands (pl. of balad, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the lands of'
وَجَزائِرِ: و + جَزَائِر — wa-, and; jazāʾir, islands (broken pl. of jazīra, gen., first term of an iḍāfa; the edition prints ئ precomposed); 'and the islands of'
بَكْرٍ: Bakr — personal/tribal name (gen.); in Diyār Bakr, the upper Mesopotamian province of the Banū Bakr; 'Bakr'
الْبِحَارِ: الـ + بِحَار — biḥār, seas (m. broken pl. of baḥr, gen.); 'the seas'
مَشَاهِيرِ: mashāhīr — famous ones (broken pl. of mashhūr, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the famous'
الْأَنْهَارِ: الـ + ا^َنْهَار — anhār, rivers (m. broken pl. of nahr, gen.); 'the rivers'
كَسَيْحُونَ: كَـ + سَيْحُون — ka-, like, such as (prep.); Sayḥūn, the Syr Darya/Jaxartes (gen.); 'like the Sayhun'
وَجَيْحُونَ: و + جَيْحُون — wa-, and; Jayḥūn, the Oxus/Amu Darya (gen.); 'and the Jayhun'
وَالنِّيلِ: و + الـ + نِيل — Nīl, the Nile (gen.); 'and the Nile'
وَالْفُرَاتِ: و + الـ + فُرَات — Furāt, the Euphrates (gen.); 'and the Euphrates'
رُسُلَهُ: رُسُل + ـهُ — rusul, messengers (m. broken pl. of rasūl, acc.) + 3ms 'his'; 'his messengers'
الْمَدائِنِ: الـ + مَدَائِن — madāʾin, cities (f. broken pl. of madīna, gen.; the edition prints ئ precomposed); 'the cities'
أَيأْتُوهُ: ا^َ + يَأْتُوهُ — a-, an initial alif, probably a slip for li- or an, 'so that' (uncertain); yaʾtū, to come, bring (verb I, subj. 3mp) + ـهُ 'him'; 'that they bring him'
بِحَقِيقَةِ: بِـ + حَقِيقَة — ḥaqīqa, truth, reality (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); bi-, with (prep.; ayta/atā bi- 'bring'); 'with the truth of'; also aʿlama bi-, ‘inform of’: the verb chooses bi-; ‘of the truth of’ (Night 110) Also after akhbara, 'tell', bi- marks what is told: tukhbiranī bi-ḥaqīqati ḥālika, 'tell me the truth of your state'.
فَعَادُوالَهُ: فَـ + عَادُوا + لَـ + ـهُ — fa-, so, then (conj.); ʿāda, to return (verb I, perf. 3mp); la-/li-, to (prep.) + 3ms 'him'; printed as one word; 'so they returned to him'
وَالْأَمَانِ: و + الـ + ا^َمَان — amān, safety, security (m., gen.); 'and security'
وَعُمَرُ: و + عُمَرُ — wa-, and; ʿUmar, personal name (diptote, nom.); 'and ʿUmar'
نَسَبٌ: nasab — lineage, ancestry (m., nom. indef.); 'a lineage'
الشَّأنِ: الـ + شَا^ن — shaʾn, station, importance (m., gen.); 'the station' (ʿaẓīm al-shaʾn 'of great consequence')
تُحْمَلُ: ḥamala — to carry (verb I, passive imperf. 3fs); 'are carried'
الْهَدَايَا: الـ + هَدَايَا — hadāyā, gifts (f. broken pl. of hadiyya, nom.); 'the gifts'
وَالتُّحَفُ: و + الـ + تُحَف — tuḥaf, rarities, curios (f. broken pl. of tuḥfa, nom.); 'and the rarities'
وَالْخَرَاجُ: و + الـ + خَرَاج — kharāj, tribute, land-tax (m., nom.); 'and the tribute'
سَمَّاهُ: sammā — to name (verb II, perf. 3ms) + ـهُ 'him'; 'he named him'
آفَةً: āfa — calamity, bane (f., acc. indef., state/complement; the edition prints آ precomposed); 'a calamity'
آفَاتِ: āfāt — calamities (f. sound pl., gen.; the edition prints آ precomposed); 'the calamities of'
وَقَهَرَ: و + قَهَرَ — wa-, and; qahara, to subdue (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he subdued'
الشُّجْعَانَ: الـ + شُجْعَان — shujʿān, brave men (m. broken pl. of shujāʿ, acc.); 'the brave'
وَأَبَادَ: و + ا^َبَادَ — wa-, and; abāda, to destroy, wipe out (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and destroyed'
الْأَقْرَانَ: الـ + ا^َقْرَان — aqrān, peers, opponents (m. broken pl. of qirn, acc.); 'the peers, the rivals'
فَأَحَبَّهُ: فَـ + ا^َحَبَّ + ـهُ — fa-, so (conj.); aḥabba, to love (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms 'him'; 'so he loved him'
وَأَوْصَى: و + ا^َوْصَى — wa-, and; awṣā, to bequeath, appoint (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he bequeathed'
فَأَطَاعَ: فَـ + ا^َطَاعَ — fa-, so, and so (conj.); aṭāʿa, to make obey (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and so made submissive'
لِمَابِهِ: لِـ + مَا + بِـ + ـهِ — li-, because of (prep.); mā, what (rel. pron.); bi-, in (prep.) + 3ms 'him'; printed as one word; 'because of what was in him'
الْبَأسِ: الـ + بَا^س — baʾs, might, valour (m., gen.); 'might'
وَالْجِلَادِ: و + الـ + جِلَاد — jilād, fighting, combat (m., gen.); 'and combat'
بِالْكِتَابِ: بِـ + الـ + كِتَاب — bi-, by, according to (prep.); kitāb, book, the Book (m., gen.); 'by the Book'
وَالسُّنَّةِ: و + الـ + سُنَّة — sunna, custom, the way of the Prophet (f., gen.); 'and the Custom' (i.e. lawful marriage)
أَحَدِلَهُنَّ: ا^َحَد + لَـ + ـهُنَّ — aḥad, one (m., gen. after min) + li-, of/to (prep.) + 3fp 'them'; printed as one word, probably a slip for iḥdāhunna, 'one of them'; 'one of them'
وَالْبَاقِي: و + الـ + بَاقِي — bāqī, remaining (act. part. of baqiya, m., nom.); 'and the remainder'
عَوَاقِرُ: ʿawāqir — barren women (f. broken pl. of ʿāqir, nom. diptote); 'barren'
ثَلَٰثُمِائَةٍ: thalāth + miʾa — three hundred (thalāth 'three', first term, + miʾa 'hundred', gen.; dagger alif; the edition prints ئ precomposed); 'three hundred'
وَسِتُّونَ: و + سِتُّونَ — wa-, and; sittūn, sixty (nom. sound pl.); 'and sixty'
عَدَدِ: ʿadad — number (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the number of'
الْقِبْطِيَّةِ: الـ + قِبْطِيَّة — qibṭiyya, Coptic (adj., f., gen.); 'the Coptic'
السَّرَارِي: الـ + سَرَارِي — sarārī, concubines (f. broken pl. of surriyya, nom., ending -ī); 'the concubines'
الْأَجْنَاسِ: الـ + ا^َجْنَاس — ajnās, races, kinds (m. broken pl. of jins, gen.); 'the races'
بَنَى: banā — to build (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition prints ى); 'he built'
الْمَقَاصِيرُ: الـ + مَقَاصِير — maqāṣīr, chambers (f. broken pl. of maqṣūra, nom.); 'the chambers'
اِثْنَى: ithnay — two (as in ithnay ʿashar 'twelve'; the edition prints final ى); 'twelve (two-)'
شُهُورِ: shuhūr — months (m. broken pl. of shahr, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the months of'
جُمْلَةُ: jumla — sum, total (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the total of'
الْمَقَاصِيرِ: الـ + مَقَاصِير — maqāṣīr, chambers (f. pl., gen.); 'the chambers'
وَسِتِّينَ: و + سِتِّينَ — wa-, and; sittīn, sixty (oblique form, as printed, in a nominative predicate); 'and sixty'
وَأَسْكَنَ: و + ا^َسْكَنَ — wa-, and; askana, to lodge, settle (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he lodged'
تَالِكَ: tālika — that (demonstrative, f. sg.; the edition prints an extra alif for tilka); 'those'
وَفَرَضَ: و + فَرَضَ — wa-, and; faraḍa, to appoint, assign (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he assigned'
يَأتِيهَا: yaʾtī + ـهَا — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs 'her'; 'he comes to her'
الْآفَاقِ: الـ + آفَاق — āfāq, horizons, regions (m. broken pl. of ufq, gen.; the edition prints آ precomposed); 'the horizons'
قُوَّةً: quwwa — strength (f., acc. indef., specification); 'in strength'
فَطَغَى: فَـ + طَغَى — fa-, so (conj.); ṭaghā, to be insolent, rise in tyranny (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and so grew overbearing'
وَتَجَبَّرَ: و + تَجَبَّرَ — wa-, and; tajabbara, to act the tyrant (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and lorded it'
الْحُصُونَ: الـ + حُصُون — ḥuṣūn, fortresses (m. broken pl. of ḥiṣn, acc.); 'the fortresses'
وَالْبِلَادَ: و + الـ + بِلَاد — bilād, lands (acc.); 'and the lands'
حَمْلُهَا: حَمْل + ـهَا — ḥaml, pregnancy (m., nom.) + 3fs 'her'; 'her pregnancy'
ذُرِّيَّتِي: ذُرِّيَّة + ـي — dhurriyya, offspring (f., nom.) + 1s 'my'; 'my offspring'
وَنَسْلِي: و + نَسْل + ـي — wa-, and; nasl, progeny (m., nom.) + 1s 'my'; 'and my progeny'
ذُكُورًا: dhukūr — males (m. broken pl. of dhakar, acc. indef., predicate of takūna); 'males'
وَعَظُمَ: و + عَظُمَ — wa-, and; ʿaẓuma, to be great, grow heavy (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and grew heavy'
يُنَازِعُنِي: nāzaʿa — to contend with (verb III, imperf. 3ms) + ـنِي 'me'; 'will contend with me'
وَلَدَتْ: walada — to bear a child (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'bears'
الزَّغَارِيتَ: الـ + زَغَارِيت — zaghārīt, trilling cries of joy (pl. of zaghrūta; acc. object of aṭlaqū); 'the ululations'
السُّكَّرِ: الـ + سُكَّر — sukkar, sugar (m., gen. after min); 'the sugar' Also gen. as second term of iḍāfa: ghadīra al-sukkari, 'a pool of sugar'.
الطَّلْقُ: الـ + طَلْق — ṭalq, labour pains (m., nom. subject of jāʾa); 'the birth-pangs'
الْإِنْعَامِ: الـ + إِنْعَام — inʿām, bestowal of favour, bounty (verbal noun IV of anʿama; gen. after min); 'the bounty'
الْبَشَائِرُ: الـ + بَشَائِر — bashāʾir, glad tidings (pl. of bishāra), here the drums that announce them (nom. subject of the passive); 'the glad-tiding drums' Also the bearers of good news, or the gifts sent with it, as subject of an active verb: wa-aqbalati al-bashāʾiru, 'and the bearers of glad tidings came in'.
الْخَاصِّ: الـ + خَاصّ — khāṣṣ, special, particular (adj. used as noun; gen. after min); 'the special ones, the privileged'
الْخَلَاصَ: الـ + خَلَاص — khalāṣ, release, deliverance; here apparently what is released, the afterbirth (m., acc. object of ramat; uncertain); 'the release'
الْعِبَادَةَ: الـ + عِبَادَة — ʿibāda, worship, devotion (f., acc. object of tuḥsinu); 'the worship'
الْقَوَابِلُ: الـ + قَوَابِل — qawābil, midwives (pl. of qābila, f.; nom.); 'the midwives'
الْمَرَاضِعِ: الـ + مَرَاضِع — marāḍiʿ, wet-nurses (pl. of murḍiʿ; gen. after min); 'the wet-nurses'
الْمَوْلُودَ: الـ + مَوْلُود — mawlūd, newborn (pass. part. of walada; m., acc.); 'the newborn'
الْوِلَادَةِ: الـ + وِلَادَة — wilāda, childbirth (f., gen. second term of iḍāfa); 'the birthing'
انْحَنَى: انْحَنَى — inḥanā, to bend, stoop (VII, perf. 3ms; with ilā); 'he bent'
أَبْهَى: أَبْهَى — abhā, more splendid, brighter (elative of bahī; m., diptote, adj. of wajh); 'brighter'
أَجْمَلَ: أَجْمَلَ — ajmal, most beautiful (elative of jamīl; acc., predicate of kānat, first term of iḍāfa); 'most beautiful of'
أَخْبَرَهُ: أَخْبَرَ + ـهُ — akhbara, to inform (IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he informed him'
أَدَبِهِ: أَدَب + ـهِ — adab, training, discipline (m., gen. after fī) + 3ms; 'his training'
أَطْلَقُوا: أَطْلَقُوا — aṭlaqū, to let loose, set free (IV, perf. 3mp); 'they let loose'
أَمْهِلُوا: أَمْهِلُوا — amhilū, to grant respite (IV imper. 2mp of mahala; here with ʿalā, 'to me'); 'give respite'
أُحِسُّ: أُحِسُّ — uḥissu, to feel, perceive (IV of ḥassa, impf. 1s; with bi-); 'I feel'
أُحْسِنَ: أُحْسِنَ — uḥsina, to do well (IV, impf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā); 'that I do well'
إِكْرَامِهِمْ: إِكْرَام + ـهِمْ — ikrām, honouring (verbal noun IV of akrama; gen. after fī) + 3mp; 'their honouring'
إِلَهِ: إِلَه — ilāh, god (m., gen. first term of iḍāfa); 'god of'
بَاهِرٍ: بَاهِر — bāhir, dazzling, brilliant (act. part. of bahara; m., gen. with tanwīn, adj. of jamāl); 'dazzling'
بَعَثَهَا: بَعَثَ + ـهَا — baʿatha, to send (perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'he sent her'
بِأَحْشَائِي: بِـ + أَحْشَاء + ـِي — bi-, with, in (prep.; with aḥassa, 'feel in') + aḥshāʾ, innards, entrails (pl. of ḥashā; gen.) + 1s; 'in my innards'
تَأَوَّهَتْ: تَأَوَّهَتْ — taʾawwahat, to sigh, groan (V, perf. 3fs; the edition prints the shadda); 'she groaned'
تَخْدُمُ: تَخْدُمُ — takhdumu, to serve (root khadama, impf. 3fs); 'she serves'
تَضَعُهُ: تَضَعُ + ـهُ — taḍaʿu, to put down, bear a child (root waḍaʿa, impf. 3fs) + 3ms object; 'she bears it'
تُحَفًا: تُحَف — tuḥaf, rarities, choice gifts (pl. of tuḥfa; acc. with tanwīn); 'rarities'
رَزَقَ: رَزَقَ — razaqa, to provide, grant (perf. 3ms); 'he provided'
رُومِيَّةً: رُومِيَّة — rūmiyya, Roman, Byzantine (f. nisba adj.; acc. predicate of kānat); 'a Roman woman'
صَالِحٍ: صَالِح — ṣāliḥ, righteous, good (act. part. of ṣaluḥa; m., gen. with tanwīn); 'righteous'
صَفِيَّةَ: صَفِيَّة — Ṣafiyya, a proper name (f., acc. diptote; predicate of kāna)
صَفِيَّةُ: صَفِيَّة — Ṣafiyya, a proper name (f., nom.)
صَلَاحٍ: صَلَاح — ṣalāḥ, righteousness, piety (m., gen. with tanwīn after ʿalā); 'righteousness'
عِرْضًا: عِرْض — ʿirḍ, honour, good name (m., acc. with tanwīn, of respect); 'in honour'
فَامْتَثَلُوا: فَـ + امْتَثَلُوا — fa-, so (sequence) + imtathalū, to comply with, obey (VIII, perf. 3mp, direct object); 'so they complied with'
فَأَعْلَمْنَ: فَـ + أَعْلَمْنَ — fa-, so, then (sequence) + aʿlamna, to inform, announce (IV, perf. 3fp); 'so they announced'
فَتَّشَتْهُ: فَتَّشَتْ + ـهُ — fattashat, to search, examine closely (II, perf. 3fs; the answer to lammā) + 3ms object; 'she examined him' (the midwives)
فَحَسَدْنَهَا: فَـ + حَسَدْنَ + ـهَا — fa-, so + ḥasadna, to envy (perf. 3fp) + 3fs object; 'so they envied her'
فَزُيِّنَتِ: فَـ + زُيِّنَتِ — fa-, so (sequence) + zuyyinat, to be adorned (II passive perf. 3fs; kasra on the tā before the article); 'so it was adorned'
فَشَكَرَهُمُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + هُمُ — fa-, so (sequence) + shakara, to thank (perf. 3ms) + 3mp object; 'so he thanked them'
فَوَجَدْنَهُ: فَـ + وَجَدْنَ + ـهُ — fa-, so (sequence) + wajadna, to find (perf. 3fp) + 3ms object; 'so they found him'
فَيَفْرَجُ: فَـ + يَفْرَجُ — fa-, so (sequence) + yafraju, to be eased, relieved (impf. 3ms; printed with jīm, perhaps a slip for yafraḥu, 'rejoices'); 'so he is eased'
قَيْسَارِيَّةَ: قَيْسَارِيَّة — Qaysāriyya, Caesarea (f., gen. diptote, second term of iḍāfa)
كَمَلَتْ: كَمَلَتْ — kamalat, to be complete (perf. 3fs of kamala); 'it was complete'
لِلْقَوَابِلِ: لِـ + الـ + قَوَابِل — li-, to (prep.; with qāla, 'say to') + qābila, midwife (pl. qawābil; gen.); 'to the midwives'
مَبِيتِهِ: مَبِيت + ـهِ — mabīt, spending the night (verbal noun, m., gen. second term of iḍāfa) + 3ms; 'his spending the night'
مَوْلُودًا: مَوْلُود — mawlūd, newborn (m., acc. with tanwīn); 'a newborn'
مُوَرَّدٍ: مُوَرَّد — muwarrad, rose-tinted, rosy (pass. part. II of warrada; m., gen. with tanwīn); 'rose-tinted'
نُزْهَةِ: نُزْهَة — nuzha, delight, pleasure (f., gen. in apposition; first term of the name Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'delight of'
وَافِرٍ: وَافِر — wāfir, abundant, ample (act. part. of wafara; m., gen. with tanwīn); 'ample'
وَالدَّايَاتِ: وَ + الـ + دَايَات — wa-, and + dāya, nurse (pl. dāyāt; gen.); 'and the nurses'
وَالْأَدْهَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَدْهَان — wa-, and + adhān, oils (pl. of duhn; gen.); 'and the oils'
وَالْحَشَمُ: وَ + الـ + حَشَم — wa-, and + ḥasham, retinue, retainers (collective, nom.); 'and the retinue'
وَالْحَشَمِ: وَ + الـ + حَشَم — wa-, and + ḥasham, retinue, retainers (collective, gen.); 'and the retinue'
وَالْخَدَمُ: وَ + الـ + خَدَم — wa-, and + khadam, servants (collective, nom.); 'and the servants'
وَالْخُدَّامِ: وَ + الـ + خُدَّام — wa-, and + khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim; gen.); 'and the servants'
وَأَجَابُوا: وَ + أَجَابُوا — wa-, and + ajābū, to answer (IV, perf. 3mp; with bi-, 'answer with'); 'and they answered'
وَأَحْسَنَهُنَّ: وَ + أَحْسَن + هُنَّ — wa-, and + aḥsan, fairest (elative of ḥasan; acc.) + 3fp; 'and fairest of them'
وَأَصْوَنَهُنَّ: وَ + أَصْوَن + هُنَّ — wa-, and + aṣwan, most guarding, most careful of (elative of ṣāna; acc.) + 3fp; 'and most guarding of them'
وَأُبَالِغَ: وَ + أُبَالِغَ — wa-, and + ubāligha, to go to extremes, take great pains (III, impf. 1s subjunctive; with fī, 'in'); 'and that I take pains'
وَبَلَغَ: وَ + بَلَغَ — wa-, and + balagha, to reach (perf. 3ms); 'and it reached'
وَتَدْعُو: وَ + تَدْعُو — wa-, and + tadʿū, to call upon, pray to (root daʿā, impf. 3fs; direct object); 'and she calls upon'
وَتُحْسِنُ: وَ + تُحْسِنُ — wa-, and + tuḥsinu, to do well (IV, impf. 3fs); 'and she does well'
وَجَاءَهَا: وَ + جَاءَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + jāʾa, to come (perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and came to her'
وَجْهًا: وَجْه — wajh, face (m., acc. with tanwīn, of respect); 'in face'
وَدُقَّتِ: وَ + دُقَّتِ — wa-, and + duqqat, to be struck, beaten (passive perf. 3fs of daqqa; kasra on the tā before the article); 'and were beaten'
وَسَهَّلَ: وَ + سَهَّلَ — wa-, and + sahhala, to make easy (II, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'for'); 'and made easy'
وَصِيَانَتِهِ: وَ + صِيَانَة + ـهِ — wa-, and + ṣiyāna, protection, safeguarding (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'and his safeguarding'
وَصْفِهِ: وَصْف + ـهِ — waṣf, description (verbal noun, m., gen. after ʿan) + 3ms; 'its description'; also gen. after fī: aḥsanti fī waṣfihi, 'you did well in describing him' (Night 182)
وَكَّلَ: وَكَّلَ — wakkala, to appoint, entrust (II, perf. 3ms; with bi-, 'over'); 'he appointed'
وَيُسَهِّلَ: وَ + يُسَهِّلَ — wa-, and + yusahhila, to make easy (II, impf. 3ms subjunctive; with ʿalā, 'for'); 'and (that) he make easy'
وَيُعْجِبُهُ: وَ + يُعْجِبُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + yuʿjibu, to please (IV, impf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and pleases him'
وِلَادَتَهُ: وِلَادَة + ـهُ — wilāda, birth (f., acc. object of yusahhila) + 3ms; 'his birth'
يَخْدُمُهُمْ: يَخْدُمُ + هُمْ — yakhdumu, to serve (impf. 3ms) + 3mp object; 'who serve them'
يَرْزُقَكَ: يَرْزُقَ + ـكَ — yarzuqa, to provide (impf. 3ms subjunctive after an) + 2ms object; 'that he provide you'
يَرْزُقَهَا: يَرْزُقَ + ـهَا — yarzuqa, to provide (impf. 3ms subjunctive after bi-an) + 3fs object; 'that he provide her'
يَكِلُّ: يَكِلُّ — yakillu, to grow weary, become blunt (root kalla, impf. 3ms); 'grows weary'
يُخْبِرُهُ: يُخْبِرُ + ـهُ — yukhbiru, to inform (IV, impf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'informing him'
يُسَمُّوا: يُسَمُّوا — yusammū, to name (II, impf. 3mp subjunctive after an; two objects); 'that they name'
يُعَرِّفُهُ: يُعَرِّفُ + ـهُ — yuʿarrifu, to inform, make known (II, impf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'who informs him'
أَعْوَامٍ: aʿwām — years (m. broken pl. of ʿām, gen. after a numeral)
يُنْقَلَ: yunqala — to carry, transport (verb I, impf. passive 3ms, subjunctive after an); 'be carried'
الْمَصَاغِ: الْ + مَصَاغ — maṣāgh, jewellery, wrought gold and silver (m., gen. after min); 'the jewellery'
وَالْأَمْوَالِ: وَ + الْ + أَمْوَال — amwāl, goods, wealth, money (pl. of māl, gen.); 'and the wealth'
وَأَوْصَاهَا: وَ + أَوْصَى + هَا — wa-, and + awṣā, to charge, commend (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he charged her'
بِتَرْبِيَتِهِمَا: بِـ + تَرْبِيَة + هِمَا — bi-, with (prep.; the verb awṣā chooses it for the thing charged, 'with') + tarbiya, upbringing, rearing (f., gen.) + -humā, the two of them; 'with their upbringing'
أَدَبِهِمَا: أَدَب + هِمَا — adab, manners, training, discipline (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -humā, the two of them; 'their manners'
نُزْهَهِ: Nuzhat — proper name, f.: the first term of 'Nuzhat al-Zamān', printed with a final hāʾ for tāʾ marbūṭa (gen. after siwā)
وَأَخْفَوْا: وَ + أَخْفَوْا — wa-, and + akhfaw, to hide, conceal (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they hid'
أَعْوَامٌ: aʿwām — years (m. broken pl. of ʿām, nom. with tanwīn)
مَشْغُولٌ: mashghūl — busy, occupied (pass. part. of I shaghala; m., nom.); 'occupied'
بِمُقَارَعَةِ: بِـ + مُقَارَعَة — bi-, with, in (prep.; mashghūl takes bi- for what one is busy with, 'with') + muqāraʿa, fighting, striking one another (verbal noun of III, f., gen.); 'with the fighting of'
الشُّجْعَانِ: الْ + شُجْعَان — shujʿān, brave men (m. broken pl. of shujāʿ, gen.); 'the brave'
وَمُبَارَزَةِ: وَ + مُبَارَزَة — wa-, and + mubāraza, single combat, duelling (verbal noun of III, f., gen.); 'and the duelling of'
الْفُرْسَانِ: الْ + فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen, knights (m. broken pl. of fāris, gen.); 'the horsemen'
رُسُلٌ: rusul — messengers, envoys (m. broken pl. of rasūl, nom. with tanwīn); 'envoys'
الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةِ: الْ + قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة — al-Qusṭanṭīniyya, Constantinople (f. proper noun, gen.)
الْعُظْمَى: الْ + عُظْمَى — ʿuẓmā, greatest, very great (f. elative of ʿaẓīm, gen. in agreement; 'the great')
وَإِنَّهُمْ: وَ + إِنَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + inna, indeed (particle, opens a clause) + -hum, they (acc.); 'and indeed they'
يُرِيدُونَ: yurīdūna — to want, wish (verb IV, impf. 3mp); 'they want'
الدُّخُولَ: الْ + دُخُول — dukhūl, entering (verbal noun of I dakhala, m., acc., object); 'the entering'
وَالتَّمَثُّلَ: وَ + الْ + تَمَثُّل — wa-, and + tamaththul, standing upright, presenting oneself (verbal noun of V, m., acc.); 'and the standing'
نُدْخِلْهُمْ: nudkhil + hum — to make enter, bring in (verb IV, impf. 1pl., jussive as the answer to the condition) + -hum, them; 'we bring them in'
مَرَدَّ: maradd — turning back, repelling (verbal noun of I radda, m., acc. without tanwīn after lā of absolute denial); 'no turning back'
لِأَمْرِهِ: لِـ + أَمْر + هِ — li-, for, to (prep.; here 'of'; 'no turning back for his command') + amr, command (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his command'
إِقْبَالِهِمْ: إِقْبَال + هِمْ — iqbāl, coming, approach (verbal noun of IV aqbala, m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -him, their; 'their coming'
فَقَبَّلُوا: فَ + قَبَّلُوا — fa-, so + qabbalū, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'so they kissed'
الْبَاعِ: الْ + بَاع — bāʿ, the reach of the arms outspread, power, ability (m., gen.)
الطَّوِيلِ: الْ + طَوِيل — ṭawīl, long (adj., m., gen., describes al-bāʿ); al-bāʿ al-ṭawīl 'the long arm, great power'
أَرْسَلَنَا: أَرْسَلَ + نَا — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us; 'sent us'
أَفْرِيدُونُ: Afrīdūn — proper name, m. (nom.), the Byzantine king
الْيُونَانِيَّةِ: الْ + يُونَانِيَّة — Yūnāniyya, Greek (adj. f. from Yūnān, Greece, gen.); 'the Greek'
وَالْعَسَاكِرِ: وَ + الْ + عَسَاكِر — wa-, and + ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar, gen.); 'and the armies'
النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ: الْ + نَصْرَانِيَّة — naṣrāniyya, Christian (adj. f., gen.); 'the Christian'
الْمُقِيمُ: الْ + مُقِيم — muqīm, dwelling, resident (act. part. of IV aqāma, m., nom.); 'the one who dwells'
بِمَمْلَكَةِ: بِـ + مَمْلَكَة — bi-, in (prep.) + mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'in the kingdom of'
يُعْلِمُكَ: يُعْلِم + كَ — yuʿlimu, to inform (verb IV, impf. 3ms) + -ka, you (m., object); 'he informs you'
حَرْبٍ: ḥarb — war (usually f.; here with a m. adjective; gen. after fī)
جَبَّارٍ: jabbār — tyrant, mighty one (m., gen. with tanwīn)
وَالسَّبَبُ: وَ + الْ + سَبَب — wa-, and + sabab, cause, reason (m., nom.); 'and the cause'
الْعَرَبِ: الْ + عَرَب — ʿarab, the Arabs (m. collective, gen.)
فُتُوحَاتِهِ: فُتُوحَات + هِ — futūḥāt, conquests (f. pl., gen. after baʿḍ) + -hi, his; 'his conquests'
كَنْزًا: kanz — treasure, hoard (m., acc. with tanwīn, object); 'a treasure'
عَهْدِ: ʿahd — time, era, reign (m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); min ʿahd 'from the time of'
فَنَقَلَ: فَ + نَقَلَ — fa-, so + naqala, to carry off, transport (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he carried off'
لَاتُحْصَى: لَا + تُحْصَى — lā, not + tuḥṣā, to count, enumerate (verb IV, impf. passive 3f.; here with the f. pl. noun amwāl); printed as one word, 'which cannot be counted'
مَاوُجِدَ: مَا + وُجِدَ — mā, what (relative) + wujida, to find (verb I, perf. passive 3ms); printed as one word, 'what was found'
خَرَزَاتٍ: kharazāt — beads (f. sound pl. of kharaza, gen. after a numeral)
مُدَوَّرَاتٍ: mudawwarāt — round, spherical (pass. part. of II dawwara; f. sound pl., acc. or gen. with tanwīn, describes kharazāt)
بَيْضِ: bayḍ — eggs (m. collective, gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
النَّعَامِ: الْ + نَعَام — naʿām, ostriches (m. collective, gen.); bayḍ al-naʿām 'ostrich eggs'
مَعْدِنِ: maʿdin — ore, mine, substance (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); min maʿdin 'of the ore of'
الْأَبْيَضِ: الْ + أَبْيَض — abyaḍ, white (adj., m., gen., describes maʿdin)
الْخَالِصِ: الْ + خَالِص — khāliṣ, pure, unmixed (act. part. of I khalaṣa; adj., m., gen.)
لَايُوجَدُ: لَا + يُوجَدُ — lā, not + yūjadu, to find (verb I, impf. passive 3ms); printed as one word, 'is not found'
خَرَزَةٍ: kharaza — bead (f., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa)
بِالْقَلَمِ: بِـ + الْ + قَلَم — bi-, with, in (prep.; of instrument or manner) + qalam, pen, script (m., gen.); 'with the pen, in the script'
الْيُونَانِيِّ: الْ + يُونَانِيّ — Yūnānī, Greek (adj. m., gen.); 'the Greek'
أُمُورٌ: umūr — matters, things (pl. of amr, m., nom. with tanwīn)
وَلَهُنَّ: وَ + لِـ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + li-, for, to (prep.; 'have') + -hunna, them (3fp); 'and they have'
مَنَافِعُ: manāfiʿ — benefits, uses (pl. of manfaʿa, f., nom., diptote)
وَخَوَاصُّ: وَ + خَوَاصّ — wa-, and + khawāṣṣ, special properties, virtues (pl. of khāṣṣa, nom.); 'and properties'; also: khawāṣṣ (pl. of khāṣṣa), the elite, the chief men: khawāṣṣu al-mamlakati, 'the chief men of the kingdom' (Night 192)
خَاصِّيَّتِهِنَّ: خَاصِّيَّة + هِنَّ — khāṣṣiyya, special property, peculiar virtue (f., gen. after min baʿḍ) + -hinna, their (3fp); 'their property'
مَوْلُودٍ: mawlūd — newborn, one born (pass. part. of I walada; m., gen. with tanwīn); 'a newborn child'
عُلِّقَتْ: ʿuliqat — to hang, suspend (verb II, perf. passive 3fs); 'was hung'
خَرَزَةٌ: kharaza — bead (f., nom. with tanwīn, deputy subject of the passive); 'a bead'
يُصِبْهُ: yuṣib + hu — to strike, afflict, befall (verb IV, impf. jussive 3ms, after lam) + -hu, him; 'did not touch him'
أَلَمٌ: alam — pain, ache (m., nom. with tanwīn)
مَادَامَتِ: مَا + دَامَتِ — mā, as long as (temporal particle) + dāmat, to last, remain (verb I, perf. 3fs; the final kasra is a link before the article); printed as one word, 'as long as'
الْخَرَزَةُ: الْ + خَرَزَة — kharaza, bead (f., nom.); 'the bead'
وَلَايَأِنُّ: وَ + لَا + يَئِنُّ — wa-, and + lā, not + yaʾinnu, to moan, groan (verb I, impf. 3ms); printed as one word with the edition's own hamza, 'and he does not moan'
وَلَايَسْخُنُ: وَ + لَا + يَسْخُنُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yaskhunu, to be or become hot, feverish (verb I, impf. 3ms); printed as one word, 'and he does not grow hot'
التُّحَفِ: الـ + تُحَف — tuḥaf, rarities, choice objects (f. pl. of تُحْفَة; gen. after min); 'the rarities'
الرُّسُلَ: الـ + رُسُل — rusul, messengers, envoys (m. broken pl. of رَسُول; acc. after inna); 'the envoys'
الرِّجَالَ: الـ + رِجَال — rijāl, men (broken pl. of رَجُل; acc., object); 'the men'
الْأَرْمَنِ: الـ + أَرْمَن — Arman, the Armenians (m. pl. collective, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the Armenians'
الْأَكْبَرِ: الـ + أَكْبَر — akbar, greatest, greater (elative of كَبِير; m., gen., adjective of al-malik); 'the greatest'; here: adjective of al-ḥabīb, 'the greater (beloved)', a lover's courtesy title
الْمَرْكَبَيْنِ: الـ + مَرْكَب + ـَيْنِ — markab, ship, vessel (m.); dual (obl.), acc. or gen. after fī; 'the two ships'
أَسْرَارِهَا: أَسْرَار + ـهَا — asrār, secrets (pl. of سِرّ; gen. after min) + 3fs; 'its secrets'
أَفْرِيدُونَ: Afrīdūn — Afridun, proper name of a king (diptote; acc. or gen. here, in apposition to al-malik)
أَقْوَى: aqwā — stronger (elative of قَوِيّ; diptote, indeclinable in the ending); 'stronger'
إِنْعَامِ: إِنْعَام — inʿām, bestowal of favour, bounty (m. verbal noun of IV; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'bounty of'
بِالْإِسْعَافِ: بِـ + الـ + إِسْعَاف — bi-, by, with (prep.) + isʿāf, aid, granting of a request (m. verbal noun of IV; gen.); 'by assistance, with help'
بِعَسْكَرٍ: بِـ + عَسْكَر — bi-, with (prep.; مَدَّ بِـ 'to supply with') + ʿaskar, army, troops (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'with an army'
رَعَايَا: رَعَايَا — raʿāyā, subjects, those under a ruler's care (pl. of رَعِيَّة; diptote, acc. after illā in a negative sentence, first term of an iḍāfa); 'subjects of'
سَافَرَا: سَافَرَا — sāfarā, to travel, set out (verb III, perf. 3m dual); 'the two travelled' (the two ships)
سَوَاحِلِ: سَوَاحِل — sawāḥil, coasts, shores (pl. of سَاحِل; gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); 'coasts of'
عَسَاكِرُ: عَسَاكِر — ʿasākir, soldiers, troops (pl. of عَسْكَر; nom., diptote); 'soldiers'
عَسْكَرًا: عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army, troop (m. collective, acc. with tanwīn, object); 'an army'
فَأَخَذُ: فَـ + أَخَذُ — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadhū, to take (verb I, perf. 3mp, the ending -ū printed in the next word); 'so they took'
فَكَسَرُوهُ: فَـ + كَسَرُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + kasara, to break, defeat (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 3ms; 'and they broke it'
فَهَزَمُوهُ: فَـ + هَزَمُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + hazama, to rout, put to flight (verb I, perf. 3mp) + 3ms; 'and they routed it'
قَبَّلُوا: قَبَّلُوا — qabbalū, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'they kissed'
قَبُولَهَا: قَبُول + هَا — qabūl, acceptance (m. verbal noun of I qabila; acc., object of yasʾalu) + 3fs; 'their acceptance' (the gifts, fem. pl. in Arabic)
قَيْسَارِيَةَ: Qaysāriyya — Caesarea (f. place name, diptote; gen. or acc. with fatḥa)
قُطَّاعِ: قُطَّاع — quṭṭāʿ, cutters, those who cut (m. pl. of قَاطِع; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); قُطَّاعِ الطَّرِيقِ, 'highwaymen'
مَرَاكِبَهُ: مَرَاكِب + ـهُ — marākib, ships (broken pl. of مَرْكَب; acc., object of yaḥbisu) + 3ms; 'his ships'
مَعَنَاشَيْئًا: مَعَ + ـنَا + شَيْئًا — maʿa, with (prep.) + 1pl + shayʾ, thing (m., acc. with tanwīn); 'with us something' (printed as one word)
مَلِكَنَا: مَلِك + ـنَا — malik, king (m., acc., object of balagha) + 1pl; 'our king'
مَلِكُهَا: مَلِك + ـهَا — malik, king (m., nom., subject) + 3fs; 'its king'
مَمْلَكَةِ: مَمْلَكَة — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); 'realm of'
مُتَوَجِّهَةٌ: مُتَوَجِّهَة — mutawajjiha, heading, directed (act. part. of V tawajjaha; f., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'heading'
وَالتَّفَضُّلَ: وَ + الـ + تَفَضُّل — wa-, and (conj.) + tafaḍḍul, condescension, favour (m. verbal noun of V; acc., coordinated with qabūlahā); 'and the showing of favour'
وَالذَّخَائِرِ: وَ + الـ + ذَخَائِر — wa-, and (conj.) + dhakhāʾir, treasures, stores (pl. of ذَخِيرَة; gen., coordinated after min); 'and the treasures'
وَالْمُرَادُ: وَ + الـ + مُرَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + murād, the thing intended, aim (pass. part. of IV arāda; m., nom., subject); 'and the aim'
وَثَلَٰثَ: وَ + ثَلَٰث — wa-, and (conj.) + thalāth, three (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa; dagger alif marks defective spelling ثلث); 'and three'
وَجَهَّزَ: وَ + جَهَّزَ — wa-, and (conj.) + jahhaza, to equip (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he equipped'
وَطَرِيقُ: وَ + طَرِيق — wa-, and (conj.; here 'especially as, while') + ṭarīq, road, route (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the route of'
وَفِيهِمْ: وَ + فِي + هِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + fī, in, among (prep.) + 3mp; 'and among them'
وَقَتَلُوا: وَ + قَتَلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they killed'
وَمَرْكَبَيْنِ: وَ + مَرْكَب + ـَيْنِ — wa-, and (conj.; extra in the print) + markab, ship (m.); dual acc. (obj. of jahhaza); 'and two ships'
وَيَتْرُكَ: وَ + يَتْرُكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yatruka, to leave (verb I, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'and (until) he leaves'
وْاجَمِيعَ: وْا + جَمِيع — wa, the stray plural ending (-wā) of the preceding verb fa-akhadhū, printed at the head of this word + jamīʿ, all (m., acc., object); 'all of'
يَتْرُكَ: يَتْرُكَ — yatruka, to leave, abandon (verb I, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'he leaves'
يَحْبِسُ: يَحْبِسُ — yaḥbisu, to hold back, detain (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'to stop, hold back'
يَحْكُمُ: يَحْكُمُ — yaḥkumu, to rule, govern (verb I, impf. 3ms; with عَلَى); 'he rules'
يَمُدَّنَا: يَمُدَّ + ـنَا — yamudda, to reinforce, supply (verb I madda, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an) + 1pl; 'he reinforces us'
وَالرُّسُلَ: و + الـ + رُسُل — wa-, and + rusul, messengers, envoys (pl. of rasūl), acc.; 'and the envoys'
حَكَوْا: حَكَى — ḥakā, to relate, tell; 3 m. pl. perfect, 'they related'
الْهَدِيَّةُ: الـ + هَدِيَّة — hadiyya, gift (f.), nom.; 'the gift'
أَقْبِيَةٌ: أَقْبِيَة — aqbiya, coats, long outer garments (pl. of qabāʾ), nom.; 'coats'
بِمَنَاطِقَ: بِـ + مَنَاطِق — bi-, with (prep.: 'furnished with') + manāṭiq, girdles, belts (pl. of minṭaqa; diptote); 'with girdles'
مَمْلُوكٍ: مَمْلُوك — mamlūk, owned male slave, gen. sg. after kull; 'mamlūk'
أُذُنِهِ: أُذُن + هِ — udhun, ear (f.) + -hi, his; fī udhunihi 'in his ear'
وَعَلَيْهِمْ: و + عَلَى + هِمْ — wa-, and + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -him, them; 'and upon them'
رَآهُمُ: رَأَى + هُمُ — raʾā, to see; 3 m. sg. perfect + -humu, them (vowelled -mu before the article); 'he saw them' (the edition prints the madda form)
قَبِلَهُمْ: قَبِلَ + هُمْ — qabila, to accept, receive; 3 m. sg. perfect + -hum, them; 'he accepted them'
بِإِكْرَامِ: بِـ + إِكْرَام — bi-, (the doing) of (prep.; the verb amara chooses bi-: 'order (something)') + ikrām, honouring, showing honour (verbal noun of form IV), gen.; 'the honouring of'
الرُّسُلِ: الـ + رُسُل — rusul, messengers, envoys, gen.; 'the envoys'
وَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ: و + اِسْتَشَارَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + istashāra (form X), to consult, ask counsel of; + -hum, them; 'and he consulted them'
دَنْدَانُ: دَنْدَان — Dandān, proper name (the vizier), nom.
تُجَهِّزَ: جَهَّزَ — jahhaza (form II), to equip, fit out; 2 m. sg. subjunctive (after أَنْ), 'you equip'
جَرَّارًا: جَرَّار — jarrār, dragging; of an army, so vast that it trails along (m.), acc.; 'mighty'
وَتُقَدِّمَ: و + قَدَّمَ — wa-, and + qaddama (form II), to put forward, set at the head; 2 m. sg. subjunctive; 'and you set'
غِلْمَانٌ: غِلْمَان — ghilmān, lads, young servants (pl. of ghulām), nom.; 'lads'
الرَّأْيُ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m.), nom.; 'the opinion'
لِوَجْهَيْنِ: لِـ + وَجْهَيْن — li-, for, on account of (prep.) + wajhayn, two faces, i.e. two aspects or grounds (dual of wajh), gen.; 'for two reasons'
اسْتَجَا: اِسْتَجَارَ — istajāra (form X), to seek protection; the first part of the verb, divided by the edition from its last letters (see the next word); read with رَبِكَ as 'he sought your protection'
رَبِكَ: ـرَ + بِـ + كَ — the end of istajāra, -ra, + bi- (istajāra bi- 'seek the protection of') + -ka, you; with اسْتَجَا 'sought your protection'
فَقَبِلْتَهَا: فَـ + قَبِلَ + تَ + هَا — fa-, and so + qabila, to accept; 2 m. sg. perfect (-ta, you) + -hā, it (f.); 'and you accepted it'
لَايَجْسُرُ: لَا + يَجْسُرُ — lā, not (printed joined) + yajsuru, he dares (jasura, to dare, venture; 3 m. sg. imperfect); 'does not dare' (no complement printed)
عَسْكَرُكَ: عَسْكَر + كَ — ʿaskar, army (nom.) + -ka, your; 'your army'
عَدُوُّهُ: عَدُوّ + هُ — ʿaduww, enemy (nom.) + -hu, his; 'his enemy'
يُنْسَبُ: نَسَبَ — nasaba, to ascribe; 3 m. sg. imperfect passive, 'is ascribed'
وَيَشِيعُ: و + يَشِيعُ — wa-, and + shāʿa, to spread, become known; 3 m. sg. imperfect; 'and it spreads'
وَلَاسِيَّمَا: و + لَا سِيَّمَا — wa-, and + lā siyyamā, especially (printed joined); 'and especially'
فَيَحْمِلُونَ: فَـ + يَحْمِلُونَ — fa-, so, and so + ḥamala, to carry, bring; 3 m. pl. imperfect; 'and so they bring'
وَالتُّحَفَ: و + الـ + تُحَف — wa-, and + tuḥaf, rarities, choice objects (pl. of tuḥfa), acc.; 'and the rarities'
وَالْأَمْوَالَ: و + الـ + أَمْوَال — wa-, and + amwāl, monies, wealth (pl. of māl), acc.; 'and the monies'
أَعْجَبَهُ: أَعْجَبَ + هُ — aʿjaba (form IV), to please, delight; 3 m. sg. perfect + -hu, him; 'pleased him'
وَاسْتَصْوَبَهُ: و + اِسْتَصْوَبَ + هُ — wa-, and + istaṣwaba (form X), to deem right, approve; + -hu, it; 'and he approved it'
تَسْتَشِيرُهُ: تَسْتَشِيرُ + هُ — istashāra (form X), to consult; 3 f. sg. imperfect (agreeing with al-mulūk) + -hu, him; 'consults him'
وَيَنْبَغِي: و + يَنْبَغِي — wa-, and + inbaghā (form VII), to be fitting, proper; 3 m. sg. imperfect; 'and it is fitting'
مُقَدَّمِ: مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, front, van (m.), in construct (gen.); 'front of' Also of a person, 'leader, captain': ilā muqaddami al-khayyālati, 'to the captain of the horsemen'.
سَاقَةِ: سَاقَة — sāqa, rear guard (f.), in construct (gen.); 'rear of'
فَقَصَّ: فَـ + قَصَّ — fa-, and then + qaṣṣa, to relate, recount; 3 m. sg. perfect; 'and he recounted'
الرُّسُلُ: الـ + رُسُل — rusul, messengers, envoys, nom.; 'the envoys'
بِأَخْذِ: بِـ + أَخْذ — bi-, with, to (prep.; awṣā bi- 'charge with') + akhdh, taking (verbal noun of akhadha), gen.; 'with the taking of'
الْأُهْبَةِ: الـ + أُهْبَة — uhba, equipment, readiness, preparation (f.), gen.; 'the equipment'
وَالتَّجْهِيزِ: و + الـ + تَجْهِيز — wa-, and + tajhīz, equipping, preparation (verbal noun of form II), gen.; 'and the preparation'
يُخَالِفُ: khālafa (III), to oppose, go against; imperfect 3 m. sg. yukhālifu, 'he opposes'
دَنْدَانَ: Dandān, the vizier's name (a proper noun, diptote); in apposition to al-wazīr
يَنْتَخِبَ: intakhaba (VIII), to pick out, select; subjunctive 3 m. sg. yantakhiba after an, 'he select'
فَارِسٍ: fāris, horseman, cavalryman (m.); genitive singular as the counted noun; 'ten thousand horsemen'
كَامِلِينَ: kāmil, complete, perfect (act. part. of kamala), m. pl. accusative; 'complete-ones'
الْعُدَّةَ: الـ + عُدَّة — al-, the + ʿudda, equipment, gear, readiness (f.); accusative of respect: 'complete as to equipment'; also (Night 202): الـ + عُدَّة — al-, the + ʿudda, equipment, gear (f.); acc., object of akhadha: akhadha minhu al-ʿuddata, 'he took the instruments from him'
صَابِرِينَ: ṣābir, patient, enduring (act. part. of ṣabara), m. pl. accusative; 'enduring-ones'
الْحُرُوبِ: الـ + حُرُوب — al-, the + ḥurūb, wars (pl. of ḥarb, f.); genitive after ʿalā
وَالشِّدَّةِ: و + الـ + شِدَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + shidda, hardship, severity (f.); genitive; 'and the hardship'
وَاخْتَارَ: و + اخْتَارَ — wa-, and + ikhtāra (VIII), to choose, pick; perfect 3 m. sg.; 'and he chose'
وَعَرَضَ: و + عَرَضَ — wa-, and + ʿaraḍa, to present for inspection, to muster, review (troops); perfect 3 m. sg.; 'and he reviewed'
عَسْكَرَهُ: عَسْكَر + ـهُ — ʿaskar, army (m., collective) + -hu, his; accusative object; 'his army'
وَأَنْفَقَ: و + أَنْفَقَ — wa-, and + anfaqa (IV), to spend, lay out money; perfect 3 m. sg.; 'and he spent'
الْمُهْلَةُ: الـ + مُهْلَة — al-, the + muhla, respite, delay, time allowed (f.); nominative, subject of a verbless clause
مُطِيعِينَ: muṭīʿ, obedient (act. part. of IV aṭāʿa), m. pl. accusative, circumstantial; 'obeying'
وَإِصْلَاحِ: و + إِصْلَاح — wa-, and + iṣlāḥ, putting right, setting in order (verbal noun of IV aṣlaḥa, m.); genitive, coordinated with al-uhba
خَزَائِنِ: خَزَائِن — khazāʾin, storehouses, treasuries, chests (pl. of khizāna, f.; diptote); genitive in annexation here after ilā; khazāʾin al-silāḥ, 'the armouries'
السِّلَاحِ: الـ + سِلَاح — al-, the + silāḥ, weapons, arms (m.); genitive in annexation
الْعُدَدِ: الـ + عُدَد — al-, the + ʿudad, gear, implements, tools (pl. of ʿudda); genitive after mina
وَالسِّلَاحِ: و + الـ + سِلَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + silāḥ, weapons (m.); genitive, 'and the weapons'
الْإِصْطَبْلَ: الـ + إِصْطَبْل — al-, the + iṣṭabl, stable (m.; from Greek via Aramaic); accusative object of dakhala
الْمُسَوَّمَةَ: الـ + مُسَوَّمَة — al-, the + musawwama, marked, branded, or put to pasture (pass. part. of II sawwama, f.), the Qurʾānic epithet of fine horses (3:14); agrees with al-khayl; accusative
وَغَيْرَهُمْ: و + غَيْر + هُمْ — wa-, and + ghayr, other than, others (m.) + -hum, them; accusative; 'and others (than them)'
أَقَامُوا: aqāma (IV), to stay, remain; perfect 3 m. pl. aqāmū; 'they stayed'
لِوَدَاعِ: لِـ + وَدَاع — li-, to, in order to (prep.; purpose) + wadāʿ, farewell, taking leave (m., verbal noun of III wādaʿa); genitive in annexation; 'to bid farewell to'
وَأَهْدَى: و + أَهْدَى — wa-, and + ahdā (IV), to present as a gift; perfect 3 m. sg.; 'and he gave as a present'
بِعَسْكَرِ: بِـ + عَسْكَر — bi-, with regard to (prep.; awṣā bi-, 'charge (someone) with, commend (something) to him') + ʿaskar, army (m.); genitive in annexation; 'concerning the army of'; after mashghūl, 'occupied with, anxious about' (qalbī mashghūlun bi-ʿaskari, 'my heart is uneasy for the army of')
وَأَجَابَهُ: و + أَجَابَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ajāba (IV), to answer, reply to, + -hu, him; 'and he answered him'
يُشَاوِرُ: shāwara (III), to consult, take counsel with; imperfect 3 m. sg. yushāwiru, indicative (the edition has anna + indicative, where Classical would use an + subjunctive); 'he consults'
أُمُورِهِ: أُمُور + ـهِ — umūr, affairs, matters (pl. of amr) + -hi, his; genitive in annexation; 'all his affairs'
فَقَبِلَ: ف + قَبِلَ — fa-, so, then (sequence) + qabila, to accept, agree to; perfect 3 m. sg.; 'so he accepted'
النُّقَبَاءَ: الـ + نُقَبَاء — al-, the + nuqabāʾ, captains, chiefs of companies (pl. of naqīb); accusative, the person ordered
بِالْعَرْضِ: بِـ + الـ + عَرْض — bi-, to, for (prep.; amara bi-, 'order (something)') + al-, the + ʿarḍ, presenting for inspection, muster, review (m., verbal noun of ʿaraḍa); 'to the review'
فَعَرَضُوا: ف + عَرَضَ — fa-, so, and so + ʿaraḍa, to muster, review (troops); perfect 3 m. pl. ʿaraḍū; 'so they mustered'
عِدَّتُهُمْ: عِدَّة + هُمْ — ʿidda, number, count (f.; also 'equipment') + -hum, their; nominative, subject of kānat; 'their number'
يَتْبَعُهُمْ: يَتْبَعُ + هُمْ — tabiʿa, to follow; imperfect 3 m. sg. yatbaʿu + -hum, them; mā yatbaʿuhum, 'what follows them' (the camp-followers and baggage-men)
الْقَوْمَ: الـ + قَوْم — al-, the + qawm, people, folk, company (m.); accusative after inna
حَمَلُوا: ḥamala, to bear, carry; with ʿalā 'to charge'; used alone of an army, 'to set off, to move off' (so Lane: to rush forward); perfect 3 m. pl.; the sense is uncertain in one earlier passage
الطُّبُولُ: الـ + طُبُول — al-, the + ṭubūl, drums (pl. of ṭabl); nominative, subject of the passive
وَزَعَقَتِ: و + زَعَقَتِ — wa-, and + zaʿaqat, to cry out, blare (zaʿaqa, perfect 3 f. sg.), with a helping kasra before al-; 'and blared'
الْبُوقَاتُ: الـ + بُوقَات — al-, the + būqāt, trumpets, horns (pl. of būq, from Persian/Turkish); nominative, subject
وَانْتَشَرَتِ: و + انْتَشَرَتِ — wa-, and + intashara (VII), to spread out, be unfurled; perfect 3 f. sg. intasharat, with a helping kasra before al-; 'and spread out'
الْأَعْلَامُ: الـ + أَعْلَام — al-, the + aʿlām, standards, banners (pl. of ʿalam); nominative
وَالرَّايَاتُ: و + الـ + رَايَات — wa-, and + al-, the + rāyāt, flags, banners (pl. of rāya, f.); nominative
وَالْأَعْلَامُ: و + الـ + أَعْلَام — wa-, and (here 'while', circumstantial) + al-, the + aʿlām, standards (pl. of ʿalam); nominative
تَخْفِقُ: khafaqa, to flutter, flap; imperfect 3 f. sg. takhfiqu (agreeing with a plural of things); 'flutter'
وَالرُّسُلُ: و + الـ + رُسُل — wa-, and (here 'with', circumstantial) + al-, the + rusul, messengers, envoys (pl. of rasūl); nominative; here the envoys of the king of Constantinople who brought the gift, now guiding the army
تَقْدُمُهُمْ: تَقْدُمُ + هُمْ — qadama, to go before, precede, lead; imperfect 3 f. sg. taqdumu + -hum, them; 'going before them'
وَاسْتَرَاحُوا: و + اسْتَرَاحَ — wa-, and + istarāḥa (X), to rest, take rest; perfect 3 m. pl. istarāḥū; 'and they rested'
بِالصَّبَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + صَبَاح — bi-, with (prep.; here 'with the morning-light', completing the idiom aṣbaḥa bi-) + al-, the + ṣabāḥ, morning, dawn (m.)
رَكِبُوا: rakiba, to ride, mount; perfect 3 m. pl. rakibū; 'they mounted'
مُجِدِّينَ: mujidd, earnest, in earnest, diligent (act. part. of IV ajadda), m. pl. accusative, predicate of lam yazālū; 'pressing on'; also acc. of state (ḥāl), with a direct object: mujiddīna al-masīra, 'pressing on the march'
السَّيْرِ: الـ + سَيْر — al-, the + sayr, travelling, journeying (m., verbal noun of sāra); genitive after fī
يَدُلُّونَهُمْ: يَدُلُّونَ + هُمْ — dalla (ʿalā), to guide, point out to; imperfect 3 m. pl. yadullūna + -hum, them; 'guiding them'
النَّبَاتِ: الـ + نَبَات — nabāt, plants, vegetation (m.); gen. in construct: 'of the plants'
النَّوَاحِي: الـ + نَوَاحِي — nawāḥī, regions, quarters (pl. of نَاحِيَة); gen. in construct: 'of the regions'
الْبَيْ—تَيْنِ: الـ + بَيْ—تَيْنِ — bayt, verse (line of poetry); dual of بَيْت, here acc./gen. dual, printed with a dash in the middle: 'the two verses'
الْجَوَادُ: الـ + جَوَاد — jawād, steed, fine horse (m.); nom. subject: 'the steed'
الْجِهَاتِ: الـ + جِهَات — jihāt, sides, directions (pl. of جِهَة); gen. in construct: 'of the sides'
الْحَرَسَ: الـ + حَرَس — ḥaras, guard, watch (m.); acc. object of يَتَوَلَّى: 'the guard'
الْحَظِّ: الـ + حَظّ — ḥaẓẓ, fortune, luck (m.); gen. in construct: 'of fortune'
الْخَافِقَيْنِ: الـ + خَافِقَيْنِ — khāfiqayn, the two horizons, east and west (dual of خَافِق, 'fluttering'); gen. dual after فِي: 'the two quarters of the sky'
الْعِدَ: الـ + عِدَ — as printed, cut short; probably for الْعِدَا / الْعَدُوّ, ʿidā / ʿaduww, enemy; gen. in construct: 'of the enemy' (a guess; see note)
الْغَابَاتِ: الـ + غَابَات — ghābāt, thickets, woods (pl. of غَابَة); gen. after بَعْض: 'the thickets'
الْمَسِيحِ: الـ + مَسِيح — Masīḥ, the Messiah, Christ (m.); gen. in construct with حَقّ in the oath: 'by the Messiah'
الْوَادِيَ: الـ + وَادِي — wādī, valley (m.); acc. object of يَكْشِفَ: 'the valley'
الْوَحْشِ: الـ + وَحْش — waḥsh, wild beasts (m., collective); gen. after مِنْ: 'of wild beasts'
انْبَسَطَ: انْبَسَطَ — inbasaṭa, 'it spread out' (verb VII perfect, 3 m. sg., root ب س ط): 'spread'
أَشْرَفُوا: أَشْرَفُوا — ashrafū, 'they overlooked, came out upon' (verb IV perfect, 3 m. pl., root ش ر ف), followed by عَلَى: 'they came out upon'
بِاخْتِلَافِ: بِـ + اخْتِلَاف — bi-, by, in respect of (prep.) + ikhtilāf, difference (verbal noun of VIII, m.), gen. in construct: 'by the difference of'
بِالْعَرَبِيِّ: بِـ + الـ + عَرَبِيّ — bi-, in (prep., naming the language spoken) + ʿarabī, Arabic (adj. used as noun, m.): 'in Arabic'
بِالْقَمَرِ: بِـ + الـ + قَمَر — bi-, marks what appears after وَإِذَا (not a preposition of place) + qamar, moon (m.): 'and behold, the moon'
بِحَافِرِهِ: بِـ + حَافِر + هِ — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + ḥāfir, hoof (m.) + -hi, his (3 m. sg. pron.): 'with his hoof'
بِزُنَّارِهَا: بِـ + زُنَّار + هَا — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + zunnār, girdle, belt (m.) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. pron.): 'with her girdle'
بِكَلِمَةٍ: بِـ + كَلِمَة — bi-, with, in (prep., after تَكَلَّمَ 'speak a word') + kalima, word (f.): 'a word'; also: after naṭaqa, bi- marks the thing uttered: lam anṭiq bi-kalimatin, 'I did not utter a word'; here: radda ʿalayhā bi-kalimatin, bi- marks the word given in reply, 'did not answer her a word' Also bi- of the means after zāda: wa-lā bi-kalimatin wāḥidatin, 'not by so much as a single word'.
بِنَهْرٍ: بِـ + نَهْر — bi-, marks what appears after فَإِذَا هُوَ (not a preposition of place) + nahr, river (m.), gen. indef.: 'a river'
تَرْتَعُ: تَرْتَعُ — tartaʿu, 'they graze' (verb I imperfect indic., 3 f. sg. agreeing with plural of non-humans, root ر ت ع): 'grazing'
تَسْرَحُ: تَسْرَحُ — tasraḥu, 'they roam, pasture freely' (verb I imperfect indic., 3 f. sg., root س ر ح): 'roaming'
تَشْرَحُ: تَشْرَحُ — tashraḥu, 'they explain, expound' (verb I imperfect indic., 3 f. sg., root ش ر ح): 'explaining' Also sharaḥa al-ṣadra, 'to open the breast', i.e. 'to gladden': mimmā tashraḥu ruʾyatuhu al-ṣadra, 'such as gladden the heart to look on'.
تَمْرَحُ: تَمْرَحُ — tamraḥu, 'they frolic' (verb I imperfect indic., 3 f. sg. agreeing with the collective طَيْر, root م ر ح): 'frolicking'
جَوَانِبِ: جَوَانِب — jawānib, sides, flanks (pl. of جَانِب); gen. after فِي: 'sides of'
رُبْعُهُ: رُبْع + هُ — rubʿ, a quarter (m.) + -hu, its (3 m. sg. pron., referring to the night); nom. subject of مَضَى: 'a quarter of it'
صَرَعْتُهَا: صَرَعَ + تُ + هَا — ṣaraʿa, 'throw down' (verb I perfect, root ص ر ع) + -tu, I (1 sg. subject) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. object): 'I throw her down'
عَادَةٌ: عَادَة — ʿāda, habit, custom (f.); nom. indef., subject of كَانَ لَهُ: 'a habit'
فَأَرْخَى: فَـ + أَرْخَى — fa-, and so (conj.) + arkhā, 'he slackened, let loose' (verb IV perfect, 3 m. sg., root ر خ و): 'then he slackened'
فَأَمَرَهُمْ: فَـ + أَمَرَ + هُمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + amara, 'he ordered' (verb I perfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them (3 m. pl. object): 'so he ordered them'
فَتَعِبَ: فَـ + تَعِبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + taʿiba, 'he grew tired' (verb I perfect, 3 m. sg., root ت ع ب): 'so he grew weary'
فَسِيحِ: فَسِيح — fasīḥ, spacious, wide (adj., m.); gen. in construct, agreeing with وَادٍ: 'spacious of'
كَآنَّهُ: كَ + أَنَّ + هُ — ka-, as, like (prep./conj.) + anna, that + -hu, it (3 m. sg. pron.); printed with alif madda as كَآنَّهُ: 'as though it were'
لَايَخْجَلُ: لَا + يَخْجَلُ — lā, not (negative particle) + yakhjalu, 'he is ashamed' (verb I imperfect, 3 m. sg., root خ ج ل); printed as one word: 'is not ashamed'
لُغَاتِهَا: لُغَات + هَا — lughāt, languages, tongues (pl. of لُغَة), gen. in construct + -hā, their (3 f. sg. pron., agreeing with plural of non-humans): 'their tongues'
لِأَحْلِ: لِـ + أَحْل — li-, for, on account of (prep.) + aḥl, as printed; the sense requires أَجْل, 'sake' (ajl; the ح is probably a misprint of ج): 'for the sake of'
لِمَعَانِى: لِـ + مَعَانِى — li-, to, for (prep., marks the thing explained after شَرَحَ: 'explain … to/for') + maʿānī, meanings (pl. of مَعْنَى), gen. in construct: 'the meanings of'
مَرْجٍ: مَرْج — marj, meadow, pasture (m.); gen. indef. after عَلَى: 'a meadow'
مَمَالِيكَهُ: مَمَالِيك + هُ — mamālīk, mamluks, slave-soldiers (pl. of مَمْلُوك), acc. object of أَمَرَ + -hu, his (3 m. sg. pron.): 'his mamluks'
مُرُوجِ: مُرُوج — murūj, meadows (pl. of مَرْج); gen. in construct, after مِنْ: 'meadows of'
مُزَرْكَشٌ: مُزَرْكَش — muzarkash, embroidered, brocaded, flowered (passive participle of the quadriliteral زَرْكَشَ, from Persian zarkash 'gold-working'); nom. predicate: 'embroidered'
مِنْكُنَّ: مِنْ + كُنَّ — min, from (prep.) + -kunna, you (2 f. pl. pron.): 'from you (women)'
نَهْرِ: نَهْر — nahr, river, stream (m.); gen. after عَلَى, in construct: 'a river of'; also indefinite, gen. after ʿalā, tanwīn dropped at the rhyme: 'a river'
هَٰذَيْنِ: هَٰذَيْنِ — hādhayni, these two (demonstrative, m. dual, acc./gen.): 'these two'
وَافْتَرَقَ: وَ + افْتَرَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + iftaraqa, 'it dispersed' (verb VIII perfect, 3 m. sg., root ف ر ق): 'and dispersed'
وَالطُّيُورُ: وَ + الـ + طُيُور — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṭuyūr, birds (pl. of طَيْر), nom. subject: 'and the birds'
وَالنَّبَاتِ: وَ + الـ + نَبَات — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + nabāt, plants (m.), gen.: 'and the plants'
وَالْإِقَامَةِ: وَ + الـ + إِقَامَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iqāma, staying, residing (verbal noun of IV, f.), gen. after بِالنُّزُولِ: 'and the staying'
وَالْعِشْرِينَ: وَ + الـ + عِشْرِين — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ʿishrīn, twenty (numeral); gen. in 'the one and the twenty', i.e. the twenty-first day: 'and the twenty'
وَتَفَرَّقُوا: وَ + تَفَرَّقُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + tafarraqū, 'they scattered' (verb V perfect, 3 m. pl., root ف ر ق): 'and dispersed'
وَحِسًّا: وَ + حِسّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥiss, sound, noise (m.), acc. indef. object of سَمِعَ: 'and a sound'
وَخَوَاصَّهُ: وَ + خَوَاصّ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + khawāṣṣ, intimates, special people (pl. of خَاصّ), acc. object of أَمَرَ + -hu, his (3 m. sg. pron.): 'and his intimates'
وَذَٰلِكَ: وَ + ذَٰلِكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhālika, that (demonstrative, m. sg.): 'and that'
وَرَبَطَهُ: وَ + رَبَطَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + rabaṭa, 'he tied' (verb I perfect, 3 m. sg., root ر ب ط) + -hu, it (3 m. sg. object): 'and tied it'; also: 'and he tied him', with fī marking what he is tied to: rabaṭahu fī salabati al-biʾri, 'tied him to the well rope'
وَشَرْكَانُ: وَ + شَرْكَان — wa-, while (circumstantial conj.) + Sharkān, a personal name, nom. diptote: 'while Sharkān'
وَصُحْبَتَهُ: وَ + صُحْبَة + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣuḥba, company (f.), acc. as adverb + -hu, his (3 m. sg. pron.): 'and in his company'
وَصِيَّةِ: وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, charge, testament, bequest (f.); gen. in construct: 'the charge of'
وَضَحِكًا: وَ + ضَحِك — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍaḥik, laughter (m., verbal noun), acc. indef. object of سَمِعَ: 'and laughter'
وَطَيْرٍ: وَ + طَيْر — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭayr, birds (m., collective), gen. indef. after بِنَهْرٍ: 'and birds'
وَغِزْلَانٍ: وَ + غِزْلَان — wa-, and (conj.) + ghizlān, gazelles (pl. of غَزَال), gen. indef.: 'and gazelles'
وَفَسَارَ: وَ + فَـ + سَارَ — wa-, and (conj.) + fa-, so (conj., doubled in the print) + sāra, 'he rode' (verb I perfect, 3 m. sg., root س ي ر): 'and so he rode'
وَكَتَفْتُهَا: وَ + كَتَفَ + تُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + katafa, 'tie up, bind (arms)' (verb I perfect, root ك ت ف) + -tu, I (1 sg. subject) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. object): 'and I bind her'
وَوُحُوشٍ: وَ + وُحُوش — wa-, and (conj.) + wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of وَحْش), gen. indef.: 'and wild beasts'
وَيَتَوَلَّى: وَ + يَتَوَلَّى — wa-, and (conj.) + yatawallā, 'he takes charge of' (verb V imperfect subjunctive, 3 m. sg., root و ل ي): 'and take charge of'
وُصُولُهُمْ: وُصُول + هُمْ — wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of وَصَلَ, m.), nom. subject of كَانَ + -hum, their (3 m. pl. pron.): 'their arrival'
يَرْكُضَ: يَرْكُضَ — yarkuḍa, 'he spurs, urges on' (verb I imperfect subjunctive, 3 m. sg., root ر ك ض): 'he spur'
يَسْبِي: يَسْبِي — yasbī, 'it captivates, carries off' (verb I imperfect indic., 3 m. sg., root س ب ي): 'captivates'
يَكْشِفَ: يَكْشِفَ — yakshifa, 'he uncovers, scouts' (verb I imperfect subjunctive, 3 m. sg., root ك ش ف): 'he scout'
يَنْتَبِهْ: يَنْتَبِهْ — yantabih, 'he wakes, becomes aware' (verb VIII imperfect jussive after لَمْ, 3 m. sg., root ن ب ه): 'did not wake'
تَحْسُنُ: taḥsunu, 3 f. sg. imperfect of ḥasuna, be beautiful; 'is beautiful'
الْاَرْضُ: الـ + أَرْض — al-, the + arḍ, earth (f.); 'the earth' (nom.; printed with bare alif)
زَهْرَتِهَا: زَهْرَة + هَا — zahra, blossoming, flower (f.) + -hā, her/its; 'its blossoming'
وَالْمَاءُ: و + الـ + مَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + māʾ, water (m.); 'and the water'
بِاِرْسَالِ: بِـ + إِرْسَال — bi-, with (prep., 'in the manner of') + irsāl, letting loose, sending (verbal noun); 'with a letting-loose'
صُنْعُ: ṣunʿ, making, handiwork (m.), nom. in construct; 'the making of'
الْاِلَهِ: الـ + إِلَه — al-, the + ilāh, god (m.), gen.; 'the God' (printed with bare alif)
مُعْطِى: muʿṭī, giver (active part. of aʿṭā, give), printed with ى, in construct; 'giver of'
الْعَطَايَا: الـ + عَطَايَا — al-, the + ʿaṭāyā, gifts (pl. of ʿaṭiyya), gen.; 'the gifts'
وَمُعْطِي: و + مُعْطِي — wa-, and + muʿṭī, giver (active part. of aʿṭā), in construct; 'and giver of'
اِفْضَالِ: إِفْضَال — ifḍāl, bestowal of favour, bounty (verbal noun of afḍala), gen. as second term of construct; 'of bounty'
دَيْرًا: dayr, monastery, convent (m.), acc. indef., object; 'a monastery'
الدَّيْرِ: الـ + دَيْر — al-, the + dayr, monastery (m.), gen.; 'the monastery'
قَلْعَةٌ: qalʿa, fortress, citadel (f.), nom. indef.; 'a fortress'
شَاهِقَةٌ: shāhiqa, lofty, towering (f., active part. of shahaqa), nom., adj. of قلعة; 'lofty'
الرِّيَاضِ: الـ + رِيَاض — al-, the + riyāḍ, gardens, meadows (pl. of rawḍa), gen.; 'the gardens'
وَهُنَاكَ: و + هُنَاكَ — wa-, and + hunāka, there (adv.); 'and there'
وَعَلَيْهِنَّ: و + عَلَى + هِنَّ — wa-, and + ʿalā, on, upon (prep.) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); 'and upon them'
مَايُدْهِشُ: مَا + يُدْهِشُ — mā, what (relative, printed glued) + yudhishu, 3 m. sg. imperfect of adhasha, bewilder, dazzle; 'what bewilders'
الْأَبْصَارَ: الـ + أَبْصَار — al-, the + abṣār, sights, eyes (pl. of baṣar), acc., object; 'the eyes'
وَكُلُّهُنَّ: و + كُلّ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + kull, all of (nom., in construct) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'and all of them'
فِيهِنَّ: فِي + هِنَّ — fī, in, concerning (prep.) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); 'about them'
يُشْرِقُ: yushriqu, 3 m. sg. imperfect of ashraqa, shine, light up; 'shines'
الْمَرْجُ: الـ + مَرْج — al-, the + marj, meadow (m.), nom.; 'the meadow'
الْبِيضِ: الـ + بِيض — al-, the + bīḍ, white ones (pl. of abyaḍ/bayḍāʾ), gen.; 'the white ones'
الْغَوَانِي: الـ + غَوَانِي — al-, the + ghawānī, beauties, women who need no adornment (pl. of ghāniya), gen.; 'the fair ones'
بَدِيعَاتِ: badīʿāt, wondrous, marvellous things (f. pl. of badīʿ), in construct, gen.; 'wondrous ones of'
غُنْجٍ: ghunj, coquetry, languishing manner (m.), gen. indef.; 'coquetry'
وَدَلَالِ: و + دَلَال — wa-, and + dalāl, playful coyness, wantonness (m.), gen.; 'and playful pride'
رَاخِيَاتٍ: rākhiyāt, letting loose, trailing (f. pl. active part. of rakhā), acc./gen. indef.; 'letting down'
لِشُعُورٍ: لِـ + شُعُور — li-, to, for (prep.; marks the thing the participle acts on) + shuʿūr, hairs, tresses (pl. of shaʿr), gen. indef.; 'letting down tresses'
كَعَنَاقِيدِ: كَـ + عَنَاقِيد — ka-, like (prep.) + ʿanāqīd, bunches, clusters (pl. of ʿunqūd), gen.; 'like bunches of'
اللَّ: al-l, probably the beginning of الدَّوَالِي 'the vines' split by a printer's space; the edition has الـ + لّ; 'the l-'
فَاتِنَاتٍ: fātināt, bewitching, enchanting (f. pl. active part. of fatana), gen. or acc. indef.; 'enchanting'
رَامِيَاتٍ: rāmiyāt, shooting, throwing (f. pl. active part. of ramā), indef.; 'shooting'
بِالنِّبَالِ: بِـ + الـ + نِبَال — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + al-, the + nibāl, arrows (pl. of nabl), gen.; 'with the arrows'
مَائِسَاتٍ: māʾisāt, swaying, strutting (f. pl. active part. of māsa), indef.; 'swaying'
قَاتِلَاتٍ: qātilāt, killing, slaying (f. pl. active part. of qatala), indef.; 'slaying'
لِصَنَادِيدِ: لِـ + صَنَادِيد — li-, to, for (prep.; the participle's 'to/of' object) + ṣanādīd, chieftains, champions (pl. of ṣindīd), gen.; 'the chieftains'
بِشَعْرٍ: بِـ + شَعْر — bi-, with (prep., 'having') + shaʿr, hair (m.), gen. indef.; 'with hair'
أَجْعَدَوَ: أَجْعَد + وَ — ajʿad, curly (m. adj., diptote gen.) + wa-, and (conjunction, run onto the adjective in the print); 'curly, and'
أَدْعَجَ: adʿaj, with deep black pupils, black-eyed (adj., diptote gen.); 'dark-eyed'
وَصُدْغٍ: و + صُدْغ — wa-, and + ṣudgh, temple, side-lock (m.), gen. indef.; 'and a temple'
مُعَقْرَبٍ: muʿaqrab, scorpion-curled, curled like a scorpion's tail (part. of ʿaqraba), gen. indef.; 'scorpion-curled'
الذَّاتِ: الـ + ذَات — al-, the + dhāt, self, essence, person (f.), gen.; 'the person'
وَالصِّفَاتِ: و + الـ + صِفَات — wa-, and + al-, the + ṣifāt, qualities, attributes (pl. of ṣifa), gen.; 'and the qualities'
بِالْحَاظِ: بِـ + أَلْحَاظ — bi-, with, by (prep.) + alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ), gen. (printed with bare alif, not the article); 'with glances'
وَقَدُّهَا: و + قَدّ + هَا — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m.) + -hā, her, nom.; 'and her stature'
مُخْجِلُ: mukhjil, shaming, putting to shame (m. active part. of akhjala), nom., printed without tanwīn; 'shames'
لِلسَّمْهَرِيَّاتِ: لِـ + الـ + سَمْهَرِيَّات — li-, to, for (prep.; the participle's object, 'shaming to') + al-, the + samhariyyāt, Samharī lances (f. pl.), gen.; 'the lances'
اِلَيْنَا: إِلَى + نَا — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + -nā, us; 'to us'
وَخَدَّاهَا: و + خَدَّا + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + khaddā, cheeks (dual nom.) + -hā, her; 'her two cheeks'
مُوَرَّدَةٌ: muwarrada, rose-coloured, flushed (f. part. of warrada), nom. indef., predicate; 'rose-red'
الظَّرْفِ: الـ + ظَرْف — al-, the + ẓarf, elegance, grace (m.), gen.; 'elegance'
اَنْوَاعُ: anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of nawʿ), nom. in construct (printed without hamza); 'kinds of'
طَلْعَتِهَا: طَلْعَة + هَا — ṭalʿa, face, countenance (f.) + -hā, her; 'her face'
لَيْلٌ: layl, night (m.), nom. indef., predicate of كأن; 'a night'
تَقَدَّمُوا: taqaddama, advance (form V; imper. m. pl.); 'advance!'
أُصَارِعَكُمْ: ṣāraʿa, wrestle (form III; impf. subj. 1 sg.) + كُمْ, you (m. pl., obj.); 'I wrestle you'
يَغِيبَ: ghāba, be absent, set (of a heavenly body) (impf. subj. 3 m. sg.)
وَيَأْتِىَ: و + يَأْتِىَ — wa-, and; yaʾtī, come (subj. 3 m. sg., ى printed for ي); 'and comes'
تَتَقَدَّمُ: taqaddama, advance (form V; impf. 3 f. sg.); 'advancing'
فَتَصْرَعُهَا: فَـ + تَصْرَعُ + هَا — ṣaraʿa, throw down (impf. 3 f. sg.); fa-, 'and then'; -hā, her; 'and she throws her down'
وَتَكْتِفُهَا: و + تَكْتِفُ + هَا — kataf, bind the arms/shoulders (impf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she binds her'
تُصَارِعُهُنَّ: ṣāraʿa, wrestle (form III; impf. 3 f. sg.) + هُنَّ, them (f. pl.); 'she wrestles them'
وَتَصْرَعُهُنَّ: و + تَصْرَعُ + هُنَّ — ṣaraʿa, throw down (impf. 3 f. sg.) + hunna, them; 'and she throws them down'
صَرَعَتِ: ṣaraʿa, throw down (perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra of -t- before الـ)
كَالْمُغْضَبَةِ: كَـ + الـ + مُغْضَبَة — ka-, like, as (prep.); mughḍaba, angered, made angry (pass. part. IV, f.); 'like one made angry'
أَتَفْرَحِينَ: أَ + تَفْرَحِينَ — a-, question particle; fariḥa, rejoice (impf. 2 f. sg.); 'do you rejoice?'
بِصَرْعِكِ: بِـ + صَرْع + كِ — bi-, in, over (prep.; fariḥa bi- 'rejoice in'); ṣarʿ, throwing down (verbal noun); -ki, your (f. sg.); 'in your throwing down'
أَصْرَعْتُهُنَّ: أَصْرَعَ + تُ + هُنَّ — aṣraʿa, throw down (form IV as printed; perf.); -tu, I; -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'I have thrown them'
تَعْجَبِينَ: ʿajiba, be vain, wonder (impf. 2 f. sg.); 'you are vain'
مُصَارَعَتِي: مُصَارَعَة + ي — muṣāraʿa, wrestling (verbal noun of III); -ī, my/me (obj. of the noun); 'wrestling me'
فَصَارِعِينِي: فَـ + صَارِعِي + نِي — fa-, 'then' (answer to the condition); ṣāraʿa, wrestle (imper. f. sg.); -nī, me; 'then wrestle me'
أَقُومَ: qāma, rise, stand up (impf. subj. 1 sg.)
وَأَجْعَلَ: و + أَجْعَلَ — wa-, and; jaʿala, put, place (impf. subj. 1 sg.); 'and put'
رَأْسَكِ: رَأْس + كِ — raʾs, head (m.); -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your head'
رِجْلَيْكِ: رِجْلَيْ + كِ — rijl, leg, foot (f.), dual gen. in construct; -ki, your; 'your two legs'
فَتَبَسَّمَتِ: فَـ + تَبَسَّمَتِ — tabassama, smile (form V; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'so she smiled'
الدَّوَاهِي: الـ + دَوَاهِي — dawāhī, calamities (pl. of dāhiya); dhāt al-dawāhī, 'lady of calamities'
أَتُصَارِعِينَنِي: أَ + تُصَارِعِينَ + نِي — a-, question particle; ṣāraʿa, wrestle (III; impf. 2 f. sg.); -nī, me (with nūn of protection); 'do you wrestle me?'
حَقِيقَةً: ḥaqīqa, truth, reality (f.; acc., adverbial); 'in truth'
تَمْزَحِينَ: mazaḥa, jest, joke (impf. 2 f. sg.); 'you jest'
الْمُبَ——————بَاحِ: الـ + مُبَاح — mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (pass. part. IV; the edition breaks the word with dashes); 'the permitted'
الْبَيْ: الـ + بَيْ(تَيْنِ) — first part of الْبَيْتَيْنِ, al-baytayn, 'the two verses' (the print breaks the word with a dash: بَيْ—تَيْنِ); 'the two verses'
