لِذَاتِ: لِـ + ذَات — li-, to (marks the person spoken to after قَالَ) + dhāt, owner, mistress (f.), first term of the name; 'to Dhāt'
أُصَارِعُكِ: صَارَعَ + كِ — ṣāraʿa, to wrestle; 1st sg. impf. + -ki, you (f.); 'I wrestle you'
إِلَيْهِنَّ: إِلَى + هِنَّ — ilā, to, at (naẓara ilā, 'look at') + -hinna, them (f. pl.); 'at them'
لِلصِّرَاعِ: لِـ + الـ + صِرَاع — li-, for (the purpose of) + al-, the + ṣirāʿ, wrestling (m.); 'for the wrestling'
شَعْرُ: شَعْر — shaʿr, hair (m.); nom., first term of a construct; 'hair of'
قُنْفُذٍ: قُنْفُذ — qunfudh, hedgehog (m.); gen. in construct (the print has a damma on the qāf); 'of a hedgehog'
أُصَارِعْكِ: صَارَعَ + كِ — ṣāraʿa, to wrestle; 1st sg. jussive + -ki, you (f.); 'I (will) wrestle you'
وَفَكَّتْ: و + فَكَّ — wa-, and + fakka, to undo, loosen; 3rd f. sg. perf.; 'and she undid'
لِبَاسَهَا: لِبَاس + هَا — libās, garment, undergarment (m.) + -hā, her; acc.; 'her garment'
وَنَزَعَتْهَا: و + نَزَعَ + هَا — wa-, and + nazaʿa, to pull off; 3rd f. sg. perf. + -hā, them (the clothes); 'and she pulled them off'
وَلَمَّتِ: و + لَمَّ — wa-, and + lamma, to gather up; 3rd f. sg. perf., bridging kasra; 'and she gathered up'
وَشَدَّتْهُ: و + شَدَّ + هُ — wa-, and + shadda, to bind, tie; 3rd f. sg. perf. + -hu, it; 'and she tied it'
عِفْرِيتَةٌ: عِفْرِيتَة — ʿifrīta, she-ʿifrīt, a powerful malign jinn (f.); nom. predicate after كَأَنَّ; 'a she-ʿifrīt'
مَعْطَاءُ: مَعْطَاء — maʿṭāʾ, hairless, bald (f. of amʿaṭ; Lane; reading uncertain); diptote; 'hairless'
أَوْحَيَّةٌ: أَوْ + حَيَّة — aw, or + ḥayya, snake (f.), printed run together; 'or a snake'
رَقْطَاءُ: رَقْطَاء — raqṭāʾ, speckled (f. of arqaṭ); diptote; 'speckled'
انْحَنَتْ: اِنْحَنَى — inḥanā, to bend over (form VII); 3rd f. sg. perf.; 'she bent'
كَفِعْلِي: كَـ + فِعْل + ي — ka-, like, as (prep., 'like my doing') + fiʿl, doing, deed (m.) + -ī, my; 'like my doing'
يَتَأَمَّلُ: تَأَمَّلَ — taʾammala, to contemplate, gaze (form V); 3rd m. sg. impf.; 'he gazes'
تَشْوِيهِ: تَشْوِيه — tashwīh, disfigurement, deforming (m.); gen. after فِي; 'the disfiguring of'
وَيَضْحَكُ: و + يَضْحَكُ — wa-, and + yaḍḥaku (ḍaḥika, to laugh; 3rd m. sg. impf.); 'and (he) laughs'
مَهَلٍ: مَهَل — mahal, leisure, slowness (m.); gen. after عَلَى; ʿalā mahalin, 'at leisure, without haste'
فُوطَةً: فُوطَة — fūṭa, waist-wrap, cloth (f.); acc. object; 'a waist-wrap'
وَثَنَّتْهَا: و + ثَنَّى + هَا — wa-, and + thannā, to double, fold (form II); 3rd f. sg. perf. + -hā, it (the wrap); the print has the shadda; 'and she doubled it'
سَاقَانِ: سَاقَان — sāq, leg, shank (f.), dual nom.; 'two legs'
وَفَوْقَهُمَا: و + فَوْقَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + fawqa, above (adv./prep., acc.) + -humā, the two of them; 'and above them'
كَثِيبٌ: كَثِيب — kathīb, sand-dune, mound (m.); nom.; 'a dune'
نَاعِمٌ: نَاعِم — nāʿim, soft, smooth (m.); nom. adj.; 'soft'
مُرَبْرَبٌ: مُرَبْرَب — murabrab, plump, fleshy (m.; uncertain, cf. Lane under ربرب); 'plump'
وَبَطْنٌ: و + بَطْن — wa-, and + baṭn, belly (m.); nom.; 'and a belly'
أَعْكَانِهِ: أَعْكَان + هُ — aʿkān, folds of the belly (pl. of ʿukna) + -hi, its; gen. after مِنْ; 'its folds'
بِشَقَائِقِ: بِـ + شَقَائِق — bi-, with (marks what covers it: 'overlaid with') + shaqāʾiq, anemones (pl. of shaqīqa); gen.; 'with anemones'
رَفِيهِ: رَفِيهِ — rafīhi; as printed, apparently corrupt (probably فِيهِ, 'in it', with a stray ر); see the note
نَهْدَانِ: نَهْدَان — nahd, breast (m.), dual nom.; 'two breasts'
كَفَحْلَيْ: كَـ + فَحْلَيْ — ka-, like (prep.) + faḥlay, the two stallions, males (faḥl, m.; dual gen., construct); 'like two stallions of'
وَتَمَاسَكَا: و + تَمَاسَكَا — wa-, and + tamāsakā (tamāsaka, to grip each other, form VI; 3rd m. dual perf.); 'and the two held fast'
بِبَعْضِهِمَا: بِـ + بَعْض + هِمَا — bi-, with (what is held: tamāsaka bi-, 'hold fast to') + baʿḍ, some, part + -humā, the two; 'each to the other' ; also: after ashbah, 'more like', bi- marks the one resembled: ashbaha al-nāsi bi-baʿḍihimā, 'more like each other than anyone'
تَغْلِبُ: غَلَبَ — ghalaba, to overcome, defeat; 3rd f. sg. impf.; 'she overcomes'
شِقَّتِهَا: شِقَّة + هَا — shiqqa, side, portion (f.), here probably 'cleft' (see the note) + -hā, her; gen. after فِي; 'her cleft'
وَيَدَهَا: و + يَد + هَا — wa-, and + yad, hand (f.) + -hā, her; acc. object; 'and her hand'
وَرَفَعَتْهَا: و + رَفَعَ + هَا — wa-, and + rafaʿa, to lift; 3rd f. sg. perf. + -hā, her; 'and she lifted her'
فَانْفَلَتَتِ: فَـ + اِنْفَلَتَتِ — fa-, and then + infalatat (infalata, to slip away, escape, form VII; 3rd f. sg. perf., bridging kasra); 'and she slipped away'
وَأَرَادَتِ: و + أَرَادَتِ — wa-, and + aradat (arāda, to want, form IV; 3rd f. sg. perf., bridging kasra); 'and she wanted'
فَارْتَفَعَتْ: فَـ + اِرْتَفَعَتْ — fa-, and then + irtafaʿat (irtafaʿa, to rise up, form VIII; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and (they) rose'
رِجْلَاهَا: رِجْلَا + هَا — rijl, leg, foot (f.), dual nom. + -hā, her; 'her two legs'
شِعْرَتُهَا: شِعْرَة + هَا — shiʿra, pubic hair, mons (f.) + -hā, her; nom. subject of بَانَ; 'her pubic hair'
فَضَرَطَتْ: فَـ + ضَرَطَتْ — fa-, and then + ḍaraṭat (ḍaraṭa, to fart; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she farted'
ضَرْطَتَيْنِ: ضَرْطَتَيْنِ — ḍarṭatayni, two farts (ḍarṭa, a fart (f.); dual acc., cognate object); 'two farts'
عَفَّرَتْ: عَفَّرَ — ʿaffara, to strew with dust (form II); 3rd f. sg. perf.; 'it raised dust on'
وَدَخَّنَتِ: و + دَخَّنَتِ — wa-, and + dakhkhanat (dakhkhana, to send up smoke, form II; 3rd f. sg. perf., bridging kasra); 'and (it) smoked'
حُسَامَهُ: حُسَام + هُ — ḥusām, sword (m.) + -hu, his; acc. object; 'his sword'
مَرْمِيَّةً: مَرْمِيَّة — marmiyya, thrown, cast down (f. pass. part. of ramā); acc. circumstantial; 'lying thrown'
مَاكَذَبَ: مَا + كَذَبَ — mā, not (negative particle) + kadhaba, to lie; 3rd m. sg. perf., printed run together; 'he did not lie'
سَمَّاكِ: سَمَّى + كِ — sammā, to name (form II); 3rd m. sg. perf. + -ki, you (f.); 'named you'
قُوَّتَهَا: قُوَّة + هَا — quwwa, strength (f.) + -hā, her; acc. object; 'her strength'
غَيْرِكِ: غَيْر + كِ — ghayr, other than (m.) + -ki, you (f.); gen. after مَعَ; 'other than you'
تَقَرَّبَ: تَقَرَّبَ — taqarraba, to draw near (form V); 3rd m. sg. perf.; 'he drew near'
لِيَسْمَعَ: لِـ + يَسْمَعَ — li-, in order to (purpose, + subjunctive) + yasmaʿa (samiʿa, to hear; 3rd m. sg.); 'in order to hear'
فَأَقْبَلَتِ: فَـ + أَقْبَلَتِ — fa-, and then + aqbalat (aqbala, to come forward, form IV; 3rd f. sg. perf., bridging kasra); 'and she came forward'
رَفِيعَةً: رَفِيعَة — rafīʿa, fine, thin (f.); acc. adj.; 'fine'
وَاعْتَذَرَتْ: و + اِعْتَذَرَ — wa-, and + iʿtadhara, to apologise, make excuses (form VIII); 3rd f. sg. perf.; 'and she apologised'
إِلَّاصَرْعَكِ: إِلَّا + صَرْع + كِ — illā, except + ṣarʿ, throwing down (verbal noun of ṣaraʿa, m.; acc.) + -ki, your (f.), printed run together; 'nothing but your throwing'
لَاجَمِيعَ: لَا + جَمِيع — lā, not (negates the noun that follows) + jamīʿ, all (m.; acc.), printed run together; 'not all of'
إِنَّكِ: إِنَّ + كِ — inna, indeed, that (particle) + -ki, you (f.); 'that you'
انْفَلَتِّ: اِنْفَلَتَ + تِ — infalata, to slip away (form VII) + -ti, you (f.) (the root t and the ending -ti merged; the print has kasra and shadda); 'you slipped away'
خَجَلِهَا: خَجَل + هَا — khajal, shame, embarrassment (m.) + -hā, her; gen. after مِنْ, which gives the cause; 'out of her shame'
مَاشِيَةً: مَاشِيَة — māshiya, walking (f. active part. of mashā); acc. predicate; 'walking'
مُكَتَّفَاتٍ: مُكَتَّفَات — mukattafāt, with arms bound (f. pl. pass. part. of kattafa, form II); acc. predicate; 'bound'
مَرْمِيَّاتٍ: مَرْمِيَّات — marmiyyāt, thrown down (f. pl. pass. part. of ramā); acc. predicate; 'flung down'
وَاقِفَةٌ: وَاقِفَة — wāqifa, standing (f. active part. of waqafa); nom. predicate; 'standing'
رِزْقٍ: rizq, provision, livelihood (m.; gen. after kull)
وَسَارَبِي: وَ + سَارَ + بِـ + ي — wa-, and; sāra, he went (verb I); bi-, with (prep.: 'with me', i.e. 'bearing me') + -ī, me; 'and went with me'; the edition prints it as one word
لِبَخْتِي: لِـ + بَخْت + ي — li-, for, because of (prep.: 'except for my luck', i.e. the cause) + bakht, luck, fortune (m.; Persian loan) + -ī, my
غَنِيمَةً: ghanīma, booty, spoil (f.; acc. indef., predicate)
وَرَكِبَهُ: وَ + رَكِبَ + هُ — wa-, and; rakiba, he rode (verb I) + -hu, it; 'and mounted it'
وَلَكَزَهُ: وَ + لَكَزَ + هُ — wa-, and; lakaza, to jab, strike with the heel (verb I) + -hu, it
فَقَرَّبَهُ: فَـ + قَرَّبَ + هُ — fa-, and so; qarraba, to bring near, of a horse to put it to the gait called taqrīb (verb II) + -hu, it
كَالسَّهْمِ: كَـ + الـ + سَهْم — ka-, like (prep., introducing the comparison) + sahm, arrow; 'like the arrow'
فَرَّ: farra, to flee, spring away (verb I, 3 m.s. past)
حُسَامُهُ: حُسَام + هُ — ḥusām, sword (m.) + -hu, his; subject
عَرْضُهُ: عَرْض + هُ — ʿarḍ, breadth (m.) + -hu, its; subject of kāna
بِذِرَاعِ: بِـ + ذِرَاع — bi-, by (prep.: 'by the measure of') + dhirāʿ, cubit, forearm (m.; construct)
الْعَمَلِ: الـ + عَمَل — ʿamal, work; 'the working cubit', i.e. the builders' standard
وَوَثَبَتْ: وَ + وَثَبَتْ — wa-, and; wathaba, to leap (verb I, 3 f.s. past)
وَنَادَتْ: وَ + نَادَتْ — wa-, and; nādā, to call out (verb III, 3 f.s. past)
بِرَفِيعِ: بِـ + رَفِيع — bi-, with (prep., of manner: 'with the raised …') + rafīʿ, high, raised (adj.; construct, gen.)
صَوْتِهَا: صَوْت + هَا — ṣawt, voice (m.) + -hā, her; 'with her raised voice', i.e. loudly
يَاهَذَا: يَا + هَذَا — yā, O (vocative particle); hādhā, this (one); 'you there'; the edition prints it as one word
قَاطِعًا: qāṭiʿ, cutting off, interrupting (act. part. of qaṭaʿa; acc. predicate of kunta)
سُرُورَنَا: سُرُور + نَا — surūr, joy, pleasure (m.; object) + -nā, our
وَحِينَ: وَ + حِينَ — wa-, and; ḥīna, when, at the time that (acc. adverb)
قَهَرْتَ: qahara, to overpower, subdue (verb I, 2 m.s. past)
حَمَلْتَ: ḥamala ʿalā, to charge at, attack (verb I, 2 m.s. past)
وَأَىَّ: وَ + أَىّ — wa-, and; ayy, which, what (interrog.; acc. as object, printed with ى)
فَاصْدُقْ: فَـ + اصْدُقْ — fa-, so; uṣduq, be truthful! (imp. of ṣadaqa, verb I)
مَقَالِكَ: مَقَال + كَ — maqāl, speech, saying (m.; gen. after fī) + -ka, your
الصِّدْقَ: الـ + صِدْق — ṣidq, truth, truthfulness (m.; acc. after inna)
أَنْفَعُ: anfaʿ, more useful (elative of nāfiʿ; nom. predicate)
تَكْذِبْ: kadhaba, to lie (verb I, 2 m.s. jussive)
أَخْلَاقِ: akhlāq, character traits, manners (pl. of khuluq; construct, gen.)
وَلَاشَكَّ: وَ + لَا + شَكَّ — wa-, and; lā, no (negating the genus); shakk, doubt (m.; acc.); 'and no doubt'; the edition prints it as one word
تِهْتَ: tāha, to lose one's way, go astray (verb I, 2 m.s. past)
خَلَاصُكَ: خَلَاص + كَ — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m.; nom.) + -ka, your
الْغَنِيمَاتِ: الـ + غَنِيمَات — ghanīmāt, booties, gains (f. pl. of ghanīma; gen.)
صَرَخْنَا: ṣarakha, to cry out (verb I, 1 pl. past)
لَجَاءَ: لَـ + جَاءَ — la-, particle opening the apodosis of law ('then …'); jāʾa, he came (verb I, 3 m.s. past)
بِطْرِيقٍ: biṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine noble or officer (Greek patrikios; gen. sing. after the number); the bi- belongs to the word and is not a preposition
نَهْدِيَكَ: هَدَى + كَ — hadā, to guide (verb I, 1 pl. subj.) + -ka, you
هَدَيْنَاكَ: هَدَى + كَ — hadā, to guide (verb I, 1 pl. past, answering the condition: 'we will guide') + -ka, you
الرِّفْدَ: الـ + رِفْد — rifd, gift, help, support (m.; acc.)
أَرْفَدْنَاكَ: أَرْفَدَ + نَا + كَ — arfada, to aid, give a gift (verb IV, 1 pl. past, as the promise) + -ka, you
أَجِلْ: ajil, as printed; by the sense a misprint for أَجِدْ (ajid), 'I find' (wajada, verb I, 1 s. jussive)
الْعَشْرَةِ: الـ + عَشْرَة — ʿashra, ten (f.; gen., apposed to the girls)
فَآخُذُهُنَّ: فَـ + آخُذُ + هُنَّ — fa-, and so; ākhudhu, I take (verb I, 1 s. imperf.) + -hunna, them (f. pl.)
وَأَلْحَقُ: وَ + أَلْحَقُ — wa-, and; alḥaqu, I join, go along (laḥiqa, verb I, 1 s. imperf.)
بِهِنَّ: بِـ + هِنَّ — bi-, with (prep. chosen by laḥiqa: 'join with') + -hinna, them (f. pl.) Also after ʿilm, 'knowledge', bi- marks what is known: lā ʿilma lanā bihinna, 'we know nothing of them'.; here in verse, bi- of the means, 'by them', the eight virtues
غَنِيمَتُكَ: غَنِيمَة + كَ — ghanīma, booty (f.; nom. predicate) + -ka, your
شَيْنٌ: shayn, blemish, disgrace (m.; nom. indef., predicate)
الْعَاقِلُ: الـ + عَاقِل — ʿāqil, wise, prudent (act. part. of ʿaqala; nom., subject)
يَعْتَبِرُ: iʿtabara, to take warning, learn from an example (verb VIII, 3 m.s. imperf.)
هَلَاكُكَ: هَلَاك + كَ — halāk, destruction, death (m.; nom.) + -ka, your
صِحْتُ: ṣāḥa, to cry out (verb I, 1 s. past)
الْمَرْجَ: الـ + مَرْج — marj, meadow (m.; acc., object)
وَرِجَالًا: وَ + رِجَال — wa-, and; rijāl, men, men on foot (pl. of rajul; acc. indef.)
أُشْفِقُ: ashfaqa ʿalā, to feel pity for (verb IV, 1 s. imperf.)
تَنْزِلَ: nazala, to dismount (verb I, 2 m.s. subj.)
جَوَادِكَ: جَوَاد + كَ — jawād, steed (m.; gen.) + -ka, your
وَتَحْلِفَ: وَ + تَحْلِفَ — wa-, and; ḥalafa, to swear (verb I, 2 m.s. subj., governed by the same an)
بِدِينِكَ: بِـ + دِين + كَ — bi-, by (prep. of the oath); dīn, religion, faith (m.) + -ka, your; 'by your religion'
لَاتَتَقَرَّبُ: لَا + تَتَقَرَّبُ — lā, not; taqarraba, to draw near (verb V, 2 m.s. imperf.); the edition prints it as one word
بِشَيُ: بِـ + شَيُ — bi-, with (prep.: 'with anything', instrument); shayʾ, thing (m.), printed شيُ with a damma on the yā, a slip for شَيْء
وَأَتَصَارَعَ: وَ + أَتَصَارَعَ — wa-, and; taṣāraʿa, to wrestle together (verb VI, 1 s. subj., governed by the same an)
صَرَعْتَنِي: صَرَعَ + تَ + نِي — ṣaraʿa, to throw down (verb I) + -ta, you (m.s. past) + -nī, me
فَضَعْنِي: فَـ + ضَعْ + نِي — fa-, then (answering the condition); ḍaʿ, put! (imp. of waḍaʿa) + -nī, me
وَخُذْنَا: وَ + خُذْ + نَا — wa-, and; khudh, take! (imp. of akhadha) + -nā, us
صَرَعْتُكَ: صَرَعَ + تُ + كَ — ṣaraʿa, to throw down (verb I) + -tu, I (past) + -ka, you
أَتَحَكَّمُ: taḥakkama, to exercise authority (verb V, 1 s. imperf.; the answer to the condition)
فَاحْلِفْ: فَـ + احْلِفْ — fa-, so; iḥlif, swear! (imp. of ḥalafa, verb I)
غَدْرِكَ: غَدْر + كَ — ghadr, treachery (m.; gen.) + -ka, your
الْغَدْرُ: الـ + غَدْر — ghadr, treachery (m.; nom., subject of kāna)
طِبَاعًا: ṭibāʿ, nature, disposition (m.; acc. indef., predicate of kāna)
الثِّقَةَ: الـ + ثِقَة — thiqa, trust, confidence (f.; acc. after inna)
عَجْزٌ: ʿajz, incapacity, weakness (m.; nom. indef., predicate)
عَدَيْتُ: ʿadā, to cross over, run across (verb I, 1 s. past, as the promise: 'I will cross')
طَمِعَ: ṭamiʿa fī, to covet (verb I, 3 m.s. past)
أَخْذِهَا: أَخْذ + هَا — akhdh, taking, seizing (m. verbal noun; gen.) + -hā, her
بَطَلٌ: baṭal, hero, champion (m.; nom. indef., predicate)
الْأَبْطَالِ: الـ + أَبْطَال — abṭāl, heroes (pl. of baṭal; gen.)
نَادَاهَا: نَادَى + هَا — nādā, to call (verb III, 3 m.s. past) + -hā, her
حَلِّفِينِي: حَلَّفَ + ي + نِي — ḥallafa, to make swear (verb II; imp. 2 f.s., with the printed marks on ḥā and lām) + -nī, me
تَثِقِينَ: wathiqa, to trust (verb I, 2 f.s. imperf.)
أَقْرَبُكِ: قَرِبَ + كِ — qaraba, to approach (verb I, 1 s. imperf.) + -ki, you (f.)
تَأْخُذِي: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, 2 f.s. subj.)
أُهْبَتَكِ: أُهْبَة + كِ — uhba, equipment, readiness (f.; object) + -ki, your (f.)
وَتَقُولِي: وَ + تَقُولِي — wa-, and; qāla, to say (verb I, 2 f.s. subj.)
لِأُصَارِعَكِ: لِـ + أُصَارِعَ + كِ — li-, so that, in order to (purpose); uṣāriʿa, I wrestle (verb III, 1 s. subj.) + -ki, you (f.)
فَحِينَئِذٍ: فَـ + حِينَئِذٍ — fa-, then; ḥīna-ʾidhin, at that time, only then
أَتَقَرَّبُ: taqarraba, to draw near (verb V, 1 s. imperf.)
صَرَعْتِنِي: صَرَعَ + تِ + نِي — ṣaraʿa, to throw down (verb I) + -ti, you (f.s. past) + -nī, me
صَرَعْتُكِ: صَرَعَ + تُ + كِ — ṣaraʿa, to throw down (verb I) + -tu, I (past) + -ki, you (f.)
احْلِفِ: احْلِفْ — iḥlif, swear! (I, imperative 2ms, ḥalafa); the final kasra is a linking vowel before al-
الْأَرْوَاحَ: الـ + أَرْوَاح — arwāḥ, spirits, souls (pl. of rūḥ), accusative object; 'the spirits'
الْأَشْبَاحِ: الـ + أَشْبَاح — ashbāḥ, bodies, forms (pl. of shabaḥ), genitive after fī; 'the bodies'
وَشَرَعَ: و + شَرَعَ — wa-, and + sharaʿa, he laid down, enacted (I, perfect 3ms)
الشَّرَائِعَ: الـ + شَرَائِع — sharāʾiʿ, laws, ordinances (pl. of sharīʿa), accusative object; 'the laws'
لِلْأَنَامِ: لِـ + الـ + أَنَام — li-, for (prep., dative of benefit) + al- + anām, mankind, creatures (m. collective), genitive; 'for mankind'
لَوْتَتَعَرَّضُ: لَوْ + تَتَعَرَّضُ — law, if (particle) + tataʿarraḍu, you expose yourself, make an attempt (V, imperfect 2ms); printed as one word; 'if you make an attempt'
بِسُوءٍ: بِـ + سُوء — bi-, with, by way of (prep., marking what the attempt consists in) + sūʾ, evil, harm (m.), genitive tanwīn; 'with harm'
الْمُصَارَعَةِ: الـ + مُصَارَعَة — muṣāraʿa, wrestling (f., III verbal noun), genitive in construct with ghayr; 'the wrestling'
غَيْرِدِينِ: غَيْر + دِين — ghayr, other than (m.) + dīn, religion (m.), both genitive in construct; printed as one word; 'other than the religion of'
لَوْحَلَّفَنِي: لَوْ + حَلَّفَ + نِي — law, if + ḥallafa, he made (someone) swear (II, perfect 3ms) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'if (a judge) made me swear'
قَاضِى: قَاضِى — qāḍī, judge (m.), predicate of kāna and head of the construct, spelled with final ى as printed; 'the judge of'
يُحَلِّفْنِي: يُحَلِّفْ + نِي — yuḥallif, he makes swear (II, jussive 3ms after lam) + -nī, me; 'he would not make me swear'
الْأَيْمَانِ: الـ + أَيْمَان — aymān, oaths (pl. of yamīn), genitive; 'the oaths'
ذَكَرَتْهُ: ذَكَرَتْ + هُ — dhakarat, she mentioned (I, perfect 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she mentioned it'
وَرَبَطَ: و + رَبَطَ — wa-, and + rabaṭa, he tied, tethered (I, perfect 3ms)
بَحْرِالِافْتِكَارِ: بَحْر + الـ + افْتِكَار — baḥr, sea (m.) + al- + iftikār, reflection, pondering (m., VIII verbal noun); printed as one word, genitive construct; 'sea of reflection'
مَهِينٍ: مَهِين — mahīn, lowly, contemptible (adj. m.), genitive tanwīn; 'lowly'
أُهْبَتَهُ: أُهْبَة + هُ — uhba, equipment, readiness (f.), accusative object + -hu, his; 'his equipment'
وَاعْبُرِي: و + اعْبُرِي — wa-, and + iʿburī, cross! (I, imperative 2fs, ʿabara); 'and cross!'
عُبُورٌ: عُبُور — ʿubūr, crossing (m., verbal noun), nominative indefinite, subject of laysa; 'a crossing'
فَاعْبُرْأَنْتَ: فَـ + اعْبُرْ + أَنْتَ — fa-, then (introducing the main clause) + iʿbur, cross! (I, imperative 2ms) + anta, you (pron., for emphasis); printed as one word; 'then cross, you'
أَتَا: أَتَا — atā, the print's slip for أَنَا anā, I (pron. 1s.)
أَذْ: أَذْ — adh, first piece of the misdivided أَذْيَالَهَا (adh-yā-lahā), 'her skirts'
وَقَفَزَتْ: و + قَفَزَتْ — wa-, and + qafazat, she leapt (I, perfect 3fs)
انْحَنٰي: انْحَنَى — inḥanā, he bent, stooped (VII, perfect 3ms), spelled with ي as printed, the dagger alif marking the long vowel
اغْتَرَفَتْهَا: اغْتَرَفَتْ + هَا — ightarafat, she scooped up, ladled (VIII, perfect 3fs; subject yad al-qudra) + -hā, it (the form); 'had scooped it up'
الْقُدْرَةِ: الـ + قُدْرَة — qudra, power (f.), genitive; 'of Power'
بِوَرَقَةِ: بِـ + وَرَقَة — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + waraqa, leaf (f.), genitive in construct; 'with a leaf of'
الْجَانِ: الـ + جَان — jān, jinn (or a kind of serpent; possibly a slip for الجنان, 'the gardens'), genitive; 'of the Jān'
وَرَبَّتْهَا: و + رَبَّتْ + هَا — wa-, and + rabbat, she reared, nursed (II, perfect 3fs; subject yad al-ʿināya) + -hā, it; 'and reared it'
الْعِنَايَةِ: الـ + عِنَايَة — ʿināya, care, providence (f.), genitive; 'of Providence'
وَهَبَّتْ: و + هَبَّتْ — wa-, and + habbat, it blew (I, perfect 3fs, habba)
نَسَمَاتُ: نَسَمَات — nasamāt, breezes, breaths (pl. of nasama), nominative, in construct; 'the breezes of'
السُّعُودِ: الـ + سُعُود — suʿūd, felicities, good fortunes (pl. of saʿd), genitive; 'of good fortune'
وَقَابَلَهَا: و + قَابَلَ + هَا — wa-, and + qābala, he/it met, faced (III, perfect 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and met her'
خِلْقَتِهَا: خِلْقَة + هَا — khilqa, creation, making (f.), genitive in construct + -hā, her; 'her creation'
وَنَادَتْهُ: و + نَادَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + nādat, she called (III, perfect 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and called him'
مُسْلِمُ: مُسْلِم — muslim, Muslim (m., IV active participle), vocative after yā; 'Muslim'
الصِّرَاعِ: الـ + صِرَاع — ṣirāʿ, wrestling (m.), genitive after ilā; 'the wrestling'
يَطْلُعَ: يَطْلُعَ — yaṭluʿa, it rises (I, subjunctive 3ms, ṭalaʿa); also: 'come out, emerge': ḥattā yaṭlaʿa min ẓahrī, 'until it comes out through my back' (Night 179)
سَاعِدٍ: سَاعِد — sāʿid, forearm (m.), genitive tanwīn after ʿan; 'a forearm'
دَنُّهُ: دَنّ + هُ — dann (obscure; possibly corrupt for كَأَنَّهُ ka-annahu, 'as if') + -hu, its/his; 'as if it'
الْجُبْنِّ: الـ + جُبْن — jubn, cheese (m.), with the print's shadda on the nūn; 'the cheese'
وَانْحَنَى: و + انْحَنَى — wa-, and + inḥanā, he bent (VII, perfect 3ms)
وَصَفَّقَتِ: و + صَفَّقَتِ — wa-, and + ṣaffaqat, she clapped (II, perfect 3fs); the final kasra is a linking vowel before al-
وَتَعَانَقَا: و + تَعَانَقَا — wa-, and + taʿānaqā, they two embraced (VI, perfect 3 dual)
وَتَعَارَكَا: و + تَعَارَكَا — wa-, and + taʿārakā, they two grappled (VI, perfect 3 dual)
فَوَضَعَ: فَـ + وَضَعَ — fa-, then + waḍaʿa, he put (I, perfect 3ms)
خَصْرِهَا: خَصْر + هَا — khaṣr, waist (m.), genitive after ʿalā + -hā, her; 'her waist'
النَّحِيلِ: الـ + نَحِيل — naḥīl, slender; thin, wasted (adj. m.), genitive; 'the slender'; of a lover's body, 'the wasted'
فَغَاصَتْ: فَـ + غَاصَتْ — fa-, and so + ghāṣat, it sank (I, perfect 3fs, ghāṣa)
مِلُهُ: مِلُ + هُ — second piece of the misdivided أَنَامِلُهُ (anā-miluhu), anāmil, fingertips (pl.), nominative + -hu, his; 'his fingertips'
طَبَقَاتِ: طَبَقَات — ṭabaqāt, layers, folds (pl. of ṭabaqa), genitive in construct after fī; 'the folds of'
وَاسْتَرْخَتْ: و + اسْتَرْخَتْ — wa-, and + istarkhat, it went slack (X, perfect 3fs)
أَعْضَاؤُهُ: أَعْضَاء + هُ — aʿḍāʾ, limbs (pl. of ʿuḍw), nominative (the print spells the hamza with a waw) + -hu, his; 'his limbs'
مَقَامِ: مَقَام — maqām, station, standing-place (m.), genitive after ʿalā, in construct; 'a station of'
الْحَسْرَةِ: الـ + حَسْرَة — ḥasra, regret, dismay (f.), genitive; 'of regret'
الْفَتْرَةُ: الـ + فَتْرَة — fatra, languor, slackness (f.), nominative; 'the languor'
الْقَصَبَةِ: الـ + قَصَبَة — qaṣaba, reed (f.), genitive in construct; 'the reed'
الْفَارِسِيَّةِ: الـ + فَارِسِيَّة — fārisiyya, Persian (f. adj.), genitive; 'Persian'
الْعَاصِفِ: الـ + عَاصِف — ʿāṣif, raging, blustering (act. part. m.), genitive adjective; 'raging'
فَرَفَعَتْهُ: فَـ + رَفَعَتْ + هُ — fa-, then + rafaʿat, she lifted (I, perfect 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and lifted him'
بِكَفَلٍ: بِـ + كَفَل — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment: sat 'with a rump') + kafal, rump, haunches (m.), genitive tanwīn; 'with a rump'
كَثِيبُ: كَثِيب — kathīb, dune, heap of sand (m.), nominative predicate, in construct; 'a dune of'
يَمْلِكْ: يَمْلِكْ — yamlik, he controls, possesses (I, jussive 3ms after lam, malaka)
النَّصَارَى: الـ + نَصَارَى — naṣārā, Christians (pl. of naṣrānī); 'the Christians'
قَوْلُكِ: قَوْل + كِ — qawl, saying (m.), nominative + -ki, your (f.); 'your saying'
إِلَّاحَرَامٌ: إِلَّا + حَرَام — illā, except, nothing but (particle) + ḥarām, forbidden (m.); printed as one word; 'nothing but forbidden'
نَبِيَّنَا: نَبِيّ + نَا — nabī, prophet (m.), accusative after inna + -nā, our; 'our Prophet'
نَهَى: نَهَى — nahā, he forbade (I, perfect 3ms); nahā ʿan 'forbid (the doing of)'
النِّسْوَانِ: الـ + نِسْوَان — niswān, women (pl.), genitive; 'the women'
وَالصِّبْيَانِ: و + الـ + صِبْيَان — wa-, and + al- + ṣibyān, boys, children (pl. of ṣabī); 'and the children'
وَالشُّيُوخِ: و + الـ + شُيُوخ — wa-, and + al- + shuyūkh, old men, elders (pl. of shaykh); 'and the elders'
وَالرُّهْبَانِ: و + الـ + رُهْبَان — wa-, and + al- + ruhbān, monks (pl. of rāhib); 'and the monks'
نَبِيُّكُمْ: نَبِيّ + كُمْ — nabī, prophet (m.), nominative + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your prophet'
أُوحِيَ: أُوحِيَ — ūḥiya, it was revealed (IV, passive perfect 3ms, awḥā), spelled with final ي as printed
فَيَنْبَغِي: فَـ + يَنْبَغِي — fa-, then (introducing the main clause) + yanbaghī, it is fitting (VII, imperfect 3ms); 'then it is fitting'
نُكَافِئَهُ: نُكَافِئ + هُ — nukāfiʾa, we requite, repay (III, subjunctive 1pl. after an) + -hu, him; 'that we repay him'
يَضِيعُ: يَضِيعُ — yaḍīʿu, it is lost, wasted (I, imperfect 3ms, ḍāʿa)
الْإِنْسَانِ: الـ + إِنْسَان — insān, human being (m.), genitive after ʿinda; 'the human being'
الْإِحْسَانُ: الـ + إِحْسَان — iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (m., IV verbal noun), nominative subject; 'the kindness'
يَنْفُضُ: يَنْفُضُ — yanfuḍu, shake off (v. I, 3ms imperfect), circumstantial; 'shaking off'
ذَوَاتِ: ذَوَات — dhawāt, possessors-of, those having (f. pl. of dhāt), genitive after مِنْ; 'those of'
الضِّلَعِ: الـ + ضِّلَع — al-, the + ḍilaʿ, rib (m./f.), genitive; 'the rib'
الْأَعْوَجِ: الـ + أَعْوَج — al-, the + aʿwaj, crooked, bent (adj.); 'the crooked'
الْأَمَانَتْ: الـ + أَمَانَتْ — al-, the + amānat, trust, deposit, trustworthiness (f.); Middle Arabic spelling with tā for tā marbūṭa, pointed in pause; 'the trust'
تَخْجَلْ: تَخْجَلْ — takhjal, be ashamed, shy (v. I, 2ms jussive after لَا); 'do not be ashamed'
وَيُعِينُ: وَ + يُعِينُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuʿīnu, help, aid (v. IV, 3ms imperfect); 'and helping'
مَاهِيَ: مَا + هِيَ — mā, not (neg.) + hiya, it (pron. 3fs); printed as one word; 'it is not'
لِضَعْفِ: لِـ + ضَعْف — li-, because of (prep., marks the cause) + ḍaʿf, weakness (m.), genitive in construct; 'because of weakness of'
قُوَّتِي: قُوَّة + ـِي — quwwa, strength (f.) + -ī, my; 'my strength'
بِقُوَّتِكِ: بِـ + قُوَّة + كِ — bi-, by means of (prep., instrument) + quwwa, strength (f.) + -ki, your (f.); 'by your strength'
جَمَالُكِ: جَمَال + كِ — jamāl, beauty (m.) + -ki, your (f.), nominative subject; 'your beauty'
صَرَعَنِي: صَرَعَ + نِي — ṣaraʿa, throw down (v. I, 3ms perfect) + -nī, me; 'threw me down'
أَنْعَمْتِ: أَنْعَمْتِ — anʿamti, bestow a favour, show grace (v. IV, 2fs perfect); 'you would favour'
بِدَسْتٍ: بِـ + دَسْت — bi-, with (prep., marks what is bestowed after أَنْعَمَ إِلَى) + dast, bout, round (m., Persian dast, 'hand'); 'with a bout'
آخَرَ: آخَر — ākhar, another, other (adj., diptote), genitive in -a after بِـ; 'another'
أَجَبْتُكَ: أَجَبْتُ + كَ — ajāba, answer, grant a request (v. IV), 1s perfect -tu + -ka, you (m.); 'I have granted you'
الْكِتَافُ: الـ + كِتَاف — al-, the + kitāf, binding by the shoulders, pinioning (m.), nominative; 'the pinioning'
السَّوَاعِدُ: الـ + سَّوَاعِد — al-, the + sawāʿid, forearms (pl. of sāʿid), nominative; 'the forearms'
وَالْأَطْرَافُ: وَ + الـ + أَطْرَاف — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aṭrāf, extremities, limbs (pl. of ṭaraf), nominative; 'and the limbs'
وَالصَّوَابُ: وَ + الـ + صَّوَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṣawāb, the right course (m.), nominative; 'and the right course'
أَحُلُّهُمْ: أَحُلُّ + هُمْ — aḥullu, untie, loose (v. I, 1s imperfect; the shadda is printed) + -hum, them (m.); 'I loose them'
فَلَرُبَّمَا: فَ + لَ + رُبَّمَا — fa-, for (conj., gives the ground) + la-, emphatic lām + rubbamā, perhaps, it may be that; 'for it may well be'
الصِّرَاعُ: الـ + صِّرَاع — al-, the + ṣirāʿ, wrestling (m.), nominative; 'the wrestling'
الدَّسْتِ: الـ + دَّسْت — al-, the + dast, bout, round (m., Persian), genitive after فِي; 'the bout'
وَحَلَّتْ: وَ + حَلَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥalla, untie, loosen (v. I, 3fs perfect; the shadda is printed); 'and she loosed'
أَكْتَافَهُنَّ: أَكْتَاف + هُنَّ — aktāf, shoulders, shoulder-bonds (pl. of katif/kitf), accusative + -hunna, their (f.); 'their shoulder-bonds'
وَقَلَٰتْ: وَ + قَلَٰتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + qālat, say (v. I, 3fs perfect); printed قلت without alif, pointed with dagger alif; 'and she said'
تَأْمَنَّ: تَأْمَنَّ — taʾmanna, be safe, secure (v. I, 2fp imperfect; nūn of the stem + feminine plural -na, the shadda is printed), relative clause on 'a place'; 'you are safe'
أَنْفُسِكُنَّ: أَنْفُس + كُنَّ — anfus, selves (pl. of nafs), genitive after عَلَى + -kunna, your (f. pl.); 'yourselves' (ʿalā anfusikunna, 'for yourselves')
يَنْقَطِعَ: يَنْقَطِعَ — yanqaṭiʿa, be cut off, cease (v. VII, 3ms subjunctive after حَتَّى); 'is cut off'
فَذَهَبْنَ: فَ + ذَهَبْنَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + dhahaba, go away (v. I), 3fp perfect -na; 'so they went'
يَتَفَرَّجْنَ: يَتَفَرَّجْنَ — yatafarrajna, watch as a spectacle (v. V, 3fp imperfect); 'watching'
دَنَا: دَنَا — danā, draw near, close in (v. I, 3ms perfect); 'drew near'
بِصَاحِبِهِ: بِـ + صَاحِب + هِ — bi-, with (prep., after دَنَا, 'close with') + ṣāḥib, companion (m.) + -hi, his; 'with his companion'
بَطْنَهُ: بَطْن + هُ — baṭn, belly (m.), accusative + -hu, his; 'his belly'
وَعَلِمَتِ: وَ + عَلِمَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿalima, know, perceive (v. I, 3fs perfect; kasra to bridge the article); 'and she perceived'
رَفَعَتْهُ: رَفَعَتْ + هُ — rafaʿa, lift, raise (v. I), 3fs perfect + -hu, him; 'she lifted him'
الْبَرْقِ: الـ + بَرْق — al-, the + barq, lightning (m.), genitive; 'the lightning'
الْخَاطِفِ: الـ + خَاطِف — al-, the + khāṭif, snatching, flashing (act. part. of khaṭifa), adjective; 'the snatching'
وَرَمَتْهُ: وَ + رَمَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ramā, throw, cast (v. I), 3fs perfect + -hu, him; 'and she threw him'
أَكْرَمْتُكَ: أَكْرَمْتُ + كَ — akrama, honour, treat generously (v. IV), 1s perfect -tu + -ka, you (m.); 'I honoured you'
نَبِيِّكَ: نَبِيّ + كَ — nabiyy, prophet (m.), genitive + -ka, your (m.); 'your prophet'
أَحَلَّ: أَحَلَّ — aḥalla, make lawful, permit (v. IV, 3ms perfect; the shadda is printed); 'made lawful'
قَتْلَ: قَتْل — qatl, killing (m.), accusative object in construct; 'the killing of'
وَحَدَانَةِ: وَ + حَدَانَة — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥadāna as printed, a misprint for حَدَاثَة ḥadātha, youth (f.), genitive in construct; 'and the youth of'
وَغُرْبَتِكَ: وَ + غُرْبَة + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghurba, being away from home, strangerhood (f.) + -ka, your; 'and your strangerhood'
عَسْكَرُا: عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army (m.), construct; printed عسكرا, the final alif being the article's alif split off by a misdivision, pointed silent; 'the army of'
لْمُسْلِمِينَ: (ا)لْ + مُسْلِمِينَ — al-, the (its alif lost to the previous word) + muslimīn, Muslims (m. pl.), genitive; 'the Muslims'
جَٰأُوا: جَٰأُوا — jāʾū, come (v. I, 3mp perfect); printed جأوا for جاؤوا, pointed with dagger alif; 'they came'
أَرْسَلَهُمْ: أَرْسَلَ + هُمْ — arsala, send (v. IV, 3ms perfect) + -hum, them (m.); 'he sent them'
فَأَرْسِلْهُ: فَ + أَرْسِلْ + هُ — fa-, then (conj., introduces the result) + arsil, send (v. IV, 2ms imperative) + -hu, him; 'then send him'
الْمِصْرَاعَ: الـ + مِصْرَاع — al-, the + miṣrāʿ, door-leaf, hemistich (m.), accusative after إِنَّ; probably a slip for الْمُصَارَعَة, wrestling; 'the (wrestling)'
أَنْوَاعًا: أَنْوَاع — anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of nawʿ), accusative indefinite; 'kinds'
وَمَرَاتِبَ: وَ + مَرَاتِب — wa-, and (conj.) + marātib, ranks, degrees (pl. of martaba, diptote accusative); 'and ranks'
وَضُرُوبًا: وَ + ضُرُوب — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍurūb, sorts, varieties (pl. of ḍarb), accusative indefinite; 'and sorts'
الْوَهْمِ: الـ + وَهْم — al-, the + wahm, fancy, supposition (m.), genitive; possibly corrupt; 'the supposition'
وَمِنْهَا: وَ + مِنْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + min, of (prep., partitive) + -hā, them (the kinds); 'and among them'
الْمُسَابَقَةُ: الـ + مُسَابَقَة — al-, the + musābaqa, racing, contest of speed (f.), nominative; 'the racing'
وَالْمُنَازَلَةُ: وَ + الـ + مُنَازَلَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + munāzala, fighting hand to hand (f.), nominative; 'and the single combat'
وَأَخْذُ: وَ + أَخْذ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhdh, taking, seizing (m.), nominative in construct; 'and the seizing of'
وَعَضُّ: وَ + عَضّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaḍḍ, biting (m.), nominative in construct; 'and the biting of'
الْفَخِذِ: الـ + فَخِذ — al-, the + fakhidh, thigh (f.), genitive; 'the thigh'
وَالْعِرَاكِ: و + الـ + عِرَاك — ʿirāk, grappling, close wrestling (m.); 'and the grappling' (genitive, continuing a list)
وَالشِّبَاكِ: و + الـ + شِبَاك — shibāk, nets, snares (pl. of shabaka), here entangling holds; 'and the clinches'
إِذَاكَانَ: إِذَا + كَانَ — idhā, if (here concessive, 'even if') + kāna, he/it was, there were; printed fused: 'if there were'
الْقَيِّمُ: الـ + قَيِّم — qayyim, steward, overseer, guardian (m.); a title before the name
الصَّفَدِيُّ: الـ + صَّفَدِيّ — al-Ṣafadī, nisba from Ṣafad (proper name; a master named in a list)
أَوِ: أَوْ — aw, or (before the article it takes a kasra: awi)
قَيْمَالُ: قَيْمَال — Qaymāl (proper name; the print's spelling, perhaps a surname or epithet)
السُّدِّيِّ: الـ + سُّدِّيّ — al-Suddī, nisba (proper name; reading of the print's السدي uncertain)
مَاحَفِظْتُ: مَا + حَفِظْتُ — mā, not (neg.) + ḥafiẓtu, I memorised, kept (حَفِظَ, I حفظ, 1st sg.); printed fused: 'I have not memorised'
الْمَوَالِيفَ: الـ + مَوَالِيف — mawālīf, obscure plural (probably wrestling holds or tricks) (m. pl., accusative); 'the tricks'
ذَكَرْتِهِمْ: ذَكَرْتِ + هِمْ — dhakarti, you (f.) mentioned (ذَكَرَ, I; 2nd f. sg. perf.) + -him, them; 'you mentioned them'
بَاسَيِّدَتِي: بَا + سَيِّدَة + ـتِي — printed slip for يَا سَيِّدَتِي: yā, O + sayyida, lady (f.) + -tī, my; 'O my lady'
رَا: رَا — first half of a split word: rā- of رَاوَدَتْنِي, 'solicited' (from راود, III)
وَدَتْنِي: وَدَتْ + نِي — second half of the split word: -wadat, completing rāwadat (III راود, she wooed, lured) + -nī, me; read with the first half: 'you lured me'
كَفَلِكِ: كَفَل + كِ — kafal, rump, buttocks (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your rump'
الْعِرَاقِ: الـ + عِرَاق — al-ʿIrāq, Iraq (proper name; genitive after أهل)
الْفَخِذَ: الـ + فَخِذ — fakhidh, thigh (m., accusative object)
وَلَابَصِيرَةٌ: و + لَا + بَصِيرَة — wa-, and + lā, no, nor + baṣīra, insight, discernment (f., nom. tanwīn); printed fused: 'and no insight'
تُصَارِعِينَنِي: تُصَارِعِين + نِي — tuṣāriʿīna, you (f.) wrestle (III صارع, imperfect, with the final nūn kept) + -nī, me; 'you wrestle me'
وَفَهْمِي: و + فَهْم + ـي — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'with…') + fahm, understanding, wits (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my wits'
فَمَابَقِيَ: فَ + مَا + بَقِيَ — fa-, for, so + mā, not (neg.) + baqiya, there remained; printed fused: 'for there remains not'
دَسْتٌ: دَسْت — dast, bout, round, turn (Persian dast) (m., nom. tanwīn)
بِقَانُونِ: بِـ + قَانُون — bi-, by, according to (prep.) + qānūn, rule, canon (m.); 'by the rule of'
الصِّنَاعَةِ: الـ + صِّنَاعَة — ṣināʿa, craft, art (f.); 'the craft'
نَشَاطِي: نَشَاط + ـي — nashāṭ, vigour, briskness (m.) + -ī, my; 'my vigour'
يَامَغْلُوبُ: يَا + مَغْلُوب — yā, O + maghlūb, defeated, vanquished (pass. part. of غلب) (m.); printed fused: 'O defeated one'
الدَّسْتَ: الـ + دَّسْت — dast, bout (m.); accusative as the appositive of هذا after أنّ
الْكِفَايَةُ: الـ + كِفَايَة — kifāya, sufficiency, enough (f., nom.); predicate: 'the enough'
فَانْحَنَى: فَ + انْحَنَى — fa-, and so + inḥanā, he bent over (VII انحنى, 3rd m. sg.)
الْجِدِّ: الـ + جِدّ — jidd, earnest, seriousness (m.); أَخَذَ فِي الْجِدِّ 'set to it in earnest'
وَاحْتَرَزَ: و + احْتَرَزَ — wa-, and + iḥtaraza, he guarded himself (VIII احترز)
الْجَذْلَانِ: الـ + جَذْلَان — jadhlān, glad, exultant (adj. m.; diptote, genitive after من); 'the exultant one'
تَعْهَدْهَا: تَعْهَدْ + هَا — taʿhad, she knew, was familiar with (I عهد, jussive) + -hā, it; 'she had not known it'
يَامُسْلِمُ: يَا + مُسْلِم — yā, O + muslim, Muslim (m.); printed fused: 'O Muslim'
مَابَقِيَ: مَا + بَقِيَ — mā, not + baqiya, remained; printed fused: 'there remains not' (after أَنَّ)
فَخِذِهِ: فَخِذ + هِ — fakhidh, thigh (m.) + -hi, his; 'his thigh'
وَقَبَضَتْهُ: و + قَبَضَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + qabaḍat, she seized (I قبض) + -hu, him; 'and she seized him'
وَأَلْقَتْهُ: و + أَلْقَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + alqat, she threw (IV ألقى) + -hu, him; 'and she threw him'
نَشَّالًا: نَشَّال + ً — nashshāl, snatcher, pickpocket (m., accusative tanwīn; obscure); 'snatcher-fashion'
طُرْطُورٌ: طُرْطُور + ٌ — ṭurṭūr, a tall cap; a lanky dunce (m., nom. tanwīn, predicate)
بَدَوِيٌّ: بَدَوِيّ + ٌ — badawī, Bedouin (nisba adj., m., nom. tanwīn)
بَطْشَةٍ: بَطْشَة + ٍ — baṭsha, a single blow, grip, assault (f., genitive tanwīn)
رِيَاحٍ: رِيَاح + ٍ — riyāḥ, winds (pl. of rīḥ), genitive tanwīn; Abū Riyāḥ 'Father of Winds'
مَشْوُمُ: مَشْوُمُ — mashūm for mashʾūm, ill-omened (m.); the edition's damma is kept on the wāw
عَسْكَرِ: عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army (m.), in construct; ilā ʿaskari 'to the army of'
وَأَرْسِلْ: و + أَرْسِلْ — wa-, and + arsil, send! (IV أرسل, imperative)
الْجُهْدِ: الـ + جُهْد — juhd, effort, power (m., genitive); قليل الجهد 'of small might'
وَنَادِ: و + نَادِ — wa-, and + nādi, call out! (III نادى, imperative)
وَالْعَجَمِ: و + الـ + عَجَم — wa-, and + al-ʿajam, the non-Arabs, Persians and foreigners (m. pl.)
وَالتُّرْكِ: و + الـ + تُّرْك — wa-, and + al-Turk, the Turks
وَالدَّيْلَمِ: و + الـ + دَّيْلَم — wa-, and + al-Daylam, the Daylamites (highlanders of northern Persia)
قَفَزَتْ: قَفَزَتْ — qafazat, she leapt (I قفز, 3rd f. sg.)
لِشَرْكَانَ: لِـ + شَرْكَان — li-, to (prep.: the one addressed) + Sharkān (proper name, diptote); 'to Sharkān'
فِرَاقُكَ: فِرَاق + كَ — firāq, parting, separation (m., nom.: subject) + -ka, your; 'your parting'
تَأْتِيَكَ: تَأْتِيَ + كَ — taʾtiya, it/she comes (I أتى, subjunctive after لئلا) + -ka, you (m.); 'come upon you'
الْبَطَارِقَةُ: الـ + بَطَارِقَة — baṭārika, patricians (pl. of biṭrīq, Byzantine officers/nobles) (m. pl., nom.)
وَيَأْخُذُونَكَ: و + يَأْخُذُون + كَ — wa-, and + yaʾkhudhūna, they take (I أخذ, 3rd m. pl.; the nūn is kept) + -ka, you (m.); 'and take you'
أَسِنَّةِ: أَسِنَّة — asinna, spear-points, lance-heads (pl. of sinān), genitive after ʿalā (preceded by ʿalā, 'on')
الرِّمَاحِ: الـ + رِّمَاح — rimāḥ, lances (pl. of rumḥ); 'of the lances'
لِدَفْعِ: لِـ + دَفْع — li-, for (prep.: the purpose, 'for the …-ing of') + dafʿ, pushing away, repelling (m. verbal noun, in construct)
الْفُرْسَانَ: الـ + فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen, knights (pl. of fāris) (m. pl., accusative, in apposition)
مُعْرِضَةً: مُعْرِضَة + ً — muʿriḍa, turning aside, averting (IV act. part., f., accusative ḥāl)
طَالِبَةً: طَالِبَة + ً — ṭāliba, seeking (I act. part., f., accusative ḥāl)
لِلدَّيْرِ: لِـ + الـ + دَّيْر — li-, for, toward (prep.: the goal sought) + al-dayr, monastery (m.); 'the monastery'
أَتَذْهَبِينَ: أَ + تَذْهَبِين — a-, interrogative particle 'do you…?' + tadhhabīna, you (f.) go (I ذهب, 2nd f. sg.)
وَتَتْرُكِينَ: و + تَتْرُكِين — wa-, and + tatrukīna, you (f.) leave (I ترك, 2nd f. sg.)
الْغَرِيبَ: الـ + غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger, far from home (m., adj. accusative)
الْمِسْكِينَ: الـ + مِسْكِين — miskīn, poor, wretched (m., adj. accusative)
الْكَسِيرَ: الـ + كَسِير — kasīr, broken (m., accusative, in construct)
حَاجَتُكَ: حَاجَة + كَ — ḥāja, need, desire (f.; nom.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your need'
أُجِيبُ: أُجِيبُ — ujību, I answer, respond to (IV أجاب, 1st sg. imperfect)
دَعْوَتَكَ: دَعْوَة + كَ — daʿwa, call, invitation (f.; acc. object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your call'
أَطَأُ: أَطَأُ — aṭaʾu, I tread, set foot on (I وطأ, 1st sg. imperfect)
أَرْضَكِ: أَرْض + كِ — arḍ, land, earth (f., accusative object) + -ki, your (f.); 'your land'
وَأَتَحَلَّى: و + أَتَحَلَّى — wa-, and + ataḥallā, I adorn/sweeten myself (V تحلّى, 1st sg.)
بِحَلَاوَةِ: بِـ + حَلَاوَة — bi-, with, by means of (prep.: the thing he is sweetened with) + ḥalāwa, sweetness (f., genitive in construct); 'with the sweetness of'
لُطْفِكِ: لُطْف + كِ — luṭf, kindness, graciousness (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your kindness'
زَادِكِ: زَاد + كِ — zād, provisions, travel-food (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your provisions'
وَطَعَامِكِ: و + طَعَام + كِ — wa-, and + ṭaʿām, food (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your food'
خُدَّامِكِ: خُدَّام + كِ — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim) (m. pl.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your servants'
لَايَأْبَى: لَا + يَأْبَى — lā, not (neg.) + yaʾbā, he refuses (I أبى, imperfect); printed fused: 'does not refuse'
الْكَرَامَةَ: الـ + كَرَامَة — karāma, honour, hospitality (f., accusative object)
إِلَّالَئِيمٌ: إِلَّا + لَئِيم + ٌ — illā, except + laʾīm, base, mean (m., nom. tanwīn); printed fused: 'except a base man'
جَوَادَكَ: جَوَاد + كَ — jawād, swift horse, steed (m., accusative object) + -ka, your (m.); 'your steed'
وَسِرْ: و + سِرْ — wa-, and + sir, go! (imperative of I سير)
مُقَابِلِي: مُقَابِل + ي — muqābil, facing, opposite (III act. part., m., accusative ḥāl) + -ī, me; 'facing me'
لِلْمُصْرَاعِ: لِـ + الـ + مُصْرَاع — li-, to, for (prep.: the object of the summons) + al-, the + muṣrāʿ, wrestling (noun from III صارع; reading of the print's المصراع uncertain); 'to the wrestling'
وَبَادَرَ: وَ + بَادَرَ — wa-, and + bādara, he hastened (III, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he hastened'
مُقَابِلِهَا: فِي (the preceding word) + مُقَابِل + ـهَا — muqābil, facing, opposite (act. part. III of qābala) + -hā, her; 'facing her' (gen. after fī)
سَائِرَهْ: سَائِرَة — sāʾira, going along, proceeding (f. act. part. of sāra), final ة printed as ه; 'going along'
قِبَالَهُ: قِبَال + ـهُ — qibāl, the front, opposite (m.) + -hu, his, him; 'opposite him'
جِسْرٍ: جِسْر — jisr, bridge (m.), gen. tanwīn after ilā; 'a bridge'
مَعْمُولٍ: مَعْمُول — maʿmūl, made, constructed (pass. part. of ʿamila), gen. tanwīn agreeing with jisr; 'made'
بِأَخْشَابٍ: بِـ + أَخْشَاب — bi-, with, of (what it is made from) + akhshāb, wooden beams (pl. of khashab, wood); 'of beams'
الْحَوْرِ: الـ + حَوْر — al-, the + ḥawr, poplar (coll. m.), gen. after min; 'the poplar'
بُكَرٌ: بُكَر — bukar, pulleys (pl. of bakara) (nom. tanwīn, delayed subject after fīhi); 'pulleys'
بِسَلَاسِلَ: بِـ + سَلَاسِل — bi-, with (what the pulleys are fitted with) + salāsil, chains (pl. of silsila, diptote); 'with chains'
الْبُولَادِ: الـ + بُولَاد — al-, the + būlād, steel (m., from Persian), gen. after min; 'the steel'
أَقْفَالٌ: أَقْفَال — aqfāl, locks (pl. of qufl) (nom. tanwīn); 'locks'
كَلَالِيبَ: كَلَالِيب — kalālīb, hooks (pl. of kallūb, diptote), gen. after fī; 'hooks'
الْجِسْرِ: الـ + جِسْر — al-, the + jisr, bridge (m.), gen. after dhālika/ilā; 'the bridge'
بِالْجَوَارِى: بِـ + الـ + جَوَارِي — bi-, marks the thing that appears after idhā, with no separate sense + al-, the + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya), final yā' printed ى; 'and behold, the slave-girls'
اللَّاتِي: الَّتِي — allātī, who (f. pl. relative pronoun); 'who'
كُنَّ: كَانَ — kunna, they (f.) were (perf. 3 f. pl. of kāna); 'they were'
قَائِمَاتٍ: قَائِمَات — qāʾimāt, standing (f. pl. act. part. of qāma), acc. as ḥāl; 'standing'
يَنْتَظِرْنَهَا: يَنْتَظِرْنَ + ـهَا — yantaẓirna, they (f.) await (VIII imperf. 3 f. pl.) + -hā, her (obj.); 'awaiting her'
عَلَيْهِنَّ: عَلَى + ـهِنَّ — ʿalā, upon, toward (after aqbala) + -hinna, them (f.); 'to them'
كَلَّمَتْ: كَلَّمَتْ — kallamat, she spoke to (II perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she spoke to'
بِاسَانِ: بِـ + [ل]ِسَان — bi-, in, with (the language used) + lisān, tongue, language (m.), printed without the lām; 'in the tongue of' (gen. before al-Rūmiyya)
الرُّومِيَّةِ: الـ + رُومِيَّة — al-, the + Rūmiyya, the Greek (Byzantine) language (f.; nisba adj. of Rūm), gen. in idāfa; 'the Greek'
وَأَمْسِكِي: وَ + أَمْسِكِي — wa-, and + amsikī, hold, take hold of (IV imper. 2 f. sg.); 'and hold'
فَسَارَ: فَـ + سَارَ — fa-, and then + sāra, he went, travelled (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he went on'
عَدَّى: عَدَّى — ʿaddā, he crossed over, passed (II perf. 3 m. sg., printed ى); 'he crossed'
وَقَدِا: وَ + قَدْ + (ا) — wa-, and + qad, already, (with the perfect, 'had') with kasra to link; the printed alif belongs to the next word indahasha, misdivided in the edition; 'and had'
نْدَهَشَ: (ا)نْدَهَشَ — indahasha, he was bewildered (VII perf. 3 m. sg.), its initial alif printed on the preceding word; 'been bewildered'
لَوْأَنَّ: لَوْ + أَنَّ — law, if, if only + anna, that (takes acc.), printed as one word; 'if only'
بَدِيعَةَ: بَدِيعَة — badīʿa, wondrous, peerless (f. adj.), vocative in idāfa, acc.; 'wondrous one'
حُرْمَتَانِ: حُرْمَة — ḥurma, inviolable right, claim (f.) in the dual nom. ḥurmatān; 'two claims'
حُرْمَةُ: حُرْمَة — ḥurma, inviolable right, claim (f.), nom. in apposition (first term of idāfa); 'the claim of'
بِسَيْرِي: بِـ + سَيْر + ـِي — bi-, by, through (means or cause) + sayr, going (m., verbal noun of sāra) + -ī, my; 'by my going'
مَنْزِلِكِ: مَنْزِل + ـكِ — manzil, dwelling (m.), gen. after ilā + -ki, your (f.); 'your dwelling'
وَقَبُولِ: وَ + قَبُول — wa-, and + qabūl, acceptance (m., verbal noun), gen. coordinated with sayr; 'and the acceptance of'
ضِيَافَنِكِ: ضِيَافَتِكِ — ḍiyāfatiki, your (f.) hospitality (ḍiyāfa f. + -ki), printed with nūn for tā'; 'your hospitality'
حُكْمِكِ: حُكْم + ـكِ — ḥukm, rule, judgement (m.), gen. after taḥta + -ki, your (f.); 'your rule'
وَزِمَامِكِ: وَ + زِمَام + ـكِ — wa-, and + zimām, rein, halter (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your rein'
فَلَوْأَنَّكِ: فَـ + لَوْ + أَنَّ + ـكِ — fa-, so + law, if only + anna, that + -ki, you (f.); 'so if only you'
تُنْعِمِينَ: تُنْعِمِينَ — tunʿimīna, you (f.) show favour (IV imperf. 2 f. sg.); 'would favour'
بِالْمَسِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + مَسِير — bi-, with (anʿama bi-, favour with something) + al-, the + masīr, going, journey (m.); 'with the going' Also after amara, 'to order', bi- marks the thing ordered: amaratnī bi-al-masīri, 'she ordered me to go'. Also after ashāra ʿalā, 'to advise', bi- marks the course advised: ashartu ʿalā Abī al-Ḥasani bi-al-masīri, 'I advised Abū al-Ḥasan to go'.
وَتَتَفَرَّجِينَ: وَ + تَتَفَرَّجِينَ — wa-, and + tatafarrajīna, you (f.) look on (V imperf. 2 f. sg., tafarraja ʿalā); 'and look upon'
سَيِّدٍ: سَيِّد — sayyid, lord, master (m.), gen. tanwīn; 'lord'
ضِرْغَامٍ: ضِرْغَام — ḍirghām, lion (m.), gen. tanwīn in apposition; 'lion'
وَتَعْرِفِينَ: وَ + تَعْرِفِينَ — wa-, and + taʿrifīna, you (f.) know (imperf. 2 f. sg. of ʿarafa); 'and know'
سَدِيدٍ: سَدِيد — sadīd, sound, right (adj.), gen. tanwīn; 'sound'
وَلَٰكِنِّي: وَ + لَٰكِنَّ + ـِي — wa-, and + lākinna, but (takes acc.), printed ولكني without alif + -ī, me; 'but I'
اطَّلَعْتُ: اطَّلَعْتُ — iṭṭalaʿtu, I have learned, been apprised (VIII perf. 1 sg.; iṭṭalaʿa ʿalā); 'I have learned'
يَجُوزُ: يَجُوزُ — yajūzu, it is allowed, is proper (imperf. 3 m. sg. of jāza); 'is it allowed'
تَتَكَلَّمَ: تَتَكَلَّمَ — tatakallama, you speak (V imperf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'you speak'
تُنْسَبُ: تُنْسَبُ — tunsabu, you are ascribed (pass. imperf. of nasaba, 2 m. sg.; or 3 f. 'it is ascribed'); 'you are ascribed'
الْخِدَاعِ: الـ + خِدَاع — al-, the + khidāʿ, deceit (m.), gen. after ilā; 'the deceit'
حَصَلْتُ: حَصَلْتُ — ḥaṣaltu, I came to be (perf. 1 sg. of ḥaṣala); 'I come to be'
مَلِكِكُمْ: مَلِك + ـكُمْ — malik, king (m.), gen. after ʿinda + -kum, your (pl.); 'your king'
صُوَرِهِ: صُوَر + ـهِ — ṣuwar, forms, images (pl. of ṣūra), gen. after fī + -hi, his (or read ṣūrihi, 'his wall'); 'his forms'
قُصُورِهِ: قُصُور + ـهِ — quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr), gen. after fī + -hi, his; 'his palaces'
وَالْقُصُورُ: وَ + الـ + قُصُور — wa-, and (circumstantial) + al-, the + quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr), nom. subject; 'and the palaces'
عَدَدُ: عَدَد — ʿadad, number (m.), nom. predicate, first term of idāfa; 'the number of'
اعْتِقَادَكُمْ: اعْتِقَاد + ـكُمْ — iʿtiqād, belief (m., verbal noun VIII), acc. after anna + -kum, your (pl.); 'your belief'
نَحِلُّ: نَحِلُّ — naḥillu, we are lawful (imperf. 1 pl. of ḥalla, be lawful); 'we are lawful'
كُتُبِكُمْ: كُتُب + ـكُمْ — kutub, books (pl. of kitāb), gen. after fī + -kum, your (pl.); 'your books'
أَوْمَا: أَوْ + مَا — aw, or + mā, what, that which (rel.), printed as one word; 'or what'
أَيْمَانُكُمْ: أَيْمَان + ـكُمْ — aymān, right hands (pl. of yamīn), nom. subject + -kum, your (pl.); 'your right hands'
شُجْعَانِ: شُجْعَان — shujʿān, brave men (pl. of shujāʿ), gen. after a preposition (ʿalā, min), first term of an iḍāfa; 'the brave men of'
فَوَحَقِّ: فَـ + وَ + حَقّ — fa-, then (opens the main clause after ammā) + wa-, by (particle of oath) + ḥaqq, right (m.), gen. after the oath-particle; 'then by the right of'
صَحِيحٍ: صَحِيح — ṣaḥīḥ, sound, true (adj.), gen. tanwīn in idāfa; 'sound'
عَسْكَرَكُمْ: عَسْكَر + كُمْ — ʿaskar, army (m.), acc. as object; -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your army'
اسْتَقْبَلْتُمْ: اِسْتَقْبَلَ — istaqbala, to face, advance toward (Form X); perfect, 2nd m. pl. (-tum); 'you faced / approached'
أَرْضَنَا: أَرْض + نَا — arḍ, earth, land (f.), acc. as object; -nā, our; 'our land'
وَبِلَادَنَا: و + بِلَاد + نَا — wa-, and; bilād, lands (pl. of balad), acc. as object; -nā, our; 'and our lands'
الْيَوْمَيْنِ: الـ + يَوْم — al-, the; yawm, day (m.), dual oblique; 'the two days'
أَقْبَلْتُمْ: أَقْبَلَ — aqbala, to come on, advance (Form IV); perfect, 2nd m. pl.; 'you came on'
تَرْبِيَتَكُمْ: تَرْبِيَة + كُمْ — tarbiya, training, upbringing (f.), acc. as first object; -kum, your; 'your upbringing'
تَرْبِيَةَ: تَرْبِيَة — tarbiya, training, upbringing (f.), acc. as second object, in iḍāfa with مُلُوكٍ; 'the upbringing of (kings)'
رَأَيْتُكُمْ: رَأَى + كُمْ — raʾā, to see; perfect, 1st sg. (-tu) + -kum, you (m. pl.) as object; 'I saw you'
طَوَائِفَ: طَوَائِف — ṭawāʾif, bands, parties (pl. of ṭāʾifa; diptote), acc. as second object; 'bands'
إِجْلَا: إِجْلَال — ijlāl, honouring, reverence (verbal noun of Form IV, m.), gen. in iḍāfa; the last letter is the printed split of the word, whose end is the following لَكَ; 'honouring-(of)'
الْفَخْرِ: الـ + فَخْر — al-, the; fakhr, pride, boasting (m.), gen. after لِأَجْلِ; 'the pride'
وَعَرَفْتُ: و + عَرَفَ — wa-, and; ʿarafa, to know; perfect, 1st sg. (-tu); 'and I knew'
قُدُومَهُ: قُدُوم + هُ — qudūm, coming, arrival (m., verbal noun), acc. as object; -hu, his; 'his coming'
الْعَسَاكِرِ: الـ + عَسَاكِر — al-, the; ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; diptote), gen. (after a preposition); 'the armies, the troops'
وَعِدَّتُهُمْ: و + عِدَّة + هُمْ — wa-, and; ʿidda, number, strength, equipment (f.), nom. subject; -hum, their; 'and their number'
الْجَيْشَ: الـ + جَيْش — al-, the; jaysh, army (m.), acc. as object; 'the army'
لِنُصْرَةِ: لِـ + نُصْرَة — li-, for (prep. of purpose); nuṣra, help, aid (f., verbal noun), gen. after لِـ and in iḍāfa; 'for the helping of'
أَقْسَمْتُ: أَقْسَمَ — aqsama, to swear, adjure (Form IV); perfect, 1st sg. (-tu); 'I adjure'
تَعْتَقِدِينَ: اِعْتَقَدَ — iʿtaqada, to believe, hold as a creed (Form VIII); imperfect, 2nd f. sg. (-īna); 'you hold / believe'
دِينِكِ: دِين + كِ — dīn, religion, faith (m.), gen. after مِنْ; -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your religion'
يَظْهَرَ: ظَهَرَ — ẓahara, to appear; imperfect, 3rd m. sg., subjunctive after حَتَّى; 'may appear' Also subjunctive after an: an yaẓhara al-amru, 'that the matter come to light'.
الْكَذِبِ: الـ + كَذِب — al-, the; kadhib, lie, falsehood (m.), gen. after مِنْ; 'the lie'
وَبَالُ: وَبَال — wabāl, evil consequence, guilt (m.), nom. subject of يَكُونُ, in iḍāfa; 'the ill-consequence of'
دِينِكَ: دِين + كَ — dīn, religion (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your religion'
يَشِيعَ: شَاعَ — shāʿa, to spread (of news); imperfect, 3rd m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ; 'spread'
خَاطَرْتُ: خَاطَرَ — khāṭara, to hazard, stake (Form III); perfect, 1st sg.; 'I risked'
وَبَارَزْتُ: و + بَارَزَ — wa-, and; bāraza, to fight single combat (Form III); perfect, 1st sg.; 'and I fought'
وَقَتَلْتُ: و + قَتَلَ — wa-, and; qatala, to kill; perfect, 1st sg.; 'and I killed'
مُقَدَّمَهُمُ: مُقَدَّم + هُمُ — muqaddam, leader, foremost (passive participle of Form II, m.), acc. as object; -humu, their (the final vowel supports the following article); 'their foremost one'
وَظَفِرْتُ: و + ظَفِرَ — wa-, and; ẓafira, to get the better of, win (takes بِـ); perfect, 1st sg.; 'and I got'
بِفَارِسِ: بِـ + فَارِس — bi-, over, of (prep.; ظَفِرَ بِـ puts the thing won after بِـ); fāris, horseman (m.), gen. after بِـ and in iḍāfa; 'the horseman of'
سَهْمِ: سَهْم — sahm, arrow; also lot, share, company (m.), gen. in iḍāfa; obscure here; 'the division / lot of'
عَارٌ: عَار — ʿār, shame, disgrace (m.), nom. indef. as subject of كَانَ; 'shame'
وَلَٰكِنَّنِي: و + لَٰكِنَّ + نِي — wa-, and; lākinna, but (takes the accusative; the print omits the alif) + -nī, me; 'but I'
الْأَدَبَ: الـ + أَدَب — al-, the; adab, good breeding, polite letters (m.), acc. as object; 'the courtesy / culture'
أَصِفُ: وَصَفَ — waṣafa, to describe; imperfect, 1st sg.; 'I describe'
لشَّجَاعَةِ: (ا)لـ + شَجَاعَة — l- (the rest of the article الـ, whose alif is in the preceding بِا; assimilated before sh), the; shajāʿa, courage (f.), gen. after بِـ; 'the courage'
الْعَلَامَةَ: الـ + عَلَامَة — al-, the; ʿalāma, sign, token (f.), acc. as object; 'the sign'
وَالصِّنَاعَةَ: و + الـ + صِنَاعَة — wa-, and; al-, the; ṣināʿa, craft, skill (f.), acc.; 'and the craft'
وَالْقُوَّةَ: و + الـ + قُوَّة — wa-, and; al-, the; quwwa, strength (f.), acc.; 'and the strength'
وَالْبَرَاعَةَ: و + الـ + بَرَاعَة — wa-, and; al-, the; barāʿa, excellence, mastery (f.), acc.; 'and the mastery'
نُطَّ: نَطَّ — naṭṭa, to leap; imperative, 2nd m. sg. (shadda printed); 'leap!'
النَّهْرَ: الـ + نَهْر — al-, the; nahr, river (m.), acc. as object of the leaping; 'the river'
أَوَدُّوَأَنْ: أَوَدُّ + و + أَنْ — awaddu, I wish (wadda, to wish; imperfect 1st sg.; shadda printed); wa-, and (extra, as printed); an, that (conj., with the subjunctive); 'I wish and that'
الْمَسِيحُ: الـ + مَسِيح — al-, the; Masīḥ, the Messiah, Christ (m.), nom. as subject; 'the Messiah'
يَرْمِيَهُ: رَمَى + هُ — ramā, to throw, cast; imperfect, 3rd m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ; -hu, him; 'cast him'
وَأٓسِرَهُ: و + أَسَرَ + هُ — wa-, and; asara, to take captive (aorist 1st sg. in the subjunctive after حَتَّى, read ʾāsirahu with the maddah supplied for the single alif printed); -hu, him; 'and take him captive'
وَأَجْعَلَهُ: و + جَعَلَ + هُ — wa-, and; jaʿala, to make, put; imperfect, 1st sg., subjunctive after حَتَّى; -hu, him; 'and put him'
الْأَغْلَالِ: الـ + أَغْلَال — al-, the; aghlāl, fetters (pl. of ghull), gen. after فِى; 'the fetters'
الْمُ—بَاحِ: الـ + مُ—بَاح — al-, the; the rest damaged in the source text (the dash marks lost letters); most likely الْمُبَاح, mubāḥ, permitted (passive participle of Form IV, gen. as adjective of الْكَلَامِ); 'the permitted'
النَّصْرَانِيَّةَ: الـ + نَصْرَانِيَّة — naṣrāniyya, Christian (f. adj., from naṣrānī, 'Nazarene', acc.); 'the Christian'
يَسْمَعُهُ: يَسْمَعُ + هُ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it (3ms object); 'he hears it'
وَأَجْعَلُهُ: وَ + أَجْعَلُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jaʿala, to make, put (verb I, impf. 1cs) + -hu, him (3ms object); 'and I put him'
الْقُيُودِ: الـ + قُيُود — qayd (pl. quyūd), fetter, shackle (m., gen. after fī); 'the fetters'
غْلَالِ: غْلَال — ghlāl, the remainder of الأغلال (al-aghlāl, pl. of ghull, 'iron collar, shackle'), gen. after fī; see وَالْأَ; 'shackles'
أَسَرَهُ: أَسَرَ + هُ — asara, to take captive, seize (verb I, perf. 3ms, as printed) + -hu, him (3ms object); 'seized him'
النَّخْوَةُ: الـ + نَخْوَة — nakhwa, pride, haughty zeal (f., nom., subject of akhadhat-hu); 'the pride'
وَالْحَمِيَّةُ: وَ + الـ + حَمِيَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥamiyya, zeal, fierce honour (f., nom.); 'and the zeal'
وَغَيْرَةُ: وَ + غَيْرَة — wa-, and (conj.) + ghayra, jealousy, protective honour (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the jealousy of'
بْطَالِ: بْطَال — bṭāl, the remainder of الأبطال (al-abṭāl, pl. of baṭal, 'hero, champion'), gen. in annexation; see الْأَ; 'heroes'
يُظْهِرَ: أَظْهَرَ — aẓhara, to show, reveal (verb IV); yuẓhira, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an; 'that he show'
وَيَبْطِشَ: وَ + يَبْطِشَ — wa-, and (conj.) + baṭasha, to seize violently, fall upon (verb I, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); 'and lay hold on'
رَدَّهُ: رَدَّ + هُ — radda, to turn back, repel (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (3ms object); 'turned him back'
وَإِذَا: وَ + إِذَا — wa-, and (conj.) + idhā, when, if (temporal/conditional particle); 'and when'
بِذَنْبٍ: بِـ + ذَنْب — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- 'to come with, to commit') + dhanb, offence, fault (m., gen. indef.); 'with a fault'
بِأَلْفِ: بِـ + أَلْف — bi-, with, accompanied by (prep.; jāʾa bi- 'come with, bring') + alf, thousand (gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with a thousand'
شَفِيحِ: شَفِيح — shafīḥ, as printed, probably a misprint for shafīʿ, intercessor (m., gen. indef.; from shafaʿa, to intercede); 'an intercessor'
تَتَلَاطَمُ: تَتَلَاطَمُ — talāṭama, to dash against one another (verb VI, impf. 3fs, agreeing with a broken plural; circumstantial, 'surging'); 'they surge'
كَالْأَ: كَـ + الـ + أَ — ka-, like, as (prep.) + al-, the + a-, first part of al-amwāj, split by a space in the print; read with the next word: 'like the waves'
مْوَاجِ: مْوَاج — mwāj, the remainder of الأمواج (al-amwāj, pl. of mawj, 'wave'), gen. after ka-; see كَالْأَ; 'waves'
الرَّجْرَاجِ: الـ + رَجْرَاج — rajrāj, quaking, surging, heaving (adj., m., gen., describing the sea); 'the heaving'
شَافِعٌ: shāfiʿ — intercessor, advocate (act. part. of shafaʿa, m., nom. indef., subject of a postposed predicate); 'an intercessor'
يَمْحُو: yamḥū — maḥā, to wipe out, efface (verb I, defective, impf. 3ms); 'he wipes out'
إِسَاءَتَهَا: إِسَاءَة + هَا — isāʾa, ill-doing, offence (f. verbal noun of IV asāʾa, acc.) + -hā, her; 'her ill-doing'
وَجِيهٌ: wajīh — honoured, of standing, eminent (adj., m., nom. indef.); 'one of standing'
شَفَعَا: shafaʿa — to intercede, plead (verb I, perf. 3ms; the final alif is the verse's rhyme-alif); 'he intercedes'
تَأَمَّلْتُهَا: تَأَمَّلْتُ + هَا — taʾammala, to gaze at, contemplate (verb V, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her (3fs object); 'I gazed at her'
نَادَيْتُ: nādā, to call out, cry (verb III, defective, perf. 1cs); 'I cried out'
الْاِكْمَالِ: الـ + إِكْمَال — ikmāl, completion (verbal noun of IV akmala, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the completion', the night of the full moon
عِفْرِيتَ: عِفْرِيت — ʿifrīt, powerful jinn, demon (m., acc. after anna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the ʿifrīt of'
بِلْقِيسٍ: بِلْقِيس — Bilqīs, the Queen of Sheba (proper name; gen., here with tanwīn as the verse prints it); 'of Bilqīs'
يُصَارِعُهَا: يُصَارِعُ + هَا — ṣāraʿa, to wrestle (verb III, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her (3fs object); 'he wrestles her'
قُوَّتِهِ: قُوَّة + هِ — quwwa, strength (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his strength'
صُرِعَا: ṣuriʿa — to be thrown down, felled (verb I, passive perf. 3ms; the final alif is the rhyme-alif); 'he was thrown down'
قَنْطَرَتُهُ: قَنْطَرَة + ـهُ — qanṭara, arch (f.; nom., subject of kānat) + 3ms poss.; 'its arch'
رُخَامٍ: رُخَامٍ — rukhām, marble (m.; gen. indef. after min)
مُقَبًّى: مُقَبًّى — muqabban, vaulted (pass. part. of qabbā, verb II defective; m. gen. indef., written with final ى)
قَنَاطِرَ: قَنَاطِرَ — qanāṭir, arches (broken pl. of qanṭara; gen., diptote, genitive of the counted noun after ʿashr)
مَعْقُودَةٍ: مَعْقُودَةٍ — maʿqūd, bound, knotted, vaulted (pass. part. of ʿaqada; f. sg. gen., agreeing with the non-human pl. qanāṭir)
قَنْطَرَةٍ: قَنْطَرَةٍ — qanṭara, arch (f.; gen. indef., second term of kull)
قِنْدِيلٌ: قِنْدِيلٌ — qindīl, hanging lamp (m.; nom. indef., subject of the verbless clause)
الْبِلَّوْرِ: الـ + بِلَّوْر — billawr, crystal (m.; gen. after min); 'the crystal'
كَشُعَاعِ: كَـ + شُعَاع — ka-, like (prep., comparing) + shuʿāʿ, ray, beam (m., gen. after ka-); 'like the ray of'
فَتَلَقَّتْهَا: فَ + تَلَقَّتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + talaqqat, met, received (verb V, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural al-jawārī) + -hā, her (3fs object); 'and they met her'
آخِرِا: آخِر + ا — ākhir, end, last part (m., gen. after fī), followed by a stray alif as the edition prints it; read 'at the end of' (see the note on this sentence)
لِلْ: لِـ + الـ — li-, of, belonging to (prep.) + al-, the; the edition's broken spelling of 'of the' in the phrase meaning 'the end of the corridor' (see the note on this sentence)
هِلِيزِ: هِلِيز — the last piece of the edition's broken spelling of الدِّهْلِيز, 'the corridor' (dihlīz, m., gen.); see the note on this sentence
بِالشُّمُوعِ: بِـ + الـ + شُّمُوع — bi-, with, bearing (prep., of accompaniment) + al-, the + shumūʿ, candles (m. pl. of shamʿa; gen.); 'with the candles'
الْمُطَيَّبَةِ: الـ + مُطَيَّبَة — muṭayyab, perfumed, scented (pass. part. of ṭayyaba, verb II; f. sg. gen., agreeing with the non-human pl.); 'the perfumed ones'
رُؤُسِهِنَّ: رُؤُس + هِنَّ — ruʾūs, heads (pl. of raʾs; gen. after ʿalā) + -hinna, their (3fp); 'their heads'
الْعَصَائِبُ: الـ + عَصَائِب — ʿaṣāʾib, headbands, fillets (pl. of ʿiṣāba; nom. indef.-like, subject of the verbless clause); 'the headbands'
الْمُزَرْكَشَةُ: الـ + مُزَرْكَشَة — muzarkash, embroidered, inlaid (pass. part. of zarkasha, quad. verb; f. sg., agreeing with the non-human pl.); 'the embroidered'
وَسَارَتْ: وَ + سَارَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + sārat, went on, walked (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and she walked'
أَمَامَهَا: أَمَامَهَا — amāma, in front of (prep.; adverbial acc.) + hā, her; the printed form is أَمَامَهَا, 'before her'
بِدَائِرِ: بِـ + دَائِر — bi-, at, round (prep., of place) + dāʾir, circuit, circumference (act. part. of dāra, used as noun; m. gen., construct); 'at the circuit of'
أَسِرَّةً: أَسِرَّةً — asirra, beds, couches (broken pl. of sarīr; f. pl., acc. indef., object of wajada)
مُقَابِلَةً: مُقَابِلَةً — muqābil, facing (act. part. of III qābala; f. sg. acc., agreeing with the non-human pl. asirra)
لِبَعْضِهَا: لِـ + بَعْض + هَا — li-, to, towards (prep.; qābala takes li- for 'face, be opposite') + baʿḍ, part, some, one (m., gen.) + 3fs; 'to one another' (lit. 'to some of them')
مُكَلَّلَةٌ: مُكَلَّلَةٌ — mukallal, crowned, wreathed, adorned (pass. part. of kallala, verb II; f. sg. agreeing with the non-human pl.); 'adorned (with)'
وَأَرْضُ: وَ + أَرْض — wa-, and (conj.) + arḍ, floor, ground (f.; nom., construct, subject); 'and the floor of'
بِرْكَةُ: بِرْكَةُ — birka, pool, tank (f.; nom., construct, subject of the verbless clause)
فَوَّارَةً: فَوَّارَةً — fawwāra, fountain (f.; acc. indef., specifier tamyīz after 'four and twenty')
كَاللُّجَيْنِ: كَـ + الـ + لُّجَيْن — ka-, like (prep., comparing) + al-, the + lujayn, silver (m., gen. after ka-; poetic); 'like silver'
الْمَلُوكِيِّ: الـ + مَلُوكِيّ — malūkī, royal, kingly (rel. adj. from mulūk; m. gen., adjective of ḥarīr; Classical malakī)
اصْعَدْ: اصْعَدْ — iṣʿad — go up, climb (verb I, imperative 2ms of ṣaʿida; the alif is a wasl-alif bearing kasra); 'go up'
يَامَوْلَائِي: يَا + مَوْلَائِي — yā, O (vocative particle) + mawlāʾī, my master, my lord (m.; vocative, 1cs suffix spelled with ئ as printed; Classical mawlāya), printed as one word; 'O my master'
فَصَعِدَ: فَ + صَعِدَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + ṣaʿida, went up, climbed (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he went up'
وَذَهَبَتِ: وَ + ذَهَبَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhahabat, went away (verb I, perf. 3fs; kasra bridges into the article); 'and she went away'
ذَهَبَتْ: ذَهَبَتْ — dhahabat, went (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she has gone'
مَرْقَدِهَا: مَرْقَد + هَا — marqad, bed, place of lying down (m., gen. after ilā; noun of place from raqada, 'lie, sleep') + 3fs poss.; 'to her bed'
نَخْدُمُكَ: نَخْدُمُكَ — nakhdumu-ka, we serve (verb I, imperfect 1cp, indicative) + 2ms suffix object; 'we serve you'
غَرَائِبِ: غَرَائِبِ — gharāʾib, rarities, curiosities (pl. of gharība; gen., construct, after min partitive); 'rare things of'
اكْتَفَى: اكْتَفَى — iktafā — he was sated, had enough (verb VIII defective, perf. 3ms); 'he had his fill'
قَدَّمُوالَهُ: قَدَّمُوا + لَهُ — qaddamū, they presented, set before (verb II, perf. 3mp) + li-, to (prep., marking the recipient) + 3ms suffix, printed as one word; 'they presented to him'
وَإِبْرِيقًا: وَ + إِبْرِيق + ا — wa-, and (conj.) + ibrīq, ewer, jug (m.; acc. indef., object); 'and a ewer'
وَخَاطِرُهُ: وَ + خَاطِر + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + khāṭir, mind, thought, heart (m.; nom., subject) + 3ms poss.; 'and his mind'
وَصِيَّةَ: وَصِيَّةَ — waṣiyya, testament, charge, counsel (f.; acc., construct, object of nasiya)
نَادِمًا: نَادِمًا — nādim, regretful, remorseful (act. part. of nadima; m. sg. acc., state)
الْفَجْرُوَبَانَ: الـ + فَجْر + وَ + بَانَ — al-, the + fajr, dawn (m., nom., subject) + wa-, and (conj.) + bāna, appeared, became clear (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms), printed as one word; 'the dawn and appeared' (the sense is 'the dawn rose and the day appeared')
فَتَنَهَّدَ: فَ + تَنَهَّدَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + tanahhada, sighed (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he sighed'
وَتَحَسَّرَ: وَ + تَحَسَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥassara, lamented, grieved (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he lamented'
مَافَعَلَ: مَا + فَعَلَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + faʿala, he did (verb I, perf. 3ms), printed as one word; 'what he did' Also mā, not (negative) + faʿala, printed as one word: mā faʿala … illā, 'he did not do … except', i.e. 'he did it only' (Night 188).
غَرِيقًا: غَرِيقًا — gharīq, drowned, sunk (m. sg. acc., predicate of ṣāra)
بِحَارِ: بِحَارِ — biḥār, seas (pl. of baḥr; gen., construct after fī); 'seas of'
اَعْلِمِ: اَعْلِمِ — aʿlimi, I know (verb I, jussive 1cs of ʿalima, printed with a kasra on the mīm); read as 'I knew'
الْحَزْمَ: الـ + حَزْم — ḥazm, prudence, resolve, foresight (m., acc., object of aʿlam)
وَلْكِنَّنِي: وَ + لٰكِنَّ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but (particle, with acc. subject) + ī, 1cs suffix (nūn al-wiqāya); 'but I'
دُهِيتْ: دُهِيتْ — duhītu — I was struck by calamity (verb I passive, perf. 1cs of dahā, 'befall'; sukūn on the tā printed)
الْاَمْرِ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, affair, matter (m., gen. after fī); 'in the matter'
الْهَوى: الـ + هَوَى — hawā, passion, love (m.; object of yakshifu; final ى)
بَرِئْتُ: بَرِئْتُ — bariʾtu, I would be free of, I would disown (verb I, perf. 1cs of bariʾa, with min); 'I would be rid of'
ضَلَالِ: ḍalāl, error, straying (m., gen. after fī, construct); 'in the straying of'
صَبٌّ: ṣabb, love-smitten, longing (m. sg., nom. indef., predicate of inna)
وَاَرْجُو: وَ + أَرْجُو — wa-, and (conj.) + arjū, I hope (verb I defective, imperfect 1cs, indicative); 'and I hope'
شِدَّتِي: شِدَّتِي — shidda, hardship, distress (f., gen. after fī) + ī, my; 'my distress'
بِبَهْجَةٍ: بِـ + بَهْجَة + ـٍ — bi-, with (prep.; after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears) + bahja, splendour, radiance (f., gen. indef.); 'with a splendour' i.e. 'behold, a splendour'
بِأَكْثَرَ: بِـ + أَكْثَرَ — bi-, with (prep.; after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears) + akthar, more (elative, gen. after bi-); 'with more'
يَحْجُبْنَ: يَحْجُبْنَ — yaḥjubna, they screen, veil, shield (verb I, imperfect 3 f. pl.); 'they screening'
دِيبَاجٌ: دِيبَاجٌ — dībāj, brocade, silk-cloth (m., nom. indef.); 'a brocade'
مُلُوكِيٌّ: مُلُوكِيٌّ — mulūkī, royal, kingly (adj. from mulūk, m., nom. indef.); 'royal'
شَدَّتْ: شَدَّتْ — shaddat, she tied, girded, fastened (verb I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'she had girded'
زُنَّارًا: زُنَّارًا — zunnār, girdle, belt (m., acc. indef., object of shaddat); 'a girdle'
مَحْبُوكًا: مَحْبُوكًا — maḥbūk, closely-woven, tightly-twisted (passive part. of ḥabaka, acc. indef., agreeing with zunnār); 'closely woven'
نْوَاعِ: نْوَاعِ — nwāʿ, the remaining piece of bi-anwāʿ (أَنْوَاع, pl. of nawʿ, kind, sort; gen. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'kinds', continuing 'with kinds of jewels'
ضَمَرَ: ضَمَرَ — ḍamara, he/it became lean, slender (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'was slender'
خَصْرُهَا: خَصْرُهَا — خَصْر + هَا — khaṣr, waist (m., nom. subject) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'her waist'
وَأُبْرِزَ: وَ + أُبْرِزَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ubriza, was brought out, made prominent (verb IV passive, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and were brought out'
رِدْفَاهَا: رِدْفَاهَا — رِدْفَا + هَا — ridfā, the two buttocks, hips (dual of ridf, nom.) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'her two hips'
فَصَارَتَا: فَ + صَارَتَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + ṣārata, they two became (verb I, perfect 3 f. dual; نَاقِص 'kāna-sister'); 'and they two became'
كَأنَّهُمَا: كَ + أَنَّ + هُمَا — ka-, as (prep. fused into the particle) + anna, that (particle) + -humā, the two of them (dual suffix); kaʾanna, 'as if, as though'; 'as if the two'
كَثِيبَ: kathīb, sand-dune, heap of sand (m.; printed acc., though khabar of kaʾanna would be nominative: a Middle Arabic looseness; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a dune'
بَلُّورٍ: بَلُّورٍ — ballūr, crystal (m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'of crystal'
وَنَهْدَاهَا: وَ + نَهْدَا + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + nahdā, the two breasts (dual of nahd, nom.) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'and her two breasts'
كِفْلَيْنِ: كِفْلَيْنِ — kiflayn, two portions, shares (dual of kifl, acc./gen.; sense uncertain, perhaps corrupt); 'two portions'
يَطِيرَ: يَطِيرَ — yaṭīra, he flies (verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an); 'fly'
وَنَسِيَ: وَ + نَسِيَ — wa-, and (conj.) + nasiya, he forgot (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and he forgot'
وَوَزِيرَهُ: وَ + وَزِيرَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + wazīr, vizier, minister (m., acc.) + -hu, his (3 m. sg. suffix); 'and his vizier'
وَتَأَمَّلَ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾammala, he gazed at, contemplated (verb V, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and he gazed at'
شَبَكَةً: شَبَكَةً — shabaka, net, network (f., acc. indef., object of raʾā); 'a net'
مُفَصَّلَةً: مُفَصَّلَةً — mufaṣṣala, set, divided, jewelled (passive part. of verb II faṣṣala, f., acc. indef., agreeing with shabaka); 'set (with jewels)'
يَمِينِهَا: يَمِينِهَا — يَمِين + هَا — yamīn, right, right side (m., gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'her right'
وَيَسَارِهَا: وَ + يَسَارِ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yasār, left, left side (m., gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'and her left'
يَرْفَعْنَ: يَرْفَعْنَ — yarfaʿna, they lift, raise (verb I, imperfect 3 f. pl.); 'they lifting'
وَثَبَ: وَثَبَ — wathaba, he sprang, leapt up (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he sprang'
لَمَّارَأَى: لَمَّا + رَأَى — lammā, when (conj.) + raʾā, he saw (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.); the print joins the two words; 'when he saw'
زِنْهَارِ: زِنْهَارِ — zinhār, beware, mercy, quarter (Persian-derived interjection, indeclinable); 'mercy!'
الزُّنَّارِ: الزُّنَّارِ — الـ + زُنَّار — al-, the + zunnār, girdle, belt (m., gen. after min); 'the girdle'
ثَقِيلَةُ: ثَقِيلَةُ — thaqīla, heavy (f. adj., nom. first term of an iḍāfa); 'heavy of'
الْاَرْدَافِ: الْاَرْدَافِ — الـ + أَرْدَاف — al-, the + ardāf, hips, buttocks (pl. of ridf, gen. as second term of an iḍāfa; printed with bare alif); 'the hips'
مَائِلَةٌ: مَائِلَةٌ — māʾila, swaying, inclining (active part. f., nom. indef.); 'swaying'
خُرْعُوبَةٌ: خُرْعُوبَةٌ — khurʿūba, a slender, supple young woman (f., nom. indef.); 'supple, slender'
نَاعِمَةُ: نَاعِمَةُ — nāʿima, soft, delicate (f. adj., nom. first term of an iḍāfa); 'soft of'
تَكَتَّمَتْ: تَكَتَّمَتْ — takattamat, she concealed, kept secret (verb V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'she concealed'
جَوًى: جَوًى — jawan, passion, ardent grief (m., gen. indef. after min); 'of passion'; here: acc. indef. of cause: qutiltu bihā jawan, 'slain through her by passion'
خُدَّ: خُدَّ — khudd, as printed; perhaps khadd, cheek, or a corrupted word such as 'attendants' (obscure); 'cheek(?)'
اُمَّهَا: اُمَّهَا — اُمَّ + هَا — umm, mother (f., acc. as printed, with a bare alif) + -hā, her (3 f. sg. suffix); 'her mother' as printed (the reading is doubtful)
يَمْشِينَ: يَمْشِينَ — yamshīna, they walk (verb I, imperfect 3 f. pl.); 'they walk'
كَالْقَيْلِ: كَـ + الْقَيْلِ — ka-, like, as (prep.) + al-, the + qayl, petty king, chieftain (m., gen. after ka-); 'like the chieftain'
حَلٍ: حَلٍ — ḥall, loosing, untying (m., gen. indef. after fī; as in 'loosing and binding'); 'in loosing'
عَقْلِ: عَقْلِ — ʿaql, binding, restraining (m., gen. indef. after fī; as printed, for the usual ʿaqd 'binding'); 'binding'
وَتُكَرِّرُ: وَ + تُكَرِّرُ — wa-, and (conj.) + karrara, to repeat (verb II, impf. 3fs, indic.)
تَحَقَّقَتْهُ: taḥaqqaqa, to verify, make certain of (verb V, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'she made sure of him'
وَعَرَفَتْهُ: وَ + عَرَفَ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'and she knew him'
يَاشَرْكَانُ: يَا + شَرْكَان — yā, O (vocative particle) + Sharkān, personal name (nom.); the edition prints yā run on to the name; 'O Sharkān'
لَيْلَتُكَ: لَيْلَة + ـكَ — layla, night (f., nom., subject) + 2ms poss.; 'your night'
هَمَّامُ: hammām — high-minded, resolute (epithet of praise, m., nom. after yā; from hamma); 'O high-minded one'
مَضَيْنَا: maḍā, to go on, depart (verb I defective, perf. 1pl); 'we went on'
وَتَرَكْنَاكَ: وَ + تَرَكَ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 1pl) + 2ms obj.; 'and we left you'
عِنْدَالْمُلُوكِ: عِنْدَ + الـ + مُلُوك — ʿinda, with, among (prep.) + al-, the + mulūk, kings (broken pl. of malik, gen.); the edition prints it as one word; 'among kings'
مَنْقَصَةٌ: manqaṣa, defect, disgrace (f., nom. indef., predicate)
وَعَارٌ: وَ + عَار — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿār, shame (m., nom. indef.)
تَكْتُمْ: katama, to hide, conceal (verb I, jussive 2ms)
سِرَّكَ: سِرّ + كَ — sirr, secret (m., acc., object) + 2ms poss.; 'your secret'
وَحَالَكَ: وَ + حَال + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāl, state, condition (m., acc., coordinate) + 2ms poss.; 'and your state'
تُسْمِعْنِي: asmaʿa, to make hear (verb IV, jussive 2ms) + 1s obj. (-nī); 'let me hear'
الصِّدْقِ: الـ + صِدْق — al-, the + ṣidq, truth (m., gen. after ghayr); 'the truth'
يُورِثُ: awratha, to bring about, bequeath (verb IV, impf. 3ms, indic.); 'breeds'
الْبُغْضَ: الـ + بُغْض — al-, the + bughḍ, hatred (m., acc., object)
وَالْعَدَاوَةَ: وَ + الـ + عَدَاوَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ʿadāwa, enmity (f., acc., coordinate)
الْقَضَاءِ: الـ + قَضَاء — al-, the + qaḍāʾ, decree, fate (m., gen.)
فَعَلَيْكَ: فَ + عَلَى + كَ — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 2ms pron.; ʿalayka bi- is the idiom 'you must hold to, it behooves you to'
بِالتَّسْلِيمِ: بِـ + الـ + تَسْلِيم — bi-, with (prep.; the object of the idiom ʿalayka bi-) + al-, the + taslīm, submission (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'to submission'
وَالرِّضَاءِ: وَ + الـ + رِضَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + riḍāʾ, contentment (m., gen., coordinate; for riḍā)
يُمْكِنْهُ: amkana, to be possible (verb IV, jussive 3ms) + 3ms pron.; 'it was not possible to him'
النُّكْرَانُ: الـ + نُكْرَان — al-, the + nukrān, denial (m. verbal noun, nom., subject)
فَصَدَّقَهَا: فَ + صَدَّقَ + هَا — fa-, so, and (conj.) + ṣaddaqa, to confirm, hold true (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'so he confirmed her'
عَذَّ: ʿadhdha-, the first part of ʿadhdhabanī, from ʿadhdhaba (verb II, perf. 3ms), to torment; the edition splits the word from its pronoun
فَمَهْمَا: فَ + مَهْمَا — fa-, so (conj.) + mahmā, whatever (conditional rel.)
فْعَلِيهِ: اِفْعَلِي + هِ — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperative 2fs; the initial alif of the imperative is not printed) + 3ms obj.; 'do it'
فَأَطْرَقَتْ: فَ + أَطْرَقَ — fa-, and then (conj.) + aṭraqa, to bow the head, look down (verb IV, perf. 3fs)
وَقَرَّعَيْنًا: وَ + قَرَّ + عَيْنًا — wa-, and (conj.) + qarra, to be cool, content (verb I geminate, imperative 2ms) + ʿayn, eye (f., acc. indef., specification); the edition prints it as one word; 'and be cool of eye'
فَأَنَّكَ: فَ + أَنَّ + كَ — fa-, for (conj.) + anna, that + 2ms pron.; the edition prints fa-anna for fa-inna, 'for you are'
خُبْزٌ: khubz, bread (m., nom. indef., subject of ṣāra)
وَمِلْحٌ: وَ + مِلْح — wa-, and (conj.) + milḥ, salt (m., nom. indef.)
لَوْأَرَادَ: لَوْ + أَرَادَ — law, if (counterfactual particle) + arāda, to wish, want (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); the edition prints them as one word; 'if … wished'
يُؤْذُوكَ: آذَى — ādhā, to harm (verb IV, subjunctive 3mpl, final nūn dropped after an) + كَ — ka, 2ms obj.; 'to harm you'
أَجْلِكَ: أَجْل + كَ — ajl, cause, sake (m., gen. after min) + 2ms poss.; min ajlika, 'for your sake'
وَأَمَانِي: وَ + أَمَان + ـي — wa-, and (conj.) + amān, protection (m., gen., coordinate) + 1s poss.; 'and my protection'
تُلَاعِبُهُ: lāʿaba, to play with, toy with (verb III, impf. 3fs, indic.) + 3ms obj.; 'toying with him'
أَرَبٌ: arab, need, purpose, desire (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna)
لَفَعَلَتْهُ: لَ + فَعَلَ + ـهُ — la-, (apodosis particle after law) + faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'she would have done it'
فَغَابَتْ: فَـ + غَابَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ghābat, from ghāba, to be absent, go away; 3fs perfect; 'and she was gone'
وَأَنَتْ: وَ + أَنَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + anat, printed slip for atat, from atā, to come; 3fs perfect; 'and she came'
كَأْسٌ: kaʾs, cup, goblet (m., nom. with tanwīn; subject of an implied verbless clause after maʿahā)
وَمَائِدَةُ: وَ + مَائِدَة — wa-, and (conj.) + māʾida, table, spread with food (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
فَتَوَقَّفَ: فَـ + تَوَقَّفَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tawaqqafa (V), to halt, hold back; 3ms perfect; 'and he held back'
شَئًا: shayʾ, thing, something (m., acc. with tanwīn; printed شيا without hamza seat); 'something'
ضَمِيرِهِ: ضَمِير + هِ — ḍamīr, inner mind, conscience (m., gen. after fī) + hi, his; 'his inmost mind'
تَتَوَهَّمُهُ: تَتَوَهَّمُ + هُ — tatawahhamu, from tawahhama (V), to imagine, suppose, fancy; 2ms imperfect indicative + hu, it (acc. suffix); 'you imagine it'
لَقَتَلْتُكَ: لَـ + قَتَلْتُ + كَ — la-, introduces the answer to law (emphatic particle; 'then, surely') + qataltu, from qatala, to kill; 1s perfect + ka, you (acc.); 'I would have killed you'
الْمَائِدَةِ: الـ + مَائِدَة — māʾida, table (f., gen. after ilā); 'the table'
وَأَكَلَتْ: وَ + أَكَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + akalat, from akala, to eat; 3fs perfect; 'and she ate'
وَغَسَلَا: وَ + غَسَلَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ghasalā, from ghasala, to wash; 3 dual perfect; 'and the two washed'
يَدَيْهِمَا: يَدَيْ + هِمَا — yad, hand (f., acc. dual in construct; the final -ni dropped) + himā, their (dual); 'their two hands'
تَأْتِيَ: taʾtiya, from atā, to come; 3fs subjunctive after أَنْ; with bi-, 'to bring'
بِالرَّيَاحِينِ: بِـ + الـ + رَيَاحِين — bi-, with (prep.; after atā bi- 'bring', the verb chooses bi-) + al-, the + rayāḥīn, pl. of rayḥān, sweet-smelling herbs (m. pl., gen. after bi-); 'with the fragrant herbs', i.e. 'to bring the fragrant herbs'
أَوَانِى: awānī, pl. of ināʾ, vessel (m. pl., gen., diptote; printed with ى); 'vessels of'
وَالْبِلَّوْرِ: وَ + الـ + بِلَّوْر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + billawr, crystal, glass (m., gen.); 'and the crystal'
الْمُخْتَلِفَةِ: الـ + مُخْتَلِفَة — mukhtalifa, varied, differing (f., act. part. of VIII ikhtalafa; gen., adjective of al-alwān taken as a plural of a thing); 'the varied'
فَأَتَتْهَا: فَـ + أَتَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + atat, from atā, to come, bring (here with a direct object: 'brought'); 3fs perfect + hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and she brought her'
أَلَّلِ: allal, printed form, probably a slip for aladhdh, elative of ladhīdh, 'most delightful' (m., gen. in construct after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the most delightful of'
وَمَسَرَّةٍ: وَ + مَسَرَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + masarra, joy, gladness (f., gen. with tanwīn, coordinated with ʿayshin); 'and of joy'
رُشْدِهِ: رُشْد + هِ — rushd, right judgement, right-mindedness (m., gen. after ʿan) + hi, his; 'his senses'; ghāba ʿan rushdihi, 'he lost his wits'
التَّسْنِيمِ: الـ + تَسْنِيم — tasnīm, the spring of Paradise (m., gen.); 'the Tasnīm'
اللَّوَاحِظُ: الـ + لَوَاحِظ — lāḥiẓa, glance, eye (f.; broken pl. lawāḥiẓ, nom.); 'the glances'
الْحَاكِمَ: الـ + حَاكِم — ḥākim, ruler (act. part. of ḥakama; m., acc.); 'the ruler'
الْمُتَحَكِّمَا: الـ + مُتَحَكِّم — mutaḥakkim, domineering, despot (act. part. of taḥakkama, V; m., acc., with pausal alif); 'the despot'
اَسْهُمَاً: asham — sahm, arrow (m.; broken pl. ashum, acc. with tanwīn); 'arrows'
اَفْدِي: afdī — fadā, ransom (verb I, 1st sg. imperf.); 'I ransom'
اُجِلُّ: ajillu — ajalla, hold in awe, revere (verb IV, 1st sg. imperf.); 'I honour'
بِعُودٍ: بِـ + عُود — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi-, 'bring') + ʿūd, lute (m., gen.); 'with a lute, bringing a lute'
تَحَكَّمْتَ: taḥakkamta — taḥakkama, assume authority, hold sway (verb V, 2nd m. sg. perf.); 'you have taken sway'
