تَنْرِيٍّ: tanrī — obscure nisba adjective (m., gen.), perhaps corrupt; kept as printed
جَائِرَاً: jāʾir — unjust, tyrannous (act. part. of jāra, m., acc. with tanwīn)
جَلْقِيٍّ: jalqī — Jillīqī, of Jillīq (a poetic name of Damascus; nisba adj., m., gen.); 'Damascene'
حَبِيبَاً: ḥabīb — beloved (m., acc. with tanwīn); 'a beloved'
حَبِيبِهِ: حَبِيب + هِ — ḥabīb, lover, beloved (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his lover'
دَمَاً: dam — blood (m., acc. with tanwīn; specification)
سَفَكَتْ: safaka — shed (verb I, 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'they shed'
سُكْرِ: sukr — drunkenness, intoxication (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
عَيْنَيْكَ: عَيْن + ـَيْ + كَ — ʿayn, eye (f. dual, gen. after ʿan) + -ka, your; 'your two eyes'
فَوَّقَتْ: fawwaqa — notch an arrow (verb II, 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she notched'
لِطَرْفٍ: لِـ + طَرْف — li-, for, to (prep.) + ṭarf, eye (m., gen.); 'for an eye'
لِقَلْبٍ: لِـ + قَلْب — li-, for, to (prep.) + qalb, heart (m., gen.); 'for a heart'
مَازَالَتْ: مَا + زَالَتْ — mā, not (neg.) + zāla, cease (verb I, 3rd f. sg. perf., printed as one word); 'she did not cease'; with a present verb, 'kept on'
مَالِكِي: مَالِك + ي — mālik, owner, master (act. part. of malaka; m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my master'
مَرْجَانَةُ: Marjāna — Marjāna, Abrīza's maid (proper name, f.)
مُتَيَّمَاً: mutayyam — enslaved by love (pass. part. of tayyama, II; m., acc. with tanwīn)
مُسَهَّدَاً: musahhad — kept sleepless (pass. part. of sahhada, II; m., acc. with tanwīn)
هَنِيئَاً: hanīʾ — pleasant, happy (adj., m., acc. with tanwīn; 'happy be')
وَأَعْذَبَ: وَ + أَعْذَب — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿdhab, sweeter (elative of ʿadhb, diptote gen.); 'and sweeter'
وَجَنْكٍ: وَ + جَنْك — wa-, and (conj.) + jank, harp (Persian chang; m., gen.); 'and a harp'
وَطُوبَى: وَ + طُوبَى — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭūbā, bliss, blessedness (f.)
وَغَنَّتْ: وَ + غَنَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghannā, sing (verb II, 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she sang'
وَقَانُونٍ: وَ + قَانُون — wa-, and (conj.) + qānūn, zither (m., gen.); 'and a zither'
وَنَايٍ: وَ + نَاي — wa-, and (conj.) + nāy, reed flute (m., gen.); 'and a flute'
وَيَرْحَمَا: وَ + يَرْحَمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yarḥama, show mercy (verb I, 3rd m. sg. subj., with pausal alif); 'and show mercy'
يَرِقَّ: yariqqa — raqqa, grow tender, soften (verb I, 3rd m. sg. subj.); 'he be tender'
آلَتُهَا: آلَة + هَا — āla, instrument (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her instrument'
فَطَرِبَ: فَ + طَرِبَ — fa-, and so, thereupon (conj.) + ṭariba, to be moved with delight (I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and so he was delighted'
غَنَّتِ: ghannā, to sing (II, perf. 3 f. sg.; final -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'she sang'
سَيِّدَتُهُنَّ: سَيِّدَة + هُنَّ — sayyida, mistress, lady (f., nom. in apposition) + -hunna, their (3 f. pl.); 'their mistress'
فَهِمْتَ: fahima, to understand (I, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you understood'
طَرِبْتُ: ṭariba, to be moved with delight, esp. by music (I, perf. 1 sg.); 'I was moved' (after mā … illā)
غَنَّيْتُ: ghannā, to sing (II, perf. 1 sg.); 'I sing' (after in, 'if I sing')
بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + عَرَبِيَّة — bi-, in (prep.; of language) + al-, the + ʿarabiyya, Arabic (f. nisba adj., gen.); 'in Arabic'
فَغَيَّرَتِ: فَ + غَيَّرَتِ — fa-, and (conj.) + ghayyara, to change (II, perf. 3 f. sg.; final -i the helping vowel before al-); 'and she changed'
التَّفَرُّقِ: الـ + تَفَرُّق — tafarruq, parting, separation (V verbal noun, m., gen.); 'the parting'
مُرُّ: murr — bitter (m., pred.; printed with damma without tanwīn, for the rhyme)
صَبْرُ: ṣabr — patience, endurance (m., nom.; subject of the question)
تَعَرَّضَتْ: taʿarraḍa, to present oneself, confront (V, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'confronted'
ثَلْثُ: thalth — three (f. form, for thalāth, with sukūn; nom.); see note
صَدُّو: ṣadd — turning away, rebuff (m. verbal noun; printed with a long final -ū, for the rhyme); 'rebuff'
وَهَجْرُ: و + هَجْر — wa-, and (conj.) + hajr, desertion, abandonment (m. verbal noun, nom.); 'and desertion'
ظَرِيفَاً: ẓarīf — graceful, charming (adj., m., acc. tanwīn, here as a noun 'a charming one')
سَبَانِي: sabā, to captivate, take captive (I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he captivated me'
فَوَجَدَتْ: فَ + وَجَدَتْ — fa-, and (conj.) + wajada, to find (I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she found'
وُجُودِهِ: وُجُود + هُ — wujūd, being, existence, consciousness (m., gen. after ʿan) + -hu, his; 'his being'
الْغِنَاءَ: الـ + غِنَاء — ghināʾ, singing, song (m. verbal noun, acc.); 'the singing'
أَقْبَلَا: aqbala, to turn toward, set about (IV, perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two of them turned'
لَعِبٍ: laʿib — play, sport (m., gen. tanwīn after fī); 'play'
وَلَهْوٍ: و + لَهْو — wa-, and (conj.) + lahw, amusement, diversion (m., gen. tanwīn); 'and sport'
بِالرَّوَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + رَوَاح — bi-, with, at (prep.) + al-, the + rawāḥ, going out, going away in the evening (m., gen.); 'with the going-out'
الْجَنَاحَ: الـ + جَنَاح — janāḥ, wing (m., acc.); 'the wing'
وَدَاعَةِ: wadāʿa — repose, security, safe keeping (f., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَحِفْظِهِ: و + حِفْظ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥifẓ, keeping, protection (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and His keeping'
تَدْعُوكَ: tadʿū + ـكَ — daʿā, to call, summon (3rd f. sg. imperf.) + -ka, you (m.); 'she is calling you'
زَفَّتْهُ: zaffat + ـهُ — zaffa, to lead in procession with music (3rd f. sg. perf.; the girls as collective) + -hu, him; 'they led him in procession'
وَالْمَوَاصِلِ: و + الـ + مَوَاصِل — wa-, and + mawāṣil, obscure (gen. pl.; perhaps a kind of instrument, or a slip for مَزَامِير 'pipes'); 'and the mawāṣil'
الْعَاجِ: الـ + عَاج — ʿāj, ivory (m., gen.); 'the ivory'
بِالدُّرَرِ: بِـ + الـ + دُرَر — bi-, with (prep., the verb-adjective مُرَصَّع takes it of the inlay) + durra, pearl (f.; pl. durar, gen.); 'with the pearls'
دَٰرًا: dār — house, mansion (f., acc.; the print omits the alif of دَارًا, so the dagger alif is added)
وَبِدَائِرِ: و + بِـ + دَائِر — wa-, and + bi-, in, at (prep.) + dāʾir, surrounding, circuit (act. part. of dāra; here 'around', gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and around'
شُبَّا: shubbā — first part of شُبَّابِيك 'windows' (shubbāk, pl. shabābīk), split in the print from the next word
بِيكُ: bīku — second part of شُبَّابِيك 'windows' (nom.), split in the print; read together shubbābīk
مُفَتَّحَةٌ: mufattaḥa — opened (pass. part. of II fattaḥa; f., nom.)
صُوَرٌ: ṣuwar — figures, images (f. pl. of ṣūra; nom.)
مُجَسَّمَةٌ: mujassama — embodied, solid (pass. part. of II jassama; f., nom.)
فَتَتَحَرَّكُ: fa- + tataḥarraku — fa-, and so, with the result that (conj.) + V taḥarraka, to move (3rd f. sg. imperf.); 'and so they move'
جَوْفِهَا: jawf + ـهَا — jawf, inside, belly, hollow (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, their; 'inside them'
آلَاتٌ: ālāt — devices, instruments, machines (f. pl. of āla; nom.)
فَيَتَخَيَّلُ: fa- + yatakhayyalu — fa-, and so + V takhayyala, to imagine, appear in the mind (3rd m. sg. imperf.); 'and it seems'
لِلنَّاظِرِ: لِـ + الـ + نَاظِر — li-, to, for (prep., marking the one to whom it seems) + nāẓir, onlooker (act. part. of naẓara; m., gen.); 'to the onlooker'
نَظَرَتْهُ: naẓarat + ـهُ — naẓara, to look, see (3rd f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; the object is attached directly, as printed ('looked upon him')
وَمَسَكَتْ: wa- + masakat — wa-, and + masaka, to seize, take hold of (colloquial for amsaka; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she took hold of'
وَأَجْلَسَتْهُ: wa- + ajlasat + ـهُ — wa-, and + IV ajlasa, to seat (3rd f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and she seated him'
وَسَأَلَتْهُ: wa- + saʾalat + ـهُ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (3rd f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and she asked him'
يَتَحَدَّثَانِ: yataḥaddathāni — V taḥaddatha, to converse (3rd m. dual imperf., indicative); 'conversing'
أَتَعْرِفُ: a- + taʿrifu — a-, interrogative particle + ʿarafa, to know (2nd m. sg. imperf.); 'do you know?'
بِالْعَاشِقِينَ: بِـ + الـ + عَاشِقِين — bi-, with (prep.; taʿallaqa bi- 'be connected with') + ʿāshiq, lover (act. part. of ʿashiqa; m. sound pl., gen.); 'with the lovers'
وَالْمُتَيَّمِينَ: و + الـ + مُتَيَّمِين — wa-, and + mutayyam, love-enslaved, besotted (pass. part. of II tayyama; m. sound pl., gen.); 'and the besotted'
الْأَشْعَارِ: الـ + أَشْعَار — ashʿār, poems, verses (m. pl. of shiʿr; gen. after min); 'the poems'; also gen. after inshād: inshādi al-ashʿāri, 'reciting poems' (Night 194)
أَسْمِعْنِي: asmiʿ + nī — IV asmaʿa, to make hear (imper. m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'let me hear'
مُخَامِرِ: mukhāmir — lurking, clinging, pervading (act. part. of III khāmara; m., gen.)
لِعَزَّةَ: li- + ʿAzza — li-, to, for (prep.) + ʿAzza, the poet's beloved (proper name f., gen. diptote); 'to ʿAzza'
اَعْرَاضِنَا: aʿrāḍ + nā — aʿrāḍ, honours, reputations (pl. of ʿirḍ; gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'our honours'
اسْتَحَلَّتِ: istaḥallat — X istaḥalla, to deem lawful, hold permissible (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she deemed lawful'
قَارَبْتُ: qārabtu — III qāraba, to draw near (1st sg. perf.); 'I drew near'
اِلَّانَبَا: illā + nabā — illā, except (particle) + nabā, to shy away, turn aside (3rd m. sg. perf.; or perhaps a corruption); printed as one word
عَدَتْ: ʿadat — ʿadā, to run, hasten away (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she ran off'
بِصَرْمٍ: bi- + ṣarm — bi-, with (prep., of manner or state) + ṣarm, cutting off, rupture (m., gen.); 'with a rupture'
اَكْثَرْتُ: akthartu — IV akthara, to do much, say much (1st sg. perf.); 'I did much'
اَقَلَّتِ: aqallat — IV aqalla, to do little, lessen (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she did less'
وَتَهْيَامِي: wa- + tahyām + ـِي — wa-, and + tahyām, passionate love, distraction (m. verbal noun of hāma; nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my passion'
بِعَزَّةَ: bi- + ʿAzza — bi-, for, toward (prep., of the object of love) + ʿAzza, the poet's beloved (proper name f., gen. diptote); 'for ʿAzza'
تَخَلَّيْتُ: takhallaytu — V takhallā, to withdraw, give up (1st sg. perf.); 'I withdrew'
وَتَخَلَّتِ: wa- + takhallat — wa-, and + V takhallā, to withdraw (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she withdrew'
لَكَالْمُرْتَجِي: la- + ka- + al- + murtajī — la-, indeed (emphatic, introducing the predicate) + ka-, like, as (prep.) + murtajī, one hoping (act. part. of VIII irtajā; m., gen.); 'surely like the one who hopes'
ظِلَّ: ẓilla — shade, shadow (m., acc.; object of murtajī, or subject after inna; first term of an iḍāfa); also second object of khawwala, 'grant (someone) the shade of'; figuratively 'protection'
الْغَمَامَةِ: الـ + غَمَامَة — ghamāma, cloud (f., gen.); 'the cloud'
لِلْمَقِيلِ: li- + al- + maqīl — li-, for (prep., of purpose) + maqīl, midday rest (m., gen.); 'for the midday rest'
اضْمَحَلَّتِ: iḍmaḥallat — IV-form iḍmaḥalla, to dissolve, vanish (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'it vanishes'
بَيِّنَ: bayyin — clear, manifest (adj., acc., here in an annexation with الْفَصَاحَةِ); printed with shadda
الْفَصَاحَةِ: الـ + فَصَاحَة — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., gen.); 'the eloquence'
عَفِيفٌ: ʿafīf — chaste, continent (adj. m., nom.) Also the name ʿAfīf, one of the caliph's eunuchs: 'ʿAfīf'.
وَبَالَغَ: wa- + bālagha — wa-, and + III bālagha, to go to extremes, exaggerate (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he went far'
لَوْاَنَّ: law + anna — law, if (contrary-to-fact) + anna, that; printed as one word; 'if'
عَزَّةَ: ʿAzza — the poet's beloved (proper name f., acc. after anna)
حَاكَمَتْ: ḥākamat — III ḥākama, to take to court, litigate against (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she went to law with'
الضُّحَى: الـ + ضُحَى — ḍuḥā, forenoon, morning (f., gen.); 'the forenoon'
مُوَفَّقٍ: muwaffaq — one granted success, rightly guided (pass. part. of II waffaqa; m., gen.)
لَقَضَى: la- + qaḍā — la-, indeed (introducing the main clause) + qaḍā, to judge, rule (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he would have judged'
بِعَيْبِ: bi- + ʿayb — bi-, with (prep.; saʿā bi- 'go about with, report') + ʿayb, fault, defect (m., gen.); 'with the fault of'
الْاِلَهُ: الـ + اِلَه — ilāh, god (m., nom.; the printed form of الْإِلَه); 'the God'
خُدُودَهُنَّ: khudūd + hunna — khudūd, cheeks (m. pl. of khadd; acc.) + -hunna, their (f.); 'their cheeks'
نِعَالَهَا: niʿāl + hā — niʿāl, sandals (f. pl. of naʿl; acc.) + -hā, her; 'her sandals'
نِهَايَةِ: nihāya — end, utmost limit (f., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the utmost of'
بُثَيْنَةَ: Buthayna — proper name, Jamīl's beloved (f., gen. diptote, in apposition)
فَأَنْشِدْنَا: fa- + anshid + nā — fa-, then (conj. in a conditional apodosis) + IV anshada, to recite (imper. m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'then recite for us'
أَعْرَفُ: aʿrafu — more knowing, better acquainted (elative of ʿarafa; m., nom.)
بِقَوْلٍ: bi- + qawl — bi-, with (prep.) + qawl, saying, speech (m., gen.); printed so, perhaps a slip for يَقُولُ 'saying'; here: 'by a word, by speech', with bi- of means: lā yatimmu ʿamalun illā bi-qawlin
شِعْرِ: shiʿr — poetry, verse (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
تَبَوَّأ: tabawwaʾa — V tabawwaʾa, to take up a dwelling, settle (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he settles'
الْأَبْ: الـ + أَبْ(يَات) — first half of al-abyāt, 'the verses', split across a line break in print
اتَ: (الْأَبْ)يَاتَ — second half of al-abyāt, 'the verses' (acc. pl., object of anshada), split across a line break in print
الْأبْ: الـ + أَبْ(يَات) — first half of al-abyāt, 'the verses', split across a line break in print
جَاهِدْ: jāhid — jāhada, to strive, fight (III); imperative m. sg.; 'strive!'
جَمِيلُ: Jamīl — the poet Jamīl, lover of Buthayna (m., voc., proper name); 'O Jamīl'
بِغَزْوَةٍ: بِـ + غَزْوَة — ghazwa, raid, military expedition (f., gen.); bi-, in, on (prep.); 'on a raid'
جِهَادٍ: jihād, striving, holy war (m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa)
اُرِيدُ: urīdu — arāda, to want, wish (IV); 1st sg. imperfect; 'I want'
فَتِيلٍ: fatīl — one slain, a killed man (m., gen.; Middle Arabic for qatīl)
مَابِي: مَا + بِـ + ـي — mā, what (rel.); bi-, in (prep.) + -ī, me; 'what is in me'
بُثَيْنَةُ: Buthayna — the beloved of the poet Jamīl (f., voc.)
ثَابِتٌ: thābit — firm, fixed, abiding (act. part. of thabata; m., nom.)
رُدِّي: ruddī — radda, to give back (I); imperative f. sg.; 'give back!'
اَعِشْ: aʿish — ʿāsha, to live (I); 1st sg. jussive (answer to the imperative); 'that I may live'
تُرِيدِينَ: turīdīna — arāda, to want (IV); 2nd f. sg. imperfect; 'you (f.) want'
لَاتُرِيدِينَ: لَا + تُرِيدِين — lā, not (neg. particle) + turīdīna, arāda (IV), 2nd f. sg. imperfect; 'you do not want' (printed as one word)
قَصْدًا: qaṣd — aim, purpose, goal (m., acc. tanwīn)
جَمِيلٌ: Jamīl — the poet Jamīl, lover of Buthayna (m., nom., proper name)
أَرَادَتْهُ: أَرَادَتْ + ـهُ — arāda, to want (IV); 3rd f. sg. perfect; -hu, it (the rel. clause's returning pronoun); 'she wanted it'
بِجَمِيلٍ: بِـ + جَمِيل — Jamīl, the poet (m., gen.); bi-, of, with (prep.; arāda bi-X 'want of X'); 'of Jamīl'
الشَّطْرَ: الـ + شَطْر — shaṭr, half, half-line, hemistich (m., acc.); 'the half-verse'
وَلَايُرْضِيكِ: وَ + لَا + يُرْضِي + ـكِ — wa-, and; lā, not; yurḍī, to please (IV arḍā; 3rd m. sg. imperfect); -ki, you (f.); 'and it does not please you' (printed as one word)
بِالِاعْتِكَارِ: بِـ + الـ + اعْتِكَار — iʿtikār, darkening, gathering gloom (VIII verbal noun of ʿakara; m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., accompaniment); 'with the gathering gloom'
وَنَامَتْ: وَ + نَامَتْ — nāma, to sleep (I); 3rd f. sg. perfect; wa-, and; 'and she slept'
مَقَامِهِ: مَقَام + ـهِ — maqām, place, standing-place (m., gen. after fī); -hi, his; 'his place'
وَقَبَّلْنَ: وَ + قَبَّلْنَ — qabbala, to kiss (II); 3rd f. pl. perfect; wa-, and; 'and they kissed'
سَيِّدَتَنَا: سَيِّدَة + نَا — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., acc. after inna); -nā, our; 'our lady'
الْحُضُورِ: الـ + حُضُور — ḥuḍūr, presence, attendance (m. verbal noun of ḥaḍara; gen. after ilā); 'the presence'
يَضْرِبْنَ: yaḍribna — ḍaraba, to strike, beat (I); 3rd f. pl. imperfect; 'they strike'
وَصُوَرِ: وَ + صُوَر — ṣūra, form, image (f.; broken pl. ṣuwar, gen. in construct); wa-, and; 'and images of'
وَالْوُحُوشِ: وَ + الـ + وُحُوش — waḥsh, wild beast (m.; pl. wuḥūsh, gen.); wa-, and; 'and the wild beasts'
صَنْعَةِ: ṣanʿa — craft, workmanship (f., gen. in construct)
اَجْنَى: ajnā — janā, to pick, gather (fruit) (I); 3rd m. sg. perfect (pointed as an IV form in the print); 'gathered'
رَقِيبِي: رَقِيب + ـي — raqīb, watcher, guardian (m., nom.); -ī, my; 'my watcher'
قَلَائِدٍ: qalāʾid — necklaces (pl. of qilāda; gen. tanwīn)
دُرَّ: durra — pearl (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
النُّحُورِ: الـ + نُحُور — naḥr, throat, upper chest (m.; pl. nuḥūr, gen.); 'the throats'
مُنَضَّدًا: munaḍḍad — arranged in rows, strung (pass. part. of II naḍḍada; m., acc. ḥāl)
بِالْعَسْجَدِ: بِـ + الـ + عَسْجَد — ʿasjad, gold (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep.); 'with the gold'
وَعُيُونِ: وَ + عُيُون — ʿayn, eye, spring (f.; pl. ʿuyūn, gen.); wa-, and; 'and springs'
وَخُدُودِ: وَ + خُدُود — khadd, cheek (m.; pl. khudūd, gen.); wa-, and; 'and cheeks'
الْبَنَفْسَجِ: الـ + بَنَفْسَج — banafsaj, violet (m., gen.); 'the violet'
زُرْقَ: zurq — blue(s) (pl. of azraq; acc., object of ḥakā)
وَكُحِّلَتْ: وَ + كُحِّلَتْ — kaḥḥala, to line with kohl (II); 3rd f. sg. perfect passive; wa-, and; 'and (they) were kohl-lined'
بِالْاِثْمِدِ: بِـ + الـ + إِثْمِد — ithmid, antimony, kohl powder (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep.); 'with antimony'
أَتُحْسِنُ: أَ + تُحْسِنُ — a-, interrogative particle; aḥsana, to do well (IV); 2nd m. sg. imperfect; 'do you do well?'
لَعِبِ: laʿib — playing, game (verbal noun of laʿiba; m., gen. after fī)
الشِّطْرَنْجِ: الـ + شِطْرَنْج — shiṭranj, chess (m., gen.); 'the chess'
اَقُولُ: aqūlu — qāla, to say (I); 1st sg. imperfect; 'I say'
وَالْوَجْدُ: وَ + الـ + وَجْد — wajd, passion, ardent love (m., nom.); wa-, while, and (circumstantial); 'and passion'; here: simply 'and', coordinating
وَنَهْلَةٌ: وَ + نَهْلَة — nahla, a drink, a sip (f., nom.); wa-, and; 'and a sip'
تُرْوِينِي: turwīnī — arwā, to give to drink, quench (IV); 3rd f. sg. imperfect + -nī, me; 'quenches me'
حَضَرْتُ: ḥaḍartu — ḥaḍara, to attend, be present at (I); 1st sg. perfect; 'I attended'
فَلَاعَبَنِي: فَ + لَاعَبَ + نِي — lāʿaba, to play against (III); 3rd m./f. sg. perfect; -nī, me; fa-, and so; 'and she played me'
بِالْبِيضِ: بِـ + الـ + بِيض — abyaḍ, white (pl. bīḍ, gen.); bi-, with (prep.); 'with the whites'
وَالسُّودِ: وَ + الـ + سُود — aswad, black (pl. sūd, gen.); wa-, and; 'and the blacks'
يُرْضِينِي: yurḍīnī — arḍā, to please, satisfy (IV); 3rd m. sg. imperfect + -nī, me; 'pleases me'
كَاَنَّمَا: كَأَنَّمَا — ka-annamā, as though, as if (conj.)
الشَّاهُ: الـ + شَاه — shāh, king (Persian; the chess king, m., nom.); 'the king'
الرُّخِّ: الـ + رُخّ — rukhkh, rook (chess piece, m., gen.); 'the rook'
مَوْضِعُهُ: مَوْضِع + هُ — mawḍiʿ, place, position (m., nom.); -hu, his; 'his place'
دَسْتًا: dast — hand, move, round of a game (Persian; m., acc. tanwīn)
بِالْفَرَازِينِ: بِـ + الـ + فَرَازِين — firzān, queen (chess piece; pl. farāzīn, gen.); bi-, among, with (prep.); 'among the queens'
فَغُنْجُ: فَ + غُنْج — ghunj, coquetry, languishing manner (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); fa-, then; 'then the coquetry of'
اَلْحَاظِهَا: أَلْحَاظ + هَا — alḥāẓ, glances, eyes (pl. of laḥẓ, m.; gen.); -hā, her; 'her eyes'
يُرْدِينِي: yurdīnī — ardā, to destroy, bring to ruin (IV); 3rd m. sg. imperfect + -nī, me; 'destroys me'
نَقْلِهَا: نَقْل + هَا — naql, moving, moving of a piece (m., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her moving of the pieces'
فَيَضَعُ: فَ + يَضَعُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + waḍaʿa, put, place (3 m. sg. impf.); 'and he puts'
الْفَرَسَ: الـ + فَرَس — faras, horse, the knight at chess (m., acc., object); 'the horse'
الْفِيلِ: الـ + فِيل — fīl, elephant, the bishop at chess (m., gen.); 'the elephant'
وَيَضَعُ: وَ + يَضَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + waḍaʿa, put, place (3 m. sg. impf.); 'and he puts'
الْفِيلَ: الـ + فِيل — fīl, elephant, the bishop at chess (m., acc., object); 'the elephant'
لَعِبُكَ: لَعِب + كَ — laʿib, play, playing (m., nom., verbal noun of laʿiba) + -ka, your (m.); 'your playing'
دَسْتٍ: دَسْت — dast, round, a hand at a game (Persian, m., gen., indef.); 'of a round'
لَاتَحْسِبِيهِ: لَا + تَحْسِبِي + هِ — lā, do not (neg. with jussive) + ḥasaba, count, reckon (2 f. sg. juss.) + -hi, it; printed as one word; 'do not count it'
غَلَبَتْهُ: غَلَبَتْ + هُ — ghalaba, defeat, beat (3 f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'she beat him'
وَصَفَّ: وَ + صَفَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣaffa, line up, arrange in rows (II; 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he arranged'
الْقِطَعَ: الـ + قِطَع — qiṭaʿ, pieces (f. pl. of qiṭʿa, acc., object); 'the pieces'
وَلَعِبَ: وَ + لَعِبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + laʿiba, play (3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he played'
فَغَلَبَتْهُ: فَ + غَلَبَتْ + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + ghalaba, beat (3 f. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and she beat him'
وَرَابِعًا: وَ + رَابِعًا — wa-, and (conj.) + rābiʿ, fourth (acc. adverbial); 'and a fourth time'
وَخَامِسًا: وَ + خَامِسًا — wa-, and (conj.) + khāmis, fifth (acc. adverbial); 'and a fifth time'
مَغْلُوبٌ: مَغْلُوب — maghlūb, beaten, overcome (pass. part. of ghalaba; m., nom., predicate); 'beaten'
لَاعَبَ: لَاعَبَ — lāʿaba, play against, play with (III; 3 m. sg. perf.); 'plays with'
مِثْلَكِ: مِثْل + كِ — mithl, like, the like of (m., acc., object) + -ki, you (f. sg.); 'one like you'
لَايُغْلَبُ: لَا + يُغْلَبُ — lā, not (neg.) + ghalaba, beat (pass.; 3 m. sg. impf.); printed as one word, with a damma on the yāʾ; 'is not beaten'
الْقَانُونَ: الـ + قَانُون — qānūn, zither (m., acc., object); 'the zither'
يَدٌفِي: يَدٌ + فِي — yad, hand, skill (f., nom., indef.) + fī, in (prep.); printed as one word; 'a hand in, skill at'
الْقَانُونِ: الـ + قَانُون — qānūn, zither (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the zither'
مَابَيْنَ: مَا + بَيْنَ — mā, what (here a filler before bayna) + bayna, between (prep./adv., acc.); printed as one word; 'between'
مَطْوِيٍّ: مَطْوِيّ — maṭwī, folded, rolled up (pass. part. of ṭawā; m., gen., indef.); 'folded'
وَمَبْسُوطِ: وَ + مَبْسُوط — wa-, and (conj.) + mabsūṭ, spread out (pass. part. of basaṭa; m., gen.); 'and spread out'
وَمِثْلُهُ: وَ + مِثْل + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + mithl, like, likeness (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and its likeness'
مَجْرُورٍ: مَجْرُور — majrūr, dragged, drawn along (pass. part. of jarra; m., gen., indef.)
وَمَخْرُوطِ: وَ + مَخْرُوط — wa-, and (conj.) + makhrūṭ, turned on a lathe, shaped to a cone (pass. part. of kharaṭa; m., gen.); 'and lathe-turned'
فَاشْرَبْ: فَ + اشْرَبْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ishrab, drink (imper. 2 m. sg. of shariba); 'so drink'
اِنْكُنْتَ: إِنْ + كُنْتَ — in, if (cond.) + kāna, be (2 m. sg. perf.); printed as one word; 'if you are'
لَاتُفَارِقَنِي: لَا + تُفَارِقَنِي — lā, not (neg.) + fāraqa, part from, leave (III; 2 m. sg. subj.) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'that you not leave me'
تَفْرِيطِ: تَفْرِيط — tafrīṭ, neglect, negligence (m., gen., verbal noun of II farraṭa)
فَأَلْقَى: فَ + أَلْقَى — fa-, and so (conj.) + alqā, throw, cast (IV; 3 m. sg. perf.); 'and he threw'
وَأَخَذْنَهُ: وَ + أَخَذْن + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, take (3 f. pl. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and they took him'
وَمَشَيْنَ: وَ + مَشَيْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + mashā, walk (3 f. pl. perf.); 'and they walked'
تَرْكُنَنَّ: تَرْكُنَنَّ — rakana, incline, lean (2 m. sg. energetic); 'do not lean'
الْمَذَاقِ: الـ + مَذَاق — madhāq, taste (m., gen.); 'the taste'
اَلشَّمْسُ: الـ + شَّمْسُ — shams, sun (f., nom.); 'the sun'
غُرُوبِهَا: غُرُوب + هَا — ghurūb, setting (m., gen.; verbal noun of gharaba) + -hā, its / her; 'its setting'
تَصْفَرُّ: تَصْفَرُّ — iṣfarra, turn yellow, grow pale (IX; 3 f. sg. impf.); 'she turns yellow'
اَلَمِ: أَلَم — alam, pain, suffering (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the pain of'
بِضَجَّةٍ: بِـ + ضَجَّة — ḍajja, clamour, uproar (f., gen.); bi-, with (prep.), after وَإِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears: 'and behold, a clamour'
مُتَزَاحِمِينَ: mutazāḥim — crowding, jostling (act. part. of VI tazāḥama; m. pl., acc./gen., agreeing with رِجَال); 'crowding'
وَبَطَارِقَةٍ: وَ + بَطَارِقَة — baṭāriqa, patricians, Byzantine nobles (pl. of بَطْرِيق; gen.); 'and patricians'
بِأَيْدِيهِمُ: بِـ + أَيْدِي + هِمُ — yad, hand (f., pl. aydī, gen.); bi-, in (prep., 'in their hands') + 'their' (the final vowel is carried to the article that follows)
مَسْلُولَةً: maslūl — drawn (of a sword) (pass. part. of I salla; f. sg., acc. as circumstantial ḥāl); 'drawn'
تَلْمَعُ: talmaʿu — gleams, flashes (imperf. of I lamaʿa; 3 f. sg., with the swords as subject); 'gleaming'
فَأَيْقَنَ: فَ + أَيْقَنَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ayqana, was certain (IV; perf. 3 m. sg.; takes its object with بِـ)
وَأَمْهَلَتْنِي: وَ + أَمْهَلَتْ + نِي — amhala, gave respite, gave time (IV; perf. 3 f. sg.) + 'me'; 'and she gave me time'
رِجَالُهَا: رِجَال + هَا — rijāl, men (pl. of رَجُل; nom.); 'her men'
خَوَّفَتْنِي: khawwafat-nī — frightened, threatened (II khawwafa; perf. 3 f. sg.) + 'me'; takes the thing threatened with بِـ
أَلْقَيْتُ: alqaytu — cast, threw (IV alqā; perf. 1 sg.); 'I cast'
لِيُعَاتِبَهَا: لِـ + يُعَاتِبَ + هَا — li-, in order to (conj., with subjunctive) + yuʿātibu, reproaches (III ʿātaba; subj. 3 m. sg.) + 'her'; 'to reproach her'
بِالِاصْفِرَارِ: بِـ + الـ + اصْفِرَار — iṣfirār, yellowing, pallor (verbal noun of iṣfarra, m., gen.); bi-, by, with (prep., of the means): 'with the paling'
الْبَطْرِيقُ: الـ + بَطْرِيق — baṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine commander (m., nom.); 'the patrician'
الْمُقَدَّمُ: الـ + مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, set forward, put in command (pass. part. of II qaddama; m., nom., describing الْبَطْرِيق); 'the one put in command' Also as a noun, 'the captain': fa-ṭallaʿanā al-muqaddamu, 'the captain put us aboard'.
الْكَرِيمَةُ: الـ + كَرِيمَة — karīma, noble, generous (f., nom. in the vocative phrase); 'the noble'
وَالدُّرَّةُ: وَ + الـ + دُرَّة — durra, pearl (f., nom. in the vocative phrase); 'and the pearl'
لَاأَعْرِفُهُ: لَا + أَعْرِفُ + هُ — lā, not (neg.) + aʿrifu, I know (imperf. of I ʿarafa; 1 sg.) + 'him' (printed as one word); 'I do not know him'
مُخَرِّبُ: mukharrib — ruiner, devastator (act. part. of II kharraba; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَسَيِّدُ: وَ + سَيِّد — sayyid, lord, master (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and lord of'
الْقِلَاعَ: الـ + قِلَاع — qilāʿ, fortresses, citadels (pl. of قَلْعَة; acc.); 'the fortresses'
وَمَلَكَ: وَ + مَلَكَ — malaka, took possession of, ruled (I; perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he took possession of'
حِصْنٍ: ḥiṣn — fortress, stronghold (m., gen. after كُلّ); also gen. after alf, 'a thousand forts'
مَنَاعٍ: manāʿ — forbidding, impregnable (printed form; read as manna ʿ, an intensive adj. of manaʿa, or for منيع; m., gen., describing حِصْن)
حَرْدُوبَ: Ḥardūb — name of the Christian king, the girl's father and the son of the old woman Dhāt al-Dawāhī (proper name, diptote, acc. or gen. with -a; in apposition after الْمَلِك)
وَالِدِكِ: وَالِد + كِ — wālid, father (m., gen., in apposition); 'your (f.) father'
السَّيِّدَةِ: الـ + سَيِّدَة — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., gen. after مِنْ); 'the lady'
وَالِدُكِ: وَالِد + كِ — wālid, father (m., nom., subject of تَحَقَّقَ); 'your (f.) father'
نَقْلًا: naqlan — report, transmission (verbal noun of I naqala; acc. adverbial); 'by report'
الْعَجُوزِوَهَا: الـ + عَجُوز + وَ + هَا — ʿajūz, old woman (f., gen. after عَنْ) + wa-, and + hā, lo, here (printed as one word); 'the old woman, and lo'
نَصَرْتِ: naṣarti — helped, gave victory to (I naṣara; perf. 2 f. sg.); 'you (f.) have helped'
عَسْكَرَ: ʿaskar — army, host (m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْأَسَدِ: الـ + أَسَد — asad, lion (m., gen.); 'the lion', here Sharkān; also the animal itself: aẓfāri al-asadi, 'the claws of the lion' (Night 182)
الْمَشْئُومِ: الـ + مَشْئُوم — mashʾūm, ill-omened, unlucky (pass. part. of shaʾuma; m., gen., describing الْأَسَد); 'the ill-starred'
الْبَطْرِيقِ: الـ + بَطْرِيق — baṭrīq, patrician (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the patrician'
اسْمُكَ: اسْم + كَ — ism, name (m., nom.); 'your (m.) name'
مَاسُورَةُ: Māsūra — the patrician's name (proper name, nom.)
عَهْدِكَ: ʿahd + ka — covenant, oath, time, charge (m., gen.) + 'your'; obscure here, perhaps a corrupt word (see the note)
مُوسُورَةَ: Mūsūra — a name (proper name, second in the chain of names)
كَاشْرَدَهْ: Kāshrada — a name (proper name, the patrician's father or forefather)
بَطْرِيقُ: baṭrīq — patrician (m., nom. in apposition; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْبَطَارِنَةِ: الـ + بَطَارِنَة — baṭārina, patricians (printed for بَطَارِقَة; pl., gen.); 'the patricians'
إِذْنِي: idhn + ī — permission, leave (m., gen. after غَيْر); 'my leave'
مَامَنَعَنِي: مَا + مَنَعَ + نِي — mā, not (neg.) + manaʿa, prevented, stopped (I; perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'me' (printed as one word); 'did not stop me'
وَلَابَوَّابٌ: وَ + لَا + بَوَّاب — wa-, and + lā, nor (neg.) + bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., nom.) (printed as one word); 'and no doorkeeper'
وَمَشَوْابَيْنَ: وَ + مَشَوْا + بَيْنَ — wa-, and + mashaw, they walked (I mashā; perf. 3 m. pl.) + bayna, between (prep., acc.) (printed as one word); 'and they walked between'
الْعَادَةُ: الـ + عَادَة — ʿāda, custom (f., nom.); 'the custom'
غَيْرُنَا: ghayr + nā — other than, anyone but (m., nom., in apposition to أَحَد) + 'us'; 'other than us'
يَتْرُكُونَهُ: yatrukūna + hu — they leave (imperf. of I taraka; 3 m. pl.) + 'him'; 'they leave him'
يَسْتَأْذِنُوا: yastaʾdhinū — they ask leave (X istaʾdhana; subj. 3 m. pl., after ḥattā; the nūn dropped); takes عَلَى for the person announced; here after an, with li- for the one on whose behalf and bi- for what is asked: an yastaʾdhinū lī bi-al-dukhūli
إِطَالَةِ: iṭāla — prolonging, lengthening (verbal noun of IV aṭāla; f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
مُنْتَظِرٌ: muntaẓir — waiting, expecting (act. part. of VIII intaẓara; m. sg., nom., predicate)
رُجُوعَنَا: رُجُوع + نَا — rujūʿ, return (verbal noun of I rajaʿa; m., acc., object of the participle) + 'our'; 'our return'
شَوْكَةُ: shawka — thorn, (hence) sting, military might (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the thorn of'
وَيَرْحَلُ: وَ + يَرْحَلُ — wa-, and + yarḥalu, departs, marches off (imperf. of I raḥala; subj. 3 m. sg.); 'and departs'
جَاوُا: jāwū — they came (printed for جَاؤُوا; I jāʾa, perf. 3 m. pl.)
قِتَالِهِمْ: قِتَال + هِمْ — qitāl, fighting (verbal noun of III qātala; m., gen. after فِي) + 'them'; 'fighting them'
كَذَبَتِ: كَذَبَ — kadhaba, to lie (perf. 3fs, linking kasra before al-); 'she lied'
بَاطِلٍ: bāṭil, false, vain, untrue (adj., m. gen. indef.)
حَقِيقَتَهُ: حَقِيقَة + ـهُ — ḥaqīqa, truth, reality (f., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'its truth'
أَسِيرٌ: أَسِير — asīr, captive, prisoner (m. nom. indef.)
الضِّيَافَةَ: الـ + ضِيَافَة — ḍiyāfa, hospitality, entertainment of a guest (f., acc.)
فَأَضَفْنَاهُ: فَـ + أَضَافَ + نَا + ـهُ — fa-, so (conj. of consequence) + aḍāfa, to host as a guest (perf. 1pl, form IV, with the long vowel shortened before the ending) + 3ms suffix; 'so we hosted him'
تَحَقَّقْنَا: تَحَقَّقَ — taḥaqqaqa, to ascertain, be sure (perf. 1pl, form V); 'we ascertained'
بِمُرُوَّتِي: بِـ + مُرُوَّة + ـي — bi-, to, for (prep.; yalīqu takes bi- for what is fitting to someone) + muruwwa, manliness, honour (f. gen.) + 1s suffix; 'for my honour'
أُمَكِّنُكُمْ: مَكَّنَ + ـكُمْ — makkana, to give power to, allow (imperf. 1s indic., form II) + 2m pl suffix; 'I give you power'
تَخُونُونِي: خَانَ + ـنِي — khāna, to betray (imperf. 2m pl indic.) + 1s object suffix; 'you betray me' (after lā, 'do not betray me')
تَفْضَحُونِي: فَضَحَ + ـنِي — faḍaḥa, to disgrace, expose to shame (imperf. 2m pl indic.) + 1s object suffix; 'you disgrace me'
الْأَنَامِ: الـ + أَنَام — anām, mankind, people (m. gen.)
وَقَبِّلِ: وَ + قَبَّلَ — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (imperative 2ms, form II, linking kasra); 'and kiss'
وَأَخْبِرْهُ: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform (imperative 2ms, form IV) + 3ms object suffix; 'and tell him'
الْبِطْرِيقُ: الـ + بِطْرِيق — baṭrīq (printed with kasra, biṭrīq), patrician, Byzantine commander (m., nom.); 'the patrician'
سُورَةُ: sūra, of obscure sense in the phrase mā sūra; perhaps for ṣūra, 'form' (f., nom.); 'what a form!', an exclamation of refusal
أَبْرِيزَةُ: Abrīza, the Christian girl, daughter of King Ḥardūb (proper name, f., vocative)
أَعُودَ: عَادَ — ʿāda, to return (imperf. 1s subjunctive after an); 'that I return'
بِغَرِيمِهِ: بِـ + غَرِيم + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment) + gharīm, adversary, debtor (m. gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'with his adversary'
عُذِّلْهُ: عَذَّلَ + ـهُ — ʿadhdhala, to reproach, chide (imperative 2ms, form II; the ʿayn carries the printed damma) + 3ms object suffix; 'chide him'
بِالْجَوَابِ: بِـ + الـ + جَوَاب — bi-, with (prep., means) + al-, the + jawāb, answer, reply (m. gen.); 'with the answer' Also after ʿāda, 'to come back', bi- marks what one brings back: ʿud … bi-al-jawābi, 'come back with the answer' (Night 188).
فَتَغَيَّرَ: فَـ + تَغَيَّرَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + taghayyara, to change (perf. 3ms, form V); 'and it changed'
وَالْهَذَيَانِ: وَ + الـ + هَذَيَان — wa-, and + al-, the + hadhayān, raving, delirious talk (m. gen.); 'and the raving'
وَاثِقٌ: wāthiq, confident, sure (active part. of wathiqa, m. nom. indef.)
لَاأُمَكِّنُكُمْ: لَا + أُمَكِّنُ + كُمْ — lā, not (negative) + makkana, to give power to, allow (imperf. 1s, form II) + 2m pl suffix; 'I will not let you' (printed as one word)
تَتَعَرَّضُوا: تَعَرَّضَ — taʿarraḍa, to expose oneself to, to molest, to meddle with (imperf. 2m pl subjunctive, form V); 'that you molest'
تَعَرَّضْتُمْ: تَعَرَّضَ — taʿarraḍa, to molest (perf. 2m pl, form V); 'you molested'
أُحْضِرُةُ: أَحْضَرَ + ـةُ — aḥḍara, to bring, present (imperf. 1s indic., form IV) + 3ms object suffix, printed with tāʾ marbūṭa for -hu; 'I bring him'
وَسَيْفُهُ: وَ + سَيْف + ـهُ — wa-, and + sayf, sword (m. nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his sword'
وَخِفَّتُهُ: وَ + خِفَّة + ـهُ — wa-, and + khiffa, lightness, agility (f. nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his lightness'
أَمِنْتُ: أَمِنَ — amina, to be safe (perf. 1s); 'I am safe'
غَضَبِكِ: غَضَب + ـكِ — ghaḍab, anger (m. gen.) + 2fs suffix; 'your anger'
آمَنْ: أَمِنَ — amina, to be safe (imperf. 1s jussive after lam); 'I am not safe'
أَبِيكِ: أَب + ـكِ — ab, father (m. gen.) + 2fs suffix; 'your father'
رَأَبْتُهُ: رَأَى (printed with bāʾ for yāʾ) + تُ + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (perf. 1s) + 3ms object suffix; 'I saw him'
الْبَطَارِقَةِ: الـ + بَطَارِقَة — baṭāriqa, patricians (pl. of baṭrīq, m., gen.); 'the patricians'
فَيَأْخُذُونَهُ: فَـ + أَخَذَ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj. of consequence) + akhadha, to take (imperf. 3m pl indic.) + 3ms object suffix; 'and they take him'
وَنَمْضِي: وَ + مَضَى — wa-, and + maḍā, to go (imperf. 1pl indic.); 'and we go'
حَقِيرًا: حَقِير — ḥaqīr, despised, abased (m. acc. indef., acc. of state); 'abased'
عُنْوَانُ: عُنْوَان — ʿunwān, title, token, mark (m. nom., in construct); 'the mark of'
مُصَادَمَتَهُ: مُصَادَمَة + ـهُ — muṣādama, clashing, encountering (verbal noun of ṣādama, form III; f. acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'clashing with him'
فَابْرُزُوا: فَـ + بَرَزَ — fa-, then (conj.) + baraza, to come out, step forth (imperative 2m pl); 'then come forth'
أَبْطَلُ: abṭal, more valiant (elative of baṭal, hero; or 'more worthless' from bāṭil) (m., nom.)
لِلْخَمْسِينَ: لِـ + الـ + خَمْسِين — li-, to, for (prep.; here 'completing to the fifty') + al-, the + khamsīn, fifty; 'to the fifty'
لِلْبَطْرِيقِ: لِـ + الـ + بَطْرِيق — li-, to (prep.; marks the person spoken to after قَالَ) + al-, the + baṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine noble commander (m.); 'to the patrician'
فَأَظْهِرُوا: فَـ + أَظْهِرُوا — fa-, then, so (introduces the command) + aẓhirū, show yourselves, appear (IV imperative m. pl. of ظَهَرَ); 'then show yourselves'
الْبَطَلُ: الـ + بَطَل — baṭal, hero, brave warrior (m.); 'the hero'
سُورَةٌ: سُورَة — sūra, obscure as printed (the ordinary meaning is 'chapter, row, rank'); possibly corrupt, see note
قُلْتِ: قَالَ — qāla, to say (2nd f. sg. perfect, -ti; the kasra is printed in the edition); 'you said'; here: 'you (f.) said / told', addressed to the slave-girl: alladhī qulti lī ʿalayhi, 'whom you told me about'
اُصْبُرْ: صَبَرَ — ṣabara, to be patient (imperative m. sg.); 'be patient, wait'
وَأُعَرِّفَهُ: وَ + أُعَرِّفَ + هُ — wa-, and + uʿarrifa, to make known, inform (II; 1st sg. subj., continuing after حَتَّى) + -hu, him; 'and acquaint him'
بِالْخِطَابِ: بِـ + الـ + خِطَاب — bi-, with (prep.; عَرَّفَ takes بِـ for the thing made known) + al-, the + khiṭāb, address, speech (m.); 'with the speech'
أَجَابَ: أَجَابَ — ajāba, to answer (IV; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he answers'
أَبَى: أَبَى — abā, to refuse (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he refuses'
وَأَكُونَ: وَ + أَكُونَ — wa-, and + akūna, to be (1st sg. subj.); 'and I shall be'
وَجَوَارِيَّ: وَ + جَوَارِي + ي — wa-, and + jawārī, girls (plural of جَارِيَة) + -ya, my (the shadda is printed); 'and my girls'
فِدَاهُ: فِدَاء + هُ — fidāʾ, ransom, sacrifice (m.) + -hu, him; 'his ransom'
تُخْبِرْ: أَخْبَرَ — akhbara, to inform (IV; 3rd f. sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'she did not tell'
بِأَمْرِهِ: بِـ + أَمْر + هِ — bi-, about (prep.; أَخْبَرَ takes بِـ for the matter) + amr, matter, affair (m.) + -hi, his; 'about his affair'
خَبَرَةُ: خَبَر + ة — khabar, news (m.) + ة, printed for the pronoun ـه 'his' (a slip, see note); 'his news'
إِرَادَتِهَا: إِرَادَة + هَا — irāda, will, intention (f.) + -hā, her; 'her will'
بِاللَّوْمِ: بِـ + الـ + لَوْم — bi-, with (prep.; 'turn back with something') + al-, the + lawm, blame, reproach (m.); 'with the blame'
بُرُوزَهُمْ: بُرُوز + هُمْ — burūz, coming out, sallying forth (verbal noun of بَرَزَ), acc. + -hum, their; 'their sallying out'
إِنِيَّ: printed إِنِّي-like form with a shadda on yā'; probably a misprint for إِلَيَّ, ilayya, 'to me' (see note)
إِحْجَافٌ: إِحْجَاف — iḥjāf, printed with ḥ before j for إِجْحَاف, ijḥāf, wronging, depriving of due (verbal noun IV of أَجْحَفَ); 'a wrong, an injustice'
فَهَلَّا: فَـ + هَلَّا — fa-, so, then + hallā, why not (particle of urging); 'so why not'
يَبْرُزُونَ: بَرَزَ — baraza, to come out, sally forth (3rd m. pl. imperfect); 'they come out'
الشَّطَارَةُ: الـ + شَطَارَة — shaṭāra, daring, bravado, cunning (f.); 'the bravado'
سَيْفُهُ: سَيْف + هُ — sayf, sword (m.) + -hu, his; 'his sword'
وَآلَةُ: وَ + آلَة — wa-, and + āla, tool, instrument, weapon (f.); 'and the gear of'
حَرْبِهِ: حَرْب + هِ — ḥarb, war (f.), gen. in construct + -hi, his; 'his war'
فَقَابَلَهُ: فَـ + قَابَلَ + هُ — fa-, and + qābala, to face, meet (III; 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and met him'
عَاتِقِهِ: عَاتِق + هِ — ʿātiq, shoulder (m.) + -hi, his; 'his shoulder'
وَأَمْعَائِهِ: وَ + أَمْعَاء + هِ — wa-, and + amʿāʾ, bowels, entrails (plural of مِعًى) + -hi, his; 'and his bowels'
وَعَرَفَتْ: وَ + عَرَفَتْ — wa-, and + ʿarafat, to know, recognise (3rd f. sg. perfect); 'and she knew'
صَرَعَتْهُ: صَرَعَ + تْ + هُ — ṣaraʿa, to fell, throw down (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'she felled him'
بِقُوَّتِهَا: بِـ + قُوَّة + هَا — bi-, by, by means of (prep.) + quwwa, strength (f.) + -hā, her; 'by her strength'
بِثَأْرِ: بِـ + ثَأْر — bi-, (take) in, i.e. أَخَذَ بِـ = 'avenge' (the verb chooses the preposition) + thaʾr, blood-revenge (m.), gen. in construct; 'the vengeance of'
صَاحِبِكُمْ: صَاحِب + كُمْ — ṣāḥib, companion, comrade (m.) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your comrade'
الْمَقْتُولِ: الـ + مَقْتُول — maqtūl, killed (pass. part. of قَتَلَ), gen.; 'the slain man'
جَبَّارًا: جَبَّار — jabbār, tyrant, mighty brute (m.), acc. predicate of كَانَ; 'a tyrant'
فَحَمَلَ: فَـ + حَمَلَ — fa-, and, so + ḥamala, to charge (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and he charged'
يُمْهِلْهُ: أَمْهَلَ + هُ — amhala, to give respite, give time (IV; 3rd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ) + -hu, him; 'give him respite'
ضَرَبَهُ: ضَرَبَ + هُ — ḍaraba, to strike (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'he struck him'
أَمْعَائِهِ: أَمْعَاء + هِ — amʿāʾ, bowels, entrails (plural of مِعًى), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his bowels'
نَادَتِ: نَادَى — nādā, to call out (III; 3rd f. sg. perfect, with helping kasra before الـ); 'she called out'
عِبَادَ: عِبَاد — ʿibād, servants, worshippers (plural of عَبْد), in construct; 'servants of'
بَطْرِيقًا: بَطْرِيق — baṭrīq, patrician (m.), acc. singular after the number; 'patricians'
قَذَفَ: قَذَفَ — qadhafa, to cast, hurl (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'cast' Also, of a boatman, with bi-, 'to row, ply the oars with': qadhafa bihimā, 'he rowed them (across)'.
الرُّعْبَ: الـ + رُعْب — ruʿb, terror (m.), acc.; 'the terror'
قُلُوبِ: قُلُوب — qulūb, hearts (plural of قَلْب), gen. in construct; 'the hearts of'
تَأَخَّرُوا: تَأَخَّرَ — taʾakhkhara, to hold back, lag (V; 3rd m. pl. perfect); 'they held back'
الْبَرَازِ: الـ + بَرَاز — barāz, single combat, duelling (m.), gen.; 'the duel'
يَجْسُرُوا: جَسَرَ — jasara, to dare (3rd m. pl. jussive after لَمْ; جَسَرَ عَلَى = 'dare to'); 'they dared'
الْبُرُوزِ: الـ + بُرُوز — burūz, coming out, sallying forth (m.), gen. after عَلَى; 'the sallying out'
بِأَجْمَعِهِمْ: بِـ + أَجْمَع + هِمْ — bi-, with (prep.) + ajmaʿ, all, the whole of (elative of جَامِع) + -him, them; 'all of them together'
بِقَلْبٍ: بِـ + قَلْب — bi-, with (prep.) + qalb, heart (m.); 'with a heart'
طَحَنَهُمْ: طَحَنَ + هُمْ — ṭaḥana, to grind (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hum, them; 'he ground them'
الدِّرَاسِ: الـ + دِرَاس — dirās, threshing (m.), gen.; 'the threshing' (see note)
وَسَلَبَ: وَ + سَلَبَ — wa-, and + salaba, to strip, take away (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and stripped'
وَالنُّفُوسَ: وَ + الـ + نُفُوس — wa-, and + al-, the + nufūs, souls, selves (plural of نَفْس), acc.; 'and the souls'
جَوَارِبِهَا: جَوَارِب + هَا — jawārib, stockings (plural of جَوْرَب) + -hā, her; printed for جَوَارِيهَا, 'her girls' (a slip, see note)
لَاقَتْهُ: لَاقَى + هُ — lāqā, to meet, encounter (III; 3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'she met him'
بِالْأَحْضَانِ: بِـ + الـ + أَحْضَان — bi-, in, with (prep.) + al-, the + aḥḍān, embraces, bosoms (plural of حِضْن); 'in embraces'
فَرَاغِهِ: فَرَاغ + هِ — farāgh, finishing, being free of (m.), gen. in construct + -hi, his; 'his finishing'
الْمُعَارَكَةِ: الـ + مُعَارَكَة — muʿāraka, fighting, battle (verbal noun of III عَارَكَ) (f.), gen.; 'the fighting'
كَامِنٌ: كَامِن — kāmin, lurking, hidden (act. part. of كَمَنَ), nom.; 'lurking'
زَوَايَا: زَوَايَا — zawāyā, corners (plural of زَاوِيَة), diptote, in construct; 'the corners of'
الْقَلِيلِ: الـ + قَلِيل — qalīl, few, a little (adj.), gen.; 'that few'
زَرَدِيَّةٌ: زَرَدِيَّة — zaradiyya, coat of mail (f.; from زَرَد, mail rings); 'a coat of mail'
ضَيِّقَةُ: ضَيِّقَة — ḍayyiqa, narrow, close (f. adj.), nom. in construct; 'narrow of'
وَبِيَدِهَا: وَ + بِـ + يَد + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + bi-, in (prep.; 'in her hand') + yad, hand (f.) + -hā, her; 'and in her hand'
أَبْخَلْ: بَخِلَ — bakhila, to be stingy, grudge (1st sg. jussive after لَمْ); 'I will not grudge'
أَتَخَلَّى: تَخَلَّى — takhallā, to abandon, give up (V; 1st sg. subj. after لَا); 'I abandon'
بَقِى: بَقِيَ — baqiya, to remain (3rd m. sg. perfect; printed with ى); 'there should remain'
مَعِيرَةٌ: مَعِيرَة — maʿīra, reproach, disgrace (f.; cf. عَيَّرَ 'to reproach'); 'a reproach'
تَأَمَّلَتِ: تَأَمَّلَ — taʾammala, to look closely at, survey (V; 3rd f. sg. perfect, helping kasra before الـ); 'she surveyed'
الْبَطَارِقَةَ: الـ + بَطَارِقَة — baṭāriqa, patricians (plural of بَطْرِيق), acc.; 'the patricians'
وَجَدَتْهُ: وَجَدَ + تْ + هُ — wajada, to find (3rd f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'she found him'
وَاِنْهَزَمَ: وَ + اِنْهَزَمَ — wa-, and + inhazama, to be routed, flee (VII; 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and fled'
بِالْقَوْمِ: بِـ + الـ + قَوْم — bi-, to (prep.; صَنَعَ بِـ = 'do to') + al-, the + qawm, people, host (m.); 'to the people'
بِمِثْلِكَ: بِـ + مِثْل + كَ — bi-, in, through (prep.) + mithl, the like of (m.) + -ka, you; 'in one like you'; here: after samiʿa, bi- marks what one hears of: mā samiʿtu bi-mithlika, 'I have not heard of the like of you'
تَفْتَخِرُ: اِفْتَخَرَ — iftakhara, to boast, take pride (VIII; 3rd f. sg. imperfect, as the verb precedes its plural subject); 'take pride'
الْفُرْسَانُ: الـ + فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen, knights (plural of فَارِس); 'the knights'
فَلِلَّهِ: فَـ + لِـ + اللَّه — fa-, so + li-, to, for (prep.) + Allāh, God; li-llāhi darruka = a cry of admiration
فَرَّقْتُ: farraqtu — farraqa, form II, to scatter, break up (perfect, 1st sg. -tu); 'I scattered'
الْهَيْجَاءِ: الـ + هَيْجَاء — al-, the + hayjāʾ, battle, war (f.); gen. after فِي; 'in the battle'
كُمَاتَهُمْ: كُمَاة + هُمْ — kumāt, armoured warriors (pl. of kamī) + -hum, their (m. pl.); 'their champions'
طُعْمَ: ṭuʿm, food, meat (here a second object: 'left them as food'), acc. in construct with السِّبَاعِ; 'food of'
السِّبَاعِ: الـ + سِبَاع — al-, the + sibāʿ, beasts of prey (pl. of sabuʿ); gen. in construct; 'the beasts'
سَلُوا: salū — saʾala, to ask (imperative, m. pl., with hamza dropped); 'ask!'
وَعَنْهُمْ: و + عَنْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ʿan, about (prep.) + -hum, them; 'and about them'
نِزَالِي: نِزَال + ـِي — nizāl, single combat, fighting man to man + -ī, my; gen. after فِي (in the preceding word's clause); 'in my combat'
الْقِرَاعِ: الـ + قِرَاع — al-, the + qirāʿ, clashing, battle (m.); gen. in construct; 'the clash'
لُيُوثَهُمْ: لُيُوث + هُمْ — luyūth, lions (pl. of layth) + -hum, their; acc. as object of تَرَكْتُ; 'their lions'
الْحَرْبِ: الـ + حَرْب — al-, the + ḥarb, war (f./m.); gen. after فِي; 'the war'
صَرْعَى: ṣarʿā, laid low, fallen (pl. of ṣarīʿ), acc. as a second object / state; 'laid low'
الرَّمْضَاءِ: الـ + رَمْضَاء — al-, the + ramḍāʾ, scorching ground; gen. after عَلَى; 'the burning ground'
الْبِقَاعِ: الـ + بِقَاع — al-, the + biqāʿ, tracts, plains (pl. of buqʿa); gen. in apposition/construct after تِلْكَ; 'those tracts'
انْبَلَتْ: inbalat — probably a misprint for aqbalat (aqbala, to advance toward); as printed, perfect 3rd f. sg.; 'she came forward (?)'
مُتَبَسِّمَةً: mutabassima, smiling (f., active participle of form V tabassama); acc. state; 'smiling'
وَقَلَعَتِ: و + قَلَعَتِ — wa-, and + qalaʿat, to pull off, take off (perfect 3rd f. sg., with kasra before al-); 'and she took off'
الزَّرَدَ: الـ + زَرَد — al-, the + zarad, mail, chain armour (m.); acc. object; 'the mail'
لَبِسْتِ: labistī — labisa, to put on, wear (perfect, 2nd f. sg. -ti); 'you put on'
وَشَهَرْتِ: و + شَهَرْتِ — wa-, and + shahartī, shahara, to unsheathe, brandish (perfect 2nd f. sg.); 'and you drew'
حُسَامَكِ: حُسَام + كِ — ḥusām, sword (m.), acc. object + -ki, your (f.); 'your sword'
حِرْصًا: ḥirṣ, eagerness, concern (m.), acc. of purpose; 'out of concern'
هُولَاءِ: hāʾulāʾi — hāʾulāʾ, these (pl. demonstrative), printed without hamza and with a damma on the first letter; gen. after مِنْ; 'these'
دَعَتِ: daʿat — daʿā, to call, summon (perfect 3rd f. sg., kasra before al-); 'she summoned'
تَرَكْتُمْ: taraktum — taraka, to leave, let be (perfect, 2nd m. pl.); 'you left / you let'
جَرَتِ: jarat — jarā, to run, flow, be customary (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'has run'
اسْتِيذَانٍ: isti'dhān (printed without hamza for istiʾdhān), asking leave, seeking permission (m., verbal noun of form X); gen. after إِلَى; 'asking leave'
رُسُلِ: rusul, messengers, envoys (pl. of rasūl); gen. after عَلَى, in construct; 'envoys of'
الْبِطْرِيقَ: الـ + بِطْرِيق — al-, the + biṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine high officer (from Greek patrikios); acc.; 'the patrician'
أَظُنُّكُمْ: أَظُنُّ + كُمْ — aẓunnu, to think, suppose (imperfect 1st sg.; zanna takes two objects) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I think you'
هَتْكِي: هَتْك + ـِي — hatk, tearing of a veil, exposing, dishonouring (verbal noun) + -ī, my; 'my dishonour'
يَضْرِبَ: yaḍriba — ḍaraba, to strike (imperfect subjunctive 3rd m. sg.); 'strike'
رِقَابَهُمْ: رِقَاب + هُمْ — riqāb, necks (pl. of raqaba), acc. object + -hum, their; 'their necks'
فَضَرَبَ: فَـ + ضَرَبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḍaraba, perfect 3rd m. sg.; 'and he struck'
لِبَاقِي: لِـ + بَاقِي — li-, to (prep., of the person addressed) + bāqī, the rest, remainder (active participle of baqiya); gen. in construct; 'to the rest of'
خُدَّامِهَا: خُدَّام + هَا — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim) + -hā, her; gen. in construct; 'her servants'
يَسْتَحِقُّونَ: yastaḥiqqūna — istaḥaqqa, form X, to deserve (imperfect 3rd m. pl.); 'they deserve'
خَافِيًا: khāfiyan — khāfin, hidden (active participle of khafiya, def. noun) acc. predicate of كَانَ; 'hidden'
جَدَّتِي: جَدَّة + ـِي — jadda, grandmother (f.) + -ī, my; 'my grandmother'
أَعْلَمَتْ: aʿlamat — aʿlama, form IV, to inform (perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she informed'
بُدَّأَنَّهَا: بُدّ + أَنَّ + هَا — budd, escape, avoidance (m.; lā budda = 'there is no escaping') + anna, that (conj.) + -hā, she; printed as one word; 'no escaping that she'
بَطَارِقَةَ: baṭāriqa, patricians (pl. of biṭrīq), acc. object, in construct; 'patricians of'
انْفَرَدْتُ: infaradtu — infarada, form VII, to be alone, break away (perfect 1st sg.); 'I have gone off alone'
وَتَخَرَّبْتُ: و + تَخَرَّبْتُ — wa-, and + takharrabtu, form V, to be ruined (perfect 1st sg.); possibly a misprint for taḥazzabtu 'I took sides'; 'and I (took sides)'
فَالرَّأْيُ: فَـ + الـ + رَأْي — fa-, so (conj.) + al-, the + raʾy, opinion, judgement (m.); nom. subject; 'so the opinion'
السَّدِيدُ: الـ + سَدِيد — al-, the + sadīd, sound, right (adj.); nom.; 'the sound'
أَتْرُكُ: atruku — taraka, to leave, give up (imperfect 1st sg.); 'I give up' ; also: to let (something) do, with an object and a verb: lā atruku niṣfa al-nahāri yafūtu, 'I will not let half the day go by'
الْإِقَامَةَ: الـ + إِقَامَة — al-, the + iqāma, staying, residing (verbal noun of form IV); acc. object; 'staying'
لِ: li-, so that, that (particle introducing the subjunctive of purpose, printed apart from the verb); 'that'
الْعَدَاوَةَ: الـ + عَدَاوَة — al-, the + ʿadāwa, enmity (f.); acc. after inna; 'the enmity'
تَتْرُكْ: tatruk — taraka, to leave (jussive 2nd m. sg.); 'leave'; here: 3fs jussive, lam tatruk, 'she did not leave'
شَأْنِكَ: شَأْن + كَ — shaʾn, affair, matter (m.) + -ka, your; gen. after مِنْ; 'your affair'
وَأَهْلِكِ: و + أَهْل + كِ — wa-, and + ahl, family, people (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your family'
فَحَلَّفَهَا: فَـ + حَلَّفَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥallafa, form II, to make swear (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and he made her swear'
وَتَعَاهَدَا: و + تَعَاهَدَا — wa-, and + taʿāhadā, form VI, to make a covenant with one another (perfect, dual); 'and the two covenanted'
الْأَنَ: الـ + أَن — al-, the + ān (printed with hamza-alif), the present moment; 'now'
تَرْجِعُ: tarjiʿu — rajaʿa, to return (imperfect 2nd m. sg.); 'you return'; here: 3fs, 'she returns'
بِلَادِكَ: بِلَاد + كَ — bilād, lands, country (pl. of balad) + -ka, your; gen. after إِلَى; 'your country'
أَرْسَلَنِي: أَرْسَلَ + نِي — arsala, form IV, to send (perfect 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he sent me'
قِتَالِ: qitāl, fighting, battle (m., verbal noun of qātala), gen. after إِلَى, in construct; 'fighting'
خَرَ: khara — first part of the split خَرَ زَاتِ, i.e. kharazāt; 'jewels' (see next)
زَاتِ: zāt — second part of the split kharazāt, jewels, beads (pl. of kharaza); gen. in construct; 'jewels'
الْكَثِيرَةِ: الـ + كَثِيرَة — al-, the + kathīra, much, abundant (f.); gen.; 'the many-of'
الْبَرَكَاتِ: الـ + بَرَكَات — al-, the + barakāt, blessings (pl. of baraka); gen. in construct; 'blessings'
مُعَادَاتِنَا: مُعَادَاة + نَا — muʿādāt, enmity, hostility (verbal noun of form III) + -nā, our; gen. in construct; 'our enmity'
عِيدًا: ʿīd, festival (m.), acc. after anna; 'a festival'
تَجْتَمِعُ: tajtamiʿu — ijtamaʿa, form VIII, to gather (imperfect 3rd f. sg.); 'gather'
وَبَنَاتُ: و + بَنَات — wa-, and + banāt, daughters (pl. of bint), nom. in construct; 'and the daughters of'
وَنِسَاؤُهُمْ: و + نِسَاء + هُمْ — wa-, and + nisāʾ, women (pl.), nom. + -hum, their; 'and their women'
وَيَقْعُدُونَ: و + يَقْعُدُونَ — wa-, and + yaqʿudūna, qaʿada, to sit, stay (imperfect 3rd m. pl.); 'and they stay'
الْمُعَادَاةُ: الـ + مُعَادَاة — muʿādāt, enmity, hostility (f. verbal noun, form III of عَادَى); nom. as subject; 'the enmity'
حُضُورِ: حُضُور — ḥuḍūr, presence, attendance (m. verbal noun of حَضَرَ); genitive after مِنْ; 'attendance'
الْعِيدِ: الـ + عِيد — ʿīd, festival, feast (m.); genitive in apposition after ذَلِكَ; 'the festival'
أَمَاكِنِهَا: أَمَاكِن + هَا — amākin, places (plural of مَكَان, diptote) + -hā, their (f. pl. referent); 'their places'
فَأَقَامُوا: فَـ + أَقَامُوا — fa-, and/so + aqāma, to stay, remain (form IV), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'and they stayed'
أَيَّامٍ: أَيَّامٍ — ayyām, days (plural of يَوْم); genitive after the number; 'days'
السَّابِعِ: الـ + سَّابِعِ — sābiʿ, seventh (ordinal, active participle of سَبَعَ); genitive adjective; 'the seventh'
انْصَرَفَتِ: انْصَرَفَتْ — inṣarafa, to depart, go away (form VII), 3rd f. sg. perfect; printed with the f. ending though the subject is الناس; 'went away' Also with a feminine subject: inṣarafati al-jāriyatu, 'the slave-girl went away'.
فَجَهَّزُوا: فَـ + جَهَّزُوا — fa-, so + jahhaza, to equip, fit out (form II), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'so they fitted out'
وَخَوَاصُّهَا: وَ + خَوَاصُّ + هَا — wa-, and + khawāṣṣ, special ones, intimates (plural of خَاصَّة) + -hā, her; 'and her attendants'
حَلُّوا: حَلُّوا — ḥalla, to loosen, untie, release (the sails); 3rd m. pl. perfect (here with -ū); 'they unfurled'
سَائِرُونَ: سَائِرُونَ — sāʾirūn, travelling, journeying (active participle of سَارَ, nom. m. pl.); 'sailing along'
بِرِيحٍ: بِـ + رِيح — bi-, only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise + rīḥ, wind (f., gen.); 'and behold, a wind'
بِالْقَضَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + قَضَاءِ — bi-, by, through (prep., instrumental) + al-, the + qaḍāʾ, decree, fate (m.); 'by decree'
مَرْكَبُ: مَرْكَبُ — markab, ship (m.); nom. as subject of كَانَ, in construct with نَصَارَى; 'a ship of'
نَصَارَى: نَصَارَى — naṣārā, Christians (plural of نَصْرَانِيّ); genitive, diptote; 'Christians'
خَمْسُمِأَنَةِ: خَمْسُمِأَنَةِ — khamsumiʾana, five hundred (printed form of خَمْسُمِائَة, the ن odd); genitive/construct before the counted noun; 'five hundred'
أِفْرَنْجِيٍّ: إِفْرَنْجِيٍّ — Ifranjī, Frank, European (m. nisba from إِفْرَنْج); indefinite genitive singular after the hundred; 'Franks'
بِالسِّلَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + سِّلَاحِ — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment/equipment) + al-, the + silāḥ, weapon, arms (m.); 'with weapons, armed'
انْقَضُّوا: انْقَضُّوا — inqaḍḍa, to swoop down, pounce (form VII), 3rd m. pl. perfect; 'they swooped'
مُسْرِعِينَ: مُسْرِعِينَ — musriʿīn, hastening, hurrying (active participle of form IV أَسْرَعَ, acc. m. pl., circumstantial); 'in haste'
الْكَلَالِيبَ: الـ + كَلَالِيبَ — kalālīb, grappling hooks (plural of كُلَّاب, diptote); accusative object; 'the hooks'
وَجَرُّوهَا: وَ + جَرُّوا + هَا — wa-, and + jarra, to drag, draw (3rd m. pl. perfect) + -hā, it; 'and they dragged it'
قُلُوعَهُمْ: قُلُوع + هُمْ — qulūʿ, sails (plural of قِلْع), accusative + -hum, their; 'their sails'
وَقَصَدُ: وَ + قَصَدُ — wa-, and + qaṣada, to head for, make for, aim at; 3rd m. pl. perfect, the plural wāw is printed on the next word; 'and they made for'
وْاجَزِيرَتَهُمْ: وْا + جَزِيرَة + هُمْ — -ū, plural ending of the preceding قَصَدُ (the edition prints its و and silent alif attached to this word) + jazīra, island (f.), accusative object + -hum, their; 'their island'
بَعُدُوا: بَعُدُوا — baʿuda, to be far, go far; 3rd m. pl. perfect; فَمَا بَعُدُوا 'and they had not gone far'
انْعَكَسَ: انْعَكَسَ — inʿakasa, to be reversed, turn about (form VII), 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'turned about'
جَذَبَهُمْ: جَذَبَ + هُمْ — jadhaba, to pull, draw; 3rd m. sg. perfect + -hum, them; 'it pulled them'
شِعْبٍ: شِعْبٍ — shiʿb, mountain pass, cleft, rocky channel (m.); indefinite genitive after إِلَى; 'a ravine'
وَجَرَّهُمْ: وَ + جَرَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + jarra, to drag (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hum, them; 'and it dragged them'
فَرَأَيْنَاهُمْ: فَـ + رَأَيْنَا + هُمْ — fa-, and + raʾā, to see; 1st pl. perfect (-nā, we) + -hum, them; 'and we saw them'
انْسَاقَتْ: انْسَاقَتْ — insāqa, to be driven along (form VII), 3rd f. sg. perfect; 'had been driven'
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ: فَـ + أَخَذْنَا + هُمْ — fa-, and + akhadha, to take, seize (1st pl. perfect) + -hum, them; 'and we seized them'
وَقَتَلْنَاهُمْ: وَ + قَتَلْنَا + هُمْ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (1st pl. perfect) + -hum, them; 'and we killed them'
الْأَمْوَالَ: الـ + أَمْوَالَ — amwāl, goods, wealth (plural of مَال); accusative object; 'the goods'
وَقَدَّمْنَا: وَ + قَدَّمْنَا — wa-, and + qaddama, to present, put forward (form II, 1st pl. perfect); 'and we presented'
ابْنَةَ: ابْنَةَ — ibna, daughter (f.); accusative as the (inverted) subject of أَنَّ with the predicate فِيهِنَّ; 'the daughter of'
فَاخْتَارَ: فَـ + اخْتَارَ — fa-, so/and + ikhtāra, to choose (form VIII), 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he chose'
وَفِيهِنَّ: وَ + فِيهِنَّ — wa-, and + fī, in, among + -hinna, them; 'and among them'
وَفَرَّقَ: وَ + فَرَّقَ — wa-, and + farraqa, to distribute, divide (form II), 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'and he distributed'
حَاشِيَتِهِ: حَاشِيَة + هِ — ḥāshiya, retinue, household, entourage (f.) + -hi, his; 'his retinue'
عَزَلَ: عَزَلَ — ʿazala, to set apart, remove; 3rd m. sg. perfect; 'he set aside'
وَأَرْسَلَهُنَّ: وَ + أَرْسَلَ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + arsala, to send (form IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hunna, them (f.); 'and he sent them'
الْجُوخِ: الـ + جُوخِ — jūkh, broadcloth, fine woollen cloth (m.); genitive after مِنْ; 'the broadcloth'
الرُّومِيِّ: الـ + رُّومِيِّ — rūmī, of Rūm, Byzantine (nisba adjective); genitive; 'Greek, Byzantine'
وَقَبِلَهُ: وَ + قَبِلَ + هُ — wa-, and + qabila, to accept (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hu, it; 'and he accepted it'
الْخَمْسِ: الـ + خَمْسِ — khams, five (f. numeral), genitive after مِنَ; 'the five'
كِتَابًا: كِتَابًا — kitāb, letter, book (m.); indefinite accusative object; 'a letter'; here, in Qurʾān 3:145, kitāban muʾajjalan, 'a writ with a fixed term', a decree written down
لَايَنْبَغِي: لَا + يَنْبَغِي — lā, not (negative) + yanbaghī, it is fitting, proper (3rd m. sg. imperfect of انْبَغَى, form VII); printed as one word; 'is not fitting'
ذِكْرُهُ: ذِكْر + هُ — dhikr, mention, mentioning (m. verbal noun) + -hu, its; nom. subject of يَنْبَغِي; 'its mention'; also subject of taqaddama: ka-mā taqaddama dhikruhu, 'as its mention has gone before'; also 'remembrance of him', nom. subject: baʿīdun dhikruhu minnī qarību, 'far, the thought of him is near to me' (Night 194, verse)
يُهَدِّدُهُ: يُهَدِّدُ + هُ — yuhaddidu, to threaten (form II imperfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'threatening him'
وَيُوَبِّخُهُ: وَ + يُوَبِّخُ + هُ — wa-, and + yuwabbikhu, to rebuke, reproach (form II, 3rd m. sg. imperfect) + -hu, him; 'and rebuking him'
رَبِحْتُمْ: رَبِحْتُمْ — rabiḥa, to gain, profit; 2nd m. pl. perfect; 'you gained'
سَنَتَيْنِ: سَنَتَيْنِ — sanatayn, two years (dual of سَنَة, genitive/oblique); 'two years'
لُصُوصٍ: لُصُوصٍ — luṣūṣ, thieves (plural of لِصّ, diptote); indefinite genitive; 'thieves'
أَفْرَنْجٍ: أَفْرَنْجٍ — afranj, Franks (a variant plural/collective form of إِفْرَنْج); genitive; 'Franks'
حَرَامِيَّةٍ: حَرَامِيَّةٍ — ḥarāmiyya, thieves, brigands (colloquial plural of حَرَامِيّ); indefinite genitive adjective; 'brigands'
تُعْلِمُونِي: تُعْلِمُونِي — ʿallama / aʿlama (form IV), to inform; 2nd m. pl. imperfect with the plural nūn + -nī, me (object); after وَلَمْ 'and you did not inform me' (the nūn is kept in the print)
تُرْسِلُوا: تُرْسِلُوا — arsala, to send (form IV); 2nd m. pl., printed without the final nūn: after لَمْ it is the jussive 'you did not send', and in the next unit it stands in the apology of the letter; 'you send'
أُظْهِرُ: أُظْهِرُ — aẓhara, to reveal, make public (form IV); 1st sg. imperfect; here following أَقْدِرْ without أَنْ; 'to reveal'
فَكَتَمْتُ: فَـ + كَتَمْتُ — fa-, so + katama, to conceal (1st sg. perfect); 'so I concealed'
فَكَاتَبْتُ: فَـ + كَاتَبْتُ — fa-, and + kātaba, to correspond with, write to (form III; 1st sg. perfect); 'and I wrote to'
الْحَرَامِيَّةِ: الـ + حَرَامِيَّةِ — ḥarāmiyya, brigands (colloquial plural of حَرَامِيّ); genitive; 'the brigands'
الْأَفْرَنْجِ: الـ + أَفْرَنْجِ — afranj, Franks (collective); genitive after مِنَ; 'the Franks'
وَسَأَلْتُهُمْ: وَ + سَأَلْتُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (1st sg. perfect) + -hum, them; 'and I asked them'
حُرْ: حُرْ — Ḥur, first part of a proper name (the king's name is printed as two words); 'Ḥur'
دُوبَ: دُوبَ — Dūb, second part of the name; 'Dūb'
وَحَكَوْا: وَ + حَكَوْا — wa-, and + ḥakā, to tell, relate (3rd m. pl. perfect, printed with a final alif); 'and they told'
الْمَكْتُوبِ: الـ + مَكْتُوبِ — maktūb, letter, written thing (m.); genitive after فِي; 'the letter'
لِوَالِدِي: لِـ + وَالِدِي — li-, to, for (prep., indirect object) + wālid, father (m.) + -ī, my; 'to my father'
مُرَادُكُمْ: مُرَادُ + كُمْ — murād, intent, aim (m.) + -kum, your (m. pl.); nom. as subject of يَكُنْ; 'your aim'
مُعَادَ: مُعَادَ — muʿādā-, first part of مُعَادَاتِي 'my enmity' (printed split); 'my enmity'
اتِي: اتِي — -tī, second part of مُعَادَاتِي, the ending with the suffix -ī, my; 'my (enmity)'
وَقَصْدُكُمْ: وَ + قَصْد + كُمْ — wa-, and + qaṣd, aim, purpose (m.) + -kum, your; 'and your aim'
وَهَتْكَ: وَ + هَتْكَ — wa-, and + hatk, violation, dishonouring (m.); accusative in construct; 'and violating'
أَهْمَلْتُمْ: أَهْمَلْتُمْ — ahmala, to neglect, ignore (form IV); 2nd m. pl. perfect; 'you neglect'
وَعَصَيْتُمْ: وَ + عَصَيْتُمْ — wa-, and + ʿaṣā, to disobey, defy; 2nd m. pl. perfect; 'and you disobey'
أُكَافِئَكُمْ: أُكَافِئَ + كُمْ — ukāfiʾu, to repay, requite (form III imperfect, 1st sg. subjunctive) + -kum, you; 'that I repay you'
قَبِيحِ: قَبِيحِ — qabīḥ, ugly, vile (adj. used as noun, m.); genitive in construct; عَلَى 'for'; 'the vileness of'
أَفْعَالِكُمْ: أَفْعَال + كُمْ — afʿāl, deeds, acts (plural of فِعْل) + -kum, your; 'your deeds'
وَسُوءِ: وَ + سُوءِ — wa-, and + sūʾ, evil, badness (m.); genitive in construct; 'and the wickedness of'
أَعْمَالِكُمْ: أَعْمَال + كُمْ — aʿmāl, works, doings (plural of عَمَل) + -kum, your; 'your works'
الْمُكَاتَبَةُ: الـ + مُكَاتَبَةُ — mukātaba, correspondence, letter (f. verbal noun of form III); nom. subject; 'the letter'
وَقَرَأَهَا: وَ + قَرَأَ + هَا — wa-, and + qaraʾa, to read (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hā, it; 'and he read it'
يَعْرِفْ: يَعْرِفْ — ʿarafa, to know; 3rd m. sg. jussive after لَمْ; 'he knew'
لِيَرُدَّهَا: لِـ + يَرُدَّ + هَا — li-, so that, in order to (particle of purpose) + yaruddu, to return, send back (3rd m. sg. subjunctive) + -hā, her; 'so that he might return her'
وَمَابَقِيَ: و + مَا + بَقِيَ — wa-, and + mā, not (negative) + baqiya, to remain (perf. 3 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'and not … remained, no longer'
يُمْكِنُهُ: يُمْكِنُ + هُ — amkana, to be possible (IV, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, to him (pron. 3 m.); 'it is possible for him'
الْكَبِيرَةِ: الـ + كَبِيرَة — kabīra, great, large (f. adj.); 'the great' (gen.)
يُرْسِلَ: arsala, to send (IV, subj. 3 m. sg.); 'that he send'
يَطْلُبُهَا: يَطْلُبُ + هَا — ṭalaba, to ask for, seek (impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'asking for her'
أَوْلَادًا: awlād, children, sons (pl. of walad, indef. acc.)
الْمُصِيبَةُ: الـ + مُصِيبَة — muṣība, calamity, disaster (f.); 'the calamity'
وَيَعْتَذِرُ: و + يَعْتَذِرُ — wa-, and + iʿtadhara, to excuse oneself, apologise (VIII, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (he) excuses himself'
وَيَحْلِفُ: و + يَحْلِفُ — wa-, and + ḥalafa, to swear (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (he) swears'
بِالْأَقْسَامِ: بِـ + الـ + أَقْسَام — bi-, by (prep. of oath) + al-, the + aqsām, oaths (pl. of qasam); 'by the oaths'
أَظْهَرَهُ: أَظْهَرَ + هُ — aẓhara, to make known, inform (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; with ʿalā, 'he informed him (of)'
أَرْسَلَهَا: أَرْسَلَ + هَا — arsala, to send (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'he sent her'
الْأَوْلَادَ: الـ + أَوْلَاد — awlād, children (pl. of walad); 'the children' (acc.)
رِسَالَةُ: risāla, message, letter (f.); 'the letter of' (nom., idafa)
رَغَى: raghā, to roar, bellow (of a camel; perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he roared'
وَأَزْبَدَ: و + أَزْبَدَ — wa-, and + azbada, to foam (IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he foamed (with rage)'
سَبَي: sabā, to take captive (perf. 3 m. sg.; printed with yāʾ); 'he took captive'
بِصِفَةِ: بِـ + صِفَة — bi-, in (prep., 'in the manner of') + ṣifa, quality, guise (f., gen.); 'in the guise of'
وَتَتَدَاوَلُهَا: و + تَتَدَاوَلُ + هَا — wa-, and + tadāwala, to pass from hand to hand (VI, impf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and (the hands) pass her around'
الْأَيْدِي: الـ + أَيْدِي — aydī, hands (pl. of yad, f.); 'the hands'
وَتَصِلُ: و + تَصِلُ — wa-, and + waṣala, to arrive, reach (impf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she reaches'
وَيَطَؤُنَهَا: و + يَطَؤُنَ + هَا — wa-, and + waṭiʾa, to tread, have intercourse with (impf. 3 m. pl., printed without the long ū) + -hā, her; 'and they have intercourse with her'
عَقْدٍ: ʿaqd, contract, marriage contract (m., indef. gen.)
وَالدِّينِ: و + الـ + دِّين — wa-, and, by (continuing the oath) + al-, the + dīn, religion, faith (m.); 'and the religion'
الصَّحِيحِ: الـ + صَّحِيح — ṣaḥīḥ, true, sound (adj.); 'the true'
الثَّأْرَ: الـ + ثَّأْر — thaʾr, vengeance, blood-revenge (m.); 'the vengeance' (acc.)
وَأَكْشِفَ: و + أَكْشِفَ — wa-, and + kashafa, to uncover, remove (subj. 1 sg.); 'and (that) I uncover'
الْعَارَ: الـ + عَار — ʿār, shame, disgrace (m.); 'the shame' (acc.)
الْمُحَدِّثُونَ: الـ + مُحَدِّثُونَ — muḥaddith, talker, narrator (m., nom. pl.); 'the narrators'
صَابِرًا: ṣābir, patient, enduring (m., acc. of state); 'patient'
دَبَّرَ: dabbara, to plan, devise (II, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he devised'
مَكَائِدَ: makāʾid, snares, plots (pl. of makīda; diptote acc.)
رُسُلًا: rusul, messengers (pl. of rasūl; indef. acc.)
وَذَكَرَ: و + ذَكَرَ — wa-, and + dhakara, to mention (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he mentioned'
الْأَقْوَالِ: الـ + أَقْوَال — aqwāl, sayings, reports (pl. of qawl); 'the sayings' (gen.)
جَهَّزَكَ: جَهَّزَ + كَ — jahhaza, to equip, fit out (II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'he fitted you out'
بِالْعَسَاكِرِ: بِـ + الـ + عَسَاكِر — bi-, with (prep., instrument or accompaniment) + al-, the + ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar); 'with the armies'
أَجْلِهَا: أَجْل + هَا — ajl, sake, cause (m.) + -hā, her; with min, 'for her sake'
وَصَيَّرَكَ: و + صَيَّرَ + كَ — wa-, and + ṣayyara, to turn, make (II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'and he turned you'
يَقْبِضَ: qabaḍa, to seize (subj. 3 m. sg.); 'that he seize'
عَسْكَرِكَ: عَسْكَر + كَ — ʿaskar, army (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your army'
لِوَالِدِكَ: لِـ + وَالِد + كَ — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed) + wālid, father + -ka, your; 'to your father'
سَالَتِهِ: سَالَة + هِ — sāla, as printed, evidently risāla, letter (f.; initial r- dropped) + -hi, his; 'in his letter'
اسْتَوْلَى: istawlā, to gain mastery over (X, perf. 3 m. sg.); with ʿalā, 'he seized'
وَوَهَبَهَا: و + وَهَبَ + هَا — wa-, and + wahaba, to give (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her/them; 'and he gave them'
فَاذْهَبْ: فَـ + اذْهَبْ — fa-, so (conj.) + idhhab, go (imper. m. sg. of dhahaba); 'so go'
وَرُدَّهُمْ: و + رُدَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + rudda, turn back (imper. m. sg. of radda) + -hum, them; 'and turn them back'
يَسْتَغْرِقُوا: istaghraqa, to go deep, be absorbed (X, subj. 3 m. pl.); 'they plunge'
وَيَتَوَغَّلُوا: و + يَتَوَغَّلُوا — wa-, and + tawaghghala, to press deep into (V, subj. 3 m. pl.); 'and press far'
وَالرُّومِ: و + الـ + رُّوم — wa-, and + al-, the + Rūm, Byzantines, Greeks; 'and the Rūm'
فَإِنَّكُمْ: فَـ + إِنَّ + كُمْ — fa-, for, since (conj.) + inna, indeed (particle) + -kum, you (pl.); 'for you'
تَوَغَّلْتُمْ: tawaghghala, to press deep into (V, perf. 2 m. pl.); 'you press far'
يُضَيِّقُونَ: ḍayyaqa, to narrow, constrict (II, impf. 3 m. pl.); 'they will narrow'
الطُّرُقَ: الـ + طُّرُق — ṭuruq, roads (pl. of ṭarīq); 'the roads' (acc.)
تَجِدُوا: wajada, to find (jussive 2 m. pl.); 'you will find'
الْجَزَاءِ: الـ + جَزَاء — jazāʾ, requital, recompense (m.); 'the requital' (gen.)
وَالْقِصَاصِ: و + الـ + قِصَاص — wa-, and + al-, the + qiṣāṣ, retribution (m.); 'and the retribution'
مَكَانِهِمْ: مَكَان + هِمْ — makān, place (m., gen. after fī) + -him, their; 'their place'
رَسَمْتَ: rasama, to decree, order (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you ordered'
بِالْإِقَامَةِ: بِـ + الـ + إِقَامَة — bi-, with (prep.; with rasama 'order … to') + al-, the + iqāma, staying, remaining (f.); 'to stay'
فَقَدُوكَ: فَقَدُوا + كَ — faqada, to miss, lose (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -ka, you; 'they lost you'
يَفْعَلُونَ: faʿala, to do (impf. 3 m. pl.); 'they do'
الْمَلِكَةِ: الـ + مَلِكَة — malika, queen (f.); 'the queen' (gen.); also: of a king's daughter, 'princess': al-malikati Budūra, 'Princess Budūr' (Night 179)
وَجَعَلَكِ: و + جَعَلَ + كِ — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -ki, you (f.); 'and he made you'
لِسَلَامَتِي: لِـ + سَلَامَة + ي — li-, for (prep., 'for the sake of') + salāma, safety (f.) + -ī, my; 'for my safety'
وَسَلَامَةِ: و + سَلَامَة — wa-, and + salāma, safety (f., gen. in idafa); 'and the safety of'
فِرَانَكِ: فِرَان + كِ — firān, as printed, evidently firāq, parting (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your parting'
فَاقْبِضْ: فَـ + اقْبِضْ — fa-, then (conj. of the result) + iqbiḍ, seize (imper. m. sg. of qabaḍa); 'then seize'
لَكُمُ: لِـ + كُمُ — li-, to, for (prep.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'to you'
بِالْقُرْبِ: بِـ + الـ + قُرْب — bi-, in, at (prep.) + al-, the + qurb, nearness (m.); 'in the nearness (of)', i.e. 'close to'
أُلْحِقُكُمْ: أُلْحِقُ + كُمْ — alḥaqa, to make catch up with, join (IV, impf. 1 sg.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I will join you'
تَدْخُلُونَ: dakhala, to enter (impf. 2 m. pl.); 'you will enter'
بَغْدَادًا: Baghdād, Baghdad (indef. acc. as printed with alif)
وَكُلُّنَا: و + كُلّ + نَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + kull, all (m., nom.) + -nā, us; 'and all of us'
الِانْصِرَافَ: الـ + انْصِرَاف — inṣirāf, departing, going away (m., VII verbal noun); 'the departure' (acc.)
وَالْعَهْدُ: و + الـ + عَهْد — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿahd, covenant, pledge (m.); 'and the covenant'
لَاتَنْسَاءُ: لَا + تَنْسَاءُ — lā, not (prohibitive) + tansā, nasiya, to forget (as printed with final hamza, evidently tansāhu, 'forget it'); 'do not forget (it)'
وَالْعِنَاقِ: و + الـ + عِنَاق — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿināq, embrace (m.); 'and the embrace'
وَإِطْفَاءِ: و + إِطْفَاء — wa-, and + iṭfāʾ, extinguishing, quenching (m., IV verbal noun, gen.); 'and the quenching of'
الْأَشْوَاقِ: الـ + أَشْوَاق — ashwāq, longings, desires (pl. of shawq); 'the longings' (gen.)
وَوَدَّعَتْهُ: و + وَدَّعَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + waddaʿa, to bid farewell (II, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she bade him farewell'
وَيَدِى: و + يَدِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yad, hand (f.) + ī, my; 'and my hand' (the ى is the edition's spelling of the ending)
الْيَمِينُ: الـ + يَمِين — al-, the + yamīn, right (hand, side); 'the right'
لِادْمُعِي: لِـ + أَدْمُع + ـِي — li-, for (prep.: the hand is given over 'for' the tears) + admuʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ) + -ī, my; 'for my tears' (hamza unwritten in the print)
الْيَسَارُ: الـ + يَسَار — al-, the + yasār, left (hand, side); 'the left'
لِضَمَّةٍ: لِـ + ضَمَّة — li-, for (prep.: for the purpose of) + ḍamma, embrace, a pressing to oneself (f.); 'for an embrace'
وَعِنَاقِ: و + عِنَاق — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿināq, clasp, hug; 'and a clasp'
تَخْشَى: تَخْشَى — khashiya, to fear (imperf. 2nd m.sg.); 'you fear'
الْفَضِيحَةَ: الـ + فَضِيحَة — al-, the + faḍīḥa, scandal, public disgrace (f.), acc.; 'the scandal'
الْوَدَاعِ: الـ + وَدَاع — al-, the + wadāʿ, farewell, parting; 'the farewell'
فَضِيحَةُ: فَضِيحَةُ — faḍīḥa, scandal, disgrace (f.), nom. in construct; 'the scandal of'
الْعُشَّاقِ: الـ + عُشَّاق — al-, the + ʿushshāq, lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq); 'the lovers'
فَارَقَهَا: فَارَقَ + هَا — fāraqa, to part from, leave (Form III); -hā, her; 'he parted from her'
لِلْجِسْرِ: لِـ + الـ + جِسْر — li-, for, toward (prep.: the goal sought) + al-, the + jisr, bridge (m.); 'for the bridge'
وَمَرَّ: و + مَرَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + marra, to pass, cross; 'and he passed over'
تَخَلَّصَ: تَخَلَّصَ — takhallaṣa, to get free, come clear of (Form V); 'he got clear'
الْمَرْجِ: الـ + مَرْج — al-, the + marj, meadow, grassland (m.); 'the meadow'
فَوَارِسَ: فَوَارِس — fawāris, horsemen (pl. of fāris), gen. diptote after thalātha; 'horsemen'
لِنَفْسِهِ: لِـ + نَفْس + هِ — li-, for (prep.: on his own behalf) + nafs, self (f.) + -hi, his; 'for himself' Also after qāla, li- marks the one spoken to: qāla li-nafsihi, 'he said to himself'.
وَشَهَرَ: و + شَهَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + shahara, to draw (a weapon); 'and he drew'
وَانْحَدَرَ: و + انْحَدَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + inḥadara, to go down, descend (Form VII); 'and he went down'
أَحَدُهُمُ: أَحَد + هُمْ — aḥad, one (m.) + -hum, them (mīm vowelled before the article); 'one of them'
أَمِيرَانِ: أَمِير + َانِ — amīr, emir, commander (m.) + -āni, dual nom.; 'two emirs'
وَعَرَفُوهُ: و + عَرَفَ + وا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know, recognise; -ū, they; -hu, him; 'and they recognised him'
تَرَجَّلُوا: تَرَجَّلَ + وا — tarajjala, to dismount (Form V); -ū, they; 'they dismounted'
غِيَابِهِ: غِيَاب + هِ — ghiyāb, absence (m.) + -hi, his; 'his absence'
فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ: فَـ + أَخْبَرَ + هُمْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + akhbara, to inform (Form IV); -hum, them; 'and he informed them'
أَوَّلِهِ: أَوَّل + هِ — awwal, first, beginning (m.) + -hi, its; 'its beginning'
فَحَمِدَ: فَـ + حَمِدَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥamida, to praise; 'and he praised'
ارْحَلُوا: ارْحَلُوا — irḥalū (iḥmal) — raḥala, to journey off, depart; imper. m.pl.; 'depart!'
جَاؤُا: جَاءَ + وا — jāʾa, to come; -ū, they; the hamza is unwritten in the print; 'they came'
لِيُعْلِمُوا: لِـ + يُعْلِمُوا — li-, so that, in order that (+ subjunctive) + yuʿlimū, aʿlama, to inform (Form IV), they; 'so that they inform'
مَلِكَهُمْ: مَلِك + هُمْ — malik, king (m.) + -hum, their; 'their king'
بِقُدُومِنَا: بِـ + قُدُوم + نَا — bi-, of, about (aʿlama bi-, inform of) + qudūm, arrival (m.) + -nā, our; 'of our arrival'
فَرُبَّمَا: فَـ + رُبَّمَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + rubbamā, perhaps, it may be that; 'and perhaps'
أَسْرَعُوا: أَسْرَعَ + وا — asraʿa, to hasten (Form IV); -ū, they; 'they hasten'
وَقَبَضُوا: و + قَبَضَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.) + qabaḍa, to seize (qabaḍa ʿalā, seize someone); -ū, they; 'and they seize'
فَرَحَلُوا: فَـ + رَحَلَ + وا — fa-, and so (conj.) + raḥala, to depart; -ū, they; 'and they departed'
مَلِكِهِمْ: مَلِك + هِمْ — malik, king (m.) + -him, their; 'their king'
بِقُدُومِ: بِـ + قُدُوم — bi-, of, about (akhbara bi-, 'inform of'; ʿalima bi-, 'learn of': the verb chooses the bi-) + qudūm, arrival, coming (m.), in construct; 'of the arrival of'
فَجَهَّزَ: فَـ + جَهَّزَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + jahhaza, to equip, fit out (Form II); 'and he equipped'
لِيَقْبِضُوا: لِـ + يَقْبِضُوا — li-, so that, in order that (+ subjunctive) + yaqbiḍū, qabaḍa, to seize, they; 'so that they seize'
وَمَلِكِهِمْ: و + مَلِك + هِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + malik, king (m.) + -him, their; 'and their king'
وَوَزِيرِ: و + وَزِير — wa-, and (conj.) + wazīr, vizier (m.), in construct, printed without the article; 'and the vizier of'
وَأَمِيرَيْنِ: و + أَمِير + يْنِ — wa-, and (conj.) + amīr, emir (m.) + -ayni, dual oblique; 'and two emirs'
الْأَرْبَعَةُ: الـ + أَرْبَعَة — al-, the + arbaʿa, four; 'the four'
عَسْكَرِهِمْ: عَسْكَر + هِمْ — ʿaskar, army (m.) + -him, their; 'their army'
سَاعَتِهِمْ: سَاعَة + هِمْ — sāʿa, hour, moment (f.) + -him, their; min sāʿatihim, 'at that very hour'
وَلَازَالُوا: و + لَا زَالَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.) + lā zāla, to keep on (lit. not cease); -ū, they; 'and they kept on'
وَمَازَالُوا: و + مَا زَالَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.) + mā zāla, to keep on (lit. not cease); -ū, they; 'and they kept on'
خَمْسَةٍ: خَمْسَةٍ — khamsa, five, gen. (the unit in 'five and twenty'); 'five'
أَوَائِلِ: أَوَائِل — awāʾil, first parts, outskirts (pl. of awwal), in construct (the ئ is printed precomposed); 'the borders of'
أَمِنُوا: أَمِنَ + وا — amina, to be safe, feel safe (Form I); -ū, they; 'they felt safe'
أَنْفُسِهِمْ: أَنْفُس + هِمْ — anfus, selves (pl. of nafs) + -him, their; ʿalā anfusihim, 'for their lives'
لِأَخْذِ: لِـ + أَخْذ — li-, for, in order to (prep.: purpose) + akhdh, taking (m., verbal noun of akhadha); 'for the taking of'
بِالضِّيَافَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + ضِيَافَات — bi-, with (prep.: bringing) + al-, the + ḍiyāfāt, hospitality gifts (pl. of ḍiyāfa); 'with the hospitality gifts'
وَعَلِيقِ: و + عَلِيق — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿalīq, fodder (m.), in construct; 'and fodder for'
وَالْإِقَامَاتِ: و + الـ + إِقَامَات — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iqāmāt, lodgings, provisions for a stay (pl. of iqāma); 'and the lodgings'
وَرَحَلُوا: و + رَحَلَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.) + raḥala, to depart; -ū, they; 'and they departed'
دِيَارَهُمْ: دِيَار + هُمْ — diyār, homes, abodes (pl. of dār) + -hum, their; 'their homes'
وَتَأَخَّرَ: و + تَأَخَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾakhkhara, to lag behind (Form V); 'and he lagged behind' Also 'to draw back, step back' in deference: wa-taʾakhkhara warāʾahu, 'and he stepped back'.
وَأَمَّرَ: و + أَمَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ammara, to make someone commander (Form II); the shadda is printed; 'and he put in command'
الْجَيْشُ: الـ + جَيْش — al-, the + jaysh, army (m.); 'the army'
مَسِيرِهِمْ: مَسِير + هِمْ — masīr, going, march (m.) + -him, their; 'their march'
عَوَّلَ: عَوَّلَ — ʿawwala, to resolve (ʿawwala ʿalā, resolve on) (Form II); 'he resolved'
وَرَكِبَتْ: و + رَكِبَ + تْ — wa-, and (conj.) + rakiba, to ride; -at, she (the collective 'hundred' takes a feminine verb); 'and rode'
فَرْسَخَيْنِ: فَرْسَخ + َيْنِ — farsakh, parasang, league (m.) + -ayni, dual gen.; 'two parasangs'
مَضِيقٍ: مَضِيقٍ — maḍīq, narrow pass, defile (m.), gen. indef.; 'a narrow pass'
جَبَلَيْنِ: جَبَل + َيْنِ — jabal, mountain (m.) + -ayni, dual gen.; 'two mountains'
أَمَامَهُمْ: أَمَام + هُمْ — amām, in front of (prep.) + -hum, them; 'before them'
غَبْرَةٌ: غَبْرَة — ghabra, a cloud of dust (f.), nom. indef.; 'a cloud of dust'
وَعَجَاجٌ: و + عَجَاج — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿajāj, swirling dust (m.); 'and swirling dust'
فَمَنَعُوا: فَـ + مَنَعَ + وا — fa-, and so (conj.) + manaʿa, to hold back, prevent; -ū, they; 'and they held back'
خُيُولَهُمْ: خُيُول + هُمْ — khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl) + -hum, their; 'their horses'
وَالزَّرَدِ: و + الـ + زَرَد — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + zarad, chain-mail (m.); 'and the mail'
غَوَاطِسُ: غَوَاطِس — ghawāṭis, plunged, sunk in (pl. of ghāṭis), nom. diptote; 'plunged'
وَمَرْيَمَ: و + مَرْيَمَ — wa-, and (conj.; here joining the second name in the oath) + Maryam, Mary (proper name), gen. diptote; 'and Mary'
أَمَّلْنَاهُ: أَمَّلَ + نَا + هُ — ammala, to hope for (Form II); -nā, we; -hu, it; 'we hoped for it'
خَلْفَكُمْ: خَلْف + كُمْ — khalf, behind (adv./prep.) + -kum, you (pl.); 'behind you'
مُجِدُّونَ: مُجِدُّونَ — mujidd, pressing on, earnest (active part. of ajadda, Form IV), nom. m.pl.; 'pressing on'
السَّيْرَ: الـ + سَيْر — al-, the + sayr, going, travel (m.), acc. object of the participle; 'the going'
سَبَقْنَاكُمْ: سَبَقَ + نَا + كُمْ — sabaqa, to outstrip, get ahead of; -nā, we; -kum, you (pl.); 'we got ahead of you'
فَانْزِلُوا: فَـ + انْزِلُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + inzilū, nazala (ʿan), to get down (from a horse); imper. m.pl.; 'so get down'
خُيُولِكُمْ: خُيُول + كُمْ — khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl) + -kum, your; 'your horses'
وَأَعْطُونَا: و + أَعْطُوا + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭā, to give (Form IV), imper. m.pl.; -nā, us; 'and give us'
أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ: أَسْلِحَة + كُمْ — asliḥa, weapons (pl. of silāḥ) + -kum, your; 'your weapons'
وَسَلِّمُوا: و + سَلِّمُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + sallimū, sallama, to hand over, surrender (Form II), imper. m.pl.; 'and hand over'
أَنْفُسَكُمْ: أَنْفُس + كُمْ — anfus, selves (pl. of nafs) + -kum, your; 'yourselves'
نَجُودَ: نَجُودَ — najūda, jāda (ʿalā bi-), to be generous (to someone with something); 1st pl. subjunctive after ḥattā; 'we show generosity'
بِأَرْوَاحِكُمْ: بِـ + أَرْوَاح + كُمْ — bi-, with (prep.; jāda ʿalā bi-, be generous to X with Y) + arwāḥ, souls, lives (pl. of rūḥ) + -kum, your; 'with your lives'
وَاحْمَرَّتْ: و + احْمَرَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḥmarrat, iḥmarra, to turn red (Form IX); -at, she; 'and turned red'
وَجْنَتَاهُ: وَجْنَة + َاهُ — wajna, cheek (f.) + -āhu, dual nom. + his; 'his two cheeks'
كِلَابَ: كِلَاب — kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb, m.); accusative as the noun of a vocative annexation, 'O dogs of ...'
