جَسَرْتُمْ: جَسَرْتُمْ — jasartum, you (m. pl.) have dared (perfect 2 m. pl., root ج-س-ر)
وَجِئْتُمْ: و + جِئْتُمْ — wa- (and) + jiʾtum, you came (perfect 2 m. pl. of جَاءَ, root ج-ي-ء); 'and you came'
وَمَشَيْتُمْ: و + مَشَيْتُمْ — wa- (and) + mashaytum, you walked (perfect 2 m. pl., root م-ش-ي); 'and you walked'
أَرْضِنَا: أَرْضِنَا — arḍ + -nā, our land, our earth (arḍ, f.; -nā, our); genitive after fī
كَفَاكُمْ: كَفَاكُمْ — kafā + -kum, it sufficed you (kafā, to suffice, root ك-ف-ي; -kum, you, m. pl., object)
أَنَّكُمْ: أَنَّ + كُمْ — anna (that, with its noun) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'that you'
تُخَاطِرُونَ: تُخَاطِرُونَ — tukhāṭirūna, you (m. pl.) risk, stake (imperfect, form III of خَاطَرَ, root خ-ط-ر)
بِأَنْفُسِكُمْ: بِـ + أَنْفُسِ + كُمْ — bi-, with (prep.; with khāṭara, bi- marks what is staked) + anfus, selves (pl. of nafs, f.) + -kum, your; 'with your selves', 'your own lives'
وَتُخَاطِبُونَ: و + تُخَاطِبُونَ — wa- (and) + tukhāṭibūna, you (m. pl.) address, speak to (imperfect, form III of خَاطَبَ, root خ-ط-ب); 'and you address'
أَظَنَنْتُمْ: أَ + ظَنَنْتُمْ — a-, question particle ('did ...?') + ẓanantum, you (m. pl.) thought (perfect 2 m. pl., root ظ-ن-ن); 'did you think'
تَخْلُصُونَ: تَخْلُصُونَ — takhluṣūna, you (m. pl.) escape, get free (imperfect, root خ-ل-ص); printed in the indicative after 'that'
وَتَعُودُونَ: و + تَعُودُونَ — wa- (and) + taʿūdūna, you (m. pl.) return (imperfect, root ع-و-د); 'and you return'
دُونَكُمْ: دُونَ + كُمْ — dūna, 'at hand, below' + -kum, you; dūnakum is a stock imperative-adverb, 'yours to take!', 'at them!', governing the object that follows
وَهَؤُلَاءِ: و + هَؤُلَاءِ — wa- (and; here introducing the object of dūnakum) + hāʾulāʾi, these (demonstrative, pl. comm.); 'and these (take these)'
الْكِلَابَ: الـ + كِلَاب — al- (the) + kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb, m.); accusative, the object of dūnakum, in apposition to 'these'
عَدَدِكُمْ: عَدَدِ + كُمْ — ʿadad, number (m.) + -kum, your; genitive after fī (in the preceding fī ʿadadikum, 'equal to your number')
وَحَمَلَتْ: و + حَمَلَتْ — wa- (and) + ḥamalat, she/it charged (perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and ... charged' (feminine to agree with the collective 'hundred')
الْمِائَةُ: الـ + مِائَةُ — al- (the) + miʾa, hundred (f.); nominative subject, 'the hundred'
فَاسْتَقْبَلَتْهُمُ: فَـ + اسْتَقْبَلَتْ + هُمُ — fa- (and so) + istaqbalat, she/it met, received (perfect 3 f. sg., form X, root ق-ب-ل) + -humu, them (m.); 'and so ... met them'
الْإِفْرَنْجُ: الـ + إِفْرَنْج — al- (the) + Ifranj, the Franks, Europeans (collective); nominative subject, with feminine verb
بِقُلُوبٍ: بِـ + قُلُوبٍ — bi-, with (prep.) + qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb, m.); 'with hearts'
أَقْوَى: أَقْوَى — aqwā, stronger (elative of qawī, root ق-و-ي); 'stronger than ...'
الصَّخْرِ: الـ + صَّخْر — al- (the) + ṣakhr, rock, stone (m.); genitive after min; 'than the rock'
وَاصْطَدَمَتِ: و + اصْطَدَمَتِ — wa- (and) + iṣṭadamat, she/it collided (perfect 3 f. sg., form VIII, root ص-د-م); 'and ... collided'
وَوَقَعَتِ: و + وَقَعَتِ — wa- (and) + waqaʿat, she/it fell (perfect 3 f. sg., root و-ق-ع); 'and ... fell'
الْأَبْطَالُ: الـ + أَبْطَال — al- (the) + abṭāl, heroes, champions (pl. of baṭal, m.); nominative subject
الْأَبْطَالِ: الـ + أَبْطَالِ — al- (the) + abṭāl, heroes (pl. of baṭal); genitive after fī; 'upon the heroes'
وَالْتَحَمَ: و + الْتَحَمَ — wa- (and) + iltaḥama, it was joined, locked in close fight (perfect 3 m. sg., form VIII, root ل-ح-م); 'and ... was joined'
الْقِتَالُ: الـ + قِتَال — al- (the) + qitāl, fighting, battle (m.); nominative subject
النِّزَالُ: الـ + نِّزَال — al- (the) + nizāl, combat at close quarters (m.); nominative subject
وَعَظُمَتِ: و + عَظُمَتِ — wa- (and) + ʿaẓumat, she/it grew great (perfect 3 f. sg., root ع-ظ-م); 'and ... grew great'
الْأَهْوَالُ: الـ + أَهْوَال — al- (the) + ahwāl, terrors, horrors (pl. of hawl, m.); nominative subject
الْقِيلُ: الـ + قِيل — al- (the) + qīl, 'it is said', talk (m.; verbal noun of qīla)
وَالْقَالُ: و + الـ + قَال — wa- (and) + al- (the) + qāl, 'he said', talk (m.); al-qīl wa-al-qāl, 'idle chatter, argument'
وَالْكِفَاحِ: و + الـ + كِفَاحِ — wa- (and) + al- (the) + kifāḥ, close fighting, hand-to-hand combat (m.); genitive; 'and the close fighting'
وَالضَّرْبِ: و + الـ + ضَّرْبِ — wa- (and) + al- (the) + ḍarb, striking (m.; verbal noun of ḍaraba); genitive; 'and the striking'
بِالصِّفَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + صِّفَاحِ — bi-, with (prep., the instrument of striking) + al- (the) + ṣifāḥ, broad blades (pl. of ṣafīḥa); 'with the broad blades'
بِالْاِعْتِكَارِ: بِـ + الـ + اِعْتِكَارِ — bi-, with (prep., 'with, in'; of the accompanying circumstance) + al- (the) + iʿtikār, dense darkness (m.; verbal noun, root ع-ت-ك-ر); 'in thick darkness'
فَانْفَصَلُوا: فَـ + انْفَصَلُوا — fa- (and so) + infaṣalū, they separated, parted (perfect 3 m. pl., form VII, root ف-ص-ل); 'and so they parted'
بَعْضِهِمُ: بَعْضِ + هِمُ — baʿḍ, some, part (m.) + -himu, them; 'some of them'; genitive after ʿan
بِأَصْحَابِهِ: بِـ + أَصْحَابِ + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; ijtamaʿa bi- 'meet with') + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib) + -hi, his; 'with his companions'
انْصَدَمَ: انْصَدَمَ — inṣadama, he was struck, hurt (perfect 3 m. sg., form VII, root ص-د-م); describing aḥad, 'anyone struck'
أَرْبَعَةِ: أَرْبَعَةِ — arbaʿat, four (f. form, for a masc. counted noun) + genitive in annexation; 'four of'
أَنْفُسٍ: أَنْفُسٍ — anfus, selves, persons (pl. of nafs, f.); genitive after the number; 'four persons'
بِجِرَاحَاتٍ: بِـ + جِرَاحَاتٍ — bi-, with (prep.; 'with, having') + jirāḥāt, wounds (f. pl. of jirāḥa); 'with wounds'
رَأَهَا: رَأَهَا — raʾā + -hā, he saw her/it/them (raʾā, perfect 3 m. sg., root ر-أ-ي; -hā, 'them', the wounds, fem. sg. of a non-person plural); the edition prints the precomposed hamza
سَالِمَةً: سَالِمَةً — sālimatan, safe, sound, unharmed (f. sg., root س-ل-م); accusative, a state: 'he saw them safe'
أَخُوضُ: أَخُوضُ — akhūḍu, I plunge into, wade (imperfect 1 sg., root خ-و-ض)
بَحْرَ: بَحْرَ — baḥr, sea (m.); accusative object of akhūḍu, in annexation to al-ḥarb
الْعَجَّاجَ: الـ + عَجَّاجَ — al- (the) + ʿajjāj, surging, roaring (adj., root ع-ج-ج); accusative, describing the sea
وَأُقَاتِلُ: و + أُقَاتِلُ — wa- (and) + uqātilu, I fight (imperfect 1 sg., form III, root ق-ت-ل); 'and I fight'
لَقِيتُ: لَقِيتُ — laqītu, I met (perfect 1 sg., root ل-ق-ي)
أَصْبَرَ: أَصْبَرَ — aṣbara, more patient, more steadfast (elative of ṣābir, root ص-ب-ر); accusative, the object of laqītu with the sense 'any more steadfast'
الْجِلَادِ: الـ + جِلَاد — al- (the) + jilād, sword-fighting, combat with swords (m.); genitive after ʿalā (ṣabr ʿalā, 'steadfastness at'): 'more steadfast at the sword-fight'
وَمُلَاقَاةِ: و + مُلَاقَاةِ — wa- (and) + mulāqāt, meeting, encountering (f.; verbal noun of lāqā, form III, root ل-ق-ي); genitive in annexation to al-rijāl
إِفْرَنْجِيًّا: إِفْرَنْجِيًّا — Ifranjiyyan, Frankish, a Frank (adjective in -iyy from Ifranj); accusative, describing fārisan
شَجَاعَةٌ: شَجَاعَةٌ — shajāʿa, courage, bravery (f.) + nominative tanwīn; 'bravery' (subject of 'to him is ...')
وَطَعَنَاتٌ: و + طَعَنَاتٌ — wa- (and) + ṭaʿanāt, thrusts (f. pl. of ṭaʿna, a lance-thrust); 'and thrusts'
نَافِذَاتٌ: نَافِذَاتٌ — nāfidhāt, piercing, penetrating (f. pl. of nāfidh, root ن-ف-ذ); describing ṭaʿanāt
عَفَاعَنَّا: عَفَا + عَنَّا — ʿafā, he pardoned, spared (perfect 3 m. sg., root ع-ف-و) + ʿannā, from us (ʿan + -nā); printed as one word, 'he spared us'
يَتَغَافَلُ: يَتَغَافَلُ — yataghāfalu, he feigns heedlessness, pretends not to notice (imperfect 3 m. sg., form VI, root غ-ف-ل)
يُقَاتِلُهُ: يُقَاتِلُ + هُ — yuqātilu, he fights (imperfect 3 m. sg., form III, root ق-ت-ل) + -hu, him; 'fights him'
لَوْأَ: لَوْ + أ — law, if (conditional particle, referring to the unreal) + the alif that belongs to the next piece, أَرَادَ (printed split from it); read with رَادَ as law arāda, 'if he had wished'
رَادَ: رَادَ — rāda, i.e. arāda (without its initial alif, which the print has put at the end of the previous piece), he wished, wanted (perfect 3 m. sg., form IV, root ر-و-د)
قَتْلَنَا: قَتْلَ + نَا — qatl, killing (m.; verbal noun, root ق-ت-ل) + -nā, our; accusative object of arāda, 'our killing'
لَقَتَلَنَا: لَـ + قَتَلَ + نَا — la-, would have (particle opening the answer of law) + qatala, he killed (perfect 3 m. sg., root ق-ت-ل) + -nā, us; 'he would have killed us'
بِأَجْمَعِنَا: بِـ + أَجْمَعِ + نَا — bi-, with (prep.) + ajmaʿ, all, whole (elative-form noun, root ج-م-ع) + -nā, our; 'with all of us', i.e. 'every one of us'
لِمَارَأَى: لِـ + مَا + رَأَى — li-, at (prep.; taḥayyara li-, 'be amazed at') + mā, what + raʾā, he saw (perfect 3 m. sg., root ر-أ-ي); printed as one word, 'at what he saw'
نَصْطَفُّ: نَصْطَفُّ — naṣṭaffu, we line up, draw up in ranks (imperfect 1 pl., form VIII, root ص-ف-ف)
نُبَارِزُهُمْ: نُبَارِزُ + هُمْ — nubārizu, we duel, fight single combat (imperfect 1 pl., form III, root ب-ر-ز) + -hum, them; 'we fight them man to man'
النَّصْرَ: الـ + نَّصْرَ — al- (the) + naṣr, victory, help (m.); accusative object, 'the victory'
الْاِتِّفَاقِ: الـ + اِتِّفَاقِ — al- (the) + ittifāq, agreement, accord (m.; verbal noun, form VIII, root و-ف-ق); genitive after ʿalā, 'on that agreement'
فَإِنَّهُمُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُمُ — fa- (then; answering ammā) + inna (indeed, with its noun) + -humu, they; 'then they'
مُقَدَّمِهِمْ: مُقَدَّمِ + هِمْ — muqaddam, leader (m.; passive participle, form II, root ق-د-م) + -him, their; genitive after ʿinda; 'their leader'
أَرَبًا: أَرَبًا — araban, an aim, a purpose (m.; root أ-ر-ب); accusative, the thing not attained; 'any aim'
وَنُبَارِزُهُمْ: و + نُبَارِزُ + هُمْ — wa- (and) + nubārizu, we duel (imperfect 1 pl., form III, root ب-ر-ز) + -hum, them; 'and we fight them'
فَبَاتُوا: فَـ + بَاتُوا — fa- (and so) + bātū, they spent the night (perfect 3 m. pl. of بَاتَ, root ب-ي-ت); 'and so they spent the night'
وَتَحَارَسَ: و + تَحَارَسَ — wa- (and) + taḥārasa, they kept watch on one another (perfect 3 m. sg., form VI, root ح-ر-س); 'and ... kept watch on each other'
الْفَرِيقَانِ: الـ + فَرِيقَانِ — al- (the) + farīqān, the two parties, the two camps (nominative dual of farīq, m.)
وَأَتَوْا: و + أَتَوْا — wa- (and) + ataw, they came (perfect 3 m. pl. of أَتَى, root أ-ت-ي); 'and they came'
الْإِفْرَنْجَ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجَ — al- (the) + Ifranj, the Franks (collective); accusative object
اصْطَفُّوا: اصْطَفُّوا — iṣṭaffū, they lined up, drew up in ranks (perfect 3 m. pl., form VIII, root ص-ف-ف)
لِلْقِتَالِ: لِـ + الـ + قِتَالِ — li-, for (prep.; 'for the purpose of') + al- (the) + qitāl, fighting (m.); 'for the fight'
لِأَصْحَابِهِ: لِـ + أَصْحَابِ + هِ — li-, to (prep.; after qāla, li- marks the person spoken to) + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib) + -hi, his; 'to his companions'
أَعْدَاءَنَا: أَعْدَاءَ + نَا — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww, m.) + -nā, our; accusative, noun of inna
وَالْمُبَادَرَةَ: و + الـ + مُبَادَرَةَ — wa- (and) + al- (the) + mubādara, hastening, hurrying (f.; verbal noun, form III, root ب-د-ر); accusative, the object of dūnakum: 'and make haste'
الْإِفْرَنْجِ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِ — al- (the) + Ifranj, the Franks (collective); genitive after min; 'of the Franks'
لَايَكُونُ: لَا + يَكُونُ — lā (not) + yakūnu, it is, it will be (imperfect 3 m. sg. of kāna, root ك-و-ن); printed as one word, 'it shall not be'
قِتَالُنَا: قِتَال + نَا — qitāl, fighting (m.) + -nā, our; nominative, subject, 'our fighting'
إِلَّامُنَاوَبَةً: إِلَّا + مُنَاوَبَةً — illā, except (particle) + munāwabatan, by turns, in rotation (f.; verbal noun, form III, root ن-و-ب); accusative, a manner; printed as one word, 'except by turns'
يَبْرُزَ: يَبْرُزَ — yabruza, he comes forth (subjunctive 3 m. sg., root ب-ر-ز)
بَطَلٍ: بَطَلٍ — baṭal, hero, champion (m.) + genitive tanwīn; 'to a champion'
أَصْحَابِ: أَصْحَابِ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, m.); genitive in annexation to Sharkān
وَسَاقَ: و + سَاقَ — wa- (and) + sāqa, he drove, rode on (perfect 3 m. sg., root س-و-ق); 'and he rode'
الصَّفَّيْنِ: الـ + صَّفَّيْنِ — al- (the) + ṣaffayn, the two ranks (genitive dual of ṣaff, m.); bayna al-ṣaffayn, 'between the two lines'
مُبَارِزٍ: مُبَارِز — mubāriz, challenger, duellist (m.; active participle, form III, root ب-ر-ز) + genitive tanwīn; after min of generalisation (hal min mubārizin, 'is there any challenger at all?')
مُنَاجِزٍ: مُنَاجِز — munājiz, one who fights to the finish (m.; active participle, form III, root ن-ج-ز) + genitive tanwīn; after min of generalisation, 'any fighter to the death?'
لَايَبْرُزُلِي: لَا + يَبْرُزُ + لِـ + ي — lā (not) + yabruzu, he comes forth (imperfect 3 m. sg., root ب-ر-ز) + li-, to, against (prep.) + -ī, me; printed as one word, 'let no one come out to me'
كَسْلَانُ: كَسْلَانُ — kaslān, lazy, an idler (m.; diptote, nominative)
عَاجِزٌ: عَاجِز — ʿājiz, weak, helpless, a weakling (m.; active participle of ʿajaza, root ع-ج-ز) + nominative tanwīn; 'nor a weakling' (after wa-lā)
بَرَزَإِلَيْهِ: بَرَزَ + إِلَيْ + هِ — baraza, he came forth (perfect 3 m. sg., root ب-ر-ز) + ilā, to (prep.) + -hi, him; printed as one word, 'came out to him'
سِلَاحِهِ: سِلَاحِ + هِ — silāḥ, weapon, arms (m.) + -hi, his; genitive after fī
وَقُمَاشِهِ: و + قُمَاشِ + هِ — wa- (and) + qumāsh, gear, equipment, stuff (m.) + -hi, his; 'and his gear'
جَوَادٍ: جَوَادٍ — jawād, a horse, a swift steed (m.) + genitive tanwīn; 'on a horse'
أَشْهَبَ: أَشْهَبَ — ashhab, grey, whitish (m.; diptote, genitive)
الْإِفْرَنْجِيُّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيُّ — al- (the) + Ifranjiyy, a Frank, Frankish (adj. in -iyy); nominative
لَانَبَاتَ: لَا + نَبَاتَ — lā, no (negation of the genus) + nabāt, growth, plant (m.; root ن-ب-ت); printed as one word, 'there is no growth'
بِعَارِضَيْهِ: بِـ + عَارِضَ + يْهِ — bi-, on, in (prep.) + ʿāriḍ, the side of the face, cheek (m.) + -ayhi, his two (dual); 'on his two cheeks'
فَسَاقَ: فَـ + سَاقَ — fa- (and so) + sāqa, he drove, urged on (perfect 3 m. sg., root س-و-ق); 'and so he drove'
وَالطِّعَانِ: و + الـ + طِّعَانِ — wa- (and) + al- (the) + ṭiʿān, thrusting, lance-fighting (m.); genitive; 'and the thrusting'
طَعَنَهُ: طَعَنَ + هُ — ṭaʿana, he thrust, pierced (perfect 3 m. sg., root ط-ع-ن) + -hu, him; 'he thrust him'
بِالرُّمْحِ: بِـ + الـ + رُّمْحِ — bi-, with (prep., the instrument) + al- (the) + rumḥ, spear, lance (m.); 'with the spear'
فَنَكَسَهُ: فَـ + نَكَسَ + هُ — fa- (and so) + nakasa, he overturned, turned upside down (perfect 3 m. sg., root ن-ك-س) + -hu, him; 'and so he toppled him'
وَأَخَذَهُ: و + أَخَذَ + هُ — wa- (and) + akhadha, he took (perfect 3 m. sg., root أ-خ-ذ) + -hu, him; 'and he took him'
أَسِيرًا: أَسِيرًا — asīran, a prisoner, captive (m.; root أ-س-ر); accusative, a state: 'as a prisoner'
وَقَادَهُ: و + قَادَ + هُ — wa- (and) + qāda, he led (perfect 3 m. sg., root ق-و-د) + -hu, him; 'and he led him'
قَوْمُهُ: قَوْمُ + هُ — qawm, people, kinsmen (m.) + -hu, his; nominative subject
وَمَنَعُوهُ: و + مَنَعُوا + هُ — wa- (and) + manaʿū, they prevented, forbade (perfect 3 m. pl., root م-ن-ع) + -hu, him; 'and they forbade him'
وَأَخْرَجُوا: و + أَخْرَجُوا — wa- (and) + akhrajū, they brought out, sent out (perfect 3 m. pl., form IV, root خ-ر-ج); 'and they sent out'
وَهُوَأَخُ: و + هُوَ + أَخُ — wa- (and) + huwa, he (pronoun) + akhu, brother of (akh, m.; the printed spelling omits the final و of akhū, so we point akhu); printed as one word, 'and he was the brother of'
الْأَسِيرِ: الـ + أَسِيرِ — al- (the) + asīr, prisoner, captive (m.); genitive in annexation to akhū
وَغَالَطَهُ: و + غَالَطَ + هُ — wa- (and) + ghālaṭa, he deceived, tricked (perfect 3 m. sg., form III, root غ-ل-ط) + -hu, him; 'and he tricked him'
وَطَعَنَهُ: و + طَعَنَ + هُ — wa- (and) + ṭaʿana, he thrust (perfect 3 m. sg., root ط-ع-ن) + -hu, him; 'and he struck him'
بِعَقِبِ: بِـ + عَقِبِ — bi-, with (prep., the instrument) + ʿaqib, heel, hind part, here the butt-end (m.; root ع-ق-ب); in annexation to al-rumḥ; 'with the butt of'
الرُّمْحِ: الـ + رُّمْحِ — al- (the) + rumḥ, spear, lance (m.); genitive; 'of the lance'
فَنَكَّسَهُ: فَـ + نَكَّسَ + هُ — fa- (and so) + nakkasa, he overturned (perfect 3 m. sg., form II, root ن-ك-س) + -hu, him; 'and so he toppled him'; the shadda is the edition's
وَلَازَالَتِ: و + لَا + زَالَتِ — wa- (and) + lā (not) + zālat, she/it ceased (perfect 3 f. sg., root ز-ي-ل); printed as one word, 'and ... did not cease'
وَالْإِفْرَنْجِيُّ: و + الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيُّ — wa- (and) + al- (the) + Ifranjiyy, the Frank (adj. in -iyy as noun); nominative
يَأْسِرُهُمْ: يَأْسِرُ + هُمْ — yaʾsiru, he captures (imperfect 3 m. sg., root أ-س-ر) + -hum, them; 'he captures them'
أَخْذٍ: akhdh — akhdh, taking (verbal noun, gen. as part of the list 'attack, retreat, taking, giving-back')
أَسَرُوا: asarū — asara, take captive (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they took captive'
اسْتَتَمَّ: istatamma — istatamma, complete, finish (X perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he finished'
اصْطَدَمَا: iṣṭadamā — iṣṭadama, collide, clash (VIII perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two clashed'
الطَّائِفَتَانِ: الـ + طَائِفَتَان — ṭāʾifa, party, band (f., dual nom.); 'the two parties'
الطَّعْنِ: الـ + طَعْن — ṭaʿn, thrusting, stabbing (verbal noun, gen. after فِي); 'the thrusting'
الْإِفْرَنْجِيَّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيّ — Ifranjī, Frank, a European (m., acc., object of تَلَقَّى); 'the Frank'
الْإِفْرَنْجِيُّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيّ — Ifranjī, Frank, a European (m., nom.); 'the Frank'
الْإِفْرَنْجِيِّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيّ — Ifranjī, Frank, a European (m., gen. after مِنْ); 'the Frank'
الْبُلْدَانَ: الـ + بُلْدَان — buldān, lands, countries (pl. of balad, acc.); 'the lands'
الْتَطَمَا: iltaṭamā — iltaṭama, dash together, crash (of waves; VIII perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two crashed together'
الْغَضْبَانِ: الـ + غَضْبَان — ghaḍbān, angry, enraged (adj., m., gen.); 'the enraged'
بَحْرَانِ: baḥrān — baḥr, sea (m., dual nom.); 'two seas'
بَرَزَلَهُ: baraza + لـ + -hu — baraza, come out, go forth (perf. 3 m. sg.) + li-, to (prep.; with برز 'come out to, against') + 'him'; 'he came out against him' (printed as one word)
بِأَصْحَابِهِ: بِـ + أَصْحَاب + -hi — bi-, with (prep.; with اجْتَمَعَ 'meet with') + aṣḥāb, companions (gen.) + 'his'; 'with his companions'
بِالْإِفْرَنْجِ: بِـ + الـ + إِفْرَنْج — bi-, only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise + ifranj, the Franks (collective); 'and behold, the Franks'
بِالْفَارِسِ: بِـ + الـ + فَارِس — bi-, only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise + fāris, horseman; 'and behold, the horseman'
بِخِبْرَةٍ: بِـ + خِبْرَة — bi-, with (prep.; of manner) + khibra, skill, experience (f., gen.); 'with skill'
بِرَازَ: birāz — birāz, single combat, challenge (m., acc. as object of أَطْلُبُ, in iḍāfa); 'single combat of'
جَبَلَانِ: jabalān — jabal, mountain (m., dual nom.); 'two mountains'
صَاحِبِهِ: ṣāḥib + -hi — ṣāḥib, companion (gen. after مِنْ) + 'his'; 'his companion'
صَالَحَنَا: ṣāliḥa + -nā — ṣāliḥa, make peace with (III perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'us'; 'he made peace with us'
صَالَحْنَاهُ: ṣāliḥ + -nā + -hu — ṣāliḥa, make peace with (III perf.) + 'we' + 'him'; 'we made peace with him'
صَدْمَةَ: ṣadma — ṣadma, collision, shock (f., acc. as absolute object, in iḍāfa); 'the collision of'
عَرَبِيٍّ: ʿarabī — ʿarabī, Arabic, Arab (adj., m., gen.); 'Arabic'
غُرَّةٌ: ghurra — ghurra, blaze (white mark on a horse's forehead; f., nom.); 'a blaze'
فَتَأَمَّلَ: فَـ + تَأَمَّلَ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + taʾammala, look at closely, scrutinise (V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he studied'
فَتَلَقَّى: فَـ + تَلَقَّى — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + talaqqā, meet, receive (V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he met'
فَدَانَهُ: فَـ + دَانَ + -hu — fa-, and (conj.) + dāna?, obscure verb (perhaps a slip for فَدَنَوْا 'they drew near') + 'him'; printed as 'and he drew near him'
فَرٍّوَ: فَرٍّ + وَ — farr, retreat, flight (m., gen.) + wa-, and (conj., joined in the print to the word); 'retreat, and'
فَرَكِبَتِ: فَـ + رَكِبَتِ — fa-, and (conj. of sequence) + rakiba, mount, ride (perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra before الـ); 'and mounted'
قَاتَلْنَاهُ: qātal + -nā + -hu — qātala, fight (III perf.) + 'we' + 'him'; 'we fought him' (future sense after إِنْ)
قَبَاءً: qabāʾ — qabāʾ, coat, long outer garment (m., acc. as object of the participle); 'a coat'
قَوْمِكَ: qawm + -ka — qawm, people (gen. in iḍāfa) + 'your'; 'your people'
قَوْمِي: qawm + -ī — qawm, people (gen. in iḍāfa) + 'my'; 'my people'
قِتَالٍ: qitāl — qitāl, fighting, battle (m., gen. after فِي); 'fighting'
قِتَالِنَا: qitāl + -nā — qitāl, fighting (gen. after مِنْ) + 'our'; 'our fighting'
كَالدِّرْهَمِ: كَـ + الـ + دِرْهَم — ka-, like, as (prep.; of comparison) + dirham, silver coin; 'like the dirham'
كَالْأَسَدِ: كَـ + الـ + أَسَد — ka-, like (prep.; of comparison) + asad, lion; 'like the lion'
كَرٍّوَ: كَرٍّ + وَ — karr, attack, charge (m., gen.) + wa-, and (conj., joined in the print to the word); 'attack, and'
مَلَّانُ: mallān — malʾān (printed with shadda), full (adj., m., nom.); 'full'
مُهَنَّدٌوَ: مُهَنَّدٌ + وَ — muhannad, Indian-tempered (m., adj. nom., of a sword) + wa-, and (conj., joined in the print to the word); 'Indian-tempered, and'
نَاصَفَكَ: nāṣafa + -ka — nāṣafa, meet half-way, be equal to (III perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'you'; 'he equalled you'
نِصْفِهِمْ: niṣf + -him — niṣf, half (gen. after مِنْ) + 'their'; 'half of them'
وَأَخَذَا: وَ + أَخَذَا — wa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, take, begin (perf. 3 m. dual; with فِي 'set about'); 'and the two began'
وَأَخْرَبَ: وَ + أَخْرَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhraba, lay waste, ruin (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and laid waste'
وَأَطْلُبُ: وَ + أَطْلُبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭlubu, seek, demand (impf. 1 sg.); 'and I seek'
وَإِمْكَانٍ: وَ + إِمْكَان — wa-, and (conj.) + imkān, ability, power (m., gen.); 'and ability'
وَابْرُزَّ: وَ + ابْرُزَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ubruz, come forth (imperative, printed with shadda); 'and come out'
وَاصْطَفَّتِ: وَ + اصْطَفَّتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iṣṭaffa, draw up in ranks (VIII perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and drew up in ranks'
وَالْحَرْبَ: وَ + الـ + حَرْب — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥarb, war (f., acc. after دُونَكَ); 'and the war'
وَالْقِتَالَ: وَ + الـ + قِتَال — wa-, and (conj.) + qitāl, fighting (acc. after دُونَكَ); 'and the fighting'
وَانْفَصَلَ: وَ + انْفَصَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + infaṣala, part, separate (VII perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and parted'
وَرَدٍّ: وَ + رَدّ — wa-, and (conj.) + radd, giving back, returning (verbal noun, gen.); 'and giving-back'
وَصَدَمَهُ: وَ + صَدَمَ + -hu — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣadama, strike, collide with (perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'him'; 'and struck him'
وَطَبَّقَ: وَ + طَبَّقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭabbaqa, cover, close upon (II perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he closed upon'
وَلَكَزَ: وَ + لَكَزَ — wa-, and (conj.) + lakaza, prod, jab (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he prodded'
قَطُّ: qaṭṭu, ever (adv., used with a negative: 'never'); 'ever'
خَصْلَةً: خَصْلَة — khaṣla, trait, habit (f.); acc. tanwīn, object; 'a trait'
أَحَلٍ: أَحَل — aḥal as printed; evidently a slip for أَحَد aḥad, anyone; gen. after مِنْ; 'from anyone'
نَّهُ: (أَ)نَّ + هُ — (a)nna, that (conj.; its أَ is lost at the printed word split) + -hu, he/it; 'that he'
خَصْمِهِ: خَصْم + هِ — khaṣm, adversary (m.); gen. after فِي + -hi, his; 'in his adversary'
مَضْرِبٌ: مَضْرِب — maḍrib, place to strike, vulnerable spot (m.); nom. tanwīn; 'a striking-place'
قَاتِلٌ: قَاتِل — qātil, deadly, killing (act. part. of قَتَلَ); nom.; 'deadly'
يُقَلِّبُ: قَلَّبَ — qallaba (II), turn over, reverse; impf. 3 m. sg.; 'he turns over'
الرُّمْحَ: الـ + رُمْح — al-, the + rumḥ, lance (m.); acc., object; 'the lance'
وَيَضْرِبُهُ: و + يَضْرِبُ + هُ — wa-, and + yaḍribu, strike (ضَرَبَ), impf. 3 m. sg. + -hu, him/it; 'and strikes him'
بِعَقِبِهِ: بِـ + عَقِب + هِ — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + ʿaqib, heel, butt-end (m.) + -hi, its; 'with its butt'
مِنِّي: مِنْ + ـنِي — min, from (prep.) + -nī, me (the nūn is doubled before the pronoun); 'from me'
عَسْكَرِنَا: عَسْكَر + نَا — ʿaskar, army (m.); gen. after فِي + -nā, our; 'our army'
وَمِثْلُ: و + مِثْل — wa-, and + mithl, the like of; nom. in construct; 'and the like of'
الصَّبَاحُ: الـ + صَبَاح — al-, the + ṣabāḥ, morning (m.); nom.; 'the morning'
الْإِفْرَنْجِيُّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيّ — al-, the + Ifranjī, a Frank (nisba of Ifranj, the Franks); nom.; 'the Frank'
أَخَذَا: أَخَذَ — akhadha, take; perf. dual (-ā); أَخَذَ فِي 'begin'; 'the two began'
الْقِتَالِ: الـ + قِتَال — al-, the + qitāl, fighting (m.); gen. after فِى; 'the fighting'; also gen. after min ('tired from the fighting')
وَأَوْسَعَا: و + أَوْسَعَ — wa-, and + awsaʿa (IV), make wide, give scope; perf. dual; 'and the two gave wide scope'
وَالْمَجَالِ: و + الـ + مَجَال — wa-, and + al-, the + majāl, field of play, scope (m.); gen.; 'and the field of play'
وَامْتَدَّتْ: و + اِمْتَدَّ — wa-, and + imtadda (VIII), stretch out; perf. 3 f. sg. -at; 'and stretched'
الْأَعْنَاقُ: الـ + أَعْنَاق — al-, the + aʿnāq, necks (pl. of عُنُق); nom.; 'the necks'
وَكِفَاحٍ: و + كِفَاح — wa-, and + kifāḥ, close combat, struggle (m.); gen. tanwīn; 'and combat'
وَطَعْنٍ: و + طَعْن — wa-, and + ṭaʿn, thrusting, stabbing (m.); gen. tanwīn; 'and thrusting'
بِالرِّمَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + رِمَاح — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + rimāḥ, lances (pl. of رُمْح); 'with the lances'
النَّهَارُ: الـ + نَهَار — al-, the + nahār, day (m.); nom.; 'the day'
افْتَرَقَا: اِفْتَرَقَ — iftaraqa (VIII), part, separate; perf. dual; 'the two parted'
قَوْمِهِمَا: قَوْم + هِمَا — qawm, people (m.); gen. after إِلَى + -himā, their (of the two); 'their people'
كُلٌّ: كُلّ — kull, each, every (m.); nom. tanwīn; 'each'
لَاقَاهُ: لَاقَى + هُ — lāqā (III), meet, encounter; perf. 3 m. sg. + -hu, it; 'he met'
الْإِفْرَنْجِيَّ: الـ + إِفْرَنْجِيّ — al-, the + Ifranjī, a Frank; acc. after إِنَّ; 'the Frank'
الِانْفِصَالُ: الـ + اِنْفِصَال — al-, the + infiṣāl, separation, decision (VII verbal noun); nom.; 'the decision'
اللَّيْلَةَ: الـ + لَيْلَة — al-, the + layla, night (f.); acc. of time; 'the night'
الصَّبَاحِ: الـ + صَبَاح — al-, the + ṣabāḥ, morning; gen. after إِلَى; 'the morning'
وَحَمَلَا: و + حَمَلَ — wa-, and + ḥamala, charge (حَمَلَ عَلَى 'charge at'); perf. dual; 'and the two charged'
النَّهَارِ: الـ + نَهَار — al-, the + nahār, day; gen.; 'the day'
جَذَّ: جَذَّ — jadhdha as printed ('cut off'); probably a short writing of جَذَبَ jadhaba, pull, tug; perf. 3 m. sg.; 'pulled'
بِاللِّجَامِ: بِـ + الـ + لِجَام — bi-, by, by means of (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + lijām, bridle (m.); 'by the bridle'
فَانْكَبَّ: فَـ + اِنْكَبَّ — fa-, and then, thereupon + inkabba (VII), fall upon, bend over; perf. 3 m. sg.; 'and fell upon'
يَضْرِبَهُ: يَضْرِبَ + هُ — yaḍriba, strike (ضَرَبَ); subj. 3 m. sg. after أَنْ + -hu, him; 'to strike him'
بِالسَّيْفِ: بِـ + الـ + سَيْف — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + al-, the + sayf, sword (m.); 'with the sword'
يَطُولَ: طَالَ — ṭāla, be long, last; subj. 3 m. sg. after أَنْ; 'that it be long'
إِنَّمَا: innamā, only, merely (إِنَّ + مَا restricting particle)
فِعْلُ: فِعْل — fiʿl, deed, act (m.); nom. in construct; 'the deed of'
الْمَغْلُوبِ: الـ + مَغْلُوب — al-, the + maghlūb, vanquished, beaten (pass. part. of غَلَبَ); gen. in construct; 'the vanquished one'
بِالنِّسْوَانِ: بِـ + الـ + نِسْوَان — bi-, with, in dealing with (prep.; the beaten man's acts 'with' women) + al-, the + niswān, women (pl.); 'with the women'
طَرْفَهُ: طَرْف + هُ — ṭarf, eye, glance (m.); acc., object + -hu, his; 'his eye'
وَأَمْعَنَ: و + أَمْعَنَ — wa-, and + amʿana (IV), go far into; أَمْعَنَ النَّظَرَ 'look intently'; perf. 3 m. sg.; 'and looked intently'
النَّظَرَ: الـ + نَظَر — al-, the + naẓar, looking, gaze (m.); acc.; 'the looking'
الَّتِي: alladhī, who, which (f. sg. relative pronoun) → 'the one who'
الدَّيْرِ: الـ + دَيْر — al-, the + dayr, monastery (m.); gen. after فِي; 'the monastery'
عَرَفَهَا: عَرَفَ + هَا — ʿarafa, know, recognise; perf. 3 m. sg. + -hā, her; 'he recognised her'
السَّيْفَ: الـ + سَيْف — al-, the + sayf, sword; acc.; 'the sword'
وَقَبَّلَ: و + قَبَّلَ — wa-, and + qabbala (II), kiss; perf. 3 m. sg.; 'and kissed'
حَمَلَكِ: حَمَلَ + كِ — ḥamala, carry, impel; perf. 3 m. sg. + -ki, you (f.); مَا حَمَلَكِ عَلَى 'what drove you to'
أَخْتَبِرَكَ: أَخْتَبِرَ + كَ — akhtabira (VIII), test, try; subj. 1st sg. after أَنْ + -ka, you (m.); 'to test you'
ثَبَاتَكَ: ثَبَات + كَ — thabāt, steadfastness (m.); acc., object + -ka, your; 'your steadfastness'
وَالطِّعَانِ: و + الـ + طِعَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭiʿān, thrusting with the lance (vn. of طَاعَنَ); gen.; 'and the thrusting'
كُلُّهُمْ: كُلّ + هُمْ — kull, all (m.); nom. in construct + -hum, them (m. pl.); 'all of them'
جَوَارِيَّ: جَوَارِي + ـيَّ — jawārī, girls, maids (pl. of جَارِيَة) + -ya, my (the yā' of the plural merges with the possessive); 'my girls'
وَكُلُّهُنَّ: و + كُلّ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + kull, all + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'and all of them'
قَهَرْنَ: قَهَرَ — qahara, overpower, conquer; perf. 3 f. pl. -na; 'they overpowered'
فُرْسَانَكَ: فُرْسَان + كَ — fursān, horsemen (pl. of فَارِس); acc., object + -ka, your; 'your horsemen'
حَوْمَةِ: حَوْمَة — ḥawma, thick of battle, press (f.); gen. in construct; 'the thick of'
جَوَادِي: جَوَاد + ـي — jawād, steed (m.); acc. after أَنَّ + -ī, my; 'my steed'
لَكُنْتَ: لَـ + كُنْتَ — la-, would (particle opening the result clause after لَوْلَا) + kunta, you were (كَانَ, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you would have been'
قُوَّتِي: قُوَّة + ـي — quwwa, strength (f.); acc., object + -ī, my; 'my strength'
وَجِلَادِي: و + جِلَاد + ـي — wa-, and + jilād, hardness, toughness (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my toughness'
قَوْلِهَا: قَوْل + هَا — qawl, speech, saying (m.); gen. after a preposition (min; ilā, as in ajābāhā ilā qawlihā, 'consented to her word') + -hā, her; 'her words'
السَّلَامَةِ: الـ + سَلَامَة — al-, the + salāma, safety (f.); gen. after عَلَى; 'the safety'
مَلِكَةَ: مَلِكَة — malika, queen (f.); acc. in construct after يَا (vocative of a construct noun); 'queen of'
الرُّمَّانِ: الـ + رُمَّان — al-, the + rummān, pomegranate (m.); gen. in construct; printed so, evidently a slip for الزَّمَانِ 'the age'
وَأَمَرَتْهُنَّ: و + أَمَرَ + تْ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + amara, command; perf. 3 f. sg. -at + -hunna, them (f.); 'and she commanded them'
يَرَجَّلْنَ: يَرَجَّلْنَ — as printed with shadda; probably for يَتَرَجَّلْنَ, tarajjala (V), dismount; subj. 3 f. pl. after أَنْ; 'that they dismount'
يُطْلِقْنَ: أَطْلَقَ — aṭlaqa (IV), release, set free; subj. 3 f. pl. after أَنْ; 'they release'
كُنَّ: كَانَ — kāna, be; perf. 3 f. pl. -na; 'they had been', helping the following verb: 'they had [captured]'
أَسَرْنَهُمْ: أَسَرَ + نَ + هُمْ — asara, take captive; perf. 3 f. pl. -na + -hum, them (m. pl.); 'they had captured them'
فَامْتَثَلَتِ: فَـ + اِمْتَثَلَتِ — fa-, and so, thereupon + imtathala (VIII), comply with, carry out; perf. 3 f. sg. -at (with kasra before the article); 'and they carried out'
إِنَّهُنَّ: إِنَّ + هُنَّ — inna, indeed (narrative particle, 'then that') + -hunna, they (f. pl.); 'that they'
قَبَّلْنَ: قَبَّلَ — qabbala (II), kiss; perf. 3 f. pl. -na; 'they kissed'
لَهُنَّ: لِـ + هُنَّ — li-, to (prep.; the ones addressed) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'to them'
مِثْلُكُنَّ: مِثْل + كُنَّ — mithl, the like of (m.); nom. + -kunna, you (f. pl.); 'the like of you'
يَكُنَّ: كَانَ — kāna, be; impf. 3 f. pl. -na (agreeing with the girls); 'are'
مُدَّخَرًا: مُدَّخَر — muddakhar, stored up, reserved (VIII pass. part. of ادَّخَرَ); acc. tanwīn, predicate; 'laid up'
لِلشَّدَائِدِ: لِـ + الـ + شَدَائِد — li-, for (prep.; reserved 'for', against) + al-, the + shadāʾid, hardships, calamities (pl. of شَدِيدَة); 'for the hardships'
إِنَّهُ: إِنَّ + هُ — inna, indeed (narrative particle, 'then that') + -hu, he; 'that he'; also: -hu as the pronoun of the matter, 'indeed (it is that) …', pointing ahead to the clause (innahu khāmaranī khilṭun)
أَشَارَ: أَشَارَ — ashāra (IV), signal, gesture (أَشَارَ إِلَى 'signal to'); perf. 3 m. sg.; 'signalled'; ashāra ʿalā, 'to advise'
سَلِّمُوا: سَلَّمَ — sallama (II), greet (سَلَّمَ عَلَى 'greet someone'); imperative m. pl. -ū; 'greet'
فَتَرَجَّلُوا: فَـ + تَرَجَّلُوا — fa-, and so, at once (the dismounting follows the signal) + tarajjala (V), dismount; perf. 3 m. pl. -ū; 'and they dismounted'
وَقَبَّلُوا: و + قَبَّلُوا — wa-, and + qabbala (II), kiss; perf. 3 m. pl. -ū; 'and kissed'
الْقَضِيَّةَ: الـ + قَضِيَّة — al-, the + qaḍiyya, matter, case (f.); acc.; 'the matter'
مِانَتَا: مِائَتَا — miʾatā, two hundred (dual construct of مِائَة, hundred); printed with ن in place of the hamza-seat; 'two hundred'
اللَّيْلِ: الـ + لَيْل — al-, the + layl, night (m.); gen. after فِي; 'the night'
وَالنَّهَارِ: و + الـ + نَهَار — wa-, and + al-, the + nahār, day (m.); gen.; 'and the day'
مُدَّةِ: مُدَّة — udda, period, span (f.); gen. in construct after إِلَى; 'a span of'
سِتَّةِ: سِتَّة — sitta, six (f. form with a m. noun); gen. in construct; 'six'
الدِّيَارِ: الـ + دِيَار — al-, the + diyār, dwellings, homeland (pl. of دَار); gen. after عَلَى; 'the dwellings'
وَجَوَارِيَهَا: و + جَوَارِي + هَا — wa-, and + jawārī, girls, maids (pl. of جَارِيَة); acc. (joined to الْمَلِكَةَ) + -hā, her; 'and her maids'
يَتْزِعْنَ: يَتْزِعْنَ — as printed; evidently a slip (transposed letters) for يَنْزِعْنَ, nazaʿa, take off; subj. 3 f. pl. after أَنْ; 'that they take off'
عَلَيْهِنَّ: عَلَى + هِنَّ — ʿalā, on, upon (prep.) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); 'upon them'
الْإِفْرَنْجِ: الـ + إِفْرَنْج — al-, the + Ifranj, the Franks (collective); gen. in construct; 'the Franks'
وَالْخَمْسُونَ: وَ + الـ + خَمْسُون — wa-, and (conj.) + khamsūn, fifty (m. sound pl. numeral; nom. as printed); 'and the fifty', so 'the fifty-first' Also, after al-rābiʿa, 'the fifty-fourth' (al-laylatu al-rābiʿatu wa-al-khamsūna). Also, after al-khāmisa, 'the fifty-fifth' (al-laylatu al-khāmisatu wa-al-khamsūna). Also, after al-sābiʿa, 'the fifty-seventh' (al-laylatu al-sābiʿatu wa-al-khamsūna). Also, after al-tāsiʿa, 'the fifty-ninth' (al-laylatu al-tāsiʿatu wa-al-khamsūna).
يَنْزِعْنَ: nazaʿa/yanziʿu — to pull off, strip off (verb I, impf. 3fpl., subjunctive after أَنْ, the -na ending staying in both moods); 'that they strip off'
لِبْسَ: libs, dress, mode of dress, wearing (m. verbal noun of labisa; acc. as internal object / manner, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wearing of, the dress of'; also (Night 202): لِبْس — libs, dress, clothing (m.); acc. as the second object of albasa, first term of a construct: albasahu libsa al-tujjāri, 'dressed him in the dress of merchants'
وَفَعَلْنَ: وَ + فَعَلَ + نَ — wa-, and (conj.) + faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3fpl.); 'and they did'
جَمَاعَةً: jamāʿa — group, company, party (f., acc. indef., object of arsala)
إِىَ: إِلَى — ilā, to, toward (prep.), the print omitting the lām; we point the printed letters; 'to'
لِيُعْلِمَ: لِـ + يُعْلِمَ — li-, so that, in order to (purpose particle governing the subjunctive) + yuʿlima, he informs (verb IV of ʿalima, impf. 3ms subjunctive); 'so that he might inform'
وَيُخْبِرَهُ: وَ + يُخْبِرَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yukhbira, to tell, inform (verb IV of khabara, impf. 3ms subjunctive, coordinated with liyuʿlima) + -hu, him; 'and that he tell him'
لِيُرْسِلَ: لِـ + يُرْسِلَ — li-, so that, in order to (purpose particle governing the subjunctive) + yursila, he sends (verb IV, impf. 3ms subjunctive); 'so that he send'
يُلَاقِيهَا: lāqā/yulāqī — to meet (verb III, impf. 3ms, indicative as a relative clause) + -hā, her; 'who meets her'
وَوَقْتِهِمْ: وَ + وَقْت + هِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + waqt, time, moment (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'and their moment'
وَاسْتَقْبَلُوا: وَ + اسْتَقْبَلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + istaqbala, to face, go toward, approach (verb X, perf. 3mp); 'and they faced'
مُلَاقَاةِ: mulāqāh — meeting (f. verbal noun of lāqā, verb III; gen. after ajl, first term of an iḍāfa); 'meeting'
وَشَرْكَانَ: وَ + شَرْكَان — wa-, and (conj.) + Sharkān, personal name (diptote, gen. with fatḥa, joined to the queen); 'and Sharkān'
بِإِشَارَةِ: بِـ + إِشَارَة — bi-, by, at (prep., instrumental: 'at the sign of') + ishāra, sign, signal, order (f. verbal noun of IV ashāra; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'at the order of'
مُلَاقَاتِهِمَا: مُلَاقَاة + هِمَا — mulāqāh, meeting (f. verbal noun of lāqā, verb III; gen. after ilā) + -himā, them both (dual); 'the meeting of them both'
رَكِبَا: rakiba — to ride, mount (verb I, perf. 3md, ending -ā); 'the two mounted'
خِدْ: khid — the first part of the word خِدْمَة (khidma, service), cut off by a space in the print; read with the next piece, 'service'
قَالَتْهُ: قَالَ + تْ + هُ — qāla, to say (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms) + -at, she (subject) + -hu, it (object, referring back to mā); 'she said (it)'
مَمْلَكَتَهَا: مَمْلَكَة + هَا — mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., acc., object of fāraqat) + -hā, her; 'her kingdom'
وَفَارَقَتْ: وَ + فَارَقَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + fāraqa, to leave, part from (verb III, perf. 3fs); 'and she left'
اخْتَارَتِ: ikhtāra — to choose (verb VIII, hollow, perf. 3fs, with linking kasra before al-); 'she chose'
الرَّحِيلَ: الـ + رَحِيل — raḥīl, departure, setting out (m. verbal noun of raḥala; acc., object of ikhtārat); 'the departing'
وَالْقُعُودَ: وَ + الـ + قُعُود — wa-, and (conj.) + quʿūd, sitting, staying (m. verbal noun of qaʿada; acc., coordinated with al-raḥīl); 'and the staying'
بِحِكَايَتِهَا: بِـ + حِكَايَة + هَا — bi-, of (prep.; akhbara bi- 'inform of') + ḥikāya, story, account (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her story'
إِهْدَائِهَا: إِهْدَاء + هَا — ihdāʾ, giving as a gift (m. verbal noun of IV ahdā; gen., the ئ printed in the edition) + -hā, her; 'her being presented'
يَرُدُّهَا: radda/yaruddu — to return, send back (verb I, doubled, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'return her'
خَلَاصُنَا: خَلَاص + نَا — khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m., nom., subject of kāna) + -nā, our; 'our deliverance'
أَشْجَعَ: ashjaʿ — braver, bravest (elative of shujāʿ, brave; acc. diptote, object of raʾaynā); 'braver'
وَالْمُبَارَزَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُبَارَزَة — wa-, and + mubāraza, single combat, duel (f. verbal noun of verb III, gen.); 'and the duelling'
عَظُمَتْ: ʿaẓumat — to be great, grow great (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she grew great (in his eyes)'
طَلَبَهَا: طَلَبَ + هَا — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for, demand (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'he sought her'
يَسْأَلَهَا: يَسْأَلَ + هَا — yasʾala, to ask (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an) + -hā, her; 'that he ask her'
يَدْعُوكِ: يَدْعُو + كِ — yadʿū, to call, summon (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -ki, you (f. sg.); 'he calls you'
وَتَرْجَمَتْ: وَ + تَرْجَمَتْ — wa-, and + tarjama, to expound, speak out, interpret (verb Iq, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she spoke out'
فَصَاحَتِهَا: فَصَاحَة + هَا — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her eloquence'
وَشَكَرَهَا: وَ + شَكَرَ + هَا — wa-, and + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and he thanked her'
قَرَّبَهَا: قَرَّبَ + هَا — qarraba, to bring near (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'he brought her near'
وَأَدْنَاهَا: وَ + أَدْنَى + هَا — wa-, and + adnā, to draw close (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg., defective) + -hā, her; 'and drew her close'
مُخْتَصًّا: mukhtaṣṣ — set apart, specially assigned (passive participle of ikhtaṣṣa, verb VIII, m., acc. indef., adjective of qaṣran; the shadda on ṣ is printed); 'made exclusive'
وَبِجَوَارِيهَا: وَ + بِـ + جَوَارِي + هَا — wa-, and + bi-, for/to (prep.: 'exclusive to') + jawārī, girls, slave-girls (f. broken pl. of jāriya, gen.) + -hā, her; 'and to her girls'
وَلِجَوَارِيهَا: وَ + لِـ + جَوَارِي + هَا — wa-, and + li-, for (prep.) + jawārī, girls (f. broken pl., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and for her girls'
يَسْأَ: yasʾa — to ask (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg.; the printed word is yasʾa(lu), followed by a separate lahā, 'he asks her'); the final letters of the verb are in the next printed word
الْخَرَزَاتِ: الـ + خَرَزَات — kharazāt, beads (f. sound pl. of kharaza, gen.); 'the beads'
ذِكْرُهَا: ذِكْر + هَا — dhikr, mention (m., nom.) + -hā, its/her; 'its mention'; also: 'fame, report': shāʿa fī al-bilādi dhikruhā, 'word of her spread through the lands' (Night 179)
هَاهِيَ: هَا + هِيَ — hā, lo, here (particle) + hiya, she/it (f. pron.); 'here she is, here they are'
مَحَلِّهَا: مَحَلّ + هَا — maḥall, place, lodging (m., gen. after ilā) + -hā, her; 'her place, her quarters' Also with -hā for a non-human plural: ilā maḥallihā, 'to their place' (the goods).
حَوَائِجَهَا: حَوَائِج + هَا — ḥawāʾij, belongings, necessaries (f. broken pl. of ḥāja, acc.) + -hā, her; 'her belongings'
الْعُلْبَةِ: الـ + عُلْبَة — ʿulba, box (f., gen.); 'the box'
حُقًّا: ḥuqq — casket, small box (m., acc. indef.; the shadda is printed); 'a casket'
وَبَاسَتْهَا: وَ + بَاسَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + bāsa, to kiss (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., hollow) + -hā, them (the beads); 'and she kissed them'
وَأَعْطَتْهَا: وَ + أَعْطَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3 f. sg., defective) + -hā, them; 'and she gave them'
انْصِرَافِهَا: انْصِرَاف + هَا — inṣirāf, departing (m. verbal noun of VII, gen.) + -hā, her; 'her departing'
خَرَزَةً: kharaza — bead (f. sing., acc. indef., second object of aʿṭā); 'a bead'
ثَلٰثِ: thalāth — three (f., gen. as first term of an iḍāfa; printed ثلث, with the dagger alif supplied); 'of three' Also (Night 196): ثَلٰث — thalāth, three (gen. after mundhu; first term of the construct with the counted noun; printed ثلٰث with dagger alif); 'three'
فَسَأَلَهُ: فَـ + سَأَلَ + هُ — fa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and he asked him'
الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ: الـ + أُخْرَيَيْنِ — ukhrayayn, other (f. dual oblique of ukhrā, gen., adjective of al-ithnayn; printed with two yā's); 'the other two'
أَعْطَيْتُ: aʿṭaytu — to give (verb IV, perf. 1 sg.); 'I have given'
لِأَخِيكَ: لِـ + أَخ + كَ — li-, to (prep.: marks the one given to) + akh, brother (m., gen., long form akhī- before a suffix) + -ka, your; 'to your brother'
لِنُزْهَةِ: لِـ + نُزْهَة — li-, to (prep.: marks the one given to) + nuzha, delight, pleasure outing (f., gen.; first term of the name Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'to Nuzha'
أُخْتِكَ: أُخْت + كَ — ukht, sister (f., gen., apposition) + -ka, your; 'your sister'
أَلَكَ: أَ + لَكَ — a-, interrogative particle ('is it that') + laka (li-, to/for + -ka, you); 'have you' (the print has الك, hamza unwritten)
وَعُمْرُهُ: وَ + عُمْر + هُ — wa-, and + ʿumr, age, life (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his age'
أَعْلَمَهُ: أَعْلَمَ + هُ — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'he informed him'
اسْمَهُ: اسْم + هُ — ism, name (m., acc. after anna) + -hu, his; 'his name'
وَأَنَّهُمَا: وَ + أَنَّ + هُمَا — wa-, and + anna, that (particle) + -humā, the two of them; 'and that they two'
وُلِدَا: wulidā — to be born (verb I passive, perf. 3 m. dual); 'they were born'
بَطْنٍ: baṭn — belly, womb (m., gen. indef.); 'a belly'
كَتَمَ: katama — to hide, conceal (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he hid'
سِرَّهُ: سِرّ + هُ — sirr, secret, what is hidden (m., acc.; the shadda is printed) + -hu, his; 'his secret'
بَرَكَةِ: baraka — blessing (f., gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the blessing of'; also gen. after another preposition (fī barakati, 'in the blessing of')
وَنَفَضَ: وَ + نَفَضَ — wa-, and + nafaḍa, to shake out (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he shook out'
أَحْوَالُكَ: أَحْوَال + كَ — aḥwāl, states, conditions (m. broken pl. of ḥāl, nom.) + -ka, your; 'your condition'
حَلَّفْتُ: ḥallaftu — to make swear, administer an oath (verb II, perf. 1 sg.); 'I made swear'
وَعَاهَدْتُ: وَ + عَاهَدْتُ — wa-, and + ʿāhada, to make a covenant with (verb III, perf. 1 sg.); 'and I made covenant with'
وَاسْتَحَى: وَ + اسْتَحَى — wa-, and + istaḥā, to be ashamed (verb X, perf. 3 m. sg., from ḥayiya/ḥayā); 'and he was ashamed'
يُكَافِحَ: yukāfiḥa — to confront face to face (verb III, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'confront'
وَشَكَرَتْهُ: وَ + شَكَرَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she thanked him'
فِعَالِهِ: فِعَال + ـِهِ — fiʿāl, deeds, actions (m., gen. after ʿalā; a plural form of fiʿl) + -hi, his; 'his deeds'
وَدَعَتْ: وَ + دَعَتْ — wa-, and + daʿat, to pray, invoke (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., from daʿā); 'and she prayed (for him)'
وَأَوَالِدِهِ: وَ + أَوَالِد + هِ — wa-, and + awālid, printed for أَوْلَاد awlād, children, with the lām and alif transposed (see the note) (gen., after li- understood) + -hi, his; 'and his children (sons)'
فَسَأَلَتْهُ: فَـ + سَأَلَ + تْ + هُ — fa-, and so + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; the edition's أ) + -hu, him; 'and she asked him'
فَأَخْبَرَهَا: فَـ + أَخْبَرَ + هَا — fa-, and so + akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and he informed her'
وَأُنْثَى: وَ + أُنْثَى — wa-, and + unthā, a female (f. indef. acc., diptote); 'and a female'
وَسَمَّى: وَ + سَمَّى — wa-, and + sammā, to name (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he named'
وَالْأُنْثَى: وَ + الـ + أُنْثَى — wa-, and + al-, the + unthā, female (f., acc., object of sammā); 'and the girl'
فَتَرَكْتُهَا: فَـ + تَرَكْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so + taraka, to leave, let be (verb I, perf. 1 c. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'and I left it'
إِلَّافِي: إِلَّا + فِي — illā, except + fī, in, at (prep.), printed as one word; 'except at'
الْغَيْظُ: الـ + غَيْظ — ghayẓ, rage (m., nom., subject of a verb such as akhadha or ishtadda); 'the rage'
أَخْبَرْتُكِ: أَخْبَرْتُ + كِ — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1 c. sg.) + -ki, you (f. object); 'I informed you'
أُخْفِ: ukhfi — to hide, conceal (verb IV, jussive 1 c. sg. after lam, from akhfā)
يَتَزَوَّجَ: yatazawwaja — to marry (verb V, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'he marry'
الطَّمَعِ: الـ + طَمَع + ِ — ṭamaʿ, covetousness, desire (m. verbal noun, gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'of desire'
تَقُولِينَ: taqūlīna — to say (verb I hollow, impf. 2 f. sg.); 'you say'
يَأْخُذَنِي: yaʾkhudhanī — to take (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ) + -nī, me; 'he take me'
يَأْخُذُنِي: yaʾkhudhunī — to take (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he takes me'
بَالِي: بَال + ي — bāl, mind, heed (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; ʿalā bālī 'on my mind'
يُنْعِمَ: yunʿima — to bestow favour (verb IV, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ), with ʿalā 'upon' (prep. of the favoured person); 'he bestow favour'
طَنَنْتُ: ṭanantu — printed for ظَنَنْتُ ẓanantu, to suppose, think (verb I, perf. 1 c. sg.), with ط for ظ; 'I supposed'
يَجْعَلُهَا: yajʿaluhā — to put, make (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them (f. object); 'he put them'
خَزَائِنِهِ: خَزَائِن + هِ — khazāʾin, treasuries, storehouses (pl. of khizāna, gen. after fī; the edition prints the ئ) + -hi, his; 'his treasuries'
ذَخَائِرِهِ: ذَخَائِر + هِ — dhakhāʾir, stores, hoards (pl. of dhakhīra, gen. after maʿa; the edition prints the ئ) + -hi, his; 'his stores'
تَهَبَنِي: tahabanī — to give, grant (verb I, impf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ, from wahaba) + -nī, me; 'you give me'
أَعْطَاهَا: أَعْطَى + هَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'he gave it'
قَبِلْتَهَا: قَبِلْتَ + هَا — qabila, to accept (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.); 'you accepted it'
وَتَحَدَّثَتْ: وَ + تَحَدَّثَتْ — wa-, and + taḥaddathat, to converse (verb V, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she conversed'
يَسْمَعَ: yasmaʿa — to hear (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'he hear'
وَيَسْعَى: وَ + يَسْعَى — wa-, and + yasʿā, to strive, run (verb I, impf. 3 m. sg., from saʿā); 'and he strives'
طَلَبِي: طَلَب + ي — ṭalab, seeking (m. verbal noun, gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my seeking (of me)'
وَيَتَّفِقُ: وَ + يَتَّفِقُ — wa-, and + yattafiqu, to agree, concur (verb VIII, impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he agrees'
فَيَأْتِيَانِ: فَـ + يَأْتِيَانِ — fa-, and so + yaʾtiyāni, to come (verb I, impf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two come'
ضَجَّةٌ: ḍajjatun — clamour, uproar (f., nom. indef., subject of takūnu); 'an uproar'
رَاضِيَةً: rāḍiyatan — content, satisfied (act. part. of raḍiya, f., acc. indef., predicate of kunti); 'content'
لَاتُفَكِّرِي: لَا + تُفَكِّرِي — lā, not (neg. particle, prohibitive) + tufakkirī, to think, reflect (verb II, jussive 2 f. sg.), printed as one word; 'do not think'
وَالْبَحْرِ: وَ + الـ + بَحْر + ِ — wa-, and + al-, the + baḥr, sea (m., gen.); 'and the sea'
أَحْسَنْتُمْ: أَحْسَنْتُمْ — aḥsana, to do well, treat well (verb IV, perf. 2 m. pl.); 'you treated well'
قَعَدْتُ: qaʿadtu — to sit, stay (verb I, perf. 1 c. sg.); 'I stayed'
أَسَأْنُمْ: asaʾnum — printed for أَسَأْتُمْ asaʾtum, to do ill (verb IV, perf. 2 m. pl.), with ن for ت; 'you did ill'
رَحَلْتُ: raḥaltu — to depart, journey away (verb I, perf. 1 c. sg.); 'I departed'
فَقُدِّمَتِ: فَـ + قُدِّمَتِ — fa-, and so + quddimat, to present, set before (verb II passive, perf. 3 f. sg.; kasra before al-); 'and was presented'
الْمَائِدَةُ: الـ + مَائِدَة — māʾida, table, food-tray (f., nom., subject; the edition's ئ); 'the table'
مَغْمُومًا: maghmūman — grieved, sorrowful (pass. part. of ghamma, m., acc. indef.; circumstantial state, rhyming with mahmūm); 'grieved'
الْخَرَزَتَيْنِ: الـ + خَرَزَتَيْن + ِ — kharaza, bead (f.), dual -atayni; 'the two beads'
قَائِمَهْ: qāʾimah — standing (act. part. of qāma, f.; the edition prints final ه for ة), acc. state; 'standing'
وَنُزْهَةُ: وَ + نُزْهَةُ — wa-, and + nuzha, delight (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa; part of the name Nuzhat al-Zamān)
رَأَهُمَا: raʾa-humā — to see (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., from raʾā; hamza printed by the edition without madda) + -humā, the two of them; 'he saw them'
قَبَّلَهُمَا: قَبَّلَ + هُمَا — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -humā, the two of them; 'he kissed them'
فَفَرِحَا: فَـ + فَرِحَا — fa-, and so + fariḥā, to rejoice (verb I, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two rejoiced'
وَقَبَّلَا: وَ + قَبَّلَا — wa-, and + qabbalā, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two kissed'
وَأَقْبَلَا: وَ + أَقْبَلَا — wa-, and + aqbalā, to turn toward (verb IV, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two turned'
أُمِّهِمَا: أُمّ + هِمَا — umm, mother (f., gen. after ʿalā) + -himā, their (dual); 'their mother'
الدَّوَامِ: الـ + دَوَام + ِ — dawām, continuance, permanence (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'the continuance'
تُعْلِمِينِي: تُعْلِمِينِي — a-ʿlama, to inform (verb IV, impf. 2 f. sg., jussive after lam, with the final nūn retained in the print) + -nī, me; 'you inform me'
أَزِيدَ: azīda — to add, increase (verb I, impf. 1 c. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'I add'
إِكْرَامِكِ: إِكْرَام + كِ — ikrām, honouring, honour (m. verbal noun of IV, gen. after fī) + -ki, your (f.); 'your honouring'
وَأُوَسِّعَ: وَ + أُوَسِّعَ — wa-, and + uwassiʿa, to widen, make ample (verb II, impf. 1 c. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'and I widen'
وَأَرْفَعَ: وَ + أَرْفَعَ — wa-, and + arfaʿa, to raise (verb I, impf. 1 c. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'and I raise'
مَنْزِلَتَكِ: مَنْزِلَة + كِ — manzila, station, rank (f., acc. object) + -ki, your (f.); 'your station'
وَأَعْلَا: وَ + أَعْلَا — wa-, and + aʿlā, higher (elative of ʿālin; printed with alif for ى, acc.); 'and higher'
الْمَنْزِلَةِ: الـ + مَنْزِلَة — manzila, station, rank (f., gen. after min); 'the station'
مَغْمُورَةٌ: maghmūra, submerged, overwhelmed (pass. part. of ghamara, to flood; f., nom. indef.)
بِإِنْعَامِكَ: بِـ + إِنْعَام + كَ — bi-, in, with (prep., here marking what one is submerged in) + inʿām, bestowal of favour (m. verbal noun IV, gen.) + ka, 'your'; 'in your bestowal of favours'
وَخَيْرِكَ: وَ + خَيْر + كَ — wa-, and + khayr, goodness, bounty (m., gen., coordinated with the preceding بِ-phrase) + ka, 'your'; 'and your goodness'
بِوَلَدَيْنِ: بِـ + وَلَدَيْنِ — bi-, with (prep.; the verb razaqa takes the gift with bi-) + walad, child (m. dual, gen.); 'with two children'
فَأَعْجَبَ: فَـ + أَعْجَبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿjaba, to please (form IV perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and so it pleased'
وَلِأَوْلَادِهَا: وَ + لِـ + أَوْلَاد + هَا — wa-, and + li-, for (prep.) + awlād, children (pl. of walad, gen.) + hā, 'her'; 'and for her children'
الْخَدَمَ: الـ + خَدَم — khadam, servants (coll. pl., acc.); 'the servants'
وَالْحَشَمَ: وَ + الـ + حَشَم — wa-, and + ḥashām, retinue, household attendants (coll., acc.); 'and the retinue'
وَالْفُقَهَاءَ: وَ + الـ + فُقَهَاء — wa-, and + fuqahāʾ, jurists, men of religious law (pl. of faqīh, acc.); 'and the jurists'
وَالْفَلَكِيَّةَ: وَ + الـ + فَلَكِيَّة — wa-, and + falakiyya, astronomers, astrologers (collective, from falak, sphere; acc.); 'and the astronomers'
وَالْأَطِبَّاءَ: وَ + الـ + أَطِبَّاء — wa-, and + aṭibbāʾ, physicians (pl. of ṭabīb, acc.); 'and the physicians'
وَالْجِرَا: وَ + الـ + جِرَا — wa-, and + first piece of the word printed in two parts, والجرا يحية; read by sense as al-jarrāḥiyya, 'the surgeons' (jarrāḥ, one who cuts wounds); 'and the surgeons' with the next piece
يْحِيَّةَ: second piece of والجرا يحية, with a stray ي; together with وَالْجِرَا, 'and the surgeons' (acc.)
وَالْمُحَاكَمَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُحَاكَمَة — wa-, and + muḥākama, judging, adjudication (f. verbal noun III, gen., coordinated with al-mamlaka); 'and the adjudication'
الْمَلِكَهِ: الـ + مَلِكَه — malika, queen (f.; printed with final ه for ة; gen.); 'the queen'
مَشْغُوفًا: mashghūf, smitten to the heart with love (pass. part. of shaghafa, acc. as predicate of ṣāra)
وَيَتَحَدَّثُ: وَ + يَتَحَدَّثُ — wa-, and + taḥaddatha, to converse (form V imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he converses'
وَيُلَوِّحُ: وَ + يُلَوِّحُ — wa-, and + lawwaḥa, to signal, hint (form II imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he hints'
غَرَضٌ: gharaḍ, purpose, desire, need (m., nom. indef.; the subject of the possession sentence); here: subject of yatimmu: lā yatimmu gharaḍun, 'no aim is achieved'
تَمَنُّعَهَا: tamannuʿ, refusing oneself, holding back (m. verbal noun V, acc., object of raʾā) + hā, 'her'; 'her holding-herself-back'
أَعْيَاهُ: aʿyā, to weary, baffle (form IV perf. 3 m. sg.) + hu, 'him'; 'it wearied him'
مَحَبَّةِ: maḥabba, love (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'love of'
ابْنَةِ: ibna, daughter (f., gen., apposition; alif of connection)
يَنَلْ: nāla, to obtain (imperf. 3 m. sg., jussive after lam, shortened); 'he obtain'
فَأَعْطِهَا: فَـ + أَعْطِ + هَا — fa-, then + aʿṭi, give (imperative IV) + hā, 'her'; 'then give her'
الْأَخِيرَ: الـ + أَخِير — akhīr, last (adj., acc.); 'the last'
وَاسْقِيهِ: وَ + اِسْقِ + يهِ — wa-, and + isqi, give to drink (imperative of saqā; printed with a lengthened yā') + hi, 'it'; 'and give it to drink'
فَتَدْخُلُ: فَـ + تَدْخُلُ — fa-, then + dakhala, to enter (imperf. 2 m. sg., ind.); 'then you enter'
وَتَتَّصِلُ: وَ + تَتَّصِلُ — wa-, and + ittaṣala, to join, be in contact (form VIII imperf. 2 m. sg., ind.); 'and you join'
وَتَبْلُغُ: وَ + تَبْلُغُ — wa-, and + balagha, to reach, attain (imperf. 2 m. sg., ind.); 'and you attain'
غَرَضَكَ: gharaḍ, purpose, desire (m., acc., object) + ka, 'your'; 'your purpose'
الرَّأْيِ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, plan, counsel (m., gen. after a preposition such as min or ʿalā, in apposition to hādhā); 'the opinion'
أَشَرْتَ: ashāra, to indicate, advise (form IV perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you advised' Also with ʿalā and bi-, 'to advise someone (ʿalā) of something (bi-)': asharta ʿalayya bi-mā asharta, 'you gave me the advice you gave'.
مُكَرَّرٍ: mukarrar, repeated, refined (pass. part. form II of karrara, gen. indef., qualifying banj); 'refined'
وَجَعَلَهَا: وَ + جَعَلَ + هَا — wa-, and + jaʿala, to put (perf. 3 m. sg.) + hā, 'it' (f., the piece); 'and he put it' Also of a candle (shamʿa, f.): wa-jaʿalahā fī shamʿadānin, 'and set it in a candlestick'.
السَّرَاوِيلَ: الـ + سَرَاوِيل — sarāwīl, trousers, drawers (f. or m. collective, acc., diptote); object of قَلَعَتْ
النَّقْلِ: الـ + نَقْل — naql, nibbles, dessert-nuts served with wine (m., gen.); 'the nibbles'
الْأَشْرِبَةَ: الـ + أَشْرِبَة — ashriba, drinks, cordials (pl. of شَرَاب, acc.); object of أَرْسَلَ
الْبَنْجِ: الـ + بَنْج — banj, the drug, narcotic (m., gen., from Persian); in construct: 'of the banj'
الْحَمْلِ: الـ + حَمْل — ḥaml, pregnancy, carrying (m., gen.); 'of the pregnancy'
الْكَأْسِ: الـ + كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (f., gen.); after فِي: 'in the cup' (the edition prints it without hamza)
امْنَعُوا: امْنَعْ + ـُوا — imnaʿ, prevent, keep out (Form I imperative, wasl alif) + 2mp ending; 'prevent!' (said to the maids)
اُمْسُكْ: اُمْسُكْ — umsuk, hold, take hold (Form I imperative of مَسَكَ, with the printed damma)
أَبْرِبَرَةَ: أَبْرِبَرَة — Abrībara, misprint for Abrīza (queen's name, f., acc., diptote); object-clause subject after أَنَّ
أَبْرِيزَه: أَبْرِيزَة — Abrīza (queen's name), printed with final hāʾ for tāʾ marbūṭa (Middle Arabic spelling); in apposition after لِلْمَلِكَةِ
أَشْهُرُ: أَشْهُر — ashhur, months (pl. of شَهْر, nom.); in construct: 'the months of'
أَصَابِعِهِ: أَصَابِع + ـهِ — aṣābiʿ, fingers (pl. of إِصْبَع, gen. after بَيْنَ) + 3ms suffix; 'his fingers'
أَمْرُهَا: أَمْر + ـهَا — amr, matter, affair (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her affair'
إِدْرَاكَهَا: إِدْرَاك + ـهَا — idrāk, perception, awareness (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; object of سَلَبَ: 'her perception'
بَاطِنِهَا: بَاطِن + ـهَا — bāṭin, inside, belly (m., gen. after مِنْ) + 3fs suffix; 'her inside'
بَرَدَتْ: بَرَدَتْ — baradat, it grew cold (Form I perfect, 3fs, with نَارُهُ) from بَرَدَ; 'it cooled'
بَطْنُهَا: بَطْن + ـهَا — baṭn, belly (f. here, nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her belly'
تَمَالَكَ: تَمَالَكَ — tamālaka, he held, controlled (Form VI perfect, 3ms) from مَلَكَ; with نَفْسَهُ 'hold himself'
حِيلَ: حِيلَ — ḥīla, it was come between (Form I passive perfect, 3ms) from حَالَ; with بَيْنَ 'a barrier was set between'
حِيلَنُهُ: حِيلَة + ـهُ — ḥīla, ruse, trick (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his ruse'; the print has ن for ت (misprint for حِيلَتُهُ)
دَمَهَا: دَم + ـهَا — dam, blood (m., acc.) + 3fs suffix; object of وَجَدَتْ: 'her blood'
سَرَاوِيلَهُ: سَرَاوِيل + ـهُ — sarāwīl, trousers, drawers (acc., diptote) + 3ms suffix; 'his trousers'
سَيِّدَتِكِ: سَيِّدَة + ـكِ — sayyida, mistress, lady (f., gen. after عَلَى) + 2fs suffix; 'your mistress' Also gen. as second term of an iḍāfa: ḥālu sayyidatiki, 'how your mistress is'.
سِيقَانِهَا: سِيقَان + ـهَا — sīqān, legs (pl. of سَاق, gen. after عَلَى) + 3fs suffix; 'her legs'
شَأْنَ: شَأْن — shaʾn, matter, condition (m., acc.); object of أَصْلَحَتْ, in construct: 'the state of'
شَوْقُهُ: شَوْق + ـهُ — shawq, longing, desire (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his longing'
شُهُورًا: شُهُور — shuhūr, months (pl. of شَهْر, acc. indef.); 'for months' (duration)
عَطَسَتِ: عَطَسَتْ — ʿaṭasat, she sneezed (Form I perfect, 3fs) from عَطَسَ; the sukūn becomes kasra before the wasl alif of الْمَلِكَةُ
عَقْلِهِ: عَقْل + ـهِ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., gen. after بَيْنَ) + 3ms suffix; 'his mind'; here also gen. after fī: mā jarā fī ʿaqlihi, 'what has come over his mind'
فَاغْتَمَّتْ: فَـ + اغْتَمَّتْ — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + ightammat, she grieved (Form VIII perfect, 3fs) from غَمَّ; 'and so she grieved'
فَأَخَذَتْهُ: فَـ + أَخَذَتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + akhadat, she took (Form I perfect, 3fs) + 3ms object; 'and she took it'
فَأَزَالَ: فَـ + أَزَالَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + azāla, he removed (Form IV perfect, 3ms) from زَالَ; 'and he removed'
فَأَعَادَتْ: فَـ + أَعَادَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿādat, she repeated (Form IV perfect, 3fs) from عَادَ; 'and she repeated'
فَخِذَيْهَا: فَخِذ + ـَيْ + ـهَا — fakhidh, thigh (f., dual gen. in construct after بَيْنَ) + 3fs suffix; 'her two thighs'
فَمَدَّتْ: فَـ + مَدَّتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + maddat, she stretched (Form I perfect, 3fs) from مَدَّ; 'and she stretched out'
فَمَهَا: فَم + ـهَا — fam, mouth (m., acc.; the stem fam- returns before a suffix when not in the long form) + 3fs suffix; 'her mouth'
قَلَعَتِ: قَلَعَتْ — qalaʿat, she pulled off, took off (Form I perfect, 3fs); sukūn becomes kasra before wasl alif of السَّرَاوِيلَ
كَالْقُرْصِ: كَـ + الـ + قُرْص — ka-, like, as (prep.) + al- + qurṣ, disc, round cake (m., gen.); 'like the disc'
كَأْسًابِيَدِهِ: كَأْسًا + بِـ + يَد + ـهِ — kaʾs, cup (f., acc. indef.) + bi-, with (prep.) + yad, hand (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; printed run together: 'a cup with his hand'
كَلِّمِيهَا: كَلِّمْ + ـِي + ـهَا — kallim, speak to (Form II imperative) from كَلَمَ + ـī 2fs ending + 3fs object; 'speak to her'
لِجَوَارِيهَا: لِـ + جَوَارِي + ـهَا — li-, to (prep.; قَالَ لِـ 'say to') + jawārī, maids (gen., defective) + 3fs suffix; 'to her maids'
لِلْمَلِكَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مَلِكَة — li-, to (prep.; قَالَ لِـ 'say to') + al- + malika, queen (gen.); 'to the queen'
لِمَرْجَانَةَ: لِـ + مَرْجَانَة — li-, to (prep.; قَالَ لِـ 'say to') + Marjāna, proper name (f., gen., diptote); 'to Marjāna'
مَحْجُوبَةٌ: مَحْجُوبَة — maḥjūba, veiled, shut away (f. nom. indef., passive participle of حَجَبَ); circumstantial: 'veiled, in seclusion'
مَنَادِيلِهَا: مَنَادِيل + ـهَا — manādīl, handkerchiefs (pl. of مِنْدِيل, gen.) + 3fs suffix; 'her handkerchiefs'
مُلْقَاةً: مُلْقَاة — mulqāt, thrown down, lying (f. acc. indef., passive participle of Form IV أَلْقَى); circumstantial accusative: 'lying'
مُلْقَاةٌ: مُلْقَاة — mulqāt, thrown down, lying (f. nom. indef., passive participle of Form IV أَلْقَى); circumstantial after وَهِيَ: 'lying'
نَارُهُ: نَار + ـهُ — nār, fire (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fire'
وَالسُّكَّرَ: وَ + الـ + سُكَّر — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + sukkar, sugar (m., acc.); 'and the sugar'
وَالْحَلَاوَاتِ: وَ + الـ + حَلَاوَات — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + ḥalāwāt, sweetmeats (pl. of حَلَاوَة, gen.); 'and the sweetmeats'
وَالْمَعَاجِينَ: وَ + الـ + مَعَاجِين — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + maʿājīn, electuaries (pl. of مَعْجُون, acc.); 'and the electuaries'
وَانْطَفَأَ: وَ + انْطَفَأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + inṭafaʾa, it went out (Form VII perfect, 3ms) from طَفِئَ; 'and it went out'
وَأَسْقَطَ: وَ + أَسْقَطَ — wa-, and (conj.) + asqaṭa, he dropped (Form IV perfect, 3ms) from سَقَطَ; 'and he dropped'
وَبَاتَتْ: وَ + بَاتَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + bātat, she spent the night (Form I perfect, 3fs) from بَاتَ; 'and she stayed the night'
وَتَثَاوَبَتْ: وَ + تَثَاوَبَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tathāwabat, she yawned (Form VI perfect, 3fs) from ثَاءَبَ; 'and she yawned'
وَتَقَايَتْ: وَ + تَقَايَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taqāyat, she vomited (Form VI perfect, 3fs, printed without the final hamza) from قَيَّأَ; 'and she vomited'
وَحَجَبَتْ: وَ + حَجَبَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥajabat, she veiled (Form I perfect, 3fs) from حَجَبَ; 'and she veiled'
وَرِجْلَيْهَا: وَ + رِجْل + ـَيْ + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + rijl, foot (dual acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'and her two feet'
وَصَفَّتْ: وَ + صَفَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣaffat, she lined up, arranged (Form II perfect, 3fs) from صَفَّ; 'and she arranged'
وَكَبُرَتْ: وَ + كَبُرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + kaburat, it grew big (Form I perfect, 3fs) from كَبُرَ; 'and it grew large'
وَمَلَاً: وَ + مَلَأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + malaʾa, he filled (Form I perfect, 3ms) from مَلَأَ; the printed tanwin on the alif belongs to the following noun
وَمَلَأَهُ: وَ + مَلَأَ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + malaʾa, he filled (Form I perfect, 3ms) + 3ms object (the cup); 'and he filled it'
وَوَاصَلَهَا: وَ + وَاصَلَ + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + wāṣala, he joined, had union with (Form III perfect, 3ms) from وَصَلَ + 3fs object; 'and joined her'
وَوَسْوَسَ: وَ + وَسْوَسَ — wa-, and (conj.) + waswasa, he whispered (Form I quadriliteral perfect, 3ms) from وَسْوَسَ; 'and he whispered'
وَيَدَيْهَا: وَ + يَد + ـَيْ + ـهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yad, hand (f., dual acc./gen.) + 3fs suffix; 'and her two hands'
يُنَادِمُهَا: يُنَادِمُ + ـهَا — yunādimu, he keeps company in wine (Form III imperfect, 3ms) from نَدِمَ + 3fs object; 'carousing with her'
وَضَاقَتِ: و + ضَاقَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍāqa, to be or grow narrow (I, 3 f. sg. perfect; the final kasra is the helping vowel before al-); 'and ... grew narrow'
لِجَارِيَتِهَا: لِـ + جَارِيَة + هَا — li-, to (prep.) + jāriya, girl, maid (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'to her maid'
مَرْجَانَةَ: Marjāna, a woman's name (f., acc., diptote; in apposition to جَارِيَتِهَا, which governs it as genitive but the name is diptote)
أعْلَمِي: iʿlamī — ʿalima, to know (I, imperative f. sg.); 'know!'
ظَلَمُونِي: ظَلَمُوا + نِي — ẓalama, to wrong (I, 3 m. pl. perfect) + -nī, me; 'they wronged me'
وَإنَّمَا: و + إِنَّمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + innamā, only, but (restrictive particle: inna + mā)
الْجَانِيَةُ: الـ + جَانِيَة — jāniya, wrong-doer, offender (f., active participle of جَنَى; nom. predicate); 'the offender'
أبِي: أَب + ي — ab, father (m., gen., one of the 'five nouns': abī, my father)
وَأمِّى: و + أُمّ + ى — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., gen.) + -ī, my (the print writes the final yā' as ى); 'and my mother'
وَمَمْلَكَتِى: و + مَمْلَكَة + ى — wa-, and + mamlaka, kingdom (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my kingdom'
الْحَيَاةَ: الـ + حَيَاة — ḥayāh, life (f., acc.); 'the life, life'
هِمَّتِى: هِمَّة + ى — himma, resolve, spirit, ambition (f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my resolve'
عِنْدِى: عِنْد + ى — ʿinda, at, with, in the possession of (prep.) + -ī, me; 'with me'
الْهِمَّةِ: الـ + هِمَّة — himma, resolve (f., gen. after min); 'the resolve'
الْقُوَّةِ: الـ + قُوَّة — quwwa, strength (f., gen. after min); 'the strength'
أقْدِرُ: aqdiru — qadira (ʿalā), to be able (to), have mastery of (I, 1 sg. imperfect); 'I am able'
الرُّكُوبِ: الـ + رُّكُوب — rukūb, riding (verbal noun of رَكِبَ; gen. after ʿalā); 'the riding'
وَإنِّي: و + إِنَّ + ي — wa-, and + inna, indeed (particle) + -ī, me; 'and indeed I'
وَلَدْتُ: وَلَدَ + تُ — walada, to give birth, bear (I, 1 sg. perfect); 'I give birth'
مُعَيَّرَةً: muʿayyara — one reproached, taunted (f., passive participle of II عَيَّرَ; acc. as second predicate of ṣāra); 'a reproached one'
أخَذَ: akhadha — to take (I, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'he took'
سِفَاحًا: sifāḥ — fornication, unlawful intercourse (m., acc. tanwīn, adverbial of manner); 'in fornication, unlawfully'
لِأبِي: لِـ + أَب + ي — li-, to (prep.; with رَجَعَ, 'to') + ab, father (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'to my father'
بِأَيِّ: بِـ + أَيّ — bi-, with (prep.; here 'with what', governing a question word) + ayy, which, what (m., gen. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'with what ...' (the print writes أ)
ألْقَاهُ: alqā + -hu — laqiya, to meet (I, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative) + -hu, him; 'I meet him'
وَبِأَيِّ: و + بِـ + أَيّ — wa-, and + bi-, with (prep.) + ayy, which, what (m., gen.); 'and with what'
أرْجِعُ: arjiʿu — rajaʿa, to return (I, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative); 'I return'
أحْسَنَ: aḥsana — how good! (exclamatory afʿala form of ḥasuna, with mā: mā aḥsana); 'how excellent'
بِمَ: بِـ + مَ — bi-, with, by (prep.) + ma, what? (mā with its alif dropped after a preposition); 'by what?'
التَّعَلُّلُ: الـ + تَّعَلُّل — taʿallul, diversion, solace (m., verbal noun of V تَعَلَّلَ; nom.); 'the diversion'
اَهْلٌ: ahl — family, kin (m., nom. tanwīn; verse, as printed, with fatḥa on the alif)
وَطَنُ: waṭan — homeland (m., nom., pointed without tanwīn for the rhyme; as printed)
نَدِيمَ: nadīm — boon-companion (m., acc. with no tanwīn after lā of absolute negation; as printed)
سَكَنُ: sakan — dwelling, place of rest (m., nom., pointed without tanwīn for the rhyme; as printed)
الْأمْرُ: الـ + أَمْر — amr, command, matter (m., nom.); 'the command'
أمْرُكِ: أَمْر + كِ — amr, command (m., nom.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your command'
طَوْعِكِ: طَوْع + كِ — ṭawʿ, willing obedience (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your will'
أرِيدُ: urīdu — arāda, to want, wish (IV, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative); 'I want'
أخْرُجَ: akhruja — kharaja, to go out (I, 1 sg. subjunctive after an); 'that I go out'
غَيْرُكِ: غَيْر + كِ — ghayr, other than (m., nom., in apposition to aḥad) + -ki, you (f.); 'other than you'
وَأسَافِرَ: و + أُسَافِرَ — wa-, and + usāfiru, sāfara, to travel (III, 1 sg. subjunctive, parallel to akhruja); 'and (that) I travel'
فَإنَّ: فَـ + إِنَّ — fa-, for, so (conj.) + inna, indeed (particle governing the accusative)
أنْتَنَ: antana — to stink, rot (IV, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'it has spoiled'
أهْلُهُ: أَهْل + هُ — ahl, family, kin (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its own people'
تَفْعَلِينَ: tafʿalīna — faʿala, to do (I, 2 f. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'you (f.) do'
أيَّتُهَا: ayyuhā — O (vocative support-word, f. ayyatuhā; takes the article of the following noun)
جَهَّزَتْ: jahhazat — jahhaza, to prepare, equip (II, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'she made ready'
أحْوَالَهَا: أَحْوَال + هَا — aḥwāl, circumstances, affairs (m. broken pl. of حَال, acc.) + -hā, her; 'her affairs'
وَكَتَمَتْ: و + كَتَمَتْ — wa-, and + katama, to conceal (I, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she hid'
وَصَبَرَتْ: و + صَبَرَتْ — wa-, and + ṣabara, to be patient, wait (I, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she waited'
أيَّا: ayyā — first part of أيَّا مَا, printed split; for ayyāman, 'days' (m. pl. of يَوْم); the break is a print slip
الْقِلَاعِ: الـ + قِلَاع — qilāʿ, fortresses (m. broken pl. of قَلْعَة, gen. after ilā); 'the fortresses'
لِيُقِيمَ: لِـ + يُقِيمَ — li-, in order that (particle governing the subjunctive) + yuqīma, aqāma, to stay, dwell (IV, 3 m. sg. subjunctive); 'so that he stay'
فَأقْبَلَتْ: فَـ + أَقْبَلَتْ — fa-, and so + aqbala (ʿalā), to turn toward (IV, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she turned'
أبْرِيزَةُ: Abrīza, the queen's name (f., nom., diptote)
أرِيدُأنْ: أرِيدُ + أنْ — urīdu, I want (arāda, IV, 1 sg. imperfect) + an, that (particle governing the subjunctive); printed as one word, 'I want that'
أسَافِرَ: usāfira — sāfara, to travel (III, 1 sg. subjunctive after an); 'that I travel'
هَذِ: hādhi — this (f.; the print shortens هَذِهِ)
أصْنَعُ: aṣnaʿu — ṣanaʿa, to make, do (I, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative); 'shall I do'
الْمَقَادِيرِ: الـ + مَقَادِير — maqādīr, decrees, things decreed (m. broken pl. of مِقْدَار, gen.); 'the decrees'
بِالطَّلْقِ: بِـ + الـ + طَّلْق — bi-, (feel) with, of (prep.; ḥasaytu bi- 'feel something') + al-, the + ṭalq, labour pains (m., gen.); 'the labour-pains'
وَالْوِلَادَةِ: و + الـ + وِلَادَة — wa-, and + al-, the + wilāda, giving birth (f., gen.); 'and the birth'
أيَّامٍ: ayyām — days (m. broken pl. of يَوْم, gen. tanwīn); 'days'
أرْبَعَةً: arbaʿa — four (f. form, acc. tanwīn; the counted noun is understood); 'four'
وَضَعْتُ: waḍaʿtu — waḍaʿa, to put down; of a woman, to give birth (I, 1 sg. perfect); 'I will give birth'
أقْدِرْ: aqdir — qadira, to be able (I, 1 sg. jussive after lam); 'I am (not) able'
أرُوحَ: arūḥa — rāḥa, to go, set out (I, 1 sg. subjunctive after an, here with a direct object); 'to go'
تَفَكَّرَتْ: tafakkarat — tafakkara, to reflect, think (V, 3 f. sg. perfect); 'she reflected'
أنْظُرِي: unẓurī — naẓara, to look (I, imperative f. sg.); 'look for!'
وَإيَّاهُ: و + إِيَّا + هُ — wa-, and, with (conj. 'together with') + iyyā-, carrier of the object suffix + -hu, him; 'and him'
وَيَخْدِمُنَا: و + يَخْدِمُ + نَا — wa-, and + yakhdimu, khadama, to serve (I, 3 m. sg. imperfect) + -nā, us; 'and he serves us'
أعْرِفُ: aʿrifu — ʿarafa, to know, be acquainted with (I, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative); 'I know'
أسْوَدَ: aswad — black (m., gen. diptote, adjective of ʿabd)
أسْمُهُ: اِسْم + هُ — ism, name (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his name'
الْغَضْبَانُ: الـ + غَضْبَان — Ghaḍbān, a name from ghaḍbān, angry (m., nom.); 'al-Ghaḍbān'
وَهُمُو: و + هُمُو — wa-, and + humū, they (the old long form of hum; here evidently standing for 'he', or a misprint for huwa); 'and he'
مُلَازِمٌ: mulāzim — one attached, constantly present at (m., active participle of III lāzama; nom. tanwīn); 'constant'
لِبَابِ: لِـ + بَاب — li-, to, at (prep.; of attachment, 'attached to') + bāb, door, gate (m., gen.); 'to the door of'
وَأمَرَهُ: و + أَمَرَ + هُ — wa-, and + amara, to command (I, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and he commanded him'
يَخْدِمَنَا: yakhdimanā — khadama, to serve (I, 3 m. sg. subjunctive after an) + -nā, us; 'that he serve us'
غَمَرْنَاهُ: غَمَرَ + نَا + هُ — ghamara, to flood, overwhelm (I, 1 pl. perfect) + -hu, him; 'we have flooded him'
بِإحْسَانِنَا: بِـ + إِحْسَان + نَا — bi-, with (prep.; ghamara bi- 'overwhelm with') + iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (m., gen.) + -nā, our; 'with our kindness'
أخْرُجُ: akhruju — kharaja, to go out (I, 1 sg. imperfect, indicative); 'I go out'
وَأكَلِّمُهُ: و + أُكَلِّمُ + هُ — wa-, and + ukallimu, kallama, to speak to (II, 1 sg. imperfect) + -hu, him; 'and I speak to him'
وَأعِدُهُ: و + أَعِدُ + هُ — wa-, and + aʿidu, waʿada, to promise (I, 1 sg. imperfect) + -hu, him; 'and I promise him'
وَأقُولُ: و + أَقُولُ — wa-, and + aqūlu, qāla, to say (I, 1 sg. imperfect); 'and I say'
أرَدْتَ: aradta — arāda, to want (IV, 2 m. sg. perfect); 'you wish'
الْمُقَامَ: الـ + مُقَام — muqām, staying, residence (m., verbal noun of IV aqāma, acc.); 'the stay'
أزَوِّجُكَ: uzawwijuka — zawwaja, to marry off, give in marriage (II, 1 sg. imperfect) + -ka, you (m.); 'I will marry you'
ذَكَرَنِي: dhakara + -nī — dhakara, to mention, say (I, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; printed with the person as direct object; 'he told me'
فَإنْ: فَـ + إِنْ — fa-, so + in, if (conditional)
هُوَطَا: hu-wa-ṭā — the first part of هُوَ طَاوَعَنَا, 'he obeys us', wrongly divided in print: huwa, he + ṭā(wa-)
وَعَنَا: wa-ʿa-nā — the rest of (ṭā)wa-ʿa-nā, ṭāwaʿa, to obey (III, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -nā, us; wrongly divided in print
مُرَادَنَا: مُرَاد + نَا — murād, desire, aim (m., acc. object) + -nā, our; 'our aim'
وَوَصَلْنَا: و + وَصَلْنَا — wa-, and + waṣala, to arrive (I, 1 pl. perfect); 'and we arrive'
نَادِيهِ: نَادِي + هِ — nādī, call! (III nādā, imperative f. sg.) + -hi, him; 'call him'
أحَدِّثَهُ: uḥaddithahu — ḥaddatha, to speak to (II, 1 sg. subjunctive after ḥattā) + -hu, him; 'I speak to him'
غَضْبَانُ: Ghaḍbān, name from ghaḍbān, angry (m., voc. with ḍamma); also: the adj. ghaḍbān, angry (m., diptote, nom. predicate of anna; ʿalā, with): annahu ghaḍbānu ʿalayhā, 'that he was angry with her' (Night 179)
أسْعَدَكَ: asʿadaka — asʿada, to make happy, favour (IV, 3 m. sg. perfect) + -ka, you (m.); 'he has made you fortunate'
مَاتَقُولُهُ: مَا + تَقُولُ + هُ — mā, what (relative) + taqūlu, qāla, to say (I, 3 f. sg. imperfect) + -hu, it (referring to what); printed as one word; 'what she says'
نَفَرَ: nafara — to shy away, shrink (I, 3 m. sg. perfect); 'shrank'
الضَّرُورَةَ: الـ + ضَّرُورَة — ḍarūra, necessity (f., acc. after inna); 'necessity'
أحْكَامٌ: aḥkām — rulings, laws (m. broken pl. of حُكْم, nom. tanwīn; subject after lahā); 'rulings'
تُحَدِّثُهُ: تُحَدِّثُ + هُ — tuḥaddithu, ḥaddatha, to speak to (II, 3 f. sg. imperfect, circumstantial) + -hu, him; 'speaking to him'
نَافِرٌ: nāfir — averse, shying away (act. part. of nafara; m. sing., nom. indef., predicate); 'averse'
مُسَاعَدَةٌ: musāʿada — help, assistance (f., nom. indef.; verbal noun of III sāʿada)
غَدَرَاتِ: ghadarāt — treacheries (pl. of ghadra, act of treachery; f. sound pl., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
أَظْهَرْتُكَ: أَظْهَرْتُ + كَ — aẓhartu, I showed, made known (IV aẓhara, perf. 1 sing.; aẓhara ʿalā 'let see') + -ka, you (m. obj.); 'I show you'
وَعَشِقَهَا: و + عَشِقَ + هَا — wa-, and + ʿashiqa, he fell passionately in love with (perf. 3 m. sing.) + -hā, her; 'and he fell in love with her'
أَمَرْتِنِي: أَمَرْتِ + نِي — amarti, you commanded (amara, perf. 2 f. sing.) + -nī, me; 'you command me'
تَأْخُذَنِي: تَأْخُذَ + نِي — taʾkhudha, you take (akhadha, subj. 2 m. sing.) + -nī, me; 'that you take me'
وَتَأْخُذَ: و + تَأْخُذَ — wa-, and + taʾkhudha, you take (subj. 2 m. sing., continuing an); 'and take'
وَتَشُدَّ: و + تَشُدَّ — wa-, and + tashudda, you tie on, saddle (shadda, subj. 2 m. sing.; shadda printed in the edition); 'and tie on'
رَاحِلَتَيْنِ: rāḥilatayn — two riding-camels (dual of rāḥila, f., acc.)
وَرَأْسَيْ: و + رَأْسَيْ — wa-, and + raʾsay, two heads (dual of raʾs, m., acc., construct form); 'and two heads of'
خُيُولِ: khuyūl — horses (broken pl. of khayl; gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَتَجْعَلَ: و + تَجْعَلَ — wa-, and + tajʿala, you put, place (jaʿala, subj. 2 m. sing.); 'and put'; also: jaʿala li-, 'to set aside for', li- marking what it is for: wa-tajʿala li-al-dīwāni … yawmayni, 'and set aside two days for the council' (Night 192)
فَرَسٍ: faras — horse, mare (m. or f., gen.); 'of a horse'
وَشَيْأً: و + شَيْأً — wa-, and + shayʾan, something (shayʾ, thing, m., acc. indef.; edition's variant spelling with أ); 'and something'
وَتَرْحَلَ: و + تَرْحَلَ — wa-, and + tarḥala, you set out, travel (raḥala, subj. 2 m. sing.); 'and travel'
أَقَمْتَ: aqamta — you stayed, remained (IV aqāma, perf. 2 m. sing.)
زَوَّجْتُكَ: زَوَّجْتُ + كَ — zawwajtu, I married off, gave in marriage (II zawwaja, perf. 1 sing.) + -ka, you (m. obj.); 'I shall marry you'
تَخْتَارُهَا: تَخْتَارُ + هَا — takhtāru, you choose (VIII ikhtāra, imperf. 2 m. sing.) + -hā, her (resumptive pronoun); 'you choose (her)'
جَوَارِيَّ: جَوَارِي + ي — jawārī, girls, maids (pl. of jāriya; gen. after min) + -ya, my; 'my girls' (shadda printed in the edition)
طَلَبْتَ: ṭalabta — you asked for, sought (ṭalaba, perf. 2 m. sing.)
الرُّجُوعَ: الـ + رُجُوع — rujūʿ, returning (m., acc., verbal noun of rajaʿa, object of ṭalabta); 'the returning'
بِلَادِلَ: بِلَاد + لَ — bilād, lands (m., gen. after ilā) + -la, printed for -ka (probably a misprint for بِلَادِكَ, 'your lands')
زَوَّجْنَاكَ: زَوَّجْنَا + كَ — zawwajnā, we married off (II, perf. 1 pl.) + -ka, you; 'we shall marry you'
وَأَعْطَيْنَاكَ: و + أَعْطَيْنَا + كَ — wa-, and + aʿṭaynā, we gave (IV aʿṭā, perf. 1 pl.) + -ka, you (m.); 'and we shall give you'
أَخْدُمُكُمَا: أَخْدُمُ + كُمَا — akhdumu, I serve (khadama, imperf. 1 sing.) + -kumā, you two (obj.); 'I serve you both'
بِعُيُونِي: بِـ + عُيُون + ي — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn; gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my eyes', i.e. gladly Also literally, 'with my own eyes', of seeing: raʾaytuhā bi-ʿuyūnī, 'I saw her with my own eyes' (Night 188).
مَعَكُمَا: مَعَ + كُمَا — maʿa, with (prep.) + -kumā, you two; 'with you both'
وَأَشُدُّ: و + أَشُدُّ — wa-, and + ashuddu, I tie on, saddle (shadda, imperf. 1 sing.); 'and I tie on'
تُطَا: tuṭā — first half of a verb split by a stray space: read with the next word as تُطَاوِعَانِي, 'they two obey me' (III ṭāwaʿa, to comply)
وَعَانِي: waʿānī — second half of the split verb: read as -wiʿānī, the ending of تُطَاوِعَانِي, 'they two obey me'
قَتَلْتُهُمَا: قَتَلْتُ + هُمَا — qataltu, I killed (qatala, perf. 1 sing.) + -humā, the two of them; 'I shall kill them both'
وَأَضْمَرَ: و + أَضْمَرَ — wa-, and + aḍmara, he concealed, kept secret (IV, perf. 3 m. sing.); 'and he kept hidden'
رَاحِلَتَانِ: rāḥilatān — two riding-camels (dual of rāḥila, f., nom.; subject of the verbless clause)
وَثَلٰثُ: و + ثَلٰثُ — wa-, and + thalāth, three (edition's defective spelling of ثَلَاثُ; numeral, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and three'
رُؤُسٍ: ruʾus — heads (edition's short spelling of رُؤُوس, pl. of raʾs; gen., second term of the iḍāfa)
أَحَدِهِمْ: أَحَد + هِمْ — aḥad, one (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -him, them (masc., for the horses); 'one of them'
وَأَرْكَبَتْ: و + أَرْكَبَتْ — wa-, and + arkabat, she made ride, set on a mount (IV, perf. 3 f. sing.); 'and she set'
مُتَوَجِّعَةٌ: mutawajjiʿa — suffering, in pain (act. part. of V tawajjaʿa; f. sing., nom. indef., predicate)
الطَّلْقِ: الـ + طَلْق — ṭalq, the pangs of childbirth (m., gen.); 'the labour-pangs'
تَمَالَكُ: tamālaku — she holds, controls (VI tamālaka, imperf. 3 f. sing.; read as tatamālaku with one ta dropped)
الْوَجَعِ: الـ + وَجَع — wajaʿ, pain, ache (m., gen.); 'of the pain'
عَرْصَةِ: ʿarṣa — open ground, wide tract (f., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
بَيْنَهَا: بَيْنَ + هَا — bayna, between (prep., acc.) + -hā, her; 'between her'
بِلَادِهَا: بِلَاد + هَا — bilād, lands (m., gen., after bayna) + -hā, her; 'her country'
قَدَرَتْ: qadarat — she was able (qadara, perf. 3 f. sing.)
تُمْسِكُهُ: تُمْسِكُ + هُ — tumsiku, she holds, restrains (IV amsaka, imperf. 3 f. sing., without an) + -hu, it; 'hold it'
لِلْغَضْبَانِ: لِـ + الْ + غَضْبَان — li-, to (prep.; qāla li- 'say to') + al-Ghaḍbān (gen.); 'to al-Ghaḍbān'
أَنْزِلْنِي: أَنْزِلْ + نِي — anzil, bring down, lower (IV anzala, imper. 2 m. sing.) + -nī, me; 'lower me'
حَاشَنِي: حَاشَ + نِي — ḥāsha, obscure, perhaps for jāsha 'it surged (over)' (perf. 3 m. sing.) + -nī, me; 'has come over me'
