انْزِ: inzi — first half of اِنْزِلِي, 'come down' (nazala, imper. 2 f. sing.), the final -lī split off by a stray space
وَاقْعُدِي: و + اقْعُدِي — wa-, and + uqʿudī, sit (qaʿada, imper. 2 f. sing.); 'and sit'
وَوَلِّدِينِي: و + وَلِّدِي + نِي — wa-, and + wallidī, deliver, act as midwife (II walada, imper. 2 f. sing.) + -nī, me; 'and deliver me'
فَرَسِهَا: فَرَس + هَا — faras, horse (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her horse'
الْفَرَسَيْنِ: الـ + فَرَسَيْنِ — faras, horse; dual (gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'of the two horses'
وَنَزَلَتِ: و + نَزَلَتِ — wa-, and + nazalat, she descended (perf. 3 f. sing.; kasra before the definite article)
غَائِبَةٌ: ghāʾiba — absent (act. part. of ghāba; f. sing., nom. indef., predicate; the ئ is printed by the edition); 'absent'
فَشَهَرَ: فَـ + شَهَرَ — fa-, and so + shahara, he drew (a sword), brandished (perf. 3 m. sing.); 'and he drew'
ارْحَمِينِي: ارْحَمِي + نِي — irḥamī, have mercy (raḥima, imper. 2 f. sing.) + -nī, me; 'have mercy on me'
بِوَصْلِكِ: بِـ + وَصْل + كِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; what he begs of her) + waṣl, joining, union (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your union', i.e. by giving yourself
أَرْضَى: arḍā — I am satisfied (raḍiya, imperf. 1 sing.)
بِالْمُلُوكِ: بِـ + الـ + مُلُوك — bi-, with (prep.; raḍiya bi- 'be content with') + mulūk, kings (pl. of malik; gen.); 'with the kings'
الصَّنَادِيدِ: الـ + صَنَادِيد — ṣanādīd, chiefs, mighty men (pl. of ṣindīd; gen., adj. of the kings); 'the mighty'
أَرْضِي: أَرْضَى — a- + raḍiya, to be pleased, content (imperf. 1 sg., indic.); written with final yā' (أَرْضِي) in the print for -ā; 'I am content with'
وَاغْتَاظَتْ: وَ + اغْتَاظَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ightāẓa, to be enraged (VIII, perf. 3 f.sg.); 'and she was enraged'
تَقُولُهُ: تَقُولُ + هُ — taqūlu, you say (imperf. 2 m.sg., from qāla) + -hu, it (obj.); 'which you say'
تَتَفَوَّهْ: tatafawwah, to blurt out, open the mouth (V, jussive 2 m.sg. after lā, prohibition); 'do not utter'
أُصْلِحَ: أُصْلِحَ — uṣliḥa, to set right, mend (IV, subj. 1 sg., after ḥattā); 'I set right'
الْجَنِينِ: الـ + جَنِين — janīn, foetus, unborn child (m., gen.); 'the unborn child'
وَأُصْلِحَ: وَ + أُصْلِحَ — wa-, and (conj.) + uṣliḥa, I set right (IV, subj. 1 sg.); 'and I set right'
قَدَرْتَ: قَدَرْتَ — qadarta, to be able, have power (perf. 2 m.sg.); 'you are able'
فَاحِشَ: فَاحِش — fāḥish, foul, indecent (act. part. of faḥasha; here as a noun in the acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the foul of'
وَأُفَارِقُ: وَ + أُفَارِقُ — wa-, and + a-, I + fāraqa, to part from, leave (III, imperf. 1 sg. indic.); 'and I take leave of'
وَأَرْتَاحُ: وَ + أَرْتَاحُ — wa-, and + a-, I + irtāḥa, to be at ease, find rest (VIII, imperf. 1 sg. indic.); 'and I rest'
كَفَانِيْ: كَفَا + نِي — kafā, to suffice (perf. 3 m.sg.) + -nī, me; 'suffices me, is enough for me'
مُكَابَدَةُ: مُكَابَدَة — mukābada, enduring, struggling through (f. verbal noun of III kābada; nom. subject, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَالزَّمَانِ: وَ + الـ + زَّمَان — wa-, and (conj.) + zamān, time, fortune (m., gen.); 'and of time'
الْفَحْشَاءِ: الـ + فَحْشَاء — faḥshāʾ, indecency, lewdness (f., gen.); 'the indecency'
نَهَانِيْ: nahā, to forbid (perf. 3 m.sg.) + -nī, me; 'has forbidden me'
مَثْوَى: مَثْوَى — mathwā, abode, lodging (m., nom. predicate)
عَصَانِيْ: عَصَا + نِي — ʿaṣā, to disobey (perf. 3 m.sg.) + -nī, me; 'disobeys me'
وَاِنِّي: وَ + إِنِّي — wa-, and + inna, indeed + -ī, I; 'and indeed I'
اِمِيلُ: أَمِيلُ — amīlu, I incline (imperf. 1 sg. indic. of māla); the print has a bare alif, 'I do not incline'
لِفِعْلِ: لِـ + فِعْلِ — li-, to, toward (prep.; māla li- 'incline to') + fiʿl, deed, act (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'to a deed'
النَّقْصِ: الـ + نَّقْص — naqṣ, deficiency, disparagement (m., gen.); 'of deficiency'
لَاتَرَانِيْ: لَا + تَرَا + نِي — lā, not (prohibition) + tarā, you see (jussive 2 m.sg. of raʾā, here without the final alif change) + -nī, me; 'do not see me'; printed as one word
تَتْرُكِ: تَتْرُكِ — tatruki, you leave (jussive 2 m.sg. after lam, with a kasra before the article); 'you leave'
الْفَحْشَاءَ: الـ + فَحْشَاء — faḥshāʾ, indecency (f., acc. object); 'the indecency'
عَنِّيْ: عَنِّ + ي — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + -ī, me (ʿanni: ʿan + nī); 'from me'
وَتَرْعَى: وَ + تَرْعَى — wa-, and + tarʿā, you heed, respect (imperf. 2 m.sg. of raʿā; indicative as printed where the grammar wants a jussive); 'and you respect'
رَعَانِيْ: raʿā, to tend, protect (perf. 3 m.sg.) + -nī, me; 'tended me'
لَاصْرُخْ: لَ + اصْرُخْ — la-, indeed, I would (lām of the apodosis/oath) + aṣrukh, I cry out (imperf. 1 sg., from ṣarakha; printed with the a- elided); 'I would cry out'
طَاقَتِيْ: طَاقَة + ِي — ṭāqa, strength, capacity (f., acc. adverbial) + -ī, my; 'with all my strength'
لِرِجَالِ: لِـ + رِجَالِ — li-, to (prep., marking whom one cries to) + rijāl, men (m. pl., gen. in iḍāfa); 'to the men'
قَوْمِيْ: قَوْم + ِي — qawm, people, tribe (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my people'
وَاَجْلِبُ: وَ + أَجْلِبُ — wa-, and + a-, I + jalaba, to bring, summon (imperf. 1 sg. indic.); 'and I summon'
قَاصِيهَا: قَاصِي + هَا — qāṣī, distant (act. part. of qaṣā, m.sg., gen. in iḍāfa) + -hā, it, them (the people); 'its far one'
وَدَانِيْ: وَ + دَانِ — wa-, and + dānī, near (act. part. of danā, m.sg., gen.); 'and near'
قَطَّعْتُ: قَطَّعْتُ — qaṭṭaʿtu, I cut (II, perf. 1 sg.); the print points it active, the sense wanted is probably 'were I cut to pieces'
الْيَمَانِيْ: الـ + يَمَانِي — yamānī, Yemeni (nisba adj., m., gen.); 'the Yemeni'
فَحَّاشًا: فَحَّاشًا — faḥḥāsh, lewd, foul-mouthed person (m., acc. with tanwīn, intensive of fāḥish); 'a lewd one'
يَرَانِيْ: يَرَا + نِي — yarā, he sees (imperf. 3 m.sg. of raʾā) + -nī, me; 'who sees me'
الْاَحْرَارِ: الـ + أَحْرَار — aḥrār, free men (m. pl. of ḥurr, gen.); 'the free-born'
وَالْكُبَرَاءِ: وَ + الـ + كُبَرَاء — wa-, and + kubarāʾ, great ones, grandees (m. pl. of kabīr, gen.); 'and the grandees'
نَسْلِ: نَسْلِ — nasl, offspring, stock (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa after min)
الزَّوَانِيْ: الـ + زَّوَانِي — zawānī, fornicating women, whores (f. pl. of zāniya, gen.); 'the whores'
وَاغْبَرَّتْ: وَ + اغْبَرَّتْ — wa-, and + ighbarrat, to turn dust-coloured (IX, perf. 3 f.sg., from ghubra, dust); 'and went dusky'
سَجْنَتُهُ: سَجْنَة + هُ — sajna, face, complexion (f., nom.; Lane) + -hu, his; 'his face'
وَانْتَفَخَتْ: وَ + انْتَفَخَتْ — wa-, and + intafakhat, to swell (VII, perf. 3 f.sg.); 'and swelled'
مَنَاخِرُهُ: مَنَاخِر + هُ — manākhir, nostrils (m. pl. of manākhir/minkhar, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his nostrils'
وَاسْتَدَلَّتْ: وَ + اسْتَدَلَّتْ — wa-, and + istadallat (obscure: perhaps a slip for istarkhat, 'went slack'; here taken as 'hung down', perf. 3 f.sg., X)
مَشَافِرُهُ: مَشَافِر + هُ — mashāfir, thick lips (m. pl. of mishfar, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his lips'
النَّفَرَاتُ: الـ + نَّفَرَات — nafarāt, starts, fits of shying (f. pl. of nafra, nom.); 'the fits'
اَبْرِيزَةُ: أَبْرِيزَة — Abrīza, the princess (proper name, f., vocative nom.)
تَتْرُكِينِيْ: لَا + تَتْرُكِينِي — lā, not (prohibition) + tatrukīnī, you (f.) leave me (imperf. 2 f.sg. with -ī, jussive form kept as printed, + -nī, me); 'do not leave me'
قَتِيلَ: قَتِيل — qatīl, slain one (m., acc. with tanwīn dropped, in iḍāfa, second object, state)
بِاللَّحْظِ: بِـ + الـ + لَّحْظ — bi-, by, with (prep., of the instrument or cause) + laḥẓ, glance (m., gen.); 'by the glance'
فَقَلْبِيْ: فَ + قَلْب + ِي — fa-, for, so (conj.) + qalb, heart (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'for my heart'
جَفَاكِ: جَفَا + كِ — jafā, cruelty, harshness (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your cruelty'
وَجِسْمِيْ: وَ + جِسْم + ِي — wa-, and + jism, body (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my body'
نَاحِلٌ: نَاحِلٌ — nāḥil, wasted, emaciated (act. part. of naḥala; m., nom. predicate); 'is wasted'
وَالصَّبْرُ: وَ + الـ + صَّبْرُ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + ṣabr, patience (m., nom.); 'and patience'; also plain 'and' opening a sentence (wa-al-ṣabru munfaṣilun, 'and patience is cut off')
فَانِ: فَانِ — fānī, perishing, passing away (act. part. of fanā, m., nom. predicate); 'is spent'
وَطَرْفُكِ: وَ + طَرْف + كِ — wa-, and + ṭarf, eye, glance (m., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your eye'
سَبَى: سَبَى — sabā, to take captive (perf. 3 m.sg.); 'has captivated'
الْاَلْبَابَ: الـ + أَلْبَاب — albāb, minds, hearts (m. pl. of lubb, acc. object); 'the minds'
سِحْرًا: سِحْرًا — siḥr, sorcery, magic (m., acc. with tanwīn, adverbial); 'by sorcery'
وَعَقْلِيْ: وَ + عَقْل + ِي — wa-, and + ʿaql, reason (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my reason'
نَازِحٌ: نَازِحٌ — nāziḥ, far away, gone far (act. part. of nazaḥa; m., nom. predicate); 'is far off'
دَانِ: دَانِ — dānī, near (act. part. of danā, m., nom. predicate); 'is near'
اَجْلَبْتِ: أَجْلَبْتِ — ajlabti, to summon, gather (IV, perf. 2 f.sg., -ti); 'you summoned'
مِلْأَ: مِلْأَ — milʾ, fullness (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'a fullness of'
جَيْشًا: جَيْشًا — jaysh, army (m., acc. with tanwīn, specifying); 'an army'
بْلُغَ: بْلُغَ — remainder of أَبْلُغَ, ablugha, 'I reach' (subj. 1 sg. of balagha); the print splits the word after its alif, which sits in the preceding لَا
رَبِيْ: رَبِي — rabī: 'my lord' as printed (rabb + -ī); most likely مَأْرَبِي, maʾrabī 'my aim', split as mā rabī; see the verse note
يَاغَضْبَانُ: يَا + غَضْبَانُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Ghaḍbān, 'Angry', the slave's name (nom.); printed as one word
قَدْرِكَ: مِنْ + قَدْر + كَ — min, from, of (prep., of the extent reached) + qadr, rank, worth (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'from your rank'
تُخَاطِبَنِي: تُخَاطِبَ + نِي — tukhāṭiba, you address (III, subj. 2 m.sg., after an) + -nī, me; 'you address me'
الزِّنَا: الـ + زِّنَا — zinā, fornication (m., gen.); 'of fornication'
وَتَرْبِيَةَ: وَ + تَرْبِيَة — wa-, and + tarbiya, upbringing, rearing (f., acc. in the vocative, first term of an iḍāfa); 'and rearing'
الْخَنَى: الـ + خَنَى — khanā, lewdness, obscenity (m., gen.); 'of lewdness'
أَتَحْسَبُ: أَ + تَحْسَبُ — a-, (interrog. particle for yes-no questions) + taḥsabu, you reckon, suppose (imperf. 2 m.sg. indic. of ḥasiba); 'do you suppose?'
وَرَائِدِهَا: فِي + وَرَائِد + هَا — fī, in (prep.) + warāʾid, obscure (perhaps for warīd, 'jugular vein', or warāʾ, 'back') + -hā, her; 'in her …'
فَقَتَلَهَا: فَ + قَتَلَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + qatala, to kill (perf. 3 m.sg.) + -hā, her; 'and killed her'; in Night 193 the masculine follows ḍarabat bihi, 'she struck her with it', so read 'and it (the sword) killed her'
جَوَادَهَا: جَوَاد + هَا — jawād, fine horse, steed (m., acc. object) + -hā, her; 'her horse'
وَنَجَا: وَ + نَجَا — wa-, and + najā, to escape (perf. 3 m.sg.); 'and he escaped'
وَأَرْمَى: وَ + أَرْمِيَ — wa-, and + a-, I (1 sg. prefix) + ramā, to throw, aim at (subj., yā' written as final ى); obscure, 'and I aim at, make for'
شَأْنَهُ: شَأْن + ـهُ — shaʾn, condition, state, matter (m., acc. as object of aṣlaḥat; printed شانه without the hamza) + 3ms poss.; 'his condition'
وَجَعَلَتْهُ: وَ + جَعَلَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make, place, put (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'and she placed him'
جَنْبِ: جَنْب — janb, side (m., gen. sg. in construct after ilā); 'the side of'
ثَدْيَهَا: ثَدْي + هَا — thady, breast (m., acc. sg. as object) + 3fs poss.; 'her breast'
وَحَثَتِ: وَ + حَثَا — wa-, and + ḥathā, to throw, heap, scatter (dust) (verb I defective, perf. 3fs, ḥathat with the kasra of the following article); 'and she cast'
وَاسِتَاهْ: وَا + سِتَاهْ — wā, O, alas (exclamatory particle) + a lament-cry, perhaps a clipped سَوْأَتَاهْ 'my shame' (sawʾa, disgrace, + ā + hā of lament); 'alas, my shame' (obscure; so read in context)
وَاخَيْبَتَاهْ: وَا + خَيْبَة + ـا + ـهْ — wā, alas (exclamatory) + khayba, failure, disappointment, ruin (f.) + lament ā + hā; 'alas for the ruin of it'
قُتِلْتِ: قَتَلَ — qatala, to kill (verb I, passive perf. 2fs, qutilti; the print marks the kasra on the tāʾ); 'you (f.) were killed'
لَاقِيمَةَ: لَا + قِيمَة — lā, no (negation of the genus) + qīma, value, worth (f., acc. without tanwīn after lā), printed run together; 'no worth'
فَرٍّ: فَرّ — farr, flight, fleeing (verbal noun of farra, gen. tanwīn after baʿda); 'flight'
وَسِيتِكِ: وَ + سِيت + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + sīt, probably ṣīt, fame, renown (m., gen.; the print has sīn; or a form of 'lady', uncertain) + 2fs poss. (the print marks the kasra on kāf); 'and your renown'
الْأَقْطَارَ: الـ + أَقْطَار — aqṭār, regions, quarters (m., broken pl. of quṭr, acc. as object); 'the regions'
عَسْكَرٌ: عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, army (m., nom. tanwīn, subject of bāna, of kharaja); 'an army'
جَرَّارٌ: جَرَّار — jarrār, dragging, trailing, hence vast (intensive adj. of jarra, m., nom. tanwīn); 'a vast, trailing (host)'
وَالِدِ: وَالِد — wālid, father (m., act. part. of walada used as noun, gen. in apposition, in construct); 'father of'
هَرَبَتْ: هَرَبَ — haraba, to flee, run away (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she fled'
وَجَوَارِبَهَا: وَ + جَوَارِب + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + jawārib, printed with bāʾ, surely a slip for jawārī, girls, maids (f. pl. of jāriya, acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her maids'
يَتَشَمَّمُ: تَشَمَّمَ — tashammama, to sniff out, scent (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'sniffing out, scenting'
الْأَخْبَارَ: الـ + أَخْبَار — akhbār, news, reports (m., pl. of khabar, acc. as object); 'the news'
الْمُسَافِرِينَ: الـ + مُسَافِرِينَ — musāfir, traveller (act. part. of sāfara, verb III; m. pl., gen. -īna after baʿḍ); 'the travellers'
وَبَعُدَ: وَ + بَعُدَ — wa-, and + baʿuda, to be far (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and was far'
مَسِيرَةَ: مَسِيرَة — masīra, journey, distance travelled (f., acc. of extent, in construct); 'a journey of'
فُرْسَانٍ: فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen, riders (m., broken pl. of fāris, gen. tanwīn, counted noun); 'horsemen'
فَقَصَدَهُمْ: فَـ + قَصَدَ + هُمْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + qaṣada, to head for, make for (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; 'and he made for them'
لِيَسْأَ: لِـ + يَسْأَلَ — li-, in order to (particle of purpose, takes the subjunctive) + yasʾala, to ask (verb I, subj. 3ms; the print has precomposed أ, separated from its next word); 'to ask'
وَيَعْلَمَ: وَ + يَعْلَمَ — wa-, and + yaʿlama, to know, learn (verb I, subj. 3ms, continuing the li- purpose); 'and to know'
وَجَارِيَتَهَا: وَ + جَارِيَة + هَا — wa-, and + jāriya, girl, maid (f., acc.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her maid'
وَالْعَبْدَ: وَ + الـ + عَبْد — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿabd, slave (m., acc.); 'and the slave'
الْغَضْبَانَ: الـ + غَضْبَان — ghaḍbān, enraged (the slave's by-name, acc. in apposition); 'al-Ghaḍbān'
قَصَدَهُمْ: قَصَدَ + هُمْ — qaṣada, to head for, make for (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3mp obj.; 'he made for them'
وَجَارِيَتُهَا: وَ + جَارِيَة + هَا — wa-, and (waw of circumstance) + jāriya, girl, maid (f., nom.) + 3fs poss.; 'and her maid'
ضَرَبُوا: ضَرَبَ — ḍaraba, to strike; of tents, to pitch (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they pitched'
وَنَصَبُواقُبَّةً: وَ + نَصَبُوا + قُبَّة — wa-, and + naṣabū, to set up, erect (verb I, perf. 3mp, with silent alif) + qubba, dome, domed tent (f., acc. tanwīn), printed run together; 'and they set up a dome'
وَمُدَوَّرَةً: وَ + مُدَوَّرَة — wa-, and + mudawwara, round (pass. part. of dawwara, verb II, f., acc. tanwīn); 'and a round (one)'
الْخَيْمَةِ: الـ + خَيْمَة — khayma, tent (f., gen.); 'the tent'
عَرَفَتْهُ: عَرَفَ + تْ + هُ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'she recognised him'
غَشْيَتِهِ: غَشْيَة + ـهِ — ghashya, fainting fit, swoon (f., gen. after min) + 3ms poss.; 'his swoon' Also gen. after fī: lam yazal fī ghashyatihi, 'he remained in his swoon'.
وَسَأَلَهَا: وَ + سَأَلَ + هَا — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and he asked her'
فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ: فَـ + أَخْبَرَ + تْ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'and she told him'
حَرْدُوبُ: Ḥardūb — proper name, king of the Rūm (nom. in apposition to al-maliku)
مِحْنَةٍ: مِحْنَة — miḥna, as printed 'trial, ordeal' (f., gen. tanwīn); the sense wants مِحَفَّة miḥaffa, a litter; 'a litter' (probable slip)
وَحَمْلِ: وَ + حَمْل — wa-, and + ḥaml, carrying (verbal noun of ḥamala, gen., coordinated with iḥḍār, in construct); 'and the carrying of'
وَأَدْخَلُوهَا: وَ + أَدْخَلَ + وا + هَا — wa-, and + adkhala, to bring in, cause to enter (verb IV, perf. 3mp) + 3fs obj.; 'and they brought her in'
بِبِنْتِي: بِـ + بِنْت + ـي — bi-, to (prep.; faʿala bi- 'do to someone') + bint, daughter (f., gen.) + 1cs poss.; 'to my daughter'
يَأُخُذُ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms; the print puts a damma on the alif for yaʾkhudhu); 'takes'
عَبِيدِهِ: عَبِيد + هِ — ʿabīd, slaves (m., pl. of ʿabd, gen. after min) + 3ms poss.; 'his slaves'
أَخْذِنَا: أَخْذ + نَا — akhdh, taking (verbal noun of akhadha, gen. after min) + 1cp poss.; 'our taking'
ثَأُرَ: ثَأْر — thaʾr, blood-vengeance, vengeance (m., acc. as object of akhdh; the print puts a damma on the alif); 'the vengeance of'
وَكَشْفِ: وَ + كَشْف — wa-, and + kashf, uncovering, removing (verbal noun of kashafa, gen. after min, coordinated); 'and the removal of'
الْعَارِ: الـ + عَار — ʿār, shame, disgrace (m., gen. in construct); 'the shame'
عِرْضِي: عِرْض + ـي — ʿirḍ, honour, reputation (m., gen. after ʿan) + 1cs poss.; 'my honour'; here: gen. as second term after hatk, 'the tearing of my honour'
وَإِلَّاقَتَلْتُ: وَ + إِلَّا + قَتَلْتُ — wa-, and + illā, if not, else (conditional 'if not') + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 1cs, qataltu; 'else I will kill'), printed run together; 'and if not, I will kill'
مَاقَتَلَ: مَا + قَتَلَ — mā, not, none (negative) + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed as one word, 'none killed'
إِلَّامَرْجَانَةُ: إِلَّا + مَرْجَانَة — illā, except (particle of exception) + Marjāna, the maid's name (nom.); printed as one word, 'except Marjāna'
تَكْرَهُهَا: تَكْرَهُ + هَا — karaha, to hate (verb I, impf. 3fs) + -hā, her (object); 'she hated her'
لَاتَحْزَنْ: لَا + تَحْزَنْ — lā, not (prohibitive particle) + ḥazina, to grieve (verb I, jussive 2ms); printed as one word, 'do not grieve'
ثَأْرِهَا: ثَأْر + هَا — thaʾr, blood-vengeance (m., gen.; second term of the iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'vengeance for her'
وَأَقْتُلَ: وَ + أَقْتُلَ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (verb I, subjunctive 1s, continuing the ḥattā clause); 'and I kill'
عْمَلَنَّ: ʿmalanna — the rest of the verb عَمِلَ (ʿamila, to do, make; verb I) in the emphatic energetic (impf. 1s + nūn of emphasis); the second half of the printed division, 'do (surely)'
الدُّهَاةُ: الـ + دُّهَاة — dāhin, crafty, shrewd person (m.; pl. duhāt, nom.); 'the crafty'
وَالْأَبْطَالُ: وَ + الـ + أَبْطَال — wa-, and + baṭal, hero (m.; pl. abṭāl, nom.); 'and the heroes'
تَمْتَثِلَ: tamtathila — to comply with, obey (verb VIII of mathala, subjunctive 2ms after an); 'that you comply'
أَقُولُهُ: أَقُولُ + هُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, impf. 1s) + -hu, it (object); 'I say it'
نَوَى: nawā, to intend, resolve (verb I defective, perf. 3ms); 'he intended'
يَبْلُغْ: balagha, to reach, attain (verb I, jussive 3ms; the answer to the conditional man); 'he will reach'
أُخَالِفُكِ: أُخَالِفُ + كِ — khālafa, to oppose, go against (verb III, impf. 1s) + -ki, you (2fs, object); 'I oppose you'
تَقُولِينَهُ: تَقُولِينَ + هُ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, impf. 2fs) + -hu, it (object); 'you say it'
اِئْتِنِي: i'tī (أَتَى) — to bring (verb I, imperative 2ms, with the hamzat al-waṣl) + -nī, me (1s object); 'bring me'
نُهَّدٍ: nuhhad — high-breasted, with swelling breasts (adj., pl. of nāhid, f.; gen. with tanwīn, qualifying jawārin); 'high-breasted'
وَائْتِنِي: وَ + ائْتِنِي — wa-, and + ʾtī (أَتَى), to bring (verb I, imperative 2ms) + -nī, me; 'and bring me'
بِحُكَمَاءِ: بِـ + حُكَمَاءِ — bi-, with (prep.; the verb ʾatā chooses it) + ḥakīm, sage, wise man (m.; pl. ḥukamāʾ, gen.); 'with the sages of'
وَدَعْهُمْ: وَ + دَعْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + daʿ, leave, let (imperative 2ms of wadaʿa/daʿa) + -hum, them (object); 'and let them'
يُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ: يُعَلِّمُونَ + هُنَّ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, impf. 3mp, with the final -na kept) + -hunna, them (3fp object); 'they teach them'
الْحِكْمَةَ: الـ + حِكْمَة — ḥikma, wisdom (f., acc. object); 'the wisdom'
وَالْأَدَبَ: وَ + الـ + أَدَب — wa-, and + adab, good manners, culture (m., acc. object); 'and the manners'
وَالْمُنَادَمَةَ: وَ + الـ + مُنَادَمَة — wa-, and + munādama, boon-companionship, drinking in company (f., verbal noun of III nādama, acc. object); 'and the boon-companionship'
وَالْأَشْعَارَ: وَ + الـ + أَشْعَار — wa-, and + shiʿr, poetry (m.; pl. ashʿār, acc. object); 'and the poems'
وَيَتَكَلَّمُونَ: وَ + يَتَكَلَّمُونَ — wa-, and + takallama, to speak (verb V, impf. 3mp); 'and they speak, converse'
مَعَهُنَّ: مَعَ + هُنَّ — maʿa, with (prep.) + -hunna, them (3fp); 'with them'
بِالْحِكْمَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حِكْمَة — bi-, with, in (prep.; of the manner of speech) + ḥikma, wisdom (f., gen.); 'with wisdom'
وَالْمَوَاعِظِ: وَ + الـ + مَوَاعِظ — wa-, and + mawʿiẓa, exhortation, admonition (f.; pl. mawāʿiẓ, gen. after the bi- of the previous phrase); 'and with exhortations'
الْحُكَمَاءُ: الـ + حُكَمَاء — ḥakīm, sage (m.; pl. ḥukamāʾ, nom.); 'the sages'
يُعَلِّمُوهُنَّ: يُعَلِّمُوا + هُنَّ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, subjunctive 3mp after ḥattā, with the nūn dropped) + -hunna, them (object); 'they teach them'
أَخْبَارَ: akhbār — reports, tales, stories (pl. of khabar, m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the reports of'
وَتَوَارِيخَ: وَ + تَوَارِيخَ — wa-, and + tawārīkh, histories (pl. of taʾrīkh, m., acc. object, diptote; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the histories of'
الْخُلَفَاءِ: الـ + خُلَفَاء — khalīfa, caliph, successor (m.; pl. khulafāʾ, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the caliphs'
وَأَخْبَارَ: وَ + أَخْبَارَ — wa-, and + akhbār, reports (pl. of khabar, m., acc. object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the reports of'
سَلَفَ: salafa, to go before, precede (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'has gone before'
أَقَمْنَا: aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV hollow, perf. 1p) ; 'we stayed'
لَبَلَغْنَا: لَـ + بَلَغْنَا — la-, surely (the lām of the answer to law) + balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 1p); 'we would reach'
الْمَرَامَ: الـ + مَرَام — marām, aim, goal, desire (m., acc. object); 'the goal'
فَطَوِّلْ: فَـ + طَوِّلْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ṭawwala, to lengthen (verb II, imperative 2ms); 'so lengthen'
وَاصْبِرْفَإِنَّ: وَ + اصْبِرْ + فَـ + إِنَّ — wa-, and + iṣbir, be patient (imperative 2ms of ṣabara) + fa-, for (explaining the command) + inna, indeed (particle); printed as one word, 'and be patient, for'
الْأَعْرَابِ: الـ + أَعْرَاب — aʿrāb, Bedouin (pl., m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the Bedouin'
أَخْذَ: akhdh — taking (verbal noun of akhadha, m., acc. as subject of inna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the taking of'
الثَّأْرِ: الـ + ثَّأْر — thaʾr, blood-vengeance (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the vengeance'
عَلَّمْنَا: ʿallama, to teach (verb II, perf. 1p); 'we have taught'
عَدُوِّنَا: عَدُوّ + نَا — ʿaduww, enemy (m., gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'our enemy'
نَخْتَارُ: nakhtāru — to choose (verb VIII of khāra, impf. 1p); 'we choose'
مُمْتَحَنٌ: mumtaḥan — tried, tested, afflicted (pass. part. of VIII imtaḥana; m. nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'tried'
ثَلٰثُمِائَةٍ: thalāthumiʾa — three hundred (numeral, f., gen. with tanwīn, in the number-phrase); printed without alif, pointed with a dagger alif; 'three hundred'
وَسِتٌّ: وَ + سِتٌّ — wa-, and + sitt, six (numeral, with the shadda; the unit before the tens); 'and six'
وَازْدَدْنَ: وَ + ازْدَدْنَ — wa-, and + izdāda, to increase (verb VIII of zāda, perf. 3fp, or imperative fp); 'and they were increased'
جَوَارِيكَ: جَوَارِي + كَ — jāriya, girl (f.; pl. jawārī, gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -ka, your; 'your girls'
الْمَرْحُومَةِ: الـ + مَرْحُومَة — marḥūma, one granted mercy, the late (pass. part. of I raḥima; f., gen. after maʿa); 'the late'
أَخَذْتُهُنَّ: أَخَذْتُ + هُنَّ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hunna, them (3fp object); 'I took them'
وَأُسَافِرُ: وَ + أُسَافِرُ — wa-, and + sāfara, to travel (verb III, impf. 1s); 'and I travel'
وَالْقُصَّادَ: وَ + الـ + قُصَّاد — wa-, and + qāṣid, courier, messenger (m.; pl. quṣṣād, acc. object); 'and the messengers'
أَطْرَٰفِ: aṭrāf — extremities, edges (pl. of ṭaraf, m., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa); printed without alif (اطرف), pointed with a dagger alif; 'the farthest parts of'
لِيَأْتُوا: لِـ + يَأْتُوا — li-, so that, in order to (particle of purpose + subjunctive) + ʾatā, to come, bring (verb I, subjunctive 3mp, the nūn dropped); 'so that they bring'
بِالْحُكَمَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + حُكَمَاء — bi-, with (prep.; ʾatā bi-, 'bring') + ḥakīm, sage (m.; pl. ḥukamāʾ, gen.); 'with the sages' Also after istadʿā, 'to summon', bi- marks who is sent for; ḥukamāʾ, 'wise men, sages', named beside the aṭibbāʾ, 'physicians': istadʿā bi-al-ḥukamāʾi wa-al-aṭibbāʾi, 'he summoned the sages and the physicians'.
وَأَتَوْهُ: وَ + أَتَوْا + هُ — wa-, and + ʾatā, to come (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him (object); 'and they came to him'
الْحُكَمَاءِ: الـ + حُكَمَاء — ḥakīm, sage (m.; pl. ḥukamāʾ, gen. after min); 'the sages'
وَالْعُلَمَاءِ: وَ + الـ + عُلَمَاء — wa-, and + ʿālim, scholar, learned man (m.; pl. ʿulamāʾ, gen.); 'and the scholars'
أَكْرَمَهُمْ: أَكْرَمَ + هُمْ — akrama, to honour (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them (object); 'he honoured them'
وَوَعَدَهُمْ: وَ + وَعَدَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them (object); 'and he promised them'
الْجَزِيلِ: الـ + جَزِيل — jazīl, abundant, plentiful (adj., m. gen., qualifying al-māl); 'the abundant'
عَلَّمُوا: ʿallama, to teach (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'they taught'
بِالتَّعْلِيمِ: بِـ + الـ + تَعْلِيم — bi-, with (prep.; here the verb awṣā chooses it: awṣā bi-, 'charge with') + al-, the + taʿlīm, teaching (verbal noun of II, gen.); 'with the teaching'
وَالْحِكْمَةِ: وَ + الـ + حِكْمَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥikma, wisdom (f., gen., coordinated with the object of bi-); 'and the wisdom'
وَالْأَدَبِ: وَ + الـ + أَدَب — wa-, and + al-, the + adab, good breeding, polite learning (m., gen., coordinated with the object of bi-); 'and good breeding'
يَجِدْهَا: يَجِدْ + هَا — wajada, to find (I imperf. 3 m.s., jussive after lam) + 3 f.s. object; 'he did not find her'
يُعْلِمْهُ: يُعْلِمْ + هُ — aʿlama, to let know, inform (IV imperf. 3 m.s., jussive after the lam of the preceding wa-lam) + 3ms object; 'let him know'
ضَائِعَةُ: ضَائِع + ة — ḍāʾiʿa, lost, wasted, neglected (active participle of ḍāʿa, f., nom. predicate, first term of an adjectival idāfa); 'lost'
ضَابِطَ: ضَابِط — ḍābiṭ, controller, one who keeps order (active participle of ḍabaṭa, m., acc. without tanwīn after lā of absolute negation); 'a controller'
فَمَاعُدْتُ: فَـ + مَا + عُدْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + mā, not (negation) + ʿudtu, to return, (do) again (I perf. 1cs; with a following imperfect 'no longer ...'); printed as one word; 'so I shall no longer'
يَتَوَكَّلُ: تَوَكَّلَ — tawakkala, to take charge (V imperf. 3 m.s., used with bi-); 'takes charge'
حُزْنُهُ: حُزْن + هُ — ḥuzn, grief (m., nom.) + 3ms; 'his grief'
لِفِرَاقِ: لِـ + فِرَاق — li-, because of, at (prep. of cause: 'at the separation from') + firāq, separation, parting (m., gen., first term of idāfa); 'at the loss of'
يَتَفَقَّدُ: تَفَقَّدَ — tafaqqada, to look in on, inspect, check on (V imperf. 3 m.s.); 'he looks in on'
وَيُكْرِمُهُمْ: وَ + يُكْرِمُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + akrama, to honour (IV imperf. 3 m.s.) + 3 m.pl. object; 'and honours them'
لِيُعَلِّمُوا: لِـ + يُعَلِّمُوا — li-, so that, in order that (purpose, + subjunctive) + yuʿallimū, to teach (II imperf. 3 m.pl., subjunctive with nūn dropped); 'so that they might teach'
لِأَوْلَادِهِ: لِـ + أَوْلَاد + ـهِ — li-, to, for (prep. marking the recipient of the teaching) + awlād, sons, children (pl. of walad, gen.) + 3ms; 'to his sons'
وَحَسَدَ: وَ + حَسَدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥasada, to envy (I perf. 3 m.s.); 'and he envied'
إِخْوَتَهُ: إِخْوَة + هُ — ikhwa, brothers (pl. of akh, acc. object) + 3ms; 'his brothers'
مُتَمَرِّضًا: مُتَمَرِّض — mutamarriḍ, ailing, making oneself out sick (V participle of tamarraḍa, acc. predicate of lam yazal); 'ailing'
أَرَالَ: أَرَى + لَ — evidently أَرَاكَ: arā, to see (I imperf. 1cs) + -ka, you; but the edition prints lām where kāf is expected (misprint or slip); vocalised as printed; 'I see you'
جِسْمِكَ: جِسْم + كَ — jism, body (m., gen. after a preposition, fī or ilā) + 2ms; 'your body'
وَصُفَارًا: وَ + صُفَار — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣufār, yellowness, sallow pallor (m., acc., tamyīz); 'and in yellowness'
تُقَرِّبُ: قَرَّبَ — qarraba, to bring near, draw close (II imperf. 2ms; the shadda is printed in the edition); 'you draw near'
وَأَخَافُ: وَ + أَخَافُ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhāfu, to fear (I imperf. 1cs); 'and I fear'
يَزِيدَ: زَادَ — zāda, to increase, grow (I imperf. 3 m.s., subjunctive after an); 'increases'
فَأَقْتُلَهُمْ: فَـ + أَقْتُلَ + هُمْ — fa-, and so, so that (conj. of result) + aqtula, to kill (I imperf. 1cs, subjunctive) + 3 m.pl. object; 'so that I kill them'
وَتَقْتُلَنِي: وَ + تَقْتُلَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + taqtula, to kill (I imperf. 2ms, subjunctive; the nūn is the nūn of protection) + 1cs object; 'and you kill me'
بِسَبَبِهِمْ: بِـ + سَبَب + هِمْ — bi-, by reason of (prep.) + sabab, cause, reason (m., gen.) + 3 m.pl.; 'because of them'
قَتَلْتُهُمْ: قَتَلَ + تُ + هُمْ — qatala, to kill (I perf.) + -tu, 1cs + -hum, them; 'I killed them'
فَمَرَضُ: فَـ + مَرَض — fa-, so (conj. resuming with the cause) + maraḍ, sickness, illness (m., nom., first term of idāfa; the ḍamma is printed in the edition); 'so the sickness of'
وَتَغَيُّرُ: وَ + تَغَيُّر — wa-, and (conj.) + taghayyur, changing, alteration (m., verbal noun of V, nom., first term of idāfa); 'and the changing of'
تُعْطِيَنِي: تُعْطِيَ + نِي — aʿṭā, to give (IV imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an; the nūn is the nūn of protection) + 1cs object; 'you give me'
قَلْعَةً: قَلْعَة — qalʿa, fortress, citadel (f., acc., tanwīn, second object); 'a fortress'
الْخَارِجِ: الـ + خَارِج — al-, the + khārij, outside, outer part (active participle of kharaja, m., gen. after fī); 'the outside'
أُقِيمُ: أَقَامَ — aqāma, to dwell, stay (IV imperf. 1cs; here a descriptive clause with no relative pronoun, 'where I may dwell'); 'I dwell'
بُعْدِي: بُعْد + ي — buʿd, distance, being far (m., nom. subject) + -ī, my; 'my distance'
وَأَجْمَلُ: وَ + أَجْمَل — wa-, and (conj.) + ajmal, fairer, more beautiful (elative of jamīl, nom.); 'and fairer'
وَقَلْبٌ: وَ + قَلْب — wa-, and (conj.) + qalb, heart (m., nom., tanwīn); 'and a heart'
التَّقْصِيرِ: الـ + تَقْصِير — al-, the + taqṣīr, falling short, shortcoming, neglect (m., verbal noun of II, gen. after min); 'the shortcoming'
أُجِيبُكَ: أَجَابَ + كَ — ajāba, to answer, grant (IV imperf. 1cs) + 2ms object; 'I answer you, I grant you'
قَلْعَةِ: قَلْعَة — qalʿa, fortress, citadel (f., gen. in idāfa); 'the fortress of'
مَلَّكْتُهَا: مَلَّكَ + تُ + هَا — mallaka, to give someone possession of, make an owner (II perf.) + -tu, 1cs + -hā, it (the fortress); 'I have made it a possession'
الْمُوَقِّعِينَ: الـ + مُوَقِّعِين — al-, the + muwaqqiʿīn, secretaries who sign and endorse documents (pl. of muwaqqiʿ, active participle of II, acc. object; the shadda is printed in the edition); 'the secretaries'
بِكِتَابَةِ: بِـ + كِتَابَة — bi-, to, with (prep.; amara bi-, 'command to do', the verb chooses it) + kitāba, writing (verbal noun, f., gen., first term of idāfa); 'to write'
تَقْلِيدِ: تَقْلِيد — taqlīd, investiture, appointment by patent (m., verbal noun of II, gen. in idāfa); 'the investiture of'
وِلَايَةَ: وِلَايَة — wilāya, governorship, province (f., acc., second object of taqlīd, first term of idāfa); 'the governorship of'
وَجَهَّزُوهُ: وَ + جَهَّزَ + وا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jahhaza, to equip, fit out (II perf.) + -ū, 3 m.pl. + 3ms object; 'and they equipped him'
وَأَخَدَ: وَ + أَخَدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhada, to take (I perf. 3 m.s.), printed with dāl for dhāl (Middle Arabic spelling of akhadha); 'and he took'
بِالْمَمْلَكَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَمْلَكَة — bi-, with (prep.; awṣā bi-, 'charge with') + al-, the + mamlaka, kingdom, government (f., gen.); 'with the kingdom'
وَالسِّيَاسَةِ: وَ + الـ + سِيَاسَة — wa-, and + al-, the + siyāsa, statecraft, management of affairs (f., gen., coordinated with the object of bi-); 'and the statecraft'
أُمُورَهُ: أُمُور + هُ — umūr, affairs, matters (pl. of amr, acc., second object) + 3ms; 'his affairs'
وَالْإِقَامَةَ: وَ + الـ + إِقَامَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iqāma, staying, residing (verbal noun of IV, f., acc., coordinated with umūrahu); 'and the staying'
بِالْعَسْكَرِ: بِـ + الـ + عَسْكَر — bi-, with, accompanied by (prep. of accompaniment) + al-, the + ʿaskar, army (m., gen.); 'with the army'
إِلَيْهَادَقَّ: إِلَى + هَا + دَقَّ — ilā, to (prep.; waṣala ilā, 'arrive at') + -hā, it (Damascus) + daqqa, to beat, strike (I perf. 3 m.s.); printed as one word, 'at it, beat'
أَهْلُهَا: أَهْل + هَا — ahl, people, inhabitants (m., nom. subject) + -hā, its; 'its people'
الْكَاسَاتِ: الـ + كَاسَات — al-, the + kāsāt, cymbals, bowl-shaped drums (pl. of kāsa, 'cup', gen.-acc. -āt, object of daqqa); 'the cymbals'
بِالْبُوقَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + بُوقَات — bi-, with, by means of (prep. of means: 'cried out with the trumpets') + al-, the + būqāt, trumpets (pl. of būq, gen.); 'with the trumpets'
وَزَيَّنُوا: وَ + زَيَّنَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.) + zayyana, to adorn, decorate (II perf.) + -ū, 3 m.pl.; 'and they adorned'
وَقَابَلُوهُ: وَ + قَابَلَ + وا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qābala, to meet, receive (III perf.) + -ū, 3 m.pl. + 3ms object; 'and they met him'
بِمَوْكِبٍ: بِـ + مَوْكِب — bi-, with (prep. of means/manner: 'met him with') + mawkib, procession, cavalcade (m., gen., tanwīn); 'with a procession'
سَارَفِيهِ: سَارَ + فِي + هِ — sāra, to go, march (I perf. 3 m.s.) + fī, in (prep.) + -hi, it (the procession); printed as one word; 'in which went'
الْمَيْمَنَةِ: الـ + مَيْمَنَة — al-, the + maymana, right wing of an army (f., gen. in idāfa); 'the right wing'
مَيْمَنَةً: مَيْمَنَة — maymana, right wing (f., acc., tanwīn; ḥāl, 'as a right wing'); 'as a right wing'
وَالْمَيْسَرَةِ: وَ + الـ + مَيْسَرَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + maysara, left wing of an army (f., gen., coordinated with al-maymana, 'the people of' understood); 'and the left wing'
مَيْسَرَةً: مَيْسَرَة — maysara, left wing (f., acc., tanwīn; ḥāl, 'as a left wing'); 'as a left wing'
أَوْلَادَكَ: أَوْلَاد + ـكَ — awlād, children, sons (m., broken pl. of walad, acc. after inna); 'your sons'
تَعَلَّمُوا: taʿallama — to learn (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'they learned, have learned'
وَكَمَّلُوا: وَ + كَمَّلُوا — kammala, to perfect, bring to completion (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'and they perfected'
وَالْحَشْمَةَ: وَ + الـ + حَشْمَة — ḥashma, decorum, dignity of bearing (f., acc.); 'and the decorum'
وَتَرَعْرَعَ: وَ + تَرَعْرَعَ — tarʿaraʿa, to flourish, shoot up, grow (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms); 'and he thrived'
بِالدِّيَانَةِ: بِـ + الـ + دِّيَانَة — bi-, with (prep.; ishtaghala bi- 'be occupied with') + diyāna, religion, piety (f., gen.); 'with piety'
وَالْعِبَادَةِ: وَ + الـ + عِبَادَة — ʿibāda, worship (f., gen., coordinate with the noun governed by bi-); 'and worship'
مُحِبًّا: muḥibb — loving, fond of (act. part. of IV aḥabba; m., acc. with tanwīn, ḥāl); 'a lover'; also as plain object: a-tajfū muḥibban, 'do you shun a lover?' (Night 201)
لِلْفُقَرَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + فُقَرَاء — li-, to, for (prep.; here marks the object of the participle muḥibb 'a lover of') + faqīr, poor man (m., broken pl., gen.); 'of the poor'
وَالْقُرْأَنِ: وَ + الـ + قُرْأَن — qurʾān, the Qurʾān (m., gen.); 'and the Qurʾān'
نِسَاءً: nisāʾ — women (f., pl. of imraʾa, acc. with tanwīn; ḥāl/specification); 'women'
طَافَ: ṭāfa — to go round, make a circuit (verb I, perf. 3ms; with bi- 'make its round through')
مَحْمِلُ: maḥmil — litter, the decorated palanquin sent with the pilgrim caravan (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)
زِيَارَةِ: ziyāra — visit, visiting (f., verbal noun of zāra; gen. as part of an iḍāfa); 'visiting'
مَوْكِبَ: mawkib — procession, cavalcade (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)
سْتَأْذِنَكَ: staʾdhinaka — to ask leave (verb X istaʾdhana, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after li-, its alif dropped after the lām and the word printed apart) + 2ms object; 'to ask your leave'
أَحُجَّ: aḥujja — to make the Pilgrimage (verb I ḥajja, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'that I make the Pilgrimage'
الْقَابِلِ: الـ + قَابِل — qābil, receiving, coming (act. part. of qabila; m., gen.); الْعَامُ الْقَابِلُ 'next year'
أَمْضِي: amḍī — to go (verb I maḍā, imperf. 1cs, indicative); 'I shall go'
أُخْتِهِ: أُخْت + ـهِ — ukht, sister (f., gen.); 'his sister'
تُصَلِّي: tuṣallī — to pray (verb II ṣallā, imperf. 3fs); 'praying'
قَضَتِ: qaḍat — to accomplish, finish (verb I qaḍā, perf. 3fs; a kasra joins it to the following al-)
الصَّلَوٰةَ: الـ + صَّلَوٰة — ṣalāh, prayer (f., acc.; spelled with waw, dagger alif for ā); 'the prayer'
لِلْحَجِّ: لِـ + الـ + حَجّ — li-, for, with respect to (prep.; shawq li- 'longing for') + al-ḥajj, the Pilgrimage (gen.); 'for the Pilgrimage'
وَزِيَارَةِ: وَ + زِيَارَة — ziyāra, visit (f., verbal noun, gen.); 'and the visiting of'
الصَّلَوٰةُ: الـ + صَّلَوٰة — ṣalāh, prayer, blessing (f., nom.; waw with dagger alif); 'the blessing'
وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُ: وَ + اسْتَأْذَنْتُ — istaʾdhana, to ask leave of (verb X, perf. 1cs; takes a direct object); 'and I asked leave of'
فَمَنَعَنِي: فَ + مَنَعَ + نِي — manaʿa, to forbid (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs object; 'and he forbade me'
فَالْمَقْصُودُ: فَ + الـ + مَقْصُود — maqṣūd, intended, the aim (pass. part. of qaṣada; m., nom.); 'so the aim (is)'
وَأَخْرُجَ: وَ + أَخْرُجَ — akhruja, to go out (verb I kharaja, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'and that I go out'
أُعَلِّمْ: uʿallim — to teach, inform (verb II, imperf. 1cs jussive after lam; the shadda is printed; Classical would use IV uʿlim)
أَصْحَبْتَنِي: أَصْحَبْتَ + نِي — aṣḥaba, to take along, make accompany (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1cs object; 'you take me with you'
تَحْرِمْنِي: taḥrim + nī — ḥarama, to deprive (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive after lā) + 1cs object; 'do not deprive me'
فَاخْرُجِي: فَ + اخْرُجِي — fa-, then (apodosis) + ukhruji, go out (verb I kharaja, imperative 2fs); 'then go out'
تُعَلِّمِي: tuʿallimī — to teach, inform (verb II, imperf. 2fs jussive after lā, the print's shadda kept); 'do not inform'
عُمْرِ: ʿumr — age, life (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa)
أَخَاهَا: أَخ + هَا — akh, brother (m., acc., long-vowel noun) + 3fs suffix; 'her brother'
وَأَرْكَبَهَا: وَ + أَرْكَبَ + هَا — arkaba, to make mount, set on a beast (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and he set her up on a beast'
وَاخْتَلَطَا: وَ + اخْتَلَطَا — ikhtalaṭa, to mingle (verb VIII, perf. 3 dual; with bi- 'mingle with'); 'and the two mingled'
بِالْحَجِّ: بِـ + الـ + حَجّ — bi-, with (prep.; ikhtalaṭa bi- 'mix with') + ḥajj, the body of pilgrims (m., gen.); 'with the pilgrims'
الْعِرَاقِيِّ: الـ + عِرَاقِيّ — ʿirāqī, Iraqi (adj., m., gen., nisba of ʿIrāq); 'the Iraqi'
زَالَا: zālā — to cease (verb I zāla, perf. 3 dual); مَا زَالَا 'they did not cease'
سَائِرَيْنِ: sāʾir — travelling (act. part. of sāra; read as dual, acc.; the print سائرين could also be a plural); 'travelling'
الْمُشَرَّفَةَ: الـ + مُشَرَّفَة — musharrafa, ennobled, honoured (pass. part. of II sharrafa; f., acc.); 'the Ennobled'
وَوَقَفَا: وَ + وَقَفَا — waqafa, to stand (verb I, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two stood'
بِعَرَفَاتٍ: بِـ + عَرَفَات — bi-, at (prep.; waqafa bi- 'stand at') + ʿArafāt, the plain near Mecca (gen. with tanwīn); 'at ʿArafāt'
وَقَضَيَا: وَ + قَضَيَا — qaḍā, to accomplish, perform (verb I, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two performed'
مَنَاسِكَ: manāsik — rites (m., pl. of mansak, acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); مَنَاسِكُ الْحَجِّ 'the rites of the Pilgrimage'
أَتَيَا: atayā — to come (verb I, perf. 3 dual); 'the two came'
لِزِيَارَةِ: لِـ + زِيَارَة — li-, for, in order to (prep.; marks purpose) + ziyāra, visiting (f., gen.); 'for the visiting of'
فَزَارَاهُ: فَ + زَارَا + هُ — zāra, to visit (verb I, perf. 3 dual) + 3ms object; 'and the two visited it'
أَرَادَا: aradā — to want, wish (verb IV, perf. 3 dual); 'the two wished'
الْحُجَّاجِ: الـ + حُجَّاج — ḥājj, pilgrim (m., broken pl., gen.); 'the pilgrims'
لِأُخْتِهِ: لِـ + أُخْت + ـهِ — li-, to (prep.; after qāla it marks the person addressed, 'to his sister'; after ḥaṣalat it marks the one affected, 'there befell his sister') + ukht, sister (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'to his sister', 'his sister had'
زِيَارَةُ: ziyāra — visit (f., nom.; subject of a nominal clause); 'a visit'
الْمَقْدِسِ: الـ + مَقْدِس — maqdis, sanctuary, holy place (m., gen.); بَيْتُ الْمَقْدِسِ 'the House of the Holy-place', Jerusalem
وَالْخَلِيلِ: وَ + الـ + خَلِيل — khalīl, friend (m., gen.); 'and the Friend' (of God, i.e. Abraham)
وَاتَّفَقَا: وَ + اتَّفَقَا — ittafaqa, to agree (verb VIII, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two agreed'
وَاكْتَرَى: وَ + اكْتَرَى — iktarā, to hire, rent (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and he hired'
الْمَقَادِسَةِ: الـ + مَقَادِسَة — maqdisī, man of Bayt al-Maqdis (m., pl. maqādisa, gen. after maʿa); 'the Jerusalemites'
وَجَهَّزَا: وَ + جَهَّزَا — jahhaza, to equip, prepare (verb II, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two prepared'
وَتَوَجَّهَا: وَ + تَوَجَّهَا — tawajjaha, to set off, head (verb V, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two set off'
الرَّكْبِ: الـ + رَّكْب — rakb, caravan, riders (m., gen.); 'the caravan'
حُمَّى: ḥummā — fever (f., nom.; ending in alif maqṣūra, no tanwīn shown)
بَارِدَةٌ: bārid — cold (adj., f., nom. with tanwīn); حُمَّى بَارِدَةٌ 'a cold fever, a chill'
فَتَشَوَّشَتْ: فَ + تَشَوَّشَتْ — tashawwasha, to be disturbed, fall unwell (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and she was upset'
شَفَتْ: shafat — to heal, recover (verb I shafā, perf. 3fs; the print omits the yāʾ of Classical shufiyat 'was healed'); 'she recovered'
فَنَزَلَا: فَ + نَزَلَا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + nazala, to alight, put up (verb I, perf. 3 dual); 'so they two alighted'
وَاكْتَرَيَا: وَ + اكْتَرَيَا — wa-, and + iktarā, to hire, rent (Form VIII of كري, final-weak, perf. 3 dual); 'and they two hired'
مَخْزَنًا: مَخْزَن — makhzan, storeroom, magazine (m., acc. indef., object of the hiring); 'a storeroom'
يَتَزَايَدُ: يَتَزَايَدُ — tazāyada, to increase progressively, grow ever greater (Form VI of زيد, imperf. 3ms); 'keeps increasing'
انْحَلَّهُ: انْحَلَّ + ـهُ — inḥalla, to dissolve, waste away (Form VII of حلل, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix; 'it wasted him'; the print marks the shadda
وَأَخُوهَا: وَ + أَخُو + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + akh, brother (m., nom.; the long-vowel form akhū before a suffix) + 3fs suffix; 'and her brother'
تَخْدُمُهُ: تَخْدُمُ + ـهُ — khadama, to serve, attend (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms object suffix; 'serving him'
وَتُنْفِقُ: وَ + تُنْفِقُ — wa-, and + anfaqa, to spend (Form IV of نفق, imperf. 3fs)
فَنَفِدَ: فَ + نَفِدَ — fa-, so + nafida, to run out, be exhausted (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَافْتَقَرَتْ: وَ + افْتَقَرَتْ — wa-, and + iftaqara, to become poor (Form VIII of فقر, perf. 3fs); 'and she became destitute'
دِرْهَمٌ: دِرْهَم — dirham, silver coin (m., nom. indef., in 'not even a dirham')
فَأَرْسَلَتْ: فَ + أَرْسَلَتْ — fa-, so + arsala, to send (Form IV of رسل, perf. 3fs)
صَبِيَّ: صَبِيّ — ṣabiyy, boy, lad, servant (m., acc., object and first term of the construct); 'the boy of'
قُمَاشِهَا: قُمَاش + هَا — qumāsh, cloth, clothing, stuff (m., gen. after min) + 3fs poss.; 'her clothes'
فَبَاعَهُ: فَ + بَاعَهُ — fa-, so + bāʿa, to sell (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix; 'so he sold it'
وَأَنْفَقَتْهُ: وَ + أَنْفَقَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + anfaqa, to spend (Form IV, perf. 3fs) + 3ms object suffix; 'and she spent it'
أَخِيهَا: أَخ + ـهَا — akh, brother (m., gen. after ʿalā; the long form akhī- before a suffix) + 3fs poss.; 'her brother'
بَاعَتْ: بَاعَ — bāʿa, to sell (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she sold'
أَمْتِعَتِهَا: أَمْتِعَة + هَا — matāʿ (pl. amtiʿa), goods, belongings (f. pl. noun, gen. after min) + 3fs poss.; 'her belongings'
فَشَئْاً: فَ + شَئْاً — fa-, then (conj. of succession: 'thing by thing') + shayʾ, thing (m., acc. indef.; the print drops the hamza letter); 'and then a thing'
إِلَّاحَصِيرًا: إِلَّا + حَصِيرًا — illā, except, save (particle of exception) + ḥaṣīr, mat (m., acc. indef.); the edition runs the two words together (الاحصيرا), kept as one word; 'except a mat'
أَخُوهَا: أَخُو + هَا — akh, brother (m., nom., subject; akhū- before a suffix) + 3fs poss.; 'her brother'
حَسَسْتُ: حَسَسْتُ — ḥassa, to sense, perceive, feel (verb I, perf. 1cs; the geminate root حسس, here with the suffix -tu); 'I felt'
بِالْعَافِيَةِ: بِـ + الـ + عَافِيَة — bi-, (the preposition chosen by ḥassa, 'to feel / sense something') + ʿāfiya, health, well-being (f., gen.); 'sensed well-being'
شَيٌّ: شَيّ — shayy, thing (m., nom. indef.; the print drops the hamza of shayʾ, read here smoothed); 'a thing, a bit of'
الْمَشْوِيِّ: الـ + مَشْوِيّ — mashwiyy, roasted, grilled (pass. part. of شوي, adj., gen.); 'the roasted'
لِلشَّحَّاذَةِ: لِـ + الـ + شَّحَّاذَة — li-, for, to (prep.: 'a face for begging') + shaḥḥādha, begging, mendicancy (f., gen.); 'for begging'
وَأَخْدُمُ: وَ + أَخْدُمُ — wa-, and + khadama, to serve (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'and I will serve'
نَقْتَاتُ: نَقْتَاتُ — iqtāta, to sustain oneself, live on (Form VIII of قوت, imperf. 1cp); 'we live on'
أُفَارِقَكَ: أُفَارِقَ + كَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (Form III of فرق, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after an) + 2ms object suffix; 'that I leave you'
أَبَعْدَ: أَ + بَعْدَ — a-, (interrogative particle) + baʿda, after (prep., acc.); 'what, after…?'
تُصْبِحِينَ: تُصْبِحِينَ — aṣbaḥa, to become (Form IV of صبح, imperf. 2fs, the ending -īna marking the feminine); 'you become'
ذَلِيلَةً: ذَلِيلَة — dhalīl, abased, humble (adj., f., acc. indef., predicate of the verb 'become'); 'abased'
مَادَقَّ: مَا + دَقَّ — mā, not (negative of the perfect) + daqqa, to knock (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms); the print runs the two words together; 'has not knocked'
نَمُوتُ: نَمُوتُ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cp); 'we die'
تَبْرَأَ: تَبْرَأَ — baraʾa, to recover, be cured (verb I, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an); the edition prints the precomposed أ; 'you recover'
وَمَكَثَتْ: وَ + مَكَثَتْ — wa-, and + makatha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3fs)
مُتَّكِىًٔ: مُتَّكِئ — muttakiʾ, reclining, leaning (act. part. Form VIII of وكأ, acc. indef., circumstantial); the print writes the final hamza-seat as ى and carries the tanwīn on it; 'reclining'
عَبَاءَةٍ: عَبَاءَة — ʿabāʾa, cloak, wrap (f., gen. indef., second term); 'cloak'
الْجَمَّالِينَ: الـ + جَمَّالِين — jammāl, camel-driver (m., gen. pl. in -īna, second term); 'the camel-drivers'
يَنْتَظِرُهَا: يَنْتَظِرُ + هَا — intaẓara, to wait for (Form VIII of نظر, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs object suffix; 'waiting for her'
تَأْتِ: تَأْتِ — atā, to come (verb I, jussive 3fs after lam, hamza-initial); the edition prints the precomposed أ; 'she did not come'
فَمَكَثَ: فَ + مَكَثَ — fa-, so + makatha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَارْتَجَفَ: وَ + ارْتَجَفَ — wa-, and (conj.) + irtajafa, to tremble, quake (VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and trembled'
لِصَبِيِّ: لِـ + صَبِيّ — li-, to (prep.; ṣāḥa li- 'call to someone', marks the one called) + ṣabiyy, boy, lad (m., gen. in iḍāfa; the iḍāfa to al-ḥān follows); 'to the boy of'
الْحَانِ: الـ + حَان — al-, the + ḥān, khan, inn, caravanserai (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the inn'
أُرِبْدَانْ: أُرِبْدَانْ — misprint (b for y) for أُرِيدُ أَنْ — urīdu an, 'I want that' (arāda, IV, imperf. 1s + an, that); 'I want that'
تَحْمِلَنِي: تَحْمِلَنِي — ḥamala, to carry (imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an) + -nī, me (with the linking nūn al-wiqāya); 'you carry me'
وَأَلْقَاهُ: وَ + أَلْقَى + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + alqā, to throw, cast down (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and threw him down'
الْقُدْسِ: الـ + قُدْس — al-, the + quds, holiness; al-Quds, Jerusalem ('the Holy'), (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'Jerusalem'
فَجَاؤُا: فَ + جَاؤُا — fa-, then (conj.) + jāʾū, to come (perf. 3mp; the edition prints the hamza on wāw followed by alif and omits the usual extra wāw spelling); 'and they came'
وَأَطْعَمُوهُ: وَ + أَطْعَمُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭʿama, to feed (IV, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and fed him'
إِيَّاهُ: إِيَّا + هُ — iyyā-, the carrier of an independent object pronoun + -hu, it (the second object of aṭʿama); 'it'
وَوَضَعُوهُ: وَ + وَضَعُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + waḍaʿa, to put, place (perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they placed him'
وَفَرَشُوا: وَ + فَرَشُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + farasha, to spread out, lay out (perf. 3mp); 'and spread'
بَرْشٍ: بَرْش — barsh, matting, rug, mat (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'matting'
إِبْرِيقًا: إِبْرِيقًا — ibrīq, ewer, jug (m., acc. as object of waḍaʿū); 'a ewer'
هَمَّهُ: هَمّ + هُ — hamm, care, worry, trouble (m., acc. as object of ḥamalū) + -hu, his; 'his trouble' Also object of the participle ḥāmil: ḥāmilun hammahu, 'sharing his care'.
أُخْتَهُ: أُخْت + هُ — ukht, sister (f., acc. as object) + -hu, his; 'his sister'
فِضَّةً: فِضَّةً — fiḍḍa, silver (f., acc., appositive/specification of the dirhams); 'of silver'
وَاكْتَرَوْا: وَ + اكْتَرَوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + iktarā, to hire, rent (VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and hired'
وَأَوْصِلْهُ: وَ + أَوْصِلْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + awṣala, to bring to, convey (IV, imperative 2ms) + -hu, him; 'and convey him'
وَأَدْخِلْهُ: وَ + أَدْخِلْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + adkhala, to bring in, admit (IV, imperative 2ms) + -hu, him; 'and put him into'
الْمَارَسْتَانَ: الـ + مَارَسْتَان — al-, the + mārastān, hospital (m., from Persian bīmāristān; acc. as the place entered); 'the hospital'
يَبْرَأُ: يَبْرَأُ — bariʾa, to recover, be cured (imperf. 3ms indic.); 'recovers'
وَيَطِيبُ: وَ + يَطِيبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭāba, to be good, be well (imperf. 3ms indic.); 'and is well'
أَلْقَاهُ: أَلْقَى + هُ — alqā, to throw, cast down (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'threw him'
مَزْبَلَةِ: مَزْبَلَة — mazbala, rubbish heap, dunghill (f., gen. after ʿalā, in iḍāfa); 'the rubbish heap of'
مُسْتَوْقَدِ: مُسْتَوْقَد — mustawqad, place of kindling a fire, furnace, stokehold (m., gen. in iḍāfa; from istawqada, X); 'the furnace of'
وَقَّادُ: وَقَّاد — waqqād, one who kindles the fire, stoker (m., nom. as subject; intensive noun of waqada); 'the stoker of'
لِأَىِّ: لِـ + أَيّ — li-, for, why (prep.; lī-ayyi shayʾin 'for what thing' = 'why?') + ayy, which, what (interrogative, m., gen. in iḍāfa); the edition prints ى with shadda for the yāʾ; 'for what'
مَايَرْمُونَ: مَايَرْمُونَ — mā, not (here with the following illā: 'only') + yarmūna, ramā, to throw (imperf. 3mp indic.); printed as one word; 'they do not throw'
إِلَّاهُنَا: إِلَّا + هُنَا — illā, except, but (particle of exception) + hunā, here (adv.); printed as one word; 'except here'
وَرَفَصَهُ: وَ + رَفَصَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + rafaṣa, to kick (perf. 3ms; the edition's spelling for rafasa) + -hu, him; 'and kicked him'
فَتَحَرَّكَ: فَ + تَحَرَّكَ — fa-, and then (conj.) + taḥarraka, to move, stir (V, perf. 3ms); 'and he stirred'
الْوَقَّادُ: الـ + وَقَّاد — al-, the + waqqād, stoker (m., nom. as subject); 'the stoker'
الْوَاحِدُ: الـ + وَاحِد — al-, the + wāḥid, one (m., nom.); al-wāḥid minkum 'each one of you'
حَشِيشٍ: حَشِيش — ḥashīsh, hashish, cannabis (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of hashish'
فَرَآهُ: فَ + رَآ + هُ — fa-, and then (conj.) + raʾā, to see (perf. 3ms; the edition prints the hamza + madda) + -hu, him; 'and saw him'
بَهَاءٍ: بَهَاء — bahāʾ, splendour, radiance (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'splendour'
فَأَخَذَتْهُ: فَ + أَخَذَتْ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + akhadha, to seize, take (perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'so seized him'
وَغَرِيبٌ: وَ + غَرِيب — wa-, and (conj.) + gharīb, stranger, foreigner (m. sg., nom.); 'and a stranger'
خَطِيئَةِ: خَطِيئَة — khaṭīʾa, sin, fault, offence (f., gen. after fī, in iḍāfa); the edition prints the hamza; dakhaltu fī khaṭīʾa 'I have fallen into sin'
أَوْصَى: أَوْصَى — awṣā, to charge, commend (IV, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for what is commended); 'enjoined'
النَّبِيُّ: الـ + نَّبِيّ — al-, the + nabiyy, prophet (m., nom. as subject); 'the Prophet'
بِإِكْرَامِ: بِـ + إِكْرَام — bi-, with, to (prep.; awṣā bi- 'commend, enjoin something': it marks what is enjoined) + ikrām, honouring, treating generously (m., verbal noun of IV, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the honouring of'
وَأَمَرَهَا: وَ + أَمَرَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + amara, to command (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and told her'
تَخْدُمَهُ: تَخْدُمَ + هُ — khadama, to serve, wait on (imperf. 3fs, subj. after an) + -hu, him; 'that she serve him'
وَتَفْرُشَ: وَ + تَفْرُشَ — wa-, and (conj.) + farasha, to spread (imperf. 3fs, subj. after an); 'and spread'
فَفَرَشَتْ: فَ + فَرَشَتْ — fa-, so (conj.) + farasha, to spread (perf. 3fs); 'so she spread'
وِسَادَةً: وِسَادَةً — wisāda, pillow, cushion (f., acc. as object); 'a cushion'
وَوَجْهَهُ: وَ + وَجْهَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + wajh, face (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his face'
مَاوِ: مَاوِ — māʾ, water (m.; the edition spells the hamza with wāw, gen. in iḍāfa after min); 'water of'
وَالسُّكَّرِ: وَ + الـ + سُّكَّر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + sukkar, sugar (m., gen.); 'and sugar'
وَسَقَاهُ: وَ + سَقَى + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + saqā, to give to drink (perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and gave him to drink'
وَأَلْبَسَهُ: وَ + أَلْبَسَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + albasa, to clothe, dress (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and dressed him'
فَشَمَّ: فَ + شَمَّ — fa-, and then (conj.) + shamma, to smell, scent (perf. 3ms); 'and he smelled'
نَسِيمَ: نَسِيم — nasīm, breeze, breath (m., acc., in iḍāfa); 'the breeze of'
وَتَوَجَّهَتْ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tawajjaha, to turn toward (V, perf. 3fs); 'and turned'
وَاتَّكَأً: وَ + اتَّكَأً — wa-, and (conj.) + ittakaʾa, to lean, recline (VIII, perf. 3ms); the print has a tanwīn on the final hamza, kept; 'and reclined'
الْمَخَدَّةِ: الـ + مَخَدَّة — al-, the + makhadda, cushion, bolster (f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the cushion'
عَافِيَةِ: عَافِيَة — ʿāfiya, well-being, recovery (f., gen. in iḍāfa after ʿalā); 'the well-being of'
أَسْأَلُكَ: أَسْأَلُ + كَ — saʾala, to ask (imperf. 1s indic.; first alif the 1s prefix with its hamza unwritten, the second the root hamza printed) + -ka, you (God); 'I ask You'
بِسِرِّكَ: بِـ + سِرّ + كَ — bi-, by (prep. of oath/petition: 'I ask You by …') + sirr, secret (m., gen.) + -ka, Your; 'by Your secret'
الْمَكْنُونِ: الـ + مَكْنُون — al-, the + maknūn, hidden, concealed (passive participle of kanna, m. sg., gen.); 'the hidden'
تَجْعَلَ: تَجْعَلَ — jaʿala, to make, cause (imperf. 2ms, subj. after an); 'that You make'
سَلَامَةَ: سَلَامَة — salāma, safety, well-being (f., acc. as object, in iḍāfa); 'the safety of'
الْمُ————بَاحِ: الـ + مُبَاح — al-, the + mubāḥ, permitted, lawful (passive participle of abāḥa, IV; m., gen.); the edition breaks the word with a run of dashes (al-mu————bāḥ); 'the permitted'
الْوَقَّادَ: الـ + وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker (m., acc. after anna); 'the stoker'
حَيْوَةَ: ḥayāh, life (f., acc.), here in the older spelling with waw; object of 'make'
يَتَعَهَّدُهُ: taʿahhada — look after, tend (verb V, imperf. 3rd m. sg.) + ـهُ, him; 'tending him'
وَهُوَيَسْقِيهِ: وَ + هُوَ + يَسْقِي + ـهِ — wa-, and + huwa, he + saqā, give to drink (imperf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hi, him; printed as one word, 'and he was giving him to drink'
الْخِلَافِ: الـ + خِلَاف — khilāf, willow, the Egyptian willow (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the willow'
وَيَتَعَطَّفُ: وَ + يَتَعَطَّفُ — wa-, and + taʿaṭṭafa, show tenderness (verb V, imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he showed tenderness'
وَيَتَلَطَّفُ: وَ + يَتَلَطَّفُ — wa-, and + talaṭṭafa, be gentle, be kind (verb V, imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he was gentle'
سَرَتِ: sarā — creep, spread through (verb, perf. 3rd f. sg., with helping kasra); 'it crept'
الصِّحَّةُ: الـ + صِحَّة — ṣiḥḥa, health (f., nom.); 'the health'
النَّشٰطِ: الـ + نَشَاط — nashāṭ, liveliness, vigour (m., gen.; printed short, النشط); 'the liveliness'
فَرَارِيجَ: farārīj — chickens (m. pl., gen. of the broken plural of فَرُّوج, gen. here with diptote ending after a numeral); 'chickens'
بَحِي: baḥī — second half of the split imperative idhbaḥī (dhabaḥa, slaughter; imper. f. sg.); 'slaughter!'
وَآخِرَ: وَ + آخِر — wa-, and (conj.) + ākhir, last part, end (m., acc. adverbial; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and at the end of'
وَذَبَحَتْ: وَ + ذَبَحَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhabaḥa, slaughter (verb, perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'and she slaughtered'
فَرُّوجًا: farrūj — chicken, young fowl (m., acc. tanwīn); 'a chicken'
وَسَلَقَتْهُ: وَ + سَلَقَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + salaqa, boil (verb, perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and she boiled it'
وَأَطْعَمَتْهُ: وَ + أَطْعَمَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭʿama, feed (verb IV, perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she fed him'
مَرَقَتَهُ: مَرَقَة + ـهُ — maraqa, broth (f., acc.) + -hu, its; 'its broth'
مَاوْ: māʾ — water (m.); printed ماو with waw, an irregular spelling of ماء; 'water'
وَغَطَّتْهُ: وَ + غَطَّتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghaṭṭā, cover (verb II, perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and she covered him'
بِمِلَاءَةٍ: بِـ + مِلَاءَة — bi-, with (prep., of instrument) + milāʾa, wrap, sheet (f., gen. tanwīn); 'with a sheet'
وَسَلَقَتْ: وَ + سَلَقَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + salaqa, boil (verb, perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'and she boiled'
وَفَسَخَتْهُ: وَ + فَسَخَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fasakha, pull apart, dismember (verb, perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and she pulled it apart'
تُطْعِمُهُ: aṭʿama — feed (verb IV, imperf. 3rd f. sg.) + ـهُ, him; 'she feeds him'
الْعَافِيَةِ: الـ + عَافِيَة — ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f., gen.); 'the well-being'
بِشَرَابِ: بِـ + شَرَاب — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- = 'bring') + sharāb, syrup, drink (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the syrup of'
وَمَاءِ: وَ + مَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + māʾ, water (m., gen. after the same bi-); 'and the water of'
فَيَشْتَرِي: فَـ + يَشْتَرِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + ishtarā, buy (verb VIII, imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he buys'
بِدِرْهَمٍ: بِـ + دِرْهَم — bi-, for, at the price of (prep.) + dirham, silver coin (m., gen. tanwīn); 'for a dirham'
وَشَرَابَ: وَ + شَرَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + sharāb, syrup (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the syrup of'
وَيَشْتَرِي: وَ + يَشْتَرِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ishtarā, buy (verb VIII, imperf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he buys'
يُلَاطِفُهُ: lāṭafa — treat kindly (verb III, imperf. 3rd m. sg.) + ـهُ, him; 'he treated him kindly'
تَوَجَّهَتْ: tawajjaha — turn toward (verb V, perf. 3rd f. sg.); 'it turned'
بِعَافِيَةِ: بِـ + عَافِيَة — bi-, at (prep.; fariḥa bi- = 'rejoice at') + ʿāfiya, well-being (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'at the recovery of'
بِمُكَارِى: بِـ + مُكَارِى — bi-, with (prep.; here the verb أَتَى بِـ 'bring' takes it: brought a muleteer) + mukārī, muleteer, donkey-hirer (m., gen.; printed with final ى); 'with a muleteer'
وَأَرْكَبَهُ: وَ + أَرْكَبَ + هُ — wa-, and + arkaba, cause to ride, mount (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and he mounted him'
يُسْنِدُهُ: يُسْنِدُ + هُ — yusnidu, lean (something) on, prop up (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. impf.) + -hu, him; 'propping him up'
الْحَمَّامِ: الـ + حَمَّام — ḥammām, bath, bathhouse (m., gen.); 'the bath'
فَأَجْلَسَهُ: فَـ + أَجْلَسَ + هُ — fa-, and so + ajlasa, seat (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. perf.) + -hu, him; 'and he seated him'
وَأَدْخَلَ: وَ + أَدْخَلَ — wa-, and + adkhala, cause to enter, lead in (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he led in'
الْمُسْتَوْقَدِ: الـ + مُسْتَوْقَد — mustawqad, place where a fire is kindled, furnace room of a bath (m., gen.); 'the furnace room'
سِدْرًا: sidr — lote-tree, its leaves ground for washing (m., acc. indef.); 'lote-leaf'
وَدُقَاقًا: وَ + دُقَاق — wa-, and + duqāq, fine powder, meal (m., acc. indef.); 'and a fine powder'
لِضَوْءِ: لِـ + ضَوْءِ — li-, to (prep.; here marks the one addressed after قَالَ) + ḍawʾ, light, brightness (m., gen.; first part of the name Ḍawʾ al-Makān); 'to Ḍawʾ'
اللَّهِ: Allāh — God (gen., second term of an iḍāfa)
جَسَدَكَ: جَسَد + كَ — jasad, body (m., acc.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your body'
وَإِيَّاهُ: وَ + إِيَّاهُ — wa-, and + iyyāhu, him (independent object pronoun, here 'together with him'); 'and he himself'
الْوَقَّادُ: الـ + وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker, one who keeps the fire (m., nom.); 'the stoker'
يَحُكُّ: yaḥukku — scrub, rub (verb, 3rd m. sg. impf.); 'scrubbing'
بِالسِّدْرِ: بِـ + الـ + سِدْر — bi-, with (prep., of the means) + al-, the + sidr, lote-leaf (m., gen.); 'with the lote-leaf'
وَالدُّقَاقِ: وَ + الـ + دُقَاق — wa-, and + al-, the + duqāq, fine powder (m., gen. after bi-); 'and the fine powder'
بِبَلَّانٍ: بِـ + بَلَّان — bi-, with (prep.; after wa-idhā of surprise it only marks what appears, 'behold, a …') + ballān, bath-attendant (m., gen. indef.); 'behold, an attendant'
مُعَلِّمُ: muʿallim — master, teacher, boss (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the master of'
الْوَقَّادَ: الـ + وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker (m., acc.); 'the stoker'
يَغْسِلُهُ: يَغْسِلُ + هُ — yaghsilu, wash (verb, 3rd m. sg. impf.) + -hu, him; 'washing him'
وَيَحُكُّ: وَ + يَحُكُّ — wa-, and + yaḥukku, scrub (verb, 3rd m. sg. impf.); 'and scrubbing'
الْبَلَّانُ: الـ + بَلَّان — ballān, bath-attendant (m., nom.); 'the attendant'
نَقْصٌ: naqṣ — deficiency, shortcoming (m., nom. indef.); 'a shortcoming'
حَقِّ: ḥaqq — right, due (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the right of'
الْمُعَلِّمِ: الـ + مُعَلِّم — muʿallim, master, boss (m., gen.); 'the master'
الْمُعَلِّمَ: الـ + مُعَلِّم — muʿallim, master (m., acc. after inna); 'the master'
غَمَرَنَا: غَمَرَ + نَا — ghamara, flood, overwhelm (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.) + -nā, us; 'he overwhelmed us'
فَشَرَعَ: فَـ + شَرَعَ — fa-, and so + sharaʿa, begin (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and so he began'
اغْتَسَلَ: ightasala — wash oneself, bathe (verb VIII, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he bathed'
وَالْوَقَّادُ: وَ + الـ + وَقَّاد — wa-, and + al-, the + waqqād, stoker (m., nom.); 'and the stoker'
رَفِيعًا: rafīʿ — fine, thin, high-quality (adj. m., acc. indef.); 'fine'
وَثَوْبًا: وَ + ثَوْب — wa-, and + thawb, garment, robe (m., acc. indef.); 'and a garment'
وَعِمَامَةً: وَ + عِمَامَة — wa-, and + ʿimāma, turban (f., acc. indef.); 'and a turban'
لَطِيفَةً: laṭīfa — delicate, dainty, fine (adj. f., acc. indef.); 'dainty'
وَحِزَامًا: وَ + حِزَام — wa-, and + ḥizām, belt, girdle (m., acc. indef.); 'and a belt'
وَلَفَّ: وَ + لَفَّ — wa-, and + laffa, wind, wrap (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he wound'
شَدَّ: shadd — binding, wrapping, a scarf or neck-cloth (m., printed without the alif of the accusative); 'a binding'
الْوَقَّادِ: الـ + وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker (m., gen.); 'the stoker'
ذَبَحَتْ: dhabaḥat — slaughter (verb, 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'she slaughtered'
فَرُّوجَيْنِ: farrūj — young chicken, pullet (m., dual acc.); 'two chickens'
وَطَبَخَهُمَا: وَ + طَبَخَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + ṭabakha, cook (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf., as printed) + -humā, them two; 'and cooked them'
السُّكَّرُ: الـ + سُكَّر — sukkar, sugar (m., nom.); 'the sugar'
قَدَّمَ: qaddama — present, set before (verb II, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he set before'
السُّفْرَةَ: الـ + سُفْرَة — sufra, dining-cloth, spread (f., acc.); 'the dining-cloth'
يَفْسَخُ: yafsakhu — tear apart, dismember (verb, 3rd m. sg. impf.); 'tearing apart'
الْفَرَارِيجِ: الـ + فَرَارِيج — farārīj, young chickens (m. broken pl. of farrūj, gen. after min); 'the chickens'
وَيُطْعِمُهُ: وَ + يُطْعِمُ + هُ — wa-, and + yuṭʿimu, feed (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. impf.) + -hu, him; 'and feeding him'
وَيَسْقِيهِ: وَ + يَسْقِي + هِ — wa-, and + yasqī, give to drink (verb, 3rd m. sg. impf.) + -hi, him; 'and giving him to drink'
الْمَسْلُوقَةِ: الـ + مَسْلُوقَة — maslūqa, boiled (passive participle f., gen.); 'the boiled' (the boiled meat or its broth)
وَحَمِدَ: وَ + حَمِدَ — wa-, and + ḥamida, praise (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'and he praised'
لِلْوَقَّادِ: لِـ + الـ + وَقَّاد — li-, to (prep.; marks the one addressed after قَالَ) + al-, the + waqqād, stoker (m., gen.); 'to the stoker'
مَنَّ: manna — bestow a favour (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.; مَنَّ عَلَى 'show favour to'); 'he favoured'
النِّعْمَةِ: الـ + نِعْمَة — niʿma, blessing, prosperity (f., gen.); 'the prosperity'
أُخْبِرَكَ: أُخْبِرَ + كَ — ukhbira, inform (verb IV, 1st sg. subjunctive) + -ka, you; 'that I may inform you'
أَمَّا: ammā — as for (particle introducing a topic, answered by fa-)
تَوَجَّهْتُ: tawajjahtu — turn toward, head for (verb V, 1st sg. perf.); 'I headed'
وَجَدْتُكَ: وَجَدْتُ + كَ — wajadtu, find (verb, 1st sg. perf.) + -ka, you; 'I found you'
مَرْمِيًّا: marmiyy — thrown (passive participle m., acc. indef., circumstantial); 'thrown'
الْقُمَامَةِ: الـ + قُمَامَة — qumāma, rubbish, sweepings (f., gen.); 'the rubbish'
الصُّبْحِ: الـ + صُبْح — ṣubḥ, morning, dawn (m., gen.); 'the dawn'
رَمَاكَ: رَمَى + كَ — ramā, throw (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.) + -ka, you; 'he threw you' Also with bi- of the instrument, 'to strike (someone) with': وَبِشَرِّهِ رَمَاكَ 'and struck you down with its evil'.
فَأَخَذْتُكَ: فَـ + أَخَذْتُ + كَ — fa-, and so + akhadtu, take (verb, 1st sg. perf.) + -ka, you; 'so I took you'
حِكَايَتِى: حِكَايَة + ي — ḥikāya, story, tale (f., nom.) + -ī, my (printed with final ى); 'my story'
يُحْيِي: yuḥyī — give life to, revive (verb IV, 3rd m. sg. impf.); 'gives life'
إِنَّكَ: إِنَّ + كَ — inna, indeed + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'indeed you'
إِلَّامَعَ: إِلَّا + مَعَ — illā, except, only (particle) + maʿa, with (prep.); 'only with' (printed as one word)
وَسَتَجْنِي: وَ + سَـ + تَجْنِي — wa-, and + sa-, will (future particle) + tajnī, pick, gather, reap (verb, 2nd m. sg. impf.); 'and you will reap'
ثَمَرَةَ: thamara — fruit (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the fruit of'
فَعِنْدَهُ: فَـ + عِنْدَ + هُ — fa-, and so + ʿinda, at (prep.) + -hu, him; printed in place of the usual فَعِنْدَ ذَلِكَ 'and at that'; 'and at him'
تَذَكَّرَ: tadhakkara — remember (verb V, 3rd m. sg. perf.); 'he remembered'
غُرْبَتَهُ: غُرْبَة + هُ — ghurba, exile, being a stranger far from home (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his exile'
فِرَاقَ: firāq — separation, parting (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the parting from'
وَبَاحَ: وَ + بَاحَ — wa-, and + bāḥa, disclose, divulge (verb, 3rd m. sg. perf.; بَاحَ بِـ 'divulge'); 'and he disclosed'
بِسِرِّهِ: بِـ + سِرّ + هِ — bi-, of (prep.; the verb بَاحَ بِـ 'divulge' takes it) + sirr, secret (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his secret'
حَمَّلُونِي: حَمَّلُونِي — حَمَّلَ + ـُوا + نِي — ḥammala, II to load, burden (3mp perf.) + 1s object suffix; 'they loaded me'
طَاقَتِي: طَاقَتِي — طَاقَة + ـِي — ṭāqa, capacity, strength (f., gen. as second term) + 1s possessive; 'my capacity'
أَجْلِهِمْ: أَجْلِهِمْ — أَجْل + هِمْ — ajl, cause, sake (m., gen. after min) + 3mp suffix; min ajlihim = 'because of them'
قِيَامَتِي: قِيَامَتِي — قِيَامَة + ـِي — qiyāma, resurrection, the Rising, hence uproar or reckoning (f., nom., subject) + 1s possessive; 'my day of reckoning'
اَلاَفَارْ: اَلاَفَارْ — garbled in the print; probably أَلَا ارْفُقُوا, a-lā, 'ho!' + irfuqū, 'be gentle' (rafaqa, to treat gently), wrongly divided. See the verse note.
فَقُوا: فَقُوا — garbled in the print; probably the tail of ارْفُقُوا (irfuqū, imp. 2mp, 'be gentle'). See the verse note.
يَاهَا: يَاهَا — garbled in the print; probably يَا + the first half of هَاجِرُونَ: yā, O (vocative) + hā-. See the verse note.
جِرُونَ: جِرُونَ — garbled in the print; probably the second half of هَاجِرُونَ, hājirūna, 'you who forsake' (hajara, to leave; m. sound pl.). See the verse note.
فَقَدْرَقَّ: فَقَدْرَقَّ — فَ + قَدْ + رَقَّ — fa-, for, so (conj.) + qad (particle, 'has indeed') + raqqa, to grow tender, take pity (3ms perf.); printed as one word; 'for he has softened'
بَعْدِكُمْ: بَعْدِكُمْ — بَعْد + كُمْ — baʿd, after, absence (m., gen. after min) + 2mp suffix; 'after you, in your absence'
شَامِتِ: شَامِتِ — shāmit, gloater, one who rejoices at another's misfortune (active part. of shamita; m. sing.; the print gives a kasra without tanwīn, where the nominative is expected); 'gloater'
تَبْخَلُوْا: تَبْخَلُوْا — tabkhalū, bakhila, to be stingy (2mp, jussive after lā); 'be stingy'
تَسْمَحُوْا: تَسْمَحُوْا — tasmaḥū, samaḥa, to allow, grant (2mp subjunctive after an); 'that you allow'
تُخَفِّفُ: تُخَفِّفُ — tukhaffifu, khaffafa, II to lighten, ease (3fs imperfect, the glance being the subject); 'it lightens'
اَحْوِ: اَحْوِ — garbled in the print; probably the beginning of أَحْوَالِي, aḥwālī, 'my states' (aḥwāl, pl. of ḥāl, state, condition). See the verse note.
اِلِيْ: اِلِيْ — garbled in the print; probably the end of أَحْوَالِي (-lī, 'my'), wrongly divided. See the verse note.
وَفَرْطَ: وَفَرْطَ — وَ + فَرْط — wa-, and (conj.) + farṭ, excess, extremity (m., acc. in the print; first term of an annexation); 'and the excess of'
سَانَتْ: سَانَتْ — obscure in the print; perhaps a slip for صَانَتْ (ṣānat, 'guarded') or for a verb of grief or wrong; left unglossed. See the verse note.
فُؤَادِى: فُؤَادِى — فُؤَاد + ي — fuʾād, heart (m.) + 1s possessive; the print writes the yā' as ى; 'my heart'
اِلَيْكَ: اِلَيْكَ — إِلَى + كَ — ilā, to (prep.) + 2ms suffix, used as an interjection; 'Away with you!'
الصَّبْرَ: الصَّبْرَ — الـ + صَبْر — ṣabr, patience (m., acc. as noun of inna); 'the patience' Also acc. as the noun of laʿalla: laʿalla al-ṣabra, 'perhaps patience'. Also acc. as object: ukābidu al-ṣabra, 'I wrestle with patience'.
بُكَائِهِ: بُكَائِهِ — بُكَاء + هِ — bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen. after fī) + 3ms possessive; 'his weeping'
لَاتَبْكِ: لَاتَبْكِ — لَا + تَبْكِ — lā, not (negative with the jussive) + tabki, bakā, to weep (2ms jussive); printed as one word; 'do not weep'
وَاحْمَدِ: وَاحْمَدِ — وَ + احْمَدِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iḥmadi, ḥamida, to praise, thank (imp. 2ms; helping kasra before the article); 'and thank'
وَالْعَافِيَةِ: وَالْعَافِيَةِ — وَ + الـ + عَافِيَة — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f., gen.); 'and the well-being'
تُرْسِلَنِي: تُرْسِلَنِي — تُرْسِلَ + نِي — tursila, arsala, IV to send (2ms subjunctive after an) + 1s object suffix; 'that you send me'
يَاسَيِّدِى: يَاسَيِّدِى — يَا + سَيِّد + ي — yā, O (vocative) + sayyid, master, lord (m.) + 1s possessive, with the yā' printed ى; printed as one word; 'O my lord'
أَدَعُكَ: أَدَعُكَ — أَدَعُ + كَ — adaʿu, wadaʿa/daʿa, to leave, let (1s imperfect) + 2ms object suffix; 'I leave you, I let you'
وَأَطَاعَتْنِي: وَأَطَاعَتْنِي — وَ + أَطَاعَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭāʿat, IV aṭāʿa, to obey (3fs perf.) + 1s object suffix; 'and she obeyed me'
وَسَافَرَتْ: وَسَافَرَتْ — وَ + سَافَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + sāfarat, III sāfara, to travel (3fs perf.); 'and she travelled'
لَايَهُونُ: لَايَهُونُ — لَا + يَهُونُ — lā, not (negative) + yahūnu, hāna, to be easy, light (3ms imperfect); printed as one word; 'it is not easy'
تُسَافِرِي: تُسَافِرِي — tusāfirī, III sāfara, to travel (2fs subjunctive after an, the -na dropped); 'that you travel'
أَوْتَكُونِي: أَوْتَكُونِي — أَوْ + تَكُونِي — aw, or (conj.) + takūnī, kāna, to be (2fs subjunctive); printed as one word; 'or you be'
مُقِيمَةً: مُقِيمَةً — muqīma, staying, resident (active part. of IV aqāma; f., acc. as predicate, indef.); 'staying'
أُوصِلَ: أُوصِلَ — uwṣila, IV awṣala, to bring to arrival, convey (1s subjunctive after ḥattā); 'until I bring'
وَأَعُودَ: وَأَعُودَ — وَ + أَعُودَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿūda, ʿāda, to return (1s subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and I return'
فِرَاقُهُ: فِرَاقُهُ — فِرَاق + هُ — firāq, parting (m., nom., subject) + 3ms possessive; 'his parting'
الْمُوَافَقَةِ: الْمُوَافَقَةِ — الـ + مُوَافَقَة — muwāfaqa, agreement, consent (verbal noun of III wāfaqa; f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the agreement'
وَتَمَّ: وَتَمَّ — وَ + تَمَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + tamma, to be completed (3ms perf.); 'and it was completed'
أَمْتِعَتَهُ: أَمْتِعَتَهُ — أَمْتِعَة + هُ — amtiʿa, goods, belongings (pl. of matāʿ; acc., object) + 3ms possessive; 'his goods'
وَأَمْتِعَةَ: وَأَمْتِعَةَ — وَ + أَمْتِعَة — wa-, and (conj.) + amtiʿa, goods (acc.; first term of an annexation); 'and the goods of'
الم—باح: الم—باح — printed truncated and hyphenated in the archive and kept as is: الم + em dash + باح. It stands for الْمُبَاحِ, al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted' (pass. part. of IV abāḥa), the last word of the closing formula 'she fell silent from the permitted speech'.
اتَّفَقَا: اِتَّفَقَا — ittafaqā, they (m. dual) agreed (form VIII perfect of وَفَقَ)
اشْتِيَاقِي: اِشْتِيَاق + ي — ishtiyāq, longing (verbal noun, form VIII) + -ī, my; 'my longing'
اعْتَادَ: اِعْتَادَ — iʿtāda, he became accustomed (form VIII perfect of عَادَ); takes عَلَى here
اكْتَرَى: اكْتَرَى — iktarā, he hired (form VIII perfect of كَرَى)
التَّقْدِمَةُ: الْـ + تَقْدِمَة — al-, the + taqdima, present, offering (f.); nom. as predicate of the question 'to whom is this …?'
الْمَسْئُولُ: الْـ + مَسْئُول — al-, the + masʾūl, asked, 'the asked one' (passive participle of سَأَلَ); nom.
الْوَقَّادِ: الْـ + وَقَّاد — al-, the + waqqād, stoker, fire-tender (m.); gen. (after إِلَى, or in construct after زَوْجَةُ)
اِصْطَبْلِ: اِصْطَبْل — iṣṭabl, stable (m.); in construct with the following word (gen.)
أَنَّهُمَا: أَنَّ + هُمَا — anna, that (conj.) + -humā, they two (dual suffix); 'that the two of them'
إِرْسَالَهَا: إِرْسَال + هَا — irsāl, sending (verbal noun, form IV, of أَرْسَلَ) + -hā, her/it (gen. suffix, the gift); 'the sending of it'
بِاجْتِمَاعِي: بِـ + اجْتِمَاع + ي — bi-, with (prep.; here قَضَى بِـ 'decree …') + ijtimāʿ, coming together (verbal noun, form VIII) + -ī, my; 'decree my meeting'
بِفَضْلِهِ: بِـ + فَضْل + هِ — bi-, by, through (prep.) + faḍl, bounty, favour (m.) + -hi, his; 'by His bounty'
تَحْلُو: تَحْلُو — taḥlū, she/it is sweet (imperfect of حَلَا); 'is not sweet' after لَيْسَ
تَخْدِمُهُ: تَخْدِمُ + هُ — takhdimu, she serves (imperfect of خَدَمَ) + -hu, him; 'she used to serve him' after كَانَتْ
تَغَرْغَرَتْ: تَغَرْغَرَتْ — tagharghara, it brimmed/gurgled (perfect, 3rd f. sg., form II quadriliteral of غَرْغَرَ) + -t, she/it; said of eyes filling with tears
جَمَالُكُمْ: جَمَال + كُمْ — jamāl, beauty (m.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your beauty'
جِمَالًا: جِمَالًا — jimāl, camels (pl. of جَمَل); acc. object of وَجَدَا
حَزِينًا: حَزِينًا — ḥazīn, sorrowful (adj.); acc. as the second object/circumstance after وَجَدَهُ, 'found him grieving'
حَزْنًا: حُزْنًا — ḥuzn, grief (m.); acc. as cognate object (absolute), 'grieved a grief'
خَرَاجِ: خَرَاج — kharāj, tribute, tax revenue (m.); in construct (gen. after مَعَ)
دَاخِلُونَ: دَاخِلُونَ — dākhilūna, entering, going in (active participle of دَخَلَ, masc. pl. nom.); predicate of إِنَّنَا
رَأْيُكَ: رَأْي + كَ — raʾy, opinion (m.) + -ka, your; 'your opinion'
فَاللَّهُ: فَـ + اللَّه — fa-, so, for (conj. introducing the consequence) + Allāh, God (nom., subject)
فَحَيَاتِي: فَـ + حَيَاة + ي — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥayāh, life (f.) + -ī, my; 'so my life'
لِيَنْشَرِحَ: لِـ + يَنْشَرِحَ — li-, so that (purpose particle with the subjunctive) + yanshariḥa, it may be eased/opened (form VII, subjunctive, of شَرَحَ)
مَرِضَتْ: مَرِضَتْ — mariḍat, she fell ill (perfect, 3rd f. sg., of مَرِضَ)
مُحَمَّلِينَ: مُحَمَّلِينَ — muḥammalīna, loaded (passive participle, form II, of حَمَلَ; masc. pl. acc.); describing جِمَالًا
مُسَرَّجَةً: مُسَرَّجَةً — musarraja, saddled (passive participle, form II, of سَرَجَ; f. sg. acc.); describing جَنَائِبَ
هَرْجٍ: هَرْج — harj, tumult, turmoil (m.); gen. after فِي
وَالْأَقْمِشَةُ: وَ + الـ + أَقْمِشَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aqmisha, cloths, stuffs (pl. of قُمَاش); nom., joined to the subject
وَالْجِمَالُ: وَ + الـ + جِمَال — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + jimāl, camels (pl. of جَمَل); nom., joined to the subject
وَانْتَقَلَتْ: وَ + انْتَقَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + intaqalat, she moved, passed over (form VII perfect, 3rd f. sg., of نَقَلَ)
وَأَرْكَبَ: وَ + أَرْكَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + arkaba, he made ride, set on a mount (form IV perfect of رَكِبَ)
وَبَخَاتِيَ: وَ + بَخَاتِيَ — wa-, and (conj.) + bakhātī, Bactrian (two-humped) camels (pl. of بُخْتِيّ, diptote); acc.
وَجَنَائِبَ: وَ + جَنَائِبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + janāʾib, led horses (pl. of جَنِيبَة, diptote); acc.
وَزَوْجَتَهُ: وَ + زَوْجَة + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + zawja, wife (f.) + -hu, his; 'and his wife' (acc., joined to الْوَقَّادَ)
وَعَبِيدًا: وَ + عَبِيدًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of عَبْد); acc.
وَفَرْشًا: وَ + فَرْشًا — wa-, and (conj.) + farsh, furnishings, bedding (m.); acc.
وَقُمَاشًا: وَ + قُمَاشًا — wa-, and (conj.) + qumāsh, goods, cloth, stuffs (m.); acc.
وَمَرْجٍ: وَ + مَرْج — wa-, and (conj.) + marj, confusion (m.; rhymes with هَرْج); gen., joined to هَرْجٍ
وَمَمَالِيكَ: وَ + مَمَالِيكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + mamālīk, mamluks (pl. of مَمْلُوك, diptote); acc.
وَنَتَفَرَّجَ: وَ + نَتَفَرَّجَ — wa-, and (conj.) + natafarraja, we may take a stroll, amuse ourselves (form V, subjunctive after أَنْ, of فَرَجَ)
وَيُزِيلُ: وَ + يُزِيلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuzīlu, He removes (form IV imperfect of زَالَ)
يَاتُرَى: يَا + تُرَى — yā, O (particle) + turā, it is seen (passive imperfect of رَأَى); the stock phrase 'I wonder', printed as one word
يَمْضِيَانِ: يَمْضِيَانِ — yamḍiyāni, they (m. dual) go, proceed (imperfect of مَضَى)
يُعَوِّضُ: يُعَوِّضُ — yuʿawwiḍu, He compensates, makes up (form II imperfect of عَاضَ)
صَدَّقْنَا: ṣaddaqnā, we believed (perfect, 1 pl.; form II, 'to hold true'; root ṣ-d-q)
جَاوَتْكَ: jāwat- (printed so; an unclear verb, perhaps a slip for jāʾat 'came' or jāwazat 'passed over', 3 f. sg.) + -ka (you, m. sg. acc.) — 'came to you'
فَطِبْ: fa- (so, then) + ṭib, be good (imperative of ṭāba, 'be pleasant'; root ṭ-y-b) — 'so be of good (cheer)'
وَلَاتَبْكِ: wa- (and) + lā (do not; with jussive) + tabki, you weep (jussive, 2 m. sg.; root b-k-y) — 'and do not weep'
النَّكْسَةِ: al- (the) + naksa, relapse, setback (f.) — 'of the relapse' (gen. after mina)
وَيُمَازِحُهُ: wa- (and) + yumāziḥu, he jokes with (imperfect, form III, root m-z-ḥ) + -hu (him)
وَضَوْءُ: wa- (and, while; circumstantial) + ḍawʾu, light (m.; nom.) — 'and Ḍawʾ'; also: 'and the light (of)': wa-ḍawʾu mubtasimi, 'and the light of a smiling mouth' (verse, Night 183)
يَتَنَهَّدُ: yatanahhadu, he sighs (imperfect, 3 m. sg.; form V, root n-h-d)
وَيَتَحَسَّرُ: wa- (and) + yataḥassaru, he grieves, laments (imperfect, form V; root ḥ-s-r)
غُرْبَتِهِ: ghurba, exile, being far from home (f.) + -tihi (his) — 'his exile'
وَيُرْسِلُ: wa- (and) + yursilu, he sends forth, lets flow (imperfect, form IV; root r-s-l)
الْعَبَرَاتِ: al- (the) + ʿabarāt, tears (f. pl.; sg. ʿabra) — 'the tears'
تَزَوَّدْ: tazawwad, provision yourself, take provisions (imperative, 2 m. sg.; form V, root z-w-d)
رَاحِلُ: rāḥil, departing, setting out (active participle of raḥala; m. sg.) — 'departing' (as predicate)
نَازِلُ: nāzil, descending, alighting, befalling (active participle; m. sg.) — 'about to come down (upon you)'
وَحَسْرَةٌ: wa- (and) + ḥasra, regret, anguish (f.; nom. tanwīn) — 'and regret'
وَعَيْشُكَ: wa- (and) + ʿaysh, living, life (m.) + -ka (your) — 'and your life'
وَبَاطِلُ: wa- (and) + bāṭil, vain, false, void (m.) — 'and vain'
كَمَنْزِلِ: ka- (like, as; prep.) + manzil, halting-place, lodging (m.; gen.) — 'like the camp of'
اَنَاخَ: anākha, he made (his camel) kneel, he halted (perfect, form IV; root n-w-kh)
عِشِيًّا: ʿishiyyan, in the evening (adv. acc., from ʿashiyy; tanwīn) — 'at evening'
وَيَنْتَحِتُ: wa- (and) + yantaḥitu, printed so; likely a slip for yantaḥibu, he sobs (imperfect, form VII; root n-ḥ-b) — 'and sobs'
وَالْوَقَّادُ: wa- (and, while) + al- (the) + waqqād, stoker (m.; nom.) — 'while the stoker'
يَتَلَطَّفُ: yatalaṭṭafu, he treats gently, is kind (imperfect, form V; root l-ṭ-f; takes bi-, 'be gentle with') — 'he is gentle'
بِضَوْءِ: bi- (with, toward; the verb yatalaṭṭafu bi- chooses it) + ḍawʾi (Ḍawʾ; gen.) — 'with Ḍawʾ' (al-Makān follows); after wa-idhā of surprise the bi- only marks who appears: wa-idhā bi-ḍawʾi al-makāni kharaja 'and behold, Ḍawʾ al-Makān went out'
تَذَكَّرْتَ: tadhakkarta, you remembered (perfect, 2 m. sg.; form V; root dh-k-r)
أَسْتَطِيعُ: astaṭīʿu, I am able (imperfect, 1 sg.; form X, root ṭ-w-ʿ)
