وَأَسْتَوْدِعُكَ: wa- (and) + astawdiʿu, I entrust (imperfect, 1 sg.; form X, root w-d-ʿ) + -ka (you) — 'and I commit you (to God)'
هَؤُلَا: hāʾulāʾ, these (demonstrative pron., pl. 'these'; the print gives ؤ and drops the final hamza)
وَأَمْشِي: wa- (and) + amshī, I walk (imperfect, 1 sg.; root m-sh-y)
أَصِلَ: aṣila, I arrive (subjunctive after an, 1 sg.; root w-ṣ-l)
أُتَمِّمَهَا: utammima, I complete (subjunctive after an, 1 sg.; form II, root t-m-m) + -hā (it, f.) — 'complete it'
بِخِدْمَتِي: bi- (by, by means of; prep.) + khidma, service (f.) + -tī (my) — 'by my service'
بِسَفَرِ: bi- (at; the verb fariḥa bi-, 'to rejoice at' chooses bi-) + safar, travelling, journey (m.; gen.) — 'at the travelling of'
وَعَبَّى: wa- (and) + ʿabbā, he packed, made up (a load) (perfect, form II; Middle Arabic for ʿabbaʾa; printed with ى)
تَعِبْتَ: taʿibta, you grew tired (perfect, 2 m. sg.; root t-ʿ-b)
مُكَافَأَتِكَ: mukāfaʾa, repaying, requital (verbal noun, form III; f.) + -tika (your) — 'repaying you' (ʿalā, 'to' repay)
يَفْعَلُهُ: yafʿalu, he does (imperfect, 3 m. sg.) + -hu (it) — 'does it'
فَحَمَلَا: fa- (and so) + ḥamalā, they (two) loaded, carried (perfect, 3 m. dual; root ḥ-m-l)
وَأَمْتِعَتَهُمَا: wa- (and) + amtiʿa, goods, baggage (pl. of matāʿ) + -humā (their two) — 'and their baggage'
وَسَافَرَا: wa- (and) + sāfarā, they (two) travelled (perfect, 3 m. dual; form III, root s-f-r)
وَالْوَقَّادِ: wa- (and) + al- (the) + waqqād, stoker (m.; gen.) — 'and the stoker'
الْتَفَّتْ: iltaffat, she wrapped herself (perfect, 3 f. sg.; form VIII, root l-f-f; the edition prints the shadda)
بِالْعَبَاءَةِ: bi- (in, with; prep.; iltaffa bi-, 'wrap oneself in') + al- (the) + ʿabāʾa, cloak (f.) — 'in the cloak'
تَخْدُمَ: takhduma, she serves (subjunctive after an; root kh-d-m)
وَتَشْتَرِيَ: wa- (and) + tashtariya, she buys (subjunctive, 3 f. sg.; form VIII, root sh-r-y)
لِأَخِيهَا: li- (for; prep.) + akh, brother (m.) + -ihā (her) — 'for her brother'
اشْتَهَاهُ: ishtahā, he craved, desired (perfect, form VIII; root sh-h-w) + -hu (it) — 'what he craved'
تَتَوَجَّهُ: tatawajjahu, she heads for, turns toward (imperfect, form V; root w-j-h)
وَتَفَكَّرَتِ: wa- (and) + tafakkarati, she thought of, called to mind (perfect, 3 f. sg.; form V, root f-k-r; printed with kasra before al-)
الْأَهْلَ: al- (the) + ahl, family, people (m.; acc.) — 'the family'
وَالْأَوْطَانَ: wa- (and) + al- (the) + awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan; acc.) — 'and the homelands'
تَتَضَرَّعُ: tataḍarraʿu, she supplicates (imperfect, 3 f. sg.; form V, root ḍ-r-ʿ)
دَفْعِ: dafʿ, repelling, warding off (verbal noun; m.; gen.) — 'in warding off' (fī, 'for the sake of')
الْبَلِيَّاتِ: al- (the) + baliyyāt, afflictions, calamities (f. pl. of baliyya) — 'the afflictions'
بِالسَّقَمِ: bi- (with, by; prep., here of accompaniment) + al- (the) + saqam, sickness (m.) — 'with the sickness'
حَرَّكَ: ḥarraka, he moved, stirred (perfect, form II; root ḥ-r-k)
الْا: al- (the) + ā, the first fragment of a word the print divides: al-ā + āmi make al-ālāmi, 'the pains' (pl. of alam; a lām seems to have dropped out)
آمِ: ām, the second fragment (printed آمِ, gen.); joined with the preceding al-ā it reads al-ālām, 'the pains'
وَلَوْعَةُ: wa- (and) + lawʿa, anguish, burning pain (f.; nom.) — 'and the anguish of'
الْاحْشَاءِ: al- (the) + aḥshāʾ, entrails, innards (f. pl.; gen. after fī; the print marks no hamza) — 'the entrails'
سَكَنَتْ: sakanat, she/it settled, dwelt (perfect, 3 f. sg.; root s-k-n) Also 'grew calm, was stilled': sakanat nafsuhu, 'his spirit grew calm'.
صَيَّرَنِي: ṣayyara, he made, turned into (perfect, form II; root ṣ-y-r) + -nī (me) — 'made me'
اقْلَقَنِي: aqlaqa, he disquieted, unsettled (perfect, form IV; root q-l-q) + -nī (me) — 'unsettled me'
اَحْرَقَنِي: aḥraqa, he burned (perfect, form IV; root ḥ-r-q) + -nī (me) — 'burned me'
وَالدَّمْعُ: wa- (and) + al- (the) + damʿ, tear(s), weeping (m.; nom.) — 'and the tear'
مُكْتَتِمِ: muktatim, concealed, hidden (passive participle of iktatama; printed gen. -i for the rhyme) — 'concealed'
اعْرِفُهَا: aʿrifu, I know (imperfect, 1 sg.; root ʿ-r-f) + -hā (it, f.) — 'that I know'
تُزَحْزِحَ: tuzaḥziḥa, it/she removes, shifts (subjunctive, form Q; root z-ḥ-z-ḥ); the subject is not stated, perhaps the stratagem — 'until it shifts'
فَنَارُ: fa- (for, so) + nār, fire (f.; nom.) — 'so the fire of'
بِالْاَشْوَاقِ: bi- (with, by; prep.) + al- (the) + ashwāq, longings (pl. of shawq; m.) — 'with the longings'
مُوقَدَةٌ: mūqada, kindled, set alight (passive participle of awqada; f. nom. tanwīn) — 'kindled'
يَظَلُّ: yaẓallu, he remains, continues (imperfect, 3 m. sg.; root ẓ-l-l)
الصَّبُّ: al- (the) + ṣabb, lover, one smitten (m.; nom.)
نِقَمِ: niqam, torments, afflictions (pl. of niqma; gen. after fī) — 'torments'
خُطَّ: khuṭṭa, it was written, drawn (passive perfect, 3 m. sg.; root kh-ṭ-ṭ) — 'was written'
بِالْحُبِّ: bi- (by; prep. of oath) + al- (the) + ḥubb, love (m.; gen.) — 'by love'
سُلْوَةٌ: suluwa, consolation, forgetting, solace (f.; nom. tanwīn)
اَهْلِ: ahl, people, folk (m.; gen. in annexation) — 'of the people of'
مَبْرُورَةُ: mabrūra, fulfilled, kept, sworn true (passive participle of barra; f. nom.; in annexation) — 'fulfilled'
الْقَسَمِ: al- (the) + qasam, oath, swearing (m.; gen.) — 'in swearing'
بَلِّغْ: ballagh, convey, deliver (imperative, 2 m. sg.; form II, root b-l-gh)
رُوَاةَ: ruwāta, transmitters, reciters (pl. of rāwī; acc. as object of ballagh, or as vocative-like address) — 'the transmitters of'
وَاشْهَدْ: wa- (and) + ishhad, bear witness (imperative, 2 m. sg.; root sh-h-d)
اَنَمِ: anam, I sleep (jussive, 1 sg.; root n-w-m; the final kasra is a rhyme-vowel) — 'I slept'
أَمِنَ: amina, to be safe, secure (3 m. sg. perfect); here 'I may be safe', with عَلَى 'as to'
اسْتَأْمَنْتُكَ: اسْتَأْمَنَ + تُ + كَ — ista'mana, to trust, put oneself in the safe-keeping of (form X) + -tu, I + -ka, you (obj.); 'I trusted you'
الرَّفِيقِ: الـ + رَفِيق — rafīq, companion, travelling-companion (m., gen.); 'the companion'
الشَّرْطَ: الـ + شَرْط — sharṭ, condition (m., acc.); 'the condition'
الْأَحْزَانَ: الـ + أَحْزَان — aḥzān, griefs (pl. of ḥuzn, m., acc. object of the verb); 'the griefs'
الْبَدَوِيَّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — badawī, Bedouin, desert-dweller (m., acc. after أَنَّ); 'the Bedouin'
الْبَدَوِيِّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — badawī, Bedouin (m., gen. after إِلَى); 'the Bedouin'
الْبَدْوِ: الـ + بَدْو — badw, the Bedouin, desert-dwellers (collective, gen. after مِنَ); 'the Bedouin'; also gen. after ladā; with al-ḥaḍr, 'desert folk and town folk'
الْجِبَالَ: الـ + جِبَال — jibāl, mountains (pl. of jabal, acc.); 'the mountains'
الْحَيَاءِ: الـ + حَيَاء — ḥayāʾ, modesty, shame (m., gen. after مِنَ, 'out of'); 'the modesty'
الْخِدْمَةِ: الـ + خِدْمَة — khidma, service (f., gen. after عَلَى); 'the service'
الْعَقْلَ: الـ + عَقْل — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., acc. object); 'the mind'
الْقَفِرَةِ: الـ + قَفِرَة — qafira, desolate, barren (f. adj., gen., agrees with الْجِبَالِ treated as a fem. singular); 'the desolate'
الْمِسْكِينَةِ: الـ + مِسْكِينَة — miskīna, poor one, wretched (f., gen., governed by the بِـ of the preceding بِهَذِهِ: وَقَعَ بِـ 'fall upon', so bi- means 'upon'); 'the poor girl'
الْهِجَانَ: الـ + هِجَان — hijān, high-bred (white) camels (collective, acc. object); 'the thoroughbred camels'
الْهِجَانِ: الـ + هِجَان — hijān, high-bred camels (collective, gen. after عَنْ); 'the thoroughbred camels'
أَخِيكِ: أَخ + كِ — akh, brother (m., gen. after إِلَى) + -ki, your (f.); 'your brother'
أَصْغَرُهُنَّ: أَصْغَر + هُنَّ — aṣghar, youngest, smaller (elative, nom.) + -hunna, of them (f. pl.); 'the youngest of them'
أَلَكِ: أ + لَكِ — a-, question particle + li-, to, for (prep.) + -ki, you (f.); 'have you?' (the hamza of the question is unprinted)
أَوْسَمِعْتُكِ: أَوْ + سَمِعْتُ + كِ — aw, or + samiʿa, to hear (1 sg. perfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'or I hear you'
أُخْتُ: ukht, sister (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'sister of'
أُرِيدُكِ: أُرِيد + كِ — arāda, to want (form IV; 1 sg. imperfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'I want you'
إِخْوَانِهَا: إِخْوَان + هَا — ikhwān, brothers, siblings (pl. of akh, gen. after عَلَى) + -hā, her; 'her siblings'
إِلَّاعَابِرَ: إِلَّا + عَابِر — illā, except, but + ʿābir, passer-by (act. part., acc. predicate of كَانَ, first term of an iḍāfa); 'nothing but a passer-by of'; printed as one word
بُنَيَّةُ: بُنَيَّة — bunayya, little daughter, my child (dim. of bint, f., vocative); 'O little daughter'
بِالْجِمَالِ: بِـ + الـ + جِمَال — bi-, with (prep.; سَيَّرَ بِـ 'set (animals) going') + al-, the + jimāl, camels (pl. of jamal, gen.); 'with the camels'
بِحَيَاتِكَ: بِـ + حَيَاة + كَ — bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ḥayāh, life (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your life'
بِرُفْقَتِهِ: بِـ + رُفْقَة + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; اجْتَمَعَ بِـ 'meet up with') + rufqa, company, party of travellers (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his company'
بِمَطْلُوبِي: بِـ + مَطْلُوب + ي — bi-, with (prep.; فَازَ بِـ 'win, obtain') + maṭlūb, that which is sought (pass. part., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my object'
تَبْكِينَ: bakā, to weep (2 f. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'you (f.) weep'
تَعَرَّضَ: taʿarraḍa, to present oneself to, come in the way of (form V; 3 m. sg. perfect, with لَـ 'to'); 'he put himself in her way'
تَهْلِكِي: halaka, to perish (2 f. sg. subjunctive after إِلَى أَنْ); 'you perish'
تُجَا: first half of the split تُجَاوِبِينَنِي: tujāwibīnanī, 'you answer me back'; with the following وِبِينَنِي
تُجَدِّدْ: jaddada, to renew, make new (form II; 2 m. sg. jussive after لَا, 'do not'); 'renew'
تُعَذِّبُنِي: تُعَذِّبُ + نِي — ʿadhdhaba, to torment, torture (form II; 2 m. sg. imperfect) + -nī, me; 'you torture me'
جَعَلْتُكِ: جَعَلَ + تُ + كِ — jaʿala, to make, place (1 sg. perfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'I made / I will make you'
جَمِيلَةً: jamīla, beautiful (f. adj., acc. as ḥāl / second object of 'saw'); 'beautiful'
جَهَنَّمَ: Jahannam, Hell (gen., second term of an iḍāfa)
جَهَّزُوا: jahhaza, to make ready, equip (form II; 3 m. pl. perfect); 'they prepared'
حَضَرِيَّةُ: ḥaḍariyya, townswoman, settled (not nomadic) (f. adj. used as a noun, nom. in apposition after the vocative)
حَقِيرَةً: ḥaqīra, contemptible, despised (f. adj., acc., second predicate of أَصْبَحَ); 'despised'
دُمُوعَهَا: دُمُوع + هَا — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, acc. object) + -hā, her; 'her tears'
رَأَيْتُكِ: رَأَى + تُ + كِ — raʾā, to see (1 sg. perfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'I see you'
رُزِقْتُ: ruziqa, to be provided with, granted (passive; 1 sg. perfect); 'I was given'
زِنَاءٍ: zināʾ, fornication, adultery (m., gen. indefinite); 'of fornication'
سَكَتَتْ: sakata, to fall silent (3 f. sg. perfect); 'she fell silent'
سَيَّرُوا: sayyara, to set in motion, send on (form II; 3 m. pl. perfect, with بِـ 'set (animals) going'); 'they set going'
شَيْبَةَ: shayba, grey hair, hoary old age (f., acc. vocative, first term of an iḍāfa); 'O grey-hair of'
ضَرَبْتُكِ: ضَرَبَ + تُ + كِ — ḍaraba, to beat, strike (1 sg. perfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'I will beat you'
طَرْطُورِي: طَرْطُور + ي — ṭarṭūr, tall pointed cap (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my cap'
طَوْقِهَا: طَوْق + هَا — ṭawq, collar, neck-opening (m., gen. after فِي) + -hā, her; 'her collar'
ظَاهِرِهَا: ظَاهِر + هَا — ẓāhir, outside, outskirts (m., gen. after إِلَى) + -hā, its; 'its outside'
عَرَبٍ: ʿarab, Arabs (collective, gen. indefinite, second term of an iḍāfa); 'of Arabs'
عَزِيزَةً: ʿazīza, honoured, dear (f. adj., acc. predicate of كَانَ); 'honoured'
عِزِّهَا: عِزّ + هَا — ʿizz, honour, glory (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her honour'
غَدَرْتَنِي: غَدَرَ + تَ + نِي — ghadara, to betray (2 m. sg. perfect) + -nī, me; 'you betrayed me'
غَرَّهَا: غَرَّ + هَا — gharra, to deceive (3 m. sg. perfect) + -hā, her; 'he deceived her'
غَرِيبَةً: gharība, stranger, foreign woman (f., acc. as predicate/ḥāl); 'a stranger'
فَانْقُلِيهِ: فَـ + اِنْقُلِي + هِ — fa-, then (conj. in a conditional answer) + inqul, carry (imperative, f. sg.; naqala) + -hi, him; 'then bring him'
فَانْكَبَّتْ: فَـ + اِنْكَبَّتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + inkabba, to fall prone, throw oneself down (form VII; 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she threw herself down'
فَأَصْبَحْتُ: فَـ + أَصْبَحْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aṣbaḥa, to become (form IV; 1 sg. perfect); 'and I have become'
فَتَشْتَغِلَ: فَـ + تَشْتَغِلَ — fa-, so that (conj. followed by subjunctive) + ishtaghala, to be busy (form VIII; 3 f. sg. subjunctive); 'so that she be busied'
فَرَأَهَا: فَـ + رَأَى + هَا — fa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see (3 m. sg. perfect) + -hā, her; 'and he saw her'
فَسَبَقُوهُ: فَـ + سَبَقُوا + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + sabaqa, to go ahead of (3 m. pl. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and they went ahead of him'
فَكَفَّ: فَـ + كَفَّ — fa-, and so (conj.) + kaffa, to hold back, desist (3 m. sg. perfect, with عَنْ 'from'); 'and he held back'
فُزْتُ: fāza, to win, succeed (1 sg. perfect, with بِـ 'win something'); 'I have won'
فِيصِهَا: second half of the split قَرَا فِيصِهَا: (قَرَا)فِيص + هَا — apparently qarāfīṣ, haunches or squatting-place (obscure) + -hā, her; with the preceding قَرَا, 'her haunches' (a guess)
قَاطِعَ: qāṭiʿ, cutter (act. part., m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'cutter of'
قَتَلْتُكِ: قَتَلَ + تُ + كِ — qatala, to kill (1 sg. perfect) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'I will kill you'
قَسَا: qasā, to be hard (3 m. sg. perfect); 'was hardened'
قَشَفٍ: qashaf, squalor, hardship (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'of squalor'
قُدْ: first half of the split قُدْ امَهَا: qudām-, 'in front of' (see next word)
كَرِهَتِ: kariha, to hate, dislike (3 f. sg. perfect, with elided final vowel before الْحَيَاةَ); 'she hated'
كُسِّكِ: كُسّ + كِ — kuss, cunt (m., vulgar; gen. after فِي) + -ki, your (f.); 'your cunt'
كُورَةَ: kūra, an abusive term of address, sense uncertain (f., acc. vocative, first term of an iḍāfa); 'O kūra of'
لَانَتْ: lāna, to grow soft, yield (3 f. sg. perfect); 'she yielded'
لَايَعْرِفُ: لَا + يَعْرِفُ — lā, not + ʿarafa, to know (3 m. sg. imperfect); 'he will not know'; printed as one word
لِأَسْأَلَكِ: لِـ + أَسْأَلَ + كِ — li-, in order to (purpose lām, + subjunctive) + asʾala, to ask (1 sg. subjunctive) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'in order that I ask you'
لِتُؤَا: first half of the split لِتُؤَانِسِيهَا: لِـ + تُؤَانِسِي + هَا — li-, in order that (purpose lām) + tuʾānisī, 'you keep company' (see next word)
لِتُؤَانِسِي: لِـ + تُؤَانِسِي — li-, in order that (purpose lām, + subjunctive) + ʾānasa, to keep company (form III; 2 f. sg. subjunctive); 'that you keep company'
لِسَانَكِ: لِسَان + كِ — lisān, tongue (m., acc. object) + -ki, your (f.); 'your tongue'
لِيَسْأَلَهَا: لِـ + يَسْأَلَ + هَا — li-, in order to (purpose lām, + subjunctive) + saʾala, to ask (3 m. sg. subjunctive) + -hā, her (obj.); 'to ask her'
مَكْرٍ: makr, cunning, guile (m., gen. second term of an iḍāfa); 'of cunning'
مَمْلُوكَةٌ: mamlūka, owned one, slave-girl (f. pass. part., nom.); 'owned, a slave'
مُسَافِرٍ: musāfir, traveller (act. part., m., gen. indefinite); 'travelling'
مُسَافِرُونَ: musāfir, travelling (act. part., m. pl. nom. predicate); 'travelling'
نِسِيهَا: second half of the split لِتُؤَا نِسِيهَا: (تُؤَا)نِسِي + هَا — (tuʾā)nisī, 'you keep company' + -hā, her; with the preceding لِتُؤَا, 'that you keep her company'
وَآلَمَهَا: وَ + آلَمَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ālama, to pain, hurt (form IV; 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hā, her; 'and it pained her'
وَاغْتِرَابِهِمَا: وَ + اِغْتِرَاب + هِمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ightirāb, exile, being far from home (m. verbal noun form VIII, gen.) + -himā, the two of them; 'and the exile of them both'
وَالزَّادَ: وَ + الـ + زَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + zād, provisions (m., acc.); 'and the provisions'
وَأَجْعَلَكِ: وَ + أَجْعَلَ + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + jaʿala, to place (1 sg. subjunctive after أَنْ) + -ki, you (f. obj.); 'and place you'
وَتَبِعَتْهُ: وَ + تَبِعَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tabiʿa, to follow (3 f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and she followed him'
وَتَصِيرِينَ: وَ + تَصِيرِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣāra, to become (2 f. sg. imperfect); 'and you become'
وَتَصْرُخُ: وَ + تَصْرُخُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣarakha, to cry out (3 f. sg. imperfect); 'and crying out'
وَتَفَكَّرَتْ: وَ + تَفَكَّرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tafakkara, to think, reflect (form V; 3 f. sg. perfect); 'and she thought'
وَتَلْتَفِتُ: وَ + تَلْتَفِتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iltafata, to turn about (form VIII; 3 f. sg. imperfect); 'and turning about'
وَتَمَنَّتِ: وَ + تَمَنَّتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + tamannā, to wish for (form V; 3 f. sg. perfect, vowel before الْمَوْتَ); 'and she wished for'
وَجَنَاتِهَا: وَجَنَات + هَا — wajanāt, cheeks (pl. of wajna, f., gen. after عَلَى) + -hā, her; 'her cheeks'
وَحَرَامِيًّا: وَ + حَرَامِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥarāmī, robber, thief (m., acc. predicate of كَانَ); 'and a thief'
وَحَمَّلُوا: وَ + حَمَّلُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥammala, to load (form II; 3 m. pl. perfect); 'and they loaded'
وَحِيَلٍ: وَ + حِيَل — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥiyal, wiles, tricks (pl. of ḥīla, gen.); 'and wiles'
وَخَائِنَ: وَ + خَائِن — wa-, and (conj.) + khāʾin, betrayer (act. part., m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and betrayer of'
وَدَسَّتُهُ: وَ + دَسَّتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + dassa, to shove, thrust (1 sg. perfect, in the contracted form dassatu) + -hu, it; 'and I will shove it'
وَذُلِّهَا: وَ + ذُلّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + dhull, abasement (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her abasement'
وَقَبَّلَتْهُمَا: وَ + قَبَّلَتْ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + qabbala, to kiss (form II; 3 f. sg. perfect) + -humā, the two of them; 'and she kissed them both'
وَلَكِنَّهَا: وَ + لَكِنَّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but (takes its subject in the accusative) + -hā, she; 'but she'
وَنَادَاهَا: وَ + نَادَى + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + nādā, to call (form III; 3 m. sg. perfect) + -hā, her; 'and he called her'
وَهَيَّأُوا: وَ + هَيَّأُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + hayyaʾa, to make ready (form II; 3 m. pl. perfect); 'and they made ready'
وَوَافَقَتْهُ: وَ + وَافَقَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + wāfaqa, to agree with (form III; 3 f. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'and she agreed with him'
وَوَحْدَتِهِ: وَ + وَحْدَة + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + waḥda, solitude, loneliness (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his loneliness'
وَيَسَارًا: وَ + يَسَار — wa-, and (conj.) + yasār, left (m., acc. adverbial); 'and left'
وَيُلِينُ: وَ + يُلِينُ — wa-, and (conj.) + alāna, to soften (form IV; 3 m. sg. imperfect); 'and softening'
وِبِينَنِي: second half of the split تُجَا وِبِينَنِي: (تُجَا)وِب + ِينَ + نِي — (tujā)wibī-na, you answer (2 f. sg. imperfect) + -nī, me; with the preceding تُجَا, 'you answer me back'
يَرَاهُمْ: يَرَى + هُمْ — raʾā, to see (3 m. sg. subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hum, them; 'that he see them'
يَشْتُمُهَا: يَشْتُمُ + هَا — shatama, to curse, revile (3 m. sg. imperfect) + -hā, her; 'cursing her'
يُحَدِّثُهَا: يُحَدِّثُ + هَا — ḥaddatha, to talk to, tell (form II; 3 m. sg. imperfect) + -hā, her; 'talking to her'
يُطَيِّبُ: ṭayyaba, to sweeten, put at ease (form II; 3 m. sg. imperfect); 'sweetening'
أَوْصَالُ: awṣāl — pl. of waṣl, joint, limb, connection (m., nom.); 'limbs, bonds' (pausal -u, printed أَوْصَالُ)
الدُّنْيَالَهُ: الـ + دُنْيَا + لَهُ — al-dunyā, the world (f., gen.); lahu: li-, to, for (prep.) + -hu, it/him (the edition prints the two words as one, الدنيا له); 'of the world, it has…'
الشَّعِيرِ: الـ + شَعِير — shaʿīr, barley (m., gen. in apposition); 'the barley'
الضَّيْمَ: الـ + ضَيْم — ḍaym, injustice, wrong, injury (m., acc.); 'the injury'
الْفَاحِشِ: الـ + فَاحِش — fāḥish, obscene, outrageous, foul (active participle of faḥasha, adj., m., gen.); 'the obscene'
الْقُرْصِ: الـ + قُرْص — qurṣ, disc, round loaf (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the loaf'
الْمَبْ—احُ: الـ + مَبْ—احُ — a damaged or fragmentary printed word; al-, the, + letters م ب, a dash, ا ح; not recoverable (perhaps al-ṣabāḥ, 'the morning'); kept as printed
انْصَرَمَتْ: ا + نْصَرَمَتْ — inṣarama, to be cut off, to come to an end (VII, perf. 3 f. sg., -at); 'they (f. sg., i.e. the hopes) were cut off'
اَجَالُ: ajāl — pl. of ajal, appointed term, span of life (m., nom.); 'terms'
اَجَلُ: ajal — appointed term, end-point of a life or thing (m., nom.); 'a term'
اَحْمِلُ: أَ + حْمِلُ — a-: 1st sg. impf.; ḥamala, to carry, bear (impf. aḥmilu); 'I bear'
اَسَفِي: asaf + ī — asaf, grief, sorrow (m.); -ī, my; 'my sorrow', after yā as an exclamation, 'alas'
اَسْعَدَ: أَ + سْعَدَ — asʿada, to make happy, grant good fortune (perf. 3 m. sg.); with lā in a wish, 'may (He) not make happy'
اَيَّامًا: أَيَّام + ا — ayyām, pl. of yawm, days (m., acc. with tanwīn); 'days'
اِدْبَارٌ: idbār — verbal noun of adbara, to turn away, retreat (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a turning-away'
اِذْلَالُ: idhlāl — verbal noun of adhalla, to abase, humiliate (m., nom.); 'abasement'
أَبِيعُكِ: أَ + بِيعُ + كِ — a-: 1st sg. impf. prefix; bāʿa, to sell (impf. abīʿu, 'I sell'); -ki, you (f. sg.) as object; 'I sell you'
أَكَلَتْ: أَكَلَتْ — akala, to eat (perf. 3 f. sg., -at); 'she ate'
أَمَرَهُمُ: أَمَرَ + هُمْ — amara, to command (perf. 3 m. sg.); -hum, them as object (printed -humu before al-); 'he ordered them'
بَلِّغْهُ: بَلِّغْ + هُ — ballagha, to cause to reach, convey (II, imper. m. sg.); -hu, him (indirect object); 'convey to him'
بِالتَّغْرِيبِ: بِـ + الـ + تَغْرِيب — bi-, by means of (prep.); taghrīb, banishment, sending far away, exile (verbal noun of gharraba, m., gen.); 'by the exile'
تَصَدِّي: taṣaddī / tasaddī — verbal noun of taṣaddā, to aim at, to apply oneself (m., nom.), + -ī, my; the printed pointing is tasaddī; 'my striving'
خَابَ: خَابَ — khāba, to fail, be disappointed (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'it failed, came to nothing'
دَارِيمَا: دَارِ + يَ + مَا — dār, house, abode (f., gen. in iḍāfa; printed with ī, dārī as in dār + ī, the joined mā after it); mā, what, that which; the edition runs the words together: 'house of that which…'
دَهْرًا: dahr + an — dahr, time, a long period (m., acc. with tanwīn, adverbial); 'for a time'
سَكَنِي: سَكَن + ِي — sakan, dwelling, abode (m.), + -ī, my; 'my dwelling'
ضَيْمٌ: ḍaym — injury, wrong (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'injury'
طَيِّ: ṭayy — folding, fold, the inside of something (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the fold, the midst'
طَيِّبٍ: ṭayyib — good, kind, pleasant (adj., m., gen. with tanwīn); 'good'
عَادَةِ: ʿāda — habit, custom (f., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the habit'
عُزِزْتُ: عُزِزْتُ — ʿuzizta/ʿuziztu, passive of ʿazza, to be mighty, to be honoured (perf. 1 sg., -tu, with the two zāys unassimilated); 'I was honoured'
عِيشَةٍ: ʿīsha — life, way of living (f., gen. with tanwīn after min); 'a life'
لَاتُجَاوِبِينَنِي: لَا + تُجَاوِبِينَ + نِي — lā, not (negative); tujāwibīna, you (f. sg.) answer (III, impf. 2 f. sg., jāwaba, to answer, reply); -nī, me (with nūn of protection); 'you do not answer me'
لِجَمِيعِ: لِـ + جَمِيع — li-, for, belonging to (prep.); jamīʿ, all, the whole (m., gen.); 'for all'
لِرَجُلٍ: لِـ + رَجُل + ٍ — li-, to (prep., indirect object of bāʿa, 'to sell to'); rajul, man (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'to a man'
هَطَّالُ: haṭṭāl — pouring, streaming (intensive adj., m., nom., pausal -u); 'pouring'
وَآمَالِي: وَ + آمَال + ِي — wa-, and (conj.); āmāl, pl. of amal, hope (m., nom.); -ī, my; 'and my hopes'
وَالاَهْوَالَ: وَ + الـ + أَهْوَال — wa-, and (conj.); al-, the; ahwāl, pl. of hawl, terror, dread (m., acc.; printed الاهوال with the alif of 'al' and the fatḥa-bearing alif of ahwāl); 'and the terrors'
وَاَهْوَالُ: وَ + أَهْوَال — wa-, and (conj.); ahwāl, terrors (m., nom.); 'and terrors'
وَاِقْبَالُ: وَ + اِقْبَال — wa-, and (conj.); iqbāl, a turning toward, advance (verbal noun of aqbala, m., nom., pausal -u); 'and a turning-toward'
وَأَحْرَقَتْهَا: وَ + أَحْرَقَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); aḥraqa, to burn (IV, perf. 3 f. sg., -at); -hā, her (object); 'and it burned her'
وَتَنْقَضِي: وَ + تَنْقَضِي — wa-, and (conj.); inqaḍā, to come to an end, run out (VII, impf. 3 f. sg. tanqaḍī, 'it ends'; f. sg. because ajāl is a broken plural); 'and they run out'
وَرَثَى: وَ + رَثَى — wa-, and (conj.); ratha, to feel pity, take pity (perf. 3 m. sg., spelled with final ى); 'and he pitied'
وَعَطَفَ: وَ + عَطَفَ — wa-, and (conj.); ʿaṭafa, to bend toward, show tenderness (perf. 3 m. sg.); with ʿalā; 'and he showed tenderness'
يُجَاوِبُنِي: يُ + جَاوِبُ + نِي — yu-: 3 m. sg. impf. prefix; jāwaba, to answer, talk back to (III, impf. yujāwibu); -nī, me (with nūn of protection); 'who answers me'
يُسَافِرُوا: يُ + سَافِرُوا — yu-: 3 m. pl. impf. prefix; sāfara, to travel (III, subjunctive after an: -ū without nūn); 'that they travel'
السَّعِيدُأنَّ: الـ + سَعِيد + أَنَّ — saʿīd, fortunate, happy (m.); 'the fortunate' + anna, that (conj. + noun in acc.); print runs the two words together; 'the fortunate, that'
الْقُرْصَ: الـ + قُرْص — qurṣ, round loaf, disc (m.); acc. object; 'the loaf'
وَوَعَدَهَا: وَ + وَعَدَ + هَا — wa-, and; waʿada, promise (3rd m. sg. past) + -hā, her; 'and he promised her'
جَيِّدٍ: جَيِّد — jayyid, good, fine (adj. m.); gen. agreeing with 'man'
مِثْلِهِ: مِثْل + هِ — mithl, like, the like of (m.) + -hi, him; 'like him'; here: after min: yakhāfu min mithlihi, 'fears the like of it'
وَأَحْرَقَهَا: وَ + أَحْرَقَ + هَا — wa-, and; aḥraqa, to burn (3rd m. sg. past, IV) + -hā, her; 'and it burned her'
جَمَاعَتَهُ: جَمَاعَة + هُ — jamāʿa, company, band (f.), acc. object + -hu, his; 'his company'
فَحَمَلُوا: فَـ + حَمَلَ + وا — fa-, so/and then (conj.); ḥamala, load (3rd m. pl. past); 'and they loaded'
وَأَرْدَفَ: وَ + أَرْدَفَ — wa-, and; ardafa, to seat (someone) behind oneself (3rd m. sg. past, IV); 'and he seated behind him'
وَنَزَلُوافِي: وَ + نَزَلُوا + فِي — wa-, and; nazala, alight, lodge (3rd m. pl. past); fī, in (prep.); the print runs the words together; 'and they alighted in'
النَّائِبِ: الـ + نَائِب — nāʾib, deputy, governor (m.); gen.; 'the deputy'
وَتَعَبِ: وَ + تَعَب — wa-, and; taʿab, weariness, fatigue (m.); gen. after min; 'and the weariness of'
تَتْرُكِي: تَرَكَ — taraka, to leave, abandon (2nd f. sg. jussive, n dropped after lam); 'you leave'
لِيَهُودِيٍّ: لِـ + يَهُودِيّ — li-, to (prep., marking the buyer: sell 'to'); yahūdī, a Jew (m.); gen.; 'to a Jew'
وَأَدْخَلَهَا: وَ + أَدْخَلَ + هَا — wa-, and; adkhala, to bring in, make enter (3rd m. sg. past, IV) + -hā, her; 'and he put her in'; here: 'and he brought her in'
وَتَمَشَّى: وَ + تَمَشَّى — wa-, and; tamashshā, to walk, stroll (3rd m. sg. past, V); 'and he walked'
وَمَرَّعَلَى: وَ + مَرَّ + عَلَى — wa-, and; marra, pass (3rd m. sg. past); ʿalā, upon (prep.; marra ʿalā 'pass by'); the print runs the words together; 'and he passed by'
يَتَّجِرُونَ: اِتَّجَرَ — ittajara, to trade (3rd m. pl. pres., VIII); 'they trade'
يُكَلِّمُهُمْ: كَلَّمَ + هُمْ — kallama, to speak with (3rd m. sg. pres., II) + -hum, them; 'he speaks with them'
فَأَرْسَلْتُهُ: فَـ + أَرْسَلَ + تُ + هُ — fa-, so (conj.); arsala, to send (past) + -tu, I + -hu, him; 'so I sent him' Also of a thing, 'so I sent it': fa-arsaltuhu ilā manzilī, 'I sent it to my house'.
لِبِلَادِ: لِـ + بِلَاد — li-, to (prep., marking direction: 'to the land of'); bilād, lands, country (pl.); gen.; 'to the land of'
يُدَاوُوهُ: دَاوَى + وا + هُ — dāwā, to treat medically (3rd m. pl. subj., III, n dropped after an) + -hu, him; 'that they treat him'
يَبْرَأَ: بَرَأَ — bara'a, to recover (from illness) (3rd m. sg. subj. after an); 'that he recover'
أَبِيعَهَا: أَبِيعَ + هَا — bāʿa, to sell (1st sg. subj. after an) + -hā, her; 'that I sell her'
وَأُرِيدُأَنَّ: وَ + أُرِيدُ + أَنَّ — wa-, and; urīdu, want (1st sg. pres., IV); anna, that (conj. + noun in acc.); the print runs the words together; 'and I want that'
يَشْتَرِيَهَا: اِشْتَرَى + هَا — ishtarā, to buy (3rd m. sg. subj., VIII) + -hā, her; 'that he buy her'
يُلِينُ: لَيَّنَ / أَلَانَ — yulīnu, to soften, make gentle (3rd m. sg. pres., IV); 'he softens'
أُرْخِصُ: أَرْخَصَ — arkhaṣa, to make cheap, lower the price (1st sg. pres., IV); 'I make cheap'
أَخَاكِ: أَخ + كِ — akh, brother (m.), acc. after inna + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your brother'
وَأَدَبٍ: و + أَدَب — adab, good breeding, refinement (m.); 'and refinement'
وَفِطْنَةٍ: و + فِطْنَة — fiṭna, shrewdness, acumen (f.); 'and shrewdness'
وَانْقَلَبَتْ: و + انْقَلَبَتْ — inqalaba, be turned about, be transformed (perf. 3 f. sg., form VII); 'and (it) was altered'
بِسِيمَتِهَا: بِـ + سِيمَة + هَا — bi-, in (prep., of respect: 'in respect of') + sīma, mark, look, appearance (f.; the form is unusual, cf. sīmā) + -hā, her; 'in her looks'
تَمْدَحُهَا: تَمْدَحُ + هَا — tamdaḥu, praise (imperf. 2 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'you praise her'
وَتَشْكُرُ: و + تَشْكُرُ — tashkuru, thank, commend (imperf. 2 m. sg.); 'and you commend'
عَقْلِهَا: عَقْل + هَا — ʿaql, intellect (m.) + -hā, her; 'her intellect'
وَأَدَبِهَا: و + أَدَب + هَا — wa-, and + adab, good breeding (m.) + -hā, her; 'and her breeding'
وَحُسْنِهَا: و + حُسْن + هَا — wa-, and + ḥusn, beauty (m.) + -hā, her; 'and her beauty'
وَأُعْطِيكَ: و + أُعْطِي + كَ — wa-, and + uʿṭī, give (imperf. 1 sg., form IV) + -ka, you (m.); 'and I give you'
وَأَشْرِطُ: و + أَشْرِطُ — ashriṭu, stipulate, make conditions (imperf. 1 sg.); 'and I stipulate'
شُرُوطًا: shurūṭ, conditions, stipulations (pl. of sharṭ; acc. indef. as object)
نَقَدْتُ: naqadtu, pay in cash (perf. 1 sg.); 'I pay (shall have paid)'
تَقْبَلْهَا: تَقْبَلْ + هَا — taqbal, accept (imperf. jussive 2 m. sg. after lam) + -hā, her; 'you accept her not'
رَدَدْتُهَا: رَدَدْتُ + هَا — radadtu, return, send back (perf. 1 sg.) + -hā, her; 'I return her'
وَاشْرِطْ: و + اشْرِطْ — wa-, and + ishriṭ, stipulate (imperative m. sg.); 'and stipulate'
الشُّرُوطِ: الـ + شُرُوط — al-, the + shurūṭ, conditions (pl. of sharṭ), genitive after min
أَوْصَلْتَهَا: أَوْصَلْتَ + هَا — awṣalta, convey, bring (perf. 2 m. sg., form IV) + -hā, her; 'you bring her'
تَلِيقُ: talīqu, suit, be fitting (imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'she will suit'
بِعَقْلِهِ: بِـ + عَقْل + هِ — bi-, to, with (prep.; chosen by the verb: lāqa bi-, 'suit, befit') + ʿaql, mind (m.) + -hi, his; 'to his mind'
وَيُكْثِرُ: و + يُكْثِرُ — yukthiru, multiply, make abundant (imperf. 3 m. sg., form IV); 'and he increases'
الرِّبْحَ: الـ + رِبْح — al-, the + ribḥ, profit, gain (m.), accusative as object
وَهُوَأَنْ: و + هُوَ + أَنْ — wa-, and + huwa, he/it (here 'it is') + an, that (conj.; the print runs the three words together; read وَهُوَ أَنْ 'and it is that')
تَحْلِيلٌ: taḥlīl, making lawful, release, exemption (m. verbal noun of form II); 'an exemption'
لَايُؤْخَذُ: لَا + يُؤْخَذُ — lā, not (negative) + yuʾkhadhu, be taken (imperf. passive 3 m. sg.; the print runs the two words together); 'that not be taken'
مَكْسًا: maks, customs-due, toll (m.; acc. here after a passive, the print's Middle Arabic habit; alif not printed so tanwīn on the sīn)
بِالْوَصِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + وَصِيَّة — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; here 'with a recommendation') + al-, the + waṣiyya, charge, recommendation (f.); 'with the recommendation'
وَزَنْتُ: wazantu, weigh out, pay (perf. 1 sg.); 'I weigh out (I pay)'
نَاجِيَةُ: Nājiya, personal name (the name he gave her; f. nominative vocative)
سَمَّاهَا: سَمَّى + هَا — sammā, name, call (perf. 3 m. sg., form II) + -hā, her; 'he had named her'
سَمِعَتْهُ: سَمِعَتْ + هُ — samiʿat, hear (perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him/it; 'she heard it'
تُجِبْهُ: تُجِبْ + هُ — tujib, answer (jussive 3 f. sg., form IV) + -hu, him; 'she did not answer him'
فَأَقْبِلْ: فَـ + أَقْبِلْ — fa-, and so, then + aqbil, come forward, turn to (imperative m. sg., form IV); 'then approach'
وَانْظُرْهَا: و + انْظُرْ + هَا — wa-, and + unẓur, look at, inspect (imperative m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'and look at her'
وَلَاطِفْهَا: و + لَاطِفْ + هَا — wa-, and + lāṭif, treat gently, be kind to (imperative m. sg., form III) + -hā, her; 'and be gentle with her'
أَوْصَيْتُكَ: أَوْصَيْتُ + كَ — awṣaytu, charge, bid (perf. 1 sg., form IV) + -ka, you (m.); 'I charged you'
أَبْلُغُ: بَلَغَ — balagha, to reach, attain (verb I); present 1 s. ablughu; 'I reach/gain'
أَرْجَى: أَرْجَى — arjā, more hopeful, more to be hoped for (elative of رَجِيّ/رَجَا), nom. indef. predicate; 'more promising'
أُجَاوِبُهُ: أُجَاوِبُ + هُ — ujāwibu, I answer (verb III of جَابَ/جَوَبَ, present 1 s.) + -hu, him; 'I answer him'
إِنِ: إِنْ — in, if (conditional particle), written ini before the wasl alif of the next word; 'if'
التَّاجِرُإِنْ: الـ + تَاجِر + إِنْ — al-, the; tājir, merchant (m.), nom. subject; in, if (conditional particle), run together in print; 'the merchant: if'
الظَّالِمِ: الـ + ظَالِم — al-, the; ẓālim, oppressor, tyrant (act. participle of ظَلَمَ), gen. as demonstrative's noun; 'the tyrant'
الْجِلْفِ: الـ + جِلْف — al-, the; jilf, boorish, rude, coarse (adj., m.), gen. agreeing with الْبَدَوِيِّ; 'the boor'
الْعُيُوبِ: الـ + عُيُوب — al-, the; ʿuyūb, faults, defects (m. pl. of ʿayb), gen. after ʿalā; 'the faults'
بَصَرَهَا: بَصَر + هَا — baṣar, sight, gaze (m.), acc. object + -hā, her; 'her gaze'
بِخُلُقٍ: بِـ + خُلُق — bi-, with (prep., of manner: 'in/with'); khuluq, disposition, manners (m.), gen. indef.; 'with a disposition'
تَتَمَنَّاهُ: تَتَمَنَّى + هُ — tatamannā, you wish for (verb V of مَنَى, 2 m.s.) + -hu, it; 'you wish it'
تَعْرِفَهُ: عَرَفَ + هُ — ʿarafa, to know (verb I); subjunctive 2 m.s. taʿrifa + -hu, it; 'you know it'
حَالُكِ: حَال + كِ — ḥāl, state, condition (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your state'
خُلُقَكَ: خُلُق + كَ — khuluq, temper, disposition (m.), acc. object + -ka, your; 'your temper'
ذَكَرْتَهَا: ذَكَرَ + هَا — dhakara, to mention (verb I); past 2 m.s. dhakarta + -hā, them (the faults, as f. sing.); 'you mentioned them'; also: -hā, her (a beloved): allatī dhakartahā, 'whom you mentioned' (Night 179)
رَيِّضْ: رَيَّضَ — rayyaḍa, to break in, tame, train (verb II); imperative 2 m.s. rayyiḍ; the print marks the shadda, kept here; 'tame!'
فَاطْلُبْ: فَـ + اطْلُبْ — fa-, so (draws the consequence); uṭlub, ask, demand (verb I of طَلَبَ, imperative 2 m.s.); 'so ask'
فَعَلَى: فَـ + عَلَى — fa-, so/and; ʿalā, upon (prep.); 'so upon'
فَيُهْلِكُنِي: فَـ + يُهْلِكُ + نِي — fa-, and so/then (result); yuhliku, he destroys (verb IV of هَلَكَ, present 3 m.s.) + -nī, me; 'and so he destroys me'
قُطَاعَةِ: قُطَاعَة — quṭāʿa, what is cut off, scraps, leavings (f.), gen. in construct after مِنْ; 'the scraps of'
لِأَعْدَائِكَ: لِـ + أَعْدَاء + كَ — li-, for, upon (prep.; marks whom the wish is for); aʿdāʾ, enemies (m. pl. of ʿaduww), gen. + -ka, your; 'for your enemies'
لِلْخَيْرِ: لِـ + الـ + خَيْر — li-, for, as regards (prep.; marks what the hope concerns); al-, the; khayr, good (m.), gen.; 'for the good'
مَايُسَمِّي: مَا + يُسَمِّي — mā, not (negative); yusammī, he names (verb II of سَمَّى, present 3 m.s.), run together in print; 'he does not name'
مَسْطُورًا: مَسْطُور — masṭūr, written (passive participle of سَطَرَ), acc. indef. as predicate/complement of كَانَ; 'written'
مَنْطِقِى: مَنْطِق + ي — manṭiq, speech, utterance (m., gen.) + -ī, my (the print spells it with ى); 'my speech'
مُحْتَشِمٌ: مُحْتَشِم — muḥtashim, dignified, respectable (act. participle of iḥtashama, verb VIII), nom. indef.; 'dignified'
وَبَرَكَاتُهُ: وَ + بَرَكَات + هُ — wa-, and; barakāt, blessings (f. pl. of baraka), nom. + -hu, his; 'and His blessings'
وَرَحْمَةُ: وَ + رَحْمَة — wa-, and; raḥma, mercy (f.), nom. in construct; 'and the mercy of'
وَرَعَاعِ: وَ + رَعَاع — wa-, and; raʿāʿ, rabble, riff-raff (m., collective), gen. in construct; 'and the rabble of'
وَصَفْتَ: وَصَفَ — waṣafa, to describe (verb I); past 2 m.s. waṣafta; 'you described'
وَعَيْنُهَا: وَ + عَيْن + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'while'); ʿayn, eye (f.), nom. + -hā, her; 'while her eye'
وَلَعَلَّهُ: وَ + لَعَلَّ + هُ — wa-, and; laʿalla, perhaps, it may be that (+ acc.) + -hu, he; 'and perhaps he'
يَشْتَرِينِي: يَشْتَرِي + نِي — yashtarī, he buys (verb VIII of شَرَى, present 3 m.s.) + -nī, me; 'he buys me', a clause of purpose after 'came'
مُقَرْقِعٌ: مُقَرْقِع — muqarqiʿ, rattling, noisy (act. part. of qarqaʿa, to rattle, clatter); indefinite nominative predicate; uncertain, 'a rattler, a blusterer'
نَاشِفُ: نَاشِف — nāshif, dry (act. part. of nashifa, to be dry); first term of an annexation with 'head'; 'dry-of'
أَنَالَا: أَنَا + لَا — anā, I (pron.) + lā, not (neg.); the print runs the two words together; 'I (do) not'
قِيمَةً: قِيمَة — qīma, value, worth (f.); accusative, object; 'a value'
بِفَصَاحَتِهَا: بِـ + فَصَاحَة + هَا — bi-, by means of, through (prep.) + faṣāḥa, eloquence (f.) + -hā, her; 'by her eloquence'
مَنْظَرِهَا: مَنْظَر + هَا — manẓar, look, appearance (m.); -hā, her; 'her looks'
يَشْتَرِيهَا: يَشْتَرِي + هَا — yashtarī, he buys (v. VIII impf. 3ms of ishtarā) + -hā, her; 'who buys her'
أَدْفَعُ: أَدْفَعُ — adfaʿu, I pay (v. I impf. 1sg of dafaʿa); 'I will pay'
مِائَتَيْ: مِائَة — miʾa, hundred (f.), in the dual annexed form miʾatay (the -n dropped before the following noun); 'two hundred'
لِيَدِكَ: لِـ + يَد + كَ — li-, to, into (prep.; of the receiver) + yad, hand (f.) + -ka, your; 'into your hand'
الضَّمَانِ: الـ + ضَمَان — al-, the + ḍamān, surety, guarantee, liability (m.); genitive; 'the guarantee'
اِغْتَاظَ: اِغْتَاظَ — ightāẓa, he became enraged (v. VIII perf. 3ms of ghāẓa); 'he was enraged'
عَيْظًا: عَيْظ — print slip for غَيْظ ghayẓ, rage (m.); accusative cognate object; 'a rage'
الْقِطْعَةِ: الـ + قِطْعَة — al-, the + qiṭʿa, piece (f.); genitive after fī; 'the piece'
الْعَبَاءَةِ: الـ + عَبَاءَة — al-, the + ʿabāʾa, cloak (f.); genitive in apposition; 'the cloak'
بِعْتُهَا: بِعْتُ + هَا — biʿtu, I sold (v. I perf. 1sg of bāʿa) + -hā, her; 'I sold her' (here 'I would not have sold her')
أُخَلِّيهَا: أُخَلِّي + هَا — ukhallī, I leave, let be (v. II impf. 1sg of khallā) + -hā, her; 'I leave her'
تَرْعَيٰ: تَرْعَى — tarʿā, she pastures, tends (v. I impf. 3fs of raʿā); printed with a ya for the final alif; 'she herds'
وَتَطْحَنُ: وَ + تَطْحَنُ — wa-, and + taṭḥanu, she grinds (v. I impf. 3fs of ṭaḥana); 'and grinds'
الطَّحِينَ: الـ + طَحِين — al-, the + ṭaḥīn, flour (m.); accusative; 'the flour'
تَعَالِي: تَعَالِي — taʿālī, come! (v. VI imp. 2fs of taʿālā); addressed to the girl
يَامُنْتِنَةُ: يَا + مُنْتِنَة — yā, O (vocative) + muntina, stinking, foul-smelling (f.; act. part. of IV antana); the print runs them together; 'O stinker'
أَحْسِبُكَ: أَحْسِبُ + كَ — aḥsibu, I reckon, suppose (v. I impf. 1sg of ḥasiba) + -ka, you; 'I reckoned you'
طُرْطُورِي: طُرْطُور + ي — ṭurṭūr, tall conical cap (m.); -ī, my; genitive after ḥaqq; 'my cap'
تَذْهَبْ: تَذْهَبْ — tadhhab, you go (v. I jussive 2ms of dhahaba); 'you go'
لَأُسْمِعَنَّكَ: لَـ + أُسْمِعَنَّ + كَ — la-, surely (emphatic lām of a threat) + usmiʿanna, I will make hear (v. IV impf. 1sg of asmaʿa, with the emphatic ending -nna) + -ka, you; 'I will surely make you hear'
يُرْضِيكَ: يُرْضِي + كَ — yurḍī, he pleases (v. IV impf. 3ms of arḍā) + -ka, you; 'pleases you'
قِيمَتَهَا: قِيمَة + هَا — qīma, value (f.), accusative; -hā, her; 'her value'
ثَمَنِهَا: ثَمَن + هَا — thaman, price (m.); -hā, her; 'her price'
كِسْرَى: كِسْرَى — Kisrā, Khosrow, the Persian king (proper name; indeclinable)
طَوِّلْ: طَوِّلْ — ṭawwil, lengthen! (v. II imp. 2ms of ṭawwala); the print marks the shadda
وَرَيِّضْ: وَ + رَيِّضْ — wa-, and + rayyiḍ, tame, calm! (v. II imp. 2ms; apparently the form of rawwaḍa/rāḍa, to break in, with ya for waw); the print marks the shadda
الْكُورَةِ: الـ + كُورَة — al-, the + kūra, district, province (f.); here of uncertain sense, apparently a contemptuous word for the girl, 'lump'
وَأَقْلِبُهَا: وَ + أَقْلِبُ + هَا — wa-, and + aqlibu, I turn over (v. I impf. 1sg of qalaba) + -hā, her; 'and turn her'
الِاشْتِرَاءِ: الـ + اشْتِرَاء — al-, the + ishtirāʾ, buying (m.; v.n. VIII of sharā), genitive; 'the buying'
يَحْفَظُ: يَحْفَظُ — yaḥfaẓu, he keeps, preserves (v. I impf. 3ms of ḥafiẓa); wish-sense, 'may he keep'
شَبَابَكَ: شَبَاب + كَ — shabāb, youth (m.), accusative object; -ka, your; 'your youth'
فَقَلِّبْهَا: فَـ + قَلِّبْ + هَا — fa-, so + qallib, turn over! (v. II imp. 2ms of qallaba) + -hā, her; 'so turn her over'
وَبَاطِنًا: وَ + بَاطِن — wa-, and + bāṭin, inner, inside (act. part. of baṭana); accusative adverbial; 'and on the inside, back'
فَعَرِّهَا: فَـ + عَرِّ + هَا — fa-, then + ʿarri, strip! (v. II imp. 2ms of ʿarrā) + -hā, her; 'then strip her'; the print marks the shadda
اُنْظُرْهَا: اُنْظُرْ + هَا — unẓur, look at! (v. I imp. 2ms of naẓara) + -hā, her; 'look at her'
مَعَاذَ: مَعَاذ — maʿādh, refuge (m.); accusative verbal noun, first term of an annexation; maʿādha allāh, 'God forbid'
خَجْلَانُ: خَجْلَان — khajlān, ashamed, abashed (m.; diptote); nominative predicate; 'abashed'
الْعَبَاءَةَ: الـ + عَبَاءَة — al-, the + ʿabāʾa, cloak (f.); accusative after inna; 'the cloak'
اسْمُكِ: اِسْم + كِ — ism, name (m., nom., predicate of an unmarked verbless question) + -ki, your (f.); 'your name'
تَسْأَلُ: saʾala, to ask (verb I, impf. 2ms/3fs); 'you ask' (an unmarked question: 'do you ask?')
اسْمٌ: اِسْم — ism, name (m., nom. indef., the thing possessed)
غُصَّةُ: ghuṣṣa — a choking lump in the throat, grief, sorrow (f., nom., predicate; first term of the name Ghuṣṣat al-Zamān); 'Sorrow'; here nom., subject, first term of ghuṣṣatu al-mawti, 'the choking of death', the death-agony
فَرَّقَ: farraqa, to separate, part (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he/it parted'
عُذُوبَةِ: ʿudhūba, sweetness (f., verbal noun of عَذُبَ 'to be sweet', gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'sweetness'
مَنْطِقِهَا: مَنْطِق + هَا — manṭiq, speech, utterance (m., gen. as second term of the iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her speech'
صَدَقَ: ṣadaqa, to speak truly, tell the truth (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he spoke truly'; also: to prove true, of a guess: in ṣadaqa ḥadhrī, 'if my guess is right'
مَقَالَتِهِ: مَقَالَة + هِ — maqāla, saying, speech (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his words'
تَذَكَّرَتْ: tadhakkarat — tadhakkara, to remember, recall (verb V, perf. 3fs, -t); 'she remembered'
وَمَرَضَهُ: وَ + مَرَض + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + maraḍ, illness (m., acc., object of tadhakkarat) + -hu, his; 'and his illness'
وَغُرْبَتَهُ: وَ + غُرْبَة + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghurba, exile, estrangement (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his exile'
وَفِرَاقَهَا: وَ + فِرَاق + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + firāq, parting, separation (m., verbal noun of فَارَقَ, acc., object) + -hā, her; 'and her parting'
وَبُعْدِهَا: وَ + بُعْد + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + buʿd, distance (m., verbal noun of بَعُدَ, gen., coordinated with the object of the preceding 'how') + -hā, her; 'and her distance'
أُمِّهَا: أُمّ + هَا — umm, mother (f., gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her; 'her mother'
وَأَبِيهَا: وَ + أَب + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ab, father (m., gen. after ʿan; the long form abī- is the genitive of the 'five nouns') + -hā, her; 'and her father'
وَمَمْلَكَتِهَا: وَ + مَمْلَكَة + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + mamlaka, kingdom, realm (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her kingdom'
دُمُوعُهَا: دُمُوع + هَا — dumūʿ, tears (m. pl. of دَمْع, nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'her tears'
وَأَرْسَلَتِ: وَ + أَرْسَلَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + arsala, to send forth, let loose (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -t); the kasra is a helping vowel before al-; 'and she let loose'
الْأَبْيَ—اتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses (m. pl. of بَيْت, acc., object of taqūlu); 'the verses'; the printed dash splits the word and is kept
التَّقْلِيبِ: الـ + تَقْلِيب — taqlīb, turning over, handling (verbal noun of قَلَّبَ, form II; m., gen. after مِنْ); 'the handling' (of a slave girl by a buyer)
الرَّاحِلُ: الـ + رَاحِل — rāḥil, departing one, traveller (active part. of رَحَلَ; vocative apposition after أَيُّهَا, nom.); 'the departer'
الرُّقَادَ: الـ + رُقَاد — ruqād, sleep (m., acc., object of شَهِدْتَ); 'the sleep'
الضَّرْبَةُ: الـ + ضَرْبَة — ḍarba, a blow (f. nomen unitatis of ضَرْب; nom., subject); 'the blow'
الْوِرْدِ: الـ + وِرْد — wird, watering-place, drinking (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after خَضِرُ); 'the watering-place'
اَمْسَيْتَ: أَمْسَى — amsā, to enter the evening, spend the evening (form IV) + تَ (2nd m. sg. suffix, 'you'); 'you spend the evening'; printed with bare alif (hamza of the wasl/qaṭʿ unmarked in the print)
اَيَّ: ayy — which, what (interrogative/exclamatory; acc., first term of iḍāfa with سَكْبِ); 'what a ...!'
اِلاَّ: illā — except, save (إِنْ + لَا fused; printed with the mark placed over the lām); 'except'
أَكْتَافِهَا: أَكْتَاف + هَا — aktāf, shoulders (pl. of كَتِف; gen. after عَلَى) + hā, 'her'; 'her shoulders'
بِاَيِّ: بِـ + أَيّ — bi-, in (prep.: location 'in') + ayy, which (interrogative, gen. as first term of an iḍāfa with رَبْعٍ); 'in which'
بِثِقْلِهَا: بِـ + ثِقْل + هَا — bi-, at, for (prep., marks the price or measure) + thiql, weight (m., gen.) + hā, her; 'at her weight'
بِدَارٍ: بِـ + دَار — bi-, in (prep., location) + dār, house, abode (f., gen., tanwīn); 'in a house'
بِوَجْهِهَا: بِـ + وَجْه + هَا — bi-, with (prep., of accompaniment: 'with her face foremost') + wajh, face (m., gen.) + hā, her; 'with her face'; also: after tamallā bi-, 'to enjoy', bi- marks what is enjoyed: atamallā bi-wajhihā, 'I feast my eyes on her face' (Night 179)
حَاجِبِهَا: حَاجِب + هَا — ḥājib, eyebrow, brow (m., gen. after فِي) + hā, her; 'her eyebrow'
حَاشَاكَ: ḥāshā, far be it, God forbid (exclamatory verb-particle, 'exempt') + كَ, you (2nd m. sg.); 'far be it from you'
حَافِظُ: ḥāfiẓ — guardian, keeper (active part. of حَفِظَ; m., printed without tanwīn, nom., apposition to جَارُ)
حَصَاةٌ: ḥaṣāt — pebble (f. nomen unitatis; nom., tanwīn, subject of جَاءَتْ)
حَيَوةٍ: ḥayāt — life (f., gen., tanwīn; second term of an iḍāfa after مَاءِ); the print spells the long ā defectively with waw (ḥayawa form); 'of life'
خَضِرُ: khaḍir — green, fresh (adj., m., nom., printed so; first term of an iḍāfa with الْوِرْدِ)
دَمُهَا: دَم + هَا — dam, blood (m., nom., subject of سَالَ) + hā, her; 'her blood'
دَهْرٍ: dahr — time, fate (m., gen., tanwīn; second term of an iḍāfa after صُرُوفِ); 'of time'
رَبْعٍ: rabʿ — dwelling, abode (m., gen., tanwīn; second term of an iḍāfa after أَيِّ); 'dwelling'
سَكْبِ: sakb — pouring (verbal noun; m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after أَيَّ); 'what a pouring'
سَهْلٌ: sahl — easy (adj., m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of كُلُّ شَيْءٍ)
سُهَادِي: سُهَاد + ـِي — suhād, sleeplessness, wakefulness (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after مِنْ) + ī, my; 'my sleeplessness'
شَارِبًا: shārib — drinker (active part. of شَرِبَ; m., acc., tanwīn; predicate of تَكُنْ); 'a drinker'
شَهِدْتَ: shahida, to witness, see, be present at (2nd m. sg. perf.) — 'you witness'; perfect in a conditional, with future sense
شِرْبِي: شِرْب + ـِي — shirb, drink, a share of drinking (m., nom., predicate) + ī, my; 'my drink'
صَعْبِ: ṣaʿb — hard, difficult (adj., m., gen., printed so after غَيْرُ in the iḍāfa); 'hard'
صُرُوفِ: ṣurūf — turns, vicissitudes (pl. of صَرْف; m., gen. after مِنْ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the turnings of'
غَشْيَتِهَا: غَشْيَة + هَا — ghashya, swoon, fainting (f., gen. after فِي) + hā, her; 'her swoon'
فَاسْتَوْحَشَتْ: فَ + اِسْتَوْحَشَ — fa-, so, and (conj. of consequence) + istawḥasha, to feel desolate, find lonely (form X; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'so it grew desolate'
فَالْمَدَامِعُ: فَ + الـ + مَدَامِع — fa-, then (apodosis marker of the conditional) + al-, the + madāmiʿ, tears (pl. of مَدْمَع; nom., subject); 'then the tears'
فَجَمْرٌ: فَ + جَمْر — fa-, then (apodosis marker of the conditional) + jamr, live coal, ember (m., nom., tanwīn; predicate/subject in a nominal sentence with مِنْ ... بَيْنَ); 'then a live coal'
فَسَالَ: فَ + سَالَ — fa-, so (conj. of sequence/result) + sāla, to flow (3rd m. sg. perf.); 'so it flowed'
فَشَقَّتْهُ: فَ + شَقَّ + هُ — fa-, so (conj. of sequence) + shaqqa, to split (3rd f. sg. perf.; subject the pebble) + hu, it (acc., the brow); 'so it split it'
فَغَطَّتْ: فَ + غَطَّى — fa-, so (conj. of sequence) + ghaṭṭā, to cover (form II; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'so she covered'
قَعَلَ: qaʿala — printed so, probably a slip for قَعَدَ 'he sat' or جَعَلَ 'he began' (3rd m. sg. perf.); governs the following present verb
لِقُرْبِكَ: لِـ + قُرْب + كَ — li-, for, on account of (prep., of cause) + qurb, nearness (m., gen.) + ka, your; 'for your nearness'
لِمَاءِ: لِـ + مَاء — li-, of, for (prep.; here 'of the water', a possessive/relational sense: 'a drinker of the water of') + māʾ, water (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the water of'
لِيَمْسَحَ: لِـ + يَمْسَحُ — li-, in order to (prep./particle, purpose, governs subjunctive) + yamsaḥa, to wipe (3rd m. sg. impf. subjunctive); 'to wipe'
مَسَحَتِ: masaḥa — to wipe (3rd f. sg. perf.; kasra on the tāʾ before الدُّمُوعَ); 'she wiped'
مَوْلَاهَا: مَوْلَى + هَا — mawlā, lord, master (m., gen. after مِنْ; here God) + hā, her; 'her Lord'
مُسْتَوْطِنٌ: mustawṭin — settled, one who has made a home (active part. of اِسْتَوْطَنَ, form X; m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of اَنْتَ)
مِقْوَدُ: miqwad — halter-rope, lead (m., nom., subject of كَانَ's phrase 'with him was'; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَاسْتَهَلَّتْ: وَ + اِسْتَهَلَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + istahalla, to begin to pour, burst forth (form X; 3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and they began to pour'
وَالدَّمَ: وَ + الـ + دَم — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + dam, blood (m., acc., object of مَسَحَتْ); 'and the blood'
وَاَرْضٍ: وَ + أَرْض — wa-, and (conj.) + arḍ, land (f., gen., tanwīn); 'and land'; printed with bare alif
وَأُرِيحَهَا: وَ + أُرِيحَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj., continuing the subjunctive after أَنْ) + urīḥa, to relieve, give rest (form IV; 1st sg. impf. subjunctive) + hā, her (acc. object); 'and that I relieve her'
وَجَنْبِي: وَ + جَنْب + ـِي — wa-, and (conj.) + janb, side (m., gen., coordinate with الْفِرَاشِ) + ī, my; 'and my side'
وَخَطْبِ: وَ + خَطْب — wa-, and (conj.) + khaṭb, calamity, grave matter (m., gen., coordinate with دَهْرٍ); 'and calamity'
وَرَفَعَتْ: وَ + رَفَعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + rafaʿa, to raise (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she raised'
وَشِعْبِ: وَ + شِعْب — wa-, and (conj.) + shiʿb, mountain path, ravine (m., gen., coordinate with دَارٍ); 'or a mountain path' (the wa- here is 'or' in the sense of 'and/or')
وَطَلَبَتْ: وَ + طَلَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭalaba, to ask, petition (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she asked'
وَعَصَبَتْ: وَ + عَصَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaṣaba, to bind, bandage (3rd f. sg. perf.); 'and she bound'
وَغَيْرُهُ: وَ + غَيْر + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghayr, other than (m., nom.) + hu, it; 'and other than it'
وَقَاكَ: waqā, to guard, protect (3rd m. sg. perf.) + كَ, you (acc. object); 'has guarded you' (with the invocation sense 'may He guard you')
يَشْتُمُ: shatama — to revile, curse (3rd m. sg. impf. indic.); 'he reviles'
يَمْسَحَ: masaḥa — to wipe (3rd m. sg. impf. subjunctive after أَنْ); 'he wipes'
رَحْمَتَا: raḥma, mercy, pity (f.) + ـا, the lament ending (wā raḥmatā, 'O the pity of it')
لِعَزِيْزَهِ: لِـ + عَزِيزَة — li-, for (prep., 'for, on account of') + ʿazīza, dear, cherished, mighty one (f., gen.; ya sukūn and final -hi as printed in verse); 'for a cherished woman'
بِالضَّيْمِ: بِـ + الـ + ضَيْم — bi-, by, through (prep., marks the cause) + ḍaym, wrong, injustice (m., gen.); 'by wrong'
ذَلِيلَهْ: dhalīla — abased, humbled, lowly (f. adj., pausal -h as printed in verse); 'abased'
هَاطِلٍ: hāṭil — pouring, streaming (act. part. of hataḷa; m., gen., qualifying damʿ)
الْوَغْدِ: الـ + وَغْد — waghd, vile, base fellow, wretch (m., gen.); 'the wretch'
حِيلَهْ: ḥīla — stratagem, ruse, device (f., pausal -h as printed in verse); 'a ruse'
تَدَعْنِي: تَدَعْ + ـنِي — wadaʿa, to leave, let be (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā; prohibition) + 1s object (-nī, with the nūn of protection); 'do not leave me'
فَخَلِّصْنِي: فَـ + خَلِّصْ + ـنِي — fa-, so, then (consequence of the plea) + khalliṣ, to deliver, rescue (verb II, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; 'so deliver me'
يُخَلِّصْكَ: يُخَلِّصْ + ـكَ — khalliṣa, to deliver (verb II, jussive 3ms, the result clause after an imperative) + 2ms object; 'he will deliver you'
لِلْبَدَوِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + بَدَوِيّ — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed) + badawī, Bedouin (nisba adj. of badw, desert; m., gen.); 'to the Bedouin'
بِعْنِي: بِعْ + ـنِي — bāʿa, to sell (verb I, imperative 2ms, biʿ) + 1s indirect object; 'sell me'
وَادْفَعْ: وَ + ادْفَعْ — wa-, and + idfaʿ, to pay, hand over (verb I, imperative 2ms of dafaʿa)
النَّجْعِ: الـ + نَجْع — najʿ, pasture-ground, camp (m., gen. after ilā); 'the grazing camp'
وَأُخَلِّيهَا: وَ + أُخَلِّي + هَا — wa-, and + khallā, to leave, let be (verb II, impf. 1s, indicative as printed) + 3fs object; 'and I leave her'
تَلُمُّ: talummu — to gather, collect up (verb I, impf. 3fs of lamma; doubled m as printed, circumstantial); 'gathering'
الْبَعْرَ: الـ + بَعْر — baʿr, dung, droppings (m., acc., object); 'the dung'
أَقْرَاصَ: aqrāṣ — discs, round loaves (pl. of qurṣ; acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa)
بِتِسْعِينَ: بِـ + تِسْعِين — bi-, at, to the value of (prep., marks the price) + tisʿīn, ninety (gen.); 'for ninety'
وَأَهْلُكَ: وَ + أَهْل + ـكَ — wa-, and + ahl, family, kin (m., nom., co-subject) + 2ms; 'and your family'
وَقَبِيلَتُكَ: وَ + قَبِيلَة + ـكَ — wa-, and + qabīla, tribe (f., nom., co-subject) + 2ms; 'and your tribe'
زَمَانِكُمْ: زَمَان + ـكُمْ — zamān, time, lifetime (m., gen.) + 2mpl; 'your time'
أَكَلْتُمْ: akaltum — to eat (verb I, perf. 2mpl of akala); after mā, 'you have not eaten'
شَعِيرًا: shaʿīr — barley (m., acc. with tanwīn, object of akaltum)
تَرْضَ: tarḍa — to be pleased, satisfied (verb I, jussive 2ms of raḍiya)
غَمَزْتُ: ghamaztu — to wink, inform against (verb I, perf. 1s of ghamaza; with ʿalā, 'denounce'); here the future-sense apodosis, 'I will have denounced'
نَائِبَ: nāʾib — deputy, viceroy, governor (act. part. of nāba; m., acc., object of ghamaztu; first term of an iḍāfa; precomposed hamza as printed)
فَيَأْخُذُهَا: فَـ + يَأْخُذُ + هَا — fa-, and so (consequence) + akhadha, to take (verb I, impf. 3ms, indicative) + 3fs object; 'and he takes her'
بِعْتُكَ: بِعْتُ + كَ — bāʿa, to sell (verb I, perf. 1s, biʿtu) + 2ms indirect object; 'I sold you'
وَاقْدُرْ: وَ + اقْدُرْ — wa-, and (conj.) + uqdur, reckon, suppose (imperative of qadara; reading uncertain); 'and reckon'
أَٔنَّنِي: أَنَّ + نِي — anna, that (introducing a clause) + -nī, me (1sg. object/subject suffix after anna); 'that I'
وَأَٔتَى: وَ + أَتَى — wa-, and + atā, come, bring (perfect 3m.sg.); 'and he came'
وَأَٔقْبَضَهُ: وَ + أَقْبَضَ + هُ — wa-, and + aqbaḍa, make (someone) take possession (form IV perfect 3m.sg.) + -hu, him; 'and he made him take possession'
إِٔيَّاهُ: iyyā- + -hu, the carrier for an object pronoun: 'it' (second object of aqbaḍa); 'him/it'
فَأَٔخَذَهُ: فَـ + أَخَذَ + هُ — fa-, and then + akhadha, take (perfect 3m.sg.) + -hu, it; 'and he took it'
بُدَّأنْ: بُدَّ + أَنْ — budd, escape, avoidance (m., gen.; lā budda, 'no escape') + an, that (introducing a subjunctive clause); printed run together as one word; 'no escape that'
أَٔذْهَبَ: adhhaba, go (imperfect 1sg. subjunctive after an); 'I go'
أَٔجِدَ: ajida, find (imperfect 1sg. subjunctive after laʿalla); 'I find'
أَٔخَاهَا: akh, brother (m., acc. object; long form akhā) + -hā, her; 'her brother'
فَأَٔجِيءَ: فَـ + أَجِيءَ — fa-, and then + ajīʾa, come, bring (imperfect 1sg. subjunctive); 'and I come/bring'
وَأَٔبِيعَهُ: وَ + أَبِيعَ + هُ — wa-, and + abīʿa, sell (imperfect 1sg. subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'and I sell him'
أَٔنْ: an, that (introducing a subjunctive or perfect clause); with ilā, 'until that'
أَٔخِيهَا: akh, brother (m., gen. after ʿan; long form akhī) + -hā, her; 'her brother'
يَجِدْهُ: yajid, find (imperfect 3m.sg. jussive after lam) + -hu, him; 'he found him not'
أَٔمْرِهِ: amr, affair, matter (m., gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'his affair'
وَأَٔمَّا: وَ + أَمَّا — wa-, and + ammā, as for (topic-introducing particle, answered by fa-); 'and as for'
أَٔمْرِ: amr, affair, matter (m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَنُزْهَةِ: وَ + نُزْهَة — wa-, and + Nuzha, delight, pleasure (f., gen., first term of the name); 'and Nuzhat'
فَإِٔنَّهُ: فَـ + إِنَّ + هُ — fa-, then (answering ammā) + inna, indeed + -hu, he; 'then indeed he'
وَأَٔدْرَكَ: وَ + أَدْرَكَ — wa-, and + adraka, overtake, reach (form IV perfect 3m.sg.); 'and it overtook'
الْمُ—بَ—احِ: الـ + مُبَاح — mubāḥ, permitted, allowed (passive participle of form IV; m., gen., adjective of al-kalām); printed split by dashes; 'the permitted'
الْأَبْيَ: الـ + أَبْيَات (first part of the word, split by the print's dash) — al-abyāt, the verses; see the whole form الْأَبْيَ—اتَ
تَسَلَّمَ: tasallama — to receive, take delivery of (verb V, perf. 3ms)
مَصَاغًا: maṣāgh — wrought gold or silver, jewellery (m., acc. indef.)
بُقْجَةٍ: buqja — bundle, wrapping-cloth (f., gen. indef.; from Turkish bohça)
الْأَطْلَسِ: الـ + أَطْلَس — al-, the + aṭlas, satin (m., gen.)
وَوَضَعَهَا: وَ + وَضَعَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object suffix (the bundle); 'and he set it'
تُعْلِمِيهِ: تُعْلِمِي + ـهُ — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, subj. 2fs) + 3ms object suffix; 'that you inform him'
وَإِنْكَانَ: وَ + إِنْ + كَانَ — wa-, and + in, if + kāna, to be (perf. 3ms); wa-in, 'even if'; printed as one word
ظُفْرِكِ: ظُفْر + ـكِ — ẓufr, fingernail (m., gen.) + 2fs suffix; 'your nail'
وَاشْتَرَاكِ: وَ + اشْتَرَى + ـكِ — wa-, and + ishtarā, to buy (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + 2fs object suffix; 'and he buys you'
وَاطْلُبِي: وَ + اطْلُبِي — wa-, and + uṭlubī, ṭalaba, to ask for, request (verb I, imperative 2fs)
مَنْشُورًا: manshūr — open letter, patent, decree (m., acc. indef.)
لِأَذْهَبَ: لِـ + أَذْهَبَ — li-, so that, in order to (with subjunctive) + adhhaba, dhahaba, to go (verb I, subj. 1s); 'so that I may go'
يَمْنَعَ: yamnaʿa — manaʿa, to prevent, stop (verb I, subj. 3ms)
أَتَّجِرُ: attajiru — ittajara, to trade (verb VIII, imperf. 1s)
وَانْتَحَبَتْ: وَ + انْتَحَبَتْ — wa-, and + intaḥaba, to sob, weep aloud (verb VIII, perf. 3fs)
تَدْمَعُ: tadmaʿu — damaʿa, to shed tears, water (of the eye) (verb I, imperf. 3fs)
عَيْنَاكِ: عَيْنَا + ـكِ — ʿayn, eye (f., dual nom., construct) + 2fs suffix; 'your two eyes'
تُحِبِّينَهُ: تُحِبِّينَ + ـهُ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV, imperf. 2fs) + 3ms object suffix; 'whom you love'
أَوْغَيْرَهُ: أَوْ + غَيْر + ـهُ — aw, or + ghayr, other than (acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'or someone else' (printed as one word)
فَأَخْبِرِ: فَـ + أَخْبِرِ… — fa-, then (introducing the answer of the condition) + akhbirī, akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imperative 2fs); first half of فَأَخْبِرِينِي, split by the print
ينِي: …ـِينِي — the end of فَأَخْبِرِينِي: -ī of the 2fs imperative + -nī, 1cs object suffix; 'tell me' (the print splits the word)
وَغَيْرِهِمْ: وَ + غَيْر + ـهِمْ — wa-, and + ghayr, other than (gen.) + 3mp suffix; 'and others besides them'
أُوصِلُهَا: أُوصِلُ + ـهَا — awṣala, to deliver, convey (verb IV, imperf. 1s) + 3fs object suffix; 'I will deliver it'
بِتَاجِرٍ: بِـ + تَاجِر — bi- (prep.; after laysa it introduces the predicate and adds emphasis: lastu bi-tājirin, 'I am no merchant'; elsewhere 'with', as in maʿrifa bi-, 'acquaintance with') + tājir, merchant (m., gen. indef.); 'a merchant'
وَلَاغَيْرِهِ: وَ + لَا + غَيْر + ـهِ — wa-, and + lā, not + ghayr, other than (gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'nor anyone else' (printed as one word)
بِالْمَلِكِ: بِـ + الـ + مَلِك — bi-, with (prep.; maʿrifa bi-, 'acquaintance with') + al-, the + malik, king (gen.); 'with the king'; also muṭmaʾinn bi-, ‘trusting in, at ease in’: ‘in the king’ (Night 110)
عُرِضْتِ: ʿuriḍti — ʿaraḍa, to display, present (verb I, perf. passive 2fs); ʿuriḍa ʿalā, 'be shown to (for sale)'
لَابَلْ: لَا + بَلْ — lā, no + bal, rather (adversative particle); 'no, rather' (printed as one word)
تَرَبَّيْتُ: tarabbaytu — tarabbā, to be brought up, raised (verb V, perf. 1s)
وَبِنْتُهُ: وَ + بِنْت + ـهُ — wa-, and + bint, daughter (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his daughter'
فَإِنْكَانَ: فَـ + إِنْ + كَانَ — fa-, so + in, if (conditional particle) + kāna, to be (verb, 3ms past); 'so if (it) is', printed as one word
فَأْتِنِي: فَـ + ائْتِ + ـنِي — fa-, then + (i)ʾti, come! (imperative of أَتَى) + -nī, me; with بِـ 'bring me'
بِدَوَاةٍ: بِـ + دَوَاة — bi-, with (prep.; after أَتَى 'come with' = 'bring') + dawāh, inkwell (f.), indef. gen.; '(bring) an inkwell'
وَقِرْطَاسٍ: وَ + قِرْطَاس — qirṭās, paper, sheet of paper (m.), indef. gen.; 'and paper'
فَسَلِّمِ: فَـ + سَلِّمْ — fa-, then + sallim, hand over, deliver (imperative, form II of س ل م), helping kasra before the article; 'then hand over'
طَرَقَتْهَا: طَرَقَ + ـتْ + ـهَا — ṭaraqa, to knock at, come upon (esp. by night) (verb, 3fs past, agreeing with the broken plural صُرُوف) + -hā, her; 'have come upon her'
وَالْأَيَّامِ: وَ + الـ + أَيَّام — ayyām, pl. of يَوْم, day, gen.; 'and the days'
بِيعَتْ: بَاعَ — bāʿa, to sell (verb, hollow root, 3fs past passive); 'she was sold'
سَأَلَكَ: سَأَلَ + ـكَ — saʾala, to ask (verb, 3ms past; future sense after إِذَا) + -ka, you (m.); 'he asks you'
فَأَخْبِرْهُ: فَـ + أَخْبِرْ + ـهُ — fa-, then + akhbir, inform! (imperative, form IV of خ ب ر) + -hu, him; 'then tell him'
وَازْدَادَتْ: وَ + اِزْدَادَ — izdāda, to increase, grow (verb, form VIII of ز ي د, 3fs past); 'and (it) grew'
لَعِبُوا: لَعِبَ — laʿiba, to play (verb, 3mp past); with بِـ 'to play with, trick'; 'they played'
بِعَقْلِكِ: بِـ + عَقْل + ـكِ — bi-, with (prep.; لَعِبَ بِـ 'play with') + ʿaql, mind, reason (m.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your mind'
وَبَاعُوكِ: وَ + بَاعُوا + ـكِ — wa-, and + bāʿū, they sold (بَاعَ, to sell, 3mp past; the final alif drops before the suffix) + -ki, you (f.); 'and they sold you'
تَحْفَظِينَ: حَفِظَ — ḥafiẓa, to keep, guard; to know by heart (verb, 2fs present); 'you know by heart'
وَأَعْرِفُ: وَ + عَرَفَ — wa-, and + ʿarafa, to know (verb, 1s present); 'and I know'
حِكْمَةَ: حِكْمَة — ḥikma, wisdom, science (f.), acc., construct; 'the science of'
وَمُقَدِّمَةَ: وَ + مُقَدِّمَة — muqaddima, introduction, preface (f.), acc., construct; 'and the Introduction of', title of a book (see note)
وَشَرْحَ: وَ + شَرْح — sharḥ, commentary, explanation (m.), acc., construct; 'and the Commentary on'
فُصُولِ: فُصُول — fuṣūl, pl. of فَصْل, section, chapter, gen.; here the Aphorisms of Hippocrates; 'the Sections of'
بُقْرَاطَ: بُقْرَاط — Buqrāṭ, Hippocrates (foreign name, diptote), gen.; 'Hippocrates'
لِجَالِينُوسَ: لِـ + جَالِينُوس — li-, by (prep.; marks the author) + Jālīnūs, Galen (foreign name, diptote), gen.; 'by Galen'
وَشَرَحْتُهُ: وَ + شَرَحَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — sharaḥa, to explain, write a commentary on (verb, 1s past) + -hu, it; 'and I commented on it'
التَّذْكِرَةَ: الـ + تَذْكِرَة — tadhkira, memorandum, reminder (f.), acc.; book title al-Tadhkira (see note)
وَشَرَحْتُ: وَ + شَرَحَ — sharaḥa, to comment on, explain (verb, 1s past); 'and I commented on'
الْبُرْهَانَ: الـ + بُرْهَان — burhān, proof (m.), acc.; book title al-Burhān (see note)
مُفْرَدَاتِ: مُفْرَدَات — mufradāt, pl. of مُفْرَد, single thing; in medicine 'simple drugs', acc. (fem. pl. -āt), construct; 'the Simples of'
الْبَيْطَارِ: الـ + بَيْطَار — bayṭār, farrier, veterinarian (m.), gen.; in the name Ibn al-Bayṭār
وَتَكَلَّمْتُ: وَ + تَكَلَّمَ — takallama, to speak (verb, form V, 1s past); with عَلَى 'to lecture on', with فِي 'to speak on'; 'and I spoke'
الْمَكِّيِّ: الـ + مَكِّيّ — makkī, Meccan (relative adj. from مَكَّة), gen.; 'the Meccan' (possibly a slip for الْمَلَكِيّ 'the Royal'; see note)
سِينَا: سِينَا — Sīnā, in the name Ibn Sīnā, Avicenna; indeclinable
وَحَلَّيْتُ: وَ + حَلَّيْتُ — ḥallaytu, I solved, untied: spoken-style form of حَلَلْتُ (حَلَّ, to untie, solve, doubled root, 1s past); 'and I solved'
الرُّمُوزَ: الـ + رُمُوز — rumūz, pl. of رَمْز, sign, symbol, riddle, acc.; 'the riddles'
الْأَشْكَالَ: الـ + أَشْكَال — ashkāl, pl. of شَكْل, figure, shape (also: difficult question), acc.; 'the figures'
وَأَتْقَنْتُ: وَ + أَتْقَنَ — atqana, to master, do perfectly (verb, form IV, 1s past); 'and I mastered'
الْأَبْدَانِ: الـ + أَبْدَان — abdān, pl. of بَدَن, body, gen.; 'the bodies'
الشَّافِعِيَّةِ: الـ + شَافِعِيَّة — Shāfiʿiyya, the Shāfiʿites, followers of the jurist al-Shāfiʿī (collective f.), gen.; 'the Shāfiʿites'
وَنَاظَرْتُ: وَ + نَاظَرَ — nāẓara, to debate, dispute with (verb, form III, 1s past); 'and I disputed with'
وَأَلَّفْتُ: وَ + أَلَّفَ — allafa, to compose, write (a book) (verb, form II, 1s past); 'and I composed'
وَالْجَدَاوِلِ: وَ + الـ + جَدَاوِل — jadāwil, pl. of جَدْوَل, table (esp. astronomical), gen.; 'and the tables'
الرُّوحَانِيَّ: الـ + رُوحَانِيّ — rūḥānī, spiritual (relative adj. from رُوح, spirit), acc., used as a noun: the science of spirits; 'the spiritual (science)'
وَالْمِيقَاتَ: وَ + الـ + مِيقَات — mīqāt, appointed time; the science of timekeeping (m.), acc.; 'and timekeeping'
وَفَهِمْتُ: وَ + فَهِمَ — fahima, to understand (verb, 1s past); 'and I understood'
يَنْفَعُكَ: نَفَعَ + ـكَ — nafaʿa, to profit, be of use to (verb, 3ms present) + -ka, you (m.); 'it benefits you'
سَفَرِكَ: سَفَر + ـكَ — safar, journey (m.), gen. + -ka, your (m.); 'your journey'
وَيُغْنِيكَ: وَ + أَغْنَى + ـكَ — aghnā, to make rich; with عَنْ 'to make free of need for, spare' (verb, form IV, 3ms present) + -ka, you (m.); 'and it spares you'
مُجَلَّدَاتِ: مُجَلَّدَات — mujalladāt, pl. of مُجَلَّد, bound volume, gen., construct; 'the volumes of'
الْأَسْفَارِ: الـ + أَسْفَار — asfār, pl. of سِفْر, large book, tome, gen.; 'the tomes'
بَخٍ: بَخٍ — bakhin, interjection of admiration, 'bravo! excellent!'
سَعْدَ: سَعْد — saʿd, good fortune, happiness (m.), acc. after يَا, construct; 'the good fortune of'
تَكُونِينَ: كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb, hollow root, 2fs present); 'you will be'; also: in a question, 'are you': man takūnīna anti, 'who are you?'
أَنَاهَا: the print's اناها, no known word, almost certainly a misprint for أَتَاهَا: أَتَى + ـهَا — atā, to come (verb, 3ms past); with بِـ 'bring' + -hā, her; 'he brought her'
وَقَلَمٍ: وَ + قَلَم — qalam, pen (reed pen) (m.), indef. gen.; 'and a pen'
وَتَنَاوَلَتِ: وَ + تَنَاوَلَ — tanāwala, to take up, reach for (verb, form VI, 3fs past), helping kasra before the article; 'and she took up'
عَيْنِيَّ: عَيْن + ـيَّ — ʿayn, eye (f.) + my; 'my eyes' (printed with kasra where the dual ʿaynayya is expected)
نَفَرَا: نَفَرَ — nafara, to flee, shy away (verb I, perf. 3ms, rhyme-alif); 'has fled'
أَاَنْتَ: أَ + أَنْتَ — a-, question particle + anta, you (m. sg.); 'is it you?'
عَلَّمْتَ: عَلَّمَ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, perf. 2ms); 'you taught'
السَّهَرَا: الـ + سَهَر — sahar, sleeplessness, wakefulness (m., acc., rhyme-alif); 'the wakefulness'
وَمَالِذِكْرِكَ: وَ + مَا + لِـ + ذِكْر + ـكَ (printed as one word) — wa-, and + mā, what + li-, for (prep.: 'what is the matter with') + dhikr, remembrance (m., gen.) + you; 'and what is it with remembrance of you?'
يُصْلِي: يُصْلِي — aṣlā, to roast in fire, set burning (verb IV, impf. 3ms); 'it roasts, it sets burning'
اَهَكَذَا: اَ + هٰكَذَا — a-, question particle + hākadhā, thus, like this; 'is it thus?'
صَبٍّ: صَبّ — ṣabb, one sick with love, ardent lover (m., gen.); 'lover'
الْمَهْوَى: الـ + مَهْوَى — mahwā, place or object of love (from hawiya, to love; acc.); 'the beloved'
ذَكَرَا: ذَكَرَ — dhakara, to remember, call to mind (verb I, perf. 3ms, rhyme-alif); 'remembered'
سَقْيًا: سَقْي — saqy, watering (m., acc. of exclamation); 'may rain water ...!' (a blessing)
يَّامِنَا: (أَ)يَّام + ـنَا — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm; gen.) + our; with the preceding لَا, printed apart: 'for our days'
اَطْيَبَهَا: اَطْيَبَ + ـهَا — aṭyaba, 'how sweet' (verb of wonder, afʿala form, from ṭāba) + them/it (f.); 'how sweet they were'
اَقْضِ: قَضَى — qaḍā, to fulfil, accomplish (verb I, jussive 1s after lam); 'I (did not) fulfil'
لَذَّاتِهَا: لَذَّات + ـهَا — ladhdhāt, pleasures (pl. of ladhdha; gen.) + its/their (f.); 'their pleasures'
وَطَرَا: وَطَر — waṭar, wish, desire (m., acc., rhyme-alif); 'a desire'
اَسْتَعْطِفُ: اسْتَعْطَفَ — istaʿṭafa, to ask kindness of (verb X, impf. 1s); 'I plead with'
حَامِلَةٌ: حَامِلَة — ḥāmila, carrying, a carrier (act. part. f. of ḥamala; nom.); 'carries' Also with a direct object, like a verb: wa-hiya ḥāmilatun al-māla, 'she carrying the money'.
اَكْنَافِكُمْ: اَكْنَاف + ـكُمْ — aknāf, sides, regions (pl. of kanaf; gen.) + your (pl.); 'your parts, your country'
يَشْكُو: شَكَا — shakā, to complain (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'he complains'
نَاصِرُهُ: نَاصِر + ـهُ — nāṣir, helper (act. part. of naṣara; nom.) + his; 'his helpers'
وَلِلْفِرَاقِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + فِرَاق — wa-, and + li-, belonging to (prep.: 'X has ...') + firāq, parting (m., gen.); 'and parting has'
خُطُوبٌ: خُطُوب — khuṭūb, calamities (pl. of khaṭb; nom.); 'calamities'
تَصْدَعُ: صَدَعَ — ṣadaʿa, to split, crack (verb I, impf. 3fs); 'they split'
الْحَجَرَا: الـ + حَجَر — ḥajar, stone (m., acc., rhyme-alif); 'the stone'
كِتَابَةِ: كِتَابَة — kitāba, writing (verbal noun of kataba; gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the writing (of)'
اخْتَرَمَهَا: اخْتَرَمَ + ـهَا — ikhtarama, to cut off, carry off (as death does) (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + her; 'has consumed her'
وَأَنْحَلَهَا: وَ + أَنْحَلَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + anḥala, to make thin, waste (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + her; 'and has wasted her'
فَظُلْمَتُهَا: فَـ + ظُلْمَة + ـهَا — fa-, so + ẓulma, darkness (f., nom.) + her; 'so her darkness'
أَنْوَارٍ: أَنْوَار — anwār, lights (pl. of nūr; gen. after min); 'lights'
وَتَتَقَلَّبُ: وَ + تَقَلَّبَ — wa-, and + taqallaba, to toss and turn (verb V, impf. 3fs); 'and she tosses'
مَرَاقِدِ: مَرَاقِد — marāqid, beds, sleeping-places (pl. of marqad; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the beds (of)'
وَتَكْتَحِلُ: وَ + اكْتَحَلَ — wa-, and + iktaḥala, to put kohl on one's own eyes (verb VIII, impf. 3fs); 'and she lines her eyes'
بِمَرَاوِدِ: بِـ + مَرَاوِد — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + marāwid, kohl-rods (pl. of mirwad; gen.); 'with the kohl-sticks (of)'
لِلنُّجُومِ: لِـ + الـ + نُجُوم — li-, for, over (prep., the object of the watching) + nujūm, stars (pl. of najm; gen.); 'over the stars'
رَقِيبَةٌ: رَقِيبَة — raqība, watcher (f. of raqīb; nom.); 'a watcher'
وَلِلظَّلَامِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + ظَلَام — wa-, and + li-, over (prep., what is guarded) + ẓalām, darkness (m., gen.); 'and over the darkness'
نَقِيبَةٌ: نَقِيبَة — naqība, overseer, warden (f. of naqīb; nom.); 'an overseer'
أَذَا: (first half of أَذَابَهَا, printed apart) أَذَابَ — adhāba, to melt (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); 'has melted'
الْكُفْرُ: الـ + كُفْر — kufr, unbelief (m., nom.); as printed; probably a misprint (for الفكر 'care' or الكمد 'grief')
وَشَرْحُ: وَ + شَرْح — wa-, and + sharḥ, explaining, account (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the telling (of)'
مُسَاعِدَ: مُسَاعِد — musāʿid, helper (act. part. III of sāʿada; acc. after lā of absolute negation); 'no helper'
الْأَبْ—يَ—اتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات (printed split by dashes) — abyāt, verses, lines of poetry (pl. of bayt; acc.); 'the verses'
غَرَّدَتْ: غَرَّدَ — gharrada, to warble, sing (of a bird) (verb II, perf. 3fs); 'has sung'
سَحَرًا: سَحَر — saḥar, the time before dawn (m., acc. of time); 'at dawn'
وَرْقَاءُ: وَرْقَاء — warqāʾ, ash-grey dove (f. of awraq; nom.); 'a grey dove'
فَنَنٍ: فَنَن — fanan, branch (m., gen. after fī); 'a branch'
تَحَرَّكَ: تَحَرَّكَ — taḥarraka, to stir, move (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'there stirred'
الشَّجَنِ: الـ + شَجَن — shajan, grief, sorrow (m., gen.); 'grief'
تَأَوَّهَ: تَأَوَّهَ — taʾawwaha, to sigh, say 'ah!' (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'has sighed'
الْاَحِبَّةِ: الـ + اَحِبَّة — aḥibba, beloved ones (pl. of ḥabīb; gen. after ilā); 'the beloved ones'
حَزَنِي: حَزَن + ـِي — ḥazan, sorrow (m., nom.) + my; 'my sorrow'
يَرْحَمُنِي: رَحِمَ + ـنِي — raḥima, to pity (verb I, impf. 3ms) + me; 'pities me'
وَالْبَدَنِ: وَ + الـ + بَدَن — wa-, and + badan, body (m., gen.); 'and the body'
أَفَاضَتْ: أَفَاضَ — afāḍa, to pour out, shed (verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she shed'
اَبْلَى: اَبْلَى — ablā, to wear out (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'has worn out'
اَسَفًا: اَسَف — asaf, grief, sorrow (m., acc. of manner); 'with grief'
النَّوَى: الـ + نَوَى — nawā, distance, separation (f., gen.); 'parting'
بَدَنِي: بَدَن + ـِي — badan, body (m., acc.) + my; 'my body'
الْهَجْرُ: الـ + هَجْر — hajr, forsaking, abandonment (m., nom.); 'abandonment'
الْجَفْنِ: الـ + جَفْن — jafn, eyelid (m., gen.); 'the eyelid'
وَالْوَسَنِ: وَ + الـ + وَسَن — wa-, and + wasan, drowsiness, sleep (m., gen.); 'and sleep'
بِجِسْمِي: بِـ + جِسْم + ـِي — bi-, for, as regards (prep., with kafā: 'it is enough for') + jism, body (m., gen.) + my; 'for my body'
نُحُولًا: نُحُول — nuḥūl, thinness, wasting (m., acc. of specification); 'as for thinness'
مُخَاطَبَتِي: مُخَاطَبَة + ـِي — mukhāṭaba, addressing, speaking to (verbal noun III of khāṭaba; nom.) + my; 'my speaking'
اِيَّاكَ: اِيَّا + ـكَ — iyyā, carrier of an object pronoun + you (m.); 'you' (object) With a following accusative it gives a warning: iyyāka ḍarbata …, 'beware the blow of …'.
تَرَنِي: رَأَى + ـنِي — raʾā/yarā, to see (verb I, jussive 2ms after lam, long vowel dropped: tara) + me; 'you would not see me'
أفَاضَتْ: أَفَاضَ — afāḍat, she made overflow, poured forth (verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs, of فَاضَ 'overflow'); hamza supplied, printed bare
أسْفَلِ: أَسْفَل — asfal, lowest; as a noun, the bottom, lower part (elative of سَفَلَ; gen. after فِي); hamza supplied, printed bare
الْبَعِيدَةِ: الـ + بَعِيدَة — al- + baʿīda, far, distant (f. of بَعِيد; gen.; used as a noun, 'her who is far'); construed with عَنْ, 'far from'
الْأهْلِ: الـ + أَهْل — al- + ahl, family, kin, people (m., gen. after عَنْ); hamza supplied, printed bare
وَالْأوْطَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَوْطَان — wa-, and + al- + awṭān, homelands (pl. of وَطَن; gen.); hamza supplied, printed bare
الْحَزِينَةِ: الـ + حَزِينَة — al- + ḥazīna, sad, grieving (f. of حَزِين; gen.); with a following genitive noun, 'sad of ...'
وَالْجَنَانِ: وَ + الـ + جَنَان — wa-, and + al- + janān, heart, inward soul (m., gen.); 'and the soul'
لَفَّتِ: لَفَّتْ — laffat (laffa, to roll up, wrap; verb I doubled, perf. 3fs), with helping kasra before al-; 'she rolled up'
وَنَاوَلَتْهُ: وَ + نَاوَلَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + nāwalat (nāwala, to hand, pass to; verb III, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (3ms object); 'and she handed it'
صَوَّرَكِ: صَوَّرَ + كِ — ṣawwara, to form, fashion, give shape to (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -ki, you (2fs object); 'He fashioned you'; the shadda is printed
وَأدْرَكَ: وَ + أَدْرَكَ — wa-, and + adraka, overtake, reach (form IV perfect 3m.sg.); 'and it overtook'; hamza supplied, printed bare
كَتَبَتِ: كَتَبَ + تِ — kataba, write; 3 f.s. perfect (kasra links to الـ); 'she wrote'
وَقَرَأهُ: وَ + قَرَأَ + هُ — qaraʾa, read; 3 m.s. perfect + it; 'and he read it'
يُلَاطِفُهَا: يُلَاطِفُ + هَا — lāṭafa (III), treat gently; 3 m.s. imperfect + her; 'he treats her kindly'
نَهَارَهُ: نَهَار + هُ — nahār, day(time); acc. of time + his; 'his day'
فَأَطْعَمَهَا: فَـ + أَطْعَمَ + هَا — fa-, and then + aṭʿama (IV), feed; + her; 'and he fed her'
أَدْخَلَهَا: أَدْخَلَ + هَا — adkhala (IV), make enter, take in; + her; 'he took her in'
بِبَلَّانَةٍ: بِـ + بَلَّانَة — ballāna, bath-attendant (f.); bi- goes with أَتَى 'bring'; 'with a bath-woman'
فَرَغْتِ: فَرَغَ + تِ — faragha, finish; 2 f.s. perfect; 'you (f.) have finished'
فَأَلْبِسِيهَا: فَـ + أَلْبِسِي + هَا — fa-, then (begins the answer to idhā) + albisī, imperative f.s. of albasa (IV), clothe + her; 'then dress her'
الْأَثْوَابَ: الـ + أَثْوَاب — athwāb, garments (pl. of thawb); acc., second object; 'the clothes'
وَفَاكِهَةً: وَ + فَاكِهَة — fākiha, fruit; acc.; 'and fruit'
مَصْطَبَةِ: مَصْطَبَة — maṣṭaba, built bench; gen. after ʿalā, first term of iḍāfa; 'bench of'
فَرَغَتِ: فَرَغَ + تِ — faragha, finish; 3 f.s. perfect (kasra links to الـ); 'she finished'
الْبَلَّانَةُ: الـ + بَلَّانَة — ballāna, bath-attendant (f.); nom.; 'the bath-woman'
تَنْظِيفِهَا: تَنْظِيف + هَا — tanẓīf, cleaning (verbal noun of II); gen. after min + her; 'cleaning her'
أَلْبَسَتْهَا: أَلْبَسَ + تْ + هَا — albasa (IV), clothe; 3 f.s. perfect + her; 'she dressed her'
مَصْطَبَتِهِ: مَصْطَبَة + هِ — maṣṭaba, bench + its (the bath's); gen. after ʿalā; 'its bench'
أَعْلَمَتْهُ: أَعْلَمَ + تْ + هُ — aʿlama (IV), inform; 3 f.s. perfect + him; 'she informed him'
فَأَكَلَتْ: فَـ + أَكَلَتْ — fa-, and then + akala, eat; 3 f.s. perfect; 'and she ate'
وَالْبَلَّانَةُ: وَ + الـ + بَلَّانَة — 'and the bath-woman' (nom., joined to hiya)
وَدَفَعَتَا: وَ + دَفَعَ + تَا — dafaʿa, give, hand over; 3 f. dual perfect (-atā); 'and the two of them gave'
لِصُنَّاعِ: لِـ + صُنَّاع — ṣunnāʿ, workers (pl. of ṣāniʿ); li-, to (marks the recipient); 'to the workers of'
وَحَارِسِهِ: وَ + حَارِس + هِ — ḥāris, guardian, keeper + his; gen. with ṣunnāʿ; 'and its keeper'
بَاتَتْ: بَاتَ + تْ — bāta, spend the night; 3 f.s. perfect; 'she spent the night'
مُنْعَزِلًا: مُنْعَزِل — munʿazil, withdrawn, apart (act. part. of VII); acc. (circumstantial); 'apart'
اسْتَيْقَظَ: اسْتَيْقَظَ — istayqaẓa (X), wake up; 3 m.s. perfect; 'he woke'
نَوْمِهِ: نَوْم + هِ — nawm, sleep + his; gen. after min; 'his sleep'
كُوفِيَّةً: كُوفِيَّة — kūfiyya, head-cloth, kerchief; acc.; 'a head-cloth'
وَبَدْلَةَ: وَ + بَدْلَة — badla, suit (of clothes); acc.; 'and a suit of'
تُرْكِيَّةً: تُرْكِيَّة — turkiyya, Turkish (f.); acc., adjective of badla; 'Turkish'
وَخُفًّا: وَ + خُفّ — khuff, boot, slipper; acc.; 'and a boot'
أُذْنَيْهَا: أُذْن + هَا — udhn, ear; dual gen. (-ayn) after fī + her; 'her two ears'
بِلُؤْلُؤٍ: بِـ + لُؤْلُؤ — luʾluʾ, pearls; bi-, with (what it is studded with); 'with pearls' Also bi- of the instrument: ḍarrasat al-ʿaqīqa bi-luʾluʾin, 'she bit the carnelian with a pearl' (her teeth).
طَوْقًا: طَوْق — ṭawq, collar, neck-ring; acc.; 'a collar'
الرُّمَّانَتَيْنِ: الـ + رُمَّانَة — rummāna, pomegranate; dual gen. (-ayn); 'the two pomegranates'
وَقِلَادَةً: وَ + قِلَادَة — qilāda, necklace; acc.; 'and a necklace'
الْقِلَادَةُ: الـ + قِلَادَة — qilāda, necklace; nom.; 'the necklace'
أُكَرٍ: أُكَر — ukar, balls (pl. of ukra); gen. after ten; 'balls'
أَهِلَّةٍ: أَهِلَّة — ahilla, crescents (pl. of hilāl); gen.; 'crescents'
فَصٌّ: فَصّ — faṣṣ, gem, set stone; nom. (subject of a sentence with fī wasaṭihi first); 'a gem'
قُوتٍ: قُوت — second half of yā qūt (yāqūt), ruby; gen. after min; 'ruby'
أُكْرَةٍ: أُكْرَة — ukra, ball; gen. in iḍāfa; 'ball'
الْبَلَخْشِ: الـ + بَلَخْش — balakhsh, balas ruby (pale red spinel, from Badakhshān); gen. after min; 'the balas ruby'
وَثَمَنُ: وَ + ثَمَن — thaman, price; nom.; 'and the price of'
الْقِلَادَةِ: الـ + قِلَادَة — qilāda, necklace; gen. in iḍāfa; 'the necklace'
الْكِسْوَةُ: الـ + كِسْوَة — kiswa, clothing, outfit; nom.; 'the outfit'
كَسَاهَا: كَسَا + هَا — kasā, clothe (two objects); 3 m.s. perfect + her; 'he clothed her'
بَلِيغَةٍ: بَلِيغَة — balīgha, ample, considerable (f.); gen., adjective of jumla; 'ample'
لَبِسَهَا: لَبِسَ + هَا — labisa, put on, wear; 3 m.s. perfect form (see note) + it; 'she put it on'
أَمَرَهَا: أَمَرَ + هَا — amara, command; 3 m.s. perfect + her; 'he told her'
التَّاجِرُأَنْ: الـ + تَاجِر + أَنْ — tājir, merchant (nom., subject) + an, that (+ subjunctive, after a verb of commanding); printed as one word; 'the merchant, that'
تَتَزَيَّنَ: تَتَزَيَّنَ — tazayyana (V), adorn oneself; 2/3 f.s. subjunctive after an; 'she adorn herself'
فَتَزَيَّنَتْ: فَـ + تَزَيَّنَتْ — fa-, and so + tazayyana (V), adorn oneself; 3 f.s. perfect; 'and she adorned herself'
وَأَرْخَتْ: وَ + أَرْخَتْ — arkhā (IV), let down, let fall; 3 f.s. perfect; 'and she let down'
خَاقُونِيَّةً: خَاقُونِيَّة — khāqūniyya, a face-veil (named after the Khāqān; reading uncertain); acc. object; 'a veil'
وَمَشَتْ: وَ + مَشَتْ — mashā, walk; 3 f.s. perfect; 'and she walked'
عَايَنَهَا: عَايَنَ + هَا — ʿāyana (III), see with one's eyes, behold; 3 m.s. perfect + her; 'he beheld her'
بَهِتُوا: بَهِتَ + وا — bahita, be dumbfounded, stunned; 3 m.pl. perfect; 'they were stunned'
الْخَالِقِينَ: الـ + خَالِق — khāliq, creator (pl. gen. -īna after the elative); 'the creators'
الْمَلِكُ،: الـ + مَلِك — malik, king; 'the king' (nom., vocative address; comma is the print's)
