غَرِيبَةِ: غَرِيبَة — gharība, strange, wondrous (f.), gen. in an adjective-genitive chain; 'strange of'
مَعْدُودَةِ: maʿdūda, counted, reckoned (pass. part. f., عَدَّ), gen. in an adjective-genitive chain; 'counted as'
الْمِثَالِ: الـ + مِثَال — mithāl, likeness, pattern, example; 'the example' (gen.)
حَازَتِ: ḥāza, gain, possess (perfect 3 f.sg.; the kasra links to the following الـ); 'she has won'
وَالْإِحْسَانَ: و + الـ + إِحْسَان — wa-, and + iḥsān, benefaction, kindness, good doing; 'and the grace' (acc.)
أَرِنِي: arā, show (verb IV imperative) + -nī, me; 'show me'
أَوْقَفَهَا: awqafa, make stand, stop (verb IV, perfect 3 m.sg.) + -hā, her; 'he stood her'
فَارَقَتْهُ: fāraqa, part from, leave (verb III, perfect 3 f.sg.) + -hu, him; 'she had parted from him'
يَنْظُرْهَا: nazara, look at (jussive 3 m.sg. after لَمْ) + -hā, her; 'he had not looked at her'
مُضِيِّ: muḍiyy, passing, lapse (verbal noun of مَضَى), gen. in a construct; 'the passing of'
وِلَادَتِهَا: وِلَادَة + هَا — wilāda, birth + -hā, her; 'her birth'
أُخْتًا: ukht, sister; acc. (subject noun after أَنَّ, 'that to-him was a sister')
وَأَخًا: و + أَخ — wa-, and + akh, brother (acc.); 'and a brother'
ضُؤَ: Ḍawʾ, 'light' (printed ضؤ for ضَوْء; first half of the name Ḍawʾ al-Makān), acc.
يُبْغِضُهُمَا: abghaḍa, hate (verb IV, imperfect 3 m.sg.) + -humā, them both; 'hating them both'
مَعْرِفَتِهِ: مَعْرِفَة + ـهِ — maʿrifa, knowing, acquaintance + -hi, his; 'his knowing'
قَدَّمَهَا: qaddama, present, put forward (verb II, perfect 3 m.sg.) + -hā, her; 'he presented her'
كَوْنِهَا: كَوْن + هَا — kawn, being (verbal noun of كَانَ) + -hā, her; 'her being'
نَظِيرَ: naẓīr, equal, peer; acc. without tanwīn after لَا, 'no peer'
الدِّينِيَّةِ: الـ + دِينِيَّة — dīniyya, religious (f. adj.); 'the religious'
وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ: و + الـ + دُنْيَوِيَّة — wa-, and + dunyawiyya, worldly, secular (f. adj.); 'and the worldly'
وَالسِّيَاسِيَّةِ: و + الـ + سِيَاسِيَّة — wa-, and + siyāsiyya, political, of statecraft (f. adj.); 'and the political'
وَالرِّيَاضِيَّةِ: و + الـ + رِيَاضِيَّة — wa-, and + riyāḍiyya, mathematical (f. adj.); 'and the mathematical'
اشْتَرَيْتَهَا: ishtarā, buy (verb VIII, perfect 2 m.sg. -ta) + -hā, her; 'you bought her'
وَدَعْهَا: و + دَعْ + هَا — wa-, and + daʿ, leave (imperative of وَدَعَ) + -hā, her; 'and leave her'
وَلٰكِنِ: و + لٰكِنِ — wa-, and + lākin, but (kasra before the following wasl alif); 'but'
عُشْرًا: ʿushr, a tenth, tithe, customs duty (acc.); the damma is printed
تِجَارَتِي: تِجَارَة + ي — tijāra, trade + -ī, my; 'my trade'
بِخَازِنِ: بِـ + خَازِن — bi-, for (دَعَا بِـ, 'call for') + khāzin, keeper, treasurer; 'for the treasurer of'
دَارَةِ: دَار + ـهِ — dār, house + -hi, his (printed دارة for داره); 'his house' (gen., construct)
أَعْطِ: aʿṭi — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imper. 2ms); 'give!'
ثَلٰثَمِائَةِ: thalāthumiʾa — three hundred (numeral, acc. as object of aʿṭi, first term of an iḍāfa with alf); dagger alif not printed
مِئَةٌ: miʾa — hundred (f., nom. indef., part of the subject of yakūnu)
بِحَضْرَتِهِمْ: بِـ + حَضْرَة + هِمْ — bi-, in, with (prep.) + ḥaḍra, presence (f., gen.) + 3mp suffix; 'in their presence'
لِلْقُضَاةِ: لِـ + الـ + قُضَاة — li-, to (prep., the one addressed) + al- + quḍāt, judges (gen.); 'to the judges'
أُشْهِدُكُمْ: ushhidukum — ashhada, to call as witness (verb IV, impf. 1s) + -kum, you (2mp); 'I call you to witness'
أَعْتَقْتُ: aʿtaqtu — aʿtaqa, to free, manumit (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'I have freed'
أَتَزَوَّجَهَا: atazawwajahā — tazawwaja, to marry (verb V, impf. subj. 1s, after an) + -hā, her; 'that I marry her'
الْقُضَاةُ: الـ + قُضَاة — al- + quḍāt, judges (pl. of qāḍī, nom., subject); 'the judges'
حُجَّةً: ḥujja — deed, proof, legal document (f., acc. indef.; the print's own shadda); 'a deed'
بِإِعْتَاقِهَا: بِـ + إِعْتَاق + هَا — bi-, of, attesting (prep.) + iʿtāq, freeing, manumission (m., gen., verbal noun of IV) + -hā, her; 'of her freeing'
كَتَبُوا: katabū — kataba, to write (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they wrote'
وَنَثَرَ: وَ + نَثَرَ — wa-, and + nathara, to scatter, strew (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he scattered'
رُؤُسِ: ruʾus — heads (pl. of raʾs, gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa; printed without the Classical second waw); 'the heads of'
يَلْتَقِطُونَ: yaltaqiṭūna — iltaqaṭa, to pick up, gather (verb VIII, impf. 3mp)
نَثَرَهُ: نَثَرَ + هُ — nathara, to scatter (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'he scattered it'
مَنْشُورٍ: manshūr — decree, patent, open letter (m., gen. indef.)
سَامَهُ: سَامَ + هُ — sāma, to offer, put a price to (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; obscure here) + -hu, him; 'he offered him'
التَّوْقِيعَ: الـ + تَوْقِيع — al- + tawqīʿ, signature, royal endorsement (m., acc., object); 'the signature'
مُخَلَّدًا: mukhalladan — mukhallad, made lasting, perpetual (pass. part. of II khallada, acc. of state); 'in perpetuity'
يَدْفَعُ: yadfaʿu — dafaʿa, to pay; to push, ward off (verb I, impf. 3ms, indicative); 'he pays'; 'wards off' (yadfaʿu khalqun mawāqiʿa al-qadari, 'no creature wards off the blows of fate')
تِجَارَتِهِ: تِجَارَة + هِ — tijāra, trade, merchandise (f., gen. after ʿalā) + 3ms suffix; 'his trade'
لِلسِّتِّينَ: لِـ + الـ + سِتِّين — li-, for (prep., marking the number the night completes) + sittīn, sixty (gen. after li-); 'for the sixty'
الْمُتَاجِرَ: الـ + مُتَاجِر — mutājir, trader, merchant (act. part. of III tājara; m., acc. as object); 'the trader'
مُخَلِّدًا: mukhallid — making lasting, perpetuating (act. part. of II khallada; m., acc. with tanwīn, hāl); 'making it lasting'
وَالتَّاجِرِ: وَ + الـ + تَاجِر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + tājir, merchant (m., gen.); 'and the merchant'
أَلْفَاظِ: alfāẓ — words, utterances (broken pl. of lafẓ; m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'words of'
عِلْمِهَا: عِلْم + هَا — ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her knowledge'
ادَّعَاهُ: اِدَّعَى + هُ — iddaʿā, claimed (VIII, 3 m. sg. perf. of daʿā) + -hu, it (object, referring back to mā); 'he claimed it'
لِنُحَقِّقَ: لِـ + نُحَقِّقَ — li-, so that, in order to (particle taking the subjunctive; marks purpose) + nuḥaqqiqa, we verify (1 pl. subjunctive of II ḥaqqaqa); 'so that we verify'
بِإِرْخَاءِ: بِـ + إِرْخَاء — bi-, introducing the thing commanded after amara (prep.) + irkhāʾ, letting down, slackening (verbal noun of IV arkhā; m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the letting down of'
سِتَارَةٍ: sitāra — curtain, screen (f., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa); 'a curtain'
السِّتَارَةِ: الـ + سِتَارَة — sitāra, curtain, screen (f., gen. after khalfa); 'the curtain'
يُهَنِّينَهَا: يُهَنِّينَ + هَا — yuhanniyna, they (f.) congratulate (3 f. pl. impf. of II hannā, a defective spelling of hanna'a; the shadda is the print's own) + -hā, her (object); 'they congratulate her'
وَيُقَبِّلْنَ: وَ + يُقَبِّلْنَ — wa-, and + yuqabbilna, they (f.) kiss (3 f. pl. impf. of II qabbala); 'and kissing'
دُرْنَ: durna — they (f.) went round (3 f. pl. perf. of I dāra, hollow verb); 'they went round'
وَقَلَعْنَ: وَ + قَلَعْنَ — wa-, and + qalaʿna, they (f.) pulled off, removed (3 f. pl. perf. of I qalaʿa); 'and they took off'
وَخَفَّفْنَهَا: وَ + خَفَّفْنَ + هَا — wa-, and + khaffafna, they (f.) lightened, relieved (3 f. pl. perf. of II khaffafa) + -hā, her (object); 'and they relieved her'
ثِقَلِ: thiql — weight, burden (m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the weight of'
يَنْظُرْنَ: yanẓurna — they (f.) look (3 f. pl. impf. of I naẓara, takes ilā for 'look at'); 'they look'
امْتِحَانِهَا: امْتِحَان + هَا — imtiḥān, testing, examination (verbal noun of VIII imtaḥana, m., gen. after li-ajli) + 3fs poss.; 'her testing'
أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ: أَزْوَاج + هِنَّ — azwāj, husbands (pl. of zawj, gen. after min) + 3fp poss.; 'their husbands'
أَضَاءَتْ: aḍāʾat — to shine, be lit up (verb IV, perf. 3fs, final hamza); 'she/it shone'
أَوْعَدَتْهُنَّ: أَوْعَدَتْ + هُنَّ — awʿada, to promise (verb IV, perf. 3fs; classically 'threaten') + 3fp obj.; 'she promised them'
إِحْسَانِكِ: إِحْسَان + كِ — iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (verbal noun of IV aḥsana, m., gen. after min) + 2fs poss.; 'your kindness'
بَعْضُهُنَّ: بَعْض + هُنَّ — baʿḍ, some, part (m., nom. in apposition to the subject) + 3fp; 'some of them'
بَلْدَتُنَا: بَلْدَة + نَا — balda, town, city (f., nom. as subject of aḍāʾat) + 1pl poss.; 'our town'
بِقُلُوبِهِنَّ: بِـ + قُلُوب + هِنَّ — bi-, by (prep.; with akhadhat, 'took them by the hearts') + qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb, gen.) + 3fp poss.; 'by their hearts'
بِلَادُنَا: بِلَاد + نَا — bilād, lands, country (pl. of balad, nom. as subject of sharufat) + 1pl poss.; 'our lands'
تَرَبَّتْ: tarabbat — to be brought up, be raised (verb V, perf. 3fs, from rabbā); 'she had been raised'
تُجَاوِبَهُمْ: تُجَاوِبَ + هُمْ — jāwaba, to answer, reply to (verb III, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā) + 3mp obj.; 'she answers them'
تُخَلِّيَنَا: تُخَلِّيَ + نَا — khallā, to leave, leave empty (verb II, imperf. 2ms, final-weak; yā kept in the print; strictly jussive tukhallinā after lā) + 1pl obj.; 'leave us void'
ثَلٰثُمِائَةِ: thalāthu-miʾa — three hundred (thalāth, 'three', first term + miʾa, 'hundred'; defective spelling with the alif of thalāth supplied by the dagger alif; gen. as first term of an iḍāfa with dīnār)
جَالِسُونَ: jālisūna — sitting, seated (act. part. of jalasa; m. pl., nom.)
حَوَتْ: ḥawat — to contain, comprise, master (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she contained'
حُسْنِكِ: حُسْن + كِ — ḥusn, beauty, comeliness (m., gen. after ilā) + 2fs poss.; 'your beauty'
دَاخِلَةً: dākhila — entering, going in (act. part. of dakhala; f. sg., acc. as ḥāl); 'entering'
فَالْمَمْلَكَةُ: فَـ + الـ + مَمْلَكَة — fa-, so, then (introducing the inference) + al-, the + mamlaka, kingdom (f., nom. as subject); 'so the kingdom'
فَتَعَجَّبْنَ: فَـ + تَعَجَّبْنَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + taʿajjabna, to marvel, wonder (verb V, perf. 3fp); 'and they marvelled'
فَجَلَسْنَ: فَـ + جَلَسْنَ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + jalasna, to sit (verb I, perf. 3fp); 'and they sat'
فَسَمِعَتْ: فَـ + سَمِعَتْ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + samiʿat, to hear (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and heard'
فَشَكَرَتْهُنَّ: فَـ + شَكَرَتْ + هُنَّ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence) + shakarat, to thank (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3fp obj.; 'and she thanked them'
قَدْرَهَا: قَدْر + هَا — qadr, worth, rank, station (m., acc. as object) + 3fs poss.; 'her worth'
قَصْرُكِ: قَصْر + كِ — qaṣr, palace (m., nom. as subject) + 2fs poss.; 'your palace'
مَرَاتِبِهِنَّ: مَرَاتِب + هِنَّ — marātib, ranks, degrees (pl. of rutba, gen. after fī) + 3fp poss.; 'their ranks'
مَلِكَةٌ: malika — queen (f., nom. indef. as predicate); 'a queen'
مَمْلَكَتُكِ: مَمْلَكَة + كِ — mamlaka, kingdom (f., nom. as predicate) + 2fs poss.; 'your kingdom'
مُرْخَاةٌ: murkhāt — let down, lowered, hanging (pass. part. of IV arkhā; f. sg., nom. as predicate); 'lowered'
نِسَاءَ: nisāʾ — women, wives (pl., acc. as object of raʾat; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the women of'
نِسَاءُ: nisāʾ — women, wives (pl., nom. as subject of samiʿat; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the women of'
وَالسِّتَارَةُ: وَ + الـ + سِّتَارَة — wa-, while (circumstantial conj., opening a ḥāl clause) + al-, the + sitāra, curtain (f., nom. as subject); 'and the curtain'
وَالنَّظَرِ: وَ + الـ + نَّظَر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + naẓar, looking, sight (verbal noun of naẓara, m., gen.); 'and the looking'
وَالْعِلْمِ: وَ + الـ + عِلْم — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ʿilm, knowledge (m., gen.); 'and the knowledge'
وَالْقَصْرُ: وَ + الـ + قَصْر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + qaṣr, palace (m., nom. as subject); 'and the palace'
وَالْقُضَاةِ: وَ + الـ + قُضَاة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + quḍāt, judges (pl. of qāḍī, gen.); 'and the judges'
وَأَرْبَابَ: وَ + أَرْبَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + arbāb, lords, masters (pl. of rabb, acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the lords of'
وَأَعْتَقَهَا: وَ + أَعْتَقَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿtaqa, to free, manumit (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'and freed her'
وَأَمَاكِنُنَا: وَ + أَمَاكِن + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + amākin, places (pl. of makān, nom.; diptote form, here with damma) + 1pl poss.; 'and our places'
وَأَنْزَلَتْهُنَّ: وَ + أَنْزَلَتْ + هُنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + anzalat, to lodge, seat, give a place (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 3fp obj.; 'and she seated them'
وَأَوْطَانُنَا: وَ + أَوْطَان + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan, nom.) + 1pl poss.; 'and our homelands'
وَتَلَقَّتِ: وَ + تَلَقَّتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + talaqqat, to receive, meet (verb V, perf. 3fs; final kasra before the article); 'and she received'
وَجَدْنَ: wajadna — to find (verb I, perf. 3fp); 'they found'
وَزَنَ: wazana — to weigh, pay out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he weighed out'
وَشَرُفَتْ: وَ + شَرُفَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + sharufat, to be noble, be honoured (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and was honoured'
وَقَابَلَتْهُنَّ: وَ + قَابَلَتْ + هُنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + qābalat, to meet, face (verb III, perf. 3fs) + 3fp obj.; 'and she met them'
وَمَضَيْنَ: وَ + مَضَيْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + maḍayna, to go, depart (verb I, perf. 3fp, final-weak); 'and they went'
وَمَمْلَكَتُنَا: وَ + مَمْلَكَة + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + mamlaka, kingdom (f., nom.) + 1pl poss.; 'and our kingdom'
وَوَقَفَتِ: وَ + وَقَفَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + waqafat, to stand (verb I, perf. 3fs; final kasra before the article); 'and stood'
وَيُنَاظِرُونَهَا: وَ + يُنَاظِرُونَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yunāẓirūna, to dispute with (verb III, imperf. 3mp indic.) + 3fs obj.; 'and dispute with her'
وُقُوفًا: wuqūf — standing (verbal noun of waqafa used as ḥāl, m., acc.); 'standing'
يَسْأَلُونَهَا: يَسْأَلُونَ + هَا — yasʾalūna, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3mp indic.) + 3fs obj.; 'they ask her'
يُعَظِّمْنَ: yuʿaẓẓimna — to magnify, honour (verb II, imperf. 3fp); 'they honoured'
يَتَّبِعَ: yattabiʿa — to follow (verb VIII, impf. 3ms, subjunctive)
الْمَمْلَكَةُ: الـ + مَمْلَكَة — mamlaka, queen, sovereign (f., nom. in vocative apposition)
وَالزِّرَاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + زِرَاعَة — wa-, and + zirāʿa, farming, tillage (f., nom.)
انْهِمَاكِهِمْ: انْهِمَاك + هِمْ — inhimāk, absorption, immersion in (verbal noun of VII inhamaka, m., gen.) + 3mp poss.; 'their being absorbed'
فَالْإِمَارَةُ: فَـ + الـ + إِمَارَة — fa-, so, as for (resuming a topic) + imāra, governorship (f., nom.)
وَصَفَكِ: وَصَفَ + كِ — waṣafa, to describe (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 2fs obj.; 'he described you'
وَأَعْمَالُ: وَ + أَعْمَال — wa-, and + aʿmāl, works, occupations (pl. of ʿamal, nom.)
التَّامَّةُ: الـ + تَامَّة — tāmm, complete (act. part. of tamma; f., nom.)
فَتَسَبَّبَتْ: فَـ + تَسَبَّبَتْ — fa-, so + tasabbabat, to arise, be caused (verb V, perf. 3fs)
بِالدُّنْيَا: بِـ + الـ + دُنْيَا — bi-, by means of (prep.) + dunyā, the world; 'by way of the world'
أَقْسَامٍ: aqsām — parts, divisions (m. broken pl. of qism, gen. with tanwīn); 'parts'; also, as pl. of qasam, 'oath', conjurations, adjurations recited over the possessed: qaraʾa baʿḍa aqsāmin, 'he read some conjurations' (Night 193; 'some sections' is also possible)
الْمَلَكِيَّةِ: الـ + مَلَكِيَّة — malakī, royal (rel. adj., f., gen.)
يَتَوَصَّلُ: yatawaṣṣalu — to reach, attain, arrive at (verb V, impf. 3ms); takes ilā for the goal
مَحَاسِنَ: maḥāsin — fair points, virtues (broken pl.; diptote, acc. as subject of anna; first term of a construct)
إِعْلَمْ: iʿlam — to know (verb I imperative 2ms; wasl alif); 'know!'
وَهَوَاهُ: وَ + هَوَى + هُ — wa-, and + hawā, desire, whim (m., acc., final-weak) + 3ms poss.; 'and his desire'
أَهَمَّ: ahamm — more/most important (af ʿal elative of muhimm, diptote); as printed اهم, possibly a corrupt يلزمهم 'is incumbent on them'
وَالتِّجَارَةُ: وَ + الـ + تِجَارَة — wa-, and + tijāra, trade, commerce (f., nom.)
قِبَلِ: qibal — side, direction (m., gen.); مِنْ قِبَلِ 'on the part of, from the side of'
السِّيَاسَاتِ: الـ + سِيَاسَات — siyāsa, policy, statecraft (f. sound pl., gen.); 'the policies'
زَمَانِهَا: زَمَان + هَا — zamān, time, age (m., gen. after fī) + 3fs poss.; 'her age'
الْخُصُومَاتُ: الـ + خُصُومَات — khuṣūma, dispute, quarrel (f. pl., nom.); 'the disputes'
تَنَاوَلَهَا: تَنَاوَلَ + هَا — tanāwala, to take, take up (verb VI, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; 'took it'
السِّيَاسَةُ: الـ + سِيَاسَة — siyāsa, policy, statecraft (f., nom.)
بِالْعِلْمِ: بِـ + الـ + عِلْم — bi-, with / as having (prep.; waṣafa bi- 'describe as possessing') + ʿilm, knowledge (m., gen.); 'as having learning'
الْخُلُقِ: الـ + خُلُق — khuluq, character, disposition (m., gen.); 'the character'
الصَّادِقَةُ: الـ + صَادِقَة — ṣādiq, true, sincere (act. part. of ṣadaqa; f., nom.)
بِالْجَوْرِ: بِـ + الـ + جَوْر — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + jawr, injustice, oppression (m., gen.); 'with injustice'
الْمَعْبَادَ: الـ + مَعْبَاد — maʿbād, apparently a misprint for معاد 'the return, hereafter' or related to maʿbad 'place of worship' (m., acc. in apposition); uncertain
لَانْقَطَعَتِ: لَـ + انْقَطَعَتِ — la-, would (marks the answer to law) + inqaṭaʿat, to be cut off, cease (verb VII, perf. 3fs; final kasra is liaison before the article)
لِوُلَاةِ: لِـ + وُلَاة — li-, for, to (prep.; marks those it befits) + wulāt, governors (broken pl. of wālī, gen., first term of a construct); 'for the governors of'
وَالْآدَابِ: وَ + الـ + آدَاب — wa-, and + ādāb, refinements, manners (broken pl. of adab, gen.); 'and the refinements'
يَتَنَاوَلَ: yatanāwala — to take, partake of (verb VI, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an)
وَالْفِرَاسَةُ: وَ + الـ + فِرَاسَة — wa-, and + firāsa, discernment, shrewd insight (f., nom.)
فَاحْتَاجُوا: فَـ + احْتَاجُوا — fa-, so + iḥtāja, to need (verb VIII, perf. 3mp, hollow); takes ilā for the thing needed
الْإِمَارَةُ: الـ + إِمَارَة — imāra, governorship, rule (f., nom.)
الْإِمَارَةَ: الـ + إِمَارَة — imāra, governorship (f., acc. as subject of anna)
طَرِيقٌ: ṭarīq — road, way (m., nom. indef., predicate)
وَلَكِنَّهُمْ: وَ + لَكِنَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + lākinna, but (particle; puts its subject in the accusative) + 3mp; 'but they'
عِمَارَةِ: ʿimāra — building up, cultivation, prosperity (f., gen.; first term of a construct)
وَمُتَابَعَةِ: وَ + مُتَابَعَة — wa-, and + mutābaʿa, following (verbal noun of III tābaʿa, f., gen., first term of a construct)
الْمَرْضِيَّةِ: الـ + مَرْضِيَّة — marḍī, approved, pleasing (pass. part. of raḍiya; f., gen.)
تَنْقَسِمُ: tanqasimu — to be divided, divide (verb VII, impf. 3fs)
مَدَارُ: madār — pivot, axis, that on which something turns (m., nom.; first term of a construct)
وَالصِّنَاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + صِنَاعَة — wa-, and + ṣināʿa, craft, handiwork (f., nom.)
يَنْتَظِمُ: yantaẓimu — to be ordered, put in order (verb VII, impf. 3ms)
الْعَزِيزَةُ: الـ + عَزِيزَة — ʿazīz, dear, precious, mighty (adj., f., nom.); 'the dear one'
فَاسْمَعِينَا: فَـ + اسْمَعِي + نَا — fa-, so + asmiʿ-, to make hear, let hear (verb IV imperative 2fs; wasl alif) + 1pl obj.; 'so let us hear'
بِأَعْمَالِ: بِـ + أَعْمَال — bi-, by, by means of (prep.) + aʿmāl, works, deeds (pl. of ʿamal, gen., first term of a construct); 'by the labours of'
يَتَنَاوَلُونَهَا: يَتَنَاوَلُونَ + هَا — tanāwala, to take (verb VI, impf. 3mp) + 3fs obj.; 'they take it'
مَجْمُوعَةٌ: majmūʿa — gathered, collected (pass. part. of jamaʿa; f., nom. as predicate)
الشَّيْءِ: الـ + شَيْء — shayʾ, thing (m., gen. after min); 'the thing'
يُنْصِفَ: yunṣifa — to deal justly, do justice (verb IV, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an)
يَلْزَمُ: yalzamu — to be necessary, incumbent (verb I, impf. 3ms)
وَاذْكُرِي: وَ + اذْكُرِي — wa-, and + udhkur-, to mention, relate (verb I imperative 2fs; wasl alif)
كَزَادِ: كَـ + زَاد — ka-, like, as (prep.) + zād, provision for a journey (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'like the provision of'
وَيَضْبِطُ: وَ + يَضْبِطُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḍbiṭu, he regulates, manages (verb I imperf. 3ms, indic.; ḍabaṭa, to hold firmly, keep in order)
أُمُورَهُمْ: أُمُور + ـهُمْ — umūr, affairs (pl. of amr; m., acc., object of yaḍbiṭu); 'their affairs'
وَلَوْلَارَدْعُ: وَ + لَوْلَا + رَدْع — wa-, and + lawlā, were it not for (particle) + radʿ, restraining, checking (m. verbal noun of I radaʿa; nom. after lawlā); printed as one word: 'and were it not for the restraining of'
أَغْلَبَ: aghlaba — he overcame, overpowered (perf. 3ms; the printed form, see note; Lane records IV aghlaba, to cause to prevail); apodosis of lawlā, 'would have overpowered'
قَوِيُّهُمْ: قَوِيّ + ـهُمْ — qawiyy, strong (adj. used as noun; m., nom., subject); 'their strong one'
ضَعِيفِهِمْ: ضَعِيف + ـهِمْ — ḍaʿīf, weak (adj. used as noun; m., gen. after ʿalā); 'their weak one'
أَزْدَ: azd — first half of a name printed split: Azdashīr (Ardashīr) (see note)
شِيرُ: Shīr — second half of the name Ardashīr (nom.); 'Azd Shīr' = Ardashīr
الدِّينَ: الـ + دِين — dīn, religion, faith (m., acc., subject of anna); 'the religion'
وَالْمُلْكَ: وَ + الـ + مُلْك — wa-, and (conj.) + mulk, kingship, dominion (m., acc.; second subject of anna); 'and the kingship'
تَوْأَمَانِ: تَوْأَمَان — tawʾam, twin (m. dual, nom. predicate of anna; the printed precomposed hamza is kept); 'twins'
فَالدِّينُ: فَ + الـ + دِين — fa-, so, then (conj.) + dīn, religion (m., nom.); 'so religion'
كَنْزٌ: kanz — treasure (m., nom. with tanwīn; predicate)
وَالْمُلْكُ: وَ + الـ + مُلْك — wa-, and (conj.) + mulk, kingship, dominion (m., nom.; subject); 'and the kingship'
حَارِسٌ: ḥāris — guard, guardian (act. part. of I ḥarasa; m., nom. with tanwīn; predicate)
دَلَّتِ: dallat — it pointed to, indicated (verb I perf. 3fs, ending in -t for the feminine subject; with ʿalā, 'point to, show')
الشَّرَائِعُ: الـ + شَرَائِع — sharāʾiʿ, religious laws (broken pl. of sharīʿa; f., nom.); 'the laws'
وَالْعُقُولُ: وَ + الـ + عُقُول — wa-, and + ʿuqūl, minds, reason (broken pl. of ʿaql; m., nom.); 'and the minds'
يَتَّخِذُوا: yattakhidhū — they take, adopt (verb VIII imperf. 3mp, subjunctive after an, dropped final -n; ittakhadha, to take for oneself)
الظَّالِمَ: الـ + ظَالِم — ẓālim, wrongdoer, unjust (act. part. of I ẓalama; m., acc.); 'the wrongdoer'
الْمَظْلُومِ: الـ + مَظْلُوم — maẓlūm, wronged (pass. part. of I ẓalama; m., gen.); 'the wronged'
وَيُنْصِفُ: وَ + يُنْصِفُ — wa-, and + yunṣifu, he deals justly with, gives justice to (verb IV imperf. 3ms, indic.; anṣafa)
الضَّعِيفَ: الـ + ضَعِيف — ḍaʿīf, weak (adj. used as noun; m., acc., object of yunṣifu); 'the weak'
الْقَوِيِّ: الـ + قَوِيّ — qawiyy, strong (adj. used as noun; m., gen.); 'the strong'
وَيَكُفُّ: وَ + يَكُفُّ — wa-, and + yakuffu, he restrains, holds back (verb I imperf. 3ms, indic.; kaffa, geminate)
الْعَاتِي: الـ + عَاتِي — ʿātī, insolent, rebellious, tyrannical (act. part. of I ʿatā; m., gen., defective ending); 'the tyrant'
وَالْبَاغِي: وَ + الـ + بَاغِي — wa-, and + bāghī, oppressor, wrongdoer (act. part. of I baghā; m., gen.); 'and the oppressor'
شَيْئَانِ: شَيْئَان — shayʾ, thing (m. dual, nom. with the dual ending -āni; subject of the opening statement); 'two things'
صَلَحَا: ṣaliḥā — the two were sound, good (verb I perf. 3m dual of ṣaluḥa; the dual agrees with shayʾāni)
صَلَحَ: ṣaluḥa — he/it was sound, good (verb I perf. 3ms of ṣaluḥa, here with the people, nās, as subject)
فَسَدَا: fasadā — the two were corrupt, spoiled (verb I perf. 3m dual of fasada)
فَسَدَ: fasada — he/it was corrupt, spoiled (verb I perf. 3ms of fasada)
الْعُلَمَاءُ: الـ + عُلَمَاء — ʿulamāʾ, scholars, the learned (broken pl. of ʿālim; m., nom.); 'the scholars'
وَالْأُمَرَاءُ: وَ + الـ + أُمَرَاء — wa-, and + umarāʾ, commanders, princes (broken pl. of amīr; m., nom.); 'and the rulers'
ثَلَٰثَةٌ: thalāthah — three (f. form with tā' marbūṭa, nom. predicate; the printed spelling ثلثة omits the alif, restored here with the dagger alif)
دِينٍ: dīn — religion, faith (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa); 'of religion'
وَمَلِكُ: وَ + مَلِك — wa-, and (conj.) + malik, king (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and a king of'
مُحَافَظَةٍ: muḥāfaẓah — guarding, preserving (verb III verbal noun of ḥāfaẓa; f., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa); 'of guarding'
الْحُرُمَاتِ: الـ + حُرُمَات — ḥurumāt, sacred things, inviolable things (f. sound pl. of ḥurma; gen. after ʿalā); 'the sacred things'
هَوًي: hawan — desire, whim, passion (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa; printed with yā' for alif maqṣūra)
يُلْزِمُ: yulzimu — he binds, obliges (verb IV imperf. 3ms, indic.; alzama, to make someone keep to something)
رَعِينَهُ: رَعِين + ـهُ — raʿīn(a), the printed letters of what is probably a misprint for رَعِيَّة, raʿiyya, subjects, flock; + -hu, his; 'his subjects' (acc., object of yulzimu)
بِاتِّبَاعِ: بِـ + اِتِّبَاع — bi-, by, to (prep.; here marks what he binds them to: bound to following) + ittibāʿ, following (verb VIII verbal noun of tabiʿa; m., gen.)
دِينِهِمْ: دِين + ـهِمْ — dīn, religion (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'their religion'
أَدْيَنَهُمْ: أَدْيَن + ـهُمْ — adyan, more religious, most devout (elative of dayyin, from dīn; m., acc., predicate of yakūna); 'the most devout of them'
يُقْتَدَى: yuqtadā — one follows, is followed as a model (verb VIII imperf. passive 3ms of iqtadā; with bi-)
أُمُورِ: umūr — affairs, matters (pl. of amr; m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَيُلْزِمُ: وَ + يُلْزِمُ — wa-, and + yulzimu, he binds, obliges (verb IV imperf. 3ms, indic.)
طَاعَتَهُ: طَاعَة + ـهُ — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., acc., second object of yulzimu) + -hu, his; 'obedience to him'
لِلْأَحْكَامِ: لِـ + الْـ + أَحْكَام — li-, to, with (prep.; here the object of muwāfiqan: 'in agreement with') + ahkām, rulings (pl. of ḥukm; m., gen.); 'with the rulings'
يُنَزِّلُ: yunazzilu — he sets down, makes to alight (verb II imperf. 3ms, indic.; nazzala); with manzilata, 'he puts X in the position of Y'
السَّاخِطَ: الـ + سَاخِط — sākhiṭ, angry, resentful (act. part. of I sakhiṭa; m., acc.); 'the angry one'
مَنْزِلَةَ: manzilah — position, station (f., acc., adverbial; first term of an iḍāfa); 'in the position of'
الرَّاضِي: الـ + رَاضِي — rāḍī, content, satisfied (act. part. of I raḍiya; m., gen., defective ending); 'the contented'
التَّسْلِيمِ: الـ + تَسْلِيم — taslīm, submission, surrender (verb II verbal noun of sallama; m., gen.); 'the submission'
بِأُمُورِ: بِـ + أُمُور — bi-, by, with (prep.; after yaqūmu, qāma bi- 'he takes charge of, attends to') + umūr, affairs (pl. of amr; m., gen.)
بِانْبَاعِ: بِـ + اِنْبَاع — bi-, by, to (prep.; as with ittibāʿ above, what he binds them to) + inbāʿ, printed letters of what is probably a misprint for ittibāʿ, following (m., gen.)
الشَّرْعِ: الـ + شَرْع — sharʿ, the law, divine law (m., gen.); 'the law'
وَالْمُحَافَظَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُحَافَظَة — wa-, and + muḥāfaẓa, preserving, safeguarding (verb III verbal noun; f., gen.); 'and the safeguarding'
جَامِعًا: جَامِعًا — jāmiʿ, uniting, combining (act. part. of I jamaʿa; m., acc. with tanwīn, predicate of yakūnu)
الْقَلَمِ: الـ + قَلَم — qalam, pen (m., gen.); 'the pen' (after bayna)
وَالسَّيْفِ: وَ + الـ + سَيْف — wa-, and + sayf, sword (m., gen.); 'and the sword'
زَاغَ: zāgha — he swerved, strayed (verb I perf. 3ms, hollow; zāgha ʿan, 'stray from')
سَطَرَ: saṭara — he wrote, drew lines (verb I perf. 3ms)
زَلَّتْ: zallat — she/it slipped (verb I perf. 3fs, geminate; the subject is the foot)
فَيُقَوِّمُ: فَ + يُقَوِّمُ — fa-, so, and then (conj.) + yuqawwimu, he straightens, sets right (verb II imperf. 3ms, indic.; qawwama)
اعْوِجَابَهُ: اِعْوِجَاب + ـهُ — iʿwijāb, printed letters of what is probably a misprint for iʿwijāj, crookedness (verb IX verbal noun of iʿwajja; m., acc., object of yuqawwimu); + -hu, his; 'his crookedness'
بِحَدِّ: بِـ + حَدّ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; instrumental) + ḥadd, edge (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the edge of'
الْحُسَامِ: الـ + حُسَام — ḥusām, sharp sword (m., gen.); 'the sharp sword'
وَيَنْشُرُ: وَ + يَنْشُرُ — wa-, and + yanshuru, he spreads, unfolds (verb I imperf. 3ms, indic.; nashara)
الْعَدْلَ: الـ + عَدْل — ʿadl, justice (m., acc. as object); 'the justice'
اِتِّبَاعُ: ittibāʿ — following, pursuit (verbal noun of form VIII ittabaʿa; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the following of'
يَخْشَ: yakhsha — he fears (jussive of khashiya, to fear, dread; 3rd m. sg.)
سَطْوَةَ: saṭwa — violent assault, might, wrath (f., acc. as object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wrath of'
وَلَّاهُ: wallā + هُ — wallā, he set in authority, appointed (form II perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'who appointed him'
فَمَأٰلُ: فَـ + مَآل — fa-, so (links the conclusion) + maʾāl, outcome, end (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'so the outcome of'
الدَّمَارِ: الـ + دَمَار — damār, destruction, ruin (m., gen. after ilā); 'the ruin'
وَنِهَايَةُ: وَ + نِهَايَة — wa-, and + nihāya, end, extremity (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the end of'
عَتُوِّهِ: ʿutuww + هِ — ʿutuww, insolence, arrogant rebellion (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his insolence'
الْبَوَارِ: الـ + بَوَار — bawār, perdition, destruction (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the perdition'
وَقٰلَتِ: وَ + قَالَتِ — wa-, and + qālat, she/they said (form I perfect, 3rd f. sg.; the print has قل, so the dagger alif restores the vowel; kasra before the article); 'and said'
وَجَبَ: wajaba — it was necessary, incumbent (form I perfect, 3rd m. sg.)
بِأَخْلَاقِهِمْ: بِـ + أَخْلَاق + هِمْ — bi-, with, of (prep.; the one ʿārif takes, 'acquainted with') + akhlāq, characters, dispositions (m. pl. of khuluq, gen.) + -him, their; 'with their characters'
لِيَرُدَّ: لِـ + يَرُدَّ — li-, in order to (purposive; takes the subjunctive) + yaruddu, he returns, brings back (form I of radda, 3rd m. sg., subj.); 'in order to bring back'
اِخْتِلَافَهُمْ: ikhtilāf + هُمْ — ikhtilāf, disagreement, discord (verbal noun of form VIII ikhtalafa; m., acc. as object) + -hum, their; 'their discord'
وِفَاتِهِمْ: wifāt + هِمْ — wifāt (as printed; see note) + -him, their; presumably wifāq, concord, agreement (m., gen. after ilā); 'their concord'
وَيَعُمَّهُمْ: وَ + يَعُمَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + yaʿummu, he encompasses, includes all (form I of ʿamma, 3rd m. sg., subj.) + -hum, them; 'and embrace them'
بِعَدْ: بِـ + عَدْ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + ʿad-, the first half of ʿadl, justice, printed split from its ending (see note); 'with just-'
وَيَغْمُرَهُمْ: وَ + يَغْمُرَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + yaghmuru, he floods, overwhelms (form I of ghamara, 3rd m. sg., subj.) + -hum, them; 'and flood them'
شِيرَ: shīr — second half of the name Azdashīr; (acc. after anna)
جَمْرُ: jamr — coal, ember (m., nom.); here part of the name as printed (see note)
وَقَسَّمَهَا: وَ + قَسَّمَ + هَا — wa-, and + qassama, he divided (form II perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -hā, them; 'and divided them'
خَوَاتِمَ: khawātim — seals, signet-rings (m. broken pl. of khātam, acc., diptote); 'seals'
قِسْمٍ: qism — part, division (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'part'
حَاتِمٌ: ḥātim — printed for khātim, a seal; as printed the word is the name Ḥātim (m., nom. with tanwīn); 'a seal'
خَاتِمُ: khātim — seal, signet (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the seal of'
وَالشُّرْطَةِ: وَ + الـ + شُرْطَة — wa-, and + shurṭa, the police, the guard (f., gen.); 'and the police'
وَالْمُحَامَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُحَامَة — wa-, and + muḥāma, as printed, presumably muḥāmāh, defence, protection (f., gen.); 'and the defence'
النِّيَابَاتِ: الـ + نِيَابَات — niyābāt, deputyships, offices of deputy (f. sound pl., acc. as object); 'the deputyships'
الْخَرَاجِ: الـ + خَرَاج — kharāj, land-tax, revenue (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the land-tax'
وَجِبَايَةِ: وَ + جِبَايَة — wa-, and + jibāya, collecting (of taxes) (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the collection of'
الْعِمَارَةَ: الـ + عِمَارَة — ʿimāra, cultivation, building-up, prosperity (f., acc. as object); 'the cultivation'
خَانِمُ: khānim — printed for khātim, seal; as printed, a non-word (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'seal of'
الْقُوتِ: الـ + قُوت — qūt, food, sustenance (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'the sustenance'
الرَّخَاءَ: الـ + رَخَاء — rakhāʾ, ease, plenty (m., acc. as object); 'the plenty'
الْمَظَالِمِ: الـ + مَظَالِم — maẓālim, wrongs, grievances (m. broken pl. of maẓlima, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the grievances'
فَبَقِيَتْ: فَـ + بَقِيَتْ — fa-, so, and so (consecutive) + baqiyat, she remained (form I perfect of baqiya, 3rd f. sg.); 'so remained'
وَاسْتَمَرَّتْ: وَ + اسْتَمَرَّتْ — wa-, and + istamarrat, she continued, went on (form X perfect of marra, 3rd f. sg.); 'and continued'
الرُّسُومُ: الـ + رُسُوم — rusūm, rules, established practices (m. broken pl. of rasm, nom.); 'the customs'
الْإِسْلَامُ: الـ + إِسْلَام — islām, Islam, submission (m., nom.); 'Islam'
جَيْشِهِ: jaysh + هِ — jaysh, army (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his army'
لَاتُوَسِّعَنَّ: لَا + تُوَسِّعَنَّ — lā, not (prohibition) + tuwassiʿanna, do widen (form II jussive of wasiʿa, 2nd m. sg., with emphatic nūn); 'do not be lavish'
جَيْشِكَ: jaysh + كَ — jaysh, army (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your; 'your army'
فَيَسْتَغْنُوا: فَـ + يَسْتَغْنُوا — fa-, lest, so that (fa- of consequence, with the subjunctive) + yastaghnū, they become independent (form X of ghaniya, 3rd m. pl., subj.); 'lest they become independent'
وَالسِّتُّونَ: وَ + الـ + سِتُّون — wa-, and + sittūn, sixty (m. sound pl., nom.); 'and the sixty'
بْنِهِ: (ا)بْن + هِ — ibn, son (m.; its alif stands on the preceding لِا, so لِا بْنِهِ = li-ibnihi, gen. after li-) + -hi, his; 'his son'
تُوَسِّعَنَّ: تُ + وَسِّعَ + نَّ — ta-, 2nd person prefix + wassaʿa, to widen, be generous (form II) + -anna, emphatic nūn; after lā, 'do not at all be lavish'
تُضَيِّقْ: تُضَيِّقْ — tuḍayyiq, 2nd m. sg. jussive of ḍayyaqa, to narrow, press hard (form II); after lā, 'do not be strict'
فَيَضْجَرُوا: فَـ + يَضْجَرُوا — fa-, so that (result, with subjunctive) + yaḍjarū, 3rd m. pl. subjunctive of ḍajira, to grow weary, fret; 'so that they grow weary'
وَأَعْطِهِمْ: وَ + أَعْطِ + هِمْ — wa-, and + aʿṭi, imperative of aʿṭā 'to give' (form IV) + -him, them; 'and give them'
عَطَاءً: عَطَاء — ʿaṭāʾ, gift (m., acc. indef.); 'a gift'
وَامْنَحْهُمْ: وَ + امْنَحْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + imnaḥ, imperative of manaḥa 'to grant, bestow' + -hum, them; 'and bestow upon them'
مَنًّا: مَنّ — mann, favour, benefaction (m., acc. indef.); 'a favour'
وَوَسِّعْ: وَ + وَسِّعْ — wa-, and + wassiʿ, imperative of wassaʿa 'to widen, be generous'; 'and be generous'
الرَّخَاءِ: الـ + رَخَاء — rakhāʾ, ease, prosperity (m., gen. after fī); 'the ease'
الشِّدَّةِ: الـ + شِدَّة — shidda, hardship, distress (f., gen. after fī); 'the hardship'
أَعْرَابِيًّا: أَعْرَابِيّ — aʿrābī, Bedouin, desert Arab (m., acc. indef., subject of anna); 'a Bedouin'
كَلْبَكَ: كَلْب + كَ — kalb, dog (m., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your dog'
يَتْبَعْكَ: يَتْبَعْ + كَ — yatbaʿ, 3rd m. sg. jussive of tabiʿa 'to follow' (jussive as the result of the imperative) + -ka, you (object); 'that he follow you'
الْمَنْصُورُ: الـ + مَنْصُور — al-Manṣūr, the caliph (nom., subject); 'al-Manṣūr'
الْأَعْرَابِيِّ: الـ + أَعْرَابِيّ — aʿrābī, Bedouin (m., gen. after min); 'the Bedouin'
الطُّوسِيُّ: الـ + طُوسِيّ — Ṭūsī, of Ṭūs (nisba; m., nom., in apposition); 'the man of Ṭūs'
أَخْشَى: أَخْشَى — akhshā, 1st sg. imperfect of khashiya 'to fear'; 'I fear'
يُلَوِّحَ: يُلَوِّحَ — yulawwiḥa, 3rd m. sg. subjunctive of lawwaḥa 'to wave, signal' (form II); 'that he wave'
بِرَغِيفٍ: بِـ + رَغِيف — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; lawwaḥa bi- 'wave something') + raghīf, loaf of bread (m., gen. indef.); 'with a loaf'
فَيَتْبَعَهُ: فَـ + يَتْبَعَ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (conj., continuing the subjunctive) + yatbaʿa, he follows (subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'and so he follows him'
وَيَتْرُكَكَ: وَ + يَتْرُكَ + كَ — wa-, and + yatruka, he leaves (subjunctive) + -ka, you; 'and leaves you'
فَسَكَنَ: فَـ + سَكَنَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + sakana, to grow still, subside (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and it subsided'
غَيْظُ: غَيْظ — ghayẓ, rage (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the rage of'
كَلِمَةٌ: كَلِمَة — kalima, word, saying (f., nom. indef.); 'a word'
تُخْطِئُ: تُخْطِئُ — tukhṭiʾu, 3rd f. sg. imperfect of akhṭaʾa 'to miss, err' (form IV); 'it misses'
لِلْأَعْرَابِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + أَعْرَابِيّ — li-, for (prep.; amara li- 'order for someone', marks the receiver) + aʿrābī, Bedouin (gen.); 'for the Bedouin'
بِعَطِيَّةٍ: بِـ + عَطِيَّة — bi-, with (prep.; amara … bi- 'order something', marks the thing ordered) + ʿaṭiyya, gift (f., gen. indef.); 'a gift'
وَجَّهَهُ: وَجَّهَ + هُ — wajjaha, to direct, send (form II, 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hu, him; 'he sent him'
تَفَقَّدْ: تَفَقَّدْ — tafaqqad, imperative of tafaqqada 'to inspect, look into' (form V); 'inspect'
كُتَّابَكَ: كُتَّاب + كَ — kuttāb, scribes, secretaries (m. pl., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your scribes'
وَحُجَّا: وَ + حُجَّا(ب) — wa-, and + ḥujjāb, chamberlains, doorkeepers (m. pl., acc.; its final bā' is printed apart, on the next word); 'and your chamberlains' (with بَكَ)
بَكَ: (بَ) + كَ — the final bā' of حُجَّاب, printed detached (with its fatḥa of the accusative) + -ka, your; completes وَحُجَّا
الثَّابِتَ: الـ + ثَابِت — thābit, firm, established (active part. of thabata; acc. after inna); 'the established one'
يُخْبِرُكَ: يُخْبِرُ + كَ — yukhbiru, he informs (form IV imperfect) + -ka, you (object); 'informs you'
كُتَّابُكَ: كُتَّاب + كَ — kuttāb, scribes (m. pl., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'your scribes'
وَالتَّرْسِيمُ: وَ + الـ + تَرْسِيم — wa-, and + tarsīm, registering, enrolment (verbal noun of rassama; nom.; sense uncertain); 'and the enrolment'
تُعَرِّفُكَ: تُعَرِّفُ + كَ — tuʿarrifu, it/she makes known (form II imperfect, 3rd f. sg., agreeing with the plural حُجَّابُكَ) + -ka, you; 'makes you know'
حُجَّابُكَ: حُجَّاب + كَ — ḥujjāb, chamberlains (m. pl., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'your chamberlains'
وَالْخَارِجُ: وَ + الـ + خَارِج — wa-, and + khārij, the one going out (active part. of kharaja; nom.); 'and the one who leaves'
يُعَرِّفُكَ: يُعَرِّفُ + كَ — yuʿarrifu, he makes known (form II) + -ka, you; 'he makes you acquainted'
بِجَيْشِكَ: بِـ + جَيْش + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; ʿarrafa bi- 'acquaint with') + jaysh, army + -ka, your; 'with your army'
الْخَطَّابِ: الـ + خَطَّاب — al-Khaṭṭāb, personal name (gen. after ibn)
اسْتَخْدَمَ: اسْتَخْدَمَ — istakhdama, to take into service, employ (form X, 3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he took into service'
شَرَطَ: شَرَطَ — sharaṭa, to stipulate, make a condition (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'he stipulated'
شُرُوطٍ: شُرُوط — shurūṭ, conditions (pl. of sharṭ; gen. indef.); 'conditions'
الْبَرَاذِينَ: الـ + بَرَاذِين — barādhīn, heavy non-Arab horses, pack-horses (pl. of birdhawn; acc., object); 'the heavy horses'
يَلْبَسَ: يَلْبَسَ — yalbasa, 3rd m. sg. subjunctive of labisa 'to wear'; 'wear'
الثَّوْبَ: الـ + ثَوْب — thawb, garment (m., acc., object); 'the garment'
الرَّقِيقَ: الـ + رَقِيق — raqīq, thin, fine (adj., m., acc.); 'the thin'
يَأْكُلَ: يَأْكُلَ — yaʾkula, 3rd m. sg. subjunctive of akala 'to eat'; 'eat'
الْفَيْءِ: الـ + فَيْء — fayʾ, spoil, public revenue (m., gen. after min); 'the public revenue'
يُؤَخِّرَ: يُؤَخِّرَ — yuʾakhkhira, 3rd m. sg. subjunctive of akhkhara 'to delay, put off' (form II); 'delay'
الصَّلٰوةَ: الـ + صَلٰوة — ṣalāh, prayer (f., acc., object; printed with the defective spelling, dagger alif); 'the prayer'
أَجْوَدُ: أَجْوَد — ajwad, better, more excellent (elative of jayyid; m., nom., predicate); 'better'
كَالتَّدْبِيرِ: كَـ + الـ + تَدْبِير — ka-, like, the equal of (prep.) + tadbīr, planning, foresight (m., gen. after ka-); 'like foresight'
وَالْحَزْمِ: وَ + الـ + حَزْم — wa-, and + ḥazm, resolve, firmness (m., gen., joined to التَّدْبِير); 'and resolve'
حَزْمَ: حَزْم — ḥazm, resolve, firmness (m., acc. without tanwīn after lā); 'resolve'
كَالتَّقْوَى: كَـ + الـ + تَقْوَى — ka-, like (prep.) + taqwā, piety, fear of God (f., gen.); 'like piety'
قُرْبَةَ: قُرْبَة — qurba, nearness, an act that draws one near to God (f., acc. without tanwīn after lā); 'nearness'
كَحُسْنِ: كَـ + حُسْن — ka-, like (prep.) + ḥusn, goodness, beauty (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the goodness of'
مِيزَانَ: مِيزَان — mīzān, scale, balance (m., acc. without tanwīn after lā); 'scale'
كَالْأَدَبِ: كَـ + الـ + أَدَب — ka-, like (prep.) + adab, good breeding, culture (m., gen.); 'like good breeding'
فَائِدَةَ: فَائِدَة — fāʾida, benefit, gain (f., acc. without tanwīn after lā); 'benefit'
كَالتَّوْفِيقِ: كَـ + الـ + تَوْفِيق — ka-, like (prep.) + tawfīq, success granted by God (m., gen.); 'like God-given success'
تِجَارَةَ: تِجَارَة — tijāra, trade, commerce (f., acc. without tanwīn after the lā of absolute negation)
كَالْعَمَلِ: كَـ + الـ + عَمَل — ka-, like (prep., 'like, as good as') + al- + ʿamal, work, deed (m., gen. after ka-); 'like the work'
الصَّالِحِ: الـ + صَالِح — ṣāliḥ, righteous, good (act. part. of ṣaluḥa; adj., gen.); 'the righteous'
كَثَوَابِ: كَـ + ثَوَاب — ka-, like (prep.) + thawāb, reward (m., gen. after ka-; first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the reward of'
وَرَعَ: وَرَع — wara', scrupulous piety, abstention from what is doubtful (m.; acc. after lā)
كَالْوُقُوفِ: كَـ + الـ + وُقُوف — ka-, like (prep.) + al- + wuqūf, standing, halting (verbal noun of waqafa, m., gen.); 'like halting'
حُدُودِ: حُدُود — ḥudūd, limits, bounds (pl. of ḥadd; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
السُّنَّةِ: الـ + سُنَّة — sunna, custom, the Prophetic practice (f., gen.); 'the Sunna'
كَالتَّفَكُّرِ: كَـ + الـ + تَفَكُّر — ka-, like (prep.) + al- + tafakkur, reflection (verbal noun of V tafakkara, gen.); 'like reflection'
عِبَادَةَ: عِبَادَة — ʿibāda, worship (f.; acc. without tanwīn after lā)
كَأَدَاءِ: كَـ + أَدَاء — ka-, like (prep.) + adāʾ, discharge, performance (verbal noun of II addā, m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the discharge of'
الْفَرَائِضِ: الـ + فَرَائِض — farīḍa, religious obligation (f.; pl. farāʾiḍ, gen.); 'the obligations'
إِيمَانَ: إِيمَان — īmān, faith (m.; acc. without tanwīn after lā)
كَالْحَيَاءِ: كَـ + الـ + حَيَاء — ka-, like (prep.) + al- + ḥayāʾ, modesty, shame (m., gen.); 'like modesty'
حَسَبَ: حَسَب — ḥasab, merit of lineage, inherited worth (m.; acc. without tanwīn after lā)
كَالتَّوَاضُعِ: كَـ + الـ + تَوَاضُع — ka-, like (prep.) + al- + tawāḍuʿ, humility (verbal noun of VI tawāḍaʿa, gen.); 'like humility'
شَرَفَ: شَرَف — sharaf, nobility, honour (m.; acc. without tanwīn after lā)
كَالْعِلْمِ: كَـ + الـ + عِلْم — ka-, like (prep.) + al- + ʿilm, knowledge (m., gen.); 'like knowledge'
فَاحْفَظِ: فَـ + اِحْفَظِ — fa-, so (conj. introducing the command) + iḥfaẓ, guard (imp. ms. of ḥafiẓa, with a kasra to meet the next word's al-); 'so guard'
الرَّأْسَ: الـ + رَأْس — raʾs, head (m., acc. object); 'the head'
وَالْبَطْنَ: وَ + الـ + بَطْن — wa-, and + al- + baṭn, belly (m., acc. object); 'and the belly'
وَعَى: وَعَى — waʿā, to hold, retain (perf. 3ms, rel. clause); 'it contains'
وَاذْكُرِ: وَ + اُذْكُرِ — wa-, and + udhkur, remember (imp. ms. of dhakara, with a kasra before al-); 'and remember'
وَالْبَلَاءَ: وَ + الـ + بَلَاء — wa-, and + al- + balāʾ, affliction, trial (m., acc. object); 'and tribulation'
كَرَّمَ: كَرَّمَ — karrama, to honour, make noble (II perf. 3ms; the wish 'God honour his face')
اِتَّقُوا: اِتَّقُوا — ittaqū, beware of, guard yourselves against (VIII imp. 2mpl of waqā; takes a direct object)
أَشْرَارَ: أَشْرَار — ashrār, evil ones, the wicked (pl. of sharr/sharīr; acc. object, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَكُونُوا: وَ + كُونُوا — wa-, and + kūnū, be (imp. 2mpl of kāna); 'and be'
حَذَرٍ: حَذَر — ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., gen. after ʿalā)
تُشَاوِرُوهُنَّ: تُشَاوِرُو + هُنَّ — tushāwirū, you (pl.) consult (III imperf. 2mpl, shāwara 'take counsel with', jussive after the prohibitive lā; the final alif is silent) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'do not consult them'
تُضَيِّقُوا: تُضَيِّقُوا — tuḍayyiqū, you (pl.) constrict, press hard (II imperf. 2mpl, jussive after the prohibitive lā)
مَعْرُوفٍ: مَعْرُوف — maʿrūf, what is known, customary and proper (pass. part. of ʿarafa; m., gen. after fī)
يَطْمَعْنَ: يَطْمَعْنَ — yaṭmaʿna, they (f.) covet, grow bold or greedy (imperf. 3fpl; subjunctive after ḥattā)
الْمَكْرِ: الـ + مَكْر — makr, cunning, scheming (m., gen. after fī); 'the scheming'

أَلُمُّهَا: أَلُمُّهَا — alummu-hā, I gather, draw (her) close (imperfect of lamma, 1st sg.) + -hā, her; the print is unpointed and obscure, perhaps for alminuhā 'I touch her'
تَسْتَطِيبَ: تَسْتَطِيبَ — tastaṭība, she finds it pleasant, is at ease (form X subjunctive of ṭāba, 3rd f. sg., after ḥattā); 'she is at ease'
وَأَلْثِمُهَا: وَ + أَلْثِمُ + هَا — wa-, and + althimu, I kiss (imperfect of lathama, 1st sg.) + -hā, her; 'and I kiss her'
تَطْرَبَ: تَطْرَبَ — taṭraba, she is stirred, delighted (subjunctive of ṭariba, 3rd f. sg., after ḥattā); 'she is moved to delight'
طَرَحْتُهَا: طَرَحْتُ + هَا — ṭaraḥtu, I threw, laid (perfect of ṭaraḥa, 1st sg.) + -hā, her; 'I lay her'
اسْتَقَرَّتِ: اسْتَقَرَّتِ — istaqarrat, it settled, took its place (form X perfect of qarra, 3rd f. sg.; final kasra before the article); 'it settled'
النُّطْفَةُ: الـ + نُطْفَة — nuṭfa, a drop; the seed of conception (f., nom., subject); 'the seed'
قَرَارِهَا: قَرَار + هَا — qarār, resting place, settling place (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, its; 'its resting place'
تَجْعَلْهَا: تَجْعَلْ + هَا — tajʿal, you make (jussive after lā, 2nd m. sg., of jaʿala) + -hā, her/it; 'do not make it'
شَقِيَّةً: شَقِيَّة — shaqiyya, wretched, unfortunate (f. adj., acc. tanwīn, second object of tajʿalhā); 'wretched'
وَصَوِّرْهَا: وَ + صَوِّرْ + هَا — wa-, and + ṣawwir, form, shape (form II imperative of ṣawwara, m. sg., shadda as printed) + -hā, it; 'and shape it'
تَصْوِيرٍ: تَصْوِير — taṣwīr, shaping, forming (verbal noun of form II, gen. tanwīn, iḍāfa after aḥsana); 'shaping'
فَأُفِيضُ: فَ + أُفِيضُ — fa-, and so + ufīḍu, I pour out (form IV imperfect of fāḍa, 1st sg.); 'and I pour'
أَصُبُّهُ: أَصُبُّ + هُ — aṣubbu, I pour (imperfect of ṣabba, 1st sg.) + -hu, it; 'I pour it'
أَحْمَدُ: أَحْمَدُ — aḥmadu, I praise (imperfect of ḥamida, 1st sg.); 'I praise'
تَنْقِىَ: تَنْقِىَ — tanqiya, you ... (printed with ن for ت: evidently تَتَّقِىَ tattaqiya, form VIII subjunctive of waqā, 'you fear, guard against', after an); 'you fear'
وَتَعْدِلَ: وَ + تَعْدِلَ — wa-, and + taʿdila, you act justly (subjunctive of ʿadala, 2nd m. sg., after an); 'and deal justly'
بِالسَّوِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + سَوِيَّة — bi-, with (prep.) + al-sawiyya, equality, evenness (f., gen.); 'with equal measure'
مُعَٰوِبَةَ: مُعَاوِيَة — Muʿāwiya, the caliph (gen. diptote after majlis; the print has ب for ي: معوبة)
لَوْلَمْ: لَوْلَمْ — law, if + lam, not (negative with jussive) (printed as one word); 'if ... not'
بِالْعِرَاقِ: بِـ + الـ + عِرَاق — bi-, in (prep.) + al-ʿIrāq, Iraq (gen.); 'in Iraq'
لَكَفَاءَ: لَكَفَاءَ — la-, would (apodosis particle) + kafā, it sufficed (perfect of kafā; the print's final ء is evidently a slip for the pronoun -hu: لَكَفَاهُ); 'it would suffice'
النُّبْذَةُ: الـ + نُبْذَة — nubdha, a short piece, extract, passage (f., nom.); 'the extract'
مُعَيْقِبٌ: مُعَيْقِب — Muʿayqib, a man's name (nom., subject of kāna; Muʿayqib, ʿUmar's keeper of the treasury)
عَامِلًا: عَامِل — ʿāmil, worker, officer, one in charge (active participle of ʿamila, acc. tanwīn, predicate of kāna); 'an officer'
زَٰدَ: زَٰد — zād, the second element of the name Shahrazād, printed without its alif (زد) and pointed with the dagger alif; the pair is declined as one name (acc.)
انْصَرَفْتُ: انْصَرَفَ — inṣarafa, to turn away, go away (VII; 1st sg. perfect, -tu 'I'); 'I went away'
فَرَهِبْتُ: فَ + رَهِبَ — fa-, 'and, so' + rahiba, to fear (1st sg. perfect, -tu 'I'); 'and I was afraid'
وَيْحَكَ: وَيْحَ + كَ — waylaka, 'woe to you', a mild exclamation of reproach, with the object suffix -ka 'you' (m. sg.)
مُعَيْقِبُ: مُعَيْقِب — Muʿayqib, a man's name (nom.; vocative after yā: 'O Muʿayqib')
تُخَاصِمُ: تُخَاصِمُ — tukhāṣimu, to dispute, contend with (III; 2nd m. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'you will contend'
أُمَّةَ: أُمَّة — umma, nation, community (f.; acc. after khāṣama, here the community of Muḥammad's followers); 'the nation of'
الْأَشْعَرِيِّ: الـ + أَشْعَرِيّ — al-, 'the' + Ashʿarī, the tribal name (nisba) of Abū Mūsā, from the Ashʿar tribe of Yemen (gen.)
مَضْمُونُهُ: مَضْمُون + هُ — maḍmūn, contents, purport, tenor (nom. in apposition to kitāban) + -hu 'its'; 'its contents'
جَاءَكَ: جَاءَ + كَ — jāʾa, to come (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + -ka 'you'; 'comes to you'
فَأَعْطِ: فَ + أَعْطِ — fa-, 'then' + aʿṭi, to give (IV; imperative, m. sg.); 'then give'
وَاحْمِلْ: وَ + احْمِلْ — wa-, 'and' + iḥmil, to carry (imperative, m. sg.); 'and carry'
فَفَعَلَ: فَ + فَعَلَ — fa-, 'and' + faʿala, to do (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and he did so'
عُثْمَانُ: عُثْمَان — ʿUthmān, a man's name (nom.); the third caliph, ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān
زِيَادٌ: زِيَاد — Ziyād, a man's name (nom., tanwīn)
الْخَرَاجَ: الـ + خَرَاج — al-, 'the' + kharāj, tribute, land-tax, revenue (acc., object of waḍaʿa); 'the revenue'
عُثْمَانَ: عُثْمَان — ʿUthmān, a man's name (gen., second term of the construct bayna yadayi ʿUthmāna; diptote, so the genitive takes -a)
بِنَزْعِهِ: بِـ + نَزْع + هِ — bi-, 'to, for' (governed by amara 'to order … that') + nazʿ, pulling out, removal (gen.) + -hi 'its'; 'for its removal'
يَنْزِعُهُ: يَنْزِعُ + هُ — yanziʿu, to pull out, remove (3rd m. sg. imperfect, indicative) + -hu 'it'; 'who removes it'
تَلْقَى: تَلْقَى — talqā, to find, meet (3rd f. / 2nd m. sg. imperfect, here 2nd m.); 'you find'
وَرَوَى: وَ + رَوَى — wa-, 'and' + rawā, to relate (a tradition) (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and he related'
زَيْدُ: زَيْد — Zayd, a man's name (nom., first term of Zayd ibn Aslam)
أَسْلَمَ: أَسْلَم — Aslam, a man's name (gen. after ibn; diptote)
تُضْرَمُ: تُضْرَمُ — tuḍramu, to kindle, set alight (passive, 3rd f. sg. imperfect); 'is being kindled'
أَسْلَمُ: أَسْلَم — Aslam, a man's name (nom., vocative after yā: 'O Aslam')
رَكْبًا: رَكْب — rakb, riders, a party of travellers (acc. tanwīn, predicate of hāʾulāʾi in the clause after aḥsibu); 'a party of riders' Also object of ānasat: ānasat rakban, 'she glimpsed a party of riders'.
أَضَّرَبِهِمُ: أَضَرَّ + بِـ + هِمُ — aḍarra, to harm (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect; the print gives the ḍ a shadda) + bi-, 'with' (governed by aḍarra: aḍarra bi- 'to harm') + -him 'them'; 'has harmed them'
الْبَرْدُ: الـ + بَرْد — al-, 'the' + bard, cold (nom., subject of aḍarra); 'the cold'
فَانْطَلِقْ: فَ + انْطَلِقْ — fa-, 'so' + inṭaliq, to set off (VII, imperative, m. sg.); 'so set off'
تُوقِدُ: تُوقِدُ — tūqidu, to kindle, light (IV; 3rd f. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'kindling'
قِدْرٍ: قِدْر — qidr, cooking-pot (f.; gen. tanwīn, after taḥta 'under'); 'a pot'
صِبْيَانٌ: صِبْيَان — ṣibyān, boys (plural of ṣabī; nom. tanwīn, subject of maʿahā)
يَتَضَرَّعُونَ: يَتَضَرَّعُونَ — yatadarraʿūna, to cry out humbly, implore (V; 3rd m. pl. imperfect, indicative); 'crying and pleading'
الضَّوْءِ: الـ + ضَّوْء — al-, 'the' + ḍawʾ, light (gen., second term of aṣḥāba al-ḍawʾi); 'the light'
وَكَرِهَ: وَ + كَرِهَ — wa-, 'and' + kariha, to dislike (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and he disliked'
أَضَّرَبِنَا: أَضَرَّ + بِـ + نَا — aḍarra, to harm (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect; the print gives the ḍ a shadda) + bi-, 'with' (governed by aḍarra) + -nā 'us'; 'has harmed us'
وَاللَّيْلُ: وَ + الـ + لَّيْل — wa-, 'and' + al-, 'the' + layl, night (nom., second subject of aḍarra, which stays singular); 'and the night'
بَالُ: بَال — bāl, state, condition, concern (m.; nom., in mā bālu 'what is the state of …?'); 'the state of'
الْقِدْرُ: الـ + قِدْر — al-, 'the' + qidr, cooking-pot (f.; nom., predicate in the question mā hādhihi al-qidru); 'the pot'
أُسْكِتُهُمْ: أُسْكِتُ + هُمْ — uskitu, to quiet, silence (IV; 1st sg. imperfect, indicative) + -hum 'them'; 'I quiet them'
لَبَسْأَ: لَبَسْأَ — the print's لَبَسْأَ لَهُ, apparently a slip for لَيَسْأَلُهُ, 'he will surely ask him' (la- 'surely' + yasʾalu 'asks'), with ب for ي and a stray space; pointed as printed
بِحَالِهِمْ: بِـ + حَال + هِمْ — bi-, 'of, about' (governed by yadrī: darā bi- 'to know of') + ḥāl, state, condition (gen.) + -him 'their'; 'of their condition'
يَتَوَلَّى: يَتَوَلَّى — yatawallā, to take charge of, take upon oneself (V; 3rd m. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'he takes charge of'
وَيَغْفُلُ: وَ + يَغْفُلُ — wa-, 'and' + yaghfulu, to be heedless, neglect (3rd m. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'and is heedless'
انْطَلِقْ: انْطَلِقْ — inṭaliq, to set off (VII; imperative, m. sg.); 'set off'
نُهَرْوِلُ: نُهَرْوِلُ — nuharwilu, to hurry, go at a half-run (quadriliteral, 1st pl. imperfect, indicative; a circumstantial 'hurrying'); 'we hurry'
عَدْلًا: عَدْل — ʿadl, a half-load, a sack or bale (acc. tanwīn, object of akhraja); 'a sack'
دَقِيقٌ: دَقِيق — daqīq, flour (nom. tanwīn, subject of fīhi); 'flour'
وَإِنَاءً: وَ + إِنَاء — wa-, 'and' + ināʾ, vessel, container (acc. tanwīn, object of akhraja, as pointed); 'and a vessel'
شَحْمٌ: شَحْم — shaḥm, fat (nom. tanwīn, subject of fīhi); 'fat'
حَمِّلْنِي: حَمِّلْ + نِي — ḥammil, to load, make carry (II; imperative, m. sg.) + -nī 'me'; 'load me'
أَتَحْمِلُ: أَ + تَحْمِلُ — a-, question particle + taḥmilu, to carry (2nd m. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'will you carry?'
وِزْرِي: وِزْر + ي — wizr, burden, load, sin (acc., object of taḥmilu) + -ī 'my'; 'my burden'
فَحَمَّلْتُهُ: فَ + حَمَّلْتُ + هُ — fa-, 'so' + ḥammaltu, to load (II; 1st sg. perfect, with the printed shadda) + -hu 'him'; 'so I loaded him'
أَلْقَيْنَا: أَلْقَيْنَا — alqaynā, to throw down, set down (IV; 1st pl. perfect); 'we set down'
الدَّقِيقِ: الـ + دَّقِيق — al-, 'the' + daqīq, flour (gen., after min 'of, some of'); 'the flour'
لِلْمَرْأَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مَرْأَة — li-, 'to' + al-, 'the' + marʾa, woman (f.; gen. after li-); 'to the woman'
تَرَدَّدِي: تَرَدَّدِي — taraddadī, to go back and forth, keep coming (V; imperative, f. sg.); 'keep coming'
يَنْفُخُ: يَنْفُخُ — yanfukhu, to blow (3rd m. sg. imperfect, indicative); 'blowing'
الْقِدْرِ: الـ + قِدْر — al-, 'the' + qidr, cooking-pot (f.; gen. after taḥta 'under'); 'the pot'
لِحْيَةٍ: لِحْيَة — liḥya, beard (f.; gen. tanwīn, in the construct dhū liḥyatin 'possessor of a beard'); 'a beard'
الدُّخَانَ: الـ + دُّخَان — al-, 'the' + dukhān, smoke (acc., object of raʾaytu); 'the smoke'
خِلَالِ: خِلَال — khilāl, the space between, the gaps, 'through' (gen. after min; construct with liḥyatihi); 'from between'
مِقْدَارًا: مِقْدَار — miqdār, measure, quantity (acc. tanwīn, object of akhadha); 'an amount'; here: 'in rank, in standing', accusative of specification after aʿlā, 'higher'
الشَّحْمِ: الـ + شَّحْم — al-, 'the' + shaḥm, fat (gen., after min 'of'); 'the fat'
فَرَمَاهُ: فَ + رَمَى + هُ — fa-, 'and' + ramā, to throw (3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hu 'it'; 'and he threw it'
أَطْعِمِيهِمْ: أَطْعِمِي + هِمْ — aṭʿimī, to feed (IV; imperative, f. sg.) + -him 'them'; 'feed them'
أُبَرِّدُ: أُبَرِّدُ — ubarridu, to cool (II; 1st sg. imperfect, indicative); 'I will cool'
أَكَلُوا: أَكَلُوا — akalū, to eat (3rd m. pl. perfect); 'they ate'
وَتَرَكَ: وَ + تَرَكَ — wa-, 'and' + taraka, to leave (3rd m. sg. perfect); 'and he left'
الْجُوعَ: الـ + جُوع — al-, 'the' + jūʿ, hunger (acc., object of raʾaytu); 'the hunger'
أَبْكَاهُمْ: أَبْكَى + هُمْ — abkā, to make weep (IV, 3rd m. sg. perfect) + -hum 'them'; 'made them weep'
فَأَحْبَبْتُ: فَ + أَحْبَبْتُ — fa-, 'and so' + aḥbabtu, to like, to wish (IV; 1st sg. perfect); 'and I wished'
يَتَبَيَّنَ: يَتَبَيَّنَ — yatabayyana, to become clear (V; 3rd m. sg. imperfect, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'becomes clear'
اللَّيْةُ: الـ + لَيْلَة — layla, night (f., nom.); 'the night' — the print drops a lām (for الليلة)
بِرَاعٍ: بِـ + رَاعٍ — rāʿin, herder, shepherd (m., gen. indef.); bi-, 'by' (prep. after مَرَّ, 'pass by'): 'by a herder'
فَاسْتَبَاعَهُ: فَـ + اسْتَبَاعَ + هُ — istabāʿa, ask (someone) to sell (form X, perf.) + him; 'and he asked him to sell'
شَاةً: شَاة — shāt, sheep, a head of small livestock (f., acc. indef., second object of استباع); 'a sheep'
الْفَصْلُ: الـ + فَصْل — faṣl, decision, separation; the one who decides (m., nom., predicate); 'the decision'
فَاشْتَرَاهُ: فَـ + اشْتَرَى + هُ — ishtarā, buy (form VIII, perf.) + him; 'and he bought him'
أَعْتَقَهُ: أَعْتَقَ + هُ — aʿtaqa, set free, manumit (form IV, perf.) + him; 'he freed him'
رَزَقْتَنِي: رَزَقْتَ + نِي — razaqa, provide, grant (perf., 2nd m. sg.) + me; 'You provided me'
الْعِتْقَ: الـ + عِتْق — ʿitq, freeing, manumission (m., acc.); 'the freeing'
الْأَصْغَرَ: الـ + أَصْغَر — aṣghar, smaller, lesser (elative, m., acc.); 'the lesser'
فَارْزُقْنِى: فَـ + ارْزُقْ + نِي — razaqa, provide, grant (imperative, m. sg.) + me; fa-, 'so, then': 'so grant me' (the print ends it with dotless ى)
الْأَكْبَرَ: الـ + أَكْبَر — akbar, greater, greatest (elative, m., acc.); 'the greater'
يُطْعِمُ: يُطْعِمُ — yuṭʿimu, feed (form IV, imperf., 3rd m. sg.); 'he feeds'
الْحَلِيبَ: الـ + حَلِيب — ḥalīb, milk (m., acc.); 'the milk'
لِلْخَدَمِ: لِـ + الـ + خَدَم — khadam, servants, attendants (coll., gen.); li-, 'to, for' (the beneficiary): 'to the servants'
الْغَلِيظَ: الـ + غَلِيظ — ghalīẓ, coarse, thick, rough (m., acc.); 'the coarse'
وَيَكْسُوهُمُ: وَـ + يَكْسُو + هُمُ — kasā, clothe (imperf., 3rd m. sg.) + them (m. pl.); 'and he clothes them'
اللَّيِّنَ: الـ + لَيِّن — layyin, soft, supple (m., acc.); 'the soft' — the print writes a shadda on the second lām
وَيَلْبَسُ: وَـ + يَلْبَسُ — labisa, wear, put on (imperf., 3rd m. sg.); 'and he wears'
الْخَشِنَ: الـ + خَشِن — khashin, rough, coarse (m., acc.); 'the rough'
وَيُعْطِى: وَـ + يُعْطِي — aʿṭā, give (form IV, imperf., 3rd m. sg.); 'and he gives' (the print ends it with ى)
حُقُوقَهُمْ: حُقُوق + هُمْ — ḥuqūq, rights, dues (pl. of ḥaqq, acc.) + their; 'their dues'
عَطَائِهِمْ: عَطَاء + هِمْ — ʿaṭāʾ, gift, allowance, stipend (m., gen. after فِي) + their; 'their allowances'
وَزَادَهُ: وَـ + زَادَ + هُ — zāda, add to, increase (perf., 3rd m. sg.) + him; 'and he added to him'
أَلْفًا: أَلْف — alf, a thousand (m., acc. indef., specification); 'a thousand'
ابْنَكَ: ابْن + كَ — ibn, son (m., acc.) + your (m. sg.); 'your son'
زِدْتَ: زِدْتَ — zāda, add, increase (perf., 2nd m. sg.); 'you added'
ثَبَتَ: ثَبَتَ — thabata, stand firm, hold fast (perf., 3rd m. sg.); 'he stood firm'
أُحُدٍ: أُحُد — Uḥud, the hill near Medina and the battle of 625 fought there (gen. indef.); 'Uḥud'
الْحَسَنُ: الـ + حَسَن — al-Ḥasan, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, the early Basran preacher (nom.); 'al-Ḥasan'
أُتِيَ: أُتِيَ — utiya, be brought, be come to (perf. passive, 3rd m. sg., from أَتَى); 'there was brought'
فَانْتَهَ: فَـ + انْتَهَ — intahā, reach, come to (form VIII); the print drops the final tā' (for فانتهت): 'and she reached (him)'
حَفْصَةُ: حَفْصَة — Ḥafṣa, daughter of ʿUmar and wife of the Prophet (f., nom.); 'Ḥafṣa'
قَرَابَتِكَ: قَرَابَة + كَ — qarāba, kinship, relatives (f., gen. in iḍāfa) + your (m. sg.); 'your kin'
قَرَابَتِي: قَرَابَة + ي — qarāba, kinship, relatives (f., gen. in iḍāfa) + my; 'my kin'
مَالُ: مَال — māl, wealth, property, money (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wealth of'
أَرْضَيْتِ: أَرْضَيْتِ — arḍā, please, satisfy (form IV, perf., 2nd f. sg.); 'you have pleased' (said to a woman)
قَوْمَكِ: قَوْم + كِ — qawm, people, kinsfolk (m., acc.) + your (f. sg.); 'your people'
وَأَغْضَبْتِ: وَـ + أَغْضَبْتِ — aghḍaba, anger (form IV, perf., 2nd f. sg.); 'and you have angered'
تَجُرُّ: تَجُرُّ — jarra, drag, trail (imperf., 3rd f. sg.); 'dragging' (circumstantial clause)
ذَيْلَهَا: ذَيْل + هَا — dhayl, hem, train of a garment (m., acc.) + her; 'her hem'
تَضَرَّعْتُ: تَضَرَّعْتُ — taḍarraʿa, beseech, humble oneself in prayer (form V, perf., 1st sg.); 'I besought'
يُرِيَنِي: يُرِيَ + نِي — arā, show (form IV, subjunctive after أَنْ; two objects) + me; 'that He show me'
الْعَرَقَ: الـ + عَرَق — ʿaraq, sweat (m., acc.); 'the sweat'
الْفَصْلَ: الـ + فَصْل — faṣl, section, chapter (m., acc., object of اسمع); 'the section'
أَخْبَارِ: أَخْبَار — akhbār, reports, accounts (pl. of khabar, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the reports of'
التَّابِعِينَ: الـ + تَّابِعِين — tābiʿūn, followers, the generation after the Companions (pl., gen.); 'the Followers'
الدُّنْيَاً: الـ + دُّنْيَا — dunyā, this world, the world (f., gen. after مِنْ); 'the world' — the print adds a fatḥatān on the alif
يَتَأَسَّفُ: يَتَأَسَّفُ — taʾassafa, grieve, regret (form V, imperf., 3rd m. sg.); 'he grieves'
ثَلَٰثَةِ: ثَلَٰثَة — thalātha, three (f., gen. before a plural; defective spelling, with dagger alif for ثلاثة); 'three'
تَمَتُّعِهِ: تَمَتُّع + هِ — tamattuʿ, enjoyment (verbal noun of form V, m., gen. in iḍāfa) + his; 'his enjoying'
إِدْرَاكِهِ: إِدْرَاك + هِ — idrāk, attaining, reaching (verbal noun of form IV, m., gen. in iḍāfa) + his; 'his attaining'
أَمَّلَ: أَمَّلَ — ammala, hope for, expect (form II, perf., 3rd m. sg.); 'he hoped for'
اسْتِعْدَادِهِ: اسْتِعْدَاد + هِ — istiʿdād, preparing, readiness (verbal noun of form X, m., gen. in iḍāfa) + his; 'his preparing'
لِسُفْيَانَ: لِـ + سُفْيَانَ — Sufyān, a man's name (diptote, gen.); li-, 'to' (marks who is told after قِيلَ): 'to Sufyān'
أَيَكُونُ: أَ + يَكُونُ — kāna, be (imperf., 3rd m. sg.); a-, interrogative particle introducing a yes/no question: 'can he be?'
زَاهِدًا: زَاهِد — zāhid, ascetic, one who renounces the world (m., acc. indef., predicate of كان); 'an ascetic'
ابْتُلِيَ: ابْتُلِيَ — ubtuliya, be tried, be tested (form VIII, perf. passive, 3rd m. sg.); 'he is tried'
شَدَّادٍ: شَدَّاد — Shaddād, a man's name (m., gen. indef.); 'Shaddād'
فَأَوْصَاهُ: فَـ + أَوْصَى + هُ — awṣā, charge, give a command to (form IV, perf.) + him; 'and he charged him'
بُنَيَّ: بُنَيَّ — bunayy, my little son (diminutive of ibn + my; m., vocative, after يَا); 'my son'
لَأَرَى: لَـ + أَرَى — raʾā, see (imperf., 1st sg.); la-, emphatic particle after inna: 'I indeed see'
دَاعِيَ: دَاعِي — dāʿī, caller, summoner (active participle of daʿā, m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the summoner of'
دَعَالِي: دَعَا + لِي — daʿā, call (perf., 3rd m. sg.) + li-, 'for' + me; 'he has called for me'
بِتَقْوَى: بِـ + تَقْوَى — taqwā, fear of God, piety (f., gen.); bi-, 'to' (prep. governed by عَلَيْكَ in the idiom 'hold fast to'): 'to the fear of'
وَالْعَلَانِيَةِ: وَـ + الـ + عَلَانِيَة — ʿalāniya, openness, the open, publicly (f., gen.); wa-, 'and': 'and the open'
وَالشُّكْرِلِلَّهِ: وَـ + الـ + شُّكْر + لِـ + لَّه — shukr, thanks, gratitude (m., gen.) + li-, 'to, for' + Allāh, God (gen.); 'and thanks to God' (the print runs the three words together)
فَالشُّكْرُ: فَـ + الـ + شُّكْرُ — shukr, thanks, gratitude (m., nom.); fa-, 'for, since': 'for gratitude'
يُؤْذِنُ: يُؤْذِنُ — adhina, give notice, announce (form IV, imperf., 3rd m. sg.; construed with بِـ); 'it announces'
بِازْدِيَادِ: بِـ + ازْدِيَاد — izdiyād, increase (verbal noun of form VIII, m., gen.); bi-, 'of' (prep. governed by يؤذن, 'announce'): 'an increase'
وَالتَّقْوَى: وَـ + الـ + تَّقْوَى — taqwā, fear of God, piety (f., nom.); 'and piety'
زَادٍ: زَادٍ — zād, provision, provisions for a journey (m., gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of provision'
السَّعَادَةَ: الـ + سَّعَادَة — saʿāda, happiness, felicity (f., acc., object of أَرَى); 'the happiness'; also acc. as the noun of inna: inna al-saʿādata fī …, 'happiness lies in …' (Night 182)
جَمْعَ: جَمْع — jamʿ, gathering, amassing (verbal noun, m., acc., second object of أَرَى); 'a gathering of'
وَلٰكِنَّ: وَـ + لٰكِنَّ — lākinna, but (particle that takes an accusative subject); 'but'; here the print gives its noun in the nominative: wa-lākinna liḥāẓu, 'but glances'
التَّقِيَّ: الـ + تَّقِيَّ — taqiyy, God-fearing, pious (m., acc.; the verse's final yā' is lengthened); 'the God-fearing'
وَتَقْوَى: وَـ + تَقْوَى — taqwā, fear of God (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the fear of'
لِلْاَتْقَى: لِـ + الـ + أَتْقَى — atqā, most God-fearing (elative, m., gen.); li-, 'for' (the beneficiary): 'for the most God-fearing'
لِيَسْمَعِ: لِـ + يَسْمَعِ — samiʿa, hear (jussive, 3rd m. sg.); li-, 'let' (the lām of command): 'let him hear'
النُّكَتَ: الـ + نُّكَت — nukat, points, subtle anecdotes (pl. of nukta, acc.); 'the points'
الْفَصْلِ: الـ + فَصْل — faṣl, section, chapter (m., gen. after مِنْ); 'the section'
وَمَاهِيَ: وَ + مَا + هِيَ — wa-, 'and' + mā, 'what' + hiya, 'she, they (f.)'; 'and what are they?'
جَاءَلِأَ: جَاءَ + لِـ + أ — jāʾa, come, go (perf., 3rd m. sg.) + li-, 'to' + the first letter of أَهْل; the print runs it together and splits the next word: 'he came to'
هْلِ: أَهْل — ahl, people, family, household (m., gen. in iḍāfa); the print gives only هل, the alif having fused with the word before: 'the people of'
عَمَّتِهِ: عَمَّة + هِ — ʿamma, paternal aunt (f., gen. after إِلَى) + his; 'his aunt'
فَاطِمَةَ: فَاطِمَة — Fāṭima, a woman's name (f., gen. in apposition); 'Fāṭima'
لِقَائِكَ: لِقَاء + كَ — liqāʾ, meeting (verbal noun, m., gen. after مِنْ) + your (m. sg.); 'meeting you'
أَتَتْهُ: أَتَتْ + هُ — atā, come (perf., 3rd f. sg.) + him; 'she came to him'
دَابَّتِهَا: دَابَّة + هَا — dābba, riding animal, mount (f., gen.) + her; 'her mount'
مَجْلِسَهَا: مَجْلِس + هَا — majlis, seat, sitting place (m., acc.) + her; 'her seat'
عَمَّةُ: عَمَّة — ʿamma, paternal aunt (f., vocative, after يَا); 'aunt'
فَأَخْبِرِينِي: فَـ + أَخْبِرِي + نِي — akhbara, inform (form IV, imperative, 2nd f. sg.) + me; 'so inform me'
مُرَادِكِ: مُرَاد + كِ — murād, aim, what is wanted (m., gen. after عَنْ) + your (f. sg.); 'what you want'
وَرَأْيُكَ: وَـ + رَأْي + كَ — raʾy, opinion, judgment (m., nom.) + your (m. sg.); 'and your judgment'
يَسْتَشِفُّ: يَسْتَشِفُّ — istashaffa, see through, perceive beyond (form X, imperf., 3rd m. sg.); 'it sees through'
الْأَفْهَامِ: الـ + أَفْهَام — afhām, understandings, minds (pl. of fahm, gen.); 'the minds'
رَحْمَةً: رَحْمَةً — raḥma, mercy (f., acc. indef., circumstantial of purpose); 'as a mercy'
لِقَوْمٍ: لِـ + قَوْمٍ — qawm, a people (m., gen. indef.); li-, 'to, for' (the beneficiary): 'to a people'
وَعَذَابًا: وَـ + عَذَابًا — ʿadhāb, punishment, torment (m., acc. indef.); 'and as a punishment'
آخَرِينَ: آخَرِين — ākharīn, others (pl. m., gen. after عَلَى); 'others'
اخْتَارَ: اخْتَارَ — ikhtāra, choose (form VIII, perf., 3rd m. sg.); 'he chose'
فَقَبَضَهُ: فَـ + قَبَضَ + هُ — qabaḍa, seize, take (the soul), take in death (perf., 3rd m. sg.) + him; 'and He took him'
نُرْهَةَ: nuzha (printed نرهة, a misprint of نزهة) — Nuzhat, 'delight'; first term of the name Nuzhat al-Zamān (f., gen. in iḍāfa)
لِنَاسٍ: لِـ + نَاس — nās, people (gen.); li-, for (prep.): 'for people' (printed without the article)
الصِّدِّيقُ: الـ + صِدِّيق — ṣiddīq, the truthful, veracious (m., nom.); epithet of Abū Bakr
خَلِيفَةً: khalīfa — caliph, successor (m., acc. as state); 'as caliph'
يُرْضِى: yurḍī — pleases, satisfies (IV impf. of raḍiya/raḍā, ending written ى); 'what pleases'
اجْتِهَادًا: ijtihād — striving, exertion (VIII verbal noun, acc. as cognate object); 'a striving'
اشْتَقَّ: ishtaqqa — split off, cut a channel (VIII perf., 3 m. sg.); 'he split off'
مُعْوِبَةُ: Muʿwiba (printed معوبة, for Muʿāwiya) — the caliph Muʿāwiya (m., nom.)
فَاشْتَقَّ: فَـ + اشْتَقَّ — fa-, and so, then; ishtaqqa, split off (VIII perf.); 'and he split off'
الْأَنْهَارَ: الـ + أَنْهَار — anhār, rivers (pl. of nahr, acc.); 'the rivers'
يَشْتَقُّ: yashtaqqu — splits off, cuts channels (VIII impf., 3 m. sg.); 'he splits off'
يَزِيدُ: Yazīd — the Umayyad caliph Yazīd (m., nom.)
وَبَنُو: وَ + بَنُو — wa-, and; banū, sons of (m. pl. nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the sons of'
كَعَبْدِ: كَـ + عَبْد — ka-, like, such as (prep.); ʿAbd (first term of the name ʿAbd al-Malik, gen.); 'like ʿAbd'
وَالْوَلِيدِ: وَ + الـ + وَلِيد — wa-, and; al-Walīd, the caliph Walīd (gen. after ka-); 'and al-Walīd'
وَسُلَيْمَانَ: وَ + سُلَيْمَان — wa-, and; Sulaymān, the caliph Sulaymān (gen., diptote); 'and Sulaymān'
وَيَبِسَ: وَ + يَبِسَ — wa-, and; yabisa, dried up (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it dried up'
النَّهْرُ: الـ + نَهْر — nahr, river (m., nom.); 'the river'
الْأَعْظَمُ: الـ + أَعْظَم — aʿẓam, greatest, mightiest (elative, m., nom.); 'the greatest'
آلَ: āla — returned, reverted, passed to (perf. 3 m. sg. of ʾāla); 'it came back, reverted'
إِلَّيَّ: ilayya (printed with the shadda on the lām) — إِلَى + ـيَ: ilā, to; -ya, me; 'to me'
وَمُذَاكَرَتَكَ: وَ + مُذَاكَرَة + كَ — wa-, and; mudhākara, conversing, talk (III verbal noun, acc.); -ka, you; 'and conversing with you'
مَقَالَتَكَ: مَقَالَة + كَ — maqāla, saying, statement (f., acc. as predicate of kāna); -ka, your; 'your saying'
بِذَاكِرَةٍ: بِـ + ذَاكِرَة — bi-, (prep., strengthens the negated predicate after laysa); dhākira, mentioning, one who mentions (f., gen.); 'a mentioner'
ذُوقُوا: dhūqū — taste! (imper. m. pl. of dhāqa)
أَمْرِكُمْ: أَمْر + كُمْ — amr, affair, matter (m., gen. in iḍāfa); -kum, your (pl.); 'your affair'
بِتَزْوِيجِكُمْ: بِـ + تَزْوِيج + كُمْ — bi-, by, through (prep.); tazwīj, giving in marriage (II verbal noun, gen.); -kum, your (pl.); 'by your giving in marriage'
مَسْلَمَةُ: Maslama — Maslama, a son of ʿAbd al-Malik (m., nom.)
فُقَرَاءَ: fuqarāʾ — poor (pl. of faqīr, acc., diptote); 'poor'
رَاعِيهِمْ: رَاعِي + هِمْ — rāʿī, shepherd, guardian (m., nom. predicate); -him, their; 'their shepherd'
يَمْنَعُكَ: yamnaʿu + ka — prevents, hinders (impf. 3 m. sg.); -ka, you; 'prevents you'
حَيٰوتِكَ: حَيٰوَة + كَ — ḥayāt (printed حيوة, with the dagger alif), life; -ka, your (gen. after fī); 'your life'
تُعْطِيَهُمْ: tuʿṭiya + hum — you give (IV impf. subj. 2 m. sg.); -hum, them; 'that you give them'
يُغْنِيهِمْ: yughnī + him — enriches, makes self-sufficient (IV impf. 3 m. sg.); -him, them; 'enriches them'
تَرْجِعَهُ: tarjiʿa + hu — you return (impf. subj. 2 m. sg.); -hu, it; 'that you return it'
بِعَدْلٍ: بِـ + عَدْل — bi-, with (prep.); ʿadl, justice (gen. indef.); 'with justice'
مُغْضَبٍ: mughḍab — one angered, enraged (IV passive participle, m., gen.); 'of one enraged'
مُتَعَجِّبٍ: mutaʿajjib — amazed, astonished (V active participle, m., gen.); 'astonished'
مَنَعْتُهُمْ: manaʿtu + hum — I withheld, prevented (perf. 1 sg.); -hum, them; 'I withheld from them'
حَيٰوتِي: حَيٰوَة + ي — ḥayāt (printed حيوة, dagger alif), life; -ī, my; 'my life'
أَشْقَى: ashqā — I will be wretched, miserable (impf. 1 sg. of shaqiya); 'shall I be wretched'
مَمَاتِي: مَمَات + ي — mamāt, death (m., gen. in iḍāfa); -ī, my; 'my death'
رَجُلَيْنِ: rajulayn — two men (dual of rajul, gen.); 'two men'
مُطِيعٌ: muṭīʿ — obedient (IV active participle, m., nom.); 'obedient'
عَاصٍ: ʿāṣin — disobedient, rebellious (active participle of ʿaṣā, m., nom. indef.); 'disobedient'
لِأَنْ: لِـ + أَنْ — li-, for (prep.); an, that (+ subj.); 'for that'
أُعِينَهُ: uʿīna + hu — I help (IV impf. subj. 1 sg.); -hu, him; 'that I help him'
دُفِنَ: dufina — was buried (passive perf. 3 m. sg.); 'was buried'
أُقْضِيَ: uqḍiya (printed with qāf; perhaps for افضي) — was brought, was committed (passive perf., 3 m. sg.); 'was brought to'
فَهَالَنِي: فَـ + هَالَ + نِي — fa-, and; hāla, terrified, appalled (perf. 3 m. sg.); -nī, me; 'and it terrified me'
وَرَاعَنِي: وَ + رَاعَ + نِي — wa-, and; rāʿa, alarmed (perf. 3 m. sg.); -nī, me; 'and it alarmed me'
فَعَاهَدْتُ: فَـ + عَاهَدْتُ — fa-, and so; ʿāhadtu, I made a covenant with (III perf. 1 sg.); 'and I covenanted with'
عَمَلَهُ: عَمَل + هُ — ʿamal, deed, work (m., acc.); -hu, his; 'his deed'
وُلِّيتُ: wulliytu — I was put in charge, made ruler (II passive perf. 1 sg.); 'I was made ruler'
اجْتَهَدْتُ: ijtahadtu — I strove, exerted myself (VIII perf. 1 sg.); 'I have striven'
وَأَرْجُوأَنْ: وَ + أَرْجُو + أَنْ — wa-, and; arjū, I hope (impf. 1 sg.); an, that (+ subj.); printed joined; 'and I hope that'
أُقْضَى: uqḍā (printed with qāf) — I be brought, committed (passive impf. subj., 1 sg.); 'that I be brought to'
دَفْنَهُ: دَفْن + هُ — dafn, burial (verbal noun, acc.); -hu, his; 'his burial'
دَفْنِهِ: دَفْن + هِ — dafn, burial (gen. after min); -hi, his; 'his burial'
النَّائِمُ: الـ + نَائِم — nāʾim, sleeper, one asleep (active participle, m., nom.); 'the sleeper'
رَوْضَةٍ: rawḍa — garden, meadow (f., gen. indef.); 'a garden'
بِيضٌ: bīḍ — white (pl. of abyaḍ, nom. indef.); 'white'
فَلْيَعْمَلِ: فَـ + لِـ + يَعْمَلِ — fa-, so; li-, let (jussive particle); yaʿmali, he works (impf. jussive); 'so let work'
الْعَامِلُونَ: الـ + عَامِلُونَ — ʿāmilūn, workers, those who do (active participle, m. pl. nom.); 'the workers'
وَنَحْوُ: وَ + نَحْو — wa-, and; naḥw, like, the sort of (m., nom.); 'and the like of'
الثِّقَاتِ: الـ + ثِقَات — thiqāt, trustworthy ones (pl. of thiqa, gen.); 'the trustworthy ones'
أَحْلُبُ: aḥlubu — I milk (impf. 1 sg. of ḥalaba); 'I milk'
الْغَنَمَ: الـ + غَنَم — ghanam, sheep, flock (coll., acc.); 'the flock'
فَمَرَرْتُ: فَـ + مَرَرْتُ — fa-, and so; marartu, I passed (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I passed' (takes bi-, 'by')
غَنَمِهِ: غَنَم + هِ — ghanam, sheep, flock (gen. in iḍāfa); -hi, his; 'his flock'
ذِئَابًا: dhiʾāb — wolves (pl. of dhiʾb, acc. indef.); 'wolves'
فَظَنَّتُ: فَـ + ظَنَنْتُ — fa-, and so; ẓanantu, I supposed (perf. 1 sg., the print drops one nūn); 'and I supposed'
كِلَابُهَا: كِلَاب + هَا — kilāb, dogs (pl. of kalb, nom.); -hā, its; 'its dogs'
أَكُنْ: akun — I was (jussive of kāna, 1 sg., after lam); 'I had not been'; here: lam akun ka-, 'I am not like'
تَضُرَّهَا: taḍurra + hā — it harms (impf. jussive after lam, 3 f. sg.); -hā, it (the flock); 'does not harm it'
الْجَسَدُ: الـ + جَسَد — jasad, body (m., nom.); 'the body'
وَخَطَبَ: وَ + خَطَبَ — wa-, and; khaṭaba, he preached, gave a sermon (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he preached'
الطِّينِ: الـ + طِين — ṭīn, clay (m., gen.); 'the clay'
وَأَثْنَى: وَ + أَثْنَى — wa-, and; athnā, he praised (IV perf. 3 m. sg., takes ʿalā); 'and he lauded'
بِثَلٰثِ: بِـ + ثَلَاث — bi-, (prep.) with, in; thalāth (printed ثلث, dagger alif), three (gen. before a plural); 'with three'
أَصْلِحُوا: aṣliḥū — set right, mend! (IV imper. m. pl.)
أَسْرَارَكُمْ: أَسْرَار + كُمْ — asrār, secrets (pl. of sirr, acc.); -kum, your (pl.); 'your secrets'
لِتَصْلُحَ: لِـ + تَصْلُحَ — li-, so that, in order that (+ subj.); taṣluḥa, she is sound (impf. subj. 3 f. sg.); 'so that it be sound'
عَلَانِيَتُكُمْ: عَلَانِيَة + كُمْ — ʿalāniya, openness, public conduct (f., nom.); -kum, your (pl.); 'your public conduct'
لِإِخْوَانِكُمْ: لِـ + إِخْوَان + كُمْ — li-, for (prep.); ikhwān, brothers (pl., gen.); -kum, your (pl.); 'for your brothers'
وَتُكْفَوْا: وَ + تُكْفَوْا — wa-, and; tukfaw, you be spared, relieved of (passive impf. subj. 2 m. pl.); 'and you be spared'
دُنْيَاكُمْ: دُنْيَا + كُمْ — dunyā, world, worldly life (f., gen.); -kum, your (pl.); 'your world'
الْمَوْتَى: الـ + مَوْتَى — mawtā, the dead (pl. of mayyit, gen.); 'the dead'
مَنْكِئًا: mankiʾ (printed منكئا) — something to lean on, a support (m., acc. indef.), presumably for مُتَّكَأ; 'a leaning-place'
لِتَعْتَمِدَ: لِـ + تَعْتَمِدَ — li-, so that (+ subj.); taʿtamida, you lean (VIII impf. subj. 2 m. sg., takes ʿalā); 'so that you lean'
إِثْمٌ: ithm — sin, guilt (m., nom. indef.); 'a sin'
فَخَرَّ: فَـ + خَرَّ — fa-, and so; kharra, he fell down (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he fell down'
يَامَرْيَمُ: يَا + مَرْيَم — yā, O (vocative); Maryam, a woman's name (f., nom. as vocative); printed joined; 'O Maryam'
يَامُزَاحِمُ: يَا + مُزَاحِم — yā, O (vocative); Muzāḥim, a man's name (m., nom. as vocative); printed joined; 'O Muzāḥim'
وَتَبْكِي: وَ + تَبْكِي — wa-, and; tabkī, she weeps (impf. 3 f. sg.); 'and weeping'
يُبْكِيكِ: yubkī + ki — makes weep (IV impf. 3 m. sg.); -ki, you (f.); 'makes you weep'
مَصْرَعَكَ: مَصْرَع + كَ — maṣraʿ, falling, the place or act of falling (m., acc.); -ka, your; 'your falling'
فَتَذَكَّرْتُ: فَـ + تَذَكَّرْتُ — fa-, and so; tadhakkartu, I remembered (V perf. 1 sg.); 'and I remembered'
لِلْمَوْتِ: لِـ + الـ + مَوْت — li-, for, at (prep.); mawt, death (m., gen.); 'for death'
وَتَخَلِّيكَ: وَ + تَخَلِّي + كَ — wa-, and; takhallī, giving up (V verbal noun, gen.); -ka, your; 'and your giving up'
وَفِرَاقَكَ: وَ + فِرَاق + كَ — wa-, and; firāq, parting (m., gen.); -ka, your; 'and your parting'
أَبْكَانِي: abkā + nī — made weep (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); -nī, me; 'made me weep'
حَسْبُكِ: ḥasb + ki — enough, sufficient (m., nom.); -ki, for you (f.); 'enough for you'
أَبْلَغْتِ: ablaghti — you have conveyed fully, said all (IV perf. 2 f. sg.); 'you have said it fully'
فَسَقَطَ: فَـ + سَقَطَ — fa-, and so; saqaṭa, he fell (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he fell'
فَضَمَّتْهُ: فَـ + ضَمَّتْ + هُ — fa-, and; ḍammat, she embraced (perf. 3 f. sg.); -hu, him; 'and she embraced him'
نَسْتَطِيعُ: nastaṭīʿu — we are able (X impf. 1 pl.); 'we are able'
نُكَلِّمَكَ: nukallima + ka — we speak to (II impf. subj. 1 pl.); -ka, you; 'that we speak to you'
وَلِلْقُضَاةِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + قُضَاة — wa-, and; li-, to, for; quḍāt, judges (pl. of qāḍī, gen.); 'and to the judges'
فَرَأَيْتُهُ: فَـ + رَأَيْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + raʾaytu, I saw + -hu, him; 'and I saw him'
رَأَبْتُ: raʾabtu (printed رأبت, for رأيت) — I saw (perf. 1 sg.); 'I saw'
رَأَيْتُ: raʾaytu — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I saw'
فَرَأَهَا: فَـ + رَأَى (+ ـهَا) — raʾā, to see (I); 'and he saw her'
فَرَأَيْتُ: فَ 'so, then' + رَأَيْتُ (see above); 'and I saw'
فَرَأَيْتُهُ: فَـ + رَأَيْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + raʾaytu, I saw + -hu, him; 'and I saw him'
تَعْرِفْهُ: تَعْرِفُ + هُ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (I); jussive after لَمْ; -hu, him; 'she did not recognise him'
تَتِمَّةُ: tatimma, completion, conclusion (f.), from تَمَّ, to be complete; 'the completion of'
الْمَوْسِمِ: الـ + مَوْسِم — mawsim, season, esp. the pilgrimage season; gen. after أَهْلِ; 'the season' Also 'the festival' (gen. after fī): al-ḥāḍirīna fī al-mawsimi, 'present at the festival'.
أُشْهِدُ: أَشْهَدَ (IV), to call to witness; 'I call (God) to witness'
وَالْبَلَدِ: وَ + الـ + بَلَد — wa-, and + al-balad, the land, town (here Mecca); 'and the land'
وَيَوْمِ: وَ + يَوْم — wa-, and + yawm, day; construct, 'and the day of'
أَمْرُقُ: مَرَقَ, to pass out of, go through; 'I go out from' (the print; perhaps for أَبْرَأُ, 'I am clear of')
ظُلْمِكُمْ: ظُلْم (+ كُمْ) — ẓulm, wrongdoing, injustice + -kum, your; 'your wronging' (of you)
وَعُدْوَانِ: وَـ + عُدْوَان — ʿudwān, enmity, aggression (construct); 'and the aggression of'
اعْتَدَى: اِعْتَدَى (VIII) — iʿtadā ʿalā, to transgress against; 'he transgressed'
تَعَمَّدْتُهُ: تَعَمَّدَ (V) + هُ — taʿammada, to do deliberately, intend; 'I intended it'
أَوْيَكُونَ: أَوْ + يَكُونَ — aw, or + yakūna, he/it be (subjunctive after an understood أَنْ); the print runs the two together; 'or that there be'
وَأَرْجُو: وَـ + أَرْجُو — wa-, and + arjū, I hope (rajā); 'and I hope'
إِذْنَ: إِذْن — idhn, permission, leave; accusative after لَا of negation, 'no permission'
بِظُلْمِ: بِـ + ظُلْم — bi-, in, for (prep.) + ẓulm, wrongdoing; 'for the wronging of'
مَسْئُولٌ: مَسْؤُول — masʾūl, passive participle of سَأَلَ, 'one questioned', held to account; 'questioned, accountable'
مَظْلُومٍ: مَظْلُوم — maẓlūm, wronged, passive participle of ظَلَمَ; 'a wronged person'
عَامِلٍ: عَامِل — ʿāmil, governor, agent, active participle of عَمِلَ, to work; 'a governor'
عُمَّالِي: عُمَّال + ـِي — ʿummāl, governors, agents (pl. of عَامِل) + -ī, my; 'my governors'
سُنَّةٍ: سُنَّة — sunna, established custom, the practice of the Prophet; 'a sunna' (after بِلَا … وَلَا)
طَاعَةَ: طَاعَة — ṭāʿa, obedience; accusative after لَا of negation, 'no obedience'
يُخَفَّفَ: خَفَّفَ (II) passive — khaffafa, to lighten, ease; subjunctive passive after أَنْ; 'be made light'
عَنِّى: عَنْ + ـِي — ʿan, from, for + -ī, me (with the print's final ى); 'for me'; here: after ṣadd, 'turning away', ʿan marks the one turned from: al-ṣadda ʿannī, 'turning away from me'; here also 'about me', after qāla: mā alladhī qāla lakum ʿannī, 'what did he tell you about me'
مَايُؤْجَرُ: مَا + يُؤْجَرُ — mā, what + yuʾjaru, he is rewarded (passive of آجَرَ/أَجَرَ, to reward); the print runs the two together; 'what is rewarded for'
بِوَضْعِهَا: بِـ + وَضْع + ـهَا — bi-, with, for (prep.; amara bi-, to order that) + waḍʿ, placing + -hā, it/them; 'the placing of them'
أَفْقَرْتَ: أَفْقَرَ (IV) — afqara, to make poor, impoverish; 'you have impoverished'
