وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ: وَـ + جَعَلْتَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make (you made) + -hum, them; 'and you made them'
عِيَالًا: عِيَال — ʿiyāl, dependants, a man's household who rely on him; accusative of the predicate, 'as dependants'
لَاشَيْءَ: لَا + شَيْء — lā, no + shayʾ, thing; the print runs the two together; 'nothing'
أَوْصَيْتَ: أَوْصَى (IV) — awṣā, to bequeath, make a bequest; 'you bequeathed'
فَأَوْصِ: فَـ + أَوْصِ — fa-, so + awṣi, bequeath (imperative of أَوْصَى); 'so bequeath'
إِنَى: the print's إنى, evidently for إِلَى, ilā, to, towards; read as 'to'
فَغَيْرُ: فَـ + غَيْر — fa-, then + ghayr, other than, not; 'then it is not'
يَتَّقِى: اِتَّقَى (VIII) — ittaqā, to fear God, be pious (final ى as printed); 'he fears'
فَسَيَجْعَلُ: فَـ + سَـ + يَجْعَلُ — fa-, then + sa-, will (future) + yajʿalu, he makes; 'then He will make'
مَخْرَجًا: مَخْرَج — makhraj, a way out, exit; accusative; 'a way out'
مُعْتَكِفٌ: مُعْتَكِف — muʿtakif, active participle of اِعْتَكَفَ (VIII), to stay in retreat, cling; 'one who clings, given up to'
الْمَعَاصِي: الـ + مَعَاصِي — maʿāṣī, acts of disobedience, sins (pl. of مَعْصِيَة); 'the sins'
لِأُقَوِّيَهُ: لِـ + أُقَوِّيَ + هُ — li-, to, for (prep.; with lam al-juḥūd after لَمْ أَكُنْ, 'not to be one to') + uqawwiya, I strengthen (qawwā II, subjunctive) + -hu, him; 'to strengthen him'
مَعْصِيَةِ: مَعْصِيَة — maʿṣiya, disobedience, sin; construct; 'the disobedience of'
ذَرَفَتْ: ذَرَفَ — dharafa, to shed tears, stream; 'it streamed' (f.)
أَبَاكُمْ: أَب + كُمْ — ab, father (acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your father'
أَمْرَيْنِ: أَمْر — amr, matter, outcome; dual after بَيْنَ; 'two matters'; here gen. after min: min amrayni, 'from two things'
تَسْتَغْنُوا: اِسْتَغْنَى (X) — istaghnā, to become rich, be independent; 'you become rich' (subjunctive, pl.)
فَيَدْخُلُ: فَـ + يَدْخُلُ — fa-, so, and so + yadkhulu, he enters; 'and so he enters'
أَبُوكُمُ: أَبُو + كُمُ — abū, father (nom., construct) + -kum, your; 'your father'
تَفْتَقِرُوا: اِفْتَقَرَ (VIII) — iftaqara, to become poor; 'you become poor' (subjunctive, pl.)
وَدُخُولُ: وَـ + دُخُول — wa-, and + dukhūl, entering (verbal noun of دَخَلَ); 'and the entering of'
أَبِيكُمُ: أَبِي + كُمُ — abī, father (gen., construct) + -kum, your; 'of your father'
عَصَمَكُمُ: عَصَمَ + كُمُ — ʿaṣama, to protect, keep safe + -kum, you (pl.); optative 'may (God) protect you'
وَكَلْتُ: وَكَلَ — wakala, to entrust, commit to another's charge; 'I have entrusted'
أَمْرَكُمْ: أَمْر + كُمْ — amr, affair, matter (acc.) + -kum, your; 'your affair'
خَالِدُ: خَالِد — Khālid (ibn Ṣafwān), a Basran orator at the Umayyad court; nom., construct
صَفْوَانَ: صَفْوَان — Ṣafwān, a man's name; gen. (diptote) after ابْن
صَحِبَنِي: صَحِبَ + نِي — ṣaḥiba, to accompany + -nī, me; 'he accompanied me'
يُوسُفُ: يُوسُف — Yūsuf (ibn ʿUmar al-Thaqafī), governor of Iraq under Hishām ; also: Yūsuf, Joseph the prophet (sura 12 of the Qurʾān), proverbial type of male beauty; nom., after kam: kam fī jamālika Yūsufu, 'how many a Joseph is in your beauty!'
هِشَامِ: هِشَام — Hishām (ibn ʿAbd al-Malik), Umayyad caliph; gen. after إِلَى
بِقَرَابَتِهِ: بِـ + قَرَابَة + هِ — bi-, with (prep.) + qarāba, kinsfolk, relatives + -hi, his; 'with his kinsfolk'
وَخَدَمِهِ: وَـ + خَدَم + هِ — wa-, and + khadam, servants (coll.) + -hi, his; 'and his servants'
وَضُرِبَتْ: وَـ + ضُرِبَتْ — wa-, and + ḍuribat, it was struck, pitched (passive of ضَرَبَ; ḍaraba khayma, to pitch a tent); 'and was pitched'
مَجَالِسَهُمْ: مَجَالِس + هُمْ — majālis, seats, places of sitting (pl. of مَجْلِس) + -hum, their; 'their seats'
أَتَمَّ: أَتَمَّ (IV) — atamma, to complete, perfect; here optative, 'may (God) complete'
نِعْمَتَهُ: نِعْمَة + هُ — niʿma, favour, blessing (acc.) + -hu, His; 'His favour'
قَلَّدَكَ: قَلَّدَ (II) + كَ — qallada, to hang (a sword-belt, necklace) on, invest with + -ka, you; 'He has invested you with'
رَشَدًا: رَشَد — rashad, right guidance, rectitude; acc. as second object of جَعَلَ; 'right guidance'
خَالَطَ: خَالَطَ (III) — khālaṭa, to mix with, mingle; optative after وَلَا, 'may (nothing) mingle with'
أَبْلَغَ: أَبْلَغ — ablagh, more eloquent, more effective (elative of بَلِيغ); acc., diptote; 'more telling'
فَاسْتَوَى: فَـ + اِسْتَوَى — fa-, so + istawā (VIII/X), to sit upright, be level; 'so he sat up'
عَامِكَ: عَام + كَ — ʿām, year + -ka, your; 'of your year'
لِجُلَسَائِهِ: لِـ + جُلَسَاء + هِ — li-, to (prep.) + julasāʾ, table-companions (pl. of جَلِيس) + -hi, his; 'to his companions'
رَأَيْتُمْ: رَأَى + تُمْ — raʾā, to see + -tum, you (pl.); 'have you seen'
بَقَايَا: بَقَايَا — baqāyā, remnants, survivors (pl. of بَقِيَّة); 'the remnants of'
حَمَلَةِ: حَمَلَة — ḥamala, bearers (pl. of حَامِل); construct; 'the bearers of'
الْحُجَّةِ: الـ + حُجَّة — ḥujja, proof, argument; 'the proof'
وَالْمُعِينِينَ: وَـ + الـ + مُعِينِينَ — wa-, and + al-muʿīnīn, those who help (active participle of أَعَانَ IV, pl. gen.); 'and the helpers'
السَّالِكِينَ: الـ + سَالِكِينَ — sālikīn, those who travel a road (active participle of سَلَكَ, pl.); 'the travellers'
مِنْهَاجِهِ: مِنْهَاج + هِ — minhāj, open road, way + -hi, its; 'its path'
سَأَلْتَ: سَأَلَ + تَ — saʾala, to ask (+ ʿan, about) + -ta, you; 'you have asked'
أَتَأْذَنُ: أَ + تَأْذَنُ — a-, interrogative particle + taʾdhanu, you permit (adhina li-, to give leave to); 'will you permit'
أَرَأَيْتَ: أَ + رَأَيْتَ — a-, interrogative + raʾayta, you saw; 'do you see, consider'
زَائِلًا: زَائِل — zāʾil, passing away, perishable (active participle of زَالَ); acc.; 'passing'
زَائِلٌ: زَائِل — zāʾil, passing away, perishable; nom. predicate; 'passing'
أُعْجِبْتَ: أُعْجِبَ (IV passive) + تَ — uʿjiba bi-, to be pleased with, be taken with + -ta, you; 'you were delighted (with)'
وَتُسْأَلُ: وَـ + تُسْأَلُ — wa-, and + tusʾalu, you are questioned (passive of سَأَلَ); 'and you are asked'
حِسَابِهِ: حِسَاب + هِ — ḥisāb, reckoning + -hi, its; 'its reckoning'
مُرْتَهَنًا: مُرْتَهَن — murtahan, held in pledge (passive participle of اِرْتَهَنَ VIII); acc.; 'a pledge held'
الْمَهْرَبُ: الـ + مَهْرَب — mahrab, place of escape, way out (from هَرَبَ); 'the escape'
الْمَطْلَبُ: الـ + مَطْلَب — maṭlab, thing sought, goal (from طَلَبَ); 'the object of search'
مُلْكِكَ: مُلْك + كَ — mulk, kingdom, dominion + -ka, your; 'your kingdom'
فَتَعْمَلَ: فَـ + تَعْمَلَ — fa-, and so + taʿmala, you work, act (subjunctive after أَنْ); 'and work'
طَاعَةِ: طَاعَة — ṭāʿa, obedience; construct, 'the obedience of'
تَلْبَسَ: لَبِسَ — labisa, to put on, wear; subjunctive, 'you put on'
أَطْمَارَكَ: أَطْمَار + كَ — aṭmār, rags, tattered garments (pl. of طِمْر) + -ka, your; 'your rags'
وَتَعْبُدَ: وَـ + تَعْبُدَ — wa-, and + taʿbuda, you worship (ʿabada; subjunctive); 'and worship'
رَبَّكَ: رَبّ + كَ — rabb, lord (acc.) + -ka, your; 'your Lord'
حَتَّي: حَتَّى — ḥattā, until (the print has a dotted final ي); introduces the subjunctive; 'until'
يَأْتِيَكَ: يَأْتِي + كَ — yaʾtī, he comes (ataā; subjunctive after حَتَّى) + -ka, you; 'comes to you'
أَجَلُكَ: أَجَل + كَ — ajal, appointed term, hour of death + -ka, your; 'your appointed hour'
السَّحَرُ: الـ + سَحَر — saḥar, the last part of the night, dawn; nom.; 'the dawn'
قَرَعَ: قَرَعَ — qaraʿa, to knock (+ ʿalayhi bābahu, at his door); 'he knocked'
السَّحَرِ: الـ + سَحَر — saḥar, dawn; gen. after عِنْدَ; 'the dawn'; also second term of an iḍāfa: waqtu al-saḥari, 'the time before dawn'
تَاجَهُ: تَاج + هُ — tāj, crown (acc.) + -hu, his; 'his crown'
وَتَهَيَّأَ: وَـ + تَهَيَّأَ — wa-, and + tahayyaʾa (V), to make oneself ready; 'and made ready'
لِلسِّيَاحَةِ: لِـ + الـ + سِيَاحَة — li-, for, to (prep.) + al-siyāḥa, wandering as an ascetic, travel; 'for the wandering life'
مَوْعِظَتِهِ: مَوْعِظَة + هِ — mawʿiẓa, admonition, sermon + -hi, his; 'his admonition'
بِنَزْعِ: بِـ + نَزْع — bi-, with (prep.; amara bi-, to order that) + nazʿ, taking off, removing; 'the removal of'
خَالِدِ: خَالِد — Khālid (ibn Ṣafwān); gen. after إِلَى
مِيرِ: the print's مير after بِا — for أَمِير, amīr, commander (construct); 'commander' (of the believers)
لَذَّتَهُ: لَذَّة + هُ — ladhdha, pleasure, enjoyment + -hu, his; 'his pleasure'
وَنَغَّصْتَ: وَـ + نَغَّصْتَ — wa-, and + naghghaṣta (II), to trouble, embitter (you embittered); 'and you soured'
حَيَاتَهُ: حَيَاة + هُ — ḥayāh, life + -hu, his; 'his life'
النَّصَائِحِ: الـ + نَصَائِح — naṣāʾiḥ, counsels (pl. of نَصِيحَة); 'the counsels'
لَأَعْجِزُ: لَـ + أَعْجِزُ — la-, indeed (emphasis, after إِنِّي) + aʿjizu, I am unable (ʿajaza ʿan); 'I am indeed unable'
الْإِتْيَانِ: الـ + إِتْيَان — itiyān, coming, bringing (verbal noun of أَتَى); 'the bringing'
الْمُ: first part of the damaged word الم—باح in the print — evidently المباح, al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted'
بَاحِ: second part of the damaged word الم—باح — see الْمُ; المباح, 'the permitted'
وَبَتِيمَةُ: و + بَتِيمَة — wa-, and + batīma, as the print has it for يَتِيمَة (yatīma), the unique pearl, the peerless one (f.); 'and the pearl'
عُمْرِنَا: ʿumr + نَا — ʿumr, lifetime, life (m.), gen. after ṭūla, + -nā, our; 'our lives'
دَعَوْا: daʿā, he called, invoked a blessing on (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; takes لِـ of the one prayed for); 'they prayed'
خُدَّامِهِ: khuddām, servants, attendants (m. pl. of khādim), gen. after ilā, + هُ, his; 'his servants'
اشْرَعُوا: ishraʿ-, begin, set about, address yourselves to (imperative of sharaʿa, 2nd m. pl.); 'begin'
عَمَلِ: ʿamal, making, doing, work (m.), gen. in construct before al-ʿurs; 'the making of'
الْعُرْسِ: الـ + عُرْس — ʿurs, wedding, wedding feast (m.), gen. in construct; 'the wedding'
وَهَيِّئُوا: و + هَيِّئُوا — wa-, and + hayyiʾū, prepare, make ready (imperative of hayyaʾa, 2nd m. pl.); 'and prepare'
امْتَثَلُوا: imtathalū, they complied with, carried out (perfect of imtathala, form VIII; takes the command as object); 'they carried out'
وَهَيَّئُوا: و + هَيَّئُوا — wa-, and + hayyaʾū, they prepared, made ready (perfect of hayyaʾa, 3rd m. pl.); 'and they prepared'
بِنِسَاءِ: بِـ + نِسَاء — bi-, here the bi- that follows amara in 'gave order concerning' + nisāʾ, women, wives (f. pl.), gen. in construct; 'concerning the wives of'
يَنْصَرِفْنَ: yanṣarifna, they depart, go away (jussive after an lā, 3rd f. pl.; the -na ending marks the feminine plural); 'they depart'
يَحْضُرْنَ: yaḥḍurna, they attend, are present at (subjunctive after ḥattā, 3rd f. pl.); 'they attend'
الْجِلَاءَ: الـ + جِلَاء — jilāʾ, unveiling, display of a bride (m.), verbal noun of jalā; 'the unveiling'
وَالْعُرْسَ: و + الـ + عُرْس — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿurs, wedding (m.); 'and the wedding'
مُدَّتِ: muddat-i, was stretched out, was laid out (passive perfect of madda, 3rd f. sg.; the kasra is the linking vowel before al-); 'was laid out'
السُّفْرَةُ: الـ + سُفْرَة — sufra, the dining spread, the table-cloth with the food on it (f.); 'the spread'
تَشْتَهِيهِ: tashtahī + hi — tashtahī, she (it) desires (imperfect of ishtahā, form VIII; the subject is al-anfus, treated as feminine singular) + -hi, it (the relative's returning pronoun); 'desires'
وَتَلَذُّ: و + تَلَذُّ — wa-, and + taladhdhu, it delights, takes pleasure (imperfect of ladhdha, 3rd f. sg.); 'and delights'
مَشْوِيٍّ: mashwī, roasted, roast meat (m.; passive participle of shawā), gen. after min; 'roast'
وَرَسَمُوا: و + رَسَمُوا — wa-, and + rasamū, they decreed, ordered (perfect of rasama, 3rd m. pl.); 'and they ordered'
مُغَنِّيَةٍ: mughanniya, woman singer (f.; active participle of ghannā), gen. after kulli; 'singer'
فَحَضَرْنَ: فَـ + حَضَرْنَ — fa-, so, and + ḥaḍarna, they attended, came (perfect, 3rd f. pl.); 'and they came'
جَوَارِىَ: jawārī, slave girls (f. pl. of jāriya), gen. in construct after kadhālika; the print writes the final yāʾ dotless; 'the slave girls of'
جَمِيعُهُنَّ: jamīʿ + هُنَّ — jamīʿ, all, the whole (nom.) + -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'all of them'
وَالْكُبَرَاءُ: و + الـ + كُبَرَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + kubarāʾ, great men, grandees (m. pl. of kabīr), nom.; 'and the grandees'
وَالْمَوَاشِطُ: و + الـ + مَوَاشِط — wa-, and + al-, the + mawāshiṭ, women who dress and comb a bride's hair (f. pl. of māshiṭa), nom.; 'and the bridal women'
لِتُزَيِّنَهَا: لِـ + تُزَيِّنَ + هَا — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + tuzayyina, they adorn (form II) + -hā, her; 'to adorn her'
وَتُلْبِسَهَا: و + تُلْبِسَ + هَا — wa-, and + tulbisa, they dress, clothe (subjunctive of albasa, form IV; two objects) + -hā, her; 'and to dress her'
فَرَأَتْهَا: فَـ + رَأَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so + raʾat, she saw (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; the print has the hamza) + -hā, her; 'and she saw her'
لَاتَحْتَاجُ: lā taḥtāju — lā, not + taḥtāju, she needs (imperfect of iḥtāja, form VIII; takes ilā); the print writes the two as one word; 'she does not need'
زِينَةٍ: zīna, adornment, ornament (f.), gen. after ilā; 'adornment'
وَجُلِيَتْ: و + جُلِيَتْ — wa-, and + julīyat, she was unveiled, displayed (passive perfect of jalā, 3rd f. sg.); 'and was displayed'
الْعَرُوسُ: الـ + عَرُوس — ʿarūs, bride (f.), nom.; 'the bride'
خَفَّفُوا: khaffafū, they lightened, made lighter (perfect of khaffafa, form II, 3rd m. pl.); 'they lightened'
تُوصَى: tūṣā, she is charged, enjoined (passive imperfect of awṣā, form IV; the subject is al-banāt); 'is charged with'
الزِّفَافِ: الـ + زِفَاف — zifāf, the bridal procession, the leading of the bride to her husband (m.), gen. in construct after laylata; 'the procession'
الْحُكَمَاءَ: الـ + حُكَمَاء — ḥukamāʾ, sages, wise men, physicians (m. pl. of ḥakīm), acc.; 'the sages'
يَكْتُبُوا: yaktubū, they write (subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.; the final alif is only a spelling); 'they write'
كَاتِبَ: kātib, writer, secretary (m.; active participle of kataba), acc. in construct before sirrihi; 'secretary of'
عِلْمٍ: ʿilm, knowledge, learning (m.), gen. after dhāta; 'knowledge'
فُنُونَ: funūn, arts, kinds, branches (m. pl. of fann), acc. in construct; 'the arts of'
لِتَزُورَاخَاهُ: لِـ + تَزُورَ + أَخَا + هُ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + tazūra, she visit (subjunctive of zāra) + akhā, brother (acc.; one of the 'five nouns') + -hu, his; the print runs the verb and the noun together; 'to visit his brother'
عَمَلَهَا: ʿamal + هَا — ʿamal, deed, doing, work (m.; acc., object of shakara) + -hā, her; 'her deed'
وَيُسَلِّمُ: و + يُسَلِّمُ — wa-, and + yusallimu, he gives greeting (imperfect of sallama ʿalā, form II); 'and gives greetings'
وَوَزِيرِهِ: و + وَزِير + هِ — wa-, and + wazīr, vizier (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'and his vizier'
بَرِيدٍ: barīd, courier, post (m.), gen. in construct after ṣuḥbata; 'a courier'
الْبَرِيدُ: الـ + بَرِيد — barīd, courier (m.), nom.; 'the courier'
وَقَرَاءَهُ: و + قَرَاءَ + هُ — wa-, and + qaraʾa, he read (perfect; the print spells it with alif and hamza) + -hu, it; 'and he read it'
الْحَائِرِ: الـ + حَائِر — ḥāʾir, bewildered, perplexed (m.; active participle of ḥāra), gen. after min ʿindi; 'the bewildered'
الْوَلْهَانِ: الـ + وَلْهَان — walhān, distraught, frantic with grief (m.), gen., the second epithet; 'the distraught'
فَقَدَ: faqada, he lost (perfect of faqada); 'he lost'
الْوِلْدَانَ: الـ + وِلْدَان — wildān, children, boys (m. pl. of walad), acc.; 'the children'
وَهَجَرَ: و + هَجَرَ — wa-, and + hajara, he forsook, abandoned (perfect of hajara); 'and he forsook'
مَسِيرِكَ: masīr + كَ — masīr, going, journey (verbal noun of sāra), gen. after baʿda + -ka, your; 'your going'
الصَّيْدِو: الـ + صَيْد + و — al-, the + ṣayd, hunting, the hunt (m.), gen. after ilā + wa-, and, which the print runs onto it; 'the hunt, and'
الْقَنْصِ: الـ + قَنْص — qanṣ, the chase, hunting game (m.), gen. after the conjunction (the print runs wa- onto the preceding word); 'the chase'
نَوَائِبَ: nawāʾib, misfortunes, calamities (f. pl. of nāʾiba), acc. in construct; 'the misfortunes of'
وَمَنَعْتُهُ: و + مَنَعْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + manaʿtu, I prevented, kept back (perfect, 1st sg.) + -hu, him; 'and I prevented him'
يَاحِ: second part of the damaged word الم—ياح in the print — see الْمُ; evidently المباح, al-mubāḥ, 'the permitted', with yāʾ printed for bāʾ
أُعْجُوبَةُ: uʿjūba — wonder, marvel (f.), nom. in a nominal predicate; 'a wonder'
الْأَعْيُنُ: الـ + أَعْيُن — aʿyun, eyes (f. pl. of ʿayn), nom.; 'the eyes'
وَأَوَزٍّ: و + أَوَزّ — wa-, and + awazz, geese (coll., plural of wazza); 'and geese'
وَأَظْلَمَ: و + أَظْلَمَ — wa-, and + aẓlama, it grew dark (perfect of form IV); 'and grew dark'
وَأَوْصَوْهَا: و + أَوْصَوْ + هَا — wa-, and + awṣaw, they charged, enjoined (perfect of awṣā, form IV, 3rd m. pl.; takes bi- for the thing) + -hā, her; 'and they charged her'
إِرْسَالِهَا: irsāl + هَا — irsāl, sending (verbal noun of arsala, form IV; gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her sending'
أَعْتَقَهَا: aʿtaqa + هَا — aʿtaqa, he freed, manumitted (perfect of form IV) + -hā, her; 'he freed her'
إِخْوَتِهِ: ikhwa + هُ — ikhwa, brothers (m. pl. of akh), gen. after ʿalā + -hi, his; 'his brothers'
الْأَوْطَانَ: الـ + أَوْطَان — awṭān, homelands, native places (m. pl. of waṭan), acc.; 'the homelands'
أَكْتُمَ: aktuma, I conceal (subjunctive after an, 1st sg.; imperfect of katama); 'I conceal'
مَكْتُوبِهِ: maktūb, letter, something written (m., from kataba), gen. after fī + -hi, his; 'his letter'
أَخَاكَ: akhā, brother (m.), acc. as object of wajadtu + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your brother'; or acc. in apposition to an accusative noun after inna (inna sharrukāna akhāka, 'that Sharrukān your brother')
وَأُخْتَكَ: wa-, and + ukht, sister (f.), acc. + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'and your sister'
الْفَضَاءُ: الـ + فَضَاء — faḍāʾ, open space, the wide world (m.), nom.; 'the open space'
انْتَظَرْتُ: intaẓartu, I waited, I waited for (perfect of form VIII intaẓara, 1st sg.); 'I waited'
لَعَلَّهُمَا: laʿalla, perhaps, in the hope that (particle) + -humā, the two of them; 'that perhaps they two'
يَجِيئَانِ: yajīʾāni, they two come (imperfect of jāʾa, 3rd m. dual); 'they two come'
الْحُجَّاجُ: الـ + حُجَّاج — ḥujjāj, pilgrims (m. pl. of ḥājj), nom.; 'the pilgrims'
سَائَتُ: saʾatu, I asked (the print's spelling for saʾaltu, perfect of saʾala, 1st sg.; the lām seems to have dropped out); 'I asked'
عَنْهُمَا: ʿan, about, concerning (prep.) + -humā, the two of them; 'about them two'
أَخْبَرَنِي: akhbara, he told, informed (perfect of form IV, 3rd m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'he told me'
لِأَجْلِهِمَا: li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake (m.), gen. + -himā, the two of them; 'for their sake'
مَرْهُونُ: marhūn, pledged, held in pawn (passive participle of rahana, m.), nom., first term of a construct with al-fuʾād; 'pledged'
عَلِيمُ: ʿalīm, knowing (m.), nom., first term of a construct; the likely sense is ʿadīm, 'lacking', a probable misprint; 'knowing-of'
الرَّقَادِ: الـ + رَقَاد — raqād, sleep, slumber (m.), gen. in a construct; 'the sleep'
غَرِيقُ: gharīq, drowned (m., from gharaqa), nom., first term of a construct; 'drowned-in'
دَمْعِ: damʿ, tears, weeping (m.), gen. in a construct; 'tear of'
خَيَالُهُمَا: khayāl, image, phantom, apparition (m.), nom. + -humā, their (the two of them); 'their image'
يَبْرَحُ: yabraḥu, he leaves, departs (imperfect of bariḥa, 3rd m. sg.); 'he leaves'
جَعَلْتُ: jaʿaltu, I made, I set, placed (perfect of jaʿala, 1st sg.); 'I set'
أَشْرَفَ: ashrafa, noblest, most honourable (elative of sharīf, m.), acc. (diptote), first term of a construct; 'the noblest'
وَلَوْلَارَجَاءُ: wa-, and + lawlā, were it not for (particle) + rajāʾ, hope (m.), nom.; the print joins the words; 'and were it not for hope'
الْعَوْدِ: الـ + عَوْد — ʿawd, return, coming back (verbal noun of ʿāda, m.), gen. in a construct; 'the return'
مَاعِشْتُ: mā, not (negative particle) + ʿishtu, I lived (perfect of ʿāsha, 1st sg.); the print joins the words; 'I would not have lived'
خَيَالُ: khayāl, image, phantom (m.), nom., first term of a construct with al-ṭayf; 'the phantom of'
الطَّيْفِ: الـ + طَيْف — ṭayf, a visiting phantom, the visitor-in-the-night, a dream-image (m.), gen. in a construct; 'the night-visitor'
أَتَهَجَّعِ: atahajjaʿi, I sleep a little, doze (imperfect of form V tahajjaʿa, 1st sg., jussive after lam, with a kasra added for the rhyme); 'I sleep a little'
أُعَرِّفُكَ: uʿarrifu, I inform, let know (imperfect of form II ʿarrafa, 1st sg.) + -ka, you (m. sg.), acc.; 'I let you know'
لَاتَتَهَاوَنْ: lā, not (negative particle, here prohibitive) + tatahāwan, you be slack, lax (jussive of form VI tahāwana, 2nd m. sg.); the print joins the words; 'you must not be lax'
كَشْفِ: kashf, uncovering, laying bare, investigating (verbal noun of kashafa, m.), gen. after fī; 'uncovering'
لِفَقْدِ: li-, at, because of (prep., of the cause of his gladness) + faqd, loss (verbal noun of faqada, m.), gen.; 'at the loss of'
فَسَهَّلَ: fa-, and so (conj.) + sahhala, he made easy (perfect of form II, 3rd m. sg.); 'and so he made easy'
الْوِلَادَةَ: الـ + وِلَادَة — wilāda, birth, childbirth (f.), acc. as object; 'the birthing'
فَوَلَدَتْ: fa-, and so (conj.) + waladat, she bore, gave birth to (perfect of walada, 3rd f. sg.); 'and she bore'
تَطْلُبُ: taṭlubu, she seeks, asks for (imperfect of ṭalaba, 3rd f. sg.), here the circumstantial 'sending, seeking'; 'she seeks'
فَسَمِّهَا: fa-, so (conj.) + sammi, name! (imperative of form II sammā, m. sg.) + -hā, her, acc.; 'so name her'
أَوْلَادَهُمْ: awlād, children, sons (m. pl. of walad), acc. as object of yusammū + -hum, their; 'their children'
سَابِعِ: sābiʿ, seventh (m.), gen. after fī, first term of a construct; 'the seventh of'
وِلَادَتِهِمْ: wilāda, birth (f.), gen. in a construct + -him, their; 'their birth'
عُنُقِهَاخَرَزَةً: ʿunuq, neck (m.), gen. after fī + -hā, her; run together in the print with kharaza, a bead (f.), acc. (object of wajada); 'her neck [and] a bead'
مَعْرِفَتِهَا: maʿrifa, knowledge, knowing (verbal noun of ʿarafa, f.), gen. in the construct ḥaqqa maʿrifatihā + -hā, its/her; 'the knowing of it'
جَائَتْكِ: jāʾat, she/it came (perfect of jāʾa, 3rd f. sg.; the print spells the hamza on a yāʾ) + -ki, you (f. sg.), acc.; 'it came to you'
يَاجَارِيَةُ: yā, O (vocative particle) + jāriya, slave-girl (f.), nom. (the print joins the words); 'O slave-girl'
سَيِّدَتُكَ: sayyida, mistress, lady (f. of sayyid), nom. + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your mistress'
وَسَيِّدَةُ: wa-, and (conj.) + sayyida, mistress, lady (f. of sayyid), nom., first term of a construct; 'and mistress of'
جَارِيَةُ: jāriya, slave-girl, girl (f.), nom. after yā (vocative); 'slave-girl' Also nom. as subject and first term of an iḍāfa: jāʾat jāriyatu Shamsi al-Nahāri, 'Shams al-Nahār's slave-girl came'.
الْكِتْمَانُ: الـ + كِتْمَان — kitmān, concealment, secrecy (verbal noun of katama, m.), nom.; 'the concealment'
الِارْتِعَاشُ: الـ + ارْتِعَاش — irtiʿāsh, trembling, shivering (verbal noun of form VIII irtaʿasha, m.), nom.; 'the trembling'
ارْتَجَفَ: irtajafa — to tremble, shake (VIII perf. 3 m. sg.); 'trembled'
الِارْتِعَاسُ: الـ + ارْتِعَاس — irtiʿās, trembling (m., nom.); the print's slip for ارتعاش; 'the trembling'
يُعَرِّفْهَا: yuʿarrifhā — يُعَرِّفُ (II impf. of عَرَفَ, make known, introduce) + هَا (her), jussive after لَمْ; 'make her know, introduce himself to her'
فِرَاقِكِ: firāq + كِ — firāq, parting, separation (m., gen. after 'cause of') + 'your' (f.); 'your parting'
لِوَالِدِكِ: لِـ + وَالِد + كِ — wālid, father (m., gen.); 'for your father' (li-, for, marks who is parted from)
وَبَيْعِكِ: وَ + بَيْع + كِ — bayʿ, selling (m., gen.); 'and your being sold'
فَحَكَتْ: فَ + حَكَتْ — ḥakā, to tell, relate (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she told'
تَرَكَتْ: tarakat — taraka, to leave (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she left'
بِاخْتِطَافِ: بِـ + اخْتِطَاف — ikhtiṭāf, seizing, abduction (m., gen.); 'of the seizing' (bi- here follows أَخْبَرَ 'inform of')
وَبَيْعِهِ: وَ + بَيْع + هِ — bayʿ, selling (m., gen.) + 'his'; 'and his selling'
بِأُخْتِي: بِـ + أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f., gen.); 'with my sister' (bi- after تَزَوَّجَ, marry; 'marry with')
أُزَوِّجَهَا: uzawwijahā — زَوَّجَ (II, marry off) subj. 1 sg. + هَا (her); 'that I marry her off'
حُجَّابِي: ḥujjāb + ī — ḥājib pl., chamberlains (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + 'my'; 'my chamberlains'
أَدَّعِي: addaʿī — iddaʿā, to claim (VIII impf. 1 sg.); 'I shall claim'
طَلَّقْتُهَا: ṭallaqtuhā — ṭallaqa, to divorce (II perf. 1 sg.) + هَا (her); 'I divorced her'
وَزَوَّجْتُهَا: وَ + زَوَّجْتُهَا — zawwaja, to marry off (II perf. 1 sg.) + her; 'and I married her off'
بِالْحَاجِبِ: بِـ + الـ + حَاجِب — ḥājib, chamberlain (m., gen.); bi- chosen by the verb: with زَوَّجَ, 'marry off to' ('to the chamberlain'); with اجْتَمَعَ بِـ, 'meet with' ('with the chamberlain')
يَانُزْهَةَ: يَا + نُزْهَة — yā, O (vocative) + Nuzha, 'delight', name (f., acc. as vocative first term of iḍāfa); 'O Nuzha' — print runs ya- on
أَسْتَغْفِرُ: astaghfiru — istaghfara, to ask forgiveness (X impf. 1 sg.); 'I ask forgiveness of'
وَقَعْنَا: waqaʿnā — waqaʿa, to fall (perf. 1 pl.); 'we fell, we have fallen'
عُمَرَبْنِ: ʿUmar + بْنِ — ʿUmar, name (m., gen. diptote-like acc. ending as printed) + ibn, son (gen.); the print runs the two together; 'ʿUmar son of'
وَحَقَّقَتْهُ: وَ + حَقَّقَتْ + هُ — ḥaqqaqa, to make certain, examine closely (II perf. 3 f. sg.) + him; 'and she studied him closely'
صَوَابِهَا: ṣawāb + hā — ṣawāb, right, sound judgement (m., gen. after 'from'); 'her right mind'
جَاءَتْكِ: jāʾat + kī — jāʾa, to come (perf. 3 f. sg.) + 'you' (f.); 'has come to you'
أُزَوِّجَكِ: uzawwijaki — zawwaja, marry off (II subj. 1 sg.) + kī (you, f.); 'that I marry you off'
وَأَدَعَكِ: وَ + أَدَعَ + كِ — adaʿa, to leave, let (subj. 1 sg.; wadaʿa) + you (f.); 'and leave you'
تُرَبِّي: turabbī — rabbā, to rear, bring up (II impf. 2 f. sg. subj.); 'that you bring up'
إِخْتِي: ikhtī — the print puts a kasra on the alif; the sense is ukhtī, 'my sister'; 'my sister'
لَامَرَارَادَهُ: lāmarārādahu — garbled in the print; probably لا مردّ لإرادته 'no turning back of his will'; read so
يَسْتُرُنَا: yasturunā — satara, to cover, shelter (impf. 3 m. sg.) + نَا (us); 'will cover us'
زَوَاجُكِ: zawāj + ki — zawāj, marriage (m., nom.) + 'your' (f.); 'your marriage'
يَدْرِيَ: yadriya — darā, to know, learn (impf. 3 m. sg. subj. after قَبْلَ أَنْ); 'learns'
صَارَيَأْخُذُ: ṣāra + yaʾkhudhu — ṣāra, to become, begin (perf.) + akhadha, to take (impf. 3 m. sg.); print runs them together; 'he began taking' (أَخَذَ بِخَاطِرِهَا, 'soothe her')
وَيُقَبِّلُ: وَ + يُقَبِّلُ — qabbala, to kiss (II impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and kissing'
تُسَمِّيهَا: tusammīhā — sammā, to name (II impf. 2 m. sg.) + her; 'you name her, call her'
قُضِىَ: quḍiya — qaḍā, to decree (I passive perf. 3 m. sg.; print ى); 'it was decreed'
لِلْحَاجِبِ: لِـ + الـ + حَاجِب — ḥājib, chamberlain (m., gen.); 'to the chamberlain' (li-, to: marks the one addressed — married to (an earlier night); complained to, after ashkā/shakā (Night 138))
وَنَقَلَهَا: وَ + نَقَلَ + هَا — naqala, to move, carry (perf. 3 m. sg.) + her; 'and moved her'
وَبِنْتَهَا: وَ + بِنْت + هَا — bint, daughter (f., acc.) + 'her'; 'and her daughter'
فَرَبَّوْهَا: فَ + رَبَّوْا + هَا — rabbā, to rear (II perf. 3 m. pl.) + her; 'and they reared her'
أَكْتَافِ: aktāf — katif pl., shoulders (f., gen. in iḍāfa); 'shoulders of'
وَوَاظَبُوا: وَ + وَاظَبُوا — wāẓaba, to persevere, keep at (III perf. 3 m. pl.; takes عَلَى); 'and they kept at'
بِالْأَشْرِبَهِ: بِـ + الـ + أَشْرِبَة — ashriba, pl. of sharāb, drinks, syrups (gen.); the print's ه for ة; 'with the drinks' (bi-, with, of the means)
وَأَنْوَاعِ: وَ + أَنْوَاع — anwāʿ, kinds (pl. of nawʿ, gen. in iḍāfa); 'and kinds of'
السُّفُوفِ: الـ + سُفُوف — sufūf, powders (pl. of saffūf, gen.); 'the powders'
بَرِيدٌ: barīd — courier, post-rider (m., nom., indef.); 'a courier'
وَقَرَأَهُ: وَ + قَرَأَ + هُ — qaraʾa, to read (perf. 3 m. sg.) + it; 'and read it'
الْعَزِيزُ: الـ + عَزِيز — ʿazīz, dear, mighty (m., nom. in apposition); 'the dear'
زَمَنِى: zamanī — zamina, to cling to; with the previous word 'wa-lā zamanī' = 'and (wakefulness) clung to me' (the print splits ولازمني, ending ى); 'clung to me'
وَقَدْأَرْ: وَ + قَدْ + أَرْ — the print splits وقد أرسلت as وقدار سلت; 'and indeed I sent' (first part)
سَلْتُ: salt(u) — second part of أَرْسَلْتُ, arsala, to send (IV perf. 1 sg.); 'I sent'
فَصْلَ: faṣla — faṣl, cutting off, separation (m., acc. adverbial; perhaps a slip for فَوْرَ/عِنْدَ); 'at the time of'
تُجَهِّزْ: tujahhiz — jahhaza, to prepare, fit out (II impf. 2 m. sg.; jussive used as imperative); 'prepare'
وَالْخَرَاجَ: وَ + الـ + خَرَاج — kharāj, tribute, land-tax (m., acc.); 'and the tribute'
وَتُرْسِلْ: وَ + تُرْسِلْ — arsala, to send (IV impf. 2 m. sg., jussive as imperative); 'and send'
وَتَزَوَّجْتَ: وَ + تَزَوَّجْتَ — tazawwaja, to marry (V perf. 2 m. sg.; takes بِـ); 'and you married'
أَرَاهَا: arāhā — raʾā, to see (impf. 1 sg. subj.) + her; 'that I see her'
جَاءَنَا: jāʾa + nā — jāʾa, to come (perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'to us'; 'came to us'
الصَّالِحَاتِ: الـ + صَالِحَات — ṣāliḥāt, pious women (f. pl. of ṣāliḥa, gen. after min); 'the righteous (women)'
وَصُحْبَتَهَا: وَ + صُحْبَة + هَا — ṣuḥba, company (f., acc. as adverb) + her; 'and in her company'
وَمَدٌّ: wa-madd — obscure word printed ومد; possibly corrupt or a dropped word; 'and (?)'
حَازُوا: ḥāzū — ḥāza, to gain, acquire (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they have gained'
وَفُنُونِ: وَ + فُنُون — funūn, arts (pl. of fann, gen. in iḍāfa); 'and the arts of'
مَعْرِفَتُهُ: maʿrifa + hu — maʿrifa, knowing (f., nom.) + 'his'; 'his knowing'
وَيَعْجِزُ: وَ + يَعْجِزُ — ʿajaza, to be unable (impf. 3 m. sg.; takes عَنْ); 'and is unable'
الْعَجُوزِوَ: الـ + عَجُوز + وَ — ʿajūz, old woman (gen.); the print runs the next وَ on; 'the old woman, and'
فَإِنَّهُنَّ: فَ + إِنَّ + هُنَّ — inna, indeed + them (f. pl.); 'for they'
حُزْنَ: ḥuzna — ḥāza, to gain (perf. 3 f. pl.); 'they have gained'
وَالْفَضِيلَةِ: وَ + الـ + فَضِيلَة — faḍīla, virtue (f., gen.); 'and the virtue'
رَأَيْتُهُنَّ: raʾaytuhunna — raʾā, to see (perf. 1 sg.) + them (f. pl.); 'I saw them'
أَحْبَبْتُهُنَّ: aḥbabtuhunna — aḥabba, to love (IV perf. 1 sg.) + them; 'I loved them'
يَكُنَّ: yakunna — kāna, to be (impf. 3 f. pl. subj.); 'that they be'
مِلْكِ: milk — milk, possession, ownership (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'possession of'
لِأَنَّهُنَّ: لِـ + أَنَّ + هُنَّ — li-, because + anna, that + them (f. pl.); 'because they'
فَسَأَلْتُ: فَ + سَأَلْتُ — saʾala, to ask (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I asked'
ثَمَنِهِنَّ: thaman + hinna — thaman, price (m., gen.) + 'their' (f. pl.); 'their price'
أَبِيعُهُنَّ: abīʿuhunna — bāʿa, to sell (impf. 1 sg.) + them; 'I sell them'
إِلَّابِخَرَاجِ: illā + bi + kharāj — 'except for the tribute of'; print runs it together (bi-, for, of price)
تُسَاوِى: tusāwī — sāwā, to be worth, equal (III impf. 3 f. sg.; print ى); 'is worth'
وَبَقِينَ: وَ + بَقِينَ — baqiya, to remain (perf. 3 f. pl.); 'and they remained'
حَوْزِي: ḥawz + ī — ḥawz, possession, keeping (m., gen.) + 'my'; 'my possession'
فَعَجِّلْ: فَ + عَجِّلْ — ʿajjala, to hasten (II imperative 2 m. sg.); 'so hasten'
بِالْخَرَاجِ: بِـ + الـ + خَرَاج — kharāj, tribute (gen.); 'with the tribute' (bi-, with, after عَجَّلَ 'send quickly')
تُنَاظِرَ: tunāẓira — nāẓara, to dispute, debate with (III subj. 3 f. sg.); 'that she debate'
غَلَبَتْهُنَّ: ghalabathunna — ghalaba, to overcome (perf. 3 f. sg.) + them; 'she overcomes them'
أَرْسَلْتُهَا: arsaltuhā — arsala, to send (IV perf. 1 sg.) + her; 'I shall send her' In the perfect sense, 'I sent her': allatī tazʿumu annī arsaltuhā ilayka, 'whom you claim I sent to you' (Night 190).
خَرَاجُ: kharāj — tribute (m., nom. in iḍāfa); 'tribute of'
بَ: ba — a fragment of the damaged final word الم—ب—اح, 'al-mubāḥ', the permitted
أَرْسَلْتَهَا: arsaltahā — you sent her (verb IV perf. 2ms + -hā, her); the letter's address, 'you send her' Also of a girl sent to someone: anta alladhī arsaltahā ilayya, 'you are the one who sent her to me'.
وَصَحِبْتَهَا: وَ + صَحِبْتَهَا — wa-, and + ṣaḥibtahā, you accompanied her / sent her along with (verb I perf. 2ms + -hā); 'and you accompany her (with)'
خَرَاجَ: kharāja — tribute, levy (m., acc., first term of an idafa, 'the tribute of…')
صِهْرِهِ: ṣihr + -hu — his son-in-law, relation by marriage (m., gen. after ʿalā; 'his son-in-law')
اشْتَاقَتْ: ishtāqat — she longed, yearned (verb VIII perf. 3fs; with ilā, 'longed for')
وَوَطَنِهَا: وَ + وَطَن + -hā — wa-, and + waṭan, homeland (m., gen.) + her; 'and her homeland'
أَرْسِلْنِي: arsilnī — send me (verb IV imper. 2ms + -nī, me)
لِأَحْكِيَ: لِـ + أَحْكِيَ — li-, so that, in order to (+ subjunctive) + aḥkiya, I tell, relate (verb I impf. 1s subj.); 'so that I tell'
وَأُخْبِرَهُ: وَ + أُخْبِرَهُ — wa-, and + ukhbirahu, I inform him (verb IV impf. 1s subj. + -hu; the subjunctive continues the purpose clause)
بِمَاوَقَعَ: بِـ + مَا + وَقَعَ — bi-, with (akhbara, here the imperative akhbirnī, takes bi-, 'inform of': bi- marks what is told) + mā, what + waqaʿa, it happened, befell (verb I perf. 3ms); the print runs mā and waqaʿa together; 'of what befell'
بَاعَنِي: bāʿa + -nī — he sold me (verb I perf. 3ms, hollow root b-y-ʿ; + me)
زَوَّجْتَنِي: zawwajtanī — you married me off (verb II perf. 2ms + -nī); 'you gave me in marriage'
عِتْقِي: ʿitq + -ī — my freeing, manumission (m., gen. after baʿda; 'after my freeing')
لِلْمَرَاضِعِ: لِـ + الـ + مَرَاضِع — li-, to, for (prep.; with sallama, 'hand over to') + marāḍiʿ, wet-nurses (broken pl. of murḍiʿ; f., gen.); 'to the wet-nurses'
وَالْخَدَمِ: وَ + الـ + خَدَم — wa-, and + khadam, servants, attendants (coll. pl.; gen.); 'and the servants'
تَجْهِيزِ: tajhīz — equipping, preparing (verbal noun of II jahhaza; m., gen. after fī; 'in the equipping of')
بِالسَّيْرِ: بِـ + الـ + سَيْر — bi-, with (amara bi-, 'command to do') + sayr, going, travelling (verbal noun; m., gen.); 'to travel, with the going'
وَالْخَرَاجِ: وَ + الـ + خَرَاج — wa-, and + kharāj, tribute (m., gen. after maʿa); 'and the tribute'
بَغْدَادَوَرَسَمَ: Baghdād + وَ + رَسَمَ — Baghdād, Baghdad (city; gen., diptote) + wa-, and + rasama, he appointed, ordered (verb I perf. 3ms); the print runs them together; 'Baghdad, and he appointed'
بِمَحَفَّةٍ: بِـ + مَحَفَّة — bi-, with (rasama lahu bi-, 'appoint for him a…') + maḥaffa, litter, sedan carried by a camel (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'a litter'
وَالْجَارِيَةِ: وَ + الـ + جَارِيَة — wa-, and + jāriya, slave-girl (f., gen.); the genitive is by loose parallel with the chamberlain's litter, 'and for the girl'
سِلْسِلَةٍ: silsila — chain (f., gen. with tanwīn after fī; 'a chain')
خَالِصِ: khāliṣ — pure, unalloyed (act. part. of I khalaṣa; gen., first term of an idafa, 'pure of gold')
الطَّارِمَةِ: الـ + طَارِمَة — al-, the + ṭārima, domed pavilion, porch or dome-chamber (f., gen.); 'the pavilion'
فَرَأَيَا: فَ + رَأَيَا — fa-, and so + raʾayā, the two saw (verb I perf. 3md); 'and they two saw'
وَبِغَالًا: وَ + بِغَال — wa-, and + bighāl, mules (broken pl. of baghl; m., acc. with tanwīn); 'and mules'
مُحَلْمَةً: muḥalma — as printed, probably a slip for مُحَمَّلَة muḥammala, loaded, laden (pass. part. II; f., acc. with tanwīn, qualifying the animals); 'loaded'
وَمَشَاعِلَ: وَ + مَشَاعِل — wa-, and + mashāʿil, torches (broken pl. of mashʿal; acc., diptote); 'and torches'
وَفَوَانِيسَ: وَ + فَوَانِيس — wa-, and + fawānīs, lanterns (broken pl. of fānūs; acc., diptote); 'and lanterns'
مُضِيئَةً: muḍīʾa — shining, giving light (act. part. IV of aḍāʾa; f., acc. with tanwīn); 'shining'
الْمَحَامِلِ: الـ + مَحَامِل — al-, the + maḥāmil, litters, palanquins (broken pl. of maḥmil; gen. after the idafa); 'the litters' Also 'ways of taking, interpretations' (from ḥamala ʿalā, 'to construe as'): ʿalā al-maḥāmili al-ḥasanati, 'in the best light'.
وَالْحِكْمَةَ: وَ + الـ + حِكْمَة — wa-, and + ḥikma, wisdom (f., acc.); 'and wisdom'
وَأَبَاهُ: وَ + أَبَا + -hu — wa-, and + abā, father (m., acc., long-vowel form of ab) + his; 'and his father'
وَوَطَنَهُ: وَ + وَطَن + -hu — wa-, and + waṭan, homeland (m., acc.) + his; 'and his homeland'
لِلْوَقَّادِمَا: لِـ + الـ + وَقَّاد + مَا — li-, to (qāla li-, 'said to') + waqqād, fire-tender, stoker (m., gen.) + mā, the first word of what he says ('not…'); the print runs them together; 'to the stoker: what…'
الْقَافِلَةِ: الـ + قَافِلَة — al-, the + qāfila, caravan (f., gen. after maʿa); 'the caravan'
آامَنُ: a-amanu — as printed with a madda: the question particle a- + amanu, shall I be safe, feel secure (verb I impf. 1s of amina); 'shall I feel safe?'
وَصُحْبَتَكَ: وَ + صُحْبَة + -ka — wa-, and + ṣuḥba, company, companionship (f., acc.) + your; 'and your company'
إى: printed for إِلَى ilā, to, as far as (prep.); the print drops the lam
مَقْصِدِكَ: maqṣid + -ka — your goal, destination (m., gen. after ilā) + your
حِمَارِهِ: ḥimār + -hu — his donkey (m., gen. after ʿalā) + his
وَتَأَهَّبَ: وَ + تَأَهَّبَ — wa-, and + taʾahhaba, he made himself ready (verb V perf. 3ms)
جَازَتْ: jāzat — she (it) passed (verb I perf. 3fs, hollow root j-w-z; with ʿalā, 'pass by'; fem. sing. for the plural loads)
الْأَحْمَالُ: الـ + أَحْمَال — al-, the + aḥmāl, loads, burdens (broken pl. of ḥiml; m., nom., subject); 'the loads'
هَجِينٍ: hajīn — a swift riding camel, dromedary (m., gen. with tanwīn after ʿalā); 'a dromedary'
وَالْمُشَاةُ: وَ + الـ + مُشَاة — wa-, and + mushāt, foot-travellers, those on foot (pl. of māshin; m., nom.)
حِمَارَ: ḥimāra — donkey (m., acc., first term of an idafa; 'the donkey of…')
لِلْوَقَّادِا: لِـ + الـ + وَقَّاد + ا — li-, to + waqqād, fire-tender (m., gen.) + the alif of the command ارْكَبْ, which the print runs onto the end of the noun
رْكَبْ: (i)rkab — ride! (verb I imper. 2ms); its initial alif is carried by the preceding word in the print
تَرْكَبَ: tarkaba — you ride (verb I impf. 2ms subj.); after lā budda an, 'you must'
أَتْعَبَ: atʿaba — I tire, grow weary (verb I impf. 1s subj. after an)
سَوْفَ: sawfa — the future particle (like sa-), 'you will…'
الْقَائِلَةِ: الـ + قَائِلَة — al-, the + qāʾila, midday rest, noon siesta (act. part. f. of qāla, to take a siesta; gen. in the idafa waqt al-qāʾila); 'the noon rest'
وَأَسْقَوْ: وَ + أَسْقَوْ — wa-, and + asqaw, they gave to drink, watered (verb IV perf. 3mp, whose final alif is not written in the print)
جِمَالَهُمْ: jimāl + -hum — their camels (broken pl. of jamal; m., acc.) + their
حَمَاةَ: Ḥamāt — Ḥamāh, the city in Syria on the Orontes (f., gen., diptote after madīna)
ثَلْثَةَ: thalthata — three (f. form with the alif dropped in the print, for ثلاثة), first term of an idafa with ayyām; m., acc.
تَنْطَفِي: تَنْطَفِي — tanṭafī, it goes out, is extinguished (form VII imperf. 3fs of طَفَأَ); 'will go out'
وَافْعَلْ: و + افْعَلْ — wa-, and + ifʿal, do! (imperative ms of فَعَلَ)
قَرِيبًا: قَرِيبًا — qarīban, near, soon (adv. acc.); 'soon'. Also with min, 'near to, nearly': qarīban min ʿishrīna sanatan, 'nearly twenty years'.
بِالتَّهَانِيْ: بِـ + الـ + تَهَانِي — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + tahānī, felicitations; 'with felicitations'
كَفِّ: كَفّ — kaff, palm, hand (f., gen.); 'the hand of'
فُؤَادُهَا: فُؤَاد + هَا — fuʾād, heart (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her heart'
اتَسَتَّرُ: أَتَسَتَّرُ — atasattaru, I conceal myself, hide (form V imperf. 1s of سَتَرَ)
رَمَانِيْْ: رَمَى + نِي — ramā, he shot, threw (perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he shot me'
ارْتَاحَ: ارْتَاحَ — irtāḥa, it was eased, rejoiced, stirred with relief (form VIII perf. 3ms of رَاحَ)
أَسْلُوا: أَسْلُوا — aslū, forget! (imperative mp of سَلَا); here 'forget your love'
مُضِئاً: مُضِيئًا — muḍīʾan, shining, bright (active participle of form IV, acc.); circumstantial after kāna al-qamar; printed without the hamza-seat
زَمَانِيْ: زَمَان + ـِي — zamān, time + 1s suffix; 'my time, my days'
التأنِّي: الـ + تَأَنِّي — al-, the + taʾannī, forbearance, waiting, delay (verbal noun of form V)
نَسِيمُ: نَسِيم — nasīm, breeze (m., nom.); first term of an idāfa, 'the breeze of …'
اسْلُوا: أَسْلُو — aslū, I forget (imperf. 1s of سَلَا), printed with a plural-style alif; read 'I forget'
بِحَبِيبٍ: بِـ + حَبِيب — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; here 'with a beloved' as the thing he was tried with) + ḥabīb, beloved (m., gen.); here: after taʿallaqa, bi- marks what one becomes attached to: taʿallaqta bi-ḥabībin, 'you have fallen for a beloved'
رَبِّيْ: رَبّ + ـِي — rabb, lord (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my Lord'
أَفْتُرُ: أَفْتُرُ — aftur, I slacken, cease (imperf. 1s of فَتَرَ); 'I will not slacken'
وَحُوى: و + حَوَى — wa-, and + ḥawā, it gathered, contained (perf. 3ms of حَوَى); the print points it ḥuwā
بِالتَّصَابِيْ: بِـ + الـ + تَصَابِي — bi-, in, of (prep.) + al-, the + taṣābī, youthful folly, amorous frolics (verbal noun of form VI); 'O time of youthful folly'
اَمَانٍ: أَمَان — amān, safety, security (m., gen. after maʿa)
احْشَرُ: أُحْشَرُ — uḥsharu, I am mustered, gathered (passive imperf. 1s of حَشَرَ); the gathering of the Day of Judgement
تَبْكِى: تَبْكِي — tabkī, she weeps (imperf. 3fs of بَكَى); 'she was weeping'
خَلِيلَيَ: خَلِيلَيَّ — khalīlayya, my two friends (dual, vocative, + 1s suffix); 'O my two friends'
الْوِصَالِ: الـ + وِصَال — al-, the + wiṣāl, union, meeting of lovers (gen., second term of an idāfa)
عَلَيْهِ،: عَلَى + هِ — ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 3ms suffix; 'upon him'; the print attaches an Arabic comma to the word
الَا: أَلَا — alā, ah, indeed, lo (particle drawing attention); where the print splits لَمْ يَزَالَا as يَزَ الَا, the second piece of yazālā, '(they did not) cease'
وَتَبَحْبَحَتْ: و + تَبَحْبَحَتْ — wa-, and + tabaḥbaḥat, she settled herself in comfort (quadriliteral form perf. 3fs); sense uncertain here
فَوَاللهِ: فَـ + وَ + اللهِ — fa-, so + wa-, by (oath particle) + Allāh (gen.); 'by God'
رَمَانِيْ: رَمَى + نِي — ramā, he/it shot (perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'has shot me'
الْبَرْقُ: الـ + بَرْق — al-, the + barq, lightning (m., nom.)
وَدَعَتِ: و + دَعَتِ — wa-, and + daʿat, she called (perf. 3fs of دَعَا) with the connecting kasra before al-; 'and she called'
فَشَجَانِيْْ: فَـ + شَجَا + نِي — fa-, and so + shajā, it grieved, distressed (perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and it grieved me'
جَسَدِيْ: جَسَد + ـِي — jasad, body (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my body'
حَاجَتُكِ: حَاجَة + كِ — ḥāja, need, business (f., nom.) + 2fs suffix; 'your need'
اَوْلَادِ: أَوْلَاد — awlād, children, sons (pl. of وَلَد); first term of an idāfa, 'sons of'
أَسْمَعْهُ: أَسْمَعْ + هُ — asmaʿ, I hear (jussive 1s of سَمِعَ, after lam) + 3ms object suffix; 'I did not hear him'
عَذُوْلِيْ: عَذُول + ـِي — ʿadhūl, blamer, reproacher (m.) + 1s suffix; 'O my blamer'
شَجَانِي: شَجَا + نِي — shajā, it grieved (perf. 3ms) + 1s object suffix; 'grieved me'; in the line, 'what grieved me' (mā shajānī)
حِيْنَ: حِين — ḥīna, time, when (acc., as a conjunction before a verb); 'when'
وَالسَّبْعُونَ: و + الـ + سَبْعُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-sabʿūn, seventy (nom. pl. numeral); 'and the seventy'
وَمِيضَ: وَمِيض — wamīḍ, flash, gleam (m., acc. vocative-annexed); 'O flash of …'
وَاصْبِرُ: و + أَصْبِرُ — wa-, and + aṣbiru, I am patient, I endure (imperf. 1s); 'and I endure'
حَكَّمَتْ: حَكَّمَتْ — ḥakkamat, she gave judgement, ruled (form II perf. 3fs)
الْحَسَرَاتُ: الـ + حَسَرَات — al-, the + ḥasarāt, regrets, pangs of grief (f. pl., nom.); subject of ishtaddat
وَبِكَأْسٍ: و + بِـ + كَأْس — wa-, and + bi-, with (prep.) + kaʾs, cup (f., gen.); 'and with a cup'
التَّدَانِيْ: الـ + تَدَانِي — al-, the + tadānī, nearness, drawing close (verbal noun of form VI); 'the days of nearness'
سُرُوْرٍ: سُرُور — surūr, joy, gladness (m., gen. after fī); 'in joy'
دَهَانِيْ: دَهَى + نِي — dahā, it befell, struck (perf. 3ms of دَهَى) + -nī, me; 'has struck me'
وَالْأَنِينَ: و + الـ + أَنِين — wa-, and + al-, the + anīn, groaning, moaning (m., acc.)
قَصِيرَةُ: قَصِيرَة — qaṣīra, short (f. sg., nom.); predicate of inna
تَلُمْنِيْ: تَلُمْ + نِي — talum, you blame (jussive 2ms of لَامَ, after lā) + -nī, me; 'do not blame me'
التفرُّقِ: الـ + تَفَرُّق — al-, the + tafarruq, parting, separation (verbal noun of form V, gen.)
مِنكُمْ: مِنْ + كُمْ — min, from (prep.) + 2mp suffix; 'from you'
ذَكَّرَنِيْ: ذَكَّرَ + نِي — dhakkara, he reminded (form II perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'it/he reminded me'
وَهَبَّ: و + هَبَّ — wa-, and + habba, he/it blew, stirred (verb, perf.); 'and there blew'
لِمِسْكِيْنٍ: لِـ + مِسْكِين — li-, for, to (prep.) + miskīn, poor wretch (m., gen.); 'for a poor man'
وَزَمَانٍ: و + زَمَان — wa-, and + zamān, time, fortune (m., gen.); 'and a time'
ضَنَىْ: ضَنَى — ḍanā, wasting, emaciation from illness or love (m.); object of tanẓurū
أَنْوَارَهُ: أَنْوَار + هُ — anwār, lights (pl. of نُور) + 3ms suffix; 'its lights', object of musbilan
بَلَانِيْ: بَلَا + نِي — balā, he tried, afflicted (perf. 3ms of بَلَا) + -nī, me; 'has tried me'
أَيَّامَ: أَيَّام — ayyām, days (pl. of يَوْم); first term of an idāfa (acc., after inna / layta)
خَيْمَةِ: خَيْمَة — khayma, tent (f., gen.); first term of an idāfa, 'the tent of …'
بِيَدِيْ: بِـ + يَدِي — bi-, by, with (prep.) + yadī, my hand (f.); 'by my hand'
قَلْبِيْ: قَلْب + ـِي — qalb, heart (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my heart'
مَرْعُوْبَ: مَرْعُوب — marʿūb, terrified (passive participle of رَعَبَ, acc.); first term of an idāfa, 'terrified of heart'
عُدْ: عُدْ — ʿud, return! (imperative ms of عَادَ)
بِالْحِمَى: بِـ + الـ + حِمَى — bi-, at, in (prep.) + al-, the + ḥimā, protected pasture, sanctuary (m.); 'at the sacred pasture'
سَقَانِيْ: سَقَى + نِي — saqā, he gave to drink (perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'gave me to drink'
تَنَمْ: تَنَمْ — tanam, she sleeps (jussive 3fs of نَامَ, after lam); 'she did not sleep'; here: 2ms jussive after lā of prohibition, lā tanam, 'do not sleep'
وَاشْتَدَّتْ: و + اشْتَدَّتْ — wa-, and + ishtaddat, it grew intense (form VIII perf. 3fs, from شَدَّ); 'and grew intense'
تَنْظُرُوا: تَنْظُرُوا — tanẓurū, you will see (jussive mp, as the answer to a command); 'and you will see'
وَاَرَانِيْ: و + أَرَى + نِي — wa-, and + arā, he showed (form IV perf. 3ms of رَأَى) + -nī, me; 'and it showed me'
اتْرُكْ: اتْرُكْ — utruk, leave! stop! (imperative ms of تَرَكَ)
نَأَتْ: نَأَتْ — naʾat, she went far, was distant (perf. 3fs of نَأَى)
اكْشِفُوا: اكْشِفُوا — ikshifū, uncover! lift away! (imperative mp of كَشَفَ)
سَاقِيًا: سَاقِيًا — sāqiyan, giving to drink, pouring (active participle of سَقَى, acc.); circumstantial
خَلِيْلِيْ: خَلِيل + ـِي — khalīl, close friend (m.) + 1s suffix; 'O my friend'
إِنْشَادِي: إِنْشَاد + ـِي — inshād, reciting (verbal noun of form IV) + 1s suffix; 'my reciting'
يُخْبِرُ: يُخْبِرُ — yukhbiru, he informs, tells (form IV imperf. 3ms); relative clause on rasūl, 'who informs'; also after rubbamā: rubbamā yukhbiru li-abī, 'he might tell my father' (Night 194)
سَاهِرَةً: سَاهِرَة — sāhira, wakeful, awake at night (active participle of سَهِرَ, f. acc.); predicate of kānat
التَّهَانِيْ: الـ + تَهَانِي — al-, the + tahānī, felicitations, congratulations (pl. of تَهْنِئَة); 'the cup of felicitations'
عِنْدِيْ: عِنْدَ + ـِي — ʿinda, at, with (prep.) + 1s suffix; 'with me'
اقُلْ: أَقُلْ — aqul, I say (jussive 1s of قَالَ, in the conditional's answer)
بِرَغْمِ: بِـ + رَغْم — bi-, in (prep.) + raghm, spite, despite (m., gen.); 'in spite of'
بِوَجْهِهِ: بِـ + وَجْه + هِ — bi-, with (prep.) + wajh, face (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'with his face'; here aʿraḍa bi-wajhihi ʿan, 'turned his face away from': bi- marks the part turned
دِيَارَ: دِيَار — diyār, abodes, lands (pl. of دَار), here in the name Diyār Bakr (acc., first term of an idāfa)
تَقصُرُ: تَقْصُرُ — taqṣuru, it is/becomes short (imperf. 3fs of قَصُرَ); 'were short'
فَقَلِقَتْ: فَـ + قَلِقَتْ — fa-, and so + qaliqat, she was restless, uneasy (perf. 3fs of قَلِقَ)
مُسْبِلًا: مُسْبِلًا — musbilan, letting down, shedding (active participle of form IV أَسْبَلَ, acc.); 'letting fall'
نَائِمُونَ: nāʾim — sleeping, asleep (m. pl., nom.; active participle of نَامَ); 'sleepers'
مُسْتَيْقِظًا: mustayqiẓ — awake (m., acc.; Form X participle of يَقِظَ-type root); 'awake' (circumstantial accusative)
فَفَتَّشَ: فَـ + فَتَّشَ — fa-, 'and so' + fattasha, he searched (Form II perf.)
وَاقِعًا: wāqiʿ — fallen, placed, standing (m., acc.; active participle of وَقَعَ); here 'standing over', as a state of the servant
الْوَقَّادُأَنَّ: الـ + وَقَّاد + أَنَّ — al-waqqād, the stoker (m., nom.) with the print's run-together أَنَّ, 'that'; 'the stoker — that'
إِنْشَادِ: inshād — reciting, chanting (m., gen.; verbal noun of Form IV أَنْشَدَ, after min); 'the reciting'
فَدُلَّنِي: فَـ + دُلَّ + نِي — fa-, 'then' + dulla, guide, show (imperative of دَلَّ) + -nī, me; 'then show me'
يَضُرُّهُ: yaḍurru + -hu — he harms (imperf. of ضَرَّ) + him; 'he will harm him'
أَزْعَجَنِي: azʿaja + -nī — he disturbed, alarmed (Form IV perf.) + me; 'disturbed me'
وَأَتْلَقَنِي: وَ + أَتْلَقَ + نِي — wa-, 'and' + atlaqa (as printed; probably a misprint for أَتْلَفَ atlafa, 'he ruined') + -nī, me
يُجَازِيهِ: yujāzī + -hi — he requites, repays (Form III imperf.) + him; 'will repay him'
وَأَجِي: وَ + أَجِي — wa-, 'and' + ajī, I come / bring (colloquial short form of أَجِيءُ, imperf. of جَاءَ)
الْمَحَفَّةِ: الـ + مَحَفَّة — al-maḥaffa, the litter, covered howdah carried on a camel (f., gen. after ʿalā bāb); 'of the litter'
آتِيَكَ: آتِيَ + كَ — ātiya, I come (atā, yaʾtī, verb I, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā) + -ka, you; with bi-, 'come to you with' = 'bring you'; here subjunctive after an, qabla an ātiyaka, 'before I came to you', with no bi-
فَخَلَاءَ: فَـ + خَلَاءَ — fa-, 'and so' + khalāʾa (as printed; apparently for خَلَّاهُ khallāhu, 'he left him')
فَهَيَّجَ: فَـ + هَيَّجَ — fa-, 'so' + hayyaja, he stirred up, excited (Form II perf.)
الْبَلَابِلَ: الـ + بَلَابِل — al-balābil, cares, worries (pl. of بَلْبَلَة; acc.); 'the cares'
وَالْأَشْجَانَ: وَ + الـ + أَشْجَان — wa-, 'and' + al-ashjān, griefs, sorrows (pl. of شَجَن; acc.); 'and the sorrows'
فَحَسَّنَ: فَـ + حَسَّنَ — fa-, 'so' + ḥassana, he made beautiful, improved (Form II perf.)
لِأُطْفِىَ: لِـ + أُطْفِىَ — li-, 'so that, in order to' (+ subjunctive) + uṭfiya, I quench, put out (Form IV subj.; final ى as printed); 'that I may quench'
بِأَخْذِي: بِـ + أَخْذِ + ي — bi-, 'by, through' + akhdh, taking (m., gen.; verbal noun of أَخَذَ) + my; 'by my taking'
أَتَانِى: أَتَى + نِي — atā, he came (perf.) + me; 'came to me' (final ى as printed)
مَغْشِيٌّ: maghshī — swooned, covered over (m., nom.; passive participle of غَشِيَ), as in مَغْشِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ 'fainted'
يَتَطَلَّعُ: yataṭallaʿu — he peers, looks closely (Form V imperf. of طَلَعَ)
فَسَأَلَنِي: فَـ + سَأَلَ + نِي — fa-, 'so' + saʾala, he asked + me; 'so he asked me'
يَمْنَعُنِي: yamnaʿu + -nī — he prevents (imperf. of مَنَعَ) + me; 'prevents me'
النَّشِيدِ: الـ + نَشِيد — al-nashīd, chant, recitation (m., gen. after min); 'the chant'
وَيَجْرِي: وَ + يَجْرِي — wa-, 'and' + yajrī, it runs, happens (imperf. of جَرَى); 'and what happens'
إِلَّاهَلَاكَ: إِلَّا + هَلَاكَ — illā, 'except' + halāk, destruction, perishing (m., acc.; verbal noun of هَلَكَ); the print runs the two together
وَتَجْتَمِعَ: وَ + تَجْتَمِعَ — wa-, 'and' + tajtamiʿa, you meet, gather (Form VIII subj., after ḥattā)
بِأَبِيكَ: بِـ + أَبِي + كَ — bi-, 'with' (tajtamiʿu bi-, 'to meet with') + abī, father (gen.) + your; 'with your father'
وَأُمِّكَ: وَ + أُمِّ + كَ — wa-, 'and' + umm, mother (gen.) + your; 'and your mother'
هَجَعُوا: hajaʿū — they lay down, slept (perf. of هَجَعَ)
لِيَسْتَرِيحُوا: لِـ + يَسْتَرِيحُوا — li-, 'in order to' (+ subjunctive) + yastarīḥū, they rest (Form X subj.); 'to rest'
وَمُحْتَاجُونَ: وَ + مُحْتَاجُونَ — wa-, 'and' + muḥtājūna, needing (m. pl., nom.; Form VIII participle of حَاجَ); 'and in need'
حَرَّكَتْهُ: ḥarrakat + -hu — she/it moved, stirred (Form II perf. f.) + him; 'stirred him'
الْأَشْجَانُ: الـ + أَشْجَان — al-ashjān, griefs, sorrows (pl. of شَجَن; nom.); 'the sorrows'
فَبَاحَ: فَـ + بَاحَ — fa-, 'and so' + bāḥa, he revealed, made public (perf. of بَاحَ)
بِالْكِتْمَانِ: بِـ + الـ + كِتْمَان — bi-, 'of' (bāḥa bi-, 'to reveal something') + al-, the + kitmān, concealment (m., gen.); 'the concealed (thing)'
وَحَيِّ: وَ + حَيِّ — wa-, 'and' + ḥayyi, greet (imperative of حَيَّا, Form II)
الدُّرُسَا: الـ + دُرُس — al-durus, effaced, worn away (pl. of دَارِس; acc.); 'the effaced ones'
وَنَادِهَا: وَ + نَادِ + هَا — wa-, 'and' + nādi, call (imperative of نَادَى) + her/them; 'and call to them'
فَعَسَاهَا: فَـ + عَسَى + هَا — fa-, 'so' + ʿasā, perhaps, it may be (verb of hope) + her/them; 'perhaps they'
تُجِيبْ: tujīb — she/they answer (Form IV imperf.; the print gives a sukūn for the subjunctive); 'answer'
اَجَنَّكَ: ajanna + -ka — it hid, covered (Form IV perf. of جَنَّ) + you; 'hides you' (as printed)
تَوَحُّشِهَا: tawaḥḥush + -hā — desolation, wildness (m., gen.; verbal noun of Form V) + its; 'of their desolation'
ظُلُمَاتِهَا: ẓulumāt + -hā — darknesses (f. pl., gen.) + their; 'in their darkness'
قَبَسَا: qabasā — firebrand, ember (m., acc.; print gives the alif without tanwīn); 'a firebrand'
عِذَارَبِهِ: ʿidār + بِهِ — cheek-down, the first beard on the cheek (m.) with the print's run-together بِهِ, 'of him / his'; 'his cheek-down' (obscure)
يَجْنِي: yajnī — he gathers, picks (imperf. of جَنَى), or 'commits'; the line is obscure
اَجْتَنِي: ajtanī — I gather, pluck (Form VIII imperf. of جَنَى); 'I gather'
لَعَسَا: laʿas — darkness of the lips, a dark-red lip colour (m.); 'dark-lip sweetness'
فَارَقْتُهَا: fāraqtu + -hā — I left, parted from (Form III perf.) + her; 'I left her' (the soul is subject in the line, النَّفْسُ)
مُكْرِهَةً: mukriha — compelled, unwilling (f., acc.; Form IV participle of كَرِهَ); 'unwilling, forced' (circumstantial accusative)
التَّاسِّي: al-tāssī — the consolation, comfort (Form VI verbal noun of أَسَا; as printed)
الْخُلْدِ: الـ + خُلْد — al-khuld, eternity (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of eternity'; al-khuld, 'the Everlasting', i.e. Paradise (gen. after fī)
خَادِمَةً: khādima — servant (f., acc.; active participle of خَدَمَ), here 'serving'; 'a servant'
وَالشَّمْلُ: وَ + الـ + شَمْل — wa-, 'and' + al-shaml, the union, company, gathering (m., nom.); 'and the company'
مُجْتَمِعٌ: mujtamiʿ — gathered, united (m., nom.; Form VIII participle of جَمَعَ); 'united'
اَبْهَجِ: abhaj — most joyous, loveliest (elative of بَهِيج; gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْوَطَنِ: الـ + وَطَن — al-waṭan, the homeland (m., gen.); 'of the homeland'
بِدَارًا: بِـ + دَارًا — bi-, 'for, by' (man lī bi-, 'who will give me …') + dārā, house, dwelling (f., as printed with tanwīn fatḥ)
حِبَّائِي: ḥibbāʾ + -ī — beloved ones, loved ones (pl. of حَبِيب) + my; 'my beloved ones'
صَيْحَاتٍ: ṣayḥāt — cries, shouts (f. pl., gen. after thalātha; pl. of صَيْحَة); 'cries'
وَغَطَّاهُ: وَ + غَطَّى + هُ — wa-, 'and' + ghaṭṭā, he covered (Form II perf.) + him; 'and covered him'
الْإِنْشَادَ: الـ + إِنْشَاد — al-inshād, the reciting (m., acc.; verbal noun of Form IV أَنْشَدَ); 'the recitation'
وَأَخَاهَا: وَ + أَخَا + هَا — wa-, 'and' + akhā, brother (acc., object of tadhakkarat) + her; 'and her brother'
الْمُتَضَمِّنَ: الـ + مُتَضَمِّن — al-mutaḍammin, containing, comprising (m., acc.; Form V participle of ضَمِنَ), agreeing with الإنشاد; 'the one containing'
لِذِكْرِ: لِـ + ذِكْر — li-, 'of, for' (mutaḍammin li-, 'containing') + dhikr, mention (m., gen.); 'of the mention of'
وَمَعَا: وَ + مَعَا — wa-, 'and' + maʿā, the first half of the word split in the print; read with the next as maʿāhid, 'haunts'
هِدِهِمَا: hidihimā — the second half of the split word معاهدهما, read maʿāhidihimā, 'their (two) haunts'; 'and their haunts'
تَأْتِنِي: taʾti + -nī — you bring (Form IV jussive of أَتَى, after in lam) + me; 'bring me'
لَأُنَبِّهَنَّ: لَـ + أُنَبِّهَنَّ — la-, 'surely' + unabbihanna, I will surely alert, wake, inform (Form II energetic of نَبَّهَ)
فَيَضْرِبَكَ: فَـ + يَضْرِبَ + كَ — fa-, 'and so' + yaḍriba, he beats (subj.) + you; 'and he beat you'
وَيَطْرُدَكَ: وَ + يَطْرُدَ + كَ — wa-, 'and' + yaṭruda, he drives away (subj.) + you; 'and drive you out'
تَضُرَّهُ: taḍurra + -hu — you harm (subj./jussive of ضَرَّ after lā) + him; 'do not harm him'
وَصَنْعَتَهُ: وَ + صَنْعَة + هُ — wa-, 'and' + ṣanʿa, craft, trade (f., acc.) + his; 'and his trade'
تَغِبْ: taghib — you are absent, delay (jussive of غَابَ, after lā); 'do not be absent'; here: 3fs jussive after lam, 'she was (not) absent'
نُزْهَةَالزَّمَانِ: nuzhata al-zamān — Nuzhat al-Zamān (name, 'delight of the age'; acc. after anna), printed run together; 'Nuzhat al-Zamān'
أَرْسَلَتِ: arsalat(i) — she sent (form IV of رَسَلَ; the final i is the helping vowel before al-); 'she sent'
يُفَتِّشُ: yufattishu — he searches (form II, ind.; circumstantial clause after the servant); 'searching'
إِيَّاكَ: iyyāka — beware (iyyā + -ka; with an + subjunctive, 'beware lest'); 'do not dare to'
وَتَقُولَ: wa- + taqūla — wa-, 'and' + you say (subj. of قَالَ after an); 'and say'
وَيَدُوسُ: wa- + yadūsu — wa-, 'and' + he treads (ind. of دَاسَ); 'and treads'
الْخِيَمِ: al- + khiyam — the tents (pl. of خَيْمَة; gen. after fī)
فَجَأَ: fajaʾa — printed for فَجَاءَ, 'he came' (perfect of جَاءَ with fa-); 'then he came'
مَكْشُوفَ: makshūf(a) — uncovered, bare (pass. part. of كَشَفَ; acc. in construct with al-raʾs); 'bare-' (of head)
مُقَدَّمَ: muqaddam(a) — foremost, chief, commander (pass. part. of form II قَدَّمَ, 'put in front'; in construct). In a vocative with al-qawm, 'O chief'; elsewhere 'the commander of' (e.g. muqaddama al-daylami, 'commander of the Daylam', acc. in apposition)
أَتْرُكُكَ: atrukuka — I leave you (ind. of تَرَكَ + -ka); 'I leave you'
تَدُلَّنِي: tadullanī — you guide me (subj. of دَلَّ after ḥattā + -nī); 'you show me'
عَابِرَ: ʿābir(a) — passing, crossing (act. part. of عَبَرَ; acc. in construct with sabīl); 'passer-'
خَطِيئَتِي: khaṭīʾatī — khaṭīʾa, fault, sin (f.) + my (gen. after fī); 'my fault'
وَاحْكِ: wa- + iḥki — wa-, 'and' + tell (imperative of حَكَى); 'and tell'
لِسَيِّدَتِي: li- + sayyidatī — li-, 'to' (marks the one told) + sayyida, mistress + my; 'to my mistress'
بِفَمِكَ: bi- + famika — bi-, 'with, by means of' + fam, mouth (gen.) + your; 'with your mouth'
مَارَأَيْتُ: mā raʾaytu — mā, 'not' + I saw (perfect of رَأَى + -tu), printed run together; 'I have not seen'
مُسْتَقِيظًا: mustaqīẓan — printed for مُسْتَيْقِظًا, awake (act. part. of form X, acc. as complement); 'awake'
وَرَأَيْتَنِي: wa- + raʾaytanī — wa-, 'and' + you saw me (perfect of رَأَى + -ta + -nī); 'and saw me'
يَنْفَكَّ: yanfakka — he is released, parts from (subj. of form VII اِنْفَكَّ after an); 'to leave'
أَمْسَكَتْهُ: amsakat-hu — it (f.) seized him (perfect of form IV أَمْسَكَ + -hu); 'seized him'
الْحُرَّاسُ: al- + ḥurrās — the guards (pl. of حَارِس; nom.); 'the guards'
تَسْمَعْ: tasmaʿ — you hear (jussive of سَمِعَ; the apodosis after the conditional wa-in ʿudta); 'you will hear'
فَتَرَكَهُ: fa- + taraka-hu — fa-, 'and so' + he left (perfect of تَرَكَ) + him; 'and left him'
دَوْرَةً: dawratan — a turn, a round (f., acc., cognate with dāra); 'a turn'
فَاسْتَتَرَ: fa- + istatara — fa-, 'and' + he hid himself (form VIII perfect of سَتَرَ); 'and hid'
سَيِّدَتِهِ: sayyidati-hi — sayyida, mistress + his (gen. after ilā); 'his mistress'
فَائِدَةٍ: fāʾidatin — profit, benefit (f., gen. after bi-lā); 'profit'
أُفَكِّرُ: ufakkiru — I think, ponder (form II, ind.); 'I think'
بِأَحَدٍ: bi- + aḥadin — bi-, 'about' (the verb ubālī takes bi-, 'care about') + aḥad, anyone (gen.); 'about anyone'
مُطَاوِعٌ: muṭāwiʿ — obeying, yielding to (act. part. of form III; nom., governs nafsaka and al-shayṭāna as objects); 'obeying'
وَالشَّيْطَانَ: wa- + al- + shayṭān — wa-, 'and' + the devil (acc., object of muṭāwiʿ); 'and the devil'
بَلَدَكَ: baladaka — balad, country (acc., object of tadkhula) + your; 'your country'
زَحْرَكَ: zaḥraka — printed zaḥr, evidently for zajr, rebuke + your (acc. object of turīdu); 'to rebuke you'
أَتْلَقْتَهَا: atlaqtahā — as printed; evidently for atlafta-hā, you wore her out (form IV of تَلِفَ + -ta + her); 'you have exhausted her'
وَكَأَنَّهَا: wa- + ka-annahā — wa-, 'and' + ka-anna, 'as though' + she; 'and as if she'
إِنَّةُ: innatu — printed for innahu, 'it is' (inna + -hu, the ة standing for ه); 'it is'
تَعَبِ: taʿab(i) — weariness, fatigue (gen. in construct after min); 'fatigue of'
وَبُعْدِ: wa- + buʿdi — wa-, 'and' + buʿd, distance (gen. in construct); 'and the distance of'
الْمَسَافَةِ: al- + masāfa — the distance, the road (f., gen.)
تُرْسِلُ: tursilu — she sends (form IV, ind. of أَرْسَلَ); 'she sends'
لَائِمْ: lāʾim — blamer, reproacher (act. part. of لَامَ; gen. after kulla, the final vowel dropped in pause for the metre); 'blamer'
مَلَامُهُ: malāmu-hu — malām, blame + his (nom., subject); 'his blame'
اَقْلَقَنِي: aqlaqanī — he/it unsettled me (form IV perfect of قَلِقَ + -nī); 'unsettled me'
يَعْذِلُنِي: yaʿdhilunī — he scolds me (ind. of عَذَلَ + -nī); 'scolds me'
دَرَى: darā — he knew (perfect of دَرَى); 'he knew'
بِاَنَّهُ: bi- + annahu — bi-, 'of' (after darā, 'know of') + anna, 'that' + he; 'that he'
حَرَّضَنِي: ḥarraḍanī — he urged me on, spurred me (form II perfect of حَرَضَ + -nī); 'spurred me on'
الْوُشَاةُ: al- + wushāt — the slanderers, talebearers (pl. of وَاشٍ; nom.); 'the slanderers'
سَلَا: salā — he has forgotten, got over (perfect of سَلَا); 'has forgotten'
قَالُوْا: qālū — they said (perfect of قَالَ + plural -ū); 'they said'
اَحْسَنَهُ: aḥsana-hu — how fair it is! (exclamatory af ʿala form of حَسُنَ + -hu); 'how fair it is'
اَعْشَقَنِي: aʿshaqanī — how ardent I am! (exclamatory form of عَشِقَ + -nī); 'how I long for it'
اَعَزَّهُ: aʿazza-hu — how dear it is! (exclamatory form of عَزَّ + -hu); 'how dear it is'
اَذَلَّنِي: adhallanī — how abased I am! (exclamatory form of ذَلَّ + -nī); 'how abased I am'
اَتْرُكَهُ: atruka-hu — I leave (subj. of تَرَكَ after an) + it; 'that I leave it'
جُرِعْتُ: juriʿtu — I was made to swallow (passive of form II جَرَّعَ, printed without shadda, + -tu); 'I were made to swallow'
كَاسَ: kāsa — cup (printed kās for ka's; acc. in construct with al-shajan); 'cup of'
اَطَعْتُ: aṭaʿtu — I obeyed (perfect of أَطَاعَ + -tu); 'I obeyed'
لَائِمًا: lāʾiman — blamer (act. part. of لَامَ; acc., object of aṭaʿtu); 'a blamer'
مُسْتَخْفٍ: mustakhfin — hiding, concealed (act. part. of form X of خَفِيَ, printed without the final ī; circumstantial); 'in hiding'
وَانْتَهَى: wa- + intahā — wa-, 'and' + he stopped, finished (form VIII perfect of نَهَى); 'and stopped'
الْكَلْبَةُ: الـ + كَلْبَة — al-kalba, the bitch (f., nom.); a coarse insult
تَطْلُبُنِي: taṭlubunī — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for (impf. 3fs) + ـنِي, me; 'who seeks me'
لَعَنَهَا: laʿanahā — laʿana, to curse (perf. 3ms) + ـهَا, her; 'cursed her'
شَتْمًا: shatman — shatm, abuse, cursing (m., acc. indef.); 'in abuse'
أَوْصَتْهُ: awṣathu — awṣā, to charge, instruct (perf. 3fs, form IV) + ـهُ, him
يُؤْذِيهِ: yuʾdhīhi — ādhā, to harm (impf. 3ms, form IV) + ـهِ, him; 'that he harm him'
بِمُرَادِهِ: بِـ + مُرَاد + ـهِ — bi-, by, of (prep.) + murād, wish, desire (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'by his own wish'
يَأْتِ: yaʾti — atā, to come (impf. 3ms, jussive after لَمْ); prints with a precomposed hamza
يُعْطِهِ: yuʿṭihi — aʿṭā, to give (impf. 3ms, jussive) + ـهِ, him; 'he gives him'
الْمِائَةَ: الـ + مِائَة — al-miʾa, the hundred (f., acc.)
يُلَيِّنُ: yulayyinu — layyana, to soften, make gentle (impf. 3ms, form II); 'softening'
وَاذْهَبْ: و + اذْهَبْ — wa-, and + idhhab, go (imper. 2ms)
أَخْطَأْ: akhṭaʾ — akhṭaʾa, to wrong, err (perf., form IV; the pronoun -nā is split off as the next word); prints with a precomposed final hamza
جُرْنَا: jurnā — jāra, to be unjust, oppress (perf. 1pl); 'we have oppressed'
فَالْقَصْدَأَنْ: فَـ + الـ + قَصْد + أَنْ — fa-, so, then + al-qaṣd, the aim (m.) + an, that (conj.); printed run together, 'the aim is that'
بِخُطُوَاتِكَ: بِـ + خُطُوَات + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep.) + khuṭuwāt, steps, strides (f. pl., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'with your steps'
وَتَرْجِعَ: و + تَرْجِعَ — wa-, and + tarjiʿa, you return (impf. 2ms, subjunctive)
وَسَلَامَةٍ: و + سَلَامَة — wa-, and + salāma, safety, well-being (f., gen. indef.)
بِشَارَةٌ: bishāra — bishāra, glad tidings, a gift given for good news (f., nom. indef.)
وَتَخَطَّا: و + تَخَطَّا — wa-, and + takhaṭṭā, to step over, pass beyond (perf. 3ms, form V); the following هم is printed as a separate word
وَنَاظِرٌ: و + نَاظِر — wa-, and + nāẓir, looking, watching (act. part., m., nom. indef.)
يَشْنُقُونَهُ: yashnuqūnahu — shanaqa, to hang (impf. 3mpl) + ـهُ, him; 'they hang him'
شِيًا: shiyan — second half of the printed split ما شيا, māshiyan, walking (act. part. of mashā, acc. indef.)
لَايَرَوْنَهُ: لَا + يَرَوْنَ + ـهُ — lā, not + yarawna, they see (impf. 3mpl) + him; printed as one word
أَخَسَّهُ: akhassahu — mā akhassahu, how base, how vile is he (exclamatory afʿala form of khasīs) + ـهُ; 'how low he is'
أَنْشِدِ: anshidi — anshada, to recite (verse) (imper. 2ms, form IV); the kasra is a linking vowel before الْأَشْعَارَ
فَابَّهُ: فَابَّهُ — printed فابه, evidently a misprint for فَإِنَّهُ (fa-innahu, 'for he'); pointed as printed
تَطْلُبِينَهُ: taṭlubīnahu — ṭalaba, to seek (impf. 2fs) + ـهُ, him; 'whom you seek'
أَسْمَعَهُ: asmaʿahu — samiʿa, to hear (impf. 1s, subjunctive after حَتَّى) + ـهُ, him; 'until I hear him'
قُرْبٍ: qurb — qurb, nearness (m., gen. indef.); 'from near'
فَأَسْأَ: fa-asʾa — first half of the printed split فاسا له, fa-asʾalahu; فَـ, and (so) + asʾalu, I ask (impf. 1s) + له, him
حَاضِرَةٌ: ḥāḍira — ḥāḍir, present (act. part., f., nom. indef.)
تَسْمَعُكَ: tasmaʿuka — samiʿa, to hear, listen to (impf. 3fs) + ـكَ, you; 'listening to you'
أَسْأَلُكَ: asʾaluka — saʾala, to ask (impf. 1s) + ـكَ, you; 'I ask you'
اسْمِكَ: ism + ـكَ — ism, name (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your name'
وَبَلَدِكَ: و + بَلَد + ـكَ — wa-, and + balad, country, land (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your country'
وَحَالِكَ: و + حَال + ـكَ — wa-, and + ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your state'
سَأَلْتَنِي: saʾaltanī — saʾala, to ask (perf. 2ms) + ـنِي, me; 'you ask me'
مَحَا: maḥā — maḥā, to be effaced, wiped out (perf. 3ms); read as passive in sense, 'it has been effaced'
وَرَسْمِي: و + رَسْم + ـي — wa-, and + rasm, trace, outline, mark (m.) + 1s suffix; 'and my trace'
فَنَى: fanā — fanā, to perish, pass away (perf. 3ms)
وَجِسْمِي: و + جِسْم + ـي — wa-, and + jism, body (m.) + 1s suffix; 'and my body'
بَلِيَ: baliya — baliya, to wear out, decay (perf. 3ms)
مَنْزِلَةِ: manzila — manzila, station, position, state (f., gen.); fī manzilat, 'in the position of'
السَّكْرَانِ: الـ + سَكْرَان — al-sakrān, the drunk, the drunkard (m., gen.)
تَبَخَّلَ: tabakhkhala — tabakhkhala, to affect stinginess, hold back (perf. 3ms, form V); uncertain, read 'was niggardly'
وْصَابُ: second half of the printed split الا وصاب, al-awṣāb — waṣab (pl. awṣāb), ailment, sickness (m., nom.)
وَتَاهَ: و + تَاهَ — wa-, and + tāha, to go astray, be lost (perf. 3ms)
وَاحْتَارَ: و + احْتَارَ — wa-, and + iḥtāra, to be bewildered (perf. 3ms, form VIII)
وَغَرِقَ: و + غَرِقَ — wa-, and + ghariqa, to drown, be sunk (perf. 3ms)
فْكَارِ: second half of the printed split الا فكار, al-afkār — fikr (pl. afkār), thought, care (m., gen.)
نِينِ: second half of the printed split والا نين, wa-al-anīn — anīn, groaning (m., gen.)
فَارَقْتَ: fāraqta — fāraqa, to part from (perf. 2ms, form III); 'have you parted from'
وَأَبِيكَ: و + أَبِي + ـكَ — wa-, and + abī, father (m., gen.; long-form construct) + 2ms suffix; 'and your father'
أَمَرَتْهُ: amarathu — amara, to command (perf. 3fs) + ـهُ, him; 'she commanded him'
وَأَعَزُّهُمْ: و + أَعَزُّ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + aʿazz, dearest (elative, m., nom.) + 3mpl suffix; 'and the dearest of them'
أُخْتَى: ukhtī — ukht, sister (f.) + 1s suffix; printed with a dotless ى, اختى; 'my sister'
شَمْلَهُ: shamlahu — shaml, union, gathering, company (m., acc.) + ـهُ, his; 'his union'
اِسْمَعْنِي: اِسْمَعْ + نِي — samiʿa, hear (imper. IV-type: “make hear”, m. sg.) + me; 'let me hear' (here: tell me)
مُفَارَقَتِكَ: مُفَارَقَة + كَ — mufāraqa, parting, separation (f., gen. after min) + your (m.); 'your parting'
لِأَهْلِكَ: لِـ + أَهْل + كَ — ahl, family, people (gen. after li-, 'of, from' the family) + your (m.); 'from your family'
وَوَطَنِكَ: وَ + وَطَن + كَ — waṭan, homeland (m., gen., second term of the same preposition) + your (m.); 'and your homeland'
سَيِّدَتُهُ: سَيِّدَة + هُ — sayyida, mistress, lady (f., nom.) + his; 'his mistress'
فَصَعَّدَ: فَـ + صَعَّدَ — ṣaʿʿada, he sent up, heaved (II); 'and he heaved up'
الزَّفَرَاتِ: الـ + زَفَرَات — zafarāt, sighs, groans (f. pl., acc.); 'the sighs'
وَهَوَاهَا: وَ + هَوَى + هَا — hawā, love, passion (m.; oath particle wa- 'by') + her; 'by her love'
وَجْدِ: وَجْد — wajd, passion, grief (m., gen. after dhī); 'passion'
لَاُكْرِمُ: لَـ + أُكْرِمُ — la- (emphatic, answering the oath) + akrama, honor (IV impf. 1st sg.); 'I will honor'
دَاراً: دَار — dār, dwelling, house (f., acc. tanwīn); 'a dwelling'
اَحَلَّتْ: أَحَلَّتْ — aḥalla, she made halt, alighted (IV perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she has alighted'
هِنْدُ: هِنْد — Hind, a woman's name (f., nom.); 'Hind', the beloved
هَوًى: هَوًى — hawan, love, passion (m., nom. tanwīn); 'a love'
مُمَسَّكُ: مُمَسَّك — mumassak, musked, scented with musk (m. pass. part. II, nom.); 'musked'
عَنْبَرِ: عَنْبَر — ʿanbar, ambergris (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of ambergris'
بِسَاحَتِهِ: بِـ + سَاحَة + هِ — bi-, in (prep.) + sāḥa, courtyard (f., gen.) + its; 'in its courtyard'
سَلَامٌ: سَلَام — salām, peace (m., nom. tanwīn, the greeting); 'peace'
مَحْبُوبَةٍ: مَحْبُوبَة — maḥbūba, beloved (f. pass. part., gen.); 'a beloved woman'
بِرِبَا: بِـ + رِبَا — bi-, on, at (prep.) + ribā (pl. of rabwa), hills, rises (gen.); 'on the hills of'
الْحِمَى: الـ + حِمَى — ḥimā, protected pasture, preserve (m.); 'the protected ground'
عَزِيزَةِ: عَزِيزَة — ʿazīza, dear, precious one (f., gen. in apposition; first term of an iḍāfa); 'dear one of'
الْعَشِيَّةِ: الـ + عَشِيَّة — ʿashiyya, evening (f., gen.); 'the evening'
مَنْزِلُ: مَنْزِل — manzil, halting-place, abode (m., nom.); 'a halting-place'
اَرِيحَا: أَرِيحَا — arīḥā, rest! (IV imper. dual); 'rest, you two'
الْبَانُ: الـ + بَان — bān, the ban-tree (moringa, a slender tree praised in verse) (m., nom.); 'the ban-tree'
وَالْعَلَمُ: وَ + الـ + عَلَم — ʿalam, landmark, sign-post, mountain (m., nom.); 'and the landmark'
الْفَرْدُ: الـ + فَرْد — fard, single, solitary (m., nom., adj.); 'the lone'
نَسَاً: نَسَأ — nasaʾ, postponing, delay (m., in the print pointed with tanwīn fatḥ); obscure here, 'no putting off'
حَلِيفُ: حَلِيف — ḥalīf, ally, confederate (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'ally of'
يُسْتَطَاعُ: يُسْتَطَاعُ — istaṭāʿa, be able (X, impf. 3 m. sg. passive); 'is (not) able to be done'
سَقَى: سَقَى — saqā, he gave to drink, watered (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'may (God) water' (optative)
سَحَائِباً: سَحَائِب — saḥāʾib, clouds (pl. of saḥāba, acc. tanwīn); 'clouds'
مِسَحَّاً: مِسَحّ — misaḥḥ, pouring heavily (of rain/cloud) (acc. tanwīn, adj.); 'pouring'
يَنْفَكُّ: يَنْفَكُّ — infakka, cease, let go (VII impf. 3 m. sg.); 'ceases'
مَتْنِهَا: مَتْن + هَا — matn, back, upper part (m., gen. after ʿan) + its (f.); 'its back'
وَسَمِعَتْهُ: وَ + سَمِعَتْ + هُ — samiʿa, hear (perf. 3 f. sg.) + him; 'and she heard him'
بَصَرُهَا: بَصَر + هَا — baṣar, sight, eyes (m., nom.) + her; 'her sight'
فَأَلْقَتْ: فَـ + أَلْقَتْ — alqā, throw, cast (IV perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she threw'
فَتَلَقَّاهَا: فَـ + تَلَقَّى + هَا — talaqqā, meet, receive (V perf. 3 m. sg.) + her; 'and he received her'
رَأَ: رَأَ — raʾā, see (perf. 3 m. sg.); the print leaves off the final alif-maqṣūra; 'he saw'

أَفَاقَا: أَفَاقَا — afāqa, recover consciousness, revive (IV perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two revived'
غَشْيَتِهِمَا: غَشْيَة + هِمَا — ghashya, swoon, fainting-fit (f., gen. after min) + their (dual); 'their swoon'
وَالتَّرَحُ: وَ + الـ + تَرَح — taraḥ, sorrow, grief (m., nom.); 'and the sorrow'
وَتَوَالَتْ: وَ + تَوَالَتْ — tawālā, follow one upon another (VI perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and they followed in succession'
الْمَسَرَّاتُ: الـ + مَسَرَّات — masarrāt, joys, delights (f. pl., nom.); 'the delights'
اَقْسَمَ: أَقْسَمَ — aqsama, swear (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he swore'
يَزَالُ: يَزَالُ — zāla, cease; with lā yazālu 'he does not cease to' (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'does not cease'
مُكَدِّرِي: مُكَدِّر + ي — mukaddir, troubler, one who clouds (II act. part., nom.) + my; 'troubler of me'
حَنَثَتْ: حَنَثَتْ — ḥanitha, break an oath (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'was broken'
يَمِينُكَ: يَمِين + كَ — yamīn, oath (f., nom.) + your (m.); 'your oath'
فَكَفِّرِي: فَـ + كَفِّرِي — kaffara, atone, make amends (II imper. f. sg.; the poet addresses Time as 'you'); 'so make amends'
اَلسَّعْدُ: اَلـ + سَّعْد — saʿd, good fortune, happiness (m., nom.); 'good fortune'
وَافَى: وَافَى — wāfā, come, arrive (III perf. 3 m. sg.); 'has come'
وَالْحَبِيبُ: وَ + الـ + حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved (m., nom.); 'and the beloved'
مُسَاعِدِي: مُسَاعِد + ي — musāʿid, helper (III act. part., nom.) + my; 'my helper'
فَانْهَضْ: فَـ + انْهَضْ — nahaḍa, rise (VII imper. m. sg.); 'so rise'
السُّرُورِ: الـ + سُّرُور — surūr, joy (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of joy'
وَشَمِّرِي: وَ + شَمِّرِي — shammara, gird oneself, tuck up (II imper. f. sg.); 'and gird yourself'
اَعْتَقِدُ: أَعْتَقِدُ — iʿtaqada, believe, hold (VIII impf. 1st sg.); 'I hold'
السَّوَالِفَ: الـ + سَّوَالِف — sawālif, bygone times; also the side-locks of the hair or sides of the neck (pl., acc.); 'the bygone days'
ظَفِرْتُ: ظَفِرْتُ — ẓafira, win, obtain (perf. 1st sg.); 'I won'
اللَّمَى: الـ + لَّمَى — lamā, dusk of the lips, the dark shade of beautiful lips (m.); 'the dusk of the lips'
بِالْكَوْثَرِ: بِـ + الـ + كَوْثَر — bi-, with, (obtaining) (prep.) + kawthar, the Kawthar, the river of Paradise; 'the Kawthar'
ضَمَّ: ضَمَّ — ḍamma, press, clasp (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he pressed'
لِفَرْطِ: لِـ + فَرْط — li-, from, because of (prep., cause) + farṭ, excess (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'from the excess of'
سُرُورِهِ: سُرُور + هِ — surūr, joy (m., gen.) + his; 'his joy'
أَجْفَانِهِ: أَجْفَان + هِ — ajfān, eyelids (pl. of jafn, gen. after min) + his; 'his eyelids'
الْعَبَرَاتُ: الـ + عَبَرَات — ʿabarāt, tears (f. pl., nom.); 'the tears'
كِلَانَا: كِلَا + نَا — kilā, both (m., nom.) + our; 'both of us'
انَّهَا: أَنَّ + هَا — anna, that (particle, with the exception ghayra anna) + she (f.); 'that she'

اَحْيَانًا: أَحْيَانًا — aḥyān, times, occasions (pl. of ḥīn, acc. tanwīn); 'at times'
تَجَلُّدُ: تَجَلُّد — tajalluḍ, fortitude, constancy (V verbal noun, nom.); 'fortitude'
وَعِيدَ: وَعِيد — waʿīd, threat (m., acc., object of takhāfu); 'the threat of'
الْكَاشِحِينَ: الـ + كَاشِحِين — kāshiḥ, one who bears hidden enmity, backbiter (act. part., m. pl., gen.); 'the slanderers'
انْهَى: أُنْهَى — nahā, forbid (pass. impf. 1st sg.); the print gives only the consonants and pointing as 'unhā'; 'I am forbidden'
وَاُوعِدُ: وَ + أُوعَدُ — waʿada, threaten (IV pass. impf. 1st sg.); 'and I am threatened'
فَدَخَلَا: فَـ + دَخَلَا — dakhala, enter (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two entered'
ضَوْءُالْمَكَانِ: ضَوْء الْمَكَان — Ḍawʾ al-Makān, 'Light of the Place', the prince's name; the print joins the two words (nom.)
وَبَاعَهَا: وَ + بَاعَ + هَا — bāʿa, sell (perf. 3 m. sg.) + her; 'and he sold her'
وَمِثْلَ: وَ + مِثْل — mithl, like, the likeness of (m., acc.; here with mā, 'just as'); 'and just as'
وَالِدِنَا: وَالِد + نَا — wālid, father (m., gen.) + our; 'our father'
يُوصِلَنِي: يُوصِلَ + نِي — awṣala, bring, deliver (IV subj. 3 m. sg.) + me; 'that he bring me'
ذَهَابِي: ذَهَاب + ي — dhahāb, going, departure (verbal noun, gen. after baʿda) + my; 'my going'
بِالْوَقَّادِ: بِـ + الـ + وَقَّاد — bi-, with (prep., after manna 'show favor') + waqqād, stoker, fire-tender (m.); 'with the stoker'
أَحَدٍ: أَحَد — aḥad, anyone, someone (m., gen. tanwīn); 'anyone'
الْوَالِدُ: الـ + وَالِد — wālid, father (m., nom.); 'the father'
يَجُوعُ: يَجُوعُ — jāʿa, be hungry (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'goes hungry'
وَيُطْعِمُنِي: وَ + يُطْعِمُ + نِي — aṭʿama, feed (IV impf. 3 m. sg.) + me; 'and feeds me'
وَيَمْشِي: وَ + يَمْشِي — mashā, walk (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and walks'
وَيُرْكِبُنِي: وَ + يُرْكِبُ + نِي — arkaba, make ride, set on a mount (IV impf. 3 m. sg.) + me; 'and sets me riding'
حَيَاتِي: حَيَاة + ي — ḥayāt, life (f., nom.) + my; 'my life'
نُزْهَةُالزَّمَانِ: نُزْهَة الزَّمَان — Nuzhat al-Zamān, 'Delight of the Age', the princess's name; the print joins the two words (nom.)
نُكَافِئُهُ: نُكَافِئُ + هُ — kāfaʾa, repay, reward (III impf. 1st pl.) + him; 'we shall repay him'
نَقْدِرُ: نَقْدِرُ — qadara, be able (impf. 1st pl.); 'we are able'
ضَوْءِالْمَكَانِ: ضَوْء الْمَكَان — Ḍawʾ al-Makān, 'Light of the Place' (gen.); the print joins the two words
بِشَارَتَكَ: بِشَارَة + كَ — bishāra, good news; the reward given for it (f., acc.) + your (m.); 'your good-news reward'
فَالْكِيسُ: فَـ + الـ + كِيس — kīs, purse, bag (m., nom.); 'so the purse'
بِسَيِّدِكَ: بِـ + سَيِّد + كَ — bi-, with (prep., after ʾti 'bring') + sayyid, master (m., gen.) + your (m.); 'with your master'
وَدَعَاهُ: وَ + دَعَا + هُ — daʿā, call, summon (perf. 3 m. sg.) + him; 'and he called him'; here: subject a thing (what came into his mind), with ʿalā for Classical ilā: daʿāhu ʿalā al-safari, 'and (which) drove him to travel'
نُزْهَةِالزَّمَانِ: نُزْهَة الزَّمَان — Nuzhat al-Zamān (gen., in apposition after zawjatihi); the print joins the two words
مَاوَقَعَ: مَا + وَقَعَ — mā, what (rel.) + waqaʿa, happen, fall (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'what happened'; the print joins the two words
مَاقَالَتْهُ: مَا + قَالَتْ + هُ — mā, what (rel.) + qāla, say (perf. 3 f. sg.) + it; 'what she had said'; the print joins the words
الصَّرِيحُ: الـ + صَّرِيح — ṣarīḥ, pure, plain, undoubted (m., nom., adj.); 'the plain'
وَتَيَقَّنَ: وَ + تَيَقَّنَ — tayaqqana, be certain (V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he was certain'
مَصِيرِي: مَصِير + ي — maṣīr, end, destiny (m., nom.) + my; 'my destination'

قُطْرٍ: قُطْر — quṭr, region, province (m., gen. tanwīn); 'a region'
أَقْبَلَ: أَقْبَلَ — aqbala, turn toward, approach (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he turned to'
وَهَنَّأَهُ: وَ + هَنَّأَ + هُ — hannaʾa, congratulate (II perf. 3 m. sg.) + him; 'and he congratulated him'
بِسَلَامَتِهِ: بِـ + سَلَامَة + هِ — bi-, on, for (prep., after congratulating) + salāma, safety (f.) + his; 'on his safety'
وَجَمْعِ: وَ + جَمْع — jamʿ, gathering, bringing together (verbal noun, gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and the gathering of'
شَمْلِهِ: شَمْل + هِ — shaml, union, (family) togetherness (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + his; 'his union'
خَدَمَهُ: خَدَم + هُ — khadam, servants (coll. pl., acc.) + his; 'his servants'
يُهَيِّئُوا: يُهَيِّئُوا — hayyaʾa, make ready (II subj. 3 m. pl.); 'that they prepare'
خَيْمَةً: خَيْمَة — khayma, tent (f., acc. tanwīn); 'a tent'
وَمَرْكُوبًا: وَ + مَرْكُوب — markūb, mount, ridden animal (m., acc. tanwīn); 'and a mount'
أَخْتَلِي: أَخْتَلِي — ikhtalā, be alone with, withdraw (VIII impf. 1st sg.); 'I will be alone'
وَنَسْتَرِيحُ: وَ + نَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa, rest (X impf. 1st pl.); 'and we rest'
بَعْضِنَا: بَعْض + نَا — baʿḍ, some, one another (m., gen.) + our; 'one another' (with maʿa/min)
وَنَشْبَعُ: وَ + نَشْبَعُ — shabiʿa, be sated (impf. 1st pl.); 'and we are sated'
مُفْتَرِقَانِ: مُفْتَرِقَانِ — muftariq, parted, separated (VIII act. part., m. dual, nom.); 'two parted ones'
الْأَمْرُكَمَا: الـ + أَمْر + كَمَا — amr, matter (m., nom.) + ka-mā, as (ka-, like + mā, what); 'the matter is as'; the print joins the words
تُرِيدَانِ: تُرِيدَانِ — arāda, wish (IV impf. 2nd dual); 'you two wish'
وَأَنْوَاعَ: وَ + أَنْوَاع — anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of nawʿ, acc.); 'and kinds of'

وَيُهَيِّءَ: وَ + يُهَيِّءَ — hayyaʾa, make ready (II subj. 3 m. sg.); 'and prepare'
حِصَانًا: حِصَان — ḥiṣān, stallion, horse (m., acc. tanwīn); 'a horse'
وَيُرَتِّبَ: وَ + يُرَتِّبَ — rattaba, arrange, set in order (II subj. 3 m. sg.); 'and arrange'
الْغَدَاةِ: الـ + غَدَاة — ghadāt, morning (f., gen.); 'the morning'
