لَايُفَارِقُنَا: لَا + يُفَارِقُ + نَا — lā, not + fāraqa, leave, part from (III impf. 3 m. sg.) + us; 'he does not leave us'; the print joins the words
يَفْعَلَ: يَفْعَلَ — faʿala, do (subj. 3 m. sg.); 'that he do'
يَشُدُّ: يَشُدُّ — shadda, tighten, bind (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'tightens'
حِمَارَهُ: حِمَار + هُ — ḥimār, donkey (m., acc.) + his; 'his donkey'
وَيُرِيدُأَنْ: وَ + يُرِيدُ + أَنْ — arāda, want (IV impf. 3 m. sg.) + an, that (subj. particle); 'and wants to'; the print joins yurīdu an
يَهْرُبَ: يَهْرُبَ — haraba, flee (subj. 3 m. sg.); 'to flee'
حُزْنِهِ: حُزْن + هِ — ḥuzn, grief (m., gen. after min) + his; 'his grief'
نَصَحْتُهُ: نَصَحْتُ + هُ — naṣaḥa, advise (perf. 1st sg.) + him; 'I advised him'
يَاتَرَى: يَا + تَرَى — yā tarā, 'I wonder' (colloquial, lit. 'O you see'); the print joins the words

وَرَأَى: وَ + رَأَى — raʾā, see (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he saw'

سِرّاً: سِرّاً — sirran, secretly (adv. acc. of سِرّ, secret); 'in secret'
أَكْرِمُوهُ: أَكْرِمُوا + هُ — akrama, honour (IV imp. m. pl.) + him; 'honour him'

يَقْرُبُ: يَقْرُبُ — qaruba, be near, be kin (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'is near'
وَقَّادٌ: وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker (one who kindles fires; intens.); 'a stoker'
وَوَجَدْتُهُ: وَ + وَجَدْتُ + هُ — wajada, find (perf. 1 sg.) + him; 'and I found him'

وَيَحْسِبُ: وَ + يَحْسِبُ — ḥasaba, reckon, calculate (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and reckons'
يُعَرِّفْهُ: يُعَرِّفْ + هُ — ʿarrafa, let know, inform (II impf. jussive 3 m. sg.) + him; 'inform him' (after لَمْ)
قَلَقْتَ: قَلَقْتَ — qalaqa, be anxious (perf. 2 m. sg.); read as أَقْلَقْتَ 'you have troubled'; the print drops the alif and runs قد into it
تَنَا: تَنَا — the second half of سَيِّدَتَنَا 'our lady', which the print splits
نِشَادِ: نِشَاد — (i)nshād, reciting; the print drops the alif of إِنْشَاد; 'reciting'
الصَّبِيَّى: الـ + صَبِيّ — ṣabiyy, boy, lad; 'the boy'; the print adds a stray ى
فَيَأْكُلُ: فَـ + يَأْكُلُ — akala, eat (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and eats'
آنِيَةٍ: آنِيَة — āniya, vessel, dish (f.; pl. of إِنَاء); 'a vessel'
يَأْتُوا: يَأْتُوا — atā, come, bring (impf. subj. m. pl.); 'bring', with بِـ 'with'
وَيُعْطِيهَا: وَ + يُعْطِي + هَا — aʿṭā, give (IV impf. 3 m. sg.) + her/it; 'and gives it'
لِلْوَقَّادِ: لِـ + الـ + وَقَّاد — waqqād, stoker; li-, to (prep.), marks the recipient; 'to the stoker'
تَنْشَفْ: تَنْشَفْ — nashifa, dry up (impf. jussive 3 f. sg.); 'dry' (after لَمْ)
دَمْعَةٌ: دَمْعَة — damʿa, a tear (n. unit.); 'a tear'
غُرْبَتِهِمَا: غُرْبَة + هِمَا — ghurba, exile, being away from home; 'their (two) exile'
سَائِرَانِ: سَائِرَانِ — sāra, travel (act. part. m. dual nom.); 'travelling' (the two)
يُلَاحِظُ: يُلَاحِظُ — lāḥaẓa, observe, keep an eye on (III impf. 3 m. sg.); 'watches'
وَشَكْوَى: وَ + شَكْوَى — shakwā, complaint, lament (f.); 'and lament'
ثَلَثَةُ: ثَلَثَةُ — thalātha, three (m., construct, nom.); the print spells ثلثة for ثلاثة
وَاسْتَرَا: وَ + اسْتَرَا — the first half of وَاسْتَرَاحُوا, istarāḥa, rest (X perf. 3 m. pl.), which the print splits; 'and rested'
حُوا: حُوا — the second half of وَاسْتَرَاحُوا (see وَاسْتَرَا); 'they rested'
فَاسْتَيْقَظُوا: فَـ + اسْتَيْقَظُوا — istayqaẓa, wake up (X perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they woke'
يَحْمِلُوا: يَحْمِلُوا — ḥamala, load, lift up (impf. subj. m. pl.); 'load' (the baggage animals)
الْجَّوُّ: الـ + جَوّ — jaww, air, atmosphere; 'the air'; the print has a shadda on the jīm
صَارَكَا: صَارَ + كَـ — ṣāra, become (perf. 3 m. sg.) + ka-, like (prep.); the print splits صار كالليل as صاركا لليل; 'became like'
لَلَّيْلِ: الـ + لَّيْل — layl, night; the second half of كَالَّيْلِ as the print splits it; 'the night'
الدَّاجِي: الـ + دَاجِي — dājī, dark, dusky (act. part.); 'the dusky'
تَحْمِلُوا: تَحْمِلُوا — ḥamala, load (impf. jussive m. pl.); 'load' (after لَا, 'do not load')
وَمَمَالِيكُهُ: وَ + مَمَالِيك + هُ — mamālīk, mamluks, slave-soldiers (pl. of مَمْلُوك); 'and his mamluks'
كَالْبَحْرِ: كَـ + الـ + بَحْر — baḥr, sea; ka-, like (prep.); 'like the sea'
الزَّخَّارِ: الـ + زَخَّار — zakhkhār, swelling, surging (intens.); 'the surging'
وَأَعْلَامٌ: وَ + أَعْلَام — aʿlām, standards, flags (pl. of عَلَم); 'and standards'
وَطُبُولٌ: وَ + طُبُول — ṭubūl, drums (pl. of طَبْل); 'and drums'
وَفُرْسَانٌ: وَ + فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen (pl. of فَارِس); 'and horsemen'
وَأَبْطَالٌ: وَ + أَبْطَال — abṭāl, heroes, champions (pl. of بَطَل); 'and champions'
أَمْرِهِمْ: أَمْر + هِمْ — amr, affair, matter; 'their affair'
رَأَهُمُ: رَأَ + هُمُ — raʾā, see (perf. 3 m. sg.) + them; 'saw them'; the print has رأ for رأى
افْتَرَقَتْ: افْتَرَقَتْ — iftaraqa, separate, split off (VIII perf. 3 f. sg.); 'separated'
وَأَحَاطُوا: وَ + أَحَاطُوا — aḥāṭa, surround (IV perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and surrounded'
وَأَحَاطَتْ: وَ + أَحَاطَتْ — aḥāṭa, surround (IV perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and surrounded'
بِمَمْلُوكٍ: بِـ + مَمْلُوك — mamlūk, mamluk; bi-, here the object of أَحَاطَ بِـ 'surround'; 'surrounded a mamluk'
الْأَفْعَالَ: الـ + أَفْعَال — afʿāl, deeds, actions (pl. of فِعْل); 'the deeds'
وَالْهَدِيَّةِ: وَ + الـ + هَدِيَّة — hadiyya, gift (f.); 'and the gift'
مُتَوَجِّهاً: مُتَوَجِّهاً — tawajjaha, head toward (V act. part. acc.); circumstantial 'heading'
مَنَادِيلَهُمْ: مَنَادِيل + هُمْ — mandīl, kerchief, scarf (pl. مَنَادِيل); 'their kerchiefs'
قَدْمَاتَ: قَدْ + مَاتَ — qad, already + māta, die (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'has died'; the print runs the two into one word
مَسْمُوماً: مَسْمُوماً — samma, poison (pass. part. acc.); circumstantial 'poisoned'
فَتَوَجَّهْ: فَـ + تَوَجَّهْ — tawajjaha, go on, head (V imp. m. sg.); 'so go on'
تَجْتَمِعَ: تَجْتَمِعَ — ijtamaʿa, meet, assemble with (VIII impf. subj. 2 m. sg.); 'you meet' (after حَتَّى, with بِـ 'with')
خَيْبَتَنَا: خَيْبَة + نَا — khayba, disappointment, failure (f.); 'our failure'
اخْتَلَطُوا: اخْتَلَطُوا — ikhtalaṭa, mingle (VIII perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they mingled'
فَاسْتَأْذَنُوا: فَـ + اسْتَأْذَنُوا — istaʾdhana, ask leave (X perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they asked leave'
خِيَامِهِ: خِيَام + هِ — khiyām, tents (pl. of خَيْمَة); 'his tents'
بِالْهَدَايَا: بِـ + الـ + هَدَايَا — hadāyā, gifts (pl. of هَدِيَّة); bi-, with (prep.), after جَاءَ بِـ 'bring'; 'with the gifts'; after istadʿā (Night 107), bi- marks what is sent for: istadʿā bi-al-hadāyā, 'sent for the gifts'
وَخَرَاجِ: وَ + خَرَاج — kharāj, tribute, tax (construct); 'and the tribute of'
اخْتَلَفَ: اخْتَلَفَ — ikhtalafa, differ, quarrel (VIII perf. 3 m. sg.); 'differed'
يُوَلُّونَهُ: يُوَلُّونَ + هُ — wallā, set over, appoint (II impf. 3 m. pl.) + him; 'they set him over them'
أَوْقَعُوا: أَوْقَعُوا — awqaʿa, bring about, cause to fall (IV perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they brought about'
مَنَعَهُمْ: مَنَعَ + هُمْ — manaʿa, prevent, restrain (perf. 3 m. sg.) + them; 'restrained them'
الْأَكَابِرُ: الـ + أَكَابِر — akābir, grandees, great ones (pl. of أَكْبَر); 'the grandees'
وَالْأَشْرَافُ: وَ + الـ + أَشْرَاف — ashrāf, nobles (pl. of شَرِيف); 'and the nobles'
وَالْقُضَاةُ: وَ + الـ + قُضَاة — quḍāt, judges (pl. of قَاضٍ); 'and the judges'
أَشَارَبِهِ: أَشَارَ + بِهِ — ashāra, point out, advise (IV perf. 3 m. sg.) + bi-, with + him; 'pointed out (it)'; the verb takes بِـ; the print runs the two into one word
لَايُخَالِفُهُمْ: لَا + يُخَالِفُ + هُمْ — khālafa, oppose, contradict (III impf. 3 m. sg.) + them; 'does not oppose them'; the print runs لا into the verb
الِاتِّفَاقُ: الـ + اتِّفَاق — ittifāq, agreement (VIII verbal noun); 'the agreement'
نَسِيرُ: نَسِيرُ — sāra, go, travel (impf. 1 pl.); 'we go'
وَنَقْصِدُ: وَ + نَقْصِدُ — qaṣada, make for, seek out (impf. 1 pl.); 'and we make for'
وَنَأْتِي: وَ + نَأْتِي — atā, come, bring (impf. 1 pl.); with بِـ 'bring'; 'and we bring'
وَنُسَلْطِنُّهُ: وَ + نُسَلْطِنُّ + هُ — salṭana, make sultan (quadriliteral II impf. 1 pl.; the shadda is the print's) + him; 'and we make him sultan'
تَوَجَّهَا: تَوَجَّهَا — tawajjaha, set out, head (V perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two set out'
يَقَعْ: يَقَعْ — waqaʿa, fall, light upon (impf. jussive 3 m. sg.); 'fall' (after لَمْ)
لِمَوْتِ: لِـ + مَوْت — mawt, death; li-, at, on account of (prep.), after اغْتَمَّ 'grieve'; 'at the death of'
غَمّاً: غَمّاً — ghamm, grief (acc. of internal object); 'with grief'
فَرَحاً: فَرَحاً — faraḥ, joy (acc. of internal object); 'with joy'
وَخُصُوصاً: وَ + خُصُوصاً — khuṣūṣan, especially (adv. acc.); 'and especially'
بِمَجِيءِ: بِـ + مَجِيء — majīʾ, coming, arrival; bi-, at (prep.) 'at the coming of'
سُلْطَاناً: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (acc., predicate of يَصِيرُ); 'a sultan'
حَاجِبَ: ḥājib — chamberlain (m., acc. after anna; first term of an iḍāfa, here 'the chamberlain of')
وَأَخِيهَا: و + أَخ — akh, brother (m., gen. after li-) + ـهَا her; 'and her brother'
قِصَّتَكُمْ: قِصَّة — qiṣṣa, story (f., acc. after inna) + ـكُمْ your (m. pl.); 'your story'
صَادَفْتُمُونِي: صَادَفَ — ṣādafa, to meet by chance, come upon (III) + ـتُمْ you (m. pl.) + ـنِي me; 'you chanced upon me'
أَرَاحَكُمُ: أَرَاحَ — arāḥa, to give rest to (IV) + ـكُمْ you (m. pl.); 'may He give you rest' (a prayer; the dammatan-less mīm takes a damma before allāhu)
جَاءَكُمُ: جَاءَ — jāʾa, to come + ـكُمْ to you (m. pl.); 'it came to you'
الْأَمْرَكَمَا: الـ + أَمْر — amr, affair (m., acc.) + كَـ ka-, like (prep.) + مَا what; the print runs three words into one: 'the affair as'
تَشْتَهُونَ: اِشْتَهَى — ishtahā, to desire (VIII); imperfect, 2nd m. pl.: 'you desire'
أَهْوَنِ: أَهْوَن — ahwan, easiest (elative of hayyin, easy; gen. in iḍāfa after ʿalā)
وَانْصَلَحَ: و + اِنْصَلَحَ — inṣalaḥa, to be set right, mended (VII, colloquial for inṣalaḥa); 'and it was mended'
بِقِصَّتِهِمَا: بِـ bi-, of, about (prep., after akhbara 'inform of') + قِصَّة qiṣṣa, story (f., gen.) + ـهِمَا their (dual); 'of their story'
غِيَابِهِمَا: غِيَاب — ghiyāb, absence (m., gen. in iḍāfa) + ـهِمَا their (dual); 'their absence'
وَأَكَابِرِ: و + أَكَابِر — akābir, the greatest, great ones (pl. of akbar; gen., coordinate with al-umarāʾ)
وَأَطْلَعَهُمْ: و + أَطْلَعَ — aṭlaʿa, to make aware, acquaint (IV) + ـهُمْ them; 'and he acquainted them'
دِ: د — dāl, the first letter of dīwān; the print splits دِيوَان (divan, formal audience) into two words, د + يوانا
يوَاناً: يوَان — the rest of dīwān, divan (m., acc., tanwīn); the print splits the word after its first letter
الْمَنَاصِبِ: الـ + مَنْصِب — manṣib, office, post (m.; pl. manāṣib, gen.)
مَرَاتِبِهِمْ: مَرْتَبَة — martaba, rank (f.; pl. marātib, gen. after ḥasab) + ـهِمْ their; 'their ranks'
بَلُّوا: بَلَّ — balla, to moisten, wet; perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'they moistened'
لِلْمَشُورَةِ: لِـ li-, for (prep., purpose) + الـ + مَشُورَة — mashūra, consultation, counsel (f., gen.); 'for the consultation'
وَأَعْطَوْا: و + أَعْطَى — aʿṭā, to give (IV); perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'and they gave'
إِذْناً: إِذْن — idhn, leave, permission (m., acc., tanwīn)
يَرْكَبُوا: رَكِبَ — rakiba, to ride, mount; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.: 'that they ride'
وَيَتَقَدَّمُوا: و + تَقَدَّمَ — taqaddama, to advance, go forward (V); subjunctive after an: 'and that they advance'
قَلِيلاً: قَلِيل — qalīl, little (acc., tanwīn); repeated, 'little by little'
يُتِمُّوا: أَتَمَّ — atamma, to complete (IV); subjunctive after ḥattā, 3rd m. pl.: 'until they complete' (the print puts the shadda on the ت)
الْمَشُورَةَ: الـ + مَشُورَة — mashūra, consultation (f., acc.); 'the consultation'
وَيَلْحَقُوهُمْ: و + لَحِقَ — laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with; subjunctive after ḥattā, 3rd m. pl. + ـهُمْ them: 'and overtake them'
يَدَى: يَد — yad, hand (f.); dual construct in the genitive, spelled with ى in the print for ي: bayna yaday, 'before' (lit. 'between the two hands of')
وَقُدَّامَهُمْ: و + قُدَّام — quddām, in front of (prep. noun, acc.) + ـهُمْ them; 'and in front of them'
رَايَاتُ: رَايَة — rāya, banner (f.; pl. rāyāt, nom. subject of the verbless clause; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْكُبَرَاءُ: الـ + كُبَرَاء — kubarāʾ, the great ones, grandees (pl. of kabīr, nom.)
مَشُورَتِهِمْ: مَشُورَة — mashūra, consultation (f., gen. after min) + ـهِمْ their; 'their consultation'
وَلَحِقُوا: و + لَحِقَ — laḥiqa, to overtake; perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'and they overtook'
أَتَقَدَّمَ: تَقَدَّمَ — taqaddama, to go ahead (V); subjunctive after an, 1st sg.: 'that I go ahead'
وَأَسْبِقَكُمْ: و + سَبَقَ — sabaqa, to precede; subjunctive, 1st sg. + ـكُمْ you (m. pl.): 'and that I precede you'
أُهَيِّءَ: هَيَّأَ — hayyaʾa, to prepare, make ready (II); subjunctive after li-ajl an, 1st sg.: 'that I prepare' (the print writes the hamza as a free ء)
يُنَاسِبُهُ: نَاسَبَ — nāsaba, to suit, be fitting for (III); imperfect, 3rd m. sg. + ـهُ him: 'that suits him'
وَأُعْلِمَهُ: و + أَعْلَمَ — aʿlama, to inform (IV); subjunctive, 1st sg. + ـهُ him: 'and that I inform him'
بِقُدُومِكُمْ: بِـ bi-, of (prep., after aʿlama 'inform of') + قُدُوم — qudūm, coming, arrival (m., gen.) + ـكُمْ your (m. pl.); 'of your coming'
وَإِنَّكُمُ: و + إِنَّ inna, that (after the verb of informing) + ـكُمْ you (m. pl.); 'and that you'
اخْتَرْتُمُوهُ: اِخْتَارَ — ikhtāra, to choose (VIII); perfect, 2nd m. pl. + ـهُ him: 'you chose him'
رَأَيْتَهُ: رَأَى — raʾā, to see, judge + ـتَ you (m. sg.) + ـهُ it; 'you saw it' (i.e. 'you judged best')
تَعْظِيماً: تَعْظِيم — taʿẓīm, honouring (m., acc. tanwīn; adverbial accusative of purpose, 'in honour')
التَّقَادِمَ: الـ + تَقَادِم — taqādim, gifts, presents (pl. of taqdima, acc.)
يَقْبَلَهَا: قَبِلَ — qabila, to accept; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. sg. + ـهَا it (f.): 'that he accept them'
تُحَدِّثُ: حَدَّثَ — ḥaddatha, to speak to, tell (II); imperfect, 2nd m. sg.: 'you speak to'
أَمْرِنَا: أَمْر — amr, affair, matter (m., gen. after fī) + ـنَا our; 'our affair'
لِيُبْقِيَنَا: لِـ li-, so that (purpose) + أَبْقَى — abqā, to keep, leave (IV); subjunctive, 3rd m. sg. + ـنَا us: 'that he keep us'
مُسْتَمِرِّينَ: مُسْتَمِرّ — mustamirr, continuing (act. part., X; acc. pl. as a state, ḥāl): 'continuing'
مَنَاصِبِنَا: مَنْصِب — manṣib, office, post (m.; pl. manāṣib, gen. after fī) + ـنَا our; 'our offices'
فَأَجَا: فَـ fa-, and so + أَجَا — the first part of أَجَابَ, ajāba, to answer (IV), which the print splits as فاجا بهم
بَهُمْ: the second part of أَجَابَهُمْ, ajābahum, 'he answered them'; the print splits it as فاجا بهم
يَنْصِبُوهَا: نَصَبَ — naṣaba, to set up, pitch; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl. + ـهَا them (f.): 'that they pitch them'
بِمَسَافَةِ: بِـ bi-, at (prep., of measure) + مَسَافَة — masāfa, distance (f., gen. in iḍāfa); 'at a distance of'
السَّفْرَةَ: الـ + سَفْرَة — safra, journey (f., acc.); 'the journey'
وَعَظُمَتْ: و + عَظُمَ — ʿaẓuma, to be or become great; perfect, 3rd f. sg.: 'and she grew great'
جَدَّ: جَدَّ — jadda, to be earnest, press on (with fī al-safar, 'press on with the journey')
مَسَافَةُ: مَسَافَة — masāfa, distance (f., nom. as subject of the verbless clause, 'a day's distance')
لِجُلُوسِ: لِـ li-, for (prep.) + جُلُوس — julūs, sitting (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'for the sitting of'
وَمَمَا: و + مَمَا — the first part of مَمَالِيكِهِ, mamālīk, mamluks; the print splits it as ومما ليكه
لِيكِهِ: the rest of مَمَالِيكِهِ, mamālīkihi, 'his mamluks' (mamlūk, slave-soldier; pl. mamālīk) + ـهِ his; the print splits it
السَّيِّدَةَ: الـ + سَيِّدَة — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., acc.); 'the lady'
شَأْنِ: شَأْن — shaʾn, matter, concern (m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'in the matter of'
فَأَذِنَتْ: فَـ fa-, and so + أَذِنَ — adhina, to give leave; perfect, 3rd f. sg.: 'and she gave leave'
وَبِأَخِيهَا: و + بِـ bi-, with (prep., after ijtamaʿa 'meet with') + أَخ — akh, brother (gen.) + ـهَا her; 'and with her brother'
وَأَخْبَرَهُمَا: و + أَخْبَرَ — akhbara, to inform (IV) + ـهُمَا the two of them; 'and he informed them'
ضَوْءَالْمَكَانِ: ضَوْء الْمَكَان — Ḍawʾ al-Makān, 'Light of the Place', the prince's name (acc. after anna); the print writes it as one word
الرُّؤَسَاءُ: الـ + رُؤَسَاء — ruʾasāʾ, chiefs, leaders (pl. of raʾīs, nom. subject; the print omits the hamza)
مَلِكاً: مَلِك — malik, king (m., acc., tanwīn; second object of jaʿala 'make')
عِوَضاً: عِوَض — ʿiwaḍ, compensation, in place of (acc., tanwīn; 'ʿiwaḍan ʿan' = 'in place of')
وَهَنَّا: و + هَنَّأَ — hannaʾa, to congratulate (II); the first part of وهنّاهما, which the print splits as وهنّا هما
فَبَكَيَا: فَـ fa-, and so + بَكَى — bakā, to weep; perfect, 3rd dual: 'and they both wept'
وَالْجَيْشُ: و + الـ + جَيْش — jaysh, army (m., nom., coordinate with the pronoun 'he'); 'and the army'
أَشَارُوا: أَشَارَ — ashāra, to indicate, advise (IV); perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'they indicated' (bi-hi, 'what they proposed')
كُلَّهُمُ: كُلّ — kull, all (acc., emphasis) + ـهُمْ they; 'all of them'
اخْتَارُوكَ: اِخْتَارَ — ikhtāra, to choose (VIII); perfect, 3rd m. pl. + ـكَ you (m. sg.): 'they chose you'
سَلْطَنُوا: سَلْطَنَ — salṭana, to install as sultan (a verb made from sulṭān; colloquial); perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'they made sultan'
تَأْمَنُ: أَمِنَ — amina, to be safe; imperfect, 2nd m. sg.: 'you are safe'
يَتَسَلْطَنُ: تَسَلْطَنَ — tasalṭana, to become sultan, rule as sultan (V, from sulṭān); imperfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'who becomes sultan'
يَقْتُلُكَ: قَتَلَ — qatala, to kill; imperfect, 3rd m. sg. + ـكَ you: 'he kills you'
الْفَشَلُ: الـ + فَشَل — fashal, failure, discord, cowardice (m., nom.); 'the failure, the discord'
وَيَخْرُجُ: و + خَرَجَ — kharaja, to go out; imperfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'and it goes out'
أَيْدِيكُمَا: يَد — yad, hand (f.; pl. aydī, gen. after min) + ـكُمَا your (dual); 'your hands'
التَّخَلِّي: الـ + تَخَلِّي — takhallī, relinquishing, giving up (verbal noun of V, nom.; 'it is not possible to relinquish')
الرَّشَادُ: الـ + رَشَاد — rashād, right guidance, sound judgement (m., nom.)
أَخُوكَ: أَخ — akh, brother (m., nom.; the long form of the five nouns) + ـكَ your; 'your brother'
سُلْطَانَ: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., acc., predicate of yakūnu; first term of an iḍāfa)
سُلْطَانُ: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., nom., predicate of 'you'; first term of an iḍāfa)
عَزْمَكَ: عَزْم — ʿazm, resolve (m., acc., object of shudda) + ـكَ your; 'your resolve'
وَجَهِّزْ: و + جَهَّزَ — jahhaza, to equip, make ready (II); imperative, m. sg.: 'and prepare'
مَلَابِسِ: مَلْبَس — malbas, garment (m.; pl. malābis, gen. after min)
النِّمْشَةَ: النِّمْشَة — nimsha (Persian nīmsha, 'half-sword'), a short sword or dagger (f., acc.); 'the short sword'
يَخْتَارُوا: اِخْتَارَ — ikhtāra, to choose (VIII); subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.: 'that they choose'
مَوْضِعاً: مَوْضِع — mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m., acc., tanwīn)
عَالِياً: عَالٍ — ʿālin, high (acc., tanwīn; adjective of mawḍiʿ)
وَيَنْصِبُوا: و + نَصَبَ — naṣaba, to pitch; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.: 'and that they pitch'
وَاسِعَةً: وَاسِع — wāsiʿ, wide, spacious (f., acc., tanwīn; adjective of khayma)
لِيَجْلِسَ: لِـ li-, so that (purpose) + جَلَسَ — jalasa, to sit; subjunctive, 3rd m. sg.: 'that he sit'
يَطْبُخُوا: طَبَخَ — ṭabakha, to cook; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.: 'that they cook'
فَاخِراً: فَاخِر — fākhir, splendid, sumptuous (m., acc., tanwīn; adjective of ṭaʿām)
وَيُحْضِرُوهُ: و + أَحْضَرَ — aḥḍara, to bring (IV); subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl. + ـهُ it: 'and that they bring it'
يَنْصِبُوا: نَصَبَ — naṣaba, to set up; subjunctive after an, 3rd m. pl.: 'that they set up'
حِيَاضَ: حَوْض — ḥawḍ, basin, trough (m.; pl. ḥiyāḍ, acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'basins of'
سَدَّا: سَدَّ — sadda, to block, stop up; the print joins its final alif to the next word's ل: سدا لاقطار for سدّ الأقطار
لْأَقْطَارَ: the article's لـ + أَقْطَار — aqṭār, regions, quarters (pl. of quṭr, acc.); 'the regions'; the print splits سدّ الأقطار as سدا لاقطار
وَجَاؤُا: و + جَاؤُا — jāʾū, they came (the print writes the plural ending with a seat, جاؤا)
سَأَلُوهُ: سَأَلَ — saʾala, to ask; perfect, 3rd m. pl. + ـهُ him: 'they asked him'
وَتَهْيِئَةِ: و + تَهْيِئَة — tahyiʾa, preparing (verbal noun of hayyaʾa, gen. after li-ajl)
فَاسْتَأْذَنُوهَا: فَـ fa-, and so + اِسْتَأْذَنَ — istaʾdhana, to ask leave of (X); perfect, 3rd m. pl. + ـهَا her: 'so they asked her leave'
وَسَأَلَا: و + سَأَلَ — saʾala, to ask; perfect, 3rd dual: 'and they both asked'
السَّقَّائِينَ: الـ + سَقَّاء — saqqāʾ, water-carrier (m.; pl. saqqāʾūn, acc. pl. -īn); 'the water-carriers'
لِاجْتِمَاعِ: لِـ + اجْتِمَاع — ijtimāʿ, gathering; li-, for, for the purpose of (prep., governing the genitive); 'for the gathering of'
قَدْطَارَ: قَدْ + طَارَ — qad ṭāra, 'had flown up' (the print joins qad to the verb); perfect 3rd m. sg. of ṭāra, to fly, rise
مَحَقَ: maḥaqa, to wipe out, efface; perfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'he/it wiped away'
الْغُبَارَ: الـ + غُبَار — ghubār, dust (m.); acc.: 'the dust'
وَتَبَيَّنَ: و + تَبَيَّنَ — tabayyana, to become clear (V); perfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'and it became clear'
عَسْكَرُ: ʿaskar, army (m.); in construct: 'the army of'
وَمُقَدِّمُهُ: و + مُقَدِّم + هُ — muqaddim, vanguard, one who leads (act. part. II) + his: 'and its vanguard'
وَكُلُّهُمْ: و + كُلّ + هُمْ — kull, all, every + their: 'and all of them'
فَرِحُونَ: fariḥ, glad, rejoicing; nom. m. pl. -ūna: 'rejoicing'
بِسَلْطَنَةِ: بِـ + سَلْطَنَة — salṭana, sultanate, kingship; bi-, at, over (prep. with fariḥ, 'glad at'): 'at the sultanate of'
لَابِساً: lābis, wearing, clad (act. part. of labisa); acc. indef. (ḥāl): 'wearing'
خِلْعَةَ: khilʿa, robe of honour (f.); acc., in construct: 'the robe of'
مُتَقَلِّداً: mutaqallid, girded with (act. part. V of taqallada, to gird on a sword); acc. indef. (ḥāl): 'girded'
مُشَاةً: mushāt, on foot (pl. of māshin, walker); acc. (ḥāl): 'walking, on foot'
النَّمْشَةَ: الـ + نَمْشَة — namsha, a kind of short sword or dagger (f.; sense uncertain); acc.: 'the short sword'
فَخِذَيْهِ: فَخِذ + يْهِ — fakhidh, thigh (f.), dual gen. + his: 'his two thighs'
مَمَالِيكُهُ: مَمَالِيك + هُ — mamālīk, mamluks, slave-soldiers (pl. of mamlūk) + his: 'his mamluks'
وَشَهَرُوا: و + شَهَرُوا — shahara, to draw (a sword), brandish; perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'and they drew'
السُّيُوفَ: الـ + سُيُوف — suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf); acc.: 'the swords'
وَالْجُيُوشُ: و + الـ + جُيُوش — juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh); 'and the armies'
وَاسْتَأْذَنَ: و + اسْتَأْذَنَ — istaʾdhana, to ask leave (X); perfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'and he asked leave'
فَأَمَرَأَنْ: فَـ + أَمَرَ + أَنْ — the print joins the verb amara, to command (perfect 3rd m. sg.) to the following an, 'that': 'and he commanded that'
فَأَعْلَمَهُمُ: فَـ + أَعْلَمَ + هُمُ — aʿlama, to inform (IV); perfect, 3rd m. sg. + them (hum with a helping vowel before al-): 'and he informed them'
فَأَجَابُوا: فَـ + أَجَابُوا — ajāba, to answer (IV); perfect, 3rd m. pl.: 'and they answered'
هَابُوهُ: هَابُوا + هُ — hāba, to stand in awe of, fear; perfect, 3rd m. pl. + him: 'they stood in awe of him'
فَتَلَقَّاهُمْ: فَـ + تَلَقَّى + هُمْ — talaqqā, to meet, receive (V); perfect, 3rd m. sg. + them: 'and he met them'
مُلْتَقًى: multaqan, meeting, place or manner of meeting (n. of place); acc. indef., after aḥsana: 'a meeting'
فَهَنَّوْهُ: فَـ + هَنَّوْا + هُ — hannaʾa/hannā, to congratulate (II); perfect, 3rd m. pl. + him: 'and they congratulated him' (print has no hamza)
وَدَعَوْالَهُ: و + دَعَوْا + لَهُ — daʿā, to pray (for), call upon; perfect, 3rd m. pl.; la-hu, for him (the print joins the words): 'and they prayed for him'
وَحَلَفُوالَهُ: و + حَلَفُوا + لَهُ — ḥalafa, to swear; perfect, 3rd m. pl.; la-hu, to him (the print joins the words): 'and they swore to him'
الصَّادِقَةَ: الـ + صَادِقَة — ṣādiqa, true, truthful (f.); acc. f. sg. (agreeing with al-aymān): 'the true'
لَايُخَالِفُونَ: لَا + يُخَالِفُونَ — lā, not + khālafa, to oppose, contravene (III); imperfect, 3rd m. pl. (the print joins lā to the verb): 'they will not oppose'
أَمْراً: amr, command, order (m.); acc. indef.: 'any command'
بِغَيْرِهِمْ: بِـ + غَيْر + هِمْ — ghayr, other + them; bi-, with, to (prep. after faʿala, 'did to'): 'to others than them, to others'
بَيْقَ: bayqa — the print's spelling of yabqa, 'remained'; jussive after lam, 3rd m. sg. of baqiya (the ب is a slip for ي)
مَرْحَباً: marḥaban, welcome! (acc. of marḥab, spaciousness; 'you have come to a spacious place')
وَالْوَالِدِ: و + الـ + وَالِد — wālid, father (m.); gen., after bi- carried over: 'and the father'
الْكَبِيرَأَنَّ: الـ + كَبِير + أَنَّ — kabīr, great, elder (the print joins the particle anna, 'that, indeed'): 'the great — indeed'
فِعْلَكَ: فِعْل + كَ — fiʿl, deed, action (m.) + your: 'your deed'
الْمُشِيرِ: الـ + مُشِير — mushīr, counsellor, adviser (act. part. IV of ashāra, to advise); gen., in construct: 'the counsellor'
وَالتَّدْبِيرُ: و + الـ + تَدْبِير — tadbīr, ordering, planning, management; 'and the ordering'
اللَّطِيفِ: الـ + لَطِيف — laṭīf, subtle, gracious; al-Laṭīf, one of the names of God: 'the Subtle'
الْخَبِيرِ: الـ + خَبِير — khabīr, all-aware, well-informed; al-Khabīr, one of the names of God: 'the All-Aware'
وَأَمَرَ: و + أَمَرَ — amara, to command; perfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'and he commanded'
بِمَدِّ: بِـ + مَدّ — madd, stretching out, spreading; bi-, a prep. which the verb amara chooses ('command (something)'): 'the spreading of'
السِّمَاطِ: الـ + سِمَاط — simāṭ, table, cloth laid for a feast (m.); gen.: 'the table'
جَمِيعاً: jamīʿan, all together, altogether (acc. indef., ḥāl): 'all of it'
وَأَكَلُو: و + أَكَلُو — akala, to eat; perfect, 3rd m. pl. (the print omits the final alif): 'and they ate'
اِءْمُرِ: imuri/ʾmur — imperative of amara, to command, with the hamza written as a separate sign (ءْ); 2nd m. sg. with a helping kasra before al-: 'command!'
أَخْتَلِيَ: akhtaliya, to be alone (VIII of khalā); subjunctive, 1st sg., after ḥattā: 'that I may be alone'
وَتُخْبِرَنِي: و + تُخْبِرَ + نِي — akhbara, to inform (IV); subjunctive, 2nd m. sg. (after ḥattā ... wa-, continuing the purpose) + me: 'and that you inform me'
وَأَمَرَا: و + أَمَرَ(ا) — amara, to command; perfect, 3rd m. sg. (the print has a spurious alif at the end, perhaps the article's alif displaced): 'and he commanded'
وَلَايَدْخُلُ: و + لَا + يَدْخُلُ — wa-, and + lā, not + dakhala, to enter; imperfect, 3rd m. sg. (the print joins lā to the verb): 'and none shall enter'
وَدَعَوُا: و + دَعَوُا — daʿā, to pray for, call upon; perfect, 3rd m. pl. (with a helping vowel before al-): 'and they prayed for'
الضَّوْءَ: الـ + ضَوْء — ḍawʾ, light (m.); acc.; here the print puts the article on the first half of the name Ḍawʾ al-Makān: 'the (Ḍawʾ)'
أَهَلْ: أَ + هَلْ — a Middle Arabic blend of the question-particle a- and hal, both 'is it that?': 'did ...?'
عَلِمْتِ: ʿalima, to know; perfect, 2nd f. sg.: 'you (f.) knew'
تَعْلَمِي: taʿlamī, to know; jussive after lam, 2nd f. sg.: 'you (f.) did not know' (with lam)
سِتَارَةً: sitāra, curtain, screen (f.); acc. indef.: 'a curtain'
السِّنَارَةِ: الـ + سِنَارَة — the print's misprint for al-sitāra, 'the curtain' (f.); gen., after khārija: 'the curtain'
أُرِيدَأَنْ: أُرِيدُ + أَنْ — urīdu, I want (imperfect, 1st sg. of arāda, IV); an, that (the print joins the two; the dammah is read as fatḥa before an): 'I want that'
تَفْصِيلاً: tafṣīl, detailing, explanation in detail (m.); acc. indef.: 'in detail'
سَفَرِهِ: سَفَر + هِ — safar, journey, travel + his: 'his journey'
عَنْكُمَا: عَنْ + كُمَا — ʿan, about, concerning (prep.) + you two: 'about you two'
يَجِدْكُمَا: يَجِدْ + كُمَا — wajada, to find; jussive after lam, 3rd m. sg. + you two: 'he did not find you two' (with lam)
أَنَّكُمَا: أَنَّ + كُمَا — anna, that + you two: 'that you two'
قَصَدْتُمَا: qaṣada, to set out for, intend; perfect, 2nd dual: 'you two set out for'
الْحَجَّ: الـ + حَجّ — ḥajj, the pilgrimage (to Mecca); acc.: 'the pilgrimage'
شَارِدٍ: shārid, straying, a straggler (act. part. of sharada); gen. indef., in construct with kull: 'a straggler'
وَوَارِدٍ: و + وَارِد — wārid, arriving, one who comes (act. part. of warada); gen. indef.: 'and an arrival'
فَقْدِكُمَا: فَقْد + كُمَا — faqd, loss, being lost or missing (m.) + of you two: 'your (dual) loss'
الْعِبَادَةِ: الـ + عِبَادَة — ʿibāda, worship, devotion (f.); gen., in construct: 'worship'
وَرَدَتْ: warada, to arrive, come (to); perfect, 3rd f. sg.: 'she had come'
حَوَيْنَ: ḥawā, to gather, comprise, possess; perfect, 3rd f. pl.: 'they had gathered/possessed'
كَمَالِ: kamāl, perfection (m.); gen., in construct: 'the perfection of'
حُسْنِهِنَّ: حُسْن + هِنَّ — ḥusn, beauty (m.) + their (f. pl.): 'their beauty'
يَقْرَأْنَ: yaqraʾna, to read, recite; imperfect, 3rd f. pl.: 'they recite'
وَيَعْرِفْنَ: و + يَعْرِفْنَ — ʿarafa, to know; imperfect, 3rd f. pl.: 'and they know'
فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ: فَـ + اسْتَأْذَنَتْ — istaʾdhana, to ask leave (X); perfect, 3rd f. sg.: 'and she asked leave'
جَالِساً: jālis, sitting (act. part. of jalasa); acc. indef., predicate of kuntu: 'sitting'
آثَارِ: āthār, marks, traces (pl. of athar); gen., in construct: 'marks of'
الزُّهْدِ: الـ + زُهْد — zuhd, asceticism, renunciation of the world; gen.: 'asceticism'
مِثْلَهُنَّ: مِثْل + هُنَّ — mithl, like, the equal of + them (f. pl.); acc.: 'the like of them'
بِالرِّوَايَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + رِوَايَات — riwāyāt, transmissions (pl. of riwāya), the canonical variant readings of the Qurʾān; bi-, in (prep., of manner): 'in the transmissions'
الْأُمَمِ: الـ + أُمَم — umam, nations, peoples (pl. of umma); gen., in construct: 'the nations'
وَاقِفَاتٌ: wāqif, standing (act. part. of waqafa); nom. f. pl. -āt: 'standing'
الِامْتِحَانِ: الـ + امْتِحَان — imtiḥān, testing, trial (VIII verbal noun of miḥna); gen., after ʿinda: 'the testing'
يُكْرَمُ: yukramu, to honour (IV, passive); imperfect, 3rd m. sg.: 'is honoured'
الْمَرْءُ: الـ + مَرْء — marʾ, man, person (m.); nom.: 'the man'
أَوْيُهَانُ: أَوْ + يُهَانُ — aw, or + yuhānu, to disgrace (IV, passive); imperfect 3rd m. sg. (the print joins the two): 'or is disgraced'
الْمَرْحُومُ: الـ + مَرْحُوم — marḥūm, one on whom mercy has been shown (pass. part. of raḥima); the courteous epithet for a dead man: 'the late-lamented'
فَسَرَّتْهُ: فَـ + سَرَّتْ + هُ — sarra, to delight, please; perfect, 3rd f. sg. + him: 'and it delighted him'
رُؤْيَتُهُنَّ: رُؤْيَة + هُنَّ — ruʾya, seeing, sight (f.) + their (f. pl.): 'the sight of them'
تُسْمِعُنِي: تُسْمِعُ + نِي — asmaʿa, to let hear (IV); imperfect, 3rd f. sg. (used as a command, 'each shall let') + me: 'let me hear'
وَالْأُمَمِ: و + الـ + أُمَم — umam, nations, peoples; gen.: 'and the nations'
السَّابِقِينَ: الـ + سَابِق — sābiq, preceding, former (act. part. of sabaqa); gen. m. pl. -īna: 'the former ones'
رُؤْبَتُهُنَّ: رُؤْبَة + هُنَّ — ruʾba (misprint for ruʾya, seeing, sight; f.) + their (f. pl.): 'the sight of them'
لِذِي: لِـ + ذِي — li-, for, to (prep.: 'it is fitting for') + dhī, possessor of, owner of (gen. after لِـ): 'for the possessor of'
يَجْتَنِبَ: يَجْتَنِبَ — ijtanaba, to avoid, shun (VIII); subjunctive, 3rd m. sg., after أَنْ: 'that he avoid'
وَيَتَحَلَّي: و + يَتَحَلَّي — wa-, and + taḥallā, to adorn oneself (V); imperfect, 3rd m. sg. (edition's yā for ى): 'and adorn himself'
بِالْفَضَائِلِ: بِـ + الـ + فَضَائِل — bi-, with (instrument: 'adorn oneself with') + faḍāʾil, virtues (pl. of faḍīla); gen.: 'with the virtues'

فَأَخْوَفُ: فَـ + أَخْوَف — akhwaf, most fearful (elative); fa-, so/then (introduces the predicate after أَمَّا); 'the most fearful'
لِلْجَزَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + جَزَاء — jazāʾ, reward (gen.); li-, for, 'in order to (get)'; 'for the reward'
أَبُوهُمَا: أَب + هُمَا — ab, father (nom., long form in construct) + 'their (dual)'; 'their father'
كِلَاهُمَا: كِلَا + هُمَا — kilā, both (acc. object of يَسْمَعُ; print كلاهما); 'both of them'
صَادِقَيْنِ: صَادِق — ṣādiq, truthful (dual acc.); 'truthful, the two of them'
فَاقْبِضْهُمَا: فَـ + اِقْبِضْ + هُمَا — qabaḍa, to seize, take (a soul) (imper. 2 m. sg.); fa-, then (after the conditional); 'then take the two of them'
الْعُقَلَاءِ: الـ + عُقَلَاء — ʿuqalāʾ, wise men (pl. of عَاقِل; gen.); 'the wise'
أَفْضَلِ: أَفْضَل — afḍal, best (elative, gen. construct); 'the best of'
صَحِبْتُ: صَحِبَ — ṣaḥiba, to accompany, keep company with (perf. 1 sg.); 'I accompanied'
الْخَصْلَتَيْنِ: الـ + خَصْلَة — khaṣla, trait, quality (dual acc.); 'the two traits'
لَاتُشْرِكَ: لَا + تُشْرِكَ — ashraka, to associate (partners with God) (subj. 2 m. sg., after أَنْ); lā, not; 'that you not associate' (print runs لا to the verb)
لَاتُؤْذِيَ: لَا + تُؤْذِيَ — ādhā, to harm (subj. 2 m. sg., after أَنْ); lā, not; 'that you not harm'
خَلَقَ: خَلَقَ — khalaqa, to create (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'created'
وَانْفِ: و + اِنْفِ — nafā, to drive away, expel (imper. 2 m. sg.); 'and drive away'
بَاسِ: بَأْس — baʾs, harm, trouble (gen.; print has bare alif); 'harm' (مِنْ بَأْسٍ 'any harm')
فَلَاتَقْرَبْ: فَـ + لَا + تَقْرَبْ — qaruba, to approach (jussive 2 m. sg., prohibitive); fa-, so; 'so do not approach'
بِهُمَا: بِـ + هُمَا — bi-, with, near (prep.; after قَرُبَ بِـ) + 'them (dual)'; 'near them'
اَشِرْكُ: شِرْك — shirk, associating (partners) with God (nom.); print's form is read as 'associating'
وَالْاِضْرَارُ: و + الـ + إِضْرَار — iḍrār, harming (verbal noun, nom.); 'and the harming'
يَصْحَبْكَ: صَحِبَ — ṣaḥiba, to accompany (jussive 3 m. sg., after لَمْ) + كَ, you; 'does not accompany you'
زَادُ: زَاد — (1) zād, provision, esp. for a journey (m., nom.); 'provision'. (2) -zād, the second element of the name Shahrazād where the print splits it in two, يَا شَهْرَ زَادُ, 'O Shahrazād' (vocative: the name takes -u without tanwīn); see شَهْرَ.
وَلَاقَيْتَ: و + لَاقَى — lāqā, to meet (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'and you meet'
تَزَوَّدَا: تَزَوَّدَ — tazawwada, to provide oneself (with provision) (perf. 3 m. sg., with pausal alif); 'he provisioned himself'
كَمِثْلِهِ: كَـ + مِثْل + هِ — ka-, like (prep.) + mithl, likeness (gen.) + him; 'like him'
وَاَنَّكَ: و + أَنَّ + كَ — anna, that (+ 'you'); 'and that you'
تَرْصُدْ: رَصَدَ — raṣada, to lay up, set aside (jussive 2 m. sg., after لَمْ); 'you did not lay up'
اَرْصَدَا: أَرْصَدَ — arṣada, to lay up, prepare (perf. 3 m. sg., with pausal alif); 'he laid up'
يَحْضُرُنِي: حَضَرَ — ḥaḍara, to be present (impf. 3 m. sg.) + نِي, me; 'is present to me / comes to me'
الْعَارِفِينَ: الـ + عَارِف — ʿārif, knower, gnostic (Sufi) (pl. gen.); 'the knowers'
أَسْتَبْشِرُ: اِسْتَبْشَرَ — istabshara, to rejoice (impf. 1 sg.; with بِـ 'at'); 'I rejoice'
أَتَيَقَّنُ: تَيَقَّنَ — tayaqqana, to be certain (impf. 1 sg.); 'I am certain'
غَيْرَأَنِّي: غَيْرَ + أَنَّ + ي — ghayra, except, but (acc.) + anna, that + 'I'; 'except that I' (print runs غير to أني)
فَأَرْجُو: فَـ + أَرْجُو — rajā, to hope (impf. 1 sg.); fa-, so; 'so I hope'
مُضَاعَفَةَ: مُضَاعَفَة — muḍāʿafa, doubling, multiplying (verbal noun, acc.); 'the multiplying of'
وَانْقِطَاعَ: و + اِنْقِطَاع — inqiṭāʿ, cutting off, ceasing (verbal noun, acc.); 'and the ceasing of'
السَّيِّءِ: الـ + سَيِّء — sayyiʾ, bad, evil (gen.); 'the bad'
السَّلَمِيُّ: الـ + سَلَمِيّ — Salamī (or Sulamī), a tribal name (nisba) (nom.); 'al-Salamī'
وَصِيَّتِهِ: وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, testament, will, bidding (gen., construct) + هِ; 'his testament'
وَارْتَعَدَ: و + اِرْتَعَدَ — irtaʿada, to tremble (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he trembled'
أُرِيدَانِ: أُرِيدُ + أَنْ — arīdu an, 'I want to / I am about to' (print runs أن to the verb: اريدان); 'I am about to'
الِانْتِصَابُ: الـ + اِنْتِصَاب — intiṣāb, standing, taking one's stand (verbal noun, nom.); 'the standing'
لِلْعَمَلِ: لِـ + الـ + عَمَل — ʿamal, action (gen.); li-, for, 'in order to'; 'for the acting'
بِمُقْتَضَى: بِـ + مُقْتَضَى — muqtaḍā, requirement, tenor (gen.); bi-, according to; 'according to the requirement of'
وَلِذَلِكَ: و + لِـ + ذَلِكَ — dhālika, that; li-, for, 'because of'; 'and for that (reason)'
زَيْنُ: زَيْن — zayn, ornament, adornment (nom., construct); 'ornament of'
الْعَابِدِينَ: الـ + عَابِد — ʿābid, worshipper (pl. gen.); 'the worshippers' (Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn, an honorific)
لِلصَّلَوةِ: لِـ + الـ + صَلَوة — ṣalāh, prayer (print: صلوة; gen.); li-, to, for; 'to the prayer'
فَسُئِلَ: فَـ + سُئِلَ — saʾala, to ask (pass. perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he was asked'
أَتَدْرُونَ: أَ + تَدْرُونَ — darā, to know (impf. 2 m. pl.); a-, interrogative particle; 'do you know?'
أُخَاطِبُ: خَاطَبَ — khāṭaba, to address (impf. 1 sg.); 'I address'
الثَّوْرِيِّ: الـ + ثَوْرِيّ — Thawrī, nisba of Thawr (gen.); 'al-Thawrī'
شَهْرُ: شَهْر — shahr, month (nom., construct); 'the month of'
وَيُصَلِّى: و + يُصَلِّي — ṣallā, to pray, lead prayer (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he leads in prayer'
فَيَسْكُتُ: فَـ + يَسْكُتُ — sakata, to be silent (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'then he falls silent'
وَيُبْطِيءُ: و + يُبْطِيءُ — abṭaʾa, to be slow, hesitate (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he hesitates'
فَيُمَيَّزُونَ: فَـ + يُمَيَّزُونَ — mayyaza, to distinguish (pass. impf. 3 m. pl.); 'then they are distinguished'
بِعَلَامَةِ: بِـ + عَلَامَة — ʿalāma, sign (gen., construct); bi-, by means of; 'by a sign of'
مَزِيدِ: مَزِيد — mazīd, increase, more (gen., construct); 'increase of'
الْكَرَامَةِ: الـ + كَرَامَة — karāma, honour, dignity (gen.); 'the honour'
سِوَاهُمْ: سِوَى + هُمْ — siwā, other than, besides (+ 'them'); 'other than them'
لَطَارَ: لَـ + طَارَ — ṭāra, to fly (perf. 3 m. sg.); la-, answer to لَوْ; 'it would fly'
وَشَوْقًا: و + شَوْق — shawq, longing (acc., adverbial); 'and with longing'
وَحُزْنًا: و + حُزْن — ḥuzn, grief (acc., adverbial); 'and with grief'
وَخَوْفًا: و + خَوْف — khawf, fear (acc., adverbial); 'and with fear'
أَتَكَلَّمُ: تَكَلَّمَ — takallama, to speak (impf. 1 sg.; bi-: of); 'I speak'
رُوِيَ: رُوِيَ — ruwiya, 'it was related' (pass. perf. 3 m. sg. of رَوَى); 'it is related'
إِيَّاكُمْ: إِيَّاكُمْ — iyyākum, 'beware (you pl.)' (warning idiom, with وَ + acc.); 'beware'
وَسَرَائِرَ: و + سَرَائِر — sarāʾir, hidden things, secrets (pl. of سَرِيرَة; acc.); 'and the hidden things of'
يُصَلِّيَ: صَلَّى — ṣallā, to pray (subj. 3 m. sg., after أَنْ); 'that he pray'
أَحَدُكُمْ: أَحَد + كُمْ — aḥad, one (nom., construct) + 'you (pl.)'; 'one of you'
فَيُطِيلَ: فَـ + يُطِيلَ — aṭāla, to lengthen, prolong (subj. 3 m. sg.); fa-, and then; 'and prolong'
رُكُوعَهُ: رُكُوع + هُ — rukūʿ, bowing in prayer (acc.) + 'his'; 'his bowing'
وَسُجُودَهُ: و + سُجُود + هُ — sujūd, prostration (acc.) + 'his'; 'and his prostration'
يَلْحَقَهُ: لَحِقَ — laḥiqa, to reach, overtake (subj. 3 m. sg., after حَتَّى) + هُ, him; 'reaches him'
الْحَدَثُ: الـ + حَدَث — ḥadath, ritual impurity, the need to relieve oneself (nom.); 'the impurity'
يُكَفِّرُ: كَفَّرَ — kaffara, to expiate, cover over (sins) (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'it expiates'
السَّيِّئَاتِ: الـ + سَيِّئَات — sayyiʾāt, bad deeds (f. pl. acc.); 'the evil deeds'
الْتَمَسْتُ: اِلْتَمَسَ — iltamasa, to request, seek (perf. 1 sg.); 'I asked / sought'
أَسْرَارِ: أَسْرَار — asrār, secrets (pl. of سِرّ; gen., construct); 'secrets of'
الْحَقَائِقِ: الـ + حَقَائِق — ḥaqāʾiq, true realities (pl. of حَقِيقَة; gen.); 'the realities'
يَابُنَيَّ: يَا + بُنَيَّ — yā, O + bunayya, my little son (dim. of ابْن); 'O my son' (print: يابنّي)
نُعَلِّمَهُ: عَلَّمَ — ʿallama, to teach (subj. 1 pl., after أَنْ) + هُ, it; 'that we teach it'
زَكَوةِ: زَكَاة — zakāh, alms-due (print: زكوة; gen., construct); 'the alms-tax of'
فَاسْتَحْلَيْتُ: فَـ + اِسْتَحْلَى — istaḥlā, to find sweet (perf. 1 sg.); fa-, and so; 'so I found sweet'
وَاسْتَحْسَنْتُهُ: و + اِسْتَحْسَنَ + هُ — istaḥsana, to think good (perf. 1 sg.) + 'it'; 'and approved it'
أُصَلِّي: صَلَّى — ṣallā, to pray (impf. 1 sg.); 'I pray'
بِبِشْرٍ: بِـ + بِشْر — Bishr (gen.); bi-, after إِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears; 'behold, Bishr'
يُصَلِّي: صَلَّى — ṣallā, to pray (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'he prays'
أَرْكَعُ: رَكَعَ — rakaʿa, to bow (in prayer) (impf. 1 sg.); 'I bow'
يُؤَذِّنَ: أَذَّنَ — adhdhana, to call to prayer (subj. 3 m. sg., after أَنْ); 'that he call the adhān'
الْمُؤَذِّنُ: الـ + مُؤَذِّن — muʾadhdhin, one who calls to prayer (nom.); 'the muezzin'
رَثُّ: رَثّ — rathth, worn, shabby (nom., construct); 'shabby of'
احْذَرُوا: اِحْذَرُوا — iḥdharū, beware, guard against (imper. 2 m. pl.); 'beware!'
الضَّارَّ: الـ + ضَارّ — ḍārr, harmful (act. part., acc.); 'the harmful'
بِالْكَذِبِ: بِـ + الـ + كَذِب — kadhib, lie (gen.); bi-, in (لَا بَأْسَ بِـ: 'there is no harm in'); 'in the lie'
الِاضْطِرَارِ: الـ + اِضْطِرَار — iḍṭirār, compulsion, necessity (gen.); 'the compulsion'
وَلَايَنْفَعُ: و + لَا + يَنْفَعُ — nafaʿa, to benefit (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it does not benefit' (print runs لا to the verb)
لَايَضُرُّ: لَا + يَضُرُّ — ḍarra, to harm (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'does not harm' (print runs لا to the verb)
وُجُودِ: وُجُود — wujūd, existence, presence (gen., construct); 'the presence of'
دَانِقٌ: دَانِق — dāniq, a sixth of a dirham, a very small coin (nom.); 'a danaq'
أَسْتَبْدِلُ: اِسْتَبْدَلَ — istabdala, to exchange (impf. 1 sg.); 'I exchange'
نِعَمَ: نِعَم — niʿam, blessings (pl. of نِعْمَة; acc., construct); 'blessings of'
بِنِعَمِ: بِـ + نِعَم — niʿam, blessings (gen.); bi-, for (اِسْتَبْدَلَ … بِـ 'exchange … for'); 'for the blessings of'
قَصَدَتْ: قَصَدَ — qaṣada, to make for, go to (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she made for'
فَسَكَنَتْ: فَـ + سَكَنَتْ — sakana, to become still, be quiet (perf. 3 f. sg.; print: فسكنت); fa-, then; 'and she became still'
يْنِ: —yni — the last part of the word stretched across the line by filler dashes (الْبَيْت————يْنِ); together البيتين, 'the two verses' (dual gen.)
اشْرَحُوا: اشْرَحُوا — sharaḥa, to explain, lay open (imperative pl.); 'explain!'
اعْوِجَاجَهُ: اعْوِجَاج + هُ — iʿwijāj, crookedness (verbal noun of IX اعوجّ) + -hu, his; acc.; 'his crookedness'
السَّبْعُونَ: السَّبْعُون — al-sabʿūn, the seventieth (as a night's ordinal), seventy; 'the seventieth'
الْخَنْجَرِ: الـ + خَنْجَر — khanjar, dagger (m.), gen.; 'the dagger'
اِصْطَدْ: اِصْطَدْ — iṣṭāda, to hunt, to fish (VIII imperative m. sg., of صيد); 'fish!'
أَتَاهَا: أَتَى + هَا — atā, to come (perf.; with بِـ 'to bring') + -hā, her; 'he came to her, brought her'
أَتْلَفْتَهَا: أَتْلَفْ + تَ + هَا — atlafa, to ruin, wear out (IV perf.) + -ta, you + -hā, her; 'you have worn her out'
أَجَابَتْنِي: أَجَابَ + تْ + نِي — ajāba, to answer (IV perf.) + -at, she + -nī, me; 'she answered me'
أَخْرَبَ: أَخْرَبَ — akhraba, to lay waste, ruin (IV perf.); 'he would have laid waste'
بَنَاتُهُ: بَنَات + هُ — banāt, daughters (pl. of بِنْت) + -hu, his; 'his daughters'
بِجَارِيَتِي: بِـ + جَارِيَة + ي — bi-, with + jāriya, slave-girl (f.) + -ī, my; 'with my slave-girl'
بِذَنْبِي: بِـ + ذَنْب + ي — bi-, with/of + dhanb, offence, sin (m.) + -ī, my; 'of my offence'
تَأْتُوا: تَ + أْتُوا — ta-, you + atā, to come (subj. pl.); 'you come'
تُبْرِئُنِي: تُ + بْرِئُ + نِي — tu-, you (imperfect prefix) + abraʾa, to cure (IV) + -nī, me; 'will you cure me'
جُهدَك: جُهْد + كَ — juhd, utmost effort (m.) + -ka, your; acc.; 'your utmost'
حِيلَتُهُ: حِيلَة + هُ — ḥīla, ruse, stratagem (f.) + -hu, his; nom.; 'his ruse'
رُؤْيَةِ: رُؤْيَة — ruʾya, sight, seeing (f., verbal noun of رأى), gen.; 'the sight (of)'
زَجْرَكَ: زَجْر + كَ — zajr, rebuke, scolding (verbal noun of زجر) + -ka, your/you; acc.; 'to rebuke you'
فَاحْفَظْنِي: فَ + احْفَظْ + نِي — fa-, so + ḥafiẓa, to guard, keep (imperative) + -nī, me; 'so guard me'
فَاقْعُدْ: فَ + اقْعُدْ — fa-, so + qaʿada, to sit (imperative m. sg.); 'so sit'
فَأَتَاهُ: فَ + أَتَى + هُ — fa-, and + atā, to come (perf.; with بِـ 'to bring') + -hu, him; 'and he brought him'
فَخَلَّاهُ: فَ + خَلَّى + هُ — fa-, and + khallā, to leave, let go (II perf.) + -hu, him; 'and he left him'
مَوْقُوفاً: مَوْقُوف — mawqūf, fixed, held still (pass. part. of وقف), acc.; 'held steady'
مُتَّكِيًا: مُتَّكِي — muttakiʾ, leaning, reclining (VIII act. part. of وكأ, hamza unwritten), acc.; 'leaning'
مُحَمَّلَةً: مُحَمَّلَة — muḥammala, loaded, laden (II pass. part. of حمل, f.), acc.; 'loaded'
مُقْلَتَهُ: مُقْلَة + هُ — muqla, eye, eyeball (f.) + -hu, his; acc.; 'his eye'
وَالزَّبَرْجَدِ: وَ + الـ + زَبَرْجَد — wa-, and + zabarjad, chrysolite, peridot (m.), gen.; 'and chrysolite'
وَالْفُضَلَاءِ: وَ + الـ + فُضَلَاء — wa-, and + fuḍalāʾ, men of merit, the learned (pl. of فَاضِل), gen.; 'and the eminent'
وَأُسَاعِدُكَ: وَ + أُ + سَاعِدُ + كَ — wa-, and + u-, I + sāʿada, to help (III) + -ka, you; 'and I would help you'
وَأَتْلَفَنِي: وَ + أَتْلَفَ + نِي — wa-, and + atlafa, to ruin, destroy (IV perf.) + -nī, me; 'and ruined me'
وَأَجْلَسَتْنِى: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and + ajlasa, to seat (IV perf.) + -at, she + -nī, me (final ى as printed); 'and she seated me'
وَأَذْهَلَتْ: وَ + أَذْهَلَ + تْ — wa-, and + adhhala, to bewilder, stun (IV perf.) + -at, she; 'and she bewildered'
وَأَنْشَدْتُهَا: وَ + أَنْشَدَ + تُ + هَا — wa-, and + anshada, to recite verse (IV perf.) + -tu, I + -hā, her; 'and I recited to her'
وَحَدَاثَةِ: وَ + حَدَاثَة — wa-, and + ḥadātha, youth, newness (f.; حَدَاثَةُ السِّنِّ 'youthfulness'), gen.; 'and the youth (of)'
وَيْلًا: وَيْل — woe (m.), acc. in the curse formula وَيْلًا لَكِ; 'woe (to you)'
وِفَاقِهِمْ: وِفَاق + هِمْ — wifāq, concord, agreement (m.) + -him, their; gen.; 'their concord'
إِمَامَ: إِمَام — imām, leader, imam (m.), acc. after the vocative يَا; '(O) imam'
نَغْزِلُ: نَ + غَزَلَ — na-, we + ghazala, to spin (imperf. 1 pl.); 'we spin'
وَنَشْتَغِلُ: وَ + نَشْتَغِلُ — wa-, and + nashtaghilu, we busy ourselves, work (VIII, imperf. 1 pl.); 'and we work'
بِمَعَاشِنَا: بِـ + مَعَاش + نَا — bi-, in, at (prep., marking the thing worked at) + maʿāsh, livelihood (m.) + -nā, our; gen. after بِـ; 'at our livelihood'
تَمُرُّ: مَرَّ — marra, to pass (imperf. 3 f. sg., with a plural non-human subject); 'there pass'
مَشَاعِلُ: مَشَاعِل — mashāʿil, torches (pl. of مِشْعَل, m.); 'torches'
وُلَاةِ: وُلَاة — wulāt, governors (pl. of وَالٍ, m.), gen. in iḍāfa; '(of) the governors'
ضَوْئِهَا: ضَوْء + هَا — ḍawʾ, light (m.) + -hā, its; gen. after فِي; 'in its light'
يَحْرُمُ: حَرُمَ — ḥarama, to be forbidden (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'is forbidden'
أَسْتَشِفُّ: اِسْتَشَفَّ — istashaffa, to see through a thin thing, to perceive the glow of (X, imperf. 1 sg.); 'I see through'
الْوَرَعَ: الـ + وَرَع — al-, the + waraʿ, scrupulousness, pious restraint (m.), acc.; 'the scrupulousness'
قُلُوبِكُمْ: قُلُوب + كُمْ — qulūb, hearts (pl. of قَلْب, m.) + -kum, your (m. pl.); gen. after مِنْ; 'your hearts'
مَالِكُ: مَالِك — Mālik (proper name; lit. 'owner, possessor'), nom.; 'Mālik'
يَشْتَهِيهِ: يَشْتَهِي + هُ — yashtahī, he desires (VIII, imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'he desires it'
صَابِرِي: صَابِرِي — ṣābirī, be patient, endure (III imperative, f. sg., addressed to the soul)
أُوَافِقُكِ: أُ + وَافَقَ + كِ — u-, I + wāfaqa, to agree with, to comply with (III, imperf. 1 sg.) + -ki, you (f.); 'I will agree with you'
مُخَالَفَتِهَا: مُخَالَفَة + هَا — mukhālafa, opposing, contradicting (f.; verbal noun of III) + -hā, it; gen. after فِي; 'in opposing it'
وَبَلَاؤُهَا: وَ + بَلَاء + هَا — wa-, and + balāʾ, affliction, trial (m.) + -hā, its; nom.; 'and its affliction'
مُتَابَعَتِهَا: مُتَابَعَة + هَا — mutābaʿa, following, obeying (f.; verbal noun of III) + -hā, it; gen. after فِي; 'in following it'
مَنْصُورُ: مَنْصُور — Manṣūr (proper name; lit. 'made victorious'), nom.; 'Manṣūr'
عَمَّارٍ: عَمَّار — ʿAmmār (proper name), gen. in the patronymic بن; '(son of) ʿAmmār'
حَجَجْتُ: حَجَّ — ḥajja, to make the pilgrimage (perf. 1 sg.); 'I made the pilgrimage'
حَجَّةً: حَجَّة — ḥajja, one pilgrimage (f.), acc. as internal object; 'a pilgrimage'
فَقَصَدْتُ: فَ + قَصَدَ — fa-, and then + qaṣada, to make for, head for (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I made for'
الْكُوفَةِ: الـ + كُوفَة — al-, the + Kūfa, the city of Kūfa in Iraq (f.), gen. in iḍāfa; '(of) Kūfa'
مُظْلِمَةً: مُظْلِمَة — muẓlima, dark (f.; active participle of IV), acc. as predicate of كَانَتْ; 'dark'
بِصَارِخٍ: بِـ + صَارِخ — bi-, marks what appears after وَإِذَا (not a preposition of meaning) + ṣārikh, one who cries out, crier (m.; active participle), gen.; '(behold,) a crier'
جَوْفِ: جَوْف — jawf, inside, belly, depths (m.), gen. in iḍāfa after فِي; 'the depths (of)'
إِلَهِي: إِلَه + ي — ilāh, god, God (m.) + -ī, my; 'my God'
وَعِزَّتِكَ: وَ + عِزَّة + كَ — wa-, by (oath particle) + ʿizza, might, glory (f.) + -ka, your; gen. after the oath; 'by Your might'
وَجَلَالِكَ: وَ + جَلَال + كَ — wa-, and (by) + jalāl, majesty (m.) + -ka, your; gen.; 'and Your majesty'
بِمَعْصِيَتِى: بِـ + مَعْصِيَة + ي — bi-, by means of, in (prep.) + maʿṣiya, disobedience (f.) + -ī, my; the print spells the final ى; gen. after بِـ; 'by my disobedience'
مُخَالَفَتَكَ: مُخَالَفَة + كَ — mukhālafa, opposing (f.) + -ka, you; acc., object of أَرَدْتُ; 'opposing You'
جَاهِلٌ: جَاهِل — jāhil, ignorant (m.; active participle of جَهِلَ), nom. predicate; 'ignorant'
قَضَيْتَهَا: قَضَى + هَا — qaḍā, to decree, ordain (perf. 2 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'You decreed it'
أَزَلِكَ: أَزَل + كَ — azal, eternity without beginning (m.) + -ka, your; gen. in iḍāfa after قَدِيم; 'Your eternity'
فَاغْفِرْلِي: فَ + اِغْفِرْ + لِـ + ي — fa-, so + ighfir, forgive (imperative) + li-, to, for (prep., marking the one forgiven) + -ī, me; the print joins لي to the verb; 'so forgive me'
عَصَيْتُكَ: عَصَى + كَ — ʿaṣā, to disobey (perf. 1 sg.) + -ka, you; 'I disobeyed You'
بِجَهْلِي: بِـ + جَهْل + ي — bi-, through, by reason of (prep.) + jahl, ignorance (m.) + -ī, my; gen. after بِـ; 'through my ignorance'
دُعَائِهِ: دُعَاء + هُ — duʿāʾ, prayer, supplication (m.) + -hi, his; gen. after مِنْ; 'his prayer'
الْآيَةَ: الـ + آيَة — al-, the + āya, a verse of the Qurʾān, sign (f.), acc.; 'the verse'
آمَنُوا: آمَنَ — āmana, to believe (IV, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they have believed'
قُوْا: وَقَى — waqā, to guard, protect (imperative, m. pl.), pointed as in the print; 'guard!'
وَأَهْلِيكُمْ: وَ + أَهْلِي + كُمْ — wa-, and + ahlī, families (acc. pl. of أَهْل, the plural أَهْلِين) + -kum, your; 'and your families'
وَقُودُهَا: وَقُود + هَا — waqūd, fuel (m.) + -hā, its; nom. subject; 'its fuel'
وَالْحِجَارَةُ: وَ + الـ + حِجَارَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥijāra, stones (coll. f.), nom.; 'and the stones'
سَقْطَةً: سَقْطَة — saqṭa, a fall, a thud (f.), acc. object; 'a thud'
فَمَضَيْتُ: فَ + مَضَى — fa-, and then + maḍā, to go on, proceed (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I went on'
مَدْرَجِنَا: مَدْرَج + نَا — madraj, path, route (m.) + -nā, our; gen. after إِلَى; 'our route'
بِجِنَازَةٍ: بِـ + جِنَازَة — bi-, marks what appears after وَإِذَا (not a preposition of meaning) + janāza, funeral procession, bier (f.), gen.; '(behold,) a funeral'
قُوَّتُهَا: قُوَّة + هَا — quwwa, strength (f.) + -hā, her; nom. subject; 'her strength'
فَسَأَلْتُهَا: فَ + سَأَلَ + هَا — fa-, and + saʾala, to ask (perf. 1 sg.) + -hā, her; 'and I asked her'
جَنَازَةُ: جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, bier (f.), nom. predicate in iḍāfa; 'funeral (of)'
مَرَّبِنَا: مَرَّ + بِـ + نَا — marra, to pass + bi-, by (prep.; مَرَّ بِـ 'pass by') + -nā, us; the print runs them together; 'passed by us'
فَتَلَا: فَ + تَلَا — fa-, and + talā, to recite (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he recited'
آيَةً: آيَة — āya, a verse (f.), acc.; 'a verse'
فَانْفَطَرَتْ: فَ + اِنْفَطَرَ — fa-, and + infaṭara, to burst, split (VII, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and it burst'
مَرَارَةُ: مَرَارَة — marāra, gall-bladder, bile; also bitterness (f.), nom. subject in iḍāfa; 'the gall-bladder (of)'
تَصْحِيحِ: تَصْحِيح — taṣḥīḥ, setting right, correcting (m.; verbal noun of II), gen. in iḍāfa after عِنْدَ; 'the correcting (of)'
الضَّمَائِرِ: الـ + ضَمَائِر — al-, the + ḍamāʾir, inner thoughts, consciences (pl. of ضَمِير, m.), gen.; 'the consciences'
تُغْفَرُ: غَفَرَ — ghafara, to forgive (passive imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'are forgiven'
الصَّغَائِرُ: الـ + صَغَائِر — al-, the + ṣaghāʾir, minor sins (pl. of صَغِيرَة, f.), nom.; 'the small sins'
وَالْكَبَائِرُ: وَ + الـ + كَبَائِر — wa-, and + al-, the + kabāʾir, grave sins (pl. of كَبِيرَة, f.), nom.; 'and the great'
تَرْكِ: تَرْك — tark, leaving, giving up (m.; verbal noun), gen. after عَلَى; 'leaving'
الْآثَامِ: الـ + آثَام — al-, the + āthām, sins (pl. of إِثْم, m.), gen. in iḍāfa; 'the sins'
الْفُتُوحُ: الـ + فُتُوح — al-, the + futūḥ, openings, spiritual gifts (pl. of فَتْح, m.), nom. subject; 'the openings'
بَلِيَّةٌ: بَلِيَّة — baliyya, trial, affliction (f.), nom. predicate; 'a trial'
وَقَلِيلُ: وَ + قَلِيل — wa-, and + qalīl, a little, a small amount (m.), nom. in iḍāfa; 'and a little (of)'
يَشْغَلُ: شَغَلَ — shaghala, to occupy, distract (imperf. 3 m. sg.); with عَنْ 'distracts from'
وَكَثِيرُهَا: وَ + كَثِير + هَا — wa-, and + kathīr, much (m.) + -hā, of it; nom. subject; 'and much of it'
يُنْسِيكَ: يُنْسِي + كَ — yunsī, to make forget (IV, imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'makes you forget'
قَلِيلَهَا: قَلِيل + هَا — qalīl, a little (m.) + -hā, of it; acc. second object; 'a little of it'
وَسُئِلَ: وَ + سُئِلَ — wa-, and + suʾila, was asked (passive perf. 3 m. sg. of سَأَلَ); 'and he was asked'
حَازِمٍ: حَازِم — Ḥāzim (proper name; lit. 'resolute'), gen. in the kunya; '(Abū) Ḥāzim'
أَبْسَرُ: أَبْسَر — abṣar, as printed; unknown form, perhaps a slip for أَيْسَر 'easier, better-off' (elative); read 'most fortunate' by sense
أَحْمَقُ: أَحْمَق — aḥmaq, most foolish (m.; elative of حَمُقَ), nom. predicate in iḍāfa; 'the most foolish'; here simply 'foolish', the afʿal adjective of defects (diptote), nom., in the predicate after mā … illā
آخِرَتَهُ: آخِرَة + هُ — ākhira, the hereafter (f.) + -hu, his; acc. object; 'his hereafter'
بِدُنْيَا: بِـ + دُنْيَا — bi-, for, in exchange for (prep.; بَاعَ بِـ 'sell for') + dunyā, the world, this life (f.); 'for the world (of)'
وَرَدَمَاءَ: وَرَدَ + مَاءَ — warada, to come to a watering-place (perf. 3 m. sg.) + māʾ, water (m.), acc.; the print runs the two together; 'came to the water (of)'
مَدْيَنَ: مَدْيَن — Madyan, Midian (proper name, diptote), gen.; '(of) Midian'
أَنْزَلْتَ: أَنْزَلَ — anzala, to send down (IV, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'You have sent down'
رَبَّهُ: رَبّ + هُ — rabb, lord (m.) + -hu, his; acc. object; 'his Lord'
يَسْأَلِ: سَأَلَ — saʾala, to ask (imperf. 3 m. sg., jussive after لَمْ, with a linking kasra before الـ); 'he did not ask'
فَسَقَى: فَ + سَقَى — fa-, and + saqā, to give water to (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he watered'
تُصْدِرِ: أَصْدَرَ — aṣdara, to send back, drive away from the water (IV, jussive 3 f. sg. after لَمْ, with a linking kasra); 'did not drive away'
الرِّعَاءُ: الـ + رِعَاء — al-, the + riʿāʾ, shepherds (pl. of رَاعٍ, m.), nom.; 'the shepherds'
رَجَعَتَا: رَجَعَ — rajaʿa, to return (perf. 3 f. dual); 'the two returned'
أَخْبَرَتَا: أَخْبَرَ — akhbara, to inform (IV, perf. 3 f. dual); 'the two informed'
شُعَيْبًا: شُعَيْب — Shuʿayb, the Qurʾānic prophet of Midian (proper name), acc. apposition; 'Shuʿayb'
لِأَحْدِيهِمَا: لِـ + أَحْدِي + هِمَا — li-, to (prep.) + aḥdī, one (f.; the print's spelling of إِحْدَى) + -humā, of the two; 'to one of the two'
وَادْعِيهِ: وَ + اُدْعِ + هُ — wa-, and + udʿi, call (imperative, f. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and call him'
لِيَجْزِيَكَ: لِـ + يَجْزِي + كَ — li-, so that, in order that (+ subjunctive) + yajzī, he recompenses (imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you; 'so that he may repay you'
أَجْرَ: أَجْر — ajr, wage, reward (m.), acc. object in iḍāfa; 'the wage (of)'
مَاسَقَيْتَ: مَا + سَقَيْتَ — mā, what + saqayta, you watered (perf. 2 m. sg.); the print runs them together; 'what you watered'
فَكَرِهَ: فَ + كَرِهَ — fa-, and + kariha, to dislike (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he disliked'
لَايَتْبَعَهَا: لَا + يَتْبَعَ + هَا — lā, not + yatbaʿa, he follows (imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hā, her; the print runs the أن and لا together with the verb; 'that he not follow her'
عَجُزٍ: عَجُز — ʿajuz, hips, buttocks (m.), gen. in iḍāfa after ذَاتَ; 'hips'
فَكَانَتِ: فَ + كَانَتِ — fa-, and + kānat, was, would (f. sg., with a linking kasra); 'and (the wind) would'
فَيَظْهَرُ: فَ + يَظْهَرُ — fa-, so that + yaẓharu, he/it appears (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and it showed'
لِمُوسَى: لِـ + مُوسَى — li-, to, for (prep.; ظَهَرَ لِـ 'appear to') + Mūsā, Moses; 'to Moses'
عَجُزُهَا: عَجُز + هَا — ʿajuz, hips (m.) + -hā, her; nom. subject; 'her hips'
فَيَغُضُّ: فَ + يَغُضُّ — fa-, and + yaghuḍḍu, he lowers (imperf. 3 m. sg.; with بَصَر 'lowers his gaze'); 'and he lowers'
كُونِي: كَانَ — kāna, to be (imperative, f. sg.); 'be!'
أَمَامَكِ: أَمَام + كِ — amām, in front (adv., m.) + -ki, you (f.); 'in front of you'
فَمَشَتْ: فَ + مَشَتْ — fa-, so + mashat, she walked (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'so she walked'
شُعَيْبٍ: شُعَيْب — Shuʿayb, the prophet of Midian (proper name), gen. after عَلَى; '(upon) Shuʿayb'
وَالْعَشَاءُ: وَ + الـ + عَشَاء — wa-, and (circumstantial) + al-, the + ʿashāʾ, supper, evening meal (m.), nom.; 'and the supper'
مُهَيَّءٌ: مُهَيَّأ — muhayyaʾ, prepared, ready (m.; passive participle of II), nom. predicate; the print spells it مهيء; 'ready'
مُهَيٌّ: muhayyan — participle of هَيَّأَ, 'made ready' (m.; the print has tanwin and no hamza); 'prepared, ready'
شُعَيْبٌ: Shuʿayb — the prophet Jethro of Midian (proper name, nom.)
يَامُوسَى: يَا + مُوسَى — yā, O (vocative particle, run together in the print) + Mūsā, Moses; 'O Moses'
أُعْطِيَكَ: uʿṭiya- — form IV of عَطَا/أَعْطَى, to give (subj. 1s, after أَنْ) + -ka, you (m.); 'that I give you'
وَفِضَّةٍ: وَ + فِضَّة — wa-, and + fiḍḍa, silver (f., gen. after min); 'and silver'
شَابُّ: shābb — young man, youth (m., vocative); 'O youth'
ضَيْفِى: ضَيْف + ـِي — ḍayf, guest (m., nom., predicate) + -ī, my (the print writes ى); 'my guest'
وَإِكْرَامُ: وَ + إِكْرَام — wa-, and + ikrām, honouring, hospitality (verbal noun of form IV, m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the honouring of'
الضَّيْفِ: الـ + ضَيْف — ḍayf, guest (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the guest'
وَعَادَةُ: وَ + عَادَة — wa-, and + ʿāda, custom, habit (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the custom of'
بِإِطْعَامِ: بِـ + إِطْعَام — bi-, by (prep., instrument or manner) + iṭʿām, feeding (verbal noun of form IV, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'by feeding'
اسْتَأْجَرَ: ista'jara — form X of أَجَرَ, to hire (perf. 3ms; hamza supplied); 'he hired'
ثَمَانِيَ: thamāniya — eight (the form before an iḍāfa, gen. here, with the final yā' kept); 'eight'
حِجَجٍ: ḥijaj — plural of حَجَّة, literally 'pilgrimages', used for 'years' (gen. after thamāniya; the text glosses it أي سنين); 'years'
تَزْوِيجَةُ: tazwījahu — تَزْوِيج + هُ, tazwīj, marrying off (verbal noun of form II) + -hu, his; the print spells the pronoun with ة; 'his marrying-off'
بِنْتَيْهِ: بِنْت + يْ + هِ — bint, daughter (f., dual gen. in an iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'of his two daughters'
عَمَلُ: ʿamal — work, labour (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the work of'
لِشُعَيْبٍ: لِـ + شُعَيْب — li-, for (prep., 'for the benefit of') + Shuʿayb; 'for Shuʿayb'
صَدَاقًا: ṣadāq — dower, bride-gift (m., acc., predicate of kāna); 'a dower'
اِنّي: اِنَّ + ـِي — inna, indeed + -ī, I (the Qurʾānic quotation, pointed in the print); 'indeed I'
أُرِيْدُانْ: أُرِيدُ + أَنْ — urīdu, I want (form IV of رَادَ, imperf. 1s) + an, that (the two run together in the print); 'I want that'
أُنْكِحَكَ: unkiḥa- — form IV of نَكَحَ, to marry off (subj. 1s) + -ka, you (m.); 'that I marry you (to)'
إِحْدَى: iḥdā — one (f., of two or more; first term of an iḍāfa); 'one of'
ابْنَتَيَّ: ابْنَة + يْ + ـِي — ibna, daughter (f., dual gen. in an iḍāfa) + -ya, my; 'my two daughters'
تَأْجُرَنِي: ta'jura- — أَجَرَ, form I, to hire out, let (subj. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'that you hire yourself to me'
أَتْمَمْتَ: atmamta — form IV of تَمَّ, to complete (perf. 2ms); 'you complete'
عَشْرًا: ʿashr — ten (f. count form, acc.; years understood); 'ten'
أَشُقَّ: ashuqqa — شَقَّ, to burden (verb I geminate, subj. 1s, after أَنْ); 'that I burden'
يَرَهُ: yara- + -hu — raʾā, to see (jussive after lam, 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he had not seen him'
لِأَنَّنِي: لِـ + أَنَّ + نِي — li-, because (prep. with anna) + anna, that + -nī, I; 'because I'
مُنْذُزَمَانٍ: مُنْذُ + زَمَان — mundhu, since (prep.) + zamān, time (m., gen.; run together in the print); 'since a time'
اشْتَغَلْتُ: ishtaghaltu — form VIII of شَغَلَ, to be busy, occupied (perf. 1s); 'I was busy'
شِهَابٍ: Shihāb — meteor, flame; here a proper name (gen., in the iḍāfa ibn Shihāb)
أَتَعْرِفُهُ: أَ + تَعْرِفُ + هُ — a-, interrogative particle + taʿrifu, you know (imperf. 2ms) + -hu, him; 'do you know him?'
هُوَجَارِي: هُوَ + جَار + ـِي — huwa, he + jār, neighbour (m., nom., predicate) + -ī, my (run together in the print); 'he is my neighbour'
إِلَّاأَنَّنِي: إِلَّا + أَنَّ + نِي — illā, except + anna, that + -nī, I (run together in the print, which drops one alif); 'except that I'
أُكَلِّمْهُ: ukallim- + -hu — form II of كَلَمَ, to speak to (jussive 1s after lam) + him; 'I have not spoken to him'
فَنَسِيتَ: فَـ + نَسِيتَ — fa-, so + nasīta, you forgot (perf. 2ms); 'so you forgot'
جَارَكَ: jār + -ka — neighbour (m., acc., object) + your (m.); 'your neighbour'
وَلَوْأَحْبَبْتَ: وَ + لَوْ + أَحْبَبْتَ — wa-, and + law, if (unreal condition) + aḥbabta, you loved (form IV of حَبَّ, perf. 2ms); 'and if you had loved'
لَأَحْبَبْتَ: لَـ + أَحْبَبْتَ — la-, then (answer to law) + aḥbabta, you loved; 'you would have loved'
لِلْجَارِ: لِـ + الـ + جَار — li-, for, to (prep., 'belongs to') + al- + jār, neighbour (m., gen.); 'for the neighbour'
الْجَارِ: الـ + جَار — jār, neighbour (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the neighbour'
حَقٌّ: ḥaqq — right, due, claim (m., nom.; the print has no accusative alif); 'a right'
كَحَقِّ: كَـ + حَقّ — ka-, like (prep., 'as, in the manner of') + ḥaqq, right (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the right of'
الْقَرَابَةِ: الـ + قَرَابَة — qarāba, kinship (f., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of kinship'
الْبَلْخِيُّ: الـ + بَلْخِيّ — al-balkhī, of Balkh, from Balkh (nisba, m., nom.; apposition); 'the Balkhī'
قَدْحَجَّ: قَدْ + حَجَّ — qad, already (particle with perfect) + ḥajja, he made the pilgrimage (I geminate, perf. 3ms; run together in the print); 'he had made the pilgrimage'
فَاجْتَمَعْنَا: فَـ + اجْتَمَعْنَا — fa-, so + ijtamaʿnā, we gathered (form VIII of جَمَعَ, perf. 1p); 'so we met'
الطَّوَافِ: الـ + طَوَاف — ṭawāf, circumambulation of the Kaʿba (m., gen. after fī); 'the circling'
لِشَقِيقٍ: لِـ + شَقِيق — li-, to (prep., after qāla) + Shaqīq; 'to Shaqīq'
مَاشَأْنُكُمْ: مَا + شَأْنُ + كُمْ — mā, what (interrogative) + shaʾn, affair, state (m., nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'what is your affair' (run together in the print)
رُزِقْنَا: ruziqnā — razaqa, to provide (passive perf. 1p); 'we are given provision'
وَإِذَاجُعْنَا: وَ + إِذَا + جُعْنَا — wa-, and + idhā, when + juʿnā, we are hungry (jāʿa, I hollow, perf. 1p); 'and when we are hungry'
بَلْخٍ: Balkh — city in Khurāsān (gen. after kilāb; second term of an iḍāfa)
وَلَكِنَّنَا: وَ + لَكِنَّ + نَا — wa-, and + lākinna, but + -nā, we; 'but we'
آثَرْنَا: ātharnā — form IV of أَثَرَ, to prefer, put before oneself (perf. 1p); 'we prefer others'
جُعْنَا: juʿnā — jāʿa, to be hungry (I hollow, perf. 1p); 'we are hungry'
شَكَرْنَا: shakarnā — shakara, to thank (perf. 1p); 'we give thanks'
أُسْتَاذِي: ustādh + -ī — master, teacher (m., nom., predicate) + my; 'my master'
عِمْرَانَ: ʿImrān — proper name (gen., in the iḍāfa ibn ʿImrān; diptote) Also gen. as the second term of Āl ʿImrān, 'the Family of ʿImrān', the name of sura 3.
حَاتِمًا: Ḥātim — proper name (acc., object of saʾala), Ḥātim al-Aṣamm
الْأَصَمَّ: الـ + أَصَمّ — al-aṣamm, the deaf (m., acc.; his nickname); 'the Deaf'
التَّوَكُّلِ: الـ + تَوَكُّل — tawakkul, trust in God, reliance (form V verbal noun, gen. after fī); 'reliance'
خَصْلَتَيْنِ: khaṣla, trait, quality (f., dual gen. after ʿalā); 'two qualities'
لَايَأْكُلُهُ: لَا + يَأْكُلُ + هُ — lā, not + yaʾkulu, he eats (imperf. 3ms) + -hu, it (run together in the print); 'will not eat it'
فَاطْمَأَنَّتْ: فَـ + اطْمَأَنَّتْ — fa-, so + iṭmaʾannat, was at ease (form IX/quadriliteral of طَمَأَنَ, perf. 3fs); 'so it was at rest'
أُخْلَقْ: ukhlaq — khalaqa, to create (passive jussive 1s after lam); 'I was not created'
فَاسْتَحَيْتُ: فَـ + اسْتَحَيْتُ — fa-, so + istaḥaytu, I felt shame (form X of حَيِيَ, perf. 1s; the print has one yā'); 'so I was ashamed'
قَدْسَمِعْتُ: قَدْ + سَمِعْتُ — qad, indeed + samiʿtu, I heard (perf. 1s; run together in the print); 'I have heard'
تَابِعَةٌ: tābiʿa — follower (f., nom., predicate; active participle of تَبِعَ); 'a follower'
فَأَذْكُرُ: فَـ + أَذْكُرُ — fa-, so + adhkuru, I mention (imperf. 1s); 'so I will mention'
الْإِمَامُ: الـ + إِمَام — imām, leader, founder of a school (m., nom.); 'the imam'
الشَّافِعِيُّ: الـ + شَافِعِيّ — al-Shāfiʿī, Muḥammad ibn Idrīs al-Shāfiʿī (d. 820), founder of the Shāfiʿī school of law (nom.)
يُقَسِّمُ: yuqassimu — form II of قَسَمَ, to divide (imperf. 3ms); 'he divided'
الثُّلُثُ: الـ + ثُلُث — thulth, third (m., nom.); 'the third'
لِلْعِلْمِ: لِـ + الـ + عِلْم — li-, for (prep., 'devoted to') + ʿilm, knowledge (gen.); 'for learning'
لِلنَّوْمِ: لِـ + الـ + نَوْم — li-, for (prep., 'devoted to') + nawm, sleep (m., gen.); 'for sleep'
لِلتَّهَجُّدِ: لِـ + الـ + تَهَجُّد — li-, for (prep., 'devoted to') + tahajjud, night prayer, keeping vigil (form V verbal noun, gen.); 'for night prayer'
حَنِيفَةَ: Ḥanīfa — proper name (gen., in the name Abū Ḥanīfa; diptote)
لِآخَرَإنَّ: لِـ + آخَر + أَنَّ — li-, to (prep.) + ākhar, another (m., gen.) + anna, that (run together in the print); 'to another: that'
أَسْتَحِي: astaḥī — form X of حَيِيَ, to be ashamed (imperf. 1s); 'I am ashamed'
أُوصَفَ: ūṣafa — waṣafa, to describe (passive subj. 1s after an); 'that I be described'
بِمَالَيْسَ: بِـ + مَا + لَيْسَ — bi-, by (prep., 'as, with') + mā, what + laysa, is not (run together in the print); 'by what is not'
شَهْرِ: shahr — month (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the month of'
الشَّافِعِىُّ: الـ + شَافِعِيّ — al-Shāfiʿī (nom.; the print writes the nisba with ى)
مَاشَبِعْتُ: مَا + شَبِعْتُ — mā, not (negative of the perfect) + shabiʿtu, I was sated (perf. 1s; run together in the print); 'I have not been sated'
خُبْزِ: khubz — bread (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'bread of'
عَشْرَسِنِينَ: عَشْرَ + سِنِينَ — ʿashra, ten (f. count form, acc.) + sinīn, years (f. plural, gen.; run together in the print); 'ten years'
الشِّبَعَ: الـ + شِبَع — shibaʿ, satiety, a full stomach (m., acc. after anna); 'satiety'
يُقَسِّى: yuqassī — form II of قَسَا, to harden (imperf. 3ms; the print writes ى); 'hardens'
الْفِطْنَةَ: الـ + فِطْنَة — fiṭna, shrewdness, intelligence (f., acc., object); 'the wits'
وَيَجْلِبُ: وَ + يَجْلِبُ — wa-, and + yajlibu, he brings, draws on (imperf. 3ms); 'and brings on'
وَيُضْعِفُ: وَ + يُضْعِفُ — wa-, and + yuḍʿifu, he weakens (form IV, imperf. 3ms); 'and weakens'
الْقِيَامِ: الـ + قِيَام — qiyām, standing (verbal noun of قَامَ, gen. after ʿan); 'standing' Also 'getting up', after qadara ʿalā: لَاأَقْدِرُ عَلَى الْقِيَامِ 'unable to get up'.
السُّكَّرِيِّ: الـ + سُكَّرِيّ — al-sukkarī, the sugar-seller (nisba, gen.; part of a name)
أَوْرَعَ: awraʿ — more scrupulous, more pious (elative of وَرِعَ, m., acc. after mā raʾaytu); 'more scrupulous'
أَفْصَحَ: أَفْصَحَ — afṣaḥa, he spoke out, made plain (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'about': afṣaḥa lahā ʿani al-ḍamīr, 'he opened his heart to her'); also the elative afṣaḥ, 'more eloquent'
إِدْرِيسَ: Idrīs — proper name (gen., in ibn Idrīs; diptote)
الشَّافِعِيِّ: الـ + شَافِعِيّ — al-Shāfiʿī (gen., part of the name)
وَالْحَارِثُ: وَ + الـ + حَارِث — wa-, and (with, 'I and him') + al-Ḥārith, proper name (nom.); 'and al-Ḥārith'
لَبِيبٍ: Labīb — proper name (gen., in ibn Labīb), 'intelligent'
الصَّفَّارُ: الـ + صَفَّار — al-ṣaffār, the brass-worker (m., nom.; trade name); 'the brass-worker'
تِلْمِيذَ: tilmīdh — pupil, disciple (m., acc., predicate of kāna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'a pupil of'
الْمُزَنِيِّ: الـ + مُزَنِيّ — al-Muzanī, Ismāʿīl al-Muzanī, pupil of al-Shāfiʿī (gen.)
تَعَالَي: taʿālā — form VI of عَلَا, 'He is exalted' (perf. 3ms; the print writes ي); 'the Exalted'
لَايَنْطِقُونَ: لَا + يَنْطِقُونَ — lā, not + yanṭiqūna, they speak (imperf. 3mp; run together in the print); 'they do not speak'
يُؤْذَنُ: yu'dhanu — adhina li-, to permit (form I, passive imperf. 3ms); 'permission is given'
فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ: فَـ + يَعْتَذِرُونَ — fa-, so that (with a following indicative, Qurʾānic) + yaʿtadhirūna, they make excuse (form VIII of عَذَرَ, imperf. 3mp); 'so that they make excuse'
الْإِمَامَ: الـ + إِمَام — imām, leader, founder of a school (m., acc., object); 'the imam'
الشَّافِعِيَّ: الـ + شَافِعِيّ — al-Shāfiʿī (acc., object of raʾaytu)
وَاقْشَعَرَّ: وَ + اقْشَعَرَّ — wa-, and + iqshaʿarra, to bristle, shudder (quadriliteral form IX, perf. 3ms); 'and shuddered'
وَاضْطَرَبَ: وَ + اضْطَرَبَ — wa-, and + iḍṭaraba, to be agitated, tremble (form VIII of ضَرَبَ, perf. 3ms); 'and trembled'
اضْطِرَابًا: iḍṭirāb — agitation, trembling (verbal noun of form VIII, acc., absolute object); 'a trembling'
الْكَذَّابِينَ: الـ + كَذَّابِينَ — kadhdhāb, liar (m. plural, gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the liars'
وَإِعْرَاضِ: وَ + إِعْرَاض — wa-, and + iʿrāḍ, turning away, aversion (form IV verbal noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the aversion of'
الْغَافِلِينَ: الـ + غَافِلِينَ — ghāfil, heedless, negligent (m. plural, gen.; second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the heedless'
خَشَعَتّْ: khashaʿat — khashaʿa, to be humbled, to be lowly (perf. 3fs, agreeing with qulūb; the print has a stray shadda on the tā'); 'were humbled'
قُلُوبُ: qulūb — hearts (plural of قَلْب, m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the hearts of'
هَبْلِي: هَبْ + لِـ + ـِي — hab, give (imperative of وَهَبَ) + li-, to (prep.) + -ī, me (run together in the print); 'give me'
غُفْرَانَ: ghufrān — forgiveness (m., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); 'forgiveness of'
ذُنُوبِي: dhunūb + -ī — sins (plural of ذَنْب, gen. in an iḍāfa) + my; 'my sins'
جُودِكَ: jūd + -ka — generosity (m., gen. after min) + your (m.); 'Your generosity'
وَجَمِّلْنِي: وَ + جَمِّلْ + نِي — wa-, and + jammil, beautify (form II imperative of جَمُلَ) + -nī, me; 'and adorn me'
بِسَتْرِكَ: بِـ + سَتْر + كَ — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + satr, covering, veil (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with Your covering'
تَقْصِيرِي: taqṣīr + -ī — falling short, shortcoming (form II verbal noun, gen. after ʿan) + my; 'my shortcomings'
بِكَرَمِ: بِـ + كَرَم — bi-, by, for the sake of (prep.) + karam, generosity (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the generosity of'
الثِّقَاةِ: الـ + ثِقَاة — thiqāt, trustworthy ones (plural of ثِقَة, gen.; the print writes ة); 'the reliable'
الشَّاطِئِ: الـ + شَاطِئ — shāṭiʾ, bank, shore (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the bank'
لِأَتَوَضَّأَ: لِـ + أَتَوَضَّأَ — li-, in order to (with subjunctive) + atawaḍḍaʾa, I perform ablution (form V of وَضُؤَ, subj. 1s); 'to perform my ablutions'
لِلصَّلٰوةِ: لِـ + الـ + صَلٰوة — li-, for (prep., 'for the sake of') + ṣalāt, prayer (f., gen.; the print writes the older spelling صلوة); 'for the prayer'
إِذْمَرَّبِي: إِذْ + مَرَّ + بِـ + ي — idh, when, suddenly + marra, to pass (I geminate, perf. 3ms) + bi-, by (prep., marrā bi 'pass by') + -ī, me (run together in the print); 'when he passed by me'
أَحْسِنْ: aḥsin — form IV of حَسُنَ, to do well, do properly (imperative 2ms); 'make good'
وُضُؤَكَ: wuḍū' + -ka — ablution (m., acc., object; the print spells the hamza on wāw) + your; 'your ablution'
يُحْسِنِ: yuḥsini — form IV of حَسُنَ, (jussive 3ms, answer to the imperative) 'he will do good'
يَتْبَعُهُ: yatbaʿu + -hu — tabiʿa, to follow (imperf. 3ms) + him; 'following him'
فَأَسْرَعْتُ: فَـ + أَسْرَعْتُ — fa-, so + asraʿtu, I hurried (form IV of سَرُعَ, perf. 1s); 'so I hurried'
وُضُوئِي: wuḍūʾ + -ī — ablution (m., gen. after fī) + my; 'my ablution'
أَقْفُو: aqfū — qafā, to follow, trace (imperf. 1s); 'I follow'
أَثَرَهُ: athar + -hu — track, trace (m., acc., object) + his; 'his track'
تُعَلِّمُنِي: تُعَلِّمُ + نِي — tuʿallimu, you teach (form II of عَلِمَ, imperf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'you teach me'
عَلَّمَكَ: ʿallama + -ka — form II of عَلِمَ, he taught (perf. 3ms) + you (m.); 'taught you'
أَشْفَقَ: ashfaqa — form IV of شَفَقَ, to take care, show tender concern (perf. 3ms; with ʿalā); 'he cares for'
سَامَ: sāma — the print's word, doubtful; the sense wants سَلِمَ salima, 'was safe' (perf. 3ms); 'is safe'
زَهِدَ: zahida — to renounce, be ascetic (perf. 3ms); 'he renounces'
قَرَّتْ: qarrat — qarra, to be cool, be at rest (I geminate, perf. 3fs; qarrat ʿaynuhu, 'his eye is cooled', idiom for joy); 'was cooled'
أَفَلَا: أَ + فَـ + لَا — a-, interrogative + fa-, then + lā, not; 'shall I not?'
أَزِيدُكَ: azīdu + -ka — zāda, to add (imperf. 1s) + you (m.); 'I add to you'
بَلَى: balā — yes (answer to a negative or a question); 'yes'; here, after a prohibition: 'nay, rather': balā fa-isʾalūhā, 'no, rather ask her'
رَاغِبًا: rāghib — desiring, eager (active participle of رَغِبَ, acc., hal); 'longing'; also acc. as predicate of kāna: kunta rāghiban, 'you were desirous' (Night 201)
وَاصْدُقْ: وَ + اصْدُقْ — wa-, and + iṣduq, be truthful (imperative 2ms of صَدَقَ); 'and be truthful'
أُمُورِكَ: umūr + -ka — affairs (plural of أَمْر, gen. in an iḍāfa) + your (m.); 'your affairs'
تَنْجُ: tanju — najā, to be saved (jussive 2ms, answer to the imperative); 'you will be saved'
النَّاجِينَ: الـ + نَاجِينَ — nājī, saved (active participle, m. plural, gen.); 'the saved'
وَدِدْتُ: wadidtu — wadda, to love, wish (perf. 1s); 'I would love'
يَنْتَفِعُونَ: yantafiʿūna — form VIII of نَفَعَ, to benefit (imperf. 3mp); 'they benefit'
يُنْسَبَ: yunsaba — nasaba, to ascribe (passive subj. 3ms, after an lā); 'is ascribed'
نَاظَرْتُ: nāẓartu — form III of نَظَرَ, to dispute, debate with (perf. 1s); 'I disputed'
يُوَفِّقَهُ: yuwaffiqahu — form II of وَفَقَ, to grant success (subj. 3ms) + هُ 'him'; 'he grant him success'
لِلْحَقِّ: li-al-ḥaqqi — لِـ, for, towards (prep.) + الـ + حَقّ, truth (gen.); 'for the truth'
وَيُعِينَهُ: wa-yuʿīnahu — و, and + يُعِينَ, form IV of عَوَنَ, to help (subj. 3ms) + هُ 'him'; 'and help him'
إِظْهَارِهِ: iẓhārihi — iẓhār, manifesting, making evident (form IV verbal noun, gen.) + هِ 'its'; 'to its manifesting'
إِظْهَارِ: iẓhāri — iẓhār, manifesting (form IV verbal noun, in construct, gen.); 'the manifesting of'
يُبَيِّنَ: yubayyina — form II of بَانَ, to make clear (subj. 3ms); 'he make clear'
الْعُجْبَ: al-ʿujba — الـ + عُجْب, conceit, self-admiration (acc.); 'the conceit'
فَاذْكُرْ: fa-udhkur — فَـ, then + اُذْكُرْ, dhakara, to remember (imper. 2ms); 'then remember'
تَرْغَبُ: targhabu — raghiba fī, to desire, yearn for (imperf. 2ms); 'you yearn'
تَرْهَبُ: tarhabu — rahiba min, to dread, fear (imperf. 2ms); 'you dread'
الْمَنْصُورَ: al-manṣūra — الـ + مَنْصُور, 'the victorious', the caliph's title (acc., apposition); 'al-Manṣūr'
جَعَلَكَ: jaʿalaka — jaʿala, to make, appoint (perf. 3ms) + كَ 'you'; 'he has made you'
قَاضِيًا: qāḍiyan — qāḍin, judge (acc., second object); 'a judge'
تَوَقَّعَ: tawaqqaʿa — form V of وَقَعَ, to expect (perf. 3ms); 'he expected'
يُؤْتَى: yuʾtā — passive of أَتَى, to bring (imperf. 3ms); 'there be brought'
تَغَشَّى: taghashshā — form V of غَشِيَ, to cover oneself (perf. 3ms); 'he wrapped himself'
بِثَوْبِهِ: bi-thawbihi — بِـ, with, in (prep.) + ثَوْب, garment (gen.) + هِ 'his'; 'with his garment'
جَاءَهُ: jāʾahu — jāʾa, to come (perf. 3ms) + هُ 'him'; 'he came to him'
وَخَاطَبَهُ: wa-khāṭabahu — و, and + khāṭaba, form III of خَطَبَ, to address (perf. 3ms) + هُ 'him'; 'and addressed him'

أَلِجَ: alija — walaja, to enter, go into (subj. 1s, after أَنْ); 'I enter'

مَنِيَّه: maniyyah — maniyya, death, fate (f., rhyme word, printed with ه for ة); 'death'

الْعَمَلَ: al-ʿamala — الـ + عَمَل, deed, action (acc. after إِنَّ); 'the deed'
الصَّالِحَ: al-ṣāliḥa — الـ + صَالِح, righteous, good (m. acc.); 'the righteous'
يُحْبِطُهُ: yuḥbiṭuhu — form IV of حَبِطَ, to nullify, make void (imperf. 3ms) + هُ 'it'; 'he nullifies it'
بِخَصْلَةٍ: bi-khaṣlatin — بِـ, by means of (prep.) + خَصْلَة, trait, quality (gen. indef.); 'by one trait'
إِلَّاعَنْ: illā ʿan — إِلَّا, except + عَنْ, from (prep.), printed run together; 'except from'

عُمُرِكَ: ʿumrika — ʿumr, life, lifespan (gen.) + كَ 'your'; 'your life'
وَانْصَحْ: wa-anṣaḥ — و, and + اِنْصَحْ, naṣaḥa, to counsel, advise (imper. 2ms); 'and counsel'
مُؤْمِنٍ: muʾminin — muʾmin, believer (gen. indef., after كُلّ); 'believer'
تَخُونَ: takhūna — khāna, to betray (subj. 2ms, after أَنْ); 'you betray'

وَالْخِصَامَ: wa-al-khiṣāma — و, and + الـ + خِصَام, quarrelling (acc.); 'and quarrelling'
يَرِيبُكَ: yarībuka — form I of رَابَ, to make doubtful, trouble (imperf. 3ms) + كَ 'you'; 'it troubles you'
سَلِيمًا: salīman — salīm, sound, safe (acc. indef., predicate of تَكُنْ); 'safe'

وَانْهَ: wa-nha — و, and + اِنْهَ, nahā, to forbid (imper. 2ms); 'and forbid'
الْمُنْكَرِ: al-munkari — الـ + مُنْكَر, the disapproved, wrong (gen. after عَنْ); 'the wrong'
وَأَحْسِنْ: wa-aḥsin — و, and + أَحْسِنْ, form IV of حَسُنَ, to make good (imper. 2ms); 'and make good'
سَرِيرَتَكَ: sarīrataka — sarīra, inner self, secret heart (acc.) + كَ 'your'; 'your inner self'
عَلَانِيَتَكَ: ʿalāniyataka — ʿalāniya, outward state, openness (acc.) + كَ 'your'; 'your outward state'
وَاقْبَلِ: wa-iqbali — و, and + اِقْبَلِ, qabila, to accept (imper. 2ms); 'and accept'
