مِمَّنِ: mimmani — مِنْ, from (prep.) + مَنِ, who (assimilated: min + man); 'from him who'
اعْتَذَرَ: iʿtadhara — form VIII of عَذَرَ, to excuse oneself, apologise (perf. 3ms); 'he apologised'
تُبْغِضْ: tubghiḍ — form IV of بَغَضَ, to hate (jussive 2ms, after لَا); 'do not hate'
وَصِلْ: wa-ṣil — و, and + صِلْ, waṣala, to join, keep ties with (imper. 2ms); 'and keep ties with'
قَطَعَكَ: qaṭaʿaka — qaṭaʿa, to cut off (perf. 3ms) + كَ 'you'; 'he cut you off'
رَفِيقَ: rafīqa — rafīq, companion (acc., predicate of تَكُنْ, in construct); 'companion of'
الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: al-anbiyāʾi — الـ + أَنْبِيَاء, prophets (pl. of نَبِيّ, gen.); 'the prophets'
مُفَوَّضًا: mufawwaḍan — mufawwaḍ, entrusted, committed (form II passive participle, acc. indef.); 'entrusted'
وَاخْشَ: wa-ikhsha — و, and + اِخْشَ, khashiya, to fear (imper. 2ms); 'and fear'
خَشْيَةَ: khashyata — khashya, fear, awe (acc., absolute object, in construct); 'the fear of'
وَمَبْعُوثٌ: wa-mabʿūthun — و, and + مَبْعُوث, raised, resurrected (passive participle of بَعَثَ, nom. indef.); 'and raised'
وَصَائِرٌ: wa-ṣāʾirun — و, and + صَائِر, bound for, going (active participle of صَارَ, nom. indef.); 'and bound'
الْحَشْرِ: al-ḥashri — الـ + حَشْر, the gathering (of the Day of Judgment) (gen.); 'the Gathering'
وَالْوُقُوفِ: wa-al-wuqūfi — و, and + الـ + وُقُوف, standing (verbal noun, gen.); 'and the standing'
وَاذْكُرْ: wa-udhkur — و, and + اُذْكُرْ, dhakara, to remember (imper. 2ms); 'and remember'
مَصِيرَكَ: maṣīraka — maṣīr, destination, end (acc.) + كَ 'your'; 'your destination'
الدَّارَيْنِ: al-dārayni — الـ + دَارَيْنِ, the two abodes (dual of دَار, gen.): this world and the next; 'the two abodes'
عَالِيَةٌ: ʿāliyatun — ʿāliya, lofty, high (f. nom. indef.); 'lofty'
حَامِيَةٌ: ḥāmiyatun — ḥāmiya, hot, blazing (f. nom. indef.); 'blazing'
كَلَامَهُنَّ: kalāmahunna — kalām, speech (acc.) + هُنَّ 'their' (f. pl.); 'their speech'
أَنَّهُنَّ: annahunna — أَنَّ, that + هُنَّ 'they' (f. pl.); 'that they'
زَمَانِهِنَّ: zamānihinna — zamān, time, age (gen.) + هِنَّ 'their' (f. pl.); 'their time'
حُسْنَهُنَّ: ḥusnahunna — ḥusn, beauty (acc.) + هُنَّ 'their' (f. pl.); 'their beauty'
وَجَمَالَهُنَّ: wa-jamālahunna — و, and + jamāl, loveliness (acc.) + هُنَّ 'their'; 'and their loveliness'
وَزِيَادَةَ: wa-ziyādata — و, and + ziyāda, excess, surplus (acc., in construct); 'and the excess of'
أَدَبِهِنَّ: adabihinna — adab, culture, good breeding (gen.) + هِنَّ 'their' (f. pl.); 'their culture'
فَأٓوَاهُنَّ: fa-āwāhunna — فَـ, and then + form IV of أَوَى, to lodge, give shelter to (perf. 3ms) + هُنَّ 'them'; 'and he lodged them'
فَأَكْرَمَهَا: fa-akramahā — فَـ, and + form IV of كَرُمَ, to honour (perf. 3ms) + هَا 'her'; 'and honoured her'
الْخَيْرَاتِ: al-khayrāti — الـ + خَيْرَات, good things, goods (pl. of خَيْر, gen. after مِنْ); 'the good things'
فَأَقَمْنَ: fa-aqamna — فَـ, and + form IV of قَامَ, to stay, remain (perf. 3fp); 'and they stayed'
يَجِدُهَا: yajiduhā — wajada, to find (imperf. 3ms) + هَا 'her'; 'he finds her'
مُعْتَكِفَةً: muʿtakifatan — form VIII of عَكَفَ, to devote oneself (active participle f., acc. indef., circumstantial); 'devoted'
صَلَوٰتِهَا: ṣalawātihā — ṣalawāt, prayers (pl. of صَلَاة, gen., printed with و) + هَا 'her'; 'her prayers'
وَقِيَامِهَا: wa-qiyāmihā — و, and + qiyām, standing in night prayer (gen.) + هَا 'her'; 'and her standing'
وَصِيَامِهَا: wa-ṣiyāmihā — و, and + ṣiyām, fasting (gen.) + هَا 'her'; 'and her fasting'
مَهَابَتُهَا: mahābatuhā — mahāba, awe, reverence (nom.) + هَا 'her'; 'her awe'
الْحَادِيَ: al-ḥādiya — الـ + حَادِي, eleventh (m., acc., first part of the compound ‘eleventh ten’); 'the eleventh'
ثَمَنِ: thamani — thaman, price (in construct, gen.); 'the price of'
تَتَعَامَلُ: tataʿāmalu — form VI of عَمِلَ, to deal, trade (imperf. 3fs); 'they deal'
جَوَاهِرَ: jawāhira — jawāhir, jewels (pl. of جَوْهَر, diptote acc.); 'jewels'
أَوْكَثِيرًا: aw kathīran — أَوْ, or + كَثِير, much (acc. indef.), printed run together; 'or much'
ثَمَنُهُنَّ: thamanuhunna — thaman, price (nom.) + هُنَّ 'their' (f. pl.); 'their price'
أَبِيعُهُنَّ: abīʿuhunna — bāʿa, to sell (imperf. 1s) + هُنَّ 'them'; 'I sell them'
إِلَّابِصِيَامِ: illā bi-ṣiyāmi — إِلَّا, except + بِـ, in exchange for (prep.: the price paid) + ṣiyām, fasting (gen.), printed run together; 'except for the fasting of'
لَيْلَهُ: laylahu — layl, night (acc., time) + هُ 'its'; 'its night'
فَهُنَّ: fa-hunna — فَـ, then (apodosis) + هُنَّ 'they' (f. pl.); 'then they are'
مِلْكٌ: milkun — milk, possession, property (nom. indef.); 'a possession'
تَصَرُّفِكَ: taṣarrufika — taṣarruf, disposal, control (form V verbal noun, gen.) + كَ 'your'; 'your disposal'
وَزُهْدِهَا: wa-zuhdihā — و, and + zuhd, abstinence, renunciation (gen.) + هَا 'her'; 'and her renunciation'
وَوَرَعِهَا: wa-waraʿihā — و, and + waraʿ, scrupulousness, piety (gen.) + هَا 'her'; 'and her scrupulousness'
نَفَعَنَا: nafaʿanā — nafaʿa, to benefit (perf. 3ms) + نَا 'us'; 'he benefit us'
الصَّالِحَةِ: al-ṣāliḥati — الـ + صَالِحَة, righteous (f. gen.); 'the righteous'
الشَّهْرَ: al-shahra — الـ + شَهْر, month (acc., time); 'the month'
اشْتَرَطَتْهُ: ishtaraṭathu — form VIII of شَرَطَ, to stipulate (perf. 3fs) + هُ 'it'; 'she stipulated it'
أُعِينُكَ: uʿīnuka — form IV of عَوَنَ, to help (imperf. 1s) + كَ 'you'; 'I help you'
بِدَعَوَاتٍ: bi-daʿawātin — بِـ, with, by (prep.) + دَعَوَات, supplications (pl. of دَعْوَة, gen. indef.); 'with supplications'
أَدْعُو: adʿū — daʿā, to call, pray (imperf. 1s); 'I pray'
فَائْتِنِي: fa-ʾtinī — فَـ, then + اِئْتِ, atā, to bring (imper. 2ms) + نِي 'me'; 'then bring me'
بِكُوزِ: bi-kūzi — بِـ, with (prep.: ātā bi-, to bring something) + kūz, jug (in construct, gen.); 'a jug of'
فَأَتَاهَا: fa-atāhā — فَـ, and + atā, to come, bring (perf. 3ms) + هَا 'her'; 'and he came to her'
غَطَّتْهُ: ghaṭṭathu — form II of غَطَّى, to cover (perf. 3fs) + هُ 'it'; 'she covered it'
بِخِرْقَةٍ: bi-khirqatin — بِـ, with (prep.) + خِرْقَة, rag, piece of cloth (gen. indef.); 'with a rag'
وَخَتَمَتْهُ: wa-khatamathu — و, and + khatama, to seal (perf. 3fs) + هُ 'it'; 'and sealed it'
صُمْتَ: ṣumta — ṣāma, to fast (perf. 2ms); 'you have fasted'
فَأَفْطِرْ: fa-afṭir — فَـ, then + form IV of فَطَرَ, to break one's fast (imper. 2ms); 'then break fast'
يَنْزِعُ: yanziʿu — nazaʿa, to remove, pull out (imperf. 3ms); 'it removes'
حُبَّ: ḥubba — ḥubb, love (acc., in construct); 'love of'
وَيَمْلَاؤُهُ: wa-yamlāʾuhu — و, and + yamlaʾu, to fill (imperf. 3ms, printed with alif) + هُ 'it'; 'and fills it'
وَإِيمَانًا: wa-īmānan — و, and + īmān, faith (acc. indef.); 'and faith'
رِجَالُ: rijālu — rijāl, men (pl. of رَجُل, nom., in construct); 'the men of'
الْغَيْبِ: al-ghaybi — الـ + غَيْب, the unseen (gen.); 'the Unseen'
سَبِيلِهَا: sabīlihā — sabīl, way, path (gen.) + هَا 'her'; 'her way'
صَوْمَ: صَوْم — ṣawm, fasting (m., acc., object of أَتَمَّ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the fast of'
فُؤَادِهِ: فُؤَاد — fuʾād, heart (m., gen. after فِي) + هِ 'his'; 'in his heart'
لَايُشْبِهُ: لَا + يُشْبِهُ — lā, not + yushbihu, resembles (imperf. 3 m. sg. of أَشْبَهَ); 'not resembling' (print joins the two words)
وَرَقَ: وَرَق — waraq, leaves, foliage (collective, m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa)

بِالسَّيِّدَةِ: بِـ + الـ + سَيِّدَة — sayyida, lady (f., gen.); bi- marks the person welcomed after مَرْحَبًا ('welcome to the lady')
رِجَالَ: رِجَال — rijāl, men (pl. of رَجُل, acc., after إِنَّ; first term of an iḍāfa)
الْحَلَاوَةَ: الـ + حَلَاوَة — ḥalāwa, sweetness, a sweetmeat (f., acc.); 'the sweetmeat'
حَلَاوَةِ: حَلَاوَة — ḥalāwa, sweetness (f., gen. after مِنْ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the sweetness'
إِخْوَانًا: إِخْوَان — ikhwān, brothers (pl. of أَخ, indef. acc., object of جَعَلَ)
رِجَالِ: رِجَال — rijāl, men (pl., gen. after مِنْ; first term of an iḍāfa)
وَأَكْرَمَهَا: و + أَكْرَمَ + هَا — akrama, honoured (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV) + 'her'; 'and he honoured her'
وَأَكْرَمَ: و + أَكْرَمَ — akrama, honoured (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV); 'and he honoured'

صَائِمٌ: صَائِم — ṣāʾim, fasting (act. part. of صَامَ, m., nom.; predicate in a circumstantial clause)

لَايَرْجِعْنَ: لَا + يَرْجِعْنَ — lā, not + yarjiʿna, they return (imperf. 3 f. pl.); 'they will not return' (print joins the two words)
وَمَعَهُنَّ: و + مَعَ + هُنَّ — wa-, 'with' in a circumstantial clause + maʿa, with + 'them' (f.); 'and with them'
كُنُوزِ: كُنُوز — kunūz, treasures (pl. of كَنْز, gen. after مِنْ; first term of an iḍāfa)
صَوْمِكَ: صَوْم + كَ — ṣawm, fasting (m., gen. in an iḍāfa) + 'your'; 'your fast'
تَشْتَغِلُ: تَشْتَغِلُ — ishtaghala, be busy, occupy oneself (imperf. 2 m. sg., form VIII); 'you will busy yourself'
بِكِسْوَتِهِنَّ: بِـ + كِسْوَة + هِنَّ — bi-, with, in (after اشْتَغَلَ, 'busy oneself with') + kiswa, clothing (f., gen.) + 'their' (f.); 'with clothing them'
وَتَسْتَعِينُ: و + تَسْتَعِينُ — istaʿāna, seek help, make use (imperf. 2 m. sg., form X; takes بِـ); 'and you will make use'
تِينَكَ: تِينَ + كَ — second half of the split يَأْتِينَكَ: ātā, come/bring (imperf. 3 f. pl. ending -na) + 'you' (m.); 'they bring you'
أَغْرَاضِكَ: أَغْرَاض + كَ — aghrāḍ, aims, purposes (pl. of غَرَض, gen. after عَلَى) + 'your'; 'upon your purposes' (عَلَى after اسْتَعَانَ بِـ, 'to meet your needs'); here also gen. after li-qaḍāʾi: li-qaḍāʾi aghrāḍika, 'to see to your needs'
مُخَالَفَتِي: مُخَالَفَة + ي — mukhālafa, opposition, going against (f. verbal noun of خَالَفَ, acc., object of أَخْشَى) + 'my'; 'my opposing'
مَارَضِيتُ: مَا + رَضِيتُ — mā, not + raḍītu, I was pleased (perf. 1 sg.; takes بِـ); 'I would not have been pleased' (جواب لَوْلَا; print joins the words)
بِالْكَنْزِ: بِـ + الـ + كَنْز — kanz, treasure (m., gen.); bi- with رَضِيَ 'be pleased with'; 'with the treasure'
تَخْرُجِينَ: تَخْرُجِينَ — kharaja, go out (imperf. 2 f. sg.); 'you go out'
قَدْأَوْفَيْتَ: قَدْ + أَوْفَيْتَ — qad, (with a perfect) already, 'will have' + awfā, fulfilled, completed (perf. 2 m. sg., form IV) (print joins the words); 'you will have fulfilled'
الصَّوْمَ: الـ + صَوْم — ṣawm, fasting (m., acc.); 'the fast'
اسْتَبْرَأُوهُنَّ: اسْتَبْرَؤُوا + هُنَّ — istabraʾa, cleared (a slave-girl, to show she is not with child; perf. 3 m. pl., form X) + 'them' (f.); 'they cleared them' (the sense wants the noun استبراؤهن 'their clearing')
أَمْرِكَ: أَمْر + كَ — amr, command, authority (m., gen. after تَحْتَ) + 'your'; 'under your command' Also 'your affair, your business': aṭliʿhā ʿalā amrika, 'let her into your affairs'.
الصَّالِحَةُ: الـ + صَالِحَة — ṣāliḥa, righteous, pious (f., nom.; adjective of السَّيِّدَة); 'the righteous'
يَجِدَ: يَجِدَ — wajada, find (subjunctive 3 m. sg., after حَتَّى); 'that he may find'
الْأُنْسَ: الـ + أُنْس — uns, companionship, familiarity, cheer (m., acc.); 'the companionship'
وَيَلْتَمِسَ: و + يَلْتَمِسَ — iltamasa, seek (subjunctive 3 m. sg., form VIII); 'and seek'
وَرُزِقْتُ: و + رُزِقْتُ — ruziqtu, I was provided (perf. pass. 1 sg. of رَزَقَ; takes مِنْ of the mother, بِـ of the thing given); 'and I was granted'
وَذَكَرٍ: و + ذَكَر — dhakar, male (m., gen. in apposition to وَلَدَيْنِ); 'and a male'
وَلَكِنَّهُمَا: و + لَكِنَّ + هُمَا — lākinna, but (particle taking an acc. noun) + 'the two of them'; 'but they two'
فُقِدَا: فُقِدَا — fuqida, were lost, went missing (perf. pass. 3 m. dual); 'the two were lost'
فَخُذِيهَا: فَـ + خُذِي + هَا — fa-, so + khudhī, take (imperative f. sg. of أَخَذَ) + 'her'; 'so take her'
تَحْصُلَ: تَحْصُلَ — ḥaṣala, come about, be obtained (subjunctive 3 f. sg., after أَنْ); 'that may come about'
الْبَرَكَةُ: الـ + بَرَكَة — baraka, blessing (f., nom., subject of تَحْصُلَ); 'the blessing'
طَلَبَتْ: طَلَبَ — ṭalaba, ask, seek (perfect 3 f. sg.); 'she asked'
وَلَعَلَّ: و + لَعَلَّ — wa-, and + laʿalla, perhaps (takes the accusative); 'and perhaps'
يَدْعُوا: دَعَا — daʿā, call, pray (subjunctive 3 m. pl., after أَنْ; the final alif is the print's); 'they call, pray'
وَلَدَيْهَا: وَلَد + هَا — walad, child (dual acc., 'two children') + 'her'; 'her two children'
وَيَجْمَعَ: و + يَجْمَعَ — wa-, and + jamaʿa, gather (subjunctive 3 m. sg., after أَنْ); 'and gather'
شَمْلَهَا: شَمْل + هَا — shaml, union, gathered company (acc., object) + 'her'; 'her scattered family'
غَرَضِهَا: غَرَض + هَا — gharaḍ, aim, purpose (gen., after أَعْظَمَ) + 'her'; 'her aim'
صِيَامِهِ: صِيَام + هُ — ṣiyām, fasting (gen., after تَمَامِ) + 'his'; 'his fast'
فَدَعَابِهَا: فَـ + دَعَا + بِـ + هَا — fa-, so + daʿā, call + bi-, the preposition this verb takes (دَعَا بِـ 'send for') + 'her'; 'so he sent for her' (one word in the print)
سَاعَتِهَا: سَاعَة + هَا — sāʿa, hour, moment (gen., after فِي) + 'her'; 'her hour', i.e. 'at once'
فَسَلَّمَهَا: فَـ + سَلَّمَ + هَا — fa-, so + sallama, hand over (perfect 3 m. sg.) + 'her'; 'so he handed her over'
فَخَلَطَتْهَا: فَـ + خَلَطَتْ + هَا — fa-, so + khalaṭa, mix (perfect 3 f. sg.) + 'her'; 'so she mixed her'
بِالْجَوَارِي: بِـ + الـ + جَوَارِي — bi-, with, among (prep.) + al- + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of جَارِيَة); 'with the slave-girls'
مَخْدَعَهَا: مَخْدَع + هَا — makhdaʿ, private chamber (acc.) + 'her'; 'her chamber'
بِكَأْسٍ: بِـ + كَأْس — bi-, with (prep.) + kaʾs, cup (gen., indef.); 'with a cup'
مَخْتُومٍ: مَخْتُوم — makhtūm, sealed (passive participle of خَتَمَ, gen.); 'sealed'
الثُّلَٰثِينَ: الـ + ثَلَاثِين — al- + thalāthīn, thirty (gen., after يَوْمُ; the print spells it without the alif, here the dagger alif); 'the thirtieth'
فَادْخُلِ: فَـ + ادْخُلِ — fa-, then + udkhul, enter (imperative m. sg., kasra before the article); 'then enter'
الْخَلَاوَى: الـ + خَلَاوَى — al- + khalāwā, retreats, private rooms (pl. of خَلْوَة); 'the retreats'
الْكَأْسَ: الـ + كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (m. here, acc., object); 'the cup'
نِلْتَ: نَالَ — nāla, attain, obtain (perfect 2 m. sg.); 'you have attained'
اسْتَوْدَعْتُكَ: اسْتَوْدَعَ + كَ — istawdaʿa, entrust, deposit (perfect 1 sg., X) + 'you'; 'I entrust you (to God)'
وَالْمَلِكَةُ: و + الـ + مَلِكَة — wa-, and + al- + malika, queen (f., nom.); 'and the queen'
هَلَّ: هَلَّ — halla, appear (said of the new moon) (perfect 3 m. sg., printed with its shadda); 'appeared'
الْخَلْوَةَ: الـ + خَلْوَة — khalwa, retreat, private room (acc., object); 'the retreat'
لَايَدْخُلَ: لَا + يَدْخُلَ — lā, not + yadkhula, enter (subjunctive 3 m. sg., after أَنْ; run together in the print); 'that not enter'
قَاعِدُونَ: قَاعِد — qāʿid, sitting (active participle of قَعَدَ, nom. m. pl.); 'sitting'
وَصِيَامِ: و + صِيَام — wa-, and + ṣiyām, fasting (gen.); 'and the fasting of'
فَبِسَبَبِ: فَـ + بِـ + سَبَب — fa-, so + bi-, by reason of (prep.) + sabab, cause (gen.); 'so by reason of'
فَانْتَظَرْنَاهُ: فَـ + انْتَظَرْنَا + هُ — fa-, so + intaẓarnā, wait for (perfect 1 pl., VIII) + 'him'; 'so we waited for him'
فَوَقَفْنَا: فَـ + وَقَفْنَا — fa-, so + waqafnā, stand (perfect 1 pl.); 'so we stood'
بِرَفْعِ: بِـ + رَفْع — bi-, with (prep.) + rafʿ, raising (gen.); 'with the raising of' Also after amara, 'to order', bi- marks the thing ordered: amara bi-rafʿi al-sharābi, 'he ordered the drink cleared away'.
يَنْتَبِهُ: اِنْتَبَهَ — intabaha, wake up, take notice (imperfect 3 m. sg., VIII); 'he wakes'
فَخَلَعْنَا: فَـ + خَلَعْنَا — fa-, so + khalaʿnā, tear off, pull off (perfect 1 pl.); 'so we tore off'
تَمَزَّقَ: تَمَزَّقَ — tamazzaqa, be torn to pieces (perfect 3 m. sg., V); 'was torn apart'
وَهَرَّأَ: و + هَرَّأَ — wa-, and + harraʾa, make ragged, reduce to tatters (perfect 3 m. sg., II; read as 'fell into shreds'); 'and was in tatters'
وَتَفَتَّتَ: و + تَفَتَّتَ — wa-, and + tafattata, crumble (perfect 3 m. sg., V); 'and crumbled'
رَأَيْنَاهُ: رَأَى + نَا + هُ — raʾā, see (perfect 1 pl.) + 'him'; 'we saw him'
غِطَائِهِ: غِطَاء + هُ — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (gen., after فِي) + 'its'; 'its lid'
لَابِسْتَوْحِشَ: لَا + بِسْتَوْحِشَ — as printed, perhaps a misprint for لَا يَسْتَوْحِشُ (lā yastawḥishu, 'does not feel alarmed'); doubtful, kept as printed; the sense is not rendered
يَتَحَيَّلُ: تَحَيَّلَ عَلَى — taḥayyala ʿalā, scheme against, use craft on (imperfect 3 m. sg., V); 'schemes against'
وَيُفْسِدُهُنَّ: و + يُفْسِدُ + هُنَّ — wa-, and + yufsidu, corrupt, ruin (imperfect 3 m. sg., IV) + 'them' (f. pl.); 'and corrupts them'
نُعَلِّمُ: عَلَّمَ — ʿallama, inform, teach (imperfect 1 pl., II; نُعَلِّمُ بِهِ 'we inform by it'); 'we inform'
الْوَرَقَةِ: الـ + وَرَقَة — waraqa, sheet, slip of paper (gen.); 'the paper'
وَمَاكَفَاهُ: و + مَا + كَفَاهُ — wa-, and + mā, not + kafā, suffice (perfect 3 m. sg.) + 'him' (run together in the print); 'and it was not enough for him'
وَوَجَدْنَاهَا: و + وَجَدْنَا + هَا — wa-, and + wajadnā, find (perfect 1 pl.) + 'her'; 'and we found her'
مَطْرُوحَةً: مَطْرُوحَة — maṭrūḥa, thrown, flung (passive participle of طَرَحَ, f. acc., hāl); 'flung down'
مَاحَلَّ: مَا + حَلَّ — mā, what + ḥalla, befall, alight (perfect 3 m. sg.; run together in the print); 'what befell'
لَاتَتَّهِمُوا: لَا + تَتَّهِمُوا — lā, do not (negative imperative) + tattahimū, accuse (jussive 2 m. pl., VIII; run together in the print); 'do not accuse'
بِقَتْلِهِ: بِـ + قَتْل + ـهِ — bi- + qatl, killing (gen.) + -hi, his. After اتَّهَمَ the verb takes bi- for the charge: 'accuse of killing him'. After illā, bi- is 'by, through': lā tatimmu illā bi-qatlihi, 'will not succeed except by his killing'
الْعَاهِرَةُ: الـ + عَاهِرَة — ʿāhira, harlot, whore (f., nom.); 'the whore'
الشَّاطِرَةُ: الـ + شَاطِرَة — shāṭira, cunning, crafty (f., nom.; Middle Arabic sense); 'the cunning one'
نَغْزُوَكُمْ: نَغْزُو + كُمْ — ghazā, raid, march against (subjunctive 1 pl., after أَنْ) + 'you' (pl.); 'we raid you'
وَنَقْتُلَكُمْ: و + نَقْتُلَ + كُمْ — wa-, and + qatala, kill (subjunctive 1 pl.) + 'you' (pl.); 'and kill you'
وَنَأْخُذَ: و + نَأْخُذَ — wa-, and + akhadha, take (subjunctive 1 pl.); 'and take'
مِنْكُمُ: مِنْ + كُمْ — min, from (prep.) + 'you' (pl.), the mīm vowelled before the article; 'from you'; here: in verse, minkumu, with the old long ending -mu filling out the metre
فَتَهْلِكُونَ: فَـ + تَهْلِكُونَ — fa-, so + halaka, perish (imperfect 2 m. pl.); 'so you perish'
آخِرِكُمْ: آخِر + كُمْ — ākhir, last (gen., after عَنْ) + 'your' (pl.); عَنْ آخِرِكُمْ 'to the last of you'
دَيَّارٌ: دَيَّار — dayyār, dweller, anyone (m. nom., indef.; used with negatives); 'a dweller'
الصَّلِيبَ: الـ + صَلِيب — ṣalīb, cross (acc., object); 'the cross'
وَالزُّنَّارَ: و + الـ + زُنَّار — wa-, and + al- + zunnār, girdle, belt (the Christian's belt, acc.); 'and the girdle'
خَدَعَتْنَا: خَدَعَ + نَا — khadaʿa, deceive (perfect 3 f. sg.) + 'us'; 'she deceived us'
وَلَطَمْنَا: و + لَطَمْنَا — wa-, and + laṭamnā, strike, slap (perfect 1 pl.); 'and we struck'
يَفِدْنَا: أَفَادَ + نَا — afāda, benefit, avail (jussive 3 m. sg., IV, after لَمْ; corrected from the print's يقدنا) + 'us'; 'did not avail us'
وَاخْتَلَفَتِ: و + اخْتَلَفَتِ — wa-, and + ikhtalafa, differ, disagree (perfect 3 f. sg., VIII); 'and differed'
يَجْعَلُونَهُ: يَجْعَلُونَ + هُ — jaʿala, make, appoint (imperfect 3 m. pl.) + 'him'; 'they make him'
يُرِيدُكَ: يُرِيدُ + كَ — arāda, want (imperfect 3 m. sg., IV) + 'you'; 'wants you'
الِاخْتِلَافِ: الـ + اخْتِلَاف — ikhtilāf, disagreement, dispute (gen.); 'the dispute'
جَمَعَنَا: جَمَعَ + نَا — jamaʿa, gather (perfect 3 m. sg.) + 'us'; 'gathered us'
نَمْضِىَ: مَضَى — maḍā, go on, proceed (subjunctive 1 pl., after أَنْ; the print spells the ending with ى); 'we go'
فَسَافَرْنَا: فَـ + سَافَرْنَا — fa-, so + sāfarnā, travel (perfect 1 pl., III); 'so we travelled'
وَجَدْنَاكَ: وَجَدَ + نَا + كَ — wajada, find (perfect 1 pl.) + 'you'; 'we found you'
مَوْتِ: مَوْت — mawt, death (gen., first term of an idafa); 'the death of'
بَكَيٰ: بَكَى — bakā, weep (perfect 3 m. sg.; the print spells the ending with ي, here the dagger alif); 'wept'
لَايُفِيدُكَ: لَا + يُفِيدُ + كَ — lā, not + afāda, avail (imperfect 3 m. sg., IV) + 'you'; 'does not avail you' (run together in the print)
وَلَايَنِيدُكَ: و + لَا + يَنِيدُ + كَ — wa-, and + lā, not + yanīdu, a verb of doubtful form, kept as printed, probably 'help, benefit' + 'you'; 'nor … you' (run together in the print)
تَشُدُّ: شَدَّ — shadda, tighten, brace (imperfect 2 m. sg.); 'you brace'
وَتُقَوِّي: و + تُقَوِّي — wa-, and + qawwā, strengthen (imperfect 2 m. sg., II); 'and you strengthen'
وَتُؤَيِّدُ: و + تُؤَيِّدُ — wa-, and + ayyada, support, uphold (imperfect 2 m. sg., II); 'and you uphold'
مَمْلَكَتَكَ: مَمْلَكَة + كَ — mamlaka, kingdom (acc., object) + 'your'; 'your kingdom'
بِنَصْبِ: بِـ + نَصْب — bi-, the preposition أَمَرَ takes ('command (something)') + naṣb, setting up (gen.); 'the setting up of'
يَعْرِضُوا: عَرَضَ — ʿaraḍa, present, parade (subjunctive 3 m. pl., after أَنْ); 'that they parade'
السِّلَحْدَارِيَّةِ: الـ + سِلَحْدَارِيَّة — silaḥdāriyya, armour-bearers, the weapon-bearers of the guard (pl., from Turkish silāḥdār, gen.); 'the armour-bearers'
كُلُّوَاحِدٍ: كُلّ + وَاحِد — kull, each (nom., subject of وَقَفَ; the print runs the two words together) + wāḥid, one (gen.); 'each one'; here: subject of ishtaghala
مَرْتَبَتِهِ: مَرْتَبَة + هُ — martaba, rank, station (gen., after فِي) + 'his'; 'his rank'
لِلْمُوزْبِرْدَنْدَانَ: لِـ + الـ + مُوزْبِرْدَنْدَان — li-, to (prep.) + a garbled form in the print, apparently للوزير دندان, 'to the vizier Dandān'; doubtful, kept as printed
بِخَزَائِنِ: بِـ + خَزَائِن — bi-, the preposition أَخْبَرَ takes ('inform of') + khazāʾin, treasuries (pl. of خِزَانَة, gen.); 'of the treasuries of'
خِزْنَتِهِ: خِزْنَة + هُ — khizna, treasury, as printed (perhaps خِزَانَة with a dropped alif) (gen.) + 'his'; 'his treasury'
بِالْبَقَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + بَقَاء — bi-, with, for (prep.; دَعَا لَهُ بِـ 'pray for him for') + al- + baqāʾ, continuance, long life (gen.); 'for long life'
اعْرِضْ: عَرَضَ — ʿaraḍa, present, show (imperative m. sg.); 'show'
فَعَرَضَ: فَـ + عَرَضَ — fa-, so + ʿaraḍa, present, show (perfect 3 m. sg.); 'so he showed'
وَالْجَوَاهِرَ: و + الـ + جَوَاهِر — wa-, and + al- + jawāhir, jewels (pl., acc.); 'and the jewels'
وَفَرَّقَهَا: و + فَرَّقَ + هَا — wa-, and + farraqa, distribute (perfect 3 m. sg., II) + 'them'; 'and distributed them'
فَأَحْضِرْلِي: فَـ + أَحْضِرْ + لِي — fa-, so + aḥḍir, bring, make present (imperative m. sg.) + li-, to (prep.) + -ī, me; 'so bring me' (written as one word in the print)
أَوَدُّ: وَدَّ — wadda, wish, want (imperfect 1 sg., printed with its shadda); 'I wish'
أُفَارِقَكِ: فَارَقَ + كِ — fāraqa, part from (subjunctive 1 sg., after أَنْ لَا) + 'you' (f.); 'I part from you'
وَأَعْلَنَّا: و + أَعْلَنَّا — wa-, and + aʿlannā, announce, call out (perfect 1 pl. of أَعْلَنَ, the two nūns joined by shadda); 'and we called out'
أَفْسَدَ: أَفْسَدَ — afsada, corrupt, ruin (perfect 3 m. sg., IV); 'he corrupted'
أَبْرِيزَ: أَبْرِيز — Abrīz, a woman's name (the princess/queen of the Greeks, acc.; diptote)
فَأَنْفَقَ: فَـ + أَنْفَقَ — fa-, so + anfaqa, spend (perfect 3 m. sg., IV); 'so he spent'
يَعْرِضَ: yaʿriḍa — ʿaraḍa, present, display (imperfect 3 m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'that he present'
يُبْقِ: yubqi — abqā, leave remaining (IV; imperfect 3 m. sg. jussive after lam); 'he did not leave'
أَصْبَحُوا: aṣbaḥū — aṣbaḥa, reach the morning (IV; perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they reached morning'
فَوَجَدُوهَا: فَـ + وَجَدُوهَا — fa-, so + wajadū-hā, find (perfect 3 m. pl.) + her/it (f. sg., the city); 'so they found it'

وَحَاجِبُ: وَ + حَاجِب — wa-, and + ḥājib, chamberlain (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa)

وَتَحْضُرْ: وَ + تَحْضُرْ — wa-, and + taḥḍur, be present, come (imperfect 2 m. sg. jussive, read as a command); 'and come'

وَنَكْشِفَ: وَ + نَكْشِفَ — wa-, and + nakshifa, uncover, remove (imperfect 1 pl. subjunctive); 'and uncover'

يَتَوَجَّهُ: yatawajjahu — tawajjaha, go, set out with (V; imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'goes'
تَتَلَطَّفَ: tatalaṭṭafa — talaṭṭafa, be gentle, use tact (V; imperfect 2 m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'that you be gentle'
وَأَخُوكَ: وَ + أَخُو + كَ — wa-, and + akh, brother (nom., long-vowel construct) + your (m. sg.); 'and your brother'

يَجْعَلُوا: yajʿalū — jaʿala, make, set (imperfect 3 m. pl. subjunctive after an; the final nūn is dropped in the print); 'that they make'
فَاخِرًا: fākhir — splendid, magnificent (act. part. of fakhara, acc., adjective of makānan)
وَيَفْرُشُوهُ: وَ + يَفْرُشُوهُ — wa-, and + yafrushū-hu, spread, furnish (imperfect 3 m. pl. subjunctive, final nūn dropped in the print) + it; 'and furnish it'
الْخُيُولِ: الـ + خُيُول — al-khuyūl, the horses (broken plural of khayl, gen. after min); 'the horses'
الْجِيَادِ: الـ + جِيَاد — al-jiyād, the thoroughbreds, swift fine horses (pl. of jawād, gen. adjective); 'the fine ones'
فَاسْتَخْلَى: فَـ + اسْتَخْلَى — fa-, so + istakhlā, withdraw alone (X; perfect 3 m. sg.), with bi- marking the person: istakhlā bi-hā 'be alone with her'
وَتُلَاقِيَهُ: وَ + تُلَاقِيَ + هُ — wa-, and + tulāqiya, meet (III; imperfect 2 m. sg. subjunctive after an) + him; 'and meet him'
نْتِظَارِ: intiẓār — awaiting, waiting for (VIII verbal noun, gen.); the print separates it from the preceding li-: 'for the awaiting of'
عَسَاكِرِ: ʿasākir — ʿaskar, army (m., broken plural, gen., first term of an iḍāfa)
مِقْدَامٍ: miqdām — bold, dauntless (intensive form, indef. gen.; adjective of fārisin)
وَأَسَدٍ: وَ + أَسَد — wa-, and + asad, lion (m., gen. after mā bayna); 'and a lion'
وَبَطَلٍ: وَ + بَطَل — wa-, and + baṭal, hero, champion (m., gen.); 'and a hero'
مِصْدَامٍ: miṣdām — one who dashes against, battering (intensive form of ṣadama, indef. gen.; adjective of baṭalin)
أَشْرَفَتِ: ashrafati — ashrafa, overlook, come into view (IV; perfect 3 f. sg.; the final kasra is the helping vowel before al-); 'appeared'
الْكَتَائِبُ: الـ + كَتَائِب — al-katāʾib, the squadrons (broken pl. of katība; nom.); 'the squadrons'
وَقَدِمَتِ: وَ + قَدِمَتِ — wa-, and + qadimat, arrive (perfect 3 f. sg.; kasra as helping vowel before al-); 'and arrived'
السَّحَائِبُ: الـ + سَحَائِب — al-saḥāʾib, the clouds (pl. of saḥāba; nom.), here the dust-clouds or the hosts themselves; 'the clouds'
وَخَفَقَتْ: وَ + خَفَقَتْ — wa-, and + khafaqat, flutter, flap (perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and fluttered'
أَعْلَامُ: aʿlām — ʿalam, banner, flag (m., broken plural, nom., first term of an iḍāfa)
الْمَوَاكِبِ: الـ + مَوَاكِب — al-mawākib, the processions, columns of riders (pl. of mawkib; gen. second term of an iḍāfa)
لِمُلَاقَاتِهِمْ: لِـ + مُلَاقَاة + هِمْ — li-, to, for (prep. of purpose) + mulāqāh, meeting (III verbal noun, gen.) + them; 'to meet them'
يَتَرَجَّلَ: yatarajjala — tarajjala, dismount, go on foot (V; imperfect 3 m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'that he dismount'
فَأَقْسَمَ: فَـ + أَقْسَمَ — fa-, so, but + aqsama, swear (IV; perfect 3 m. sg.), with ʿalā 'swear to (someone)'; 'so he swore'
وَتَرَجَّلَ: وَ + تَرَجَّلَ — wa-, and + tarajjala, dismount (V; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and dismounted'
خُطُوَاتٍ: khuṭuwāt — khuṭwa, step, pace (f., sound plural, acc. as an object of mashā); 'steps'
صَارَبَيْنَ: ṣāra + bayna — ṣāra, become, come to be (perfect 3 m. sg.) + bayna, between (acc. prep.); the print runs the two together: 'he came to be between'
فَاحْتَضَنَهُ: فَـ + احْتَضَنَ + هُ — fa-, and then + iḥtaḍana, clasp to the bosom (VIII; perfect 3 m. sg.) + him; 'and he embraced him'
وَبَكَيَا: وَ + بَكَيَا — wa-, and + bakayā, weep (perfect 3 dual); 'and the two wept'
وَعَزَّى: وَ + عَزَّى — wa-, and + ʿazzā, console, comfort (II; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and consoled'
وَأَخُوهُ: وَ + أَخُو + هُ — wa-, and + akh, brother (nom., long-vowel construct) + his; 'and his brother'
وَبَاتَا: وَ + بَاتَا — wa-, and + bātā, spend the night (perfect 3 dual); 'and the two spent the night'
يَجْمَعُوا: yajmaʿū — jamaʿa, gather, muster (imperfect 3 m. pl. subjunctive after an; final nūn dropped in the print); 'that they gather'
وَيُنَادُوا: وَ + يُنَادُوا — wa-, and + yunādū, call out, proclaim (III; imperfect 3 m. pl. subjunctive, final nūn dropped in the print); 'and proclaim'
بِالْغَزْوِ: بِـ + الـ + غَزْو — bi-, with (prep., here with nādā 'proclaim': what is proclaimed) + al-ghazw, the raid, holy war; 'the raid'
الْجُيُوشِ: الـ + جُيُوش — al-juyūsh, the armies (pl. of jaysh, gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the armies'
يُكْرِمُونَهُ: yukrimūna-hu — akrama, honour, treat generously (IV; imperfect 3 m. pl.) + him; 'they honour him'
وَيَعِدُونَهُ: وَ + يَعِدُونَ + هُ — wa-, and + yaʿidūna, promise (imperfect 3 m. pl. of waʿada) + him; 'and promise him'
بِالْجَمِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + جَمِيل — bi-, with (prep., marking what is promised: waʿada bi-) + al-jamīl, the fair, the good; 'the fair thing'
وَالْقَوْمُ: وَ + الـ + قَوْم — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'while') + al-qawm, the people, the folk (nom.); 'and the people'
يَأْتُونَ: yaʾtūna — atā, come (imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they come'
أَفْوَاجًا: afwāj — fawj, troop, band (m., broken plural, acc. as a state); 'in troops'
مُتَتَابِعَةً: mutatābiʿa — following one another in succession (VI act. part., f. sg. agreeing with the plural; acc. state)
أَعْلِمْنِي: aʿlim-nī — aʿlama, inform, let know (IV; imperative m. sg.) + me; 'tell me'
بِقَضِيَّتِكَ: بِـ + قَضِيَّة + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; aʿlama bi- 'inform of') + qaḍiyya, case, affair, story (f., gen.) + your; 'of your case'
صَنَعَهُ: ṣanaʿa-hu — ṣanaʿa, do, make (perfect 3 m. sg.) + it/what; 'he did it'
كَافَأْتَهُ: kāfaʾta-hu — kāfaʾa, repay, reward (III; perfect 2 m. sg.) + him; 'you repaid him'
مَعْرُوفِهِ: maʿrūf-ihi — maʿrūf, kindness, good deed (m., gen. after ʿalā) + his; 'his kindness'
كَافَأْتُهُ: kāfaʾtu-hu — kāfaʾa, repay (III; perfect 1 sg.) + him; 'I repaid him'
أُكَافِئُهُ: ukāfiʾu-hu — kāfaʾa, repay (III; imperfect 1 sg.) + him; 'I will repay him'
الْغَزْوَةِ: الـ + غَزْوَة — al-ghazwa, the raid, campaign (f., gen. after min); 'the campaign'
الْمُبَ——————————حِ: الـ + مُبَاح — al-mubāḥ, the permitted, lawful (pass. part. of abāḥa, IV; gen. second term of an iḍāfa); the print breaks the word with a rule of dashes
كَافَأْتَ: kāfaʾta — kāfaʾa, repay, reward (III; perfect 2 m. sg.); 'you rewarded'

صَادِقَةٌ: ṣādiqa — ṣādiq, truthful (f. sg. active participle of ṣadaqa; nom. predicate); 'truthful'
وَأَمْرَهَا: وَ + أَمْر + هَا — wa-, and + amr, affair, matter (m., acc.) + her; 'and her affair'
فَبَعَثَتْ: فَـ + بَعَثَتْ — fa-, so + baʿathat, sent (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'so she sent'
وَسَأَلَتْ: وَ + سَأَلَتْ — wa-, and + saʾalat, asked (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and she asked'
ابْنَتِهَا: ibnat-hā — ibna, daughter (f., gen. after ʿan) + her; 'her daughter'
وَالسَّلَامَةِ: وَ + الـ + سَّلَامَة — wa-, and + al-, the + salāma, safety, soundness (f., gen. after the iḍāfa); 'and safety'
فَحَمِدَتِ: فَـ + حَمِدَتِ — fa-, so + ḥamidat, praised (I; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'so she praised'
يُشَاوِرُهُ: yushāwiru-hu — shāwara, consult (III; imperfect 3 m. sg.) + him; 'consulting him'
الرَّحِيلِ: الـ + رَحِيل — al-raḥīl, the departure, setting out (m., gen. after amr); 'the departure'
تَتَكَامَلُ: tatakāmalu — takāmala, be complete, come to full strength (VI; imperfect 3 f. sg.); 'are completed'
وَتَأَنَّى: وَ + تَأَنَّى — wa-, and + taʾannā, to wait, take one's time (V; perfect 3 m. sg.; the print's spelling, perhaps for تَأْتِي 'come'; see note); 'and waited'
الْعُرْبَانُ: الـ + عُرْبَان — al-ʿurbān, the Bedouin, desert Arabs (pl., nom.); 'the Bedouin'
بِتَجْهِيزِ: بِـ + تَجْهِيز — bi-, here the preposition after amara, 'to order (something)' + tajhīz, equipping (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'the equipping of'
الْمِيرَةِ: الـ + مِيرَة — al-mīra, provisions, supplies (f., gen. after the iḍāfa); 'the provisions'
وَإِحْضَارِ: وَ + إِحْضَار — wa-, and + iḥḍār, bringing, causing to be present (IV verbal noun, m., gen. in a coordinate with bi-tajhīz); 'and the bringing of'
الذَّخِيرَةِ: الـ + ذَخِيرَة — al-dhakhīra, stores, munitions (f., gen. after the iḍāfa); 'the stores'
الْأَقْلَامِ: الـ + أَقْلَام — al-, the + aqlām, pens (pl. of qalam; gen. after arbāb); 'the pens'; ahl/arbāb al-aqlām, scribes
طَاعَتِهَا: ṭāʿat-hā — ṭāʿa, obedience, authority (f., gen. after taḥta) + her; 'her obedience'
الْجَرَايَاتِ: الـ + جَرَايَات — al-jarāyāt, the allowances, rations (f. pl., acc. after rattaba lahum); 'the allowances'
ثَالِثِ: thālith — third (m., gen. in the iḍāfa fī thālithi shahrin); 'third'
نُزُولِ: nuzūl — alighting, coming down, encamping (m. verbal noun, gen. after ḥīn); 'the alighting of'
قَدِمَتِ: qadimat — qadima, arrive (I; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'arrived'
وَسَارَتِ: وَ + سَارَتِ — wa-, and + sārat, went, marched (I; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'and went'
الْجُيُوشُ: الـ + جُيُوش — al-juyūsh, the hosts, armies (pl. of jaysh; nom.); 'the hosts'
وَتَتَابَعَتِ: وَ + تَتَابَعَتِ — wa-, and + tatābaʿat, followed one upon another (VI; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'and followed one another'
الْجَحَافِلُ: الـ + جَحَافِل — al-jaḥāfil, the great columns, large troops (pl. of jaḥfal; nom.); 'the great columns'
رَئِيسِ: raʾīs — head, chief, commander (m., gen. in the iḍāfa); 'head of'

التُّرْكِ: الـ + تُّرْك — al-Turk, the Turks (gen., second term of an iḍāfa, after ʿaskar or amīr); 'the Turks'
بَهْرَمَانَ: Bahramān — proper name, m. (diptote; acc. as predicate of kāna); a Turkish commander
يَسَارِهِ: yasār-ihi — yasār, left (side) (m., gen. after ʿan) + his; 'his left'
صِهْرُهُ: ṣihr-uhu — ṣihr, relative by marriage, son-in-law or brother-in-law (m., nom. apposition) + his; 'his in-law'
يَنْزِلُونَ: yanzilūna — nazala, alight, encamp (I; imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they alight'
وَيَسْتَرِيحُونَ: وَ + يَسْتَرِيحُونَ — wa-, and + yastarīḥūna, rest (X; imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they rest'
فَنَفَرَتْ: فَـ + نَفَرَتْ — fa-, so + nafarat, took fright, fled in alarm (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'so they took fright'
الْقُرَى: الـ + قُرَى — al-qurā, the villages (pl. of qarya; gen. after ahl); 'the villages'
وَالضِّيَاعِ: وَ + الـ + ضِّيَاع — wa-, and + al-ḍiyāʿ, the estates, farms (pl. of ḍayʿa; gen.); 'and the estates'
وَالصَّعَا: وَ + الـ + صَّعَا — first piece of الصعاليك 'the vagabonds', which the print splits into two; wa-, and + al-ṣaʿā[līk]; see the next entry
لِيكِ: līk — second piece of الصعاليك (ṣaʿālīk, pl. of ṣuʿlūk, poor wretch, vagabond), split off by the print; with the preceding piece, 'and the vagabonds'
وَفَرُّوا: وَ + فَرُّوا — wa-, and + farrū, fled (I; perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they fled'
مَلِكُهُمْ: malik-uhum — malik, king (m., nom. apposition) + their; 'their king'
بِخَبَرِهِمْ: bi-khabar-ihim — bi-, here the preposition after samiʿa, 'hear of' + khabar, news (m., gen.) + their; 'of their news'
دَبَّرَتِ: dabbarat — dabbara, contrive, plan (II; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'she contrived'
الْحِيَلَ: الـ + حِيَل — al-ḥiyal, the stratagems, tricks (pl. of ḥīla; acc.); 'the stratagems'
قَتَلَتِ: qatalat — qatala, kill (I; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'she killed'
جَوَارِيَهَا: jawāriy-ahā — jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya; acc., object of akhadhat) + her; 'her slave-girls' Also object of aʿtaqa: aʿtaqa jawāriyahā, 'he freed her slave-girls'.
وَالْمَلِكَةَ: وَ + الـ + مَلِكَة — wa-, and + al-malika, the queen (f., acc.); 'and the queen'
وَأَمِنَتْ: وَ + أَمِنَتْ — wa-, and + aminat, be safe, feel secure (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and she was safe'
بْنِهَا: ibn-ihā — second piece of لابنها 'to her son', which the print splits (لا بنها); ibn, son (m., gen. after li-) + her
قَرَّعَيْنًا: qarra ʿaynan — qarra, be cool, be at rest (I; perfect/imperative 3 m. sg.) + ʿayn, eye (f., acc. of specification), run together by the print; 'be cool of eye', i.e. be glad
بِصَفِيَّةَ: bi-ṣafiyyata — bi-, with, here after jāʾa, 'to bring (someone)' (jāʾa bi-) + Ṣafiyya, proper name (f., gen. diptote); 'with Ṣafiyya'
وَارْحَلْ: وَ + ارْحَلْ — wa-, and + irḥal, set out, depart (I; imperative m. sg.); 'and set out'
جَمِيعُنَا: jamīʿ-unā — jamīʿ, all, the whole (m., nom.) + our; 'all of us'
وَنَتَجَهَّزَ: وَ + نَتَجَهَّزَ — wa-, and + natajahhaza, equip oneself, get ready (V; subjunctive 1 pl., after ḥattā); 'and we get ready'
