يَثْبُتُونَ: yathbutūna — thabata, stand firm (I; imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they stand firm'
أَمْهِلِي: amhilī — amhala, give respite, grant time (IV; imperative f. sg.); 'give respite'
يَقْرُبُوا: yaqrubū — qaruba, draw near (I; subjunctive 3 m. pl., after an); 'they draw near'
نُجَهِّزَ: nujahhiza — jahhaza, equip, make ready (II; subjunctive 1 pl., after ḥattā); 'we equip'
أَحْوَالَنَا: aḥwāl-anā — aḥwāl, affairs, conditions (pl. of ḥāl; acc.) + our; 'our affairs'
رِجَالِهِمْ: rijāl-ihim — rijāl, men (pl. of rajul; gen. after jamʿ) + their; 'their men'
وَتَجْهِيزِ: وَ + تَجْهِيز — wa-, and + tajhīz, equipping (II verbal noun, m., gen.); 'and the equipping of'
أَحَدُوا: aḥadū — obscure and probably corrupt (perhaps for احوالهم, 'their affairs'); kept as printed and vowelled as the letters allow
حَالَهُمْ: ḥāl-ahum — ḥāl, state, condition (m., acc.) + their; 'their state'
الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةَ: الْ + قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة — al-Qusṭanṭīniyya, Constantinople (f. proper name; acc., object of waṣalū); 'Constantinople'
الْأَكْبَرُ: الـ + أَكْبَر — al-akbar, the greatest (m., nom. adjective of al-malik); 'the greatest'
لِمُلَاقَاتِهِ: li-mulāqāt-ihi — li-, to, for (prep., of purpose) + mulāqāt, meeting (III verbal noun, f., gen.) + his; 'to meet him'
بِمَلِكِ: bi-malik-i — bi-, with (prep.): after ijtamaʿa, 'meet with'; after dhahaba, 'go with' = 'take, bring' (tadhhabu ilayhim bi-maliki, 'she would bring them the king of') + malik, king (m., gen., in the iḍāfa); 'with the king of'
عَمِلَتْهُ: ʿamilat-hu — ʿamila, do, make (I; perfect 3 f. sg.) + it; 'she had done it'
الْحِيَلِ: الـ + حِيَل — al-ḥiyal, the stratagems (pl. of ḥīla; gen. after min); 'the stratagems'
قَتَلَتْ: qatalat — qatala, kill (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'she killed'
جَمَعُوا: jamaʿū — jamaʿa, gather (I; perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they gathered'
عَسَاكِرَهُمْ: ʿasākir-ahum — ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; acc.) + their; 'their armies'
وَنُرِيدَأَنْ: وَ + نُرِيدَ + أَنْ — wa-, and + nurīdu, want (IV; imperfect 1 pl.) + an, that; the print runs them together; 'and we want that'
نَكُونَ: nakūna — kāna, be (I; subjunctive 1 pl., after an); 'we be'
وَنَلْقَاهُمْ: وَ + نَلْقَاهُمْ — wa-, and + nalqā-hum, meet (I; imperfect/subjunctive 1 pl.) + them; 'and meet them'
وَقَتْلِ: وَ + قَتْل — wa-, and + qatl, killing (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'and the killing of'
الْأَقَالِيمِ: الـ + أَقَالِيم — al-aqālīm, the regions, provinces (pl. of iqlīm; gen. after sāʾir); 'the regions'
النَّجْدَةَ: الـ + نَّجْدَة — al-najda, help, reinforcement (f., acc.); 'the help'
وَيَذْكُرُ: وَ + يَذْكُرُ — wa-, and + yadhkuru, mention (I; imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'and he mentions'
فَهَرَعَتْ: فَـ + هَرَعَتْ — fa-, so + haraʿat, hurry, rush (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'so they hurried'
جُيُوشُ: juyūsh — hosts, armies (pl. of jaysh; nom. in the iḍāfa); 'armies of'
فَمَامَرَّ: فَـ + مَا + مَرَّ — fa-, so + mā, not + marra, pass (I; perfect 3 m. sg.), run together by the print; 'and there did not pass'
ثَلْثَةُ: thalthatu — three (the print's spelling of ثلاثة; nom. as subject of marra); 'three'
تَكَامَلَتْ: takāmalat — takāmala, be complete (VI; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'were complete'
الْإِفْرَنْجُ: الـ + إِفْرَنْج — al-ifranj, the Franks, Europeans (collective; nom.); 'the Franks'
أَطْرَافِهَا: aṭrāf-ihā — aṭrāf, quarters, sides (pl. of ṭaraf; gen. after min sāʾir) + their (f.); 'its quarters'
لْفَرْ: al-far — first piece of الفرنسيس, 'the French', which the print splits into three (كا لفر نسيس); ka-, like, in كَا + al-far[ansīs]
نَسِيسِ: nasīs — last piece of الفرنسيس (al-Faransīs, the French), split off by the print; with the preceding piece, 'the French'
وَالنَّمْسَا: وَ + الـ + نَّمْسَا — wa-, and + al-Namsā, Austria (proper name, f.); 'and Austria'
وَدُوبَرَهْ: وَ + دُوبَرَهْ — wa-, and + Dūbara, a place-name not identified (the print ends it in h); 'and Dūbara'
وَجُورْنَهْ: وَ + جُورْنَهْ — wa-, and + Jūrna, a place-name not identified (the print ends it in h); 'and Jūrna'
وَبُنْدُقِيَّهْ: وَ + بُنْدُقِيَّهْ — wa-, and + Bunduqiyya, Venice (the print ends it in h for ة); 'and Venice'
وَجَنُوِيزَ: وَ + جَنُوِيزَ — wa-, and + Janūwīz, Genoa (proper name, diptote); 'and Genoa'
تَكَامَلَتِ: takāmalat — takāmala, be complete (VI; perfect 3 f. sg., vowelled before the article); 'were complete'
كَثْرَتِهِمْ: kathrat-ihim — kathra, abundance, multitude (f., gen. after min) + their; 'their multitude'
يَرْحَلُوا: yarḥalū — raḥala, depart, set out (I; subjunctive 3 m. pl., after an); 'they depart'
وَاسْتَمَرَّ: وَ + اسْتَمَرَّ — wa-, and + istamarra, continue, go on (X; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and it continued'
تَتَابُعُ: tatābuʿ — following one upon another, succession (VI verbal noun, m., nom.); 'the succession of'
عَسَاكِرِهِمْ: ʿasākir-ihim — ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; gen.) + their; 'their armies'
وَسَارُ: وَ + سَارُ — wa-, and + sārū, went (I; perfect 3 m. pl.), first piece of a word the print splits (سار وا); 'and they went'
وا: wā — second piece of سار وا, the plural ending of sārū split off by the print; no separate meaning
بِوَادِي: bi-wādī — bi-, in (prep.) + wādī, valley (m., gen. in the iḍāfa); 'in the valley of'
فَأَتَتْهُمُ: فَـ + أَتَتْ + هُمُ — fa-, so + atat, came (I; perfect 3 f. sg.) + them; 'so there came to them'
وَحُمَاةِ: وَ + حُمَاة — wa-, and + ḥumāt, protectors, defenders (pl. of ḥāmī; gen., coordinate with ʿasākir); 'and the defenders of'
مِلَّةِ: milla — religious community, faith (f., gen. in the iḍāfa); 'the community of'
خَيْرِ: khayr — best, the best of (m., gen. in the iḍāfa khayr al-anām); 'the best of'
رَأَوْا: raʾaw — raʾā, see (I; perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they saw'
غُبَارًا: ghubār — dust (m., acc. indefinite, object of raʾaw); 'dust'
طَارَحَتَّى: طَارَ + حَتَّى — ṭāra, flew, rose (I; perfect 3 m. sg.) + ḥattā, until; the print runs the two together; 'flew until'
تَمْضِ: tamḍi — maḍā, pass (I; jussive 3 f. sg., after lam); 'did not pass'
وَتَمَزَّقَ: وَ + تَمَزَّقَ — wa-, and + tamazzaqa, be torn to pieces (V; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and was torn apart'
وَمَحَتْ: وَ + مَحَتْ — wa-, and + maḥat, wipe out, efface (I; perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and wiped out'
ظُلْمَتَهُ: ẓulmat-ahu — ẓulma, darkness (f., acc., object of maḥat) + its; 'its darkness'
كَوَاكِبُ: kawākib — stars (pl. of kawkab; nom. as subject of maḥat); 'the stars of'
الْأَسِنَّةِ: الـ + أَسِنَّة — al-asinna, the spear-points (pl. of sinān; gen. after kawākib); 'the spear-points'
وَالرِّمَاحِ: وَ + الـ + رِّمَاح — wa-, and + al-rimāḥ, the lances (pl. of rumḥ; gen.); 'and the lances'
وَبَرِيقُ: وَ + بَرِيق — wa-, and + barīq, gleam, glitter (m., nom.); 'and the gleam of'
بِيضِ: bīḍ — white ones (pl. of abyaḍ; gen. in the iḍāfa bīḍ al-ṣifāḥ, 'white broad-swords'); 'white'
الصِّفَاحِ: الـ + صِّفَاح — al-ṣifāḥ, the broad blades, broad-swords (pl. of ṣafīḥa; gen.); 'the broad-swords'
إِسْلَامِيَّةٌ: islāmiyya — Islamic (f. sg. relative adjective; nom. indefinite); 'Islamic'
مُحَمَّدِيَّةٌ: muḥammadiyya — Muḥammadan, of Muḥammad (f. sg. relative adjective; nom. indefinite); 'Muḥammadan'
كَانْدِفَاعِ: كَـ + انْدِفَاع — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + indifāʿ, rushing, surging (VII verbal noun, m., gen.); 'like the rushing of'
دُرُوعٍ: durūʿ — coats of mail, armour (pl. of dirʿ; gen. indefinite after fī); 'coats of mail'
تَحْسَبُهَا: taḥsabu-hā — ḥasiba, reckon, think (I; imperfect 2 m. sg.) + it/them (f.); 'you would reckon them'
سُحُبًا: suḥub — clouds (pl. of saḥāb; acc. as second object of taḥsabuhā); 'clouds'
مُزَرَّدَةً: muzarrada — ringed with mail, linked in rings (II passive participle, f. sg.; acc. adjective); 'ringed'
أَقْمَارٍ: aqmār — moons (pl. of qamar; gen. after ʿalā); 'moons'
تَقَابَلَ: taqābala — face one another (VI; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'faced each other'
الْجَيْشَانِ: الـ + جَيْشَان — al-jayshān, the two armies (dual of jaysh; nom.); 'the two armies'
وَالْتَطَمَ: وَ + الْتَطَمَ — wa-, and + iltaṭama, dash together, clash like waves (VIII; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and clashed'
الْبَحْرَانِ: الـ + بَحْرَان — al-baḥrān, the two seas (dual of baḥr; nom.); 'the two seas'
الْعَيْنُ: الـ + عَيْن — al-ʿayn, the eye (f., nom.); 'the eye'
وَعَسَاكِرُ: وَ + عَسَاكِر — wa-, and + ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; nom. in apposition); 'and the armies of'
ثَلْثِينَ: thalthīna — thirty (the print's spelling of ثلاثين; acc. before alf); 'thirty'
عِنَانٍ: ʿinān — rein, bridle (m., gen. indefinite after alf); 'reins', i.e. riders
وَمُقَدَّمُ: وَ + مُقَدَّم — wa-, and + muqaddam, commander, one placed in front (II passive participle, m., nom.); 'and the commander of'
رُسْتُمُ: Rustam — proper name, m. (nom. diptote, in apposition to muqaddam al-Daylam)
وَبَهْرَامُ: وَ + بَهْرَام — wa-, and + Bahrām, proper name, m. (nom. diptote); 'and Bahrām'
وَرَائِهِمْ: warāʾ-ihim — warāʾ, behind (m., gen. after min) + their; 'behind them'
صَوْبِ: ṣawb — direction, quarter (m., gen. after min, in the iḍāfa); 'the direction of'
لَابِسُونَ: lābisūna — labisa, wear, put on (I; active participle, m. pl. nom.); 'wearing'
زَرَدَ: zarad — chain-mail, mail rings (m., acc., object of the participle); 'mail'
وَالسَّافِرَةِ: وَ + الـ + سَّافِرَة — wa-, and + al-sāfira, the unveiled one, the one that shows its face (f. active participle of safara; gen., coordinate with al-badr); 'and the unveiled one'
الْعَاكِرَةِ: الـ + عَاكِرَة — al-ʿākira, murky, turbid, dark (f. adjective; gen. after al-layālī); 'the murky'
يَالَعِيسَى: يَا + لَـ + عِيسَى — yā, O + la-, the lām of the battle-cry (to, for, on behalf of) + ʿĪsā, Jesus (proper name, m.); the print sets them as one word; 'O for ʿĪsā!'
وَالصَّلِيبِ: وَ + الـ + صَّلِيب — wa-, and + al-ṣalīb, the cross (m., gen., coordinate with ʿĪsā in the cry); 'and the cross'
الْمُسَخَّمِ: الـ + مُسَخَّم — al-musakhkham, the blackened, i.e. the soot-black, accursed (II passive participle, m.; gen. adjective of al-ṣalīb); 'the blackened'
انْطَبَقُوا: inṭabaqū — inṭabaqa ʿalā, close upon, come down upon (VII; perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they closed upon'
بِتَدْبِيرِ: بِـ + تَدْبِير — bi-, by, through (prep. of means) + tadbīr, contriving, scheming (II verbal noun, m., gen.); 'by the scheming of'
الْعَسِيرِ: الـ + عَسِير — al-ʿasīr, the hard, difficult (m. adjective, gen. after al-amr); 'the hard'
وَالْكَاهِنُ: وَ + الـ + كَاهِن — wa-, and + al-kāhin, the priest, diviner (m., nom. vocative with ayyuhā); 'and the priest'
الْخَطِيرُأَنِّي: الـ + خَطِير + أَنَّ + ـِي — al-khaṭīr, the weighty, mighty (m. adjective, nom.) + anna, that + -ī, I (suffix of anna); run together by the print; 'the mighty, that I'
بِأَمْرٍ: بِـ + أَمْر — bi-, here the preposition after ashāra ʿalā, 'to advise (someone) of/with' + amr, matter, plan (m., gen. indefinite); 'with a plan'; here: bi- after ittahama, 'to accuse (someone) of', marking the charge: 'of a matter' Also after amara, 'to command', bi- marks the thing commanded: an āmuraka bi-amrin, 'that I give you a command'.
تَدْبِيرِهِ: tadbīr-ihi — tadbīr, contriving, devising (II verbal noun, m., gen. after ʿan) + it; 'devising it'
إِبْلِيسُ: Iblīs — the devil, Satan (proper name, m., nom. as subject of yaʿjizu); 'Iblīs'
وَلَوِ: وَ + لَوِ — wa-, and + law, even if (vowelled before the article); 'even if'
اسْتَعَانَ: istaʿāna — istaʿāna ʿalā bi-, seek help against something with someone (X; perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he sought help'
بِحِزْبِهِ: bi-ḥizb-ihi — bi-, with, by means of (prep., after istaʿāna) + ḥizb, party, band (m., gen.) + his; 'with his party'
الْمَتَاعِيسِ: الـ + مَتَاعِيس — al-matāʿīs, the wretched ones (pl. of matʿūs; gen. adjective of ḥizb); 'the wretched'
وَيَتَوَجَّهُونَ: و + يَتَوَجَّهُونَ — yatawajjahūna, they head, make for (V tawajjaha, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they head out'
يَصِلُوا: yaṣilū, they arrive (imperfect subjunctive 3 m. pl. of waṣala, after إلى أن); 'they reach'
الدُّخَانِ: الـ + دُخَان — al-dukhān, the smoke (m., gen. in the name جبل الدخان, 'Mountain of Smoke')
وَيُقِيمُونَ: و + يُقِيمُونَ — yuqīmūna, they stay, remain (IV aqāma, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they stay'
وَلَايَرْحَلُونَ: و + لَا + يَرْحَلُونَ — wa-, and + lā, not + yarḥalūna, they depart (raḥala, imperfect 3 m. pl.); the print joins lā to the verb; 'and they do not leave'
تَأْتِيَكُمْ: taʾtiya-kum, comes to you (subjunctive of atā after ḥattā, + you m. pl. as object); 'comes to you'
نُقَابِلُهُمْ: nuqābilu-hum, we face, confront them (III qābala, imperfect 1 pl. + them); 'we meet them'
وَدَامَ: و + دَامَ — wa-, and + dāma, it lasted, continued (perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and it lasted'
الْهَنَاءُ: الـ + هَنَاء — al-hanāʾ, gladness, ease (m., nom.); rhymes with al-ʿanāʾ, 'toil'
فَاسْتَصْوَبَ: فَـ + اسْتَصْوَبَ — fa-, so + istaṣwaba, he judged right, approved (X, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'so he approved'
رَأْيُكِ: raʾy-uki, your (f. sg.) opinion, plan (raʾy, m. nom. + you f.); 'your plan'
يَاسَيِّدَةَ: يَا + سَيِّدَة — yā, O (vocative; the print joins it) + sayyida, mistress, lady (f., accusative construct); 'O mistress'
الْعَجَائِزِ: الـ + عَجَائِز — al-ʿajāʾiz, the old women (pl. of ʿajūz, gen., in construct with sayyida); 'of the old women'
الْمَاكِرَةِ: الـ + مَاكِرَة — al-mākira, the crafty, scheming (f. sg. active participle of makara, gen. adjective); 'the crafty'
وَمَرْجِعَ: و + مَرْجِع — wa-, and + marjiʿa, refuge, resort, place of return (m., accusative vocative in construct); 'and refuge of'
الْكُهَّانِ: الـ + كُهَّان — al-kuhhān, the priests, soothsayers (pl. of kāhin, gen.); 'of the priests'
الْفِتَنِ: الـ + فِتَن — al-fitan, the troubles, strifes (pl. of fitna, gen.); 'in the troubles'
الثَّائِرَةِ: الـ + ثَائِرَة — al-thāʾira, the rising, surging (f. sg. active participle of thāra, gen. adjective); 'the rising'
يَشْعُرُوا: yashʿurū, they were aware (shaʿara, perfect-sense jussive after lam, 3 m. pl.); 'they did not know'
وَالنَّارُ: و + الـ + نَار — wa-, and (here circumstantial: 'when suddenly') + al-nār, the fire (f., nom.); 'and the fire'
تَلْتَهِبُ: taltahibu, it blazes (VIII iltahaba, imperfect 3 f. sg.); 'blazes'
وَالسُّيُوفُ: و + الـ + سُيُوف — wa-, and + al-suyūf, the swords (pl. of sayf, nom.); 'and the swords'
الْأَجْسَامِ: الـ + أَجْسَام — al-ajsām, the bodies (pl. of jism, gen.); 'in the bodies'
وَتَبِعُوا: و + تَبِعُوا — wa-, and + tabiʿū, they followed (tabiʿa, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they followed'
أَثَرَهُمْ: athar-hum, their track, trace (athar, m. acc. + them); 'their track'
يَاحِزْبَ: يَا + حِزْب — yā, O (vocative; the print joins it) + ḥizba, party, band (m., accusative construct); 'O party'
الْمُخْتَارِ: الـ + مُخْتَار — al-mukhtār, the chosen (passive participle of VIII ikhtāra, gen. epithet of al-nabī); 'the chosen'
وَقَاتِلُوا: و + قَاتِلُوا — wa-, and + qātilū, fight! (III qātala, imperative m. pl.); 'and fight'
الْكُفْرِ: الـ + كُفْر — al-kufr, unbelief (m., gen.); 'of unbelief'
وَالْعُدْوَانِ: و + الـ + عُدْوَان — wa-, and + al-ʿudwān, enmity, aggression (m., gen.); 'and aggression'
بِطَائِفَةٍ: بِـ + طَائِفَة — bi-, with (prep.; he came 'with' a force) + ṭāʾifa, band, body of men (f., gen.); 'with a band'
وَسِتِّمِائَةِ: و + سِتِّمِائَة — wa-, and + sittimiʾa, six hundred (sitt + miʾa, gen. in construct with alf); 'and six hundred'
اخْتَلَطَ: اخْتَلَطَ — ikhtalaṭa, he mingled, joined (VIII, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'they mingled'
قَوِيَتْ: qawiyat, it became strong (qawiya, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'grew strong'
قَائِلِينَ: qāʾilīna, saying (active participle of qāla, acc. pl., circumstantial); 'saying'
وَعَدَنَا: waʿada-nā, he promised us (waʿada, perfect 3 m. sg. + us); 'promised us'
بِالنَّصْرِ: بِـ + الـ + نَصْر — bi-, with (the object of the promise) + al-naṣr, victory, help (m., gen.); 'victory'; after daʿā li-X, bi- names what is prayed for: yadʿū li-al-muslimīna bi-al-naṣri 'praying for victory for the Muslims'
وَأَوْعَدَ: و + أَوْعَدَ — wa-, and + awʿada, he threatened (IV, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and threatened'
الْكُفَّارَ: الـ + كُفَّار — al-kuffār, the unbelievers (pl. of kāfir, acc.); 'the unbelievers'
بِالْخِذْلَانِ: بِـ + الـ + خِذْلَان — bi-, with (the object of the threat) + al-khidhlān, abandonment, desertion (m., gen.); 'with abandonment'
تَصَادَمُوا: taṣādamū, they clashed (VI, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they clashed'
وَالسِّنَانِ: و + الـ + سِنَان — wa-, and + al-sinān, spear-point, lance (m., gen.); 'and the spear-point'
وَاخْتَرَقَ: و + اخْتَرَقَ — wa-, and + ikhtaraqa, he pierced, cut through (VIII, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and he cut through'
الصُّفُوفَ: الـ + صُفُوف — al-ṣufūf, the ranks (pl. of ṣaff, acc.); 'the ranks'
الْأُلُوفِ: الـ + أُلُوف — al-ulūf, the thousands (pl. of alf, gen.); 'among the thousands'
وَقَاتَلَ: و + قَاتَلَ — wa-, and + qātala, he fought (III, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and fought'
تَشِيبُ: tashību, it turns grey, grows white-haired (shāba, imperfect 3 f. sg., with al-aṭfāl); 'turn grey'
الْأَطْفَالُ: الـ + أَطْفَال — al-aṭfāl, the children (pl. of ṭifl, nom.); 'the children'
يَجُولُ: yajūlu, he ranges, goes about (jāla, imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'he ranged'
الصَّارِمَ: الـ + صَارِم — al-ṣārim, the sharp, keen (active participle of ṣarama; here the 'keen (sword)', acc. object); 'the keen'
الْبَتَّارَ: الـ + بَتَّار — al-battār, the cutting (intensive of bātir, 'cutter'; acc. epithet of al-ṣārim); 'the cutting'
وَيُنَادِي: و + يُنَادِي — wa-, and + yunādī, he calls out (III nādā, imperfect 3 m. sg.); 'and calls out'
الْأَجْسَامُ: الـ + أَجْسَام — al-ajsām, the bodies (pl. of jism, nom.); 'the bodies'
وَنَصَرَ: و + نَصَرَ — wa-, and + naṣara, he gave victory to, helped (perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and gave victory to'
يُقَاتِلُونَ: yuqātilūna, they fight (III qātala, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they were fighting'
سُكَارَى: sukārā, drunk (pl. of sakrān, 'drunk'; circumstantial hāl); 'drunk'
الْوَقْعَةِ: الـ + وَقْعَة — al-waqʿa, the battle, encounter (f., gen.); 'battle'
وَأَرْبَعُونَ: و + أَرْبَعُونَ — wa-, and + arbaʿūna, forty (nom.); 'and forty'
وَقُتِلَ: و + قُتِلَ — wa-, and + qutila, he was killed (qatala, passive perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and were killed'
وَخَمْسُمِائَةٍ: و + خَمْسُمِائَة — wa-, and + khamsumiʾa, five hundred (khams + miʾa, gen.); 'and five hundred'
أَسَدَالدِّينِ: asad al-dīn, Asad al-Dīn, 'Lion of the Faith' (Sharrukān's title; the print joins the two words); 'Asad al-Dīn'
يَنَمْ: yanam, he sleeps (nāma, jussive after lam, 3 m. sg.); 'he did not sleep'
لَاهُوَ: لَا + هُوَ — lā, not + huwa, he; the print joins them; 'neither he'
يُبَشِّرَانِ: yubashshirāni, they two give good news to (II bashshara, imperfect 3 m. dual); 'they were bringing glad tidings'
وَيَتَفَقَّدَانِ: و + يَتَفَقَّدَانِ — wa-, and + yatafaqqadāni, they two look in on, inspect (V tafaqqada, imperfect 3 m. dual); 'and visiting'
الْجَرْحَى: الـ + جَرْحَى — al-jarḥā, the wounded (pl. of jarīḥ, acc.); 'the wounded'
وَيُهَنِّئَانِهِمْ: و + يُهَنِّئَانِهِمْ — wa-, and + yuhanniʾāni-him, they two congratulate them (II hannaʾa, imperfect 3 m. dual + them; the print writes it with plain ya); 'and congratulating them'
وَالثَّوَابِ: و + الـ + ثَوَاب — wa-, and + al-thawāb, reward, recompense (m., gen.); 'and the reward'
وَمَلِكِ: و + مَلِك — wa-, and + malik, king (m., gen. in construct with al-rūm); 'and king of'
وَأُمِّهِ: و + أُمّ + هِ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., gen.) + his; 'and his mother'
لِبَعْضِهِمْ: لِـ + بَعْض + هِمْ — li-, to (prep.) + baʿḍ, some, one (m.) + their; 'to one another'
إِنَّا: innā, truly we (inna + nā; the print has the hamza written); 'indeed we'
الْمُرَادَ: الـ + مُرَاد — al-murād, the aim, desire (m., acc., object); 'the aim'
وَشَفَيْنَا: و + شَفَيْنَا — wa-, and + shafaynā, we healed, slaked (shafā, perfect 1 pl.); 'and healed'
الْفُؤَادَ: الـ + فُؤَاد — al-fuʾād, the heart (m., acc.); 'the heart'
إِعْجَابَنَا: iʿjāb-anā, our wonder, delight, pride (iʿjāb, m. verbal noun of IV, acc. after lākin + us); 'our pride'
بِكَثْرَتِنَا: بِـ + كَثْرَة + نَا — bi-, in, at (iʿjāb bi-, 'pride in') + kathra, multitude (f., gen.) + our; 'in our numbers'
خَذَلَنَا: khadhala-nā, he forsook us, let us down (perfect 3 m. sg. + us); 'forsook us'
لَايَنْفَعُكُمْ: لَا + يَنْفَعُ + كُمْ — lā, not + yanfaʿu, it profits (imperfect 3 m. sg.) + you m. pl.; the print joins lā to the verb; 'it does not profit you'
تَتَقَرَّبُوا: tataqarrabū, you draw near (V, imperfect 2 m. pl.; the print has no final nūn, as after أن); 'you draw near'
لِلْمَسِيحِ: لِـ + الـ + مَسِيح — li-, to (prep.): after taqarraba, 'draw near to'; after a word of thanks or praise, the one it is owed to (al-shukru li-al-masīḥi, 'thanks be to the Messiah') + al-masīḥ, the Messiah (m., gen.); 'to the Messiah'
وَتَتَمَسَّكُوا: و + تَتَمَسَّكُوا — wa-, and + tatamassakū, you hold fast (V, imperfect 2 m. pl.; no final nūn in the print); 'and hold fast'
بِالِاعْتِقَادِ: بِـ + الِاعْتِقَاد — bi-, to (tamassaka bi-, 'hold to') + al-iʿtiqād, belief, creed (m., gen.); 'to the belief'
قَوَّى: qawwā, he strengthened (II, perfect 3 m. sg.; the print points the shadda); 'strengthened'
عَوَّلْتُ: ʿawwaltu, I relied on, resolved (II ʿawwala, perfect 1 sg.); 'I have resolved'
أَصُفَّ: aṣuffa, I draw up in array (ṣaffa, subjunctive 1 sg. after an); 'I draw up'
وَأُخْرِجَ: و + أُخْرِجَ — wa-, and + ukhrija, I bring out (IV akhraja, subjunctive 1 sg. after an); 'and bring out'
لُوقَا: lūqā, Lūqā (Luke), a Greek name of the champion; 'Lūqā'
شَمْلُوطٍ: shamlūṭ, Shamlūṭ, a name (gen., after ibn); 'Shamlūṭ'
تَقْدِيسِكُمْ: taqdīs-ikum, your hallowing, sanctifying (II verbal noun taqdīs, gen. after ʿalā + you m. pl.); 'hallowing you'
بِالْبَخُورِ: بِـ + الـ + بَخُور — bi-, with (bi-, 'with the incense') + al-bakhūr, incense (m., gen.); 'with the incense'
خُرْءَ: khurʾa, dung, excrement (m., acc.; khurʾ, the print writes it with final hamza); 'the dung of'
الْإِنْكَارِ: الـ + إِنْكَار — al-inkār, denial, denunciation (m., gen.); 'the denial'
وَالنَّكِيرِ: و + الـ + نَكِير — wa-, and + al-nakīr, rebuke, disapproval (m., gen.; paired with al-inkār); 'and the rebuke'
يَتَنَافَسُونَ: yatanāfasūna, they vie, compete (VI, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they vied'
وَيَسْتَحْسِنُونَ: و + يَسْتَحْسِنُونَ — wa-, and + yastaḥsinūna, they find good, approve (X, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'and thought fair'
مَسَاوِيَهُ: masāwī-hi, its faults, ill qualities, foulness (pl. of masāʾ/masāwī, acc. + his); 'its foulness'
أَكَابِرُ: akābir, the greatest, elders (pl. of akbar, nom. in construct with baṭāriqa); 'the greatest of'
بَطَارِقَةِ: baṭāriqa, the patriarchs (pl. of baṭrīq, gen. in construct with al-rūm); 'of the patriarchs'
يَبْعَثُونَهُ: yabʿathūna-hu, they send it (baʿatha, imperfect 3 m. pl. + it); 'they would send it'
أَقَالِيمِ: aqālīm, regions, provinces (pl. of iqlīm, gen. in construct with bilād-him); 'provinces of'
خِرَقٍ: khiraq, rags, scraps (pl. of khirqa, gen. indefinite); 'in scraps'
وَيَمْزُجُونَهُ: و + يَمْزُجُونَ + هُ — wa-, and + yamzujūna, they mix (mazaja, imperfect 3 m. pl.) + it; 'and mix it'
وَالْعَبِيرِ: و + الـ + عَبِير — wa-, and + al-ʿabīr, perfume, ambergris (m., gen.); 'and perfume'
يَأْخُذُونَ: yaʾkhudhūna, they take (akhadha, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they would take'
يُرْسِلُونَ: yursilūna, they send (IV arsala, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'send'
طَلَبِهِ: ṭalab-ihi, its seeking, request (ṭalab, m., gen. after fī + it); 'in search of it' Also (Night 196): طَلَب + ـهِ — ṭalab, seeking, search (verbal noun of ṭalaba; m., gen. after fī) + 3ms, the one sought; 'seeking him'
بَخُورِ: bakhūr, incense (m., gen. in construct with al-ʿarāʾis); 'incense of'
الْعَرَائِسِ: الـ + عَرَائِس — al-ʿarāʾis, the brides (pl. of ʿarūs, gen.); 'of the brides'
يَخْلِطُونَهُ: yakhliṭūna-hu, they mix it (khalaṭa, imperfect 3 m. pl. + it); 'they mixed it'
بِخُرْئِهِمْ: بِـ + خُرْء + هِمْ — bi-, with (khalaṭa bi-, 'mix with') + khurʾ, dung (m., gen.; the print spells it with ya-hamza) + their; 'with their own dung'
لَايَكْفِي: لَا + يَكْفِي — lā, not + yakfī, it suffices (kafā, imperfect 3 m. sg.); the print joins lā to the verb; 'does not suffice'
أَقَالِيمَ: aqālīma, regions (pl. of iqlīm, gen. diptote after ʿasharata); 'regions'
خَوَاصُّ: khawāṣṣ, the special ones, intimates (pl. of khāṣṣa, nom. in construct); 'the favourites of'
مُلُوكِهِمْ: mulūk-ihim, their kings (pl. of malik, gen. + their); 'their kings'
يَجْعَلُونَ: yajʿalūna, they put, make (jaʿala, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they used to put'
كُحْلِ: kuḥl, kohl, eye-salve (m., gen. in construct with al-ʿuyūn); 'kohl of'
وَيُدَاوُونَ: و + يُدَاوُونَ — wa-, and + yudāwūna, they treat medically (III dāwā, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'and treat'
وَالْمَبْطُونَ: و + الـ + مَبْطُون — wa-, and + al-mabṭūn, one afflicted in the belly (passive participle of baṭana, acc.); 'and the bowel-sick'
وَأَشْرَقَ: و + أَشْرَقَ — wa-, and + ashraqa, it shone, rose (IV, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and shone'
وَتَبَادَرَتِ: و + تَبَادَرَتِ — wa-, and + tabādarati, they hastened (VI tabādara, perfect 3 f. sg. with al-fursān, before a definite article); 'and hastened'
لِلتِّسْعِينَ: لِـ + الـ + تِسْعِين — li-, for, of (prep.; here ‘the one that completes the ninety’) + al-, the + tisʿīn, ninety (gen. pl. after lām); 'for the ninety'
بِخَوَاصِّ: بِـ + خَوَاصّ — bi-, with (prep.; dāʿā bi- ‘call for’) + khawāṣṣ, the chosen ones, intimates (pl. of khāṣṣa, gen.); 'for the chosen ones of'
بَطَارِقَتِهِ: بَطَارِقَة + هِ — baṭāriqa, patriarchs, Christian dignitaries (pl. of baṭrīq, gen. of idāfa) + -hi, his; 'his patriarchs'
وَنَقَشَ: و + نَقَشَ — wa-, and + naqasha, he engraved, marked (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and engraved'
وَبَخَّرَهُمْ: و + بَخَّرَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + bakhkhara, he perfumed, fumigated (II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and perfumed them'
الْمُتَقَدِّمِ: الـ + مُتَقَدِّم — al-, the + mutaqaddim, preceding, aforementioned (V active participle of taqaddama, gen. after bi-); 'the aforementioned'
خُرْوُ: خُرْو — khurʾ, dung, excrement (the print’s خرو for classical خَرْء; nom. predicate of huwa, in idāfa with al-baṭrīq); 'dung of'
وَالْكَاهِنِ: و + الـ + كَاهِن — wa-, and + al-, the + kāhin, priest (gen., second term after al-baṭrīq); 'and the priest'
الْأَذْكَرِ: الـ + أَذْكَر — al-, the + adhkar, more mentioned, more renowned (elative of dhakara, gen., apposition after al-kāhin); 'the most renowned'
بَخَّرَهُمْ: بَخَّرَ + هُمْ — bakhkhara, he perfumed (II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'he had perfumed them'
بِحُضُورِهِ: بِـ + حُضُور + هِ — bi-, to (prep.; daʿā bi- ‘call for’) + ḥuḍūr, presence + -hi, his; 'to his presence'
شَمْلُوطَ: شَمْلُوط — Shamlūṭ, a personal name (gen., in idāfa after ibn); 'Shamlūṭ'
يُسَمُّونَهُ: يُسَمُّونَ + هُ — yusammūna, they name, call (II, imperfect 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'they call him'
سَيْفَ: سَيْف — sayf, sword (acc., second object of yusammūna, in idāfa with al-masīḥ); 'sword of'; also second object of qallada, 'gird with the sword of'
وَبَخَّرَهُ: و + بَخَّرَ + هُ — wa-, and + bakhkhara, he perfumed (II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and perfumed him'
بِالرَّجِيعِ: بِـ + الـ + رَجِيع — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + al-, the + rajīʿ, droppings, dung; 'with the dung'
وَحَكَّهُ: و + حَكَّ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥakka, he rubbed (I, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and rubbed him'
التَّبْخِيرِ: الـ + تَبْخِير — al-, the + tabkhīr, perfuming, fumigation (verbal noun of II, gen. after baʿda); 'the perfuming'
وَنَشَّقَهُ: و + نَشَّقَ + هُ — wa-, and + nashshaqa, he made (him) snuff, inhale (II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and made him sniff it'
وَلَطَّخَ: و + لَطَّخَ — wa-, and + laṭṭakha, he smeared (II, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and smeared'
عَوَارِضَهُ: عَوَارِض + هُ — ʿawāriḍ, cheeks, side-whiskers (pl. of ʿāriḍ, acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his cheeks'
بِالنَّخْلَةِ: بِـ + الـ + نَخْلَة — bi-, with (prep., instrument; masaḥa bi- ‘wipe with’) + al-, the + nakhla, palm-tree, palm-frond; 'with the palm-frond'
شَوَارِبَهُ: شَوَارِب + هُ — shawārib, moustaches (pl. of shārib, acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his moustaches'
أَضْرَبُ: أَضْرَب — aḍrab, more striking, more skilful at striking (elative of ḍaraba, after lā ‘none’); 'more striking'
أَطْعَنُ: أَطْعَن — aṭʿan, more thrusting (elative of ṭaʿana ‘to thrust’); 'more thrusting'
النِّزَالِ: الـ + نِزَال — al-, the + nizāl, combat, single fight (gen. in idāfa after yawm); 'combat'
بَشِعَ: بَشِع — bashiʿ, ugly, repulsive (adj. in idāfa with al-manẓar, acc. predicate of kāna); 'ugly of'
كَأَنَّ: كَأَنَّ — ka-anna, as if, as though (particle, governs the acc.); 'as if'
وَصُورَتَهُ: و + صُورَة + هُ — wa-, and + ṣūra, form, shape + -hu, his (acc. after ka-anna); 'and his form'
صُورَةُ: صُورَة — ṣūra, form, shape (nom. predicate, in idāfa with qird); 'the form of'
وَطَلْعَتَهُ: و + طَلْعَة + هُ — wa-, and + ṭalʿa, countenance, appearance + -hu, his; 'and his countenance'
طَلْعَةُ: طَلْعَة — ṭalʿa, countenance, look (nom. predicate, in idāfa with al-raqīb); 'the look of'
الرَّقِيبِ: الـ + رَقِيب — al-, the + raqīb, watcher, guard; in love poetry the spy or rival who hinders lovers (gen.); 'the watcher'
وَقُرْبَهُ: و + قُرْب + هُ — wa-, and + qurb, nearness + -hu, his (acc. after ka-anna); 'and his nearness'
أَصْعَبُ: أَصْعَب — aṣʿab, harder, more difficult (elative of ṣaʿuba, nom. predicate); 'harder'
ظُلْمَتُهُ: ظُلْمَة + هُ — ẓulma, darkness + -hu, its (nom., object of the implied ‘he had’); 'its darkness'
نَكْهَتُهُ: نَكْهَة + هُ — nakha, breath of the mouth + -hu, its (nom.); 'its breath'
النَّمِرِ: الـ + نَمِر — al-, the + namir, leopard, tiger (gen. after min); 'the leopard'
وَقَاحَتُهُ: وَقَاحَة + هُ — waqāḥa, impudence, shamelessness + -hu, its; 'its impudence'
سِيمَتُهُ: سِيمَة + هُ — sīma, mark, stamp, look + -hu, its; 'its mark'
تَبْرُزَ: تَبْرُزَ — tabruza, you go out, sally forth (I, subjunctive 2 m. sg. after anna; here ‘go out to’ a combat, with ilā); 'that you go out'
انْجَلَى: انْجَلَى — injalā, it cleared away, was lifted (VII, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'has cleared'
الشَّرُّوَهُمَانُ: الـ + شَرّ + وَهُمَان — al-, the + sharr, evil, trouble, then وهمان, an unidentified word (the print joins them); read as ‘this evil’ + a garbled word; doubtful, flagged in the note; 'the evil … (word unclear)'
نَقَشَ: نَقَشَ — naqasha, he engraved, marked (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he engraved'
وَزَعَمَ: و + زَعَمَ — wa-, and + zaʿama, he claimed, asserted (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and claimed'
قَرِيبٍ: قَرِيب — qarīb, near (gen. after ʿan; ʿan qarīb ‘before long, soon’); 'nearness; soon'
أَشْقَرَ: أَشْقَر — ashqar, chestnut, reddish-bay (colour adj., acc.; of a horse); 'chestnut'
وَزَرَدِيَّةٌ: و + زَرَدِيَّة — wa-, and + zaradiyya, coat of mail, ringed armour (nom.); 'and a coat of mail'
الْمُرَصَّعِ: الـ + مُرَصَّع — al-, the + muraṣṣaʿ, set, inlaid (II passive participle of raṣṣaʿa, gen.); 'the set (with jewels)'
رِجَالُهُ: رِجَال + هُ — rijāl, men (pl. of rajul, nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his men'
ثُلْثَ: ثُلْث — thulth, the print’s spelling of ثَلَاث ‘three’ (long alif unwritten), kept as printed; acc. before ḥirāb; 'three'
حِرَابٍ: حِرَاب — ḥirāb, lances, spears (pl. of ḥarba, gen. in idāfa); 'of lances'
اللَّعِينُ: الـ + لَعِين — al-, the + laʿīn, accursed (adj., nom. in apposition to Iblīs); 'the accursed'
الْأَحْزَابِ: الـ + أَحْزَاب — al-, the + aḥzāb, confederates, the allied tribes (pl. of ḥizb, gen.); yawm al-Aḥzāb is the day of the siege of Medina; 'the Confederates'
وَحِزْبُهُ: و + حِزْب + هُ — wa-, and + ḥizb, party, band + -hu, his; 'and his party'
الْكُفَّارُ: الـ + كُفَّار — al-, the + kuffār, infidels, unbelievers (pl. of kāfir, nom., as subject or in apposition); 'the infidels'
يُسَاقُونَ: يُسَاقُونَ — yusāqūna, they are driven (I passive, imperfect 3 m. pl.); 'they are driven'
مُنَادٍيُنَادِي: مُنَادٍ + يُنَادِي — munādin, a crier, herald (III active participle, indefinite nom.) + yunādī, he cries (III, imperfect 3 m. sg.); the print joins the two words; 'a crier crying'
فَارِسُكُمْ: فَارِس + كُمْ — fāris, horseman, knight (nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your horseman'
سَيْفُ: سَيْف — sayf, sword (nom., in idāfa with al-Islām; ‘Sword of Islam’ is Sharrukān’s title); 'the sword of'
وَضَجَّةٌ: و + ضَجَّة — wa-, and + ḍajja, din, clamour (nom. after illā wa- ‘but, when’); 'and a clamour'
صَوْتَهَا: صَوْت + هَا — ṣawt, sound (acc. object) + -hā, its; 'its sound'
الْمَلَا: الـ + مَلَأ — al-, the + malaʾ, assembly, host, the notables (nom.); 'the assembly'
وَرَكَضَاتٌ: و + رَكَضَات — wa-, and + rakaḍāt, gallopings, hoof-beats (pl. of rakḍa, nom.); 'and gallopings'
فَرَّقَتِ: فَرَّقَتِ — farraqat, they (f.) parted, separated (II, perfect 3 f. sg.; with a final -i before the article); 'parted'
وَأَذْكَرَتْ: و + أَذْكَرَتْ — wa-, and + adhkarat, they recalled, reminded of (IV, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and recalled'
حُنَيْنٍ: حُنَيْن — Ḥunayn, a valley near Mecca and the famous battle there in the Prophet’s time (gen., in idāfa after yawm); 'Ḥunayn'
فَفَزِعَ: فَـ + فَزِعَ — fa-, and so + fazīʿa, he was frightened (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and so were frightened'
وَأَلْفَتُوا: و + أَلْفَتُوا — wa-, and + alfatū, they turned (the print’s والفتوا, probably a slip for والتفتوا; vocalised as a perfect 3 m. pl. by the sense; doubtful); 'and turned'
الْأَعْنَاقَ: الـ + أَعْنَاق — al-, the + aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq, acc. object); 'the necks'
نَحْوَهَا: نَحْو + هَا — naḥw, toward (acc. adverb) + -hā, it, her; 'toward it'
يُرِيدُونَكَ: يُرِيدُونَ + كَ — yurīdūna, they want (IV, imperfect 3 m. pl.) + -ka, you; 'they want you'
تَحَقَّقُوا: تَحَقَّقُوا — taḥaqqaqū, they made sure of, were certain of (V, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'they made sure'
يَبْرُزْلِي: يَبْرُزْ + لِي — yabruz, let (him) go out (I, jussive 3 m. sg., negative command with lā) + li-, to (prep.) + -ī, me; the print joins them; 'let none go out to me'
فَارِسُ: فَارِس — fāris, horseman, champion (nom., in idāfa with bilād); 'the horseman of'
يُخَلِّىَ: يُخَلِّيَ — yukhalliya, he empties, clears (II, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after anna; the print spells it with ى); 'that he empty'
أَخْسَرِ: أَخْسَر — akhsar, most losing, greatest of the losers (elative of khasira, gen. in idāfa with al-khāsirīn); 'the greatest of'
الْخَاسِرِينَ: الـ + خَاسِرِين — al-, the + khāsirīn, losers (I active participle of khasira, gen. pl.); 'the losers'
حَرَّقَ: حَرَّقَ — ḥarraqa, he burned (II, perfect 3 m. sg.); ‘to burn the livers’ means to cause grief; 'he burned'
الْأَكْبَادَ: الـ + أَكْبَاد — al-, the + akbād, livers (pl. of kabid, acc. object; the liver is the seat of feeling); 'the livers'
وَفَزِعَتْ: و + فَزِعَتْ — wa-, and + fazʿat, they (f.) were frightened (I, perfect 3 f. sg.; with a f. sg. verb before the pl. subject); 'and were frightened'
الْأَجْنَادُ: الـ + أَجْنَاد — al-, the + ajnād, armies, troops (pl. of jund, nom., subject); 'the armies'
وَالْأَكْرَادِ: و + الـ + أَكْرَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + akrād, Kurds (pl. of kurdī, gen.); 'and the Kurds'
بَرَزَإِلَيْهِ: بَرَزَ + إِلَيْهِ — baraza, he went out, sallied forth (I, perfect 3 m. sg.) + ilā-hi, to him (the print joins them); 'he went out to him'
أَسَدٌ: أَسَد — asad, lion (nom., predicate of ka-anna); 'a lion'
شَارِدَ: شَارِد — shārid, fleeing, bolting (I active participle, acc. in idāfa with al-ghizlān); 'the bolting of'
وَهَزَّ: و + هَزَّ — wa-, and + hazza, he shook, brandished (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and brandished'
الرُّمْحَ: الـ + رُمْح — al-, the + rumḥ, lance (acc. object); 'the lance'
أَفْعَى: أَفْعَى — afʿā, viper (nom., predicate of ka-anna, indeclinable in -ā); 'a viper'
الْحَيَّاتِ: الـ + حَيَّات — al-, the + ḥayyāt, snakes (pl. of ḥayya, gen. after min); 'the snakes'
الْأَبْ—يَاتَ: الـ + أَبْيَات — al-, the + abyāt, verses (pl. of bayt, acc. object of anshada; the print breaks the word with a dash); 'the verses'
اَشْقَرُ: أَشْقَر — ashqar, a chestnut (horse), here the horse itself (nom.; the print’s bare alif is kept in the verse); 'a chestnut'
سَمْحُ: سَمْح — samḥ, easy, free-going (adj., nom., in idāfa with al-ʿinān); 'easy of'
الْعِنَانِ: الـ + عِنَان — al-, the + ʿinān, rein (gen.); 'the rein'
مُغَائِرُ: مُغَائِر — mughāʾir, jealous, fiercely spirited (III active participle, nom.; the print’s reading, vocalised as printed); 'fiery'
مَجْهُودِهِ: مَجْهُود + هِ — majhūd, utmost effort, toil (gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'his utmost effort'
وَمُثَقَّفٌ: و + مُثَقَّف — wa-, and + muthaqqaf, a straightened one, a lance that has been trued (II passive participle of thaqqafa, nom.); 'and a straightened (lance)'
لَدْنُ: لَدْن — ladn, supple, pliant (adj., nom., in idāfa with al-sinān); 'supple of'
السِّنَانِ: الـ + سِنَان — al-, the + sinān, spear-head, point (gen.); 'the point'
اُمُّ: أُمّ — umm, mother (nom., first term of an idāfa; ‘mother of deaths’ is a poetic name for the deadly lance-head); 'mother of'
رُكِّبَتْ: رُكِّبَتْ — rukkibat, it (f.) was set, fixed (II passive, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'was set'
عُودِهِ: عُود + هِ — ʿūd, wood, shaft (gen. after fī) + -hi, its; 'its shaft'
وَمُهَنَّدٌ: و + مُهَنَّد — wa-, and + muhannad, an Indian-made blade, sword (II passive participle of hannada, nom.); 'and an Indian-wrought one'
جَرَّدْتَهُ: جَرَّدْتَ + هُ — jarradta, you drew, unsheathed (II, perfect 2 m. sg.) + -hu, it; 'you drew it'
خِلْتَ: خِلْتَ — khilta, you thought, imagined (I, perfect 2 m. sg.; takes two objects); 'you imagined'
الْبُرُوقَ: الـ + بُرُوق — al-, the + burūq, lightnings (pl. of barq, acc. object); 'the lightnings'
تَمُوجُ: تَمُوجُ — tamūju, it surges, heaves (I, imperfect 3 f. sg.); 'surging'
تَجْرِيدِهِ: تَجْرِيد + هِ — tajrīd, drawing, unsheathing (verbal noun of II, gen. after fī) + -hi, its; 'its drawing'
يَفْهَمْ: يَفْهَمْ — yafham, he understands (I, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam); 'did not understand'
وَلَاحَمَاسَ: و + لَا + حَمَاس — wa-, and + lā, nor + ḥamās, fervour, zeal (acc.; the print joins the three); 'nor the fervour of'
النِّظَامِ: الـ + نِظَام — al-, the + niẓām, arrangement, order; here the verse as a composition (gen.); 'the arrangement'
لِلصَّلِيبِ: لِـ + الـ + صَلِيب — li-, for, in honour of (prep.) + al-, the + ṣalīb, cross; 'in veneration of the cross'
قَبَّلَهَا: قَبَّلَ + هَا — qabbala, he kissed (II, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (the hand, f.); 'he kissed it'
وَأَشْرَعَ: و + أَشْرَعَ — wa-, and + ashraʿa, he levelled, pointed (IV, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and levelled'
وَكَرَّ: و + كَرَّ — wa-, and + karra, he charged, wheeled back to attack (I, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and charged'
طَوَّحَ: طَوَّحَ — ṭawwaḥa, he flung, tossed (II, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'he flung'
الْحَرْبَةَ: الـ + حَرْبَة — al-, the + ḥarba, spear, javelin (acc. object); 'the spear'
بِإِحْدَى: بِـ + إِحْدَى — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + iḥdā, one (f.; indeclinable in -ā; governs the dual yadayhi); 'with one of'
خَفِيَتْ: خَفِيَتْ — khafiyat, it (f.) was hidden, vanished (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'it was hidden'
أَعْيُنِ: أَعْيُن — aʿyun, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, gen. after ʿan); 'eyes of'
النَّاظِرِينَ: الـ + نَاظِرِين — al-, the + nāẓirīn, lookers, onlookers (I active participle, gen. pl.); 'the lookers'
وَتَلَقَّاهَا: و + تَلَقَّى + هَا — wa-, and + talaqqā, he caught, received (V, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'and caught it'
بِالْيَدِ: بِـ + الـ + يَد — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + al-, the + yad, hand (f., gen.); 'with the hand'
كَفِعْلِ: كَـ + فِعْل — ka-, like (prep.) + fiʿl, doing, act (gen.); 'like the doing of'
السَّاحِرِينَ: الـ + سَاحِرِين — al-, the + sāḥirīn, sorcerers, conjurors (gen. pl.); 'the sorcerers'
شِهَابٌ: شِهَاب — shihāb, shooting star, meteor (nom., predicate of ka-anna); 'a meteor'
ثَاقِبٌ: ثَاقِب — thāqib, piercing, bright (I active participle, adj.; shihāb thāqib is Qurʾānic; the print’s ثانب corrected); 'piercing'
فَضَجَّتِ: فَـ + ضَجَّتِ — fa-, and so + ḍajjati, it clamoured, cried out (I, perfect 3 f. sg. before the article); 'and so clamoured'
قَرُبَتِ: قَرُبَتِ — qarubati, it (f.) drew near (I, perfect 3 f. sg. before the article); 'drew near'
الْحَرْبَةُ: الـ + حَرْبَة — al-, the + ḥarba, spear (nom., subject); 'the spear'
اخْتَطَفَهَا: اخْتَطَفَ + هَا — ikhtaṭafa, he snatched (VIII, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'he snatched it'
فَتَحَيَّرَتْ: فَـ + تَحَيَّرَتْ — fa-, and so + taḥayyarat, they (f.) were bewildered (V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and so were bewildered'
هَزَّهَا: هَزَّ + هَا — hazza, he shook (I, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'he shook it'
كَادَأَنْ: كَادَ + أَنْ — kāda, he nearly (I, perfect 3 m. sg.; ‘almost did’) + an, that (the print joins them); 'he almost'
يَقْصِفَهَا: يَقْصِفَ + هَا — yaqṣifa, he breaks, snaps (I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an) + -hā, it; 'break it'
النَّظَرِ: الـ + نَظَر — al-, the + naẓar, sight, vision (gen. after ʿan); 'sight'
وَالْتَقَاهَا: و + الْتَقَى + هَا — wa-, and + iltaqā, he met, caught (VIII, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'and met it'
أَقْرَبَ: أَقْرَب — aqrab, nearer (elative of qaruba, gen. after fī); 'nearer'
لَمْحِ: لَمْح — lamḥ, glance, a flash (gen.; lamḥ al-baṣar ‘the blink of an eye’; the print’s لمج corrected); 'the glance of'
السَّبْعَ: الـ + سَبْع — al-, the + sabʿ, seven (acc. object of khalaqa); 'the seven'
الطِّبَاقَ: الـ + طِبَاق — al-, the + ṭibāq, layers, strata (pl. of ṭabaq, apposition; ‘the seven layers’ are the heavens); 'the layers'
لَأَجْعَلَنَّ: لَـ + أَجْعَلَنَّ — la-, surely (oath-particle) + ajʿalanna, I will make (I, energetic 1 sg.); 'I will surely make'
اللَّعِينَ: الـ + لَعِين — al-, the + laʿīn, accursed (adj., acc., in apposition to hādhā); 'the accursed'
شُهْرَةً: شُهْرَة — shuhra, fame, notoriety, an example known to all (acc., second object of ajʿalanna); 'a spectacle'
بِالْحَرْبَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حَرْبَة — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + al-, the + ḥarba, spear; 'with the spear'
الْحَرْبَةِ: الـ + حَرْبَة — al-, the + ḥarba, spear (gen. after ilā); 'the spear'
لِيَخْتَطِفَهَا: لِـ + يَخْتَطِفَ + هَا — li-, in order to (particle + subjunctive) + yakhtaṭifa, he snatches (VIII, 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it; 'to snatch it'
الصُّوَى: الـ + صُوًى — al-, the + ṣuwā, waymarks, desert signposts of stone (pl. of ṣuwwa, gen. after min); the print’s reading, probably a slip for الهوى, kept and flagged; 'the waymarks'
فَعَاجَلَهُ: فَـ + عَاجَلَ + هُ — fa-, and + ʿājala, he forestalled, anticipated (III, perfect 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and forestalled him'
بِضَرْبَةٍ: بِـ + ضَرْبَة — bi-, with (prep.) + ḍarba, a blow, stroke (gen.); 'with a blow'
الصَّلِيبِ: الـ + صَلِيب — al-, the + ṣalīb, cross (gen. in idāfa after wasaṭ); 'the cross'
وَعَجَّلَ: و + عَجَّلَ — wa-, and + ʿajjala, he hastened (II, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and hastened'
بِرُوحِهِ: بِـ + رُوح + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; ʿajjala bi- 'hurry (someone) off'; after fadā, 'ransom', bi- marks the price paid: 'with his life') + rūḥ, soul, life + -hi, his; 'his soul', 'with his soul'
وَبِئْسَ: و + بِئْسَ — wa-, and + biʾsa, wretched is (verb of blame, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and wretched is'
شَلْمُوطَ: شَلْمُوط — Shalmūṭ, a personal name; the print’s variant of شملوط ‘Shamlūṭ’; 'Shalmūṭ'
لَطَمُوا: لَطَمُوا — laṭamū, they struck, slapped (I, perfect 3 m. pl.; as a sign of grief); 'they struck'
وَاسْتَغَاثُوا: و + اسْتَغَاثُوا — wa-, and + istaghāthū, they called for help (X, perfect 3 m. pl.; takes bi- ‘on’ the one called); 'and called for help'
بِبَطَارِقَةِ: بِـ + بَطَارِقَة — bi-, on (prep.; istaghātha bi- ‘call on for help’) + baṭāriqa, patriarchs (gen.); 'on the patriarchs of'
الدُّيُورِ: الـ + دُيُور — al-, the + duyūr, monasteries (pl. of dayr, gen.); 'the monasteries'
وَالتِّسْعُونَ: و + التِّسْعُونَ — wa-, and + al-tisʿūna, the ninety (nom. pl. of the tens; one-and-ninetieth is built ‘the first and the ninety’); 'and the ninety'
الصُّلْبَانُ: الـ + صُلْبَان — al-, the + ṣulbān, crosses (pl. of ṣalīb, nom.); 'the crosses'
وَتَزَهُّدُ: و + تَزَهُّد — wa-, and + tazahhud, self-denial, asceticism (V verbal noun, nom.); 'and the self-denial of'
الرُّهْبَانِ: الـ + رُهْبَان — al-, the + ruhbān, monks (pl. of rāhib, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the monks'
وَأَعْمَلُوا: و + أَعْمَلُوا — wa-, and + aʿmalū, they put to work, plied (IV, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they plied'
الصَّوَارِمَ: الـ + صَوَارِم — al-, the + ṣawārim, keen swords (pl. of ṣārim, acc.); 'the swords'
وَهَجَمُوا: و + هَجَمُوا — wa-, and + hajamū, they rushed, charged (I, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they rushed'
وَالْتَقَتِ: و + الْتَقَتِ — wa-, and + iltaqat, it met (VIII, perfect 3 f. sg.; the final -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'and met'
الْحَوَافِرِ: الـ + حَوَافِر — al-, the + ḥawāfir, hooves (pl. of ḥāfir, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the hooves'
وَتَحَكَّمَتِ: و + تَحَكَّمَتِ — wa-, and + taḥakkamat, it held sway, ruled (V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and held sway'
وَالصَّوَارِمُ: و + الـ + صَوَارِم — wa-, and + al-, the + ṣawārim, swords (nom.); 'and the swords'
وَضَعُفَتِ: و + ضَعُفَتِ — wa-, and + ḍaʿufat, it grew weak (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and grew weak'
قَوَائِمَ: قَوَائِم — qawāʾim, legs (pl. of qāʾima; diptote, gen. after bi-lā ‘without’); 'legs'
مُنَادِي: مُنَادِي — munādī, crier, herald (active participle III of nādā, nom., in iḍāfa with al-ḥarb); 'the herald of'
كَلَّتِ: كَلَّتِ — kallat, it grew weary, tired (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'grew weary'
الْأَيَادِي: الـ + أَيَادِي — al-, the + ayādī, hands (pl. of yad, nom.); 'the hands'
شُجَاعٍ: شُجَاع — shujāʿ, brave (adj., m.), a brave man (gen. after kullu); 'a brave man'
كَالسَّكْرَانِ: كَـ + الـ + سَكْرَان — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + sakrān, drunk, drunkard (gen.); 'like the drunk'
امْتَلَأَتِ: امْتَلَأَتِ — imtalaʾat, it was filled (VIII of malaʾa, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'was filled'
بِالْقَتْلَى: بِـ + الـ + قَتْلَى — bi-, with, by (prep.) + al-, the + qatlā, the slain (pl. of qatīl, gen.); 'with the slain'
الْجِرَاحَاتُ: الـ + جِرَاحَات — al-, the + jirāḥāt, wounds (pl. of jirāḥa, nom.); 'the wounds'
وَلَايَعْرِفُ: و + لَا + يَعْرِفُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yaʿrifu, he knows, can tell (I, imperfect 3 m. sg.); the print runs the words together; 'and does not know'
الْجَرِيحُ: الـ + جَرِيح — al-, the + jarīḥ, wounded man (nom.); 'the wounded man'
بِأَخِيهِ: بِـ + أَخِي + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; ijtamaʿa bi- ‘meet with’) + akhī, brother (gen. in iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'with his brother'; after shughl, bi- names what occupies one: lam yakun lahu shughlun illā bi-akhīhi 'he had no concern but his brother'
وَالْحَاجِبِ: و + الـ + حَاجِب — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥājib, chamberlain (gen. after li-akhīhi … wa-); 'and the chamberlain'
لِهَلَاكِ: لِـ + هَلَاك — li-, for, to (prep.) + halāk, destruction (gen. in iḍāfa); 'for the destruction of'
الْكَافِرِينَ: الـ + كَافِرِين — al-, the + kāfirīna, unbelievers (active participle of kafara, gen. pl.); 'the unbelievers'
نَحْمَدُ: نَحْمَدُ — naḥmadu, we praise, thank (I, imperfect 1 pl.); 'we praise'
لِكَشْفِ: لِـ + كَشْف — li-, for, because of (prep.) + kashf, uncovering, lifting (verbal noun, gen. in iḍāfa); 'for the lifting of'
الْكَرْبِ: الـ + كَرْب — al-, the + karb, distress (gen. in iḍāfa); 'the distress'
وَسَوْفَ: و + سَوْفَ — wa-, and + sawfa, will (future particle before the imperfect); 'and will'
تَتَحَدَّثُ: تَتَحَدَّثُ — tataḥaddathu, she/they talk (V, imperfect 3 f. sg.; al-nās takes the feminine); 'will talk'
جِيلًا: جِيل — jīl, generation (acc., in the idiom jīlan baʿda jīlin); 'a generation'
صَنَعْتَ: صَنَعْتَ — ṣanaʿta, you did, made (I, perfect 2 m. sg.); 'you did'
بِاللَّعِينِ: بِـ + الـ + لَعِين — bi-, to, with (prep.; ṣanaʿa bi- ‘do to’) + al-, the + laʿīn, accursed (adj., gen.); 'to the accursed'
مُحَرِّفِ: مُحَرِّف — muḥarrif, falsifier, one who alters (active participle II, gen. in apposition, iḍāfa); 'the falsifier of'
الْإِنْجِيلِ: الـ + إِنْجِيل — al-, the + injīl, the Gospel (gen. in iḍāfa); 'the Gospel'
وَأَخْذِكَ: و + أَخْذِ + كَ — wa-, and + akhdhi, taking (verbal noun, gen. after bi-ma … wa-) + -ka, your; 'and your taking'
وَضَرْبِكَ: و + ضَرْبِ + كَ — wa-, and + ḍarbi, striking (verbal noun, gen.) + -ka, your; 'and your striking'
لِعَدُوِّاللَّهِ: لِـ + عَدُوِّ + اللَّه — li-, for, of (prep.) + ʿaduwwi, enemy (gen. in iḍāfa) + allāh, God; the print runs the words together; 'of the enemy of God'
وَالْمِقْدَامُ: و + الـ + مِقْدَام — wa-, and + al-, the + miqdām, dauntless one, bold in attack (nom., in apposition); 'and the dauntless one'
بِالتَّلْبِيَةِ: بِـ + الـ + تَلْبِيَة — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + talbiya, the answering cry labbayka ‘at your service’ (gen.); 'with the response “at your service”'
وَسَرِّبْهُمْ: و + سَرِّبْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + sarrib, send in companies (II, imperative 2 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and send them in bands'
فَرَاسِخَ: فَرَاسِخ — farāsikh, leagues (pl. of farsakh, a measure of about three miles; diptote, gen.); 'leagues'
تَكُونُوا: تَكُونُوا — takūnū, you be (I, subjunctive 2 m. pl. after ḥattā); 'you are'; also: in a question, indicative with the final -na dropped (Middle Arabic): man takūnū, 'who are you?'
السَّاحِلِ: الـ + سَاحِل — al-, the + sāḥil, shore (gen. after min); 'the shore'; also gen. after ilā: al-wuṣūlu ilā al-sāḥili, 'reaching the shore' (Night 194)
وَاخْتَفُوا: و + اخْتَفُوا — wa-, and + ikhtafū, hide yourselves (VIII, imperative 2 m. pl.); 'and hide'
وَهَدَاتِ: وَهَدَات — wahadāt, hollows, depressions (pl. of wahda, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the hollows of'
وَتَسْمَعُوا: و + تَسْمَعُوا — wa-, and + tasmaʿū, you hear (I, subjunctive 2 m. pl. after ḥattā); 'and hear'
الصِّيَاحَ: الـ + صِيَاح — al-, the + ṣiyāḥ, shouting (acc.); 'the shouting'
الْقَوَاضِبُ: الـ + قَوَاضِب — al-, the + qawāḍib, cutting swords (pl. of qāḍib, nom.); 'the cutting swords'
تَقَهْقَرُوا: تَقَهْقَرُوا — taqahqarū, they fell back, retreated (quadriliteral II, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'fell back'
مُنْهَزِمُونَ: مُنْهَزِمُون — munhazimūna, routed, in flight (VII active participle, nom. pl.); 'routed'
زَاحِفَةً: زَاحِفَة — zāḥifa, creeping, advancing (active participle, f., acc. of state); 'creeping'
فَكُونُوا: فَ + كُونُوا — fa-, then + kūnū, be (I, imperative 2 m. pl.); 'then be'
بِالْمِرْصَادِ: بِـ + الـ + مِرْصَاد — bi-, in (prep.) + al-, the + mirṣād, ambush, watching-place (gen.); kūnū lahum bi-al-mirṣād ‘lie in wait for them’; 'in ambush'
فَارْفَعِ: فَ + ارْفَعِ — fa-, then + irfaʿi, raise (I, imperative 2 m. sg.; the final -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'then raise'
الْأَخْضَرَ: الـ + أَخْضَر — al-, the + akhḍar, green (adj., acc.); 'the green'
وَصِحْ: و + صِحْ — wa-, and + ṣiḥ, cry out (I of ṣāḥa, imperative 2 m. sg.); 'and cry out'
الْمُنْهَزِمِينَ: الـ + مُنْهَزِمِين — al-, the + munhazimīna, the routed (VII active participle, gen. pl.); 'the routed'
وَاتَّفَقُو: و + اتَّفَقُو — wa-, and + ittafaqū, they agreed (VIII, perfect 3 m. pl.; the print omits the final alif); 'and they agreed'
أَلْفًاكَمَا: أَلْفًا + كَمَا — alfan, thousand (acc. after ʿishrīna) + ka-mā, as; the print runs the words together; 'twenty thousand as'
مُجَرِّدُونَ: مُجَرِّدُون — mujarridūna, drawing, unsheathing (II active participle, nom. pl.; the print keeps the nūn before the object); 'drawing'
وَمُعْتَقِلُونَ: و + مُعْتَقِلُون — wa-, and + muʿtaqilūna, couching, holding at rest (VIII active participle, nom. pl.); 'and couching'
وَحَامِلُونَ: و + حَامِلُون — wa-, and + ḥāmilūna, carrying (active participle, nom. pl.); 'and carrying'
وَالْبِطَاحِ: و + الـ + بِطَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + biṭāḥ, wide stony valleys (pl. of baṭḥāʾ, gen.); 'and the valleys'
الْقُسُوسُ: الـ + قُسُوس — al-, the + qusūs, priests (pl. of qass, nom.); 'the priests'
الرُّؤُسُ: الـ + رُؤُس — al-, the + ruʾus, heads (pl. of raʾs; the print spells it with one waw, for ruʾūs, nom.); 'the heads'
قُلُوعِ: قُلُوع — qulūʿ, sails (pl. of qilʿ, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the sails of'
وَقَصَدُوا: و + قَصَدُوا — wa-, and + qaṣadū, they made for, aimed at (I, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they made for'
السَّاحِلَ: الـ + سَاحِل — al-, the + sāḥil, shore (acc., object); 'the shore'
وَأَنْزَلُوا: و + أَنْزَلُوا — wa-, and + anzalū, they brought down (IV, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they brought down'
وَعَزَمُوا: و + عَزَمُوا — wa-, and + ʿazamū, they resolved (I, perfect 3 m. pl.; ʿazama ʿalā ‘resolve on’); 'and they resolved'
الْكَرِّ: الـ + كَرّ — al-, the + karr, charging, the charge (verbal noun, gen. after ʿalā); 'the charge'
وَالْفَرِّ: و + الـ + فَرّ — wa-, and + al-, the + farr, retreating, the retreat (verbal noun, gen.); 'and the retreat'
وَلَمَعَتِ: و + لَمَعَتِ — wa-, and + lamaʿat, it flashed (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and flashed'
الْجُمُوعُ: الـ + جُمُوع — al-, the + jumūʿ, throngs, hosts (pl. of jamʿ, nom.); 'the hosts'
وَبَرَقَتْ: و + بَرَقَتْ — wa-, and + baraqat, it gleamed (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and gleamed'
شُهُبُ: شُهُب — shuhub, meteors, shooting stars (pl. of shihāb, nom. in iḍāfa); 'the meteors of'
الدُّرُوعِ: الـ + دُرُوع — al-, the + durūʿ, coats of mail (pl. of dirʿ, gen.); 'the coats of mail'
طَاحُونُ: طَاحُون — ṭāḥūn, mill (nom. in iḍāfa); 'the mill of'
وَالْفُرْسَانِ: و + الـ + فُرْسَان — wa-, and + al-, the + fursān, horsemen (pl. of fāris, gen.); 'and the horsemen'
وَخَرِسَتِ: و + خَرِسَتِ — wa-, and + kharisat, it went dumb, mute (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and went mute'
الْأَلْسُنُ: الـ + أَلْسُن — al-, the + alsun, tongues (pl. of lisān, nom.); 'the tongues'
وَتَغَشَّتِ: و + تَغَشَّتِ — wa-, and + taghashshat, it was covered, veiled over (V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and was veiled'
وَانْفَطَرَتِ: و + انْفَطَرَتِ — wa-, and + infaṭarat, it burst, split (VII, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and burst'
الْمَرَائِرُ: الـ + مَرَائِر — al-, the + marāʾir, gall-bladders, strong cords of the heart (pl. of marīra, nom.); 'the gall-bladders'
الْبَوَاتِرُ: الـ + بَوَاتِر — al-, the + bawātir, cutting blades (pl. of bātira, nom.); 'the cutting blades'
الْجَمَاجِمُ: الـ + جَمَاجِم — al-, the + jamājim, skulls (pl. of jumjuma, nom.); 'the skulls'
الْمَعَاصِمُ: الـ + مَعَاصِم — al-, the + maʿāṣim, wrists (pl. of miʿṣam, nom.); 'the wrists'
وَخَاضَتِ: و + خَاضَتِ — wa-, and + khāḍat, she waded (I of khāḍa, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and waded'
وَتَقَابَضُوا: و + تَقَابَضُوا — wa-, and + taqābaḍū, they seized one another (VI, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they seized each other'
اللِّحَى: الـ + لِحَى — al-, the + liḥā, beards (pl. of liḥya, gen. after fī); 'the beards'
بِالصَّلٰوةِ: بِـ + الـ + صَلٰوة — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + ṣalāh, blessing, prayer (the print spells it with a waw, gen.); 'with the blessing'
وَبِالثَّنَاءِ: و + بِـ + الـ + ثَنَاء — wa-, and + bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + thanāʾ, praise (gen.); 'and with the praise'
بِالثَّنَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + ثَنَاء — bi-, with (prep.) + al-, the + thanāʾ, praise (gen.); 'with praise'
وَالزَّارِ: و + الـ + زَّار — wa-, and + al-, the + zār, obscure as printed (perhaps al-zunnār ‘the girdle’ with a nūn dropped; gen.); 'and the zār'
وَالْعَصِيرِ: و + الـ + عَصِير — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿaṣīr, juice, wine-must (gen.); 'and the juice'
وَالْعَصَّارِ: و + الـ + عَصَّار — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿaṣṣār, presser (maker of juice or wine, gen.); 'and the presser'
وَالْقُسُوسِ: و + الـ + قُسُوس — wa-, and + al-, the + qusūs, priests (gen.); 'and the priests'
وَالسَّعَانِينِ: و + الـ + سَعَانِين — wa-, and + al-, the + saʿānīn, Palm Sunday (gen.); 'and Palm Sunday'
وَالْمُطْرَانِ: و + الـ + مُطْرَان — wa-, and + al-, the + muṭrān, metropolitan, archbishop (gen.); 'and the metropolitan'
وَتَأخَّرَ: و + تَأَخَّرَ — wa-, and + taʾakhkhara, he held back, fell back (V, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and fell back'
وَرَائِهِمَا: وَرَاء + هِمَا — warāʾ, behind, the rear (gen.) + -himā, them both; 'behind them both'
وَقَهْقَرَتِ: و + قَهْقَرَتِ — wa-, and + qahqarat, she retreated (quadriliteral, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and retreated'
وَأَظْهَرُوا: و + أَظْهَرُوا — wa-, and + aẓharū, they showed (IV, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they showed'
الِانْهِزَامَ: الـ + انْهِزَام — al-, the + inhizām, rout, flight (VII verbal noun, acc.); 'the rout'
لِلْأَعْدَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + أَعْدَاء — li-, to, before (prep.) + al-, the + aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww, gen.); 'to the enemies'
وَزَحَفَتْ: و + زَحَفَتْ — wa-, and + zaḥafat, she crept forward, advanced (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and advanced'
لِوَهْمِ: لِـ + وَهْم — li-, for, from (prep.) + wahm, supposition, imagining (gen. in iḍāfa); 'from the supposing of'
الْهَزِيمَةِ: الـ + هَزِيمَة — al-, the + hazīma, rout, defeat (gen.); 'the rout'
وَتَهَيَّئُوا: و + تَهَيَّئُوا — wa-, and + tahayyaʾū, they made ready (V, perfect 3 m. pl.); 'and they made ready'
لِلطَّعْنِ: لِـ + الـ + طَّعْن — li-, for (prep.) + al-, the + ṭaʿn, thrusting (gen.); 'for the thrusting'
فَاسْتَهَلَّ: فَ + اسْتَهَلَّ — fa-, and so + istahalla, he began, opened with (X, perfect 3 m. sg.); 'and began'
بِقِرَأَةِ: بِـ + قِرَأَة — bi-, with (prep.) + qirāʾa, reciting, recitation (the print omits the alif, gen. in iḍāfa); 'with the recitation of'
أَرْجُلِ: أَرْجُل — arjul, feet (pl. of rijl, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the feet of'
مُنْدَثِرَهْ: مُنْدَثِرَة — mundathira, effaced, trampled out (VII active participle, f.; the print spells it with final hāʾ); 'effaced'
مُنَادِى: مُنَادِي — munādī, crier, herald (nom., in iḍāfa; the print spells it with ى); 'the herald of'
عَبَدَةَ: عَبَدَة — ʿabada, worshippers (pl. of ʿābid, vocative in iḍāfa); 'O worshippers of'
وَذَوِى: و + ذَوِي — wa-, and + dhawī, possessors of (vocative in iḍāfa; the print spells it with ى); 'and possessors of'
الْجَاثَلِيقِ: الـ + جَاثَلِيق — al-, the + jāthalīq, Catholicos, head of a church (gen. in iḍāfa); 'the Catholicos'
جَنَحُوا: جَنَحُوا — janaḥū, they inclined, turned (I, perfect 3 m. pl.; janaḥa ilā ‘incline to’); 'inclined'
الْفِرَارِ: الـ + فِرَار — al-, the + firār, flight (gen. after ilā); 'flight'
الْأَدْبَارَ: الـ + أَدْبَار — al-, the + adbār, backs (pl. of dubur, acc.; tuwallū ʿan … al-adbāra ‘turn the back on’); 'the backs'
فَمَكِّنُوا: فَ + مَكِّنُوا — fa-, so + makkinū, give power, let (II, imperative 2 m. pl.); 'so let'
أَقْفِيَتِهِمْ: أَقْفِيَة + هِمْ — aqfiya, napes of necks (pl. of qafan, gen. after min) + -him, their; 'their napes'
تَرْجِعُوا: تَرْجِعُوا — tarjiʿū, you return (I, jussive 2 m. pl. after lam, or after lā of prohibition); 'you turn back'
وَإِلَّابَرِئْتُمْ: و + إِلَّا + بَرِئْتُمْ — wa-, and + illā, if not, otherwise + bariʾtum, you are free of, disowned by (I, perfect 2 m. pl.; the print runs the words together); 'or else you are disowned'
مَرْيَمَ: مَرْيَم — maryam, Mary (diptote proper name, gen.); 'Mary'
الْمَهْدِ: الـ + مَهْد — al-, the + mahd, cradle (gen. after fī); 'the cradle'
مَنْصُورَةٌ: مَنْصُورَة — manṣūra, victorious, helped (passive participle, f. sg., predicate, nom.); 'victorious'
يُبَشِّرُهُ: يُبَشِّرُ + هُ — yubashshiru, he gives good news (II, imperfect 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'bringing him good news'
بِالظَّفَرِ: بِـ + الـ + ظَّفَر — bi-, of (prep.; bashshara bi- 'announce …'), or marking the prize after فَازَ بِـ ('win') + al-, the + ẓafar, victory (gen.); 'of the victory', 'won the victory'
غَائِطُ: غَائِط — ghāʾiṭ, excrement, dung (nom., in iḍāfa); 'the dung of'
فَاحَتْ: فَاحَتْ — fāḥat, it wafted, spread (scent; I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'wafted'
وَالشَّوَارِبِ: و + الـ + شَّوَارِب — wa-, and + al-, the + shawārib, moustaches (pl. of shārib, gen.); 'and the moustaches'
وَغَائِبٍ: و + غَائِب — wa-, and + ghāʾib, absent (active participle, gen.); 'and absent'
بِالْمُعْجِزَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + مُعْجِزَات — bi-, by (prep. of oath) + al-, the + muʿjizāt, miracles (pl. of muʿjiza, gen.); 'by the miracles'
وَبِبِنْتِهِ: و + بِـ + بِنْتِ + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + bint, daughter (gen. in iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'and by his daughter'
الْمَرْيَمِيَّةِ: الـ + مَرْيَمِيَّة — al-, the + maryamiyya, Marian, of Mary (adj., f., gen.); 'the Marian'
وَالْمِيَاهِ: و + الـ + مِيَاه — wa-, and + al-, the + miyāh, waters (pl. of māʾ, gen., oath continued); 'and by the waters'
الْمَعْمُودِيَّةِ: الـ + مَعْمُودِيَّة — al-, the + maʿmūdiyya, baptismal (adj., f., gen.); 'baptismal'
مُجَاهِدًا: مُجَاهِد — mujāhid, fighter for the faith, holy warrior (III active participle, acc., indefinite); 'a warrior of the faith'
بِالْكُلِّيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + كُلِّيَّة — bi-, in (prep.) + al-, the + kulliyya, wholeness, totality (gen.); bi-al-kulliyya ‘altogether, at all’; 'altogether'
النِّيَّةِ: الـ + نِّيَّة — al-, the + niyya, intention (gen. in apposition to sūʾ hādhihi); 'the intention'; also: in بِقَامَةِ النِّيَّةِ (Night 183), gen. second term of an iḍāfa, a doubtful reading: 'a stature of the intent', a stature as one would wish (perhaps for alfiyya, 'alif-like')
الرَّسُولُ: الـ + رَّسُول — al-, the + rasūl, messenger (nom.); 'the messenger'
وَكَأَنَّ: و + كَأَنَّ — wa-, and + ka-anna, as if, as though (particle, takes the accusative); 'and as if'
خُدَّامَ: خُدَّام — khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim, vocative in iḍāfa); 'servants of'
وَتَوَجَّهَتِ: و + تَوَجَّهَتِ — wa-, and + tawajjahat, she turned, set forward (V, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and set forward'
الرِّمَاحَ: الـ + رِمَاح — al-, the + rimāḥ, lances (pl. of rumḥ, acc.); 'the lances'
عُبَّادِ: عُبَّاد — ʿubbād, worshippers (pl. of ʿābid, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the worshippers of'
الْقَوْمُ: الـ + قَوْم — al-, the + qawm, people, company (nom.); 'the people'
وَطَارَتِ: و + طَارَتِ — wa-, and + ṭārat, it flew (I, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and flew'
حَاضِرٍ: حَاضِر — ḥāḍir, present (active participle, gen.); 'present'; also 'settled townsman', paired with bādī, 'nomad': min ḥāḍirin aw bādī, 'of town or desert' (Night 182)
التَّوْفِيقُ: الـ + تَّوْفِيق — al-, the + tawfīq, success, divine guidance (nom.); 'success'
وَأُقْسِمُ: و + أُقْسِمُ — wa-, and + uqsimu, I swear (IV, imperfect 1 sg.; takes bi- ‘by’ the thing sworn by); 'and I swear'
السِّلَاحَ: الـ + سِلَاح — al-, the + silāḥ, arms, weapons (acc.); 'the arms'
وَاجْتَهِدْ: و + اجْتَهِدْ — wa-, and + ijtahid, strive (VIII, imperative 2 m. sg.); 'and strive'
عَنْهُمُ: عَنْ + هُمُ — ʿan, from, away from (prep.) + -humu, them (the helping vowel before al-); 'from them'
تَدْبِيرِ: تَدْبِير — tadbīr, management, planning (verbal noun II, gen. in iḍāfa); 'the planning of'
وَكُشِفَتِ: و + كُشِفَتِ — wa-, and + kushifat, it was uncovered (I passive, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and were bared'
وَالرِّمَاحَ: و + الـ + رِمَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + rimāḥ, lances (acc.); 'and the lances'
ضَجَّةَ: ضَجَّة — ḍajja, clamour, din (acc., object, in iḍāfa); 'the clamour of'
الصُّدُورُ: الـ + صُدُور — al-, the + ṣudūr, breasts, chests (pl. of ṣadr, nom.); 'the breasts'
عَسَاكِرَ: عَسَاكِر — ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar, diptote, acc. after inna, in iḍāfa); 'the armies of'
وَرُفِعَتِ: و + رُفِعَتِ — wa-, and + rufiʿat, it was raised (I passive, perfect 3 f. sg.); 'and were raised'
يَحُولَ: يَحُولَ — yaḥūla, he comes between, intervenes (I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an lā); 'come between'
سُورَةِ: سُورَة — sūra, sura, chapter of the Qurʾān (gen. in iḍāfa); 'the sura of'
تُوَلُّوا: تُوَلُّوا — tuwallū, you turn (II, jussive 2 m. pl. after lā; wallā ʿan … al-adbāra ‘turn one’s back on’); 'turn'
عَلَمًا: عَلَم — ʿalam, banner, standard (acc., indefinite); 'a banner'
بِثَأْرِ: بِـ + ثَأْر — bi-, for (prep.; akhadha bi-thaʾr ‘take vengeance for’) + thaʾr, blood-vengeance (gen. in iḍāfa); 'for the vengeance of'
وَرَاءٍ: وَرَاء — warāʾ, behind, the rear (gen., after ilā); 'the rear'

إِرْضَاءِ: إِرْضَاء — irḍāʾ, pleasing (IV verbal noun of arḍā, gen., construct); 'the pleasing of'

الْمَخُوفِ: الـ + مَخُوف — al-, the + makhūf, feared, dreadful (pass. part. of khāfa, gen.); 'the dreaded (day)'
ظِلَالِ: ظِلَال — ẓilāl, shades (pl. of ẓill, gen., construct); 'the shade of'
السُّيُوفِ: الـ + سُيُوف — al-, the + suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, gen.); 'the swords'

طَرِيقَ: طَرِيق — ṭarīq, road, way (acc., construct); 'the way of'
الصُّفُوفِ: الـ + صُفُوف — al-, the + ṣufūf, ranks (pl. of ṣaff, gen.); 'the ranks'
وَطَافَ: و + طَافَ — wa-, and + ṭāfa, he went round, circled (I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and circled'
بِفَارِسٍ: بِـ + فَارِس — bi- (after wa-idhā, marks what appears) + fāris, horseman (gen.); 'and behold, a horseman'
مَلِيحِ: مَلِيح — malīḥ, comely, graceful (gen., construct); 'comely of'
الِانْعِطَافِ: الـ + اِنْعِطَاف — al-, the + inʿiṭāf, bending, swaying (VII verbal noun, gen.); 'bearing, sway (of the body)'
الْكَفَرَةِ: الـ + كَفَرَة — al-, the + kafara, unbelievers (pl. of kāfir, gen.); 'the unbelievers'

وَطِعَانًا: و + طِعَان — wa-, and + ṭiʿān, spear-thrusting (III verbal noun, acc.); 'and spear-thrusting'
وَمَلَأَ: و + مَلَأَ — wa-, and + malaʾa, he filled (I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and filled'

خَافَتِ: خَافَتْ — khāfat, feared (I perf. 3 f. sg., agreeing with a broken plural); '(the unbelievers) feared'

لِطَعْنِهِ: لِـ + طَعْن + هِ — li-, to + ṭaʿn, thrusting (verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his thrusting'
وَضَرْبِهِ: و + ضَرْب + هِ — wa-, and + ḍarb, striking (gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his striking'

لَحْظٍ: لَحْظ — laḥẓ, glance (gen., in apposition); 'a glance'
وَحُسَامٍ: و + حُسَام — wa-, and + ḥusām, sharp sword (gen.); 'and a blade'
وَاعْتَقَلَ: و + اعْتَقَلَ — wa-, and + iʿtaqala, he couched (a lance between leg and stirrup) (VIII perf., with bi-); 'and couched'
بِرُمْحَيْنِ: بِـ + رُمْحَيْن — bi- (iʿtaqala bi-, ‘couch’) + rumḥayn, two lances (dual, gen.); 'two lances'
قَنَاةٍ: قَنَاة — qanāt, spear-shaft (gen., in apposition); 'a spear-shaft'
بِوَفْرَةٍ: بِـ + وَفْرَة — bi-, with + wafra, full head of hair falling to the ear-lobes (gen.); 'with a mane of hair'
تُغْنِي: تُغْنِي — tughnī, it makes needless (IV impf. 3 f. sg.; aghnā ʿan, ‘make one do without’); 'that makes needless'
وَافِرِ: وَافِر — wāfir, abundant (act. part., gen., construct); 'the abundant (number) of'
الْوَفْرَةُ: الـ + وَفْرَة — al-, the + wafra, full head of hair (nom.); 'the mane of hair'
وَهِيْ: و + هِيَ — wa- (of state, ‘while’) + hiya, she, it (the print points the yā with sukūn); 'while it is'
مَنْشُورَةُ: مَنْشُورَة — manshūra, spread out, unbound (pass. part. f., nom., construct); 'spread out in'
مُعْتَقِلٍ: مُعْتَقِل — muʿtaqil, couching (a lance) (VIII act. part., gen.); 'couching'
صَعْدَةً: صَعْدَة — ṣaʿda, straight lance (acc.); 'a straight lance'
يُعِلُّهَا: يُعِلّ + هَا — yuʿillu, he gives a second draught (IV impf. of ʿalla) + -hā, it (the lance); 'he gives it a second drink'
وَافِى: وَافِي — wāfī, full, ample (act. part., gen., construct; final ى for ي); 'full of'

كَفَتْكَ: كَفَتْ + كَ — kafat, sufficed (I perf. 3 f. sg., with a broken plural) + -ka, you; 'have sufficed you'
سُيُوفُ: سُيُوف — suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, nom., construct); 'the swords of'
الْعَضْبِ: الـ + عَضْب — al-, the + ʿaḍb, sharp sword (gen.; the print has اْعَضْبِ with the lām dropped, corrected); 'the sharp blade'
لِحَاظِيْ: لِحَاظ + ي — liḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ) + -ī, my; 'my glances'

وَآيَاتِ: و + آيَات — wa-, and + āyāt, verses, signs (pl. of āya, gen., construct); 'and the verses of'

هَزَمْتَ: هَزَمْتَ — hazamta, you routed (I perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you have routed'

مَاخَفِيَ: مَا + خَفِيَ — mā, what + khafiya, was hidden (I perf. 3 m. sg.); run together in print; 'what had been hidden'
ازْدِحَامِ: ازْدِحَام — izdiḥām, crowding, press (VIII verbal noun, gen.); 'the press of'

وَانْطِبَاقِ: و + انْطِبَاق — wa-, and + inṭibāq, closing together (VII verbal noun, gen.); 'and the closing-in of'
لِأَمْرَيْنِ: لِـ + أَمْرَيْن — li-, for (of the reason) + amrayn, two matters (dual, gen.); 'for two reasons'
صِغَرُ: صِغَر — ṣighar, smallness, youth (nom., construct); 'the smallness of'
سِنِّهِ: سِنّ + هِ — sinn, age (gen.) + -hi, his; 'his age'

الْجَنَاحَيْنِ: الـ + جَنَاحَيْن — al-, the + janāḥayn, two wings (dual, gen.); 'the two wings'
خَاطَرْتَ: خَاطَرْتَ — khāṭarta, you risked (III perf. 2 m. sg.; with bi- of what is staked); 'you have risked'
فَأَلْصِقْ: فَـ + أَلْصِقْ — fa-, so + alṣiq, make cleave, keep close (IV imperative 2 m. sg.; with bi-, ‘to’); the print has فاصق, corrected; 'so keep close'
بِجَوَادِي: بِـ + جَوَاد + ي — bi-, to (alṣaqa bi-, ‘attach to’) + jawād, steed (gen.) + -ī, my; 'to my horse'
الْأَعْدَاءِ: الـ + أَعْدَاء — al-, the + aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww, gen.); 'the enemies'
وَالْمَصْلَحَةُ: و + الـ + مَصْلَحَة — wa-, and + al-, the + maṣlaḥa, advantage, the wise course (nom.); 'and the wise course'
لَاتَخْرُجَ: لَا + تَخْرُجَ — lā, not + takhruja, you go out (I subj. 2 m. sg. after an); run together in print; 'that you not go out'
الْعَصَائِبِ: الـ + عَصَائِب — al-, the + ʿaṣāʾib, bands, troops (pl. of ʿiṣāba, gen.); 'the troops'
نَرْمِيَ: نَرْمِيَ — narmiya, we shoot (I subj. 1 pl. after an); 'we may shoot'
بِسَهْمِكَ: بِـ + سَهْم + كَ — bi-, with + sahm, arrow (gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your arrow'
الصَّائِبِ: الـ + صَائِب — al-, the + ṣāʾib, hitting the mark (act. part., gen.); 'the unerring'
أُسَاوِيَكَ: أُسَاوِيَ + كَ — usāwiya, I equal (III subj. 1 sg. after an) + -ka, you; 'that I match you'
أَبْخَلَ: أَبْخَلَ — abkhala, I be sparing (I subj. 1 sg.; bakhila bi-, ‘withhold, grudge’); '(and not) grudge'
وَجَاهَدُوهُمْ: و + جَاهَدُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and + jāhadū, they fought, strove (III perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hum, them; 'and they fought them'
شَوْكَةَ: شَوْكَة — shawka, thorn; armed might (acc., construct); 'the might of'
وَالْعِنَادِ: و + الـ + عِنَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿinād, obstinacy (gen.); 'and obstinacy'
وَالْفَسَادِ: و + الـ + فَسَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + fasād, corruption (gen.; the print has والنساد, corrected); 'and corruption'
فَتَأَسَّفَ: فَـ + تَأَسَّفَ — fa-, and + taʾassafa, he grieved, regretted (V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he grieved'
بِالرُّومِ: بِـ + الـ + رُوم — bi- (ḥalla bi-, ‘befall’, marks the one it lands on) + al-, the + rūm, the Byzantines (gen.); 'upon the Rūm'
الْمَذْمُومِ: الـ + مَذْمُوم — al-, the + madhmūm, blameworthy, evil (pass. part., gen.); 'the evil (matter)'
وَلَّوُا: وَلَّوْا — wallaw, they turned (II perf. 3 m. pl.; wallā al-adbār, ‘turn tail’); 'they turned'
وَرَكَنُوا: و + رَكَنُوا — wa-, and + rakanū, they inclined, resorted (I perf. 3 m. pl., with ilā); 'and took (to)'
يَقْصِدُونَ: يَقْصِدُونَ — yaqṣidūna, they make for (I impf. 3 m. pl.); 'making for'
الْمَرَاكِبَ: الـ + مَرَاكِب — al-, the + marākib, ships (pl. of markab, acc.); 'the ships'
أَوَّلِهِمُ: أَوَّل + هُمْ — awwal, front, first part (gen.) + -hum, their; 'their head, their front'
مُجَنْدِلُ: مُجَنْدِل — mujandil, one who throws (men) down to the ground (quadriliteral act. part., nom., construct); 'the thrower-down of'
دَوَائِرِ: دَوَائِر — dawāʾir, districts (pl. of dāʾira, gen.); 'the districts of'
خَلْفٍ: خَلْف — khalf, the rear, behind (gen. after min); 'behind'
أَمَامٍ: أَمَام — amām, the front, before (gen. after min); 'before'
وَأَوْقَعُوا: و + أَوْقَعُوا — wa-, and + awqaʿū, they inflicted (IV perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they inflicted'
الْمَعَاطِبَ: الـ + مَعَاطِب — al-, the + maʿāṭib, destructions, perils (pl. of maʿṭab, acc.); 'havoc'
فَرَمَوْا: فَـ + رَمَوْا — fa-, and so + ramaw, they threw (I perf. 3 m. pl. of ramā); 'and they threw'
يَنْجُ: يَنْجُ — yanju, he escapes (I jussive of najā, after lam); '(did not) escape'
أَبْطَالِهِمْ: أَبْطَال + هِمْ — abṭāl, champions (pl. of baṭal, gen.) + -him, their; 'their champions'
وَلَاكَبِيرٌ: و + لَا + كَبِير — wa-, and + lā, nor + kabīr, great (nom.); run together in print; 'nor great'
مَرَاكِبَهُمْ: مَرَاكِب + هُمْ — marākib, ships (acc.) + -hum, their; 'their ships'

إِلَّاعِشْرِينَ: إِلَّا + عِشْرِين — illā, except + ʿishrīn, twenty (acc.); run together in print; 'except twenty'

وَلَاسَمِعَتْ: و + لَا + سَمِعَتْ — wa-, and + lā, nor + samiʿat, heard (I perf. 3 f. sg., subject udhun; with bi-, ‘hear of’); run together in print; 'nor did (an ear) hear'
مَاغَنِمُوهُ: مَا + غَنِمُوا + هُ — mā, what + ghanimū, they took as spoil + -hu, it; run together in print; 'what they took as spoil'
أَلْفًامِنَ: أَلْفًا + مِنَ — alfan, thousand (acc.) + min, of; run together in print; 'thousand of'
وَالْأَسْلَابِ: و + الـ + أَسْلَاب — wa-, and + al-, the + aslāb, spoils stripped from the fallen (pl. of salab, gen.); 'and the spoils'

وَلَاحِسَابٌ: و + لَا + حِسَاب — wa-, and + lā, nor + ḥisāb, reckoning (nom.); run together in print; 'nor reckoning'

الظَّافِرُ: الـ + ظَافِر — al-, the + ẓāfir, victor (act. part. of ẓafira, with bi- of the defeated; nom.); 'the victor'

يَخَافُ: يَخَافُ — yakhāfu, he fears (I impf. 3 m. sg.); 'fears'
الْإِسْلَامِيَّةِ: الـ + إِسْلَامِيَّة — al-, the + islāmiyya, Islamic (nisba adj. f., gen.); 'Islamic'
وَيَرُدُّ: و + يَرُدُّ — wa-, and + yaruddu, he brings back (I impf. of radda); 'and brings back'
الْمِلَّةِ: الـ + مِلَّة — al-, the + milla, creed, religious community (gen.); 'the creed'
يُزَيِّنَ: يُزَيِّنَ — yuzayyina, he adorn (II subj. after an); 'that he deck out'
الْبَلَدَ: الـ + بَلَد — al-, the + balad, city, town (acc.); 'the city'

بِالْمَقْدُورِ: بِـ + الـ + مَقْدُور — bi- (ʿalima bi-, ‘know of’) + al-, the + maqdūr, what is decreed (pass. part., gen.); 'of what was decreed'
نَعَقَ: نَعَقَ — naʿaqa, croaked (of a raven) (I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'croaked'
غُرَابُ: غُرَاب — ghurāb, raven (nom., construct); 'the raven of'
وَالْأَتْرَاحِ: و + الـ + أَتْرَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + atrāḥ, sorrows (pl. of taraḥ, gen.); 'and sorrows'
الْهَارِبَةُ: الـ + هَارِبَة — al-, the + hāriba, fleeing (act. part. f., nom., agreeing with the ships); 'that had fled'
فَقَابَلَهُمْ: فَـ + قَابَلَ + هُمْ — fa-, and + qābala, he met (III perf.) + -hum, them; 'and he met them'
بُكَاؤُهُمْ: بُكَاء + هُمْ — bukāʾ, weeping (nom.) + -hum, their; 'their weeping'
نَحِيبُهُمْ: نَحِيب + هُمْ — naḥīb, wailing, sobbing (nom.) + -hum, their; 'their wailing'
بِشَارَاتُ: بِشَارَات — bishārāt, glad tidings (pl. of bishāra, nom., construct); 'the good tidings of'
