النَّوَائِبُ: الـ + نَوَائِب — al-, the + nawāʾib, misfortunes (pl. of nāʾiba, nom.); 'misfortunes'
الْمَنِيَّةِ: الـ + مَنِيَّة — al-, the + maniyya, death, fate (gen.); 'death'
الصَّائِبُ: الـ + صَائِب — al-, the + ṣāʾib, hitting the mark (act. part., nom.); 'the unerring'
الْقِيَامَةُ: الـ + قِيَامَة — al-, the + qiyāma, the Resurrection (nom.); 'the Resurrection'
اعْوِجَاجَهُمْ: اعْوِجَاج + هُمْ — iʿwijāj, crookedness (IX verbal noun, acc.) + -hum, their; 'their crookedness'
اسْتِقَامَةٌ: اسْتِقَامَة — istiqāma, straightness, setting right (X verbal noun, nom.); 'straightening'
الْمَآتِمُ: الـ + مَآتِم — al-, the + maʾātim, mourning gatherings (pl. of maʾtam, nom.); 'the mourning assemblies'
وَانْحَلَّتْ: و + انْحَلَّتْ — wa-, and + inḥallat, was loosened, gave way (VII perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and gave way'
الْعَزَائِمُ: الـ + عَزَائِم — al-, the + ʿazāʾim, resolves (pl. of ʿazīma, nom.); 'the resolves'
وَنَدَبَتِ: و + نَدَبَتْ — wa-, and + nadabat, keened, lamented the dead (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and keened'
النَّوَادِبُ: الـ + نَوَادِب — al-, the + nawādib, keening women (pl. of nādiba, nom.); 'the wailing-women'
النَّحِيبُ: الـ + نَحِيب — al-, the + naḥīb, wailing (nom.); 'the wailing'
وَالْبُكَاءُ: و + الـ + بُكَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + bukāʾ, weeping (nom.); 'and the weeping'
هَزِيمَةَ: هَزِيمَة — hazīma, rout, defeat (acc., noun of anna; the print has همزيمة, corrected); 'the defeat of'
وَالْمِحَالِ: و + الـ + مِحَال — wa-, and + al-, the + miḥāl, cunning, trickery (gen.); 'and trickery'
تَنْتَظِرْ: تَنْتَظِرْ — tantaẓir, you wait, expect (VIII jussive 2 m. sg. after prohibitive lā); '(do not) expect'
أَنْفُهُ: أَنْف + هُ — anf, nose (nom.) + -hu, his; 'his nose'
الْمَسِيحَ: الـ + مَسِيح — al-, the + masīḥ, the Messiah (acc., after laʿalla); 'the Messiah'
الْفَنَاءُ: الـ + فَنَاء — al-, the + fanāʾ, annihilation (nom.); 'destruction'
وَجَزَانَا: و + جَزَى + نَا — wa-, and + jazā, he requited (I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'and (he/it) has requited us' (the subject follows: the Messiah, or what has befallen us)
تَغْتَمُّوا: تَغْتَمُّوا — taghtammū, you grieve (VIII jussive 2 m. pl. after prohibitive lā); '(do not) grieve'
تَحْزَنُوا: تَحْزَنُوا — taḥzanū, you are sad (I jussive 2 m. pl. after lā); '(do not) be sad'
لَابُدَّأَنَّ: لَا بُدَّ + أَنَّ — lā budda, there is no escape + anna, that; run together in print; 'it must be that'
أَحَدَكُمْ: أَحَد + كُمْ — aḥad, one (acc., noun of anna) + -kum, of you; 'one of you'
وَعُوقِبَ: و + عُوقِبَ — wa-, and + ʿūqiba, was punished (III passive perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and were punished'
بِذَنْبِهِ: بِـ + ذَنْب + هِ — bi-, for (the cause) + dhanb, sin (gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his sin'
نَقْرَأُكُمُ: نَقْرَأُ + كُمْ — naqraʾu, we recite (I impf. 1 pl.) + -kum, you (colloquial for ‘recite for you’); 'we recite for you'
الدُّعَاءَ: الـ + دُعَاء — al-, the + duʿāʾ, prayer, supplication (acc.); 'the prayer'
الْبِيَعِ: الـ + بِيَع — al-, the + biyaʿ, churches (pl. of bīʿa, gen.; the print points it); 'the churches'
تَنْدَفِعَ: تَنْدَفِعَ — tandafiʿa, it be driven off (VII subj. 3 f. sg. after ḥattā); 'be driven off'
الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةُ: الـ + مُحَمَّدِيَّة — al-, the + muḥammadiyya, Muḥammadan (nisba adj. f., nom.); 'Muḥammadan'
بِالْحِيلَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حِيلَة — bi-, by (means); after aʿlama, 'of' (what one is informed of) + al-, the + ḥīla, stratagem, guile (gen.); 'by guile', 'of the trick'
وَمَكِيدَةً: و + مَكِيدَة — wa-, and + makīda, plot, snare (acc.); 'and a snare'
وَأَمْضِيَ: و + أَمْضِيَ — wa-, and + amḍiya, I go (I subj. 1 sg. of maḍā); 'and go'
غَرَضِي: غَرَض + ي — gharaḍ, aim, purpose (acc.) + -ī, my; 'my aim'
وَأَقْتُلُ: و + أَقْتُلُ — wa-, and + aqtulu, I kill (I impf. 1 sg.); 'and kill'
فَارِسَهُمْ: فَارِس + هُمْ — fāris, horseman, champion (acc.) + -hum, their; 'their champion'
عَسَاكِرِهِ: عَسَاكِر + هِ — ʿasākir, armies, troops (pl. of ʿaskar, gen.) + -hi, his; 'his troops'
أَقْوِيَاءُ: أَقْوِيَاء — aqwiyāʾ, strong (pl. of qawī, nom.); 'strong'
الْقَاطِنِينَ: الـ + قَاطِنِين — al-, the + qāṭinīn, dwelling (act. part. m. pl., gen.); 'who dwell'
بِالشَّامِ: بِـ + الـ + شَام — bi-, in + al-shām, Syria (gen.); 'in Syria'
لِبَيْعِ: لِـ + بَيْع — li-, for, in order to + bayʿ, selling (verbal noun, gen.); 'to sell'
بَضَائِعِهِمْ: بَضَائِع + هِمْ — baḍāʾiʿ, goods, wares (pl. of biḍāʿa, gen.) + -him, their; 'their wares'
وَعَامٍ: و + عَام — wa-, and + ʿām, year (gen.); 'and year'
يُسَاعِدُونِي: يُسَاعِدُوا + نِي — yusāʿidū, they help (III subj. 3 m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'that they help me'
بِأَىِّ: بِـ + أَيّ — bi-, at (of time) + ayy, which (gen.; final ى for ي); 'at what'
فَأَمَرَتْ: فَـ + أَمَرَتْ — fa-, and + amarat, she commanded (I perf. 3 f. sg.; amara bi-, ‘command’); 'and she ordered'
يُحْضَرَ: يُحْضَرَ — yuḥḍara, be brought (IV passive subj. after an); 'that there be brought'
فَأَحْضَرُوهُمْ: فَـ + أَحْضَرُوا + هُمْ — fa-, and + aḥḍarū, they brought (IV perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hum, them; 'and they brought them'
مَاتَمَّ: مَا + تَمَّ — mā, what + tamma, was done, befell (I perf.); run together in print; 'what has befallen'
وَهَبَتْ: وَهَبَتْ — wahabat, she gave (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she has given'
عَوَّلَتْ: عَوَّلَتْ — ʿawwalat, she resolved (II perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she has resolved'
الْمُوَحِّدِينَ: الـ + مُوَحِّدِين — al-, the + muwaḥḥidīn, professors of God's oneness, i.e. the Muslims (II act. part. pl., gen.); 'the Muslims'
لِتَدْبِيرِ: لِـ + تَدْبِير — li-, for, in order to + tadbīr, contriving (II verbal noun, gen.); 'to contrive'
نَفْعُهَا: نَفْع + هَا — nafʿ, benefit (nom.) + -hā, its; 'its benefit'
وَتَمْنَعُ: و + تَمْنَعُ — wa-, and + tamnaʿu, it prevents (I impf. 3 f. sg.); 'and that keeps (from)'
الْوُصُولِ: الـ + وُصُول — al-, the + wuṣūl, arriving (verbal noun, gen.); 'reaching'
وَاهِبُونَ: وَاهِبُون — wāhibūn, givers (act. part. m. pl., nom.); 'giving'
أُعْطِيكُمْ: أُعْطِي + كُمْ — uʿṭī, I give (IV impf. 1 sg.) + -kum, you; 'I will give you'
قِنْطَارًا: قِنْطَار — qinṭār, a great weight, about a hundredweight (acc.); 'a hundredweight'
فَلَهُ: فَـ + لَـ + هُ — fa-, then + la-, to, belonging to + -hu, him; 'his is'
فَيُجَازِيهِ: فَـ + يُجَازِي + هِ — fa-, then + yujāzī, he rewards (III impf.) + -hi, him; 'then (the Messiah) will reward him'
وَهَبْنَا: وَهَبْنَا — wahabnā, we gave (I perf. 1 pl.); 'we have given'
أَنْفُسَنَا: أَنْفُس + نَا — anfus, selves (pl. of nafs, acc.) + -nā, our; 'ourselves'
فِدَاؤُكَ: فِدَاء + كَ — fidāʾ, ransom (nom.) + -ka, your; 'your ransom'
الْعَقَاقِيرِ: الـ + عَقَاقِير — al-, the + ʿaqāqīr, drugs, medicinal herbs (pl. of ʿaqqār, gen.); 'the drugs'
وَغَلَتْهُمْ: و + غَلَتْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ghalat, she boiled (I perf. 3 f. sg. of ghalā, used transitively) + -hum, them (the drugs); 'and boiled them'
فَانْحَلَّ: فَـ + انْحَلَّ — fa-, and + inḥalla, it dissolved (VII perf.); 'and (the blackness) dissolved'
السَّوَادُ: الـ + سَوَاد — al-, the + sawād, blackness (nom.); 'the blackness'
فَأَرْخَتْ: فَـ + أَرْخَتْ — fa-, and + arkhat, she let down, let hang (IV perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she let down'; here: arkhat ʿalayhi al-nawma, 'she let sleep down over him'
طَرَفَ: طَرَف — ṭaraf, end, edge (acc., construct); 'the end of'
مُطَرَّزَةً: مُطَرَّزَة — muṭarraza, embroidered (II pass. part. f., acc.); 'embroidered'
بِطِرَازٍ: بِـ + طِرَاز — bi-, with + ṭirāz, embroidered band (gen.); 'with a band of embroidery'
تَسْبِيحٌ: تَسْبِيح — tasbīḥ, glorifying God; here the prayer-beads it is counted on (nom.); 'a rosary'
يَعْرِفْهَا: يَعْرِفْ + هَا — yaʿrif, he know (I jussive after lam) + -hā, her; '(did not) know her'
الْجَالِسِينَ: الـ + جَالِسِين — al-, the + jālisīn, those sitting (act. part. pl., gen.); 'those sitting'

ابْنُهَا: ابْن + هَا — ibn, son (nom.) + -hā, her; 'her son'
لَاعَدِمَ: لَا + عَدِمَ — lā (of wishing, with the perfect) + ʿadima, lacked, lost (I perf. 3 m. sg.); run together in print; 'may (he) never lack'
طَلْعَتَكِ: طَلْعَة + كِ — ṭalʿa, countenance, face (acc.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your countenance'
نَفَضَ: نَفَض — nafaḍa, shook out (I perf. 3 m. sg.); 'shook out'
جِرَابَ: جِرَاب — jirāb, bag, sack (m., acc.); 'the sack (of)'
مَعِدَتِهِ: مَعِدَة + ـهِ — maʿida, stomach (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'of his stomach'
فَشَكَا: فَـ + شَكَا — fa-, and so + shakā, complained (I perf. 3 m. sg.); with إِلَى, 'complained to'
اللَّعِينَةُ: الـ + لَعِينَة — al-, the + laʿīna, accursed (f., nom.); 'the accursed woman'
كَاهِنَةً: كَاهِنَة — kāhina, soothsayer, diviner (f., acc. pred. of kānat); 'a soothsayer'
وَمُتْقِنَةً: وَ + مُتْقِنَة — wa-, and + mutqina, adept, expert (IV act. part. f., acc.); 'and adept'
لِلسِّحْرِ: لِـ + الـ + سِحْر — li-, in, at (prep., object of mutqina) + siḥr, sorcery (m., gen.); 'in sorcery'
وَالْبُهْتَانِ: وَ + الـ + بُهْتَان — wa-, and + buhtān, slander, lying (m., gen.); 'and lies'
مَكَّارَةً: مَكَّارَة — makkāra, very wily, scheming (intensive f., acc.); 'a schemer'
فَاجِرَةً: فَاجِرَة — fājira, wanton, profligate (f., acc.); 'a wanton'
غَدَّارَةً: غَدَّارَة — ghaddāra, treacherous (intensive f., acc.); 'a traitor'
وَلَهَافَمٌ: وَ + لَـ + هَا + فَم — wa-, and + la-, to (prep., possession) + -hā, her + fam, mouth (m., nom.); set solid in print (corrected from the misprint ولهانم); 'and she had a mouth'
وَجَفْنٌ: وَ + جَفْن — wa-, and + jafn, eyelid (m., nom.); 'and an eyelid'
وَخَدٌّ: وَ + خَدّ — wa-, and + khadd, cheek (m., nom.); 'and a cheek'
أَغْبَشَ: أَغْبَش — aghbash, murky, dim (adj., gen. of a diptote); 'murky'
وَظَهْرٍ: وَ + ظَهْر — wa-, and + ẓahr, back (m., gen.); 'and a back'
لَكِنَّهَا: لٰكِنَّ + هَا — lākinna, but (particle) + -hā, she; 'but she'
قَرَأَتْ: قَرَأَتْ — qaraʾat, she read (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she read'
تَطَّلِعَ: تَطَّلِع — taṭṭaliʿa, look into, inform herself (VIII subj. 3 f. sg.); with عَلَى, 'acquaint herself with'
الْأَدْيَانِ: الـ + أَدْيَان — al-, the + adyān, religions (pl. of dīn, gen.); 'the religions'
وَتَعْرِفَ: وَ + تَعْرِف — wa-, and + taʿrifa, she know (I subj. 3 f. sg.); 'and learn'
آيَاتِ: آيَات — āyāt, verses (of the Qurʾān), signs (f. pl. of āya, acc.); 'the verses (of)'

لِتَحُوزَ: لِـ + تَحُوز — li-, so that (with subj.) + taḥūza, she gain, acquire (I subj. 3 f. sg.); 'so that she might gain'
مَكْرَ: مَكْر — makr, guile, cunning (m., acc.); 'the guile (of)'
الثَّقَلَيْنِ: الـ + ثَقَلَيْن — al-, the + thaqalayn, the two weighty ones, men and jinn (dual, gen.); 'of men and jinn'
آفَةٌ: آفَة — āfa, plague, bane (f., nom.); 'a plague'
الْآفَاتِ: الـ + آفَات — al-, the + āfāt, plagues (f. pl., gen. after min); 'among the plagues'
وَبَلِيَّةٌ: وَ + بَلِيَّة — wa-, and + baliyya, affliction, calamity (f., nom.); 'and an affliction'
الِاعْتِقَادِ: الـ + اِعْتِقَاد — al-, the + iʿtiqād, belief (VIII verbal noun, gen.); 'of belief'
لِلدِّينِ: لِـ + الـ + دِّين — li-, to (prep., object of tanqādu) + dīn, religion (m., gen.); 'to religion'

إِقَامَتِهَا: إِقَامَة + هَا — iqāma, stay, residence (IV verbal noun, nom.) + -hā, her; 'her stay'
الْأَبْكَارِ: الـ + أَبْكَار — al-, the + abkār, virgins (pl. of bikr, gen.); 'the virgins'

انْمِحَاقٍ: اِنْمِحَاق — inmiḥāq, waning, wasting away (VII verbal noun, gen. after fī); 'wasting away'

تُعَلِّمُهَا: تُعَلِّم + هَا — tuʿallimu, she teaches (II imperf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her; 'she teaches her'
وَتَسْحَقُ: وَ + تَسْحَق — wa-, and + tasḥaqu, she grinds, rubs (I imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'and grinds'
الزَّعْفَرَانَ: الـ + زَّعْفَرَان — al-, the + zaʿfarān, saffron (m., acc.); 'the saffron'
فَتُغْشَى: فَـ + تُغْشَى — fa-, and then + tughshā, she is overcome, swoons (I passive imperf. 3 f. sg., with عَلَيْهَا); 'and she swoons'
اللَّذَّةِ: الـ + لَّذَّة — al-, the + ladhdha, pleasure (f., gen.); 'of pleasure'
طَاوَعَتْهَا: طَاوَعَتْ + هَا — ṭāwaʿat, (she) complied with (III perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her; 'who gave in to her'
أَحْسَنَتْ: أَحْسَنَتْ — aḥsanat, she did good (IV perf. 3 f. sg.); with إِلَى, 'treated (her) kindly'
وَرَغَّبَتْ: وَ + رَغَّبَتْ — wa-, and + raghghabat, she made desirous (II perf. 3 f. sg.); with فِي, 'made (him) desire'
تُطَاوِعْهَا: تُطَاوِعْ + هَا — tuṭāwiʿ, (she) comply with (III jussive 3 f. sg. after lam) + -hā, her; 'did not give in to her'
تَتَحَيَّلُ: تَتَحَيَّل — tataḥayyalu, she schemes (V imperf. 3 f. sg.); with عَلَى, 'plots toward'
هَلَاكِهَا: هَلَاك + هَا — halāk, destruction (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her destruction'
وَرَيْحَانَةُ: وَ + رَيْحَانَة — wa-, and + Rayḥāna, a slave-girl's name, 'sweet basil' (nom.); 'and Rayḥāna'
وَأُتْرُجَّةُ: وَ + أُتْرُجَّة — wa-, and + Utrujja, a slave-girl's name, 'citron' (nom.); 'and Utrujja'
وَتَكْرَهُ: وَ + تَكْرَه — wa-, and + takrahu, she hates (I imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she loathed'
تَرْقُدَ: تَرْقُد — tarquda, she lie down, sleep (I subj. 3 f. sg.); 'to lie (with)'
صُنَانَهَا: صُنَان + هَا — ṣunān, armpit stench (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her reek'
إِبْطَيْهَا: إِبْطَيْ + هَا — ibṭay, two armpits (dual of ibṭ, gen., nūn dropped in construct) + -hā, her; 'her armpits'
وَرَائِحَةُ: وَ + رَائِحَة — wa-, and + rāʾiḥa, smell (f., nom.); 'and the smell (of)'
فُسَاهَا: فُسَا + هَا — fusā, farting (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her farting'
الْجِيفَةِ: الـ + جِيفَة — al-, the + jīfa, carrion, carcass (f., gen.); 'than carrion'
وَجَسَدُهَا: وَ + جَسَد + هَا — wa-, and + jasad, body (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her body'
أَخْشَنُ: أَخْشَن — akhshan, rougher (elative of khashin, nom.); 'rougher'
اللِّيفَةِ: الـ + لِّيفَة — al-, the + līfa, palm-fibre (used as a scrubber) (f., gen.); 'than palm-fibre'
تُرَغِّبُ: تُرَغِّب — turaghghibu, she entices (II imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'she would tempt'
يُسَاحِقُهَا: يُسَاحِق + هَا — yusāḥiqu, (who) practises siḥāq with (III imperf. 3 m. sg., agreeing with man) + -hā, her; 'who would lie with her'
وَالتَّعْلِيمِ: وَ + الـ + تَّعْلِيم — wa-, and + taʿlīm, teaching, instruction (II verbal noun, gen.); 'and lessons'
الْعَلِيمِ: الـ + عَلِيم — al-, the + ʿalīm, All-Knowing (a name of God, gen.); 'the All-Knowing'
تَسَفَّلَ: تَسَفَّلَ — tasaffala, stooped low, abased himself (V perf. 3 m. sg.); 'who grovelled'
لِلْغَنِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + غَنِيّ — li-, to, before (prep.) + ghaniyy, rich man (gen.); 'before the rich'
مَذِلَّةً: مَذِلَّة — madhilla, abasement (f., acc. of manner); 'in abasement'
عَلَاتَيَّهَا: عَلَا + تَيَّهَا — ʿalā, rose high (I perf.) + tayyahā, unclear as printed (perhaps tīhuhā, her arrogance); set solid in print; doubtful
وَيَزِيْنُ: وَ + يَزِين — wa-, and + yazīnu, he adorns (I imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he adorns'
شُمْعَتَهُ: شُمْعَة + هُ — shumʿa, candle (f., acc.; usually shamʿa) + -hu, his; 'his candle'
بِجَمْعِ: بِـ + جَمْع — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + jamʿ, gathering, hoarding (m., gen.); 'by hoarding'
دَرَاهِمِ: دَرَاهِم — darāhim, dirhams, silver coins (pl. of dirham, gen.); 'coins'
الْقَبِيْحَةِ: الـ + قَبِيحَة — al-, the + qabīḥa, ugly woman (f., gen.); 'of the ugly woman'
لَابَفِيْ: لَا + بَفِي — lā, not + bafī, unclear as printed (perhaps yafī, suffices, ب for ي); set solid; 'does not suffice'
بِفَسَاهَا: بِـ + فَسَا + هَا — bi-, for, against (prep., with yafī: 'make up for') + fasā, farting (gen.) + -hā, her; 'for her farts'
وَنَرْجِعُ: وَ + نَرْجِع — wa-, and + narjiʿu, we return (I imperf. 1 pl.); 'and we return'
وَدَوَاهِي: وَ + دَوَاهِي — wa-, and + dawāhī, calamities (pl. of dāhiya, gen. construct); 'and the calamities (of)'
سَارَتْ: سَارَتْ — sārat, she set out, went (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she set out'
عُظَمَاءُ: عُظَمَاء — ʿuẓamāʾ, great men, grandees (pl. of ʿaẓīm, nom.); 'the grandees (of)'
وَعَسَاكِرُهُمْ: وَ + عَسَاكِر + هُمْ — wa-, and + ʿasākir, armies, troops (pl. of ʿaskar, nom.) + -hum, their; 'and their troops'
وَبَعْدَهَا: وَ + بَعْدَ + هَا — wa-, and + baʿda, after (prep.) + -hā, her, it; 'and after she had gone'
بِدُعَائِهِ: بِـ + دُعَاء + هِ — bi-, of (prep., after ḥāja: 'need of') + duʿāʾ, prayer (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'of his prayers'
بِرَأْىِ: بِـ + رَأْى — bi-, on, by (prep., after naʿmalu: 'act on') + raʾy, counsel, opinion (m., gen.; spelled with ى); 'on the counsel (of)'
بِخِدَاعِهَا: بِـ + خِدَاع + هَا — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + khidāʿ, deceit (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her deceit'; after tafaṭṭun, 'awareness of', bi- marks what is seen through: 'the seeing-through of her deceit'
الْمُتَنَاهِي: الـ + مُتَنَاهِي — al-, the + mutanāhī, finite, coming to an end (VI act. part., gen.); ghayr al-mutanāhī, 'endless'
بِقُوَّتِهِمْ: بِـ + قُوَّة + هِمْ — bi-, with, by (prep.) + quwwa, strength (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'in their strength'
وَاصِلُونَ: وَاصِلُون — wāṣilūn, arriving (act. part. m. pl., nom.); with إِلَى, 'coming at'
يَكُونُونَ: يَكُونُون — yakūnūna, they will be (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'they will be'
لَدَيْنَا: لَدَيْ + نَا — laday, with, at (prep.) + -nā, us; 'upon us'
وَيُحِيطُونَ: وَ + يُحِيطُون — wa-, and + yuḥīṭūna, they surround (IV imperf. 3 m. pl.); with بِـ, 'surround (us)'
الرُّعْبُ: الـ + رُّعْب — al-, the + ruʿb, terror, dread (m., nom.); 'the dread'
سَائِرِأَقَالِيمِ: سَائِر + أَقَالِيم — sāʾir, all, the rest of (gen.) + aqālīm, regions, lands (pl. of iqlīm, gen.); set solid in print; 'all the lands (of)'
يَتَخَلَّفُ: يَتَخَلَّف — yatakhallafu, he stays behind, hangs back (V imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'hangs back'
وَالْعِصَابَةِ: وَ + الـ + عِصَابَة — wa-, and + ʿiṣāba, band, company (f., gen.); 'and the company (of)'
الصَّلِيبِيَّةِ: الـ + صَّلِيبِيَّة — al-, the + ṣalībiyya, of the Cross (nisba adj. f., gen.); 'of the Cross'
الْحُصُونِ: الـ + حُصُون — al-, the + ḥuṣūn, forts (pl. of ḥiṣn, gen.); 'the forts'
وَالْقِلَاعِ: وَ + الـ + قِلَاع — wa-, and + qilāʿ, castles (pl. of qalʿa, gen.); 'and castles'
يَأْتُونَ: يَأْتُون — yaʾtūna, they come (I imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'let them come'
رِجَالًا: رِجَال — rijālan, on foot (pl. of rājil, acc. of state); 'on foot'; also rijāl, men (pl. of rajul), acc. as object: 'men'
وَرُكْبَانًا: وَ + رُكْبَان — wa-, and + rukbānan, riders (pl. of rākib, acc. of state); 'and mounted'
وَنِسَاءً: وَ + نِسَاء — wa-, and + nisāʾan, women (pl., acc.); 'and women'
وَصِبْيَانًا: وَ + صِبْيَان — wa-, and + ṣibyānan, boys, children (pl. of ṣabiyy, acc.); 'and children'
وَطِئُوا: وَطِئُوا — waṭiʾū, they trod, set foot on (I perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they have set foot on'
فَالْعَجَلَ: فَـ + الـ + عَجَل — fa-, so + ʿajala, haste (m., acc. of urging); 'so haste!'
الْوَجَلِ: الـ + وَجَل — al-, the + wajal, dread, fear (m., gen.); 'of terror'
أَصْحَابِهَا: أَصْحَاب + هَا — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, gen.) + -hā, her; 'her companions'
وَأَلْبَسَتْهُمْ: وَ + أَلْبَسَتْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + albasat, she clothed (IV perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and she dressed them'
زِيَّ: زِيّ — ziyy, garb, dress (m., acc.); 'in the garb (of)'
الْأَنْطَاكِيِّ: الـ + أَنْطَاكِيّ — al-, the + anṭākiyy, of Antioch (nisba adj., gen.); 'Antiochene'
مَعْدِنِيٍّ: مَعْدِنِيّ — maʿdiniyy, metallic, of metal thread (nisba adj., gen.); 'shot with metal'
وَدِيبَاجٍ: وَ + دِيبَاج — wa-, and + dībāj, brocade (m., gen.); 'and brocade'
مَلَكِيٍّ: مَلَكِيّ — malakiyy, royal, kingly (nisba adj., gen.); 'royal'
دِيَارِنَا: دِيَار + نَا — diyār, lands, dwellings (pl. of dār, gen.) + -nā, our; 'our lands'
يَتَعَرَّضَ: يَتَعَرَّض — yataʿarraḍa, interfere, molest (V subj. 3 m. sg.); with لِـ, 'interfere with'
وَمَحَلِّ: وَ + مَحَلّ — wa-, and + maḥall, place (m., gen.); 'and the place (of)'
أَمْنِهِمْ: أَمْن + هِمْ — amn, safety (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'their safety'
عَمَارُ: عَمَار — ʿamār, prosperity, flourishing (m., nom.); 'the prosperity (of)'
وَلَيْسُوا: وَ + لَيْسُوا — wa-, and + laysū, they are not (3 m. pl.); 'and they are not'
الْمَلْعُونَةَ: الـ + مَلْعُونَة — al-, the + malʿūna, accursed (pass. part. f., acc. after inna); 'the accursed woman'
أُدَبِّرَ: أُدَبِّر — udabbira, I contrive, devise (II subj. 1 sg.); 'contrive'
مُرِينَا: مُرِي + نَا — murī, command! (imperative f. sg. of amara) + -nā, us; corrected from the misprint مربنا; with بِـ, 'command us (to do)'
طَاعَتِكِ: طَاعَة + كِ — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your obedience'
أَحْبَطَ: أَحْبَطَ — aḥbaṭa, brought to nothing (IV perf.); with lā, a wish: 'may (he) not bring to nothing'
عَمَلَكِ: عَمَل + كِ — ʿamal, work, deed (m., acc.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your work'
فَلَبِسَتْ: فَـ + لَبِسَتْ — fa-, so + labisat, she put on (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'so she put on'
وَحَكَّتْ: وَ + حَكَّتْ — wa-, and + ḥakkat, she rubbed (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she rubbed'
جَبِينَهَا: جَبِين + هَا — jabīn, forehead (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her forehead'
صَارَلَهُ: صَارَ + لَـ + هُ — ṣāra, became (I perf.) + la-, to (prep., possession) + -hu, it; set solid in print; 'it came to have'
وَسْمٌ: وَسْم — wasm, brand, mark (m., nom.); 'a mark'
وَدَهَنَتْهُ: وَ + دَهَنَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + dahanat, she anointed (I perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and she anointed it'
دَبَّرَتْهُ: دَبَّرَتْ + هُ — dabbarat, she contrived (II perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'which she had contrived'
ضَوْوٌ: ضَوْو — ḍawʾ, light, sheen (m., nom.; the print's spelling of ضوء); 'a sheen'
الْمَلْعُونَهُ: الـ + مَلْعُونَه — al-, the + malʿūna, accursed woman (f., nom.; final hāʾ for tāʾ marbūṭa); 'the accursed woman'
نَحِيلَةَ: نَحِيلَة — naḥīla, lean, thin (f., acc. construct); 'lean (of)'
غَائِرَةَ: غَائِرَة — ghāʾira, sunken (act. part. f., acc. construct); 'sunken (of)'
فَقَيَّدَتْ: فَـ + قَيَّدَتْ — fa-, and + qayyadat, she fettered (II perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she shackled'
حَلَّتِ: حَلَّتِ — ḥallat, she untied, loosed (I perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she took off'
أَثَّرَ: أَثَّرَ — aththara, left a mark (II perf. 3 m. sg.); with فِي, 'marked'
الْقَيْدُ: الـ + قَيْد — al-, the + qayd, fetter, shackle (m., nom.); 'the shackle'
سَاقَيْهَا: سَاقَيْ + هَا — sāqay, two shins (dual of sāq, gen.) + -hā, her; 'her shins'
دَهَنَتْهَا: دَهَنَتْ + هَا — dahanat, she smeared (I perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, them (her legs); 'she smeared them'
بِدَمِ: بِـ + دَم — bi-, with (prep.) + dam, blood (m., gen.); 'with the blood (of)'
الْأَخَوَيْنِ: الـ + أَخَوَيْن — al-, the + akhawayn, two brothers (dual, gen.); dam al-akhawayn, dragon's blood (a red resin)
يَضْرِبُوهَا: يَضْرِبُو + هَا — yaḍribū, they beat (I subj. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'that they beat her'
يَضَعُوهَا: يَضَعُو + هَا — yaḍaʿū, they put (I subj. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'that they put her'
وَأَعْلِنُوا: وَ + أَعْلِنُوا — wa-, and + aʿlinū, proclaim! (IV imperative m. pl.); 'and declare aloud'
كَلِمَةِ: كَلِمَة — kalima, word (f., gen.); kalimat al-tawḥīd, the profession of faith
التَّوْحِيدِ: الـ + تَّوْحِيد — al-, the + tawḥīd, (God's) oneness (II verbal noun, gen.); 'of God's oneness'
بَاسٍ: بَاس — bāʾs, harm (m., gen. after min; بأس without hamza); 'harm'
نَضْرِبُكِ: نَضْرِب + كِ — naḍribu, we beat (I imperf. 1 pl.) + -ki, you (f.); 'we beat you'
الْمُبَاهِي: الـ + مُبَاهِي — al-, the + mubāhī, vying in glory, glorious (III act. part., gen.); 'the glorious'
لَوْمَ: لَوْم — lawm, blame (m., acc. after lā of negation); 'no blame'
تَعْنِيفَ: تَعْنِيف — taʿnīf, reproach, scolding (II verbal noun, acc. after lā); 'no scolding'
الْكَنِيفَ: الـ + كَنِيف — al-, the + kanīf, privy (m., acc.); 'the privy'
الضَّرُورَاتِ: الـ + ضَّرُورَات — al-, the + ḍarūrāt, necessities (f. pl., gen.); 'necessities'
تُبَاحُ: تُبَاح — tubāḥu, are made lawful (IV passive imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'are permitted'
الْمَحْظُورَاتُ: الـ + مَحْظُورَات — al-, the + maḥẓūrāt, forbidden things (pass. part. f. pl., nom.); 'the forbidden'
تَضَعُونِي: تَضَعُو + نِي — taḍaʿū, you put (I subj. 2 m. pl.) + -nī, me; 'you put me'
وَاحْمِلُوهُ: وَ + اِحْمِلُو + هُ — wa-, and + iḥmilū, load! carry! (I imperative m. pl.) + -hu, it; 'and load it'
الْبِغَالِ: الـ + بِغَال — al-, the + bighāl, mules (pl. of baghl, gen.); 'the mules'
وَمُرُّوا: وَ + مُرُّوا — wa-, and + murrū, pass! (I imperative m. pl.); with بِـ, 'pass with'
تَخْشَوْا: تَخْشَوْا — takhshaw, you fear (I jussive 2 m. pl. after lā of prohibition); 'do not fear'
الْمَلَامِ: الـ + مَلَام — al-, the + malām, blame, reproach (m., gen.); 'of reproach'
فَسَلِّمُوا: فَـ + سَلِّمُوا — fa-, then + sallimū, hand over! (II imperative m. pl.); 'hand over'
الْبِغَالَ: الـ + بِغَال — al-, the + bighāl, mules (pl. of baghl, acc.); 'the mules'
وَانْصَرِفُوا: وَ + اِنْصَرِفُوا — wa-, and + inṣarifū, go off! betake yourselves! (VII imperative m. pl.); 'and go'
وَاسْتَغِيثُوا: وَ + اِسْتَغِيثُوا — wa-, and + istaghīthū, call for help! (X imperative m. pl.); with بِـ, 'appeal to'
تَوْقِيعًا: تَوْقِيع — tawqīʿ, signed warrant, decree (II verbal noun, acc.); 'a warrant'
تَأْخُذُونَ: تَأْخُذُون — taʾkhudhūna, you take (I imperf. 2 m. pl.); 'you take'
أَمْوَالَنَا: أَمْوَال + نَا — amwāl, goods, wealth (pl. of māl, acc.) + -nā, our; 'our goods'
بِمَكْرُوهٍ: بِـ + مَكْرُوه — bi-, with (prep.) + makrūh, hateful thing, harm (pass. part., gen.); 'with harm'
رَبِحْتُمُوهُ: رَبِحْتُمُو + هُ — rabiḥtum, you gained, profited (I perf. 2 m. pl., -ū- before a suffix) + -hu, it; 'that you profited'
تِجَارَتِكُمْ: تِجَارَة + كُمْ — tijāra, trading, trade (f., gen.) + -kum, your; 'your trading'
رَبِحْنَا: رَبِحْنَا — rabiḥnā, we gained, profited (I perf. 1 pl.); 'our profit was'
خَلَاصَ: خَلَاص — khalāṣ, deliverance, rescue (m., acc.); 'the rescue (of)'
زَاهِدٍ: زَاهِد — zāhid, ascetic (act. part., gen.); 'an ascetic'
يُغَاثُ: يُغَاث — yughāthu, he is helped (IV passive imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'helped'
بَضَائِعَنَا: بَضَائِع + نَا — baḍāʾiʿ, wares, merchandise (pl. of biḍāʿa, acc.) + -nā, our; corrected from the misprint بصائعنا; 'our wares'
وَاشْتَرَيْنَا: وَ + اِشْتَرَيْنَا — wa-, and + ishtaraynā, we bought (VIII perf. 1 pl.); 'and we bought'
خِلَافَهَا: خِلَاف + هَا — khilāf, other than, different from (acc.) + -hā, them; 'others'
حَالَنَا: حَال + نَا — ḥāl, state, affairs (m./f., acc.) + -nā, our; 'our affairs'
وَعَزَمْنَا: وَ + عَزَمْنَا — wa-, and + ʿazamnā, we resolved (I perf. 1 pl.); with عَلَى, 'resolved upon'
وَبِتْنَا: وَ + بِتْنَا — wa-, and + bitnā, we passed the night (I perf. 1 pl. of bāta); 'and we spent the night'
أَصْبَحْنَا: أَصْبَحْنَا — aṣbaḥnā, we reached morning (IV perf. 1 pl.); 'in the morning'
مُصَوَّرَةً: مُصَوَّرَة — muṣawwara, pictured, painted (II pass. part. f., acc.); 'painted'
تَأَمَّلْنَاهَا: تَأَمَّلْنَا + هَا — taʾammalnā, we gazed at (V perf. 1 pl.) + -hā, it; 'we looked at it'
يُعَامِلُ: يُعَامِل — yuʿāmilu, he deals, trades with (III imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'who deals with'
الصُّورَةُ: الـ + صُّورَة — al-, the + ṣūra, picture, image (f., nom.); 'the picture'
أَنْطَقَنِي: أَنْطَقَ + نِي — anṭaqa, made to speak (IV perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'has given me speech'
لِيُقَوِّيَ: لِـ + يُقَوِّي — li-, so that (with subj.) + yuqawwiya, he strengthen (II subj. 3 m. sg.); 'to strengthen'
يَقِينَكُمْ: يَقِين + كُمْ — yaqīn, certainty, faith (m., acc.) + -kum, your; 'your faith'
وَيَهُمَّكُمْ: وَ + يَهُمَّ + كُمْ — wa-, and + yahumma, concern, weigh on (I subj. 3 m. sg.) + -kum, you; 'and (that it) concern you'
دِينُكُمْ: دِين + كُمْ — dīn, religion (m., nom.) + -kum, your; 'your religion'
وَتَخْرُجُوا: وَ + تَخْرُجُوا — wa-, and + takhrujū, you go out (I subj. 2 m. pl.); 'and that you leave'
وَتَقْصِدُوا: وَ + تَقْصِدُوا — wa-, and + taqṣidū, you make for (I subj. 2 m. pl.); 'and go to'
الرَّحْمٰنِ: الـ + رَّحْمٰن — al-, the + raḥmān, the Merciful (a name of God, gen.); 'of the Merciful'
وَبَطَلَ: وَ + بَطَل — wa-, and + baṭal, hero, champion (m., acc.); 'and the champion (of)'
الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةُ: الـ + قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة — al-qusṭanṭīniyya, Constantinople (nom., subject of the passive); 'Constantinople'
وَيَمْلِكُ: وَ + يَمْلِك — wa-, and + yamliku, he rules, possesses (I imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he will rule'
بِدَيْرِ: بِـ + دَيْر — bi-, by (prep., after yuʿrafu: 'known by (the name)') + dayr, monastery (m., gen.); 'as the Monastery (of)'
مَطَرْ: مَطَرْ — Maṭar, first part of the monastery's name as printed
وَحَنَّى: وَ + حَنَّى — wa- + Ḥannā, second part of the monastery's name as printed (Ḥannā is a form of John); 'Maṭar wa-Ḥannā'
صَوْمَعَةٌ: صَوْمَعَة — ṣawmaʿa, hermit's cell (f., nom.); 'a hermit's cell'
فَاقْصِدُوهَا: فَـ + اُقْصِدُو + هَا — fa-, so + uqṣidū, make for! (I imperative m. pl.) + -hā, it; 'make for it'
بِصِدْقِ: بِـ + صِدْق — bi-, with (prep.) + ṣidq, truthfulness, sincerity (m., gen.); 'in (good) faith'; also after kafā, where bi- only marks what suffices (kafā bi-ṣidqi al-mawaddati, 'sincere affection is enough')
نِيَّتِكُمْ: نِيَّة + كُمْ — niyya, intention (f., gen.) + -kum, your; 'your intention'
وَتَحَيَّلُوا: وَ + تَحَيَّلُوا — wa-, and + taḥayyalū, contrive! find a means! (V imperative m. pl.); with عَلَى, 'contrive (to)'
بِقُوَّةِ: بِـ + قُوَّة — bi-, with, by (prep.) + quwwa, strength (f., gen.); 'by the strength (of)'
عَزِيمَتِكُمْ: عَزِيمَة + كُمْ — ʿazīma, resolve (f., gen.) + -kum, your; 'your resolve'
عَابِدًا: عَابِد — ʿābid, worshipper, devotee (act. part., acc.); 'devout'
أَدْيَنِ: أَدْيَن — adyan, most religious, most pious (elative, gen.); 'the most pious (of)'
كَرَامَاتٌ: كَرَامَات — karāmāt, saints' wonders, miracles (f. pl. of karāma, nom.); 'wonders'
تُزِيحُ: تُزِيح — tuzīḥu, it removes, dispels (IV imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'that dispel'
الشَّكَّ: الـ + شَّكّ — al-, the + shakk, doubt (m., acc.); 'doubt'
وَالْإِلْبَاسَ: وَ + الـ + إِلْبَاس — wa-, and + ilbās, confusion, obscurity (IV verbal noun, acc.); 'and confusion'
خَدَعَهُ: خَدَعَ + هُ — khadaʿa, deceived (I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'tricked him'
وَسَجَنَهُ: وَ + سَجَنَ + هُ — wa-, and + sajana, imprisoned (I perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and shut him up'
إِنْقَاذِهِ: إِنْقَاذ + هِ — inqādh, rescue (IV verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, his; 'his rescue'
إِرْضَاءُ: إِرْضَاء — irḍāʾ, pleasing, satisfying (IV verbal noun, nom.); 'the pleasing (of)'
فَكَاكَهُ: فَكَاك + هُ — fakāk, release, setting free (m., acc. after anna) + -hu, his; 'freeing him'
سَمْعَهُ: سَمْع + هُ — samʿ, hearing (m., acc.) + -hu, his; alqā samʿahu, 'gave (you) his ear'
الْعَابِدَ: الـ + عَابِد — al-, the + ʿābid, worshipper, holy man (acc. after anna); 'the holy man'
وَعِبَادِاللَّهِ: و + عِبَاد + الله — wa-, and + ʿibād, servants (pl. of ʿabd; gen.) + Allāh, God; printed as one word; 'and the servants of God'
الْمُخْلَصِينَ: الـ + مُخْلَص — mukhlaṣ, made sincere, chosen (pass. part. IV of kh-l-ṣ; m. pl. gen.); 'the chosen (of God)'
الدَّيْرَ: الـ + دَيْر — dayr, monastery (m., acc.); 'the monastery'
فَعَرَّجْنَا: فَـ + عَرَّجَ — fa-, and so + ʿarraja ʿalā, turn aside to (II perf. 1 pl.); 'and we turned aside'
وَمِلْنَا: و + مَالَ — wa-, and + māla ilā, incline, turn toward (I perf. 1 pl.); 'and we turned toward'
الْبَيْعِ: الـ + بَيْع — bayʿ, selling (verbal noun; gen.); 'the selling'
وَالشِّرَاءِ: و + الـ + شِرَاء — wa-, and + shirāʾ, buying (verbal noun; gen.); 'and the buying'
الصَّوْمَعَةَ: الـ + صَوْمَعَة — ṣawmaʿa, hermit's cell, monk's tower (f., acc.); 'the cell'
السِّرْدَابُ: الـ + سِرْدَاب — sirdāb, underground vault, cellar (m., nom.); 'the vault'
فَسَمِعْنَاهُ: فَـ + سَمِعَ + ـنَا + ـهُ — fa-, and + samiʿa, hear (perf. 1 pl.) + -hu, him; 'and we heard him'
الْآيَاتِ: الـ + آيَات — āyāt, verses of the Qurʾān (pl. of āya; gen.); 'the verses'
كَبِدِيْ: كَبِد + ـي — kabid, liver (f.), seat of grief in Arabic verse + -ī, my; 'my liver'
اُكَابِدُهُ: أُكَابِدُ + ـهُ — ukābidu, I suffer, endure (III imperf. 1 sg. of k-b-d) + -hu, it; 'I endure it'
وَصَدْرِي: و + صَدْر + ـي — wa-, and + ṣadr, breast + -ī, my; 'and my breast'
بَحْرُهُمْ: بَحْر + ـهُمْ — baḥr, sea + -hum, their; 'their sea'
مُغْرِقُ: مُغْرِق — mughriq, drowning, that drowns (act. part. IV of gh-r-q); 'drowning'
فَمَوْتٌ: فَـ + مَوْت — fa-, then + mawt, death (nom.); 'then death'
الْحَمَامَ: الـ + حَمَام — ḥamām, doves (as printed; the sense wants ḥimām, death, fate); 'the death'
الرَّزَايَا: الـ + رَزَايَا — razāyā, calamities (pl. of raziyya; gen.); 'the calamities'
اَرْفَقُ: أَرْفَق — arfaq, gentler, kinder (elative of rafīq); 'kinder'
بَرْقُ: بَرْق — barq, lightning (m.; vocative after yā); 'O lightning'
وَاَهْلَهَا: و + أَهْل + ـهَا — wa-, and + ahl, people + -hā, its; 'and its people'
الْبَشَائِرِ: الـ + بَشَائِر — bashāʾir, good tidings (pl. of bishāra; gen.); 'the good tidings'
رَوْنَقُ: رَوْنَق — rawnaq, lustre, gleam (m., nom.); 'a gleam'
السَّبِيْلُ: الـ + سَبِيل — sabīl, way, path (m., nom.); 'the way'
اللِّقَاءِ: الـ + لِقَاء — liqāʾ, meeting (verbal noun of laqiya; gen.); 'the meeting'
وَبَيْنَنَا: و + بَيْنَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + bayna, between + -nā, us; 'when between us'
الْحُرُوْبُ: الـ + حُرُوب — ḥurūb, wars (pl. of ḥarb; nom.); 'the wars'
وَبَابُ: و + بَاب — wa-, and + bāb, gate, door (nom.); 'and a gate'
رَهْنٍ: رَهْن — rahn, pledge, hostage (gen.); 'of a pledge'
مُغْلَقُ: مُغْلَق — mughlaq, shut, locked (pass. part. IV of gh-l-q); 'shut'
اِنِّيْ: إِنَّ + ـي — inna (particle of assertion, 'that' after qul) + -nī, me; 'that I'
الرُّوْمِ: الـ + رُوم — al-Rūm, the Byzantines, the Christian Greeks (gen.); 'of the Rūm'
قَاصِ: قَاصٍ — qāṣin, far, remote (act. part. of q-ṣ-w; printed with kasra for the tanwīn); 'far away'
مُوْثَقُ: مُوثَق — mūthaq, bound, fettered (pass. part. IV of w-th-q); 'bound'
وَصَلْتُمْ: وَصَلَ + ـتُمْ — waṣala, arrive (perf. 2 m. pl.); with bi-, 'bring'; 'you have arrived'
أُدَبِّرُ: أُدَبِّرُ — udabbiru, I contrive, devise (II imperf. 1 sg. of d-b-r); 'I contrive'
خَدِيعَتِهِمْ: خَدِيعَة + ـهِمْ — khadīʿa, deceiving (f., gen.) + -him, them; 'deceiving them'
وَقَتْلِهِمْ: و + قَتْل + ـهِمْ — wa-, and + qatl, killing (gen.) + -him, them; 'and killing them'
وَوَضَعُوهَا: و + وَضَعُوا + ـهَا — wa-, and + waḍaʿū, they put (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and they put her'
ضَرَبُوهَا: ضَرَبُوا + ـهَا — ḍarabū, they beat (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'they beat her'
أَشَدَّ: أَشَدّ — ashadd, hardest, most severe (elative of shadīd; acc., adverbial); 'the hardest (of)'
الضَّرَبَاتِ: الـ + ضَرَبَات — ḍarabāt, blows (pl. of ḍarba; gen.); 'the blows'
الْمُوجِعَاتِ: الـ + مُوجِعَات — mūjiʿāt, painful (act. part. IV of w-j-ʿ, f. pl. gen.); 'the painful ones'
يَرَوْنَ: يَرَوْنَ — yarawna, they see, hold, consider (imperf. 3 m. pl. of raʾā); 'they hold'
طَاعَتَهَا: طَاعَة + ـهَا — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., acc.) + -hā, her; 'obedience to her'
الْوَاجِبَاتِ: الـ + وَاجِبَات — wājibāt, duties (pl. of wājib; gen.); 'the duties'
قَصَدُوا: قَصَدُوا — qaṣadū, they made for (perf. 3 m. pl.); with bi-, 'took (her) to'; 'they made for'
اللَّعِينَةِ: الـ + لَعِينَة — laʿīna, accursed (f.; gen.); 'the accursed one'
نَصَرَهُمُ: نَصَرَ + ـهُمُ — naṣara, give victory (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -humu, them (helping vowel before al-); 'gave them victory'
أَعْدَائِهِمْ: أَعْدَاء + ـهِمْ — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww; gen., printed with ئ) + -him, their; 'their enemies'
وَغَنِمُوا: و + غَنِمُوا — wa-, and + ghanimū, they took as spoil (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they took as spoil'
نَصَرَنَا: نَصَرَ + ـنَا — naṣara, give victory (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'gave us victory'
عَدْلِنَا: عَدْل + ـنَا — ʿadl, justice (gen.) + -nā, our; 'our justice'
وَانْقِيَادِنَا: و + انْقِيَاد + ـنَا — wa-, and + inqiyād, submitting, giving way (VII verbal noun; gen.) + -nā, our; 'and our giving way'
لِبَعْضِنَا: لِـ + بَعْض + ـنَا — li-, to + baʿḍ, some + -nā, of us; 'to one another'
مُمْتَثِلًا: مُمْتَثِلًا — mumtathilan, obedient, complying (VIII act. part.; acc. as predicate of kun); 'obedient'
لِأَمْرِي: لِـ + أَمْر + ـي — li-, to (the object of mumtathil) + amr, command + -ī, my; 'to my command'
نَوَيْتُ: نَوَيْتُ — nawaytu, I have intended, resolved (perf. 1 sg. of n-w-y); 'I have resolved'
وَأَذْبَحَ: و + أَذْبَحَ — wa-, and + adhbaḥa, I slaughter (subj. 1 sg., after an); 'and to slaughter'
وَلَوْأُ: و + لَوْ + أُـ — wa-, and + law, even if; the alif of uqīmu is printed attached to this word (ولوا قيم for ولو اقيم); 'even if I'
قِيمُ: ـقِيمُ — the rest of uqīmu, I stay (IV imperf. 1 sg. of q-w-m), printed apart from its first letter; 'stay'
وَاسْمُهَا: و + اسْم + ـهَا — wa-, and + ism, name (nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her name'
وَسَيَكُونُ: و + سَـ + يَكُونُ — wa-, and + sa-, will + yakūnu, be (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and there will be'
مِيلَادٍ: مِيلَاد — mīlād, birth (gen. after ʿalā); ʿalā mīlād, 'near her time'
مَايَرْزُقُنِي: مَا + يَرْزُقُ + ـنِي — mā, what + yarzuqu, provide, grant (imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'what (God) will grant me'
عَاهِدْنِي: عَاهِدْ + ـنِي — ʿāhid, make a covenant with (III imperative m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'give me your word'
تَسْمَحُ: تَسْمَحُ — tasmaḥu, you grant (imperf. 2 m. sg.); samaḥa li- bi-, 'grant someone something'; 'you grant'
بِابْنَتِكَ: بِـ + ابْنَة + ـكَ — bi-, marking the thing granted (after samaḥa) + ibna, daughter + -ka, your; 'your daughter'
وَتُعْطِينِي: و + تُعْطِي + ـنِي — wa-, and + tuʿṭī, you give (IV imperf. 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and you give me'
الْمَوَاثِيقَ: الـ + مَوَاثِيق — mawāthīq, compacts, solemn pledges (pl. of mīthāq; acc.); 'the pledges'
وَالْأَيْمَانَ: و + الـ + أَيْمَان — wa-, and + aymān, oaths (pl. of yamīn; acc.); 'and the oaths'
أُعْطِيَنَّهُ: أُعْطِيَنَّ + ـهُ — uʿṭiyanna, I shall surely give (IV imperf. 1 sg., energetic) + -hu, him; 'I will give him'
يُهَنِّي: يُهَنِّي — yuhannī, congratulate (II imperf. 3 m. sg.; spoken form of yuhanniʾu, hamza dropped); 'congratulate'
وَهَنَّى: و + هَنَّى — wa-, and + hannā, congratulated (II perf. 3 m. sg.; spoken form of hannaʾa); 'and (he) congratulated'
وَأَخَاهُ: و + أَخَا + ـهُ — wa-, and + akhā, brother (acc. of akh before a suffix) + -hu, his; 'and his brother'
اعْلَمَا: اعْلَمَا — iʿlamā, know! (imperative, m. dual); 'know, both of you'
وَهَجَرْنَا: و + هَجَرْنَا — wa-, and + hajarnā, we forsook, left (perf. 1 pl.); 'and we left'
وَالرَّأْيُ: و + الـ + رَأْي — wa-, and + raʾy, opinion, counsel (nom.); 'and the counsel'
نَرْحَلَ: نَرْحَلَ — narḥala, we march, set out (subj. 1 pl., after an); 'that we march'
وَنُحَاصِرَهُمْ: و + نُحَاصِرَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + nuḥāṣira, we besiege (III subj. 1 pl.) + -hum, them; 'and besiege them'
وَنُقَاتِلَهُمْ: و + نُقَاتِلَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + nuqātila, we fight (III subj. 1 pl.) + -hum, them; 'and fight them'
يُبَلِّغَنَا: يُبَلِّغَ + ـنَا — yuballigha, bring to, cause to attain (II subj. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'bring us (to)'
وَنَسْتَأْصِلَ: و + نَسْتَأْصِلَ — wa-, and + nastaʾṣila, we uproot, extirpate (X subj. 1 pl. of ʾ-ṣ-l); 'and we uproot'
أَعْدَائَنَا: أَعْدَاء + ـنَا — aʿdāʾ, enemies (acc., printed with ئ) + -nā, our; 'our enemies'
شِئْتُمْ: شِئْتُمْ — shiʾtum, you wish (perf. 2 m. pl. of shāʾa); 'you wish'
وَسِيرُوا: و + سِيرُوا — wa-, and + sīrū, go, travel (imperative m. pl. of sāra); 'and go'
وَالطَّعْنِ: و + الـ + طَعْن — wa-, and + ṭaʿn, thrusting with the spear (verbal noun; gen.); 'and the spear-thrusts'
يُحَرِّضُهُمْ: يُحَرِّضُ + ـهُمْ — yuḥarriḍu, urge on, incite (II imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'urging them on'
اَطْيَبُ: أَطْيَب — aṭyab, sweetest, most pleasant (elative of ṭayyib); 'the sweetest'
ٱلْاَعَادِي: الـ + أَعَادِي — aʿādī, enemies (pl. of pl. of ʿaduww; gen.); printed with the waṣla sign; 'the enemies'
وَاحْتِمَالِي: و + احْتِمَال + ـي — wa-, and + iḥtimāl, being carried, borne (VIII verbal noun) + -ī, my; 'and my being borne'
ظُهُوْرِ: ظُهُور — ẓuhūr, backs (pl. of ẓahr; gen.); 'the backs'
ٱلْجِيَادِ: الـ + جِيَاد — jiyād, thoroughbred horses, steeds (pl. of jawād; gen.); printed with the waṣla sign; 'the steeds'
وَرَسُوْلُ: و + رَسُول — wa-, and + rasūl, messenger (nom., printed without nunation); 'and a messenger'
بِوَعْدِ: بِـ + وَعْد — bi-, with (what he brings; atā bi-, 'bring') + waʿd, promise (gen.); 'with a promise'
حَبِيْبٍ: حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved, lover (gen.); 'of a beloved'
وَحَبِيْبٌ: و + حَبِيب — wa-, and + ḥabīb, beloved (nom.); 'and a beloved'
مِيْعَادِ: مِيعَاد — mīʿād, appointment, appointed time (gen. after bi-lā, 'without'); 'appointment'
وَقَوْلَ: و + قَوْل — wa-, and + qawl, saying, words (acc., object of anshada); 'and the words'
عُمِرْتُ: عُمِرْتُ — ʿumirtu, I am given long life (passive perf. 1 sg.); 'if I live long'
وَالِدَةً: وَالِدَة — wālida, mother (acc., second object of jaʿala); 'a mother'
وَالسَّمْهَرِيَّ: و + الـ + سَمْهَرِيّ — wa-, and + samharī, the Samharī spear, named for Samhar, a legendary spear-maker (acc.); 'and the Samharī spear'
وَالْمَشْرَفِيَّ: و + الـ + مَشْرَفِيّ — wa-, and + mashrafī, Mashrafī sword, from the Mashārif uplands of Syria (acc.); 'and the Mashrafī sword'
اَبَا: أَب — ab, father (acc. aban, lengthened abā for the rhyme); 'a father'
اَشْعَثَ: أَشْعَث — ashʿath, dishevelled, dusty-haired (diptote; gen. with fatḥa after bi-kulli); 'every wild-haired (warrior)'
يَلْقَى: يَلْقَى — yalqā, meet, encounter (imperf. 3 m. sg. of laqiya); 'meets'
مُبْتَسِمًا: مُبْتَسِمًا — mubtasiman, smiling (VIII act. part.; acc. of state); 'smiling'
كَاَنَّ: كَـ + أَنَّ — ka-, as + anna, that; ka-anna, 'as though'
اَرَبَا: أَرَب — arab, desire, need (acc., lengthened arabā for the rhyme); 'a longing'
أَيَّدَنَا: أَيَّدَ + ـنَا — ayyada, strengthen, uphold (II perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'upheld us'
بِنَصْرِةِ: بِـ + نَصْر + ـهِ — bi-, with, by means of + naṣr, victory + -hi, His; printed with tāʾ marbūṭa for ه; 'with His victory'
وَظَفَّرَنَا: و + ظَفَّرَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + ẓaffara, make win (II perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; ẓaffara bi-, 'make win (something)'; 'and gave us'
بِغَنِيمَةِ: بِـ + غَنِيمَة — bi-, marking the thing won (after ẓaffara) + ghanīma, booty, spoil (gen.); 'the spoil'
وَالْإِبْرِيزِ: و + الـ + إِبْرِيز — wa-, and + ibrīz, pure gold (gen.); 'and pure gold'
وَجَدُّوا: و + جَدُّوا — wa-, and + jaddū, they were earnest, pressed on (perf. 3 m. pl. of j-d-d); 'and they pressed on'
سَيْرِهِمْ: سَيْر + ـهِمْ — sayr, going, march (gen.) + -him, their; 'their march'
وُحُوشٍ: وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh; gen.); 'wild beasts'
تَسْنَحُ: تَسْنَحُ — tasnaḥu, cross one's path (of game; imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'darting across'
مَفَاوِزَ: مَفَاوِز — mafāwiz, deserts, waterless wastes (pl. of mafāza; acc., diptote); 'deserts'
الْعُيُونَ: الـ + عُيُون — ʿuyūn, springs (pl. of ʿayn; acc.); 'the springs'
النَّابِعَةَ: الـ + نَابِعَة — nābiʿa, welling, gushing (act. part., f.; acc.); 'welling'
وَالْأَثْمَارَ: و + الـ + أَثْمَار — wa-, and + athmār, fruits (pl. of thamar; acc.); 'and the fruits'
الْيَانِعَةَ: الـ + يَانِعَة — yāniʿa, ripe (act. part., f.; acc.); 'ripe'
زُخْرُفَهَا: زُخْرُف + ـهَا — zukhruf, finery, adornment (acc.) + -hā, its; 'its finery'
وَازَّيَّنَتْ: و + ازَّيَّنَتْ — wa-, and + izzayyanat, adorned itself (V perf. 3 f. sg., assimilated tazayyanat; cf. Qurʾān 10:24); 'and adorned itself'
وَسَكِرَتْ: و + سَكِرَتْ — wa-, and + sakirat, became drunk (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and grew drunk'
أَغْصَانُهَا: أَغْصَان + ـهَا — aghṣān, branches (pl. of ghuṣn; nom.) + -hā, its; 'its branches'
رَحِيقِ: رَحِيق — raḥīq, choice wine, nectar (gen.); 'the nectar'
الطَّلِّ: الـ + طَلّ — ṭall, dew, light rain (gen.); 'of the dew'
فَتَمَايَلَتْ: فَـ + تَمَايَلَتْ — fa-, and so + tamāyalat, swayed to and fro (VI perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and they swayed'
وَاعْتِلَالِ: و + اعْتِلَال — wa-, and + iʿtilāl, languor, softness (VIII verbal noun; gen.); 'and the languor'
فَتُدْهِشُ: فَـ + تُدْهِشُ — fa-, so + tudhishu, amaze, dazzle (IV imperf. 3 f. sg.); 'so it dazzles'
وَالنَّاظِرَ: و + الـ + نَاظِر — wa-, and + nāẓir, beholder, eye (acc.); 'and the eye'
نُشِرَتْ: نُشِرَتْ — nushirat, was spread out (passive perf. 3 f. sg.); 'had been spread'
مَلَاءَةٌ: مَلَاءَة — malāʾa, sheet, wrap, mantle (f., nom.); 'a cloak'
سَنَحْتَ: سَنَحْتَ — sanaḥta, you turned, went aside (perf. 2 m. sg.); in mā sanaḥta, 'if ever you turn'
بِلَحْظِ: بِـ + لَحْظ — bi-, with + laḥẓ, glance (gen.); 'with the glance'
عَيْنِكَ: عَيْن + ـكَ — ʿayn, eye + -ka, your; 'of your eye'
لَاتَرَى: لَا + تَرَى — lā, not + tarā, you see (imperf. 2 m. sg.); printed as one word; 'you will not see'
جَالَ: جَالَ — jāla, roam, wander (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'wanders'
فِيْهِ: فِي + ـهِ — fī, in + -hi, it; 'in it'; also after zahida, 'to lose desire', fī marks what one turns from: tazhadu fīhi, 'you lose desire for him' (Night 201)
دَوْحِهِ: دَوْح + ـهِ — dawḥ, great spreading trees (coll.; gen.) + -hi, its; 'its tall trees'
اِذْفَوْقَ: إِذْ + فَوْقَ — idh, since + fawqa, above; printed as one word; 'for above'
رَأْسِكَ: رَأْس + ـكَ — raʾs, head (gen.) + -ka, your; 'your head'
سِرْتَ: سِرْتَ — sirta, you go, walk (perf. 2 m. sg. of sāra); ḥaythu sirta, 'wherever you walk'
وَكَمَا: و + كَـ + مَا — wa-, and + ka-, as + mā, what; 'and as'
اَلنَّهْرُ: الـ + نَهْر — nahr, river (m., nom.); 'the river'
بِالشُّعَاعِ: بِـ + الـ + شُعَاع — bi-, by (the cause) + shuʿāʿ, sunbeam (gen.); 'by the sunlight'
مُوَرَّدٌ: مُوَرَّد — muwarrad, rosy, rose-tinted (pass. part. II of w-r-d); 'rosy'
عِذَارُ: عِذَار — ʿidhār, first down of a youth's beard on the cheek (nom.); 'the down'
ظِلِّ: ظِلّ — ẓill, shade, shadow (gen.); 'of the shade'
سُوْقِ: سُوق — sūq, shanks, trunks (pl. of sāq; gen.); 'the legs'
الْغُصُوْنِ: الـ + غُصُون — ghuṣūn, boughs (pl. of ghuṣn; gen.); 'of the boughs'
خَلَاخِلٌ: خَلَاخِل — khalākhil, anklets (pl. of khalkhāl; nom., diptote here nunated for the metre); 'anklets'
كَالتِّيْجَانِ: كَـ + الـ + تِيجَان — ka-, like + tījān, crowns (pl. of tāj; gen.); 'like crowns'
وَزَهَتْ: و + زَهَتْ — wa-, and + zahat, shone, bloomed brightly (perf. 3 f. sg. of z-h-w); 'and (its flowers) bloomed'
أَزْهَارُهُ: أَزْهَار + ـهُ — azhār, flowers (pl. of zahr; nom.) + -hu, its; 'its flowers'
وَتَرَنَّمَتْ: و + تَرَنَّمَتْ — wa-, and + tarannamat, trilled, sang (V perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and sang'
أَطْيَارُهُ: أَطْيَار + ـهُ — aṭyār, birds (pl. of ṭayr; nom.) + -hu, its; 'its birds'
دِمَشْقًا: دِمَشْق — Dimashq, Damascus (acc., here declined fully, -an); 'Damascus'
نَرْحَلُ: نَرْحَلُ — narḥalu, we depart (imperf. 1 pl.); 'we leave'
نَأْخُذَ: نَأْخُذَ — naʾkhudha, we take (subj. 1 pl., after ḥattā); 'that we take'
تَنْشَطَ: تَنْشَطَ — tanshaṭa, grow lively, be refreshed (subj. 3 f. sg.); 'recover their spirits'
نُفُوسُهُمْ: نُفُوس + ـهُمْ — nufūs, souls (pl. of nafs; nom.) + -hum, their; 'their souls'
أَصْوَاتًا: أَصْوَات — aṣwāt, voices, sounds (pl. of ṣawt; acc.); 'voices'
قَافِلَةُ: قَافِلَة — qāfila, caravan (f., nom., first term of construct); 'a caravan'
لِلرَّاحَةِ: لِـ + الـ + رَاحَة — li-, for (purpose) + rāḥa, rest (gen.); 'to rest'
صَادَمُوهُمْ: صَادَمُوا + ـهُمْ — ṣādamū, they collided with, fell upon (III perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hum, them; 'fell on them'
بَضَائِعِهِمُ: بَضَائِع + ـهِمُ — baḍāʾiʿ, goods, merchandise (pl. of biḍāʿa; gen.) + -himu, their (helping vowel before al-); 'their goods'
صَارِخُونَ: صَارِخُونَ — ṣārikhūna, crying out (act. part. m. pl.); 'crying out'
يَسْتَغِيثُونَ: يَسْتَغِيثُونَ — yastaghīthūna, they call for help (X imperf. 3 m. pl.); istaghātha bi-, 'appeal to (someone)'; 'appealing'
بِإِحْضَارِهِمْ: بِـ + إِحْضَار + ـهِمْ — bi-, marking the thing commanded (after amara) + iḥḍār, bringing (IV verbal noun) + -him, them; 'that they be brought'
يَنْهَبُوا: يَنْهَبُوا — yanhabū, they plunder (jussive 3 m. pl., after lam); 'they did (not) plunder'
تَنْهَبُ: تَنْهَبُ — tanhabu, plunder (imperf. 3 f. sg., before a plural subject); 'plunder'
إِخْوَانُنَا: إِخْوَان + ـنَا — ikhwān, brothers (pl. of akh; nom.) + -nā, our; 'our brothers'
عَسَاكِرَكُمْ: عَسَاكِر + ـكُمْ — ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; acc.) + -kum, your; 'your armies'
أَقْبَلْنَا: أَقْبَلْنَا — aqbalnā, we came forward (IV perf. 1 pl.); aqbala ʿalā, 'come towards'; 'we came towards'
أَخْبَرْنَاكَ: أَخْبَرْنَا + ـكَ — akhbarnā, we informed (IV perf. 1 pl.) + -ka, you; akhbara bi-, 'tell of'; 'we have told you'
وَقَرَأَ: و + قَرَأَ — wa-, and + qaraʾa, read (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and read'
نَرُدُّ: نَرُدُّ — naruddu, we return, give back (imperf. 1 pl.); radda ʿalā, 'give back to'; 'we will give back'
أُخِذَ: أُخِذَ — ukhidha, was taken (passive perf. 3 m. sg.; the print marks the damma); 'was taken'
لَاتَحْمِلُوا: لَا + تَحْمِلُوا — lā, not + taḥmilū, you carry (subj. 2 m. pl., after an); printed as one word; 'that you not carry'
يَامَوْلَانَا: يَا + مَوْلَى + ـنَا — yā, O + mawlā, lord, master + -nā, our; printed as one word; 'our lord'
سَيَّرَنَا: سَيَّرَ + ـنَا — sayyara, send on a journey (II perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'sent us'
لِنَظْفَرَ: لِـ + نَظْفَرَ — li-, so that + naẓfara, we win (subj. 1 pl.); ẓafira bi-, 'win, lay hands on'; 'that we might win'
بِمَالَمْ: بِـ + مَا + لَمْ — bi-, marking the prize (after ẓafira) + mā, what + lam, not; printed as one word; 'what (no one) has'
يَظْفَرْ: يَظْفَرْ — yaẓfar, win (jussive 3 m. sg., after lam); 'won'
الْغُزَاةِ: الـ + غُزَاة — ghuzāt, raiders, warriors of the faith (pl. of ghāzī; gen.); 'the raiders'
غَزَوَاتِكُمْ: غَزَوَات + ـكُمْ — ghazawāt, raids, campaigns (pl. of ghazwa; gen.) + -kum, your; 'your campaigns'
ظَفِرْتُمْ: ظَفِرْتُمْ — ẓafirtum, you won (perf. 2 m. pl.); with bi-, 'win (something)'; 'you have won'
لِهَلَاكِنَا: لِـ + هَلَاك + ـنَا — li-, for + halāk, destruction (gen.) + -nā, our; 'of our destruction'
وَهَلَاكِ: و + هَلَاك — wa-, and + halāk, destruction (gen.); 'and the destruction'
خَبَؤُا: خَبَؤُوا — khabaʾū, they hid (perf. 3 m. pl. of kh-b-ʾ; printed خبؤا); 'they had hidden'
وَاخْتَلَيَا: و + اخْتَلَيَا — wa-, and + ikhtalayā, the two were alone (VIII perf. 3 m. dual); ikhtalā bi-, 'be alone with'; 'and they were alone (with)'
فَشَرَحُوا: فَـ + شَرَحُوا — fa-, and + sharaḥū, they explained, laid out (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they told'
أَبْكَوْهُمَا: أَبْكَوْا + ـهُمَا — abkaw, they made weep (IV perf. 3 m. pl.) + -humā, the two of them; 'they made them both weep'
هَيْئَةِ: هَيْئَة — hayʾa, form, guise, appearance (f., gen. after فِي); 'the guise of'
التُّجَّارِ: الـ + تُجَّار — tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir; gen.); 'the merchants'
اخْتَلَى: اخْتَلَى — ikhtalā, to be alone (with) (verb VIII of kh-l-w, perf. 3ms); with بِـ, 'was alone with'
شَرَحُوا: شَرَحَ — sharaḥa, to lay out, explain, relate in full (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they laid out'
وَأَخْبَرُوهُمَا: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV of kh-b-r, perf. 3mp) + -humā, the two of them (obj.); 'and they told the two of them'
عَلَّمَتْهُمُ: عَلَّمَ + ـتْ + هُمُ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II of ʿ-l-m, perf. 3fs) + -humu, them (obj., helping vowel -u before al-); 'she had taught them'
الْكَاهِنَةُ: الـ + كَاهِنَة — kāhina, soothsayer, diviner (f. of kāhin; nom.); 'the soothsayer'
فَرَّقَ: فَرَّقَ — as printed, farraqa, to divide, separate (verb II of f-r-q, perf. 3ms); the sense here wants فَـ + رَقَّ — fa-, and so (conj.) + raqqa, to grow soft, tender (verb I, doubled, perf. 3ms); 'and softened'
لِلزَّاهِدِ: لِـ + الـ + زَاهِد — li-, for, toward (prep.; marks the one the heart softens for) + al-zāhid, the ascetic (gen.); 'toward the ascetic'
الْحَمِيَّةُ: الـ + حَمِيَّة — ḥamiyya, zeal, ardour in defence of what is one's own (f., nom.); 'the zeal'
خَلَّصْتُمْ: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, to set free, rescue (verb II of kh-l-ṣ, perf. 2mp); 'you rescued'
الزَّاهِدَ: الـ + زَاهِد — zāhid, ascetic (m., acc.); 'the ascetic'
خَلَّصْنَاهُ: خَلَّصَ + نَا + هُ — khallaṣa, to rescue (verb II, perf. 1pl) + -hu, him (obj.); 'we rescued him'
وَقَتَلْنَا: وَ + قَتَلَ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 1pl); 'and we killed'
خَوْفِنَا: خَوْف + نَا — khawf, fear (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -nā, our; 'our fear'
أَسْرَعْنَا: أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa, to hasten (verb IV of s-r-ʿ, perf. 1pl); 'we hastened'
الْعَطَبِ: الـ + عَطَب — ʿaṭab, ruin, destruction (m., gen.); 'the ruin'
قَنَاطِيرَ: قَنَاطِير — qanāṭīr, qinṭārs, hundredweights; heaps of treasure (pl. of qinṭār; acc. subject of أَنَّ, diptote)
قَرْنُ: قَرْن — qarn, horn; pod (m., nom., in construct, predicate of كَأَنَّ); 'a pod of'
شَنْبَرٍ: شَنْبَر — shanbar; in khiyār shanbar, cassia (Cassia fistula), with long black pods (gen.)
وَالنُّحُولِ: وَ + الـ + نُحُول — wa-, and + nuḥūl, leanness, emaciation (m., gen.); 'and the leanness'
مُكَبَّلَةٌ: مُكَبَّلَة — mukabbala, fettered, shackled (passive participle of kabbala, verb II, f., nom.); 'fettered'
السَّلَاسِلِ: الـ + سَلَاسِل — salāsil, chains (pl. of silsila; gen.); 'the chains'
وَالْقُيُودِ: وَ + الـ + قُيُود — wa-, and + quyūd, shackles, fetters (pl. of qayd; gen.); 'and the shackles'
الْعُبَّادِ: الـ + عُبَّاد — ʿubbād, worshippers, devotees (pl. of ʿābid; gen.); 'the worshippers'
وَأَفْضَلِ: وَ + أَفْضَل — wa-, and + afḍal, most excellent (elative of faḍl; gen., in construct); 'and the best of'
الزُّهَّادِ: الـ + زُهَّاد — zuhhād, ascetics (pl. of zāhid; gen.); 'the ascetics'
وَجَبِينُهَا: وَ + جَبِين + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial: 'as') + jabīn, brow, forehead (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'as her brow'
الدِّهَانِ: الـ + دِهَان — dihān, ointment, grease (m., gen. after مِنْ); 'the ointment'
دَهَنَتْ: دَهَنَ — dahana, to anoint, smear (verb I, perf. 3fs); with بِـ, 'she anointed with'
يَنْتَحِبَانِ: انْتَحَبَ — intaḥaba, to sob, weep aloud (verb VIII of n-ḥ-b, imperf. 3m dual); 'sobbing'
كُفَّا: كَفَّ — kaffa, to hold back, desist (verb I, doubled; imperative m. dual); with عَنْ, 'stop, both of you'
وَاسْمَعَا: وَ + اسْمَعَا — wa-, and + ismaʿā, hear (imperative m. dual of samiʿa, verb I); 'and hear, both of you'
فَتَرَكَا: فَـ + تَرَكَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + taraka, to leave, give up (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two left off'
امْتِثَالًا: امْتِثَال — imtithāl, compliance, obedience (verbal noun of verb VIII of m-th-l; acc. of purpose); 'in compliance'
لِأَمْرِهَا: لِـ + أَمْر + هَا — li-, to, with (prep.; marks what is complied with) + amr, command (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her command'
امْتِحَانٌ: امْتِحَان — imtiḥān, testing, trial (verbal noun of verb VIII of m-ḥ-n; nom., predicate of أَنَّ); 'a trial'
يَصْبِرْ: صَبَرَ — ṣabara, to be patient, endure (verb I, jussive 3ms after لَمْ); with عَلَى, 'endure'
جَنَّاتِ: جَنَّات — jannāt, gardens (pl. of janna; gen. after إِلَى, in construct); 'the Gardens of'
جَزَعاً: جَزَع — jazaʿ, impatience, anguish, inability to bear (m., acc. of cause); 'out of impatience'
حَلَّ: حَلَّ — ḥalla, to alight, befall (verb I, doubled, perf. 3ms); with بِـ, 'befell'
أَمُوتَ: مَاتَ — māta, to die (verb I, hollow, subj. 1s after أَنْ); 'I die'
خَيْلِ: خَيْل — khayl, horses (collective; gen., in construct); 'the horses of'
الْمُجَاهِدِينَ: الـ + مُجَاهِدِين — mujāhidīn, strivers, those fighting in the way of God (pl. of mujāhid, verb III of j-h-d; gen.); 'the holy warriors'
أَحْيَاءٌ: أَحْيَاء — aḥyāʾ, living (pl. of ḥayy; nom.); 'alive'
أَمْوَاتٍ: أَمْوَات — amwāt, dead (pl. of mayyit; gen. after غَيْر); 'dead'
اَلْحِصْنُ: الـ + حِصْن — ḥiṣn, fortress (m., nom.); 'the fortress'
طُوْرٌ: طُور — ṭūr, mountain; al-Ṭūr, Mount Sinai (m., nom.); 'a Sinai'
وَنَارُ: وَ + نَار — wa-, and + nār, fire (f., nom., in construct); 'and the fire of'
مُوْقَدَةٌ: مُوقَدَة — mūqada, kindled (passive participle of awqada, verb IV of w-q-d; f., nom.); 'kindled'
مِيْقَاتُ: مِيقَات — mīqāt, appointed time (m., nom., the rhyme's -u); 'an appointed time'
اَلْقِ: أَلْقَى — alqā, to throw, cast (verb IV of l-q-y, imperative m. sg. alqi); 'cast'
تَتَلَقَّفْ: تَلَقَّفَ — talaqqafa, to swallow up, snatch up (verb V of l-q-f, jussive 3fs, answering the imperative); 'it will swallow up'
صَنَعُوْا: صَنَعَ — ṣanaʿa, to make, do (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they made'
بِحِبَالِ: بِـ + حِبَال — bi-, in (prep.; locates the snakes: 'in the ropes') + ḥibāl, ropes (pl. of ḥabl; gen., in construct); 'in the ropes of'
حَيَّاتُ: حَيَّات — ḥayyāt, snakes (pl. of ḥayya; nom.); 'snakes'
فَاقْرَأْ: فَـ + اقْرَأْ — fa-, so (conj.) + iqraʾ, read, recite (imperative m. sg. of qaraʾa, verb I); 'so read' (the print has فاترأ)
سُطُوْرَ: سُطُور — suṭūr, lines of writing; rows, ranks (pl. of saṭr; acc., in construct); 'the lines of'
الْعِدَى: الـ + عِدَى — ʿidā, enemies (collective pl.; gen.); 'the enemies'
سُوْرًا: سُور — sūr, sūras, chapters of the Qurʾān (pl. of sūra; acc., 'as'); 'as sūras'
سَيْفَكَ: سَيْف + كَ — sayf, sword (m., acc. after إِنَّ) + -ka, your; 'your sword'
الْاَعْنَاقِ: الـ + أَعْنَاق — aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq; gen.); 'the necks'
آيَاتُ: آيَات — āyāt, verses of the Qurʾān; signs, wonders (pl. of āya; nom., predicate of إِنَّ); 'verses'
تَنَاثَرَتْ: تَنَاثَرَ + ـتْ — tanāthara, to scatter, fall in drops (v. VI, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural al-madāmiʿ); 'scattered'
الْمَدَامِعُ: الْـ + مَدَامِع — madāmiʿ, tears (pl. of madmaʿ, tear-duct, tear; nom.); 'the tears'
بِالدِّهَانِ: بِـ + الـ + دِهَان — bi-, with (prep.: what it is smeared with) + dihān, oil, ointment (m., gen.); 'with the oil'
كَالضَّوْءِ: كَـ + الـ + ضَوْء — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + ḍawʾ, light (m., gen.); 'like the light'
اللَّامِعِ: الـ + لَامِع — lāmiʿ, gleaming, shining (act. part. of lamaʿa; gen., agreeing); 'the gleaming'
وَأَحْضَرَلَهَا: وَ + أَحْضَرَ + لِـ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aḥḍara, to bring, have brought (v. IV, perf. 3ms) + li-, for (prep.: the one it is brought for; la- before the suffix) + 3fs suffix; printed as one word; 'and he brought for her'
فَامْتَنَعَتْ: فَـ + امْتَنَعَ + ـتْ — fa-, but, and so + imtanaʿa, to refuse, hold back (v. VIII, perf. 3fs); 'but she refused'
أُفْطِرْ: أُفْطِرْ — ufṭir, break one's fast (afṭara, v. IV, jussive 1s after lam); 'I have (not) broken my fast'
بِالْخَلَاصِ: بِـ + الْـ + خَلَاص — bi-, with (prep.: the gift, governed by jāda ʿalā … bi-) + khalāṣ, deliverance, release (m., gen.); 'with deliverance' Also after ṣaddaqa, 'to believe', bi- marks the thing believed: لَا أُصَدِّقُ بِالْخَلَاصِ 'scarcely believing in my deliverance'.
أَسْرِ: أَسْر — asr, captivity, being taken prisoner (m., gen.); 'the captivity of'
أَشَقُّ: أَشَقّ — ashaqq, harder, more grievous (elative of shāqq, from shaqqa; nom.); 'harder'
عَذَابِ: عَذَاب — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., gen.); 'the torment of'
وَقَدَّمَا: وَ + قَدَّمَ + ـَا — wa-, and + qaddama, to set before, offer (v. II, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two set before'
انْتَصَبَتْ: انْتَصَبَ + ـتْ — intaṣaba, to stand upright, take one's stand (v. VIII, perf. 3fs); 'she stood up'
الْمِحْرَابِ: الْـ + مِحْرَاب — miḥrāb, prayer niche showing the direction of Mecca (m., gen.); 'the prayer niche'
بِلَيَالِيهَا: بِـ + لَيَالِي + ـهَا — bi-, with (prep.: together with) + layālī, nights (pl. of layla; gen.) + 3fs poss. (referring to the days); 'with their nights'
التَّحِيَّةِ: الـ + تَحِيَّة — taḥiyya, greeting, salutation (f., gen.); here perhaps the greeting that closes a prayer; 'the salutation'
اضْرِبْ: اضْرِبْ — iḍrib, strike! (ḍaraba, v. I, imperative 2ms); with khayma, 'pitch (a tent)'
الْأَدِيمِ: الْـ + أَدِيم — adīm, tanned leather, hide (m., gen.); 'leather'
الْعَابِدِ: الْـ + عَابِد — ʿābid, worshipper, devout man (m., act. part. of ʿabada; gen.); 'the worshipper'
وَوَكِّلْ: وَ + وَكِّلْ — wa-, and + wakkil, put in charge! (wakkala, v. II, imperative 2ms); wakkala … bi-, 'put someone in charge of': bi- marks the duty given; 'and charge (with)'
فَرَّاشًا: فَرَّاش — farrāsh, tent-servant, one who spreads the carpets (m., acc. indef.); 'a servant'
بِالطَّعَامِ: بِـ + الـ + طَعَام — bi-, for (prep.: the thing sent for, governed by daʿā bi-) + ṭaʿām, food (m., gen.); 'for the food'
الْأَنْفُسُ: الْـ + أَنْفُس — anfus, souls (pl. of nafs; nom.); 'the souls'
تَأْكُلْ: تَأْكُلْ — taʾkul, she eats (akala, v. I; jussive 3fs after lam); 'she did (not) eat'
بِمِلْحٍ: بِـ + مِلْح — bi-, with (prep.: what it is eaten with) + milḥ, salt (m., gen.); 'with salt'
نَوَتِ: نَوَى + ـتِ — nawā, to intend, make the intention (v. I, perf. 3fs; final ā dropped, kasra linking); 'she intended'
الْجِهَادُ: الـ + جِهَاد — jihād, holy war, striving (m., nom.)
لَازَمْتُهُ: لَازَمْتُ + ـهُ — lāzama, to stay close to, keep constantly with (verb III, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'kept close to him'
وَأَعْبُدُ: وَ + أَعْبُدُ — ʿabada, to worship (verb I, impf. 1cs); 'and I would worship'
أَلْقَاهُ: أَلْقَى + ـهُ — laqiya, to meet (verb I, impf. 1cs alqā) + -hu, Him; 'I meet Him'
وَأَتَحَدَّثَ: وَ + أَتَحَدَّثَ — taḥaddatha, to talk, converse (verb V, impf. subj. 1cs, still after أَنْ); 'and that I talk'
نَجِدْ: نَجِدْ — wajada, to find (verb I, jussive 1cp after لَمْ); 'we (did not) find'
نَحْبِي: نَحْب + ـي — naḥb, vow; (by extension) one's appointed death (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my vow' (qaḍā naḥbahu, 'he died', Qurʾān 33:23)
وَلِقَاءِ: وَ + لِقَاء — wa-, and + liqāʾ, meeting (verbal noun of laqiya, m., gen., first term of a construct); still governed by the bi- of yadʿū lī bi-, 'pray for me for (something)', which names what is prayed for; 'and (for) the meeting of'
زَهِدْتُ: zahidtu — zahida, to renounce (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I have renounced'
الْكَاهِنَةِ: الـ + كَاهِنَة — kāhina, soothsayer, priestess (f. of kāhin, gen.)
خَيْمَتِهَا: خَيْمَة + ـهَا — khayma, tent (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her tent'
فَرَأَوْهَا: فَـ + رَأَوْا + ـهَا — fa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they saw her'
فَدَنَوْا: فَـ + دَنَوْا — fa-, and (conj.) + danā, to draw near (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they drew near'
صَلٰوتِهَا: صَلٰوة + ـهَا — ṣalāh, prayer (f., gen.; printed with و and the dagger alif) + -hā, her; 'her prayer'
وَحَيَّتْهُمْ: وَ + حَيَّتْ + ـهُمْ — ḥayyā, to greet (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -hum, them; 'and she greeted them'
جِئْتُمْ: jiʾtum — jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 2mp); 'you have come'
الْعَابِدُ: الـ + عَابِد — ʿābid, worshipper, devotee (act. part. of ʿabada, m., nom. after ayyuhā); also nom. in apposition (al-zāhidu al-ʿābidu, 'the ascetic, the devout')
بُكَائِنَا: بُكَاء + ـنَا — bukāʾ, weeping (verbal noun of bakā, m.; object of samiʿta, pointed bukāʾinā as the print's yāʾ-seat spells it, Classical bukāʾanā) + -nā, our; 'our weeping'
حَوْلَكَ: حَوْل + ـكَ — ḥawla, around (prep./adv.) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'around you'
يَقِفُ: yaqifu — waqafa, to stand (verb I assimilated, impf. 3ms); 'stands'
وُجُودٌ: وُجُود — wujūd, existence, being (m., nom. indef.)
صَوْتَ: صَوْت — ṣawt, voice, sound (m., acc., first term of a construct)
تُحَدِّثَنَا: تُحَدِّثَ + ـنَا — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (verb II, impf. subj. 2ms after أَنْ) + -nā, us; 'that you tell us'
أَسْرِكَ: أَسْر + ـكَ — asr, captivity, being taken prisoner (m., gen.) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your captivity'
وَتَدْعُوَ: وَ + تَدْعُوَ — daʿā, to pray (verb I, impf. subj. 2ms, still after أَنْ); 'and that you pray'
مُلْكِ: مُلْك — mulk, dominion, sovereignty (m., gen., first term of a construct)
أُحَدِّثُكُمْ: أُحَدِّثُ + ـكُمْ — ḥaddatha, to tell (verb II, impf. 1cs) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I would tell you'
أَشْكُو: ashkū — shakā, to complain (verb I, impf. 1cs); shakā ilā, 'complain to'
أُخْبِرُكُمْ: أُخْبِرُ + ـكُمْ — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. 1cs; akhbara bi-, 'tell of') + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I tell you'
أَسْرِي: أَسْر + ـي — asr, captivity (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my captivity'
الْأَبْدَالِ: الـ + أَبْدَال — abdāl, 'substitutes', the hidden saints of Sufi lore (pl. of badal, gen.)
أَتَكَبَّرُ: atakabbaru — takabbara, to be proud, haughty (verb V, impf. 1cs); takabbara ʿalā, 'to look down on'
بِالتَّوَاضُعِ: بِـ + الـ + تَوَاضُع — bi-, with (prep.; anʿama bi-, names the gift) + tawāḍuʿ, humility (verbal noun of verb VI, m., gen.); 'with humility'
وَالزُّهْدِ: وَ + الـ + زُهْد — wa-, and + zuhd, renunciation of the world (m., gen.), still after the bi- of anʿama ʿalā … bi-, 'favour someone with', which names the gift; 'and (with) renunciation'
فَدَاخَلَنِي: فَـ + دَاخَلَ + ـنِي — fa-, and (conj.) + dākhala, to enter into, pervade (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and there entered into me'
الْعُجْبُ: الـ + عُجْب — ʿujb, self-admiration, conceit (m., nom., subject)
فَقَسَا: فَـ + قَسَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + qasā, to grow hard (verb I, final-weak, perf. 3ms); 'and (my heart) grew hard'
وَابْتَلَانِي: وَ + ابْتَلَى + ـنِي — ibtalā, to try, afflict (verb VIII of b-l-w, perf. 3ms) + 1cs object; takes bi- for the affliction; 'and (God) tried me'
وَجُلْتُ: وَ + جُلْتُ — jāla, to roam, wander about (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs); 'and I roamed'
أَقْطَارِهَا: أَقْطَار + ـهَا — aqṭār, regions, quarters (pl. of quṭr; gen.) + 3fs suffix (the lands); 'its regions'
أَتْرُكْ: أَتْرُكْ — taraka, to leave (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam); 'I (did not) leave'
عَبَدْتُ: عَبَدْتُ — ʿabada, to worship (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I worshipped'
صَعِدْتُ: صَعِدْتُ — ṣaʿida, to climb, go up (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ilā); 'I climbed'
دَيْرُ: دَيْر — dayr, monastery (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'a monastery of'
رَاهِبٍ: رَاهِب — rāhib, monk (m., gen. indef.); 'a monk'
مَطْرُوحَنَى: مَطْرُوحَنَى — Maṭrūḥanā, name of the monk (proper name, indeclinable); 'Maṭrūḥanā'; dayr Maṭrūḥanā, the monastery named after him
وَرِجْلَيَّ: وَ + رِجْلَا + ـيَ — rijl, foot (f., dual acc.) + 1cs suffix; 'and my two feet'
وَأَدْخَلَنِي: وَ + أَدْخَلَ + ـنِي — adkhala, to bring in, make enter (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1cs object; 'and he brought me into'
غَافَلَنِي: غَافَلَ + ـنِي — ghāfala, to catch off guard, take unawares (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 1cs object; 'he caught me off guard'
قَصْدُهُ: قَصْد + ـهُ — qaṣd, intent, purpose (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his intent' (corrected from the print's قصدة)
بَطْرِيقٌ: بَطْرِيق — baṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine commander (m., nom. indef., subject of dakhala); 'a patrician'
دَقْيَانُوسُ: دَقْيَانُوس — Daqyānūs, a patrician's name (proper name, diptote, nom.); 'Daqyānūs'
تَمَاثِيلُ: تَمَاثِيل — Tamāthīl, the patrician's daughter (proper name, diptote; the word means 'images, statues'); 'Tamāthīl'
مَثِيلٌ: مَثِيل — mathīl, like, equal (m., nom. indef.); 'an equal'
أَخْبَرَهُمُ: أَخْبَرَ + ـهُمُ — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for the news) + 3mp object (-humu before the article); 'he informed them'
الرَّاهِبُ: الـ + رَاهِب — rāhib, monk (m., nom.); 'the monk'
أَخْرِجُوهُ: أَخْرِجُوا + ـهُ — akhraja, to bring out (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + 3ms object; 'bring him out'
لَحْمِهِ: لَحْم + ـهِ — laḥm, flesh (m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his flesh'
فَفَتَحُوا: فَـ + فَتَحُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'so they opened'
فَوَجَدُونِي: فَـ + وَجَدُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and + wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3mp; the plural alif drops before the suffix) + 1cs object; 'and they found me'
وَأَقْرَأُ: وَ + أَقْرَأُ — qaraʾa, to read, recite the Qurʾān (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'and reciting'
وَأُسَبِّحُ: وَ + أُسَبِّحُ — sabbaḥa, to glorify God, say subḥān allāh (verb II, imperf. 1cs); 'and glorifying'
رَؤُنِي: رَؤُو + ـنِي — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mp, printed without the plural wāw for raʾawnī) + 1cs object; 'they saw me'
سَاحِرٌ: سَاحِر — sāḥir, sorcerer (m., nom. indef.); 'a sorcerer'
السَّحَرَةِ: الـ + سَحَرَة — saḥara, sorcerers (pl. of sāḥir; gen.); 'the sorcerers'
وَجَمَاعَتُهُ: وَ + جَمَاعَة + ـهُ — jamāʿa, company, band of followers (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his company'
يَتَكَبَّرُ: يَتَكَبَّرُ — takabbara, to be proud, arrogant (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'is proud'
وَيُعْجَبُ: وَ + يُعْجَبُ — wa-, and + uʿjiba, to be pleased with oneself, vain (verb IV passive, imperf. 3ms); uʿjiba bi-, 'be vain of': bi- names the thing one is vain of; 'and is vain (of)'
رَبُّهُ: رَبّ + ـهُ — rabb, Lord (m., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his Lord'
مِمَّالَيْسَ: مِنْ + مَا + لَيْسَ — min, of (prep., explicative) + mā, what + laysa, is not (printed as one word); 'of what is not'
طَاقَتِهِ: طَاقَة + ـهِ — ṭāqa, power, capacity (f., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his power'
دَاخَلَكِ: دَاخَلَ + ـكِ — dākhala, to enter into, pervade (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 2fs object; 'has entered you'
وَالْكِبْرُ: وَ + الـ + كِبْر — kibr, pride, arrogance (m., nom.); 'and pride'
الْكِبْرَ: الـ + كِبْر — kibr, pride (m., acc. after anna); 'pride'
يُغْضِبُ: يُغْضِبُ — aghḍaba, to anger (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'angers'
الرَّبَّ: الـ + رَبّ — rabb, Lord (m., acc.); 'the Lord'
وَيُقَسِّى: وَ + يُقَسِّى — qassā, to harden (verb II, imperf. 3ms; final yāʾ printed undotted); 'and hardens'
وَيُدْخِلُ: وَ + يُدْخِلُ — adkhala, to make enter, bring into (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'and brings into'
الْإِنْسَانَ: الـ + إِنْسَان — insān, man, human being (m., acc.); 'a man'
قَيَّدُونِي: قَيَّدُوا + ـنِي — qayyada, to fetter, chain (verb II, perf. 3mp) + 1cs object; 'they fettered me'
وَرَدُّونِي: وَ + رَدُّوا + ـنِي — radda, to return, send back (verb I doubled, perf. 3mp) + 1cs object; 'and they returned me'
سِرْدَابًا: سِرْدَاب — sirdāb, underground vault, cellar (m., acc., predicate of kāna); 'a vault'
يَرْمُونَ: يَرْمُونَ — ramā, to throw (verb I, final-weak, imperf. 3mp); 'they throw'
قُرْصَةً: قُرْصَة — qurṣa, round flat loaf (f., acc. indef.); 'a round loaf'
وَشَرْبَةَ: وَ + شَرْبَة — sharba, a drink, draught (f., acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'and a drink of'
يَأْتِى: يَأْتِى — atā, to come (verb I, final-weak, imperf. 3ms; final yāʾ printed undotted); 'comes'
وَيَدْخُلُ: وَ + يَدْخُلُ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and enters'
كَبِرَتِ: كَبِرَتْ — kabira, to grow up, grow older (verb I, perf. 3fs; -i joining vowel); 'has grown up'
ابْنَتُهُ: ابْنَة + ـهُ — ibna, daughter (f., nom.) + 3ms suffix; 'his daughter'
تِسْعِ: تِسْع — tisʿ, nine (f. form, used with masc. sinīn; gen.); 'nine'
فَجُمْلَةُ: فَـ + جُمْلَة — fa-, so (conj.) + jumla, sum, total (f., nom.); 'so the sum of'
يَأْخُذَهَا: يَأْخُذَ + ـهَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after an) + 3fs object; 'he take her'
غَيْرَأَنَّهَا: غَيْرَ + أَنَّ + ـهَا — ghayra, except (acc. of exception) + anna, that + 3fs suffix (printed as one word); 'except that she'
تَرْكَبُ: تَرْكَبُ — rakiba, to ride (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'she rides'
خَزَنَ: خَزَنَ — khazana, to store, lay up (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he stored'
أَمْوَالَهَا: أَمْوَال + ـهَا — amwāl, riches, wealth (pl. of māl; acc.) + 3fs suffix; 'her riches'
شَئٌ: شَئ — shayʾ, thing, something (m., nom. indef.; the print's spelling of شَيْء); 'a thing'
نَفَائِسِ: نَفَائِس — nafāʾis, precious things (pl. of nafīsa; gen.); 'the precious ones of'
يَضَعُهُ: يَضَعُ + ـهُ — waḍaʿa, to put, lay down (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'puts it'
يُحْصِي: يُحْصِي — aḥṣā, to count, number (verb IV, final-weak, imperf. 3ms); 'counts'
عَدَدَهُ: عَدَد + ـهُ — ʿadad, number (m., acc.) + 3ms suffix; 'its number'
فَخُذُوا: فَـ + خُذُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + khudh, take (imperative of akhadha, 2mp); 'so take'
وَأَنْفِقُوهُ: وَ + أَنْفِقُوا + ـهُ — anfaqa, to spend (verb IV, imperative 2mp; with ʿalā, 'spend on') + 3ms object; 'and spend it'
وَخُصُوصًا: وَ + خُصُوصًا — khuṣūṣan, especially (adverbial acc. of khuṣūṣ); 'and especially'
بِضَاعَتَهُمْ: بِضَاعَة + ـهُمْ — biḍāʿa, merchandise, goods (f., acc.) + 3mp suffix; 'their goods'
كَلَّمَتْهُمْ: كَلَّمَتْ + ـهُمْ — kallama, to speak to (verb II, perf. 3fs) + 3mp object; 'spoke to them'
لِكَرَامَةٍ: لِـ + كَرَامَة — li-, by virtue of, because of (prep. of cause) + karāma, a saint's miracle, mark of divine favour (f., gen. indef.); 'by a miracle'
أَكْرَمَنِى: أَكْرَمَ + ـنِى — akrama, to honour (verb IV, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for the gift) + 1cs object (yāʾ printed undotted); 'honoured me'
الْبَطْرِيقَ: الـ + بَطْرِيق — baṭrīq, patrician (m., acc.); here the print's word for the monk; 'the patrician'
عَاقَبُوهُ: عَاقَبُوا + ـهُ — ʿāqaba, to punish (verb III, perf. 3mp) + 3ms object; 'they punished him'
فَدَلَّهُمْ: فَـ + دَلَّ + ـهُمْ — fa-, and so + dalla, to guide, show (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā) + 3mp object; 'and he showed them'
سَبِيلٌ: سَبِيل — sabīl, way, course (m./f., nom. indef.); 'a way'
الْهَرَبَ: الـ + هَرَب — harab, flight (m., acc. after illā); 'flight'
وَيَلْحَقُهَا: وَ + يَلْحَقُ + ـهَا — laḥiqa, to follow, catch up with (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and follows her'
تُشَاهِدُوا: تُشَاهِدُوا — shāhada, to witness, see with one's own eyes (verb III, subjunctive 2mp after an); 'you witness'
فَخُذُونِي: فَـ + خُذُوا + ـنِي — fa-, then (introducing the apodosis) + khudh, take (imperative 2mp) + 1cs object; 'then take me'
إِلَيْكُمُ: إِلَى + ـكُمُ — ilā, to (prep.) + 2mp suffix (-kumu before the article); 'to you'
وَخِزَانَةَ: وَ + خِزَانَة — khizāna, treasury, treasure-house (f., acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'and the treasury of'
دَقْيَانُوسَ: دَقْيَانُوس — Daqyānūs (proper name, diptote, gen. in -a, in apposition); 'Daqyānūs'
رَأَيْتُهُمْ: رَأَيْتُ + ـهُمْ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3mp object; 'I have seen them'
يُخْرِجُونَ: يُخْرِجُونَ — akhraja, to bring out (verb IV, imperf. 3mp); 'bringing out'
حَسْرَتَاهُ: حَسْرَة + ـَاهْ — ḥasra, grief, regret (f.) + -āh, lament ending (printed apart from wā); 'alas, my grief'
قِرَاءَةِ: قِرَاءَة — qirāʾa, reading, recitation (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'the reciting of'
فَادْخُلُوا: فَـ + ادْخُلُوا — fa-, then (introducing the answer of the condition) + dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperative 2mp); 'then enter'
وَاكْمُنُوا: وَ + اكْمُنُوا — wa-, and + kamana, to lie hidden, lie in ambush (verb I, imperative 2mp); 'and lie in wait'
فَخُذُوهَا: فَـ + خُذُوا + ـهَا — fa-, then + akhadha, to take (verb I, imperative 2mp) + -hā, her; 'then take her'
يُصَدِّقْهَا: صَدَّقَ + ـهَا — ṣaddaqa, to believe (verb II, imperf. 3ms, jussive after لَمْ) + -hā, her; 'he (did not) believe her'
يَتَحَدَّثَ: تَحَدَّثَ — taḥaddatha, to talk, speak (verb V, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'to talk'
بَاهِتًا: بَاهِت — bāhit, dumbfounded, bewildered (active participle of bahita, m., acc. predicate of ṣāra); 'dumbfounded'
عَلَامَةُ: عَلَامَة — ʿalāma, sign, mark (f., nom., in construct); 'the sign of'
يُقْبِلَ: أَقْبَلَ — aqbala, to come on, approach (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'he comes'
وَيَنْظُرَ: وَ + يَنْظُرَ — wa-, and + naẓara, to look at, see (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ, taking a direct object); 'and sees'
يَجْسُرُأَنْ: يَجْسُرُ + أَنْ (printed as one word) — jasara, to dare (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative) + an, that (governs the subjunctive); 'he dares to'
الْعَسْكَرَأَنْ: الـ + عَسْكَر + أَنْ (printed as one word) — ʿaskar, army (m., acc., object of amara) + an, that (governs the subjunctive); 'the army to'
صَوْبَ: صَوْب — ṣawba, toward (noun used as preposition, acc.); 'toward'
نَأْخُذَ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 1p, subjunctive after أَنْ; the print has the hamza); 'we take'
وَنَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + نَتَوَجَّهَ — wa-, and + tawajjaha, to head for (verb V, imperf. 1p, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'and we head'
نُحَمِّلَهُمُ: نُحَمِّلَ + ـهُمْ — ḥammala, to load (verb II, imperf. 1p, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hum, them (the mules); 'we load them'
وَالْأَتْرَاكَ: وَ + الـ + أَتْرَاك — wa-, and + atrāk, Turks (pl. of turk, acc.); 'and the Turks'
وَالدَّيْلَمَ: وَ + الـ + دَيْلَم — wa-, and + Daylam, the Daylamites (collective proper name, acc.); 'and the Daylam'
فَارْحَلُوا: فَـ + ارْحَلُوا — fa-, then (answer of إِذَا) + raḥala, to march (verb I, imperative 2mp); 'then march'
تُعْلِمُوا: أَعْلَمَ — aʿlama, to inform, let know (verb IV, imperf. 2mp, jussive after prohibitive لَا); 'let know'
نَلْحَقُكُمْ: نَلْحَقُ + ـكُمْ — laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with (verb I, imperf. 1p) + -kum, you (pl.); 'we will overtake you'
انْتَخَبَ: انْتَخَبَ — intakhaba, to choose, select (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'he chose'
وَانْحَازَ: وَ + انْحَازَ — wa-, and + inḥāza, to draw aside, go apart (verb VII hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and he drew apart'
وَالصَّنَادِيقَ: وَ + الـ + صَنَادِيق — wa-, and + ṣanādīq, chests (pl. of ṣundūq, acc.); 'and the chests'
وَالْمِائَةَ: وَ + الـ + مِائَة — miʾa, hundred (f.), acc.; 'and the hundred' (the alif after mīm is not pronounced)
خَيَّالٍ: خَيَّال — khayyāl, rider, horseman (m.), gen. indef. after miʾa; 'horsemen'
وَصَفَتْهُ: وَصَفَتْ + ـهُ — waṣafat, she described (verb I waṣafa, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she described it'
يَظُنُّونَ: yaẓunnūna, they think, suppose (verb I ẓanna, imperf. 3mp)
وَضَوْءَ: وَ + ضَوْء — wa-, and + ḍawʾ, acc.; 'and Ḍawʾ (al-Makān)'
أَقَامُو: aqāmū, they stayed, remained (verb IV aqāma, perf. 3mp); printed without the final silent alif (Classical أقاموا)
وَاسْتَأْذَنَهَا: وَ + اسْتَأْذَنَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + istaʾdhana, he asked leave of (verb X of adhina, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he asked her leave' (singular as printed, among plurals)
وَأَمَرَتْهُمْ: وَ + أَمَرَتْ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + amarat, she commanded (verb I amara, perf. 3fs) + -hum, them; 'and she commanded them'
شَاءَتْ: shāʾat, she wished, willed (verb I shāʾa, perf. 3fs)
وَخُذُوا: وَ + خُذُوا — wa-, and + khudhū, take! (verb I akhadha, imperative 2mp)
فَأَطَاعُوهَا: فَـ + أَطَاعُوا + ـهَا — fa-, and so + aṭāʿū, they obeyed (verb IV aṭāʿa, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they obeyed her'
وَتَرَكُوا: وَ + تَرَكُوا — wa-, and + tarakū, they left (verb I taraka, perf. 3mp)
سَفْحِ: سَفْح — safḥ, foot, lower slope (of a mountain) (m.), gen., first term of a construct; 'the foot of'
فَرَحِهَا: فَرَح + ـهَا — faraḥ, joy (m.), gen. + -hā, her; 'her joy'
قَوَّي: qawwā, he strengthened (verb II of qawiya, perf. 3ms); printed with final yāʾ for alif maqṣūra
الطَّيْرِ: الـ + طَيْر — al-, the + ṭayr, birds (m. collective; gen.); 'the birds'
تُخْبِرُهُ: تُخْبِرُ + ـهُ — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'informing him' (circumstantial)
تُنَفِّذَلِي: تُنَفِّذَ + لِـ + ي — naffadha, to dispatch, send off (verb II, impf. 2ms subjunctive after an) + li-, to (prep.; marks the one the troops are sent to) + -ī, me; printed as one word; 'that you send to me'
سَيْرُهُمْ: سَيْر + ـهُمْ — sayr, going, march (m., nom., subject of yakūnu) + -hum, their; 'their march'
وَيَأْتُونَ: وَ + يَأْتُونَ — wa-, and + atā, to come (verb I, impf. 3mp indicative; the precomposed hamza is the print's); 'and they come'
وَيَكْمُنُونَ: وَ + يَكْمُنُونَ — wa-, and + kamana, to lie hidden, lie in ambush (verb I, impf. 3mp indicative); 'and they lie in ambush'
خَدَعْتُهُمَا: خَدَعْتُ + ـهُمَا — khadaʿa, to deceive, trick (verb I, perf. 1s) + -humā, the two of them; 'I have tricked the two of them'
الصُّلْبَانَ: الـ + صُلْبَان — al-, the + ṣulbān, crosses (pl. of ṣalīb, acc. as object); 'the crosses'
الرَّاهِبِ: الـ + رَاهِب — rāhib, monk (m., gen.); 'the monk'
تَتِمُّ: تَتِمُّ — tamma, to be completed, come off (verb I doubled, impf. 3fs); 'it is completed'
تَمَّتِ: تَمَّتِ — tamma, to be complete (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs; -i helping vowel before al-); 'is complete'
لِأَهْلِ: لِـ + أَهْل — li-, for (prep.; for whose sake the ransom is given) + ahl, people, folk (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'for the people of'
وَالشُّكْرُ: وَ + الـ + شُكْر — wa-, and + shukr, thanks, gratitude (m., nom., subject); 'and thanks'
وَآخِرًا: وَ + آخِرًا — wa-, and + ākhir, last (acc. adverb; the print has the madda); 'and last'
الْكِتَابُ: الـ + كِتَاب — kitāb, letter, book (m., nom.); 'the letter'
بَرَّاجُ: بَرَّاج — barrāj, keeper of a pigeon-tower (from burj, tower; m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the keeper of'
بِالْوَرَقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + وَرَقَة — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi-, 'bring') + waraqa, leaf, sheet of paper, note (f., gen.); 'brought the paper'
نَفَّذَ: نَفَّذَ — naffadha, to dispatch, send off (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he dispatched'
بِفَرَسٍ: بِـ + فَرَس — bi-, with (prep.; jahhaza bi-, 'equip with') + faras, horse (gen. indef.); 'with a horse'
وَهَجِينٍ: وَ + هَجِين — wa-, and + hajīn, swift riding camel, dromedary (m., gen. indef.); 'and a riding camel'
وَبَغْلٍ: وَ + بَغْل — wa-, and + baghl, mule (m., gen. indef.); 'and a mule'
وَزَادٍ: وَ + زَاد — wa-, and + zād, provisions for a journey (m., gen. indef.); 'and provisions'
وَأَمَرَهُمْ: وَ + أَمَرَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3ms; the precomposed hamza is the print's) + -hum, them; 'and he ordered them'
الْبُرْجِ: الـ + بُرْج — burj, tower (m., gen. after إِلَى); 'the tower'
كَمَنُوا: كَمَنُوا — kamana, to lie hidden, lie in ambush (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they lay in ambush'
وَالْعَسْكَرِ: وَ + الـ + عَسْكَر — ʿaskar, troop, army (m., gen.); 'and the troop'
دَخَلُوهُ: دَخَلُوا + ـهُ — dakhala, to enter (perf. 3 m. pl.) + it (obj.); 'they entered it'
فَرَأَوُا: فَـ + رَأَوْا — raʾā, to see (perf. 3 m. pl.; the final -u joins the next word); 'and they saw'
الرَّاهِبَ: الـ + رَاهِب — rāhib, monk (m., acc.); 'the monk'
لِيَنْظُرَ: لِـ + يَنْظُرَ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + naẓara, to look (impf. subj. 3 m. sg.); 'to look at'
اقْتُلُوا: اُقْتُلُوا — qatala, to kill (imperative m. pl.); 'kill!'
الْحُتُوفِ: الـ + حُتُوف — ḥutūf, deaths (pl. of ḥatf, death; gen.); 'the deaths'
