النُّذُورِ: الـ + نُذُور — nudhūr, vows, votive offerings (pl. of nadhr; gen.); 'the votive offerings'
وَبَعْدَأَنْ: وَ + بَعْدَ + أَنْ — baʿda, after + an, that (printed as one word); 'and after'
وَضَعُوهُ: وَضَعُوا + ـهُ — waḍaʿa, to put, place (perf. 3 m. pl.) + it (obj.); 'they put it'
تَحْضُرْ: تَحْضُرْ — ḥaḍara, to come, be present (impf. juss. 3 f. sg., after لَمْ); 'she (did not) come'
لَاهِيَ: لَا + هِيَ — lā, not, neither + hiya, she (printed as one word); 'neither she'
انْتِظَارِهَا: انْتِظَار + ـهَا — intiẓār, waiting (verbal noun of form VIII intaẓara; gen.) + her; 'waiting for her'
النَّهَارَ: الـ + نَهَار — nahār, day, daytime (m., acc. of time); 'the day'
حَالُهُمْ: حَال + ـهُمْ — ḥāl, state, condition (nom.) + their; 'their state'
نَظُنُّ: نَظُنُّ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (impf. 1 pl.); 'we think'
تَمَاثِيلَ: تَمَاثِيل — Tamāthīl, the patrician's daughter (proper name, diptote; acc. after أَنَّ); 'Tamāthīl'
لِعَسْكَرِ: لِـ + عَسْكَر — li-, to (the one affected: what befalls someone, after جَرَى; what is left to someone, after بَقِيَ) + ʿaskar, army (gen.); 'to the army of'
نَقْنَعُ: نَقْنَعُ — qaniʿa, to be content (impf. indic. 1 pl.; with بِـ, content with); 'we are content'
يَسَّرَهُ: يَسَّرَ + ـهُ — yassara, to make easy, grant (perf. 3 m. sg., form II) + it (obj.); 'He granted it'
وَنَتَوَجَّهُ: وَ + نَتَوَجَّهُ — tawajjaha, to set out, turn toward (impf. 1 pl., form V); 'and we set out'
يُعِينُنَا: يُعِينُ + ـنَا — aʿāna, to help (impf. 3 m. sg., form IV) + us (obj.); 'He helps us'
أَمْكَنَ: أَمْكَنَ — amkana, to be possible for (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV; the person in the acc.); 'it was possible for'
تَتَعَرَّضَ: تَتَعَرَّضَ — taʿarraḍa, to oppose, get in the way of (impf. subj. 3 f. sg., form V; with لِـ of the person); 'that she oppose'
التَّفَطُّنِ: الـ + تَفَطُّن — tafaṭṭun, perceiving, seeing through (verbal noun of form V; gen.; with بِـ, awareness of); 'the being found out'
سَارُوا: سَارُوا — sāra, to journey, travel (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they journeyed'
الشِّعْبِ: الـ + شِعْب — shiʿb, mountain pass, ravine (m., gen.); 'the pass'
أَكْمَنَتْ: أَكْمَنَتْ — akmana, to set in ambush, hide (perf. 3 f. sg., form IV of kamana); 'she had set in ambush'
رَأَوْهُمْ: رَأَوْا + ـهُمْ — raʾā, to see (perf. 3 m. pl.) + them (obj.); 'they saw them'
وَأَشْرَعُوا: وَ + أَشْرَعُوا — ashraʿa, to level, point (a lance) (perf. 3 m. pl., form IV); 'and they levelled'
نَحْوَهُمُ: نَحْوَ + ـهُمُ — naḥwa, toward (prep.) + them (final -u joins the next word); 'toward them'
وَجَرَّدُوا: وَ + جَرَّدُوا — jarrada, to bare, draw (a sword) (perf. 3 m. pl., form II); 'and they drew'
بِيضَ: بِيض — bīḍ, white ones (pl. of abyaḍ; acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the white (blades) of'
بِكَلِمَةِ: بِـ + كَلِمَة — bi-, with (after نَادَى, 'call out with'), or marking what is proclaimed (after أَعْلَنَ بِـ, 'proclaim') + kalima, word (f., gen.); 'with the word of', 'proclaimed the word of'
وَفَوَّقُوا: وَ + فَوَّقُوا — fawwaqa, to nock an arrow, fit its notch to the string (perf. 3 m. pl., form II); 'and they nocked'
شَرِّهِمْ: شَرّ + ـهِمْ — sharr, evil, malice (m., gen.) + their; 'their evil'
أَعْلَمَ: aʿlama — to inform, let know (v. IV of ʿalima, perf. 3ms); with bi- of the thing made known; 'informed'
وَالرَّمْيِ: وَ + الـ + رَمْي — ramy, shooting, throwing (verbal noun of ramā; gen.); 'and the shooting'
بِالسِّهَامِ: بِـ + الـ + سِهَام — bi-, with (instrument) + sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm; gen.); 'with arrows'
فَشُدُّوا: فَـ + شُدُّوا — shadda, to tighten, bind fast (v. I doubled, impv. 2mp); 'so bind tight'
عَزْمَكُمْ: عَزْم + كُمْ — ʿazm, resolve, determination (m., acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your resolve'
وَقَوُّوا: وَ + قَوُّوا — qawwā, to strengthen (v. II of qawiya, impv. 2mp); the print marks the shadda; 'and strengthen'
نُفُوسَكُمْ: نُفُوس + كُمْ — nufūs, souls, selves (pl. of nafs; acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your souls'
الشِّعْبَ: الـ + شِعْب — shiʿb, mountain pass, ravine (m., acc.); 'the pass'
الدَّرْبِ: الـ + دَرْب — darb, lane, street of a town quarter closed by gates (m., gen.)
بَابَانِ: bābān — two gates (dual of bāb, gate, door; nom.)
أَفْنَيْتُهُمْ: أَفْنَيْتُ + هُمْ — afnā, to annihilate, wipe out (v. IV of faniya, perf. 1s) + -hum, them; 'I annihilated them'
لَأَخَذْنَا: لَـ + أَخَذْنَا — la-, then (particle introducing the answer of law) + akhadha, to take (perf. 1p); 'we would have taken'
الضَّيِّقِ: الـ + ضَيِّق — ḍayyiq, narrow (adj., m., gen.); 'the narrow'
تُفِيدُنَا: تُفِيدُ + نَا — afāda, to avail, benefit (v. IV hollow, impf. 3fs) + -nā, us; 'they avail us'
وَضِيقَهُ: وَ + ضِيق + هُ — ḍīq, narrowness (m., acc.) + -hu, its; 'and its narrowness'
غَزَوْتُ: ghazā, to raid, campaign against unbelievers (v. I defective, perf. 1s); 'I campaigned'
حَاصَرْنَا: ḥāṣara, to besiege (v. III, perf. 1p); 'we besieged'
أَبْرَدُ: abrad — colder (elative of bārid, cold; nom.)
الثَّلْجِ: الـ + ثَلْج — thalj, snow, ice (m., gen.)
فَانْهَضُوا: فَـ + انْهَضُوا — nahaḍa, to rise, set off (v. I, impv. 2mp); 'so rise'
لِنَخْرُجَ: لِـ + نَخْرُجَ — li-, so that (with the subjunctive) + kharaja, to go out (impf. subj. 1p); 'that we may go out'
يَكْثُرَ: kathura, to grow many, multiply (v. I, impf. subj. 3ms); 'grow many'
وَيَسْبِقُونَا: وَ + يَسْبِقُوا + نَا — sabaqa, to outstrip, get ahead of (v. I, impf. subj. 3mp, still under an) + -nā, us; the alif of -ū drops before the suffix; 'and outstrip us'
فَيَرْمُو: فَـ + يَرْمُو — fa-, and so + ramā, to throw, shoot (v. I defective, impf. subj. 3mp); printed without the silent final alif (يرموا); 'and so throw'
الْحِجَارَةَ: الـ + حِجَارَة — ḥijāra, stones (pl. of ḥajar; acc.)
نَمْلِكْ: malaka, to possess, have power over (v. I, jussive 1p); 'we gain, have power'
أَرَبًا: arab — need, aim, object; hence advantage (m., acc. indef.)
الْإِسْرَاعِ: الـ + إِسْرَاع — isrāʿ, hastening (verbal noun of asraʿa, v. IV; gen.)
بِعْتُمْ: bāʿa, to sell (v. I hollow, perf. 2mp); 'you have sold'
مَكَثْتُ: makatha, to stay, remain (v. I, perf. 1s); 'I remained'
مَسْجُونًا: masjūn — imprisoned (pass. part. of sajana; acc. indef., circumstantial)
أَعْتَرِضْ: iʿtaraḍa, to object, take issue (v. VIII, jussive 1s after lam); with ʿalā 'object to'
فَقَاتِلُوا: فَـ + قَاتِلُوا — qātala, to fight (v. III, impv. 2mp); 'so fight'
فَالْجَنَّةُ: فَـ + الـ + جَنَّة — fa-, then (introducing the answer of a condition) + janna, garden, Paradise (f., nom.); 'then Paradise'
مَأْوَاهُ: مَأْوَى + هُ — maʾwā, refuge, abode, shelter (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his refuge' (corrected from the print's ماواة)
فَإِلَى: فَـ + إِلَى — fa-, then (introducing the answer of a condition) + ilā, to (prep.); 'then to'
الشَّرَفِ: الـ + شَرَف — sharaf, honour, glory (m., gen.)
مَسْعَاهُ: مَسْعَى + هُ — masʿā, course, striving, way one goes (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his course' (corrected from the print's مسعاة)
وَثَبَتُوا: وَ + ثَبَتُوا — thabata, to stand firm (v. I, perf. 3mp); 'and they stood firm'
هَجَمَتْ: hajama, to rush, fall upon (v. I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with a collective); with ʿalā 'attack'
أَعْنَاقِهِمُ: أَعْنَاق + ـهِمْ — aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq; gen. after fī) + -him, their (final -u for the joining vowel); 'their necks'
كَأْسُ: كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the cup of'
أَدَاءِ: أَدَاء — adāʾ, delivery, discharge, performance (verbal noun of IV addā; m., gen. after fī); 'the delivering of' (possibly a slip for الأعداء, 'the enemies')
وَالنِّصَالِ: وَ + الـ + نِصَال — niṣāl, blades, arrowheads (pl. of naṣl; gen.); 'and the blades'
وَيُجَنْدِلُ: وَ + يُجَنْدِلُ — jandala, throw to the ground, fell (quadriliteral verb, imperf. 3ms); 'and he fells'
الْأَبْطَالَ: الـ + أَبْطَال — abṭāl, champions, heroes (pl. of baṭal; acc.); 'the champions'
وَعَشَرَةً: وَ + عَشَرَة — ʿashara, ten (with a masc. counted noun; acc. of manner, repeated: 'ten by ten'); 'and ten'
أَفْنَى: أَفْنَى — afnā, annihilate, wipe out (verb IV of faniya, perf. 3ms); 'he wiped out'
عَدَدًا: عَدَد — ʿadad, number (m., acc. indef.); 'a number'
وَجُمَلًا: وَ + جُمَل — jumal, sums, totals (pl. of jumla; acc. indef.); 'and sums'
تُسْتَقْصَى: تُسْتَقْصَى — istaqṣā, reckon out to the end, count exhaustively (verb X, imperf. passive 3fs); 'they are (not) to be reckoned out'
وَتُقَوِّيهِمْ: وَ + تُقَوِّي + ـهِمْ — qawwā, strengthen, encourage (verb II, imperf. 3fs) + -him, them; 'and she strengthens them'
يَهْرُبُ: يَهْرُبُ — haraba, flee (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'he flees'
تُومِي: تُومِي — awmaʾa, make a sign, beckon (verb IV, imperf. 3fs; Middle Arabic for Classical تُومِئُ, hamza dropped); 'she signals'
فَيَمِيلُونَ: فَـ + يَمِيلُونَ — fa-, so + māla, incline, turn (verb I, imperf. 3mp); 'so they turn'
فِرْقَةً: فِرْقَة — firqa, band, troop, party (f., acc. indef., adverbial); 'band (after band)'
فِرْقَةٍ: فِرْقَة — firqa, band, troop, party (f., gen. indef.); 'a band'
وَيَهْزِمُهَا: وَ + يَهْزِمُ + ـهَا — hazama, rout, put to flight (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he routs it'
وَتَأْتِي: وَ + تَأْتِي — atā, come (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'and there comes'
حَامِلَةً: حَامِلَة — ḥāmila, charging (act. part. f. of ḥamala, with ʿalā 'charge upon'; acc. of state); 'charging'
فَيَرُدُّهَا: فَـ + يَرُدُّ + ـهَا — fa-, so + radda, turn back, repel (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'and he drives it back'
أَعْقَابِهَا: أَعْقَاب + ـهَا — aʿqāb, heels (pl. of ʿaqib; gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, its (f.); 'its heels'
نَصْرَهُ: نَصْر + ـهُ — naṣr, victory, help (m., acc. after anna) + -hu, his; 'his victory'
عِنَايَتِهِ: عِنَايَة + ـهِ — ʿināya, care, providence, solicitude (f., gen.) + -hi, His; 'His care'
عَزْمِي: عَزْم + ـِي — ʿazm, resolve, determination (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my resolve'
بِخَالِصِ: بِـ + خَالِص — bi-, by, through (prep., cause) + khāliṣ, pure, sincere (gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the purity of'
يَخَافُونَنِي: يَخَافُونَ + ـنِي — khāfa, fear (verb I, imperf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'they fear me'
يَسْتَطِيعُونَ: يَسْتَطِيعُونَ — istaṭāʿa, be able (verb X, imperf. 3mp); 'they are able'
الْإِقْدَامَ: الـ + إِقْدَام — iqdām, venturing, daring advance (verbal noun of IV aqdama; m., acc.); with ʿalā, 'the advancing upon'
يُوَلُّونَ: يُوَلُّونَ — wallā, turn (verb II, imperf. 3mp); with al-adbār, 'they turn their backs, flee'
وَيَرْكَنُونَ: وَ + يَرْكَنُونَ — rakana, lean, incline, resort (verb I, imperf. 3mp; with ilā); 'and they resort (to)'
قَاتَلُوا: قَاتَلُوا — qātala, fight (verb III, perf. 3mp); 'they fought'
يَوْمِهِمْ: يَوْم + ـهِمْ — yawm, day (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'their day'
الشِّعْبِ: الـ + شِعْب — shiʿb, mountain pass, ravine, defile (m., gen.); 'the pass'
الْوَبَالِ: الـ + وَبَال — wabāl, ruinous misfortune, calamity, ruin (m., gen., after min or as second term of an iḍāfa: kaʾs al-wabāl, 'the cup of ruin'); 'the calamity'
وَرَمْيِ: وَ + رَمْي — ramy, throwing, hurling (verbal noun of ramā; m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the hurling of'
الْحِجَارَةِ: الـ + حِجَارَة — ḥijāra, stones (pl. of ḥajar; gen.); 'the stones'
فَتَّشُوا: فَتَّشُوا — fattasha, search (verb II, perf. 3mp; here with ʿalā, 'search for'); 'they searched'
يَرَوْا: يَرَوْا — raʾā, see (verb I, jussive 3mp after lam); '(did not) see'
اسْتُشْهِدَ: اسْتُشْهِدَ — ustushhida, be martyred, die as a witness for the faith (verb X, perf. passive 3ms); 'he has been martyred'
يُقَوِّى: يُقَوِّى — qawwā, strengthen, hearten (verb II, imperf. 3ms; printed with final ى for ي); 'strengthening'
بِالْإِشَارَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + إِشَارَات — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + ishārāt, signs, gestures (pl. of ishāra; gen.); 'with the gestures'
الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ: الـ + رَبَّانِيَّة — rabbānī, of the Lord, divine (relative adj. from rabb; f., agreeing with ishārāt; gen.); 'divine'
وَيُعِيذُهُمْ: وَ + يُعِيذُ + ـهُمْ — aʿādha, commit to (God's) refuge, protect by a charm or prayer (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -hum, them; 'and he commits them to God's protection'
بِالْآيَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + آيَات — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + āyāt, verses (of the Qurʾān), signs (pl. of āya; gen.); 'with the verses'
الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ: الـ + رَحْمَانِيَّة — raḥmānī, of the All-Merciful (relative adj. from al-raḥmān, God; f., agreeing with āyāt; gen.); 'of the Merciful'
بِالْمَلْعُونَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مَلْعُونَة — bi- after wa-idhā of surprise, only marking what appears + malʿūna, accursed woman (f., gen.); 'behold, the accursed woman'
الْبِطْرِيقِ: الـ + بِطْرِيق — biṭrīq, patrician, Byzantine commander (from Greek patrikios; m., gen.); 'the patrician'
الرَّئِيسِ: الـ + رَئِيس — raʾīs, chief, commander (m., gen., in apposition); 'the chief'
وَشَيْطَانًا: وَ + شَيْطَان — shayṭān, devil (m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'and a devil'
مَرِيدًا: مَرِيد — marīd, rebellious, insolent (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'rebellious'
الْأَتْرَاكِ: الـ + أَتْرَاك — atrāk, Turks (pl. of turk; gen. after min, or as second term of a construct, muqaddamu al-atrāki, 'commander of the Turks'); 'the Turks'
بِسَهْمٍ: بِـ + سَهْم — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + sahm, arrow (m., gen. indef.); 'with an arrow'
فَعَجَّلَ: فَـ + عَجَّلَ — fa-, and so + ʿajjala, hasten, speed on (verb II, perf. 3ms; with bi- for what is sent); 'and (God) hastened'
الْمُسْلِمُ: الـ + مُسْلِم — muslim, Muslim (m., nom.); 'the Muslim'
بِصَاحِبِهِمْ: بِـ + صَاحِب + ـهِمْ — bi-, to (with faʿala 'do to') + ṣāḥib, companion, master (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'to their master'
مَالُوا: مَالُوا — māla, lean, incline; with ʿalā, 'turn upon, fall upon' (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they fell upon'
بِكُلِّيَّتِهِمْ: بِـ + كُلِّيَّة + ـهِمْ — bi-, with (prep., manner) + kulliyya, entirety, the whole (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'with all of themselves, en masse'
وَأَوْصَلُوا: وَ + أَوْصَلُوا — awṣala, cause to reach, deliver (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they made (harm) reach'
وَقَطَّعُوهُ: وَ + قَطَّعُوا + ـهُ — qaṭṭaʿa, cut to pieces (verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they hacked him to pieces'
وَأَلْقَتْهَا: وَ + أَلْقَتْ + ـهَا — alqā, throw, cast down (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it (f., referring to raʾs); 'and she threw it'
وَالْمَلِكِ: وَ + الـ + مَلِك — malik, king (m., gen., coordinated after bayna yaday); 'and the king'
وَرُؤْيَتِكَ: وَ + رُؤْيَة + ـكَ — ruʾya, seeing, sight (f., gen.) + -ka, you (m.); 'and the seeing of you'
الْمُجَاهِدُ: الـ + مُجَاهِد — mujāhid, one who strives in holy war (act. part. of III jāhada; m., nom.); 'the striver, warrior for the faith'
أَرْمِي: أَرْمِي — ramā, throw, hurl (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'I throw'
يَهَابُونَنِي: يَهَابُونَ + ـنِي — hāba, dread, stand in awe of (verb I, imperf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'they stand in awe of me'
انْفَصَلْتُمْ: انْفَصَلْتُمْ — infaṣala, separate, draw apart (verb VII, perf. 2mp); 'you separated'
أَخَذَتْنِى: أَخَذَتْ + ـنِى — akhadha, take, seize (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (printed with final ى); 'it seized me'
وَهَجَمْتُ: وَ + هَجَمْتُ — hajama, fall upon, attack (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ʿalā); 'and I fell upon'
رَئِيسِهِمْ: رَئِيس + ـهِمْ — raʾīs, chief (m., gen., in apposition) + -him, their; 'their chief'
يُعَدُّ: يُعَدُّ — ʿadda, count, reckon (verb I, imperf. passive 3ms); with bi-, 'he is reckoned at (the worth of)'
أَطَحْتُ: أَطَحْتُ — aṭāḥa, make fall, send flying (verb IV of ṭāḥa, perf. 1cs); 'I sent flying'
يَدْنُوَ: يَدْنُوَ — danā, draw near (verb I, imperf. subj. 3ms after an); 'that he come near'
اللَّعِينَةَ: الـ + لَعِينَة — laʿīna, accursed (f.; fem. of laʿīn), here used as a noun, acc. after anna; 'the accursed woman'
كَافِرٍ: kāfir — unbeliever, infidel (m., gen. sg. indef., the counted noun after alf); 'twenty thousand infidels'
حَالَكُمْ: حَال + كُمْ — ḥāl, state, condition (acc., object of raʾaytu) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your state'
فَأَطَحْتُ: فَـ + أَطَحْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aṭāḥa, to make fall, send flying (verb IV hollow, perf. 1cs; aṭāḥa raʾsahu 'struck off his head'); 'and so I sent flying'
لِتَقْوَى: لِـ + تَقْوَى — li-, so that (governs the subjunctive) + qawiya, to be strong (verb I, imperf. 3fs subj.); 'so that (they) may grow strong'
نُفُوسُكُمْ: نُفُوس + كُمْ — nufūs, souls, spirits (pl. of nafs, f., nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your souls'
وَتُرْضُوا: وَ + تُرْضُوا — wa-, and + arḍā, to satisfy, please (verb IV, imperf. 2mp subj., still governed by the li- 'so that'); 'and that you may please'
بِسُيُوفِكُمْ: بِـ + سُيُوف + كُمْ — bi-, with (instrument) + suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, gen.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'with your swords'
أَشْغَلَكُمْ: أَشْغَلَ + كُمْ — shaghala, to occupy, keep busy (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj. after an) + -kum, you (pl.); 'that I keep you busy'
وَأَذْهَبَ: وَ + أَذْهَبَ — wa-, and + dhahaba, to go (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj., coordinated under an); 'and (that) I go'
عَسْكَرِكُمْ: عَسْكَر + كُمْ — ʿaskar, army, host (m., gen. after ilā) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your army'
وَآتِيَكُمْ: وَ + آتِيَ + كُمْ — wa-, and + atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj., under an; ʾaʾtiya written with alif-madda, as printed) + -kum, you (pl.); with bi-, 'bring': 'and (that) I bring you'
يُهْلِكُونَ: yuhlikūna — ahlaka, to destroy, cause to perish (verb IV, imperf. 3mp indic.); 'who will destroy'
الْكَفَرَةَ: الـ + كَفَرَة — kafara, unbelievers (pl. of kāfir, acc.); 'the unbelievers'
وَالْوَادِي: وَ + الـ + وَادِي — wa-, and/while (introducing a circumstantial clause) + wādī, valley, wadi (m., nom.); 'while the valley'
بِالْكُفَّارِ: بِـ + الـ + كُفَّار — kuffār, infidels (pl. of kāfir, gen.); bi- here either says what fills or blocks a place (masdūd bi-al-kuffār, 'blocked with the infidels') or, after wa-idhā of surprise, only marks what suddenly appears ('and behold, the infidels'); after aḥāṭa, 'surround', the verb chooses the bi-, which marks what is surrounded ('surrounded the infidels')
يَسْتُرُنِي: يَسْتُرُ + نِي — satara, to veil, hide, cover (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he hides me'
أَعْيُنِهِمْ: أَعْيُن + هِمْ — aʿyun, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, gen. after ʿan) + -him, their; 'their eyes'
يَرَوْنِي: يَرَوْ(نَ) + نِي — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3mp, yarawna) + -nī, me (the two nūns merge); 'they see me'
فَانِيًا: fāniyan — fānin, passing away, extinguished (act. part. of faniya; m., acc. predicate of akūnu); fānin fī allāh, the Sufi 'passed away (from self) in God'
عِدَاةً: ʿidātan — enemies (pl. akin to ʿidan / ʿudāt, from ʿadā 'to be hostile'; acc. indef., object of yuqātilu); the print marks the kasra; form doubtful, perhaps for عِدَاهُ or عِدَاتِي; 'enemies'
شَاهَدْتُ: shāhadtu — shāhada, to witness, see with one's own eyes (verb III, perf. 1cs); 'I witnessed'
تَقْدِرُأَنْ: تَقْدِرُ + أَنْ (printed as one word) — qadara, to be able (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic.) + an, to (governs the subjunctive); 'you are able to'
أَجْوَدَ: ajwada — ajwad, better, best (elative of jayyid; diptote, acc. predicate of yakūnu); 'better'
تُرِيدُأَنْ: تُرِيدُ + أَنْ (printed as one word) — arāda, to want (verb IV hollow, imperf. 2ms indic.) + an, to (governs the subjunctive); 'you want to'
أَخَذْنَاهُ: أَخَذْنَا + هُ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 1cp, here in the answer of a condition) + -hu, him; 'we (will) take him' Also plain past, the -hu pointing back to a relative: alladhī akhadhnāhu, 'what we took'.
الْوَلِيِّ: الـ + وَلِيّ — walī, friend (of God), saint (m., gen.); 'the saint'
يَسْتُرُ: yasturu — satara, to veil, hide, cover (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'it hides'
وَخَلَصَ: وَ + خَلَصَ — wa-, and + khalaṣa, to get free, escape (verb I, perf. 3ms; min, 'from'); 'and gets free'
الضِّيقِ: الـ + ضِيق — ḍīq, narrowness, strait, distress (m., gen.); 'the strait'
حِصْنُ: ḥiṣn — fortress, stronghold (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the fortress of'
وَسَيْفُ: وَ + سَيْف — wa-, and + sayf, sword (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the sword of'
فَلْيَأْخُذْ: فَـ + لْـ + يَأْخُذْ — fa-, then (answering in shāʾa) + li-, let (lām of command; vowelless after fa-) + akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive); 'then let him take'
يَخْتَارُ: yakhtāru — ikhtāra, to choose (verb VIII hollow, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'he chooses'
إِعَانَةً: iʿānatan — iʿāna, help, aid (verbal noun of aʿāna, verb IV; acc. of purpose, indef.); 'as an aid'
فَاصْطَلَحُوا: فَـ + اصْطَلَحُوا — fa-, and so + iṣṭalaḥa, to come to terms, agree together (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'so they came to terms'
وَاتَّفَقُوا: وَ + اتَّفَقُوا — wa-, and + ittafaqa, to agree (verb VIII, perf. 3mp; ʿalā, 'on'); 'and they agreed'
أَمْهِلُونِي: أَمْهِلُوا + نِي — amhala, to grant respite, give time (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + -nī, me; 'give me time'
قَبْلَكُمْ: قَبْلَ + كُمْ — qabla, before (adv. of time/place) + -kum, you (pl.); 'ahead of you'
نِيَامٌ: niyām — sleeping, asleep (pl. of nāʾim, nom. indef.); 'asleep'
يَقْظَانُونَ: yaqẓānūna — awake (Middle Arabic sound m. pl. of yaqẓān, nom.; Classical plural yaqāẓā); 'awake'
نَخْرُجُ: nakhruju — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 1cp indic.); 'we go out'
وَنُسَلِّمُ: وَ + نُسَلِّمُ — wa-, and + sallama, to hand over, commit (verb II, imperf. 1cp indic.; li-, 'to'); 'and we commit'
أَمْرَنَا: أَمْر + نَا — amr, affair, matter (m., acc.) + -nā, our; 'our affair'
طَاوَعْتُكُمْ: طَاوَعْتُ + كُمْ — ṭāwaʿa, to comply with, obey (verb III, perf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I comply with you'
تَلُومُونِي: تَلُومُوا + نِي — lāma, to blame (verb I hollow, imperf. 2mp jussive after prohibitive lā) + -nī, me; 'do not blame me'
وَلُومُوا: وَ + لُومُوا — wa-, and + lāma, to blame (verb I hollow, imperative 2mp); 'and blame'
تُمْهِلُونِي: تُمْهِلُوا + نِي — amhala, to give time (verb IV, imperf. 2mp subj. after an) + -nī, me; 'that you give me time'
أَكْشِفَ: akshifa — kashafa, to uncover, find out (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj. after ḥattā); 'that I find out'
تُبْطِئْ: tubṭiʾ — abṭaʾa, to be slow, tarry (verb IV, imperf. 2ms jussive after prohibitive lā; ʿalā, 'in coming back to'); 'do not be slow'
نَنْتَظِرُكَ: نَنْتَظِرُ + كَ — intaẓara, to wait for (verb VIII, imperf. 1cp) + -ka, you (m.); 'we are waiting for you'
حَدَّثَ: ḥaddatha — to talk to, tell (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he talked with'
خُرُوجِهَا: خُرُوج + هَا — khurūj, going out, departure (verbal noun of kharaja, gen.) + -hā, her; 'her going out'
كَرَامَاتٍ: karāmāt — saintly wonders, wonders of grace worked by a saint (pl. of karāma, gen. indef.); 'wonders'
الْجَبَّارَ: الـ + جَبَّار — jabbār, tyrant, overbearing brute (m., acc., adj. agreeing with al-biṭrīqa); 'the tyrant'
الْقَدْرِ: الـ + قَدْر — qadr, measure, amount (m., gen.); 'the measure'
كَرَامَةِ: karāma — saintly power, wonder of a saint (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the saintly wonder of'
كَرَامَاتِ: karāmāt — saintly wonders (pl. of karāma, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wonders of'
بِاللَّعِينَةِ: بِـ + الـ + لَعِينَة — bi-, marking what suddenly appears (after wa-idhā, 'and behold') + laʿīna, accursed woman (gen.); 'the accursed woman'
وَوَعَدَتْهُمْ: وَ + وَعَدَتْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 3fs; the thing promised takes bi-) + -hum, them; 'and she promised them'
وَخِدَاعٌ: وَ + خِدَاع — wa-, and + khidāʿ, deceit, trickery (m., nom. indef.); 'and deceit'
فَأَجَابَهَا: فَـ + أَجَابَ + هَا — fa-, and so + ajāba, to answer (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he answered her'
نَذْهَبَ: nadhhaba — dhahaba, to go (verb I, imperf. 1cp subj. after ḥattā); 'that we go'
أَعْلَمَتِ: aʿlamati — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -i before al-; bi-, 'of'); 'she informed'
عَمِلَتْهَا: عَمِلَتْ + هَا — ʿamila, to do, make (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it (f., resumptive for al-ḥīla); 'which she had made'
يَجْبُرُ: yajburu — jabara, to set (a bone), mend (verb I, imperf. 3ms); jabara khāṭirahu, 'console'; 'mends'
خَاطِرَنَا: خَاطِر + نَا — khāṭir, mind, heart, feelings (m., acc.) + -nā, our; 'our hearts'
نَظِيرِ: naẓīr — counterpart, equivalent (m., gen. after fī); fī naẓīri, 'in return for'
أَفْرَسُ: afrasu — better horseman (elative of fāris, from faruwa 'be skilled in horsemanship'; nom., subject of yakun); 'a better horseman'
لِعَجُوزِ: لِـ + عَجُوز — li-, to (prep., marking the one spoken to after qāla) + ʿajūz, old woman (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'to the old woman of'
أَخْبَرَتْهُمْ: أَخْبَرَتْ + ـهُمْ — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hum, them; 'she informed them'
بِأَنَّهَا: بِـ + أَنَّ + ـهَا — bi-, of (prep.; akhbara bi-, 'inform of', the verb chooses the bi-, which marks what is told) + anna, that + -hā, she; 'that she'
تَذْهَبُ: تَذْهَبُ — dhahaba, to go (verb I, imperf. 3fs); with bi-, 'go with' = 'take, bring'; 'she goes, would go'
أَتَيْتِ: أَتَيْتِ — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 2fs); with bi-, 'come with' = 'bring'; 'you (f.) came'
نَأْخُذُهُ: نَأْخُذُ + ـهُ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 1cp) + -hu, him; 'we take him'
سَابِقَةٌ: سَابِقَة — sābiq, going before, preceding (act. part. of sabaqa, f. sg., nom., predicate of hiya); 'going ahead'
سِيرَا: سِيرَا — sāra, to go, travel, march (verb I hollow, imperative, m. dual); 'go, you two'
فَأَجَابَاهَا: فَـ + أَجَابَا + ـهَا — fa-, and so + ajāba, to answer (verb IV hollow, perf. 3m dual) + -hā, her; with ilā, 'answer to' = 'consent to'; 'and they two answered her'
وَنَفَذَ: وَ + نَفَذَ — nafadha, to pass through, pierce (verb I, perf. 3ms; of an arrow, to go clean through); 'and it pierced'
تَوَسَّطَتْ: تَوَسَّطَتْ — tawassaṭa, to get into the middle (verb V, perf. 3fs); with bi-, 'bring into the midst'; 'she got into the midst'
وَوَصَلُوا: وَ + وَصَلُوا — waṣala, to arrive, reach (verb I, perf. 3mp; with ilā, 'arrive at'); 'and they reached'
يَتَعَرَّضُونَ: يَتَعَرَّضُونَ — taʿarraḍa, to put oneself in the way of (verb V, imperf. 3mp); with li-, 'meddle with, molest'; 'they meddle'
أَوْصَتْهُمْ: أَوْصَتْ + ـهُمْ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV, perf. 3fs; awṣā bi-, 'charge with', the verb chooses the bi-) + -hum, them; 'she charged them'
وَعَرَفُوا: وَ + عَرَفُوا — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3mp; here used of two men); 'and they knew'
عَايَنُوهُمْ: عَايَنُوا + ـهُمْ — ʿāyana, to see with one's own eyes, eye (verb III, perf. 3mp) + -hum, them; 'they had eyed them'
يَتَعَرَّضُوالَهُمْ: يَتَعَرَّضُوا + لِـ + ـهُمْ — set as one word in the print, for yataʿarraḍū lahum: taʿarraḍa, to meddle (verb V, jussive 3mp after lam) + li-, with (prep., the verb chooses it: taʿarraḍa li-, 'interfere with') + -hum, them; '[did not] meddle with them'
كَرَامَةٌ: كَرَامَة — karāma, a wonder of grace worked by a saint, miracle (f., indef. nom., predicate of inna); 'a wonder'
الْخَوَاصِّ: الـ + خَوَاصّ — khawāṣṣ, the special ones, the elect (pl. of khāṣṣa, gen. after min); 'the elect'
إِلَّاعُمْيَانًا: إِلَّا + عُمْيَان — set as one word in the print, for illā ʿumyānan: illā, except, but + ʿumyān, blind ones (pl. of aʿmā, indef. acc., second object of ẓanna); 'nothing but blind'
نَرَاهُمْ: نَرَى + ـهُمْ — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 1cp) + -hum, them; 'we see them'
يَرَوْنَنَا: يَرَوْنَ + ـنَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3mp) + -nā, us; 'they see us'
وَتَعْدَادِ: وَ + تَعْدَاد — taʿdād, counting over, enumeration (verbal noun of ʿaddada; m., gen., coordinated with al-thanāʾ, first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the recounting of'
كَرَامَاتِهِ: كَرَامَات + ـهِ — karāmāt, saintly wonders, wonders of grace worked by a saint (pl. of karāma, gen.) + -hi, his; 'his wonders'
وَزُهْدِهِ: وَ + زُهْد + ـهِ — zuhd, asceticism, renunciation of the world (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his asceticism'
وَعِبَادَاتِهِ: وَ + عِبَادَات + ـهِ — ʿibādāt, acts of worship, devotions (pl. of ʿibāda, gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his devotions'
غَيْرُكُمَا: غَيْر + ـكُمَا — ghayr, other than, besides (nom., agreeing with aḥadun) + -kumā, you two; 'other than you two'
فَنَقْبِضَ: فَـ + نَقْبِضَ — fa-, so that (answering a question, it takes the subjunctive) + qabaḍa, to seize (verb I, subj. 1cp; with ʿalā, 'lay hold of'); 'so that we may seize'
وَالْجَاثَلِيقِ: وَ + الـ + جَاثَلِيق — jāthalīq, catholicos, head of an Eastern church (m., gen., by the oath's wa-ḥaqqi); 'and the catholicos'
نَرَ: نَرَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, jussive 1cp after lam, final vowel dropped); 'we [did not] see'
غَيْرَكُمَا: غَيْر + ـكُمَا — ghayr, other than, besides (acc., agreeing with aḥadan) + -kumā, you two; 'other than you two'
عُقُوبَةٌ: عُقُوبَة — ʿuqūba, punishment, penalty (f., indef. nom., predicate of inna); 'a punishment'
قَبَضُوا: قَبَضَ + وا — form I qabaḍa, seize; 3rd pl. m. perf.; with ʿalā 'lay hold on, arrest'; 'they seized'
وَالْمِطْرَانِ: وَ + الـ + مِطْرَان — wa-, and + miṭrān, metropolitan (bishop) (m., gen. in an oath after wa-ḥaqqi); 'and the metropolitan'
نَرَى: نَرَى — form I raʾā/yarā, see; 1st pl. imperf.; 'we see'
الْقُيُودَ: الـ + قُيُود — quyūd, fetters (pl. of qayd, acc.); 'the fetters'
أَرْجُلِهِمَا: أَرْجُل + هِمَا — arjul, legs, feet (pl. of rijl, gen. after fī) + their (dual); 'their legs'
وَوَكَّلُوا: وَ + وَكَّلَ + وا — wa-, and + form II wakkala, put in charge; 3rd pl.; with bi- 'set (someone) over'; 'and they set over'
يَحْرُسُهُمَا: يَحْرُسُ + هُمَا — form I ḥarasa/yaḥrusu, guard; 3rd sing. m. imperf. + them (dual); 'he guards them'
الْمَبِيتِ: الـ + مَبِيت — mabīt, night's lodging, the night (gen.); 'the night-quarters'
وَغَابَتِ: وَ + غَابَتْ — wa-, and + form I ghāba, be absent, vanish; 3rd sing. f. perf. (kasra before the article); 'and she vanished'
أَعْيُنِهِمَا: أَعْيُن + هِمَا — aʿyun, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, gen. after ʿan) + their (dual); 'their eyes'
يَتَأَسَّفَانِ: يَتَأَسَّفَانِ — form V taʾassafa, grieve, lament; 3rd dual m. imperf.; 'the two lament'
وَيَقُولَانِ: وَ + يَقُولَانِ — wa-, and + form I qāla/yaqūlu, say; 3rd dual m. imperf.; 'and the two say'
الِاعْتِرَاضَ: الـ + اِعْتِرَاض — iʿtirāḍ, objecting, finding fault (form VIII verbal noun, acc. after inna); with ʿalā 'against'
صَلَٰوةَ: صَلَٰوة — ṣalāt, prayer (f., acc., object of ṣallā), in the edition's spelling with wāw, dagger alif; 'the prayer of'
وَتَأَهَّبُوا: وَ + تَأَهَّبَ + وا — wa-, and + form V taʾahhaba, make ready; 3rd pl. perf.; with ilā 'for'; 'and they made ready'
وَقَوَّى: وَ + قَوَّى — wa-, and + form II qawwā, strengthen; 3rd sing. m. perf.; 'and he strengthened'
قَلْبَهُمْ: قَلْب + هُمْ — qalb, heart (m., acc.) + their; 'their heart'
أَسَرْنَا: أَسَرْ + نَا — form I asara, take captive; 1st pl. perf.; 'we have captured'
سُلْطَانَكُمْ: سُلْطَان + كُمْ — sulṭān, sultan (m., acc.) + your (pl.); 'your sultan'
انْتِظَامُ: اِنْتِظَام — intiẓām, being in good order (form VIII verbal noun, nom.); 'the ordering of'
قَتَلْنَاكُمْ: قَتَلْ + نَا + كُمْ — form I qatala, kill; 1st pl. perf. (with conditional sense after in) + you (pl.); 'we will kill you'
سَلَّمْتُمْ: سَلَّمْ + تُمْ — form II sallama, hand over, surrender; 2nd pl. m. perf.; 'you surrender'
نَرُوحُ: نَرُوحُ — form I rāḥa/yarūḥu, go; 1st pl. imperf.; with bi- 'take (along)'; 'we go'
مَلِكِنَا: مَلِك + نَا — malik, king (m., gen. after ilā) + our; 'our king'
فَيُصَالِحُكُمْ: فَ + يُصَالِحُ + كُمْ — fa-, and so + form III ṣālaḥa, make peace with; 3rd sing. m. imperf. + you (pl.); 'and he will make peace with you'
تَخْرُجُوا: تَخْرُجُوا — form I kharaja, go out; 2nd pl. m. subjunctive (after an lā); 'that you (not) go out'
تَذْهَبُوا: تَذْهَبُوا — form I dhahaba, go; 2nd pl. m. subjunctive (after an lā); 'that you (not) go'
تَضُرُّونَا: تَضُرُّو + نَا — form I ḍarra/yaḍurru, harm; 2nd pl. m. subjunctive (after an lā) + us; 'that you (not) harm us'
نَضُرَّكُمْ: نَضُرَّ + كُمْ — form I ḍarra/yaḍurru, harm; 1st pl. subjunctive (after an lā) + you (pl.); 'that we (not) harm you'
خَاطِرُكُمْ: خَاطِر + كُمْ — khāṭir, mind, inclination (m., nom.) + your (pl.); ṭāba khāṭirukum 'you are content'
أَبَيْتُمْ: أَبَيْ + تُمْ — form I abā, refuse; 2nd pl. m. perf. (conditional after in); 'you refuse'
إِلَّاقَتْلُكُمْ: إِلَّا + قَتْل + كُمْ (printed as one word) — illā, except + qatl, killing (m., nom.) + your (pl.); 'nothing but your killing'
كَلَامِنَا: كَلَام + نَا — kalām, speech, words (m., gen.) + our; 'our speech'
أَسْرَ: أَسْر — asr, capture (verbal noun of asara, acc., object of taḥaqqaqa); 'the capture of'
وَضَعُفَتْ: وَ + ضَعُفَتْ — wa-, and + form I ḍaʿufa, grow weak; 3rd sing. f. perf.; 'and (it) weakened'
قُوَّتُهُ: قُوَّة + هُ — quwwa, strength (f., nom.) + his; 'his strength'
وَأَيْقَنَ: وَ + أَيْقَنَ — wa-, and + form IV ayqana, be certain; 3rd sing. m. perf.; with bi- 'be certain of'; 'and he was certain'
أَسْرِهِمَا: أَسْر + هِمَا — asr, capture (verbal noun, gen.) + their (dual); 'their capture'
إِسَاءَةُ: إِسَاءَة — isāʾa, ill-doing (form IV verbal noun, f., nom.); isāʾat adab 'a breach of good manners'
وَاعْتَرَضَا: وَ + اِعْتَرَضَا — wa-, and + form VIII iʿtaraḍa, object, find fault; 3rd dual m. perf.; with ʿalā 'against'; 'and the two objected'
شَأْنُهُمَا: شَأْن + هُمَا — shaʾn, affair, case (m., nom.) + their (dual); 'their case'
نَهَضُوا: نَهَضُوا — form I nahaḍa, rise, set out; 3rd pl. m. perf.; 'they rose'
فَقَتَلُوا: فَ + قَتَلُوا — fa-, and + form I qatala, kill; 3rd pl. m. perf.; 'and they killed'
الْجَبَانِ: الـ + جَبَان — jabān, coward (m., gen. after min); 'the coward'
وَاخْتَضَبَ: وَ + اِخْتَضَبَ — wa-, and + form VIII ikhtaḍaba, be dyed (as with henna); 3rd sing. m. perf.; 'and (it) was dyed'
وَالسِّنَانُ: وَ + الـ + سِنَان — wa-, and + sinān, spearhead (m., nom.); 'and the spearhead'
وَتَهَافَتَ: وَ + تَهَافَتَ — wa-, and + form VI tahāfata, swarm, fall in crowds; 3rd sing. m. perf.; with ʿalā 'upon'; 'and (they) swarmed'
تَهَافُتَ: تَهَافُت — tahāfut, swarming (form VI verbal noun, acc., cognate object); 'the swarming of'
الذُّبَابِ: الـ + ذُبَاب — dhubāb, flies (collective, gen.); 'the flies'
قِتَالَ: قِتَال — qitāl, fighting (form III verbal noun, acc., cognate object); 'the fighting of'
يَعْتَرِيهِ: يَعْتَرِي + هِ — form VIII iʿtarā, befall, come upon; 3rd sing. m. imperf. + him; 'comes upon him'
الْفُرْصَةِ: الـ + فُرْصَة — furṣa, chance, opportunity (f., gen.); 'the chance'
فَوْتٌ: فَوْت — fawt, missing, passing by (m., nom., subject of yaʿtarī); 'a missing'
بِالدِّمَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + دِّمَاء — bi-, with (of what fills: sāla bi-) + dimāʾ, blood (pl. of dam); 'with blood'
وَامْتَلَائَتِ: وَ + اِمْتَلَائَتْ — wa-, and + form VIII imtalaʾa, be filled; 3rd sing. f. perf., the edition's spelling for امتلأت; with bi- 'with'; 'and (it) was filled'
الْفَرِيقَيْنِ: الـ + فَرِيقَيْن — farīqān, the two parties (dual of farīq, gen. after min); 'the two sides'
الْمَغَارَةِ: الـ + مَغَارَة — maghāra, cave (f., gen.); 'the cave'
وَبَانَتْ: وَ + بَانَتْ — wa-, and + form I bāna, appear, become plain; 3rd sing. f. perf.; 'and (it) appeared'
الْغَلَبَةُ: الـ + غَلَبَة — ghalaba, overpowering (f., nom.); with minhum, the defeat they suffered; 'the being worsted'
وَالْخَسَارَةُ: وَ + الـ + خَسَارَة — wa-, and + khasāra, loss (f., nom.); 'and the loss'
تَعْوِيلٌ: تَعْوِيل — taʿwīl, reliance (form II verbal noun, m., nom.); with ʿalā 'on'
الْأَعْيَانِ: الـ + أَعْيَان — aʿyān, notables, men of rank (pl., gen., adjectival to al-umarāʾ); 'the notables'
بِسَيْفِهِمْ: بِـ + سَيْف + هِمْ — bi-, by (of the instrument) + sayf, sword (m., gen.) + their; 'by their sword'
آلَافٌ: آلَاف — ālāf, thousands (pl. of alf, nom.); 'thousands'
وَالرُّكْبَانِ: وَ + الـ + رُكْبَان — wa-, and + rukbān, riders (pl. of rākib, gen.); 'and the riders'
مَايُرِيدُهُ: مَا + يُرِيدُ + هُ (printed as one word) — mā, what + form IV arāda, will, want; 3rd sing. m. imperf. + it; 'what (God) wills'
الْعَسْكَرِإِنْ: الـ + عَسْكَر + إِنْ (printed as one word) — ʿaskar, army (m., gen. after baqiyya) + in, if (conditional); 'the army: if'
خَرَجْتُمْ: خَرَجْ + تُمْ — form I kharaja, go out; 2nd pl. m. perf. (conditional after in); 'you go out'
وَالزَّادِ: وَ + الـ + زَّاد — wa-, and + zād, provisions (m., gen.); 'and the provisions'
تُجَرِّدُوا: تُجَرِّدُوا — form II jarrada, strip, bare (a sword); 2nd pl. m. subjunctive (after an); 'that you draw'
سُيُوفَكُمْ: سُيُوف + كُمْ — suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, acc.) + your (pl.); 'your swords'
وَتَقِفُوا: وَ + تَقِفُوا — wa-, and + form I waqafa/yaqifu, stand; 2nd pl. m. subjunctive; 'and that you stand'
تَدْفَعُوا: تَدْفَعُوا — form I dafaʿa, push away, repel; 2nd pl. m. subjunctive (after li-ajli an); 'that you repel'
أَنْفُسِكُمْ: أَنْفُس + كُمْ — anfus, selves (pl. of nafs, gen. after ʿan) + your (pl.); 'yourselves'
وَيَأْتِينَا: وَ + يَأْتِي + نَا — wa-, and + form I atā/yaʾtī, come; 3rd sing. m. imperf. + us; with bi- 'bring'; 'and he comes to us (with)' (corrected from the print's وبأنينا)
فَيُعِينُونَنَا: فَ + يُعِينُونَ + نَا — fa-, and so + form IV aʿāna, help; 3rd pl. m. imperf. + us; with ʿalā 'in, against'; 'and they will help us'
يَنْظُرُوهُ: يَنْظُرُو + هُ — form I naẓara, see; 3rd pl. m. jussive (after lam) + him; 'they (did not) see him'
الرَّأْىَ: الـ + رَّأْى — raʾy, opinion, plan (m., acc. after inna), spelt with final ى; 'the opinion'
سَدَادِهِ: سَدَاد + هِ — sadād, soundness, rightness (m., gen. after fī) + its; 'its soundness'
ارْتِيَابٌ: اِرْتِيَاب — irtiyāb, doubt (form VIII verbal noun, m., nom.); 'a doubting'
وَمَلَكُوا: وَ + مَلَكُوا — wa-, and + form I malaka, possess, take hold of; 3rd pl. m. perf.; 'and they held'
طَرَفَيْهِ: طَرَفَيْ + هِ — ṭarafān, two sides (dual of ṭaraf, gen. after fī, nūn dropped before the suffix) + its; 'its two sides'
يَقْتُلُونَهُ: يَقْتُلُونَ + هُ — form I qatala, kill; 3rd pl. m. imperf. + him; 'they kill him'
يَدْفَعُونَ: يَدْفَعُونَ — form I dafaʿa, push back, repel; 3rd pl. m. imperf.; 'they repel'
وَصَبَرُوا: وَ + صَبَرُوا — wa-, and + form I ṣabara, endure; 3rd pl. m. perf.; with ʿalā 'hold out in'; 'and they held out'
رَأٰهُمُ: رَأٰ + هُمُ — raʾā, see (perf. 3 m. sg.) + them; the print writes رأ without the long ā, pointed with a dagger alif; 'saw them'
عَرَّفْنَاكُمْ: عَرَّفْ + نَا + كُمْ — form II ʿarrafa, inform; 1st pl. perf. + you (pl.); 'we have informed you'
مَلَكُوا: مَلَكَ — malaka, take possession of, hold (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they held'
يَهْجُمَ: هَجَمَ — hajama, rush upon, attack (imperf. subj. 3 m. sg., after أَنْ); 'that he attack'; with عَلَى, 'rush upon'
لَاغَيْرُ: لَا + غَيْرُ — lā ghayru, 'no other, only' (fixed tag after a number; the print sets it as one word)
نَهْجُمْ: هَجَمَ — hajama, attack (imperf. jussive 1 pl., answering a command); 'let us attack'
نَقْدِرْ: قَدَرَ — qadara, be able (imperf. jussive 1 pl., after لَمْ); 'we are not able'; with عَلَى, 'able to deal with'
نُضْرِمْ: أَضْرَمَ — aḍrama, kindle, set alight (imperf. jussive 1 pl., answering إِنْ); 'we will kindle'
انْقَادُوا: انْقَادَ — inqāda, submit, give in (form VII, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they submit'
أَخَذْنَاهُمْ: أَخَذَ + نَا + هُمْ — akhadha, take; 'we take them'
أَسَارَى: أَسِير — asīr, captive; pl. asārā (acc., as a state); 'as captives'
أَبَوْا: أَبَى — abā, refuse (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they refuse'
تَرَكْنَاهُمْ: تَرَكَ + نَا + هُمْ — taraka, leave; 'we leave them'
لِلنَّارِ: لِـ + الـ + نَار — li-, for (prep.) + nār, fire (f.); 'for the fire'
يَصِيرُوا: صَارَ — ṣāra, become (imperf. subj. 3 m. pl., after حَتَّى); 'that they become'
لِأُولِى: لِـ + أُولِى — li-, for (prep.) + ulī, possessors of (gen. pl., construct; spelled with ى); 'for those possessed of'
الْأَبْصَارِ: الْ + أَبْصَار — abṣār, eyes, sight (pl. of baṣar); 'the eyes'
أَبَاهُمْ: أَب + هُمْ — ab, father (acc. abā); 'their father'
جَعَلُ: جَعَلَ — jaʿala, make (perf. 3 m. sg.); the print sets a ḍamma on the final lām; 'make'
مُسْتَقَرَّ: مُسْتَقَرّ — mustaqarr, resting-place, abode (acc., construct); 'the resting-place of'
مَثْوَاهُمْ: مَثْوَى + هُمْ — mathwā, dwelling, abode; 'their abode'
وَأَضْرَمُوا: و + أَضْرَمَ — wa-, and + aḍrama, kindle (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they kindled'
بِالْبَوَارِ: بِـ + الْ + بَوَار — bi-, of (after أَيْقَنَ, 'be certain of') + bawār, perdition, ruin; 'of ruin'
نُفُوسَهُمْ: نَفْس — nafs, self, soul; pl. nufūs (acc.) + هُمْ; 'themselves'
بِالْبِطْرِيقِ: بِـ + الْ + بِطْرِيق — after إِذَا of surprise bi- only marks what appears + biṭrīq, patrician; 'behold, the patrician'
الرَّئِيسِ: الْ + رَئِيس — raʾīs, chief, head (gen.); 'the chief'
بِقَتْلِهِمْ: بِـ + قَتْل + هِمْ — bi-, (after الْمُشِير, from أَشَارَ بِـ 'advise' — the verb chooses the bi-; it marks the course advised) + qatl, killing; '(advising) their killing'
يَشْفِيَ: شَفَى — shafā, heal (imperf. subj. 3 m. sg.); with غَلِيل, 'slake one's thirst for revenge'
غَلِيلَهُ: غَلِيل + هُ — ghalīl, burning thirst, rancour (acc.); 'his thirst (for vengeance)'
نُبْقِيهِمْ: نُبْقِي + هِمْ — abqā, keep, leave remaining (form IV, imperf. 1 pl.); 'we keep them'
وَنُسَلِّمُهُمْ: و + نُسَلِّمُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + sallama, hand over (form II, imperf. 1 pl.); 'and we hand them over'
فَيَفْعَلُ: فَـ + يَفْعَلُ — fa-, and so + faʿala, do (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he does'
الرَّأْىُ: الْ + رَأْى — raʾy, opinion, counsel, plan (nom.; spelled with ى); 'the counsel'
أَمَرُوا: أَمَرَ — amara, command (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they commanded'; with بِـ, 'order (a thing)'
بِتَكْتِيفِهِمْ: بِـ + تَكْتِيف + هِمْ — bi-, (after أَمَرَ بِـ, 'order') + taktīf, binding the arms behind (verbal noun II); 'that their arms be bound'
بِاللَّهْوِ: بِـ + الـ + لَهْو — bi-, with (after اشْتَغَلَ بِـ, 'be busy with') + lahw, amusement, diversion; 'with amusement'
فَشَرِبُوا: فَـ + شَرِبُوا — fa-, and + shariba, drink (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they drank'
مُقَيَّدَيْنِ: مُقَيَّد — muqayyad, fettered (pass. part. II, dual acc.); 'both fettered'
كَالطَّيْرِ: كَـ + الـ + طَيْر — ka-, like + ṭayr, birds (coll.); 'like birds' Also of a single bird: ka-al-ṭayri fī al-qafaṣi, 'like a bird in a cage' (ka-, like).
الْأَقْفَاصِ: الْ + أَقْفَاص — aqfāṣ, cages (pl. of qafaṣ); 'the cages'
وَتَمَطَّى: و + تَمَطَّى — wa-, and + tamaṭṭā, stretch oneself (form V, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he stretched himself'
خَلَصَ: خَلَصَ — khalaṣa, get free (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he got free'
الْوَثَاقِ: الْ + وَثَاق — wathāq, bond, fetter; 'the bond'
الْحُرَّاسِ: الْ + حُرَّاس — ḥurrās, guards (pl. of ḥāris; gen.); 'the guards'
وَنَلْبَسَهَا: و + نَلْبَسَ + هَا — wa-, and + labisa, put on, wear (imperf. subj. 1 pl.); 'and we put them on'
نَصِيرَ: صَارَ — ṣāra, become (imperf. subj. 1 pl., after حَتَّى); 'so that we become'
وَنَسِيرَ: و + نَسِيرَ — wa-, and + sāra, go, travel (imperf. subj. 1 pl.); 'and we go'
الرَّأْيَ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, counsel, plan (acc., after إِنَّ; spelled with ي); 'the plan'
قَتَلْنَاهُمْ: قَتَلَ + نَا + هُمْ — qatala, kill; '(if) we kill them'
شَخِيرَهُمْ: شَخِير + هُمْ — shakhīr, snorting, death-rattle (acc.); 'their death-rattle'
فَتَنْتَبِهَ: فَـ + تَنْتَبِهَ — fa-, and so + intabaha, become alert (form VIII, imperf. subj. 3 f. sg., with a broken plural subject); 'and (the infidels) become alert'
فَيَقْتُلُونَنَا: فَـ + يَقْتُلُونَ + نَا — fa-, and so + qatala, kill (imperf. 3 m. pl., indicative); 'and they kill us'
السَّدِيدُأَنْ: السَّدِيد + أَنْ — al-sadīd, the sound, right (nom.) + an, that (the print sets them as one word); 'the sound (course is) that'
نَسِيرَ: سَارَ — sāra, go, travel (imperf. subj. 1 pl., after أَنْ); 'that we go'
فَأَجَابُوهُ: فَـ + أَجَابُوا + هُ — fa-, and + ajāba, answer (form IV, perf. 3 m. pl.); with إِلَى, 'consent to'; 'and they agreed with him'
بِقَلِيلٍ: بِـ + قَلِيل — bi-, by (of the measure) + qalīl, a little; 'by a little'
مَرْبُوطَةً: مَرْبُوط — marbūṭ, tied, tethered (pass. part., f. sg. acc., with broken plural خَيْل); 'tethered'
وَأَصْحَابُهَا: و + أَصْحَاب + هَا — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, owners, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib); 'and their owners'
يَأْخُذَ: أَخَذَ — akhadha, take (imperf. subj. 3 m. sg., after أَنْ); 'that (each) take'
لِحِكْمَةٍ: لِـ + حِكْمَة — li-, for (of purpose) + ḥikma, wisdom, wise purpose; 'for a wise purpose'
يَعْلَمُهَا: يَعْلَمُ + هَا — ʿalima, know (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'He knows it'
يَخْتَلِسُ: اخْتَلَسَ — ikhtalasa, snatch, steal by stealth (form VIII, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'stealing'
أَخَذُوهَا: أَخَذُوا + هَا — akhadha, take (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they had taken them'
فِكَاكِ: فِكَاك — fikāk, release, setting free (gen., construct); 'the freeing of'
وَأَنَّهُمْ: و + أَنَّ + هُمْ — wa-, and + anna, that; 'and that they'
خَلَصُوا: خَلَصُوا — khalaṣa, get free (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they got free'
وَاقِفِينَ: وَاقِف — wāqif, standing (act. part., m. pl. acc.); 'standing'
نَارٍوَهُمْ: نَار + وَ + هُمْ — nār, fire (gen., after عَلَى) + wa-hum, 'while they' (the print sets them as one word); 'on fire, and they'
أَجْلِهِ: أَجْل + هِ — min ajl, for the sake of; 'on his account'
الِافْتِكَارِ: الْ + افْتِكَار — iftikār, anxious thought, worry (verbal noun VIII of fakara; the kasra on the lām is only the joining vowel before the waṣl); 'the anxiety'
تَخَافُوا: خَافَ — khāfa, fear (imperf. jussive 2 m. pl., after لَا of prohibition); 'do not fear'
سَتَرَنَا: سَتَرَ + نَا — satara, cover, shield (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'He has shielded us'
رَأْىٌ: رَأْى — raʾy, opinion, plan (nom. indef.; spelled with ى); 'a plan'
تَطْلُعُوا: طَلَعَ — ṭalaʿa, go up, climb (imperf. subj. 2 m. pl., after أَنْ); 'that you climb'
وَتُكَبِّرُوا: و + تُكَبِّرُوا — wa-, and + kabbara, say Allāhu akbar (form II, imperf. subj. 2 m. pl.); 'and cry God is greatest'
كُلُّكُمْ: كُلّ + كُمْ — kull, all; 'all of you'
تَكْبِيرَةً: تَكْبِيرَة — takbīra, one cry of Allāhu akbar (acc.); 'one cry'
وَتَقُولُوا: و + تَقُولُوا — wa-, and + qāla, say (imperf. subj. 2 m. pl.); 'and say'
جَاءَتْكُمُ: جَاءَتْ + كُمُ — jāʾa, come (perf. 3 f. sg., with a broken plural subject); 'have come to you'
الْإِسْلَامِيَّةُ: الْ + إِسْلَامِيَّة — islāmiyya, Islamic (adj. f. sg. nom., with broken plural عَسَاكِر); 'Islamic'
وَنَصِيحَ: و + نَصِيحَ — wa-, and + ṣāḥa, shout (imperf. subj. 1 pl.); 'and we shout'
بِقَوْلِ: بِـ + قَوْل — bi-, with (of the words shouted) + qawl, saying (gen., construct); 'with the saying' Also after ghannā, 'to sing': bi- marks the words sung, ghannat bi-qawli al-shāʿiri, 'she sang the poet's lines'.
فَيَفْتَرِقُ: فَـ + يَفْتَرِقُ — fa-, and so + iftaraqa, be scattered, break apart (form VIII, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (the host) will scatter'
الْجَمْعُ: الْ + جَمْع — jamʿ, gathering, host (nom.); 'the host'
يَجِدُونَ: وَجَدَ — wajada, find (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'they find'
وَيَظُنُّونَ: و + يَظُنُّونَ — wa-, and + ẓanna, think, suppose (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they will think'
وَاخْتَلَطُوا: و + اخْتَلَطُوا — wa-, and + ikhtalaṭa, mingle (form VIII, perf. 3 m. pl.); with بِـ, 'mingle with'; 'and got among'
فَيَقَعُونَ: فَـ + يَقَعُونَ — fa-, and so + waqaʿa, fall (imperf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they will fall'
دَهْشَةِ: دَهْشَة — dahsha, bewilderment, daze (gen., construct); 'the daze of'
فَنُقَطِّعُهُمْ: فَـ + نُقَطِّعُ + هُمْ — fa-, and + qaṭṭaʿa, cut to pieces (form II, imperf. 1 pl.); 'and we cut them down'
بِسُيُوفِهِمْ: بِـ + سُيُوف + هِمْ — bi-, with (of the instrument) + suyūf, swords; 'with their swords'
وَيَدُورُ: و + يَدُورُ — wa-, and + dāra, go round (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (the sword) goes round'
نَنْطِقُ: نَطَقَ — naṭaqa, utter, speak (imperf. 1 pl.); with بِـ, 'utter (a word)'
كَبَّرْنَا: كَبَّرَ + نَا — kabbara, cry Allāhu akbar (form II, perf. 1 pl.); 'we cry God is greatest'
تَنَبَّهُوا: تَنَبَّهُوا — tanabbaha, become aware (form V, perf. 3 m. pl.); with لِـ, 'become aware of'
وَلَحِقُونَا: و + لَحِقُوا + نَا — wa-, and + laḥiqa, overtake, catch up with (perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they overtake us'
لَوِا: لَوْ + ا — law, if (the print attaches the next word's alif to it: لوا نتبهوا for لو انتبهوا); 'if'
نْتَبَهُوا: (ا)نْتَبَهُوا — intabaha, become alert (form VIII, perf. 3 m. pl.; the print sets its alif on the word before); with لِـ, 'become alert to'
تُوَافِقُونِي: تُوَافِقُوا + نِي — wāfaqa, agree with (form III, imperf. subj. 2 m. pl., -na dropped after أَنْ) + -nī, me; 'that you agree with me'
إِلَّاخَيْرًا: إِلَّا + خَيْرًا — illā, except + khayr, good (acc.; the print sets them as one word); 'nothing but good'
بِالتَّكْبِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + تَكْبِير — bi-, with (of the cry, after صَاحَ بِـ) + takbīr, crying Allāhu akbar; 'with the takbīr'; likewise after ḍajja bi- 'clamour with'
فَكَبَّرَتْ: فَـ + كَبَّرَتْ — fa-, and + kabbara, cry Allāhu akbar (perf. 3 f. sg., with a broken plural subject); 'and (the mountains) cried God is greatest'
الْجِبَالُ: الْ + جِبَال — jibāl, mountains (pl. of jabal; nom.); 'the mountains'
وَالْأَحْجَارُ: و + الْ + أَحْجَار — wa-, and + aḥjār, stones (pl. of ḥajar); 'and the stones'
خَشْيَةِ: خَشْيَة — khashya, fear, awe (gen., construct); 'fear of'
التَّكْبِيرَ: الـ + تَكْبِير — takbīr, the cry Allāhu akbar (acc.); 'the takbīr'
لِلْمِائَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مِائَة — li-, for, of (prep., giving the number the night completes: al-mūfiya li-, 'completing the') + miʾa, hundred (f., gen.; the print spells it مائة, with an alif that is not pronounced); 'for the hundred'
فَصَاحُوا: فَـ + صَاحُوا — fa-, and so + ṣāḥa, to cry out, shout (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); with ʿalā, 'call out to'; 'and they shouted'
الْأَعْدَاءُ: الـ + أَعْدَاء — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww; nom.); 'the enemies'
إِلَّااللَّهُ: إِلَّا + اللَّهُ — illā, except + Allāh, God (nom.), the print setting the two as one word; 'except God'
فَتَّشُوا: فَتَّشُوا — fattasha, to search (verb II, perf. 3mp); with ʿalā, 'search for' (Classical fattasha ʿan); 'they searched'
الْأَسَارَى: الـ + أَسَارَى — asārā, captives, prisoners (pl. of asīr); 'the captives'
رُؤَسَاؤُهُمْ: رُؤَسَاء + هُمْ — ruʾasāʾ, chiefs, heads (pl. of raʾīs; nom.) + -hum, their; 'their chiefs'
هُمُ: هُمُ — hum, they (3mp independent pron.; linking vowel -u before the following al-)
وَالسَّعْيَ: وَ + الـ + سَعْي — wa-, and + saʿy, running, hastening, pursuit (m., acc., object of the urging word dūnakum, 'to it!'); 'and the running'
تَلْحَقُوهُمْ: تَلْحَقُوا + هُمْ — laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with (verb I, imperf. subj. 2mp after ḥattā, -na dropped) + -hum, them; 'that you overtake them'
فَتَسْقُوهُمْ: فَـ + تَسْقُوا + هُمْ — fa-, and so + saqā, to give to drink (verb I, imperf. subj. 2mp, -na dropped) + -hum, them; 'and make them drink'
انْذِهَالٌ: انْذِهَال — indhihāl, bewilderment, dismay, being dazed (VII verbal noun of dhahala; m., nom.); 'bewilderment'
وَسَعَوْا: وَ + سَعَوْا — wa-, and + saʿā, to run, hasten, go (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they ran'
لَحْظَةٌ: لَحْظَة — laḥẓa, a glance, a moment, the blink of an eye (f., nom.); 'a moment'
لَحِقُوهُمْ: لَحِقُوا + هُمْ — laḥiqa, to overtake, catch up with (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hum, them; 'they overtook them'
الْفَزَعُ: الـ + فَزَع — fazaʿ, fright, terror (m., nom.); 'the terror'
حُصُولِهِ: حُصُول + هِ — ḥuṣūl, coming about, happening (verbal noun of ḥaṣala; m., gen. after min) + -hi, its; 'its happening'
انْحَدَرَ: انْحَدَرَ — inḥadara, to go down, descend (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'he came down'
وَكَبَّرَ: وَ + كَبَّرَ — wa-, and + kabbara, to cry Allāhu akbar (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he cried God is greatest'
وَكَبَّرَتْ: وَ + كَبَّرَتْ — wa-, and + kabbara, to cry Allāhu akbar (verb II, perf. 3fs, with a broken plural subject); 'and (they) cried God is greatest'
وَعَوَّلُوا: وَ + عَوَّلُوا — wa-, and + ʿawwala, to resolve, determine (verb II, perf. 3mp); with ʿalā, 'resolve upon'; 'and they resolved'
بِالتَّهْلِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + تَهْلِيل — bi-, with (marks the words cried, after ṣāḥa bi- or nādā bi-; the verb chooses the bi-) + al-, the + tahlīl, saying lā ilāha illā allāh (verbal noun of II hallala; m., gen.); 'with the tahlīl'
وَالتَّكْبِيرِ: وَ + الـ + تَكْبِير — wa-, and + al-, the + takbīr, crying allāhu akbar (verbal noun of II kabbara; m., gen.); 'and the takbīr'
وَالصَّلٰوةِ: وَ + الـ + صَلَوة — wa-, and + ṣalāt, prayer, the blessing (f., gen.; the print spells it صلٰوة with the dagger alif); 'and the blessing'
النَّذِيرِ: الـ + نَذِير — al-, the + nadhīr, warner (m., gen., in apposition); with al-bashīr, a Qurʾānic epithet of the Prophet: 'the warner'
جُيُوشَ: جُيُوش — juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh; acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the armies of'
وَعَسَاكِرَ: وَ + عَسَاكِر — wa-, and + ʿasākir, troops, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; acc., diptote; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the troops of'; also: gen. in -a (diptote), coordinated after ṣāḥibu, not in construct: ṣāḥibu juyūshin wa-ʿasākira, 'master of armies and hosts' (Night 179)
مُقْبِلِينَ: مُقْبِلِين — muqbil, coming on, advancing (act. part. of form IV aqbala; m. pl. acc., circumstantial); 'advancing'; with ʿalā, 'bearing down on'
وَهَلَّلَ: وَ + هَلَّلَ — wa-, and + hallala, to say lā ilāha illā allāh (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he cried There is no god but God'
فَارْتَجَّتِ: فَـ + ارْتَجَّتْ — fa-, and so + irtajja, to shake, quake (verb VIII, perf. 3fs; linking vowel -i before al-); 'and (the earth) shook'
كَالزَّلَازِلِ: كَـ + الـ + زَلَازِل — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison) + zalāzil, earthquakes (pl. of zalzala; gen.); 'like the earthquakes'
وَتَفَرَّقَتْ: وَ + تَفَرَّقَتْ — wa-, and + tafarraqa, to scatter, disperse (verb V, perf. 3fs, with a broken plural subject); 'and (they) scattered'
فَتَبِعَتْهُمُ: فَـ + تَبِعَتْ + هُمُ — fa-, and so + tabiʿa, to follow, pursue (verb I, perf. 3fs; here with al-muslimūn) + -humu, them (linking vowel -u before al-); 'and (the Muslims) followed them'
وَأَزَاحُوا: وَ + أَزَاحُوا — wa-, and + azāḥa, to remove, put away (verb IV hollow, perf. 3mp); 'and they removed'
الرُّؤُسَ: الـ + رُؤُس — ruʾūs, heads (pl. of raʾs; acc.; the print spells it with one wāw, الرؤس, for رؤوس); 'the heads'
يَضْرِبُونَ: يَضْرِبُونَ — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, imperf. 3mp); with fī, 'strike into'; 'striking'
أَعْنَاقِ: أَعْنَاق — aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq; gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the necks of'
انْحَازَ: انْحَازَ — inḥāza, to draw aside, withdraw, rally (to) (verb VII hollow, root ح-و-ز, perf. 3ms); with إِلَى, 'drew together to'
مُسْتَبْشِرِينَ: مُسْتَبْشِرِين — mustabshir, rejoicing at good tidings (act. part. of form X اِسْتَبْشَرَ, root ب-ش-ر; m. pl. acc., circumstantial after bāta); 'rejoicing'
لَيْلِهِمْ: لَيْل + هِمْ — layl, night (m., gen. after ṭūla) + -him, their; 'their night'
رأَوْا: رأَوْا — raʾaw, they saw (perf. 3mp of رَأَى; the edition prints the hamza on the alif); 'they saw'
بَهْرَامَ: بَهْرَام — Bahrām, proper name, m. (Persian), emir of the Daylam (diptote: acc., or gen. with -a)
وَرُسْتُمَ: وَ + رُسْتُم — wa-, and + Rustam, proper name, m. (Persian), emir of the Turks (diptote: acc., or gen. with -a); 'and Rustam'
كَاللُّيُوثِ: كَـ + الـ + لُيُوث — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + luyūth, lions (pl. of layth, gen. after ka-); 'like the lions'
الْعَوَابِسِ: الـ + عَوَابِس — ʿawābis, scowling, grim-faced (pl. of ʿābis, act. part. of ʿabasa, 'frown'; gen., agreeing with al-luyūth); 'the scowling'
تَرَجَّلَ: تَرَجَّلَ — tarajjala, to dismount, go on foot (verb V, root ر-ج-ل, perf. 3ms; singular before a plural subject); 'dismounted'
بِنَصْرِ: بِـ + نَصْر — bi-, of, at (abshara bi-, 'rejoice at the news of': the verb chooses the bi-) + naṣr, victory, help (m., gen., in construct); 'at the victory of'
هَنَّوْا: هَنَّوْا — hannaw, they congratulated (form II هَنَّأَ, root ه-ن-أ, perf. 3mp, written without its hamza and conjugated like a weak verb, a Middle Arabic form; with بِـ, 'on'); 'they congratulated'
وَعَظِيمِ: وَ + عَظِيم — wa-, and + ʿaẓīm, great, mighty (adj., gen., coordinated with al-salāma; here first term of a construct, ʿaẓīm al-ajr, 'the great reward'); 'and the great (of)'
الْأَجْرِ: الـ + أَجْر — ajr, wage, reward, esp. God's reward in the hereafter (m., gen.); 'the reward'
الْأَمِيرَ: الـ + أَمِير — amīr, emir, commander, prince (m., acc., subject of anna); 'the emir'
وَالْأَمِيرَ: وَ + الـ + أَمِير — wa-, and + al-, the + amīr, emir, commander (m., acc., coordinated after anna); 'and the emir'
وَالْحَاجِبَ: وَ + الـ + حَاجِب — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥājib, chamberlain (m., acc.); al-ḥājib al-kabīr, 'the Grand Chamberlain'
بِجُيُوشِ: بِـ + جُيُوش — bi-, with (prep.; sāra bi-, 'march with, lead': bi- of what goes along) + juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh, gen., in construct); 'with the armies of'
مَنْشُورَةٌ: مَنْشُورَة — manshūra, spread out, unfurled (pass. part. of nashara, f. sg. nom., predicate in a circumstantial clause agreeing with the plural rāyāt); 'unfurled'
رأَوُا: رأَوُا — raʾaw, they saw (perf. 3mp of رَأَى, the final wāw taking ḍamma before the article; the edition prints the hamza on the alif); 'they saw'
الْأَسْوَارِ: الـ + أَسْوَار — aswār, city walls, ramparts (pl. of sūr, gen. after ʿalā); 'the walls'
الْأَبْرَاجَ: الـ + أَبْرَاج — abrāj, towers (pl. of burj, acc., object of malakū); 'the towers'
وَالْقِلَاعَ: وَ + الـ + قِلَاع — wa-, and + al-, the + qilāʿ, citadels, strongholds (pl. of qalʿa, acc.); 'and the citadels'
وَاسْتَعَدُّوا: وَ + اسْتَعَدُّوا — wa-, and + istaʿaddū, they made ready, prepared themselves (form X of ع-د-د, perf. 3mp); 'and they made ready'
مَنَّاعٍ: مَنَّاع — mannāʿ, much-withholding, impregnable (intensive faʿʿāl of manaʿa, 'bar, keep off'; gen., agreeing with ḥiṣn); 'impregnable'
وَالْأَعْلَامِ: وَ + الـ + أَعْلَام — wa-, and + al-, the + aʿlām, standards, banners (pl. of ʿalam, gen.); 'and the standards'
الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ: الـ + مُحَمَّدِيَّة — muḥammadiyya, Muḥammadan, of Muḥammad (nisba adj., f. sg. gen., agreeing with the broken plural aʿlām); 'of Muḥammad'
قَعْقَعَةَ: قَعْقَعَة — qaʿqaʿa, clatter, clash (of arms) (quadriliteral verbal noun, f., acc., object of samiʿū, in construct); 'the clatter of'
وَضَجَّةَ: وَ + ضَجَّة — wa-, and + ḍajja, clamour, uproar (f., acc., in construct); 'and the clamour of'
الصِّيَاحِ: الـ + صِيَاح — ṣiyāḥ, shouting, cries (verbal noun of ṣāḥa, m., gen.); 'the shouting'
فَرأَوُا: فَـ + رأَوُا — fa-, and so (conj.) + raʾaw, they saw (perf. 3mp of رَأَى, wāw with ḍamma before the article; the edition prints the hamza on the alif); 'and they saw'
حَوَافِرَ: حَوَافِر — ḥawāfir, hooves (pl. of ḥāfir; diptote, acc., object of samiʿū, in construct); 'the hooves of'
خُيُولِهِمْ: خُيُول + هِمْ — khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl, gen.) + -him, their; 'their horses'
فَإِذَاهُمْ: فَـ + إِذَا + هُمْ — fa-, and + idhā, behold (particle of surprise) + hum, they (independent pron.); the edition prints it as one word; 'and behold, they'
كَالْجَرَادِ: كَـ + الـ + جَرَاد — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + jarād, locusts (collective, gen. after ka-); 'like the locusts'
الْمُنْتَشِرِ: الـ + مُنْتَشِر — muntashir, spreading, scattered abroad (act. part. of form VII intashara, gen.); 'spreading'
وَالسَّحَابِ: وَ + الـ + سَحَاب — wa-, and + al-, the + saḥāb, clouds (collective, gen., still governed by ka-); 'and the clouds'
الْمُنْهَمِرِ: الـ + مُنْهَمِر — munhamir, pouring down (of rain) (act. part. of form VII inhamara, gen.); 'pouring'
أَصْوَاتَ: أَصْوَات — aṣwāt, voices, sounds (pl. of ṣawt, m.; acc. object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the voices of'
بِتِلَاوَةِ: بِـ + تِلَاوَة — bi-, with (prep.: what the voices were busy with) + tilāwa, recitation (of the Qurʾān) (f., gen.); 'with the reciting of'
وَتَسْبِيحِ: وَ + تَسْبِيح — wa-, and + tasbīḥ, glorifying God, saying subḥāna allāh (verbal noun of II sabbaḥa; m., gen.); 'and the glorifying of'
إِعْلَامِ: إِعْلَام — iʿlām, informing, notifying (verbal noun of IV aʿlama, 'inform', which takes bi- for what one is told; m., gen. after fī); 'the informing of'
زُورِهَا: زُور + هَا — zūr, falsehood, lying (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her falsehood'
وَعُهْرِهَا: وَ + عُهْر + هَا — wa-, and + ʿuhr, whoring, harlotry (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her harlotry'
وَبُهْتَانِهَا: وَ + بُهْتَان + هَا — wa-, and + buhtān, slander, calumny (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her slander'
وَمَكْرِهَا: وَ + مَكْر + هَا — wa-, and + makr, guile, cunning (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her guile'
الزَّاخِرِ: الـ + زَاخِر — al-, the + zākhir, swelling, brimming (of the sea) (act. part. of zakhara; m., gen., adj.); 'the swelling'
وَالنِّسَاءِ: وَ + الـ + نِسَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + nisāʾ, women (pl. of imraʾa, gen.); 'and the women'
أَمِيرُ: أَمِير — amīr, emir, commander (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the emir of'; also nom. after yā, 'O emir'
بَقِينَا: بَقِينَا — baqiya, remain (I perf. 1 pl.); 'we have remained, we are left'
خَطَرٍ: خَطَر — khaṭar, danger, peril (m., gen. indef.); ʿalā khaṭarin, 'in danger'
الْأَبْرَاجِ: الـ + أَبْرَاج — al-, the + abrāj, towers (pl. of burj, gen.); 'the towers'
بِالْأَمْوَاجِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْوَاج — bi-, with (prep.: the waves that clash) + al-, the + amwāj, waves (pl. of mawj, gen.); 'with the waves'
قَدْرُنَا: قَدْر + نَا — qadr, measure, amount (m., nom.) + -nā, our; qadrunā miʾata marratin, 'a hundred times our measure'
وَلَانَأْمَنُ: وَ + لَا + نَأْمَنُ — wa-, and + lā, not + naʾmanu, we feel safe (I amina, impf. 1 pl.; amina min, 'feel safe from'); 'and we are not safe'. The print sets it as one word
جَاسُوسٍ: جَاسُوس — jāsūs, spy (m., gen. indef.); 'a spy'
يُخْبِرُهُمْ: يُخْبِرُ + هُمْ — yukhbiru, he informs, tells (IV akhbara, impf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'who tells them'
مَاعِنْدَنَا: مَا + عِنْدَ + نَا — mā, not (neg.) + ʿinda, with, at + -nā, us; 'there is not with us'. The print sets it as one word
سُلْطَانٍ: سُلْطَان — sulṭān, sultan (m., gen. indef.); min sulṭānin after a negative, 'any sultan'
وَأَنَّنَا: وَ + أَنَّ + نَا — wa-, and + anna, that + -nā, we; 'and that we'
مَدَدُهُمْ: مَدَد + هُمْ — madad, reinforcement, supply (of troops) (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their reinforcement'
الْأَجَلِّ: الـ + أَجَلّ — al-, the + ajall, most illustrious, most exalted (elative of jalīl; m., gen., adj.); 'the most illustrious'
يَطْمَعُونَ: يَطْمَعُونَ — yaṭmaʿūna, they covet, hope to gain (I ṭamiʿa, impf. 3 m. pl.); ṭamiʿa fī, 'have designs on': the verb chooses the fī
لِغَيْبَتِهِمْ: لِـ + غَيْبَة + هِمْ — li-, because of (prep. of cause) + ghayba, absence (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'because of their absence'
فَيَمْحَقُونَنَا: فَـ + يَمْحَقُونَ + نَا — fa-, and so + yamḥaqūna, they annihilate, wipe out (I maḥaqa, impf. 3 m. pl.) + -nā, us; 'and they wipe us out'
آخِرِنَا: آخِر + نَا — ākhir, the last (m., gen.) + -nā, of us; ʿan ākhirinā, 'to the last of us' (the edition prints the madda)
نَاجٍ: نَاجٍ — nājin, one who escapes (act. part. of I najā; m., nom. indef., final -ī dropped); lā yanjū minnā nājin, 'not one of us escapes'
الْمَوَاصِلَةِ: الـ + مَوَاصِلَة — al-, the + mawāṣila, the men of Mosul (pl. of mawṣilī; gen.); 'the Mosul-men'
وَالْأَتْرَاكِ: وَ + الـ + أَتْرَاك — wa-, and + al-, the + atrāk, Turks (pl. of turk, gen.); 'and the Turks'
وَتَذْهَبَ: وَ + تَذْهَبَ — wa-, and + tadhhaba, you go (I dhahaba, subjunctive 2 m. sg., after an); dhahaba bi-, 'go with, take along'
دَيْرِ: دَيْر — dayr, monastery (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the monastery of'
وَمَرْجِ: وَ + مَرْج — wa-, and + marj, meadow (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the meadow of'
مَاوَخْنَا: مَاوَخْنَا — Māwakhnā, name of a meadow (proper name, gen.); given as printed, its pointing not certain
إِخْوَانِنَا: إِخْوَان + نَا — ikhwān, brothers, brethren (pl. of akh, gen.) + -nā, our; 'our brothers'
وَأَصْحَابِنَا: وَ + أَصْحَاب + نَا — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, gen.) + -nā, our; 'and our companions'
أَطَعْتُمُونِي: أَطَعْتُمُ + و + نِي — aṭaʿtum, you obeyed (IV aṭāʿa, perf. 2 m. pl., with the linking -ū- before a suffix) + -nī, me; in a condition, 'if you obey me'
كُنْتُمْ: كُنْتُمْ — kuntum, you were (I kāna, perf. 2 m. pl.); in the answer to a condition, 'you will be'
ضَيَّقُوا: ضَيَّقُوا — ḍayyaqū, they pressed hard (II ḍayyaqa, perf. 3 m. pl.); ḍayyaqa ʿalā, 'hem in, press hard upon': the verb chooses the ʿalā
تُطِيعُونِي: تُطِيعُو + نِي — tuṭīʿū, you obey (IV aṭāʿa, jussive 2 m. pl. after lam) + -nī, me; 'you (do not) obey me'
تَوَجَّهْتُمْ: تَوَجَّهْتُمْ — tawajjahtum, you set out, headed (V tawajjaha, perf. 2 m. pl.); after idhā, 'when you have set out'
الْحَزْمِ: الـ + حَزْم — al-, the + ḥazm, prudence, firm judgment (m., gen.); 'the prudence'
الظَّنِّ: الـ + ظَنّ — al-, the + ẓann, opinion, supposing (m., gen.); sūʾ al-ẓann, 'thinking ill, suspicion'
فَعِنْدَهَا: فَـ + عِنْدَ + هَا — fa-, and so + ʿinda, at + -hā, it (f., the moment); 'thereupon, at that'
الْمَذْكُورُ: الـ + مَذْكُور — al-, the + madhkūr, aforesaid, mentioned (pass. part. of dhakara; m., nom., adj.); 'the aforesaid'
وَانْتَخَبَا: وَ + انْتَخَبَا — wa-, and + intakhabā, the two chose, picked out (VIII intakhaba, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two picked out'
الطُّرُقَاتِ: الـ + طُرُقَات — al-, the + ṭuruqāt, roads, ways (pl. of ṭarīq, acc.); qaṭaʿa al-ṭuruqāt, 'travel the roads'
الْمَذْكُورَ: الـ + مَذْكُور — al-, the + madhkūr, aforesaid, mentioned (pass. part. of dhakara; m., acc., adj.); 'the aforesaid'
وَالدَّيْرَ: وَ + الـ + دَيْر — wa-, and + al-, the + dayr, monastery (m., acc.); 'and the monastery'
الْمَشْهُورَ: الـ + مَشْهُور — al-, the + mashhūr, famous, well known (pass. part. of shahara; m., acc., adj.); 'the famous'
أَوْقَعَتِ: أَوْقَعَتِ — awqaʿati, she made fall (IV awqaʿa, perf. 3 f. sg., -i before the article); awqaʿa fī, 'make (someone) fall into, deliver into'
أَيْدِى: أَيْدِى — aydī, hands (pl. of yad; gen., first term of an iḍāfa; printed with ى); fī aydī, 'into the hands of'
وَرَكِبَتْهُ: وَ + رَكِبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + rakibat, she mounted, rode (I rakiba, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it; 'and mounted it'
لِلْكُفَّارِ: لِـ + الـ + كُفَّار — li-, to (prep.: whom she speaks to) + al-, the + kuffār, infidels (pl. of kāfir, gen.); 'to the infidels'
أَلْحَقَ: أَلْحَقَ — alḥaqa, I overtake, catch up with (I laḥiqa, subjunctive 1 sg., after an); 'that I catch up with'
وَأَتَحَيَّلَ: وَ + أَتَحَيَّلَ — wa-, and + ataḥayyala, I use guile (V taḥayyala, subjunctive 1 sg., after an); taḥayyala ʿalā, 'plot against, contrive (something)': the verb chooses the ʿalā
هَلَاكِهِمْ: هَلَاك + هِمْ — halāk, destruction, perdition (m., gen.) + -him, their; 'their destruction'
فَأُعْلِمُهُمْ: فَـ + أُعْلِمُ + هُمْ — fa-, and (so) + uʿlimu, I inform (IV aʿlama, impf. 1 sg.) + -hum, them; 'and I will inform them'
أَصْحَابَهُمْ: أَصْحَاب + هُمْ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, acc. after anna) + -hum, their; 'their companions'
هَلَكُوا: هَلَكُوا — halakū, they perished (I halaka, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they have perished'
تَشَتَّتَ: تَشَتَّتَ — tashattata, be scattered, dispersed (V, perf. 3 m. sg.); in the answer to idhā, 'will be scattered'
شَمْلُهُمْ: شَمْل + هُمْ — shaml, union, gathered state (m., nom.) + -hum, their; tashattata shamluhum, 'their union is broken up'
وَانْصَرَمَ: وَ + انْصَرَمَ — wa-, and + inṣarama, be cut, snap (VII of ṣarama, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (it) snaps'
حَبْلُهُمْ: حَبْل + هُمْ — ḥabl, rope, bond (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their rope, the bond that holds them'
وَتَفَرَّقَ: وَ + تَفَرَّقَ — wa-, and + tafarraqa, be dispersed, scatter (V, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and (it) scatters'
جَمْعُهُمْ: جَمْع + هُمْ — jamʿ, gathering, host (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their host'
وَأُخْبِرُهُمَا: وَ + أُخْبِرُ + هُمَا — wa-, and + ukhbiru, I inform (IV akhbara, impf. 1 sg.; akhbara bi-, 'inform of': the verb chooses the bi-) + -humā, the two of them; 'and I inform them both'
فَيَخْرُجَانِ: فَـ + يَخْرُجَانِ — fa-, and so + yakhrujāni, the two go out (I kharaja, impf. 3 m. dual); kharaja bi-, 'go out with, lead out'
بِعَسَاكِرِهِمَا: بِـ + عَسَاكِر + هِمَا — bi-, with (prep.: what they lead out, kharaja bi-) + ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar, gen.) + -himā, of the two; 'with their (two) armies'
وَيُهْلِكُونَهُمْ: وَ + يُهْلِكُونَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + yuhlikūna, they destroy (IV ahlaka, impf. 3 m. pl.) + -hum, them; 'and they destroy them'
يَتْرُكُونَ: يَتْرُكُونَ — yatrukūna, they leave (I taraka, impf. 3 m. pl.); lā yatrukūna aḥadan, 'they leave no one'
تَقْطَعُ: تَقْطَعُ — taqṭaʿu, she cuts (I qaṭaʿa, impf. 3 f. sg.); qaṭaʿa al-arḍ, 'cut across the land, travel'
وَأَخْفَتْ: وَ + أَخْفَتْ — wa-, and + akhfat, she hid (IV akhfā, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she hid'
وَتَمَشَّتْ: وَ + تَمَشَّتْ — wa-, and + tamashshat, she walked about, strolled (V tamashshā, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she walked (a little)'
مُنْهَزِمِينَ: مُنْهَزِمِين — munhazimīn, routed, put to flight (act. part. of VII inhazama; m. pl., acc. as circumstantial, or gen. after ghayr); 'routed'
حَرْبِ: حَرْب — ḥarb, war, battle (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the war of'
وَتَحَقَّقَتْ: وَ + تَحَقَّقَتْ — wa-, and + taḥaqqaqa, make certain of, see clearly (V; perfect 3rd f. sg., takes a direct object); 'and she made out clearly'
أَعْلَامَهُمْ: أَعْلَام + ـهُمْ — aʿlām, banners, flags (pl. of ʿalam, acc.) + -hum, their; 'their banners'
فَرَأَتْهَا: فَـ + رَأَتْ + ـهَا — fa-, and so + raʾā, see (I; perfect 3rd f. sg.) + -hā, them (3fs suffix for a non-human plural, the banners); 'and she saw them'
مُنَكَّسَةٍ: مُنَكَّسَة — munakkasa, turned upside down, lowered (pass. part. II of nakkasa, f., gen. after ghayr); of banners, a sign of defeat; 'lowered'
خَائِفِينَ: خَائِفِين — khāʾifīn, fearing, afraid (act. part. of khāfa, m. pl., gen.; the edition's ئ); with ʿalā, 'fearing for'
وَأَصْحَابِهِمْ: وَ + أَصْحَاب + ـهِمْ — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, gen.) + -him, their; 'and their companions'
عَايَنَتْ: عَايَنَتْ — ʿāyana, behold with one's own eyes (III; perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she beheld'
أَسْرَعَتْ: أَسْرَعَتْ — asraʿa, hasten, go quickly (IV; perfect 3rd f. sg.); 'she hastened'
نَحْوَهُمْ: نَحْوَ + ـهُمْ — naḥwa, toward (adverbial acc.) + -hum, them; 'toward them'
بِالْجَرْيِ: بِـ + الـ + جَرْي — bi-, with (prep. of manner) + al-, the + jary, running (verbal noun of jarā, gen.); 'at a run'
الشَّدِيدِ: الـ + شَدِيد — al-, the + shadīd, hard, violent, intense (adj., m., gen.); 'the hard'
الْمَرِيدِ: الـ + مَرِيد — al-, the + marīd, rebellious, refractory (adj., m., gen.; Qurʾānic epithet of Satan); 'the rebellious'
جُنْدَ: جُنْد — jund, army, host, soldiery (m., acc. after yā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'army of'
جِهَادِ: جِهَاد — jihād, holy war, struggle (verbal noun of jāhada, gen. after ilā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the holy war against'
حِزْبِ: حِزْب — ḥizb, party, faction (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the party of'
وَلِيَّ: وَلِيّ — waliyy, friend, protégé; with allāh, 'friend of God', a saint (m., acc. after yā, first term of an iḍāfa)
وَرَاءَكَ: وَرَاءَ + ـكَ — warāʾa, behind (adverbial acc.; the edition's ء) + -ka, you (m. sg.); mā warāʾaka, 'what news do you bring?'
لَاتَسْأَلْ: لَا + تَسْأَلْ — lā, do not (prohibitive) + tasʾal, ask (I, jussive 2nd m. sg. of saʾala); printed as one word; 'do not ask'
وَشَدِيدِ: وَ + شَدِيد — wa-, and + shadīd, severe, intense (adj. used as a noun, gen., first term of an iḍāfa: 'the severe of'); 'and the direness of'
هْوَالِ: (أَ)هْوَال — -hwāli, the rest of al-ahwāl, 'the terrors' (pl. of hawl, gen.), printed apart from الا; read with the word before
أَصْحَابَنَا: أَصْحَاب + ـنَا — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib, acc. after inna) + -nā, our; 'our companions'
يَتَوَجَّهُوا: يَتَوَجَّهُوا — tawajjaha, turn toward, set out for (V; subjunctive 3rd m. pl. after an); with ilā, 'to make for'
بَأْسٍ: بَأْس — baʾs, might, valour in war (m., gen. after dhū); dhū baʾsin, 'formidable'
أَعَادَتْ: أَعَادَتْ — aʿāda, repeat, tell again (IV; perfect 3rd f. sg.); with ilā, 'she repeated to'
إِرْجَافًا: إِرْجَاف — irjāf, spreading of alarming rumours (verbal noun of IV arjafa, acc. indef., of purpose); 'to spread alarm'
وَوَجَلًا: وَ + وَجَل — wa-, and + wajal, fear, dread (m., acc. indef., of purpose); 'and (to cause) dread'
أَكْثَرَهُمْ: أَكْثَر + ـهُمْ — akthar, most, the greater part (elative, acc. after inna) + -hum, of them; 'most of them'
فَارَقْتَهُمْ: فَارَقْتَ + ـهُمْ — fāraqa, part from, leave (III; perfect 2nd m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'you parted from them'
الْبَعِيدَةَ: الـ + بَعِيدَة — al-, the + baʿīda, far, distant (adj., f., acc.); 'the far-off'
قَدَمَيْكَ: قَدَمَيْ + ـكَ — qadamay, two feet (dual of qadam, gen. after ʿalā, nūn dropped before the suffix) + -ka, your; 'your two feet'
جَرِيدَةٍ: جَرِيدَة — jarīda, palm-stalk stripped of leaves, used as a staff (f., gen. indef. after ʿalā); 'a palm-staff'
الْأَوْلِيَاءِ: الـ + أَوْلِيَاء — al-, the + awliyāʾ, saints, friends of God (pl. of waliyy, gen. after min); 'the saints'
الطَّيَّارَةِ: الـ + طَيَّارَة — al-, the + ṭayyāra, fliers, those who fly (intensive form, f. used for a class of persons, gen., agreeing with al-awliyāʾ); 'the flying (ones)'
الْمُلْهَمِينَ: الـ + مُلْهَمِين — al-, the + mulhamīn, inspired (pass. part. IV of alhama, m. pl., gen.; takes what is inspired as its object); 'the inspired with'
وَحْيَ: وَحْي — waḥy, revelation, inspiration (m., acc., object of mulhamīn, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the revelation of'
مَدْهُوشٌ: مَدْهُوش — madhūsh, dazed, stunned (pass. part. of dahasha, m., nom. indef.); 'dazed'
حَيْرَانُ: حَيْرَان — ḥayrān, bewildered, perplexed (adj., m., diptote, nom.); 'bewildered'
الْإِفْكِ: الـ + إِفْك — al-, the + ifk, lie, falsehood (m., gen.); 'the lie'
ضَاعَ: ضَاعَ — ḍāʿa, be lost, wasted (I hollow; perfect 3rd m. sg.); 'has been lost'
تَعَبُنَا: تَعَب + ـنَا — taʿab, toil, labour (m., nom.) + -nā, our; 'our toil'
صُدُورُنَا: صُدُور + ـنَا — ṣudūr, breasts (pl. of ṣadr, nom.) + -nā, our; ḍāqat ṣudūrunā, 'our hearts are heavy'
وَأُسِرَ: وَ + أُسِرَ — wa-, and + usira, was taken captive (I passive, perfect 3rd m. sg. of asara; the print marks the ḍamma); 'and was captured'
سُلْطَانُنَا: سُلْطَان + ـنَا — sulṭān, sultan (m., nom.) + -nā, our; 'our sultan'
جَعَلُوا: جَعَلُوا — jaʿala, to make, put; with a following imperfect, 'to begin to, set about' (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they set about'
طُولًا: طُول — ṭūl, length (m., acc. as adverb); ṭūlan wa-ʿarḍan, 'lengthwise and crosswise', i.e. 'far and wide'
وَعَرْضًا: وَ + عَرْض — wa-, and + ʿarḍ, breadth, width (m., acc. as adverb); 'and in breadth'
رأْسِ: رَأْس — raʾs, head; of a pass or valley, its upper end (m., gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the head of' (the print has the precomposed hamza)
فَرأَوْا: فَـ + رَأَوْا — fa-, and so + raʾaw, they saw (raʾā, verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they saw'
يُنَادِيَانِ: يُنَادِيَانِ — nādā, to call out, cry aloud (verb III, impf. 3 m. dual); with bi-, 'cry (a formula)'; 'the two of them calling out'
إِحَاطَةَ: إِحَاطَة — iḥāṭa, surrounding, encircling (f., verbal noun of IV aḥāṭa; acc., cognate object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'a surrounding like that of'
السَّيْلِ: الـ + سَيْل — al-, the + sayl, torrent, flood (m., gen.); 'the torrent'
بِالْقِفَارِ: بِـ + الـ + قِفَار — bi- (required by iḥāṭa, 'surrounding of') + al-, the + qifār, deserts, empty wastes (pl. of qafr, gen.); 'the wastes'
صِيَاحًا: صِيَاح — ṣiyāḥ, shouting, cry (m., verbal noun of ṣāḥa; acc., cognate object, indef.); 'a shouting'
ضَجَّتْ: ضَجَّتْ — ḍajja, to clamour, raise an uproar (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs, agreeing with a broken plural); 'clamoured'
الْأَبْطَالُ: الـ + أَبْطَال — al-, the + abṭāl, champions, heroes (pl. of baṭal; nom.); 'the champions'
وَتَصَدَّعَتْ: وَ + تَصَدَّعَتْ — wa-, and + taṣaddaʿa, to be split, cleave apart (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and were split'
فَاحَ: فَاحَ — fāḥa, to waft, spread (of a scent) (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); 'wafted'
طِيبُهُ: طِيب + ـهُ — ṭīb, fragrance, perfume (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his fragrance'
وَنَشْرُهُ: وَ + نَشْر + ـهُ — wa-, and + nashr, sweet smell, scent spread abroad (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his scent'
وَتَعَارَفُوا: وَ + تَعَارَفُوا — wa-, and + taʿārafa, to know one another, make oneself known to each other (verb VI, perf. 3mp); 'and they recognised one another'
بِبَعْضِهِمْ: بِـ + بَعْض + ـهِمْ — bi-, with (marks the partner, after taʿārafa) + baʿḍ, some (m., gen.) + -him, of them; 'with one another'
كَمَاتَقَدَّمَ: كَـ + مَا + تَقَدَّمَ — ka-, as, like + mā, what (ka-mā, 'as') + taqaddama, to go before, precede (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'as has gone before'; the print runs كما and تقدم together
وَأَخْبَرَهُمْ: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3ms; takes bi- of what is told) + -hum, them; 'and he told them'
أَسْرِعُوا: أَسْرِعُوا — asraʿa, to hasten (verb IV, imperative 2mp); with binā, 'hurry with us', i.e. 'let us hurry'
تَرَكْنَا: تَرَكْنَا — taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 1pl); 'we left'
وَقُلُوبُنَا: وَ + قُلُوب + ـنَا — wa-, and + qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb; nom.) + -nā, our; 'and our hearts'
وَتَوَكَّلُوا: وَ + تَوَكَّلُوا — wa-, and + tawakkala, to put one's trust (verb V, perf. 3mp; takes ʿalā, 'in'); 'and they trusted'
يُقَوِّى: يُقَوِّي — qawwā, to strengthen, hearten (verb II final-weak, impf. 3ms; the print spells the end with ى); with ʿalā, 'strengthen (someone) for'; 'he strengthens'
الثَّبَاتِ: الـ + ثَبَات — al-, the + thabāt, standing firm, steadfastness (m., verbal noun, gen. after ʿalā); 'standing firm'
يَامُسْتَوْجِبَ: يَا + مُسْتَوْجِب — yā, O (vocative) + mustawjib, one who deserves, merits (act. part. of X istawjaba; acc. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'O deserver of'; the print runs يا and the noun together
الْحَمْدِ: الـ + حَمْد — al-, the + ḥamd, praise (m., gen.); 'the praise'
وَالشُّكْرِ: وَ + الـ + شُكْر — wa-, and + al-, the + shukr, thanks, gratitude (m., gen.); 'and the thanks'
زِلْتَ: زِلْتَ — zāla (yazālu), to cease; mā zilta, 'you have not ceased, you have always been' (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms); 'you ceased'
بِالْعَوْنِ: بِـ + الـ + عَوْن — bi-, with (prep.; mā zilta lī bi-al-ʿawni, 'you have never ceased to be, for me, with help') + al-, the + ʿawn, help, aid (m., gen.); 'with help'
يَارَبِّ: يَا + رَبّ + ـِ — yā, O (vocative) + rabb, Lord + -i, my (shortened suffix); 'O my Lord'; the print runs يا and the noun together
اَمْرِي: اَمْر + ـِي — amr, affair, matter (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my affair' (hamza unprinted)
رَبَّيْتَ: رَبَّيْتَ — rabbā, to rear, bring up (verb II final-weak, perf. 2ms); 'you reared'
غَرِيْبًا: غَرِيْب — gharīb, stranger, one far from home (m., acc., indef.); 'a stranger'
كَفِيْلاً: كَفِيْل — kafīl, guarantor, protector (m., acc., predicate of kunta); 'a guarantor'
قَدَّرْتَ: قَدَّرْتَ — qaddara, to decree, ordain (verb II, perf. 2ms); 'you decreed'
نَصْرِيْ: نَصْر + ـِيْ — naṣr, victory, help (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my victory'
وَاَعْطَيْتَنِي: وَ + اَعْطَيْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'and you gave me'
مَالاً: مَال — māl, wealth, property (m., acc., indef.); 'wealth'
وَمُلْكًا: وَ + مُلْك — wa-, and + mulk, kingship, sovereignty (m., acc.); 'and kingship'
وَنِعْمَةً: وَ + نِعْمَة — wa-, and + niʿma, favour, blessing, prosperity (f., acc.); 'and favour'
وَقَلَّدْتَنِي: وَ + قَلَّدْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + qallada, to gird (someone) with, hang on (verb II, perf. 2ms; two objects) + -nī, me; 'and you girded me with'
الشُّجَّاعَةِ: الـ + شُجَّاعَة — al-, the + shajāʿa, courage (f., gen.); the print points it al-shujjāʿa, with a doubled jīm, for the usual al-shajāʿa
وَالنَّصْرِ: وَ + الـ + نَصْر — wa-, and + al-, the + naṣr, victory (m., gen.); 'and the victory'
وَخَوَّلْتَنِي: وَ + خَوَّلْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + khawwala, to grant, bestow on (verb II, perf. 2ms; two objects) + -nī, me; 'and you granted me'
الْمَلِيْكِ: الـ + مَلِيْك — al-, the + malīk, king (m., gen.; poetic for malik); 'the king'
مُعَمَّرًا: مُعَمَّر — muʿammar, long-lived, granted long life (pass. part. of II ʿammara; acc. of state); 'long-lived'
فَيْضِ: فَيْض — fayḍ, overflow, abundance (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the overflow of'
جُوْدِكَ: جُوْد + ـِكَ — jūd, generosity, bounty (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your bounty'
بِالْغَمْرِ: بِـ + الـ + غَمْر — bi- (jāda bi-, 'be generous with': the verb chooses the bi-, which marks what is given) + al-, the + ghamr, abundant, copious (water); abundance (gen.); 'with abundance'
وَسَلِمْتَنِي: وَ + سَلِمْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + salima, to be safe (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; as printed this does not construe — the sense wants sallamtanī (verb II), 'you kept me safe'
خَطْبٍ: خَطْب — khaṭb, calamity, grave matter (m., gen., indef., after kull); 'calamity'
حَذَرْتُهُ: حَذَرْتُ + ـهُ — ḥadhira, to fear, be wary of (verb I, perf. 1s; printed with fatḥa, ḥadhartu) + -hu, it; 'I feared it'
بِمَشْوَرَةِ: بِـ + مَشْوَرَة — bi-, by, through (instrument) + mashwara, counsel, advice (f., gen.); 'by the counsel of'
الْوَزِيْرِ: الـ + وَزِيْر — al-, the + wazīr, vizier (m., gen., in apposition); 'the vizier'
