الدَّهْرِى: الـ + دَهْر — al-, the + dahr, time, the age (m., gen.); printed with a final ى to rhyme in -rī; 'the age'
بِفَضْلِكَ: بِـ + فَضْل + ـِكَ — bi-, by, through (cause) + faḍl, grace, bounty (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your grace'
صُلْنَا: صُلْنَا — ṣāla (yaṣūlu), to assail, attack (verb I hollow, perf. 1pl; with ʿalā, 'upon'); 'we assailed'
صَوْلَةً: صَوْلَة — ṣawla, assault, onslaught (f., acc., cognate object); 'an assault'
رَجَعُوْا: رَجَعُوْا — rajaʿa, to return, go back (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they went back'
حُلَلٍ: حُلَل — ḥulal, robes, garments (pl. of ḥulla; gen. after fī, indef.); 'robes'
حُمْرِ: حُمْر — ḥumr, red (pl. of aḥmar; gen., agreeing with ḥulal; tanwīn dropped at the rhyme); 'red'
وَاَظْهَرْتُ: وَ + اَظْهَرْتُ — wa-, and + aẓhara, to make apparent, feign (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'and I made a show'
هُزِمْتُ: هُزِمْتُ — huzima, to be routed, defeated (verb I passive, perf. 1s); 'I was routed'
هَزِيْمَةً: هَزِيْمَة — hazīma, rout, defeat (f., acc., cognate object); 'a rout'
وَعُدْتُ: وَ + عُدْتُ — wa-, and + ʿāda, to return, turn back (verb I hollow, perf. 1s; with ʿalā, 'turn back upon'); 'and I turned back'
عَوْدَةَ: عَوْدَة — ʿawda, a return, turning back (f., acc., cognate object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the turning of'
الضَّيْغَمِ: الـ + ضَيْغَم — al-, the + ḍaygham, lion (m., gen.); 'the lion'
الْغَمْرِ: الـ + غَمْر — al-, the + ghamr, abundant, overwhelming; of a man, generous, bold (gen., adjective); 'the overwhelming'
تَرَكْتُهُمْ: تَرَكْتُ + ـهُمْ — taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hum, them; 'I left them'
الْقَاعِ: الـ + قَاع — al-, the + qāʿ, plain, level hollow (m., gen. after fī); 'the plain'
كَاَنَّهُمْ: كَاَنَّ + ـهُمْ — kaʾanna, as though (particle) + -hum, they; 'as though they'
نَشَاوَى: نَشَاوَى — nashāwā, drunken, tipsy (pl. of nashwān; predicate of kaʾanna, invariable); 'drunken'
بِكَأْسِ: بِـ + كَأْس — bi-, with, from (cause: what made them drunk) + kaʾs, cup (f., gen.); 'with the cup of'
قَهْوَةِ: قَهْوَة — qahwa, wine (old poetic word; later 'coffee') (f., gen., parallel to kaʾs); 'the wine of'
بِاَيْدِيْنَا: بِـ + اَيْدِي + ـنَا — bi-, in (prep.) + aydī, hands (pl. of yad; gen.) + -nā, our; 'in our hands'
كَرَامَتُهُ: كَرَامَة + ـهُ — karāma, a saint's wonder, miracle of grace (f., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his wonder-working'
شَاعَتْ: شَاعَتْ — shāʿa, to spread, become known (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'spread'
لَدَى: لَدَى — ladā, with, among, in the presence of (prep.)
وَالْحَضْرِ: وَ + الـ + حَضْر — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥaḍr, settled folk, town-dwellers (collective, gen.); 'and the settled'
اَتَيْنَا: اَتَيْنَا — atā, to come (verb I final-weak, perf. 1pl); 'we came'
لِاَخْذِ: لِـ + اَخْذ — li-, for, in order to (purpose) + akhdh, taking (m., verbal noun, gen.); 'for the taking of'
الثَّارِ: الـ + ثَار — al-, the + thaʾr, blood-vengeance (m., gen.; hamza unprinted); 'the vengeance'
كَافِرِ: كَافِر — kāfir, unbeliever (m., gen. after kull; printed with kasra, no tanwīn, at the half-line's end); 'unbeliever'
قَتَلُوْا: قَتَلُوْا — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they killed'
فَاَصْبَحُوْا: فَـ + اَصْبَحُوْا — fa-, and so + aṣbaḥa, to become (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they became'
غُرَفٌ: غُرَف — ghuraf, upper chambers (pl. of ghurfa; nom., indef.); 'chambers'
تَعْلُوْ: تَعْلُوْ — ʿalā (yaʿlū), to rise, be high (verb I final-weak, impf. 3fs, agreeing with ghuraf); with ʿalā, 'rise above'
أَفْعَالِهِ: أَفْعَال + ـهِ — afʿāl, deeds (pl. of fiʿl; gen. after ʿalā, 'for') + -hi, his; 'his deeds'
الْمَسِيرَ: الـ + مَسِير — al-, the + masīr, going, march (m., acc., object of mujiddīna); 'the march' Also as the object of arāda: فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ الْمَسِيرَ 'when I was about to set out'.
هَنَّأَهُ: هَنَّأَ + ـهُ — hannaʾa, to congratulate (verb II, perf. 3ms; takes bi-, 'on') + -hu, him; 'he congratulated him' (the print has the precomposed hamza)
الْأَسْوَارِ: الـ + أَسْوَار — al-, the + aswār, city walls, ramparts (pl. of sūr, gen., e.g. after ʿalā); 'the walls'
أَصْحَابَنَا: أَصْحَاب + ـنَا — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; acc., e.g. after inna or as object) + -nā, our; 'our companions'
بِدُونَكُمْ: بِـ + دُون + كُمْ — the letters could be read, bi-, with, in (prep.) + dūn, below, without + -kum, you (pl.): 'without you'; here probably the urging word dūnakum, 'to it, at them!' (taking its object in the acc.), with an extra bi- in front; doubtful
الْمِائَةِ: الـ + مِائَة — miʾa, hundred (f., gen.; the alif of مائة is silent); 'the hundred'
هَنَّأَ: هَنَّأَ — hannaʾa, to congratulate (II, perf. 3ms); with bi-, 'congratulate on'
لَاقَتْ: لَاقَتْ — lāqat (lāqā, to meet, encounter; III, perf. 3fs); 'she met'
الْغَابَةِ: الـ + غَابَة — ghāba, thicket, wood (f., gen.); 'the thicket'
وَأَسْرَعَتْ: وَ + أَسْرَعَتْ — wa-, and + asraʿat (asraʿa, to hurry; IV, perf. 3fs); 'and she hastened'
سَيْرِهَا: سَيْر + هَا — sayr, going, journey (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her going'
أَشْرَفَتْ: أَشْرَفَتْ — ashrafat (ashrafa ʿalā, to come in sight of, look down on; IV, perf. 3fs); 'she came in sight of'
الْمُحَاصِرِينَ: الـ + مُحَاصِرِين — muḥāṣir, besieging (act. part. of III ḥāṣara; m. pl., gen.); 'the besiegers'
لِلْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةِ: لِـ + الـ + قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة — li-, marking the object of the participle + al-Qusṭanṭīniyya, Constantinople (f., gen.); '(besieging) Constantinople'
رَأٰهَا: رَأٰى + هَا — raʾā, to see (perf. 3ms; print رأها, long alif not written) + -hā, her; 'he saw her'
بِالْعَابِدِ: بِـ + الـ + عَابِد — bi-, after marḥaban, marks the one welcomed + ʿābid, worshipper, devout man (m., gen.); 'to the worshipper'
سَأَلَهَا: سَأَلَ + هَا — saʾala, to ask (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'he asked her'
الْمُرْجِفِ: الـ + مُرْجِف — murjif, alarming, rumour-spreading (act. part. of IV arjafa; m., gen.); 'the alarming'
الْمُتْلِفِ: الـ + مُتْلِف — mutlif, ruinous, destroying (act. part. of IV atlafa; m., gen.); 'the ruinous'
الْأَمِيرِ: الـ + أَمِير — amīr, emir, commander (m., gen.); 'the emir'
وَالْأَمِيرِ: وَ + الـ + أَمِير — wa-, and + amīr, emir (m., gen.); 'and the emir'
لَاقَيْتُهُمَا: لَاقَيْتُ + هُمَا — lāqaytu (lāqā, to meet; III, perf. 1s) + -humā, the two of them; 'I met them both'
عَسْكَرِهِمَا: عَسْكَر + هِمَا — ʿaskar, army (m., gen.) + -himā, of the two; 'their army'
وَأَرْسَلْتُهُمَا: وَ + أَرْسَلْتُ + هُمَا — wa-, and + arsaltu (arsala, to send; IV, perf. 1s) + -humā, the two of them; 'and I sent them both'
وَالْكُفَّارُ: وَ + الـ + كُفَّار — wa-, and + kuffār, infidels (pl. of kāfir; nom.); 'and the infidels'
يَلْحَقُوهُمْ: يَلْحَقُوا + هُمْ — yalḥaqū (laḥiqa, to catch up with, overtake; subj. 3mp after ḥattā) + -hum, them; 'that they overtake them'
يَهْلِكُوا: يَهْلِكُوا — yahlikū (halaka, to perish; subj. 3mp after li-allā); '(lest) they perish'
وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ: وَ + الـ + مُسْلِمُون — wa-, and + muslimūn, Muslims (m. pl., nom.); 'and the Muslims'
انْحَلَّتْ: انْحَلَّتْ — inḥallat (inḥalla, to come undone, slacken; VII, perf. 3fs); 'gave way'
عَزَائِمُهُمْ: عَزَائِم + هُمْ — ʿazāʾim, resolves (pl. of ʿazīma; nom.) + -hum, their; 'their resolve'
اسْتَعِينُوا: اسْتَعِينُوا — istaʿīnū (istaʿāna bi-, to seek help from; X, impv. 2mp); 'seek help'
وَاصْبِرُوا: وَ + اصْبِرُوا — wa-, and + iṣbirū (ṣabara ʿalā, to bear patiently; impv. 2mp); 'and be patient'
الرَّزِيَّةِ: الـ + رَزِيَّة — raziyya, calamity, grievous loss (f., gen.); 'the calamity'
أُسْوَةٌ: أُسْوَة — uswa, example, model (f., nom.); with bi-, 'an example in'
الْأُمَّةِ: الـ + أُمَّة — umma, community, nation (f., gen.); 'the community'
الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ: الـ + مُحَمَّدِيَّة — muḥammadiyya, Muhammadan, of Muhammad (f. adj., gen.); 'the Muhammadan'
الْقُصُورِ: الـ + قُصُور — quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr; gen.); 'the palaces'
أَعَدَّهَا: أَعَدَّ + هَا — aʿadda, to prepare, make ready (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'he has prepared it'
شَهِيدًا: شَهِيد — shahīd, martyr (m., acc. of state); 'as a martyr'
بِأَخِ: بِـ + أَخ — bi-, after daʿā marks the one summoned + akh, brother (gen., construct; colloquial short form for akhī); '(called) for the brother of'
تُرْكَاشُ: تُرْكَاش — Turkāsh, proper name (Bahrām's brother; vowels editorial), nom.; 'Turkāsh'
وَانْتَخَبَ: وَ + انْتَخَبَ — wa-, and + intakhaba, to pick out, select (VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and he chose'
أَبْطَالٍ: أَبْطَال — abṭāl, heroes, champions (pl. of baṭal; gen., in apposition); 'heroes'
عَوَابِسَ: عَوَابِس — ʿawābis, grim-faced ones (pl. of ʿābis; diptote, gen. with fatḥa); 'grim-faced'
وَطُولَ: وَ + طُولَ — wa-, and + ṭūl, length (m., acc. of time); 'and the length of, all through'
مُقْبِلَةٌ: مُقْبِلَة — muqbila, advancing, approaching (act. part. of IV aqbala; f., nom.); with ʿalā, 'advancing upon' Also, of a task, 'setting about': muqbilatun ʿalā mā amara bihi, 'setting about what he had ordered'.
فَإِمَّا: فَـ + إِمَّا — fa-, so + immā, either (print اما without hamza); 'so either'
يَكُونُوا: يَكُونُوا — yakūnū (kāna, to be; subj. 3mp after an); 'that they be'
النَّصْرُ: الـ + نَصْر — naṣr, victory (m., nom.); 'the victory'
الْمُبِينُ: الـ + مُبِين — mubīn, manifest, clear (act. part. of IV abāna; m., nom.); 'the manifest' ; also: of a poet, 'clear-spoken, eloquent': al-shāʿiru al-mubīnu, 'the eloquent poet'
اعْتِرَاضَ: اعْتِرَاض — iʿtirāḍ, objection (VIII verbal noun; acc. after lā of negation); 'no objecting'
الْأَقْدَارِ: الـ + أَقْدَار — aqdār, decrees of fate (pl. of qadar; gen.); 'the decrees'
أَعْدَاؤُنَا: أَعْدَاء + نَا — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww; nom. where Classical wants acc. after kāna) + -nā, our; 'our enemies'
أُقَابِلَ: أُقَابِلَ — uqābila (qābala, to meet face to face; III, subj. 1s after an); 'that I meet'
مَوْتِي: مَوْت + ي — mawt, death (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my death' Also nom., subject: ṭāba mawtī, 'my death has become sweet'.
لِأَسْأَلَهُ: لِـ + أَسْأَلَ + هُ — li-, in order to (purpose) + asʾala (saʾala, to ask; subj. 1s) + -hu, him; 'to ask him'
يَدْعُوَلِي: يَدْعُوَ + لِـ + ي — yadʿuwa (daʿā li-, to pray for; subj. 3ms after an) + li-, for + -ī, me; 'that he pray for me' (one word in the print)
إِلَّاشَهِيدًا: إِلَّا + شَهِيدًا — illā, except + shahīd, martyr (acc. of state); 'except as a martyr' (one word in the print)
بِالرَّايَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + رَايَات — bi-, after idhā of surprise, marks what appears + rāyāt, banners (pl. of rāya; gen.); 'behold, the banners'
بِعَافِيَةٍ: بِـ + عَافِيَة — bi-, in (state) + ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f., gen.); 'in well-being'
إِلَّاخَوْفًا: إِلَّا + خَوْفًا — illā, except + khawf, fear (acc. of cause); 'only out of fear' (one word in the print)
وَرُسْتُمُ: وَ + رُسْتُم — wa-, and + Rustam, proper name (diptote, nom.); 'and Rustam'
اَمَاهُمُ: اَ + مَا + هُمُ — a-, question particle + mā, not + hum, they (the print's own vowels on اَمَا); 'are they not'
سَالِمُونَ: سَالِمُون — sālimūn, safe, unharmed (act. part. of salima; m. pl., nom.); 'safe'
وَمَنِ: وَ + مَنْ — wa-, and + man, who (kasra before the following al-); 'and who'
أَخْبَرَكُمْ: أَخْبَرَ + كُمْ — akhbara bi-, to inform of (IV, perf. 3ms) + -kum, you (pl.); 'told you'
بِخَبَرِنَا: بِـ + خَبَر + نَا — bi-, of (the thing told; akhbara chooses it) + khabar, news (m., gen.) + -nā, our; 'of our news'
ذَكَرَ: ذَكَرَ — dhakara, to mention, relate (perf. 3ms); 'he mentioned'
وَأَرْسَلَهُمَا: وَ + أَرْسَلَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + arsala, to send (IV, perf. 3ms) + -humā, the two of them; 'and he sent them both'
كَثِيرُونَ: كَثِيرُون — kathīrūn, many, numerous (m. pl., nom.); 'many'
مَنْصُورُونَ: مَنْصُورُون — manṣūrūn, made victorious, granted victory (pass. part. of naṣara; m. pl., nom.); 'victorious'
وُصُولُ: وُصُول — wuṣūl, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala; nom.); 'the arrival of'
وَلَيْلَةٍ: وَ + لَيْلَة — wa-, and + layla, night (f., gen.); 'and a night'
لِلْفَارِسِ: لِـ + الـ + فَارِس — li-, for + fāris, horseman (m., gen.); 'for the horseman'
الْمُجِدِّ: الـ + مُجِدّ — mujidd, hard-pressing, making haste (act. part. of IV ajadda; m., gen.); 'riding hard'
تَرَكْنَاهُ: تَرَكْنَا + هُ — taraknā (taraka, to leave; perf. 1p) + -hu, him; 'we left him'
الْإِيمَانِ: الـ + إِيمَان — īmān, faith (IV verbal noun of āmana; gen.); 'the faith'
وَحَمِدُوا: وَ + حَمِدُوا — wa-, and + ḥamidū (ḥamida, to praise; perf. 3mp); 'and they praised'
سَلَامَتِهِمْ: سَلَامَة + هِمْ — salāma, safety (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'their safety'
وَتَرَحَّمُوا: وَ + تَرَحَّمُوا — wa-, and + taraḥḥamū (taraḥḥama ʿalā, to ask God's mercy on; V, perf. 3mp); 'and they asked mercy upon'
كَسَرُوا: كَسَرُوا — kasarū (kasara, to break; of an army, to rout; perf. 3mp); 'they have routed'
الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ: الـ + مَشْرِقَيْن — mashriqayn, the two easts, i.e. east and west (dual of mashriq; acc./gen.); 'east and west'
حَالِكِ: حَالِك — ḥālik, intensely black (act. part.; gen., construct); 'the pitch-black of'
تَقْرُبُ: تَقْرُبُ — taqrubu (qaruba min, to draw near to; imperf. 3fs); 'it drew near'
الدِّعَامَةُ: الـ + دِعَامَة — diʿāma, pillar, prop (f., nom.); 'the pillar'
هَوْلِ: هَوْل — hawl, terror, dread (m., gen., construct); 'the terror of'
فَتَسَارَعَتْ: فَـ + تَسَارَعَتْ — fa-, and so + tasāraʿat (tasāraʿa ilā, to hasten to; VI, perf. 3fs); 'and they hastened'
لِيَنْظُرُوا: لِـ + يَنْظُرُوا — li-, in order to (purpose) + yanẓurū (naẓara, to look, see; subj. 3mp); 'to see'
الْمُشَارَ: الـ + مُشَار — mushār, pointed to (pass. part. of IV ashāra); al-mushār ilayhi, 'the one already mentioned' (acc.)
فَازْدَحَمُوا: فَـ + ازْدَحَمُوا — fa-, and + izdaḥamū (izdaḥama ʿalā, to crowd round, throng; VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and they crowded'
وَمِصْبَاحِ: وَ + مِصْبَاح — wa-, and + miṣbāḥ, lamp (m., gen., construct); 'and the lamp of'
غَدَرُوا: غَدَرُوا — ghadarū (ghadara bi-, to betray, act treacherously toward; perf. 3mp); 'they betrayed'
فَأَدْرِكُوا: فَـ + أَدْرِكُوا — fa-, so + adrikū (adraka, to overtake, come to the aid of; IV, impv. 2mp); 'so reach (them)'
وَأَنْقِذُوهُمْ: وَ + أَنْقِذُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and + anqidhū (anqadha, to rescue; IV, impv. 2mp) + -hum, them; 'and rescue them'
الْعَذَابُ: الـ + عَذَاب — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., nom.); 'the torment'
الْمُهِينُ: الـ + مُهِين — muhīn, humiliating (act. part. of IV ahāna; m., nom.); 'the humiliating'
الْخَفَقَانِ: الـ + خَفَقَان — khafaqān, throbbing, palpitation (verbal noun of khafaqa; gen.); 'the throbbing'
جَوَادِةِ: جَوَاد + ة — jawād, horse, steed (m., gen.) + -hi, his (pronoun written with tāʾ marbūṭa in the print); 'his horse'
يَتَرَجَّلْ: يَتَرَجَّلْ — yatarajjal (tarajjala, to dismount; V, juss. 3ms after lam); '(did not) dismount'
لِلْمُتَنَطِّعِينَ: لِـ + الـ + مُتَنَطِّعِين — li-, of/in (those in whom something is known) + mutanaṭṭiʿīn, zealots, over-scrupulous ones (act. part. of V tanaṭṭaʿa; m. pl., gen.); 'in the zealots'
الْمَفَاسِدِ: الـ + مَفَاسِد — mafāsid, corruptions, mischiefs (pl. of mafsada; gen.); 'the mischiefs'
فَاتْرُكُوةُ: فَـ + اتْرُكُوا + ةُ — fa-, so + utrukū (taraka, to leave; impv. 2mp) + -hu, him (written with tāʾ marbūṭa in the print); 'so leave him'
وَأَدْرِكُوا: وَ + أَدْرِكُوا — wa-, and + adrikū (adraka, to overtake, come to the aid of; IV, impv. 2mp); 'and go to the aid of'
أَصْحَابَكُمُ: أَصْحَاب + كُمُ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; acc.) + -kum, your; 'your companions'
الْمَطْرُودِينَ: الـ + مَطْرُودِين — maṭrūdīn, driven away, outcast (pass. part. of ṭarada; m. pl., gen.); 'the outcasts'
وَدُسْتُ: وَ + دُسْتُ — wa-, and + dustu (dāsa, to tread, trample; perf. 1s); 'and I trod'
أَرَاضِيَ: أَرَاضِي — arāḍī, lands (pl. of arḍ; acc.); 'the lands of'
الظَّنَّ: الـ + ظَنّ — ẓann, suspicion, opinion (m., acc.); 'the suspicion'
الْفَاسِدَ: الـ + فَاسِد — fāsid, corrupt, wicked (m., acc.); 'the corrupt'
يُحَرِّضُ: يُحَرِّضُ — yuḥarriḍu (ḥarraḍa ʿalā, to urge on to; II, imperf. 3ms); 'he urges'
يُبَالِي: يُبَالِي — yubālī (bālā bi-, to care about, heed; III, imperf. 3ms); '(does not) care'
وَالنِّبَالِ: وَ + الـ + نِبَال — wa-, and + nibāl, arrows (pl. of nabl; gen.); 'and the arrows'
تَغْتَبْهُ: تَغْتَبْ + هُ — taghtab (ightāba, to backbite, slander in absence; VIII, juss. 2ms after lā of prohibition) + -hu, him; 'do not backbite him'
الْغِيبَةَ: الـ + غِيبَة — ghība, backbiting, slander of the absent (f., acc. after anna); 'backbiting'
مَذْمُومَةٌ: مَذْمُومَة — madhmūma, blameworthy (pass. part. of dhamma; f., nom.); 'blameworthy'
وَلُحُومَ: وَ + لُحُوم — wa-, and + luḥūm, flesh, meats (pl. of laḥm; acc. after anna); 'and the flesh of'
مَسْمُومَةٌ: مَسْمُومَة — masmūma, poisoned (pass. part. of samma; f., nom.); 'poisoned'
تَحْرِيضِهِ: تَحْرِيض + هِ — taḥrīḍ, urging on (II verbal noun of ḥarraḍa; gen.) + -hi, his; 'his urging'
أَعْدَائِنَا: أَعْدَاء + نَا — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww; gen.) + -nā, our; 'our enemies'
يُحِبُّهُ: يُحِبُّ + هُ — yuḥibbu (aḥabba, to love; IV, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'loves him'
الْبَعِيدَ: الـ + بَعِيد — baʿīd, far, distant (m., acc.); 'the far (part)'
أَوْقَعَهُ: أَوْقَعَ + هُ — awqaʿa, to make fall, cast (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he let him fall'
يُقَدِّمُوا: يُقَدِّمُوا — yuqaddimū (qaddama, to bring forward, present; II, subj. 3mp after an); 'that they bring forward'
لِيَرْكَبَهَا: لِـ + يَرْكَبَ + هَا — li-, in order to (purpose) + yarkaba (rakiba, to ride; subj. 3ms) + -hā, it (f.); 'to ride it'
النَّاسِكُ: الـ + نَاسِك — nāsik, devotee, ascetic (m., nom.); 'the devotee'
يَقْبَلْ: يَقْبَلْ — yaqbal (qabila, to accept; juss. 3ms after lam); '(did not) accept'
الزُّهْدَ: الـ + زُهْد — zuhd, asceticism, self-denial (m., acc.); 'asceticism'
لِيَنٰلَ: لِـ + يَنٰلَ — li-, in order to (purpose) + yanāla (nāla, to obtain; subj. 3ms; print لينل, long alif not written); 'to obtain'
الْمَطْلُوبَ: الـ + مَطْلُوب — maṭlūb, what is sought (pass. part. of ṭalaba; acc.); 'the thing sought'
دَرَوْا: دَرَوْا — daraw (darā, to know, be aware; perf. 3mp); 'they knew'
الْعَاهِرَ: الـ + عَاهِر — ʿāhir, fornicator, debauchee (m., acc.); 'the lecherous'
وَصَامَ: وَ + صَامَ — wa-, and + ṣāma, to fast (perf. 3ms); 'and he fasted'
صَامَا: صَامَ — ṣāma, to fast (perf. 3ms; the final alif is the rhyme's lengthening); '(nor) fasted'
الْمُحْتَالُ: الـ + مُحْتَال — muḥtāl, wily, trickster (act. part. of VIII iḥtāla; m., nom.); 'the cunning'
لِلِاغْتِيَالِ: لِـ + الـ + اغْتِيَال — li-, for (purpose) + ightiyāl, taking unawares, assassination (VIII verbal noun; gen.); 'for the ambush'
رَافِعًا: رَافِع — rāfiʿ, raising (act. part. of rafaʿa; m., acc. as predicate of ṣāra); 'raising'
الِانْكِسَارِ: الـ + انْكِسَار — inkisār, brokenness, defeat (VII verbal noun; gen.); 'the defeat'
وَالْفِرَارِ: وَ + الـ + فِرَار — wa-, and + firār, flight (verbal noun of farra; gen.); 'and the flight'
الْأَبْرَارِ: الـ + أَبْرَار — abrār, the righteous (pl. of barr; gen.); 'the righteous'
وَالْفُجَّارِ: وَ + الـ + فُجَّار — wa-, and + fujjār, the wicked, sinners (pl. of fājir; gen.); 'and the wicked'
أَمَانَظَرْتَ: اَ + مَا + نَظَرْتَ — a-, question particle + mā, not + naẓarta (naẓara ilā, to look at; perf. 2ms); 'have you not looked' (one word in the print)
أَدْرَكَ: أَدْرَكَ — adraka, to overtake, catch up with, come up with (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'he overtook'
خَذْلِ: خَذْل — khadhl, abandoning, leaving in the lurch, leaving without support (m. verbal noun of khadhala; gen. after fī); 'the forsaking (of)'
عَدُوَّةَ: عَدُوَّة — ʿaduwwa, enemy (f. of ʿaduww; acc. in apposition to al-laʿīna); 'enemy (of)'; the shadda is the print's
لَمَّارَأَتْ: لَمَّا + رَأَتْ — lammā, when (temporal particle) + raʾat, she saw (raʾā, verb I, perf. 3fs); run together in print; 'when she saw'
سَارَا: سَارَا — sārā, the two went, set out (sāra, verb I hollow, perf. 3m dual); 'the two had gone'
بِعَسْكَرِهِمَا: بِـ + عَسْكَر + ـهِمَا — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment: going with something) + ʿaskar, army (m., gen.) + -humā, their (dual); 'with their army'
وَأَنْفَذَتِ: وَ + أَنْفَذَتْ — wa-, and + anfadha, to send off, dispatch (verb IV, perf. 3fs; linking vowel -i before al-); 'and she sent off'
تُرْكَاشَ: تُرْكَاش — Turkāsh, proper name, m., an emir of the Muslim army (diptote; acc. here, in apposition to al-amīr)
وَقَصْدُهَا: وَ + قَصْد + ـهَا — wa-, and + qaṣd, aim, intention (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her aim'
تُفَرِّقَ: تُفَرِّقَ — farraqa, to divide, split, scatter (verb II, imperf. 3fs subj. after an); farraqa bayna, 'split apart, sow division among'
يَضْعُفُوا: يَضْعُفُوا — ḍaʿufa/yaḍʿufu, to grow weak (verb I, imperf. 3mp subj. after an); 'that they grow weak'
تَرَكَتْهُمْ: تَرَكَتْ + هُمْ — taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hum, them; 'she left them'
وَقَصَدَتِ: وَ + قَصَدَتْ — wa-, and + qaṣada, to head for, make for (verb I, perf. 3fs; linking vowel -i before al-); 'and she made for'
بِأَعْلَى: بِـ + أَعْلَى — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + aʿlā, highest (elative of ʿālī, high; first term of iḍāfa); bi-aʿlā ṣawtihā, 'with the highest of her voice', i.e. at the top of her voice
أَدْلُوا: أَدْلُوا — adlā, to let down, lower (a rope or bucket) (verb IV, imperative 2mp); 'let down!'
حَبْلًا: حَبْل — ḥabl, rope (m., acc. indef.); 'a rope'
لِاَرْبِطَ: لِـ + أَرْبِطَ — li-, so that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + rabaṭa/yarbiṭu, to tie, bind (verb I, imperf. 1cs subj.); 'so that I may tie'; the kasra and fatḥa are the print's
وَأَوْصِلُوهُ: وَ + أَوْصِلُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + awṣala, to convey, deliver (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + -hu, it; 'and deliver it'
لِيَقْرَأَهُ: لِـ + يَقْرَأَ + ـهُ — li-, so that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + qaraʾa/yaqraʾu, to read (verb I, imperf. 3ms subj.) + -hu, it; 'so that he may read it'
وَيَعْمَلَا: وَ + يَعْمَلَا — wa-, and + ʿamila/yaʿmalu, to act, do (verb I, imperf. 3m dual subj., still governed by li-); ʿamila bi-, 'act upon'; 'and that the two act'
وَنَوَاهِيهِ: وَ + نَوَاهِي + ـهِ — wa-, and + nawāhī, prohibitions (pl. of nāhiya; gen.) + -hi, its; 'and its prohibitions' (paired with amr, 'command')
فَأَدْلَوْا: فَـ + أَدْلَوْا — fa-, so + adlā, to let down, lower (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'so they let down'
فَرَبَطَتْ: فَـ + رَبَطَتْ — fa-, and then + rabaṭa, to tie, bind (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she tied'
الدَّاهِيَةِ: الـ + دَاهِيَة — dāhiya, calamity, disaster; also a person of great cunning (f., gen.; pl. dawāhī); 'the calamity'
وَالطَّامَّةِ: وَ + الـ + طَامَّة — wa-, and + ṭāmma, overwhelming catastrophe (f., gen.); al-ṭāmma al-kubrā, 'the great catastrophe', a Qurʾānic name for the Last Day; the shadda is the print's
دَبَّرْتُ: دَبَّرْتُ — dabbara, to contrive, devise, plan (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'I have contrived'; the shadda is the print's; here: here the print has no shadda (دبرت) and it is supplied; dabbartu li-nafsī amran, 'I have worked out a plan for myself'
مُطْمَئِّنِينَ: مُطْمَئِنّ — muṭmaʾinn, at ease, reassured (act. part. of IV iṭmaʾanna; m. pl., acc. as predicate of kūnū); 'at ease'; read muṭmaʾinnīna: the print sets its shadda on the hamza instead of the nūn, and it is kept there
أَسَرْتُهُمْ: أَسَرْتُ + هُمْ — asara, to take captive (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'I have captured them'
وَأَسَرْتُ: وَ + أَسَرْتُ — wa-, and + asara, to take captive (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I captured'
سُلْطَانَهُمْ: سُلْطَان + هُمْ — sulṭān, sultan, ruler (m., acc.) + -hum, their; 'their sultan'
وَوَزِيرَهُمْ: وَ + وَزِير + هُمْ — wa-, and + wazīr, vizier (m., acc.) + -hum, their; 'and their vizier'
شَوْكَتُهُمْ: شَوْكَة + هُمْ — shawka, thorn; sting, fighting strength, might (f., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their might'
خَدَعْتُ: خَدَعْتُ — khadaʿa, to deceive, trick (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I have deceived'
اثْنَا: اثْنَا — ithnā, two (m., nom. form, here in the compound ithnā ʿashara, 'twelve'); used where Classical Arabic wants the acc. ithnay: a Middle Arabic habit
خِلَافَ: خِلَافَ — khilāfa, apart from, besides, not counting (acc. of khilāf, difference, used as a preposition); 'besides' ; also: unlike, contrary to: khilāfa anīsī fī qarārati dārī, 'unlike my companion in the depths of my house'
الْمَأْسُورِينَ: الـ + مَأْسُور — maʾsūr, captive, taken prisoner (pass. part. of asara; m. pl., gen.); 'the captives'; hamza as printed
فَالْمُرَادُ: فَـ + الـ + مُرَاد — fa-, so + murād, what is wanted, intention (pass. part. of IV arāda used as noun; nom.); 'so what is wanted'
تَخْرُجُونَ: تَخْرُجُونَ — kharaja/yakhruju, to go out, march out (verb I, imperf. 2mp); 'you go out'
وَتَهْجُمُونَ: وَ + تَهْجُمُونَ — wa-, and + hajama/yahjumu, to rush upon, attack (verb I, imperf. 2mp); hajama ʿalā, 'fall upon'; 'and you fall upon'
وَلَكِنَّكُمْ: وَ + لَكِنَّ + كُمْ — wa-, and + lākinna, but (particle taking an acc. subject) + -kum, you (pl.); 'but you'; the shadda is the print's
وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ: وَ + اقْتُلُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (verb I, imperative 2mp) + -hum, them; 'and kill them'
وَالْعَذْرَاءَ: وَ + الـ + عَذْرَاء — wa-, and + ʿadhrāʾ, virgin (f.; acc. still governed by inna); al-ʿAdhrāʾ, the Virgin Mary; 'and the Virgin'
تَعَطَّفَتْ: تَعَطَّفَتْ — taʿaṭṭafa, to incline kindly, be compassionate (verb V, perf. 3fs); taʿaṭṭafa ʿalā, 'take pity on'; the shadda is the print's
لَايَنْسَى: لَا + يَنْسَى — lā, not + nasiya/yansā, to forget (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subj. after an); run together in print; 'that he not forget'
فِعْلِي: فِعْل + ـي — fiʿl, deed, act (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my deed'
كِتَابُهَا: كِتَاب + هَا — kitāb, letter, writing (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her letter'
وَأَحْضَرَهُ: وَ + أَحْضَرَ + هُ — wa-, and + aḥḍara, to bring, summon (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he had him brought'
مَكْرَأُمِّي: مَكْرَ + أُمِّي — makr, cunning, guile (m., acc., object of unẓur, first term of iḍāfa) + umm, mother (f.) + -ī, my; run together in print; 'the cunning of my mother'; the shadda is the print's
يُغْنِى: يُغْنِي — aghnā, to make unnecessary, suffice (verb IV, imperf. 3ms; final ى for ي as printed); aghnā ʿan, 'do instead of, make needless'
وَطَلْعَتُهَا: وَ + طَلْعَة + هَا — wa-, and + ṭalʿa, face, countenance, appearance (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her countenance'
تَنُوبُ: تَنُوبُ — nāba/yanūbu, to stand in for, take the place of (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs); nāba ʿan, 'stand in for'
طَلْعَةَ: طَلْعَة — ṭalʿa, face, countenance (f., acc., object of ʿadima; first term of iḍāfa); 'the face of'
يُنَادُوا: يُنَادُوا — nādā, to call out, proclaim (verb III, imperf. 3mp subj. after an); nādā bi-, 'proclaim'; 'that they proclaim'
النَّصْرَانِيَّةُ: الـ + نَصْرَانِيَّة — naṣrāniyya, Christian (adj., f. sg. agreeing with a broken pl.; nom.); 'the Christian'
وَالْعِصَابَةُ: وَ + الـ + عِصَابَة — wa-, and + ʿiṣāba, band, troop, company (f., nom.); 'and the band'
الصَّلِيبِيَّةُ: الـ + صَلِيبِيَّة — ṣalībiyya, of the Cross (relative adj. from ṣalīb, cross; f., nom.); 'the Cross-bearing'
الْحِدَادَ: الـ + حِدَاد — ḥidād, sharp (pl. of ḥadīd, sharp; acc. in agreement with al-suyūf); 'the sharp'
وَأَعْلَنُوا: وَ + أَعْلَنُوا — wa-, and + aʿlana, to declare, proclaim openly (verb IV, perf. 3mp); aʿlana bi-, 'declare' (bi- marks what is declared); 'and they declared'
وَالْإِلْحَادِ: وَ + الـ + إِلْحَاد — wa-, and + ilḥād, heresy, deviation from the faith (verbal noun of IV alḥada; gen.); 'and the heresy'
وَكَفَرُوا: وَ + كَفَرُوا — wa-, and + kafarū, they disbelieved (kafara, verb I, perf. 3mp; takes bi- of what is denied); 'and they disbelieved'
بِرَبِّ: بِـ + رَبّ — bi-, in (prep., chosen by kafara bi- 'disbelieve in') + rabb, Lord (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'in the Lord of'
الرُّومَ: الـ + رُوم — al-Rūm, the Byzantines, the Christians of the east (collective, acc. after inna); 'the Rūm'
سُلْطَانَنَا: سُلْطَان + نَا — sulṭān, sultan (m., acc. after anna) + -nā, our; 'our sultan'
وَأَكْثَرُ: وَ + أَكْثَر — wa-, and/while (introducing a circumstantial clause) + akthar, most, the greater part (elative, nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'while most of'
يَاعَسْكَرَ: يَا + عَسْكَر — yā, O (vocative particle; the print joins it to the noun) + ʿaskar, army (m., acc. as first term of an iḍāfa after yā); 'O army of'
وَحُمَاةَ: وَ + حُمَاة — wa-, and + ḥumāh, protectors, defenders (pl. of ḥāmin, acc., vocative in construct); 'and protectors of'
الْمَتِينِ: الـ + مَتِين — matīn, firm, solid, strong (adj., m., gen.); 'the firm'
هَرَبْتُمْ: هَرَبْتُمْ — harabtum, you fled (haraba, verb I, perf. 2mp; future sense after in 'if'); 'you flee'
هَلَكْتُمْ: هَلَكْتُمْ — halaktum, you perished (halaka, verb I, perf. 2mp; apodosis of a condition); 'you perish'
صَبَرْتُمْ: صَبَرْتُمْ — ṣabartum, you were patient, held firm (ṣabara, verb I, perf. 2mp); 'you endure'
نُصِرْتُمْ: نُصِرْتُمْ — nuṣirtum, you were given victory (naṣara, verb I, passive perf. 2mp); 'you will be granted victory'
فَاعْلَمُوا: فَـ + اعْلَمُوا — fa-, so + iʿlamū, know! (ʿalima, verb I, imperative 2mp); 'so know'
الشَّجَاعَةَ: الـ + شَجَاعَة — shajāʿa, courage, bravery (f., acc. after anna); 'courage'
وَمَاضَاقَ: وَ + مَا + ضَاقَ — wa-, and + mā, not (negation) + ḍāqa, to be narrow, grow tight (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'and no … grew narrow'
أَمْرٌإِلَّا: أَمْر + إِلَّا — amr, matter, affair (m., nom. indef.) + illā, except, but (after a negative: 'not … but'); printed as one word; 'a matter, but'
أَوْجَدَ: أَوْجَدَ — awjada, to bring into being, provide (wajada, verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'brought about'
اتِّسَاعَهُ: اتِّسَاع + هُ — ittisāʿ, widening, ample room (VIII verbal noun of wasiʿa; acc.) + -hu, its; 'its widening, a way out of it'
كَبَّرَتِ: كَبَّرَتِ — kabbarat, she/they cried 'God is greatest' (kabbara, verb II, perf. 3fs with a plural subject treated as collective; linking vowel -i); 'cried Allāhu akbar'
الْمُوَحِّدُونَ: الـ + مُوَحِّدُونَ — muwaḥḥidūn, professors of God's oneness, i.e. the Muslims (II act. part., sound m. pl., nom.); 'the believers in the One God'
رَحَاةُ: رَحَاة — raḥāh, millstone (as printed, for رَحًى; f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the millstone of'
بِالطَّعْنِ: بِـ + الـ + طَعْن — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + ṭaʿn, thrusting, stabbing (verbal noun of ṭaʿana; m., gen.); 'with the thrusting'
الصَّوَارِمُ: الـ + صَوَارِم — ṣawārim, sharp swords (pl. of ṣārim; nom.); 'the swords'
وَالرِّمَاحُ: وَ + الـ + رِمَاح — wa-, and + rimāḥ, spears (pl. of rumḥ; nom.); 'and the spears'
الْأَوْدِيَةَ: الـ + أَوْدِيَة — awdiya, valleys (pl. of wādin; acc. as object); 'the valleys'
وَالْبِطَاحَ: وَ + الـ + بِطَاح — wa-, and + biṭāḥ, broad plains, wide stream-beds (pl. of baṭḥāʾ; acc.); 'and the plains'
وَتَسَسَّتِ: وَ + تَسَسَّتِ — wa-, and + tasassat, obscure verb as printed (perf. 3fs; perhaps for تَقَسَّسَتْ 'acted as priests' or تَنَسَّكَتْ 'devoted themselves to worship'; reading uncertain)
وَالرُّهْبَانُ: وَ + الـ + رُهْبَان — wa-, and + ruhbān, monks (pl. of rāhib; nom.); 'and the monks'
وَشَدُّوا: وَ + شَدُّوا — wa-, and + shaddū, they bound, girded (shadda, verb I doubled, perf. 3mp); 'and they bound on'
الزَّنَانِيرَ: الـ + زَنَانِير — zanānīr, girdles (pl. of zunnār, the belt worn by non-Muslims; acc.); 'the girdles'
وَرَفَعُوا: وَ + رَفَعُوا — wa-, and + rafaʿū, they raised (rafaʿa, verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they raised'
وَأَعْلَنَ: وَ + أَعْلَنَ — wa-, and + aʿlana, to proclaim aloud (ʿalana, verb IV, perf. 3ms; takes bi- of what is proclaimed); 'and (they) proclaimed'
بِتَكْبِيرِ: بِـ + تَكْبِير — bi- (marks what is proclaimed, after aʿlana bi-) + takbīr, crying 'God is greatest', magnifying (II verbal noun of kabbara; m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the magnifying of'
وَاصْطَدَمَ: وَ + اصْطَدَمَ — wa-, and + iṣṭadama, to collide, clash (ṣadama, verb VIII, perf. 3ms; takes bi- of what is struck); 'and (it) clashed'
حِزْبُ: حِزْب — ḥizb, party, faction (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the party of'
بِحِزْبِ: بِـ + حِزْب — bi-, with (prep., chosen by iṣṭadama bi- 'clash with') + ḥizb, party (m., gen.); 'with the party of'
وَطَافَتِ: وَ + طَافَتِ — wa-, and + ṭāfat, she/they went round (ṭāfa, verb I hollow, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā 'go round about, attend'; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) went round over'
الْأَخْيَارُ: الـ + أَخْيَار — akhyār, the good, the excellent (pl. of khayyir; nom.); 'the good'
أُمَّةِ: أُمَّة — umma, community, nation (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the community of'
أَحَاطَتِ: أَحَاطَتِ — aḥāṭat, she/they surrounded (ḥāṭa, verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs with a collective plural; takes bi- of what is surrounded; linking vowel -i); 'surrounded'
وَحَسِبُوا: وَ + حَسِبُوا — wa-, and + ḥasibū, they reckoned, supposed (ḥasiba, verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they thought'
يَنْجُوا: يَنْجُوا — yanjū, they escape (najā, verb I defective, imperf. subj. 3mp after an; the corrected reading for the print's يبخوا); 'that they would escape'
الْمُهِينِ: الـ + مُهِين — muhīn, humiliating, shameful (IV act. part. of hāna; gen.); 'the shameful'
وَطَمِعَ: وَ + طَمِعَ — wa-, and + ṭamiʿa, to covet, set one's hopes on (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes fī of what is coveted); 'and (they) had designs on'
الْمُشْرِكُونَ: الـ + مُشْرِكُونَ — mushrikūn, those who associate partners with God, polytheists (IV act. part. of ashraka, sound m. pl., nom.); 'the idolaters'
وَعَسْكَرُهُ: وَ + عَسْكَر + هُ — wa-, and + ʿaskar, army (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his army'
وَرَجَا: وَ + رَجَا — wa-, and + rajā, to hope (verb I defective, perf. 3ms); 'and he hoped'
يَنْصُرُهُ: يَنْصُر + هُ — yanṣuru, he gives victory to, aids (naṣara, verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he would grant him victory'
وَاخْتَلَطَتِ: وَ + اخْتَلَطَتِ — wa-, and + ikhtalaṭat, it mingled (khalaṭa, verb VIII, perf. 3fs with a broken plural; takes bi- 'with'; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) mingled'
الْأُمَمُ: الـ + أُمَم — umam, nations, peoples (pl. of umma; nom.); 'the nations'
بِالْأُمَمِ: بِـ + الـ + أُمَم — bi-, with (prep., chosen by ikhtalaṭa bi- 'mingle with') + umam, nations (gen.); 'with the nations'
الْحَرْبُ: الـ + حَرْب — ḥarb, war, battle (f., nom.); 'the war'
قَدَمٍ: قَدَم — qadam, foot (f., gen. indef. after ʿalā); ʿalā qadam, 'on its feet, in full swing'
الْقِمَمُ: الـ + قِمَم — qimam, crowns of the head, skulls (pl. of qimma; nom.); 'the heads'
الْجَبَانُ: الـ + جَبَان — jabān, coward (m., nom.); 'the coward'
وَانْهَزَمَ: وَ + انْهَزَمَ — wa-, and + inhazama, to be routed, flee in defeat (hazama, verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'and he fled'
تَطَاوَحَتِ: تَطَاوَحَتِ — taṭāwaḥat, they were flung about (as printed, for taṭāyaḥat; ṭāḥa/ṭawwaḥa 'fling', verb VI, perf. 3fs with a broken plural; linking vowel -i); 'were hurled'
السُّرُوجِ: الـ + سُرُوج — surūj, saddles (pl. of sarj; gen. after ʿan); 'the saddles'
وَامْتَلَأَتْ: وَ + امْتَلَأَتْ — wa-, and + imtalaʾat, it was filled (malaʾa, verb VIII, perf. 3fs; takes bi- of the contents); 'and (they) were filled'
بِالْأَمْوَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + أَمْوَات — bi-, with (prep., marking the contents after imtalaʾa bi-) + amwāt, the dead (pl. of mayyit; gen.); 'with the dead'
الْمُرُوجُ: الـ + مُرُوج — murūj, meadows (pl. of marj; nom.); 'the meadows'
وَتَأَخَّرَتِ: وَ + تَأَخَّرَتِ — wa-, and + taʾakhkharat, it fell back, withdrew (akhkhara, verb V, perf. 3fs with a plural subject treated as collective; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) fell back'
أَمَاكِنِهِمْ: أَمَاكِن + هِمْ — amākin, places, positions (pl. of makān; gen. after ʿan) + -him, their; 'their positions'; also: gen. after fī: fī amākinihim, 'in their quarters'
وَمَلَكَتِ: وَ + مَلَكَتِ — wa-, and + malakat, it took possession of (malaka, verb I, perf. 3fs with the collective al-Rūm; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) seized'
الرُّومُ: الـ + رُوم — al-Rūm, the Byzantines, the Christians of the east (collective, nom.); 'the Rūm'
وَمَسَاكِنِهَا: وَ + مَسَاكِن + هَا — wa-, and + masākin, dwellings, quarters (pl. of maskan; gen.) + -hā, its/their (f.; antecedent unclear); 'and its quarters'
وَالْهَزِيمَةِ: وَ + الـ + هَزِيمَة — wa-, and + hazīma, defeat, rout (f., gen.); 'and defeat'
بِعَسَاكِرِ: بِـ + عَسَاكِر — bi-, with (prep., chosen by waṣala bi- 'arrive with, bring') + ʿasākir, armies (pl. of ʿaskar; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the armies of'
وَرَايَاتِ: وَ + رَايَات — wa-, and + rāyāt, banners (pl. of rāya; gen., still after bi-); 'and the banners of'
وَتَبِعَهُ: وَ + تَبِعَ + هُ — wa-, and + tabiʿa, to follow (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and (he) followed him'
بَعْدَهُمَا: بَعْدَ + هُمَا — baʿda, after (prep.) + -humā, the two of them (dual); 'after the two of them'
عُقُولُهُمْ: عُقُول + هُمْ — ʿuqūl, minds, wits (pl. of ʿaql; nom.) + -hum, their; 'their wits'
وَغُلِبَ: وَ + غُلِبَ — wa-, and + ghuliba, was overcome (ghalaba, verb I, passive perf. 3ms); 'and (it) was overcome'
مَعْقُولُهُمْ: مَعْقُول + هُمْ — maʿqūl, reason, understanding (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their reason'
وَاجْتَمَعَتِ: وَ + اجْتَمَعَتِ — wa-, and + ijtamaʿat, it joined, met (jamaʿa, verb VIII, perf. 3fs with a plural subject treated as collective; takes bi- 'with'; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) were reunited'
بِأَصْحَابِهِمُ: بِـ + أَصْحَاب + هِمُ — bi-, with (prep., chosen by ijtamaʿa bi- 'meet with') + aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; gen.) + -him, their (linking vowel -u before al-); 'with their companions'
وَهَنَّأَهُ: وَ + هَنَّأَ + هُ — wa-, and + hannaʾa, to congratulate (verb II, perf. 3ms; takes bi- of the occasion) + -hu, him; 'and he congratulated him'
بِتَائِيدِةِ: بِـ + تَائِيد + ةِ — bi-, on (prep., marking the occasion after hannaʾa bi-) + taʾyīd, support, divine aid (II verbal noun of ayyada, printed تائيد; gen.) + -hi, his (printed with ة for ه); 'on his being aided'
وَنَصْرِةِ: وَ + نَصْر + ةِ — wa-, and + naṣr, victory (m., gen.) + -hi, his (printed with ة for ه); 'and his victory'
وَفَرِحَتِ: وَ + فَرِحَتِ — wa-, and + fariḥat, rejoiced (fariḥa, verb I, perf. 3fs with a plural subject treated as collective; linking vowel -i); 'and (they) rejoiced'
وَقَوِيَتْ: وَ + قَوِيَتْ — wa-, and + qawiyat, it grew strong (qawiya, verb I defective, perf. 3fs with a broken plural); 'and (they) grew strong'
وَأَخْلَصُوا: وَ + أَخْلَصُوا — wa-, and + akhlaṣū, they were sincere, devoted themselves purely (khalaṣa, verb IV, perf. 3mp; takes li- of the one served); 'and they devoted themselves'
جِهَادِهِمْ: جِهَاد + هِمْ — jihād, holy war, striving (III verbal noun of jāhada; gen. after fī) + -him, their; 'their holy war'
الرَّايَاتِ: الـ + رَايَات — rāyāt, banners (pl. of rāya; gen. after ilā); 'the banners'
كَلِمَةُ: كَلِمَة — kalima, word, saying (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the word of'
الْإِخْلَاصِ: الـ + إِخْلَاص — ikhlāṣ, sincerity, pure devotion (IV verbal noun of akhlaṣa; gen.); kalimat al-ikhlāṣ, the profession of faith
حَنَّى: حَنَّى — obscure name as printed (shadda the print's); perhaps Ḥannā, 'John' (short for Yūḥannā), or Anne; uncertain
وَالصَّلِيبَ: وَ + الـ + صَلِيب — wa-, and + ṣalīb, cross (m., acc. as object of nādaw); 'and the Cross'
الْمُسَخَّمَ: الـ + مُسَخَّم — musakhkham, blackened with soot (II pass. part. of sakhkhama; acc.); a mocking epithet; 'the soot-blackened'
وَانْقَبَضَتْ: وَ + انْقَبَضَتْ — wa-, and + inqabaḍat, it drew back, shrank (qabaḍa, verb VII, perf. 3fs with a broken plural; takes ʿan 'from'); 'and (they) drew back'
قْبَلَ: (أَ)قْبَلَ — aqbala, to come forward, advance (verb IV, perf. 3ms), printed without its first letter, which stands on the preceding qad; 'came forward'
الْمَيْسَرَةِ: الـ + مَيْسَرَة — maysara, left wing of an army (f., gen. after fī); 'the left wing'
وَعِنْدَهُمْ: وَ + عِنْدَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ʿinda, with, at (adv. prep.) + -hum, them; 'and they had (with them)'
مَشْهُورٌ: مَشْهُور — mashhūr, famous, well-known (pass. part. of shahara, m., nom. indef.)
لَاوِيَا: Lāwiyā — proper name, m., a Rūmī knight (indeclinable; vowels editorial, the print leaves the name unpointed)
وَسْطًا: وَسْط — wasṭ, middle, centre (m., acc. indef. as adverb); 'in the middle' (the sukūn is printed)
وَاصْطَفُّوا: وَ + اِصْطَفُّوا — wa-, and + iṣṭaffa, to line up, form ranks (verb VIII of ṣ-f-f, perf. 3mp); 'and they ranged themselves'
لِلنِّزَالِ: لِـ + الـ + نِزَال — li-, for (prep., purpose) + al-, the + nizāl, combat, fighting (verbal noun of III nāzala, gen.); 'for the combat'
فَزَعٍ: فَزَع — fazaʿ, fright, terror (m., gen. indef. after fī)
وَزِلْزَالٍ: وَ + زِلْزَال — wa-, and + zilzāl, quaking, convulsion (m., gen. indef.); 'and quaking'
صَفَّتِ: صَفَّتْ — ṣaffa, to range in rows, draw up (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs, with linking kasra); here with the masculine plural al-muslimūna as a collective; 'drew up'
غَايَةُ: غَايَة — ghāya, utmost, extreme limit (f., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the utmost of'
مُرَادِنَا: مُرَاد + نَا — murād, wish, desire (pass. part. of IV arāda used as noun, gen.) + -nā, our; 'our desire'
أُقَدِّمَ: أُقَدِّمَ — qaddama, to put forward, send ahead (verb II, subj. 1s after an); 'that I put forward'
عَزْمٌ: عَزْم — ʿazm, resolve, determination (m., nom. indef.)
التَّدْبِيرَ: الـ + تَدْبِير — tadbīr, planning, management, forethought (verbal noun of II dabbara; acc. after inna)
الْمَعِيشَةِ: الـ + مَعِيشَة — maʿīsha, livelihood, living (f., gen.)
تُرِيدُيَا: تُرِيدُ + يَا — turīdu, you want (verb IV arāda, imperf. 2ms) + yā, O (vocative); printed as one word; 'do you want, O'
السَّدِيدِ: الـ + سَدِيد — sadīd, sound, right, well-aimed (adj., m., gen.)
وَالْأَمِيرُ: وَ + الـ + أَمِير — wa-, and + al-, the + amīr, emir, commander (m., nom.); 'and the emir'
الْجَنَاحِ: الـ + جَنَاح — janāḥ, wing; of an army, flank (m., gen. after fī)
الْأَيْمَنِ: الـ + أَيْمَن — ayman, right(-hand) (adj., m., gen.); 'the right'
الْأَيْسَرِ: الـ + أَيْسَر — aysar, left(-hand) (adj., m., gen.); 'the left'
الْأَعْلَامِ: الـ + أَعْلَام — aʿlām, flags, standards (pl. of ʿalam, gen. after taḥta)
وَالرَّايَاتِ: وَ + الـ + رَايَات — wa-, and + al-, the + rāyāt, banners (pl. of rāya, f., gen.); 'and the banners'
عِمَادُنَا: عِمَاد + نَا — ʿimād, pillar, support (m., nom.) + -nā, our; 'our pillar'
اعْتِمَادُنَا: اِعْتِمَاد + نَا — iʿtimād, reliance (verbal noun of VIII iʿtamada, nom.) + -nā, our; 'our reliance'
فِدَيٰكَ: فِدَى + كَ — fidā, ransom (m., nom.) + -ka, your; spelled فديك, with yāʾ for the long ā; 'your ransom', i.e. we would give our lives for you
يُؤْذِيكَ: يُؤْذِي + كَ — ādhā, to harm, hurt (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'that harms you'
الصِّيَاحُ: الـ + صِيَاح — ṣiyāḥ, shouting, outcry (verbal noun of ṣāḥa, nom.)
وَجُرِّدَتِ: وَ + جُرِّدَتْ — wa-, and + jurridat, were bared, drawn (verb II jarrada, pass. perf. 3fs, linking kasra); 'and were drawn'
الصِّفَاحُ: الـ + صِفَاح — ṣifāḥ, broad swords (pl. of ṣafīḥa, nom.)
قَطُوفٍ: قَطُوف — qaṭūf, short-stepping, slow-paced (of a mount; adj., gen. indef.)
تَفِرُّ: تَفِرُّ — farra, to flee (verb I doubled, imperf. 3fs); 'she flees'
بِصَاحِبِهَا: بِـ + صَاحِب + هَا — bi-, with (prep.; farra bi- 'flee carrying') + ṣāḥib, owner, rider (gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her rider'
وَبَرْذَعَتُهَا: وَ + بَرْذَعَة + هَا — wa-, and + bardhaʿa, saddle-cloth, pack-saddle pad (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her saddle-cloth'
أَبْيَضِ: أَبْيَض — abyaḍ, white (m., gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa); abyaḍ al-ḥarīr 'the white of silk', i.e. white silk
كَشْمِيرَ: كَشْمِير — Kashmīr, Kashmir (proper name, diptote, gen. with -a)
الشَّيْبَةِ: الـ + شَيْبَة — shayba, grey or white hair, old age (f., gen.)
ظَاهِرُ: ظَاهِر — ẓāhir, manifest, evident (act. part. of ẓahara, m., nom.; first term of iḍāfa); 'manifest of'
الْهَيْبَةِ: الـ + هَيْبَة — hayba, awe, reverend dignity (f., gen.)
مِدْرَعَةٌ: مِدْرَعَة — midraʿa, woollen gown, smock (f., nom. indef.)
يُسْرِعُ: يُسْرِعُ — asraʿa, to hurry (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); with bi-, 'to speed (a mount) on'
وَيَنْهَضُ: وَ + يَنْهَضُ — wa-, and + nahaḍa, to rise, press on (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and pressing on'
رَسُولٌ: رَسُول — rasūl, messenger, envoy (m., nom. indef.); 'a messenger'
الرَّسُولِ: الـ + رَسُول — rasūl, messenger (m., gen.); 'the messenger'
الْبَلَاغُ: الـ + بَلَاغ — balāgh, delivery (of a message), conveying (m., nom.); 'the delivering'
فَأَعْطُونِي: فَـ + أَعْطُوا + ـنِي — fa-, so + aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + 1s object suffix; 'so give me'
وَالْإِقَالَهَ: وَ + الـ + إِقَالَه — wa-, and + iqāla, release, discharge, indemnity (verbal noun of verb IV aqāla; f., acc.; the print writes the ending ة as ه); 'and the release'
أُبَلِّغَكُمُ: أُبَلِّغَ + ـكُمُ — ballagha, to deliver, convey (verb II, imperf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā) + 2mp object suffix; 'I may deliver to you'
الرِّسَالَةَ: الـ + رِسَالَة — risāla, message (f., acc.); 'the message'
الْأَمَانُ: الـ + أَمَان — amān, safety, safe-conduct (m., nom.); 'the safe-conduct'
حَرْبَ: حَرْب — ḥarb, war, fighting (f., acc., construct); 'the fighting of'
سَيْفٍ: سَيْف — sayf, sword (m., gen. indef.); 'a sword'
طَعْنَ: طَعْن — ṭaʿn, thrust, stabbing (verbal noun of ṭaʿana; m., acc., construct); 'the thrust of'
سِنَانٍ: سِنَان — sinān, spearhead, spear (m., gen. indef.); 'a spearhead'
وَخَضَعَ: وَ + خَضَعَ — khaḍaʿa, to humble oneself, submit (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes li- of the one submitted to); 'and he humbled himself'
خُضُوعَ: خُضُوع — khuḍūʿ, submission, humbling (verbal noun, m., acc. of manner, construct); 'with the humbling of'
رَاجِى: رَاجِي — rājī, one who hopes (active participle of rajā, verb I defective; m., gen., construct; the print writes ى); 'a hoper of'
لِيَمْتَنِعَ: لِـ + يَمْتَنِعَ — li-, so that (with the subjunctive) + imtanaʿa, to refrain (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms subj.; takes ʿan); 'that he might refrain'
تَلَفِ: تَلَف — talaf, destruction, ruin (m., gen., construct); 'the destruction of'
الصُّوَرِ: الـ + صُوَر — ṣūra, form, image (pl. ṣuwar, gen.); 'the forms'
الْإِنْسَانِيَّةِ: الـ + إِنْسَانِيَّة — insāniyy, human (relative adj., f. agreeing with a non-human plural, gen.); 'human'
وَالْهَيَاكِلِ: وَ + الـ + هَيَاكِل — haykal, temple; frame, body (pl. hayākil, gen.); 'and the frames'
الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ: الـ + رَحْمَانِيَّة — raḥmāniyy, of the Merciful (relative adj. from al-Raḥmān, God; f., gen.); 'made by the Merciful'
وَبَيَّنْتُ: وَ + بَيَّنْتُ — bayyana, to make clear, explain (verb II, perf. 1s); 'and I made clear'
الصَّوَابَ: الـ + صَوَاب — ṣawāb, the right thing, correct course (m., acc. after anna); 'the right course'
حَقْنُ: حَقْن — ḥaqn, holding back, sparing (verbal noun of ḥaqana; m., nom., construct); 'the sparing of'
وَالِاقْتِصَارُ: وَ + الـ + اقْتِصَار — iqtiṣār, confining oneself, limiting (verbal noun of verb VIII iqtaṣara; takes ʿalā; m., nom.); 'and the limiting (to)'
فَأَجَابَنِي: فَـ + أَجَابَ + ـنِي — fa-, so + ajāba, to answer, consent (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms; with ilā 'consent to') + 1s object suffix; 'so he answered me'
عَسْكَرِي: عَسْكَر + ـِي — ʿaskar, army (m.) + 1s suffix; 'my army'
فَلْيَفْعَلْ: فَـ + لْ + يَفْعَلْ — fa-, so + li-, let (lām of command, vowel lost after fa-) + faʿala, to do (verb I, jussive 3ms); 'so let him do'
وَيَفْدِي: وَ + يَفْدِي — fadā, to ransom (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms; Classical would have jussive yafdi here, the print keeps the long vowel); 'and (let him) ransom'
ثَبَاتٌ: ثَبَات — thabāt, firmness, standing fast (m., nom. indef.); 'any firmness'
رَاهِبُ: رَاهِب — rāhib, monk (m., nom. after yā, no nunation); 'monk!'
أَجَبْنَاهُ: أَجَبْنَا + ـهُ — ajāba, to answer, consent (verb IV hollow, perf. 1p; with ilā 'consent to') + 3ms object suffix; 'we have answered him'
الْإِنْصَافُ: الـ + إِنْصَاف — inṣāf, fairness, fair dealing (verbal noun of verb IV; m., nom.); 'fairness'
خِلَافٌ: خِلَاف — khilāf, departing, going back, dissent (m., nom. indef.); 'a going back'
أَبْرُزُ: أَبْرُزُ — baraza, to come out (to single combat) (verb I, imperf. 1s; with ilā); 'I go out'
وَأَحْمِلُ: وَ + أَحْمِلُ — ḥamala, to charge (verb I, imperf. 1s; with ʿalā 'charge upon'); 'and I charge'
فَازَ: فَازَ — fāza, to win (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with bi- of the prize); 'he has won'
الْمَفَرِّ: الـ + مَفَرّ — mafarr, flight, place of fleeing (noun of place/verbal noun from farra; m., gen.); 'flight'
فَارْجِعْ: فَـ + ارْجِعْ — fa-, so + rajaʿa, to go back (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'so go back'
الْبِرَازِ: الـ + بِرَاز — birāz, single combat (m., gen.); 'the single combat'
سَفَرِنَا: سَفَر + ـنَا — safar, journey (m., gen.) + 1p suffix; 'our journey'
تَعَبٍ: تَعَب — taʿab, weariness, fatigue (m., gen. indef.); ʿalā taʿabin 'in a state of weariness'
لَاعَتْبَ: لَا + عَتْبَ — lā, no (denying the whole class) + ʿatb, reproach (m., acc. without nunation after lā; the print joins the two words); 'no reproach'
أَضْرَبُهُمْ: أَضْرَب + ـهُمْ — aḍrab, best at striking (elative of ḍaraba; m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'the best striker of them'
وَأَطْعَنُهُمْ: وَ + أَطْعَن + ـهُمْ — aṭʿan, best at thrusting (elative of ṭaʿana; m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'and the best thruster of them'
بِالسِّنَانِ: بِـ + الـ + سِنَان — bi-, with (instrument) + sinān, spearhead, spear (m., gen.); 'with the spear'
هِمَّتُهُمْ: هِمَّة + ـهُمْ — himma, resolve, spirit (f., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'their resolve'
كَاتَبَتِ: كَاتَبَتْ — kātaba, to write to, correspond with (verb III, perf. 3fs; vowel i to join the next word; with bi- of the matter); 'she wrote to'
وَشُجَاعُ: وَ + شُجَاع — shujāʿ, brave man (m., nom., construct); 'and the brave one of'
وَحَذَّرَتْ: وَ + حَذَّرَتْ — ḥadhdhara, to warn (verb II, perf. 3fs; with min 'against'); 'and she warned'
وَيَضْرِبُ: وَ + يَضْرِبُ — ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and he strikes'
بِعَمُودِ: بِـ + عَمُود — bi-, with (instrument) + ʿamūd, column, pole; mace (m., gen., construct); 'with the mace of'
يَخْشَى: يَخْشَى — khashiya, to fear (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms; here with min, the spoken usage); 'he fears'
الْبَأْسِ: الـ + بَأْس — baʾs, might, violence in war (m., gen.; the print has the hamza); 'might'
وَيَعْلَمُ: وَ + يَعْلَمُ — ʿalima, to know (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and he knows'
لَاطَاقَةَ: لَا + طَاقَةَ — lā, no (denying the whole class) + ṭāqa, power, ability (f., acc. without nunation; the print joins the two words); 'no power'
وَشُرْبِ: وَ + شُرْب — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of shariba; m., gen., construct); 'and the drinking of'
خُمُورٍ: خُمُور — khamr, wine (pl. khumūr, gen. indef.); 'wines'
الْفَوَارِسُ: الـ + فَوَارِس — fāris, horseman (pl. fawāris, nom.); 'the horsemen'
بِسُمْرِ: بِـ + سُمْر — bi-, with (what they carried) + sumr, tawny, brown ones (pl. of asmar; gen., construct); 'with the tawny of'
وَبِيضِ: وَ + بِيض — wa-, and + bīḍ, white, bright ones (pl. of abyaḍ; gen., construct, still governed by the preceding bi-); 'and the white of'
مُعَدٍّ: مُعَدّ — muʿadd, made ready, prepared (pass. part. IV of ʿadda, m., gen. agreeing with jawād); 'made ready'
قَوَائِمُ: قَوَائِم — qawāʾim, legs (of a beast) (pl. of qāʾima, nom.); 'legs'
شِدَادٌ: شِدَاد — shidād, strong, sturdy (pl. of shadīd, nom. indef.); 'strong'
دِرْعٌ: دِرْع — dirʿ, coat of mail (m./f., nom. indef.); 'a coat of mail'
مُعَدٌّ: مُعَدّ — muʿadd, made ready (pass. part. IV, m., nom. indef., agreeing with dirʿ); 'made ready'
لِلْبَأْسِ: لِـ + الـ + بَأْس — li-, for (prep., purpose) + baʾs, might, violence in war (m., gen.); 'for the fierce fighting'
مِرْآةٌ: مِرْآة — mirʾāt, mirror (f., nom. indef.); here a polished disc worn on the breast
أَبْتَرُ: أَبْتَر — abtar, cutting, trenchant (of a sword; adj., nom.); 'trenchant'
وَقِنْطَارِيَّةُ: وَ + قِنْطَارِيَّة — wa-, and + qinṭāriyya, lance, spear (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and a lance of'
خُولَنْجٍ: خُولَنْج — khūlanj, a hard speckled wood (Persian khalang) (gen.); 'of khūlanj wood' (reading uncertain)
عَرَفَنِى: عَرَفَ + نِى — ʿarafa, to know (I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (ى for ي); 'knows me'
اكْتَفَانِى: اِكْتَفَى + نِى — iktafā, to be content, have enough (VIII of kafā) + -nī, me (ى for ي); 'has had enough of me', i.e. needs no introduction
يَعْرِفْنِى: يَعْرِفْ + نِى — ʿarafa, to know (I, jussive 3ms after lam) + -nī, me (ى for ي); 'know me'
يَرَانِي: يَرَى + نِي — raʾā, to see (I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he will see me'
الْمَغْمُورُ: الـ + مَغْمُور — maghmūr, flooded, steeped, overwhelmed (pass. part. of ghamara, nom.); 'steeped (in)'
شَوَاهِي: Shawāhī — personal name of the old woman Dhāt al-Dawāhī (gen.); 'Shawāhī'
عُدَّةٌ: عُدَّة — ʿudda, gear, armour, equipment (f., nom. indef.); 'armour'
مُزَرْكَشَةٌ: مُزَرْكَشَة — muzarkasha, embroidered, worked with gold (pass. part. of zarkasha, f., nom.); 'embroidered'
مُتَقَلِّدٌ: مُتَقَلِّد — mutaqallid, girt (with a sword) (act. part. V of qallada, m., nom.); with bi-, 'girt with'
بِسَيْفٍ: بِـ + سَيْف — bi-, with (prep., chosen by taqallada: marks what is slung on) + sayf, sword (m., gen. indef.); 'with a sword'
هِنْدِىٍّ: هِنْدِىّ — hindī, Indian (nisba adj., gen. indef.; ى for ي); 'Indian'
مُجَوْهَرٍ: مُجَوْهَر — mujawhar, jewelled (pass. part., m., gen. indef.); 'jewelled'
يَقُدُّ: قَدَّ — qadda, to cleave, slice lengthwise (I, imperf. 3ms); 'cleaves'
الرِّقَابَ: الـ + رِقَاب — riqāb, necks (pl. of raqaba, acc.); 'the necks'
وَيُهَوِّنُ: وَ + هَوَّنَ — wa-, and + hawwana, to make easy (II, imperf. 3ms); 'and makes easy'
الصِّعَابَ: الـ + صِعَاب — ṣiʿāb, hard, difficult (pl. of ṣaʿb, acc. adj.); 'the hard'
وَالْفُرْسَانُ: وَ + الـ + فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen, knights (pl. of fāris, nom.); 'while the horsemen'
تَنْظُرُهُ: تَنْظُرُ + هُ — naẓara, to look at (I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with a broken plural) + -hu, him; 'watching him'
أَتَظُنُّنِي: أَ + تَظُنُّ + نِي — a-, interrogative + ẓanna, to think, suppose (I, imperf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'do you think me'
كَمَنْ: كَـ + مَنْ — ka-, like, as (prep.) + man, whoever, the one who; 'like those whom'
لَاقَيْتَ: لَاقَى — lāqā, to meet, encounter (III, perf. 2ms); 'you have met'
يَثْبُتُ: ثَبَتَ — thabata, to stand firm, hold one's ground (I, imperf. 3ms); 'stands firm'
يَصْطَدِمَانِ: اِصْطَدَمَ — iṣṭadama, to collide (VIII, imperf. 3 m. dual); 'colliding'
يَلْتَطِمَانِ: اِلْتَطَمَ — iltaṭama, to dash together (of waves) (VIII, imperf. 3 m. dual); 'clashing'
تَقَارَبَا: تَقَارَبَ — taqāraba, to draw near each other (VI, perf. 3 m. dual); 'they drew close'
وَتَبَاعَدَا: وَ + تَبَاعَدَ — wa-, and + tabāʿada, to draw apart (VI, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and drew apart'
وَالْتَصَقَا: وَ + اِلْتَصَقَ — wa-, and + iltaṣaqa, to cling, close together (VIII, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and grappled'
وَافْتَرَقَا: وَ + اِفْتَرَقَ — wa-, and + iftaraqa, to part, separate (VIII, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and parted'
يَزَ: يَزَ(الَا) — first piece of yazālā, zāla (lam yazal), to cease (I, jussive 3 m. dual), which the print splits as يز الا; 'cease-'
كَرٍّ: كَرّ — karr, charging, attack (verbal noun, gen. after fī); 'charging'
وَفَرٍّ: وَ + فَرّ — wa-, and + farr, wheeling away, retreat (verbal noun, gen.); karr wa-farr, 'attack and retreat'
وَهَزْلٍ: وَ + هَزْل — wa-, and + hazl, jest, play (m., gen.); 'and jest'
وَجِدٍّ: وَ + جِدّ — wa-, and + jidd, earnest, seriousness (m., gen.); 'and earnest'
وَضَرْبٍ: وَ + ضَرْب — wa-, and + ḍarb, striking, blows (verbal noun, gen.); 'and striking'
وَالْجَيْشَانِ: وَ + الـ + جَيْشَانِ — wa-, and/while + jaysh, army (m., dual nom.); 'while the two armies'
وَالْبَعْضُ: وَ + الـ + بَعْض — baʿḍ, some (m., nom.); 'and others'
الْفَارِسَانِ: الـ + فَارِسَانِ — fāris, horseman, knight (m., dual nom.); 'the two horsemen'
وَمَالَتِ: وَ + مَالَتْ — wa-, and + māla, to incline, lean (I hollow, perf. 3fs; linking kasra before al-); 'and (the sun) leaned'
الِاصْفِرَارِ: الـ + اِصْفِرَار — iṣfirār, turning yellow (verbal noun IX of ṣafira, gen.); 'the yellowing' (of the setting sun)
دِينِ: دِين — dīn, religion (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'the religion of'
وَالِاعْتِقَادِ: وَ + الـ + اِعْتِقَاد — iʿtiqād, belief, creed (verbal noun VIII, gen.); 'and the belief'
كَرَّارٌ: كَرَّار — karrār, one who charges again and again (intensive of karra, nom.); 'ever-charging'
وَبَطَلٌ: وَ + بَطَل — wa-, and + baṭal, hero, champion (m., nom. indef.); 'and a hero'
مِغْوَارٌ: مِغْوَار — mighwār, bold raider, daring (intensive, nom.); 'daring'
غَدَّارٌ: غَدَّار — ghaddār, treacherous (intensive of ghadara, nom.); 'treacherous'
وَطَبْعُكَ: وَ + طَبْع + كَ — wa-, and + ṭabʿ, nature, character (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your nature'
الْأَخْيَارِ: الـ + أَخْيَار — akhyār, the good, the noble (pl. of khayyir, gen.); 'the noble'
حَمِيدٍ: حَمِيد — ḥamīd, praiseworthy (adj., gen. after ghayr); ghayr ḥamīd, 'blameworthy'
وَقِتَالُكَ: وَ + قِتَال + كَ — wa-, and + qitāl, fighting (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your fighting'
قِتَالُ: قِتَال — qitāl, fighting (m., nom., first term of a construct); 'the fighting of'
الصِّنْدِيدِ: الـ + صِنْدِيد — ṣindīd, brave chief, champion (m., gen.); 'the champion'
وَقَوْمُكَ: وَ + قَوْم + كَ — wa-, and + qawm, people, folk (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your people'
يَنْسُبُونَكَ: نَسَبَ + كَ — nasaba, to trace back, attribute (I, imperf. 3 m. pl.; with ilā, 'count among') + -ka, you; 'they count you (among)'
يَنْسُبُونَهُ: نَسَبَ + هُ — nasaba, to attribute (I, imperf. 3 m. pl.; with ilā, 'count among') + -hu, him; 'they count him (among)'
وَهَاهُمْ: وَ + هَا + هُمْ — wa-, and + hā, here! (particle of pointing) + hum, they; printed as one word; 'and here they are'
أَخْرَجُوالَكَ: أَخْرَجُوا + لَكَ — akhraja, to bring out (IV, perf. 3 m. pl.) + li-, for (prep., the one benefited) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'they have brought out for you'
وَتَعُودُ: وَ + عَادَ — wa-, and + ʿāda, to return (I hollow, imperf. 2ms); 'and you will return'
أَعْيَانِي: أَعْيَا + نِي — aʿyā, to weary, exhaust (IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'has wearied me'
قِتَالُكَ: قِتَال + كَ — qitāl, fighting (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your fighting'
وَأَتْعَبَنِي: وَ + أَتْعَبَ + نِي — wa-, and + atʿaba, to tire (IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and has tired me'
ضَرْبُكَ: ضَرْب + كَ — ḍarb, striking, blows (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your blows'
وَطِعَانُكَ: وَ + طِعَان + كَ — wa-, and + ṭiʿān, spear-thrusting (verbal noun III, nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your thrusts'
قِتَالِي: قِتَال + ي — qitāl, fighting (m., acc.; the case is hidden by -ī) + -ī, me; 'fighting me'
تُغَيِّرْ: غَيَّرَ — ghayyara, to change (II, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā); 'do not change'
عُدَّتِكَ: عُدَّة + كَ — ʿudda, gear, armour (f., gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your armour'
لِلْفُرْسَانِ: لِـ + الـ + فُرْسَان — li-, to (prep.: to whom it appears) + fursān, horsemen (gen.); 'to the horsemen'
كَرَمُكَ: كَرَم + كَ — karam, nobility, generosity (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your nobility'
حَقِّهِ: حَقّ + هِ — ḥaqq, right, due (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; fī ḥaqqihi, 'concerning him'
يُشِيرَ: أَشَارَ — ashāra, to signal, point (IV hollow, subj. 3ms after an); with ilā, 'signal to'
وَيَأْمُرَهُمْ: وَ + أَمَرَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + amara, to command (I, subj. 3ms after an) + -hum, them; 'and order them'
يُغَيِّرُوا: غَيَّرَ — ghayyara, to change (II, subj. 3 m. pl. after an lā); 'that they not change'
وَلَاعُدَّةً: وَ + لَا + عُدَّة — wa-, and + lā, nor + ʿudda, gear, armour (f., acc. indef.); printed as one word; 'nor armour'
بِأَفْرِيدُونَ: بِـ + أَفْرِيدُون — bi- (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears) + Afrīdūn (diptote, gen. with fatḥa); 'behold, Afrīdūn'
حَرْبَتَهُ: حَرْبَة + هُ — ḥarba, spear, javelin (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his spear'
وَأَرْسَلَهَا: وَ + أَرْسَلَ + هَا — wa-, and + arsala, to send, launch (IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the spear, f.); 'and hurled it'
دْرَكَتْهُ: (أَ)دْرَكَتْ + هُ — adraka, to overtake, reach (IV, perf. 3fs), its a- printed with the preceding qad + -hu, him; '(had) reached him'
فَمَالَ: فَـ + مَالَ — fa-, and so + māla, to lean, swerve (I hollow, perf. 3ms); with ʿan, 'swerved away from'
قَرَبُوصَ: قَرَبُوص — qarabūṣ, saddle-bow, pommel (m., acc.; variant spelling of qarabūs); 'the pommel of'
فَجَرَتِ: فَـ + جَرَتْ — fa-, and + jarā, to run, glide (I, perf. 3fs; linking kasra before al-); 'and (the spear) ran'
عَالِىَ: عَالٍ (عَالِي) — ʿālin, high (act. part. of عَلَا; acc. as predicate of كَانَ, first term of an iḍāfa; print writes final ي as ى); 'high (of)'
فَكَشَطَتِ: فَـ + كَشَطَتْ — kashaṭa, to scrape off, strip away (perf. 3fs; kasra for the join); 'so (it) scraped off'
جِلْدَةَ: جِلْدَة — jilda, (a piece of) skin (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the skin of'
فَهَاجَتْ: فَـ + هَاجَتْ — hāja, to be stirred up, surge (perf. 3fs, agreeing with the collective أَهْل); 'and (they) surged'
الطُّغْيَانِ: الـ + طُغْيَان — ṭughyān, tyranny, transgression (m., gen.); 'the tyranny'
فَلَمَّارَأَى: فَـ + لَمَّا + رَأَى — fa-, and + lammā, when + raʾā, to see (perf. 3ms); 'and when (he) saw' (print sets lammā and raʾā as one word)
مَائِلًا: مَائِل — māʾil, leaning, slumping (act. part. of مَالَ, acc. indef. as ḥāl); 'leaning'
نَحْوَهُ: نَحْوَ + ـهُ — naḥwa, toward (adv. prep.) + him; 'toward him'; also 'toward it' (the heart, fuʾād) (Night 182)
فَتَسَابَقَتْ: فَـ + تَسَابَقَتْ — tasābaqa, to race one another (form VI perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural); 'and (they) raced'
وَأَتَوابِهِ: وَ + أَتَوْا + بِـ + ـهِ — wa-, and + ataw, they came (perf. 3mp of أَتَى) + bi-, with (the verb أَتَى chooses it: أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + him; 'and they brought him' (print sets أتوا and به as one word)
وَالْتَقَى: وَ + الْتَقَى — iltaqā, to meet, encounter (form VIII perf. 3ms); 'and (they) met'
وَاخْتَلَطَ: وَ + اخْتَلَطَ — ikhtalaṭa, to be mixed, mingle (form VIII perf. 3ms); 'and (they) mingled'
الصَّفَّانِ: الـ + صَفَّانِ — ṣaffāni, two ranks, battle lines (dual of صَفّ, nom.); 'the two ranks'
الْيَمَانِيُّ: الـ + يَمَانِيّ — yamānī, Yemeni (nisba, nom.); here 'the Yemeni (sword)'
الْبَتَّارُ: الـ + بَتَّار — battār, sharp, cutting (intensive adj. from بَتَرَ, nom.); 'the cutting'
أَسْبَقَ: أَسْبَق — asbaq, quickest, first to arrive (elative of سَبَقَ, acc. as predicate of كَانَ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the quickest of'
قُوَّتُهُمْ: قُوَّة + هُمْ — quwwa, strength, power (f., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their strength'
فَشَكَرَةُ: فَـ + شَكَرَ + ةُ — fa-, and so + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'thank for') + -hu, him (printed with tāʾ marbūṭa, ة for ه); 'and he thanked him'
الْبِرَازَ: الـ + بِرَاز — birāz, single combat between the lines (verbal noun of III bāraza; m., acc.); 'the single combat'
وَأَمِيرُ: وَ + أَمِير — wa-, and + amīr, emir, commander (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the emir of'
فَلَحِقُوهُ: فَـ + لَحِقُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and so + laḥiqū, they caught up with (laḥiqa, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they caught up with him'
فَأَسْنَدُوهُ: فَـ + أَسْنَدُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and + asnadū, they propped up, supported (asnada, form IV, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they held him up'
أَوْصَوْابِهِ: أَوْصَوْا + بِـ + ـهِ — awṣaw, they gave charge (awṣā, form IV, perf. 3mp) + bi-, concerning (prep.; awṣā X bi-Y 'commend Y to X's care') + -hi, him; printed as one word; 'they commended him (to)'
وَتَقَصَّفَتِ: وَ + تَقَصَّفَتْ — wa-, and + taqaṣṣafat, shattered, broke to pieces (taqaṣṣafa, form V, perf. 3fs; -i for the following article); 'and (the blades) shattered'
النِّصَالُ: الـ + نِصَال — niṣāl, blades, arrowheads (pl. of naṣl; nom.); 'the blades'
فَلَايُرَى: فَـ + لَا + يُرَى — fa-, and so + lā, not + yurā, is seen (raʾā, passive imperf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'and there was not seen'
إِلَّادَمٌ: إِلَّا + دَمٌ — illā, except, but + dam, blood (m., nom., indefinite); printed as one word, with the print's shadda; 'but blood'
وَعُنُقٌ: وَ + عُنُق — wa-, and + ʿunuq, neck (m./f., nom., indefinite); 'and a neck'
الْأَعْنَاقِ: الـ + أَعْنَاق — aʿnāq, necks (pl. of ʿunuq; gen. after fī); 'the necks'
الشِّقَاقُ: الـ + شِّقَاق — shiqāq, discord, strife (m., nom.); 'the strife'
وَكَلَّتِ: وَ + كَلَّتْ — wa-, and + kallat, grew weary, tired (kalla, perf. 3fs; -i for the following article; shadda printed); 'and (the two parties) grew weary'
فَنَادَوْا: فَـ + نَادَوْا — fa-, and so + nādaw, they called out, proclaimed (nādā, form III, perf. 3mp); 'and they called out'
بِالِانْفِصَالِ: بِـ + الـ + انْفِصَال — bi-, (marks what is proclaimed, after nādā) + al-, the + infiṣāl, separation, disengagement (form VII verbal noun); '(called) for the disengaging'
طَائِفَةٍ: طَائِفَة — ṭāʾifa, party, band, side (f., gen., indefinite after kull); 'every party'
خِيَامِهَا: خِيَام + ـهَا — khiyām, tents (pl. of khayma; gen.) + -hā, its (the party's); 'its tents'
وَقَبَّلُّوا: وَ + قَبَّلُوا — wa-, and + qabbalū, they kissed (qabbala, form II, perf. 3mp); the print sets the shadda on the lām; 'and they kissed'
وَهَنَّأَتْهُ: وَ + هَنَّأَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + hannaʾat, congratulated (hannaʾa, form II, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural al-qusūs) + -hu, him; corrected from the print's وهنّأنه; 'and (the priests) congratulated him'
بِظَفَرِةِ: بِـ + ظَفَر + ـهِ — bi-, on (prep.; hannaʾa bi- 'congratulate on') + ẓafar, victory (m., gen.) + -hi, his (pronoun written with tāʾ marbūṭa, ة); 'on his victory'
سَاعِدَكَ: سَاعِد + ـكَ — sāʿid, forearm, arm (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your arm'
مُسَاعِدَكَ: مُسَاعِد + ـكَ — musāʿid, helper (form III active participle of sāʿada, acc. as predicate of lā zāla) + -ka, your; 'your helper'
وَاسْتَجَابَ: وَ + اسْتَجَابَ — wa-, and + istajāba, answered, granted (a prayer) (form X, perf. 3ms, here a wish: 'may he grant'); 'and may (he) grant'
الْأُمِّ: الـ + أُمّ — umm, mother (f., gen. after min); shadda printed; 'the mother'
مَاتَدْعُو: مَا + تَدْعُو — mā, what (relative) + tadʿū, she prays (daʿā, imperf. 3fs); printed as one word; 'what she prays (for)'
إِقَامَةٌ: إِقَامَة — iqāma, staying, remaining in place (form IV verbal noun of aqāma; nom., indefinite); 'a staying'
وَقَتَلْتُهُ: وَ + قَتَلْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + qataltu, I killed (qatala, perf. 1s) + -hu, him; 'and I kill him'
عَسْكَرَهُمْ: عَسْكَر + ـهُمْ — ʿaskar, army (m., acc. after inna) + -hum, their; 'their army'
يُوَلُّونَ: يُوَلُّونَ — yuwallūna, they turn (wallā, form II, imperf. 3mp; wallā al-adbār 'turn the backs, flee'); shadda printed; 'they will turn'
أَسْوَأِ: أَسْوَأ — aswaʾ, worst (elative of sayyiʾ, bad; gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); hamza printed; 'the worst of'
وَأَقَلِّ: وَ + أَقَلّ — wa-, and + aqall, least, fewest (elative of qalīl; gen.); 'and the least of'
وَبَهْرَامَ: وَ + بَهْرَام — wa-, and + Bahrām, proper name, a commander of the Muslim host (called emir of the Turks in Night 103, of the Daylam elsewhere) (diptote; gen. in the list after bi-); 'and Bahrām'
اقْتَضَى: اقْتَضَى — iqtaḍā, required, called for (form VIII, perf. 3ms); corrected from the print's انتضى; 'called for'; here: the print has اقتضى itself; iqtaḍā raʾyī, 'my judgement required', i.e. 'I decided'
رَأْيُهُمْ: رَأْي + ـهُمْ — raʾy, opinion, judgement (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'their judgement'
إِحْضَارَ: إِحْضَار — iḥḍār, bringing, summoning (form IV verbal noun of aḥḍara; acc.); 'the bringing of'
لِعِلَاجِ: لِـ + عِلَاج — li-, for (prep., purpose) + ʿilāj, treatment, cure (verbal noun of ʿālaja; gen.); 'for the treating of'
بَكَوْا: بَكَوْا — bakaw, they wept (bakā, perf. 3mp); 'they wept'
يَسْمَحْ: يَسْمَحْ — yasmaḥ, be generous, grant freely (samaḥa, jussive 3ms after lam; samaḥa bi- 'part with, grant'); 'has (not) granted'
بِمِثْلِهِ: بِـ + مِثْل + ـهِ — bi-, (marks what is granted, after samaḥa) + mithl, the like (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his like'
وَسَهِرُوا: وَ + سَهِرُوا — wa-, and + sahirū, they stayed awake, kept vigil (sahira, perf. 3mp); 'and they sat up'
فَمَلَسَ: فَـ + مَلَسَ — fa-, and + malasa, stroked, passed the hand smoothly (perf. 3ms); kept as printed, perhaps for فلمس, 'and he touched'; 'and he stroked'
جُرْحِ: جُرْح — jurḥ, wound (m., gen.); 'the wound of'
الْقُرْأَنِ: الـ + قُرْأَن — al-Qurʾān, the Qurʾān (m., gen.); spelled with the print's أ; 'the Qurʾān'
وَعَوَّذَهُ: وَ + عَوَّذَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿawwadha, recited protective verses over (form II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he charmed him (with verses)'
بِآيَاتِ: بِـ + آيَات — bi-, with (prep., instrument, after ʿawwadha) + āyāt, verses (of the Qurʾān), signs (pl. of āya; gen.); 'with the verses of'
سَهْرَانًا: سَهْرَان — sahrān, awake, wakeful (adj., acc. as predicate of mā zāla; printed with tanwīn alif); 'awake'
وَأَدَارَلِسَانَهُ: وَ + أَدَارَ + لِسَان + ـهُ — wa-, and + adāra, turned, moved round (form IV, perf. 3ms) + lisān, tongue (m., acc.) + -hu, his; printed as one word; 'and he moved his tongue'
بَرَكَةُ: بَرَكَة — baraka, blessing (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the blessing of'
فَإِنَّنِي: فَـ + إِنَّ + ـنِي — fa-, for + inna, truly (particle) + -nī, me (with the extra nūn); 'for I'
زُغْتُ: زُغْتُ — zughtu, I swerved, dodged (zāgha, perf. 1s); 'I swerved'
لَكَانَتِ: لَـ + كَانَتْ — la-, then, surely (the la- that answers lawlā) + kānat, was (kāna, perf. 3fs; -i for the following article); 'then (the spear) would have'
نَفَذَتْ: نَفَذَتْ — nafadhat, went through, pierced (nafadha, perf. 3fs); 'gone through'
بِجَمِيلِ: بِـ + جَمِيل — bi-, (marks what is to be held to, after ʿalayka) + jamīl, the beautiful, the best (gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'to beautiful (patience)'
يُعْظِمِ: يُعْظِمِ — yuʿẓim, makes great (aʿẓama, form IV, jussive 3ms, answering the command; -i for the following word); 'will make great'
بَرَزَتِ: بَرَزَتْ — barazat, came out, sallied forth (baraza, perf. 3fs, with the masculine plural al-muslimūn; -i for the following article); 'came out'
فَطَلَبُوا: فَـ + طَلَبُوا — fa-, and + ṭalabū, they sought (ṭalaba, perf. 3mp); 'and they sought'
وَالْكِفَاحَ: وَ + الـ + كِفَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + kifāḥ, close combat, hand-to-hand fighting (verbal noun of kāfaḥa; acc.); 'and the close fighting'
وَأَفْرِيدُونُ: وَ + أَفْرِيدُونُ — wa-, and + Afrīdūn, the Byzantine king (proper name, nom.); 'and Afrīdūn'
يَحْمِلَا: يَحْمِلَا — yaḥmilā, the two of them charge (ḥamala, subj. dual 3m after an); 'that the two charge'
فِدَاكَ: فِدَا + ـكَ — fidā, ransom (m.) + -ka, your; naḥnu fidāka 'we are your ransom, we would die for you'
وَزَمْزَمَ: وَ + زَمْزَم — wa-, and + Zamzam, the sacred well at Mecca (proper name, gen. in the oath); 'and (by) Zamzam'
وَالْمَقَامِ: وَ + الـ + مَقَام — wa-, and + al-, the + maqām, station, standing-place (m., gen.); here the Station of Abraham at the Kaʿba; 'and (by) the Station'
الْعُلُوجِ: الـ + عُلُوج — ʿulūj, louts, non-Arab unbelievers (pl. of ʿilj; gen.); 'the barbarians'
لَعِبَ: لَعِبَ — laʿiba, played (perf. 3ms; laʿiba bi- 'play with, wield in display'); 'he made play'
أَذْهَلَ: أَذْهَلَ — adhhala, astounded, dumbfounded (form IV, perf. 3ms); 'he astounded'
فَقَتَلَ: فَـ + قَتَلَ — fa-, and + qatala, killed (perf. 3ms); 'and he killed'
بِطْرِيقَيْنِ: بِطْرِيقَيْنِ — biṭrīqayn, two patricians, Byzantine commanders (dual of biṭrīq, acc.); 'two patricians'
أُذِيقَهُ: أُذِيقَ + ـهُ — udhīqa, I make taste (adhāqa, form IV, subj. 1s after ḥattā) + -hu, him; 'that I make him taste'
عَذَابَ: عَذَاب — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the torment of'
الْهُونِ: الـ + هُون — hūn, humiliation, disgrace (m., gen.); 'the humiliation'
يُوَلِّيَ: يُوَلِّيَ — yuwalliya, turn away, turn tail (wallā, form II, subj. 3ms after an); 'to turn away'
أَقْسَمَ: أَقْسَمَ — aqsama, swore (form IV, perf. 3ms; aqsama ʿalā 'adjure, beg by oath'); 'he adjured'
بِشَجَاعَتِهِ: بِـ + شَجَاعَة + ـهِ — bi-, about (prep.; lā ubālī bi- 'not care about') + shajāʿa, courage (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his courage'
حِصَانٌ: حِصَان — ḥiṣān, stallion, horse (m., nom., indefinite); 'a stallion'
الْأَبْجَرُ: الـ + أَبْجَر — al-Abjar, the name of ʿAntar's horse (nom.); 'al-Abjar'
أَدْهَمُ: أَدْهَم — adham, black (of a horse) (adj., m., nom.); 'black'
مُغَائِرٌ: مُغَائِر — kept as printed; read mughāʾir, taken as mughāyir, different, unlike others (form III active participle; nom.); doubtful; 'unmatched'
سَابَقَ: سَابَقَ — sābaqa, raced, competed in speed with (form III, perf. 3ms); 'he raced'
بِطِرْفٍ: بِـ + طِرْف — bi-, on, with (prep., instrument) + ṭirf, thoroughbred horse (m., gen., indefinite); 'on a thoroughbred'
سَابِقٍ: سَابِق — sābiq, swift, outstripping (active participle of sabaqa; gen., agreeing with ṭirf); 'a swift one'
اِدْرَاكَ: اِدْرَاك — idrāk, overtaking, reaching (form IV verbal noun of adraka; acc.); 'to overtake'
دُهْمَتُهُ: دُهْمَة + ـهُ — duhma, blackness (of a horse) (f., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its blackness'
تُبْدِي: تُبْدِي — tubdī, shows, displays (abdā, form IV, imperf. 3fs); 'shows'
كَاَنَّهَا: كَـ + أَنَّ + ـهَا — ka-, as (prep.) + anna, that + -hā, it (f.); ka-anna 'as if'; printed with bare alif; 'as if it'
عَكَرْ: عَكَرْ — ʿakar, grew thick, dark (of night) (ʿakira, perf. 3ms, pausal form at line-end); 'grows thick'
صَهِيلُهُ: صَهِيل + ـهُ — ṣahīl, neighing (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its neighing'
يُطْرِبُ: يُطْرِبُ — yuṭribu, delights, thrills (aṭraba, form IV, imperf. 3ms); 'delights'
الرَّعْدُ: الـ + رَّعْد — raʿd, thunder (m., nom.); 'the thunder'
زَجَرْ: زَجَرْ — zajar, rumbled, roared (zajara, perf. 3ms, pausal form at line-end); 'rolls'
لَوْسَابَقَ: لَوْ + سَابَقَ — law, if (unreal condition) + sābaqa, raced (form III, perf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'if it raced'
قَبْلِهَا: قَبْل + ـهَا — qabl, before (gen. after min) + -hā, it (the wind, f.); 'ahead of it'
وَالْبَرْقُ: وَ + الـ + بَرْق — wa-, and + al-, the + barq, lightning (m., nom.); 'and the lightning'
يُسْبِقُهُ: يُسْبِقُ + ـهُ — yusbiqu, outstrips (printed as a form IV verb, where yasbiqu is expected; imperf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'outstrips it'
مَضَارِبِهِ: مَضَارِب + ـهِ — maḍārib, strokes, blows (pl. of maḍrab; gen.) + -hi, his (the opponent's); 'his strokes'
عَجَائِبِهِ: عَجَائِب + ـهِ — ʿajāʾib, wonders, marvels (pl. of ʿajība; gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'of his wonders'
ضَاقَتِ: ضَاقَتْ — ḍāqat, grew narrow, tight (ḍāqa, perf. 3fs; -i for the following article); 'grew tight'
لِلْمَقْدُورِ: لِـ + الـ + مَقْدُور — li-, for, toward (prep.) + al-, the + maqdūr, what is decreed, fate (passive participle of qadara; gen.); 'for what was decreed'
أَنْفَاسَهُ: أَنْفَاس + ـهُ — anfās, breaths (pl. of nafas; acc.) + -hu, his; 'his breath'
بِكُلِّيَّتِهِمْ: بِـ + كُلِّيَّة + ـهِمْ — bi-, with (prep.) + kulliyya, entirety, whole (f., gen.) + -him, their; shadda on the lām printed; 'with the whole of them'
وَالطِّعَانُ: وَ + الـ + طِّعَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭiʿān, thrusting with lances (verbal noun of ṭāʿana; nom.); 'and the thrusting'
بِالْجَرَيَانِ: بِـ + الـ + جَرَيَان — bi-, with, in (prep., manner) + al-, the + jarayān, running, flowing (verbal noun of jarā; gen.); 'in streams'
وَضَجَّ: وَ + ضَجَّ — wa-, and + ḍajja, clamoured, cried out (perf. 3ms; ḍajja bi- 'clamour with'); shadda printed; 'and (the Muslims) clamoured'
وَالتَّهْلِيلِ: وَ + الـ + تَّهْلِيل — wa-, and + al-, the + tahlīl, saying lā ilāha illā allāh (verbal noun of form II; gen.); 'and the tahlīl'
وَقٰتَلُوا: وَ + قَاتَلُوا — wa-, and + qātalū, they fought (qātala, form III, perf. 3mp; printed defectively, قتلوا, the long ā shown by a dagger alif); 'and they fought'
وَالْخِزْيَ: وَ + الـ + خِزْي — wa-, and + al-, the + khizy, disgrace, shame (m., acc.); 'and the disgrace'
بِثَائِرِ: بِـ + ثَائِر — bi-, (belongs to the idiom akhadha bi-thaʾr 'take revenge for') + thāʾir, kept as printed where thaʾr, blood-revenge, is expected (gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the vengeance of'
وَثَارِ: وَ + ثَار — wa-, and + thār, blood-revenge (thaʾr, written without hamza; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the vengeance of'
لِلْأَتْرَاكِ: لِـ + الـ + أَتْرَاك — li-, to (prep., of those addressed) + al-, the + atrāk, Turks (pl. of turk; gen.); 'to the Turks'
يَجِدِ: يَجِدِ — yajid, find (wajada, jussive 3ms after lam; -i for the following article); 'did (not) find'
لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ: لِـ + أَنْفُس + ـهِمْ — li-, for (prep.) + anfus, selves (pl. of nafs; gen.) + -him, their; 'for themselves'
وَتَوَلَّى: وَ + تَوَلَّى — wa-, and + tawallā, turned (form V, perf. 3ms; tawallā al-adbār 'turn the backs, flee'); 'and (they) turned'
الصَّارِمُ: الـ + صَّارِم — ṣārim, sharp sword, cutting (active participle of ṣarama, 'cut', used as a noun for 'sword'; nom.); 'the sharp sword'
وَأَسَرُوا: وَ + أَسَرُوا — wa-, and + asarū, they took captive (asara, perf. 3mp); 'and they captured'
غَلَّقَ: غَلَّقَ — ghallaqa, shut fast, locked (form II, perf. 3ms; the letters also allow ghalaqa); 'shut'
خَوْفَ: خَوْف — khawf, fear (m., acc. of reason, first term of an iḍāfa); 'for fear of'
طَوَائِفُ: طَوَائِف — ṭawāʾif, bands, companies (pl. of ṭāʾifa; nom.); 'the companies of'
مُؤَيَّدِينَ: مُؤَيَّدِينَ — muʾayyadīn, aided, strengthened (by God) (form II passive participle, m. pl., acc. of state); 'aided'
مَنْصُورِينَ: مَنْصُورِينَ — manṣūrīn, given victory, victorious (passive participle of naṣara, m. pl., acc. of state); 'victorious'
وَأَتَوْاخِيَا: وَ + أَتَوْا + خِيَا(مَهُمْ) — wa-, and + ataw, they came (atā, perf. 3mp) + the first part of khiyāmahum, their tents, which the print divides wrongly (واتواخيا مهم); 'and they came to their tents'
مَهُمْ: (خِيَا)مَهُمْ — the end of khiyāmahum, 'their tents' (khiyām, tents, acc. + -hum, their), split off by the print's misplaced space (واتواخيا مهم)
أَسَرِّ: أَسَرّ — asarr, most joyful, happiest (elative of sārr, gladdening; gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); shadda printed; 'the most joyful of'
فَسَجَدَ: فَـ + سَجَدَ — fa-, and so + sajada, prostrated himself, bowed down in prayer (perf. 3ms); 'and he bowed down'
شُكْراً: شُكْر — shukr, thanks (m., acc. of purpose, tanwīn printed); 'in thanks'
لِلْكَرِيمِ: لِـ + الـ + كَرِيم — li-, to (prep., of the one thanked) + al-, the + karīm, the Generous (a name of God; gen.); 'to the Generous'
الْمُتَعَالِ: الـ + مُتَعَالِ — mutaʿālī, the Most High, Exalted (form VI active participle, a name of God; gen.; final yāʾ dropped as in the Qurʾān); 'the Exalted'
الْأَوَّابِ: الـ + أَوَّاب — awwāb, one who often turns back to God, penitent (intensive adj.; gen.); 'the penitent'
انْتَصَرْتُمْ: انْتَصَرْتُمْ — intaṣartum, you were victorious (intaṣara, form VIII, perf. 2mp); 'you won'
إِلَّابِدُعَائِهِ: إِلَّا + بِـ + دُعَاء + ـهِ — illā, except, only + bi-, by (prep., means) + duʿāʾ, prayer (m., gen.) + -hi, his; printed as one word; 'only by his prayer'
لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ: لِـ + الـ + مُسْلِمِينَ — li-, for (prep., the ones prayed for; daʿā li-) + al-, the + muslimīn, Muslims (m. pl., gen.); 'for the Muslims'
لِعَنْتَرٍ: لِـ + عَنْتَر — li-, belonging to (prep.) + ʿAntar, the hero ʿAntara ibn Shaddād (proper name, fully declined, gen.); 'ʿAntar's'
وَالْعَابِدُ: وَ + الـ + عَابِد — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿābid, worshipper, devout man (act. part. of ʿabada, m., nom.); 'and the worshipper'
بَرِحَ: بَرِحَ — bariḥa, to leave off, cease (verb I, perf. 3ms); mā bariḥa, 'he has not ceased'
تَكْبِيرَكُمْ: تَكْبِير + ـكُمْ — takbīr, the cry Allāhu akbar, 'God is most great' (verbal noun II of k-b-r, m., acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your takbīr'
أَعْدَائِكُمْ: أَعْدَاء + ـكُمْ — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww, gen. after ʿalā) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your enemies'
فَأَثْنَى: فَـ + أَثْنَى — fa-, and so + athnā ʿalā, to praise (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he praised'
وَتَغَرْغَرَتْ: وَ + تَغَرْغَرَتْ — wa-, and + taghargharat, to brim, swim (of eyes with tears; quadriliteral verb II, perf. 3fs); 'and (her eyes) brimmed'
عَيْنَاهَا: عَيْنَا + ـهَا — ʿaynā, two eyes (dual of ʿayn, f., nom., the nūn dropped before the suffix) + -hā, her; 'her two eyes'
الْغِزَارِ: الـ + غِزَار — al-, the + ghizār, abundant, copious (pl. of ghazīr, gen.); 'the copious (tears)'
أَخْفَتْ: أَخْفَتْ — akhfat, she hid (akhfā, verb IV, perf. 3fs)
وَأَظْهَرَتْ: وَ + أَظْهَرَتْ — wa-, and + aẓharat, she showed, made out (aẓhara, verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and she made out'
أُحْرِقْ: أُحْرِقْ — uḥriq, I burn (aḥraqa, verb IV, jussive 1s after lam); 'I (do not) burn'
أَحْرَقَ: أَحْرَقَ — aḥraqa, he burned (verb IV, perf. 3ms)
عِمَادِ: عِمَاد — ʿimād, pillar, support (m., gen. after ʿalā; construct); 'the pillar of'
كَتَمَتْ: كَتَمَتْ — katamat, she concealed, kept secret (katama, verb I, perf. 3fs)
وَالْمَلِكَ: وَ + الـ + مَلِك — wa-, and + al-malik, the king (m., acc. after inna); 'and the king'
اسْتَمَرُّوا: اسْتَمَرُّوا — istamarrū, they continued, kept on (istamarra, verb X geminate, perf. 3mp)
جَالِسِينَ: جَالِسِينَ — jālisīn, sitting (act. part. of jalasa, m. pl., acc., predicate of istamarrū); 'sitting'
اللِّزَاقَ: الـ + لِزَاق — al-, the + lizāq, sticking plaster, poultice (m., acc.); 'the plaster'
وَالْأَدْهَانَ: وَ + الـ + أَدْهَان — wa-, and + al-, the + adhān, ointments, oils (pl. of duhn, acc.); 'and the ointments'
