وَأَعْطَوْهُ: وَ + أَعْطَوْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aʿṭaw, they gave (aʿṭā, verb IV, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they gave him'
فَتَبَاشَرَ: فَـ + تَبَاشَرَ — fa-, and so + tabāshara, to give one another good news (verb VI of b-sh-r, perf. 3ms before a plural subject); 'and (the Muslims) passed the good news'
يَرْكَبُ: يَرْكَبُ — yarkabu, he rides (rakiba, verb I, impf. 3ms)
وَيُبَاشِرُ: وَ + يُبَاشِرُ — wa-, and + yubāshiru, he takes in hand, undertakes (bāshara, verb III, impf. 3ms); 'and he takes charge of'
الْحِصَارَ: الـ + حِصَار — al-, the + ḥiṣār, siege (m., acc.); 'the siege'
قَاتَلْتُمُ: قَاتَلْتُمُ — qātaltum, you (pl.) fought (qātala, verb III, perf. 2mp; final -u a helping vowel before al-)
وَتَعِبْتُمْ: وَ + تَعِبْتُمْ — wa-, and + taʿibtum, you (pl.) grew tired (taʿiba, verb I, perf. 2mp); 'and you grew tired'
تَتَوَجَّهُوا: تَتَوَجَّهُوا — tatawajjahū, you (pl.) go, betake yourselves (tawajjaha, verb V, subj. 2mp after an)
أَمَاكِنِكُمْ: أَمَاكِن + ـكُمْ — amākin, places (pl. of makān, gen. after ilā) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your quarters'
وَتَنَامُوا: وَ + تَنَامُوا — wa-, and + tanāmū, you (pl.) sleep (nāma, verb I hollow, subj. 2mp); 'and sleep'
تَسْهَرُوا: تَسْهَرُوا — tas-harū, you (pl.) stay awake, sit up at night (sahira, verb I, jussive 2mp after prohibitive lā)
سُرَادِقِهِ: سُرَادِق + ـهِ — surādiq, pavilion, great tent (m., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his pavilion'
وَالْعَجُوزِ: وَ + الـ + عَجُوز — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿajūz, old woman (f., gen., coordinated with qalīlin after siwā); 'and the old woman'
فَتَحَدَّثَ: فَـ + تَحَدَّثَ — fa-, and + taḥaddatha, to talk, converse (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he talked'
قَلِيلً: قَلِيلً — qalīlan, a little (adverbial acc.); printed قليل without the alif of the accusative; 'for a little while'
اضْطَجَعَ: اضْطَجَعَ — iḍṭajaʿa, he lay down (verb VIII of ḍ-j-ʿ, perf. 3ms)
لِيَنَامَ: لِـ + يَنَامَ — li-, in order to (purpose, with subj.) + yanāma, he sleeps (nāma, subj. 3ms); 'to sleep'
فَصَارُوا: فَـ + صَارُوا — fa-, and + ṣārū, they became (ṣāra, verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); 'and they became'
الْأَمْوَاتِ: الـ + أَمْوَات — al-, the + amwāt, the dead (pl. of mayyit, gen. after mithla); 'the dead'
وَغِلْمَانِهِ: وَ + غِلْمَان + ـهِ — wa-, and + ghilmān, pages, servant boys (pl. of ghulām, gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his pages'
نَوْمِهِمْ: نَوْم + ـهِمْ — nawm, sleep (verbal noun, gen. after baʿda) + -him, their; 'their sleeping'
يَقْظَانَةً: يَقْظَانَةً — yaqẓāna, awake (fem. of yaqẓān, non-Classical for yaqẓā; acc., predicate of ṣārat)
فَوَجَدَتْهُ: فَـ + وَجَدَتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and + wajadat, she found (wajada, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she found him'
مُسْتَغْرِقًا: مُسْتَغْرِقًا — mustaghriqan, sunk, absorbed (in sleep) (act. part. X of gh-r-q, m., acc.)
فَوَثَبَتْ: فَـ + وَثَبَتْ — fa-, and + wathabat, she leapt, sprang (wathaba, verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she sprang'
دُبَّةٌ: دُبَّة — dubba, she-bear (f., nom., predicate of ka-anna); the marks on the first two letters are the print's
مَعْطَا: مَعْطَا — maʿṭā, hairless, mangy (fem. of amʿaṭ; Classical maʿṭāʾ, the final hamza unwritten)
رَقْطَا: رَقْطَا — raqṭā, speckled, spotted (fem. of arqaṭ; Classical raqṭāʾ, the final hamza unwritten)
خَنْجَرًا: خَنْجَرًا — khanjaran, a dagger (m., acc. indef.)
وُضِعَ: وُضِعَ — wuḍiʿa, it was placed (waḍaʿa, verb I, perf. passive 3ms)
لَأَذَابَهَا: لَـ + أَذَابَ + ـهَا — la-, then surely (the la- answering law 'if'; its fatḥa is the print's) + adhāba, to melt (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the rock); 'it would have melted it'
جَرَّدَتْهُ: جَرَّدَتْ + ـهُ — jarradat, she bared, unsheathed (jarrada, verb II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she unsheathed it'
غِمْدِهِ: غِمْد + ـهِ — ghimd, sheath, scabbard (m., gen. after min) + -hi, its; 'its sheath'
فَذَبَحَتْهُ: فَـ + ذَبَحَتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and + dhabaḥat, she cut the throat of, slaughtered (dhabaḥa, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she cut his throat'
وَأَزَالَتْ: وَ + أَزَالَتْ — wa-, and + azālat, she removed (azāla, verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and she took off'
النِّيَامِ: الـ + نِيَام — al-, the + niyām, sleeping (pl. of nāʾim, gen., agreeing with al-ghilmān); 'the sleeping'
يَنْتَبِهُوا: يَنْتَبِهُوا — yantabihū, they wake up (intabaha, verb VII, subj. 3mp after li-allā)
خِيَامِ: خِيَام — khiyām, tents (pl. of khayma, gen. after ilā; construct); 'the tents of'
الْحُرَّاسَ: الـ + حُرَّاس — al-, the + ḥurrās, guards (pl. of ḥāris, acc.; the shadda is the print's); 'the guards'
نَائِمِينَ: نَائِمِينَ — nāʾimīn, sleeping (act. part. of nāma, m. pl., gen. after ghayra)
بِالزَّاهِدِ: بِـ + الـ + زَّاهِد — bi-, to (prep., marking the one greeted after marḥaban) + al-zāhid, the ascetic (m., gen.); 'welcome to the ascetic'
مَجِيئِي: مَجِيء + ـِي — majīʾ, coming (verbal noun of jāʾa, m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my coming'
وَلِيٍّ: وَلِيٍّ — waliyy, friend (of God), saint (m., gen. indef.)
أَوْلِيَاوِ: أَوْلِيَاو — awliyāʾ, friends (of God), saints (pl. of waliyy, gen.; printed with wāw for the final hamza, a Middle Arabic spelling)
ذَاهِبٌ: ذَاهِبٌ — dhāhib, going (act. part. of dhahaba, m., nom.); here the jeweller of himself: annanī dhāhibun, 'that I am going'. Elsewhere a woman speaking of herself in the masculine of her disguise
تْبَعُ: تْبَعُ — (a)tbaʿu, I follow (tabiʿa, verb I, impf. 1s); second half of la-atbaʿu, the print dividing the word as لا تبع; 'I will surely follow'
أَحَسَّتِ: أَحَسَّتِ — aḥassat, she sensed, became aware (aḥassa, verb IV geminate, perf. 3fs; takes bi- of what is perceived; final -i a helping vowel)
فَخَشِيَتْ: فَـ + خَشِيَتْ — fa-, and + khashiyat, she feared (khashiya, verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she feared'
تَفْتَضِحَ: تَفْتَضِحَ — taftaḍiḥa, she is exposed, disgraced (iftaḍaḥa, verb VIII, subj. 3fs after an)
أَخْدَعْهُ: أَخْدَعْ + ـهُ — akhdaʿ, I deceive (khadaʿa, verb I, jussive 1s after lam) + -hu, him; 'I (do not) trick him'
أَفْتَضِحُ: أَفْتَضِحُ — aftaḍiḥu, I am exposed, disgraced (iftaḍaḥa, verb VIII, impf. 1s)
سَائِرٌ: سَائِرٌ — sāʾir, going, walking (act. part. of sāra, m., nom.; masculine of her disguise)
لِأَعْرِفَهُ: لِـ + أَعْرِفَ + ـهُ — li-, in order to (purpose, with subj.) + aʿrifa, I know, find out (ʿarafa, subj. 1s) + -hu, him; 'to find out who he is'
أَسْتَأْذِنُهُ: أَسْتَأْذِنُ + ـهُ — astaʾdhinu, I ask leave of (istaʾdhana, verb X, impf. 1s; fī, for) + -hu, him; 'I ask his leave'
وَأُقْبِلُ: وَ + أُقْبِلُ — wa-, and + uqbilu, I come back toward (aqbala, verb IV, impf. 1s; ʿalā, to); 'and I come to (you)'
اسْتِئْذَانِ: اسْتِئْذَان — istiʾdhān, asking leave, permission (verbal noun X of ʾ-dh-n, gen. after bi-ghayri); 'asking leave of'
فَيَحْصُلَ: فَـ + يَحْصُلَ — fa-, and so (with subj., of consequence) + yaḥṣula, it comes about (ḥaṣala, verb I, subj. 3ms); 'so that there comes about'
نَفْرَةٌ: نَفْرَةٌ — nafra, aversion, shying away (f., nom.)
رَآكَ: رَآ + ـكَ — raʾā, he saw (verb I, perf. 3ms; after idhā, 'if he sees') + -ka, you; 'he sees you'
اسْتَحَى: اسْتَحَى — istaḥā, he was ashamed, shrank from (short form of istaḥyā, verb X, perf. 3ms)
فَتَرَكَهَا: فَـ + تَرَكَ + ـهَا — fa-, and + taraka, he left (perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he let her go'
خَيْمَتِهِ: خَيْمَة + ـهِ — khayma, tent (f., gen.; tāʾ marbūṭa becomes -t- before the suffix) + -hi, his; 'his tent'
وَكَادَتِ: وَ + كَادَتِ — wa-, and + kādat, she was about to, almost (kāda, verb of approach, perf. 3fs; -i helping vowel); 'and (the world) almost'
تَنْطَبِقَ: تَنْطَبِقَ — tanṭabiqa, it closes in, is shut tight (inṭabaqa, verb VII, subj. 3fs after an; ʿalā, upon)
وَأَتَحَدَّثُ: وَ + أَتَحَدَّثُ — wa-, and + ataḥaddathu, I talk (taḥaddatha, verb V, impf. 1s); 'and I talk'
خَيْمَةَ: خَيْمَةَ — khayma, tent (f., acc., construct); 'the tent of'
سَائِلًا: سَائِلًا — sāʾilan, flowing (act. part. of sāla, m., acc., circumstantial)
كَالْقَنَاةِ: كَـ + الـ + قَنَاة — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + qanāt, channel, watercourse (f., gen.); 'like a stream'
مَذْبُوحِينَ: مَذْبُوحِينَ — madhbūḥīn, slaughtered, with throats cut (pass. part. of dhabaḥa, m. pl., acc.)
أَزْعَجَتْ: أَزْعَجَتْ — azʿajat, it disturbed, startled (azʿaja, verb IV, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ṣayḥa)
فَتَسَارَعَتِ: فَـ + تَسَارَعَتِ — fa-, and + tasāraʿat, they hurried, raced (tasāraʿa, verb VI, perf. 3fs with collective al-khalq; ilā, to); 'and (people) came running'
فَضَجُّوا: فَـ + ضَجُّوا — fa-, and + ḍajjū, they clamoured (ḍajja, verb I geminate, perf. 3mp; bi-, with, marking the noise raised); 'and they raised a clamour'
وَالْغِلْمَانَ: وَ + الـ + غِلْمَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ghilmān, pages (pl. of ghulām, acc. after inna); 'and the pages'
مَقْتُولُونَ: مَقْتُولُونَ — maqtūlūn, killed (pass. part. of qatala, m. pl., nom.)
جُثَّةَ: جُثَّة — juththa, corpse, body (f., acc., construct); 'the body of'
رَأْسٍ: رَأْسٍ — raʾs, head (m., gen. indef. after bi-lā); 'without a head'
وَدَارُوا: وَ + دَارُوا — wa-, and + dārū, they went round (dāra, verb I hollow, perf. 3mp; ḥawla, around); 'and they gathered round'
وَفَعَلَ: وَ + فَعَلَ — wa-, and + faʿala, he did (perf. 3ms); 'and (the vizier) did' Also with bi-, 'did (so) with/to': wa-faʿala bī ayḍan, 'and (one) did so with me too'.; also: with maʿa, 'did (the same) for': faʿala kadhālika maʿa ʿAlī, 'he did likewise for ʿAlī'
وَأَكْثَرَ: وَ + أَكْثَرَ — wa-, and + akthara, he did much of (verb IV, perf. 3ms; min, of); 'and he lamented much'
النُّوَاحِ: الـ + نُّوَاح — al-, the + nuwāḥ, lamenting, wailing for the dead (verbal noun, gen. after min); 'the lamenting'
الِارْتِحَالَ: الـ + ارْتِحَال — al-, the + irtiḥāl, departure, breaking camp (verbal noun VIII of r-ḥ-l, acc.); 'the departure'
الْأَوْجَالِ: الـ + أَوْجَال — al-, the + awjāl, fears, terrors (pl. of wajal, gen. after min); 'of fears'
مَتَاعِ: مَتَاع — matāʿ, goods, chattels; the good things of life (m., gen. after ʿan; construct); 'the goods of'
مُتَبَاعِدٌ: مُتَبَاعِدٌ — mutabāʿid, holding himself far, remote (act. part. VI of b-ʿ-d, m., nom.; ʿan, from)
جَلَبَ: جَلَبَ — jalaba, he brought, brought on (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَالْآخِرِ: وَ + الـ + آخِر — wa-, and + al-, the + ākhir, last (gen.; the madda is the print's); fī al-awwal wa-al-ākhir, 'from first to last'
مُتَنَطِّعٍ: مُتَنَطِّعٍ — mutanaṭṭiʿ, one who goes to extremes, overdoes (piety) for show (act. part. V of n-ṭ-ʿ, m., gen. indef.)
خَبِيثٌ: خَبِيثٌ — khabīth, vile, wicked (adj., m., nom.)
مَاكِرٌ: مَاكِرٌ — mākir, cunning, deceitful (act. part. of makara, m., nom.)
يَتْبَعَهُ: يَتْبَعَ + ـهُ — yatbaʿa, he follows (tabiʿa, verb I, subj. 3ms after an) + -hu, him; 'to follow him'
مَكَّنَهُ: مَكَّنَ + ـهُ — makkana, to enable, allow (verb II, perf. 3ms; the shadda is the print's) + -hu, him; 'he (did not) let him'
ضَجُّوا: ضَجُّوا — ḍajjū, they clamoured (ḍajja, verb I geminate, perf. 3mp; the shadda is the print's; bi-, with, marking the noise raised)
وَتَضَرَّعُوا: وَ + تَضَرَّعُوا — wa-, and + taḍarraʿū, they humbly implored (taḍarraʿa, verb V, perf. 3mp; ilā, to; the shadda is the print's); 'and they implored'
الْقَرِيبِ: الـ + قَرِيب — al-, the + qarīb, near; al-Qarīb, the Near (a name of God, gen. after ilā)
الْمُجِيبِ: الـ + مُجِيب — al-, the + mujīb, answering; al-Mujīb, He who answers (prayer) (act. part. IV of j-w-b, a name of God, gen.)
يُوقِعَ: يُوقِعَ — yūqiʿa, he makes fall, delivers (awqaʿa, verb IV of w-q-ʿ, subj. 3ms after an); bayna aydīhim, 'into their hands'
لِآيَاتِ: لِـ + آيَات — li-, (object marker before a fronted object of jāḥid) + āyāt, signs, verses (pl. of āya, gen.; the madda is the print's); 'the signs (of God)'
جَاحِدٌ: جَاحِدٌ — jāḥid, denier, one who rejects (act. part. of jaḥada, m., nom.)
وَحَزِنُوا: وَ + حَزِنُوا — wa-, and + ḥazinū, they grieved (ḥazina, verb I, perf. 3mp; ʿalā, over); 'and they mourned'
فَضْلِهِ: فَضْل + ـهِ — faḍl, excellence, merit, virtue (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his virtue'
الْمَشْهُورِ: الـ + مَشْهُور — al-, the + mashhūr, famous, well known (pass. part. of shahara, m., gen.); 'famed'
انْتَظَرُوا: intaẓara — wait for (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'they waited for'
يُفْتَحَ: yuftaḥa — fataḥa, open (verb I, impf. passive, subjunctive 3ms, after an); 'that it be opened'
أَحُولُ: aḥūlu — ḥāla ʿan (ḥ-w-l), turn away from, or with min, move from (verb I, impf. 1s, indicative after lā); 'I will not turn away, I will not move'
وَأَعْوَامًا: وَ + أَعْوَام — wa-, and + aʿwām, years (pl. of ʿām, m., acc., adverbial of time); 'and years'
وَأُخَرِّبَ: وَ + أُخَرِّبَ — wa-, and + ukharriba, lay waste, ruin (verb II, impf. 1s, subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and lay waste'
مُلُوكَ: mulūk — kings (pl. of malik, m., acc., first term of a construct); 'the kings of'
تُدْرِكُنِي: tudriku + nī — adraka, overtake, reach (verb IV, impf. 3fs) + -nī, me (object, with support -n-); 'overtakes me'
الْمَنِيَّةُ: الـ + مَنِيَّة — al-maniyya, death, fate, destined end (f., nom., subject); 'death'
وَأَسْتَرِيحُ: وَ + أَسْتَرِيحُ — wa-, and + astarīḥu, find rest (istarāḥa, verb X, impf. 1s); 'and I find rest'
الدَّنِيَّةِ: الـ + دَنِيَّة — al-daniyya, base, mean, vile (f. adj., gen., agreeing with al-dunyā); 'the base'
وَاكْتِفَاءً: وَ + اكْتِفَاء — wa-, and + iktifāʾ, sufficiency, having enough (verbal noun of iktafā, VIII, m., acc.); 'and a sufficiency'
أَرْسِلُوا: arsilū — arsala, send, dispatch (verb IV, imperative 2mp); 'send'
النَّفَقَاتِ: الـ + نَفَقَات — al-nafaqāt, expenses, money for upkeep (pl. of nafaqa, f., acc., object); 'the expenses'
بُيُوتِكُمْ: بُيُوت + كُمْ — buyūt, houses (broken pl. of bayt, m., gen. after ilā) + -kum, your (2mp); 'your houses'
ثَارَ: thaʾr — blood-revenge, vengeance (m., acc., object of akhadha, here without bi-; written without hamza, a non-classical spelling of ثَأْرَ); 'vengeance'
الْقُصَّادَ: al-quṣṣād — couriers, messengers (pl. of qāṣid, m., acc.); 'the couriers'
وَأَعْطَاهُمُ: وَ + أَعْطَى + هُمُ — wa-, and + aʿṭā, give (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them (the -u- is the helping vowel before al-); 'and he gave them'
بِإِيصَالِهَا: بِـ + إِيصَال + هَا — bi-, marks what is charged (awṣā bi-, 'charge with') + īṣāl, conveying, delivering (verbal noun of awṣala IV, m., gen.) + -hā, them (the letters, f. sg. agreeing with kutub); 'with delivering them'
وَإِيصَالِ: وَ + إِيصَالِ — wa-, and + īṣāl, delivering (verbal noun of awṣala IV, m., gen., coordinated with the preceding bi-īṣāli-hā); 'and delivering'
بُيُوتِ: buyūt — houses (pl. of bayt, m., gen. after ilā, first term of a construct); 'the houses of'
يُخْبِرُوهُمْ: yukhbirū + hum — akhbara, inform, tell (verb IV, impf. subjunctive 3mp, after an) + -hum, them; 'that they tell them'
بِأَنَّهُمْ: بِـ + أَنَّ + هُمْ — bi-, of, about (akhbara bi-, 'inform of') + anna, that + -hum, they (subject of the clause); 'of the fact that they'
مُطْمَئِنُّونَ: muṭmaʾinnūn — at ease, tranquil, secure (iṭmaʾanna, quadriliteral verb, active part., m. pl., nom., predicate of anna-hum); 'at ease'
وَأَعْلِمُوهُمْ: وَ + أَعْلِمُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and + aʿlimū, inform (aʿlama, verb IV, imperative 2mp) + -hum, them; 'and inform them'
حِصَارِ: ḥiṣār — siege, blockade (verbal noun of ḥāṣara III, m., gen. after a preposition, first term of a construct); 'the siege of'
نُخَرِّبَهَا: nukharribu + hā — kharraba, lay waste, ruin (verb II, impf. 1p, subjunctive after an) + -hā, it (the city, f.); 'that we lay it waste'
نَمُوتَ: namūta — māta, die (verb I, impf. 1p, subjunctive after aw 'or' with implied an); 'or we die'
بِفَتْحِهَا: بِـ + فَتْح + هَا — bi-, by, with (illā bi-, 'except with, only by') + fatḥ, opening, conquest (verbal noun of fataḥa, m., gen.) + -hā, its (the city's); 'except with its conquest'
أَعْلِمْهَا: aʿlim + hā — aʿlama, inform, let know (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + -hā, her (Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'inform her'
وَأَوْصِهَا: وَ + أَوْصِ + هَا — wa-, and + awṣi, charge, commend (awṣā, verb IV, imperative 2ms; takes bi- of the thing charged, here bi-waladī 'with my child') + -hā, her; 'and charge her'; here followed by an and the subjunctive for what she is charged to do: awṣihā an taʾtiya, 'bid her come'
زَوْجَتِى: zawjat + ī — zawja, wife (f., nom., construct) + -ī, my (written ى for ي, a non-classical spelling); 'my wife'
قَرِيبَةً: qarībatan — qarība, near (f. adj., acc., predicate of kānat; with min, 'near to giving birth')
إِلَّاوَلَدَتْ: illā + waladat — illā, except + waladat, give birth (walada, verb I, perf. 3fs); written run together as إِلَّاوَلَدَتْ, a non-classical spelling; mā hiya al-āna illā waladat, 'she has by now given birth'
رُزِقَتْ: ruziqat — razaqa, provide, grant (verb I, perf. passive 3fs); 'she has been granted (a child)'
فَأَسْرِعْ: فَ + أَسْرِعْ — fa-, then, so + asriʿ, hasten (asraʿa, verb IV, imperative 2ms); 'then hasten'
بِالْأَخْبَارِ: بِـ + الـ + أَخْبَار — bi-: (1) with, after ātā bi- 'bring' (iʾtinī bi-al-akhbār, 'bring me the news'); (2) after wa-idhā of surprise it only marks what appears ('and behold, the news') + al-, the + akhbār, news, tidings (pl. of khabar, gen.)
وَهَبَهُمْ: wahaba + hum — wahaba, give, bestow (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them (indirect object); 'he gave them'
شَيْاً: shayʾan — shayʾ, a thing, something (m., acc.); written شَيْاً without hamza, a non-classical spelling; 'something'
فَأَخَذُوةُ: فَ + أَخَذُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and so + akhadhū, take (akhadha, verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, it (written ة for the pronoun -hu, a non-classical spelling); 'so they took it'
لِوَدَاعِهِمْ: لِـ + وَدَاع + هِمْ — li-, for (purpose: 'in order to bid farewell') + wadāʿ, farewell, seeing off (verbal noun of wadaʿa/waddaʿa, m., gen.) + -him, them; 'to bid them farewell'
وَأَوْصَوْهُمْ: وَ + أَوْصَوْا + هُمْ — wa-, and + awṣaw, charge, enjoin (awṣā, verb IV, perf. 3mp; here with ʿalā 'over, concerning') + -hum, them; 'and they charged them'
أَمْوَالِهِمْ: amwāl + him — amwāl, riches, goods (pl. of māl, m., gen. after ʿalā; awṣā ʿalā 'charge concerning') + -him, their; 'their wealth'
وَأَمَرَةُ: وَ + أَمَرَ + هُ — wa-, and + amara, command (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes the accusative of the person and bi- or an of the command) + -hu, him (written ة for -hu, a non-classical spelling); 'and he commanded him'
يَأْمُرَ: yaʾmura — amara, command (verb I, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an; takes the accusative of the person and bi- of the thing commanded); 'that he command'
بِالزَّحْفِ: بِـ + الـ + زَّحْف — bi-, with (amara bi-, 'command to do something') + al-, the + zaḥf, advance, marching on (verbal noun of zaḥafa, m., gen.); 'to advance'
السُّورِ: الـ + سُور — al-, the + sūr, wall, city wall (m., gen. after a preposition or noun); 'the wall'
فَزَحَفُوا: فَ + زَحَفُوا — fa-, and so + zaḥafū, advance, march in a body (zaḥafa, verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and so they advanced'
الْخَوَّانِ: الـ + خَوَّان — al-khawwān, the treacherous, perfidious (intensive form of khāna, m. adj., gen., in apposition to al-zāhid); 'the traitor'
غِيَابِهِمْ: ghiyāb + hum — ghiyāb, absence (verbal noun of ghāba, m., gen., first term of a construct) + -hum, their; 'their absence'
لِلْحُرَّاسِ: لِـ + الـ + حُرَّاس — li-, to (ṣāḥa li-, 'cry out to') + al-, the + ḥurrās, guards (pl. of ḥāris, m., gen.); 'to the guards'
يُدْلُوا: yudlū — adlā, let down (a bucket, rope) (verb IV, impf. subjunctive 3mp, after an; with li-hā 'to her'); 'that they let down'
فَعَرَفُوهَا: فَ + عَرَفُوا + هَا — fa-, and so + ʿarafū, know, recognise (ʿarafa, verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they recognised her'
وَأَدْلَوْا: وَ + أَدْلَوْا — wa-, and + adlaw, let down (adlā, verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they let down'
وَسَحَبُوهَا: وَ + سَحَبُوا + هَا — wa-, and + saḥabū, drag, haul (saḥaba, verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they hauled her'
أَبْكَتْ: abkat — abkā, make weep (verb IV, perf. 3fs, causative of bakā); 'she made (them) weep'
أَفْرِيدُونُ: Afrīdūn — personal name, the king of the Rūm (diptote; nom. here, subject of fariḥa / qāla); 'Afrīdūn'
وَدَعَى: وَ + دَعَى — wa-, and + daʿā, pray (verb I, perf. 3ms; daʿā lahā bi-, 'pray for her for' — bi- marks what is asked); written with ى for ا; 'and he prayed'
بِالصَّبْرِ: بِـ + الـ + صَّبْر — bi-, with, for (daʿā bi-, 'invoke upon someone') + al-, the + ṣabr, patience, fortitude (m., gen.); 'for patience'
أَرْضَ: arḍa — raḍiya, be content (verb I, impf. 1s, jussive after lam; raḍiya bi- 'be content with', here bi-qatli); 'I am not content'
كِلَابِ: kilāb — dogs (pl. of kalb, m., gen., after min; construct with al-Muslimīna); 'the dogs of'
ثَأْرِ: thaʾr — blood-revenge, vengeance (m., gen. after fī, 'in return for'; written ثَأْرِ with hamza); 'vengeance'
وَأُدَبِّرُ: وَ + أُدَبِّرُ — wa-, and + udabbiru, contrive, plan (dabbara, verb II, impf. 1s); 'and I contrive'
مَكِيدَةً: makīda — plot, stratagem, ruse (f., acc., object); 'a plot'
وَعَشَرَةَ: وَ + عَشَرَة — wa-, and + ʿasharat, ten (f. numeral, acc., object of aqtul, governing the gen. ālāf 'thousands'); 'and ten (thousand)'
رَاسُ: raʾs — head (m., nom., construct); written رَاسُ without hamza (non-classical for رَأْس); 'the head of'
بِرَاسِ: بِـ + رَاس — bi-, in exchange for (tarūḥu bi-, 'go for, be the price of') + raʾs, head (m., gen.; written رَاس without hamza); 'for the head of'
وَأَقْطَعَ: وَ + أَقْطَعَ — wa-, and + aqṭaʿa, cut (qaṭaʿa, verb I, impf. 1s, subjunctive after an); 'and cut'
الزُّنَّارَ: الـ + زُّنَّار — al-zunnār, girdle, the belt worn by Christians (m., acc., object); 'the girdle'
وَأَكْسِرَ: وَ + أَكْسِرَ — wa-, and + aksira, break (kasara, verb I, impf. 1s, subjunctive after an); 'and break'
أُخَالِفُ: ukhālifu — khālafa, oppose, contradict (verb III, impf. 1s, indicative after lā; with li-ki 'to you'); 'I do not oppose'
حُزْنَكِ: ḥuzn + ki — ḥuzn, grief, mourning (m., acc., object of ʿamilti) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your mourning'
يُحَاصِرُونَا: yuḥāṣirūnā — ḥāṣara, besiege (verb III, impf. 3mp) + -nā, us; the verb follows arādū without an and its plural -ūna is shortened to -ū before -nā; 'they wanted to besiege us'
يَنَالُوا: yanālū — nāla min-nā, obtain from us (nāla, verb I, impf. 3mp, jussive after lam, nūn dropped); 'they would not obtain'
يَنَالُهُمْ: yanālu + hum — nāla, reach, befall (verb I, impf. 3ms, indicative after lā) + -hum, them (object); 'would reach them'
وَالنَّصَبِ: وَ + الـ + نَّصَب — wa-, and + al-, the + naṣab, toil, fatigue, weariness (m., gen.); 'and the weariness'
وَالْمَخَازِى: وَ + الـ + مَخَازِي — wa-, and + al-, the + makhāzī, infamies, disgraceful deeds (pl. of makhzāt, indeclinable gen.; written ى for ي, a non-classical spelling); 'and the infamies'
لِنَفْسِهَا: لِـ + نَفْس + هَا — li-, of, for (possessive: 'that were of her') + nafs, self, soul (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her own self' Also li- of benefit after ikhtāra, 'to choose': ikhtārathu li-nafsihā, 'she chose it for herself'.
أَبْدَتْهَا: abdat + hā — abdā, show, reveal, display (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hā, them (the infamies); 'she had shown them'
وَقِرْطَاسًا: وَ + قِرْطَاس — wa-, and + qirṭās, paper, sheet (m., acc. indef., coordinated with dawātan as object of akhadhat); 'and paper'
بِلَادَكُمْ: بِلَاد + كُمْ — bilād, lands, country (pl. of balad; acc., direct object of dakhaltu) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your lands'
وَغَشَشْتُ: وَ + غَشَشْتُ — wa-, and + ghashasha, deceive, cheat (verb I, perf. 1sg; the doubled sh is kept unmerged before -tu); 'and I deceived'
بِلُؤْمِى: بِـ + لُؤْم + ـي — bi-, with, by (prep., instrument: 'by means of') + luʾm, baseness, vileness (m., gen.) + -ī, my (the print writes the pronoun with ى); 'by my baseness'
كِرَامَكُمْ: كِرَام + كُمْ — kirām, noble, generous ones (pl. of karīm; m., acc., object of ghashashtu) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your noblest men'
مَلِكَكُمْ: مَلِك + كُمْ — malik, king (m., acc., object of qataltu, in construct) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your king'
وَقْعَةِ: وَقْعَة — waqʿa, battle, encounter (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa after fī); 'the battle of'
وَالْمَغَارَةِ: وَ + الـ + مَغَارَة — wa-, and + al-, the + maghāra, cave (f., gen., coordinated with al-shiʿb); 'and the cave'
وَغِلْمَانُهُ: وَ + غِلْمَان + ـهُ — wa-, and + ghilmān, pages, servant boys (pl. of ghulām; m., nom., coordinated with sharrukān) + -hu, his; 'and his pages'
وَطَاوَعَنِي: وَ + طَاوَعَنِي — wa-, and + ṭāwaʿa, obey, comply with (verb III, perf. 3ms, in the conditional after law) + -nī, me (object); 'and (if) Satan obeys me'
وَالْمَكَائِدُ: وَ + الـ + مَكَائِد — wa-, and + al-, the + makāʾid, plots, wiles (pl. of makīda; f., nom., coordinated with al-ḥiyal, subject of inṭalaqat); 'and the plots'
سَلَامَتَكُمْ: سَلَامَة + كُمْ — salāma, safety, deliverance (f., acc., object of shiʾtum) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your safety'
هَلَاكَ: هَلَاك — halāk, destruction, ruin (verbal noun of halaka; m., acc., object of shiʾtum, first term of an iḍāfa with anfusikum); 'the destruction of'
نَعَنِ: نَعَنِ — a form kept as printed (misprint-like); the sense wants فَعَنِ fa-ʿani, fa-, then + ʿan, from, away from (prep., before al-iqāma, the article's alif lost); 'then from'
الْإِقَامَةِ: الـ + إِقَامَة — al-, the + iqāma, staying, remaining (verbal noun of form IV aqāma; f., gen. after ʿan 'from'); 'the staying'
تَعْدِلُوا: تَعْدِلُوا — ʿadala ʿan, swerve, turn aside from (verb I, jussive 2mp after lā, prohibition; the final -ū is written with alif); 'do not swerve (from)'
تَبْلُغُونَ: تَبْلُغُونَ — balagha, reach, attain (verb I, imperf. 2mp indicative, after mā 'not'); 'you will (not) reach'
مَرَامًا: مَرَام — marām, aim, object of desire (m., acc. indef., object of tablughūna); 'an aim'
أَقَامَتْ: أَقَامَتْ — aqāma, stay, remain, keep (verb IV of qwm, perf. 3fs); 'she stayed, she kept up'
حُزْنِهَا: حُزْن + هَا — ḥuzn, grief, mourning (m., gen. after fī 'in') + -hā, her; 'her grief'
بِطْرِيقًا: بِطْرِيق — biṭrīq (vocalised here biṭrīq; also baṭrīq), patrician, Byzantine commander (from Latin patricius, through Greek patrikios; m., acc. indef., object of daʿat); the bi- here is part of the word, not a preposition; 'a patrician'
وَيَضَعَهَا: وَ + يَضَعَ + هَا — wa-, and + waḍaʿa, put, place (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after an, coordinated with yaʾkhudha) + -hā, it (f., the leaf); 'and put it'
سَهْمٍ: سَهْم — sahm, arrow (m., gen. indef. after fī 'in'); 'an arrow'
وَيَرْمِيَهَا: وَ + يَرْمِيَ + هَا — wa-, and + ramā, throw, shoot (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after an) + -hā, it (f., the leaf); 'and shoot it'
الْكَنِيسَهَ: الـ + كَنِيسَة — al-, the + kanīsa, church (f., acc., direct object of dakhalat); the print writes ه for ة (الْكَنِيسَهَ); 'the church'
تَنْدُبُ: تَنْدُبُ — nadaba, lament, mourn (verb I, imperf. 3fs, after ṣārat 'she began'); 'lamenting'
تَسَلْطَنَ: تَسَلْطَنَ — tasalṭana, become sultan, assume the sultanate (denominal quadriliteral, form II, tafaʿlala, from sulṭān; perf. 3ms); 'who became sultan'
بَعْدَةُ: بَعْد + ـهُ — baʿda, after (adv., acc. in construct) + -hu, him; the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (بَعْدَةُ); 'after him'
وَاغْتِمَامٍ: وَ + اغْتِمَام — wa-, and + ightimām, gloom, distress (verbal noun of form VIII of ghamma; m., gen., coordinated with hamm after fī); 'and gloom'
بِبِطْرِيقٍ: بِـ + بِطْرِيق — bi-, only marks what appears after wa-idhā 'and behold' (not 'with') + biṭrīq, patrician (m., gen. indef.; the second bi- belongs to the word; elsewhere baṭrīq); 'and behold, a patrician'
نُشَّابٍ: نُشَّاب — nushshāb, arrows (collective, m.; gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa with sahmu); 'an arrow-shaft of arrows', i.e. 'an arrow'
طَرَفِهِ: طَرَف + ـهِ — ṭaraf, tip, end (m., gen. after fī 'at') + -hi, its (the arrow's); 'at its tip'
فَصَبَرُوا: فَ + صَبَرُوا — fa-, and so, then + ṣabara ʿalā, wait for, be patient with (verb I, perf. 3mp; the verb chooses ʿalā); 'so they waited (for him)'
رَمَاةُ: رَمَا + هُ — ramā, throw, shoot (verb I, perf. 3ms, after ḥattā) + -hu, it (the arrow); the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (رَمَاةُ); 'he shot it'
قَرَأَةُ: قَرَأَ + هُ — qaraʾa, read (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the letter); the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (قَرَأَةُ); 'he read it'
مَعْنَاهُ: مَعْنَى + هُ — maʿnā, meaning, sense (m., acc., object of ʿarafa) + -hu, its; 'its meaning'
هَمَلَتْ: هَمَلَتْ — hamala, flow, run, shed (of eyes; verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the dual ʿaynāhu); 'ran (with tears)'
وَتَضَجَّرَ: وَ + تَضَجَّرَ — wa-, and + taḍajjara, be vexed, chafe, cry out in anguish (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he cried out in anguish'
نَافِرًا: نَافِر — nāfir, shying, averse (act. part. of nafara min 'shy away from'; m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'shying (from her)'
أَمْلَأَ: أَمْلَأَ — malaʾa, fill (verb I, subjunctive 1sg after ḥattā; takes bi- 'with' for the filling matter); 'I fill'
فَرْجَهَا: فَرْج + هَا — farj, vulva, sex (m., acc., object of amlaʾa) + -hā, her; 'her sex'
بِمَسِيحِ: بِـ + مَسِيح — bi-, with (prep.; 'fill with', the verb malaʾa takes bi- for the filling) + masīḥ, molten, running (read here as from sāḥa 'flow, melt'; the reading is uncertain; m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-raṣāṣ); 'with molten (lead)'
وَأَسْجُنَهَا: وَ + أَسْجُنَ + هَا — wa-, and + sajana, imprison, shut up (verb I, subjunctive 1sg after ḥattā) + -hā, her; 'and imprison her'
سِجْنَ: سِجْن — sijn, imprisoning, confinement (verbal noun of sajana; m., acc., cognate accusative, first term of an iḍāfa with al-ṭayr); 'the imprisoning of (birds)', i.e. 'as birds are caged'
أَرْبِطُهَا: أَرْبِطُ + هَا — rabaṭa, tie, bind (verb I, imperf. 1sg indicative) + -hā, her (object); with min shaʿrihā, 'by her hair'; 'I tie her'
وَأُصَلِّبُهَا: وَ + أُصَلِّبُ + هَا — wa-, and + ṣallaba, crucify (verb II, imperf. 1sg indicative) + -hā, her; ʿalā bāb 'on the gate'; 'and I crucify her'
أَخَاةُ: أَخَا + هُ — akhā, brother (m., acc., object of tadhakkara; one of the 'five nouns', acc. -ā) + -hu, his; the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (أَخَاةُ); 'his brother'
وَأَخْبَرَتْهُمْ: وَ + أَخْبَرَتْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + akhbara, inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3fs; takes bi- for the thing told, here bi-mā ḥaṣala 'of what happened') + -hum, them; 'and she told them'
وَوَعَدَهُمُ: وَ + وَعَدَ + هُمُ — wa-, and + waʿada, promise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -humu, them (object; the vowel u comes from the following al-); 'and he promised them'
وَعَرَى: وَ + عَرَى — wa-, and + ʿarā, befall, come over, seize (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes a direct object, here jismahu, with the subject al-huzāl placed after); 'and (the wasting) befell'
جِسْمَهُ: جِسْم + ـهُ — jism, body (m., acc., object of ʿarā) + -hu, his; 'his body'
الْهُزَالُ: الـ + هُزَال — al-, the + huzāl, emaciation, leanness (verbal noun of hazila; m., nom., subject of ʿarā); 'the wasting'
وَقَرَّ: وَ + قَرَّ — wa-, and + qarra, be cool, be at rest (verb I, imperative 2ms; in qarra ʿaynan 'be cool of eye', i.e. be glad, take comfort); 'and be comforted'
عَيْنًا: عَيْن — ʿayn, eye (f., acc. indef., specification, tamyīz, after qarra); 'in eye', i.e. 'cool of eye'; also acc. indef. after anna (anna lī ʿaynan, 'that I have an eye')
بِأَجَلِهِ: بِـ + أَجَل + ـهِ — bi-, by, at (prep., 'died only at/by his term') + ajal, appointed term, hour of death (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'at his appointed hour'
يَكُوْنُ: يَكُوْنُ — kāna, be, come to pass (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms indicative, after relative mā lā; the verse is pointed with sukūn on wāw as in the 1839 print); 'what is not to be'; here: plain 'is': hākadhā yakūnu jazāʾu al-mustahāmi, 'is this how the lovesick is repaid?'
بِحِيْلَة: بِـ + حِيْلَة — bi-, by, by means of (prep., instrument) + ḥīla, scheme, stratagem (f., gen.; the verse is printed without tanwīn, read ḥīlatin); 'by any scheme'
فَيَكُوْنُ: فَ + يَكُوْنُ — fa-, and so, then (introduces the consequent) + yakūnu, kāna, be, come to pass (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms indicative; pointed with sukūn on wāw in the print); 'and it will be'
سَيَكُوْنُ: سَ + يَكُوْنُ — sa-, will (future particle) + yakūnu, kāna, be, come to pass (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms indicative; pointed with sukūn on wāw in the print); 'it will be'
وَاَخُ: وَ + أَخُ — wa-, and + akhu, brother (m., nom., one of the 'five nouns', first term of an iḍāfa; the hamza is missing in the print, اَخُ, and the short vowel is as the verse wants it); 'and the brother of', i.e. 'one given to (ignorance)'
الْجَهَالَةِ: الـ + جَهَالَة — al-, the + jahāla, ignorance, folly (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'ignorance'
مَغْبُوْنُ: مَغْبُون — maghbūn, cheated, defrauded, the loser (pass. part. of ghabana; m., nom., predicate; printed with sukūn on wāw in the verse); 'cheated, a loser'
وَالنُّوَاحَ: وَ + الـ + نُوَاح — wa-, and + al-, the + nuwāḥ, wailing (verbal noun of nāḥa; m., acc., coordinated with al-bukāʾ, object of daʿi); 'and the wailing'
وَقَوِّ: وَ + قَوِّ — wa-, and + qawwi, strengthen (verb II, imperative 2ms; the imperative drops the final -ī); 'and strengthen'
غِيَابِنَا: غِيَاب + نَا — ghiyāb, absence (m., gen. after min ajli 'because of') + -nā, our; 'our absence'
بِرَعِيَّتِي: بِـ + رَعِيَّة + ـي — bi-, with (prep.; mashghūl bi- 'busy with' — the participle chooses bi-) + raʿiyya, subjects, flock, those shepherded (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my subjects'
وَسَمَّتْهُ: وَ + سَمَّتْ + هُ — wa-, and + sammā, name (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him (first object); 'and she named him'
سَيَكُونُ: سَ + يَكُونُ — sa-, will (future particle) + yakūnu, kāna, be (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); with lahu 'to him', kāna la- 'have'; 'he will have'
شَانٌ: شَأْنٌ — shaʾn, matter, standing, consequence (m., nom. indef., subject of yakūnu; the hamza is missing in the print, شَانٌ); 'a standing, consequence'
رَأَوْةُ: رَأَوْ + هُ — raʾā, see (verb I, perf. 3mp, written without the silent alif of the plural) + -hu, it, him; the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (رَأَوْةُ); 'they saw it'
وَالْخُطَبَاءَ: وَ + الـ + خُطَبَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + khuṭabāʾ, preachers (pl. of khaṭīb; m., acc., diptote, coordinated with al-ʿulamāʾ, object of amarat); 'and the preachers'
وَدُبُرَ: وَ + دُبُر — wa-, and + dubur, back, end, close (m., acc. adverbial, first term of an iḍāfa with kulli ṣalātin); 'and at the end of'
صَلٰوةٍ: صَلٰوَة — ṣalāt, prayer (f., gen. indef., after kull; spelt with wāw and dagger alif, the edition's older spelling for ṣalāh); 'prayer'
وَالْأَمْطَارُ: وَ + الـ + أَمْطَار — wa-, and + al-, the + amṭār, rains (pl. of maṭar; m., nom., subject of a nominal clause, wa-al-amṭāru kathīratun); 'and the rains'
صَاحِبَكَ: صَاحِب + كَ — ṣāḥib, companion, friend (m., acc., after anna, in construct) + -ka, your (m. sg.); 'your friend'
الْجَزِيلَةِ: الـ + جَزِيلَة — al-, the + jazīla, ample, abundant (f. adj., gen., agreeing with al-niʿma, which it follows); 'the ample'
وَعِنْدَةُ: وَ + عِنْد + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿinda, with, at the disposal of (prep./adv., 'he has') + -hu, him; the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu (وَعِنْدَةُ); 'and with him'
أَتَاةُ: أَتَى + ـهُ — atā, to come (verb I, 3ms perfect) + 3ms object; print ة for ه: atāhu, 'came to him'
أَتْرُكَ: أَتْرُكَ — taraka, to leave, abandon (verb I, 1cs subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that I leave'
وَأَعْمَلَ: وَ + أَعْمَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿmala, to do, make (verb I, 1cs subjunctive, coordinated with أَنْ); 'and do'
وَأُمُورًا: وَ + أُمُور — wa-, and (conj.) + umūr, matters, things (pl. of أَمْر); accusative, object of aʿmala
فَنَصَبُوهَا: فَ + نَصَبَ + وا + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + naṣaba, to set up, pitch (verb I) + 3mp ending + 3fs object (the tents); 'so they pitched them'
خَرَجُوْا: خَرَجُوا — kharaja, to go out (verb I, 3mp perfect); print has sukūn on the wāw; 'they went out'
بَاكٍ: بَاكٍ — bākin, weeping one, weeper (active participle of بَكَى, verb I, indefinite genitive after كُلِّ); 'every weeper'
صَعَقَاتُ: صَعَقَات — ṣaʿaqāt, swoonings, thunder-struck faintings (pl. of صَعْقَة), nominative; 'the swoonings of Moses'
دَكِّ: دَكّ — dakk, shattering, pounding to dust (verbal noun of dakka, verb I); genitive in iḍāfa after يَوْم
الطُّوْرِ: الطُّور — al-Ṭūr, the Mount (Sinai) (m.); genitive in iḍāfa after دَكّ; 'the shattering of the Mount'
اَتَوْا: أَتَوْا — atā, to come (verb I, 3mp perfect); print omits the hamza-seat mark and has alif for hamza; 'they came'
جَدَثًا: جَدَثًا — jadathan, tomb, grave (m., acc., indefinite), object of atawā 'until they came to a tomb'
ضَرِيْحَهُ: ضَرِيح + هُ — ḍarīḥ, grave-trench, tomb (m., nom. subject after كَأَنَّ) + 3ms possessive; 'its grave-trench'
مُوَحِّدٍ: مُوَحِّد — muwaḥḥid, one who affirms God's oneness, monotheist (active participle verb II); genitive after كُلّ
مَحْفُوْرُ: مَحْفُور — maḥfūr, dug (passive participle of ḥafara, verb I; nom. predicate of كَأَنَّ); 'were dug'
آمُلُ: آمُلُ — amala, to hope (verb I, 1cs imperfect indicative, after مَا كُنْتُ); 'I did not hope'
نَعْشِكَ: نَعْش + كَ — naʿsh, bier (m.; genitive after قَبْلَ) + 2ms possessive; 'your bier'
رَضْوَى: رَضْوَى — Raḍwā, a proper name: a mountain near Medina (acc., object of أَرَى; indeclinable, ending in -ā)
اَيْدِى: أَيْدِي — aydī, hands (pl. of يَد), genitive after عَلَى; print writes final ى for ي; 'upon the hands'
تَسِيْرُ: تَسِير — sāra, to move, travel (verb I, 3fs imperfect indicative, refers to رَضْوَى); 'moving'
دَفْنِكَ: دَفْن + كَ — dafn, burial (verbal noun of dafana, verb I; genitive after قَبْلِ) + 2ms possessive; 'your burial'
تَغُوْرُ: تَغُور — ghāra, to sink, go down (verb I, 3fp imperfect, subject الْكَوَاكِب); 'sink'
اَمُجَاوِرَ: أَ + مُجَاوِر — a-, O (vocative particle, written with alif) + mujāwir, neighbour (active participle verb III; acc. as vocative muḍāf); 'O neighbour of'
الدَّيْمَاسِ: الدَّيْمَاس — al-daymās, the dungeon, vault, the grave (m.); genitive in iḍāfa after مُجَاوِر
رَهْنُ: رَهْن — rahn, pledge, thing pledged (m., nom.); here 'a pledge' (of the low ground); in apposition to the vocative
قَرَارَةٍ: قَرَارَة — qarāra, low-lying ground, hollow where water settles; here the grave (f., genitive in iḍāfa after رَهْن)
فِيْهَا: فِي + هَا — fī, in (prep.) + 3fs pronoun (referring to قَرَارَة); print ي with sukūn then ـهَا; 'in it'
وَالنُّوْرُ: وَ + الـ + نُّور — wa-, and (conj.) + al-nūr, the light (m., nom.); coordinated with الضِّيَاء
كَفَلَ: كَفَلَ — kafala, to guarantee, be surety (verb I, 3ms perfect); 'has guaranteed'
الثَّنَاءُ: الثَّنَاء — al-thanāʾ, praise (m., nom., subject of kafala)
انْطَوَى: انْطَوَى — inṭawā, to be folded up, rolled up (verb VII, 3ms perfect, from ṭawā); final ى for alif maqṣūra; 'was folded up'
فَكَانَّهُ: فَ + كَأَنَّ + هُ — fa-, then (conj.) + ka-anna, as if, 'as though' (ka- + anna; print omits the hamza-seat, kaanna) + 3ms; 'then it is as if he'
مَنْشُورُ: مَنْشُور — manshūr, spread out, unfolded (passive participle of nashara, verb I; nom. predicate of كَأَنَّ); 'spread out'
تَرَكْتَ: تَرَكْتَ — taraka, to leave (verb I, 2ms perfect); 'you left'
يَفْنِي: يَفْنِي — fanā, to perish, pass away (verb I, 3ms imperfect, relative clause after الَّذِي); 'which perishes'
اَقْوَامٌ: أَقْوَام — aqwām, peoples, folk (pl. of قَوْم; nom. indefinite, predicate of مِثْلُكَ); print writes alif without hamza
سَبَقُوا: سَبَقُوا — sabaqa, to go before, precede (verb I, 3mp perfect); 'they have gone before'
سَبْقَا: سَبْقًا — sabqan, a going before (verbal noun of sabaqa, verb I, acc.; cognate accusative for emphasis); print has alif without tanwīn mark
وَفَارَقْتَ: وَ + فَارَقْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, 2ms perfect); 'and you parted from'
هَذِى: هَذِي — hādhī, this (f. demonstrative, qualifying الدَّار); print writes ى for ي; 'this (abode)'
رِيبَةٍ: رِيبَة — rība, doubt, suspicion (f., genitive after مِنْ غَيْرِ); 'without a doubt'
تَسُرُّ: تَسُرّ — sarra, to gladden (verb I, imperfect as pointed in print, 2ms/3fs); sense 'glad, rejoicing', with bi- of the cause: 'at what you meet'
تَلَاقَى: تَلَاقَى — talāqā, to meet, encounter (verb VI, 2ms imperfect, ending -ā for rhyme, after بِمَا); 'what you meet'
الاَعْدَاءِ: الْأَعْدَاء — al-aʿdāʾ, the enemies (pl. of عَدُو); genitive after مِنْ; print writes alif without hamza
وِقَايَةً: وِقَايَة — wiqāya, protection, shielding (verbal noun of waqā; acc. as object of tubdī); 'showing a shielding'
سِهَامُ: سِهَام — sihām, arrows (pl. of سَهْم; m. nom. subject of sāwat)
سَاوَتِ: سَاوَتِ — sāwā, to equal, match (verb III, 3fs perfect, with kasra before الرَّشْقَى); 'matched'
الرَّشْقَى: الرَّشْقَى — al-rashqā, the volley, flight of arrows (rashq); print writes ى for alif of the rhyme; accusative object of sāwat
غُرُورًا: غُرُورًا — ghurūr, delusion, deceit (m., acc. indefinite, predicate object of arā)
وَبَاطِلًا: وَ + بَاطِلًا — wa-, and (conj.) + bāṭil, vain thing, falsehood (active participle of baṭala; acc.); 'and vanity'
وَجَلُّ: وَ + جُلّ — wa-, and (conj.) + julla, the greater part, most of (m., nom. in iḍāfa); print points jallu; 'and the most of'
مُرَادِ: مُرَاد — murād, wish, object of desire (passive participle verb IV of arāda; genitive after جُلّ)
يَطْلُبُوا: يَطْلُبُوا — ṭalaba, to seek (verb I, 3mp subjunctive after أَنْ, dropped nūn); 'that they seek'
حَبَاكَ: حَبَاكَ — ḥabā, to grant, bestow upon (verb I, 3ms perfect) + 2ms object; 'has granted you'
فَوْزًا: فَوْزًا — fawz, triumph, success (verbal noun of fāza, acc., second object); 'a triumph'
بِجَنَّةٍ: بِ + جَنَّة — bi-, with/by way of (attaching fawz to its content: 'triumph with a garden') + janna, garden, Paradise (f., genitive)
وَاَسْكَنَكَ: وَ + أَسْكَنَ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + askana, to make dwell, lodge (verb IV, 3ms perfect) + 2ms object; 'and made you dwell'
اَصْدَقَا: أَصْدَقَا — aṣdaqa, most true (elative of صَادِق); print has final alif for rhyme (-ā) for accusative; 'most true'
اَمْسَيْتُ: أَمْسَيْتُ — amsā, to come to evening, become (verb IV, 1cs perfect, from masā); 'I have come to evening, I am'
بِحَسْرَةٍ: بِ + حَسْرَة — bi-, in (state of) (the preposition marking being in regret) + ḥasra, regret, anguish (f., genitive); 'in regret'
الْغَرْبَ: الْغَرْب — al-gharb, the west (m., acc., object of arā); 'the west'
مَحْزُونًا: مَحْزُونًا — maḥzūn, grieving, saddened (passive participle of ḥazina/ḥazana; acc., predicate of object); 'grieving'
بِفَقْدِكَ: بِ + فَقْد + كَ — bi-, at, because of (with maḥzūn: 'grieving at') + faqd, loss (verbal noun of faqada; genitive) + 2ms possessive; 'at the loss of you'
وَالشَّرْقَ: وَ + الـ + شَّرْقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-sharq, the east (m., acc., coordinated with الْغَرْب)
وَنَثَرَتْ: وَ + نَثَرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + nathara, to scatter, strew (verb I, 3fs perfect, subject عُيُون); 'and scattered'
عُيُونُهُ: عُيُون + هُ — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of عَيْن; nom. subject) + 3ms possessive; 'his eyes'
دُرًّا: دُرًّا — durr, pearls (collective noun; acc. as hāl/comparison, 'as pearls'); with tanwīn
نَضِيدًا: نَضِيدًا — naḍīd, strung or arranged in order (passive sense, from naḍada; acc. adjective of دُرًّا); 'strung in order'
الْخُلْجَانَ: الْخُلْجَان — al-khuljān, channels, creeks (pl. of خَلِيج; acc.); print form khuljān; 'the channels'
الْمَكْرُمَاتِ: الْ + مَكْرُمَات — al-makrumāt, noble deeds, generous acts (pl. of مَكْرُمَة); genitive after مِنْ; 'of the noble deeds'
مُخَمَّسًا: مُخَمَّسًا — mukhammas, five-fold, five-lined (passive participle verb II of khammasa; acc. adjective of شِعْرًا); 'five-fold (verse)'
الْعَطَاءُ: الْعَطَاء — al-ʿaṭāʾ, giving, gift (verbal noun of aʿṭā; m., nom. subject after أَيْنَ); 'the giving'
وَكَفُّ: وَ + كَفّ — wa-, and (circumstantial conj.; 'while') + kaff, palm of the hand (m., nom. in iḍāfa with جُودِكَ)
وَالْجِسْمُ: وَ + الـ + جِسْم — wa-, and (circumstantial conj.) + jism, body (m., nom.); 'and the body'; also plain 'and' joining a sentence (wa-al-jismu matʿūbu, 'and the body is worn out')

انْبَرَى: انْبَرَى — inbarā, to be pared thin, whittled (verb VII, 3ms perfect with qad); final ى for alif maqṣūra; 'has been pared down'
حَادِيَ: حَادِيَ — ḥādī, driver of camels, singer to camels (active participle of ḥadā; vocative muḍāf, acc.); 'O driver of'
الْاَضْعَانِ: الْأَضْعَان — al-aẓʿān, camel-litters (pl. of ظَعِينَة); print has ض for ظ; genitive, 'of the litters'
سَرَّكَ: سَرَّ + كَ — sarra, to gladden (verb I, 3ms perfect) + 2ms object; wish: 'may what you see gladden you'
اَسْطُرَا: أَسْطُر — asṭur, lines (pl. of سَطْر); acc. (object of kataba), ending in alif for rhyme; 'lines'
تَعْنِي: تَعْنِي — ʿaniya, to be concerned, occupied with (verb I, 2ms imperfect; takes bi- 'with them', 'you concern yourself')
مَنْظَرَا: مَنْظَرًا — manẓar, sight, spectacle (m., acc., tamyīz/ḥāl: 'as a sight')
حَدَّثْتُ: حَدَّثْتُ — ḥaddatha, to tell, speak to (verb II, 1cs perfect; the 'inmost-thoughts' are the subject: 'have not told of you')
ضَمَائِرِي: ضَمَائِر + ي — ḍamāʾir, inmost thoughts, hearts (pl. of ضَمِير; nom.) + 1cs possessive; 'my inmost thoughts'
عُلَاكَ: عُلَا + كَ — ʿulā, loftiness, high rank (f., nom.) + 2ms possessive; 'your loftiness'
جَرَحَ: جَرَحَ — jaraḥa, to wound (verb I, 3ms perfect; subject الدُّمُوع as plural taking a masculine verb); 'wounded'
مَحَاجِرِي: مَحَاجِر + ي — maḥājir, eye-sockets (pl. of مَحْجِر); acc. object + 1cs possessive; 'my eye-sockets'
نَوَاظِرِي: نَوَاظِر + ي — nawāẓir, eyes, glances (pl. of nāẓira); acc. object of ṣarafa + 1cs possessive; 'my glances'
عَنَانَ: عَنَان — ʿanān, rein (m., acc., object of jadhaba; in iḍāfa with طَرْفِي); 'the rein'
إِنَّهُمُ: إِنَّ + هُمُ — inna, indeed (particle introducing a clause, here 'then') + 3mp pronoun (subject); 'that they'
يَتَشَاوَرَانِ: يَتَشَاوَرَانِ — tashāwara, to consult together (verb VI, 3md imperfect, dual); 'the two consulting'
وَاسْتَمَرَّا: وَ + اسْتَمَرَّ + ا — wa-, and (conj.) + istamarra, to continue, persist (verb X, 3md perfect, dual -ā); 'and the two continued'
يَتَضَجَّرُ: يَتَضَجَّرُ — taḍajjara, to chafe, be vexed (verb V, 3ms imperfect indicative); takes min 'from care'
سَمَاعَ: سَمَاع — samāʿ, hearing (verbal noun of samiʿa; acc., object of اشْتَهِي); 'the hearing of'
وَأَحَادِيثِ: وَ + أَحَادِيث — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥādīth, talks, narratives (pl. of حَدِيث); genitive in series; 'and the talks of'
وَحِكَايَاتِ: وَ + حِكَايَات — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥikāyāt, tales, stories (pl. of حِكَايَة); genitive; 'and the tales of'
الْمُتَيَّمِينَ: الْ + مُتَيَّمِين — al-mutayyamīn, those enslaved by love (active participle verb II of tayyama; genitive pl. after ḥikāyāt)
وَيُذْهِبُ: وَ + يُذْهِبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhahaba, verb IV adhhaba, to take away (3ms imperfect indicative, God as subject); 'and takes away'
وَالْعَدِيدَ: وَ + الـ + عَدِيد — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿadīd, wailing, lamentation (m., acc., coordinated with البُكَاء); 'and the wailing'
سَمَاعُ: سَمَاع — samāʿ, hearing (verbal noun of samiʿa; nom. after إِلَّا as subject of يُفَرِّجُ); 'the hearing of'
قِصَصِ: قِصَص — qiṣaṣ, stories, narratives (pl. of قِصَّة); genitive in iḍāfa after سَمَاعُ
نَوَادِرِ: نَوَادِر — nawādir, rarities, curiosities (pl. of نَادِرَة); genitive after مِنْ; 'of the rarities of'
بِالْحِكَايَاتِ: بِ + الـ + حِكَايَات — bi-, with (the occupation: shughl... illā bi-, 'except with') + al-ḥikāyāt, the tales (genitive pl.)
وَالْأَشْعَارِ: وَ + الـ + أَشْعَار — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ashʿār, the poems (pl. of شِعْر); genitive, coordinated with الْحِكَايَاتِ
الْعَاشِقِ: الْ + عَاشِق — al-ʿāshiq, the lover (active participle of ʿashiqa, verb I; genitive after khabar)
وَالْمَعْشُوقِ: وَ + الـ + مَعْشُوق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-maʿshūq, the beloved (passive participle of ʿashiqa; genitive)
وَعَدَهُ: وَعَدَ + هُ — waʿada, to promise (verb I, 3ms perfect) + 3ms object; 'he had promised him' (the verb takes bi- of the thing promised)
اشْتِغَالٌ: اشْتِغَال — ishtighāl, occupation, being busy (verbal noun of verb VIII ishtaghala; nom. subject of yabqa); 'occupation'
بِانْتِظَارِ: بِ + انْتِظَار — bi-, with (occupation 'with'; ishtighāl takes bi-) + intiẓār, awaiting, waiting (verbal noun of verb VIII; genitive)
مَجِيءِ: مَجِيء — majīʾ, coming (verbal noun of jāʾa, verb I; genitive in iḍāfa after intiẓār); 'the coming of (the night)'
يَحْكِيهِ: يَحْكِي + هِ — ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, 3ms imperfect) + 3ms object (the relative mā); 'what he would tell'
بِإِيقَادِ: بِ + إِيقَاد — bi-, with ('ordered the' + verbal noun: amara takes bi- of the thing ordered) + īqād, kindling (verbal noun of verb IV awqada; genitive)
فَأَحْضَرُوا: فَ + أَحْضَرُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + aḥḍara, to bring, make present (verb IV, 3mp perfect); 'so they brought'
وَتُرْكَاشَ: وَ + تُرْكَاش — wa-, and (conj.) + Turkāsh, a proper name, an emir (genitive after إِلَى)
وَسَدَلَ: وَ + سَدَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + sadala, to let down, draw down (verb I, 3ms perfect, subject اللَّيْل); 'and drew down'
جَلَابِيبَهُ: جَلَابِيب + هُ — jalābīb, mantles, outer garments (pl. of جِلْبَاب; acc. object) + 3ms possessive (the night's); 'its mantles'
وَنُرِيدُ: وَ + نُرِيدُ — wa-, and (conj.) + arāda, to want, wish (verb IV, 1cp imperfect indicative); 'and we wish'
وَعَدْتَنَا: وَعَدْتَ + نَا — waʿada, to promise (verb I, 2ms perfect) + 1cp object; 'you promised us'
الْحِكَايَاتِ: الْ + حِكَايَات — al-ḥikāyāt, the tales, stories (pl. of حِكَايَة); genitive after مِنْ; 'of the tales'
تَحْكِىَ: تَحْكِي — ḥakā, to tell, relate (verb I, 2ms subjunctive after أَنْ, final ى for ي in print); 'that you tell'
وَنُرِيدُأَنْ: وَ + نُرِيدُ + أَنْ — wa-, and; nurīdu, to want (verb IV, imperf. 1pl., indic.) + an, that (subjunctive particle); the print runs the two words together; 'and we want you to'
تَحْكِيَ: تَحْكِيَ — taḥkiya, to tell, relate (verb I defective ḥakā/yaḥkī, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that you tell'

وَيُسَلِّي: وَ + يُسَلِّي — wa-, and; yusallī, to console, comfort (verb II defective, imperf. 3ms, indic.; takes ʿan for what is consoled); 'and consoles (for)'
حُزْنِ: حُزْن — ḥuzn, grief, sorrow (m. noun; gen. as second term of idāfa after mithl); 'the grief (of)'
يَعْقُوبَ: يَعْقُوب — Yaʿqūb, Jacob (proper name, diptote, gen. -a); 'Jacob', whose grief for Joseph is proverbial

جِبَالِ: جِبَال — jibāl, mountains (pl. of جَبَل, gen. in idāfa); 'the mountains (of)'
أَصْبَهَانَ: أَصْبَهَان — Aṣbahān, Isfahan (city in Iran; diptote proper name, gen. -a); 'Isfahan'
الْخَضْرَاءُ: الْـ + خَضْرَاء — al-, the + khaḍrāʾ, green (f. of أَخْضَر, nom.; adj. of al-madīna); 'the Green (City)'
جُودٍ: جُود — jūd, generosity, bounty (m. noun, gen. in idāfa after ṣāḥib); 'of generosity'
وَعَدْلٍ: وَ + عَدْل — wa-, and; ʿadl, justice (m. noun, gen., coordinated); 'and of justice'
وَفَضْلٍ: وَ + فَضْل — wa-, and; faḍl, favour, virtue, excellence (m. noun, gen., coordinated); 'and of bounty'
وَامْتِنَانٍ: وَ + امْتِنَان — wa-, and; imtinān, bestowal of favours, beneficence (verbal noun of VIII imtanna, gen.); 'and of benevolence'
الرُّكْبَانُ: الـ + رُّكْبَان — al-, the + rukbān, riders, travellers (pl. of رَاكِب, nom., subject of sārat); 'the travellers'
عِزٍّ: عِزّ — ʿizz, might, honour, glory (m. noun, gen. after fī, in); 'in glory'
خَالِيًا: خَالِيًا — khālin, empty, devoid (active part. of khalā, adj. I defective, acc. as predicate of kāna; takes min); 'was without'
وَالزَّوْجَاتِ: وَ + الْـ + زَّوْجَات — wa-, and; al-, the + zawjāt, wives (f. sound pl. of زَوْجَة, gen. after min); 'and wives'
يُقَارِبُهُ: يُقَارِبُهُ — yuqāribu + hu — qāraba, to come close to, approach (verb III, imperf. 3ms, indic.) + 3ms object; 'who approached him, rivalled him'
الصِّفَاتِ: الصِّفَات — al-, the + ṣifāt, qualities, attributes (f. pl. of صِفَة, gen. after fī); 'in qualities'
وَعِيلَ: وَ + عِيلَ — wa-, and; ʿīla, to be exhausted, overcome (verb I passive perf. 3ms of ʿāla, 'overburden'); 'and (my patience) has run out'
صَبْرِى: صَبْرِي — ṣabr + ī — ṣabr, patience (m. noun, nom., passive subject of ʿīla) + 1s possessive; the print spells the final ī with ى; 'my patience'
الْجَلَدُ: الْـ + جَلَد — al-, the + jalad, fortitude, endurance (m. noun, nom., subject of ḍaʿufa); 'the endurance'
وَلَدٍ: وَلَد — walad, child, son (m. noun, gen. after bi-lā, 'without'; sing. used collectively); 'a child'
سَبِيلُ: سَبِيل — sabīl, way, path, custom (m. noun, nom., predicate/subject in idāfa with al-mulūk); 'the way (of)'
وَصُعْلُوكٍ: وَ + صُعْلُوك — wa-, and; ṣuʿlūk, poor man, pauper (m. noun, gen. after kull); 'and (every) poor man'

وَتَتَضَاعَفُ: وَ + تَتَضَاعَفُ — wa-, and; tataḍāʿafu, to be multiplied (verb VI, imperf. 3fs, indic.); 'and is multiplied'
الْعَدَدُ: الْـ + عَدَد — al-, the + ʿadad, number, numbers (m. noun, nom., subject); 'the number'
وَالْأَعْدَادُ: وَ + الْـ + أَعْدَاد — wa-, and; al-, the + aʿdād, numbers, (broken pl. of عَدَد; nom.); 'and the numbers, the multitudes'
تَنَاكَحُوا: تَنَاكَحُوا — tanākaḥū, to marry one another (verb VI, imperative 2mpl.); 'marry'
تَنَاسَلُوا: تَنَاسَلُوا — tanāsalū, to breed, beget offspring (verb VI, imperative 2mpl.); 'procreate'
تَكْثُرُوا: تَكْثُرُوا — takthurū, to become many (verb I, jussive 2mpl. as result of the imperatives, n dropped); 'and you will multiply'
مُبَاهٍ: مُبَاهٍ — mubāhin, one who boasts, takes pride (active part. verb III bāhā, defective, indef. nom., predicate of inna; takes bi-); 'one who will boast'
بِكُمُ: بِـ + كُمُ — bi-, with (prep.; bāhā bi- 'boast of/by means of') + 2mpl. -kum (with connecting vowel, as before al-); 'of you'
الْأُمَمَ: الْـ + أُمَم — al-, the + umam, nations, communities (pl. of أُمَّة, acc. object of mubāhin); 'the (other) nations'
فَشِرْ: فَـ + شِرْ — fa-, so + shir, to advise (verb IV, imperative 2ms of ashāra, hollow; takes ʿalā for the person); 'so advise (me)'
النُّصْحُ: الـ + نُّصْحُ — al-, the + nuṣḥ, sincere counsel, good advice (m. noun, nom., subject of fīhi); 'the good advice'
التَّدْبِيرِ: الـ + تَّدْبِير — al-, the + tadbīr, planning, management, contrivance (verbal noun of II, gen. after min, explaining mā); 'of plans, of measures'
فَاضَتِ: فَاضَتِ — fāḍat, to overflow (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'overflowed'
بِالِانْسِجَامِ: بِـ + الْـ + انْسِجَام — bi-, in (prep., of manner) + al-, the + insijām, flowing, streaming (verbal noun of VII insajama, gen.); 'in streams, streaming'
خَصَائِصِ: خَصَائِص — khaṣāʾiṣ, special attributes, prerogatives (pl. of خَصِيصَة, gen. in idāfa with al-Raḥmān); 'the prerogatives (of)'
أَتُرِيدُأَنْ: أَ + تُرِيدُ + أَنْ — a-, interrogative particle + turīdu, to want (verb IV, imperf. 2ms) + an, that (subj. particle); the print runs the two words together; 'do you want me to'
بِسَخَطِ: بِـ + سَخَطِ — bi-, with, through (prep., means/cause) + sakhaṭ, wrath, displeasure (m. noun, gen. in idāfa); 'by incurring the wrath (of)'
فَاشْتَرِ: فَـ + اشْتَرِ — fa-, so + ishtari, to buy (verb VIII, imperative 2ms, defective); 'then buy'
حَسَبَهَا: حَسَب + هَا — ḥasab, lineage, worth by deeds and merit (m. noun, acc. object of yaʿlam) + 3fs possessive; 'her merit, standing'
نَسَبَهَا: نَسَب + هَا — nasab, descent, genealogy (m. noun, acc. object of yaʿrif) + 3fs possessive; 'her ancestry'
خَسَاسَةَ: خَسَاسَة — khasāsa, baseness, meanness (f. noun, acc. object of yadrī, in idāfa with aṣl); 'the lowliness (of)'
أَصْلِهَا: أَصْل + هَا — aṣl, origin, stock (m. noun, gen. in idāfa) + 3fs possessive; 'her origin'
يَجْتَنِبَهَا: يَجْتَنِبَ + هَا — yajtanibahā: ijtanaba, to avoid, shun (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after ḥattā) + 3fs object; 'he avoids her'

عُنْصُرِهَا: عُنْصُر + هَا — ʿunṣur, element, root, stock (m. noun, gen. in idāfa) + 3fs possessive; 'her stock, origin'

أَفْضَي: أَفْضَى — afḍā, to reach, come to (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms; takes ilā; here euphemistic for 'have intercourse'); print spells final ā with ي; 'he has relations with'
فَيَجِيءُ: فَـ + يَجِيءُ — fa-, so, and then + yajīʾu, to come (verb I hamzated, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'and so comes (into being)'
مُنَافِقًا: مُنَافِقًا — munāfiq, hypocrite, double-dealer (active part. III, acc. as ḥāl/predicate, indef.); 'hypocritical'
ظَالِمًا: ظَالِمًا — ẓālim, unjust, tyrannical (active part. I, acc., indef.); 'unjust'
سَافِكًا: سَافِكًا — sāfik, one who sheds (active part. I of safaka, acc., indef.); 'a shedder (of)'
لِلدِّمَاءِ: لِـ + الـ + دِّمَاء — li-, for, of (prep.; here marks the object of the active participle sāfik, 'shedder of') + al-, the + dimāʾ, blood (pl. of دَم, gen.); 'of blood'
مَثَلُهَا: مَثَل + هَا — mathal, likeness, parable, case (m. noun, nom., subject of yakūnu) + 3fs possessive; 'her case, her likeness'
مَثَلَ: مَثَلَ — mathala, like, the likeness of (m. noun, acc. as predicate of yakūnu, in idāfa); 'like'
السَّبِخَةِ: الْـ + سَّبِخَة — al-, the + sabikha, salty, saline (f. adj. of arḍ, gen.); 'the salt-marsh, saline'
زُرِعَ: زُرِعَ — zuriʿa, to sow, plant (verb I passive, perf. 3ms); 'is sown'
يَخْبُثُ: يَخْبُثُ — yakhbuthu, to be bad, worthless (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'turns bad'
نَبَاتُهُ: نَبَات + هُ — nabāt, plant, vegetation (m. noun, nom., subject) + 3ms possessive; 'its plants'
وَلَايَحْسُنُ: وَ + لَا + يَحْسُنُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yaḥsunu, to be good (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.); the print runs wa-lā and yaḥsunu together; 'and (it) does not do well'
ثَبَاتُهُ: ثَبَات + هُ — thabāt, steadiness, stability, constancy (m. noun, nom.) + 3ms possessive; 'its stability'
مُتَعَرِّضًا: مُتَعَرِّضًا — mutaʿarriḍ, exposing oneself to (active part. V, acc. as predicate of yakūnu; takes li-); 'exposed to'
لِسَخَطِ: لِـ + سَخَطِ — li-, to, for (prep.; taʿarraḍa li- 'be exposed to') + sakhaṭ, wrath, anger (m. noun, gen. in idāfa); 'to the wrath of'
يَجْتَنِبُ: يَجْتَنِبُ — yajtanibu, to avoid, shun (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'he avoids'
نَهَاهُ: نَهَا + هُ — nahā, to forbid (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; with ʿan 'forbid something') + 3ms object; 'he forbade him'
أَتَسَبَّبُ: أَتَسَبَّبُ — atasabbabu, to take a means, bring about a cause (verb V, imperf. 1s, indic.; fī hādhā 'in this matter'); 'I will go about it'
بِشِرَاءِ: بِـ + شِرَاء — bi-, with, by (prep., means) + shirāʾ, buying, purchase (verbal noun of VIII, gen. in idāfa); 'by buying'
تَخْطُبَ: تَخْطُبَ — takhṭuba, to ask in marriage, to woo (verb I, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an; takes lī 'for me'); 'that you seek in marriage'
نَسَبُهَا: نَسَب + هَا — nasab, descent, lineage (m. noun, nom., subject of yakūnu) + 3fs possessive; 'her lineage'
مَوْصُوفًا: مَوْصُوفًا — mawṣūf, described, praised (passive part. I of waṣafa, acc., predicate of yakūnu); 'renowned, described (as famed)'
دَلَلْتَنِي: دَلَلْتَ + نِي — dalla, to guide, direct (verb I, perf. 2ms; takes ʿalā for the thing pointed to) + 1s object; 'you direct me (to)'
النَّسَبِ: الـ + نَّسَب — al-, the + nasab, descent, lineage (m. noun, gen. in idāfa after dhāt, 'possessed of'); 'of lineage'
وَأَتَزَوَّجُ: وَ + أَتَزَوَّجُ — wa-, and + atazawwaju, to marry (verb V, imperf. 1s, indic.; takes bi-, tazawwaja bi- 'marry'); 'and I will marry'
الْأَشْهَادِ: الْـ + أَشْهَاد — al-, the + ashhād, witnesses (pl. of شَاهِد, gen. in idāfa after ruʾūs); 'the witnesses'
لِيَحْصُلَ: لِـ + يَحْصُلَ — li-, so that (purpose particle) + yaḥṣula, to be obtained, come about (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive); 'so that there may come to me'
رِضَاءُ: رِضَاء — riḍāʾ, satisfaction, approval (m. noun, nom., subject of yaḥṣula; a recognised by-form of riḍā (Lane gives both)); 'the approval (of)'
وَبَلَّغَكَ: وَ + بَلَّغَ + كَ — wa-, and + ballagha, to cause to reach, grant (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 2ms object; 'and he has brought you (to)'
أُمْنِيَّتَكَ: أُمْنِيَّة + كَ — umniyya, wish, desire (f. noun, acc., second object of ballagha) + 2ms possessive; 'your heart's desire'
زَهْرْشَاه: Zahrshāh (Persian name: zahr + shāh, king), king of the White Land; left uninflected here; 'Zahrshāh'
بَارِعَةُ: بَارِعَة — bāriʿa, outstanding, surpassing (f. active part. of baraʿa, I; nom., adj. of bint, in idāfa with al-jamāl); 'surpassing (in beauty)'
قَوِيمَةُ: قَوِيمَة — qawīma, well-proportioned, upright (f. adj. of qawīm, nom., predicate/ḥāl, in idāfa with al-iʿtidāl); 'perfectly balanced (in)'
الِاعْتِدَالِ: الْـ + اعْتِدَال — al-, the + iʿtidāl, evenness, symmetry, proportion (verbal noun of VIII iʿtadala, gen. in idāfa after qawīma); 'of proportion'
طَرْفٍ: طَرْف — ṭarf, eye, glance (m. noun, gen. in idāfa after dhāt; ṭarfin kaḥīlin 'kohl-darkened eye'); 'of an eye'
فَتَنَتْ: فَتَنَتْ — fatanat, to enchant, captivate (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she enchants'
أَدْبَرَتْ: أَدْبَرَتْ — adbarat, to turn away, go back (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'she turns away'
تُخْجِلُ: تُخْجِلُ — tukhjilu, to put to shame (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, indic.; subject hayfāʾ, 'slender woman'); 'puts to shame'
قَامَتُهَا: قَامَة + هَا — qāma, stature, height, figure (f. noun, nom. subject, in idāfa) + 3fs possessive; 'her figure'
يَحْكِ: يَحْكِ — yaḥki, to resemble, imitate (verb I defective, jussive 3ms after lam, final ī dropped); 'did not match'
طَلْعَتَهَا: طَلْعَة + هَا — ṭalʿa, countenance, appearance (f. noun, acc. object of yaḥki) + 3fs possessive; 'her face, her look'
كَانَّمَا: كَأَنَّمَا — ka-anna-mā: كَـ, like + أَنَّ, that (particle) + مَا, a particle neutralising the governing effect; 'as if'; the print writes it with bare alif for hamza
رِيقُهَا: رِيقُهَا — rīq, saliva (m., nom., subject) + هَا 3fs possessive; 'her saliva'
شَهْدٌ: شَهْدٌ — shahd, honey, honeycomb (m., nom., predicate); '(were) honey'
مُزِجَتْ: مُزِجَتْ — mazaja, to mix (verb I, passive perf. 3fs, after وَقَدْ); 'has been mixed'
الْمُدَامَةُ: الْمُدَامَةُ — al- + mudāma, wine (f., nom., the passive's subject); 'the wine'
دُرَرُ: دُرَرُ — durar, pearls (pl. of دُرَّة; nom. predicate); '(is) pearls'
مَمْشُوقَةُ: مَمْشُوقَةُ — mamshūqa, lithe, slender (f. passive participle of mashaqa, to stretch out; first term of iḍāfa); 'lithe of'
الْجِنَانِ: الْجِنَانِ — al- + jinān, gardens, i.e. Paradise (pl. of جَنَّة; gen. after مِنْ حُورِ); 'the gardens'
حَوَرُ: حَوَرُ — ḥawar, intense contrast of white and black in the eye, large dark eyes (m. nom.); 'ḥawar, lustrous eyes'
قَتِيلٍ: قَتِيلٍ — qatīl, slain, killed (adj./noun, m. sg., gen. after مِنْ in كَمْ ... مِنْ); 'a slain one'
كَمَدٍ: كَمَدٍ — kamad, grief, suppressed sorrow (m., gen. after مِنْ, 'from, of'); 'of grief'
وَالْخَطَرُ: وَالْخَطَرُ — wa- + al- + khaṭar, and the danger (m. nom., conjoined to al-khawf); 'and the danger'
شِئْتُ: شِئْتُ — shāʾa, to wish, will (verb I, perf. 1s, conditional after اِنْ); 'if I wish'; the print gives hamza on yāʾ as shiʾtu
الْمُنَى: الْمُنَى — al- + munā, desires, wishes (pl. of مُنْيَة; nom. predicate, defective noun); 'the desire'
اَذْكُرُهَا: اَذْكُرُهَا — dhakara, to mention, remember (verb I, imperf. 1s) + هَا 3fs object; 'I mention her'; the print uses bare alif for hamza (اَذْكُرُ)
دُونِهَا: دُونِهَا — dūn, short of, below, in place of (prep./noun, gen.) + هَا 3fs; 'short of her, without reaching her'
يُجْلِ: يُجْلِ — verb (imperf. jussive after لَمْ), obscure as printed; perhaps for يُجْدِ, 'avail' (jadā IV), 'it availed nothing'; or yujlī, 'clear'
الرَّأْى: الرَّأْى — al- + raʾy, opinion, view (m., nom.); 'the opinion'; the print writes final ى for ي (al-raʾy)
فَطِنًا: فَطِنًا — faṭin, clever, shrewd (adj. m. sg., acc., describing رَسُولًا); 'shrewd'
مُجَرَّبًا: مُجَرَّبًا — mujarrab, experienced, tried (passive participle of jarraba, verb II; acc.); 'seasoned'
لِتَصَارِيفِ: لِـ + تَصَارِيف — li-, by (prep.; mujarrab li-, 'tested by': li- marks what does the testing) + taṣārīf, turns, vicissitudes (pl. of تَصْرِيف; gen., in idāfa with al-duhūr); 'by the turns (of)'
الدُّهُورِ: الدُّهُورِ — al- + duhūr, ages, times, fortunes (pl. of دَهْر; gen. in iḍāfa); 'of the times'
لِيَتَلَطَّفَ: لِيَتَلَطَّفَ — لِـ + يَتَلَطَّفَ — li-, so that (purpose particle + subjunctive); talaṭṭafa, to be gentle, act tactfully (verb V, imperf. subj. 3ms); 'so that he may tactfully'
خِطْبَتِهَا: خِطْبَتِهَا — khiṭba, courtship, asking for her hand (f. verbal noun of khaṭaba, gen. after فِي) + هَا 3fs; 'in asking for her hand'
لَانَظِيرَ: لَانَظِيرَ — لَا + نَظِير — lā, no (negation of genus) + naẓīr, equal, match (m.; acc. without tanwīn); 'there is no match'; the print runs the two words together
قَاصِي: قَاصِي — qāṣī, far, remote (active part. of qaṣā, defective; gen. after fī, in idāfa with al-arḍ, so the final yāʾ stays); 'the far (parts)'
وَدَانِيهَا: وَدَانِيهَا — وَ + دَانِي + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); dānī, near (active participle of danā, defective, gen.) + 3fs possessive; 'and its nearest'
وَتَحْظَى: وَ + تَحْظَى — wa-, and; taḥẓā, to obtain, enjoy (verb I ḥaẓiya, defective, imperf. 2ms, indic.; takes مِنْ for the source and بِـ for what is won); 'and you will win'
بِالْوَجْهِ: بِالْوَجْهِ — بِـ + الـ + وَجْه — bi-, with (prep.; also governed by ḥaẓiya, 'obtain, enjoy'); wajh, face (m.); 'the face', i.e. 'you will enjoy the beautiful face'
الرَّبُّ: الرَّبُّ — al- + rabb, the Lord (m., nom., subject of yarḍā); 'the Lord'
لَارَهْبَانِيَّةَ: لَارَهْبَانِيَّةَ — لَا + رَهْبَانِيَّة — lā, no (negation of genus) + rahbāniyya, monasticism (f.; acc. without tanwīn); 'no monasticism'; the print runs the two words together
لَايَتَوَجَّهُ: لَايَتَوَجَّهُ — لَا + يَتَوَجَّهُ — lā, not (neg.) + tawajjaha, to head toward, go to (verb V, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'no one goes'; the print runs the two words together
لِكَمَالِ: لِكَمَالِ — لِـ + كَمَال — li-, because of (prep., reason); kamāl, perfection (m., gen.); 'because of the perfection of'
وَأَدَبِكَ: وَأَدَبِكَ — وَ + أَدَب + كَ — wa-, and; adab, good breeding, culture (m., gen.) + 2ms possessive; 'and your good breeding'
مَنْزِلِكَ: مَنْزِلِكَ — manzil, house, dwelling (m., gen. after إِلَى) + كَ 2ms possessive; 'your house'
أَشْغَالَكَ: أَشْغَالَكَ — ashghāl, affairs, business (pl. of شُغْل; acc. object of iqḍi) + كَ 2ms possessive; 'your affairs'
وَتَجَهَّزْ: وَتَجَهَّزْ — وَ + تَجَهَّزْ — wa-, and; tajahhaza, to get ready, equip oneself (verb V, imperative 2ms); 'and get ready'
وَاخْطُبْ: وَاخْطُبْ — وَ + اخْطُبْ — wa-, and; khaṭaba, to ask for in marriage, propose (verb I, imperative 2ms; lī, for me); 'and ask for (her hand)'
أَشْغَلْتَ: أَشْغَلْتَ — ashghala, to occupy, preoccupy (verb IV, perf. 2ms; with بِهَا, 'with her'); 'you have preoccupied'
خَاطِرِى: خَاطِرِى — khāṭir, mind, thought (m., acc. object) + ي 1s possessive; 'my mind'; the print writes final ى for ي
وَلَاتَعُدْ: وَلَاتَعُدْ — وَ + لَا + تَعُدْ — wa-, and; lā, not (prohibition) + ʿāda, to return (verb I hollow, jussive 2ms); 'and do not return'; the print runs the words together
إِلَّابِهَا: إِلَّابِهَا — إِلَّا + بِـ + هَا — illā, except; bi-, with (prep.) + 3fs pronoun; 'except with her'; the print runs the words together
وَاسْتَدْعَى: وَاسْتَدْعَى — وَ + اسْتَدْعَى — wa-, and; istadʿā, to summon, send for (verb X defective, perf. 3ms; takes بِـ for things, here بِالْهَدَايَا); 'and sent for' Also with a direct object of persons: istadʿā ghilmānahu, 'he summoned his servants'.
وَنَفِيسِ: وَنَفِيسِ — وَ + نَفِيس — wa-, and; nafīs, precious (adj. m., gen., used as noun in iḍāfa); 'and the precious'
خَفِيفٌ: خَفِيفٌ — khafīf, light (adj. m. sg., nom., predicate); 'light'
الْعَرَبِيَّةِ: الْعَرَبِيَّةِ — al- + ʿarabiyya, Arabian (f. adj., gen., describing الْخَيْل); 'Arabian (horses)'
وَالدُّرُوعِ: وَالدُّرُوعِ — وَ + الـ + دُرُوع — wa-, and; durūʿ, coats of mail (pl. of دِرْع; gen. after مِنَ); 'and coats of mail'
الدَّاؤُدِيَّةِ: الدَّاؤُدِيَّةِ — al- + Dāwūdiyya, Davidic (f. adj., gen.; mail attributed to David); 'Davidic'; print writes the hamza on wāw
وَصَنَادِيقِ: وَصَنَادِيقِ — وَ + صَنَادِيق — wa-, and; ṣanādīq, chests, boxes (pl. of صُنْدُوق; gen.); 'and chests'
حَمَلُوهَا: حَمَلُوهَا — ḥamala, to load, carry (verb I, perf. 3mp) + هَا 3fs object; 'they loaded them'; also: 'they carried her' (Night 192)
وَالْجِمَالِ: وَالْجِمَالِ — وَ + الـ + جِمَال — wa-, and; jimāl, camels (pl. of جَمَل; gen.); 'and camels'
وَانْتَشَرَتْ: وَانْتَشَرَتْ — وَ + انْتَشَرَتْ — wa-, and; intashara, to spread out, be unfurled (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'and were unfurled'
الرَّايَاتُ: الرَّايَاتُ — al- + rāyāt, banners (pl. of رَايَة; nom., subject); 'the banners'
قَلِيلَةٍ: قَلِيلَةٍ — qalīla, few, short (adj. f. sg., gen., describing مُدَّة); 'short'
تَوَجُّهِهِ: تَوَجُّهِهِ — tawajjuh, setting out, heading (verbal noun of V, gen. after بَعْدَ) + هِ 3ms possessive; 'his departure'
مَقَالِى: مَقَالِى — maqālī, frying pans (pl. of مِقْلَى/مَقْلَى), gen.; 'on hot coals, frying pans'; the print writes final ى for ي
يَطْوِي: يَطْوِي — ṭawā, to fold, traverse (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms); 'traversing'
بَرَارِيَ: بَرَارِيَ — barārī, deserts, open wastes (pl. of بَرِّيَّة; acc. object, defective, written with fatḥa); 'deserts'
وَقِفَارًا: وَقِفَارًا — وَ + قِفَار — wa-, and; qifār, wastelands (pl. of قَفْر; acc.); 'and wastelands'
مُتَوَجِّهٌ: مُتَوَجِّهٌ — mutawajjih, heading, bound (active participle of tawajjaha, V; nom. predicate of huwa); 'he is heading'
نَهْرٍ: نَهْرٍ — nahr, river (m., gen. in iḍāfa after shāṭiʾ); 'a river'
خَوَاصِّهِ: خَوَاصِّهِ — khawāṣṣ, intimates, special attendants (pl. of khāṣṣa; gen. after baʿḍa) + هِ 3ms possessive; 'his intimates'
يَتَوَجَّهَ: يَتَوَجَّهَ — tawajjaha, to go, head to (verb V, imperf. 3ms subj. after أَنْ; with إِلَى); 'to go'
قُدُومُهُ: قُدُومُهُ — qudūm, arrival (m. verbal noun of qadima, nom., subject of wāfaqa) + هُ 3ms possessive; 'his arrival'
شَاه: شَاه — shāh, king (Persian; second half of Zahrshāh; printed with ه for final h); '-shāh'
الْمُنْتَزَهَاتِ: الْمُنْتَزَهَاتِ — al- + muntazahāt, pleasure grounds, promenades (pl. of مُنْتَزَه; gen. after baʿḍ); 'the pleasure grounds'
الْخَضْرَاءِ: الْخَضْرَاءِ — al- + khaḍrāʾ, green (f. adj. of akhḍar; gen., describing الْأَرْض); 'the Green (Land)', Sulaymān Shāh's realm
وَجِبَالِ: وَجِبَالِ — وَ + جِبَال — wa-, and; jibāl, mountains (pl. of جَبَل; gen., conjoined); 'and the mountains of'
أَصْفَهَانَ: أَصْفَهَانَ — Iṣfahān, Isfahan (Persian city; gen., diptote, fatḥa); 'Isfahan'
بِالرَّسُولِ: بِالرَّسُولِ — بِـ + الـ + رَسُول — bi-, chosen by raḥḥaba, 'welcome (someone)'; rasūl, messenger, envoy (m.); 'welcomed the messenger'
الْفُلَانِيِّ: الْفُلَانِيِّ — al- + fulānī, such-and-such (relative adj. from fulān; gen., describing the noun before it); 'the such-and-such (place, river)'
وَاصِلًا: وَاصِلًا — wāṣil, arriving (active participle of waṣala, I; acc. predicate of yakūnu; with إِلَيْكَ); 'arriving'
أَدَامَ: أَدَامَ — adāma, to make last, perpetuate (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms, optative; subject Allāh); 'may (God) prolong'
وَرَحِمَ: وَرَحِمَ — وَ + رَحِمَ — wa-, and; raḥima, to have mercy on (verb I, perf. 3ms, optative); 'and may (He) have mercy on'
وَالِدَيْكَ: وَالِدَيْكَ — wālidayka: wālid, parent (dual obl., with the final nūn dropped in iḍāfa) + كَ 2ms; 'your parents'
وَحُجَّابِهِ: وَحُجَّابِهِ — وَ + حُجَّاب + هِ — wa-, and; ḥujjāb, chamberlains (pl. of حَاجِب; gen.) + 3ms possessive; 'and his chamberlains'
وَنُوَّابِهِ: وَنُوَّابِهِ — وَ + نُوَّاب + هِ — wa-, and; nuwwāb, deputies (pl. of نَائِب; gen.) + 3ms possessive; 'and his deputies'
وَيَخْرُجَ: وَيَخْرُجَ — وَ + يَخْرُجَ — wa-, and; kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 3ms subj. after أَنْ); 'and go out'
مُقَابَلَتِهِ: مُقَابَلَتِهِ — muqābala, meeting, receiving (f. verbal noun of qābala, III; gen. after إِلَى) + هِ 3ms; 'to meet him'
نَافِذٌ: نَافِذٌ — nāfidh, effective, in force (active participle of nafadha; nom. predicate); 'in force'
مُتَوَجِّهًا: مُتَوَجِّهًا — mutawajjih, heading (active participle of tawajjaha, V; acc. ḥāl); 'heading'
وَأَشْرَقَتِ: وَأَشْرَقَتِ — وَ + أَشْرَقَتِ — wa-, and; ashraqa, to shine, rise (verb IV, perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'and rose'
الرَّوَابِي: الرَّوَابِي — al- + rawābī, hills (pl. of رَابِيَة; gen., defective); 'the hills'
وَوَزِيرُ: وَوَزِيرُ — وَ + وَزِير — wa-, and, here 'and behold'; wazīr, vizier (m., nom., iḍāfa); 'when, lo, the vizier of'
وَحُجَّابُهُ: وَحُجَّابُهُ — وَ + حُجَّاب + هُ — wa-, and; ḥujjāb, chamberlains (pl., nom.) + 3ms possessive; 'and his chamberlains'
قَدِمُوا: قَدِمُوا — qadima, to arrive (verb I, perf. 3mp; with عَلَى, 'upon'); 'had arrived'
قَابَلُوهُ: قَابَلُوهُ — qābala, to meet (verb III, perf. 3mp) + هُ 3ms object; 'they met him'
يَدْخُلُهُ: يَدْخُلُهُ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + هُ 3ms object; 'enters it'; 'lā yadkhuluhu' negates
أَنْيَابِ: أَنْيَابِ — anyāb, tusks, fangs (pl. of نَاب; gen., iḍāfa after مِنْ); 'tusks of'
مَرْتَبَةٌ: مَرْتَبَةٌ — martaba, mattress, cushion (f., nom., indef.); 'a mattress'
الْأَخْضَرِ: الْأَخْضَرِ — al- + akhḍar, green (adj. m., gen., describing الْأَطْلَس); 'green'
مُطَرَّزَةٌ: مُطَرَّزَةٌ — muṭarraza, embroidered (f. passive participle of ṭarraza, II; nom.; with بِالذَّهَبِ); 'embroidered'
سُرَادِقٌ: سُرَادِقٌ — surādiq, canopy, pavilion (m., nom.); 'a canopy'
ثَبَّتَ: ثَبَّتَ — thabbata, to make firm (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he steadied'
وَأَطْلَقَ: وَأَطْلَقَ — وَ + أَطْلَقَ — wa-, and; aṭlaqa, to release, loosen (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and loosed'
فَصَاحَةَ: فَصَاحَةَ — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., acc. object of abdā); 'the eloquence of'
الْبُلَغَاءِ: الْبُلَغَاءِ — al- + bulaghāʾ, eloquent speakers (pl. of بَلِيغ; gen.); 'the orators'
زَهْرْ: Zahr, first half of the name Zahrshāh (the print splits it across a line; left uninflected, as the whole name is elsewhere); 'Zahr-'
بِلُطْفِ: بِـ + لُطْف — bi-, with (prep., manner) + luṭf, grace, gentleness (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with a grace of'
الْتِفَاتٍ: iltifāt — turning (of the face or body) toward someone (verbal noun of VIII iltafata, gen. indef.); 'turning'
وَاَقْبَلَ: وَ + اَقْبَلَ — wa-, and + aqbala, to come forward, draw near (verb IV, perf. 3ms; printed with its hamza as a fatḥa on alif); 'and drew near'
الْغَلَائِلِ: الـ + غَلَائِل — ghalāʾil, fine robes worn next to the body (pl. of ghilāla, gen.); 'the fine robes'
يَنْثَنِي: inthanā, to bend, sway (verb VII, imperf. 3ms); 'swaying'
يُولِي: awlā, to grant, bestow (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'he grants'
لِلْمُجْتَنَى: لِـ + الـ + مُجْتَنَى — li-, to (prep., the one who receives) + mujtanā, one plucked, gathered (pass. part. of VIII ijtanā); 'to the one plucked'
وَالْمُجْتَنِي: وَ + الـ + مُجْتَنِي — wa-, and + mujtanī, one who plucks, gathers (act. part. of VIII ijtanā); 'and the one who plucks'
وَرَقَى: وَ + رَقَى — wa-, and + raqā, to cast a spell, charm (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he cast a spell'
تُغْنِى: aghnā, to avail, be of use (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, printed with ى); 'they avail'
التَّمَائِمُ: الـ + تَمَائِم — tamāʾim, amulets (pl. of tamīma, nom.); 'the amulets'
وَالرُّقَا: وَ + الـ + رُقَا — wa-, and + ruqā, charms, incantations (pl. of ruqya, written with alif for ى); 'and the charms'
وَالسِّحْرُ: وَ + الـ + سِحْر — wa-, and + siḥr, magic, enchantment (m., nom.); 'and the magic'
لَحَظَاتِ: laḥaẓāt — glances (pl. of laḥẓa, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the glances of'
الْاَعْيُنِ: الـ + اَعْيُن — aʿyun, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, gen.; printed with its hamza as a fatḥa on alif); 'the eyes'
لِلْعَوَاذِلِ: لِـ + الـ + عَوَاذِل — li-, to (prep., the ones addressed after qul) + ʿawādhil, women who blame, censurers (pl. of ʿādhila); 'to the women who blame'
لَاتَلُومُوا: لَا + تَلُومُوا — lā, do not (prohibition) + lāma, to blame (verb I, hollow, jussive 2mp); printed as one word; 'do not blame'
الْمُدَى: الـ + مُدَى — madā, span, extent of time (m.; the print points it mudā); 'the span'
انْثَنِي: inthanā, to turn back, bend away (verb VII, imperf. 1cs, with its hamza unwritten); 'I turn back'
وَوَفَى: وَ + وَفَى — wa-, and + wafā, to keep faith, be loyal (verb I, perf. 3ms; with li-, 'to'); 'and kept faith'
الرُّقَادُ: الـ + رُقَاد — ruqād, sleep (m., nom.); 'the sleep'
وَمَلَّنِي: وَ + مَلَّ + نِي — wa-, and + malla, to grow weary of (verb I, doubled, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and wearied of me'
يَاقَلْبُ: يَا + قَلْب — yā, O (vocative) + qalb, heart (m., vocative, indeclinable -u); printed as one word; 'O heart'
رَافَةً: rāfa — raʾfa, pity, tenderness, with the hamza unwritten (f., acc. indef.); 'pity'
فَامْكُثْ: فَـ + امْكُثْ — fa-, so, then + makutha, to stay, remain (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'so stay'
لَدَيْهِ: لَدَى + هِ — ladā, with, in the presence of (prep.) + -hi, him; 'with him'
اَوْحَشْتَنِي: اَوْحَشَ + تَ + نِي — awḥasha, to make desolate, leave lonely (verb IV, perf. 2ms; printed with its hamza as a fatḥa on alif) + -nī, me; 'you have left me desolate'
شَىْءَ: shayʾ, thing (m., acc. after lā of absolute negation; printed with ى); 'no thing'
مَسْمَعِي: مَسْمَع + ي — masmaʿ, ear, hearing (m.) + -ī, my; 'my hearing'
بِسَمَاعِهِ: بِـ + سَمَاع + هِ — bi-, by, through (prep., the means) + samāʿ, hearing (verbal noun) + -hi, its; 'by hearing it'
لِزَهْرِشَاهِ: لِـ + زَهْرِشَاه — li-, of, for (prep.; al-thanāʾ li-, 'praise of') + Zahrshāh, the king (gen.; pointed zahri-shāh here for the metre); 'of Zahrshāh'
اَنْفَقْتَ: anfaqa, to spend (verb IV, perf. 2ms; printed with its hamza as a fatḥa on alif); 'you spent'
عُمْرَكَ: عُمْر + كَ — ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your life'
نَظْرَةٍ: naẓra — a look, glance (f., gen. indef.); 'a look'
الْغَنِي: الـ + غَنِي — ghanī, rich (adj., written for al-ghaniyy in the rhyme); 'the rich one'
انْتَخَبْتَ: intakhaba, to choose, select (verb VIII, perf. 2ms); 'you chose'
تَلْقَ: laqiya, to meet, find (verb I, jussive 2ms after lam); 'you (would) meet'
مُشَارِكٍ: mushārik — one who shares, joins in (act. part. III, gen. indef.); 'a sharer'
وَمُؤَمِّنِ: وَ + مُؤَمِّن — wa-, and + muʾammin, one who says amen (act. part. II of ammana, gen.); 'and one who says amen'
يَااَهْلَ: يَا + اَهْل — yā, O (vocative) + ahl, people of, or those worthy of (acc. as vocative, first term of an iḍāfa); printed as one word; 'O people of / O you worthy of'
سِوَاهُ: سِوَى + هُ — siwā, other than + -hu, him; 'other than him'
اَرَاهُ: اَرَى + هُ — arā, I see, consider (verb I raʾā, imperf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I see him'
بِمُؤْمِنِ: بِـ + مُؤْمِن — bi-, (adds emphasis to the predicate after a negative, 'as') + muʾmin, believer (gen.); '(as) a believer'
قَرَّبَهُ: قَرَّبَ + هُ — qarraba, to bring near (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he brought him near'
وَتَبَسَّمَ: وَ + تَبَسَّمَ — wa-, and + tabassama, to smile (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and smiled'
وَشَرَّفَهُ: وَ + شَرَّفَ + هُ — wa-, and + sharrafa, to honour (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and honoured him'
بِلَطِيفِ: بِـ + لَطِيف — bi-, with (prep., the means) + laṭīf, gentle, gracious (adj. used as noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'with gracious'
رَفَعُوا: rafaʿa, to lift, clear away (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they lifted'
الْخَوَاصُّ: الـ + خَوَاصّ — khawāṣṣ, intimates, inner circle (pl. of khāṣṣa, nom.); 'the intimates'
خُلُوَّ: khuluww — emptiness, being empty (verbal noun of khalā, acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the emptiness of'
سَعَيْتُ: saʿā, to hasten, go (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ilā, 'to'); 'I hastened'
وَقَدِمْتُ: وَ + قَدِمْتُ — wa-, and + qadima, to come, arrive (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ʿalā, 'come before someone'); 'and I came'
الصَّلَاحُ: الـ + صَلَاح — ṣalāḥ, welfare, soundness (m., nom.); 'the welfare'
وَالْخَيْرُ: وَ + الـ + خَيْر — wa-, and + khayr, good (m., nom.); 'and the good'
وَالْفَلَاحُ: وَ + الـ + فَلَاح — wa-, and + falāḥ, prosperity, success (m., nom.); 'and the prosperity'
خَاطِبًا: khāṭib — one who asks for a woman in marriage (act. part. of khaṭaba, acc. as ḥāl); 'asking in marriage'
الْحَسِيبَةِ: الـ + حَسِيبَة — ḥasība, noble-born, of honoured descent (adj., f., gen.); 'the noble-born'
النَّسِيبَةِ: الـ + نَسِيبَة — nasība, of good lineage (adj., f., gen.); 'the well-descended'
وَالْفَضْلِ: وَ + الـ + فَضْل — wa-, and + faḍl, bounty, excellence (m., gen.); 'and the bounty'
وَالْإِحْسَانِ: وَ + الـ + إِحْسَان — wa-, and + iḥsān, beneficence, kindness (verbal noun IV, gen.); 'and the beneficence'
الْكَثِيرَةَ: الـ + كَثِيرَة — kathīra, many, much (adj., f., acc.); 'many'
الْغَزِيرَةَ: الـ + غَزِيرَة — ghazīra, abundant, plentiful (adj., f., acc.); 'abundant'
مُصَاهَرَتِكَ: مُصَاهَرَة + كَ — muṣāhara, alliance by marriage (verbal noun III, gen.) + -ka, you; 'marriage alliance with you'
رَاغِبٌ: rāghib — desiring (act. part. of raghiba, nom. indef.; with fī, 'desire something'); 'desiring'
الْجَوَابَ: الـ + جَوَاب — jawāb, answer (m., acc.); 'the answer'
الْأَقْدَامِ: الـ + أَقْدَام — aqdām, feet (pl. of qadam, gen.); 'the feet'
وَلَثَمَ: وَ + لَثَمَ — wa-, and + lathama, to kiss (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and kissed'
