بِاسْتِنَامٍ: بِـ + اسْتِنَام — bi-, with (prep., manner) + istinām, as printed: reliance, ease (verbal noun X of nāma); obscure here, perhaps for istilām, reverent kissing; 'with reverence (?)'
خُضُوعِ: khuḍūʿ — submission, humbling oneself (verbal noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the submission of'
لِلرَّسُولِ: لِـ + الـ + رَسُول — li-, to, before (prep.; khuḍūʿ li-, 'submission to') + rasūl, envoy, messenger (m.); 'to the envoy'
وَانْدَهَشَتْ: وَ + انْدَهَشَتْ — wa-, and + indahasha, to be astonished, bewildered (verb VII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with al-ʿuqūl); 'and were astounded'
الْعُقُولُ: الـ + عُقُول — ʿuqūl, minds (pl. of ʿaql, nom.); 'the minds'
أَثْنَي: athnā — to praise (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'praise someone'; printed with dotted ي); 'he praised'
ذِى: dhū — possessor of, lord of (gen., printed ذى; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the Possessor of'
وَالْإِكْرَامِ: وَ + الـ + إِكْرَام — wa-, and + ikrām, honour, honouring (verbal noun IV, gen.); 'and honour'
الْمُعَظَّمُ: الـ + مُعَظَّم — muʿaẓẓam, magnified, mighty (pass. part. II, nom.); 'the mighty'
الْمُكَرَّمُ: الـ + مُكَرَّم — mukarram, honoured (pass. part. II, nom.); 'the honoured'
رَعَايَاهُ: رَعَايَا + هُ — raʿāyā, subjects (pl. of raʿiyya, gen.) + -hu, his; 'his subjects'; also acc., predicate of aṣbaḥū: aṣbaḥū raʿāyāhu, 'they became his subjects'
وَنَتَشَرَّفُ: وَ + نَتَشَرَّفُ — wa-, and + tasharrafa, to be honoured (verb V, imperf. 1cp; with bi-, 'by'); 'and we are honoured'
بِنَسَبِهِ: بِـ + نَسَب + هِ — bi-, by (prep., chosen by tasharrafa) + nasab, kinship, lineage (m.) + -hi, his; 'by kinship with him'
وَنُنَافِسُ: وَ + نُنَافِسُ — wa-, and + nāfasa, to vie, compete (verb III, imperf. 1cp; with fī, 'vie for'); 'and we vie'
وَابْنَتِي: وَ + ابْنَة + ي — wa-, and + ibna, daughter (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my daughter'
جَوَارِيهِ: جَوَارِي + هِ — jawārī, slave girls (pl. of jāriya, gen.) + -hi, his; 'his slave girls'
أَجَلُّ: ajall — most exalted, greatest (elative of jalīl, nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the greatest of'
ذُخْرِي: ذُخْر + ي — dhukhr, treasure, something laid up (m.) + -ī, my; 'my treasure'
وَاعْتِمَادِي: وَ + اعْتِمَاد + ي — wa-, and + iʿtimād, support, reliance (verbal noun VIII) + -ī, my; 'and my support'
عَقْدَ: ʿaqd — contract, here the marriage contract (m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the contract of'
بِابْتِهَاجٍ: بِـ + ابْتِهَاج — bi-, with (prep., manner) + ibtihāj, joy, delight (verbal noun VIII); 'with joy'
أَحْكَمُوا: aḥkama, to make firm, conclude securely (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'they made firm'
النِّكَاحِ: الـ + نِكَاح — nikāḥ, marriage (m., gen.); 'the marriage'
بِالْفَوْزِ: بِـ + الـ + فَوْز — bi-, for (prep.; daʿā li-… bi-…, 'pray for someone for something') + fawz, triumph, good fortune; 'for good fortune'
وَالنَّجَاحِ: وَ + الـ + نَجَاح — wa-, and + najāḥ, success (m., gen.); 'and success'
وَنَفَائِسِ: وَ + نَفَائِس — wa-, and + nafāʾis, precious things (pl. of nafīsa, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the precious of'
وَالْعَطَايَا: وَ + الـ + عَطَايَا — wa-, and + ʿaṭāyā, gifts, presents (pl. of ʿaṭiyya); 'and the presents'
وَإِكْرَامِ: وَ + إِكْرَام — wa-, and + ikrām, honouring (verbal noun IV, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the honouring of'
بِوَلَائِمِهِ: بِـ + وَلَائِم + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; ʿamma bi-, 'include in, cover with') + walāʾim, banquets, feasts (pl. of walīma) + -hi, his; 'with his banquets'
وَالْحَقِيرَ: وَ + الـ + حَقِير — wa-, and + ḥaqīr, lowly, humble (adj. as noun, acc.); 'and the lowly'
إِقَامَةِ: iqāma — holding, keeping up (verbal noun IV of aqāma, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the holding of'
يَسُرُّ: sarra, to gladden (verb I, doubled, imperf. 3ms); 'gladdens'
وَالْعَيْنَ: وَ + الـ + عَيْن — wa-, and + ʿayn, eye (f., acc.); 'and the eye'
فَضُرِبَتْ: فَـ + ضُرِبَتْ — fa-, and so + ḍaraba, to strike; of tents, to pitch (verb I, passive perf. 3fs); 'and they were pitched'
الرُّومِيَّاتِ: الـ + رُومِيَّات — rūmiyyāt, Greek, Byzantine (f. pl. adj. of rūmī, acc.); 'the Greek'
وَالْوَصَائِفَ: وَ + الـ + وَصَائِف — wa-, and + waṣāʾif, maidservants (pl. of waṣīfa, acc.); 'and the maidservants'
التُّرْكِيَّاتِ: الـ + تُرْكِيَّات — turkiyyāt, Turkish (f. pl. adj., acc.); 'the Turkish'
وَأَصْحَبَ: وَ + أَصْحَبَ — wa-, and + aṣḥaba, to send along with (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with bi-, what is sent); 'and he sent with'
بِنَفِيسِ: بِـ + نَفِيس — bi-, (marks what is sent along, after aṣḥaba) + nafīs, precious (adj. as noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the most precious of'
وَثَمِينِ: وَ + ثَمِين — wa-, and + thamīn, costly, valuable (adj. as noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the costliest of'
مِحَفَّةً: miḥaffa — litter, covered palanquin (f., acc. indef.); 'a litter'
مُرَصَّعَةً: muraṣṣaʿa — studded, inlaid (pass. part. II, f., acc. indef.; with bi-, 'with'); 'studded'
بِغَالًا: bighāl — mules (pl. of baghl, acc. indef.; plural after a tens numeral, a Middle Arabic habit); 'mules'
لِلْمَسِيرِ: لِـ + الـ + مَسِير — li-, for (prep., purpose) + masīr, journey, travel (m.); 'for the journey'
الْمِحَفَّةُ: الـ + مِحَفَّة — miḥaffa, litter, palanquin (f., nom.); 'the litter'
مَقْصُورَةٌ: maqṣūra — closed chamber, private apartment (f., nom. indef.); 'a chamber'
وَصَاحِبَتُهَا: وَ + صَاحِبَة + هَا — wa-, and + ṣāḥiba, mistress, owner (f., nom.) + -hā, its; 'and its mistress'
الْحُورِ: الـ + حُور — ḥūr, houris, maidens of Paradise (pl., gen.); 'the houris'
وَخِدْرُهَا: وَ + خِدْر + هَا — wa-, and + khidr, curtain, curtained seat of a woman (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her curtained seat'
كَقَصْرٍ: كَـ + قَصْر — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + qaṣr, palace (m., gen. indef.); 'like a palace'
رَزَمُوا: razama, to bundle, pack in bales (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they bundled'
الذَّخَائِرَ: الـ + ذَخَائِر — dhakhāʾir, treasures (pl. of dhakhīra, acc.); 'the treasures'
وَحَمَلُوهَا: وَ + حَمَلُوا + هَا — wa-, and + ḥamala, to load, carry (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, them; 'and they loaded them'
الْأَوْطَانِ: الـ + أَوْطَان — awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan, gen.); 'the homelands'
بْنَةِ: ibna, daughter (f., gen.); the print splits بابنة after the bi- (بِا, 'with, in company with'), so the word begins with sukūn on the bāʾ, the hamzat al-waṣl being elided; 'daughter'
يَطْوِى: ṭawā, to fold up; of a road, to cover quickly (verb I, imperf. 3ms, printed with ى); 'folding up'
الْمَرَاحِلَ: الـ + مَرَاحِل — marāḥil, stages of a journey (pl. of marḥala, acc.); 'the stages'
وَالْقِفَارَ: وَ + الـ + قِفَار — wa-, and + qifār, deserts, wastes (pl. of qafr, acc.); 'and the wastes'
أَتَيْتُكَ: أَتَيْتُ + كَ — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 1cs; corrected from the print's اتينك) + -ka, you; 'I have come to you'; here: with bi-, atā bi-, 'to bring': ataytuka bihi, 'I will bring it to you' (perfect in the answer of idhā)
فَأَسْرَعَ: فَـ + أَسْرَعَ — asraʿa, to hasten (verb IV, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so (sequence); 'and so hastened'
عَسَاكِرَهُ: عَسَاكِر + ـهُ — ʿaskar, army, troops (m., pl. ʿasākir, acc. object of amara) + -hu, his; 'his troops'
بِالتَّكْرِيمِ: بِـ + الـ + تَكْرِيم — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + takrīm, honouring (m. verbal noun of verb II karrama, gen.); 'with honour'
الْبَهَجَاتِ: الـ + بَهَجَات — bahja, splendour, finery (f., pl. bahajāt, gen. in the superlative annexation aḥsan al-bahajāt); 'the finest of splendours'
رُؤُسِهِمُ: رُؤُس + ـهِمُ — raʾs, head (m., pl. ruʾūs, gen. after ʿalā) + -him, their (the final -u is the print's helping vowel before al-); 'over their heads'
مُخَدَّرَةٌ: مُخَدَّرَة — mukhaddara, curtained, secluded (f., pass. part. of verb II khaddara, adj. of bint, nom.); 'kept behind the curtain'
مُوَقَّرَةٌ: مُوَقَّرَة — muwaqqara, honoured, respected (f., pass. part. of verb II waqqara, adj. of ḥurra, nom.); 'of standing'
مُكَسَّرَةٌ: مُكَسَّرَة — mukassara, broken, bent with age (f., pass. part. of verb II kassara, adj. of ʿajūz, nom.); 'bent with age'
لِقَائِهَا: لِقَاء + ـهَا — liqāʾ, meeting (m., verbal noun of laqiya; the lām is a root letter, not a prefix; gen. after ilā) + -hā, her; 'to meet her'
وَسَعَتْ: وَ + سَعَتْ — saʿā, to strive, exert oneself (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural kubarāʾ); wa-, and; 'and strove'
كُبَرَاؤُهُمْ: كُبَرَاء + ـهُمْ — kabīr, great man, notable (m., pl. kubarāʾ, nom., subject) + -hum, their; 'their great men'
خِدْمَتِهَا: خِدْمَة + ـهَا — khidma, service (f., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'in her service'
يُزَيِّنُوا: يُزَيِّنُوا — zayyana, to adorn, decorate (verb II, imperf. 3mp subjunctive after an, the final nūn dropped); 'that they adorn'
يَقِفُوا: يَقِفُوا — waqafa, to stand (verb I, assimilated, imperf. 3mp subjunctive after an; the wāw drops in the imperfect); 'that they stand'
تَمُرَّ: تَمُرَّ — marra, to pass (verb I, geminate, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā); marra bi-, 'pass by' (the verb chooses the preposition, here bihim); 'until she passed by'
وَالْخُدَّامُ: وَ + الـ + خُدَّام — khādim, servant (m., pl. khuddām, nom.); wa-, and (circumstantial, a verbless clause); 'and the servants'
الْخِلْعَةُ: الـ + خِلْعَة — khilʿa, robe of honour (f., nom., subject of ʿalayhā); 'the robe'
وَذَاتَ: وَ + ذَاتَ — dhāt, side, direction (f., acc. adverbial, in the fixed annexation dhāta al-shimāl, 'to the left'); wa-, and; 'and to the left'
تَزَلِ: تَزَلِ — zāla, to cease (verb I, jussive 3fs after lam; kasra to avoid a cluster before al-); lam tazal + active participle, 'did not cease (going)'
لَاعِبَةً: لَاعِبَة — lāʿiba, playing (f., act. part. of laʿiba, acc., second predicate of ṣārat); 'played'
وَالْبُوقَاتُ: وَ + الـ + بُوقَات — būq, trumpet, horn (m., sound f. pl. būqāt, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the trumpets'
صَائِحَةً: صَائِحَة — ṣāʾiḥa, crying out, blaring (f., act. part. of ṣāḥa, acc. predicate); 'blared'
وَرَوَائِحُ: وَ + رَوَائِح — rāʾiḥa, scent, smell (f., pl. rawāʾiḥ, nom. subject); wa-, and; 'and the scents'
الطِّيبِ: الـ + طِّيب — ṭīb, perfume, fragrance (m., gen. in annexation); 'of perfume'
فَائِحَةً: فَائِحَة — fāʾiḥa, wafting, diffusing fragrance (f., act. part. of fāḥa, acc. predicate); 'drifted'
خَافِقَةً: خَافِقَة — khāfiqa, fluttering (f., act. part. of khafaqa, acc. predicate); 'fluttered'
وَالْخَيْلُ: وَ + الـ + خَيْل — khayl, horses (coll. f., nom.); wa-, and; 'and the horses'
مُتَسَابِقَةً: مُتَسَابِقَة — mutasābiqa, racing one another (f., act. part. of verb VI tasābaqa, acc. predicate); 'raced one another'
بِالْمِحَفَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + مِحَفَّة — bi-, with (prep.; taqaddama bi-, 'go forward with', i.e. carry forward) + miḥaffa, litter, palanquin (f., gen.); 'with the litter'
بِبَهْجَتِهَا: بِـ + بَهْجَة + ـهَا — bi-, with, by (prep., of cause) + bahja, splendour, beauty (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'by her beauty'
وَأَشْرَقَتْ: وَ + أَشْرَقَتْ — ashraqa, to shine, gleam (verb IV, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural jihāt); wa-, and; 'and gleamed'
جِهَاتُهُ: جِهَات + ـهُ — jiha, side, quarter (f., pl. jihāt, nom.) + -hu, its (the place's); 'its sides'
بِحُلِيِّ: بِـ + حُلِيّ — bi-, with, by (prep., of cause) + ḥuliyy, jewels, ornaments (pl. of ḥaly, gen., in annexation); 'with the jewels of'
زِينَتِهَا: زِينَة + ـهَا — zīna, adornment, finery (f., gen. in annexation) + -hā, her; 'her adornment'
مُحْتَاطُونَ: مُحْتَاطُونَ — muḥtāṭūna, surrounding (m. pl., act. part. of verb VIII iḥtāṭa, nom. predicate of hum); iḥtāṭa bi-, 'surround' (the verb chooses the preposition, here bi-al-bāb); 'surrounding'
الدُّرَّةِ: الـ + دُّرَّة — durra, pearl, large pearl (f., gen.; the ka- of ka-al-qamar carries over through aw); 'like the pearl'
الْفَرِيدَةِ: الـ + فَرِيدَة — farīda, unique, matchless (f., adj. of durra, gen.); 'matchless'
الْمَنْظُومِ: الـ + مَنْظُوم — manẓūm, strung (m., pass. part. of naẓama, adj. of luʾluʾ, gen.); 'strung'
وَأَوْقَعَ: وَ + أَوْقَعَ — awqaʿa, to cast, make fall (verb IV, perf. 3ms, subject Allāh); wa-, and; 'and cast'
مَحَبَّتَهَا: مَحَبَّة + ـهَا — maḥabba, love (f., acc. object) + -hā, her (objective: love for her); 'love of her'
الْقَلَقِ: الـ + قَلَق — qalaq, restlessness, anxiety (m., gen. after min, explaining mā); 'of the restlessness'
وَالْقَهْرِ: وَ + الـ + قَهْر — qahr, vexation, distress, subjugation (m., gen.); wa-, and; 'and the vexation'
وَعَدَلَ: وَ + عَدَلَ — ʿadala, to act justly, do justice (verb I, perf. 3ms), with fī, 'among, over'; wa-, and; 'and ruled justly'
وَفَتْ: وَفَتْ — wafā, to be fulfilled, complete (verb I, defective, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural ashhuruhā); 'were fulfilled'
التَّاسِعِ: الـ + تَّاسِع — tāsiʿ, ninth (ordinal, m., adj. of shahr, gen.); 'the ninth'
جَاءَهَا: جَاءَ + هَا — jāʾa, to come (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (object: 'came to her'); 'came upon her'
الْمَخَاضُ: الـ + مَخَاض — makhāḍ, labour pains, travail (m., nom., subject); 'the labour'
وَهَوَّنَ: وَ + هَوَّنَ — hawwana, to make easy (verb II, perf. 3ms, subject Allāh, with ʿalā); wa-, and; 'and made easy'
فَوَضَعَتْ: فَـ + وَضَعَتْ — waḍaʿa, to put down, give birth (verb I, perf. 3fs); fa-, and so/then (sequence); 'and she bore'
غُلَامًا: غُلَامًا — ghulām, boy (m., acc. object); 'a boy'
عَلَامَاتُ: عَلَامَات — ʿalāma, sign, mark (f., pl. ʿalāmāt, nom.), in annexation with al-saʿāda; 'the signs of'
بِالْوَلَدِ: بِـ + الـ + وَلَد — bi-, of (prep.; samiʿa bi-, 'hear of', the verb choosing the preposition) + walad, child (m., gen.); 'of the child'
جَلِيلًا: جَلِيلًا — jalīl, great, mighty (m., acc., adj. of faraḥan); 'great'
الْمُبَشِّرَ: الـ + مُبَشِّر — mubashshir, bringer of good news (m., act. part. of verb II bashshara, acc. object); 'the bearer of the good news'
فَرْحَتِهِ: فَرْحَة + ـهِ — farḥa, joy (f., gen., after min 'from, out of') + -hi, his; 'in his joy'
الْغُلَامِ: الـ + غُلَام — ghulām, boy (m., gen. after ilā); 'the boy'; also: youth, young man (gen., after hādhā in a construct): ḥikāyatu hādhā al-ghulāmi, 'the story of this youth' (Night 179)
الْبَاهِرِ: الـ + بَاهِر — bāhir, dazzling, brilliant (m., act. part. of bahara, adj. of jamāl, gen.); 'dazzling'
قَوْلُ: قَوْل — qawl, saying, word (m., nom., subject of taḥaqqaqa, in annexation with al-shāʿir); 'the words of'
خَوَّلَ: خَوَّلَ — khawwala, to grant, bestow, make over (verb II, perf. 3ms, subject Allāh); with min-hu, 'of him'; 'has made of him'
آجَامَ: آجَام — ajam, thicket, lair (f., pl. ajām, here pointed as the print gives it; sense gen. in annexation with al-ʿulā); 'the thickets of'
اَسَدًا: أَسَدًا — asad, lion (m., acc. object); 'a lion'
وَآفَاقُ: وَ + آفَاق — ufuq, horizon (m., pl. āfāq; the print has nom., the sense is 'and (for) the horizons of'); wa-, and; 'and the horizons of'
الرَّآسَةَ: الـ + رَّآسَة — raʾāsa, headship, command (f., by-form of riʾāsa; the print has acc., the sense is gen. in annexation); 'of command'
كَوْكَبًا: كَوْكَبًا — kawkab, star (m., acc. object, second to asadan); 'a star'
هَشَّتْ: هَشَّتْ — hashsha, to be glad, rejoice (verb I, geminate, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural al-asinna; takes li- 'at', here limaṭlaʿihi); 'rejoiced'
لِمَطْلَعِهِ: لِـ + مَطْلَع + ـهِ — li-, at (prep.; hashsha li-, 'rejoice at', the verb choosing the preposition) + maṭlaʿ, rising (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'at his rising'
الْاَسِنَّةُ: الـ + أَسِنَّة — sinān, spearhead (m., pl. asinna, nom., subject of hashshat); 'the spearheads'
وَالْاَسِرَّةُ: وَ + الـ + أَسِرَّة — sarīr, throne, couch (m., pl. asirra, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the thrones'
وَالْمَحَافِلُ: وَ + الـ + مَحَافِل — maḥfil, assembly, gathering (m., pl. maḥāfil, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the assemblies'
وَالْجَحَافِلُ: وَ + الـ + جَحَافِل — jaḥfal, great army, host (m., pl. jaḥāfil, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the armies'
وَالظُّبَى: وَ + الـ + ظُّبَى — ẓubā, edges (of swords), points (pl. of ẓubat, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the sword-edges'
لَاتَرْكَبُوهُ: لَا + تَرْكَبُوهُ — lā, not (prohibitive) + tarkabū, rakiba, to ride (verb I, jussive 2mp, final nūn dropped) + -hu, him; the sense is 'do not set him to ride', i.e. carry him; 'do not carry him'
النُّهُودِ: الـ + نُّهُود — nahd, breast (m., pl. nuhūd, gen. after ʿalā); 'on the breasts'
لَيَرَى: لَـ + يَرَى — la-, indeed (emphatic lām after inna) + yarā, to see, deem, hold (verb I, defective, imperf. 3ms indicative, two objects); 'he surely holds'
ظُهُورَ: ظُهُور — ẓahr, back (m., pl. ẓuhūr, acc., first object of yarā, in annexation with al-khayl); 'the backs of'
اَوْطَاءَ: أَوْطَاء — awṭaʾ, smoother, softer, more comfortable (elative of wāṭiʾ; the print lengthens the vowel; acc., second object); 'the softest'
مَرْكَبَا: مَرْكَب — markab, mount, seat for riding (m., acc., specification); 'as a mount'
وَلْتَفْطِمُوهُ: وَ + لْـ + تَفْطِمُوهُ — wa-, and + li-, lām of command (let, must; not the preposition) + taftimū, faṭama, to wean (verb I, jussive 2mp) + -hu, him; 'and wean him'
الرَّضَاعِ: الـ + رَّضَاع — raḍāʿ, suckling, nursing (m., gen. after ʿan; also riḍāʿ); 'from suckling'
الْاَعْدَاءِ: الـ + أَعْدَاء — ʿadūw, enemy (m., pl. aʿdāʾ, gen. in annexation with dam); 'of enemies'
اَحْلَى: أَحْلَى — aḥlā, sweeter, sweetest (elative of ḥulw, acc., second object of yarā); 'the sweetest'
أَخَذْنَ: أَخَذْنَ — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3fp, -na the verb ending, subject al-dāyāt); 'took'
وَقَطَعْنَ: وَ + قَطَعْنَ — qaṭaʿa, to cut (verb I, perf. 3fp); wa-, and; 'and cut'
وَكَحَّلْنَ: وَ + كَحَّلْنَ — kaḥḥala, to put kohl on (verb II, perf. 3fp); wa-, and; 'and lined with kohl'
سَمَّوْهُ: سَمَّى + وْا + ـهُ — sammā, to name (verb II, defective, perf. 3mp, indefinite subject, 'they') + -hu, him (first object); 'they named him'
خَارَانَ: خَارَان — Khārān, proper name (m., second object of sammā, diptote); 'Khārān'
وَارْتَضَعَ: وَ + ارْتَضَعَ — irtaḍaʿa, to suck, nurse at (verb VIII, perf. 3ms, taking a direct object); wa-, and; 'and nursed at'
ثَدْيَ: ثَدْي — thady, breast (m., acc. object, in annexation with al-dalāl); 'the breast of'
وَتَرَبَّى: وَ + تَرَبَّى — tarabbā, to be reared, grow up (verb V, defective, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and was brought up'
الْإِقْبَالِ: الـ + إِقْبَال — iqbāl, good fortune, favour (m., verbal noun of verb IV aqbala, gen. in annexation with ḥijr); 'of good fortune'
تَجْرِى: تَجْرِى — jarā, to run, flow (verb I, defective, imperf. 3fs indicative, predicate of lā zālat; the print writes final yāʾ as ى); 'ran on'
وَالْأَعْوَامُ: وَ + الـ + أَعْوَام — ʿām, year (m., pl. aʿwām, nom.); wa-, and; 'and the years'
يُعَلِّمُوا: يُعَلِّمُوا — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, imperf. 3mp subjunctive after an, taking two objects); 'that they teach'
فَمَكَثُوا: فَـ + مَكَثُوا — makatha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3mp); fa-, and so/then (sequence); 'and so they stayed'
تَعَلَّمَ: تَعَلَّمَ — taʿallama, to learn (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he learned'
أَحْضَرَهُ: أَحْضَرَ + هُ — aḥḍara, to bring, fetch (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (object); 'brought him'
وَالْمُعَلِّمِينَ: وَ + الـ + مُعَلِّمِين — muʿallim, teacher (m., act. part. of verb II ʿallama, pl. muʿallimūn, gen. after min ʿinda); wa-, and; 'and the teachers'
أُسْتَاذًا: أُسْتَاذًا — ustādh, master, tutor (m., Persian loanword, acc. object); 'a master'
يُعَلِّمُهُ: يُعَلِّم + هُ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, imperf. 3ms indicative, relative clause) + -hu, him; 'to teach him'
الْفُرُوسِيَّةَ: الـ + فُرُوسِيَّة — furūsiyya, horsemanship, knightly skill (f., acc., second object of yuʿallimuhu); 'horsemanship'
أَشْغَالِهِ: أَشْغَال + ـهِ — shughl, business, affair (m., pl. ashghāl, gen. in annexation with baʿḍ) + -hi, his; 'his affairs'
يَفْتَتِنُ: يَفْتَتِنُ — iftatana, to be enchanted, infatuated (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms indicative); iftatana bi-, 'be enchanted by' (the verb chooses the preposition, here bihi); 'was captivated'
وَيُجِدُّ: وَ + يُجِدُّ — ajadda, to press on, hasten (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indic., yujiddu); wa-, and (conj.); 'and pressing on' (ajadda al-sayr, 'press the going')
مَهَرَ: مَهَرَ — mahara, to be skilled, expert (verb I, perf. 3ms); mahara fī, 'be skilled in' (the verb chooses fī); 'became skilled'
الْفُرُوسِيَّةِ: الْفُرُوسِيَّةِ — الـ + فُرُوسِيَّة — furūsiyya, horsemanship, knightly skill (f., gen. after fī); 'the horsemanship'
نَظَمُوا: نَظَمُوا — naẓama, to string together, compose (verse) (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they composed'
وَتَهَتَّكَتْ: وَتَهَتَّكَتْ — و + تَهَتَّكَتْ — tahattaka, to cast off restraint, be shamelessly exposed (verb V, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural al-aḥrār); 'and threw off restraint'; also agreeing with the collective al-warā, 'mankind': tahattakat fī ḥusnihi al-warā, 'mankind threw off all restraint over his beauty'
الْأَحْرَارُ: الْأَحْرَارُ — الـ + اَحْرَار — aḥrār, free-born, the free (pl. of ḥurr; nom., subject); 'the free-born'
عَانَقْتُهُ: عَانَقْتُهُ — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 1s) + هُ 3ms object suffix; 'I embraced him'
الشَّذَى: الشَّذَى — الـ + شَذَى — al-shadhā, fragrance, strong scent (m., gen., governed by ṭībi); 'the fragrance'
رَطِيبًا: رَطِيبًا — raṭīb, moist, fresh, supple (adj., acc. sg., qualifying ghuṣnan); 'supple'
بِالنَّسِيمِ: بِالنَّسِيمِ — بِـ + الـ + نَسِيم — bi-, on, with (prep.; ightadhā bi-, ‘feed on’: the verb chooses bi-, which marks the food) + al-nasīm, the breeze (m., gen.); 'by the breeze'
اغْتَذَى: اغْتَذَى — ightadhā, to be nourished, to feed (verb VIII defective, perf. 3ms, after qad); 'has been nourished'
مَاشَرِبَ: مَاشَرِبَ — مَا + شَرِبَ — mā, not (negative particle) + shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 3ms); the edition runs the two words together; 'he did not drink'
وَانَّمَا: وَانَّمَا — و + اِنَّمَا — wa-, and + innamā, but rather, only (particle; the edition prints alif without hamza); 'but rather'
اَمْسَى: اَمْسَى — amsā, to come to be in the evening, to become (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms; the edition prints alif without hamza); 'he has come to be' ; also: 1s subjunctive after an: an amsā asīra asīratin, 'that I become the captive of a captive woman'
بِخَمْرِ: بِخَمْرِ — بِـ + خَمْر — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + khamr, wine (m./f., gen. in construct); 'by the wine of'
رُضَابِهِ: رُضَابِهِ — رُضَاب + هِ — ruḍāb, saliva, the sweet moisture of the mouth (m., gen. in construct) + 3ms suffix; 'his saliva'
مُتَنَبِّذَا: مُتَنَبِّذَا — mutanabbidh, steeped like nabīdh (date-wine), turned to wine (active participle of tanabbadha, verb V; acc., predicate of amsā); rare word; 'steeped like date-wine'
اَضْحَى: اَضْحَى — aḍḥā, to come to be, become (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms; the edition prints alif without hamza); 'has come to be'
اَسْرِهِ: اَسْرِهِ — asr, captivity, bondage (m., gen. after fī) + هِ 3ms suffix; the line puns on asr, 'entirety' (bi-asrihi, 'in its entirety') and asr, 'captivity'; here 'his captivity'
فَلِاَجْلِ: فَلِاَجْلِ — فَـ + لِـ + اَجْل — fa-, so, and so + li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake (m., gen.); li-ajli, 'for the sake of'; 'and for the sake of'
اسْتَحْوَذَا: اسْتَحْوَذَا — istaḥwadha, to gain mastery over, take possession of (verb X, perf. 3ms; final alif is the verse-rhyme alif); istaḥwadha ʿalā, 'gain mastery over' (the verb chooses ʿalā); 'he has gained mastery'
مَادُمْتُ: مَادُمْتُ — مَا + دُمْتُ — mā, as long as (temporal mā) + dāma, to continue, last (verb I hollow, perf. 1s); 'as long as I remain'
قَيْدِ: قَيْدِ — qayd, fetter, bond (m., gen. in construct after fī); 'the fetter of'
الْحَيوةِ: الْحَيوةِ — الـ + حَيَاة — al-ḥayāt, life (f., gen.; the edition prints the old spelling with wāw, حيوة, read ḥayāt); 'the life'
اَمُتْ: اَمُتْ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s jussive, after in, 'if'); 'I die'
وَصَبَابَةً: وَصَبَابَةً — و + صَبَابَة — wa-, and + ṣabāba, ardent longing, passion (f., acc. as an adverbial of cause); ‘and (of) longing’
عَشَرَعَامًا: عَشَرَعَامًا — عَشَرَ + عَامًا — ʿashara, ten (in thamāniyata ʿashara, 'eighteen') + ʿām, year (m., acc. sg. as specifier); the edition runs the two words together; '(eighteen) years'
عِذَارُهُ: عِذَارُهُ — عِذَار + هُ — ʿidhār, the first down on a youth's cheek, cheek-hair (m., nom., subject) + 3ms suffix; 'his cheek-down'
الْأَخْضَرُ: الْأَخْضَرُ — الـ + اَخْضَر — akhḍar, green (adj., m. nom.; poets' 'green' for dark down), qualifying ʿidhāruhu; 'the green'
شَامَةِ: شَامَةِ — shāma, mole, beauty-spot, mark (f., gen. in construct after ʿalā); 'the mark of'
وَزَانَهُمَا: وَزَانَهُمَا — و + زَانَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + zāna, to adorn, grace (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual object suffix; 'and adorned the two of them'
وَالنَّوَاظِرَ: وَالنَّوَاظِرَ — و + الـ + نَوَاظِر — wa-, and + al-nawāẓir, the eyes (pl. of nāẓira, f., acc., coordinated with al-ʿuqūla as object of yasbī); 'and the eyes'
لِيُوسُفَ: لِيُوسُفَ — لِـ + يُوسُف — li-, to, for (prep., introducing the one to whom 'successor' is related) + Yūsuf, Joseph, the pattern of male beauty (proper name, diptote, gen. -a); 'to Joseph'
تَخْشَاهُ: تَخْشَاهُ — khashiya, to fear (verb I defective, imperf. 3fs indicative: the verb agrees in sense with kullu al-ʿāshiqīna, ‘all the lovers’, as with a broken plural (poetic licence)) + هُ 3ms object suffix; 'fears him'
الْعَاشِقِينَ: الْعَاشِقِينَ — الـ + عَاشِقِين — ʿāshiqīn, lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq, active participle of ʿashiqa; gen. pl. after kull); 'the lovers'
عَرِّجْ: عَرِّجْ — ʿarraja, to turn aside, stop on the way (verb II, imper. 2ms); 'turn aside'
اَسْوَداً: اَسْوَداً — aswad, black (adj., acc. sg., ḥāl or second object, qualifying the banner; the edition spells with tanwīn on the alif); 'black'
اَحْسَنُ: اَحْسَنُ — aḥsan, more beautiful (elative of ḥasan; the edition points it with ḍamma, though the grammar wants acc.); 'more beautiful'
مَنْظَرًا: مَنْظَرًا — manẓar, sight, appearance (m., acc. sg. as specifier); 'of sight'; also acc. indef. object of a verb (raʾaytu manẓaran bahiyyan, 'I saw a lovely sight')
الْاَشْيَاءِ: الْاَشْيَاءِ — الـ + اَشْيَاء — ashyāʾ, things (pl. of shayʾ, diptote; gen. after min sāʾiri); 'the things'
كَالشَّامَةِ: كَالشَّامَةِ — كَـ + الـ + شَامَة — ka-, like (prep.; after aḥsanu manẓaran it serves as English ‘than’) + al- + shāma, mole, beauty-spot (f., gen.); 'like the mole'
الْوَجْنَةِ: الْوَجْنَةِ — الـ + وَجْنَة — wajna, cheek, cheekbone (f., gen. after fawqa); 'the cheek'
الْحَمْرَاءِ: الْحَمْرَاءِ — الـ + حَمْرَاء — ḥamrāʾ, red (adj., f. sg. of aḥmar; gen., qualifying al-wajna); 'the red'
الْمُقْلَةِ: الْمُقْلَةِ — الـ + مُقْلَة — muqla, eyeball, the eye (f., gen. after taḥta); 'the eyeball'
السَّوْدَاءِ: السَّوْدَاءِ — الـ + سَوْدَاء — sawdāʾ, black (adj., f. sg. of aswad; gen., qualifying al-muqla); 'the black'
بِخَالٍ: بِخَالٍ — بِـ + خَال — ʿajiba bi-, 'marvel at' (bi- here where ʿajiba usually takes min) + khāl, mole, beauty-spot (m., gen., indef.); 'at a mole'
بِخَدِّكَ: بِخَدِّكَ — بِـ + خَدّ + ـكَ — bi-, on, in (prep., location: the mole on your cheek) + khadd, cheek (m., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'on your cheek'
يُحْرَقْ: يُحْرَقْ — ḥaraqa, to burn (verb I, imperf. 3ms passive, jussive after lam); 'was not burned'
كَافِرُ: كَافِرُ — kāfir, unbeliever, infidel (active participle of kafara; m. nom. sg., predicate in the clause wa-huwa kāfirun, tanwīn dropped at the rhyme); 'an unbeliever'
مُرْسَلًا: مُرْسَلًا — mursal, one sent, a messenger, prophet (passive participle of arsala, verb IV; m. acc. sg., noun of anna); 'a sent-one'
بِالْايَاتِ: بِالْايَاتِ — بِـ + الـ + اٰيَات — ṣaddaqa bi-, 'believe in, affirm' (the verb chooses bi-) + al-āyāt, the signs, miracles (f. pl., gen.; the edition prints alif without madda); 'the signs'
لَسَاحِرُ: لَسَاحِرُ — لَـ + سَاحِر — la-, indeed (emphatic particle on the predicate) + sāḥir, sorcerer (active participle of saḥara; m. nom.); 'indeed a sorcerer'
اخْضَرَّ: اخْضَرَّ — ikhḍarra, to turn green (verb IX, perf. 3ms); 'turned green'
الْخَدُّ: الْخَدُّ — الـ + خَدّ — khadd, cheek (m., nom., subject); 'the cheek'
نَبْتًا: نَبْتًا — nabt, growth, plant-growth (verbal noun of nabata; m. acc., specifier); 'as growth'
لِكَثْرَةِ: لِكَثْرَةِ — لِـ + كَثْرَة — li-, because of, on account of (prep.) + kathra, abundance, multitude (f., gen. in construct); 'because of the abundance of'
شُقَّتْ: شُقَّتْ — shaqqa, to split, cleave (verb I, perf. 3fs passive, agreeing with the plural marāʾir); 'have been split'
لَاَعْجَبُ: لَاَعْجَبُ — لَـ + اَعْجَبُ — la-, indeed (emphatic, after inna) + ʿajiba, to marvel (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative); ʿajiba min, 'marvel at' (the verb chooses min); 'I do marvel'
سُؤَالِ: سُؤَالِ — suʾāl, asking, question (verbal noun of saʾala; m., gen. in construct after min); 'the asking of'
مُنْهَمِرِ: مُنْهَمِرِ — munhamir, pouring forth, streaming (active participle of inhamara, verb VII; gen. sg., qualifying arḍin; tanwīn dropped at the rhyme); 'pouring forth'
بِثَغْرِ: بِثَغْرِ — بِـ + ثَغْر — bi-, in (prep., location) + thaghr, mouth, front teeth, lips (m., gen. in construct); 'in the mouth of'
ظَبْيٍ: ظَبْيٍ — ẓaby, gazelle (m., gen. indef., governed by thaghri; the beloved is likened to one); 'a gazelle'
اَغْيَدٍ: اَغْيَدٍ — aghyad, supple-necked, languid, delicate (adj., gen. indef., qualifying ẓabyin); 'supple-necked'
شَارِبُهُ: شَارِبُهُ — شَارِب + هُ — shārib, moustache (m., nom., subject) + 3ms suffix; 'his moustache'
الْخَضِرْ: الْخَضِرْ — الـ + خَضِر — al-khaḍir, the green one (adj. from akhḍar, cf. al-Khiḍr; nom. m., qualifying shāribuhu, with pausal sukūn for the rhyme); 'the green'
يَلْتَقِي: يَلْتَقِي — iltaqā, to meet (verb VIII defective, imperf. 3ms indicative); iltaqā maʿa, 'meet with' (maʿa follows); 'meets'
سَوُءِ: سَوُءِ — obscure word, printed damaged; possibly a corruption (perhaps sūʾ, 'evil', or a name); sense uncertain; here read tentatively in 'meets with him there … did not have patience'
يَصْطَبِرْ: يَصْطَبِرْ — iṣṭabara, to be patient, endure (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam); 'did not have patience'
لِتَاجِ: لِتَاجِ — لِـ + تَاج — li-, for (prep.; ṣāra li-X, 'there came to be for X') + tāj, crown (m., gen. in construct, first part of the name Tāj al-Mulūk, 'Crown of Kings'); 'for Tāj (al-Mulūk)'; after qāla, li- marks the one addressed: qāla li-tāji al-mulūki, 'said to Tāj al-Mulūk'
أَصْحَابٌ: أَصْحَابٌ — aṣḥāb, companions (pl. of ṣāḥib; m., nom., subject of ṣāra); 'companions'
وَأَحْبَابٌ: وَأَحْبَابٌ — و + اَحْبَاب — wa-, and + aḥbāb, loved ones, friends (pl. of ḥabīb; nom.); 'and loved ones'
يَرْجُوأَنَّهُ: يَرْجُوأَنَّهُ — يَرْجُو + اَنَّ + هُ — rajā, to hope (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms indicative) + anna, that + 3ms pronoun as its subject; the edition runs the words together; 'hoping that he'
أَمِيرًا: أَمِيرًا — amīr, emir, commander, prince (m., acc. sg., predicate of yakūnu); 'an emir'
يَفْتُرْ: يَفْتُرْ — fatara, to slacken, relax, abate (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam); fatara ʿan, 'slacken from' (the verb chooses ʿan); 'did not slacken'
يَنْهَاهُ: يَنْهَاهُ — nahā, to forbid, prohibit (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms indicative) + هُ 3ms object suffix; nahā ʿan, 'forbid from' (the verb chooses ʿan); 'forbade him'
مَخَافَةً: مَخَافَةً — makhāfa, fear, dread (verbal noun of khāfa; f. acc., of purpose/cause); 'out of fear'
لِخُدَّامِهِ: لِخُدَّامِهِ — لِـ + خُدَّام + هِ — li-, to (prep.; qāla li-, 'say to') + khuddām, servants (pl. of khādim; gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'to his servants'
عَلِيقَ: عَلِيقَ — ʿalīq, fodder, provender for animals (m., acc. in construct, object of khudhū); 'fodder of'
بِأَتْبَاعِهِ: بِأَتْبَاعِهِ — بِـ + اَتْبَاع + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; kharaja bi-, 'go out with, take along') + atbāʿ, followers, retinue (pl. of tābiʿ; gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'with his followers'
وُحُوشًا: وُحُوشًا — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh; m., acc., object of raʾaw); 'wild beasts'
رَاتِعَةً: رَاتِعَةً — rātiʿa, grazing, roaming at pleasure (active participle of rataʿa; f. sg. acc., agreeing with the plural of a non-human); 'grazing'
وَأَشْجَارًا: وَأَشْجَارًا — و + اَشْجَار — wa-, and + ashjār, trees (pl. of shajar; m., acc.); 'and trees'
يَانِعَةً: يَانِعَةً — yāniʿa, ripe, fresh, flourishing (active participle of yaniʿa; f. sg. acc.); 'ripe'
وَعُيُونًا: وَعُيُونًا — و + عُيُون — wa-, and + ʿuyūn, springs (pl. of ʿayn, 'eye, spring'; f., acc.); 'and springs'
نَابِعَةً: نَابِعَةً — nābiʿa, welling up, gushing (active participle of nabaʿa; f. sg. acc.); 'welling'
تَاجُ: تَاجُ — tāj, crown (m., nom., first part of the name Tāj al-Mulūk Khārān, 'Crown of Kings'; nom., subject); 'Tāj (al-Mulūk)'
لِأَتْبَاعِهِ: لِأَتْبَاعِهِ — لِـ + اَتْبَاع + هِ — li-, to (prep.; qāla li-, 'say to') + atbāʿ, followers (pl. of tābiʿ; gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'to his followers'
أَنْصِبُو: أَنْصِبُو — anṣaba, to set up (verb IV, imper. 2mp, anṣibū; Classical has inṣibū, form I; the edition omits the alif after -ū); 'set up'
الْحَبَائِلَ: الْحَبَائِلَ — الـ + حَبَائِل — ḥabāʾil, nets, snares (pl. of ḥibāla, diptote; f., acc., object); 'the nets'
وَأَوْسِعُوا: وَأَوْسِعُوا — و + اَوْسِعُوا — wa-, and + awsaʿa, to widen, make wide (verb IV, imper. 2mp); 'and widen'
دَائِرَةَ: دَائِرَةَ — dāʾira, circle, ring (f., acc. in construct, object); 'the circle of'
حَلْقَتِهَا: حَلْقَتِهَا — حَلْقَة + هَا — ḥalqa, ring, circle (f., gen. in construct) + 3fs suffix referring to the nets; 'their ring'
اجْتِمَاعُنَا: اجْتِمَاعُنَا — اِجْتِمَاع + نَا — ijtimāʿ, gathering, meeting (verbal noun of ijtamaʿa, verb VIII; m., nom., subject of yakūnu) + 1pl suffix; 'our gathering'
الْحَلْقَةِ: الْحَلْقَةِ — الـ + حَلْقَة — ḥalqa, ring, circle (f., gen. after raʾs); 'the ring'
وَأَنْصَبُوا: وَأَنْصَبُوا — و + اَنْصَبُوا — wa-, and + anṣaba, to set up (verb IV, perf. 3mp; Classical has naṣaba, form I); 'and they set up'
وَأَوْسَعُوا: وَأَوْسَعُوا — و + اَوْسَعُوا — wa-, and + awsaʿa, to widen (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they widened'
وَالْغِزْلَانِ: وَالْغِزْلَانِ — و + الـ + غِزْلَان — wa-, and + ghizlān, gazelles (pl. of ghazāl; m., gen., after min aṣnāfi); 'and the gazelles'
الْوُحُوشُ: الْوُحُوشُ — الـ + وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh; m., nom., subject of ḍajjat); 'the wild beasts'
وَتَنَافَرَتْ: وَتَنَافَرَتْ — و + تَنَافَرَتْ — wa-, and + tanāfara, to scatter, shy away from one another (verb VI, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural); 'and scattered'
فَأَغْرَى: فَأَغْرَى — فَـ + اَغْرَى — fa-, then + aghrā, to set on, incite (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms); aghrā ʿalā, 'set (hounds) on' (the verb chooses ʿalā); 'then he set on'
وَالْفُهُودَ: وَالْفُهُودَ — و + الـ + فُهُود — wa-, and + fuhūd, cheetahs, hunting leopards (pl. of fahd; m., acc.); 'and the cheetahs'
وَالصُّقُورَ: وَالصُّقُورَ — و + الـ + صُقُور — wa-, and + ṣuqūr, falcons (pl. of ṣaqr; m., acc.); 'and the falcons'
بِالنُّشَّابِ: بِالنُّشَّابِ — بِـ + الـ + نُشَّاب — bi-, with (prep., instrument: struck with) + nushshāb, arrows (collective, m., gen.); 'with the arrows'
فَأَصَابُوا: فَأَصَابُوا — فَـ + اَصَابُوا — fa-, and so + aṣāba, to hit, strike (the mark) (verb IV hollow, perf. 3mp); 'and hit'
مَقَاتِلَ: مَقَاتِلَ — maqātil, vital spots, killing-places (pl. of maqtal; diptote, acc. in construct, object); 'the vital spots of'
الْبَاقِي: الْبَاقِي — الـ + بَاقِي — bāqī, the remaining (active participle of baqiya; m. nom. sg., subject of haraba); 'the remainder'
وَقَسَّمَهُ: وَقَسَّمَهُ — و + قَسَّمَ + هُ — wa-, and + qassama, to divide, apportion (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix; 'and divided it'
خَاصَّ: خَاصَّ — khāṣṣ, the choice, pick, special part (active participle of khaṣṣa used as noun; m., acc. in construct, object of afrada); 'the choice of'; also: second object of albasū: albasū ḥīṭānahu khāṣṣa al-dībāji, 'hung its walls with the choicest brocade' (Night 192)
قَافِلَةٌ: قَافِلَةٌ — qāfila, caravan (f., nom., subject of aqbalat); 'a caravan'
مُشْتَمِلَةٌ: مُشْتَمِلَةٌ — mushtamila, comprising, containing (active participle of ishtamala, verb VIII; f. nom., adjective of qāfila); ishtamala ʿalā, 'comprise' (the verb chooses ʿalā); 'comprising'
وَتُجَّارٍ: وَتُجَّارٍ — و + تُجَّار — wa-, and + tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir; m., gen. after ʿalā); 'and merchants'
الْقَافِلَةُ: الْقَافِلَةُ — الـ + قَافِلَة — qāfila, caravan (f., nom., in apposition with tilka); 'the caravan'
وَالْخُضْرَةِ: وَالْخُضْرَةِ — و + الـ + خُضْرَة — wa-, and + khuḍra, greenery, verdure (f., gen., after ʿalā); 'and the greenery'; here: coordinate with al-narjis after ilā, of some part or tint of the beloved's body (sense uncertain)
أْتِنِي: أْتِنِي — اِيتِ + نِي — atā, to come (verb I, imper. 2ms) + 1s suffix; atā bi-, 'bring' (the verb chooses bi-; bi-khabari follows); 'bring me'
وَاسْأَلْهُمْ: وَاسْأَلْهُمْ — و + اِسْأَلْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, imper. 2ms) + 3mp object suffix; 'and ask them'
أَخْبِرُونَا: أَخْبِرُونَا — اَخْبِرُوا + نَا — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imper. 2mp) + 1pl object suffix; 'tell us'
بَعِيدٌ: بَعِيدٌ — baʿīd, far, distant (adj., m. nom., predicate of al-manzil); 'far'; also predicate of waṣluhu: qarībun waṣluhu minnī baʿīdun, 'his union with me is far' (Night 194, verse)
نَزَلْنَا: نَزَلْنَا — nazala, to alight, halt (verb I, perf. 1pl); 'we have alighted'
وَنَعْلَمُ: وَنَعْلَمُ — و + نَعْلَمُ — wa-, and + ʿalima, to know (verb I, imperf. 1pl indicative); 'and we know'
أَمَانٍ: أَمَانٍ — amān, safety, security (m., gen. indef., after fī); 'safety'
وَاطْمِئْنَانٍ: وَاطْمِئْنَانٍ — و + اِطْمِئْنَان — wa-, and + iṭmiʾnān, security, peace of mind (verbal noun of iṭmaʾanna, verb IV quadriliteral; m., gen.); 'and security'
قُمَاشٌ: قُمَاشٌ — qumāsh, cloth, fabric, goods (m., nom., subject of the clause maʿanā qumāshun); 'cloth'
نَفِيسٌ: نَفِيسٌ — nafīs, precious, costly (adj., m. nom., qualifying qumāsh); 'precious'
جِئْنَا: جِئْنَا — jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 1pl); jāʾa bi-, 'bring' (the verb chooses bi-; here bihi follows); 'we have come (with), brought'
تَاجِ: تَاجِ — tāj, crown (m., gen. in apposition; first part of Tāj al-Mulūk, 'Crown of Kings'; after waladihi); 'Tāj (al-Mulūk)'
جَاؤُابِهِ: جَاؤُابِهِ — جَاؤُوا + بِـ + هِ — jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp) + bi-, with (the verb chooses bi-: jāʾa bi-, 'bring') + 3ms suffix; the edition runs the words together; 'they have brought it'
أَرْحَلُ: أَرْحَلُ — raḥala, to depart, set out (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative, after lā); 'I depart'
أَسْتَعْرِضَهُ: أَسْتَعْرِضَهُ — اَسْتَعْرِضَ + هُ — istaʿraḍa, to have (goods) laid out for inspection, review (verb X, imperf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā) + 3ms object suffix; ‘(until) I have it laid out’
وَالْإِقْبَالِ: وَالْإِقْبَالِ — و + الـ + اِقْبَال — wa-, and + iqbāl, good fortune, prosperity (verbal noun of aqbala, verb IV; m., gen., coordinated with al-naṣri after daʿaw lahu bi-, ‘prayed for him for’: the verb chooses bi-, which names the thing asked for); 'and good fortune'
وَدَوَامِ: وَدَوَامِ — و + دَوَام — wa-, and + dawām, lasting, continuance (verbal noun of dāma; m., gen., coordinated with al-naṣri after daʿaw lahu bi-, ‘prayed for him for’: the verb chooses bi-, which names the thing asked for; in construct with al-ʿizzi); 'and the lasting of'
وَالْإِفْضَالِ: وَالْإِفْضَالِ — و + الـ + اِفْضَال — wa-, and + ifḍāl, bounty, beneficence (verbal noun of afḍala, verb IV; m., gen., coordinated with al-ʿizzi under dawāmi); 'and the bounty'
مَقْعَدًا: مَقْعَدًا — maqʿad, seat, place to sit (m., acc., object of farashū); 'a seat'
وَصَدْرُهُ: وَصَدْرُهُ — و + صَدْر + هُ — wa-, and, circumstantial + ṣadr, chest, upper end, place of honour (m., nom., subject) + 3ms suffix; 'and its upper end'
بِالزُّمُرُّدِ: بِالزُّمُرُّدِ — بِـ + الـ + زُمُرُّد — bi-, with (prep.; muzarkash bi-, 'embroidered with') + zumurrud, emerald (m., gen.); 'with the emerald'
يُحْضِرُوا: يُحْضِرُوا — aḥḍara, to bring, make present (verb IV, imperf. 3mp subjunctive after an); aḥḍara bi-, 'bring' (takes bi- as jāʾa bi- does); 'that they bring'
بِبَضَائِعِهِمْ: بِبَضَائِعِهِمْ — بِـ + بَضَائِع + هِمْ — bi-, with (prep.; aqbala ʿalayhi bi-, 'come to him with') + baḍāʾiʿ, wares, goods (pl. of biḍāʿa; diptote, gen.) + 3mp suffix; 'with their wares'
فَاسْتَعْرَضَ: فَاسْتَعْرَضَ — فَـ + اسْتَعْرَضَ — fa-, and so + istaʿraḍa, to have (goods) laid out for inspection, review (verb X, perf. 3ms); ‘and he had (it) laid out’
بِضَاعَتِهِمْ: بِضَاعَتِهِمْ — بِضَاعَة + هِمْ — biḍāʿa, merchandise, stock (f., acc. in construct, object) + 3mp suffix; 'their merchandise'
وَوَفَّى: وَوَفَّى — و + وَفَّى — wa-, and + waffā, to pay in full, discharge (verb II defective, perf. 3ms); waffā bi-, ‘pay in full’ (the verb chooses bi-, which marks what is paid: bi-al-thamani, ‘the price’), with li- for the payee; ‘paid them in full’
يَسِيرَ: يَسِيرَ — sāra, to go, travel (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an); 'to go'
فَرَأَي: فَرَأَي — فَـ + رَأَى — fa-, and then + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms; the edition spells with final yāʾ); 'and he saw'
نَظِيفَ: نَظِيفَ — naẓīf, clean (adj., m. acc. in construct, annexed to al-thiyābi; qualifying shābban); 'clean of (clothes)'
ظَرِيفَ: ظَرِيفَ — ẓarīf, elegant, graceful (adj., m. acc. in construct, annexed to al-maʿānī); 'elegant of (qualities)'
وَعَلَاهُ: وَعَلَاهُ — و + عَلَا + هُ — wa-, and + ʿalā, to rise over, come over, overspread (verb I defective, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object suffix; 'and came over him'
الْأَنِينُ: الـ + أَنِين — anīn, moaning (m., nom.); 'the moaning' (subject of zādahu, 'increased him')
وَالِانْتِحَابُ: و + الـ + اِنْتِحَاب — intiḥāb, sobbing (m., nom., verbal noun of form VIII); wa-, 'and'; 'and the sobbing'
وَالْوَجَلُ: و + الـ + وَجَل — wajal, dread, fear (m., nom.); wa-, 'and'; 'and the dread'
مُقْلَتِي: مُقْلَة + ي — muqla, eye, eyeball (f., gen. after min) + -ī, my; 'my eye' (min muqlatī, 'from my eyes')
يَاصَاحِ: يَا + صَاحِ — yāṣāḥi, run together in the print: yā, vocative 'O' + ṣāḥi, clipped vocative of ṣāḥib, companion (verse form); 'O companion', 'my friend'
مُنْهَمِلُ: مُنْهَمِل — munhamil, pouring down, streaming (active part., form VII of hamala, m., nom., predicate of al-damʿ); 'pouring down'
وَالْعَتْبُ: و + الـ + عَتْب — wa-, 'and'; ʿatb, reproach (m., nom.); 'and the reproach'
وَدَّعْتُهُ: وَدَّعَ + تُ + هُ — waddaʿa, to bid farewell (form II, perf.) + -tu, I + -hu, him/it; 'I bade it farewell'
فَرْدًا: فَرْد + ًا — fard, alone, single (m., acc. indef., as state ḥāl); 'alone'
اَمَلُ: أَمَل — amal, hope (m., nom.); printed with plain alif (اَمَل) for أَمَل; 'hope' (lā qalbun wa-lā amalu, 'no heart and no hope')
صَاحِبِي: صَاحِب + ي — ṣāḥib, companion, friend (m., acc. in vocative yā ṣāḥibī) + -ī, my; 'my companion'
اُوَدِّعَ: أُوَدِّع — uwaddiʿa, I bid farewell (form II, 1st sg. imperf. subjunctive after ḥattā); 'I say goodbye' (to her)
نُطْقِهَا: نُطْق + هَا — nuṭq, speech, utterance (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; min nuṭqihā, 'from her speech'; 'her speech'
تَشْتَفِى: تَشْتَفِي — tashtafī, are cured, find a cure (form VIII of shafā, 3rd f. sg. imperf., agreeing with plural al-amrāḍ); printed with final ى; 'are cured'
الْاَمْرَاضُ: الـ + أَمْرَاض — maraḍ, sickness, pl. amrāḍ (m., nom.); printed with plain alif; 'the sicknesses'
وَالْعِلَلُ: و + الـ + عِلَل — wa-, 'and'; ʿilla, ailment, pl. ʿilal (f., nom.); 'and the ailments'
نَاظِرٌ: نَاظِر — nāẓir, looking, watching (active part. of naẓara, m., nom., predicate of Tāj al-Mulūk) with ilayhi, 'at him'; 'watching (him)' ; also: 'eye' and also 'overseer, minister' (m., nom. indef., subject delayed after laka): laka … nāẓirun, 'you have an eye (an overseer)', a court pun paired with ḥājib
بِفَاتِكِ: بِـ + فَاتِك — bi-, with (prep., 'with glances that...') + fātik, slaying, murderous (act. part. of fataka, m., gen., first term of idāfa); 'with murderous (glances)'; in mughram bi-, 'enamoured of', bi- names the object of desire (Night 131)
اللَّحَظَاتِ: الـ + لَحَظَات — laḥẓa, glance, pl. laḥaẓāt (f., gen., second term of idāfa); 'the glances'; fātiki al-laḥaẓāt, 'glances that could kill'
حِذْرَكُمْ: حِذْر + كُمْ — ḥidhr, caution, guard (m., acc., object of khudhū) + -kum, your (pl.); khudhū ḥidhrakum, 'take your caution', 'beware'
طَرْفِهَا: طَرْف + هَا — ṭarf, glance, eye (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her glance'
سَاحِرُ: سَاحِر — sāḥir, sorcerer, bewitching (active part. of saḥara, m., nom., predicate); 'a sorcerer'
بِنَاجٍ: بِـ + نَاجٍ — bi-, marking the predicate of laysa (not 'by') + nājin, one who escapes (act. part. of najā, m., gen.); 'not one who escapes'
رَمَتْهُ: رَمَتْ + هُ — ramat, shot, cast (perf. 3rd f. sg. of ramā) + -hu, him; 'has shot him' (the relative clause is man ramathu 'whom ... shot')
الْمَحَاجِرُ: الـ + مَحَاجِر — maḥjir, eye-socket, pl. maḥājir (m., nom., subject of ramat); stands for the eyes; 'the eye-sockets', 'those eyes'
نَوَاعِسُ: نَوَاعِس — nāʿis, drowsy, languid (act. part. of naʿasa, pl. nawāʿis, f. pl. agreeing with al-ʿuyūn, a ḥāl clause 'wa-hiya'); 'drowsy'
تَقُدُّ: تَقُدُّ — taqudd, cuts through, slices (3rd f. sg. imperf. of qadda, agreeing with al-ʿuyūn); 'cut through'
الْبِيضَ: الـ + بِيض — al-, the + bīḍ, white (pl. of abyaḍ, m./f. pl., adjective of al-suyūf, acc.); 'the white (swords)'
بَوَاتِرُ: بَوَاتِر — bātir, sharp, cutting (act. part. of batara, pl. bawātir; ḥāl clause after wa-hiya); 'keen', 'sharp-cutting'
تَخْدَعُوا: تَخْدَعُوا — takhdaʿū, you (pl.) deceive (2nd m. pl. imperf. jussive after lā, prohibition); printed active, 'do not deceive', but the sense wants the passive tukhdaʿū, 'do not be deceived'
رِقَّةٍ: رِقَّة + ٍ — riqqa, softness, gentleness (f., gen. indef. after min, 'from, by reason of'); 'softness' (min riqqatin, 'by the softness')
الْحُمَيَّا: الـ + حُمَيَّا — ḥumayyā, strength of wine, strong wine (f., nom.; the fire of wine at its sharpest); 'strong wine'
لِلْعُقُولِ: لِـ + الـ + عُقُول — li-, to, for (prep., marking what the wine goes to) + al-ʿuqūl, the minds (pl. of ʿaql, gen.); 'to the minds', 'to the head'
تُخَامِرُ: تُخَامِر — tukhāmir, gets into, steals over (form III, 3rd f. sg. imperf. of khāmara, 'to penetrate'); 'goes (to the head)'
مُنَعَّمَةُ: مُنَعَّمَة — munaʿʿama, delicately nurtured, soft (pass. part. form II of naʿʿama, f., nom., predicate of an implied 'she'; first term of idāfa with al-aṭrāf); 'delicately nurtured'
الْاَطْرَافِ: الـ + أَطْرَاف — ṭaraf, extremity, limb, pl. aṭrāf (m., gen., second term of idāfa); printed with plain alif; 'of the extremities'
لَوْمَسَّ: لَوْ + مَسَّ — law, if (conditional particle) + massa, touched (perf. 3rd m. sg. of massa); run together in the print (لَوْمَسَّ); 'if it touched'
جِسْمَهَا: جِسْم + هَا — jism, body (m., acc., object of massa) + -hā, her; 'her body'
حَرِيرٌ: حَرِير — ḥarīr, silk (m., nom. indef., subject of massa); 'silk'
لَادْمَاهُ: لَـ + أَدْمَى + هُ — la-, apodosis particle of law ('would') + admā, made bleed (form IV perf. of damiya) + -hu, it/her; run together in the print (لَادْمَاهُ); 'it would have made her bleed'
نَاظِرُ: نَاظِر — nāẓir, looking, seeing (active part. of naẓara, m., nom., predicate of anta in wa-hā anta nāẓiru); 'looking on'
بَعِيدَةُ: بَعِيدَة — baʿīda, far, distant (f., nom., predicate of an implied 'she'; first term of idāfa with mā bayna); 'far' (baʿīdatu mā bayna ... 'long is the way between')
الْمُخَلْخَلِ: الـ + مُخَلْخَل — mukhalkhal, anklet-place, the ankle (m., gen. after bayna; or 'anklet'); 'the anklet' (from her anklets to her neck)
وَالطُّلَا: و + الـ + طُلَا — wa-, 'and' + al-ṭulā, the neck (pl. of ṭulya/ṭulāt, 'neck'; gen., second term after bayna); 'and the neck'
الشَّذَا: الـ + شَذَا — shadhā, fragrance, perfume (m., nom. in aynā al-shadhā, 'where is the fragrance'); 'the perfume'
طِيبِهَا: طِيب + هَا — ṭīb, scent, perfume (m., gen. after min, 'compared with') + -hā, her; 'her scent'
عَاطِرُ: عَاطِر — ʿāṭir, fragrant (act. part. of ʿaṭira, m., nom., predicate of wa-huwa, ḥāl clause); 'fragrant'
تَعْرِضْ: لَمْ + تَعْرِضْ — lam, not (jussive particle) + taʿriḍ, you display (2nd m. sg. imperf. jussive of ʿaraḍa, 'to show'); 'did you not show'
بِضَاعَتَكَ: بِضَاعَة + كَ — biḍāʿa, merchandise, goods (f., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your goods'
لِحَضْرَةِ: لِـ + حَضْرَة — li-, for (prep., 'fit for') + ḥaḍra, presence (f., gen., first term of idāfa); 'for the presence (of)'; with saʿādatika a courtly address like 'Your Highness'
سَعَادَتِكَ: سَعَادَة + كَ — saʿāda, felicity, happiness (f., gen., second term) + -ka, your; ḥaḍrat saʿādatika, 'Your Felicity'
تَعْرِضَ: أَنْ + تَعْرِضَ — an, that (+ subjunctive) + taʿriḍa, you show (2nd m. sg. imperf. subjunctive, after lā budda an); 'that you show'
بَاكِى: بَاكِي — bākī, weeping (act. part. of bakā, m., acc., ḥāl/adjective; printed with final ى, in bākī al-ʿayn, first term of idāfa); 'weeping'
أَزَلْنَا: أَزَلْ + نَا — azala, removed (form IV of zāla) + -nā, we; here a conditional answer, 'we will remove'
ظُلَامَتَكَ: ظُلَامَة + كَ — ẓulāma, a wrong suffered, grievance (f., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'the wrong done to you'
مَدْيُونًا: مَدْيُون + ًا — madyūn, indebted, in debt (pass. part. of dāna, m., acc. indef., predicate of kunta); 'in debt'
دَيْنَكَ: دَيْن + كَ — dayn, debt (m., acc., object of qaḍaynā) + -ka, your; 'what you owe'
كُرْسِيَّيْنِ: كُرْسِيَّيْن — kursī, chair, seat (m., dual gen. after bi-naṣb, '-ayni'); 'two seats'
فَنَصَبُوا: فَـ + نَصَبُوا — fa-, 'so, then' + naṣabū, they set up (perf. 3rd m. pl. of naṣaba); 'so they set up'
وَالآبَنُوسِ: و + الـ + آبَنُوس — wa-, 'and' + al-ābanūs, ebony (m., gen. after min); 'and ebony'
مُشَبَّكًا: مُشَبَّك + ًا — mushabbak, latticed, worked in openwork (pass. part. form II of shabbaka, m., acc. indef., ḥāl/adjective of kursiyyan); 'worked in a lattice'
وَبَسَطُوا: و + بَسَطُوا — wa-, 'and' + basaṭū, they spread (perf. 3rd m. pl. of basaṭa); 'and they spread'
تَذْكُرْ: تَذْكُرْ — tadhkur, you mention (2nd m. sg. imperf. jussive after lā, prohibition); lā tadhkur lī dhālika, 'do not mention that to me', 'do not ask that of me'
بِمُنَاسِبَةٍ: بِـ + مُنَاسِبَة + ٍ — bi-, marking the predicate of laysa + munāsiba, suitable (act. part. form III of nāsaba, f., gen. indef.); 'not suitable'
بِإِحْضَارِهَا: بِـ + إِحْضَار + هَا — bi-, marking what is ordered (amara bi-, 'order to do') + iḥḍār, bringing, fetching (verbal noun form IV, gen.) + -hā, it (the goods); 'to bring it/them'
فَأَحْضَرُوهَا: فَـ + أَحْضَرُوا + هَا — fa-, 'so' + aḥḍarū, they brought (form IV perf. 3rd m. pl.) + -hā, it/them (the goods); 'and they brought them'
قَهْرًاعَنْهُ: قَهْرًا + عَنْهُ — run together in the print (قهراعنه): qahran, by force, compulsion (m., acc. indef., adverbial) + ʿanhu, ʿan, from/against + -hu, him; 'by force, against his will'
وَصَعَّدَ: و + صَعَّدَ — wa-, 'and' + ṣaʿʿada, sent up, heaved (form II perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'and he heaved' (the sighs)
بِجَفْنِكَ: بِـ + جَفْن + كَ — bi-, in (prep.; part of the oath bi-mā, 'by what is in...') + jafn, eyelid (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your eyelid'
كَحَلٍ: كَحَل + ٍ — kaḥal, natural darkness of the eyelids, as if kohl-lined (m., gen. indef., after min); 'dark (of the eyelid)'
بِقَدِّكَ: بِـ + قَدّ + كَ — bi-, in + qadd, stature, form (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your form'
لِينٍ: لِين + ٍ — līn, softness, suppleness (m., gen. indef., after min); 'suppleness'
مَيَلٍ: مَيَل + ٍ — mayal, swaying, inclining (m., gen. indef., after min); 'sway'
بِثَغْرِكَ: بِـ + ثَغْر + كَ — bi-, in + thaghr, mouth, lips (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your mouth'
خَمْرٍ: خَمْر + ٍ — khamr, wine (f./m., gen. indef., after min); 'wine'; here: gen. indef., second term of a construct: kāsāti khamrin, 'cups of wine'
شَهْدِ: شَهْد — shahd, honey (m., gen., after min); printed without tanwīn where min shahdin is expected; 'honey'
بِطَبْعِكَ: بِـ + طَبْع + كَ — bi-, in + ṭabʿ, nature, disposition (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your nature'
مَلَلِ: مَلَل + ٍ — malal, weariness, boredom, fickleness (m., gen. indef., after min); 'fickleness', the beloved's quickness to tire
طَيْفٍ: طَيْف + ٍ — ṭayf, phantom, image of the beloved visiting in sleep (m., gen. indef., second term with ziyāra); 'of a phantom'
الْاَمْنِ: الـ + أَمْن — amn, safety, security (m., gen. after min, 'than'); printed with plain alif; 'safety'
بِضَاعَتَهُ: بِضَاعَة + هُ — biḍāʿa, merchandise, goods (f., acc., object of fataḥa) + -hu, his; 'his goods'
وَتَفْصِيلَةً: و + تَفْصِيلَة + ً — wa-, 'and' + tafṣīla, length of cloth cut for a garment (f., acc. indef., repeated for distribution); 'and length (by length)'
جُمْلَتِهَا: جُمْلَة + هَا — jumla, whole, totality (f., gen. after min) + -hā, their/its; min jumlatihā, 'from among them'
مَنْسُوجًا: مَنْسُوج + ًا — mansūj, woven (pass. part. of nasaja, m., acc. indef., adjective of thawban; with bi-al-dhahab 'with gold'); 'woven'
أَلْفَيْ: أَلْف + َيْ — alf, thousand (m., dual in construct, gen./acc. -ay, dropping nūn before dīnār); 'two thousand'
خِرْقَةٌ: خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, scrap of cloth (f., nom. indef., subject of waqaʿat); 'a scrap of cloth'
وَرِكِهِ: وَرِك + هِ — warik, thigh, hip (m., gen. after taḥta) + -hi, his; taḥta warikihi, 'under his thigh'
ذَهَلَ: ذَهَلَ — dhahila, was distracted, lost his wits (perf. 3rd m. sg.; takes ʿan, 'from'); 'he had become distracted'
الْمَعْقُولِ: الـ + مَعْقُول — maʿqūl, the reasonable, what is sensible (pass. part. of ʿaqala, m., gen. after ʿan); dhahala ʿani al-maʿqūl, 'beside himself'
الْفُوَادُ: الـ + فُؤَاد — fuʾād, heart (m., nom., subject of yashtafī); printed al-fuwād, with a plain wāw for the hamza, an unusual spelling; 'the heart'
الْمُعَذَّبُ: الـ + مُعَذَّب — muʿadhdhab, tormented (pass. part. form II of ʿadhdhaba, m., nom., adjective of al-fuʾād); 'the tormented'
وَنَجْمُ: و + نَجْم — wa-, 'and' (circumstantial, 'when') + najm, star (m., nom.; najm al-thurayyā, 'the star of the Pleiades'); 'and the star (of the Pleiades)'
وِصَالِكَ: وِصَال + كَ — wiṣāl, union (m., gen. after min, 'than') + -ka, your; 'than union with you'
اَقْرَبُ: أَقْرَب — aqrab, nearer (elative of qarīb, m., nom., predicate of najm); printed with plain alif; 'nearer'
بِعَادٌ: بِعَاد + ٌ — biʿād, distance, estrangement (m., nom. indef., in a list of nouns); 'distance'
وَلَوْعَةٌ: و + لَوْعَة + ٌ — wa-, 'and' + lawʿa, burning pain, passion (f., nom. indef.); 'and burning pain'
وَمَطْلٌ: و + مَطْل + ٌ — wa-, 'and' + maṭl, putting off, delaying a promise (m., nom. indef.); 'and delay'
وَتَسْوِيفٌ: و + تَسْوِيف + ٌ — wa-, 'and' + taswīf, putting off, procrastination (verbal noun form II, m., nom. indef.); 'and putting off'
الْعُمْرُ: الـ + عُمْر — ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., nom., subject of yadhhabu); 'my life'
الْوَصْلُ: الـ + وَصْل — waṣl, union, meeting (m., nom., subject of yuḥyīnī); 'union'
يُحْيِينِي: يُحْيِي + نِي — yuḥyī, revives, brings to life (form IV imperf., 3rd m. sg., of aḥyā) + -nī, me; 'revives me'
الْبُعْدُ: الـ + بُعْد — buʿd, distance, remoteness (m., nom., subject); 'distance'
يُدْنِينِي: يُدْنِي + نِي — yudnī, brings near (form IV imperf., 3rd m. sg., of adnā) + -nī, me; 'brings me near'
اِنْصَافٌ: اِنْصَاف + ٌ — inṣāf, fairness, justice (verbal noun form VII/VIII, m., nom. indef., subject of mā min-ka); printed with plain alif; 'fairness'
رَحْمَةٌ: رَحْمَة + ٌ — raḥma, mercy (f., nom. indef.; lā laka raḥmatun, 'no mercy to you'); 'mercy'
اِسْعَافٌ: اِسْعَاف + ٌ — isʿāf, help, aid (verbal noun form IV, m., nom. indef.); 'help'
مَهْرَبُ: مَهْرَب — mahrab, escape, place of flight (m., nom. indef. in the prepositional-phrase predicate lā ʿanka mahrabu; the poem's rhyme -bu); 'an escape'
وَبِي: و + بِـ + ي — wa-, 'and' + bī, in me, with me (bi- + -ī); hard to construe as printed, 'and in me, your love...'; probably for wa-fī ḥubbikum or wa-bi-ḥubbikum, 'and through love of you'; kept as printed; 'and for/through (love of you)'
حُبِّكُمْ: حُبّ + كُمْ — ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -kum, your (pl., courtesy plural for the beloved); 'love of you'
مَذَاهِبِي: مَذَاهِب + ي — madhhab, way, course (pl. madhāhib, m., nom., subject of ḍāqat) + -ī, my; 'my ways'
اَذْهَبُ: أَذْهَب — adhhab, I go (1st sg. imperf. of dhahaba); printed with plain alif; 'I go' (ilā ayna adhhabu, 'to where I go')
الْخِرْقَةَ: الـ + خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, scrap of cloth (f., acc., object of akhadha); 'the scrap'
الْخِرْقَةُ: الـ + خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, scrap of cloth (f., nom., in mā hādhihi al-khirqatu, 'what is this rag'); 'the rag'
الْخِرْقَةِ: الـ + خِرْقَة — khirqa, rag, scrap of cloth (f., gen., after bi-, 'need of': ḥāja bi-); 'the scrap'
لِأَجْلِهَا: لِـ + أَجْل + هَا — li-, for (prep.) + ajl, sake, reason (m., gen.) + -hā, its (the scrap's); li-ajlihā, 'for its sake', 'because of it'
رَأٰهُ: رَأَى + هُ — raʾā, saw (perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hu, him; printed رأه without its long alif (for رَآهُ); 'saw him'; pointed with a dagger alif; also with two objects, 'he saw it (to be)': raʾāhu ṣawāban, 'he saw that it was right' (Night 192)
الْأَنَّاتِ: الـ + أَنَّات — anna, groan (pl. annāt, f., gen., after min in akthara min, 'did much of'); 'the groans'
تَعْذُلِيهِ: تَعْذُلِي + هِ — taʿdhulī, you reproach (imperf. 2nd f. sg., jussive after lā, prohibition, of ʿadhala) + -hi, him; 'do not reproach him'
الْعَذْلَ: الـ + عَذْل — ʿadhl, reproach (verbal noun, m., acc., after inna); 'the reproach'
يُوجِعُهُ: يُوجِع + هُ — yūjiʿu, hurts (form IV imperf. 3rd m. sg. of awjaʿa) + -hu, him; 'hurts him'
اَسْتَوْدِعُ: أَسْتَوْدِع — astawdiʿu, I entrust, leave in keeping (form X imperf. 1st sg.); printed with plain alif; 'I leave in keeping'
الْبَطْحَاءِ: الـ + بَطْحَاء — baṭḥāʾ, gravelly valley-bed (f., gen., after fī, 'in'); 'the valley'
قَمَرًا: قَمَر — qamar, moon (m., acc. indef., object); 'a moon' (of a beloved); also: acc. of state (ḥāl) after badat, a noun standing for a likeness: badat qamaran, 'she appeared as a moon'
بِالْحَيِّ: بِـ + الـ + حَيّ — bi-, among, in (prep., place) + ḥayy, tribe, encampment (m., gen.); 'among the tents'
الْاَزْرَارِ: الـ + أَزْرَار — zirr, button (pl. azrār, m., gen., in the idāfa falak al-azrār); printed with plain alif; 'the collar buttons', 'the collar'
مَطْلِعُهُ: مَطْلِع + هُ — maṭliʿ, place of rising (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his rising'
وَبِوُدِّي: و + بِـ + وُدّ + ي — wa-, and + bi-, in (prep., with wudd: bi-wuddī law, 'it is my wish that') + wudd, love, wish (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and I wish'
يُوَدِّعُنِي: يُوَدِّع + نِي — yuwaddiʿu, bids farewell (form II imperf. 3rd m. sg., after law) + -nī, me; 'would bid me farewell'
صَفْوَ: صَفْو — ṣafw, purity, the best part (m., acc., object of yuwaddiʿunī, in idāfa before al-ḥayāh); 'the sweetness (of life)'
اُوَدِّعُهُ: أُوَدِّع + هُ — uwaddiʿu, I bid farewell (form II imperf. 1st sg.) + -hu, him; printed with plain alif; 'I bid him farewell'
تَشَفَّعَ: تَشَفَّعَ — tashaffaʿa, pleaded, interceded (form V perf. 3rd m. sg.; bī, 'with me', follows); 'he pleaded'
ضُحًى: ضُحًى — ḍuḥā, forenoon, morning (m., acc. indef., adverbial of time); 'in the morning'
وَاَدْمُعِي: و + أَدْمُع + ي — wa-, and (circumstantial) + admuʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; printed with plain alif; 'and my tears'
مُسْتَهِلَّاتٌ: مُسْتَهِلَّات + ٌ — mustahilla, pouring, streaming (act. part. form X, f. pl., nom. indef., predicate); 'pouring down'
وَاَدْمُعُهُ: و + أَدْمُع + هُ — wa-, and + admuʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, m., nom.) + -hu, his; printed with plain alif; 'and his tears'
اَكْذَبَ: أَكْذَبَ — akdhaba, I give the lie (form IV 1st sg.; lā akdhaba Allāha, an asseveration); printed with plain alif; 'I do not lie, God knows'
ثَوْبُ: ثَوْب — thawb, robe, garment (m., nom., subject, in idāfa before al-ʿudhr); 'the robe (of)'
الْعُذْرِ: الـ + عُذْر — ʿudhr, excuse (m., gen., idāfa); 'of excuse(s)'
مُنْخَرِقٌ: مُنْخَرِق + ٌ — munkhariq, torn (act. part. form VII of inkharaqa, m., nom. indef., predicate); 'is torn'
بِفُرْقَتِهِ: بِـ + فُرْقَة + هِ — bi-, by, through (prep., cause: 'by reason of') + furqa, parting (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'by parting from him'
اُرَقِّعُهُ: أُرَقِّع + هُ — uraqqiʿu, I patch (form II imperf. 1st sg.) + -hu, it; printed with plain alif; 'I patch it'
يَسْتَقِرُّ: يَسْتَقِرّ — yastaqirru, stays still, settles (form X imperf. 3rd m. sg. of istaqarra); 'will keep still'
لِجَنْبِي: لِـ + جَنْب + ي — li-, for (prep., benefit: 'for my side') + janb, side (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my side', 'for me'
مَضْجَعٌ: مَضْجَع + ٌ — maḍjaʿ, bed, place of lying down (m., nom. indef., subject); 'a bed'
مَضْجَعُهُ: مَضْجَع + هُ — maḍjaʿ, bed (m., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his bed'
سَعَى: سَعَى — saʿā, strove, went about, meddled (perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'has meddled'
بِيَدٍ: بِـ + يَد — bi-, with (prep., instrument/accompaniment) + yad, hand (f., gen. indef.); 'with a hand'
عَسْرَاءَ: عَسْرَاء — ʿasrāʾ, left-handed, clumsy, hard (f. adj., gen. indef., diptote, modifying yad); 'clumsy'
حَظِّي: حَظّ + ي — ḥaẓẓ, share, luck (m., acc., object of tamnaʿunī) + -ī, my; 'my share'
وَتَمْنَعُهُ: و + تَمْنَع + هُ — wa-, and + tamnaʿu, keeps back (imperf. 3rd f. sg. of manaʿa, subject yad) + -hu, him; 'and keeps from him'
وَصَبَّتِ: و + صَبَّتِ — wa-, and + ṣabbat, poured (perf. 3rd f. sg. of ṣabba; kasra before al-); 'and she poured'
كَاْسًا: كَأْس + ًا — kaʾs, cup (f., acc. indef., object of malaʾat); printed كاسا with plain alif; 'a cup'
تَجَرَّعَ: تَجَرَّعَ — tajarraʿa, drank in gulps, swallowed (form V perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'he drank'
اُجَرِّعُهُ: أُجَرِّع + هُ — ujarriʿu, I give to drink, make swallow (form II imperf. 1st sg.) + -hu, it; printed with plain alif; 'what I am made to swallow'
أَرَي: أَرَى — arā, I see (imperf. 1st sg. of raʾā); printed with ي for ى; 'I see'
أَحْوَالَكَ: أَحْوَال + كَ — aḥwāl, conditions (pl. of ḥāl, m., acc., object of arā) + -ka, your; 'your state'
مُسْتَقِيمَةٍ: مُسْتَقِيمَة + ٍ — mustaqīm, straight, right (act. part. form X, f., gen. indef., after ghayra); 'right', 'in order'
بُكَائِكَ: بُكَاء + كَ — bukāʾ, weeping (verbal noun, m., gen., idāfa after sabab) + -ka, your; 'your weeping'
نَظَرِكَ: نَظَر + كَ — naẓar, looking (verbal noun, m., gen., after ʿinda) + -ka, your; 'your looking'
تَنَهَّدَ: تَنَهَّدَ — tanahhada, sighed (form V perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'sighed'
وَأَمْرِي: و + أَمْر + ي — wa-, and + amr, affair (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'and my affair'
وَصَاحِبَتِهَا: و + صَاحِبَة + هَا — wa-, and + ṣāḥiba, owner, mistress (f., gen., coordinated after maʿa) + -hā, its (the cloth's); 'and its owner'
وَصَاحِبَةِ: و + صَاحِبَة — wa-, and + ṣāḥiba, owner, maker (f., gen., idāfa before hādhihi al-ṣuwar); 'and the woman (of)'
وَالتَّمَاثِيلِ: و + الـ + تِمْثَال — wa-, and + timthāl, figure, statue (pl. tamāthīl, m., gen., coordinated); 'and the figures'
نَشَرَ: نَشَرَ — nashara, spread out, unfolded (perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'spread out'
مَرْقُومَةٌ: مَرْقُومَة + ٌ — marqūm, embroidered, inscribed (pass. part. of raqama, f., nom. indef., predicate; bi-l-ḥarīr, 'in silk', follows); 'embroidered'
وَقُبَالَهَا: و + قُبَال + هَا — wa-, and + qubāl, opposite (m., acc., adverbial) + -hā, it; 'and facing it'
طَوْقٌ: طَوْق + ٌ — ṭawq, collar, neck-ring (m., nom. indef.); 'a collar'
قَصَبَاتٍ: قَصَبَات + ٍ — qaṣaba, tube, cane (pl. qaṣabāt, f., gen. indef., idāfa after thalāth); 'tubes'
الزَّبَرْجَدِ: الـ + زَبَرْجَد — zabarjad, chrysolite, peridot (m., gen., after min, 'of'); 'of chrysolite'
صَنْعَتِهِ: صَنْعَة + هِ — ṣanʿa, craft, making (f., gen., idāfa after ḥusn) + -hi, its; 'its making'
عَلَّمَ: عَلَّمَ — ʿallama, taught (form II perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'taught'
مَالَمْ: مَا + لَمْ — mā, what (relative) + lam, not (neg., with jussive); written as one word; 'what (he did) not (know)'; here: mā lam yalqahu, 'what (he) did not meet'
الْغَزَالِ: الـ + غَزَال — ghazāl, gazelle (m., gen., idāfa after ṣāḥiba); 'the gazelle'
تَعَاهَدَ: تَعَاهَدَ — taʿāhada, made a pact, agreed (form VI perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'agreed'
يُزَوِّجَانِي: يَحْجُبُوا + نِي — yaḥjubū, they keep away (imperf. 3rd m. pl., jussive after lam, of ḥajaba; the nūn belongs to the suffix) + -nī, me; 'did not keep me'
يَحْجُبُوهَا: يَحْجُبُوا + هَا — yaḥjubū, they keep away (imperf. 3rd m. pl., jussive after lam, of ḥajaba) + -hā, her; 'did not keep her'
يَحْجُبُونِي: يَحْجُبُون + نِي — yaḥjubūna, they keep away (imperf. 3rd m. pl.; printed with nūn after lam) + -nī, me; 'did not keep me'
تَحَدَّثَ: تَحَدَّثَ — taḥaddatha, spoke, conversed (form V perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'spoke'
نَكْتُبُ: نَكْتُب — naktubu, we write (imperf. 1st pl. of kataba); 'we will draw up'
عَزِيزٍ: عَزِيز + ٍ — ʿAzīz, personal name, lit. 'dear, mighty' (m., gen. indef., idāfa after kitāb); 'of ʿAzīz'
عَزِيزَةَ: عَزِيزَة — ʿAzīza, personal name (f., gen., diptote, after ʿalā, 'upon, to'); 'ʿAzīza'
مُؤَنِ: مُؤَن — muʾna, provisions, supplies (pl. muʾan, f., gen., idāfa after tajhīz); 'provisions'
الْوَلَائِمِ: الـ + وَلَائِم — walīma, wedding banquet (pl. walāʾim, f., gen., idāfa); 'the feasts'
نَدْرِ: نَدْرِ — nadri, we know (imperf. 1st pl., jussive after lam, of darā, shortened); 'we did not know'
أَشْعَرَ: أَشْعَر — ashʿar, more perceptive (elative of shaʿura, m. sg., diptote, predicate of kānat; min-nī, 'than I', follows); 'quicker'
وَأَعْرَفَ: و + أَعْرَف — wa-, and + aʿraf, more knowing (elative of ʿarafa, diptote, predicate); 'and knew more'
وَأَدْرَى: و + أَدْرَى — wa-, and + adrā, more aware (elative of darā, predicate); 'and understood more'
أَدَوَاتِ: أَدَوَات — adāh, tool, equipment (pl. adawāt, f., acc., object of jahhaza; sound pl. acc. shows kasra, in idāfa before al-faraḥ); 'the equipment'
كَتْبِ: كَتْب — katb, writing (verbal noun of kataba, m., gen., idāfa after ghayr); 'the writing (of)'
وَالدُّخُولِ: و + الـ + دُخُول — wa-, and + dukhūl, entering, going in to the bride (verbal noun, m., gen., coordinated with katb; ʿalā follows); 'and the going in'
صَلٰوةِ: صَلَوٰة — ṣalāt, prayer (f., gen., idāfa after baʿda); printed with ṣalwa spelling (dagger alif); 'prayer'
وَأَعْلَمَهُمْ: و + أَعْلَمَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + aʿlama, informed (form IV perf. 3rd m. sg.) + -hum, them; 'and told them'
أَقَارِبَهَا: أَقَارِب + هَا — aqārib, relatives (pl. of qarīb, m., acc., object of daʿat) + -hā, her; 'her relations'
الْمُعَدَّةَ: الـ + مُعَدَّة — muʿadda, prepared, made ready (pass. part. form II of aʿadda, f., acc., modifying al-qāʿa); 'the ready (hall)'
رُخَامَهَا: رُخَام + هَا — rukhām, marble (m. collective, acc., object of ghasalū) + -hā, its; 'its marble'
زَوَّقُوا: زَوَّقُوا — zawwaqū, they adorned, decorated (form II perf. 3rd m. pl.); 'they hung/decked'
حِيطَانَهَا: حِيطَان + هَا — ḥīṭān, walls (pl. of ḥāʾiṭ, m., acc., object) + -hā, its; 'its walls'
الْمُقَصَّبِ: الـ + مُقَصَّب — muqaṣṣab, gold-threaded, brocaded (pass. part. form II, m., gen., modifying al-qumāsh, after bi-, 'with'); 'gold-threaded'
يَجِيئُوا: يَجِيئُوا — yajīʾū, they come (imperf. 3rd m. pl., subjunctive after an, of jāʾa); 'to come'
بَيْتَنَا: بَيْت + نَا — bayt, house (m., acc., object of yajīʾū, 'come to') + -nā, our; 'our house'
وَأَطْبَاقَ: و + أَطْبَاق — wa-, and + aṭbāq, trays, dishes (pl. of ṭabaq, m., acc., object of ʿamila, in idāfa before al-sukkar); 'and the dishes (of)'
أَرْسَلَتْنِي: أَرْسَلَتْ + نِي — arsalat, sent (form IV perf. 3rd f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'sent me'
مُطَيَّبَةً: مُطَيَّبَة + ً — muṭayyaba, perfumed (pass. part. form II of ṭayyaba, f., acc. indef., predicate of kānat); 'perfumed'
لَبِسْتُهَا: لَبِسْتُ + هَا — labistu, I put on (perf. 1st sg. of labisa) + -hā, it (the suit); 'I put it on'
رَائِحَةٌ: رَائِحَة + ٌ — rāʾiḥa, scent (f., nom. indef., subject of fāḥat); 'a scent'
زَكِيَّةٌ: زَكِيَّة + ٌ — zakiyya, sweet-smelling, fragrant (f. adj., nom. indef.); 'sweet'
عَبِقَتْ: عَبِقَتْ — ʿabiqat, clung, was fragrant, spread (perf. 3rd f. sg. of ʿabiqa); 'filled'
الْجَامِعِ: الـ + جَامِع — jāmiʿ, congregational mosque (m., gen., after ilā, 'to'); 'the mosque'
صَاحِبًا: صَاحِب + ًا — ṣāḥib, friend, companion (m., acc. indef., object of tadhakkartu); 'a friend'
لِيَحْضُرَ: لِـ + يَحْضُرَ — li-, so that (prep. + subjunctive, purpose) + yaḥḍura, he attends (imperf. 3rd m. sg. subjunctive of ḥaḍara); 'so that he might attend'
كَتْبَ: كَتْب — katb, writing (verbal noun, m., acc., object of yaḥḍura, idāfa before al-kitāb); 'the writing (of the contract)'
أَشْتَغِلُ: أَشْتَغِل — ashtaghilu, I busy myself (form VIII imperf. 1st sg.; bi-hādhā al-amr, 'with this matter', follows); 'I will busy myself'
يَقْرُبَ: يَقْرُبَ — yaqruba, draws near (imperf. 3rd m. sg., subjunctive after ilā an, of qaruba); 'comes near'
دَخَلْتُهُ: دَخَلْتُ + هُ — dakhaltu, I entered (perf. 1st sg.) + -hu, it (the lane, relative clause); 'I had entered it'
عَرْقَانًا: عَرْقَان + ًا — ʿarqān, sweating, drenched in sweat (adj., m., acc. indef., diptote, predicate of kuntu); 'sweating'
فَسَاحَ: فَـ + سَاحَ — fa-, so (consequence) + sāḥa, flowed, ran (perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'so ... ran'
عَرَقِي: عَرَق + ي — ʿaraq, sweat (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'my sweat'
وَفَاحَتْ: و + فَاحَتْ — wa-, and + fāḥat, spread, wafted (of scent; perf. 3rd f. sg. of fāḥa); 'and spread'
رَوَائِحِي: رَوَائِح + ي — rawāʾiḥ, scents, perfumes (pl. of rāʾiḥa, f., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'my perfumes'
لِأَرْتَاحَ: لِـ + أَرْتَاحَ — li-, in order to (prep. + subjunctive, purpose) + artāḥa, I rest (form VIII imperf. 1st sg. subjunctive of irtāḥa); 'to rest'
مَسْطَبَةٍ: مَسْطَبَة + ٍ — masṭaba, stone bench (f., gen. indef., after ʿalā, 'on'); 'a stone bench'
فَعَرِقَ: فَـ + عَرِقَ — fa-, so (consequence) + ʿariqa, sweated (perf. 3rd m. sg.); 'so ... broke into sweat'
الْعَرَقُ: الـ + عَرَق — ʿaraq, sweat (m., nom., subject of ṣāra); 'the sweat'
يَنْحَدِرُ: يَنْحَدِر — yanḥadiru, runs down (form VII imperf. 3rd m. sg. of inḥadara, predicate of ṣāra); 'running down'
يُمْكِنِّي: يُمْكِن + نِي — yumkin, is possible (form IV imperf. 3rd m. sg., jussive after lam) + -nī, me; 'it was not possible for me'
مَسْحُ: مَسْح — masḥ, wiping (verbal noun, m., nom., subject of yumkin, idāfa before al-ʿaraq); 'wiping'
بِالْمِنْدِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + مِنْدِيل — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + mindīl, kerchief (m., gen.); 'with the kerchief'
فَرَجِيَّتِي: فَرَجِيَّة + ي — farajiyya, long-sleeved robe (f., acc., object of akhudha) + -ī, my; 'the skirt of my robe'
وَأَمْسَحَ: و + أَمْسَحَ — wa-, and + amsaḥa, I wipe (imperf. 1st sg., subjunctive after an, of masaḥa); 'and wipe'
وَمِنْدِيلٌ: و + مِنْدِيل + ٌ — wa-, and (after mā adrī illā, 'I knew nothing till') + mindīl, kerchief (m., nom. indef.); 'when suddenly a kerchief'
الْمِنْدِيلُ: الـ + مِنْدِيل — mindīl, kerchief (m., nom., predicate/subject of kāna); 'the kerchief'
وَرُؤْيَتُهُ: و + رُؤْيَة + هُ — wa-, and + ruʾya, sight (f., nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'and the sight of it'
شِفَاءِ: شِفَاء — shifāʾ, healing, cure (m., gen., after min, 'than', comparative); 'healing'
السَّقِيمِ: الـ + سَقِيم — saqīm, sick (m., gen., idāfa); 'the sick'
طَاقَةٍ: طَاقَة — ṭāqa, window, opening (f., gen., after min); 'from a little window'
إِصْبَعَهَا: إِصْبَع + هَا — iṣbaʿ, finger (m./f., acc., object of waḍaʿat) + -hā, her (3fs possessive); 'her finger'
الْوُسْطَانِيَّ: الـ + وُسْطَانِيّ — al-wusṭānī, middle (adj., acc.), spoken form for al-wusṭā; 'the middle finger'
وَأَلْصَقَتْهَا: وَ + أَلْصَقَ + تْ + هَا — alṣaqa, to stick, press (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it (3fs object, the middle finger); 'and she pressed it'
بِإِصْبَعِهَا: بِـ + إِصْبَع + هَا — bi-, against, to (prep., with alṣaqa 'press against'); iṣbaʿ, finger (gen.) + -hā, her; 'against her finger'
وَوَضَعَتْهُمَا: وَ + وَضَعَ + تْ + هُمَا — waḍaʿa, to put, lay (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -humā, them both (dual object); 'and she laid the two'
أَدْخَلَتْ: أَدْخَلَ — adkhala, to bring in, put in (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -at); 'she drew her head in'
الِاسْتِعَارُ: الـ + اِسْتِعَار — istiʿār, blazing, kindling (m., nom., verbal noun of istaʿara, form X); 'the blaze'
وَأَعْقَبَتْنِي: وَ + أَعْقَبَ + تْ + نِي — aʿqaba, to leave behind, bring in its train (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (object); 'and it left me'
وَتَحَيَّرْتُ: وَ + تَحَيَّرَ + تُ — taḥayyara, to be bewildered (verb V, perf. 1s); 'and I was bewildered'
أَفْهَمْ: فَهِمَ — fahima, to understand (verb I, imperf. 1s, jussive after lam); 'I did not understand'
مَطْبُوقَةً: مَطْبُوقَة — maṭbūqa, shut (f., acc., predicate/hal), spoken form for muṭbaqa, passive participle of ṭabbaqa/aṭbaqa; 'found it shut'
فَصَبَرْتُ: فَـ + صَبَرَ + تُ — fa-, and so, then (conj.); ṣabara, to be patient, wait (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I waited' (until, ilā)
مَغِيبِ: مَغِيب — maghīb, setting, going down (m., gen. in idafa after ilā; verbal noun of ghāba); 'until sunset'
يَئِسْتُ: يَئِسَ — yaʾisa, to despair, give up hope (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); takes min of the thing: 'I gave up hope of'
رُؤْيَتِهَا: رُؤْيَة + هَا — ruʾya, seeing (f., gen. after min, verbal noun of raʾā) + -hā, her (objective suffix); 'of seeing her'
فَتَحْتُهُ: فَتَحَ + تُ + هُ — fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hu, it (the kerchief); 'I opened it'
فَفَاحَتْ: فَـ + فَاحَ + تْ — fa-, and so (conj.); fāḥa, to spread, be wafted (of scent) (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and it rose'
رَأيِحَةُ: رَائِحَة — rāʾiḥa, scent (f., nom., construct before al-misk), the print's spelling رأيحة; 'the scent (of musk)'
الرَّأيِحَةِ: الـ + رَائِحَة — rāʾiḥa, scent (f., gen., after min tilka), the print's spelling الرأيحة; 'that scent'
كَأَنَّنِي: كَأَنَّ + نِي — ka-anna, as if (conj., governs acc.; ka- here means 'as, like') + -nī, me (its noun, acc.); 'as if I were'
نَشَرْتُهُ: نَشَرَ + تُ + هُ — nashara, to spread out, unfold (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hu, it (the kerchief); 'I spread it out'
فَسَقَطَتْ: فَـ + سَقَطَ + تْ — fa-, and so (conj.); saqaṭa, to fall (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and fell'
وَرَقَةٌ: وَرَقَة — waraqa, sheet, slip of paper (f., nom.; subject of saqaṭat)
فَرَأَيْتُهَا: فَـ + رَأَى + تُ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hā, it (the slip); 'and I saw it'
مُضَمَّخَةً: مُضَمَّخَة — muḍammakha, smeared, steeped (passive participle, form II, f., acc., hal); 'found it steeped (in scents)'
بِالرَّوَائِحِ: بِـ + الـ + رَوَائِح — bi-, with (prep.; muḍammakha bi- 'steeped in'); rawāʾiḥ, scents (f. broken pl. of rāʾiḥa, gen.); 'in scents'
الزَّكِيَّاتِ: الـ + زَكِيَّات — zakiyya, sweet-smelling, fragrant (adj., f. pl., gen.; agrees with rawāʾiḥ); 'the sweet (scents)'
بَعَثْتُ: بَعَثَ — baʿatha, to send (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); 'I sent' (a letter), here 'I wrote'
اَشْكُوْ: أَشْكُو — ashkū, shakā, to complain (verb I, imperf. 1s, indicative, verse spelling); 'complaining'
الْجَوَى: الـ + جَوَى — al-jawā, passion, burning grief (m., gen. after min; indeclinable noun in -ā); 'of passion'; here: gen., second term of a construct: lāʿija al-jawā, 'the burning of passion'
رَقِيْقٍ: رَقِيق — raqīq, fine, thin (adj., m., gen., describing khaṭṭ); 'in a fine (hand)'
وَالْخُطُوْطُ: وَ + الـ + خُطُوط — wa-, and (here 'and, as you know'); khuṭūṭ, lines, handwritings (pl. of khaṭṭ, nom.); 'and hands'
فُنُوْنُ: فُنُون — funūn, arts, kinds, varieties (pl. of fann, m., nom., predicate); 'are of many arts'
لِخَطِّكَ: لِـ + خَطّ + كَ — li-, for, concerning (prep.; mā li-X 'what is wrong with X?'); khaṭṭ, handwriting (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'what is wrong with your writing'
رَقِيْقًا: رَقِيق — raqīq, fine, thin (adj., acc., ḥāl/predicate after hākadhā); 'so fine'
دَقِيْقًا: دَقِيق — daqīq, minute, faint (adj., m., acc., ḥāl); 'and faint'
يَكَادُ: كَادَ — kāda, to be about to, almost (verb I, imperf. 3ms; with lā 'scarcely'); 'hardly'
يَبِيْنُ: بَانَ — bāna, to be clear, show, appear (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'to show'
لِاَنِّيْ: لِـ + أَنَّ + نِي — li-, because (prep. with anna, giving the reason); anna, that (governs acc.) + -nī, me; 'because I am'
نُحُوْلٍ: نُحُول — nuḥūl, emaciation, wasting (m., gen., after fī); 'in wasting'
وَدِقَّةٍ: وَ + دِقَّة — wa-, and (conj.); diqqa, thinness, fineness (f., gen.); 'and thinness'
كَذَاكَ: كَـ + ذَا + كَ — ka-, like (prep.) + dhā, this (demonstrative) + -ka, that-far particle; 'like that, thus'
خُطُوْطُ: خُطُوط — khuṭūṭ, handwritings, lines (pl. of khaṭṭ, nom., construct); 'the handwriting (of lovers)'
الْعَاشِقِيْنَ: الـ + عَاشِقِين — ʿāshiqīn, lovers (active participle of ʿashiqa, m. pl., gen., in idafa); 'of lovers'
تَكُوْنُ: كَانَ — kāna, to be (verb I, imperf. 3fs, takūnu; agrees with plural non-human khuṭūṭ); 'is (so)'
أَطْلَقْتُ: أَطْلَقَ — aṭlaqa, to let loose, set free (verb IV, perf. 1s, -tu); aṭlaqtu naẓara al-ʿayn 'I let my eyes roam'
بَهْجَةِ: بَهْجَة — bahja, beauty, splendour (f., gen., construct after fī); 'in the beauty (of the kerchief)'
الْمِنْدِيلِ: الـ + مِنْدِيل — mindīl, kerchief, handkerchief (m., gen., construct); 'of the kerchief'
حَاشِيَتَيْهِ: حَاشِيَة + ـَيْـ + هِ — ḥāshiya, border, edge (f., dual gen., after iḥdā) + -hi, its; 'its two borders'
تَسْطِيرَ: تَسْطِير — tasṭīr, lining out, writing in lines (m., acc., verbal noun of form II saṭṭara, object of raʾaytu); 'the lining out (of these two verses)'
الْعِذَارُ: الـ + عِذَار — al-ʿidhār, the down on a youth's cheek (m., nom., subject of kataba); 'the down'
سَطْرَيْنِ: سَطْر + ـَيْنِ — saṭr, line (m., dual acc. object of kataba); 'two lines'
بِالرَّيْحَانِ: بِـ + الـ + رَيْحَان — bi-, in, with (prep., the material written with); rayḥān, sweet basil (m., gen.); 'in sweet basil'
وَاحَيْرَةَ: وَا + حَيْرَة — wā, oh! (interjection of lament) + ḥayra, bewilderment (f., acc. as in lament-construct); 'oh, the bewilderment of'
الْقَمَرَيْنِ: الـ + قَمَر + ـَيْنِ — qamar, moon (m., dual gen.); 'the two moons', i.e. sun and moon; here (verse): acc. (the dual -ayni serves for acc. and gen.), second object of aratnī, 'showed me the two moons': the moon in the sky and the beloved's face
انْثَنَى: اِنْثَنَى — inthanā, to bend, sway (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'when he bends'
وَاخَجْلَةَ: وَا + خَجْلَة — wā, oh! (interj.) + khajla, shame (f., acc. lament-construct); 'oh, the shame of'
الْاَغْصَانِ: الـ + أَغْصَان — aghṣān, branches, boughs (pl. of ghuṣn, m., gen.); 'the branches'
وَمُسَطَّرٌ: وَ + مُسَطَّر — wa-, and (conj.); musaṭṭar, lined, written in lines (passive participle, form II, m., nom.); 'and (there) are lined'
الْحَاشِيَةِ: الـ + حَاشِيَة — ḥāshiya, border (f., gen., after fī); 'on the border'
الْبَيْتَانِ: الـ + بَيْت + َانِ — bayt, verse, line of poetry (m., dual nom.); 'these two verses'
بِعَنْبَرٍ: بِـ + عَنْبَر — bi-, in, with (prep., material written with); ʿanbar, ambergris (m., gen.); 'in ambergris'
لُوْلُوءٍ: لُؤْلُؤ — luʾluʾ, pearl(s) (m., gen. after fī; tanwīn, spelt with hamza on wāw); 'on pearl'
سَبَجٍ: سَبَج — sabaj, jet (m., gen., after min); 'of jet'
تُفَّاحِ: تُفَّاح — tuffāḥ, apple(s) (collective, m., gen., after ʿalā); 'on the apple (of his cheek)'
اَلْقَتْلُ: الـ + قَتْل — qatl, killing, death (m., nom.); 'death'
الْحُدُقِ: الـ + حُدُق — ḥudaq, eyes, pupils (pl. of ḥadaqa, f., gen., after fī); 'in the eyes'
الْمِرَاضِ: الـ + مِرَاض — mirāḍ, ailing, languid (pl. of marīḍ, adj., gen.); 'the languid (eyes)'
رَنَتْ: رَنَا — ranā, to gaze (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at; agrees with plural non-human ḥudaq); 'when they gaze' Also of a woman: idhā ranat, 'when she gazes'.
الْوَجَنَاتِ: الـ + وَجَنَات — wajanāt, cheeks (f. sound pl. of wajna, gen., after fī); 'in the cheeks'
الرَّاحِ: الـ + رَاح — rāḥ, wine (f., gen., after fī, lā fī); 'in wine'
انْطَلَقَ: اِنْطَلَقَ — inṭalaqa, to break out, flare (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'broke out'
لَهِيبُ: لَهِيب — lahīb, flame, blaze (m., nom., construct before al-nār); 'the flame (of fire)'
الْأَشْوَاقُ: الـ + أَشْوَاق — ashwāq, longings (pl. of shawq, m., nom.); 'the longings'
وَالْأَفْكَارُ: وَ + الـ + أَفْكَار — wa-, and (conj.); afkār, thoughts, cares (pl. of fikr, m., nom.); 'and the thoughts'
وَالْوَرَقَةَ: وَ + الـ + وَرَقَة — wa-, and (conj.); waraqa, slip of paper (f., acc., object); 'and the slip of paper'
الْعِشْقِ: الـ + عِشْق — ʿishq, passionate love (m., gen., after fī); 'in love, in my passion'
تَفْصِيلَ: تَفْصِيل — tafṣīl, detailing, making clear (m., acc., object of astaṭīʿu, construct; verbal noun of form II faṣṣala); 'the detailing (of the summary)'
جْمَالِ: جْمَال — second half of the print's split word الْإِجْمَال: al-ijmāl, the summary, the general outline (m., gen., verbal noun of form IV ajmala, in idafa after tafṣīl); here the hint, what she only indicated
جَالِسَةً: جَالِسَة — jālisa, sitting (active participle of jalasa, f., acc., ḥāl); 'sitting'
مَسَحَتْ: مَسَحَ — masaḥa, to wipe (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at); 'she wiped'
وَقَلَعَتْنِي: وَ + قَلَعَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); qalaʿa, to take off, pull off (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (first object; takes two objects, 'she took off me the clothes'); 'and she took off my (clothes)'
