وَسَأَلَتْنِي: وَ + سَأَلَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; takes ʿan of the matter: 'asked me about'
غِيَابِي: غِيَاب + ي — ghiyāb, absence (m., gen., construct after sabab) + -ī, my; 'my absence'
وَأَخْبَرَتْنِي: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; akhbara takes bi- or anna for what is told; here 'told me that'
وَكُبَرَاءَ: وَ + كُبَرَاء — wa-, and (conj.); kubarāʾ, grandees, notables (broken pl. of kabīr, m., gen. diptote, in apposition to al-nās); 'and grandees'
بَيْتِنَا: بَيْت + نَا — bayt, house (m., gen., after fī) + -nā, our; 'our house'
وَاسْتَمَرُّوا: وَ + اِسْتَمَرَّ + وا — wa-, and (conj.); istamarra, to continue (verb X, perf. 3mp); 'and they stayed on'
حُضُورَكَ: حُضُور + كَ — ḥuḍūr, presence, arrival (m., acc., object of yantaẓirūna; verbal noun of ḥaḍara) + -ka, your; 'your coming'
يَئِسُوا: يَئِسَ — yaʾisa, to give up hope (verb I, perf. 3mp, -ū); with min: 'they gave up hope of'
حُضُورِكَ: حُضُور + ِكَ — ḥuḍūr, presence, arrival (m., gen., after min) + -ka, your; 'of your coming'
تَفَرَّقُوا: تَفَرَّقَ — tafarraqa, to disperse (verb V, perf. 3mp, -ū); 'they broke up'
وَذَهَبُوا: وَ + ذَهَبَ + وا — wa-, and (conj.); dhahaba, to go (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and went'
سَبِيلِهِمْ: سَبِيل + هِمْ — sabīl, way, road (m., gen., construct) + -him, their; ilā ḥāli sabīlihim 'each to his own way'
لَايَكْتُبُ: لَا + يَكْتُبُ — lā, not (negative particle) + kataba, to write (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative; the print runs lā and yaktubu together); 'he will not write'
كِتَابَنَا: كِتَاب + نَا — kitāb, (marriage) contract, writing (m., acc., object) + -nā, our; 'our contract'
الْقَابِلَةِ: الـ + قَابِلَة — qābila, coming, next (active participle of qabila, f., gen., adjective of sana); 'the coming (year)'
غَرِمَ: غَرِمَ — gharima, to pay out, be put to expense (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he has laid out'
تَأَخَّرْتَ: تَأَخَّرَ + تَ — taʾakhkhara, to be late, delayed (verb V, perf. 2ms); 'you were late'
غِيَابِكَ: غِيَاب + كَ — ghiyāb, absence (m., gen., after bi-sabab) + -ka, your; 'your absence'
لَاتَسْأَلِي: لَا + تَسْأَلِي — lā, do not (prohibitive particle) + saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 2fs, jussive, -ī; the print runs lā and tasʾalī together); takes ʿan: 'do not ask about'
بِالْخَبَرِ: بِـ + الـ + خَبَر — bi-, of (prep.; akhbara takes bi- of the thing told, 'inform of'); khabar, news, story (m., gen.); 'of the story'
وَالْمِنْدِيلَ: وَ + الـ + مِنْدِيل — wa-, and (conj.); mindīl, kerchief (m., acc., object); 'and the kerchief'
خُدُودِهَا: خُدُود + هَا — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd, m., gen., after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her cheeks'
اَوَّلُ: أَوَّل — awwal, first, beginning (m., nom., construct, subject); 'the beginning (of love)'
اخْتِيَارُ: اِخْتِيَار — ikhtiyār, choice (m., nom., predicate; verbal noun of form VIII ikhtāra); 'choice'
اضْطِرَارُ: اِضْطِرَار — iḍṭirār, compulsion, constraint (m., nom., predicate; verbal noun of form VIII iḍṭarra); 'compulsion'
الْاِضْطِرَارِ: الـ + اِضْطِرَار — iḍṭirār, compulsion (m., gen., after baʿda); 'after compulsion'
عَارُ: عَار — ʿār, shame, disgrace (m., nom., subject of laysa's clause); 'shame'
دَلَّتْ: دَلَّ — dalla, to indicate, bear witness (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at; agrees with plural non-human akhbār); with ʿalā: 'bear witness to'
صِحَّتِهِ: صِحَّة + هِ — ṣiḥḥa, soundness, truth (f., gen., after ʿalā) + -hi, its; 'its truth'
اَخْبَارُ: أَخْبَار — akhbār, reports, traditions (pl. of khabar, m., nom., subject)
زُيِّفَتْ: زُيِّفَتْ — zayyafa, to forge, counterfeit (verb II, passive perf. 3fs, zuyyifat); 'was forged' (mā, negative: 'never forged')
صَحِيْحِ: صَحِيح — ṣaḥīḥ, sound, genuine (adj., m., gen., after ʿalā); 'the genuine'
اَنْقَلِ: اَنْقَل — obscure word, probably corrupt in the print (likely for al-naqd, 'assay of coin', fitting zuyyifat 'forged' and ṣaḥīḥ 'sound'); meaning uncertain
تَشَأْ: شَاءَ — shāʾa, to wish, will (verb I, imperf. 2ms, tashaʾ, jussive after in); 'if you wish'
يَعْذُبُ: عَذُبَ — ʿadhuba, to be sweet (verb I, imperf. 3ms, yaʿdhubu); 'a sweet (torment)', playing on ʿadhāb, torment
ضَرَبَانٌ: ضَرَبَان — ḍarabān, throbbing, pulsing (m., nom., tanwīn; verbal noun of ḍaraba); 'a throbbing'
الْحَشَى: الـ + حَشَى — ḥashā, innards, the heart (m., gen., after fī; indeclinable noun in -ā); 'in the heart'
نِعْمَةٌ: نِعْمَة — niʿma, blessing, favour (f., nom., tanwīn); 'a blessing'
نِقْمَةٌ: نِقْمَة — niqma, punishment, vengeance (f., nom., tanwīn); 'a punishment'
اَرَبُ: أَرَب — arab, desire, craving (m., nom.); 'a craving'
تَأْنِسُ: أَنِسَ — anisa, to take delight, be at ease (verb I, imperf. 3fs, taʾnasu; subject al-nafs); with bi- 'delight in': 'delights in'
تَعْطِبُ: عَطِبَ — ʿaṭiba, to perish, be ruined (verb I, imperf. 3fs, taʿṭabu, here with kasra for rhyme/verse); 'is ruined by'
عَكْسِهِ: عَكْس + هِ — ʿaks, reversal, the reverse (m., gen., after bayna) + -hi, its; 'its reverse'
وَالطَّرْدِ: وَ + الـ + طَرْد — wa-, and (conj.); ṭard, driving forward, the straight order (m., gen.; contrasted with ʿaks); 'and the straight'
وَمَعْ: وَ + مَعَ — wa-, and (conj.) + maʿa, with (prep.; spelling مَعْ with sukūn); maʿ dhā 'for all that, and yet'
اَيَّامُهُ: أَيَّام + هُ — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm, m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its days'
مَوَاسِمْ: مَوَاسِم — mawāsim, festivals, seasons (pl. of mawsim, m., nom., predicate; final -m with sukūn for rhyme)
وَثَغْرُهَا: وَ + ثَغْر + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); thaghr, mouth, lips (m., nom.) + -hā, their/her; 'and their lips'
بَاسِمْ: بَاسِم — bāsim, smiling (active participle of basama, m., nom., predicate; sukūn for rhyme)
وَنَفَحَاتُ: وَ + نَفَحَات — wa-, and (conj.); nafaḥāt, wafts, breaths (f. sound pl. of nafḥa, nom., construct); 'and the wafts'
طِيْبِهَا: طِيب + هَا — ṭīb, perfume, fragrance (m., gen.) + -hā, their/her; 'their perfume'
يَشِينُ: شَانَ — shāna, to disgrace, disfigure (verb I, imperf. 3ms, yashīnu); 'all that disgraces'
حَاسِمْ: حَاسِم — ḥāsim, cutting off, decisive (active participle of ḥasama, m., nom., predicate; sukūn for rhyme); 'cutting away'
نَذْلٍ: نَذْل — nadhl, base, vile (adj., m., gen.; in idafa after qalb); 'base'
وَغْدِ: وَغْد — waghd, worthless, contemptible (adj., m., gen., coordinated with nadhl); 'and worthless'
نَطَقَتْ: نَطَقَ — naṭaqa, to speak (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at); naṭaqa bi- 'utter': 'she uttered (nothing)'
قَرَنَتْهَا: قَرَنَ + تْ + هَا — qarana, to join, couple (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it (the finger); takes bi- of the thing joined to: 'she joined it to'
بِالْإِصْبَعِ: بِـ + الـ + إِصْبَع — bi-, to (prep., with qarana 'join to'); iṣbaʿ, finger (gen.); 'to the finger'
وَجَعَلَتِ: وَ + جَعَلَ + تِ — wa-, and (conj.); jaʿala, to put, place (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at, with kasra before al-); 'and she placed'
الْإِصْبَعَيْنِ: الـ + إِصْبَع + َيْنِ — iṣbaʿ, finger (dual acc., object of jaʿalat); 'the two fingers'
وَأَغْلَقَتِ: وَ + أَغْلَقَ + تِ — wa-, and (conj.); aghlaqa, to shut, close (verb IV, perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'and she shut'
غِيَابِ: غِيَاب — ghiyāb, setting, absence (m., gen., construct); ghiyāb al-shams 'sunset'
تُعِينِينِي: تُعِينِينِي — aʿāna, to help (verb IV, imperf. 2fs, indicative, tuʿīn-īn) + -nī, me (nūn al-wiqāya + ī); takes ʿalā: 'that you help me with'
بُلِيتُ: بُلِيتُ — balā / ibtalā, to afflict (verb I passive, perf. 1s, buliytu); takes bi-: 'I have been afflicted with'
فَرَفَعَتْ: فَـ + رَفَعَ + تْ — fa-, and so (conj.); rafaʿa, to raise (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she raised'
لَاَخْرَجْتُهَا: لَـ + أَخْرَجَ + تُ + هَا — la-, emphatic particle opening the answer clause after law, 'I would surely'; akhraja, to take out (verb IV, perf. 1s) + -hā, it (my eye); 'I would pluck it out'
جُفُونِي: جُفُون + ي — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of jafn, m., gen., after min) + -ī, my; 'from my eyelids' Also nom., subject of asbalat: asbalat jufūnī, 'my eyelids shed'.
أُسَاعِدَكَ: سَاعَدَ + كَ — sāʿada, to help (verb III, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after an in lā budda an) + -ka, you; 'that I help you'
وَأُسَاعِدَهَا: وَ + سَاعَدَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); sāʿada, to help (verb III, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after an) + -hā, her; 'and help her'
مُغْرَمَةٌ: مُغْرَمَة — mughrama, passionately in love (passive participle of form IV, f., nom., predicate); takes bi-: 'in love with'
مُغْرَمٌ: مُغْرَم — mughram, passionately in love (passive participle of form IV, m., nom., predicate); takes bi-: 'in love with'
تَفْسِيرُ: تَفْسِير — tafsīr, interpretation, meaning (m., nom., verbal noun of form II fassara); 'the meaning'
وَضْعُ: وَضْع — waḍʿ, putting, placing (m., nom., construct; verbal noun of waḍaʿa); 'the putting'
إِصْبَعِهَا: إِصْبَع + هَا — iṣbaʿ, finger (gen., construct) + -hā, her; 'her finger'
إِشَارَةٌ: إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, indication (f., nom., predicate); ishāra ilā 'an indication of'; 'means'
رُوحِهَا: رُوح + هَا — rūḥ, soul (f./m., gen., construct) + -hā, her; 'her soul'
تَعَضُّ: عَضَّ — ʿaḍḍa, to bite (verb I, imperf. 3fs, taʿaḍḍu); with ʿalā 'bite on', figuratively 'hold fast to'
بِالنَّوَاجِذِ: بِـ + الـ + نَوَاجِذ — bi-, with (prep., instrument); nawājidh, molars (pl. of nājidh, gen.); 'with her teeth'
سَلَامِ: سَلَام — salām, greeting (m., gen., construct); 'a greeting (of)'
الْمُحِبِّينَ: الـ + مُحِبِّين — muḥibbīn, lovers (active participle of form IV aḥabba, m. pl., gen.); 'of the lovers'
الْمَحْبُوبِينَ: الـ + مَحْبُوبِين — maḥbūbīn, beloved ones (passive participle of ḥabba, m. pl., gen., after ʿalā); 'to the beloved'
الْوَرَقَةُ: الـ + وَرَقَة — waraqa, slip of paper (f., nom.); 'the slip of paper'
مُتَعَلِّقَةٌ: مُتَعَلِّقَة — mutaʿalliqa, attached, hanging (active participle of form V taʿallaqa, f., nom., predicate); takes bi-: 'attached to'
إِصْبَعَيْهَا: إِصْبَع + َيْ + هَا — iṣbaʿ, finger (dual gen., construct) + -hā, her; 'her two fingers'
فَتَفْسِيرُهُ: فَـ + تَفْسِير + هُ — fa-, introduces the predicate after ammā (conj.); tafsīr, meaning (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'its meaning is'
لِيَزُولَ: لِـ + يَزُولَ — li-, so that (particle of purpose, with subjunctive); zāla, to go away, cease (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive); 'so that it may go away'
بِطَلْعَتِكَ: بِـ + طَلْعَة + كَ — bi-, by (prep., means); ṭalʿa, sight, countenance (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by the sight of you'
أَنَّهَالَكَ: أَنَّ + هَا + لَـ + كَ — the print runs together annahā laka: anna, that (governs acc.) + -hā, she (its noun) + la-/li-, for, towards (prep.) + -ka, you; 'that she (is) for you', i.e. in love with you
التَّفْسِيرِ: الـ + تَفْسِير — tafsīr, interpretation (m., gen., after min); 'of interpretation'
لِإِشَارَاتِهَا: لِـ + إِشَارَات + هَا — li-, of, for (prep.; al-tafsīr li-, the interpretation of); ishārāt, signs (f. sound pl. of ishāra, gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her signs'
وَلَوْكُنْتُ: وَ + لَوْ + كُنْتُ — the print runs these together: wa-, and (conj.) + law, if (contrary-to-fact conditional) + kuntu, kāna, to be (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and if I were'
وَأَخْرُجُ: وَ + أَخْرُجُ — wa-, and (conj.); kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 1s, indicative); 'and go out'
لَجَمَعْتُ: لَـ + جَمَعَ + تُ — la-, answer particle after law, 'I would surely'; jamaʿa, to bring together (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I would bring together'
أَسْرَعِ: أَسْرَع — asraʿ, quickest (elative of sarīʿ, m., gen. diptote, construct before waqt); fī asraʿi waqtin 'in no time'
وَأَسْتُرُكُمَا: وَ + أَسْتُرُ + كُمَا — wa-, and (conj.); satara, to cover, screen (verb I, imperf. 1s, indicative) + -kumā, you two (dual object); 'and cover you both'
بِذَيْلِي: بِـ + ذَيْل + ي — bi-, with (prep., instrument); dhayl, hem, skirt (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with the hem of my skirt'
أَشْرَبُ: شَرِبَ — shariba, to drink (verb I, imperf. 1s, indicative, ashrabu); 'nor drinking'
تُسَلِّينِي: سَلَّى + نِي — sallā, to console, comfort (verb II, imperf. 3fs, tusallī) + -nī, me; 'she comforted me'
قَوِّ: قَوَّى — qawwā, to strengthen (verb II, imperative 2ms, qawwi); 'strengthen!'
وَهِمَّتَكَ: وَ + هِمَّة + كَ — wa-, and (conj.); himma, resolve, determination (f., acc., object of qawwi) + -ka, your; 'and your resolve'
وَخَاطِرَكَ: وَ + خَاطِر + كَ — wa-, and (conj.); khāṭir, mind, heart (m., acc., object; ṭayyib khāṭiraka 'cheer your heart') + -ka, your; 'and your heart'
انْقَضَى: inqaḍā — to pass, be over (VII, perf. 3ms); 'was over, had passed'
الْيَوْمَانِ: al- + yawm + -āni — al-, the (def. art.) + yawm, day (m.) + -āni, dual nom.; 'the two days'
الْمِيعَادِ: al- + mīʿād — al-, the + mīʿād, appointed time, rendezvous (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the appointed time'
وَبَخَّرَتْنِي: وَ + بَخَّرَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and + bakhkhara, to perfume with incense (II, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'and she censed me'
شَدَدْتُ: shadadtu — I tightened, braced (I, perf. 1s of shadda); 'I braced'
وَقَوَّيْتُ: وَ + قَوَّيْتُ — wa-, and + qawwaytu, I strengthened, steadied (II, perf. 1s); 'and I steadied (my heart)'
الزُّقَاقَ: al- + zuqāq — al-, the + zuqāq, lane, alley (m., acc. as object of dakhaltu); 'the lane'
الْمِصْطَبَةِ: al- + miṣṭaba — al-, the + miṣṭaba, raised stone bench against a wall (f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the stone bench'
بِالطَّاقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + طَّاقَة — bi-, marking what appears after idhā of surprise (not 'with') + al-, the + ṭāqa, little window, niche (f.); 'and behold, the window'
انْفَتَحَتْ: infataḥat — to open, be opened (VII, perf. 3fs); 'opened'
مِرْآةً: mirʾāt — mirror (f., acc. indef.; the print writes the alif with madda); 'a mirror'
وَمِنْدِيلًا: وَ + مِنْدِيل + ًا — wa-, and + mindīl, kerchief, napkin (m., acc. indef.); 'and a kerchief'
سَاعِدَيْهَا: sāʿid + -ayhā — sāʿid, forearm (m., dual gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her; 'her forearms'
أَصَابِعَهَا: aṣābiʿ + -a + -hā — aṣābiʿ, fingers (pl. of iṣbaʿ, acc., object of fataḥat) + -hā, her; 'her fingers'
الْخَمْسَ: al- + khams + -a — al-, the (article on the numeral, spoken usage) + khams, five (the form without -a, used with a feminine counted noun; acc.); 'the five (fingers)'
بِالْكَفِّ: بِـ + الـ + كَفّ — bi-, with (instrument) + al-, the + kaff, palm of the hand (f., gen.); 'with the palm'
وَالْخَمْسِ: وَ + الـ + خَمْس — wa-, and + al-khams, the five (article on the numeral, spoken usage; gen. after bi- carried on from bi-al-kaff); 'and the five (fingers)'
وَأَبْرَزَتِ: وَ + أَبْرَزَتِ — wa-, and + abrazat, to bring out, show (IV, perf. 3fs; the kasra is the linking vowel before al-); 'and she held out'
الْمِرْآةَ: al- + mirʾāt + -a — al-, the + mirʾāt, mirror (f., acc., object of abrazat); 'the mirror'
وَاَدْلَتْهُ: وَ + اَدْلَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + adlat, adlā, to let down, lower (IV, perf. 3fs; the print points its first letters, with no hamza) + -hu, it; 'and she let it down'
تُدَلِّيهِ: تُدَلِّي + هِ — tudallī, dallā, to let down, lower (II, imperf. 3fs) + -hi, it; 'lowering it'
وَتَرْفَعُهُ: وَ + تَرْفَعُ + هُ — wa-, and + tarfaʿu, to raise (I, imperf. 3fs, indicative) + -hu, it; 'and drawing it up'
عَصَرَتْهُ: ʿaṣarat + -hu — ʿaṣara, to wring, squeeze (I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (the kerchief); 'she wrung it'
جَذَبَتْهَا: jadhabat + -hā — jadhaba, to pull, draw (I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, her/it (fem. object, probably her hand; see note); 'she drew it back'
تُكَلِّمْنِي: tukallim + -nī — kallama, to speak to (II, imperf. 3fs, jussive after lam) + -nī, me; 'she spoke to me'
تَرَكَتْنِي: taraka + -t + -nī — taraka, to leave (I, perf.) + -t, she + -nī, me; 'she left me'
حَيْرَانًا: ḥayrān + -an — ḥayrān, bewildered (adj.; acc. as ḥāl); the print gives a full -an ending where Classical has ḥayrāna (diptote); 'bewildered'
وَاسْتَمَرَّيْتُ: وَ + اسْتَمَرَّيْتُ — wa-, and + istamarraytu, I continued (X, perf. 1s; Middle Arabic form as if from a weak root, Classical istamrartu); 'and I stayed on'
قُرْبَ: qurb — nearness; used as a preposition, 'near, towards' (m., acc. as adverb of time, first term of iḍāfa with niṣf al-layl); 'towards (midnight)'
وَاضِعَةً: wāḍiʿa + -tan — wāḍiʿa, placing, putting (active part. I f., acc. indef. as ḥāl; governs yadahā); 'with (her hand) laid'
وَأَجْفَانُهَا: وَ + أَجْفَان + ُ + هَا — wa-, and (of circumstance) + ajfān, eyelids, eyes (pl. of jafn, nom. subject) + -hā, her; 'and her eyes'
تَسْكُبُ: taskubu — to pour, shed (I, imperf. 3fs, indicative; feminine singular agreement with the broken plural ajfān); 'pouring out (tears)' Also with ʿaynī, 'my eye', as subject: ʿaynī taskubu, 'my eye pours'.
وَلِلَّاحِيْ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + لَّاحِي — wa-, and + li-, for, concerning (the li- of mā lī wa-li-: 'what do I have to do with') + al-lāḥī, the critic, the one who blames (active part. I of laḥā, to blame; gen.); 'and with the critic'
وَانْتَ: وَ + انْتَ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'when') + anta, you (2ms pron.; printed without hamza); 'when you are'
اَهْيَفُ: ahyaf — slender-waisted, lissom (adj. of the afʿal pattern, m. nom., diptote); 'slender'
طَلْعَةً: ṭalʿa + -tan — ṭalʿa, face, countenance (f., acc. indef. after yā, in vocative); 'O face'
سَلَبَتْ: salabat — to rob, take away (I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ṭalʿa); 'stole'
فُؤَادِيْ: fuʾād + ī — fuʾād, heart (m., acc.; printed with ؤ) + -ī, my (1s poss.); 'my heart'
وَانْثَنَتْ: وَ + انْثَنَتْ — wa-, and + inthanat, to turn away, bend (VII, perf. 3fs); 'and turned away'
لِلْهَوَى: لِـ + الـ + هَوَى — li-, for, belonging to (the li- of 'what does it have': mā li- = 'no ... has') + al-hawā, love, passion (m., gen.); 'for love' Also li- of the goal after daʿā: daʿānī li-al-hawā, 'called me to love'.
الْعُذْرِيِّ: al- + ʿudhrī + -i — al-, the + ʿudhrī, of the tribe of ʿUdhra, chaste (nisba adj., m. gen., agreeing with al-hawā); 'the ʿUdhrī (love)'
مَصْرِفُ: maṣrif — turning away, escape, a way to turn (m., nom. indef., place noun from ṣarafa; subject of mā li-); 'a way to turn'
تُرْكِيَّةُ: turkiyya + -tu — Turkish (nisba adj. f., nom., first term of iḍāfa with al-alḥāẓ); 'Turkish (of glances)'
الْاَلْحَاظِ: الـ + اَلْحَاظ — al-, the + alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ, gen. as second term of iḍāfa; the print points the alif with a fatḥa and no hamza); 'the glances'
بِالْحَشَى: بِـ + الـ + حَشَى — bi-, to, upon (bi- after faʿala 'do (something) to') + al-ḥashā, the innards, the heart (m., gen., shortened -ā form); 'to the heart'
الصَّقِيلُ: al- + ṣaqīl — al-, the + ṣaqīl, polished, burnished (adj., m. nom.; here the polished blade); 'the polished (sword)'
الْمُرْهَفُ: al- + murhaf — al-, the + murhaf, keen, finely sharpened (pass. part. of IV arhafa; adj. m. nom.); 'the keen-edged'
حَمَّلْتِنِي: ḥammaltinī — ḥammala, to burden, load (II, perf. 2fs as printed, with -tī + -nī me; the poem addresses a man, but the print points it as addressed to a woman); 'you have loaded me'
جَلَدٌ: jalad — endurance, strength to bear (m., nom. indef., subject of laysa lī); 'strength'
وَاَضْعَفُ: وَ + اَضْعَفُ — wa-, and + aḍʿaf, weaker (elative of ḍaʿīf, m. nom. indef., diptote); 'and (I am) weaker'
عَوَاذِلِي: ʿawādhil + ī — ʿawādhil, blamers, critics (pl. of ʿādhil/ʿādhila, gen. after qawl) + -ī, my; 'my critics'
تَهْوَى: tahwā — hawiya, to love (I, imperf. 2ms, in the relative clause man tahwā, 'the one you love'); 'you love'
يَرُوعُكَ: yarūʿu + -ka — rāʿa, to alarm, frighten (I hollow, imperf. 3ms, indicative) + -ka, you; 'frightens you'
مُرْهَفُ: murhaf — keen, sharpened, a blade (adj. as noun, m. nom. indef., pass. part. IV); 'a sharp blade'
كَخَصْرِكَ: كَـ + خَصْر + كَ — ka-, like (prep.) + khaṣr, waist (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'like your waist'
بِالنَّحَافَةِ: بِـ + الـ + نَّحَافَة — bi-, in, in respect of (bi- of specification) + al-naḥāfa, slimness, thinness (f., gen.); 'in thinness'
مُتْلَفُ: mutlaf — ruined, wasted away (pass. part. IV atlafa, adj. m. nom. indef., predicate of jismī); 'wasted away'
اَمِيْرِىْ: amīr + ī — amīr, prince, commander (m., voc. with pronoun) + -ī, my (printed with ىْ); 'my prince'
وَحَاجِبٌ: وَ + حَاجِب — wa-, and + ḥājib, eyebrow; also chamberlain (m., nom. indef.); 'and a brow (and chamberlain)'
يَنْصِفُ: yanṣifu — to deal justly (I, imperf. 3ms; the print points yanṣifu where Classical has yunṣifu from IV anṣafa); 'gives justice'
يُوسُفٍ: yūsuf + in — Yūsuf, Joseph (proper name, gen. after fī; the print gives it a full tanwīn although diptote, which the metre requires); 'in Joseph'; here: gen., second term of a construct: ṣūratu Yūsufin, 'the beauty of Joseph'
جَمَالِكَ: jamāl + -i + -ka — jamāl, beauty (m., gen. after fī) + -ka, your; 'your beauty'
اَتَكَلَّفُ: atakallafu — takallafa, to force oneself to, take on with effort (V, imperf. 1s; the a- is the prefix of 'I'); 'I force myself'
الْاِعْرَاضَ: al- + iʿrāḍ + a — al-, the + iʿrāḍ, turning away, avoidance (IV verbal noun, m., acc., object of atakallafu); 'the turning away'
اَعْيُنِ: aʿyun — eyes (pl. of ʿayn, f., gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa; printed with alif); 'eyes'
الرُّقَبَاءِ: al- + ruqabāʾ — al-, the + ruqabāʾ, watchers, spies (pl. of raqīb, gen. as second term of iḍāfa); 'the watchers'
شِعْرَهَا: shiʿr + a + hā — shiʿr, poetry, a poem (m., acc., object of samiʿtu) + -hā, her; 'her poem'
وَتَكَاثَرَتْ: وَ + تَكَاثَرَتْ — wa-, and + takāthara, to multiply, grow numerous (VI, perf. 3fs); 'and crowded in'
الْغُمُومُ: al- + ghumūm — al-, the + ghumūm, griefs, sorrows (pl. of ghamm, m., nom., subject; verb agrees as fem. sing. with a broken plural); 'the griefs'
بِكُمِّهَا: بِـ + كُمّ + هَا — bi-, with (instrument) + kumm, sleeve (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her sleeve'
يَابْنَ: yā + bna — yā, O (vocative particle) + ibna, son of (m., acc.; the alif of ibn drops after yā); 'O son of (my uncle), cousin'
إِشَارَتُهَا: ishāra + tu + hā — ishāra, sign, gesture (f., nom., topic after ammā) + -hā, her; 'her sign'
وَالْخَمْسَةِ: وَ + الـ + خَمْسَة — wa-, and + al-khamsa, the five (numeral with article, and in its -a form beside feminine aṣābiʿ: both spoken usage; gen. after bi- carried on); 'and the five'
تَفْسِيرَهُ: tafsīr + a + hu — tafsīr, interpretation, meaning (m., acc. after inna) + -hu, its; 'its meaning'
بِالْمِرْآةِ: بِـ + الـ + مِرْآة — bi-, with (instrument: by means of the mirror) + al-mirʾāt, the mirror (f., gen.); 'with the mirror'
وَإِدْلَاءِ: وَ + إِدْلَاء — wa-, and + idlāʾ, letting down, lowering (IV verbal noun, m., gen., coordinated with al-mirʾāti after bi-, 'with'; first term of iḍāfa with al-mindīl); 'and the letting down'
وَرَفْعِهِ: وَ + رَفْع + هِ — wa-, and + rafʿ, raising (verbal noun, m., gen.) + -hi, it; 'and its raising'
وَإِبْرَازِ: وَ + إِبْرَاز — wa-, and + ibrāz, putting out, showing (IV verbal noun, m., gen.); 'and the putting out'
الصَّبَّاغِ: al- + ṣabbāgh — al-, the + ṣabbāgh, dyer (m., gen. as second term of iḍāfa after dukkān); 'the dyer'
رَسُولِي: rasūl + ī — rasūl, messenger (m., nom., subject of yaʾtiyaka) + -ī, my; 'my messenger'
اشْتَعَلَتِ: ishtaʿalat — to blaze up, catch fire (VIII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with al-nār); 'blazed up'
تَصْدُقِينَنِي: taṣduqīna + nī — ṣadaqa, to tell the truth to (I, imperf. 2fs, indicative; takes the person told as direct object) + -nī, me; 'you tell me the truth'
صَبَّاغًا: ṣabbāgh + an — ṣabbāgh, dyer (m., acc. indef., object of raʾaytu); 'a dyer'
يَهُودِيًّا: yahūdī + yy + an — yahūdī, Jewish (nisba adj., m., acc. indef.; agrees with ṣabbāghan); 'Jewish'
وَثَبِّتْ: وَ + ثَبِّتْ — wa-, and + thabbit, make firm, steady (II, imperative 2ms; the print marks the shadda); 'and steady'
بِالْعِشْقِ: بِـ + الـ + عِشْق — bi-, with (after ishtaghala, 'be busy with'; the verb takes bi-) + al-ʿishq, love, passion (m., gen.); 'with love'
وَيَتَجَلَّدُ: وَ + يَتَجَلَّدُ — wa-, and + yatajalladu, to bear bravely, show fortitude (V, imperf. 3ms, indicative); 'and bears bravely'
حَرِّ: ḥarr — heat (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa with al-gharām, after ʿalā in yatajalladu ʿalā 'endure'); 'the heat (of passion)'
آكُلَهَا: آكُلَ + هَا — ākula, I eat (akala, I, imperf. 1s subjunctive after an; the print writes the alif with madda) + -hā, it; 'to eat it'
قَدَرْتُ: qadartu — qadara ʿalā, to be able, manage (I, perf. 1s); 'I was able'
وَهَجَرْتُ: وَ + هَجَرْتُ — wa-, and + hajartu, I abandoned, forsook (I, perf. 1s); 'and I forsook'
مَحَاسِنِي: maḥāsin + ī — maḥāsin, good features, beauties (pl. of ḥusn, used of a person's looks; nom.) + -ī, my; 'my good looks'
عَشِقْتُ: ʿashiqtu — I fell in love (I, perf. 1s; ʿashiqa, to love passionately); 'I was in love'
حَرَارَةَ: ḥarāra + ta — ḥarāra, heat (f., acc., object of dhuqtu); 'the heat'
فَضَعُفْتُ: فَـ + ضَعُفْتُ — fa-, so, and so + ḍaʿuftu, I grew weak (I, perf. 1s); 'so I grew weak'
وَالْمُحِبِّينَ: وَ + الـ + مُحِبِّين — wa-, and + al-muḥibbūn, the lovers, those who love (active part. IV of aḥabba, m. pl. gen., coordinated with al-ʿushshāq); 'and the lovers'
التَّسَلِّي: al- + tasallī — al-, the + tasallī, consolation, comforting oneself (V verbal noun, m., gen. after ʿalā sabīli, 'by way of'); 'the comforting'
أَسْتَيْقِظُ: astayqiẓu — istayqaẓa, to wake up (X, imperf. 1s); 'I would wake'
فَأَجِدُهَا: فَـ + أَجِدُ + هَا — fa-, and then + ajidu, I find (I, imperf. 1s, indicative) + -hā, her; 'and I would find her'
سَهْرَانَةً: sahrān + a + tan — sahrān, wakeful, sleepless (adj.; here the Middle Arabic fem. sahrānatan, acc. indef. as ḥāl; Classical sahrā); 'wakeful'
وَدَمْعُهَا: وَ + دَمْع + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + damʿ, tears (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her tears'
الْخَمْسَةُ: al- + khamsa + tu — al-, the (article on the numeral, spoken usage) + khamsa, five (the form with -a, used with a masculine counted noun such as ayyām; nom.); 'the five (days)'
وَحَمَّتْنِي: وَ + حَمَّتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥammat, she bathed (a Middle Arabic contracted form of ḥammamat, II) + -nī, me; 'and she bathed me'
وَأَلْبَسَتْنِي: وَ + أَلْبَسَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + albasat, to dress (IV, perf. 3fs, taking two objects) + -nī, me; 'and she dressed me (in)'
قَضَي: qaḍā — to fulfil (I, perf. 3ms, used as a wish 'may He fulfil'; the print spells it with a dotted yā, as Middle Arabic does); 'may (God) fulfil'
مَقْصُودَكَ: maqṣūd + a + ka — maqṣūd, aim, what is wished for (pass. part. of qaṣada, m., acc., object of ballagha) + -ka, your; 'what you long for'
مَحْبُوبَتِكَ: maḥbūba + ti + ka — maḥbūba, beloved (f., gen. after min, pass. part. of aḥabba) + -ka, your; 'your beloved'; also (Night 202): maḥbūba + ti + ka — maḥbūba, beloved (f., pass. part. of aḥabba; gen. in apposition to Budūr) + -ka, your; 'your beloved'
السَّبْتِ: al- + sabt — al-, the + sabt, Saturday, the Sabbath (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after yawm); 'Saturday'
وَاصْفَرَّتِ: وَ + اصْفَرَّتِ — wa-, and + iṣfarrat, to turn yellow (IX, perf. 3fs; the kasra links to al-shams); 'and turned yellow'
وَأَذَّنَ: وَ + أَذَّنَ — wa-, and + adhdhana, to call to prayer (II, perf. 3ms); 'and the call was made'
عَمِّى: ʿamm + ī — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + -ī, my (written with an undotted final yā); ibnat ʿammī, 'my cousin'
وَإِحْدَى: وَ + إِحْدَى — wa-, and (circumstantial) + iḥdā, one (f. of aḥad, nom., first term of iḍāfa with yadayhā); 'and one (of her hands)'
قَابِضَةٌ: qābiḍa — gripping, holding (active part. I f., nom. indef., predicate of iḥdā yadayhā; qabaḍa ʿalā, 'take hold of'); 'gripping'
وَتَدٍ: watad + in — watad, peg, tent-peg (m., gen. indef., after ʿalā); 'a peg'
مَدْقُوقٍ: madqūq + in — madqūq, driven in, hammered (pass. part. I of daqqa, m., gen. indef., agreeing with watad); 'driven in'
وَيَدُهَا: وَ + يَد + هَا — wa-, and + yad, hand (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her hand'
تُصَعِّدُ: tuṣaʿʿidu — to send up, make rise (II, imperf. 3fs, indicative); 'sending up (sighs)'
وَتُنْشِدُ: وَ + تُنْشِدُ — wa-, and + tunshidu, to recite (poetry) (IV, imperf. 3fs, indicative); 'and reciting'
وَجْدُ: wajd — longing, passionate love (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa; subject of mā ... bi-aʿẓama); 'the longing of'
اَعْرَابِيَّةٍ: aʿrābiyya + tin — aʿrābiyya, a Bedouin woman (nisba fem., gen. as second term of iḍāfa; printed with alif); 'a Bedouin girl'
اَهْلُهَا: ahl + u + hā — ahl, people, family (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her people'
فَحَنَّتْ: فَـ + حَنَّتْ — fa-, and so + ḥannat, to long, yearn for (I, perf. 3fs; ḥanna ilā 'yearn for'); 'and she pined'
بَانِ: bān + i — bān, the ben-tree, moringa (m., gen. as first term of iḍāfa; printed bāni as in the verse); 'the ben-tree'
وَرَنْدِهِ: وَ + رَنْد + هِ — wa-, and + rand, rand, a fragrant desert shrub (m., gen.) + -hi, its; 'and its rand'
اٰنَسَتْ: ānasat — ānasa, to catch sight of, glimpse (IV, perf. 3fs; the print marks the long ā with a small upright alif); 'she glimpses'
تَكَفَّلَ: takaffala — to undertake, take charge of (V, perf. 3ms, takes bi-: takaffala bi- 'take responsibility for'); 'undertook'
شَوْقُهَا: shawq + u + hā — shawq, longing (m., nom., subject of takaffala) + -hā, her; 'her longing'
قِرَاهُ: qirā + hu — qirā, hospitality, the meal given to a guest (m., gen., from qarā) + -hu, his; 'its (the traveller's) welcome'
وَالدُّمُوعِ: وَ + الـ + دُّمُوع — wa-, and + al-dumūʿ, the tears (pl. of damʿ, gen. after bi- carried on from bi-nāri); 'and the tears'
بِوِرْدِهِ: بِـ + وِرْد + هِ — bi-, for (bi- after takaffala, 'take charge of') + wird, watering place, water drawn (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his water'
بِاَعْظَمَ: بِـ + اَعْظَم — bi-, the bi- that follows a negative mā, adding emphasis only (here predicate of wa-mā wajdu) + aʿẓam, greater (elative, gen. but diptote); 'greater'
وَجْدِىْ: wajd + ī — wajd, longing, passion (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my (printed with ىْ); 'my longing'
بِحِبِّي: بِـ + حِبّ + ي — bi-, for (bi- after wajd, 'longing for') + ḥibb, beloved (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my beloved'
اَذْنَبْتُ: adhnabtu — I sinned, committed a fault (IV, perf. 1s); 'I have sinned'
بِوُدِّهِ: بِـ + وُدّ + هِ — bi-, by, because of (bi- of cause) + wudd, love, affection (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'by loving him'
فَرَأَتْنِى: فَـ + رَأَتْ + نِي — fa-, and so + raʾat, to see (I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'and saw me'
فَمَسَحَتْ: فَـ + مَسَحَتْ — fa-, and so + masaḥat, to wipe (I, perf. 3fs); 'and wiped'
وَدُمُوعِي: وَ + دُمُوع + ي — wa-, and + dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, acc., coordinated with dumūʿahā) + -ī, my; 'and my tears'
هَنَّاكَ: hannāka — hannaʾa, to wish well, bless (II, perf. 3ms with -ka; the spoken form of hannaʾaka, hamza dropped; the print marks its shadda); 'may (God) bless you'
أَعْطَاكَ: aʿṭā + ka — aʿṭā, to give (IV, perf. 3ms, here with relative mā) + -ka, you; 'has given you'
فَلِأَيِّ: فَـ + لِـ + أَيّ — fa-, and so + li-, for, because of (li- of reason) + ayyi, which (interrog. in iḍāfa, gen.); 'so for which (thing), why'
تَبِتِ: tabit — to spend the night (I hollow, jussive 2ms after lam, with a linking kasra before al-laylata; from bāta, 'to pass the night'); 'you did not spend the night'
تَقْضِ: taqḍi — to fulfil, carry out (I, jussive 2ms after lam, shortened from taqḍī; qaḍā arabahu, 'fulfil one's desire'); 'you did not fulfil'
رَفَصْتُهَا: rafaṣtu + hā — rafaṣa, to kick (I, perf. 1s; a Middle Arabic form of rafasa) + -hā, her; 'I kicked her'
فَانْقَلَبَتْ: فَـ + انْقَلَبَتْ — fa-, and so + inqalabat, to be overturned, fall back (VII, perf. 3fs); 'and she fell back'
جَبْهَتُهَا: jabha + tu + hā — jabha, forehead (f., nom., subject of jāʾat) + -hā, her; 'her forehead'
وَتَدٌ: watad — peg, tent-peg (m., nom. indef., subject of kāna hunāka 'there was'); 'a peg'
جَبْهَتِهَا: jabha + ti + hā — jabha, forehead (f., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her forehead'
فَتَأَمَّلْتُهَا: فَـ + تَأَمَّلْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so + taʾammaltu, I looked at closely (V, perf. 1s) + -hā, her; 'so I looked at her closely'
الْخَامِسَةَ: الـ + خَامِسَة — al-, the + khāmisa, fifth (f.), compound number, fixed in -a (indeclinable), agreeing with al-layla; 'the fifteenth' (with ʿashara, as printed)
رَفَصْتُ: رَفَصْتُ — rafaṣa, kick (perf. 1 sg.; ṣ for s in the edition's spelling of rafasa); 'I kicked'
انْقَلَبَتْ: اِنْقَلَبَتْ — inqalaba, turn over, fall back (VII, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'she fell back' ; also: to be transformed, change shape: inqalabat Maymūnatu, 'Maymūna changed her shape'
الْوَتَدُ: الْوَتَدُ — al-watad, the peg, tent-peg (m., nom. sg., subject of jāʾa); 'the peg'
جَبِينُهَا: جَبِينُ + هَا — jabīn, brow, forehead (m., nom., subject of infataḥa) + -hā, her (possessive); 'her brow'
تَنْطِقْ: تَنْطِقْ — naṭaqa, speak, utter (imperf. 3 f. sg., jussive after lam); 'she did not speak'
بِحَرْفٍ: بِـ + حَرْفٍ — bi-, with (marks what is uttered after nataqa) + ḥarf, letter, word (m. gen. indef.); 'a single word'
وَأَحْرَقَتْ: وَـ + أَحْرَقَتْ — wa-, and + aḥraqa, burn (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she burned'
حُرَاقًا: حُرَاقًا — ḥurāq, tinder (rag or fungus burned for stopping blood) (m., acc. indef., object); 'some tinder'
وَحَشَتْ: وَـ + حَشَتْ — wa-, and + ḥashā, stuff, pack (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and packed'
الْجُرْحَ: الـ + جُرْحَ — al-jurḥ, the wound (m., acc., object of ḥashat); 'the wound'
وَتَعَصَّبَتْ: وَـ + تَعَصَّبَتْ — wa-, and + taʿaṣṣaba, bind the head (V, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and bound her head'
بِعِصَابَةٍ: بِـ + عِصَابَةٍ — bi-, with (what the head is bound with) + ʿiṣāba, bandage, headband (f., gen. indef.); 'with a bandage'
وَمَسَحَتِ: وَـ + مَسَحَتِ — wa-, and + masaḥa, wipe (perf. 3 f. sg., vowelled -ti before al-); 'and wiped up'
بِلِينِ: بِـ + لِينِ — bi-, with (of manner) + līn, gentleness, softness (m., gen. sg., in construct with al-kalām); 'gently'
وَلَابِهَا: وَ + لَا + بِـ + هَا — wa-, and + lā, not + bi-, of (istihzāʾ takes bi- for the one mocked: 'mockery of her') + -hā, her; run together in print; 'or her'
مَشْغُولَةً: مَشْغُولَةً — mashghūl, occupied, preoccupied (pass. part. f. sg., acc. as predicate of kuntu); 'occupied'
بِوَجَعِ: بِـ + وَجَعِ — bi-, with (the adjective mashghūla takes bi- for what occupies one) + wajaʿ, ache, pain (m., gen. in construct); 'with the aching (of my head)'
خَفَّتْ: خَفَّتْ — khaffa, be light, grow light (perf. 3 f. sg.; raʾs treated as feminine); 'has grown light'
وَخَفَّتْ: وَـ + خَفَّتْ — wa-, and + khaffa, be light (perf. 3 f. sg., agreeing with jabhatī); 'and ... has grown light'
جَبْهَتِي: جَبْهَة + ـِي — jabha, forehead (f., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'my forehead'
بِنَجَاحِ: بِـ + نَجَاحِ — bi-, with (abshir takes bi- for the good news) + najāḥ, success (m., gen. in construct); 'at the success'
قَصْدِكَ: قَصْد + كَ — qaṣd, aim, purpose (m., gen. in construct) + -ka, your; 'of what you seek'
وَبُلُوغِ: وَـ + بُلُوغِ — wa-, and + bulūgh, reaching, attainment (verbal noun of balagha, m., gen., joined to najāḥ); 'and the attainment'
أَمَلِكَ: أَمَل + كَ — amal, hope (m., gen. in construct) + -ka, your; 'of what you hope for'
الْقَبُولِ: الـ + قَبُولِ — al-, the + qabūl, acceptance (m., gen. in construct with ʿalāmatu); 'of acceptance'
تَخْتَبِرَكَ: تَخْتَبِرَ + كَ — ikhtabara, test (VIII, imperf. 3 f. sg. subjunctive after an) + -ka, you (object); 'to test you'
أَفْرَاحُكَ: أَفْرَاح + كَ — afrāḥ, joys (pl. of faraḥ, m., nom., subject of qarubat) + -ka, your; 'your joys'
وَزَالَتْ: وَـ + زَالَتْ — wa-, and + zāla, cease, pass away (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and ... are over'
أَحْزَانُكَ: أَحْزَان + كَ — aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn, m., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'your sorrows'
مُتَزَايِدَ: مُتَزَايِدَ — mutazāyid, increasing (VI act. part. m. sg., acc. as predicate of lam azal; takes the genitive of what increases); 'only grew'
وَالْغُمُومِ: وَـ + الـ + غُمُومِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ghumūm, griefs, sorrows (pl. of ghamm, gen., joined to al-humūm in the rhyming pair); 'and sorrows'
فَرَفَصْتُهُ: فَـ + رَفَصْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so (then) + rafaṣa, kick (perf. 1 sg.; ṣ for s) + -hu, it (the food); 'and I kicked it away'
زُبْدِيَّةٍ: زُبْدِيَّة — zubdiyya, glazed earthenware bowl (f., gen. indef. in kullu zubdiyyatin); 'bowl' (every bowl)
يَلْتَذُّ: يَلْتَذُّ — iltadhdha, take pleasure in (VIII, imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'has pleasure'
بِمَنَامٍ: بِـ + مَنَامٍ — bi-, in (yaltadhdhu takes bi- for what one enjoys) + manām, sleep (m., gen. indef.); 'in sleep'
وَلَمَّتْ: وَـ + لَمَّتْ — wa-, and + lamma, gather up (I, doubled, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she gathered up'
شَقَافَةَ: شَقَافَة — shaqāfa, shard, broken piece of pottery (f., acc., colloquial; in construct with al-zabādī); 'the broken pieces'
الزَّبَادِي: الـ + زَّبَادِي — al-, the + zabādī, bowls (pl. of zubdiyya, gen.); 'of the bowls'
تُسَامِرُنِي: تُسَامِرُ + نِي — sāmara, talk with at night (III, imperf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'sat talking with me through the night'
أَدْعُواللَّهَ: أَدْعُو + اللَّه — adʿū, I pray (daʿā, imperf. 1 sg. indic.) + allāh, God (acc., object); run together in print; 'I prayed God'
يُصْبِحَ: يُصْبِحَ — aṣbaḥa, be in the morning, come to morning (IV, imperf. 3 m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'to come'
الْمَسْطَبَةِ: الـ + مَسْطَبَة — al-, the + masṭaba, stone bench (f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the bench'
وَأَبْرَزَتْ: وَـ + أَبْرَزَتْ — wa-, and + abraza, put out, bring forth (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she put out'
وَقَصْرِيَّةٌ: وَـ + قَصْرِيَّةٌ — wa-, and + qaṣriyya, earthenware pot (f., nom. indef., subject of maʿahā); 'and a pot'
مُمْتَلِئَةٌ: مُمْتَلِئَةٌ — mumtaliʾ, full (VIII act. part. f. sg., nom., adjective of qaṣriyya); 'full'
بِزَرْعٍ: بِـ + زَرْعٍ — bi-, with (mumtaliʾa takes bi- for what fills it) + zarʿ, seedlings, young crop (m., gen. indef.); 'of green seedlings'
وَأَدْخَلَتْهَا: وَـ + أَدْخَلَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + adkhala, put in (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, it (the mirror); 'and put it in'
رَبَطَتْهُ: رَبَطَتْ + هُ — rabaṭa, tie (perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it (the bag); 'she tied it'
وَضَعَتِ: وَضَعَتِ — waḍaʿa, put, hold (perf. 3 f. sg., vowelled -ti before al-); 'she held'
الْقِنْدِيلَ: الـ + قِنْدِيل — al-, the + qindīl, lamp (m., acc., object); 'the lamp'
فَانْفَطَرَ: فَـ + انْفَطَرَ — fa-, and so (result) + infaṭara, break, be split (VII, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and ... broke'
إِشَارَاتِهَا: إِشَارَات + هَا — ishārāt, signs, gestures (pl. of ishāra, f., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her signs'
الْخَفِيَّةِ: الـ + خَفِيَّةِ — al-, the + khafiyy, hidden, secret (adj. f. sg., gen., rhyming with makhfiyya); 'secret'
وَرُمُوزِهَا: وَـ + رُمُوز + هَا — wa-, and + rumūz, riddles, hints (pl. of ramz, m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her riddles'
الْمَخْفِيَّةِ: الـ + مَخْفِيَّةِ — al-, the + makhfiyy, concealed (pass. part. adj. f. sg., gen.); 'hidden'
وَهُيَامِى: وَـ + هُيَام + ِي — wa-, and + huyām, longing, wandering madness (m., nom. as subject of zāda) + -ī, my (final -ى for -ي); 'and my madness'
عَقِبِي: عَقِب + ِي — ʿaqib, heel (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ī, my; ʿalā ʿaqibī, back on my heels, 'I turned back'
قَاعِدَةً: قَاعِدَةً — qāʿid, sitting (act. part. f. sg., acc., ḥāl after raʾaytu); 'sitting'
وَالْغَيْرَةِ: وَـ + الـ + غَيْرَةِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ghayra, jealousy (f., gen., third in the list of cares); 'and jealousy'
مَنَعَتْهَا: مَنَعَتْ + هَا — manaʿa, prevent (perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, her (object; the verb takes a second object an tukhbira); 'kept her'
الْوَجْدِ: الـ + وَجْدِ — al-, the + wajd, longing, passion (m., gen. in construct after kathrat); 'of longing'; also gen. after alam (alami al-wajdi, 'the pain of passion'); here: gen. after min, mā bihi mina al-wajdi, 'what was in him of longing'
وَالْهُيَامِ: وَـ + الـ + هُيَامِ — wa-, and + al-, the + huyām, madness (m., gen., joined to al-wajd); 'and madness'; here: huyām, the wild madness of love, joined to al-wajd: 'and love-madness'
عِصَابَتَيْنِ: عِصَابَتَيْنِ — ʿiṣāba, bandage (f., dual acc. as object of raʾaytu); 'two bandages'
إِحْدٰهُمَا: إِحْدَى + هُمَا — iḥdā, one (f.) + -humā, of the two (dual pronoun); 'one of them'
عَيْنِهَا: عَيْن + هَا — ʿayn, eye (f., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her eye'
وَجَعٍ: وَجَعٍ — wajaʿ, ache, pain (m., gen. indef. after bi-sababi); 'an ache'
بُكَائِهَا: بُكَاء + هَا — bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen. in construct after shiddat) + -hā, her; 'her weeping'
أَسْوَءِ: أَسْوَأ — aswaʾ, worst (elative of sayyiʾ, m., gen. in construct; hamza written on the line); 'the worst'
الْحَالَاتِ: الـ + حَالَات — al-, the + ḥālāt, states, conditions (pl. of ḥāl, f., gen.); 'of states'
اَعُدُّ: أَعُدُّ — ʿadda, count (imperf. 1 sg. indic.); 'I count'
اللَّيَالِيْ: الـ + لَيَالِي — al-, the + layālī, nights (pl. of layla, f., acc., object of aʿuddu); 'the nights'; here gen. after ṣurūfu: ṣurūfu al-layālī, 'the turns of the nights'
اللَّيَالِيَا: الـ + لَيَالِيَا — al-, the + layālī, nights (pl., acc.) with lengthened final -ā for the rhyme; 'nights'
اَمْلِكُ: أَمْلِكُ — malaka, have power over, possess (imperf. 1 sg.); 'I have no power over'
لِيَا: لِـ + يَا — li-, for/to (of the person affected, 'for me') + -ya, me (rhyme-lengthened -iyā); 'for me'
قَضَاهَا: قَضَى + هَا — qaḍā, decree, assign (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her (object); 'He gave her'
لِغَيْرِيْ: لِـ + غَيْرِي — li-, to (marks the one she is given to) + ghayr, other (m., gen.) + -ī, me; 'to another (than me)'
وَابْتَلَانِيْ: وَـ + ابْتَلَى + نِي — wa-, and + ibtalā, try, afflict (VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me (object); 'and made me suffer'
ابْتَلَانِيَا: ابْتَلَى + نِي + يَا — ibtalā, try, afflict (VIII, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me + rhyme-lengthened -ā; 'tried me'
مِمَّاهِيَ: مِنْ + مَا + هِيَ — min, from + mā, what + hiya, she; run together in print; 'from what she was in' (the following fīhi supplies 'in')
سَاكِتَةً: سَاكِتَةً — sākit, silent (act. part. f. sg., acc., predicate of lam tazal); 'silent'
بُرْهَةً: بُرْهَةً — burha, a while (f., acc. indef., adverbial of time); 'for a long while'
وَظَفِرْتَ: وَـ + ظَفِرْتَ — wa-, and + ẓafira bi-, win, gain (perf. 2 m. sg.; the verb takes bi- for what is won); 'and you have won'
بِبُلُوغِ: بِـ + بُلُوغِ — bi-, with (ẓafira takes bi- for the prize) + bulūgh, reaching, attaining (m., gen., in construct with āmāl); 'the attainment (of)'
آمَالِكَ: آمَال + كَ — āmāl, hopes (pl. of amal, m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your hopes'
وَكَوْنُهَا: وَـ + كَوْن + هَا — wa-, and + kawn, being, the fact of (verbal noun of kāna, m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her having (put it in)'
أَدْخَلَتْهَا: أَدْخَلَتْ + هَا — adkhala, put in (IV, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hā, it (the mirror); 'she put it (in the bag)'
تَغْطِسَ: تَغْطِسَ — ghaṭasa, plunge, sink (imperf. 3 f. sg. subjunctive after ilā an; al-shams is feminine); 'has sunk'
إِرْخَاؤُهَا: إِرْخَاؤُ + هَا — irkhāʾ, letting down (IV verbal noun, m., nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'her letting (hair fall)'
وَانْسَدَلَ: وَـ + انْسَدَلَ — wa-, and + insadala, hang down like a curtain (VII, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and ... falls like a veil'
سَوَادُ: سَوَادُ — sawād, blackness (m., nom., subject, in construct with al-ẓalām); 'the black (of darkness)'
فَتَعَالَ: فَـ + تَعَالَ — fa-, then (begins the answer to idhā) + taʿāla, come (VI, imperative m. sg.); 'then come'; also: fa-, so (consecutive, after a reproach): fa-taʿāla ʿindī, 'so come here to me'
بِالْقَصْرِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + قَصْرِيَّةِ — bi-, with (marks what she signs with: ishāratuhā laka bi-) + al-, the + qaṣriyya, earthenware pot (f., gen.); 'with the pot'
الزَّرْعُ: الـ + زَّرْعُ — al-, the + zarʿ, seedlings (m., nom., subject of fīhā); 'the seedlings'
بِالْقِنْدِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + قِنْدِيلِ — bi-, with (marks what she signs with) + al-, the + qindīl, lamp (m., gen.); 'with the lamp'
وَأَيَّ: وَـ + أَيَّ — wa-, and + ayy, whichever (m., acc., adverbial in construct with mawḍiʿ); 'and wherever'
مُضِيأً: مُضِيأً — muḍīʾ, shining, alight (IV act. part. m. sg., acc., ḥāl; hamza spelled on alif in the edition); 'alight'
وَانْتَظِرْنِي: وَـ + انْتَظِرْ + نِي — wa-, and + intaẓara, wait for (VIII, imperative m. sg.) + -nī, me (object); 'and wait for me'
هَوَاكَ: هَوَا + كَ — hawā, love, passion (m., acc. after inna) + -ka, you (love for you); 'my love for you'
تَعِدِينِى: تَعِدِي + نِي — waʿada, promise (imperf. 2 f. sg.) + -nī, me (final ى for ي); 'you promise me'
وَأَتَوَجَّهُ: وَـ + أَتَوَجَّهُ — wa-, and + tawajjaha, go toward (V, imperf. 1 sg.); 'and I go'
أَحْصُلُ: أَحْصُلُ — ḥaṣala, obtain (imperf. 1 sg., with a direct object); 'I do not get'
مَقْصُودِي: مَقْصُود + ِي — maqṣūd, aim, thing intended (pass. part. as noun, m., acc., object) + -ī, my; 'what I want'
لِتَفْسِيرِكِ: لِـ + تَفْسِير + كِ — li-, for (of the interpretation: a meaning 'for' it) + tafsīr, interpretation (II verbal noun, m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'in your readings'
تَصْبِرَ: تَصْبِرَ — ṣabara, be patient (imperf. 2 m. sg. subjunctive after an); 'to wait'
يُوَلِّىَ: يُوَلِّيَ — wallā, turn away, pass (II, imperf. 3 m. sg. subjunctive after ilā an; final ى for ي); 'is gone'
وَيُقْبِلَ: وَـ + يُقْبِلَ — wa-, and + aqbala, approach, come on (IV, imperf. 3 m. sg. subjunctive); 'and ... comes on'
فَتَحْظَى: فَـ + تَحْظَى — fa-, then (result) + ḥaẓiya bi-, be favoured with (imperf. 2 m. sg. subjunctive; takes bi- for what is won); 'then you will have'
الْآمَالِ: الـ + آمَالِ — al-, the + āmāl, hopes (pl. of amal, gen. in construct after bulūgh); 'all you hoped for'
صِدْقٌ: صِدْقٌ — ṣidq, truth (m., nom. indef., predicate of hādhā al-kalām); 'the truth'
مَيْنٍ: مَيْنٍ — mayn, falsehood, lie (m., gen. indef. after ghayr); 'lie'
دَرِّجِ: دَرِّجِ — darraja, make go by degrees, let pass (II, imperative m. sg.); 'let ... roll by'
تَنْدَرِجْ: تَنْدَرِجْ — indaraja, roll by, pass away (VII, imperf. 3 f. sg., jussive as answer to the imperative); 'they roll by'
وَبُيُوْتُ: وَـ + بُيُوتُ — wa-, and + buyūt, houses (pl. of bayt, m., nom., topic put first: "as for the houses"); 'and the houses (of care)'
تَلِجْ: تَلِجْ — walaja, enter (imperf. 2 m. sg., jussive after lā); 'do not enter'
رُبَّ: رُبَّ — rubba, many a (particle taking an indefinite genitive noun); 'how often'
قَرَّبَتْهُ: قَرَّبَتْ + هُ — qarraba, bring near (II, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it (the thing too hard to reach); 'brought it close'
سَاعَةُ: سَاعَةُ — sāʿa, hour (f., nom., subject, in construct with al-faraj); 'the hour (of release)'
الْفَرَجْ: الـ + فَرَجْ — al-, the + faraj, release, relief (m., gen. in construct; final vowel dropped for rhyme); 'of release'
تُسَلِّينِى: تُسَلِّي + نِي — sallā, comfort, console (II, imperf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'comforting me'
تَجْسُرْ: تَجْسُرْ — jasura, dare (imperf. 3 f. sg., jussive after lam); 'did not dare'
تَأْتِيَنِى: تَأْتِيَ + نِي — atā, come/bring (imperf. 3 f. sg. subjunctive after an; with -nī, me, the nūn of wiqāya); 'to bring me'
غَضَبِي: غَضَب + ِي — ghaḍab, anger (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; 'my anger'
وَرَجَاءَ: وَـ + رَجَاءَ — wa-, and + rajāʾ, hope (m., acc. as reason clause after makhāfatan); 'and in the hope'
مَيْلِي: مَيْل + ِي — mayl, inclination, warming (m., gen. in construct) + -ī, my; 'that I might warm (to her)'
قَصْدٌ: قَصْدٌ — qaṣd, aim, intention (m., nom. indef., subject of yakun); 'all she meant / aim'
أُحَدِّثَكَ: أُحَدِّثَ + كَ — ḥaddatha, tell, relate to (II, imperf. 1 sg. subjunctive after ḥattā) + -ka, you; 'I tell you stories' Also with bi- for the matter told: حَتَّى أُحَدِّثَكَ بِشَيْءٍ 'so that I can tell you something'.
يُسَلِّيكَ: يُسَلِّي + كَ — sallā, amuse, console (II, imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -ka, you (object); 'that passes the time for you'
مَايَأْتِي: مَا + يَأْتِي — mā, not + yaʾtī, come (imperf. 3 m. sg.); run together in print; 'night will not come (before)'
بَكَتِ: بَكَتِ — bakā, weep (perf. 3 f. sg., vowelled -ti before ibnatu); 'wept'
حَبَّةَ: حَبَّةَ — ḥabba, grain, pellet (f., acc. sg., object, in construct with miskin); 'a pellet'
خَالِصٍ: خَالِصٍ — khāliṣ, pure (act. part. adj. m., gen., qualifies miskin); 'pure'
فَمِكَ: فَم + كَ — fam, mouth (m., gen. after fī; stem fam-i) + -ka, your; 'your mouth'
بِمَحْبُوبَتِكَ: بِـ + مَحْبُوبَة + كَ — bi-, with (ijtamaʿa takes bi- for the one met) + maḥbūba, beloved (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'with your beloved'
وَقَضَيْتَ: وَـ + قَضَيْتَ — wa-, and + qaḍā, fulfil (perf. 2 m. sg.); 'and have fulfilled'
وَسَمَحَتْ: وَـ + سَمَحَتْ — wa-, and + samaḥa, grant, allow (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she has granted'
تَمَنَّيْتَ: تَمَنَّيْتَ — tamannā, wish for (V, perf. 2 m. sg.); 'you wished'
فَأَنْشِدْهَا: فَـ + أَنْشِدْ + هَا — fa-, then (so) + anshada, recite (IV, imperative m. sg.) + -hā, to her (the pronoun marks the person addressed); 'recite to her'
الْعُشَّاقُ: الـ + عُشَّاقُ — al-, the + ʿushshāq, lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq, m., vocative after ayyuhā); 'you lovers'
خَبِّرُوْا: خَبِّرُوا — khabbara, tell, inform (II, imperative m. pl.); 'tell me'
بِالْفَتَى: بِـ + الـ + فَتَى — bi-, in (the passion takes hold in the young man) + al-, the + fatā, young man (m., gen.); 'in a young man' Also after faʿala, 'to do (something) to/with', bi- marks the one it is done to: faʿala ākharu bi-al-fatā, 'another did the same with the young man'.
قَبَّلَتْنِي: قَبَّلَتْ + نِي — qabbala, kiss (II, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'she kissed me'
وَحَلَّفَتْنِي: وَـ + حَلَّفَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥallafa, make swear (II, perf. 3 f. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and made me swear'
لَاأُنْشِدُهَا: لَا + أُنْشِدُ + هَا — lā, not + anshada, recite (IV, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hā, to her; run together in print; 'I would not recite to her'
فَقَصَدْتُهُ: فَـ + قَصَدْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so + qaṣada, head for, make for (perf. 1 sg.) + -hu, it (the light); 'and made my way towards it'
مَعْقُودًا: مَعْقُودًا — maʿqūd, vaulted (pass. part. m. sg., acc., adjective of maqʿad; takes the dome as subject); 'roofed'
وَالْآبَنُوسِ: وَـ + الـ + آبَنُوس — wa-, and + al-, the + ābanūs, ebony (m., gen., joined to al-ʿāj, ivory); 'and ebony'
وَالْقِنْدِيلُ: وَـ + الـ + قِنْدِيلُ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'with') + al-, the + qindīl, lamp (m., nom., subject); 'and the lamp'
الْمَقْعَدُ: الـ + مَقْعَدُ — al-, the + maqʿad, pavilion (m., nom., subject of mafrūsh); 'the pavilion'
الْمُزَرْكَشَةِ: الـ + مُزَرْكَشَة — al-, the + muzarkash, embroidered with gold thread (pass. part. f. sg., gen., adjective of al-busuṭ); 'embroidered'
شَمْعَدَانٍ: شَمْعَدَان — shamʿadān, candlestick (m., gen. indef. after fī); 'candlestick'
أَنْوَاعُ: أَنْوَاعُ — anwāʿ, kinds, sorts (pl. of nawʿ, m., nom., subject in construct); 'all kinds'
التَّصَاوِيرِ: الـ + تَّصَاوِيرِ — al-, the + taṣāwīr, figures, pictures (pl. of taṣwīr, m., gen.); 'of figures'
وَبِجَانِبِ: وَـ + بِـ + جَانِبِ — wa-, and + bi-, at (with jānib, 'side': 'at the side of') + jānib, side (m., gen. in construct); 'and beside'
الْفَسْقِيَّةِ: الـ + فَسْقِيَّة — al-, the + fasqiyya, fountain basin (f., gen. after jānibi); 'the basin'
مُغَطَّاةٌ: مُغَطَّاةٌ — mughaṭṭā, covered (II pass. part. f. sg., nom., adjective of sufra); 'covered'
بِفُوطَةٍ: بِـ + فُوطَةٍ — bi-, with (what covers it) + fūṭa, cloth, napkin (f., gen. indef.); 'with a silk cloth'
بَاطِيَةٌ: بَاطِيَةٌ — bāṭiya, large wide vessel (f., nom. indef., subject); 'a great bowl'
مَمْلُوءَةٌ: مَمْلُوء — mamlūʾ, filled (pass. part. f. sg., nom., adjective of bāṭiya); 'filled' (takes khamr, wine, as what fills it)
بِلَّوْرٍ: بِلَّوْر — billawr, crystal (m., gen. indef. after min; the initial bi- belongs to the word, it is not the preposition); 'of crystal'
وَرُمَّانٍ: وَـ + رُمَّان — wa-, and + rummān, pomegranates (collective, m., gen. indef. after bayna); 'and pomegranates'
وَعِنَبٍ: وَـ + عِنَب — wa-, and + ʿinab, grapes (collective, m., gen. indef.); 'and grapes'
وَنَارَنْجٍ: وَـ + نَارَنْج — wa-, and + nāranj, bitter orange (m., gen. indef.); 'and bitter oranges'
وَأُتْرُجٍّ: وَـ + أُتْرُجّ — wa-, and + utrujj, citron (m., gen. indef.); 'and citrons'
وَكَبَّادٍ: وَـ + كَبَّاد — wa-, and + kabbād, large sour citrus, a kind of citron (m., gen. indef.); 'and kabbād'
الرَّيَاحِينِ: الـ + رَّيَاحِينِ — al-, the + rayāḥīn, sweet-smelling herbs and flowers (pl. of rayḥān, m., gen. in construct after anwāʿ); 'of sweet-smelling flowers'
وَيَاسَمِينٍ: وَـ + يَاسَمِين — wa-, and + yāsamīn, jasmine (m., gen. indef.); 'and jasmine'
وَآسٍ: وَـ + آس — wa-, and + ās, myrtle (m., gen. indef.); 'and myrtle'
وَنِسْرِينٍ: وَـ + نِسْرِين — wa-, and + nisrīn, eglantine, musk rose (m., gen. indef.); 'and eglantine'
الْمَشْمُومَاتِ: الـ + مَشْمُومَات — al-, the + mashmūmāt, things to be smelled, fragrant things (pass. part. f. pl., gen. after min); 'fragrant things'
فَهِمْتُ: فَـ + هِمْتُ — fa-, and so (result) + hāma, be enraptured (perf. 1 sg.; the print points it so as not to read fahimtu); 'and I was enraptured' Also, as one word, fahimtu, 'I understood' (fahima, verb I, perf. 1cs): innī fahimtu … hādhā al-amra, 'I have understood this matter'.
لَكِنِّي: لَكِنَّ + ِي — lākinna, but (particle that takes the accusative) + -ī, me (with nūn of wiqāya, -nī); 'but I'
خَلْقِ: خَلْقِ — khalq, creation, creatures (m., gen. sg. in construct with allāh); 'creatures (of God)'
يُعَانِي: يُعَانِي — yuʿānī, to deal with, to see to (verb III, defective, imperf. 3ms, relative clause after man); 'who sees to'
هَذِة: هَذِة — hādhihi, this (f. sg. demonstrative); the print's spelling of hādhihi; 'these' (before the non-human plural al-umūr)
يَحْرُسُ: يَحْرُسُ — ḥarasa, to guard (verb I, sound, imperf. 3ms indicative, relative clause after man); 'who guards'
مَحْبُوبَةِ: مَحْبُوبَةِ — maḥbūba, beloved (f. sg., fem. of the passive participle maḥbūb, from ḥabba; genitive as first term of an idāfa with qalbī); 'the beloved (of my heart)'
وَثَالِثُ: وَ + ثَالِثُ — wa-, and (conj.) + thālith, third (ordinal, m. sg., nominative, first term of an idāfa with sāʿa); 'and the third (hour)'
أَلَمُ: أَلَمُ — alam, pain (m. sg., nominative, subject of ishtadda and first term of an idāfa with al-jūʿ); 'the pain (of hunger)'
لِشِدَّةِ: لِـ + شِدَّةِ — li-, because of (prep., causal) + shidda, intensity, violence (f. sg., genitive, first term of an idāfa with wajdī); 'because of the intensity (of my passion)' Also with maḥabbatihi: li-shiddati maḥabbatihi lahā, 'because he loved her so dearly'.
وَظَهَرَ: وَ + ظَهَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ẓahara, to appear, become clear (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and (the truth) became clear'
صِدْقُ: صِدْقُ — ṣidq, truthfulness, correctness (m. sg., verbal noun of ṣadaqa, nominative, subject, first term of an idāfa); 'the truth (of my cousin)'
إِشَارَةِ: إِشَارَةِ — ishāra, sign, gesture (f. sg., verbal noun of IV ashāra, genitive, first term of an idāfa after fahm); 'the sign (of my beloved)'
مَعْشُوقَتِى: مَعْشُوقَتِى — maʿshūqa + ī, beloved (f. sg., fem. of the passive participle maʿshūq, from ʿashiqa; genitive in idāfa) + -ī, my (ى printed for ي); 'my beloved'
اسْتَرَحْتُ: اسْتَرَحْتُ — istarāḥa, to be at ease, to find rest (verb X, hollow, root r-w-ḥ, perf. 1s); 'I was at ease'
أَلَمَ: أَلَمَ — alam, pain (m. sg., accusative, object of wajadtu, first term of an idāfa with al-jūʿ); 'the pain (of hunger)'
شَوَّقَتْنِي: شَوَّقَتْ + نِي — shawwaqa, to make long for, to tempt (verb II, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the non-human plural rawāʾiḥ) + -nī, me (object); 'tempted me'
رَوَائِحُ: رَوَائِحُ — rawāʾiḥ, smells (broken pl. of rāʾiḥa, nominative, subject, first term of an idāfa with al-ṭaʿām); 'the smells (of the food)'
السُّفْرَةِ: السُّفْرَةِ — al- + sufra, the table-cloth, dining cloth (f. sg., genitive after fī); 'the cloth'
وَاطْمَأَنَّتْ: وَ + اطْمَأَنَّتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iṭmaʾanna, to be at rest, be calm (quadriliteral verb of the iqshaʿarra pattern, perf. 3fs, subject nafsī); 'and (my mind) was at ease'
فَاشْتَهَتْ: فَـ + اشْتَهَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ishtahā, to long for, desire (verb VIII, defective, perf. 3fs, subject nafsī, taking an accusative object); 'and so (my soul) longed for'
وَكَشَفْتُ: وَ + كَشَفْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + kashafa, to uncover (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I lifted'
مُحَمَّرَةٍ: مُحَمَّرَةٍ — muḥammara, browned, roasted (passive participle of II ḥammara, f. sg., genitive indefinite, adjective of dajājāt, a non-human plural taking f. sg.); 'browned'
وَمُتَبَّلَةٍ: وَ + مُتَبَّلَةٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + mutabbala, seasoned (passive participle of II tabbala, f. sg., genitive indefinite); 'and seasoned'
بِالْبَهَارَاتِ: بِـ + الْـ + بَهَارَاتِ — bi-, with (prep., instrument, the verb being passive in sense: seasoned with) + al- + bahārāt, spices (sound f. pl. of bahār, genitive after bi-); 'with the spices'
وَحَوْلَ: وَ + حَوْلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥawla, around (prep./adverbial accusative, preposed predicate, governing dhālika al-ṭabaq); 'and around'
زَبَادِى: زَبَادِى — zabādī, bowls (broken pl. of zabdiyya, ى printed for ي; indefinite, genitive after the number arbaʿ); '(four) bowls'
حَلْوَى: حَلْوَى — ḥalwā, sweetmeat, sweet (f. sg., indeclinable, nominative, predicate of an implied 'is' after wāḥida); '(one) of sweetmeat'
حَبُّ: حَبُّ — ḥabb, grains, seeds (collective m., nominative, first term of an idāfa with al-rummān); '(one of) seeds (of pomegranate)'
وَالثَّالِثَةُ: وَ + الْـ + ثَّالِثَةُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + thālitha, the third (ordinal, f. sg., nominative, referring to zabdiyya); 'and the third'
بَقْلَاوَةٌ: بَقْلَاوَةٌ — baqlāwa, baklava, a layered nut pastry (f. sg., nominative indefinite, loanword); 'baklava'
وَالرَّابِعَةُ: وَ + الْـ + رَّابِعَةُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + rābiʿa, the fourth (ordinal, f. sg., nominative); 'and the fourth'
قَطَائِفُ: قَطَائِفُ — qaṭāʾif, qaṭāʾif, a pancake-like pastry (pl. of qaṭīfa, nominative, diptote); 'qaṭāʾif'
الزَّبَادِى: الزَّبَادِى — al- + zabādī, the bowls (broken pl. of zabdiyya, ى printed for ي; nominative, with demonstrative tilka before it); 'the bowls'
وَحَامِضٍ: وَ + حَامِضٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāmiḍ, sour (active participle of ḥamaḍa, m. sg., genitive after bayna); 'and sour'
وَعَمَدْتُ: وَ + عَمَدْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿamada, to make for, turn to (verb I, perf. 1s; the verb chooses ilā, 'to'); 'and I turned (to)'
الْبَقْلَاوَةِ: الْـ + بَقْلَاوَةِ — al- + baqlāwa, the baklava (f. sg., genitive after ilā, 'to', which ʿamada requires); 'the baklava'
مِلْعَقَةً: مِلْعَقَةً — milʿaqa, spoon, spoonful (f. sg., accusative indefinite, object of akaltu); 'a spoonful'
ثَلٰثًا: ثَلٰثًا — thalāthan, three (numeral, accusative, object of akaltu, spelled with a dagger alif for ثَلَاثًا); 'three (spoonfuls)'
أَرْبَعًا: أَرْبَعًا — arbaʿan, four (numeral, accusative, object of akaltu); 'four (spoonfuls)'
دَجَاجَةٍ: دَجَاجَةٍ — dajāja, a chicken (unit noun, f. sg., genitive indefinite, second term of an idāfa after baʿḍa); '(part of) a chicken'
بَطْنِي: بَطْنِي — baṭn + ī, belly (treated as feminine here, since the verb is imtalaʾat; nominative, subject) + -ī, my; 'my belly'; also: gen. after fī: adkhaltu dhubābatahu fī baṭnī, 'I put its point into my belly' (Night 179)
وَارْتَخَتْ: وَ + ارْتَخَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + irtakhā, to become slack, relaxed (verb VIII, defective, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural mafāṣil); 'and grew slack'
مَفَاصِلِي: مَفَاصِلِي — mafāṣil + ī, joints (broken pl. of mafṣil, nominative, subject) + -ī, my; 'my joints'
كَسِلْتُ: كَسِلْتُ — kasila, to be lazy, drowsy (verb I, perf. 1s; takes ʿan, 'from', of what one is too sluggish for); 'I was too drowsy (for)'
فَوَضَعْتُ: فَـ + وَضَعْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + waḍaʿa, to put, lay (verb I, assimilated, perf. 1s); 'and so I laid'
وِسَادَةٍ: وِسَادَةٍ — wisāda, cushion, pillow (f. sg., genitive indefinite after ʿalā); '(on) a cushion'
يَدِى: يَدِى — yad + ī, hand (f., sg. here for 'hands', accusative, object of ghasaltu) + -ī, my (ى printed for ي); 'my hands'
فَغَلَبَنِي: فَـ + غَلَبَ + نِي — fa-, and (conj.) + ghalaba, to overcome (verb I, perf. 3ms, subject al-nawm) + -nī, me; 'and (sleep) overcame me'
أَحْرَقَنِي: أَحْرَقَ + نِي — aḥraqa, to burn, scorch (verb IV, perf. 3ms, subject ḥarr al-shams) + -nī, me; '(the heat) scorched me'
حَرُّ: حَرُّ — ḥarr, heat (m. sg., nominative, subject, first term of an idāfa with al-shams); 'the heat (of the sun)'
وَفَحْمًا: وَ + فَحْمًا — wa-, and (conj.) + faḥm, charcoal (collective m., accusative indefinite, second object of wajadtu); 'and charcoal'
فَانْتَصَبْتُ: فَـ + انْتَصَبْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + intaṣaba, to stand up, stand erect (verb VII, perf. 1s, followed by qāʾiman as ḥāl); 'and so I sprang up'
وَنَفَضْتُ: وَ + نَفَضْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + nafaḍa, to shake out (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I shook out'
تَلَفَّتُّ: تَلَفَّتُّ — talaffata, to look around, turn about (verb V, perf. 1s; the print has the shadda on the lām, read talaffattu); 'I looked around'
فَتَحَيَّرْتُ: فَـ + تَحَيَّرْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + taḥayyara, to be bewildered, at a loss (verb V, perf. 1s); 'and so I was bewildered'
وَتَأَسَّفْتُ: وَ + تَأَسَّفْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾassafa, to feel sorry, grieve (verb V, perf. 1s; takes ʿalā, 'over'); 'and I grieved (for myself)'
تَدُقُّ: تَدُقُّ — daqqa, to beat, knock (verb I, geminate, imperf. 3fs indicative, ḥāl clause: she beating); 'beating'
يُبَارِي: يُبَارِي — bārā, to vie with, rival (verb III, defective, imperf. 3ms, relative clause on damʿ); 'rivalling'
السُّحُبَ: السُّحُبَ — al- + suḥub, the clouds (broken pl. of saḥāb, accusative, object of yubārī); 'the clouds'
الْمَاطِرَاتِ: الْـ + مَاطِرَاتِ — al- + māṭirāt, raining (sound f. pl. active participle of maṭara, accusative, adjective of al-suḥub); 'the rain-bearing (clouds)'
وَنَسِيمٌ: وَ + نَسِيمٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + nasīm, gentle breeze (m. sg., nominative indefinite, joined to rīḥ); 'and a gentle breeze'
فَاَهَاجَ: فَـ + أَهَاجَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ahāja, to stir up (verb IV, hollow, perf. 3ms; printed with a plain alif for the hamza); 'and so (it) stirred up'
بِنَشْرِ: بِـ + نَشْرِ — bi-, by, through (prep., means) + nashr, spreading, diffusion of scent (m. sg., verbal noun, genitive, first term of an idāfa); 'by the spreading (of its blowing)'
هُبُوبِهْ: هُبُوبِهْ — hubūb + hi, blowing (verbal noun of habba, m. sg., genitive in idāfa) + -hi, his/its (verse rhyme form with sukūn, ـهْ); 'its blowing'
الصَّبَا: الصَّبَا — al- + ṣabā, the east wind, morning breeze (f. sg., genitive in idāfa after nasīm, indeclinable ending); '(breeze) of the east wind'
هَلُمَّ: هَلُمَّ — halumma, come! (invariable imperative, Hijazi usage, followed by ilaynā in the print's form); 'come (to us)'
بِحَظِّهِ: بِـ + حَظِّ + هِ — bi-, with (prep., the lover has his portion: the share goes with each) + ḥaẓẓ, portion, luck (m. sg., genitive) + -hi, his; 'with his portion'
وَنَصِيبِهْ: وَ + نَصِيبِهْ — wa-, and (conj.) + naṣīb, share, lot (m. sg., genitive, joined to ḥaẓẓ) + -hi, his (verse rhyme form with sukūn, ـهْ); 'and his share'
قَدَرْنَا: قَدَرْنَا — qadara, to be able (verb I, perf. 1p -nā, in the conditional after law); 'we were able', 'if we could'
الْعَرَامِ: الْعَرَامِ — al- + ʿarām, the print has an undotted ʿayn, ʿarām 'fierceness', probably for al-gharām 'passion' (m. sg., genitive after min, 'from, out of'); 'of passion'
كَاعْتِنَاقِ: كَـ + اعْتِنَاقِ — ka-, like, as (prep., comparison) + iʿtināq, embracing (verb VIII verbal noun of iʿtanaqa, m. sg., genitive, first term of an idāfa); 'like the embrace of'
صَدْرَ: صَدْرَ — ṣadr, breast, chest (m. sg., accusative, object of the verbal noun iʿtināq, first term of an idāfa); 'the breast (of his beloved)'
حَبِيبِهْ: حَبِيبِهْ — ḥabīb + hi, beloved (m. sg., genitive, second term of an idāfa) + -hi, his (verse rhyme form with sukūn, ـهْ); 'his beloved'
وَطِيبِهْ: وَ + طِيبِهْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭīb, goodness, pleasantness (m. sg., verbal noun of ṭāba, genitive, joined to ʿaysh) + -hi, its (verse rhyme form with sukūn, ـهْ); 'and its goodness'
ذَائِبٌ: ذَائِبٌ — dhāʾib, melting (active participle of dhāba, hollow, m. sg., nominative indefinite, predicate/ḥāl of qalbuhu); 'melting'
وَلَهِيبِهْ: وَ + لَهِيبِهْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lahīb, flame (m. sg., genitive, joined to ḥarr) + -hi, its (verse rhyme form with sukūn, ـهْ); 'and its flame'
مُسْرِعَةً: مُسْرِعَةً — musriʿa, hurrying (active participle of IV asraʿa, f. sg., accusative, ḥāl); 'hurriedly'
عِشْقِكَ: عِشْقِ + كَ — ʿishq + ka: ʿishq, passionate love (m. sg., verbal noun of ʿashiqa, genitive after fī) + -ka, your; 'in your love'
لَطَفَ: لَطَفَ — laṭafa, to be kind, gracious (verb I, perf. 3ms, subject Allāh; takes bi-, 'to, toward'); 'has been kind (to you)'
أَحَبَّكَ: أَحَبَّ + كَ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV, perf. 3ms, subject the relative man) + -ka, you (object); 'loves you'
وَحُزْنِي: وَ + حُزْنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥuzn, grief (m. sg., genitive, joined to bukāʾī) + -ī, my; 'and my grief'
يَلُمْنِي: يَلُمْنِي — lāma, to blame (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; shortened yalūmunī, the print drops the final vowel and nūn; 'blame me'
وَيَعْذِرُنِي: وَ + يَعْذِرُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿadhara, to excuse, make allowance for (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and excuse (pity) me'
يُؤَاخِذُكَ: يُؤَاخِذُ + كَ — ākhadha, to hold to account (verb III, imperf. 3ms indicative, with lā as a prayer 'may He not') + -ka, you; 'hold you to account'
تَبَسُّمَ: تَبَسُّمَ — tabassum, smiling (verb V verbal noun of tabassama, m. sg., accusative, cognate accusative, first term of an idāfa with al-ghayẓ); 'a smile (of vexation)'
وَنَشَرَتْهَا: وَ + نَشَرَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + nashara, to spread out (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, them (f. sg. for the non-human plural athwābī); 'and spread them out'
حَظِيَ: حَظِيَ — ḥaẓiya, to win the favour of, obtain (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms; the verb chooses bi-); 'who has won'
بِمَحْبُوبِهِ: بِـ + مَحْبُوبِ + هِ — bi-, chosen by the verb ḥaẓiya bi- 'to win the favour of' + maḥbūb, beloved (m. sg., passive participle of ḥabba, genitive) + -hi, his; 'his beloved'
مُوجَعٌ: مُوجَعٌ — muwjaʿ, aching, pained (passive participle of IV awjaʿa, m. sg., nominative indefinite, second predicate of inna after malʾān); 'aching'
يُوجِعُ: يُوجِعُ — awjaʿa, to pain, hurt (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indicative, relative clause after man); 'who pains'
تَعَزُّزًا: تَعَزُّزًا — taʿazzuz, haughtiness, hard-to-get behaviour (verb V verbal noun of taʿazzaza, m. sg., accusative, cognate accusative intensified by qawiyyan); 'playing hard to get'
خَائِفَةٌ: خَائِفَةٌ — khāʾifa, afraid (active participle of khāfa, hollow, f. sg., nominative indefinite, predicate of inna); 'afraid'
تَفْسِيرَ: تَفْسِيرَ — tafsīr, interpretation, meaning (verb II verbal noun of fassara, m. sg., accusative as subject of anna, first term of an idāfa); 'the meaning (of the salt)'
الْمِلْحِ: الْـ + مِلْحِ — al- + milḥ, the salt (m. sg., genitive, second term of an idāfa); 'of the salt'
مُسْتَغْرِقٌ: مُسْتَغْرِقٌ — mustaghriq, sunk, absorbed (active participle of X istaghraqa, m. sg., nominative indefinite, predicate of anna; takes fī, 'in'); 'sunk (in sleep)'; here: predicate in a circumstantial clause after wa-
فَكَأَنَّكَ: فَـ + كَأَنَّ + كَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ka-anna, as if, as though (particle, ka- + anna, taking an accusative subject) + -ka, you; 'so it is as if you'
الطَّعْمِ: الطَّعْمِ — al- + ṭaʿm, the taste (m. sg., genitive, second term of an idāfa after bashiʿ); '(foul) of taste'
تَعَافُكَ: تَعَافُ + كَ — ʿāfa, to loathe, find repellent (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the non-human plural al-nufūs) + -ka, you; 'find you repugnant'
النُّفُوسُ: النُّفُوسُ — al- + nufūs, the souls, people (broken pl. of nafs, nominative, subject); 'people'
تَتَمَلَّحَ: تَتَمَلَّحَ — tamallaḥa, to make oneself salty, to season oneself (verb V, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'that you season yourself'
تَمُجَّكَ: تَمُجَّ + كَ — majja, to spit out (verb I, geminate, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā lā, agreeing with al-ṭibāʿ) + -ka, you; 'spit you out'
الطِّبَاعُ: الطِّبَاعُ — al- + ṭibāʿ, the natures, dispositions (broken pl. of ṭabʿ, nominative, subject); 'people's natures'
تَدَّعِي: تَدَّعِي — iddaʿā, to claim (verb VIII, defective, imperf. 2ms indicative; the assimilated dāl is written with shadda); 'you claim'
فَدَعْوَاكَ: فَـ + دَعْوَى + كَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + daʿwā, claim (f. sg., nominative, subject, first term of an idāfa) + -ka, your; 'so your claim'
الْمَحَبَّةَ: الْـ + مَحَبَّةَ — al- + maḥabba, love (f. sg., accusative, the object of the verbal noun daʿwā); '(claim) of love'; also acc. object of yajlibu: yajlibu al-maḥabbata ilā al-qalbi, 'draws love to the heart'
كَاذِبَةٌ: كَاذِبَةٌ — kādhiba, false, lying (active participle of kadhaba, f. sg., nominative indefinite, predicate); 'false'
رَأَتْكَ: رَأَتْ + كَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject the beloved) + -ka, you; 'she saw you'
تُنَبِّهْكَ: تُنَبِّهْ + كَ — nabbaha, to wake, rouse (verb II, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam) + -ka, you; 'she did not wake you'
صَادِقَةً: صَادِقَةً — ṣādiqa, truthful, sincere (active participle of ṣadaqa, f. sg., accusative indefinite, predicate of kānat); 'sincere'
لَنَبَّهَتْكَ: لَـ + نَبَّهَتْ + كَ — la-, introduces the apodosis of law (particle) + nabbaha, to wake (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -ka, you; 'she would have woken you'
الْفَحْمُ: الْـ + فَحْمُ — al- + faḥm, charcoal (collective m., nominative, topic after the particle ammā); 'as for the charcoal'
إِشَارَتِهِ: إِشَارَةِ + هِ — ishāra, sign (f. sg., verbal noun of IV ashāra, genitive, second term of an idāfa after tafsīr) + -hi, its; 'its sign'
سَوَّدَ: سَوَّدَ — sawwada, to blacken (verb II, perf. 3ms, used as a prayer, 'may God blacken your face'); 'blacken'
ادَّعَيْتَ: ادَّعَيْتَ — iddaʿā, to claim (verb VIII, defective, perf. 2ms); 'you claimed'
كِذْبًا: كِذْبًا — kidhb, falsehood, lie (m. sg., accusative indefinite, adverbial, 'falsely'); 'falsely'
هِمَّةٌ: هِمَّةٌ — himma, aspiration, concern, ambition (f. sg., nominative indefinite, subject of yakun, with laka as predicate); 'a care'
الْأَكْلُ: الْأَكْلُ — al- + akl, eating (m. sg., verbal noun of akala, nominative, after illā in an exception); 'eating'
وَالشُّرْبُ: وَ + الشُّرْبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + shurb, drinking (m. sg., verbal noun of shariba, nominative, joined to al-akl); 'and drinking'
إِشَارَتِهَا: إِشَارَةِ + هَا — ishāra, sign (f. sg., verbal noun of IV ashāra, genitive, second term of an idāfa) + -hā, her; 'her signs'
يُخَلِّصُكَ: يُخَلِّصُ + كَ — khallaṣa, to deliver, set free (verb II, imperf. 3ms indicative, optative, followed by min-hā 'from her') + -ka, you; 'may He free you'
الصَّحِيحُ: الصَّحِيحُ — al- + ṣaḥīḥ, the true, correct thing (m. sg., nominative, predicate after the pronoun huwa); 'the truth'
وَالْعُشَّاقُ: وَ + الْـ + عُشَّاقُ — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial 'while') + al- + ʿushshāq, the lovers (broken pl. of ʿāshiq, nominative, subject); 'and lovers'
يَنَامُونَ: يَنَامُونَ — nāma, to sleep (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3mp indicative, after lā); 'sleep'
أَضَرَّ: أَضَرَّ — aḍarr, more harmful (elative of ḍārr, diptote, accusative as predicate of kāna; ʿalayya, 'to me', follows); 'more harmful'
زِدْتُ: زِدْتُ — zāda, to increase (verb I, hollow, perf. 1s; takes fī, 'in', for what one increases); 'I increased (in weeping)', 'I wept all the more'
دُلِّينِي: دُلِّي + نِي — dalla, to guide, point out (verb I, geminate, imperative 2fs, dullī, the print doubling the lām; takes ʿalā, 'to', for the thing shown) + -nī, me; 'show me'
وَارْحَمِينِي: وَ + ارْحَمِي + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + irḥamī, to have mercy (verb I, imperative 2fs of raḥima, with the support nūn before the pronoun) + -ī, me; 'and have pity on me'
يَرْحَمُكِ: يَرْحَمُ + كِ — raḥima, to have mercy (verb I, imperf. 3ms indicative, optative, subject Allāh) + -ki, you (f.); 'may He have mercy on you'
الصِّينِىِّ: الصِّينِىِّ — al- + ṣīnī, Chinese, china (nisba adjective from al-Ṣīn, m. sg., genitive after min; ى printed for ي); 'of china'
وَارْحَمِينِى: و + ارْحَمِي + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); irḥamī, imperative f. sing. of رَحِمَ, raḥima, to have mercy on (final ي printed ى) + -nī, me (with nūn of protection); 'and have mercy on me'
تُحِبُّنِى: تُحِبُّ + نِي — tuḥibbu, imperfect of أَحَبَّ, aḥabba, to love (form IV, 3rd f. sing., here after كَانَتْ, 'she used to'; the print's تُحِبُّنِى has ى for ي) + -nī, me; 'loved me'
أَجْمَعُ: أَجْمَعُ — ajmaʿu, I bring together (imperfect 1st sing. of جَمَعَ, jamaʿa), after كُنْتُ in the apodosis of لَوْ: 'I would be joining'; 'I would bring together'
أَقْرَبِ: أَقْرَبِ — aqrab, nearest, soonest (elative of قَرِيب, qarīb, near; m., gen. as first term of the idafa with زَمَنٍ after فِي); 'the nearest'
زَمَنٍ: زَمَنٍ — zaman, time (m., gen., indef., second term of the idafa after أَقْرَبِ); 'time' (so 'in the soonest time')
وَأُغَطِّيكُمَا: و + أُغَطِّي + كُمَا — wa-, and (conj.); ughaṭṭī, I cover (imperfect 1st sing., form II of غَطَّى, ghaṭṭā); -kumā, you two (dual obj.); 'and I will cover you both'
لِقَصْدِ: لِـ + قَصْد — li-, for, for the sake of (prep., purpose); qaṣd, aim, intention (m., gen., first term of idafa with رِضَاكَ); 'for the purpose of'
رِضَاكَ: رِضَا + كَ — riḍā, pleasure, satisfaction (verbal noun of رَضِيَ, m., gen. as second term of idafa after قَصْدِ) + -ka, your; 'your satisfaction'
أَبْذُلُ: أَبْذُلُ — abdhulu, I expend, exert (imperfect 1st sing. of بَذَلَ, badhala; governs غَايَةَ الْجُهْدِ); 'I will expend'
وَأَطِعْ: و + أَطِعْ — wa-, and (conj.); aṭiʿ, obey (imperative m. sing. of أَطَاعَ, aṭāʿa, form IV; takes direct object); 'and obey'
أَمْرِى: أَمْر + ي — amr, command, order (m., acc. as object of أَطِعْ) + -ī, my (final ي printed ى); 'my command'
وَاحْذَرْ: و + احْذَرْ — wa-, and (conj.); iḥdhar, beware, take care (imperative m. sing. of حَذِرَ, ḥadhira; here followed by أَنْ + subjunctive, 'beware of doing'); 'and beware'
شَيًاْ: شَيْئًا — shayʾan, anything (m., acc. as object of تَأْكُلَ, indef.; printed شيا with a small mark over the alif); 'anything'
يَجْلِبُ: يَجْلِبُ — yajlibu, brings, induces (imperfect 3rd m. sing. of جَلَبَ, jalaba); 'brings on'
يَمْضِى: يَمْضِي — yamḍī, passes, elapses (imperfect subjunctive 3rd m. sing. of مَضَى, maḍā, after حَتَّى; final ي printed ى); 'has passed'
شَرَّمَا: شَرَّ + مَا — sharra, evil of (شَرّ, sharr, evil, m., acc.) + mā, what; printed شرّما and read sharra mā, 'the evil of what…'; doubtful, possibly a misprint for شَرَّهَا, 'its evil'; 'the evil of what…'; here: here plainly sharra mā, 'the harm of what (you fear)', the print running the two words together; acc., second object of kafā
الْمُتَقَدِّمَ: الـ + مُتَقَدِّم — al-, the (def. art.); mutaqaddim, foregoing, aforementioned (act. part. of تَقَدَّمَ, form V; m., acc., adjective of الْبَيْتَ); 'the aforementioned'
انْصِرَافِكَ: انْصِرَاف + ك — inṣirāf, departure, going away (verbal noun of انْصَرَفَ, form VII; m., gen. after وَقْتَ) + -ka, your; 'your departure'
مُهَيَّأً: مُهَيَّأً — muhayyaʾ, prepared, made ready (pass. part. of هَيَّأَ, form II; m., acc. indef., predicative complement of وَجَدْتُ); 'prepared'
مَايُحْتَاجُ: مَا + يُحْتَاجُ — two words printed as one: mā, what (rel.) + yuḥtāju, is needed (imperfect passive of احْتَاجَ, iḥtāja, form VIII; the verb chooses إِلَى, 'need' with ilayhi); 'what is needed'
الْمَقْعَدَ: الـ + مَقْعَد — al-, the (def. art.); maqʿad, seat, pavilion, sitting place (m., acc. as object of طَلَعْتُ); 'the pavilion'
فَاشْتَاقَتْ: فَـ + اشْتَاقَتْ — fa-, so, and so (conj., consequence); ishtāqat, longed (perfect 3rd f. sing. of اشْتَاقَ, ishtāqa, form VIII; chooses إِلَى, 'long for'); 'and so longed'
فَمَنَعْتُهَا: فَـ + مَنَعْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.); manaʿtu, I prevented (perfect 1st sing. of مَنَعَ, manaʿa); -hā, it/her (nafs, f. obj.); 'and so I held it back'
مَنْعِهَا: مَنْع + هَا — manʿ, preventing (verbal noun of مَنَعَ, m., gen. after عَلَى; qadara ʿalā, 'be able to') + -hā, it (my soul); 'restraining it'
غِطَاءَهَا: غِطَاء + هَا — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (m., acc. as object of كَشَفْتُ) + -hā, its; 'its cover'
صَحْنَ: صَحْن — ṣaḥn, dish, plate (m., acc. as object of وَجَدْتُ, first term of idafa with دَجَاجٍ); 'a dish (of)'
مَاتَيَسَّرَ: مَا + تَيَسَّرَ — two words printed as one: mā, what (rel.) + tayassara, was easy, available (perfect 3rd m. sing. of تَيَسَّرَ, form V); 'whatever was available'
الزَّرْدَةِ: الـ + زَّرْدَة — al-, the (def. art., assimilated to zāy); zarda, saffron-coloured sweet rice (f., gen. after مِنْ, partitive 'some of'); 'the zarda'
وَأَعْجَبَتْنِي: و + أَعْجَبَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); aʿjabat, pleased (perfect 3rd f. sing. of أَعْجَبَ, aʿjaba, form IV; takes direct object) + -nī, me; 'and it pleased me'
فَأَكْثَرْتُ: فَـ + أَكْثَرْتُ — fa-, and so (conj., consequence); akthartu, I did much, overdid it (perfect 1st sing. of أَكْثَرَ, akthara, form IV); 'and so I ate much'
بِالْمِلْعَقَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مِلْعَقَة — bi-, with (prep., instrument); al-, the; milʿaqa, spoon (f., gen.); 'with the spoon'
أَجْفَانِي: أَجْفَان + ي — ajfān, eyelids (broken pl. of جَفْن, jafn; nom., subject of انْطَبَقَتْ) + -ī, my; 'my eyelids'
وَوَضَعْتُهَا: و + وَضَعْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); waḍaʿtu, I put (perfect 1st sing. of وَضَعَ, waḍaʿa); -hā, it (the pillow); 'and I put it'
أَتَّكِئُ: أَتَّكِئُ — attakiʾu, I lean, recline (imperfect 1st sing. of اتَّكَأَ, ittakaʾa, form VIII; subjunctive after laʿallī, with ʿalā); 'I might lean'
فَأَغْمَضْتُ: فَـ + أَغْمَضْتُ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence); aghmaḍtu, I closed (perfect 1st sing. of أَغْمَضَ, aghmaḍa, form IV, 'close the eyes'); 'and so I closed'
انْتَبَهْتُ: انْتَبَهْتُ — intabahtu, I woke up (perfect 1st sing. of انْتَبَهَ, intabaha, form VIII); 'I woke'
كَعْبَ: كَعْب — kaʿb, knucklebone, ankle-bone (m., acc. as object of وَجَدْتُ, first term of idafa with عَظْمٍ); 'a knucklebone (of)'
عَظْمٍ: عَظْم — ʿaẓm, bone (m., gen., indef., second term of the idafa; kaʿb ʿaẓm = knucklebone); 'bone'
وَفَرْدَةَ: و + فَرْدَة — wa-, and (conj.); farda, one of a pair, single piece (f., acc. as object of وَجَدْتُ, first term of idafa with طَابٍ); 'and one stick (of)'
طَابٍ: طَاب — ṭāb, the game of ṭāb, played by throwing flat sticks (m., gen., second term of idafa; fardat ṭāb = one stick of ṭāb); 'ṭāb'
وَنَوَايَةَ: و + نَوَايَة — wa-, and (conj.); nawāya, fruit-stone (colloquial for نَوَاة, nawāh; f., acc., first term of idafa with بَلَحٍ); 'and a stone (of)'
بَلَحٍ: بَلَح — balaḥ, unripe dates (collective, m., gen., second term of idafa); 'unripe dates'
وَبِزْرَةَ: و + بِزْرَة — wa-, and (conj.); bizra, seed, pip (f., acc., first term of idafa with خَرُّوبٍ); 'and a seed (of)'
خَرُّوبٍ: خَرُّوب — kharrūb, carob (collective, m., gen., second term of idafa); 'carob'
جَرِيحٌ: جَرِيح — jarīḥ, wounded (m., nom. indef., adjective of قَلْبٌ); 'wounded'
وَدُمُوعٌ: و + دُمُوع — wa-, and (conj.); dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع, damʿ; nom. indef., subject, with ʿalā al-khudūdi tasīḥu as description); 'and tears'
تَسِيحُ: تَسِيحُ — tasīḥu, flow, run (imperfect 3rd f. sing. of سَاحَ, sāḥa; agreeing with the plural دُمُوعٌ); 'flow'
وَحَبِيبٌ: و + حَبِيب — wa-, and (conj.); ḥabīb, beloved (m., nom. indef.); 'and a beloved'
صَعْبُ: صَعْب — ṣaʿb, hard, difficult (m., nom., predicate-like adjective, first term of idafa with التَّجَنِّي, 'hard of offence'); 'hard (in)'
مَلَأْتَ: مَلَأْتَ — malaʾta, you filled (perfect 2nd m. sing. of مَلَأَ, malaʾa; takes object plus بِـ for what it is filled with); 'you have filled'
بِالْوَجْدِ: بِـ + الـ + وَجْد — bi-, with (prep.; with مَلَأَ it marks what something is filled with); al-, the; wajd, passion, ardent love (m., gen.); 'with passion'
الدُّمُوعِ: الـ + دُّمُوع — al-, the (def. art., assimilated to dāl); dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع; gen. after مِنْ, 'because of'); 'the tears'; also gen. after ghayru: ghayru al-dumūʿi, 'nothing but tears' (Night 194)
قَرِيحُ: قَرِيح — qarīḥ, sore, wounded, inflamed (m., nom. indef., predicate of inna ṭarfī); 'sore'
فَنَهَرْتُ: فَـ + نَهَرْتُ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence); nahartu, I rebuked, scolded (perfect 1st sing. of نَهَرَ, nahara; takes direct object); 'and I scolded'
وَشَتَمْتُهَا: و + شَتَمْتُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); shatamtu, I abused, cursed (perfect 1st sing. of شَتَمَ, shatama); -hā, her; 'and I abused her'
وَقَبَّلَتْنِي: و + قَبَّلَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); qabbalat, she kissed (perfect 3rd f. sing. of قَبَّلَ, qabbala, form II) + -nī, me; 'and she kissed me'
تَضُمُّنِي: تَضُمُّ + نِي — taḍummu, she embraces (imperfect 3rd f. sing. of ضَمَّ, ḍamma; in the clause after أَخَذَتْ, 'she began to') + -nī, me; 'embracing me'
أَتَبَاعَدُ: أَتَبَاعَدُ — atabāʿadu, I draw away, keep aloof (imperfect 1st sing. of تَبَاعَدَ, tabāʿada, form VI); 'I kept aloof'
وَأُعَاتِبُ: و + أُعَاتِبُ — wa-, and (conj.); uʿātibu, I reproach (imperfect 1st sing. of عَاتَبَ, ʿātaba, form III); 'and reproaching'
وَلٰكِنَّنِي: و + لٰكِنَّ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); lākinna, but (particle, governs acc.) + -nī, me/I (obj. suffix with nūn of protection, as its noun); 'but I'
