فَسِّرِي: فَسِّرِي — fassirī, explain (imperative f. sing. of فَسَّرَ, fassara, form II; takes the following إِشَارَةَ as object); 'explain'
إِشَارَةَ: إِشَارَة — ishāra, sign, meaning (verbal noun of أَشَارَ, f., acc. as object of فَسِّرِي, first term of idafa with فِعْلِهَا); 'the sign (of)'
وَسَاعِدِينِي: و + سَاعِدِي + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); sāʿidī, help (imperative f. sing. of سَاعَدَ, sāʿada, form III) + -nī, me; 'and help me'
فَرْدَةُ: فَرْدَة — farda, single piece, one stick (f., nom. as topic after أَمَّا, first term of idafa with الطَّابِ); 'the stick (of)'
الطَّابِ: الـ + طَّاب — al-, the (def. art., assimilated to ṭāʾ); ṭāb, the game of ṭāb (m., gen., second term of idafa); 'the game of ṭāb'
وَضَعَتْهَا: وَضَعَتْ + هَا — waḍaʿat, she put (perfect 3rd f. sing. of وَضَعَ, waḍaʿa) + -hā, it (resumptive to relative allatī); 'she put (it)'; here: -hā refers to the cups (kāsāt): idhā waḍaʿathā, 'when she sets them (to her mouth)'
بَطْنِكَ: بَطْن + كَ — baṭn, belly, stomach (m., gen. after عَلَى) + -ka, your; 'your belly'
حَضَرْتَ: حَضَرْتَ — ḥaḍarta, you were present (perfect 2nd m. sing. of حَضَرَ, ḥaḍara; here, bodily present); 'you were present'
وَقَلْبُكَ: و + قَلْب + كَ — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial 'while'); qalb, heart (m., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'and your heart'
وَكَأَنَّهَا: و + كَـ + أَنَّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); ka-anna, as if (particle governing acc., from كَـ 'like' + أَنَّ 'that') + -hā, she; 'and as if she'
تَعُدَّ: تَعُدَّ — taʿudda, count, reckon (jussive 2ms of عَدَّ, ʿadda, after the prohibitive لَا: fa-lā taʿudda, 'so do not count'; takes نَفْسَكَ as object and مِنَ, 'among'); 'count'
نَوَايَةُ: نَوَايَة — nawāya, fruit-stone (colloquial for نَوَاة, nawāh; f., nom. as topic after أَمَّا, first term of idafa); 'the stone (of)'
الْبَلَحِ: الـ + بَلَح — al-, the (def. art.); balaḥ, unripe dates (collective, m., gen., second term of idafa); 'the unripe dates'
قَلْبُكَ: قَلْب + كَ — qalb, heart (m., nom., subject of كَانَ) + -ka, your; 'your heart'
مُحْتَرِقًا: مُحْتَرِقًا — muḥtariq, burning (act. part. of احْتَرَقَ, iḥtaraqa, form VIII; m., acc. indef., predicate of كَانَ); 'burning'
بِالْغَرَامِ: بِـ + الـ + غَرَام — bi-, with (prep.; with مُحْتَرِقًا, marks what one burns with); al-, the; gharām, passionate love (m., gen.); 'with passion'
تَذُقْ: تَذُقْ — tadhuq, you taste (jussive 2nd m. sing. of ذَاقَ, dhāqa, after لَمْ, 'you did not taste'); 'taste'
لَذَّةَ: لَذَّة — ladhdha, pleasure, delight (f., acc. as noun of inna, first term of idafa with الْحُبِّ); 'the delight (of)'
كَتَمْرَةٍ: كَـ + تَمْرَة — ka-, like, as (prep., comparison); tamra, a date (f., gen. indef. after كَـ); 'like a date'
أَلْهَبَتْ: أَلْهَبَتْ — alhabat, set aflame (perfect 3rd f. sing. of أَلْهَبَ, alhaba, form IV; the date as subject, relative clause qualifying تَمْرَةٍ); 'set ablaze'
جَمْرَةً: جَمْرَة — jamra, live coal, ember (f., acc. indef., object of أَلْهَبَتْ); 'an ember'
بِزْرَةُ: بِزْرَة — bizra, seed, pip (f., nom. as topic after أَمَّا, first term of idafa with الْخَرُّوبِ); 'the seed (of)'
الْخَرُّوبِ: الـ + خَرُّوب — al-, the (def. art.); kharrūb, carob (collective, m., gen., second term of idafa); 'the carob'
مَتْعُوبٌ: مَتْعُوب — matʿūb, wearied, worn out (colloquial pass. part. of تَعِبَ; m., nom. indef., predicate of anna qalba al-muḥibbi); 'wearied'
فِرَاقِنَا: فِرَاق + نَا — firāq, separation, parting (verbal noun of فَارَقَ, m., gen. after عَلَى; iṣbir ʿalā, 'bear patiently', the verb chooses ʿalā) + -nā, our; 'our parting'
التَّفْسِيرَ: الـ + تَّفْسِير — al-, the (def. art., assimilated to tāʾ); tafsīr, explanation, interpretation (verbal noun of فَسَّرَ, m., acc. as object of سَمِعْتُ); 'the explanation'
انْطَلَقَتْ: انْطَلَقَتْ — inṭalaqat, broke out, was let loose (perfect 3rd f. sing. of انْطَلَقَ, inṭalaqa, form VII; agreeing with the fem. sing. of non-human plural النِّيرَانُ); 'broke out'
الْأَحْزَانُ: الـ + أَحْزَان — al-, the (def. art.); aḥzān, sorrows, griefs (pl. of حُزْن, ḥuzn; m., nom., subject of زَادَتْ, here with bi-qalbī); 'the sorrows'
فَصِحْتُ: فَـ + صِحْتُ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence); ṣiḥtu, I cried out (perfect 1st sing. of صَاحَ, ṣāḥa); 'and I cried out'
تُدَبِّرِى: تُدَبِّرِي — tudabbirī, you arrange, contrive (subjunctive 2nd f. sing. of دَبَّرَ, dabbara, form II, after أَنْ; ending ي printed ى, with lī 'for me'); 'that you contrive'
أَتَوَصَّلُ: أَتَوَصَّلُ — atawaṣṣalu, I reach, attain (imperfect 1st sing. of تَوَصَّلَ, tawaṣṣala, form V; chooses بِـ for the means and إِلَى for the goal; here 'by which I reach her'); 'I may reach'
بِالْفِكْرِ: بِـ + الـ + فِكْر — bi-, with (prep.; with مَلْآنُ, marks what one is full of); al-, the; fikr, thought, worry (m., gen.); 'with thought'
رُحِ: رُحِ — ruḥi, go (imperative m. sing. of رَاحَ, rāḥa; kasra on ḥāʾ only to join the next word, الليلة); 'go'
تَبْلُغُ: تَبْلُغُ — tablughu, you reach, attain (imperfect 2nd m. sing. of بَلَغَ, balagha; takes direct object الْمَرَامَ); 'you will attain'
تَأْمُرِينِي: تَأْمُرِينِي — taʾmurīnī, you (f.) command me (Middle Arabic for taʾmurīnanī; imperfect 2nd f. sing. of أَمَرَ, amara + -nī, me; takes بِـ for the thing, with bihi); 'you command me'
كُلِ: كُلِ — kuli, eat (imperative m. sing. of أَكَلَ, akala; kasra only to join the next word, الآن); 'eat'
كِفَايَتِي: كِفَايَة + ي — kifāya, sufficiency, enough (verbal noun of كَفَى, kafā; f., acc. as object of أَكَلْتُ) + -ī, my; 'my fill'
وَأَتَتْنِي: و + أَتَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); atat, she brought/came (perfect 3rd f. sing. of أَتَى, atā) + -nī, me; with بِـ following, أَتَى بِـ means 'bring'; 'and she brought me'
أَذْكُرَلَهَا: أَذْكُرَ + لَهَا — two words printed as one: adhkura, I mention (subjunctive 1st sing. of ذَكَرَ, dhakara, after an) + li-hā, لِـ 'to' (prep., dative) + -hā, her; 'that I mention to her'
وَحَذَّرَتْنِي: و + حَذَّرَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); ḥadhdharat, she warned (perfect 3rd f. sing. of حَذَّرَ, ḥadhdhara, form II) + -nī, me; 'and she warned me'
بِأَصَابِعِى: بِـ + أَصَابِع + ي — bi-, with (prep., instrument); aṣābiʿ, fingers (pl. of إِصْبَع, iṣbaʿ; gen.) + -ī, my (final ي printed ى); 'with my fingers'
وَأَهُزُّ: و + أَهُزُّ — wa-, and (conj.); ahuzzu, I shake (imperfect 1st sing. of هَزَّ, hazza; following جَعَلْتُ, 'I kept on'); 'and shaking'
مَلْأٰنُ: مَلْآن — malʾān, full (diptote faʿlān adjective, m., nom., predicate of inna qalbī; printed ملأن without its long alif); 'full'
بِأَصَابِعِي: بِـ + أَصَابِع + ـي — bi-, with (prep. of instrument); aṣābiʿ, fingers (pl. of iṣbaʿ; gen. after bi-) + -ī, my; 'with my fingers'
فَجُعْتُ: فَـ + جَاعَ + تُ — fa-, and so (conj. of sequence); jāʿa, to be hungry (hollow verb I, perf. 1s, -tu, stem shortened to juʿ-); with min, 'from' (cause), min al-sahar; 'and I grew hungry'
جُوعِي: جُوع + ـي — jūʿ, hunger (m., nom., subject of fa-zdāda) + -ī, my; 'my hunger'
غِطَاوَهَا: غِطَاء + هَا — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (m., acc., object of kashafa) + -hā, its (the food-cloth); the edition's spelling غطاوها (hamza written as wāw) is non-Classical for غطاءها; 'its cover'
بَاطِيَةِ: بَاطِيَة — bāṭiya, large bowl, flagon (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-khamr, after ilā; atā ilā, 'came to'); 'the flagon (of wine)'
فَشَرِبْتُهُ: فَـ + شَرِبَ + تُ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu) + -hu, it (the cup, object); 'and I drank it'
كَالْقَتِيلِ: كَـ + الـ + قَتِيل — ka-, like (prep. of comparison); qatīl, slain (m., adj. of passive sense from qatala, gen. after ka-); 'like the slain'
وَمَازِلْتُ: وَ + مَا زَالَ + تُ — wa-, and (conj.); mā zāla, to cease not, continue (negated verb of the kāna group, perf. 1s, -tu, stem zil-); the edition prints wa-mā and zilt run together as one word; 'and I continued (thus)'
فَانْتَبَهْتُ: فَـ + انْتَبَهَ + تُ — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); intabaha, to wake up (verb VIII, perf. 1s, -tu; the alif is hamzat al-waṣl, dropped after fa-); 'and I woke'
شَفْرَةٌ: شَفْرَة — shafra, large knife, blade (f., nom., indefinite postposed subject of the predicate ʿalā baṭnī); the print's pointing shafra, taken as the usual shafra; 'a knife-blade'
مَاضِيَةٌ: مَاضِيَة — māḍiya, sharp, cutting (act. part. of maḍā; f., nom., adj. of shafra); 'sharp'
وَدِرْهَمُ: وَ + دِرْهَم — wa-, and (conj.); dirham, silver coin (m., nom., coordinated with shafra, first term of an iḍāfa with ḥadīd); 'and a dirham (of iron)'
وَأَخَذْتُهُمَا: وَ + أَخَذَ + تُ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.); akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu) + -humā, them both (dual; the knife and the dirham); 'and I took the two of them'
مِسْكِينَةٌ: مِسْكِينَة — miskīna, wretched, poor (f., nom., predicate of inna, with ḥazīna); 'wretched'
مُعِينٌ: مُعِين — muʿīn, helper (act. part. of IV aʿāna; m., nom. with tanwīn, subject of laysa, which stands before it with lī); 'a helper'
طُولِى: طُول + ـي — ṭūl, length (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; min ṭūlī, 'at full length'; the edition prints final ى for ي (ṭūlā for ṭūlī); 'at my full length'
وَالدِّرْهَمَ: وَ + الـ + دِرْهَم — wa-, and (conj.); dirham, silver coin (m., acc., coordinated with al-sikkīn, objects of ramaytu); 'and the dirham'
عَرَّفْتُهَا: عَرَّفَ + تُ + هَا — ʿarrafa, to make known, inform (verb II, perf. 1s, -tu; the thing told is introduced by bi-, bi-mā ḥaṣala lī) + -hā, her; 'I informed her'
أَنَلْ: أَنَالَ — nāla, to attain, obtain (hollow verb I, imperf. 1s, jussive after lam, shortened to anal; lam anal); 'I have not attained'
أَرَبِي: أَرَب + ـي — arab, aim, need, desire (m., acc., object of lam anal) + -ī, my; 'my aim'
حُزْنُهَا: حُزْن + هَا — ḥuzn, grief (m., nom., subject of ishtadda) + -hā, her; with ʿalayya, 'over me'; 'her grief'
لَمَّارَأَتْ: لَمَّا + رَأَتْ — lammā, when (temporal conj. + perfect) + raʾat, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at); the edition prints lammā raʾat as one word, لمارأت; 'when she saw'
وَوَجْدِي: وَ + وَجْد + ـي — wa-, and (conj.); wajd, passion, ardent love (m.) + -ī, my; coordinated with bukāʾī, objects of raʾat; 'and my passion'
عَجَزْتُ: عَجَزَ + تُ — ʿajaza, to be powerless, give up (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); 'I have become powerless'
أَنْصَحُكَ: أَنْصَحُ + كَ — naṣaḥa, to counsel, advise (verb I, imperf. 1s, indic.) + -ka, you (ms, object); here with ʿan, 'against', ʿan al-nawm; 'I counsel you'
نُصْحِي: نُصْح + ـي — nuṣḥ, counsel, advice (m., acc., object of lam tasmaʿ) + -ī, my; 'my counsel'
فَكَلَامِي: فَـ + كَلَام + ـي — fa-, so, consequently (conj. of result); kalām, speech (m., nom., subject of lā yufīdu) + -ī, my; 'so my speech'
أَسْأَلُكِ: أَسْأَلُ + كِ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 1s, indic.) + -ki, you (fs); followed by bi-llāh, the bi- of adjuration, 'by God'; 'I ask you'
تُفَسِّرِي: تُفَسِّرِي — fassara, to explain, interpret (verb II, imperf. 2fs, subjunctive after an, final nūn dropped, -ī); with lī, 'for me'; 'that you interpret'
السِّكِّينِ: الـ + سِكِّين — sikkīn, knife (m./f., gen., second term of the iḍāfa ishārat al-sikkīn); 'the knife'
وَالدِّرْهَمِ: وَ + الـ + دِرْهَم — wa-, and (conj.); dirham, silver coin (m., gen., coordinated with al-sikkīn within the iḍāfa after ishāra); 'and the dirham'
الْحَدِيدُ: الـ + حَدِيد — ḥadīd, iron (m., nom., in apposition to al-dirham, 'the dirham of iron'); 'the iron'
تُقْسِمُ: أَقْسَمَ — aqsama, to swear (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, indic.; the oath is introduced by bi-, here bi-hā, 'by it', the eye); 'she swears'
رَجَعْتَ: رَجَعَ + تَ — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, perf. 2ms, -ta; in the protasis of in, with future sense); 'you return'; here past, after arāka: arāka rajaʿta, 'I see you have come back'
وَنِمْتَ: وَ + نَامَ + تَ — wa-, and (conj.); nāma, to sleep (hollow verb I, perf. 2ms, stem nim-, -ta); 'and you sleep'
لَأَذْبَحَنَّكَ: لَـ + أَذْبَحَ + نَّ + كَ — la-, surely (emphatic lām introducing the oath's answer); dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, imperf. 1s with nūn of emphasis, -anna) + -ka, you (ms, object); 'I will surely slaughter you' (with bi-hādhihi al-sikkīn, bi- of instrument)
بِالْحُزْنِ: بِـ + الـ + حُزْن — bi-, with (prep.; malʾān bi-, 'full of'); ḥuzn, grief (m., gen.); 'with the grief' (full of grief)
وَاحْذَرِ: وَ + احْذَرْ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥadhira, to beware (verb I, imperative 2ms, with kasra before al-; transitive, takes al-nawm directly); 'and beware (the sleep)'
تَفُوزُ: تَفُوزُ — fāza, to win, succeed (hollow verb I, imperf. 2ms, indic.; chooses bi-, fāza bi-, 'obtain'); 'you will win'
بِحَاجَتِكَ: بِـ + حَاجَة + كَ — bi-, (the preposition chosen by fāza: fāza bi-, 'win, obtain'); ḥāja, need (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'your need'
عَادَتِكَ: عَادَة + كَ — ʿāda, habit, custom (f., gen. after ʿalā, ʿalā ʿādatika, 'according to your habit') + -ka, your; 'your habit'
ذَبَحَتْكَ: ذَبَحَتْ + كَ — dhabaḥat + ka: dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at; perfect in the apodosis, future sense) + -ka, you (ms, object); the print has ذبحنك, a corrected misprint; 'she will slaughter you'
تُسَاعِدِينِي: تُسَاعِدِي + نِي — sāʿada, to help (verb III, imperf. 2fs, subjunctive after an, -ī, nūn dropped) + -nī, me (the nūn is the protective nūn); 'that you help me'
وَرَأْسِي: وَ + رَأْس + ـي — wa-, and (conj.); raʾs, head (m., gen. coordinated after ʿalā) + -ī, my; ʿalā ʿaynī wa-raʾsī, 'on my eye and my head', an expression of ready compliance; 'and my head'
وَأَطَعْتَ: وَ + أَطَاعَ + تَ — wa-, and (conj.); aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV, perf. 2ms, -ta; takes a direct object, amrī); 'and you obey'
قَضَيْتَ: قَضَى + تَ — qaḍā, to accomplish, fulfil (verb I, perf. 2ms, -ta; apodosis of in with future sense); 'you will accomplish'
وَأُطِيعُ: وَ + أُطِيعُ — wa-, and (conj.); aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV, imperf. 1s, indic.; direct object); 'and I obey'
أَمْرَكِ: أَمْر + كِ — amr, command (m., acc., object of uṭīʿu) + -ki, your (fs); 'your command'
ضَمَّتْنِي: ضَمَّ + تْ + نِي — ḍamma, to press, clasp (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at) + -nī, me; with ilā ḥiḍnihā, 'to her bosom'; 'she pressed me'
تَكْبِسُنِي: تَكْبِسُ + نِي — kabasa, to press, knead, massage (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic.) + -nī, me; after lā zālat, 'did not cease', 'kept on'; 'pressing me'
غَلَبَنِي: غَلَبَ + نِي — ghalaba, to overcome (verb I, perf. 3ms; transitive) + -nī, me; subject al-nuʿās, drowsiness; 'overcame me'
مِرْوَحَةً: مِرْوَحَة — mirwaḥa, fan (f., acc. with tanwīn, object of akhadhat; instrument noun from rawwaḥa); 'a fan'
تُرَوِّحُ: تُرَوِّحُ — rawwaḥa, to fan (verb II, imperf. 3fs, indic., a circumstantial clause); with ʿalā wajhī, 'upon my face'; 'fanning'
وَجَدتُّهَا: وَجَدَ + تُّ + هَا — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hā, her; the edition prints the dāl assimilated to the tāʾ (wajattuhā for wajadtuhā); 'I found her'
الْمِرْوَحَةُ: الـ + مِرْوَحَة — mirwaḥa, fan (f., nom., postposed subject of fī yadihā, 'in her hand the fan'); 'the fan'
وَدُمُوعُهَا: وَ + دُمُوع + هَا — wa-, and (conj. of circumstance, ḥāl); dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ; nom., subject of qad ballat) + -hā, her; 'and her tears'
بَلَّتْ: بَلَّ + تْ — balla, to wet, moisten (verb I, doubled root, perf. 3fs, -at; qad balla, 'had wetted'); 'had wetted'
بِشَئٍ: بِـ + شَيْء — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾa bi-, 'come with' = 'bring', the verb chooses bi-); shayʾ, thing (m., gen. with tanwīn); the edition spells شَئٍ (yāʾ dropped) for شَيْءٍ; 'with something', i.e. 'brought something'
أُخَالِفْهَا: لَمْ + أُخَالِفْ + هَا — lam, not (neg. particle with the jussive); khālafa, to oppose, disobey (verb III, imperf. 1s, jussive) + -hā, her (direct object); 'I did not oppose her'
أَمْضَغُ: أَمْضَغُ — maḍagha, to chew (verb I, imperf. 1s, indic.; a circumstantial clause after wa-anā); 'I chewed'
امْتَلَأْتُ: امْتَلَأَ + تُ — imtalaʾa, to be filled (verb VIII, perf. 1s, -tu); after ḥattā, 'until'; 'I was full'
أَسْقَتْنِي: أَسْقَى + تْ + نِي — asqā, to give to drink (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -at; two objects) + -nī, me, the first object; 'she gave me to drink'
نَقِيعَ: نَقِيع — naqīʿ, infusion, steeped drink (m., acc., second object of asqat; first term of an iḍāfa with ʿunnāb); 'an infusion (of)'
عُنَّابٍ: عُنَّاب — ʿunnāb, jujube (m. collective, gen. with tanwīn, second term of the iḍāfa); 'of jujube'
وَنَشَّفَتْهَا: وَ + نَشَّفَ + تْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); nashshafa, to dry (verb II, perf. 3fs, -at) + -hā, it (my hand, yadī, fem.); 'and dried it'
بِمَحْرَمَةٍ: بِـ + مَحْرَمَة — bi-, with (prep. of instrument); maḥrama, napkin, kerchief (f., gen. with tanwīn); 'with a napkin'
أَلْبَسَتْنِي: أَلْبَسَ + تْ + نِي — albasa, to clothe (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -at; two objects) + -nī, me, the first object (clothes, thiyābī, the second); 'she clothed me'
اسْهَرْ: اسْهَرْ — sahira, to stay awake (verb I, imperative 2ms, with hamzat al-waṣl); 'stay awake'
تَأْتِيكَ: تَأْتِي + كَ — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic.; takes the person directly, -ka, 'to you'); 'she will come to you'
لَاتَنْسَ: لَا + تَنْسَ — lā, do not (prohibitive) + nasiya, to forget (verb I, imperf. 2ms, jussive); the edition prints lā tansa as one word; 'do not forget'
وَصِيَّتِي: وَصِيَّة + ـي — waṣiyya, charge, injunction (f., acc., object of lā tansa) + -ī, my; 'my charge'
فَأَوْجَعَنِي: فَـ + أَوْجَعَ + نِي — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); awjaʿa, to pain (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; subject qalbī; 'and it pained me'
الْوَصِيَّةُ: الـ + وَصِيَّة — waṣiyya, charge, injunction (f., nom., predicate/subject in mā al-waṣiyyatu, 'what is the charge'); 'the charge'
وَعَدْتِنِي: وَعَدَ + تِ + نِي — waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 2fs, -ti; the thing promised is introduced by bi-, here bihā) + -nī, me; 'you promised me'
انْصَرَفْتَ: انْصَرَفَ + تَ — inṣarafa, to depart (verb VII, perf. 2ms, -ta; with min ʿindihā, 'from her presence'); 'you depart'
وَسَهِرْتُ: وَ + سَهِرَ + تُ — wa-, and (conj.); sahira, to stay awake (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); 'and I stayed awake'
رُبْعِ: رُبْع — rubʿ, quarter (m., gen. after ilā; first term of an iḍāfa with al-layl); 'a quarter (of the night)'
فَمَكَثْتُ: فَـ + مَكَثَ + تُ — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); makatha, to remain, stay (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); 'and I remained'
سَاهِرًا: سَاهِر — sāhir, wakeful (act. part. of sahira; m., acc., ḥāl); 'awake'
مَضَي: مَضَى — maḍā, to pass (verb I, perf. 3ms); the edition prints مضي with ي for final ى; 'had passed'
أَرْبَاعِ: أَرْبَاع — arbāʿ, quarters (pl. of rubʿ; gen. as second term of the iḍāfa after thalāthat; first term of an iḍāfa with al-layl); 'quarters (of the night)'
الدُّيُوكُ: الـ + دُيُوك — dayūk, cocks (pl. of dīk; nom., subject of ṣāḥat, the verb in fem. sg. agreeing with a broken plural); 'the cocks'
وَفَمِي: وَ + فَم + ـي — wa-, and (conj.); fam, mouth (m., acc., coordinated with yadī, objects of ghasaltu) + -ī, my; 'and my mouth'
وَنَبَّهْتُ: وَ + نَبَّهَ + تُ — wa-, and (conj.); nabbaha, to rouse, wake (verb II, perf. 1s, -tu; with nafsī as reflexive object); 'and I roused (myself)'
حُلَّةٌ: حُلَّة — ḥulla, robe, suit of clothes (f., nom. with tanwīn, postposed subject of ʿalayhā, 'on her'); 'a robe'
تَتِيهُ: تَتِيهُ — tāha, to be proud, bear oneself haughtily (hollow verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic.; with ʿalā, 'over'); 'she bears herself proudly'
مُفَكَّكَةُ: مُفَكَّكَة — mufakkaka, unfastened, undone (pass. part. of II fakkaka; f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa with al-azrār); the print's nom. runs as a predicate of an omitted subject, where a ḥāl would be acc.; 'unfastened (of)'
مَحْلُولَةُ: مَحْلُولَة — maḥlūla, loosened, let down (pass. part. of ḥalla; f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa with al-shaʿr), same construction as mufakkakatu; 'loosened (of)'
الْاِسْمُ: الـ + اِسْم — ism, name (m., nom., in mā al-ismu, 'what is the name'); the print writes the alif of waṣl after al-; 'the name'
كَوَيْتُ: كَوَى + تُ — kawā, to brand, cauterise, burn (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu); 'I branded'
قُلُوبَ: قُلُوب — qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb; acc., object of kawaytu; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ʿāshiqīn); 'hearts (of)'
الْجَمْرِ: الـ + جَمْر — jamr, embers, live coals (m. collective, gen. after ʿalā); 'the embers'
اُقَاسِي: أُقَاسِي — qāsā, to suffer, endure (verb III, imperf. 1s, indic., uqāsī; the print writes the initial hamza as a bare alif; relative clause without expressed object); 'I suffer'
صَخْرٍ: صَخْر — ṣakhr, rock (m. collective, gen. with tanwīn after ilā; shakā ilā, the person complained to); 'a rock'
شَكَوْتَ: شَكَا + تَ — shakā, to complain (verb I, perf. 2ms, -ta; chooses ilā for the one complained to, min or ʿan for the grievance); 'you complained'
تَدْرِ: لَمْ + تَدْرِ — lam, not (neg. particle with the jussive); darā, to know (verb I, imperf. 2ms, jussive tadri, with the final ī shortened); 'you did not know'
صَخْرَةً: صَخْرَة — ṣakhra, rock (f. nomen unitatis, acc., predicate of kāna, in an if-clause); 'a rock'
اَنْبَعَ: أَنْبَعَ — anbaʿa, to cause to gush (verb IV, perf. 3ms; the print writes the hamza as a bare alif); subject Allāh; 'made gush forth'
الزُّلَالَ: الـ + زُّلَال — zulāl, sweet clear water (m., acc., object of anbaʿa); 'the sweet water'
يَغْلِبْ: لَمْ + يَغْلِبْ — lam, not (neg. particle with the jussive); ghalaba, to overcome (verb I, imperf. 3ms, jussive; transitive with ʿalā, ʿalayka); 'has not overcome'
وَحَيْثُ: وَ + حَيْثُ — wa-, and (conj.); ḥaythu, where (adv., indeclinable in -u), here causal 'since'; 'and since'
سَهِرْتَ: سَهِرَ + تَ — sahira, to stay awake (verb I, perf. 2ms, -ta; with al-layl as acc. of time, 'through the night'); 'you stayed awake'
شِيَمِ: شِيَم — shiyam, natures, characteristics (pl. of shīma; gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ʿushshāq); 'qualities (of)'
مُكَابَدَةِ: مُكَابَدَة — mukābada, enduring, bearing hardship (verbal noun of III kābada; f., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ashwāq); fī, 'in the course of'; 'enduring (of)'
وَغَمَزَتْهُنَّ: وَ + غَمَزَ + تْ + هُنَّ — wa-, and (conj.); ghamaza, to wink at, signal to (verb I, perf. 3fs, -at; direct object) + -hunna, them (fpl.); 'and she winked at them'
فَانْصَرَفْنَ: فَـ + انْصَرَفَ + نَ — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); inṣarafa, to depart (verb VII, perf. 3fpl, -na; with ʿanhā, 'from her'); 'and they went away'
وَبَاسَتْنِي: وَ + بَاسَ + تْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.); bāsa, to kiss (hollow verb I, perf. 3fs, -at) + -nī, me; 'and she kissed me'
وَبُسْتُهَا: وَ + بَاسَ + تُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.); bāsa, to kiss (hollow verb I, perf. 1s, stem shortened to bus-, -tu) + -hā, her; 'and I kissed her'
شَفَتِي: شَفَة + ـي — shafa, lip (f., acc., object of maṣṣat) + -ī, my; 'my lip'
الْفَوْقَانِيَّةَ: الـ + فَوْقَانِيَّة — fawqāniyya, upper (f., acc., nisba adjective from fawq, 'above', agreeing with shafatī); 'the upper (lip)'
وَمَصَصْتُ: وَ + مَصَّ + تُ — wa-, and (conj.); maṣṣa, to suck (verb I, doubled root, perf. 1s, stem unmerged, maṣaṣtu); 'and I sucked'
شَفَتَهَا: شَفَة + هَا — shafa, lip (f., acc., object of maṣaṣtu) + -hā, her; 'her lip'
التَّحْتَانِيَّةَ: الـ + تَّحْتَانِيَّة — taḥtāniyya, lower (f., acc., nisba adjective from taḥt, 'below', agreeing with shafatahā); 'the lower (lip)'
وَغَمَزْتُهُ: وَ + غَمَزَ + تُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.); ghamaza, to press, squeeze (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu) + -hu, it (the waist, khaṣr, m.); 'and I pressed it'
خَلَاخِلِ: خَلَاخِل — khalākhil, anklets (pl. of khalkhāl; gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa with rijlayhā); 'anklets (of)'
الْهِرَاشِ: الـ + هِرَاش — hirāsh, romping, scuffling (verbal noun of III hārasha; m., gen. after fī; akhadha fī, 'set about'); 'the romping'
وَالتَّعْنِيقِ: وَ + الـ + تَّعْنِيق — wa-, and (conj.); taʿnīq, embracing (verbal noun of II ʿannaqa; m., gen., coordinated); 'and the embracing'
وَالْغُنْجِ: وَ + الـ + غُنْج — wa-, and (conj.); ghunj, coquetry, amorous play (m., gen., coordinated); 'and the coquetry'
الرَّقِيقِ: الـ + رَّقِيق — raqīq, thin, tender, gentle (m., gen., adjective of al-kalām); 'the tender'
وَالْعَضِّ: وَ + الـ + عَضّ — wa-, and (conj.); ʿaḍḍ, biting (verbal noun of ʿaḍḍa; m., gen., coordinated); 'and the biting'
السِّيقَانِ: الـ + سِّيقَان — sīqān, legs (pl. of sāq; gen., second term of the iḍāfa ḥaml al-sīqān, 'the lifting of the legs'); 'the legs'
وَالطَّوَافِ: وَ + الـ + طَّوَاف — wa-, and (conj.); ṭawāf, circling (verbal noun of ṭāfa; m., gen., coordinated); of the ritual circumambulation, here in a bawdy figure; 'and the circling'
بِالْبَيْتِ: بِـ + الـ + بَيْت — bi-, (the preposition chosen by ṭāfa, ṭawāf bi-, 'circle around'); bayt, house (m., gen.); the Kaʿba image, bawdily meant; 'the House'
وَالْأَرْكَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَرْكَان — wa-, and (conj.); arkān, corners, pillars (pl. of rukn; gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and the corners'
ارْتَخَتْ: ارْتَخَى + تْ — irtakhā, to grow slack, relax (verb VIII, perf. 3fs, -at; after ilā an, 'until'); 'grew slack'
مَفَاصِلُهَا: مَفَاصِل + هَا — mafāṣil, joints (pl. of mafṣil; nom., subject of irtakhat, fem. sg. verb with a broken plural) + -hā, her; 'her joints'
الْغَيْبُوبَةِ: الـ + غَيْبُوبَة — ghaybūba, swoon, unconsciousness (f., gen. after fī; dakhala fī, 'enter into'); 'the swoon'
مَسَّرَةَ: مَسَرَّة — masarra, joy, delight (f., acc., predicate of kānat; first term of an iḍāfa with al-qalb); the edition prints مَسَّرَةَ with the shadda misplaced on the sīn, for masarra; 'joy (of)'
وَقُرَّةَ: وَ + قُرَّة — wa-, and (conj.); qurra, coolness, delight (f., acc., coordinated; cf. qurrat al-ʿayn, 'delight of the eye'); 'and the coolness'
النَّاظِرِ: الـ + نَّاظِر — nāẓir, beholder, eye (act. part. of naẓara; m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the beholder'
اَهْنَى: أَهْنَأ — ahnaʾ, most pleasant, most agreeable (elative of hanīʾ; m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa with layālī); the edition prints اهنى, with ى for the hamza, ahnā for ahnaʾ; 'the most pleasant'
اَخْلُ: لَمْ + أَخْلُ — lam, not (neg. particle); khalā, to be empty (verb I, imperf. 1s) — the print's pointing akhlu, which does not construe with al-kaʾsu; the sense wants ukhli (IV, 'I did not leave empty') with al-kaʾsa as object; 'I did not leave (void)'
الْكَأْسُ: الـ + كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (f.); printed nom. al-kaʾsu, the print's pointing, where the sense wants the acc. al-kaʾsa as object of ukhli; 'the cup'
اِعْمَالِ: اِعْمَال — iʿmāl, using, employment (verbal noun of IV aʿmala; m., gen. after min), the print's pointing; 'use'
وَالْكَرَى: وَ + الـ + كَرَى — wa-, and (conj., closing bayna ... wa-, 'between ... and'); karā, slumber, drowsiness (m., gen., indeclinable -ā); 'and the slumber'
وَجَمَعْتُ: وَ + جَمَعَ + تُ — wa-, and (conj.); jamaʿa, to join, gather (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu; with bayna, 'between'); 'and I joined'
الْقُرْطِ: الـ + قُرْط — qurṭ, earring (m., gen. after bayna); 'the earring'
وَالْخَلْخَالِ: وَ + الـ + خَلْخَال — wa-, and (conj., second term of bayna ... wa-); khalkhāl, anklet (m., gen.); 'and the anklet'
وَاجْتَمَعْنَا: وَ + اجْتَمَعَ + نَا — wa-, and (conj.); ijtamaʿa, to come together (verb VIII, perf. 1pl, -nā); a euphemism for lovemaking; 'and we came together'; also: plainly 'and we were brought together' (ʿalā, with): wa-ijtamaʿnā ʿalayhi, 'and we were together with him again'
أَمْسَكَتْنِي: أَمْسَكَ + تْ + نِي — amsaka, to hold, seize (verb IV, perf. 3fs, -at) + -nī, me; follows wa-idhā bihā, 'and behold her'; 'she held me fast'
وَأُوصِيَكَ: وَ + أُوصِيَ + كَ — wa-, and + awṣā, to charge, commission (verb IV, subj. 1cs, here after ḥattā) + 2ms obj.; 'and (so that) I charge you'
وَصِيَّةً: وَصِيَّةً — waṣiyya, charge, commission, bequest (f., acc. indef.); 'a charge' (cognate object of awṣā, adding weight)
فَحَلَّتْ: فَـ + حَلَّتْ — fa-, so/and + ḥalla, to untie, undo (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she untied'
وَتَوَاعَدْتُ: وَ + تَوَاعَدْتُ — wa-, and + tawāʿada, to make a mutual promise, agree (verb VI, perf. 1cs; the pronoun anā wa-iyyāhā adds 'she and I'); 'and I agreed'
آتِي: آتِي — ātī, I come (verb I hamzated, defective; imperf. 1cs, indic., in the clause after annī, 'that I'); 'that I would come'
أَوْصَتْنِي: أَوْصَتْ + نِي — awṣā, to charge (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; the verb takes bi- for the thing charged (awṣā-nī bi-hi 'charged me with it'); 'she had charged me'
اللَّتِي: اللَّتِي — allatī, who/which (f. sg. relative pronoun; the print's usual spelling with two lāms); 'in which (was)' referring to al-khirqa
وَمَااسْمُ: وَ + مَا + اسْمُ — wa-, and + mā, what (interrogative) + ism, name (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa; run together in print); 'and what is the name of'
نُورُالْهُدَى: نُورُ + الْهُدَى — Nūr al-Hudā, 'Light of Right Guidance' (nūr, light, nom., + al-hudā, guidance, gen.; proper name, two words printed as one)
فَاحْتَفِظْ: فَـ + احْتَفِظْ — fa-, so + iḥtafaẓa, to keep, guard (verb VIII, imper. 2ms); takes bi- for the thing kept (iḥtafiẓ bi-); 'so keep safe'
نَسِيتُهُ: نَسِيتُ + هُ — nasiya, to forget (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'I forgot it'
أَشْغَلَنِي: أَشْغَلَ + نِي — ashghala, to occupy, distract (verb IV, perf. 3ms; the print's form, Classical shaghala) + 1cs obj.; 'distracted me' (from it, ʿanhu)
تُطِقِ: تُطِقِ — tuṭiq, she was able to (ṭāqa, verb IV hollow, jussive 3fs after lam, with kasra before the article); 'she could not bear'
وَأَفَاضَتْ: وَ + أَفَاضَتْ — wa-, and + afāḍa, to make overflow, pour out (verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and she poured out'
دَمْعَ: دَمْعَ — damʿ, tears, weeping (m., acc., first term of iḍāfa with al-ʿayn); 'the tear (of the eye)'
الْعِنَاقُ: الْعِنَاقُ — al-ʿināq, embrace, embracing (m., nom.; the article + masdar of ʿānaqa); 'the embracing' (subject of yaghurranna-ka)
وَاٰخِرُ: وَ + آخِرُ — wa-, and + ākhir, last, end (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa; print writes the ā with a dagger alif); 'and the end of'
فَوَهَبْتُهَا: فَـ + وَهَبْتُ + هَا — fa-, so + wahaba, to give, grant (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj. (the rag, f.); 'so I gave it' (to her, lahā, follows as its own word)
مَصْحُوبًا: مَصْحُوبًا — maṣḥūb, accompanied (m. sg. passive participle of ṣaḥiba, acc. ḥāl); 'accompanied (by safety)', a parting blessing
أَخْبَرْتُكَ: أَخْبَرْتُ + كَ — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I told you'
وَنَسِيتَهُ: وَ + نَسِيتَ + هُ — wa-, and + nasiya, to forget (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3ms obj.; 'and you forgot it'
أَعِيدِيهِ: أَعِيدِي + هِ — aʿāda, to repeat, bring back (verb IV hollow, imper. 2fs) + 3ms obj.; 'repeat it'
فَأَعَادَتْهُ: فَـ + أَعَادَتْ + هُ — fa-, so + aʿāda, to repeat (verb IV hollow, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'and she repeated it'
وَأَجْلَسَتْنِي: وَ + أَجْلَسَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ajlasa, to seat, make sit (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she seated me'
حِجْرِهَا: حِجْرِ + هَا — ḥijr, lap, bosom (m., gen. after fī) + 3fs suffix; 'her lap'
وَقَضَيْنَا: وَ + قَضَيْنَا — wa-, and + qaḍā, to accomplish, fulfil (verb I defective, perf. 1cp); 'and we accomplished'
أَغْرَاضَنَا: أَغْرَاضَ + نَا — aghrāḍ, purposes, desires (m. broken pl. of gharaḍ, acc. object) + 1cp suffix; 'our purposes' (a plain phrase for lovemaking)
أَنْشَدْتُهَا: أَنْشَدْتُ + هَا — anshada, to recite (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj.; 'I recited to her'
يُدَارِي: يُدَارِي — yudārī, he conceals, manages gently (dārā, verb III defective, imperf. 3ms); 'he keeps disguised'
وَيَصْبِرُ: وَ + يَصْبِرُ — wa-, and + ṣabara, to be patient (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and is patient'
الْاُمُوْرِ: الْأُمُورِ — al-umūr, the affairs, things (m. broken pl. of amr, gen. after kull; as the print points it); 'all the affairs' Also gen. after baʿd: min baʿdi al-umūri, 'after (some) things' (Night 191).
وَيَخْضَعُ: وَ + يَخْضَعُ — wa-, and + khaḍaʿa, to submit, bow (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and submits'
فَحَفِظْتُهُ: فَـ + حَفِظْتُ + هُ — fa-, so + ḥafiẓa, to memorise, keep (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'so I memorised it'
حَاجَةِ: حَاجَةِ — ḥāja, need, errand (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa with ibnat ʿammī); 'the need (of my cousin)'
حٰلِهَا: حَالِ + هَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f., gen. after ʿalā; print writes it without alif, with a dagger alif) + 3fs suffix; 'her state'
تَسْأَلُ: تَسْأَلُ — tasʾalu, you ask (saʾala, verb I, imperf. 2ms, indic.); takes ʿan for the matter asked about (ʿan maraḍihā); 'you ask (about)'
مَرَضِهَا: مَرَضِ + هَا — maraḍ, sickness, illness (m., gen. after ʿan) + 3fs suffix; ʿan, about; 'her illness'
أَنْشَدْتَهَا: أَنْشَدْتَ + هَا — anshada, to recite (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 3fs obj.; 'you recited to her'
وَأَنْشَدَتْنِي: وَ + أَنْشَدَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + anshada, to recite (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she recited to me'
وَحَفِظْتُهُ: وَ + حَفِظْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥafiẓa, to memorise (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms obj.; 'and I memorised it'
أَسْمَعْتُهَا: أَسْمَعْتُ + هَا — asmaʿa, to make hear, recite to (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 3fs obj. (taking a second object iyyāhu); 'I made her hear'
يَتَقَطَّعُ: يَتَقَطَّعُ — yataqaṭṭaʿu, it is cut to pieces (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'is torn to pieces'
حَاوَلَ: حَاوَلَ — ḥāwala, to try, strive for (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'he has tried'
الصَّبَابَةِ: الصَّبَابَةِ — al-ṣabāba, ardent, wasting love, longing (f., gen. after fī); 'the longing'; also gen. after min (khuliqtu mina al-ṣabābati, 'I was created from ardent love')
يَجْزَعُ: يَجْزَعُ — yajzaʿu, he frets, is distressed (jazaʿa, verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'is distressed'
ذَهَبْتَ: ذَهَبْتَ — dhahaba, to go (verb I, perf. 2ms); with ilayhā 'to her'; 'you went'
سَمِعْتَهُمَا: سَمِعْتَ + هُمَا — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3 dual obj.; the print follows it with the singular alladhī; 'you have heard them (both)'
يَقْصُرُ: يَقْصُرُ — yaqṣuru, it falls short (qaṣara, verb I, imperf. 3ms); takes ʿan for what it falls short of (ʿan waṣfihi); 'falls short (of)'
ذَيْنِكَ: ذَيْنِ + كَ — dhayni, these two (m. dual demonstrative, oblique form, here acc., object of anshadtu) + ka, the distal particle; 'those two' (dual of dhālika)
آخِرِهِمَا: آخِرِ + هِمَا — ākhir, end, last (m., gen. after ilā) + 3 dual suffix; ilā, to; 'to the end of them (both)'
سَمِعَتْهُمَا: سَمِعَتْ + هُمَا — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3fs) + 3 dual obj.; 'she heard them both'
مَدَامِعُهَا: مَدَامِعُ + هَا — madāmiʿ, tears, tear ducts (m. broken pl. of madmaʿ, nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her tears'
الْمَحَاجِرِ: الْمَحَاجِرِ — al-maḥājir, the eye-sockets, hollows of the eyes (m. broken pl. of maḥjar, gen. after min); min, from; 'the eye-sockets'
لِكِتْمَانِ: لِـ + كِتْمَانِ — li-, for, of purpose + kitmān, hiding, concealment (m., gen., masdar of katama; first term of iḍāfa); 'for the hiding (of)'; here after the elatives aqrab and aḥfaẓ, li- names what one is fit for: aḥfaẓu li-kitmāni al-sirri, 'better at keeping the secret'
اَنْفَعُ: أَنْفَعُ — anfaʿ, more useful, more beneficial (elative, root n-f-ʿ; m., nom., subject of laysa, with lahu as predicate); 'more useful'
اَطَعْنَا: أَطَعْنَا — aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV hollow, perf. 1cp); 'we obeyed'
مُتْنَا: مُتْنَا — māta, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp, contracted mut-nā); 'we died'
فَبَلِّغُوا: فَـ + بَلِّغُوا — fa-, so + ballagha, to convey (verb II, imper. 2mp); 'so convey'
سَلَامِي: سَلَامِي — salām, greeting, peace (m., acc. object) + ī, my (1cs suffix); 'my greeting'; also nom., subject: salāmī ʿalā al-aḥbābi, 'my greeting (be) upon the loved ones' (Night 193, verse)
لِلْوَصْلِ: لِـ + الْوَصْلِ — li-, marking the object of yamnaʿu, set before the verb + al-waṣl, union, joining (m., gen.); 'the union'
هَنِيْأً: هَنِيئًا — hanīʾan, wholesome, may it do good (m. acc. adverbial; print's spelling هَنِيْأً); 'joy to'
لِاَرْبَابِ: لِـ + أَرْبَابِ — li-, to, for + arbāb, lords, masters (m. broken pl. of rabb, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'to the masters (of)'
نَعِيمُهُمْ: نَعِيمُ + هُمْ — naʿīm, bliss, delight (m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'their bliss'
وَلِلْعَاشِقِ: وَ + لِـ + الْعَاشِقِ — wa-, and + li-, to, for + al-ʿāshiq, the lover (m., act. part. of ʿashiqa, gen.); 'and to the lover'
يَتَجَرَّعُ: يَتَجَرَّعُ — yatajarraʿu, he gulps down, swallows bitterly (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'he swallows'
شُغْلَنَا: شُغْلَ + نَا — shughl, business, occupation (m., acc. object) + 1cp suffix; 'our business' (plain phrase for lovemaking)
وَتَضَجَّرَتْ: وَ + تَضَجَّرَتْ — wa-, and + taḍajjara, to be vexed, distressed (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and was distressed'
قَائِلَةَ: قَائِلَةَ — qāʾila, one who says, sayer (f. active part. of qāla, acc. after inna, first term of iḍāfa); 'the woman who said'
قَائِلَةُ: قَائِلَةُ — qāʾila, one who says, sayer (f. active part. of qāla, nom. subject, first term of iḍāfa); 'the woman who said (this verse)'
قَتَلْتَهَا: قَتَلْتَ + هَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 3fs obj.; 'you killed her'
قَتَلَكَ: قَتَلَ + كَ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; wish formula with Allāh as subject; 'may (God) kill you'
أَخْبَرْتَنِي: أَخْبَرْتَ + نِي — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'you told me'
قَرَّبْتُكَ: قَرَّبْتُ + كَ — qarraba, to bring near (verb II, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I brought you near'
تُفَسِّرُ: تُفَسِّرُ — tufassiru, she explains (fassara, verb II, imperf. 3fs, after kānat 'used to'); 'she used to interpret'
الْإِشَارَاتِ: الـ + إِشَارَاتِ — al-ishārāt, the signs, gestures (f. sound pl. of ishāra, acc. in -āti, object of tufassiru after tilka); 'the signs'
تُشِيرِينَ: تُشِيرِينَ — tushīrīna, you (f.) sign, gesture (ashāra, verb IV hollow, imperf. 2fs); takes bi- for the means (tushīrīna bi-hā 'sign with'); 'you used to sign'
أَصِلُ: أَصِلُ — aṣilu, I reach (waṣala, verb I assimilated, imperf. 1cs; ilā 'to'); 'I should reach'
وَأَفْعَلُ: وَ + أَفْعَلُ — wa-, and + afʿalu, I do, act (faʿala, verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'and do (with you)'
حَسَّرَكَ: حَسَّرَ + كَ — ḥassara, to make grieve, make lament (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; wish formula; 'may (God) make you grieve'
شَبَابِكَ: شَبَابِ + كَ — shabāb, youth (m., gen. after ʿalā; ʿalā marks what is grieved over) + 2ms suffix; 'your youth'; here also gen. as second term after salāmatu: salāmatu shabābika, '(God keep) your youth safe'
حَسَّرْتَهَا: حَسَّرْتَ + هَا — ḥassara, to make grieve (verb II, perf. 2ms) + 3fs obj.; 'you made her grieve'
انْظُرْهَا: انْظُرْ + هَا — unẓur, look at (naẓara, verb I, imper. 2ms, direct object, spoken use) + 3fs obj.; 'look at her'
فَذَهَبْتُ: فَـ + ذَهَبْتُ — fa-, so/and + dhahaba, to go (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'so I went'
مُتَشَوِّشٌ: مُتَشَوِّشٌ — mutashawwish, troubled, confused (m., nom. predicate; active part. of verb V tashawwasha, spoken word); 'troubled'
زُقَاقِنَا: زُقَاقِ + نَا — zuqāq, lane, alley (m., gen. after ilā) + 1cp suffix; 'our lane'
عِيَاطًا: عِيَاطًا — ʿiyāṭ, wailing, crying out (m., acc., object of samiʿtu; spoken word); 'wailing'
وَجَدْنَاهَا: وَجَدْ + نَا + هَا — wajada, to find (verb I, perf.) + 1cp subj. + 3fs obj.; 'we found her'
مَيِّتَةً: مَيِّتَةً — mayyita, dead (f. sg. adj., acc. ḥāl; from mayyit); 'dead'
خَطِيئَتَهَا: خَطِيئَةَ + هَا — khaṭīʾa, sin, guilt (f., acc. after inna, first term of iḍāfa) + 3fs suffix; 'the sin of her (death)'
ذِمَّتِكَ: ذِمَّةِ + كَ — dhimma, charge, responsibility (f., gen. after fī) + 2ms suffix; 'your charge, on your conscience'
وَعُنُقِكَ: وَ + عُنُقِ + كَ — wa-, and + ʿunuq, neck (m./f., gen., after fī) + 2ms suffix; 'and your neck'
سَامَحَكَ: سَامَحَ + كَ — sāmaḥa, to forgive, pardon (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; used after lā as a wish, with min for the matter forgiven (min damihā); 'may (God) not forgive you'
دَمِهَا: دَمِ + هَا — dam, blood (m., gen. after min; min marks what is forgiven) + 3fs suffix; 'her blood'
لِلْعِشْرِينَ: لِـ + الـ + عِشْرِين — li-, for (the night 'completing for' the twenty; the participle al-mūfiya takes li-) + al-, the + ʿishrūn, twenty (m., gen. pl. form ʿishrīn); 'for the twenty'
عَزِيزْ: ʿAzīz — personal name (m.), the youth, in apposition to al-shābba 'the youth'; printed without the accusative alif, read without case ending
وَجَهَّزْنَاهَا: وَ + جَهَّزْنَا + هَا — wa-, and + jahhaza, to make ready, prepare the dead for burial (verb II, perf. 1cp) + -hā, her (obj.); 'and we made her ready'
وَأَخْرَجْنَاهَا: وَ + أَخْرَجْنَا + هَا — wa-, and + akhraja, to bring out, carry out (verb IV, perf. 1cp) + -hā, her (obj.); 'and we carried her out'
وَشَيَّعْنَا: وَ + شَيَّعْنَا — wa-, and + shayyaʿa, to accompany, escort in procession (verb II, perf. 1cp); 'and we followed'
جِنَازَتَهَا: جِنَازَة + هَا — jināza, bier, funeral (f., acc., obj.) + -hā, her; 'her bier'
وَدَفَنَّاهَا: وَ + دَفَنَّا + هَا — wa-, and + dafana, to bury (verb I, perf. 1cp) + -hā, her (obj.); 'and we buried her'
الْخَتَمَاتِ: الـ + خَتَمَات — al-, the + khatamāt, pl. of khatma, a reading of the whole Qurʾān (f., acc. pl., obj. of ʿamilnā); 'the complete recitations'
وَمَكَثْنَا: وَ + مَكَثْنَا — wa-, and + makatha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 1cp; with ʿalā 'at/over'); 'and we stayed'
تَفْعَلُهُ: تَفْعَلُ + هُ — faʿala, to do (verb I, impf. 2ms, after kunta) + -hu, it (obj.); 'you used to do it'; here: 'you are doing (it)', the present
فَقَعْتَ: فَقَعْتَ — faqaʿa, to burst (verb I, perf. 2ms); faqaʿa marārata-hā 'you burst her gall-bladder', i.e. 'you broke her heart'
مَرَارَتَهَا: مَرَارَة + هَا — marāra, gall-bladder, gall (f., acc., obj. of faqaʿta) + -hā, her; 'her gall-bladder'
الْأَوْقَاتِ: الـ + أَوْقَات — al-, the + awqāt, pl. of waqt, time (m., gen. after kull); 'the times' (fī kulli al-awqāti, 'at all times, again and again')
أَطْلَعَتْنِي: أَطْلَعَ + تْ + نِي — aṭlaʿa, to let see, acquaint (verb IV, perf. 3fs; the verb chooses ʿalā, aṭlaʿa ʿalā 'acquaint with') + -nī, me; 'she let me see'
تُخْبِرْنِي: تُخْبِرْ + نِي — akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. 3fs, jussive after lam; the verb chooses bi-, akhbara bi- 'inform of') + -nī, me; 'she did not tell me'; also: 2ms jussive after lam: lam tukhbirnī, 'you have not told me'
يَقْتَصُّ: يَقْتَصُّ — iqtaṣṣa, to take retribution (verb VIII, doubled, impf. 3ms; li- 'on behalf of' the wronged, min 'from' the wrongdoer); 'he will take revenge'
رَاضِيَةٌ: رَاضِيَة — rāḍiya, content, pleased (act. part. of raḍiya, f., nom. indef., ḥāl; with ʿan 'with'); 'content'
امْرَأَةَ: امْرَأَة — imraʾa, wife, woman (f., acc., in construct, vocative after yā: 'O wife of'); 'O (wife of my uncle)'
وَلَدَكِ: وَلَد + كِ — walad, son (m., acc., obj. of jaʿala) + -ki, your (f.); 'your son'
حِلٍّ: حِلّ — ḥill, release, freedom from a claim (m., gen. after fī); fī ḥillin min damī, 'free of my blood'
آخَذَهُ: آخَذَ + هُ — ākhadha, to take to task, call to account (verb III, perf. 3ms, optative after lā) + -hu, him; 'may He not call him to account'
نَقَلَنِى: نَقَلَ + نِي — naqala, to move, transfer (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (obj.); 'He has moved me'
الْفَانِيَةِ: الـ + فَانِيَة — al-, the + fāniya, perishing, passing (act. part. of fanā, f., gen., adj. of al-dār); 'the perishing'
آلْآخِرَةِ: الـ + آخِرَة — al-, the + ākhira, last, hereafter (f. adj., gen., after al-dār; printed with madd alif); 'the last (abode)', the world to come
سَلَامَتُكِ: سَلَامَة + كِ — salāma, safety, well-being (f., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your safety', i.e. 'may you be well'
وَسَلَامَتُ: وَ + سَلَامَة — wa-, and + salāma, safety (f., nom., in construct; printed with open tāʾ); 'and the safety of'
شَبَابِكِ: شَبَاب + كِ — shabāb, youth (m., gen., 2nd term of iḍāfa) + -ki, your (f.); 'your youth'
أَسْأَلُهَا: أَسْأَلُ + هَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, impf. 1cs, after ṣirtu 'I began') + -hā, her (direct obj.); 'I kept asking her'
لِابْنِكِ: لِـ + ابْن + كِ — li-, to (marks the one addressed, after qūlī 'say') + ibn, son (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'to your son'
الرَّوَاحَ: الـ + رَوَاح — al-, the + rawāḥ, going, setting out (verbal noun of rāḥa, m., acc., obj. of arāda); 'the going'
يَرُوحُهُ: يَرُوحُ + هُ — rāḥa, to go (verb I, hollow, impf. 3ms, here taking the place directly) + -hu, it, referring back to al-mawḍiʿ; 'which he goes to'
الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ: الـ + كَلِمَتَيْن — al-, the + kalima, word, saying (f., dual acc.); 'the two words'
انْصِرَافِهِ: انْصِرَاف + هِ — inṣirāf, departure (verbal noun of VII inṣarafa, m., gen. after ʿinda) + -hi, his; 'his leaving'
الْوَفَاءُ: الـ + وَفَاء — al-, the + wafāʾ, faithfulness, loyalty (m., nom., subject); 'faithfulness'
وَالْغَدْرُ: وَ + الـ + غَدْر — wa-, and + al-, the + ghadr, treachery (m., nom., subject); 'and treachery'
قَبِيحٌ: قَبِيح — qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj., m., nom. indef., predicate); 'foul'
شَفَقَةٌ: شَفَقَة — shafaqa, tenderness, care (f., nom. indef., predicate of hādhihi); 'a tenderness'
لِأَكُونَ: لِـ + أَكُونَ — li-, so that (introduces purpose, + subjunctive) + kāna, to be (verb I, hollow, subj. 1cs); 'so that I may be'
شَغُوفَةً: شَغُوفَة — shaghūf, passionately devoted (adj., f., acc. indef., predicate of akūna; with ʿalā 'over'); 'devoted'
أُعْطِيهَا: أُعْطِي + هَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, impf. 1cs) + -hā, it (the thing, ḥāja, f.); 'I give it'
وَتَنُوحُ: وَ + تَنُوحُ — wa-, and + nāḥa, to lament, wail (verb I, hollow, impf. 2ms, with tabkī); 'and lamenting'
وَالْحَاجَةُ: وَ + الـ + حَاجَة — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while') + al-, the + ḥāja, thing, object (f., nom.); 'and the thing (is with me)'
ذَكَرَتْهَا: ذَكَرَتْ + هَا — dhakara, to mention (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it, referring back to al-ṣifa (relative clause); 'which she mentioned'
أَعْطَيْتُكَ: أَعْطَيْتُ + كَ — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 1cs, future sense after idhā) + -ka, you (first obj.; the second obj. is iyyāhā); 'I will give you'
رَضِيَتْ: رَضِيَتْ — raḍiya, to be willing, consent (verb I, perf. 3fs, after mā); 'she was not willing'
بِلَذَّاتِي: بِـ + لَذَّات + ي — bi-, with (the verb chooses it: ishtaghala bi- 'busy oneself with') + ladhdhāt, pl. of ladhdha, pleasure (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my pleasures'
مَوْتَ: مَوْت — mawt, death (m., acc., obj. of dhakartu, first term of iḍāfa); 'the death of'
طَائِشَ: طَائِش — ṭāʾish, light, flighty, reckless (act. part. of ṭāsha, m., acc., predicate of kuntu, in construct with al-ʿaql); 'flighty (of mind)'
لَيْلِي: لَيْل + ي — layl, night (m., gen., after ṭūla) + -ī, my; 'my night' Also nom., subject of ṭāla: laqad ṭāla laylī, 'long has my night become'.
وَنَهَارِي: وَ + نَهَار + ي — wa-, and + nahār, day (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my day'
مَحْبُوبَتِي: مَحْبُوبَة + ي — maḥbūba, beloved (pass. part. of aḥabba, f., gen. after ʿinda) + -ī, my; 'my beloved'; also gen. after fī, 'about my beloved' (Night 182) ; also nom., subject: 'my beloved (is fairer)'
وَمَاصَدَّقْتُ: وَ + مَا + صَدَّقْتُ — wa-, and + mā, not (neg.) + ṣaddaqa, to believe (verb II, perf. 1cs); idiom mā ṣaddaqtu anna … ḥattā 'I could hardly believe … before' (print runs wa-mā together); 'and no sooner'
صَدَّقَتْ: صَدَّقَتْ — ṣaddaqa, to believe (verb II, perf. 3fs, after mā); mā ṣaddaqat annahā raʾatnī 'she could hardly believe she saw me'
وَبَادَرَتْ: وَ + بَادَرَتْ — wa-, and + bādara, to hasten, rush (verb III, perf. 3fs; with ilā 'to'); 'and she rushed'
الذِّكْرَ: الـ + ذِّكْر — al-, the + dhikr, remembrance, chanting God's names (m., acc., obj. of ʿamilnā); 'the remembrance'
وَالْخُتُومَ: وَ + الـ + خُتُوم — wa-, and + al-, the + khutūm, pl. of khatma, a full reading of the Qurʾān (acc.); 'and the complete readings'
مَوْتِهَا: مَوْت + هَا — mawt, death (m., gen. after qabla) + -hā, her; 'her death' Also gen. after baʿda and after yawmi: baʿda mawtihā, 'after her death'; min yawmi mawtihā, 'from the day of her death'.
أُكَافِئُهَا: أُكَافِئ + هَا — kāfaʾa, to repay, requite (verb III, impf. 1cs, after la-kuntu) + -hā, her (obj.); 'I would have been repaying her'
مَافَعَلَتْ: مَا + فَعَلَتْ — mā, what (rel. pron., after ʿalā 'for') + faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'for what she did'
خَدَمَتْنِي: خَدَمَتْ + نِي — khadama, to serve (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (obj.); 'she served me'
وَأَوْصَلَتْكَ: وَ + أَوْصَلَتْ + كَ — wa-, and + awṣala, to bring through, convey (verb IV, perf. 3fs; ilayya 'to me') + -ka, you (obj.); 'and brought you'
وَلَوْلَاهَا: وَ + لَوْلَا + هَا — wa-, and + law lā, were it not for (introduces a condition contrary to fact) + -hā, her; 'and but for her'
اجْتَمَعْتُ: اجْتَمَعْتُ — ijtamaʿa, to come together, meet (verb VIII, perf. 1cs; with anā wa-iyyāka 'you and I'); 'we came together'
تَقَعَ: تَقَعَ — waqaʿa, to fall, befall (verb I, assimilated, subj. 3fs after an; the verb takes bi-, waqaʿa bi-ka 'befall you'); 'that … fall on'
رَزِيَّةٌ: رَزِيَّة — raziyya, calamity, misfortune (f., nom. indef., subject of taqaʿa); 'a calamity'
خَطِيئَتِهَا: خَطِيئَة + هَا — khaṭīʾa, sin, wrong (f., gen., 2nd term of iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her sin', the wrong done to her
جَعَلَتْنِي: جَعَلَتْ + نِي — jaʿala, to make, put (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (obj.); 'she made me (free)'
فَاعْرِفِ: فَ + اعْرِفِ — fa-, then (opens the answer to idhā) + ʿarafa, to know, find out (verb I, imper. 2ms); 'then find out'
ابْنُكِ: ابْن + كِ — ibn, son (m., nom., subject of arāda) + -ki, your (f.); 'your son'
يَذْهَبَ: يَذْهَبَ — dhahaba, to go (verb I, subj. 3ms after an; with ilā 'to'); 'he go'
الذَّهَابُ: الـ + ذَّهَاب — al-, the + dhahāb, going (verbal noun of dhahaba, m., nom., predicate of ʿādatuhu); 'the going'
أَضْمَرْتُ: أَضْمَرْتُ — aḍmara, to hide in the heart, intend secretly (verb IV, perf. 1cs; the verb chooses ʿalā, aḍmara ʿalā 'purpose against'); 'I had secretly meant'
ضَرَرِكَ: ضَرَر + كَ — ḍarar, harm (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your; 'your harm'
أَضُرُّكَ: أَضُرّ + كَ — ḍarra, to harm (verb I, doubled, impf. 1cs, indic.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I will harm you'
أُشَوِّشُ: أُشَوِّشُ — shawwasha, to trouble, upset (verb II, impf. 1cs; the verb chooses ʿalā, shawwasha ʿalā 'trouble someone'); 'I will trouble'
وَمَاكُنْتِ: وَ + مَا + كُنْتِ — wa-, and + mā, what (interrog.) + kāna, to be (verb I, perf. 2fs, with turīdīna 'what were you wanting'); 'and what were you'
تَفْعَلِيهِ: تَفْعَلِي + هِ — faʿala, to do (verb I, subj. 2fs after an) + -hi, it (obj.); 'that you do it'
وَبَيْنَكِ: وَ + بَيْن + كِ — wa-, and + bayna, between (prep., repeated for emphasis) + -ki, you (f.); 'and between you'
مَوَدَّةٌ: مَوَدَّة — mawadda, affection, love (f., nom. indef., subject of ṣāra); 'affection'

وَتَجَمَّرْتُ: وَ + تَجَمَّرْتُ — wa-, and + tajammartu (tajammara, V, to clean oneself with pebbles, perf. 1cs); 'and I cleaned myself with stones'
أَمْشِيَ: أَمْشِيَ — amshiya (mashā, to walk, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'to walk'
رَبُّنَا: رَبّ + نَا — rabb, lord (m.) + 1cp poss.; 'our Lord'
يُهَنِّيكَ: يُهَنِّيكَ — yuhannīka (yuhanniʾuka, II hannaʾa, to gladden, imperf. 3ms, hamza dropped) + 2ms obj.; 'may he gladden you'
بِشَبَابِكَ: بِـ + شَبَاب + ـِكَ — bi-, with, of the thing enjoyed (after hannaʾa bi-) + shabāb, youth (m.) + 2ms poss.; '(joy) of your youth'
أَتَرَجَّاكَ: أَتَرَجَّاك — atarajjā-ka (tarajjā, V, to beg, imperf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; colloquial for arjūka; 'I beg you'
تَمْشِيَ: تَمْشِيَ — tamshiya (mashā, to walk, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'that you walk'
يُصَدِّقُونِي: يُصَدِّقُو + نِي — yuṣaddiqū (ṣaddaqa, II, to believe, imperf. 3mp jussive after lam, its -na dropped) + nūn of support + 1cs obj.; '(did not) believe me'
وَاقْرَأْ: وَ + اقْرَأْ — wa-, and + iqraʾ (imper. 2ms of qaraʾa, to read); 'and read'
وَاسْتَقْبِلْ: وَ + اسْتَقْبِلْ — wa-, and + istaqbil (istaqbala, X, to receive, imper. 2ms); 'and receive'
دَعْوَةً: دَعْوَة — daʿwa, prayer, invocation (f.), acc. indef., object; 'a prayer'
صَالِحَةً: صَالِحَةً — ṣāliḥa, good, righteous (f. adj.), acc. indef., agreeing with daʿwa; 'good'
وَمَكَثَ: وَ + مَكَثَ — wa-, and + makatha (perf. 3ms, to stay, remain); 'and he stayed'
فَقَطَعْنَا: فَـ + قَطَعْنَا — fa-, so + qaṭaʿnā (qaṭaʿa, to cut off, perf. 1cp); 'so we cut off'
الرَّجَاءَ: الْ + رَّجَاء — rajāʾ, hope (m.), acc., object; 'the hope'
وَظَنَنَّا: وَ + ظَنَنَّا — wa-, and + ẓanannā (ẓanna, to think, perf. 1cp); 'and we thought'
آنَاءَ: آنَاء — ānāʾ, hours (pl. of inan / inā), acc. as adverb of time, first term of the construct with al-layl; 'the hours (of the night)'
وَأَطْرَافَ: وَ + أَطْرَاف — wa-, and + aṭrāf, ends, edges (pl. of ṭaraf, m.), acc. adverbial; 'and the ends (of the day)'
تَأْتِيَنِي: تَأْتِيَنِي — taʾtiya-nī (atā, to come, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an) + nūn of support + 1cs obj.; with bi-man following, 'you bring me (someone)'
يَطْمَئِنَّ: يَطْمَئِنَّ — yaṭmaʾinna (iṭmaʾanna, IV-q., to be at rest, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after ḥattā); 'may be at rest'
وَيَطِيبَ: وَ + يَطِيبَ — wa-, and + yaṭība (ṭāba, to be good, easy, imperf. 3ms subjunctive); 'and may be easy'
الْمُحِبَّ: الْ + مُحِبّ — muḥibb, lover (act. part. IV of aḥabba), acc. after anna; 'the lover'
وَتَقْرَأَ: وَ + تَقْرَأَ — wa-, and + taqraʾa (qaraʾa, imperf. 2ms subjunctive, still under the preceding an); 'and (that) you read'
وَتُفَرِّجَ: وَ + تُفَرِّجَ — wa-, and + tufarrija (farraja, II, to relieve, imperf. 2ms subjunctive); 'and (that) you relieve'
وَتَقْضِيَ: وَ + تَقْضِيَ — wa-, and + taqḍiya (qaḍā, to fulfil, imperf. 2ms subjunctive); 'and (that) you fulfil'
نَفَّسَ: نَفَّسَ — naffasa (II, perf. 3ms), to relieve, give breathing room (from nafas, breath); 'he relieved'
مَكْرُوبٍ: مَكْرُوب — makrūb, distressed (pass. part. of karaba), gen. indef. after min; 'a distressed person'
كُرَبِ: كُرَب — kurab, distresses (pl. of kurba, f.), gen. in construct; 'the distresses (of the world)'
كُرْبَةٍ: كُرْبَة — kurba, distress, affliction (f.), gen. indef. (after miʾat in the construct); 'a distress'
قَصَدْتُكَ: قَصَدْتُ + كَ — qaṣadtu (qaṣada, to make for, seek out, perf. 1cs) + 2ms obj.; 'I have come to you'
تُخَيِّبْنِي: تُخَيِّبْ + نِي — tukhayyib (khayyaba, II, to disappoint, imperf. 2ms jussive after lā) + 1cs obj.; 'do not disappoint me'
تَقَدَّمِي: تَقَدَّمِي — taqaddamī (taqaddama, V, to go ahead, imper. 2fs); 'go ahead, lead the way'
وَرٰأَهَا: وَرَاءَ + هَا — warāʾa, behind (prep.) + 3fs poss.; spelled defectively here (warāʾahā); 'behind her'
وَبَابُهَا: وَ + بَاب + هَا — wa-, and (circumstantial) + bāb, door (m.) + 3fs poss.; 'and its door'
بِالنُّحَاسِ: بِـ + الـ + نُّحَاس — bi-, with (of the material it is plated with) + nuḥās, copper, brass (m.); 'with copper'
بِالْعَجَمِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجَمِيَّة — bi-, in (of the language used) + ʿajamiyya, the foreign tongue, Persian (f.); 'in the foreign tongue'
وَصَبِيَّةٌ: وَ + صَبِيَّة — wa-, and + ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f.), nom. indef. after illā wa-; 'and a girl'
بِخِفَّةٍ: بِـ + خِفَّة — bi-, with (of manner) + khiffa, lightness (f.); 'with lightness'
وَنَشَاطٍ: وَ + نَشَاط — wa-, and + nashāṭ, briskness, energy (m.), gen. after bi-; 'and briskness'
مُشَمِّرَةٌ: مُشَمِّرَة — mushammira, tucking up (act. part. II of shammara, f.), nom. indef., predicate of hiya in the circumstantial clause wa-hiya mushammiratun …; 'tucking up'
رُكْبَتَيْهَا: رُكْبَتَيْ + هَا — rukbatayn, two knees (dual of rukba, f., gen. after ilā, construct form) + 3fs poss.; 'her two knees'
سَاقَيْنِ: سَاقَيْن — sāqayn, two legs (dual of sāq, f.), acc. indef., object; 'two legs'
يُحَيِّرَانِ: يُحَيِّرَان — yuḥayyirāni (ḥayyara, II, to bewilder, imperf. 3md); 'they (two) bewilder'
الْفِكْرَ: الْ + فِكْر — fikr, thought, mind (m.), acc., object; 'the mind'
يُشَمِّرُ: يُشَمِّرُ — yushammiru (shammara, II, to tuck up, bare, imperf. 3ms); 'he bares / tucks up'
سَاقٍ: sāq, leg (f.), gen. indef.; sāqin ʿalā sāqin, 'leg upon leg'; elsewhere after ʿan, punning on sāqī, cupbearer; 'a leg'
لِيَعْرِضَهُ: لِـ + يَعْرِضَ + هُ — li-, in order to (purpose) + yaʿriḍa (ʿaraḍa, to show, imperf. 3ms subjunctive) + 3ms obj.; 'in order to show it'
يَسْعَى: يَسْعَى — yasʿā (saʿā, to hasten, imperf. 3ms), circumstantial; 'hastening'
عَاشِقِهِ: عَاشِق + هِ — ʿāshiq, lover (act. part., m.) + 3ms poss.; 'his lover'
افْتَنَ: افْتَنَ — aftana (IV of fatana, perf. 3ms), seduce, lead astray; the print sets the alif bare with a sukūn on the fāʾ; 'seduced'
الْكَأْسِ: الْ + كَأْس — kaʾs, cup (f.), gen. in the construct; 'the cup'
وَالسَّاقِي: وَ + الـ + سَّاقِي — wa-, and + sāqī, cupbearer (act. part. of saqā, m.); 'and the cupbearer'
وَزَانَ: وَ + زَانَ — wa-, and + zāna (perf. 3ms, to adorn); 'and (there) adorned'
عَمُودَانِ: عَمُودَان — ʿamūdān, two columns (dual of ʿamūd, m.), nom. after kaʾanna-humā; 'two columns'
مَرْمَرٍ: مَرْمَر — marmar, marble (m.), gen. indef. after min; 'marble'
خَلَاخِلُ: خَلَاخِل — khalākhil, anklets (pl. of khalkhāl, m.), nom. as the (delayed) subject of zāna; 'the anklets'
الْمُرَصَّعَةُ: الْ + مُرَصَّعَة — muraṣṣaʿa, studded, inlaid (pass. part. II of raṣṣaʿa, f.); 'the studded (ones)'
مُشَمِّرَةً: مُشَمِّرَةً — mushammira, tucking up (act. part. II of shammara, f.), acc. indef. (predicate of kānat); 'tucking up'
وَمُشَمِّرَةً: وَ + مُشَمِّرَةً — wa-, and + mushammira, tucking up (act. part. II, f.), acc. indef., second predicate; 'and tucking up'
ذِرَاعَيْهَا: ذِرَاعَيْ + هَا — dhirāʿayn, two forearms (dual of dhirāʿ, f., gen. after ʿan, construct form) + 3fs poss.; 'her two forearms'
الْأَسَاوِرِ: الْ + أَسَاوِر — asāwir, bracelets (pl. of siwār, also pl. of aswira), gen. after min; 'the bracelets'
بِأَقْفَالٍ: بِـ + أَقْفَال — bi-, with (of what goes with them) + aqfāl, clasps, literally locks (pl. of qufl, m.); 'with clasps'
ثَمِينِ: ثَمِين — thamīn, precious, costly (adj., m.), gen., in construct before al-jawāhir; 'precious (jewels)'
قُرْطَانِ: قُرْطَان — qurṭān, two earrings (dual of qurṭ, m.), nom.; 'two earrings'
كُوفِيَّةٌ: كُوفِيَّة — kūfiyya, a close-fitting cap (f.), nom. indef.; 'a cap'
دَقُّ: دَقّ — daqq, beating, hammering (m.), first term of the construct with al-miṭraqa; 'beating (of the hammer)'
الْمِطْرَقَةِ: الْ + مِطْرَقَة — miṭraqa, hammer (f.), gen. as second term of the construct; 'the hammer'
رَشَقَتْ: رَشَقَتْ — rashaqat (rashaqa, to tuck in; classically to shoot, perf. 3fs); 'she tucked in'
أَطْرَافَ: أَطْرَاف — aṭrāf, ends, edges (pl. of ṭaraf, m.), acc., object; 'the ends'
اللِّبَاسِ: الْ + لِّبَاس — libās, clothing, here the trousers (m.), gen. as second term of the construct; 'the trousers'
بَهِتُّ: بَهِتُّ — bahittu (bahita, to be dumbfounded, perf. 1cs); 'I was dumbfounded'
الْمُضِيئَةُ: الْ + مُضِيئَة — muḍīʾa, shining (act. part. IV of aḍāʾa, f.), adjective of al-shams; 'the shining (sun)'
اَهَذَا: اَ + هَذَا — a-, question particle (is?) + hādhā, this (m.); 'is this (the one)?'
فَمَدَدْتُ: فَـ + مَدَدْتُ — fa-, so + madadtu (madda, to stretch out, perf. 1cs); 'so I stretched out'
لِأَتَنَاوَلَ: لِـ + أَتَنَاوَلَ — li-, in order to (purpose) + atanāwala (tanāwala, VI, to take, imperf. 1cs subjunctive); 'in order to take'
فَأَدْخَلْتُ: فَـ + أَدْخَلْتُ — fa-, so + adkhaltu (adkhala, IV, to put in, perf. 1cs); 'so I put in'
وَأَكْتَافِي: وَ + أَكْتَاف + ـِي — wa-, and + aktāf, shoulders (pl. of katif, f.) + 1cs poss.; 'and my shoulders'
لِأَقْرُبَ: لِـ + أَقْرُبَ — li-, in order to (purpose) + aqruba (qaruba, to come near, imperf. 1cs subjunctive); 'in order to come near'
وَأَقْرَأَ: وَ + أَقْرَأَ — wa-, and + aqraʾa (qaraʾa, to read, imperf. 1cs subjunctive, under li-); 'and (in order to) read'
وَدَفَعَتْنِي: وَ + دَفَعَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + dafaʿat (dafaʿa, to push, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she pushed me'
وَيَدِي: وَ + يَد + ـِي — wa-, and (circumstantial) + yad, hand (f.) + 1cs poss.; 'and my hand'
إِلَّاقَفْلُ: إِلَّا + قَفْل — illā, except + qafl, locking (verbal noun of qafala, to lock, m., nom.); the print runs the two words together; 'except the locking'
دَفَعَتْنِي: دَفَعَتْ + نِي — dafaʿat (dafaʿa, to push, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'she pushed me'
الْعَجُوزَةُ: الْـ + عَجُوزَة — al-, the + ʿajūza, old woman (f. sg., nom.); spoken form for book ʿajūz; 'the old woman'
وَضَمَّتْنِي: وَ + ضَمَّتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ḍammat (ḍamma, to press, hug, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she pressed me'
وَعَصَرَتْ: وَ + عَصَرَتْ — wa-, and + ʿaṣarat (ʿaṣara, to squeeze, perf. 3fs); 'and she squeezed'
أَتَخَلَّصَ: أَتَخَلَّصَ — atakhallaṣa (Form V takhallaṣa, to free oneself, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an); 'that I free myself'
حَضَنَتْنِي: حَضَنَتْ + نِي — ḥaḍanat (ḥaḍana, to embrace, hold to the chest, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'she embraced me'
وَالشَّمْعَةُ: وَ + الشَّمْعَة — wa-, and + al-, the + shamʿa, candle (f. sg., nom.); 'and the candle'
دَهَالِيزَ: دَهَالِيز — dahālīz, passages, vestibules (broken pl. of dihlīz, m., gen. diptote after construct); 'passages'
لَوَاوِينَ: لَوَاوِين — lawāwīn, (spoken pl. of līwān) vaulted halls, iwans (m. pl., gen., after bi-); spoken form, book ayāwīn; 'iwans'
الْخَيَّالُ: الْـ + خَيَّال — al-, the + khayyāl, horseman, rider (m. sg., nom.); 'the horseman'
بِالْاُكَرِ: بِـ + الْـ + اُكَر — bi-, with (instrument) + al-, the + ukar, balls (pl. of kura, ball, gen.; the print sets the ḍamma on the alif); 'with the balls'
خَلَّتْنِي: خَلَّتْ + نِي — khallat (khallā, to let, leave, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; spoken form, book khallatnī 'she let me go'; 'then she let me be'
دَائِخٌ: دَائِخٌ — dāʾikh, dizzy, giddy (active part. of dākha, m. sg., nom. indef.); spoken form; 'dizzy'
وَعَصَرَتْنِي: وَ + عَصَرَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + ʿaṣarat (ʿaṣara, to squeeze, perf. 3fs) + 1cs obj.; 'and she squeezed me'
بِنَاءَ: بِنَاء — bināʾ, building, construction (verbal noun of banā, m., acc., obj. of raʾaytu, in construct); 'the building of'
رُخَامٌ: رُخَام — rukhām, marble (m. collective, nom., predicate); 'marble'
أَبْهَجِ: أَبْهَجِ — abhaj, most splendid (elative of bahīj, in construct, gen. after min); 'of the most splendid'
فَرْشِهَا: فَرْش + هَا — farsh, furnishings, bedding (m., nom. in construct) + hā, her/its (3fs poss.); 'its furnishings'
الْمِخَدَّاتُ: الْـ + مِخَدَّات — al-, the + mikhaddāt, cushions, pillows (f. pl. of mikhadda, nom.); 'the cushions'
وَالْمَرَاتِبُ: وَ + الْـ + مَرَاتِب — wa-, and + al-, the + marātib, mattresses, divans (pl. of martaba, nom.); 'and the mattresses'
دَكَّتَانِ: دَكَّتَان — dakkatān, two benches, platforms (dual of dakka, f., nom.); 'two benches'
وَسَرِيرٌ: وَ + سَرِير — wa-, and + sarīr, couch, throne-bed (m. sg., nom. indef.); 'and a couch'
وَمَقَاعِدُ: وَ + مَقَاعِد — wa-, and + maqāʿid, seats (pl. of maqʿad, m., nom. indef.); 'and seats'
وَبَيْتُ: وَ + بَيْت — wa-, and + bayt, house, chamber (m. sg., nom. indef., in construct); 'and a house of'
سَعَادَةٍ: سَعَادَة — saʿāda, happiness, felicity (f. sg., gen., second term of construct); 'of felicity'
لَايَصْلُحُ: لَا + يَصْلُحُ — lā, not + yaṣluḥu (ṣaluḥa, to be fit, impf. 3ms indic.); the print runs the two words together; 'is not fit'
أَمِ: أَمْ — am, or (conjunction of the alternative question, after hamza; vowelled amī before al-); 'or'
الْحَيَاةُ: الْـ + حَيَاة — al-, the + ḥayāh, life (f. sg., nom.); 'the life'
الْحَيَوٰةُ: الْـ + حَيَوٰة — al-, the + ḥayāh, life (f. sg., nom., variant spelling with dagger alif); subject of kānat; 'life'
فَتَزَوَّجْ: فَ + تَزَوَّجْ — fa-, then, so (introduces the imperative) + tazawwaj (Form V tazawwaja, to marry, imperative 2ms); 'then marry'
بِمِثْلِكِ: بِـ + مِثْل + كِ — bi-, marks the spouse after tazawwaja + mithl, like, one such as (gen.) + ki, you (2fs poss.); 'a woman like you'
تَزَوَّجْتَ: تَزَوَّجْتَ — tazawwajta (Form V tazawwaja, to marry, perf. 2ms, here in a conditional clause after in); 'you married'
الدَّلِيلَةِ: الدَّلِيلَة — al-, the + dalīla, the Dalīla (proper name, f. sg., gen., in construct with bint); 'the Dalīla'
الْمُحْتَالَةِ: الْـ + مُحْتَالَة — al-, the + muḥtāla, cunning, trickster (active part. of iḥtāla, Form VIII, f. sg., gen., adj.); 'the cunning'
صُحْبَتِهَا: صُحْبَة + هَا — ṣuḥba, companionship, company (f. sg., gen. after fī, in construct) + hā, her (3fs poss.); 'in her company'
وَأَرْبَعَةُ: وَ + أَرْبَعَة — wa-, and + arbaʿa, four (f. numeral form, nom., with masc. noun ashhur); 'and four'
أَهْلَكَهَا: أَهْلَكَ + هَا — ahlaka (Form IV halaka, to destroy, perf. 3ms) + hā, her (3fs obj.); 'may He destroy her'
وَابْتَلَاهَا: وَ + ابْتَلَى + هَا — wa-, and + ibtalā (Form VIII ibtalā, to afflict, test, perf. 3ms) + hā, her (3fs obj.); 'and afflict her'
أَمْكَرُ: أَمْكَر — amkar, more cunning (elative of makir/makr, diptote, nom., subject of yūjadu); 'more cunning'
نَاسًا: نَاسًا — nās, people (m. collective, acc. indef., obj. of qatalat); 'people'
أَفْعَالًا: أَفْعَالًا — afʿāl, deeds (pl. of fiʿl, m., acc. indef., obj. of faʿalat; here ill deeds); 'deeds'
سَلِمْتَ: سَلِمْتَ — salimta (salima, to be safe, escape, perf. 2ms); 'you escaped'
الْمُدَّةُ: الْـ + مُدَّة — al-, the + mudda, period, span of time (f. sg., nom.; hādhihi al-mudda, 'this period'); 'the period'
تَقْتُلْكَ: تَقْتُلْ + كَ — taqtul (qatala, to kill, impf. 3fs jussive after lam) + ka, you (2ms obj.); 'she did not kill you'
تُشَوِّشْ: تُشَوِّشْ — tushawwish (Form II shawwasha, to trouble, confuse, impf. 3fs jussive after lam); spoken/Middle Arabic form; 'or trouble (you)'
عَرَّفَكِ: عَرَّفَ + كِ — ʿarrafa (Form II ʿarrafa, to make known, inform, perf. 3ms) + ki, you (2fs obj.); 'informed you'
أَعْرِفُهَا: أَعْرِفُ + هَا — aʿrifu (ʿarafa, to know, impf. 1cs indic.) + hā, her (3fs obj.); 'I know her'
مَصَائِبَهُ: مَصَائِب + هُ — maṣāʾib, misfortunes (pl. of muṣība, f., acc., obj. of yaʿrifu) + hu, its/his (3ms poss.); 'its misfortunes'

وَجِئْتُهُ: وَ + جِئْتُ + هُ — wa-, and; jiʾtu, I came (perfect 1st sg. of jāʾa, which takes a direct object) + -hu, it (the place); 'and I came to it'
بَاقِيَةٌ: بَاقِيَة + ٌ — bāqiya, remaining, still (f. active part. of baqiya, nom., predicate); 'is she still (as she was)'
أَرُوحَ: أَرُوحَ — arūḥa, subjunctive 1st sg. of rāḥa 'go (off)' (after qabla an); 'that I go'
وَرَأْسُهَا: وَ + رَأْس + ـهَا — wa-, and + raʾs, head (m.) + 3fs possessive; 'and her head'
فَرْحَتِهَا: فَرْحَة + ـهَا — farḥa, joy (f.) + 3fs possessive; min farḥatihā, 'for joy' (min = from, because of)
وَطَأْطَأْتُ: وَ + طَأْطَأْتُ — wa-, and + ṭaʾṭaʾa, lower, bow (quadriliteral, perf. 1s); 'and I lowered'
وَقَبَّلْتُهَا: وَ + قَبَّلْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + qabbala, kiss (form II, perf. 1s) + 3fs object; 'and I kissed her'
أَجِئَ: أَجِئَ — jāʾa, come (subj. 1s after an, spelled in the print without yāʾ); 'that I would come'
لَاعِلْمَ: لَا + عِلْمَ — lā, no (negating the genus) + ʿilm, knowledge (m., acc.); two words run together in the print; 'no knowledge', 'I knew nothing'
سَهْرَانَةٌ: سَهْرَانَةٌ — sahrāna, wakeful, sleepless (adj., f., nom. tanwīn; root s-h-r); 'awake'
وَأَعْطَيْتُكَ: وَ + أَعْطَيْتُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + aʿṭā, give (form IV, perf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'and I gave you'
وَوَعَدْتَنِي: وَ + وَعَدْتَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + waʿada, promise (perf. 2ms) + 1s object; 'and you promised me'
وَتَجِيءُ: وَ + تَجِيءُ — wa-, and + jāʾa, come (impf. 2ms, plain present for a promised future); 'and (you) come back'
انْتَظَرْتُكَ: انْتَظَرْتُ + ـكَ — intaẓara, wait for (form VIII, perf. 1s, direct object) + 2ms; 'I waited for you'
مُنْتَظِرَةٌ: مُنْتَظِرَةٌ — muntaẓira, waiting (act. part. f., form VIII of n-ẓ-r; the thing waited for is marked by li-); 'waiting'
لِمَجِيئِكَ: لِـ + مَجِيء + ـكَ — li-, for (marks what is waited for, after muntaẓira) + majīʾ, coming (m., verbal noun of jāʾa) + 2ms; 'for your coming'
شَأْنُ: شَأْن — shaʾn, matter, way, custom (m., in construct); 'the way of'
تَحْكِي: تَحْكِي — ḥakā, tell, relate (impf. 2ms; ḥakā lī ʿalā, 'tell me about'); 'you tell'; here: ḥakā, to resemble (impf. 3fs, agreeing with banān, 'fingertips'): taḥkī ʿuṣārata ʿandami, 'resembling the juice of ʿandam'
السَّنَةَ: الـ + سَنَة — al-, the + sana, year (f., acc. of time); hādhihi al-sana, 'this (whole) year'
وَحَبَسَتْكَ: وَ + حَبَسَتْ + ـكَ — wa-, and + ḥabasa, confine, shut up (perf. 3fs) + 2ms object; 'and she shut you up'
حَلَّفَتْكَ: حَلَّفَتْ + ـكَ — ḥallafa, make (someone) swear (form II, perf. 3fs, with bi- of the oath) + 2ms object; 'she made you swear'
بِالطَّلَاقِ: بِـ + الـ + طَلَاق — bi-, by (the oath; ḥallafa bi-, 'make swear by') + al-, the + ṭalāq, divorce (m.); 'by divorce', i.e. 'on pain of divorce'
لَيْلَتِكَ: لَيْلَة + ـكَ — layla, night (f.) + 2ms; min laylatika, 'the same night (you are out)', 'from your night'
نَفْسُهَا: نَفْس + ـهَا — nafs, soul, self (f.) + 3fs; 'her soul', 'she herself'
تَتَفَسَّحَ: تَتَفَسَّحَ — tafassaḥa, take one's ease, go out for pleasure (form V, subj. 2ms after an); 'that you take your ease'
يَهُنْ: يَهُنْ — hāna, be easy (jussive 3ms after lam; hāna ʿalā, 'be easy for, be bearable to'); 'it was not easy'
تَبِيتَ: تَبِيتَ — bāta, spend the night (subj. 2ms after an); 'that you spend the night'
عَرَفْتُكَ: عَرَفْتُ + ـكَ — ʿarafa, know (perf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'I knew you'
قَبْلَهَا: قَبْل + ـهَا — qabla, before (prep., acc.) + 3fs; 'before her'
وَمَاتَتْ: وَ + مَاتَتْ — wa-, and + māta, die (perf. 3fs); 'and she died'
مَقْهُورَةً: مَقْهُورَةً — maqhūra, overpowered, crushed (pass. part. f. of qahara, acc. as a state, tanwīn); 'crushed (by grief)'
حَمَتْكَ: حَمَتْ + ـكَ — ḥamā, protect (perf. 3fs) + 2ms object; 'she protected you'
فَخَلَّيْتُ: فَـ + خَلَّيْتُ — fa-, so, and so + khallā, let go, leave (form II, perf. 1s); 'so I let (go)'
سَبِيلَكَ: سَبِيل + ـكَ — sabīl, way, path (m., acc. object of khallā) + 2ms; khallā sabīlahu, 'let him go his way'; 'your way'
بِشَحْمٍ: بِـ + شَحْم — bi-, with (accompaniment) + shaḥm, fat (m.); sāliman bi-shaḥmin, 'safe with fat', apparently an idiom for 'unharmed'
وَأَقْدِرُ: وَ + أَقْدِرُ — wa-, and + qadara, be able (impf. 1s; qadara ʿalā, 'be able to, have power over'); 'and I was able'; imperfect, so present/future: laʿallī … aqdiru ʿalā dawāʾihā, 'perhaps I … (may) be able to cure her' (Night 193)
حَبْسِكَ: حَبْس + ـكَ — ḥabs, imprisoning (m., verbal noun of ḥabasa, gen. after ʿalā) + 2ms; 'your imprisoning'
وَهَلَاكِكَ: وَ + هَلَاك + ـكَ — wa-, and + halāk, destruction, ruin (m., verbal noun of halaka) + 2ms; 'and your destroying'
وَاقْشَعَرَّتْ: وَ + اقْشَعَرَّتْ — wa-, and + iqshaʿarra, bristle, shudder (quadriliteral, perf. 3fs); 'and she bristled'
فَرَائِصِي: فَرَائِص + ـي — farāʾiṣ, shoulder-muscles (pl. of farīṣa, the flesh between shoulder and breast that quivers in fear) + 1s; 'my shoulder-muscles'
الْغُولَةِ: الـ + غُولَة — al-, the + ghūla, ogress, ghoul (f., gen. after mithla); 'the ogress'
الْمَهُولَةِ: الـ + مَهُولَة — al-, the + mahūla, dreadful, terrifying (adj. f., gen.); 'the dreadful'
الْفُولَةِ: الـ + فُولَة — al-, the + fūla, bean, a single broad bean (f., gen. after mithla); 'the bean'
لِعِشْرَتِي: لِـ + عِشْرَة + ـي — li-, for (fit for; taṣluḥu li-, 'be fit for') + ʿishra, companionship, company (f.) + 1s; 'for my company'
الْعَزَبُ: الـ + عَزَب — al-, the + ʿazab, unmarried man, bachelor (m., nom.); 'the bachelor'
الْمُتَزَوِّجُ: الـ + مُتَزَوِّج — al-, the + mutazawwij, married (act. part. of tazawwaja, form V; the print has المتزوح, a misprint corrected here); 'the married (man)'
بِعْتَنِي: بِعْتَ + نِي — bāʿa, sell (perf. 2ms) + 1s object (the price is marked by bi-, 'sell for'); 'you sold me'
بِالْحُزْمَةِ: بِـ + الـ + حُزْمَة — bi-, for (price; bāʿa bi-, 'sell for') + al-, the + ḥuzma, bundle (f.); 'for the bundle'
الدَّفِرَةِ: الـ + دَفِرَة — al-, the + dafira, stinking, foul-smelling (adj. f., gen.; dafir); 'the stinking'
لَأُحَسِّرَنَّ: لَـ + أُحَسِّرَ + نَّ — la-, of oath, 'surely' + uḥassira, make grieve (form II ḥassara, impf. 1s) + energetic -anna; ḥassara ʿalā, 'make grieve over'; 'I will surely make grieve'
الْعَاهِرَةَ: الـ + عَاهِرَة — al-, the + ʿāhira, whore, adulteress (act. part. f. of ʿahara, acc. object); 'the whore'
وَعَشَرَةُ: وَ + عَشَرَة — wa-, and + ʿashara, ten (numeral, f. form with the f. noun jawārin, in construct); 'and ten'
وَرَمَيْنَنِي: وَ + رَمَيْنَ + نِي — wa-, and + ramā, throw (perf. 3fpl) + 1s object (-n- is the verb ending plus the linking nūn); 'and they threw me'
أَيْدِيهِنَّ: أَيْدِي + ـهِنَّ — aydī, hands (pl. of yad, f.; gen. after taḥta) + 3fpl; 'their hands'
ذَبْحَ: ذَبْح — dhabḥ, slaughtering (m., verbal noun of dhabaḥa, acc. of manner, in construct); 'the slaughter of', 'as … are slaughtered'
التُّيُوسِ: الـ + تُيُوس — al-, the + tuyūs, he-goats (pl. of tays, gen.); 'the he-goats'
وَتَعَفَّرَ: وَ + تَعَفَّرَ — wa-, and + taʿaffara, be smeared with dust, be befouled (form V, perf. 3ms; the dust is marked by bi-, 'with'); 'and was befouled'
وَرَأَيْتُهَا: وَ + رَأَيْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + raʾā, see (perf. 1s) + 3fs object; 'and I saw her'
تَسُنُّ: تَسُنُّ — sanna, whet, sharpen (impf. 3fs); 'she was sharpening'
لِضَوْؤِ: لِـ + ضَوْءُ الْمَكَانِ — li-, to (marking the person addressed by qāla, 'said to') + Ḍawʾ al-Makān, 'Light of the Place' (proper name, gen.); the print spells the name ضوؤ with hamza on wāw; 'to Ḍawʾ al-Makān'
اسْتَغَثْتُ: اسْتَغَثْتُ — istaghātha, to cry for help, beg (verb X, perf. 1cs); the one appealed to follows with bi- (bihā, 'to her'); 'I begged'
تَزْدَدْ: تَزْدَدْ — izdāda, to increase, grow (verb VIII, jussive 3fs, from yazdādu, after lam); 'she did not increase'
قَسَاوَةً: قَسَاوَةً — qasāwa, hardness, cruelty (f., acc.); accusative of respect, naming what she grew in after illā; 'in hardness'
يُكَتِّفْنَنِي: يُكَتِّفْنَنِي — kattafa, to tie someone's arms behind his back, from katif, shoulder (verb II, subjunctive 3fpl after an) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); the -na is the fem. pl. ending (the slave-girls) and the -nī follows it; 'that they tie my arms'
فَكَتَّفْنَنِي: فَكَتَّفْنَنِي — fa-, so, and (sequence) + kattafa, to tie arms behind the back (verb II, perf. 3fpl) + -nī, me; 'and they tied me'
وَمَسَكْنَ: وَمَسَكْنَ — wa-, and + masaka, to hold (spoken form, Classical amsaka; verb I, perf. 3fpl); 'and they held'
رَأْسِى: رَأْس + ـِى — raʾs, head (m., acc., object of masakna) + -ī, my (1cs poss.); the print writes the final yāʾ as ى; 'my head'
جَارِيَتَانِ: جَارِيَتَانِ — jāriya, slave-girl (f., nom. dual), subject of qāmat; 'two slave-girls'
جَلَسَتَا: جَلَسَتَا — jalasa, to sit (verb I, perf. 3fd); 'they (two) sat'
أَقْصَابِ: أَقْصَابِ — aqṣāb, plural of qaṣaba, reed, here the long bones of the shin (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with rijlāya); 'the shins (of)'; gen. after ʿalā
وَجَارِيَتَانِ: وَ + جَارِيَتَانِ — wa-, and + jāriya, slave-girl (f., nom. dual); 'and two slave-girls'
مَسَكَتَا: مَسَكَتَا — masaka, to hold (spoken form, Classical amsaka; verb I, perf. 3fd); 'they (two) held'
يَدَايَ: يَدَايَ — yad, hand (f., dual) + -ī, my; Middle Arabic: the nominative dual -āya stands where Classical Arabic requires the accusative yadayya (object of masakatā); 'my two hands'
فَأَمَرَتْهُمَا: فَـ + أَمَرَتْهُمَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -humā, them two (3d obj.); 'and she commanded them two'
يَضْرِبَانِي: يَضْرِبَا + نِي — ḍaraba, to beat (verb I, subjunctive 3md after an) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); Middle Arabic: masculine dual for two women (Classical taḍribānī); 'that they beat me'
فَضَرَبَتَانِي: فَـ + ضَرَبَتَانِي — fa-, and (sequence) + ḍaraba, to beat (verb I, perf. 3fd, the -tāni dual ending, feminine for the two girls) + -ī, me; 'and they two beat me'
وَخَفِيَ: وَ + خَفِيَ — wa-, and + khafiya, to be hidden, fail (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and ... failed'
صَوْتِي: صَوْتِي — ṣawt, voice (m., nom., subject of khafiya) + -ī, my; 'my voice'
مَذْبُوحًا: مَذْبُوحًا — madhbūḥ, slaughtered (passive participle of dhabaḥa, m., acc.); accusative of state/manner describing how he dies; 'slaughtered, with my throat cut'
وَأَهْوَنُ: وَ + أَهْوَنُ — wa-, and + ahwan, easier (elative of hayyin, m., nom., predicate; followed by ʿalayya, for me, and min, than); 'and easier'
شَرَّهَا: شَرَّهَا — sharr, evil, harm (m., acc., second object of kafā) + -hā, her (3fs poss.); 'her harm'
فَصَرَخْتُ: فَـ + صَرَخْتُ — fa-, and so (sequence) + ṣarakha, to scream (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I screamed'
انْقَطَعَ: انْقَطَعَ — inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off, give out (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'gave out'
سَنَّتِ: سَنَّتِ — sanna, to whet, sharpen (verb I, perf. 3fs); the final tāʾ takes kasra before the article of as-sikkīn; 'she sharpened'
اكْشِفْنَ: اكْشِفْنَ — kashafa, to uncover (verb I, imperative 2fpl, to the slave-girls; ʿanhu follows: uncover from him); 'uncover!'
فَأَلْهَمَنِى: فَـ + أَلْهَمَنِي — fa-, and so (sequence) + alhama, to inspire, put into the mind (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and (God) inspired me, put it in my mind'
وَأَوْصَتْنِي: وَ + أَوْصَتْنِي — wa-, and + awṣā, to charge, entrust (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; takes bi- for what is entrusted (bihimā, with the two); 'and she charged me (with them)'
الْوَفَاءَ: الْوَفَاءَ — al-, the + wafāʾ, faithfulness, loyalty (m., acc., subject after anna); 'faithfulness'
وَالْغَدْرَ: وَ + الْ + غَدْرَ — wa-, and + al-, the + ghadr, treachery (m., acc., subject after anna, second member); 'and treachery'
يَاعَزِيزَةُ: يَا + عَزِيزَةُ — yā, O (vocative particle, run together with the name in the print) + ʿAzīza, proper name (f., nom. in vocative); 'O ʿAzīza'
يُعَوِّضُهَا: يُعَوِّضُهَا — ʿawwaḍa, to compensate, recompense (verb II, imperf. 3ms, optative in sense 'may He') + -hā, her (3fs obj.); ʿawwaḍa X fī Y Z, give X Z in return for Y; 'may He give her (Paradise in return)'
نَفَعَتْكَ: نَفَعَتْكَ — nafaʿa, to benefit (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'she did you good'
حَيَاتِهَا: حَيَاتِهَا — fī + ḥayāt, life (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her life' (in her lifetime)
وَفَاتِهَا: وَفَاتِهَا — wafāt, death (f., gen. after baʿda, after) + -hā, her; 'her death'
وَخَلَّصَتْكَ: وَ + خَلَّصَتْكَ — wa-, and + khallaṣa, to rescue, deliver (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'and she saved you'
نِكَايَةِ: نِكَايَةِ — nikāya, spite, injury done to an enemy (f., gen. after li-ajli); 'spiting'
الْعَاهِرَةِ: الْ + عَاهِرَةِ — al-, the + ʿāhira, whore (f., gen., noun in apposition to tilka); 'the whore'
الْمَهْتُوكَةِ: الْ + مَهْتُوكَةِ — al-, the + mahtūka, shameless (lit. 'whose veil is torn'; passive participle of hataka, f., gen., adjective of al-ʿāhira); 'the shameless'
حَجَبَتْكَ: حَجَبَتْكَ — ḥajaba, to veil, keep away, shut out (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'who kept you (from me)'
وَأَمَرَتْهُنَّ: وَ + أَمَرَتْهُنَّ — wa-, and + amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hunna, them (3fpl obj.); 'and she ordered them'
يَرْبُطْنَ: يَرْبُطْنَ — rabaṭa, to tie (verb I, subjunctive 3fpl after an; the -na is the fem. pl. ending); 'that they tie'
بِالْحَبْلِ: بِـ + الْ + حَبْلِ — bi-, with (prep., instrument: tying with the rope) + al-, the + ḥabl, rope (m., gen.); 'with the rope'
ارْكَبْنَ: ارْكَبْنَ — rakiba, to ride, mount (verb I, imperative 2fpl; followed by ʿalayhi, upon him, i.e. sit on him); 'mount!, sit on him'
بِطَاجِنٍ: بِـ + طَاجِنٍ — bi-, with (prep., after atat: atat bi- 'brought', the verb takes bi- for what is brought) + ṭājin, frying-pan (m., gen., indef.; from Greek via Aramaic); 'with a pan', i.e. 'brought a pan'
وَعَلَّقَتْهُ: وَ + عَلَّقَتْهُ — wa-, and + ʿallaqa, to hang (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (3ms obj., the pan); 'and she hung it'
كَانُونِ: كَانُونِ — kānūn, brazier (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with nārin, of fire); 'a brazier (of fire)'
وَصَبَّتْ: وَ + صَبَّتْ — wa-, and + ṣabba, to pour (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she poured'
شِيرَجًا: شِيرَجًا — shīraj, sesame oil (m., acc., indef.; from Persian); object of ṣabbat; 'sesame oil'
وَقَلَتْ: وَ + قَلَتْ — wa-, and + qalā, to fry (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she fried'
جُبُنًّا: جُبُنًّا — jubunn, cheese (m., acc., indef.; one of the older forms, written with shadda in the print); object of qalat; 'cheese'
وَرَبَطَتْ: وَ + رَبَطَتْ — wa-, and + rabaṭa, to tie (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she tied'
مَحَاشِمِى: مَحَاشِمِي — maḥāshim, private parts (pl. of maḥsham, m., acc. object of rabaṭat) + -ī, my; the print writes the final yāʾ as ى; 'my private parts'
وَأَمْسَكَتْهُ: وَ + أَمْسَكَتْهُ — wa-, and + amsaka, to take hold of (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (3ms obj., the rope); 'and she held it'
لِجَارِيَتَيْنِ: لِـ + جَارِيَتَيْنِ — li-, to (prep., marking the recipient after nāwalathu: 'handed it to') + jāriya, slave-girl (f., gen. dual); 'to two slave-girls'
جُرَّا: جُرَّا — jarra, to pull (verb I, imperative 2d; addressed to the two girls); 'pull!'
فَجَرَّتَاهُ: فَـ + جَرَّتَاهُ — fa-, and so (sequence) + jarra, to pull (verb I, perf. 3fd) + -hu, it (3ms obj., the rope); 'and they two pulled it'
بِمُوسَى: بِـ + مُوسَى — bi-, with (prep.; jāʾat bi- 'came with', i.e. brought) + mūsā, razor (m., gen., indef., of the type -ā, so no tanwīn); 'with a razor', i.e. 'brought a razor'
ذَكَرِي: ذَكَرِي — dhakar, male member, penis (m., acc., object of qaṭaʿat) + -ī, my; 'my penis'
