كَوَتْ: كَوَتْ — kawā, to cauterise, burn (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she cauterised'
وَكَبَسَتْهُ: وَ + كَبَسَتْهُ — wa-, and + kabasa, to press, pack (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (3ms obj., the wound); 'and she packed it'
بِذَرُورٍ: بِـ + ذَرُورٍ — bi-, with (prep., instrument: what she packed it with) + dharūr, medicinal powder (m., gen., indef.); 'with a powder'
مُغْمًى: مُغْمًى — mughman, fainted (passive participle of aghmā, verb IV, m.; here the predicate, written indef. with the following ʿalayya: mughman ʿalayya, 'fainted upon me'); 'unconscious'
يُحَلِّلْنَنِي: يُحَلِّلْنَنِي — ḥalla, to untie, loose (verb II, subjunctive 3fpl after an; the -na is the fem. pl. ending, the slave-girls) + -nī, me; 'that they untie me'
فَأَسْقَتْنِي: فَـ + أَسْقَتْنِي — fa-, and so (sequence) + asqā, to give to drink (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (1st obj.); 'and she gave me to drink'
وَبَخِلْتَ: وَ + بَخِلْتَ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'you who ...') + bakhila, to be stingy (verb I, perf. 2ms); takes ʿalā for the person refused (ʿalayya) and bi- for the thing withheld; 'and you grudged'
بِلَيْلَةٍ: بِـ + لَيْلَةٍ — bi-, with (prep., marking what was withheld after bakhila ʿalā) + layla, night (f., gen., indef.); 'a night'
نَجَاتِكَ: نَجَاتِكَ — najāt, rescue, salvation (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after sabab) + -ka, your; 'your rescue'
تُبِحْ: تُبِحْ — abāḥa, to divulge, disclose (verb IV, jussive 3fs after lam, from tubīḥu); 'she did not divulge'
أَسْمَعْتَنِي: أَسْمَعْتَنِي — asmaʿa, to make hear (verb IV, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me (1st obj.); 'you made me hear, let me hear'
كَلِمَتَيْهَا: كَلِمَتَيْهَا — kalima, word, saying (f., acc. dual, 2nd obj., oblique form kalimatayn) + -hā, her; 'her two sayings'
ذَبَحْتُكَ: ذَبَحْتُكَ — dhabaḥa, to slaughter, cut the throat of (verb I, perf. 1cs; the perfect in the answer la-kuntu dhabaḥtuka, 'I would have slaughtered') + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'I would have cut your throat'
غَيْرُالَّذِي: غَيْرُ الَّذِي — ghayr, other than, nothing but (m., nom.) + alladhī, that which (rel. pron., ms); the print runs the two words together; 'nothing but what'
قَطَعْتُهُ: قَطَعْتُهُ — qaṭaʿa, to cut off (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it (3ms obj., relative's returning pronoun); 'I cut off'
وَلَالِي: وَ لَا + لِي — wa-, and + lā, no, not + lī, to me, I have (li-, to + -ī, me); the print runs the words together; 'and I have no (desire)'
وَلَاحَاجَةَ: وَ لَا + حَاجَةَ — wa-, and + lā, no (negating a noun in the accusative without tanwīn) + ḥāja, need (f., acc.); the print runs the words together; 'and no need'
وَمَلِّسْ: وَ + مَلِّسْ — wa-, and + mallasa, to smooth, stroke (verb II, imperative 2ms; colloquial; mallis ʿalā raʾsika 'stroke your head', perhaps 'console yourself'; the reading is uncertain); 'and stroke'
وَتَرَحَّمْ: وَ + تَرَحَّمْ — wa-, and + taraḥḥama, to ask God's mercy on (verb V, imperative 2ms, followed by ʿalā); 'and pray for mercy'
رَفَصَتْنِي: رَفَصَتْنِي — rafaṣa, to kick (spoken form, Classical rafasa; verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me (1cs obj.); Middle Arabic; 'she kicked me'
بِرِجْلِهَا: بِـ + رِجْلِهَا — bi-, with (prep., instrument: kicked with her foot) + rijl, foot, leg (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her foot'
فَرَمَيْتُ: فَـ + رَمَيْتُ — fa-, and so (sequence) + ramā, to throw (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I threw'
وَإِذَابِزَوْجَتِي: وَ + إِذَا + بِـ + زَوْجَتِي — wa-, and + idhā, behold (of surprise) + bi-, which after idhā of surprise only marks what appears (not 'with') + zawja, wife (f., gen. after bi-) + -tī, my (1cs poss.); the print runs the words together; 'and behold, my wife'
وَأَدْخَلَتْنِى: وَ + أَدْخَلَتْنِي — wa-, and + adkhala, to make enter, bring in (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; the print writes the final yāʾ as ى; 'and she brought me in'
فَوَجَدَتْنِي: فَـ + وَجَدَتْنِي — fa-, and so (sequence) + wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'and she found me'
وَصَحَوْتُ: وَ + صَحَوْتُ — wa-, and + ṣaḥā, to wake, come to (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I woke'
مَرْمِيًّا: مَرْمِيًّا — marmī, thrown, flung (passive participle of ramā, m., acc.); accusative of state describing how he found himself; 'thrown down'
أَئِنُّ: أَئِنُّ — aʾinnu, to groan, moan (verb I, imperf. 1cs indicative, root a-n-n); 'I groaning' (hāl clause after wa-anā)
وَأَتَضَجَّرُ: و + أَتَضَجَّرُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḍajjara, to fret, be vexed, complain (verb V, imperf. 1cs indicative); 'and fretting'
يَاهَلْ: يَا + هَلْ — yā, O (vocative particle; the print runs it together with hal) + hal, whether, is it (interrogative particle); 'O, is it...'
تُرَي: تُرَي — turā, is it seen? (verb I raʾā, imperf. passive 3fs; after hal, 'I wonder'); the print writes final ى as ي; 'is it seen'
يَاوَلَدِي: يَا + وَلَدِي — yā, O (vocative; the print runs it together with the noun) + walad, son, child (m. sg.) + ـي, my; 'O my son'
وَحَسَّتْ: و + حَسَّتْ — wa-, and + ḥassat, to feel, perceive (verb I, perf. 3fs, spoken for aḥassat, IV); middle Arabic; with bi- 'felt me'; 'and she felt'
وَجَدَتْنِي: وَجَدَتْ + نِي — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3fs, wajadat) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc. object); 'she found me'
اسْتِوَأٍ: اسْتِوَأٍ — istiwāʾ, evenness, being level, normal state (verbal noun of VIII istawā, m., gen. with tanwīn after ghayr); the print sets the hamza on a final alif (written استوأ for istiwāʾ); ʿalā ghayri istiwāʾ, 'in an abnormal state'
وَالسَّوَادُ: و + الـ + سَوَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + sawād, blackness, darkness (m., nom., second subject of ṣāra); 'and the blackness'
وَمَافَعَلَتْ: و + مَا + فَعَلَتْ — wa-, and + mā, what (rel. pron.) + faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3fs); the print runs mā together with the verb; 'and what she had done'
فَازْدَدْتُ: فَـ + ازْدَدْتُ — fa-, and/so (sequence) + izdāda, to increase, grow (verb VIII of z-y-d, perf. 1cs; takes an acc. of specification); 'so I increased'
وَكِدْتُ: و + كِدْتُ — wa-, and + kāda, to be on the point of, almost (verb I, perf. 1cs; takes an + subjunctive/passive verb here); 'and I almost'
هَذَاالْبُكَاءِ: هَذَا + الْبُكَاءِ — hādhā, this (dem. pron., m. sg.; the print runs it together with the following word) + al-, the + bukāʾ, weeping (m., verbal noun, gen. after fī); 'this weeping'
وَهُوَمَيِّتٌ: و + هُوَ + مَيِّتٌ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + huwa, he (3ms pers. pron.; the print runs it together with the predicate) + mayyit, dead (m. sg., nom. predicate); 'and he dead'
أَسْتَحِقُّ: أَسْتَحِقُّ — istaḥaqqa, to deserve, merit (verb X, imperf. 1cs indicative, root ḥ-q-q); 'I deserve'
أَهْمَلْتُهَا: أَهْمَلْتُ + هَا — ahmala, to neglect, disregard (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + ـهَا, her/it (3fs acc. object); 'I neglected her'
وَمَاحَصَلَ: و + مَا + حَصَلَ — wa-, and + mā, what (interrogative pron.; the print runs it with the verb) + ḥaṣala, to befall, occur (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and what has befallen'
وَأَحْضَرَتْ: و + أَحْضَرَتْ — wa-, and + aḥḍara, to bring, fetch (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and she brought'
وَأَعَدْتُ: و + أَعَدْتُ — wa-, and + aʿāda, to repeat, retell (verb IV of ʿ-w-d, perf. 1cs); 'and I repeated'
جَرَي: جَرَي — jarā, to happen, come to pass (verb I, perf. 3ms, written with yāʾ for alif maqṣūra; middle Arabic spelling); 'happened'
عَالَجَتْنِي: عَالَجَ + نِي — ʿālaja, to treat, tend medically (verb III, perf. 3fs, ʿālajat) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc.); 'she treated me'
وَدَاوَتْنِي: و + دَاوَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + dāwā, to doctor, treat (verb III, perf. 3fs) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc.); 'and she doctored me'
وَتَكَامَلَتْ: و + تَكَامَلَتْ — wa-, and + takāmala, to become complete, be perfected (verb VI, perf. 3fs, subject ʿāfiyatī); 'and became complete'
عَافِيَتِي: عَافِيَة + ـي — ʿāfiya, health, well-being (f. sg., nom., subject; with the glide yāʾ before the suffix) + ـي, my; 'my health'
الْوَدَاعَةَ: الـ + وَدَاعَة — al-, the + wadāʿa, a trust, deposit (f., acc. as object); the print's word for wadīʿa 'a deposit'; 'the deposit, the trust'
حَلَّفَتْنِي: حَلَّفَ + نِي — ḥallafa, to make someone swear, put under oath (verb II, perf. 3fs) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc. object); 'she made me swear'
أُخْرِجُهَا: أُخْرِجُ + هَا — akhraja, to bring out, take out (verb IV, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after an) + ـهَا, it (3fs acc., the deposit); 'that I bring it out'
تَتَذَكَّرُهَا: تَتَذَكَّرُ + هَا — tadhakkara, to remember, recall (verb V, imperf. 2ms, here after ḥattā arāka 'until I see you'; the nominative-looking ending is a hāl, 'remembering') + ـهَا, her (3fs acc.); 'you remembering her'
وَتَنْقَطِعُ: و + تَنْقَطِعُ — wa-, and + inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off, severed (verb VII, imperf. 3fs indicative, hāl clause); 'and are cut'
عَلَائُقُكَ: عَلَائِق + ـكَ — ʿalāʾiq, ties, attachments (pl. of ʿalāqa, nom., subject of tanqaṭiʿu; the print sets a ḍamma on the hamza, ʿalāʾuq-) + ـكَ, your (2ms); 'your ties'
الشُّرُوطَ: الـ + شُّرُوط — al-, the + shurūṭ, conditions, stipulations (m. pl. of sharṭ, acc. as object of ʿalimtu); 'the conditions'
الْمُصَوَّرِ: الـ + مُصَوَّر — al-, the + muṣawwar, pictured, depicted (pass. part. of II ṣawwara; m. sg., gen., adjective of al-ghazāl); 'the pictured'
يَارَبَّةَ: يَا + رَبَّةَ — yā, O (vocative; the print runs it together) + rabba, mistress, lady (f. sg., acc. as vocative in construct with al-ḥusn); 'O mistress'
بِالصَّدِّ: بِـ + الـ + صَّدّ — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + al-, the + ṣadd, turning away, aversion (m. verbal noun, gen.); 'with the turning-away'
اَغْرَاكِ: أَغْرَاكِ — aghrā, to incite, instigate (verb IV, perf. 3ms, root gh-r-y) + ـكِ, you (2fs acc.); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'incited you'
قَتَلْتِ: قَتَلْتِ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 2fs, 'you killed'); the subject is the beloved addressed
بِفَرْطِ: بِـ + فَرْط — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + farṭ, excess, extremity (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-ḥubb); 'with excess of'; also with other nouns: bulītu bi-farṭi wajdin, 'I am afflicted with excess of passion', where bi- is chosen by bulītu and marks the affliction (Night 193, verse); here after akhbara, 'to inform', which takes bi- for the news: akhbarahu bi-farṭi maḥabbatihā, 'told him of the excess of her love'
مُضْنَاكِ: مُضْنَاكِ — muḍnā + ـكِ, your wasted one: muḍnā, one worn out by passion (pass. part. of IV aḍnā, m. sg. acc., object of qatalti) + ـكِ, your (2fs); 'the one you wasted, your victim'
تَذْكُرِينَا: تَذْكُرِي + نَا — dhakara, to remember (verb I, imperf. 2fs jussive after lam: tadhkurī) + ـنَا, us (1pl acc.); 'lam tadhkurīnā, you have not remembered us'
فُرْقَتِنَا: فُرْقَة + ـنَا — furqa, separation, parting (f. sg., gen. after baʿda; with the connecting vowel) + ـنَا, our; 'our parting'
فَاللّٰهُ: فَـ + اللّٰهُ — fa-, then, so (introducing the apodosis) + Allāh, God (nom., subject; the print writes a dagger alif); 'then God'
اَنَّا: أَنَّا — anna + ـنَا: anna, that (particle putting its subject in the acc.) + ـنَا, we (1pl suffix, subject of the clause); printed with bare alif for أَنَّا; 'that we'
نَسِينَاكِ: نَسِيَ + نَا + كِ — nasiya, to forget (verb I, perf. 1pl: nasīnā) + ـكِ, you (2fs acc. object); 'we forgot you'
عَذَّبْتِنِي: عَذَّبْتِ + نِي — ʿadhdhaba, to torment, torture (verb II, perf. 2fs) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc.); 'you tormented me'
بِالتَّجَنِّي: بِـ + الـ + تَّجَنِّي — bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + al-, the + tajannī, false accusation, finding fault (verbal noun of V tajannā; m., gen.); 'with the false-blaming'
تَجُودِينَ: تَجُودِينَ — jāda, to be generous, bestow (verb I hollow, imperf. 2fs indicative; with bi- 'bestow with'); 'you grant'
بِرُؤْيَاكِ: بِـ + رُؤْيَا + كِ — bi-, with (prep.; jāda bi- 'to be generous with') + ruʾyā, sight, vision (f., gen.) + ـكِ, your (2fs); 'with the sight of you'
اَحْسِبُ: أَحْسِبُ — ḥasiba, to reckon, think (verb I, imperf. 1cs indicative); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'I reckoned'
الْحُبَّ: الـ + حُبَّ — al-, the + ḥubb, love (m., acc. as subject of anna); 'the love'; also acc. object of malla, 'to weary of': malla qalbī al-ḥubba, 'my heart wearied of love' (Night 182)
ضَنَا: ضَنَا — ḍanā, wasting, languor, emaciation (m., nom., predicate of an al-ḥubb fīhi ḍanā, 'in it is wasting'); alif maqṣūra written as alif
نُفُوسٍ: نُفُوس + ٍ — nufūs, souls, selves (f. pl. of nafs, gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa after ʿadhāb); 'of souls'
اَهْوَاكِ: أَهْوَى + ـكِ — hawiya, to love, desire (verb I, imperf. 1cs: ahwā) + ـكِ, you (2fs acc.); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'I loved you'
اَسِيرَ: أَسِير — asīr, captive, prisoner (m. sg., acc. as predicate of amsā, first term of an iḍāfa with al-hawā); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif here (اَسِيرَ); 'a captive' ; also: in asīra asīratin, 'the captive of a captive woman'
لَحْظِ: لَحْظ — laḥẓ, glance, look (m. sg., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa with ʿaynāki); 'the glance'
الْعَذُولُ: الـ + عَذُول — al-, the + ʿadhūl, blamer, reproacher (intensive form, m. sg., nom., subject of raqqa); 'the blamer'
وَاَنْتِ: و + أَنْتِ — wa-, and (circumstantial/contrastive) + anti, you (2fs pers. pron., nom.); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'and you'
تَرْثِي: تَرْثِي — rathā, to pity, feel compassion (verb I, imperf. 2fs jussive after lam; the nūn of tarthīna dropped); 'you did not pity'
لِمُضْنَاكِ: لِـ + مُضْنَاك — li-, for, toward (prep., chosen by rathā li- 'pity someone') + muḍnā, one wasted (m. sg., gen.) + ـكِ, your (2fs); 'for your wasted one'
تَاللّٰهِ: تَا + اللّٰه — tā-, by (oath particle, used only with Allāh) + Allāh, God (gen. after the oath); the print writes a dagger alif; 'by God'
لَوْمُتُّ: لَوْ + مُتُّ — law, if (conditional particle; the print runs it together with the verb) + māta, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs: muttu); 'if I died'
اَسْلُوكِ: أَسْلُو + كِ — salā, to be consoled, forget (verb I, imperf. 1cs, jussive after lam; takes the acc. 'you' directly, 'forget you') + ـكِ, you (2fs acc.); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'I would not be consoled for you'
فَنِيتُ: فَنِيتُ — faniya, to perish, waste away (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I perished'
غَرَامًا: غَرَامًا — gharām, passion, ardent love (m., acc. with tanwīn, of specification/cause); 'of passion'
اَنْسَاكِ: أَنْسَى + كِ — nasiya, to forget (verb I, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive-looking, with ـكِ, you 2fs acc.); printed with bare alif for hamzated alif; 'I do not forget you'
جَعَلْتُكَ: جَعَلْتُ + كَ — jaʿala, to make, put (verb I, perf. 1cs) + ـكَ, you (2ms acc. object); with fī ḥill 'in release': 'I have made you'
وَأَرْجُواللَّهَ: و + أَرْجُو + اللَّهَ — wa-, and + arjū, to hope, ask of (verb I, imperf. 1cs, root r-j-w; the print runs it together with Allāh) + Allāh, God (acc. object); 'and I hope God'
يُوَفِّقَ: يُوَفِّقَ — waffaqa, to bring together, reconcile, grant success (verb II, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an; baynaka wa-bayna 'between you and'); 'that He reconcile'
وَاصْبِرْ: و + اصْبِرْ — wa-, and + iṣbir, to be patient, endure (verb I, imperative 2ms; ʿalā chosen by the verb: ṣabara ʿalā 'be patient with/over'); 'and be patient'
بَلِيَّتِكَ: بَلِيَّة + ـكَ — baliyya, affliction, calamity (f. sg., gen. after ʿalā) + ـكَ, your (2ms); 'your affliction'
مَدِيدٌ: مَدِيدٌ — madīd, long, extended (adj., m. sg., nom. with tanwīn, predicate of ajaluka); 'long'
وَسَلَامِي: و + سَلَام + ـِي — wa-, and + salām, peace, greeting (m., nom. subject) + ـي, my; 'and my peace (be upon you)'
وَاحْتَفِظْ: و + احْتَفِظْ — wa-, and + iḥtafiẓ, to keep safe, guard (verb VIII, imperative 2ms; takes ʿalā 'keep guard on', middle Arabic for bi-); 'and keep'
تُخَلِّيهَا: تُخَلِّي + ـهَا — khallā, to let, allow (verb II, imperf. 2ms, with lā 'do not let'; the print keeps the final yāʾ, a middle Arabic indicative form for jussive tukhallihā) + ـهَا, it (3fs acc.); 'do not let it'
تُفَارِقُكَ: تُفَارِق + ـكَ — fāraqa, to leave, part from (verb III, imperf. 3fs indicative, subject the rag/picture; after lā tukhallīhā) + ـكَ, you (2ms acc.); 'leave you'
الصُّورَةَ: الـ + صُّورَة — al-, the + ṣūra, picture, image (f. sg., acc. after inna); 'the picture'
تُؤَانِسُنِي: تُؤَانِس + نِي — ānasa, to keep company, cheer (verb III, imperf. 3fs: tuʾānisu, spelled with hamza on wāw) + ـنِي, me (1cs acc.); 'used to keep me company'
إِذَ: إِذَ — idhā, when (temporal particle); the print's misplaced space: إِذَ اغِبْتَ stands for إِذَا غِبْتَ 'when you were away'
اغِبْتَ: اغِبْتَ — ghibta, to be absent (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms); the print's misplaced space puts the alif of idhā in front: إِذَا غِبْتَ, 'when you were away'; 'you were absent'
فَقَرَأْتُ: فَ + قَرَأْتُ — fa-, and/so (sequence) + qaraʾa, to read (verb I, perf. 1s -tu); 'and I read'
مَاكَتَبَتْهُ: مَا + كَتَبَتْ + ـهُ — mā, what (relative, 'that which') + kataba, to write (verb I, perf. 3fs katabat) + ـهُ, it (3ms acc., resuming mā); run together in the print (mā katabathu); 'what she had written'
احْتَفِظْ: احْتَفِظْ — iḥtafaẓa, to keep safe, guard (verb VIII, imper. 2ms; takes bi- for the thing kept, here bi-hādhā al-ghazāl); 'keep (it) safe'
تَدَعْهُ: تَدَعْهُ — tadaʿ, wadaʿa/yadaʿu, to leave, let (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā, prohibition) + ـهُ, it (3ms acc.); 'do not let it'
يُفَارِقُكَ: يُفَارِقُكَ — yufāriqu, fāraqa, to leave, part from (verb III, imperf. 3ms; plain indicative as the complement of tadaʿ, 'let it leave') + ـكَ, you (2ms acc.); 'leave you'
يُؤَانِسُنِي: يُؤَانِسُنِي — yuʾānisu, ānasa, to keep company, cheer (verb III, imperf. 3ms) + ـنِي, me (1s acc., with nūn of protection); 'kept me company'
وَبِاللَّهِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + اللَّه — wa-, and + bi-, by (the particle of adjuration, introducing the one adjured by) + al-, the + Allāh, God (gen. after bi-); 'and by God' (wa-bi-allāhi ʿalayka, 'I beg you by God')
تَتَبَاعَدُ: تَتَبَاعَدُ — tabāʿada, to keep far away, withdraw (verb VI, imperf. 2ms, takes ʿan for what one keeps away from: tabāʿad ʿanhā); plain imperfect used as a request/command ('you keep away'), Middle Arabic for the imperative; 'keep away'
تَقْرَبُكَ: تَقْرَبُكَ — taqrabu, qariba, to come near, approach (verb I, imperf. 3fs, here after lā tukhallīhā, 'do not let her', plain indicative for subjunctive) + ـكَ, you (2ms acc., direct object, not with min); 'come near you'
تَحْصُلْ: تَحْصُلْ — taḥṣul, ḥaṣala, to come about, fall to someone (verb I, jussive 3fs after lam, negating the perfect); with laka, 'to you', in the sense 'come into your hands'; 'she does not fall to you'
سَبِيلًا: سَبِيلًا — sabīl, way, path (m. sg., acc. as object of wajadta, indefinite with tanwīn); 'a way'
تَقْرَبْ: تَقْرَبْ — taqrab, qariba, to approach (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā, prohibition; here with a direct object wāḥidatan 'go near one'); 'do not go near'
صَاحِبَةَ: صَاحِبَةَ — ṣāḥiba, owner, maker, companion (f. sg., fem. of ṣāḥib; acc. after anna, first term of an iḍāfa with hādhā al-ghazāl); 'the owner (of this gazelle)'
وَتُرْسِلُهُ: وَ + تُرْسِلُهُ — wa-, and + tursilu, arsala, to send (verb IV, imperf. 3fs) + ـهُ, it (3ms acc.); 'and sends it'
خَبَرُهَا: خَبَرُهَا — khabar, report, news (m. sg., nom., subject of yashīʿa) + ـهَا, her (3fs gen., possessive); 'her report'
صَنْعَتِهَا: صَنْعَتِهَا — ṣanʿa(t), craft, workmanship (f. sg., gen. in iḍāfa after ḥusn, 'the beauty of') + ـهَا, her (3fs gen.); 'her craft'
مَحْبُوبَتُكَ: مَحْبُوبَتُكَ — maḥbūba, beloved (f. sg., passive participle of aḥabba/ḥabba, nom. as subject of the clause after wa-ammā) + ـكَ, your (2ms gen.); 'your beloved'
الْغَزَالُ: الْغَزَالُ — al-, the + ghazāl, gazelle (m. sg., nom.; subject of waṣala in 'this gazelle reached her', after hādhā in 'this gazelle which is with you'); 'the gazelle'
تَصْدِمُ: تَصْدِمُ — taṣdimu, ṣadama, to strike, hit; here with bi- 'to dazzle people with' (verb I, imperf. 3fs, after ṣārat, 'she began to'; bi-hi, 'with it', the gazelle); 'she dazzles/strikes (people) with it'
وَتُرِيهِ: وَ + تُرِيهِ — wa-, and + turī, arā, to show (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, takes two objects) + ـهِ, it (3ms acc., after the i vowel); 'and shows it (to them)'
كَذَّابَةٌ: كَذَّابَةٌ — kadhdhāba, great liar, liar (f. sg., intensive pattern faʿʿāl with fem. -a, nom. predicate of wa-hiya); 'a liar'
هَتَكَ: هَتَكَ — hataka, to tear open, expose, rip (verb I, perf. 3ms); perfect used as a wish/curse ('may God...'), with allāhu as subject; 'may (God) rip away'
سِتْرَهَا: سِتْرَ + هَا — sitr, covering, veil, protection (m. sg., acc. object of hataka, first term of an iḍāfa) + ـهَا, her (3fs gen.); 'her cover' (hataka sitrahā, a curse: may God expose her)
تَضِيقُ: تَضِيقُ — taḍīqu, ḍāqa, to become narrow, straitened (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs, subject al-dunyā; with ʿalayka, 'upon you', i.e. closes in on you); preceded by qad with the imperfect = 'may ...'; 'may become narrow'
مَوْتِى: مَوْتِ + ى — mawt, death (m. sg., gen. after baʿda, in iḍāfa) + ى for ـِي, my (1s gen.); Middle Arabic spelling with ى for final ي; 'my death'
تَتَغَرَّبُ: تَتَغَرَّبُ — tatagharrabu, tagharraba, to go abroad, become a stranger (verb V, imperf. 2ms, after rubbamā, 'it may be that'); 'you go abroad'
وَتَطُوفُ: وَ + تَطُوفُ — wa-, and + taṭūfu, ṭāfa, to roam, wander about (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms, continuing the plain imperfects after rubbamā); 'and roam'
وَتَسْمَعُ: وَ + تَسْمَعُ — wa-, and + tasmaʿu, samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 2ms); the verb chooses bi- for 'hear of' (samiʿa bi-), here bi-ṣāḥibati...; 'and hear of'
بِصَاحِبَةِ: بِـ + صَاحِبَةِ — bi-, of/about (chosen by samiʿa bi-, 'hear of') + ṣāḥiba, owner, maker (f. sg., gen. after bi-, first term of iḍāfa with 'this picture'); 'of the maker (of this picture)'
فَتَتَشَوَّقُ: فَ + تَتَشَوَّقُ — fa-, and so/then (result) + tatashawwaqu, tashawwaqa, to long for, yearn (verb V, imperf. 3fs, takes ilā for the object longed for: tashawwaqa ilā); 'and so longs (for)'
نَفْسُكَ: نَفْسُ + كَ — nafs, self, soul (f. sg., nom., subject of tatashawwaqu, first term of iḍāfa; fem. verb agrees) + ـكَ, your (2ms gen.); 'your self'
فَتَذْكُرُنِي: فَ + تَذْكُرُ + نِي — fa-, and (then) + tadhkuru, dhakara, to remember, mention (verb I, imperf. 2ms) + ـنِي, me (1s acc., with nūn of protection); 'and you will remember me'
وَسِتُّ: وَ + سِتُّ — wa-, and + sitt, lady, mistress (f., nom. in iḍāfa, first term; coordinated with bintu; a Middle Arabic/Egyptian title, from sayyida); 'and the lady (of the free-born)'
الْأَحْرَارِ: الـ + أَحْرَار — al-, the + aḥrār, free-born, free persons (m. pl., broken pl. of ḥurr, gen. in iḍāfa after sitt); 'the free-born'
لِبُكَائِي: لِـ + بُكَاء + ـِي — li-, for, because of (cause) + bukāʾ, weeping (verbal noun of bakā, gen. after li-) + ـِي, my (1s gen.); 'for my weeping', i.e. to see me weep
وَلَازِلْتُ: وَ + لَا زِلْتُ — wa-, and + lā ziltu, zāla (yazālu), to cease (verb I; lā zāla + imperf. = 'continue to'), perf. 1s -tu, run together in the print (wa-lā ziltu); the negative lā with a perfect has continuing sense, as in 'I did not cease'; 'and I kept on'
أَتَجَهَّزَ: أَتَجَهَّزَ — atajahhaza, tajahhaza, to get ready, equip oneself (verb V, subjunctive 1s after an, depending on ashārat ʿalayya an, 'advised me to'); 'that I get ready'
وَأُسَافِرَ: وَ + أُسَافِرَ — wa-, and + usāfira, sāfara, to travel (verb III, subjunctive 1s after an); 'and travel'
أَتَسَلَّى: أَتَسَلَّى — atasallā, tasallā, to console oneself, be diverted (verb V, defective, imperf. 1s, after laʿallī, 'perhaps I', subjunctive/indicative; final alif maqṣūra); 'I may be consoled'
اشْرَحْ: اشْرَحْ — ishraḥ, sharaḥa, to open up, expand (verb I, imper. 2ms; sharaḥa ṣadrahu, 'open wide your breast', i.e. cheer up); 'open up'
وَتَغِيبُ: وَ + تَغِيبُ — wa-, and + taghību, ghāba, to be absent, go away (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms); plain imperfect used as a command/request ('and be away'), Middle Arabic; 'and be away'
يَنْشَرِحُ: يَنْشَرِحُ — yansharḥu, insharaḥa, to be opened wide, be eased (verb VII of sharaḥa, imperf. 3ms, after laʿalla; subject ṣadruka, 'your breast', i.e. your heart lightens); 'may open wide'
وَيَنْجَلِي: وَ + يَنْجَلِي — wa-, and + yanjalī, injalā, to become clear, be cleared (verb VII defective, imperf. 3ms, after laʿalla, subject khāṭiruka 'your mind'); 'and clears'
وَلَازَالَتْ: وَ + لَا زَالَتْ — wa-, and + lā zālat, zāla, to cease (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, with lā = 'did not cease', followed by imperfect tulāṭifunī 'kept coaxing'); run together in the print (wa-lā zālat); 'and she kept on'
تُلَاطِفُنِي: تُلَاطِفُ + نِي — tulāṭifu, lāṭafa, to treat gently, coax (verb III, imperf. 3fs) + ـنِي, me (1s acc., with nūn of protection); 'coaxing me' (bi-al-kalām, with words)
مَتْجَرِي: مَتْجَر + ِي — matjar, trade, merchandise, goods (m. sg., from tajara; acc. object of jahhaztu, first term of iḍāfa) + ـِي, my (1s gen.); 'my merchandise'
مَنْزِلَةٍ: مَنْزِلَةٍ — manzila, halting-place, stage (f. sg., indef. gen. after kull, 'every stage'; place of nuzūl); 'halting-place'
نَنْزِلُ: نَنْزِلُ — nanzilu, nazala, to alight, halt (verb I, imperf. 1pl, relative clause with bi-hā, 'in which we halt'; nazala bi- 'halt at'); 'we halt (at)'
فَأَتَذَكَّرُ: فَ + أَتَذَكَّرُ — fa-, and so + atadhakkaru, tadhakkara, to recall, call to mind (verb V, imperf. 1s; takes a direct object, here ibnata ʿammī); 'and so I recall'
وَمَافَعَلْتُ: وَ + مَا + فَعَلْتُ — wa-, and + mā, not (negative particle with perfect) + faʿaltu, faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 1s -tu); run together in the print (wa-mā faʿaltu); 'and I did not do'
الضَّرَرَ: الـ + ضَّرَرَ — al-, the + ḍarar, harm, injury (m. sg., acc., object of faʿaltu after illā, 'only/except'); 'the harm'
سَفَرِهِمْ: سَفَرِ + هِمْ — safar, journey, travel (m. sg., verbal noun of safara, gen. after min) + ـهِمْ, their (3mp gen.); 'their journey'
وَتَكْمُلُ: وَ + تَكْمُلُ — wa-, and + takmulu, kamula, to be complete, be full (verb I, imperf. 3fs; subject muddatu ghiyābī, 'the period of my absence'); 'and is completed'
وَمَاجَدَّدَ: وَ + مَا + جَدَّدَ — wa-, and + mā, not/nothing (negative; here 'nothing ... except') + jaddada, to renew, make fresh (verb II, perf. 3ms); run together in the print (wa-mā jaddada); 'and nothing renewed'
جُزْتُ: جُزْتُ — jāza, to pass, pass by (verb I hollow, perf. 1s -tu; takes ʿalā: jāza ʿalā, 'pass by/over'); 'I passed'
وَقَلْعَةِ: وَ + قَلْعَةِ — wa-, and + qalʿa, castle, fortress (f. sg., gen. in iḍāfa with al-ballūr; coordinated with jazāʾir after ʿalā); 'and the castle'
شَهْرَمَانُ: شَهْرَمَانُ — Shahramān, name of the king of the Camphor Islands (nom., after yuqālu lahu, 'who is called'); 'Shahramān' Also Qamar al-Zamān's father, a different king of the name (nom., diptote): qāla al-maliku Shahramānu, 'King Shahramān said'.
الْغِزْلَانَ: الـ + غِزْلَان — al-, the + ghizlān, gazelles (m. pl., broken pl. of ghazāl, acc. object of taṣnaʿu); 'the gazelles'
رَقْمِهَا: رَقْم + هَا — raqm, embroidery, figured work (m. sg., gen. after jumla, in iḍāfa) + ـهَا, her (3fs gen.); 'her embroidery'
وَالِاحْتِرَاقِ: وَ + الـ + احْتِرَاقِ — wa-, and + al-, the + iḥtirāq, burning (m. verbal noun, VIII of ḥaraqa, gen., coordinated with al-fikr as second term of the iḍāfa after baḥr; rhymes with al-ashwāq); 'and the burning'
حِيلَةَ: حِيلَةَ — ḥīla, means, remedy, way out (f. sg., acc. without tanwīn after the lā of absolute negation); lā ḥīlata lī, 'I have no remedy'; 'no way out'
آلَةٌ: آلَةٌ — āla, instrument, organ (f. sg., nom., subject of baqiya); here the male organ, which ʿAzīz has lost; 'an organ'
لِجَزَائِرِ: لِـ + جَزَائِر — li-, from (here marks what is parted from, firāqī li-, 'my parting from', where Classical firāq takes a direct object) + jazāʾir, islands (f. pl., broken pl. of jazīra, gen. after li-; diptote); 'from the islands (of)'
وَأَمُوتَ: وَ + أَمُوتَ — wa-, and + amūta, māta, to die (verb I hollow, subjunctive 1s after an, depending on yumkinunī an arjiʿa wa-amūta); 'and die'
وَالِدَتِى: وَالِدَةِ + ى — wālida, mother (f. sg., act. participle of walada; gen. after ʿinda) + ى for ـِي, my (1s gen.); Middle Arabic ى for final ي; 'my mother'
وَقَائِلٍ: وَ + قَائِلٍ — wa-, and (with the sense 'and many a', as after rubba) + qāʾil, sayer, one who says (m. sg., act. participle of qāla, gen. through the implied rubba, 'many a ...'); 'and many a sayer'
لِيْْ: لِـ + ي — li-, to (with qāla: qāla li-, 'say to') + ـيْ, me (1s gen.), as pointed in the print with doubled sukun; 'to me'
فَرَجٍ: فَرَجٍ — faraj, relief, deliverance (m. sg., gen. after min in lā budda min, 'there is no escaping'); 'relief'
لِلْغَيْظِ: لِـ + الـ + غَيْظِ — li-, for/out of (expresses cause or reason) + al-, the + ghayẓ, vexation, anger (m. sg., gen. after li-); 'out of vexation'
عَجَبِيْ: عَجَبِ + يْ — ʿajab, wonder, marvel (m. sg., vocative muḍāf after yā, with ـيْ in pause-like form, as pointed in the print) + my (1s); 'my wonder'
يَضْمَنُ: يَضْمَنُ — yaḍmanu, ḍamina, to guarantee, be surety for (verb I, imperf. 3ms, takes direct object al-ʿumr and li- for the person: ḍamina li-); 'guarantees'
الْعُمْرَ: الـ + عُمْرَ — al-, the + ʿumr, life, lifespan (m. sg., acc., object of yaḍmanu); 'the life'
بَارِدَ: بَارِدَ — bārid, cold (m. sg., act. participle of barada; acc. in vocative yā bārida, muḍāf to al-ḥujaj), fig. 'feeble, tasteless'; 'O cold (of arguments)'
الْحُجَجِ: الـ + حُجَجِ — al-, the + ḥujaj, arguments, pleas (f. pl., broken pl. of ḥujja, gen. after bārid in iḍāfa); 'the arguments'
وَقَوْلُ: وَ + قَوْلُ — wa-, and + qawl, saying, utterance (m. verbal noun of qāla, nom., first term of iḍāfa with al-ākhar, predicate omitted); 'and the saying (of the other)'
اَنِّيْ: أَنَّ + ي — anna, that (introduces the object clause after yaʿlamu, 'God knows that'), written اَنِّيْ with the print's alif conventions + ـيْ, I (1s acc. after anna); 'that I'
فُرْقَتِكُمْ: فُرْقَةِ + كُمْ — furqa, parting, separation (f. sg., verbal noun of fāraqa/faraqa; gen. after baʿda in iḍāfa) + ـكُمْ, your (2mp gen.); 'your parting'
اسْتَلَفْتُ: اسْتَلَفْتُ — istalaftu, istalafa, to borrow (verb VIII of s-l-f, perf. 1s -tu; takes a direct object, al-damʿa, with bi-al-dayn 'on credit'); 'I borrowed'
بِالدَّيْنِ: بِـ + الـ + دَّيْنِ — bi-, on, against (with the borrowed tears: 'on debt', 'on credit') + al-, the + dayn, debt, loan (m. sg., gen. after bi-); 'on credit'
عَاذِلِيْْ: عَاذِل + يْْ — ʿādhil, blamer, scolder (m. sg., act. participle of ʿadhala, nom., subject of qāla) + ـيْ, my (1s gen.), as pointed in the print with a doubled sukun; 'my blamer'
تَنَالُهُمْ: تَنَالُ + هُمْ — tanālu, nāla, to attain, reach (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms; plain indicative for jussive in the promise after iṣbir, 'be patient and you will...') + ـهُمْ, them (3mp acc.); 'you will reach them'
اَلصَّبْرُ: اَلـ + صَّبْرُ — al-, the (printed with alif of the print) + ṣabr, patience (m. sg., nom., subject; the clause is a question 'patience, from where?'); 'the patience'
اَيْنِ: أَيْنِ — ayn, where (interrogative, m., indecl.; min ayna, 'from where?'), written with kasra in the print (اَيْنِ) as pointed there, rhyme-driven; 'where'
بِجَمَالِ: بِـ + جَمَال — bi-, of (marks what one hears about, after samiʿa) + jamāl, beauty (m., gen.); 'of the beauty'
تَرْقُمُ: تَرْقُمُ — raqama, to embroider, work a figure into cloth (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'she embroiders'
وَالْهُيَامُ: وَ + الـ + هُيَام — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + huyām, love-madness, distracted passion (m., nom.)
غَيْرِكَ: غَيْر + ـكَ — ghayr, other than (m., gen., in idāfa after li-aḥad) + 2ms possessive; 'other than you'
عُمْرٌ: عُمْر — ʿumr, life, life-span (m., nom., indef.); 'a life-span'
تَقْضِيهِ: تَـ + قْضِي + ـهِ — qaḍā, to accomplish, live out (verb I) imperfect 2ms + 3ms object; 'you will live it out'
أَسْأَلَكَ: أَ + سْأَلَ + ـكَ — saʾala, to ask (verb I) imperfect 1cs subjunctive (after an) + 2ms object; 'I ask you'
أَتَيْتُهَا: أَتَيْتُ + ـهَا — ataytu, to come (verb I) perfect 1cs + 3fs object; 'I came to her' (takes a direct object)
بَلَدِهَا: بَلَد + ـهَا — balad, country, town (m., gen., after ilā) + 3fs possessive; 'her country'
كَثِيرَةُ: كَثِيرَة — kathīra, many, plentiful (f. sg., nom., predicate; in idāfa with al-ashjār); 'many of trees'
وَحَارِسُ: وَ + حَارِس — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāris, guard, keeper (active participle, m., nom.); 'and the guard of'
وَتَشُمُّ: وَ + تَـ + شُمُّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ta-, she (3fs prefix) + shamma, to smell (verb I) imperfect 3fs indicative; 'and she smells'
أَنْعِمْ: أَنْعِمْ — anʿama, to grant a favour (verb IV) imperative 2ms; anʿama ʿalā ... bi- 'grant the favour of'; 'bestow favour'
أَقْعُدَ: أَ + قْعُدَ — aqʿuda, qaʿada, to sit (verb I) imperfect 1cs subjunctive (after an); 'I sit'
وَتَمُرَّ: وَ + تَـ + مُرَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ta-, she (3fs prefix) + marra, to pass (verb I) imperfect 3fs subjunctive (after ḥattā); 'and passes'
أَحْظَى: أَحْظَى — aḥẓā, ḥaẓiya, to be granted, win (verb I) imperfect 1cs; ḥaẓiya bi- 'be granted'; written with final ى; 'I may win'
أُحْضِرَ: أُحْضِرَ — aḥḍara, to bring (verb IV) imperfect 1cs subjunctive (after an); 'I bring'
خَرُوفٌ: خَرُوف — kharūf, lamb (m., nom., indef.); 'a lamb'
جَالِسَانِ: جَالِس + ـانِ — jālis, sitting (active participle of jalasa, verb I) + dual nom. ending; 'we two sitting'
اخْتَفِ: اِخْتَفِ — ikhtafā, to hide (verb VIII) imperative 2ms; 'hide!'
بِطَوَاشِي: بِـ + طَوَاشِي — bi-, after wa-idhā of surprise only marks what appears (no meaning of its own) + ṭawāshī, eunuch (m. sg.); 'a eunuch'
أَغْلِقْ: أَغْلِقْ — aghlaqa, to shut (verb IV) imperative 2ms; 'shut'
فَأَغْلَقَ: فَـ + أَغْلَقَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aghlaqa, to shut (verb IV) perfect 3ms; 'and he shut'
بِالسِّتِّ: بِـ + الـ + سِتِّ — bi-, after wa-idhā of surprise only marks what appears (no meaning of its own) + al-, the + sitt, lady (f.); 'the lady'
ظَنَنْتُ: ظَنَنْتُ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I) perfect 1cs; 'I thought'
الْقَمَرَ: الـ + قَمَر — al-, the + qamar, moon (m., acc., subject after anna); 'the moon'
الْأُفُقِ: الـ + أُفُق — al-, the + ufuq, horizon (m., gen., after min); 'the horizon'
كَاشْتِيَاقِ: كَـ + اشْتِيَاق — ka-, like (comparison) + ishtiyāq, longing (verbal noun of verb VIII, m., gen., in idāfa); 'like the longing of'
أَغْلَقَتِ: أَغْلَقَتِ — aghlaqat, to shut (verb IV) perfect 3fs, with a linking kasra before al-; 'she shut'
رِجَالِهَا: رِجَال + ـهَا — rijāl, men (pl. of rajul, m., gen., after min) + 3fs possessive; 'her men'
الْمَرْأَةِ: الـ + مَرْأَة — al-, the + marʾa, woman (f., gen., after mithla); 'the woman'
آلَةُ: آلَة — āla, instrument, member (f., nom., construct with rijāl); 'the member of (men)', i.e. the male genitals
تَجَهَّزْتُ: تَجَهَّزْتُ — tajahhaza, to make oneself ready (verb V) perfect 1cs; 'I made ready'
قَاصِدُونَ: قَاصِد + ُونَ — qāṣid, heading for, intending (active participle of qaṣada, m. pl. nom.); 'heading for'
الْبَلْدَةَ: الـ + بَلْدَة — al-, the + balda, town (f., acc., object of qāṣidūn); 'the town'; here object of dakhalnā
وَسَأَلْتَنِى: وَ + سَأَلْتَ + ـنِى — wa-, and (conj.) + saʾalta, to ask (verb I) perfect 2ms + 1cs object, written with final ى; 'and you asked me'
فَأَخْبَرْتُكَ: فَـ + أَخْبَرْتُ + ـكَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + akhbartu, to tell (verb IV) perfect 1cs + 2ms object; 'and I told you'
بَالُهُ: بَال + ـهُ — bāl, mind, heart (m., nom.) + 3ms possessive; 'his mind'
وَفِكْرُهُ: وَ + فِكْر + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fikr, thought (m., nom.) + 3ms possessive; 'and his thought'
وَعَادَبِهِ: وَ + عَادَ + بِـ + ـهِ — wa-, and + ʿāda, to return (verb I) perfect 3ms + bi-, with (ʿāda bi- 'bring back') + 3ms; run together in the print; 'and he brought him back'
لِعَزِيزٍ: لِـ + عَزِيزٍ — li-, for (marks who it is set apart for, after afrada) + ʿAzīz, proper name (m., gen.); 'for ʿAzīz'
الْمَأْكَلِ: الـ + مَأْكَل — maʾkal, food, what is eaten (m., gen., after min; from akala, to eat); 'food'
وَالْمَشْرَبِ: وَ + الـ + مَشْرَب — wa-, and + mashrab, drink, what is drunk (m., gen.; from shariba, to drink); 'and drink'
وَالْمَلْبَسِ: وَ + الـ + مَلْبَس — wa-, and + malbas, clothing, what is worn (m., gen.; from labisa, to wear); 'and clothing'
يَحُلُّ: يَـ + حُلُّ — ya-, he/it (3ms prefix) + ḥalla, to take (a place), alight (verb I) imperfect 3ms; 'takes'
مَحَلَّ: مَحَلّ — maḥall, place, position (m., acc., object, in idāfa with al-naẓar); 'the place of'
وَالِاجْتِمَاعِ: وَ + الـ + اِجْتِمَاع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ijtimāʿ, meeting (verbal noun of verb VIII, m., gen.); 'and meeting'
مُتَغَيِّرَ: مُتَغَيِّر — mutaghayyir, changed (active participle of verb V, m., acc., in idāfa with al-lawn, 'changed of colour')
نَحِيفَ: نَحِيف — naḥīf, thin, slender (m., acc., in idāfa with al-jism); 'thin of'
وَنَحَلَ: وَ + نَحَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + naḥala, to grow thin, waste away (verb I) perfect 3ms; 'and grew thin'
فَأَعَادَ: فَـ + أَعَادَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿāda, to repeat, give back (verb IV) perfect 3ms; 'and he repeated'
وَقِصَّةِ: وَ + قِصَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., gen., in idāfa); 'and the story of'
عَشِقَهَا: عَشِقَ + ـهَا — ʿashiqa, to fall in love with (verb I) perfect 3ms + 3fs object; 'he fell in love with her'
السَّمَاعِ: الـ + سَّمَاع — al-, the + samāʿ, hearing (verbal noun of samiʿa, m., gen., after ʿalā); 'hearing' Also music listened to: min al-samāʿi al-muṭribi, 'of delightful music'.
وَبِلَادُهُ: وَ + بِلَاد + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + bilād, lands, country (pl., nom.) + 3ms possessive; 'and his lands'
بَعِيدَةٌ: بَعِيدَة — baʿīda, far, distant (f. sg., nom., predicate); 'far'
فَدَعْ: فَـ + دَعْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + daʿ, wadaʿa, to leave, let go (verb I) imperative 2ms; 'so leave'
الظَّمْأٰنِ: الـ + ظَّمْأَن — al-, the + ẓamʾān, thirsty (m., gen.; for ظَمْآن, written without madda, long ā marked with dagger alif); 'the thirsty one'
بَاكِىَ: بَاكِي — bākī, weeping (act. participle of bakā, m., acc., construct with al-ʿayn, 'weeping of eye'); written with final ى in the print
فَفِيهِ: فَـ + فِي + ـهِ — fa- for/so (links the reason to the command) + fī in (prep.) + -hi it (the palace, m.); 'for in it (there are)'
وَنَخْطُبُ: وَ + نَخْطُبُ — wa- and + nakhṭubu (I), khaṭaba, to ask a woman's hand in marriage, imperf. 1pl indic.; 'and we will ask for (you)'
بِنْتًامِنْ: بِنْتًا + مِنْ — print's run-together 'bintan min': bint, daughter (f., acc. indef., object of nakhṭubu) + min of/from (partitive, with banāt); 'a daughter of'
أَهِجْ: أَهِجْ — ahij, hāja, yahīju (I, hollow), to rage, run wild; imperf. 1sg jussive after wa-illā (otherwise); 'I will run wild'
الْبَرَارِي: الـ + بَرَارِي — al- the + barārī, broken plural of barriyya, wilderness, desert (f. pl., gen. after fī, defective)
وَالْقِفَارِ: وَ + الـ + قِفَار — wa- and + al- the + qifār, wastes, deserts, pl. of qafr (m., gen., coordinated after fī); 'and the wastes'
وَأَقْتُلْ: وَ + أَقْتُلْ — wa- and + aqtul, qatala, yaqtulu (I), to kill; imperf. 1sg jussive after illā, coordinated with ahij; 'and kill (myself)'
بِسَبَبِهَا: بِـ + سَبَب + ـهَا — bi- because of, on account of (prep.) + sabab, cause (m., gen.) + -hā her; 'for her sake'
وَأَخْطُبَهَا: وَ + أَخْطُبَ + ـهَا — wa- and + akhṭuba, khaṭaba (I), to ask in marriage, subjunctive 1sg after ḥattā + -hā her; 'and ask for her hand'
وَأُبَلِّغَكَ: وَ + أُبَلِّغَ + ـكَ — wa- and + uballigha, ballagha (II), to cause to reach, bring, subjunctive 1sg after ḥattā + -ka you; 'and bring you (to your desire)'
يُبَلِّغَكَ: يُبَلِّغَ + ـكَ — yuballigha, ballagha (II), to cause to reach, grant, subjunctive 3ms after an (following laʿalla) + -ka you; 'will grant you'
زَلْزَلْتُ: زَلْزَلْتُ — zalzaltu, zalzala (quadriliteral I), to shake, convulse; perf. 1sg, here the apodosis of in lam yarḍa; 'I will shake down'
مَمْلَكَتَهُ: مَمْلَكَة + ـهُ — mamlaka, kingdom (f., acc., object of zalzaltu) + -hu his; 'his kingdom'
بِجَيْشٍ: بِـ + جَيْش — bi- with, by means of (instrumental) + jaysh, army (m., gen. indef.); 'with an army'
آخِرُهُ: آخِر + ـهُ — ākhir, last, rear (m., nom., subject; active part. of I) + -hu its; 'whose rear'
وَأَوَّلُهُ: وَ + أَوَّل + ـهُ — wa- and + awwal, first, van (m., nom.) + -hu its; 'and its van'
رَأْيًا: رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, plan, counsel (m., acc. indef., object of dabbir, tanwīn -an); 'a plan'
مَلِكِهَا: مَلِك + ـهَا — malik, king (m., gen., iḍāfa with bint) + -hā their/its (the islands); 'their king'
زَائِدُ: زَائِد — zāʾid, increasing (active part. of zāda, I, m., nom., khabar, in iḍāfa with al-madad); 'ever more'
الْمَدَدِ: الـ + مَدَد — al- the + madad, supply, flow, increase (m., gen. in iḍāfa); zāʾid al-madad 'flowing ever more'
النِّيْرَانِ: الـ + نِّيْرَان — al- the + nīrān, fires, pl. of nār (f., gen. in iḍāfa after shiddat); verse word as pointed in the print; 'the fires'
تُخْبِرُكُمْ: تُخْبِرُ + كُمْ — tukhbiru, akhbara (IV), to inform, imperf. 3fs indic. (the nights, as fem. sing. agreement) + -kum you (m. pl.); akhbara takes bi- of the thing told; 'they will tell you'
وَالْكَمَدِ: وَ + الـ + كَمَد — wa- and + al- the + kamad, suppressed grief, anguish (m., gen., coordinated with al-hamm); 'and grief'
اَرْعَى: اَرْعَى — arʿā, raʿā, yarʿā (I), to pasture, watch over, observe; imperf. 1sg indic.; verse word as pointed in the print; 'I watch'
نُجُومَ: نُجُوم — nujūm, stars, pl. of najm (m., acc., object of arʿā, iḍāfa with al-layl); 'the stars (of night)'
وَلَهِي: وَلَه + ـِي — walah, distraction, passionate love (m., gen. after min, the wa- is root) + -ī my; 'from my distraction (of love)'
مُنْهَمِلٌ: مُنْهَمِل — munhamil, active part. of VII inhamala, to pour down, stream (m., nom. indef., khabar); 'pouring'
كَالْبَرَدِ: كَـ + الـ + بَرَد — ka- like (prep., introduces the comparison) + al- the + barad, hail (m., gen.); 'like hail'
وَحِيدًا: وَحِيد — waḥīd, alone, solitary (m., acc. indef., ḥāl after baqītu; the wa- is root); 'alone'
كَمِثْلِ: كَـ + مِثْل — ka- like (prep., pleonastic, comparing) + mithl, likeness (m., gen. in iḍāfa with ṣabbin); 'like'
اَهْلٍ: أَهْل — ahl, kin, family (m., gen. indef. after bi-lā); verse word as pointed in the print; 'kin'
يُفِقْ: يُفِقْ — yufiq, afāqa, yufīqu (IV, hollow), to come to oneself, recover consciousness; jussive 3ms after lam (shortened); 'did not come to himself'
خَادِمُ: خَادِم — khādim, servant (active part. of khadama, I, m., nom., iḍāfa with abīhi); 'servant (of his father)'
فَصَبَّرَهُ: فَـ + صَبَّرَ + ـهُ — fa- so, and (sequence) + ṣabbara (II), to bid be patient, console, perf. 3ms + -hu him; 'so he bade him be patient'
وَأَنْفَذَ: وَ + أَنْفَذَ — wa- and + anfadha (IV), to dispatch, send off, perf. 3ms; 'and sent'
لِيُخْبِرَهُ: لِـ + يُخْبِرَ + ـهُ — li- in order to (purpose, + subjunctive) + yukhbira, akhbara (IV, takes bi- of the news: bi-qudūmihim), subj. 3ms + -hu him; 'to tell him'
وَحُجَّابُ: وَ + حُجَّاب — wa- and + ḥujjāb, chamberlains, pl. of ḥājib (m., nom., iḍāfa with al-malik); 'and the chamberlains (of the king)'
وَأُمَرَاؤُهُ: وَ + أُمَرَاء + ـهُ — wa- and + umarāʾ, emirs, pl. of amīr (m., nom., iḍāfa) + -hu his; 'and his emirs'
وَلَاقَوْهُمْ: وَ + لَاقَوْ + هُمْ — wa- and + lāqaw, lāqā (III), to meet, perf. 3mpl + -hum them; 'and met them'
مَسِيرَةِ: مَسِيرَة — masīra, a journey, distance of travel (f., gen. after min, iḍāfa with farsakh); 'a distance of'
فَرْسَخٍ: فَرْسَخ — farsakh, parasang (about three miles; m., gen. indef.); 'a parasang'
فَتَلَقَّوْهُمْ: فَـ + تَلَقَّوْ + هُمْ — fa- and so (sequence) + talaqqaw, talaqqā (V), to receive, go out to meet, perf. 3mpl + -hum them; 'and received them'
خِدْمَتِهِمْ: خِدْمَة + ـِهِمْ — khidma, service, attendance (f., gen. after fī) + -him their; fī khidmatihim 'in attendance on them'
ضِيَافَتِهِ: ضِيَافَة + ـِهِ — ḍiyāfa, hospitality, entertainment of guests (f., gen. after fī) + -hi his; 'as his guests'
وَحَدَّثَهُ: وَ + حَدَّثَ + ـهُ — wa- and + ḥaddatha (II), to tell, speak to, perf. 3ms (takes bi- of the matter: bi-al-amr) + -hu him; 'and told him'
لَاتُحِبُّ: لَا + تُحِبُّ — print's run-together 'lā tuḥibbu': lā not (neg.) + tuḥibbu, aḥabba (IV), to love, imperf. 3fs indic.; 'does not love'
بِخَادِمٍ: بِـ + خَادِم — bi- (daʿā bi-, 'call for', the verb chooses bi-) + khādim, servant (m., gen. indef.); 'for a servant'
سَيِّدَتِكَ: سَيِّدَة + ـِكَ — sayyida, mistress, lady (f., gen. after ilā) + -ka your; 'your mistress'
وَأَعِدْ: وَ + أَعِدْ — wa- and + aʿid, aʿāda, yuʿīdu (IV, hollow), to repeat, relate again, imperative 2ms (followed by ʿalayhā 'to her'); 'and repeat'
جَاءَبِهِ: جَاءَ + بِـ + هِ — print's run-together 'jāʾa bihi' (misprint corrected): jāʾa (I), to come, perf. 3ms + bi- with (jāʾa bi- 'bring, come with') + -hi it; 'came with'
وَأَخْبَرْتُ: وَ + أَخْبَرْتُ — wa- and + akhbartu, akhbara (IV), to inform, perf. 1sg (takes the person as object and the thing with bi-: akhbara bi- 'inform of'); 'and I told'
غَضِبَتْ: غَضِبَتْ — ghaḍibat, ghaḍiba, yaghḍabu (I), to be angry (ʿalā 'at'), perf. 3fs; 'she grew angry'
بِعَصَاةٍ: بِـ + عَصَاة — bi- with (instrumental) + ʿaṣā, stick, staff (f., gen. indef.; the print spells it with final tāʾ marbūṭa); 'with a stick'
وَأَرَادَتْ: وَ + أَرَادَتْ — wa- and + arādat, arāda (IV, hollow), to want, intend, perf. 3fs; 'and she meant'
كَسْرَ: كَسْر — kasr, breaking (verbal noun of kasara, I; m., acc., object of arādat, iḍāfa with raʾsī); 'to break'
فَفَرَرْتُ: فَـ + فَرَرْتُ — fa- and so (consequence) + farartu, farra, yafirru (I, doubled), to flee, perf. 1sg (min 'from'); 'and I fled'
يَغْصِبُنِى: يَغْصِب + ـُنِى — yaghṣibu, ghaṣaba, yaghṣibu (I), to force, compel (ʿalā 'to'), imperf. 3ms indic. + -nī me (final yāʾ printed undotted); 'forces me'
فَالَّذِي: فَـ + الَّذِي — fa- then (introduces the apodosis of in kāna) + alladhī who, the one who (rel. pron., m. sg.); 'then the man whom'
وَلِعَزِيزٍ: وَ + لِـ + عَزِيز — wa- and + li- to (marks the person addressed with qāla) + ʿAzīz (proper name, gen. indef., corrected from the print's misprint); 'and to ʿAzīz'
سَمِعْتُمَا: سَمِعْتُمَا — samiʿtumā, samiʿa, yasmaʿu (I), to hear, perf. 2 dual (-tumā you two); 'you two have heard'
فَأَنْتُمَا: فَـ + أَنْتُمَا — fa- so, therefore (consequence) + antumā you two (dual pron., subject); 'so you two'
تَعْلَمَانِ: تَعْلَمَانِ — taʿlamāni, ʿalima, yaʿlamu (I), to know, imperf. 2 dual indic. (-āni); 'you know'
وَأَخْبِرَا: وَ + أَخْبِرَا — wa- and + akhbirā, akhbara (IV), to inform (the thing with bi-: bi-dhālika 'of that'), imperative 2 dual; 'and tell (both of you)'
وَسَلِّمَا: وَ + سَلِّمَا — wa- and + sallimā, sallama (II), to greet, give greetings, imperative 2 dual; 'and give (my) greetings'
شَهْرَمَانَ: Shahramān — proper name, king of the Camphor Islands (m. sing., acc. after inna, in apposition to al-malik; diptote); 'Shahramān' Also another king of the name, Qamar al-Zamān's father, whose tale follows: gen. (diptote, fatḥa) in apposition, ḥadīthi al-maliki Shahramāna, 'the tale of King Shahramān'.; here: gen. in apposition to al-malik, after ʿalā; here Qamar al-Zamān's father, acc. as the noun of anna: anna al-malika Shahramāna; also acc. in apposition after anna wālidaka al-malika, 'that your father King Shahramān' (Night 201)
وَعَزِيزٍ: وَ + عَزِيز — wa-, and + ʿAzīz, proper name, 'dear, mighty' (m., gen., coordinated with a preceding genitive: min amri al-wazīri wa-ʿazīzin, 'of the affair of the vizier and ʿAzīz'; after li-al-wazīr, 'and to ʿAzīz')
سَلِّمَا: sallimā — سَلِّمَا: sallama (II), to greet, give greeting (imperative, 2nd dual m., the final -ā is the dual ending; takes ʿalā for the one greeted); 'greet, you two'
وَإِنَّكُمَا: وَ + إِنَّ + كُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + inna, indeed (particle; puts its subject in the accusative) + -kumā, you two (2nd dual attached pronoun, acc.); 'and indeed you two'
تُخْبِرَانِ: tukhbirāni — تُخْبِرَانِ: akhbara (IV), to inform (imperfect indicative, 2nd dual m.; akhbara takes bi- for what is told, as in the bi-mā and bi-anna that follow; imperfect after inna used as a polite command); 'you shall tell'
سَمِعْتُمَاهُ: سَمِعْتُمَا + هُ — samiʿa (I), to hear + -tumā, you two (perfect ending, 2nd dual) + -hu, it (3rd m. sing. pronoun, acc., referring back to mā, ‘what’); 'you two heard it'
بِمَاجَرَي: بِـ + مَا + جَرَى — bi-, with/of (verbs of telling, ḥaddatha and akhbara, take bi- for what is told) + mā, what + jarā, it happened (I); 'about what happened' (printed run together, with final ي for ى)
ذَنْبَ: dhanb — ذَنْبَ: sin, fault, blame (m. sing., acc. without tanwīn after lā of absolute negation: lā dhanba lahu, ‘there is no fault to him’); 'no blame'
غَصَبَنِى: ghaṣaba (I), to force, compel (perfect 3rd m. sing., here with future sense in the conditional clause after in, ‘if’; takes ʿalā for what one is forced into) + -nī, me (acc.); 'forces me' (printed with final ى for ي)
أَقْتُلْ: aqtul — أَقْتُلْ: qatala (I), to kill (imperfect jussive, 1st sing., the jussive after the conditional in, ‘if’); 'I will kill'
الِامْتِنَاعُ: الـ + اِمْتِنَاع — al-, the (article; the alif of imtināʿ is a hamzat waṣl, so the pair is written with a kasra) + imtināʿ, refusal, abstaining (VIII verbal noun of imtanaʿa; m. sing., nom., subject); 'the refusal'
حَارَبْتُ: ḥārabtu — حَارَبْتُ: ḥāraba (III), to fight, make war on (perfect, 1st sing., with future sense in the conditional clause); 'I make war on'
تَقْتُلُ: taqtulu — تَقْتُلُ: qatala (I), to kill (imperfect indicative, 3rd f. sing.); 'she will kill'
يُفِيدُنِي: yufīdunī — يُفِيدُنِي: afāda (IV), to benefit, profit (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -nī, me (acc.); 'profits me' (with lā before it: 'nothing will profit me')
ابْنَهُ: ابْن + هُ — ibn, son (m. sing., acc., object of aʿlama) + -hu, his (3rd m. sing. pronoun); 'his son'
أُطِيقُ: uṭīqu — أُطِيقُ: aṭāqa (IV), to be able to bear, endure (imperfect indicative, 1st sing.); 'I can bear' (with lā: 'I cannot bear')
اتِّصَالِي: ittiṣāl + ī — ittiṣāl, joining, reaching, union (VIII verbal noun of ittaṣala, root w-ṣ-l; m. sing., gen. after fī, ‘in’; the verbal noun takes bi- for the one joined) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'my reaching her'
وَعَزِيزًا: وَ + عَزِيز — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿAzīz, proper name (m. sing., acc., joined to al-wazīr, the object of khudh, ‘take’); 'and ʿAzīz'
وَهَيَّأَ: وَ + هَيَّأَ — wa-, and (conj.) + hayyaʾa (II), to prepare, make ready (perfect, 3rd m. sing.); 'and he made ready'
وَعَزِيزٌ: وَ + عَزِيز — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿAzīz, proper name (m. sing., nom., joined to the subject Tāj al-Mulūk of dhahaba); 'and ʿAzīz'
مَسْلُوبَ: maslūb — مَسْلُوبَ: passive participle of salaba (I), to rob, strip (m. sing., acc. as the predicate of ṣāra, ‘he became’; first term of an iḍāfa with al-fuʾād, ‘robbed of heart’); 'robbed of'
وَلَارُقَادٌ: وَ + لَا + رُقَاد — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, nor (negative, repeating the negation of lam yaṭib) + ruqād, sleep (m. sing., nom.); 'nor sleep' (printed run together)
مَحْبُوبَتِهِ: maḥbūba + hi — maḥbūba, beloved (f. sing., passive participle of ḥabba I, ‘to love’ (the usual verb is aḥabba IV); gen. after ilā, ‘to’) + -hi, his (3rd m. sing. pronoun); 'his beloved'
فَتَوَسَّلَ: فَ + تَوَسَّلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + tawassala (V), to entreat, plead (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; takes bi- for the one appealed to); 'and he besought'
بِالْخَلَّاقِ: بِـ + الـ + خَلَّاق — bi-, by/to (prep.; tawassala bi- names the one appealed to) + al-, the + khallāq, creator (intensive form of khalaqa, ‘to create’; m. sing., gen.; a name of God); 'to the Creator'
بِالتَّلَاقِ: بِـ + الـ + تَلَاق — bi-, with (prep.; manna ʿalā … bi-, ‘to bestow … on’, names the gift) + al-, the + talāq, meeting (VI verbal noun of talāqā, ‘to meet one another’; m. sing., gen.; here the meeting of lovers); 'with the meeting'
وُصُوْلُ: wuṣūl — وُصُوْلُ: union, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala I; m. sing., nom., subject of the clause hal lanā wuṣūl, ‘is there for us a union?’; the print puts a sukūn on the wāw, and the final -u is the rhyme vowel); 'union'
فَاَشْكُوْ: فَ + أَشْكُو — fa-, so that (conj.; here introducing the result of the wish) + ashkū, I complain/tell (shakā I, imperfect 1st sing.; shakā ilā, ‘to complain to’; the print writes the alif without hamza and the wāw with sukūn); 'so that I may tell'
الَيْكُمْ: إِلَى + كُمْ — ilā, to (prep.; shakā ilā names the one complained to) + -kum, you (2nd m. pl. pronoun, gen.); 'to you' (the print writes the alif without hamza)
صَبْوَتِي: ṣabwa + ī — ṣabwa, longing, passion (f. sing., verbal noun of ṣabā, ‘to yearn’; acc., object of ashkū) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'my longing'
وَاَقُوْلُ: وَ + أَقُولُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqūlu, I say (qāla I, imperfect 1st sing.; the print writes the alif without hamza and the wāw with sukūn); 'and say'
تَذَكَّرْتُكُمْ: tadhakkartu + kum — tadhakkara (V), to remember (perfect, 1st sing.) + -kum, you (2nd m. pl. pronoun, acc.); 'I remembered you'
وَاَسْهَرْتُمُوْنِي: وَ + أَسْهَرْتُمُونِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ashara (IV, root s-h-r), to keep awake, make sleepless + -tum, you (perfect, 2nd m. pl.; the mīm is lengthened to -mū before the suffix, here -nī) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and you kept me awake' (the print writes the alif without hamza, the wāw with sukūn)
وَالْاَنَامُ: وَ + الـ + أَنَام — wa-, while (circumstantial wa-, ‘and’) + al-, the + anām, mankind, creatures (m. collective, nom., subject); 'while all creatures' (the print writes the alif without hamza)
غَفُوْلُ: ghafūl — غَفُوْلُ: heedless (intensive faʿūl form of ghafala, ‘to be heedless’; m. sing., nom., predicate; the print puts a sukūn on the wāw, and the final -u is the rhyme vowel); 'heedless, asleep'
يَبْكِيَانِ: yabkiyāni — يَبْكِيَانِ: bakā (I), to weep (imperfect indicative, 3rd dual m.; the predicate of lā zālā, ‘the two did not cease’); 'weeping'
أُهْبَةَ: uhba — أُهْبَةَ: gear, equipment (f. sing., acc., the object of the active participle lābis, ‘wearing’; first term of an iḍāfa with al-safar); 'the gear of'
وَدَّعَتْهُ: waddaʿa (II), to bid farewell (root w-d-ʿ; perfect, 3rd f. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'she bade him farewell' (the initial و is a root letter, not wa-, ‘and’; compare daʿat lahu, ‘she prayed for him’, from d-ʿ-w)
بِالْأَحْبَابِ: بِـ + الـ + أَحْبَاب — bi-, with (prep.; ijtimāʿ bi-, ‘meeting with’, takes bi- for those met) + al-, the + aḥbāb, loved ones (m. pl., broken plural of ḥabīb, gen.); 'with those he loved'
وَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ: وَ + اِسْتَأْذَنَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + istaʾdhana (X), to ask leave of (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; takes a direct object for the person asked) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and asked his leave'
يَرْحَلَ: yarḥala — يَرْحَلَ: raḥala (I), to set out, depart (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd m. sing., after an, ‘to’); 'to set out'
تُضْرَبَ: tuḍraba — تُضْرَبَ: ḍaraba (I), to strike, pitch a tent (imperfect passive, 3rd f. sing., subjunctive after an; the subject is the feminine khaymatun, ‘a tent’); 'be pitched'
الْخَيْمَةُ: al-khayma — الْخَيْمَةُ: الـ + خَيْمَة — al-, the + khayma, tent (f. sing., nom., subject of the passive ḍuribat); 'the tent'
بِعَزِيزٍ: بِـ + عَزِيزٍ — bi-, in (prep.; istaʾnasa bi-, ‘to find comfort in, take pleasure in the company of’, names the companion) + ʿAzīz, proper name (m. sing., gen.); 'in ʿAzīz'
بِوَالِدَتِي: بِـ + وَالِدَة + ـِي — bi-, with/by (prep.; ishtaghala bi-, ‘to be preoccupied with’, names the cause of worry) + wālida, mother (f. sing., gen.; active participle of walada used as a noun) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'with my mother'
نَبْلُغُ: nablughu — نَبْلُغُ: balagha (I), to reach, attain (imperfect indicative, 1st pl.; lammā with the imperfect, spoken usage, for a time to come); 'we reach'
بِالِاصْطِبَارِ: بِـ + الـ + اِصْطِبَار — bi-, to (prep.; awṣā bi-, ‘to enjoin, urge’, names what is urged) + al-, the + iṣṭibār, patience (VIII verbal noun of iṣṭabara, root ṣ-b-r; m. sing., gen.); 'to patience'
يُسَامِرُهُ: yusāmiru + hu — sāmara (III), to keep company in evening talk, samar (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'keeps him company'
وَيُحَدِّثُهُ: وَ + يُحَدِّثُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuḥaddithu, ḥaddatha (II), to tell, relate (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.; takes bi- for what is told, as in the next word) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and tells him'
بِالتَّوَارِيخِ: بِـ + الـ + تَوَارِيخ — bi-, of (prep.; ḥaddatha bi-, ‘to tell of’, names what is told) + al-, the + tawārīkh, histories, chronicles (m. pl., broken plural of tārīkh, gen.; diptote); 'of histories'
وَالْأَخْبَارِ: وَ + الـ + أَخْبَار — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + akhbār, tales, reports (m. pl., broken plural of khabar, gen., joined to al-tawārīkh and so also governed by bi-); 'and tales'
يَجِدُّونَ: yajiddūna — يَجِدُّونَ: jadda (I, geminate), to be earnest, press on (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. pl.; jadda fī al-sayr, ‘to press on with the journey’); 'they press on'
فَطَالَتِ: فَ + طَالَتِ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ṭālat, ṭāla (I), to be long (perfect, 3rd f. sing.; the final -i is the vowel supplied before the next word’s al-, here al-ṭarīq, which is feminine here); 'and so grew long'
وَالْقَلَق: وَ + الـ + قَلَق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + qalaq, unrest, anxiety (m. sing., nom., joined to al-hamm; the print leaves the rhyme word without a final vowel); 'and unrest'
الْحُرَقِ: al-ḥuraq — الْحُرَقِ: الـ + حُرَق — al-, the + ḥuraq, burnings, flames (plural of ḥurqa, f.; nom., subject of zādat; the print gives the rhyme vowel -i); 'the burnings' Also gen. after min: mā bi-qalbika mina al-ḥuraqi, 'the burnings in your heart'.
مُنْيَتِي: munya + ī — munya, wish, desire, heart’s desire (f. sing., vocative, after yā in the printed line) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'my wish'
يَامُنْتَهَى: يَا + مُنْتَهَى — yā, O (vocative particle; printed run together) + muntahā, utmost, end (VIII passive participle of intahā, a defective noun of place; m. sing., vocative, first term of an iḍāfa with amalī); 'O utmost of'
اَمَلِيْ: amal + ī — amal, hope (m. sing., gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun; the print writes the alif without hamza and the yāʾ with sukūn); 'my hope'
الْانْسَانَ: al-insān — الْانْسَانَ: الـ + إِنْسَان — al-, the + insān, man, human being (m. sing., acc., object of khalaqa; the print writes the alif without hamza); 'man'
عَلَقِ: ʿalaq — عَلَقِ: clot (of blood), leech-like clot (collective, m., gen. after min, ‘from’; echoes Qurʾān 96:2; the print gives the rhyme vowel -i); 'a clot'
يَاسُؤْلِيْ: يَا + سُؤْل + ـِي — yā, O (vocative particle; printed run together) + suʾl, request, desire (m. sing., vocative) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun; the print writes the yāʾ with sukūn); 'O my desire'
تَحْمِلْنَهُ: taḥmilna + hu — taḥmilna, ḥamala (I), to bear, carry (imperfect jussive after lam, 3rd f. pl., agreeing with jibāl; the ending -na marks the f. pl.) + -hu, it (3rd m. sing. pronoun, acc., the passion); 'did not bear it'
جِبَالُ: jibāl — جِبَالُ: mountains (m. pl., broken plural of jabal, nom., subject of lam taḥmilnahu; first term of an iḍāfa with al-shumm); 'the mountains of'
الشُّمِّ: al-shumm — الشُّمِّ: الـ + شُمّ — al-, the + shumm, lofty, high-peaked (plural of ashamm, adjective; gen., second term of the iḍāfa jibālu al-shummi); 'the lofty'
بِالْاَرَقِ: بِـ + الـ + أَرَق — bi-, with/in (prep., of accompaniment: ‘together with’) + al-, the + araq, sleeplessness, insomnia (m. sing., gen.; the print writes the alif without hamza); 'with sleeplessness'
دُنْيَايَ: dunyā + ya — dunyā, world (f. sing., gen., second term of the iḍāfa after sitta; also the beloved’s name, Sitt Dunyā, ‘Lady World’) + -ya, my (1st sing. pronoun; the alif is kept before it, dunyāya); 'my world'
اَهْلَكَنِيْ: ahlaka + nī — ahlaka (IV), to destroy, ruin (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -nī, me (acc.; the print writes the alif without hamza and the yāʾ with sukūn); 'has ruined me'
وَرَدَّنِي: وَ + رَدَّ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + radda (I), to return, render (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; here taking two objects, ‘made me … dead’) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and left me'
مَافِيَّ: مَا + فِي + يَ — mā, not (negative particle) + fī, in (prep.) + -ya, me (1st sing. pronoun; fī + ya becomes fiyya); 'there is not in me' (printed run together)
رَمَقِ: ramaq — رَمَقِ: last breath, spark of life (m. sing., gen. after min, which is added for emphasis after the negative; the print gives the rhyme vowel -i); 'any breath'
الرَّجَاءُ: al-rajāʾ — الرَّجَاءُ: الـ + رَجَاء — al-, the + rajāʾ, hope (m. sing., nom., subject after lawlā, ‘were it not for’); 'the hope'
يُطْمِعُنِيْ: yuṭmiʿu + nī — yuṭmiʿu, aṭmaʿa (IV), to lure, make hope (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -nī, me (acc.; the print writes the yāʾ with sukūn); 'lures me on'
شَخْصِي: shakhṣ + ī — shakhṣ, person, body (m. sing., nom., the name of kāna) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'my person, I'
مُنْطَلِقِ: munṭaliq — مُنْطَلِقِ: setting out, going off (active participle of VII inṭalaqa; m. sing., the sense is a hāl, which would take -an, but the print gives the rhyme vowel -i); 'setting out'
جَرِيحُ: jarīḥ — جَرِيحُ: wounded (faʿīl form of jaraḥa I, ‘to wound’; m. sing., nom., predicate of annahu; first term of an iḍāfa with al-qalb, ‘wounded of heart’); 'wounded'
يَاوَزِيرُ: يَا + وَزِير — yā, O (vocative particle; printed run together) + wazīr, vizier (m. sing., nom. in the vocative, the form of address for a single unqualified noun); 'O vizier'
وَالْأَوْعَارَ: وَ + الـ + أَوْعَار — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + awʿār, rough ground (m. pl., broken plural of waʿr, acc., object of yaqṭaʿūna, ‘cross’); 'and the rough country'
وَالْبَرَارِيَ: وَ + الـ + بَرَارِي — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + barārī, wildernesses, open deserts (f. pl., broken plural of barriyya; acc., object of yaqṭaʿūna; the final yāʾ is the defective plural ending, here with fatḥa); 'and the wildernesses'
إِذْرَأَى: إِذْ + رَأَى — idh, behold, suddenly (particle, answering baynamā, ‘while’) + raʾā, he saw (I perfect, 3rd m. sing., of raʾā, here ‘he dreamed’); 'behold, he saw' (printed run together; the print’s plain spelling lacks the hamza, اذراى)
يُعَانِقُهَا: yuʿāniqu + hā — ʿāniqa (III), to embrace (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing., in a circumstantial clause) + -hā, her (3rd f. sing. pronoun, acc.); 'he embraces her'
وَيَضُمُّهَا: وَ + يَضُمُّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḍummu, ḍamma (I), to hold close, clasp (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -hā, her (acc.); 'and holds her'
مَرْعُوبًا: marʿūb — مَرْعُوبًا: terrified (passive participle of raʿaba I, ‘to terrify’; m. sing., acc., hāl, ‘in a state of’); 'terrified'
فَزِعًا: faziʿ — فَزِعًا: startled, in a fright (adjective of faziʿa I, ‘to be frightened’; m. sing., acc., hāl); 'startled'
طَائِرَ: ṭāʾir — طَائِرَ: flying, flown (active participle of ṭāra I, ‘to fly’; m. sing., acc., hāl; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ʿaql, ‘flown of mind’); 'with wits flown'
هَامَ: hāma — هَامَ: hāma (I, hollow), to wander distraught, be mad with love (perfect, 3rd m. sing.); 'has wandered distraught'
سَاجِمُ: sājim — سَاجِمُ: pouring, flowing (active participle of sajama I, ‘to pour’; m. sing., nom., predicate of al-damʿ); 'pouring'
غَزِيْرٌ: ghazīr — غَزِيْرٌ: abundant, copious (faʿīl adjective of ghazura I; m. sing., nom., predicate of wajdī; the print writes the yāʾ with sukūn); 'abundant'
مُلَازِمُ: mulāzim — مُلَازِمُ: clinging, constant (active participle of lāzama III, ‘to cling to’; m. sing., nom., predicate of al-gharām); 'clinging'
وَنَوْحِي: وَ + نَوْح + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + nawḥ, lament, wailing (verbal noun of nāḥa I; m. sing., nom., subject) + -ī, my (1st sing. pronoun); 'and my lament'
كَنَوْحِ: كَـ + نَوْح — ka-, like (prep., of comparison; governs the genitive) + nawḥ, lament (m. sing., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-thākilāt); 'like the lament of'
الثَّاكِلَاتِ: al-thākilāt — الثَّاكِلَاتِ: الـ + ثَاكِلَات — al-, the + thākilāt, bereaved women (f. pl., sound plural of thākila, active participle of thakila I, ‘to be bereaved’; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the bereaved women'
نُحْتُ: nuḥtu — نُحْتُ: nāḥa (I, hollow), to lament (perfect, 1st sing., used for a present or habitual action in the main clause after idhā); 'I lament'
نَوْحَ: nawḥa — نَوْحَ: lament (m. sing., acc., absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) of nuḥtu; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ḥamāʾim); 'the lament of'
الْحَمَائِمِ: al-ḥamāʾim — الْحَمَائِمِ: الـ + حَمَائِم — al-, the + ḥamāʾim, doves (f. pl., broken plural of ḥamāma; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the doves'
نَحْوَارْضِكُمْ: naḥwa + arḍ + kum — naḥwa, towards, in the direction of (adverbial accusative, governing the genitive) + arḍ, land, earth (f. sing., gen.) + -kum, your (2nd m. pl. pronoun); 'the direction of your land' (printed run together, with the alif of arḍ written without hamza)
بَرْدًا: bard — بَرْدًا: coolness (m. sing., acc., indefinite, object of wajadtu); 'a coolness'; here: acc. of manner after nazala: nazala ʿalā qalbihi bardan wa-salāman, 'it came down on his heart as coolness and peace'
قَادِمِ: qādim — قَادِمِ: coming (active participle of qadima I, ‘to come’; m. sing., qualifying bardan, so grammar wants the accusative -an; the print gives the rhyme vowel -i); 'coming'
قُمْرِيٌّ: qumriyy — قُمْرِيٌّ: turtle-dove (m. sing., nom., subject of ṭāra; a nisba adjective used as a noun); 'a turtle-dove'
وَنَاحَتْ: وَ + نَاحَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + nāḥat, nāḥa (I, hollow), to lament (perfect, 3rd f. sing., agreeing with the plural of a non-human noun); 'and lament'
حَمَائِمُ: ḥamāʾim — حَمَائِمُ: doves (f. pl., broken plural of ḥamāma; nom., subject of nāḥat; diptote); 'doves'
تَبْلُغَ: tablugha — تَبْلُغَ: balagha (I), to reach (imperfect subjunctive, 2nd m. sing., after an in lā budda an, ‘you will surely’); 'you reach'
وَصَبَّرَهُ: وَ + صَبَّرَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣabbara (II), to make patient, console (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and consoled him'
يُلْهِيهِ: yulhī + hi — yulhī, alhā (IV), to divert, amuse (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -hi, him (3rd m. sing. pronoun, acc.); 'amuses him'
وَيُحَادِثُهُ: وَ + يُحَادِثُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuḥādithu, ḥādatha (III), to converse with (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and talks with him'
وَيَحْكِي: وَ + يَحْكِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḥkī, ḥakā (I, defective), to relate, tell (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.; takes li- for the hearer, here lahu); 'and tells'
آخَرَيْنِ: ākharayn — آخَرَيْنِ: another, other (dual m. oblique of ākhar, adjective qualifying shahrayn, ‘two months’; gen. after muddat); 'another (two months)'
أَشْرَقَتْ: ashraqat — أَشْرَقَتْ: ashraqa (IV), to shine, rise (of the sun) (perfect, 3rd f. sing., agreeing with al-shams; takes ʿalā for those shone upon); 'shone'
الْبَيَاضُ: al-bayāḍ — الْبَيَاضُ: الـ + بَيَاض — al-, the + bayāḍ, whiteness (m. sing., noun from the root b-y-ḍ (cf. ibyaḍḍa IX, ‘to be white’); nom., in apposition to hādhā); 'the whiteness'
الْقَلْعَةُ: al-qalʿa — الْقَلْعَةُ: الـ + قَلْعَة — al-, the + qalʿa, castle, fortress (f. sing., nom., predicate); 'the castle'
الْبَيْضَاءُ: al-bayḍāʾ — الْبَيْضَاءُ: الـ + بَيْضَاء — al-, the + bayḍāʾ, white (f. of abyaḍ; diptote adjective, nom., qualifying al-qalʿa); 'the White (castle)'
طَالِبُهَا: ṭālib + hā — ṭālib, seeker (active participle of ṭalaba I, ‘to seek’; m. sing., nom., predicate of anta; takes a direct object through the suffix) + -hā, it (3rd f. sing. pronoun, the city); 'seeking it'
دَخَلُوهَا: dakhalū + hā — dakhala (I), to enter (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; takes a direct object, here the city) + -hā, it (3rd f. sing. pronoun, acc.); 'they entered it'
سِيمَةِ: sīma — سِيمَةِ: mark, appearance, guise (f. sing., gen. after fī, ‘in’; first term of an iḍāfa with al-tujjār); 'in the guise of'
بِمَنْزِلِ: بِـ + مَنْزِل — bi-, by (prep.; yuʿrafu bi-, ‘is known by’, names the name or title it is known by) + manzil, lodging, resting-place (m. sing., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-tujjār); 'by (the name of) the Lodging of'
خَانٌ: khān — خَانٌ: inn, caravanserai for merchants and their goods (m. sing., nom., indefinite, predicate of huwa); 'an inn'
أَهَذَا: أَ + هَذَا — a-, is? (interrogative particle) + hādhā, this (m. sing. demonstrative, nom.); 'is this'
مَحَلُّ: maḥall — مَحَلُّ: place, lodging (m. sing., nom., predicate; first term of an iḍāfa with al-tujjār); 'the place of'
وَأَنَاخُوا: وَ + أَنَاخُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + anākhū, anākha (IV), to make a camel kneel (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; the final alif is silent); 'and they made kneel'
مَطِيَّهُمْ: maṭiyy + hum — maṭiyy, mounts, riding-beasts (collective, m., acc., object of anākhū) + -hum, their (3rd m. pl. pronoun); 'their mounts'
رِحَالَهُمْ: riḥāl + hum — riḥāl, saddles, baggage (m. pl., broken plural of raḥl, acc., object of ḥaṭṭū, ‘they unloaded’) + -hum, their (3rd m. pl. pronoun); 'their baggage'
وَخَزَنُوا: وَ + خَزَنُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + khazanū, khazana (I), to store, lay up (perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'and they stored'
أَمْتِعَتَهُمْ: amtiʿa + hum — amtiʿa, goods, baggage (m. pl., broken plural of matāʿ, acc., object of khazanū) + -hum, their (3rd m. pl. pronoun); 'their goods'
يَكْتَرُوا: yaktarū — يَكْتَرُوا: iktarā (VIII, defective), to hire, rent (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd m. pl., after an, ‘to’; the nūn dropped, the final alif silent); 'to rent'
وَاسِعَةَ: wāsiʿa — وَاسِعَةَ: spacious (f. sing., active participle of wasiʿa I, ‘to be wide’; acc., qualifying dāran; first term of an iḍāfa with al-bunyān, ‘spacious of build’); 'spacious'
يُدَبِّرَانِ: yudabbirāni — يُدَبِّرَانِ: dabbara (II), to devise, manage (imperfect indicative, 3rd dual m., in a circumstantial clause after the subjects al-wazīr and ʿAzīz); 'devising'
تَاجَرَ: tājara — تَاجَرَ: tājara (III, from tajara), to trade (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; the same letters could be tājir, ‘a merchant’, and it is read here as the verb); 'he traded'
قَيْصَرِيَّةِ: qayṣariyya — قَيْصَرِيَّةِ: covered market of shops (f. sing., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa with al-bazz; from Qayṣar, ‘Caesar’, so ‘imperial’ market); 'in the covered market of'
الْبَزِّ: al-bazz — الْبَزِّ: الـ + بَزّ — al-, the + bazz, cloth, linen and fine stuffs (m. sing., gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the cloth'
تُقْضَي: tuqḍā — تُقْضَي: qaḍā (I, defective), to fulfil (imperfect indicative passive, 3rd f. sing., agreeing with ḥāja, ‘need’); 'is fulfilled' (printed with final ي for ى)
مَابَدَا: مَا + بَدَا — mā, what, whatever (relative pronoun) + badā, it appeared (I perfect, 3rd m. sing., of badā, ‘to appear’; the full phrase badā laka means ‘seemed good to you’); 'what seems good' (printed run together)
مَارَسْتَ: mārasta — مَارَسْتَ: mārasa (III), to practise, be versed in (perfect, 2nd m. sing., after qad); 'you have practised' (the verb takes a direct object, al-umūr)
مَاخَطَرَ: مَا + خَطَرَ — mā, what (relative pronoun) + khaṭara, it came to mind (I perfect, 3rd m. sing., of khaṭara; takes bi- for the mind it enters); 'what came' (printed run together)
بِبَالِكَ: بِـ + بَال + كَ — bi-, in (prep.; khaṭara bi-bālihi, ‘it occurred to him’, where the thought comes to rest in the mind) + bāl, mind, heed (m. sing., gen.) + -ka, your (2nd m. sing. pronoun); 'in your mind'
نَكْتَرِي: naktarī — نَكْتَرِي: iktarā (VIII, defective), to rent (imperfect indicative, 1st pl., after anna); 'we rent'
لِلْبَيْعِ: لِـ + الـ + بَيْع — li-, for (prep., of purpose) + al-, the (the alif of al- is not written after li-: لل) + bayʿ, selling (verbal noun of bāʿa I; m. sing., gen.); 'for selling'
كُلَّوَاحِدٍ: kull + wāḥid — kull, every (m. sing., acc. after li-anna, first term of an iḍāfa) + wāḥid, one (m. sing., gen., with tanwīn); 'everyone' (printed run together)
وَالْعَامِّ: وَ + الـ + عَامّ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ʿāmm, common, general (active participle of ʿamma I, used as a noun; m. sing., gen., coordinated with al-khāṣṣ after min); 'and the common people'
وَالتَّفَاصِيلِ: وَ + الـ + تَفَاصِيل — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + tafāṣīl, pieces cut to length (m. pl., broken plural of tafṣīl; gen., coordinated with al-bazz after ilā); 'and lengths of cloth'
وَقَعَدْتَ: وَ + قَعَدْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qaʿadta, qaʿada (I), to sit (perfect, 2nd m. sing., in the clause after idhā, ‘when’); 'and sit'
يَنْصَلِحُ: yanṣaliḥu — يَنْصَلِحُ: inṣalaḥa (VII), to come right, be set right (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.; a form of the spoken language); 'comes right'
وَصُورَتُكَ: وَ + صُورَة + كَ — wa-, since (circumstantial wa-, ‘and’) + ṣūra, form, looks (f. sing., nom., subject of a circumstantial clause) + -ka, your (2nd m. sing. pronoun); 'since your looks'
أَمِينًا: amīn — أَمِينًا: trustworthy (faʿīl adjective, from amina I; m. sing., acc., second object of ijʿal, ‘make’); 'a trusted man'
وَأَجْلِسْهُ: وَ + أَجْلِسْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlis, ajlasa (IV), to seat (imperative, 2nd m. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and seat him'
لِيُنَا: لِـ + يُنَا — li-, so that (particle of purpose, followed by the subjunctive) + yunā-, the first half of yunāwila, nāwala (III), to hand, give (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd m. sing.); 'so that he may hand' (halves of li-yunāwilaka printed as two words, with the next word وِلَكَ)
وِلَكَ: وِ + لَكَ — the second half of li-yunāwilaka, ‘so that he may hand you’ (yunā- + -wi-la-ka: nāwala III, imperfect subjunctive 3rd m. sing., after li-, whose first half is لِيُنَا) + -ka, you (2nd m. sing. pronoun, acc.); 'hand you' (the two halves are printed as two words and read as one verb)
وَالْأَقْمِشَةَ: وَ + الـ + أَقْمِشَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aqmisha, fabrics (m. pl., broken plural of qumāsh, acc., second object of yunāwila); 'and the fabrics'
وَمَلِيحٌ: وَ + مَلِيح — wa-, and (conj.) + malīḥ, good, fine (faʿīl adjective, from malūḥa; m. sing., nom., joined to sadīd as predicate); 'and good'
تُجَّارِيَّةً: tujjāriyya — تُجَّارِيَّةً: of the merchants’ kind, merchant’s (f. sing., nisba adjective from tājir, pl. tujjār; acc., indefinite, qualifying badla; corrected from the print’s تجّاربة); 'a merchant’s'
وَلَبِسَهَا: وَ + لَبِسَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + labisa (I), to put on, wear (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -hā, it (3rd f. sing. pronoun, acc., the suit); 'and put it on'
وَأَعْطَي: وَ + أَعْطَى — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿṭā (IV), to give (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; here the receiver takes li-, spoken Arabic, where Classical has a second object); 'and gave' (printed with final ي for ى)
لِأَحَدِهِمْ: لِـ + أَحَد + هِمْ — li-, to (prep., marking the receiver of aʿṭā) + aḥad, one (m. sing., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa) + -him, of them (3rd m. pl. pronoun); 'to one of them'
مَصَالِحَ: maṣāliḥ — مَصَالِحَ: requirements, affairs (f. pl., broken plural of maṣlaḥa; acc., diptote, object of yaqḍī; first term of an iḍāfa with al-dukkān); 'the needs of'
تَحَيَّرُوا: taḥayyarū — تَحَيَّرُوا: taḥayyara (V), to be bewildered, amazed (perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'they were amazed'
رِضْوَانَ: Riḍwān — رِضْوَانَ: proper name, the angel who keeps the gates of Paradise (m., acc. after inna, diptote); 'Riḍwān'
وَغَفَلَ: وَ + غَفَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghafala (I), to be heedless, look away (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; takes ʿan for what one overlooks, here ʿanhā); 'and looked away'
الْبَدِيعُ: al-badīʿ — الْبَدِيعُ: الـ + بَدِيع — al-, the + badīʿ, marvellous, wondrous (faʿīl adjective of badaʿa I; m. sing., nom., qualifying al-shābb; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ḥusn, ‘marvellous of beauty’); 'the marvellous'
الْمَلَائِكَةِ: الـ + مَلَائِكَة — al-, the + malāʾika, angels (m. pl., broken plural of malak; gen. after min, ‘of’, partitive); 'the angels'
سَأَلُوا: saʾalū — سَأَلُوا: saʾala (I), to ask (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; takes ʿan for what is asked about); 'they asked'
فَمَازَالُوا: فَ + مَا + زَالُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + mā, not (negative particle) + zālū, they ceased (I perfect, 3rd m. pl., of zāla; mā zāla with a participle means ‘to keep on’); 'and so they kept on' (printed run together)
وَعَظَّمُوهُمْ: وَ + عَظَّمُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿaẓẓamū, ʿaẓẓama (II), to honour, magnify (perfect, 3rd m. pl.) + -hum, them (acc.); 'and honoured them'
مَهَابًا: mahāb — مَهَابًا: awe-inspiring, imposing (adjective, a variant of mahīb from hāba I, ‘to fear, revere’; m. sing., acc., qualifying rajulan); 'imposing'
الشَّابَّيْنِ: al-shābbayn — الشَّابَّيْنِ: الـ + شَابَّيْن — al-, the + shābbayn, two young men (dual m. of shābb, active participle of shabba I, ‘to be young’; gen., in apposition to the demonstrative hādhayni); 'the two young men' Also acc., in apposition to hādhayni as the object of khudh: khudh hādhayni al-shābbayni, 'take these two young men'.
وَتَأَمَّلَهُ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾammala (V), to look closely at (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and looked at him closely'
هَيْبَةٍ: hayba — هَيْبَةٍ: awe, dignity (f. sing., gen. with tanwīn, second term after ṣāḥib; verbal noun of hāba I); 'of dignity'
وَوَقَارٍ: وَ + وَقَار — wa-, and (conj.) + waqār, gravity, stately dignity (m. sing., gen., joined to hayba); 'and gravity'
وَعَبِيدٍ: وَ + عَبِيد — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿabīd, slaves (m. pl., broken plural of ʿabd, gen. with tanwīn, joined to the list after ṣāḥib); 'and slaves'
حَيَّاهُمُ: ḥayyā + humu — ḥayyā (II, defective), to greet (perfect, 3rd m. sing.; the verb is ḥayyā ‘to give life’, so ‘to greet’) + -humu, them (3rd m. pl. pronoun, acc.; the mīm takes ḍamma before al-ʿarīf); 'greeted them'
تَحِيَّةَ: taḥiyya — تَحِيَّةَ: greeting, salutation (f. sing., acc., absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq); first term of an iḍāfa with al-aḥbāb); 'the greeting of'
وَأَجْلَسَهُمْ: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlasa (IV), to seat (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -hum, them (acc.); 'and seated them'
بِقَضَائُهَا: بِـ + قَضَاء + هَا — bi-, in/by (prep.; fāza bi-, ‘to win, gain’, names the prize) + qaḍāʾ, fulfilment (verbal noun of qaḍā I; m. sing., gen.) + -hā, its (3rd f. sing. pronoun, the need); 'by fulfilling it' (the print points the hamza with a ḍamma, where the genitive wants a kasra)
الْغُلَامَانِ: al-ghulāmān — الْغُلَامَانِ: الـ + غُلَامَان — al-, the + ghulāmān, two lads, young men (dual m. nom. of ghulām, in apposition to hādhāni); 'the two lads'
بَلْدَةً: balda — بَلْدَةً: town (f. sing., acc., indefinite, object of dakhaltu); 'a town'
يَتَفَرَّجَا: yatafarrajā — يَتَفَرَّجَا: tafarraja (V), to look about at, enjoy the sights (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m., after ḥattā; the nūn dropped; takes ʿalā for the place); 'they (two) may see the sights'
وَيَعْرِفَا: وَ + يَعْرِفَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yaʿrifā, ʿarafa (I), to know, come to know (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m., after ḥattā); 'and come to know'
أَهْلَهَا: ahl + hā — ahl, people (m. sing., acc., object of yaʿrifā; first term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, its (3rd f. sing. pronoun, the town); 'its people'
وَاخْتَرْتُ: وَ + اِخْتَرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ikhtartu, ikhtāra (VIII, hollow), to choose (perfect, 1st sing.); 'and I chose'
جَيِّدَةً: jayyida — جَيِّدَةً: good (f. sing., adjective of jayyid, from jāda I; acc., predicate of takūnu, agreeing with the feminine dukkān); 'good'
الْمَوَاضِعِ: al-mawāḍiʿ — الْمَوَاضِعِ: الـ + مَوَاضِع — al-, the + mawāḍiʿ, places (m. pl., broken plural of mawḍiʿ; gen., second term after min aḥsani); 'the places'
أُجْلِسَهُمَا: ujlisa + humā — ujlisa, ajlasa (IV), to seat (imperfect subjunctive, 1st sing., after ḥattā) + -humā, them two (3rd dual pronoun, acc.); 'I may seat them two'
لِيَتَّجِرَا: لِـ + يَتَّجِرَا — li-, so that (particle of purpose, followed by the subjunctive) + yattajirā, ittajara (VIII), to trade (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m.; the nūn dropped); 'so that the two may trade'
وَيَتَفَرَّجَا: وَ + يَتَفَرَّجَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yatafarrajā, tafarraja (V), to look about at, see the sights (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m., continuing the purpose after li-; takes ʿalā for the place); 'and look about'
وَيَتَخَلَّقَا: وَ + يَتَخَلَّقَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yatakhallaqā, takhallaqa (V), to take on a character (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m.; takhallaqa bi- names the manners adopted, as in the next word); 'and take on'
بِأَخْلَاقِ: بِـ + أَخْلَاق — bi-, with (prep.; takhallaqa bi-, ‘to take on (manners)’, names the character adopted) + akhlāq, manners, character (m. pl., broken plural of khuluq; gen., first term of an iḍāfa with ahl); 'the manners of'
وَيَتَعَلَّمَا: وَ + يَتَعَلَّمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yataʿallamā, taʿallama (V), to learn (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd dual m.); 'and learn'
