وَالشِّرَاءَ: وَ + الـ + شِرَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + shirāʾ, buying (verbal noun of sharā I; m. sing., acc., object of yataʿallamā; the article’s lām assimilates in speech but al- is written); 'and buying'
وَالْأَخْذَ: وَ + الـ + أَخْذ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + akhdh, taking (verbal noun of akhadha I; m. sing., acc., joined to al-bayʿ); 'and taking'
وَالْعَطَاءَ: وَ + الـ + عَطَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ʿaṭāʾ, giving (verbal noun of aʿṭā IV; m. sing., acc., joined to al-bayʿ); 'and giving'
وَأَحَبَّهُمَا: وَ + أَحَبَّ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥabba (IV, geminate), to love (perfect, 3rd m. sing.) + -humā, them two (acc.); 'and loved them'
مُغْرَمًا: mughram — مُغْرَمًا: infatuated, passionately fond (passive participle of aghrama IV; m. sing., acc., predicate of kāna; takes bi- for the object of desire, as in the next word); 'infatuated'
وَيُغَلِّبُ: وَ + يُغَلِّبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yughallibu, ghallaba (II), to make prevail, prefer (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.; takes ʿalā for what is put below); 'and he prefers'
الْبَنِينَ: al-banīn — الْبَنِينَ: الـ + بَنِين — al-, the + banīn, sons, boys (m. pl., plural of ibn, gen. as the second term of the iḍāfa after ḥubb); 'boys'
وَيَمِيلُ: وَ + يَمِيلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yamīlu, māla (I, hollow), to incline (imperfect indicative, 3rd m. sing.; takes ilā for what attracts); 'and has a leaning'
الْحُمُوضَةِ: الـ + حُمُوضَة — al-, the + ḥumūḍa, sourness (f. sing., verbal noun of ḥamuḍa I, ‘to be sour’; gen. after ilā); 'sourness; here apparently slang for a taste for youths (sense uncertain)'
صَيْدَةٌ: ṣayda — صَيْدَةٌ: a catch, quarry, game (f. sing., nom., indefinite, predicate of hādhihi; noun of a single instance from ṣayd, ‘hunting’); 'a quarry'
خَالِقِهِمَا: khāliq + himā — khāliq, creator (active participle of khalaqa I; m. sing., gen., second term of the iḍāfa after subḥāna) + -himā, of them two (3rd dual pronoun); 'their Creator'
وَمُصَوِّرِهِمَا: وَ + مُصَوِّر + هِمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + muṣawwir, fashioner (active participle of ṣawwara II, ‘to fashion’; m. sing., gen., joined to khāliq) + -himā, of them two (3rd dual pronoun); 'and their Fashioner'
لِخِدْمَتِهِمَا: لِـ + خِدْمَة + هِمَا — li-, for (prep., of purpose: ‘in order to’) + khidma, service (f. sing., verbal noun of khadama I; gen.) + -himā, of them two (3rd dual pronoun, objective); 'to serve them'
كَالْغُلَامِ: كَـ + الـ + غُلَام — ka-, like (prep., of comparison; governs the genitive) + al-, the + ghulām, lad, page (m. sing., gen.); 'like a page'
أَوْجَهُ: awjah — أَوْجَهُ: more prominent, finer in appearance (elative of wajīh, from wajh, ‘face’; m. sing., nom., diptote, joined to akbaru as the name of yakun); 'finer, more prominent'
مُتَّسِعَةً: muttasiʿa — مُتَّسِعَةً: spacious (active participle of ittasaʿa VIII, ‘to be wide’; f. sing., acc., predicate of kānat); 'spacious'
مُزَخْرَفَةً: muzakhrafa — مُزَخْرَفَةً: decorated, adorned (passive participle of zakhrafa, quadriliteral I; f. sing., acc., predicate of kānat, joined to muttasiʿa); 'richly decorated'
رُفُوفٌ: rufūf — رُفُوفٌ: shelves (m. pl., broken plural of raff; nom., indefinite, the subject placed after fīhā, ‘in it’); 'shelves'
عَاجٍ: ʿāj — عَاجٍ: ivory (m. sing., gen. with tanwīn after min, ‘of’); 'of ivory'
وَخَشَبِ: وَ + خَشَب — wa-, and (conj.) + khashab, wood, timber (m. sing., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-ābanūs; joined to ʿājin after min); 'and of the wood of'
الْآبَنُوسِ: al-ābanūs — الْآبَنُوسِ: الـ + آبَنُوس — al-, the + ābanūs, ebony (m. sing., gen., second term of the iḍāfa; the print writes it with a madda); 'ebony'
الْمَفَاتِيحَ: al-mafātīḥ — الْمَفَاتِيحَ: الـ + مَفَاتِيح — al-, the + mafātīḥ, keys (m. pl., broken plural of miftāḥ; acc., object of sallama); 'the keys'
جَعَلَهَا: jaʿala + hā — jaʿala (I), to make (perfect, 3rd m. sing., used as a wish: ‘may He make’; takes two objects) + -hā, it (3rd f. sing. pronoun, acc.); 'may He make it'
مُبَارَكًا: mubārak — مُبَارَكًا: blessed (passive participle of bāraka III, ‘to bless’; m. sing., acc., qualifying manzilan); 'blessed'
وَلَدَيْكَ: walad + ay + ka — walad, son (m., dual with the nūn dropped before the suffix; gen. dual -ayn after ʿalā) + -ka, your (2nd m. sing. pronoun); 'your two sons' (the initial و is a root letter of walad, not wa-, ‘and’)
وَأَمَرُوا: وَ + أَمَرُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + amarū, amara (I), to order, command (perfect, 3rd m. pl.); 'and they ordered'
يَنْقُلُوا: yanqulū — يَنْقُلُوا: naqala (I), to carry, transport (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd m. pl., after an, ‘to’; the nūn dropped, the final alif silent); 'carry'
فَنَقَلُوا: فَـ + نَقَلُوا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + naqala, to carry across, transport (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'so they carried across'
أَخَذَهُمَا: أَخَذَ + هُمَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -humā, 'them (two)'; 'took the two of them'
فَاغْتَسَلُوا: فَـ + اغْتَسَلُوا — fa-, so, and (conj.) + ightasala, to wash oneself, bathe (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and they washed'
وَتَنَظَّفُوا: وَ + تَنَظَّفُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + tanaẓẓafa, to clean oneself (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'and cleaned themselves'
وَتَطَيَّبُوا: وَ + تَطَيَّبُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + taṭayyaba, to perfume oneself (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'and perfumed themselves'
حَظِّهِمْ: حَظّ + هِمْ — ḥaẓẓ, share, enjoyment, good fortune (m., gen., in idāfa after ghāyata) + -him, 'their'; 'their enjoyment'
الْغُلَامَيْنِ: الـ + غُلَامَيْنِ — al-, the + ghulām, young man, lad (m.), dual gen. -ayni (after min); 'the two young men'
حَدِّ: حَدّ — ḥadd, edge, limit (m., gen. after ʿalā); ʿalā ḥadd qawl, 'in accordance with the saying of'; here: gen. after mithla, mithla ḥaddi al-sināni, 'like the edge of the spearhead'
بُشْرَى: بُشْرَى — bushrā, glad tidings, joy (f., nom.); 'joy!' 'glad news to'
لِقَيِّمِهِ: لِـ + قَيِّم + هِ — li-, for, to (prep., 'joy to') + qayyim, attendant, overseer (m., here the bath-keeper) + -hi, 'its' (the bath's); 'to its attendant'
مَسَتْ: مَسَتْ — second half of lā masat, the print's split of lāmasat, to touch (verb III, perf. 3fs, agreeing with yad, hand); 'touched'
جِسْمًا: جِسْمًا — jism, body (m., acc., object of lāmasat); 'a body'
تَوَلَّدَ: تَوَلَّدَ — tawallada, to be born, be engendered (verb V, perf. 3ms, relative-clause description of jism); 'born'
يُظْهِرُ: يُظْهِرُ — aẓhara, to show, display (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'he showed'
لُطْفًا: لُطْفًا — luṭf, gentleness, kindness, delicacy (m., acc., object); 'gentleness'
صَنَاعَتِهِ: صَنَاعَة + هِ — ṣanāʿa (as pointed in the verse; also ṣināʿa), craft, trade (f., gen. after min) + -hi, 'his'; 'his craft'
الْمِسْكَ: الـ + مِسْك — al-, the + misk, musk (m., acc., object of janā); 'the musk'
تِمْثَالِ: تِمْثَال — timthāl, statue, image (m., gen. after min, in idāfa); 'a statue'
كَافُورِ: كَافُور — kāfūr, camphor (m., gen.); 'of camphor' (white, as the statue of a body)
بِدُخُولِهِمَا: بِـ + دُخُول + هِمَا — bi-, governed by samiʿa 'hear of' (samiʿa bi-, to hear about) + dukhūl, entering (m., verbal noun, gen.) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'of their entering'
انْتِظَارِهِمَا: انْتِظَار + هِمَا — intiẓār, waiting (m., verbal noun, VIII, gen. after fī) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'in waiting for them'
كَالْغَزَالَيْنِ: كَـ + الـ + غَزَالَيْنِ — ka-, like, as (prep., introducing a simile) + al-, the + ghazāl, gazelle (m.), dual gen. -ayni; 'like two gazelles'
وَلَمَعَتْ: وَ + لَمَعَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lamaʿa, to shine, gleam (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and shone'
وُجُوهُهُمَا: وُجُوه + هُمَا — wujūh, faces (pl. of wajh, m., nom.) + -humā, 'their (two)'; 'their faces'
زَاهِيَانِ: زَاهِيَانِ — zāhin, radiant, bright (active participle of zahā, dual nom. -āni, m.), describing qamarāni; 'radiant'
غُصْنَانِ: غُصْنَانِ — ghuṣn, branch (m.), dual nom. -āni, predicate after kaannahumā; 'two branches'
مُثْمِرَانِ: مُثْمِرَانِ — muthmir, fruit-bearing (active participle of IV athmara, dual nom. m.); 'bearing fruit'
حَمَّامُكُمْ: حَمَّام + كُمْ — ḥammām, bath, bathhouse (m., nom.) + -kum, 'your (pl.)'; 'your bath'
بِأَعْذَبِ: بِـ + أَعْذَب — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + aʿdhab, sweetest, most pleasant (elative of ʿadhb, gen.); 'with the sweetest'
وَاسْتَحْمَيْتَ: وَ + اسْتَحْمَيْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + istaḥamma, to take a bath (verb X, perf. 2ms, -ta 'you'); 'and bathe'
وَقَبَّلَاهَا: وَ + قَبَّلَا + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3md) + -hā, 'it' (the hand, f.); 'and kissed it'
حِشْمَةً: حِشْمَةً — ḥishma, modesty, deference (f., acc., adverbial of reason); 'out of deference'
وَتَعْظِيمًا: وَ + تَعْظِيمًا — wa-, and (conj.) + taʿẓīm, honouring, veneration (m., verbal noun II, acc.); 'and respect'
وَالسُّوقِ: وَ + الـ + سُّوق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + sūq, market (m., gen., in idāfa after kabīr); 'and of the market'
حَقِّهِمَا: حَقّ + هِمَا — ḥaqq, right, due (m., gen. after fī) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'in their regard'
بِإِعْطَائِهِمَا: بِـ + إِعْطَاء + هِمَا — bi-, by, through (prep., instrument) + iʿṭāʾ, giving (m., verbal noun IV, gen.) + -himā, 'to them (two)'; 'by giving them'
أَرْدَافَهُمَا: أَرْدَاف + هُمَا — ardāf, buttocks, hindquarters (pl. of ridf, m., acc.) + -humā, 'their (two)'; 'their buttocks'
ارْتِجَاجٍ: ارْتِجَاج — irtijāj, quivering, shaking (m., verbal noun VIII, gen. after fī); 'in a quiver'
وَشَخَرَ: وَ + شَخَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + shakhara, to snort, snore (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and snorted'
وَنَخَرَ: وَ + نَخَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + nakhara, to wheeze, snort (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and wheezed'
يُطِقِ: يُطِقِ — aṭāqa, to be able to bear (verb IV, jussive 3ms after lam, with kasra before the article); 'he could not bear'
فَأَحْدَقَ: فَـ + أَحْدَقَ — fa-, so, and (conj.) + aḥdaqa, to surround, fix (eyes) upon (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'so he fastened'
يُطَالِعُ: يُطَالِعُ — ṭālaʿa, to peruse, read through (verb III, imperf. 3ms); 'pores over'
الْاِخْتِصَاصِ: الـ + اِخْتِصَاص — al-, the + ikhtiṣāṣ, exclusive possession, ownership (m., verbal noun VIII, gen. in idāfa after bāb); 'of exclusive possession'
مَبْحَثُ: مَبْحَث — mabḥath, topic, section of study (m., nom., subject of yaqraʾu); 'a section'
الشِّرْكَهْ: الشِّرْكَهْ — al-, the + shirka, partnership, sharing (f., gen., pausal -ah for -a, verse end); 'of sharing'
كَوْنِهِ: كَوْن + هِ — kawn, being (m., verbal noun of kāna, gen. after fī) + -hi, 'its/his'; 'in its being'
يَرْتَجُّ: يَرْتَجُّ — irtajja, to quiver, shake (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms); 'it trembles'
ثِقَلٍ: ثِقَل — thiqal, weight, heaviness (m., gen. after min, 'from'); 'from weight'
لِذَا: لِـ + ذَا — li-, for, belonging to (prep.) + dhā, this (m., demonstrative, gen.); 'for this'
الْفَلَكِ: الـ + فَلَك — al-, the + falak, celestial sphere, orbit (m., gen.); 'sphere'
الدَّوَّارِ: الـ + دَّوَّار — al-, the + dawwār, revolving, turning (intensive form of dāra, m., gen.); 'turning'
حَرَكَهْ: حَرَكَهْ — ḥaraka, motion, movement (f., gen. after min, pausal -ah at verse end); 'of motion'
يَمْشِيَانِ: يَمْشِيَانِ — mashā, to walk (verb I, imperf. 3md, -āni; indicative); 'they two walk'
وَدَدْتُهُمَا: وَدَدْتُ + هُمَا — wadadtu (usual wadidtu), to wish, desire (verb I, perf. 1s) + -humā, 'them (two)'; 'I wished for them'
فَمَاصَدَّقَ: فَـ + مَا + صَدَّقَ — fa-, so, and (conj.) + mā ṣaddaqa run together, ṣaddaqa to believe (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he could hardly believe it'
وَدَخَلَا: وَ + دَخَلَا — wa-, and (conj.) + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3md); 'and the two went in'
وَتَلَقَّاهُ: وَ + تَلَقَّا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + talaqqā, to meet, receive (verb V, perf. 3ms) + -hu, 'him'; 'and met him'
خَلْوَةٍ: خَلْوَة — khalwa, private room, retreat (f., gen. after ilā, indefinite); 'a private room'
فَانْقَادَ: فَـ + انْقَادَ — fa-, so, and (conj.) + inqāda, to submit, be led (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'so he let himself be led'
الْخَبِيثُ: الـ + خَبِيث — al-, the + khabīth, wicked, vile (adj. m., nom.); 'the wicked'
هَيَمَانُهُ: هَيَمَان + هُ — hayamān, love-madness, ardent passion (m., nom.; usual hayamān/hīmān) + -hu, 'his'; 'his love-madness'
غَيْرُةُ: غَيْرُةُ — ghayr, other than, anyone but (m., nom.) + -hu, 'he/him' (written with ة for ـهُ); 'no one but he'
يَصُبَّ: يَصُبَّ — ṣabba, to pour (verb I, subjunctive 3ms, after an lā); 'he pour'
غَيْرُهُ: غَيْر + هُ — ghayr, other than (m., nom., subject) + -hu, 'he/him'; 'anyone but he'
أَوْلَادُكَ: أَوْلَاد + كَ — awlād, sons, children (pl. of walad, m., nom., predicate) + -ka, 'your (m.s.)'; 'your sons'
خَلِّهِمَا: خَلِّ + هِمَا — khalli, let, leave (verb II, imperative 2ms) + -himā, 'them (two)'; 'let them'
يَغْسِلَانِكَ: يَغْسِلَانِ + كَ — yaghsilāni, to wash (verb I, imperf. 3md) + -ka, 'you (m.s.)'; 'they wash you'
وَيُنَظِّفَانِكَ: وَ + يُنَظِّفَانِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + naẓẓafa, to clean (verb II, imperf. 3md) + -ka, 'you'; 'and clean you'
أَبْقَاهُمَا: أَبْقَا + هُمَا — abqā, to keep, preserve (verb IV, perf. 3ms, optative) + -humā, 'them (two)'; 'may (God) keep them'
وَالسَّعَادَةُ: وَ + الـ + سَّعَادَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + saʿāda, happiness, good fortune (f., nom.); 'and good fortune'
بِصُحْبَتِكُمْ: بِـ + صُحْبَة + كُمْ — bi-, with (prep.; here 'in company') + ṣuḥba, company, companionship (f., gen.) + -kum, 'your (pl.)'; '(whoever is) in your company'
اَقْبَلْتَ: أَقْبَلْتَ — aqbala, to come, approach (verb IV, perf. 2ms, -ta); 'you came'
فَاخْضَرَّتْ: فَـ + اخْضَرَّتْ — fa-, so, and (conj.) + ikhḍarra, to turn green (verb IX, perf. 3fs); 'and turned green'
الرُّبَى: الـ + رُّبَى — al-, the + rubā, hills, knolls (pl. of rabwa, f., nom.); 'the hills'
زَهَتْ: زَهَتْ — zahā, to bloom, shine (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'blossomed'
الْمُجْتَلِيْ: الـ + مُجْتَلِيْ — al-, the + mujtalī, displayed, shown (active participle VIII of ijtalā, here 'showing itself', gen.; verse -ī); 'on display'
وَنَادَتِ: وَ + نَادَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + nādat, to call, cry out (verb III, perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'and cried out'
مُقْبِلِ: مُقْبِل — muqbil, one approaching, newcomer (active participle IV, m., gen. after min); 'a newcomer'
فَشَكَرُوهُ: فَـ + شَكَرُوا + هُ — fa-, so (conj.) + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hu, 'him'; 'so they thanked him'
يَصُبُّ: يَصُبُّ — ṣabba, to pour (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative); 'pouring'
أَتَمَّا: أَتَمَّا — atamma, to complete, finish (verb IV, perf. 3md); 'they two finished'
خِدْمَتَهُ: خِدْمَة + هُ — khidma, service, attendance (f., acc.) + -hu, 'his'; 'attending to him'
جَنْبَ: جَنْب — janb, side (m., acc., adverbial, in idāfa); 'beside'
بِالْمَنَاشِفِ: بِـ + الـ + مَنَاشِف — bi-, with (prep.; verb atā bi-, 'bring') + al-, the + manāshif, towels (pl. of minshafa, m., gen.); 'with the towels'
فَتَنَقَّشُوا: فَـ + تَنَقَّشُوا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + tanaqqashū, as printed, probably a slip for tanashshafū (verb V, perf. 3mp, 'they dried themselves'); 'so they dried themselves'
وَأَلْبَسُوا: وَ + أَلْبَسُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + albasū, to clothe (verb IV causative, perf. 3mp), used for 'put on'; 'and put on'; also: 'to clothe, hang (walls) with', with two objects: albasū ḥīṭānahu khāṣṣa al-dībāji, 'they hung its walls with the choicest brocade' (Night 192)
حَوَائِجَهُمْ: حَوَائِج + هُمْ — ḥawāʾij, needs, belongings, clothes (pl. of ḥāja, f., acc.) + -hum, 'their'; 'their clothes'; also: 'their needs', object of qaḍā: fa-taqḍī lahum ḥawāʾijahum, 'and you see to their needs' (Night 192)
نَعِيمُ: نَعِيم — naʿīm, bliss, pleasure (m., nom., in idāfa); 'the pleasure (of)'
وَلِأَوْلَادِكَ: وَ + لِـ + أَوْلَاد + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, for, to (prep., 'to you and your sons') + awlād, sons (pl., gen.) + -ka, 'your'; 'and to your sons'
عَافِيَةً: عَافِيَةً — ʿāfiya, health, well-being (f., acc., second object of jaʿala); 'health'
وَكَفَاهُمَا: وَ + كَفَا + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + kafā, to ward off, suffice (verb I, perf. 3ms, optative) + -humā, 'them (two)'; 'and may He keep from them'
تَحْفَظُونَ: تَحْفَظُونَ — ḥafiẓa, to know by heart, memorise (verb I, imperf. 2mp); 'do you know by heart'
الْبُلَغَاءُ: الـ + بُلَغَاء — al-, the + bulaghāʾ, eloquent ones, masters of eloquence (pl. of balīgh, m., nom.); 'the eloquent'
أُنْشِدُ: أُنْشِدُ — anshada, to recite (verse) (verb IV, imperf. 1s); 'I will recite'
عَيْشَ: عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., acc. after inna, in idāfa); 'life (in)'
قَلِيْلُ: قَلِيْل — qalīl, little, short (adj. m., nom., predicate); 'short'
تُكْرَهُ: تُكْرَهُ — kariha, to dislike (verb I passive, imperf. 3fs); 'is disliked'
الْاِقَامَةُ: الـ + اِقَامَة — al-, the + iqāma, staying, residence (f., verbal noun IV, nom.); 'staying'
وَجَحِيْمٌ: وَ + جَحِيْم — wa-, and (conj.) + jaḥīm, hell, blazing fire (m., nom., indefinite); 'and a hell'
يَطِيْبُ: يَطِيْبُ — ṭāba, to be pleasant, be sweet (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'is pleasant'
الدُّخُولُ: الـ + دُّخُول — al-, the + dukhūl, entering (m., verbal noun, nom., subject); 'entering'
أَحْفَظُ: أَحْفَظُ — ḥafiẓa, to know by heart (verb I, imperf. 1s); 'I know by heart'; here: 'I keep, preserve' (aḥfaẓu al-wudd, 'I keep my love') Also the elative aḥfaẓu, 'better at keeping (a secret), more trustworthy': aḥfaẓu wa-aqrabu li-kitmāni al-sirri, 'more trustworthy and fitter to keep the secret'.
أَنْشِدْ: أَنْشِدْ — anshada, to recite (verb IV, imperative 2ms); 'recite'
إِيَّاهُمَا: إِيَّا + هُمَا — iyyā-, carrier of an object pronoun (object of anshada) + -humā, 'them (two)'; 'them (the two verses)'
وَبَيْتٍ: وَ + بَيْت — wa-, and, many a (wa-rubba-like, 'and (many) a house'; conj.) + bayt, house (m., gen., indefinite); 'many a house'
جَلْمَدِ: جَلْمَد — jalmad, boulder, hard stone (m., gen., in idāfa after min); 'of hard stone'
اَزْهَارُ: اَزْهَار — azhār, flowers (pl. of zahr, m., nom., subject of lahu); 'flowers'
اَنِيْقٍ: اَنِيْق — anīq, elegant, lovely (adj. m., gen., describing bayt); 'lovely'
اَضْرَمَتْ: اَضْرَمَتْ — aḍrama, to kindle (verb IV, perf. 3fs, subject al-nār); 'kindled'
جَحِيْمًا: جَحِيْمًا — jaḥīm, hell, blazing fire (m., acc., second object of tarāhu); 'a hell'
وَاَكْثَرُ: وَ + اَكْثَر — wa-, and (conj.) + akthar, most, the greater part of (elative, nom., in idāfa); 'and most'
مَافِيْهَا: مَا + فِيْهَا — mā, what, those who (rel.) + fī, in (prep.) + -hā, 'it' (the house) run together; 'what is in it'
شُمُوْسٌ: شُمُوْس — shumūs, suns (pl. of shams, f., nom., predicate); 'suns'
وَاَقْمَارُ: وَ + اَقْمَار — wa-, and (conj.) + aqmār, moons (pl. of qamar, m., nom.); 'and moons'
مَاقَالَهُ: مَا + قَالَ + هُ — mā, what (rel.) + qāla, to say (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, 'it' run together; 'what he had said'
صَبَاحَتِهِمَا: صَبَاحَة + هِمَا — ṣabāḥa, comeliness, beauty (f., gen. after fī) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'their beauty'
وَفَصَاحَتِهِمَا: وَ + فَصَاحَة + هِمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., gen.) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'and their eloquence'
حُزْتُمَا: حُزْتُمَا — ḥāza, to win, obtain (verb I, perf. 2md, -tumā 'you two'); 'you two have won'
الْفَصَاحَةَ: الـ + فَصَاحَة — al-, the + faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., acc., object); 'eloquence'
وَالْمَلَاحَةَ: وَ + الـ + مَلَاحَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + malāḥa, handsomeness, charm (f., acc.); 'and beauty'
فَاسْمَعَا: فَـ + اسْمَعَا — fa-, so, now (conj.) + samiʿa, to hear, listen (verb I, imperative 2md ismaʿā); 'so listen, you two'
أَطْرَبَ: أَطْرَبَ — aṭraba, to make merry, to sing in a stirring manner (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'he sang stirringly'
بِالنَّغَمَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + نَّغَمَات — bi-, with, in (prep., instrument/manner) + al-, the + naghamāt, melodies, notes (f. pl. of naghama); 'with the melodies'
وَالنَّعِيْمُ: وَ + الـ + نَّعِيْمُ — wa-, and (circumstantial/conj.) + al-, the + naʿīm, bliss, pleasure (m., nom.); 'and bliss'
عَذَابُهَا: عَذَاب + هَا — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., nom., predicate) + -hā, 'its/her' (the fire's); 'its torment'
تُحْيَى: تُحْيَى — uḥyiya, to bring to life (verb IV passive, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with al-arwāḥ); 'are given life'
الْاَرْوَاحُ: الـ + اَرْوَاح — al-, the + arwāḥ, souls, spirits (pl. of rūḥ, f., nom.); 'the souls'
وَالْاَبْدَانُ: وَ + الـ + اَبْدَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + abdān, bodies (pl. of badan, m., nom.); 'and the bodies'
فَاعْجَبْ: فَـ + اعْجَبْ — fa-, so (conj.) + iʿjab, marvel! (verb I, imperative 2ms of ʿajiba); 'so marvel'
لِبَيْتٍ: لِـ + بَيْت — li-, at, over (prep.; ʿajiba li-, 'marvel at') + bayt, house (m., gen., indefinite); 'at a house'
لَايَزَالُ: لَا + يَزَالُ — lā yazālu, run together: lā, not + zāla, to cease (verb I, imperf. 3ms); lā yazāl, 'does not cease', 'still, ever'
نَعِيْمُهُ: نَعِيْم + هُ — naʿīm, joy, bliss (m., nom.) + -hu, 'its'; 'its joys'
غَضًّا: غَضًّا — ghaḍḍ, fresh, tender (adj. m., acc., predicate of lā yazālu); 'fresh'
وَتُوْقَدُ: وَ + تُوْقَدُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tūqadu, to be kindled (verb IV passive, imperf. 3fs); 'and are kindled'
النِّيْرَانُ: الـ + نِّيْرَان — al-, the + nīrān, fires (pl. of nār, f., nom.); 'the fires'
السُّرُوْرِ: الـ + سُّرُوْر — al-, the + surūr, gladness, delight (m., gen., in idāfa after ʿaysh); 'of gladness'
اَلَمَّ: اَلَمَّ — alamma, to visit, call upon (verb IV, perf. 3ms; alamma bi-, to visit); 'called'
سَفَحَتْ: سَفَحَتْ — safaḥa, to shed, pour out (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject al-ghudrān); 'shed'
دُمُوْعُهَا: دُمُوْع + هَا — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, m., nom. as printed, where the object of safaḥat would be acc. dumūʿahā) + -hā, 'their' (the pools'); 'their tears'
الْغُدْرَانُ: الـ + غُدْرَان — al-, the + ghudrān, pools, ponds (pl. of ghadīr, m., nom.); 'the pools'
سَرَّحَ: سَرَّحَ — sarraḥa, to let loose, send roaming (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he let wander'
رِيَاضِ: رِيَاض — riyāḍ, gardens (pl. of rawḍa, f., gen. after fī, in idāfa); 'gardens (of)'
حُسْنِهِمَا: حُسْن + هِمَا — ḥusn, beauty (m., gen., in idāfa) + -himā, 'their (two)'; 'their beauty'
وَافِيْتُ: وَافَيْتُ — wāfā, to arrive at, come to (verb III, perf. 1s, -tu 'I'; printed with long-vowel ـِيْ in verse); 'I came to'
اَرَ: اَرَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, jussive 1s after lam, apocopated); 'I did not see'
وَيَلْقَانِي: وَ + يَلْقَا + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yalqā, to meet (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, 'me'; 'and who meets me'
ضَاحِكِ: ضَاحِك — ḍāḥik, laughing, smiling (active participle, m., gen., describing wajh); 'laughing'
جَنَّتَهُ: جَنَّة + هُ — janna, paradise, garden (f., acc., object) + -hu, 'his'; 'his paradise'
وَزُرْتُ: وَ + زُرْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + zāra, to visit (verb I, perf. 1s, -tu 'I'); 'and I visited'
جَحِيْمَهُ: جَحِيْم + هُ — jaḥīm, hell (m., acc., object) + -hu, 'his'; 'his hell'
فَشَكَرْتُ: فَـ + شَكَرْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + shakartu, to thank (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I thanked'
رِضْوَانًا: رِضْوَانًا — Riḍwān, the keeper of Paradise (proper name, acc., object, a diptote, given tanwīn here for the metre); 'Riḍwān'
وَرَأْفَةَ: وَ + رَأْفَة — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾfa, mercy, kindness (f., acc., in idāfa); 'and the mercy of'
مَالِكِ: مَالِك — Mālik, the keeper of Hell (proper name, gen., in idāfa after raʾfa); 'Mālik'
تَعَجَّبُوا: تَعَجَّبُوا — taʿajjaba, to marvel, be amazed (verb V, perf. 3mp; taʿajjaba min, 'at'); 'they marvelled'
فَامْتَنَعُوا: فَـ + امْتَنَعُوا — fa-, so, but (conj.) + imtanaʿū, to refuse, decline (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'but they declined'
فَاسْتَرَاحُوا: فَـ + اسْتَرَاحُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + istarāḥū, to rest, relax (verb X, perf. 3mp); 'so they rested'
أَتَمِّ: أَتَمّ — atamm, most complete, fullest (elative of tāmm, m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the fullest'
وَتَوَضَّؤا: وَ + تَوَضَّؤُا — wa-, and (conj.) + tawaḍḍaʾū, to perform ablution (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'and made their ablutions'
فَرْضَهُمْ: فَرْض + هُمْ — farḍ, obligatory prayer, duty (m., acc.) + -hum, 'their'; 'their prescribed prayer'
وَاصْطَبَحُوا: وَ + اصْطَبَحُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + iṣṭabaḥū, to take a morning drink (verb VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and took a morning drink'
وَفُتِحَتِ: وَ + فُتِحَتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + futiḥat, to be opened (verb I passive, perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'and were opened'
الدَّكَاكِينُ: الـ + دَّكَاكِين — al-, the + dakākīn, shops (pl. of dukkān, m., nom.); 'the shops'
وَالْأَسْوَاقُ: وَ + الـ + أَسْوَاق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + aswāq, markets (pl. of sūq, f., nom.); 'and the markets'
وَتَمَشَّوْا: وَ + تَمَشَّوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + tamashshaw, to stroll, walk about (verb V, perf. 3mp); 'and strolled'
هَيَّأُوهَا: هَيَّأُوا + هَا — hayyaʾū, to prepare, fit out (verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hā, 'it' (the shop, f.); 'they had fitted it out'
هَيْئَةٍ: هَيْئَة — hayʾa, form, manner, style (f., gen., in idāfa after aḥsana); 'style'
السَّجَاجِيدَ: الـ + سَّجَاجِيد — al-, the + sajājīd, prayer carpets, rugs (pl. of sajjāda, f., acc., object); 'the carpets'
وَالْبُسُطَ: وَ + الـ + بُسُط — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + busuṭ, rugs, carpets (pl. of bisāṭ, m., acc.); 'and the rugs'
الْحَرِيرَ: الـ + حَرِيرَ — al-, the + ḥarīr, silk (m., acc., apposition 'silk'); 'silk'
مَرْتَبَتَيْنِ: مَرْتَبَتَيْنِ — martaba, mattress, cushioned seat (f.), dual acc. -atayni (object); 'two cushioned seats'
نِطْعًا: نِطْعًا — niṭʿ, leather mat, leather cover (m., acc., object); 'a leather cover'
مُلُوكِيًّا: مُلُوكِيًّا — mulūkī, royal, kingly (relative adj. of mulūk, m., acc.); 'fit for kings'
دَائِرُهُ: دَائِر + هُ — dāʾir, surrounding (active participle of dāra, m., nom.) + -hu, 'its'; 'its edge all round'
شَرِيطٌ: شَرِيط — sharīṭ, braid, ribbon (m., nom., predicate); 'braid'
الْفَائِقُ: الـ + فَائِق — al-, the + fāʾiq, excellent, surpassing (active participle, m., adj. of al-farsh); 'the finest'
اللَّائِقُ: الـ + لَّائِق — al-, the + lāʾiq, fitting, suitable (active participle, m., adj.; followed by bi-); 'fitting'
بِالْمَقَامِ: بِـ + الـ + مَقَام — bi-, for, to (prep.; lāʾiq bi-, 'fit for') + al-, the + maqām, place, station (m., gen.); 'for the place'
وَتَسَامَعَتْ: وَ + تَسَامَعَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasāmaʿat, to hear of one another, to be rumoured (verb VI, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ahl); 'and word went round'
فَبَاعُوا: فَـ + بَاعُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + bāʿū, to sell (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'so they sold'
وَبَعْضَ: وَ + بَعْض — wa-, and (conj.) + baʿḍ, some, part of (m., acc., object); 'and some of'
أَقْمِشَتِهِمْ: أَقْمِشَة + هِمْ — aqmisha, cloths, fabrics (pl. of qumāsh, f., gen. in idāfa) + -him, 'their'; 'their cloth'
ذِكْرُ: ذِكْر — dhikr, mention, talk, renown (m., nom., subject of shāʿa); 'talk (of)'
وَحُسْنِهِ: وَ + حُسْن + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥusn, beauty, goodness (m., gen., in idāfa) + -hi, 'his'; 'and his good looks'
تَتَزَايَدُ: تَتَزَايَدُ — tazāyada, to increase, grow in number (verb VI, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with al-nās); 'increased'
وَتَهْرَعُ: وَ + تَهْرَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + hariʿa, to hurry, rush (verb I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with al-nās); 'and hurried'
بِكِتْمَانِ: بِـ + كِتْمَان — bi-, with, to (prep.; awṣā bi-, 'charge with, enjoin') + kitmān, concealing, keeping secret (m., gen., verbal noun); 'to keep' Also after ʿalayka, 'upon you be', bi- marks what is enjoined: ʿalayka bi-kitmāni al-sirri, 'see you keep the secret'.
لِيَخْتَلِيَ: لِـ + يَخْتَلِيَ — li-, in order to (particle with subjunctive, expressing purpose) + yakhtaliya, to be alone, retire (verb VIII, subjunctive 3ms); 'in order to be alone'
وَيُدَبِّرَ: وَ + يُدَبِّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yudabbira, to devise, plan (verb II, subjunctive 3ms, after li-); 'and devise'
يَتَحَادَثَانِ: يَتَحَادَثَانِ — taḥādatha, to converse together (verb VI, imperf. 3md); 'talking together'
قَلِقُ: قَلِق — qaliq, restless, uneasy (adj. m., nom., predicate, in idāfa with al-fuʾād); 'restless (of heart)'
حُرِمَ: حُرِمَ — ḥurima, to be deprived (verb I passive, perf. 3ms); 'he was robbed (of)'
التَّمَامِ: الـ + تَّمَام — al-, the + tamām, completeness, fullness (m., gen., after laylat); 'of completeness, fullness'; also after badr: badr al-tamām, 'the full moon'
بِامْرَأَةٍ: بِـ + امْرَأَة — bi-, marking what is perceived after wa-idhā 'and behold' (bi- of surprise, not translated) + imraʾa, woman (f., gen.); 'a woman'
وَخَلْفَهَا: وَ + خَلْفَ + هَا — khalf, behind (prep./adv., acc.); wa-, and (here circumstantial, 'with'); -hā, her (3 f. sg. pronoun, gen. after khalf); 'and behind her'
قَدَّهُ: قَدَّ + هُ — qadd, stature, height (m., acc., object of raʾat 'she saw'); -hu, his; 'his stature'; here: first object of jaʿala, 'who made his stature (like hers)'
وَاعْتِدَالَهُ: وَ + اعْتِدَال + هُ — iʿtidāl, evenness, fine proportion (m., verbal noun of VIII iʿtadala, acc.); wa-, and; -hu, his; 'and his fine proportion'
وَحُسْنَهُ: وَ + حُسْن + هُ — ḥusn, beauty, goodness (m., acc.); wa-, and; -hu, his; 'and his beauty'
وَجَمَالَهُ: وَ + جَمَال + هُ — jamāl, comeliness, grace (m., acc.); wa-, and; -hu, his; 'and his grace'
فَتَعَجَّبَتْ: فَ + تَعَجَّبَتْ — taʿajjaba, to marvel, be amazed (verb V, perf. 3 f. sg.); fa-, and so/then (sequence); -at, she; 'and she marvelled'
مَلَاحَتِهِ: مَلَاحَة + ـِهِ — malāḥa, handsomeness, charm (f., gen. after min, which precedes it: 'at/from'); -hi, his; 'at his handsomeness' (min malāḥatihi)
وَرَشَحَتْ: وَ + رَشَحَتْ — rashaḥa, to sweat, ooze, grow damp (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.); wa-, and; -at, she; 'and she grew damp'
سَرَاوِيلِهَا: سَرَاوِيل + هَا — sarāwīl, drawers, trousers (f./m. pl. form, gen. after fī, here diptote); -hā, her; 'in her drawers'
تَأَمَّلَتْ: تَأَمَّلَتْ — taʾammala, to look closely at, scrutinise (verb V, perf. 3 f. sg.); -at, she; 'she looked him over'
بَشَرًا: بَشَرًا — basharan, human being, mortal (m., acc. predicate after mā hādhā, Hijazi-style mā 'not'); 'a mortal'
إِلَّامَلَكٌ: إِلَّا + مَلَكٌ — illā, except, but (particle, with in 'not': in … illā 'none … but'); malak, angel (m., nom. predicate, tanwīn); Middle Arabic run-together spelling of illā malakun; 'none but an angel'
دَنَتْ: دَنَتْ — danā, to draw near, come close (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; final-weak); -at, she; 'she came close'
أَجْلَسَهَا: أَجْلَسَ + هَا — ajlasa, to seat (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg., causative of jalasa 'sit'); -hā, her (object); 'he seated her'
يُرَوِّحُ: يُرَوِّحُ — rawwaḥa, to fan, give air to (verb II, imperf. 3 m. sg.); after ṣāra 'he proceeded to', 'fanning'; takes ʿalā 'upon' (her) and bi- of the instrument
بِمِرْوَحَةٍ: بِ + مِرْوَحَة + ٍ — mirwaḥa, fan (f., gen. with tanwīn); bi-, with (instrument); 'with a fan'
وَاسْتَرَاحَتْ: وَ + اسْتَرَاحَتْ — istarāḥa, to rest, recover (verb X, perf. 3 f. sg.); wa-, and; -at, she; 'and she rested'
كَامِلَ: كَامِلَ — kāmil, perfect, complete (act. part. of I kamala, m. sg., acc. as vocative in iḍāfa with al-awṣāf); 'perfect (in) ...' as address after yā
وَالْمَعَانِي: وَ + الـ + مَعَانِي — maʿnā, meaning, quality, notion (m., pl. maʿānī, gen., coordinated with al-awṣāf); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the (inner) qualities'
أَكْرِمْ: أَكْرِمْ — akrim, honour, be generous (verb IV, imperative m. sg.), used in the exclamation form akrim bi- 'how noble is ...!'; 'what a noble ...'
قَادِمٍ: قَادِمٍ — qādim, one who arrives, newcomer (act. part. of I qadima, m., gen. with tanwīn after min); 'newcomer'
الرَّحْبِ: الرَّحْبِ — al-raḥb, roomy, spacious; al-raḥb wa-al-saʿa, 'welcome and room' (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'in spaciousness'
فَغَمَزَةُ: فَ + غَمَزَةُ — ghamaza, to wink at, nudge, signal (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.), fa-, and so; -hu, him (Middle Arabic orthography run together; read ghamazahu); 'so he winked at him'
تَشْتَهِينَ: تَشْتَهِينَ — ishtahā, to desire, want (verb VIII, imperf. 2 f. sg., final-weak); the -īna marks 'you' (f.); in kullamā tashtahīna 'whatever you wish'
وَبَنَاتِ: وَ + بَنَات — bint, girl, daughter (f., pl. banāt, gen. in iḍāfa after al-mulūk); wa-, and; 'and daughters (of kings)'
بِالشَّيْءِ: بِ + الـ + شَّيْء — shayʾ, thing (m., gen.); bi-, with/about (akhbara bi- 'to tell of, inform about'); al-, the; 'about the thing'
أُقَلِّبَ: أُقَلِّبَ — qallaba, to turn over, examine (verb II, subjunctive 1 sg. after ḥattā 'so that'); 'I may turn over'
لِأَرْبَابِهِ: لِ + أَرْبَاب + هِ — li-, for (to be fitted to); arbāb, owners, masters (pl. of rabb, gen.); -hi, its/his; 'for its owners' (i.e. for the person who suits it)
يَفْهَمَ: يَفْهَمَ — fahima, to understand (verb I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an 'to'); 'to understand'
بِالْبُقْجَةِ: بِ + الـ + بُقْجَة — buqja, bundle, wrapped parcel (f., Turkish loan, gen.); iʾti bi- 'bring' (āta bi- 'to bring'): bi- marks the thing brought; al-, the; 'the bundle'
وَحَلَّهَا: وَ + حَلَّ + هَا — ḥalla, to untie, undo (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; -hā, it (the bundle); 'and untied it'
انْتَخِبِي: انْتَخِبِي — intakhaba, to select, choose (verb VIII, imperative f. sg.); -ī, you (f.); 'choose'
مَايَصْلُحُ: مَا + يَصْلُحُ — mā, what (relative); yaṣluḥu, to be suitable (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg.); Middle Arabic run-together spelling of mā yaṣluḥu; 'what suits'
فَاخْتَارَتِ: فَ + اخْتَارَتِ — ikhtāra, to choose, pick (verb VIII, perf. 3 f. sg., hollow); fa-, and so; -at-, she (the kasra on t is before al-); 'and she chose'
بِكَمْ: بِ + كَمْ — bi-, for (price: 'at the price of'); kam, how much (interrogative); 'for how much / how much is it?'
وَتَحُكُّ: وَ + تَحُكُّ — ḥakka, to rub, scratch (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg., geminate); wa-, and; ta-, she; 'and (she) rubbing / kept rubbing'
بِكِلْوَةِ: بِ + كِلْوَة — kilwa, kidney, here 'heel of the hand' (f., gen.); bi-, with (instrument); 'with (the heel of) her hand' (Middle Arabic bi-kilwati yadihā)
أُسَاوِمُ: أُسَاوِمُ — sāwama, to haggle, bargain (verb III, imperf. 1 sg.); in the question 'would I haggle?'
الْحَقِيرِ: الْحَقِيرِ — al-ḥaqīr, despicable, paltry (adj., m. gen., qualifying al-thaman); 'the trifling (price)'
عَرَّفَنِي: عَرَّفَ + نِي — ʿarrafa, to make known, introduce (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.); -nī, me; 'brought me to know (you)' (here after biki 'you')
أُعَوِّذُ: أُعَوِّذُ — ʿawwadha, to commend to protection, put under God's shelter (verb II, imperf. 1 sg.); 'I commend (you)'
الْفَلَقِ: الْفَلَقِ — al-falaq, daybreak, dawn (m., gen. in iḍāfa after rabb); 'of the Daybreak' (cf. Qurʾān 113)
وَاللَّفْظُ: وَ + الـ + لَّفْظُ — lafẓ, utterance, speech, way of speaking (m., nom.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the speech'
فَصِيحٌ: فَصِيحٌ — faṣīḥ, eloquent, clear (adj., m. nom., predicate); 'eloquent'
وَتَضُمُّ: وَ + تَضُمُّ — ḍamma, to clasp, embrace (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg., geminate); wa-, and; 'and (she) embraces'
قَدَّكَ: قَدَّ + كَ — qadd, stature, slender figure (m., acc., object); -ka, your; 'your body'
قَاضِيَ: قَاضِيَ — qāḍī, one who fulfils (act. part. of I qaḍā, final-weak, vocative in iḍāfa with al-ḥājāt); 'O fulfiller of (needs)' (also 'judge')
الْفَاجِرَاتِ: الْفَاجِرَاتِ — al-fājirāt, wanton, shameless (act. part. of I fajara, f. pl., gen., qualifying al-ʿajāʾiz); 'the shameless (old women)'
قَاضِيَاتُ: قَاضِيَات + ُ — qāḍiya, one who fulfils (f. pl., nom., predicate; first term of iḍāfa with al-ḥājāt); 'they are those who fulfil (needs)'
مَااسْمُكَ: مَا + اسْمُ + كَ — mā, what (interrogative); ism, name (m., nom.); -ka, your; run-together spelling of mā ismuka; 'what is your name?'
الْعَجُوزُإِنَّ: الْعَجُوزُ + إِنَّ — al-ʿajūz, the old woman (nom.); inna, indeed (particle introducing the clause); Middle Arabic run-together of al-ʿajūzu inna; 'the old woman (said), indeed ...'
وَأَوْلَادِ: وَ + أَوْلَاد — walad, boy, son (m., pl. awlād, gen. in iḍāfa after (ismu) al-mulūk); wa-, and; 'and sons (of kings)' Also in awlād al-ḥarām, 'children of the forbidden', i.e. bastards, a term of abuse for rogues.
وَالِدَيْهِ: وَالِدَ + يْهِ — wālid, father (act. part. of I walada; dual wālidayn = parents; gen. dual -ayhi in iḍāfa after ʿinda); -hi, his; 'his parents'
وَمَعَزَّتِهِ: وَ + مَعَزَّة + ِهِ — maʿazza, dearness, esteem (f., verbal noun of I ʿazza, gen.); wa-, and; -hi, his; 'and his dearness (to them)'
كَفَاكُمُ: كَفَى + كُمُ — kafā, to suffice, to ward off (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., final-weak, here an invocation 'keep'); -kumu, you (m. pl.; Middle Arabic -kumu before a following vowel); 'may (God) keep you (from)'
وَشَرَّ: وَ + شَرَّ — sharr, evil, harm (m., acc., object of kafā); wa-, and; 'and (from) the evil of'
الْأَعَادِي: الْأَعَادِي — al-aʿādī, enemies (pl. of ʿadū / ʿaduww, m., gen. in iḍāfa); 'of enemies'
وَالْحُسَّادِ: وَ + الْ + حُسَّاد — ḥussād, envious ones (pl. of ḥāsid, m., gen.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the envious'
وَلَوْفَّتَتْ: وَ + لَوْ + فَتَّتَتْ — wa-, and; law, if, even if (concessive 'even though'); fattata, to crumble, break to pieces (verb II, perf. 3 f. sg.); run-together spelling of wa-law fattatat; 'and even if (it) broke'
بِمَحَاسِنِكُمُ: بِ + مَحَاسِن + كُمُ — maḥāsin, beauties, fine points (pl., gen.); bi-, by means of / through (cause); -kumu, your (m. pl.); 'by your beauties'
الْأَكْبَادُ: الْأَكْبَادُ — al-akbād, livers, hearts (pl. of kabid, f., nom.; the seat of feeling); 'the hearts'
بَاهِتَةٌ: بَاهِتَةٌ — bāhit, dazed, bewildered (act. part. of I bahita, f. sg., nom. predicate in the circumstantial clause); 'dazed'
بِقُمَاشٍ: بِ + قُمَاش + ٍ — qumāsh, cloth, fabric (m., gen. with tanwīn); bi-, marks the thing brought (jiʾtu laki bi- 'I have brought you ...'); 'a piece of cloth' (cloth)
فَقَلِّبِيهِ: فَ + قَلِّبِي + هِ — qallaba, to turn over (verb II, imperative f. sg.); fa-, so/then; -ī, you (f.); -hi, it (the cloth); 'so turn it over'
يَاعَيْنِي: يَا + عَيْنِي — yā, O (vocative particle); ʿayn, eye (f.) + -ī, my; term of endearment; run-together spelling of yā ʿaynī; 'my darling'
وَأَبْصِرِيهِ: وَ + أَبْصِرِي + هِ — abṣara, to see, look at (verb IV, imperative f. sg.); wa-, and; -ī, you (f.); -hi, it; 'and look at it'
بَهِتَتْ: بَهِتَتْ — bahita, to be astonished, dumbfounded (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; Middle Arabic spelling bahitat); -at, she; 'she was astonished'
يَادَادَتِي: يَا + دَادَتِي — yā, O; dāda, nanny, nurse (f., Turkish-Persian loan) + -tī/-ī, my; run-together spelling of yā dādatī; 'Nanny' (my nanny)
مَارَأَيْتُهُ: مَا + رَأَيْتُ + هُ — mā, not (negative); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1 sg. -tu); -hu, it (its like); run-together spelling of mā raʾaytuhu; 'I have not seen it'
بَائِعَهُ: بَائِع + هُ — bāʾiʿ, seller (act. part. of I bāʿa, m., acc. after inna); -hu, its; 'its seller'
وَسَهَا: وَ + سَهَا — sahā, to be inattentive, to look away, lapse (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., final-weak); wa-, and; 'and (he) looked away'
نُهُودِكِ: نُهُود + كِ — nuhūd, breasts (pl. of nahd, m., gen. after bayna); -ki, your (f.); 'your breasts'
مَدِينَتَكِ: مَدِينَة + كِ — madīna, city (f., acc., object of atā 'came to'); -ki, your (f.); 'your city'
بِأَقْمِشَةٍ: بِ + أَقْمِشَة + ٍ — aqmisha, fabrics, cloths (pl. of qumāsh, gen. with tanwīn); bi-, with / atā bi- 'to bring' (marks what was brought); 'with (precious) cloths'
مُثَمَّنَةٍ: مُثَمَّنَة + ٍ — muthamman, costly, valuable (pass. part. of II thamman; f. sg. (agreeing with broken pl. aqmisha), gen. tanwīn); 'precious'
أَخْزَاكِ: أَخْزَى + كِ — akhzā, to disgrace, put to shame (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg., final-weak, here an imprecation 'God shame ...'); -ki, you (f.); 'shame you!'
يَاعَجُوزَ: يَا + عَجُوزَ — yā, O; ʿajūz, old woman (f., vocative in iḍāfa with al-naḥs); run-together spelling of yā ʿajūza; 'O old woman'
خَرِفْتِ: خَرِفْتِ — kharifa, to be senile, dote (verb I, perf. 2 f. sg., -ti); 'you have gone soft in the head'
هَاتِى: هَاتِي — hāti, give, bring (imperative f. sg. of hāti; -ī, you f.), Middle Arabic final ى for ي; 'give (me)'
نَظَرًا: نَظَرًا — naẓar, looking, examination (m., verbal noun of I naẓara, acc. as absolute object, qualified by jayyidan); 'a look (properly)'
فَأَعْطَتْهَا: فَ + أَعْطَتْ + هَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3 f. sg., final-weak); fa-, and so; -hā, her (indirect object); (iyyāhu follows as the direct object); 'and she gave her'
فَنَظَرَتْهُ: فَ + نَظَرَتْ + هُ — naẓara, to look at (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.); fa-, and then; -hu, it (the cloth); 'and she looked at it'
وَثَمَنَهُ: وَ + ثَمَن + هُ — thaman, price (m., nom.; subject of a verbless clause); wa-, and; -hu, its; 'and its price'
فَأَعْجَبَهَا: فَ + أَعْجَبَ + هَا — aʿjaba, to please, delight (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.; subject the cloth); fa-, and so; -hā, her (object); 'and it pleased her'
مَارَأَتْ: مَا + رَأَتْ — mā, not (negative); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg. -at); run-together spelling of mā raʾat; 'she had never seen'
لَوْرَأَيْتِ: لَوْ + رَأَيْتِ — law, if (contrary-to-fact conditional); raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 2 f. sg. -ti); run-together spelling of law raʾayti; 'if you saw'
لَعَرَفْتِ: لَ + عَرَفْتِ — la-, (introduces the apodosis of law, 'then you would'); ʿarafa, to know (verb I, perf. 2 f. sg. -ti); run-together spelling of la-ʿarafti; 'you would know'
سَأَلْتِهِ: سَأَلْتِ + هِ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 2 f. sg. -ti); -hi, him (object); 'you asked him'
يُعْلِمُنَا: يُعْلِمُ + نَا — ʿalima / aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, imperf. 3 m. sg., jussive sense 'let him inform'); -nā, us; 'he should let us know'
فَنَقْضِيهَا: فَ + نَقْضِي + هَا — qaḍā, to fulfil, settle (verb I, imperf. 1 pl., final-weak); fa-, and then; na-, we; -hā, it (his need); 'and we will see to it'
هَزَّتْ: هَزَّتْ — hazza, to shake (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., geminate); -at, she; 'she shook'
فِرَاسَتَكِ: فِرَاسَة + كِ — firāsa, shrewdness, physiognomic insight (f., acc., object of ḥafiẓa); -ki, your (f.); 'your shrewdness'
لَاعَدِمْتُ: لَا + عَدِمْتُ — lā, not (in a wish formula); ʿadima, to lose, be deprived of (verb I, perf. 1 sg. -tu); run-together spelling of lā ʿadimtu; 'may I never lose / be without (your ...)'
مَعْرِفَتَكِ: مَعْرِفَة + كِ — maʿrifa, knowledge, acquaintance (f., acc., object of ʿadimtu); -ki, your (f.); 'your acquaintance'
وَيَخْلُو: وَ + يَخْلُو — khalā, to be free (of), be empty (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., final-weak, subject aḥad); wa-, and; with min 'free from'; 'and (be) free'
اذْهَبِي: اذْهَبِي — idhhabī, go (imperative f. sg. of dhahaba); -ī, you (f.); 'go'
وَسَلِّمِي: وَ + سَلِّمِي — sallima, to greet (verb II, imperative f. sg.); wa-, and; -ī, you (f.); taking ʿalayhi 'greet him'; 'and greet (him)'
شَرَّفْتَ: شَرَّفْتَ — sharrafa, to honour (verb II, perf. 2 m. sg. -ta); 'you have honoured'
بِقُدُومِكَ: بِ + قُدُوم + كَ — qudūm, arrival, coming (m., verbal noun of I qadima, gen.); bi-, by, through (cause/means); -ka, your; 'by your coming'
وَمَدِينَتَنَا: وَ + مَدِينَة + نَا — madīna, city (f., acc., object of sharrafta); wa-, and; -nā, our; 'and our city'
قَضَيْنَاهَا: قَضَيْنَا + هَا — qaḍā, to fulfil, settle (verb I, perf. 1 pl., final-weak); -nā, we; -hā, it (the need); 'we have fulfilled it / we will see to it'
سُرُورٌ: سُرُورٌ — surūr, gladness, joy (m., nom., subject (postposed) of dakhala); 'gladness'
قُضِيَتْ: قُضِيَتْ — quḍiyat, to be fulfilled, settled (verb I, perf. passive 3 f. sg., final-weak); subject ḥājatī 'my need'; 'has been fulfilled'
لَعَلَّكِ: لَعَلَّ + كِ — laʿalla, perhaps (particle governing the acc.); -ki, you (f.); 'perhaps you'
تَأْخُذِى: تَأْخُذِي — akhadha, to take (verb I, subjunctive 2 f. sg. after an, final -ī; the nūn is dropped); Middle Arabic final ى for ي; 'take'
وَتَأْتِينِي: وَ + تَأْتِينِي — ātā, to come, bring (verb I, imperf. 2 f. sg. taʾtīna + -nī, me); wa-, and; 'and bring me' (taʾtīnī bi-jawābihā: 'bring me her answer')
بِجَوَابِهَا: بِ + جَوَاب + هَا — jawāb, answer, reply (m., gen.); bi-, with: ātā bi- 'to bring' marks the thing brought; -hā, her; 'with her answer' Also with -hā for a thing (f.): jawābihā, 'its answer', the answer to the letter (waraqa).
الْأَدَوَاتِ: الْأَدَوَات — al-adawāt, tools, implements (pl. of adāh, f., gen., after bi-tilka 'with those'); 'the (writing) implements'
يَاسُؤْلِي: يَا + سُؤْلِي — yā, O; suʾl, desire, request, one asked for (m.) + -ī, my; run-together spelling of yā suʾlī; 'my heart's desire'
اَلْقَاهُ: أَلْقَا + هُ — alqā, to meet with, undergo (verb IV, imperf. 1 sg., final-weak; Middle Arabic spelling with alif); -hu, it (relative-clause object, 'what I ... from'); 'what I suffer'
فَاَوَّلُ: فَ + أَوَّلُ — fa-, and then (sequence in verse); awwal, first (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa with saṭr); 'and the first'
سَطْرِهِ: سَطْر + هِ — saṭr, line (m., gen. in iḍāfa); -hi, its (the letter's); 'of its (lines)'
وَثَانِيْهِ: وَ + ثَانِيْ + هِ — wa-, and; thānī, second (m., nom., final ي spelled with sukūn); -hi, its; 'and its second'
وَاشْتِيَاقِي: وَ + اشْتِيَاق + ِي — ishtiyāq, longing (m., verbal noun of VIII ishtāqa, nom. coordinated with gharāmī); wa-, and; -ī, my; 'and my longing'
وَثَالِثُهُ: وَ + ثَالِث + ُهُ — thālith, third (m., nom., subject); wa-, and; -hu, its; 'and its third'
وَصَبْرِي: وَ + صَبْرِي — ṣabr, patience (m., nom.); wa-, and; -ī, my; 'and my patience'
وَرَابِعُهُ: وَ + رَابِع + ُهُ — rābiʿ, fourth (m., nom., subject); wa-, and; -hu, its; 'and its fourth'
بَاقِي: بَاقِي — bāqī, remaining, surviving (act. part. of I baqiya, m. nom. predicate, final-weak); in verse 'lives on'
وَخَامِسُهُ: وَ + خَامِس + ُهُ — khāmis, fifth (m., nom., subject); wa-, and; -hu, its; 'and its fifth'
وَسَادِسُهُ: وَ + سَادِس + ُهُ — sādis, sixth (m., nom., subject); wa-, and; -hu, its; 'and its sixth'
التَّلَاقِيْ: التَّلَاقِيْ — al-talāqī, meeting, encounter (m., verbal noun of VI talāqā, gen. in iḍāfa after yawm; final ي spelled with sukūn for the rhyme); 'the meeting'; here nom., subject of yakūnu: matā yakūnu al-talāqī, 'when will the meeting be'
إِمْضَائِهِ: إِمْضَاء + ِهِ — imḍāʾ, signing, concluding (m., verbal noun of IV amḍā, gen. after fī); -hi, its; 'at its signing' (where he signed it)
أَسِيرِ: أَسِيرِ — asīr, captive, prisoner (m., gen. in iḍāfa after min); 'of the captive' (the letter is from the captive)
الْمَسْجُونِ: الْمَسْجُونِ — al-masjūn, imprisoned (pass. part. of I sajana, m. gen., in apposition to asīr); 'the imprisoned'
سِجْنِ: سِجْنِ — sijn, prison, jail (m., gen. in iḍāfa after fī); 'in the prison of'
الِاشْتِيَاقِ: الِاشْتِيَاقِ — al-ishtiyāq, longing, yearning (m., verbal noun of VIII ishtāqa, gen.); the article's alif is written with kasra (Middle Arabic/pausal vocalisation of al-); 'of longing'
إِطْلَاقٌ: إِطْلَاقٌ — iṭlāq, release, setting free (m., verbal noun of IV aṭlaqa, nom., tanwīn; subject of laysa lahu); 'release'
وَالتَّلَاقِ: وَ + الـ + تَّلَاقِ — talāq, meeting (m., verbal noun of VI talāqā, gen., final -ī dropped in the rhyme-style pausal form); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the meeting'
وَالْفِرَاقِ: و + الـ + فِرَاق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + firāq, separation, parting (m. verbal noun of III fāraqa, gen. after wa- continuing the prepositional chain with al-); 'and the parting'
يُقَاسِى: yuqāsī — qāsā, to suffer, endure (verb III, final-weak, impf. 3ms, ى for ي in the Middle Arabic spelling); takes min of the cause; 'he suffers'
أَلِيمَ: أَلِيم — alīm, painful, grievous (adj., m., acc.; here with the following noun in an iḍāfa-like phrase, object of yuqāsī); 'painful'
أَفَاضَ: أَفَاضَ — afāḍa, to pour forth, let overflow (verb IV, perf. 3ms, hollow); 'he poured forth (the tear)'
وَالْعَبَرَاتُ: و + الـ + عَبَرَات — wa-, and, introducing a circumstantial clause 'while' + al-, the + ʿabarāt, tears (f. sound pl. of ʿabra, nom., subject of tajrī); 'and the tears (are running)'
وَدَمْعُ: و + دَمْع — wa-, and (circumstantial) + damʿ, tear, weeping (m., nom. in an iḍāfa with al-ʿayn); 'and the tear (of the eye)'
انْقِطَاعُ: inqiṭāʿ — ceasing, stopping (VII verbal noun of qaṭaʿa, m., nom., subject of laysa lahu); 'a ceasing'; written without the article, indefinite
بَآيِسٍ: بِـ + آيِس — bi-, redundant particle in the predicate after laysa (lastu bi-āyisin), only strengthening the negation + āyis, despairing (act. part. I of ya'isa, m., gen.); 'I am not despairing'
اِجْتِمَاعُ: ijtimāʿ — coming together, meeting (VIII verbal noun of jamaʿa, m., nom., subject of yakūnu, with bihi 'in it'); 'a coming-together'
أَوْصِلِيهِ: أَوْصِلِي + هُ — awṣil-, to deliver, convey (verb IV, imperative 2fs, with the -ī ending for the old woman) + -hu, it (the letter); 'deliver it'
اقْبَلِي: iqbalī — qabila, to accept, receive (verb I, imperative 2fs, addressed to the old woman); 'accept!'
رَأَتْهَا: raʾat-hā — رَأَتْ + هَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs, final-weak: ى + t) + -hā, her (3fs object, the lady Dunyā); 'she saw her' (the subject is the old woman)
دَادَتِي: yā dādatī — يَا + دَادَة + ـِي — yā, O (vocative) + dāda, nurse, nanny (f., Turkish-Persian loan) + -ī, my; 'O my nurse'
إِيشْ: īsh — what? (interrogative, m.; colloquial contraction of ayyu shayʾin 'which thing'), Middle Arabic for mā; 'what (did he ask)'
نَقْضِيَهَا: naqḍiya-hā — نَقْضِيَ + هَا — naqḍiya, to fulfil (verb I, final-weak, subjunctive 1pl after ḥattā, 'so that we') + -hā, them (the needs, f. pl. takes f. sg. suffix); 'so that we fulfil them'
وَقَرَأَتْهُ: وَ + قَرَأَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + qaraʾa, to read (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (the letter); 'and she read it'
وَفَهِمَتْ: وَ + فَهِمَ + تْ — wa-, and + fahima, to understand (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she understood'
يُرَاسِلَنِي: yurāsila-nī — يُرَاسِلَ + نِي — rāsala, to correspond with, send messages to (verb III, subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā) + -nī, me (object); 'that (he) should send me messages'
وَيُكَاتِبَنِي: wa-yukātiba-nī — وَ + يُكَاتِبَ + نِي — wa-, and + kātaba, to write to, correspond with (verb III, subjunctive 3ms, continuing the ḥattā clause) + -nī, me; 'and write to me'
لَطَمَتْ: laṭamat — laṭama, to slap, strike (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she slapped (her face)'
اتَّصَلْنَا: ittaṣalnā — ittaṣala, to be connected, get in touch (verb VIII, perf. 1pl, initial-weak waṣala assimilated: ittaṣala for iwtaṣala); 'we became connected'
وَصَلَبْتُهُ: وَ + صَلَبْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + ṣalaba, to crucify (verb I, perf. 1cs; in a lawlā apodosis, la-qataltuhu wa-ṣalabtuhu, the perfect has conditional sense 'I would') + -hu, him; 'and crucified him'
وَإِيشْ: وَ + إِيشْ — wa-, and + īsh, what (colloquial for ayyu shayʾin); 'and what (is in this letter)'
أَزْعَجَ: azʿaja — to disturb, alarm, upset (verb IV, perf. 3ms); the subject is the letter; 'it disturbed (your heart)'
وَغَيَّرَ: وَ + غَيَّرَ — wa-, and + ghayyara, to change, alter (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and changed (your mind)'
خَاطِرَكِ: خَاطِر + كِ — khāṭir, mind, thought, feelings (m., acc., object of ghayyara) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your mind'
شِكَايَةُ: shikāyat — complaint, grievance (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with maẓlimatin; verbal noun of III shakā); 'a complaint (of a wrong)'
مَظْلِمَةٍ: maẓlimat — wrong, injustice (f., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa; noun of place/instance from ẓalama); 'of a wrong'
أَوْفِيهِ: أَ + وْ + فِي + هِ — aw, or (conj.) + fī, in (prep.) + -hi, it (the letter); 'or in it' (the opening hamza is alif and the aw run together in the print)
طَلَبُ: ṭalab — demand, request (verbal noun I of ṭalaba, m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with thamani al-qumāsh); 'a demand (for the price)'
عِشْقٍ: ʿishq — passion, ardent love (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of an iḍāfa after kalāmu); 'of passion'
وَمَحَبَّةٍ: و + مَحَبَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + maḥabba, love, affection (f., gen. with tanwīn, coordinated with ʿishqin); 'and love'
قَصْرِكِ: قَصْر + كِ — qaṣr, palace, castle (m., gen. after fī) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your palace'
الْعَالِي: الـ + عَالِي — al-, the + ʿālī, high, lofty (act. part. I of ʿalā, adj., m., gen., defective); 'the high'; the adjective is definite after the possessive noun, agreeing with qaṣr
الطَّائِرُ: الـ + طَائِر — al-, the + ṭāʾir, flying, bird (act. part. I of ṭāra, m., nom.; ṭāʾir al-ṭayr 'the flying bird', adjective of al-ṭayr); 'the flying (bird)'
وَسَلَامَةُ: و + سَلَامَة — wa-, and (conj.) + salāma, safety, soundness (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with shabābiki; wish construction, 'may you be safe'); 'and the safety (of your youth)'; here also with ʿaqlika: wa-salāmatu ʿaqlika al-rajīḥi, 'and (God keep) your weighty mind sound'
اللَّوْمِ: الـ + لَوْم — al-, the + lawm, blame (m. verbal noun, gen. after min); 'the blame'
وَالْعِتَابِ: و + الـ + عِتَاب — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿitāb, reproach, rebuke (m. verbal noun of III ʿātaba, gen. after min); 'and the reproach'
نَبِيحِ: nabīḥ — barking (m. verbal noun of nabaḥa, gen. with min, first term of an iḍāfa with al-kilāb 'of the dogs'); 'the barking (of the dogs)'
سَيِّدَةٌ: sayyida — lady, mistress (f. of sayyid, nom. with tanwīn, predicate of anti, in apposition to bintu sayyidin); 'a lady'; the Middle Arabic form ends with ـةٌ for the tanwīn
تُوْاخِذِينِى: تُ + وْ + آخِذِينِي — tu-, you (2fs) + ākhadha, to blame, call to account (verb III, impf. 2fs jussive after lā, nūn dropped; the print spells the hamza with wāw, تُوْ) + -nī, me (the print writes ى for ي); 'do not blame me'
تَرُدِّي: taruddī — radda, to return, give back (verb I geminate, subjunctive 2fs after an, 'that you'); with ilayhi jawāban 'give him back an answer'; 'that you return'
وَتُهَدِّدِيهِ: وَ + تُهَدِّدِي + هِ — wa-, and + tuhaddidī, to threaten (verb II, subjunctive 2fs continuing after an) + -hi, him; 'and (that you) threaten him'
الْهَذَيَانِ: الـ + هَذَيَان — al-, the + hadhayān, raving, delirium, nonsense (m. verbal noun of hadhā, gen. after ʿan); 'the raving'
يَنْتَهِي: yantahī — intahā, to desist, cease (verb VIII, final-weak, impf. 3ms, indicative); 'he will desist'
أُكَاتِبَهُ: ukātiba-hu — أُكَاتِبَ + هُ — kātaba, to write to, correspond with (verb III, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'that I') + -hu, him; 'that I write to him'
فَيَطْمَعَ: فَ + يَطْمَعَ — fa-, and so (causal fa- with subjunctive: 'lest, and then') + yaṭmaʿa, to covet, desire, hope for (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after fa-); with fī 'in me'; 'and he covet (me)'
التَّهْدِيدَ: الـ + تَّهْدِيد — al-, the + tahdīd, threatening, intimidation (m. verbal noun of II haddada, acc., object of samiʿa); 'the threatening' (the article's lām assimilated in the print before ت)
وَالْوَعِيدَ: وَ + الـ + وَعِيد — wa-, and + al-, the + waʿīd, menace, threat (m., acc., coordinated); 'and the menace'
يَامُدَّعِي: يَا + مُدَّعِي — yā, O (vocative) + muddaʿī, claimer, pretender (act. part. VIII of daʿā, m., acc. as first term of an iḍāfa); 'O claimer (of love)'; yā is written run together with the noun
وَالْبَلْوَى: وَ + الـ + بَلْوَى — wa-, and + al-, the + balwā, affliction, trial, misfortune (f., gen., final ى, second term in the pair al-ḥubb wa-al-balwā); 'and the affliction'
يُلَاقِيهِ: yulāqī-hi — يُلَاقِي + هِ — lāqā, to meet, encounter, suffer (verb III, final-weak, impf. 3ms, here in a relative clause) + -hi, it (the ardour); 'meets it, endures'
وَجْدٍ: wajd — ardour, passion, grief (m., gen. with tanwīn after min); 'of ardour'
فِكَرِ: fikar — thoughts, anxieties (f. pl. of fikra, gen., written fikari for a plural with a rhyme vowel); 'of thoughts'
اَتَطْلُبُ: أَ + تَطْلُبُ — a-, interrogative (introducing a question, 'do you?') + taṭlubu, to seek, ask for (verb I, impf. 2ms); 'do you seek'; the hamza is written as ا in the print
يَامَغْرُورُ: يَا + مَغْرُور — yā, O (vocative) + maghrūr, deluded, deceived (pass. part. I of gharra, m., nom.; the vowel ُ in vocative); 'O deluded one'
طَالِبُهُ: ṭālibu-hu — طَالِب + هُ — ṭālib, seeker (act. part. I of ṭalaba, m., nom.; 'you are seeking it') + -hu, it (relative clause object); 'seeking it'
فَاقْصُرْ: فَ + اقْصُرْ — fa-, so, then + uqṣur, to refrain, stop (verb I, imperative 2ms of qaṣara); the alif elides after fa-; 'so desist'
خَطَرِ: khaṭar — danger, peril (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'in danger'
اَتَاكَ: أَتَى + كَ — atā, to come to (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., final-weak) + -ka, you; 'there has come to you'; the print marks the opening alif with a fatḥa and no hamza
الضَّرَرِ: الـ + ضَّرَر — al-, the + ḍarar, harm, injury (m., gen. in an iḍāfa with zāʾidu); 'the harm'; 'exceeding in harm' Also gen. after min, 'of harm': shayʾun mina al-ḍarari, 'any harm'.
الْاِنْسَانَ: الـ + إِنْسَان — al-, the + insān, human being, man (m., acc., object of khalaqa); 'man'; written with a plain alif without hamza
عَلَقٍ: ʿalaq — clot (of blood), embryo (m. collective, gen. after min; cf. Qurʾān 96:2); 'from a clot'
اَنَارَ: anāra — to illuminate, light up (verb IV, perf. 3ms, hollow, written with alif for the hamza); 'who lit'
ضِيَاوَ: ḍiyāʾ — light, radiance (m., acc., object; written ضياو in the verse with wāw for hamza, Middle Arabic); 'the light'
ذَاكِرُهُ: dhākiru-hu — ذَاكِر + هُ — dhākir, mentioning, one who mentions (act. part. I of dhakara, m., nom.) + -hu, it; 'you are mentioning it'
لَاُصْلِبَنَّكَ: la-uṣlibanna-ka — لَ + أُصْلِبَنَّ + كَ — la-, emphatic particle (oath answer, 'surely') + uṣlibanna, to crucify (verb IV, energetic, impf. 1cs) + -ka, you; 'I will surely crucify you'; the hamza written as ا
جِذْعٍ: jidhʿ — trunk (of a tree), palm trunk (m., gen. with tanwīn after fī); 'on a trunk'
طَوَتِ: ṭawat — ṭawā, to fold (verb I, final-weak, perf. 3fs) + ـِ liaison vowel before the article; 'she folded'
كُفَّ: kuffa — kaffa, to refrain, hold back, cease (verb I geminate, imperative 2ms, with fatḥa, 'hold back'); takes ʿan; 'refrain (from this speech)'
بَيْتِهَا: بَيْت + هَا — bayt, house (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her house'
وَأَقْعَدَهَا: وَ + أَقْعَدَ + هَا — wa-, and + aqʿada, to seat, make sit (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and seated her'
اقْرَأْ: iqraʾ — qaraʾa, to read (verb I, imperative 2ms); 'read!'
كِتَابَكَ: كِتَاب + كَ — kitāb, letter (m., acc., object of qaraʾat) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your letter'
وَلَكِنَّنِي: وَ + لَكِنَّ + نِي — wa-, and + lākinna, but (particle, takes acc.) + -nī, me (suffix, subject of the clause); 'but I'; written run together as one word in the print
لَاطَفْتُهَا: lāṭaftu-hā — لَاطَفْتُ + هَا — lāṭafa, to treat gently, coax (verb III, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I coaxed her'
وَمَازَحْتُهَا: وَ + مَازَحْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + māzaḥa, to joke with, banter (verb III, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and joked with her'
أَضْحَكْتُهَا: aḍḥaktu-hā — أَضْحَكْتُ + هَا — aḍḥaka, to make laugh (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I made her laugh'
وَرَقَّتْ: وَ + رَقَّتْ — wa-, and + raqqa, to soften, become tender (verb I geminate, perf. 3fs, 'and she softened'); with laka 'to you'; 'and she softened'
وَرَدَّتْ: وَ + رَدَّتْ — wa-, and + radda, to return, give back (verb I geminate, perf. 3fs); with laka al-jawāba, 'returned to you the answer'; 'and she returned'
يُعْطِيَهَا: yuʿṭiya-hā — يُعْطِيَ + هَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, final-weak, subjunctive 3ms after an, 'that he') + -hā, her (indirect object); 'that he give her'
وَفَهِمَهُ: وَ + فَهِمَ + هُ — wa-, and + fahima, to understand (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the letter); 'and understood it'
وَشَكْوَاهُ: وَ + شَكْوَى + هُ — wa-, and + shakwā, complaint, plaint (f., nom., subject with ʿaẓuma) + -hu, his; 'and his complaint'
تُهَدِّدُنِي: tuhaddidu-nī — تُهَدِّدُ + نِي — haddada, to threaten (verb II, impf. 3fs, indicative) + -nī, me; with bi- of the threat; 'she threatens me (with)'
وَالصَّلْبِ: و + الـ + صَّلْب — wa-, and + al-, the + ṣalb, crucifixion (m. verbal noun of ṣalaba, gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and the crucifying'
وَتَنْهَانِي: وَ + تَنْهَى + نِي — wa-, and + tanhā, to forbid (verb I, final-weak, impf. 3fs, ى for ي in print) + -nī, me; with ʿan of the thing; 'and forbids me'
مُرَاسَلَتِهَا: murāsalat-i-hā — مُرَاسَلَة + هَا — murāsala, correspondence, exchange of messages (f. verbal noun of III rāsala, gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her; 'corresponding with her'
أُرَاسِلْهَا: urāsil-hā — أُرَاسِلْ + هَا — rāsala, to correspond with (verb III, jussive 1cs after lam, 'I do not') + -hā, her; 'I do not correspond with her'
جَوَابَ: jawāb — answer, reply (m., acc., object of khudhī, first term of an iḍāfa with kitābihā); 'the answer'; the print omits the article
كِتَابِهَا: kitāb-i-hā — كِتَاب + هَا — kitāb, letter (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hā, her; 'her letter'
وَدَعِيهَا: وَ + دَعِي + هَا — wa-, and + daʿī, to leave, let (verb I, imperative 2fs of wadaʿa/daʿa, with the sense 'let her do') + -hā, her; 'and leave her'; the old woman is addressed
وَحَيٰوةِ: وَ + حَيَاة — wa-, and, here wāw of oath, 'by' + ḥayāt, life (f., gen. after the oath-wāw; written with a dagger alif) + shabābika; 'by the life of (your youth)'
بُدَّأَنِّي: budd + annī — بُدّ + أَنَّ + نِي — budd, escape, avoidance (m., after lā, 'no escape') + anna, that (particle) + -nī, me (suffix); 'there is no escape that I'; run together in the print
أُخَاطِرُ: ukhāṭiru — khāṭara, to risk, hazard (verb III, impf. 1cs, indicative); with bi-rūḥī 'with my soul'; 'I risk'
وَأُبَلِّغُكَ: وَ + أُبَلِّغُ + كَ — wa-, and + uballighu, to make reach, convey (verb II, impf. 1cs, indicative) + -ka, you; 'and I make you reach'
أُجَازِيكِ: ujāzī-ki — أُجَازِي + كِ — jāzā, to repay, reward (verb III, final-weak, impf. 1cs) + -ki, you (2fs); with ʿalayhi 'for it'; 'I will reward you'
وَتَلْتَقِيهِ: وَ + تَلْتَقِي + هِ — wa-, and + taltaqī, to meet, find (verb VIII, final-weak, impf. 2fs, of laqiya) + -hi, it (the reward); 'and you will meet it'
مِيزَانِكِ: mīzān-i-ki — مِيزَان + كِ — mīzān, balance, scale (m., gen. after fī) + -ki, your; 'your balance'
فَإِنَّكِ: فَ + إِنَّ + كِ — fa-, for, because + inna, indeed (particle, takes acc.) + -ki, you (2fs); 'for you'
خَبِيرَةٌ: khabīra — khabīra, expert, knowledgeable (f. of khabīr, nom. with tanwīn, predicate of inna); 'an expert'
بِالسِّيَاسَةِ: بِـ + الـ + سِّيَاسَة — bi-, in, with (prep.: 'expert in') + al-, the + siyāsa, management, policy, cunning (f., gen.); 'in the management'
وَعَارِفَةٌ: وَ + عَارِفَة — wa-, and + ʿārifa, knowing, familiar (f. act. part. I of ʿarafa, nom., second predicate); 'and knowing'
بِأَبْوَابِ: بِـ + أَبْوَاب — bi-, in, with (prep., ʿārifa bi-, 'knowing of') + abwāb, doors, ways (m. broken pl. of bāb, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the doors'
الدَّنَاسَةِ: الـ + دَّنَاسَة — al-, the + danāsa, filthiness, baseness (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the filth' (trickery)
عَسِيرٍ: ʿasīr — hard, difficult (adj., m., gen. with tanwīn, after kullu; kullu ʿasīrin 'every hard thing'); 'every hard (thing)'
يَسِيرٌ: yasīr — easy (adj., m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate of kullu); 'easy'
اَلَسْتَ: أَ + لَسْتَ — a-, interrogative particle, 'are you not' + lasta, you are not (laysa, perf. 2ms, with -ta); 'are you not (threatening me)'; the hamza is written as ا
وَاعَجَبِي: وَا + عَجَب + ي — wā, O! (particle of lament or amazement) + ʿajab, wonder (m.) + -ī, my; 'O my wonder!', 'how strange!' (the print has واعربي, a misprint corrected here)
وَالْقَتْلُ: وَ + الـ + قَتْل — wa-, and (here 'when', introducing a circumstance) + al-, the + qatl, killing (m., verbal noun, nom., subject); 'when killing (is)'
رَاحَةٌ: rāḥa — rest, ease, repose (f., nom. with tanwīn, predicate of al-qatlu); 'a rest'; here: subject of taḥṣulu: lā taḥṣulu rāḥatun illā baʿda taʿabin, 'no rest comes except after toil'
وَالْمَوْتُ: وَ + الـ + مَوْت — wa-, and + al-, the + mawt, death (m., nom., subject); 'and the death'
مَقْدُورُ: maqdūr — decreed, destined (pass. part. I of qadara, m., nom., predicate); 'decreed'; written with a final ُ for rhyme in the verse
لِصَبٍّ: لِـ + صَبّ — li-, for (prep., 'more wholesome for') + ṣabb, lover, one smitten (m., gen. with tanwīn); 'for a lover'
تَطُولَ: taṭūla — ṭāla, to be long, last long (verb I hollow, subjunctive 3fs after an, 'that'); the subject is ḥayātuhu; 'that (it) be long'
حَيوتُهُ: حَيٰوة + هُ — ḥayāt, life (f., nom., subject of taṭūla), spelled with wāw (حيوة), the old Qurʾānic spelling + -hu, his; 'his life'
مَمْنُوعٌ: mamnūʿ — forbidden, prevented (pass. part. I of manaʿa, m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate of huwa); 'forbidden' Also predicate of a noun subject: manāmuhu ʿanhu mamnūʿun, 'his sleep is barred from him' (Night 191).
وَمَقْهُورُ: وَ + مَقْهُور — wa-, and + maqhūr, overpowered, subdued (pass. part. I of qahara, m., nom., predicate); 'and overpowered'; ending ُ is the rhyme vowel
زُورُوا: zūrū — zāra, to visit (verb I hollow, imperative 2mp, addressed to 'my masters'); 'visit (a lover)' Also addressed to the beloved, in the plural of discretion usual in love poetry (Night 191).
فَاِنَّنِي: فَ + إِنَّ + نِي — fa-, for, because + inna, indeed (particle) + -nī, me (suffix, subject); 'for I'
عَبْدُكُمْ: ʿabd-u-kum — عَبْد + كُمْ — ʿabd, slave, servant (m., nom., predicate of inna) + -kum, your (2mp); 'your slave'
مَاسُورُ: مَاسُور — māsūr, captive, prisoner (pass. part. I of asara, m., nom., predicate; written with alif for hamza, Middle Arabic); 'captive'
يَاسَادَتِي: يَا + سَادَة + ـِي — yā, O (vocative) + sāda, masters (m. broken pl. of sayyid, acc., vocative) + -ī, my; 'O my masters'
فَارْحَمُونِي: فَ + ارْحَمُو + نِي — fa-, so (consequence of the plea) + irḥamū, to have mercy on (verb I, imperative 2mp) + -nī, me; 'so have mercy on me'
يَعْشَقُ: yaʿshaqu — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (verb I, impf. 3ms, indicative; relative with man, 'whoever loves'); 'loves'
الْاَحْرَارَ: الـ + أَحْرَار — al-, the + aḥrār, the free-born, the noble (m. pl. of ḥurr, acc., object of yaʿshaqu); 'the free-born'; the print marks the alif with a fatḥa and no hamza
مَعْذُورُ: maʿdhūr — excused, pardoned (pass. part. I of ʿadhara, m., nom., predicate of kullu); 'excused'; final -u is the rhyme vowel
الصُّعَدَاءَ: الـ + صُّعَدَاء — al-, the + ṣuʿadāʾ, deep sigh (m., acc., cognate object of tanaffasa, 'he sighed the sigh'); 'the deep sigh'
أُبَلِّغَكَ: uballigha-ka — أُبَلِّغَ + كَ — ballagha, to make reach, convey (verb II, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'that I') + -ka, you; 'that I make you reach'
وَتَنْهَيْهِ: وَ + تَنْهَيْ + هِ — wa-, and + tanhay, you forbid (nahā, yanhā, verb I, final-weak, subj. 2 f. sg. after an, with the -na dropped) + -hi, him; 'and (that you) forbid him'
وَتَرَكَتْهُ: وَ + تَرَكَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + tarakat, she left (taraka, yatruku, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; the old woman) + -hu, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, the prince, left waiting); 'and she left him'
مُتَغَيِّرَةَ: مُتَغَيِّرَةَ — mutaghayyirata, changed, altered (active participle of tataghayyara, verb V, f. sg., acc. as ḥāl, 'in a state of', governing al-lawn in an idāfa); 'changed (of colour)'
بِمَكْتُوبِ: بِـ + مَكْتُوبِ — bi-, at, because of (prep.; gives the cause of her rage, not chosen by the verb) + maktūbi, letter (m., 'written thing'; gen. after bi-, first term of an idāfa with Tāj al-Mulūk); 'at the letter'
فَنَاوَلَتْهَا: فَـ + نَاوَلَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + nāwalat, she handed (nāwala, yunāwilu, verb III, perf. 3 f. sg.; the old woman) + -hā, her (Dunyā, the king's daughter; first object, the letter being the second); 'and she handed her'
يَطْمَعُ: يَطْمَعُ — yaṭmaʿu, he covets (ṭamiʿa, yaṭmaʿu, verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk; takes fī, 'to set one's hopes on', here with fīnā, us); 'he covets'
اذْهَبِى: اذْهَبِي — idhhabī, go! (dhahaba, yadhhabu, verb I, imperative 2 f. sg., said by Dunyā to the old woman; the print spells the ending with a final ى, اذهبى, read -ī); 'go'
رَاسَلْتَهَا: رَاسَلْتَ + هَا — rāsalta, you corresponded with (rāsala, yurāsilu, verb III, perf. 2 m. sg., after in, 'if'; past tense for the future; Tāj al-Mulūk is addressed in the message) + -hā, her (Dunyā); 'you correspond with her'
عُنُقَكَ: عُنُقَ + كَ — ʿunuqa, neck (ʿunuq, m./f., acc., object of ḍaraba; ḍaraba ʿunuqa, 'to strike the neck', is to behead) + -ka, your (m. sg., the one addressed); 'your neck'
اكْتُبِي: اُكْتُبِي — uktubī, write! (kataba, yaktubu, verb I, imperative 2 f. sg.; the old woman to Dunyā); 'write'
الْمَكْتُوبَ: الْـ + مَكْتُوبَ — al-, the + maktūba, letter (maktūb, 'written thing', m., acc. as object of ākhudhu, 'I take'); 'the letter'
يَزْدَادَ: يَزْدَادَ — yazdāda, he increases (izdāda, yazdādu, verb VIII, from zāda, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; the subject is khawfuhu, his fear; li-ajli an, 'so that'); 'that (his fear) increase'
خَوْفُةُ: خَوْفُ + هُ — khawfu, fear (khawf, m., nom. subject of yazdāda) + -hu, his (Tāj al-Mulūk's); the print writes the pronoun with a final tāʾ marbūṭa (خوفة), a habit of this edition, read -hu; 'his fear'
غَافِلاً: غَافِلًا — ghāfilan, heedless, unmindful (active participle of ghafala, yaghfulu, verb I, m. sg.; acc. after the vocative ayā, as an indefinite vocative linked to what follows, ʿan, 'of'; the addressee is Tāj al-Mulūk); 'O heedless one'
حَادِثَاتِ: حَادِثَاتِ — ḥādithāti, happenings, events (ḥādithāt, sound f. pl. of ḥāditha, 'occurrence'; gen., after ʿan, 'of', and first term of an idāfa with al-ṭawāriq); 'the happenings of'
الطَّوَارِقِ: الـ + طَّوَارِقِ — al-, the + ṭawāriqi, night-comers, nocturnal visitors (ṭāriq, f. pl. ṭawāriq, broken plural; here misfortunes that strike by night; gen., second term of the idāfa); 'the night-comers (misfortunes)'
اِلى: اِلَى — ilā, to, towards (prep.; the print spells it with a final ى, اِلى; ilā nayli, 'to the attaining'; read ilā); 'to'
نَيْلِ: نَيْلِ — nayli, attaining, obtaining (nayl, m., verbal noun of nāla, yanālu, verb I; gen. after ilā, first term of an idāfa with al-wiṣāl); 'the attaining of'
بِسَابِقِ: بِـ + سَابِقِ — bi-, bi- (prep.; after the negative laysa it only strengthens the predicate, no meaning of its own) + sābiqi, forerunner, one who gets ahead (active participle of sabaqa, yasbiqu, verb I, m. sg.; gen. after the pleonastic bi-); '(not) a forerunner'
اَتَزْعُمُ: اَ + تَزْعُمُ — a-, interrogative particle, 'do (you)?' + tazʿumu, you claim, you think (zaʿama, yazʿumu, verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg., indicative; takes an + subjunctive, 'that'; Dunyā addresses Tāj al-Mulūk); 'do you claim'
مَغْرُورُ: مَغْرُورُ — maghrūru, deluded one (maghrūr, passive participle of gharra, yaghurru, verb I, m., 'deceived, conceited'; nom. without tanwīn, the regular vocative after yā when one particular person is addressed); 'O deluded one'
تُدْرِكَ: تُدْرِكَ — tudrika, you reach, overtake (adraka, yudriku, verb IV, subjunctive 2 m. sg. after an, 'that'; object al-Suhā, the faint star, the type of the unreachable); 'that you reach'
لِلْبَدْرِ: لِـ + الْـ + بَدْرِ — li-, to, towards (prep.; with lāḥiqi, 'catching up to', the participle taking li- for what is caught up with) + al-, the + badri, full moon (badr, m., gen. after li-; the easy mark he cannot reach either); 'to the full moon'
بِلَاحِقِ: بِـ + لَاحِقِ — bi-, bi- (prep.; after the negative mā anta it only strengthens the predicate) + lāḥiqi, one who catches up, catcher-up (active participle of laḥiqa, yalḥaqu, verb I, m. sg., gen. after the pleonastic bi-); '(not) a catcher-up'
تُؤَمِّلُنَا: تُؤَمِّلُ + نَا — tuʾammilu, you hope in, you pin hopes on (ammala, yuʾammilu, verb II, imperf. 2 m. sg., indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk) + -nā, us (Dunyā, the plural of dignity, speaking of herself); 'you set your hopes on us'
وَتَرْجُو: وَ + تَرْجُو — wa-, and + tarjū, you hope for (rajā, yarjū, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 2 m. sg., indicative; takes its object directly); 'and you hope for'
وِصَالَنَا: وِصَالَ + نَا — wiṣāla, union, joining, love's meeting (wiṣāl, m., verbal noun of wāṣala/waṣala; acc., object of tarjū) + -nā, our (Dunyā, plural of dignity); 'our union'
لِتَحْظَى: لِـ + تَحْظَى — li-, so that, in order that (particle + subjunctive, giving purpose) + taḥẓā, you win, obtain (ḥaẓiya, yaḥẓā, verb I, final-weak, subjunctive 2 m. sg.; takes bi- for what is won); 'so that you win'
بِضَمٍّ: بِـ + ضَمٍّ — bi-, with, of (prep.; ḥaẓiya bi-, 'to win', the verb chooses the preposition) + ḍammin, embrace, clasping (ḍamm, m., verbal noun of ḍamma, yaḍummu, verb I; gen. after bi-, indefinite, tanwīn); 'an embrace'
لِلْقُدُودِ: لِـ + الْـ + قُدُودِ — li-, of (prep.; the objective genitive, the embrace 'of') + al-, the + qudūdi, statures, figures (qadd, pl. qudūd, broken plural; gen. after li-); 'of the statures'
الرَّوَاشِقِ: الـ + رَّوَاشِقِ — al-, the + rawāshiqi, slender, graceful (rāshiqa, pl. rawāshiq, f. adjective agreeing with al-qudūd; gen.); 'the slender (ones)'
الْقَصْدَ: الْـ + قَصْدَ — al-, the + qaṣda, aim, purpose, intention (qaṣd, m., verbal noun of qaṣada, yaqṣidu; acc. as object of daʿ, 'leave'); 'this aim'
سَطْوَتِي: سَطْوَتِ + ي — saṭwati, assault, might, wrath (saṭwa, f., verbal noun of saṭā, yasṭū, 'to assault'; gen., second term of idāfa after khīfata, 'for fear of') + -ī, my (Dunyā); 'my assault'
عَبُوسٍ: عَبُوسٍ — ʿabūsin, frowning, grim (ʿabūs, adjective of intensity, m., gen. indefinite, qualifying yawm; a Qurʾānic phrase, yawm ʿabūs, 76:10); 'frowning'
شَيْبُ: شَيْبُ — shaybu, greying, white hair (shayb, m., verbal noun of shāba, yashību; nom., subject of the clause fīhi shaybu, 'in it the greying'); 'the greying of'
الْمَفَارِقِ: الْـ + مَفَارِقِ — al-, the + mafāriqi, partings of the hair (mafriq, pl. mafāriq, broken plural; gen., second term of idāfa; where greyness first shows); 'the partings'
أَعْدَمَنِى: أَعْدَمَ + نِي — aʿdama, deprived (aʿdama, yuʿdimu, verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.; the subject is Allāh; lā + perfect expresses a wish, 'may He not deprive') + -nī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker; the print spells it with a final ى, اعدمنى, read -nī); 'may (God) not deprive me'
بَرَكَةَ: بَرَكَةَ — baraka, blessing (baraka, f., acc. as second object of aʿdama; first term of idāfa with qudūmiki); 'the blessing of'
قُدُومِكِ: قُدُومِ + كِ — qudūmi, coming, arrival (qudūm, m., verbal noun of qadima, yaqdamu; gen., second term of idāfa) + -ki, your (f. sg., the old woman); 'your coming'
مَكْتُوبِكَ: مَكْتُوبِ + كَ — maktūbi, letter (maktūb, m., 'written thing'; gen., first term of idāfa) + -ka, your (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk); 'your letter'
أَسْتَرِيحَ: أَسْتَرِيحَ — astarīḥa, I rest, find relief (istarāḥa, yastarīḥu, verb X, hollow, subjunctive 1 cs after ḥattā, 'so that'; Tāj al-Mulūk speaking); 'that I rest'
وَرَقَمَ: وَ + رَقَمَ — wa-, and + raqama, he inscribed, wrote out (raqama, yarqumu, verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., the prince; 'a more elegant word than kataba'; takes fīhi, 'in it'); 'and he inscribed'
تَبْتَغِي: تَبْتَغِي — tabtaghī, you seek (ibtaghā, yabtaghī, verb VIII, final-weak, jussive 2 f. sg. after lā, prohibition, with the -na dropped; the beloved is addressed as a woman); '(do not) seek'
وَالْجَفَا: وَ + الْـ + جَفَا — wa-, and + al-, the + jafā, harshness, cruelty (jafāʾ, m., verbal noun of jafā, yajfū; acc., coordinated with al-hajr as object of tabtaghī, spelled without hamza, the pausal rhyme form); 'and the harshness'
وَزُورِي: وَ + زُورِي — wa-, and + zūrī, visit! (zāra, yazūru, verb I, hollow, imperative 2 f. sg., the beloved is addressed); 'and visit'
غَارِقُ: غَارِقُ — ghāriqu, drowning (active participle of gharaqa, yaghraqu, verb I, m. sg.; printed nominative for the rhyme where muḥibban would lead one to expect ghāriqan; read it as 'who is drowning'); 'drowning'
تَحْسَبِينِي: تَحْسَبِي + نِي — taḥsabī, you reckon, think (ḥasiba, yaḥsabu, verb I, jussive 2 f. sg. after lā, prohibition, with the -na dropped) + -nī, me (the lover); 'and (do not) reckon me'
طَالِقُ: طَالِقُ — ṭāliqu, divorced (ṭāliq, active participle of ṭalaqa, yaṭluqu, verb I, f. sg. used without the feminine mark; the word for a repudiated wife; nom., predicate of rūḥī, 'my spirit'); 'divorced'
وَأَعْطَاةُ: وَ + أَعْطَا + هُ — wa-, and + aʿṭā, he gave (aʿṭā, yuʿṭī, verb IV, final-weak, perf. 3 m. sg.; takes li- for the one given to, Middle Arabic) + -hu, it (the letter); the print writes the pronoun with a final tāʾ marbūṭa (اعطاة), read -hu; 'and he gave it'
تُوَأخِذِينِى: تُوَاخِذِينِي — tuwākhidhīnī, (do not) hold it against me (wākhadha, spoken form of Classical ākhadha, yuʾākhidhu, verb III; jussive 2 f. sg. tuwākhidhī after lā of prohibition, the -na dropped as usual) + -nī, me; Classical lā tuʾākhidhīnī; the print spells it with wāw (توأخذينى); a set phrase of apology, 'do not hold it against me'
أَتْعَبْتُكِ: أَتْعَبْتُ + كِ — atʿabtu, I wearied (atʿaba, yutʿibu, verb IV, perf. 1 cs; Tāj al-Mulūk) + -ki, you (f. sg., the old woman); 'I have wearied you'
بِدُونِ: بِـ + دُونِ — bi-, with (prep.) + dūni, short of, lacking (dūn, gen. after bi-, first term of idāfa with fāʾida); bi-dūni together means 'without': 'without profit'
يَدْفَعَ: يَدْفَعَ — yadfaʿa, he pays (dafaʿa, yadfaʿu, verb I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; ʿAzīz is ordered to pay; takes li- for the payee, lahā); 'that he pay'
يَعْقُبَهَا: يَعْقُبَ + هَا — yaʿquba, he (it) follows, succeeds (ʿaqaba, yaʿqubu, verb I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; the subject is kamālu, completeness) + -hā, it (al-waraqa, the paper, f.); 'that there follow it'
الِاتِّصَالِ: الـ + اِتِّصَالِ — al-, the + ittiṣāli, joining, union (ittiṣāl, m., verbal noun of ittaṣala, verb VIII; gen., second term of idāfa after kamālu, 'completeness of'; rhymes with al-infiṣāl); 'the joining'
الِانْفِصَالِ: الـ + اِنْفِصَالِ — al-, the + infiṣāli, parting, separation (infiṣāl, m., verbal noun of infaṣala, verb VII; gen., second term of idāfa after kamālu); 'the parting'
الْأَنْوَارِ: الْـ + أَنْوَارِ — al-, the + anwāri, lights (nūr, pl. anwār, broken plural; gen., second term of idāfa after ṣāḥibu, 'owner of'); 'the lights'
السَّاطِعَةِ: الـ + سَّاطِعَةِ — al-, the + sāṭiʿati, radiant, shining (active participle of saṭaʿa, yasṭaʿu, verb I, f. sg., gen., adjective of al-anwār, plural of things agreeing as f. sg.; rhymes with al-ṭāliʿa); 'the radiant'
الطَّالِعَةُ: الـ + طَّالِعَةُ — al-, the + ṭāliʿatu, rising (active participle of ṭalaʿa, yaṭluʿu, verb I, f. sg., nom., adjective of al-shams, the sun); 'the rising (sun)'
أَجْمَعْ: أَجْمَعْ — ajmaʿ, I bring together (jamaʿa, yajmaʿu, verb I, jussive 1 cs after lam, 'if I do not'; the old woman speaking; baynakumā, between you two, Tāj al-Mulūk and Dunyā); 'I (do not) bring together'
وَالْخِدَاعِ: وَ + الْـ + خِدَاعِ — wa-, and + al-, the + khidāʿi, deceit, trickery (khidāʿ, m., verbal noun of khadaʿa, yakhdaʿu; gen. after fī, 'in', coordinated with al-makr; rhymes with al-aʿwām); 'and the deceit'
الْأَعْوَامِ: الْـ + أَعْوَامِ — al-, the + aʿwāmi, years (ʿām, pl. aʿwām, broken plural; gen. after min, 'of', partitive/specifying al-tisʿīn, 'the ninety of the years'); 'the years'
أَعْجِزُ: أَعْجِزُ — aʿjizu, I am incapable, fail (ʿajaza, yaʿjizu, verb I, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; the old woman; takes ʿan, 'to be unable to do'); 'am I incapable'
وَطَيَّبَتْ: وَ + طَيَّبَتْ — wa-, and + ṭayyabat, she made good, cheered (ṭayyaba, yuṭayyibu, verb II, perf. 3 f. sg.; the old woman; ṭayyaba qalbahu, 'to make someone's heart good', to comfort him); 'and she cheered'
أَخْفَتِ: أَخْفَتِ — akhfati, she hid (akhfā, yukhfī, verb IV, final-weak, perf. 3 f. sg., the old woman; the final -t takes a kasra before the article al-); 'she had hidden'
عَسَاكِ: عَسَاكِ — ʿasā-ki, perhaps, would that (ʿasā, defective verb of hope, 'it may be that') + -ki, you (f. sg., Dunyā; a polite request, with an taflī, 'that you delouse'); 'perhaps you (would)'
تَفْلِي: تَفْلِي — taflī, you delouse, pick lice from (falā, yaflī, verb I, final-weak, subjunctive 2 f. sg. after an, 'that'; taflīna loses its -na in the subjunctive); 'that you pick the lice from'
شُوشَتِي: شُوشَ + تِ + ي — shūsha, tuft of hair, topknot (colloquial word, f.; shūshat, with -t- of the construct state, acc. as object of taflī) + -ī, my (the old woman); 'my hair-tuft'
مَادَخَلْتُ: مَا + دَخَلْتُ — mā, not (negative particle, run together with the verb in the print) + dakhaltu, I entered (dakhala, yadkhulu, verb I, perf. 1 cs, the old woman speaking; the print runs mā dakhaltu together, مادخلت); 'I have not entered'
فَكَشَفَتِ: فَـ + كَشَفَتِ — fa-, and so (sequence) + kashafat, she uncovered (kashafa, yakshifu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., Dunyā; ʿan mirfaqayhā, 'from her elbows': she pushed back her sleeves; the -t is vowelled with kasra before the article al-); 'and so she uncovered'
مِرْفَقَيْهَا: مِرْفَقَ + يْ + هَا — mirfaqay, two elbows (mirfaq, m., dual, gen. after ʿan, here -ay for the oblique dual, ending dropped before the possessive) + -hā, her (Dunyā); 'her two elbows'
شَعْرَ: شَعْرَ — shaʿra, hair (shaʿr, m., acc. as object of ḥallat, 'she untied'; first term of idāfa with al-ʿajūz, 'the hair of the old woman'); 'the hair of'
شُوشَهَا: شُوشَ + هَا — shūsha, tuft of hair, topknot (colloquial word, acc., object of taflī) + -hā, her (the old woman's); printed without the -t- of shūshatī just before, so it may be a slip for shūshatahā or another form of the word, kept as printed; 'her hair-tuft'
