فَسَقَطَتِ: فَـ + سَقَطَتِ — fa-, and so, then (sequence) + saqaṭat, she/it fell (saqaṭa, yasquṭu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; the subject is al-waraqa, the paper; the -t takes a kasra before the article al-); 'and (the paper) fell'
تِيهَا: تِي + هَا — tī, give! (feminine imperative of hāti, 'give!'; the hā that the print sets as a separate word, ها, is the first syllable of hāti) + -hā, it (the paper); with the preceding ها the old woman says hātīhā, 'give it here'
أُوَدِّيهَا: أُوَدِّي + هَا — uwaddī, I take, convey (waddā, yuwaddī, verb II, final-weak, subjunctive 1 cs after ḥattā, 'so that'; the old woman speaking; colloquial for 'convey'; could also be read uʾaddīhā, 'I deliver it', with hamza unwritten) + -hā, it (the paper); 'that I take it'
حِسَابٌ: حِسَابٌ — ḥisābun, account, reckoning, calculation (ḥisāb, m., verbal noun of ḥasaba, yaḥsibu; nom. indefinite, subject of yakūnu fīhā, 'there is in it'); 'an account'
فَفَتَحَتْهَا: فَـ + فَتَحَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (sequence) + fataḥat, she opened (fataḥa, yaftaḥu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; Dunyā) + -hā, it (the paper, al-waraqa, f.); 'and she opened it'
وَقَرَأَتْهَا: وَ + قَرَأَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + qaraʾat, she read (qaraʾa, yaqraʾu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., Dunyā) + -hā, it (the paper, f.); 'and she read it'
حِيَلِكِ: حِيَلِ + كِ — ḥiyali, tricks, ruses (ḥīla, pl. ḥiyal, broken plural; gen. after min baʿḍi, 'of some of', second term of idāfa) + -ki, your (f. sg., the old woman); 'your tricks'
رَبَّيْتِنِي: رَبَّيْتِ + نِي — rabbayti, you raised, brought up (rabbā, yurabbī, verb II, final-weak, perf. 2 f. sg.; the old woman was Dunyā's nurse) + -nī, me (Dunyā); 'you brought me up'
لَبَطَشْتُ: لَـ + بَطَشْتُ — la-, then, would (particle marking the consequence of lawlā, 'were it not that') + baṭashtu, I would strike at (baṭasha, yabṭishu, verb I, perf. 1 cs; Dunyā speaking; takes bi-, baṭasha bi-, 'to seize violently', here bi-ki, you); 'I would have struck at'
بَلَانِي: بَلَا + نِي — balā, he afflicted, tried (balā, yablū, verb I, final-weak, perf. 3 m. sg.; the subject is Allāh; takes bi-, 'to afflict with', here bi-hādhā al-tājiri, this merchant) + -nī, me (Dunyā); 'afflicted me'
رَأْسِكِ: رَأْسِ + كِ — raʾsi, head (raʾs, m., gen. after taḥti, 'under') + -ki, your (f. sg., the old woman); min taḥti raʾsiki, 'from under your head': your doing; 'your head'
يَتَجَاسَرَ: يَتَجَاسَرَ — yatajāsara, he dares, makes bold (tajāsara, yatajāsaru, verb VI, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; takes ʿalā, 'to presume upon', here ʿalayya, me); 'that he dare'
يَنْكَشِفَ: يَنْكَشِفَ — yankashifa, it is uncovered, comes out (inkashafa, yankashifu, verb VII, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; the subject is amrī, my affair, the passive-sense of VII); 'that (my affair) be uncovered'; here: the subject is amruhumā, 'their affair'
جِنْسِي: جِنْسِ + ي — jinsi, kind, sort, class (jins, m., gen. after min, 'of') + -ī, my (Dunyā); 'my kind'
أَقْرَانِي: أَقْرَانِ + ي — aqrāni, peers, equals (qarn, pl. aqrān, broken plural; gen. after min, 'of') + -ī, my (Dunyā); 'my peers'
سَطْوَتِكِ: سَطْوَةِ + كِ — saṭwati, might, power (saṭwa, f., verbal noun of saṭā, yasṭū; gen. after min, 'from', and as second term of khawfan min, 'for fear of') + -ki, your (f. sg., Dunyā); 'your might'
وَهَيْبَةِ: وَ + هَيْبَةِ — wa-, and + haybati, awe, reverence (hayba, f., verbal noun of hāba, yahābu; gen. after min, coordinated with saṭwa; first term of idāfa with abīki, 'your father'); 'and the awe of'
وَلَابَأْسَ: وَ + لَا + بَأْسَ — wa-, and + lā, no (negation of the genus) + baʾsa, harm, objection (baʾs, m., acc. without tanwīn after lā; the print runs it together and writes it without hamza, ولاباس); 'and (there is) no harm'
دَادَتِى: دَادَتِ + ي — dādat, nurse, nanny (dāda, f., a Persian word; here dādat- before the possessive; vocative after yā) + -ī, my (Dunyā); the print spells it with a final ى (دادتى), read -ī; 'my nurse'
تَجَاسَرَ: تَجَاسَرَ — tajāsara, he dared, made bold (tajāsara, yatajāsaru, verb VI, perf. 3 m. sg.; Tāj al-Mulūk; takes ʿalā, 'to presume upon', ʿalā banāti al-mulūk, 'he has presumed upon the daughters of kings'; elsewhere ʿalā hādhā al-kalām); 'he dared'
يَخَفْ: يَخَفْ — yakhaf, he fears (khāfa, yakhāfu, verb I, hollow, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, 'did not', short form with the long vowel shortened); 'he did (not) fear'
سَطْوَةِ: سَطْوَةِ — saṭwati, might, power (saṭwa, f., verbal noun of saṭā, yasṭū; gen. after min, 'from', first term of idāfa with al-sulṭān, the sultan, her father King Shahramān); 'the might of'; here also with al-malik: min saṭwati al-maliki, 'of the king's wrath'
بِصَوَابٍ: بِـ + صَوَابٍ — bi-, bi- (prep.; after the negative laysa it only strengthens the predicate, no meaning of its own) + ṣawābin, right, correct, proper (ṣawāb, m., gen. indefinite after the pleonastic bi-); '(not) right'
تَجَاسُرِهِ: تَجَاسُر + هِ — tajāsuri, daring, boldness (tajāsur, m., verbal noun of tajāsara, verb VI; gen. after fī, 'in') + -hi, his (Tāj al-Mulūk); 'in his daring'
يَنْزَجِرُ: يَنْزَجِرُ — yanzajiru, he is restrained, checked (inzajara, yanzajiru, verb VII, imperf. 3 m. sg., indicative, after laʿalla, 'perhaps'; Tāj al-Mulūk; passive sense of VII, 'to be checked, to desist'); 'he will be restrained'
فَطَلَبَتْ: فَـ + طَلَبَتْ — fa-, and so (sequence) + ṭalabat, she asked for (ṭalaba, yaṭlubu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; Dunyā; takes its object directly, 'she asked for paper'); 'and she asked for'
وَدَوَاةً: وَ + دَوَاةً — wa-, and + dawātan, inkwell (dawāh, f., acc. indefinite, tanwīn; object of ṭalabat, coordinated with waraqa); 'and an inkwell'
الْعِتَابُ: الْـ + عِتَابُ — al-, the + ʿitābu, reproach, rebuke (ʿitāb, m., verbal noun of ʿātaba, yuʿātibu; nom., subject of ṭāla, 'has grown long'); 'the reproach'
وَفَرْطُ: وَ + فَرْطُ — wa-, and + farṭu, excess, extremity (farṭ, m., verbal noun of faraṭa, yafruṭu; nom., coordinated with al-ʿitāb as a second subject; first term of idāfa with al-jahl); 'and the excess of' Also wa-farṭu naḥībī, 'and the excess of my wailing', coordinated with damʿī as subject of kadhdhaba.
الْجَهْلِ: الْـ + جَهْلِ — al-, the + jahli, ignorance, folly (jahl, m., verbal noun of jahila, yajhalu; gen., second term of idāfa after farṭu); 'the ignorance'
اَغْرَاكَا: أَغْرَا + كَا — aghrā, it tempted, incited (aghrā, yughrī, verb IV, final-weak, perf. 3 m. sg.; the subject is farṭu al-jahl, excess of folly) + -kā, you (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk; the printed ā is the rhyme-lengthened -ka); 'has tempted you'
يَدِىْ: يَدِ + يْ — yadī, hand (yad, f., gen., second term of the idāfa after khaṭṭi, 'the writing of') + -ī, my (Dunyā; the print spells it يَدِىْ with a final ى); 'my hand'
اَنْهَاكَا: أَنْهَا + كَا — anhā, I forbid (nahā, yanhā, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 1 cs; after kam, 'how often (have I)'; Dunyā speaking) + -kā, you (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk, -ka lengthened for the rhyme); 'how often I have forbidden you'
النَّهْيِ: الـ + نَّهْيِ — al-, the + nahyi, forbidding, prohibition (nahy, m., verbal noun of nahā, yanhā; gen. after ʿinda, 'at the time of'); 'the forbidding'
طَمَعٍ: طَمَعٍ — ṭamaʿin, greed, covetousness (ṭamaʿ, m., verbal noun of ṭamiʿa, yaṭmaʿu; gen. indefinite after fī, 'in'; tazdādu ʿinda al-nahyi fī ṭamaʿin, 'you increase in greed'); 'greed'
بِكَتْمِ: بِـ + كَتْمِ — bi-, with, only on condition of (prep.; bi- of condition, 'only if you keep it secret') + katmi, hiding, keeping secret (katm, m., verbal noun of katama, yaktumu; gen. after bi-, first term of idāfa with al-sirr); 'with the hiding of'
اَرْضَاكَا: أَرْضَا + كَا — arḍā, I am pleased with (raḍiya, yarḍā, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; Dunyā speaking; here with a direct object) + -kā, you (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk, -ka lengthened for the rhyme); 'only ... am I pleased with you'
تَجْهَرْ: تَجْهَرْ — tajhar, you proclaim openly (jahara, yajharu, verb I, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā, prohibition; takes bi-, 'to declare something aloud', here bihi, it, his passion); '(do not) proclaim'
اِرْعَاكَا: اِرْعَا + كَا — irʿā, I regard, I care for (raʿā, yarʿā, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 1 cs, after lastu; the print points the alif with a kasra, اِرْعَاكَا, where arʿā-ka is expected, kept as printed) + -kā, you (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk, the -kā lengthened for the rhyme); 'I regard you'
تَذْكُرُهُ: تَذْكُرُ + هُ — tadhkuru, you mention (dhakara, yadhkuru, verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg., indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk; part of the relative clause mā anta tadhkuruhu, 'what you mention') + -hu, it (returning to mā, what); 'you mention it'
يَنْعَاكَا: يَنْعَا + كَا — yanʿā, he announces a death (naʿā, yanʿā, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 3 m. sg.; the rhyme word twice in the poem: first with ghurāb al-bayn, the raven of parting, as subject, then with al-ahl, the family, 'mourning you') + -kā, you (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk, -ka lengthened for the rhyme); 'announcing your death, mourning you'
مُنْدَفِعاً: مُنْدَفِعًا — mundafiʿan, rushing, surging (active participle of indafaʿa, verb VII, m. sg., acc. as predicate of yakūnu, 'will be'; the print has the tanwīn sign before the alif, مُنْدَفِعاً); 'rushing'
وَالدَّفْنُ: وَ + الـ + دَّفْنُ — wa-, and + al-, the + dafnu, burial (dafn, m., verbal noun of dafana, yadfinu; nom., subject of the nominal clause, with mathwāka as predicate, 'the burial under the earth is your dwelling'); 'and the burial'
مَثْوَاكَا: مَثْوَا + كَا — mathwā, dwelling, abode (m., noun of place from thawā, yathwī, 'to dwell'; nom., predicate of al-dafn) + -kā, your (m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk, -ka lengthened for the rhyme); 'your dwelling'
وَتَتْرُكُ: وَ + تَتْرُكُ — wa-, and + tatruku, you leave (taraka, yatruku, verb I, imperf. 2 m. sg., indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk; takes al-ahl, family, as direct object); 'and you leave'
الْاَهْلَ: الْـ + أَهْلَ — al-, the + ahla, family, kin (ahl, m., acc. as object of tatruku; the second subject of yanʿāka at the end of the line, 'the family mourning you'); 'the family'
مَغْرُوْرُ: مَغْرُورُ — maghrūru, deluded one (maghrūr, passive participle of gharra, yaghurru, verb I, m.; nom. without tanwīn, the regular vocative after yā when one particular person is addressed); 'O deluded one'
نَدَمٍ: نَدَمٍ — nadamin, regret, remorse (nadam, m., verbal noun of nadima, yandamu; gen. indefinite after fī, 'in'; fī nadamin ʿalā firāqika, 'in regret over your parting'); 'regret'
طُوْلَ: طُولَ — ṭūla, length, throughout (ṭūl, m., acc. as adverb of time, 'the length of'; first term of idāfa with al-dahr, 'the length of time', all their days); 'the length of'
وَدَفَعَتْهَا: وَ + دَفَعَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + dafaʿat, she handed over (dafaʿa, yadfaʿu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; takes li- for the one given to, as li-al-ʿajūz or lahu, Middle Arabic where Classical prefers ilā) + -hā, it (the paper, f.); 'and she handed it'
قَاسِيَةُ: قَاسِيَةُ — qāsiyatu, hard, harsh (active participle of qasā, yaqsū, verb I, final-weak, f. sg., nom. as predicate of anna-hā, 'that she was'; first term of idāfa with al-qalb, 'hard of the heart'); 'hard of'
بِالْخَمْسَةِ: بِـ + الْـ + خَمْسَةِ — bi-, by (prep. of oath/invocation; swearing by the Five, as in Shīʿī prayers) + al-, the + khamsati, five (khamsa, f., number placed before its noun, both with the article) ; 'by the five'
الْاَشْبَاحِ: الْـ + أَشْبَاحِ — al-, the + ashbāḥi, figures, forms (shabaḥ, pl. ashbāḥ, broken plural; gen., the Five Holy Ones: Muḥammad, ʿAlī, Fāṭima, al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn); 'the figures'
فَاجْعَلْهُ: فَـ + اجْعَلْ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (sequence) + ijʿal, make, put (jaʿala, yajʿalu, verb I, imperative 2 m. sg., addressed to Allāh, the Lord) + -hu, him (the one who torments him; wa-man bulītu bihi, 'the one with whom I am afflicted'); 'and make him'
شَجَنِي: شَجَنِ + ي — shajani, grief, sorrow (shajan, m., 'distress'; gen. after fī, 'in'; the -ī of the pronoun is the final vowel here, shajan + -ī, 'in my grief') + -ī, my (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'my grief'
فَاَنْتَ: فَـ + أَنْتَ — fa-, for, and indeed (explanatory) + anta, you (m. sg., independent pronoun; here Allāh, the Lord, addressed in prayer); 'for You'
لَهَبٍ: لَهَبٍ — lahabin, flame, blaze (lahab, m., gen. indefinite; stands beside jawan, 'passion', in the construct as a descriptive second noun, fī jawan lahabin, 'in a passion, a flame'); 'a flame'
جَفَانِي: جَفَا + نِي — jafā, he shunned, treated harshly (jafā, yajfū, verb I, final-weak, perf. 3 m. sg.; the subject is ḥabībun, a beloved) + -nī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'has shunned me'
اَرِقُّ: أَرِقُّ — ariqqu, I grow tender, am softened (raqqa, yariqqu, verb I, doubled, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk speaking; takes li-, 'toward', here lahā, her); 'I grow tender'
تَجُوْرُ: تَجُورُ — tajūru, she tyrannizes, wrongs (jāra, yajūru, verb I, hollow, imperf. 3 f. sg. (the beloved), written as in the printed vowelling; takes ʿalā, 'to oppress', here ʿalā ḍaʿfī, my weakness); 'she tyrannizes'
وَتَظْلِمُنِي: وَ + تَظْلِمُ + نِي — wa-, and + taẓlimu, she wrongs (ẓalama, yaẓlimu, verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg., indicative; the beloved) + -nī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'and wrongs me'
اَهِيمُ: أَهِيمُ — ahīmu, I wander distraught, roam in love (hāma, yahīmu, verb I, hollow, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk speaking; fī ghamarātin, 'in floods'); 'I wander distraught'
غَمَرَاتٍ: غَمَرَاتٍ — ghamarātin, floods, depths (ghamra, pl. ghamarāt, sound f. pl.; gen. indefinite after fī, 'in'; the surges of sorrow, qualified by the relative clause lā inqiḍāʾa lahā, 'no ending to them'); 'floods'
انْقِضَاءَ: انْقِضَاءَ — inqiḍāʾa, ending, passing (inqiḍāʾ, m., verbal noun of inqaḍā, yanqaḍī, verb VII, final-weak; acc. without tanwīn as the noun of lā, negation of the genus, 'no ending'); 'no ending'
مُسْعِفًا: مُسْعِفًا — musʿifan, helper (active participle of asʿafa, yusʿifu, verb IV, m. sg.; acc. indefinite, object of arā, 'I see'; 'one who grants help'); 'a helper'
يُسْعِفُنِي: يُسْعِفُ + نِي — yusʿifu, he helps, grants aid (asʿafa, yusʿifu, verb IV, imperf. 3 m. sg., indicative; a relative clause qualifying musʿifan, 'who helps') + -nī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'who helps me'
اَرُوْمُ: أَرُومُ — arūmu, I seek, strive for (rāma, yarūmu, verb I, hollow, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk speaking; object suluwwan, consolation); 'I seek'
سُلُوًّا: سُلُوًّا — suluwwan, consolation, forgetting, cure (suluww, m., verbal noun of salā, yaslū; acc. indefinite, object of arūmu; the print's doubling is the shadda on the wāw); 'consolation'
اَسْلُو: أَسْلُو — aslū, I am consoled, I forget (salā, yaslū, verb I, final-weak, imperf. 1 cs, indicative; Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker; 'to be consoled, to forget', how can I forget); 'I forget'
مَانِعِي: مَانِعِ + ي — māniʿī, withholder, one who denies (active participle of manaʿa, yamnaʿu, verb I, m. sg.; vocative after yā, with the -ī 'me' as its object and ṭība al-wiṣāl as the second object) + -ī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker, as the one denied); 'O you who withhold from me'
طِيبَ: طِيبَ — ṭība, sweetness, goodness (ṭīb, m., verbal noun of ṭāba, yaṭību, hollow; acc. as the second object of māniʿī; first term of idāfa with al-wiṣāl, 'the sweetness of union'); 'the sweetness of'
اَمِنْتَ: أَمِنْتَ — aminta, you are safe, secure (amina, yaʾmanu, verb I, perf. 2 m. sg., with the interrogative hal before it; takes min, 'safe from', here min nāʾibāti al-dahr; the beloved is addressed in the masculine here); 'are you safe'
نَائِبَاتِ: نَائِبَاتِ — nāʾibāti, calamities, blows (active participle of nāba, yanūbu, verb I, hollow, f.; pl. nāʾibāt, sound f. pl.; gen. after min, 'from', first term of idāfa with al-dahr, 'the calamities of the time'); 'the calamities of'
اَلَسْتِ: أَ + لَسْتِ — a-, interrogative particle, 'are (you) not?' + lasti, you are not (laysa, defective verb, perf.-form 2 f. sg., 'you are not'; here the beloved is addressed in the feminine); 'are you not'
مَسْرُوْرَةٍ: مَسْرُورَةٍ — masrūratin, gladdened, delightful (masrūr, passive participle of sarra, yasurru, verb I, f. sg., gen. indefinite, adjective of ʿīsha, 'a life'; fī ʿīshatin masrūratin, 'in a gladdened life'); 'gladdened'
مُغَرَّبٌ: مُغَرَّبٌ — mugharrabun, made a stranger, exiled (passive participle of gharraba, yugharribu, verb II, m. sg., nom. indefinite, predicate of anā, 'I am'; fīki, 'for your sake': fī of cause); 'an exile'
اَهْلِي: أَهْلِ + ي — ahli, family, people (ahl, m., gen. after ʿan, 'from', first term of idāfa) + -ī, my (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'my family'
وَطَنِي: وَطَنِ + ي — waṭani, homeland, native land (waṭan, m., gen. after ʿan, 'from', first term of idāfa) + -ī, my (Tāj al-Mulūk, the speaker); 'my homeland'
قَرَأَهُ: قَرَأَ + هُ — qaraʾa, he read (qaraʾa, yaqraʾu, verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., Tāj al-Mulūk) + -hu, it (the letter, al-kitāb, m.); 'he read it'
إِيَّاةُ: إِيَّا + هُ — iyyā-, direct-object carrier, the second object of nāwalathā ('she handed her it') + -hu, it (the letter, m.); the print writes the pronoun with a final ة (اياة) as it does hādhihi (هذة), read -hu; 'it'
قَرَأَتْهَا: قَرَأَتْ + هَا — qaraʾat, she read (qaraʾa, yaqraʾu, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., Dunyā) + -hā, it (feminine, as if for risāla, 'letter', though the next word maḍmūnahu goes back to the masculine kitāb); 'she read it'
مَضْمُونَهُ: مَضْمُونَ + هُ — maḍmūna, contents, purport (maḍmūn, m., passive participle of ḍamina, yaḍmanu, verb I, used as a noun; acc., object of fahimat; first term of idāfa) + -hu, its (the letter's, masculine kitāb); 'its contents'
أَمْسِكُوا: أَمْسِكُوا — amsikū, seize! (amsaka, yumsiku, verb IV, imperative 2 m. pl.; Dunyā to her slave-girls and servants); 'seize'
الْمَاكِرَةَ: الْـ + مَاكِرَةَ — al-, the + mākirata, crafty, scheming (active participle of makara, yamkuru, verb I, f. sg., acc., adjective of al-ʿajūza, 'the old woman'; the third in a row with al-malʿūna); 'the crafty'
وَاضْرِبُوهَا: وَ + اضْرِبُوهَا — wa-, and + iḍribū, beat! (ḍaraba, yaḍribu, verb I, imperative 2 m. pl.; Dunyā to her servants) + -hā, her (the old woman, al-ʿajūz, f.); 'and beat her'
بِنِعَالِكُمْ: بِـ + نِعَالِ + كُمْ — bi-, with (prep. of instrument) + niʿāli, sandals (niʿl, f., pl. niʿāl, broken plural; gen. after bi-, first term of idāfa; a beating with shoes is a beating meant to shame) + -kum, your (m. pl., the servants); 'with your sandals'
بِالنِّعَالِ: بِـ + النِّعَال — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + al-, the + niʿāl, sandals (pl. of niʿl, f.; gen. after bi-); 'with the sandals'
لَاخَوْفِى: لَا + خَوْفِ + ي — lā, the lā of lawlā, 'were it not for' (law + lā, run onto the next word in the print) + khawf, fear (m., nom., the noun after lawlā) + -ī, my (the print spells the ending with ى); 'were it not for my fear'
لَقَتَلْتُكِ: لَ + قَتَلْتُ + كِ — la-, the answer particle after lawlā, 'were it not for': 'would have' + qataltu, I killed (qatala, yaqtulu, verb I, perf. 1 cs; Dunyā speaking) + -ki, you (f. sg., the old woman); 'I would have killed you'. The print has لتنلتك, a misprint for لقتلتك, corrected here
أَعِيدُوا: aʿīdū — أَعِيدُوا — aʿāda, to repeat (verb IV, imperative 2 m. pl.; with ʿalā, 'repeat on someone'); 'repeat!'
فَضَرَبُوهَا: فَ + ضَرَبُوا + هَا — fa-, so, then (sequence) + ḍarabū, they beat (ḍaraba, yaḍribu, verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her (the old woman); 'so they beat her'
أَمَرَتْهُمْ: أَمَرَتْ + هُمْ — amarat, she ordered (amara, yaʾmuru, verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; Dunyā; the act ordered follows with an, 'that') + -hum, them (the servants); 'she ordered them'
يَجُرُّوهَا: يَجُرُّوا + هَا — yajurrū, they drag (jarra, yajurru, verb I, geminate, subjunctive 3 m. pl. after an, 'that', with the -na dropped) + -hā, her; 'that they drag her'
وَيَرْمُوهَا: وَ + يَرْمُوا + هَا — wa-, and + yarmū, they throw (ramā, yarmī, verb I, final-weak, subjunctive 3 m. pl. after the an of the previous clause, with the -na dropped) + -hā, her; 'and (that they) throw her'
فَسَحَبُوهَا: فَ + سَحَبُوا + هَا — fa-, so, then + saḥabū, they dragged (saḥaba, yasḥabu, verb I, perfect 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'so they dragged her'
وَرَمَوْهَا: وَ + رَمَوْا + هَا — wa-, and + ramaw, they flung (ramā, yarmī, verb I, final-weak, perfect 3 m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'and they flung her'
وَتَقْعُدُ: وَ + تَقْعُدُ — wa-, and + taqʿudu, she sits (qaʿada, yaqʿudu, verb I, imperfect 3 f. sg., Dunyā's old woman, linked to tamshī as a second state: 'walking and sitting'); 'and sitting'
أَجْمَعَ: أَجْمَعَ — ajmaʿa, from jamaʿa, to bring together (verb I, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā, 'until'; jamaʿa bayna … wa-bayna, 'bring … and … together'); 'until I bring (you) together'; here: subjunctive after an, 'that'; an ajmaʿa mālī, 'to gather my goods'
وَأُوصِلَكَ: وَ + أُوصِلَ + كَ — wa-, and + ūṣila, I cause to arrive (waṣala, to arrive; awṣala, verb IV, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā, continued by wa-) + -ka, you (Tāj al-Mulūk); 'and (until) I get you (to)'
أَحْرَقَتْنِي: أَحْرَقَتْ + نِي — aḥraqat, she burned (ḥaraqa, to burn; aḥraqa, verb IV, perfect 3 f. sg., Dunyā) + -nī, me (the old woman); 'she has set me on fire'
بُغْضِهَا: بُغْض + هَا — bughḍ, hatred (m., gen., second term of the idāfa after sababu, the subject of the question; mā sabab bughḍi-hā, 'what is the cause of her hatred') + -hā, her (Dunyā); 'her hatred'
لِلرِّجَالِ: لِـ + الـ + رِّجَال — li-, for, towards (prep.; marks the object of the feeling, 'hatred for') + al-, the + rijāl, men (pl. of rajul, m., gen. after li-); 'for men'
الْمَنَامُ: الـ + مَنَام — al-, the + manām, dream (m., nom., predicate in 'what was that dream?'; also 'sleep'); 'the dream'
وَبَذَرَ: وَ + بَذَرَ — wa-, and + badhara, he scattered (badhara, yabdhuru, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., the fowler); 'and he scattered (seed)'
الشَّرَكِ: الـ + شَّرَك — al-, the + sharak, snare, net (m., gen. after ilā, 'to', in 'came to that net'); 'the net'
حَمَامَتَيْنِ: حَمَامَة + يْنِ — ḥamāma, dove (f., singular noun of unity from ḥamām) + -ayni, dual, two (acc., object of raʾat, 'she saw'); 'two doves'
بِرِجْلِ: بِـ + رِجْل — bi- (after wa-idhā of surprise it only marks what appears: 'and behold, ...') + rijl, foot, leg (f., gen. after bi-); 'and behold, the foot'. The print's kasra marks it as rijl, not rajul, 'man'
الذَّكَرِ: الـ + ذَّكَر — al-, the + dhakar, male (m., gen., second term of the idāfa 'foot of the male'); 'the male'
تَعَلَّقَتْ: تَعَلَّقَتْ — taʿallaqat, to be caught, attached (taʿallaqa, verb V, perfect 3 f. sg., agreeing with feminine rijl; the doubling mark is the print's); 'it caught'
يَخْتَبِطُ: يَخْتَبِطُ — yakhtabiṭu, to thrash about, flounder (ikhtabaṭa, verb VIII, imperfect 3 m. sg., after ṣāra, 'he began to'); 'he thrashes about'
وَفَرَّتْ: وَ + فَرَّتْ — wa-, and + farrat, they fled (farra, yafirru, verb I, geminate, perfect 3 f. sg., agreeing with the broken plural al-ṭuyūr; the doubling mark is the print's); 'and (they) fled'
وَحَامَتْ: وَ + حَامَتْ — wa-, and + ḥāmat, she circled (ḥāma, yaḥūmu, verb I, hollow, perfect 3 f. sg., the female dove; with ʿalayhi, 'around him'); 'and she circled'
غَافِلٌ: غَافِلٌ — ghāfil, unaware, not looking (ghafala, to be heedless; active participle of verb I, m. sg. nom. indef., predicate of wa-al-ṣayyādu in a circumstantial clause); 'unaware'
تَنْقُرُ: تَنْقُرُ — tanquru, she pecks (naqara, yanquru, verb I, imperfect 3 f. sg., after ṣārat, 'she began to'); 'she pecks'
تَجْذِبُهُ: تَجْذِبُ + هُ — tajdhibu, she pulls (jadhaba, yajdhibu, verb I, imperfect 3 f. sg., after ṣārat) + -hu, it, him (the mesh or the trapped bird; masculine in the print); 'she pulls it'
خَلَّصَتْ: خَلَّصَتْ — khallaṣat, she freed (khallaṣa, verb II, perfect 3 f. sg., with direct object rijlahu; the doubling mark is the print's); 'she freed'
الشَّرَكَ: الـ + شَّرَكَ — al-, the + sharaka, snare, net (m., acc., object of aṣlaḥa, 'he mended'); 'the net'
يَمْضِ: يَمْضِ — yamḍi, to pass (maḍā, yamḍī, verb I, final-weak, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, the -ī dropped; the subject is ghayru sāʿatin, 'nothing but an hour'); 'did not pass'
نَزَلَتِ: نَزَلَتِ — nazalat-i, they came down (nazala, yanzilu, verb I, perfect 3 f. sg., agreeing with the plural al-ṭuyūr; the final -i is the helping kasra before the article al-); 'came down' Also 3fs of a single woman, of leaving a boat: فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ 'when the woman came ashore'.
الطُّيُورُ: الـ + طُّيُورُ — al-, the + ṭuyūr, birds (pl. of ṭayr, nom., subject of nazalat); 'the birds'
وَعَلِقَ: وَ + عَلِقَ — wa-, and + ʿaliqa, it caught (ʿaliqa, yaʿlaqu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg.; the subject is the net, with fī al-unthā, 'on the female'); 'and (it) caught'
الشَّرَكُ: الـ + شَّرَكُ — al-, the + sharak, net (m., nom., subject of ʿaliqa: the net, not the bird, does the catching); 'the net'
الذَّكَرُ: الـ + ذَّكَرُ — al-, the + dhakar, male (m., nom., adjective in apposition to al-ṭayru, 'the male bird'); 'the male'
يَعُدْ: يَعُدْ — yaʿud, to return (ʿāda, yaʿūdu, verb I, hollow, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, the long vowel shortened); 'did not return'
لِأُنْثَاهُ: لِـ + أُنْثَا + هُ — li-, for, to (prep.; lam yaʿud li-, 'he did not return to or for') + unthā, female, mate (f., gen. after li-; the -ā is invariable) + -hu, his; 'for his mate'
الطَّيْرَةَ: الـ + طَّيْرَة — al-, the + ṭayra, female bird (f., acc., object of akhadha; a colloquial feminine made from ṭayr, not Classical; the note marks it so); 'the (female) bird'
وَذَبَحَهَا: وَ + ذَبَحَ + هَا — wa-, and + dhabaḥa, he cut the throat of (dhabaḥa, yadhbaḥu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., the fowler) + -hā, her; 'and he slaughtered her'
مَرْعُوبَةً: مَرْعُوبَةً — marʿūba, terrified (raʿaba, to terrify; passive participle of verb I, f. sg. acc., ḥāl, 'in terror', of the woman who woke) + -tan, indef. acc. ending; 'terrified'
مَنَامِهَا: مَنَام + هَا — manām, sleep; also dream (m., gen. after min, 'from') + -hā, her; intabahat min manāmihā, 'she woke from her sleep'
فَتَحَيَّلِي: فَ + تَحَيَّلِي — fa-, so (introducing the request) + taḥayyalī, contrive (ḥāla; taḥayyala, verb V, imperative 2 f. sg., addressed to the old woman; the doubling mark is the print's; takes bi-ḥīla, 'by a trick', the same root as its object); 'so contrive' Also with fī, 'contrive (something)': fa-taḥayyalī fī khurūjihimā, 'then contrive a way to get them out'.
بُسْتَانًا: بُسْتَان + اً — bustān, garden (m., from Persian; acc., the noun of anna (anna lahā bustānan), 'she has a garden') + -an, indef. acc.; 'a garden'
فُرْجَتِهَا: فُرْجَة + هَا — furja, outing, recreation (f., gen. after bi-rasmi, 'appointed for') + -hā, her (Dunyā's); 'her pleasure, her outing'
أَرَادَتِ: أَرَادَتِ — arādat-i, she wanted (arāda, yurīdu, verb IV, hollow, perfect 3 f. sg.; the final -i is the helping kasra before the article al-); 'she wishes (to go out)'; here: 'when she wants (to rise / to sleep)'
وَأُعْلِمُكَ: وَ + أُعْلِمُ + كَ — wa-, and + uʿlimu, I let know (ʿalima; aʿlama, verb IV, imperfect 1cs, indicative) + -ka, you (Tāj al-Mulūk); 'and I let you know'
وَتُصَادِفَهَا: وَ + تُصَادِفَ + هَا — wa-, and + tuṣādifa, you come upon (ṣādafa, verb III, subjunctive 2 m. sg. after ḥattā, 'so that', 'meet by chance') + -hā, her (Dunyā); 'and (so that) you come across her'
وَاحْرِصْ: وَ + احْرِصْ — wa-, and + iḥriṣ, be intent, take care (ḥariṣa, yaḥraṣu, verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.; with ʿalā an, 'on the fact that'); 'and take care'
تُفَارِقُ: تُفَارِقُ — tufāriqu, you leave (fāraqa, verb III, imperfect 2 m. sg., indicative after lā in a clause with annaka, 'that you'); 'you leave'
حُسْنَكَ: حُسْن + كَ — ḥusn, beauty (m., acc., object of raʾat) + -ka, your; 'your beauty'
وَجَمَالَكَ: وَ + جَمَال + كَ — wa-, and + jamāl, grace, beauty (m., acc., coordinated with ḥusnaka) + -ka, your; 'and your grace'
بِمَحَبَّتِكَ: بِـ + مَحَبَّة + كَ — bi-, with, by (prep.; the verb taʿallaqa takes bi-, 'be attached to') + maḥabba, love (f., gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (Tāj al-Mulūk's, objective: love of you); 'to love of you'
الِاجْتِمَاعِ: الـ + اِجْتِمَاع — al-, the + ijtimāʿ, coming together, union (m., verbal noun of verb VIII; gen., second term of idāfa 'causes of union'); 'the coming together'
وَمَضَيَا: وَ + مَضَيَا — wa-, and + maḍayā, they went (maḍā, yamḍī, verb I, final-weak, perfect 3 m. dual, Tāj al-Mulūk and ʿAzīz, his companion); 'and the two went'
وَعَرَّفَاهُ: وَ + عَرَّفَا + هُ — wa-, and + ʿarrafā, they made known (ʿarrafa, verb II, perfect 3 m. dual) + -hu, it (the lodging; Classical would have a second pronoun, ʿarrafāhā iyyāhu, while the following li-hā, 'to her', marks the one told); 'and they showed it (to her)'
بِالدُّكَّانِ: بِـ + الـ + دُّكَّان — bi-, of, for (prep.; ḥāja bi-, 'need of') + al-, the + dukkān, shop (m., gen. after bi-; treated as feminine in this passage); 'of the shop'
وَوَهَبْتُهَا: وَ + وَهَبْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + wahabtu, I gave (wahaba, yahabu, verb I, perfect 1cs, Tāj al-Mulūk) + -hā, it (the shop, taken as feminine); 'and I have given it'
يَسْئَلُهُ: يَسْئَلُ + هُ — yasʾalu, he asks (saʾala, yasʾalu, verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg., after ṣāra, 'he began to'; the print's hamza on a yāʾ seat is an older spelling) + -hu, him (ʿAzīz, his companion); 'he asks him'
أَحْوَالِهِ: أَحْوَال + هِ — aḥwāl, circumstances, adventures (pl. of ḥāl, m.; gen., second term of idāfa after ʿan, 'about') + -hi, his (ʿAzīz's); 'his circumstances'
وَأَعْلَمَاهُ: وَ + أَعْلَمَا + هُ — wa-, and + aʿlamā, they informed (ʿalima; aʿlama, verb IV, perfect 3 m. dual, Tāj al-Mulūk and ʿAzīz; takes bi-, 'inform of') + -hu, him (the vizier); 'and they informed him'
فَلَبِسَ: فَ + لَبِسَ — fa-, so, then (sequence) + labisa, he put on (labisa, yalbasu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., agreeing with kullu wāḥidin, 'each one'); 'so he put on'
وَخَلْفَهُمْ: وَ + خَلْف + هُمْ — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'with') + khalf, behind (adverbial noun, acc. of place) + -hum, them (the vizier and the young men); 'and behind them'
غَزِيرَ: غَزِيرَ — ghazīr, abundant (adj., in the idāfa ghazīra al-anhāri, acc., ḥāl with kathīra: 'full of streams'); 'abundant (of)'
وَرَأَوُا: وَ + رَأَوُا — wa-, and + raʾaw, they saw (raʾā, yarā, verb I, defective, perfect 3 m. pl.; the final -u is the helping ḍamma before the article al-); 'and they saw'
الْخَوْلِيَّ: الـ + خَوْلِيَّ — al-, the + khawliyy, gardener, keeper of an orchard (m., acc., object of raʾaw; ending -iyy, a relative noun; an Egyptian word, as the note says); 'the gardener'
فَنَاوَلَهُ: فَ + نَاوَلَ + هُ — fa-, so, then + nāwala, he handed (nāwala, verb III, perfect 3 m. sg., the vizier) + -hu, him (the gardener); 'so he handed him'
نَأْكُلُهُ: نَأْكُلُ + هُ — naʾkulu, we eat (akala, yaʾkulu, verb I, imperfect 1 pl., a relative clause on shayʾan, 'something') + -hu, it; 'that we may eat'
أُفَرِّجَهُمْ: أُفَرِّجَ + هُمْ — ufarrija, I give a pleasant outing (farraja, verb II, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'that I'; the root of furja) + -hum, them (the young men); 'that I show them the sights'
وَتَفَرَّجُوا: وَ + تَفَرَّجُوا — wa-, and + tafarrajū, enjoy the sights (tafarraja, verb V, imperative 2 m. pl., the gardener to the visitors); 'and enjoy yourselves'
وَجَمِيعُهُ: وَ + جَمِيع + هُ — wa-, and + jamīʿ, all (m., nom., subject of the nominal sentence) + -hu, it (the garden); 'and all of it'
مِلْكُكُمْ: مِلْك + كُمْ — milk, property, possession (m., nom., predicate; a courteous formula, not a gift) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your property'
وَاجْلِسُوا: وَ + اجْلِسُوا — wa-, and + ijlisū, sit (jalasa, yajlisu, verb I, imperative 2 m. pl.); 'and sit'
تَأْكُلُونَ: تَأْكُلُونَ — taʾkulūna, you eat (akala, yaʾkulu, verb I, imperfect 2 m. pl., indicative, in the relative clause after bi-mā, 'with what'; aḥḍara bi-mā, 'bring something', borrows the bi- of atā bi-); 'you eat'
خَارُوفٌ: خَارُوفٌ — khārūf, lamb, sheep (m., nom. indef., subject after wa-maʿahu, 'and with him was'; the spoken form of Classical kharūf, with long ā, kept); 'a lamb'
وَخُبْزٌ: وَ + خُبْزٌ — wa-, and + khubz, bread (m., nom. indef., coordinated with khārūf); 'and bread'
الْقُطْنِ: الـ + قُطْن — al-, the + quṭn, cotton (m., gen., second term of idāfa after mithlu, 'like'); 'cotton'
فَتَحَلَّوْا: فَ + تَحَلَّوْا — fa-, so, then + taḥallaw, they ate sweets (taḥallā, verb V, final-weak, perfect 3 m. pl.; from ḥalwā, 'sweetmeat'); 'so they ate sweets'
يُحَدِّثُونَ: يُحَدِّثُونَ — yuḥaddithūna, they talk (ḥaddatha, verb II, imperfect 3 m. pl., indicative, ḥāl after jalasū; Classical would be yataḥaddathūna, as the note says, the text uses that form later); 'talking'
مُسْتَأْجِرُهُ: مُسْتَأْجِر + هُ — mustaʾjir, one who rents (ista'jara, verb X; active participle, m. sg. nom., predicate of anta; the print omits the hamza) + -hu, it (the garden); 'you rent it'
مَاهُوَلِي: مَا + هُوَ + لِي — mā, not (negative) + huwa, it (the garden; run together in the print, ماهولي) + li-, to, belonging to (prep.; marks the owner) + -ī, me; 'it is not mine'
لِبِنْتِ: لِـ + بِنْتِ — li-, belonging to (prep.; marks the owner) + bint, daughter (f., gen. after li-, first term of idāfa 'daughter of the king', i.e. Dunyā, the king's daughter); 'to the daughter (of)'
الْأُجْرَةِ: الـ + أُجْرَة — al-, the + ujra, wage, pay (f., gen. after min, 'of'); 'the wages'
تَذْكُرُنِي: تَذْكُرُ + نِي — tadhkuru, you remember (dhakara, yadhkuru, verb I, imperfect 2 m. sg., the gardener; dhakarahu bi-, 'remember someone by') + -nī, me (the vizier); 'you remember me'
الثَّلٰثَمِائَةِ: الـ + ثَّلٰثَمِائَة — al-, the + thalāthamiʾa, three hundred (thalātha, three + miʾa, hundred; gen. after hādhihi in a demonstrative phrase; the counted noun stands in the singular). The print has الثلٰمائة, a misprint corrected here; 'the three hundred'
الْخَوْلِيُّ: الـ + خَوْلِيُّ — al-, the + khawliyy, gardener (m., nom., subject of samiʿa; an Egyptian word, as in the note); 'the gardener'
إِنْشَاءَ: إِنْ + شَاءَ — in, if (conditional particle) + shāʾa, he wills (shāʾa, yashāʾu, verb I, hollow, perfect 3 m. sg.; the subject is Allāh); set in the print as one word, which looks like inshāʾ, 'composition', but is read as the formula in shāʾa allāhu, 'if God wills'
مُبَيِّضًا: مُبَيِّض + اً — mubayyiḍ, plasterer, whitener (bayyaḍa, verb II; active participle, m., acc., object of aḥḍara, 'he brought') + -an, indef. acc.; 'a plasterer'
وَنَقَّاشًا: وَ + نَقَّاش + اً — wa-, and + naqqāsh, painter, decorator (intensive form from naqasha, 'to paint'; m., acc., coordinated) + -an, indef. acc.; 'and a painter'
وَصَائِغًا: وَ + صَائِغ + اً — wa-, and + ṣāʾigh, goldsmith (ṣāgha, yaṣūghu, hollow; active participle, m., acc., coordinated) + -an, indef. acc.; 'and a goldsmith'
مَايَحْتَاجُونَ: مَا + يَحْتَاجُونَ — mā, what (relative) + yaḥtājūna, they need (iḥtāja ilā, verb VIII, imperfect 3 m. pl., indicative); the print runs the two words together (مايحتاجون); 'what they need'
بِتَبْيِيضِ: بِـ + تَبْيِيض — bi-, with (prep.; amara bi-, 'order (something)': the verb takes bi- for the thing commanded) + tabyīḍ, whitewashing (m., verbal noun of bayyaḍa, verb II, gen. after bi-); 'to whitewash'
وَزَخْرَفَتِهِ: وَ + زَخْرَفَة + هِ — wa-, and + zakhrafa, adorning, ornamenting (f., verbal noun of zakhrafa, gen., coordinated with tabyīḍ) + -hi, it (the palace); 'and adorning it'
وَاللَّازَوَرْدِ: وَ + الـ + لَّازَوَرْد — wa-, and + al-, the + lāzaward, lapis lazuli (m., Persian loan; gen., coordinated with al-dhahab after bi-iḥḍāri, 'bringing'); 'and the lapis lazuli'; also: gen. coordinated with al-dhahab after bi- of the material: manqūshun bi-al-dhahabi wa-al-lāzawardi, 'worked with gold and lapis lazuli' (Night 192)
لِلنَّقَّاشِ: لِـ + الـ + نَّقَّاش — li-, to (prep.; marks the person addressed after qāla) + al-, the + naqqāsh, painter (m., gen. after li-); 'to the painter'
آدَمِيٍّ: آدَمِيّ — ādamiyy, human being, 'son of Adam' (relative adjective from Ādam; m., gen., second term of idāfa after ṣūrata, 'figure of'); 'of a man'
صَيَّادٍ: صَيَّاد — ṣayyād, fowler, hunter (m., gen., in apposition to ādamiyyin; the doubling mark is the print's); 'a fowler'
شَرَكَهُ: شَرَك + هُ — sharak, net, snare (m., acc., object of naṣaba) + -hu, his (the fowler's); 'his net'
وَحَمَامَةٌ: وَ + حَمَامَة — wa-, and + ḥamāma, dove (f., nom. indef., subject, with ṭuyūrun, of waqaʿat, 'fell'); 'and a dove'
بِمِنْقَارِهَا: بِـ + مِنْقَار + هَا — bi-, with (prep., instrument; ishtabakat bi-, 'be entangled by') + minqār, beak (m., gen. after bi-) + -hā, her, its (the dove's); 'by its beak'
النَّقَّاشُ: الـ + نَّقَّاشُ — al-, the + naqqāsh, painter (m., nom., subject of naqasha); 'the painter'
جَانِبًا: جَانِب + اً — jānib, side (m., acc., object of naqasha, 'painted one side') + -an, indef. acc.; 'one side'
نَقْشِهِ: نَقْش + هِ — naqsh, painting, ornament (m., verbal noun of naqasha; gen. after min) + -hi, his (the painter's); 'of his painting'
وَصَوِّرْ: وَ + صَوِّرْ — wa-, and + ṣawwir, depict, paint (ṣawwara, verb II, imperative 2 m. sg.; the doubling mark is the print's); 'and paint'
وَاعْمَلْ: وَ + اعْمَلْ — wa-, and + iʿmal, make, do (ʿamila, yaʿmalu, verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.); 'and make'
جَارِحٍ: جَارِح — jāriḥ, bird of prey, raptor (jaraḥa, 'to wound'; active participle, m., gen., second term of idāfa after ṣūrata, 'figure of'); 'of a bird of prey'
قَنَصَ: قَنَصَ — qanaṣa, he caught (qanaṣa, yaqniṣu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., the bird of prey, in a qad clause); 'it has caught'
الْحَمَامِ: الـ + حَمَام — al-, the + ḥamām, doves (collective, m., gen.; dhakar al-ḥamām, 'the male of the doves'); 'of the doves'
وَأَنْشَبَ: وَ + أَنْشَبَ — wa-, and + anshaba, he drove in, fastened (nashiba; anshaba, verb IV, perfect 3 m. sg., the raptor; with fīhi, 'into him'); 'and it drove in'
مَخَالِبَهُ: مَخَالِب + هُ — makhālib, talons (pl. of mikhlab, m., acc., object of anshaba) + -hu, its (the raptor's); 'its talons'
أُجْرَتَهُمُ: أُجْرَة + هُمُ — ujra, pay, wage (f., acc., second object of aʿṭā) + -hum, their (the craftsmen's; the final -u is the helping vowel before the wa-l of inṣarafū); 'their wages'
وَوَدَّعُوا: وَ + وَدَّعُوا — wa-, and + waddaʿū, they took leave of (waddaʿa, verb II, perfect 3 m. pl., the vizier and his companions; the doubling mark is the print's); 'and they took leave of'
الْبُسْتَانِيَّ: الـ + بُسْتَانِيَّ — al-, the + bustāniyy, gardener (relative noun from bustān, 'garden'; m., acc., object of waddaʿū); 'the gardener'
أَنْشِدْنِي: أَنْشِدْ + نِي — anshid, recite (nashada; anshada, verb IV, imperative 2 m. sg., addressed to ʿAzīz, his companion) + -nī, me (Tāj al-Mulūk); 'recite to me'
وَتَزُولُ: وَ + تَزُولُ — wa-, and + tazūlu, it departs (zāla, yazūlu, verb I, hollow, imperfect 3 f. sg., indicative, after laʿalla, 'perhaps'; subject al-afkār, plural of a non-person); 'and (these cares) will leave'
الْأَفْكَارُ: الـ + أَفْكَارُ — al-, the + afkār, thoughts, cares (pl. of fikr, m.; nom., subject of tazūlu; here anxious, lovesick thoughts); 'the cares'
وَيَبْرُدُ: وَ + يَبْرُدُ — wa-, and + yabrudu, it cools (barada, yabrudu, verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg., indicative; subject mā bi-qalbī, 'what is in my heart'); 'and (it) will cool'
لَهِيبِ: لَهِيب — lahīb, blaze, flame (m., gen. after min, 'of', first term of idāfa 'blaze of the fire'); 'the blaze (of)'
حَوَيْتُهُ: حَوَيْتُ + هُ — ḥawaytu, I have gathered, contained (ḥawā, yaḥwī, verb I, final-weak, perfect 1cs, the poet, ʿAzīz) + -hu, it (all the grief of lovers); 'I have gathered it'
مُفْرَدًا: مُفْرَد + اً — mufrad, alone, single (afrada, verb IV; passive participle used as ḥāl, acc., m.) + -an, indef. acc.; 'alone'
وَهَى: وَهَى — wahā, it grew weak (wahā, yahī, verb I, final-weak, perfect 3 m. sg.; spelled with ى); 'gave way'
جَلَدِى: جَلَد + ي — jalad, strength, endurance (m., nom., subject of wahā) + -ī, my (the poet's; the print spells the ending with ى); 'my strength'
تُرِدْ: تُرِدْ — turid, you want (arāda, yurīdu, verb IV, hollow, jussive 2 m. sg. after in, 'if', conditional); 'if you want'
مَوْرِدًا: مَوْرِد + اً — mawrid, watering-place (m., acc., object of turid; from warada, 'to come to water') + -an, indef. acc.; 'a watering-place'
ادمعِي: ادمعِي — admuʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, m.; the print marks only the ʿayn, ادمعِي; gen. after min, 'from') + -ī, my (the poet's); 'my tears'
اتَّسَعَتْ: اتَّسَعَتْ — ittasaʿat, it spread wide (ittasaʿa, verb VIII, perfect 3 f. sg., agreeing with biḥār, plural of a non-person, 'seas'); 'it spread wide'
لِلْوَارِدِينَ: لِـ + الـ + وَارِدِينَ — li-, for (prep.; marks those who benefit) + al-, the + wāridīna, those who come to drink (warada, 'to arrive at water'; active participle, m. pl. gen. after li-); 'for those who come to drink'
بِحَارُ: بِحَار — biḥār, seas (pl. of baḥr, m.; nom., subject of ittasaʿat; first term of idāfa); 'seas (of)'
الدَّمْعِ: الـ + دَّمْع — al-, the + damʿ, tears, weeping (m., gen., second term of idāfa 'seas of weeping'); 'the weeping' Also after gharāʾib: gharāʾibu al-damʿi, 'the strange (unbidden) tears'.
مَدَدِ: مَدَد — madad, supply, reinforcement (m., gen. after fī, 'in'; the seas of tears never run short; spelled with a final kasra for the verse); 'in flood, in full supply'
يَعْشِقُ: يَعْشِقُ — yaʿshiqu, he loves passionately (ʿashiqa, verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., indicative, after lā, 'does not', in man kāna lā yaʿshiqu; the print points the imperfect with kasra, where yaʿshaqu is the usual form); 'he loves'
الْاَجْيَادَ: الـ + أَجْيَادَ — al-, the + ajyād, necks (pl. of jīd, m.; acc., object of yaʿshaqu; a long neck is a mark of beauty); 'the necks'
وَالْحُدَقَ: وَ + الـ + حُدَقَ — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥadaq, dark of the eye, eyes (pl. of ḥadaqa; acc., coordinated with al-ajyād); 'and the eyes'
ادَّعَى: ادَّعَى — iddaʿā, he claimed (daʿā; iddaʿā, verb VIII, final-weak, perfect 3 m. sg.; object ladhdhata al-dunyā, 'the pleasure of the world'); 'he claimed'
يُدْرِكُهُ: يُدْرِكُ + هُ — yudriku, he grasps (adraka, yudriku, verb IV, imperfect 3 m. sg., indicative, after laysa, 'not') + -hu, it (the meaning in love); 'he grasps it'
عَشِقَ: عَشِقَ — ʿashiqa, he loved (ʿashiqa, yaʿshaqu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., relative clause after man, 'whoever'); 'loved'
خَفَّفَ: خَفَّفَ — khaffafa, he lightened, eased (khaffafa, verb II, perfect 3 m. sg., subject Allāh; lā with the past tense makes a wish, 'may God not ease'); 'may (God) not ease'
صَبَابَتَهُ: صَبَابَة + هُ — ṣabāba, longing, ardour (f., acc., object of khaffafa) + -hu, its, his (the heart's); 'its longing'
هَوَيْتُ: هَوَيْتُ — hawaytu, I love (hawiya, yahwā, verb I, final-weak, perfect 1cs, the poet, after bi-man, 'for the one who'); 'I love'
جَفْنِيَ: جَفْن + ِي — jafn, eyelid (m., gen. after ʿan, 'from') + -iya, my (the poet's; the ya is voweled before al-araqa); 'my eyelid'
الْاَرَقَ: الـ + أَرَقَ — al-, the + araq, sleeplessness, waking (m., acc., object of khaffafa, parallel to ṣabābatahu); 'the wakefulness'
زَعَمَ: زَعَمَ — zaʿama, he claimed, held (zaʿama, yazʿumu, verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., subject Ibn Sīnā, i.e. Avicenna, the physician and philosopher; introduces anna, 'that'); 'he claimed'
اُصُولِ: أُصُول — uṣūl, principles, foundations (pl. of aṣl, m.; gen. after fī, 'in'; the print writes the initial hamza without its seat as اُصُول); 'principles (of)'
دَوَاؤُهُ: دَوَاؤ + هُ — dawāʾ, medicine, cure (m., nom., subject of the clause, with al-alḥān as predicate) + -hu, his (the lover's); 'his cure'
الْاَلْحَانُ: الـ + أَلْحَان — al-, the + alḥān, melodies, music (pl. of laḥn, m.; nom., predicate: 'his cure is music'); 'the melodies'
وَوِصَالُ: وَ + وِصَالُ — wa-, and + wiṣāl, union, meeting (m., verbal noun of III wāṣala; nom., coordinated with al-alḥān; first term of idāfa 'union with one like'); 'and union (with)'
وَالنُّقْلُ: وَ + الـ + نُّقْلُ — wa-, and + al-, the + nuql, sweetmeats (dried fruit and nuts taken with wine; m., nom., coordinated); 'and the sweetmeats'
وَالْمَشْرُوبُ: وَ + الـ + مَشْرُوبُ — wa-, and + al-, the + mashrūb, the drink, i.e. wine (passive participle of verb I, 'drunk'; nom., coordinated); 'and the drink'
وَالْبُسْتَانُ: وَ + الـ + بُسْتَانُ — wa-, and + al-, the + bustān, garden (m., Persian loan; nom., coordinated); 'and the garden'
فَصَحِبْتُ: فَ + صَحِبْتُ — fa-, so, and so (consequence) + ṣaḥibtu, I accompanied, took as a companion (ṣaḥiba, yaṣḥabu, verb I, perfect 1cs, the poet; object ghayraka, 'one other than you'); 'so I took'
لِلتَّدَاوِي: لِـ + الـ + تَّدَاوِي — li-, for, in order to (prep.; gives the purpose) + al-, the + tadāwī, treating oneself, seeking a cure (verbal noun of tadāwā, verb VI, final-weak, gen. after li-); 'for the cure'
وَاَعَانَنِي: وَ + أَعَانَ + نِي — wa-, and + aʿāna, he helped (ʿāna; aʿāna, verb IV, hollow, perfect 3 m. sg.; subject al-maqdūr, 'fate') + -nī, me (the poet); 'and (it) helped me'
وَالْاِمْكَانُ: وَ + الـ + إِمْكَانُ — wa-, and + al-, the + imkān, possibility, opportunity (m., verbal noun of verb IV; nom., coordinated with al-maqdūru as a second subject of aʿānanī); 'and the opportunity'
دَاءٌ: دَاءٌ — dāʾ, disease, illness (m., nom. indef., predicate of anna al-ḥubba, 'love is a disease'); 'a disease'
طِبُّهُ: طِبّ + هُ — ṭibb, medicine, physic (m., nom., subject of the last clause: 'Ibn Sīnā, his physic is raving') + -hu, his (Ibn Sīnā's); 'his medicine'
هَذَيَانُ: هَذَيَان — hadhayān, raving, delirium (m., nom., predicate, with a final -u for the rhyme; 'his physic is raving', i.e. nonsense against love); 'raving'
فَصَاحَتِهِ: فَصَاحَة + هِ — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., verbal noun of faṣuḥa; gen. after min, 'at', cause of the marvelling) + -hi, his (ʿAzīz's, the speaker of the verses); 'at his eloquence'
رِوَايَتِهِ: رِوَايَتِ + هِ — riwāyat-, delivery, recitation (riwāya, f., gen. as second term of the construct after ḥusn) + -hi, his (ʿAzīz's); 'his delivery'
أَزَلْتَ: أَزَلْتَ — azalta, you removed (azāla, yuzīlu, verb IV, perfect 2 m. sg., with qad, 'have'; governs ʿan, from) ; 'you have removed'
لِلْمُتَقَدِّمِينَ: لِـ + الْمُتَقَدِّمِينَ — li-, for, to (prep., with waqaʿa, 'befall to') + al-, the + mutaqaddimīna, those who went before, the ancients (m. pl., participle of verb V, gen. after li-); 'to the former ones'; also li- of authorship after kutub: kutuban li-al-mutaqaddimīna, 'books by the ancients'
يَحْضُرُكَ: يَحْضُرُ + كَ — yaḥḍuru, is present, comes (ḥaḍara, yaḥḍuru, verb I, imperfect 3 m. sg.; here 'comes to mind', after in kāna) + -ka, you (acc., object); 'comes to you'
جِنْسِ: جِنْس — jinsi, kind, sort (jins, m., gen. after min, 'of'); 'of the kind (of this)'
فَأَسْمِعْنِي: فَـ + أَسْمِعْ + نِي — fa-, then (apodosis of in, 'if') + asmiʿ, make hear (sammaʿa/asmaʿa, verb IV, imperative 2 m. sg.) + -nī, me (first object, with nūn al-wiqāya); 'then make me hear'
حَضَرَكَ: حَضَرَ + كَ — ḥaḍara, it was present, came (verb I, perfect 3 m. sg., relative clause after mā, 'what') + -ka, you (acc.); 'has come to you'
وَطَوِّلِ: وَ + طَوِّلِ — wa-, and + ṭawwili, lengthen, draw out (ṭawwala, verb II, imperative 2 m. sg., vowelled with kasra before al-); read as an imperative, not ṭūl, 'length', as the unit's note says; 'and lengthen'
فَأَطْرَبَ: فَـ + أَطْرَبَ — fa-, so + aṭraba, he delighted, made merry (verb IV, perfect 3 m. sg.; the vizier, who sang; the following bi-, 'with', marks what he delighted with); 'so he delighted'
وَصْلَكَ: وَصْلَ + كَ — waṣla, union, joining, meeting (waṣl, m., acc. as subject of anna) + -ka, you (gen., possessor); 'union with you'
بِكَرَائِمِ: بِـ + كَرَائِمِ — bi-, with, at the price of (prep., instrument of payment with yushtarā, 'is bought') + karāʾimi, the noblest, choicest (pl. of karīma, f., gen. as first term of a construct); 'with the noblest (of)'
الْاَمْوَالِ: الـ + أَمْوَالِ — al-, the + amwāli, riches, wealth (pl. of māl, m., gen. as second term of the construct); printed with alif without hamza (الاموال); 'the riches'
وَالْاَشْبَاحِ: وَ + الـ + أَشْبَاحِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ashbāḥi, forms, bodies, persons (pl. of shabaḥ, m., gen., coordinated with al-amwāl; here lives given as the price); printed without hamza; 'and the bodies'
حُبَّكَ: حُبَّ + كَ — ḥubba, love (ḥubb, m., acc. as subject of anna) + -ka, you (gen., possessor); 'your love'
دَيِّنٌ: دَيِّنٌ — dayyinun, as printed: damaged type; read as 'pious' or 'in debt', which makes little sense, so perhaps a broken hayyin, 'easy' (m., nom., predicate of anna), the reading our English follows; 'easy' (doubtful)
نَفَائِسُ: نَفَائِسُ — nafāʾisu, precious things, treasures (pl. of nafīsa, f., nom., subject, in a line partly lost in the damaged type); 'the precious things (of)'
الْاَرْبَاحِ: الـ + أَرْبَاحِ — al-, the + arbāḥi, profits, gains (pl. of ribḥ, m., gen. as second term of the construct); printed without hamza; 'the profits'
رَاَيْتُكَ: رَأَيْتُ + كَ — raʾaytu, I saw (raʾā, yarā, verb I, perfect 1 cs; printed without hamza, رَاَيْتُ) + -ka, you (acc.); 'I saw you'
تَجْتَنِي: تَجْتَنِي — tajtanī, you pluck, gather (ijtanā, yajtanī, verb VIII, final-weak, imperfect 2 m. sg., indicative, after raʾaytuka as a circumstantial); 'you pluck'
وَتَخُصُّ: وَ + تَخُصُّ — wa-, and + takhuṣṣu, you single out, set apart (khaṣṣa, yakhuṣṣu, verb I, doubled, imperfect 2 m. sg.; its object is lost in the damaged type); 'and you single out'
الْاَمْنَاحِ: الـ + أَمْنَاح — al-, the + amnāḥ, gifts (an unusual plural of minḥa, f.; possibly misread, per the note; printed without hamza); 'the gifts' (doubtful)
اَنَّكَ: أَنَّ + كَ — anna, that (particle, introducing a noun clause, governs the accusative; the verb before it, partly lost, is probably 'I knew'; printed without hamza) + -ka, you (acc., subject of anna); 'that you'; also after min ʿajabi al-ayyāmi, 'among the wonders of the days (is) that you …' (Night 201)
تُنَالُ: تُنَالُ — tunālu, you are attained, won (nāla, yanālu, verb I, hollow, passive imperfect 2 m. sg., indicative after lā; the following bi-ḥīlatin, 'by a trick', gives the means); 'you are won'
وَلَوَيْتُ: وَ + لَوَيْتُ — wa-, and + lawaytu, I turned, twisted (lawā, yalwī, verb I, final-weak, perfect 1 cs); 'and I turned'
جَنَاحِيْ: جَنَاحِيْ — janāḥī, my wing (janāḥ, m., + -ī, my; the print writes the final yā with a sukūn, جَنَاحِيْ); 'my wing'
وَجَعَلْتَ: وَ + جَعَلْتَ — wa-, and + jaʿalta, you made, set (jaʿala, yajʿalu, verb I, perfect 2 m. sg.; with bī, 'in me', as the place, and a nest as the thing made); 'and you made'
عُشِّ: عُشِّ — ʿushshi, nest (ʿushsh, m., gen., apparently as first term of a construct whose second word is lost in the damaged type); 'a nest (of)'
قَاسِمِي: قَاسِمِي — qāsimī, my sharer (qāsim, active participle of qasama, verb I, 'to divide, share' + -ī, my; in the construct with the lost word; qāsimī is a guess at the sense, per the note); 'my sharer' (doubtful)
غُدُوِّي: غُدُوِّ + ي — ghuduwwi, going out at morning (ghuduww, m., nom., subject of the clause fīhi ghuduwwī) + -ī, my; with rawāḥ, the whole round of the day; 'my going out in the morning'
وَرَوَاحِي: وَ + رَوَاحِ + ي — wa-, and + rawāḥi, going in the evening, coming home (rawāḥ, m., nom., coordinated with ghuduwwī) + -ī, my; 'and my coming home at evening'
انْقَطَعَتْ: انْقَطَعَتْ — inqaṭaʿat, she was cut off, kept apart (inqaṭaʿa, verb VII, perfect 3 f. sg., after fa-innahā, 'and indeed she'; the old woman, who stayed in her house); 'she cut herself off, she kept to'
لَاتَخْرُجُ: لَا + تَخْرُجُ — lā, not (negative; the print runs it together with the verb, لاتخرج) + takhruju, she goes out (kharaja, yakhruju, verb I, imperfect 3 f. sg., indicative; the king's daughter Dunyā; with illā bi-, 'except with'); 'she does not go out'
وَصَالَحَتْهَا: وَ + صَالَحَ + تْ + هَا — wa-, and + ṣāliḥat, she made peace (ṣālaḥa, yuṣāliḥu, verb III, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā) + -hā, her (the old woman, acc.); 'and made peace with her'
خَاطِرَهَا: خَاطِرَ + هَا — khāṭira, mind, feelings (khāṭir, m., acc., object of ṭayyabat, 'she sweetened') + -hā, her (the old woman's); 'her mind'
لِأَتَفَرَّجَ: لِـ + أَتَفَرَّجَ — li-, in order to, so that (particle of purpose, with the subjunctive) + atafarraja, I take pleasure, gaze (tafarraja, verb V, subjunctive 1 cs; with ʿalā, 'at'); 'to gaze with pleasure'
أَشْجَارِهِ: أَشْجَارِ + هِ — ashjāri, trees (pl. of shajar/shajara, gen. after ʿalā, 'on') + -hi, its (the garden's); 'its trees'
وَأَثْمَارِهِ: وَ + أَثْمَارِ + هِ — wa-, and + athmāri, fruits (pl. of thamar, m., gen., coordinated with ashjārihi) + -hi, its; 'and its fruits'
بِأَزْهَارِهِ: بِـ + أَزْهَارِ + هِ — bi-, by, with (prep., of cause: her heart is gladdened by) + azhāri, flowers (pl. of zahr, m., gen. after bi-) + -hi, its (the garden's); 'by its flowers'
وَأَلْبَسَ: وَ + أَلْبَسَ — wa-, and + albasa, I put on, wear (labisa, yalbasu, verb I, subjunctive 1 cs, after an, 'that', coordinated with adhhaba; the old woman speaking; the object athwābī, 'my garments', follows); 'and (that) I put on'
وَأَحْضُرَ: وَ + أَحْضُرَ — wa-, and + aḥḍura, I come, am present (ḥaḍara, yaḥḍuru, verb I, subjunctive 1 cs after an, coordinated; with ʿindaki, 'with you'); 'and (that) I come'
تَأَخَّرِي: تَأَخَّرِي — taʾakhkharī, you be late, lag (for tataʾakhkharī with one ta- dropped, as the note says; verb V, jussive 2 f. sg., after lā, with the -na dropped; Dunyā speaking to the old woman); 'do not be late'
أَثْوَابِكَ: أَثْوَابِ + كَ — athwābi, garments (pl. of thawb, m., gen., second term after afkhara, 'finest of') + -ka, your (Tāj al-Mulūk's); 'of your garments'
الْبُسْتَانِيِّ: الـ + بُسْتَانِيِّ — al-, the + bustāniyyi, the gardener (bustānī, m., relative adjective from bustān, 'garden', gen. after ʿalā; the person Tāj al-Mulūk is to go in to; he is also called al-khawlī); 'the gardener'
إِشَارَةً: إِشَارَةً — ishāratan, a signal (ishāra, f., acc. indefinite, object of jaʿalat, 'she made'; between the old woman and Tāj al-Mulūk); 'a signal'
ذَهَابِهَا: ذَهَابِ + هَا — dhahābi, going (dhahāb, verbal noun of dhahaba, m., gen. after baʿda, 'after') + -hā, her (the old woman's); 'her going'
وَأَلْبَسَا: وَ + أَلْبَسَ + ا — wa-, and + albasā, they dressed, clothed (labisa, verb IV albasa, perfect 3 m. dual, the vizier and ʿAzīz; takes two objects, Tāj al-Mulūk and badlatan, 'a suit'; the -ā is the dual); 'and the two dressed'
وَشَدَّا: وَ + شَدَّ + ا — wa-, and + shaddā, the two bound, fastened (shadda, yashuddu, verb I, doubled, perfect 3 m. dual: the vizier and ʿAzīz); 'and the two fastened'
حِيَاصَةً: حِيَاصَةً — ḥiyāṣatan, a belt, girdle (ḥiyāṣa, f., acc. indefinite, object of shaddā; golden, set with jewels); 'a girdle'
بِالتَّعْظِيمِ: بِـ + الـ + تَّعْظِيمِ — bi-, with (prep., of manner: qābalahu bi-, 'he met him with') + al-, the + taʿẓīm, magnifying, showing great respect (verbal noun of verb II, m., gen. after bi-); 'with the magnifying'
وَتَفَرَّجْ: وَ + تَفَرَّجْ — wa-, and + tafarraj, take your pleasure, enjoy (tafarraja, verb V, imperative 2 m. sg.; the gardener to Tāj al-Mulūk); 'and enjoy'
يَعْلَمِ: يَعْلَمِ — yaʿlami, he knows (ʿalima, yaʿlamu, verb I, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, with a kasra before al-bustāniyyu, 'the gardener'); 'he did not know'
ضَجَّةً: ضَجَّةً — ḍajjatan, a clamour, commotion (ḍajja, f., acc. indefinite, object of samiʿa, 'he heard'); 'a clamour'
بِمَجِيئِهَا: بِـ + مَجِيءِ + هَا — bi-, of (prep., chosen by the verb aʿlamahu bi-, 'he informed him of') + majīʾi, coming (majīʾ, verbal noun of jāʾa, m., gen. after bi-) + -hā, her (the princess's); 'of her coming'
أَخْتَفِي: أَخْتَفِي — akhtafī, I hide myself (ikhtafā, yakhtafī, verb VIII, final-weak, imperfect 1 cs, indicative, after fa-innī, 'for I'; Tāj al-Mulūk speaking); 'I will hide'
مَوَاضِعِ: مَوَاضِعِ — mawāḍiʿi, places, spots (pl. of mawḍiʿ, m., gen. as second term after baʿḍi, 'some of'; the garden's); 'places (of)'
بِغَايَةِ: بِـ + غَايَةِ — bi-, with (prep., awṣāhu bi-, 'he enjoined him', so bi- marks what is urged) + ghāyati, the extreme, utmost (ghāya, f., gen. after bi-, first term of a construct); 'with the utmost of'
الِاخْتِفَاءِ: الِـ + اخْتِفَاءِ — al-, the + ikhtifāʾi, hiding, concealing oneself (verbal noun of ikhtafā, verb VIII, m., gen. as second term of the construct); 'the hiding'
وَجَوَارِيهَا: وَ + جَوَارِي + هَا — wa-, and + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya, f., nom., coordinated with bintu al-maliki, 'the king's daughter') + -hā, her (Dunyā's); 'and her slave-girls'
نَنَلْ: نَنَلْ — nanal, we attain (nāla, yanālu, verb I, hollow, 1 pl.; the text's own short, jussive shape after lā, though plain lā normally takes the indicative, as the note says; the old woman speaking of herself and Dunyā); 'we will not attain'
مَقْصُودَنَا: مَقْصُودَ + نَا — maqṣūda, aim, thing sought (maqṣūd, passive participle of qaṣada, m., acc., object of nanal) + -nā, our; 'our aim'
لِقَلْبِكِ: لِـ + قَلْبِ + كِ — li-, for (prep., of benefit: rest for your heart) + qalbi, heart (qalb, m., gen. after li-) + -ki, your (f., Dunyā's); 'for your heart'
يَاسَيِّدَتِى: يَا + سَيِّدَتِ + ى — yā, O (vocative particle; the print runs it together with the noun) + sayyidatī, my lady (sayyida, f., + -ī, my; the print spells the final yā with ى); 'O my lady'
لَاحَاجَةَ: لَا + حَاجَةَ — lā, no (negation of the class, with the accusative, the print runs it together with the noun) + ḥājata, need (ḥāja, f., acc. without tanwīn after lā; the construction ḥāja bi-, 'need of'); 'no need'
صَدْرُكِ: صَدْرُ + كِ — ṣadru, breast, chest (ṣadr, m., nom., subject of yansharihu; inshirāḥ al-ṣadr is ease, gladness) + -ki, your (f.); 'your breast'
مَادَامُوا: مَا + دَامُوا — mā, as long as (temporal particle) + dāmū, they remain, continue (dāma, yadūmu, verb I, hollow, perfect 3 m. pl.; the servants; the print runs it together, ماداموا); 'as long as they are'
فَاصْرِفِيهِمْ: فَـ + اصْرِفِي + هِمْ — fa-, so (consequence) + iṣrifī, send away, dismiss (ṣarafa, yaṣrifu, verb I, imperative 2 f. sg.; Dunyā) + -him, them (m. pl., the servants, object); 'so send them away'
صَرَفَتْهُمْ: صَرَفَ + تْ + هُمْ — ṣarafat, she sent away (ṣarafa, verb I, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā) + -hum, them (m. pl., the servants and slave-girls); 'she sent them away'
تَمَشَّتْ: تَمَشَّتْ — tamashshat, she strolled, walked about (tamashshā, verb V, final-weak, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā); 'she strolled'
يُغْشَى: يُغْشَى — yughshā, he is covered over (ghashiya/ghashā, verb I, passive imperfect 3 m. sg., impersonal passive with ʿalayhi, 'over him': he faints; after kullamā the text has the imperfect where Classical prose would use the perfect: Middle Arabic, per the note); 'he swooned'
بَارِعِ: بَارِعِ — bāriʿi, surpassing, excelling (bāriʿ, active participle of baraʿa, m., gen. as first term of the construct bāriʿi ḥusnihā, 'surpassing (of) her beauty', after min, 'of'); 'surpassing'
تُسَارِقُهَا: تُسَارِقُ + هَا — tusāriqu, she steals along, draws along (sāraqa, yusāriqu, verb III, imperfect 3 f. sg., after ṣārati, 'she began'; the old woman) + -hā, her (Dunyā, acc.); 'she steals her along'
أَوْصَلَتْهَا: أَوْصَلَ + تْ + هَا — awṣalat, she brought, led (awṣala, yūṣilu, verb IV, perfect 3 f. sg.; the old woman, after ilā an, 'until') + -hā, her (Dunyā, acc.); 'she brought her'
بِنَقْشِهِ: بِـ + نَقْشِ + هِ — bi-, of, to (prep., chosen by amara bi-, 'to order') + naqshi, painting, decorating (naqsh, verbal noun of naqasha, m., gen. after bi-) + -hi, it (the pavilion); 'to paint it, the painting of it'
وَتَفَرَّجَتْ: وَ + تَفَرَّجَ + تْ — wa-, and + tafarrajat, she took pleasure, gazed (tafarraja, verb V, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā; with ʿalā, 'at', the painting); 'and she gazed with pleasure'
وَأَبْصَرَتِ: وَ + أَبْصَرَ + تِ — wa-, and + abṣarat, she saw, caught sight of (abṣara, yubṣiru, verb IV, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā; the final -ti has kasra before al-); 'and she saw'
الطُّيُورَ: الـ + طُّيُورَ — al-, the + ṭuyūra, birds (pl. of ṭayr, m., acc., object of abṣarat); 'the birds'
وَالْحَمَامَ: وَ + الـ + حَمَامَ — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥamāma, doves (ḥamām, collective, m., acc., coordinated with al-ṭuyūra); the dream's doves; 'and the doves'
صِفَّةُ: صِفَّةُ — ṣiffatu, description, likeness (ṣifa, f., nom., predicate of inna hādhihi, 'this is'; the print sets a shadda on the fāʾ which no reading needs, so we read ṣifa, per the note); 'the likeness (of)'
صُوَرِ: صُوَرِ — ṣuwari, pictures, images (pl. of ṣūra, f., gen. after ilā, 'at', first term of the construct 'pictures of the birds'); 'pictures (of)'
وَالصَّيَّادِ: وَ + الـ + صَّيَّادِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ṣayyādi, hunter, fowler (ṣayyād, intensive form of ṣāda, m., gen., coordinated with al-ṭuyūri); 'and the hunter'
وَالشَّرَكِ: وَ + الـ + شَّرَكِ — wa-, and + al-, the + sharaki, snare, net (sharak, m., gen., coordinated); 'and the net'
وَتَتَعَجَّبُ: وَ + تَتَعَجَّبُ — wa-, and + tataʿajjabu, she marvels (taʿajjaba, verb V, imperfect 3 f. sg., indicative, a second verb after ṣārat, 'she began'; Dunyā); 'and marvelling'
أَلُومُ: أَلُومُ — alūmu, I blame (lāma, yalūmu, verb I, hollow, imperfect 1 cs, indicative, after kuntu, 'I was, used to'); 'I used to blame'
وَأُبْغِضُهُمْ: وَ + أُبْغِضُ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ubghiḍu, I hate (abghaḍa, verb IV, imperfect 1 cs) + -hum, them (the men, m. pl., object); 'and I hated them'
انْظُرِى: انْظُرِى — unẓurī, look (naẓara, yanẓuru, verb I, imperative 2 f. sg., addressed to the old woman, Dunyā's dāda; the print spells the final yā with ى); 'look'
ذُبِحَتِ: ذُبِحَتِ — dhubiḥat, she was slaughtered (dhabaḥa, yadhbaḥu, verb I, passive perfect 3 f. sg.; the print's ذبحت could be dhabaḥat, 'she slaughtered', but the fowler is a man, so we take it as the passive, per the note; final -ti with kasra before al-); 'was slaughtered'
الطَّيْرَةُ: الـ + طَّيْرَةُ — al-, the + ṭayratu, bird (ṭayra, f., nom., subject of dhubiḥat; a feminine of ṭayr, colloquial, per the note; it is the female dove); 'the bird'
وَيُخَلِّصَهَا: وَ + يُخَلِّصَ + هَا — wa-, and + yukhalliṣa, he frees, rescues (khallaṣa, verb II, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; the male dove) + -hā, her (the female, acc.); 'and (that he) free her'
الْجَارِحُ: الـ + جَارِحُ — al-, the + jāriḥu, bird of prey, predator (jāriḥ, active participle of jaraḥa, m., nom., subject of qābalahu); 'the bird of prey'
وَافْتَرَسَهُ: وَ + افْتَرَسَ + هُ — wa-, and + iftarasa, he seized and tore (farasa, verb VIII iftarasa, perfect 3 m. sg.; the bird of prey) + -hu, him (the male dove); 'and tore him to pieces'
تَتَجَادَلُ: تَتَجَادَلُ — tatajādalu, she disputes, argues (tajādala, verb VI, imperfect 3 f. sg., indicative, after ṣārati, 'began'; the old woman; with ʿalā, 'at', a doubtful sense, per the note: she kept arguing at Dunyā, pressing her case for men); 'she kept arguing' (doubtful)
وَتُشَاغِلُهَا: وَ + تُشَاغِلُ + هَا — wa-, and + tushāghilu, she occupies, keeps busy (shāghala, yushāghilu, verb III, imperfect 3 f. sg.; the old woman) + -hā, her (Dunyā, acc.); 'and keeping her occupied'
بِالْحَدِيثِ: بِـ + الـ + حَدِيثِ — bi-, with (prep., of means: occupying her with) + al-, the + ḥadīth, talk, conversation (m., gen. after bi-); 'with talk' Also after bādara, 'to be quick (to someone) with', bi- marks what is brought out: al-mubādarata lahum bi-al-ḥadīthi, 'telling them the story straight out'.
قَرُبَتَا: قَرُبَتَا — qarubatā, they two drew near (qaruba, yaqrubu, verb I, perfect 3 f. dual; the old woman and Dunyā; -tā is the feminine dual ending; takes min, 'to/from' the place); 'the two of them came near'
الْمُخْتَفِي: الـ + مُخْتَفِي — al-, the + mukhtafī, hiding, one who hides (active participle of ikhtafā, verb VIII, final-weak, m., gen. agreeing with al-makān, 'the place'; it takes Tāj al-Mulūk as its subject, per the note); 'where (he) lay hidden'
يَتَمَشَّى: يَتَمَشَّى — yatamashshā, he strolls (tamashshā, verb V, final-weak, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after an, 'that'; Tāj al-Mulūk; the old woman signalled that he stroll); 'that he stroll'
فَرَأَتْهُ: فَـ + رَأَى + تْ + هُ — fa-, and so + raʾat, she saw (raʾā, yarā, verb I, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā) + -hu, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, acc.); 'and she saw him'
وَتَأَمَّلَتْ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ + تْ — wa-, and + taʾammalat, she contemplated, looked long at (taʾammala, verb V, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā); 'and she contemplated'; here: Budūr
جَمَالَهُ: جَمَالَ + هُ — jamāla, beauty, comeliness (jamāl, m., acc., object of taʾammalat) + -hu, his (Tāj al-Mulūk's); 'his beauty'
وَقَدَّهُ: وَ + قَدَّ + هُ — wa-, and + qadda, stature, height, figure (qadd, m., acc., coordinated with jamālahu) + -hu, his; 'and his stature'
النِّهَايَةَ: الـ + نِّهَايَةَ — al-, the + nihāyata, the utmost, the end (nihāya, f., acc., object of balagha, 'he reached', the extreme of beauty; rhymes with al-ghāya); 'the utmost'
الْغَايَةَ: الـ + غَايَةَ — al-, the + ghāyata, the farthest limit, the end (ghāya, f., acc., object of balagha, understood; rhymes with al-nihāya); 'the farthest limit'
فَهَامَتْ: فَـ + هَامَ + تْ — fa-, and so + hāmat, she became madly in love (hāma, yahīmu, verb I, hollow, perfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā; with bi-, 'with', marking the beloved, here bihi, 'with him'); 'and she fell madly in love'
عُرَى: عُرَى — ʿurā, loops, fastenings (pl. of ʿurwa, f., nom., subject of inḥallat; first term of the construct ʿurā ʿazāʾimihā, 'the fastenings of her resolves', her resolutions coming unbuttoned); 'the loops (of)'
عَزَائِمِهَا: عَزَائِمِ + هَا — ʿazāʾimi, resolves, resolutions (pl. of ʿazīma, f., gen., second term of the construct) + -hā, her (Dunyā's); 'her resolves'
وَانْبَهَرَ: وَ + انْبَهَرَ — wa-, and + inbahara, it was dazzled, overwhelmed (inbahara, verb VII, perfect 3 m. sg.; its subject is ʿaqluhā, 'her mind'); 'and was dazzled'
وَقَدِّةِ: وَ + قَدِّ + ةِ — wa-, and + qaddi, stature (qadd, m., gen., coordinated after min, 'by') + -hi, his; the print spells the pronoun with a final tāʾ marbūṭa (قدة) and we read -hi, per the note; 'and his stature'
الْتَهَبَتْ: الْتَهَبَتْ — iltahabat, it blazed (iltahaba, verb VIII, perfect 3 f. sg., agreeing with nāru al-gharāmi, 'the fire of passion', which follows; bihi, 'in him', bi- of place); 'blazed'
يَقِفْ: يَقِفْ — yaqif, he stops (waqafa, yaqifu, verb I, assimilated, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam; Tāj al-Mulūk); 'he did not stop'
بِتَاجِ: بِـ + تَاجِ — bi-, in (prep., of place, with hāja, 'to surge up in') + tāji, crown (tāj, m., gen. after bi-; first term of the proper name Tāj al-Mulūk, the prince); 'in Tāj (al-Mulūk)'. Also bi-, with (prep., of the instrument, after tawwaja, 'to crown') + tāj, crown (m., gen.; first term of the construct): tawwajahu bi-tāji al-kamāli, 'crowned him with the crown of perfection'.
يُخَالِفِ: يُخَالِفِ — yukhālifi, he goes against, disobeys (khālafa, yukhālifu, verb III, jussive 3 m. sg. after lam, with a kasra before al-ʿajūza, 'the old woman'); 'he did not go against'
يُصَبِّرَانِهِ: يُصَبِّرَ + انِ + هِ — yuṣabbirāni, they two make patient, console (ṣabbara, verb II, imperfect 3 m. dual; the vizier and ʿAzīz; with ṣārā, 'they began') + -hi, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, acc.); 'consoling him'
رُجُوعِكَ: رُجُوعِ + كَ — rujūʿi, returning (rujūʿ, verbal noun of rajaʿa, m., gen. after fī, 'in') + -ka, your (Tāj al-Mulūk's); 'your returning'
مَصْلَحَةً: مَصْلَحَةً — maṣlaḥatan, a benefit, good (maṣlaḥa, f., acc. indefinite, after anna fī rujūʿika, 'that in your returning (is)'); 'a benefit'
الرَّجِيمِ: الـ + رَّجِيمِ — al-, the + rajīmi, stoned, accursed (rajīm, passive sense, m., gen., adjective of al-shayṭān, 'Satan'); 'the accursed'
عِشْقِهِ: عِشْقِ + هِ — ʿishqi, passionate love (ʿishq, m., gen. after min, 'from') + -hi, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, objective genitive: love of him); 'love of him'
وْجَالُ: الْاَ وْجَالُ — as printed: the print sets الا وجال as two words and we read it as one, al-awjālu, 'the fears, alarms' (pl. of wajal, nom., subject of ḥallat); the reading is not certain, per the note; this fragment is the wāw-initial second half, وْجَالُ; 'alarms' (doubtful)
لِشَبَابِكِ: لِـ + شَبَابِ + كِ — li-, for (prep.: what he is fit for) + shabābi, youth (shabāb, m., gen. after li-) + -ki, your (Dunyā's); 'for your youth'
إِلَّاهُوَ: إِلَّا + هُوَ — illā, except (particle of exception) + huwa, he (independent pronoun, nom., the subject of yaṣluḥu; the print runs it together, الاهو); 'except him'
أَسْعِفِينِي: أَسْعِفِ + ي + نِي — asʿifī, succour, help (asʿafa, yusʿifu, verb IV, imperative 2 f. sg.; Dunyā to the old woman) + -nī, me (acc., object, with nūn al-wiqāya); 'help me'
وَخِلْعَةٌ: وَ + خِلْعَةٌ — wa-, and + khilʿatun, a robe of honour (khilʿa, f., nom. indefinite, coordinated with alfu dīnārin; the pair is Dunyā's reward; the bi-alfi dīnārin that follows is bi- of price); 'and a robe of honour'
تُسْعِفِينِي: تُسْعِفِي + نِي — tusʿifī, you help (asʿafa, verb IV, jussive 2 f. sg. after lam, the -na dropped as in every jussive) + -nī, me; 'you do not help me'
بِوِصَالِهِ: بِـ + وِصَالِ + هِ — bi-, with, to (prep., marks what the help consists in) + wiṣāli, union, joining (wiṣāl, m., gen. after bi-) + -hi, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, objective: union with him); 'with union with him'
اجْتِمَاعِكُمَا: اجْتِمَاعِ + كُمَا — ijtimāʿi, meeting together (ijtimāʿ, verbal noun of verb VIII, m., gen. after fī, 'for') + -kumā, you two (dual, Dunyā and Tāj al-Mulūk); 'your meeting-together'
وَأَبْذُلُ: وَ + أَبْذُلُ — wa-, and + abdhulu, I spend, give up (badhala, yabdhulu, verb I, imperfect 1 cs, indicative; the old woman; its object is rūḥī, 'my soul'); 'and I will spend'
مَرْضَاتِكُمَا: مَرْضَاتِ + كُمَا — marḍāti, pleasing, satisfaction (marḍāt, verbal noun of raḍiya, f., gen. after fī, 'in') + -kumā, you two (dual); 'your pleasing'
بِإِعْزَازٍ: بِـ + إِعْزَازٍ — bi-, with (prep., of manner: qābalahā bi-, 'he met her with') + iʿzāzin, esteem, honouring (iʿzāz, verbal noun of verb IV, m., gen. indefinite after bi-); 'with esteem'
وَإِكْرَامٍ: وَ + إِكْرَامٍ — wa-, and + ikrāmin, honour (ikrām, verbal noun of verb IV, m., gen. indefinite, coordinated; the pair rhymes with al-aqdām); 'and honour'
الِاجْتِمَاعُ: الِـ + اجْتِمَاعُ — al-, the + ijtimāʿu, the meeting (ijtimāʿ, verbal noun of verb VIII, m., nom., subject of yakūnu, 'will be'); 'the meeting'
وَحُلَّةً: وَ + حُلَّةً — wa-, and + ḥullatan, a robe, suit of clothes (ḥulla, f., acc. indefinite, second object of aʿṭāhā; the print marks the shadda; the bi-alfi dīnārin after it is bi- of price); 'and a robe'
وَتَمَايَلْ: وَ + تَمَايَلْ — wa-, and + tamāyal, sway (tamāyala, verb VI, imperative 2 m. sg.; the print points it itself, so it is read as an imperative: he is to walk like a woman); 'and sway'
خَطَوَاتِكَ: خَطَوَاتِ + كَ — khaṭawāti, steps, paces (pl. of khaṭwa, f., gen. after fī, 'in') + -ka, your (Tāj al-Mulūk's); 'your steps'
تَسْتَعْجِلْ: تَسْتَعْجِلْ — tastaʿjil, you hurry (istaʿjala, yastaʿjilu, verb X, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā, prohibition); 'do not hurry'
تَلْتَفِتْ: تَلْتَفِتْ — taltafit, you turn round (iltafata, yaltafitu, verb VIII, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā, prohibition; with ilā, 'to', whoever speaks to him); 'do not turn'
أَوْصَتْ: أَوْصَتْ — awṣat, she charged, enjoined (awṣā, yūṣī, verb IV, final-weak, perfect 3 f. sg., after baʿda an, 'after that'; the old woman; the verb takes bi-, 'with', the thing charged, here bi-hādhihi al-waṣiyyati, 'with this charge'); 'she had charged'
تُعَلِّمُهُ: تُعَلِّمُ + هُ — tuʿallimu, she teaches, coaches (ʿallama, verb II, imperfect 3 f. sg., after ṣārat, 'she began'; the old woman) + -hu, him (Tāj al-Mulūk, acc.); 'teaching him'
وَتُجَسِّرُهُ: وَ + تُجَسِّرُ + هُ — wa-, and + tujassiru, she emboldens (jassara, verb II, imperfect 3 f. sg.) + -hu, him (Tāj al-Mulūk); 'and emboldening him'
يَفْزَعَ: يَفْزَعَ — yafzaʿa, he takes fright (fazaʿa, yafzaʿu, verb I, subjunctive 3 m. sg. after ḥattā lā, 'so that not'; Tāj al-Mulūk); 'that he take fright'
تَخْتَرِقُ: تَخْتَرِقُ — takhtariqu, she passes through, threads her way (ikhtaraqa, verb VIII, imperfect 3 f. sg., after ṣārat, 'she began'; the old woman); 'passing through'
وَالدَّهَالِيزَ: وَ + الـ + دَّهَالِيزَ — wa-, and + al-, the + dahālīza, passages, vestibules (pl. of dihlīz, m., acc. as object, a word from Persian, per the note); 'and the passages'
زَعَقْتُ: زَعَقْتُ — zaʿaqtu, I shouted (zaʿaqa, yazʿaqu, verb I, perfect 1 cs, after idhā, 'when'; zaʿaqa ʿalā is colloquial, 'to shout at'; the print points it itself; the old woman speaking); 'I shout'
اعْبُرِى: اعْبُرِى — uʿburī, pass through, cross (ʿabara, yaʿburu, verb I, imperative 2 f. sg., said to the 'slave-girl'; feminine because Tāj al-Mulūk plays a slave-girl; the print spells the final yā with ى); 'pass through'
تَتَوَانَ: تَتَوَانَ — tatawāna, you slacken, dawdle (tawānā, yatawānā, verb V, final-weak, jussive 2 m. sg. after lā, with the final vowel dropped; Tāj al-Mulūk); 'do not slacken'
وَهَرْوِلْ: وَ + هَرْوِلْ — wa-, and + harwil, trot, hurry (harwala, quadriliteral, imperative 2 m. sg.; the print points it itself); 'and hurry along'
شِمَالِكَ: شِمَالِ + كَ — shimāli, left side (shimāl, m., gen. after ilā, 'to') + -ka, your; 'your left'
إِيوَانًا: إِيوَانًا — īwānan, a hall open on one side (īwān, m., acc. indefinite, object of tarā, 'you will see'; a word from Persian, per the note); 'a hall'
أَبْوَابٌ: أَبْوَابٌ — abwābun, doors (pl. of bāb, m., nom. indefinite, subject of the clause fīhi abwābun, 'in it doors'); 'doors'
فَعُدَّ: فَـ + عُدَّ — fa-, then (consequence of the preceding imperative) + ʿudda, count (ʿadda, yaʿuddu, verb I, doubled, imperative 2 m. sg.; the print marks the shadda); 'so count'
السَّادِسَ: الـ + سَّادِسَ — al-, the + sādisa, sixth (sādis, ordinal from sitta, m., acc., adjective of al-bāb, 'the door', object of udkhuli); 'the sixth'
تَرُوحِينَ: تَرُوحِ + ينَ — tarūḥīna, you go (rāḥa, yarūḥu, verb I, hollow, imperfect 2 f. sg., indicative; the everyday verb of going; Tāj al-Mulūk asks the old woman, anti, 'you', for emphasis); 'you go, will you be going'
أَتَأَخَّرُ: أَتَأَخَّرُ — ataʾakhkharu, I lag behind, am late (taʾakhkhara, verb V, imperfect 1 cs, indicative, after rubbamā, 'perhaps'; the old woman; with ʿanka, 'behind you'); 'I may lag behind'
وَعَاقَنِى: وَ + عَاقَ + نِى — wa-, and + ʿāqa, he detains, holds up (ʿāqa, yaʿūqu, verb I, hollow, perfect 3 m. sg.; past in form but looking ahead after rubbamā, per the note; its subject is al-khādimu al-kabīru, 'the chief eunuch') + -nī, me (acc.; the print spells it with a final ى); 'and (if) he holds me up'
الْأَشْغَالَ: الـ + أَشْغَالَ — al-, the + ashghāla, works, handicrafts (pl. of shughl, m., acc., object of taʿrifu, 'she knows'; here the skilled handiwork of a slave-girl, such as embroidery); 'the handiworks'
وَتُرِيدُأَنْ: وَ + تُرِيدُ + أَنْ — wa-, and + turīdu, she wants (arāda, yurīdu, verb IV, imperfect 3 f. sg.; Dunyā) + an, that (subjunctive particle; the print runs turīdu an together, وتريدان); 'and wants that'
تَشْتَرِيَهَا: تَشْتَرِيَ + هَا — tashtariya, she buys (ishtarā, yashtarī, verb VIII, final-weak, subjunctive 3 f. sg. after an, 'that'; Dunyā) + -hā, her (the slave-girl, acc.); 'that she buy her'
أُفَتِّشَهُ: أُفَتِّشَ + هُ — ufattisha, I search, inspect (fattasha, yufattishu, verb II, subjunctive 1 cs after ḥattā, 'until'; the eunuch; the print marks the shadda) + -hu, him (whoever enters, acc.); 'until I search him'
أَسْعَي: asʿā — أَسْعِي — saʿā, yasʿā, to strive, run about (verb I, final-weak, imperfect 1cs, after lā azālu, 'I do not cease'; the print spells it with a dotted yāʾ); 'I strive'
أَظْهَرَتِ: أَظْهَرَتِ — aẓharat, she showed (aẓhara, yuẓhiru, verb IV, perf. 3fs; the final -i is a linking vowel before al-); 'she had made a show of'
الْغَضَبَ: الـ + غَضَب — al-, the + ghaḍab, anger (m., acc., object of aẓharat); 'the anger'
وَمُؤَدَّبٌ: و + مُؤَدَّب — wa-, and + muʾaddab, well-mannered (passive participle of verb II, addaba; nom. predicate; the print marks the shadda); 'and well-mannered'
أُعْلِمُهَا: أُعْلِمُ + هَا — uʿlimu, I inform (aʿlama, yuʿlimu, verb IV, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her (the Lady Dunyā, acc.); 'I shall let her know'
وَأُخْبِرُهَا: و + أُخْبِرُ + هَا — wa-, and + ukhbiru, I tell (akhbara, verb IV, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her (acc.); 'and tell her'
تَعَرَّضْتَ: تَعَرَّضْتَ — taʿarraḍta, you accosted, meddled (taʿarraḍa, yataʿarraḍu, verb V, perf. 2ms; takes li-, 'to', marking the one interfered with; the print marks the shadda); 'you interfered with'
زَعَقَتْ: زَعَقَتْ — zaʿaqat, she shouted (zaʿaqa, yazʿaqu, verb I, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'at'; colloquial); 'she shouted'
اعْبُرِي: اُعْبُرِي — uʿburī, pass! (ʿabara, yaʿburu, verb I, imperative 2fs; fem. because she keeps up the disguise of speaking to a slave-girl); 'pass, you (fem.)'
عَدَّ: عَدَّ — ʿadda, he counted (verb I, perf. 3ms, geminate; the print marks the shadda; the subject is Tāj al-Mulūk); 'he counted'
وَتَحَيَّلَتْ: و + تَحَيَّلَتْ — wa-, and + taḥayyalat, she used a ruse (taḥayyala, yataḥayyalu, verb V, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'for', the thing contrived; the print marks the shadda); 'and she contrived'
صَرْفِ: صَرْف — ṣarf, sending away, dismissing (m., verbal noun of ṣarafa, in construct, gen. after ʿalā, 'for', which follows taḥayyala); 'sending away (of)'
الْفَضِيحَةِ: الـ + فَضِيحَة — al-, the + faḍīḥa, scandal, disgrace (f., gen. after min, 'from', in khawfan min, 'fear of'); 'the scandal'
لِلْعَجُوزِكُونِي: لِـ + الْعَجُوز + كُونِي — li-, to (indirect object of qālat) + al-ʿajūz, the old woman (gen.) + kūnī, be! (imperative 2fs of kāna); the print runs the two words together (للعجوزكوني); 'to the old woman: be you'
بَوَّابَةً: بَوَّابَة — bawwāba, door-keeper (f.; the print marks the doubled wāw; acc., predicate of kūnī); 'a door-keeper'
اخْتَلَتْ: اِخْتَلَتْ — ikhtalat, she was alone, in private (ikhtalā, yakhtalī, verb VIII, perf. 3fs, from khalā; the subject is Dunyā, with Tāj al-Mulūk added after); 'she was alone (with him)'
ضَمٍّ: ضَمّ — ḍamm, pressing, hugging (m., verbal noun of ḍamma, gen. after fī, 'in'); '(in) pressing'
وَعِنٰقٍ: و + عِنَاق — wa-, and + ʿināq, embracing (m., verbal noun of ʿānaqa, gen. after fī); the print spells it with a small alif over the nūn (عنٰق); 'and embracing'
وَالْتِفَافِ: و + الْتِفَاف — wa-, and + iltifāf, twining (m., verbal noun of verb VIII iltaffa, gen. in construct with al-sāq); 'and the twining (of leg on leg)'
وَأَغْلَقَتْ: و + أَغْلَقَتْ — wa-, and + aghlaqat, she locked (aghlaqa, yughliqu, verb IV, perf. 3fs; ʿalayhi, 'upon him', she locks him in); 'and she locked'
فَقَضَتْ: فَـ + قَضَتْ — fa-, so, and then + qaḍat, she settled (qaḍā, yaqḍī, verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she settled'
حَوَائِجَهُنَّ: حَوَائِج + هُنَّ — ḥawāʾij, needs, wants (f. broken plural of ḥāja, acc., object of qaḍat) + -hunna, their (fem. pl., the slave-girls); 'their needs'
تُحَدِّثُهُنَّ: تُحَدِّثُ + هُنَّ — tuḥaddithu, she talks with (ḥaddatha, yuḥaddithu, verb II, imperf. 3fs; after ṣārat, 'she began to') + -hunna, them (fem. pl., acc.); 'talking with them'
اخْرُجْنَ: اُخْرُجْنَ — ukhrujna, go out! (kharaja, yakhruju, verb I, imperative 2fpl., addressed to the slave-girls); 'go out (you women)'
أَنْشَرِحَ: أَنْشَرِحَ — anshariḥa, I relax, am at ease (insharaḥa, yanshariḥu, verb VII, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'to'; literally the 'expansion' of the breast); 'that I be at ease'
فَأَغْلَقَتْ: فَـ + أَغْلَقَتْ — fa-, so, and + aghlaqat, she locked (aghlaqa, verb IV, perf. 3fs; ʿalayhimā, 'upon the two of them'); 'so she locked'
وَالسَّيِّدَةِ: و + الـ + سَيِّدَة — wa-, and + al-, the + sayyida, lady (f., gen. after min amri, 'of the affair of', joined to Tāj al-Mulūk); 'and the Lady (Dunyā)'
عَلِمَا: عَلِمَا — ʿalimā, the two knew (ʿalima, yaʿlamu, verb I, perf. 3 dual; the vizier and ʿAzīz, resuming fa-innahumā after the lammā clause); 'the two knew'
أَبَداً: أَبَداً — abadan, ever (adverbial acc., tanwīn; after lā yakhruju, 'he will not come out'; the print sets the tanwīn over the final alif); 'ever'
مُشْكِلٌ: مُشْكِل — mushkil, difficult, problematic (verb IV active participle of ashkala; nom., predicate of inna hādhā al-amra); 'difficult'
نَرْجِعْ: نَرْجِعْ — narjiʿ, we return (rajaʿa, yarjiʿu, verb I, imperf. 1cpl., jussive after in lam, 'if we do not'; ilā abīhi, 'to his father'); 'we return'
وَنُعْلِمْهُ: و + نُعْلِمْ + هُ — wa-, and + nuʿlim, we inform (aʿlama, verb IV, imperf. 1cpl., jussive, in the in-clause) + -hu, him (his father, acc.); 'and let him know'
يَلُومُنَا: يَلُومُ + نَا — yalūmu, he blames (lāma, yalūmu, verb I, hollow, imperf. 3ms) + -nā, us (acc.); with ʿalā dhālika, 'for that'; 'he will blame us'
