تَجَهَّزَا: تَجَهَّزَا — tajahhazā, the two made ready (tajahhaza, yatajahhazu, verb V, perf. 3 dual; the vizier and ʿAzīz; the print marks the shadda); 'the two made ready'
وَالْعَمُودَيْنِ: و + الـ + عَمُودَيْن — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿamūdayn, the two pillars (dual of ʿamūd, gen. after ilā, 'to', in the kingdom's name 'the Green Land and the Two Pillars'); 'and the Two Pillars'
يَقْطَعَانِ: يَقْطَعَانِ — yaqṭaʿāni, cutting, crossing (qaṭaʿa, yaqṭaʿu, verb I, imperf. 3 dual, nom.; after sārā, 'the two went on'); 'cutting (the valleys)'
وَأَخْبَرَاهُ: و + أَخْبَرَا + هُ — wa-, and + akhbarā, the two told (akhbara, verb IV, perf. 3 dual) + -hu, him (the king, acc.); with bi-, 'of', the verb takes bi- before the matter told; 'and they told him'
النَّدَامَةُ: الـ + نَّدَامَة — al-, the + nadāma, regret (f., nom., subject of ishtadda; the verb is masc. before it); 'the regret'
يُنَادَى: يُنَادَى — yunādā, it be proclaimed (nādā, yunādī, verb III, passive imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an, 'that'; the print runs wa-amara an together); with bi-, the verb takes bi- before what is proclaimed; 'that it be proclaimed'
بِالْجِهَادِ: بِـ + الـ + جِهَاد — bi-, for, of (the verb nādā takes bi- before what is announced) + al-, the + jihād, holy war (m., gen.), here a call to arms; 'for the holy war'
بَرَّزَ: بَرَّزَ — barraza, he brought out (verb II, perf. 3ms, of baraza; the print marks the shadda; the king is subject, al-ʿasākir object); 'he brought out'
اجْتَمَعَتِ: اِجْتَمَعَتِ — ijtamaʿat, gathered (ijtamaʿa, yajtamiʿu, verb VIII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with al-juyūsh, 'the armies'; the final -i is a linking vowel before al-); 'gathered'
رَعِيَّتُهُ: رَعِيَّة + هُ — raʿiyya, subjects, flock (f., nom., subject of kānat) + -hu, his (the king's); 'his subjects'
عَدْلِهِ: عَدْل + هِ — ʿadl, justice (m., gen., in construct after li-kathrati, 'for the abundance of') + -hi, his; 'his justice'
وَإِحْسَانِهِ: و + إِحْسَان + هِ — wa-, and + iḥsān, beneficence, kindness (m., verbal noun of aḥsana, gen., after li-kathrati, where li- gives the reason) + -hi, his; 'and his beneficence'
الْأُفُقَ: الـ + أُفُق — al-, the + ufuq, horizon (m., acc., object of sadda, 'blocked'); 'the horizon'
وَلَدِةِ: وَلَد + هِ — walad, son, child (m., gen., in construct after talab, 'search of') + -hi, his (Sulaymān Shāh's); the print writes the pronoun -hi with a final tāʾ marbūṭa (ولدة); 'his son'; also: gen. after taḥwīl and ʿinda, the son of King Shahramān: bi-taḥwīli waladihi, 'the moving of his son' (Night 192)
أَقَامَا: أَقَامَا — aqāmā, the two stayed, remained (aqāma, yuqīmu, verb IV, perf. 3 dual, Tāj al-Mulūk and Dunyā; with ʿalā ḥālihimā, 'in their state'); 'the two remained'
حَالِهِمَا: حَال + هِمَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen., after ʿalā, 'upon') + -himā, their (dual); 'their state'
يَزْدَادَانِ: يَزْدَادَانِ — yazdādāni, increasing (izdāda, yazdādu, verb VIII, imperf. 3 dual, nom.; a circumstantial after humā, 'they'; with maḥabbatan, 'in love', as specification (tamyīz)); 'increasing'
الضَّمِيرِ: الـ + ضَّمِير — al-, the + ḍamīr, the inner heart, secret thoughts (m., gen., after ʿan, 'about', following afṣaḥa, 'he made plain'); 'the inner heart'
حَبِيبَةَ: حَبِيبَة — ḥabība, beloved (f., vocative in construct, in yā ḥabībata al-qalbi, 'O beloved of the heart'); 'beloved'
وَالْفُؤَادِ: و + الـ + فُؤَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + fuʾād, inmost heart (m., gen., second term of the vocative construct); 'and of the inmost heart'
هُيَامًا: هُيَام — huyām, love-madness, distraction (m., acc., tanwīn, specification after izdadtu, 'I increased in'); 'in love-madness'
وَوَجْدًا: و + وَجْد — wa-, and + wajd, longing, ardour (m., acc., tanwīn, specification); 'and in longing'
وَغَرَامًا: و + غَرَام — wa-, and + gharām, ardent desire (m., acc., tanwīn, specification); 'and in ardour'
الضَّمِّ: الـ + ضَّمّ — al-, the + ḍamm, pressing (m., gen., after ghayr, 'other than'); 'the pressing'
السَّاقِ: الـ + سَّاق — al-, the + sāq, leg (f., gen. after ʿalā, 'upon', in iltifāf al-sāq ʿalā al-sāq, 'the twining of leg on leg'); 'the leg'
فَافْعَلِ: فَـ + افْعَلِ — fa-, then (introduces the answer to in shiʾta, 'if you wish') + ifʿali, do! (faʿala, yafʿalu, verb I, imperative 2ms; the final -i is a linking vowel before alladhī); 'then do'
شَرِيكٌ: شَرِيك — sharīk, partner (m., nom., tanwīn, subject of laysa, with predicate li-allāh fīnā; li- marks possession, 'to God'); 'a partner'
أُخْبِرَكِ: أُخْبِرَ + كِ — ukhbira, I tell (akhbara, yukhbiru, verb IV, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'that') + -ki, you (fem., Dunyā, acc.); with bi-, the verb takes bi- before the matter told; 'that I tell you'
بِحَقِيقَتِي: بِـ + حَقِيقَة + ي — bi-, of (akhbara takes bi- for the matter told) + ḥaqīqa, truth, reality (f., gen., 'who I truly am') + -ī, my; 'of my truth'
فَاعْلَمِي: فَـ + اعْلَمِي — fa-, so + iʿlamī, know! (ʿalima, yaʿlamu, verb I, imperative 2fs, to Dunyā; followed by annī, 'that I'); 'so know'
أَنْفَذَ: أَنْفَذَ — anfadha, he sent (verb IV, perf. 3ms, Sulaymān Shāh; takes the vizier as object and rasūlan, 'as messenger'); 'he sent'
لِيَخْطُبَكِ: لِـ + يَخْطُبَ + كِ — li-, so that (of purpose, with the subjunctive) + yakhṭuba, he asks in marriage (khaṭaba, yakhṭubu, verb I, subjunctive 3ms) + -ki, you (fem., acc.); 'so that he might ask for your hand'
بَلَغَكِ: بَلَغَ + كِ — balagha, it reached (verb I, perf. 3ms; subject al-khabar, 'the news') + -ki, you (fem., acc.); the print marks the feminine ending; 'it reached you'
رَضِيتِ: رَضِيتِ — raḍīti, you were content (raḍiya, yarḍā, verb I, perf. 2fs; the print marks the feminine ending, to make clear he speaks to a woman); 'you were content'
قَصَّ: قَصَّ — qaṣṣa, he related (qaṣṣa, yaquṣṣu, verb I, geminate, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'to', the hearer; the print marks the shadda); 'he related'
أَتَوَجَّهَ: أَتَوَجَّهَ — atawajjaha, I go, head (tawajjaha, yatawajjahu, verb V, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'to'; with ilā, 'to', his father); 'that I go'
وَيَخْطُبَكِ: و + يَخْطُبَ + كِ — wa-, and + yakhṭuba, he asks in marriage (khaṭaba, verb I, subjunctive 3ms, continuing after li-yursila, 'that he send') + -ki, you (fem., acc.); 'and ask for your hand'
وَنَسْتَرِيحَ: و + نَسْتَرِيحَ — wa-, and + nastarīḥa, we rest, are at ease (istarāḥa, yastarīḥu, verb X, subjunctive 1cpl., continuing after li-); 'and we be at rest'
غَرَضَهَا: غَرَض + هَا — gharaḍ, purpose, aim (m., acc., object of wāfaqa, 'it agreed with') + -hā, her (Dunyā); 'her purpose'
بَاتَا: بَاتَا — bātā, the two spent the night (bāta, yabītu, verb I, hollow, perf. 3 dual; the print has بانا, a misprint corrected here); 'the two spent the night'
دَسْتِ: دَسْت — dast, seat of honour, throne (m., a Persian word; gen., in construct after fī, 'on' the seat of his kingdom); 'seat'
عَرِيفُ: عَرِيف — ʿarīf, headman, master of a guild (m., nom., subject of dakhala, in construct with al-ṣuyyāgh); 'the head (of)'
الصُّيَّاغِ: الـ + صُّيَّاغ — al-, the + ṣuyyāgh, goldsmiths (m. pl. of ṣāʾigh, gen., second term of the construct; the print marks the doubled yāʾ); 'the goldsmiths'
حُقٌّ: حُقّ — ḥuqq, casket, small box (m., nom., tanwīn; the print marks the doubled qāf; wa-bi-yadihi ḥuqq, 'in his hand a casket'); 'a casket'
وَالْيَوَاقِيتِ: و + الـ + يَوَاقِيت — wa-, and + al-, the + yawāqīt, rubies (m. broken plural of yāqūt, gen., listed after mina al-jawāhir, 'of the jewels'); 'and the rubies'
وَالزُّمُرُّدِ: و + الـ + زُّمُرُّد — wa-, and + al-, the + zumurrud, emerald (m., gen., third item after mina, 'of'); 'and the emerald'
وَالْعَجُوزَ: و + الـ + عَجُوز — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿajūz, old woman (f., acc., second object of wajada, 'he found') + nāʾimatan, 'sleeping' (circumstantial); 'and the old woman'
عَتَبَتِهِ: عَتَبَة + هِ — ʿataba, threshold (f., gen., after ʿalā, 'on') + -hi, its (the door's); 'its threshold'
انْتَبَهَتْ: اِنْتَبَهَتْ — intabahat, she woke (intabaha, yantabihu, verb VII, perf. 3fs, the old woman; min manāmihā, 'from her sleep'); 'she woke'
وَخَافَتْ: و + خَافَتْ — wa-, and + khāfat, she feared (khāfa, yakhāfu, verb I, hollow, perf. 3fs; minhu, 'of him', the eunuch); 'and she was afraid'
بِالْمِفْتَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + مِفْتَاح — bi-, with (atā bi-, 'to come with', so the verb takes bi- for what is brought) + al-, the + miftāḥ, key (m., gen.); ātiyaka bi-al-miftāḥ, 'I bring you the key'
مُرْتَابَةٌ: مُرْتَابَة — murtāba, suspect, in doubt (f., nom., tanwīn; participle of verb VIII irtāba, 'to be in doubt, uneasy', predicate of annahā, 'that she'); 'was suspect, had a guilty conscience'
نَائِمَانِ: نَائِمَان — nāʾimāni, sleeping (m., active participle of nāma, nom. dual, predicate after humā, 'and the two'); 'sleeping, the two'
وَهَمَّ: و + هَمَّ — wa-, and + hamma, he was about to (verb I, geminate, perf. 3ms; hamma an, 'to intend to'; the print marks the doubled mīm); 'and he was about to'
يَعُودَ: يَعُودَ — yaʿūda, he returns (ʿāda, yaʿūdu, verb I, hollow, subjunctive 3ms after an, 'to'; with ilā, 'to', the king); 'that he return'
فَانْتَبَهَتِ: فَـ + انْتَبَهَتِ — fa-, and then + intabahat, she woke (intabaha, verb VII, perf. 3fs; the final -i is a linking vowel before al-sayyida); 'and she woke'
اسْتُرْ: اُسْتُرْ — ustur, cover! (satara, yasturu, verb I, imperative 2ms, to Kāfūr); 'cover'
مَاسَتَرَ: مَا سَتَرَ — mā, what (relative) + satara, he covered (satara, verb I, perf. 3ms; the subject is God); the print runs mā satara together (ماستر); 'what He has covered'
أُخْفِيَ: أُخْفِيَ — ukhfiya, I hide (akhfā, yukhfī, verb IV, subjunctive 1cs after an, 'to'; takes shayʾan, 'a thing', and ʿan, 'from', the king); 'that I hide'
أَعْطَيْتَ: أَعْطَيْتَ — aʿṭayta, you gave (aʿṭā, yuʿṭī, verb IV, perf. 2ms; with hal, 'did?', a question); 'did you give'
لِسَيِّدَتِكَ: لِـ + سَيِّدَة + كَ — li-, to (marks the one given to, indirect object of aʿṭā; Classical Arabic would use a second object) + sayyida, lady (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'to your lady'; also after jarā, 'to happen', li- marks the one it befalls: lammā jarā li-sayyidatika mā jarā, 'when what happened happened to your mistress' (Night 193)
مَاشِي: مَاشِي — māshī, nothing doing (perhaps mā shī, 'nothing', colloquial for mā shayʾ; or colloquial māshī, 'all right'); the word is not clear to us; 'nothing doing'
مُتَعَانِقَانِ: مُتَعَانِقَان — mutaʿāniqāni, embracing each other (verb VI active participle of taʿānaqa, nom. dual, a circumstantial, 'the two embracing'); 'embracing each other'
بِإِحْضَارِهِمَا: بِـ + إِحْضَار + هِمَا — bi-, of (amara bi-, 'to command (a thing)': the verb takes bi-) + iḥḍār, bringing, summoning (m., verbal noun of aḥḍara, gen.) + -himā, them both (obj. suffix on the verbal noun); 'the bringing of the two of them'
حَضَرَا: حَضَرَا — ḥaḍarā, the two were present (ḥaḍara, yaḥḍuru, verb I, perf. 3 dual; Tāj al-Mulūk and Dunyā); 'the two came before him'
قَمْشَةً: قَمْشَة — qamsha, whip (f., acc., tanwīn, object of akhadha; a Turkish word, vowels uncertain); 'a whip'
اقْتُلْنِي: اُقْتُلْ + نِي — uqtul, kill! (qatala, yaqtulu, verb I, imperative 2ms) + -nī, me (acc., with the helper nūn); 'kill me'
فَنَهَرَهَا: فَـ + نَهَرَ + هَا — fa-, and so + nahara, he rebuked (verb I, perf. 3ms, the king) + -hā, her (Dunyā, acc.); 'and he rebuked her'
يَمْضُوا: يَمْضُوا — yamḍū, they go (maḍā, yamḍī, verb I, subjunctive 3mpl. after an, 'that'; with bi-, 'with', taking her away, 'to go with her'); 'that they go'
حُجْرَتِهَا: حُجْرَة + هَا — ḥujra, room, chamber (f., gen., after ilā, 'to') + -hā, her; 'her room'
وَمَاجَسَّرَكَ: و + مَا جَسَّرَ + كَ — wa-, and + mā, what (interrogative) + jassara, he made bold (verb II, perf. 3ms, of jasura) + -ka, you (acc.); ʿalā, 'against', the print runs mā jassaraka together (ماجسرك); 'and what made you dare'
وَنَدِمْتَ: و + نَدِمْتَ — wa-, and + nadimta, you repented (nadima, yandamu, verb I, perf. 2ms); 'and you will repent'
مَمْلَكَتِكَ: مَمْلَكَة + كَ — mamlaka, kingdom (f., gen., after fī, 'in') + -ka, your; 'your kingdom'
وَلِمَ: و + لِـ + مَ — wa-, and + li-, for (preposition) + ma, what? (mā shortened after a preposition); 'and why?' (li-ma, 'for what')
وَرَجِلِهِ: و + رَجِل + هِ — wa-, and + rajil, foot-soldiers, infantry (m., gen., after bi-, 'with', paired with khayl, 'cavalry') + -hi, his; 'and his foot'
وَيَضَعَهُ: و + يَضَع + هُ — wa-, and + yaḍaʿa, he puts (waḍaʿa, yaḍaʿu, verb I, subjunctive 3ms after an, 'to', continuing yuʾakhkhira) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and put him'
تُعَجِّلَ: تُعَجِّلَ — tuʿajjila, you hasten (ʿajjala, yuʿajjilu, verb II, subjunctive 2ms after an, 'that'; object qatla, 'the killing of'); 'that you hasten'
لِلسَّيَّافِ: لِـ + الـ + سَّيَّاف — li-, to (indirect object of qāla) + al-, the + sayyāf, swordsman, executioner (m., gen.; the print marks the doubled yāʾ); 'to the swordsman'
وِثَاقَهُ: وِثَاق + هُ — withāq, bond, binding (m., acc., object of shadda) + -hu, his; 'his bond'
وَشَاوَرَ: و + شَاوَرَ — wa-, and + shāwara, he consulted (verb III, perf. 3ms, the swordsman); 'and consulted'
الْأُمَرَاءَ: الـ + أُمَرَاء — al-, the + umarāʾ, emirs (m. broken plural of amīr, acc., object of shāwara); 'the emirs'
وَثَانِيًا: و + ثَانِيًا — wa-, and + thāniyan, secondly, a second time (adverbial acc. of thānin; after awwalan, 'first'); 'and a second (time)'
تَوَانٍ: تَوَانٍ — tawānin, slackness, delay (m., verbal noun of verb VI tawānā, tanwīn, nom., subject of yakūna in an yakūna fī al-amri, 'that there be in the matter'); 'delay'
تُشَاوِرُ: تُشَاوِرُ — tushāwiru, you consult (shāwara, yushāwiru, verb III, imperf. 2ms, nom.; after ilā matā, 'until when'); 'you will consult'
شَاوَرْتَ: شَاوَرْتَ — shāwarta, you consult (shāwara, verb III, perf. 2ms, in the condition after in, 'if'; marratan ukhrā, 'another time'); 'if you consult'
شَعْرُإِبْطِهِ: شَعْر + إِبْط + هِ — shaʿr, hair (m., nom., subject of bāna) + ibṭ, armpit (m., gen., in construct) + -hi, his; the print runs shaʿr ibṭihi together (شعرابطه); 'the hair of his armpit'
اِزْدْدتُّ: اِزْدْدتُّ — izdattu (izdadtu), I increased (izdāda, yazdādu, verb VIII, perf. 1cs; the second dāl is absorbed into the tāʾ; the print points it with sukūn on the first dāl and a doubled tāʾ, kept as printed); 'I have increased'
بِزَعَقَاتٍ: بِـ + زَعَقَات — bi-, with (prep.; after وَإِذَا of surprise it only marks what appears) + zaʿaqāt, loud shouts (f. pl., gen.; pl. of zaʿqa); 'and behold, (there came) shouts'
وَخَيْلُهُمْ: وَ + خَيْل + هُمْ — wa-, and + khayl, horses, cavalry (coll., f./m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'and their horses'
رَكْضٍ: رَكْض — rakḍ, galloping, running (vn. of rakaḍa, m., gen. after فِي); 'galloping'
ارْتَجَّتْ: ارْتَجَّتْ — irtajja, to shake, quake (form VIII; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'it shook'
الْقَادِمِ: الـ + قَادِم — al-, the + qādim, arriving, coming (act. part. of qadima, m., gen.); 'the arriving (king)'
وَقَرَّبَهُمْ: وَ + قَرَّبَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + qarraba, to bring near (form II; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them (obj.); 'and he drew them near'
قُدُومِهِمْ: قُدُوم + هِمْ — qudūm, arrival, coming (vn. of qadima, m., gen.) + -him, their; 'their coming'
بِأَرْضِكَ: بِـ + أَرْض + كَ — bi-, in (prep.; with نَزَلَ, 'alight in') + arḍ, land (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your land'
كَالْمُلُوكِ: كَـ + الـ + مُلُوك — ka-, like (prep.; comparison) + al-, the + mulūk, kings (m. pl., gen.; pl. of malik); 'like the kings'
السَّلَاطِينِ: الـ + سَلَاطِين — al-, the + salāṭīn, sultans (m. pl., gen.; pl. of sulṭān); 'the sultans'
السَّالِفِينَ: الـ + سَالِف + ِينَ — al-, the + sālif, past, bygone (act. part. of salafa, m. pl., gen.); 'the bygone'
بِعُلُوِّ: بِـ + عُلُوّ — bi-, with, on account of (prep.; here 'about', with شَاعَ, 'spread abroad with/of') + ʿuluww, loftiness, height (vn., m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'of the loftiness (of his aspiration)'
وَالْإِنْصَافَ: وَ + الـ + إِنْصَاف — wa-, and + al-, the + inṣāf, fairness, equity (form IV vn., m., acc., object of يُحِبُّ); 'and fair-dealing'
وَيَكْرَهُ: وَ + يَكْرَهُ — wa-, and + kariha, to hate, dislike (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he hates'
وَالِاعْتِسَافَ: وَ + الـ + اِعْتِسَاف — wa-, and + al-, the + iʿtisāf, high-handedness, wrongful dealing (form VIII vn., m., acc.); 'and high-handedness'
حُشَاشَةُ: حُشَاشَة — ḥushāsha, last breath of life, remnant of life (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa with قَلْبِهِ); 'the last breath (of his heart)'
الْمَقْصُودُ: الـ + مَقْصُود — al-, the + maqṣūd, aim, thing intended (pass. part. of qaṣada, m., nom.); 'the thing aimed at'
الْمَشْكُورُ: الـ + مَشْكُور — al-, the + mashkūr, thanked (pass. part. of shakara, m., nom.); 'the thanked one'
الْمَحْمُودُ: الـ + مَحْمُود — al-, the + maḥmūd, praised (pass. part. of ḥamida, m., nom.); 'the praised one'
فَأَبْشِرْ: فَـ + أَبْشِرْ — fa-, then (apodosis) + abshara, to receive good news (form IV; imper. 2 m. sg.; used with بِـ, here ironically of bad tidings); 'then take the tidings (of)'
بِالدَّمَارِ: بِـ + الـ + دَمَار — bi-, with, of (prep.; governed by أَبْشِرْ 'rejoice at/take tidings of') + al-, the + damār, destruction (m., gen.); 'of destruction'
وَخَرَابِ: وَ + خَرَاب — wa-, and + kharāb, ruin, devastation (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa, coordinated after بِـ); 'and the ruin (of the dwellings)'
قَفْرَاءَ: قَفْرَاء — qafrāʾ, desolate, empty (f. adj. of aqfar; diptote; here acc. as predicate of يَصِيرُ); 'a wasteland'
يَنْعَقُ: يَنْعَقُ — naʿaqa, to croak, caw (impf. 3 m. sg.); 'croaks'
بَلَّغْتُكَ: بَلَّغْ + تُ + كَ — ballagha, to convey, deliver (form II; perf.) + -tu, I (1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I have conveyed to you'
وَيْلَكُمْ: وَيْل + كُمْ — wayl, woe, misery (m., acc.; exclamation, first term of an iḍāfa) + -kum, you (pl.); 'woe to you!'
تُؤَاخِذْنِي: تُؤَاخِذْ + نِي — ākhadha, to take to task, hold accountable (form III; impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after لَا) + -nī, me (obj.); 'do not take me to task'
تُوَاخِذِ: تُوَاخِذِ — ākhadha, to take to task (form III; impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after لَا, with kasra before the following definite article; spelled with wāw for hamza, Middle Arabic); 'do not take (the evil-doer) to task'
فَارْحَمْ: فَـ + ارْحَمْ — fa-, so, then + raḥima, to have mercy on (imper. 2 m. sg.); 'so have mercy (on)'
شَيْبَتِي: شَيْبَة + ي — shayba, grey hair, old age (f., acc.; obj. of ارْحَمْ) + -ī, my; 'my grey hair'
تُخَرِّبْ: تُخَرِّبْ — kharraba, to ruin, lay waste (form II; impf. 2 m. sg., jussive after لَا); 'do not ruin'
الْحَذَرَأَنْ: الـ + حَذَر + أَنْ — al-, the + ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., nom.) + an, that (subjunctive particle); run together in the print for الْحَذَرُ أَنْ; 'the caution (is) lest'
كُبَرَاءَ: كُبَرَاء — kubarāʾ, great ones, grandees (m. pl., acc.; pl. of kabīr; obj. of أَمَرَ, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the great ones (of his state)'
يَأْخُذُوا: أَخَذَ — akhadha, to take (impf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after أَنْ, final nūn dropped); 'that they take'
وَيَمْضُوا: وَ + يَمْضُوا — wa-, and + maḍā, to go, proceed (impf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after أَنْ); 'and go'
وَيُلْبِسُوهُ: وَ + يُلْبِسُوا + هُ — wa-, and + albasa, to clothe (form IV; impf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hu, him (obj.); 'and clothe him'
وَيَأْتُوا: وَ + يَأْتُوا — wa-, and + atā, to come (impf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after أَنْ; with بِهِ 'bring him'); 'and bring (him)'
سُرْعَةً: سُرْعَة — surʿa, speed, haste (f., acc.; adverbial); 'quickly'
أَفْرَدَهَا: أَفْرَدَ + هَا — afrada, to set apart, reserve (form IV; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (f.; the suit); 'had set it apart'
أَتَوابِهِ: أَتَوْا + بِـ + هِ — atā, to come (perf. 3 m. pl.; final alif of the plural omitted, run together with the next word) + bi-, with (prep.; أَتَى بِـ 'bring') + -hi, him; 'they came with him'
وَأَوْقَفَ: وَ + أَوْقَفَ — wa-, and + awqafa, to make stand (form IV; perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and made stand'
فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ: فَـ + أَخْبَرْ + نَا + هُ — fa-, and so + akhbara, to inform (form IV; perf.) + -nā, we (1 pl.) + -hu, him (obj.); 'and we told him'
سَرَايَةَ: سَرَايَة — sarāya, palace, mansion (f., acc.; Middle Arabic, = سَرَاي/سَرَايَة, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the palace (of the king's daughter)'
وَالْتَبَسَ: وَ + الْتَبَسَ — wa-, and + iltabasa, to be obscure, confused (form VIII; perf. 3 m. sg.); with عَلَى, 'and (it) was obscure to (us)'
قَدِمْنَا: قَدِمْ + نَا — qadima, to come, arrive (perf.) + -nā, we (1 pl.); 'we came'
قُدُومِنَا: قُدُوم + نَا — qudūm, arrival, coming (vn. of qadima, m., gen. after فِي) + -nā, our; 'our coming'
تُوَلْوِلُ: تُوَلْوِلُ — walwala, to wail, keen (quadriliteral; impf. 3 f. sg.); 'she wails'
وَرَكَزَتْ: وَ + رَكَزَتْ — wa-, and + rakaza, to plant, fix in the ground (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she planted'
ذُبَابَتَهُ: ذُبَابَة + هُ — dhubāba, point, tip (of a sword) (f., acc.) + -hu, its; 'its point'
وَانْحَنَتْ: وَ + انْحَنَتْ — wa-, and + inḥanā, to bend, stoop (form VII; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she bent over'
تَفْعَلِى: تَفْعَلِي — faʿala, to do (impf. 2 f. sg., jussive after لَا; final ى is a Middle Arabic spelling of ي); 'do not do (it)'
وَارْحَمِي: وَ + ارْحَمِي — wa-, and + raḥima, to have mercy on (imper. 2 f. sg.); 'and have mercy (on)'
بَلْدَتِكِ: بَلْدَة + كِ — balda, town, city (f., gen.; first term, in iḍāfa after أَهْلَ) + -ki, your (f.); 'your city'
أُحَاشِيكِ: أُحَاشِي + كِ — ḥāshā, to exempt, hold free of (form III; impf. 1 sg.) + -ki, you (f., obj.); 'I hold you exempt (from)'
مَحْبُوبَهَا: مَحْبُوب + هَا — maḥbūb, beloved (pass. part. of aḥabba, m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her beloved'
زَوَاجَهَا: زَوَاج + هَا — zawāj, marriage (m., acc.; obj. of يُرِيدُ) + -hā, her; 'marriage with her'
وَالزَّوَاجِ: وَ + الـ + زَوَاج — wa-, and + al-, the + zawāj, marriage (m., gen.); 'and the marriage'
بِرَأْيِكِ: بِـ + رَأْي + كِ — bi-, upon, on (prep.; with تَعَلَّقَ 'depend on, hang on') + raʾy, opinion, judgment (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'on your opinion'
أُخَلِّيهِ: أُخَلِّي + هِ — khallā, to let, leave (form II; impf. 1 sg., subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hi, him (obj.); 'that I let him'
يَصْلُبَكَ: يَصْلُبَ + كَ — ṣalaba, to crucify (impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after حَتَّى) + -ka, you (obj.); 'until he crucifies you'
خَشَبَهٍ: خَشَبَة — khashaba, plank, piece of wood (f., gen. after عَلَى; final ة written هٍ in the print); 'a plank'
بِالْعَجَلِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجَل — bi-, with, in (prep.; adverbial) + al-, the + ʿajal, haste (m., gen.); 'in haste'
وَسَارَّهُ: وَ + سَارَّ + هُ — wa-, and + sārra, to tell privately, whisper to (form III; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him (obj.); 'and told him privately'
وَأَتَيَا: وَ + أَتَيَا — wa-, and + atā, to come (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two came'
بِحَضْرَةِ: بِـ + حَضْرَة — bi-, in (prep.) + ḥaḍra, presence (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa with أَبِيهَا); 'in the presence (of her father)'. Also with other nouns: bi-ḥaḍrati al-wuzarāʾi, 'in the presence of the viziers'.
يُفَرِّطُ: يُفَرِّطُ — farraṭa, to squander, neglect (form II; impf. 3 m. sg.); with فِي, 'who squanders'
الْمُصَانِينَ: الـ + مُصَانِين — al-, the + muṣān, kept safe, guarded (pass. part. of ṣāna, m. pl., gen.; printed الْمُصَانِينَ for classical الْمَصُونِينَ, Middle Arabic); 'the kept-safe'
الرَّذَائِلِ: الـ + رَذَائِل — al-, the + radhāʾil, vices, base acts (f. pl., gen.; pl. of radhīla); 'the vices'
بِصُحْبَتِهِ: بِـ + صُحْبَة + هِ — bi-, in (prep.; with, in company) + ṣuḥba, company (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'in his company'
مَعْشُوقَتِهِ: مَعْشُوقَة + هِ — maʿshūqa, beloved woman (pass. part. of ʿashiqa, f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his beloved'
فَتَوَجَّهُوا: فَـ + تَوَجَّهُوا — fa-, and so + tawajjaha, to turn towards (form V; perf. 3 m. pl.); 'so they turned towards'
لِيُعْلِمُوهُ: لِـ + يُعْلِمُوا + هُ — li-, in order to, so that (purpose) + aʿlama, to let know, inform (form IV; impf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive) + -hu, him (obj.); 'to let him know'
وَالْعَلُوفَاتِ: وَ + الـ + عَلُوفَات — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿalūfāt, fodder, provisions for animals (f. pl., gen.; pl. of ʿalūfa); 'and the fodders'
وَالضِّيَافَاتِ: وَ + الـ + ضِيَافَات — wa-, and + al-, the + ḍiyāfāt, hospitality gifts, entertainments (f. pl., gen.; pl. of ḍiyāfa); 'and the hospitalities'
أَخْرَجُو: أَخْرَجُوا — akhraja, to bring out (form IV; perf. 3 m. pl.; final alif of the plural omitted in the print); 'they brought out'
وَمِئَةَ: وَ + مِئَة — wa-, and + miʾa, hundred (f., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa; variant spelling of مِائَة); 'and a hundred'
سُرِّيَّهٍ: سُرِّيَّة — surriyya, concubine (f., gen.; final ة written هٍ in the print); '(a hundred) concubines'
لِقَائِهِ: لِـ + لِقَاء + هِ — li-, to, towards (prep.; of purpose/goal, 'to meet') + liqāʾ, meeting (vn. of laqiya, m., gen.) + -hi, him; 'to meet him'
أَعْلَمَاهُ: أَعْلَمَا + هُ — aʿlama, to let know, inform (form IV; perf. 3 m. dual) + -hu, him (obj.); 'the two had informed him'
الْحَمْدُلِلّٰهِ: الـ + حَمْد + لِـ + اللّٰه — al-, the + ḥamd, praise (m., nom.) + li-, to, for (prep.; marks the one praised) + Allāh, God (gen.); run together in the print for الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ; 'praise be to God'
بِحِضْنِهِ: بِـ + حِضْن + هِ — bi-, in, with (prep.) + ḥiḍn, bosom, embrace (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'in his bosom'
بِجَانِبِةِ: بِـ + جَانِب + هِ — bi-, at, by (prep.) + jānib, side (m., gen.) + -hi, his (final ـهِ misspelled ـةِ in the print); 'at his side'
وَتَحَادَثَا: وَ + تَحَادَثَا — wa-, and + taḥādatha, to converse with each other (form VI; perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two conversed'
فَتَفَكَّهُوا: فَـ + تَفَكَّهُوا — fa-, and so + tafakkaha, to eat fruit, enjoy oneself (form V; perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they ate fruit'
وَتَنَقَّلُوا: وَ + تَنَقَّلُوا — wa-, and + tanaqqala, to eat nuts and dessert (form V; perf. 3 m. pl.; from nuql); 'and they ate dessert'
إِلَّاوَتَاجُ: إِلَّا + وَ + تَاجُ — illā, except, but (particle) + wa-, and (circumstantial; 'but that') + tāj, crown (m., nom.; first term of the name Tāj al-Mulūk); run together in the print for إِلَّا وَتَاجُ; 'but (that) Tāj (al-Mulūk)'
وَزِينَةٍ: وَ + زِينَة — wa-, and + zīna, finery, adornment (f., gen.); 'and finery'
وَاحْتَضَنَهُ: وَ + احْتَضَنَ + هُ — wa-, and + iḥtaḍana, to embrace, take to the bosom (form VIII; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him (obj.); 'and embraced him'
لِيَشْتَهِرَ: لِـ + يَشْتَهِرَ — li-, so that (purpose) + ishtahara, to become known, famous (form VIII; impf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive); 'so that it becomes known'
الْبَقَاشِيشُ: الـ + بَقَاشِيش — al-, the + baqāshīsh, gratuities, tips (m. pl., nom.; pl. of baqshīsh, Persian loan); 'the gratuities'
وَانْطَلَقَ: وَ + انْطَلَقَ — wa-, and + inṭalaqa, to be released, set off (form VII; perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and were let loose'
لِوَالِدِةِ: لِـ + وَالِد + هِ — li-, to (prep.; with قَالَ 'said to') + wālid, father (m., gen.) + -hi, his (final ـهِ misspelled ـةِ in the print); 'to his father'
خَدَمَنِى: خَدَمَ + نِي — khadama, to serve (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me (obj.; ى for ي in the print); 'he served me'
بُغْيَتِي: بُغْيَة + ي — bughya, desire, aim (f., gen. after إِلَى) + -ī, my; 'my desire'
وَيُصَبِّرُنِي: وَ + يُصَبِّرُ + نِي — wa-, and + ṣabbara, to make patient, console (form II; impf. 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me (obj.); 'and he keeps me patient'
سَنَتَانِ: سَنَتَان — sana, year (f. dual nom., the dual of سَنَة; predicate-subject after لَهُ); 'two years'
مُشَتَّتٌ: مُشَتَّت — mushattat, scattered, driven away (pass. part. of shattata, form II; m. sg., nom.); 'scattered away'
وَقَصْدِى: وَ + قَصْد + ي — wa-, and + qaṣd, aim, intention (m., nom.) + -ī, my (ى for ي in the print); 'and my aim'
نُهَيِّئُ: نُهَيِّئُ — hayyaʾa, to prepare (form II; impf. 1 pl., subjunctive/indicative after أَنَّنَا); 'we prepare'
مَحْبُورَ: مَحْبُور — maḥbūr, glad, delighted (pass. part. of ḥabara, m., acc.; first term of an iḍāfa with الْخَاطِرِ, state); 'glad (of mind)'
بِلَادِةِ: بِلَاد + هِ — bilād, country, land (m. pl./sg., nom.) + -hi, his (final ـهِ misspelled ـةِ in the print); 'his country'
هَيَّئُوا: هَيَّأَ — hayyaʾa, to prepare, make ready (form II; perf. 3 m. pl.); 'they prepared'
وَأَغْلَاهُ: وَ + أَغْلَا + هُ — wa-, and + aghlā, costlier, most precious (elative of ghālin, m., gen.) + -hu, it (m.; the stuff); 'and the costliest of it'
وَصَدِيقِى: وَ + صَدِيق + ي — wa-, and + ṣadīq, friend (m., acc., coordinated with أَخِي) + -ī, my (ى for ي in the print); 'and my friend'
وَاقْبَلْهَا: وَ + اقْبَلْ + هَا — wa-, and + qabila, to accept (imper. 2 m. sg.) + -hā, them (obj.; the loads); 'and accept them'
وَالْمَحَبَّةِ: وَ + الـ + مَحَبَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + maḥabba, love, affection (f., gen.); 'and the love'
فَقَبِلَهَا: فَـ + قَبِلَ + هَا — fa-, and so + qabila, to accept (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, them (obj.; the loads); 'so he accepted them'
وَوَدَّعَهُمْ: وَ + وَدَّعَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + waddaʿa, to bid farewell (form II; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hum, them (obj.); 'and bade them farewell'
شَيَّعَهُ: شَيَّعَ + هُ — shayyaʿa, to escort, see off (form II; perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him (obj.); 'he escorted him'
أَمْيَالٍ: أَمْيَال — amyāl, miles (m. pl., gen.; pl. of mīl; after ثَلَاثَة); 'miles'
خَاطِرِةِ: خَاطِر + هِ — khāṭir, mind, heart, feelings (m., acc.) + -hi, his (ـهِ misspelled ـةِ in the print); 'his mind' (أَخَذَ خَاطِرَهُ 'consoled/pleased him')
فَارَقْتُكَ: فَارَقْ + تُ + كَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (form III; perf.) + -tu, I (1 sg.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I would have parted from you'
لَاتَقْطَعْ: لَا + تَقْطَعْ — lā, not (prohibitive) + qaṭaʿa, to cut off (impf. 2 m. sg., jussive); run together in the print for لَا تَقْطَعْ; 'do not cut off'
تَزُورُهُ: تَزُورُ + هُ — zāra, to visit (impf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it, him (obj.; the tomb); 'she visits it'
وَجَدَهَا: وَجَدَ + هَا — wajada, to find (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her (obj.); 'he found her'
وَنَشَرَتْهُ: وَ + نَشَرَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + nashara, to spread out (perf. 3 f. sg.) + -hu, it (obj.; her hair); 'and she spread it'
لَصَبَّارٌ: لَـ + صَبَّار — la-, indeed (emphatic particle after إِنَّ) + ṣabbār, very patient, enduring (intensive form; m. sg., nom., predicate); 'indeed a great endurer'
خُطَّةِ: خُطَّة — khuṭṭa, matter, affair, plight (f., gen. after مِنْ); 'the matter (of the parting)'
اَجْزَعُ: أَجْزَعُ — jazaʿa, to be in anguish, lose patience (impf. 1 sg.); 'I am in anguish'
خَلِيلِهِ: خَلِيل + هِ — khalīl, close friend, bosom friend (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his close friend'
لِوَشْكِ: لِـ + وَشْك — li-, at, on account of (prep.; 'at the nearness of') + washk, nearness, imminence (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa with الْبَيْنِ); 'at the nearness (of the parting)'
يَتَضَعْضَعُ: يَتَضَعْضَعُ — taḍaʿḍaʿa, to be shaken, grow humbled (quadriliteral, reflexive; impf. 3 m. sg.); 'is shaken'
جَوَابِكُمْ: جَوَاب + كُمْ — jawāb, answer, reply (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa) + -kum, your (pl., used for respect/singular); 'your answer'
رَهِينُ: رَهِين — rahīn, pledged, held hostage (m. sg., nom.; predicate; first term of an iḍāfa with جَنَادِلٍ); 'pledge (of rocks)' Also with lisān: rahīnu lisānihi, 'hostage to his tongue'.
جَنَادِلٍ: جَنَادِل — janādil, rocks, stones (m. pl., gen.; pl. of jandal); 'rocks'
وَتُرَابِي: وَ + تُرَاب + ـِي — wa-, and + turāb, dust, earth (m., gen.); the final -ī is carried by the rhyme (all the lines end in -ābī), so it may be read 'my dust' or simply 'dust'
فَنَسِيتُكُمْ: فَـ + نَسِي + تُ + كُمْ — fa-, so, and so + nasiya, to forget (perf.) + -tu, I (1 sg.) + -kum, you (pl., obj.); 'so I have forgotten you'
فَنَضَحَ: فَـ + نَضَحَ — fa-, and so + naḍaḥa, to sprinkle (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he sprinkled'
فَأَفَاقَتْ: فَـ + أَفَاقَتْ — fa-, and so + afāqa, to recover consciousness, come to (form IV; perf. 3 f. sg.); 'and she came to'
خَصَتْهُ: خَصَى + ـتْ + ـهُ — khaṣā, to castrate (perf. 3fs khaṣat, the regular form of this defective verb) + -hu, him (obj.); 'she castrated him'
بِمَحْبُوبَتِهِ: بِـ + مَحْبُوبَة + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; with دَخَلَ بِـ 'go in to, consummate marriage with') + maḥbūba, beloved (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his beloved'
وَوَالِدُهُ: وَ + وَالِد + هُ — wa-, and + wālid, father (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his father'
مَدِينَتِهِمْ: مَدِينَة + هِمْ — madīna, city (f., gen.) + -him, their; 'their city'
فَتَوَاتَرَتِ: فَـ + تَوَاتَرَتِ — fa-, and so + tawātara, to follow one another in succession (form VI; perf. 3 f. sg., with kasra before the definite article); 'and followed one another'
فَابْتَدَأَ: فَـ + ابْتَدَأَ — fa-, and then + ibtadaʾa, to begin (form VIII; perf. 3ms); with بِـ, 'begin with': ibtadaʾa bi-al-salām, 'he began with the greeting' (the print has فابتدأء, a misprint, corrected)
زُيِّنَتْ: zuyyina, to be adorned, decorated (perf. passive 3 f. sg., form II); 'the city was decked out'
عُرْسًا: ʿurs, wedding, wedding feast (m.), acc. indef. as object of ʿamila; 'a wedding feast'
لِلسَّيِّدَةِ: لِـ + الـ + سَيِّدَة — li-, marking the object of tujallī (spoken usage: the tirewomen display the bride) + al-, the + sayyida, lady (f., gen. after li-); 'the Lady (Dunyā)', the bride of Tāj al-Mulūk; here after qāla, li- marks the one spoken to: qālat li-al-sayyidati Budūra, 'she said to the Lady Budūr' (Night 193); here after jarā, 'to happen', li- marks the one it befalls: mā jarā li-al-sayyidati Budūra, 'what happened to the Lady Budūr'
الْحَزِينَ: al- + ḥazīn — ḥazīn, sorrowful, grieving (adj., acc. def., qualifying al-qalb); 'the grieving heart'
تَدْبِيرِهِمْ: tadbīr + -him — tadbīr, management, ordering of affairs (m., gen. after fī) + -him, their (m. pl.); 'in managing them (the kings)'
أَوْطَانِهِمْ: awṭān + -him — waṭan (pl. awṭān), homeland, home country (gen. after ilā) + -him, their; 'to their homelands'
وَإِدَامَةِ: وَ + إِدَامَة — wa-, and + idāma, keeping up, prolonging (verbal noun of form IV adāma; f., gen., coordinated after min, construct with al-ḥarb); 'and the keeping-up (of the war)'
الْحَسْرَةُ: al- + ḥasra — ḥasra, grief, regret (f., nom. subject of ṣārat); 'the grief'
مُصِيبَتَيْنِ: muṣībatayn, calamity, misfortune (f., dual acc., predicate of ṣārat); 'two calamities'
الثَّأْرِ: al- + thaʾr — thaʾr, blood-revenge, vengeance (m., gen. in construct after akhdh); 'the vengeance' (for King ʿUmar ibn al-Nuʿmān)
وَرُدُّوا: wa- + ruddū — wa-, and; radda, to give back, return (imper. 2 m. pl.); 'and give back (to me an answer)'
إِقَامَتِنَا: iqāma + -nā — iqāma, staying, residence (f., gen. after fī) + -nā, our; 'in our staying on'
اشْتَاقُوا: ishtāqū, to long for, yearn (perf. 3 m. pl., form VIII; takes ilā); 'they long for'
أَحْوَالِهِمْ: aḥwāl + -him — ḥāl (pl. aḥwāl), condition, affairs, belongings (gen. in construct after tajhīz) + -him, their; 'their affairs (their baggage)'
وَنُشِرَتِ: wa- + nushirat — wa-, and; nashara, to spread out, unfurl (perf. passive 3 f. sg.); 'and the banners were unfurled'
الْحُضَّارُ: al- + ḥuḍḍār — ḥāḍir (pl. ḥuḍḍār), present ones, those at home (m. pl., nom.); 'the present'
فَاُحْضِرَ: fa- + uḥḍira — fa-, so; aḥḍara, to bring, summon (perf. passive 3 m. sg., form IV); 'so he was brought in' (the stoker)
وَالْمَعْرُوفِ: wa- + al- + maʿrūf — wa-, and; maʿrūf, kindness, good deed (m., gen., coordinated with al-khayr); 'and the kindness'
غَلُظَ: ghaluẓa, to grow thick, coarse (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'had grown thick' (the stoker, now fat)
عُنُقُهُ: ʿunuq + -hu — ʿunuq, neck (m., nom. subject of ṣāra) + -hu, his; 'his neck'
الدُّرْفِيلِ: الـ + دُرْفِيل — al-, the + durfīl, dolphin (m., gen. after baṭn; by-form of dulfīn, shaped to rhyme with fīl); 'the dolphin'
وَانْبَشَّ: wa- + inbashsha — wa-, and; inbashsha, to beam, brighten with welcome (perf. 3 m. sg., form VII); 'and he beamed'
وَتَحَقَّقَهُ: wa- + taḥaqqaqa + -hu — wa-, and; taḥaqqaqa, to make sure of, verify (perf. 3 m. sg., form V) + -hu, him; 'and made sure of him'
وَشَرَحَ: wa- + sharaḥa — wa-, and; sharaḥa, to explain, set out (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and explained (to him the story)'
أَتَمَنَّيٰ: atamannā, to wish, ask for (imperf. 1 sg. subjunctive after an, form V; takes ʿalā for the person asked); 'that I ask (of him)'
سَأَتَمَنَّيٰ: sa- + atamannā — sa-, will (future); atamannā, to wish, ask for (imperf. 1 sg., form V; takes ʿalā); 'I shall ask (of him)'
لَأَعْطَاكَ: la- + aʿṭā + -ka — la-, apodosis particle after law (surely); aʿṭā, to give (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV) + -ka, you; 'he would surely give you'
قُعُودِي: قُعُود + ـِي — quʿūd, sitting (verbal noun of qaʿada; m., gen. after ayyām) + -ī, my; 'my sitting'
لِحَيَاتِي: li- + ḥayāt + -ī — li-, for (the cause: you were a reason for my life); ḥayāt, life (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my life'
لَاتَقْدِرُ: lā + taqdir(u) — lā, not; qadara, to be able (imperf. 2 m. sg., takes ʿalā); 'you cannot (do)'
الْوَقَّادِينَ: al- + waqqād + īna — waqqād, stoker, fire-tender (m. pl., gen., after jamīʿ; sound pl. in -īn); 'the stokers'
تَجْعَلَنِي: تَجْعَلَ + نِي — jaʿala, to make, appoint (imperf. 2 m. sg., subj. after an) + -nī, me; 'that you make me (chief of the dung-men)'
فَانْقَلَبَ: fa- + inqalaba — fa-, so; inqalaba, to topple over, turn upside down (perf. 3 m. sg., form VII); 'and (they) fell over (laughing)'
بِلَادِى: bilād + -ī — bilād, lands, country (f. pl., gen. after ilā) + -ī, my; 'to my country'
تُوَلِّيَنِي: تُوَلِّيَ + نِي — wallā, to appoint (as governor) (form II, imperf. 2 m. sg., subj. after an; two objects) + -nī, me; 'that you appoint me (viceroy of Damascus)'
مَايَرُوحُ: mā + yarūḥu — mā, not; rāḥa, to go (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'no one will go (with him)'
فَأَحْضِرْ: fa- + aḥḍir — fa-, then; aḥḍara, to bring (imperv. 2 m. sg., form IV); 'then bring (with you)'
وَطَقْمَ: wa- + ṭaqm — wa-, and; ṭaqm, set, suite (m., acc., coordinated); 'and a set (of sultanic regalia)'
فَلْيُكْرِمْ: fa- + li- + yukrim — fa-, then; li-, let (jussive/imperative particle, 'let him'); akrama, to honour (imperf. 3 m. sg. jussive, form IV); 'let him honour'
وَسَمَّاهُ: wa- + sammā + -hu — wa-, and; sammā, to name (perf. 3 m. sg., form II) + -hu, him; 'and named him' (the Sultan named the stoker al-Zabalkān)
بِالْمُجَاهِدِ: bi- + al- + mujāhid — bi-, with (laqqaba takes bi- for the title); mujāhid, fighter in the holy war (m., gen.); 'with the title al-Mujāhid'
وَيَطْلُبَ: wa- + yaṭluba — wa-, and; ṭalaba, to ask for (imperf. 3 m. sg. subjunctive after li-, form I); 'and to ask (of him)'
الْأُهْبَةَ: al- + uhba — uhba, equipment, preparedness (f., acc., object of yaʾkhudh); 'the equipment'
بِالزَّبَلْكَانِ: bi- + al- + Zabalkān — Zabalkān, 'the dung-man', the former stoker made viceroy of Damascus; bi-, with (musammā takes bi- for the name); 'named al-Zabalkān'
وَالْخَدَمَ: wa- + al- + khadam — wa-, and; khadam, servants, attendants (m. coll. pl., acc.); 'and the servants'
وَتَوْدِيعِهِ: wa- + tawdīʿ + -hi — wa-, and; tawdīʿ, bidding farewell (m. verbal noun, form II, gen.) + -hi, his; 'and taking leave of him'
الْقَلْعَةَ: al- + qalʿa — qalʿa, citadel, fortress (f., acc., object of ṭalaʿa); 'the citadel' (of Damascus)
وَيُقَبِّلُونَ: wa- + yuqabbilūna — wa-, and; qabbala, to kiss (imperf. 3 m. pl., form II); 'and they kiss (his hands)'
الْإِبْرِيسَمِ: al- + ibrīsam — ibrīsam, raw silk (m., gen. after min); 'the silk' (the litter was of silk)
الْمِحَفَّةِ: al- + miḥaffa — miḥaffa, litter, covered palanquin (f., gen. after fī); 'the litter' (in which Qaḍā Fakān, Sharrukān's daughter, was seated)
بِآلَةِ: بِـ + آلَة — bi-, with (ihtamma takes bi-: 'busy oneself with') + āla, gear, equipment (f., gen., construct with al-silāḥ); 'with the gear (of arms)'
الرَّحْبَةِ: al- + raḥba — Raḥba, Rahba, a town on the Euphrates (f., gen. after ilā); 'Rahba'
وَفَصَّلَ: wa- + faṣṣala — wa-, and; faṣṣala, to cut and tailor (perf. 3 m. sg., form II); 'and he had cut (clothes for her)'
ابْنِهِ: ibn + -hi — ibn, son (m., gen. after maʿa) + -hi, his; 'with his son' (Kān Mā Kān)
وَأَشْجَعَ: وَ + أَشْجَع — wa-, and + ashjaʿ, bravest (elative of shujāʿ; acc., diptote, coordinated with adhkā, the complement of ṭalaʿā 'they turned out'); 'and the bravest'
بِعَوَاقِبِ: bi- + ʿawāqib — bi-, of (khibra takes bi-: experience of); ʿāqiba (pl. ʿawāqib), outcome, consequence (f., gen.); 'of the consequences (of affairs)'
عَاقِبَةِ: ʿāqiba, outcome, consequence (f., gen. in construct after fī, before shayʾ); 'the outcome (of anything)'
وَتَسُوقُ: وَ + تَسُوقُ — wa-, and + sāqa, to drive (a mount), ride hard (imperf. 3 f. sg.; here with bihi, 'with him'); 'and she rides hard (with him)'
الطَّعْنَ: al- + ṭaʿn — ṭaʿn, thrusting, stabbing (m. verbal noun, acc.); 'thrusting (with the lance)'
وَأَكْمَلَ: wa- + akmala — wa-, and; akmala, to complete (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV); 'and completed (the preparations)'
أُسَلْطِنَ: usalṭina, to make sultan, enthrone (imperf. 1 sg. subjunctive after an, form II, denominative); 'that I enthrone'
يُدْرِكَنِى: يُدْرِكَ + نِى — adraka, to overtake (form IV, imperf. 3 m. sg., subj. after ilā an) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'until (death) overtakes me'
نُوصِي: نُوصِي — awṣā, to charge, commend (form IV, imperf. 1 pl.); here awṣā X ʿalā Y, 'to charge X with the care of Y': the Chamberlain is charged, ʿalayhi the boy; 'we will charge (the Great Chamberlain) with him'
وَطِعَانِهِ: wa- + ṭiʿān + -hi — wa-, and; ṭiʿān, lance-fighting (m. verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his lance-fighting'
وَابْنَةَ: وَ + ابْنَة — wa-, and + ibna, daughter (f., acc.: coordinated with waladī, the noun of inna; construct with akhī); 'and (my brother's) daughter (Qaḍā Fakān)'
نَقَلَ: naqala, to transfer (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he transferred (to his son)'
مَدَى: مَدَى — madā, extent, span (m., acc. as adverb of time, construct with al-zamān / al-duhūr); 'for the length (of time)'
وَتُلَاحِظِي: wa- + tulāḥiẓī — wa-, and; lāḥaẓa, to watch over, regard (imperf. 2 f. sg. subjunctive, form III); 'and (that) you look after (his mother)'
وَبِنْتِ: wa- + bint — wa-, and; bint, daughter (f., gen., in construct, by coordination with the object of yūṣī ʿalā); 'and (the) daughter (of his brother)'
وَأَيَّامًا: wa- + ayyām — wa-, and; yawm (pl. ayyām), day (acc. indef., adverbial); 'and days'
يَتَعَاطَيٰ: yataʿāṭā, to undertake, take in hand (imperf. 3 m. sg., form VI); 'he handled (the affairs of the people)'
رَاحِلٌ: rāḥil, departing (act. part., m. sg., nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'departing'
وَالِدِى: wālid + -ī — wālid, father (m., vocative, in construct) + -ī, my; 'my father'
مَكْرِ: makr, cunning, plotting (m., gen. after min); 'the cunning (of the old woman)'
عِمَادُ: ʿimād, pillar, mainstay (m., nom. predicate of inna); 'the mainstay (of our kingdom)'
وَيَنْهَى: wa- + yanhā — wa-, and; nahā, to forbid (imperf. 3 m. sg.); 'and forbids'
الْأَمْرَاضُ: الـ + أَمْرَاض — al-, the + maraḍ (pl. amrāḍ), sickness (m. pl., nom., subject of tunhikuhu); 'the illnesses'
فَيَخْدُمُهُ: fa- + yakhdumu + -hu — fa-, and so; khadama, to serve (imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'and he serves him'
تَفَانى: tafānā, to pass away, be spent (perf. 3 m. sg., form VI); 'has been spent' (verse)
بَقِيْتُ: بَقِيتُ — baqiya, to remain (perf. 1 sg.; the print marks the long ī with a sukūn); 'I have remained' (verse)
اَعَزَّ: aʿazz, mightier, dearer (elative, m., predicate of kuntu); 'the mightiest' (verse)
لِوُلْدِيْ: لِـ + وُلْد + ـِي — li-, for (marks the one the hoped-for sight concerns: 'shall I see for my son …?') + wuld, child, son (by-form of walad; gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my son' (verse)
بِالْعِدَاةِ: bi- + al- + ʿidāt — bi-, with, upon (yaftiku takes bi-: strike at); ʿidāt, enemies (m. pl., gen.); 'upon the enemies'
السَّنَانِ: الـ + سِنَان — al-, the + sinān, spearhead, lance (m., gen., construct after ṭaʿn; the print points it sanān); 'the spear' (verse)
يَشْفِيْ: yashfī, to heal, satisfy (imperf. 3 m. sg., verse); 'he does not heal'
وَيَمْلِكُهَا: wa- + yamlikuhā — wa-, and; malaka, to rule, possess (imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, it (the lands); 'and rules it'
طَرَقَهُ: ṭaraqa + -hu — ṭaraqa, to befall, come upon at night (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hu, him; 'came upon him'
غَمٌّ: ghamm, grief, distress (m., nom. indef., subject of aṣāba); 'grief'
الزَّمَانُ: al- + zamān — zamān, time (m., nom., subject of maḍā); 'time'
وَجَعَلُوهُ: wa- + jaʿalū + -hu — wa-, and; jaʿala, to make, put (perf. 3 m. pl.) + -hu, him; 'and they put him' (Kān Mā Kān, in a separate place)
أُمُّ: umm, mother (f., nom., in construct before Kān Mā Kān); 'the mother (of Kān Mā Kān)'
قَصْدِ: qaṣd, going to, seeking out (m. verbal noun, gen. after min); 'going to (the Great Chamberlain)'
الْمَيِّتَ: al- + mayyit — mayyit, dead one, the deceased (m., acc. after inna); 'the dead man'
الدُّهُورِ: al- + duhūr — dahr (pl. duhūr), time, ages (m. pl., gen. in construct after mada); 'the ages'
تَحْكُمُونَ: taḥkumūna, to rule, judge (imperf. 2 m. pl.; bi- governed by the verb: ḥakama bi-l-ʿadl 'rule with justice'); 'you rule'
أُذُنَاكِ: udhn + ā + ki — udhn, ear (f., nom. dual in construct, -ā) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your two ears'
وَالْعِزِّ: wa- + al- + ʿizz — wa-, and; ʿizz, glory, might (m., gen. by coordination); 'and the glory'
وَخَانَنَا: wa- + khāna + -nā — wa-, and; khāna, to betray (perf. 3 m. sg.) + -nā, us; 'and betrayed us'
بِالْعُدْوَانِ: bi- + al- + ʿudwān — bi-, with, in (qaṣada takes bi-: 'set upon us with aggression'); ʿudwān, hostility, aggression (m., gen.); 'with hostility'
إِسْدَائِي: isdāʾ + -ī — isdāʾ, bestowing (verbal noun, form IV, m., gen. after baʿda) + -ī, my; 'my bestowing (of kindness)'
الرَّجُلُ: al- + rajul — rajul, man (m., nom., subject of māta); 'the man' (the head of the household)
بَادِي: bādī, manifest, showing (act. part., m. nom., construct, verse); 'showing' (death shows its wonders)
مَرَاحِلُ: marāḥil, stages of a journey (m. pl., nom., broken pl. of marḥala); 'stages'
بِالْمَصَائِبِ: bi- + al- + maṣāʾib — bi-, with (mamzūja takes bi-: 'mixed with'); muṣība (pl. maṣāʾib), misfortune (f., gen.); 'with misfortunes'
اَحَاطَتْ: aḥāṭat, to encompass, surround (perf. 3 f. sg., form IV; takes bi-); 'have encompassed'
تَذَكَّرَتْ: tadhakkarat, to remember (perf. 3 f. sg., form V); 'she remembered' (Nuzhat al-Zamān, remembered her brother Ḍawʾ al-Makān)
غَنِيَّةٌ: ghaniyya, rich, well-off (adj., f. sg., nom. indef., predicate); 'rich'
افْتِقَادَكِ: iftiqād + -ki — iftiqād, looking in on, visiting (verbal noun, form VIII, m., acc., object of tarakna) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'visiting you'
قَلْبِكِ: qalb + -ki — qalb, heart (m., gen. in construct after inkisār) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your heart'
بِبَالِكِ: bi- + bāl + -ki — bi-, in (khaṭara takes bi-: 'it occurs to'); bāl, mind (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'that it occur to your mind'
فَبَيْتُنَا: fa- + bayt + -nā — fa-, so; bayt, house (m., nom.) + -nā, our; 'so our house'
مَحَلُّكِ: maḥall + -ki — maḥall, dwelling place, abode (m., nom., predicate) + -ki, your (f.); 'your place'
مُلَاصِقًا: mulāṣiqan, adjoining, adjacent (act. part., m. acc. indef., ḥāl; takes li-: adjacent to her place); 'adjoining'
وَوَلَدُهَا: wa- + walad + -hā — wa-, and; walad, son (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her son' (Kān Mā Kān)
فَدَمَعَتْ: fa- + damaʿat — fa-, so; damaʿa, to well with tears (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'so (his eyes) shed tears'
فَانْظُرِيهَا: فَـ + انْظُرِي + هَا — fa-, then + naẓara, to look at, see (imper. 2 f. sg.) + -hā, it (the world); 'then look at it'
وَلِوَلَدِهِ: و + لِـ + وَلَد + ـهِ — wa-, and; li-, for (dative of benefit: the town was decked for him); walad, son (m.), gen. after li-; -hi, his; 'and for his son'
وَالْمَلَاهِي: و + الـ + مَلَاهِي — wa-, and; al-, the; malāhī, entertainments, pastimes (pl. of malhā, m.), nom. in a coordinated subject; 'and the entertainments'
تَمَلُّ: تَمَلُّ — tamallu, to tire of, grow weary of (imperf. 3 f. sg., indic.; the verb takes min, 'of'); 'she does not tire of'
وَيُنَادِمُ: و + يُنَادِمُ — wa-, and; yunādimu, to keep company with, be a boon companion to (III, imperf. 3 m. sg., indic.); 'and keeps kings company'
مُحَاصِرُونَ: مُحَاصِرُونَ — muḥāṣirūna, besiegers, besieging (act. part. III, m. pl. nom., predicate of hum, governing Constantinople in the acc.); 'besieging'
وَضَجِرَتِ: و + ضَجِرَتِ — wa-, and; ḍajira, to be weary, fed up (perf. 3 f. sg., with -ti vowel before al-); 'and the armies grew weary'
لِنَخْلُصَ: لِـ + نَخْلُصَ — li-, in order to (introduces purpose, with subjunctive); nakhluṣa, to be rid of, be quit of (imperf. 1 pl., subj.; takes min); 'in order to free ourselves of the vengeance'
حَسْرَتَيْنِ: حَسْرَتَيْنِ — ḥasratayni, two griefs (dual of ḥasra, f., acc.-gen. dual, predicate of ṣāra, 'became'); 'two griefs'
عَمِلَتِ: عَمِلَتِ — ʿamilat, to make, to work (perf. 3 f. sg., -ti vowel before al-; the old queen, subject); ʿamila l-ḥīla, to contrive a trick; 'she contrived'
قَائِلُونَ: قَائِلُونَ — qāʾilūna, saying, those who say (act. part., m. pl. nom.); mā antum qāʾilūna, 'what do you say?'
فَأَطْرَقُوا: فَ + أَطْرَقُوا — fa-, so, then; aṭraqū, to lower, bow (IV perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they bowed their heads'
وَالرَّأْىُ: و + الرَّأْىُ — wa-, and; al-raʾy, opinion, counsel, view (m., nom.; the printed spelling with ى stands for ي); 'and the opinion (is that)'
وَنَغْزُو: و + نَغْزُو — wa-, and; naghzū, to raid, make war on (imperf. 1 pl., indic., governing the infidel acc.); 'and we raid'
عِيَالِهِمْ: عِيَال + ـهِمْ — ʿiyāl, dependants, family (m. coll., gen. after ruʾya, annexed); -him, their; 'their families'
دُقَّتِ: دُقَّتِ — daqqa, to beat, strike (perf. passive 3 f. sg.; -ti before al-); of the kettledrums (al-kāsāt) sounding the march; 'were beaten'
بِقُدُومِهِمُ: بِـ + قُدُوم + ـِهِمُ — bi-, at, on (prep., 'at their arrival', causal with 'rejoiced'); qudūm, arrival (m. verbal noun, gen.); -himu, their; 'at their coming'
بِالْغُيَّابِ: بِـ + الـ + غُيَّاب — bi-, with (the verb iltaqā, 'meet', takes bi-: 'meet with'); al-, the; ghuyyāb, absentees (pl. of ghāʾib, gen.); 'met with the absent'
إِعْظَامًا: إِعْظَامًا — iʿẓāman, honouring, esteem (IV verbal noun, acc. as adverbial of purpose/reason); 'out of respect (for his right)'
فَعَظَّمَتْهُ: فَ + عَظَّمَتْ + هُ — fa-, so, then; ʿaẓẓamat, to honour, magnify (II perf. 3 f. sg., agreeing with the plural al-umarāʾ); -hu, him (the stoker); 'and the emirs honoured him'
وَسَمِنَ: و + سَمِنَ — wa-, and; samina, to grow fat (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and grew fat'
كَعُنُقِ: كَـ + عُنُق — ka-, like (prep., comparison); ʿunuq, neck (m., gen.), annexed to al-fīl, 'the elephant'; 'like the neck (of an elephant)'
طَأئِشَ: طَائِش — ṭāʾish, light, giddy (act. part. of ṭāsha; m. sg., acc. as the complement of ṣāra, construct with al-ʿaql; the print spells it طأئش); 'flighty (of mind)'
التَّحِيَّاتِ: الـ + تَّحِيَّات — al-, the; taḥiyyāt, greetings, salutations (pl. of taḥiyya, f., gen. in annexation after aʿẓam); 'the greatest of greetings'
وَاثِبًا: وَاثِب + ًا — wāthib, leaping, springing up (act. part., acc. indef., adverbial ḥāl); 'jumping up'
وَصَاحِبَكَ: و + صَاحِب + كَ — wa-, and; ṣāḥib, companion, friend (m., acc. as second predicate of kāna); -ka, your; 'and your companion'
يَسْمَحَ: يَسْمَحَ — yasmaḥa, to be generous, grant (imperf. 3 m. sg., subj. after an; takes li- 'to me' and bi- 'with it'); 'he will not grant'
الشَّيْءَ: الـ + شَّيْء — al-, the; shayʾ, thing (m., acc., object of atamannā); 'the thing'
وَوَلَّاكَ: و + وَلَّاك — wa-, and; wallā, to appoint (as governor) (II perf. 3 m. sg.); -ka, you (acc.); 'and appointed you (over it)'
حَضْرَتِكَ: حَضْرَة + ـِكَ — ḥaḍra, presence, court (f., gen. after fī); -ka, your; 'in your presence'
تَسْمَحَ: تَسْمَحَ — tasmaḥa, to be generous, grant (imperf. 2 m. sg., subj. after an); 'that you not grant'
تَكْتُبَ: تَكْتُبَ — taktuba, to write (imperf. 2 m. sg., subj. after an); 'that you write (for me a decree)'
فَلَكَزَهُ: فَ + لَكَزَ + هُ — fa-, so, then; lakaza, to punch, jab (perf. 3 m. sg.); -hu, him (the stoker); 'and he jabbed him'
رَئِيسَ: رَئِيس — raʾīs, chief, head (m., acc. second object of jaʿala, 'make'), annexed to al-zabbālīn, 'the dung-men'; 'chief (of the dung-men)'
ظُهُورِهِمْ: ظُهُور + ـِهِمْ — ẓuhūr, backs (pl. of ẓahr, gen. after ʿalā); -him, their; 'on their backs'
لَائِقًا: لَائِق + ًا — lāʾiq, fitting, suitable (act. part., acc. indef., adj. of shayʾan, takes bi- 'to'); lāʾiqan bi-maqāminā, 'befitting our rank'
بِوَضْعِ: بِـ + وَضْع — bi-, to (the verb amara takes bi-: 'order something'); waḍʿ, placing (m. verbal noun, gen.), annexed to kursī, 'chair'; 'ordered the placing (of a chair)'
الْعَوْدَ: الـ + عَوْد — al-, the; ʿawd, return (m. verbal noun, acc. object of aradta); 'the return'
يُخْرِجُوا: يُخْرِجُوا — yukhrijū, to bring out, provide (IV imperf. 3 m. pl., subj. after an); 'that they bring out'
سَلْطَنَةٍ: سَلْطَنَة — salṭana, sultanate, royal state (f., gen. in annexation after ṭaqm); ṭaqm salṭana, 'a set of royal regalia'
وَيُقَدِّمْ: و + يُقَدِّمْ — wa-, and; yuqaddim, to present (II imperf. 3 m. sg., jussive after the li-/fa- imperative 'let him honour'); 'and let him present'
الزَّبَلْكَانَ: الـ + زَّبَلْكَان — al-, the; al-Zabalkān, 'the dung-man', the former stoker made viceroy of Damascus (second object of sammā, acc.); 'al-Zabalkān'
حَوَائِجُهُ: حَوَائِج + ـُهُ — ḥawāʾij, needs, belongings, equipment (pl. of ḥāja, f., nom. subject); -hu, his; 'his outfit'
إِذْنًا: إِذْن + ًا — idhn, permission, leave (m., acc. object of yaṭlubu); idhnan bi-l-safar, 'permission for the journey'
لِلْجِهَادِ: لِـ + الـ + جِهَاد — li-, for (purpose); al-, the; jihād, struggle, holy war (m., gen.); 'for the jihad'
أَوْصَاهُ: أَوْصَى + هُ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (form IV, perf. 3 m. sg.; the matter enjoined takes bi-) + -hu, him (al-Zabalkān); 'he charged him'
فَبَلَغُوا: فَ + بَلَغُوا — fa-, so, then; balaghū, to reach, amount to (perf. 3 m. pl., the mamluks and servants); 'and they came to'
الزَّبَلْكَانُ: الـ + زَّبَلْكَان — al-, the; al-Zabalkān, 'the dung-man', the former stoker made viceroy of Damascus (nom. in apposition after al-sulṭān); 'the Sultan al-Zabalkān'
مَنَازِلَ: مَنَازِل — manāzil, ranks, stations (pl. of manzil, m., acc. object of yuʿarrifu); 'the ranks (of the emirs)'
وَأَنْفَقَهَا: و + أَنْفَقَ + هَا — wa-, and; anfaqa, to spend, distribute (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); -hā, them (the treasures, f. pl. as fem. sg.); 'and spent them'
قَرِيبُ: قَرِيب — qarīb, near, recent (m., nom. predicate of anta, in annexation to ʿahd); qarību ʿahdin bi-l-mulk, 'new to rule'; also predicate of dhikruhu, at the rhyme (tanwīn dropped): dhikruhu minnī qarību, 'the thought of him is near me' (Night 194, verse)
وَنُرْسِلُ: و + نُرْسِلُ — wa-, and; nursilu, to send (IV imperf. 1 pl., indic.; takes ilayka, 'to you'); 'and we shall send to you'
لِيُدَبِّرَهَا: لِـ + يُدَبِّر + هَا — li-, in order to (purpose, with subjunctive); yudabbira, to manage, govern (II imperf. 3 m. sg., subj.); -hā, it (his kingdom); 'to govern it'
الزَّبَلْكَانِ: الـ + زَّبَلْكَان — al-, the; al-Zabalkān, 'the dung-man', the former stoker made viceroy of Damascus (gen. annexed after al-sulṭān); 'Sultan al-Zabalkān'
الْمُجَاهِدِ: الـ + مُجَاهِد — al-, the; al-Mujāhid, 'the Fighter (for the faith)', the honorific title given to al-Zabalkān (III act. part., gen. in apposition); 'al-Mujāhid'
وَحُلِيًّا: و + حُلِيًّا — wa-, and; ḥuliyyan, jewellery, ornaments (pl. of ḥalī, acc. coordinate with maṣāghan, 'trinkets'); 'and jewels'
أَذْكَى: أَذْكَى — adhkā, cleverest, sharpest (elative of dhakī, acc., annexed to ahl); 'the most intelligent (of the people of their age)'
وَعَقْلٍ: و + عَقْل — wa-, and; ʿaql, intellect, reason (m., gen. coordinate with tadbīr); 'and reason'
سَمْحًا: سَمْح + ًا — samḥ, generous, open-handed (m., acc. predicate of ṭalaʿa, 'turned out', Kān Mā Kān); 'open-handed'
قَضَيٰ: قَضَى — Qaḍā (printed with ى for ā; read as the name; in this text the name is Qaḍā Fakān, Sharrukān's daughter, nom. as subject of ṣārat); 'Qaḍā (Fakān)'
وَتُوَسِّعُ: و + تُوَسِّعُ — wa-, and; tuwassiʿu, to widen, give room (II imperf. 3 f. sg.); tuwassiʿu fī l-barr, 'she ranges widely over the open country'
اثْنَتَىْ: اثْنَتَيْ — ithnatay, two (f., construct form with ʿashra, 'twelve'; ithnatay ʿashrata sana, 'twelve years'); 'twelve'
وَالِاسْتِعْدَادَ: و + الـ + اِسْتِعْدَاد — wa-, and; al-, the; istiʿdād, preparation, readiness (X verbal noun, acc. coordinate with al-uhba); 'and the readiness'
وَأَفْرَحَ: وَ + أَفْرَحَ — wa-, and + fariḥa, to rejoice (form I, imperf. 1 sg., subj. after an; with bihi, 'in him'); 'and (that I) rejoice (in him)'
لِخَصْلَتَيْنِ: لِـ + خَصْلَتَيْنِ — li-, because of (causal 'for'); khaṣlatayni, two traits, two reasons (dual of khaṣla, f., gen. dual); 'for two reasons'
بَدَالَكَ: بَدَا + لَكَ — badā, to appear, seem good (perf. 3 m. sg.; ma badā laka, 'whatever seems good to you'; li- 'to you' marks the experiencer); 'whatever you see fit'
وَصِيٌّ: وَصِيّ — waṣiyy, guardian, executor (m. sg., nom. predicate of huwa); 'a guardian'
زَوَّجْتُهَا: زَوَّجْتُ + هَا — zawwajtu, to marry off (II perf. 1 sg.); -hā, her (acc.; takes bi-hi, 'to him', the person married to); 'I have married her'
وَلَدَايَ: وَلَدَا + يَ — waladā, two children (dual nom. in annexation); -ya, my; 'my two children'
وَأَمِنْتُ: و + أَمِنْتُ — wa-, and; amintu, to feel safe (perf. 1 sg.; takes ʿalā 'about, for'); 'and I feel at ease about'
يُوصِى: يُوصِي — yūṣī, to charge, commend (IV imperf. 3 m. sg., indic.; takes the person in acc., the matter with ʿalā: 'concerning'); 'he charged'
وَزَوْجَتِهِ: و + زَوْجَة + ـِهِ — wa-, and; zawja, wife (f., gen. coordinate with ibnat akhīhi after ʿalā); -hi, his; 'and his wife'
بِكَأْسِ: بِـ + كَأْس — bi-, 'of' (the verb ayqana takes bi-: 'be certain of'); kaʾs, cup (f., gen.), annexed to al-ḥimām, 'death'; 'certain of the cup of death'
أَحْكَامَ: أَحْكَام — aḥkām, judgments, rulings (pl. of ḥukm, m., acc. object of yatʿāṭā); 'the rulings (of the people)'
حَسْرَةٌ: حَسْرَة — ḥasra, grief, regret (f. sg., nom. indef., subject of baqiya); 'a regret'
جَدِّكَ: جَدّ + ـِكَ — jadd, grandfather (m., gen. annexed to ʿUmar b. al-Nuʿmān); -ka, your; 'your grandfather'
وَاقْبَلْ: و + اِقْبَلْ — wa-, and; iqbal, to accept (imp. 2 m. sg.); 'and accept'
مُلْكِنَا: مُلْك + ـِنَا — mulk, kingdom, rule (m., gen. in annexation after ʿimād); -nā, our; 'our kingdom's mainstay'
بِمَرَضِهِ: بِـ + مَرَض + ـِهِ — bi-, with (the passive adj. mashghūl takes bi-: 'occupied with'); maraḍ, illness (m., gen.); -hi, his; 'busy with his illness'
رُكُوبَ: رُكُوب — rukūb, riding (m. verbal noun, acc. after illā, annexed to al-khayl); 'riding (horses)'
عَادَتِهِمَا: عَادَة + ـِهِمَا — ʿāda, habit, custom (f., gen. after ʿalā); -himā, their (dual); 'as is their habit'
قُوَّتِيْ: قُوَّتِي — quwwatī, my strength (f., nom., subject of tafānā; the final ي is the 1 sg. pronoun -ī, here with printed sukūn); 'my strength'
تَرَانِيْ: تَرَى + نِي — raʾā, to see (imperf. 2 m. sg. tarā) + -nī, me (object pronoun with its supporting nūn; the print marks the final ī with a sukūn); 'you see me' (verse)
وَاَسْبَقَهُمْ: وَ + أَسْبَقَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + asbaq, swiftest, foremost (elative of sabaqa; acc., coordinated with aʿazza, the predicate of kuntu) + -hum, of them; 'and the swiftest of them' (verse)
مَكَانِيْ: مَكَان + ـِي — makān, place (m., acc. used loosely as adverb of place, 'in my place') + -ī, my; 'in my place' (verse)
ثَارِ: ثَار — thār, vengeance, blood-revenge (m., gen., after li-akhdhi); li-akhdhi thārin, 'to take vengeance'
الْمَغْبُوْنُ: الـ + مَغْبُون — al-, the; maghbūn, cheated, the one wronged (pass. part., nom. predicate); anā l-maghbūn, 'I am the one cheated'
جِنَانِيْ: جِنَان + ـِي — janān, heart, inmost self (m., acc., object of yashfī; the print points it jinān) + -ī, my; 'my heart' (verse)
وَتُطِيعُهُ: و + تُطِيعُ + هُ — wa-, and; tuṭīʿu, to obey (IV imperf. 3 f. sg. as the pl. al-ʿibād), -hu, him; 'and the people obey him'
فَأَصَابَ: فَ + أَصَابَ — fa-, so, then; aṣāba, to befall, strike (IV perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and there befell'
الْوَضِيعُ: الـ + وَضِيع — al-, the; waḍīʿ, lowly, humble (m., nom. subject of bakā); 'the lowly (and the great)'
وَتَغَيَّرَ: و + تَغَيَّرَ — wa-, and; taghayyara, to change (V perf. 3 m. sg.); ḥāl, state (subject); 'and the state of Kān Mā Kān changed'
وَعِيَالَهُ: و + عِيَال + هُ — wa-, and; ʿiyāl, dependants, family (acc. coordinate with the pronoun object); -hu, his; 'and his family'
أَذَلِّ: أَذَلّ — adhall, most abject, lowest (elative of dhalīl, gen. in annexation to al-aḥwāl, after fī); 'in the most abject of states'
الرَّأْفَةَ: الـ + رَّأْفَة — al-, the; raʾfa, tenderness, compassion (f., acc. object of arjū); 'the mercy'
صَاحِبٌ: صَاحِب — ṣāḥib, friend, protector (m., nom. indef., subject: 'has no protector'); 'a friend'; here: 'a friend' (kāna lī ṣāḥibun, 'I had a friend')
وَالْأَعْوَامِ: و + الـ + أَعْوَام — wa-, and; al-, the; aʿwām, years (pl. of ʿām, m., gen. coordinate with al-duhūr after madā); 'and years'
الْخَاصِّ: الـ + خَاصّ — al-, the; khāṣṣ, the elect, the particular (m., gen. after bayna); 'the elite (and the common)'
وَرَأَتْ: و + رَأَتْ — wa-, and; raʾat, to see (perf. 3 f. sg., subject ʿaynāki, 'your eyes'); 'and your eyes saw'
وَالْجَاهِ: و + الـ + جَاه — wa-, and; al-, the; jāh, rank, standing (m., gen. coordinate); 'and status'
وَالْأَوَانُ: و + الـ + أَوَان — wa-, and; al-, the; awān, time, the (fitting) hour (m., nom. coordinate with al-dahr, subject of khānanā); 'and the time (betrayed us)'
قَاصِدَةً: قَاصِدَة + ً — qāṣida, intending, seeking (act. part. f., acc. indef., ḥāl, governing iḥsānaki); 'seeking (your kindness)'
لِلْإِحْسَانِ: لِـ + الـ + إِحْسَان — li-, for, towards (iṣdāʾ takes li-); al-, the; iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (IV verbal noun, gen.); 'for benefaction'
ذَلَّتْ: ذَلَّتْ — dhalla, to be humbled, brought low (perf. 3 f. sg., with the plural subject al-nisāʾ wa-al-banāt coming after it); 'are brought low'
الْاَعْمَارِ: الـ + أَعْمَار — al-, the + ʿumr (pl. aʿmār), lifetime (m. pl., gen., construct after ghāʾib); ghāʾibu al-aʿmāri, 'what is hidden of lifetimes' (the unknown hour of death) (verse)
مَوَارِدُهَا: مَوَارِد + ُهَا — mawārid, watering places, sources (pl. of mawrid, m., nom. subject); -hā, its; 'their watering-places'
ضَرَّ: ضَرَّ — ḍarra, to harm (perf. 3 m. sg.); mā ḍarra qalbī mithlu, 'nothing hurt my heart like'
مُسْتَعْظَمَاتُ: مُسْتَعْظَمَات — mustaʿẓamāt, grave, awesome (X pass. part., f. pl., nom. subject of aḥāṭat, annexed to al-nawāʾib); 'the great (calamities)'
وَابْنَهُ: و + اِبْن + هُ — wa-, and; ibn, son (m., acc. coordinate with akhāhā); -hu, his; 'and his son'
فَقِيرَةٌ: فَقِيرَة — faqīra, poor (f., nom. predicate of anti); 'poor'
إِلَّاخَوْفًا: إِلَّا + خَوْفًا — illā, except, only; khawfan, fear, apprehension (m., acc. adverbial of reason; printed run together); 'only out of fear'
لِئَلَّا: لِ + أَنْ + لَا — li-, so that (final, 'in order that'); an, that; lā, not; li-allā, so that not, lest (with yakhṭura, subj.); 'lest'
نُهْدِيهِ: نُهْدِي + هِ — nuhdī, to give as a gift (IV imperf. 1 pl.); -hi, it (the relative's returning pronoun); 'what we send as a gift'
بَيْتُكِ: بَيْت + ُكِ — bayt, house (m., nom. predicate); -ki, your (f.); 'is your house'
وَعَلَيْكِ: و + عَلَيْ + كِ — wa-, and; ʿalā, upon (prep., 'incumbent on'); -ki, you (f.); 'and upon you (is what is upon us)'
لِمَكَانِهَا: لِ + مَكَان + ِهَا — li-, to, next to (mulāṣiq, 'adjoining', takes li-); makān, place (m., gen.); -hā, her; 'adjoining her place'
خِدْمَتِهِمَا: خِدْمَة + ِهِمَا — khidma, service (f., gen., annexed after bi-rasmi, 'for the purpose of'); -himā, their (dual); 'to serve them both'
الدُّنْيَا: الـ + دُّنْيَا — al-, the; dunyā, the world (f., acc. object of tanẓurī); 'the world'
فَأَكْرِمِي: فَ + أَكْرِمِي — fa-, so, then; akrimī, to honour (IV imp. 2 f. sg.); 'then show honour (to her dwelling)'
وَوَلَدُهُ: و + وَلَد + ـهُ — walad, son (m.), 'and his son'; wa-, and; -hu, his (3 m. sg.); nom. subject: 'and his son Tāj al-Mulūk at his side'
تُجَلِّى: تُجَلِّى — jallā, to display (the bride) in her gowns (form II, imperf. 3 f. sg., active; subject al-mawāshiṭ, the tirewomen; the object, the Lady Dunyā, is marked with li-; printed with ى for ي); 'they display'
يَمْلَلْنَ: يَمْلَلْنَ — malla, to tire of (imperf. 3 f. pl., indic., negated by lā; the doubled lām is split before -na; takes min); 'they do not tire (of looking at her)'
وَيَسْلُكُ: و + يَسْلُكُ — salaka, to follow a course, to proceed (imperf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and follows the best conduct (in managing them)'
فَاشْتَاقُوا: فَـ + اشْتَاقُوا — ishtāqa, to long (for) (perf. 3 m. pl., form VIII; the verb takes ilā for the object longed for); fa-, so, and so; 'so they longed (for their homelands)'
وَالْحِصَارِ: و + الـ + حِصَار — ḥiṣār, siege (m.; gen. after min); wa-, and; 'and the siege'
فَقُتِلَ: فَـ + قُتِلَ — qutila, to be killed (perf. passive 3 m. sg., qatala); fa-, and so; 'so was killed (from among us) my brother Sharrukān'
وَالْمُصِيبَةُ: و + الـ + مُصِيبَة — muṣība, calamity (f., nom. sg.); wa-, and; 'and the calamity (became two calamities)'
الْتَزَمْتُ: iltazamtu, to bind oneself, to undertake a vow (perf. 1 sg., form VIII); 'I have bound myself (and sworn great oaths)'
فَافْهَمُوا: فَـ + افْهَمُوا — fahima, to understand (imperative 2 m. pl.); fa-, so; 'so understand this speech'
الرَّأْيُ: الـ + رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m., nom.); subject of a verbless clause whose predicate is li-l-wazīr (li-, belonging to, 'rests with'); 'the counsel rests with the vizier Dandān'
وَنُقِيمُ: و + نُقِيمُ — aqāma, to stay, dwell (imperf. 1 pl., form IV); wa-, and; 'and we shall stay (there awhile)'
الْأَوْثَانِ: الـ + أَوْثَان — wathan, idol (m.; pl. awthān, gen. in iḍāfa after ʿabadat, 'worshippers of'); 'the idols'
فَابْتَدَؤُا: فَـ + ابْتَدَؤُا — ibtadaʾa, to begin (perf. 3 m. pl., form VIII; the verb takes fī 'in/with' for what is begun); fa-, so; 'so they began (preparing their affairs)'
الْكَاسَاتُ: الـ + كَاسَات — al-, the + kāsa (pl. kāsāt), bowl; here the bowl-shaped kettledrums of the army (f. pl., nom., subject of the passive duqqat); 'the kettledrums'
وَالْبَأْسُ: وَ + الـ + بَأْس — wa-, and + al-, the + baʾs, hardship, distress (m., nom., coordinated with al-hamm; printed without hamza, الباس, rhyming with al-nās); 'and the distress'
وَيَرْكَبُ: و + يَرْكَبُ — rakiba, to ride (imperf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and rides'
لِحَقِّهِ: لِـ + حَقّ + ـهِ — ḥaqq, right, due, standing (m., gen.); li-, because of, out of (reason); -hi, his; 'in honour of his standing'
وَعَظَّمَهُ: و + عَظَّمَ + ـهُ — ʿaẓẓama, to honour, magnify (perf. 3 m. sg., form II); wa-, and; -hu, him; 'and the vizier honoured him'
وَالرَّاحَةِ: و + الـ + رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, ease (f., gen. after min, coordinated with al-akl); wa-, and; 'and from rest' (he grew fat from eating and rest)
كَبَطْنِ: كَـ + بَطْن — baṭn, belly (m., gen.); ka-, like (comparison); 'like the belly (of a dolphin)'
بِسِيمَاهُ: بِـ + سِيمَا + ـهُ — sīmā, mark, look, features (f., gen.); bi-, by (means of); -hu, his; 'did not recognise the king by his features'
فَأَمْعَنَ: فَـ + أَمْعَنَ — amʿana, to look closely (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV; amʿana fī 'to scrutinise'); fa-, so; 'so he examined (him closely)'
عَمِلَكَ: ʿamila + ـكَ — ʿamila, to make, appoint (perf. 3 m. sg., with two accusatives); -ka, you; 'who made you sultan?'
تَتَمَنَّ: tatamanna, to wish for (jussive 2 m. sg., form V tamannā, after lā); 'do not wish for (anything but something great)'
يَقْدِرَ: yaqdira, to be able (subjunctive 3 m. sg., qadara; takes ʿalā 'to have power over'); 'or not be able (to give) it'
أَحْلُمُ: aḥlumu, to dream (imperf. 1 sg., ḥalama; takes bi- for what is dreamt of); 'I dream (of it)'
أَيَّامُ: ayyām, days (pl. of yawm, m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the days (of my sitting in your presence)'
الْآنِ: الـ + آن — āna, now (m.; gen. after ilā); 'until now'
لَشَارَكْتُكَ: لَـ + شَارَكْتُ + كَ — shāraka, to share with (perf. 1 sg., form III); la-, then (apodosis of law); -ka, you; 'I would have shared (it) with you'
بِعِرَافَةِ: بِـ + عِرَافَة — ʿirāfa, headship, office of chief (f., gen.); bi-, concerning, for (marks what the decree is about, with 'write a decree'); 'a decree for the chiefship (of all the stokers)'
وَأَسْرِعْ: و + أَسْرِعْ — asraʿa, to hurry (imperative 2 m. sg., form IV); wa-, and; 'and hurry'
الزَّبَّالِينَ: الـ + زَبَّالِين — zabbāl, dung-man, scavenger (m.; gen. pl. in iḍāfa after raʾīs); 'the dung-men (of the city)'
تَضْرِبَنِي: taḍribanī, to strike (subjunctive 2 m. sg. after ḥattā, with nūn al-wiqāya; ḍaraba) + -ī, me; 'so that you strike me'
بِمَقَامِنَا: بِـ + مَقَام + نَا — maqām, station, rank (m., gen.); bi-, to, with (the adjective lāʾiq 'befitting' takes bi-); -nā, our; 'befitting our rank'
النِّيَابَةِ: الـ + نِيَابَة — niyāba, deputyship, viceroyalty (f., gen. in iḍāfa after khilʿa, 'robe of'); 'the robe of viceroyalty'
وَجِئْتَ: و + جِئْتَ — jāʾa, to come (perf. 2 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and you come'
وَتَخْتًا: و + تَخْت + ًا — takht, throne, couch (m., acc., object of yukhrijū); wa-, and; 'and a new throne'
يُحِبُّنِي: yuḥibbu + nī — aḥabba, to love (imperf. 3 m. sg., form IV); -nī, me; 'whoever loves me'
هِمَّتِهِ: هِمَّة + هِ — himma, aspiration, means, generosity (f., gen. after qadr, 'in proportion to'); -hi, his; 'according to his means'
وَلَقَّبَهُ: و + لَقَّبَ + هُ — laqqaba, to give a title (perf. 3 m. sg., form II; the title takes bi-, 'with'); wa-, and; -hu, him; 'and gave him the title (al-Mujāhid)'
لِيُوَدِّعَهُ: لِـ + يُوَدِّعَ + هُ — wadda'a, to bid farewell (subjunctive 3 m. sg., form II); li-, in order to (purpose); -hu, him; 'to bid him farewell'
وَعَانَقَةُ: و + عَانَقَ + هُ — ʿānaqa, to embrace (perf. 3 m. sg., form III; spelled with final ة for ه); wa-, and; -hu, him; 'and embraced him'
الْمُسَمَّى: الـ + مُسَمَّى — musammā, named, called (passive participle, form II, sammā; nom., agreeing with al-Malik al-Mujāhid; the name follows with bi-); 'the one called (al-Zabalkān, the former stoker made viceroy of Damascus)'
بِالرَّعِيَّةِ: بِـ + الـ + رَعِيَّة — raʿiyya, subjects, flock (f., gen.); bi-, with, concerning (awṣā 'to charge' takes bi-); 'charged him (with) the subjects (well)'
رُسْتَمُ: Rustam, Persian commander (muqaddam al-ʿAjam), after the hero of the Shāhnāma; nom.; 'Rustam, commander of the Persians'
سَلْطَنَ: salṭana, to make sultan (perf. 3 m. sg., form II); 'made (a man) sultan over Damascus' (al-Zabalkān, the former stoker)
وَمَرَاتِبَهُمْ: و + مَرَاتِب + هُمْ — martaba, rank (f.; pl. marātib, acc., coordinated with manāzil); wa-, and; -hum, their; 'and their ranks'
وَصَغِيرًا: و + صَغِير + ًا — ṣaghīr, small, young (adj., acc. as hāl/adverbial with kabīran); wa-, and; 'great and small'
عَهْدٍ: ʿahd, term, time (m., gen. in iḍāfa after qarīb); qarīb ʿahd bi-l-mulk 'newly come to kingship'; 'recent (in rule)'
تَهَيَّأَ: tahayyaʾa, to get ready (perf. 3 m. sg., form V); 'when the vizier Dandān had made ready (for the journey)'
وَاهْتَمَّ: و + اهْتَمَّ — ihtamma, to be concerned (perf. 3 m. sg., form VIII; takes bi- 'with, about'); wa-, and; 'and busied himself (with weapons)'
بِقَضَى: بِـ + قَضَى — Qaḍā (Fakān), Sharrukān's daughter, taken with the next word; bi-, with (accompaniment); 'with Qaḍā Fakān'
وَالرَّاحَةَ: و + الـ + رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, ease (f., acc., after dūnaka 'take, have'); wa-, and; 'and rest'
يُبَيِّتُوهَا: yubayyitū + hā — bayyata, to lodge for the night (subjunctive 3 m. pl., form II, after an); -hā, her; 'that they should lodge her (with his son Kān Mā Kān)'
زَمَانِهِمَا: zamān, time, age (m., gen. in iḍāfa after ahl); -himā, their (dual); 'of their age'
وَخِبْرَةٍ: و + خِبْرَة — khibra, experience, knowledge (f., gen.); wa-, and; 'and experience (in the outcome of affairs)'
يُفَكِّرُ: yufakkiru, to think (imperf. 3 m. sg., form II; fakkara fī 'to think about'); 'who did not think (of the outcome of anything)'
وَتَطْلُعُ: و + تَطْلُعُ — ṭalaʿa, to go out (imperf. 3 f. sg.); wa-, and; 'and goes out (with her cousin)'
وَيَتَعَلَّمَانِ: و + يَتَعَلَّمَانِ — taʿallama, to learn (imperf. 3 m. dual, form V); wa-, and; 'and the two learn (sword-play)'
أَشْغَالُهُ: ashghāl, affairs, tasks (pl. of shughl, m., nom.); -hu, his; 'his tasks (for the jihad) were finished'
اطِّلَاعَكَ: اطِّلَاع + ـَكَ — iṭṭilāʿ, being informed, acquaintance (verbal noun of form VIII iṭṭalaʿa; takes ʿalā for the thing learned; acc., object of urīdu) + -ka, your; 'your being informed (of it)'
وَأُقَاتِلَ: و + أُقَاتِلَ — qātala, to fight (subjunctive 1 sg., form III, after an); wa-, and; 'and fight (before him)'
وَالثَّانِيَةُ: و + الـ + ثَانِيَة — thāniya, second (f. adj., nom.); wa-, and; 'and the second (matter)'
مُطِيعُونَ: muṭīʿūna, obedient (active participle, form IV aṭāʿa, nom. m. pl.; governs amraka in the accusative); 'we are obedient (to your command)'
غَرِيسُ: gharīs, one reared, creature (m., nom.; gharīs niʿmatika 'reared by your bounty'); 'I am only the creature of your favour'
وَأَشْهَدَ: و + أَشْهَدَ — ashhada, to call as witness (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV; the matter takes ʿalā); wa-, and; 'and called the attendants to witness (that)'
وَتَعِيشُ: و + تَعِيشُ — ʿāsha, to live (imperf. 2 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and may you live (for them)'
تُلَاحِظِيهِ: tulāḥiẓī + hi — lāḥaẓa, to watch over (subjunctive 2 f. sg., form III, after an); -hi, him; 'that you look after him (with your eye)'
وَنُزْهَةَ: و + نُزْهَة — Nuzhat (al-Zamān), Ḍawʾ al-Makān's sister, taken with the next word; wa-, and; acc. object of yūṣī; 'and Nuzhat al-Zamān'
لَيَالِيَ: layālī, nights (pl. of layla, f.; acc. with final -iya); 'nights (and days)'; here: object of arat, layāliya arbaʿan, 'four nights'
الْحِمَامِ: الـ + حِمَام — ḥimām, fate, death (m., gen. after kaʾs); kaʾs al-ḥimām 'the cup of death'; 'death'
بَعْدِى: baʿd, after (m., gen. in min baʿdī); -ī, my; 'after me'
يُزِيلُهَا: yuzīlu + hā — azāla, to remove (imperf. 3 m. sg., form IV); -hā, it (the pang); 'which God will remove (by your hand)'
وَعَمِّكَ: و + عَمّ + كَ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen. coordinated with jaddika); wa-, and; -ka, your; 'and your uncle (King Sharrukān)'
يَقُولُهُ: yaqūlu + hu — qāla, to say (imperf. 3 m. sg.); -hu, it (relative object); 'what he says (to you)'
وَيَأْمُرُ: و + يَأْمُرُ — amara, to command (imperf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and commands (and forbids)'
تُنْهِكُهُ: tunhiku + hu — anhaka, to exhaust (imperf. 3 f. sg., form IV); -hu, him; 'illnesses kept wearing him down'
فَيَجِدُهَا: فَـ + يَجِدُ + هَا — wajada, to find (imperf. 3 m. sg.); fa-, then; -hā, her; 'then he finds her (sitting)'
التَّوَجُّعَاتُ: الـ + تَوَجُّعَات — tawajjuʿ, aching, pain (m.; pl. tawajjuʿāt, nom.); 'the pains (grew long on Ḍawʾ al-Makān)'
وَمَضىٰ: و + مَضَى — maḍā, to pass (perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; 'and (my) time has passed' (verse)
فَيَوْمَ: فَـ + يَوْم — yawm, day (m., acc. adverbial in iḍāfa); fa-, so, for; 'on the day (of glory)' (verse)
الْاَمَانِيْ: الـ + أَمَانِي — umniya, wish (f.; pl. amānī, gen. in iḍāfa after nayl, with -ī by rhyme); 'the attainment of wishes' (verse)
وَيَفْتِكُ: و + يَفْتِكُ — fataka, to attack, strike down (imperf. 3 m. sg.; takes bi- 'to assault' the enemy); wa-, and; 'and strikes (the enemies)' (verse)
طَعْنِ: طَعْن — ṭaʿn, thrusting (m. verbal noun, gen., coordinated by aw with ḍarb after bi-; construct with al-sinān); 'the thrust (of the spear)' (verse)
هَزْلٍ: هَزْل — hazl, jesting (m., gen. after fī 'in'; opposed to jidd 'earnest'); 'in jest (and earnest)' (verse)
فَغَفَلَتْ: فَـ + غَفَلَتْ — ghafala, to doze off (perf. 3 f. sg.; the subject is ʿayn 'eye'); fa-, so; 'so his eye drowsed (and he slept)'
الْعِبَادُ: الـ + عِبَاد — ʿabd, servant, subject; pl. ʿibād (m., nom., with the 3 f. sg. verb tuṭīʿu); 'the people (will obey him)'
لِمَوْتِهِ: لِـ + مَوْت + هِ — mawt, death (m., gen.); li-, on account of, at; -hi, his; 'at his death (great grief struck Baghdad)'
وَالْعَظِيمُ: و + الـ + عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great, eminent (adj. as noun, m., nom.); wa-, and; 'and the great (as well as the lowly)'
وَعَزَلَهُ: و + عَزَلَ + هُ — ʿazala, to set apart, dismiss (perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; -hu, him (Kān Mā Kān); 'and the people of Baghdad set him aside'
حِدَتِهِمْ: حِدَة + هِمْ — ḥida, separateness (f., gen. after ʿalā); ʿalā ḥidatihim 'on their own'; -him, their; 'by themselves'
لَابُدَّ: لَا + بُدَّ — lā budda, 'there is no escape', i.e. must (lā of absolute negation + budd, escape, acc. without tanwīn); here lā budda annī sa-atamannā, 'I shall certainly wish'; 'there is no help for it'
اللَّطِيفِ: الـ + لَطِيف — laṭīf, subtle, kind (m., gen. after min); al-Laṭīf al-Khabīr, epithets of God; 'the Subtle, the All-Aware (God)'
أَحْوَجَكُمُ: aḥwaja + kum — aḥwaja, to make needy (perf. 3 m. sg., form IV, with fa-lā optative negative 'may He never'); -kum, you (pl.); 'may God never make you needy'
زِلْتُمْ: zil + tum — zāla, to cease (perf. 2 m. pl.; lā zāla 'never cease', optative 'may you ever'); -tum, you (pl.); 'may you never cease (ruling with justice)'
وَالْعَامِّ: و + الـ + عَامّ — ʿāmm, common, general (adj. as noun, m., gen. after bayna); wa-, and; 'and the common (people)'
كُنَّا: kun + nā — kāna, to be (perf. 1 pl.); -nā, we; mā kunnā fīhi 'what we were in'; 'what we were (in of kingship)'
وَالْحَالِ: و + الـ + حَال — ḥāl, state, condition (m., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; 'and circumstance'
وَقَصَدَنَا: و + قَصَدَ + نَا — qaṣada, to aim at, assail (perf. 3 m. sg.); wa-, and; -nā, us; (bi-l-ʿudwān, 'with hostility'); 'and it set upon us (in aggression)'
إِحْسَانَكِ: iḥsān + ki — iḥsān, kindness, beneficence (m., acc., object of qāṣida); -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your kindness'
لِأَنَّهُ: لِـ + أَنَّ + هُ — li-, because (causal); anna, that; -hu, it/he (pron. of the statement); 'because (if the man dies...)'
النِّسَاءُ: الـ + نِسَاء — nisāʾ, women (pl., nom., subject of dhallat); 'the women (and girls are humbled)'
بِغَائِبِ: بِـ + غَائِب — ghāʾib, absent (active participle, gen.); bi-, redundant predicate marker after mā (negation); 'is not absent' (verse)
مَمْزُوجَةٌ: mamzūja, mixed (passive participle, f. sg. nom., predicate; mazaja); the verb takes bi- for the thing mixed (bi-l-maṣāʾib); 'mixed (with misfortunes)' (verse)
اَكَارِمٍ: akārim, noble ones (pl. of akram/karīm, gen., diptote, in iḍāfa after faqd); 'of nobles' (verse)
النَّوَائِبِ: الـ + نَوَائِب — nāʾiba, calamity (f.; pl. nawāʾib, gen. in iḍāfa after mustaʿẓamāt); 'misfortunes' (verse)
فَقَرَّبَتْهَا: فَـ + قَرَّبَتْ + هَا — qarraba, to draw near (perf. 3 f. sg., form II); fa-, so; -hā, her (the arriving woman); 'so she (Nuzhat al-Zamān) drew her close'
فَوَاللّٰهِ: فَـ + وَ + اللّٰه — Allāh, God (gen.); wa-, by (oath particle); fa-, so; 'so by God'
انْكِسَارِ: انْكِسَار — inkisār, breaking (m. verbal noun, form VII, gen. after min); 'the breaking (of your heart)'
يَخْطُرَ: yakhṭura, to occur, cross the mind (subjunctive 3 m. sg., khaṭara; after li-allā; bi-bālik 'in your mind'); 'lest it cross (your mind)'
زَوْجِكِ: زَوْج + كِ — zawj, husband (m., gen. after min); -ki, your (f. sg.); 'from your husband'
وَمَحَلُّنَا: و + مَحَلّ + نَا — maḥall, place, standing (m., nom.); wa-, and; -nā, our; 'and our place (is your place)'
وَأَفْرَدَتْ: و + أَفْرَدَتْ — afrada, to set apart (perf. 3 f. sg., form IV; li- 'for her'); wa-, and; 'and she set apart (for her a place)'
طَيِّبَةٍ: طَيِّبَة — ṭayyib, good, pleasant (adj., f. sg., gen., agreeing with ʿīsha); 'a pleasant (life)'
مُدَّةٍ: مُدَّة — mudda, period, span (f., gen. in iḍāfa after baʿda); 'after a short while'
بَعْدَكِ: baʿd + ki — baʿd, after (prep.); -ki, you (f.); baʿdaki 'after you, in your absence'; 'after you'
مَثْوَاهَا: mathwā + hā — mathwā, lodging, abode (m., acc., object of akrimī, 2 f. imperative); -hā, her; 'her lodging (honour it)'
أَكْرِمِي: أَكْرِمِي — akrama/yukrimu, to honour, treat generously (verb IV of ك-ر-م, imperative 2fs); 'honour (her lodging)'
وَأَغْنِي: و + أَغْنِي — wa-, and + aghnā/yughnī, to enrich, make free of want (verb IV of غ-ن-ي, imperative 2fs); 'and enrich'
فَقْرَهَا: فَقْر + هَا — faqr, poverty, want (m., acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her poverty'
وَزَوْجِهَا: و + زَوْج + هَا — wa-, and + zawj, husband (m., gen., coordinated within the iḍāfa after amr) + -hā, her; 'and her husband'
وَأُمِّ: و + أُمِّ — wa-, and + umm, mother (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa with ḍawʾ al-makān); 'and the mother (of)'
وَتَرَعْرَعَا: و + تَرَعْرَعَا — wa-, and + taraʿraʿa/yataraʿraʿu, to grow up, shoot up (quadriliteral verb, ر-ع-ر-ع, perf. 3md); 'and they grew up'
