أَزْهَرَانِ: أَزْهَرَانِ — azhar, shining, bright (adj. of the colour/quality pattern afʿal, not an elative, of ز-ه-ر, m. dual nom., agreeing with qamarān); 'two moons shining'
وَبَلَغَا: و + بَلَغَا — wa-, and + balagha/yablughu, to reach, attain (verb I of ب-ل-غ, perf. 3md); 'and they reached'
الْمُخَدَّرَاتِ: الـ + مُخَدَّرَات — mukhaddarāt, curtained, secluded girls (passive part., verb II of خ-د-ر, f. pl., gen.; from khidr, curtain); 'the curtained ones'
أَسِيلٍ: أَسِيل — asīl, smooth and long, of a cheek (adj., m., gen., qualifying khadd); 'smooth-long'
وَقَدٍّ: و + قَدّ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, build (m., gen.; the bi- of 'with a beautiful face' runs on: what she was endowed with); 'and a stature'
رَشِيقٍ: رَشِيق — rashīq, graceful, supple (adj., m., gen., qualifying qadd); 'graceful'
أَلَذَّ: أَلَذّ — aladhdh, more delicious (elative of ladhīdh, ل-ذ-ذ; the print writes الذّ without the hamza and marks the doubled dhāl; read aladhdh, followed by min, than); 'more delicious (than)'
الرَّحِيقِ: الـ + رَحِيق — raḥīq, choice, pure wine (m., gen. after min, than); 'the choice wine'
وَرِيقٍ: و + رِيق — wa-, and + rīq, saliva (m., gen.; also in the bi- 'with' series); 'and saliva'
كَالسَّلْسَبِيلِ: كَـ + الـ + سَلْسَبِيل — ka-, like (prep.) + al-Salsabīl, a spring of Paradise (Qurʾān 76:18) (m., gen.); 'like the Salsabīl'
سُلَافَ: سُلَاف — sulāf, the first flow of the wine, the finest juice that runs before pressing (m., acc., noun of kaʾanna; first term of iḍāfa); 'the first-flow of'
رِيْقِهَا: رِيق + هَا — rīq, saliva (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after māʾ) + -hā, her; 'her saliva'
وَعُنْقُودُهَا: و + عُنْقُود + هَا — wa-, and + ʿunqūd, cluster of grapes (m., nom.) + -hā, its (the wine's); 'and its cluster'
ثَغْرِهَا: ثَغْر + هَا — thaghr, mouth (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her mouth'
الْعَذْبِ: الـ + عَذْب — ʿadhb, sweet (adj., m., gen., qualifying thaghr); 'the sweet'
يُقْطَفُ: يُقْطَفُ — qaṭafa/yaqṭifu, to pluck, pick (verb I of ق-ط-ف, impf. passive 3ms); 'is plucked'
وَاَعَنَابَهَا: و + أَعْنَاب + هَا — the print has وَاَعَنَابَهَا, which is not a correct form; read as wa-aʿnābuhā: wa-, and + aʿnāb, grapes (pl. of ʿinab, m., nom.) + -hā, its; 'and its grapes'
ثَنَيْتَهَا: ثَنَيْتَ + هَا — thanā/yathnī, to bend, fold (verb I of ث-ن-ي, perf. 2ms) + -hā, her; 'you bend her'
خَلَّاقٍ: خَلَّاق — khallāq, creator (intensive of khāliq, pattern faʿʿāl, m., gen. after subḥāna; its li- 'of her' follows); 'a Creator'
يُوْصَفُ: يُوْصَفُ — waṣafa/yaṣifu, to describe (verb I of و-ص-ف, impf. passive 3ms); 'is described'
فَقَدُّهَا: فَـ + قَدّ + هَا — fa-, so + qadd, stature (m., nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'so her stature'
الْأَغْصَانَ: الـ + أَغْصَان — aghṣān, branches (pl. of ghuṣn, m., acc., object of yukhjilu); 'the branches'
الرِّيقُ: الـ + رِيق — rīq, saliva (m., nom., subject); 'the saliva'
يَهْزَأُ: يَهْزَأُ — hazaʾa/yahzaʾu, to mock at (verb I of ه-ز-ء, impf. 3ms); the verb takes bi- for what is mocked; 'it mocks'
بِالرَّحِيقِ: بِـ + الـ + رَحِيق — bi-, at (prep.: hazaʾa bi-, to mock at: the verb takes bi-) + raḥīq, choice wine (m., gen.); 'at the choice wine'. Also after azrā, 'to put to shame', bi- marks what is belittled: yuzrī bi-al-raḥīqi, 'puts the choice wine to shame'.
مَلِيْحَةُ: مَلِيحَة — malīḥa, lovely, comely (adj., f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with al-waṣf); 'lovely of'
الْوَصْفِ: الـ + وَصْف — waṣf, description (m., gen.; second term of iḍāfa); 'description'
اَجْفَانُهَا: أَجْفَان + هَا — ajfān, eyelids (pl. of jafn, m., nom., subject) + -hā, her; 'her eyelids'
تَفْضَحُ: تَفْضَحُ — faḍaḥa/yafḍaḥu, to disgrace, put to shame (verb I of ف-ض-ح, impf. 3fs); 'disgrace'
التَّكْحِيْلَ: الـ + تَكْحِيل — takḥīl, painting with kohl (verbal noun of verb II of ك-ح-ل, m., acc., object); 'the kohl-painting'
بِالْكُحَلِ: بِـ + الـ + كُحَل — bi-, with (prep.: what the kohl-painting is disgraced by, 'with') + kuḥal, as the print points it, for kaḥal, the natural darkness of the eyelid's rim (m., gen.); 'with the natural dark'
الْحَاظَهَا: أَلْحَاظ + هَا — alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ; the print writes it without the hamza, الحاظ, read as alḥāẓ; m., acc., noun of kaʾanna) + -hā, her; 'her glances'
عَاشِقِهَا: عَاشِق + هَا — ʿāshiq, lover (act. part. of ع-ش-ق, m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after qalb) + -hā, her; 'her lover'
بِكَفِّ: بِـ + كَفّ — bi-, in (prep.) + kaff, palm, hand (f., gen.; first term of iḍāfa); 'in the palm of'
اَمِيْرِ: أَمِير — amīr, commander (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa, in 'Commander of the Faithful')
الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ: الـ + مُؤْمِنِين — muʾminīn, believers, the Faithful (act. part., verb IV of أ-م-ن, m. pl., gen.); 'of the Faithful'
عَلِيْ: عَلِي — ʿAlī (ibn Abī Ṭālib), the Prophet's cousin and fourth caliph (name, m., gen., in apposition; the print gives no tanwīn); 'ʿAlī'
فَائِقَ: فَائِق — fāʾiq, surpassing, excelling (act. part. of ف-و-ق, m., acc., predicate of kāna; first term of iḍāfa); 'surpassing of'
وَالْحُسْنِ: و + الـ + حُسْن — wa-, and + ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.); 'and beauty'
مِثَالٌ: مِثَال — mithāl, likeness, match (m., nom., noun of laysa, with tanwīn); 'a likeness'
الشَّجَاعَةُ: الـ + شَجَاعَة — shajāʿa, courage (f., nom., subject); 'the courage'
وَتَشْهَدُ: و + تَشْهَدُ — wa-, and + shahida/yashhadu, to testify, bear witness (verb I of ش-ه-د, impf. 3fs; with li-, for); 'and it testifies (for him)'
تَشْهَدُ: تَشْهَدُ — shahida/yashhadu, to testify (verb I, impf. 3fs); after wa-lā, 'and does not testify' (shahida ʿalā, to testify against)
وَتَمِيلُ: و + تَمِيلُ — wa-, and + māla/yamīlu, to incline, lean towards (verb I of م-ي-ل, impf. 3fs; with ilā); 'and they incline'
الْقَاسِيَةُ: الـ + قَاسِيَة — qāsiya, hard (act. part. f. of ق-س-و, nom., agreeing with the broken plural al-qulūb); 'the hard'
أَكْحَلُ: أَكْحَل — akḥal, dark-rimmed, dark-lidded (adj., m., nom.; first term of iḍāfa with al-ṭarf; of ك-ح-ل); 'dark-lidded of'
عِذَارٌ: عِذَار — ʿidhār, the line of down along the cheek (m., nom., with tanwīn); 'a cheek-down'
كَثُرَتْ: كَثُرَتْ — kathura/yakthuru, to be many, become many (verb I of ك-ث-ر, perf. 3fs); 'became many'
الْأَشْعَارُ: الـ + أَشْعَار — ashʿār, poems, verses (pl. of shiʿr, m., nom., subject); 'the poems'
عُذْرِيْ: عُذْر + ي — ʿudhr, excuse (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my excuse'
عَذَّرَا: عَذَّرَا — ʿadhdhara/yuʿadhdhiru, to grow the cheek-down, ʿidhār (verb II, perf. 3ms; the final -ā is the rhyme's alif); 'he grew cheek-down'
الدُّجَى: الـ + دُجَى — dujā, darkness (m., nom.; here the dark down); 'the darkness'
فَتَحَيَّرَا: فَـ + تَحَيَّرَا — fa-, and + taḥayyara/yataḥayyaru, to be bewildered (verb V of ح-ي-ر, perf. 3ms; final -ā is the rhyme's alif); 'and was bewildered'
رَشَاءُ: the print has رَشَاءُ (rashāʾu, 'well-rope'); read as رَشَأ rashaʾ, fawn, young gazelle (m., nom., predicate): the usual image for a beautiful youth; 'a fawn'
رَنَتِ: رَنَتِ — ranā/yarnū, to gaze at (verb I of ر-ن-و, perf. 3fs, with the linking kasra before al-); takes li- for what is gazed at; 'gaze'
الْعُيُوْنُ: الـ + عُيُون — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, f., nom.); 'the eyes'
لِحُسْنِهِ: لِـ + حُسْن + هِ — li-, at (prep.: ranā li-, to gaze at: the verb takes li-) + ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'at his beauty'
سَلَّتْ: سَلَّتْ — salla/yasullu, to draw (a sword or blade) (verb I of س-ل-ل, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural subject); 'draw'
لَوَحِظُهُ: the print has لَوَحِظُهُ, without the long alif; read as lawāḥiẓuhu = لَوَاحِظ + هُ — lawāḥiẓ, glances, corners of the eyes (pl. of lāḥiẓa, nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'his glances'
نَسَخَتْ: نَسَخَتْ — nasakha/yansakhu, to copy out, write out (verb I of ن-س-خ, perf. 3fs); 'copied'
نُفُوْسُ: نُفُوس — nufūs, souls (pl. of nafs, f., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the souls of'
بِخَدِّهِ: بِـ + خَدّ + هِ — bi-, on (prep., of place: 'on his cheek') + khadd, cheek (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'on his cheek'
نَمْلًا: نَمْل — naml, ants (collective, m., acc., object of nasakhat); the fine down likened to a trail of ants; 'ants'
النَّجِيْعُ: الـ + نَجِيع — najīʿ, blood, fresh blood (m., nom.); 'the blood'
الْاَحْمَرُ: الـ + أَحْمَر — aḥmar, red (adj., m., nom., qualifying al-najīʿ); 'the red'
شَهْدًا: the print points شَهْدًا (shahdan, 'honey', acc.); the sense seems to want شُهَدَاء shuhadāʾ, 'martyrs' (pl. of shahīd); the reading is uncertain; kept as printed: 'honey(?)'
وَمَسْكَنُهُمْ: و + مَسْكَن + هُمْ — wa-, and + maskan, dwelling (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'and their dwelling'
وَلِبَاسُهُمْ: و + لِبَاس + هُمْ — wa-, and + libās, clothing (m., nom.) + -hum, their; 'and their clothing'
الْحَرِيْرُ: الـ + حَرِير — ḥarīr, silk (m., nom., predicate); 'the silk'
الْاَخْضَرُ: الـ + أَخْضَر — akhḍar, green (adj., m., nom., qualifying al-ḥarīr); 'the green'
الْأَعْيَادِ: الـ + أَعْيَاد — aʿyād, feasts, festivals (pl. of ʿīd, m., gen. after baʿḍ); 'the feasts'
تَتَعَيَّدُ: تَتَعَيَّدُ — taʿayyada/yataʿayyadu, to keep the feast, make a feast-day visit (verb V of ع-ي-د, impf. 3fs, state clause; with ʿalā, to visit); 'keeping the feast'
أَقَارِبِهَا: أَقَارِب + هَا — aqārib, relatives (pl. of qarīb, m., gen. after baʿḍ) + -hā, her; 'her relatives'
حَوَالَيْهَا: حَوَالَيْ + هَا — ḥawālay, around (prep., dual-form adverb, acc.) + -hā, her; 'around her'
وَالْحُسْنُ: و + الـ + حُسْن — wa-, and + ḥusn, beauty (m., nom., subject of a state clause); 'and the beauty'
عَمَّهَا: عَمَّ + هَا — ʿamma/yaʿummu, to cover, envelop (verb I of ع-م-م, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'had covered her'
وَرْدُ: وَرْد — ward, rose (collective, m., nom.; first term of iḍāfa with al-khadd); 'the rose of'
خَالَهَا: خَال + هَا — khāl, mole, beauty-spot (m., acc., object of yaḥsudu) + -hā, her; 'her mole'
وَالْأُقْحُوَانُ: و + الـ + أُقْحُوَان — wa-, and + uqḥuwān, camomile (m., nom.), whose white petals stand for teeth; 'and the camomile'
يَتَبَسَّمُ: يَتَبَسَّمُ — tabassama/yatabassamu, to smile (verb V of ب-س-م, impf. 3ms; with ʿan, from); 'smiles'
بَارِقِ: بَارِق — bāriq, flashing, gleaming (act. part. of ب-ر-ق, m., gen., first term of iḍāfa after ʿan); 'the lightning of'
وَيُطْلِقُ: و + يُطْلِقُ — wa-, and + aṭlaqa/yuṭliqu, to let loose, set free (verb IV of ط-ل-ق, impf. 3ms); 'and let loose'
النِّظَارَ: الـ + نِظَار — the print has النِّظَارَ, a verbal noun of 'looking' (acc., object of yuṭliqu); the usual phrase is yuṭliqu al-naẓar, and the print's form may be a slip for النظر; 'the looking'
الزَّاهِرِ: الـ + زَاهِر — zāhir, shining, bright (act. part. of ز-ه-ر, m., gen., qualifying al-qamar); 'the shining'
بِالشِّعْرِ: بِـ + الـ + شِّعْر — bi-, with (prep.: 'let loose his tongue with poetry') + shiʿr, poetry (m., gen.); 'with the poetry'
الْكَئِيبِ: الـ + كَئِيب — kaʾīb, sorrowful, dejected (adj., m., gen.; second term of iḍāfa after qalb); 'the sorrowful'
ثَغَرُ: the print has ثَغَرُ (thagharu, two fatḥas); read as ثَغْرُ thaghru, mouth (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa with al-waṣl); 'the mouth of'
زَائِلِ: زَائِل — zāʾil, passing, vanishing (act. part. of ز-و-ل, m., gen., first term of iḍāfa after min); 'at the passing of'
الصَّدِّ: الـ + صَدّ — ṣadd, turning away, coldness (m., gen.); 'the turning-away'
اَبِيتَنَّ: أَبِيتَنَّ — bāta/yabītu, to spend the night (verb I of ب-ي-ت, impf. 1s with emphatic -anna, after hal); 'shall I surely spend the night'
بِوَصْلِ: بِـ + وَصْل — bi-, in (prep.: bāta bi-, to spend the night in/with) + waṣl, union (m., gen.; first term of iḍāfa); 'in the union of'
أَظْهَرَتْ: أَظْهَرَتْ — aẓhara/yuẓhiru, to show, make appear (verb IV of ظ-ه-ر, perf. 3fs); 'she showed'
الْمَلَامَةَ: الـ + مَلَامَة — malāma, blame (f., acc., object); 'the blame'
وَالْعِتَابَ: و + الـ + عِتَاب — wa-, and + ʿitāb, reproach (m., acc., object); 'and the reproach'
وَشَمَخَتْ: و + شَمَخَتْ — wa-, and + shamakha/yashmakhu, to be lofty, carry one's nose high (verb I of ش-م-خ, perf. 3fs); 'and she grew haughty'
شَمْخَةً: شَمْخَة — shamkha, a single act of haughtiness (verbal noun of unity, f., acc., cognate object); 'a haughtiness'
فَاغْتَاظَتْ: فَـ + اغْتَاظَتْ — fa-, and so + ightāẓa/yaghtāẓu, to be enraged (verb VIII of غ-ي-ظ, perf. 3fs); here with bi- for the one she is angry with; 'and was enraged'; also with min for the one she is angry with: fa-ightāẓat minhā, 'she was enraged at her' (Night 193)
بِكَانَ: بِـ + كَانَ — bi-, with (prep.: ightāẓa bi-, to be enraged with: the verb takes bi- here) + Kān (Mā Kān), the hero's name (gen.); 'with Kān Mā Kān'
أَتَذْكُرُنِي: أَ + تَذْكُرُ + نِي — a-, (interrogative particle) + dhakara/yadhkuru, to mention (verb I of ذ-ك-ر, impf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'do you mention me?'
شِعْرِكَ: شِعْر + كَ — shiʿr, poetry (m., gen., after fī) + -ka, your; 'your poetry'
تَفْضَحَنِي: تَفْضَحَ + نِي — faḍaḥa/yafḍaḥu, to disgrace, shame (verb I of ف-ض-ح, impf. 2ms, subjunctive after an) + -nī, me; 'you disgrace me'
أَهْلِكَ: أَهْل + كَ — ahl, family, kin (m., gen., after bayna) + -ka, your; 'your family' Also a different word with the same letters and vowels: ahlika, 'that I perish' (halaka, verb I, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an): kidtu an ahlika, 'I all but perished'.
شْكِيَنَّكَ: the print has لَأَ شْكِيَنَّكَ split in two (لا شكينك); read la-ashkiyannaka: la- (oath answer) + shakā/yashkī, to complain (verb I of ش-ك-و, impf. 1s, built on spoken ashkī for classical ashkū) + emphatic -anna + -ka, you; 'I shall surely complain of you'
وَبَغْدَادَ: و + بَغْدَاد — wa-, and + Baghdād, Baghdad (city, gen., diptote, coordinated with Khurāsān); 'and Baghdad'
وَالْإِنْصَافِ: و + الـ + إِنْصَاف — wa-, and + inṣāf, equity, fairness (verbal noun of verb IV of ن-ص-ف, m., gen.); 'and the equity'
يُنْزِلُ: يُنْزِلُ — anzala/yunzilu, to bring down, send down (verb IV of ن-ز-ل, impf. 3ms); with bi-, upon, marking the one it falls on; 'he brings down'
وَالْهَوَانَ: و + الـ + هَوَان — wa-, and + hawān, contempt, humiliation (m., acc.); 'and the contempt'
وَشَكَتْ: و + شَكَتْ — wa-, and + shakā/yashkū, to complain (verb I of ش-ك-و, perf. 3fs; shakā min … ilā, to complain of … to); 'and she complained'
أَرَادَكِ: أَرَادَ + كِ — arāda/yurīdu, to intend, want (verb IV of ر-و-د, perf. 3ms; arāda bi-, to intend (something) towards someone) + -ki, you (f.); 'he intended you'
يَتِيمٌ: يَتِيم — yatīm, orphan (m., nom., with tanwīn, after illā); 'an orphan'
يَذْكُرْ: يَذْكُرْ — dhakara/yadhkuru, to mention (verb I of ذ-ك-ر, impf. 3ms jussive after lam); 'he did not mention'
يَعِيبُكِ: يَعِيبُ + كِ — ʿāba/yaʿību, to shame, find fault with (verb I of ع-ي-ب, impf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'shames you'
فَإِيَّاكِ: فَـ + إِيَّاكِ — fa-, so + iyyāki, beware (of), warning formula with the pronoun 'you' (f.); iyyāki an …, 'beware of …'; 'so beware'
فَيُقَصِّرُ: فَـ + يُقَصِّرُ — fa-, and so + qaṣṣara/yuqaṣṣiru, to cut short (verb II of ق-ص-ر, impf. 3ms); 'and he would cut short'
وَيُخْمِدُ: و + يُخْمِدُ — wa-, and + akhmada/yukhmidu, to extinguish, quench (verb IV of خ-م-د, impf. 3ms); 'and extinguish'
ذِكْرَهُ: ذِكْر + هُ — dhikr, mention, memory (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his memory'
وَيَجْعَلُهُ: و + يَجْعَلُ + هُ — wa-, and + jaʿala/yajʿalu, to make (verb I of ج-ع-ل, impf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and make him'
كَأَمْسِ: كَـ + أَمْسِ — ka-, like (prep.) + amsi, yesterday (indeclinable, gen.); 'like yesterday'
هٰذَاوَشَاعَ: the print runs two words together: هٰذَا + وَ + شَاعَ — hādhā, this (closing the scene) + wa-, and + shāʿa/yashīʿu, to spread (verb I of ش-ي-ع, perf. 3ms); 'this; and there spread'
لِقَضَى: لِـ + قَضَى — li-, for (prep.: ḥubb … li-, love for: li- marks the one loved) + Qaḍā (Fakān), her name; 'for Qaḍā Fakān'
حَيْلُهُ: حَيْل + هُ — ḥayl, strength, power (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his strength'
يَخْفَ: يَخْفَ — khafiya/yakhfā, to be hidden (verb I of خ-ف-ي, impf. 3ms jussive after lam, ending shortened); 'was not hidden'
وَاشْتَهَى: و + اشْتَهَى — wa-, and + ishtahā/yashtahī, to desire, long for (verb VIII of ش-ه-و, perf. 3ms); 'and he desired'
يَبُوحَ: يَبُوحَ — bāḥa/yabūḥu, to disclose, reveal (verb I of ب-و-ح, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); takes bi- for the secret; 'to disclose'
عَتْبِهَا: عَتْب + هَا — ʿatb, reproach, blame (m., gen., after min) + -hā, her; 'her reproach'
وَغَضَبِهَا: و + غَضَب + هَا — wa-, and + ghaḍab, anger (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her anger'
عِتَابَ: عِتَاب — ʿitāb, reproach (m., acc., object of khiftu; first term of iḍāfa with allatī); 'the reproach of'
الَّتِيْ: الَّتِي — allatī, she who, the one who (relative pron., f. sing., gen.); 'her whose'
اَخْلَاقَهَا: أَخْلَاق + هَا — akhlāq, natures, manners (pl. of khuluq) + -hā, her; the print points takaddara akhlāqahā (acc.), which does not construe; read takaddarat akhlāquhā, 'her clear manners grow clouded'
الصَّافِيَهْ: الـ + صَافِيَة — ṣāfiya, clear, pure (act. part. f. of ص-ف-و, adj. qualifying akhlāq; the pausal -h marked with sukūn); 'the clear'
كَصَبْرِ: كَـ + صَبْر — ka-, like (prep.) + ṣabr, patience (m., gen.; first term of iḍāfa); 'like the patience of'
الْكَيِّ: الـ + كَيّ — kayy, cauterising, branding with a hot iron (verbal noun of kawā, m., gen., after ʿalā, under); 'the cautery'
الْعَافِيَهْ: الـ + عَافِيَة — ʿāfiya, health, well-being (f., gen., after ṭalab; pausal -h marked with sukūn); 'health'
الْمَمْلَكَهِ: الـ + مَمْلَكَة — al-, the + mamlaka, kingdom (f.); ة written ه (Middle Arabic), genitive in construct after تَخْت; 'of the kingdom'
سِيرَةً: سِيرَة — sīra, conduct, way of life (f.), accusative (object of سَارَ); 'a conduct'
أَبْيَاتُ: أَبْيَات — abyāt, verses (pl. of bayt), nominative, in construct with Kān Mā Kān; 'the verses of'
الْجَمْعَ: الـ + جَمْع — al-, the + jamʿ, bringing together (verbal noun of jamaʿa), accusative after إِنَّ; 'the bringing-together'
الْحَلِفَةِ: الـ + حَلِفَة — al-, the + ḥalifa, a stalk of esparto grass (f.; unit noun of ḥalfāʾ; gen. after bayna, between); 'the esparto-grass'
وَالنَّارِ: وَ + الـ + نَار — wa-, and + al-, the + nār, fire (f.); 'and the fire'
لَمِنْ: لَـ + مِنْ — la-, emphatic 'indeed' (on the predicate after inna) + min, of/from (partitive, with the elative); 'indeed of'
أَعْظَمِ: أَعْظَم — aʿẓam, greatest (elative of ʿaẓīm), genitive in construct; 'the greatest of'
الْأَخْطَارِ: الـ + أَخْطَار — al-, the + akhṭār, dangers (pl. of khaṭar); 'the dangers'
وَلَيْسَتِ: وَ + لَيْسَتِ — wa-, and + laysa, is not (perf. 3 f. sg., final ت vowelled before al-); 'and are not'
بِمُؤْتَمَنِينَ: بِـ + مُؤْتَمَنِينَ — bi-, (pleonastic, marks the predicate of laysa) + muʾtaman, trusted (pass. part. VIII, m. pl.); 'trusted-ones'
تَرْمُقُ: تَرْمُقُ — ramaqa, glance, gaze (imperf. 3 f. sg.; non-human pl. ʿuyūn takes f. sg.); 'cast glances'
وَالْجُفُونُ: وَ + الـ + جُفُون — wa-, and + al-, the + jufūn, eyelids (pl. of jafn); 'and the eyelids'
مَنْعُهُ: مَنْع + هُ — manʿ, preventing, keeping (verbal noun of manaʿa) + -hu, him; 'the keeping of him'
رَبَّاتِ: رَبَّات — rabbāt, mistresses, ladies (f. pl. of rabba), genitive after ʿalā and in construct; 'the ladies of'
الْحِجَالِ: الـ + حِجَال — al-, the + ḥijāl, bridal curtains, canopies (pl. of ḥijla); 'the bridal-curtains'
وَمَنْعُ: وَ + مَنْع — wa-, and + manʿ, keeping (verbal noun of manaʿa), in construct; 'and the keeping of'
بِنْتِكِ: بِنْت + كِ — bint, daughter (f.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your daughter'
أَوْجَبُ: أَوْجَب — awjab, more binding (elative of wājib); 'more binding'
تُحْجَبَ: تُحْجَبَ — tuḥjaba, be veiled, screened (pass. subjunctive 3 f. sg. of ḥajaba, after an); 'be veiled'
أَقُولَهُ: أَقُولَ + هُ — aqūla, I say (imperf. 1 sg., subjunctive after an) + -hu, it; 'that I should say it'
أُخْبِرُكَ: أُخْبِرُ + كَ — ukhbiru, I inform (imperf. 1 sg. IV of khabara) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'I inform you'
أَنْشَدْتَهُ: أَنْشَدْتَ + هُ — anshadta, you recited (perf. 2 m. sg. IV of nashada) + -hu, it; 'you recited it'
بِحَجْبِهَا: بِـ + حَجْب + هَا — bi-, with (the verb amara chooses bi- for the thing commanded) + ḥajb, screening, veiling (verbal noun) + -hā, her; 'the screening of her'
أُرْسِلُهَا: أُرْسِلُ + هَا — ursilu, I send (imperf. 1 sg. IV of arsala) + -hā, it (f.); 'I send it'
تَنْظُرْ: تَنْظُرْ — tanẓur, look (jussive 2 m. sg. after lā of prohibition); 'do not look'
أَعْلَمَهَا: أَعْلَمَ + هَا — aʿlama, he informed (perf. 3 m. sg. IV of ʿalima) + -hā, her; 'he informed her'
عَمَّتُهُ: عَمَّة + هُ — ʿamma, paternal aunt (f.) + -hu, his; 'his aunt'
وَانْتَشَرَلَهُ: وَ + انْتَشَرَ + لَهُ — wa-, and + intashara, spread (perf. 3 m. sg. VII) + la-hu, li-, for + -hu, it (the two words are printed run together); 'and there spread for it'
ذِكْرٌ: ذِكْر — dhikr, mention, report, fame (m.), nominative indefinite (subject after the fronted لَهُ); 'a mention'
زَادَهُمْ: زَاد + هُمْ — zād, provisions, food (m.; same spelling as the verb 'he increased') + -hum, their; 'their provision'
تَعْشَقُ: تَعْشَقُ — ʿashiqa, love passionately (imperf. 2 m. sg.); 'you love'
بِنْتَهُمْ: بِنْت + هُمْ — bint, daughter (f.), accusative object + -hum, their; 'their daughter'
يَأْخُذُهَا: يَأْخُذُ + هَا — yaʾkhudhu, he takes (imperf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her; 'takes her'
بَطِّلْ: بَطِّلْ — baṭṭil, stop, cease (imperative m. sg. II of baṭṭala, with object 'this talk'); 'stop'
حِرْمَانِكَ: حِرْمَان + كَ — ḥirmān, being deprived (verbal noun of ḥaramā), in construct with sabab + -ka, your; 'your being deprived'
أَحْزَانِكَ: أَحْزَان + كَ — aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn) + -ka, your; 'your sorrows'
يَبْعَثُوا: يَبْعَثُوا — yabʿathū, they send (imperf. 3 m. pl., jussive after lam, the final alif is silent orthography); 'they have not sent'
وَنَمُوتُ: وَ + نَمُوتُ — wa-, and + namūtu, we die (imperf. 1 pl. of māta); 'and we die'
جُوعًا: جُوعًا — jūʿ, hunger (m.), accusative of cause/specification; 'of hunger'
لَوْكُنَّا: لَوْ + كُنَّا — law, if + kunnā, we were (perf. 1 pl. of kāna); the two words are printed run together; 'if we were'
لَكُنَّا: لَـ + كُنَّا — la-, introduces the apodosis of law ('would') + kunnā, we were (perf. 1 pl. of kāna; here auxiliary with hālaknā); 'we would have'
هَلَكْنَا: هَلَكْنَا — halaknā, we perished (perf. 1 pl. of halaka); 'perished'
أَلَمِ: أَلَم — alam, pain (m.), genitive in construct after min (kasra from the following الـ); 'the pain of'
ذُلِّ: ذُلّ — dhull, abasement, humiliation, genitive in construct after أَوْ; 'the abasement of'
حَسْرَتُهُ: حَسْرَة + هُ — ḥasra, grief, regret (f.) + -hu, his; 'his grief'
فَأَنَّ: فَـ + أَنَّ — fa-, and (sequence) + anna, he moaned (perf. 3 m. sg. of anna, yaʾinnu; not the particle anna); 'and he moaned'
اَقِلِّي: أَقِلِّي — aqillī, lessen (imperative f. sg. IV of aqalla; initial hamza printed without its sign); 'lessen'
فَقَلْبِي: فَـ + قَلْب + ي — fa-, for, since + qalb, heart (m.) + -ī, my; 'for my heart'
اِلىَ: إِلَى — ilā, to, toward (printed اِلىَ with ى pointed); with man: 'toward whom' (the beloved)
تَيَّمَتْهُ: تَيَّمَتْ + هُ — tayyamat, she enslaved with love (perf. 3 f. sg. II of tayyama) + -hu, him; 'she enslaved him'
لَعَاشِقُ: لَـ + عَاشِق — la-, emphatic 'indeed' (on the predicate after inna) + ʿāshiq, lover (act. part. of ʿashiqa), nominative; 'indeed a lover'
تَطْلُبِي: تَطْلُبِي — taṭlubī, seek (jussive 2 f. sg. after lā of prohibition; the final ī is the f. sg. ending); 'do not seek'
ذَرَّةً: ذَرَّة — dharra, a speck, grain, atom (f.), accusative (object); 'a grain'
فَصَبْرِي: فَـ + صَبْر + ي — fa-, for, since + ṣabr, patience (m.) + -ī, my; 'for my patience'
وَبَيْتِ: وَ + بَيْت — wa-, by (oath particle, governs the genitive) + bayt, house, genitive (Allāh follows: the Kaʿba); 'by the House (of God)'
سَامَنِي: سَامَ + نِي — sāma, he imposed on, demanded of (perf. 3 m. sg. of sāma, yasūmu) + -nī, me; 'imposed on me'
اللُّوَّامُ: الـ + لُّوَّام — al-, the + lawwām, blamers, reproachers (pl. of lāʾim); 'the blamers'
نَهْيًا: نَهْيًا — nahy, forbidding, prohibition (m.), accusative (object of sāma); 'a forbidding'
عَصَيْتُهُمْ: عَصَيْتُ + هُمْ — ʿaṣaytu, I disobeyed (perf. 1 sg. of ʿaṣā) + -hum, them; 'I disobey them'
دَعْوَى: دَعْوَى — daʿwā, claim, profession (f.), genitive in construct (fī); 'the claim of'
صَادِقُ: صَادِق — ṣādiq, truthful (act. part. of ṣadaqa), nominative, predicate; 'truthful'
عَنْوَةً: عَنْوَةً — ʿanwatan, by force, perforce (adverbial accusative); 'by force'
اَزُورَهَا: أَزُورَ + هَا — azūra, I visit (imperf. 1 sg., subjunctive after an; printed اَزُورَهَا) + -hā, her; 'that I visit her'
وَالرَّحْمٰنِ: وَ + الـ + رَّحْمٰن — wa-, by (oath particle) + al-, the + raḥmān, Merciful (name of God); 'by the Merciful'
فَاسِقُ: فَاسِق — fāsiq, transgressor, sinner, immoral (act. part. of fasaqa), nominative; 'a transgressor'
ذِكْرَهَا: ذِكْر + هَا — dhikr, mention (m.), accusative object of tasmaʿu + -hā, her; 'the mention of her'
تُشَابِهُ: تُشَابِهُ — tushābihu, resemble (imperf. 3 f. sg. III of shābaha; subject ʿiẓām, non-human pl.); 'resemble'
خَلْفَهُنَّ: خَلْف + هُنَّ — khalf, behind (prep.) + -hunna, them (f. pl., the birds); 'behind them'
بَوَاشِقُ: بَوَاشِق — bawāshiq, sparrowhawks (pl. of bāshiq; Persian loan), nominative, the subject after the fronted 'behind them'; 'sparrowhawks'
لَامَ: لَامَ — lāma, he blamed (perf. 3 m. sg. of lāma, yalūmu); 'has blamed'
لِوَجْهِكَ: لِـ + وَجْه + كَ — li-, for, on account of (cause) + wajh, face (m.) + -ka, your (addressing the beloved in the verse); 'for your face'
عَمَّتِي: عَمَّة + ي — ʿamma, paternal aunt (f.) + -ī, my; 'my aunt'
وَأَسْكُنُ: وَ + أَسْكُنُ — wa-, and + askunu, I dwell (imperf. 1 sg. of sakana); 'and I will dwell'
أَطْرَافِ: أَطْرَاف — aṭrāf, edges, outskirts (pl. of ṭaraf), genitive in construct after fī; 'the edges of'
صَعَالِيكَ: صَعَالِيك — ṣaʿālīk, paupers, vagabonds (pl. of ṣuʿlūk), genitive, qualifying 'a people'; 'paupers'
وَسَكَنُوا: وَ + سَكَنُوا — wa-, and + sakanū, they dwelt (perf. 3 m. pl. of sakana); 'and they dwelt'
وَتَأْخُذُ: وَ + تَأْخُذُ — wa-, and + taʾkhudhu, she takes (imperf. 3 f. sg. of akhadha); 'and takes'
تَقْتَاتُ: تَقْتَاتُ — taqtātu, she feeds herself, subsists (imperf. 3 f. sg. VIII of qāta; verb takes bi- for the food); 'she would feed on'
بِأُمِّ: بِـ + أُمّ — bi-, with (ikhtalā bi- 'be alone with' is chosen by the verb) + umm, mother (f.), genitive in construct; 'with the mother of'
عَمَّتَاهْ: عَمَّتَا + هْ — ʿammatā-h, O my aunt (ʿamma, aunt + ā, vocative lament ending + h, pausal; Middle Arabic form of yā ʿammatī); 'O my aunt'
وَاقِعٌ: وَاقِع — wāqiʿ, fallen (act. part. of waqaʿa), nominative indefinite, predicate; 'fallen'
وَأَنْشَدَتْهَا: وَ + أَنْشَدَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + anshadat, she recited (perf. 3 f. sg. IV of nashada) + -hā, her (to her); 'and she recited to her'
هَجَرْتُهُ: هَجَرْتُ + هُ — hajartu, I shunned, abandoned (perf. 1 sg. of hajara) + -hu, him; 'I shunned him'
لِكَلَامِهِ: لِـ + كَلَام + هِ — li-, because of (cause) + kalām, speech + -hi, his; 'because of his speech'
بُغْضًا: بُغْضًا — bughḍ, hatred (m.), accusative of cause; 'in hatred'
أَضْعَافَ: أَضْعَاف — aḍʿāf, multiples, manifold (pl. of ḍiʿf), accusative object in construct with mā; 'multiples of'
شَوْقِي: شَوْق + ي — shawq, longing (m.), genitive in construct after waṣf + -ī, my; 'my longing'
عَثَرَاتُ: عَثَرَات — ʿatharāt, stumblings, slips (f. pl. of ʿathra), nominative after law lā, in construct; 'the stumblings of'
وَخَفَقَانُ: وَ + خَفَقَان — wa-, and + khafaqān, fluttering, palpitation (verbal noun of khafaqa), in construct; 'and the fluttering of'
إِحْسَانَهُ: إِحْسَان + هُ — iḥsān, kindness, benefaction (verbal noun IV of aḥsana), accusative object + -hu, his; 'his kindness'
وَأَوْلَاةُ: وَ + أَوْلَاةُ — wa-, and + awlā, he gave, dealt (perf. 3 m. sg. IV of walā) + -hu, him; the ة is written for the pronoun ه (Middle Arabic); 'and dealt him'
مَنْعَهُ: مَنْع + هُ — manʿ, withholding (verbal noun of manaʿa) + -hu, his; 'his withholding'
وَحِرْمَانَهُ: وَ + حِرْمَان + هُ — wa-, and + ḥirmān, depriving (verbal noun of ḥaramā) + -hu, his; 'and his depriving'
دُوَلٌ: دُوَل — duwal, turns, changing fortunes (pl. of dawla), nominative indefinite, predicate; 'turns'
أَجْمَلُ: أَجْمَل — ajmal, more/most beautiful, finest (elative of jamīl), predicate; 'most beautiful'
الْعَمِّ: الـ + عَمّ — al-, the + ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.), genitive in construct (ibna l-ʿammi, 'cousin'); 'the uncle'
غَرَامِيْ: غَرَام + ي — gharām, passion, ardent love (m.) + -ī, my (printed with ي bearing sukūn, for metre); 'my passion'
كَامْثَالِ: كَـ + أَمْثَال — ka-, like (prep.; comparison) + amthāl, likes, equivalents (pl. of mithl), genitive in construct (hamza printed unmarked); 'like the likes of'
عِنْدَكْ: عِنْد + كْ — ʿinda, with, at (prep.) + -k, your (the -ka with sukūn, for the verse); 'with you'
وَلٰكِنِّيْ: وَ + لٰكِنَّ + ي — wa-, and + lākinna, but (particle, takes accusative) + -ī, me (printed with ي sukūn); 'but I'
كَتَمْتُ: كَتَمْتُ — katamtu, I hid, concealed (perf. 1 sg. of katama); 'I hid'
كَتَمْتَ: كَتَمْتَ — katamta, you hid (perf. 2 m. sg. of katama); 'you were hiding'
وَجْدَكْ: وَجْد + كْ — wajd, longing, passion (m.) + -k, your (the -ka with sukūn, for the verse); 'your longing'
طَمَعُهُ: طَمَع + هُ — ṭamaʿ, hope, desire (m.), nominative subject + -hu, his; 'his hope'
يَأْسَهُ: يَأْس + هُ — yaʾs, despair (m.), accusative object of qaṭaʿa + -hu, his; 'his despair'
وَخَمَدَتْ: وَ + خَمَدَتْ — wa-, and + khamadat, died down, was extinguished (perf. 3 f. sg. of khamada); 'and died down'
أَنْفَاسُهُ: أَنْفَاس + هُ — anfās, breaths (pl. of nafas) + -hu, his; 'his breaths'
دِع: دِع — printed دِع with kasra, evidently daʿ, leave! (imperative m. sg. of wadaʿa/yadaʿu, 'leave, let be'); 'leave!'
اللَّوْمَ: الـ + لَّوْم — al-, the + lawm, blame, reproach (m.), accusative object; 'the blame'
اَصْغِيْ: أَصْغِي — aṣghī, I listen (imperf. 1 sg. IV of aṣghā; the verb takes ilā for the one listened to; printed اَصْغِيْ, ي with sukūn); 'I listen'
لَائِمِ: لَائِم — lāʾim, blamer, reproacher (act. part. of lāma), genitive in construct after qawl; 'of a blamer'
بُحْتُ: بُحْتُ — buḥtu, I disclosed, divulged (perf. 1 sg. of bāḥa; the verb takes bi- for the thing disclosed); 'I have disclosed'
كَاتِمَا: كَاتِمًا — kātim, hiding (act. part. of katama), accusative as predicate of kuntu; ا is the rhyme vowel; 'hiding'
اُرَجِّيْ: أُرَجِّي — urajjī, I hope for (imperf. 1 sg. II of rajjā; printed اُرَجِّيْ with ي sukūn); 'I hope for'
وِصَالَهُ: وِصَال + هُ — wiṣāl, union, meeting (m.), accusative object + -hu, his; 'his union'
سَهَرَتْ: سَهَرَتْ — saharat, stayed awake, was sleepless (perf. 3 f. sg. of sahira, here 'my eye'); 'has stayed awake'
عَيْنِيْ: عَيْن + ي — ʿayn, eye (f.) + -ī, my (case vowel dropped for metre); 'my eye'
نَائِمَا: نَائِم + ا — nāʾim, sleeping (active part. of nāma) + -an, acc. (circumstantial, after bāta); 'sleeping'
وَاللَّيَالِي: و + الـ + لَيَالِي — wa-, and + al-, the + layālī, nights (pl. of layla, f.); 'and the nights'
جَمْرِ: جَمْر — jamr, embers, live coals (m.; gen. in construct after عَلَى); 'the embers'
الْمَقَالِي: الـ + مَقَالِي — al-, the + maqālī, frying-pans (pl. of miqlan/miqlā); 'the frying-pans' (idiom: on hot coals, in torment)
سَنَهْ: سَنَهْ — sana, year (f.); final ة written هْ (Middle Arabic spelling), sing. after the number 17; 'year' Also gen. sg. after alf, 'a thousand', in a pausal rhyme: alfa sanah, 'a thousand years'.
ظَرْفُهُ: ظَرْف + هُ — ẓarf, elegance, grace (m.) + -hu, his; 'his grace'
فَسَهِرَ: فَـ + سَهِرَ — fa-, and/so + sahira, stay awake (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he lay awake'
أَسْكُتُ: أَسْكُتُ — askutu, I keep silent (imperf. 1 sg., sakata; indicative after مَالِي 'what ails me that'); 'I keep silent'
أَذُوبَ: أَذُوبَ — adhūba, I melt, dissolve (subj. 1 sg., dhāba, after حَتَّى); 'I melt'
أَرْحَلَ: أَرْحَلَ — arḥala, I depart (subj. 1 sg., raḥala, after أَنْ); 'to depart'
وَأَشِتَّ: و + أَشِتَّ — wa-, and + ashitta, I scatter, disperse (subj. 1 sg., shatta, after أَنْ); 'and to scatter away'
مُقَامِي: مُقَام + ي — muqām, staying, abode (m., verbal noun of qāma/aqāma) + -ī, my; 'my staying'
يُسَلِّينِي: يُسَلِّي + نِي — yusallī, console, divert (imperf. 3 m. sg., form II of salā, relative clause on 'a friend') + -nī, me; '(who) consoles me'
أُسَلِّيَ: أُسَلِّيَ — usalliya, I console (subj. 1 sg., form II of salā, after أَنْ); 'to console'
بِالْغُرْبَةِ: بِـ + الـ + غُرْبَة — bi-, with (instrument/means) + al-, the + ghurba, estrangement, life abroad (f.); 'with the estrangement'
وَأَسْتَرِيحَ: و + أَسْتَرِيحَ — wa-, and + astarīḥa, I rest (subj. 1 sg., form X of rāḥa, after حَتَّى); 'and rest'
مُهْجَتِيْ: مُهْجَة + ي — muhja, heart-blood, life (f.) + -ī, my (ـيْ with sukūn, verse); 'my heart-blood'
خَفَقَانِهَا: خَفَقَان + هَا — khafaqān, throbbing, palpitation (m.) + -hā, its/her; 'its throbbing'
التَّذَلُّلُ: الـ + تَّذَلُّلُ — al-, the + tadhallul, abasement, self-humbling (m., verbal noun of form V); 'abasement'
شَانِهَا: شَان + هَا — shaʾn, manner, matter, concern (m.; written شَان for شَأْن) + -hā, its; 'its manner'
وَاعْذُرْ: و + اعْذُرْ — wa-, and + iʿdhur, excuse (imper. m. sg., ʿadhara); 'and excuse (me)'
حُشَاشَتِيْ: حُشَاشَة + ي — ḥushāsha, last breath of life, remnant of life (f.) + -ī, my (ـيْ verse form); 'my last breath'
كَصَحِيْفَةٍ: كَـ + صَحِيفَة — ka-, like (prep., comparison) + ṣaḥīfa, page, sheet (f.); 'like a page' (printed صَحِيْفَةٍ)
عُنْوَانِهَا: عُنْوَان + هَا — ʿunwān, superscription, address (m.) + -hā, its; 'its superscription'
عَمِّيْ: عَمّ + ي — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m.) + -ī, my (ـيْ verse form); 'my uncle' (bint ʿammī, 'cousin')
حُوْرِيَّةً: حُورِيَّة — ḥūriyya, houri, dark-eyed maiden of paradise (f.; acc. -an, ḥāl 'as a houri'; printed with odd pointing حُوْرِيَّةً); 'a houri'
رِضْوَانِهَا: رِضْوَان + هَا — Riḍwān, the keeper of paradise (proper name) + -hā, her; 'her Riḍwān'
اَلْحَاظَ: اَلْحَاظَ — alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ, m.; acc. object of rāma; initial hamza printed as bare alif اَ, here wasl-less spelling); 'glances'
مُعَارِضًا: مُعَارِضًا — muʿāriḍ, opposing, rivalling (active part. form III, ʿāraḍa; acc. ḥāl); 'opposing'
لِسُيُوفِهَا: لِـ + سُيُوف + هَا — li-, to/for (marks what is opposed: ʿāraḍa li- 'rival') + suyūf, swords (pl. of sayf, m.) + -hā, their/her; 'their swords'
عُدْوَانِهَا: عُدْوَان + هَا — ʿudwān, aggression, hostility (m.) + -hā, their/her; 'their aggression'
سَاسِيْرُ: سَـ + أَسِيرُ — sa-, will (future prefix) + asīru, I journey (imperf. 1 sg., sāra; printed سَاسِيْرُ, the hamza written as alif, i.e. sa-+asīr); 'I shall journey'
اَرْضَ: أَرْض — arḍ, earth, land (f.; acc. object of sāra, printed with initial اَ); 'the land'
مُقَصِّرِ: مُقَصِّر — muqaṣṣir, falling short, remiss (active part. form II of qaṣṣara, gen. -i for metre/rhyme; printed غَيْرَ مُقَصِّرِ 'not falling short'); 'falling short'
اَنَالَ: أَنَالَ — anāla, I obtain, attain (subj. 1 sg., nāla, after كَيْ أَنْ 'so that'); printed اَنَالَ; 'I may obtain'
حِرْمَانِهَا: حِرْمَان + هَا — ḥirmān, withholding, deprivation (m.) + -hā, its/her; 'its withholding'
الْوَسِيعَةِ: الـ + وَسِيعَة — al-, the + wasīʿa, wide, spacious (adj. f.); 'the wide'
مُنْقِذًا: مُنْقِذًا — munqidh, rescuing (active part. form IV of anqadha, acc. ḥāl); 'rescuing'
وَاَمْنَحُهَا: و + أَمْنَحُ + هَا — wa-, and + amnaḥu, I grant (imperf. 1 sg., manaḥa) + -hā, it/her (the soul); 'and I shall grant it'
وَاَعُودُ: و + أَعُودُ — wa-, and + aʿūdu, I return (imperf. 1 sg., ʿāda); 'and I shall return'
الْفُؤادِ: الـ + فُؤَاد — al-, the + fuʾād, heart (m.; printed الْفُؤادِ, gen. in construct after مَسْرُور); 'of heart'
مُنَعَّمًا: مُنَعَّمًا — munaʿʿam, made to live in ease, comfortable (pass. part. form II of naʿʿama, acc. ḥāl); 'in ease'
وَاُقَاتِلُ: و + أُقَاتِلُ — wa-, and + uqātilu, I fight (imperf. 1 sg., form III of qātala); 'and I shall fight'
الْاَبْطَالَ: الـ + أَبْطَال — al-, the + abṭāl, champions, heroes (pl. of baṭal, m.; acc. object); 'the champions'
مَيْدَانِهَا: مَيْدَان + هَا — maydān, field, arena (m.) + -hā, its; 'its field'
وَلَسَوْفَ: و + لَـ + سَوْفَ — wa-, and + la-, surely (emphatic) + sawfa, will (future particle); 'and surely I shall'
اَشْتَاقُ: أَشْتَاقُ — ashtāqu, I long for (imperf. 1 sg., form VIII of shāqa/ishtāqa; takes the acc. here, usually ilā); 'I long for'
الْغَنَائِمَ: الـ + غَنَائِم — al-, the + ghanāʾim, spoils, booty (pl. of ghanīma, f.; acc. object); 'the spoils'
عَائِدًا: عَائِدًا — ʿāʾid, returning (active part. of ʿāda, acc. ḥāl); 'returning'
وَاَصُولُ: و + أَصُولُ — wa-, and + aṣūlu, I assault, charge (imperf. 1 sg., ṣāla); 'and I shall assault'
اَقْرَانِهَا: أَقْرَان + هَا — aqrān, peers, equals, opponents (pl. of qirn, m.) + -hā, its/their; 'its peers'
حَافِيًا: حَافِيًا — ḥāfin, barefoot (adj.; acc. ḥāl, from ḥafiya); 'barefoot'
قَصِيرِ: قَصِير — qaṣīr, short (adj.; gen. in construct, idāfa with the following noun); 'short of'
الْأَكْمَامِ: الـ + أَكْمَام — al-, the + akmām, sleeves (pl. of kumm, m.); 'the sleeves'
لِبْدَةٌ: لِبْدَة — libda, felt cap, felt (f.; nom. indef.); 'a felt cap'
رَغِيفٌ: رَغِيف — raghīf, loaf of bread (m.; nom. indef.); 'a loaf'
نَاشِفٌ: نَاشِف — nāshif, dry (active part. of nashafa, adj. m.); 'dry'
ثَلٰثَهُ: ثَلَاثَة — thalātha, three (m.; written ثَلٰثَهُ with dagger alif and ة as هُ, Middle Arabic/orthographic form); 'three'
الْأَزَجِ: الـ + أَزَج — al-, the + azaj, the vaulted gate quarter/gate of al-Azaj in Baghdad (m., name; gen. in construct after بَاب); 'of al-Azaj'
وَسَاحَ: و + سَاحَ — wa-, and + sāḥa, roam, wander (perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he roamed'
الْقِفَارِ: الـ + قِفَار — al-, the + qifār, wastes, deserts (pl. of qafr, m.); 'the wastes'
فَضَاقَتْ: فَـ + ضَاقَتْ — fa-, so (consequence) + ḍāqat, become narrow (perf. 3 f. sg., ḍāqa); 'so it became narrow'
بِاتِّسَاعِهَا: بِـ + اتِّسَاع + هَا — bi-, with (accompaniment, 'despite its wideness') + ittisāʿ, wideness, vastness (m., form VIII verbal noun) + -hā, its; 'with its wideness'
تَلْتَذَّ: تَلْتَذَّ — taltadhdha, take delight (subj. 3 f. sg., form VIII of ladhdha, after لَمْ/وَلَمْ here jussive-form spelling; 'she did not take delight'); 'take delight'
مَتَاعِهَا: مَتَاع + هَا — matāʿ, goods, enjoyment (m.) + -hā, its; 'its goods'
فَانْتَظَرَتْهُ: فَـ + انْتَظَرَتْ + هُ — fa-, and + intaẓarat, wait for (perf. 3 f. sg., form VIII) + -hu, him; 'and she waited for him'
تَقَعْ: تَقَعْ — taqaʿ, fall, light upon (jussive 3 f. sg. after لَمْ, waqaʿa); 'she did not fall (upon news)', i.e. find no news
صَدْرُهَا: صَدْر + هَا — ṣadr, breast, chest (m.) + -hā, her; 'her breast'
وَعَيَّطَتْ: و + عَيَّطَتْ — wa-, and + ʿayyaṭat, cry aloud, shriek (perf. 3 f. sg., form II; colloquial/Middle Arabic verb); 'and she cried aloud'
أَنِيسِي: أَنِيس + ي — anīs, companion, intimate (m.) + -ī, my; 'my companion'
هَيَّجْتَ: هَيَّجْتَ — hayyajta, stir up, excite (perf. 2 m. sg., form II); 'you have stirred up'
أَحْزَانِي: أَحْزَان + ي — aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn, m.) + -ī, my; 'my sorrows'
بَعُدْتَ: بَعُدْتَ — baʿudta, be/go far (perf. 2 m. sg., baʿuda); 'you went far'
أَوْطَانِي: أَوْطَان + ي — awṭān, homelands (pl. of waṭan, m.) + -ī, my; 'my homelands'
أَلْتَذُّ: أَلْتَذُّ — altadhdhu, I take delight (imperf. 1 sg., form VIII of ladhdha; the verb takes bi- 'in'); 'I take delight'
وَالْأَحْزَانُ: و + الـ + أَحْزَان — wa-, and + al-, the + aḥzān, sorrows (pl. of ḥuzn, m.); 'and the sorrows'
أُنَادِيكَ: أُنَادِي + كَ — unādī, I call (imperf. 1 sg., form III of nādā) + -ka, you (m.); 'I call you'
تَأْوِيكَ: تَأْوِي + كَ — taʾwī, shelter, give refuge (imperf. 3 f. sg., awā, subj. 'land' f.) + -ka, you (m.); 'shelters you'
صَعَّدَتِ: صَعَّدَتِ — ṣaʿʿadat, send up, raise (perf. 3 f. sg., form II; final -i before the article); 'she sent up'
بِاَنَّا: بِـ + أَنَّا — bi-, with (the verb ʿalima 'know' takes bi- 'of/that'; here introduces the clause) + anna, that + -nā, we; 'that we'
غَيْبَتِكُمْ: غَيْبَة + كُمْ — ghayba, absence (f.) + -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your absence'
نُبْلَى: نُبْلَى — nublā, be worn away, tried (imperf. pass. 1 pl., balā/ablā; subj. after anna with the 'would' sense); 'we would be worn away'
قُسِيٌّ: قُسِيّ — qusiyy, bows (pl. of qaws, f.; nom. indef., read quṣiyy for qisiyy 'bows'); 'bows'
نَبْلًا: نَبْلًا — nabl, arrows (collective, m.; acc. object of madda); 'arrows'
خَلَّفُونِي: خَلَّفُوا + نِي — khallafū, leave behind (perf. 3 m. pl., form II) + -nī, me; 'they left me behind'
شَدِّ: شَدّ — shadd, binding, tightening (m., verbal noun of shadda; gen. in construct after بَعْدَ); 'the binding of'
رِحَالِهِمْ: رِحَال + هِمْ — riḥāl, saddles, baggage (pl. of raḥl, m.) + -him, their; 'their saddles'
اُعَالِجُ: أُعَالِجُ — uʿālij, I struggle with, endure (imperf. 1 sg., form III of ʿālaja; ḥāl clause); 'struggling with'
كُربَ: كُرْب — kurb, anguish, distress (m.; printed كُربَ with the sukūn missing and fatḥa for the construct, i.e. acc. object); 'the anguish of'
الرَّمْلَا: الـ + رَّمْلَا — al-, the + raml, sand (m.; acc. object of qaṭaʿū 'they crossed', with ـا lengthening for the rhyme); 'the sand'
هَتَفَتْ: هَتَفَتْ — hatafat, call out, cry (perf. 3 f. sg., hatafa; takes bi- 'to' the person called); 'she called'
جُنْحَ: جُنْح — junḥ, wing, dark part of the night (m.; acc. of time, 'in the dark of'); 'in the wing of (night)'
حَمَامَةٌ: حَمَامَة — ḥamāma, dove, pigeon (f.; nom. indef.); 'a dove'
مُطَوَّقَةٌ: مُطَوَّقَة — muṭawwaqa, ringed, collared (pass. part. form II of ṭawwaqa, f.; adj. of the dove); 'a ringed one'
نَاحَتْ: نَاحَتْ — nāḥat, lament, coo mournfully (perf. 3 f. sg., nāḥa); 'she lamented'
مَهْلا: مَهْلًا — mahlan, gently! slowly! (adverbial acc., written مَهْلا with bare alif, verb of exhortation); 'gently!'
لَعَمْرُكَ: لَـ + عَمْر + كَ — la-, by (oath particle) + ʿamr, life (m.) + -ka, your; 'by your life'
كَمِثْلِي: كَـ + مِثْل + ي — ka-, like (prep., redundant with mithl) + mithl, the like of (m.) + -ī, me/my; 'like me'
حَزِينَةً: حَزِينَة — ḥazīna, grieving, sad (adj. f., acc. ḥāl); 'grieving'
خَضَبَتْ: خَضَبَتْ — khaḍabat, dye, stain (perf. 3 f. sg., khaḍaba); 'she dyed'
اِلْفِي: إِلْف + ي — ilf, intimate, close companion (m.) + -ī, my (printed اِلْفِي); 'my intimate'
فَلَاقَيْتُ: فَـ + لَاقَيْتُ — fa-, and + lāqaytu, meet, encounter (perf. 1 sg., form III of lāqā; printed with ā); 'and I met'
دَوَاعِيَ: دَوَاعِيَ — dawāʿī, causes, motives (pl. of dāʿī, m.; acc. object, -ya before the dropped nunation); 'causes of'
هَمِّ: هَمّ — hamm, care, worry (m.; gen. in construct after دَوَاعِي); 'care'
تُفَارِقُنِي: تُفَارِق + نِي — tufāriqu, part from, leave (imperf. 3 f. sg., form III; subj. dawāʿī, pl. non-human) + -nī, me; 'they do not part from me'
اَصْلًا: أَصْلًا — aṣlan, at all, absolutely (adverbial acc. of aṣl, 'root'; printed اَصْلًا); 'at all'
امْتَنَعَتْ: امْتَنَعَتْ — imtanaʿat, refrain, abstain (perf. 3 f. sg., form VIII; takes min 'from'); 'she refrained'
وَالِانْتِحَابِ: و + الـ + اِنْتِحَاب — wa-, and + al-, the + intiḥāb, sobbing (m., form VIII verbal noun; gen. after فِي); 'and the sobbing'
فَأَبْكَتِ: فَـ + أَبْكَتِ — fa-, so (result) + abkat, make weep (perf. 3 f. sg., form IV of bakā; -i before the article); 'so she made weep'
الْعِبَادَ: الـ + عِبَاد — al-, the + ʿibād, servants, people (pl. of ʿabd, m.; acc. object); 'the servants'
عَيْنُكَ: عَيْن + كَ — ʿayn, eye (f.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your eye'
وَشَكَوْا: و + شَكَوْا — wa-, and + shakaw, complain (perf. 3 m. pl., shakā); 'and they complained'
تَحَامُلَ: تَحَامُل — taḥāmul, oppression, bearing down unjustly (m., form VI verbal noun; acc. object in construct); 'the oppression of'
بَعُدَ: بَعُدَ — baʿuda, be/go far (perf. 3 m. sg.; takes ʿan 'from'); 'he went far'
وَطَنِهِ: وَطَن + هِ — waṭan, homeland (m.) + -hi, his; 'his homeland'
وَطُرِدَ: و + طُرِدَ — wa-, and + ṭurida, be driven out (perf. pass. 3 m. sg., ṭarada; min 'from'); 'and he was driven out'
يُشْبِعُ: يُشْبِعُ — yushbiʿu, fill, satisfy (imperf. 3 m. sg., form IV of shabiʿa); 'he used to fill'
الْجِيعَانَ: الـ + جِيعَان — al-, the + jīʿān, hungry (pl. of jāʾiʿ, m.; acc. object); 'the hungry'
وَيَأْمُرُ: و + يَأْمُرُ — wa-, and + yaʾmuru, command (imperf. 3 m. sg., amara; the verb takes bi- 'with/to' what is commanded); 'and he commanded'
وَالْآنَانِ: و + الـ + أَنَان — wa-, and + al-, the + anān, moaning, groaning (m., verbal noun of anna; printed الْآنَانِ with long ā, gen. after فِي); 'and the moaning'
خَبَرُ: خَبَر — khabar, news, report (m., nom., subject of waṣala, first term of an iḍāfa with kāna mā kāna); 'the news of'
ذُرِّيَّةِ: ذُرِّيَّة — dhurriyya, offspring, descendants (f., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'offspring'
بَلَغَنَا: بَلَغَ + نَا — balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1pl object; 'it has reached us'
تَغَرَّبَ: تَغَرَّبَ — tagharraba, to go abroad, become a stranger (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he has gone off a stranger'
سَاسَانُ: سَاسَان — Sāsān, proper name, the king (nom., subject of sami‘a)
هَيْبَتُهُ: هَيْبَة + ـهُ — hayba, awe, dread (f., nom., subject of waqa‘at) + 3ms possessive; 'the awe of him'
وَيَأْخُذَهُمْ: وَ + يَأْخُذَ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (verb I, subj. 3ms, after an) + 3mpl object; 'and take them'
وَيَدُورَ: وَ + يَدُورَ — wa-, and + dāra, to go round, search about (verb I hollow, subj. 3ms, after an); with عَلَى, 'go round after'
أَطَّلِعْ: أَطَّلِعْ — iṭṭala‘a, to come to know, learn (verb VIII, jussive 1s after lam; takes عَلَى, 'learn of'); 'I have not come to know'
أَثَرٍ: أَثَر — athar, trace, track (m., gen. after ‘alā; wa-qaftu ‘alā = 'stand upon'); 'a trace'
بِخَبَرٍ: بِـ + خَبَر — bi-, with (prep.; akhbara 'inform' takes the matter with bi-) + khabar, news (m., gen. indef.); 'with news'; also: after atā, 'bring', bi- marks what is brought (lam yaʾtihi aḥadun bi-khabarin, 'no one brought him news'); after samiʿa, 'hear of', bi- marks what is heard of (samiʿta bi-khabarin, 'have you heard any news') Also after rajaʿa, 'to return', bi- marks what one brings back: tarjiʿu ilayya bi-khabarin, 'she may come back to me with news'.
أُمُّهُ: أُمّ + ـهُ — umm, mother (f., nom., subject) + 3ms possessive; 'his mother'
لَايَقِرُّلَهَا: لَا + يَقِرُّ + لَهَا — lā, not + qarra, to settle, be at rest (verb I, impf. 3ms) + li-, for (prep.) + 3fs; run together, 'there does not settle for her'
قَرَارٌ: قَرَار — qarār, settling, rest, stability (m., nom., subject of yaqirru); 'a settling' Also subject of the same-root verb istaqarra: وَلَمْ يَسْتَقِرَّلِي قَرَارٌ 'I could find no rest'.
وَلَايُطَاوِعُهَا: وَ + لَا + يُطَاوِعُ + هَا — wa-, and + lā, not + ṭāwa‘a, to obey, comply with (verb III, impf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and does not obey her'
اصْطِبَارٌ: اصْطِبَار — iṣṭibār, patience, endurance (VIII verbal noun; m., nom., subject); 'patience'
وَمَضَي: وَ + مَضَى — wa-, and + maḍā, to pass, elapse (verb I, perf. 3ms), spelled with ي for ى; with عَلَيْهَا, 'passed over her'; 'and there passed'
الْبَرِّ: الـ + بَرّ — barr, open land, desert (m., gen. after fī); 'the open land'
رَاجِلًا: رَاجِل — rājil, man on foot, pedestrian (act. part.; m., acc. indef. object of yara); 'a man on foot'
رُقَادُةُ: رُقَاد + ـهُ — ruqād, sleep (m., nom., subject of ṭāra) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'his sleep'
سُهَادُةُ: سُهَاد + ـهُ — suhād, sleeplessness, wakefulness (m., nom., subject of zāda) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'his sleeplessness'
أَهْلَهُ: أَهْل + ـهُ — ahl, family, people (m., acc., object of tafakkara) + 3ms possessive; 'his people'; here object of li-ukhbira, 'to inform his family'
وَبِلَادَةُ: وَ + بِلَاد + ـهُ — wa-, and + bilād, country, land (m., acc., coordinated object) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'and his country'
نَبَاتِ: نَبَات — nabāt, plants, vegetation (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'plants'
وَيَشْرَبُ: وَ + يَشْرَبُ — wa-, and + shariba, to drink (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'and drinking'
أَنْهَارِهَا: أَنْهَار + هَا — nahr, river (m. broken pl., gen. after min) + 3fs possessive; 'its rivers'
وَيَقِيلُ: وَ + يَقِيلُ — wa-, and + qāla, to take the noon rest (verb I hollow, impf. 3ms); 'and taking the noon rest'
الْحَرِّ: الـ + حَرّ — ḥarr, heat (m., gen.; second term of an iḍāfa after waqt); 'the heat'
قَائِلَةٍ: قَائِلَة — qāʾila, noontide, midday rest (f., gen. after kull; second term of an iḍāfa); 'noontide'
أَشْجَارِهَا: أَشْجَار + هَا — shajar, tree (m. broken pl., gen. after taḥta) + 3fs possessive; 'its trees'
مُعْشِبَةِ: مُعْشِبَة — mu‘shiba, grassy, abounding in herbage (act. part. of IV a‘shaba; f., gen. adj. of arḍ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'grassy'
الْفَلَوَاتِ: الـ + فَلَوَات — falāh/falāt, wastes, open desert (f. pl. of falāt; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the wastes'
الْجَنَبَاتِ: الـ + جَنَبَات — janaba, side, flank (f. pl. of janba; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of the sides'
وَهٰذِةِ: وَ + هٰذِةِ — wa-, and + hādhihi, this (f. demonstrative), spelled with ة for ه; 'and this'
كَأْسَاتِ: كَأْسَات — ka'sāt, cups (f. sound pl. of ka's; gen., first term of an iḍāfa after min); 'cups of'
أَصْوَاتِ: أَصْوَات — aṣwāt, voices, sounds (m. broken pl. of ṣawt; gen. after ‘alā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the voices of'
الرُّعُودِ: الـ + رُّعُود — ru‘ūd, thunders (m. pl. of ra‘d; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the thunders'
وَالْحَمَامِ: وَ + الـ + حَمَام — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥamām, doves, pigeons (m. collective, gen., coordinated); 'and the doves'
جَوَانِبُهَا: جَوَانِب + هَا — jawānib, sides, parts (f. broken pl. of jānib; nom., subject of ikhḍarrat) + 3fs possessive; 'its sides'
عَوْدَةٌ: عَوْدَة — ‘awda, return (f., nom. indef., predicate of the fronted fī amalī); 'a return'
وَشَرَّدْتُ: وَ + شَرَّدْتُ — wa-, and + sharrada, to stray, wander off (verb II, perf. 1s); 'and I have strayed'
حُبِّ: حُبّ — ḥubb, love (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the love of'
اَجِدْ: أَجِدْ — wajada, to find (verb I assimilated, jussive 1s after lam); 'I have not found'
وَتَوَضَّأَ: وَ + تَوَضَّأَ — wa-, and + tawaḍḍaʾa, to perform the ablution (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he made the ablution'
هٰذِةِ: هٰذِةِ — hādhihi, this (f. demonstrative), spelled with ة for ه; 'this'
يَسْتَرِيحُ: يَسْتَرِيحُ — istarāḥa, to rest, take ease (verb X hollow, impf. 3ms); 'resting'
بِطُولِهِ: بِـ + طُول + ـهِ — bi-, in/for (prep., marks the extent of time) + ṭūl, length (m., gen.) + 3ms possessive; 'in its length', i.e. all day long
انْتَبَهَ: انْتَبَهَ — intabaha, to wake up (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'he woke'
بَارِقُ: بَارِق — bāriq, lightning flash, gleam (act. part. of bāraqa/baraqa; m., nom. subject); 'a lightning flash'
ثَغْرِ: ثَغْر — thaghr, mouth, front teeth (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the mouth of'
وَوَجْهٌ: وَ + وَجْه — wa-, and + wajh, face (m., nom. indef., coordinated); 'and a face'
رَائِقُ: رَائِق — rāʾiq, clear, limpid, pleasing (act. part. of rāqa; m., nom., adj. of wajh); 'clear'
صَلُّوْا: صَلُّوا — ṣallā, to pray (verb II, perf. 3mpl, with ا written ـوْا); with عَلَيْهَا, 'prayed to/over her'; 'they prayed'
الدُّيُوْرِ: الـ + دُّيُور — dayr, monastery (m. broken pl., gen. after fī); 'the monasteries'
اَسَاقِفٌ: أَسَاقِف — asāqif, bishops (m. broken pl. of usquf; nom., subject); 'bishops'
خَرُّوْا: خَرُّوا — kharra, to fall down (verb I, perf. 3mpl); with إِلَيْهَا, 'fell down before her'; 'they fell down'
بِالسُّجُوْدِ: بِـ + الـ + سُّجُود — bi-, in/with (prep., marks the manner) + al-, the + sujūd, prostration (m., gen.); 'in prostration'
اَسْهَلُ: أَسْهَل — ashal, easier (elative of sahl; m., nom., predicate); with مِنْ, 'easier than'
صُدُوْدِ: صُدُود — ṣudūd, turning away, avoidance (m., gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the turning away of'
حَبِيْبِهِ: حَبِيب + ـهِ — ḥabīb, beloved (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + 3ms possessive; 'his beloved'
يَغْشَنِي: لَمْ + يَغْشَ + نِي — lam, not + ghashiya, to come over, overtake (verb I, jussive 3ms, final vowel shortened) + 1s object; 'has not come over me'
خَيَالٌ: خَيَال — khayāl, phantom, apparition (m., nom., subject); 'a phantom'
طَارِقُ: طَارِق — ṭāriq, night visitor, coming by night (act. part. of ṭaraqa; m., nom., adj. of khayāl); 'night-visiting'
يَافَرْحَةَ: يَا + فَرْحَة — yā, O (vocative particle; run together) + faraḥa, joy (f., acc. as the first term of a vocative iḍāfa); 'O the joy of'
تَجَمَّعُوْا: تَجَمَّعُوا — tajammaʿa, to gather, assemble (verb V, perf. 3mpl); 'they have gathered'
وَاَقَامَ: وَ + أَقَامَ — wa-, and + aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and (he) stayed'
مَعْشُوْقٌ: مَعْشُوق — maʿshūq, beloved one (pass. part. of ʿashiqa; m., nom., subject of aqāma); 'a beloved'
وَعَاشِقُ: وَ + عَاشِق — wa-, and + ʿāshiq, lover (act. part. of ʿashiqa; m., nom., coordinated); 'and a lover'
الرَّبِيْعِ: الـ + رَّبِيع — rabīʿ, spring (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after waqt); 'the spring'
وَزَهْرِهِ: وَ + زَهْر + ـهِ — wa-, and + zahr, blossom, flowers (m., gen., coordinated) + 3ms possessive; 'and its blossom'
شَارِبَ: شَارِب — shārib, drinker (act. part. of shariba; m., acc. as vocative iḍāfa, first term); 'O drinker of'
الصَّهْبَاءِ: الـ + صَّهْبَاء — ṣahbāʾ, tawny wine (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa; the wine reddish in colour); 'the tawny wine'
دُوْنَكَ: دُونَ + كَ — dūna, before, in front of (adv. used as an imperative 'take!') + 2ms; 'before you, take'
النَّعِيْمِ: الـ + نَّعِيم — naʿīm, bliss, delight (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of bliss'
وَمَاؤُهَا: وَ + مَاء + هَا — wa-, and + māʾ, water (m., nom., subject) + 3fs possessive; 'and its water'
يَتَدَفَّقُ: يَتَدَفَّقُ — tadaffaqa, to gush, flow abundantly (verb V, impf. 3ms); 'gushing'
كَالْغُدْرَانِ: كَـ + الـ + غُدْرَان — ka-, like (prep., introduces the comparison) + al-, the + ghudrān, pools (m. pl. of ghadīr; gen.); 'like the pools'
قَائِلَ: قَائِل — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part. of qāla; m., acc., object of yanẓuru; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the sayer of'
جُنْحِ: جُنْح — junḥ, wing, depth (of the night) (m., gen. after fī; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wing of'
وَجْدُةُ: وَجْد + ـهُ — wajd, passion, ardent love (m., nom., subject of zāda) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'his passion'
وَفَزِعَ: وَ + فَزِعَ — wa-, and + fazi‘a, to take fright (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he took fright'
وَأَخَذَةُ: وَ + أَخَذَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + akhadha, to seize (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'and (the unrest) seized him'
يُصَعِّدُ: يُصَعِّدُ — ṣaʿʿada, to send up, raise (verb II, impf. 3ms); 'sending up'
تَضْمُرُهَا: تَضْمُرُ + هَا — aḍmara, to hide, conceal (verb I, impf. 2ms) + 3fs object; 'you are hiding it'
اِشْفَاقًا: إِشْفَاق — ishfāq, fear, apprehension (IV verbal noun; m., acc. indef. as adverbial of cause); 'out of fear'
فَاَطْلِقِ: فَـ + أَطْلِقِ — fa-, then (introduces the imperative) + aṭlaqa, to let loose, release (verb IV, imperative 2ms, with kasra before al-); 'then let loose'
اِطْلَاقَا: إِطْلَاق — iṭlāq, letting loose, release (IV verbal noun; m., acc. indef. as cognate object); 'a letting loose'
اَحِبَّائِي: أَحِبَّاء + ي — aḥibbāʾ, loved ones, friends (m. broken pl. of ḥabīb; gen. after bayna) + 1s possessive; 'my loved ones'
عُهُودُ: عُهُود — ʿuhūd, covenants, pledges (m. broken pl. of ʿahd; nom., subject of fronted bayni; first term of an iḍāfa); 'covenants of'
اِلَيْهِمْ: إِلَى + هِمْ — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + 3mpl; 'toward them'
اَظَلُّ: أَظَلُّ — ẓalla, to remain, continue (verb I, impf. 1s, kāna-like; takes acc. predicate); 'I remain'
يَرْتَاحُ: يَرْتَاحُ — irtāḥa, to take ease, be moved with delight (verb VIII hollow, impf. 3ms); with إِلَى, 'turns gladly toward'; 'takes ease'
يُطْرِبُنِي: يُطْرِبُ + نِي — aṭraba, to move to joy or longing, stir (verb IV, impf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'moves me'
بَرْدٍ: بَرْد — bard, coolness, cold (m., gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa after nasīm); 'of coolness'
اَشْوَاقًا: أَشْوَاق — ashwāq, longings (m. broken pl. of shawq; acc. indef., object/result of hubba); 'longings'
رَبَّةُ: رَبَّة — rabba, mistress, lady (f., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the mistress of'
الْخَلْخَالِ: الـ + خَلْخَال — khalkhāl, anklet (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the anklet'
عَهْدًا: عَهْد — ʿahd, covenant, pledge (m., acc. indef., object of tadhkuru); 'a covenant'
وَمِيثَاقًا: وَ + مِيثَاق — wa-, and + mīthāq, pact, compact (m., acc. indef., coordinated); 'and a pact'
وَيَشْرَحُ: وَ + يَشْرَحُ — wa-, and + sharaḥa, to explain, relate (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'and (each) explain'
لَاقَا: لَاقَا — lāqā, to meet, encounter (verb III, perf. 3ms, with alif of the rhyme); 'he met'
فُتِنْتَ: فُتِنْتَ — futina, to be enchanted, captivated (verb I passive, perf. 2ms); with بِنَا, 'enchanted by us'; 'you are enchanted'
فَتَنْتِ: فَتَنْتِ — fatana, to enchant, captivate (verb I, perf. 2fs); 'you have enchanted'
رَعَاكِ: رَعَى + كِ — raʿā, to guard, watch over (verb I, perf. 3ms, optative) + 2fs object; 'may (God) guard you'
عُشَّاقَا: عُشَّاق — ʿushshāq, lovers (m. broken pl. of ʿāshiq; acc. indef., object of fatanti); 'lovers'
مَتَّعَ: مَتَّعَ — mattaʿa, to give enjoyment, let enjoy (verb II, perf. 3ms, optative after lā); 'may (God) not give enjoyment'
مَحَاسِنِهَا: مَحَاسِن + هَا — maḥāsin, beauties, good qualities (m. broken pl.; gen. after min) + 3fs possessive; 'her beauties'
بَعْدِهَا: بَعْد + هَا — baʿd, after (adv., gen. after min) + 3fs; 'after her'
الْكَرَى: الـ + كَرَى — karā, sleep, drowsiness (m., gen. in iḍāfa after ṭība, indeclinable ى); 'the sleep' Also gen. after fī: fa-fī al-karā, 'in slumber' (Night 191).
ذَاقًا: ذَاقَ — dhāqa, to taste (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms, with tanwīn alif for the rhyme); 'it has tasted'
لَسْعَةً: لَسْعَة — lasʿa, sting, burning pang (f., acc. indef. after yā li- of exclamation); 'O for a sting'
مَارَايْتُ: مَا + رَأَيْتُ — mā, not (negative particle) + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1s), run together and spelled with ا; 'I have not seen'
وَرَشْفِ: وَ + رَشْف — wa-, and + rashf, sipping, sucking (m., gen., coordinated in iḍāfa); 'and the sipping of'
تِرْيَاقًا: تِرْيَاق — tiryāq, antidote, theriac (m., acc. indef., object of ra'aytu); 'an antidote'
شَخْصَهُ: شَخْص + هُ — shakhṣ, person, figure (m., acc., object of yara) + 3ms possessive; 'his person'
الْقَائِلَ: الـ + قَائِل — qāʾil, sayer, speaker (act. part. of qāla; m., acc., subject of anna after dhālika); 'the sayer'
وَمُنِعَ: وَ + مُنِعَ — wa-, and + muniʿa, to be prevented (verb I passive, perf. 3ms); with مِنْ, 'prevented from'; 'and was prevented'
يَضَعَ: يَضَعَ — waḍaʿa, to put, place (verb I assimilated, subj. 3ms after an); 'he put'
أَنِيسًالِي: أَنِيسًا + لِـ + ي — anīs, companion, friend (m., acc. indef., second object of ajʿalu) + li-, for (prep.) + 1s, run together; 'a companion for me'
تَنَحْنَحَ: تَنَحْنَحَ — tanaḥnaḥa, to clear one's throat, hem (quadriliteral verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he cleared his throat'
السَّائِرُ: الـ + سَّائِر — sāʾir, traveller, one who goes (act. part. of sāra; m., nom. vocative after ayyuhā); 'the traveller'
الْعَاكِرِ: الـ + عَاكِر — ʿākir, murky, dark (act. part. of ʿakira; m., gen., adj. of layl); 'the murky'
تَقَرَّبْ: تَقَرَّبْ — taqarraba, to come near (verb V, imperative 2ms); with مِنِّي, 'come near to me'
تَجِدَنِي: تَجِدَ + نِي — wajada, to find (verb I assimilated, subj. 2ms after an) + 1s object; 'you find me'
الْمُجِيبُ: الـ + مُجِيب — mujīb, answerer, responder (act. part. of IV ajāba; m., nom. vocative after ayyuhā); 'the answerer'
لِدَعْوَتِي: لِـ + دَعْوَة + ي — li-, to/for (prep.; ajāba li- 'answer') + daʿwa, call, summons (f., gen.) + 1s possessive; 'to my call'
وَالسَّامِعُ: وَ + الـ + سَّامِع — wa-, and + al-, the + sāmiʿ, hearer, listener (act. part. of samiʿa; m., nom. vocative, coordinated); 'and the hearer'
لِقِصَّتِي: لِـ + قِصَّة + ي — li-, to (prep., object marker of the hearer) + qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., gen.) + 1s possessive; 'to my story'
بِكَلَامِكَ: بِـ + كَلَام + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; ʿajjala bi- 'hasten with') + kalām, speech (m., gen.) + 2ms possessive; 'with your speech'
دُنُوِّ: دُنُوّ — dunuww, drawing near, approach (m., gen. after qabla; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the drawing near of'
حِمَامِكَ: حِمَام + كَ — ḥimām, death, fate (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + 2ms possessive; 'your death'
صَوْتِكَ: صَوْت + كَ — ṣawt, voice (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after ghayra) + 2ms possessive; 'your voice'
قِصَّتُهُ: قِصَّة + ـهُ — qiṣṣa, story (f., nom., subject of the topic hādhā) + 3ms possessive; 'his story'
الدَّاعِي: الـ + دَّاعِي — dāʿī, caller, one who calls (act. part. of daʿā; m., nom. vocative after ayyuhā); 'the caller'
فَالْبَثْ: فَـ + الْبَثْ — fa-, then (apodosis) + labitha, to stay, tarry (verb I, imperative 2ms, with hamzat wasl); 'then tarry'
وَالنَّهَارُ: وَ + الـ + نَّهَار — wa-, and + al-, the + nahār, day, daylight (m., nom., coordinated subject of yaṭluʿa); 'and the day'
لَبِثَ: لَبِثَ — labitha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he stayed'
وَلَبِثَ: وَ + لَبِثَ — wa-, and + labitha, to stay, remain (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he stayed'
يَتَنَاشَدَانِ: يَتَنَاشَدَانِ — tanāshada, to recite verses to one another (verb VI, impf. 3m dual); 'reciting to each other'
وَيَبْكِيَانِ: وَ + يَبْكِيَانِ — wa-, and + bakā, to weep (verb I, impf. 3m dual); with bi-, 'weep with tears'; 'and weeping'
عَرَبِ: عَرَب — ʿarab, Arabs (m. collective, gen. after min; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the Arabs of'
الْبَادِيَةِ: الـ + بَادِيَة — bādiya, desert, steppe (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the desert'
رَثَّةٌ: رَثَّة — raththa, threadbare, worn out (f., nom. indef., adj. of thiyāb, a non-human pl. taking f. sg.); 'threadbare'
صَدِىٌ: صَدِئ — ṣadiʾ, rusty (adj.; m., gen. indef., adj. of sayf), spelled with ى for ئ; 'rusty'
جَفِيرِهِ: جَفِير + هِ — jafīr, scabbard, quiver (m., gen. after fī) + 3ms possessive; 'its scabbard'
بِالْإِكْرَامِ: بِـ + الـ + إِكْرَام — bi-, with (prep., marks the manner; ḥayyāhu bi- 'saluted him with') + al-, the + ikrām, honouring (IV verbal noun; m., gen.); 'with the honouring'
احْتَقَرَهُ: احْتَقَرَ + ـهُ — iḥtaqara, to despise, hold in contempt (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he despised him'
وَحَالَتُهُ: وَ + حَالَة + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥāla, state, condition (f., nom., subject) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'and his state'
حَالَةُ: حَالَة — ḥāla, state, condition (f., nom., predicate; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the state of'
فَقِيرٍ: فَقِير — faqīr, poor man (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'a poor man'
الْعُرْبَانِ: الـ + عُرْبَان — ʿurbān, Arabs, Bedouins (m. broken pl. of ʿarabī; gen. after min); 'the Arabs'
كَلَّمْتَنِي: كَلَّمْتَ + نِي — kallama, to speak to (verb II, perf. 2ms) + 1s object; 'you have spoken to me'
هُمَامٍ: هُمَام — humām, high-minded, magnanimous (m., gen. indef., adj. of fāris); 'high-minded'
قَبْضَتِي: قَبْضَة + ي — qabḍa, grasp, grip (f., gen. after fī) + 1s possessive; 'my grasp'
أَرْحَمُكَ: أَرْحَمُ + كَ — raḥima, to take pity on (verb I, impf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'I take pity on you'
لِصِغَرِ: لِـ + صِغَر — li-, because of (prep., gives the reason) + ṣighar, smallness, youth (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'for the smallness of'
فَأَجْعَلُكَ: فَـ + أَجْعَلُ + كَ — fa-, so (consequence) + jaʿala, to make (verb I, impf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'so I will make you'
فَظَاعَةَ: فَظَاعَة — fazāʿa, ugliness, atrocity, harshness (f., acc., object of samiʿa; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the ugliness of'
نِظَامِهِ: نِظَام + هِ — niẓām, arranging, order (of verse) (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after ḥusn) + 3ms possessive; 'his arranging'
لَيِّنٍ: لَيِّن — layyin, soft, gentle (m., gen. indef., adj. of kalām); 'soft'
سِنِّي: سِنّ + ي — sinn, age, tooth (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after ṣighar) + 1s possessive; 'my age'
وَأَخْبِرْنِي: وَ + أَخْبِرْ + نِي — wa-, and + akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imperative 2ms; takes ʿan for the topic) + 1s object; 'and tell me'
سَيْرِكَ: سَيْر + ـكَ — sayr, going, travelling (m. verbal noun of sāra; gen., second term of iḍāfa after sabab) + 2ms possessor; 'your going'
وَإِنْشَادِكَ: وَ + إِنْشَاد + ـكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + inshād, reciting (m. verbal noun of IV anshada; gen., coordinated after ʿan sabab) + 2ms possessor; 'and your reciting'
وَأَرَاكَ: وَ + أَرَى + ـكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾā, to see, think (verb I, imperf. 1s; ʾarā) + 2ms object; 'and I see you'
تَذْكُرُأَنَّنِي: تَذْكُرُ + أَنَّ + ـنِي — dhakara, to mention (verb I, imperf. 2ms, run together with the next word) + anna, that (particle) + 1s pronoun (-nī, subject of anna); 'you mention that I'
صَبَّاحُ: Ṣabbāḥ — personal name (nom., predicate of 'I am' as speaker's name); 'Ṣabbāḥ'
رَمَّاحِ: Rammāḥ — personal name (gen., after ibn, 'son of'); 'Rammāḥ'
هَمَّامٍ: Hammām — personal name (gen. with tanwīn, after ibn); 'Hammām'
وَقَوْمِي: وَ + قَوْم + ـِي — wa-, and (conj.) + qawm, people, tribe (m., nom., subject) + 1s possessor; 'and my people'
نَجْمَهُ: نَجْمَة + ـهُ — Najma, personal name (the cousin) spelled نَجْمَهُ for نَجْمَةُ; with ة written as ه (nom., the name of the girl); 'Najma'
النِّعْمَةُ: الـ + نِّعْمَة — al-, the (def. art.) + niʿma, blessing, favour, good fortune (f., nom., subject of 'came'); 'the blessing'
نَجْمَهَ: نَجْمَة — Najma, personal name, spelled نَجْمَهَ for نَجْمَةَ (gen. after abū, 'father of Najma'); 'Najma'
وَكَبِرَتْ: وَ + كَبِرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + kabira, to grow up, become big (verb I, perf. 3fs, the cousin); 'and she grew up'
وَحَجَبَنِي: وَ + حَجَبَ + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥajaba, to veil, screen off (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'and he veiled me'
فَقِيرَ: فَقِير — faqīr, poor (adj., m., acc. as hal/second object of raʾā, 'saw me poor'); 'poor'
فَدَخَّلْتُ: فَـ + دَخَّلْتُ — fa-, so, then (conj., consequence) + dakhkhala, to bring in, make enter (verb II, perf. 1s); 'so I brought in'
الْعَرَبَ: الـ + عَرَب — al-, the (def. art.) + ʿarab, Arabs, Bedouin (m. coll., acc., object of dakhkhaltu); 'the Arabs'
الْكِبَارَ: الـ + كِبَار — al-, the (def. art.) + kibār, great, big (m. broken pl. of kabīr; acc., adj. of al-ʿarab); 'the great'
وَسَادَاتِ: وَ + سَادَات + ـِ — wa-, and (conj.) + sādāt, lords, chiefs (m. pl. of sayyid; acc. -ī as first term of iḍāfa); 'and the lords of'
الْقَبَائِلِ: الـ + قَبَائِل — al-, the (def. art.) + qabāʾil, tribes (f. broken pl. of qabīla; gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'the tribes'
وَسُقْتُ: وَ + سُقْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sāqa, to drive, urge on (verb I hollow, perf. 1s); 'and I drove'
وَأَجَابَ: وَ + أَجَابَ — wa-, and (conj.) + IV ajāba, to consent, answer (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and he consented'
يُعْطِيَنِي: يُعْطِي + نِي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an; -iya written -ī) + 1s indirect object; 'that he give me'
وَلٰكِنَّهُ: وَ + لٰكِنَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but (particle governing acc.) + 3ms pronoun (-hu, subject of lākinna); 'but he'
مَهْرِهَا: مَهْر + ـِهَا — mahr, bride-price (m., gen. after fī) + 3fs possessor; 'her bride-price'
رَأْسًا: رَأْس — raʾs, head (m., acc. with tanwīn, counted noun after khamsīn, 'head of livestock'); 'head(s)'
نَاقَةً: نَاقَة — nāqa, she-camel (f., acc. tamyīz after khamsīn); 'she-camel'
عِشَارِيَّاتٍ: عِشَارِيَّات — ʿishāriyyāt, ten-months-pregnant (she-camels) (f. sound pl. adj. from ʿishār; acc. -ātin spelled with tanwīn, adj. of nāqa); 'ten-month-pregnant'
مُحَمَّلَةَ: مُحَمَّلَة — muḥammala, laden, loaded (pass. part. of II ḥammala; f. acc. spelled -a, adj./hal of jamalan; first term of iḍāfa with burr); 'laden (with)'
بُرٍّ: بُرّ — burr, wheat (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of iḍāfa); 'of wheat'
وَمِثْلُهَا: وَ + مِثْل + ـُهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + mithl, the like, equal (m., nom., subject of an implied 'on me') + 3fs possessor (referring to the camels); 'and the like of them'
وَعَشْرَ: وَ + عَشْر — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿashr, ten (f. numeral before jawārin 'slave-girls'; acc., coordinated object of ishtaraṭa); 'and ten'
وَحَمَّلَنِي: وَ + حَمَّلَ + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥammala, to load, burden (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1s object; 'and he loaded me'
الصَّدَاقِ: الـ + صَدَاق — al-, the (def. art.) + ṣadāq, dowry, bride-price (m., gen. after fī); 'the dowry'
وَعَزَمْتُ: وَ + عَزَمْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿazama, to resolve, determine (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I resolved'
الْمَيَاسِيرِ: الـ + مَيَاسِير — al-, the (def. art.) + mayāsīr, the well-off, rich (m. broken pl. of maysūr; gen., apposition to the merchants); 'the rich ones'
فَأَخْرُجُ: فَـ + أَخْرُجُ — fa-, then (conj., sequence) + kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 1s indic.); 'then I go out'
أَثَرِهِمْ: أَثَر + ـِ + هِمْ — athar, track, trace (m., gen. after ʿalā/fī) + 3mp possessor; 'their track'
وَأُغِيرُ: وَ + أُغِيرُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aghāra, to raid, attack (verb IV, imperf. 1s indic.; takes ʿalā 'raid upon'); 'and I raid'
رِجَالَهُمْ: رِجَال + ـَهُمْ — rijāl, men (m. broken pl. of rajul; acc. object of raid/take-over) + 3mp possessor; 'their men'
وَأَسُوقُ: وَ + أَسُوقُ — wa-, and (conj.) + sāqa, to drive off, drive (verb I hollow, imperf. 1s indic.); 'and I drive off'
وَأَحْمَالَهُمْ: وَ + أَحْمَال + ـَهُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥmāl, loads, burdens (m. broken pl. of ḥiml; acc. object of asūqu) + 3mp possessor; 'and their loads'
أَخْطَرُ: akhṭar — more dangerous, graver (elative of khaṭir; m., nom. predicate of maraḍī); 'more dangerous'
وَأَهْلُهَا: وَ + أَهْل + ـُهَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ahl, family, people (m., nom., subject) + 3fs possessor; 'and her people'
يَكْفِيهِمْ: يَكْفِي + هِمْ — kafā, to suffice (verb I, imperf. 3ms; takes direct object) + 3mp object; 'it would suffice them'
صَبَّاحٌ: Ṣabbāḥ — personal name (nom., subject of qāla); 'Ṣabbāḥ'
مَهْبُولٌ: mahbūl — crazed, deranged (m. adj. nom. with tanwīn, predicate of 'you are'); 'crazed'
مَخْبُولٌ: makhbūl — deranged, demented (m. adj., nom. with tanwīn, coordinated predicate); 'deranged'
سِيمَةُ: sīma — sign, mark, token (f., nom. as first term of iḍāfa in 'no sign of kingship on you'); 'a sign/mark'
صُعْلُوكٌ: ṣuʿlūk — pauper, penniless vagabond (m., nom. with tanwīn, predicate); 'a pauper'
تَسْتَغْرِبْ: تَسْتَغْرِبْ — istaghraba, to find strange, deem odd (verb X, imperf. 2ms jussive after lā, prohibition); 'do not find strange'
الْبَيَانَ: الـ + بَيَان — al-, the (def. art.) + bayān, clear exposition, explanation (m., acc., object of arada/aḥabba 'wish'); 'the clear account'
وَتَسَلْطَنَ: وَ + تَسَلْطَنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasalṭana, to become sultan, assume rule (verb V quadriliteral, perf. 3ms; denominal from sulṭān); 'and he became sultan'
خِفْيَةً: khifya — secrecy, stealth (f., acc. with tanwīn as adverbial/hal, 'secretly'); 'in secret'
أَوْضَحْتُ: awḍaḥtu — awḍaḥa, to make clear, explain (verb IV, perf. 1s, spelled with -tu); 'I have made clear'
فَقِصَّتُكَ: فَـ + قِصَّة + ـُكَ — fa-, so, therefore (conj.) + qiṣṣa, story, tale (f., nom., subject, spelled 'qiṣṣatuka') + 2ms possessor; 'so your story'
وَحَاجَتُكَ: وَ + حَاجَة + ـُكَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥāja, need, desire (f., nom., subject) + 2ms possessor; 'and your need'
وَافَرْحَتِي: وَا + فَرْحَة + ـِي — wā, O! (vocative/exclamatory particle of lament or joy) + faraḥa, joy (f., exclamation) + 1s possessor; 'O my joy'
كَسْبٌ: kasb — gain, profit, acquisition (m., nom. with tanwīn, subject of laysa); 'a gain'
وَخَرَجْتَ: وَ + خَرَجْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + kharaja, to go out (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'and you went out'
صُعْلُوكٍ: ṣuʿlūk — pauper, vagabond (m., gen. with tanwīn, second term of iḍāfa after zayy 'garb of'); 'of a pauper'
يَطْلُبُونَكَ: يَطْلُبُون + كَ — ṭalaba, to seek, look for (verb I, imperf. 3mp indic.) + 2ms object; 'they seek you'
وَجَدُوكَ: وَجَدُوا + كَ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3mp, final alif of plural written -ū) + 2ms object; 'they found you'
فَبِالْأَمْوَالِ: فَـ + بِـ + الـ + أَمْوَال — fa-, then (conj., apodosis of idhā) + bi-, with, by means of (prep.) + al-, the + amwāl, wealth, goods (m. broken pl. of māl; gen.); 'then with wealth'
يَفْدُونَكَ: يَفْدُون + كَ — fadā, to ransom, redeem (verb I defective, imperf. 3mp indic.) + 2ms object; 'they ransom you'
فَاَدِرْ: فَـ + أَدِرْ — fa-, so, then (conj.) + adara, to turn (verb IV, imperative 2ms, spelled with hamzat al-waṣl; 'turn'); 'so turn'
كِتَافَكَ: كِتَاف + ـَكَ — kitāf, shoulders (m. pl.; acc. object of adir; plural of katif, here 'arms bound behind') + 2ms possessor; 'your shoulders'
غُلَامِي: غُلَام + ـِي — ghulām, boy, slave-boy (m., acc. in vocative idāfa after yā) + 1s possessor; 'my slave-boy'
أَخَا: أَخَا — akh, brother (m., acc. -ā as vocative with iḍāfa 'O brother of the Arabs'); 'O brother'
يَشْتَرُونَنِي: يَشْتَرُون + ـنِي — ishtarā, to buy (verb VIII, imperf. 3mp indic., with -nūn) + 1s object (nūn al-wiqāya); 'they buy me'
بِفِضَّةٍ: بِـ + فِضَّة — bi-, with, at the price of (prep., buy with a price) + fiḍḍa, silver (f., gen. indef.); 'with silver'
بِدِرْهَمِ: بِـ + دِرْهَم — bi-, with, at the price of (prep.) + dirham, dirham, silver coin (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa with nuḥās); 'with a dirham'
الْأَخْلَاقَ: الـ + أَخْلَاق — al-, the (def. art.) + akhlāq, manners, character (m. pl. of khuluq; acc., object of daʿ, 'leave'); 'the manners'
وَاتَّخِذْنِي: وَ + اتَّخِذْ + ـنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ittakhadha, to take, adopt (verb VIII, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; 'and take me'
الرِّفَاقِ: الـ + رِّفَاق — al-, the (def. art.) + rifāq, companions (m. pl. of rafīq; gen. after min, partitive 'among'); 'the companions'
لِنَجُولَ: لِـ + نَجُولَ — li-, in order to (particle of purpose, takes subjunctive) + jāla, to roam, go about (verb I hollow, imperf. 1p subjunctive); 'so that we roam'
نَوَاحِي: nawāḥī — regions, districts (f. pl. of nāḥiya; gen., first term of iḍāfa after fī); 'the regions of'
لَعَلَّنَا: لَعَلَّ + نَا — laʿalla, perhaps, may (particle governing acc., introducing hope) + 1p pronoun (-nā, subject); 'perhaps we'
نَظْفَرُ: naẓfaru — ẓafira bi-, to win, obtain (verb I, imperf. 1p indic.; the verb takes bi- 'win something'); 'we may win'
بِالْمَهْرِ: بِـ + الـ + مَهْر — bi-, chosen by ẓafira 'win' (prep.; marks what is won) + al-, the + mahr, bride-price (m., gen.); 'the bride-price (we may win)'
وَالصَّدَاقِ: وَ + الـ + صَدَاق — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṣadāq, dowry (m., gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and the dowry'
وَنَحْظَى: وَ + نَحْظَى — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaẓiya, to be favoured, enjoy (verb I defective, imperf. 1p subjunctive; takes bi- of the thing enjoyed); 'and we be favoured'
عَمِّنَا: عَمّ + نَا — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after banāt) + 1p possessor; 'our uncle'
بِالتَّقْبِيلِ: بِـ + الـ + تَقْبِيل — bi-, with, of (prep., chosen by ḥaẓiya min ... bi- 'be favoured with') + al-, the + taqbīl, kissing (m. verbal noun of II qabbala; gen.); 'with the kissing'
الْإِعْجَابُ: الـ + إِعْجَاب — al-, the (def. art.) + iʿjāb, self-conceit, admiration (m. verbal noun of IV aʿjaba; nom., subject of izdāda); 'the self-conceit'
وَالِالْتِهَابُ: وَ + الـ + الْتِهَاب — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iltihāb, inflaming, burning (m. verbal noun of VIII iltahaba; nom.), spelled with article + hamzat al-waṣl as الِالْتِهَابُ; 'and the inflaming'
اَتُرَادِدُنِي: أَ + تُرَادِدُ + نِي — a-, interrogative particle ('do you?') + rādda, to bandy words, talk back (verb III, imperf. 2ms indic.) + 1s object; 'do you bandy words with me'
أَخَسَّ: akhass — vilest, meanest (elative of khasīs; m., acc. in vocative idāfa 'O vilest of the dogs'); 'vilest'
اَدِرْ: اِدِرْ — adara, to turn (verb IV, imperative 2ms, spelled with hamzat al-waṣl alif); 'turn'
أَنْزَلْتُ: anzaltu — anzala, to send down, bring down (verb IV, perf. 1s; takes 'ʿalā' of the one afflicted); 'I have brought down'
الْعَذَابَ: الـ + عَذَاب — al-, the (def. art.) + ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m., acc., object of anzaltu); 'the torment'
أُدِيرُ: أُدِيرُ — adara, to turn (verb IV, imperf. 1s indic.; with lahu 'for you'); 'I turn'
الْكِتَافَ: الـ + كِتَاف — al-, the (def. art.) + kitāf, shoulders (m. pl., acc., object of udīru); 'the shoulders'
إِنْصَافٌ: inṣāf — fairness, equity (m. verbal noun of IV anṣafa; nom. with tanwīn, subject of 'is there not with you'); 'fairness'
مُعَايَرَةَ: muʿāyara — reproaching, taunting (f. verbal noun of III ʿāyara; acc., object of takhshā, first term of iḍāfa with al-ʿurbān); 'the reproach (of)'
تَسُوقَ: تَسُوقَ — sāqa, to drive, lead off (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'that you drive'
وَالْهَوَانِ: وَ + الـ + هَوَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + hawān, contempt, abasement (m., gen., coordinated after fī); 'and the contempt'
اخْتَبَرْتَهُ: اخْتَبَرْتَ + هُ — ikhtabara, to test, try out (verb VIII, perf. 2ms) + 3ms object; 'you tested him'
لِتَعْلَمَ: لِـ + تَعْلَمَ — li-, in order that (particle of purpose, takes subjunctive) + ʿalima, to know (verb I, imperf. 2ms subjunctive); 'that you may know'
جَبَانٌ: jabān — coward, cowardly (m. adj., nom. with tanwīn, predicate after aw); 'a coward'
لَلّٰهِ: لَ + لّٰهِ — la-, O for (exclamatory lām of wonder; with Allāh in the formula) + Allāh, God (gen.); 'for God (what a wonder)'
سِنِّ: sinn — age (m., gen. with elided tanwīn; first term of iḍāfa after fī 'in the age of'); 'the age'
وَلٰكِنَّكَ: وَ + لٰكِنَّ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + lākinna, but (particle governing acc.) + 2ms pronoun (-ka, subject of lākinna); 'but you'
لَايَصْدُرُ: لَا + يَصْدُرُ — lā, not (neg. particle) + ṣadara, to issue, proceed (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.), written run together; 'does not issue'
الْبَطَلِ: الـ + بَطَل — al-, the (def. art.) + baṭal, hero, champion (m., gen. after min ... illā); 'the hero'
الْمِصْدَامِ: الـ + مِصْدَام — al-, the (def. art.) + miṣdām, one who clashes hard, stout in combat (m. intensive adj., gen., adj. of al-baṭal); 'the clasher'
إِنْصَافٍ: inṣāf — fairness, equity (m. verbal noun of IV anṣafa; gen. with tanwīn, after min); 'of fairness'
تُرِيدُنِي: تُرِيد + نِي — arāda, to want, wish (verb IV, imperf. 2ms indic.) + 1s object; 'you want me'
فَارْمِ: فَـ + ارْمِ — fa-, then (conj., apodosis of 'if') + ramā, to throw, cast (verb I defective, imperative 2ms); 'then throw'; also fa- of consequence after a statement, 'so': anā fī fuʾādika fa-irmi ṭarfaka, 'I am in your heart, so cast your glance' (Night 182)
سِلَاحَكَ: سِلَاح + ـَكَ — silāḥ, weapon(s) (m., acc., object) + 2ms possessor; 'your weapons'
وَخَفِّفْ: وَ + خَفِّفْ — wa-, and (conj.) + khaffafa, to lighten (verb II, imperative 2ms); 'and lighten'
وَادْنُ: وَ + ادْنُ — wa-, and (conj.) + danā, to draw near (verb I defective, imperative 2ms; takes min 'near'); 'and come near'
وَصَارِعْنِي: وَ + صَارِعْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣāraʿa, to wrestle with (verb III, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; 'and wrestle me'
صَرَعَ: ṣaraʿa — to throw down, fell (verb I, perf. 3ms; conditional subject 'whoever throws'); 'throws down'
مَرَامَهُ: مَرَام + ـَهُ — marām, aim, goal, desire (m., acc., object of yanālu) + 3ms possessor; 'his aim'
غُلَامَهُ: غُلَام + ـَهُ — ghulām, slave-boy (m., acc., second object of yattakhidhu) + 3ms possessor; 'his slave-boy'
تَدُلُّ: tadullu — dalla ʿalā, to point to, indicate (verb I, imperf. 3fs; the verb takes ʿalā 'point to'); 'points to'
سِلَاحَهُ: سِلَاح + ـَهُ — silāḥ, weapon(s) (m., acc., object of ramā) + 3ms possessor; 'his weapons'
أَذْيَالَهُ: أَذْيَال + ـَهُ — adhyāl, skirts, hems (m. broken pl. of dhayl; acc., object of shammara/ṭawā) + 3ms possessor; 'his skirts'
وَدَنَا: وَ + دَنَا — wa-, and (conj.) + danā, to draw near (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; with min/ilā 'to'); 'and he drew near'
وَتَجَاذَبَا: وَ + تَجَاذَبَا — wa-, and (conj.) + tajādhabā, to pull at each other (verb VI, perf. 3 dual); 'and they pulled at each other'
وَيَرْجَحُ: وَ + يَرْجَحُ — wa-, and (conj.) + rajaḥa, to outweigh, be heavier (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.; takes ʿalā 'outweigh'); 'and outweighing'
يَرْجَحُ: yarjaḥu — rajaḥa, to outweigh, preponderate (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.; takes ʿalā); 'outweighs'
الْقِنْطَارُ: الـ + قِنْطَار — al-, the (def. art.) + qinṭār, hundredweight, large weight (m., nom., subject of yarjaḥu); 'the hundredweight'
ثَبَاتِ: thabāt — firmness, steadiness (m. verbal noun of thabata; gen., first term of iḍāfa after ilā/fī); 'the firmness of'
فَوَجَدَهُمَا: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ـهُمَا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual object (the two feet); 'and he found them (two)'
كَالْمَأْذَنَتَيْنِ: كَـ + الـ + مَأْذَنَتَيْن — ka-, like (prep., marks comparison) + al-, the + maʾdhanatayn, two minarets (f. dual of maʾdhana; gen.); 'like the two minarets'
