الْمُؤَسَّسَتَيْنِ: الـ + مُؤَسَّسَتَيْن — al-, the (def. art.) + muʾassasatayn, well-founded (f. dual pass. part. of II assasa; gen., adj. of the minarets); 'the well-founded'
وَتَدَيْنِ: watad — tent-peg, stake (m. dual wataday, gen.; second term after aw, 'two pegs') in the dual with ـَيْنِ; 'two tent-pegs'
مَدْقُوقَيْنِ: madqūqayn — driven in, hammered (m. dual pass. part. of daqqa; gen., adj. of watadayn); 'driven in'
رَاسِخَيْنِ: rāsikhayn — firmly rooted, firm (m. dual act. part. of rasakha; gen., adj. of two mountains); 'firm-rooted'
قِصَرَ: qiṣar — shortness (m. verbal noun of qaṣura; acc., object of ʿalima, first term of iḍāfa with bāʿihi); 'the shortness of'
بَاعِهِ: بَاع + ـِهِ — bāʿ, arm's reach, span (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa) + 3ms possessor; 'his reach'
الدُّنُوِّ: الـ + دُّنُوّ — al-, the (def. art.) + dunuww, drawing near (m. verbal noun of danā; gen., after ʿalā 'regretted'); 'the drawing near'
صِرَاعِهِ: صِرَاع + ـِهِ — ṣirāʿ, wrestling (m. verbal noun of ṣāraʿa; gen., second term of iḍāfa) + 3ms possessor; 'his wrestling'
قَاتَلْتُهُ: قَاتَلْتُ + هُ — qātala, to fight (verb III, perf. 1s; lawā 'would that I had') + 3ms object; 'I had fought him'
بِسِلَاحِي: بِـ + سِلَاح + ـِي — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + silāḥ, weapon (m., gen.) + 1s possessor; 'with my weapons'
أَمْعَاءَهُ: أَمْعَاء + ـَهُ — amʿāʾ, guts, intestines (m. pl. of miʿan; acc., subject of anna) + 3ms possessor; 'his guts'
تَقَطَّعَتْ: تَقَطَّعَتْ — taqaṭṭaʿa, to be cut to pieces (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'were cut to pieces'
أَمْسِكْ: amsik — amsaka, to hold, hold back (verb IV, imperative 2ms; with ʿan/yadaka 'hold your hand'); 'hold'
أَبْدَاةُ: أَبْدَى + ـهُ — abdā, to show, display (verb IV defective, perf. 3ms), with ة written for the pronoun ـهُ (أَبْدَاةُ for أَبْدَاهُ, 'what he showed'); 'he had shown'
هَزَّةُ: hazza — shaking (f. verbal noun of hazza; spelled هَزَّةُ for هَزَّهُ 'he shook him', with ة for the pronoun ـهُ); 'he shook him'
وَرَفَعَهُ: وَ + رَفَعَ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + rafaʿa, to lift, raise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he lifted him'
لِيَرْمِيَهُ: لِـ + يَرْمِيَ + ـهُ — li-, in order to (particle of purpose, takes subjunctive) + ramā, to throw (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms subjunctive) + 3ms object; 'to throw him'
فَنَادَاةُ: فَـ + نَادَى + ـهُ — fa-, then (conj.) + nādā, to call (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object, spelled فَنَادَاةُ with ة for ـهُ; 'and he called him'
أَرْمِيَكَ: أَرْمِيَ + كَ — ramā, to throw (verb I defective, imperf. 1s subjunctive after an, spelled with run-together أُرِيدُأَنْ) + 2ms object; 'that I throw you'
يَعْبُرُ: yaʿburu — ʿabara, to cross, pass over (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.; takes bi- 'cross with'); 'it will cross'
وَالدِّجْلَةُ: وَ + الـ + دِّجْلَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + al-Dijla, the Tigris (river, f., nom., subject); 'and the Tigris'
عِيسَى: ʿĪsā — Nahr ʿĪsā, name of the canal (gen., second term of iḍāfa after nahr; the personal name ʿĪsā); 'ʿĪsā'
وَنَهْرُ: وَ + نَهْر — wa-, and (conj.) + nahr, river, canal (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa in 'Nahr ʿĪsā'); 'and the canal (of ʿĪsā)'
الْفُرَاتِ: الـ + فُرَات — al-, the (def. art.) + al-Furāt, the Euphrates (river; gen. after ilā 'to'); 'the Euphrates'
وَالْفُرَاتُ: وَ + الـ + فُرَات — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + al-Furāt, the Euphrates (river, nom., subject); 'and the Euphrates'
يُلْقِيكَ: يُلْقِي + كَ — alqā, to cast, throw (verb IV defective, imperf. 3ms indic.; with ilā 'to') + 2ms object; 'will cast you'
فَيَرَاكَ: فَـ + يَرَى + كَ — fa-, then (conj., sequence) + raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 2ms object; 'and (they) see you'
قَوْمُكَ: قَوْم + ـُكَ — qawm, people, tribe (m., nom., subject) + 2ms possessor; 'your people'
فَيَعْرِفُونَكَ: فَـ + يَعْرِفُون + كَ — fa-, then (conj., sequence) + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, imperf. 3mp indic.) + 2ms object; 'and they will know you'
وَيَعْرِفُونَ: وَ + يَعْرِفُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿarafa, to know (verb I, imperf. 3mp indic.); 'and they know'
مُرُوَّتَكَ: مُرُوَّة + ـَكَ — murūwa, manliness, chivalry (f., acc., object) + 2ms possessor; 'your manliness'
وَصِدْقَ: وَ + صِدْق — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣidq, truth, sincerity (m., acc., coordinated object, first term of iḍāfa with maḥabbatika); 'and the truth of'
وَنَادَي: وَ + نَادَى — wa-, and (conj.) + nādā, to call (verb III, perf. 3ms), spelled with ي for ى (نَادَي); 'and he called'
فَارِسَ: فَارِس — fāris, horseman, knight (m., acc., vocative in iḍāfa 'O horseman of'); 'horseman'
الْبِطَاحِ: الـ + بِطَاح — al-, the (def. art.) + biṭāḥ, broad valleys, plains (m. pl. of baṭḥāʾ; gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'the broad valleys'
الْقِبَاحِ: الـ + قِبَاح — al-, the (def. art.) + qibāḥ, ugly, vile (m. pl. of qabīḥ; gen., second term of iḍāfa after fiʿl); 'the vile ones'
بِحَيَوٰةِ: بِـ + حَيَاة — bi-, by (prep. of oath, swearing by) + ḥayāt, life (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa), spelled with dagger alif حَيَوٰة; 'by the life of'
زِينَةِ: zīna, adornment (f. noun, gen., construct, apposition to 'daughter of your uncle'); 'the adornment (of the beauties)'
وَضَعَهُ: وَضَعَ + ـهُ — waḍaʿa, to put, set down (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'he put him (down)'
خَالِصًا: khāliṣ, free, clear of (active part., m. sg. acc., circumstantial ḥāl); 'free'
وَتُرْسِهِ: وَ + تُرْس + ـهِ — turs, shield (m., gen., coordinated with sayfihi after ilā) + 3ms possessive; wa-, and (conj.); 'and his shield'
وَأَخَذَهُمَا: وَ + أَخَذَ + هُمَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual object; wa-, and (conj.); 'and he took them (both)'
الْغَدْرِ: الـ + غَدْر — ghadr, treachery (m., gen. after فِي); al-, the; fī, in/about (prep.); 'the treachery'
وَالْهُجُومِ: وَ + الـ + هُجُوم — hujūm, assault, falling upon (verbal noun, m., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; 'and the falling upon (him)'
مَلَكْتَ: malaka, to possess, gain control of (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you have taken possession of'
وَتُرْسَكَ: وَ + تُرْس + كَ — turs, shield (m., acc., object of مَلَكْتَ) + 2ms possessive; wa-, and (conj.); 'and your shield'
يَدٌ: yad, hand (f. noun, nom., indefinite subject, 'hand' = power/skill); 'a hand'
عَدِيمُ: ʿadīm, lacking, devoid of (adj., m. sg. nom., predicate in construct with al-ḥiyal); 'lacking (of)'
تَجُولُ: tajūlu, to wheel about, career (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic., ḥāl after كُنْتَ); 'wheeling about'
وَبِسَيْفِكَ: وَ + بِـ + سَيْف + كَ — sayf, sword (m., gen.) + 2ms possessive; bi-, with (instrument, prep.); wa-, and; 'and with your sword'
تَصُولُ: taṣūlu, to assault, charge (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic., ḥāl); 'assaulting'
مَقْتُولْ: maqtūl, killed (passive part., m. sg. nom., predicate), final vowel dropped in pause/rhyme; 'killed'
أُبَلِّغُكَ: ubalighu + ka — ballagha, to make attain, convey (verb II, imperf. 1s) + 2ms object; 'I will make you attain'
لَايَبْقَى: لَا + يَبْقَى — baqiya, to remain (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after ḥattā/li-); lā, not (neg.); 'so that there does not remain'
إِنْكَارٌ: inkār, denial, objection (verbal noun, m., nom., subject); 'a denying / an objection'
فَأَعْطِنِي: فَـ + أَعْطِ + نِي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + 1s object (ī, with nūn of protection); fa-, so (conj.); 'so give me'
التُّرْسَ: الـ + تُرْس — turs, shield (m., acc., second object of aʿṭā); al-, the; 'the shield'
وَاهْجُمْ: وَ + اهْجُمْ — hajama, to fall upon, attack (verb I, imperative 2ms; takes عَلَى 'upon', here with بِ of instrument); wa-, and; 'and fall upon (me)'
بِسَيْفِكَ: بِـ + سَيْف + كَ — sayf, sword (m., gen.) + 2ms possessive; bi-, with (instrument, prep.); 'with your sword'
وَجَرَّدَ: وَ + جَرَّدَ — jarrada, to bare, draw (a sword) (verb II, perf. 3ms); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he bared/drew'
فَتَنَاوَلَ: فَـ + تَنَاوَلَ — tanāwala, to take hold of, take (verb VI, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so (sequence); 'and he took'
بِيَمِينِهِ: بِـ + يَمِين + هِ — yamīn, right hand (f., gen.) + 3ms possessive; bi-, in/with (prep.); 'in his right hand'
يُلَاقِي: yulāqī, to meet, ward off (verb III, imperf. 3ms indic.); 'meeting (the blows)'
الْفَاضِلَةُ: الـ + فَاضِلَة — fāḍila, surpassing, excellent (active part. f., nom., adjective/apposition to 'this blow'); al-, the; 'the surpassing one'
فَتَخْرُجُ: فَـ + تَخْرُجُ — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 3fs indic.; subject the blow); fa-, and so (conj.); 'and it would come out'
قَاتِلَةٍ: qātila, killing (active part. f., gen. indefinite after غَيْرَ/lā-construction, 'not killing'); 'killing'
وَيَأْخُذُهَا: وَ + يَأْخُذُ + هَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 3fs object (the blow); wa-, and; 'and he would take it'
التُّرْسِ: الـ + تُرْس — turs, shield (m., gen. after عَلَى, 'on the shield'); al-, the; 'the shield'
وَتَرُوحُ: وَ + تَرُوحُ — rāḥa, to go away, depart (verb I, imperf. 3fs indic., subject the blow); wa-, and (conj.); 'and it would go (away)'
ضَائِعَةً: ḍāʾiʿa, wasted, lost (active part. f. sg., acc., ḥāl); 'wasted'
يَدُةُ: yad + ihi — yad, hand (f. noun, nom., subject of kallat) + 3ms possessive, spelled with ة for ـهُ; 'his hand'
خَصْمُهُ: khaṣm + uhu — khaṣm, adversary (m., nom., subject) + 3ms possessive; 'his adversary'
وَهَزَّةُ: وَ + هَزَّ + هُ — hazza, to shake (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object, spelled with ة for ـهُ; wa-, and; 'and he shook him'
وَأَلْقَاهُ: وَ + أَلْقَى + هُ — alqā, to throw (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; wa-, and; 'and he threw him'
وَأَدَارَ: وَ + أَدَارَ — adāra, to turn around (verb IV, perf. 3ms); wa-, and (conj.); 'and he turned'
كِتَافَهُ: كِتَاف + ـهُ — kitāf, the cord that pinions a man's arms behind his back at the shoulders (katif), and so the pinioning itself (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; here object of ḥalla, 'to untie': yaḥullū kitāfahu, 'untie his bonds'; also adāra kitāfahu, 'he turned (his arms back) for the bonds'
بِحَمَائِلِ: بِـ + حَمَائِل — ḥamāʾil, baldric straps (pl. of ḥimāla, gen., construct); bi-, with (instrument, prep.); 'with the baldrics'
وَجَرَّةُ: وَ + جَرَّ + هُ — jarra, to drag (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object, spelled with ة for ـهُ; wa-, and; 'and he dragged him'
وَفَارِسَ: وَ + فَارِس — fāris, horseman (m., voc./acc., construct, coordinated with yā ayyuhā al-shābbu); wa-, and; 'and (O) horseman of'
أَلَمْ: أَ + لَمْ — a-, interrogative particle; lam, not (neg. particle with jussive, past sense); 'did I not' Also of other persons: a-lam taʿlamī, 'did you (f.) not know?', expecting yes.
أَقُلْ: lam + aqul — qāla, to say (verb I, jussive 1s, short form 'aqul' after lam); 'I (did) say'
أُرْسِلَكَ: urslika — arsala, to send (verb IV, subjunctive 1s after anna) + 2ms object; 'that I send you'
وَقَوْمِكَ: وَ + قَوْم + كَ — qawm, people, kin (m., gen., coordinated with ahlika) + 2ms possessive; wa-, and; 'and your people'
يَشْتَغِلَ: yashtaghila — ishtaghala, to be occupied, busy (verb VIII, subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā lā); 'be occupied'
وَتَتَعَوَّقَ: وَ + تَتَعَوَّقَ — taʿawwaqa, to be held back, delayed (verb V, subjunctive 2ms, takes ʿan 'from'); wa-, and; 'and be held back'
عُرْسِ: ʿurs, wedding (m., gen., construct after ʿan, 'delayed from the wedding'); 'wedding'
فَضَجَّرَ: فَـ + ضَجَّرَ — ḍajjara, to grow distressed, weary (verb II, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so (conj.); 'and he grew distressed'
وَأَطْلِقْنِي: وَ + أَطْلِقْ + نِي — aṭlaqa, to release, let go (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; wa-, and; 'and release me'
وَاجْعَلْنِي: وَ + اجْعَلْ + نِي — jaʿala, to make, set (verb I, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; wa-, and; 'and make me'
تَغَرَّبْتُ: tagharrabtu — tagharraba, to go abroad, live in exile (verb V, perf. 1s, ʿan 'from' his people); 'I have gone abroad'
فَيَاطُولَ: فَـ + يَا + طُول — ṭūl, length (m., voc. exclamation, acc., construct); fa-, so; yā, O (exclamatory); 'so O the length (of my exile)'
وَيَالَيْتَ: وَ + يَا + لَيْتَ — layta, would that (particle, governs acc.), preceded by yā, O (exclamatory); wa-, and; 'and O would that'
اَمُوتُ: amūtu — māta, to die (verb I, imperf. 1s indic., after interrogative hal); 'shall I die' / 'I shall die'
وَاَهْلِي: وَ + أَهْل + ي — ahl, people, family (m., nom., construct) + 1s possessive; wa-, and; spelled with alif for hamza; 'and my people'
مَقْتَلِي: maqtal + ī — maqtal, place/manner of killing (m. noun of place, acc./nom.) + 1s possessive; 'the place of my killing'
وَاَوْدَى: وَ + أَوْدَى — awdā, to perish (verb IV, imperf. 1s, spelled with alif for hamza, 'aūdā'); wa-, and; 'and I shall perish'
اَزُورُ: azūru — zāra, to visit (verb I, imperf. 1s indic.); spelled with alif for hamza; 'visiting'
حَبِيبًا: ḥabīb, beloved (m., acc., object of azūru, indefinite); 'a beloved' Also object of yasurru: ḥālin lā yasurru ḥabīban, 'a state that gladdens no friend'.; here: object of aḥbabta, 'a beloved'
فَرَحِمَهُ: فَـ + رَحِمَ + هُ — raḥima, to take pity on (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; fa-, and so (conj.); 'and he took pity on him'
تُعَاهِدُنِي: tuʿāhidunī — ʿāhada, to pledge, make a covenant with (verb III, imperf. 2ms) + 1s object; 'you pledge me'
بِالْعُهُودِ: بِـ + الـ + عُهُود — ʿuhūd, covenants, pledges (pl. of ʿahd, gen.); bi-, with (prep., 'pledge with'); al-, the; 'with the pledges'
وَالْمَوَاثِيقِ: وَ + الـ + مَوَاثِيق — mawāthīq, covenants, bonds (pl. of mīthāq, gen., coordinated with al-ʿuhūd); wa-, and; 'and the covenants'
الرَّفِيقُ: al-rafīq, companion (m., nom., specified noun after niʿma); 'companion'
وَتَصْحَبُنِي: وَ + تَصْحَبُ + نِي — ṣaḥiba, to accompany (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic.) + 1s object; wa-, and; 'and you accompany me'
وَعَاهَدَةُ: وَ + عَاهَدَ + هُ — ʿāhada, to pledge (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object, spelled with ة for ـهُ; wa-, and; 'and he pledged him'
فَأَطْلَقَهُ: فَـ + أَطْلَقَ + هُ — aṭlaqa, to release, let go (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; fa-, and so; 'and he released him'
يُقَبِّلَ: yuqabbila — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, subjunctive 3ms after an, depending on arāda 'wanted'); 'to kiss'
الْبَدَوِى: al-badawī, the Bedouin (m. nom., nisba; ى written for ي); 'the Bedouin'
جِرَابَهُ: jirāb + ahu — jirāb, bag, pouch (m., acc., object of fataḥa) + 3ms possessive; 'his bag'
قُرْصَاتِ: qurṣāt, round loaves (pl. of qurṣa, f., acc. in construct, after thalāth 'three'; gen. form in -āt); 'loaves'
وَإِيَّاةُ: وَ + إِيَّا + هُ — iyyā, object pronoun base (used after wa- 'he and him') + 3ms suffix, spelled with ة for ـهُ; wa-, and; 'and him'
حَافَةِ: ḥāfa, edge, brink (f., gen., construct after ʿalā 'on'); 'the edge (of the river)'
تَوَضَّأَا: tawaḍḍaʾā — tawaḍḍaʾa, to perform ablution (verb V, perf. 3 dual); 'the two performed ablution'
وَصَلَّيَا: وَ + صَلَّيَا — ṣallā, to pray (verb II, perf. 3 dual); wa-, and (conj.); 'and the two prayed'
مَالَقِيَاةُ: مَا + لَقِيَا + هُ — mā, what (rel.); laqiya, to meet, experience (verb I, perf. 3 dual) + 3ms object spelled with ة for ـهُ; run-together ʿalā mā laqiyāhu; 'what the two had met'
أَهْلِهِمَا: ahl + himā — ahl, family, people (m., gen., after min) + 3 dual possessive; 'their (two) families'
تَعْزِمُ: taʿzimu — ʿazama, to resolve, be bound for (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic.); 'do you resolve / are you bound'
يَرْزُقَ: yarzuqa — razaqa, to provide for (verb I, subjunctive 3ms after ḥattā); 'provides'
بِالصَّدَاقِ: بِـ + الـ + صَدَاق — ṣadāq, bride-price, dowry (m., gen.); bi-, with (prep., here of the thing provided); al-, the; 'with the bride-price'
وَالطَّرِيقَ: وَ + الـ + طَّرِيق — ṭarīq, road (m., acc. as exclamation, 'and the road!'); wa-, and; 'and the road'
فَوَدَّعَهُ: فَـ + وَدَّعَ + هُ — waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; fa-, and so; 'and he bade him farewell'
لِلرُّجُوعِ: لِـ + الـ + رُّجُوع — rujūʿ, returning (verbal noun, m., gen.); li-, for (prep., 'for the returning'); al-, the; 'for returning'
وَالْفَاقَةِ: وَ + الـ + فَاقَة — fāqa, want, destitution (f., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the want'
خَائِبًا: khāʾib, disappointed, empty-handed (active part., m. sg. acc., ḥāl); 'disappointed'
سَجَدَ: sajada, to prostrate (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he prostrated'
جَبْهَتَهُ: jabhat + ahu — jabha, forehead (f., acc., object of waḍaʿa) + 3ms possessive; 'his forehead'
اللّٰهُمَّ: اللّٰهُمَّ — allāhumma, O God (vocative formula; Allāh + mma for yā); 'O God'
مُنْزِلَ: munzil, sender-down (active part. IV, m., voc., construct, acc.); 'sender-down (of)'
الْقَطْرِ: الـ + قَطْر — qaṭr, raindrops, rain (m., gen., construct); al-, the; 'the raindrops'
وَرَازِقَ: وَ + رَازِق — rāziq, provider (active part., m., voc., construct); wa-, and; 'and provider of'
الدُّودِ: الـ + دُّود — dūd, worm (m. collective, gen., construct); al-, the; 'the worm'
تَرْزُقَنِي: tarzuqa + nī — razaqa, to provide for (verb I, subjunctive 2ms after an) + 1s object; 'that you provide for me'
بِقُدْرَتِكَ: بِـ + قُدْرَة + كَ — qudra, power (f., gen.) + 2ms possessive; bi-, by (prep., of means); 'by your power'
وَلَطِيفِ: وَ + لَطِيف — laṭīf, gentleness, kindness (m., gen., construct; here adj. used as noun); wa-, and; 'and the gentleness of'
رَحْمَتِكَ: raḥmat + ika — raḥma, mercy (f., gen., construct) + 2ms possessive; 'your mercy'
صَلَوٰتِهِ: ṣalawāt + ihi — ṣalāh, prayer (f., spelled صَلَوٰة; gen. after min) + 3ms possessive; 'his prayer'
مَسْلَكٍ: maslak, path, way (m., gen., construct after kull); 'path'
يَلْتَفِتُ: yaltafitu — iltafata, to turn about, look around (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms indic., ḥāl); 'turning'
اقْتَعَدَ: iqtaʿada, to sit firm upon, mount (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'he had sat firm on'
وَأَرْخَي: وَ + أَرْخَى — arkhā, to let loose, slacken (verb IV, perf. 3ms; spelled with ي); wa-, and; 'and he let loose'
بِالْفَنَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + فَنَاء — fanāʾ, perishing, death (verbal noun, m., gen.); bi-, of (prep., after ayqana 'become certain of'); al-, the; 'of the perishing'
بَالِغٌ: bāligh, severe (active part., m. sg. nom., adjective of jurḥ); 'severe'
جَرِي: jarā, to run, flow (verb I, perf. 3ms; spelled with ي for ى); 'ran'
دَمْعُهُ: damʿ + uhu — damʿ, tears (m. collective, nom., subject) + 3ms possessive; 'his tears'
الْقِرَبِ: الـ + قِرَب — qirab, waterskins (pl. of qirba, gen., construct); al-, the; 'the waterskins'
لِكَانَ: لِـ + كَانَ مَا كَانَ — li-, to (prep., after qāla); Kān Mā Kān (name, gen. after li-); 'to Kān Mā Kān'
اتَّخِذْنِي: ittakhidh + nī — ittakhadha, to take (as), adopt (verb VIII, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; 'take me (as)'
صَدِيقًا: ṣadīq, friend (m., acc., indefinite, second object of ittakhidhnī); 'a friend'; here: object of aʿlam, 'I know (no) friend'
وَاسْقِنِي: وَ + اسْقِ + نِي — saqā, to give to drink (verb I, imperative 2ms) + 1s object; wa-, and; 'and give me to drink'
شُرْبُ: shurb, drinking (verbal noun, m., nom., subject of laysa/lā yaṣliḥ); 'the drinking'
لِلْمَجْرُوحِ: لِـ + الـ + مَجْرُوح — majrūḥ, wounded (passive part., m., gen.); li-, for (prep., 'good for'); al-, the; 'for the wounded'
وَالرُّوحِ: وَ + الـ + رُّوح — rūḥ, spirit, life (m./f., gen., 'especially for the one at the last breath'); wa-, and; 'and the soul'
دَفَعْتُ: dafaʿtu — dafaʿa, to pay, give (verb I, perf. 1s, future sense in the apodosis of in ʿishtu); 'I shall pay'
كَسْرَكَ: kasr + aka — kasr, break, brokenness (m., acc., object of yajburu) + 2ms possessive; 'your brokenness'
وَفَقْرَكَ: وَ + فَقْر + كَ — faqr, poverty (m., acc.) + 2ms possessive; wa-, and; 'and your poverty'
الْمَسْعُودُ: al-masʿūd, fortunate (passive part., m., nom., predicate); 'the fortunate one'
نِيَّتِكَ: niyyat + ika — niyya, intention (f., gen., construct) + 2ms possessive; 'your intention'
جَوَادٌ: jawād, steed, swift horse (m., nom., subject, indefinite); 'a steed'
جِيَادِ: jiyād, fine horses (pl. of jawād, gen., after min); 'of the steeds'
الْحِصَانِ: الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse, stallion (m., gen., construct); al-, the; 'of the horse'
وَصْفِّهِ: waṣf + ihi — waṣf, description (verbal noun, m., gen., after ʿan 'from describing') + 3ms possessive, spelled with shadda; 'its describing'
أَعْمِدَةِ: aʿmida, columns (pl. of ʿamūd, gen., construct, after mithl); 'columns'
الْهَيَمَانُ: al-hayamān, infatuation, passion (m., nom., subject of akhadhahu); 'the infatuation'
أَنْزَلَ: anzala, to bring down (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'he brought down'
وَرَفَقَ: وَ + رَفَقَ — rafaqa, to be gentle (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes bi-/with); wa-, and; 'and he was gentle'
وَجَرَّعَهُ: وَ + جَرَّعَ + هُ — jarraʿa, to make sip (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; wa-, and; 'and he made him sip'
سَلَّالٌ: sallāl, filcher, thief of horses (intensive adj., m. nom., predicate); 'a filcher'
غَيَّارٌ: ghayyār, raider (intensive adj., m. nom., predicate); 'a raider'
أَسُلُّ: asullu — salla, to draw out, filch (verb I, imperf. 1s indic.); 'I filch'
وَأَخْتَلِسُهَا: وَ + أَخْتَلِس + هَا — ikhtalasa, to snatch (verb VIII, imperf. 1s) + 3fs object (the horses); wa-, and; 'and I snatch them'
آفَةُ: āfa, bane, plague (f., nom., construct, apposition to Ghassān); 'the bane (of)'
وَحِصَانٍ: وَ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, stallion (m., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; 'and stallion'
بِهٰذَا: بِـ + هٰذَا — bi-, of/about (prep., samiʿa bi- 'hear of'); hādhā, this (m. demonstrative); 'of this'; here: after raḍiya, bi- marks what is accepted: raḍītu bi-hādhā al-sharṭi, 'I accept this condition'; also after amara, 'to order', bi- marks the thing ordered: amarahu bi-hādhā al-amri, 'ordered him to do this' (Night 194); here after atā bi- (iʾtinā bi-hādhā), 'bring': bi- marks what is brought, 'bring us this (astrologer)'
بِالْقَاتُولِ: بِـ + الـ + قَاتُول — bi-, with (prep., sammā bi- 'name it'); al-, the; al-Qātūl (name of the horse, 'the Killer'); 'with al-Qātūl'
بِالْمَجْنُونِ: بِـ + الـ + مَجْنُون — bi-, with (prep., laqqaba bi- 'surname it'); al-Majnūn (name of the horse, 'the Mad One'); 'with al-Majnūn'
أُرَاقِبُهُ: urāqib + uhu — rāqaba, to watch, observe (verb III, imperf. 1s indic.) + 3ms object; 'I watched it'
مُعَظَّمَةٌ: muʿaẓẓama, revered (passive part. II, f. sg. nom., adjective of ʿajūz); 'revered'
وَأَمْرُهَا: وَ + أَمْر + هَا — amr, command, authority (m., nom.) + 3fs possessive; wa-, and; 'and her command'
مُتَنَاهِي: mutanāhī, reaching the limit, extreme (active part. VI, m./f. nom., predicate, ي for final -in); 'reaching the limit'
وَالْحِصَانِ: وَ + الـ + حِصَان — ḥiṣān, horse (m., gen.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the horse'
وَقَصَدَتْ: وَ + قَصَدَتْ — qaṣada, to make for, head for (verb I, perf. 3fs); wa-, and (conj.); 'and she made for'
لِتَطْلُبَ: لِـ + تَطْلُبَ — ṭalaba, to seek, request (verb I, subjunctive 3fs after li-); li-, in order to (purpose); 'to seek'
الصُّلْحَ: الـ + صُّلْح — ṣulḥ, peace, truce (m., acc., object); al-, the; 'the peace'
وَالْأَمَانَ: وَ + الـ + أَمَان — amān, safety, security (m., acc., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the safety'
تَابِعَهُمْ: tābiʿ + hum — tābiʿ, following (active part. III, m. sg. acc., predicate of mā ziltu) + 3mp object; 'following them'
شِدَادُ: shidād, strong (pl. of shadīd, nom., in construct with al-ḥirṣ); 'strong'
الْحِرْصِ: الـ + حِرْص — ḥirṣ, guarding, eagerness (m., gen., construct); al-, the; 'of the guarding'
أُشَاوِرُ: ushāwiru — shāwara, to consult (verb III, imperf. 1s indic.); 'I was consulting'
سَرِقَةِ: sariqa, stealing (verbal noun, f., gen., construct after fī); 'stealing'
غُبَارٌ: ghubār, dust (m., nom., subject of ṭalaʿa); 'a dust (cloud)'
وَمُقَدَّمُهُمْ: وَ + مُقَدَّم + هُمْ — muqaddam, leader, foremost (passive part. II, m., nom., construct) + 3mp possessive; wa-, and; 'and their leader'
الْهَرَّاشُ: al-harrāsh, snarling, attacking (intensive adj., m. nom., adjective of al-ḍayghām); 'the snarling one'
كَأَسَدٍ: كَـ + أَسَد — asad, lion (m., gen.); ka-, like (prep. of comparison); 'like a lion'
يَجْعَلُ: yajʿalu — jaʿala, to make (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.; takes two objects); 'he makes'
كَالْفَرَاشِ: كَـ + الـ + فَرَاش — farāsh, moths (m. collective, gen.); ka-, like (prep. of comparison); al-, the; 'like the moths'
مُخَضَّبَةِ: مُخَضَّبَة — mukhaḍḍaba, dyed, tinted (pass. part. of II khaḍḍaba; f., gen., agreeing with arḍ); 'dyed (bright) of plants'
الْمَجْرُوحَ: الـ + مَجْرُوح — majrūḥ, wounded (pass. part. of جَرَحَ), accusative, in apposition to al-fāris after anna; 'the wounded (horseman)'
وَأَطْبَقَ: وَ + أَطْبَقَ — wa-, and; aṭbaqa, to close in (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.; takes عَلَى 'upon'); 'and closed in (on)'
وَهَاشَ: وَ + هَاشَ — wa-, and; hāsha, to rampage, storm in a rage (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg., root هـ و ش); 'and stormed'
رَبَطَ: رَبَطَ — rabaṭa, to bind, tie up (verb I, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'he bound'
وَتَسَلَّمَ: وَ + تَسَلَّمَ — wa-, and; tasallama, to take over, receive (verb V, perf. 3 m. sg.; مِنْهُمُ gives the source); 'and took over (from them)'
تَعَبِي: تَعَبِ + ي — taʿab, toil, trouble, weariness (m., nom., subject of ḍāʿa) + -ī, my; 'my toil'
يَؤُلُ: يَؤُلُ — yaʾūlu, to turn out, come round (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., root أ و ل; takes إِلَى 'to'); 'would turn out'
كَهْرْدَاشَ: كَهْرْدَاشَ — Kahrdāsh, a man's name: the chief (al-muqaddam) who seized the old woman's company (genitive, in apposition after لِلْمُقَدَّمِ)
الْهُمَامُ: الـ + هُمَام — al-, the; humām, valiant, high-minded (adj., m., nom., epithet of al-fāris); 'the valiant'
الضِّرْغَامُ: الـ + ضِرْغَام — al-, the; ḍirghām, lion (m., nom., in apposition to al-baṭal; used as an epithet); 'the lion-hearted'
خَادَعَتْهُ: خَادَعَ + تْ + هُ — khādaʿa, to beguile, deceive (verb III, perf. 3 f. sg.; the old woman) + -hu, him (object); 'she beguiled him'
وَحَلَفَتْ: وَ + حَلَفَ + تْ — wa-, and; ḥalafa, to swear (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg.; the oath is followed by anna); 'and she swore'
تَسُوقُ: تَسُوقُ — tasūqu, to drive (animals) (verb I, imperf. 3 f. sg. indic., root س و ق); 'she would drive'
وَالْأَنْعَامَ: وَ + الـ + أَنْعَام — wa-, and; al-, the; anʿām, cattle, livestock (pl. of naʿam, acc., coordinated with al-khayl); 'and the cattle'
فَأَطْلَقَ: فَ + أَطْلَقَ — fa-, so (conj. of consequence); aṭlaqa, to release, set free (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'so he released'
وَأَطْلَقَهَا: وَ + أَطْلَقَ + هَا — wa-, and; aṭlaqa, to release (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg.) + -hā, her (object); 'and released her'
وَتَبِعْتُهُمْ: وَ + تَبِعَ + تُ + هُمْ — wa-, and; tabiʿa, to follow (verb I, perf. 1 sg.) + -hum, them (object); 'and I followed them'
أُلَاحِظُهُ: أُلَاحِظُ + هُ — lāḥaẓa, to watch, keep an eye on (verb III, imperf. 1 sg.) + -hu, it (the horse); 'I was keeping my eye on it'
وَأَتْبَعُهُ: وَ + أَتْبَعُ + هُ — wa-, and; tabiʿa, to follow (verb I, imperf. 1 sg. atbaʿu) + -hu, it (the horse); 'and was dogging it'
مِخْلَاتِي: مِخْلَاة + ي — mikhlāh, saddlebag, nosebag (f., gen. after min) + -ī, my; 'my saddlebag'
أَحَسُّوا: أَحَسُّوا — aḥassū, to sense, become aware of (verb IV, perf. 3 m. pl., root ح س س; takes بِ before the person, here بِي 'of me'); 'they got wind (of me)'
لَحِقُونِي: لَحِقَ + ونِي — laḥiqa, to catch up with, overtake (verb I, perf. 3 m. pl. laḥiqū) + -nī, me (object); 'they overtook me'
السَّهْمِ: الـ + سَهْم — al-, the; sahm, arrow (m., gen., after mithla); 'the arrow'
الرَّاشِقِ: الـ + رَاشِق — al-, the; rāshiq, darting, shooting (act. part. of رَشَقَ, gen., adj. of al-sahm); 'the darting'
وَالنَّجْمِ: وَ + الـ + نَجْم — wa-, and; al-, the; najm, star (m., gen., coordinated with al-sahm after mithla); 'and the star'
الطَّارِقِ: الـ + طَارِق — al-, the; ṭāriq, night-comer, one that strikes by night (act. part. of طَرَقَ, gen., adj. of al-najm; cf. Qurʾān 86 al-Ṭāriq); 'the shooting (star)'
الْكِفَاحُ: الـ + كِفَاح — al-, the; kifāḥ, close combat, fighting (m., nom., subject of ishtadda); 'the fighting'
الْجِرَاحِ: الـ + جِرَاح — al-, the; jirāḥ, wounds (pl. of jurḥ, gen., second term of the construct after baʿḍu); 'the wounds'
أَلْتَذَّ: أَلْتَذَّ — iltadhdha, to take pleasure, relish (verb VIII, imperf. 1 sg., root ل ذ ذ; the thing enjoyed follows with بِ, here بِطَعَامٍ); 'nor do I relish'
ضَعُفَتْ: ضَعُفَ + تْ — ḍaʿufa, to be weak, grow weak (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., agreeing with al-quwā); 'has weakened'
الْقُوَى: الـ + قُوَى — al-, the; quwā, strengths, powers (pl. of quwwa, nom., subject of ḍaʿufat; the ending is invariable); 'my strength'
وَهَانَتْ: وَ + هَانَ + تْ — wa-, and; hāna, to be of little worth, grow cheap (verb I, perf. 3 f. sg., root ه و ن; with عَلَيَّ 'to me'); 'and has grown cheap'
وَشَفِقْتَ: وَ + شَفِقَ + تَ — wa-, and; shafiqa, to take pity (verb I, perf. 2 m. sg.; takes عَلَى, here عَلَيَّ 'on me'); 'and you took pity (on me)'
عَارِىَ: عَارِيَ — ʿārī, bare, naked (act. part. of ʿariya, defective, acc.; second object of arāka, first term of a construct with al-jasad); 'bare (of body)'
الْكَمَدِ: الـ + كَمَد — al-, the; kamad, grief, suppressed sorrow (m., gen., second term of the construct after ẓāhira); 'of the grief'
يَتِيمًا: يَتِيم + ًا — yatīm, orphan (m.), accusative indefinite as ḥāl (state): 'as an orphan'
وَالْعَظِيمِ: وَ + الـ + عَظِيم — wa-, and; al-, the; ʿaẓīm, great (adj. used as noun, gen., coordinated with al-ḥaqīr after ʿalā); 'and the great'
السَّلَّالُ: الـ + سَلَّال — al-, the; sallāl, horse-thief, filcher (intensive of salla; m., nom., subject of qāla); 'the horse-thief' (the character who stole the horse)
حَسَبٍ: حَسَب — ḥasab, lineage, noble descent (m., gen. indef., second term of the construct after dhū); 'of lineage'
وَشَرَفٍ: وَ + شَرَف — wa-, and; sharaf, nobility, honour (m., gen. indef., coordinated with ḥasab); 'and of nobility'
جَسِيمٍ: جَسِيم — jasīm, vast, lofty (adj., m., gen. indef., agreeing with sharaf); 'lofty'
أَفْرَسَ: أَفْرَسَ — afras, finest horseman (elative of fāris; diptote, acc., predicate of taṣīru, first term of a construct with ahl); 'the finest horseman (of)'
وَتُؤَدِّيَنِى: وَ + تُؤَدِّي + نِي — wa-, and; addā, to deliver, convey (verb II, imperf. 2 m. sg., subjunctive after an, coordinated with taḥmila) + -nī, me (object); 'and deliver me'
الشَّرَفُ: الـ + شَرَف — al-, the; sharaf, honour (m., nom., subject of yakun); 'the honour'
وَالْأَجْرُ: وَ + الـ + أَجْر — wa-, and; al-, the; ajr, reward (m., nom., coordinated with al-sharaf); 'and the reward'
التَّنَادِي: الـ + تَّنَادِي — al-, the; tanādī, mutual calling-out (verbal noun of verb VI tanādā, gen., after yawm; the Day of Judgment, Qurʾān 40:32); 'of Mutual Calling'
أُمْسِكُ: أُمْسِكُ — amsaka, to hold, keep hold of (verb IV, imperf. 1 sg. indic.; relative clause on quwwatun, with بِهَا 'with it'); 'I might hold (myself)'
بِالْجَوَادِ: بِـ + الـ + جَوَاد — bi-, to / in (prep.; awlā takes بِـ for the thing one has a better claim to, 'more entitled to'); al-, the; jawād, steed, fine horse (m., gen.); 'to the steed'
أُقَاسِمُكَ: أُقَاسِم + كَ — qāsama, to share with, divide with (verb III, imperf. 1 sg., coordinated with aḥmiluka) + -ka, you (object); 'I share with you'
لَفَعَلْتُ: لَـ + فَعَلَ + تُ — la-, (particle opening the main clause after law, 'would'); faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 1 sg.) + -tu, I; 'I would do (it)'
وَإِغَاثَةِ: وَ + إِغَاثَة — wa-, and; ighātha, succouring, giving help (verb IV verbal noun, f., gen., first term of a construct, coordinated with al-maʿrūf after ahl); 'and the succouring of'
الْمَلْهُوفِ: الـ + مَلْهُوف — al-, the; malhūf, distressed, grieved (pass. part. of lahifa, m., gen., second term of the construct); 'the distressed'
وَفِعْلُ: وَ + فِعْل — wa-, and; fiʿl, doing, deed (verbal noun of faʿala, m., nom., subject of yadfaʿu, first term of a construct with al-khayr); 'and the doing of'
بَلَاءً: بَلَاء — balāʾ, affliction, calamity (m., acc. indef., specifier after sabʿīna); 'calamities'
فَاعْزِمْ: فَ + اعْزِمْ — fa-, so (conj. of consequence); iʿzim, ʿazama, to resolve (verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.; takes عَلَى 'on', here عَلَى الْمَسِيرِ); 'so resolve (on)'
يَحْمِلَهُ: يَحْمِلَ + هُ — yaḥmila, to carry, lift (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an) + -hu, him (object); 'to lift him'
وَيَسِيرَ: وَ + يَسِيرَ — wa-, and; yasīra, sāra, to go, set off (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg., subjunctive after an, coordinated with yaḥmila); 'and set off'
الْمُسْتَعَانِ: الـ + مُسْتَعَان — al-, the; mustaʿān, the one whose help is sought (pass. part. of verb X istaʿāna, gen., epithet of Allāh); 'whose help is sought'
فَغَمَّضَ: فَ + غَمَّضَ — fa-, and so, then (conj. of sequence); ghammaḍa, to close (the eyes) (verb II, perf. 3 m. sg.); 'and he closed'
اغْفِرْ: اغْفِرْ — ighfir, ghafara, to forgive (verb I, imperative 2 m. sg.; the person takes لِـ, here لِيَ 'me'); 'forgive'
الذَّنْبَ: الـ + ذَّنْب — al-, the; dhanb, sin (m., acc., object of ighfir); 'the sin'
يَغْفِرُ: يَغْفِرُ — yaghfiru, ghafara, to forgive (verb I, imperf. 3 m. sg. indic., after lā); 'forgives'
وَتَهَيَّأَ: وَ + تَهَيَّأَ — wa-, and; tahayyaʾa, to make oneself ready (verb V, perf. 3 m. sg.; takes لِـ for what one prepares for); 'and he made himself ready'
لِلْمُهِمَّاتِ: لِـ + الـ + مُهِمَّات — li-, for (prep.; tahayyaʾa li- 'make ready for', chosen by the verb); al-, the; muhimmāt, weighty matters, grave tasks (f. pl. of muhimma, act. part. of verb IV ahamma, gen.); 'for the weighty matters'
ظَلَمْتُ: ظَلَمَ + تُ — ẓalama, to wrong, treat unjustly (verb I, perf. 1 sg.); 'I wronged'
وَأَمْضَيْتُ: وَ + أَمْضَى + تُ — wa-, and; amḍā, to spend, pass (time) (verb IV, perf. 1 sg., root م ض ي); 'and I spent'
الْخُمُوْر: الـ + خُمُور — al-, the; khumūr, wines (pl. of khamr, gen., second term of the construct after shurb; verse-final, pausal); 'the wines'
وَخُضْتُ: وَ + خَاضَ + تُ — wa-, and; khāḍa, to wade, plunge into (verb I, perf. 1 sg., hollow root خ و ض); 'and I waded (through)'
السُّيُوْلَ: الـ + سُّيُول — al-, the; suyūl, torrents, floods (pl. of sayl, acc., object of khuḍtu); 'the torrents'
لِسَلِّ: لِـ + سَلّ — li-, for, in order to (prep. of purpose before a verbal noun); sall, drawing out, filching (verbal noun of salla, gen., first term of a construct); 'for the filching of'
الْخُيُوْلِ: الـ + خُيُول — al-, the; khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl, gen., second term of the construct); 'the horses'
وَهَدْمِ: وَ + هَدْم — wa-, and; hadm, demolishing, pulling down (verbal noun of hadama, gen., coordinated with sall after li-, first term of a construct); 'and the demolishing of'
الطُّلُوْلِ: الـ + طُّلُول — al-, the; ṭulūl, ruins, remains of dwellings (pl. of ṭalal, gen., second term of the construct); 'the ruins'
النَّكُوْر: الـ + نَّكُور — al-, the; nakūr, abominable, vile (intensive adj. of nakira, here gen., pausal; qualifying fiʿl, 'deeds'); 'the vile'
وَأَمْرِي: وَ + أَمْر + ي — wa-, and; amr, affair, case (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'and my affair'
عَظِيْمٌ: عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great, grave (adj., m., nom. indef., predicate of amrī; printed with yā sukūn); 'grave'
وَجُرْمِي: وَ + جُرْم + ي — wa-, and; jurm, crime, guilt (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'and my guilt'
جَسِيْم: جَسِيم — jasīm, huge, enormous (adj., m., nom., predicate of jurmī; verse-final, pausal without tanwīn); 'enormous'
وَقَاتُوْلُ: وَ + قَاتُول — wa-, and; Qātūl, a name: the horse's name in this tale (al-Qātūl, 'the Killer'; nom., subject); the line is obscure; 'and Qātūl'
مِنِيْ: مِنْ + ي — min, from, of (prep.) + -ī, me (printed with a single nūn, for minnī, as the metre needs); 'from me'
الْاُمُوْر: الـ + أُمُور — al-, the; umūr, affairs, matters (pl. of amr, gen., second term of the construct after tamām); printed without the hamza mark; 'the affairs'
وَاَمَّلْتُ: وَ + أَمَّلَ + تُ — wa-, and; ammala, to hope, aspire (verb II, perf. 1 sg.; printed with a bare alif for the hamza); 'and I hoped'
اَنَالُ: أَنَالُ — anālu, nāla, to attain, obtain (verb I, imperf. 1 sg. indic., hollow root ن و ل; printed with a bare alif for the hamza); 'I would attain'
فَاَعْيَى: فَ + أَعْيَى — fa-, but, and so (conj.); aʿyā, to be exhausted, fail (verb IV, perf. 3 m. sg., root ع ي ي; subject masīrī; printed with a bare alif for the hamza); 'but ... failed'
مَسِيرِي: مَسِير + ي — masīr, journey, going (verbal noun of sāra, m., nom., subject of aʿyā) + -ī, my; 'my journey'
وَطُوْلُ: وَ + طُول — wa-, and; ṭūl, length (m.; read in the sense of an adverbial accusative ṭūla 'all the length of', though the print points a ḍamma, as in the transliteration); 'and (all) the length of'
الْحَيٰوةِ: الـ + حَيٰوَة — al-, the; ḥayāh, life (f., gen., second term of the construct after ṭūl; printed with wāw and dagger alif, an older spelling for ā); 'of life'
اَسُلُّ: أَسُلُّ — asullu, salla, to draw out, filch (verb I, geminate, imperf. 1 sg. indic.; printed with a bare alif for the hamza); 'I was filching'
الْخُيُوْلَ: الـ + خُيُول — al-, the; khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl, acc., object of asullu); 'the horses'
وَفَاتِي: وَفَاة + ي — wafāh, death (f., nom., subject of kānat; the initial و is a root letter, not 'and') + -ī, my; 'my death'
الْقَدِيْر: الـ + قَدِير — al-, the; qadīr, the All-Powerful (intensive of qadara, gen. after ʿinda; a divine epithet, as qadīr elsewhere, 'omnipotent'); 'the All-Powerful'
اَمْرِيَ: أَمْر + ي — amr, affair, matter (m., gen., second term of the construct after ākhir; printed with a bare alif for the hamza) + -ya, my (the yā with fatḥa is for the metre); 'my affair'
لِرِزْقِ: لِـ + رِزْق — rizq, provision, sustenance, livelihood (m., gen. in iḍāfa); li-, for (prep., of purpose/benefit); 'for the livelihood of'
الْغَرِيْبِ: الـ + غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger, outsider (m., gen.); al-, the; 'the stranger'
الْيَتِيْمِ: الـ + يَتِيم — yatīm, orphan (m., gen.); al-, the; 'the orphan'
الْفَقِيْر: الـ + فَقِير — faqīr, poor, needy (m., gen. in rhyme-form without final vowel); al-, the; 'the poor man'
غَمَّضَ: غَمَّضَ — ghammaḍa, to close (the eyes) (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'he closed'
فَاهُ: فَا + ـهُ — fā, mouth (m., acc. as object, the 'five nouns' long-vowel form before a suffix); -hu, his; 'his mouth'
وَشَهَقَ: و + شَهَقَ — shahaqa, to gasp, draw a sharp breath (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he gasped'
فَفَارَقَ: فَـ + فَارَقَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so / then; with الدُّنْيَا 'he left the world', i.e. died; 'and so he departed'
وَحَفَرَ: و + حَفَرَ — ḥafara, to dig (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he dug'
فَقَبَّلَهُ: فَـ + قَبَّلَ + ـهُ — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3ms); fa-, then; -hu, him/it (the horse, obj.); 'then he kissed it'
وَنِصْفُ: و + نِصْف — niṣf, half (m., nom.); wa-, and (joins 'half the army' to the subject 'he'); 'and half'
وَحَلَفُوا: و + حَلَفُوا — ḥalafa, to swear an oath (verb I, perf. 3mp); wa-, and; 'and they swore'
مَالَهُمْ: مَا + لَـ + هُمْ — mā, not (negative, with a nominal sentence); li-, to/for (prep. of possession: lahum, 'they have'); -hum, them; 'they have no (king)'
وَاسْتَوْثَقَ: و + اسْتَوْثَقَ — istawthaqa, to bind firmly, secure a pledge (verb X, perf. 3ms), here with مِنْ 'from' the army; wa-, and; 'and he secured (their oath)'
وَالْأَيْمَانِ: و + الـ + أَيْمَان — yamīn, oath (f.), pl. aymān (gen. after بِـ in the sentence); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the oaths'
وَالْبَرْبَرِ: و + الـ + بَرْبَر — barbar, the Berbers, the Berber country (collective, gen.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the Berber (lands)'
أَوَّلٌ: أَوَّل — awwal, first, beginning (m., nom., tanwīn); 'a first'; in لَا يُعْرَفُ لَهُمْ أَوَّلٌ مِنْ آخِرٍ 'no beginning of them is known from an end', i.e. they were countless
آخِرٍ: آخِر — ākhir, last, end (m., gen., tanwīn, after مِنْ 'from'); 'an end'; in 'no first could be told from a last'
يَقْصِدَ: يَقْصِدَ — qaṣada, to head for, aim at (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after أَنْ); 'that he march on'
وَيَمْلِكَ: و + يَمْلِكَ — malaka, to rule, take possession of (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, continuing أَنْ); wa-, and; 'and make himself master of'
وَيَقْتُلَ: و + يَقْتُلَ — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive, continuing أَنْ); wa-, and; 'and kill'
خَالَفَهُ: خَالَفَ + هُ — khālafa, to oppose, go against (verb III, perf. 3ms); -hu, him (obj.); 'he opposed him'
غِمْدِةِ: غِمْد + ـهِ — ghimd, sheath, scabbard (m., gen. after إِلَى); -hi, his/its (spelled -ة in the text for the pronoun ـهِ); 'its sheath'
يُمَلِّكَ: يُمَلِّكَ — mallaka, to make (someone) king (verb II, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after حَتَّى 'until'); 'he has made king'
بَلَغَتْهُ: بَلَغَتْ + هُ — balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the feminine plural subject الْأَخْبَار 'the reports'); -hu, him (obj.); 'reached him'
الْأَفْكَارِ: الـ + أَفْكَار — fikr, thought, worry (m.), pl. afkār (gen. in iḍāfa after بَحْر); al-, the; 'the thoughts', in 'a sea of anxious thoughts'
الدَّوْلَةَ: الـ + دَوْلَة — dawla, state, realm, ruling power (f., acc. after أَنَّ); al-, the; 'the realm'
انْحَرَفَتْ: انْحَرَفَتْ — inḥarafa, to turn away, swerve, turn against (verb VII, perf. 3fs, with عَلَى 'against'); 'turned against (him)'
وَالْكِبَارُ: و + الـ + كِبَار — kibār, the great, the grown (m. pl., nom., plural of كَبِير); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the great (ones)'
وَتَمَنَّى: و + تَمَنَّى — tamannā, to wish, long (verb V, perf. 3ms, III-weak); wa-, and; 'and he wished'
يَقْدَمُ: يَقْدَمُ — qadima, to come, arrive (verb I, imperf. 3ms), with عَلَى 'to' someone; 'he would come to'
وَيَجْذِبُ: و + يَجْذِبُ — jadhaba, to draw, attract, win over (verb I, imperf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and win over'
بِالْمُلَاطَفَةِ: بِـ + الـ + مُلَاطَفَة — mulāṭafa, kindness, gentle treatment (f., gen.); bi-, with/by means of (prep. of instrument); al-, the; 'with kindness'
لِتَطْفَى: لِـ + تَطْفَى — ṭafiya, to die down, be extinguished (verb I, imperf. 3fs subjunctive, III-weak); li-, so that (lām of purpose, with the subjunctive); 'so that it might die down'
شَرَارَةُ: شَرَارَة — sharāra, spark (f., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'the spark (of)'
جَمْرَتِهِ: جَمْرَة + ـهِ — jamra, ember, live coal (f., gen. in iḍāfa); -hi, his; 'his ember', i.e. the glow of his anger
بَلَغَهُ: بَلَغَ + هُ — balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3ms, here 'came to'); -hu, him (obj.); 'reached him'
أَرِيكَتِهِ: أَرِيكَة + ـهِ — arīka, couch, throne-seat (f., gen. after فِي 'in'); -hi, his; 'his throne'
وَوُجَهَاءَ: و + وُجَهَاء — wajīh, notable, person of standing (m.), pl. wujahāʾ (acc., diptote, object of أَخْرَجَ); wa-, and; 'and the notables (of Baghdad)'
وَلَاقَوْهُ: و + لَاقَوْ + هُ — lāqā, to meet, encounter (verb III, perf. 3mp, III-weak); wa-, and; -hu, him (obj.); 'and they met him'
يُقَبِّلُونَ: يُقَبِّلُونَ — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, imperf. 3mp); 'kissing' (a circumstantial clause describing how they walked)
الْأَعْتَابَ: الـ + أَعْتَاب — ʿataba, threshold, doorstep (f.), pl. aʿtāb (acc., object of يُقَبِّلُونَ); al-, the; 'the thresholds'
وَالطَّوَاشِيَّةُ: و + الـ + طَوَاشِيَّة — ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., collective/pl. ṭawāshiyya, nom.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the eunuchs'
فَبَشَّرُوهَا: فَـ + بَشَّرُوهَا — bashshara, to give good news to (verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her (obj.); fa-, then; with بِـ in the next word 'of' the news; 'and they gave her the good news'
أُمَّاهْ: أُمَّ + اهْ — umm, mother (f.); the vocative يَا أُمَّاهْ, with the lengthening/pausal ending -āh, 'O mother'; 'Mother!'
غَمَرَنِي: غَمَرَ + نِي — ghamara, to flood, overwhelm, shower (verb I, perf. 3ms), here with بِـ 'with' (the verb governs the preposition: غَمَرَ بِـ 'shower with'); -nī, me (obj.); 'showered me (with)'
بِالنِّعْمَةِ: بِـ + الـ + نِعْمَة — niʿma, favour, bounty (f., gen.); bi-, with (governed by غَمَرَ 'shower with'); al-, the; 'with favour'
تَحَيَّرَتْ: تَحَيَّرَتْ — taḥayyara, to be bewildered, dazzled, amazed (verb V, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural عُقُول 'minds'); 'were dazzled'
وَالدَّوْلَةِ: و + الـ + دَوْلَة — dawla, state, court, ruling circle (f., gen. in iḍāfa); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the court'
لِغِيَابِكَ: لِـ + غِيَاب + ـكَ — ghiyāb, absence (m., gen.); li-, because of (prep. of cause); -ka, your; 'because of your absence'
سَنَةِ: سَنَة — sana, year (f., gen. in iḍāfa after مِنْ 'from'); 'a year', in مِنْ سَنَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا 'in such and such a year'
عَبَدَةِ: عَبَدَة — ʿabada, worshippers (m. pl., gen. in iḍāfa after حِصَار), plural of عَابِد; 'worshippers (of)'
الصُّلْبَانِ: الـ + صُلْبَان — ṣulbān, crosses (m. pl., gen.), plural of صَلِيب; al-, the; 'the crosses', i.e. 'the cross-worshippers', the Christians (the Calcutta text's phrase)
لَوْقَدَرَ: لَوْ + قَدَرَ — law, if (counterfactual); qadara, to be able to, have power over (verb I, perf. 3ms), here run together in the text and with عَلَى 'over it'; 'if he had been able to'
لَاشْتَرَاهُ: لَـ + اشْتَرَى + هُ — ishtarā, to buy (verb VIII, perf. 3ms, III-weak); la-, the lām answering law ('he would have'); -hu, it (obj.); 'he would have bought it'
الْعِزُّإِلَي: الـ + عِزّ + إِلَى — ʿizz, glory, honour, might (m., nom.); al-, the; run together with إِلَى (ilā, to, towards), scribal spelling with ي for ى; 'glory (has come) to'
قَبِلْنَاهُ: قَبِلْ + نَا + هُ — qabila, to accept (verb I, perf. 1pl); -nā, we; -hu, it (obj.); 'we accepted it'
وَهَبْنَاهُ: و + وَهَبْ + نَا + هُ — wahaba, to give, grant (verb I, perf. 1pl); wa-, and; -nā, we; -hu, it (obj.); 'and we have given it'
وَقَادَ: و + قَادَ — qāda, to lead (verb I, perf. 3ms, hollow); wa-, and; 'and he led', here with لَهُ 'for him', 'had led out'
الْخُيُولَ: الـ + خُيُول — khayl, horses (coll.), pl. khuyūl (acc., object); al-, the; 'the horses'
الدُّورِ: الـ + دُور — dār, house, dwelling (f.), pl. dūr (gen. in iḍāfa after أَكْبَر 'the largest of'); al-, the; 'the dwellings', here apartments
الْعِزُّ: الـ + عِزّ — ʿizz, honour, glory, might (m., nom.); al-, the; 'honour' (cf. الْعِزُّإِلَي)
وَالسُّرُورُ: و + الـ + سُرُور — surūr, gladness, joy (m., nom.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and gladness'
الذُّلُّ: الـ + ذُلّ — dhull, humiliation, abasement (m., nom., subject of زَالَ); al-, the; 'the humiliation'
وَالْهَوَانُ: و + الـ + هَوَان — hawān, contempt, disgrace (m., nom.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the contempt'
بِغَيْبَتِكَ: بِـ + غَيْبَة + ـكَ — ghayba, absence (f., gen.); bi-, because of / on account of (prep. of cause, with شُغْلِي 'my preoccupation'); -ka, your; 'by your absence'
شَغَلَنِي: شَغَلَ + نِي — shaghala, to occupy, preoccupy (verb I, perf. 3ms, with عَنْ 'from' ... 'kept me from'); -nī, me (obj.); 'it occupied me'
لِغَيْبَتِكَ: لِـ + غَيْبَة + ـكَ — ghayba, absence (f., gen.); li-, for / as the cause of (prep.: سَبَبًا لِ 'a cause of'); -ka, your; 'of your absence'
وَفُرْقَتِكَ: و + فُرْقَة + ـكَ — furqa, separation, parting (f., gen., coordinated with li-ghaybatika: li-, of (prep.), 'a cause of your absence and parting'); wa-, and; -ka, your; 'and your separation'
فَشَكَى: فَـ + شَكَى — shakā, to complain (verb I, perf. 3ms, III-weak), here with إِلَى 'to' someone and the object حَالَهُ 'his state'; fa-, then; 'so he complained' Also with li- for the one complained to (Middle Arabic for ilā) and the grievance as direct object: fa-shakā abūhu li-baʿḍi wuzarāʾihi ziyādata ḥubbihi lahu, 'his father complained to one of his viziers of the excess of his love for him'.
وَأَقْبِلِي: و + أَقْبِلِي — aqbala, to turn toward, approach (verb IV, imperative 2fs), with عَلَى 'to'; wa-, and; 'and turn to (her)'
لَعَلَّهَا: لَعَلَّ + هَا — laʿalla, perhaps, may (particle taking the accusative); -hā, she (acc. suffix as its subject); 'perhaps she'
تَجُودُ: تَجُودُ — jāda, to be generous, bestow (verb I, imperf. 3fs, hollow), with عَلَى 'on' and بِـ 'with' (جَادَ عَلَى ... بِـ 'grant to ... a thing'); 'she would grant'
الْحَسْرَةَ: الـ + حَسْرَة — ḥasra, grief, longing, heartache (f., acc., object of تُزِيلُ); al-, the; 'the heartache'
تُذِلُّ: تُذِلُّ — adhalla, to humble, abase (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with feminine plural subject الْمَطَامِع 'greeds'); 'it humbles', i.e. 'bows'
يُفْضِي: يُفْضِي — afḍā, to lead to, end in (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, III-weak), with إِلَى 'to'; 'which leads to'
أَخْبَرَهَا: أَخْبَرَ + هَا — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, perf. 3ms); -hā, her (obj.); 'he told her'
طَرَقَتْ: طَرَقَتْ — ṭaraqa, to come by night, visit stealthily, knock (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she stole into'
بِلَادَهُمْ: بِلَاد + هُمْ — bilād, lands, country (f. pl./coll., acc., object of طَرَقَتْ); -hum, their; 'their country'
وَجَدِّى: و + جَدّ + ي — jadd, grandfather (m., gen., coordinated with عَمِّي); wa-, and; -ī, my (the text writes ى); 'and my grandfather'
الثَّأْرَ: الـ + ثَأْر — thaʾr, revenge, blood-vengeance (m., acc., object of آخُذُ); al-, the; 'the vengeance', in آخُذُ الثَّأْرَ 'I take revenge'
وَأَكْشِفُ: و + أَكْشِفُ — kashafa, to uncover, remove (verb I, imperf. 1s), with عَنْ 'from'; wa-, and; 'and I will remove (from us)'; here: with ʿalā, 'and I uncover (my story) to (you)', I disclose
نَحْسٍ: نَحْس — naḥs, ill-omened, unlucky, wretched (adj./noun, m., gen. in apposition to عَجُوز, tanwīn); 'an ill-omened (woman)'
عَاهِرَةٍ: عَاهِرَة — ʿāhira, adulteress, whore (f., gen., tanwīn, in apposition to عَجُوز, active participle of عَهَرَ); 'a whore'
مَاكِرَةٍ: مَاكِرَة — mākira, cunning, sly (f., gen., tanwīn, active participle of مَكَرَ); 'sly'
مُحْتَالَةٍ: مُحْتَالَة — muḥtāla, tricky, deceitful (f., gen., tanwīn, active participle of iḥtāla, verb VIII); 'full of tricks'
انَةُ: انَة — the second half of the name سَعْدَانَة (Saʿdāna), split off by a stray space after سَعْد in the text: Saʿdāna is a name, that of the old woman; read together 'Saʿdāna' (nom. as predicate of اسْمُهَا 'her name')
يَجِدُهُ: يَجِدُ + هُ — wajada, to find, feel, suffer (verb I, imperf. 3ms, here 'feel (love-pain)'), with مِنْ 'from'; -hu, it (obj.); 'what he feels'
وَسَأَلَهَا: و + سَأَلَ + هَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; -hā, her (obj.); 'and he asked her'
وَتَسْتَعْطِفَهَا: و + تَسْتَعْطِفَ + هَا — istaʿṭafa, to move to compassion, win over (verb X, imperf. 3fs subjunctive, continuing أَنْ; the old woman is subject); wa-, and; -hā, her (obj.); 'and (that she) win her over'
وَاسْتَعْطَفَتْ: و + اسْتَعْطَفَتْ — istaʿṭafat, to soften, win over (verb X, perf. 3fs); wa-, and; 'and she softened/worked on (her heart)'
وَوَعَدْتُهَا: و + وَعَدْتُ + هَا — waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 1s), with the object -hā 'her' and لَكَ 'for you'; wa-, and; 'and I got her promise'
تَأْتِي: تَأْتِي — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indicative); the vocalisation shows the ending -ī (3fs ta-); 'she is coming'
إِنْجَازَ: إِنْجَازَ — injāz, fulfilment, carrying out (verbal noun of IV anjaza; m., acc., object of yantaẓiru, first term of a construct); 'the fulfilment of'
وَعْدِ: وَعْدِ — waʿd, promise (m., gen., second term of a construct after injāz, itself first term before bint); 'of the promise'
بِمُلَاءَةٍ: بِمُلَاءَةٍ — بِـ + مُلَاءَة — bi-, with (prep., governed by atā bi-, 'bring'); mulāʾa, wrap, sheet (f., gen. tanwīn); 'with a wrap' (she brought a wrap) Also after taghaṭṭā bi-, 'to cover oneself with', where bi- marks the covering: 'with a sheet'.
سَوْدَاءَ: سَوْدَاءَ — sawdāʾ, black (f. adj., gen. diptote, here printed with fatḥa -a; agreeing with mulāʾa); 'black'; here: agreeing with jāriyatin, 'a black slave-woman'
وَنَبَّهَتْهُ: وَنَبَّهَتْهُ — و + نَبَّهَتْ + هُ — wa-, and; nabbaha, to rouse, wake (verb II, perf. 3fs); -hu, him (acc.); 'and she woke him'
خَلِيُّ: خَلِيُّ — khaliyy, free, empty, void of (m. adj., nom. predicate, first term of a construct with al-bāl); khaliyyu l-bāl, 'carefree'; 'empty (of mind)'
الْبَالِ: الْبَالِ — الـ + بَال — al-, the; bāl, mind, heed, concern (m., gen., second term of a construct); 'of mind'
خَيَالٍ: خَيَالٍ — khayāl, phantom, image (m., gen. indef., after فِي); 'a phantom'
يَطْرُقُنِي: يَطْرُقُنِي — يَطْرُقُ + نِي — ṭaraqa, to come by night, visit at night (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indicative, relative clause on khayāl); -nī, me (acc., with nūn wiqāya); 'that visits me by night'
عَاتَبَتْهُ: عَاتَبَتْهُ — عَاتَبَتْ + هُ — ʿātaba, to reproach, chide (verb III, perf. 3fs); -hu, him (acc.); 'she reproached him'
الْكَلِمَاتِ: الْكَلِمَاتِ — الـ + كَلِمَات — al-, the; kalimāt, words (f. sound pl. of kalima; gen., second term of a construct after laṭīf); 'of the words'; here: gen. after min, saying what mā is made of: mā yulqīhi mina al-kalimāti, 'the words he was uttering'
تَصْدُقُ: تَصْدُقُ — ṣadaqa, to be truthful, sincere (verb I, imperf. 2ms, indicative; after kunta in the condition with law); 'you were truthful'
جَنَحْتَ: جَنَحْتَ — janaḥa, to incline, lean (toward, ilā) (verb I, perf. 2ms; after mā in the apodosis of law); 'you would have inclined'
الْمَنَام: الْمَنَام — الـ + مَنَام — al-, the; manām, sleep (m.); after ilā, gen., printed without its case vowel (verse-end pausal form); 'sleep'
مُدَّعِي: مُدَّعِي — muddaʿī, claimer, pretender (act. part. of VIII iddaʿā, to claim; m., vocative after yā, annexed, defective -ī); 'O claimer of'
طُرُقِ: طُرُقِ — ṭuruq, ways, roads (pl. of ṭarīq; f./m.; gen., second term of a construct after muddaʿī, first term before al-maḥabba); 'of the ways of'
الْمَوَدَّةِ: الْمَوَدَّةِ — الـ + مَوَدَّة — al-, the; mawadda, affection (f., gen., after فِي); 'in affection'
وَالْغَرَام: وَالْغَرَام — و + الـ + غَرَام — wa-, and; al-, the; gharām, passion, ardent love (m.); gen. by coordination with al-mawadda, printed without its case vowel (verse-end); 'and passion'
الْعَمّ: الْعَمّ — الـ + عَمّ — al-, the; ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen. in the construct ibn al-ʿamm, 'cousin', printed without its case vowel); 'the uncle'
عُيُونُ: عُيُونُ — ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn, f.; nom., subject of raqadat, first term of a construct); 'the eyes of'
الْمُسْتَهَام: الْمُسْتَهَام — الـ + مُسْتَهَام — al-, the; mustahām, love-crazed, distraught (pass. part. of X istahāma; m., gen., second term of a construct, printed without its case vowel); 'the love-crazed'
وَاعْتَذَرَ: وَاعْتَذَرَ — و + اِعْتَذَرَ — wa-, and; iʿtadhara, to excuse oneself, apologise (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and he excused himself'
وَتَشَاكَيَا: وَتَشَاكَيَا — و + تَشَاكَيَا — wa-, and; tashākā, to complain to one another (verb VI of shakā, perf. 3 dual m.; -ā, the two); 'and the two complained to each other'
وَانْتَشَرَ: وَانْتَشَرَ — و + اِنْتَشَرَ — wa-, and; intashara, to spread out (verb VIII of nashara, perf. 3ms; subject al-fajr); 'and it spread'
فَعَزَمَتْ: فَعَزَمَتْ — فَـ + عَزَمَتْ — fa-, and so; ʿazamat, to resolve (verb I, perf. 3fs; ʿazama ʿalā, to resolve upon); 'and so she resolved'
زَائِرِي: زَائِرِي — زَائِر + ي — zāʾir, visitor (act. part. of I zāra; m., vocative after yā, annexed); -ī, my; 'my visitor'
صُدُودِهِ: صُدُودِهِ — صُدُود + هِ — ṣudūd, turning away, aloofness (verbal noun of ṣadda; m., gen., second term of a construct after farṭ); -hi, his; 'his turning away'
الدُّرُّ: الدُّرُّ — الـ + دُرّ — al-, the; durr, pearls (collective, m., nom., subject of a nominal clause with fī l-thaghr as predicate); 'the pearls'; also subject of inʿaqada: wa-inʿaqada al-durru, 'and the pearls are strung'
نَظْمِ: نَظْمِ — naẓm, stringing, arranging in order (verbal noun of naẓama; m., gen. after fī, first term of a construct); 'the stringing of'
عِقْدِهِ: عِقْدِهِ — عِقْد + هِ — ʿiqd, necklace (m., gen., second term of a construct); -hi, his; 'his necklace'
فَقَبَّلْتُهُ: فَقَبَّلْتُهُ — فَـ + قَبَّلْتُ + هُ — fa-, and so; qabbaltu, to kiss (verb II, perf. 1cs); -hu, him; 'and so I kissed him'
اَلْفًا: اَلْفًا — alf, a thousand (m., acc. indef., adverbial of number, 'a thousand times'; printed with plain alif for hamza); 'a thousand (times)'
وَعَانَقْتُ: وَعَانَقْتُ — و + عَانَقْتُ — wa-, and; ʿānaqtu, to embrace (verb III, perf. 1cs); 'and I embraced'
وَخَدِّي: وَخَدِّي — و + خَدّ + ي — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'while'); khadd, cheek (m., nom., subject of a circumstantial clause); -ī, my; 'and my cheek'
لَاصِقٌ: لَاصِقٌ — lāṣiq, clinging, adhering (act. part. of laṣiqa; m., nom. indef., predicate of khaddī); 'clinging'
الْمُفَرِّقُ: الْمُفَرِّقُ — الـ + مُفَرِّق — al-, the; mufarriq, separator, one who parts (act. part. of II farraqa; m., nom., in apposition to al-ṣubḥ, with bayna governing bayna-nā); 'the separater'
كَحَدِّ: كَحَدِّ — كَـ + حَدّ — ka-, like (prep., simile); ḥadd, edge, blade (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'like the edge of'
حُسَامٍ: حُسَامٍ — ḥusām, sharp sword (m., gen. indef., second term of a construct); 'of a sword'
وَدَّعَتْهُ: وَدَّعَتْهُ — وَدَّعَتْ + هُ — waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3fs; the initial و is a root letter, not wa-, 'and'); -hu, him (acc.); 'she bade him farewell'
خِدْرِهَا: خِدْرِهَا — خِدْر + هَا — khidr, curtained chamber, women's apartment (m., gen., after ilā); -hā, her; 'her chamber'
فَاطَّلَعَتْ: فَاطَّلَعَتْ — فَـ + اِطَّلَعَتْ — fa-, and so; iṭṭalaʿat, to come upon, learn of (verb VIII of ṭalaʿa, perf. 3fs, agreeing with baʿḍ al-jawārī, f. pl. subject; with ʿalā); 'and so [some] came upon'
سِرِّهَا: سِرِّهَا — سِرّ + هَا — sirr, secret (m., gen., after ʿalā); -hā, her; 'her secret'
فَذَهَبَتْ: فَذَهَبَتْ — فَـ + ذَهَبَتْ — fa-, and so; dhahabat, to go (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject jāriya); 'and so she went'
مِنْهُنَّ: مِنْهُنَّ — مِنْ + هُنَّ — min, of, from among (prep., partitive); -hunna, them (f. pl.); 'of them'
فَأَعْلَمَتِ: فَأَعْلَمَتِ — فَـ + أَعْلَمَتِ — fa-, and so; aʿlamat, to inform (verb IV of ʿalima, perf. 3fs; the kasra is the linking vowel before al-); 'and so she informed'
فَتَوَجَّهَ: فَتَوَجَّهَ — فَـ + تَوَجَّهَ — fa-, and so; tawajjaha, to betake oneself, head toward (verb V, perf. 3ms; with ilā); 'and so he betook himself'
الْحُسَامَ: الْحُسَامَ — الـ + حُسَام — al-, the; ḥusām, sharp sword (m., acc., object of jarrada); 'the sword'
يَقْتُلَهَا: يَقْتُلَهَا — يَقْتُلَ + هَا — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); -hā, her (acc.); 'to kill her'
أُمُّهَا: أُمُّهَا — أُمّ + هَا — umm, mother (f., nom., subject of dakhalat); -hā, her; 'her mother'
ضَرَرًا: ضَرَرًا — ḍarar, harm, injury (m., acc. indef., object of tafʿal); 'harm'
فَإِنَّكَ: فَإِنَّكَ — فَـ + إِنَّ + كَ — fa-, for, so; inna, indeed (particle, takes the acc.); -ka, you (2ms, its noun); 'for indeed you'
يَشِيعُ: يَشِيعُ — shāʿa, to spread (of news) (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms, indicative; main clause of the condition, subject al-khabar); 'it will spread'
مُعَيَّرَةً: مُعَيَّرَةً — muʿayyara, reproached, taunted (pass. part. of II ʿayyara; f., acc. indef., predicate of taqbā); 'reproached'
وَأَنَّهَا: وَأَنَّهَا — و + أَنَّ + هَا — wa-, and; anna, that (conj., after iʿlam); -hā, she (its noun, acc.); 'and that she'
تَرَبَّتْ: تَرَبَّتْ — tarabbat, to be reared, brought up (verb V of rabbā, perf. 3fs); 'she was reared'
وَأَنَّهُ: وَأَنَّهُ — و + أَنَّ + هُ — wa-, and; anna, that (conj.); -hu, he (its noun, acc.); 'and that he'
عِرْضٍ: عِرْضٍ — ʿirḍ, honour, reputation (m., gen. indef., second term of a construct after ṣāḥib); 'of honour'
وَمُرُوَّةٍ: وَمُرُوَّةٍ — و + مُرُوَّة — wa-, and; murūwa, manliness, chivalry (f., gen. indef., coordinated with ʿirḍ); 'and manliness'
يُعَابُ: يُعَابُ — ʿāba, to fault, blame (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms passive, indicative; with ʿalayhi); 'he is faulted' ('would be faulted')
قَادَ: قَادَ — qāda, to lead (verb I, perf. 3ms, subject al-wazīr Dandān; object al-ʿasākir); 'he led'
لِيُمَلِّكُوا: لِيُمَلِّكُوا — لِـ + يُمَلِّكُوا — li-, so that (purpose, with subjunctive); mallaka, to make king, install as ruler (verb II, imperf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive, final -ū with the nūn dropped); 'so that they might make king'
بُدَّأَنْ: بُدَّأَنْ — بُدَّ + أَنْ — budda, escape, alternative (acc., after lā of absolute negation) + an, that (subjunctive particle); the edition prints lā budda an as one word (lā budd + an); 'there is no escape that'
أَرْمِيَهُ: أَرْمِيَهُ — أَرْمِيَ + هُ — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I, imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after an); -hu, him (acc.); 'that I throw him'
بَلِيَّةٍ: بَلِيَّةٍ — baliyya, calamity, affliction (f., gen. indef., after fī); 'a calamity'
تُقِلُّهُ: تُقِلُّهُ — تُقِلُّ + هُ — aqalla, to bear, carry, support (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, indicative, relative/ḥāl clause on arḍ); -hu, him (acc.); 'bears him'
سَمَاءَ: سَمَاءَ — samāʾ, sky (f., acc. without tanwīn after lā of absolute negation; 'no sky'); 'no sky'
تُظِلُّهُ: تُظِلُّهُ — تُظِلُّ + هُ — aẓalla, to shade, overshadow (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, indicative, qualifying samāʾ); -hu, him (acc.); 'shades him'
وَإِنِّي: وَإِنِّي — و + إِنَّ + ـِي — wa-, and; inna, indeed (particle) + -ī, me (1cs, its noun, with the nūn of inna doubled); 'and indeed I'
أَنْعَمْتُ: أَنْعَمْتُ — anʿamtu, to bestow favour, be gracious (verb IV of naʿima, perf. 1cs; with ʿalā); 'I bestowed favour'
وَطَيَّبْتُ: وَطَيَّبْتُ — و + طَيَّبْتُ — wa-, and; ṭayyabtu, to make good, soothe (verb II, perf. 1cs); 'and I soothed'
خَاطِرَهُ: خَاطِرَهُ — خَاطِر + هُ — khāṭir, mind, heart (m., acc., object of ṭayyabtu); -hu, his; 'his mind'
وَدَوْلَتِي: وَدَوْلَتِي — و + دَوْلَة + ي — wa-, and; dawla, state, dynasty, rule (f., gen., coordinated with mamlakatī); -ī, my; 'and my state'
يَمِيلُوا: يَمِيلُوا — māla, to incline, lean (toward, ilā) (verb I hollow, imperf. 3 m. pl., subjunctive after li-allā, nūn dropped); 'they incline'
تَرَيْنَ: تَرَيْنَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 2fs, indicative, the ending -ayna; addressed to the woman); 'you (f.) will see'
يُدَبِّرُ: يُدَبِّرُ — dabbara, to manage, arrange (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indicative, circumstantial ḥāl after kharaja); 'managing'
أُمِّهِ: أُمِّهِ — أُمّ + هِ — umm, mother (f., gen., after ʿalā); -hi, his; 'his mother'
أُمِّي: أُمِّي — أُمّ + ي — umm, mother (f., vocative, annexed with -ī, 'O my mother'); 'my mother'
إِنِّي: إِنِّي — إِنَّ + ـِي — inna, indeed (particle) + -ī, me (1cs, its noun, doubled nūn); 'indeed I'
شَنِّ: شَنِّ — shann, launching, waging, pouring out (verbal noun of shanna; m., gen., second term after ʿalā, first term of a construct with al-ghārāt); 'the launching of'
الْغَارَاتِ: الْغَارَاتِ — الـ + غَارَات — al-, the; ghārāt, raids (f. sound pl. of ghāra, gen., second term of a construct); 'raids'
وَقَطْعِ: وَقَطْعِ — و + قَطْع — wa-, and; qaṭʿ, cutting (verbal noun of qaṭaʿa; m., gen., coordinated with shann, first term of a construct); 'and the cutting of'
الطُّرُقَاتِ: الطُّرُقَاتِ — الـ + طُرُقَات — al-, the; ṭuruqāt, roads, highways (pl. of ṭarīq, gen., second term of a construct); 'the roads'
وَسَوْقِ: وَسَوْقِ — و + سَوْق — wa-, and; sawq, driving off (verbal noun of sāqa, retaining the wāw; m., gen., coordinated with shann); 'and the driving off of'
وَالنَّعَمِ: وَالنَّعَمِ — و + الـ + نَعَم — wa-, and; al-, the; naʿam, livestock, cattle (collective, m., gen., coordinated); 'and the cattle'
وَالْمَمَالِيكِ: وَالْمَمَالِيكِ — و + الـ + مَمَالِيك — wa-, and; al-, the; mamālīk, mamluks (pl. of mamlūk; gen., coordinated, second term in the list after sawq); 'and the mamluks'
كَثُرَ: كَثُرَ — kathura, to become much, abound (verb I, perf. 3ms, in the idhā clause, subject mālī); 'became much'
وَحَسُنَ: وَحَسُنَ — و + حَسُنَ — wa-, and; ḥasuna, to be good, become fair (verb I, perf. 3ms, subject ḥālī); 'and became fair'
خَطَبْتُ: خَطَبْتُ — khaṭabtu, to ask in marriage, woo (verb I, perf. 1cs, apodosis of idhā; object bint ʿammī); 'I asked in marriage'
أَمْوَالَ: أَمْوَالَ — amwāl, wealth, possessions (pl. of māl, m.; acc. after inna, first term of a construct with al-nās); 'the possessions of'; also: acc., object of jalaba: jalaba amwāla sāʾiri al-mulūki, 'he brought in the wealth of all the kings' (Night 179)
سَائِبَةٍ: سَائِبَةٍ — sāʾiba, left loose, ownerless (f. act. part. of sāba; gen. indef., second term after ghayr; f. agreeing with amwāl, taken as fem. sg.); 'left loose'
لِأَنَّ: لِأَنَّ — لِـ + أَنَّ — li-, because (prep. forming li-anna) + anna, that (particle; takes the acc.); 'because'
دُونَهَا: دُونَهَا — دُونَ + هَا — dūna, before, short of, in front of (prep./noun, acc. as ẓarf, predicate fronted) + -hā, them; 'before them'
الصِّفَاحِ: الصِّفَاحِ — الـ + صِفَاح — al-, the; ṣifāḥ, broad swords, blades (pl. of ṣafīḥa; gen., second term of a construct after ḍarb); 'of the broad-blades'
وَطَعْنَ: وَطَعْنَ — و + طَعْن — wa-, and; ṭaʿn, thrusting, stabbing (verbal noun of ṭaʿana; m., acc., coordinated with ḍarb, first term of a construct); 'and the thrusting of'
الرِّمَاحِ: الرِّمَاحِ — الـ + رِمَاح — al-, the; rimāḥ, lances, spears (pl. of rumḥ; gen., second term of a construct); 'of the spears'
وَرِجَالٌ: وَرِجَالٌ — و + رِجَال — wa-, and; rijāl, men (pl. of rajul; nom. indef., coordinated, with a following relative clause); 'and men'
السِّبَاعَ: السِّبَاعَ — الـ + سِبَاع — al-, the; sibāʿ, beasts of prey (pl. of sabuʿ; acc., object of takulu); 'the beasts of prey'
وَتُوحِشُ: وَتُوحِشُ — و + تُوحِشُ — wa-, and; awḥasha, to make desolate (verb IV, imperf. 3fs/pl. of non-human agreement, indicative; subject rijāl); 'and make desolate'
الْبِقَاعَ: الْبِقَاعَ — الـ + بِقَاع — al-, the; biqāʿ, places, tracts of land (pl. of buqʿa; acc., object of tūḥish); 'the places'
وَتَقْتَنِصُ: وَتَقْتَنِصُ — و + تَقْتَنِصُ — wa-, and; iqtanaṣa, to hunt, snare (verb VIII of qanaṣa, imperf. 3 pl.; indicative, same agreement); 'and snare'
الْأُسُودَ: الْأُسُودَ — الـ + أُسُود — al-, the; usūd, lions (pl. of asad; acc., object of taqtaniṣ); 'the lions'
وَتَصِيدُ: وَتَصِيدُ — و + تَصِيدُ — wa-, and; ṣāda, to hunt (verb I hollow, imperf. 3 pl. agreement, indicative); 'and hunt'
الْفُهُودَ: الْفُهُودَ — الـ + فُهُود — al-, the; fuhūd, leopards (pl. of fahd; acc., object of taṣīd); 'the leopards'
عَزِيمَتِي: عَزِيمَتِي — عَزِيمَة + ي — ʿazīma, resolve, determination (f., gen., after ʿan); -ī, my; 'my resolve'
يُعْلِمُهَا: يُعْلِمُهَا — يُعْلِمُ + هَا — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, indicative, ḥāl after arsala); -hā, her (acc.); 'informing her'
يَتَسَبَّبُ: يَتَسَبَّبُ — tasabbaba, to seek the means, procure (verb V, imperf. 3ms, indicative; ḥāl, with li-hā 'for her'); 'seeking the means'
تَسْأَلَهَا: تَسْأَلَهَا — تَسْأَلَ + هَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an); -hā, her (acc.); 'that you ask her'
بِجَوَابٍ: بِجَوَابٍ — بِـ + جَوَاب — bi-, with (governed by atā bi-, 'bring'); jawāb, answer (m., gen. tanwīn); 'with an answer'
دَاخِلَةٌ: دَاخِلَةٌ — dākhila, entering (f. act. part. of dakhala; nom. indef., predicate in the clause after illā wa-hiya; 'coming in'); 'entering'
السَّهَرِ: السَّهَرِ — الـ + سَهَر — al-, the; sahar, wakefulness, sleeplessness (m., gen., after min); 'the wakefulness'
الْأَسْوَاءِ: الْأَسْوَاءِ — الـ + أَسْوَاء — al-, the; aswāʾ, evils, ills (pl. of sūʾ; gen., after min jamīʿ); 'the evils'
الْعَمِّ: الْعَمِّ — الـ + عَمّ — al-, the; ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen., second term of a construct, bint al-ʿamm, 'cousin'); 'the uncle'
يَمُنَّ: يَمُنَّ — manna, to be gracious, bestow a favour (ʿalā) (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an; doubled nūn); 'that He be gracious'
بِالتَّلَاقِي: بِالتَّلَاقِي — بِـ + الـ + تَلَاقِي — bi-, with (the means of the favour; manna ʿalā bi-, 'favour with'); al-, the; talāqī, meeting again (verbal noun of VI talāqā; m., gen., defective); 'with the meeting again'
وَالْوِفَاقِ: وَالْوِفَاقِ — و + الـ + وِفَاق — wa-, and; al-, the; wifāq, concord, agreement (m., gen., coordinated with al-talāqī); 'and the concord'
عَوَّلَ: عَوَّلَ — ʿawwala, to resolve, rely (ʿalā) (verb II, perf. 3ms, subject Kān Mā Kān); 'he set his mind'
السَّفَرِ: السَّفَرِ — الـ + سَفَر — al-, the; safar, journey, travel (m., gen., after ʿalā); 'the journey'
وَوَدَّعَهَا: وَوَدَّعَهَا — و + وَدَّعَ + هَا — wa-, and; waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3ms; the second و is the root letter); -hā, her (acc.); 'and he bade her farewell'
وَتَقَلَّدَ: وَتَقَلَّدَ — و + تَقَلَّدَ — wa-, and; taqallada, to gird oneself (verb V, perf. 3ms; with bi-sayfihi); 'and he girded himself'
وَتَعَمَّمَ: وَتَعَمَّمَ — و + تَعَمَّمَ — wa-, and; taʿammama, to wind on a turban (verb V of ʿamma, perf. 3ms; root ʿ-m-m); 'and he put on a turban'
وَتَلَثَّمَ: وَتَلَثَّمَ — و + تَلَثَّمَ — wa-, and; talaththama, to veil the lower face (verb V, perf. 3ms; root l-th-m); 'and he veiled his face'
الْقَاتُولَ: الْقَاتُولَ — الـ + قَاتُول — al-, the; al-Qātūl, the name of Kān Mā Kān's horse (acc., apposition to jawādahu); 'al-Qātūl'
وَشَقَّ: وَشَقَّ — و + شَقَّ — wa-, and; shaqqa, to cleave, pass through (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he cleft'
بِرَفِيقِهِ: بِرَفِيقِهِ — بِـ + رَفِيق + هِ — bi-, only marks what appears after wa-idhā ('and behold,'); rafīq, companion (m., gen. after bi-); -hi, his; 'and behold his companion'
صَبَّاحِ: صَبَّاحِ — Ṣabbāḥ the Bedouin, personal name (gen., in apposition to rafīq, before ibn, 'son of'); 'Ṣabbāḥ'
رَمَّاحٍ: رَمَّاحٍ — Rammāḥ, personal name (gen., after ibn, 'son of'); 'Rammāḥ'
رَأَٰهُ: رَأَٰهُ — رَأَى + هُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (acc.); printed without its long alif and pointed with a dagger alif for رَآهُ; 'he saw him'
فَرَدَّ: فَرَدَّ — فَـ + رَدَّ — fa-, and so; radda, to return (a greeting) (verb I, perf. 3ms; radda ʿalayhi l-salām); 'and so he returned'
السَّلَامَ: السَّلَامَ — الـ + سَلَام — al-, the; salām, greeting of peace (m., acc., object of radda); 'the greeting'
صَبَّاحٌ: صَبَّاحٌ — Ṣabbāḥ the Bedouin, personal name (nom., subject of qāla); 'Ṣabbāḥ'
وَالثِّيَابُ: وَالثِّيَابُ — و + الـ + ثِيَاب — wa-, and; al-, the; thiyāb, garments, clothes (pl. of thawb; nom., coordinated with al-jawād, subject of ṣāra); 'and the clothes'
وَتُرْسِي: وَتُرْسِي — و + تُرْس + ي — wa-, and; turs, shield (m., gen., coordinated with sayfī after ghayr); -ī, my; 'and my shield'
الصَّيَّادُ: الصَّيَّادُ — الـ + صَيَّاد — al-, the; ṣayyād, hunter (intensive noun from ṣāda; m., nom., subject of yarjiʿu); 'the hunter'
بِصَيْدٍ: بِصَيْدٍ — بِـ + صَيْد — bi-, with (rajaʿa bi-, 'return with'); ṣayd, catch, game (m., gen. tanwīn); 'with a catch'
نِيَّتِهِ: نِيَّتِهِ — نِيَّة + هِ — niyya, intention (f., gen., second term of a construct after qadr); -hi, his; 'his intent'
بِسَاعَةٍ: بِسَاعَةٍ — بِـ + سَاعَة — bi-, by, at an interval of (prep. with the time measure, after baʿd fi-rāqika); sāʿa, hour (f., gen. tanwīn); 'by an hour' ('an hour after')
السَّعَادَةُ: السَّعَادَةُ — الـ + سَعَادَة — al-, the; saʿāda, good fortune, happiness (f., nom., subject of ḥaṣalat); 'the good fortune'
وَتُخْلِصَ: وَتُخْلِصَ — و + تُخْلِصَ — wa-, and; akhlaṣa, to make pure, sincere (verb IV, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an); 'and that you make pure'
النِّيَّةَ: النِّيَّةَ — الـ + نِيَّة — al-, the; niyya, intention (f., acc., object of tukhliṣa); 'the intent'
وَتُسَافِرَ: وَتُسَافِرَ — و + تُسَافِرَ — wa-, and; sāfara, to travel (verb III, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an); 'and that you travel'
الْبَرِّيَّةِ: الْبَرِّيَّةِ — الـ + بَرِّيَّة — al-, the; barriyya, wilderness, open country (f., gen., after fī); 'the wilderness'
وَرَبِّ: وَرَبِّ — و + رَبّ — wa-, by (oath particle, governing the gen.); rabb, lord (m., gen., first term of a construct); 'by the Lord of'
الْكَعْبَةِ: الْكَعْبَةِ — الـ + كَعْبَة — al-, the; Kaʿba, the Kaʿba at Mecca (f., gen., second term of a construct); 'the Kaʿba'
وَجِرَابُهُ: وَجِرَابُهُ — و + جِرَاب + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial); jirāb, bag, wallet (m., nom., subject of a nominal clause); -hu, his; 'and his bag'
كَتِفَيْهِ: كَتِفَيْهِ — كَتِف + هِ — katif, shoulder (f., dual gen. -ayhi, after bayna, ‘between’); -hi, his; 'his shoulder-blades'
وَاسْتَغْرَقُوا: وَاسْتَغْرَقُوا — و + اِسْتَغْرَقُوا — wa-, and; istaghraqū, to spend entire, take up (time) (verb X of gharaqa, perf. 3 m. pl.); 'and they spent'
صَيْدِ: صَيْدِ — ṣayd, hunting, game (m., gen., after min, first term of a construct); 'the hunt of'
وَيَشْرَبَانِ: وَيَشْرَبَانِ — و + يَشْرَبَانِ — wa-, and; shariba, to drink (verb I, imperf. 3 dual m., indicative, ḥāl); 'and drinking'
أَشْرَفَا: أَشْرَفَا — ashrafā, to look down from a height, overlook (verb IV, perf. 3 dual m., ʿalā); 'they looked down' Also with ʿalā, 'to be on the verge of': ashrafā ʿalā al-halāki, 'they were on the brink of death'.
تَلٍّ: تَلٍّ — tall, hill, mound (m., gen. indef., after ʿalā); 'a hill'
مَرَابِعُ: مَرَابِعُ — marābiʿ, spring pastures (pl. of marbaʿ; m., nom. indef., subject of a fronted prepositional predicate taḥtahu); 'spring pastures'
وَغَدِيرٌ: وَغَدِيرٌ — و + غَدِير — wa-, and; ghadīr, pool, stream-bed pool (m., nom. indef., coordinated); 'and a pool'
سَيَّاحٌ: سَيَّاحٌ — sayyāḥ, flowing, running (intensive adj. from sāḥa; m., nom. indef., qualifying ghadīr); 'flowing'
إِبِلٌ: إِبِلٌ — ibil, camels (collective, f.; nom. indef., first of the list of livestock); 'camels'
وَبَقَرٌ: وَبَقَرٌ — و + بَقَر — wa-, and; baqar, cattle (collective, m., nom. indef.); 'and cattle'
وَغَنَمٌ: وَغَنَمٌ — و + غَنَم — wa-, and; ghanam, sheep, small stock (collective, m., nom. indef.); 'and sheep'
وَخُيُولٌ: وَخُيُولٌ — و + خُيُول — wa-, and; khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl; nom. indef., followed by the relative clause malaʾat); 'and horses'
مَلَأَتِ: مَلَأَتِ — malaʾat, to fill (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject khuyūl; the kasra before al- is the linking vowel); 'it filled' Also with a woman as subject: malaʾati al-kaʾsa, 'she filled the cup'.
الرَّوَابِيَ: الرَّوَابِيَ — الـ + رَوَابِي — al-, the; rawābī, hillocks (pl. of rābiya; acc., object of malaʾat; defective pl. with the -ya of the accusative); 'the hillocks'
الْمُرَاحِ: الْمُرَاحِ — الـ + مُرَاح — al-, the; murāḥ, night-fold, place where animals rest at night (m., gen., after ḥawla); 'the night-fold'
الْأَفْرَاحُ: الْأَفْرَاحُ — الـ + أَفْرَاح — al-, the; afrāḥ, joys (pl. of faraḥ; nom., subject of zādat); 'the joys'
وَامْتَلَأَ: وَامْتَلَأَ — و + اِمْتَلَأَ — wa-, and; imtalaʾa, to be filled (verb VIII of malaʾa, perf. 3ms, subject ṣadruhu); 'and it filled'
بِالِانْشِرَاحِ: بِالِانْشِرَاحِ — بِـ + الـ + اِنْشِرَاح — bi-, with (what fills it; imtalaʾa bi-, 'be filled with'); al-, the; inshirāḥ, expansion, gladness (verbal noun of VII insharaḥa; m., gen.); 'with gladness'
وَعَوَّلَ: وَعَوَّلَ — و + عَوَّلَ — wa-, and; ʿawwala, to resolve (ʿalā) (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he resolved'
لِيَأْخُذَ: لِيَأْخُذَ — لِـ + يَأْخُذَ — li-, so that, in order to (purpose, with subjunctive); akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive); 'to take'
النِّيَاقَ: النِّيَاقَ — الـ + نِيَاق — al-, the; niyāq, she-camels (pl. of nāqa; acc., object of yakhudh); 'the she-camels'
لِصَبَّاحٍ: لِصَبَّاحٍ — لِـ + صَبَّاح — li-, to (prep., indirect object of qāla); Ṣabbāḥ the Bedouin, personal name (gen.); 'to Ṣabbāḥ'
وَحِيدٌ: وَحِيدٌ — waḥīd, alone, solitary (m. adj., nom. indef., predicate of al-ladhī, with ʿan ahlihi 'from its people'); 'alone'
وَقَاتِلْ: وَقَاتِلْ — و + قَاتِلْ — wa-, and; qātila, to fight (verb III, imperative 2ms; qātil maʿī); 'and fight!'
الْقَرِيبَ: الْقَرِيبَ — الـ + قَرِيب — al-, the; qarīb, near (adj., m., acc., object of qātil); 'the near'
وَالْبَعِيدَ: وَالْبَعِيدَ — و + الـ + بَعِيد — wa-, and; al-, the; baʿīd, far (adj., m., acc., coordinated); 'and the far'
أَبْطَالٌ: أَبْطَالٌ — abṭāl, heroes, champions (pl. of baṭal; nom. indef., subject of a fronted predicate fīhim); 'heroes'
رَمَيْنَا: رَمَيْنَا — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I, perf. 1cpl, -nā; in the condition after in; object arwāḥanā, 'our souls'); 'we threw'
نَكُونُ: نَكُونُ — kāna, to be (verb I, imperf. 1cpl, indicative, apodosis after fa-innanā; with ʿalā khaṭar); 'we shall be'
هَوْلِهِ: هَوْلِهِ — هَوْل + هِ — hawl, terror, dread (m., gen., after min); -hi, its; 'its terror'
لِأَهْلِهِ: لِـ + أَهْل + هِ — ahl, people, family (m., gen.); li-, to (direction, after rajaʿa; Middle Arabic for ilā); -hi, his; 'to his people'
وَيَنْخَرِمُ: وَ + يَنْخَرِمُ — inkharama, to be cut off, broken (verb VII, imperf. 3ms indic.; takes min of what one is cut off from); wa-, and; 'and he will be cut off'
الرَّابِيَةِ: الـ + رَّابِيَة — rābiya, hillock, rise (f., gen. after min); al-, the; 'the hillock'
شَنِّ: شَنّ — shann, launching, pouring out (verbal noun of shanna I; m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-ghārāt, after ʿalā); 'the launching of'
وَآلِ: وَ + آلِ — āl, house, family (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with Nuʿmān); wa-, and; 'and of the house of'
نُعْمَانَ: نُعْمَان — Nuʿmān, proper name, the eponym of the speaker's house (gen., diptote, second term of an iḍāfa); 'Nuʿmān'
وَالسَّادَةُ: وَ + الـ + سَّادَة — sāda, lords, chiefs (pl. of sayyid, m., nom., predicate); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the lords'
الضَّارِبُوْنَ: الـ + ضَّارِبُونَ — ḍārib, striker (act. part. of ḍaraba I; m. pl., nom., in apposition to al-sāda; printed ـُوْنَ); al-, the; 'the strikers'
الْقِمَمِ: الـ + قِمَم — qimam, crowns of the head, skull-tops (pl. of qimma; gen. after fī); al-, the; 'the skull-tops'
الْهِيَاجُ: الـ + هِيَاج — hiyāj, battle-fury, tumult (m., verbal noun of hāja; nom., subject of qāma); al-, the; 'the battle-fury'
قَامُوْا: قَامُوْا — qāma, to rise, stand up (verb I hollow, perf. 3mpl, printed with sukūn wāw); qāma bi-, stand up to/for; 'they stood up (to)'
باَسْوَاقِهِ: بِـ + أَسْوَاق + هِ — sūq, market (m.; pl. aswāq, gen.; also 'shank, leg'); bi-, to/at (qāma bi-, stand up to); -hi, its (the battle-fury's); 'to its markets'; Middle Arabic bare-alif spelling
الْفَقِيْرِ: الـ + فَقِير — faqīr, poor man (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after ʿayn); al-, the; 'the poor man'
قُبْحَ: قُبْح — qubḥ, ugliness (m., acc., object of yarā; first term of an iḍāfa with ṣūra); 'the ugliness of'
صُوْرَةِ: صُورَة — ṣūra, face, form (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-ʿadam); 'the face of'
اَرْتَجِيْ: اَرْتَجِي — artajī, to hope for (verb VIII, imperf. 1s indic., defective, printed ـِيْ); 'I hope'
مُعَاوَنَةً: مُعَاوَنَة — muʿāwana, aid, help (verbal noun of III ʿāwana; f., acc. indef., object of artajī); 'aid'
بَارِئِ: بَارِئ — bāriʾ, creator (act. part. of baraʾa I; m., gen., in apposition to mālik; first term of an iḍāfa with al-nasam); 'Creator of'
النَّسَمِ: الـ + نَّسَم — nasam, living souls, breaths (pl. of nasama; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); al-, the; 'the living souls'
النُّوقِ: الـ + نُّوق — nūq, she-camels (pl. of nāqa, f.; gen. after ʿalā, with tilka); al-, the; 'the she-camels'
الْهَائِجِ: الـ + هَائِج — hāʾij, raging, excited (act. part. of hāja I; m., gen., epithet of al-jamal); al-, the; 'the raging'
الْإِبِلِ: الـ + إِبِل — ibil, camels (coll., f.; gen., second term of an iḍāfa after jamīʿ); al-, the; 'the camels'
وَالْبَقَرِ: وَ + الـ + بَقَر — baqar, cattle (coll., m., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the cattle'
وَالْخَيْلِ: وَ + الـ + خَيْل — khayl, horses (coll. f., gen., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the horses'
فَبَادَرَتْ: فَـ + بَادَرَتْ — bādara, to hasten (verb III, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural al-ʿabīd); fa-, and so; 'and (they) hastened'
الصِّقَالِ: الـ + صِّقَال — ṣiqāl, polished, burnished (pl. of ṣaqīl; m., gen., epithet of al-suyūf); al-, the; 'the polished'
الطِّوَالِ: الـ + طِّوَال — ṭiwāl, long (pl. of ṭawīl; m., gen., epithet of al-rimāḥ); al-, the; 'the long'
تُرْكِيٌّ: تُرْكِيّ — turkī, Turkish, a Turk (nisba adj., m., nom. indef., epithet of fāris); 'Turkish'
شَدِيدُ: شَدِيد — shadīd, strong, fierce (adj., m., nom., predicate of anna-hu; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ḥarb); 'strong of'
عَارِفٌ: عَارِف — ʿārif, knowing, skilled (act. part. of ʿarafa I, m., nom. indef.; governs bi- for what is known); 'knowing in'
سُمْرِ: سُمْر — sumr, brown, tawny (pl. of asmar; gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-qanā); 'brown'
لِلْعِصَابَةِ: لِـ + الـ + عِصَابَة — ʿiṣāba, band, gang (f., gen.); li-, belonging to (possession: the goods belong to); al-, the; 'to the band'
وَالْأَبْطَالِ: وَ + الـ + أَبْطَال — baṭal, hero (m.; pl. abṭāl, gen., coordinated after li-); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the heroes'
الْبَحْرِيَّةِ: الـ + بَحْرِيَّة — baḥrī, of the sea, maritime (nisba adj., f. sg., gen., epithet of al-abṭāl); al-, the; 'the sea-'
وَالْفِرْقَةِ: وَ + الـ + فِرْقَة — firqa, troop, company (f., gen., coordinated after li-); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the troop'
الْجَرْكَسِيَّةِ: الـ + جَرْكَسِيَّة — jarkasī, Circassian (nisba adj., f. sg., gen., epithet of al-firqa); al-, the; 'the Circassian'
عَابِسٍ: عَابِس — ʿābis, grim, frowning (act. part. of ʿabasa I; m., gen. indef., epithet of baṭal); 'grim'
يَرْجِعُوا: يَرْجِعُوا — rajaʿa, to return (verb I, imperf. 3mpl subjunctive after an lā, final nūn dropped); 'that they return'
لِئَامُ: لِئَام — liʾām, base, ignoble (pl. of laʾīm; m., nom. as vocative after yā); 'O base ones'
تَعْنُونَ: تَعْنُونَ — ʿanā, to mean, intend (verb I, imperf. 2mpl indic.; relative clause with omitted object); 'you mean'
