طَالِبُونَ: طَالِبُونَ — ṭālib, seeker (act. part. of ṭalaba I; m. pl., nom., predicate of antum); 'seekers'
رَاغِبُونَ: رَاغِبُونَ — rāghib, desirous (act. part. of raghiba I; m. pl., nom., predicate; takes fī); 'desirous'
فَبَارِزُونِي: فَـ + بَارِزُو + نِي — bāraza, to come out to single combat (verb III, imperative 2mpl); fa-, and so; -nī, me; 'so come out to duel me'
أَجْمَعُونَ: أَجْمَعُونَ — ajmaʿ, all (corroborative, m. pl., nom., after kullukum); 'all together'
وَشَأْنَكُمْ: وَ + شَأْن + كُمْ — shaʾn, business, affair (m., acc., in an exhortation, 'look to'); wa-, and; -kum, your (m. pl.); 'and (to) your business'
تُرِيدُونَ: تُرِيدُونَ — arāda, to want (verb IV, imperf. 2mpl indic., after mā); 'you want'
أُذُنَيِ: أُذُن + يِ — udhun, ear (f.; dual gen. -ayi, nūn lost in construct, first term of an iḍāfa with al-Qātūl, after bayna); 'the two ears of'
الْقَاتُولِ: الـ + قَاتُول — al-Qātūl, the horse's name (gen., second term of an iḍāfa); al-, the; 'al-Qātūl'
الْغُولِ: الـ + غُول — ghūl, ghoul, desert demon (m., gen., after mithla); al-, the; 'the ghoul'
عَطَفَ: عَطَفَ — ʿaṭafa, to turn, wheel (verb I, perf. 3ms; after ṣāra, 'went on to'; takes ʿalā); 'he wheeled'
فَطَعَنَهُ: فَـ + طَعَنَ + هُ — ṭaʿana, to thrust, spear (verb I, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; -hu, him; 'and he speared him'
كُلَاهُ: كُلَا + هُ — kulā, kidneys (pl. of kulya, f., acc., object of akhraja); -hu, his; 'his kidneys'
وَمَالَ: وَ + مَالَ — māla, to incline, turn (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; takes ʿalā); wa-, and; 'and he turned'
وَثَالِثٍ: وَ + ثَالِث — thālith, third (ordinal, m., gen. indef., after ʿalā, coordinated with thānin); wa-, and; 'and a third'
وَرَابِعٍ: وَ + رَابِع — rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal, m., gen. indef., after ʿalā, coordinated); wa-, and; 'and a fourth'
أَعْدَمَهُمُ: أَعْدَمَ + هُمُ — aʿdama, to deprive of, make lack (verb IV, perf. 3ms, two objects); -humu, them; 'he made them lack (life)'
هَابَتْهُ: هَابَتْ + هُ — hāba, to fear, stand in awe of (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, agreeing with plural al-ʿabīd); -hu, him; 'feared him'
الزَّوَانِي: الـ + زَّوَانِي — zawānī, adulteresses, whores (pl. of zāniya, f.; gen., second term of an iḍāfa after awlād); al-, the; 'the adulteresses'
سُوقُوا: سُوقُوا — sāqa, to drive (verb I hollow, imperative 2mpl); 'drive!'
وَالْخُيُولَ: وَ + الـ + خُيُول — khuyūl, horses (pl. of khayl; acc., coordinated with al-māl); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the horses'
خَضَبْتُ: خَضَبْتُ — khaḍaba, to dye, stain (verb I, perf. 1s); after illā, 'or else'; 'I have dyed'
دِمَائِكُمْ: دِمَاء + كُمْ — dimāʾ, blood (pl. of dam; gen. after min, partitive); -kum, your (m. pl.); 'your blood'
سِنَانِي: سِنَان + ي — sinān, spearhead (m., acc., object of khaḍabtu); -ī, my; 'my spearhead'
فَسَاقُوا: فَـ + سَاقُوا — sāqa, to drive (verb I hollow, perf. 3mpl); fa-, and so; 'so they drove'
الِانْطِلَاقِ: الـ + انْطِلَاق — inṭilāq, setting off (verbal noun of VII inṭalaqa; m., gen. after fī, in akhadhū fī, 'took to'); al-, the; 'the setting off'
فَانْحَدَرَ: فَـ + انْحَدَرَ — inḥadara, to go down, descend (verb VII, perf. 3ms; takes ilā); fa-, and so; 'and he came down'
بِالصِّيَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + صِّيَاح — ṣiyāḥ, shouting (m., gen.); bi-, with (aʿlana bi-, 'make public with', verb governs the preposition); al-, the; 'the shouting'
اللُّيُوثِ: الـ + لُّيُوث — luyūth, lions (pl. of layth, m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after mithl); al-, the; 'the lions'
فَهَرَبَ: فَـ + هَرَبَ — haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and he fled'
أَعْلَى: أَعْلَى — aʿlā, top, highest part (elative of ʿālin used as a noun; m., gen. after ʿalā, indeclinable, first term of an iḍāfa with al-rābiya); 'the top of'
الْبِطَاحَ: الـ + بِطَاح — biṭāḥ, flatlands, broad valleys (pl. of baṭḥāʾ; acc., object of taraka); al-, the; 'the flatlands'
الْكِفَاحِ: الـ + كِفَاح — kifāḥ, fray, close combat (m. verbal noun, gen. after ʿalā); al-, the; 'the fray'
وَالْمُزَاحِ: وَ + الـ + مُزَاح — muzāḥ, jesting, banter (verbal noun of III māzaḥa; m., gen., coordinated with al-laʿib after fī); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and jest'
وَمَكَانٍ: وَ + مَكَان — makān, place (m., gen. indef., coordinated after kull-i jānib); wa-, and; 'and place'
تَمْضِى: تَمْضِي — maḍā, to go on, go off (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms indic.; final -ī printed ى); 'you go off'
وَأَحْرِمُكَ: وَ + أَحْرِمُ + كَ — ḥarama, to deprive (verb I, imperf. 1s indic.); wa-, and; -ka, you (m., object); 'and I deprive you'
فَدُونَكَ: فَـ + دُونَ + كَ — dūna, 'here you are, take' (prep. used as exhortation, with acc. object al-qitāl); fa-, so; -ka, you (m.); 'so there you are'
دُونِهِ: دُون + هِ — dūn, short of, below (prep., gen. after min); -hi, it; 'short of it'
أَرْوَعُ: أَرْوَع — arwaʿ, awe-inspiring, gallant (adj. of elative shape, m., nom. indef., epithet of asad); 'awe-inspiring'
سَمَيْدَعٌ: سَمَيْدَع — samaydaʿ, lordly, noble, gallant (adj. m., nom. indef., epithet of baṭal); 'lordly'
وَسَيْفٌ: وَ + سَيْف — sayf, sword (m., nom. indef., coordinated); wa-, and; 'and a sword'
الضِّرْغَامِ: الـ + ضِّرْغَام — ḍirghām, fierce lion (m., gen., epithet of al-asad); al-, the; 'the fierce'
وَالشَّجَاعَةُ: وَ + الـ + شَّجَاعَة — shajāʿa, courage (f., nom., subject of a circumstantial clause); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the courage'
الْمُقَدَّمَ: الـ + مُقَدَّم — muqaddam, one set in command (pass. part. of II qaddama; m., printed acc.; Middle Arabic, predicate after huwa); al-, the; 'the one put in command'
فُرُوسِيَّتِهِ: فُرُوسِيَّة + هِ — furūsiyya, horsemanship, knightliness (f., gen., after kamāl); -hi, his; 'his horsemanship'
مَعْشُوقَةٍ: مَعْشُوقَة — maʿshūqa, beloved, sweetheart (pass. part. of ʿashiqa I; f., gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa after ḥusn); 'a beloved'
فَاتِنُ: فَاتِن — Fātin, the warrior-maiden (proper name, printed nom. as the quoted name after yuqāl lahā); 'Fātin'
وَكَرَمِ: وَ + كَرَم — karam, nobility, generosity (m., gen., coordinated after min; first term of an iḍāfa with al-khiṣāl); wa-, and; 'and nobility of'
وَيَشْغَلُ: وَ + يَشْغَلُ — shaghala, to occupy (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.); wa-, and; 'and it occupies'
فُرْسَانُ: فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen (pl. of fāris, m., nom., subject of kānat; first term of an iḍāfa with al-qawm); 'the horsemen of'
تَخْشَي: تَخْشَى — khashiya, to fear (verb I, imperf. 3fs indic.; fem. with a broken plural; final ā printed ي); 'fear(ed)'
سَطْوَتَهَا: سَطْوَة + هَا — saṭwa, assault, violence (f., acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her assault'
وَأَبْطَالُ: وَ + أَبْطَال — baṭal, hero (m.; pl. abṭāl, nom., first term of an iḍāfa with al-quṭr); wa-, and; 'and the heroes of'
الْقُطْرِ: الـ + قُطْر — quṭr, region, tract (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); al-, the; 'the region'
هَيْبَتِهَا: هَيْبَة + هَا — hayba, awe, dread (f., gen. after min, governed by takhāfu); -hā, her; 'her awe'
تُمَلِّكُ: تُمَلِّكُ — mallaka, to make (someone) owner (verb II, imperf. 3fs indic.; object nafsahā, 'give herself in possession'); 'she makes (herself) owner'
يَقْهَرُهَا: يَقْهَرُ + هَا — qahara, to overpower (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic., in a relative clause after man); -hā, her; 'overpowers her'
خُطَّابِهَا: خُطَّاب + هَا — khuṭṭāb, suitors (pl. of khāṭib, m., gen., after jumla); -hā, her; 'her suitors'
يَقْرَبُنِي: يَقْرَبُ + نِي — qaruba, to come near (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.; direct object); -nī, me; 'comes near me'
يَقْهَرُنِي: يَقْهَرُ + نِي — qahara, to overpower (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic., after man); -nī, me; 'overpowers me'
وَمَوْقِفِ: وَ + مَوْقِف — mawqif, standing-place (m., gen., coordinated with al-maydān; first term of an iḍāfa with al-ḥarb); wa-, and; 'and the standing-place of'
اخْتَشَى: اخْتَشَى — ikhtashā, to be ashamed, fear (verb VIII of khashiya, perf. 3ms; Middle Arabic sense 'be ashamed'); 'he was ashamed'
يُقَاتِلَ: يُقَاتِلَ — qātala, to fight (verb III, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an); 'that he fight'
قَاتَلْتَهَا: قَاتَلْتَ + هَا — qātala, to fight (verb III, perf. 2ms, after law); -hā, her; 'you fought her'
تَغْلِبُهَا: تَغْلِبُ + هَا — ghalaba, to overcome (verb I, imperf. 2ms indic.); -hā, her; 'you overcome her'
تَنْهَزِمُ: تَنْهَزِمُ — inhazama, to be routed, flee (verb VII, imperf. 3fs indic.); 'she is routed'
تَمْلِكَهَا: تَمْلِكَ + هَا — malaka, to possess (verb I, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after ḥattā); -hā, her; 'you possess her'
قِتَالِهَا: قِتَال + هَا — qitāl, fighting (verbal noun of III qātala; m., gen. after min, governed by imtanaʿa); -hā, her; 'fighting her'
امْتِنَاعِهِ: امْتِنَاع + هِ — imtināʿ, holding back, refusal (verbal noun of VIII imtanaʿa; m., gen. after ʿalā, in istamarra ʿalā); -hi, his; 'his holding back'
الْأَفْعَالُ: الـ + أَفْعَال — afʿāl, deeds (pl. of fiʿl; m., nom., subject of jarat); al-, the; 'these doings'
مَحْبُوبَتُهُ: مَحْبُوبَة + هُ — maḥbūba, beloved (f., nom., predicate of anna-hu); -hu, his; 'his beloved'
فَهَابَ: فَـ + هَابَ — hāba, to fear, be awed (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and he was awed'
عَشِقَتْهُ: عَشِقَتْ + هُ — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (verb I, perf. 3fs); -hu, him; 'she had fallen in love with him'
وَشَجَاعَتِهِ: وَ + شَجَاعَة + هِ — shajāʿa, courage (f., gen., coordinated with ḥusn after bi-); wa-, and; -hi, his; 'and his courage'
أَتَيْتِنِي: أَتَيْتِ + نِي — atā, to come (verb I, perf. 2fs; takes a direct object, not bi-); -nī, me; 'you have come to me'
لِتُرِينِي: لِـ + تُرِي + نِي — arā, to show (verb IV, imperf. 2fs subjunctive, nūn dropped); li-, in order to (purpose); -nī, me; 'so that you show me'
شَجَاعَتَكِ: شَجَاعَة + كِ — shajāʿa, courage (f., acc., second object of turī); -ki, your (f.); 'your courage'
فَانْزِلِي: فَـ + انْزِلِي — nazala, to get down (verb I, imperative 2fs); fa-, so; 'so get down'
جَوَادِكِ: جَوَاد + كِ — jawād, steed (m., gen. after ʿan); -ki, your (f.); 'your steed'
أَتَحَدَّثَ: أَتَحَدَّثَ — taḥaddatha, to converse (verb V, imperf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā); 'that I may talk'
سُقْتُ: سُقْتُ — sāqa, to drive off (verb I hollow, perf. 1s); 'I drove'
وَخُنْتُ: وَ + خُنْتُ — khāna, to betray (verb I hollow, perf. 1s); wa-, and; 'and I betrayed'
الرَّفِيقَ: الـ + رَّفِيق — rafīq, companion (m., acc., object of khuntu); al-, the; 'the companion'
الطَّرِيقَ: الـ + طَّرِيق — ṭarīq, road (m./f., acc., object of qaṭaʿtu, 'cut the road'); al-, the; 'the road'
كُلُّ: كُلّ — kull, all (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with hādhā); 'all of'
لِحُسْنِكِ: لِـ + حُسْن + كِ — ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.); li-, for the sake of (cause); -ki, your (f.); 'for your beauty'
وَجَمَالِكِ: وَ + جَمَال + كِ — jamāl, loveliness, grace (m., gen., coordinated after li-); wa-, and; -ki, your (f.); 'and your loveliness'
وَتَزَوَّجِينِي: وَ + تَزَوَّجِي + نِي — tazawwaja, to marry (verb V, imperative 2fs; direct object of the bride/groom); wa-, and; -nī, me; 'and marry me'
تَخْدُمَكِ: تَخْدُمَ + كِ — khadama, to serve (verb I, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā, with banāt); -ki, you (f.); 'may serve you'
وَتَصِيرِى: وَ + تَصِيرِي — ṣāra, to become (verb I hollow, imperf. 2fs subjunctive, nūn dropped; final ī printed ى); wa-, and; 'and you become'
نِيرَانُ: نِيرَان — nīrān, fires (pl. of nār, f.; nom., subject of ṣārat; first term of an iḍāfa with ghayẓ); 'the fires of'
اضْطِرَامٍ: اضْطِرَام — iḍṭirām, blaze, flaming (verbal noun of VIII iḍṭarama; m., gen. indef. after fī); 'a blaze'
الْأَعْجَامِ: الـ + أَعْجَام — aʿjām, non-Arabs, barbarians (pl. of aʿjam; gen., second term of an iḍāfa after kalb); al-, the; 'the barbarians'
فَاتِناً: فَاتِناً — Fātin, the warrior-maiden (proper name, acc., object of daʿ; printed with tanwīn); 'Fātin'
تَرْتَابُ: تَرْتَابُ — irtāba, to be uneasy, in doubt (verb VIII, imperf. 2ms indic.; governs bi-); 'you are uneasy'
وَتَقَدَّمْ: وَ + تَقَدَّمْ — taqaddama, to advance (verb V, imperative 2ms, sukūn); wa-, and; 'and come forward'
الطَّعْنِ: الـ + طَّعْن — ṭaʿn, thrusting (verbal noun of ṭaʿana I; m., gen. after ilā); al-, the; 'the thrusting'
وَالضِّرَابِ: وَ + الـ + ضِّرَاب — ḍirāb, striking (verbal noun of ḍaraba / III ḍāraba; m., gen., coordinated after ilā); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the striking'
فَعَنْ: فَـ + عَنْ — ʿan, from, after (prep.); fa-, for (explanatory); ʿan qarībin, 'in a short while'; 'for in a short while'; also: fa-, for + ʿan, from, marking what the eyes are turned back from: fa-ʿan ḥusni hādhā al-ẓabyi tuthnā al-nawāẓiru, 'for from this gazelle's beauty the eyes are turned back' (Night 192)
التُّرَابِ: الـ + تُّرَاب — turāb, dust, earth (m., gen. after ʿalā); al-, the; 'the dust'
وَصَالَ: وَ + صَالَ — ṣāla, to charge, assault (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he charged'
وَمَدَّ: وَ + مَدَّ — madda, to stretch out (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he stretched out'
وَاسْتَطَالَ: وَ + اسْتَطَالَ — istaṭāla, to reach far, make oneself long (verb X, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he reached far'
كَهْرَدَاشُ: كَهْرَدَاش — Kahrdāsh, robber chief (proper name, nom., subject of ʿalima; variant spelling without sukūn); 'Kahrdāsh'
ضِرْغَامٌ: ضِرْغَام — ḍirghām, lion, lion-like (m., nom. indef., epithet of baṭal); 'lion-like'
وَتَبَيَّنَ: وَ + تَبَيَّنَ — tabayyana, to become clear (verb V, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and it became clear'
ظَنِّهِ: ظَنّ + هِ — ẓann, supposition (verbal noun of ẓanna I; m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after khaṭaʾ); -hi, his; 'his supposition'
أَخْضَرُ: أَخْضَر — akhḍar, green (adj. m., nom. indef., epithet of ʿidhār, 'cheek-down'); 'green'
خَدِّهِ: خَدّ + هِ — khadd, cheek (m., gen. after fawqa); -hi, his; 'his cheek'
كَآسِ: كَـ + آس — ās, myrtle (m., gen. indef.); ka-, like (comparison); 'like myrtle'
نَبَتَ: نَبَتَ — nabata, to sprout, grow (verb I, perf. 3ms; descriptive clause of ās); 'it sprouted'
خِلَالَ: خِلَالَ — khilāla, amid, among (prep./adv. noun, acc., first term of an iḍāfa with wardin); 'amid'
كَرَّتِهِ: كَرَّة + هِ — karra, onset, charge (f., gen. after min, governed by hāba); -hi, his; 'his onset'
لِلَّذِينَ: لِـ + الَّذِينَ — alladhīna, those who (rel. pron., m. pl., gen.); li-, to (indirect object of qāla); 'to those who'
لِيَحْمِلْ: لِـ + يَحْمِلْ — ḥamala, to charge (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive; takes ʿalā); li-, let (lām of command); 'let him charge'
وَيُظْهِرْ: وَ + يُظْهِرْ — aẓhara, to show (verb IV, imperf. 3ms jussive, coordinated with li-yaḥmil); wa-, and; 'and let him show'
الْبَتَّارَ: الـ + بَتَّار — battār, cutting (intensive adj. from batara, m., acc., epithet of al-sayf); al-, the; 'the cutting'
وَالرُّمْحَ: وَ + الـ + رُّمْح — rumḥ, lance (m., acc., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the lance'
الْخَطَّارَ: الـ + خَطَّار — khaṭṭār, quivering, brandished (intensive adj., cf. khaṭara bi-rumḥihi 'to brandish'; m., acc., epithet of al-rumḥ); al-, the; 'the quivering'
لِلْوَاحِدِ: لِـ + الـ + وَاحِد — wāḥid, one (m., gen.); li-, against (with qitāl, 'fighting against'); al-, the; 'against the one'
فَارِساً: فَارِساً — fāris, horseman (m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna after law); 'a horseman'
شُجَاعاً: شُجَاعاً — shujāʿ, brave (adj. m., acc. indef., epithet of fāris); 'brave'
وَقَرْماً: وَ + قَرْماً — qarm, chieftain, noble (m., acc. indef., coordinated predicate); wa-, and; 'and a chieftain'
مَنَّاعاً: مَنَّاعاً — mannāʿ, protective, warding off (intensive adj. of māniʿ; m., acc. indef., epithet of qarm); 'protective'
بِتَحْجِيلٍ: بِـ + تَحْجِيل — taḥjīl, white leg-marks (verbal noun of II ḥajjala; m., gen. indef.); bi-, with (of accompaniment, 'with white feet'); 'with white feet'
وَغُرَّةٍ: وَ + غُرَّة — ghurra, blaze, white forehead mark (f., gen. indef., coordinated after bi-); wa-, and; 'and a blaze'
كَالدِّرْهَمِ: كَـ + الـ + دِّرْهَم — dirham, silver coin (m., gen.); ka-, like (comparison, blaze to a dirham); al-, the; 'like the dirham'
يُحَيِّرُ: يُحَيِّرُ — ḥayyara, to bewilder (verb II, imperf. 3ms indic.; circumstantial clause of the steed); 'bewildering'
وَالنَّاظِرَ: وَ + الـ + نَّاظِر — nāẓir, beholder (act. part. of naẓara I; m., acc., object, coordinated with al-ʿaql); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the beholder'
لِعَنْتَرَ: لِـ + عَنْتَر — ʿAntar, the hero ʿAntar (proper name, gen., diptote); li-, belonging to (possession, after kāna); 'to ʿAntar'
الْمُهْرُ: الـ + مُهْر — muhr, colt (m., nom., subject of jāʾa-ka); al-, the; 'the colt'
جَزْلَانَ: جَزْلَان — jazlān, glad, exulting (adj. m., acc., diptote, ḥāl); 'exulting'
يَخْلِطُ: يَخْلِطُ — khalaṭa, to mix (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic., circumstantial); 'mixing'
اَرْضَهُ: أَرْض + هُ — arḍ, earth, ground (f., acc., object of yakhliṭu); -hu, its (the colt's); 'its earth'
بِسَمَائِهِ: بِـ + سَمَاء + هِ — samāʾ, sky (f., gen.); bi-, with (khalaṭa bi-, 'mix with'); -hi, its; 'with its sky'
وَاقْتَصَّ: وَ + اقْتَصَّ — iqtaṣṣa, to take retaliation (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and it took retaliation'
فَخَاضَ: فَـ + خَاضَ — khāḍa, to wade, plunge into (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and (it) waded'
اَحْشَائِهِ: أَحْشَاء + ـِهِ — ḥashā, entrails, bowels (m., pl. aḥshāʾ; gen. after fī; edition prints without hamza seat) + -hi, his/its; 'its entrails'
وَابْتَدَرَ: و + ابْتَدَرَ — ibtadara, to rush forward, hasten (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he rushed forward'
وَتَجَاوَلَا: و + تَجَاوَلَا — tajāwala, to wheel about each other, skirmish (verb VI, perf. 3 dual m.); wa-, and; 'and the two wheeled about each other'
وَتَضَارَبَا: و + تَضَارَبَا — taḍāraba, to exchange blows, fight (verb VI, perf. 3 dual m.); wa-, and; 'and the two exchanged blows'
ضَرْباً: ضَرْب — ḍarb, striking, beating (verbal noun of ḍaraba, m., acc. indef.; cognate accusative of taḍārabā); 'a striking'
الْأَفْكَارَ: الـ + أَفْكَار — fikr, thought (m.), pl. afkār (acc. indef.-sense object of yuḥayyiru); al-, the; 'the thoughts'
وَيُعْشِى: و + يُعْشِي — ʿashiya/aʿshā, to dim, blind (verb IV, impf. 3ms, defective, indic.); wa-, and; 'and (it) dims'
فَسَبَقَهُ: فَـ + سَبَقَ + هُ — sabaqa, to get ahead of, outstrip (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (obj.); fa-, and so; 'and he got ahead of him'
بِضَرْبَةِ: بِـ + ضَرْبَة — ḍarba, a stroke, blow (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa before baṭal); bi-, with (instrument); 'with the stroke of'
فَقَطَعَتْ: فَـ + قَطَعَتْ — qaṭaʿa, to cut, cut off (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject the stroke); fa-, and so; 'and it cut'
الْعِمَامَةَ: الـ + عِمَامَة — ʿimāma, turban (f., acc., object of qaṭaʿat); al-, the; 'the turban'
وَالْمِغْفَرَ: و + الـ + مِغْفَر — mighfar, helmet, mail-coif (m., acc.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the helmet'
الْبَعِيرُ: الـ + بَعِير — baʿīr, camel (m., nom., predicate/subject of ka-annahu); al-, the; 'the camel'
تَقَدَّمَ: تَقَدَّمَ — taqaddama, to advance, step forward (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'advanced'
الثَّانِي: الـ + ثَانِي — thānī, second (ordinal adj., m., nom., subject of taqaddama); al-, the; 'the second'
الثَّالِثُ: الـ + ثَالِث — thālith, third (ordinal adj., m., nom.); al-, the; 'the third'
وَالرَّابِعُ: و + الـ + رَابِع — rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal adj., m., nom.); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the fourth'
كَالْأَوَّلِ: كَـ + الـ + أَوَّل — awwal, first (m., gen.); ka-, like, as (prep.); al-, the; 'as with the first'
اشْتَدَّ: اشْتَدَّ — ishtadda, to grow severe, intense (verb VIII, doubled root sh-d-d, perf. 3ms); 'grew severe'
الْحُرَقُ: الـ + حُرَق — ḥuraq, burnings, flames of passion (pl. of ḥurqa, f.; nom., subject of zādat); al-, the; 'the burnings'
الْتَقَطَهُمْ: الْتَقَطَ + هُمْ — iltaqaṭa, to pick off, pick up (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + -hum, them (obj.); 'picked them off'
بِسِنَانِ: بِـ + سِنَان — sinān, spearhead, point (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa before rumḥ); bi-, with (instrument); 'with the point of'
رُمْحِهِ: رُمْح + هِ — rumḥ, lance, spear (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa) + -hi, his; 'his lance'
الِارْتِحَالِ: الـ + ارْتِحَال — irtiḥāl, departure, breaking camp (verbal noun VIII of r-ḥ-l, m., gen. after min, which governs khāfa min, 'fear'); al-, the; 'the departing'
ثَبَاتَ: ثَبَات — thabāt, firmness, steadfastness (verbal noun of thabata, m., acc., object of ʿarafa, first term of iḍāfa before al-janān); 'the firmness of'
أَوْحَدُ: أَوْحَد — awḥad, unique, peerless, sole (elative of wāḥid, m., nom. diptote, predicate of anna; first term of iḍāfa); 'the unique one of'
دَمَكَ: دَم + كَ — dam, blood (m., acc., object of wahabtu; dam is a defective noun) + -ka, your; 'your blood'
وَدَمَ: و + دَم — wa-, and; dam, blood (m., acc., first term of iḍāfa before aṣḥābī, coordinated with damaka); 'and the blood of'
رَحِمْتُكَ: رَحِمَ + تُ + كَ — raḥima, to pity, show mercy to (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -tu, I (subject) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I have pitied you'
لِحُسْنِ: لِـ + حُسْن — ḥusn, goodness, beauty (m., verbal noun of ḥasuna, gen., first term of iḍāfa before thabātika); li-, for, on account of (cause); 'for the goodness of'
ثَبَاتِكَ: ثَبَات + كَ — thabāt, steadfastness (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after ḥusn) + -ka, your; 'your steadfastness'
وَالْحَيَوٰةُ: و + الـ + حَيَوٰة — ḥayāh (written ḥayawāt, with dagger alif), life (f., nom., subject); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and life'
مُرُوَّةَ: مُرُوَّة — muruwwa, manliness, chivalry (f., acc., object of ʿadimta, first term of iḍāfa before al-kirām; printed without the hamza of classical muruʾa); 'the manliness of'
تُطْمِعْ: تُطْمِعْ — aṭmaʿa, to make covet, make hopeful (verb IV, impf. 2ms jussive after lā tuṭmiʿ, prohibition); 'do not make covet'
رَدِّ: رَدّ — radd, a giving back, returning (verbal noun of radda, m., gen. after fī, first term of iḍāfa before al-ghanīma); 'the returning of'
الْغَنِيمَةِ: الـ + غَنِيمَة — ghanīma, booty (f., gen., second term of iḍāfa after radd); al-, the; 'the booty'
وَاسْلُكْ: و + اسْلُكْ — salaka, to take (a road), travel (verb I, imperative 2ms); wa-, and; 'and take'
لِنَجَاةِ: لِـ + نَجَاة — najāt, salvation, escape (f., verbal noun of najā, gen., first term of iḍāfa before anfusinā); li-, for, for the sake of (purpose); 'for the saving of'
طَرِيقَةً: طَرِيقَة — ṭarīqa, way, path (f., acc. indef., object of uslūk); 'a path'
مُسْتَقِيمَةً: مُسْتَقِيمَة — mustaqīm, straight, right (active part. verb X of qāma, f., acc. indef., adj. of ṭarīqa); 'straight'
بِكَهْرَدَاشَ: بِـ + كَهْرَدَاش — Kahrdāsh, robber chief (proper name, diptote, gen.); bi-, in, upon (prep.; ishtadda bi-, 'grow severe in/upon someone'); 'in Kahrdāsh'
الْعَطَبَ: الـ + عَطَب — ʿaṭab, ruin, destruction (m., acc., object of yūjibu); al-, the; 'the ruin'
الزِّحَامِ: الـ + زِّحَام — zihām/zaḥām, crush, press (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after ḥawma); al-, the; 'of the press'
فَاسْأَلْ: فَـ + اسْأَلْ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperative 2ms; edition prints hamza on alif seat); fa-, so (introducing a command); 'so ask'
الْبَطَّاشُ: الـ + بَطَّاش — baṭṭāsh, violent striker, assailant (intensive form, m., nom., adj./apposition of al-asad); al-, the; 'the violent striker'
بِكَهْرَ: بِـ + كَهْر — first part of Kahrdāsh, robber chief, printed split by a stray space (kahr + dāsh); bi-, with (passive part. al-maʿrūf bi-, 'known as'); 'known as Kahr-'
دَاشَ: دَاش — second part of Kahrdāsh, robber chief (proper name, gen. diptote), printed split by a stray space (kahr + dāsh); 'Kahr-dāsh'
نَهَبَ: نَهَبَ — nahaba, to plunder, pillage (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'plundered'
السُّفَّارِ: الـ + سُّفَّار — sāfir, traveller (m.), pl. suffār (gen., second term of iḍāfa after jamīʿ); al-, the; 'the travellers'
تَحْتَكَ: تَحْت + كَ — taḥta, under, beneath (prep./adv., acc.) + -ka, you; 'under you'
طَلِبَتِي: طَلِبَة + ـِي — ṭaliba, thing sought, quest, desire (f., nom., predicate; cf. classical ṭilba/maṭlab) + -ī, my; 'my quest'
تُعَرِّفَنِي: تُعَرِّفَ + نِي — ʿarrafa, to inform, let know (verb II, impf. 2ms subjunctive after an) + -nī, me (obj.); 'that you inform me'
اسْتَوْلَيْتَ: اسْتَوْلَيْتَ — istawlā, to gain possession of (verb X, defective, perf. 2ms, -ta; governs ʿalā); 'you got possession'
سَائِراً: سَائِر — sāʾir, going, travelling (act. part. of sāra, m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'going'
سَانَ: سَان — the second piece of the name Sāsān where the print splits it into two words (سا سان or سان سان); read with the piece before it as Sāsān, the king; 'Sāsān'
وَقَائِدَتُهُ: و + قَائِدَة + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial); qāʾida, leader, one who leads (act. part. of qāda, f., nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'and its leader'
يَخْدُمُونَهَا: يَخْدُم + ُونَ + هَا — khadama, to serve (verb I, impf. 3mp, indic.) + -hā, her (obj.); 'serving her'
تَعَدَّيْتَ: تَعَدَّيْتَ — taʿaddā, to transgress, commit aggression (verb V, defective, perf. 2ms, -ta; with ʿalā, 'against'); 'you transgressed'
وَأَخَذْتَهُ: و + أَخَذَ + تَ + هُ — wa-, and; akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -ta, you (subject) + -hu, it (obj.); 'and you took it'
جَدِّي: جَدّ + ـِي — jadd, grandfather (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa after jihat) + -ī, my; 'my grandfather'
النُّعْمَانِ: الـ + نُّعْمَان — al-Nuʿmān, proper name (gen., after ibn, in ʿUmar ibn al-Nuʿmān); al-, the; 'al-Nuʿmān'
وَعَمِّي: و + عَمّ + ـِي — wa-, and; ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen., in iḍāfa after jihat) + -ī, my; 'and my uncle'
شَرَّكَانَ: شَرَّكَان — Sharrkān, proper name, the king (gen.; diptote with fatḥa, as after ʿammī, in apposition); 'Sharrkān'
أُمَّ: أُمَّ — umm, mother (f., acc. without tanwīn, noun of lā al-nafy al-jins; lā ummah laka, 'no mother to you', an insult); 'mother'
يُسْتَنْكَرُ: يُسْتَنْكَرُ — istankara, to deem strange, disapprove (verb X, impf. passive 3ms, indic.; ʿalayka, 'in you'); 'is deemed strange'
الْكَمَالُ: الـ + كَمَال — kamāl, perfection (m., nom., subject of the passive); al-, the; 'the perfection'
وَالْجَمْعُ: و + الـ + جَمْع — wa-, and; jamʿ, joining, combining (verbal noun of jamaʿa, m., nom., coordinated); al-, the; 'and the joining'
الْفُرُوسِيَّةِ: الـ + فُرُوسِيَّة — furūsiyya, horsemanship, knightly skill (f., gen. after bayna); al-, the; 'the horsemanship'
تَوَجَّهْ: تَوَجَّهْ — tawajjaha, to set off, go toward (verb V, imperative 2ms); 'set out'
بِأَمَانٍ: بِـ + أَمَان — amān, safety, security (m., gen.); bi-, in, with (accompaniment/manner); 'in safety'
فَضْلٍ: فَضْل — faḍl, favour, bounty, merit (m., gen. indef., second term of iḍāfa after ṣāḥib); 'of favour'
أُوَقِّرُكَ: أُوَقِّر + كَ — waqqara, to honour, treat with respect (verb II, impf. 1cs indic.) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I will honour you'
مُهَانُ: مُهَان — muhān, despised, humiliated (passive part. IV of hāna, m., nom. in the vocative yā muhānu, 'O despised one'); 'O despised one'
أَتْهَرَكَ: أَتْهَرَ + كَ — atharaka, doubtful reading: the print has اتهرك, a word not found in the lexicons; kept as printed, pointed as an imperfect 1s subjunctive after ḥattā, 'until I …'; the sense is probably anharaka, 'I drive you back, rebuke you' (nahara), or aqharaka, 'I overpower you'; -ka, you (obj.); 'until I (humble) you'
الْبَدَوِيُّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — badawī, Bedouin (m., nom., subject of ightāẓa); al-, the; 'the Bedouin'
وَتَصَايَحَا: و + تَصَايَحَ + ا — taṣāyaḥa, to shout at each other (verb VI, perf. 3 dual m.); wa-, and; 'and the two shouted at each other'
فَسَدَّتْ: فَـ + سَدَّتْ — sadda, to stop up, block (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs, subject al-khayl); fa-, and so; 'and (it) stopped up'
آذَانَهَا: آذَان + هَا — udhn, ear (f.), pl. ādhān (acc., object of saddat) + -hā, their (the horses'); 'their ears'
أَذْنَابَهَا: أَذْنَاب + هَا — dhanab, tail (m.), pl. adhnāb (acc., object of rafaʿat) + -hā, their; 'their tails'
تَقَاتَلَا: تَقَاتَلَا — taqātala, to fight one another (verb VI, perf. 3 dual m.); 'the two fought one another'
كَكِبَاشِ: كَـ + كِبَاش — kabsh, ram (m.), pl. kibāsh (gen.); ka-, like (prep., simile); 'like rams'
النِّطَاحِ: الـ + نِّطَاح — niṭāḥ, butting, goring (verbal noun of naṭaḥa, m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after kibāsh); al-, the; 'of butting'
وَاخْتَلَفَتْ: و + اخْتَلَفَتْ — ikhtalafa, to go back and forth, alternate (verb VIII, perf. 3fs); wa-, and; 'and (they) went back and forth'
طَعَنَاتُ: طَعَنَات — ṭaʿna, thrust, stab (f.), pl. ṭaʿanāt (nom., subject of ikhtalafat, first term of iḍāfa before al-rimāḥ); 'the thrusts of'
فَحَاوَلَهُ: فَـ + حَاوَلَ + هُ — ḥāwala, to try, attempt (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (obj.; ḥāwalahu bi-, 'attempt him with'); fa-, and so; 'and (he) tried him'
كَهْرْ: كَهْر — first part of Kahrdāsh, robber chief, printed split by a stray space (kahr + dāsh); 'Kahr-'
دَاشُ: دَاشُ — second part of Kahrdāsh, robber chief (proper name, nom., subject of ḥāwalahu), printed split by a stray space (kahr + dāsh); 'Kahr-dāsh'
بِطَعْنَةٍ: بِـ + طَعْنَة — ṭaʿna, a thrust (f., gen. indef.); bi-, with (instrument); 'with a thrust'
فَزَاغَ: فَـ + زَاغَ — zāgha, to swerve, turn aside (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'from it'); fa-, and so/but; 'and he swerved'
فَأَطْلَعَ: فَـ + أَطْلَعَ — aṭlaʿa, to make come out, make rise (verb IV, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and he made come out'
وَالْأَسْلَابَ: و + الـ + أَسْلَاب — salab, spoils stripped from the slain (m.), pl. aslāb (acc., coordinated with al-khayl); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the spoils'
وَالسَّوْقَ: و + الـ + سَّوْق — wa-, and (here with the exclamatory ighrāʾ, dūnakum, 'at it!'); sawq, driving, herding (verbal noun of sāqa, m., acc.); al-, the; 'and the driving'
اسْتَجَابَ: اسْتَجَابَ — istajāba, to answer, respond to (verb X hollow, perf. 3ms; takes direct object duʿāʾī); 'has answered'
دُعَائِي: دُعَاء + ـِي — duʿāʾ, prayer, supplication (m., acc., object of istajāba) + -ī, my; 'my prayer'
صَبَّاحًا: صَبَّاح — Ṣabbāḥ, the Bedouin (proper name, acc., subject of inna); 'Ṣabbāḥ'
رَأْسَ: رَأْس — raʾs, head (m., acc., object of qaṭaʿa, first term of iḍāfa before Kahrdāsh); 'the head of'
تَنْسَ: لَا + تَنْسَ — lā, not (negative particle of prohibition); nasiya, to forget (verb I, defective, impf. 2ms jussive); 'do not forget'
مُحَافِظًا: مُحَافِظ — muḥāfiẓ, guardian, one who guards (act. part. III of ḥāfaẓa, m., acc. indef., predicate of kun; with ʿalā); 'guarding'
الْأَجْنَادِ: الـ + أَجْنَاد — jund, army, soldier (m.), pl. ajnād (gen., second term of iḍāfa after jamīʿ); al-, the; 'the troops'
وَرَؤَا: و + رَأَوْا — wa-, and; raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mp, printed with wāw-hamza as raʾawā, edition spelling); 'and they saw'
وَرَأْسَ: و + رَأْس — wa-, and; raʾs, head (m., acc. or nom. loosely, first term of iḍāfa before Kahrdāsh); 'and the head of'
رُمْحِ: رُمْح — rumḥ, lance, spear (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after ʿalā); 'the spear of'
صَبَّاحٍ: صَبَّاح — Ṣabbāḥ, the Bedouin (proper name, gen. tanwīn, second term of iḍāfa after rumḥ); 'of Ṣabbāḥ'
أَرَاحَ: أَرَاحَ — arāḥa, to give rest to, relieve (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); 'has given rest'
لِقَاتِلِهِ: لِـ + قَاتِل + هِ — li-, for (prayed for; duʿā li-); qātil, killer (act. part. of qatala, m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his killer'
فَهَابَتْهُ: فَـ + هَابَتْ + هُ — fa-, and so; hāba, to fear, stand in awe of (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, subject jamīʿ al-rijāl, fem. agreement) + -hu, him; 'and (they) held him in awe'
وَخَافَتْهُ: و + خَافَتْ + هُ — wa-, and; khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, subject al-fursān, fem. agreement) + -hu, him; 'and (they) feared him'
أَوْصَلَهُ: أَوْصَلَ + هُ — awṣala, to bring, cause to arrive (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it/them (obj.); 'he brought it'; here: with the waves as subject and -hu, him; 'it brought him'
وَرَكَزَ: و + رَكَزَ — wa-, and; rakaza, to plant, fix in the ground (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he planted'
الْفِسَاحِ: الـ + فِسَاح — fisāḥ, spacious (pl. of fasīḥ, adj., gen., modifying al-amākin); al-, the; 'the spacious'
وَاخْتَلَى: و + اخْتَلَى — wa-, and; ikhtalā, to go apart, withdraw privately (verb VIII, defective, perf. 3ms; with bi-, 'with'); 'and he went apart'
بِخَوَاصِّهِ: بِـ + خَوَاصّ + هِ — bi-, with (accompaniment, ikhtalā bi-, 'to be private with'); khāṣṣa, intimate, confidant (f.), pl. khawāṣṣ (gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his intimates'
أَبُوحَ: أَبُوح — bāḥa, to disclose, divulge (verb I hollow, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an; li-, to); 'that I disclose'
بِسِرِّي: بِـ + سِرّ + ـِي — bi-, (governed by abūḥu, bāḥa bi-, 'to disclose something'); sirr, secret (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my secret'
وَأُبْدِيَ: و + أُبْدِيَ — wa-, and; abdā, to reveal, make appear (verb IV, defective, impf. 1cs subjunctive, after an); 'and (that) I reveal'
مَكْنُونَ: مَكْنُون — maknūn, hidden, concealed (pass. part. of kanna, m., acc., first term of iḍāfa before amrī); 'the hidden part of'
لِانْقِلَاعِنَا: لِـ + انْقِلَاع + نَا — li-, for (purpose/result: sabab li-, 'a cause for'); inqilāʿ, uprooting, removal (verbal noun VII of qalaʿa, m., gen.) + -nā, our; 'for our uprooting'
قَبَائِلُ: قَبَائِل — qabīla, tribe (f.), pl. qabāʾil (nom. diptote, subject of lahu); 'tribes'
الْأَكْرَادِ: الـ + أَكْرَاد — kurd, Kurd (m.), pl. akrād (gen. after min); al-, the; 'the Kurds'
وَأَمْرُنَا: و + أَمْر + نَا — wa-, and; amr, affair, matter (m., nom., subject) + -nā, our; 'and our affair'
آيِلٌ: آيِل — āʾil, tending, returning (act. part. of āla, m., nom. indef., predicate; with ilā); 'tending'
جَيْشِنَا: جَيْش + نَا — jaysh, army (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa after akthar) + -nā, our; 'our army'
أَقَارِبِهِ: أَقَارِب + هِ — qarīb, relative, kinsman (m.), pl. aqārib (gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'his kinsmen'
جَحَدَ: جَحَدَ — jaḥada, to deny, disown (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'denied'
مَعْرُوفِي: مَعْرُوف + ـِي — maʿrūf, kindness, benefaction (m., acc., object of jaḥada; passive part. of ʿarafa) + -ī, my; 'my kindness'
وَخَانَنِي: و + خَانَ + نِي — wa-, and; khāna, to betray (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (obj.); 'and he betrayed me'
وَبَلَغَنِي: و + بَلَغَ + نِي — wa-, and; balagha, to reach (verb I, perf. 3ms; the news reaches someone) + -nī, me (obj.); 'and it reached me'
يُسَلْطِنَ: يُسَلْطِنَ — salṭana, to make (someone) sultan (verb quadriliteral II from sulṭān, impf. 3ms subjunctive after an); 'to make sultan'
وَجَدِّهِ: و + جَدّ + هِ — wa-, and; jadd, grandfather (m., gen., coordinated with abīhi) + -hi, his; 'and his grandfather'
مُحَالَةٍ: مُحَالَة — maḥāla, escape, means of avoidance (f., gen. after bi-; the bi-lā maḥāla idiom, 'without fail', Middle Arabic spelling with mu-); 'without fail'
تَرْبِيَتُكَ: تَرْبِيَة + كَ — tarbiya, rearing, upbringing, protégé (verbal noun II of rabbā, f., nom., predicate) + -ka, your; 'your rearing'
يُقْبِلْ: يُقْبِلْ — aqbala, to turn toward, advance on (verb IV, impf. 3ms jussive after lam; with ʿalā); 'did not turn'
قَتَلْنَاهُ: قَتَلَ + نَا + هُ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nā, we (subject) + -hu, him (obj.); 'we kill him' (perfect in conditional apodosis)
بُعْدَهُ: بُعْد + هُ — buʿd, distance, removal (m., verbal noun of baʿuda, acc., object of shiʾta) + -hu, his; 'his distance'
أَبْعَدْنَاهُ: أَبْعَدَ + نَا + هُ — abʿada, to remove, send far away (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nā, we (subject) + -hu, him (obj.); 'we send him away'
الْمِيثَاقِ: الـ + مِيثَاق — mīthāq, covenant, oath (m., gen., after min akhdh, second term of iḍāfa); al-, the; 'the covenant'
فَتَحَالَفُوا: فَـ + تَحَالَفُوا — taḥālafa, to swear alliance together (verb VI, perf. 3mp); fa-, and so; 'and they swore together'
يَقْتُلُوا: يَقْتُلُوا — qatala, to kill (verb I, impf. 3mp subjunctive after an, the final alif of the plural omitted in the edition); 'that they kill'
تَضْعُفُ: تَضْعُفُ — ḍaʿufa, to be weak, weaken (verb I, impf. 3fs indic., subject quwwatuhu); 'weakens'
أَعْطَوْهُ: أَعْطَوْ + هُ — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, defective, perf. 3mp, with the final alif of the plural omitted) + -hu, him (obj.); 'they gave him'
وَالْمِيثَاقَ: و + الـ + مِيثَاق — wa-, and; al-, the; mīthāq, covenant (m., acc., coordinated with al-ʿahd); 'and the covenant'
تَفَرَّقَ: تَفَرَّقَ — tafarraqa, to scatter, disperse (verb V, perf. 3ms; with ʿanhu, 'from him'); 'scattered'
الرُّأَسَاءُ: الـ + رُّؤَسَاء — raʾīs, chief, leader (m.), pl. ruʾasāʾ (nom., subject of tafarraqa); al-, the; 'the chiefs'
وَامْتَنَعَتِ: و + امْتَنَعَتِ — wa-, and; imtanaʿa, to hold back, refrain (verb VIII, perf. 3fs; the final vowel is a kasra before al-); 'and (they) held back'
وَالنُّزُولِ: و + الـ + نُّزُول — wa-, and; nuzūl, dismounting, descending (verbal noun of nazala, m., gen., coordinated after min); al-, the; 'and the dismounting'
يُبْصِرُوا: يُبْصِرُوا — abṣara, to see, observe (verb IV, impf. 3mp subjunctive after ḥattā); 'they see'
غَالِبَ: غَالِب — ghālib, greater part, most (act. part. of ghalaba, m., acc., object of raʾaw, first term of iḍāfa before al-ʿaskar); 'the greater part of'
عَادَتُهَا: عَادَة + هَا — ʿāda, habit, custom (f., nom., subject of the relative clause al-ʿajūz allatī ʿādatuhā) + -hā, her; 'whose custom'
تَأْتِيَهَا: تَأْتِيَ + هَا — atā, to come to (verb I, defective, impf. 3fs subjunctive after an) + -hā, her (obj.); 'that she come to her'
أَمَرَتْهَا: أَمَرَ + تْ + هَا — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject Qaḍā Fakān) + -hā, her (obj.; amara bi-, to command, here followed by an + subj.); 'she commanded her'
وَتُخْبِرَهُ: و + تُخْبِرَ + هُ — wa-, and; akhbara, to inform (verb IV, impf. 3fs subjunctive after an) + -hu, him (obj.); 'and that she inform him'
بَلِّغِي: بَلِّغِي — ballagha, to convey, make reach (verb II, imperative 2fs, addressed to the old woman); 'convey!'
يُورِثُهَا: يُورِثُ + هَا — awratha, to make inherit, bequeath (verb IV, impf. 3ms indic.) + -hā, it (the earth; obj.); 'He gives it as inheritance'
عِبَادِهِ: عِبَاد + هِ — ʿabd, servant (m.), pl. ʿibād (gen. after min) + -hi, His; 'His servants'
اَلْمُلْكُ: الـ + مُلْك — mulk, sovereignty, dominion (m., nom., subject; verse); al-, the; 'the sovereignty'
بِنَيْلِ: بِـ + نَيْل — nayl, attaining, obtaining (verbal noun of nāla, m., gen., first term of iḍāfa before munā); bi-, in, by; 'in the attaining of'
مُنًى: مُنًى — munan, wishes, desires (pl. of munya, f., gen. indef. defective); 'of a wish'
يَرْدُدْهُ: يَرْدُدْ + هُ — radda, to return, give back (verb I doubled, impf. 3ms jussive, apodosis of man yaẓfar) + -hu, it (obj.); 'he returns it'
وَتَضْمَنْ: و + تَضْمَنْ — wa-, and; ḍamina, to stand surety for, be liable for (verb I, impf. 3fs jussive, coordinated with yaruddu; subject nafsuhu); 'and (it) stands surety'
الدَّرَكَا: الـ + دَّرَك — darak, liability, responsibility, consequence (m., acc., object of taḍman; final alif for rhyme); al-, the; 'the liability'
لِغَيْرِي: لِـ + غَيْر + ـِي — li-, to, belonging to (li- of possession); ghayr, other (m., gen.) + -ī, me; 'to other than me'
اَنْمُلَةٍ: أُنْمُلَة — unmula, fingertip (f., gen. indef., second term of iḍāfa after qadr); 'of a fingertip'
مُشْتَرَكَا: مُشْتَرَك — mushtarak, shared, held in common (pass. part. VIII of sh-r-k, m., acc., predicate of kāna; final alif for rhyme); 'shared'
وَأَعْلَمَتْهَا: و + أَعْلَمَتْ + هَا — wa-, and; aʿlama, to inform, let know (verb IV, perf. 3fs, subject the old woman) + -hā, her (obj.); 'and she let her know'
سَان: سَان — the first piece of the name Sāsān, which the print here splits into two words, سان سان (read together as Sāsān, the king; nom., in apposition to al-malik); 'Sā(sān)'
فَاصْطَادَ: فَـ + اصْطَادَ — iṣṭāda, to hunt, catch game (verb VIII hollow, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and he caught'
غَزَالَاتٍ: غَزَالَات — ghazāla, gazelle (f.), pl. ghazālāt (gen. indef. after ʿashr, tamyīz); 'gazelles'
كَحْلَاءُ: كَحْلَاء — kaḥlāʾ, kohl-dark, dark-eyed (f. adj. of akḥal, nom. diptote, adj. of ghazāla; first term of iḍāfa before al-ʿuyūn); 'dark of the eyes'
تَتَلَفَّتُ: تَتَلَفَّتُ — talaffata, to turn about, look around (verb V, impf. 3fs indic.); 'turns about'
فَأَطْلَقَهَا: فَـ + أَطْلَقَ + هَا — fa-, and so; aṭlaqa, to set free, release (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (obj.); 'and he set her free'
أَطْلَقْتَ: أَطْلَقْتَ — aṭlaqa, to set free, release (verb IV, perf. 2ms, -ta, you); 'you set free'
إِطْلَاقَ: إِطْلَاق — iṭlāq, setting free, release (verbal noun of aṭlaqa IV, m., acc., after inna min al-muruwwa, inverted subject); 'the setting free of'
الْغَزَالَاتِ: الـ + غَزَالَات — ghazāla, gazelle (f.), pl. ghazālāt (gen., second term of iḍāfa after iṭlāq); al-, the; 'the gazelles'
فَأَطْلَقْتُهَا: فَـ + أَطْلَقْتُ + هَا — fa-, and so; aṭlaqa, to set free (verb IV, perf. 1cs, -tu, I) + -hā, her (obj.); 'so I set her free'
وَأَطْلَقْتُ: و + أَطْلَقْتُ — wa-, and; aṭlaqa, to set free (verb IV, perf. 1cs, -tu, I); 'and I set free'
كَرَامَتِهَا: كَرَامَة + هَا — karāma, honour, generosity (f., gen., after fī); -hā, her (3fs suffix, the gazelle); 'in honour of her'
يَلْتَوِي: يَلْتَوِي — iltawā, to writhe, twist (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms, indic.; circumstantial ḥāl); 'writhing'
كَالثُّعْبَانِ: كَـ + الـ + ثُّعْبَان — thuʿbān, serpent (m., gen.); ka-, like (prep., simile); al-, the; 'like the serpent'
بِغَبَرَةٍ: بِـ + غَبَرَة — ghabara, dust-cloud (f., gen. indef.; variant of ghabra); bi- after وَإِذَا of surprise only marks what appears: 'and behold, a dust-cloud'
ثَائِرَةٍ: ثَائِرَة — thāʾira, rising, stirred up (act. part. f. of thāra, verb I hollow; gen. indef., adj. of ghabara); 'rising'
وَخَيْلٍ: وَ + خَيْل — khayl, horses, cavalry (collective, f., gen. indef.); wa-, and; 'and horses'
تَرْكُضُ: تَرْكُضُ — rakaḍa, to gallop, run (verb I, perf. 3ms; imperf. 3fs, indic., fem. sing. agreeing with collective khayl; ḥāl); 'galloping'
فُرْسَانٌ: فُرْسَان — fursān, horsemen (m., broken pl. of fāris; nom. indef., subject of bāna); 'horsemen'
وَشُجْعَانٌ: وَ + شُجْعَان — shujʿān, brave men (m., broken pl. of shujāʿ; nom. indef.); wa-, and; 'and brave ones'
جَامِعٌ: جَامِع — Jāmiʿ, proper name, the emir of the Daylam (nom., predicate of yuqālu lahu); 'Jāmiʿ'
فَقَتَلَهُمْ: فَـ + قَتَلَ + هُمْ — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; -hum, them (3mp object); 'and he killed them'
مَقْتُولِينَ: مَقْتُولِينَ — qatala, to kill (verb I); maqtūl, slain (pass. part., m. pl., acc., ḥāl/second object of wajada); 'slain'
وَإِذْ: وَ + إِذْ — wa-, and; idh for idhā, behold (particle of surprise; Middle Arabic spelling, followed by bi-); 'and behold'
بِأَهَالِيهَا: بِـ + أَهَالِي + هَا — ahālī, people, inhabitants (m., broken pl. of ahl; nom. after wa-idh, with bi- only marking what appears); bi-, 'behold' marker; -hā, its (the city); 'and behold, its people'
قَصْعَتَانِ: قَصْعَة — qaṣʿa, bowl, large dish (f., dual nom. -tāni, in apposition/object of 'came out with him'); 'two bowls'
إِحْدَيٰهُمَا: إِحْدَى + هُمَا — iḥdā, one (f. of aḥad; nom., first term of annexation, with dagger alif) + -humā, the two of them (dual suffix); 'one of them'
لَبَنٌ: لَبَن — laban, milk (m., nom. indef., delayed subject after fīhā); 'milk'
ثَرِيدٌ: ثَرِيد — tharīd, bread crumbled in broth (m., nom. indef., delayed subject); 'tharīd'
وَالسَّمْنُ: وَ + الـ + سَّمْن — samn, clarified butter, ghee (m., nom., subject); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the clarified butter'
جَوَانِبِهَا: جَوَانِب + هَا — jawānib, sides (f. broken pl. of jānib; gen. after fī) + -hā, its (the bowl's); 'its sides'
يَمُوجُ: يَمُوجُ — māja, to surge, billow (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms indicative; describes al-samn, the butter); 'surging'
الْقَصْعَتَيْنِ: الـ + قَصْعَتَيْن — qaṣʿa, bowl (f.; dual acc., object of waḍaʿa); al-, the; 'the two bowls'
زَادِنَا: زَاد + نَا — zād, provisions, food (m., gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'our provision'
نَذْرٌ: نَذْر — nadhr, vow (m., nom. indef., delayed subject after ʿalayya, 'upon me'); 'a vow'
نَذْرِكَ: نَذْر + كَ — nadhr, vow (m., gen., in construct after sabab) + -ka, your; 'your vow'
غَصَبَ: غَصَبَ — ghaṣaba, to usurp, seize by force (verb I, perf. 3ms; subject al-malik Sāsān); 'he usurped'
وَعُدْوَانًا: وَ + عُدْوَانًا — ʿudwān, aggression, hostility (m., acc. indef., adverbial/ḥāl coordinated with ẓulman); wa-, and; 'and in aggression'
فَاسْتَوْلَى: فَـ + اسْتَوْلَى — istawlā, to take possession of (verb X defective, perf. 3ms; governs ʿalā, 'over/upon'); fa-, and so; 'and he took possession'
يَعْتَبِرْنِي: يَعْتَبِرْ + نِي — iʿtabara, to take into account, regard (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms, jussive after lam); -nī, me (1cs object); 'he did not take account of me'
فَنَذَرْتُ: فَـ + نَذَرْتُ — nadhara, to vow (verb I, perf. 1cs); fa-, and so; 'so I vowed'
زَادًا: زَاد — zād, provisions, food (m., acc. indef., object of akala, with li-aḥad 'of anyone'); 'provision'
أَشْفِيَ: أَشْفِيَ — shafā, to heal, cure (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'I heal' (shafā fuʾādī min, 'I ease my heart of/by vengeance on')
وَفَّى: وَفَّى — waffā, to fulfil, pay in full (verb II defective, perf. 3ms; subject Allāh, preceded by qad); 'has fulfilled'
نَذْرَكَ: نَذْر + كَ — nadhr, vow (m., acc., object of waffā) + -ka, your; 'your vow'
مَسْجُونٌ: مَسْجُون — sajana, to imprison (verb I); masjūn, imprisoned (pass. part., m., nom. indef., predicate of anna-hu); 'imprisoned'
وَأَظُنُّهُ: وَ + أَظُنُّ + هُ — ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I, imperf. 1cs, indic.); wa-, and; -hu, him (first object, second is the clause an yamūta); 'and I think him (to be one who) will die'
مُعْتَقَلٌ: مُعْتَقَل — iʿtaqala, to detain, hold captive (verb VIII); muʿtaqal, held captive (pass. part., m., nom. indef., predicate; same letters as the active participle); 'held captive'
قُبَّةٍ: قُبَّة — qubba, dome, domed chamber (f., gen. indef., after ilā; adj. ʿāliya follows); 'a dome'
غُصَصَ: غُصَص — ghuṣaṣ, chokings, pangs (pl. of ghuṣṣa, f.; acc., object of yatajarraʿu, first term of annexation with al-manūn); 'the chokings of'
وَعَايَنَ: وَ + عَايَنَ — ʿāyana, to see with one's own eyes, inspect (verb III, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; 'and he saw for himself'
مِزْوَدِهِ: مِزْوَد + هِ — mizwad, provision-bag, wallet (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his provision-bag'
ضَيَّفَهُ: ضَيَّفَ + هُ — ḍayyafa, to entertain as a guest, host (verb II, perf. 3ms, relative clause after alladhī) + -hu, him; 'who had hosted him'
كِلَابٌ: كِلَاب — kilāb, dogs (m., broken pl. of kalb; nom. indef., delayed subject of kāna after ḥawlahā); 'dogs'
يَحْرُسُونَهَا: يَحْرُسُ + ونَ + هَا — ḥarasa, to guard (verb I, imperf. 3mpl, indic.; ḥāl/adj. of kilāb); -hā, it (the dome, 3fs object); 'guarding it'
فَوَثَبَ: فَـ + وَثَبَ — wathaba, to leap (verb I assimilated, perf. 3ms); fa-, and; 'and there leapt'
لِلْكِلَابِ: لِـ + الـ + كِلَاب — kilāb, dogs (m., pl. of kalb; gen. after li-); li-, to (dative, 'throw to'); al-, the; 'to the dogs'
وَتَوَصَّلَ: وَ + تَوَصَّلَ — tawaṣṣala, to find a way, make one's way (verb V, perf. 3ms; here with ilā an 'until'); wa-, and; 'and he made his way'
سَعَيْتَ: سَعَيْتَ — saʿā, to strive, endeavour (verb I defective, perf. 2ms; governs fī, 'strive for'); 'you strove'
فَأَوْقَعَكَ: فَـ + أَوْقَعَ + كَ — awqaʿa, to cause to fall (verb IV, perf. 3ms; subject Allāh); fa-, and so; -ka, you (2ms object); 'and he made you fall'
أَمَا: أَمَا — a- + mā, interrogative hamza + negation (rhetorical, 'is it not enough?'); amā; 'is it not'
وَمُلْكِ: وَ + مُلْك — mulk, kingdom, dominion (m., gen., in construct, coordinated with mulkī; first term of annexation with abī); wa-, and; 'and the kingdom of'
الْبَاطِلَةَ: الـ + بَاطِلَة — bāṭil, false, void (act. part. of baṭala; f., acc., adj. of al-aymān, a non-human plural taking fem. sing.); al-, the; 'the false'
يَسْعَ: يَسْعَ — saʿā, to strive (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms, jussive after lam; governs fī); 'he had not striven'
فَصَفَحَ: فَـ + صَفَحَ — ṣafaḥa, to pardon, turn away from (verb I, perf. 3ms; with ʿan 'pardon him'); fa-, and so; 'and he pardoned'
أَخْطُوَ: أَخْطُوَ — khaṭā, to step, stride (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; imperf. 1cs, subjunctive after an); 'to step'
خَطْوَةً: خَطْوَة — khaṭwa, a step, pace (f., acc. indef., cognate accusative; wāḥida follows); 'a step'
نَأْخُذُ: نَأْخُذُ — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 1p, indic.; hamza shown; here a proposal, 'let us take'); 'we take'
فَرَسَيْنِ: فَرَس + يْنِ — faras, horse, mare (m./f., dual acc., object of nakhudhu); 'two horses'
وَنَطْلُبُ: وَ + نَطْلُبُ — ṭalaba, to seek (verb I, imperf. 1p, indic.); wa-, and; 'and we seek'
وَسَاسَانُ: وَ + سَاسَان — Sāsān, proper name, the king (nom., coordinated with the subject pronoun hū after rakiba); wa-, and (with); 'and Sāsān'
صَلَّوُا: صَلَّوْا — ṣallā, to pray (verb II defective, perf. 3mpl; the silent alif of the plural printed as wāw before al-); 'they prayed'
تَكْرَهُهُ: تَكْرَهُ + هُ — kariha, to dislike (verb I, imperf. 2ms, indic.; relative clause on amr) + -hu, it; 'which you dislike'
اتَّفَقُوا: اتَّفَقُوا — ittafaqa, to agree (verb VIII assimilated, perf. 3mpl); 'they agreed'
أَسْبِقُكُمَا: أَسْبِقُ + كُمَا — sabaqa, to go ahead of, outstrip (verb I, imperf. 1cs, indic.) + -kumā, you two (dual object); 'I will go ahead of you two'
بَشِّرَ: بَشِّرَ — bashshara, to give glad tidings (verb II, subjunctive after li-); the second half of the split لِأُ بَشِّرَ (li- 'in order to' + u- 'I' + bashshira, stray space); 'to give glad tidings'
فَسَبَقَ: فَـ + سَبَقَ — sabaqa, to go ahead (verb I, perf. 3ms); fa-, and so; 'and he went ahead'
يُبَشِّرُ: يُبَشِّرُ — bashshara, to give glad tidings (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indic.; ḥāl); 'giving glad tidings'
وَالرِّجَالَ: وَ + الـ + رِّجَال — rijāl, men (pl. of rajul; acc., coordinated with al-nisāʾ, object of yubashshiru); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the men'
وَالْمَزَامِيرِ: وَ + الـ + مَزَامِير — mizmār, reed-pipe (m., pl. mazāmīr; gen. after bi- of accompaniment in the preceding bi-l-dufūf); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the pipes'
وَبَرَزَتْ: وَ + بَرَزَتْ — baraza, to come forth, appear (verb I, perf. 3fs; subject Qaḍā Fakān); wa-, and; 'and she came forth'; here: subject ʿaynāhu, 'his eyes': 'and (his eyes) bulged out'
بَهِيِّ: بَهِيّ — bahī, splendid, radiant (adj., m., gen., first term of annexation with al-anwār; modifies al-badr); 'splendid of'
دَيَاجِى: دَيَاجِي — dayājī, darknesses (pl. of dayjūr/dayjāʾ, gen. after fī, first term of annexation; final ī printed ى); 'the darknesses of'
الِاعْتِكَارِ: الـ + اِعْتِكَار — iʿtikār, thick darkness, gloom (m., verbal noun of iʿtakara VIII, gen.; the night's gloom is called iʿtakara); al-, the; 'the thick gloom'
فَقَابَلَهَا: فَـ + قَابَلَ + هَا — qābala, to meet, face (verb III, perf. 3ms); fa-, and; -hā, her; 'and he met her'
وَحَمَتِ: وَ + حَمَتِ — ḥamiya, to grow hot (verb I defective, perf. 3fs, written ḥamat; final -t with kasra before al-); wa-, and; 'and grew warm'
الْأَرْوَاحُ: الـ + أَرْوَاح — arwāḥ, spirits, souls (pl. of rūḥ; nom., subject of ḥamat); al-, the; 'the spirits'
لِلْأَرْوَاحِ: لِـ + الـ + أَرْوَاح — arwāḥ, spirits (pl. of rūḥ; gen.); li-, to, toward (of direction); al-, the; 'to the spirits'
وَاشْتَاقَتِ: وَ + اشْتَاقَتِ — ishtāqa, to long for (verb VIII hollow, perf. 3fs, final -t with kasra before al-; governs ilā/li-); wa-, and; 'and longed'
الْأَشْبَاحُ: الـ + أَشْبَاح — ashbāḥ, bodies, forms (pl. of shabaḥ; nom., subject of ishtāqat); al-, the; 'the bodies'
لِلْأَشْبَاحِ: لِـ + الـ + أَشْبَاح — ashbāḥ, bodies (pl. of shabaḥ; gen.); li-, for/to (with ishtāqa, 'longed for'); al-, the; 'for the bodies'
وَشَهِدَ: وَ + شَهِدَ — shahida, to bear witness (verb I, perf. 3ms; with li- 'for him'); wa-, and; 'and (they) bore witness'
أَشْجَعُ: أَشْجَع — ashjaʿ, bravest (elative of shujāʿ, m., nom. diptote, predicate of anna-hu, first term of annexation with ahl); 'the bravest of'
وَيَعُودُ: وَ + يَعُودُ — ʿāda, to return (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; imperf. 3ms, indic.; with ilā); wa-, and; 'and it returns'
جَدِّهِ: جَدّ + هِ — jadd, grandfather (m., gen., second term of annexation after mulk) + -hi, his; 'of his grandfather'
إِلّاَ: إِلَّا — illā, except, but (exceptive particle after a negative; Middle Arabic spelling with vowel marks transposed); 'except'
وَيَصِفُونَهُ: وَ + يَصِفُ + ونَ + هُ — waṣafa, to describe (verb I assimilated, imperf. 3mpl, indic.); wa-, and; -hu, him; 'and they describe him'
بِأَوْصَافٍ: بِـ + أَوْصَاف — waṣf, description, attribute (m., pl. awṣāf, gen. indef. diptote shown with tanwīn); bi-, with (they describe him with); 'with descriptions'
صِفَاتِ: صِفَات — ṣifa, quality, attribute (f., pl. ṣifāt; gen., second term of annexation after min); 'qualities of'
يُقَلِّدُ: يُقَلِّدُ — qallada, to imitate (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indic.; subject baʿḍuhum); 'imitates'
وَمَحَبَّتِهِ: وَ + مَحَبَّة + هِ — maḥabba, love (f., gen., coordinated with madḥ, after fī) ; wa-, and; -hi, his; 'and in loving him'
أَلْسِنَةِ: أَلْسِنَة — alsina, tongues (pl. of lisān, m.; gen., first term of annexation with al-nās, after ʿalā); 'the tongues of'
مَدْحَهُ: مَدْح + هُ — madḥ, praise (m., acc., object of ajrā) + -hu, his; 'his praise'
الْغَادِرِ: الـ + غَادِر — ghādir, treacherous (act. part. of ghadara, m.; gen., adj. of Dandān); al-, the; 'the treacherous'
يَتِيمٍ: يَتِيم — yatīm, orphan (m., gen. indef., adj./apposition of ḥākim); 'an orphan'
قَصْدِهِ: قَصْد + هِ — qaṣd, aim, intent (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his aim'
وَطَاعَتِي: وَ + طَاعَة + ي — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., gen., coordinated with amrī, written ṭāʿatī) ; wa-, and; -ī, my; 'and my obedience'
الْغَدْرَ: الـ + غَدْر — ghadr, treachery (m., acc., noun of inna); al-, the; 'the treachery'
بِالْأَجَانِبِ: بِـ + الـ + أَجَانِب — ajānib, strangers, foreigners (pl. of ajnabī; gen.); bi-, in the case of, with (qabīḥ bi-, 'ugly toward'); al-, the; 'with strangers'
بِالْأَقَارِبِ: بِـ + الـ + أَقَارِب — aqārib, kinsmen (pl. of qarīb; gen.); bi-, in the case of (kayfa bi-, 'how then with'); al-, the; 'with kinsmen'
تُزَوِّجَهُ: تُزَوِّجَ + هُ — zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (verb II, perf. 3ms; imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an) + -hu, him; 'that you marry him (to)'
وَتَسْمَعَ: وَ + تَسْمَعَ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive, continuing the an clause); wa-, and; 'and that you hear'
اَحَقُّ: أَحَقُّ — aḥaqq, more deserving (elative of ḥaqq, m.; printed nom., for acc. as predicate of kunta); 'more deserving'
تَصَاعَدْ: تَصَاعَدْ — taṣāʿada, to rise, ascend by degrees (verb VI, perf. 3ms; sukūn for the rhyme); 'he ascended'
اَنِلْهُ: أَنِلْ + هُ — anāla, to grant, cause to obtain (verb IV, imperative 2ms) + -hu, him; 'give him'
رُتْبَتِهِ: رُتْبَة + هِ — rutba, rank, degree (f., gen., in construct after ḥaqq) + -hi, his; 'of his rank'
يُنِيلُكَ: يُنِيلُ + كَ — anāla, to grant (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, indic.; ḥāl/predicate after tajid-hu) + -ka, you; 'granting you'
دَنَوْتَ: دَنَوْتَ — danā, to draw near (verb I defective, perf. 2ms; conditional after in); 'you draw near'
تَبَاعَدْ: تَبَاعَدْ — tabāʿada, to be far, withdraw (verb VI, perf. 3ms; sukūn for the rhyme; conditional after in); 'he be far'
تَقُلِ: تَقُلِ — qāla, to say (verb I hollow, negative jussive 2ms after lā; kasra to avoid a cluster before al-); 'do not say'
تَدْرِيهِ: تَدْرِي + هِ — darā, to know (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms, indic.; relative clause) + -hi, him (about him, fīhi); 'which you know of him'
تَقَاعَدْ: تَقَاعَدْ — taqāʿada, to hold back, sit idle (verb VI, perf. 3ms; sukūn for the rhyme); 'has held back'
الْخِدْرِ: الـ + خِدْر — khidr, curtained chamber, women's apartment (m., gen., after fī); al-, the; 'the curtained chamber'
اَبْهَى: أَبْهَى — abhā, more splendid (elative of bahī, m.; diptote, tamyīz/object of kam, 'how many a more splendid'); 'more splendid'
عَرُوسٍ: عَرُوس — ʿarūs, bride (f./m., gen. indef., after min in the comparison); 'a bride'
لِلْعَرُوسِ: لِـ + الـ + عَرُوس — ʿarūs, bride (gen.); li-, for (benefit, with sāʿada); al-, the; 'for the bride'
سَاعَدْ: سَاعَدَ — sāʿada, to help, favour (verb III, perf. 3ms; sukūn for the rhyme; subject al-dahr); 'has helped'
قَتْلَكِ: قَتْل + كِ — qatl, killing (m. verbal noun of qatala, acc., noun of anna) + -ki, you (2fs, addressed to Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'killing you'
وَشَنَارٌ: وَ + شَنَار — shanār, disgrace, shame (m., nom. indef., predicate coordinated with ʿār); wa-, and; 'and a disgrace'
لَعَلَوْتُ: لَـ + عَلَوْتُ — ʿalā, to rise above, be high (verb I defective, perf. 1cs; with bi-l-sayf 'with the sword'); la-, emphatic (apodosis of lawlā); 'I would have raised over (you)'
وَأَخْمَدْتُ: وَ + أَخْمَدْتُ — akhmada, to extinguish, snuff out (verb IV, perf. 1cs); wa-, and; 'and I would have snuffed out'
أَنْفَاسَكِ: أَنْفَاس + كِ — anfās, breaths (m., pl. of nafas; acc., object of akhmadtu) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your breaths'
أَمْزَحُ: أَمْزَحُ — mazaḥa, to joke, jest (verb I, imperf. 1cs, indic.); 'I am joking'
وَيَدَيْهِ: وَ + يَدَيْ + هِ — yad, hand (f., dual yadayn; oblique, object of qabbalat); wa-, and; -hi, his; 'and his two hands'
أَتَدَبَّرُ: أَتَدَبَّرُ — tadabbara, to ponder, contrive (verb V, imperf. 1cs, indic., after sawfa; with anā wa-anta); 'I shall contrive'
وَفَرِّجِي: وَ + فَرِّجِي — farraja, to relieve, remove (distress) (verb II, imperative 2fs); wa-, and; 'and relieve'
كُرْبَتِي: كُرْبَة + ي — kurba, distress, anguish (f., acc., object of farriji) + -ī, my; 'my distress'
أَتَحَيَّلُ: أَتَحَيَّلُ — taḥayyala, to scheme, use a ruse (verb V, imperf. 1cs, indic., after sawfa; with la-ka 'for you'); 'I shall scheme'
إِتْلَافِ: إِتْلَاف — itlāf, destroying (m. verbal noun of aṭlafa IV, gen., after ʿalā, 'toward'; first term of annexation with muhjatihi); 'destroying'
بِجَارِيَتِنَا: بِـ + جَارِيَة + نَا — jāriya, slave-girl (f., gen.); bi-, by means of (instrument, 'by what thing'); -nā, our; 'by our slave-girl'
بَاكُونُ: بَاكُون — Bākūn, proper name, the slave-woman (nom., predicate of ismuhā); 'Bākūn'
فُنُونٍ: فُنُون — funūn, arts, kinds (pl. of fann, m.; gen. indef., after dhāt); 'arts'
أَنْحَسِ: أَنْحَس — anḥas, most ill-omened (elative of naḥs, m./f., gen. diptote, first term of annexation with al-ʿajāʾiz after min); 'the most ill-omened of'
وَعَدَمُ: وَ + عَدَم — ʿadam, absence, lack (m., nom., subject; first term of annexation with al-khubth); wa-, and; 'and the absence of'
الْخُبْثِ: الـ + خُبْث — khubth, wickedness, malice (m., gen., second term of annexation); al-, the; 'of wickedness'
مَذْهَبِهَا: مَذْهَب + هَا — madhhab, way, creed (m., gen., after fī) + -hā, her; 'in her creed'
جَائِزٍ: جَائِز — jāʾiz, permissible (act. part. of jāza, m., gen. indef., after ghayr); 'permissible'
رَبَّتْ: رَبَّتْ — rabbā, to rear, bring up (verb II defective, perf. 3fs, after qad); 'she had reared'
مَيْلِهِ: مَيْل + هِ — mayl, inclination (m. verbal noun of māla, gen., after min farṭi) + -hi, his; 'his inclining'
الرَّائَ: الـ + رَّائَ — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m., nom., apposition of hādhā; printed rāʾ with a final hamza, Middle Arabic spelling for al-raʾy); al-, the; 'the opinion'
بَاكُونَ: بَاكُون — Bākūn, proper name, the slave-woman (acc., apposition to al-jāriya, object of aḥḍara); 'Bākūn'
وَحَدَّثَهَا: وَ + حَدَّثَ + هَا — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate (verb II, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; -hā, her; 'and told her'
مُطَاعٌ: مُطَاع — aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV); muṭāʿ, obeyed (pass. part., m., nom. indef., predicate of amruka); 'obeyed'
خِنْجَرًا: خِنْجَر — khinjar, dagger (m., acc. indef., second object of tuʿṭiya; variant of khanjar); 'a dagger'
سُقِيَ: سُقِيَ — saqā, to give to drink, steep, temper (verb I defective, passive perf. 3ms; relative clause); 'has been watered'
لِأُعَجِّلَ: لِـ + أُعَجِّلَ — ʿajjala, to hasten (verb II, subjunctive 1cs); li-, in order to (purpose), + u- 'I'; 'that I may hasten'
بِإِتْلَافِهِ: بِـ + إِتْلَاف + هِ — itlāf, destroying (m. verbal noun of aṭlafa IV, gen.); bi-, with (ʿajjala bi-, 'hasten with'); -hi, his; 'with destroying him'
يَكَادُأَنْ: يَكَادُ أَنْ — kāda, to be about to (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms, indic.) + an, that (particle, printed without a space); 'almost'
يَسْبِقَ: يَسْبِقَ — sabaqa, to outstrip, precede (verb I, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an); 'outstrips'
وَتَحْفَظُ: وَ + تَحْفَظُ — ḥafiẓa, to keep in memory, memorize (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic.); wa-, and; 'and kept by heart'
النَّوَادِرَ: الـ + نَّوَادِر — nawādir, rare anecdotes, curiosities (f. pl. of nādira; acc., object of taḥfaẓu); al-, the; 'the rare anecdotes'
وَالْأَخْبَارَ: وَ + الـ + أَخْبَار — akhbār, reports, tales (pl. of khabar; acc., coordinated); wa-, and; al-, the; 'and the reports'
الْخِنْجَرَ: الـ + خِنْجَر — khinjar, dagger (m., acc., object of akhadhat; variant of khanjar); al-, the; 'the dagger'
مُفَكِّرَةً: مُفَكِّرَة — fakkara, to ponder (verb II); mufakkira, pondering (act. part., f., acc. ḥāl, with fī 'about'); 'pondering'
الدَّمَارُ: الـ + دَّمَار — damār, destruction, ruin (m., nom., subject of yakūnu); al-, the; 'the destruction'
وَعْدَ: وَعْد — waʿd, promise (m., acc., object of yantaẓiru; first term of annexation with al-sayyida); 'the promise of'
فَالْتَهَبَتْ: فَـ + الْتَهَبَتْ — iltahaba, to blaze up (verb VIII, perf. 3fs; subject al-nīrān, a non-human plural); fa-, and so; 'and there blazed'
حُبِّهَا: حُبّ + هَا — ḥubb, love (m., gen., after min) + -hā, her; 'from love of her'
مُشْتَغِلَةٌ: مُشْتَغِلَة — ishtaghala, to be occupied (verb VIII); mushtaghila, occupied (act. part., f., nom. indef., predicate of anna-hā; governs bi-); 'occupied'
بِحُبِّكَ: بِـ + حُبّ + كَ — ḥubb, love (m., gen.); bi-, with (mushtaghila bi-, 'occupied with'); -ka, your; 'with love of you'
وَأُحَدِّثُكَ: وَ + أُحَدِّثُ + كَ — ḥaddatha, to tell (verb II, imperf. 1cs, indic.); wa-, and; -ka, you; 'and I tell you'
وَأُسَلِّيكَ: وَ + أُسَلِّي + كَ — sallā, to divert, console (verb II defective, imperf. 1cs, indic.); wa-, and; -ka, you; 'and I divert you'
أَمْرَضَهُ: أَمْرَضَ + هُ — marida, to be sick; amraḍa, to make sick (verb IV, perf. 3ms; relative clause, subject al-gharām) + -hu, him; 'has made sick'
يَفْرَحُ: يَفْرَحُ — fariḥa, to rejoice (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.; relative clause; with bi- 'by it'); 'rejoices'
وَيَزُولُ: وَ + يَزُولُ — zāla, to pass away, vanish (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms, indic.; subject kurbī); wa-, and; 'and passes away'; also (Night 202): وَ + يَزُولُ — wa-, and + zāla, to pass away, vanish (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms indic.); subject mā: yazūlu mā bihā, 'what is on her passes away'
كَرْبِي: كَرْب + ي — kurb, distress, anguish (m., nom., subject of yazūlu) + -ī, my; 'my distress'
الْخِنْجَرُ: الـ + خِنْجَر — khinjar, dagger (m., nom., subject; variant of khanjar); al-, the; 'the dagger'
وَصَرَفَ: وَ + صَرَفَ — ṣarafa, to spend (verb I, perf. 3ms; governs ʿalā, 'on'); wa-, and; 'and he spent'
وَيُفَتِّشُ: وَ + يُفَتِّشُ — fattasha, to search (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indic.; with ʿalā 'for'); wa-, and; 'and searching'
شَكَّتْهُ: شَكَّتْ + هُ — shakka, to prick, pierce (verb I, perf. 3fs; subject qiṭʿat miṣmār) + -hu, him; 'pricked him'
إِصْبَعِهِ: إِصْبَع + هِ — iṣbaʿ, finger (m./f., gen., after fī) + -hi, his; 'in his finger'
جَازَ: جَازَ — jāza, to pass (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā 'by'); 'he passed'
وَدَخَلَهَا: وَ + دَخَلَ + هَا — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3ms); wa-, and; -hā, it (the bath, al-ḥammām, f.); 'and entered it'
يَنْزَحُ: يَنْزَحُ — nazaḥa, to draw out, bale (water) (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic., after mā zāla); 'drawing'
تَعِبَ: تَعِبَ — taʿiba, to grow tired (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'he tired'
وَالأَرْبَعُونَ: وَ + الـ + أَرْبَعُون — wa-, and + al-, the + arbaʿūn, forty (numeral, m. pl., nom.); 'and the forty' (in 'the third-and-forty after the hundred')
يَجِدْأَ: يَجِدْ + أَ — yajid, he finds (jussive of wajada after lam, 'did not find') + a-, the first letter of aḥadan, split off by the print; read with the next word as 'did not find anyone'
حَدًا: حَدًا — ḥadan, the rest of aḥadan, anyone (indef., acc.) after the print's split; 'anyone'
فَاخْتَلَى: فَ + اخْتَلَى — fa-, so, then + ikhtalā, he went apart, was alone (Form VIII perfect, 3rd m. sg.; from khalā); 'so he went apart'
وَبَلَعَهَا: وَ + بَلَعَ + هَا — wa-, and + balaʿa, he swallowed (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hā, it (f., the piece of hashish, object); 'and swallowed it'
فَسَاحَتْ: فَ + سَاحَتْ — fa-, and so + sāḥat, it melted, ran (perfect, 3rd f. sg., agreeing with qiṭʿa, the piece); 'and it melted'
مُخِّهِ: مُخِّ + هِ — mukhkh, brain (m., gen. after fī, 'in') + hi, his; 'his brain'
الْبَارِدِ: الْ + بَارِد — al-, the + bārid, cold (adj., m., gen., agreeing with al-ḥawḍ, the pool); 'the cold'
وَطَلَّعَ: وَ + طَلَّعَ — wa-, and + ṭallaʿa, he brought out, took out (Form II perfect, 3rd m. sg.; colloquial for Classical akhraja); 'and took out'
الْحَشِيشُ: الْ + حَشِيش — al-, the + ḥashīsh, hashish, the drug (m., nom., subject of khayyala); 'the hashish'
مَهْتَارًا: مَهْتَار — mahtār, head servant, chief attendant (m., sg., indef., acc. after anna; from Persian mihtar, 'greater'); 'a head attendant'
يَكْبِسُهُ: يَكْبِسُ + هُ — yakbisu, he kneads, massages (imperfect, 3rd m. sg.; kabasa) + hu, him (object); 'massaging him'
وَاقِفَانِ: وَاقِف + انِ — wāqif, standing (act. part., m.) + -āni, dual nom. (Middle Arabic nominative after anna, where ʿabdayni is accusative); 'standing' (of the two slaves)
وَخَيَّلَ: وَ + خَيَّلَ — wa-, and + khayyala, he made (someone) imagine (Form II perfect, 3rd m. sg.; the hashish is the subject); 'and it made him fancy'
الطَّاسَةُ: الطَّاسَة — al-, the + ṭāsa, shallow metal bowl for pouring water (f., nom.); 'the bowl'
وَالآخَرُ: وَ + الآخَر — wa-, and + al-, the + ākhar, other (m., nom.); 'and the other'
الْبَلَّانُ: الْ + بَلَّان — al-, the + ballān, bath attendant (m., nom.; from ballāna, bath-keeper); 'the bath attendant'
غَلِطُوا: غَلِطُوا — ghaliṭū, they made a mistake (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; ghaliṭa fī, 'to mistake someone', the verb takes fī); 'they have mistaken'
طَائِفَتِنَا: طَائِفَة + نَا — ṭāʾifa, group, fraternity (f., gen. after min) + nā, our; 'our fraternity'
الْحَشَّاشِينَ: الْ + حَشَّاشِين — al-, the + ḥashshāsh, hashish-eater (intensive faʿʿāl form; m. pl., here with -īn, colloquial for nominative -ūn, in apposition to 'our'); 'the hashish-eaters'
فَتَخَيَّلَ: فَ + تَخَيَّلَ — fa-, and so + takhayyala, it seemed to him, he imagined (Form V perfect, 3rd m. sg., impersonal); 'and he fancied'
أَزِفَ: أَزِفَ — azifa, it drew near, is imminent (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'is close at hand'
طُلُوعِكَ: طُلُوع + كَ — ṭulūʿ, going up, ascent (verbal n., m., gen. after ʿalā) + ka, your; 'your going up'
نَوْبَتُكَ: نَوْبَة + كَ — nawba, turn (of duty) (f., nom.) + ka, your; 'your turn'
الْبَلَّانَ: الْ + بَلَّان — al-, the + ballān, bath attendant (m., acc., subject of qāla after anna); 'the bath attendant'
حَشِيشُ: حَشِيش — ḥashīsh, hashish (m., vocative, in construct with the exclamation; addressed after yā); 'O hashish'
مِيزَرًا: مِيزَر — mīzar, bath wrap, waist-cloth (m., acc., object of adāra; colloquial for Classical miʾzar); 'a waist-cloth'
بِالطَّاسَاتِ: بِ + الـ + طَاسَات — bi-, with (prep., 'with the bowls', carried by the slaves) + al-, the + ṭāsāt, bowls (f. pl., gen.); 'with the bowls'
وَالْحَوَائِجِ: وَ + الـ + حَوَائِج — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥawāʾij, things, gear (pl. of ḥāja; gen., coordinated with the bowls after bi-); 'and the gear'
الأَسْوَدِ: الْ + أَسْوَد — al-, the + aswad, black (adj., m., gen., agreeing with al-ḥarīr, the silk); 'the black'
مَلأٰنَةً: مَلْآنَة — malʾāna, full (f., acc., predicate of wajadahā, 'found it full'; post-classical feminine of malʾān, print omits the long ā); 'full'
وَشَقُّوالَهُ: وَ + شَقُّوا + لَ + هُ — wa-, and + shaqqū, they split open (perfect, 3rd m. pl.) + la-, for (dative: 'for him') + hu, him; the print runs shaqqū and lahu together; 'and they cut open for him'
بَطِّيخَةً: بَطِّيخَة — baṭṭīkha, melon, watermelon (f., sg., indef., acc., object of shaqqū); 'a melon'
الأَبْنُوسِ: الْ + أَبْنُوس — al-, the + abnūs, ebony (m., gen. after min, 'of'); 'the ebony' (in 'a chair of ebony')
وَالْعَبْدَانِ: وَ + الـ + عَبْد + انِ — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿabd, slave (m.) + -āni, dual nom.; 'and the two slaves'
يَصُبَّانِ: يَصُبَّ + انِ — yaṣubbāni, they (two) pour (imperfect, 3rd m. dual, indicative; ṣabba); 'pouring'
دَلَكُوهُ: دَلَكُوا + هُ — dalakū, they rubbed (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; dalaka) + hu, him (object); 'they rubbed him down'
دَلْكًا: دَلْكًا — dalkan, a rubbing (verbal n., m., indef., acc.; cognate accusative of dalakūhu); 'thoroughly'
الْمِيزَرَ: الْ + مِيزَر — al-, the + mīzar, bath wrap, waist-cloth (m., acc., object of rafaʿa); 'the waist-cloth'
بَالُهُمْ: بَال + هُمْ — bāl, state, concern (m., nom.) + hum, their; mā bāluhum, 'what is their state?'; 'what is the matter with them'
يُخَاطِبُونَنِي: يُخَاطِبُون + نِي — yukhāṭibūna, they address (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; Form III khāṭaba) + nī, me (object); 'they address me'
وَيَقُولُونَ: وَ + يَقُولُون — wa-, and + yaqūlūna, they say (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; qāla); 'and they say'
الْتَبَسَ: الْتَبَسَ — iltabasa, it became confused, unclear (Form VIII perfect, 3rd m. sg.; iltabasa ʿalā, 'to be unclear to', verb takes ʿalā); 'is confused for them'
يَعْرِفُونَنِي: يَعْرِفُون + نِي — yaʿrifūna, they know, recognise (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; ʿarafa) + nī, me (object); 'they will recognise me'
زَلِيطٌ: زَلِيط — Zalīṭ, nickname of the hashish-eater, perhaps 'stark naked' (proper n., nom., predicate of 'this is'); 'Zalīṭ'
وَيُشْبِعُونَ: وَ + يُشْبِعُون — wa-, and + yushbiʿūna, they sate, give one's fill (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; Form IV ashbaʿa); 'and they give their fill'
صَكًّا: صَكًّا — ṣakkan, a slap, blow (verbal n./n., m., indef., acc., object of yushbiʿūna); 'a slap'
الأَمْرَ: الْ + أَمْر — al-, the + amr, matter, affair (m., nom. or acc. after laʿalla; the subject of iltabasa); 'the matter'
اسْتَحَمَّى: اسْتَحَمَّى — istaḥammā, he bathed (Form X perfect, 3rd m. sg.; colloquial for Classical istaḥamma); 'he bathed'
وَطَوَاشِيًا: وَ + طَوَاشِي — wa-, and + ṭawāshī, eunuch (m., acc., coordinated with mamlūkan; from Turkish); 'and a eunuch'
فَالْمَمْلُوكُ: فَ + الـ + مَمْلُوك — fa-, and (resuming the account) + al-, the + mamlūk, slave page (m., nom.); 'and the mamluk'
فُوَطٍ: فُوَط — fuwaṭ, towels, bath wraps (pl. of fūṭa; gen. after thalātha); 'towels'
وَحَزَمَهُ: وَ + حَزَمَ + هُ — wa-, and + ḥazama, he girded, tied round (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, him (object); 'and girded him'
بِالثَّالِثَةِ: بِ + الـ + ثَّالِثَة — bi-, with (prep., instrument: 'girded him with the third') + al-, the + thālitha, third (f., gen.), i.e. the third towel; 'with the third'
بُقْجَةٌ: بُقْجَة — buqja, cloth bundle for clothes (f., nom.; from Turkish bohça); 'a bundle'
الأُولَى: الْ + أُولَى — al-, the + ūlā, first (f.); 'the first' (towel)
وَالأُخْرَى: وَ + الـ + أُخْرَى — wa-, and + al-, the + ukhrā, other (f.), here 'the second'; 'and the other'
قَبْقَابًا: قَبْقَاب — qabqāb, high wooden bath clog (m., acc., object of qaddama); 'a pair of clogs'
فَلَبِسَهُ: فَ + لَبِسَ + هُ — fa-, and so + labisa, he put on, wore (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, it (object); 'and he put them on'
وَطَوَاشِيَةٌ: وَ + طَوَاشِيَة — wa-, and + ṭawāshiya, eunuchs (colloquial pl. of ṭawāshī; nom. with tanwīn); 'and eunuchs'
يُسْنِدُونَهُ: يُسْنِدُون + هُ — yusnidūna, they support, prop up (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; Form IV asnada) + hu, him (object); 'supporting him'
اللِّيوَانَ: الْ + لِّيوَان — al-, the + līwān, raised hall (m., acc., object of ṭalaʿa; colloquial for īwān); 'the hall'
الْمَرْتَبَةِ: الْ + مَرْتَبَة — al-, the + martaba, couch, mattress, raised seat (f., gen. after ʿalā, 'on'); 'the couch'
يَكْبِسُونَهُ: يَكْبِسُون + هُ — yakbisūna, they knead, massage (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; kabasa) + hu, him (object); 'massaging him'
وَتَبَادَرَتْ: وَ + تَبَادَرَتْ — wa-, and + tabādarat, they hurried (Form VI perfect, 3rd f. sg., feminine with the broken plural al-ghilmān); 'and they hurried'
فَبَاسَهَا: فَ + بَاسَ + هَا — fa-, and so + bāsa, he kissed (perfect, 3rd m. sg.; colloquial for Classical qabbala) + hā, her (object); 'and he kissed her'
وَسَحَبَهَا: وَ + سَحَبَ + هَا — wa-, and + saḥaba, he drew, dragged (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hā, her (object); 'and drew her'
زَلِيطُ: زَلِيط — Zalīṭ, nickname of the hashish-eater, perhaps 'stark naked' (proper n., vocative after yā, Middle Arabic -u ending); 'Zalīṭ'
انْتَبِهْ: انْتَبِهْ — intabih, wake up! (Form VIII imperative, 2nd m. sg.); 'wake up'
وَأَيْرُهُ: وَ + أَيْر + هُ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + ayr, penis (m., nom.; blunt everyday word) + hu, his; 'and his prick'
وَالْفُوطَةُ: وَ + الـ + فُوطَة — wa-, and + al-, the + fūṭa, bath towel, waist-cloth (f., nom.); 'and the towel'
وَتَخَيُّلَاتُ: وَ + تَخَيُّلَات — wa-, and + takhayyulāt, fancies, imaginings (f. pl.; construct, nom.; verbal n. of takhayyala); 'and the fancies'
أَضْغَاثُ: أَضْغَاث — aḍghāth, bundles, confused mixtures (pl. of ḍighth; construct, nom.; with aḥlām, Qurʾānic 'muddled dreams', Yūsuf 12:44); 'muddled'
نَبَّهَهُ: نَبَّهَ + هُ — nabbahahu: nabbaha, he woke (Form II perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, him (object); 'who had woken him'
أَحُطَّهُ: أَحُطَّ + هُ — aḥuṭṭahu: aḥuṭṭa, I put, set down (imperfect, 1st sg., subjunctive after ḥattā; ḥaṭṭa, colloquial for Classical waḍaʿa) + hu, it (object); 'I had put it in'
حَشَّاشُ: حَشَّاش — ḥashshāsh, hashish-eater (intensive faʿʿāl form; m., vocative after yā, a term of contempt); 'hashish-eater'
وَذَكَرُكَ: وَ + ذَكَر + كَ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + dhakar, penis, male member (m., nom.) + ka, your; 'and your member'
وَصَكُّوهُ: وَ + صَكُّوا + هُ — wa-, and + ṣakkū, they slapped (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; ṣakka) + hu, him (object); 'and they slapped him'
احْمَرَّ: احْمَرَّ — iḥmarra, it turned red (Form IX perfect, 3rd m. sg.; of colours); 'turned red'
جِيعَانُ: جِيعَان — jīʿān, hungry (adj., m., Middle Arabic for Classical jāʾiʿ; here pointed as a diptote); 'hungry'
لِبَاكُونَ: لِ + بَاكُون — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed after qāla, 'said to') + Bākūn, the old slave-woman (proper n., gen.); 'to Bākūn'
غَيْرُهَا: غَيْر + هَا — ghayr, other than (m., nom., in construct) + hā, it, i.e. the tale (f.); 'another than it' Also of a person: ṣabiyyatun wa-lā ghayruhā, 'a girl, nor anyone other than her' (Night 188).
بِمَخَارِفِ: بِ + مَخَارِف — bi-, with (prep.; ḥaddatha bi-, the verb takes bi- for what is told: 'told with') + makhārif, fanciful tales, perhaps akin to khurāfa, 'fable' (pl., gen.; or a misprint for zakhārif); 'with fables'
حِكَايَاتٍ: حِكَايَات — ḥikāyāt, stories (f. pl., gen. in construct after makhārif); 'of stories'
وَنَوَادِرَ: وَ + نَوَادِر — wa-, and + nawādir, anecdotes, rare things (pl. of nādira; gen., diptote); 'and anecdotes'
مُضْحِكَاتٍ: مُضْحِكَات — muḍḥikāt, comic, making laugh (act. part., f. pl., gen., adj. of nawādir); 'comic'
رَاسِهِ: رَاس + هِ — rās, head (m., gen. after ʿinda; without hamza, for Classical raʾs) + hi, his; 'his head'
غَالِبُ: غَالِب — ghālib, most, the greater part (act. part. of ghalaba, m., nom., in construct with al-layl); 'most of'
انْتِهَازِ: انْتِهَاز — intihāz, seizing (verbal n., Form VIII, m., gen. in construct after waqt); 'seizing'
وَسَلَّتِ: وَ + سَلَّتِ — wa-, and + sallat(i), she drew (a blade) (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; sallat with the kasra of meeting al-); 'and she drew'
الْخَنْجَرَ: الْ + خَنْجَر — al-, the + khanjar, dagger (m., acc., object of sallat); 'the dagger'
ذَبْحَهُ: ذَبْح + هُ — dhabḥ, slaughtering, cutting the throat (verbal n., m., acc., object of arādat) + hu, his, i.e. of him; 'to cut his throat'
رَأَتْهَا: رَأَتْ + هَا — raʾat, she saw (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; Bākūn is the subject) + hā, her (object); 'she saw her'
وَاسْتَقْبَلَتْهَا: وَ + اسْتَقْبَلَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + istaqbalat, she went to meet (Form X perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + hā, her (object); 'and went to meet her'
تَنْتَفِضُ: تَنْتَفِضُ — tantafiḍu, she shakes, trembles (Form VII imperfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'trembling'
الْحُمَّى: الْ + حُمَّى — al-, the + ḥummā, fever (f., nom., subject of akhadhat); 'the fever'
وَنَبَّهَتْ: وَ + نَبَّهَتْ — wa-, and + nabbahat, she woke (Form II perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and she woke'
مَجِيئَهَا: مَجِيء + هَا — majīʾ, coming (verbal n., m., acc., predicate of kāna) + hā, her; 'her coming'
وَالِاتِّفَاقَ: وَ + الِاتِّفَاق — wa-, and + al-, the + ittifāq, agreement, plot (verbal n., Form VIII, m., acc., coordinated with al-ḥadīth; the object of samiʿat); 'and the agreement'
الْحَقِي: الْحَقِي — ilḥaqī, overtake, reach in time (Form I imperative, 2nd f. sg.; laḥiqa); 'go quickly to'
تَقْتُلَهُ: تَقْتُلَ + هُ — taqtula, she kills (imperfect, 3rd f. sg., subjunctive after an) + hu, him (object); 'she kills him'
تَعْقِلُ: تَعْقِلُ — taʿqilu, she reasons, has her wits (imperfect, 3rd f. sg.; ʿaqala; with lā, 'she did not reason'); 'beside herself'
وَلَاتَنْتَظِرُ: وَ + لَا + تَنْتَظِرُ — wa-, and + lā, not (neg.) + tantaẓiru, she waits (imperfect, 3rd f. sg.; Form VIII); the print runs it together; 'and waiting for nothing'
اسْتَيْقَظَهُ: اسْتَيْقَظَ + هُ — istayqaẓahu: istayqaẓa, he woke up (Form X perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, him; an odd form kept as printed, read as 'he woke' (or ayqaẓathu, 'she woke him'); 'when he was awake'
وَدَادَتِي: وَ + دَادَة + ي — wa-, and (circumstantial) + dāda, nanny, nurse (f.; Persian dāya) + ī, my; 'and my nanny'
حَدَّثْتِنِي: حَدَّثْتِ + نِي — ḥaddathti, you told (perfect, 2nd f. sg.; Form II ḥaddatha) + nī, me (object); the verb takes bi- before what is told; 'you told me'
مَاحَدَّثْتُكَ: مَا + حَدَّثْتُ + كَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + ḥaddathtu, I told (perfect, 1st sg.) + ka, you (object); the print runs it together; 'what I told you'
أَحْكِيهِ: أَحْكِي + هِ — aḥkī, I tell, relate (imperfect, 1st sg., serving as a future; ḥakā) + hi, it (object); 'I will tell it'
وَلَمَحَتْ: وَ + لَمَحَتْ — wa-, and + lamaḥat, she glimpsed, sensed (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; lamaḥa); 'and she sensed'
بِمَكْرِهَا: بِ + مَكْر + هَا — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument: 'with her cunning') + makr, cunning, guile (m., gen.) + hā, her; 'with her cunning'
نَجَّاكَ: نَجَّا + كَ — najjā, he rescued, delivered (perfect, 3rd m. sg.; Form II; God is the subject) + ka, you (object); 'delivered you'
لَايَمُوتُ: لَا + يَمُوتُ — lā, not (neg.) + yamūtu, he dies (imperfect, 3rd m. sg.; māta); the print runs it together; 'he will not die'
الْأَحْوَطُ: الْ + أَحْوَط — al-, the + aḥwaṭ, most prudent, safest (elative, m., nom., predicate); 'the safest course'
الْحَيَّ: الْ + حَيّ — al-, the + ḥayy, living, alive (adj. used as n., m., acc. after inna); 'the living man' (one whose time has not come)
أَوْجَبَتْ: أَوْجَبَتْ — awjabat, it made necessary, obliged (Form IV perfect, 3rd f. sg., agreeing with umūr, 'things'); 'obliged'
خُرُوجَ: خُرُوج — khurūj, going out, leaving (verbal n., m., acc., object of awjabat; in construct with Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'the leaving'
فَاجْتَمَعَتْ: فَ + اجْتَمَعَتْ — fa-, and so + ijtamaʿat, she joined, met (Form VIII perfect, 3rd f. sg.; the subject is Nuzhat al-Zamān); 'and she joined'
دَوْلَةِ: دَوْلَة — dawla, state, dominion, regime (f., gen., in construct after arbāb); 'the state (of King Sāsān)'
يَمِيلُونَ: يَمِيلُونَ — mālā, to incline, lean (to a side); imperfect 3rd m. pl. indicative; the verb takes ilā, 'to'; 'who inclined (towards them)'
يُدَبِّرُونَ: يُدَبِّرُونَ — dabbara, to plan, contrive (form II); imperfect 3rd m. pl. indicative, circumstantial 'devising'; 'planning'
فَأَجْمَعَ: فَ + أَجْمَعَ — fa-, so, and so + ajmaʿa, to be agreed, unanimous (form IV); perfect 3rd m. sg., with subject raʾyuhum (Middle Arabic for ajmaʿū ʿalā); 'so (their opinion) was united'
وَوَقَعُوا: وَ + وَقَعُوا — wa-, and + waqaʿa, to fall (into); perfect 3rd m. pl.; 'and they fell (into captivity)'
رُومْزَانَ: رُومْزَان — Rūmzān, king of the Rūm, brother of Sharrukān (proper n., gen., diptote -a shown in construct after al-malik)
شَرْحُهَا: شَرْح + هَا — sharḥ, explanation, telling (m., nom., subject of yaṭūlu) + hā, their (the matters'); 'their telling'
السِّيَاقِ: السِّيَاق — al-siyāq, the sequence, course (of the story) (m., gen. after min); 'the course (of the story)'
أُمُورٍ: أُمُور — umūr, matters, affairs, events (pl. of amr; m., gen., indefinite, after baʿda); 'events'
رُومْزَانُ: رُومْزَان — Rūmzān, king of the Rūm, brother of Sharrukān (proper n., nom., diptote)
وَجَمَاعَتُهُمَا: وَ + جَمَاعَة + هُمَا — wa-, and + jamāʿa, company, party (f., nom.) + humā, their (the two, Sharrukān and Dandān's); 'and their party'
وَاطْمَأَنُّوا: وَ + اطْمَأَنُّوا — wa-, and + iṭmaʾanna, to be at ease, calm, reassured (form IQ); perfect 3rd m. pl.; 'and they were reassured'
أَيْقَنُوا: أَيْقَنُوا — ayqana, to be certain, be convinced (form IV); perfect 3rd m. pl.; the verb takes bi- of the thing; 'they were certain'
الْمَوَائِدِ: الْ + مَوَائِد — al-, the + mawāʾid, tables, spread tables (pl. of māʾida; f., gen.); 'the tables'
