اطْمَأَنُّوا: اطْمَأَنُّوا — iṭmaʾanna, to be at ease, calm, reassured (form IQ); perfect 3rd m. pl.; 'they were reassured'
وَقَصَصْتُهُ: وَ + قَصَصْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + qaṣṣa, to relate, recount (perfect 1st sg.) + hu, it (the dream); 'and I told it'
يُفَسِّرُهُ: يُفَسِّر + هُ — fassara, to interpret, explain (form II); imperfect 3rd m. sg. + hu, it (the dream); 'interprets it'
أَقْوَامًا: أَقْوَامًا — aqwām, peoples, folk (pl. of qawm; m., acc., indefinite, the noun after kaʾanna); 'people'
يُعَذِّبُونَنِي: يُعَذِّب + ُونَ + نِي — ʿadhdhaba, to torment (form II); imperfect 3rd m. pl. indicative + nī, me (object); 'were tormenting me'
بِئْرٍ: بِئْر — biʾr, well, pit (f., gen., indefinite, in construct-like phrase after ṣifa); 'a well'
الْقِيَامَ: الْ + قِيَام — al-, the + qiyām, rising, getting up (verbal noun of qāma; m., acc., object of aradtu); 'the rising'; here: object of arādat, 'rising'
نَهَضْتُ: نَهَضْتُ — nahaḍa, to rise, get up; perfect 1st sg.; 'I got up'
مِنْطَقَةً: مِنْطَقَةً — minṭaqa, belt, girdle (f., acc., indefinite, object of raʾaytu); 'a belt'
لِآخُذَهَا: لِ + آخُذَ + هَا — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive, expressing purpose) + ākhudha, I take (akhadha, imperfect 1st sg. subjunctive) + hā, it (the belt); 'in order to take it'
رَفَعْتُهَا: رَفَعْتُ + هَا — rafaʿa, to lift, raise; perfect 1st sg. + hā, it (the belt); 'I lifted it'
مِنْطَقَتَيْنِ: مِنْطَقَتَيْنِ — minṭaqa, belt, girdle (f.); dual acc., second object of raʾaytuhā; 'two belts'
وَسَطِي: وَسَط + ِي — wasaṭ, middle, waist (m., acc., object of shadadtu) + ī, my; 'my waist'
صَارَتَا: صَارَتَا — ṣāra, to become; perfect 3rd f. dual (agrees with the two belts); 'the two had become'
الَذِيذِ: الَذِيذِ — a doubtful form kept as printed: read as ladhīdh, sweet, delightful (adj., gen.), with the alif taken as stray, or perhaps a misprint for aladhdh, 'sweetest'; 'the sweetest (of my dreams)'
أَحْلَامِي: أَحْلَام + ِي — aḥlām, dreams (pl. of ḥulm; m., gen., after ladhīdh) + ī, my; 'my dreams'
رُؤْيَاكَ: رُؤْيَا + كَ — ruʾyā, vision, dream (f., nom., subject of tadullu; the print's misprint روباك corrected) + ka, your; 'your dream'
وَلَحْمِكَ: وَ + لَحْم + كَ — wa-, and + laḥm, flesh (m., gen., in construct, parallel to dam) + ka, your; 'and your flesh'
الْعَصَبِ: الْ + عَصَب — al-, the + ʿaṣab, the kin through the male line, agnates (m., gen. after min); also 'sinews'; 'the paternal kin'
أَخٍ: أَخ — akh, brother (m., gen., in construct after ibn); 'brother (a brother's son)'
دَمِكَ: دَم + كَ — dam, blood (m., gen., after min) + ka, your; 'your blood'
الْأُسَارَى: الـ + أُسَارَى — al-usārā, the captives, prisoners (pl. of asīr); 'the captives'
بِهَلَاكِ: بِ + هَلَاك — bi-, by, at, through (prep., giving the cause: 'at the death of') + halāk, perishing, death (verbal noun of halaka; m., gen., in construct); 'at the death of'
أَصْحَابِهِمْ: أَصْحَاب + هِمْ — aṣḥāb, companions, comrades (pl. of ṣāḥib; m., gen., in construct) + him, their; 'their comrades'
اسْتَدْعَى: اسْتَدْعَى — istadʿā, to summon, call for (form X); perfect 3rd m. sg.; the verb takes bi- of the one sent for; 'he summoned'
بِالسَّيَّافِ: بِ + الـ + سَيَّاف — bi-, for (prep., chosen by istadʿā, 'call for') + al-sayyāf, the swordsman, executioner (m., gen.); 'for the executioner'
صَمَّمَ: صَمَّمَ — ṣammama, to be firmly resolved (form II); perfect 3rd m. sg.; takes ʿalā of the thing; 'he made up his mind'
بِدَايَةِ: بِ + دَايَة — bi-, marks the one who appears after wa-idhā, 'and behold' (not translated) + dāya, nurse, nanny (f., gen., in construct after bi-); 'behold, the nurse (of the king)'
فَنَقْتُلُ: فَ + نَقْتُلُ — fa-, and so, then + qatala, to kill; imperfect 1st pl. indicative; 'and we kill'
وَنَهْزِمُ: وَ + نَهْزِمُ — wa-, and + hazama, to rout, defeat; imperfect 1st pl. indicative; 'and we rout'
الْبَاقِى: الْبَاقِي — al-bāqī, the remaining (active participle of baqiya; m., acc., object of nahzimu; the print writes the yāʾ dotless); 'the remainder'
أَحْمِلُ: أَحْمِلُ — ḥamala, to charge, bear down (on) (takes ʿalā); imperfect 1st sg. indicative; 'I charge'
وَقْعَةَ: وَقْعَة — waqʿa, battle, engagement (f., acc., predicate of takūnu, in construct before al-infiṣāl); 'the battle (of the parting)'
يَحْدُثَ: يَحْدُثَ — ḥadatha, to happen, occur; imperfect 3rd m. sg. subjunctive (after qabla an); 'happens'
دَايَتُهُ: دَايَة + هُ — dāya, nurse, nanny (f., nom., subject of samiʿat) + hu, his; 'his nurse'
تَقْتُلَ: تَقْتُلَ — qatala, to kill; imperfect 2nd m. sg. subjunctive (after an); 'you kill'; also: 3fs subjunctive after an: khashiya an taqtula nafsahā, 'he feared she would kill herself' (Night 179)
دَايَتِهِ: دَايَة + هِ — dāya, nurse, nanny (f., gen., after min) + hi, his; 'his nurse'
الْخَرَزَهَ: الْ + خَرَزَة — al-, the + kharaza, bead, jewel (f., acc., in apposition to hādhihi; the print writes final hāʾ for tāʾ marbūṭa); 'the bead'
لِأَبِيكَ: لِ + أَب + ِيك — li-, belonging to (prep., of possession: 'was for / belonged to') + ab, father (m., gen., long form abī) + ka, your; 'belonged to your father'
لَاتَصْدُقِينِي: لَا + تَصْدُقِينِي — lā, not + ṣadaqa, to tell the truth to (takes a direct object); imperfect 2nd f. sg. + nī, me; Middle Arabic form lacking the -na (Classical taṣduqīnanī); 'you do not tell me the truth'
وَأَعْطَيْتِنِي: وَ + أَعْطَيْتِ + نِي — wa-, and + aʿṭā, to give (form IV); perfect 2nd f. sg. + nī, me (indirect object); 'and you gave me'
وَقُلْتِ: وَ + قُلْتِ — wa-, and + qāla, to say; perfect 2nd f. sg.; 'and you said'
فَلِمَ: فَ + لِ + مَ — fa-, so, then + li-, for (prep., 'for what?') + ma, what (interrogative, alif dropped after a preposition); 'so why'
وَشَأْنُكَ: وَ + شَأْن + كَ — wa-, and + shaʾn, case, matter, fortune (m., nom., coordinated with shaʾnī) + ka, your; 'and your case'
وَأَمْرُكَ: وَ + أَمْر + كَ — wa-, and + amr, affair, matter (m., nom.) + ka, your; 'and your affair'
وَشَجَاعَتُهَا: وَ + شَجَاعَة + هَا — wa-, and + shajāʿa, courage, bravery (f., nom., subject of tuḍrabu) + hā, her; 'and her courage'
وَاشْتَهَرَتْ: وَ + اشْتَهَرَتْ — wa-, and + ishtahara, to become famous (form VIII); perfect 3rd f. sg. (subject Abrīza); 'and she became famous'
بِالشَّجَاعَةِ: بِ + الـ + شَجَاعَة — bi-, for (prep., chosen by ishtahara, 'become famous for') + al-shajāʿa, the courage (f., gen.); 'for courage'
تُضْرَبُ: تُضْرَبُ — ḍaraba, to strike; passive imperfect 3rd f. sg.; with al-amthāl, 'proverbs are struck' (made, coined) about it; 'are struck / are told'
الْأَمْثَالُ: الْ + أَمْثَال — al-, the + amthāl, proverbs, similes (pl. of mathal; m., nom., subject of tuḍrabu); 'the proverbs'
وَلَارَيْبٍ: وَ + لَا + رَيْب — wa-, and + lā, no (negating) + rayb, doubt, suspicion (m., gen., indefinite after min ghayri shakk); 'and without suspicion'
وَلَارَجْمِ: وَ + لَا + رَجْم — wa-, and + lā, no + rajm, casting, guessing (verbal noun of rajama; m., gen., in construct before ghayb); 'and no guesswork'
غَيْبٍ: غَيْب — ghayb, the unseen, hidden (m., gen., in construct after rajm); 'the unseen'
قَدْأَرْسَلَ: قَدْ + أَرْسَلَ — qad, had (with the perfect, after kāna: pluperfect) + arsala, to send (form IV); perfect 3rd m. sg.; 'he had sent'
قَدْكَانَ: قَدْ + كَانَ — qad, (with the perfect) + kāna, to be, happen; perfect 3rd m. sg.; 'had been, had happened'
وَانْفَرَدَ: وَ + انْفَرَدَ — wa-, and + infarada, to be alone, go off alone, separate (form VII); perfect 3rd m. sg.; takes ʿan of what one leaves; 'and he went off alone'
فَصَادَفَنَا: فَ + صَادَفَ + نَا — fa-, and so + ṣādafa, to come upon by chance (form III); perfect 3rd m. sg. + nā, us (object); 'and he came upon us'
فَتَصَارَعَ: فَ + تَصَارَعَ — fa-, and then + taṣāraʿa, to wrestle (form VI); perfect 3rd m. sg.; 'and he wrestled'
وَغَلَبَتْهُ: وَ + غَلَبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + ghalaba, to overcome; perfect 3rd f. sg. (Abrīza) + hu, him (Sharrukān); 'and she overcame him'
لِبَاهِرِ: لِ + بَاهِر — li-, because of, by reason of (prep., giving the cause) + bāhir, dazzling, overpowering (active participle of bahara; m., gen., in construct before ḥusnihā); 'because of the dazzling (of her beauty)'
وَشَجَاعَتِهَا: وَ + شَجَاعَة + ِ + هَا — wa-, and + shajāʿa, courage (f., gen., coordinated with ḥusnihā) + hā, her; 'and her courage'
اسْتَضَافَتْهُ: اسْتَضَافَتْ + هُ — istaḍāfa, to take as a guest, entertain (form X; a later usage); perfect 3rd f. sg. + hu, him; 'she hosted him'
أُمُّكَ: أُمّ + كَ — umm, mother (f., nom., subject of istaḍāfat) + ka, your; 'your mother'
الْمُلَقَّبَةِ: الْ + مُلَقَّبَة — al-, the + mulaqqaba, surnamed, nicknamed (passive participle of laqqaba, form II; f., gen., adj. of Shawāhī); takes bi- of the nickname; 'the one surnamed'
بِذَاتِ: بِ + ذَات — bi-, by, with (prep., chosen by mulaqqaba: 'surnamed with') + dhāt, owner of, she of (f., gen., in construct before al-dawāhī); 'with (the name) Dhāt (al-Dawāhī)'
الدَّوَاهِي: الدَّوَاهِي — al-dawāhī, the calamities, disasters (pl. of dāhiya; f., gen., in construct after dhāt); 'the Calamities'; in Dhāt al-Dawāhī, nickname of Shawāhī, grandmother of Abrīza
قَدْأَسْلَمَتْ: قَدْ + أَسْلَمَتْ — qad, had (with the perfect) + aslama, to become Muslim (form IV); perfect 3rd f. sg.; 'had become Muslim'
أُمُّكَ: أُمّ + كَ — umm, mother (f., nom., subject of aslamat) + ka, your; 'your mother'
وَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَ — wa-, and + tawajjaha, to head, set off (form V); perfect 3rd m. sg. (Sharrukān); takes ilā of the destination; 'and he headed'
سِرًّا: سِرًّا — sirr, secret (m., acc., indefinite; adverbial accusative); 'secretly, in secret'
أَسْلَمْنَا: أَسْلَمْنَا — aslama, to become Muslim (form IV); perfect 1st pl.; 'we had become Muslim'
وَكُنَّا: وَ + كُنَّا — wa-, and + kāna, to be; perfect 1st pl. (with qad aslamnā: 'had'); 'and we were'
كُلُّنَا: كُلّ + نَا — kull, all, every (m., nom., in apposition to the subject, emphatic) + nā, our; 'all of us'
أُمَّكَ: أُمّ + كَ — umm, mother (f., acc., object of ra'ā) + ka, your; 'your mother'
مَحَبَّتُهَا: مَحَبَّة + هَا — maḥabba, love (f., nom., subject of waqaʿa) + hā, of her; 'love of her'
فَحَمَلَتْ: فَ + حَمَلَتْ — fa-, and so + ḥamala, to conceive, become pregnant (the bi- of bika marks the child); perfect 3rd f. sg.; 'and she conceived'
فَأَعْطَتْهُمْ: فَ + أَعْطَتْ + هُمْ — fa-, and so + aʿṭā, to give (form IV); perfect 3rd f. sg. + hum, them (the beads); 'and she gave them'
أُمِّكَ: أُمّ + ِ + كَ — umm, mother (f., gen., after maʿa) + ka, your; 'your mother'
الثَّانِيَةَ: الثَّانِيَة — al-thāniya, the second (ordinal; f., acc., object of aʿṭā); 'the second (bead)'
الثَّالِثَةَ: الثَّالِثَة — al-thālitha, the third (ordinal; f., acc., object of aʿṭā); 'the third (bead)'
وَحَفِظَتْهَا: وَ + حَفِظَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + ḥafiẓa, to keep, guard; perfect 3rd f. sg. + hā, it (the bead); 'and she kept it'
وَأَطْلَعَتْنِى: وَ + أَطْلَعَتْ + نِي — wa-, and + aṭlaʿa, to let see into, acquaint (form IV); perfect 3rd f. sg. + nī, me; takes ʿalā of the matter; 'and she let me into'
وِلَادَتُهَا: وِلَادَة + هَا — wilāda, giving birth, childbirth (f., nom., subject of qarubat) + hā, her; 'her giving birth'
وَرَغَّبَتْهُ: وَ + رَغَّبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + raghghaba, to make eager (form II); perfect 3rd f. sg. + hu, him; takes fī of the thing desired; 'and she made him keen'
فَأَخَذَنَا: فَ + أَخَذَ + نَا — fa-, and so + akhadha, to take; perfect 3rd m. sg. + nā, us (object, not subject); 'and he took us'
مُنْقَطِعٍ: مُنْقَطِع — munqaṭiʿ, cut off, remote (active participle of inqaṭaʿa; m., gen., adj. of makān); 'cut off, lonely'
بِوِلَادَتِكَ: بِ + وِلَادَة + كَ — bi-, with, in the matter of (prep., with the labour pains: 'in giving birth to you') + wilāda, giving birth (f., gen.) + ka, your; 'with your birth'
الطَّلْقُ: الطَّلْق — al-ṭalq, labour pains, childbirth (m., nom., subject of akhadha, placed after its object); 'the labour pains'
فَحَدَّثَ: فَ + حَدَّثَ — fa-, and so + ḥaddatha, to speak to (form II); perfect 3rd m. sg.; in ḥaddatha nafsahu bi-, 'toy with the thought of'; 'and he talked (to himself)'
بِالْخَنَا: بِ + الـ + خَنَا — bi-, about (prep., chosen by ḥaddatha nafsahu, 'toy with the idea of') + al-khanā, obscenity, foul conduct (m., gen.); 'of filth'
رَاوَدَهَا: رَاوَدَ + هَا — rāwada, to solicit, try to entice (form III); perfect 3rd m. sg. + hā, her; takes ʿan of what he sought; 'he tried to entice her'
الْفَاحِشَةِ: الْ + فَاحِشَة — al-, the + fāḥisha, indecency, lewdness (active participle used as noun; f., gen. after ʿan); 'the indecency'
وَانْزَعَجَتْ: وَ + انْزَعَجَتْ — wa-, and + inzaʿajat, to be alarmed, frightened (form VII); perfect 3rd f. sg.; 'and she was alarmed'
انْزِعَاجِهَا: انْزِعَاج + ِ + هَا — inziʿāj, alarm, fright (verbal noun of form VII; m., gen., in construct) + hā, her; 'her alarm'
وَضَعَتْكَ: وَضَعَتْ + كَ — waḍaʿa, to put down, give birth to; perfect 3rd f. sg. + ka, you (object); 'she bore you'
الْبَرِّمِنْ: الْبَرّ + مِنْ — al-barr, the open country, land (m., gen., after fī) run together with min, from (prep.); the print joins two words; 'in the open country, from'
السَّاعَةِ: الـ + سَاعَة — al-sāʿa, the hour, time (f., gen., after fī tilka); 'the hour'
سَدَّ: سَدَّ — sadda, to block, shut off; perfect 3rd m. sg. (subject the dust); 'it blocked'
فَخَشِيَ: فَ + خَشِيَ — fa-, and so + khashiya, to fear; perfect 3rd m. sg.; takes ʿalā of the one feared for; 'and he feared'
الْهَلَاكَ: الْ + هَلَاك — al-, the + halāk, perishing, destruction, death (m., acc., object of khashiya); 'death'
شِدَّةِ: شِدَّة — shidda, intensity, violence (f., gen., after min, in construct before ghayẓihi); 'the violence (of his rage)'
مَارَاحَ: مَا + رَاحَ — mā, (after baʿda) that, when (conjunction, 'after') + rāḥa, to go off, depart; perfect 3rd m. sg.; colloquial flavour; 'after (the slave) went off'
قَتِيلَةٌ: قَتِيلَة — qatīla, slain (f., nom., indefinite; predicate/circumstantial of the woman he saw, 'she slain'); 'slain'
جَدِيلَةٌ: جَدِيلَة — jadīla, one thrown down, cast on the ground (f., nom. indef.; from jadala, to fling down); 'cast down'
جَدِّكَ: جَدّ + كَ — jadd, grandfather (m., gen., after ʿan 'from/of') + ka, your; 'your grandfather'
الرُّومِ: الـ + رُّوم — al-, the + Rūm, the Rūm, the Byzantines, Romans (proper n., gen., in construct after malik); 'the Rūm'
الْأَوَّلِ: الـ + أَوَّل — al-, the + awwal, first, beginning (m., gen., after min); 'the beginning'
احْتَمَلْنَا: احْتَمَلَ — iḥtamala, to lift up, carry off (Form VIII perfect, 1st pl.) + nā, we; 'we took up'
احْتَمَلْتُكَ: احْتَمَلَ + تُ + كَ — iḥtamala, to carry off (Form VIII perfect, 1st sg.) + tu, I + ka, you (obj.); 'I carried you away'
وَرَبَّيْتُكَ: وَ + رَبَّى + تُ + كَ — wa-, and + rabbā, to bring up, rear (Form II perfect, 1st sg.) + tu, I + ka, you (obj.); 'and I brought you up'
وَدَفَنَّاهَا: وَ + دَفَنَ + نَا + هَا — wa-, and + dafana, to bury (perfect, 1st pl.) + nā, we + hā, her (obj.); 'and we buried her'
وَعَلَّقْتُ: وَ + عَلَّقَ + تُ — wa-, and + ʿallaqa, to hang, suspend (Form II perfect, 1st sg.) + tu, I; 'and I hung' (laka, on you, follows)
لَثَارَتْ: لَـ + ثَارَ + تْ — la-, indeed (apodosis particle after lau, 'if', marking the consequence) + thāra, to rise, break out (perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'would have broken out'
كَبِرْتَ: كَبِرَ + تَ — kabira, to grow old, grow up (perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'you grew up'
وَبَلَغْتَ: وَ + بَلَغَ + تَ — wa-, and + balagha, to reach, attain (perfect, 2nd m. sg.); 'and you reached' (manhood)
الرِّجَالِ: الـ + رِّجَال — al-, the + rijāl, men (m. pl., gen., in construct after mablagh); 'of men, manhood'
لِأَنَّنِي: لِـ + أَنَّ + نِي — li-, for, because (prep., introducing the reason) + anna, that + nī, I (anna + 1st sg. pronoun, acc.); 'because I'
بَيْنَكُمُ: بَيْنَ + كُمُ — bayna, between (prep./adv., acc.) + kumu, you (m. pl., gen.; the -u is a support vowel before the next word's hamzat al-waṣl); 'between you'
الْحُرُوبُ: الـ + حُرُوب — al-, the + ḥurūb, wars (f. pl. of ḥarb, nom., subject of thārat); 'the wars'
مُخَالَفَةِ: مُخَالَفَة — mukhālafa, opposing, going against (verbal noun of Form III khālafa, f., gen., in construct after ʿalā); 'going against'
جَدُّكَ: جَدّ + كَ — jadd, grandfather (m., nom., subject of amara) + ka, your; 'your grandfather'
قُدْرَةَ: قُدْرَة — qudra, power, ability (f., acc., after lā of total negation, 'no power'); 'power'
إِعْلَامِكَ: إِعْلَام + كَ — iʿlām, informing (verbal noun of Form IV aʿlama, m., gen., in construct after ʿadam) + ka, you (obj.); 'informing you'
كِتْمَانِ: كِتْمَان — kitmān, concealment, keeping secret (verbal noun of katama, m., gen., in construct after sabab); 'concealment'
بِأَنَّ: بِـ + أَنَّ — bi-, of, about (prep.; the verbal noun iʿlām 'informing' takes its content with bi-) + anna, that; 'of the fact that'
اسْتَقَلَّيْتَ: اسْتَقَلَّ + يْتَ — istaqalla, to rule alone, hold independently (Form X perfect, here 2nd m. sg. in the Middle Arabic shape istaqallayta for Classical istaqlalta); 'you took sole charge'
وَالْبُرْهَانَ: وَ + الـ + بُرْهَان — wa-, and + al-, the + burhān, proof, evidence (m., acc., object of kashaftu); 'and the proof'
مَاعِنْدِي: مَا + عِنْد + ي — mā, what (rel. pron.; printed joined to the next word) + ʿind, at, with, in the possession of (prep./noun, nom.) + ī, my; 'what I have'; here: mā is the negative 'not', not the relative: māʿindī ghayru jāriyatin, 'I have none but a slave-woman'
بِرَأْيِكَ: بِـ + رَأْي + كَ — bi-, by, by means of (prep.) + raʾy, opinion, judgement (m., gen.) + ka, your; 'by your own judgement'
السِّرَّ: الـ + سِّرّ — al-, the + sirr, secret (m., acc., object of kashaftu); 'the secret'
أَخْبَرُ: أَخْبَر — akhbar, better informed, knowing more (elative of khabīr, 'well-informed', m., nom. indef., predicate of anta); 'better informed'
دَايَةِ: دَايَة — dāya, nurse, wet-nurse (f., gen., in construct, apposition to Marjāna); 'nurse'
الْحِدَّةُ: الـ + حِدَّة — al-, the + ḥidda, sharpness, agitation, heat of temper (f., nom., subject of akhadhat-hu); 'the agitation'
لِلدَّمِ: لِـ + الـ + دَّم — li-, for, to (prep.; ḥanna li- 'to yearn for' takes its object with li-) + al-, the + damm, blood (m., gen.); 'for blood'
وَاسْتَخْبَرَهَا: وَ + اسْتَخْبَرَ + هَا — wa-, and + istakhbara, to ask for news, ask to tell (Form X perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hā, her (obj.); 'and he asked her'
فَوَافَقَ: فَ + وَافَقَ — fa-, and so, then + wāfaqa, to agree with, match (Form III perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'and so it agreed with'
فَصَحَّ: فَ + صَحَّ — fa-, so, then + ṣaḥḥa, to be sound, be established as true (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'so it was established'
ارْتِيَابٍ: ارْتِيَاب — irtiyāb, doubt, misgiving (verbal noun of Form VIII irtāba, m., gen. indef., after lā in 'nor'); 'doubt'
كِتَافَ: كِتَاف — kitāf, bond, cord tying a captive's arms (m., acc., object of ḥalla, in construct); 'bonds' Also the clasp of the hands folded in respect (object of fakka): fakka kitāfa yadayhi, 'he unclasped his hands'.
فَقَدِمَتْ: فَ + قَدِمَ + تْ — fa-, and so, then + qadima, to come, arrive (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; takes ilā, to); 'and she came up'
لِبُكَائِهَا: لِـ + بُكَاء + هَا — li-, because of, at (prep., giving the cause of his weeping) + bukāʾ, weeping (m., gen.) + hā, her; 'because of her weeping, to see her weep'
حَنِيَّةُ: حَنِيَّة — ḥaniyya, tenderness, affection (f., nom., in construct, subject of akhadhat-hu; later word beside Classical ḥanān); 'tenderness'
الْأُخُوَّةِ: الـ + أُخُوَّة — al-, the + ukhuwwa, brotherhood (f., gen., in construct after ḥaniyya); 'of brotherhood'
نَاهِضًا: نَاهِض — nāhiḍ, rising, springing up (act. part. of nahaḍa, m., acc. indef., ḥāl, circumstantial); 'springing up'
وَثَاقَهُمْ: وَثَاق + هُمْ — wathāq, bond, fetters (m., acc., object of fakka) + hum, their; 'their bonds'
لِدَايَتِهِ: لِـ + دَايَة + هِ — li-, to (prep., after qāla 'said' marks the person addressed) + dāya, nurse (f., gen.) + hi, his; 'to his nurse'
اشْرَحِي: اشْرَحِي — ishraḥī, explain, lay out in full (imperative, f. sg., Form I sharaḥa; the -ī addresses Marjāna); 'explain!'
شَرَحْتِهِ: شَرَحْ + تِ + هِ — sharaḥa, to lay open, explain (perfect, 2nd f. sg.) + ti, you + hi, it (obj.; for Classical sharaḥtīhi); 'you explained it'
شَاهِدٍ: شَاهِد — shāhid, witness (m., gen. indef., in construct after akbar); 'witness'
حَقِيقَةَ: حَقِيقَة — ḥaqīqa, true state, reality (f., acc., object of yaʿrifu, in construct); 'the truth of'
حَضَرَهُمْ: حَضَرَ + هُمْ — ḥaḍara, to be present at, attend (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hum, them (obj.); 'who was present with them'
وَمُلُوكِ: وَ + مُلُوك — wa-, and + mulūk, kings (m. pl. of malik, gen., after min); 'and of the kings'
وَحَدَّثَتْهُمْ: وَ + حَدَّثَ + تْ + هُمْ — wa-, and + ḥaddatha, to tell, relate to (Form II perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + hum, them (obj.); 'and she told them'
يُصَدِّقُونَهَا: يُصَدِّقُ + ونَ + هَا — yuṣaddiqūna, to confirm, bear out (Form II imperfect, 3rd m. pl., ṣaddaqa) + hā, her (obj.); 'they bore her out'
رَفِيقَةَ: رَفِيقَة — rafīqa, companion, fellow, match (f., acc., in apposition to al-kharaza); 'the fellow'
فَعَرَفَتْهَا: فَ + عَرَفَ + تْ + هَا — fa-, and so + ʿarafa, to recognise, know (perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + hā, it (obj., the bead); 'and she recognised it'
دَوَى: دَوَى — dawā, to resound, ring out (perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'rang'
يَقِينِي: يَقِين + ي — yaqīn, certainty (m., gen., in construct after ṣidq) + ī, my; 'my certainty'
رَفِيقَتُهَا: رَفِيقَة + هَا — rafīqa, companion, fellow (f., nom., predicate) + hā, its; 'its fellow'
الْأَسِيرِ: الـ + أَسِير — al-, the + asīr, captive (m., gen., after hādhā); 'the captive'
نَظِيرُ: نَظِير — naẓīr, equal, counterpart, match (m., nom., predicate of inna's clause); 'the match of'
الْخَرَزَةِ: الـ + خَرَزَة — al-, the + kharaza, bead (f., gen., in construct after naẓīr); 'the bead'
وَضَعْتُهَا: وَضَعَ + تُ + هَا — waḍaʿa, to put, place (perfect, 1st sg.) + tu, I + hā, it (obj.); 'I put it'
عُنُقِكَ: عُنُق + كَ — ʿunuq, neck (m., gen., after fī) + ka, your; 'your neck'
الْأَسِيرُ: الـ + أَسِير — al-, the + asīr, captive (m., nom., subject, in apposition to hādhā); 'the captive'
فَنَزَعَهَا: فَ + نَزَعَ + هَا — fa-, and so, then + nazaʿa, to pull off, remove (perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hā, it (obj., the bead); 'and he drew it off'
وَنَاوَلَهَا: وَ + نَاوَلَ + هَا — wa-, and + nāwala, to hand over (Form III perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hā, it (obj.); 'and he handed it'
لِتِلْكَ: لِـ + تِلْكَ — li-, to (prep.; the recipient of nāwala, in spoken usage where Classical gives the person directly) + tilka, that (f. demonstrative, gen.); 'to that woman'
الْخَرَزَتَانِ: الـ + خَرَزَتَانِ — al-, the + kharazatāni, the two beads (f. dual nom., subject of ṣāra; kharaza, bead); 'the two beads'
وَالْبُرْهَانُ: وَ + الـ + بُرْهَان — wa-, and + al-, the + burhān, proof (m., nom., subject of ẓahara); 'and the proof'
عَمُّ: عَمّ — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., nom. in construct, predicate of anna); 'uncle of'
وَعَانَقَهُ: وَ + عَانَقَ + هُ — wa-, and + ʿānaqa, to embrace (Form III perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, him (obj.); 'and he embraced him'
عَانَقَ: عَانَقَ — ʿānaqa, to embrace (Form III perfect, 3rd m. sg.); 'embraced'
انْتَشَرَتِ: انْتَشَرَ + تِ — intashara, to spread abroad (Form VII perfect, 3rd f. sg.; the -ti is a support vowel before al-); 'spread'
وَالطُّبُولُ: وَ + الـ + طُّبُول — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭubūl, drums (m. pl. of ṭabl, nom., subject of duqqat); 'and the drums'
وَزُمِرَتِ: وَ + زُمِرَ + تِ — wa-, and + zumira, to be piped, be played on the reed pipe (passive perfect of zamara, 3rd f. sg.; -ti support vowel); 'and were played'
الزُّمُورُ: الـ + زُّمُور — al-, the + zumūr, reed pipes (m. pl. of zamr/zummāra, nom., subject of zumirat); 'the pipes'
وَزَادَتِ: وَ + زَادَ + تِ — wa-, and + zāda, to increase, grow (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; -ti support vowel); 'and grew'
وَالشَّامِ: وَ + الـ + شَّام — wa-, and + al-, the + Shām, Syria (proper n., gen., after ʿasākir al-ʿIrāq); 'and Syria'
ضَجِيجَ: ضَجِيج — ḍajīj, uproar, clamour (m., acc., object of samiʿa, in construct); 'the uproar of'
بِالْأَفْرَاحِ: بِـ + الـ + أَفْرَاح — bi-, with, in (prep., of the rejoicing that accompanies the clamour) + al-, the + afrāḥ, joys, rejoicings (m. pl. of faraḥ, gen.); 'in rejoicing'
فَرَكِبُوا: فَ + رَكِبُ + وا — fa-, and so, then + rakibū, to mount, ride (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; the final alif is silent); 'and they mounted'
عَوَّلُوا: عَوَّلُ + وا — ʿawwalū, to resolve upon, rely on (Form II perfect, 3rd m. pl.; ʿawwala ʿalā takes ʿalā); 'they were set upon'
وَمَقَامِ: وَ + مَقَام — wa-, and + maqām, place, standing-place (m., gen., in construct, coordinate with al-maydān after fī); 'and the place of'
فَرَآى: فَ + رَأَى — fa-, and so + raʾā, to see (perfect, 3rd m. sg.; the print spells it with a madda and final yāʾ, for رأى); 'and he saw'
وَلِلْحَرْبِ: وَ + لِـ + الـ + حَرْب — wa-, and + li-, for (prep., 'ready for') + al-, the + ḥarb, war (f./m., gen.); 'and for war'
مُتَهَيِّئِينَ: مُتَهَيِّئ + ينَ — mutahayyiʾ, getting ready, prepared (act. part. of Form V tahayyaʾa, m. pl. acc., ḥāl, circumstantial) ; 'making ready'
وَالْعِرَاقِ: وَ + الـ + عِرَاق — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿIrāq, Iraq (proper n., gen., in construct, after ʿasākir al-Shām); 'and Iraq'
وَتُعْلِمَهُمْ: وَ + تُعْلِمَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + tuʿlima, to inform (Form IV aʿlama, imperfect subjunctive, 2nd/3rd f. sg., governed by an) + hum, them (obj.); 'and tell them'
بِحُصُولِ: بِـ + حُصُول — bi-, of (prep.; aʿlama bi- 'to inform of' takes the thing told with bi-) + ḥuṣūl, occurring, coming about, achievement (verbal noun of ḥaṣala, m., gen.); 'of the coming about of'
تَسِيرَ: تَسِيرَ — tasīra, to go, travel (imperfect subjunctive, 3rd f. sg., after an; Form I sāra); 'that she go' Also 2ms subjunctive after an: fa-hal laka an tasīra maʿī, 'would you be willing to go with me'.
بِنَفْسِهَا: بِـ + نَفْس + هَا — bi-, in, by (prep.; with nafs, 'in her own person') + nafs, self (f., gen.) + hā, her; 'herself, in person'
وَنَفَتْ: وَ + نَفَ + تْ — wa-, and + nafā, to drive away, banish (perfect, 3rd f. sg.; ʿanhā 'from herself'); 'and she cast off'
الشُّرُورَ: الـ + شُّرُور — al-, the + shurūr, evils, troubles (m. pl. of sharr, acc., object of nafat); 'the evils'
عَمُّهَا: عَمّ + هَا — ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., nom., predicate in the anna-clause) + hā, her; 'her uncle'
وَعَمُّ: وَ + عَمّ — wa-, and + ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., nom., in construct with Kān Mā Kān, coordinate with ʿammuhā); 'and uncle of'
وَالْأَعْيَانِ: وَ + الـ + أَعْيَان — wa-, and + al-, the + aʿyān, notables, grandees (m. pl. of ʿayn, gen.); 'and the nobles'
فَشَرَحَتْ: فَ + شَرَحَ + تْ — fa-, and so, then + sharaḥat, to explain in full, lay out (perfect, 3rd f. sg.); 'and she explained'
أَفْرَاحُهُمْ: أَفْرَاح + هُمْ — afrāḥ, joys (m. pl. of faraḥ, nom., subject of zādat) + hum, their; 'their joys'
أَتْرَاحُهُمْ: أَتْرَاح + هُمْ — atrāḥ, griefs, sorrows (m. pl. of tarḥ, nom., subject of zālat; rhymes with afrāḥ) + hum, their; 'their sorrows'
أَوْصَلَتْهُمْ: أَوْصَلَ + تْ + هُمْ — awṣala, to bring to, convey (Form IV perfect, 3rd f. sg.) + hum, them (obj.); 'she brought them'
قُدَّامَهُمُ: قُدَّام + هُمُ — quddām, in front of, before (prep./adv., acc.) + humu, them (-u support vowel before al-); 'before them'
سُرَادِقِ: سُرَادِق — surādiq, pavilion, great tent (m., gen., in construct after ilā; Persian loanword); 'the pavilion of'
اسْتَشَارَهُ: اسْتَشَارَ + هُ — istashāra, to consult, take counsel with (Form X perfect, 3rd m. sg.) + hu, him (obj.); 'he consulted him'
وَيَتْرُكُونَهُ: وَ + يَتْرُكُ + ونَ + هُ — wa-, and + yatrukūna, to leave, let be (imperfect, 3rd m. pl.; tarak) + hu, him (obj.); 'and leave him'
دِمَشْقِ: دِمَشْق — Dimashq, Damascus (proper n., city of Syria, gen., in construct before al-Shām); 'Damascus'
فَجَعَلُوا: فَ + جَعَلُ + وا — fa-, and so, then + jaʿalū, to make, appoint (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; takes two objects); 'so they made'
أَمَرُوهُ: أَمَرُ + وهُ — amarū, to order, command (perfect, 3rd m. pl.; amara takes bi- for the thing ordered) + hu, him (obj.); 'they bade him'
بِالتَّوَجُّهِ: بِـ + الـ + تَّوَجُّه — bi-, to (prep.; the verb amara chooses bi- for the thing ordered) + al-, the + tawajjuh, setting out, heading toward (verbal noun of Form V tawajjaha, m., gen.); 'to set out'
بِعَسَاكِرِهِ: بِـ + عَسَاكِر + هِ — bi-, with (prep., of accompaniment) + ʿasākir, armies, troops (m. pl. of ʿaskar, gen.) + hi, his; 'with his troops'
الْعَسْكَرَانِ: الـ + عَسْكَرَانِ — al-, the + ʿaskarāni, the two armies (m. dual nom., subject of ijtamaʿa; ʿaskar, army); 'the two armies'
غَيْظُنَا: غَيْظ + نَا — ghayẓ, rage, fury (m., nom., subject of yushfā) + nā, our; 'our rage'
بِالِانْتِقَامِ: بِـ + الـ + انْتِقَام — bi-, by means of (prep.) + al-, the + intiqām, vengeance (verbal noun of Form VIII intaqama, m., gen.; intaqama min 'take vengeance on'); 'by vengeance'
الْمُلَقَّبَةِ: الـ + مُلَقَّبَة — al-, the + mulaqqaba, nicknamed, surnamed (pass. part. of Form II laqqaba, f., gen., qualifying al-ʿajūz; takes bi- for the nickname); 'who is called'
بِعَمِّهِ: بِـ + عَمّ + هِ — bi-, in (prep.; fariḥa bi- 'to rejoice in/at' takes its object with bi-) + ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., gen.) + hi, his; 'in his uncle'
عَرَّفَتْهُمْ: عَرَّفَ + تْ + هُمْ — ʿarrafa, to make known, acquaint (Form II perfect, 3rd f. sg.; takes bi- for the person introduced) + hum, them (obj.); 'she made them known'
يَزَالُو: يَزَالُو — yazālū, to cease (jussive, 3rd m. pl., after lam, Form I zāla; the print omits the silent alif, Classical يزالوا); 'they ceased'
أَرْضِهِمْ: أَرْض + هِمْ — arḍ, land, country (f., gen., after ilā) + him, their; 'their country'
أُعَارِضَكَ: أُعَارِضَ + كَ — uʿāriḍa, to oppose, contend with (Form III imperfect subjunctive, 1st sg., after an) + ka, you (obj.); 'that I dispute with you'
وَكُلُّوَاحِدٍ: وَ + كُلّ + وَاحِد — wa-, and + kull, each, every (m., nom., in construct; printed joined) + wāḥid, one (m., gen.); 'and each one'
فَارْتَضَيَا: فَ + ارْتَضَ + يَا — fa-, and so, then + irtaḍayā, to be content with, accept (Form VIII perfect, 3rd m. dual; irtaḍā bi- takes bi-); 'and the two agreed'
الصَّاحِبَ: الـ + صَاحِب — al-ṣāḥib, 'the Ṣāḥib', a title of a vizier, 'His Excellency' (m., acc., in apposition after the vocative yā mawlānā); 'O our lord the Ṣāḥib'
أَوْلَمُوا: أَوْلَمُوا — awlama, to give a banquet (verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'they banqueted'
وَذَبَحُوا: وَ + ذَبَحُوا — wa-, and + dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they slaughtered'
الذَّبَائِحَ: الـ + ذَّبَائِح — dhabīḥa, slaughtered animal, sacrificial beast (f. pl. broken plural dhabāʾiḥ, acc., object of dhabaḥū); 'the slaughter-beasts'
بَيْنَمَاهُمْ: بَيْنَ + مَا + هُمْ — bayna, between/during + mā, (extending particle) + hum, they (3mp suffix); 'while they (were)', bayna-mā introducing a circumstantial clause
فَرْحَانُونَ: فَرْحَانُونَ — faraḥān, glad, rejoicing (adj., m. pl. nom., sound plural of the Middle Arabic type faraḥānūn for classical farḥānūn/farāḥā); 'glad'
الشَّأْنِ: الـ + شَّأْن — shaʾn, matter, affair (m. sg., gen., after a preposition); 'at this matter'
صَارِخٌ: صَارِخٌ — ṣārikh, one who cries out, crier (active participle of ṣarakha, verb I; m. sg. nom., indef.); 'a crier calling for help'
وَأُنْهَبُ: وَ + أُنْهَبُ — wa-, and + nahaba, to plunder (verb I, passive imperf. 1s, 'am plundered'); 'and am I plundered'
بِلَادُ: بِلَادُ — bilād, lands, country (f./m. pl., construct state, vocalised nom. as given where gen. is expected after fī 'in'; in the phrase 'lands of unbelief'); 'the lands of'; here: nom., predicate of hiya: wa-hiya bilādu al-maliki, 'and they are the lands of the king'
هْدَيْتُ: هْدَيْتُ — the second half of اهديت, which the print splits as قدا هديت: ahdā, to present as a gift (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'I had presented'
تُحَفِ: تُحَفِ — tuḥaf, rarities, choice gifts (f. pl. of tuḥfa, construct, gen., after min/of); 'rarities (of India)'
حَرَمُكُمْ: حَرَمُ + كُمْ — ḥaram, sanctuary, sacred precinct (m. sg., nom., predicate) + kum, your (2mp possessive suffix); 'your sanctuary'
وَمَحَلُّ: وَ + مَحَلُّ — wa-, and + maḥall, place, abode (m. sg., nom., construct); 'and the place of'
أَمْنِكُمْ: أَمْنِ + كُمْ — amn, security, safety (m. sg., gen., construct) + kum, your (2mp possessive); 'of your security'
وَعَدْلِكُمْ: وَ + عَدْلِ + كُمْ — wa-, and + ʿadl, justice (m. sg., gen., in apposition) + kum, your (2mp possessive); 'and your justice'
عُرْبَانٌ: عُرْبَانٌ — ʿurbān, Bedouins, Arabs of the desert (m. pl., collective/broken plural of ʿarabī, nom.); 'Bedouins'
أَكْرَادٌ: أَكْرَادٌ — akrād, Kurds (m. pl. of kurdī, nom.); 'Kurds'
مُجْتَمِعَةٌ: مُجْتَمِعَةٌ — mujtamiʿa, gathered, assembled (active participle of ijtamaʿa, verb VIII; f. sg. nom., agreeing with the collective 'Kurds'); 'gathered'
رِجَالِي: رِجَالِ + ي — rijāl, men (m. pl. broken plural of rajul, acc., object of qatalū) + ī, my (1s possessive); 'my men'
أَمْوَالِي: أَمْوَالِ + ي — amwāl, goods, wealth (m. pl. of māl, acc., object) + ī, my (1s possessive); 'my goods'
شَرْحُ: شَرْحُ — sharḥ, explanation, account (m. sg. verbal noun of sharaḥa, nom., construct); 'the account of (my state)'
وَحَوْقَلَ: وَ + حَوْقَلَ — wa-, and + ḥawqala, to say lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāh (quadriliteral verb, perf. 3ms, denominal from the formula); 'and he said the ḥawqala'
بِأُلُوفٍ: بِـ + أُلُوف — bi-, as/with (here: counted as, 'worth') + alf, thousand (m. pl. ulūf, gen., after bi-); 'as thousands'
يَدُلُّهُمْ: يَدُلُّ + هُمْ — dalla, to guide, show the way (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.; circumstantial clause) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'guiding them'
غَزِيرِ: غَزِيرِ — ghazīr, abundant, copious (adj., m. sg., gen., construct with 'streams'); 'abundant of (streams)'
وَقَسَمُوا: وَ + قَسَمُوا — wa-, and + qasama, to divide, share out (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they divided'
أَحْمَالَ: أَحْمَالَ — aḥmāl, loads, burdens (m. pl. of ḥiml, acc., object, construct); 'the loads of'
فَأَطْبَقَ: فَـ + أَطْبَقَ — fa-, so/then + aṭbaqa, to close in upon (verb IV, perf. 3ms, here 'the horsemen' treated as a collective, agrees singular); 'then (they) closed in'
أَوْبَاشِ: أَوْبَاشِ — awbāsh, riff-raff, rabble (m. pl. of awbāsh/wabsh, gen., construct after min); 'from the riff-raff of'
أَسَرُوهُمْ: أَسَرُوا + هُمْ — asara, to capture, take prisoner (verb I, perf. 3mp) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'they captured them'
عَرَضُوا: عَرَضُوا — ʿaraḍa, to parade, present for inspection (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'they paraded'
وَسَأَلَاهُمْ: وَ + سَأَلَا + هُمْ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3m dual, 'the two kings') + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'and the two asked them'
كِبَارِهِمْ: كِبَار + هِمْ — kibār, great ones, chiefs (m. pl. of kabīr, gen., after ʿan 'about') + him, their (3mp possessive); 'their great ones'
كِبَارٌ: كِبَارٌ — kibār, great ones, leaders (m. pl. of kabīr, nom., subject of laysa/mā li- 'we have no'); 'leaders'
أَشْخَاصٍ: أَشْخَاصٍ — ashkhāṣ, persons, individuals (m. pl. of shakhṣ, gen., after illā in the construct 'other than three persons'); 'persons'
جَمَعُونَا: جَمَعُوا + نَا — jamaʿa, to gather (verb I, perf. 3mp) + nā, us (1p object suffix); 'they gathered us'
وَالْأَقْطَارِ: وَ + الـ + أَقْطَار — wa-, and + al-, the + aqṭār, regions, quarters (m. pl. of quṭr, gen., coordinated with the preceding genitive); 'and the regions'
مَيِّزُوهُمْ: مَيِّزُوا + هُمْ — mayyaza, to distinguish, single out (verb II, imperative 2mp) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'pick them out'
بِأَعْيَانِهِمْ: بِـ + أَعْيَان + هِمْ — bi-, by/with, (marks the means) + aʿyān, persons themselves, selves (m. pl. of ʿayn, gen.) + him, their (3mp possessive); 'by their very selves'
فَمَيَّزُوهُمْ: فَـ + مَيَّزُوا + هُمْ — fa-, so/then + mayyaza, to distinguish, single out (verb II, perf. 3mp) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'so they picked them out'
فَأَمَرَا: فَـ + أَمَرَا — fa-, so/then + amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3m dual, 'the two kings'; the verb takes bi- for the thing commanded, here 'bi-l-qabḍ'); 'and the two commanded'
بِالْقَبْضِ: بِـ + الـ + قَبْض — bi-, (the preposition governed by amara, 'command (someone) to do') + al-, the + qabḍ, seizing, arrest (m. sg. verbal noun of qabaḍa, gen.); 'to the seizing'
وَإِطْلَاقِ: وَ + إِطْلَاقِ — wa-, and + iṭlāq, releasing, setting free (m. sg. verbal noun of form IV aṭlaqa, gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and the releasing of'
وَتَسْلِيمِهِ: وَ + تَسْلِيمِ + هِ — wa-, and + taslīm, handing over (m. sg. verbal noun of form II sallama, gen., coordinated after bi-) + hi, it (3ms possessive/object suffix); 'and the handing it over'
فَتَفَقَّدَ: فَـ + تَفَقَّدَ — fa-, so/then + tafaqqada, to go over, inspect (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and he went over (his goods)'
فَوَعَدُوهُ: فَـ + وَعَدُوا + هُ — fa-, so/then + waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 3mp) + hu, him (3ms object suffix); 'so they promised him'
يُعَوِّضُونَ: يُعَوِّضُونَ — ʿawwaḍa, to compensate, make good (verb II, imperf. 3mp, indic. where classical would use the subjunctive after anna); 'they would make good'
مَاضَاعَ: مَا + ضَاعَ — mā, what (relative) + ḍāʿa, to be lost, perish (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'what had been lost'; written joined
كِتَابَيْنِ: كِتَابَيْنِ — kitāb, letter, writing (m. dual, acc., object of akhraja); 'two letters'
خَطَّ: خَطَّ — khaṭṭ, handwriting, hand (m. sg. noun, acc., object of ʿarafa; the vocalised form is the noun 'hand', construct); 'the hand of'
كَتَبَتْهُ: كَتَبَتْ + هُ — kataba, to write (verb I, perf. 3fs, 'she wrote') + hu, it (3ms object suffix, the letter); 'she had written it'
خَطَّهَا: خَطّ + هَا — khaṭṭ, handwriting, hand (m. sg., acc., object of ʿarafa) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'her hand'
الضِّيَافَاتِ: الـ + ضِّيَافَات — ḍiyāfa, hospitality, entertainment, hospitality gifts (f. pl. sound plural, acc., object of akhrajat); 'the hospitalities'
وَوَصَّتْ: وَ + وَصَّتْ — wa-, and + waṣṣā, to charge, commend (verb II, perf. 3fs); 'and she charged'
بِأَمْوَالٍ: بِـ + أَمْوَال — bi-, with/of (here with the verb amara: 'he commanded/ordered for him, with wealth') + amwāl, wealth, goods (m. pl. of māl, gen., indef.); 'wealth'
تْحَفَتْهُ: تْحَفَتْ + ـهُ — the second half of اتحفته, which the print splits as وقدا تحفته: atḥafa, to favour with a gift (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + hu, him (3ms object suffix); 'she had favoured him'
بِهَدَايَا: بِـ + هَدَايَا — bi-, with (the thing given, 'favoured him with') + hadāyā, gifts, presents (f. pl. of hadiyya, gen., diptote); 'with gifts'
تَطْلُبُهُ: تَطْلُبُ + هُ — ṭalaba, to seek, summon (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic., circumstantial 'summoning') + hu, him (3ms object suffix); 'summoning him'
وَهَنَّأَهَا: وَ + هَنَّأَ + هَا — wa-, and + hannaʾa, to congratulate (verb II, perf. 3ms) + hā, her (3fs object suffix); 'and he congratulated her'
بِسَلَامَتِهَا: بِـ + سَلَامَة + هَا — bi-, on/for (hannaʾa takes bi- of the occasion) + salāma, safety (f. sg., gen.) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'on her safety'; also (Night 202): بِـ + سَلَامَة + هَا — bi-, at (prep.; after fariḥa, 'to rejoice', bi- marks the cause of joy) + salāma, safety, soundness (f., gen.) + 3fs possessive; yafraḥu … bi-salāmatihā, 'will rejoice at her recovery'
وَاجْتِمَاعِهَا: وَ + اجْتِمَاع + هَا — wa-, and + ijtimāʿ, coming together, reunion (m. sg. verbal noun of form VIII ijtamaʿa, gen.) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'and her reunion'
بِأَخِيهَا: بِـ + أَخِي + هَا — bi-, with (ijtimāʿ bi-, 'being united with') + akh, brother (m. sg., gen., in the construct form akhī) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'with her brother'
وَدَّعَهُمْ: وَدَّعَ + هُمْ — waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3ms) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'he bade them farewell'
وَرَحَلَ: وَ + رَحَلَ — wa-, and + raḥala, to journey, depart (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he journeyed'
أَشْخَاصِ: أَشْخَاصِ — ashkhāṣ, persons (m. pl. of shakhṣ, gen., construct, 'the three persons of'); 'persons'
رُؤَسَاءَ: رُؤَسَاءَ — ruʾasāʾ, heads, chiefs (m. pl. of raʾīs, nom. in construct, diptote-form hamza ending; in apposition, 'who were heads of'); 'chiefs'
وَسَأَلُوهُمْ: وَ + سَأَلُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3mp) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'and they asked them'
أَقِفُ: أَقِفُ — waqafa, to stand (verb I, imperf. 1s, indic.); 'I stand'
لِأَخْطَفَ: لِـ + أَخْطَفَ — li-, in order to (lām of purpose) + khaṭifa/khaṭafa, to snatch, kidnap (verb I, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after the lām of purpose); 'to snatch'
الصِّغَارَ: الـ + صِّغَار — al-, the + ṣighār, young ones, children (m. pl. of ṣaghīr, acc., object); 'the young ones'
وَالْبَنَاتِ: وَ + الـ + بَنَات — wa-, and + al-, the + banāt, girls, daughters (f. pl. of bint, acc.); 'and the girls'
الْأَبْكَارَ: الـ + أَبْكَار — al-, the + abkār, virgins (f. pl. of bikr, acc., adjective/apposition to 'the girls'); 'the virgin ones'
وَأَبِيعَهُمْ: وَ + أَبِيعَ + هُمْ — wa-, and + bāʿa, to sell (verb I, imperf. 1s, subjunctive, continuing the purpose clause) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'and sell them'
لِلتُّجَّارِ: لِـ + الـ + تُّجَّار — li-, to (marks the buyer of bāʿa, 'sell to') + al-, the + tujjār, merchants (m. pl. of tājir, gen.); 'to the merchants'
وَأَغْرَانِي: وَ + أَغْرَا + نِي — wa-, and + aghrā, to incite, tempt (verb IV, perf. 3ms, 'the Devil') + nī, me (1s object suffix); 'and he tempted me'
فَاتَّفَقْتُ: فَـ + اتَّفَقْتُ — fa-, so/then + ittafaqa, to agree, come to terms (verb VIII, perf. 1s; takes maʿa 'with'); 'so I agreed'
الشَّقِيَّيْنِ: الـ + شَّقِيَّيْنِ — al-, the + shaqī, wretched (adj., m. dual, gen., after maʿa/with; 'these two wretched ones'); 'the two wretched ones'
الْأَوْبَاشِ: الـ + أَوْبَاش — al-, the + awbāsh, rabble, riff-raff (m. pl., gen., after 'gathering of'); 'the rabble'
نَهْبِ: نَهْبِ — nahb, plunder, pillage (m. sg. verbal noun of nahaba, gen., construct, after li-ajl 'for the sake of'); 'the plundering of'
خَطْفِكَ: خَطْف + كَ — khaṭf, snatching, kidnapping (m. sg. verbal noun of khaṭifa, gen., after fī 'in') + ka, your (2ms possessive); 'your snatching'
خَطَفْتُ: خَطَفْتُ — khaṭifa/khaṭafa, to snatch, kidnap (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I snatched'
خَدَّامَةً: خَدَّامَةً — khaddāma, female servant, serving woman (f. sg., acc., predicate/ḥāl after illā annahā kānat); 'a serving woman'
أَثْوَابٌ: أَثْوَابٌ — athwāb, garments (m. pl. of thawb, nom., subject, delayed); 'garments'
خَلِقَةٌ: خَلِقَةٌ — khaliqa, worn out, threadbare (adj., f. sg., nom., agreeing with a non-human plural 'garments'); 'worn-out'
وَسَبَقْتُ: وَ + سَبَقْتُ — wa-, and + sabaqa, to race ahead, outstrip (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I raced ahead'
أَصْلِي: أَصْل + ي — aṣl, root, origin, original intention (m. sg., nom., 'fī aṣlī' / 'it was in my root') + ī, my (1s possessive); 'my root intention'
وَأَجْعَلُهَا: وَ + أَجْعَلُ + هَا — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make, set (verb I, imperf. 1s, subjunctive/indic. continuing 'that I would') + hā, her (3fs object suffix); 'and set her'
تَرْعَى: تَرْعَى — raʿā, to herd, pasture (verb I, imperf. 3fs, indic., 'she herding'; circumstantial clause after jaʿala); 'herding'
وَضَرَبْتُهَا: وَ + ضَرَبْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + ḍaraba, to beat, strike (verb I, perf. 1s) + hā, her (3fs object suffix); 'and I beat her'
وَأَعْجَبَتْهُ: وَ + أَعْجَبَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + aʿjaba, to please, delight (verb IV, perf. 3fs, 'her eloquence') + hu, him (3ms object suffix); 'and it pleased him'
فَصَاحَتُهَا: فَصَاحَة + هَا — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f. sg., nom., subject) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'her eloquence'
اشْتِرَاؤُهَا: اشْتِرَاءُ + هَا — ishtirāʾ, buying, purchase (m. sg. verbal noun of form VIII ishtarā, acc. as object of arāda, construct; written ishtirāʾu) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'the buying of her'
يَزِيدُنِي: يَزِيدُ + نِي — zāda, to increase (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic., after mā zāla 'did not cease') + nī, me (1s; 'increasing to me', dative sense); 'increasing to me'
أَعْطَيْتُهَا: أَعْطَيْتُ + هَا — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 1s) + hā, her (3fs object suffix); 'I gave her'
فَصَاحَةً: فَصَاحَةً — faṣāḥa, eloquence (f. sg., acc., object of raʾaytu, 'I saw from her eloquence'); 'an eloquence'
الْمَبْلَغِ: الـ + مَبْلَغ — al-, the + mablagh, sum, amount (m. sg., gen., construct, 'the measure of the sum'); 'the sum'
وَلَعَمْرِي: وَ + لَـ + عَمْرِي — wa-, and (oath) + la-, (emphatic lām) + ʿamr, life (m. sg., 'by my life', oath formula, + ī, my 1s possessive); 'and by my life'
مَاحَكَاهُ: مَا + حَكَا + هُ — mā, what (relative) + ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, perf. 3ms, the ending -ā from root ḥ-k-y) + hu, it (3ms object suffix); 'what he related'; written joined
خَطَفَنِي: خَطَفَ + نِي — khaṭafa, to snatch, kidnap (verb I, perf. 3ms) + nī, me (1s object suffix); 'he snatched me'
غُرْبَتِهَا: غُرْبَة + هَا — ghurba, exile, estrangement (f. sg., gen., after fī) + hā, her (3fs possessive); 'her exile'
الشَّدَائِدِ: الـ + شَّدَائِد — al-, the + shadāʾid, hardships (f. pl. of shidda, gen., after min); 'the hardships'
وَالذُّلِّ: وَ + الـ + ذُّلّ — wa-, and + al-, the + dhull, abasement, humiliation (m. sg., gen., coordinated); 'and the abasement'
جَذَبَتِ: جَذَبَتِ — jadhaba, to draw, pull (verb I, perf. 3fs; final kasra before al- in the next word, 'al-sayf'); 'she drew'
لِتَقْتُلَهُ: لِـ + تَقْتُلَ + هُ — li-, in order to (lām of purpose) + qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3fs, subjunctive after the lām) + hu, him (3ms object suffix); 'to kill him'
يَامُلُوكَ: يَا + مُلُوكَ — yā, O (vocative particle) + mulūk, kings (m. pl. of malik, acc., construct, 'O kings of'); written joined
لَاتَدَعُوهَا: لَا + تَدَعُوا + هَا — lā, do not (prohibitive) + wadaʿa, to leave, let (verb I, imperf. 2mp, jussive, drops final -n) + hā, her (3fs object suffix); 'do not let her'; written joined
أَحْكِيَ: أَحْكِي — ḥakā, to relate, tell (verb I, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after ḥattā); 'until I tell'
دَعِيهِ: دَعِي + هِ — daʿ, leave, let (imperative 2fs, from wadaʿa verb I; the ending -ī marks the feminine addressee) + hi, him (3ms object suffix); 'leave him'
فَافْعَلِي: فَـ + افْعَلِي — fa-, and then + ifʿalī, do (imperative 2fs of faʿala, verb I); 'then do'
مَاتُرِيدِينَ: مَا + تُرِيدِينَ — mā, what (relative) + arāda, to want (verb IV, imperf. 2fs, indic., with the ending -īna); 'what you want'; written joined
تَعْفُوا: تَعْفُوا — ʿafā, to pardon (verb I, imperf. 2mp; Middle Arabic form with the -ūn dropped, a question 'will you pardon me?'; classical taʿfūna); 'you will pardon'
يُحَدِّثُهُمْ: يُحَدِّثُ + هُمْ — ḥaddatha, to tell, narrate (verb II, imperf. 3ms, indic., after akhadha/baqiya 'began') + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'telling them'
بِأَعْجَبِ: بِـ + أَعْجَبِ — bi-, of/with (ḥaddatha takes bi- for the thing told, 'tell of') + aʿjab, most wondrous (elative of ʿajīb; m. sg., gen., diptote form, construct); 'of the most wondrous'
أَرِقْتُ: أَرِقْتُ — ariqa, to be sleepless (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I was sleepless'
أَرَقًا: أَرَقًا — araq, sleeplessness, insomnia (m. sg. verbal noun of ariqa, acc., cognate accusative); 'a sleeplessness'
يُصْبِحُ: يُصْبِحُ — aṣbaḥa, to reach morning, to become morning (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, indic. in a dependent clause after 'did not believe that'); 'would morning'
وَقْتِي: وَقْت + ي — waqt, time, moment (m. sg., gen., after min, 'from my time') + ī, my (1s possessive); 'my time'
وَسَاعَتِي: وَ + سَاعَة + ي — wa-, and + sāʿa, hour (f. sg., gen., coordinated) + ī, my (1s possessive); 'and my hour'
وَتَقَلَّدْتُ: وَ + تَقَلَّدْتُ — wa-, and + taqallada, to gird oneself with, put on (verb V, perf. 1s); 'and I girded myself'
بِسَيْفِي: بِـ + سَيْف + ي — bi-, with (taqallada takes bi- for the thing worn) + sayf, sword (m. sg., gen.) + ī, my (1s possessive); 'with my sword'
وَاعْتَقَلْتُ: وَ + اعْتَقَلْتُ — wa-, and + iʿtaqala, to couch, hold ready (a lance) (verb VIII, perf. 1s); 'and I couched'
رُمْحِي: رُمْح + ي — rumḥ, lance (m. sg., acc., object) + ī, my (1s possessive); 'my lance'
فَوَاجَهَنِي: فَـ + وَاجَهَ + نِي — fa-, so/then + wājaha, to confront, meet face to face (verb III, perf. 3ms, 'a company') + nī, me (1s object suffix); 'and it met me'
فَسَأَلُونِي: فَـ + سَأَلُو + نِي — fa-, so/then + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3mp) + nī, me (1s object suffix; the -ū + -nī, with the nūn of protection joined as -ūnī); 'so they asked me'
فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ: فَـ + أَخْبَرْتُ + هُمْ — fa-, so/then + akhbara, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1s) + hum, them (3mp object suffix); 'and I informed them'
رُفَقَاؤُكَ: رُفَقَاءُ + كَ — rufaqāʾ, companions (m. pl. of rafīq, nom., predicate/subject) + ka, your (2ms possessive); 'your companions'
بِنَعَامَةٍ: بِـ + نَعَامَة — bi-, (marks what appears after idhā of surprise, 'lo, an ostrich') + naʿāma, ostrich (f. sg., gen., indef.); 'an ostrich'
فَقَصَدْنَاهَا: فَـ + قَصَدْنَا + هَا — fa-, so/then + qaṣada, to make for, head toward (verb I, perf. 1p) + hā, it (3fs object suffix, the ostrich); 'so we made for it'
فَاتِحَةٌ: فَاتِحَةٌ — fātiḥa, opening, spreading (active participle of fataḥa, verb I; f. sg., nom., ḥāl after the ostrich); 'spreading'
أَجْنِحَتَهَا: أَجْنِحَة + هَا — ajniḥa, wings (f. pl. of janāḥ, acc., object of fātiḥa) + hā, its (3fs possessive); 'its wings'
شَارِدَةً: شَارِدَةً — shārida, fleeing, shying off (active participle of sharada, verb I; f. sg., acc., predicate of lam tazal 'did not cease'); 'fleeing'
صَفِيرِ: صَفِير — ṣafīr, whistling, hissing (m. sg. verbal noun of ṣafara, gen., construct, after illā/min); 'the hissing of'
وَزَعِيقِ: وَ + زَعِيق — wa-, and + zaʿīq, shrieking, screech (m. sg. verbal noun of zaʿaqa, gen., coordinated); 'and the shrieking of'
وَصَرِيخِ: وَ + صَرِيخ — wa-, and + ṣarīkh, screaming, cry (m. sg. verbal noun of ṣarakha, gen., coordinated); 'and the screaming of'
الْغِيلَانِ: الـ + غِيلَان — al-, the + ghīlān, ghouls (m. pl. of ghūl, gen., construct); 'the ghouls'
أَفِى: أَ + فِي — a-, (interrogative particle) + fī, in/into (preposition, with 'the sky'); 'was it into (the sky)?'
غَارَتْ: غَارَتْ — ghāra, to sink, go underground (verb I, perf. 3fs, hollow root gh-w-r, 'it sank'); 'it sank'
فَرَدَدْنَا: فَـ + رَدَدْنَا — fa-, so/then + radda, to turn back (verb I, perf. 1p, doubled root r-d-d); 'so we turned back'
رُؤُسَ: رُؤُوس — ruʾūs, heads (m. pl. of raʾs, acc., construct, object of radadnā; 'the heads of (the horses)'); 'heads'
لَاخَيْرَ: لَا + خَيْرَ — lā, no (negating, lā li-nafy al-jins, putting its noun in the acc. without tanwīn) + khayr, good, benefit (m. sg., acc.); 'no good'; written joined
إِصْلَاحَ: إِصْلَاح — iṣlāḥ, setting right, improvement (m. sg. verbal noun of form IV aṣlaḥa, gen. or acc. after wa-lā); 'a setting-right'
وَعَطِشْنَا: وَ + عَطِشْنَا — wa-, and + ʿaṭisha, to be thirsty (verb I, perf. 1p); 'and we thirsted'
عَطَشًا: عَطَشًا — ʿaṭash, thirst (m. sg. verbal noun of ʿaṭisha, acc., cognate accusative); 'a severe thirst'
خُيُولُنَا: خُيُول + نَا — khuyūl, horses (m. pl. of khayl, nom., subject) + nā, our (1p possessive); 'our horses'
مَرْجًا: مَرْجًا — marj, meadow, pasture (m. sg., acc., object of raʾaynā; indef.); 'a meadow'
أَفْيَحَ: أَفْيَحَ — afyaḥ, wide-spreading, broad (adj., m. sg., acc., agreeing with marj; diptote of the elative-type pattern afʿal); 'wide-spreading'
غِزْلَانٌ: غِزْلَانٌ — ghizlān, gazelles (m. pl. of ghazāl, nom., subject of the circumstantial clause); 'gazelles'
مَرْبُوطٌ: مَرْبُوطٌ — marbūṭ, tethered, tied (passive participle of rabaṭa, verb I; m. sg., nom., agreeing with 'stallion'); 'tethered'
وَسِنَانٌ: وَ + سِنَانٌ — wa-, and + sinān, spearhead (m. sg., nom., subject of lāmiʿ 'gleaming'); 'and a spearhead'
مَرْكُوزٍ: مَرْكُوزٍ — markūz, planted upright, fixed (passive participle of rakaza, verb I; m. sg., gen., agreeing with 'lance', which it qualifies); 'planted upright'
فَانْتَعَشَتْ: فَـ + انْتَعَشَتْ — fa-, so/then + intaʿasha, to revive, be refreshed (verb VII, perf. 3fs, 'our souls'); 'so (they) revived'
نُفُوسُنَا: نُفُوس + نَا — nufūs, souls, selves (f. pl. of nafs, nom., subject) + nā, our (1p possessive); 'our souls'
الْيَأْسِ: الـ + يَأْس — al-, the + yaʾs, despair (m. sg., gen., after baʿda 'after'); 'the despair'
وَرَدَدْنَا: وَ + رَدَدْنَا — wa-, and + radda, to turn (verb I, perf. 1p, doubled root r-d-d); 'and we turned'
خَيْلِنَا: خَيْل + نَا — khayl, horses (collective f./m., gen., construct, 'the heads of our horses') + nā, our (1p possessive); 'our horses'
وَالْمَاءَ: وَ + الـ + مَاءَ — wa-, and + al-, the + māʾ, water (m. sg., acc., coordinated as object of ṭālibīn 'seeking'); 'and the water'
وَأَنَافِي: وَ + أَنَا + فِي — wa-, and + anā, I (1s independent pronoun, subject of a ḥāl clause) + fī, in (preposition); 'and I in'; written joined
أَوَّلِهِمْ: أَوَّل + هِمْ — awwal, first (m. sg., gen., after fī) + him, their (3mp possessive); 'the first of them'
وَسَقَيْنَا: وَ + سَقَيْنَا — wa-, and + saqā, to give to drink, water (verb I, perf. 1p, root s-q-y); 'and we watered'
خُيُولَنَا: خُيُول + نَا — khuyūl, horses (m. pl. of khayl, acc., object of saqaynā) + nā, our (1p possessive); 'our horses'
حَمِيَّةُ: حَمِيَّةُ — ḥamiyya, zeal, fierce pride, hot-headedness (f. sg., nom., construct, subject, 'the zealotry of'); 'the zeal of'
الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: الـ + جَاهِلِيَّة — al-, the + jāhiliyya, the Age of Ignorance, pre-Islamic pride (f. sg., gen., second term of the construct); 'of the Ignorance'
الْخِبَاءِ: الـ + خِبَاء — al-, the + khibāʾ, tent (m. sg., gen., after the construct 'door of'); 'the tent'
هِلَالٌ: هِلَالٌ — hilāl, new moon, crescent (m. sg., nom.; here the predicate in a comparison 'as though he were a new moon', not the name); 'a new moon'
حَمَّادُ: حَمَّاد — Ḥammād, the Bedouin narrator, son of al-Fazārī (proper n., nom.); 'I am Ḥammād'
الْفَزَارِيِّ: الـ + فَزَارِيّ — al-, the + Fazārī, of the tribe of Fazāra (nisba adj./proper n., m. sg., gen., after ibn); 'al-Fazārī'
الْفَارِسِيُّ: الـ + فَارِسِيُّ — al-, the + fārisī, Persian (nisba adj., m. sg., nom., in apposition to the speaker); 'the Fārisī'
الْمَوْصُوفُ: الـ + مَوْصُوف — al-, the + mawṣūf, described, renowned (passive participle of waṣafa, verb I; m. sg., nom., apposition to the speaker); 'the described'
أُعَدُّ: أُعَدُّ — ʿadda, to count, reckon (verb I, imperf. passive 1s, doubled root ʿ-d-d; 'I am counted'; takes bi- for the worth 'as five hundred horsemen'); 'I am counted'
مَحَلِّنَا: مَحَلّ + نَا — maḥall, place, camping-place (m. sg., gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'from our camping-place'
الْعَطَشُ: الـ + عَطَش — ʿaṭash, thirst (m. sg., nom., subject of 'overtook us'); 'the thirst'
الْمَلِيحَةِ: الـ + مَلِيحَة — malīḥ, comely, pretty (adj. f. sg., gen., agreeing with al-jāriya); 'the comely damsel'
ائْتِي: ائْتِ + ي — ātā, to come (verb I, imperative 2fs); with بِـ, 'bring' (the verb chooses bi-: ātā bi-, 'bring'); 'bring (to this man) the water'
وَمَاحَضَرَ: وَ + مَا + حَضَرَ — wa-, and + mā, what (relative pron.) + ḥaḍara, to be present, at hand (verb I, perf. 3ms), written as one word; 'and whatever is at hand'
تَسْحَبُ: تَسْحَبُ — saḥaba, to drag, trail (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, circumstantial ḥāl); 'trailing'
أَذْيَالَهَا: أَذْيَال + هَا — dhayl, hem, skirt (m., broken pl. adhyāl, acc., object of 'trailing') + -hā, her; 'her skirts'
وَالْحُجُولُ: وَ + الـ + حُجُول — wa-, and (circumstantial) + ḥijl, anklet (m., broken pl. ḥujūl, nom., subject); 'and the anklets'
تُشَخْشِخُ: تُشَخْشِخُ — shakhshakha, to jingle, rattle (quadriliteral verb, imperf. 3fs indicative, agreeing with the broken plural); 'jingling'
تَتَعَثَّرُ: تَتَعَثَّرُ — taʿaththara, to stumble (verb V, imperf. 3fs indicative, ḥāl); 'stumbling'
إِنَاءٌ: إِنَاء — ināʾ, vessel (m. sg., nom. indef., subject of the delayed predicate 'in her hand'); 'a vessel'
مَمْلُؤٌ: مَمْلُؤ — mamlūʾ, filled (passive part. of malaʾa, verb I, m. sg., nom. indef., describing ināʾ, governing an acc. of what fills it); 'filled'
بَارِدًا: بَارِد — bārid, cold (adj. m. sg., acc. indef., agreeing with māʾan); 'cold'
تَمْرًا: تَمْر — tamr, dates (collective n. m., acc. indef., specification after malʾān, 'full'); 'dates'
وَلَبَنًا: وَ + لَبَن — wa-, and + laban, milk (m. sg., acc. indef., coordinate with tamr); 'and milk'
لُحُومِ: لُحُوم — laḥm, meat (m., broken pl. luḥūm, gen., first term of an idāfa); 'of the meats of'
اسْتَطَعْتُ: اسْتَطَعْتُ — istaṭāʿa, to be able (verb X, perf. 1s), followed by an + subjunctive; 'I could (not)'
وَلَاشَرَابًا: وَ + لَا + شَرَاب — wa-, and + lā, no/nor + sharāb, drink (m. sg., acc. indef., coordinate with ṭaʿām, object of 'take'), written as one word; 'nor drink'
فَتَمَثَّلْتُ: فَـ + تَمَثَّلْتُ — fa-, so + tamaththala, to quote as apt, to apply a verse (verb V, perf. 1s); 'so I quoted'
بِهَذَيْنِ: بِـ + هَذَيْنِ — bi-, with (tamaththala bi- 'quote': the verb chooses the preposition) + hādhayni, these two (dem. m. dual, gen.); 'with these two (verses)' Also bi- of the means after waddaʿa: waddaʿahum bi-hādhayni al-baytayni, 'he bade them farewell with these two verses'.
الْخِضَابَ: الـ + خِضَاب — khiḍāb, dye, henna (m. sg., acc. as subject after kaʾanna); 'the dye'
كَفِّهَا: كَفّ + هَا — kaff, palm, hand (f. sg., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'upon her palm'
غُرَابٌ: غُرَاب — ghurāb, raven (m. sg., nom. indef., predicate of kaʾanna); 'a raven'
ثَلْجَةٍ: ثَلْجَة — thalja, a patch of snow (f. sg. unit noun, gen. indef. after ʿalā); 'on snow'
وَاقِفُ: وَاقِف — wāqif, standing (act. part. of waqafa, verb I, m. sg., nom. indef., describing ghurāb; final vowel dropped in verse); 'standing'
وَالْبَدْرَ: وَ + الـ + بَدْر — wa-, and + badr, full moon (m. sg., acc., object of tarā); 'and the moon'
قَرِيبَيْنِ: قَرِيب — qarīb, near, close (adj. m. dual, acc., ḥāl, agreeing with sun and moon); 'close together'
خَافٍ: خَافٍ — khāfin, hidden (act. part. of khafiya, verb I, defective, m. sg., nom. indef., predicate of an understood 'this one'); 'one hides'
خَائِفُ: خَائِف — khāʾif, afraid (act. part. of khāfa, verb I, m. sg., nom. indef., predicate); 'afraid'
أَوْقَفْتُكَ: أَوْقَفْتُ + كَ — awqafa, to acquaint, to make stand (verb IV, perf. 1s; awqafa ʿalā 'acquaint with') + -ka, you (object); 'I have acquainted you (with)'
وَتُوقِفَنِي: وَ + تُوقِفَ + نِي — wa-, and + awqafa (verb IV, imperf. 2ms subjunctive, after an and coordinate with tukhbiranī) + -nī, me; 'and that you acquaint me (with)'
خَبَرِكَ: خَبَر + كَ — khabar, news, story (m. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa) + -ka, your; 'of your story'
أَقْتُلْكَ: أَقْتُلْ + كَ — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 1s jussive, in the apodosis of wa-illā, 'and if not') + -ka, you; 'I will kill you'
وَآخُذْهَا: وَ + آخُذْ + هَا — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 1s jussive, coordinate with aqtulka) + -hā, her; 'and take her'
دَعْوَاكَ: دَعْوَى + كَ — daʿwā, claim (f. sg., gen. after fī; indeclinable ending) + -ka, your; 'in your claim'
مَعْرُوفٌ: مَعْرُوف — maʿrūf, known, famous (passive part. of ʿarafa, verb I, m. sg., nom. indef., describing fāris, in the that-clause); 'famous'; here: rajulun maʿrūfun bi-, 'a man known for'; nom. indef., describing rajulun
مَوْصُوفٌ: مَوْصُوف — mawṣūf, described, renowned (passive part. of waṣafa, verb I, m. sg., nom. indef., describing baṭal); 'renowned'
وَأَنَّكَ: وَ + أَنَّ + كَ — wa-, and + anna, that (particle putting its subject in the acc.) + -ka, you; 'and that you (are)'
أَسَدُ: أَسَد — asad, lion (m. sg., nom., predicate of anna, first term of an idāfa); 'the lion of'
الْبَيْدَاءِ: الـ + بَيْدَاء — baydāʾ, desert, waste (f. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa); 'of the desert'
هَجَمْتُمْ: هَجَمْتُمْ — hajama, to fall upon, attack (verb I, perf. 2mp; hajama ʿalā 'attack'), in a conditional after in; 'you fall upon (me)'
غَدْرًا: غَدْر — ghadr, treachery (m. verbal noun, acc. indef., adverbial); 'treacherously'
وَقَتَلْتُمُونِي: وَ + قَتَلْتُمُو + نِي — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 2mp, with the plural -tumū before a suffix) + -nī, me; 'and you kill me'
وَأَخَذْتُمْ: وَ + أَخَذْتُمْ — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 2mp); 'and you take (my sister)'
عَارًا: عَار — ʿār, disgrace (m. sg., acc. indef., predicate of yakūnu); 'a disgrace'
تُعَدُّونَ: تُعَدُّونَ — ʿadda, to count, reckon (verb I, imperf. passive 2mp indicative); 'you are counted (among the champions)'
وَلَاتُبَالُونَ: وَ + لَا + تُبَالُونَ — wa-, and + lā, not + bālā, to care (verb III, imperf. 2mp indicative), written as one word; 'and you do not care (about)'
بِالْحَرْبِ: بِـ + الـ + حَرْب — bi-, about (bālā bi- 'care about': the verb chooses bi-) + ḥarb, war (f./m. sg., gen.); 'about war'
وَالنِّزَالِ: وَ + الـ + نِزَال — wa-, and + nizāl, single combat (m. verbal noun of nāzala, gen., coordinate with ḥarb); 'and single combat'
فَأَمْهِلُونِي: فَـ + أَمْهِلُو + نِي — fa-, then (apodosis) + amhala, to grant a respite (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + -nī, me; 'then give me time'
أَلْبَسَ: أَلْبَسَ — labisa, to put on, wear (verb I, imperf. 1s subjunctive after ḥattā, 'until'); 'until I put on'
حَرْبِي: حَرْب + ي — ḥarb, war (f./m. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa, 'gear of war') + -ī, my; 'my war (gear)'
وَأَتَقَلَّدَ: وَ + أَتَقَلَّدَ — wa-, and + taqallada, to gird on (verb V, imperf. 1s subjunctive, continuing ḥattā; taqallada bi- 'gird on with'); 'and gird on'
وَأَعْتَقِلَ: وَ + أَعْتَقِلَ — wa-, and + iʿtaqala, to couch (a lance), to take in hand (verb VIII, imperf. 1s subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and couch'
فَرَسِي: فَرَس + ي — faras, horse, mare (m./f. sg., acc., object) + -ī, my; 'my horse'
وَأَصِيرَ: وَ + أَصِيرَ — wa-, and + ṣāra, to become, to come to be (verb I, imperf. 1s subjunctive, continuing ḥattā); 'and come to be'
وَإِيَّاكُمْ: وَ + إِيَّا + كُمْ — wa-, and, together with + iyyā-, carrier of the pronoun (acc.) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'and you' (the acc. marks 'with you')
أَقْتُلْكُمْ: أَقْتُلْ + كُمْ — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 1s jussive, apodosis of in ẓafirtu) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I will kill you'
فَهَذِهِ: فَـ + هَذِهِ — fa-, then (apodosis) + hādhihi, this (dem. f. sg., nom.); 'then this (girl)'
رَدَدْتُ: رَدَدْتُ — radda, to turn back, to rein back (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I turned (the head of)'
جَوَادِى: جَوَاد + ي — jawād, swift horse (m. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa) + -ī, my; 'of my horse'
الْجُنُونُ: الـ + جُنُون — junūn, madness (m. sg., nom., subject of zāda); 'the madness'
وَوَصَفْتُ: وَ + وَصَفْتُ — wa-, and + waṣafa, to describe (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I described'
وَشَجَاعَتَهُ: وَ + شَجَاعَة + هُ — wa-, and + shajāʿa, courage (f. sg., acc., object of waṣaftu) + -hu, his; 'and his courage'
وَقُوَّةَ: وَ + قُوَّة — wa-, and + quwwa, strength (f. sg., acc., first term of an idāfa); 'and the strength of'
يُصَادِمُ: يُصَادِمُ — ṣādama, to clash with, to take on (verb III, imperf. 3ms indicative); 'he would take on'
أَعْلَمْتُ: أَعْلَمْتُ — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'I informed'
مُنْقَطِعٌ: مُنْقَطِع — munqaṭiʿ, cut off, living apart (act. part. of inqaṭaʿa, verb VII, m. sg., nom. indef., predicate); 'living apart'
شَجَاعَةٍ: شَجَاعَة — shajāʿa, courage (f. sg., gen. indef., after dhā); 'of courage'
أُوصِيكُمْ: أُوصِي + كُمْ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV, imperf. 1s indicative) + -kum, you (m. pl.); 'I charge you'
رَضِينَا: رَضِينَا — raḍiya, to be content, to agree (verb I, perf. 1p); with بِـ, 'agree to' (the verb chooses bi-); 'we agree (to that)'
حَرْبِهِمْ: حَرْب + هِمْ — ḥarb, war (f./m. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa) + -him, their; 'of their war'
خَيْلَهُمْ: خَيْل + هُمْ — khayl, horses (collective n., acc., object) + -hum, their; 'their horses'
بِرِكَابِهِ: بِـ + رِكَاب + هِ — bi-, by (taʿallaqa bi- 'cling to': the verb chooses bi-) + rikāb, stirrup (m. sg., gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his stirrup'
وَبَلَّتْ: وَ + بَلَّتْ — wa-, and + balla, to wet, soak (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she soaked'
بُرْقُعَهَا: بُرْقُع + هَا — burquʿ, face-veil (m. sg., acc., object) + -hā, her; 'her veil'
بِدُمُوعِهَا: بِـ + دُمُوع + هَا — bi-, with (instrument) + dumūʿ, tears (m., broken pl. of damʿ, gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her tears'
مِحْنَةً: مِحْنَة — miḥna, trial, affliction (f. sg., acc. indef., object of ashkū); 'a trial'
وَكَابَةً: وَ + كَآبَة — wa-, and + kaʾāba, grief, sorrow (f. sg., acc. indef., coordinate with miḥna; spelled without hamza); 'and grief'
اِلٰهَ: إِلٰه — ilāh, god, lord (m. sg., acc. as subject after laʿalla, first term of an idāfa, 'Lord of the Throne'; the initial hamza is not written); 'the Lord of (the Throne)'
يُرْهِقُهُمْ: يُرْهِق + هُمْ — arhaqa, to overwhelm, to burden (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indicative after laʿalla) + -hum, them; 'may he overwhelm them'
رُعْبَا: رُعْب — ruʿb, terror, dread (m. sg., acc. indef., second object of arhaqa; final -ā for rhyme); 'with dread'
يُرِيدُوْنَ: يُرِيدُونَ — arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, imperf. 3mp indicative); 'they intend'
قَتْلَكَ: قَتْل + كَ — qatl, killing (m. verbal noun of qatala, acc., object of yurīdūna) + -ka, your; 'your killing'
اُخَيَّ: أُخَيّ — ukhayy, little brother (diminutive of akh, m. sg., vocative after yā, the -ī 'my' absorbed); 'little brother'
تَعَمُّدًا: تَعَمُّد — taʿammud, deliberateness (m. verbal noun of V taʿammada, acc. indef., adverbial); 'of set purpose'
ذَنْبَا: ذَنْب — dhanb, offence, fault (m. sg., acc. indef., after 'and there was nothing'; final -ā for rhyme); 'an offence'
وَاَشْجَعُ: وَ + أَشْجَع — wa-, and + ashjaʿ, bravest (elative of shujāʿ, m. sg., nom., diptote, coordinate with fāris, first term of an idāfa); 'and the bravest of'
الْمَشَارِقَ: الـ + مَشَارِق — mashriq, east, place of sunrise (m., broken pl. mashāriq, acc., diptote, object of ḥalla); 'the east(s)'
وَالْغَرْبَا: وَ + الـ + غَرْب — wa-, and + gharb, west (m. sg., acc., object of ḥalla; final -ā for rhyme); 'and the west'
تُحَامِي: تُحَامِي — ḥāmā, to defend, protect (verb III, defective, imperf. 2ms indicative); with عَنْ, 'defend on behalf of'; 'you shield'
الْاُخْتِ: الـ + أُخْت — ukht, sister (f. sg., gen. after ʿan; the hamza is written without a hamza sign in the verse); 'the sister'
عَزْمُهَا: عَزْم + هَا — ʿazm, resolve (m. sg., nom., subject of qalla) + -hā, her; 'her resolve'
اَخُوهَا: أَخُو + هَا — akh, brother (m. sg., nom., one of the 'five nouns', long -ū as predicate) + -hā, her; 'her brother'
تَدْعُو: تَدْعُو — daʿā, to call upon, to pray (verb I, defective, imperf. 3fs indicative; daʿā li- 'pray for'); 'she prays'
الرَّبَّا: الـ + رَبّ — rabb, Lord (m. sg., acc., object of tadʿū; final -ā for rhyme); 'the Lord'
الْاَعْدَاءَ: الـ + أَعْدَاء — ʿadū, enemy (m., broken pl. aʿdāʾ, acc., object of tatruk); 'the enemies'
وَتَأْخُذُنِي: وَ + تَأْخُذُ + نِي — wa-, and + akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, agreeing with the broken plural aʿdāʾ) + -nī, me; 'and (let them) seize me'
وَتَأْسِرُنِي: وَ + تَأْسِرُ + نِي — wa-, and + asara, to take captive (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, agreeing with aʿdāʾ) + -nī, me; 'and carry me off captive'
غَصْبَا: غَصْب — ghaṣb, force, compulsion (m. verbal noun, acc. indef., adverbial; final -ā for rhyme); 'by force'
اَبْقَى: أَبْقَى — baqiya, to remain, stay (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative); 'I will stay'
بِبَلْدَةٍ: بِـ + بَلْدَة — bi-, in + balda, town, land (f. sg., gen. indef.); 'in a land'
خَصْبَا: خَصْب — khaṣb, fertility, plenty (m. sg., acc., specification; final -ā for rhyme); 'with plenty'
وَاَقْتُلُ: وَ + أَقْتُلُ — wa-, and + qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative); 'and I will kill'
وَاَسْكُنُ: وَ + أَسْكُنُ — wa-, and + sakana, to dwell (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative); 'and I will dwell in'
لَحْدًا: لَحْد — laḥd, grave (m. sg., acc. indef., object of askunu); 'a grave'
اَفْتَرِشُ: أَفْتَرِشُ — iftarasha, to spread out for oneself, to lie on (verb VIII, imperf. 1s indicative); 'I make my bed'
التُّرْبَا: الـ + تُّرْب — turb, dust, earth (m. sg., acc., object; final -ā for rhyme); 'the dust'
وَأَجَابَهَا: وَ + أَجَابَ + هَا — wa-, and + ajāba, to answer (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (object); 'and he answered her'
بِقَوْلِهِ: بِـ + قَوْل + هِ — bi-, with, by means of + qawl, saying, words (m. verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, his; 'with his words'
قِفِي: قِفِي — waqafa, to stand, stay (verb I, imperative 2fs); 'stay'
وَانْظُرِي: وَ + انْظُرِي — wa-, and + naẓara, to look, watch (verb I, imperative 2fs); 'and watch'; also: 'and see', with an interrogative: wa-unẓurī man anā, 'and see who I am'
وُقُوعَ: وُقُوع — wuqūʿ, occurrence, happening (m. verbal noun of waqaʿa, acc., object of unẓurī, first term of an idāfa); 'the occurrence of'
اُثْخِنُهُمْ: أُثْخِن + هُمْ — athkhana, to overpower, to hack down (verb IV, imperf. 1s indicative) + -hum, them; 'I hack them down'
ضَرْبَا: ضَرْب — ḍarb, striking, blows (m. verbal noun, acc. indef., adverbial or specification; final -ā for rhyme); 'with blows'
اللَّيْثُ: الـ + لَّيْث — layth, lion (m. sg., nom., subject of baraza); 'the lion'
وَاَشْجَعُهُمْ: وَ + أَشْجَع + هُمْ — wa-, and + ashjaʿ, bravest (elative, m. sg., nom., diptote, in apposition) + -hum, them; 'and the bravest of them'
وَاَثْبَتُهُمْ: وَ + أَثْبَت + هُمْ — wa-, and + athbat, steadiest, firmest (elative of thābit, m. sg., nom., diptote) + -hum, them; 'and the steadiest of them'
لُبًّا: لُبّ — lubb, mind, intellect (m. sg., acc. indef., specification after athbat; final -ā for rhyme); 'in mind'
سَاَسْقِيهِ: سَـ + أَسْقِي + هِ — sa-, will (future) + saqā, to give to drink (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative; here with two objects) + -hi, him; 'I will give him to drink'
ثَعْلَبِيَّةً: ثَعْلَبِيَّة — thaʿlabī, of Thaʿlaba (nisba adj. f. sg., acc. indef., describing ḍarba; allusion to Banū Thaʿlaba); 'a Thaʿlabī (stroke)'
يَسْتَغْرِقُ: يَسْتَغْرِقُ — istaghraqa, to be sunk in entirely, to take up (verb X, imperf. 3ms indicative, ḥāl); 'sinking'
الْكَعْبَا: الـ + كَعْب — kaʿb, joint, knot (of the spear-shaft) (m. sg., acc., object of yastaghriqu; final -ā for rhyme); 'the joint'
اُقَاتِلْ: أُقَاتِلْ — qātala, to fight (verb III, imperf. 1s jussive after lam); 'I do not fight'
اُخْتِي: أُخْت + ي — ukht, sister (f. sg., acc. vocative, with -ī, my); 'my sister'
قَتِيلٌ: قَتِيل — qatīl, slain (m. sg., nom. indef., predicate in the wish layta-nī); 'slain'
وَلَيْتَ: وَ + لَيْتَ — wa-, and + layta, would that (particle of wish putting its subject in the acc.); 'and would that'
تَنْهَبُنِي: تَنْهَبُ + نِي — nahaba, to plunder, to tear at (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, agreeing with collective aṭ-ṭayr) + -nī, me; 'would tear me'
نَهْبَا: نَهْب — nahb, plunder, prey (m. verbal noun, acc., cognate object); 'as prey'
اُقَاتِلُ: أُقَاتِلُ — qātala, to fight (verb III, imperf. 1s indicative); 'I shall fight'
تَكَرُّمًا: تَكَرُّم — takarrum, generosity, nobility of conduct (m. verbal noun of V takarrama, acc. indef., object of purpose); 'as honour bids'
بَعْدَنَا: بَعْد + نَا — baʿd, after (adverb, acc., adjectival to ḥadīth) + -nā, us; 'after us'
الْكُتْبَا: الـ + كُتْب — kitāb, book (m., broken pl. kutub, acc., object of yamlaʾu; final -ā for rhyme); 'the books'
اسْمَعِي: اسْمَعِي — samiʿa, to hear, listen (verb I, imperative 2fs); 'listen'
أُوصِيكِ: أُوصِي + كِ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV, imperf. 1s indicative; awṣā bi- 'charge with') + -ki, you (f.); 'I charge you (with)'
تُمَكِّنِي: تُمَكِّنِي — makkana, to give power over, to let have (verb II, imperf. 2fs jussive after lā, the final -ī marks the fem.); 'do not let'
نَفْسِكِ: نَفْس + كِ — nafs, self, person (f. sg., gen. after min) + -ki, your (f.); 'of yourself'; also: after khāfa ʿalā, 'for yourself': khāfī ʿalā nafsiki, 'fear for yourself'
صَرِيعًا: صَرِيع — ṣarīʿ, laid low, slain (adj. m. sg., acc. indef., ḥāl); 'lying slain'
وَأُمَكِّنَ: وَ + أُمَكِّنَ — wa-, and + makkana, to give power to, to yield (verb II, imperf. 1s subjunctive, after an); 'and (that) I yield'
صُورَتُهَا: صُورَة + هَا — ṣūra, form, face, beauty (f. sg., nom., subject of lāḥat) + -hā, her; 'her beauty'
فَقَبَّلَهَا: فَـ + قَبَّلَ + هَا — fa-, then + qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he kissed her'
وَوَدَّعَهَا: وَ + وَدَّعَ + هَا — wa-, and + waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and bade her farewell'
يَافُرْسَانُ: يَا + فُرْسَان — yā, O (vocative particle) + fāris, horseman (m., broken pl. fursān, nom., vocative), written as one word; 'O horsemen'
ضِيفَانٌ: ضِيفَان — ḍayf, guest (m., broken pl. ḍīfān, nom. indef., predicate of antum); 'guests'
أَوْتُرِيدُونَ: أَوْ + تُرِيدُونَ — aw, or + arāda, to want (verb IV, imperf. 2mp indicative), written as one word; 'or do you want'
وَالطِّعَانَ: وَ + الـ + طِّعَان — wa-, and + ṭiʿān, spear-thrusting (m. verbal noun of ṭaʿana, acc., object of turīdūna); 'and spear-thrusts'
ضِيفَانًا: ضِيفَان — ḍayf, guest (m., broken pl. ḍīfān, acc. indef., predicate of kuntum); 'guests'
فَأَبْشِرُوا: فَـ + أَبْشِرُوا — fa-, then (apodosis) + abshara, to rejoice, receive good news (verb IV, imperative 2mp); with بِـ, 'be glad of'; 'then be glad'
بِالْقِرَى: بِـ + الـ + قِرَى — bi-, of, at (abshara bi- 'rejoice at': the verb chooses bi-) + qirā, hospitality, entertainment of a guest (m. sg., defective, gen.); 'at the welcome'
الزَّاهِرَ: الـ + زَّاهِر — zāhir, shining, radiant (act. part. of zahara, verb I, adj. m. sg., acc., agreeing with al-qamar); 'the shining'
فَلْيَبْرُزْلِي: فَـ + لْـ + يَبْرُزْ + لِي — fa-, then + li-, the lām of command, 'let' + baraza, to come forth (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive) + li-, to, against + -ī, me; 'then let (a horseman) come out against me'
مُوَافِقٌ: مُوَافِق — muwāfiq, agreeing, identical (act. part. of wāfaqa, verb III, m. sg., nom. indef., predicate); 'is the same as'
لِاسْمِي: لِـ + اسْم + ي — li-, to (muwāfiq li- 'agree with': the adjective chooses li-) + ism, name (m. sg., gen.) + -ī, my; 'to my name'
لِاسْمِ: لِـ + اسْم — li-, to (muwāfiq li- 'agree with') + ism, name (m. sg., gen., first term of an idāfa); 'to the name of (my father)'
بِلَالٌ: بِلَال — Bilāl, a man's name (proper n., nom. indef., predicate of ismī)
قَوْلِكَ: قَوْل + كَ — qawl, saying, words (m. verbal noun, gen. after fī) + -ka, your; 'in your saying'
بِلَالِ: بِلَال — Bilāl, a man's name (proper n., gen., diptote-style, after min); 'that you are Bilāl'
بِالزُّورِ: بِـ + الـ + زُّور — bi-, with (jāʾa bi- 'bring': the verb chooses bi-) + zūr, falsehood, lies (m. sg., gen.); 'with falsehood'
وَبِالْمُحَالِ: وَ + بِـ + الـ + مُحَال — wa-, and + bi-, with (jāʾa bi- 'bring') + muḥāl, absurdity, the impossible (m. sg., gen.); 'and with absurdity'
شَهْمًا: شَهْم — shahm, spirited, gallant (adj. m. sg., acc. indef., predicate of kunta); 'a man of spirit'
فَاسْتَمِعْ: فَـ + اسْتَمِعْ — fa-, then (apodosis) + istamaʿa, to listen (verb VIII, imperative 2ms); 'then hear'
الْاَبْطَالِ: الـ + أَبْطَال — baṭal, champion (m., broken pl. abṭāl, gen., second term of an idāfa after mujandil); 'of the champions'
بِصَارِمٍ: بِـ + صَارِم — bi-, with (instrument) + ṣārim, keen blade, sword (act. part. of ṣarama used as noun, m. sg., gen. indef.); 'with a keen blade'
مَاضٍ: مَاضٍ — māḍin, sharp, cutting (act. part. of maḍā, verb I, defective, m. sg., gen. indef., describing ṣārim); 'keen'
لِطَعْنٍ: لِـ + طَعْن — li-, for (iṣbir li- 'endure, stand firm for') + ṭaʿn, thrust, stabbing (m. verbal noun of ṭaʿana, gen.); 'for a thrust'
مُرْجِفِ: مُرْجِف — murjif, shaking, convulsing (act. part. of arjafa, verb IV, m. sg., gen., first term of an idāfa, describing ṭaʿn); 'that shakes'
السِّنَانُ: الـ + سِّنَان — sinān, spearhead (m. sg., nom., subject of kharaja); 'the spearhead'
الرِّجْسِ: الـ + رِّجْس — rijs, filth, foulness (m. sg., gen., second term of an idāfa after rakhīm); 'of foulness'
غَالِ: غَالِ — ghālin, dear, costly (act. part. of ghalā, verb I, defective, m. sg., nom., with the final -ī dropped in verse); 'the costly'
سِعْرُهُ: سِعْر + ـهُ — siʿr, price (m. sing., nom., subject) + -hu, his/its (3ms pronoun suffix, gen.); 'its price'
بَخْسِ: بَخْس — bakhs, cheap, of little worth (m., gen., after min); 'from (one) cheap'
يُبَالِ: يُبَالِ — bālā, to care, heed (verb III, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam, shortened -ī for the metre); 'who does not care'
بِنَفْسِ: بِـ + نَفْس — bi-, for/about (the verb bālā chooses bi-, 'care about') + nafs, soul, life (f., gen.); 'cares for a soul'
فَبَرَزَ: فَـ + بَرَزَ — fa-, and then (sequence) + baraza, to come out, step forth (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and there came out'
اَقْبَلْتُ: أَقْبَلْتُ — aqbala, to approach, come (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'I have come'
لَهَبْ: لَهَب — lahab, flame (m., nom., predicate/subject of the nominal clause; pausal sukūn for rhyme); 'a flame'
اُنَادِي: أُنَادِي — nādā, to call out, cry (verb III, imperf. 1s indicative); 'I call out'
صَحْبِي: صَحْب + ـِي — ṣaḥb, comrades, companions (collective m., gen., after ʿinda) + -ī, my; 'among my comrades'
الْحَرْبْ: الـ + حَرْب — ḥarb, war (f., gen., after fī; pausal sukūn for rhyme); 'the war'
سَادَاتِ: سَادَات — sādāt, lords, chiefs (pl. of sayyid, f.-form sound plural, acc., object, first term of iḍāfa); 'the lords of'
الْعَرَبْ: الـ + عَرَب — ʿarab, the Arabs (m. pl., gen., second term of iḍāfa; pausal sukūn); 'the Arabs'
فَالْيَوْمَ: فَـ + الـ + يَوْم — fa-, so/therefore + al-, the + yawm, day (m., acc., adverbial); 'so today'
تُلْقِيْ: تُلْقِي — alqā, to throw, cast, i.e. find (verb IV, imperf. 2ms, with lā; ending -ī lengthened for the metre); 'you will not find/throw'
فِكَاكًا: فِكَاك — fikāk, release, ransom, escape (m., acc., object; tanwīn -an); 'release'
طَلَبْ: طَلَب — ṭalab, pursuit, claim (verbal noun of ṭalaba, m., gen., after min; pausal sukūn); 'from pursuit'
أَجَابَهُ: أَجَابَ + هُ — ajāba, to answer (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (acc. object); 'he answered him'
شَيْطَانِ: شَيْطَان — shayṭān, devil (m., gen., indef., after min, specifying 'wretched are you as a devil'); 'of a devil'
وَبِالْبُهْتَانِ: و + بِـ + الـ + بُهْتَان — wa-, and + bi-, with (jāʾa bi-, 'come with', the verb chooses bi-) + buhtān, slander (m., gen.); 'and with the slander'
اَلْيَوْمَ: الـ + يَوْم — yawm, day (m., acc., adverbial); 'today'
فَاتِكَ: فَاتِك — fātik, deadly, murderous (act. part. of fataka, verb I; m., acc., first term of iḍāfa with al-sinān, object of tulqī); 'deadly (spearhead)'
مَوْقِفِ: مَوْقِف — mawqif, standing-place, field (m., gen., after fī, first term of iḍāfa); 'in the field of'
اَخْطَأْتَ: أَخْطَأْتَ — akhṭaʾa, to err, be mistaken (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you erred'
أَرَدْتَ: أَرَدْتَ — arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, perf. 2ms); 'you wanted'
خَوْضَ: خَوْض — khawḍ, wading, plunging into (verbal noun of khāḍa, m., acc., object of arādta, first term of iḍāfa); 'the wading of'
بَحْرِي: بَحْر + ـِي — baḥr, sea (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa) + -ī, my; 'my sea'
اَخْتَلِسُ: أَخْتَلِسُ — ikhtalasa, to snatch, steal (verb VIII, imperf. 1s indicative); 'I snatch'
وَلَسْتَ: و + لَسْتَ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + laysa, to not be (defective verb, perf. 2ms, lastā); 'and you are not (aware)', with tadrī as predicate
ضَرْبَتَانِ: ضَرْبَتَانِ — ḍarba, blow, stroke (f. dual, nom., subject of ikhtalafa); 'two blows'
ضَرْبَةُ: ضَرْبَة — ḍarba, blow, stroke (f. sing., nom., subject of kānat, first term of iḍāfa); 'the blow of'
السَّابِقَةَ: الـ + سَابِقَة — sābiqa, going first, preceding (act. part. f. of sabaqa, verb I; acc., predicate of kānat); 'the one going first'
قُتِلُوا: قُتِلُوا — qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. passive 3m pl.); 'had been killed'
أُطِقْهُ: أُطِقْ + هُ — aṭāqa, to be able to bear, be a match for (verb IV, imperf. 1s jussive after lam, hollow verb shortened) + -hu, him (acc.); 'I shall not be a match for him'
هَرَبْتُ: هَرَبْتُ — haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 1s, perfect in a conditional after inna); 'I flee' Also plain past, 'I fled': fa-innī harabtu ʿindaka, 'for I fled to you'.
مَعْيَرَةً: مَعْيَرَة — maʿyara, shame, disgrace, byword (f., acc., predicate/ḥāl of abqā); 'a shame'
انْقَضَّ: انْقَضَّ — inqaḍḍa, to swoop down upon (verb VII, perf. 3ms, with ʿalā); 'he swooped'
فَأَطَاحَنِي: فَـ + أَطَاحَ + نِي — fa-, and then + aṭāḥa, to fling down, hurl (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and flung me'
سَرْجِي: سَرْج + ـِي — sarj, saddle (m., gen., after min) + -ī, my; 'from my saddle'
فَتَعَلَّقْتُ: فَـ + تَعَلَّقْتُ — fa-, and then + taʿallaqa, to cling, hang on (verb V, perf. 1s; takes bi- 'cling to'); 'and I clung'
بِأَذْيَالِهِ: بِـ + أَذْيَال + هِ — bi-, to/by (taʿallaqa bi-, the verb chooses bi-, 'cling to') + adhyāl, skirts (pl. of dhayl, m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his skirts'
