فَحَمَلَنِي: فَـ + حَمَلَ + نِي — fa-, and then + ḥamala, to carry, lift (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and he carried me'
بِكَفِّهِ: بِـ + كَفّ + هِ — bi-, in/with + kaff, palm, hand (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'in his palm'
كَالْعُصْفُورِ: كَـ + الـ + عُصْفُور — ka-, like + al-, the + ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m., gen.); 'like the sparrow'
مَثْوَاهُ: مَثْوَى + هُ — mathwā, lodging, abode (maṣdar mīmī of thawā, m., acc., object of aḥsinī) + -hu, his; 'his lodging'
زِمَامِنَا: زِمَام + نَا — zimām, halter, rein, i.e. protection (m., gen., after fī) + -nā, our; 'into our protection'
فَقَبَضَتِ: فَـ + قَبَضَتِ — fa-, and then + qabaḍa, to seize, take hold (verb I, perf. 3fs, with ʿalā; final -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'and she took hold'
أَطْوَاقِ: أَطْوَاق — aṭwāq, collars (pl. of ṭawq, m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'the collars of'
دِرْعِي: دِرْع + ـِي — dirʿ, mail-coat (m./f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my mail-coat'
تَقُودُنِي: تَقُودُ + نِي — qāda, to lead (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, hollow) + -nī, me (acc.); 'she leads me'
لَأْمَةَ: لَأْمَة — laʾma, armour, coat of mail (f., acc., object, first term of iḍāfa with al-ḥarb); 'the armour of'
بَيَّضَ: بَيَّضَ — bayyaḍa, to whiten, make bright (verb II, perf. 3ms, optative 'may God whiten'); 'whiten'
عِرْضَكَ: عِرْض + كَ — ʿirḍ, honour, good name (m., acc., object) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your honour'
عُدَّةً: عُدَّة — ʿudda, provision, equipment, resource (f., acc., second object of jaʿala); 'a provision'; also (Night 202): عُدَّة — ʿudda, equipment, gear (f.; the shadda is printed); acc. indef., object of ʿamila: ʿamila lahu ʿuddatan, 'he made him a set of instruments'
لِلنَّائِبَاتِ: لِـ + الـ + نَائِبَات — li-, for/against + al-, the + nāʾiba, calamity, misfortune (f. pl., gen.); 'for the calamities'
أُخْتِي: أُخْت + ـِي — ukht, sister (f., nom., subject of taqūlu) + -ī, my; 'my sister'
لَوَامِعَ: لَوَامِع — lawāmiʿ, gleamings, flashes (pl. of lāmiʿa, act. part. of lamaʿa; f. broken pl., acc., object of raʾat, diptote); 'the gleamings of'
غُرَّتِي: غُرَّة + ـِي — ghurra, blaze, brow, white mark (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my blaze'
الشُّعَاعِ: الـ + شُعَاع — shuʿāʿ, sunbeam, ray (m., gen., after mithla); 'the sunbeam'
شُجَاعِ: شُجَاع — shujāʿ, brave, hero (m., gen., indef., specifying after min, 'what a hero'); 'of a hero'
تَذَلُّ: تَذَلُّ — dhalla, to be humbled, abased (verb I, imperf. 3fs indicative, agreeing with the broken plural usud); 'are humbled'
لِحَرْبِهِ: لِـ + حَرْب + هِ — li-, to/before (dhalla li-, the verb chooses li-, 'be humbled before') + ḥarb, war + -hi, his; 'before his warring'
اُسْدُ: أُسْد — usd, lions (pl. of asad, m., nom., subject of tadhillu; pausal pattern usud); 'the lions of'
سَلِي: سَلِي — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperative 2fs, saʾala for isʾalī, the hamza dropped); 'ask!'
اَرْبَابُ: أَرْبَاب — arbāb, lords, masters (pl. of rabb, m., nom., subject of farra, first term of iḍāfa); 'the lords of'
سَعْدِي: سَعْد + ـِي — saʿd, good fortune (m., gen., after fī) + -ī, my; 'my fortune'
وَعَزْمِي: و + عَزْم + ـِي — wa-, and + ʿazm, resolve (m., nom., subject of ʿalā) + -ī, my; 'and my resolve'
ارْتِفَاعِ: ارْتِفَاع — irtifāʿ, rising, height (verbal noun of verb VIII, m., gen., after ayya, 'what a rising'); 'height'
نَازَلْتَ: نَازَلْتَ — nāzala, to engage in single combat, come down to fight (verb III, perf. 2ms); 'you have fought'
لَيْثًا: لَيْث — layth, lion (m., acc., object); 'a lion'
يُرِيكَ: يُرِي + كَ — arā, to show (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indicative) + -ka, you (2ms, first acc. object); 'shows you'
كَالْاَفَاعِي: كَـ + الـ + أَفَاعِي — ka-, like + al-, the + afāʿī, vipers (pl. of afʿā, f.; gen., defective diptote pattern); 'like the vipers'
شِعْرَهُ: شِعْر + هُ — shiʿr, poetry, verse (m., acc., object) + -hu, his; 'his poetry'
حِرْتُ: حِرْتُ — ḥāra, to be perplexed, at a loss (verb I, hollow, perf. 1s); 'I was perplexed'
وَتَصَاغَرَتْ: و + تَصَاغَرَتْ — wa-, and + taṣāghara, to grow small, shrink (verb VI, perf. 3fs, agreeing with nafsī); 'and grew small'
أُخْتِ: أُخْت — ukht, sister (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa, apposition to al-jāriya); 'the sister of'
الْفِتْنَةِ: الـ + فِتْنَة — fitna, trouble, strife, temptation (f., gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'of the trouble'
وَأَجْرَيْتُ: و + أَجْرَيْتُ — wa-, and + ajrā, to make flow (verb IV, perf. 1s); 'and I made flow'
خَلِيلِي: خَلِيل + ـِي — khalīl, friend (m., vocative, acc. in construct, nida omitted) + -ī, my; 'my friend'
لَوْمِي: لَوْم + ـِي — lawm, blame (m., gen., after ʿan) + -ī, my; 'my blame'
وَعَذْلِي: و + عَذْل + ـِي — wa-, and + ʿadhl, reproach (m., gen., coordinate with lawmī) + -ī, my; 'and my reproach'
لِلْمَلَامَةِ: لِـ + الـ + مَلَامَة — li-, to/for (wāʿin li-, 'heeding') + al-, the + malāma, reproach, blame (f., gen.); 'to reproach'
وَاعِ: وَاعٍ — wāʿin, heeding, attentive (act. part. of waʿā, verb I, defective; m., gen., after ghayr, predicate of inna); 'heeding'
كُلِفْتُ: كُلِفْتُ — kulifa, to be smitten, infatuated (verb I, passive perf. 1s; takes bi-); 'I am smitten'
بِغَادَةٍ: بِـ + غَادَة — bi-, with/by (kulifa bi-, the verb chooses bi-, 'smitten with') + ghāda, tender, supple young woman (f., gen.); 'with a tender maiden'
تُبْدِ: تُبْدِ — abdā, to show, display (verb IV, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam, defective); 'she did not show (herself)'
دَعَتْنِي: دَعَتْ + نِي — daʿā, to call, summon (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural al-dawāʿī) + -nī, me (acc.); 'summoned me'
الدَّوَاعِي: الـ + دَوَاعِي — dāʿī, summoner, motive (pl. dawāʿī, act. part. of daʿā; broken pl., nom., subject); 'the summoners'
هِمَّةٍ: هِمَّة — himma, resolve, ambition (f., gen., second term of iḍāfa after ṣāḥib); 'of resolve'
وَطَوِيلُ: و + طَوِيل — wa-, and + ṭawīl, long (adj. m., nom., first term of iḍāfa with bāʿ); 'and long (of)'
بَاعِ: بَاع — bāʿ, arm-span, reach, i.e. power (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'of reach'
فَدَعَانِي: فَـ + دَعَا + نِي — fa-, and then + daʿā, to invite (verb I, perf. 3ms; daʿā ilā, 'invite to') + -nī, me (acc.); 'and he invited me'
آنِيَةَ: آنِيَة — āniya, vessels (pl. of ināʾ, f. broken pl., acc., object, first term of iḍāfa); 'the vessels of'
وَعَيْشِكَ: و + عَيْش + كَ — wa-, by (wāw of oath) + ʿaysh, life (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your life'
جَهْلًا: جَهْل — jahl, ignorance (m., acc., tanwīn -an, after illā 'except in ignorance'); 'ignorance'; also: acc. of manner without illā, 'in ignorance, not knowing' (jassa al-ṭabību yadī jahlan, 'the physician felt my hand in ignorance')
حَمَّادُأَ: حَمَّاد + أَ — Ḥammād, the narrator (proper n., vocative, nom. without tanwīn) + a-, first letter of anā, 'I', run together by the scribe (text reads 'ḥammādu a nā'); 'O Ḥammād, I (am)'
عَبَّادُ: عَبَّاد — ʿAbbād, name of the youth (proper n., nom., predicate; first element of 'ʿAbbād ibn Tamīm ibn Thaʿlaba'); 'ʿAbbād'
تَمِيمِ: تَمِيم — Tamīm, name of ʿAbbād's father (proper n., gen., after ibn); 'Tamīm'
ثَعْلَبَةَ: ثَعْلَبَة — Thaʿlaba, name of the ancestor (proper n., gen., diptote, after ibn; cf. Banū Thaʿlaba); 'Thaʿlaba'
عِرْسَكَ: عِرْس + كَ — ʿirs, wife, spouse (m./f., acc., object of abqā) + -ka, your (2ms); 'your wife'
حَيَّانِي: حَيَّا + نِي — ḥayyā, to greet, toast, pledge (verb II, perf. 3ms, defective) + -nī, me (acc.); 'he toasted me'
بِقَدَحٍ: بِـ + قَدَح — bi-, with (ḥayyā bi-, 'pledge with') + qadaḥ, cup (m., gen.); 'with a cup'
وَحَيَّانِي: و + حَيَّا + نِي — wa-, and + ḥayyā, to toast (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and he toasted me'
بِثَانٍ: بِـ + ثَانٍ — bi-, with + thānin, second (ordinal of ithnān, m., gen., defective, indef.); 'with a second'
فَشَرِبْتُ: فَـ + شَرِبْتُ — fa-, and so + shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I drank'
وَنَادَمَنِي: و + نَادَمَ + نِي — wa-, and + nādama, to keep company over wine, be a boon-companion (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and he drank with me'
وَحَلَّفَنِي: و + حَلَّفَ + نِي — wa-, and + ḥallafa, to make swear, put on oath (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (acc.); 'and he made me swear'
أَخُونُهُ: أَخُونُ + هُ — khāna, to betray (verb I, imperf. 1s indicative, hollow, after anna lā) + -hu, him (acc.); 'I would betray him'
يَمِينٍ: يَمِين — yamīn, oath (f., gen. sing., counted noun after the hundreds); 'oaths'
وَأَفْرَغَتْهَا: و + أَفْرَغَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + afragha, to pour out (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hā, them (3fs pronoun for plural non-human, acc.; the robes); 'and she poured them (over me)'
بِنَاقَةٍ: بِـ + نَاقَة — bi-, with (atā bi-, 'bring', the verb chooses bi-) + nāqa, she-camel (f., gen.); 'a she-camel'
النِّيَاقِ: الـ + نِّيَاق — niyāq, she-camels (pl. of nāqa, f. broken pl., gen., after min of partition); 'the she-camels'
فَأَتَتْنِي: فَـ + أَتَتْ + نِي — fa-, and so + atā, to come, bring (verb I, perf. 3fs, with bi- 'bring') + -nī, to me (acc.); 'and she brought me'
مُحَمَّلَةٍ: مُحَمَّلَة — muḥammala, laden (pass. part. of ḥammala, verb II; f., gen., adj. agreeing in the f. sg. with a broken plural, here jimāl, 'camels'); 'laden'
تُحْضِرَ: تُحْضِرَ — aḥḍara, to bring, fetch (verb IV, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after an); 'that she bring'
الْأَشْقَرَ: الـ + أَشْقَر — ashqar, sorrel, reddish (colour adj., m., acc., diptote, qualifying al-ḥiṣān); 'the sorrel'
مَوْجُودٌ: مَوْجُود — mawjūd, present, found (pass. part. of wajada, verb I; m., nom., predicate); 'is present'
لِأُرِيحَ: لِـ + أُرِيحَ — li-, in order to (purpose) + arāḥa, to rest, give repose to (verb IV, imperf. 1s subjunctive); 'to rest (myself)'
ثَائِرَةً: ثَائِرَة — thāʾira, rising, stirred up (act. part. f. of thāra, verb I; f. sing., acc., agreeing with collective khayl); 'rising up'
تَفْزَعْ: تَفْزَعْ — fazaʿa, to be alarmed, afraid (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive after lā of prohibition; takes min 'at'); 'do not be alarmed'
يَطْلُبُونَ: يَطْلُبُونَ — ṭalaba, to seek (verb I, imperf. 3m pl. indicative, circumstantial ḥāl); 'seeking'
تَوَسَّدَ: تَوَسَّدَ — tawassada, to take as a pillow, lay one's head on (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'he pillowed (his head on)'
اسْتَغْرَقَ: اسْتَغْرَقَ — istaghraqa, to be sunk, absorbed (verb X, perf. 3ms); 'he was sunk (in sleep)'
وَسْوَسَ: وَسْوَسَ — waswasa, to whisper, suggest evil (quadriliteral verb I, perf. 3ms; takes ilā, 'to me'); 'whispered'
وَجَذَبْتُ: و + جَذَبْتُ — wa-, and + jadhaba, to pull, draw (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I pulled'
أَطَاحَتْ: أَطَاحَتْ — aṭāḥa, to send flying, knock off (verb IV, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ḍarba); 'sent flying'
جُثَّتِهِ: جُثَّة + هِ — juththa, body, corpse (f., gen., after ʿan) + -hi, his; 'from his body'
الْاَهْلِ: الـ + أَهْل — ahl, kinsfolk, family (m., gen., after ilā); 'to the kinsfolk'
اَشْأَمُ: أَشْأَم — ashʾam, most ill-omened (elative of shuʾm, m., nom., predicate; diptote, first term of iḍāfa); 'the most ill-omened (of)'
الْخَبَرْ: الـ + خَبَر — khabar, news, tidings (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa; pausal sukūn); 'of the tidings'
مَفَرْ: مَفَرّ — mafarr, escape, refuge (maṣdar mīmī of farra, m., nom., delayed subject of 'there is not for a man'; pausal); 'an escape'
صَرِيعٌ: صَرِيع — ṣarīʿ, felled, thrown down (m., nom., predicate of anta); 'felled'
اَخِيْ: أَخِ + ـِي — akh, brother (m., vocative, in construct) + -ī, my; 'my brother'
مُتَجَنْدِلٌ: مُتَجَنْدِل — mutajandil, stretched on the ground, sprawled on stones (act. part. of quadriliteral tajandala, verb II-type; m., nom., second predicate); 'flung to the ground'
دَوْرَةَ: دَوْرَة — dawra, round, revolution, circuit (f., acc., object of yaḥkī, first term of iḍāfa); 'the round of'
الْقَمَرْ: الـ + قَمَر — qamar, moon (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa; pausal sukūn); 'of the moon'
الشُّوْمِ: الـ + شُّوْم — shūm (for shuʾm), ill-omen, bad luck (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa; hamza softened); 'of ill omen'
لَقِيتَهُمْ: لَقِيتَ + هُمْ — laqiya, to meet (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hum, them (3m pl., acc. object); 'you met them'
وَرُمْحُكَ: و + رُمْح + كَ — wa-, and + rumḥ, spear (m., nom., subject) + -ka, your; 'and your spear'
اِطِّرَادٍ: اِطِّرَاد — iṭṭirād, charging, galloping in pursuit (verbal noun of verb VIII, m., gen., after min baʿdi); 'of charging'
انْكَسَرْ: انْكَسَرْ — inkasara, to break (verb VII, perf. 3ms, with qad; pausal sukūn); 'has broken'
وَبَعْدَكَ: و + بَعْد + كَ — wa-, and + baʿda, after (prep., acc., first term of iḍāfa) + -ka, you (2ms, gen.); 'and after you'
لِلْخَيْلِ: لِـ + الـ + خَيْل — li-, in/for (yartāḥu li-, 'take delight in'; the verb chooses li-) + al-, the + khayl, horses (collective f., gen.); 'in the horses'
الْاُنْثَى: الـ + أُنْثَى — unthā, female (f. noun-adj., nom., subject of talidu); 'the female'
نَظِيرُكَ: نَظِير + كَ — naẓīr, like, equal (m., object of talidu, vocalised nom. though acc. expected, scribal lapse) + -ka, your; 'your equal'
ذَكَرْ: ذَكَر — dhakar, male (m., gen., after min, specifying 'a male'); pausal sukūn; 'a male'
وَاَصْبَحَ: و + أَصْبَحَ — wa-, and + aṣbaḥa, to become (verb IV, perf. 3ms, kāna-type, with nom. subject and acc. predicate); 'and has become'
قَاتِلًا: قَاتِل — qātil, killer (act. part. of qatala, verb I; m., acc., predicate of aṣbaḥa); 'a killer'
اَيْمَانًا: أَيْمَان — aymān, oaths (pl. of yamīn, broken pl., acc., object of khāna); 'oaths'
وَبِالْعَهْدِ: و + بِـ + الـ + عَهْد — wa-, and + bi-, with (ghadara bi-, 'betray, break faith with', the verb chooses bi-) + al-, the + ʿahd, covenant, pledge (m., gen.); 'and the covenant'
غَدَرْ: غَدَرْ — ghadara, to betray, break faith (verb I, perf. 3ms, with qad; pausal sukūn); 'he has broken (faith)'
يُرِيْدُ: يُرِيدُ — arāda, to want, intend (verb IV, imperf. 3ms indicative); 'he wants'
يَنَالَ: يَنَالَ — nāla, to attain, obtain (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an, hollow); 'to attain'
اَمَرْ: أَمَرْ — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3ms, relative clause 'in all that he commanded'; pausal sukūn); 'he commanded'
الْجَدَّيْنِ: الـ + جَدَّيْنِ — jadd, grandfather (m. dual, gen., second term of iḍāfa after malʿūn); 'of the two grandfathers'
وَخُنْتَهُ: و + خُنْتَ + هُ — wa-, and + khāna, to betray (verb I, perf. 2ms, hollow) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and betrayed him'
مُرَادُهُ: مُرَاد + هُ — murād, intent, desire (pass. part. of arāda used as noun, m., nom., subject of kāna) + -hu, his; 'his intent'
بِالزَّادِ: بِـ + الـ + زَّاد — bi-, with (radda ilā ... bi-, 'send back with') + al-, the + zād, provisions (m., gen.); 'with the provisions'
يُزَوِّجَنِي: يُزَوِّجَ + نِي — zawwaja, to marry off, give in marriage (verb II, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an) + -nī, me (acc., with nūn al-wiqāya); 'to marry me (to you)'
جَذَبَتْ: جَذَبَتْ — jadhaba, to draw, pull (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she drew'
قَائِمَهُ: قَائِم + هُ — qāʾim, hilt (lit. 'upright part', m., acc., first object of jaʿalat) + -hu, its; 'its hilt'; also: acc., object of gharaza: gharaztu qāʾimahu fī al-arḍi, 'I planted its hilt in the ground' (Night 179)
وَطَرَفَهُ: و + طَرَف + هُ — wa-, and + ṭaraf, point, tip (m., acc., second object) + -hu, its; 'and its point'
فَخَرَّتْ: فَـ + خَرَّتْ — fa-, and so + kharra, to fall down (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she fell'
لَايَنْفَعُنِي: لَا + يَنْفَعُ + نِي — lā, not + nafaʿa, to profit, benefit (verb I, imperf. 3ms indicative) + -nī, me (acc.), written as one word; 'does not profit me'
مَاخَفَّ: مَا + خَفَّ — mā, that which (relative pronoun) + khaffa, to be light (verb I, perf. 3ms), written as one word; 'what was light'
حِمْلُهُ: حِمْل + هُ — ḥiml, load, burden (m., nom., subject of khaffa) + -hu, its; 'its load'
وَعَجَلَتِى: و + عَجَلَة + ـِي — wa-, and + ʿajala, haste (f., gen., coordinated with khawfī after min) + -ī, my (written with ى); 'and my haste'
الْخَدَّامَةِ: الـ + خَدَّامَة — khaddāma, servant, serving girl (f., gen., adj. in apposition to al-bint); 'the servant (girl)'
الْبَدَوِىِّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — badawī, Bedouin (nisba adj. used as noun, m., gen. after min, 'from'); 'from the Bedouin'
جَرَّدَتِ: جَرَّدَتِ — jarrada, to strip, draw (a sword) (verb II, perf. 3fs; final tāʾ takes kasra before al-); 'she drew'
الْبَدَوِىَّ: الـ + بَدَوِيّ — badawī, Bedouin (m., acc., object of ḍarabat); 'the Bedouin'
حَمَّادًا: حَمَّاد — Ḥammād, personal name (acc., tanwīn, in apposition to al-badawī); 'Ḥammād'
فَأَطْلَعَتْهُ: فَـ + أَطْلَعَتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aṭlaʿa, to bring out, make emerge (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + 3ms obj.; 'so that she brought it out'
عَلَائِقِهِ: عَلَائِق + ـهِ — ʿalāʾiq, ties, attachments (pl. of ʿalāqa; gen. after min, 'from') + 3ms poss.; here the parts hanging on the shoulder, 'from his hanging parts'
اسْتَعْجَلْتِ: اسْتَعْجَلْتِ — istaʿjala, to hurry, be hasty (Form X, perf. 2fs; with ʿalā, 'to do' something); 'you hurried'
فَسَحَ: فَسَحَ — fasaḥa, to make wide, lengthen (verb I, perf. 3ms; with fī, 'in'); 'he lengthened'
أَجَلِي: أَجَل + ـي — ajal, appointed term, span of life (m., gen. after fī, 'in') + 1cs poss.; 'my life-span'
ثَأْرِي: ثَأْر + ـي — thaʾr, vengeance, blood-revenge (m., acc., object of akhadhtu) + 1cs poss.; 'my vengeance'
الْعَبِيدَأَنْ: الـ + عَبِيد + أَنْ — ʿabīd, slaves (pl. of ʿabd; m., acc., object of amarat) run together in print with an, 'that' (introduces the subjunctive clause); 'the slaves, that'
يَجُرُّوهُ: يَجُرُّ + وهُ — jarra, to drag (verb I, doubled, imperf. 3mpl. subjunctive after an; final -ū) + 3ms obj.; 'they drag him'
وَيَرْمُوهُ: وَ + يَرْمُوهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ramā, to throw (verb I, defective, imperf. 3mpl. subjunctive after an, coordinated) + 3ms obj.; 'and throw him'
الْبَاقِيَيْنِ: الـ + بَاقِي + يَيْنِ — al-, the + bāqī, remaining, left (act. part. of baqiya; m. dual, gen. after min-clause, in apposition to al-ithnayn); 'the two who were left'
فَاصْدُقْنَا: فَـ + اصْدُقْ + نَا — fa-, so (conj.) + ṣadaqa, to tell the truth to (verb I, imperative 2ms; takes a direct object of person) + -nā, us; 'so tell us truly'
يُتِمَّ: يُتِمَّ — atamma, to complete, finish (verb IV, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam, negating the past); 'he did not finish'
بِالْحُسَامِ: بِـ + الـ + حُسَام — bi-, with (prep., instrumental) + al-, the + ḥusām, sword, sharp blade (m., gen.); 'with the sword'
أَحْيَانِي: أَحْيَا + نِي — aḥyā, to give life to, keep alive (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he has let me live'
ثَأْرَ: ثَأْر — thaʾr, vengeance, blood-revenge (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa with ummī); 'the vengeance for'
دَايَتَهُ: دَايَة + ـهُ — dāya, nurse, governess (f., acc., subject of anna) + 3ms poss.; 'his nurse'
الْجَمَّالَ: الـ + جَمَّال — jammāl, camel-driver (m., acc., predicate of kāna); 'the camel-driver'
اكْتَرَوْهُ: اكْتَرَ + وْهُ — iktarā, to hire (verb VIII, defective, perf. 3mpl., -ū + 3ms obj.); 'they hired him'
وَتَوْصِيلِهِ: وَ + تَوْصِيل + ـهِ — wa-, and + tawṣīl, conveying, delivering (verbal noun of Form II waṣṣala; m., gen., coordinated with ḥaml) + 3ms obj.; 'and delivering him'
يُوصِلَهُ: يُوصِلَ + هُ — awṣala, to bring, convey (verb IV, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an; with ilā, 'to') + 3ms obj.; 'he bring him'
وَيَرْمِيَهُ: وَ + يَرْمِيَ + هُ — wa-, and + ramā, to throw, cast (verb I, defective, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an, coordinated) + 3ms obj.; 'and cast him'
بِالدَّرَاهِمِ: بِـ + الـ + دَرَاهِم — bi-, for, in exchange for (prep. of price) + al-, the + dirham, silver coin (pl. darāhim; gen.); 'for the dirhams'
جَازَيْتُ: جَازَيْتُ — jāzā, to repay, requite (verb III, perf. 1cs; takes a direct object, with bi-, 'for'); 'I repaid'
الْخَائِنَ: الـ + خَائِن — khāʾin, traitor (act. part. of khāna; m., acc., object of jāzaytu, after hādhā); 'the traitor'
الْمُلَقَّبَةُ: الـ + مُلَقَّبَة — mulaqqab, nicknamed, surnamed (pass. part. of Form II laqqaba; f., nom., qualifying al-ʿajūz); 'the one called'
الْبَلَايَا: الـ + بَلَايَا — balāyā, calamities, trials (pl. of balīya/balwā; f., gen. after hādhihi); 'the calamities'
أَوْقَعَتْنَا: أَوْقَعَ + تْ + نَا — awqaʿa, to cause to fall (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -nā, us (obj.); 'she made us fall'
حُضُورِهَا: حُضُور + ـهَا — ḥuḍūr, presence, coming (verbal noun of ḥaḍara I; m., gen. after min) + 3fs poss.; 'her coming'
وَكَسَرَ: وَ + كَسَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + kasara, to break, rout (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he routed'
وَأَسَرَ: وَ + أَسَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + asara, to take captive (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he took captive'
مُلُوكَهُمْ: مُلُوك + هُمْ — mulūk, kings (pl. of malik; m., acc., object of asara) + 3mpl. poss.; 'their kings'
بُدٍّ: بُدّ — budd, escape, alternative (m., gen. after min, 'from'; min kulli budd, 'by every necessity'); 'without fail'
أَمَانٌ: أَمَان — amān, safety, security (m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of al-bilād); 'safe'
وَتَجَهَّزَتْ: وَ + تَجَهَّزَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tajahhaza, to get oneself ready, equip oneself (Form V, perf. 3fs); 'and she made ready'
صَحِبَهُمْ: صَحِبَ + هُمْ — ṣaḥiba, to accompany (verb I, perf. 3ms, relative clause after man) + 3mpl. obj.; 'who accompanied them'
بِحُضُورِهَا: بِـ + حُضُور + ـهَا — bi-, about, of (prep.; akhbara takes the matter with bi-, 'inform of') + ḥuḍūr, coming (m., gen.) + 3fs poss.; 'of her arrival'
الْمَصْلَحَةُ: الـ + مَصْلَحَة — maṣlaḥa, interest, expedience, prudence (f., nom.); 'prudence'
تَقْتَضِي: تَقْتَضِي — iqtaḍā, to require, call for (verb VIII, defective, imperf. 3fs indic.; subject al-maṣlaḥa); 'requires'
نَلْبَسُ: نَلْبَسُ — labisa, to put on, wear (verb I, imperf. 1cp indic.); 'we wear'
الْإِفْرِنْجِ: الـ + إِفْرِنْج — al-, the + ifranj, the Franks, Europeans (m. collective, gen., second term of an iḍāfa after libs); 'of the Franks'
وَنُقَابِلُ: وَ + نُقَابِلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qābala, to meet, go to meet (verb III, imperf. 1cp indic.); 'and we meet'
نَأْمَنَ: نَأْمَنَ — amina, to be safe, feel secure (verb I, imperf. 1cp subjunctive after ḥattā; with min, 'from'); 'we be safe'
خِدَاعِهَا: خِدَاع + ـهَا — khidāʿ, deceit, trickery (m., gen. after min, 'from') + 3fs poss.; 'her trickery'
وَحِيَلِهَا: وَ + حِيَل + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥiyal, wiles, stratagems (pl. of ḥīla; f., gen., coordinated) + 3fs poss.; 'and her wiles'
لِبَاسَ: لِبَاس — libās, clothing, dress (m., acc., object of labisū; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the dress of'
الرَّبِّ: الـ + رَبّ — rabb, lord (m., gen. after ḥaqq in the oath wa-ḥaqqi; first element of al-rabb al-maʿbūd); 'the Lord'
الْمَعْبُودِ: الـ + مَعْبُود — maʿbūd, worshipped (pass. part. of ʿabada I; m., gen., adjective of al-rabb); 'the worshipped'
أَعْرِفُكُمْ: أَعْرِفُ + كُمْ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, imperf. 1cs indic.) + 2mpl. obj.; 'I know you'
إِفْرِنْجٌ: إِفْرِنْج + ٌ — ifranj, Franks, a Frank (m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of inna-kum); 'Franks'
يُقَابِلُونَ: يُقَابِلُ + ونَ — qābala, to go out to meet (verb III, imperf. 3mpl. indic., describing manner of kharajū); 'meeting'
وَقَعَتِ: وَقَعَتِ — waqaʿa, to fall, light upon (verb I, perf. 3fs; final tāʾ takes kasra before al-); 'fell'
تَرَجَّلَتْ: تَرَجَّلَتْ — tarajjala, to dismount, alight on foot (Form V, perf. 3fs; with ilā, 'towards'); 'she dismounted'
فَقَرَطَ: فَـ + قَرَطَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + qaraṭa, to squeeze, pinch hard (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he squeezed'
أَضْلَاعِهَا: أَضْلَاع + ـهَا — aḍlāʿ, ribs (pl. of ḍilʿ; m., gen. after ʿalā, 'on') + 3fs poss.; 'her ribs'
تُتِمَّ: تُتِمَّ — atamma, to complete, finish (verb IV, imperf. 3fs jussive after lam); 'she did not finish'
وَالْغِلْمَانِ: وَ + الـ + غِلْمَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ghilmān, boys, pages (pl. of ghulām; m., gen., coordinated with al-jawārī); 'and the pages'
وَأَخَذُوهُمْ: وَ + أَخَذُوا + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + akhadha, to seize, take (verb I, perf. 3mpl.) + 3mpl. obj.; 'and they seized them'
جَمِيعَهُمْ: جَمِيع + ـهُمْ — jamīʿ, all, whole (m., acc., in apposition to the object) + 3mpl. poss.; 'all of them'
فَزَيَّنُوهَا: فَـ + زَيَّنُوا + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + zayyana, to adorn, decorate (verb II, perf. 3mpl.) + 3fs obj. (Baghdad); 'and they adorned it'
الْخُوصِ: الـ + خُوص — khūṣ, palm-leaves, plaited palm-fibre (m. collective, gen. after min, 'of'); 'of palm-leaf'
بِرَوْثِ: بِـ + رَوْث — bi-, with (prep., instrumental; mukallal bi-, 'crowned with') + rawth, dung (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with the dung of'
الْحَمِيرِ: الـ + حَمِير — ḥamīr, donkeys (pl. of ḥimār; m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of donkeys'
يَتَجَارَى: يَتَجَارَى — tajārā, to dare, presume (Form VI, defective, imperf. 3ms indic.; with ʿalā, 'against'); 'he presumes against'
صَلَبُوهَا: صَلَبُوا + هَا — ṣalaba, to crucify (verb I, perf. 3mpl.) + 3fs obj.; 'they crucified her'
أَصْحَابُهَا: أَصْحَاب + ـهَا — aṣḥāb, companions, followers (pl. of ṣāḥib; m., nom., subject of raʾā) + 3fs poss.; 'her followers'
أَسْلَمُوا: أَسْلَمُوا — aslama, to submit, become Muslim (verb IV, perf. 3mpl.); 'they became Muslims'
وَعَمَّهُ: وَ + عَمّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿamm, paternal uncle (m., nom., coordinated with the subject) + 3ms poss.; 'and his uncle'
الْكُتَّابَ: الـ + كُتَّاب — kuttāb, scribes (pl. of kātib; m., acc., object of amarū); 'the scribes'
يُؤَرِّخُوهَا: يُؤَرِّخُوا + هَا — arrakha, to record, date, chronicle (verb II, imperf. 3mpl. subjunctive after an) + 3fs obj.; 'that they record it'
تُقْرَأَ: تُقْرَأَ — quriʾa, to be read (verb I passive, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after ḥattā; subject the story); 'it be read'
بَعْدِهِمْ: بَعْد + ِهِمْ — baʿd, after (m., gen. after min, 'from') + 3mpl. poss.; 'after them'
وَالْهَنَاهِ: وَ + الـ + هَنَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + hanāʾ, ease, contentment (m., gen., coordinated with al-ʿaysh; final -h as printed); 'and contentment'
تَصَارِيفِ: تَصَارِيف — taṣārīf, vicissitudes, changes (pl. of taṣrīf; m., gen. after min, 'of'); 'the turns of'
ضَوْ: ضَوْ — Ḍaw, the print's spelling (without hamza) of ḍawʾ, light: first element of the name Ḍawʾ al-Makān (gen., in apposition to waladihi, 'his son'); 'Ḍawʾ'
وَوَلَدِ: وَ + وَلَد — wa-, and (conj.) + walad, son (m., gen., coordinated with ʿUmar); 'and the son of'
وَبِنْتِهَا: وَ + بِنْت + ـهَا — wa-, and + bint, daughter (f., gen., coordinated) + 3fs poss.; 'and her daughter'
لِشَهْرَ: لِـ + شَهْر — li-, to (prep.; qāla li- marks the person addressed) + Shahr, first half of the name Shahrazād, printed split (gen., diptote); 'to Shahr(azād)'
انْشَرَحَ: انْشَرَحَ — insharaḥa, to be expanded, be gladdened (verb VII, perf. 3ms; subject ṣadruhu); 'was gladdened'
عَاقِبَتُكِ: عَاقِبَة + كِ — ʿāqiba, outcome, end (f., nom., subject of takūna) + 2fs poss.; 'your outcome'
مَحْمُودَةً: مَحْمُودَة — maḥmūd, praised, commendable (pass. part. of ḥamida I; f., acc., tanwīn; predicate of takūna); 'a good one'
طَاؤُوسٌ: طَاؤُوس — ṭāʾūs, peacock (m., nom., tanwīn; subject of kāna); 'a peacock'
يَأْوِي: يَأْوِي — ʾawā, to take shelter (verb I, imperf. 3ms; relative clause on 'peacock'; with ilā, 'to/by'); '(that) took shelter'
الْمَوْضِعُ: الْ + مَوْضِع — al-, the + mawḍiʿ, place (m., nom.; subject of kāna, after ذَلِكَ); 'the place'
وَالْأَنْهَارِ: وَ + الْ + أَنْهَار — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + anhār, rivers (pl. of nahr; gen., coordinated with الأشجار after kathīr); 'and rivers'
الطَّاؤُوسُ: الـ + طَاؤُوس — al-, the + ṭāʾūs, peacock (m., nom., subject; after ذَلِكَ, resumed by hūwa); 'the peacock'
يَأْوِيَانِ: يَأْوِيَانِ — ʾawā, to take shelter (verb I, imperf. 3m dual, nom.; agrees with peacock and wife; with ilā, 'to'); 'they two take shelter'
وَيَغْدُوَانِ: وَ + يَغْدُوَانِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ghadā, to go out at dawn (verb I, imperf. 3m dual, nom.); 'and they two go out early'
الرِّزْقِ: الـ + رِّزْق — al-, the + rizq, provision, sustenance (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after طَلَب); 'of provision'
خَوْفُهُمَا: خَوْفُ + هُمَا — khawf, fear (m., nom., verbal noun of khāfa; subject of kathura) + -humā, 'their two' (dual possessor); 'their fear'
فَسَارَا: فَ + سَارَا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + sāra, to set out, travel (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'so they set out'
يَبْغِيَانِ: يَبْغِيَانِ — baghā, to seek (verb I, imperf. 3m dual, nom.; circumstantial ḥāl after sāra, takes direct object mawḍiʿan); 'seeking'
مَوْضِعِهِمَا: مَوْضِع + هِمَا — mawḍiʿ, place (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after ghayra) + -himā, 'their two'; 'their (own) place'
يُفَتِّشَانِ: يُفَتِّشَانِ — fattasha, to search (Form II, imperf. 3m dual, nom.; with ʿalā, 'for'; the verb chooses the preposition); '(were) searching for'
جَزِيرَةٌ: جَزِيرَة — jazīra, island (f., nom., tanwīn; subject of ẓaharat); 'an island'
وَأَكَلَا: وَ + أَكَلَا — wa-, and (conj.) + akala, to eat (verb I, perf. 3m dual); 'and they two ate'
أَثْمَارِهَا: أَثْمَار + هَا — athmār, fruits (pl. of thamar; gen., after min, partitive 'of') + -hā, 'its' (the island's); 'of its fruits'
بِبَطَّةٍ: بِ + بَطَّة — bi-, marks what appears after wa-idhā, 'and behold' (not 'with') + baṭṭa, duck (f., gen., tanwīn); 'and behold, a duck'
الْفَزَعِ: الـ + فَزَع — al-, the + fazaʿ, terror, fright (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa after shidda); 'of terror'
يَشُكَّ: يَشُكَّ — shakka, to doubt (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam; with fī, 'about/that', taking fī anna); 'did not doubt'
الْبَطَّةَ: الـ + بَطَّة — al-, the + baṭṭa, duck (f., acc., in apposition to tilka after anna); 'the duck'
فَسَأَلَهَا: فَ + سَأَلَ + هَا — fa-, so, and (conj.) + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, 'her' (direct object; second object by ʿan, 'about'); 'and he asked her'
وَخَوْفِي: وَ + خَوْفِي — wa-, and (conj.) + khawf, fear (m., gen., coordinated with al-ḥuzn after min) + -ī, 'my'; 'and my fear'
فَالْحَذَرَ: فَ + الْ + حَذَر — fa-, so (conj.) + al-, the + ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., acc., verbal noun in exclamatory command, 'beware'; repeated with thumma); 'so beware'
لَاتَخَافِي: لَا + تَخَافِي — lā, not (prohibitive) + takhāfī, fear (verb I, jussive 2fs; written as one word); 'do not fear'
الْبَطَّةُ: الـ + بَطَّة — al-, the + baṭṭa, duck (f., nom., subject of qālat); 'the duck'
بِقُرْبِكُمَا: بِ + قُرْب + كُمَا — bi-, by, through (prep., of cause or means) + qurb, nearness (m., gen.) + -kumā, 'your two'; 'by your nearness'
رَاغِبَةً: رَاغِبَة — rāghiba, desirous (act. part. of raghiba I; f., acc., tanwīn; ḥāl of the speaker; with fī, 'in', the verb chooses the preposition); 'desiring'
مَوَدَّتِكُمَا: مَوَدَّة + كُمَا — mawadda, friendship, affection (f., gen., after fī) + -kumā, 'your two'; 'your friendship'
الطَّاؤُسِ: الـ + طَاؤُس — al-, the + ṭāʾūs, peacock (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa with zawja); spelling of طَاؤُوس the print's shorter spelling, without the second waw; 'the peacock's'
فَمِنَ: فَ + مِنَ — fa-, for, so (conj.) + min, from (prep.; before al-barr, 'from the land'); 'for from'
فَأَبْشِرِي: فَ + أَبْشِرِي — fa-, so (conj.) + abshir, rejoice, receive good news (Form IV, imperative 2fs); 'so rejoice'
وَحَدِّثِينَا: وَ + حَدِّثِي + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaddithī, tell (Form II, imperative 2fs) + -nā, 'us' (object); with bi-, the thing told; 'and tell us'
وَاعْتَرَاكِ: وَ + اعْتَرَا + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtarā, to befall, come upon (Form VIII, perf. 3ms; relative clause) + -ki, 'you' (fs object); 'and came upon you'
الطَّاؤُسَةُ: الـ + طَاؤُسَة — al-, the + ṭāʾūsa, peahen (f., nom., vocative after ayyatuhā); spelling of طَاؤُوسَة the print's shorter spelling, without the second waw; 'O peahen'
آمِنَةٌ: آمِنَة — āmina, safe, secure (act. part. of amina I; f., nom., tanwīn; ḥāl, 'in safety'); 'safe'
لَاأَرَى: لَا + أَرَى — lā, not + ara, I see (verb I, imperf. 1cs of raʾā; written as one word); 'I did not see'
مَكْرُوهًا: مَكْرُوه — makrūh, something hateful, harm (pass. part. of kariha I; m., acc., tanwīn, object of arā); 'anything hateful' Also as the object of faʿala: وَلَا تَفْعَلُوا بِي مَكْرُوهًا 'and do me no harm'.
يُخَاطِبُنِي: يُخَاطِب + نِي — yukhāṭibu, he addresses (Form III, imperf. 3ms, nom.; ḥāl after wa-huwa) + -nī, 'me'; 'addressing me'
وَأُخَاطِبُهُ: وَ + أُخَاطِب + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ukhāṭibu, I address (Form III, imperf. 1cs) + -hu, 'him'; 'and I addressing him'
احْذَرِي: احْذَرِي — iḥdhar, beware (verb I, imperative 2fs; with min, 'of', the verb chooses the preposition); 'beware'
تَغْتَرِّي: تَغْتَرِّي — ightarra, to be deceived (Form VIII, jussive 2fs taghtarrī after lā; with bi-, 'by', the verb chooses the preposition); 'do not be beguiled'
وَلَابِمَا: وَ + لَا + بِ + مَا — wa-, and + lā, nor (repeating the prohibition) + bi-, by (prep.; as with taghtarrī) + mā, what (rel.); written as one word; 'nor by what'
يُدْخِلُهُ: يُدْخِل + هُ — yudkhilu, he brings in (Form IV, imperf. 3ms; relative clause after mā) + -hu, 'it'; 'he brings in'
الْحَذَرِ: الـ + حَذَر — al-, the + ḥadhar, caution (m., gen., after kull, 'all'; intensifying); 'the caution'
مَكْرِهِ: مَكْر + هِ — makr, cunning (m., gen., after min, 'of/against') + -hi, 'his'; 'his cunning'
مُخَادِعٌ: مُخَادِع — mukhādiʿ, deceiver (act. part. of Form III khādaʿa; m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of inna); 'a deceiver'
وَيَرُوْغُ: وَ + يَرُوْغُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yarūghu, he slips away, dodges (rāgha I, imperf. 3ms; the verse spells it with sukun on the waw, يَرُوْغُ for يَرُوغُ); 'and slips away'
يَرُوْغُ: يَرُوْغُ — yarūghu, he slips away (rāgha I, imperf. 3ms; spelled with sukun on the waw; after kamā, 'as'); 'slips away'
وَاعْلَمِي: وَ + اعْلَمِي — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿlamī, know (verb I, imperative 2fs; governs anna); 'and know'
يَحْتَالُ: يَحْتَالُ — iḥtāla, to use tricks (Form VIII, imperf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'against', the verb chooses the preposition); 'uses tricks on'
الْحِيتَانِ: الـ + حِيتَان — al-, the + ḥītān, fishes (pl. of ḥūt; gen., after ʿalā); 'the fishes'
فَيُخْرِجُهَا: فَ + يُخْرِج + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + yukhriju, he brings out (Form IV, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, 'them' (the fish); 'and brings them out'
بِبُنْدُقَةٍ: بِ + بُنْدُقَة — bi-, with (prep., instrumental) + bunduqa, pellet (f., gen., tanwīn; first term of an iḍāfa-like phrase with min ṭīn); 'with a pellet'
وَيُوقِعُ: وَ + يُوقِع — wa-, and (conj.) + yūqiʿu, he makes fall, brings down (Form IV, imperf. 3ms; takes direct object al-fīl); 'and brings down'
بَلَّغْتُكِ: بَلَّغْت + كِ — ballaghtu, I conveyed (Form II, perf. 1cs; takes two objects) + -ki, 'you' (fs); 'I have conveyed to you'
فَاسْتَيْقَظْتُ: فَ + اسْتَيْقَظْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + istayqaẓtu, I woke up (Form X, perf. 1cs; with min, 'from' sleep); 'so I woke'
خَائِفَةً: خَائِفَة — khāʾifa, fearful (act. part. of khāfa I; f., acc., tanwīn; ḥāl); 'fearful'
يَدْهَمَنِي: يَدْهَمَ + نِي — yadhamu, he falls upon, assails (dahama I, subjunctive 3ms after li-allā, 'lest') + -nī, 'me' (with nūn al-wiqāya); 'lest he fall upon me'
بِحِيلَتِهِ: بِ + حِيلَة + هِ — bi-, with, by (prep., instrumental) + ḥīla, trick (f., gen.) + -hi, 'his'; 'with his trick'
وَيَصِيدَنِي: وَ + يَصِيدَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaṣīda, he catches (ṣāda I, subjunctive 3ms, coordinated with yadhama after li-allā) + -nī, 'me'; 'and catch me'
بِحَبَائِلِهِ: بِ + حَبَائِل + هِ — bi-, with, by (prep., instrumental) + ḥabāʾil, snares (pl. of ḥibāla; gen.) + -hi, 'his'; 'with his snares'
وَبَطَلَتْ: وَ + بَطَلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + baṭalat, to come to nothing, be void (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and had come to nothing'
هِمَّتِي: هِمَّة + ـِي — himma, resolve, ambition (f., nom., subject of baṭalat) + -ī, 'my'; 'my resolve'
أَتَمَشَّى: أَتَمَشَّى — tamashshā, to walk about (Form V, imperf. 1cs; ḥāl after kharajtu); 'walking about'
مُكَدَّرٌ: مُكَدَّر — mukaddar, troubled, muddied (pass. part. of Form II kaddara; m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of khāṭirī); 'troubled'
مَقْبُوضٌ: مَقْبُوض — maqbūḍ, contracted, oppressed (pass. part. of qabaḍa I; m., nom., tanwīn; predicate of qalbī); 'contracted'
شِبْلًا: شِبْل — shibl, lion cub (m., acc., tanwīn; object of wajadtu); 'a lion cub'
الشِّبْلُ: الـ + شِّبْل — al-, the + shibl, lion cub (m., nom., subject of raʾānī/faria); 'the cub'
وَكَوْنِي: وَ + كَوْن + ـِي — wa-, and (conj.) + kawn, being (m., nom., verbal noun of kāna; coordinated with lawnī as subject of aʿjabahu, taking laṭīfata as predicate) + -ī, 'my'; 'and my being'
لَطِيفَةَ: لَطِيفَة — laṭīfa, delicate, graceful (f., acc., predicate of kawnī, first term of iḍāfa with al-dhāt); 'delicate of'
اقْرَبِي: اقْرَبِي — uqrubī, come near (verb I, imperative 2fs; with min, 'to' me); 'come near'
قَرِبْتُ: قَرِبْتُ — qaribtu, I came near (verb I, perf. 1cs, a variant of qaruba; with min, 'to'); 'I came near'
جِنْسُكِ: جِنْس + كِ — jins, kind, species (m., nom., predicate/subject of interrogative mā) + -ki, 'your' (fs); 'your kind'
بَطَّةٌ: بَطَّة — baṭṭa, duck (f., nom., tanwīn; predicate of ismī; proper name here); '(is) Duck'
قُعُودِكَ: قُعُود + كَ — quʿūd, sitting, staying (m., gen., verbal noun of qaʿada; second term of iḍāfa after sabab) + -ka, 'your' (ms); 'your sitting'
أَيَّامٌ: أَيَّام — ayyām, days (pl. of yawm; m., nom., tanwīn; subject of the preposition phrase lahu, 'he has days'); 'days'
يُحَذِّرُنِي: يُحَذِّر + نِي — yuḥadhdhiru, he warns (Form II, imperf. 3ms, nom.; with min, 'against') + -nī, 'me'; 'warning me'
الشِّبْلَ: الـ + شِّبْل — al-, the + shibl, cub (m., acc., after inna, object of ḥakā); 'the cub'
حَكَيْتُهُ: حَكَيْتُ + هُ — ḥakaytu, I told, related (ḥakā I, perf. 1cs; relative clause after mā) + -hu, 'it'; 'I told'
لَجَأْتُ: لَجَأْتُ — lajaʾtu, I took refuge (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ilā, 'to', the verb chooses the preposition); 'I have taken refuge with'
وَتَحْزِمَ: وَ + تَحْزِمَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥzima, you make firm, resolve (ḥazama I, subjunctive 2ms, after an in fī an taqtula); 'and make firm'
رَأْيَكَ: رَأْي + كَ — raʾy, opinion, judgement (m., acc., object of taḥzima) + -ka, 'your'; 'your judgement'
وَازْدَدْتُ: وَ + ازْدَدْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + izdadtu, I increased (Form VIII of zāda, perf. 1cs; takes khawfan as specification); 'and I increased'
خَوْفِكَ: خَوْف + كَ — khawf, fear (m., gen., after min; verbal noun with subjective ms) + -ka, 'your'; 'your fear'
أُحَذِّرُ: أُحَذِّرُ — uḥadhdhiru, I warn (Form II, imperf. 1cs; with min, 'against', after mā ziltu); 'warning'
وَأُوصِيهِ: وَ + أُوصِي + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ūṣī, I charge, enjoin (Form IV, imperf. 1cs; with bi-, 'with', the verb chooses the preposition) + -hi, 'him'; 'and charging him'
فَفَرْقَعَ: فَ + فَرْقَعَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + farqaʿa, to crack, snap (Form I quadriliteral, perf. 3ms); 'and he cracked'
بِذَنَبِهِ: بِ + ذَنَب + هِ — bi-, with (prep., instrumental) + dhanab, tail (m., gen.) + -hi, 'his'; 'with his tail'
مَفْرَقِ: مَفْرَق — mafraq, parting, fork (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa with al-ṭarīq; after ilā); 'the fork of'
غَبْرَةً: غَبْرَة — ghabra, cloud of dust (f., acc., tanwīn; object of wajadnā); 'a dust cloud'
انْكَشَفَتِ: انْكَشَفَتِ — inkashafat, to be uncovered, clear away (Form VII, perf. 3fs; the final -i is a helping vowel before al-); 'was uncovered'
الْغَبْرَةُ: الـ + غَبْرَة — al-, the + ghabra, dust cloud (f., nom., subject of inkashafat); 'the dust'
شَارِدٌ: شَارِد — shārid, runaway, straying (act. part. of sharada I; m., nom., tanwīn; adjective of ḥimār); 'runaway'
يَقْمُصُ: يَقْمُص — qamaṣa, to buck, kick up (verb I, imperf. 3ms; with tāratan, 'now'); 'bucks'
يَتَمَرَّغُ: يَتَمَرَّغ — tamarragha, to roll about (Form V, imperf. 3ms; after tāratan); 'rolls about'
الْحَيَوَانُ: الـ + حَيَوَان — al-, the + ḥayawān, animal (m., nom., vocative after ayyuhā); 'O animal'
الْخَرِيفُ: الـ + خَرِيف — al-, the + kharīf, dotard, feeble-minded (m., nom., adjective of ḥayawān, first term of iḍāfa with al-ʿaql); 'the dotard of'
جِنْسُكَ: جِنْس + كَ — jins, kind (m., nom., predicate of mā) + -ka, 'your' (ms); 'your kind'
قُدُومِي: قُدُوم + ـِي — qudūm, coming, arrival (m., gen., verbal noun of qadima; first term of iḍāfa after sabab) + -ī, 'my'; 'my coming'
هُرُوبِي: هُرُوب + ـِي — hurūb, fleeing (m., nom., verbal noun of haraba; predicate) + -ī, 'my'; 'my fleeing'
وَيَرْكَبَنِي: وَ + يَرْكَب + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yarkabanī, he rides (rakiba I, subjunctive 3ms, after an) + -nī, 'me'; 'and ride me'
الْبَرْذَعَةَ: الـ + بَرْذَعَة — al-, the + bardhaʿa, pack-saddle (f., acc., second object of yusammīhi); 'the pack-saddle'
فَيَجْعَلُهَا: فَ + يَجْعَل + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + yajʿalu, he puts, places (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hā, 'it' (the saddle); 'and puts it'
الْحِزَامَ: الـ + حِزَام — al-, the + ḥizām, girth (m., acc., second object of yusammīhi); 'the girth'
فَيَشُدُّهُ: فَ + يَشُدُّ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + yashuddu, he binds, fastens (shadda I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, 'it'; 'and fastens it'
الطَّفَرَ: الـ + طَّفَر — al-, the + ṭafar, crupper (m., acc., second object of yusammīhi); 'the crupper'
فَيَجْعَلُهُ: فَ + يَجْعَل + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + yajʿalu, he puts (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, 'it'; 'and puts it'
ذَنَبِي: ذَنَب + ـِي — dhanab, tail (m., gen., after taḥta) + -ī, 'my'; 'my tail'
اللِّجَامَ: الـ + لِّجَام — al-, the + lijām, bridle (m., acc., second object of yusammīhi); 'the bridle'
مِنْخَاسًا: مِنْخَاس — minkhās, goad (m., acc., tanwīn; object of yaʿmalu); 'a goad'
يَنْخَسُنِي: يَنْخَس + نِي — yankhasu, he pricks, goads (nakhasa I, imperf. 3ms; relative clause on minkhās) + -nī, 'me'; 'he goads me'
وَيُكَلِّفُنِي: وَ + يُكَلِّف + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yukallifu, he burdens, charges (Form II, imperf. 3ms; takes two objects) + -nī, 'me'; 'and burdens me with'
الْجَرْيِ: الـ + جَرْي — al-, the + jary, running (m., gen., verbal noun of jarā; after min, 'of' what I cannot bear); 'the running'
لَعَنَنِي: لَعَن + نِي — laʿana, to curse (verb I, perf. 3ms; apodosis of idhā) + -nī, 'me'; 'he curses me'
نَهَقْتُ: نَهَقْتُ — nahaqtu, I brayed (verb I, perf. 1cs; after in, 'if'); 'I bray'
شَتَمَنِي: شَتَم + نِي — shatama, to revile, abuse (verb I, perf. 3ms; apodosis of in) + -nī, 'me'; 'he reviles me'
رَحْلًا: رَحْل — raḥl, saddle, pack-saddle (m., acc., tanwīn; object of yajʿalu); 'a saddle'
الْخَشَبِ: الـ + خَشَب — al-, the + khashab, wood (m., gen., after min, 'of', material); 'of wood'
وَيُسَلِّمُنِي: وَ + يُسَلِّم + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yusallimu, he hands over (Form II, imperf. 3ms; with ilā, 'to') + -nī, 'me'; 'and hands me over'
السَّقَّايِينَ: الـ + سَّقَّايِين — al-, the + saqqāyīn, water-carriers (pl. of saqqāʾ; gen., after ilā); 'the water-carriers'
وَنَحْوِهَا: وَ + نَحْو + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + naḥw, the like, similar (m., gen., coordinated with al-qirab) + -hā, 'of them'; 'and the like'
كَالْجِرَارِ: كَ + الْ + جِرَار — ka-, like, such as (prep., exemplifying) + al-, the + jirār, jars (pl. of jarra; gen.); 'such as the jars'
وَهَوَانٍ: وَ + هَوَان — wa-, and (conj.) + hawān, contempt, humiliation (m., gen., coordinated with dhull after fī); 'and contempt'
وَتَعَبٍ: وَ + تَعَب — wa-, and (conj.) + taʿab, toil, weariness (m., gen., coordinated with dhull); 'and toil'
فَيَرْمُونَنِي: فَ + يَرْمُون + نِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + yarmūna, they throw (ramā I, imperf. 3mpl., nom.) + -nī, 'me' (with nūn al-wiqāya); 'and they throw me'
التِّلَالِ: الـ + تِّلَال — al-, the + tilāl, mounds, hills (pl. of tall; gen., after fawqa); 'the mounds'
فَأَيُّ: فَ + أَيُّ — fa-, so (conj.) + ayy, which, what (interrogative; m., nom., first term of iḍāfa with shayʾ); 'so what'
الطَّاؤُوسَةُ: الـ + طَاؤُوسَة — al-, the (def. art.) + ṭāʾūsa, peahen (f., nom., vocative after أَيُّهَا, so the article is kept); 'you peahen'
اقْشَعَرَّ: اقْشَعَرَّ — iqshaʿarra (form XI quadriliteral-type), from qashʿara/iqshaʿarra, to bristle, shudder with horror; 3ms perfect; 'shuddered'
لِلشِّبْلِ: لِـ + الـ + شِبْل — li-, to (prep.; with قَالَ it marks the person addressed) + al-, the + shibl, lion cub (m., gen.); 'to the cub'
رُعْبًا: رُعْب — ruʿb, terror (m., acc.; second object of زَادَنِي, 'increased me [in] terror'); 'terror'
رُعْبِي: رُعْب + ي — ruʿb, terror (m., gen. after عَلَى 'upon', 'on top of') + ī 'my'; 'upon my terror'
إِشْرَاقِ: إِشْرَاق — ishrāq, rising, shining forth (verbal noun of IV, m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa after قَبْلَ, with الشَّمْسِ); 'the rising (of the sun)'
هَرَبًا: هَرَب — harab, flight (m., acc.; cognate/absolute object of فَرَرْتُ, giving emphasis or manner); 'in flight'
أَنْطَلِقَ: أَنْطَلِقَ — anṭaliqa (VII), from inṭalaqa, to set off, go away; 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'that I go off'
فَعَسَى: فَ + عَسَى — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿasā, perhaps, it may be (verb of hope/possibility, here followed directly by the bare verb أَجِدُ); 'so perhaps'; here: followed by an + subjunctive (an yuʿīnanī), 'so perhaps (God will)'
الشِّبْلِ: الـ + شِبْل — al-, the + shibl, lion cub (m., gen. after مَعَ 'with'); 'the cub'
يُوَدِّعَنَا: يُوَدِّعَ + نَا — yuwaddiʿa (form II), from waddaʿa, to bid farewell to; 3ms subjunctive after أَنْ + nā 'us' (object); 'that he bid us farewell'
فَنَهَقَ: فَ + نَهَقَ — fa-, and then (conj., sequence) + nahaqa, to bray; 3ms perfect; 'and brayed'
الْغَبْرَةِ: الـ + غَبْرَة — al-, the + ghabra, cloud of dust (f., gen., iḍāfa after نَاحِيَةِ 'side'); 'the dust'
ضُرَاطًا: ضُرَاط — ḍurāṭ, a fart (m., acc.; cognate object of ضَرَطَ, qualified by عَالِيًا); 'a fart'
بِغُرَّةٍ: بِـ + غُرَّة — bi-, with (prep., 'having, marked with') + ghurra, blaze, white forehead mark on a horse (f., gen., indef.); 'with a blaze'
الْفَرَسُ: الـ + فَرَس — al-, the + faras, horse (m., nom., subject of the nominal clause); 'the horse'
الْغُرَّةِ: الـ + غُرَّة — al-, the + ghurra, blaze (f., gen., specifying noun after ظَرِيفُ, 'elegant of blaze'); 'the blaze'
التَّحْجِيلِ: الـ + تَحْجِيل — al-, the + taḥjīl, white markings on a horse's legs (stockings) (verbal noun of II, m., gen., after مَلِيحُ); 'the stockings'
الْقَوَائِمِ: الـ + قَوَائِم — al-, the + qawāʾim, pl. of qāʾima, legs (of an animal) (f.pl., gen., after حَسَنُ); 'the legs'
وَالصَّهِيلِ: وَ + الـ + صَهِيل — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṣahīl, neighing (m., gen., coordinated with الْقَوَائِمِ); 'and the neighing'
اسْتَعْظَمَهُ: اسْتَعْظَمَ + هُ — istaʿẓama (form X), from ʿaẓuma, to deem great, be awed by; 3ms perfect + hu 'him' (object); 'he thought him mighty'
شُرُودِكَ: شُرُود + كَ — shurūd, running loose, bolting, straying (verbal noun, m., gen., iḍāfa after سَبَبُ) + ka 'your'; 'your running loose'
الْعَرِيضِ: الـ + عَرِيض — al-, the + ʿarīḍ, broad (adj., m., gen., second adjective of الْبَرِّ, definite to agree); 'the broad'
يَاسَيِّدَ: يَا + سَيِّدَ — yā, O (vocative particle, written joined) + sayyid, lord, master (m., acc., vocative first term of iḍāfa with الْوُحُوشِ); 'O lord (of)'
شُرُودِى: شُرُود + ى — shurūd, running loose, bolting (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa) + ī 'my' (final yāʾ written ى, a spelling variant of ي); 'my running loose'
غَلِيظٌ: غَلِيظ — ghalīẓ, thick, stout, coarse (adj., m., nom., indef., predicate coordinated with طَوِيلٌ); '(you are) thick'
جُثَّتِكَ: جُثَّة + كَ — juththa, body, bulk (f., gen., iḍāfa after عِظَمِ) + ka 'your'; 'your bulk'
وَسُرْعَةِ: وَ + سُرْعَة — wa-, and (conj.) + surʿa, swiftness (f., gen., coordinated with عِظَمِ, first term of iḍāfa with جَرْيِكَ); 'and the swiftness (of)'
جَرْيِكَ: جَرْي + كَ — jary, running (verbal noun of jarā, m., gen., iḍāfa after سُرْعَةِ) + ka 'your'; 'your running'
أَلْتَقِيَ: أَلْتَقِيَ — altaqiya (VIII), from iltaqā, to meet, encounter (takes مَعَ here); 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ; 'that I meet (with)'
فَأَبْطِشَ: فَ + أَبْطِشَ — fa-, and so (conj. + subjunctive of sequence) + abṭisha, from baṭasha, to seize violently, assault (takes بِـ for the victim, here بِهِ); 1st sg. subjunctive; 'and so I assault'
وَآكُلَ: وَ + آكُلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ākula (a + akula), from akala, to eat; 1st sg. subjunctive, continuing the أَنْ clause; 'and eat'
لَحْمَهُ: لَحْم + هُ — laḥm, flesh, meat (m., acc., object) + hu 'his'; 'his flesh'
وَأُسَكِّنَ: وَ + أُسَكِّنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + usakkina (II), from sakkana, to calm, quiet; 1st sg. subjunctive; 'and calm'
رَوْعَ: رَوْع — rawʿ, fright, alarm (m., acc., object, first term of iḍāfa with الْبَطَّةِ); 'the fright (of)'
الْبَطَّةِ: الـ + بَطَّة — al-, the + baṭṭa, duck (f., gen., after هَذِهِ 'this'; second term of iḍāfa); 'the duck'
وَأُقِرَّهَا: وَ + أُقِرَّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + uqirra (IV), from aqarra, to settle, establish in place; 1st sg. subjunctive + hā 'her' (object, the duck); 'and settle her'
وَطَنِهَا: وَطَن + هَا — waṭan, homeland, native place (m., gen. after فِي) + hā 'her'; 'her homeland'
وَأَرْجَعْتَنِي: وَ + أَرْجَعْتَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + arjaʿta (IV), from arjaʿa, to make return, turn back; 2ms perfect + nī 'me' (object); 'and you made me turn back'
عِظَمِكَ: عِظَم + كَ — ʿiẓam, greatness, size (m., gen. after مَعَ 'with') + ka 'your'; 'your greatness'
قَهَرَكَ: قَهَرَ + كَ — qahara, to overpower, subdue; 3ms perfect + ka 'you' (object); 'overpowered you'
طُولِكَ: طُول + كَ — ṭūl, length, height (m., gen. after مِنْ 'from', governed by يَخَفْ، خَافَ مِنْ 'fear [something]') + ka 'your'; 'your length'
وَعَرْضِكَ: وَ + عَرْض + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿarḍ, breadth (m., gen., coordinated with طُولِكَ) + ka 'your'; 'and your breadth'
رَفَصْتَهُ: رَفَصْتَ + هُ — rafaṣa, to kick (a variant of rafasa/rafaṣa); 2ms perfect in a conditional with لَوْ + hu 'him'; 'you kicked him'
بِرِجْلِكَ: بِـ + رِجْل + كَ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + rijl, foot, leg (f., gen.) + ka 'your'; 'with your foot'
لَقَتَلْتَهُ: لَ + قَتَلْتَ + هُ — la-, (apodosis particle of لَوْ, 'then surely') + qatala, to kill; 2ms perfect + hu 'him'; 'you would have killed him'
أَغْلِبَهُ: أَغْلِبَ + هُ — aghliba, from ghalaba, to overcome, defeat; 1st sg. subjunctive after أَنْ + hu 'him'; 'that I overcome him'
طُولِي: طُول + ي — ṭūl, length, height (m., nom., subject of يَغُرَّكَ) + ī 'my'; 'my length'
عَرْضِي: عَرْض + ي — ʿarḍ, breadth (m., nom., coordinated after وَلَا) + ī 'my'; 'my breadth'
ضَخَامَتِي: ضَخَامَة + ي — ḍakhāma, bulk, massiveness (f., nom., coordinated after وَلَا) + ī 'my'; 'my bulk'
حِيَلِهِ: حِيَل + هِ — ḥiyal, pl. of ḥīla, tricks, stratagems (f.pl., gen., iḍāfa after شِدَّةِ) + hi 'his'; 'his tricks'
وَمَكْرِهِ: وَ + مَكْر + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + makr, cunning, guile (m., gen., coordinated with حِيَلِهِ) + hi 'his'; 'and his cunning'
الشِّكَالُ: الـ + شِكَال — al-, the + shikāl, hobble (rope tying an animal's legs) (m., nom., the name introduced by يُقَالُ لَهُ 'it is called'); 'the hobble'
قَوَائِمِي: قَوَائِم + ي — qawāʾim, pl. of qāʾima, legs (of an animal) (f.pl., gen., after أَرْبَعَةِ 'four of') + ī 'my'; 'my legs'
شِكَالَيْنِ: شِكَال + يْنِ — shikāl, hobble (m.) in the dual accusative -ayn, object of يَضَعُ; 'two hobbles'
حِبَالِ: حِبَال — ḥibāl, pl. of ḥabl, ropes (m.pl., gen., iḍāfa after the dual noun, with اللِّيفِ); 'ropes (of)' Also figurative, ḥibāl al-ṣabr, 'the ropes of patience' (gen. after bi-qaṭʿi).
اللِّيفِ: الـ + لِيف — al-, the + līf, palm fibre (m., gen., second term of iḍāfa); 'palm fibre'
الْمَلْفُوفَةِ: الـ + مَلْفُوفَة — al-, the + malfūfa, wrapped (passive participle of laffa, f., gen., adjective of حِبَالِ, a non-human plural taking the f.sg.); 'the wrapped (ones)'
بِاللِّبَادِ: بِـ + الـ + لِبَاد — bi-, with (prep.; the participle malfūfa takes بِـ for the wrapping material) + al-, the + libād, felt (m., gen.); 'with felt'
وَيَصْلُبُنِي: وَ + يَصْلُبُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaṣlubu, from ṣalaba, to crucify, string up, hang; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me' (object); 'and he strings me up'
مَصْلُوبٌ: مَصْلُوب — maṣlūb, strung up, hung (passive participle of ṣalaba, m., nom., predicate in the circumstantial clause); '(I am) strung up'
يَرْكَبَنِي: يَرْكَبَ + نِي — yarkaba, from rakiba, to ride, mount; 3ms subjunctive after أَنْ + nī 'me' (object); 'that he ride me'
الرِّكَابُ: الـ + رِكَاب — al-, the + rikāb, stirrup (m., nom., the name given in اسْمُهُ الرِّكَابُ); 'the stirrup'
السَّرْجَ: الـ + سَرْج — al-, the + sarj, saddle (m., acc., second object of يُسَمِّيهِ 'he names it [the] saddle'); 'the saddle'
وَيَشُدُّهُ: وَ + يَشُدُّ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yashuddu, from shadda, to tighten, fasten; 3ms imperfect + hu 'it' (the saddle); 'and fastens it'
بِحِزَامَيْنِ: بِـ + حِزَام + يْنِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + ḥizām, girth, belt (m.) in the dual genitive -ayn; 'with two girths'
إِبْطِي: إِبْط + ي — ibṭ, armpit (m., gen., iḍāfa after تَحْتِ) + ī 'my'; 'my armpit'
الصَّرْعَ: الـ + صَرْع — al-, the + ṣarʿ, a leather rein/strap attached to the bridle (so glossed from context; the printed word is unusual and may be a variant of a rein-term) (m., acc., second object of يُسَمِّيهِ); 'the ṣarʿ (a leather rein)'
ظَهْرِى: ظَهْر + ى — ẓahr, back (m., gen., iḍāfa after فَوْقَ) + ī 'my' (final yāʾ written ى, a spelling variant of ي); 'my back'
يُمْسِكُ: يُمْسِكُ — yumsiku (IV), from amsaka, to hold, grasp (takes a direct object or بِـ); 3ms imperfect; 'he holds'
وَيَقُودُنِي: وَ + يَقُودُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaqūdu, from qāda, to lead; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me' (object); 'and leads me'
وَيَهْمِزُنِي: وَ + يَهْمِزُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yahmizu, from hamaza, to goad, prod with the heel or spur; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me' (object); 'and goads me'
بِالرِّكَابِ: بِـ + الـ + رِكَاب — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + al-, the + rikāb, stirrup (m., gen.); 'with the stirrup'
خَوَاصِرِي: خَوَاصِر + ي — khawāṣir, pl. of khāṣira, flanks (f.pl., gen. after فِي 'in') + ī 'my'; 'my flanks'
يُدْمِيَهَا: يُدْمِيَ + هَا — yudmiya (IV), from admā, to make bleed; 3ms subjunctive after حَتَّى (of purpose/result) + hā 'them' (the flanks, as a f. sg. non-human plural); 'until he makes them bleed'
أُقَاسِيهِ: أُقَاسِي + هِ — uqāsī (III), from qāsā, to suffer, endure; 1st sg. imperfect + hi 'it' (the relative clause's returning pronoun after مَا); 'what I suffer'
وَانْتَحَلَ: وَ + انْتَحَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + intaḥala (VIII), to waste away, become emaciated (said of the body); 3ms perfect; 'and (my back) wastes away'
سُرْعَةِ: سُرْعَة — surʿa, swiftness (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa with الْجَرْىِ after عَلَى; قَدَرَ عَلَى 'be able to [do]'); 'the swiftness (of)'
الْجَرْىِ: الـ + جَرْى — al-, the + jary, running (verbal noun of jarā, m., gen.; final yāʾ written ى, a spelling variant of ي); 'the running'
يَبِيعُنِي: يَبِيعُ + نِي — yabīʿu, from bāʿa, to sell; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me' (object); 'he sells me'
لِلطَّحَّانِ: لِـ + الـ + طَحَّان — li-, to (prep., recipient of بَاعَ 'sell [to]') + al-, the + ṭaḥḥān, miller (m., gen.); 'to the miller'
لِيُدَوِّرَنِي: لِـ + يُدَوِّرَ + نِي — li-, so that (particle of purpose + subjunctive) + yudawwira (II), from dawwara, to make go round, turn; 3ms subjunctive + nī 'me'; 'so that he may turn me round'
أَهْرَمَ: أَهْرَمَ — ahrama, from harima, to grow decrepit, very old; 1st sg. subjunctive after إِلَى أَنْ; 'until I grow decrepit'
فَيَبِيعُنِي: فَ + يَبِيعُ + نِي — fa-, then (conj.) + yabīʿu, from bāʿa, to sell; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me'; 'then he sells me'
فَيَذْبَحُنِي: فَ + يَذْبَحُ + نِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + yadhbaḥu, from dhabaḥa, to slaughter; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me'; 'and so he slaughters me'
وَيَسْلُخُ: وَ + يَسْلُخُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaslukhu, from salakha, to skin, flay; 3ms imperfect; 'and flays'
جِلْدِى: جِلْد + ى — jild, skin, hide (m., acc., object of يَسْلُخُ) + ī 'my' (final yāʾ written ى, a spelling variant of ي); 'my hide'
وَيَنْتِفُ: وَ + يَنْتِفُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yantifu, from natafa (I), to pluck, pull out (imperf. 3ms; subject ibn Ādam, object dhanabī); 'and plucks out'
وَيَبِيعُهُمَا: وَ + يَبِيعُ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yabīʿu, from bāʿa, to sell; 3ms imperfect + humā 'the two of them' (hide and tail); 'and sells them'
لِلْغَرَابِلِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + غَرَابِلِيّ — li-, to (prep., recipient of يَبِيعُ) + al-, the + gharābilī, maker/seller of sieves (nisba from gharābīl, sieves, m., gen.); 'to the sieve-maker'
وَالْمَنَاخِلِيِّ: وَ + الـ + مَنَاخِلِيّ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + manākhilī, maker/seller of sifters (nisba from manākhil, sifters, m., gen., coordinated with الْغَرَابِلِيِّ); 'and the sifter-maker'
وَيَسْلِي: وَ + يَسْلِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaslī, from salā (also salaʾa), to render (fat), clarify butter; 3ms imperfect (final -ī, indicative of a defective verb); 'and renders'
شَحْمِي: شَحْم + ي — shaḥm, fat (m., acc., object) + ī 'my'; 'my fat'
ثَارَتْ: ثَارَتْ — thārat, from thāra, to rise, billow up (of dust); 3fs perfect; 'rose'
هَائِجٌ: هَائِج — hāʾij, raging, in a frenzy, in rut (active participle of hāja, m., nom., indef., a circumstantial adjective of جَمَلٌ); 'raging'
يُبَعْبِعُ: يُبَعْبِعُ — yubaʿbiʿu (quadriliteral, II-type), from baʿbaʿa, to bellow, roar (of a camel; imitative); 3ms imperfect; '(he was) bellowing'
وَيَخْبِطُ: وَ + يَخْبِطُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yakhbiṭu, from khabaṭa, to stamp, strike the ground; 3ms imperfect; 'and stamping'
بِرِجْلَيْهِ: بِـ + رِجْل + يْ + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + rijl, foot, leg (f.) in the dual genitive + hi 'his'; 'with his two feet'
غَلِيظًا: غَلِيظ — ghalīẓ, thick, stout (adj., m., acc., indef., a second state/predicate after رَأٰهُ, with كَبِيرًا); 'thick'
الْوُثُوبَ: الـ + وُثُوب — al-, the + wuthūb, leaping, pouncing (verbal noun of wathaba, m., acc., object of أَرَادَ, followed by عَلَى 'upon'); 'the leaping (upon)'
وَكَأَنَّهُ: وَ + كَأَنَّ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ka-anna, as though, it seems that (particle, takes acc.) + hu 'he' (its noun); 'and it is as though he'
هَارِبٌ: هَارِب — hārib, fleeing (active participle of haraba, m., nom., indef., predicate of كَأَنَّ; هَرَبَ مِنْ 'flee from'); '(is) fleeing'
بِالْجَمَلِ: بِـ + الـ + جَمَل — bi-, after إِذَا/وَإِذَا of surprise, it only marks what appears ('behold') (prep., no independent sense) + al-, the + jamal, camel (m., gen.); 'behold, the camel'
أَيَادِى: أَيَادِي — ayādī, pl. of yad, hands (f.pl., gen., in بَيْنَ أَيَادِي 'in front of'; final yāʾ written ى, a spelling variant of ي; the usual plural is أَيْدٍ); 'the hands (of)'
وَطُولِكَ: وَ + طُول + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭūl, length, height (m., gen., coordinated with خِلْقَتِكَ after عِظَمِ) + ka 'your'; 'and your length'
رَفْصَةً: رَفْصَة — rafṣa, a kick (noun of single occurrence, f., acc.; cognate object of رَفَصْتَهُ, 'one kick'); 'one kick'
الْجَمَلُ: الـ + جَمَل — al-, the + jamal, camel (m., nom., subject of قَالَ); 'the camel'
دَوَاهِي: دَوَاهِي — dawāhī, pl. of dāhiya, calamities, mishaps (f.pl., nom., the subject of لَهُ ... ; diptote); 'calamities'
لَاتُطَاقُ: لَا + تُطَاقُ — lā, not (negative, written joined) + tuṭāqu, from aṭāqa (IV), to be able to bear, here passive; 3fs imperfect passive (agreeing with the non-human plural), qualifying دَوَاهِي; 'unbearable, not to be borne'
يَغْلِبُهُ: يَغْلِبُ + هُ — yaghlibu, from ghalaba, to overcome, defeat; 3ms imperfect + hu 'him'; '(nothing) overcomes him'
يَضَعُ: يَضَعُ — yaḍaʿu, from waḍaʿa, to put, place; 3ms imperfect; 'he puts'
أَنْفِي: أَنْف + ي — anf, nose (m., gen. after فِي 'in') + ī 'my'; 'my nose'
خَيْطًا: خَيْط — khayṭ, thread, cord (m., acc., object of يَضَعُ); 'a thread'
وَيُسَمِّيهِ: وَ + يُسَمِّي + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + yusammī (II), from sammā, to name, call; 3ms imperfect + hi 'it' (first object, the second being خِزَامًا); 'and calls it'
خِزَامًا: خِزَام — khizām, nose-ring, a ring/cord through a camel's nose (m., acc., second object of يُسَمِّيهِ); 'a nose-ring'
وَيَجْعَلُ: وَ + يَجْعَلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yajʿalu, from jaʿala, to set, put; 3ms imperfect; 'and sets'
مِقْوَدًا: مِقْوَد — miqwad, halter, leading rope (m., acc., object, from qāda 'lead'); 'a halter'
أَصْغَرِ: أَصْغَر — aṣghar, smallest, youngest (elative, m., gen., after إِلَى, iḍāfa with أَوْلَادِهِ; سَلَّمَ إِلَى 'hand over to'); 'the smallest (of)'
فَيَجُرُّنِي: فَ + يَجُرُّ + نِي — fa-, and so (conj.) + yajurru, from jarra, to drag, pull; 3ms imperfect + nī 'me'; 'and so drags me'
بِالْخَيْطِ: بِـ + الـ + خَيْط — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument) + al-, the + khayṭ, thread (m., gen.); 'by the thread'
كِبَرِي: كِبَر + ي — kibar, bigness, great size (m., gen. after مَعَ 'with') + ī 'my'; 'my bigness'
وَعِظَمِي: وَ + عِظَم + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿiẓam, greatness, size (m., gen., coordinated with كِبَرِي) + ī 'my'; 'and my greatness'
وَيُحَمِّلُونَنِي: وَ + يُحَمِّلُونَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yuḥammilūna (II), from ḥammala, to load, burden (two objects: the person and the load); 3mp imperfect + nī 'me' (first object); 'and they load me'
أَثْقَلَ: أَثْقَل — athqal, heaviest (elative of thaqīl, m., acc., second object of يُحَمِّلُونَنِي, first term of iḍāfa with الْأَحْمَالِ); 'the heaviest (of)'
وَيُسَافِرُونَ: وَ + يُسَافِرُونَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yusāfirūna (III), from sāfara, to travel (here with بِي 'with me', so 'take me on journeys'); 3mp imperfect; 'and they journey'
الْأَسْفَارَ: الـ + أَسْفَار — al-, the + asfār, pl. of safar, journeys (m.pl., acc.; cognate accusative of the journey, with الطِّوَالَ); 'the journeys'
وَيَسْتَعْمِلُونَنِي: وَ + يَسْتَعْمِلُونَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yastaʿmilūna (X), from istaʿmala, to employ, put to work (فِي for the task); 3mp imperfect + nī 'me'; 'and they employ me'
الْأَشْغَالِ: الـ + أَشْغَال — al-, the + ashghāl, tasks, jobs (pl. of shughl, work; gen., after fī, 'in'); 'in the tasks'
الشَّاقَّةِ: الـ + شَاقَّة — al-, the + shāqqa, hard, arduous (f. sg. act. part. of shaqqa I; gen., adjective of al-ashghāl, a broken plural of things taking the f. sg.); 'the hard (tasks)'
وَشِخْتُ: وَ + شِخْتُ — wa-, and + shukhtu, I grew old (verb I, hollow, perf. 1cs of shākha, yashīkhu); 'and I grow old'
انْكَسَرْتُ: انْكَسَرْتُ — inkasartu, I broke, was broken (verb VII of kasara, perf. 1cs, the reflexive-passive of 'break'); 'I break down'
يَحْفَظْ: يَحْفَظْ — yaḥfaẓ, he keeps, preserves (verb I, impf. 3ms, jussive after lam in fa-lam); 'he does not keep'
لِلدَّبَّاغِينَ: لِـ + الـ + دَبَّاغِين — li-, to (prep., marks the person sold to, indirect object of yabīʿu) + al-, the + dabbāghīn, tanners (pl. of dabbāgh; gen. sound masc. pl.); 'to the tanners'
وَلَحْمِى: وَ + لَحْم + ـِي — wa-, and + laḥm, flesh, meat (m.; coordinated with jildī as the second thing sold) + -ī, my; printed with final ى for ي; 'and my flesh'
لِلطَّبَّاخِينَ: لِـ + الـ + طَبَّاخِين — li-, to (prep., indirect object of 'sells', understood from the preceding clause) + al-, the + ṭabbākhīn, cooks (pl. of ṭabbākh; gen. sound masc. pl.); 'to the cooks'
أُقَاسِي: أُقَاسِي — qāsā, to suffer, endure (verb III, defective, impf. 1cs indic., uqāsī); relative clause after mā; 'what I suffer'
أَيَّ: أَيّ — ayy, which, what (interrog. noun; acc. as an adverbial of time, first term of an iḍāfa with waqt); 'at what time'
انْصِرَافِي: انْصِرَاف + ـِي — inṣirāf, going away, departure (m. verbal noun of VII inṣarafa; gen. after ʿinda) + -ī, my; 'at my departure'
يَجِدْنِي: يَجِدْ + نِي — yajid, he finds (wajada I, impf. 3ms jussive after lam; initial wāw drops) + -nī, me; 'he did not find me'
فَيَسْعَى: فَـ + يَسْعَى — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + yasʿā, he strives, goes (verb I, defective, impf. 3ms; here 'goes' with fī ṭalabī, 'in search of me'); 'and so he goes'
أَلْهَجَ: أَلْهَجَ — printed form, impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā; apparently from lahija (I), to be intent on, wander about; context meaning 'roam'; the vowelling and root are doubtful; 'that I may roam' (uncertain)
تَمَهَّلْ: تَمَهَّلْ — tamahhal, take your time, wait (verb V of mahala, imperative ms); 'wait'
أَفْتَرِسُهُ: أَفْتَرِسُ + هُ — aftarisu, I prey upon, seize (verb VIII of farasa, impf. 1cs indic.) + -hu, him (object); 'I prey upon him'
وَأُطْعِمُكَ: وَ + أُطْعِمُ + كَ — wa-, and + uṭʿimu, I feed (verb IV of ṭaʿima, impf. 1cs; takes two objects) + -ka, you; 'and feed you'
وَأَهْشِمُ: وَ + أَهْشِمُ — wa-, and + ahshimu, I crush, smash (verb I hashama, impf. 1cs indic.); 'and I crush'
عَظْمَهُ: عَظْم + هُ — ʿaẓm, bone (m., acc., object of ahshimu) + -hu, his; 'his bone'
الثَّقِيْلُ: الـ + ثَقِيل — al-, the + thaqīl, heavy, burdensome (adj. used as a noun, 'the heavy one', i.e. the unwelcome guest; nom., subject of ḥalla); printed with ْيْ for ي; 'the heavy one'
باَرْضِ: بِـ + أَرْض — bi-, in (prep., locative) + arḍ, land, country (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with qawm); printed باَرْضِ (fatḥa for hamza-carrying alif, misprint for بِأَرْضِ); 'in the land of'
لِلسَّاكِنِيْنَ: لِـ + الـ + سَاكِنِين — li-, for (prep., 'there is for them', possession/benefit: mā lahum) + al-, the + sākinīn, dwellers, residents (act. part. of sakana I, pl.; gen. sound masc. pl.); printed with ْيْ for ي; 'for the dwellers'
الرَّحيْل: الـ + رَحِيل — al-, the + raḥīl, departure, moving on (m. verbal noun of raḥala I; gen., after siwā, 'except'); printed with ْيْ for ي (vowel marks as printed); 'the departing'
انْكَشَفَتْ: انْكَشَفَتْ — inkashafat, it was uncovered, cleared (verb VII of kashafa, perf. 3fs; subject ghabara, dust-cloud; with ʿan, 'to reveal'); 'it cleared (to reveal)'
شَيْخٍ: شَيْخ — shaykh, old man, elder (m., gen., after ʿan, which the verb inkashafa ʿan chooses, 'disclose'; indefinite); 'an old man'
قَصِيرٍ: قَصِير — qaṣīr, short (adj., m., gen., agreeing with shaykhin); 'short'
رَقِيقِ: رَقِيق — raqīq, thin, delicate (adj., m., gen., agreeing with shaykhin; first term of an iḍāfa with al-bashara, 'thin of skin'); 'thin (of skin)'
الْبَشَرَةِ: الـ + بَشَرَة — al-, the + bashara, skin, complexion (f., gen., second term of the iḍāfa after raqīq); 'the skin'
كَتِفِهِ: كَتِف + هِ — katif, shoulder (m./f., gen., after ʿalā, 'on') + -hi, his; 'on his shoulder'
مِقْطَفٌ: مِقْطَف — miqṭaf, basket (m., nom. indef., delayed subject of a nominal clause whose predicate is ʿalā katifihi); 'a basket'
عُدَّةُ: عُدَّة — ʿudda, equipment, tools, outfit (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa with najjār, subject of fīhi); 'the tools of'
شُعْبَةٌ: شُعْبَة — shuʿba, branch, fork (f., nom. indef., delayed subject of 'on his head'); 'a forked branch'
وَثَمَانِيَةُ: وَ + ثَمَانِيَة — wa-, and + thamāniya, eight (nom., first term in construct with the counted noun alwāḥ; coordinated with shuʿba as further subject); 'and eight'
أَلْوَاحٍ: أَلْوَاح — alwāḥ, planks, boards (pl. of lawḥ; gen. indef., the counted noun after the numeral eight); 'planks'
أَطْفَالٌ: أَطْفَال — aṭfāl, children (pl. of ṭifl; nom. indef., delayed subject of 'in his hand', described by ṣighār); 'children'
يُهَرْوِلُ: يُهَرْوِلُ — harwala, to trot, go at a jog (quadriliteral verb I, impf. 3ms indic.); in a wa-huwa circumstantial clause, 'he was trotting'; after ṣāra, ṣāra yuharwilu, 'he broke into a trot'
قَاعَ: قَاع — qāʿ, ground, flat bottom (m., printed acc. -a after lā, 'no ...'); the sentence as printed is obscure (probably a stock phrase or corrupt); 'no ground' (uncertain)
النَّجَّارُ: الـ + نَجَّار — al-, the + najjār, carpenter (m., nom., subject of ḍaḥika); 'the carpenter'
أَسْعَدَ: أَسْعَدَ — asʿada, to make happy, grant good fortune (verb IV, perf. 3ms, optative sense, 'may God make ... happy'); 'may (God) make happy'
مَسَاكَ: مَسَاء + كَ — masāʾ, evening (m., acc., object of asʿada) + -ka, your; printed مَسَاكَ without hamza (misprint or elision for masāʾaka); 'your evening'
وَمَسْعَاكَ: وَ + مَسْعَى + كَ — wa-, and + masʿā, striving, endeavour, course (m. noun of place/act of saʿā; acc., second object of asʿada) + -ka, your; 'and your striving'
شَجَاعَتِكَ: شَجَاعَة + كَ — shajāʿa, courage, bravery (f., gen., after fī, which zāda fī chooses for 'increase in') + -ka, your; 'in your courage'
وَقُوَاكَ: وَ + قُوَى + كَ — wa-, and + quwā, powers, forces (pl. of quwwa; gen., after fī, coordinated with shajāʿatika) + -ka, your; 'and your powers'
أَجِرْنِي: أَجِرْ + نِي — ajir, protect, give refuge to (verb IV of jāra, imperative ms; the refuge is 'from' with min) + -nī, me; 'give me refuge'
دَهَانِي: دَهَى + نِي — dahā, to befall, strike, afflict (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; in mimmā dahānī, 'from what befell me'; 'has befallen me'
وَبِشَرِّهِ: وَ + بِـ + شَرّ + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, with (prep., instrumental, 'with his evil') + sharr, evil, harm (m., gen.) + -hi, his (the Son of Adam); 'and with his evil' Also with -hi for a calamity, not a person: مَا الَّذِي دَهَاكَ وَبِشَرِّهِ رَمَاكَ 'what has befallen you and struck you with its evil?'.
نَصِيرًا: نَصِير — naṣīr, helper, supporter (m., acc. indef., object of wajadtu); 'a helper'
بُكَاءَهُ: بُكَاء + هُ — bukāʾ, weeping (m. verbal noun of bakā, acc., object of samiʿa) + -hu, his; 'his weeping'
أَجَرْتُكَ: أَجَرْتُ + كَ — ajartu, I have given refuge (verb IV of jāra, perf. 1cs, performative: the act is done by saying it) + -ka, you; 'I have given you refuge'
شَأْنُكَ: شَأْن + كَ — shaʾn, affair, matter, case (m., nom., predicate of mā in 'what is your affair') + -ka, your; 'your affair'
فَنَجَّارٌ: فَـ + نَجَّار — fa-, so, then (the particle that follows ammā 'as for') + najjār, carpenter (m., nom. indef., predicate of anā); 'as for me, a carpenter'
ظَلَمَنِي: ظَلَمَ + نِي — ẓalama, to wrong, oppress (verb I, perf. 3ms; relative clause after alladhī) + -nī, me; 'wronged me'
صَبَاحِ: صَبَاح — ṣabāḥ, morning (m., gen., after fī, first term of an iḍāfa with hādhihi l-layla); 'in the morning of'
وَارْتَمَتْ: وَ + ارْتَمَتْ — wa-, and + irtamat, to throw oneself, dart (verb VIII of ramā, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the dual 'eyes'; with bi-l-sharar, 'with sparks'); 'and (his eyes) shot out'
لَأَسْهَرَنَّ: لَـ + أَسْهَرَنَّ — la-, surely (emphatic, introduces the oath's answer after wa-llāhi) + asharanna, I will stay awake (verb I sahira, impf. 1cs with emphatic nūn); 'I will surely stay awake'
أَبْلُغَ: أَبْلُغَ — balagha, to reach, attain (verb I, impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā); 'until I reach'
مَقْصِدِي: مَقْصِد + ـِي — maqṣid, aim, goal (m., acc., object of ablugha) + -ī, my; 'my aim'
خُطُوَاتِكَ: خُطُوَات + كَ — khuṭuwāt, steps, paces (pl. of khuṭwa, f.; acc., object of arā) + -ka, your; printed with ḍamma on khāʾ, a variant of khaṭawāt; 'your steps'
قَصِيرَةً: قَصِيرَة — qaṣīra, short (f. sg. adj., acc., second complement of arā, 'I see your steps short'); 'short'
أَكْسِرَ: أَكْسِرَ — kasara, to break (verb I, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an; with bi-khāṭirika, 'to hurt your feelings', where bi- is idiomatic); 'that I break (your feelings)'
مُرُوؤَةٍ: مُرُوءَة — murūʾa, chivalry, manliness, generosity (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa after dhū); printed مُرُوؤَةٍ (hamza written on wāw twice); 'of chivalry'
تُمَاشِىَ: تُمَاشِيَ — māshā, to walk along with (verb III of mashā, impf. 2ms subjunctive after an, taking the direct object al-wuḥūsh); printed with ى for ي; 'that you walk with'
الْفَهْدِ: الـ + فَهْد — al-, the + fahd, leopard, cheetah (m., gen., in apposition to wazīr, 'the vizier of your father, the leopard'); 'the leopard'
دَاسَ: دَاسَ — dāsa, to tread, trample (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms, after anna; 'had trodden'); 'had trodden'
لِأَصْنَعَ: لِـ + أَصْنَعَ — li-, so that, in order that (purpose particle, takes the subjunctive) + aṣnaʿa, I make (verb I ṣanaʿa, impf. 1cs subjunctive); 'so that I make'
يَسْكُنُ: يَسْكُنُ — sakana, to dwell, live (verb I, impf. 3ms indic.; relative clause on baytan, with fīhi); 'he may dwell (in it)'
وَيَأْوِي: وَ + يَأْوِي — wa-, and + yaʾwī, he takes shelter (verb I, defective, impf. 3ms; with ilā, 'to', chosen by the verb); 'and take shelter (in it)'
وَيَمْنَعُ: وَ + يَمْنَعُ — wa-, and + yamnaʿu, he keeps off, prevents (verb I, impf. 3ms indic.; with ʿanhu, 'from him', chosen by the verb); 'and keep away'
عَدُوَّهُ: عَدُوّ + هُ — ʿaduww, enemy (m., acc., object of yamnaʿu) + -hu, his; 'his enemy'
لَايَصِلَ: لَا + يَصِلَ — lā, not + yaṣila, he reaches (verb I waṣala, impf. 3ms subjunctive after ḥattā; with ilā); printed run together as لَايَصِلَ; 'so that ... does not reach'
الْأَلْوَاحَ: الـ + أَلْوَاح — al-, the + alwāḥ, planks (pl. of lawḥ; acc., object of akhadhtu, with hādhihi 'these'); 'the planks'
لِلْفَهْدِ: لِـ + الـ + فَهْد — li-, for, toward (prep., marks the object of the envy, ḥasad li-) + al-, the + fahd, leopard (m., gen.); 'for the leopard'
تَصْنَعَ: تَصْنَعَ — ṣanaʿa, to make (verb I, impf. 2ms subjunctive after an, in lā budda an; takes 'for me' and the product, 'planks into a house'); 'that you make'
وَاصْنَعْ: وَ + اصْنَعْ — wa-, and + iṣnaʿ, make! (verb I ṣanaʿa, imperative ms; with li- 'for him' as beneficiary); 'and make'
أَصْنَعَ: أَصْنَعَ — aṣnaʿa, I make (verb I ṣanaʿa, impf. 1cs subjunctive after an, 'I am not able to ...'); 'that I make'
صَنَعْتُ: صَنَعْتُ — ṣanaʿtu, I made (verb I, perf. 1cs; in the clause after illā idhā, 'except when I have made'); 'I have made'
يُحَصِّنُكَ: يُحَصِّن + كَ — yuḥaṣṣinu, he fortifies, protects (verb II of ḥaṣuna, impf. 3ms indic.; relative clause on baytan) + -ka, you; 'that fortifies you'
وَوَثَبَ: وَ + وَثَبَ — wa-, and + wathaba, to leap, spring (verb I, perf. 3ms; with ʿalayhi, 'on him'); 'and leapt'
يَمْزَحَ: يَمْزَحَ — mazaḥa, to joke, jest (verb I, impf. 3ms subjunctive after an, with maʿahu, 'with him'); 'to joke'
فَلَطَشَهُ: فَـ + لَطَشَ + هُ — fa-, and so, then (conj.) + laṭasha, to cuff, slap (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (object); 'and so he cuffed him'
نَجَّارُ: نَجَّار — najjār, carpenter (m., vocative after yā, ḍamma without tanwīn, as printed); 'O carpenter'
فَتَعَلَّ: فَـ + تَعَلَّ — fa-, and then + taʿalla, printed form of unclear root (perhaps for taʿallā or taʿālā, 'rose, recovered', suggested by the bracketed 'rose' of the literal layer); 'and (he) rose (?)' (uncertain)
تَنَاوَلَ: تَنَاوَلَ — tanāwala, to take, take hold of (verb VI of nāwala, perf. 3ms; takes a direct object); 'he took'
وَسَمَّرَ: وَ + سَمَّرَ — wa-, and + sammara, to nail (verb II of samara, perf. 3ms, from the noun mismār/sāmūr; here 'nailed together'); 'and nailed'
الْقَالَبِ: الـ + قَالَب — al-, the + qālab (usual qālib), mould, form (m., gen., after mithla, 'like'); 'the mould'
قِيَاسِ: قِيَاس — qiyās, measure, size (m. verbal noun of qāsa, gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-shibl, after ʿalā; ʿalā qiyāsi, 'to the measure of'); 'to the measure of'
وَخَلَّى: وَ + خَلَّى — wa-, and + khallā, to leave, let be (verb II, defective, perf. 3ms; takes object bābahu and a ḥāl maftūḥan); 'and left'
طَاقَةً: طَاقَة — ṭāqa, opening, window (f., acc. indef., object of fataḥa; ordinarily 'ability'); 'an opening'
غِطَاءً: غِطَاء — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (m., acc. indef., object of jaʿala); 'a cover'
وَثَقَبَ: وَ + ثَقَبَ — wa-, and + thaqaba, to bore, pierce (verb I, perf. 3ms; with fīhi, 'in it'); 'and bored'
ثُقَبًا: ثُقَب — thuqab, holes (pl. of thuqba; acc. indef., object of thaqaba); 'holes'
مَسَامِيرَ: مَسَامِير — masāmīr, nails (pl. of mismār; acc. diptote, object of akhraja, described by muṭarrafa); 'nails'
مُطَرَّفَةً: مُطَرَّفَة — muṭarrafa, pointed, tipped (f. sg. pass. part. of ṭarrafa II, acc., adjective of the non-human plural masāmīr); sense 'pointed' is a guess; 'pointed'
أَقِيسَهُ: أَقِيسَ + هُ — aqīsa, I measure (verb I qāsa, hollow, impf. 1cs subjunctive after ḥattā; with ʿalayka, 'against you') + -hu, it; 'so that I measure it'
ضَيِّقَةً: ضَيِّقَة — ḍayyiqa, narrow (f. sg. adj., acc., second complement of raʾā, 'saw it narrow'); 'narrow'
وَابْرِكْ: وَ + ابْرِكْ — wa-, and + ibrik, kneel, get down on all fours (verb I baraka, imperative ms, with ʿalā 'on'); 'and kneel'
وَرِجْلَيْكَ: وَ + رِجْلَيْ + كَ — wa-, and + rijlayka: rijl, foot, leg (f. dual, gen., after ʿalā; the final -ni drops before the suffix) + -ka, your; 'and your two feet'
ذَنَبُهُ: ذَنَب + هُ — dhanab, tail (m., nom., subject of baqiya) + -hu, his; 'his tail'
يَتَأَخَّرَ: يَتَأَخَّرَ — taʾakhkhara, to draw back (verb V, impf. 3ms subjunctive after an, with ilā warāʾihi); 'to draw back'
أَمْهِلْ: أَمْهِلْ — amhil, give time, wait (verb IV of mahala, imperative ms); 'give it time'
ذَنَبَكَ: ذَنَب + كَ — dhanab, tail (m., acc., object of yasiʿu) + -ka, your; 'your tail'
لَفَّ: لَفَّ — laffa, to wrap, roll up (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'rolled up'
وَحَشَاهُ: وَ + حَشَا + هُ — wa-, and + ḥashā, to stuff, cram (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the tail); 'and stuffed it'
اللَّوْحَ: الـ + لَوْح — al-, the + lawḥ, plank, board (m., acc., object of radda; radda ʿalā, 'put back over'); 'the plank'
وَسَمَّرَهُ: وَ + سَمَّرَ + هُ — wa-, and + sammara, to nail (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the plank); 'and nailed it (shut)'
نَجَّارُمَا: نَجَّار + مَا — najjār, carpenter (vocative after yā) + mā, what (interrog.); printed run together as يَا نَجَّارُمَا (misprint for yā najjāru mā); 'O carpenter, what'
الضَّيِّقُ: الـ + ضَيِّق — al-, the + ḍayyiq, narrow (adj., m., nom., describing al-bayt); 'the narrow'
صَنَعْتَهُ: صَنَعْتَ + هُ — ṣanaʿta, you made (verb I, perf. 2ms; relative clause after alladhī) + -hu, it (resumptive pronoun to al-bayt); 'which you made'
أَخْرُجْ: أَخْرُجْ — akhruj, I go out (verb I kharaja, impf. 1cs jussive, following the imperative daʿnī, 'let me'; with minhu, 'out of it'); 'let me go out'
مَافَاتَ: مَا + فَاتَ — mā, what (relative) + fāta, to pass, be lost (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms); printed run together as مَافَاتَ; 'what has passed'
ضِيقِ: ضِيق — ḍīq, narrowness, confinement (m. noun, gen., after min, first term of an iḍāfa with al-aqfāṣ); 'from the confinement of'
أَخْبَثَ: أَخْبَث — akhbath, most wicked, vilest (elative of khabīth; acc. as the annexed noun of a vocative, yā akhbatha l-wuḥūshi); 'O most wicked of'
الْخِطَابُ: الـ + خِطَاب — al-, the + khiṭāb, speech, address (m., nom., apposition/predicate in mā hādhā l-khiṭābu); 'the address'
تُخَاطِبُنِي: تُخَاطِبُ + نِي — tukhāṭibu, you address (verb III of khaṭaba, impf. 2ms indic.; takes bi- for the words used, in alladhī tukhāṭibunī bihi) + -nī, me; 'you address me'
وَقَدْرَمَاكَ: وَ + قَدْ + رَمَا + كَ — wa-, and + qad, indeed (before a perfect: 'has') + ramā, to throw, shoot (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms, subject al-qadar) + -ka, you; printed run together as وَقَدْرَمَاكَ; 'and (Fate) has shot you'
يَنْفَعْكَ: يَنْفَعْ + كَ — yanfaʿ, he profits, avails (verb I nafaʿa, impf. 3ms jussive after lam) + -ka, you; 'has not availed you'
الْحَذَرُ: الـ + حَذَر — al-, the + ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., nom., subject of yanfaʿ); 'caution'
حَذَّرَهُ: حَذَّرَ + هُ — ḥadhdhara, to warn (verb II, perf. 3ms; takes min for the thing warned against, hence ḥadhdharahu minhu) + -hu, him; 'had warned him (against)'
وَالْهَاتِفُ: وَ + الـ + هَاتِف — wa-, and + al-, the + hātif, unseen voice, crier (act. part. of hatafa I, m., nom., coordinated with abūhu as a second warner); 'and the voice'
بِلَاشَكٍّ: بِـ + لَا + شَكّ — bi-, with (prep.) + lā, no + shakk, doubt (m., gen.); bi-lā, 'without'; printed run together as بِلَاشَكٍّ; 'without doubt'
وَبَعُدْتُ: وَ + بَعُدْتُ — wa-, and + baʿudtu, I was far, drew away (verb I baʿuda, perf. 1cs; with ʿanhu, 'from him'); 'and I withdrew'
بِالشِّبْلِ: بِـ + الـ + شِبْل — bi-, with, to (prep.; faʿala bi-, 'do something to someone', chosen by the verb) + al-, the + shibl, lion cub (m., gen.); 'to the cub'
حَفَرَ: حَفَرَ — ḥafara, to dig (verb I, perf. 3ms; in the object-clause after raʾaytu, 'I saw ... dug'); 'dug'
وَأَحْرَقَهُ: وَ + أَحْرَقَ + هُ — wa-, and + aḥraqa, to burn (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with bi-l-nār, 'with fire') + -hu, it (the box); 'and burned it'
فَكَبُرَيَا: فَـ + كَبُرَ + يَا — fa-, so + kabura, to grow great (verb I, perf. 3ms, subject khawfī) + yā, O (vocative particle, before ukhtī); printed run together as فَكَبُرَيَا; 'so ... grew great, O'
وَخَائِفَةً: وَ + خَائِفَة — wa-, and + khāʾifa, fearing, afraid (f. act. part. of khāfa I; acc., ḥāl, coordinated with hāriba; takes min 'of' for the object of fear) ; 'and fearing'
الطَّاؤسَةُ: الـ + طَاؤُوسَة — al-, the + ṭāʾūsa, peahen (f., nom., subject of samiʿat); printed with ؤ spelling (usual ṭāwūsa); 'the peahen'
الطَّاؤسَةَ: الـ + طَاؤُوسَة — ṭāʾūsa, peahen (f.; acc. here, after أَنَّ); 'the peahen' (spelt without the second wāw)
أُخْتِى: أُخْت + ـِي — ukht, sister (f.) + 1s poss.; vocative after يَا, final ى for ي is Middle Arabic spelling; 'my sister'
أَمِنْتِ: أَمِنَ — amina, to be safe, secure (verb I, perf. 2fs; takes مِنْ of the danger); 'you are safe (from)'
لِأَنَنَّا: لِـ + أَنَّ + نَا — li-, because, for (conj.-prep. with أَنَّ, giving the reason) + anna + 1pl. suffix; the doubled nūn is printed as such; 'because we (are)'
جَزَٰئِرِ: جَزَائِر — jazāʾir, islands (pl. of jazīra; gen. after مِنْ, diptote -i); the hamza is written as a small superscript alif in the print; 'islands (of the sea)'
مَسْلَكٌ: مَسْلَك — maslak, way, passage, access (m.; nom. indef., subject of لَيْسَ); 'a way in'
