فَاخْتَارِى: فَـ + اخْتَارِي — fa-, so, then (introduces the command) + ikhtārī, choose (verb VIII, imper. 2fs; final ى for ي in the edition); 'so choose'
يُسَهِّلَ: سَهَّلَ — sahhala, to make easy, ease (verb II, subj. 3ms after إِلَى أَنْ); 'until (God) eases'
وَأَمْرَنَا: وَ + أَمْر + نَا — wa-, and (conj.) + amr, affair, matter, lot (m.; acc., second object of the verb with أَمْرَكِ) + 1pl. poss.; 'and our lot'
يَطْرُقَنِي: يَطْرُق + نِي — yaṭruqu, to come by night, knock, befall (verb I, subj. 3ms after أَنْ) + 1s obj. (with nūn al-wiqāya); 'that (a visitor) may come upon me'
وَالْقَضَاءُ: وَ + الْقَضَاء — wa-, and (here introducing a circumstantial/aphoristic clause) + al-qaḍāʾ, fate, divine decree (m.; nom., topic); 'and fate'
لَايَنْفَكُّ: لَا + يَنْفَكُّ — lā, not (neg.) + yanfakku, to break free, be released (verb VII, imperf. 3ms); the print runs لَا and the verb together; 'does not break free'
آبِقٌ: آبِق — ābiq, runaway, fugitive (act. part. of abaqa; m. nom., subject); 'a runaway'
اقْعُدِى: اقْعُدِي — uqʿudī, sit, stay (verb I, imper. 2fs; final ى for ي in the edition); 'stay'
قِلَّةَ: قِلَّة — qilla, fewness, scantiness (f.; acc., object of تَعْلَمِينَ, in construct with صَبْرِي); 'the littleness (of my patience)'
جَبِينِنَا: جَبِين + نَا — jabīn, forehead, brow (m.; gen. after عَلَى) + 1pl. poss.; the brow as the place where fate is written; 'on our brow'
نَسْتَوْفَاهُ: نَسْتَوْفِي + هُ — nastawfī, to receive in full, exact to the last (verb X, imperf. 1pl.; written نَسْتَوْفَاهُ, a Middle Arabic form with the verb's final -ā instead of the regular نَسْتَوْفِيهِ) + 3ms obj. (the thing written); 'we shall receive it in full'
أَجَلُنَا: أَجَل + نَا — ajal, appointed term, hour of death (m.; nom., subject of دَنَا) + 1pl. poss.; 'our hour'
يُخَلِّصُنَا: يُخَلِّص + نَا — yukhalliṣu, to rescue, deliver (verb II, imperf. 3ms) + 1pl. obj.; 'will rescue us'
وَلَنْ: وَ + لَنْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lan, never, will not (neg. of the future, takes subj.: تَمُوتَ); 'and never will (a soul die)'
تَسْتَوْفِىَ: تَسْتَوْفِيَ — tastawfiya, to receive in full (verb X, subj. 3fs after حَتَّى; final ى for ي in the edition); 'until it has received in full'
رِزْقَهَا: رِزْق + هَا — rizq, provision, livelihood allotted by God (m.; acc., object) + 3fs poss. (the soul's); 'its provision'
وَأَجَلَهَا: وَ + أَجَل + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ajal, term of life (m.; acc., second object) + 3fs poss.; 'and its span'
فَبَيْنَمَاهُمَا: فَـ + بَيْنَ + مَا + هُمَا — fa-, so (conj.) + bayna, between + mā (bayna-mā, 'while', introduces a clause) + 3 dual pronoun (the two of them); the clause is completed by إِذْ; 'and while the two of them (were talking)'
صَاحَتِ: صَاحَ — ṣāḥa, to cry out, shriek (verb I, perf. 3fs; ـتِ is the vowel linking to الْبَطَّةُ); 'cried out'
الْحَذَرَوَإِنْ: الْحَذَر + وَ + إِنْ — al-ḥadhar, caution, beware! (m.; acc., exclamatory, repeated in the text) + wa-, and (conj., here 'though') + in, if; the print runs the three together without a space; 'beware! ... though'
مَفَرٌّ: مَفَرّ — mafarr, place of flight, escape (m.; nom. indef., subject of يَكُنْ); 'a flight'
ظَبْيٌ: ظَبْي — ẓaby, gazelle (m.; nom. indef., subject of بَانَ); 'a gazelle'
فَاطْمَأَنَّتِ: فَـ + اطْمَأَنَّ — fa-, so, and (conj. of consequence) + iṭmaʾanna, to be at ease, be reassured (verb IV quadriliteral-form, perf. 3fs; ـتِ links to الْبَطَّةُ); 'so (the duck) was reassured'
وَالطَّاؤُوسَةُ: وَ + الطَّاؤُوسَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; nom., joined to الْبَطَّةُ); 'and the peahen'
لِلْبَطَّةِ: لِـ + الْ + بَطَّة — li-, to (prep., marks the person spoken to after قَالَتْ) + al-baṭṭa, the duck (f.; gen.); 'to the duck'
نَظَرْتِ: نَظَرْتِ — naẓarti, to look at, see (verb I, perf. 2fs); relative clause 'which you saw'
وَحَذِرْتِ: وَ + حَذِرْتِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥadhirti, to be wary, be afraid (verb I, perf. 2fs; takes مِنْ of the object feared); 'and were afraid (of it)'
وَهَاهُوَقَدْ: وَ + هَا + هُوَ + قَدْ — wa-, and + hā, behold + huwa, he (3ms) + qad, already (with perf. أَقْبَلَ); the print runs هَاهُوَ and قَدْ together; 'and here he is, he has come'
نَحْوَنَا: نَحْوَ + نَا — naḥwa, toward (adverbial acc., governing what follows) + 1pl. suffix; 'toward us'
الظَّبْيَ: الْ + ظَبْي — al-ẓaby, the gazelle (m.; acc., after إِنَّ/لِأَنَّ); 'the gazelle'
الْحَشَايِشَ: الْ + حَشَايِش — al-ḥashāyish, grasses, herbage (pl. of ḥashīsh; acc., object of يَأْكُلُ); 'the grasses'
هُوَالْآخَرُ: هُوَ + الْ + آخَر — huwa, he (3ms, topic) + al-ākhar, the other, in turn (m. nom.); with كَمَا أَنْتِ it means 'so he for his part'; the print runs them together; 'he, the other (one)'
فَاطْمَئِنِّي: فَـ + اطْمَئِنِّي — fa-, so (conj.) + iṭma'inni, be at ease (verb IV quadriliteral, imper. 2fs; ـنِّي = assimilated nūn + ī); 'so be at peace'
تَهْتَمِّي: تَهْتَمِّي — tahtammī, to be anxious, worry (verb VIII, jussive 2fs after لَا); 'do not fret'
يُنْحِلُ: يُنْحِل — yunḥilu, to make thin, emaciate (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); 'wears thin'
الْبَدَنَ: الْ + بَدَن — al-badan, the body (m.; acc., object); 'the body'
الظَّبْيُ: الْ + ظَبْي — al-ẓaby, the gazelle (m.; nom., subject of وَصَلَ); 'the gazelle'; also nom., topic of a nominal sentence: wa-dhāka al-ẓabyu martaʿuhu al-qulūbu, 'and that gazelle, his pasture is hearts' (Night 194, verse)
يَسْتَظِلُّ: يَسْتَظِلُّ — yastaẓillu, to seek shade, take shelter (verb X, imperf. 3ms; circumstantial clause, 'seeking shade'); 'taking shade'
الطَّاؤُوسَةَ: الـ + طَاؤُوسَة — al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; acc. in the phrase that closes the clause); 'the peahen'
وَالْبَطَّةَ: وَ + الْ + بَطَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-baṭṭa, the duck (f.; acc.); 'and the duck'
خِصْبًا: خِصْب — khiṣb, fertility, abundance (m.; acc. of specification after أَكْثَرَ مِنْهَا); 'more fertile' (lit. in fertility)
مَسْكَنًا: مَسْكَن — maskan, dwelling, place to live (m.; acc. of specification after أَحْسَنَ); 'a fairer place to live'
دَعَاهُمَا: دَعَا + هُمَا — daʿā, to call, invite (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual obj.; 'he invited the two of them'
لِمُرَافَقَتِهِ: لِـ + مُرَافَقَة + ـِهِ — li-, to, for (prep., giving the purpose of the invitation) + murāfaqa, companionship (f. vn. III, gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'to keep him company'
وَمُصَافَاتِهِ: وَ + مُصَافَاة + ـِهِ — wa-, and (conj.) + muṣāfāt, true friendship (f. vn. III, gen., second purpose after لِـ of the previous word) + 3ms poss.; 'and to be sincere friends with him'
تَوَدُّدَهُ: تَوَدُّد + هُ — tawaddud, courting of affection, friendly advances (m. vn. V; acc., object of رَأَتِ) + 3ms poss.; 'his warm advances'
أَقْبَلَتَا: أَقْبَلَ + تَا — aqbala, to turn toward, approach (verb IV, perf.; 3 dual fem.; takes عَلَى of the person approached); 'the two turned toward (him)'
وَرَغِبَتَا: وَ + رَغِبَ + تَا — wa-, and (conj.) + raghiba, to desire, take pleasure in (verb I, perf. 3 dual fem.; with فِي 'desire' something); 'and they were eager (for)'
عِشْرَتِهِ: عِشْرَة + ـِهِ — ʿishra, companionship, intimacy (f.; gen. after فِي) + 3ms poss.; 'his company'
فَتَصَادَقُوا: فَـ + تَصَادَقُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + taṣādaqū, to become friends with one another (verb VI, perf. 3mpl.); 'so they became friends'
وَتَحَالَفُوا: وَ + تَحَالَفُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥālafū, to make a pact with one another, swear alliance (verb VI, perf. 3mpl.); 'and swore a pact'
مَبِيتُهُمْ: مَبِيت + هُمْ — mabīt, night's lodging, place of sleeping (m. nom., subject of صَارَ) + 3mpl. poss.; 'their sleeping place'
وَمَأْكَلُهُمْ: وَ + مَأْكَل + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + maʾkal, food, place of eating (m. nom.) + 3mpl. poss.; 'and their food'
وَمَشْرَبُهُمْ: وَ + مَشْرَب + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + mashrab, drink, place of drinking (m. nom.) + 3mpl. poss.; 'and their drink'
أٓكِلِينَ: آكِلِين — ākilīn, eating (act. part. of akala, mpl. acc., ḥāl); the print writes أ where آ is meant, read with a madda here; 'eating'
شَارِبِينَ: شَارِبِينَ — shāribīn, drinking (act. part. of shariba, mpl. acc., ḥāl); 'drinking'
سَفِينَةٌ: سَفِينَة — safīna, ship (f.; nom. indef., subject of مَرَّتْ); 'a ship'
تَائِهَةً: تَائِهَة — tāʾiha, lost, wandering astray (act. part. of tāha, f. acc. indef., ḥāl/predicate of كَانَتْ); 'lost (at sea)'
فَأَرْسَتْ: فَـ + أَرْسَتْ — fa-, so, and then (conj.) + arsat, to drop anchor, moor (verb IV, perf. 3fs, the ship); 'and dropped anchor'
اجْتِمَاعَ: اجْتِمَاع — ijtimāʿ, gathering together, being together (m. vn. VIII; acc., object of رَأَوْا, in construct); 'the togetherness (of)'
الظَّبْيِ: الْ + ظَبْي — al-ẓaby, the gazelle (m.; gen., in construct after اجْتِمَاعَ); 'the gazelle'
وَالطَّاؤُوسَةِ: وَ + الطَّاؤُوسَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; gen., joined to الظَّبْيِ); 'and the peahen'
وَالْبَطَّةِ: وَ + الْبَطَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-baṭṭa, the duck (f.; gen., joined); 'and the duck'
فَأَقْبَلُوا: فَـ + أَقْبَلُوا — fa-, so (conj.) + aqbalū, to approach, turn toward (verb IV, perf. 3mpl.; with عَلَى 'toward them'); 'and they made toward (them)'
رَأَتْهُمُ: رَأَتْ + هُمُ — raʾat, to see (verb I, perf. 3fs, subject الطَّاؤُوسَةُ) + 3mpl. obj. (-hum, with -u before the following word); 'saw them'
وَشَرَدَ: وَ + شَرَدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + sharada, to bolt, flee (verb I, perf. 3ms, the gazelle); 'and bolted'
فَبَقِيَتِ: فَـ + بَقِيَتِ — fa-, so, but (conj.) + baqiyat, to remain, be left (verb I, perf. 3fs, duck; ـتِ before الْ); 'but remained'
مُخَبَّلَةً: مُخَبَّلَة — mukhabbala, dazed, bewildered (pass. part. of khabbala, verb II, f. acc. indef., predicate/ḥāl); 'dazed'
صَادُوهَا: صَادُوا + هَا — ṣādū, to hunt, catch (verb I, perf. 3mpl.; from ṣāda, root ṣ-y-d) + 3fs obj.; 'they caught her'
يَنْفَعْنِى: يَنْفَع + نِي — yanfaʿu, to benefit, profit (verb I, jussive 3ms after لَمْ) + 1s obj. (with nūn al-wiqāya; final ى for ي in the edition); 'did not avail me'
سَفِينَتِهِمْ: سَفِينَة + هِمْ — safīna, ship (f.; gen. after إِلَى) + 3mpl. poss.; 'their ship'
ارْتَحَلَتْ: ارْتَحَلَتْ — irtaḥalat, to depart, set out (verb VIII, perf. 3fs); 'she left'
إِلاّ: إِلَّا — illā, except, only (particle of exception, after the negative لَا أَرَى); the print sets its shadda over the alif rather than the lām; 'except'
مُرَاصِدَةً: مُرَاصِدَة — murāṣida, lying in wait, watching for (act. part. of rāṣada, verb III, f. acc. indef., ḥāl/second object of أَرَى); 'lying in wait'
السَّفِينَةُ: الْ + سَّفِينَة — al-safīna, the ship (f.; nom., subject of the lawlā clause); 'the ship'
افْتِرَاقٌ: افْتِرَاق — iftirāq, separation, parting (m. vn. VIII; nom. indef., subject of حَصَلَ); 'a parting'
الْأَصْدِقَاءِ: الْ + أَصْدِقَاء — al-aṣdiqāʾ, the friends (pl. of ṣadīq; gen., in construct after خِيَار); diptote ending -ʾ takes -i; 'of the friends'
طَارَتِ: طَارَتِ — ṭārat, to fly (verb I, perf. 3fs; ـتِ before الْ); 'flew'
وَاجْتَمَعَتْ: وَ + اجْتَمَعَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ijtamaʿat, to come together, meet (verb VIII, perf. 3fs; with بِـ of the person joined); 'and joined'
بِالظَّبْيِ: بِـ + الْ + ظَبْي — bi-, with (prep.; the verb اجْتَمَعَ chooses بِـ: 'join with') + al-ẓaby, the gazelle (gen.); 'with the gazelle' ; also: after mughram, 'in love with', bi- marks the beloved: mughraman bi-al-ẓabyi, 'in love with the fawn'
وَهَنَّاهَا: وَ + هَنَّأَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + hanna'a, to congratulate, give joy to (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj.; the thing congratulated for takes بِـ (بِالسَّلَامَةِ); 'and gave her joy'
الْعَدُوُّ: الْ + عَدُوّ — al-ʿaduww, the enemy (m.; nom., subject of أَخَذَهَا); 'the enemy' (the sailors)
قَطَّعَ: قَطَّعَ — qaṭṭaʿa, to cut to pieces, tear apart (verb II, perf. 3ms; intensive); in the verse the first occurrence is a statement, 'has torn' and the second a prayer, 'may (God) tear'; 'has torn to pieces'
يَوْم: يَوْم — yawm, day (m.; gen., in construct before الْفِرَاقِ); the print leaves off its case vowel; 'of the day (of parting)'
لِاُخْبِرُهُ: لِـ + أُخْبِرُ + ـهُ — li-, so that, in order to (particle of purpose) + ukhbiru, to tell, inform (verb IV, 1s; the print points -u where Classical has the subjunctive -a after li-) + 3ms obj. (the union); 'so that I might tell it'
الْفرَاقُ: الـ + فِرَاق — al-firāq, the parting, separation (m.; nom., subject of صَنَعَ); the print leaves the fāʾ without its kasra; 'the parting'
عَزْمَ: عَزْم — ʿazm, resolve, determination (m.; acc., object of رَدَّ, in construct); 'the resolve (of)'
الطَّاؤُوسَةِ: الطَّاؤُوسَة — al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; gen., in construct after عَزْمَ); 'of the peahen'
فَأَقَامَتْ: فَـ + أَقَامَتْ — fa-, so (conj.) + aqāmat, to stay, remain (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'so she stayed'
آمَنِينَ: آمِنِينَ — āminīn, safe, secure (act. part. of amina, mpl. acc., ḥāl); the print's vocalisation آمَنِينَ is irregular; 'in safety'
آكَلِينَ: آكِلِينَ — ākilīn, eating (act. part. of akala, mpl. acc., ḥāl); the key's آكَلِينَ is an irregular vocalisation; 'eating'
حَزِينَيْنِ: حَزِينَ + يْنِ — ḥazīn, sad, grieving (adj.; dual acc., predicate of لَمْ يَزَالَا); 'both grieving'
لِلطَّاؤُوسَةِ: لِـ + الْ + طَّاؤُوسَة — li-, to (prep., marks the addressee after قَالَ) + al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; gen.); 'to the peahen'
لِفِرَاقِنَا: لِـ + فِرَاق + نَا — li-, of, for (prep.; with سَبَبًا 'a cause for') + firāq, parting (m. vn.; gen.) + 1pl. poss.; 'for our parting'
وَلِهَلَاكِ: وَ + لِـ + هَلَاك — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, for (prep., 'cause for', as above) + halāk, destruction (m.; gen., in construct, of الْبَطَّةِ); 'and for the destruction (of the duck)'
فَاحْذَرِيهِمْ: فَـ + احْذَرِي + هِمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + iḥdharī, beware, be wary of (verb I, imper. 2fs; takes the object directly) + 3mpl. obj.; 'so beware of them'
وَاحْتَرِسِي: وَ + احْتَرِسِي — wa-, and (conj.) + iḥtarisī, to be on guard (verb VIII, imper. 2fs; takes مِنْ of what is guarded against); 'and guard yourself (from)'
وَخِدَاعِهِ: وَ + خِدَاع + ـِهِ — wa-, and (conj.) + khidāʿ, deceit, trickery (m.; gen., joined to مَكْرِ after مِنْ) + 3ms poss. (the Son of Adam's); 'and his deceit'
يَقِينًا: يَقِين + ًا — yaqīn, certainty (m.; acc. indef., adverbial acc.); 'for certain' Also as an adjective, 'certain', agreeing with an accusative noun: ʿilman yaqīnan, 'with certain knowledge'.
مَاقَتَلَهَا: مَا + قَتَلَ + هَا — mā, not (neg., after أَنْ, 'that nothing') + qatala, to kill (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3fs obj. (the duck); the print runs مَا and the verb together; 'nothing killed her'
تَرْكِهَا: تَرْك + هَا — tark, abandoning, neglect (m. vn.; nom., in the exception after غَيْرُ, in construct) + 3fs poss. (the duck's); 'her neglect'
تَرْكِكِ: تَرْك + كِ — tark, abandoning (m. vn.; gen., in construct after مِنْ) + 2fs poss. (you, the duck, 'your neglect'); 'your giving up'
خَلَقَهُ: خَلَق + هُ — khalaqa, to create (verb I, perf. 3ms; relative clause) + 3ms obj.; 'that He has created'
يُسَبِّحُهُ: يُسَبِّح + هُ — yusabbiḥu, to glorify, praise God (verb II, imperf. 3ms; takes the object directly) + 3ms obj. (God); 'praises Him'
التَّسْبِيحِ: الْ + تَّسْبِيح — al-tasbīḥ, the glorification, praise of God (m. vn. II; gen. after عَنْ); 'of praising God'
عُوقِبَ: عُوقِبَ — ʿūqiba, to be punished (verb III passive, perf. 3ms); 'is punished'
بِهَلَاكِهِ: بِـ + هَلَاك + ـِهِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrument of the punishment: 'punished with') + halāk, destruction (m.; gen.) + 3ms poss.; 'with its own destruction'
الطَّاؤُوسَةِ: الطَّاؤُوسَة — al-ṭāʾūsa, the peahen (f.; gen., in construct after كَلَامَ); 'of the peahen'
صُورَتَكِ: صُورَة + كِ — ṣūra, form, shape (f.; acc., object of أَحْسَنَ) + 2fs poss.; 'your form'
يَفْتُرُ: يَفْتُر — yaftur, to slacken, grow lax (verb I, imperf. 3ms; takes عَنْ of what one leaves off); 'slackens'
تَسْبِيحَ: تَسْبِيح — tasbīḥ, glorification, praise of God (m. vn. II; acc., after إِنَّ, in construct); 'the praise (of the gazelle)'
الْجَبَرُوتِ: الْ + جَبَرُوت — al-jabarūt, might, omnipotence (m.; gen., in construct after ذِي); 'of might'
وَالسُّلْطَانِ: وَ + الْ + سُّلْطَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-sulṭān, dominion, authority (m.; gen., joined to الْجَبَرُوتِ); 'and dominion'
وَوَرَدَ: وَ + وَرَدَ — wa-, and (conj.) + warada, to come, be related (verb I, perf. 3ms; 'it has been reported', the traditionist formula); 'and it is reported'
يَتَعَبَّدُ: يَتَعَبَّد — yataʿabbadu, to devote oneself to worship (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'devoted himself to worship'
زَوْجٌ: زَوْج — zawj, pair, couple, mate (m.; nom. indef., subject of يَأْوِي); 'a pair (of pigeons)'
قَسَمَ: قَسَمَ — qasama, to divide, share out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'divided'
قُوتَهُ: قُوت + هُ — qūt, sustenance, daily food (m.; acc., object) + 3ms poss.; 'his food'
وَنِصْفَهُ: وَ + نِصْف + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + niṣf, half (m.; acc. as object of جَعَلَ) + -hu, his (3ms suffix, the worshipper's); 'and half of it'
الزَّوْجِ: الـ + زَوْج — al-, the + zawj, pair, couple (m.; gen. after لِـ in لِذَلِكَ الزَّوْجِ, in apposition with الْحَمَامِ); 'the pair'
النَّسْلِ: الـ + نَسْل — al-, the + nasl, offspring, progeny (m.; gen. as second term of the iḍāfa after كَثْرَةِ); 'the progeny'
فَكَثُرَ: فَـ + كَثُرَ — fa-, so, and then (conj.) + kathura, to be/become many, multiply (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and so it multiplied'
نَسْلُهُمَا: نَسْل + هُمَا — nasl, offspring (m.; nom. as subject) + -humā, their (3 dual suffix, the two doves); 'their offspring'
الْحَمَامُ: الـ + حَمَام — al-, the + ḥamām, doves, pigeons (collective m.; nom. as subject of يَكُنِ); 'the doves'
تَسْبِيحِ: تَسْبِيح — tasbīḥ, glorification, praise of God (verbal noun of II sabbaḥa, m.; gen. as first term of iḍāfa after كَثْرَةَ); 'the glorifying of'
تَسْبِيحِهِ: تَسْبِيح + هِ — tasbīḥ, glorification (m.; gen. after فِي) + -hi, its (3ms suffix, the dove's); 'in its glorification'
وَقَاسِمِ: وَ + قَاسِم — wa-, and (conj.) + qāsim, one who apportions, divider (act. part. I of qasama, m.; gen. in iḍāfa, coordinate with خَالِقِ); 'and apportioner of'
وَبَانِى: وَ + بَانِي — wa-, and (conj.) + bānī, builder (act. part. I of banā, final-weak, m.; gen. in iḍāfa, the final yāʾ written ى); 'and builder of'
السَّمٰوَاتِ: الـ + سَمَاوَات — al-, the + samāwāt, heavens (f. pl. of سَمَاء; gen. as second term of iḍāfa; dagger alif spelling); 'the heavens'
وَبَاسِطِ: وَ + بَاسِط — wa-, and (conj.) + bāsiṭ, one who spreads out (act. part. I of basaṭa, m.; gen. in iḍāfa); 'and spreader of'
الْأَرَضِينَ: الـ + أَرَضِين — al-, the + araḍīn, earths, lands (irregular sound-masc.-pl. form of أَرْض, f.; gen. as second term of iḍāfa); 'the earths'
الزَّوْجُ: الـ + زَوْج — al-, the + zawj, pair (m.; nom., in apposition to ذَلِكَ, subject of لَمْ يَزَلْ); 'the pair'
وَنَسْلُهُ: وَ + نَسْل + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + nasl, offspring (m.; nom., coordinate with the subject) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'and his offspring'
فَتَشَتَّتَ: فَـ + تَشَتَّتَ — fa-, so, then (conj.) + tashattata, to be scattered, dispersed (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and so was scattered'
شَمْلُ: شَمْل — shaml, union, togetherness, gathering (m.; nom. as subject, first term of iḍāfa with الْحَمَامِ); 'the union of'
وَالْقُرَى: وَ + الـ + قُرَى — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + qurā, villages (broken pl. of قَرْيَة, f.; gen. after فِي, coordinate with الْمُدُنِ); 'and the villages'
الرُّعَاةِ: الـ + رُعَاة — al-, the + ruʿāt, shepherds, herdsmen (broken pl. of رَاعٍ; gen. after مِنْ); 'the shepherds'
وَعِفَّةٍ: وَ + عِفَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿiffa, chastity, continence (f.; gen. indef., coordinate with دِينٍ وَعَقْلٍ in the iḍāfa after صَاحِبَ); 'and chastity'
أَغْنَامًا: أَغْنَام — aghnām, flocks of sheep and goats (pl. of غَنَم; acc. indef., Middle Arabic acc. for the grammatical subject of كَانَ لَهُ); 'flocks'
يَرْعَاهَا: يَرْعَى + هَا — yarʿā, to pasture, tend (verb I, impf. 3ms, final-weak, indic.) + -hā, them (3fs suffix, the flocks; obj.); 'he tended them'
بِأَلْبَانِهَا: بِـ + لَبَن + هَا — bi-, with, by means of (prep.; يَنْتَفِعُ بِـ 'benefit from') + albān, milks, milk products (pl. of لَبَن, m.; gen. after bi-) + -hā, their (3fs suffix, the flocks'); 'from their milk'
وَأَصْوَافِهَا: وَ + أَصْوَاف + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aṣwāf, wools, fleeces (pl. of صُوف, m.; gen., governed by the same بِـ of يَنْتَفِعُ بِـ) + -hā, their (3fs); 'and their wool'
الْجَبَلُ: الـ + جَبَل — al-, the + jabal, mountain (m.; nom., predicate/subject of كَانَ with ذَلِكَ); 'the mountain'
وَالْمَرْعَى: وَ + الـ + مَرْعَى — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + marʿā, pasture, grazing ground (m., final-weak; gen. in coordination with الْأَشْجَارِ, after كَثِيرَ); 'and the pasture'
وَالسِّبَاعِ: وَ + الـ + سِبَاع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + sibāʿ, beasts of prey (pl. of سَبُع; gen., coordinate); 'and the beasts of prey'
مُطْمَئِنًّا: مُطْمَئِنّ — muṭmaʾinn, at ease, tranquil, secure (act. part. of IV iṭmaʾanna, quadriliteral-type; acc. indef. as ḥāl); 'at ease'
يَهُمُّهُ: يَهُمُّ + هُ — yahummu, to concern, worry, weigh on (verb I, doubled root hamma, impf. 3ms, indic.) + -hu, him (3ms suffix; obj.); 'it concerned him'
لِسَعَادَتِهِ: لِـ + سَعَادَة + هِ — li-, because of, on account of (prep., causal) + saʿāda, happiness, felicity (f.; gen. after li-) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'because of his happiness'
وَإِقْبَالِهِ: وَ + إِقْبَال + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + iqbāl, devotion, turning toward (verbal noun of IV aqbala, m.; gen., coordinate with سَعَادَتِهِ) + -hi, his (3ms); 'and his devotion'
وَعِبَادَتِهِ: وَ + عِبَادَة + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿibāda, worship (f.; gen., coordinate after عَلَى) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'and his worship'
كَهْفِ: كَهْف — kahf, cave (m.; gen. as first term of iḍāfa with الْجَبَلِ, after فِي); 'the cave of'
مَرْعَاهَا: مَرْعَى + هَا — marʿā, pasture, grazing place (m., final-weak; gen. after إِلَى) + -hā, their (3fs suffix, the sheep's); 'their pasture'
وَتَأْوِي: وَ + تَأْوِي — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾwī, to take refuge, shelter (verb I, impf. 3fs, indic., 'the sheep' being fem. collective; governs إِلَى 'to'); 'and they take shelter'
الْكَهْفِ: الـ + كَهْف — al-, the + kahf, cave (m.; gen. after إِلَى); 'the cave'
يَخْتَبِرَ: يَخْتَبِرَ — yakhtabira, to test, try (verb VIII ikhtabara, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ); 'to test'
وَيَمْتَحِنَهُ: وَ + يَمْتَحِنَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yamtaḥina, to put to the proof, examine (verb VIII imtaḥana, impf. 3ms, subjunctive after أَنْ) + -hu, him (3ms suffix; obj.); 'and to put him to the proof'
وَصَبْرِهِ: وَ + صَبْر + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣabr, patience, endurance (m.; gen., coordinate after فِي) + -hi, his (3ms); 'and his patience'
مَلَكًا: مَلَك — malak, angel (m.; acc. indef., object of بَعَثَ); 'an angel'
الْمَلَكُ: الـ + مَلَك — al-, the + malak, angel (m.; nom. as subject of دَخَلَ); 'the angel'
حَسْنَاءَ: حَسْنَاء — ḥasnāʾ, beautiful, fair (f. of أَحْسَن, elative-pattern colour/defect type; gen. indef., diptote, adjective of امْرَأَةٍ); 'beautiful'
بَدَنُهُ: بَدَن + هُ — badan, body (m.; nom. as subject of اقْشَعَرَّ) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his body'; here also subject of talawwatha, 'was smeared'
دَعَاكِ: دَعَا + كِ — daʿā, to call, summon, induce (verb I, perf. 3ms, final-weak, subject الَّذِي) + -ki, you (2fs suffix; obj.); 'called you / brought you'
الْمَجِيءِ: الـ + مَجِيء — al-, the + majīʾ, coming (verbal noun of I jāʾa, m.; gen. after إِلَى); 'the coming'
وَلَابَيْنِي: وَ + لَا + بَيْنَ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, not (negation; the print runs it together with the next word) + bayna, between (adverbial noun, acc.) + -ī, me (1s suffix); 'nor (is there anything) between me (and you)'; the print's run-together form of وَلَا بَيْنِي
لِدُخُولِكِ: لِـ + دُخُول + كِ — li-, for, as the ground of (prep.; ما يُوجِبُ لِـ 'what necessitates') + dukhūl, entering (verbal noun of I dakhala, m.; gen. after li-) + -ki, your (2fs suffix); 'for your entering'
حُسْنِي: حُسْن + ي — ḥusn, beauty (m.; acc. as object of تَرَى) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my beauty'
وَجَمَالِي: وَ + جَمَال + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + jamāl, comeliness, beauty (m.; acc., coordinate with حُسْنِي) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'and my loveliness'; here: gen., coordinate with bi-ḥusnī after tamattaʿ bi-
وَطِيبَ: وَ + طِيب — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭīb, pleasantness, fragrance (m.; acc., object of تَرَى, first term of iḍāfa); 'and the sweetness of' Also object of khalaqa: khalaqa Allāhu … ṭība al-nasīmi, 'God created … the sweetness of the breeze'.
رَائِحَتِي: رَائِحَة + ي — rāʾiḥa, scent, smell (f.; gen. as second term of iḍāfa) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my scent'
وَأَحْبَبْتُ: وَ + أَحْبَبْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥbabtu, to love, like (verb IV, perf. 1s, doubled root); 'and I loved'
وِصَالَكَ: وِصَال + كَ — wiṣāl, union, intimacy (verbal noun of III wāṣala, m.; acc. as object) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your union'
جِئْتُكَ: جِئْتُ + كَ — jiʾtu, to come (verb I, perf. 1s, hamzated, mithāl-type jāʾa) + -ka, you (2ms suffix; direct object, 'come to you'); 'I came to you'
طَائِعَةً: طَائِعَة — ṭāʾiʿa, willing, obedient (act. part. I of ṭāʿa, f.; acc. indef. as ḥāl); 'willingly'
مُمْتَنِعَةٍ: مُمْتَنِعَة — mumtaniʿa, refusing, resistant (act. part. VIII of imtanaʿa, f.; gen. indef., after غَيْرَ in iḍāfa, governing عَلَيْكَ); 'refusing'
نَخْشَاهُ: نَخْشَى + هُ — nakhshā, to fear (verb I, impf. 1pl., final-weak, indic.) + -hu, him (3ms suffix; obj.; relative clause on أَحَدٌ); 'we would fear him'
مُقَامِكَ: مُقَام + كَ — muqām, staying, residence (verbal noun of IV, m.; gen. as second term of iḍāfa after طُولَ) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your stay'
أَنِيسَةً: أَنِيسَة — anīsa, companion, friendly (f. of أَنِيس; acc. indef., predicate of أَكُونَ); 'a companion'
عَرَضْتُ: عَرَضْتُ — ʿaraḍtu, to offer, present (verb I, perf. 1s; عَرَضَ نَفْسَهُ عَلَى 'offer oneself to'); 'I offered'
لِخِدْمَةِ: لِـ + خِدْمَة — li-, for, in need of (prep.; تَحْتَاجُ لِـ 'need') + khidma, service (f.; gen. after li-, first term of iḍāfa with النِّسَاءِ); 'for the service of'
بَاشَرْتَنِي: بَاشَرْتَ + نِي — bāsharta, to have close contact with, to lie with (verb III, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me (1s object suffix with nūn al-wiqāya); 'you lay with me'
مَرَضُكَ: مَرَض + كَ — maraḍ, illness (m.; nom. as subject of زَالَ) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your illness'
صِحَّتُكَ: صِحَّة + كَ — ṣiḥḥa, health (f.; nom. as subject of عَادَتْ) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your health'
فَاتَكَ: فَاتَ + كَ — fāta, to escape, be missed by (verb I, perf. 3ms, hollow; takes direct object) + -ka, you (2ms suffix); 'what escaped you'
فَاقْبَلْ: فَـ + اقْبَلْ — fa-, so, therefore (conj.) + iqbal, to accept (verb I qabila, imper. 2ms); 'so accept'
الْخَدَّاعَةُ: الـ + خَدَّاعَة — al-, the + khaddāʿa, deceitful (intensive faʿʿāl pattern, f. of خَدَّاع; nom. adjective in vocative construction أَيَّتُهَا الْمَرْأَةُ); 'the deceitful'
الْغَدَّارَةُ: الـ + غَدَّارَة — al-, the + ghaddāra, treacherous (intensive faʿʿāl pattern, f. of غَدَّار; nom. adjective after أَيَّتُهَا الْمَرْأَةُ); 'the treacherous'
أَرْكَنُ: أَرْكَنُ — arkanu, to lean on, rely on, trust (verb I rakana, impf. 1s, indic.; governs إِلَى); 'I rely'
أَدْنُو: أَدْنُو — adnū, to approach, draw near (verb I danā, impf. 1s, final-weak, indic.; with مِنْ 'to approach someone'); 'I draw near'
بِقُرْبِكِ: بِـ + قُرْب + كِ — bi-, in, with (prep.; لَا حَاجَةَ لِي بِـ 'I have no need of') + qurb, nearness (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ki, your (2fs suffix); 'of your nearness'
بِوِصَالِكِ: بِـ + وِصَال + كِ — bi-, in, with (prep.; same construction, لَا حَاجَةَ بِـ 'no need of') + wiṣāl, union (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ki, your (2fs suffix); 'of your union'
رَغِبَ: رَغِبَ — raghiba, to desire, be fond of (verb I, perf. 3ms; governs فِي 'desire something'); 'desired'
لِعِبَادِهِ: لِـ + عِبَاد + هِ — li-, over, in respect of (prep.; بِالْمِرْصَادِ لِـ 'lying in wait for') + ʿibād, servants, worshippers (pl. of عَبْد, m.; gen. after li-) + -hi, his (3ms suffix, God's); 'for His servants'
وَالْوَيْلُ: وَ + الـ + وَيْل — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + wayl, woe, perdition (m.; nom. as subject, with predicate لِمَنِ 'for whoever'); 'and woe'
ابْتُلِىَ: ابْتُلِيَ — ubtuliya, to be afflicted, tried (verb VIII ibtalā, perf. 3ms passive, final-weak; yāʾ written ى); 'was afflicted'
بِصُحْبَتِكِ: بِـ + صُحْبَة + كِ — bi-, with (prep.; ابْتُلِيَ بِـ 'be afflicted with') + ṣuḥba, company, companionship (f.; gen. after bi-) + -ki, your (2fs suffix); 'with your company'
التَّايِهُ: الـ + تَايِه — al-, the + tāyih, one who strays, lost (misprint/Middle Arabic spelling for التَّائِهُ, act. part. I of tāha; hollow, with yāʾ for hamza; nom. in vocative أَيُّهَا); 'the one who has strayed'
وَالضَّالُّ: وَ + الـ + ضَالّ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḍāll, one gone astray (act. part. I of ḍalla, doubled root, m.; nom., coordinate in the vocative); 'and the one who has gone astray'
الرَّشَادِ: الـ + رَشَاد — al-, the + rashād, right guidance, rectitude (m.; gen. as second term of iḍāfa after طَرِيقِ); 'the right guidance'
بِوَجْهِكَ: بِـ + وَجْه + كَ — bi-, with (prep.; أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ 'turn one's face') + wajh, face (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'with your face'
وَاغْتَنِمْ: وَ + اغْتَنِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ightanim, to seize, profit by (verb VIII ightanama, imper. 2ms); 'and seize'
قُرْبِي: قُرْب + ي — qurb, nearness (m.; acc. as object of اغْتَنِمْ) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my nearness'
تَجْرِبَةً: تَجْرِبَة — tajriba, experience (f.; acc. indef., specification tamyīz after أَكْثَرَ); 'in experience'
وَأَصْوَبَ: وَ + أَصْوَب — wa-, and (conj.) + aṣwab, more correct, sounder (elative of ṣawāb, acc. as predicate of كَانُوا, coordinate with أَكْثَرَ); 'and sounder'
يَرْفُضُوا: يَرْفُضُوا — yarfuḍū, to reject, refuse (verb I, impf. 3mpl., jussive after لَمْ, nūn dropped; alif of the plural written); 'they did not reject'
رَفَضْتَ: رَفَضْتَ — rafaḍta, to reject, refuse (verb I, perf. 2ms; relative clause on مَا); 'you rejected'
التَّمَتُّعِ: الـ + تَمَتُّع — al-, the + tamattuʿ, enjoyment (verbal noun of V tamattaʿa, m.; gen. after مِنْ); 'the enjoyment'
بِالنِّسَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + نِسَاء — bi-, with, of (prep.; التَّمَتُّعُ بِـ 'enjoy something') + al-, the + nisāʾ, women (broken pl., irregular, of اِمْرَأَة; gen. after bi-); 'of women' Also after saʾala, 'to ask', bi- marks the subject asked about: in tasʾalūnī bi-al-nisāʾi, 'if you ask me about women'.
رَغِبُوا: رَغِبُوا — raghibū, to desire, be fond of (verb I, perf. 3mpl.; governs فِي); 'they desired'
زَهِدْتَ: زَهِدْتَ — zahidta, to renounce, abstain, have no desire for (verb I, perf. 2ms; governs فِي); 'you renounced'
مُبَاشَرَةِ: مُبَاشَرَة — mubāshara, close contact, sexual intercourse (verbal noun of III bāshara, f.; gen. after مِنْ, first term of iḍāfa with النِّسَاءِ); 'intimacy with'
وَقُرْبِهِنَّ: وَ + قُرْب + هِنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + qurb, nearness (m.; gen., coordinate with مُبَاشَرَةِ) + -hinna, their (3fpl. suffix, the women's); 'and nearness to them'
أَسَاءَهُمْ: أَسَاءَ + هُمْ — asāʾa, to displease, harm (verb IV, perf. 3ms, hollow-hamzate) + -hum, them (3mpl. suffix; obj.); 'it harmed them'
دُنْيَاهُمْ: دُنْيَا + هُمْ — dunyā, this world, worldly life (f.; gen., coordinate with دِينِهِمْ after فِي) + -hum, their (3mpl. suffix); 'their worldly life'
رَأْيِكَ: رَأْي + كَ — raʾy, opinion, view (m.; gen. after عَنْ) + -ka, your (2ms suffix); 'your opinion'
تَحْمَدْ: تَحْمَدْ — taḥmad, to praise, find good, approve (verb I ḥamida, impf. 2ms, jussive as the apodosis of the imperative فَارْجِعْ); 'you will find good'
نَكِرْتُهُ: نَكِرْتُ + هُ — nakirtu, to disown, find strange or objectionable (verb I nakira, perf. 1s; Middle Arabic form for أَنْكَرْتُ) + -hu, it (3ms suffix; obj.); 'I rejected it'
وَكَرِهْتُهُ: وَ + كَرِهْتُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + karihtu, to dislike, hate (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hu, it (3ms suffix; obj.); 'and I disliked it'
تُبْدِينَهُ: تُبْدِينَ + هُ — tubdīna, to show, reveal (verb IV abdā, impf. 2fs, final-weak, indic.) + -hu, it (3ms suffix; obj.; relative clause on مَا); 'you show it'
زَهِدْتُهُ: زَهِدْتُ + هُ — zahidtu, to renounce, spurn (verb I, perf. 1s; here taking a direct object, Middle Arabic for زَهِدْتُ فِيهِ) + -hu, it (3ms suffix); 'I renounced it'
خَدَّاعَةٌ: خَدَّاعَة — khaddāʿa, deceitful, a deceiver (intensive faʿʿāl pattern, f.; nom. indef., predicate of إِنَّكِ); 'deceitful'
غَدَّارَةٌ: غَدَّارَة — ghaddāra, treacherous, perfidious (intensive faʿʿāl pattern, f.; nom. indef., predicate); 'treacherous'
عَهْدَ: عَهْد — ʿahd, covenant, loyalty, pledge (m.; acc. without tanwīn, as the noun of لَا of absolute negation); 'no pledge'
وَفَاءَ: وَ + وَفَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + wafāʾ, fidelity, faithfulness (m.; acc. without tanwīn, noun of the second لَا); 'and no faithfulness'
قَبِيحٍ: قَبِيح — qabīḥ, ugly, vile, foul (adj. of faʿīl pattern used as a noun, m.; gen. indef. after مِنْ in كَمْ مِنْ); 'a foul thing'
أَخْفَيْتِهِ: أَخْفَيْتِ + هُ — akhfayti, to hide, conceal (verb IV, perf. 2fs, final-weak) + -hu, it (3ms suffix; obj., resumptive, relative clause on قَبِيحٍ); 'you concealed it'
فَتَنْتِهِ: فَتَنْتِ + هُ — fatanti, to tempt, seduce, lead astray (verb I, perf. 2fs) + -hu, him (3ms suffix; obj., relative clause on صَالِحٍ); 'you seduced him'
عَاقِبَتُهُ: عَاقِبَة + هُ — ʿāqiba, outcome, end (f.; nom. as subject of كَانَتْ) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his end'
النَّدَامَةِ: الـ + نَدَامَة — al-, the + nadāma, regret, remorse (f.; gen. after إِلَى); 'the regret'
وَالْخُسْرَانِ: وَ + الـ + خُسْرَان — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + khusrān, loss, perdition (verbal noun of I khasira, m.; gen., coordinate with النَّدَامَةِ); 'and the ruin'
فَارْجِعِي: فَـ + ارْجِعِي — fa-, so, therefore (conj.) + irjiʿī, to go back, withdraw (verb I, imper. 2fs; with عَنْ 'depart from'); 'so go away'
الْمُصْلِحَةُ: الـ + مُصْلِحَة — al-, the + muṣliḥa, one who improves, reforms (act. part. IV of aṣlaḥa, f.; nom. in vocative أَيَّتُهَا, governing نَفْسَهَا); 'the one who improves'
لِفَسَادِ: لِـ + فَسَاد — li-, for the sake of, at the cost of (prep.; مُصْلِحَةٌ نَفْسَهَا لِـ 'improving herself at the expense of') + fasād, corruption, ruin (verbal noun of I fasada, m.; gen. after li-, first term of iḍāfa with غَيْرِهَا); 'at the corruption of'
عَبَاءَتَهُ: عَبَاءَة + هُ — ʿabāʾa, cloak, mantle (f.; acc. as object of أَلْقَى) + -hu, his (3ms suffix); 'his cloak'
وَاشْتَغَلَ: وَ + اشْتَغَلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ishtaghala, to busy oneself, occupy oneself (verb VIII, perf. 3ms; governs بِـ 'with'); 'and busied himself'
قَرْيَةٌ: قَرْيَة — qarya, village (f.; nom. indef., delayed subject after the fronted predicate قَرِيبًا مِنَ الرَّاعِي); 'a village'
فَاسْتَرَاحَ: فَـ + اسْتَرَاحَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + istarāḥa, to rest, take ease (verb X, perf. 3ms, hollow); 'and so he rested'
بِوُحُوشٍ: بِـ + وُحُوش — bi-, only marks what appears (prep. after فَإِذَا هُوَ, of surprise: 'behold, he was with…') + wuḥūsh, wild animals (broken pl. of وَحْش, m.; gen. indef. after bi-); 'with wild beasts'
وَطُيُورٍ: وَ + طُيُور — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭuyūr, birds (broken pl. of طَيْر, m.; gen. indef., coordinate with وُحُوشٍ); 'and birds'
لِيَشْرَبُوا: لِـ + يَشْرَبُوا — li-, in order to (conj. of purpose, + subjunctive) + yashrabū, to drink (verb I, impf. 3mpl., subjunctive, nūn dropped; alif written); 'so that they might drink'
رَأَوُا: رَأَوْا — raʾaw, to see (verb I, perf. 3mpl., hamzated final-weak; the wāw takes ḍamma before al-: رَأَوُا الْعَابِدَ); 'they saw'
وَشَرَدُوا: وَ + شَرَدُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + sharadū, to run away, bolt, flee (verb I, perf. 3mpl.); 'and they fled'
أَسْتَرِحْ: أَسْتَرِحْ — astariḥ, to rest (verb X istarāḥa, impf. 1s, jussive after لَمْ, hollow shortened vowel); 'I did not rest'
مُعَاتِبًا: مُعَاتِب — muʿātib, reproaching, rebuking (act. part. III of ʿātaba, m.; acc. indef. as ḥāl; takes لِـ 'rebuke someone'); 'reproachfully'
جُلُوسِي: جُلُوس + ي — julūs, sitting (verbal noun of I jalasa, m.; nom. as subject of أَضَرَّ, delayed) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my sitting'
الْعُذْرُ: الـ + عُذْر — al-, the + ʿudhr, excuse (m.; nom. as predicate/subject after مَا 'what excuse'); 'the excuse'
خَالِقِي: خَالِق + ي — khāliq, creator (act. part. I of khalaqa, m.; gen. after بَيْنَ) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my Creator'
وَخَالِقِ: وَ + خَالِق — wa-, and (conj.) + khāliq, creator (act. part. I, m.; gen., coordinate with خَالِقِي, first term of iḍāfa with الطُّيُورِ); 'and the creator of'
لِشُرُودِهِمْ: لِـ + شُرُود + هِمْ — li-, for, causing (prep.; سَبَبًا لِـ 'a cause of') + shurūd, fleeing, bolting (verbal noun of I sharada, m.; gen. after li-) + -him, their (3mpl. suffix); 'of their fleeing'
شُرْبِهِمْ: شُرْب + هِمْ — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of I shariba, m.; gen. after عَنْ) + -him, their (3mpl. suffix); 'their drinking'
رِزْقِهِمْ: رِزْق + هِمْ — rizq, provision, sustenance (m.; gen. after عَنْ) + -him, their (3mpl. suffix); 'their sustenance'
وَمَرْعَاهُمْ: وَ + مَرْعَى + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + marʿā, pasture (m., final-weak; gen., coordinate after عَنْ) + -hum, their (3mpl. suffix); 'and their pasture'
خَجْلَتِي: خَجْلَة + ي — khajla, shame, embarrassment (f.; acc./nom. of lament after وَا, the accusative of exclamation) + -ī, my (1s suffix); 'my shame'
يُقْتَصُّ: يُقْتَصُّ — yuqtaṣṣu, to be retaliated, have retribution exacted (verb VIII iqtaṣṣa, impf. 3ms passive, doubled root; governs لِـ مِنْ 'for X from Y'); 'retribution is taken'
لِلشَّاةِ: لِـ + الـ + شَاة — li-, for, on behalf of (prep.; يُقْتَصُّ لِـ 'justice is done for') + al-, the + shāh, sheep, ewe (f.; gen. after li-, the lām assimilated to al-); 'for the sheep'
الْجَمَّاءِ: الـ + جَمَّاء — al-, the + jammāʾ, hornless, polled (f. of أَجَمّ, diptote; gen. adjective of الشَّاةِ); 'the hornless'
الشَّاةِ: الـ + شَاة — al-, the + shāh, sheep, ewe (f.; gen. after مِنْ); 'the sheep'
الْقَرْنَاءِ: الـ + قَرْنَاء — al-, the + qarnāʾ, horned (f. of أَقْرَن, diptote; gen. adjective of الشَّاةِ); 'the horned'
الْاَنَامُ: الـ + أَنَام — al-, the + anām, mankind, creatures (collective m.; nom. as subject of عَلِمَ; print spelling with plain alif for hamza); 'mankind'
خُلِقُوْا: خُلِقُوا — khuliqū, to be created (verb I khalaqa, perf. 3mpl. passive; print spelling with sukūn on wāw; relative clause after لِمَا 'for what'); 'they were created'
غَفَلُوْا: غَفَلُوا — ghafalū, to be heedless, neglect (verb I, perf. 3mpl.; print spelling with sukūn on wāw; in the apodosis of لَوْ with لَمَا); 'they would have been heedless'
وَنَامُوْا: وَ + نَامُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + nāmū, to sleep (verb I, perf. 3mpl., hollow; print spelling with sukūn on wāw); 'and slept'
بَعْثٌ: بَعْث — baʿth, resurrection, sending forth (verbal noun of I baʿatha, m.; nom. indef., in the list after مَوْتٌ); 'a resurrection'
حَشْرٌ: حَشْر — ḥashr, gathering (on the Day of Judgement) (verbal noun of I ḥashara, m.; nom. indef.); 'a gathering'
وَتَوْبِيخٌ: وَ + تَوْبِيخ — wa-, and (conj.) + tawbīkh, rebuke, reproof (verbal noun of II wabbakha, m.; nom. indef.); 'and rebuke'
وَاَهْوَالٌ: وَ + أَهْوَال — wa-, and (conj.) + ahwāl, terrors (pl. of هَوْل, m.; nom. indef.; print spelling with plain alif for hamza); 'and terrors'
انْتَهَيْنَا: انْتَهَيْنَا — intahaynā, to stop, desist; to be warned off (verb VIII intahā, perf. 1pl., final-weak; here with the sense of obeying a prohibition); 'we refrained' Also intahā ilā, 'to come to, reach': intahaynā ilā al-makāni, 'we came to the place'.
اَمَرْنَا: أُمِرْنَا — umirnā, to be commanded (verb I amara, perf. 1pl. passive; printed اَمَرْنَا with plain alif, vocalised as the passive); 'we are commanded'
كَاَهْلِ: كَـ + أَهْل — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison) + ahl, people, folk (m.; gen. after ka-, first term of iḍāfa with الْكَهْفِ; print spelling with plain alif); 'like the people of'
اَيْقَاظٌ: أَيْقَاظ — ayqāẓ, awake (pl. of يَقِظ/يَقْظَان, m.; nom. indef., predicate of نَحْنُ); 'awake'
نِيَامُ: نِيَام — niyām, asleep, sleeping (pl. of نَائِم, m.; nom., predicate, here without tanwīn for the verse metre); 'asleep'
جُلُوسِهِ: جُلُوس + هِ — julūs, sitting (verbal noun of I jalasa, m.; gen. after عَلَى 'over, for') + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'his sitting'
وَمَنْعِهِ: وَ + مَنْع + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + manʿ, preventing (verbal noun of I manaʿa, m.; gen., coordinate with جُلُوسِهِ; governs its object الطُّيُورَ directly) + -hi, his (3ms suffix); 'and his keeping away'
وَالْوُحُوشَ: وَ + الـ + وُحُوش — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + wuḥūsh, wild animals (broken pl. of وَحْش, m.; acc., second object of مَنْعِهِ); 'and the wild beasts'
شُرْبِهَا: شُرْب + هَا — shurb, drinking (verbal noun of I shariba, m.; gen. after مِنْ) + -hā, its (3fs suffix, the spring's); 'from drinking from it'
سَائِحًا: سَائِح — sāʾiḥ, wandering, travelling about (act. part. I of sāḥa, hollow, m.; acc. indef. as ḥāl); 'wandering'
يَدْخُلْهُ: يَدْخُلْ + هُ — yadkhul, to enter (verb I, impf. 3ms, jussive after لَمْ) + -hu, it (3ms suffix, the place; direct object, 'enter it'); 'enter it'
يَصِفُ: يَصِفُ — yaṣifu, to describe (verb I waṣafa, impf. 3ms, assimilated; relative-clause verb after مَنْ); 'describes'
وَيَأْمُرُنِي: وَ + يَأْمُرُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaʾmuru, to command, order (verb I amara, impf. 3ms; takes أَنْ + subjunctive for the command) + -nī, me (1s suffix with nūn al-wiqāya; obj.); 'and commands me'
وَأُسَلِّمَ: وَ + أُسَلِّمَ — wa-, and (conj.) + usallima, to greet, give salām (verb II sallama, impf. 1s, subjunctive after أَنْ, coordinate with أَسِيرَ; governs عَلَى 'greet'); 'and greet'
فَأَتَيْتُكَ: فَـ + أَتَيْتُ + كَ — fa-, so, and so (conj.) + ataytu, to come to (verb I atā, perf. 1s, final-weak) + -ka, you (2ms suffix; direct object, 'come to'); 'and so I came to you'
أُمِرْتُ: أُمِرْتُ — umirtu, to be commanded (verb I amara, perf. 1s passive; أُمِرَ بِـ 'be ordered to', with بِهِ following); 'I was commanded'
فَقَبِلَهُ: فَـ + قَبِلَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + qabila, to accept, receive (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (3ms suffix; obj.); 'and he welcomed him'
يَعْبُدَانِ: يَعْبُدَانِ — yaʿbudāni, to worship (verb I ʿabada, impf. 3 dual m., indic.; ḥāl clause, 'worshipping'); 'the two worship'
الْغَارِ: الـ + غَار — al-, the + ghār, cave (m., hollow; gen. after فِي ذَلِكَ, apposition with the demonstrative); 'the cave'
فَحَسُنَتْ: فَـ + حَسُنَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥasunat, to be good, become fine (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with عِبَادَتُهُمَا); 'and so it became fine'
عِبَادَتُهُمَا: عِبَادَة + هُمَا — ʿibāda, worship (f.; nom. as subject of حَسُنَتْ) + -humā, their (3 dual suffix); 'their worship'
رَبَّهُمَا: رَبّ + هُمَا — rabb, lord (m.; acc. as object of يَعْبُدَانِ) + -humā, their (3 dual suffix); 'their Lord'
وَيَتَقَوَّتَانِ: وَ + يَتَقَوَّتَانِ — wa-, and (conj.) + yataqawwatāni, to sustain oneself, live on (verb V taqawwata, impf. 3 dual, indic.; governs مِنْ 'live on'); 'and the two lived on'
وَأَلْبَانِهَا: وَ + أَلْبَان + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + albān, milks (pl. of لَبَن, m.; gen., coordinate after مِنْ) + -hā, their (3fs suffix, the sheep's); 'and their milk'
مُتَجَرِّدَيْنِ: مُتَجَرِّدَيْنِ — mutajarridayni, stripped of, detached (act. part. V of tajarrada, m. dual; acc. as ḥāl, governing عَنِ); 'detached'
وَالْبَنِينَ: وَ + الـ + بَنِين — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + banīn, sons, children (sound masc. pl. of ابْن; gen., coordinate with الْمَالِ after عَنْ); 'and sons'
أَتَاهُمَا: أَتَى + هُمَا — atā, to come to (verb I, perf. 3ms, final-weak) + -humā, them (3 dual suffix; obj.); 'came to them'
الْيَقِينُ: الـ + يَقِين — al-, the + yaqīn, certainty, i.e. death (m.; nom. as subject of أَتَاهُمَا; cf. Qurʾān 15:99); 'the certainty (death)'
حَدِيثِهِمَا: حَدِيث + هِمَا — ḥadīth, account, tale (m.; gen. as second term of iḍāfa after آخِرُ) + -himā, their (3 dual suffix); 'their story'
زَهَّدْتِنِي: زَهَّدْتِ + نِي — zahhadti, to make indifferent, turn away from (verb II zahhada, perf. 2fs) + -nī, me (1s object suffix with nūn al-wiqāya); 'you have made me renounce'
وَنَدَّمْتِنِي: وَ + نَدَّمْتِ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + naddamti, to make regretful (verb II naddama, perf. 2fs) + -nī, me (1s suffix with nūn al-wiqāya; obj.); 'and made me regret'
جَارِيًا: جَارٍ — jārin, flowing, running (act. part. I of jarā, final-weak, m.; acc. indef., predicate of كَانَ, written with yāʾ and fatḥatān); 'flowing'
بِرِمَّةِ: بِـ + رِمَّة — bi-, here only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise (prep.) + rimma, decayed bones, carcass (f.; gen. after bi-, construct with إِنْسَانٍ); 'behold, the bones (of a man)'
جَرَّهَا: جَرَّ + هَا — jarra, to drag (I, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hā, it/her (acc. suffix, the bones); 'dragged it'
أَسْنَدَهَا: أَسْنَدَ + هَا — asnada, to lean, prop (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hā, it (acc.); 'propped it (against)'
انْتَفَخَتْ: اِنْتَفَخَتْ — intafakhat, to swell, bloat (VII, perf. 3rd f.s., subject the carcass); 'it had swollen'
وَارْتَفَعَتْ: وَ + اِرْتَفَعَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + irtafaʿat, to rise, be raised (VIII, perf. 3rd f.s.); 'and had risen up'
طَيْرُ: طَيْر — ṭayr, bird (collective, m.; nom., first term of construct ṭayru al-māʾi); 'the water-bird'
وَتَأَمَّلَهَا: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾammala, to examine closely (V, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hā, it (acc.); 'and examined it'
رِمَّةَ: رِمَّة — rimma, decayed bones, carcass (f.; acc., object of raʾā in a construct with ibn Ādam); 'the remains (of a son of Adam)'
سُيُوفٍ: سُيُوف — suyūf, swords (broken pl. of sayf; gen. indef., in construct after ḍarb); 'of swords'
رِمَاحٍ: رِمَاح — rimāḥ, spears, lances (broken pl. of rumḥ; gen. indef., in construct after ṭaʿn); 'of spears'
الْمَقْتُولَ: اَلْ + مَقْتُول — al-, the + maqtūl, killed (passive part. I of qatala; acc., after anna hādhā); 'the slain man'
شِرِّيرًا: شِرِّير — shirrīr, wicked, evil, a villain (intensive adj., m.; acc. indef. as predicate of kāna); 'wicked'
فَقَتَلُوهُ: فَ + قَتَلُوهُ — fa-, so (conj.) + qatalū, to kill (I, perf. 3rd m.pl.) + -hu, him (acc.); 'and they killed him'
بِنُسُورٍ: بِـ + نُسُور — bi-, here only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise (prep.) + nusūr, vultures (broken pl. of nasr; gen. after bi-); 'behold, vultures'
وَعِقْبَانٍ: وَ + عِقْبَان — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿiqbān, eagles (broken pl. of ʿuqāb; gen., coordinated with nusūr); 'and eagles'
جَزِعَ: جَزِعَ — jazia, to be anxious, distressed (I, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'he was distressed'
جَزَعًا: جَزَعًا — jazaʿ, distress, panic (verbal noun, acc. indef. as cognate accusative with jazia); 'in great distress' Also accusative of manner after tanahhadat: 'she sighed in anguish'.
يَأْوِيهِ: يَأْوِي + هِ — yaʾwī, to take shelter in, to lodge (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., relative clause on mawḍiʿ) + -hi, it (acc. suffix); 'where he may shelter'
تَنْفَدُ: تَنْفَدُ — tanfadu, to be used up, run out (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; subject al-jīfa); 'is used up'
الْجِيفَةُ: اَلْ + جِيفَة + ُ — al-, the + jīfa, carcass (f.; nom., subject of tanfadu); 'the carcass'
سِبَاعُ: سِبَاع — sibāʿ, beasts of prey (broken pl. of sabʿ; nom., construct with al-ṭuyūr); 'the raptors (of the birds)'
شَجَرَةٌ: شَجَرَة — shajara, tree (f.; nom. indef., subject of the predicate fī wasaṭihi); 'a tree'
كَئِيبًا: كَئِيب — kaʾīb, gloomy, dejected (adj.; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'dejected'
تَتْبَعُنِي: تَتْبَعُ + نِي — tatbaʿu, to follow (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., subject al-aḥzān, the plural of non-humans takes f.s.) + -nī, me (acc., with nūn al-wiqāya); 'follow me'
الْجِيفَةَ: اَلْ + جِيفَة + َ — al-, the + jīfa, carcass (f.; acc., object of raʾaytu); 'the carcass'
رِزْقٌ: رِزْق — rizq, provision, sustenance (m.; nom. indef., predicate of hādhā); 'a provision (that God sent)'
وَسُرُورِي: وَ + سُرُور + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + surūr, joy (m.; nom., subject of ṣāra, coordinated) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'and my joy'
وَهَمًّا: وَ + هَمّ + ًا — wa-, and (conj.) + hamm, worry (m.; acc. indef., coordinated with ḥuznan as second predicate of ṣāra); 'and worry'
وَافْتَرَسَتْهَا: وَ + اِفْتَرَسَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + iftarasat, to seize as prey (VIII, perf. 3rd f.s.; agent sibāʿ al-ṭuyūr) + -hā, it (acc.); 'and preyed upon it'
وَحَالُوا: وَ + حَالُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥālū, to come between (I, hollow verb ḥāla, perf. 3rd m.pl.; takes bayna ... wa-bayna); 'and they came between (me and it)'
أَرْجُوأَنْ: أَرْجُو + أَنْ — run-together print form for arjū an: arjū, to hope (I, imperf. 1st s., defective) + an, that (subjunctive particle, before akūna); 'do I hope that'
الْكَدَرِ: اَلْ + كَدَر — al-, the + kadar, turbidity, trouble, affliction (m.; gen. after min, 'safe from'); 'the troubles'
وَأَطْمَئِنَّ: وَ + أَطْمَئِنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭmaʾinna, to feel secure (quadriliteral IQ, imperf. 1st s., subj., after an with akūna); 'and rest secure'
يَغْتَرُّبِهَا: يَغْتَرُّ + بِـ + هَا — run-together print form for yaghtarru bihā: yaghtarru, to be deceived by (VIII, imperf. 3rd m.s., governs bi-) + bi-, by (prep., chosen by the verb ightarra bi- 'be deceived by') + -hā, it (the world); 'is deceived by it'
وَيَطْمَئِنُّ: وَ + يَطْمَئِنُّ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaṭmaʾinnu, to feel secure (IQ, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; takes ilā); 'and relies calmly (on it)'
وَقَوْمِهِ: وَ + قَوْم + ِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + qawm, people, tribe (m.; gen., coordinated after bi-) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'and his people'
وَعَشِيرَتِهِ: وَ + عَشِيرَة + ِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿashīra, clan, kin (f.; gen., coordinated after bi-) + -hi, his (gen.); 'and his clan'
الْمُغْتَرُّبِهَا: اَلْ + مُغْتَرّ + بِـ + هَا — run-together print form for al-mughtarru bihā: al-, the + mughtarr, one deceived (act. part. VIII; nom., subject of lam yazali) + bi-, by (prep., chosen by ightarra bi-) + -hā, it (the world); 'the one deceived by it'
رَاكِنًا: رَاكِن + ًا — rākin, relying, inclined (act. part. I of rakana; acc. indef., ḥāl; takes ilā); 'relying (on it)'
يَخْتَالُ: يَخْتَالُ — yakhtālu, to strut, walk proudly (VIII, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow); 'struts proudly'
وَيَحْثُوَ: وَ + يَحْثُوَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḥthuwa, to heap, throw (earth) (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., subj. after ḥattā an, with ʿalayhi al-turāb); 'and (until) heaps (earth)'
وَأَقْرَبُهُمْ: وَ + أَقْرَب + ُ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqrab, nearest (elative of qarīb; nom., construct) + -hum, them (gen. suffix); 'and the nearest of them'
الَدَيْهِ: لَدَيْهِ — misprint-corrected: printed الَدَيْهِ has a stray alif; read ladayhi: ladā, with, at (prep.) + -hi, him (gen. suffix), ladayhi; 'with him'
لِلْفَتَى: لِـ + اَلْ + فَتَى — li-, for (prep., here dative of benefit/possession 'is there for') + al-, the + fatā, young man (m.; gen. after li-); 'for the young man'
هُمُومِهَا: هُمُوم + هَا — humūm, worries (broken pl. of hamm; gen. after ʿalā, 'patience with') + -hā, its (gen. suffix, the world's); 'its worries'
وَمَكَارِهِهَا: وَ + مَكَارِه + ِ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + makārih, hardships, disagreeable things (broken pl. of makrūh/makraha; gen., coordinated after ʿalā) + -hā, its (gen. suffix); 'and its hardships'
وَوَطَنِي: وَ + وَطَن + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + waṭan, homeland (m.; acc., coordinated with makānī, objects of fāraqtu) + -ī, my (suffix); 'and my homeland'
كَارِهًا: كَارِه + ًا — kārih, disliking (act. part. I of kariha; acc. indef., predicate of kuntu; governs li-furqa); 'loath (to leave)'
لِفُرْقَةِ: لِـ + فُرْقَة — li-, for, because of (prep.; after kārih 'averse to') + furqa, separation (f.; gen. after li-, construct with ikhwānī); 'to the parting from'
وَأَحِبَّائِي: وَ + أَحِبَّاء + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥibbāʾ, loved ones (broken pl. of ḥabīb; gen., coordinated) + -ī, my (suffix); 'and my loved ones'
وَخِلَّانِي: وَ + خِلَّان + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + khillān, close friends (broken pl. of khalīl; gen., coordinated) + -ī, my (suffix); 'and my intimates'
فِكْرَتِهِ: فِكْرَة + ِ + هِ — fikra, thought, reverie (f.; gen. after fī) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'his thought'
بِذَكَرٍ: بِـ + ذَكَر — bi-, here only marks what appears after وَإِذَا of surprise (prep.) + dhakar, male (m.; gen. after bi-); 'behold, a male (turtle)'
السَّلَاحِفِ: اَلْ + سَلَاحِف — al-, the + salāḥif, tortoises (pl. of silḥifāh, turtle; gen. after min; the print writes the pl. without final yāʾ, a Middle Arabic diptote-style form); 'of the turtles'
مُنْحَدِرًا: مُنْحَدِر + ًا — munḥadir, descending, gliding down (act. part. VII of inḥadara; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'gliding downstream'
طَيْرِ: طَيْر — ṭayr, bird (collective, m.; gen. after min, construct with al-māʾ); 'the water-bird'
حَجَبَكَ: حَجَبَ + كَ — ḥajaba, to veil, keep away (I, perf. 3rd m.s., subject alladhī) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'kept you away'
وَأَبْعَدَكَ: وَ + أَبْعَدَ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + abʿada, to remove, drive far (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -ka, you (acc.); 'and took you far'
مَوْضِعِكَ: مَوْضِع + ِ + كَ — mawḍiʿ, place (m.; gen. after ʿan) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your place'
لِلْعَاقِلِ: لِـ + اَلْ + عَاقِل — li-, for (prep., dative: 'no patience for') + al-, the + ʿāqil, sensible, wise person (act. part. I of ʿaqala; gen. after li-); 'for the wise'
مُجَاوَرَةِ: مُجَاوَرَة — mujāwara, living next to, neighbouring (III verbal noun; gen. after ʿalā, construct with ʿaduwwihi); 'living beside (his enemy)'
لِلسَّاكِنِيْنِ: لِـ + اَلْ + سَاكِنِيْن — li-, for (prep., dative in the verse: 'there is nothing for') + al-, the + sākinīn, dwellers (act. part. I pl., gen. -īn); 'for the residents'
الرَّحِيْلِ: اَلْ + رَحِيْل — al-, the + raḥīl, departure (verbal noun I; gen. after siwā); 'departure'
السِّحْلِفُ: اَلْ + سِحْلِف — al-, the + siḥlif, tortoise/turtle (m.; nom., subject of qāla); 'the turtle'
وَصَفْتَهُ: وَصَفْتَ + هُ — waṣafta, to describe (I, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -hu, it (acc.); 'you described it'
لَاأَزَالُ: لَا أَزَالُ — run-together print form for lā azālu: lā, not + azālu, to cease (I, hollow, imperf. 1st s.; lā azālu 'I shall never cease' kāna-sister, with bayna yadayka); 'I will not cease (to be at your service)'
وَحْشَةَ: وَحْشَة — waḥsha, loneliness, desolation (f.; acc. indef. after lā of absolute negation); 'loneliness'
وَحْشَةِ: وَحْشَة + ِ — waḥsha, loneliness (f.; gen. after min as comparison with ashadd, construct with al-gharīb); 'the loneliness (of the stranger)'
الْمُنْقَطِعِ: اَلْ + مُنْقَطِع — al-, the + munqaṭiʿ, cut off (act. part. VII of inqaṭaʿa; gen., adj. of al-gharīb; governs ʿan); 'who is cut off (from his family)'
وَوَطَنِهِ: وَ + وَطَن + ِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + waṭan, homeland (m.; gen., coordinated after ʿan) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'and from his homeland'
يُعَدُّ: يُعَدُّ — yuʿaddu, to be counted, reckoned (I passive, imperf. 3rd m.s., geminate); 'is counted (as comparable)'
يُسَلِّي: يُسَلِّي — yusallī, to console, comfort (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective, relative clause with bihi); 'consoles'
الِاسْتِينَاسُ: اَلْ + اِسْتِينَاس — al-, the + istīnās, seeking company, sociability (X verbal noun; nom., predicate of aḥsanu mā); 'being sociable'
وَالْكُرْبَةِ: وَ + اَلْ + كُرْبَة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + kurba, distress, grief (f.; gen., coordinated after ʿalā); 'and the distress'
وَمُعِينًا: وَ + مُعِين + ًا — wa-, and (conj.) + muʿīn, helper (act. part. IV of aʿāna; acc. indef., coordinated predicate of akūna); 'and a helper'
السِّحْلِفِ: اَلْ + سِحْلِف — al-, the + siḥlif, tortoise (m.; gen., construct after maqālata); 'the turtle'
أَلَمًا: أَلَم + ًا — alam, pain (m.; acc. indef., object of wajadtu); 'pain'
وَفِرَاقِي: وَ + فِرَاق + ِي — wa-, and (conj.) + firāq, parting (m.; nom., coordinated after muddata; construct) + -ī, my (suffix); 'and my parting'
لِإِخْوَانِي: لِـ + إِخْوَان + ِي — li-, from (prep.; firāq li- 'parting from', marking who is left behind) + ikhwān, brothers, companions (pl. of akh; gen. after li-) + -ī, my (suffix); 'from my brothers'
وَفِكْرَةً: وَ + فِكْرَة + ً — wa-, and (conj.) + fikra, reflection, thought (f.; acc. indef., coordinated with ʿibratan after inna fī al-firāq); 'and a thought (for whoever reflects)'
يُسَلِّيهِ: يُسَلِّي + هِ — yusallī, to console (II, imperf. 3rd m.s.) + -hi, him (acc. suffix); 'who consoles him'; here in a clause of state: wa-Marzawānu yusallīhi, 'while Marzawān cheered him'
وَيَثْبُتُ: وَ + يَثْبُتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yathbutu, to stay, persist (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.); 'and stays'
الشَّرُّ: اَلْ + شَرّ — al-, the + sharr, evil (m.; nom., subject of yathbutu); 'the evil'
سَرْمَدًا: سَرْمَد + ًا — sarmad, everlasting (m.; acc. indef., adverbial of time); 'forever'
بِالْإِخْوَانِ: بِـ + اَلْ + إِخْوَان — bi-, with (prep., 'to find solace with', tasallī bi-) + al-, the + ikhwān, brothers, friends (pl. of akh; gen. after bi-); 'with (one's) brothers'
وَمُلَازَمَةُ: وَ + مُلَازَمَة + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + mulāzama, adhering to (III verbal noun; nom., coordinated with al-tasallī, construct with al-ṣabr); 'and keeping to'
وَالتَّجَلُّدِ: وَ + اَلْ + تَجَلُّد — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + tajallud, fortitude, bearing up (V verbal noun; gen., coordinated); 'and fortitude'
خَصْلَتَانِ: خَصْلَتَان — khaṣlatān, two traits (dual of khaṣla, f.; nom. dual, predicate of inna + -humā); 'two traits'
مَحْمُودَتَانِ: مَحْمُودَتَان — maḥmūdatān, praiseworthy (pass. part. I of ḥamida, dual f., adj.; nom. dual); 'praiseworthy'
يُعِينَانِ: يُعِينَان — yuʿīnāni, to help (IV, imperf. 3rd dual, indic.; takes ʿalā); 'both help (against)'
وَنَوَائِبِ: وَ + نَوَائِب — wa-, and (conj.) + nawāʾib, misfortunes (broken pl. of nāʾiba; gen., coordinated after ʿalā, construct with al-dahr); 'and the mishaps (of time)'
وَيَدْفَعَانِ: وَ + يَدْفَعَان — wa-, and (conj.) + yadfaʿāni, to repel (I, imperf. 3rd dual, indic.); 'and both ward off'
الْفَزَعَ: اَلْ + فَزَع — al-, the + fazaʿ, fright (m.; acc., object of yadfaʿāni); 'fright'
وَالْجَزَعَ: وَ + اَلْ + جَزَع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + jazaʿ, panic, impatience (m.; acc., coordinated); 'and panic'
يُفْسِدُ: يُفْسِدُ — yufsidu, to spoil (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.); 'spoils'
عَيْشَكَ: عَيْش + كَ — ʿaysh, life, livelihood (m.; acc., object of yufsidu) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your life'
لِلسِّحْلِفِ: لِـ + اَلْ + سِحْلِف — li-, to (prep., marks the addressee of qāla, 'said to the turtle') + al-, the + siḥlif, tortoise (gen. after li-); 'to the turtle'
تَتَبَرَّكُ: تَتَبَرَّكُ — tatabarraku, to seek blessing from (V, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; governs bi-); 'seeks blessing (in you)'
وَتَعْرِفُ: وَ + تَعْرِفُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʿrifu, to know, find (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.); 'and recognises'
مَشُورَتِكَ: مَشُورَة + ِ + كَ — mashūra, counsel (f.; gen. after fī) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your counsel'
وَالضَّيْرَ: وَ + اَلْ + ضَّيْر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḍayr, harm, distress (m.; acc., coordinated with al-hamma, objects of taḥmilu); 'and harm'
يُسَكِّنُ: يُسَكِّنُ — yusakkinu, to calm (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; object rawʿa); 'calms'
طَيْرَ: طَيْر — ṭayr, bird (collective, m.; acc., subject of inna, first term of construct with al-māʾ); 'the water-bird'
سِبَاعِ: سِبَاع — sibāʿ, beasts of prey (broken pl.; gen. after min, construct with al-ṭayr); 'raptors (of the birds)'
إِلَّاعِظَامًا: إِلَّا + عِظَامًا — run-together print form for illā ʿiẓāman: illā, except (particle) + ʿiẓām, bones (broken pl. of ʿaẓm; acc. indef., excepted from a negative clause, lam yara ... min tilka al-jīfa); 'except bones'
السِّحْلِفَ: اَلْ + سِحْلِف — al-, the + siḥlif, tortoise (m.; acc., object of akhbara); 'the turtle'
الْعَدُوِّ: اَلْ + عَدُوّ — al-, the + ʿaduww, enemy (m.; gen., construct after zawāl); 'the enemy'
لِأَتَمَلَّى: لِـ + أَتَمَلَّى — li-, in order to (conj. particle li- + subj., purpose) + atamallā, to enjoy fully (V, imperf. 1st s., defective, subj.; takes bi-); 'so that I may enjoy'
بِخِلَّانِي: بِـ + خِلَّان + ِي — bi-, with (prep., chosen by tamallā bi- 'enjoy the company of') + khillān, close friends (broken pl.; gen. after bi-) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my friends'
فَأَتَيَا: فَ + أَتَيَا — fa-, so (conj.) + atayā, to come (I, perf. 3rd dual, defective); 'and the two came'
يَجِدَا: يَجِدَا — yajidā, to find (I, imperf. 3rd dual, jussive after lam, nūn dropped); 'they did not find'
يَخَافَا: يَخَافَا — yakhāfā, to fear (I, imperf. 3rd dual, hollow; nūn dropped as a Middle Arabic form, relative clause, orig. yakhāfāni); 'that they feared'
وَلَرُبَّ: وَ + لَ + رُبَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-, emphatic particle + rubba, many a, how often (particle governing an indefinite gen.); 'and many a'
نَازِلَةٍ: نَازِلَة + ٍ — nāzila, calamity (act. part. I fem. as noun; gen. indef. after rubba); 'misfortune'
يَضِيقُ: يَضِيقُ — yaḍīqu, to be narrow, constrained (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow, indic.); 'becomes straitened'
ذَرْعًا: ذَرْع + ًا — dharʿ, arm's reach, capacity (m.; acc. indef., tamyīz); 'in capacity (feels powerless)'
الْمَخْرَجُ: اَلْ + مَخْرَج — al-, the + makhraj, way out, exit (m.; nom., subject of ʿinda allāh); 'the way out'
اسْتَمْكَنَتْ: اِسْتَمْكَنَتْ — istamkanat, to take hold, become firmly set (X, perf. 3rd f.s.); 'became firmly set'
حَلَقَاتُهَا: حَلَقَات + ُ + هَا — ḥalaqāt, links, rings (pl. of ḥalaqa; nom., subject of istamkanat) + -hā, its (gen. suffix); 'its rings (of hardship)'
فَرَجَتْ: فَرَجَتْ — farajat, to be relieved, open up (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; here said of the calamity); 'it was relieved'
اَظُنُّهَا: أَظُنُّ + هَا — aẓunnu, to think (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.; printed اَظُنُّهَا with plain alif) + -hā, it (acc., 1st object); 'I thought it'
لَاتُفْرَجُ: لَا تُفْرَجُ — lā, not + tufraju, to be relieved (I passive, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; printed run together); 'would never be relieved'
سَكَنَا: سَكَنَا — sakanā, to dwell, settle (I, perf. 3rd dual); 'the two settled'
أَمِنًا: أَمِن + ًا — amin, safe, secure (act. part./adj. of amina; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'secure'
انْسَاقَ: اِنْسَاقَ — insāqa, to be driven, impelled (VII, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; subject al-qaḍāʾ); 'was driven'
بَازِيًا: بَازِي + ًا — bāzī, falcon, hawk (m.; acc. indef., defective noun, ḥāl or object); 'a falcon'
بِمِخْلَبِهِ: بِـ + مِخْلَب + ِ + هِ — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + mikhlab, talon (m.; gen. after bi-) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'with its talon'
يُغْنِ: يُغْنِ — yughni, to avail (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective, jussive after lam; takes ʿan); 'did not avail'
فَرَاغِ: فَرَاغ — farāgh, end, running out (m.; gen. after ʿinda, construct with al-ajal); 'the completion (of the term)'
غَفْلَتُهُ: غَفْلَة + ُ + هُ — ghafla, heedlessness (f.; nom., predicate/subject) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his heedlessness'
تَسْبِيحَهُ: تَسْبِيح + َ + هُ — tasbīḥ, glorification, saying subḥāna llāh (II verbal noun; acc., after inna) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his glorification'
رَبِّنَا: رَبّ + ِ + نَا — rabb, lord (m.; gen., construct after subḥāna) + -nā, our (gen. suffix); 'our Lord'
وَدَبَّرَ: وَ + دَبَّرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + dabbara, to arrange, manage (II, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'and ordained'
وَأَفْقَرَ: وَ + أَفْقَرَ — wa-, and (conj.) + afqara, to impoverish (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'and made poor'
وَجَوَارِحِ: وَ + جَوَارِح — wa-, and (conj.) + jawāriḥ, birds of prey (pl. of jāriḥa; gen., construct with al-ṭuyūr); 'and the raptors'
زِدْتِنِي: زِدْتِ + نِي — zidti, to add to, increase (I, perf. 2nd f.s.) + -nī, me (acc., with nūn al-wiqāya); 'you have given me more'
بِحِكَايَتِكِ: بِـ + حِكَايَة + ِ + كِ — bi-, by means of (prep., instrument/cause) + ḥikāya, tale (f.; gen. after bi-) + -ki, your (f. gen. suffix); 'by your story'
مَوَاعِظَ: مَوَاعِظ — mawāʿiẓ, admonitions (broken pl. of mawʿiẓa, diptote; acc., second object of zidtinī); 'admonitions'
وَاعْتِبَارًا: وَ + اِعْتِبَار + ًا — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtibār, taking a lesson (VIII verbal noun; acc. indef., coordinated); 'and instruction'
حِكَايَاتِ: حِكَايَات — ḥikāyāt, tales (f. pl. sound; gen., after min, construct with al-wuḥūsh); 'the tales (of wild beasts)'
ثَعْلَبًا: ثَعْلَب + ًا — thaʿlab, fox (m.; acc. indef., subject of anna); 'a fox'
وَذِئْبًا: وَ + ذِئْب + ًا — wa-, and (conj.) + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; acc. indef., coordinated); 'and a wolf'
أَلِفَا: أَلِفَا — alifā, to be familiar with, to take as habitual (I, perf. 3rd dual); 'were used to / settled in'
وَكْرًا: وَكْر + ًا — wakr, den, nest (m.; acc. indef., object of alifā); 'a den'
فَكَانَا: فَ + كَانَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + kānā, to be (I, hollow, perf. 3rd dual); 'and they were'
وَيَبِيتَانِ: وَ + يَبِيتَان — wa-, and (conj.) + yabītāni, to spend the night (I, imperf. 3rd dual, indic., hollow); 'and spent the night'
الذِّئْبُ: اَلْ + ذِّئْب — al-, the + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; nom., subject of kāna); 'the wolf'
قَاهِرًا: قَاهِر + ًا — qāhir, overpowering (act. part. I of qahara; acc. indef., predicate of kāna; takes li-); 'domineering'
لِلثَّعْلَبِ: لِـ + اَلْ + ثَّعْلَب — li-, over, toward (prep., object of qāhir 'overbearing to') + al-, the + thaʿlab, fox (gen. after li-); 'over the fox'
فَلَبِثَا: فَ + لَبِثَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + labithā, to stay, remain (I, perf. 3rd dual); 'and they stayed'
الثَّعْلَبَ: اَلْ + ثَّعْلَب — al-, the + thaʿlab, fox (m.; acc., subject of anna); 'the fox'
الذِّئْبِ: اَلْ + ذِّئْب — al-, the + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; gen. after ʿalā; ashāra ʿalā 'advise someone'); 'the wolf'
بِالرِّفْقِ: بِـ + اَلْ + رِّفْق — bi-, with, to (prep., verb ashāra ʿalā ... bi- 'advise someone to') + al-, the + rifq, gentleness (m.; gen. after bi-); 'gentleness'
وَتَرْكِ: وَ + تَرْك — wa-, and (conj.) + tark, leaving off, abandoning (I verbal noun; gen., coordinated after bi-); 'and giving up'
دُمْتَ: دُمْتَ — dumta, to continue (I, hollow, perf. 2nd m.s.; dāma ʿalā 'persist in'); 'you persist'
عُتُوِّكَ: عُتُوّ + كَ — ʿutuww, insolence (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your arrogance'
سَلَّطَ: سَلَّطَ — sallaṭa, to give power over (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes ʿalā, subject Allāh); 'sets (him) upon'
ذُوحِيَلٍ: ذُو + حِيَل — dhū, possessor of (one of the five nouns, nom., predicate of inna + -hu; printed run together) + ḥiyal, tricks, wiles (broken pl. of ḥīla; gen. indef.); 'master of wiles'
وَمَكْرٍ: وَ + مَكْر — wa-, and (conj.) + makr, cunning, deceit (m.; gen., coordinated); 'and cunning'
وَالْحُوتَ: وَ + اَلْ + حُوت — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥūt, fish, whale (m.; acc., object of yaṣīdu); 'and the fish'
وَيَقْطَعُ: وَ + يَقْطَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaqṭaʿu, to cut (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.); 'and cuts through'
وَيَنْقُلُهَا: وَ + يَنْقُلُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yanqulu, to move, transport (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.) + -hā, them (the mountains, acc.); 'and carries them'
وَالِاعْتِسَافِ: وَ + اَلْ + اِعْتِسَاف — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iʿtisāf, wrongdoing, tyranny (VIII verbal noun; gen., coordinated); 'and injustice'
لِعَيْشِكَ: لِـ + عَيْش + كَ — li-, for (prep., 'more pleasant for', after ahnā) + ʿaysh, life (m.; gen. after li-) + -ka, your (suffix); 'for your life'
يَقْبَلِ: يَقْبَلِ — yaqbali, to accept (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam, with kasra before al-); 'did not accept'
وَأَغْلَظَ: وَ + أَغْلَظَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aghlaẓa, to be harsh (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; aghlaẓa lahu 'be rough to him'); 'and was harsh'
الرَّدَّ: اَلْ + رَّدّ — al-, the + radd, reply, answer (m.; acc., object of aghlaẓa); 'the reply'
وَالْكَلَامَ: وَ + اَلْ + كَلَام — wa-, and (conj., wāw al-maʿiyya, 'with') + al-, the + kalām, talk (m.; acc., after mā laka 'what business have you with'); 'and (with) talking'
وَجَسِيمِهَا: وَ + جَسِيم + ِ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + jasīm, weighty, grave (adj.; gen., coordinated after ʿaẓīm) + -hā, their (gen. suffix, the affairs'); 'and their weighty ones'
لَطْمَةً: لَطْمَة + ً — laṭma, slap, blow (f.; acc. indef., cognate accusative of laṭama); 'a blow'
مُعْتَذِرًا: مُعْتَذِر + ًا — muʿtadhir, apologising (act. part. VIII of iʿtadhara; acc. indef., ḥāl; takes ilā); 'apologising'
الشَّيْنِ: اَلْ + شَّيْن — al-, the + shayn, ugly, shameful (m.; gen., adj. of al-kalām; also 'disgrace'); 'the unseemly (speech)'
سَالِفاً: سَالِف + ًا — sālif, past, former (act. part. I of salafa; acc. indef., adj. of dhanban); 'earlier'
وَأَتَيْتُ: وَ + أَتَيْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ataytu, to do, commit (I, perf. 1st s., defective; here ataytu shayʾan 'I did a thing'); 'and I did'
مُنْكَراً: مُنْكَر + ًا — munkar, objectionable (pass. part. IV of ankara; acc. indef., adj. of shayʾan; printed -an with alif); 'wrong'
وَعَفْوُكُمْ: وَ + عَفْو + ُ + كُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿafw, pardon (m.; nom., subject of yasaʿu) + -kum, your (pl. gen. suffix, honorific); 'and your forgiveness'
مُسْتَغْفِراً: مُسْتَغْفِر + ًا — mustaghfir, asking forgiveness (act. part. X of istaghfara; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'seeking pardon'
عُذْرَهُ: عُذْر + َ + هُ — ʿudhr, excuse (m.; acc., object of qabila) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his excuse'
وَكَفَّ: وَ + كَفَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + kaffa, to hold back, desist (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; takes ʿan); 'and held back'
أَشْرَارَهُ: أَشْرَار + َ + هُ — ashrār, evil ones, villains (broken pl. of sharr/sharīr; acc., object of kaffa 'restrained') + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his evils'
تَتَكَلَّمْ: تَتَكَلَّمْ — tatakallam, to speak (V, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition); 'do not speak'; here: 3fs jussive after lam: lam tatakallam, 'she did not speak'
الْأَطْبَاقِ: الـ + أَطْبَاق (pl. of طَبَق) — tray (m., gen.)
تُؤَدِّي: تُؤَدِّي — addā, to lead, convey (form II); 3rd f. sg. imperfect; 'it leads' (the print omits the hamza; ṭarīq is treated as feminine)
وَأَسَفًا: وَ + أَسَفًا — asaf, sorrow, regret (m., acc. adverbial); the edition prints the hamza here, kept as given
أَنْجُو: najā/anjū — to be saved, escape (verb I, imperf. 1cs); hamza supplied, edition prints bare انجو
تَأْكُلُهُ: تَأْكُلُ + ـهُ — taʾkulu (akala/yaʾkulu, to eat; imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the collective الوحوش والطيور) + -hu, him; 'it/they eat him'
وَقِلَّةِ: وَ + قِلَّة — wa-, and + qilla, fewness, scarcity (f., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the fewness of'
أَقْبَلُ: aqbalu — qabila, to accept (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'I accept'
الذِّئْبَ: اَلْ + ذِّئْب + َ — al-, the + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; acc., after anna 'that', subject of the clause in the sentence 'the wolf said'); 'the wolf'
تَقُولَنَّ: تَقُولَنَّ — taqūlanna, to say, speak (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., hollow; with energetic -anna after lā of prohibition; takes ʿan 'about'); 'never speak'
تُسْأَلُ: تُسْأَلُ — tusʾalu, to ask (I, imperf. 3rd f./2nd m.s. passive, indic.; sʾl takes ʿan 'about'); 'you are asked'
تُجِبْ: تُجِبْ — tujib, to answer (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition; print's helping kasra before mā); 'do not answer'
وَذَرِ: وَ + ذَرِ — wa-, and (conj.) + dhari, to leave, let be (I, imperative 2nd m.s., defective verb used only in the imperative; print's helping kasra); 'and leave'
تَبْذُلَنَّ: تَبْذُلَنَّ — tabdhulanna, to spend, lavish (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive-type ending with energetic -anna after lā of prohibition; takes object al-naṣīḥata); 'never lavish'
النَّصِيحَةَ: اَلْ + نَّصِيحَة + َ — al-, the + naṣīḥa, advice, sincere counsel (f.; acc., object of tabdhulanna); 'good counsel'
لِلْأَشْرَارِ: لِـ + اَلْ + أَشْرَار + ِ — li-, to, for (prep., here 'on, upon', after tabdhulanna 'lavish on') + al-, the + ashrār, evil ones (broken pl. of sharr/sharīr; gen. after li-); 'on the wicked'
يُجَازُونَكَ: يُجَازُونَكَ — yujāzūna, to repay, requite (III, imperf. 3rd m.pl., indic.; takes ʿalā for the thing repaid) + -ka, you (acc. suffix, object); 'they repay you'
شَرًّا: شَرًّا — sharr, evil, harm (m.; acc. indef., the thing paid in return, second object of yujāzūnaka; print's shadda); 'with harm'
أَضْمَرَ: أَضْمَرَ — aḍmara, to hide in the heart, harbour (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; the fox is the subject); 'he harboured'
مَكْرًا: مَكْرًا — makr, cunning, a ruse (m.; acc. indef., object of aḍmara); 'a trick'
أَسْعَى: أَسْعَى — asʿā, to strive, set to work (I, imperf. 1st s., defective, subjunctive after an; here 'I must set to work'); 'I set to work'
أَذَى: أَذَى — adhā, harm, ill-treatment (m.; gen. in the idāfa adhā al-dhiʾbi, after ʿalā governed by ṣabara 'to bear patiently with', defective noun with unwritten case ending); 'ill-treatment'
الْبَطَرَ: اَلْ + بَطَر + َ — al-, the + baṭar, insolence, arrogance of prosperity (m.; acc., after inna, subject of yakūnāni); 'insolence'
وَالِافْتِرَاءَ: وَ + اَلْ + اِفْتِرَاء + َ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + iftirāʾ, false accusation, slander (VIII verbal noun; acc., coordinated with al-baṭara); 'and slander'
لِلْهَلَاكِ: لِـ + اَلْ + هَلَاك + ِ — li-, for, leading to (prep., 'a cause for') + al-, the + halāk, destruction, ruin (m.; gen. after li-, depending on sababan); 'of ruin'
وَيُوقِعَانِ: وَ + يُوقِعَانِ — wa-, and (conj.) + yūqiʿāni, to cause to fall (IV, imperf. 3rd m.dual, indic.; awqaʿa fī 'land in'; the dual subject is al-baṭar and al-iftirāʾ); 'and cast (one) into'
الِارْتِبَاكِ: اَلْ + اِرْتِبَاك + ِ — al-, the + irtibāk, entanglement, confusion, a snare (VIII verbal noun; gen. after fī 'in'); 'the snare'; also gen. after min hādhā ('from this entanglement'), of a lover's distress
بَطِرَ: بَطِرَ — baṭira, to be insolent, arrogant (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; after man 'whoever', conditional); 'is insolent'
خَسِرَ: خَسِرَ — khasira, to lose, come to ruin (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; apodosis of man baṭira); 'loses'
جَهِلَ: جَهِلَ — jahila, to be ignorant, act foolishly (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; after man 'whoever', conditional); 'is ignorant'
وَالْإِنْصَافُ: وَ + اَلْ + إِنْصَاف + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + inṣāf, fair dealing, equity (IV verbal noun; nom., subject, predicate min shiyami 'among the traits of'); 'and fair dealing'
الْأَشْرَافِ: اَلْ + أَشْرَاف + ِ — al-, the + ashrāf, nobles (broken pl. of sharīf; gen. in the idāfa shiyam al-ashrāf); 'the noble'
وَالْآدَابُ: وَ + اَلْ + آدَاب + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ādāb, good manners, breeding (broken pl. of adab; nom., subject); 'and good breeding'
أَشْرَفُ: أَشْرَف + ُ — ashraf, nobler, noblest (elative of sharīf; nom., predicate, in the idāfa ashraf al-iktisāb); 'the noblest'
الِاكْتِسَابِ: اَلْ + اِكْتِسَاب + ِ — al-, the + iktisāb, acquisition, earning (VIII verbal noun; gen. in the idāfa after ashraf); 'of acquisitions'
مُدَارَاةُ: مُدَارَاة + ُ — mudārāt, humouring, handling with tact (III verbal noun, f.; nom., subject, in the idāfa mudārāt hādhā al-bāghī; mina al-raʾyi 'part of good sense'); 'humouring'
الْبَاغِي: اَلْ + بَاغِي — al-, the + bāghī, oppressor, one who transgresses (act. part. I of baghā, defective; gen. in the idāfa, the case ending unwritten, in apposition to hādhā 'this'); 'the tyrant'
مَصْرَعٍ: مَصْرَع + ٍ — maṣraʿ, a being thrown down, a fall, violent death (m.; gen. indef., after min in lā budda lahu min 'he must have'); 'a fall'
وَيَتُوبُ: وَ + يَتُوبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yatūbu, to relent, turn (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow, indic.; tāba ʿalā 'relent towards', said of God, chosen by the verb); 'and relents (towards)'
اقْتَرَفَ: اِقْتَرَفَ — iqtarafa, to commit (a sin) (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.; after in 'even if', the servant is the subject); 'he has committed'
الذُّنُوبَ: اَلْ + ذُّنُوب + َ — al-, the + dhunūb, sins (broken pl. of dhanb; acc., object of iqtarafa); 'the sins'
ارْتَكَبْتُ: ارْتَكَبْتُ — irtakabtu, to commit, be guilty of (VIII, perf. 1st s.; fī nuṣḥika 'in advising you'); 'I committed'
التَّعْمِيفَ: اَلْ + تَّعْمِيف + َ — al-, the + taʿmīf, printed as a word not otherwise known, most likely a slip for taʿnīf, harsh reproach, roughness (II verbal noun; acc., object of irtakabtu; reading doubtful, follows the note); 'the harshness'
لَطْمَتِكَ: لَطْمَة + ِ + كَ — laṭma, slap, blow (f.; gen., in the idāfa ʾalami laṭmatika 'the pain of your blow') + -ka, your (gen. suffix, the wolf's blow); 'your blow'
لَعَلِمْتَ: لَ + عَلِمْتَ — la-, then (apodosis particle after law 'if', not a preposition) + ʿalimta, to know (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; fatḥa the print's own, fixing 'you knew'); 'you would know'
أَشْتَكِي: أَشْتَكِي — ashtakī, to complain (VIII, imperf. 1st s., defective, indic.; takes min 'of' for the cause); 'I complain'
اللَّطْمَةِ: اَلْ + لَّطْمَة + ِ — al-, the + laṭma, slap, blow (f.; gen., in the idāfa alami hādhihi al-laṭmati 'the pain of this blow'); 'the blow'
عَاقِبَتُهَا: عَاقِبَة + ُ + هَا — ʿāqiba, outcome, consequence (f.; nom., subject, the predicate being surūrun 'happiness') + -hā, its (gen. suffix, the blow's); 'its outcome'
الْمُؤَدِّبِ: اَلْ + مُؤَدِّب + ِ — al-, the + muʾaddib, tutor, teacher of manners (act. part. II; gen. in the idāfa ḍarbu al-muʾaddibi 'a tutor's beating'); 'the tutor's'
أَوَّلُهُ: أَوَّل + ُ + هُ — awwal, first, beginning (m.; nom., subject, predicate ṣaʿbun 'hard') + -hu, its (gen. suffix, the beating's); 'its beginning'
وَآخِرُهُ: وَ + آخِر + ُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ākhir, last, end (act. part. IV; nom., subject, predicate aḥlā 'sweeter') + -hu, its (gen. suffix); 'and its end'
الْعَسَلِ: اَلْ + عَسَل + ِ — al-, the + ʿasal, honey (m.; gen. after min in aḥlā min 'sweeter than'); 'honey'
الْمُصَفَّى: اَلْ + مُصَفَّى — al-, the + muṣaffā, strained, purified (pass. part. II of ṣaffā, defective; gen., adj. of al-ʿasali, case ending unwritten); 'strained'
ذَنْبَكَ: ذَنْب + َ + كَ — dhanb, offence, sin (m.; acc., object of ghafartu) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your offence'
وَأَقَلْتُ: وَ + أَقَلْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqaltu, to pardon, release from (IV, perf. 1st s., hollow; aqāla ʿathratahu 'pardon his slip'); 'and I pardoned'
عَثْرَتَكَ: عَثْرَة + َ + كَ — ʿathra, stumble, slip (f.; acc., object of aqaltu) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your slip'
وَاعْتَرِفْ: وَ + اعْتَرِفْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtarif, to acknowledge, own (VIII, imperative 2nd m.s.; iʿtarafa bi- 'acknowledge', the verb chooses bi- for what is acknowledged); 'and acknowledge'
بِالْعُبُودِيَّةِ: بِـ + اَلْ + عُبُودِيَّة + ِ — bi-, (prep.; the verb iʿtarafa chooses bi- for what is acknowledged, 'acknowledge as') + al-, the + ʿubūdiyya, servitude, slavehood (f.; gen. after bi-); 'my servitude (to me)'
قَهْرِي: قَهْر + ِ + ي — qahr, subduing, crushing (m.; acc. as the object of ʿalimta, in the idāfa, 'how I crush') + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'my crushing'
عَادَانِي: عَادَانِي — ʿādā, to be hostile to (III, perf. 3rd m.s., defective) + -nī, me (acc. suffix, object); 'opposed me'
أَطَالَ: أَطَالَ — aṭāla, to lengthen, prolong (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; here a wish 'may He lengthen', the subject is God); 'may He lengthen'; here a plain perfect after baʿda an, 'after he had made long', with al-iltifāta, 'the looking', as object
وَلَازِلْتَ: وَ + لَا + زِلْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, not (negative of a wish) + zilta, to cease (I, perf. 2nd m.s., hollow; lā zilta 'may you never cease', governs a predicate in the accusative, here qāhiran 'triumphant'); 'and may you ever (be)'
مُدَارِيًا: مُدَارِي + ًا — mudārī, humouring, handling with tact (act. part. III of dārā, defective; acc. indef., predicate of lam yazal / ḥāl 'humouring'); 'humouring'
مُصَانِعًا: مُصَانِع + ًا — muṣāniʿ, flatterer, cajoling (act. part. III of ṣāniʿa; acc. indef., predicate of lam yazal / ḥāl); 'flattering'
الْكَرْمِ: اَلْ + كَرْم + ِ — al-, the + karm, vineyard (m.; gen. after ilā 'to'); 'the vineyard'
حَائِطِهِ: حَائِط + ِ + هِ — ḥāʾiṭ, wall (m.; gen. after fī 'in') + -hi, its (gen. suffix, the vineyard's); 'its wall'
ثُلْمَةً: ثُلْمَة + ً — thulma, breach, gap (f.; acc. indef., object of raʾā); 'a gap'
فَأَنْكَرَهَا: فَ + أَنْكَرَهَا — fa-, and so (conj., consequence) + ankara, to find strange, be suspicious of (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hā, it (acc. suffix, the gap); 'and found it strange'
الثُّلْمَةَ: اَلْ + ثُّلْمَة + َ — al-, the + thulma, breach, gap (f.; acc., after inna with hādhihi 'this', in apposition); 'the gap'
خَرْقًا: خَرْق + ًا — kharq, hole, tear (m.; acc. indef., object of raʾā 'saw'); 'a hole'
يَجْتَنِبْهُ: يَجْتَنِبْ + هُ — yajtanib, to avoid (VIII, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, the hole); 'does not avoid it'
وَيَتَوَقَّى: وَ + يَتَوَقَّى — wa-, and (conj.) + yatawaqqā, to guard oneself (V, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective; tawaqqā ʿan 'guard against'; keeps final ī-less alif-maqṣūra after lam, as the print does); 'and beware'
الْإِقْدَامِ: اَلْ + إِقْدَام + ِ — al-, the + iqdām, venturing, setting forward (IV verbal noun; gen. after ʿan, 'beware of'; iqdām ʿalā 'venturing upon'); 'venturing'
مَغْرُورًا: مَغْرُور + ًا — maghrūr, deluded, deceived (pass. part. I of gharra; acc. indef., predicate of kāna 'was deluded'; bi-nafsihi 'about himself'); 'deluded'
