وَلِلْهَلَاكِ: وَ + لِـ + اَلْ + هَلَاك + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, to, for (prep., mutaʿarriḍ li- 'exposing oneself to', the participle chooses li-) + al-, the + halāk, destruction (m.; gen. after li-); 'and exposing himself to ruin'
يُقَدِّمَ: يُقَدِّمَ — yuqaddima, to set before, offer (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive after ḥattā 'so that'); 'sets before'
الْعِنَبَ: اَلْ + عِنَب + َ — al-, the + ʿinab, grapes (coll. m.; acc., object of yuqaddima); 'the grapes'
فَيَقْدَمَ: فَ + يَقْدَمَ — fa-, and so (conj., sequel in the subjunctive after li-ajli an) + yaqdama, to approach, come forward (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive; qadima ilā 'come up to'); 'and approaches'
فَيَقَعَ: فَ + يَقَعَ — fa-, and so (conj., sequel in the subjunctive) + yaqaʿa, to fall (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., assimilated verb, subjunctive; fī al-halāk 'into ruin'); 'and falls'
الشَّطَارَةِ: اَلْ + شَّطَارَة + ِ — al-, the + shaṭāra, cleverness, roguish cunning (f.; gen. in the idāfa niṣfu al-shaṭārati 'half of cunning'); 'cunning'
التَّلَفِ: اَلْ + تَّلَف + ِ — al-, the + talaf, ruin, loss, destruction (m.; gen. after ilā 'to', 'leads to'); 'ruin'
يَحْمِلُنِى: يَحْمِلُ + نِي — yaḥmilu, to carry, drive, induce (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; ḥamalahu ʿalā 'drive someone to') + -nī, me (acc. suffix, nūn al-wiqāya; print ى for ي); 'drive me'
أُلْقِيَ: أُلْقِيَ — ulqiya, to throw (IV, imperf. 1st s. subjunctive after an, defective, with the subject nafsī as object: ulqiya nafsī 'I throw myself'); 'I throw'
الْهَلَكَةِ: اَلْ + هَلَكَة + ِ — al-, the + halaka, destruction, perdition (f.; gen. after fī 'into'); 'destruction'
مُحَاذِرٌ: مُحَاذِر + ٌ — muḥādhir, wary, on his guard (act. part. III; nom. indef., predicate/ḥāl after wa-huwa 'and he was'); 'warily'; also: predicate of inna, 'wary, on his guard': inna al-ʿāqila dāʾiman muḥādhirun, 'the wise man is always on his guard' (Night 192)
حَفِيرَةٌ: حَفِيرَة + ٌ — ḥafīra, pit, hole dug (f.; nom. indef., predicate of hiya 'it was' after fa-idhā 'behold'); 'a pit'
حَفَرَهَا: حَفَر + َ + هَا — ḥafara, to dig (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject ṣāḥib al-karm 'the owner of the vineyard') + -hā, it (acc. suffix, the pit); 'dug it'
لِيَصِيدَ: لِـ + يَصِيدَ — li-, in order to (particle of purpose with the subjunctive) + yaṣīda, to hunt, trap (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow, subjunctive after li-); 'to trap'
الْوَحْشَ: اَلْ + وَحْش + َ — al-, the + waḥsh, wild beast(s) (coll. m.; acc., object of yaṣīda); 'the wild beast'
الْكَرْمَ: اَلْ + كَرْم + َ — al-, the + karm, vineyard (m.; acc., object of yufsidu 'he ravages'); 'the vineyard' (i.e. its vines)
نِلْتَهُ: نِلْتَ + هُ — nilta, to obtain, attain (I, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, printed with an extra pronoun; the likely reading is innaka nilta mā ammaltahu); 'you have got it'
أَمَلّتَهُ: أَمَّلْتَ + هُ — ammaltahu (print أَمَلّتَهُ with the shadda on the lām; read ammaltahu), to hope for (II, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, relative mā's referent); 'you hoped for'
نَحِيفًا: نَحِيف + ًا — naḥīf, thin, slender (adj.; acc. indef., adj. of ghiṭāʾan 'a covering'); 'thin'
فَتَأَخَّرَ: فَ + تَأَخَّرَ — fa-, and so (conj., consequence) + taʾakhkhara, to draw back (V, perf. 3rd m.s.; ʿanhā 'away from it'; print's shadda); 'and drew back'
حَذِرْتُهَا: حَذِرْتُ + هَا — ḥadhirtu, to beware, be wary of (I, perf. 1st s.) + -hā, it (acc. suffix, the pit); 'I was wary of it'
نَغَّصَ: نَغَّصَ — naghghaṣa, to embitter, sour (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; naghghaṣa ʿayshī 'embitter my life'; relative clause on the wolf); 'who soured'
فَيَخْلُوَلِي: فَ + يَخْلُوَ + لِي — fa-, and so (conj., sequel in the subjunctive) + yakhluwa, to be left empty, be free (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive) + li-, to, for (prep., 'left to me', dative of benefit) + -ī, me (gen. suffix); the print runs these together, 'and so (the vineyard) is left to me'
الْكَرْمُ: اَلْ + كَرْم + ُ — al-, the + karm, vineyard (m.; nom., subject of yakhluwa); 'the vineyard'
وَأَسْتَقِلَّ: وَ + أَسْتَقِلَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + astaqilla, to have to oneself, be independent (X, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive, geminate; istaqalla bi- 'have (something) to oneself', the verb chooses bi-); 'and have it to myself'
وَحْدِى: وَحْد + ِ + ي — waḥd, aloneness (m.; gen. in the idāfa, acc. ḥāl idiom waḥdī 'by myself') + -ī, my (suffix); 'by myself' (print ى for ي)
وَأَعِيشَ: وَ + أَعِيشَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿīsha, to live (I, imperf. 1st s., hollow, subjunctive; fīhi 'in it'); 'and live'
اَبْصَرْتُ: أَبْصَرْتُ — abṣartu, to see (IV, perf. 1st s.; after laytanī 'would that I', print's alif without hamza); 'I might see'
ذِئْبَا: ذِئْب + ًا — dhiʾb, wolf (m.; acc. indef., object of abṣartu, printed ذِئْبَا for rhyme -ā); 'a wolf'
مَاقَدْ: مَا + قَدْ — mā, that, what (relative/verbal particle; ṭāla mā 'long has it been that') + qad, indeed (particle with the perfect); the print runs them together, 'long has it been that'
سَاءَ: سَاءَ — sāʾa, to grieve, distress (I, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; the subject is the wolf, qalbī 'my heart' is the object); 'he has grieved'
وَسَقَانِى: وَ + سَقَى + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + saqā, to give to drink (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; takes two objects) + -nī, me (acc. suffix, first object; print ى for ي); 'and made me drink'
الْمُرَّ: اَلْ + مُرَّ — al-, the + murr, bitter (adj.; acc., second object of saqā, 'the bitter thing', a bitter draught); 'the bitter (draught)'
وَيَقْضِى: وَ + يَقْضِي — wa-, and (conj.) + yaqḍī, to fulfil, accomplish (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective, subjunctive; qaḍā naḥbahu 'to die'); 'and (the wolf) meets (his end)'
نَحْبَا: نَحْب + ًا — naḥb, vow, term, death (m.; acc. indef., object of yaqḍī, printed -ā for the rhyme; qaḍā naḥbahu 'to fulfil his vow, die'); 'his end'
يَخْلُوْ: يَخْلُو + ْ — yakhlū, to be empty, be free (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective, indic.; here yakhlū al-karmu minhu 'the vineyard is rid of him', min chosen by the verb); 'is rid'
وَاَرَى: وَ + أَرَى — wa-, and (conj.) + arā, to see, find (I, imperf. 1st s., defective, indic.; arā lī fīhi 'I find for myself in it'); 'and I find'
سَهَّلَ: سَهَّلَ — sahhala, to make easy (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject Allāh; sahhala laka al-umūr 'God has smoothed your way'); 'He has made easy'
بِلَاتَعَبٍ: بِـ + لَا + تَعَب + ٍ — bi-, with (prep., 'with no toil', here bi- + lā 'without') + lā, no, without (negative particle forming 'without') + taʿab, toil, fatigue (m.; gen. indef.); the print runs them together, 'without any toil'
فَهَنِيأً: فَ + هَنِيئًا — fa-, so (conj., consequence) + hanīʾan, wholesome, pleasant (adj. used as acc. indef. exclamation, 'may it do you good'); the print spells the hamza on alif, 'then enjoy'
بِمَافَتَحَ: بِـ + مَا + فَتَحَ — bi-, for, on account of (prep., 'enjoy for what') + mā, what (relative, gen.) + fataḥa, to open (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; the subject is Allāh); the print runs them together, 'for what (He) has opened'
السَّائِغَةِ: اَلْ + سَّائِغَة + ِ — al-, the + sāʾigha, easy to swallow, pleasant (f. act. part. I of sāgha, hollow; gen., adj. of al-ghanīmati 'plunder'); 'pleasant'
وَالرِّزْقِ: وَ + اَلْ + رِّزْق + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + rizq, provision, sustenance (m.; gen., coordinated with al-ghanīmati after min); 'and the provision'
الْوَاسِعِ: اَلْ + وَاسِع + ِ — al-, the + wāsiʿ, ample, wide (act. part. I of wasiʿa; gen., adj. of al-rizqi); 'ample'
مَشَقَّةٍ: مَشَقَّة + ٍ — mashaqqa, hardship, trouble (f.; gen. indef., after bi-lā 'without'); 'trouble'
الدَّلِيلُ: اَلْ + دَّلِيل + ُ — al-, the + dalīl, proof, evidence (m.; nom., subject of mā 'what is the proof?'); 'the proof'
زَاهِيَةً: زَاهِيَة + ً — zāhiya, bright, flourishing (f. act. part. I of zahā, defective; acc. indef., ḥāl of al-athmāra 'the fruit'); 'glowing'
وَأَدْرَكَهُ: وَ + أَدْرَكَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + adraka, to overtake, seize (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject al-sharahu) + -hu, him (acc. suffix, the wolf); 'and seized him'
الشَّرَهُ: اَلْ + شَّرَه + ُ — al-, the + sharah, gluttony, greed (m.; nom., subject of adrakahu); 'gluttony'
الثُّلْمَةِ: اَلْ + ثُّلْمَة + ِ — al-, the + thulma, breach, gap (f.; gen. after ilā 'to'); 'the breach'
غَرَّهُ: غَرَّ + هُ — gharra, to deceive, lure (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; subject al-ṭamaʿu) + -hu, him (acc. suffix, the wolf); 'beguiled him'
مُتَهَافِتًا: مُتَهَافِت + ًا — mutahāfit, limp, collapsing (act. part. VI of tahāfata; acc. indef., ḥāl of the fox 'stood limp'); 'limp'
كَالْمَيِّتِ: كَـ + اَلْ + مَيِّت + ِ — ka-, like (prep. of comparison, 'as, like') + al-, the + mayyit, dead (adj. of māta; gen. after ka-); 'like a dead one'
وَتَمَثَّلَ: وَ + تَمَثَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tamaththala, to quote as fitting (V, perf. 3rd m.s.; tamaththala bi- 'quote', the verb chooses bi- for the verse quoted); 'and quoted'
اَتَطْمَعُ: اَ + تَطْمَعُ — a-, interrogative particle + taṭmaʿu, to hope, covet (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; ṭamiʿa min / bi- 'hope for' with bi-waṣlin); 'do you hope'
تَضُرُّ: تَضُرُّ — taḍurru, to harm (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., geminate, indic.; subject al-maṭāmiʿu, bi- takes the harmed part, bi-aʿnāq 'at the neck'); 'it harms'
بِاَعْنَاقِ: بِـ + اَعْنَاق + ِ — bi-, in, at (prep., the verb ḍarra bi- 'harm' takes bi- for what is harmed) + aʿnāq, necks (broken pl. of ʿunuq; gen. in idāfa aʿnāq al-rijāl); 'the necks (of men)'
الْمَطَامِعُ: اَلْ + مَطَامِع + ُ — al-, the + maṭāmiʿ, cravings, objects of greed (broken pl. of maṭmaʿ; nom., subject of taḍurru, after innamā); 'cravings'
مُؤْنَةَ: مُؤْنَة + َ — muʾna, trouble, burden, expense (f.; acc., object of kufīta, after kufita 'you were spared'); 'the trouble (of)'
التَّسْلِيقِ: اَلْ + تَّسْلِيق + ِ — al-, the + taslīq, climbing (II verbal noun; colloquial for tasalluq; gen. in the idāfa muʾnata al-taslīqi); 'of climbing'
غِطَاءَ: غِطَاء + َ — ghiṭāʾ, cover, lid (m.; acc., object of tawassaṭa 'he was in the middle of', in the idāfa ghiṭāʾa al-thulmati); 'the covering'
فَاضْطَرَبَ: فَ + اضْطَرَبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + iḍṭaraba, to quiver, be agitated (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.; followed by its verbal noun iḍṭirāban); 'and quivered'
وَالْفَرَحِ: وَ + اَلْ + فَرَح + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + faraḥ, gladness (m.; gen., coordinated with al-surūri after min); 'and gladness'
وَأَطْرَبَ: وَ + أَطْرَبَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṭraba, to sing merrily, trill (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; aṭraba bi-al-naghamāt 'he sang tunes', the bi- here is 'with'); 'and struck up merry'
لِحَالَتِيْ: لِـ + حَالَة + ِ + ي — li-, for, towards (prep., 'softened towards', after raqqa, the verb chooses li-) + ḥāla, state, plight (f., here ḥālatī; gen. after li-) + -ī, my (suffix); 'towards my plight'
لِطُوْلِ: لِـ + طُول + ِ — li-, at, because of (prep., rathā li- 'pity at', the verb chooses li-) + ṭūl, length (m.; gen. in the idāfa ṭūli taḥarruqī 'the length of my burning'); 'at the length (of)'
تَحَرُّقِيْ: تَحَرُّق + ِ + ي — taḥarruq, burning (with grief), heartburn (V verbal noun; gen. in idāfa after ṭūl) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my heartburn'
لَنِيْ: لَ + نِي — la-nī, the end of the split wa-anā la-nī (wa-anālanī), anāla, to grant, give (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; the subject is al-zamān 'Time') + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'and it granted me'
اَشْتَهِيْ: اَشْتَهِي — ashtahī, to desire (VIII, imperf. 1st s., defective, indic.; relative mā ashtahī 'what I desire', object of anāla); 'I desired'
وَاَزَالَ: وَ + أَزَالَ — wa-, and (conj.) + azāla, to remove (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; subject al-zamān; azāla min-mā 'take away from'); 'and removed'
اَتَّقِيْ: أَتَّقِي — attaqī, to fear, guard against (VIII, imperf. 1st s., defective, indic.; mimmā attaqī 'from what I feared'); 'I feared'
فَلَاَ: فَ + لَ + أَ — fa-, so (conj., consequence) + la-, surely (emphatic particle with the energetic) + a-, the first letter of aṣfaḥan (fa-la-aṣfaḥan), split by the print; 'so I will surely (pardon)'
صْفَحَنْ: صْفَحَنْ — ṣfaḥan, the remainder of fa-la-aṣfaḥan, aṣfaḥa, to forgive, overlook (I, imperf. 1st s., with energetic -an; ṣafaḥa ʿan 'forgive something' takes ʿan); 'I will pardon'
هُ: هُ — hu, the closing syllable of janāhu, split by the print across the half-line break: janā + -hu, he committed it (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'he committed'
الذُّنُوْبِ: اَلْ + ذُّنُوب + ِ — al-, the + dhunūb, sins (broken pl. of dhanb; gen., min bayān after mā janāhu min 'of the sins'); 'the sins'
السُّبَّقِ: اَلْ + سُّبَّق + ِ — al-, the + subbaq, former, past (broken pl. of sābiq; gen., adj. of al-dhunūb); 'the past'
فَالذِّئْبُ: فَ + اَلْ + ذِّئْب + ُ — fa-, for (conj., giving the reason) + al-, the + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; nom., subject of laysa lahu); 'for the wolf'
صٌ: صٌ — ṣun, the closing syllable of khalāṣun, split by the print across the half-line break: khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m.; nom. indef., subject of laysa lahu); 'escape'
هَلَاكٍ: هَلَاك + ٍ — halāk, destruction (m.; gen. indef., after min in 'from a ruin'; adj. mawbiqin); 'from ruin'
مَوْبِقِ: مَوْبِق + ِ — mawbiq, destroying, deadly (act. part. IV of awbaqa; gen. indef., adj. of halākin); 'destroying'
وَالْكَرْمُ: وَ + اَلْ + كَرْم + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + karm, vineyard (m.; nom., subject, predicate lī waḥdī 'mine alone'); 'and the vineyard'
وَحْدِيْ: وَحْد + ِ + ي — waḥd, aloneness (m.; acc. idiom waḥdī 'by myself, alone') + -ī, my (suffix); 'mine alone'
شَرِيْكٍ: شَرِيك + ٍ — sharīk, partner (m.; gen. indef., after min zāʾida in mā lī min sharīkin 'I have no partner'); 'a partner'
اَحْمَقِ: أَحْمَق + ِ — aḥmaq, foolish, fool (adj. elative form; gen. indef. diptote written with kasra for the rhyme, adj. of sharīkin); 'foolish'
نَدَمًا: نَدَم + ًا — nadam, remorse, regret (m.; acc. indef., giving the cause, 'out of remorse'); 'in remorse'
أَمِنْ: أَ + مِنْ — a-, interrogative particle + min, from, out of (prep., 'is it out of pity for me', min raḥmatika 'out of your pity'); 'is it out of'
الْحُصَيْنِ: اَلْ + حُصَيْن + ِ — al-, the + ḥuṣayn, little fortress, a name of the fox (m.; gen. in the idāfa abā al-Ḥuṣayn, after yā abā); '(Abū) al-Ḥuṣayn', the fox's kunya
قَذَفَكَ: قَذَف + َ + كَ — qadhafa, to fling, cast (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; the subject is Allāh, 'He who') + -ka, you (acc. suffix, the wolf); 'flung you'
لِطُولِ: لِـ + طُول + ِ — li-, because of (prep., 'I wept because of', the weeping verb takes li- for the reason) + ṭūl, length (m.; gen. after li-, in idāfa ṭūli ʿumrika); 'because of the length'
الْمَاضِي: اَلْ + مَاضِي — al-, the + māḍī, past, gone by (act. part. I of maḍā, defective; gen., adj. of ʿumrika, case ending unwritten); 'past'
كَوْنِكَ: كَوْن + ِ + كَ — kawn, being, the fact of being (m.; gen. after ʿalā in asafan ʿalā 'sorrow that') + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your being (that)'; also after maʿa, 'although': maʿa kawnika ʿaduwwī, 'though you are my enemy'
أَرَحْتُ: أَرَحْتُ — araḥtu, to give rest (IV, perf. 1st s., hollow; after law ... la-kuntu); 'I would have given rest'
وَاسْتَرَحْتُ: وَ + اسْتَرَحْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + istaraḥtu, to find rest (X, perf. 1st s., hollow); 'and found rest'
أُبْقِيتَ: أُبْقِيتَ — ubqīta, to leave alive, spare (IV, perf. 2nd m.s. passive; ilā 'until' marks the term); 'you were spared'
أَجَلِكَ: أَجَل + ِ + كَ — ajal, appointed term (of life) (m.; gen. after ilā 'until') + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your appointed end'
الْمَحْتُومِ: اَلْ + مَحْتُوم + ِ — al-, the + maḥtūm, decreed, fated (pass. part. I of ḥatama; gen., adj. of ajalika); 'fated'
وَوَقْتِكَ: وَ + وَقْت + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + waqt, time, hour (m.; gen., coordinated after ilā) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'and your hour'
الْمَعْلُومِ: اَلْ + مَعْلُوم + ِ — al-, the + maʿlūm, known, appointed (pass. part. I of ʿalima; gen., adj. of waqtika); 'appointed'
كَالْمَازِحِ: كَـ + اَلْ + مَازِح + ِ — ka-, like (prep. of comparison, 'as if') + al-, the + māziḥ, joker (act. part. I of mazaḥa; gen. after ka-); 'as if in jest'
الْمُسِيءُ: اَلْ + مُسِيء + ُ — al-, the + musīʾ, wrongdoer, villain (act. part. IV of asāʾa; nom., vocative after ayyuhā, 'you who'); 'you villain'
لِوَالِدَتِي: لِـ + وَالِدَة + ِ + ي — li-, to (prep., 'go to', ruḥ li- 'go to'; the verb rāḥa takes li- of destination) + wālida, mother (f. act. part. I; gen. after li-) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'to my mother'
وَأَخْبِرْهَا: وَ + أَخْبِرْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + akhbir, to inform (IV, imperative 2nd m.s.) + -hā, her (acc. suffix, the mother); 'and tell her'
تَحْتَالُ: تَحْتَالُ — taḥtālu, to find a stratagem (VIII, imperf. 3rd f.s., hollow, indic.; iḥtāla ʿalā 'find a stratagem for', the verb chooses ʿalā); 'she finds a way'
أَوْقَعَكَ: أَوْقَعَ + كَ — awqaʿa, to cause to fall, cast (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject shiddatu ṭamaʿika 'the violence of your greed') + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'cast you'
طَمَعِكَ: طَمَع + ِ + كَ — ṭamaʿ, greed (m.; gen. in the idāfa shiddatu ṭamaʿika) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your greed'
وَكَثْرَةُ: وَ + كَثْرَة + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + kathra, abundance, excess (f.; nom., coordinated subject of awqaʿaka, in the idāfa kathratu ḥirṣika); 'and the excess of'
حِرْصِكَ: حِرْص + ِ + كَ — ḥirṣ, avidity, craving (m.; gen. in the idāfa after kathratu) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your craving'
سَقَطْتَ: سَقَطْتَ — saqaṭta, to fall (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; fī ḥufratin 'into a pit'); 'you fell'
لَسْتَ: لَسْتَ — lasta, to be not (laysa, I, perf. 2nd m.s., defective negative verb; its predicate takes bi-, bi-sālimin); 'you are not'
بِسَالِمٍ: بِـ + سَالِم + ٍ — bi-, (prep., marks the predicate of lasta, 'you are not safe'; carries no meaning of its own, strengthening the negation) + sālim, safe (act. part. I of salima; gen. indef., predicate after bi-); 'safe'
السَّائِرِ: اَلْ + سَّائِر + ِ — al-, the + sāʾir, current, travelling (act. part. I of sāra; gen., adj. of al-mathali 'the proverb'); 'well-worn'
يَأْمَنِ: يَأْمَنِ — yaʾmani, to be safe (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam, with kasra before al-; takes object al-maʿāṭiba); 'is not safe from'
وَتَرْغَبُ: وَ + تَرْغَبُ — wa-, and (conj.) + targhabu, to desire, seek (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; raghiba fī 'desire', the verb chooses fī); 'and you sought'
مَوَدَّتِي: مَوَدَّة + ِ + ي — mawadda, friendship, affection (f.; gen. after fī) + -ī, my (gen. suffix, objective: friendship with me); 'my friendship'
وَتَخَافُ: وَ + تَخَافُ — wa-, and (conj.) + takhāfu, to fear (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., hollow, indic.; khāfa min 'fear' takes min for the thing feared); 'and you feared'
تَحْقِدْ: تَحْقِدْ — taḥqid, to bear a grudge (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition; ḥaqada ʿalā 'bear a grudge against', the verb chooses ʿalā); 'do not bear a grudge'
أَجْرُهُ: أَجْر + ُ + هُ — ajr, reward (m.; nom., predicate/subject of kāna, ʿalā allāhi 'with God') + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his reward'
اِزْرَعْ: اِزْرَعْ — izraʿ, to sow (I, imperative 2nd m.s.; object jamīlan 'kindness'); 'sow'
اَيْنَمَا: أَيْنَمَا — aynamā, wherever (adverb of place + mā, conditional); 'wherever'
زُرِعَا: زُرِعَ + ا — zuriʿa, to be sown (I, perf. 3rd m.s. passive; final -ā is the long vowel of the rhyme, not a dual); 'it was sown'
يَحْصُدُهُ: يَحْصُد + ُ + هُ — yaḥṣudu, to reap (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, the kindness); 'reaps it'
زَرَعَا: زَرَعَ + ا — zaraʿa, to sow (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; final -ā is the long vowel of the rhyme, not a dual); 'sowed'
أَجْهَلَ: أَجْهَلَ — ajhal, most ignorant (elative of jāhil; acc. as vocative idāfa yā ajhala al-sibāʿi after yā, in idāfa with al-sibāʿ); 'most ignorant'
وَأَحْمَقَ: وَ + أَحْمَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aḥmaq, most foolish (elative of aḥmaq; acc., vocative coordinated with ajhala, in idāfa with al-wuḥūsh); 'and most foolish'
تَجَبُّرَكَ: تَجَبُّر + َ + كَ — tajabbur, tyranny, overbearing (V verbal noun; acc., object of nasīta) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your tyranny'
وَعُتُوَّكَ: وَ + عُتُوّ + َ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿutuww, insolence, defiance (m.; acc., coordinated with tajabburaka; print's shadda) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'and your insolence'
وَتَكَبُّرَكَ: وَ + تَكَبُّر + َ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + takabbur, pride, haughtiness (V verbal noun; acc., coordinated with tajabburaka) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'and your pride'
تَرْعَ: تَرْعَ — tarʿa, to respect, observe (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., defective, jussive after lam; raʿā ḥaqqa 'respect the right of'); 'did not respect'
الْمُعَاشَرَةِ: اَلْ + مُعَاشَرَة + ِ — al-, the + muʿāshara, companionship, living together (III verbal noun; gen. in the idāfa ḥaqqa al-muʿāsharati); 'of companionship'
تَنْتَصِحْ: تَنْتَصِحْ — tantaṣiḥ, to take advice (VIII, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lam; intaṣaḥa bi- 'take advice from', the verb chooses bi- for the source); 'did not take advice'
تَظْلِمَنَّ: تَظْلِمَنَّ — taẓlimanna, to wrong (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., with energetic -anna after lā of prohibition); 'never do wrong'
الظَّلُومَ: اَلْ + ظَّلُوم + َ — al-, the + ẓalūm, oppressor, very unjust (intensive form of ẓālim; acc., after inna, subject; the case ending is the verse's); 'the oppressor'
حَدٍّ: حَدّ + ٍ — ḥadd, edge, brink (m.; gen. indef., after ʿalā in ʿalā ḥaddin min 'on the edge of'); 'a brink'
النَّقَمِ: اَلْ + نَّقَم + ِ — al-, the + naqam, vengeance, punishment (broken pl. of niqma; gen. after min); 'of vengeance'
وَالْمَظْلُومُ: وَ + اَلْ + مَظْلُوم + ُ — wa-, and (conj., 'while') + al-, the + maẓlūm, wronged one (pass. part. I of ẓalama; nom., subject, predicate muntabihun); 'and the wronged'
مُنْتَبِهٌ: مُنْتَبِه + ٌ — muntabih, awake, alert (act. part. VIII of intabaha; nom. indef., predicate of al-maẓlūm); 'awake'
وَعَيْنُ: وَ + عَيْن + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿayn, eye (f.; nom., subject, in the idāfa ʿaynu allāhi 'the eye of God'); 'and the eye of'
لَاتُؤَاخِذْنِي: لَا + تُؤَاخِذْ + نِي — lā, not (prohibition) + tuʾākhidh, to hold to account (III, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā; ākhadha bi- 'hold to account for', here bi-sābiqi) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); the print runs them together, 'do not hold me to account'
فَالْعَفْوُ: فَ + اَلْ + عَفْو + ُ — fa-, for (conj., giving the reason) + al-, the + ʿafw, pardon (m.; nom., subject, predicate maṭlūbun); 'for pardon'
مَطْلُوبٌ: مَطْلُوب + ٌ — maṭlūb, sought, desired (pass. part. I of ṭalaba; nom. indef., predicate of al-ʿafw); 'is what is sought'
وَصُنْعُ: وَ + صُنْع + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣunʿ, doing, making (m.; nom., subject, in the idāfa ṣunʿu al-maʿrūfi 'doing kindness'); 'and doing (a kindness)'
بَادِرْ: بَادِرْ — bādir, to hasten (III, imperative 2nd m.s.; bādara bi- 'hasten to do', the verb chooses bi-, here bi-khayrin 'to do good'); 'be quick'
يَتَذَلَّلُ: يَتَذَلَّلُ — yatadhallalu, to abase oneself (V, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; tadhallala li- 'humble oneself before', li-l-thaʿlabi); 'abased himself'
تُخَلِّصُنِي: تُخَلِّص + نِي — tukhalliṣu, to free, rescue (II, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; takhalliṣa min 'free from') + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'you free me'
الْمَغْرُورُ: اَلْ + مَغْرُور + ُ — al-, the + maghrūr, deluded one (pass. part. I of gharra; nom., vocative after ayyuhā 'O'); 'the deluded'
الْمَاكِرُ: اَلْ + مَاكِر + ُ — al-, the + mākir, cunning, crafty (act. part. I of makara; nom., adj. in the vocative after ayyuhā); 'the cunning'
الْغَادِرُ: اَلْ + غَادِر + ُ — al-, the + ghādir, treacherous (act. part. I of ghadara; nom., adj. in the vocative after ayyuhā); 'the treacherous'
لَاتَطْمَعْ: لَا + تَطْمَعْ — lā, not (prohibition) + taṭmaʿ, to hope, covet (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā; ṭamiʿa fī 'hope for', the verb chooses fī); the print runs them together, 'do not hope'
الْخَلَاصِ: اَلْ + خَلَاص + ِ — al-, the + khalāṣ, deliverance, escape (m.; gen. after fī in laṭ-taṭmaʿ fī 'do not hope for'); 'deliverance'
جَزَاءٌ: جَزَاء + ٌ — jazāʾ, reward, requital (m.; nom. indef., predicate of hādhā 'this'); 'a reward'
لِقَبِيحِ: لِـ + قَبِيح + ِ — li-, for (prep., 'requital for', jazāʾ li- 'recompense for') + qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj. as noun; gen., in the idāfa qabīḥi fiʿlika 'your foul deeds'); 'for the foul (deeds)'
وَقِصَاصٌ: وَ + قِصَاص + ٌ — wa-, and (conj.) + qiṣāṣ, retaliation in kind (m.; nom. indef., coordinated with jazāʾun); 'and retribution'
بِالشِّدْقَيْنِ: بِـ + اَلْ + شِّدْقَيْن + ِ — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment, 'laugh with') + al-, the + shidq, corner of the mouth (m., dual shidqayn; gen. dual after bi-); 'with both corners (of his mouth)'
تُكْثِرَنَّ: تُكْثِرَنَّ — tukthiranna, to do much, overdo (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., with energetic -anna after lā of prohibition); 'do not ply'
خِدَاعِيْ: خِدَاع + ِيْ — khidāʿ, deceit, trickery (m.; acc., object of tukthiranna) + -ī, my (suffix, objective sense 'deceiving me'); 'tricks on me'
فَلَنْ: فَ + لَنْ — fa-, so, then (conj.) + lan, will never (negative particle, takes the subjunctive; negates the future); 'so you will never'
تَنَالَ: تَنَالَ — tanāla, to attain, get (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after lan); 'you will gain'
مَنَالًا: مَنَالًا — manāl, attainment (m. verbal noun; acc. indef., cognate accusative of tanāla, for emphasis); 'any gain at all'
رُمْتَ: رُمْتَ — rumta, to seek, desire (I, perf. 2nd m.s., hollow rāma; in mā rumta minnī 'what you seek of me'); 'you seek'
مِنِّيْ: مِنْ + نِّيْ — min, from (prep.; rāma min 'seek from') + -nī, me (1st s. suffix with doubled nūn, gen. after min); 'from me' ; also: min of belonging: al-jismu minnī, 'my body' (lit. 'the body of me')
مُحَالُ: مُحَال — muḥāl, impossible (pass. part. IV of aḥāla; nom., predicate of mā rumta; printed -u for -un); 'impossible'
زَرَعْتَ: زَرَعْتَ — zaraʿta, to sow (I, perf. 2nd m.s.); 'you sowed'
فَاحْصُدْ: فَ + احْصُدْ — fa-, so, then (conj., introducing the command) + uḥṣud, to reap (I, imperative 2nd m.s.); 'so reap'
وَبَالًا: وَبَالًا — wabāl, ill consequence, ruin (m.; acc. indef., object of uḥṣud; the wāw is part of the root, not 'and'); 'the harvest of ruin'
حَلِيمَ: حَلِيم + َ — ḥalīm, forbearing, mild (adj. used as noun; acc., vocative annexed to al-sibāʿ after yā); 'most forbearing'
أَوْثَقُ: أَوْثَق — awthaq, more trustworthy (elative of wathīq; nom., predicate of anta; diptote; with min an 'too trustworthy to'); 'too trustworthy'
تُسْلِمَنِي: تُسْلِمَ + نِي — tuslima, to give up, abandon (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after min an) + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix with nūn al-wiqāya, object); 'that you would abandon me'
وَأَفَاضَ: وَ + أَفَاضَ — wa-, and (conj.) + afāḍa, to pour out, make overflow (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; object damʿa); 'and poured out'
اَيَادِيْهِ: أَيَادِي + هِ — ayādī, hands, favours (broken pl. of yad; nom., subject of the clause, 'whose favours') + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'whose favours'
مَوَاهِبُهُ: مَوَاهِب + ُ + هُ — mawāhib, gifts (broken pl. of mawhiba; nom., subject of tanmū) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'whose gifts'
تَنْمُوْ: تَنْمُو — tanmū, to grow, increase (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., defective, indic.; with ʿan 'grow past'); 'grow'
الْعَدَدِ: الـ + عَدَد — al-, the + ʿadad, number, counting (m.; gen. after ʿan, which tanmū takes for 'beyond'); 'beyond counting'
نَابَنِيْ: نَابَ + نِيْ — nāba, to befall (I, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow; takes the afflicted as acc.) + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix); 'befell me'
نَائِبَةٌ: نَائِبَة + ٌ — nāʾiba, misfortune, calamity (f.; nom. indef., subject of nābanī, act. part. of nāba); 'a blow of fortune'
وَجَدْتُكُ: وَجَدْتُ + كُ — wajadtu, to find (I, perf. 1st s.) + -ka, you (m.s. acc. suffix; printed with ḍamma on the kāf, kept as printed, the sense needs -ka); 'I found you'
آخِذًا: آخِذ + ًا — ākhidh, taking, holding (act. part. I of akhadha; acc. indef., ḥāl; with bi-yadī 'by my hand'); 'holding'
وَالْخُشُوعِ: وَ + الـ + خُشُوع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + khushūʿ, meekness, humility (m. verbal noun; gen., coordinated after ilā al-taḍarruʿ); 'and meekness'
وَالذِّلَّةِ: وَ + الـ + ذِّلَّة — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + dhilla, abasement (f.; gen., coordinated); 'and abasement'
وَالْخُضُوعِ: وَ + الـ + خُضُوع — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + khuḍūʿ, submission (m. verbal noun; gen., coordinated); 'and submission'
الْأَنَفَةِ: الـ + أَنَفَة — al-, the + anafa, haughtiness, pride (f.; gen. after baʿda); 'the pride'
وَالتَّكَبُّرِ: وَ + الـ + تَّكَبُّر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + takabbur, arrogance (V verbal noun; gen., coordinated); 'and arrogance'
وَالظُّلْمِ: وَ + الـ + ظُّلْم — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ẓulm, oppression (m.; gen., coordinated); 'and oppression'
وَالتَّجَبُّرِ: وَ + الـ + تَّجَبُّر — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + tajabbur, tyranny (V verbal noun; gen., coordinated); 'and tyranny'
صَحِبْتُكَ: صَحِبْتُ + كَ — ṣaḥibtu, to accompany, keep company with (I, perf. 1st s., takes acc.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I kept company with you'
عُدْوَانِكَ: عُدْوَان + ِ + كَ — ʿudwān, aggression, violence (m.; gen. after min; khāʾif min 'afraid of') + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your violence'
وَتَمَلَّقْتُ: وَ + تَمَلَّقْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tamallaqtu, to flatter, fawn (V, perf. 1st s.; takes li- of the person, here lak); 'and I flattered'
لَارَغْبَةً: لَا + رَغْبَة + ً — lā, not (negation) + raghba, desire (f.; acc. indef., of motive, 'out of desire'; raghba fī 'desire for'); 'not out of desire'
الرَّجْفَةُ: الـ + رَّجْفَة + ُ — al-, the + rajfa, quaking, earthquake (f.; nom., subject of nazalat); 'the earthquake'
النِّقْمَةُ: الـ + نِّقْمَة + ُ — al-, the + niqma, vengeance, retribution (f.; nom., subject of ḥallat); 'vengeance'
الْمُلْتَمِسُ: الـ + مُلْتَمِس + ُ — al-, the + multamis, one who seeks (act. part. VIII of iltamasa; nom., vocative after yā ayyuhā); 'you who seek'
الْخَدِيْعَة: الـ + خَدِيْعَة — al-, the + khadīʿa, deceit (f.; acc., object of multamis; pointed -ah for the pause); 'deceit'
فيْ: فِيْ — fī, in, into (prep.; waqaʿa fī 'fall into', the verb chooses fī); 'into'
الشَّنِيْعَةْ: الـ + شَّنِيْعَة + ْ — al-, the + shanīʿa, foul, hideous (f. adj.; gen., adj. of niyyatika; rhyme-word pointed for the pause); 'foul'
فَذُقْ: فَ + ذُقْ — fa-, so (conj., introducing the command) + dhuq, to taste (I, imperative 2nd m.s., hollow); 'so taste'
وَبَالَ: وَبَال + َ — wabāl, ill consequence, ruin (m.; acc., object of dhuq, annexed to al-miḥna; the wāw is radical, not 'and'); 'the bitter fruit of'
الْمِحْنَةِ: الـ + مِحْنَة + ِ — al-, the + miḥna, trial, ordeal (f.; gen., second term of the annexation); 'the trial'
الْفَظِيْعَةْ: الـ + فَظِيْعَة + ْ — al-, the + faẓīʿa, dreadful (f. adj.; gen., adj. of al-miḥna; pause-form); 'dreadful'
الذِّيَابِ: الـ + ذِّيَاب + ِ — al-, the + dhiyāb, wolves (= dhiʾāb, hamza softened; pl. of dhiʾb; gen. after maʿa); 'the wolves'
قَطِيْعَةْ: قَطِيْعَة + ْ — qaṭīʿa, severance, cutting off (f.; gen. indef. after fī, pause-form); 'in severance'
نَاطِقًا: نَاطِق + ًا — nāṭiq, speaking (act. part. I of naṭaqa; acc. indef., predicate of takun); 'speaking'
وَبِعَيْنِهِمْ: وَ + بِـ + عَيْن + ِ + هِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + bi-, with (prep., instrumental, 'with their eye') + ʿayn, eye (f.; gen. after bi-) + -him, their (gen. suffix); 'and with their eyes'
مُحَدِّقًا: مُحَدِّق + ًا — muḥaddiq, staring (act. part. II of ḥaddaqa; acc. indef., predicate of takun, coordinated with nāṭiqan); 'staring'
وَافِيًا: وَافِي + ًا — wāfī, faithful (act. part. I of wafā, defective; acc. indef., predicate of kun; takes bi-); 'faithful'
بِعَهْدِ: بِـ + عَهْد — bi-, to (prep., chosen by wafā bi- 'keep a pact') + ʿahd, pact, covenant (m.; gen., annexed to iʾtilāfī); 'to the pact of'
ائْتِلَافِي: ائْتِلَاف + ِي — iʾtilāf, friendship, union (VIII verbal noun; gen., second term after ʿahd) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'my friendship'
التَّلَافِي: الـ + تَّلَافِي — al-, the + talāfī, making good, remedy (VI verbal noun, defective; gen., annexed to waqt); 'setting right'
وَتَسَبَّبْ: وَ + تَسَبَّبْ — wa-, and (conj.) + tasabbab, to contrive (V, imperative 2nd m.s.; tasabbaba lī fī 'find me a way to'); 'and find a way'
حَبْلٍ: حَبْل + ٍ — ḥabl, rope (m.; gen. indef. after fī); 'a rope'
طَرَفَهُ: طَرَف + َ + هُ — ṭaraf, end (m.; acc., object of tashuddu) + -hu, its (gen. suffix); 'one end of it'
وَتُدْلِي: وَ + تُدْلِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tudlī, to let down (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., defective, indic.; adlā 'lower a rope/bucket'); 'and let down'
أَتَعَلَّقَ: أَتَعَلَّقَ — ataʿallaqa, to catch hold, hang on (V, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after ḥattā; takes bi-); 'I can catch hold'
وَأَدْفَعُ: وَ + أَدْفَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + adfaʿu, to hand over, give (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.; dafaʿa lak 'give to you'); 'and I will give'
مَاحَوَتْهُ: مَا + حَوَتْ + هُ — mā, what, all that (relative) + ḥawat, to hold, gather (I, perf. 3rd f.s., defective; subject yadī, f.) + -hu, it (acc., returning to mā); 'what ... has gathered'
أَكْثَرْتَ: أَكْثَرْتَ — aktharta, to do much (IV, perf. 2nd m.s.; akthara min 'do much of'); 'you have done a great deal'
الْمُحَاوَرَةِ: الـ + مُحَاوَرَة + ِ — al-, the + muḥāwara, exchange of words, debate (III verbal noun; gen. after min, of akthara min); 'talk'
تَطْمَعْ: تَطْمَعْ — taṭmaʿ, to hope, covet (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition; ṭamiʿa fī 'hope for'); 'do not hope'
تُمْسِكُ: تُمْسِكُ — tumsiku, to hold, keep (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic., in mā tumsiku bihi nafsaka; amsaka bi- 'hold on by', amsaka nafsahu 'keep oneself alive'); 'you might hold on by'
تُضْمِرُهُ: تُضْمِرُ + هُ — tuḍmiru, to harbour in the heart (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.) + -hu, it (acc., returning to mā); 'you harbour'
وَالْمَكْرِ: وَ + الـ + مَكْر + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + makr, cunning (m.; gen., coordinated after al-ghadr); 'and cunning'
ذَاتَكَ: ذَات + َ + كَ — dhāt, self (f.; acc., noun of anna; printed ذانك, corrected) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your self'
مُفَارِقَةٌ: مُفَارِقَة + ٌ — mufāriqa, leaving (act. part. III of fāraqa; f.; nom. indef., predicate of anna); 'leaving'
زَائِلَةٌ: زَائِلَة + ٌ — zāʾila, passing away (act. part. I of zāla; f.; nom. indef., predicate, coordinated); 'passing away'
وَعَنْهَا: وَ + عَنْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿan, from (prep.; rāḥila ʿan 'depart from') + -hā, it (the world, gen. suffix); 'and from it'
رَاحِلَةٌ: رَاحِلَة + ٌ — rāḥila, departing (act. part. I of raḥala; f.; nom. indef., predicate, coordinated); 'departing'
فَبِئْسَ: فَ + بِئْسَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + biʾsa, how wretched (verb of blame, perf. 3rd m.s.; followed by al-qarār, the thing blamed); 'and wretched is'
الرُّجُوعِ: الـ + رُّجُوع + ِ — al-, the + rujūʿ, returning (m. verbal noun; gen., annexed in qarīb al-rujūʿ); 'returning'
الْوِدَادِ: الـ + وِدَاد + ِ — al-, the + widād, friendship (m.; gen. after ilā; rajaʿa ilā 'return to'); 'friendship'
تُصِرَّ: تُصِرَّ — tuṣirra, to persist (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., geminate, jussive after lā of prohibition; aṣarra ʿalā 'persist in'); 'do not cling'
ضَغَائِنِ: ضَغَائِن + ِ — ḍaghāʾin, grudges (broken pl. of ḍaghīna; gen. after ʿalā, annexed to al-aḥqād); 'grudges of'
الْأَحْقَادِ: الـ + أَحْقَاد + ِ — al-, the + aḥqād, spite, rancour (pl. of ḥiqd; gen., second term of the annexation); 'spite'
خَلَّصَ: خَلَّصَ — khallaṣa, to save, deliver (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; man khallaṣa 'whoever saves'); 'saves'
أَحْيَاهَا: أَحْيَا + هَا — aḥyā, to give life (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective) + -hā, it (the soul, acc. suffix); 'gave it life'
فَكَأَنَّمَا: فَ + كَـ + أَنَّمَا — fa-, then (conj., apodosis) + ka-, as (in ka-annamā 'as though') + annamā, that (anna + mā); 'it is as though'
أَحْيَى: أَحْيَى — aḥyā, to give life (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; object al-nās, after ka-annamā); 'he had given life to'
تَتَّبِعِ: تَتَّبِعِ — tattabiʿi, to follow (VIII, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition, kasra before al-); 'do not follow'
الْفَسَادَ: الـ + فَسَاد + َ — al-, the + fasād, wickedness, mischief (m.; acc., object of tattabiʿ); 'wickedness'
نَهَوْا: نَهَوْا — nahaw, to forbid (I, perf. 3rd m.pl., defective; nahā ʿan 'forbid'); 'forbade'
وَلَافَسَادَ: وَ + لَا + فَسَاد + َ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, no (lā of absolute denial) + fasāda, wickedness (m.; acc. without tanwīn, noun of lā); 'and there is no wickedness'
أَظْهَرُ: أَظْهَرُ — aẓhar, plainer, more evident (elative of ẓāhir; nom., predicate of lā fasāda; diptote, followed by min); 'plainer'
أَتَجَرَّعُ: أَتَجَرَّعُ — atajarraʿu, to gulp down (V, imperf. 1st s., indic., ḥāl-like; object ghuṣaṣ); 'swallowing'
قَادِرٌ: قَادِر + ٌ — qādir, able (act. part. I of qadara; nom. indef., predicate of anta; takes ʿalā); 'able'
فَجُدْ: فَ + جُدْ — fa-, so (conj.) + jud, to be generous (I, imperative 2nd m.s., hollow jāda; jāda ʿalā ... bi- 'bestow on ... with'); 'so be generous'
الْفَظُّ: الـ + فَظّ + ُ — al-, the + faẓẓ, coarse, rough (adj.; nom., vocative after ayyuhā); 'you coarse one'
الْغَلِيظُ: الـ + غَلِيظ + ُ — al-, the + ghalīẓ, harsh, gross (adj.; nom., vocative after ayyuhā, with al-faẓẓ); 'brute'
أُشَبِّهُكَ: أُشَبِّه + ُ + كَ — ushabbihu, to liken (II, imperf. 1st s., indic.; shabbaha X bi-Y 'liken X to Y') + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I liken you'
عَلَانِيَتِكَ: عَلَانِيَة + ِ + كَ — ʿalāniya, outward show, what is public (f.; gen., annexed after fī ḥusni) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your outward show'
وَقَوْلِكَ: وَ + قَوْل + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qawl, speech, words (m.; gen., coordinated) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'and your words'
وَأَقِيسُ: وَ + أَقِيسُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqīsu, to compare, measure (I, imperf. 1st s., hollow qāsa, indic.; qāsa X bi-Y 'compare X with Y'); 'and I compare'
وَفِعْلِكَ: وَ + فِعْل + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + fiʿl, deed (m.; gen., coordinated after niyyatika) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'and your deeds'
بِالْبَازِي: بِـ + الـ + بَازِي — bi-, with, to (prep.; ushabbihu and aqīsu are completed by bi- for the thing compared, 'liken to') + al-, the + bāzī, falcon (m.; gen.); 'to the falcon'
الْحَجَلِ: الـ + حَجَل + ِ — al-, the + ḥajal, partridge (collective; gen. after maʿa); 'the partridge'
كَرْمًا: كَرْم + ًا — karm, vineyard (m.; acc. indef., object of dakhaltu); 'a vineyard'
لِآكُلَ: لِـ + آكُلَ — li-, in order to (li- of purpose, takes the subjunctive) + ākula, to eat (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive; madda printed); 'in order to eat'
عِنَبِهِ: عِنَب + ِ + هِ — ʿinab, grapes (collective; gen. after min, partitive 'some of') + -hi, its (gen. suffix); 'of its grapes'
بَأزِيًا: بَازِي + ًا — bāzī, falcon (m.; acc. indef., object of raʾaytu; printed with hamza on the alif, بأزيا, read bāzī); 'a falcon'
حَجَلٍ: حَجَل + ٍ — ḥajal, partridge (collective used as sing.; gen. indef. after ʿalā; inqaḍḍa ʿalā 'swoop on'); 'a partridge'
عَلِقَهُ: عَلِقَ + هُ — ʿaliqa, to catch hold of (I, perf. 3rd m.s., subject the falcon) + -hu, it (the partridge, acc. suffix); 'had caught hold of it'
وَاقْتَنَصَهُ: وَ + اقْتَنَصَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iqtanaṣa, to seize as prey (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and seized it'
انْفَلَتَ: انْفَلَتَ — infalata, to slip loose, escape (VII, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes min 'from'); 'slipped away'
الْحَجَلُ: الـ + حَجَل + ُ — al-, the + ḥajal, partridge (collective; nom., subject of infalata); 'the partridge'
وَكْرَهُ: وَكْر + َ + هُ — wakr, nest (m.; acc., object of dakhala) + -hu, its (gen. suffix); 'its nest'
الْبَأزِي: الـ + بَازِي — al-, the + bāzī, falcon (m.; nom., subject of tabiʿa; printed with hamza on the alif, البأزي, read bāzī); 'the falcon'
وَنَادَاهُ: وَ + نَادَا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + nādā, to call to (III, perf. 3rd m.s., defective) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'and called to him'
الْجَافِلُ: الـ + جَافِل + ُ — al-, the + jāfil, one who bolts in fright (act. part. I of jafala; nom., vocative after ayyuhā); 'you runaway'
فَرَحِمْتُكَ: فَ + رَحِمْتُ + كَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + raḥimtu, to take pity on (I, perf. 1st s., takes acc.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'and took pity on you'
وَالْتَقَطْتُ: وَ + الْتَقَطْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + iltaqaṭtu, to pick up, gather (VIII, perf. 1st s.; here with lak 'for you'); 'and gathered'
وَأَمْسَكْتُكَ: وَ + أَمْسَكْتُ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + amsaktu, to hold, seize (IV, perf. 1st s.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'and held you'
فَهَرَبْتَ: فَ + هَرَبْتَ — fa-, but, then (conj.) + harabta, to flee (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; harabta minnī 'you fled from me'); 'but you fled'
لِهُرُوبِكَ: لِـ + هُرُوب + ِ + كَ — li-, for (prep.; ʿarafa li- 'find for', 'for your flight') + hurūb, flight (m. verbal noun; gen. after li-) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'for your flight'
الْحِرْمَانَ: الـ + حِرْمَان + َ — al-, the + ḥirmān, deprivation (m.; acc., the excepted term after illā); 'but deprivation'
فَاظْهَرْ: فَ + اظْهَرْ — fa-, so (conj.) + uẓhar, to come out, show oneself (I, imperative 2nd m.s.); 'so come out'
آتَيْتُكَ: آتَيْتُ + كَ — ātaytu, to bring (IV, perf. 1st s.; printed with madda, kept as printed, the sense is ataytuka bihi 'I brought you', atā bi-) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I brought you'
الْحَبِّ: الـ + حَبّ + ِ — al-, the + ḥabb, grain (m., collective; gen. after min, explaining mā); 'of the grain'
فَكُلْهُ: فَ + كُلْ + هُ — fa-, and (conj.) + kul, to eat (I, imperative 2nd m.s. of akala, hamza dropped) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and eat it'
مَرِيأً: مَرِيأً — marīʾ, wholesome (adj.; acc. indef., adverbial, paired with hanīʾan 'with good result'); 'to your good'
صَدَّقَهُ: صَدَّقَ + هُ — ṣaddaqa, to believe (II, perf. 3rd m.s., takes acc.) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'believed him'
فَأَنْشَبَ: فَ + أَنْشَبَ — fa-, and (conj.) + anshaba, to fix, sink (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; object makhālib 'claws'); 'and sank'
وَمَكَّنَهَا: وَ + مَكَّنَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + makkana, to give a firm hold (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes min) + -hā, them (the talons, f. suffix); 'and made them fast'
كُلْهُ: كُلْ + هُ — kul, to eat (I, imperative 2nd m.s. of akala) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'eat it'
فَكَذَبْتَ: فَ + كَذَبْتَ — fa-, so (conj.) + kadhabta, to lie (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; kadhaba ʿalā 'lie to'); 'so you lied'
لَحْمِي: لَحْم + ِي — laḥm, flesh (m.; gen. after min) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'my flesh'
جَوْفِكَ: جَوْف + ِ + كَ — jawf, belly (m.; gen. after fī) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your belly'
سُمًّا: سُمّ + ًا — summ, poison (m.; acc. indef., second object of jaʿala 'make into'); 'poison'
رِيشُهُ: رِيش + ُ + هُ — rīsh, feathers (collective; nom., subject of waqaʿa 'fell out') + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his feathers'
وَسَقَطَتْ: وَ + سَقَطَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + saqaṭat, to fall, fail (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject quwwatuhu); 'and failed' Also of a person falling: wa-saqaṭat ilā al-arḍi, 'and she fell to the ground'.
قَلِيبًا: قَلِيب + ًا — qalīb, well, pit (m.; acc. indef., object of ḥafara); 'a pit'
غَدَرْتَ: غَدَرْتَ — ghadarta, to betray (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; ghadara bi- 'betray', the verb chooses bi-, here bī 'me'); 'you betrayed' (in the conditional 'if you betray')
وَضَرْبِ: وَ + ضَرْب + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḍarb, striking (m. verbal noun; gen., coordinated; ḍaraba mathalan 'tell a parable'); 'and telling'
فَضْلًا: فَضْل + ًا — faḍl, surplus (m.; acc. indef., adverbial, faḍlan ʿan 'let alone, not to mention'; ʿan chosen by the phrase); 'let alone'
الصَّدِيقِ: الـ + صَّدِيق + ِ — al-, the + ṣadīq, friend (m.; gen. after ʿan in faḍlan ʿan); 'a friend'
أَتَخَلَّصُ: أَتَخَلَّصُ — atakhallaṣu, to get free (V, imperf. 1st s., indic.; relative clause on ḥīla, 'by which'); 'I can get free'
غِيَاثِي: غِيَاث + ِي — ghiyāth, succour, rescue (m.; acc., predicate of kun) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'my rescue'
يَتَحَمَّلُ: يَتَحَمَّلُ — yataḥammalu, to bear, endure (V, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.); 'bears'
لِصَدِيقِهِ: لِـ + صَدِيق + ِ + هِ — li-, for (prep., 'for the sake of') + ṣadīq, friend (m.; gen. after li-) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'for his friend'
وَيُخَاطِرُ: وَ + يُخَاطِرُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yukhāṭiru, to risk (III, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; khāṭara bi-nafsihi 'stake his life', the verb chooses bi-); 'and risks'
نَجَاتُهُ: نَجَاة + ُ + هُ — najāt, rescue, deliverance (f.; nom., subject in fīhi najātuhu) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his rescue'
الصَّدِيقَ: الـ + صَّدِيق + َ — al-, the + ṣadīq, friend (m.; acc., noun of inna); 'the friend'
الشَّفِيقَ: الـ + شَّفِيق + َ — al-, the + shafīq, tender, solicitous (adj.; acc., adj. of al-ṣadīq); 'loving'
الْأَخِ: الـ + أَخ + ِ — al-, the + akh, brother (m.; gen. after min of comparison, khayr min); 'a brother'
تَسَبَّبْتَ: تَسَبَّبْتَ — tasabbabta, to contrive (V, perf. 2nd m.s.; tasabbaba fī 'find a way to'; perf. after in, 'if'); 'if you find a way'
وَنَجَوْتُ: وَ + نَجَوْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + najawtu, to escape (I, perf. 1st s., defective); 'and I escape'
لَأَجْمَعَنَّ: لَـ + أَجْمَعَنَّ — la-, surely (oath particle) + ajmaʿanna, to gather (I, imperf. 1st s. with energetic -anna); 'I will surely gather'
الْآلَةِ: الـ + آلَة + ِ — al-, the + āla, gear, equipment (f.; gen. after min, partitive; madda printed); 'of the gear'
عَلِّمَنَّكَ: عَلِّمَنَّ + كَ — ʿallimanna, to teach (II, imperf. 1st s. with energetic -anna; the print splits la-u from the rest, la-uʿallimanna) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I will teach you'
مَاتَفْتَحُ: مَا + تَفْتَحُ — mā, what, such as (relative) + taftaḥu, to open (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; with bihi 'by which'); 'by which you will open'
الْكُرُومَ: الـ + كُرُوم + َ — al-, the + kurūm, vineyards (pl. of karm; acc., object of taftaḥu); 'the vineyards'
الْخَصِبَةَ: الـ + خَصِبَة + َ — al-, the + khaṣiba, fertile, rich (f. sing. adj.; acc., adj. of al-kurūm, a non-human plural taking the feminine); 'the rich'
وَتَجْنِى: وَ + تَجْنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tajnī, to gather fruit (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., defective, indic.; printed with alif maqṣūra); 'and pick'
الْأَشْجَارَ: الـ + أَشْجَار + َ — al-, the + ashjār, trees (pl. of shajar; acc., object of tajnī); 'the trees'
الْمُثْمِرَةَ: الـ + مُثْمِرَة + َ — al-, the + muthmira, fruit-bearing (act. part. IV; f.; acc., adj. of al-ashjār); 'fruit-laden'
الْجُثَّةِ: الـ + جُثَّة + ِ — al-, the + juththa, body, bulk (f.; gen., in the improper annexation al-ghalīẓ al-juththa); 'of body'
الْمَشَقَّةَ: الـ + مَشَقَّة + َ — al-, the + mashaqqa, hardship (f.; acc., object of yataḥammalu); 'the hardship'
تَخْلِيصِ: تَخْلِيص + ِ — takhlīṣ, rescuing (II verbal noun; gen. after fī, governing ṣadīqihi); 'rescuing'
صَدِيقِهِ: صَدِيق + ِ + هِ — ṣadīq, friend (m.; gen., object of takhlīṣ) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'his friend'
عَرِّفْنِي: عَرِّفْ + نِي — ʿarrif, to tell, inform (II, imperative 2nd m.s.; the wolf must tell the fox) + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix with nūn al-wiqāya); 'tell me'
بِجَهْلِكَ: بِـ + جَهْل + ِ + كَ — bi-, in, with (prep., 'in your ignorance', of accompanying state) + jahl, ignorance (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'in your ignorance'
أُصَادِقُكَ: أُصَادِقُ + كَ — uṣādiqu, to befriend (III, imperf. 1st s., indic.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I befriend you'
خِيَانَتِكَ: خِيَانَة + ِ + كَ — khiyāna, treachery (f.; gen. after maʿa) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'your treachery'
أَحَسِبْتَنِي: أَ + حَسِبْتَ + نِي — a-, (question prefix) + ḥasibta, to reckon (I, perf. 2nd m.s., two objects) + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix, first object); 'did you take me'
عَدُوٌّ: عَدُوّ + ٌ — ʿaduww, enemy (m.; nom. indef., predicate of anā); 'an enemy'
شَامِتٌ: شَامِت + ٌ — shāmit, gloating (act. part. I of shamita; nom. indef., adj. of ʿaduww); 'who gloats' Also as a predicate, with bi- marking the one gloated over: man huwa shāmitun bihi, 'one who gloated over him'.
وَرَشْقِ: وَ + رَشْق + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + rashq, shooting (m. verbal noun; gen., coordinated after al-qatl, annexed to al-sihām); 'and the shooting'
السِّهَامِ: الـ + سِّهَام + ِ — al-, the + sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm; gen., second term of the annexation); 'of arrows'
وَتُعَلِّمُنِي: وَ + تُعَلِّمُ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tuʿallimu, to teach (II, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.) + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix); 'and teach me'
الْكُرُومِ: الـ + كُرُوم + ِ — al-, the + kurūm, vineyards (pl. of karm; gen. after ilā, waṣala ilā 'reach'); 'the vineyards'
الْمُخْصِبَةِ: الـ + مُخْصِبَة + ِ — al-, the + mukhṣiba, fertile (act. part. IV, f.; gen., adj. of al-kurūm); 'rich'
وَأَجْتَنِي: وَ + أَجْتَنِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ajtanī, to gather fruit (VIII, imperf. 1st s., defective, indic.); 'and gather'
فَمَالَكَ: فَ + مَا + لَ + كَ — fa-, then (conj.) + mā, what (interrogative) + la-, for, to (prep., 'what is there for you') + -ka, you (gen. suffix); 'then what ails you'
الْمُخَادِعُ: الـ + مُخَادِع + ُ — al-, the + mukhādiʿ, deceiver (act. part. III of khādaʿa; nom., vocative after ayyuhā); 'you cheat'
تَتَخَلَّصُ: تَتَخَلَّصُ — tatakhallaṣu, to get free (V, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; relative clause on ḥīlatan, 'by which'); 'you might save yourself'
أَبْعَدَكَ: أَبْعَدَ + كَ — abʿada, to be far (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., the wonder verb after mā, 'how far') + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'how far you are'
الْمَنْفَعَةِ: الـ + مَنْفَعَة + ِ — al-, the + manfaʿa, benefit (f.; gen. after min; abʿad min 'far from'); 'any good'
أَبْعَدَنِي: أَبْعَدَ + نِي — abʿada, to be far (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., wonder verb after mā, 'how far') + -nī, me (1st s. acc. suffix with nūn al-wiqāya); 'how far am I'
لِنَصِيحَتِكَ: لِـ + نَصِيحَة + ِ + كَ — li-, for (prep., marking the thing accepted, al-qabūl li- 'accepting') + naṣīḥa, advice (f.; gen. after li-) + -ka, your (gen. suffix); 'of your advice'
فَتَحَيَّلْ: فَ + تَحَيَّلْ — fa-, then (conj.) + taḥayyal, to use a stratagem (V, imperative 2nd m.s.); 'then use a trick'
يُبْعِدَ: يُبْعِدَ — yubʿida, to put far (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive after an; subject Allāh); 'that He keep far'
فَخَلِّصْ: فَ + خَلِّصْ — fa-, then (conj.) + khalliṣ, to save (II, imperative 2nd m.s.); 'then save'
تَبْذُلَ: تَبْذُلَ — tabdhula, to give freely (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after qabla an); 'you offer'
التَّعْلِيمَ: الـ + تَّعْلِيم + َ — al-, the + taʿlīm, teaching (II verbal noun; acc., object of tabdhula); 'lessons'
لِغَيْرِكَ: لِـ + غَيْر + ِ + كَ — li-, to, for (prep.; badhala li- 'offer to') + ghayr, other than (gen. after li-) + -ka, you (gen. suffix); 'to anyone but yourself'; also li- of belonging in a nominal clause: li-ghayrika sāquhā, 'her leg is another's'
نَابَهُ: نَابَ + هُ — nāba, to befall (I, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'befell him'
مَرَضٌ: مَرَض + ٌ — maraḍ, illness (m.; nom. indef., subject of nābahu); 'an illness'
لِيُدَاوِيَهُ: لِـ + يُدَاوِيَ + هُ — li-, in order to (li- of purpose, takes the subjunctive) + yudāwiya, to treat, cure (III, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive, defective) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'to cure him'
أُدَاوِيَكَ: أُدَاوِيَ + كَ — udāwiya, to treat (III, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an in hal laka an) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'that I treat you'
لَابَدَأْتَ: لَا + بَدَأْتَ — lā, not (the print runs hal lā together, 'why not', a reproach with a past verb) + bada'ta, to begin (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; badaʾa bi- 'begin with'); 'why did you not begin'
بِالْمُدَاوَاةِ: بِـ + الـ + مُدَاوَاة + ِ — bi-, with, in (prep., chosen by badaʾa bi- 'begin with', here 'in the matter of') + al-, the + mudāwāt, treating (III verbal noun; gen.); 'with the treating'
فَالْزَمْ: فَ + الْزَمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ilzam, to stay fixed in (I, imperative 2nd m.s.); 'so stay'
الْكُرْبَةِ: الـ + كُرْبَة + ِ — al-, the + kurba, distress (f.; gen. after min); 'distress'
لَأَنُوبَنَّ: لَـ + أَنُوبَنَّ — la-, surely (oath particle) + anūbanna, to repent (I, imperf. 1st s., hollow, with energetic -anna; takes min 'of'); 'I will surely repent'
تَجَبُّرِي: تَجَبُّر + ِي — tajabbur, tyranny (V verbal noun; gen. after min) + -ī, my (gen. suffix); 'my tyranny'
أَضْعَفُ: أَضْعَفُ — aḍʿaf, weaker (elative of ḍaʿīf; nom., predicate of huwa; diptote, followed by min); 'weaker'
وَلَأَلْبَسَنَّ: وَ + لَـ + أَلْبَسَنَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-, surely (oath particle) + albasanna, to put on (I, imperf. 1st s., with energetic -anna); 'and I will surely put on'
الصُّوفَ: الـ + صُّوف + َ — al-, the + ṣūf, wool (m.; acc., object of albasanna), the ascetic's dress; 'wool'
صْعَدَنَّ: صْعَدَنَّ — ṣʿadanna, the second half of the print's split wa-la-aṣʿadanna: aṣʿadu, to go up (I, imperf. 1st s., with energetic -anna; takes ʿalā); 'I will surely go up'
ذَاكِرًا: ذَاكِر + ًا — dhākir, remembering (act. part. I of dhakara; acc. indef., ḥāl; dhākiran li-llāhi); 'calling to mind'
عِقَابِهِ: عِقَاب + ِ + هِ — ʿiqāb, punishment (m.; gen. after min; khāʾif min 'fearing') + -hi, His (gen. suffix); 'His punishment'
وَأَعْتَزِلُ: وَ + أَعْتَزِلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿtazilu, to withdraw from (VIII, imperf. 1st s., indic.; plain future, no oath-ending); 'and I will withdraw from'
وَلَأُ: وَ + لَـ + أُ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-, surely (oath particle) + u-, I (1st s. imperf. prefix); the first half of the print's split wa-la-uṭʿimanna, completed by the next word; 'and I will surely ...'
طْعِمَنَّ: طْعِمَنَّ — ṭʿimanna, the second half of the print's split verb: aṭʿimu, to feed (IV, imperf. 1st s., with energetic -anna; acc. of the fed); 'feed'
وَالْفُقَرَاءَ: وَ + الـ + فُقَرَاء + َ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + fuqarāʾ, the poor (pl. of faqīr; acc., coordinated with al-mujāhidīn); 'and the poor'
وَكَائِهِ: وَ + كَائِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + kāʾi- + -hi: the print makes no word of this; probably wa-ka-annahu, with ka-, as if (prep. particle) + annahu, 'that he'; letters and pointing kept as printed; 'and (it was) as though'
تَضَرُّعَهُ: تَضَرُّع + َ + هُ — taḍarruʿ, pleading, humble entreaty (V verbal noun; acc., object of samiʿa) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his pleading'
تَوْبَتِهِ: تَوْبَة + ِ + هِ — tawba, repentance (f.; gen. after ʿalā; yadullu ʿalā 'point to') + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'his repentance'
الْعُتُوِّ: الـ + عُتُوّ + ِ — al-, the + ʿutuww, insolence, haughty rebellion (m.; gen. after min; tawba min 'repentance from'); 'insolence'
شَفِيرِ: شَفِير + ِ — shafīr, edge, brink (m.; gen. after ʿalā, annexed to al-ḥufra); 'the brink of'
وَأَدْلَى: وَ + أَدْلَى — wa-, and (conj.) + adlā, to let down (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective); 'and let down'
ذَنَبَهُ: ذَنَب + َ + هُ — dhanab, tail (m.; acc., object of adlā) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his tail'
ذَنَبِ: ذَنَب + ِ — dhanab, tail (m.; gen., annexed to al-thaʿlab after ilā; same letters as dhanb 'sin'); 'the tail of'
وَجَذَبَهُ: وَ + جَذَبَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jadhaba, to pull (I, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hu, it (the tail, acc. suffix); 'and pulled it'; here: -hu, him: 'and pulled him'
تَشْمَتُ: تَشْمَتُ — tashmatu, to gloat (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; shamita bi- 'gloat at', the verb chooses bi-, here bī 'me'); 'you gloat'
وَتَعَجَّلَتْ: وَ + تَعَجَّلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʿajjalat, to come quickly (V, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject al-ʿuqūba); 'and has come quickly'
عَايَرَ: عَايَرَ — ʿāyara, to taunt (III, perf. 3rd m.s.; ʿāyara bi- 'taunt with', the verb chooses bi-); 'taunted'
بِرَضَاعِ: بِـ + رَضَاع + ِ — bi-, with (prep., chosen by ʿāyara bi- 'taunt with') + raḍāʿ, suckling (m. verbal noun; gen. after bi-, annexed to kalba); 'with the suckling of'
كَلْبَةٍ: كَلْبَة + ٍ — kalba, bitch (f.; gen. indef., second term of the annexation); 'a bitch'
لَارْتَضَعَهَا: لَ + ارْتَضَعَ + هَا — la-, (apodosis particle after law, 'would') + irtaḍaʿa, to suckle from (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.; the result of law) + -hā, her (the bitch, acc. suffix); 'he would suckle from her'
جَرَّ: جَرَّ — jarra, to drag (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; subject ad-dahr, takes ʿalā); 'drags (over)'
اُنَاسٍ: اُنَاسٍ — unās, people (collective; gen. indef. after ʿalā; print writes initial alif without hamza); 'a people'
كَلَاكِلُهُ: كَلَاكِل + ُ + هُ — kalākil, breasts, chests (of a camel; broken pl. of kalkal; nom. as the print points, subject/in apposition of the dahr) + -hu, its (the Time's, gen. suffix); 'its breast'
بِاَخَرِيْنَا: بِ + آخَرِين + َا — bi-, upon (prep.; with anākha 'kneel upon') + ākharīn, others (masc. pl. gen. of ākhar; print omits madda); 'upon others'
للشَّامِتِيْنَ: لِ + الشَّامِتِين — li-, to, for (prep., marks the person addressed after qul 'say to') + al-, the + shāmitīn, gloaters (act. part. I of shamita, masc. pl. gen.); 'to the gloaters'
اَفِيْقُوْا: اَفِيقُوا — afīqū, to wake up, come to your senses (IV, imperative 2nd m.pl.); 'wake up!'
سَيَلْقَى: سَ + يَلْقَى — sa-, will (future particle) + yalqā, to meet, undergo (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic., defective); 'will meet'
الشَّامِتُوْنَ: اَل + شَّامِتُون — al-, the + shāmitūn, gloaters (act. part. I of shamita; masc. pl. nom., subject of yalqā); 'the gloaters'
لَقِيْنَا: لَقِينَا — laqīnā, to meet, undergo (I, perf. 1st pl., defective); 'we met (suffered)'
جَمْعٍ: جَمْع — jamʿ, company, gathering (m.; gen. indef. after fī); 'in company'
فَلَأُ: فَ + لَ + أُ — fa-, so (conj.) + la-, indeed (oath-lām of the emphatic verb) + u-, I (1st s. prefix of ʿajjilanna; printed split off from the verb as a separate word); 'so I will surely'
عَجِّلَنَّ: عَجِّلَنَّ — ʿajjilanna, to hasten, do quickly (II, imperf. 1st s., with emphatic nūn; object qatlaka, 'your killing'; the u- of fa-la-u- is printed apart); 'hasten'
آهٍ: آهٍ — āhin, ah! (interjection of pain, with tanwīn); 'alas'
تَصُوغُ: تَصُوغُ — taṣūghu, to fashion jewellery (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; subject al-marʾa); 'has made'
حُلِيَّهَا: حُلِيّ + هَا — ḥuliyy, jewels, ornaments (broken pl. of ḥaly; acc., object of taṣūghu) + -hā, her (gen. suffix); 'her jewels'
لِيَوْمِ: لِ + يَوْم — li-, for (prep., 'for the sake of, in readiness for') + yawm, day (m.; gen., first term of the iḍāfa yawm al-zīna); 'for the day (of)'
ادَّخَرْتُكِ: ادَّخَرْتُ + كِ — iddakhartu, to lay by, store up (VIII, perf. 1st s.; assimilated dāl) + -ki, you (f., the tear, acc. suffix); 'I kept you back'
دَمْعَتِي: دَمْعَة + ِ + ي — damʿa, tear (f.; vocative after yā, 'O my tear') + -ī, my (1st s. suffix); 'my tear'
أَتَحَيَّلْ: أَتَحَيَّلْ — ataḥayyal, to use stratagem (V, imperf. 1st s., jussive after lam; takes fī); 'I find no trick'
عِشْ: عِشْ — ʿish, to live (I, imperative 2nd m.s., hollow; apocopated); 'live!'
بِالْخِدَاعِ: بِ + الْ + خِدَاع — bi-, by means of (prep., instrumental) + al-, the + khidāʿ, deceit (m.; gen. after bi-); 'by deceit'
بَنُوْهُ: بَنُو + هُ — banū, sons, children (one of the sound masc. pl. forms; nom., subject of the clause) + -hu, its (the age's, suffix); 'its people'
كَاُسْدِ: كَ + أُسْد — ka-, like (prep., comparison) + usd, lions (broken pl. of asad; gen. after ka-); 'like lions (of)'
بِيْشَهْ: بِيشَة — Bīsha, a valley in Arabia famed for its lions (proper name, gen. second term of the iḍāfa); print ends with pausal hāʾ for the rhyme; 'of Bīsha'
وَاَدِرْ: وَ + أَدِرْ — wa-, and (conj.) + adir, to turn round (IV, imperative 2nd m.s., from dāra); 'and turn'
قَنَاةَ: قَنَاة — qanāt, spear-shaft, lance (f.; acc., object of adir, first term of qanāt al-makr); 'the spear (of)'
تَسْتَدِيْرُ: تَسْتَدِيرُ — tastadīru, to turn round (X, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; subject raḥā); 'turns'
رَحَى: رَحَى — raḥā, millstone, mill (f., dual/sing. defective; nom., subject of tastadīru); 'the mill (of)'
الْمَعِيْشَهْ: اَل + مَعِيشَة — al-, the + maʿīsha, livelihood, living (f.; gen., second term of raḥā al-maʿīsha; print has pausal hāʾ); 'living'
وَاجْنِ: وَ + اجْنِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ijni, to pluck, pick (I, imperative 2nd m.s., defective); 'and pluck'
الثِّمَارَ: اَل + ثِّمَار + َ — al-, the + thimār, fruit (broken pl. of thamar; acc., object of ijni); 'the fruit'
تَفُتْـ: تَفُتْ + ـكَ — tafut-, to escape, slip away from (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., jussive after in; the verb is split across the hemistichs, its subject the fruit); with the suffix on the next line, 'if it slips (from you)'
ـكَ: ـكَ — -ka, you (m.s. suffix, acc., object of tafut-; begins the second hemistich); 'you'
فَرِّضْ: فَ + رِّضْ — fa-, then (conj., apodosis) + farriḍ, as printed from II farraḍa 'apportion' (imperative 2nd m.s.); doubtful, probably meant fa-raḍḍi (be content); 'then content (yourself)'
بِالْحَشِيْشَهْ: بِ + الْ + حَشِيشَة — bi-, with (prep., 'content yourself with', the verb choosing the preposition) + al-, the + ḥashīsha, grass, herbage (f.; gen.; print has pausal hāʾ); 'with grass'
لِلذِّئْبِ: لِ + الذِّئْب — li-, to (prep., marks the person addressed after qāla 'said to') + al-, the + dhiʾb, wolf (m.; gen.); 'to the wolf'
فَتَنَدَّمَ: فَ + تَنَدَّمَ — fa-, lest, and so (conj., subjunctive after fa- in answer to a prohibition) + tanaddama, to regret (V, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive; one tāʾ dropped for tatanaddama); 'lest you regret'
وَالْبَأْسِ: وَ + الْ + بَأْس — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + baʾs, valour, might (m.; gen., coordinated after al-quwwa); 'and valour'
تَمَهَّلْتَ: تَمَهَّلْتَ — tamahhalta, to take one's time (V, perf. 2nd m.s.; in the conditional in, 'if you take your time'); 'you take your time'
وَأَمْعَنْتَ: وَ + أَمْعَنْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + amʿanta, to go deeply into (IV, perf. 2nd m.s.; amʿana al-naẓar fī 'look closely into'); 'and weigh carefully'
قَصَدْتُهُ: قَصَدْتُ + هُ — qaṣadtu, to intend, aim at (I, perf. 1st s.) + -hu, it (returns to alladhī, acc. suffix); 'that I intended'
عَجِلْتَ: عَجِلْتَ — ʿajilta, to be hasty (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; in the conditional in; takes bi- 'be quick to'); 'you are hasty'
الْخَادِعُ: اَل + خَادِع — al-, the + khādiʿ, deceiver (act. part. I of khadaʿa; nom. in vocative apposition after ayyuhā); 'you deceiver'
تَرْجُوهُ: تَرْجُو + هُ — tarjū, to hope for (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., defective) + -hu, it (returns to alladhī, acc. suffix); 'that you hope for'
وَسَلَامَتِكَ: وَ + سَلَامَة + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + salāma, safety (f.; gen., coordinated after min salāmatī) + -ka, your (m.s. gen. suffix); 'and your safety'
تَسْأَلَنِي: تَسْأَل + َ + نِي — tasʾalu, to ask (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after ḥattā) + -nī, me (acc. suffix, first object); 'you ask me'
التَّمَهُّلَ: اَل + تَّمَهُّل + َ — al-, the + tamahhul, going slowly, patience (V verbal noun; acc., second object of tasʾalanī; takes ʿalā 'with you'); 'to go easy'
فَأَعْلِمْنِي: فَ + أَعْلِمْ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + aʿlim, to inform (IV, imperative 2nd m.s.) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'so inform me'
بِقَصْدِكَ: بِ + قَصْد + ِ + كَ — bi-, of, about (prep., after aʿlim/akhbir 'inform of') + qaṣd, purpose (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (suffix); 'of your purpose'
قَصَدْتَهُ: قَصَدْتَ + هُ — qaṣadta, to intend (I, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -hu, it (returns to alladhī); 'that you intended'
تُحْسِنَ: تُحْسِنَ — tuḥsina, to do well, make fine (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after an; aḥsana ʿalā 'do well by'); 'you make (a fine reward)'
مُجَازَاتِي: مُجَازَات + ِ + ي — mujāzāt, requital, reward (III verbal noun, f.; acc., object of tuḥsina, 'fine requital') + -ī, my (suffix, the fox's; here 'to me'); 'my reward'
وَعَدْتَ: وَعَدْتَ — waʿadta, to promise (I, perf. 2nd m.s., assimilated; min nafsika 'from yourself', relative mā); 'you promised'
وَاعْتِرَافَكَ: وَ + اعْتِرَاف + َ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + iʿtirāf, confession (VIII verbal noun; acc., coordinated as an object of samiʿtu; takes bi-) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your confessing'
وَتَلَهُّفَكَ: وَ + تَلَهُّف + َ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + talahhuf, lamenting, regret (V verbal noun; acc., coordinated; takes ʿalā) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your lamenting'
مَافَاتَكَ: مَا + فَاتَ + كَ — mā, what (rel.) + fāta, to escape, slip from (I, perf. 3rd m.s., hollow) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); printed run together; 'what you have lost'
وَفِعْلِ: وَ + فِعْل — wa-, and (conj.) + fiʿl, doing (m.; gen., coordinated after al-quwwa, first term of fiʿl al-khayr); 'and doing (good)'
نَذَرْتَهُ: نَذَرْتَ + هُ — nadharta, to vow (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; takes ʿalā nafsika 'on yourself') + -hu, it (returns to mā, acc. suffix); 'you vowed'
نَجَوْتَ: نَجَوْتَ — najawta, to escape (I, perf. 2nd m.s., defective; in the conditional in, 'if you escape'); 'you escape'
الْأَذَى: اَل + أَذَى — al-, the + adhā, harm (m.; gen., object of kaff 'holding back'); 'harm'
وَتَرْكِكَ: وَ + تَرْك + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tark, leaving, giving up (m.; gen., coordinated among the vows, after min) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your giving up'
أَكْلَ: أَكْل — akl, eating (m., I verbal noun; acc., object of tark, first term of akl al-ʿinab); 'eating (of)'
الْعِنَبِ: اَل + عِنَب — al-, the + ʿinab, grapes (collective, m.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'grapes'
وَلُزُومِكَ: وَ + لُزُوم + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + luzūm, clinging to, keeping to (m.; gen., coordinated among the vows) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your keeping to'
وَتَقْلِيمِ: وَ + تَقْلِيم — wa-, and (conj.) + taqlīm, paring, clipping (II verbal noun; gen., coordinated, first term of taqlīm aẓfārika); 'and paring (of)'
أَظْفَارِكَ: أَظْفَار + ِ + كَ — aẓfār, claws, nails (broken pl. of ẓufr; gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your claws'
وَتَكْسِيرِ: وَ + تَكْسِير — wa-, and (conj.) + taksīr, breaking (II verbal noun; gen., coordinated, first term of taksīr anyābika); 'and breaking (of)'
أَنْيَابِكَ: أَنْيَاب + ِ + كَ — anyāb, fangs (broken pl. of nāb; gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your fangs'
وَلُبْسِ: وَ + لُبْس — wa-, and (conj.) + lubs, wearing, putting on (m.; gen., coordinated, first term of lubs al-ṣūf); 'and wearing (of)'
وَتَقْرِيبِكَ: وَ + تَقْرِيب + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taqrīb, offering, bringing near (II verbal noun; gen., coordinated) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your offering'
الْقُرْبَانَ: اَل + قُرْبَان + َ — al-, the + qurbān, sacrifice, offering (m.; acc., object of taqrīb); 'the sacrifice'
الْقَوْلِ: اَل + قَوْل — al-, the + qawl, speech, word (m.; gen., second term of khayr al-qawl); 'of words'
أَصْدَقُهُ: أَصْدَق + ُ + هُ — aṣdaq, most truthful (elative of ṣādiq; nom., predicate of inna) + -hu, its (refers to al-qawl, gen. suffix); 'the truest of them'
حَرِيصًا: حَرِيصًا — ḥarīṣ, eager, bent on (adj.; acc. indef., predicate of kuntu; takes ʿalā 'eager for'); 'eager'
تَوْبَتَكَ: تَوْبَة + َ + كَ — tawba, repentance (f.; acc., object of samiʿtu) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your repentance'
لَزِمَنِي: لَزِمَ + نِي — lazima, to be incumbent on (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject al-khalāṣ) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'it was binding on me'
فَأَدْلَيْتُ: فَ + أَدْلَيْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + adlaytu, to let down (IV, perf. 1st s., defective; takes ilayka 'to you'); 'so I let down'
لِكَيْمَا: لِكَيْمَا — li-kaymā, in order that (li- + kay + mā, a strengthened kay; governs the subjunctive); 'so that'
تَتَعَلَّقَ: تَتَعَلَّقَ — tataʿallaqa, to hold on to, hang from (V, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after li-kaymā; takes bi- 'catch hold of'); 'you might catch hold'
وَتَنْجُوَ: وَ + تَنْجُوَ — wa-, and (conj.) + tanjuwa, to escape, be saved (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after li-kaymā, defective); 'and be saved'
الْعُنْفِ: اَل + عُنْف — al-, the + ʿunf, violence, roughness (m.; gen. after min); 'violence'
تَلْتَمِسِ: تَلْتَمِسِ — taltamisi, to seek (VIII, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lam, kasra before al-); 'did not seek'
النَّجَاةَ: اَل + نَّجَاة + َ — al-, the + najāt, escape, deliverance (f.; acc., object of taltamisi); 'escape'; here object of turīdu: turīdu lahu al-najāta, 'you want his escape'
وَالسَّلَامَةَ: وَ + اَل + سَّلَامَة + َ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + salāma, safety (f.; acc., coordinated); 'and safety'
جَذَبْتَنِي: جَذَبْتَ + نِي — jadhabta, to pull (I, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'you pulled me'
جَذْبَةً: جَذْبَةً — jadhba, a single pull (f.; acc. indef., cognate accusative of jadhabta, nomen unitatis); 'a yank'
وَالْمَوْتِ: وَ + اَل + مَوْت — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + mawt, death (m.; gen., coordinated after al-halāk); 'and death'
يُنْجِينِي: يُنْجِي + نِي — yunjī, to save (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic., defective; subject mā...illā shayʾun) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'saves me'
قَبِلْتَهُ: قَبِلْتَ + هُ — qabilta, to accept (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; in the conditional in) + -hu, it (the one thing, acc. suffix); 'you accept it'
خَلَصْتُ: خَلَصْتُ — khalaṣtu, to get free (I, perf. 1st s.; apodosis of in, read as future); 'I shall go free'
تَفِيَ: تَفِيَ — tafiya, to keep, fulfil (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after an, defective; wafā bi- takes the thing kept with bi-); 'that you fulfil'
بِمَانَذَرْتَهُ: بِ + مَا + نَذَرْتَ + هُ — bi-, (prep., the verb tafiya takes bi- for what is kept) + mā, that which + nadhartahu, you vowed it (perf. 2nd m.s. + -hu); printed run together; 'what you vowed'
رَفِيقَكَ: رَفِيق + َ + كَ — rafīq, companion (m.; acc., predicate of akūna) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your companion'
أَقْبَلُهُ: أَقْبَل + ُ + هُ — aqbalu, to accept (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.) + -hu, it (returns to alladhī, acc. suffix); 'that I accept'
تَنْهَضُ: تَنْهَضُ — tanhaḍu, to rise (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic. used as a gentle instruction); 'you stand up'
اَعْلُو: أَعْلُو — aʿlū, to climb up, rise above (I, imperf. 1st s., indic., defective; print writes the alif without hamza); 'I climb'
أُسَاوِيَ: أُسَاوِيَ — usāwiya, to be level with (III, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after ḥattā, defective); 'until I am level with'
فَأَهْمِزَ: فَ + أَهْمِزَ — fa-, then (conj., sequence) + ahmiza, to spring, push off (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after ḥattā continued); 'then I spring'
فَأَصِيرَ: فَ + أَصِيرَ — fa-, so (conj.) + aṣīra, to become, end up (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive; hollow, 'be up on it'); 'and be'
تَتَعَلَّقُ: تَتَعَلَّقُ — tataʿallaqu, to hold on to (V, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; takes bi- 'hold on to it', in the relative clause); 'you hold'
وَتَخْلُصُ: وَ + تَخْلُصُ — wa-, and (conj.) + takhluṣu, to get free (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; subject anta); 'and you get free'
بِقَوْلِكَ: بِ + قَوْل + ِ + كَ — bi-, in (prep., object of wathiqa 'trust in', the verb choosing bi-) + qawl, word (m.; gen.) + -ka, your (suffix); 'in your word'
وَاثِقًا: وَاثِقًا — wāthiq, trusting (act. part. I of wathiqa; acc. indef., predicate of lastu, which bi- governs); 'trusting'
اسْتَعْمَلَ: اسْتَعْمَلَ — istaʿmala, to employ, make use of (X, perf. 3rd m.s.; man istaʿmala 'whoever puts'); 'puts to use'
الْحِقْدِ: اَل + حِقْد — al-, the + ḥiqd, rancour, enmity (m.; gen., second term after mawḍiʿ); 'enmity'
مُخْطِئًا: مُخْطِئًا — mukhṭiʾ, mistaken, in error (act. part. IV of akhṭaʾa; acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'in error'
وَثِقَ: وَثِقَ — wathiqa, to trust (I, perf. 3rd m.s., assimilated; takes bi- for what is trusted, 'trusts in'); 'trusts'
جَرَّبَ: جَرَّبَ — jarraba, to test, try (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; man jarraba 'whoever tests'); 'tests'
الْمُجَرَّبَ: اَل + مُجَرَّب — al-, the + mujarrab, the tested (pass. part. II; acc., object of jarraba); 'what has been tested'
أَيَّامُهُ: أَيَّام + ُ + هُ — ayyām, days (broken pl. of yawm; nom., subject of dhahabat) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his days'
ضَيَاعًا: ضَيَاعًا — ḍayāʿ, loss, waste (m.; acc. indef., ḥāl/manner); 'to waste'
يُفَرِّقْ: يُفَرِّقْ — yufarriq, to distinguish (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam; takes bayna); 'does not distinguish'
فَيُعْطِيَ: فَ + يُعْطِيَ — fa-, so as to (conj., subjunctive after fa- following a negative) + yuʿṭiya, to give (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., subjunctive, defective); 'and give'
حَظَّهَا: حَظّ + َ + هَا — ḥaẓẓ, due share (m.; acc., second object of yuʿṭiya) + -hā, its (the case's, gen. suffix); 'its due'
حَظُّهُ: حَظّ + ُ + هُ — ḥaẓẓ, luck, share (m.; nom., subject of qalla) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his luck'
وَكَثُرَتْ: وَ + كَثُرَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + kathurat, to be many (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject maṣāʾibuhu, broken plural); 'and are many'
مَصَائِبُهُ: مَصَائِب + ُ + هُ — maṣāʾib, misfortunes (broken pl. of muṣība; nom., subject of kathurat) + -hu, his (gen. suffix); 'his misfortunes'
ظَنُّكَ: ظَنّ + ُ + كَ — ẓann, thought, opinion (m.; nom., subject of yakun) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your opinion'
سَيِّأً: سَيِّأً — sayyiʾ, bad, evil (adj.; acc. indef., predicate of yakun, after illā; print puts hamza on alif for sayyiʾan); 'bad'
سُوْءَ: سُوءَ — sūʾ, badness, evil (m.; first term of sūʾ al-ẓann, in acc. after ilzam in the second poem, nom. here after inna); 'ill'
الظَّنّ: اَل + ظَّنّ — al-, the + ẓann, thinking, opinion (m.; gen., second term of sūʾ al-ẓann); 'of thinking'
اَقْوَى: اَقْوَى — aqwā, strongest, surest (elative of qawī; gen. after min, 'one of the strongest'); 'the surest'
الْفِطَنْ: اَل + فِطَنْ — al-, the + fiṭan, shrewdness, wits (broken pl. of fiṭna; gen. after aqwā; print has sukūn for the rhyme); 'kinds of wit'
مَارُمِي: مَا + رُمِيَ — mā, not (negative) + rumiya, to be thrown (I, perf. 3rd m.s., passive, defective; subject al-insān); printed run together; 'has never been cast'
مَهْلِكَةٍ: مَهْلِكَة — mahlika, place of perdition (f.; gen. indef. after fī); 'into peril'
مِثْل: مِثْل — mithl, like (m.; acc., in the manner of; first term of mithla fiʿl al-khayr); 'like'
وَالظَّنِّ: وَ + اَل + ظَّنّ + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ẓann, thinking (m.; gen., coordinated after fiʿl al-khayr, qualified by al-ḥasan); 'and thinking'
الْحَسَنْ: اَل + حَسَنْ — al-, the + ḥasan, good (adj. m.; gen., describes al-ẓann; print has sukūn for the rhyme); 'well'
اِلْزَمْ: اِلْزَمْ — ilzam, to cling to (I, imperative 2nd m.s.; takes two accusatives); 'hold to'
يَقِينَكَ: يَقِين + َ + كَ — yaqīn, certainty (m.; acc.) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your certainty'
مُسْتَيْقِظاً: مُسْتَيْقِظاً — mustayqiẓ, awake, alert (act. part. X of istayqaẓa; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'wide awake'
قَلَّتْ: قَلَّتْ — qallat, to be few (I, perf. 3rd f.s., geminate; subject maṣāʾibuhu); 'are few'
وَالْقِ: وَ + الْقِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ilqi, to meet, throw toward (I, imperative 2nd m.s., defective; print omits hamza); 'and meet'
طَلِقٍ: طَلِقٍ — ṭaliq, cheerful, open (adj.; gen., describes wajhin); 'open'
وَانْصِبْ: وَ + انْصِبْ — wa-, and (conj.) + inṣib, to set up, raise (I, imperative 2nd m.s.; takes lahu 'against him'); 'and set up'
جَيْشاً: جَيْشاً — jaysh, army (m.; acc. indef., object of inṣib); 'an army'
يُحَارِبُهُ: يُحَارِبُ + هُ — yuḥāribu, to fight (III, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; describes jayshan) + -hu, him (the enemy, acc. suffix); 'to fight him'
اَعْدَى: أَعْدَى — aʿdā, most hostile (elative of ʿaduww; nom., subject, first term of aʿdā ʿaduwwika); 'the worst'
اَدْنَى: أَدْنَى — adnā, nearest (elative of dānī; nom., predicate, first term of adnā man); 'is the nearest'
وَثِقْتَ: وَثِقْتَ — wathiqta, to trust (I, perf. 2nd m.s., assimilated; takes bi-, bihi 'trust in him'); 'you trust'
فَحَاذِرِ: فَ + حَاذِرِ — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥādhiri, to be wary of (III, imperative 2nd m.s., kasra before al-); 'so beware'
وَاصْحَبْهُمْ: وَ + اصْحَبْ + هُمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iṣḥab, to keep company with (I, imperative 2nd m.s.) + -hum, them (acc. suffix); 'and keep their company'
دَخَلِ: دَخَلِ — dakhal, hidden flaw, mistrust (m.; gen. after ʿalā, 'with reserve'); 'with reserve'
ظَنِّكَ: ظَنّ + ِ + كَ — ẓann, thought, opinion (m.; gen., second term of ḥusn ẓannika) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your thinking (well)'
مُعْجِزَةٌ: مُعْجِزَةٌ — muʿjiza, a wonder, miracle (f.; nom. indef., predicate; also read maʿjaza 'helplessness'); 'a marvel'
شَرّاً: شَرّاً — sharr, evil (m.; acc. indef., object of ẓunna); 'the worst'
وَجَلِ: وَجَلِ — wajal, fear (m.; gen. after ʿalā, 'on guard'); 'in fear'
الْكُمَّالِ: اَل + كُمَّال — al-, the + kummāl, the perfect (broken pl. of kāmil; gen., second term of shiyam al-kummāl); 'of the perfect'
وَعَاقِبَتُهُ: وَ + عَاقِبَة + ُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿāqiba, end, outcome (f.; nom., subject of the nominal clause) + -hu, its (gen. suffix); 'and its end'
النَّجَاةُ: اَل + نَّجَاة + ُ — al-, the + najāt, deliverance (f.; nom., predicate of ʿāqibatuhu); 'is deliverance'
وَنَسْلَمُ: وَ + نَسْلَمُ — wa-, and (conj.) + naslamu, to be safe (I, imperf. 1st pl., indic.; bare verb as subject: 'that we are safe'); 'that we come off safe'
مَوْتِنَا: مَوْت + ِ + نَا — mawt, death (m.; gen. after min, the comparison with khayr) + -nā, our (suffix); 'our dying'
وَالْحِقْدِ: وَ + اَل + حِقْد + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ḥiqd, rancour (m.; gen., coordinated after sūʾ al-ẓann); 'and rancour'
فَالْأَمْرُ: فَ + اَل + أَمْر — fa-, then (conj., apodosis of in) + al-, the + amr, matter, case (m.; nom., subject, with ʿalā wajhayn as predicate); 'then the matter'
وَتَنْجُو: وَ + تَنْجُو — wa-, and (conj.) + tanjū, to be saved (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic., defective; coordinated with tataʿallaqu); 'and you escape'
أَغُلَّ: أَغُلَّ — aghulla, to defraud, betray (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an; print doubtful, probably aghdira bika); 'that I betray'
فَأَخْلُصَ: فَ + أَخْلُصَ — fa-, then (conj.) + akhluṣa, to get away (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive); 'and get away'
وَأَدَعَكَ: وَ + أَدَعَ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + adaʿa, to leave (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an, from wadaʿa) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'and leave you'
أُبْتَلَي: أُبْتَلَي — ubtalā, to be afflicted (VIII, imperf. 1st s., passive, subjunctive after an; takes bi- of the affliction; print spells with final yāʾ); 'be struck'
ابْتُلِيتَ: ابْتُلِيتَ — ubtulīta, to be afflicted (VIII, perf. 2nd m.s., passive; takes bi- 'afflicted with'); 'you were struck'
عُقُوبَةَ: عُقُوبَة + َ — ʿuqūba, punishment (f.; acc., predicate of yakūna, first term of ʿuqūbat al-ghadr); 'the punishment (for)'
تَثِقَ: تَثِقَ — tathiqa, to trust (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after an, assimilated wāw; takes bī 'trust in me'); 'you trust'
جَاهِلًا: جَاهِلًا — jāhil, ignorant (act. part. I; acc. indef., predicate of akun; takes bi-); 'ignorant'
بِحَوَادِثِ: بِ + حَوَادِث — bi-, of (prep., jāhil takes bi- 'ignorant of') + ḥawādith, events, mishaps (broken pl. of ḥādith; gen., first term of ḥawādith al-dahr); 'of the turns (of)'
تُؤَخِّرْ: تُؤَخِّرْ — tuʾakhkhir, to delay (II, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition); 'do not delay'
خَلَاصِنَا: خَلَاص + ِ + نَا — khalāṣ, escape, release (m.; gen., second term after ḥīlata) + -nā, our (suffix); 'our escape'
أَضْيَقُ: أَضْيَق — aḍyaq, narrower, more pressing (elative of ḍayyiq; nom., predicate; with min an 'too ... to'); 'too pressing'
نُطِيلَ: نُطِيلَ — nuṭīla, to prolong (IV, imperf. 1st pl., subjunctive after min an); 'for us to prolong'
ثِقَتِي: ثِقَة + ِ + ي — thiqa, trust (f.; gen., after qillat) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my trust'
بِوَفَائِكَ: بِ + وَفَاء + ِ + كَ — bi-, in (prep., thiqa takes bi- 'trust in') + wafāʾ, good faith (m.; gen.) + -ka, your (suffix); 'in your good faith'
تَوْبَتِي: تَوْبَة + ِ + ي — tawba, repentance (f.; gen. after min) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my repentance'
مُحِقًّا: مُحِقًّا — muḥiqq, in the right, honest (act. part. IV of aḥaqqa; acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'honest'
اسْتَدْرَكَ: اسْتَدْرَكَ — istadraka, to make good, repair (X, perf. 3rd m.s.; doubtful reading); 'made good'
انْسَلَّ: انْسَلَّ — insalla, to slip away (VII, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; relative mā; doubtful reading, perhaps aslafa); 'slipped away'
مُبْطِلًا: مُبْطِلًا — mubṭil, in the wrong, false (act. part. IV of abṭala; acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'false'
فَجَزَاؤُهُ: فَ + جَزَاء + ُ + هُ — fa-, then (conj., apodosis of in) + jazāʾ, repayment (m.; nom., subject; predicate ʿalā rabbihi) + -hu, his (suffix); 'then his repayment'
لِهَلَاكِكَ: لِ + هَلَاك + ِ + كَ — li-, for (prep., sabab li- 'a cause of') + halāk, ruin (m.; gen.) + -ka, your (suffix); 'of your ruin'
انْتَصَبَ: انْتَصَبَ — intaṣaba, to stand upright (VII, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject al-dhiʾb); 'stood upright'
فَقَفَزَ: فَ + قَفَزَ — fa-, then (conj.) + qafaza, to leap (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes ʿan 'from'); 'and leapt'
لَاتَغْفُلْ: لَا + تَغْفُلْ — lā, do not (prohibition) + taghfal, to be heedless (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive; takes ʿan 'forget about'); printed run together; 'do not neglect'
وَلَاتُؤَخِّرْ: وَ + لَا + تُؤَخِّرْ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, do not (prohibition) + tuʾakhkhir, to delay (II, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive); printed run together; 'and do not delay'
وَقَهْقَهَ: وَ + قَهْقَهَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qahqaha, to laugh aloud (quadriliteral, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'and guffawed'
يُوقِعْنِي: يُوقِع + نِي — yūqiʿu, to cause to fall (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam; subject ʿuqūba) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'did not put me'
إِلَّاعُقُوبَةُ: إِلَّا + عُقُوبَةُ — illā, except (particle of exception) + ʿuqūba, punishment (f.; nom., subject of lam yūqiʿnī, first term of ʿuqūbat al-mazḥ); printed run together; 'nothing but the punishment (for)'
الْمَزْحِ: اَل + مَزْح + ِ — al-, the + mazḥ, joking (m.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'joking'
