وَالسُّخْرِيَّةِ: وَ + اَل + سُّخْرِيَّة + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + sukhriyya, mockery (f.; gen., coordinated; takes bi- 'mocking you'); 'and mockery'
اسْتَخَفَّنِي: اسْتَخَفَّ + نِي — istakhaffa, to carry away, make light (X, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'carried me away'
وَالْفَرَحُ: وَ + اَل + فَرَح + ُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + faraḥ, gladness (m.; nom., coordinated with al-ṭarab); 'and gladness'
فَنَطَّيْتُ: فَ + نَطَّيْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + naṭṭaytu, to leap (colloquial naṭṭā, perf. 1st s.; pointing a guess at the spoken form); 'so I leapt'
وَطَرِبْتُ: وَ + طَرِبْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭaribtu, to be moved with delight (I, perf. 1st s.); 'and made merry'
وَرَقَصْتُ: وَ + رَقَصْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + raqaṣtu, to dance (I, perf. 1st s.); 'and danced'
فَتَدَلَّى: فَ + تَدَلَّى — fa-, so (conj.) + tadallā, to dangle (V, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; subject dhanabī); 'so it dangled'
فَجَذَبْتَنِي: فَ + جَذَبْتَ + نِي — fa-, so (conj.) + jadhabta, to pull (I, perf. 2nd m.s.) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'so you pulled me'
أَنْقَذَنِى: أَنْقَذَ + نِي — anqadha, to rescue (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject Allāh; print has final yāʾ for ī) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'rescued me'
لَاأَكُونُ: لَا + أَكُونُ — lā, not (negative, in the question 'why should I not be') + akūnu, to be (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.); printed run together; 'I should not be'
عَوْنًا: عَوْنًا — ʿawn, help, helper (m.; acc. indef., predicate of akūnu; takes ʿalā 'help against'); 'a help'
أَرْقُصُ: أَرْقُصُ — arquṣu, to dance (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.); 'I was dancing'
عُرْسِكَ: عُرْس + ِ + كَ — ʿurs, wedding (m.; gen. after fī) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your wedding'
فَقَصَصْتُ: فَ + قَصَصْتُ — fa-, so (conj.) + qaṣaṣtu, to tell, relate (I, perf. 1st s., geminate; takes ʿalā of the hearer); 'so I told'
الرُّؤْيَا: اَل + رُّؤْيَا — al-, the + ruʾyā, dream (f., indeclinable; acc., object of qaṣaṣtu); 'the dream'
مُعَبِّرٍ: مُعَبِّرٍ — muʿabbir, interpreter of dreams (act. part. II of ʿabbara; gen. indef. after ʿalā, 'to an interpreter'); 'an interpreter'
وَرْطَةٍ: وَرْطَة — warṭa, quagmire, scrape (f.; gen. indef. after fī); 'a scrape'
وُقُوعِي: وُقُوع + ِ + ي — wuqūʿ, falling (I verbal noun; nom., subject of the nominal clause, with anna) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my falling'
وَنَجَاتِي: وَ + نَجَاة + ِ + ي — wa-, and (conj.) + najāt, escape (f.; nom., coordinated with wuqūʿī) + -ī, my (suffix); 'and my escape'
تَأْوِيلُ: تَأْوِيل + ُ — taʾwīl, interpretation (II verbal noun; nom., predicate of huwa, first term of taʾwīl ruʾyāya); 'the meaning (of)'
رُؤْيَايَ: رُؤْيَا + يَ — ruʾyā, dream (f.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -ya, my (1st s. suffix, after alif); 'my dream'
تَطْمَعُ: تَطْمَعُ — taṭmaʿu, to hope greedily (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; takes fī 'hope for'); 'you hope'
بِقِلَّةِ: بِ + قِلَّة — bi-, with, out of (prep., 'by reason of') + qilla, littleness, lack (f.; gen., first term of qillat ʿaqlika); 'through the lack (of)'
وَجَهْلِكَ: وَ + جَهْل + ِ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + jahl, ignorance (m.; gen., coordinated after bi-qillati) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your folly'
إِنْقَاذِى: إِنْقَاذ + ِ + ي — inqādh, rescuing (IV verbal noun; gen. after fī) + -ī, my (suffix, subject of the noun, the rescuer); print has final yāʾ; 'my rescuing'
وَتَطْهِيرًا: وَ + تَطْهِيرًا — wa-, and (conj.) + taṭhīr, cleansing (II verbal noun; acc. indef., coordinated after rāḥatan, object of the idea of mawt); 'and a cleansing'
لِلْأَرْضِ: لِ + اَل + أَرْض — li-, for, of (prep., marks what is cleansed, 'cleansing for the earth') + al-, the + arḍ, earth (f.; gen.); 'of the earth'
مَخَافَةُ: مَخَافَة + ُ — makhāfa, fear (f.; nom., subject after lawlā, first term of makhāfat an); 'fear (that)' Also nom. as subject after mā … illā: mā ḥamalanī … illā makhāfatu, 'nothing drove me … but fear'.
أَحْتَمِلَ: أَحْتَمِلَ — aḥtamila, to bear, put up with (VIII, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an); 'I should bear'
الْوَفَاءِ: اَل + وَفَاء + ِ — al-, the + wafāʾ, keeping faith (m.; gen. after fī); 'faith-keeping'
لَتَدَبَّرْتُ: لَ + تَدَبَّرْتُ — la-, then (consequence-lām after lawlā) + tadabbartu, to think over, contrive (V, perf. 1st s.; takes fī); 'then I would have considered'
خَلَاصِكَ: خَلَاص + ِ + كَ — khalāṣ, deliverance (m.; gen. after fī, 'in getting you out') + -ka, your (suffix); 'your release'
عَضَّ: عَضَّ — ʿaḍḍa, to bite (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; takes ʿalā 'bite on'); 'bit'
كَفِّهِ: كَفّ + ِ + هِ — kaff, palm, paw (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his (gen. suffix); 'his paw'
لَمَّاسَمِعَ: لَمَّا + سَمِعَ — lammā, when (conj., with perfect) + samiʿa, to hear (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject al-dhiʾb); printed run together as one word; 'when he heard'
عَضَّ: عَضَّ — ʿaḍḍa, to bite (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; takes ʿalā 'bite on'); 'bit'
لَيَّنَ: لَيَّنَ — layyana, to soften, make gentle (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject the wolf, with li-hu 'to him'); 'he softened'
يَجِدْبُدًّا: يَجِدْ + بُدًّا — yajid, to find (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after the preceding lam, past sense) + budd, escape, alternative (m.; acc. indef., object; min dhālika 'from that'); printed run together; 'he did not find an escape'
يَنْفَعْ: يَنْفَعْ — yanfaʿ, to avail, benefit (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam; fa- 'but' is separate); 'it did not avail'
خَافِتٍ: خَافِتٍ — khāfit, faint, low (act. part. I of khafata; gen. indef., adjective of lisān after bi-); 'faint'
الثَّعَالِبِ: الـ + ثَّعَالِب + ِ — al-, the + thaʿālib, foxes (broken plural of thaʿlab, m.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa after maʿāshir); 'the foxes'
وَأَلْطَفِهَا: وَ + أَلْطَفِ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + alṭaf, more graceful, gentler (elative of laṭīf; gen., coordinated with aḥlā after min) + -hā, of them (gen. suffix, referring to al-qawm as a collective); 'and the most graceful of them'
مِزَاحًا: مِزَاح + ًا — mizāḥ, jesting, joking (III verbal noun of māzaḥa; acc. indef., specification tamyīz after the elative); 'in jesting'
مِزَاحٌ: مِزَاحٌ — mizāḥ, jest, joke (m.; nom. indef., predicate of hādhā); 'a jest'
مَاكُلَّ: مَا + كُلَّ — mā, not (negative particle, here 'it is not the case that') + kull, every, all (acc., adverbial of time, first term of kulla waqtin); printed run together; 'not at every time'
اللَّعِبُ: الـ + لَّعِبُ — al-, the + laʿib, play, sport (m., I verbal noun; nom., subject of yaḥsunu); 'the play'
وَالْمِزَاحُ: وَ + الـ + مِزَاحُ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + mizāḥ, jesting (III verbal noun; nom., coordinated with al-laʿib); 'and the jesting'
لِلْمِزَاحِ: لِ + الـ + مِزَاحِ — li-, for (prep., marks possession: inna li-al-mizāḥi ḥaddan 'jesting has a limit') + al-, the + mizāḥ, jesting (gen. after li-); 'for jesting'
حَدًّا: حَدًّا — ḥadd, limit (m.; acc. indef., postponed noun of inna, whose predicate is the preceding li-al-mizāḥi); 'a limit'
لَايُجَاوِزُهُ: لَا + يُجَاوِزُ + هُ — lā, not (negative) + yujāwizu, to pass beyond, exceed (III, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; relative clause describing ḥadd) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, referring to ḥadd); printed run together; 'does not pass beyond it'
فَلَاتَظُنَّ: فَ + لَا + تَظُنَّ — fa-, so (conj., draws the consequence) + lā, do not (prohibition) + taẓunna, to think (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive-prohibitive with fatḥa before the following anna; geminate); printed run together; 'so do not think'
يُمَكِّنُكَ: يُمَكِّنُ + كَ — yumakkinu, to give power, give mastery (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; subject Allāh; takes min 'over', here minnī) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'will give you mastery'
أَنْقَذَنِي: أَنْقَذَ + نِي — anqadha, to rescue (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject Allāh; takes min 'from') + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'He rescued me'
لَجَدِيرٌأَنْ: لَ + جَدِيرٌ + أَنْ — la-, indeed (emphatic lām after inna) + jadīr, worthy, fitting (m.; nom. indef., predicate of inna) + an, that (conj., with the subjunctive); printed run together; 'indeed worthy that'
تَرْغَبَ: تَرْغَبَ — targhaba, to desire (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after an; takes fī 'desire, be eager for'); 'you should desire'
سَابِقِ: سَابِق + ِ — sābiq, former, preceding (act. part. I of sabaqa; gen., first term of the iḍāfa sābiqi al-muwākhāti, after min 'of'); 'former'
الْمُوَاخَاةِ: الـ + مُوَاخَاة + ِ — al-, the + muwākhāt, brotherhood, fraternity (III verbal noun of ākhā; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the brotherhood'
وَالصُّحْبَةِ: وَ + الـ + صُّحْبَة + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + ṣuḥba, companionship (f.; gen., coordinated with al-muwākhāt); 'and the companionship'
مُكَافَأَتَكَ: مُكَافَأَة + َ + كَ — mukāfaʾa, reward, requital (III verbal noun of kāfaʾa; acc., object of uḥsina) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your reward'
لَاتُوَاخِ: لَا + تُوَاخِ — lā, do not (prohibition) + tuwākhi, to take as a brother (III, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive, final yāʾ dropped); 'do not take as a brother'
الْجَاهِلَ: الـ + جَاهِلَ — al-, the + jāhil, ignorant person, fool (act. part. I of jahila; acc., object of tuwākhi); 'the ignorant'
الْفَاجِرَ: الـ + فَاجِرَ — al-, the + fājir, wicked, dissolute (act. part. I of fajara; acc., second adjective, in apposition to al-jāhil); 'the wicked'
يَشِينُكَ: يَشِينُ + كَ — yashīnu, to disgrace, dishonour (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic., hollow; subject the fool, after fa-inna-hu 'for he') + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'he disgraces you'
وَلَايَزِينُكَ: وَ + لَا + يَزِينُ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, not (negative) + yazīnu, to adorn, grace (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic., hollow) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'and does not adorn you'
وَلَاتُوَاخِ: وَ + لَا + تُوَاخِ — wa-, and (conj., continues the wise men's saying) + lā, do not (prohibition) + tuwākhi, to take as a brother (III, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive); 'and do not take as a brother'
الْكَذَّابَ: الـ + كَذَّابَ — al-, the + kadhdhāb, liar (intensive form of kādhib; acc., object of tuwākhi); 'the liar'
بَدَامِنْكَ: بَدَا + مِنْ + كَ — badā, to appear, show (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; subject khayr) + min, from (prep.) + -ka, you (gen. suffix); printed run together; 'shows from you'
شَرٌّأَفْشَاهُ: شَرٌّ + أَفْشَا + هُ — sharr, evil (m.; nom. indef., subject of badā) + afshā, to spread abroad, divulge (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; apodosis of in) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); printed run together; 'evil, spreads it abroad'
وَيُصْلَحُ: وَ + يُصْلَحُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuṣlaḥu, to be mended, set right (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s. passive, indic.; subject kullu shayʾin); 'and is mended'
إِلَّافَسَادَ: إِلَّا + فَسَادَ — illā, except (excepting particle) + fasād, corruption, spoiling (m., I verbal noun; acc., excepted noun, first term of fasāda al-jawhari); printed run together; 'except the corruption (of)'
وَقَدْيُدْفَعُ: وَ + قَدْ + يُدْفَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + qad, may, sometimes (particle with imperfect, expressing possibility) + yudfaʿu, to ward off, repel (I, imperf. 3rd m.s. passive, indic.); printed run together; 'and may be warded off'
الْقَدَرَ: الـ + قَدَرَ — al-, the + qadar, decree, destiny (m.; acc., excepted noun after illā); 'the decree'
الْمُكَافَأَةِ: الـ + مُكَافَأَة + ِ — al-, the + mukāfaʾa, reward, requital (III verbal noun; gen., second term of the iḍāfa jihat al-mukāfaʾati); 'the reward'
زَعَمْتَ: زَعَمْتَ — zaʿamta, to claim, assert (I, perf. 2nd m.s.; takes anna-clause); 'you claimed'
أَسْتَحِقُّهَا: أَسْتَحِقُّ + هَا — astaḥiqqu, to deserve (X, imperf. 1st s., indic., geminate) + -hā, it (acc. suffix, referring to al-mukāfaʾa); 'I deserve it'
شَبَّهْتُكَ: شَبَّهْتُ + كَ — shabbahtu, to liken (II, perf. 1st s.; takes bi- of the thing likened to) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I have likened you'
بِالْحَيَّةِ: بِ + الـ + حَيَّة + ِ — bi-, to (prep., chosen by shabbaha 'liken to') + al-, the + ḥayya, serpent (f.; gen. after bi-); 'to the serpent'
الْهَارِبَةِ: الـ + هَارِبَة + ِ — al-, the + hāriba, fleeing (act. part. I of haraba, f.; gen., adjective of al-ḥayya; takes min 'flee from'); 'the fleeing'
الْحَاوِي: الـ + حَاوِي — al-, the + ḥāwī, snake-charmer (act. part. I of ḥawā; gen., defective noun, after min); 'the snake-charmer'
إِذْرَآهَا: إِذْ + رَآ + هَا — idh, when (conj. of past time) + raʾā, to see (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject rajul) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); printed run together; 'when he saw her'
مَرْعُوبَةٌ: مَرْعُوبَة — marʿūba, terrified (pass. part. I of raʿaba, f.; nom. indef., predicate of the circumstantial clause wa-hiya); 'terrified'
شَأْنُكِ: شَأْن + ِ + كِ — shaʾn, affair, matter (m.; nom., predicate of mā) + -ki, your (2nd f.s. suffix, addressed to the serpent); 'your affair'
وَلَئِنْ: وَ + لَ + ئِنْ — wa-, and (conj.) + la-, oath-lām (introducing the conditional, anticipates the oath answer la-uḥsinanna) + in, if (conditional); 'and if'
أَنْجَيْتَنِي: أَنْجَيْتَ + نِي — anjayta, to save, deliver (IV, perf. 2nd m.s., defective; takes min 'from') + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'you save me'
وَأَخْفَيْتَنِي: وَ + أَخْفَيْتَ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + akhfayta, to hide, conceal (IV, perf. 2nd m.s., defective) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'and hide me'
لَأُحْسِنَنَّ: لَ + أُحْسِنَنَّ — la-, surely (oath-lām, answer to the conditional) + uḥsinanna, to do well, make good (IV, imperf. 1st s., energetic nūn, with fatḥa; here with the object mukāfaʾatak); 'I will surely make good'
اغْتِنَامًا: اغْتِنَامًا — ightinām, seizing the chance, gaining as a prize (VIII verbal noun of ghanima; acc. indef., object of purpose, mafʿūl lahu); 'seizing the chance'
لِلْأَجْرِ: لِ + الـ + أَجْرِ — li-, for (prep., marks the aim: 'for the sake of') + al-, the + ajr, wage, reward from God (m.; gen. after li-); 'for the (heavenly) wage'
وَطَمَعًا: وَ + طَمَعًا — wa-, and (conj.) + ṭamaʿ, greed, hope (m., I verbal noun; acc. indef., object of purpose, coordinated with ightināman); 'and in greed'
فَأَدْخَلَهَا: فَ + أَدْخَلَ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + adkhala, to put in, bring in (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject the man) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and put her in'
الْحَيَّةِ: الـ + حَيَّة + ِ — al-, the + ḥayya, serpent (f.; gen. after ʿan, 'left the serpent'); 'the serpent'
مَاكَانَتْ: مَا + كَانَتْ — mā, what (relative pronoun; subject of zāla) + kānat, to be (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; auxiliary with imperfect, past continuous); printed run together; 'what she was'
تَخَافُهُ: تَخَافُ + هُ — takhāfu, to fear (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic., hollow; subject al-ḥayya) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, resumptive of mā); editorial correction of the print's تخانه; 'she was fearing (it)'; here: takhāfu, 2ms, 'you fear' + -hu, it (resumptive of mā): 'what you fear'
الْمُكَافَأَةُ: الـ + مُكَافَأَةُ — al-, the + mukāfaʾa, reward (III verbal noun; nom., subject of the nominal sentence, after ayna 'where'); 'the reward'
أَنْجَيْتُكِ: أَنْجَيْتُ + كِ — anjaytu, to save (IV, perf. 1st s., defective; takes min 'from') + -ki, you (acc. suffix, 2nd f.s.); 'I have saved you'
مِمَّاتَخَافِينَ: مِنْ + مَا + تَخَافِينَ — min, from (prep.; anjā takes min of the danger) + mā, what (relative) + takhāfīna, to fear (I, imperf. 2nd f.s., indic.); printed run together; 'from what you fear'
وَتَحْذَرِينَ: وَ + تَحْذَرِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥdharīna, to beware, be on guard against (I, imperf. 2nd f.s., indic.; takes direct object, here the resumptive pronoun dropped); 'and beware of'
عُضْوٍ: عُضْوٍ — ʿuḍw, limb, organ (m.; gen. indef., second term of fī ayyi ʿuḍwin); 'limb'
أَنْهَشُكَ: أَنْهَشُ + كَ — anhashu, to bite (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.; kind of snake bite) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I shall bite you'
لَانَتَجَاوَزُ: لَا + نَتَجَاوَزُ — lā, not (negative) + natajāwazu, to go beyond, exceed (VI, imperf. 1st pl., indic.); printed run together; 'we do not go beyond'
الْمُكَافَأَةَ: الـ + مُكَافَأَةَ — al-, the + mukāfaʾa, reward (III verbal noun; acc., object of natajāwazu, after hādhihi); 'the reward'
نَهَشَتْهُ: نَهَشَتْ + هُ — nahashat, to bite (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject al-ḥayya) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'she bit him'
نَهْشَةً: نَهْشَة + ً — nahsha, a bite (f.; acc. indef., internal object, mafʿūl muṭlaq, of nahashat); 'a bite'
شَبَّهْتُكَ: شَبَّهْتُ + كَ — shabbahtu, to liken (II, perf. 1st s.; the verb chooses bi- 'liken to', here bi-tilka al-ḥayya) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I have likened you'
تَأْمَنَنَّ: لَا + تَأْمَنَنَّ — lā, do not (prohibition) + taʾmananna, to trust, feel safe from (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive with energetic nūn, doubled); 'do not trust'
اَسْكَنْتَ: أَسْكَنْتَ — askanta, to lodge, make to dwell (IV, perf. 2nd m.s.; verse, relative clause after fatan); 'you have lodged'
مُهْجَتَهُ: مُهْجَة + َ + هُ — muhja, heart's blood, life (f.; acc., object of askanta) + -hu, his (suffix, resumptive of fatan); 'his heart-blood'
وَتَحْسَبُ: وَ + تَحْسَبُ — wa-, and (conj., circumstantial 'while') + taḥsabu, to reckon, suppose (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; takes anna-clause); 'while you reckon'
الْاَفَاعِيْ: الـ + أَفَاعِي — al-, the + afāʿī, vipers (broken plural of afʿā, f.; acc., noun of inna, its -ya dropped for the metre; the print's sukūn on the yāʾ marks the long ī); 'the vipers'
مَلَامِسُهَا: مَلَامِس + ُ + هَا — malāmis, touching-places, surfaces to touch (broken plural of malmas, m.; nom., subject of lānat) + -hā, their (suffix); 'their touching-places'
تُبْدِى: تُبْدِي — tubdī, to show, display (IV, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic., defective; subject al-afāʿī); the print has final yāʾ for ī; 'they show'; also with subject al-ayyām: mā zālati al-ayyāmu tubdī al-ʿajāʾiba, 'the days never cease to show wonders' (Night 201)
الْعِطَافَا: الـ + عِطَافَ + ا — al-, the + ʿiṭāf, flanks, sides of the body (m.; acc., object of tubdī; print has -ā for metre); 'the flanks'
وَتُخْفِى: وَ + تُخْفِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tukhfī, to hide (IV, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic., defective; the print has final yāʾ); 'and hide'
السَّمَّ: الـ + سَّمَّ — al-, the + summ, poison (m.; acc., object of tukhfī); 'the poison'
قَتَّالَا: قَتَّالَ + ا — qattāl, killing, deadly (intensive form of qātil, m.; acc. indef., ḥāl, state, with the metrical -ā); 'killing'
الْفَصِيحُ: الـ + فَصِيحُ — al-, the + faṣīḥ, eloquent (m.; nom., vocative after ayyuhā); 'the eloquent one'
تَجْهَلْ: تَجْهَلْ — tajhal, to be ignorant of (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., jussive after lā of prohibition; takes direct object, ḥālī); 'do not be ignorant of'
وَخَوْفَ: وَ + خَوْفَ — wa-, and (conj.) + khawf, fear (m.; acc., object coordinated with ḥālī, first term of khawfa al-nāsi); 'and the fear (of)'
أَهْجُمُ: أَهْجُمُ — ahjumu, to attack, fall upon (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.; takes ʿalā 'attack'); 'I fall upon'
وَأَقْلَعُ: وَ + أَقْلَعُ — wa-, and (conj.) + aqlaʿu, to uproot, pull out (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.); 'and uproot'; here also 'and I take off', of clothes (qalaʿa thiyābahu, the later idiom)
أَمَرْتُكَ: أَمَرْتُ + كَ — amartu, to order, command (I, perf. 1st s.; chooses bi- for the thing ordered, here bi-hi) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'I ordered you'
قِيَامَ: قِيَامَ — qiyām, standing, attending (I verbal noun of qāma, m.; acc., internal object, mafʿūl muṭlaq, first term of qiyāma al-ʿabdi); 'the attending (of)'
بِسَيِّدِةِ: بِ + سَيِّد + ِ + هِ — bi-, on, upon (prep., qāma bi- 'attend on, serve') + sayyid, master (m.; gen. after bi-) + -hi, his (suffix); the print has ة for ه at the end; 'on his master'
الْمُحَاوِلُ: الـ + مُحَاوِلُ — al-, the + muḥāwil, one striving, attempting (act. part. III of ḥāwala; nom., apposition to the vocative; takes bi- 'strive after'); 'the one striving'
تَعَجَّبْتُ: تَعَجَّبْتُ — taʿajjabtu, to marvel (V, perf. 1st s.; takes min 'marvel at'); 'I have marvelled'
حُمْقِكَ: حُمْق + ِ + كَ — ḥumq, folly, stupidity (m.; gen. after min) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your folly'
وَصَلَابَةِ: وَ + صَلَابَة + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ṣalāba, hardness, impudence (f.; gen., coordinated with ḥumqika, first term of ṣalābati wajhika); 'and the hardness (of)'
تَأْمُرُنِي: تَأْمُرُ + نِي — taʾmuru, to command (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.; chooses bi- for the thing commanded, here bi-hi) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'you order me'
وَالْقِيَامِ: وَ + الـ + قِيَام + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + qiyām, standing, attending (I verbal noun; gen., coordinated with khidmatika after min); 'and the standing'
بِمَالِكَ: بِ + مَال + ِ + كَ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., price: 'bought with your wealth') + māl, wealth, property (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (suffix); 'with your wealth'
شَدْخِ: شَدْخ + ِ — shadkh, crushing, smashing (I verbal noun of shadakha, m.; gen., after min, first term of shadkhi raʾsika); 'the crushing (of)'
الْغَدَّارَةِ: الـ + غَدَّارَة + ِ — al-, the + ghaddāra, treacherous (intensive form, f.; gen., adjective of anyābika); 'the treacherous'
تَلٍّ: تَلٍّ — tall, hillock, mound (m.; gen. indef., after fawqa 'on top of'); 'a hillock'
يُشْرِفُ: يُشْرِفُ — yushrifu, to overlook (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; relative clause on tall, takes ʿalā 'overlook'); 'which overlooks'
نَبَّهَهُمْ: نَبَّهَ + هُمْ — nabbaha, to rouse, wake (II, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject the fox) + -hum, them (acc. suffix); 'he roused them'
وَبَصُرُوابِهِ: وَ + بَصُرُوا + بِ + هِ — wa-, and (conj.) + baṣurū, to see, catch sight of (I, perf. 3rd m.pl.; the verb chooses bi- 'catch sight of') + bi-, of (prep.) + -hi, him (gen. suffix); printed run together; 'and caught sight of him'
بِجَمْعِهِمْ: بِ + جَمْع + ِ + هِمْ — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment: 'with their whole band') + jamʿ, gathering, band (m.; gen. after bi-) + -him, their (suffix); 'with their whole band'
فَثَبَتَ: فَ + ثَبَتَ — fa-, and (conj., sequence) + thabata, to stand firm, hold ground (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject the fox, with la-hum 'for them'); 'and stood firm'
الْحَفِيرَةِ: الـ + حَفِيرَة + ِ — al-, the + ḥafīra, pit, dug hole (f.; gen. after min, coordinated with the pronoun in minhu); 'the pit'
فَمَالُوا: فَ + مَالُوا — fa-, and (conj., sequence) + mālū, to turn upon, incline (I, perf. 3rd m.pl., hollow; takes ʿalā 'turn against'); 'and they turned'
وَالْخَشَبِ: وَ + الـ + خَشَب + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + khashab, wood, clubs (m.; gen., coordinated with al-ḥijāra after bi-); 'and the wood'
وَيَطْعَنُونَهُ: وَ + يَطْعَنُونَ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaṭʿanūna, to pierce, stab (I, imperf. 3rd m.pl., indic.) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'and piercing him'
بِأَسِنَّةِ: بِ + أَسِنَّة + ِ — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + asinna, heads, points (broken plural of sinān, gen., first term of asinnati al-rimāḥi); 'with the heads (of)'
مَقْتَلِ: مَقْتَل + ِ — maqtal, place of slaying (noun of place from qatala, m.; gen., after ʿalā 'stand over', first term of maqtali al-dhiʾbi); 'the place of slaying (of)'
فَرَأٰهُ: فَ + رَأَى + هُ — fa-, and (conj., sequence) + raʾā, to see (I, perf. 3rd m.s., the print has dagger alif) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'and saw him'
الْفَرَحَاتِ: الـ + فَرَحَات + ِ — al-, the + faraḥāt, joys (f. sound plural of faraḥa; gen., after min shiddati, second term of the iḍāfa); 'the joys'
اَوْدَى: أَوْدَى — awdā, to make away with, destroy (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; subject al-zamān; takes bi- 'make away with'); 'has made away with'
فَاخْتَطَفَتْ: فَ + اخْتَطَفَتْ — fa-, and (conj., sequence) + ikhtaṭafat, to snatch away (VIII, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject the soul; the vocalisation is active, the sense is 'was snatched off'); 'and it was snatched off'
وَسُحْقًا: وَ + سُحْقًا — wa-, and (conj.) + suḥq, remoteness, away (m., I verbal noun; acc. indef., object of an omitted verb, invocation 'away with'; coordinated with buʿdan); 'and away'
مُهْجَةٍ: مُهْجَة + ٍ — muhja, heart's blood, life (f.; gen. indef., after min, specifying 'of what a life'); 'a heart's-blood'
تَلَفَتْ: تَلَفَتْ — talafat, to perish, be ruined (I, perf. 3rd f.s., as the print points it; Classical talifa; relative clause on muhja); 'that perished'
سَرْحَانُ: سَرْحَان + ُ — sarḥān, wolf (m.; nom., vocative after ayā); 'wolf'
تَلَفِيْ: تَلَف + ِ + ي — talaf, ruin, destruction (m.; gen. after fī) + -ī, my (suffix; print has yāʾ with sukūn); 'my ruin'
الْاَفَاتُ: الـ + آفَات + ُ — al-, the + āfāt, calamities (f. sound plural of āfa; nom., subject of ḥallat); 'the calamities'
وَالْتَصَقَتْ: وَ + اِلْتَصَقَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + iltaṣaqat, to stick fast, cling (VIII, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject al-āfāt); 'and stuck fast'
رِيَاحُ: رِيَاح + ُ — riyāḥ, winds (broken plural of rīḥ, f.; nom., subject of ʿaṣafat, first term of riyāḥu al-mawti); 'the winds (of)'
عَصَفَتْ: عَصَفَتْ — ʿaṣafat, to storm, blow violently (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject riyāḥ, after qad); 'had stormed'
بِالْكَرْمِ: بِ + الـ + كَرْم + ِ — bi-, in (prep., locative with aqāma 'stay in') + al-, the + karm, vineyard (m.; gen. after bi-); 'in the vineyard'
وَالثَّعْلَبِ: وَ + الـ + ثَّعْلَب + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + thaʿlab, fox (m.; gen., coordinated with al-dhiʾb after min ḥadīth); 'and the fox'
فَأْرَةً: فَأْرَة — faʾra, mouse (f.; acc. indef. after anna, subject of kānā); 'a mouse'
وَبِنْتَ: وَ + بِنْتَ — wa-, and (conj.) + bint, daughter (f.; acc., in construct with ʿirs; bint ʿirs is the weasel; coordinated with faʾratan after anna); 'and a weasel'
عِرْسٍ: عِرْس — ʿirs, weasel (m.; gen. indef., second term of the construct bint ʿirs); 'weasel'
يَنْزِلَانِ: يَنْزِلَانِ — yanzilāni, to lodge, alight (I, imperf. 3rd m. dual, indic.; after kānā, 'were lodging'); 'were lodging'
لِدِهْقَانٍ: لِـ + دِهْقَان — li-, belonging to (prep., marks possession of the house) + dihqān, landowner, village headman (m.; gen. indef. after li-); 'belonging to a dihqān'
الدِّهْقَانُ: الـ + دِّهْقَان — al-, the + dihqān, landowner (m.; nom., subject of kāna, after the demonstrative dhālika); 'the dihqān'
أَصْدِقَائِهِ: أَصْدِقَاء + ِ + هِ — aṣdiqāʾ, friends (broken pl. of ṣadīq; gen., second term of the construct baʿḍu aṣdiqāʾihi) + -hi, his (suffix); 'his friends'
فَوَصَفَ: فَ + وَصَفَ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + waṣafa, to prescribe, describe (I, perf. 3rd m.s., assimilated; takes li- of the patient, here lahu); 'and so (he) prescribed'
سِمْسِمًا: سِمْسِم + ًا — simsim, sesame (m.; acc. indef., object of ṭalaba); 'sesame'
يُقَشِّرُهُ: يُقَشِّرُ + هُ — yuqashshiru, to husk, peel (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; relative clause qualifying simsiman) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'that he would husk it'
لِمَرَضٍ: لِـ + مَرَض — li-, for, on account of (prep., giving the reason) + maraḍ, sickness (m.; gen. indef. after li-); 'for a sickness'
فَأَعْطَا: فَ + أَعْطَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿṭā, to give (IV, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; the print writes the final ā with alif where Classical spelling has ى; takes two objects); 'and so he gave'
الدِّهْقَانِ: الـ + دِّهْقَانِ — al-, the + dihqān, landowner (m.; gen., after li-dhālika; the following al-faqīr is its adjective); 'the dihqān'
لِيُقَشِّرَهُ: لِـ + يُقَشِّرَ + هُ — li-, so that (conj. li- + subjunctive, purpose) + yuqashshira, to husk (II, imperf. 3rd m.s., subj.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'so that he might husk it'
بِإِصْلَاحِهِ: بِـ + إِصْلَاح + هِ — bi-, with (prep.; amara bi- 'order (someone to do) something': the verb chooses the preposition) + iṣlāḥ, preparing, putting in order (IV verbal noun; gen. after bi-) + -hi, its (suffix); 'to prepare it'
فَبَلَّتْهُ: فَ + بَلَّتْ + هُ — fa-, so (conj., sequence) + ballat, to moisten, wet (I, perf. 3rd f.s., geminate) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'so she moistened it'
وَجَفَّفَتْهُ: وَ + جَفَّفَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + jaffafat, to dry (II, perf. 3rd f.s., geminate; editorial correction of the print's وخففته) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and dried it'
تَنْقُلُ: تَنْقُلُ — tanqulu, to carry, transfer (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; after lam tazal, 'kept carrying'); 'carrying' Also 2 m. sg., 'you carry': wa-anta tanqulu ḥawāʾijaka, 'while you were moving your things'.
جُحْرِهَا: جُحْر + ِ + هَا — juḥr, hole, burrow (m.; gen. after ilā) + -hā, her (suffix); 'her hole'
يَوْمِهَا: يَوْم + ِ + هَا — yawm, day (m.; gen., second term of the construct ṭūla yawmihā) + -hā, her (suffix); 'her day'
نَقَلَتْ: نَقَلَتْ — naqalat, to carry (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; after ḥattā, 'until she had carried'); 'she had carried'
أَكْثَرَهُ: أَكْثَر + َ + هُ — akthar, most (elative of kathīr; acc., object of naqalat) + -hu, it (suffix); 'most of it'
نُقْصَانَ: نُقْصَان + َ — nuqṣān, decrease, shortfall (m.; acc., object of raʾat) ; 'the decrease'
وَاضِحًا: وَاضِح + ًا — wāḍiḥ, plain, clear (act. part. I of waḍaḥa; acc. indef., ḥāl, 'to be plain'); 'plain'
تَرْصُدُ: تَرْصُدُ — tarṣudu, to lie in wait for, watch (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; ḥāl-like clause after jalasat, 'sat watching'); 'lying in wait'
نُقْصَانِهِ: نُقْصَان + ِ + هِ — nuqṣān, decrease (m.; gen., second term of the construct sababa nuqṣānihi) + -hi, its (suffix); 'its decrease'
لِتَنْقُلَ: لِـ + تَنْقُلَ — li-, in order to (conj. li- + subjunctive, purpose) + tanqula, to carry (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., subj.); 'to carry'
تَرْصُدُهَا: تَرْصُدُ + هَا — tarṣudu, to lie in wait for (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; predicate of anna) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'was lying in wait for her'
عَوَاقِبَ: عَوَاقِب + َ — ʿawāqib, consequences (broken pl. of ʿāqiba, f.; acc., diptote, as the noun of inna, postponed after the predicate li-hādhā al-fiʿli); 'consequences'
ذَمِيمَةً: ذَمِيمَة + ً — dhamīma, blameworthy (f.; acc. indef., adjective of ʿawāqiba); 'blameworthy'
بَرَاءَتِي: بَرَاءَة + ِ + ي — barāʾa, innocence (f.; acc., object of uẓhiru) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my innocence'
الْقَبِيحِ: الـ + قَبِيح + ِ — al-, the + qabīḥ, foul, ugly (adj. used as noun; gen. after min, 'of the foul'); 'of the foul'
فَجَعَلَتْ: فَ + جَعَلَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + jaʿalat, to begin, set about (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; auxiliary of beginning followed by imperf. tanqulu); 'and so she began' Also jaʿala with two objects, 'to make out, feign': fa-jaʿalat rūḥahā nāʾimatan, 'and she made out that she was asleep' (Night 188).
وَتُخْرِجُهُ: وَ + تُخْرِجُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tukhriju, to bring out (IV, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and bringing it out'
وَتَضَعُهُ: وَ + تَضَعُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḍaʿu, to put, place (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic., assimilated; takes ʿalā for 'on') + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and putting it'
فَوَافَتْهَا: فَ + وَافَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + wāfat, to come upon, arrive at (III, perf. 3rd f.s.) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and so she came upon her'
وَرَأَتْهَا: وَ + رَأَتْ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + raʾat, to see (I, perf. 3rd f.s., hamzated) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and saw her'
مَاهَذِهِ: مَا + هَذِهِ — mā, not (negative, with a nominal sentence; printed run together with the following word) + hādhihi, this (f. demonstrative; subject); 'this is not'
نَقْصِهِ: نَقْص + ِ + هِ — naqṣ, decrease, loss (m.; gen., second term of the construct sababu naqṣihi) + -hi, its (suffix); 'its decrease'
جُحْرِ: جُحْر + ِ — juḥr, hole (m.; gen., first term of the construct juḥri alladhī); 'the hole'
اخْتَلَسَهُ: اِخْتَلَسَ + هُ — ikhtalasa, to pilfer, snatch (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'pilfered it'
بَعْضِهِ: بَعْض + ِ + هِ — baʿḍ, part, some (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, its (suffix); 'the rest of it'
يُحْسَنَ: يُحْسَنَ — yuḥsana, to do good (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., passive, subj. after an; iḥsān takes ilā of the recipient, here ilayhi); 'that good be done'
وَلَيْسَتْ: وَ + لَيْسَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + laysat, not to be (defective verb, perf. 3rd f.s.; negates the nominal sentence, subject hādhihi, predicate āfatan); 'and (this) is not'
أَرْصُدُهُ: أَرْصُدُ + هُ — arṣudu, to lie in wait for (I, imperf. 1st s., indic.; after lā azālu, 'I shall keep on') + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'lying in wait for him'
بِبَالِ: بِـ + بَال + ِ — bi-, in, to (prep.; khaṭara bi-bāl 'occur to the mind': the verb chooses the preposition) + bāl, mind (m.; gen. after bi-); 'to the mind'
الْفَأْرَةِ: الـ + فَأْرَة + ِ — al-, the + faʾra, mouse (f.; gen., after ilā or as second term of a construct, juḥra al-faʾrati); 'the mouse'
يُرَاعِى: يُرَاعِي — yurāʿī, to observe, heed (III, imperf. 3rd m.s., defective, indic.; print has final alif maqṣūra for yāʾ); 'observes'
الْمُجَاوَرَةَ: الـ + مُجَاوَرَة + َ — al-, the + mujāwara, neighbourship, living next door (III verbal noun, f.; acc., object of yurāʿī); 'the neighbourship'
الْفَأْرَةُ: الـ + فَأْرَة + ُ — al-, the + faʾra, mouse (f.; nom., subject of qālat); 'the mouse'
خَلِيلَتِي: خَلِيلَة + ِ + ي — khalīla, bosom friend (f.; vocative after yā) + -ī, my (suffix); 'my bosom friend'
وَأَنْعِمْ: وَ + أَنْعِمْ — wa-, and (conj.) + anʿim, to be blessed, how excellent (IV, imperative form used in the exclamation anʿim bi-; bi- here is the pseudo-object of wonder, 'how blessed is...'); 'and how blessed'
وَبِجِوَارِكِ: وَ + بِـ + جِوَار + ِ + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + bi-, with (prep.; the preposition of the anʿim bi- exclamation, 'how blessed is...') + jiwār, neighbourhood, neighbourship (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ki, your (f. suffix); 'and your neighbourship'
بِسِمْسِمٍ: بِـ + سِمْسِم + ٍ — bi-, with (prep.; atā bi- 'bring': the verb chooses the preposition) + simsim, sesame (m.; gen. indef. after bi-); 'brought sesame'
وَعِيَالُهُ: وَ + عِيَال + ُ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿiyāl, household, dependants (m. coll.; nom., coordinated with the pronoun huwa) + -hu, his (suffix); 'and his household'
وَاسْتَغْنَوْا: وَ + اِسْتَغْنَوْا — wa-, and (conj.) + istaghnaw, to be able to do without (X, perf. 3rd m. pl., defective; takes ʿan 'from', here ʿanhu); 'and could do without (it)'
وَتَرَكُوهُ: وَ + تَرَكُوا + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tarakū, to leave (I, perf. 3rd m. pl.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and left it'
رُوحٍ: رُوح + ٍ — rūḥ, spirit, life (m.; gen. indef., second term of the construct dhī rūḥin); 'a spirit, living soul'
أَخَذْتِ: أَخَذْتِ — akhadhti, to take (I, perf. 2nd f.s., hamzated; after law, 'if you took'); 'you took'
أَحَقَّ: أَحَقَّ — aḥaqq, more entitled, more deserving (elative of ḥaqq, diptote; acc. indef., predicate of kunti; min follows for the comparison); 'more entitled'
الْفَأْرَةَ: الـ + فَأْرَة + َ — al-, the + faʾra, mouse (f.; acc., object of aʿjaba, 'pleased'); 'the mouse'
وَزَقْزَقَتْ: وَ + زَقْزَقَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + zaqzaqat, to squeak, chirp (quadriliteral I, perf. 3rd f.s.); 'and she squeaked'
وَرَقَصَتْ: وَ + رَقَصَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + raqaṣat, to dance (I, perf. 3rd f.s.); 'and she danced'
آذَانُهَا: آذَان + ُ + هَا — ādhān, ears (broken pl. of udhun, f.; nom., subject of laʿibat) + -hā, her (suffix); 'her ears'
وَذَنَبُهَا: وَ + ذَنَب + ُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + dhanab, tail (m.; nom., coordinated with ādhānuhā) + -hā, her (suffix); 'and her tail'
وَغَرَّهَا: وَ + غَرَّ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + gharra, to delude, beguile (I, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; subject al-ṭamaʿu) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and (it) deluded her'
مُجَفَّفًا: مُجَفَّف + ًا — mujaffaf, dried (pass. part. II of jaffafa; acc. indef., ḥāl or second object of raʾat); 'dried'
مَقْشُورًا: مَقْشُور + ًا — maqshūr, husked (pass. part. I of qashara; acc. indef., ḥāl); 'husked'
الْبَيَاضِ: الـ + بَيَاض + ِ — al-, the + bayāḍ, whiteness (m.; gen. after min, 'from the whiteness', the cause of the gleam); 'from the whiteness'
تَرْصُدُهُ: تَرْصُدُ + هُ — tarṣudu, to lie in wait for, watch (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; ḥāl clause, 'watching it') + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'watching it'
تُفَكِّرِ: تُفَكِّرِ — tufakkir, to think, reflect (II, imperf. 3rd f.s., jussive after lam; kasra from the following al-); 'did not think (of)'
اسْتَعَدَّتْ: اِسْتَعَدَّتْ — istaʿaddat, to make oneself ready (X, perf. 3rd f.s., geminate; takes bi- of the thing, 'with a cudgel'); 'had made herself ready'
بِهِرَاوَةٍ: بِـ + هِرَاوَة + ٍ — bi-, with (prep.; istaʿadda bi- 'prepare with': the verb chooses the preposition) + hirāwa, cudgel, club (f.; gen. indef. after bi-); 'with a cudgel'
تَتَمَالَكِ: تَتَمَالَكِ — tatamālak, to control oneself (VI, imperf. 3rd f.s., jussive after lam; kasra from the following al-); 'did not control (herself)'
وَخَالَطَتْهُ: وَ + خَالَطَتْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + khālaṭat, to mix with, mingle with (III, perf. 3rd f.s.) + -hu, it (acc. suffix); 'and mingled with it'
وَعَاشَتْ: وَ + عَاشَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿāshat, to live (I, perf. 3rd f.s., hollow); 'and lived'
فَضَرَبَتْهَا: فَ + ضَرَبَتْ + هَا — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḍarabat, to strike (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; the instrument takes bi-, here bi-tilka al-hirāwa) + -hā, her (acc. suffix); 'and so (she) struck her'
الْهِرَاوَةِ: الـ + هِرَاوَة + ِ — al-, the + hirāwa, cudgel (f.; gen. after bi-tilka, 'with that cudgel'); 'the cudgel'
فَشَجَّتْ: فَ + شَجَّتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + shajjat, to split, wound the head (I, perf. 3rd f.s., geminate); 'and split'
الطَّمَعَ: الـ + طَّمَع + َ — al-, the + ṭamaʿ, greed (m.; acc., predicate of kāna 'was the greed', sababu halākihā being its subject); 'the greed'
وَغَفْلَتَهَا: وَ + غَفْلَة + َ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ghafla, heedlessness (f.; acc., coordinated with al-ṭamaʿa; takes ʿan 'from', ʿan ʿawāqibi) + -hā, her (suffix); 'and her heedlessness'
أُحْدُوثَةٌ: أُحْدُوثَة + ٌ — uḥdūtha, tale, story (f.; nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'a tale'
دِمْنِ: دِمْن — dimn as pointed (gen. after fī), but no ordinary sense of the word ('dung, traces of an old camp') fits; perhaps for ḍimn (ضمن), 'concerning', or another word such as yumn, 'blessing'; the reading is uncertain; 'about (?)'
الصَّدَاقَةِ: الـ + صَّدَاقَة + ِ — al-, the + ṣadāqa, friendship (f.; gen., second term of a construct: dimni / ḥusni al-ṣadāqati); 'friendship'
وَحِفْظِهَا: وَ + حِفْظ + ِ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥifẓ, keeping, preserving (I verbal noun; gen., coordinated with al-ṣadāqa) + -hā, its (suffix, referring to friendship); 'and the keeping of it'
التَّخَلُّصِ: الـ + تَّخَلُّص + ِ — al-, the + takhalluṣ, escaping, getting free (V verbal noun; gen. after fī; takes min 'from'); 'the escaping'
غُرَابًا: غُرَاب + ًا — ghurāb, crow, raven (m.; acc. indef., noun of anna); 'a crow'
وَسِنَّوْرًا: وَ + سِنَّوْر + ًا — wa-, and (conj.) + sinnawr, cat (m.; acc. indef., coordinated with ghurāban); 'and a cat'
مُتَأَخِّيَيْنِ: مُتَأَخِّيَيْنِ — mutaʾakhkhiyayni, having taken each other as brothers (act. part. V of taʾakhkhā, defective, dual; acc. dual, predicate of kānā, has the same form as the genitive); 'brothers to each other'
إِذْرَأَ: إِذْ + رَأَ — idh, when (suddenly), after baynamā + raʾa-, the first part of raʾayā, to see (I, perf. 3rd m. dual), which the print splits as رأ يا, the يا set as the next word; 'when (suddenly) they saw'
نَمِرًا: نَمِر + ًا — namir, leopard (m.; acc. indef., object of raʾayā); 'a leopard'
مُقْبِلًا: مُقْبِل + ًا — muqbil, advancing, approaching (act. part. IV of aqbala; acc. indef., ḥāl; takes ʿalā 'towards'); 'advancing'
يَعْلَمَا: يَعْلَمَا — yaʿlamā, to know (I, imperf. 3rd m. dual, jussive after lam; takes bi- of the thing, bihi); 'did not know (of him)'
الْغُرَابُ: الـ + غُرَاب + ُ — al-, the + ghurāb, crow (m.; nom., subject of ṭāra, qāla); 'the crow'
السِّنَّوْرُ: الـ + سِّنَّوْر + ُ — al-, the + sinnawr, cat (m.; nom., subject of baqiya); 'the cat'
لِلْغُرَابِ: لِـ + الـ + غُرَاب + ِ — li-, to (prep.; qāla li- 'say to' someone, the person addressed) + al-, the + ghurāb, crow (m.; gen. after li-); 'to the crow'
تُلْتَمَسُ: تُلْتَمَسُ — tultamasu, to seek, look for (VIII, imperf. 3rd f.s. passive, indic.; subject al-ikhwānu, a broken plural taking a feminine verb); 'are sought'
الْإِخْوَانُ: الـ + إِخْوَان + ُ — al-, the + ikhwān, brothers (broken pl. of akh; nom., subject of the passive tultamasu); 'the brothers'
الْحَاجَةِ: الـ + حَاجَة + ِ — al-, the + ḥāja, need (f.; gen., second term of the construct after ʿinda; takes ilā 'for'); 'the need'
الْمَكْرُوهِ: الـ + مَكْرُوه + ِ — al-, the + makrūh, the hateful, misfortune (pass. part. I of kariha used as noun; gen., second term of the construct nuzūl al-makrūh); 'the hateful (thing)'
صَدِيْقَ: صَدِيق + َ — ṣadīq, friend (m.; acc. ṣadīqa, printed صَدِيْقَ; noun of inna, in construct with al-ḥaqq); 'the friend (of the truth)'
مَعَكْ: مَعَ + كَ — maʿa, with (prep., adverb of accompaniment) + -ka, you (suffix; print has sukūn on the final letter for the verse rhyme, maʿak); 'with you'
يَضُرُّ: يَضُرُّ — yaḍurru, to harm (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., geminate, indic.; the print has damma, in the verse after man); 'harms'
لِيَنْفَعَكْ: لِـ + يَنْفَعَ + كَ — li-, so that (conj. li- + subjunctive, purpose) + yanfaʿa, to benefit (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., subj.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix; print has sukūn for the rhyme); 'so that he may benefit you'
رَيْبُ: رَيْب + ُ — rayb, doubt, mischance (m.; nom., subject of ṣaddaʿa, in construct with al-zamān); 'the mischance'
صَدَّعَكَ: صَدَّعَ + كَ — ṣaddaʿa, to split, break apart (II, perf. 3rd m.s.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'has split you'
شَتَّتَ: شَتَّتَ — shattata, to scatter, disperse (II, perf. 3rd m.s., geminate; apodosis of the clause with idhā; takes fī 'for', fīka); 'scatters'
لِيَجْمَعَكَ: لِـ + يَجْمَعَ + كَ — li-, so that (conj. li- + subjunctive, purpose) + yajmaʿa, to gather (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., subj.) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'so that he may gather you'
رُعَاةٌ: رُعَاة + ٌ — ruʿāt, herdsmen (broken pl. of rāʿin; nom. indef., subject of kāna, postponed after the predicate qarīban); 'herdsmen'
وَنَعَقَ: وَ + نَعَقَ — wa-, and (conj.) + naʿaqa, to croak, caw (I, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'and croaked'
أَثَرِهِ: أَثَر + ِ + هِ — athar, track, trace (m.; gen. after fī) + -hi, his (suffix); 'his track'
يَطِيرُ: يَطِيرُ — yaṭīru, to fly (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow, indic.; ḥāl after ṭāʾiran); 'flying'
لَايَطِيرُ: لَا + يَطِيرُ — lā, not (negative) + yaṭīru, to fly (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., hollow, indic.; after ṣāra, 'came to not fly'); printed run together; 'did not fly'
وَالْخَلَاصِ: وَ + الـ + خَلَاص + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + khalāṣ, getting free, deliverance (m.; gen., coordinated with al-najāt; takes min 'from', min al-kilāb); 'and the getting free'
وَيُطْمِعُهَا: وَ + يُطْمِعُ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + yuṭmiʿu, to make covet, tempt (IV, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; takes fī + an 'to make covet (that)') + -hā, them (acc. suffix, the dogs, fem. sing. of a plural of non-persons); 'and he made them covet'
تَفْتَرِسَهُ: تَفْتَرِسَ + هُ — taftarisa, to seize, tear apart (VIII, imperf. 3rd f.s., subj. after an; subject the dogs) + -hu, him (acc. suffix); 'seize him'
ارْتَفَعَ: اِرْتَفَعَ — irtafaʿa, to rise (VIII, perf. 3rd m.s.); 'he rose'
النَّمِرُ: الـ + نَّمِر + ُ — al-, the + namir, leopard (m.; nom., postponed subject after the predicate taḥtahā); 'the leopard'
النَّمِرَ: الـ + نَّمِر + َ — al-, the + namir, leopard (m.; acc., object of raʾat); 'the leopard'
الْقِطَّ: الـ + قِطَّ — al-, the + qiṭṭ, tomcat, cat (m.; acc., object of yaʾkulu); 'the cat'
فَنَجَى: فَ + نَجَى — fa-, and so (conj.) + najā, to escape (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; print has yāʾ for the alif; takes min 'from', minhu); 'and so (it) escaped'
الْغُرَابِ: الـ + غُرَاب + ِ — al-, the + ghurāb, crow (m.; gen., after a preposition or as second term of a construct, or in apposition, as in ṣāḥibihi al-ghurābi, 'his companion the crow'); 'the crow'
مَوَدَّةَ: مَوَدَّة + َ — mawadda, affection, friendship (f.; acc., noun of anna); 'the affection'
الصَّفَا: الـ + صَّفَا — al-, the + ṣafā, purity, sincerity (m.; gen., second term of the construct ikhwāni al-ṣafā, 'brothers of purity'); 'of purity'
تُخَلِّصُ: تُخَلِّصُ — tukhalliṣu, to deliver, free (II, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic.; subject mawaddata; predicate of anna); 'delivers'
وَتُنْجِي: وَ + تُنْجِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tunjī, to save, rescue (IV, imperf. 3rd f.s., defective, indic.; takes min 'from') ; 'and saves'
وَالْوُقُوعِ: وَ + الـ + وُقُوع + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + wuqūʿ, falling (I verbal noun; gen., coordinated with al-halakāt after min; takes fī 'into'); 'and the falling'
الْمَعَاطِبِ: الـ + مَعَاطِب + ِ — al-, the + maʿāṭib, places of ruin, perils (broken pl. of maʿṭab; gen. after fī, 'into the places of ruin'); 'the perils'
يَأْكُلْ: يَأْكُلْ — yaʾkul, to eat (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive after lam; subject the fox/father animal); 'did not eat'
وَخَلَّاهُ: وَ + خَلَّا + هُ — wa-, and (conj., continues the lam-clause) + khallā, to leave alone, let be (II, perf. 3rd m.s., defective) + -hu, him/it (acc. suffix); 'and left it alone'
وَيَقْعُدْ: وَ + يَقْعُدْ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaqʿud, to sit (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive, coordinated with the lam-verb); 'and sat'
وَيَحْفَظْهُ: وَ + يَحْفَظْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḥfaẓ, to keep, guard (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive) + -hu, him/it (acc. suffix); 'and kept it'
وَيَحْرُسْهُ: وَ + يَحْرُسْ + هُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḥrus, to guard, watch over (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., jussive) + -hu, him/it (acc. suffix); 'and guarded it'
ذِرْوَةِ: ذِرْوَة + ِ — dhirwa, summit, top (f.; gen., first term of the iḍāfa after ilā); 'the summit (of)'
أَعْقِدَ: أَعْقِدَ — aʿqida, to tie, make (a bond) (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an; governs mawadda as object); 'tie'
مَوَدَّةً: مَوَدَّةً — mawadda, affection, friendship (f.; acc. indef., object of aʿqida); 'an affection'
مُؤْنِسًا: مُؤْنِسًا — muʾnis, companion, one who gives company (act. part. IV of ānasa; acc. indef., second object of ajʿalahu); 'a companion'
مُعَاوِنًا: مُعَاوِنًا — muʿāwin, helper (act. part. III of ʿāwana; acc. indef., second object of ajʿalahu, in apposition to muʾnisan); 'a helper'
يَاجَارِي: يَا + جَارِ + ي — yā, O (vocative particle) + jār, neighbour (m.; acc. as vocative muḍāf, written without tanwīn) + -ī, my (suffix); 'O my neighbour'
حَقَّيْنِ: حَقَّيْنِ — ḥaqq, right, due (m.; dual acc., the delayed noun of inna, whose predicate is the preceding li-al-jāri, 'two rights'); 'two rights'
الْجِيرَةِ: الـ + جِيرَة + ِ — al-, the + jīra, neighbourliness (f.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa ḥaqqa al-jīrati); 'of neighbourliness'
وَحَقَّ: وَ + حَقَّ — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaqq, right, due (m.; acc., apposition to ḥaqqayni, first term of ḥaqqa al-islāmi); 'and the right (of)'; also the verb: wa- + ḥaqqa, to be due, rightful (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms); wa-ḥaqqa lī, 'and it is my right' (Night 182)
جَارِي: جَارِ + ي — jār, neighbour (m.; nom., predicate of anna, 'that you are') + -ī, my (suffix); 'my neighbour'
قَضَاؤُهُ: قَضَاؤُ + هُ — qaḍāʾ, discharging, fulfilling (I verbal noun of qaḍā; nom., subject of yajibu) + -hu, its/his (suffix); 'its discharge'
الْمُجَاوَرَةِ: الـ + مُجَاوَرَة + ِ — al-, the + mujāwara, neighbouring, living next door (III verbal noun; gen., second term of the iḍāfa after ṭūl); 'of neighbourliness'
وَدِيعَةً: وَدِيعَةً — wadīʿa, deposit, thing left in trust (f.; acc. indef., delayed noun of anna after the predicate fī ṣadrī); 'a deposit'
مُلَاطَفَتِكَ: مُلَاطَفَة + ِ + كَ — mulāṭafa, treating kindly (III verbal noun; gen. after ilā, the preposition chosen by daʿā ilā 'summon to') + -ka, your (suffix, object of the verbal noun); 'treating you kindly'
وَبَعَثَتْنِي: وَ + بَعَثَتْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + baʿathat, to rouse, urge (I, perf. 3rd f.s.; subject wadīʿa; takes ʿalā 'urge to') + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'and it roused me'
الْتِمَاسِ: الْتِمَاس + ِ — iltimās, seeking, asking for (VIII verbal noun of iltamasa; no article: the alif-lām belongs to the stem; gen. after ʿalā, the preposition chosen by baʿatha ʿalā, 'urged to'; first term of iltimāsi ukhuwwatika); 'seeking (your brotherhood)'
أُخُوَّتِكَ: أُخُوَّة + ِ + كَ — ukhuwwa, brotherhood (f.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your brotherhood'
بِلِسَانِكَ: بِ + لِسَان + ِ + كَ — bi-, with (prep., instrument: 'with your tongue') + lisān, tongue (m.; gen. after bi-) + -ka, your (suffix); 'with your tongue'
مَالَيْسَ: مَا + لَيْسَ — mā, what (relative, 'that which', object of tataḥaddathu) + laysa, is not (defective verb, perf. 3rd m.s.); printed run together; 'what is not'
وَأَخْشَى: وَ + أَخْشَى — wa-, and (conj.) + akhshā, to fear (I, imperf. 1st s., indic., defective; takes an 'fear that'); 'and I fear'
أُخُوَّتُكَ: أُخُوَّة + ُ + كَ — ukhuwwa, brotherhood (f.; nom., subject of takūna) + -ka, your (suffix); 'your brotherhood'
بِاللِّسَانِ: بِ + الـ + لِسَان + ِ — bi-, with, by (prep., 'by the tongue', i.e. in speech only) + al-, the + lisān, tongue (m.; gen. after bi-); 'by the tongue'
وَعَدَاوَتُكَ: وَ + عَدَاوَة + ُ + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + ʿadāwa, enmity (f.; nom., coordinated with ukhuwwatuka as subject of takūna, understood) + -ka, your (suffix); 'and your enmity'
آكِلٌ: آكِلٌ — ākil, eater, one who eats (act. part. I of akala; nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'an eater'
مَأْكُولٌ: مَأْكُولٌ — maʾkūl, eaten, prey (pass. part. I of akala; nom. indef., predicate of anā); 'eaten (prey)'
فَوَجَبَ: فَ + وَجَبَ — fa-, so, therefore (conj., consequence) + wajaba, to be necessary, binding (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes li- of the person, 'it is incumbent on us'); 'so it follows'
التَّبَايُنُ: الـ + تَّبَايُن + ُ — al-, the + tabāyun, mutual difference, being apart (VI verbal noun; nom., subject of wajaba); 'the being apart'
وَالْمُوَاصَلَةِ: وَ + الـ + مُوَاصَلَة + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + muwāṣala, keeping company, maintaining ties (III verbal noun; gen., coordinated after fī); 'and keeping company'
دَعَاكَ: دَعَا + كَ — daʿā, to call, summon (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; takes ilā 'call to'; subject alladhī) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'called you'
مَالَاتُدْرِكُ: مَا + لَا + تُدْرِكُ — mā, what (relative) + lā, not (negative) + tudriku, to attain (IV, imperf. 2nd m.s., indic.); printed run together; 'what you do not attain'
وَإِرَادَةِ: وَ + إِرَادَة + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + irāda, wanting (IV verbal noun; gen., coordinated with ṭalab after ilā; first term of irādati mā); 'and the wanting (of)'
الْأُخُوَّةُ: الـ + أُخُوَّة + ُ — al-, the + ukhuwwa, brotherhood (f.; nom., subject, in apposition to hādhihi); 'brotherhood'
وَلَاتَصِحُّ: وَ + لَا + تَصِحُّ — wa-, and (conj.) + lā, does not (negative) + taṣiḥḥu, to be sound, valid (I, imperf. 3rd f.s., indic., geminate; subject al-ukhuwwa); printed run together; 'and does not hold good'
الْأَجِلَّاءِ: الـ + أَجِلَّاء + ِ — al-, the + ajillāʾ, noble ones (m. pl., broken plural of jalīl; gen., second term of the iḍāfa mawḍiʿa al-ajillāʾi); 'the noble'
فَأَحْسَنَ: فَ + أَحْسَنَ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + aḥsana, to do well (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; part of the subject clause man ʿalima…); 'and does well'
الِاخْتِيَارَ: الـ + اِخْتِيَار + َ — al-, the + ikhtiyār, choosing (VIII verbal noun; acc., object of aḥsana); 'the choosing'
يَخْتَارُهُ: يَخْتَارُ + هُ — yakhtāru, to choose (VIII, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; relative clause after mā) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, returning to the relative); 'he chooses'
مَنَافِعِ: مَنَافِع + ِ — manāfiʿ, benefits (broken plural of manfaʿa, f.; gen. after ilā, the preposition chosen by waṣala ilā 'reach'; first term of the iḍāfa); 'the benefits (of)'
الْإِخْوَانِ: الـ + إِخْوَان + ِ — al-, the + ikhwān, brothers (m. pl., broken plural of akh; gen., second term of the iḍāfa); 'the brothers'
أَغْرَاضِنَا: أَغْرَاض + ِ + نَا — aghrāḍ, aims, purposes (broken plural of gharaḍ; gen. after ʿalā, 'in/for our aims') + -nā, our (suffix); 'our aims'
وَتُعْقِبَ: وَ + تُعْقِبَ — wa-, and (conj., continues li-yakūna, so the verb is subjunctive) + tuʿqiba, to bring after, result in (IV, imperf. 3rd f.s., subjunctive; subject mawaddatunā); 'and may bring'
مَوَدَّتُنَا: مَوَدَّة + ُ + نَا — mawadda, affection (f.; nom., subject of tuʿqiba) + -nā, our (suffix); 'our affection'
نَجَاحًا: نَجَاحًا — najāḥ, success (m.; acc. indef., object of tuʿqiba); 'success'
حِكَايَاتٌ: حِكَايَاتٌ — ḥikāya, tale, story (f.; sound f. plural ḥikāyāt; nom. indef., delayed subject after the predicate ʿindī); 'tales'
أَحْكِيَهَا: أَحْكِيَ + هَا — aḥkiya, to relate, tell (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an) + -hā, them (acc. suffix, the tales); 'I tell them'
حَكَيْتُهَا: حَكَيْتُ + هَا — ḥakaytu, to relate, tell (I, perf. 1st s., defective; apodosis of the conditional) + -hā, them (acc. suffix); 'I will tell them'
أَذِنْتُ: أَذِنْتُ — adhintu, to permit (I, perf. 1st s.; takes li- of the person and fī 'allow in'); 'I have allowed'
تَبُثَّهَا: تَبُثَّ + هَا — tabuththa, to spread, disclose (I, imperf. 2nd m.s., subjunctive after an, geminate) + -hā, them (acc. suffix); 'you tell them'
وَحَدِّثْنِى: وَ + حَدِّثْ + نِي — wa-, and (conj.) + ḥaddith, to relate (II, imperative m.s.; takes bi- of the thing told) + -nī, me (acc. suffix); 'and tell me'
حَتِّي: حَتَّى — ḥattā, so that, until (particle governing the subjunctive; here purpose, 'so that I may hear'); 'so that'
وَأَعِيَهَا: وَ + أَعِيَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿiya, to retain, take in (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after ḥattā; doubly weak verb waʿā (w-ʿ-y)) + -hā, them (acc. suffix); 'and take them in'
وَأَعْرِفَ: وَ + أَعْرِفَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aʿrifa, to know (I, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after ḥattā, coordinated); 'and know'
بُرْغُوثٍ: بُرْغُوثٍ — burghūth, flea (m.; gen. indef. after ʿan, which yuḥkā takes 'is told about'); 'a flea'; here gen. as second term of an iḍāfa: fī ṣūrati burghūthin, 'in the form of a flea' (Night 182)
وَفَأْرَةٍ: وَ + فَأْرَة + ٍ — wa-, and (conj.) + faʾra, mouse (f.; gen. indef., coordinated after ʿan); 'and a mouse'
يُسْتَدَلُّ: يُسْتَدَلُّ — yustadallu, to take as evidence, infer (X, imperf. 3rd m.s., passive; geminate; takes bi- of the evidence, 'is inferred by it'); 'is taken as proof'
فَارَةً: فَارَةً — fāra, mouse (f.; acc. indef., noun of anna; the variant spelling of faʾra); 'a mouse'
التِّجَارَةِ: الـ + تِّجَارَة + ِ — al-, the + tijāra, trade, commerce (f.; gen., second term of the iḍāfa ʿaẓīmi al-tijārati); 'in trade'
فَأَوَى: فَ + أَوَى — fa-, and so (conj., narrative sequence) + awā, to take refuge, resort (I, perf. 3rd m.s., defective; takes ilā 'betake oneself to'); 'and so resorted'
الْبُرْغُوثُ: الـ + بُرْغُوث + ُ — al-, the + burghūth, flea (m.; nom., subject of awā); 'the flea'
فِرَاشِ: فِرَاش + ِ — firāsh, bed, bedding (m.; gen. after ilā, first term of the iḍāfa); 'the bed (of)'
بَدَنًا: بَدَنًا — badan, body (m.; acc. indef., object of wajada); 'a body'
نَاعِمًا: نَاعِمًا — nāʿim, soft, tender (act. part. I of naʿuma; acc. indef., adjective of badanan); 'soft'
عَطْشَانًا: عَطْشَانًا — ʿaṭshān, thirsty (m.; acc. indef. with tanwīn, as the print's final alif shows (Classical treats it as a diptote, ʿaṭshāna), predicate of kāna); 'thirsty'
الْبُرْغُوثِ: الـ + بُرْغُوث + ِ — al-, the + burghūth, flea (m.; gen. after min, 'from the flea', source of the pain); 'the flea'
لِجَوَارِيهِ: لِ + جَوَارِي + هِ — li-, to (prep., marks the person called: nādā li- 'call to') + jawārī, slave-girls (broken plural of jāriya; gen. after li-, defective) + -hi, his (suffix); 'to his slave-girls'
وَبَعْضِ: وَ + بَعْض + ِ — wa-, and (conj.) + baʿḍ, some, part (m.; gen., coordinated after li-, first term of baʿḍi atbāʿihi); 'and to some (of)'
أَتْبَاعِهِ: أَتْبَاع + ِ + هِ — atbāʿ, followers, attendants (broken plural of tābiʿ; gen., second term of the iḍāfa) + -hi, his (suffix); 'his followers'
فَأَسْرَعُوا: فَ + أَسْرَعُوا — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + asraʿū, to hasten (IV, perf. 3rd m. pl.; takes ilā 'hasten to'); 'and so they hastened'
وَشَمَّرُوا: وَ + شَمَّرُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + shammarū, to tuck up, roll up (sleeves) (II, perf. 3rd m. pl.; takes ʿan 'bare'); 'and rolled up'
بِالطَّلَبِ: بِ + الـ + طَّلَب + ِ — bi-, of, about (prep., after aḥassa 'sense': aḥassa bi- 'perceive') + al-, the + ṭalab, search, pursuit (I verbal noun; gen. after bi-); 'the pursuit'
فَصَادَفَ: فَ + صَادَفَ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + ṣādafa, to come upon, happen on (III, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject the flea); 'and so came upon'
جُحْرَ: جُحْر + َ — juḥr, hole, burrow (m.; acc., object of ṣādafa, first term of the iḍāfa); 'the hole (of)'
فَدَخَلَهُ: فَ + دَخَلَ + هُ — fa-, and so (conj., sequence) + dakhala, to enter (I, perf. 3rd m.s.; takes direct object of a place) + -hu, it (acc. suffix, the hole); 'and so entered it'
أَدْخَلَكَ: أَدْخَلَ + كَ — adkhala, to cause to enter, bring in (IV, perf. 3rd m.s.; subject alladhī) + -ka, you (acc. suffix); 'brought you in'
جَوْهَرِي: جَوْهَر + ِ + ي — jawhar, substance, essence, stock (m.; gen. after min, 'of my substance') + -ī, my (suffix); 'my substance'
بِآمِنٍ: بِ + آمِنٍ — bi-, redundant particle on the predicate of a negated verb (lastu bi-, 'I am not' — adds emphasis, no separate meaning) + āmin, safe, secure (act. part. I of amina; gen. after bi-, takes min 'safe from'); 'safe'
الْغِلْظَةِ: الـ + غِلْظَة + ِ — al-, the + ghilẓa, harshness, roughness (f.; gen. after min, 'from harshness'); 'harshness'
الْمُنَازَعَةِ: الـ + مُنَازَعَة + ِ — al-, the + munāzaʿa, contention, quarrelling (III verbal noun; gen., coordinated after min, 'nor from contending'); 'contention'
مُضَارَرَتِكَ: مُضَارَرَة + ِ + كَ — muḍārara, harming, injuring (III verbal noun; gen., coordinated after min) + -ka, you (object suffix of the verbal noun, 'harming you'); 'harming you'
وَفُزْتُ: وَ + فُزْتُ — wa-, and (conj.) + fuztu, to win, escape (I, perf. 1st s., hollow; takes bi- of what one carries off, 'escaped with my soul'); 'and escaped'
وَأَتَيْتُكِ: وَ + أَتَيْتُ + كِ — wa-, and (conj.) + ataytu, to come to (I, perf. 1st s., defective; direct object takes no preposition) + -ki, you (f. acc. suffix); 'and came to you'
مُسْتَجِيرًا: مُسْتَجِيرًا — mustajīr, seeking protection (act. part. X of ajāra; acc. indef., ḥāl of the speaker; takes bi- of the protector, 'seeking refuge with you'); 'seeking protection'
طَمَعَ: طَمَع — ṭamaʿ, covetousness, greed (m.; nom., noun of lā of absolute negation, built without tanwīn; takes fī 'greed for'); 'no covetousness'
يَلْحَقُكِ: يَلْحَقُ + كِ — yalḥaqu, to reach, overtake (I, imperf. 3rd m.s., indic.; subject sharr) + -ki, you (f. acc. suffix); 'will reach you'
أُكَافِئَكِ: أُكَافِئَ + كِ — ukāfiʾa, to requite, repay (III, imperf. 1st s., subjunctive after an; takes ʿalā of the kindness, 'repay for') + -ki, you (f. acc. suffix); 'I repay you'
تَجِدِينَ: تَجِدِينَ — tajidīna, to find (I, imperf. 2nd f.s., indic.; assimilated verb wajada; the mouse is addressed); 'you will find'
وَتَحْمَدِينَ: وَ + تَحْمَدِينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taḥmadīna, to praise, approve (I, imperf. 2nd f.s., indic.; object ʿāqibata mā aqūlu); 'and you will approve'
وَأَخْبَرْتَ: وَ + أَخْبَرْتَ — wa-, and + akhbarta, you told (IV akhbara, perf. 2ms); 'and (as) you told'
فَاطْمَئِنَّ: فَـ + اطْمَئِنَّ — fa-, then (introducing the answer to idhā) + iṭmaʾinna, be at ease (imperative 2ms of iṭmaʾanna, quadriliteral IV); 'then be at rest'
مَطَرُ: مَطَر + ُ — maṭar, rain (m.; nom., subject after mā … illā); maṭaru al-salāma, 'the rain of safety' (doubtful phrase)
يُصِيبُنِي: يُصِيبُ + ـنِي — yuṣību, it befalls (IV aṣāba, impf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'befalls me'
تَنْدَمْ: تَنْدَمْ — tandam, you regret (I nadima, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā); 'do not regret'
تَأْسَفْ: تَأْسَفْ — taʾsaf, you grieve (I asifa, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā); 'do not grieve'
قُوتِكَ: قُوت + ِ + ـكَ — qūt, food, sustenance (m.; gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your; 'your sustenance'
وَارْضَ: وَ + ارْضَ — wa-, and + irḍa, be content (imperative 2ms of raḍiya, which takes bi- for what one is content with)
بِبُلْغَةٍ: بِـ + بُلْغَة + ٍ — bi-, with (restating the bi- governed by irḍa, 'content with') + bulgha, bare sufficiency, just enough to live on (f.); 'with a bare sufficiency'
الْوُعَّاظِ: الـ + وُعَّاظ + ِ — al-, the + wuʿʿāẓ, preachers (pl. of wāʿiẓ; gen. after min, 'of, among')
الْقَنَاعَةَ: الـ + قَنَاعَة + َ — al-, the + qanāʿa, contentment (f.; acc., object of salaktu)
وَالْاِنْفِرَادَ: وَ + الـ + اِنْفِرَاد + َ — wa-, and + al-, the + infirād, keeping apart, solitude (VII verbal noun; acc.); verse spelling, the print's bare alif with kasra
وَقَضَّيْتُ: وَ + قَضَّيْتُ — wa-, and + qaḍḍaytu, I spent (II qaḍḍā, perf. 1cs; qaḍḍā dahrahu, 'spend one's lifetime')
بِمَاذَا: بِـ + مَاذَا — bi-, with, on (what one lives by) + mādhā, what(ever) (here indefinite relative); 'on whatever'
اتَّفَقْ: اتَّفَقْ — ittafaq(a), it chanced, happened to come (VIII ittafaqa, perf. 3ms; pausal sukūn for the rhyme)
بِكَسْرَةِ: بِـ + كَسْرَة + ِ — bi-, with, on (what one lives by) + kisra, a broken piece (of bread) (f.); 'on a crust (of)'
وَشِرْبَةِ: وَ + شِرْبَة + ِ — wa-, and + shirba, a drink, a draught (f.; gen., coordinated, first term of a construct)
وَمِلْحٍ: وَ + مِلْح + ٍ — wa-, and + milḥ, salt (m.; gen., coordinated)
وَثَوْبٍ: وَ + ثَوْب + ٍ — wa-, and + thawb, garment, robe (m.; gen., coordinated)
خَلِقْ: خَلِقْ — khaliq, worn-out, threadbare (adj.; pausal sukūn for the rhyme)
يَسَّرَ: يَسَّرَ — yassara, he made easy (II, perf. 3ms; after in, 'if (God) makes easy')
عِيْشَتِيْ: عِيْشَة + ِ + ـيْ — ʿīsha, manner of living, livelihood (f.; gen. after fī) + -ī, my; the print's verse spelling with sukūn on the long vowels
وَاِلَّا: وَ + اِنْ + لَا — wa-, and + in lā, if not (written illā); 'and if not'; verse spelling with bare alif and kasra
قَنَعْتُ: قَنَعْتُ — qanaʿtu, I am content (I qaniʿa/qanaʿa, perf. 1cs; takes bi- for what one is content with); the print points qanaʿtu
رُزِقْ: رُزِقْ — ruziq(a), it was granted as provision (I razaqa, passive perf. 3ms; pausal sukūn); bi-mā qad ruziq, 'with what has been provided'
وَصِيَّتَكِ: وَصِيَّة + َ + ـكِ — waṣiyya, counsel, charge (f.; acc., object of samiʿtu) + -ki, your (f.); 'your counsel'
مُخَالَفَتِكِ: مُخَالَفَة + ِ + ـكِ — mukhālafa, opposing, going against (III verbal noun; gen. after ʿalā) + -ki, you (f.); 'going against you'
يَنْقَضِيَ: يَنْقَضِيَ — yanqaḍiya, it comes to an end (VII inqaḍā, subj. 3ms after an); 'until (life) is ended'
فَاتَّصَلَ: فَـ + اتَّصَلَ — fa-, so + ittaṣala, it was joined, ran on unbroken (VIII, perf. 3ms)
الْوُدُّ: الـ + وُدّ + ُ — al-, the + wudd, love, affection (m.; nom., subject of ittaṣala); the shadda is printed
يَتَجَاوَزُ: يَتَجَاوَزُ — yatajāwazu, he goes beyond, oversteps (VI tajāwaza, impf. 3ms)
بُلْغَتَهُ: بُلْغَة + َ + ـهُ — bulgha, bare sufficiency (f.; acc., object of yatajāwazu) + -hu, his; 'his bare sufficiency'
بِدَنَانِيرَ: بِـ + دَنَانِير + َ — bi-, with (jāʾa bi-, 'come with, bring': the verb chooses bi-) + danānīr, dinars (pl. of dīnār, diptote: gen. in -a, no tanwīn); 'with dinars'
يُقَلِّبُهَا: يُقَلِّبُ + ـهَا — yuqallibu, he turns over and over (II qallaba, impf. 3ms) + -hā, them (the dinars); 'turning them over'
وَضَعَهَا: وَضَعَ + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, he put, laid (I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, them (the dinars); 'he laid them'
لِلْبُرْغُوثِ: لِـ + الـ + بُرْغُوث + ِ — li-, to (marking the one addressed after qālat) + al-, the + burghūth, flea (m.; gen.); 'to the flea'
الْفُرْصَةَ: الـ + فُرْصَة + َ — al-, the + furṣa, opportunity, chance (f.; acc., object of tarā)
الْمُمَكَّنَةَ: الـ + مُمَكَّنَة + َ — al-, the + mumakkana, made possible, put within reach (II passive participle of makkana, f.; acc., agreeing with al-furṣa); the shadda is printed; mumakkina, 'giving the power', is also possible
وَالْحَظَّ: وَ + الـ + حَظّ + َ — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥaẓẓ, luck, good fortune (m.; acc., coordinated)
تُوصِلُنَا: تُوصِلُ + ـنَا — tūṣilu, it brings, conveys (IV awṣala, impf. 3fs, agreeing with ḥīla) + -nā, us; 'that brings us'
بُلُوغِ: بُلُوغ + ِ — bulūgh, reaching, attaining (verbal noun of balagha; gen. after ilā, first term of a construct)
الْغَرَضِ: الـ + غَرَض + ِ — al-, the + gharaḍ, aim, object of desire (m.; gen., second term of a construct)
الْغَرَضَ: الـ + غَرَض + َ — al-, the + gharaḍ, aim, object of desire (m.; acc., object of ṭalaba)
قَادِرًا: قَادِر + ًا — qādir, able (active participle of qadara; acc., predicate of yakūna); qādir ʿalā, 'able to do'
يَحْذَرُهُ: يَحْذَرُ + ـهُ — yaḥdharu, he fears, guards against (I ḥadhira, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'what he dreads'
يُدْرِكْ: يُدْرِكْ — yudrik, he attains (IV adraka, jussive 3ms after lam); 'he did not attain'
الضَّعْفِ: الـ + ضَعْف + ِ — al-, the + ḍaʿf, weakness (m.; gen. after maʿa)
اسْتَحْكَمَتْ: اسْتَحْكَمَتْ — istaḥkamat, it was made firm, became strong (X istaḥkama, perf. 3fs, agreeing with quwwa)
قُوَّةُ: قُوَّة + ُ — quwwa, strength, power (f.; nom., subject of istaḥkamat; first term of a construct)
يَلْتَقِطُ: يَلْتَقِطُ — yaltaqiṭu, he picks up (VIII iltaqaṭa, impf. 3ms)
فَيَقَعُ: فَـ + يَقَعُ — fa-, and so + yaqaʿu, he falls (I waqaʿa, impf. 3ms)
فَيَقْتَنِصُهُ: فَـ + يَقْتَنِصُ + ـهُ — fa-, and then + yaqtaniṣu, he snares, hunts (VIII iqtanaṣa, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and (its hunter) snares it'
صَائِدُهُ: صَائِد + ُ + ـهُ — ṣāʾid, hunter, fowler (active participle of ṣāda; nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'its hunter'

وَشَأْنُكِ: وَ + شَأْن + ُ + ـكِ — wa-, and + shaʾn, affair, business (m.; nom.) + -ki, your (f.); anti wa-shaʾnuki, 'you and your business', i.e. do as you please

أَعْدَدْتُ: أَعْدَدْتُ — aʿadda, form IV, to prepare, make ready (1s past); 'I have prepared'
جُحْرِي: جُحْر + ـِي — juḥr, hole, burrow (m.) + 1s possessive; 'my hole'
مَنْفَذًا: مَنْفَذ — manfadh, outlet, way through, passage (m.; acc. indef., counted after sabʿīna); 'outlets'

حَرِيزًا: حَرِيز — ḥarīz, well-guarded, secure (adj., acc. indef.); 'secure'
تَحَيَّلْتَ: تَحَيَّلْتَ — taḥayyala, form V (root ḥ-w-l), to use a stratagem, contrive (2ms past, in a condition after in); 'you contrive'

فَرَقَدَ: فَـ + رَقَدَ — fa-, so + raqada, to lie down, sleep (3ms past); 'so he lay down'

وَفَارَقَ: وَ + فَارَقَ — wa-, and + fāraqa, form III, to leave, part from (3ms past); 'and he left'
مَضْجَعَهُ: مَضْجَع + ـَهُ — maḍjaʿ, place of lying down, bed (m.; acc.) + 3ms possessive; 'his bed'
مِصْطَبَةٍ: مِصْطَبَة — miṣṭaba, stone bench, raised seat built against a house front (f.; gen. indef. after ilā); 'a bench'
الْفَأْرَهَ: الـ + فَأْرَة — faʾra, mouse (f.; acc. after inna); the edition prints final ه for ة; 'the mouse'
نَقْلِ: نَقْل — naql, moving, carrying from place to place (verbal noun of naqala; gen. after ʿalā); 'the carrying'
يَتَّهِمُ: يَتَّهِمُ — ittahama, form VIII (root w-h-m), to suspect, accuse (impf. 3ms); 'he suspects'
وَيَظُنُّ: وَ + يَظُنُّ — wa-, and + ẓanna, to think, suppose, suspect (impf. 3ms); 'and he thinks'
الظُّنُونَ: الـ + ظُنُون — ẓunūn, pl. of ẓann, thought, supposition, suspicion (acc., internal object of yaẓunnu); 'the suspicions'

لِلْفَأْرَةِ: لِـ + الـ + فَأْرَة — li-, to (prep., here marking whom something reaches, with waṣala) + al-, the + faʾra, mouse (gen.); 'to the mouse'

جَازَاهَا: جَازَى + ـهَا — jāzā, form III, to repay, requite (3ms past) + 3fs obj.; 'he repaid her'
وَكَافَأَهَا: وَ + كَافَأَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + kāfaʾa, form III, to reward, requite in equal measure (3ms past) + 3fs obj.; the hamza is the print's own; 'and he rewarded her'
الْمُحْسِنُ: الـ + مُحْسِن — muḥsin, one who does good, benefactor (act. part. of form IV aḥsana; nom.); 'the doer of good'
وَاجِبًا: وَاجِب — wājib, obligatory, binding, owed (act. part.; acc. indef., predicate of laysa); 'obligatory'
الْتَمَسَ: الْتَمَسَ — iltamasa, form VIII (root l-m-s), to seek, request (3ms past); 'he seeks'
صِلَةً: صِلَة — ṣila, joining, tie; a gift or kindness that binds (f.; acc. indef.); 'a bond'
بِقَطِيعَةٍ: بِـ + قَطِيعَة — bi-, with, along with (or 'in exchange for') (prep.) + qaṭīʿa, cutting off, estrangement (f.; gen. indef.); 'with estrangement'
أَحْسَنْتُ: أَحْسَنْتُ — aḥsana, form IV, to do good (1s past; with ilā, 'to do good to'); the ḍamma on the t is the print's own; 'I do good'
تَسَبَّبْتُ: تَسَبَّبْتُ — tasabbaba, form V, to be the cause (1s past; with fī, 'of'); 'I have caused'
قَطِيعَةِ: قَطِيعَة — qaṭīʿa, cutting off, severance; ruin (f.; gen. after fī, in construct); 'the cutting off (of)'

الْمَكْرُ: الـ + مَكْر — makr, guile, cunning, plotting (m.; nom.); 'the guile'

أَمَانَ: أَمَان — amān, safety, security; trustworthiness (m.; acc. after lā of absolute negation); 'no safety'
وَمَكَرْتَ: وَ + مَكَرْتَ — wa-, and + makara, to plot, use guile (2ms past; with bi-, 'against'); 'and you plotted'

جِنْسِكَ: جِنْس + ـِكَ — jins, kind, species (m.; gen. after min) + 2ms possessive; 'your kind'
أَبْقَيْتَ: أَبْقَيْتَ — abqā, form IV, to spare (2ms past; with ʿalā, 'to spare someone'); 'you spared'

صَاحِبِكَ: صَاحِب + ـِكَ — ṣāḥib, companion, friend (m.; gen. after maʿa) + 2ms possessive; 'your companion'
فِعْلُكَ: فِعْل + ـُكَ — fiʿl, deed, doing (m.; nom.) + 2ms possessive; 'your doing'

السِّنُونَ: الـ + سِنُون — al-, the + sinūn, years (pl. of sana; nom.); 'the years'

فَيَأْكُلَ: فَـ + يَأْكُلَ — fa-, and then + yaʾkula, form I akala/yaʾkulu, to eat (3rd sing. m. subjunctive, joined to أَنْ يَأْتِيَ); 'and eat'

يَتَأَمَّلُ: يَتَأَمَّلُ — form V taʾammala, to gaze at, contemplate (3rd sing. m. imperfect, circumstantial); with فِي; 'gazing'

الْعُصْفُورُ: الـ + عُصْفُور — al-, the + ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m.; nom.); 'the sparrow'

صُوفُهُ: صُوف + ـهُ — ṣūf, wool, fleece (m.; nom.) + -hu, its; 'its wool'

فَاشْتَبَكَتْ: فَـ + اشْتَبَكَتْ — fa-, and so + ishtabakat, form VIII ishtabaka, to become entangled (3rd sing. f. perfect, agreeing with the dual rijlāhu); 'and (his feet) were entangled'

الْعُصْفُورِ: الـ + عُصْفُور — al-, the + ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m.; gen. after a preposition or noun); 'the sparrow'

رِيشَ: رِيش — rīsh, feathers (collective; acc., object of نَتَفَ, in construct); 'the feathers (of)'
أَجْنِحَتِهِ: أَجْنِحَة + ـهِ — ajniḥa, wings (pl. of janāḥ; gen.) + -hi, his; 'his wings'

تَتَشَبَّهَ: تَتَشَبَّهَ — form V tashabbaha, to make oneself like, imitate (2nd sing. m. subjunctive after أَنْ); with بِـ, which the verb chooses, marking the one imitated; 'that you imitate'
أَقْوَي: أَقْوَي — aqwā, stronger (elative of qawiy; printed with a dotted ي for ى); 'stronger'
فَتَهْلِكَ: فَـ + تَهْلِكَ — fa-, and so + tahlika, form I halaka/yahliku, to perish (2nd sing. m. subjunctive, joined to أَنْ تَتَشَبَّهَ); 'and so perish'

يَئِنُّ: يَئِنُّ — form I anna/yaʾinnu, to moan, groan (3rd sing. m. imperfect, circumstantial); 'moaning'
وَقَرَعَ: وَ + قَرَعَ — wa-, and + qaraʿa, form I, to knock, strike; of teeth, to gnash or clack them (3rd sing. m. perfect); 'and he struck, gnashed'
لِلنَّدَامَةِ: لِـ + الـ + نَدَامَة — li-, for, out of (gives the cause) + al-, the + nadāma, remorse, regret (f.; gen.); 'out of remorse'
وَأَنَّهُ: و + أَنّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ann, moaning (verbal noun of anna/yaʾinnu; acc., object of سَمِعَ) + -hu, his; 'and his moaning'
كَآبَتَهُ: كَآبَة + ـهُ — kaʾāba, dejection, gloom (f.; acc., object of رَأَى) + -hu, his; 'his dejection'
وَحُزْنَهُ: و + حُزْن + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥuzn, grief (m.; acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his grief'
نَابَكَ: نَاب + ـكَ / نَابَ + ـكَ — the same letters serve twice in the crow's pun: nāba (n-w-b), to befall (3rd sing. m. perfect) + -ka, you, 'what has befallen you'; and nāb, canine tooth, fang (m.; acc., object of قَرَعْتَ) + -ka, your, 'your fang'
قَرَعْتَ: قَرَعْتَ — qaraʿta, form I qaraʿa, to knock, strike (2nd sing. m. perfect); 'you struck'
قَرَعْتُ: قَرَعْتُ — qaraʿtu, form I qaraʿa, to knock, strike (1st sing. perfect); 'I struck'
أَخْدَعَ: أَخْدَعَ — akhdaʿ, more deceitful, wilier (elative of khadaʿa; acc., second object of رَأَيْتُ); 'wilier'
رَاجِعًا: رَاجِعًا — rājiʿ, returning (active participle of rajaʿa; acc. of state); 'returning'
وَلِجُحْرِهِ: و + لِـ + جُحْر + ـهِ — wa-, and + li-, marking the object of the participle ṭāliban placed before it + juḥr, burrow, den (m.; gen.) + -hi, his; 'and (seeking) his den'
وَأَطْيَبَهَا: و + أَطْيَبَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aṭyaba, how pleasant (elative in the verb-of-wonder pattern mā afʿala, carried over from مَا أَحْسَنَ) + -hā, them (the tales); 'and how delightful they are'
الْمَوْعِظَاتِ: الـ + مَوْعِظَات — al-, the + mawʿiẓāt, admonitions, edifying lessons (pl. of mawʿiẓa; gen. after مِنْ); 'of the moral tales'
وَيُحْكَى: وَ + يُحْكَى — ḥakā, to tell, relate (verb I defective, impf. passive 3ms); 'and it is told'
قُنْفُذًا: قُنْفُذ — qunfudh, hedgehog (m.), acc. indef. as subject of anna; 'a hedgehog'
اتَّخَذَ: اِتَّخَذَ — ittakhadha, to take, adopt, take as (verb VIII of ʾ-kh-dh, perf. 3ms); 'took (as)'
نَخْلَةٍ: نَخْلَة — nakhla, palm-tree, date-palm (f.), gen. indef.; 'a palm-tree'
أَلِفَهَا: أَلِفَ + ـهَا — alifa, to grow familiar with, keep to (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (f., the palm); 'had grown used to it'
الْوَرَشَانُ: الـ + وَرَشَان — warashān, ringdove, wood-pigeon (m.), nom.; 'the ringdove'
وَعَشَّشَا: وَ + عَشَّشَا — ʿashshasha, to build a nest (verb II, perf. 3 dual m.); 'and the two nested'
وَسَكَنَا: وَ + سَكَنَا — sakana, to dwell, live (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); 'and the two dwelt'
رَغِيدٍ: رَغِيد — raghīd, easy, plentiful, comfortable (adj.), gen.; 'easy, abundant'
الْقُنْفُذُ: الـ + قُنْفُذ — qunfudh, hedgehog (m.), nom.; 'the hedgehog'
الْوَرَشَانَ: الـ + وَرَشَان — warashān, ringdove, wood-pigeon (m.), acc. after inna; 'the ringdove'
ثَمَرِ: ثَمَر — thamar, fruit (collective, m.), gen. in construct; 'the fruit of'
وَلِزَوْجَتِهِ: وَ + لِـ + زَوْجَة + ـهِ — wa, and + li-, for (prep.) + zawja, wife (f.) + -hi, his; 'and for his wife'
وَاتَّخَذَ: وَ + اِتَّخَذَ — ittakhadha, to take, take as (verb VIII, perf. 3ms); 'and he took'
جَانِبَهُ: جَانِب + ـهُ — jānib, side (m.), acc. as adverb of place + -hu, its (the burrow's); 'beside it'
مَسْجِدًا: مَسْجِد — masjid, place of prostration, place of prayer, mosque (m.), acc. indef.; 'a place of prayer'
النُّسْكَ: الـ + نُسْك — nusk, devotion, ascetic practice (m.), acc.; 'piety'
وَالْعِبَادَةَ: وَ + الـ + عِبَادَة — ʿibāda, worship, devotion (f.), acc.; 'and worship'
مُتَعَبِّدًا: مُتَعَبِّد — mutaʿabbid, devoting oneself to worship (act. part. of verb V taʿabbada), acc. as predicate of yarā; 'at worship'
مُصَلِّيًا: مُصَلٍّ — muṣallī, praying (act. part. of verb II ṣallā), acc.; 'praying'
زُهْدِهِ: زُهْد + ـهِ — zuhd, renunciation of the world, asceticism (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his renunciation'
طَعَامُكَ: طَعَام + ـكَ — ṭaʿām, food (m.), nom. + -ka, your (m.); 'your food'
يَسْقُطُ: يَسْقُطُ — saqaṭa, to fall (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'falls'
لِبَاسُكَ: لِبَاس + ـكَ — libās, clothing (m.), nom. + -ka, your (m.); 'your clothing'
شَوْكٌ: شَوْك — shawk, thorns, spines (collective, m.), nom. indef.; 'thorns'
أَنْتَفِعُ: أَنْتَفِعُ — intafaʿa, to benefit (verb VIII of n-f-ʿ, impf. 1cs); with bi-, 'I benefit from'
بِخُشُونَتِهِ: بِـ + خُشُونَة + ـهِ — bi-, from (chosen by intafaʿa) + khushūna, roughness (f.) + -hi, its; 'from its roughness'
اخْتَرْتُهُ: اِخْتَرْتُ + ـهُ — ikhtāra, to choose (verb VIII hollow, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it; 'I chose it'
أُرْشِدَ: أُرْشِدَ — arshada, to guide aright (verb IV, impf. subj. 1cs after an); 'that I may guide'
الضَّالَّ: الـ + ضَالّ — ḍāll, one who has gone astray (act. part. of ḍalla), acc.; 'the one astray'
وَأُعَلِّمَ: وَ + أُعَلِّمَ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, impf. subj. 1cs); 'and teach'
رَغِبْتُ: رَغِبْتُ — raghiba, to desire (verb I, perf. 1cs); with fī, 'I have come to long for'
ضِدَّ: ضِدّ — ḍidd, opposite, contrary (m.), acc. as predicate of yakūna; 'the opposite of'
فَتَكُونَ: فَـ + تَكُونَ — fa-, and so + kāna, to be (verb I hollow, impf. subj. 2ms); 'and so you be'
كَالزَّرَّاعِ: كَـ + الـ + زَرَّاع — ka-, like (prep., comparison) + zarrāʿ, sower, farmer (m.), gen.; 'like the farmer'
بَذْرِهِ: بَذْر + ـهِ — badhr, sowing, seed (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his sowing'
تُبَلِّغَنِي: تُبَلِّغَ + ـنِي — ballagha, to make reach, bring to (verb II, impf. subj. 3fs, after an lā; the subject is the plural al-ayyām) + -nī, me; 'bring me to'
أُمْنِيَّتِي: أُمْنِيَّة + ـِي — umniyya, wish, hope (f.), acc. + -ī, my; 'my wish'
فَأَكُونَ: فَـ + أَكُونَ — fa-, and so + kāna, to be (verb I hollow, impf. subj. 1cs); 'and then I would be'
بَدَأْتُ: بَدَأْتُ — badaʾa, to begin (verb I, perf. 1cs); with bi-, 'I began with'
بِإِضَاعَةِ: بِـ + إِضَاعَة — bi-, with (chosen by badaʾa, 'begin with') + iḍāʿa, wasting, squandering (verbal noun of IV aḍāʿa), gen.; 'with the wasting of'
الْبَذْرِ: الـ + بَذْر — badhr, seed, sowing (m.), gen.; 'the seed'
الْحَصَادِ: الـ + حَصَاد — ḥaṣād, harvest, reaping (m.), gen.; 'the harvest'
يَحْصُدُونَ: يَحْصُدُونَ — ḥaṣada, to reap (verb I, impf. 3mp); 'they were reaping'
مَافَاتَهُ: مَا + فَاتَ + ـهُ — mā, what (rel.) + fāta, to escape, pass by (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'what had slipped from him' (printed as one word)
تَخَلُّفِهِ: تَخَلُّف + ـهِ — takhalluf, staying behind, holding back (verbal noun of V takhallafa), gen. + -hi, his; 'his holding back'
أَسَفًا: أَسَف — asaf, sorrow, regret (m.), acc. of cause; 'out of sorrow'; here: the direct object of fāraqtu, 'I have not parted from grief'
لِلْقُنْفُذِ: لِـ + الـ + قُنْفُذ — li-, to (marks the one addressed) + qunfudh, hedgehog, gen.; 'to the hedgehog'
عَلَائِقِ: عَلَائِق — ʿalāʾiq, ties, attachments (pl. of ʿalāqa, f.), gen.; 'the ties of'
وَأَنْقَطِعَ: وَ + أَنْقَطِعَ — inqaṭaʿa, to cut oneself off, devote oneself (verb VII, impf. subj. 1cs); with ilā, 'and give myself wholly to'
الِاسْتِعْدَادِ: الـ + اِسْتِعْدَاد — istiʿdād, making ready, preparation (verbal noun of X istaʿadda), gen. after fī; 'preparing'
لِلْمَعَادِ: لِـ + الـ + مَعَاد — li-, for (what one prepares for) + maʿād, the Return, the hereafter (m.), gen.; 'for the Return'
وَالْقَنَاعَةِ: وَ + الـ + قَنَاعَة — qanāʿa, contentment (f.), gen.; 'and contentment'
بِالْكَفَافِ: بِـ + الـ + كَفَاف — bi-, with (chosen by qanāʿa, 'contentment with') + kafāf, bare sufficiency (m.), gen.; 'with just enough'
أَتَجَاوَزَ: أَتَجَاوَزَ — tajāwaza, to pass beyond (verb VI, impf. subj. 1cs after an); 'to go beyond'
النَّخْلَةَ: الـ + نَخْلَة — nakhla, palm-tree (f.), acc.; 'the palm'
قُوتِي: قُوت + ـِي — qūt, food, sustenance (m.) + -ī, my; 'my food'
أَسْتَقِرُّ: أَسْتَقِرُّ — istaqarra, to settle, abide (verb X doubled, impf. 1cs); 'I might settle'
يُمْكِنُكَ: يُمْكِنُ + ـكَ — amkana, to be possible for (verb IV, impf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'it is possible for you, you can'
تَنْثُرَ: تَنْثُرَ — nathara, to scatter, shake down (verb I, impf. subj. 2ms); 'that you scatter'
وَزَوْجَتُكَ: وَ + زَوْجَة + ـكَ — zawja, wife (f.), nom. + -ka, your; 'and your wife'
وَتَسْكُنَ: وَ + تَسْكُنَ — sakana, to dwell (verb I, impf. subj. 2ms); 'and dwell'
وَكْرٍ: وَكْر — wakr, nest, den (m.), gen. indef.; 'a nest'
لِالْتِمَاسِ: لِـ + الـ + اِلْتِمَاس — li-, in order to (purpose) + iltimās, seeking (verbal noun of VIII iltamasa), gen.; 'for seeking'
إِرْشَادِكَ: إِرْشَاد + ـكَ — irshād, guidance (verbal noun of IV arshada), gen. + -ka, your; 'your guidance'
مِلْ: مِلْ — māla, to turn, incline (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); 'turn'
نَثَرْتَهُ: نَثَرْتَ + ـهُ — nathara, to scatter (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'you scattered'
الثَّمَرِ: الـ + ثَمَر — thamar, fruit (collective, m.), gen.; 'the fruit'
وَادَّخِرْهُ: وَ + اِدَّخِرْ + ـهُ — iddakhara, to store up (verb VIII of dh-kh-r, imper. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'and store it up'
قُوتًا: قُوت — qūt, food, sustenance (m.), acc. indef.; '(as) food'
لِلْعَدَمِ: لِـ + الـ + عَدَم — li-, against, for (the time of) + ʿadam, want, lack (m.), gen.; 'against want'
الثِّمَارُ: الـ + ثِمَار — thimār, fruits (pl. of thamar), nom.; 'the fruits'
صِرْ: صِرْ — ṣāra, to become, go over to (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); with ilā, 'turn to'
كَفَافٍ: كَفَاف — kafāf, bare sufficiency (m.), gen. indef.; 'a bare sufficiency'
بِالْمَعَادِ: بِـ + الـ + مَعَاد — bi-, of (chosen by dhakkara, 'remind of') + maʿād, the Return (m.), gen.; 'of the Return'
وَهَدَيْتَنِي: وَ + هَدَيْتَ + ـنِي — hadā, to guide (verb I defective, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'and you guided me'
طَرْحِ: طَرْح — ṭarḥ, throwing down (verbal noun of ṭaraḥa), gen.; 'throwing down'
مَسْكَنَهُ: مَسْكَن + ـهُ — maskan, dwelling (m.), acc. + -hu, his; 'his dwelling'
وَادَّخَرَهُ: وَ + اِدَّخَرَ + ـهُ — iddakhara, to store up (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and stored it up'
لِقُوتِهِ: لِـ + قُوت + ـهِ — li-, for (purpose) + qūt, food (m.) + -hi, his; 'for his food'
احْتَاجَا: اِحْتَاجَا — iḥtāja, to need (verb VIII hollow, perf. 3 dual m.); with ilā, 'the two needed'
مُؤْنَتِهِمَا: مُؤْنَة + ـهِمَا — muʾna, provision, supplies (f.), gen. + -himā, their (dual); 'their provision'
طَلَبَاهَا: طَلَبَا + ـهَا — ṭalaba, to seek, ask for (verb I, perf. 3 dual m., future sense after idhā) + -hā, it (the provision); 'they will ask for it'
وَطَمِعَا: وَ + طَمِعَا — ṭamiʿa, to covet, set hopes on (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); with fī, 'and they will covet'
