وَرَكَنَا: وَ + رَكَنَا — rakana, to lean on, trust (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); with ilā, 'and they will trust'
تَزَهُّدِي: تَزَهُّد + ـِي — tazahhud, practising (or affecting) renunciation (verbal noun of V tazahhada), gen. + -ī, my; 'my abstinence'
وَوَرَعِي: وَ + وَرَع + ـِي — waraʿ, scrupulous piety (m.), gen. + -ī, my; 'and my scruples'
نَصِيحَتِي: نَصِيحَة + ـِي — naṣīḥa, sincere counsel (f.), acc. + -ī, my; 'my counsel'
وَوَعْظِي: وَ + وَعْظ + ـِي — waʿẓ, preaching, admonition (m.), acc. + -ī, my; 'and my preaching'
دَنَيَا: دَنَيَا — danā, to draw near (verb I defective, perf. 3 dual m.); with min, 'they will come near'
فَأَقْتَنِصُهُمَا: فَـ + أَقْتَنِصُ + ـهُمَا — fa-, then + iqtanaṣa, to catch, hunt down (verb VIII, impf. 1cs) + -humā, them two; 'then I shall snatch them'
وَآكُلُهُمَا: وَ + آكُلُ + ـهُمَا — akala, to eat (verb I, impf. 1cs, printed with madda) + -humā, them two; 'and eat them'
تَسَاقَطَ: تَسَاقَطَ — tasāqaṭa, to fall down one after another (verb VI, perf. 3ms); 'falls'
نَثَرَا: نَثَرَا — nathara, to scatter (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); 'the two had scattered'
الْقُنْفُذَ: الـ + قُنْفُذ — qunfudh, hedgehog (m.), acc.; 'the hedgehog'
جُحْرِهِ: جُحْر + ـهِ — juḥr, hole, burrow (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his hole'
وَالْوَاعِظُ: وَ + الـ + وَاعِظ — wāʿiẓ, preacher (act. part. of waʿaẓa), nom. in the vocative phrase; 'and preacher'
لِلثَّمَرِ: لِـ + الـ + ثَمَر — li-, of (belonging to) + thamar, fruit, gen.; 'of the fruit'
لِقُوتِنَا: لِـ + قُوت + ـنَا — li-, for + qūt, food (m.) + -nā, our; 'for our food'
ثَمَرًا: ثَمَر — thamar, fruit (collective), acc. indef. of specification; '(any) fruit'
وَالْإِعْرَاضُ: وَ + الـ + إِعْرَاض — iʿrāḍ, turning away (verbal noun of IV aʿraḍa), nom.; 'and turning away'
الرَّازِقِ: الـ + رَازِق — rāziq, provider (act. part. of razaqa; here God), gen.; 'the Provider'
الْأَشْدَاقَ: الـ + أَشْدَاق — ashdāq, corners of the mouth, jaws (pl. of shidq), acc.; 'the jaws'
يَتْرُكُهَا: يَتْرُكُ + ـهَا — taraka, to leave (verb I, impf. 3ms) + -hā, them (the jaws); 'leaves them'
أَرْزَاقٍ: أَرْزَاق — arzāq, provisions, livelihoods (pl. of rizq), gen. after bi-lā; 'provisions'
يَعِظُهُمَا: يَعِظُ + ـهُمَا — waʿaẓa, to preach to, admonish (verb I assimilated, impf. 3ms) + -humā, them two; 'preaching to them'
الْمَوَاعِظِ: الـ + مَوَاعِظ — mawāʿiẓ, sermons, admonitions (pl. of mawʿiẓa), gen.; 'the sermons'
وَيُظْهِرُ: وَ + يُظْهِرُ — aẓhara, to show, display (verb IV, impf. 3ms); 'and showing'
بِزُخْرُفِ: بِـ + زُخْرُف — bi-, with (means) + zukhruf, gilding, false ornament (m.), gen.; 'with the gilding of'
الْمَلَافِظِ: الـ + مَلَافِظ — malāfiẓ, utterances (pl. of malfaẓ), gen.; 'words'
رَكَنَا: رَكَنَا — rakana, to lean on, trust (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); with ilā, 'the two trusted'
وَكْرِهِ: وَكْر + ـهِ — wakr, nest, den (m.), gen. + -hi, his; 'his den'
وَأَمِنَا: وَ + أَمِنَا — amina, to feel safe (verb I, perf. 3 dual m.); with min, 'and they felt safe from'
الْأَنْيَابَ: الـ + أَنْيَاب — anyāb, fangs, canine teeth (pl. of nāb), acc.; 'the fangs'
الْخَدِيعَةَ: الـ + خَدِيعَة — khadīʿa, deceit, trick (f.), acc.; 'the deceit'
لِلْمَظْلُومِينَ: لِـ + الـ + مَظْلُومِين — li-, belonging to ('the wronged have') + maẓlūmūn, the wronged (pl. of pass. part. maẓlūm), gen.; 'for the wronged'
نَاصِرًا: نَاصِر — nāṣir, helper, defender (act. part. of naṣara), acc. after anna; 'a helper'
وَالْمَكْرَ: وَ + الـ + مَكْر — makr, cunning, plotting (m.), acc. after iyyāka wa- (warning); 'beware … cunning'
وَالْخَدِيعَةَ: وَ + الـ + خَدِيعَة — khadīʿa, deceit (f.), acc.; 'and deceit'
يُصِيبَكَ: يُصِيبَ + ـكَ — aṣāba, to befall (verb IV hollow, impf. subj. 3ms after li-allā) + -ka, you; 'befall you'
الْخَدَّاعِينَ: الـ + خَدَّاعِين — khaddāʿūn, deceivers, swindlers (pl. of khaddāʿ), acc.; 'the deceivers'
مَكَرُوا: مَكَرُوا — makara, to plot, use cunning (verb I, perf. 3mp); with bi-, 'they plotted against'
بِالتَّاجِرِ: بِـ + الـ + تَاجِر — bi-, against (chosen by makara, 'plot against') + tājir, merchant (m.), gen.; 'against the merchant'
سِنْدَه: Sindah — name of a city (as printed, سنده; the final ه is the print's); 'Sindah'
وَاسِعٍ: وَاسِع — wāsiʿ, wide, ample (m. sing., gen. indef., agreeing with مال); 'ample'
فَشَدَّ: فَـ + شَدَّ — fa-, and so + shadda, he bound, tied up (perf. 3 m. sing.); 'and he bound up'
أَحْمَالًا: أَحْمَال — aḥmāl, loads, packs (pl. of ḥiml; acc. indef., object); 'loads'
مَتَاعًا: مَتَاع — matāʿ, goods, wares (m., acc. indef., object); 'merchandise'
لِيَبِيعَهُ: لِـ + يَبِيعَ + ـهُ — li-, in order to (with subj.) + yabīʿa, he sells (subj., from bāʿa) + -hu, it; 'to sell it'
الْمَكَرَةِ: الـ + مَكَرَة — makara, cunning ones, tricksters (pl. of mākir; gen. after مِنْ); 'of the tricksters'
حَضَرَهُمَا: حَضَرَ + ـهُمَا — ḥaḍara, it was present, at hand (perf. 3 m. sing.) + -humā, them two; 'what was at hand to the two'
وَمَتَاعٍ: وَ + مَتَاع — wa-, and + matāʿ, goods (gen. indef., after مِنْ); 'and goods'
وَأَظْهَرَا: وَ + أَظْهَرَا — wa-, and + aẓharā, they two displayed, made out (perf. 3 m. dual, form IV of ẓahara); 'and the two made out'
نَزَلَا: نَزَلَا — nazalā, they two halted, dismounted (perf. 3 m. dual); 'they halted' ; also: 'they two came down, descended' (of flying jinn)
مَنْزِلٍ: مَنْزِل — manzil, halting-place, stage of a journey (m., gen. indef., after أَوَّل); 'halting-place'
مَامَعَهُ: مَا + مَعَ + ـهُ — mā, what + maʿa, with + -hu, him (printed as one word); 'what he had with him'
غَدَرْتُ: غَدَرْتُ — ghadartu, I betrayed (perf. 1 sing., in a law clause: 'if I betrayed'; the damma is printed)
بِصَاحِبِي: بِـ + صَاحِب + ـِي — bi-, the object-marker that ghadara takes ('betray') + ṣāḥib, companion + -ī, my; 'my companion'
لَصَفَى: لَـ + صَفَى — la-, then (introducing the answer of law) + ṣafā, it became clear, untroubled (perf. 3 m. sing.; printed with ى for صفا); 'then would be clear'
أَضْمَرَا: أَضْمَرَا — aḍmarā, they two harboured, nursed secretly (perf. 3 m. dual, form IV of ḍamara); 'the two harboured'
نِيَّةٍ: نِيَّة — niyya, intention (f., gen. indef., after عَلَى); 'intention'
فَاسِدَةٍ: فَاسِدَة — fāsida, corrupt, evil (f. sing., gen. indef., agreeing with نية); 'corrupt'
فَأَكَلَا: فَـ + أَكَلَا — fa-, and so + akalā, they two ate (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two ate' (the hamza is printed)
فَمَاتَا: فَـ + مَاتَا — fa-, and so + mātā, they two died (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and both died'
يَجْلِسَانِ: يَجْلِسَانِ — yajlisāni, they two sit (imperf. 3 m. dual; after kānā, 'used to sit')
وَيُحَدِّثَانِهِ: وَ + يُحَدِّثَانِ + ـهُ — wa-, and + yuḥaddithāni, they two talk with (imperf. 3 m. dual, form II of ḥadatha) + -hu, him; 'and talked with him'
غَابَا: غَابَا — ghābā, they two were absent, stayed away (perf. 3 m. dual); 'they stayed away'
وَأَبْطَأَا: وَ + أَبْطَأَا — wa-, and + abṭaʾā, they two were slow, tarried (perf. 3 m. dual, form IV of baṭuʾa; the second hamza is printed); 'and were slow in coming'
فَتَّشَ: فَتَّشَ — fattasha, he searched (perf. 3 m. sing., form II); with ʿalā here, 'searched for'
خَبَرَهُمَا: خَبَر + ـهُمَا — khabar, news (acc., object) + -humā, the two of them; 'their news, what had become of them'
مَيِّتَيْنِ: مَيِّتَيْنِ — mayyitayni, dead (dual acc., of mayyit); 'both dead'
مُحْتَالَيْنِ: مُحْتَالَيْنِ — muḥtālayni, tricksters, swindlers (dual acc., of muḥtāl, form VIII of ḥāla); 'tricksters'
الْمَكْرَبِهِ: الـ + مَكْر + بِـ + ـهِ — al-makr, the plotting (acc., object of أراد) + bi-, against (makara takes bi-) + -hi, him (printed as one word); 'the plotting against him'
فَعَادَ: فَـ + عَادَ — fa-, and so + ʿāda, it returned (perf. 3 m. sing.); with ʿalā, 'came back upon'
مَكْرُهُمَا: مَكْر + ـهُمَا — makr, plot, cunning (nom., subject) + -humā, the two of them; 'their plot'
وَسَلِمَ: وَ + سَلِمَ — wa-, and + salima, he was safe, escaped unharmed (perf. 3 m. sing.); 'and was saved'
نَبَّهْتِنِي: نَبَّهْتِ + ـنِي — nabbahti, you (f.) alerted, made aware (perf. 2 f. sing., form II of nabiha) + -nī, me; 'you have made me aware'
غَافِلًا: غَافِل — ghāfil, heedless, unaware (m. sing., acc. indef., predicate of كان); 'heedless'
فَتَزِيدِينِي: فَـ + تَزِيدِينَ + ـنِي — fa-, so + tazīdīna, you (f.) increase, add to (imperf. 2 f. sing., nūn of the ending merged before -nī) + -nī, me; 'so will you give me more'
سَارِقًا: سَارِق — sāriq, thief (m. sing., acc. indef., predicate of كان); 'a thief'
وَيَنْصَرِفُ: وَ + يَنْصَرِفُ — wa-, and + yanṣarifu, he goes away, leaves (imperf. 3 m. sing., form VII of ṣarafa); after illā, 'but he comes away'
بِكَسْبٍ: بِـ + كَسْب — bi-, with + kasb, gain, earnings (gen. indef.); 'with a gain'
أَثْوَابًا: أَثْوَاب — athwāb, garments, clothes (pl. of thawb; acc. indef., object); 'clothes'
يَسُومُهَا: يَسُومُ + ـهَا — yasūmu, he bids for, asks the price of (imperf. 3 m. sing., from sāma) + -hā, them (the clothes); 'bids for them'
لَايَعْرِضُهَا: لَا + يَعْرِضُ + ـهَا — lā, not + yaʿriḍu, he offers, shows (imperf. 3 m. sing.) + -hā, them (printed as one word); 'he did not offer them'
وَيَمْتَنِعُ: وَ + يَمْتَنِعُ — wa-, and + yamtaniʿu, he refuses, holds back (imperf. 3 m. sing., form VIII of manaʿa); with min, 'refuses to'
شِرَائُهَا: شِرَاء + ـهَا — shirāʾ, buying (verbal noun of ishtarā; after min it should be genitive, but the print sets a damma on the hamza) + -hā, them; 'buying them'
السَّارِقَ: الـ + سَارِق — sāriq, thief (acc., subject of أَنَّ); 'the thief'
الشَّخْصَ: الـ + شَخْص — shakhṣ, person, individual (acc., object of رأى); 'the man'
الثِّيَابُ: الـ + ثِيَاب — al-, the + thiyāb, clothes, garments (pl. of thawb; nom., subject of a nominal clause with a fronted prepositional predicate: مَعَهُ الثِّيَابُ 'who had the clothes', عَلَيْهِمُ الثِّيَابُ 'who wore the clothes'); 'the clothes'
الْمُقَطَّعَةُ: الـ + مُقَطَّعَة — muqaṭṭaʿa, cut to pieces, tattered (pass. part. f., form II of qaṭaʿa; nom., agreeing with الثياب); 'ragged'
فَلَعِبَ: فَـ + لَعِبَ — fa-, and so + laʿiba, he played, performed (perf. 3 m. sing.); 'and it played'
بِالْفُرْجَةِ: بِـ + الـ + فُرْجَة — bi-, with (what occupied him) + al-furja, the looking-on, the show (gen.); 'with watching'
وَاخْتَلَسَ: وَ + اخْتَلَسَ — wa-, and + ikhtalasa, he snatched, stole by stealth (perf. 3 m. sing., form VIII of khalasa); 'and he snatched'
الْبُقْجَةَ: الـ + بُقْجَة — buqja, cloth bundle (f., acc., object; from Turkish bohça); 'the bundle'
الْمُقَطَّعَةَ: الـ + مُقَطَّعَة — muqaṭṭaʿa, cut to pieces, tattered (pass. part. f., acc., agreeing with الثياب); 'ragged'
نَفِيسَةٍ: نَفِيسَة — nafīsa, precious, costly (f. sing., gen. indef., agreeing with بقجة); 'costly'
وَاشْتَرَطَ: وَ + اشْتَرَطَ — wa-, and + ishtaraṭa, he stipulated, made a condition (perf. 3 m. sing., form VIII of sharaṭa); 'and he stipulated'
تُفْتَحَ: تُفْتَحَ — tuftaḥa, it (f.) is opened (imperf. pass. 3 f. sing., subj. after an lā); 'that it not be opened'
وَرَغِبَ: وَ + رَغِبَ — wa-, and + raghiba, he desired (perf. 3 m. sing.; with fī, 'want, desire'); 'and (people) wanted'; also: raghiba fīhā, 'and he desired her': the verb takes fī for the one desired (Night 183)
نَفَاسَتُهَا: نَفَاسَة + ـهَا — nafāsa, preciousness, fineness (f., nom., subject of أعجبه) + -hā, its; 'its fine look'
فَاشْتَرَاهَا: فَـ + اشْتَرَى + ـهَا — fa-, and so + ishtarā, he bought (perf. 3 m. sing., form VIII of sharā) + -hā, it; 'and he bought it'
مَتَاعٌ: مَتَاع — matāʿ, goods (m., nom. indef., predicate of an understood 'this is'); 'goods'
اشْتَرَيْتُهُ: اشْتَرَيْتُ + ـهُ — ishtaraytu, I bought (perf. 1 sing., form VIII) + -hu, it; 'I bought it'
الْقِيمَةِ: الـ + قِيمَة — al-, the + qīma, value, worth, price (f.; gen. after دُونِ, in bi-dūni al-qīmati 'for less than the value'); 'the value'
بِيعَهُ: بِيعَ + ـهُ — second part of li-abīʿahu, split by the print: abīʿa, I sell (subj. 1 sing., from bāʿa; its a- stands on the preceding لِأَ) + -hu, it; 'sell it'
فَائِدَتَهُ: فَائِدَة + ـهُ — fāʾida, profit, gain (f., acc., object) + -hu, its; 'its profit'
الْمَغْبُونُ: الـ + مَغْبُون — maghbūn, cheated, duped (pass. part. of ghabana; nom., addressed with أيها); 'you dupe'
الْمَتَاعُ: الـ + مَتَاع — matāʿ, goods (m., nom., subject of the passive يباع); 'the merchandise'
بِأَقَلَّ: بِـ + أَقَلّ — bi-, for (bi- of price) + aqall, less (elative of qalīl; diptote, gen. in -a); 'for less'
قِيمَتِهِ: قِيمَة + ـهِ — qīma, value (gen. after مِن) + -hi, its; 'than its value'
مَسْرُوقًا: مَسْرُوق — masrūq, stolen (pass. part. of saraqa; acc. indef., predicate of كان); 'stolen'
يُعَايِنْهُ: يُعَايِنْ + ـهُ — yuʿāyin, he sees with his own eyes, inspects (imperf. jussive 3 m. sing. after lam, form III of ʿayana) + -hu, it; 'did not look it over'
مَثَلُهُ: مَثَل + ـهُ — mathal, likeness, case (nom., subject of كان) + -hu, his; 'his case'
كَمَثَلِ: كَـ + مَثَل — ka-, like (prep., making the comparison) + mathal, likeness (gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the case of'
السَّارِقِينَ: الـ + سَارِق — sāriq, thief, pl. sāriqūn (gen. after مِنْ); 'the thieves'
الطَّاؤُوسَ: الـ + طَاؤُوس — al-, the + ṭāʾūs, peacock (m.; acc.: object of اخْتَارُوا, and predicate of كَانَ after إِلَّا in مَا كَانَ أَمْنِي إِلَّا الطَّاؤُوسَ); 'the peacock'
الطَّاؤُوسِ: الـ + طَاؤُوس — al-, the + ṭāʾūs, peacock (m.; gen. after a noun, بِتَمْلِيكِ, or a preposition, عَنِ / إِلَى); 'the peacock'
الطَّاوُوسُ: الـ + طَاوُوس — ṭāwūs, peacock, the print's other spelling of ṭāʾūs (nom.); 'the peacock'
النَّاعِمَةُ: الـ + نَاعِمَة — nāʿim, soft, fine (f. agreeing with the pl. thiyāb; nom.); 'soft'
الِاخْتِلَافُ: الـ + اخْتِلَاف — ikhtilāf, disagreement, dispute (nom.); 'the disagreement'
الْأَتْبَاعِ: الـ + أَتْبَاع — atbāʿ, followers, pl. of tābiʿ (gen. after aqrab); 'the followers'
الْأَطْعِمَةُ: الـ + أَطْعِمَة — aṭʿima, foods, dishes, pl. of ṭaʿām (nom., subject of yuqaddamu); 'the dishes'
الْأَغْنِيَاءِ: الـ + أَغْنِيَاء — aghniyāʾ, the rich, pl. of ghanī (gen. after مِنْ); 'the rich'
الْحَائِكُ: الـ + حَائِك — ḥāʾik, weaver (m., nom.); 'the weaver'
الْحَاوِىَ: الـ + حَاوِي — ḥāwī, snake-charmer (acc., object of raʾaytu; ى for final ي); 'the snake-charmer'
الْخَبِيرَ: الـ + خَبِير — khabīr, expert, well-versed (acc., agreeing with al-ḥāwī); 'the expert'
الْعَالِمَ: الـ + عَالِم — ʿālim, knowing, learned (act. part. of ʿalima; acc.); 'the one who knows'
الْعُصْفُورَ: الـ + عُصْفُور — ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m., acc.); 'the sparrow'
الْفَاخِرَةُ: الـ + فَاخِرَة — fākhir, splendid, choice (f. agreeing with al-aṭʿima; nom.); 'splendid'
الْقُوتَ: الـ + قُوت — qūt, food, daily sustenance (acc.); 'the daily bread'
الْمَتَاعَ: الـ + مَتَاع — matāʿ, goods, wares (acc.); 'the goods'
الْمَلَاعِبِ: الـ + مَلَاعِب — malāʿib, games, shows, pl. of malʿab (gen.); ahl al-malāʿib, 'entertainers, acrobats'
الْمُلَازَمَةَ: الـ + مُلَازَمَة — mulāzama, constant attendance, verbal noun of lāzama (III) (acc.); 'the attendance'
الْوَلِيمَةِ: الـ + وَلِيمَة — walīma, feast, banquet (f., gen.); 'the feast'
انْدَقَّتْ: انْدَقَّتْ — indaqqa (VII, root d-q-q), to be broken, crushed (3 f. sg. perf.); 'it was broken'
أَخَفَّ: أَخَفَّ — akhaff, lighter, elative of khafīf (diptote, gen. agreeing with ṣināʿatin); 'lighter'
أَخَّرَكَ: أَخَّرَ + كَ — akhkhara (II), to delay, hold back (3 m. sg. perf.) + you (m. sg.); 'delayed you'
أَعْجَزُ: أَعْجَزُ — aʿjaz, more incapable, elative of ʿājiz (nom.); wa-lā aʿjazu minhu, '(I am) no less able than he'
أَكْلَكَ: أَكْل + كَ — akl, eating; one's living (acc.) + your (m. sg.); 'your living'
أَوْتَادَهَا: أَوْتَاد + هَا — awtād, pegs, pl. of watad (acc.) + its (the net's); 'its pegs'
أُمُورِنَا: أُمُور + نَا — umūr, affairs, pl. of amr (gen. after fī) + our; 'our affairs'
بَدَّلْتُ: بَدَّلْتُ — baddala (II), to exchange (1 sg. perf., in a law clause); 'I exchanged'
بِالْحَيَّاتِ: بِـ + الـ + حَيَّات — bi-, in (marks the field of knowledge after khabīr) + ḥayyāt, snakes, pl. of ḥayya; 'in snakes'
بِأَحْوَالِهَا: بِـ + أَحْوَال + هَا — bi-, of (marks what one has knowledge of, after ʿilm) + aḥwāl, states, ways, pl. of ḥāl + its (the snake's); 'of its ways'
بِتَمْلِيكِ: بِـ + تَمْلِيك — bi-, to (marks what is advised, after ashāra ʿalā) + tamlīk, making king, verbal noun of mallaka (II); 'to make … king'
بِجَهْلِهِ: بِـ + جَهْل + هِ — bi-, by (means/cause) + jahl, ignorance + his; 'by his ignorance'
بِصِنَاعَةٍ: بِـ + صِنَاعَة — bi-, for (marks what is taken in exchange, after baddala) + ṣināʿa, craft, trade (gen.); 'for a trade'
بِعِلْمِهِ: بِـ + عِلْم + هِ — bi-, by (means) + ʿilm, knowledge + his; 'by his knowledge'
تُهْمَةٍ: تُهْمَة — tuhma, suspicion, accusation (f., gen. after fī); 'a suspicion'
حَائِكًا: حَائِك — ḥāʾik, weaver (acc. indef., noun of anna); 'a weaver'
خَارِجٍ: خَارِج — khārij, one going out, act. part. of kharaja (gen.); ākhira khārijin, 'the last to leave'
خَالَفَ: خَالَفَ — khālafa (III), to go against, disobey (3 m. sg. perf.); 'he went against'
دَاخِلٍ: دَاخِل — dākhil, one coming in, act. part. of dakhala (gen.); awwala dākhilin, 'the first to come in'
رَبَّمَا: رَبَّمَا — rabbamā (also rubbamā), often, many a time; perhaps; 'often'
رُتْبَةً: رُتْبَة — rutba, rank, standing (acc. of specification); 'in rank'
زَمَنِهِ: زَمَن + هِ — zaman, time, age (gen.) + his; 'his time'
زِيِّهِمْ: زِيّ + هِمْ — zayy (ziyy), dress, attire (gen.) + their; 'their dress'
سُورٍ: سُور — sūr, wall, rampart (m., gen. after ʿalā); 'a wall'
شَأْنِكَ: شَأْن + كَ — shaʾn, affair, business (gen.) + your (m. sg.); laysa min shaʾnika, 'is none of your business'
شَأْنِي: شَأْن + ي — shaʾn, standing, rank (nom.) + my; 'my standing'
شَاهِقٍ: شَاهِق — shāhiq, towering, lofty (gen., agreeing with sūr); 'towering'
عُصْفُورٌ: عُصْفُور — ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m., nom. indef.); 'a sparrow'
فَاخْتَارُوا: فَـ + اخْتَارُوا — fa-, so + ikhtāra (VIII), to choose (3 m. pl. perf.); 'so they chose'
فَتَجْتَمِعُ: فَـ + تَجْتَمِعُ — fa-, so that (result) + ijtamaʿa (VIII), to come together (3 f. sg. imperf.); 'so that (our word) comes together'
فَتَخَوَّفْتُ: فَـ + تَخَوَّفْتُ — fa-, so + takhawwafa (V), to grow afraid (1 sg. perf.); 'so I grew afraid'
فَتَرْغَبَ: فَـ + تَرْغَبَ — fa-, and so (result, subjunctive after li-allā) + raghiba fī, to desire (2 m. sg.); 'and so you desire'
فَتَقْتُلُهُ: فَـ + تَقْتُلُ + هُ — fa-, and + qatala, to kill (3 f. sg. imperf.) + him; 'and it kills him'
قَرْيَتِهِ: قَرْيَة + هِ — qarya, village (f., gen.) + his; 'his village'
قَلَقًا: قَلَق — qalaq, unease, agitation (acc., internal object of qaliqa); 'an unease'
كَاتِبَهُ: كَاتِب + هُ — kātib, secretary, scribe (acc.) + his; 'his secretary'
كَثُرْنَا: كَثُرْنَا — kathura, to be many, grow numerous (1 pl. perf.); 'we have grown many'
كَلِمَتُنَا: كَلِمَة + نَا — kalima, word (f., nom., subject of تَجْتَمِعُ) + -nā, our; fa-tajtamiʿu kalimatunā, 'so that our word comes together', i.e. we may be united
لَارْتَفَعَ: لَـ + ارْتَفَعَ — la-, then would (marks the answer of a law clause) + irtafaʿa (VIII), to rise (3 m. sg. perf.); 'would rise'
لِتَجْعَلَ: لِـ + تَجْعَلَ — li-, so that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + jaʿala, to make (2 m. sg.); 'so that you make'
مَاكُلُّ: مَا + كُلُّ — mā, not (negation) + kull, every (nom.); run together in the print; 'not every'
مَعْرِفَهَ: مَعْرِفَه — maʿrifa, knowledge, acquaintance (ه for ة, the print's spelling; acc. after lā of general negation); 'no knowledge'
مُؤْنَةً: مُؤْنَة — muʾna, burden, cost of upkeep (acc. of specification); 'in burden'
نَصَبَهَا: نَصَبَ + هَا — naṣaba, to set up (a net, a trap) (3 m. sg. perf.) + it (the net); 'he had set it up'
وَاشْتَبَهَ: وَ + اشْتَبَهَ — and + ishtabaha (VIII) ʿalā, to be unclear to (3 m. sg. perf.); 'and it was unclear'
وَتُحِيطُ: وَ + تُحِيطُ — and + aḥāṭa (IV) bi-, to encompass (2 m. sg. imperf.); aḥāṭa bihi ʿilman, 'to know it thoroughly'
وَرَائِحًا: وَ + رَائِح — and + rāʾiḥ, returning at evening, act. part. of rāḥa (acc., pred. of lam yazal); 'and coming back at dusk'
وَعَظُمْتُ: وَ + عَظُمْتُ — and + ʿaẓuma, to become great (1 sg. perf.); 'and I would become great'
وَكْرِي: وَكْر + ي — wakr, bird's nest (gen.) + my; 'my nest'
وَلَاكُلُّ: وَ + لَا + كُلُّ — and + not + kull, every (nom.); run together in the print; 'and not every'
وَلِئَلَّا: وَ + لِـ + أَنْ + لَا — and + li-, so that (purpose) + an, that + lā, not; 'and so that … not'
وَلِيمَةً: وَلِيمَة — walīma, feast, banquet (f., acc. indef.); 'a feast'
يَتْرُكُ: يَتْرُكُ — taraka, to leave, give up (3 m. sg. imperf.); 'he leaves off'
يَدْخُلَكَ: يَدْخُلَ + كَ — dakhala, to enter (3 m. sg. subj. after li-allā) + you; 'enter you, take hold of you'
يَظْفَرُ: يَظْفَرُ — ẓafira bi-, to get the better of, seize (3 m. sg. imperf.); 'gets the better (of)'
يَعْطَبُ: يَعْطَبُ — ʿaṭiba, to perish, come to ruin (3 m. sg. imperf.); 'perishes'
يُعَظِّمُهُمْ: يُعَظِّمُ + هُمْ — ʿaẓẓama (II), to honour, treat with respect (3 m. sg. imperf.) + them; 'honours them'
يُقَدَّمُ: يُقَدَّمُ — quddima, passive of qaddama (II), to set before (3 m. sg. imperf.); yuqaddamu lahum, 'is served to them'
بِكُرْكِيٍّ: بِـ + كُرْكِيّ — bi-, marking what appears after إِذَا of surprise ('and behold') + kurkī, crane (m., gen. indef.); 'a crane'
سَاقَهُمَا: سَاقَ + ـهُمَا — sāqa/yasūqu, to drive, lead along (I hollow, perf. 3ms) + 3 dual obj.; 'drove the two of them'
سَقَطَا: سَقَطَ + ـا — saqaṭa, to fall (I, perf. 3 m. dual); 'the two fell'
يَصْرُخَانِ: يَصْرُخ + ـَانِ — ṣarakha/yaṣrukhu, to cry out, shriek (I, imperf. 3 m. dual indic.); 'crying out'
الْوَكْرَ: الـ + وَكْر — al-, the + wakr, bird's nest (m., acc., object of askunu); 'the nest'
حَذَرًا: حَذَر — ḥadhar, caution, wariness (verbal noun of ḥadhira, m., acc. indef., giving the reason); 'out of caution'
تَرْحَلْ: تَرْحَل — raḥala/yarḥalu, to depart, move away (I, jussive 2ms after prohibitive لَا); 'do not depart'
حَذِرًا: حَذِر — ḥadhir, wary, on one's guard (adj., m., acc. indef., predicate of lam yazal); 'wary'
شَاخِصٌ: شَاخِص — shākhiṣ, staring, gazing fixedly (act. part. of shakhaṣa, m., nom. indef., predicate of huwa); 'gazing'
بِعُصْفُورَيْنِ: بِـ + عُصْفُورَيْن — bi-, marking what appears after إِذَا of surprise ('and behold') + ʿuṣfūr, sparrow (m., dual gen.); 'two sparrows'
وَأَرَى: وَ + أَرَى — wa-, and + raʾā/yarā, to see (I, imperf. 1s); 'and see' (the hamza is printed in the edition)
الْعَصَافِيرَ: الـ + عَصَافِير — al-, the + ʿaṣāfīr, sparrows (broken pl. of ʿuṣfūr, acc., object of arā); 'the sparrows'
تَقْتَتِلُ: تَقْتَتِل — iqtatala/yaqtatilu, to fight one another (VIII of qatala, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with a non-human plural); 'fighting each other'
جِوَارِى: جِوَار + ـِي — jiwār, neighbourhood, vicinity (m., gen. after فِي) + 1s suffix (final ى for ي in the edition); 'my neighbourhood, near me'
لِيُصْلِحَ: لِـ + يُصْلِح — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + aṣlaḥa, to make peace (IV, imperf. 3ms subj.); 'to make peace'
فَقَلَبَ: فَـ + قَلَبَ — fa-, and then + qalaba, to turn over, overturn (I, perf. 3ms); 'and he turned over'
وَدَفَعَهُ: وَ + دَفَعَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + dafaʿa, to hand over, give (I, perf. 3ms; with إِلَى 'to') + 3ms obj.; 'and handed him'
اسْتَوْثِقْ: اسْتَوْثِق — istawthaqa, to make sure of, make fast (X of wathiqa, imper. 2ms; with بِـ naming what is secured; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'make sure of'
سَمِينٌ: سَمِين — samīn, fat, plump (adj., m., nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'fat'
مَفَرَّ: مَفَرّ — mafarr, escape, place of flight (n. of place/verbal noun of farra, m., acc. without tanwīn after لَا of absolute negation); 'no escape'
لِلْمُحَاذِرِ: لِـ + الـ + مُحَاذِر — li-, for + al-, the + muḥādhir, one who is wary (act. part. III of ḥadhira, m., gen.); 'for the wary one'
بِحِيْلَةٍ: بِـ + حِيْلَة — bi-, by, by means of + ḥīla, stratagem, cunning (f., gen. indef.; the sukūn on the yāʾ is the print's); 'by any cunning'
فَأٰخُذَ: فَـ + آخُذَ — fa-, and so (joining it to li-abīʿahu, so also subjunctive) + ākhudha, I take (1st sing. subj. of akhadha); printed فأخذ with a single hamzated alif for ʾā, pointed with a dagger alif; 'and take'
فَأَزْعَجَنِي: فَـ + أَزْعَجَ + ـنِي — fa-, and so + azʿaja, to alarm, disturb (IV, perf. 3ms) + 1s obj.; 'and it alarmed me'
أَسْكُنُ: أَسْكُن — sakana/yaskunu, to dwell, live in (I, imperf. 1s); 'I dwell'
سَأَصْبِرُ: سَـ + أَصْبِر — sa-, will (future prefix) + ṣabara/yaṣbiru, to be patient, endure (I, imperf. 1s); 'I will bear it'
لَأُصْلِحَنَّ: لَـ + أُصْلِح + ـَنَّ — la-, surely (oath particle) + aṣlaḥa, to reconcile, make peace (IV, imperf. 1s) + -anna (energetic); 'I will surely make peace'
أَمْنِي: أَمْن + ـِي — amn, safety, security (m., nom., noun of kāna) + 1s suffix; 'my safety'
أَبْقَانِي: أَبْقَى + ـنِي — abqā, to let remain, spare (IV of baqiya, perf. 3ms, with conditional sense after إِنْ) + 1s obj.; 'lets me live on'
أَعَزَّهُ: أَعَزَّ + ـهُ — aʿazza, to make mighty, honour (IV of ʿazza, perf. 3ms used as a wish) + 3ms obj.; with Allāhu as subject, 'may God strengthen him'
النَّوَالِ: الـ + نَوَال — nawāl, gift, bounty (m., gen. sg.); 'the bounty'
وَالِهُ: وَالِه — as printed, pointed wālihu; no fitting sense here, probably a misprint for وَلَدُهُ, waladuhu, 'his son' (see note)
إِذْنٍ: إِذْن — idhn, permission, leave (m., gen. sg. indef.)
وَيُحِبُّهُ: وَ + يُحِبُّ + ـهُ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV of حبب, impf. 3ms) + 3ms obj. suffix; 'and (they) love him'
سَرَارِى: سَرَارِي — sarārī, concubines (pl. of surriyya, gen., in construct); written with final ى
وَجَوَارِيهِ: وَ + جَوَارِي + ـهِ — jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya, gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his slave-girls'
يُنَادِمُ: يُنَادِمُ — nādama, to be a boon companion to (verb III of ندم, impf. 3ms); 'he would keep company with (over wine)'
بِنَوَادِرِ: بِـ + نَوَادِر — bi-, of (prep. governed by ḥaddatha, the thing told) + nawādir, rarities, curious tales (pl. of nādira, gen., in construct); 'of the rarities of'
بَكَّارٍ: بَكَّار — Bakkār (m. name), gen. after ibn; 'ʿAlī ibn Bakkār', 'ʿAlī son of Bakkār'
الشَّكْلِ: الـ + شَكْل — shakl, shape, form, bearing (m., gen. sg.); 'the shape'
مُوَرَّدَ: مُوَرَّد — muwarrad, rose-tinted, rosy (pass. part. II of ورد, acc., in construct); 'rosy of'
الْخَدَّيْنِ: الـ + خَدَّيْنِ — khadd, cheek (m., gen. dual); 'the two cheeks'
مَقْرُونَ: مَقْرُون — maqrūn, joined (pass. part. I of قرن, acc., in construct); 'joined of'
عَذْبَ: عَذْب — ʿadhb, sweet (adj., acc., in construct); 'sweet of'
ضَاحِكَ: ضَاحِك — ḍāḥik, laughing (act. part. I of ضحك, acc., in construct); 'laughing of'
الْبَسْطَ: الـ + بَسْط — basṭ, expansiveness, merriment (m., acc. sg.); 'the merriment'
وَالِانْشِرَاحَ: وَ + الـ + اِنْشِرَاح — inshirāḥ, cheerfulness, lit. opening of the breast (verbal noun VII of شرح, acc.); 'and the cheerfulness'
جَالِسَيْنِ: جَالِسَيْنِ — jālis, sitting (act. part. I of جلس, acc. dual, predicate of kāna)
وَبَيْنَهُنَّ: وَ + بَيْنَ + ـهُنَّ — wa-, and + bayna, among, between (prep.) + 3fp suffix; 'and among them'
بِسَرْجٍ: بِـ + سَرْج — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment) + sarj, saddle (m., gen. indef.); 'with a saddle'
رِكَابٌ: رِكَاب — rikāb, stirrup(s) (m., nom. sg. indef., subject of lahu)
إِزَارٌ: إِزَار — izār, wrap, mantle (m., nom. sg. indef.)
رَفِيعٌ: رَفِيع — rafīʿ, fine, delicate; costly (adj., m. nom. indef.)
زُنَّارٌ: زُنَّار — zunnār, girdle, belt (m., nom. sg. indef.)
مُطَرَّزٌ: مُطَرَّز — muṭarraz, embroidered (pass. part. II of طرز, m. nom. indef.)
الْحَرِيْرِ: الـ + حَرِيْر — ḥarīr, silk (m., gen.); 'the silk' (verse spelling with sukūn on the long ī)
وَمَنْطِقٌ: وَ + مَنْطِق — manṭiq, speech, manner of speaking (m., nom. indef.); 'and a speech'
رَخِيْمُ: رَخِيْم — rakhīm, soft, gentle (of voice or speech) (adj., nom., in construct); 'soft of'
الْحَوَاشِي: الـ + حَوَاشِي — ḥawāshī, edges, borders (pl. of ḥāshiya, gen.); 'the edges'
لَاهُرَاءٌ: لَا + هُرَاء — lā, no, neither (negation) + hurāʾ, babble, wordy empty talk (m., nom. indef.); run together in the print
نَذْرُ: نَذْر — nadhr, vow (m., nom. indef.) as printed; very probably for نَزْر, nazr, scanty, too few (see note)
وَعَيْنَانِ: وَ + عَيْنَانِ — ʿayn, eye (f., nom. dual); 'and two eyes'
كُوْنَا: كُوْنَا — kāna, to be (verb I, imperative 2 dual); 'be (you two)!'
فَكَانَتَا: فَـ + كَانَتَا — fa-, and so + kāna, to be (perf. 3 dual f.); 'and they two were'
فَعُوْلَانِ: فَعُوْلَان — faʿūl, one who does much (intensive adj. of فعل, nom. dual); 'two great doers'
بِالْاَلْبَابِ: بِـ + الـ + أَلْبَاب — bi-, to (prep. governed by faʿala bi-, 'to do (something) to') + albāb, minds (pl. of lubb, gen.); 'to the minds'
مَاتَفْعَلُ: مَا + تَفْعَلُ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + faʿala, to do (verb I, impf. 3fs); 'what (it) does'; run together in the print
حُبَّهَا: حُبّ + ـهَا — ḥubb, love (m., acc. as vocative in construct) + 3fs suffix; 'love of her'
سُلْوَةَ: سُلْوَة — sulwa, consolation, forgetting of grief (f., acc. as vocative in construct)
مَوْعِدُكَ: مَوْعِد + ـكَ — mawʿid, appointed time or place (m., nom.) + 2ms suffix; 'your appointed time'
الْحَشْرُ: الـ + حَشْر — ḥashr, the Gathering (of the dead at the Resurrection) (m., nom.)
وَصَلْنَ: وَصَلْنَ — waṣala, to arrive (verb I, perf. 3fp); 'they (f.) arrived'
صَدَّكَ: صَدّ + ـكَ — as printed, pointed ṣadd, 'side facing' (acc., adverb of place) + 2ms suffix; 'towards you'; possibly a slip for قَصْدَكَ, 'seeking you' (see note)
مَسْكَنُهَا: مَسْكَن + ـهَا — maskan, dwelling (m., nom.) + 3fs suffix; 'her dwelling'
فَعَزِّا: فَـ + عَزِّ — fa-, so (consequence) + ʿazzā, to console (verb II of عزو/عزي, imperative 2ms); 'so console'; the print sets the alif of the following al- onto this word
لْفُوَادَ: …لْفُوَاد — (a)l-fuwād, heart (for fuʾād, m., acc., object), its alif set on the word before; 'the heart'
عَزَاءًا: عَزَاءً — ʿazāʾ, consolation, patience (m., acc. indef., absolute object), written with an extra alif after the hamza
جَمِيْلًا: جَمِيْلًا — jamīl, beautiful, seemly (adj., acc. indef.)
تَسْتَطِيعَ: تَسْتَطِيعَ — istaṭāʿa, to be able (verb X of طوع, subj. 2ms / 3fs after lan); 'you can / she can'
الصُّعُوْ: الـ + صُعُوْ… — ṣuʿūd, ascent (verbal noun I of صعد, acc., object of tastaṭīʿa), its last letter carried over to the next hemistich
دَوَلَنْ: …دَ + وَ + لَنْ — the final dāl of al-ṣuʿūd + wa-, and + lan, will not; run together across the caesura
النُّزُوْلَا: الـ + نُزُوْل — nuzūl, descending, coming down (verbal noun I of نزل, acc.), final alif for the rhyme
وَالْغَرِيبُ: وَ + الـ + غَرِيب — gharīb, stranger (nom., topic); 'and the stranger'
إِكْرَامُهُ: إِكْرَام + ـهُ — ikrām, honouring (verbal noun IV of كرم, nom.) + 3ms suffix (refers back to the stranger); 'honouring him'
تَطْلُبُكَ: تَطْلُبُ + كَ — taṭlubu, she seeks, asks for (imperfect 3 f. sg. of ṭalaba) + -ka, you (m. sg.); 'asks for you'
وَرَفِيقَكَ: وَ + رَفِيق + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + rafīq, companion (m.), acc. + -ka, your; 'and your companion'
أَبُوالْحَسَنِ: أَبُو + الْحَسَنِ — Abū, father of (nom.) + al-Ḥasan (gen.); the name Abū al-Ḥasan, printed as one word
فَأَدْخَلَتْهُمَا: فَـ + أَدْخَلَتْ + هُمَا — fa-, and (conj.) + adkhalat, she brought in (perfect 3 f. sg., form IV of dakhala) + -humā, the two of them; 'and she brought them in'
وَأَجْلَسَتْهُمَا: وَ + أَجْلَسَتْ + هُمَا — wa-, and (conj.) + ajlasat, she seated (perfect 3 f. sg., form IV of jalasa) + -humā, the two; 'and seated them'
فَتَحَدَّثَا: فَـ + تَحَدَّثَا — fa-, and (conj.) + taḥaddathā, the two talked (perfect 3 m. dual, form V of ḥ-d-th); 'and they talked'
بِالْمَوَائِدِ: بِـ + الـ + مَوَائِد — bi-, marking what appears after idhā of surprise + al- + mawāʾid, tables of food (pl. of māʾida), gen.; 'the tables'
قُدَّامَهُمَا: قُدَّامَ + هُمَا — quddāma, in front of (adv. of place) + -humā, the two; 'before them'
أَمَرَتْهُمَا: أَمَرَتْ + هُمَا — amarat, she ordered (perfect 3 f. sg. of amara) + -humā, the two; 'she ordered them'
بِالْقِيَامِ: بِـ + الـ + قِيَام — bi-, taking the thing ordered (amara bi-, 'order something') + al- + qiyām, rising (verbal noun of qāma), gen.; 'to rise'
فَقَامَا: فَـ + قَامَا — fa-, and (conj.) + qāmā, the two rose (perfect 3 m. dual of qāma); 'and they rose'
مُرَكَّبَةً: مُرَكَّبَة — murakkaba, set, mounted, built (f. passive participle, form II of rakiba), acc.; 'raised'
الْفُرُشِ: الـ + فُرُش — al- + furush, furnishings, carpets (pl. of firāsh), gen.; 'the furnishings'
مُزَيَّنَةٌ: مُزَيَّنَة — muzayyana, adorned (f. passive participle, form II of z-y-n), nom.; 'adorned'
مَقَاصِيرِ: مَقَاصِير — maqāṣīr, chambers (pl. of maqṣūra), gen. in construct; 'the chambers of'
فَانْدَهَشَا: فَـ + انْدَهَشَا — fa-, and (conj.) + indahashā, the two were amazed (perfect 3 m. dual, colloquial form VII of d-h-sh); 'and they were amazed'
عَايَنَا: عَايَنَا — ʿāyanā, the two beheld (perfect 3 m. dual, form III of ʿ-y-n, 'see with one's own eyes'); 'they saw'
الْغَرَائِبِ: الـ + غَرَائِب — al- + gharāʾib, wonders, marvels (pl. of gharība), gen.; 'the wonders'
يَتَمَايَلْنَ: يَتَمَايَلْنَ — yatamāyalna, they (f.) sway (imperfect 3 f. pl., form VI of m-y-l); 'swaying'
يُدْهِشْنَ: يُدْهِشْنَ — yudhishna, they (f.) astonish (imperfect 3 f. pl., form IV of d-h-sh); 'dazzling'
وَيُحَيِّرْنَ: وَ + يُحَيِّرْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuḥayyirna, they (f.) bewilder (imperfect 3 f. pl., form II of ḥ-y-r); 'and bewildering'
وَاصْطَفَفْنَ: وَ + اصْطَفَفْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + iṣṭafafna, they (f.) formed a row (perfect 3 f. pl., form VIII of ṣ-f-f); 'and they ranged themselves'
بُرْهَةٍ: بُرْهَة — burha, short while (f.), gen. indef.; 'a little while'
فَسَلَّمْنَ: فَـ + سَلَّمْنَ — fa-, and (conj.) + sallamna, they (f.) greeted (perfect 3 f. pl., form II of s-l-m; sallama ʿalā, 'greet'); 'and they greeted'
وَآلَاتُ: وَ + آلَات — wa-, and (conj.) + ālāt, instruments (pl. of āla), nom. in construct; 'and the instruments of'
وَالطَّرَبِ: وَ + الـ + طَرَب — wa-, and (conj.) + al- + ṭarab, delight, musical rapture (m.), gen.; 'and music'
كُلُّهُنَّ: كُلّ + هُنَّ — kull, all (nom.) + -hunna, of them (f. pl.); 'all of them'
وَأَصْلَحْنَ: وَ + أَصْلَحْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + aṣlaḥna, they (f.) put right (perfect 3 f. pl., form IV of ṣ-l-ḥ), of strings 'tuned'
الْأَوْتَارَ: الـ + أَوْتَار — al- + awtār, strings (pl. of watar), acc.; 'the strings'
وَقُمْنَ: وَ + قُمْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + qumna, they (f.) stood (perfect 3 f. pl. of qāma); 'and they stood'
بِالْعِيدَانِ: بِـ + الـ + عِيدَان — bi-, on (prep.; ḍaraba bi- 'strike on, play') + al- + ʿīdān, lutes, gen.; 'on the lutes'
وَيُغَنِّينَ: وَ + يُغَنِّينَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yughannīna, they (f.) sing (imperfect 3 f. pl., form II of gh-n-y); 'and singing'
وَيُنْشِدْنَ: وَ + يُنْشِدْنَ — wa-, and (conj.) + yunshidna, they (f.) recite (verse) (imperfect 3 f. pl., form IV of n-sh-d); 'and reciting'
لِلْعِبَادِ: لِـ + الـ + عِبَاد — li-, for, to (prep., the one tempted) + al- + ʿibād, servants (of God), mankind (pl. of ʿabd), gen.; 'to God's servants'
مِثْلِهِنَّ: مِثْل + هِنَّ — mithl, like, the like of (gen., agreeing with jawārin) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); 'like them'
كَوَاعِبَ: كَوَاعِب — kawāʿib, full-breasted maidens (pl. of kāʿib), gen. (diptote, with fatḥa); 'high-breasted'
أَتْرَابٍ: أَتْرَاب — atrāb, of equal age, peers (pl. of tirb), gen. indef.; 'of an age'
سُودِ: سُود — sūd, black (pl. of aswad), gen. in construct; 'black of'
مُوَرَّدَاتِ: مُوَرَّدَات — muwarradāt, rose-coloured (f. pl. passive participle, form II of w-r-d), gen. in construct; 'rosy of'
مَقْرُونَاتِ: مَقْرُونَات — maqrūnāt, joined (f. pl. passive participle of qarana), gen. in construct; 'joined of'
نَاعِسَاتِ: نَاعِسَات — nāʿisāt, drowsy, languid (f. pl. active participle of naʿasa), gen. in construct; 'languid of'
لِلْعَابِدِينَ: لِـ + الـ + عَابِدِين — li-, to, for (prep.) + al- + ʿābidīn, worshippers, the devout (pl. of ʿābid), gen.; 'to the devout'
وَنُزْهَةٍ: وَ + نُزْهَة — wa-, and (conj.) + nuzha, delight, pleasure (f.), gen. indef.; 'and a delight'
يُدْهِشُ: يُدْهِشُ — yudhishu, it amazes (imperfect 3 m. sg., form IV of d-h-sh); 'dazzles'
وَيُحَيِّرُةُ: وَ + يُحَيِّرُ + ةُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yuḥayyiru, it bewilders (imperfect 3 m. sg., form II of ḥ-y-r) + -hu, it, printed with tāʾ marbūṭa; 'and bewilders it'
فَوَقَفْنَ: فَـ + وَقَفْنَ — fa-, and (conj.) + waqafna, they (f.) stood, stopped (perfect 3 f. pl. of waqafa); 'and they stood'
بَعْدِهِنَّ: بَعْد + هِنَّ — baʿd, after (gen. after min) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); min baʿdihinna 'after them'
وَدَلَالًا: وَ + دَلَال — wa-, and (conj.) + dalāl, coquetry (m.), acc. indef. of specification after yazdādu; 'and in coquetry'
مُتَوَشِّحَةٌ: مُتَوَشِّحَة — mutawashshiḥa, wearing as a sash, wrapped (f. active participle, form V of w-sh-ḥ), nom.; 'wrapped'
أَزْرَقُ: أَزْرَق — azraq, blue (m.), nom. (diptote, no tanwīn); 'blue'
بِطِرَازَاتٍ: بِـ + طِرَازَات — bi-, with (prep., accompaniment: 'having') + ṭirāzāt, embroidered bands (pl. of ṭirāz), gen. indef.; 'with borders'
حِيَاصَةٌ: حِيَاصَة — ḥiyāṣa, girdle, belt (f.), nom. indef.; 'a girdle'
مُرَصَّعَةٌ: مُرَصَّعَة — muraṣṣaʿa, inlaid, studded (f. passive participle, form II of r-ṣ-ʿ), nom.; 'set'
وَتَتَمَايَلُ: وَ + تَتَمَايَلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + tatamāyalu, she sways (imperfect 3 f. sg., form VI of m-y-l); 'and swaying'
هٰذِيْ: هٰذِي — hādhī, this (f. demonstrative, by-form of hādhihi); 'this one'
اِبْتِدَاءُ: اِبْتِدَاء — ibtidāʾ, beginning (verbal noun, form VIII of b-d-ʾ), nom. in construct; 'the beginning of'
سَقَامِيْ: سَقَام + ي — saqām, sickness (m.) + -ī, my; 'my sickness'
وَتَمَادِيْ: وَ + تَمَادِي — wa-, and (conj.) + tamādī, continuance, being drawn out (verbal noun, form VI of m-d-y), in construct; 'and the drawing-out of'
نَفْسِيَ: نَفْس + ي — nafs, soul, self (f.), acc. + -iya, my (the long form of -ī before a vowel or for metre); 'my soul'
ذَابَتْ: ذَابَتْ — dhābat, she/it melted (perfect 3 f. sg. of dhāba); 'melted'
وُلُوْعِيْ: وُلُوع + ي — wulūʿ, ardent attachment (verbal noun of waliʿa) + -ī, my; 'my ardour'
وَبَرَى: وَ + بَرَى — wa-, and (conj.) + barā, he/it pared, wore thin (perfect 3 m. sg. of barā, yabrī); 'and has worn thin'
عِظَامِيْ: عِظَام + ي — ʿiẓām, bones (pl. of ʿaẓm) + -ī, my; 'my bones'
أُوَطِّنَ: أُوَطِّنَ — uwaṭṭina, I settle, accustom (subjunctive 1 sg., form II of w-ṭ-n); waṭṭana nafsahu 'steel oneself'
وَأُصَبِّرَهَا: وَ + أُصَبِّرَ + هَا — wa-, and (conj.) + uṣabbira, I make patient (subjunctive 1 sg., form II of ṣ-b-r) + -hā, it (the soul, f.); 'and make it patient'
خَشِيتُ: خَشِيتُ — khashītu, I feared (perfect 1 sg. of khashiya); 'I was afraid'
فَيَلْحَقَكَ: فَـ + يَلْحَقَ + كَ — fa-, and then (conj., consequence) + yalḥaqa, it overtakes (subjunctive 3 m. sg. of laḥiqa, still governed by an) + -ka, you; 'and there overtake you'
يَصُدُّكَ: يَصُدُّ + كَ — yaṣuddu, it turns away, hinders (imperfect 3 m. sg. of ṣadda) + -ka, you; 'keeps you'
وَيَحِيلُ: وَ + يَحِيلُ — wa-, and (conj.) + yaḥīlu, it comes between (imperfect 3 m. sg.; the print's form for Classical yaḥūlu, from ḥāla); 'and comes between'
نَحْوَكَ: نَحْوَ + كَ — naḥwa, toward (prep.) + -ka, you; 'toward you'
وَلِلِقَائِكَ: وَ + لِـ + لِقَاء + كَ — wa-, and (conj.) + li-, toward (prep., the goal) + liqāʾ, meeting, gen. + -ka, you; 'and toward meeting you'
مُتَوَصِّلَةٌ: مُتَوَصِّلَة — mutawaṣṣila, seeking a way, contriving to reach (f. active participle, form V of w-ṣ-l), nom.; 'seeking the way'
مَحَاظِي: مَحَاظِي — maḥāẓī, favourite concubines (pl. of maḥẓiyya), gen. after min; 'the favourites of'
وَتَأَمَّلَتْ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَتْ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾammalat, she contemplated, gazed at (perfect 3 f. sg., form V of ʾ-m-l); 'and gazed upon'
وَتَأَمَّلَ: وَ + تَأَمَّلَ — wa-, and (conj.) + taʾammala, he contemplated (perfect 3 m. sg., form V of ʾ-m-l), printed without hamza; 'and gazed upon'
فَاشْتَغَلَا: فَـ + اشْتَغَلَا — fa-, and (conj.) + ishtaghalā, the two were occupied (perfect 3 m. dual, form VIII of sh-gh-l); with bi-, 'were absorbed in'
بِالْغِنَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + غِنَاء — bi-, taking the thing ordered (amara bi-) + al- + ghināʾ, singing (m.), gen.; 'to sing'
اَعِدِ: أَعِدْ (imperative of أَعَادَ, form IV of ع-و-د) — aʿid, repeat!, send again (m. sg.), here aʿidi with a helping vowel before al-
الرِّسَالَةً: الـ + رِسَالَة — risāla, message, letter (f.); the print sets a tanwīn on it (الرِّسَالَةً), a slip for al-risālata, accusative object of aʿid
ثَانِيَهْ: ثَانِيَة — thāniya, a second time (f. of ثَانٍ, 'second'), adverbial accusative; spelt with ه for ة, pausal thāniyah
عَلَانِيَهْ: عَلَانِيَة — ʿalāniya, openness; acc. 'openly, publicly'; spelt with ه for ة
وَاِلَيْكَ: وَ + إِلَى + ـكَ — wa-, and + ilā, to + -ka, you (m.); 'and to you'
الْمِلَا: الـ + مِلَا(ح) — the first half of الْمِلَاح, al-milāḥ, 'the fair ones' (pl. of مَلِيح, handsome), broken across the hemistichs
اَشْكُوْحَا: أَشْكُو + حَا(لِي) — ashkū, I complain (of) (imperfect 1st sg. of شَكَا) + the first part of ḥāliyah, 'my state'; the print puts the word break in the wrong place (read ashkū ḥāliyah)
لِيَهْ: (حَا)لِيَهْ — end of ḥāliyah: حَال, ḥāl, state, condition + ـي, my, with pausal -yah for the rhyme; 'my state'
يَاقَلْبِي: يَا + قَلْب + ـي — yā, O + qalb, heart + -ī, my; 'O my heart' (the print runs yā on to the noun)
الْغَالِيَهْ: الـ + غَالِيَة — ghālī, precious, costly (f. ghāliya), spelt with ه for ة
اِنْعَمْ: أَنْعِمْ — anʿim, bestow, be gracious (imperative of أَنْعَمَ, form IV of ن-ع-م); أَنْعَمَ عَلَى 'to bestow on'
هِبَةً: هِبَة — hiba, gift (f.), acc. 'as a gift'
عَارِبَهْ: عَارِبَة — as printed, no sense here; stands for عَارِيَة, ʿāriya, a loan, a thing lent; 'as a loan'
وَاَرُدُّهَا: وَ + أَرُدُّ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aruddu, I return, give back (imperfect 1st sg. of رَدَّ) + -hā, it (the kiss); 'and I will give it back'
هِيَهْ: هِيَ + ـهْ — hiya, she, it (f.) + pausal -h for the rhyme; 'it is'
اَرَدَّتَّ: أَرَدْتَ — aradta, you wanted (past 2nd m. sg. of أَرَادَ, form IV of ر-و-د); printed اَرَدَّتَّ, showing the d assimilated to the t
رَاضِيَهْ: رَاضِيَة — rāḍiya, content, willing (f. of رَاضٍ, act. part. of رَضِيَ), spelt with ه for ة
يَامُلْبِسِي: يَا + مُلْبِس + ـي — yā, O + mulbis, one who clothes (act. part. of أَلْبَسَ, form IV of ل-ب-س) + -ī, me; 'O you who clothe me' (the print runs yā on)
يُهْنِيْكَ: يُهْنِي + ـكَ — as printed yuhnī, for يَهْنِئُ/يُهَنِّئُ, 'may it be wholesome, a joy to' (root ه-ن-أ, hamza dropped) + -ka, you; 'may it do you good'
فَحَرَّكَتِ: فَـ + حَرَّكَتْ — fa-, so + ḥarrakat, she moved, set in motion (past of حَرَّكَ, form II of ح-ر-ك, 3rd f. sg.); 'so she set astir'
يَاحَظَّ: يَا + حَظّ — yā, O + ḥaẓẓ, portion, good fortune, delight (m.); 'O delight (of …)' (run together in the print)
وَيَامُنَاهَا: وَ + يَا + مُنَى + ـهَا — wa-, and + yā, O + munā, wish, desire (pl. of مُنْيَة) + -hā, its (the eye's); 'and O its desire'
وَمُنْتَهَى: وَ + مُنْتَهَى — wa-, and + muntahā, utmost end, limit (m.)
غَايَتِي: غَايَة + ـي — ghāya, aim, goal (f.) + -ī, my; 'my aim'
وَدِينِي: وَ + دِين + ـي — wa-, and + dīn, religion, faith (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my faith'
اِرْثِ: اِرْثِ — irthi, have pity! (imperative of رَثَى, 'to pity, mourn', with لِـ of the one pitied)
طَرْفُهُ: طَرْف + ـهُ — ṭarf, eye, glance (m.) + -hu, his; 'his eye'
الْوَالِهِ: الـ + وَالِه — wālih, distraught, mad with grief or love (act. part. of وَلِهَ)
لِجَارِيَةٍ: لِـ + جَارِيَة — li-, to (the person addressed) + jāriya, slave-girl (f.); 'to a slave-girl'
أَسْمِعِينَا: أَسْمِعِي + ـنَا — asmiʿī, make hear! (f. imperative of أَسْمَعَ, form IV of س-م-ع) + -nā, us; 'let us hear'
فَأَطْرَبَتْ: فَـ + أَطْرَبَتْ — fa-, and + aṭrabat, she delighted (others), moved to ṭarab (past of أَطْرَبَ, form IV of ط-ر-ب, 3rd f. sg.)
سَكِرْتُ: سَكِرْتُ — sakirtu, I became drunk (past 1st sg. of سَكِرَ)
لَامِنْ: لَا + مِنْ — lā, not + min, from; 'not from' (run together in the print)
مُدَامَتِهِ: مُدَامَة + ـهِ — mudāma, wine (f.) + -hi, his; 'his wine'
بِالنَّوْمِ: بِـ + الـ + نَوْم — bi-, with (makes māla transitive: 'turned sleep aside') + al-, the + nawm, sleep (m.)
تَمَايُلُهُ: تَمَايُل + ـهُ — tamāyul, swaying, swinging gait (m., verbal noun of form VI تَمَايَلَ) + -hu, his
السُّلَافُ: الـ + سُلَاف — sulāf, the first-run, choicest wine (m.)
سَلَتْنِي: سَلَتْ + ـنِي — salat, she/it made forget, consoled (past 3rd f. sg. of سَلَا) + -nī, me; 'made me forget'
سَوَالِفُهُ: سَوَالِف + ـهُ — sawālif, the locks along the cheeks (pl. of سَالِفَة) + -hu, his
الشُّمُولُ: الـ + شَمُول — shamūl, cool wine (f.; a poetic name for wine)
شَلَتْنِي: شَلَتْ + ـنِي — as printed shalat, obscure: probably 'carried off, lured' (from شَلَا/أَشْلَى), perhaps for شَغَلَتْ 'held captive' + -nī, me
شَمَائِلُهُ: شَمَائِل + ـهُ — shamāʾil, qualities, graces of character (pl. of شِمَال/شَمِيلَة) + -hu, his
لَوَى: لَوَى — lawā, he/it twisted, bent (past of لَوَى); with بِـ 'twisted (something) away'
بِعَزْمِي: بِـ + عَزْم + ـي — bi-, with (object of lawā bi-: 'twisted my resolve away') + ʿazm, resolve, determination (m.) + -ī, my
اَصْدَاغٌ: أَصْدَاغ — aṣdāgh, temples; the curls at the temples (pl. of صُدْغ)
لَوَيْنَ: لَوَيْنَ — lawayna, they (f. pl.) curled, twisted (past 3rd f. pl. of لَوَى)
وَغَالَ: وَ + غَالَ — wa-, and + ghāla, destroyed, took off by stealth (past of غَالَ)
تَحْوَى: تَحْوَى — as printed for تَحْوِي, taḥwī, they (the shirts) contain (imperfect of حَوَى)
غَلَائِلُهُ: غَلَائِل + ـهُ — ghalāʾil, fine shirts worn next to the skin (pl. of غِلَالَة) + -hu, his
إِنْشَادَ: إِنْشَاد — inshād, recitation, singing of verse (m., verbal noun of أَنْشَدَ)
تَنَهَّدَتْ: تَنَهَّدَتْ — tanahhadat, she sighed (past 3rd f. sg. of تَنَهَّدَ, form V of ن-ه-د)
وَأَعْجَبَهَا: وَ + أَعْجَبَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aʿjaba, pleased (past of أَعْجَبَ, form IV of ع-ج-ب) + -hā, her; 'and it pleased her'
الشِّعْرُ: الـ + شِعْر — shiʿr, poetry (m.), nom.: subject of aʿjabahā
تُغَنِّيَ: تُغَنِّيَ — tughanniya, she should sing (subjunctive 3rd f. sg. of غَنَّى, form II of غ-ن-ي)
لِمِصْبَاحِ: لِـ + مِصْبَاح — li-, to, with (the rival, after mubāhin) + miṣbāḥ, lamp (m.); 'with the lamp (of …)'
مُبَاهِ: مُبَاهٍ — mubāhin, vying in glory, boasting against (act. part. of بَاهَى, form III of ب-ه-ي)
يَبْدُو: يَبْدُو — yabdū, it appears, shows (imperfect of بَدَا)
رَشْحَ: رَشْح — rashḥ, a sprinkling, oozing, dew (m.), acc. 'as a dew'
رَقَمَ: رَقَمَ — raqama, embroidered, inscribed (past of رَقَمَ)
غُلَالَتَيْهِ: غُلَالَتَيْ + ـهِ — ghulālatay, two fine under-garments (dual of غِلَالَة, construct) + -hi, his; 'his two fine veils', i.e. his cheeks
بِأَحْرُفٍ: بِـ + أَحْرُف — bi-, with (the means) + aḥruf, letters (pl. of حَرْف); 'with letters'
طَيِّهَا: طَيّ + ـهَا — ṭayy, fold (m.) + -hā, their (the letters'); 'their fold'
مُتَنَاهِ: مُتَنَاهٍ — mutanāhin, reaching its limit, complete (act. part. of تَنَاهَى, form VI of ن-ه-ي)
الْمُنَمْنَمُ: الـ + مُنَمْنَم — munamnam, finely embroidered, finely wrought (pass. part. of نَمْنَمَ)
طِرَازِ: طِرَاز — ṭirāz, the embroidered band of inscription on a robe; fine workmanship (m.)
أَنْشِدِى: أَنْشِدِى — anshidī, recite! sing! (f. imperative of أَنْشَدَ), printed with ى for ي
وَأَسْمِعِينَا: وَ + أَسْمِعِي + ـنَا — wa-, and + asmiʿī, make hear! (f. imperative of أَسْمَعَ) + -nā, us; 'and let us hear'
وَالدَّلَالْ: وَ + الـ + دَلَال — wa-, and + al-, the + dalāl, coquetry, playing hard to get (m.)
صُدُودٍ: صُدُود — ṣudūd, turning away, aloofness (m.), gen. after min
مُتْلِفٍ: مُتْلِف — mutlif, ruinous, deadly (act. part. of أَتْلَفَ, form IV of ت-ل-ف)
الْجَمَالْ: الـ + جَمَال — jamāl, beauty (m.); ahl al-jamāl, 'the beautiful'
فَاسْتَغْنِمُوْا: فَـ + اِسْتَغْنِمُوا — fa-, so + istaghnimū, take as spoil, seize (m. pl. imperative of اِسْتَغْنَمَ, form X of غ-ن-م)
السُّعُوْ: الـ + سُعُو(د) — the first half of السُّعُود, al-suʿūd, good fortunes, lucky stars (pl. of سَعْد), broken across the hemistichs
بِطِيبِ: بِـ + طِيب — bi-, with (the means: enjoy the time with …) + ṭīb, sweetness, goodness (m.)
الْوِصَالْ: الـ + وِصَال — wiṣāl, union, meeting of lovers (m.)
أَتْبَعَهَا: أَتْبَعَ + ـهَا — atbaʿa (IV of تَبِعَ), to make (something) follow, follow up (X with بِـ Y); perf. 3ms + obj. 3fs; 'he followed it (her song) up'
بِدُمُوعٍ: بِـ + دُمُوع — bi-, with (the means: followed up with) + dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع), indef. gen.; 'with tears'
غِزَارٍ: غِزَار — ghizār, abundant, copious (pl. of غَزِير), gen.; 'abundant'
أَحْرَقَهَا: أَحْرَقَ + ـهَا — aḥraqa (IV), to burn; perf. 3ms + obj. 3fs; 'it burned her'
وَأَتْلَفَهَا: وَ + أَتْلَفَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + atlafa (IV), to ruin, waste, destroy; perf. 3ms + obj. 3fs; 'and it wasted her'
الْوَلَهُ: الـ + وَلَه — walah, distraction, bewilderment of grief or love (m.), nom.
وَوَقَعَا: وَ + وَقَعَا — wa-, and + waqaʿa (I), to fall; perf. 3 dual m., 'and the two fell'
وَحَمَلْنَهُمَا: وَ + حَمَلْنَ + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + ḥamala (I), to carry; perf. 3fp + obj. 3 dual; 'and they (f.) carried the two'
وَأَدْخَلْنَهُمَا: وَ + أَدْخَلْنَ + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + adkhala (IV), to bring in, make enter; perf. 3fp + obj. 3 dual; 'and they (f.) brought the two in'
وَرَشَّشْنَ: وَ + رَشَّشْنَ — wa-, and + rashshasha (II), to sprinkle repeatedly; perf. 3fp, 'and they (f.) sprinkled' (the shadda is printed)
يُقْدِرَنِي: يُقْدِرَ + ـنِي — aqdara (IV of قَدَرَ), to enable, give power (to do: عَلَى); subj. 3ms after أَنْ + obj. 1s; 'that He enable me'
يَاصَاحِبَ: يَا + صَاحِب — yā, O (vocative) + ṣāḥib, possessor, master (m.), acc. in construct; run together in the print; 'O doer of'
مَابَلَغَ: مَا + بَلَغَ — mā, not (neg.) + balagha (I), to reach; with بِـ … إِلَى, 'bring (someone) to'; perf. 3ms; run together in the print; 'has not brought'
غَايَةٍ: غَايَة — ghāya, limit, extreme, utmost point (f.), indef. gen.
ضِعْفُهَا: ضِعْف + ـهَا — ḍiʿf, double, twice as much (m.), nom. + 3fs poss.; 'twice it'
أَصَابَنَا: أَصَابَ + ـنَا — aṣāba (IV), to befall, strike; perf. 3ms + obj. 1p; 'befell us'
جَمْعُ: جَمْع — jamʿ, gathering, bringing together (verbal noun of I), nom.
يُطْفِئُ: يُطْفِئُ — aṭfaʾa (IV), to extinguish, quench; imperf. 3ms (hamza printed)
اللَّهِيبِ: الـ + لَهِيب — lahīb, flame, blaze (m.), gen.
مَاتَمَكَّنَ: مَا + تَمَكَّنَ — mā, what + tamakkana (V), to take firm hold, become established; perf. 3ms; run together in the print; 'what has taken hold'
حُبِّكِ: حُبّ + ـكِ — ḥubb, love (m.) + 2fs poss. (objective); 'love of you'
بِذَهَابِ: بِـ + ذَهَاب — bi-, with, by (accompaniment: 'only along with') + dhahāb, going away, departure (verbal noun of I), gen. Also bi- of cause, 'through, by reason of': ʿarafū ʿudhrī bi-dhahābi mālī, 'they will accept my excuse, my money being gone'.
الْمَنْثُورُ: الـ + مَنْثُور — manthūr, scattered, strewn (pass. part. of I نَثَرَ), nom.
لِبُكَائِهِ: لِـ + بُكَاء + ـهِ — li-, for, because of (cause) + bukāʾ, weeping (m.), gen. + 3ms poss.; 'at his weeping'
أَمْرِكُمَا: أَمْر + ـكُمَا — amr, affair, matter, case (m.), gen. + 2 dual poss.; 'your (two's) affair'
وَأَمْرَكُمَا: وَ + أَمْر + ـكُمَا — wa-, and + amr, affair (m.), acc. after إِنَّ + 2 dual poss.; 'and your affair'
وَاحْتَرْتُ: وَ + اِحْتَرْتُ — wa-, and + iḥtāra (VIII of حَارَ), to be perplexed, at a loss; perf. 1s, 'and I am bewildered'
شَأْنِكُمَا: شَأْن + ـكُمَا — shaʾn, matter, case (m.), gen. + 2 dual poss.; printed شان without hamza
حَالَكُمَا: حَال + ـكُمَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f.), acc. after إِنَّ + 2 dual poss.; 'your state'
وَأَنْتُمَا: وَ + أَنْتُمَا — wa- of circumstance, 'while' + antumā, you two (2 dual pron.)
مُجْتَمِعَانِ: مُجْتَمِع — mujtamiʿ, together, united (act. part. of VIII اِجْتَمَعَ), nom. dual
انْفِصَالِكُمَا: اِنْفِصَال + ـكُمَا — infiṣāl, separation (verbal noun of VII اِنْفَصَلَ), gen. + 2 dual poss.
وَتَفَرُّقِكُمَا: وَ + تَفَرُّق + ـكُمَا — wa-, and + tafarruq, parting, dispersal (verbal noun of V), gen. + 2 dual poss.
فَانْشَرِحَا: فَـ + اِنْشَرِحَا — fa-, so + inshariḥ (VII), to be open-hearted, cheerful; imperat. 2 dual, 'so be glad, you two'
وَانْبَسِطَا: وَ + اِنْبَسِطَا — wa-, and + inbasiṭ (VII), to be at ease, cheerful; imperat. 2 dual
وَصَائِفُ: وَصَائِف — waṣāʾif, young maidservants (pl. of وَصِيفَة; diptote), nom.
وَصَائِفَ: وَصَائِف — waṣāʾif, young maidservants (pl. of وَصِيفَة; diptote), gen. after a number (no nunation)
حَامِلَاتٌ: حَامِلَات — ḥāmilāt, carrying (f. pl. act. part. of I حَمَلَ), nom.; 'carrying'
مَائِدَةً: مَائِدَة — māʾida, table spread with food (f.), indef. acc. (object of the participle)
صُحُونِ: صُحُون — ṣuḥūn, dishes, platters (pl. of صَحْن), gen.
الْفَاخِرِ: الـ + فَاخِر — fākhir, splendid, sumptuous (act. part. of I فَخَرَ), gen.
فَوَضَعْنَ: فَـ + وَضَعْنَ — fa-, and + waḍaʿa (I), to put, set down; perf. 3fp, 'and they (f.) set'
وَتُطْعِمُ: وَ + تُطْعِمُ — wa-, and + aṭʿama (IV), to feed; imperf. 3fs
يَأْكُلُونَ: يَأْكُلُونَ — akala (I), to eat; imperf. 3mp (hamza printed)
رُفِعَتِ: رُفِعَتْ — rafaʿa (I), to lift, take away; passive perf. 3fs, helping vowel -i before the article; 'was taken away'
وَجَاءَتْهُمُ: وَ + جَاءَتْ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + jāʾa (I), to come (to someone: direct obj.); perf. 3fs (broken pl. subject) + obj. 3mp, with helping vowel -u; 'and there came to them'
الْمَبَاخِرُ: الـ + مَبَاخِر — mabākhir, censers (pl. of مِبْخَرَة), nom.
وَالنَّدِّ: وَ + الـ + نَدّ — wa-, and + nadd, a compound incense of aloes-wood, ambergris and musk (m.), gen.
الْقَمَاقِمُ: الـ + قَمَاقِم — qamāqim, narrow-necked flasks for rose-water (pl. of قُمْقُم), nom.
فَتَطَيَّبُوا: فَـ + تَطَيَّبُوا — fa-, and + taṭayyaba (V), to perfume oneself; perf. 3mp
وَتَبَخَّرُوا: وَ + تَبَخَّرُوا — wa-, and + tabakhkhara (V), to perfume oneself with incense smoke; perf. 3mp
وَقُدِّمَتْ: وَ + قُدِّمَتْ — wa-, and + qaddama (II), to set before, offer; passive perf. 3fs (broken pl. subject); 'and there were set before'
أَطْبَاقٌ: أَطْبَاق — aṭbāq, trays, platters (pl. of طَبَق), indef. nom.
بِطَشْتٍ: بِـ + طَشْت — bi-, with (جَاءَ بِـ 'bring') + ṭasht, basin (Persian loan, m./f.), indef. gen.; 'with a basin'
الْعَقِيقِ: الـ + عَقِيق — ʿaqīq, carnelian, agate (m.), gen.
اخْتَارَتْ: اِخْتَارَتْ — ikhtāra (VIII of خَارَ), to choose; perf. 3fs
أَوْقَفَتْهُمْ: أَوْقَفَتْ + ـهُمْ — awqafa (IV), to make stand, station; perf. 3fs + obj. 3mp (for women); 'she stationed them'
الْمُغَنِّيَاتِ: الـ + مُغَنِّيَات — mughanniyāt, singing-women (f. pl. act. part. of II غَنَّى), gen.
وَصَرَفَتْ: وَ + صَرَفَتْ — wa-, and + ṣarafa (I), to send away, dismiss; perf. 3fs
أَمَاكِنِهِنَّ: أَمَاكِن + ـهِنَّ — amākin, places (pl. of مَكَان), gen. + 3fp poss.; 'their (f.) quarters'
ضَاحِكًا: ضَاحِك — ḍāḥik, laughing, smiling (act. part. of I ضَحِكَ), acc. of circumstance
فَجَدَّدَ: فَـ + جَدَّدَ — fa-, and so + jaddada (II), to renew; perf. 3ms
مَطْمَعِي: مَطْمَع + ـي — maṭmaʿ, object of hope, hope (m.) + 1s poss.; 'my hope'
ابْرَزَتْ: أَبْرَزَتْ — abraza (IV), to bring out, lay bare; perf. 3fs (broken pl. subject); printed with bare alif, read abrazat
أَيْدِى: أَيْدِى — aydī, hands (pl. of يَد), nom. in construct; final ى as printed
سَرَائِرِي: سَرَائِر + ـي — sarāʾir, secrets (pl. of سَرِيرَة) + 1s poss.; 'my secrets'
وَاَظْهَرْنَ: وَ + أَظْهَرْنَ — wa-, and + aẓhara (IV), to show, reveal; perf. 3fp; alif printed with fatḥa and no hamza
لِلْعُذَّالِ: لِـ + الـ + عُذَّال — li-, to (the ones shown) + ʿudhdhāl, blamers, censurers (pl. of عَاذِل), gen.; 'to the censurers'
اَضْلُعِي: أَضْلُع + ـي — aḍluʿ, ribs (pl. of ضِلَع) + 1s poss.; 'my ribs', i.e. my breast; alif printed with fatḥa and no hamza
دُمُوعُ: دُمُوع — dumūʿ, tears (pl. of دَمْع), nom.
وَمَلَأَتِ: وَ + مَلَأَتْ — wa-, and + malaʾa (I), to fill; perf. 3fs, helping vowel -i before the article (hamza printed)
مَلَأَتْهُ: مَلَأَتْ + ـهُ — malaʾa (I), to fill; perf. 3fs + obj. 3ms; 'she filled it' (hamza printed)
تَشَاكَلَ: تَشَاكَلَ — tashākala, to resemble one another (verb VI of sh-k-l, perf. 3ms, with two subjects joined by wa-); 'resembled each other'
وَمُدَامَتِي: وَ + مُدَامَة + ـِي — wa-, and + mudāma, wine (f., lit. 'what is kept long', aged wine) + -ī, my; 'and my wine'
اَبِالْخَمْرِ: اَ + بِـ + الـ + خَمْر — a-, interrogative particle ('was it…?') + bi-, with (prep., marking what is shed: 'shed wine') + khamr, wine (f., gen.); 'was it wine (that)…'; printed without the hamza sign
اَسْبَلَتْ: اَسْبَلَ + ـتْ — asbala, to let fall, shed (tears) (verb IV of s-b-l, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural jufūn); 'they shed'; printed without the hamza sign
اَشْرَبُ: اَشْرَبُ — shariba/yashrabu, to drink (verb I, imperf. 1cs indic.); 'I drink', with kuntu 'I was drinking'; printed without the hamza sign
كَأْسَهُ: كَأْس + ـهُ — kaʾs, cup (treated as m. here) + -hu, his (3ms poss.); 'his cup'
وَرَدَّهُ: وَ + رَدَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + radda, to give back, return (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the cup, treated as m.); 'and he returned it'
فَمَلَأَتْهُ: فَـ + مَلَأَتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and then + malaʾa, to fill (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it (the cup, treated as m.); 'and she filled it'
قَدَحِي: قَدَح + ـِي — qadaḥ, drinking-cup, goblet (m.) + -ī, my; 'my cup' (gen. after ʿalā)
شَدَّتِ: شَدَّتْ — shadda, to tighten, draw taut (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs; linking kasra before al-); with al-awtār 'she tightened (tuned) the strings'
غَرَائِبُ: غَرَائِب — gharāʾib, strange, unwonted things (pl. of gharība, nom., first term of iḍāfa); gharāʾib al-damʿ 'the unbidden tears'
تَضْطَرِبُ: تَضْطَرِبُ — iḍṭaraba, to quiver, tremble, be agitated (verb VIII of ḍ-r-b, imperf. 3fs indic., agreeing with the plural gharāʾib); 'they tremble'
وَلِلْهَوَى: وَ + لِـ + الـ + هَوَى — wa-, and + li-, to, belonging to (prep. of possession: 'passion has') + hawā, love, passion (m., gen.); 'and passion has'
حُرَقٌ: حُرَق — ḥuraq, burnings, pangs (pl. of ḥurqa, nom. indef.); 'burnings'
تَقِدُ: تَقِدُ — waqada/taqidu, to blaze, burn (verb I, assimilated, imperf. 3fs indic., agreeing with ḥuraq); 'they blaze'
الْقُرْبِ: الـ + قُرْب — qurb, nearness (m., gen. after min); 'the nearness', min al-qurb 'because of nearness'
تَبَاعُدِهِمْ: تَبَاعُد + ـهِمْ — tabāʿud, drawing apart, going away (verbal noun of verb VI tabāʿada, gen. after min) + -hum, their; 'their going away'
فَالدَّمْعُ: فَـ + الـ + دَمْع — fa-, so (conj.) + damʿ, tears (m. collective, nom., subject); 'so the tears'
نَتَفَدَّاكَ: نَتَفَدَّى + ـكَ — tafaddā, to ransom oneself for, give one's life for (verb V of f-d-y, imperf. 1cp) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'we would give our lives for you'
كَسَاكَ: كَسَا + ـكَ — kasā, to clothe (verb I defective, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you (2ms obj.); 'has clothed you'
فَرْقِكَ: فَرْق + ـكَ — farq, the parting of the hair (m., gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your parting'
الْمُضِيءِ: الـ + مُضِيء — muḍīʾ, shining, giving light (active part. of verb IV aḍāʾa, gen., agreeing with farq); 'the shining'
لِسَاقِكْ: لِـ + سَاق + ـكْ — li-, to, as far as (prep.: 'from your parting to your shank') + sāq, shank, leg (f.) + -k, your (pausal for -ka in rhyme); 'to your leg'
تَشْرُقُ: تَشْرُقُ — sharaqa/yashruqu, to rise (of the sun) (verb I, imperf. 3fs indic.); 'rises'
اَطْوَاقِكْ: اَطْوَاق + ـكْ — aṭwāq, collars, neck-bands (pl. of ṭawq, gen. after min) + -k, your (pausal); 'your collars'; printed without the hamza sign
اَقْدَاحَكَ: اَقْدَاح + ـكَ — aqdāḥ, cups, goblets (pl. of qadaḥ, acc. after inna) + -ka, your; 'your cups'; printed without the hamza sign
صَاحٍ: صَاحٍ — ṣāḥin, sober (active part. of ṣaḥā, final -ī dropped in the indef., gen. after ghayr); 'sober'
تُدَارُ: تُدَارُ — adāra, to pass round (verb IV hollow, imperf. passive 3fs, agreeing with aqdāḥ); 'they are passed round'
اَحْدَاقِكْ: اَحْدَاق + ـكْ — aḥdāq, eyes, pupils (pl. of ḥadaqa, gen. after min) + -k, your (pausal); 'your eyes'; printed without the hamza sign
اَوَلَيْسَ: اَ + وَ + لَيْسَ — a-, interrogative particle + wa-, and + laysa, is not (verb of negation); 'and is it not…?'; printed without the hamza sign
الْعَجِيبُ: الـ + عَجِيب — ʿajīb, wonderful, astonishing (adj. used as noun, nom.); 'the wonder'
كَوْنُكَ: كَوْن + ـكَ — kawn, being (verbal noun of kāna, nom.) + -ka, your; 'your being'
بَدْرًا: بَدْر — badr, full moon (m., acc. indef., predicate of the verbal noun kawn); 'a full moon'
وَالْمُحَاقُ: وَ + الـ + مُحَاق — wa-, and + muḥāq, the dark of the moon, its last nights when it cannot be seen (m., nom.); 'and the waning'
عُشَّاقِكْ: عُشَّاق + ـكْ — ʿushshāq, lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq, gen. after min) + -k, your (pausal); 'your lovers'
آالهُ: آ + اِلٰه — a- (ā), interrogative particle ('are you…?'), written with madda + ilāh, a god (m., nom.; the print gives a single ḍamma); 'a god?' (Classical spelling أَإِلٰهٌ)
تُمِيتُ: تُمِيتُ — amāta, to cause to die (verb IV hollow of m-w-t, imperf. 2ms indic.); 'you make die'
وَتُحْيِي: وَ + تُحْيِي — wa-, and + aḥyā, to give life, revive (verb IV of ḥ-y-y, imperf. 2ms indic.); 'and you give life'
بِتَلَاقِيكَ: بِـ + تَلَاقِي + ـكَ — bi-, by, by means of (prep.) + talāqī, meeting one another (verbal noun of verb VI talāqā, gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your meeting'
وَفِرَاقِكْ: وَ + فِرَاق + ـكْ — wa-, and + firāq, parting (verbal noun of fāraqa, gen., still governed by bi-: 'and by your parting') + -k, your (pausal)
خَلِيقَتِكَ: خَلِيقَة + ـكَ — khalīqa, nature, innate disposition (f., gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your nature'
اَخْلَاقِكْ: اَخْلَاق + ـكْ — akhlāq, character, manners (pl. of khuluq, gen. after min) + -k, your (pausal); 'your ways'; printed without the hamza sign
مَلِيكٌ: مَلِيك — malīk, king, sovereign (m., nom. indef., predicate of anta); 'a king'
اُرْسِلْتَ: اُرْسِلْتَ — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. passive 2ms); 'you were sent'; printed without the hamza sign
خَلَّاقِكْ: خَلَّاق + ـكْ — khallāq, the Creator (intensive form of khāliq, gen. after min) + -k, your (pausal); 'your Creator'
كَادُوا: kādū — kāda, to be on the point of, almost do (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); here with an + subjunctive; 'they almost'
يَطِيرُوا: yaṭīrū — ṭāra, to fly (verb I hollow, subj. 3mp after an); '(that) they fly'
خُدَّامُ: khuddām, servants, attendants (pl. of khādim; nom., first term of an iḍāfa); here the palace eunuchs; 'the servants of'
وَمَرْجَانُ: وَ + مَرْجَان — wa-, and + Marjān (m. name of a eunuch, lit. 'coral'; diptote, nom.); 'and Marjān'
وَغَيْرُهُمْ: وَ + غَيْر + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + ghayr, other (m., nom.) + -hum, them; 'and others besides them'
أَعْرِفْهُمْ: أَعْرِفْ + ـهُمْ — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, jussive 1s after lam) + -hum, them; '(I did not) know them'
لَاتَخَافُوا: لَا + تَخَافُوا — lā, not (prohibitive) + takhāfū, khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, jussive 2mp); printed as one word: 'do not be afraid'
مَانَتَحَوَّلُ: مَا + نَتَحَوَّلُ — mā, what (after bi-qadri, 'by the measure of', so bi-qadri mā, 'for as long as') + nataḥawwalu, taḥawwala, to move away, shift (verb V, imperf. 1p); printed as one word: '(as long as) we take to move'
بِغَلْقِ: بِـ + غَلْق — bi-, marks the thing ordered after amara + ghalq, shutting, locking (verbal noun of ghalaqa; m., gen.); '(she ordered) the shutting of'
السَّتَائِرَ: الـ + سَتَائِر — al-, the + satāʾir, curtains (pl. of sitāra; acc.); 'the curtains'
تَكْبِسَ: takbisa — kabasa, to press, knead, massage (verb I, subj. 3fs after an); '(that) she massage'
يَمْضِينَ: yamḍīna — maḍā, to go off, depart (verb I defective, subj. 3fp after an); '(that) they go'
تَدْعُوَ: tadʿuwa — daʿā, to call, summon (verb I defective, subj. 3fs after an); '(that) she call'
لِيَدْخُلَ: لِـ + يَدْخُلَ — li-, so that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + yadkhula, dakhala, to enter (subj. 3ms); 'to come in'
وَبِأَيْدِيهِمُ: وَ + بِـ + أَيْدِي + ـهِمُ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + bi-, in (prep.) + aydī, hands (pl. of yad) + -humu, their (linking vowel -u before al-); 'and in their hands'
يُسَلِّمُ: yusallimu — sallama, to greet (verb II, imperf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'sends greetings to'
اسْتَوْحَشَ: istawḥasha — to feel lonely (verb X of w-ḥ-sh, perf. 3ms); with li-, 'miss, long for'; 'he has missed'
لِرُؤْيَتِكِ: لِـ + رُؤْيَة + ـكِ — li-, for (marks what is missed after istawḥasha) + ruʾya, seeing, sight (f., gen.) + -ki, you (f.); 'for the sight of you'
وَيُخْبِرُكِ: وَ + يُخْبِرُ + ـكِ — wa-, and + yukhbiru, akhbara, to inform (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'and he tells you'
وَحَظٌّ: وَ + حَظّ — wa-, and + ḥaẓẓ, lot, fortune; colloquially pleasure, a good time (m., nom. indef.); 'and pleasure'
وَأَحَبَّ: وَ + أَحَبَّ — wa-, and + aḥabba, to love, wish (verb IV doubled, perf. 3ms); 'and he wished'
خِتَامُ: khitām, seal, close, conclusion (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the crowning end of'
بِوُجُودِكِ: بِـ + وُجُود + ـكِ — bi-, with (prep.; the means of the crowning) + wujūd, presence, being there (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'with your presence'
تَأْتِينَ: taʾtīna — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 2fs); 'you come'
لِأَمْرِ: لِـ + أَمْر — li-, to (the command obeyed) + amr, command, order (m., gen.); 'to the command of'
الْقَهْرَمَانَاتِ: الـ + قَهْرَمَانَات — al-, the + qahramānāt, stewardesses, housekeepers (pl. of qahramāna, from Persian; f., gen.); 'the stewardesses'
أَمَرَ: amara — to command, order (verb I, perf. 3ms); takes bi- for the thing ordered: mā amara bihi al-khalīfa, 'what the caliph ordered'
وَأَخْبِرُوهُ: وَ + أَخْبِرُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + akhbirū, akhbara, to inform (verb IV, imperative 2mp) + -hu, him; 'and tell him'
بِالْفُرُشِ: بِـ + الـ + فُرُش — bi-, with (prep.; what the place is furnished with) + al-, the + furush, carpets, bedding (pl. of firāsh; gen.); 'with the carpets'
وَالْأَمْتِعَةِ: وَ + الـ + أَمْتِعَة — wa-, and + al-, the + amtiʿa, goods, household furnishings (pl. of matāʿ; gen.); 'and the furnishings'
الْوَدَاعَ: الـ + وَدَاع — al-, the + wadāʿ, farewell, leave-taking (m., acc. as noun of inna); 'the farewell'
لِتَلَفِ: لِـ + تَلَف — li-, for (what the cause leads to) + talaf, ruin, destruction (m., gen.); 'for the ruin of'
يَرْزُقَنِي: يَرْزُقَ + ـنِي — razaqa, to bestow, provide (verb I, subj. 3ms after an; the subject is God) + -nī, me; '(that) He grant me'
مَايَصِيرُ: مَا + يَصِيرُ — mā, not (negative) + yaṣīru, ṣāra, to become, come to be (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); printed as one word: 'none comes to be'
وَتَجْتَمِعُ: وَ + تَجْتَمِعُ — wa-, and + tajtamiʿu, ijtamaʿa, to meet, come together (verb VIII, imperf. 2ms); with bi-, 'meet with'
فَتَكُونُ: فَـ + تَكُونُ — fa-, and so (result) + takūnu, kāna, to be (verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms); 'and so you will be'
مَصُونًا: maṣūnan — maṣūn, guarded, kept safe (pass. part. of ṣāna; m., acc. as predicate of kāna); 'safe'
وَغَرَامُكَ: وَ + غَرَام + ـكَ — wa-, and + gharām, passionate love (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your passion'
مَكْنُونًا: maknūnan — maknūn, hidden, concealed (pass. part. of kanna; m., acc., rhyming with maṣūnan); 'hidden'
وَعَدْتُ: waʿadtu — waʿada, to promise (verb I assimilated, perf. 1s); takes bi- for the thing promised; 'I promised'
بِمِيعَادٍ: بِـ + مِيعَاد — bi-, marks the thing promised after waʿada + mīʿād, appointment, appointed meeting (m., gen. indef.); '(promised) a meeting'
يَلْحَقُنِي: يَلْحَقُ + ـنِي — laḥiqa, to overtake, befall (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'befalls me'
الْخَطَرِ: الـ + خَطَر — al-, the + khaṭar, danger, peril (m., gen.); 'the danger'
وَحُبِّي: وَ + حُبّ + ـي — wa-, and + ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my love'
وَتَعَشُّقِي: وَ + تَعَشُّق + ـي — wa-, and + taʿashshuq, being enamoured, passionate love (verbal noun of V taʿashshaqa; m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my passion'
وَتَأَسُّفِى: وَ + تَأَسُّف + ـى — wa-, and + taʾassuf, grieving, regret (verbal noun of V taʾassafa; m., gen.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'and my grief'
فَبِأَيِّ: فَـ + بِـ + أَيّ — fa-, so + bi-, with (prep.; the means) + ayy, which, what (gen.); 'so with what'
أَحْضُرُ: aḥḍuru — ḥaḍara, to be present, attend (verb I, imperf. 1s); 'I attend'; here also 'I come, present myself', with ilā: aḥḍuru ilayka, 'I will come to you'
أُنَادِمُ: unādimu — nādama, to be boon companion to, drink and talk with (verb III, imperf. 1s); 'I keep company with'
نَظَرٍ: naẓar, look, gaze, sight (m., gen. indef.); 'a look'
حَضْرَةٍ: ḥaḍra, presence; a gathering held in someone's presence (f., gen. indef.); 'a gathering'
ذَوْقٍ: dhawq, taste, relish (m., gen. indef.); 'a relish'
مُدَامًا: mudāman — mudām, wine (lit. 'what is kept long'; m., acc. indef., object of ashrabu); 'wine'
حَاضِرُهُ: حَاضِر + ـهُ — ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara; m., nom., predicate) + -hu, it (the wine); 'present at it'
تَتَحَيَّرِي: tataḥayyarī — taḥayyara, to be bewildered, at a loss (verb V, jussive 2fs after prohibitive lā); '(do not) be at a loss'
وَاصْبِرِي: وَ + اصْبِرِي — wa-, and + iṣbirī, ṣabara, to be patient (verb I, imperative 2fs); 'and be patient'
تَغْفُلِي: taghfulī — ghafala, to neglect, be heedless (verb I, jussive 2fs after prohibitive lā); with ʿan, 'neglect (something)'
مُنَادَمَةِ: munādama, keeping company over wine (verbal noun of III nādama; f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the companionship of'
وَلَاتُظْهِرِي: وَ + لَا + تُظْهِرِي — wa-, and + lā, not (prohibitive) + tuẓhirī, aẓhara, to show (verb IV, jussive 2fs); printed as one word: 'and do not show'
التَّهَاوُنَ: الـ + تَهَاوُن — al-, the + tahāwun, making light of a thing, slackness (verbal noun of VI tahāwana; m., acc.); 'indifference'
وَتَجَلَّدِي: وَ + تَجَلَّدِي — wa-, and + tajalladī, tajallada, to bear up, be steadfast (verb V, imperative 2fs); 'and steel yourself'
غِلْمَانُ: ghilmān, pages, servant-lads (pl. of ghulām; nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the pages of'
وَرَفِيقَهُ: وَ + رَفِيق + ـهُ — wa-, and + rafīq, companion (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his companion'
وَاقْصِدِي: وَ + اقْصِدِي — wa-, and + iqṣidī, qaṣada, to make for, head toward (verb I, imperative 2fs); with bi-, 'take (someone) to'
وَدَعِيهِمَا: وَ + دَعِي + ـهِمَا — wa-, and + daʿī, leave, let be (imperative 2fs of wadaʿa) + -himā, the two of them; 'and leave them'
خُرُوجِهِمَا: خُرُوج + ـهِمَا — khurūj, going out (verbal noun of kharaja; m., gen.) + -himā, of the two; 'their getting out'
وَأَطْلَعَتْهُمَا: وَ + أَطْلَعَتْ + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + aṭlaʿat, aṭlaʿa, to make go up, bring up (verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -humā, the two of them; 'and she brought them up'
فَجَلَسَا: فَـ + جَلَسَا — fa-, and + jalasā, jalasa, to sit (verb I, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two sat'
وَحَوَالَيْهِ: وَ + حَوَالَيْ + ـهِ — wa-, and + ḥawālay, around (prep., dual-shaped) + -hi, him; 'and around him'
مُحِيطَاتٌ: مُحِيطَات — muḥīṭa, surrounding (f. pl. act. part. of IV أَحَاطَ, nom. indef.); aḥāṭa takes bi- for what is surrounded; 'surrounding'
وَعَفِيفٌ: وَ + عَفِيف — wa-, and + ʿAfīf (m. name, a eunuch of the caliph; lit. 'chaste'), nom.; 'and ʿAfīf'
وَوَصِيفٌ: وَ + وَصِيف — wa-, and + Waṣīf (m. name, a eunuch of the caliph; lit. 'servant-boy'), nom.; 'and Waṣīf'
يَتَمَايَلُ: يَتَمَايَلُ — tamāyala, to sway to and fro (VI, imperf. 3ms); 'swaying'
فَلَاقَيْنَهُ: فَـ + لَاقَيْنَ + ـهُ — fa-, and (so) + lāqā, to meet (III, perf. 3fp) + -hu, him; 'and they (f.) met him'
يَزَلْنَ: يَزَلْنَ — zāla (lam yazal), to cease (verb I hollow, jussive 3fp); with lam, 'they (f.) did not cease, kept on'
سَائِرَاتٍ: سَائِرَات — sāʾira, going, walking (f. pl. act. part. of sāra, acc. indef., predicate of lam yazalna); printed with ئ; 'going'
وَقَعُوا: وَقَعُوا — waqaʿa, to fall (verb I, perf. 3mp); waqaʿa bayna yadayhi, 'fell down before him'; 'they fell'
الْحِسَانُ: الـ + حِسَان — al-, the + ḥisān, beautiful (pl. of ḥasana/ḥasan, nom., adjective); 'the beautiful'
وَالْوَصَائِفُ: وَ + الـ + وَصَائِف — wa-, and + al-, the + waṣāʾif, maidservants (pl. of waṣīfa, nom.); printed with ئ; 'and the maids'
بِأَيْدِيهِنَّ: بِـ + أَيْدِي + ـهِنَّ — bi-, in (prep.) + aydī, hands (pl. of yad, f.) + -hinna, their (f.); 'in their hands'
الْمَوْقُودَةُ: الـ + مَوْقُودَة — al-, the + mawqūda, lit, kindled (f. pass. part. of waqada, nom., agreeing with al-shumūʿ); 'lighted'
وَالْبَخُورُ: وَ + الـ + بَخُور — wa-, and + al-, the + bakhūr, incense (m., nom.); 'and the incense'
يَجْلِسْنَ: يَجْلِسْنَ — jalasa, to sit (verb I, subj. 3fp after an); '(that) they (f.) sit'
وَأَبُوالْحَسَنِ: وَ + أَبُو + الْحَسَنِ — wa-, and + Abū, father of (nom.) + al-Ḥasan (gen.); the name Abū al-Ḥasan, printed as one word; 'and Abū al-Ḥasan'
وَعَلِيُّ: وَ + عَلِيّ — wa-, and + ʿAlī (m. name, nom.); 'and ʿAlī'
وَيَسْمَعَانِ: وَ + يَسْمَعَانِ — wa-, and + samiʿa, to hear, listen (verb I, imperf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two listening'
يَرَهُمَا: يَرَ + ـهُمَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam, final vowel dropped) + -humā, the two; 'see the two of them'
يُمَازِحُ: يُمَازِحُ — māzaḥa, to jest with, banter (III, imperf. 3ms); 'jesting'
فَفُتِحَتْ: فَـ + فُتِحَتْ — fa-, and so + futiḥat, it (f.) was opened (fataḥa, verb I passive, perf. 3fs); 'and it was opened'
وَشَرَعُوا: وَ + شَرَعُوا — wa-, and + sharaʿa, to open (a door or window) wide onto the outside (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they threw open'
طِيقَانَهَا: طِيقَان + ـهَا — ṭīqān, arches, arched windows (pl. of ṭāq, acc.) + -hā, its (the dome's); 'its windows'
كَالنَّهَارِ: كَـ + الـ + نَهَار — ka-, like (prep.) + al-, the + nahār, day, daytime (m., gen.); 'like the day'
يَنْقُلُونَ: يَنْقُلُونَ — naqala, to carry, transport (verb I, imperf. 3mp); 'carrying'
التَّحَائِفِ: الـ + تَحَائِف — al-, the + taḥāʾif, rarities, precious objects (the print's plural, for tuḥaf, pl. of tuḥfa; gen. after min); printed with ئ; 'the rarities'
وَأَوَانِيَ: وَ + أَوَانِي — wa-, and + awānī, vessels (pl. of ināʾ via āniya; diptote acc., object of raʾaytu); 'and vessels'
الْمَعَادِنِ: الـ + مَعَادِن — al-, the + maʿādin, metals, minerals (pl. of maʿdin, gen.); 'the metals'
الْوَصْفُ: الـ + وَصْف — al-, the + waṣf, description (m., nom., subject of yaqṣuru); 'description'
خُيِّلَ: خُيِّلَ — khayyala, to make (something) seem (II, passive perf. 3ms); khuyyila lī, 'it seemed to me'
دَهِشْتُ: دَهِشْتُ — dahisha, to be astonished, amazed (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I was amazed'
وَالْغَرَامِ: وَ + الـ + غَرَام — wa-, and + al-, the + gharām, passionate love (m., gen.); 'and passion'
يَنْظُرَنَا: يَنْظُرَ + نَا — naẓara, to look, see (verb I, subj. 3ms after an) + -nā, us (direct object, colloquial for naẓara ilā); '(that he) see us'
وَفَرْطِ: وَ + فَرْط — wa-, and + farṭ, excess (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'and the excess of'
وَفِرَاقِ: وَ + فِرَاق — wa-, and + firāq, parting, separation (verbal noun of III fāraqa, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'and the parting from'
الِاقْتِرَابِ: الـ + اِقْتِرَاب — al-, the + iqtirāb, drawing near (verbal noun of VIII iqtaraba, gen.); 'nearness'
يُخَلِّصَنَا: يُخَلِّصَ + نَا — khallaṣa, to deliver, rescue (II, subj. 3ms after an) + -nā, us; '(that He) deliver us'
الْحَضْرَةُ: الـ + حَضْرَة — al-, the + ḥaḍra, presence; here the company in attendance (f., nom.); 'the company'
يَاغَرَامُ: يَا + غَرَام — yā, O (vocative) + Gharām (f. name, 'passionate love'), built on ḍamma as a vocative; printed as one word; 'O Gharām'
الْمُطْرِبِ: الـ + مُطْرِب — al-, the + muṭrib, delighting, moving to rapture (act. part. of IV aṭraba, gen., adjective of al-samāʿ); 'the delightful'
اَنَسَتْ: اَنَسَتْ — read ānasat (آنَسَتْ), ānasa, to perceive, catch sight of (IV, perf. 3fs); the print has no madda; 'she glimpsed'
وَالدُّمُوْعُ: وَ + الـ + دُمُوع — wa-, and + al-, the + dumūʿ, tears (pl. of damʿ, nom.; printed with sukūn on the wāw); 'and the tears'
كُرْسِيِّهَا: كُرْسِيّ + ـهَا — kursī, chair, seat (m., gen. after min ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her chair'
وَاحْتَمَلْنَهَا: وَ + احْتَمَلْنَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + iḥtamalna, they (f. pl.) carried (VIII iḥtamala, from ḥamala, perf. 3fp) + -hā, her; 'and they carried her (away)'
أَطْلَعَتْهُمَا: أَطْلَعَتْ + ـهُمَا — aṭlaʿat, she made go up, brought up (IV aṭlaʿa, from ṭalaʿa, perf. 3fs) + -humā, the two of them; with a second object (al-rawshana), 'had brought the two of them up to (the balcony)'
الرَّوْشَنَ: الـ + رَوْشَن — al-, the + rawshan, latticed balcony, window-gallery (m., Persian loan; acc., second object of aṭlaʿa); 'the balcony'
جَاءَتْهُمَا: جَاءَتْ + ـهُمَا — jāʾat, she came (jāʾa, verb I, perf. 3fs) + -humā, the two of them (obj.); 'she came to the two of them'
وَرَفِيقُكَ: وَ + رَفِيق + ـكَ — wa-, and + rafīq, companion, comrade (m., nom., joined to the subject anta) + -ka, your (m.); 'and your companion'
وَانْزِلَا: وَ + انْزِلَا — wa-, and + inzilā, go down! (imper. 2 dual of nazala, verb I); 'and go down, you two'
يَنْهَضُ: yanhaḍu — nahaḍa, to rise, get up (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'he will rise'
وَلَاقُدْرَةَ: وَ + لَا + قُدْرَة — wa-, and (circumstantial, 'when') + lā, there is no (negating the whole class, noun in -a) + qudra, power, strength (f., acc.); printed as one word; 'when there is no strength'
النُّهُوضِ: الـ + نُهُوض — nuhūḍ, rising, getting up (verbal noun of nahaḍa; m., gen. after ʿalā); 'the rising, getting up'
تَرُشُّ: tarushshu — rashsha, to sprinkle, spray (verb I doubled, imperf. 3fs, indic.); 'sprinkling'
وَنَزَلَابِهِ: وَ + نَزَلَا + بِـ + ـهِ — wa-, and + nazalā, the two went down (perf. 3 dual of nazala) + bi-, with (nazala bi-, 'go down with', that is, bring down) + -hi, him; printed as one word; 'and the two brought him down'
وَعَلِيَّ: وَ + عَلِيّ — wa-, and + ʿAlī (m. name), acc. as object of akhrajat, without nunation before ibn; 'and ʿAlī'; also: acc., second object beside -nī: an yajʿalūnī … wa-ʿAliyya ibna Bakkārin, 'to put me … and ʿAlī ibn Bakkār'
مَصْطَبَةً: maṣṭaba, a raised bench of stone or brick (f., acc. indef., object of raʾayā); 'a bench'
فَصَفَّقَتِ: فَـ + صَفَّقَتْ — fa-, and then + ṣaffaqat, she clapped (II ṣaffaqa, perf. 3fs; kasra joining to the article); 'and she clapped'
وَأَطْلِعْهُمَا: وَ + أَطْلِعْ + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + aṭliʿ, bring up, land (imper. 2ms of IV aṭlaʿa) + -humā, the two of them; with ʿalā al-barr, 'and set them ashore'
وَفَارَقَا: وَ + فَارَقَا — wa-, and + fāraqā, the two parted from, left (III fāraqa, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two left'
وَالْقُبَّةِ: وَ + الـ + قُبَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + qubba, dome, domed pavilion (f., gen., joined to qaṣr); 'and the dome'
وَالْبُسْتَانِ: وَ + الـ + بُسْتَان — wa-, and + al-, the + bustān, garden (m., gen.); 'and the garden'
كَفًّا: kaff, hand, palm (f.; acc. indef., object of madadtu); 'a hand'
وَاُخْرَى: وَ + أُخْرَى — wa-, and + ukhrā, other, another (f. of ākhar; the print sets a bare alif with ḍamma); 'and the other (hand)'
الزَّادُ: الـ + زَاد — zād, provisions for a journey (m., nom.); 'the provision'
زَادِي: زَاد + ـِي — zād, provisions for a journey (m.) + -ī, my; 'my provision'
لِلْمَلَّاحِ: لِـ + الـ + مَلَّاح — li-, to (marking the one addressed after qālat) + al-, the + mallāḥ, boatman, sailor (m., gen.); 'to the boatman'
يَقْذِفُ: yaqdhifu — qadhafa, to throw, cast; of a boatman, to row, ply the oars (verb I, imperf. 3ms, indic.); 'rowing'
السُّرْعَةِ: الـ + سُرْعَة — al-, the + surʿa, speed, haste (f., gen. after li-ajli, 'for the sake of', where li- gives the purpose); li-ajli al-surʿa, 'for speed, to go fast'
الْمَلَّاحَ: الـ + مَلَّاح — mallāḥ, boatman, sailor (m., acc. after anna); 'the boatman'
الْجَانِبَ: الـ + جَانِب — jānib, side; bank of a river (m., acc.); 'the side'
وَعَدَوْا: وَ + عَدَوْا — wa-, and + ʿadā (yaʿdū), to pass beyond, cross over (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they crossed over' (not waʿada, 'to promise': the print's fatḥa on the dāl marks the reading)
وَوَدَّعَتْهُمَا: وَ + وَدَّعَتْ + ـهُمَا — wa-, and + waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3fs) + 3rd dual object; 'and she bade the two of them farewell'
قَصْدِى: قَصْد + ـِى — qaṣd, intent, purpose (m., nom.) + 1cs suffix (the print writes the yāʾ as ى); 'my intent'
أُفَارِقُكُمَا: أُفَارِقُ + ـكُمَا — fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, imperf. 1cs, indicative) + 2nd dual object; 'I (do not) leave you two'
النُّهُوضَ: الـ + نُهُوض — nuhūḍ, rising, getting up (verbal noun of nahaḍa; m., acc.); 'rising'
أَمِينٍ: أَمِين — amīn, safe, secure; trustworthy (adj., m., gen. after ghayr)
وَالْعَيَّارِينَ: وَ + الـ + عَيَّارِين — ʿayyār, vagabond, street-tough, member of an urban gang (pl. ʿayyārūn, gen. -īn); 'and the ruffians'
الْمَشْىَ: الـ + مَشْى — mashy, walking (verbal noun of mashā; m., acc.; the print writes the yāʾ as ى); 'walking'
أَصْدِقَاءُ: أَصْدِقَاء — aṣdiqāʾ, pl. of ṣadīq, friend (diptote, nom.); 'friends'
يَثِقُ: wathiqa (yathiqu), to trust (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with bi-, 'to trust in'
يَأْنَسُ: anisa (yaʾnasu), to be at ease, feel at home (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with ilā, 'to be at ease with'
