رَأٰهُمَا: رَأَى + ـهُمَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3rd dual object; 'he saw them two' (the print spells it رأهما for رآهما; the long ā is shown with a dagger alif)
وَأَجْلَسَهُمَا: وَ + أَجْلَسَ + ـهُمَا — ajlasa, to seat, make sit (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3rd dual object; 'and he seated them'
وَسَأَلَهُمَا: وَ + سَأَلَ + ـهُمَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3rd dual object; 'and he asked them'
وَأَحْوَجَنَا: وَ + أَحْوَجَ + ـنَا — aḥwaja, to make (someone) need, force (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1cp object; 'and (he) drove us'
عَامَلْتُهُ: عَامَلْتُ + ـهُ — ʿāmala, to deal with, do business with (verb III, perf. 1cs) + 3ms object; '(whom) I dealt with'
وَقَصَدْتُهُ: وَ + قَصَدْتُ + ـهُ — qaṣada, to make for, seek out (verb I, perf. 1cs) + 3ms object; 'and I sought him out'
وَاسْتَأْنَسْتُ: وَ + اسْتَأْنَسْتُ — istaʾnasa, to take comfort, seek company (verb X, perf. 1cs); with bi-, 'to take comfort in (someone's company)'
بِرَفِيقِى: بِـ + رَفِيق + ـِى — bi-, in (prep.; after istaʾnasa it marks the companion) + rafīq, companion (m., gen.) + 1cs suffix, printed ى; 'in my companion'
نَنْظُرُهُ: نَنْظُرُ + ـهُ — naẓara, to see, look at (verb I, imperf. 1cp) + 3ms object; '(that) we see him' (Classical naẓara ilā)
فَتَوَارَى: فَـ + تَوَارَى — tawārā, to hide oneself (verb VI, perf. 3ms); 'but he hid'
نَرَهُ: نَرَ + ـهُ — raʾā (yarā), to see (verb I, jussive 1cp after lam, final -ā dropped) + 3ms object; '(did not) see him'
وَعُدْنَا: وَ + عُدْنَا — ʿāda, to return (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp); 'and we came back'
صِفْرَ: صِفْر — ṣifr, empty (m., acc., describing their state; in construct); 'empty of'
بِلَاشَيْءٍ: بِلَا + شَيْء — bi-, with + lā, no: bilā, 'without' + shayʾ, thing (m., gen., indef.); 'without anything' (printed as one word)
الْعَوْدُ: الـ + عَوْد — ʿawd, returning, going back (verbal noun of ʿāda; m., nom.)
فَجِئْنَا: فَـ + جِئْنَا — jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 1cp); 'so we came'
صَدَاقَتِكَ: صَدَاقَة + ـكَ — ṣadāqa, friendship (f., gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'your friendship'
وَعَوَائِدِكَ: وَ + عَوَائِد + ـكَ — ʿawāʾid, pl. of ʿāda, custom, habit (gen.) + 2ms suffix; 'and your customs'
الْجَمِيلَةِ: الـ + جَمِيلَة — jamīl, beautiful, fine, kindly (adj., f. agreeing with the plural, gen.); 'fine'
إِكْرَامِهِمَا: إِكْرَام + ـهِمَا — ikrām, honouring, treating generously (verbal noun of akrama, IV; gen.) + 3rd dual suffix (object); 'honouring them'
فَأَقَامَا: فَـ + أَقَامَا — aqāma, to stay, remain (verb IV hollow, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two stayed'
لَيْلَتِهِمَا: لَيْلَة + ـهِمَا — layla, night (f., gen.) + 3rd dual suffix; 'their night'
وَدَخَلَاهَا: وَ + دَخَلَا + ـهَا — dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3m dual) + 3fs object; 'and the two entered it'
وَجَازَا: وَ + جَازَا — jāza, to pass (verb I hollow, perf. 3m dual); with ʿalā, 'to pass by'
وَأَدْخَلَهُ: وَ + أَدْخَلَ + ـهُ — adkhala, to bring in, make enter (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he brought him into'
فَاضْطَجَعَا: فَـ + اضْطَجَعَا — iḍṭajaʿa, to lie down (verb VIII, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two lay down'
يَفْرِشُوا: farasha (yafrishu), to spread, furnish (verb I, imperf. 3mp, subj. after an); with bi-, 'to spread (a place) with'
بِالْفِرَاشَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + فِرَاشَات — bi-, with (prep.; after farasha it marks what is spread) + firāshāt, a later pl. of firāsh, bedding, furnishings (gen.); 'with the furnishings'
وَأُؤَانِسَهُ: وَ + أُؤَانِسَ + ـهُ — ānasa (yuʾānisu), to keep company, cheer (verb III, imperf. 1cs, subj.) + 3ms object; 'and keep him company' (the print sets the second hamza on wāw)
أَدْرَيٰ: أَدْرَى — adrā, more knowing, better acquainted (elative of darā, to know; the print writes the final alif as ي); with bi-, 'better acquainted with'; with min, 'than'
الْفُرُوضِ: الـ + فُرُوض — al-, the + furūḍ, obligatory duties, the prescribed prayers (pl. of farḍ; gen.)
يَوْمِهِ: يَوْم + ـهِ — yawm, day (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his day'
وَلَيْلَتِهِ: وَ + لَيْلَة + ـهِ — wa-, and + layla, night (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his night'
يُسَلِّى: يُسَلِّى — yusallī, to console, divert (verb II of salā, impf. 3ms), written with final ى for ي as printed; shadda as printed; with nafsahu, 'consoling himself'
الْأَلْيَقَ: الـ + أَلْيَق — al-, the + alyaq, most fitting, most suitable (elative of layyiq, from lāqa bi-, to suit; acc. after inna); 'the most fitting thing'
وَيَنْفَرِجَ: وَ + يَنْفَرِجَ — wa-, and + yanfarija, to be relieved, eased, opened (verb VII of faraja, subj. 3ms, still after li-); 'and may be eased'
كَرْبِ: كَرْب — karb, grief, anguish, distress (m., gen.); construct, 'the anguish of'
وَتَتَلَاهَى: وَ + تَتَلَاهَى — wa-, and + tatalāhā, to divert oneself, amuse oneself (verb VI of lahā, subj. 2ms after li-); 'and that you may divert yourself'
يَسْكُنَ: يَسْكُنَ — yaskuna, to become still, calm, subside (verb I, subj. 3ms after an); 'that (it) may grow still'
بِقَلْبِكَ: بِـ + قَلْب + ـِكَ — bi-, in (prep. of place) + qalb, heart (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'in your heart'
فَاصْنَعْ: فَـ + اصْنَعْ — fa-, so + iṣnaʿ, do! make! (imperative 2ms of ṣanaʿa); 'so do'
وَالْآلَاتِ: وَ + الـ + آلَات — wa-, and + al-, the + ālāt, instruments, here musical ones (pl. of āla, f.; gen.); madda as printed; 'and the instruments'
وَشَرَابًا: وَ + شَرَاب — wa-, and + sharāb, drink, wine (m., acc. indef.); 'and drink'
وَانْشِرَاحٍ: وَ + انْشِرَاح — wa-, and + inshirāḥ, expansion (of the breast), gladness, merriment (verbal noun of VII insharaḥa; m., gen. indef.); 'and merriment'
كُؤُوسُ: كُؤُوس — kuʾūs, cups, wine-cups (pl. of kaʾs; nom., construct); hamza as printed; 'the cups of'
الْمُصَاحَبَةِ: الـ + مُصَاحَبَة — al-, the + muṣāḥaba, companionship (verbal noun of III ṣāḥaba; f., gen.)
الْمُغَنِّيَةُ: الـ + مُغَنِّيَة — al-, the + mughanniya, singing-woman, female singer (f., nom.); shadda as printed; 'the singing-girl'
رُمِيْتُ: رُمِيْتُ — rumītu, I was shot, I was struck (passive perf. 1s of ramā, to throw, shoot); the sukūn on the long ī as printed
لَحْظْ: لَحْظ — laḥẓ, glance, look out of the corner of the eye (m.), in pause with sukūn; 'a glance'
فَاَصْمَانِي: فَـ + اَصْمَى + ـنِي — fa-, and so + aṣmā, to shoot (game) dead on the spot (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and it struck me dead'; bare alif as printed
وَفَارَقْتُ: وَ + فَارَقْتُ — wa-, and + fāraqtu, to part from, leave (verb III, perf. 1s); 'and I parted from'
الْحَبَائِبْ: الـ + حَبَائِب — al-, the + ḥabāʾib, loved ones (pl. of ḥabība), in pause with sukūn; 'the loved ones'
وَعَانَدَنِي: وَ + عَانَدَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + ʿānada, to oppose stubbornly, set oneself against (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and (Time) set itself against me'
حَبِيبْ: حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved, loved one (m.), in pause with sukūn; predicate of kuntu, prose ḥabīban; reading doubtful (damaged type); 'a beloved'
وَيَئِسَ: وَ + يَئِسَ — wa-, and + yaʾisa, to despair (verb I, perf. 3ms); with min, 'despaired of'; hamza as printed
يَمْنَعْهُ: يَمْنَعْ + ـهُ — yamnaʿ, to prevent, hold back (manaʿa, verb I, jussive 3ms after lam) + -hu, him; 'hold him back'
غِلْمَانُهُ: غِلْمَان + ـُهُ — ghilmān, lads, young servants (pl. of ghulām; nom.) + -hu, his; 'his servants'
وَأَرْكَبُوهُ: وَ + أَرْكَبُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + arkabū, to mount, set riding (verb IV of rakiba, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they set him on it'
حَمِدَ: حَمِدَ — ḥamida, to praise, thank (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'praised (God) for'
عَلّى: عَلّى — ʿalā, for, on account of (prep., taken by ḥamida: 'to praise for'); printed with a stray shadda, kept but read ʿalā
بَكَّارٍيَا: بَكَّار + يَا — Bakkār (m. name), gen. after ibn + yā, O (vocative particle), the print joining the two as one word; 'Bakkār: O …'
تَقْطَعْ: تَقْطَعْ — qaṭaʿa/yaqṭaʿu, to cut, cut off (verb I, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā); 'do not cut off'
يَرْتَقِبُ: يَرْتَقِبُ — irtaqaba/yartaqibu, to watch for, await (verb VIII, imperf. 3ms, after ṣāra); 'awaiting'
يَأْتِهِ: يَأْتِ + هِ — atā/yaʾtī, to come (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam, final yāʾ dropped) + -hi, him; with bi-, 'to bring': lam yaʾtihi … bi-khabarin, 'did not bring him news'; the edition prints the hamza
مُلْقًي: مُلْقًي — mulqan, cast down, lying (pass. part. of alqā, form IV, acc. of state), printed with final ي for ى; 'lying'
وَيَجُسُّونَ: وَ + يَجُسُّ + ونَ — wa-, and + jassa/yajussu, to feel with the fingers (verb I, imperf. 3mp) ; 'and they feel' (yadahu, his hand: his pulse)
وَرَآهُ: وَ + رَأَى + هُ — wa-, and + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he saw him'; the edition prints رآه
وَتَسَامَعَ: وَ + تَسَامَعَ — wa-, and + tasāmaʿa, to hear of from one another (verb VI, perf. 3ms, before a plural subject); with bi-, 'to hear of', bi- marking what is heard of: 'and (my companions) heard of it'
أَسْتَعِينُ: أَسْتَعِينُ — istaʿāna/yastaʿīnu, to seek help (verb X, imperf. 1cs); with bi-, 'to call on something for help', and ʿalā, 'for a task'; 'I may seek help'
وَالْمَشْيِ: وَ + الـ + مَشْي — wa-, and + al-, the + mashy, walking (verbal noun of mashā), gen. after ʿalā; 'and the walking'
أُكَذِّبَ: أُكَذِّبَ — kadhdhaba/yukadhdhibu, to call a liar, give the lie to (verb II, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā of purpose); 'that I may give the lie to'
جَعَلَنِي: جَعَلَ + نِي — jaʿala, to make, to declare (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he made me (out to be)'
احْذَرِ: احْذَرِ — ḥadhira/yaḥdharu, to beware (verb I, imperative 2ms, with a helping -i before the article); 'beware of'
نَارَتْ: نَارَ — nāra, to shine, give light (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs, as printed; possibly a slip for نَالَتْ, nālat, 'she attained'); 'there shone'
تَنَلْهُ: تَنَلْ + ـهُ — nāla, to attain, obtain (verb I hollow, jussive 3fs after lam, the long ā shortened) + -hu, it (obj.); '(has not) attained it'
نَقَشْ: نَقَش (as pointed in the print) — naqsh, engraving, tracery, here the henna pattern on the hand (m.; the metre wants naqshan); 'tracery'
مِعْصَمٍ: مِعْصَم — miʿṣam, wrist, the place of the bracelet (m., gen. indef.); 'a wrist'
اَوْهَتْ: اَوْهَتْ — awhā, to make frail, weaken (verb IV of wahā, perf. 3fs; bare alif as printed); 'she has weakened'
جَلَدِي: جَلَد + ـي — jalad, endurance, fortitude (m.) + -ī, my; 'my endurance'
خَافَتْ: خَافَ — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); with ʿalā, 'to fear for'; 'she feared'
نَبْلِ: نَبْل — nabl, arrows (collective, gen. after min); 'the arrows (of)'
مُقْلَتِهَا: مُقْلَة + ـهَا — muqla, eye, eyeball (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her eye'
فَاَلْبَسَتْ: فَـ + اَلْبَسَتْ — fa-, so + albasa, to clothe someone/something in (verb IV of labisa, perf. 3fs, double object; bare alif as printed); 'so she clothed'
الزَّرَدِ: الـ + زَرَد — zarad, rings of chain-mail, mail (m., gen. after min, which tells what the coat is made of); 'of chain-rings'
جَسَّ: جَسَّ — jassa, to feel, touch to examine, here to take the pulse (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms); 'he felt'
التَّأَلُّمَ: الـ + تَأَلُّم — taʾallum, aching, feeling of pain (verbal noun of form V taʾallama; m., acc. after inna); 'the pain'
فَخَلِّ: فَـ + خَلِّ — fa-, so + khalli, let go, leave (imperative m. sg. of khallā, form II, final vowel dropped); 'so let go'
لِطَيْفِ: لِـ + طَيْف — li-, to (prep., the one addressed after qālat) + ṭayf, nightly phantom, apparition (m., gen., first term of construct); 'to the phantom (of)'
زَارَنِي: زَارَ + ـنِي — zāra, to visit (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'it visited me'
صِفْهُ: صِفْ + ـهُ — ṣif, describe (imperative m. sg. of waṣafa, the w dropped) + -hu, him; 'describe him'
تَنْقُصْ: تَنْقُصْ — naqaṣa, to lessen, take away (verb I, jussive 2ms after lā of prohibition); '(do not) take away'
تَزِدِ: تَزِدِ — zāda, to add, increase (verb I hollow, jussive 2ms after lā of prohibition, long ī shortened; final kasra for the rhyme); '(do not) add'
خَلَّفْتُهُ: خَلَّفْتُ + ـهُ — khallafa, to leave behind (verb II, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I left him'
وُرُودِ: وُرُود — wurūd, coming down to water to drink (verbal noun of warada; m., gen. after ʿan); 'coming down to (the water)'
يَرِدِ: يَرِدِ — warada, to come down to water to drink (verb I assimilated, jussive 3ms after lam; final kasra for the rhyme); '(he would not) come down to drink'
فَاسْتَمْطَرَتْ: فَـ + اسْتَمْطَرَتْ — fa-, then + istamṭara, to seek rain, draw down rain (verb X of maṭara, perf. 3fs); 'then she drew down a rain'
لُؤْلُؤًا: لُؤْلُؤ — luʾluʾ, pearls (collective, m., acc. indef.), in verse tears; 'pearls'
نَرْجِسٍ: نَرْجِس — narjis, narcissus (m., gen. indef.), in verse the eye; 'narcissus'
وَسَقَتْ: وَ + سَقَتْ — wa-, and + saqā, to water, give to drink (verb I defective, perf. 3fs); 'and she watered'
وَرْدًا: وَرْد — ward, roses (collective, m., acc. indef.), in verse the cheeks; 'roses'
وَعَضَّتْ: وَ + عَضَّتْ — wa-, and + ʿaḍḍa, to bite (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'to bite on'); 'and she bit'
الْعُنَّابِ: الـ + عُنَّاب — ʿunnāb, jujube, a small red fruit (m., gen. after ʿalā), in verse reddened fingertips; 'the jujubes'
بِالْبَرَدِ: بِـ + الـ + بَرَد — bi-, with (prep. of the instrument) + barad, hail (m., gen.), in verse the teeth; 'with hail'
بِمُصِيبَةٍ: بِـ + مُصِيبَة — bi-, with (prep.; chosen by buliya, 'to be afflicted with') + muṣība, calamity, misfortune (f., gen. indef.); 'with a calamity'
رَاحَةٍ: رَاحَة — rāḥa, rest, relief (f., gen. indef. after the elative aʿẓam); '(greater) relief'
يَشْفِيكَ: يَشْفِي + ـكَ — shafā, to heal, cure (verb I defective, imperf. 3ms) + -ka, you (m.); 'he will heal you'
وَفَتَحَهَا: وَ + فَتَحَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + fataḥa, to open (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the shop, dukkān, taken as f.; or the letter, waraqa); 'and he opened it' Also of a house (dār, f.): wa-fataḥahā, 'and he opened it'.
خَافِقَةَ: خَافِقَة — khāfiqa, throbbing, fluttering (act. part. of khafaqa, f., acc. as the second object of wajada, first term of an adjectival construct); 'throbbing (of heart)'
الْكَأْبَةِ: الـ + كَأْبَة — kaʾba, gloom, dejection (f., gen.; a by-form of kaʾāba, as the print spells it); 'the dejection'
دُكَّانِهِ: دُكَّان + ـهِ — dukkān, shop (m. or f., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his shop'
فَتَأَسَّفَتْ: فَـ + تَأَسَّفَ + ـتْ — fa-, and so + taʾassafa, to grieve, feel sorrow (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and she grieved' (the hamza is the edition's own)
وَتَوَجَّعَتْ: وَ + تَوَجَّعَ + ـتْ — wa-, and + tawajjaʿa, to feel pain, be pained (verb V of w-j-ʿ, perf. 3fs); 'and she was pained'
وَتَأَوَّهَتْ: وَ + تَأَوَّهَ + ـتْ — wa-, and + taʾawwaha, to sigh 'ah!', moan (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and she sighed'
وَتَعَجَّبَتْ: وَ + تَعَجَّبَ + ـتْ — wa-, and + taʿajjaba, to marvel, wonder (verb V; with min, 'at') (perf. 3fs); 'and she marvelled'
حَالُهَا: حَال + ـهَا — ḥāl, state, condition (m./f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her state'
مَضَيْتُمْ: مَضَى + ـتُمْ — maḍā, to go off, go away (verb I, perf. 2mpl); 'you went off'
وَتَوَجَّهْتُمْ: وَ + تَوَجَّهَ + ـتُمْ — wa-, and + tawajjaha, to set off, turn one's face (in a direction) (verb V, perf. 2mpl); 'and you set off'
يَخْفِقُ: يَخْفِقُ — khafaqa/yakhfiqu, to beat, throb, flutter (of the heart) (verb I, impf. 3ms); with ʿalā, 'beats (in fear) for'
بِنَجَاتِكُمْ: بِـ + نَجَاة + ـكُمْ — bi-, in (prep., chosen by ṣaddaqa bi-, 'believe in') + najāt, escape, safety (f., gen.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'in your escape'
اعْتَرَاكِ: اعْتَرَى + ـكِ — iʿtarā, to come upon, seize (of illness or care) (verb VIII of ʿ-r-w, perf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'came over you'
قَبَّلَتْ: قَبَّلَ + ـتْ — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 3fs); 'she kissed'
أَقْدَامَهُ: أَقْدَام + ـهُ — aqdām, feet (pl. of qadam, f., acc. object) + -hu, his; 'his feet'
جَعَلَنِى: جَعَلَ + ـنِى — jaʿala, to make (verb I, perf. 3ms; here as a wish, 'may (God) make') + -nī, me (the edition writes the final yāʾ as ى); 'may He make me'
خَامَرَنِي: خَامَرَ + ـنِي — khāmara, to pervade, take hold of (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'took hold of me'
خِلْطٌ: خِلْط — khilṭ, humour (one of the four humours of the old medicine) (m., nom. indef.); 'a humour'
فَأَضْرَمَ: فَـ + أَضْرَمَ — fa-, and so + aḍrama, to kindle, set ablaze (verb IV, perf. 3ms); 'and it kindled'
اسْتَعْمَلْتِهِ: اسْتَعْمَلَ + ـتِ + ـهِ — istaʿmala, to use, take (food, medicine) (verb X, perf.) + -ti, you (f.) + -hi, it; 'you took it'
نَهَارِكِ: نَهَار + ـكِ — nahār, day, daytime (m., gen. after fī) + -ki, your (f.); 'your day'
أَفْطَرْتُ: أَفْطَرَ + ـتُ — afṭara, to break one's fast (verb IV; with ʿalā, 'on' a food) (perf. 1cs); 'I broke my fast'
آكُلْهُ: آكُلْ + ـهُ — ākul, I eat (akala, verb I, impf. 1cs jussive after lam; the hamza is the edition's own) + -hu, it; 'lam ākulhu', 'I did not eat it'
وَاسْتَدْعَتْ: وَ + اسْتَدْعَى + ـتْ — wa-, and + istadʿā, to call for, send for (verb X; with bi- of the thing sent for) (perf. 3fs); 'and she called for'
فَشَرِبَتْهُ: فَـ + شَرِبَ + ـتْ + ـهُ — fa-, and so + shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'and she drank it'
سَأَلَتِ: سَأَلَ + ـتِ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3fs; the final -i is a linking vowel before the article; the hamza is the edition's own); 'she asked'
انْشِرَاحِهِ: انْشِرَاح + ـهِ — inshirāḥ, expansion (of the breast), good cheer, merriment (verbal noun of VII insharaḥa, m., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his merrymaking'
سَرِيرِهِ: سَرِير + ـهِ — sarīr, couch, throne (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his couch'
وَالْمَجْلِسُ: وَ + الـ + مَجْلِس — wa-, and (opening a circumstantial clause, 'while') + majlis, gathering, assembly, sitting-room (m., nom.); 'and the gathering'
مُنْتَظِمٌ: مُنْتَظِم — muntaẓim, in order, well arranged (act. part. of VIII intaẓama, m., nom. indef., predicate); 'in order'
سَأَلَتْنِي: سَأَلَ + ـتْ + ـنِي — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3fs; the hamza is the edition's own) + -nī, me; 'she asked me'
حَالِكُمَا: حَال + ـكُمَا — ḥāl, state, condition (gen. after ʿan) + -kumā, you two; 'how you two were'
لَعَمْرِي: لَـ + عَمْر + ـِي — la-, by (the lām of the oath) + ʿamr, life (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'by my life'
يَحِقُّ: يَحِقُّ — ḥaqqa/yaḥiqqu, to be right, be fitting (verb I doubled, impf. 3ms); with li-, 'it is right for'
لِلدَمْعِي: لِـ + (لـ) + دَمْع + ـِي — li-, for (prep., chosen by yaḥiqqu li-, 'it is right for') + damʿ, tears (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my tears'; the print sets a second lām, as if the article, which cannot stand with -ī: probably a doubled lām for لِدَمْعِي
الدِّمَا: الـ + دِمَا — al-, the + dimā, blood (pl. of dam; dimāʾ with the final hamza dropped, as verse allows; gen. after min); 'blood'
تَبْكُونَ: تَبْكُونَ — bakā/yabkī, to weep (verb I defective, impf. 2mpl, indic.); 'you weep'
دَمْعًا: دَمْع — damʿ, tears (collective, m., acc. indef., object); 'tears'
الصُّفَّةِ: الـ + صُفَّة — ṣuffa, raised bench, dais along a wall (f., gen. after ʿalā); 'the dais' (source of English 'sofa')
فَأَمْسَكْتُ: فَـ + أَمْسَكْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + amsaka, to take hold of, grasp (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I took hold of'
وَرَشَشْتُ: وَ + رَشَشْتُ — wa-, and + rashsha, to sprinkle (verb I, doubled root, perf. 1cs, where the doubled letter comes apart: rashashtu); with ʿalā, 'sprinkled upon'; 'and I sprinkled'
تَهْتِكِي: تَهْتِكِي — hataka/yahtiku, to rend (a veil), to expose to public shame (verb I, jussive 2fs after prohibitive lā); 'do not expose (to shame)'
نَفْسَكِ: نَفْس + ـكِ — nafs, self, soul (f., acc., object) + -ki, your (2fs); 'yourself'
يَحْوِيهِ: يَحْوِي + ـهِ — ḥawā/yaḥwī, to contain, hold (verb I, defective, impf. 3ms) + -hi, him (the resumptive pronoun pointing back to man, 'whoever'); 'contains (him)'
فَبِحَيَاتِ: فَـ + بِـ + حَيَاة — fa-, so (conj.) + bi-, by (prep. of oath, 'I swear by') + ḥayāt, life (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa; printed with open ت, حيات); 'so by the life of'
تَصْبِرِي: تَصْبِرِي — ṣabara/yaṣbiru, to be patient, endure (verb I, subj. 2fs after an, its nūn dropped); 'that you be patient'
أَطْلُبُهُ: أَطْلُبُ + ـهُ — ṭalaba/yaṭlubu, to seek, ask for (verb I, impf. 1cs) + -hu, it (3ms; here death); 'I seek it'
يَعْقِبُ: يَعْقِبُ — as printed yaʿqibu, from ʿaqaba, to follow, come after (verb I, impf. 3ms); the sense wanted is probably yuʿqibu, from aʿqaba (verb IV), to bring in its wake; 'brings after it'
اَكَّدَ: اَكَّدَ — akkada, to make firm, confirm, ratify (verb II, perf. 3ms; the print's bare alif with fatḥa); 'he made firm'
الْمِيثَاقَ: الـ + مِيثَاق — mīthāq, covenant, solemn compact (m., acc., object of the verb); 'the covenant'
بِقَطْعِ: بِـ + قَطْع — bi-, by (prep. of means: how the covenant was sealed) + qaṭʿ, cutting, severing (verbal noun of qaṭaʿa, m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the cutting of'
عِنَاقِهِ: عِنَاق + ـهِ — ʿināq, embrace, embracing (verbal noun of ʿānaqa, verb III, m., gen. after ʿinda) + -hi, his; 'his embracing'
فَنَظَرَهَا: فَـ + نَظَرَ + ـهَا — fa-, and (conj.) + naẓara, to look, see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (direct object, where Classical says naẓara ilayhā); 'and he saw her'
مَقْصُورَتِهَا: مَقْصُورَة + ـهَا — maqṣūra, closed-off room, private apartment (f., gen. after ilā) + -hā, her; 'her apartment'
فَاسْتَدْعَى: فَـ + اسْتَدْعَى — fa-, so (conj.) + istadʿā, to summon, call for (verb X of d-ʿ-w, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for who is sent for); 'so he summoned'
وَالْأَطِبَّاءِ: وَ + الـ + أَطِبَّاء — wa-, and + al-, the + aṭibbāʾ, physicians (pl. of ṭabīb, m., gen., joined by wa- to bi-al-ḥukamāʾi, both governed by the bi- that istadʿā takes for those sent for); 'and the physicians'
بِمُعَالَجَتِهَا: بِـ + مُعَالَجَة + ـهَا — bi- (after amara, 'to order', bi- marks the thing ordered) + muʿālaja, treatment (verbal noun of III ʿālaja, f., gen.) + -hā, her (its object); 'to treat her'
انْصَلَحَ: انْصَلَحَ — inṣalaḥa, to come right, be mended (verb VII of ṣ-l-ḥ, a later formation; perf. 3ms); 'it had mended'
عَاقَنِي: عَاقَ + ـنِي — ʿāqa, to hinder, hold back (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'from') + -nī, me; 'held me back'
إِلَيْكُمَا: إِلَى + ـكُمَا — ilā, to (prep.) + -kumā, you two (2nd dual suffix); 'to you two'
خَوَاصِّهَا: خَوَاصّ + ـهَا — khawāṣṣ, intimates, closest attendants (pl. of khāṣṣa, gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her intimates'
مُشْتَغِلِينَ: مُشْتَغِلِين — mushtaghil, busied, preoccupied (act. part. VIII of sh-gh-l, m. pl., acc., describing the group); with al-qalba, 'busied of heart, anxious'
أَمَرَتْنِي: أَمَرَتْ + ـنِي — amarat, she ordered (amara, verb I, perf. 3fs; takes bi- for the thing ordered) + -nī, me; 'she ordered me'; also: with an an-clause for what is ordered: amaratnī an adfaʿa, 'she ordered me to pay'
لِآخُذَ: لِـ + آخُذَ — li-, so that (purpose, with the subjunctive) + ākhudha, I take (akhadha, verb I, imperf. 1s subj.); 'so that I might take'; with khabar, 'to get news of'
فَعُودِي: فَـ + عُودِي — fa-, so (conj.) + ʿūdī, return! (ʿāda, verb I hollow, imper. 2fs); 'so go back'
وَبَالِغِي: وَ + بَالِغِي — wa-, and + bālighī, go to lengths! (bālagha, verb III, imper. 2fs; bālagha fī, to do a thing to the utmost); 'and press hard'
وَحُثِّيهَا: وَ + حُثِّي + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥuththī, urge! (ḥaththa, verb I doubled, imper. 2fs; with ʿalā, 'urge to') + -hā, her; 'and urge her'
اُكْتُمِي: اُكْتُمِي — uktumī, hide! keep secret! (katama, verb I, imper. 2fs); 'keep (the secret)' (corrected from the print's آكتمي)
وَأَخْبِرِيهَا: وَ + أَخْبِرِي + ـهَا — wa-, and + akhbirī, inform! (akhbara, verb IV, imper. 2fs) + -hā, her; 'and tell her'
لِتَخَلُّفِكَ: لِـ + تَخَلُّف + ـكَ — li-, because of (causal) + takhalluf, staying behind, absence (verbal noun of V takhallafa, with ʿan, 'from'; m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'because of your staying away'
مُرْتَهَنَةٌ: مُرْتَهَنَة — murtahana, held in pledge (pass. part. VIII of r-h-n, f. sg., nom., predicate; with bi-, 'pledged to'); 'pledged'
شِفَاؤُكَ: شِفَاء + ـكَ — shifāʾ, cure, healing (m., nom., subject of kāna) + -ka, your; 'your cure'
لَجُدْتُ: لَـ + جُدْتُ — la-, then (introducing the answer of law) + judtu, I gave freely (jāda, verb I hollow, perf. 1s; jāda bi-, 'give generously of'); 'I would have given'
عَاقَهَا: عَاقَ + ـهَا — ʿāqa, to hinder, hold back (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'from') + -hā, her; 'held her back'
جُلُوسُ: جُلُوس — julūs, sitting (verbal noun of jalasa, m., nom.; after mā … illā, the subject); 'the sitting of'
الْأَسَفِ: الـ + أَسَف — asaf, grief, sorrow, regret (m., gen.); ghāyata al-asafi, 'the utmost of grief'
تُسَاعِدَنِي: تُسَاعِدَ + ـنِي — sāʿada, to help, assist (form III, subj. 2ms after an) + -nī, me; 'that you help me'
وَعَلِّمْنِي: وَ + عَلِّمْ + ـنِي — wa-, and + ʿallama, to teach (form II, imperative ms) + -nī, me; 'and teach me'
وَأَسْأَلُكَ: وَ + أَسْأَلُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (impf. 1s) + -ka, you (ms); 'and I ask you'
لِأَسْتَأْنِسَ: لِـ + أَسْتَأْنِسَ — li-, so that (purpose; takes the subjunctive) + istaʾnasa, to find company and comfort (form X of anisa, subj. 1s), with bi- of the companion; 'so that I may take comfort (in)'
فَبَاتَا: فَـ + بَاتَا — fa-, and so + bāta, to spend the night (hollow, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two spent the night'
فَمِيْ: فَم + ـِي — fam, mouth (m., gen. after fī) + -ī, my (verse pointing with sukūn on the long vowel); 'my mouth'; here: nom., predicate: maghribuhā famī, 'its setting-place is my mouth'
وَمَثْوَاكَ: وَ + مَثْوَى + ـكَ — wa-, and + mathwā, abode, dwelling-place (m., noun of place from thawā, 'to stay'; nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your dwelling'
تَغِيْبُ: تَغِيبُ — ghāba, to be absent, go away (hollow, impf. 2ms, verse pointing with sukūn on the long vowel); 'you are absent'
اَسَفِيْ: أَسَف + ـِي — asaf, grief, sorrow (m., nom.) + -ī, my (verse pointing, bare alif); 'my grief'
يَنْقَضِيْ: يَنْقَضِي — inqaḍā, to come to an end, pass away (form VII of qaḍā, impf. 3ms); circumstantial, 'passing away'
الْاِجْتِمَاعِ: الـ + اِجْتِمَاع — ijtimāʿ, coming together, union (m., verbal noun of form VIII ijtamaʿa; gen. after fī); 'being together'
نَصِيْبُ: نَصِيب — naṣīb, share, portion, lot (m., nom., subject of laysa); 'a share'
خَفَرَتْ: خَفَرَتْ — khafara, to give protection; with a pledge (dhimma) as object, to break it (perf. 3fs); 'she broke (the protection)'
ذِمَّةَ: ذِمَّة — dhimma, pledge of protection, safe-conduct, covenant (f., acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'the protection of'
مِغْفَرِيْ: مِغْفَر + ـِي — mighfar, helmet, mail hood (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my helmet'
وَفَرَتْ: وَ + فَرَتْ — wa-, and + farā, to cut, split (final-weak, perf. 3fs); 'and she split'
بِرُمْحِ: بِـ + رُمْح — bi-, with (prep., of the instrument) + rumḥ, spear, lance (m., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'with the spear of'
دِرْعَ: دِرْع — dirʿ, coat of mail (f. or m., acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'the mail-coat of'
تَصَبُّرِيْ: تَصَبُّر + ـِي — taṣabbur, endurance, holding patient (m., verbal noun of form V taṣabbara; gen.) + -ī, my; 'my endurance'
وَجَلَتْ: وَ + جَلَتْ — wa-, and + jalā, to unveil, reveal, make bright (final-weak, perf. 3fs); 'and she unveiled'
مِسْكَةِ: مِسْكَة — miska, a piece of musk (f., gen. after taḥti, first term of iḍāfa); 'the musk of'
خَالِهَا: خَال + ـهَا — khāl, mole, beauty-spot (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her mole'
كَافُوْرَ: كَافُور — kāfūr, camphor (m., acc., object of jalat; first term of iḍāfa); 'a camphor of'
فَجْرٍ: فَجْر — fajr, dawn (m., gen., indef.); 'of dawn'
لَيْلَ: لَيْل — layl, night (m., acc., object of shaqqa; first term of iḍāfa); 'the night of'
فَزَعَتْ: فَزَعَتْ — fazaʿa / faziʿa, to take fright, be startled (perf. 3fs; the print points fatḥa on the zāy, the usual form being faziʿat); 'she took fright'
فَضَرَّسَتِ: فَـ + ضَرَّسَتْ — fa-, and so + ḍarrasa, to bite hard, set the teeth in (form II, perf. 3fs; linking kasra before the article); 'and she bit'
الْعَقِيْقَ: الـ + عَقِيق — ʿaqīq, carnelian (m., acc.); in verse her lips; 'the carnelian'
فَرَائِدُهُ: فَرَائِد + ـهُ — farāʾid, single large pearls (pl. of farīda; nom., subject of sakanat) + -hu, its (the pearl's); 'its single pearls'
غَدِيْرَ: غَدِير — ghadīr, pool, pond (m., acc., direct object of sakana, 'to dwell in'; first term of iḍāfa); 'a pool of'
وَتَنَهَّدَتْ: وَ + تَنَهَّدَتْ — wa-, and + tanahhada, to sigh deeply (form V, perf. 3fs); 'and she sighed'
فَاَثَّرَ: فَـ + أَثَّرَ — fa-, and so + aththara, to leave a mark, make an impression (form II, perf. 3ms; verse pointing, bare alif); 'and (her palm) left marks'
كَفُّهَا: كَفّ + ـهَا — kaff, palm, hand (usually f.; here with a masculine verb; nom.) + -hā, her; 'her palm'
اَنْظُرِ: أَنْظُرْ — naẓara, to look, see (jussive 1s after lam; kasra for the rhyme; verse pointing, bare alif); 'I (had not) seen'
اَقْلَامَ: أَقْلَام — aqlām, pens (pl. of qalam; acc., explaining mā lam anẓuri; verse pointing, bare alif); 'pens of'
مَرْجَانٍ: مَرْجَان — marjān, coral (m., gen., indef.); 'of coral'
كَتَبْنَ: كَتَبْنَ — kataba, to write (perf. 3 f. pl., agreeing with aqlām as a non-human plural); 'they wrote'
بِصَحِيْفَةِ: بِـ + صَحِيفَة — bi-, on (prep., of place) + ṣaḥīfa, page, sheet (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'on the page of'
الْبَلُّوْرِ: الـ + بَلُّور — ballūr, crystal (m., gen.); 'the crystal'
اَسْطُرَ: أَسْطُر — asṭur, lines (pl. of saṭr; counted after khamsata, where the genitive is expected; the print points it with fatḥa); 'lines'
يَاحَامِلَ: يَا + حَامِلَ — yā, O (vocative) + ḥāmil, bearer, carrier (active participle of ḥamala; acc. as first term of iḍāfa after yā); printed as one word; 'O bearer of'
الصَّحِيْحِ: الـ + صَحِيح — ṣaḥīḥ, sound, whole, unbroken (adj., gen., agreeing with al-sayf); 'the sound'
ضَرْبَةَ: ضَرْبَة — ḍarba, a blow, stroke (f., acc., the thing warned against after iyyāka; first term of iḍāfa); 'the blow of'
جَفْنِهَا: جَفْن + ـهَا — jafn, eyelid; also scabbard of a sword (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her eyelid'
الْمُتَكَسِّرِ: الـ + مُتَكَسِّر — mutakassir, broken; of an eye, languid, drooping (form V participle of kasara; gen., agreeing with jafn); 'the broken, languid'
وَتَوَقَّ: وَ + تَوَقَّ — wa-, and + tawaqqā, to guard oneself against (form V, imperative ms; final yāʾ dropped); 'and guard against'
يَارَبَّ: يَا + رَبَّ — yā, O (vocative) + rabb, lord, master, owner (acc. as first term of iḍāfa after yā); printed as one word; 'O master of'
الْقَنَاةِ: الـ + قَنَاة — qanāt, lance, spear-shaft (f., gen.); 'the lance'
الْقِوَامِ: الـ + قِوَام — qiwām (usually qawām), stature, figure (m., gen. after min); 'the stature'
بِاَسْمَرِ: بِـ + أَسْمَر — bi-, with (prep., of the weapon one charges with) + asmar, tawny, brown; as a noun, a (brown) spear (diptote, here given -ri for the rhyme; verse pointing, bare alif); 'with a tawny (spear)'
جَسَدِةِ: جَسَد + هِ — jasad, body (m., gen. after مِنْ) + -hi, his (the print spells the pronoun with ة); min jasadihi, 'from his body'
ضَحْوَةِ: ضَحْوَة — ḍaḥwa, forenoon, the bright part of the morning (f., gen. after إِلَى, first term of an iḍāfa); ḍaḥwat al-nahār, 'the forenoon of the day'
أَوْمَأَتْ: أَوْمَأَ + تْ — awmaʾa, to make a sign, gesture (verb IV, perf. 3fs; awmaʾa ilā, 'sign to'); 'she made a sign'
وَبَلَّغَتْهُ: وَ + بَلَّغَ + تْ + هُ — wa-, and + ballagha, to convey, deliver (verb II, perf. 3fs, taking two objects) + -hu, him; 'and she conveyed to him'
سَلَامَ: سَلَام — salām, greeting (m., acc., object of ballagha; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the greeting of'; also acc. after lā of negation, first term of an iḍāfa: lā salāma muwaddiʿin, 'not the greeting of one bidding farewell' (Night 193, verse)
تَسْأَلِي: تَسْأَلِي — saʾala, to ask (verb I, impf. 2fs jussive after prohibitive لَا, nūn dropped); lā tasʾalī ʿan, 'do not ask about'
أَنْحَلَهُ: أَنْحَلَ + هُ — anḥala, to make thin, waste (verb IV of naḥala, 'grow thin'; perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (object); 'it wasted him'
سَلَّمَتْنِي: سَلَّمَ + تْ + نِي — sallama, to hand over, deliver (verb II, perf. 3fs, two objects) + -nī, me; 'she handed me'
تَأْتِينِي: تَأْتِي + نِي — atā, to come (verb I, impf. 2fs jussive after prohibitive لَا, nūn dropped) + -nī, me (object); with illā bi-, 'do not come to me except with', i.e. bring back; the print writes تاتيني without hamza
وَافْعَلِي: وَ + اِفْعَلِي — wa-, and + ifʿalī, do! (faʿala, verb I, imperative 2fs; hamzat waṣl, so no hamza mark); 'and do'
أَمَرْتُكِ: أَمَرَ + تُ + كِ — amara, to command (verb I, perf. 1s) + -ki, you (f., object); with bi- of the thing commanded; 'I commanded you'
خَبَرِةِ: خَبَر + ـة (for ـهِ) — khabar, news (m., gen. after jamīʿ, in akhbartuki bi-jamīʿi khabarihi, where bi- marks the news after akhbara, 'inform of') + -hi, his (the print spells the pronoun with ة); 'his news'
أَمْرَةُ: أَمْر + ـهُ — amr, command, bidding (m., acc., object of imtathala) + -hu, his (spelled ة in the print); 'his command'
وَأَوْقَفَهَا: وَ + أَوْقَفَ + هَا — wa-, and + awqafa, to make stand, set standing (Form IV of waqafa, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he left her standing'
فُلَانًا: فُلَان — fulān, so-and-so, such a one (m., acc. indef.; the word for a person not named); 'so-and-so'
بِرُقْعَةٍ: بِـ + رُقْعَة — bi-, with (prep.; here what is sent along) + ruqʿa, scrap of paper, note, short letter (f., gen. indef.); 'with a note' Also after jāʾa, 'come', bi- marks what is brought: jāʾatnī bi-ruqʿatin, 'she brought me a note'.
تَتَضَمَّنُ: تَتَضَمَّنُ — taḍammana, to contain, include (Form V of ḍamina, impf. 3fs, indic.); 'which contains'; here: taḍammana li-, 'to guarantee (something) to someone' (tataḍammanu lahu al-salāmata, 'she assures him of safety')
تَأَخُّرِهِ: تَأَخُّر + هِ — taʾakhkhur, delay, staying back (maṣdar of Form V taʾakhkhara, m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his delay'; with ʿan, 'staying away from'
لِعُذْرٍ: لِـ + عُذْر — li-, because of, for (prep. of cause) + ʿudhr, excuse, hindrance one can plead (m., gen. indef.); 'for an excuse'
أَدْخِلُوهَا: أَدْخِلُوا + هَا — adkhilū, make enter, bring in (Form IV of dakhala, imper. m. pl.) + -hā, her; 'bring her in'
فَغَمَزَهُ: فَـ + غَمَزَ + هُ — fa-, and so + ghamaza, to press; to wink, signal with the eye (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (the one signalled to); 'and he winked at him'
السَّيِّدِ: الـ + سَيِّد — sayyid, master, lord (m., gen. as second term of an iḍāfa); 'the master'
شَفَاهُ: شَفَى + هُ — shafā, to heal, cure (verb I, perf. 3ms, here a wish) + -hu, him; 'may (God) heal him'
وَعَافَاهُ: وَ + عَافَى + هُ — wa-, and + ʿāfā, to grant health, preserve from ill (Form III, perf. 3ms, here a wish) + -hu, him; 'and restore him'
أَخْرَجَتِ: أَخْرَجَتْ — akhraja, to bring out, take out (Form IV of kharaja, perf. 3fs, linking vowel -i before al-); 'she brought out'
وَقَبَّلَّهَا: وَ + قَبَّلَ + هَا — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (Form II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the letter); 'and he kissed it'; the print sets its shadda on the lām (قبلّها), kept beside the shadda of the bāʾ
لِأَبِى: لِـ + أَبِى — li-, to (prep.; after nāwala it marks the one handed to) + abī, father (gen. of abū, printed with ى); 'to Abū (al-Ḥasan)'
يُنْبِيكَ: يُنْبِي + كَ — yunbī for yunbiʾu, informs (Form IV anbaʾa, impf. 3ms, hamza softened to ī) + -ka, you; with ʿan, 'tells you of'; 'informs you'
الرَّسُوْلُ: الـ + رَسُول — rasūl, messenger (m., nom.; verse pointing with sukūn on the long ū); 'the messenger'
خَبَرِى: خَبَر + ـِى — khabar, news (m., gen. after ʿan) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my news'; here: acc., object of akshifu; 'my story'
فَاسْتَغْنِ: فَـ + اسْتَغْنِ — fa-, so + istaghni, do without (Form X of ghaniya, imper. m. sg., final ī shortened); with ʿan, 'dispense with'; 'so dispense with'
ذِكْرِهِ: ذِكْر + هِ — dhikr, mention, account (m., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his telling'
خَلَفْتَ: خَلَفْتَ — khalafa, to leave behind; to come after (verb I as printed, perf. 2ms; the sense 'leave behind' is more usually Form II khallafa); 'you left behind'
بِحُبِّكُمْ: بِـ + حُبّ + كُمْ — bi-, with, by (prep.; the cause of the state) + ḥubb, love (m., gen.) + -kum, you (polite pl. for one person); 'with love of you'
شَغَفًا: شَغَف — shaghaf, passion that reaches the heart (m., acc. indef., saying in what way); 'in passion, passion-struck'
وَطَرْفُهُ: وَ + طَرْف + هُ — wa-, and + ṭarf, eye, glance (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his eye'
بِالسَّهَرِ: بِـ + الـ + سَهَر — bi-, in (prep. of state) + sahar, sleeplessness, wakefulness at night (m., gen.); 'in wakefulness'
أُكَابِدُ: أُكَابِدُ — kābada, to struggle with, endure (Form III, impf. 1s, indic.; the print's hamza); 'I wrestle with'
مَوَاقِعَ: مَوَاقِع — mawāqiʿ, places or strokes of falling (pl. of mawqiʿ, acc., diptote); 'the blows (of)'
وَقَرِّ: وَ + قَرِّ — wa-, and + qarri, be cool, be at rest (imper. of qarra, doubled verb, as printed); with ʿaynan, 'be comforted'
تَغْفَلُ: تَغْفَلُ — ghafala, to be heedless; with ʿan, to be heedless of, neglect (verb I, impf. 2ms or 3fs, indic.); 'you are (not) heedless of'
بَصَرِى: بَصَر + ـِى — baṣar, sight, eyesight (m., gen. after ʿan) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my sight'
حَلَّهُ: حَلَّ + هُ — ḥalla, to alight at, befall (doubled verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it (the body); 'befell it'
وَاسْتَدِلِّ: وَ + اسْتَدِلِّ — wa-, and + istadilli, take as evidence, infer (Form X of dalla, imper. m. sg.; doubled verb, final kasra as printed); with bi-, 'infer from'
بِالْاَثَرِ: بِـ + الـ + أَثَر — bi-, from, by (prep.; istadalla bi- chooses it for the evidence) + athar, trace, mark left behind (m., gen.; printed with a bare alif); 'from the trace'
بَنَانٍ: بَنَان — banān, fingertips, fingers (collective; gen. indef. after bi-ghayri); 'without fingers'; also gen. indef. in an 'improper' iḍāfa after mukhaḍḍabātu, 'henna-dyed as to fingertips'
وَنَطَقْتُ: وَ + نَطَقْتُ — wa-, and + naṭaqa, to speak, utter (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I spoke'
وَجُمْلَةُ: وَ + جُمْلَة — wa-, and + jumla, sum, whole, totality (f., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the sum of'
شَرْحِ: شَرْح — sharḥ, explanation, account (m., verbal noun of sharaḥa; gen. in an iḍāfa); 'of the account of'
لَايُفَارِقُهَا: لَا + يُفَارِقُ + ـهَا — lā, not + yufāriqu, he/it leaves, parts from (fāraqa, verb III, imperf. 3ms indic.) + -hā, it/her (object: the eye); 'does not leave it'; printed as one word
وَقَلْبًا: وَ + قَلْبًا — wa-, and + qalb, heart (m., acc. indef., governed by the preceding anna); 'and a heart'
لَاتَبْرَحُ: لَا + تَبْرَحُ — lā, not + tabraḥu, it departs, leaves (bariḥa, verb I, imperf. 3fs indic., agreeing with a plural of things); 'do not depart'; printed as one word
الْفِكَرُ: الـ + فِكَر — al-, the + fikar, thoughts, cares (pl. of fikra; nom.); 'the cares'
فَكَأَنَّنِي: فَـ + كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — fa-, so + kaʾanna, as if (particle taking the accusative) + -nī, me; 'so it is as if I'
قَطُّمَا: قَطُّ + مَا — qaṭṭu, ever, at all (adv. with a negated perfect) + mā, not (negative); 'never'; printed as one word
تَرْحَةً: تَرْحَة — tarḥa, sorrow, grief (f., acc. indef.; opposite of farḥa); 'sorrow'
وَلَارَأَيْتُ: وَ + لَا + رَأَيْتُ — wa-, and + lā, not + raʾaytu, I saw (raʾā, verb I, perf. 1cs); 'nor did I see'; printed as one word, its hamza the print's own
بَهِيًّا: بَهِيّ — bahiyy, bright, beautiful, splendid (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'lovely'
وَكَأَنَّنِي: وَ + كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — wa-, and + kaʾanna, as if (particle taking the accusative) + -nī, me; 'and as if I'
خُلِقْتُ: خُلِقْتُ — khuliqa, to be created (khalaqa, verb I, passive perf. 1cs); 'I was created'
وَالْكَآبَةِ: وَ + الـ + كَآبَة — wa-, and + al-, the + kaʾāba, dejection, gloom (f., gen.); 'and of gloom'; the madda is the print's own
فَعَلَيَّ: فَـ + عَلَى + ـيَّ — fa-, so + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + -ya, me (contracted ʿalayya); 'so upon me'; the shadda is the print's own
السَّقَامُ: الـ + سَقَام — al-, the + saqām, sickness, illness (m., nom.); 'sickness'
مُتَرَادِفٌ: مُتَرَادِف — mutarādif, following one upon another, successive (act. part. of VI tarādafa; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'coming on and on'
مُتَضَاعِفٌ: مُتَضَاعِف — mutaḍāʿif, doubling, multiplying (act. part. of VI taḍāʿafa; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'doubled and redoubled'
مُتَكَاثِرٌ: مُتَكَاثِر — mutakāthir, increasing, multiplying (act. part. of VI takāthara; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'ever growing'
ثَايِرٌ: ثَايِرٌ — thāyir, colloquial spelling of thāʾir, rising, stirred up, raging (act. part. of thāra; m., nom. indef., predicate); the hamza turned to a yāʾ glide; 'raging'
اَلْقَلْبُ: اَلـ + قَلْب — al-, the + qalb, heart (m., nom.); 'the heart'; the print points the article's alif with fatḥa
مُنْقَبِضٌ: مُنْقَبِض — munqabiḍ, contracted, oppressed, gloomy (act. part. of VII inqabaḍa; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'clenched'
مُنْبَسِطٌ: مُنْبَسِط — munbasiṭ, spread out, expanded (act. part. of VII inbasaṭa; m., nom. indef., predicate); of thoughts, 'wandering everywhere'
وَالْعَيْنُ: وَ + الـ + عَيْن — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿayn, eye (f., nom.); 'and the eye'
سَاهِرَةٌ: سَاهِرَة — sāhira, wakeful, sleepless (act. part. of sahira; f., nom. indef., predicate); 'wakeful'
مَتْعُوْبُ: مَتْعُوب — matʿūb, wearied, worn out (colloquial pass. part. of تَعِبَ, Classical mutʿab; m., nom.); 'worn out'; the sukūn on the wāw is the print's
مُنْفَصِلٌ: مُنْفَصِل — munfaṣil, cut off, severed (act. part. of VII infaṣala; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'cut off'
مُتَّصِلٌ: مُتَّصِل — muttaṣil, joined, continuous (act. part. of VIII ittaṣala; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'unbroken'; here: 'joined', with bi-, muttaṣilun bihi, 'joined to it'
وَالْعَقْلُ: وَ + الـ + عَقْل — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿaql, mind, reason (m., nom.); 'and the mind'
مُخْتَبِلٌ: مُخْتَبِل — mukhtabil, deranged, distracted (act. part. of VIII ikhtabala, root kh-b-l; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'distracted'
وَالْقَلْبُ: وَ + الـ + قَلْب — wa-, and + al-, the + qalb, heart (m., nom.); 'and the heart'
مَسْلُوبُ: مَسْلُوب — maslūb, robbed, stolen away (pass. part. of salaba; m., nom.); 'stolen'
لَاتُطْفِى: لَا + تُطْفِى — lā, not + tuṭfī, for tuṭfiʾu, it extinguishes (aṭfaʾa, verb IV, imperf. 3fs; the final hamza dropped and the verb read as weak in -ī); 'does not put out'; printed as one word
الْبَلْوَى: الـ + بَلْوَى — al-, the + balwā, affliction, trial (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'of affliction'
تُعَلِّلُ: تُعَلِّلُ — ʿallala, to divert, console, soothe with hopes (verb II, imperf. 3fs); 'it consoles'; the shadda is the print's own
أَعَلَّهُ: أَعَلَّ + ـهُ — aʿalla, to make ill (verb IV of ʿalla, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (resumptive, the one meant by man); 'whom (longing) has made sick'; the shadda is the print's own
الِاشْتِيَاقُ: الـ + اِشْتِيَاق — al-, the + ishtiyāq, longing, yearning (m., verbal noun of VIII ishtāqa; nom., subject); 'longing'
وَأَتْلَفَهُ: وَ + أَتْلَفَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + atlafa, to destroy, ruin (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and (whom parting) has undone'
وَأَتَسَلَّى: وَ + أَتَسَلَّى — wa-, and + atasallā, I console myself (tasallā, verb V, imperf. 1cs; takes bi- for the comfort); 'and I console myself'
لَفْظِ: لَفْظ — lafẓ, word, utterance (m., gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the word of'
اِذَالَمْ: اِذَا + لَمْ — idhā, if, when (conditional) + lam, not (negates the past, with the jussive); 'if … not'; printed as one word
سُخْطٌ: سُخْط — sukhṭ, displeasure, anger (m., nom. indef.); 'anger'
حَلَاوَاتُ: حَلَاوَات — ḥalāwāt, sweetnesses, delights (pl. of ḥalāwa; nom.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the sweetness of'
الرَّسَائِلِ: الـ + رَسَائِل — al-, the + rasāʾil, letters, messages (pl. of risāla; gen.); 'of the messages'
وَالْكُتْبِ: وَ + الـ + كُتْب — wa-, and + al-, the + kutb, letters, writings (pl. of kitāb, kutub shortened for the metre; gen.); 'and the letters'
قَرَأْتُهَا: قَرَأْتُ + ـهَا — qaraʾtu, I read (qaraʾa, verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it (the letter, f.); 'I read it'; the hamza and the damma are the print's own
هَيَّجَتْ: هَيَّجَتْ — hayyaja, to stir up, excite, rouse (verb II, perf. 3fs); 'stirred up'
أَلْفَاظُهَا: أَلْفَاظ + ـهَا — alfāẓ, words, expressions (pl. of lafẓ; nom.) + -hā, its (the letter's); 'its words'
بَلَابِلِي: بَلَابِل + ـِي — balābil, cares, anxieties (pl. of balbala; acc.) + -ī, my; 'my cares'
وَأَصَابَتْ: وَ + أَصَابَتْ — wa-, and + aṣāba, to hit, strike (a target) (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and struck'
مَقَاتِلِي: مَقَاتِل + ـِي — maqātil, mortal spots, places where a wound kills (pl. of maqtal; acc.) + -ī, my; 'my mortal parts', i.e. 'me to the heart'
دَفَعْتُهَا: دَفَعْتُ + ـهَا — dafaʿtu, I handed over, gave (dafaʿa, verb I, perf. 1cs; with ilā for the receiver) + -hā, it (the letter, f.); 'I handed it'
أَبْلِغِي: أَبْلِغِي — ablagha, to convey, deliver (a message) (verb IV, imper. 2fs; two objects, the person and the thing); 'convey!'
سَيِّدَتَكِ: سَيِّدَة + ـكِ — sayyida, lady, mistress (f., acc.) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your lady'
وَعَرِّفِيهَا: وَ + عَرِّفِي + ـهَا — wa-, and + ʿarrifī, make known! inform! (ʿarrafa, verb II, imper. 2fs; takes bi- for what is made known) + -hā, her; 'and let her know'
بِوَجْدِي: بِـ + وَجْد + ـِي — bi-, of (marks what is made known, after ʿarrafa) + wajd, ardour, passion (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my ardour'
وَغَرَامِي: وَ + غَرَام + ـِي — wa-, and + gharām, passionate love (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my passion'
وَامْتِزَاجِ: وَ + اِمْتِزَاج — wa-, and + imtizāj, mingling, blending (m., verbal noun of VIII imtazaja; gen., still governed by the bi- after ʿarrafa; takes bi- 'with'); 'and of the mingling of'
بِلَحْمِي: بِـ + لَحْم + ـِي — bi-, with (after imtizāj, 'mingling with') + laḥm, flesh (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my flesh'
وَعِظَامِي: وَ + عِظَام + ـِي — wa-, and + ʿiẓām, bones (pl. of ʿaẓm; gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my bones'
يُنْقِذُنِي: يُنْقِذُ + ـنِي — yunqidhu, he rescues, saves (anqadha, verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'rescues me'
وَيُنَجِّينِي: وَ + يُنَجِّي + ـنِي — wa-, and + yunajjī, he delivers, saves (najjā, verb II, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and delivers me'
تَعَدَّى: تَعَدَّى — taʿaddā, to overstep, transgress; with ʿalā, to wrong, act unjustly against (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'has wronged'; the shadda is the print's own
بِنَوَائِبِهِ: بِـ + نَوَائِب + ـهِ — bi-, with, by means of (instrument) + nawāʾib, calamities, blows of fortune (pl. of nāʾiba; gen.) + -hi, its (Time's); 'with its calamities'; the hamza is the print's own
مُنْجِدٍ: مُنْجِد — munjid, helper, rescuer (act. part. of IV anjada; m., gen. indef. after min); in hal min munjidin, 'is there any helper at all?'
شَوَائِبِهِ: شَوَائِب + ـهِ — shawāʾib, impurities, taints, troubles mixed in (pl. of shāʾiba; gen.) + -hi, its (Time's); 'its troubles'; the hamza is the print's own
فَبَكَتِ: فَـ + بَكَتِ — fa-, and so + bakat, she wept (bakā, verb I defective, perf. 3fs; -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'and (she) wept'
فَانْصَرَفَتْ: فَـ + انْصَرَفَتْ — fa-, and so + inṣarafa, to go away, depart (verb VII, perf. 3fs); 'and she went off'; inṣarafat ilā ḥālihā, 'she went her way'; also with a plural of persons as subject: fa-inṣarafat jamīʿu al-umarāʾi, 'and all the emirs withdrew' (Night 198)
انْقَبَضَ: انْقَبَضَ — inqabaḍa, to contract, shrink; of the heart, to be gripped with gloom (verb VII of qabaḍa, perf. 3ms); 'it had contracted'
صَدْرُةُ: صَدْر + ةُ — ṣadr, breast, chest (m., nom., subject of ḍāqa) + -hu, his (the pronoun spelled with ة, a habit of the print); 'his breast'; ḍāqa ṣadruhu, 'his breast grew narrow', i.e. he was dejected
وَحَارَفِي: وَ + حَارَ + فِي — wa-, and + ḥāra, to be perplexed, at a loss (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms) + fī, in (prep.), the print running verb and preposition together as one word; ḥāra fī amrihi, 'he was at a loss in his affair'
فِكْرٍ: فِكْر — fikr, thought, reflection, brooding (m., gen. indef. after fī); fī fikrin, 'in thought'
شَكْوَي: شَكْوَى — shakwā, complaint (f., gen. after fī; the print writes the final alif maqṣūra as ي); akhadha fī shakwā, 'he began to complain of'
وَمَابِهِ: وَ + مَا + بِـ + ـهِ — wa-, and + mā, what (rel.) + bi-, in (prep.) + -hi, him, the print running mā and bihi together as one word; mā bihi, 'what was in him', i.e. what he suffered
اْلغَرَامِ: الـ + غَرَام — al-, the + gharām, passion, consuming love (m., gen., second term of an iḍāfa with alam); 'of passion' (the print sets the sukūn on the alif of the article and a fatḥa on the lām)
قَبْلِيْ: قَبْل + ـِي — qabla, before (adverbial acc., in construct) + -ī, me; 'before me' (the print sets a sukūn on the long ī)
وَرَوَّعَ: وَ + رَوَّعَ — wa-, and + rawwaʿa, to frighten, terrify (verb II of rāʿa, perf. 3ms), as the print points it; the sense wants the living and dead as the ones stricken with dread, as if passive ruwwiʿa
بِالنَّوى: بِـ + الـ + نَوَى — bi-, by, through (prep. of the cause) + al-, the + nawā, distance, separation from the beloved (f.); 'by parting'
وَمَيْتُ: وَ + مَيْت — wa-, and + mayt, dead (m., nom., short form of mayyit; the damma is the rhyme's); 'and dead'
وَاَمَّا: وَ + أَمَّا — wa-, and + ammā, as for (topic particle, answered by fa-); 'but as for' (printed with bare alif)
ضَمَّتْ: ضَمَّ — ḍamma, to enclose, hold together, embrace (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs, its subject the f. pl. ḍulūʿ); 'have enclosed'
ضُلُوْعِيْ: ضُلُوع + ـِي — ḍulūʿ, ribs (pl. of ḍilʿ, f.) + -ī, my; 'my ribs' (the print sets a sukūn on both long vowels); what the ribs enclose is the heart
فَاِنِّيْ: فَـ + إِنَّ + ـِي — fa-, then (answering ammā) + inna, indeed (particle of emphasis) + -ī, I; 'then I' (printed with bare alif and a sukūn on the long ī)
وَلَقِيتُ: وَ + لَقِيتُ — wa-, and + laqiya, to meet, meet with, suffer (verb I, final-weak, perf. 1cs); 'and I have met with'
حُبِّيكَ: حُبّ + ـِي + ـكَ — ḥubb, love (m., gen. after min) + -ka, you, the vowel lengthened to ī as the metre needs (or -ī, my + -ka, a loose double pronoun); min ḥubbīka, 'from (my) love of you'
يَلْقَهُ: يَلْقَ + ـهُ — laqiya, to meet, suffer (verb I final-weak, jussive 3ms after lam, the final yāʾ dropped) + -hu, it; lam yalqahu, 'he did not meet it'
لُبْنَى: لُبْنَى — Lubnā (f. proper name), the beloved of the poet Qays ibn Dharīḥ (gen., second term of an iḍāfa); fī ḥubbi Lubnā, 'in the love of Lubnā'
قَيْسُهَا: قَيْس + ـهَا — Qays (m. proper name, nom., subject of yalqa) + -hā, her (Lubnā); 'her Qays', the lover who belongs to her
الْمَجْنُونُ: الـ + مَجْنُون — al-, the + majnūn, possessed by the jinn, mad (passive participle of janna, m., nom., in apposition to Qays); 'the madman', the by-name of the lover-poet Qays
لكنَّني: لَكِنَّ + ـنِي — lākinna, but (particle taking a noun in the acc.) + -nī, me; 'but I' (the print sets only the shadda)
اَتَّبِعْ: أَتَّبِعْ — attabiʿ, I follow (ittabaʿa, verb VIII of tabiʿa, jussive 1cs after lam; printed with bare alif); lam attabiʿ, 'I did not follow'
وَحْشَ: وَحْش — waḥsh, wild beasts (m. coll., acc., object of attabiʿ; first term of an iḍāfa); waḥsha al-falā, 'the wild beasts of the desert'
كَفَعَالُ: كَـ + فَعَال — ka-, like, as (prep.) + faʿāl, deed, doing (m.); after ka- it should be genitive, faʿāli, but the print points it with a damma; ka-faʿāli Qaysin, 'like the doing of Qays'
وَالْجُنُونُ: وَ + الـ + جُنُون — wa-, and + al-, the + junūn, madness (m., nom., subject); 'and madness'
فُنُونُ: فُنُون — funūn, kinds, sorts, varieties (pl. of fann, nom., predicate); al-junūnu funūnu, 'madness is of many kinds'
وَلَاسَمِعْتُ: وَ + لَا + سَمِعْتُ — wa-, and + lā, not + samiʿtu, I heard (samiʿa, perf. 1cs), the print running lā and the verb together as one word; wa-lā samiʿtu, 'nor have I heard'
وَضَعْفُ: وَ + ضَعْف — wa-, and + ḍaʿf, weakness (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); ḍaʿfu al-ḥarakati, 'weakness of movement'
تَعَلَّقْتَ: تَعَلَّقْتَ — taʿallaqa, to cling, become attached (verb V of ʿaliqa, perf. 2ms); with bi-, 'to fall in love with'; 'you have become attached' (the shadda and the final fatḥa are the print's own)
مُوَافِقٍ: مُوَافِق — muwāfiq, agreeing, in accord, compliant (participle of wāfaqa, verb III; m., gen. indef., adjective of ḥabīb); 'a beloved who returns your love'
أَحْبَبْتَ: أَحْبَبْتَ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV of ḥabba, doubled, perf. 2ms, the doubling undone before the consonant ending); 'you loved'
مُخَالِفًا: مُخَالِف — mukhālif, contrary, opposing, crossing one's wishes (participle of khālafa, verb III; m., acc. indef., adjective of ḥabīban); 'contrary'
مُخَادِعًا: مُخَادِع — mukhādiʿ, deceiving, playing false (participle of khādaʿa, verb III; m., acc. indef., adjective of ḥabīban); 'deceitful'
يَنْكَشِفُ: يَنْكَشِفُ — inkashafa, to be uncovered, come to light (verb VII of kashafa, imperf. 3ms); after kāna, 'would come to light'
وَرَكَنَ: وَ + رَكَنَ — wa-, and + rakana, to lean, incline; with ilā, to rely on, take comfort in (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he took comfort (in it)'
وَشَكَرَنِي: وَ + شَكَرَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + shakara, to thank (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; with ʿalā for what one is thanked for; 'and he thanked me'
وَأَمْرِةِ: وَ + أَمْر + ةِ — wa-, and + amr, affair (m., gen., joined to amrī after ʿalā) + -hi, his (the pronoun spelled with ة, a habit of the print); 'and his affair'
مُتَوَافِقَانِ: مُتَوَافِق + ـَانِ — mutawāfiq, in mutual accord, of one mind (participle of tawāfaqa, verb VI; nom. dual); 'two in accord'
يَأْتِينِي: يَأْتِي + ـنِي — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; kāna yaʾtīnī, 'he used to come to me' (the hamza is the print's own; the print has يأنيني, a misprint)
فَيَسْأَلُنِي: فَـ + يَسْأَلُ + ـنِي — fa-, and then (conj.) + saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he would ask me' (the hamza is the print's own)
سَأَلَنِى: سَأَلَ + ـنِى — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (the print writes the final ي as ى); 'he asked me' (the hamza is the print's own)
فَخَادَعْتُهُ: فَـ + خَادَعْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + khādaʿa, to deceive, beguile (verb III, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'and I deceived him'
دَعَتْهُ: دَعَتْ + ـهُ — daʿā, to call, invite (verb I final-weak, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; with ilā, 'she called him to'; 'she has invited him'
مَزِيدَ: مَزِيد — mazīd, increase, more (verbal noun of zāda; m., acc. after lā of absolute denial); mā lā mazīda ʿalayhi, 'what cannot be surpassed'
وَرَأْيًا: وَ + رَأْي — wa-, and + raʾy, view, opinion, plan (m., acc. indef.); 'and a view'; the hamza is the print's
أَعْرِضَهُ: أَعْرِضَ + ـهُ — ʿaraḍa, to show, lay before (verb I, subj. 1cs after an) + -hu, it; ʿaraḍa … ʿalā, 'to put (a thing) to (someone)'; 'that I put it (to you)'
الْمُعَامَلَاتِ: الـ + مُعَامَلَات — muʿāmala, dealing, transaction (verbal noun of III ʿāmala), f. pl. muʿāmalāt, gen.; 'the dealings'
أَمْرُهُمَا: أَمْر + ـهُمَا — amr, affair, matter (m., nom., subject of yankashifa) + -humā, the two of them; 'their affair'
لِهَلَاكِي: لِـ + هَلَاك + ـي — li-, for (prep., marking what is caused, after sabab) + halāk, ruin, destruction (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my ruin'
وَهَتْكِ: وَ + هَتْك — wa-, and + hatk, tearing (of a veil), exposure, disgrace (m., verbal noun of hataka, gen.); 'and the tearing of'
وَعِرْضِ: وَ + عِرْض — wa-, and + ʿirḍ, honour, reputation (m., gen.); 'and the honour of'
رَأْيِي: رَأْي + ـِي — raʾy, view, judgement (m., nom., subject of iqtaḍā) + -ī, my; 'my judgement'; the hamza is the print's
وَأُجَهِّزَ: وَ + أُجَهِّزَ — wa-, and + jahhaza, to equip, make ready (verb II, subj. 1cs, still after an); 'and that I make ready'; the shadda is the print's
وَأَتَوَجَّهَ: وَ + أَتَوَجَّهَ — wa-, and + tawajjaha, to turn towards, set out for (verb V, subj. 1cs); 'and that I set out'; takes ilā; the shadda is the print's
وَأُقِيمَ: وَ + أُقِيمَ — wa-, and + aqāma, to stay, reside (verb IV hollow, subj. 1cs); 'and that I stay'; aqāma bi-, 'stay in (a place)'
تَمَكَّنَتِ: تَمَكَّنَتْ — tamakkana, to become firmly established (verb V, perf. 3fs, with linking -i before al-); tamakkana min, 'take firm hold of'; 'took firm hold'
الْمُرَاسَلَةُ: الـ + مُرَاسَلَة — murāsala, exchange of letters, correspondence (f., verbal noun of III rāsala, nom.); 'the correspondence'
الْمَاشِيَ: الـ + مَاشِي — māshī, walking, one who walks (act. part. of mashā, m., acc. after anna); al-māshī baynahumā, 'the one going between them', the go-between
كَاتِمَةٌ: كَاتِمَة — kātima, keeping hidden (act. part. of katama, f. sg., nom. indef., predicate of hiya); takes its object with li-; 'keeping (their secrets)'
لِأَسْرَارِهِمَا: لِـ + أَسْرَار + ـهِمَا — li- (marking the object of the participle kātima, 'keeping') + asrār, secrets (pl. of sirr, gen.) + -himā, the two of them; 'their secrets'
يَغْلِبَ: يَغْلِبَ — ghalaba, to overcome, prevail (verb I, subj. 3ms after an); ghalaba ʿalā, 'get the better of'; 'that (weariness) overcome'
فَتَبُوحَ: فَـ + تَبُوحَ — fa-, and so + bāḥa, to disclose, reveal (verb I hollow, subj. 3fs); bāḥa bi-, 'let out (a secret)'; 'and she let out'
بِسِرِّهِمَا: بِـ + سِرّ + ـهِمَا — bi- (after bāḥa, 'reveal', marking what is revealed) + sirr, secret (m., gen.) + -himā, the two of them; 'their secret'; the shadda is the print's
فَيَشِيعَ: فَـ + يَشِيعَ — fa-, and so + shāʿa, to spread, become public (verb I hollow, subj. 3ms); 'and (their news) spread'
خَبَرُهُمَا: خَبَر + ـهُمَا — khabar, news, story (m., nom., subject of yashīʿa) + -humā, the two of them; 'their story'
وَيُؤَدِّيَ: وَ + يُؤَدِّيَ — wa-, and + addā, to lead, bring (verb II, subj. 3ms); addā ilā, 'lead to'; 'and (that) lead'; the hamza is the print's
لِتَلَفِي: لِـ + تَلَف + ـِي — li-, for (prep., marking what is caused, after sabab) + talaf, perishing, destruction (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'for my destruction'
عُذْرٌ: عُذْر — ʿudhr, excuse, plea (m., nom. indef., subject of laysa); 'an excuse'
خَطِيرٍ: خَطِير — khaṭīr, grave, momentous, dangerous (adj., m. gen. indef., agreeing with khabarin); 'grave'
وَتَخْشَاهُ: وَ + تَخْشَى + ـهُ — wa-, and + khashiya, to dread (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms) + -hu, it; 'and (what) you dread'
وَنَجَّاكَ: وَ + نَجَّى + ـكَ — wa-, and + najjā, to rescue, save (verb II, perf. 3ms, used as a wish) + -ka, you; 'and may He save you'; the shadda is the print's
عُقْبَاهُ: عُقْبَى + ـهُ — ʿuqbā, end, outcome (f.) + -hu, its; mā takhāfu ʿuqbāhu, 'that whose outcome you fear'
مَصَالِحَهُ: مَصَالِح + ـهُ — maṣāliḥ, affairs, business (pl. of maṣlaḥa, acc.) + -hu, his; qaḍā maṣāliḥahu, 'he settled his affairs'
وَيَتَجَهَّزُ: وَ + يَتَجَهَّزُ — wa-, and + tajahhaza, to get oneself ready (verb V, imperf. 3ms, after ṣāra); 'and making himself ready'; the shadda is the print's
لِيَزُورَهُ: لِـ + يَزُورَ + ـهُ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + zāra, to visit (verb I hollow, subj. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'to visit him'
يَجِدْةُ: يَجِدْ + ـةُ — wajada, to find (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam) + -hu, him, spelled with ة (يجدة); 'find him'
جِيرَانَهُ: جِيرَان + ـهُ — jīrān, neighbours (pl. of jār, m.), acc. as object of saʾala + -hu, his; 'his neighbours'
مُعَامَلَاتٍ: مُعَامَلَات — muʿāmalāt, dealings, business transactions (pl. of muʿāmala, verbal noun of III ʿāmala), acc. indef. after anna; 'dealings'
تُجَّارِهَا: تُجَّار + ـهَا — tujjār, merchants (pl. of tājir), gen. after ʿinda + -hā, its (the city, f.); 'its merchants'
لِيُطَالِبَ: لِـ + يُطَالِبَ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + yuṭāliba, ṭālaba, to demand, press for payment (verb III, subj. 3ms); 'to press for payment'
فَاحْتَارَ: فَـ + احْتَارَ — fa-, and so + iḥtāra, to be perplexed, at a loss (verb VIII hollow of ḥāra, perf. 3ms); 'and he was at a loss'
أُفَارِقْ: أُفَارِقْ — ufāriq, fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, jussive 1cs after lam); 'I (had not) left'
دَارَةُ: دَار + ة (for ـهُ) — dār, house (f.), acc. as object of qaṣada + -hu, his (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'his house'
اسْتَأْذِنْ: اسْتَأْذِنْ — istaʾdhin, istaʾdhana, to ask leave (verb X of adhina, imperative 2ms; takes the person asked as object); 'ask leave (of)' Also with fī for the thing leave is asked for: istaʾdhin wālidaka fī annaka takhruju, 'ask your father's leave to go out' (Night 200, where it follows annaka, report running into direct counsel).
سَيِّدَكَ: سَيِّد + ـكَ — sayyid, master (m.), acc. as object of istaʾdhin + -ka, your; 'your master'
دْخُلَ: دْخُلَ — -dkhula, the rest of the verb adkhula, dakhala, to enter (verb I, subj. 1cs after li-), which the print sets apart from its first letter: with لِأَ, li-adkhula, 'that I may enter'
وَأَذِنَ: وَ + أَذِنَ — wa-, and + adhina, to give leave, permit (verb I, perf. 3ms; li- for the person, fī or bi- for the thing permitted); 'and he gave leave'
فَوَجَدَةُ: فَـ + وَجَدَ + ة (for ـهُ) — fa-, and + wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'and he found him'
صَدَاقَةً: صَدَاقَة — ṣadāqa, friendship (f.), acc. indef. after inna; 'friendship'
أُوَدِّعُهُ: أُوَدِّعُ + ـهُ — uwaddiʿu, waddaʿa (verb II, imperf. 1cs), printed with shadda; usually 'to bid farewell', here in the sense of Form IV awdaʿa, 'to entrust (someone) with' + -hu, him; 'I entrust him (with)'
أَسْرَارِى: أَسْرَار + ـى — asrār, secrets (pl. of sirr), acc. as second object + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'my secrets'
أَنْقَطِعُ: أَنْقَطِعُ — anqaṭiʿu, inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off, stay away (verb VII of qaṭaʿa, imperf. 1cs; with ʿan, 'from'); 'I stay away'
الْجِيرَانَ: الـ + جِيرَان — al-, the + jīrān, neighbours (pl. of jār), acc. as object of saʾala; 'the neighbours'
خَبَرَهُ: خَبَر + ـهُ — khabar, news (m.), acc. as second object + -hu, his; 'his news, what has become of him'
التَّعَبُ: الـ + تَعَب — al-, the + taʿab, weariness, toil, distress (m., nom., subject of ḥaṣala); 'the distress'; here subject of ḥalla: fa-ḥalla ʿalaynā al-taʿabu, 'weariness came down on us'
اَبْكِي: اَبْكِي — abkī, bakā, to weep (verb I defective, imperf. 1cs; the verse prints the hamza-seat alif with fatḥa only); 'I weep, I used to weep'
وَاَهْلُ: وَ + اَهْل — wa-, and, while (circumstantial) + ahl, people, family (m., nom.; the verse prints the alif with fatḥa only); 'while the people (of)'
وُدِّي: وُدّ + ـي — wudd, love, affection (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my love'; ahlu wuddī, 'those I love'
جَمِيْعًا: جَمِيْعًا — jamīʿan, all together (acc., adverbial; the verse sets a sukūn on the long ī); 'all together'
اَشْتَاتِ: اَشْتَات — ashtāt, scattered, dispersed (pl. of shatt), gen. after ghayr (the verse prints the alif with fatḥa only); 'scattered'
فَاَبْكِي: فَـ + اَبْكِي — fa-, so + abkī, bakā, to weep (verb I, imperf. 1cs; alif with fatḥa only, as printed); 'so I weep'
الْمَوَدَّاتِ: الـ + مَوَدَّات — al-, the + mawaddāt, affections, loves (pl. of mawadda), gen.; ahl al-mawaddāt, 'the people of affection, my friends'
جِهَةٍ: جِهَة — jiha, direction, quarter, side (f.), gen. after ayy; 'quarter'
فَمَضَي: فَـ + مَضَى — fa-, so + maḍā, to go off, go away (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; the print writes the final alif maqṣūra as a dotted yāʾ); 'so he went off'
عَرَفَتْنِي: عَرَفَتْ + ـنِي — ʿarafat, ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'she recognised me'
ظَرِيفَةً: ظَرِيفَة — ẓarīfa, graceful, elegant, charming (f. of ẓarīf), acc. as second object of wajada; 'graceful'
يُقْسِمُ: يُقْسِمُ — yuqsimu, he swears (verb IV aqsama, impf. 3ms, of q-s-m); 'he swears'
جَوْهَرِيًّا: جَوْهَرِيّ — jawharī, jeweller (m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); from jawhar, jewel, + -ī of trade; 'a jeweller'
لِلْكَلَامِ: لِـ + الـ + كَلَام — li-, for (prep., what a thing is for) + kalām, speech, talking (m., gen.); wajada li-al-kalāmi maḥallan, 'he found room for talking'
وَلَارَيْبَ: وَ + لَا + رَيْب — wa-, and + lā, no (lā of total negation) + rayb, doubt, uncertainty (m., acc. without tanwīn; printed as one word); 'and no doubt'
مُطَالَبَةً: مُطَالَبَة — muṭālaba, demand, claim (f., verbal noun of Form III ṭālaba; acc. indef. after anna); 'a claim'
مُعَامَلَةً: مُعَامَلَة — muʿāmala, dealing, business, transaction (f., verbal noun of Form III ʿāmala; acc. indef. after anna); 'dealings'
أَعْلَمَكَ: أَعْلَمَ + ـكَ — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV of ʿalima, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for the thing made known) + 2ms obj.; 'informed you'
مَعْرِفَتِي: مَعْرِفَة + ـي — maʿrifa, knowledge, acquaintance (f., nom.; takes bi- for the person known) + 1cs; 'my knowing'
ثَمِينًا: ثَمِين — thamīn, precious, costly (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'a costly (one)'
خُشِيَ: خُشِيَ — khushiya, was feared (passive of khashiya, verb I, perf. 3ms); khushiya ʿalayhi, 'it was feared for him'
التَّلَفُ: الـ + تَلَف — talaf, ruin, destruction, death (m., nom.); 'the perishing'
الْجَوْهَرِيُّ: الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — jawharī, jeweller (m., nom.); 'the jeweller'
الْإِلْحَاحَ: الـ + إِلْحَاح — ilḥāḥ, insistence, importunity (m., verbal noun of Form IV alaḥḥa; acc.); 'the insisting'
يَدْخُلُكَ: يَدْخُلُ + ـكَ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, impf. 3ms) + 2ms obj.; 'enters you', i.e. comes into your mind
وَهْمٌ: وَهْم — wahm, notion, fancy; misgiving, suspicion (m., nom. indef.); 'a misgiving'
يَعْتَرِيكَ: يَعْتَرِي + ـكَ — iʿtarā, to befall, come over (verb VIII, impf. 3ms, defective) + 2ms obj.; 'comes over you'
انْقِبَاضٌ: انْقِبَاض — inqibāḍ, contraction; depression of spirit, unease (m., verbal noun of Form VII inqabaḍa; nom. indef.); 'a shrinking (of heart)'
أُخْفِي: أُخْفِي — ukhfī, I hide, conceal (akhfā, verb IV, impf. 1cs, defective); 'I hide'
وَأُبَيِّنُ: وَ + أُبَيِّنُ — wa-, and + ubayyinu, I make clear, explain (bayyana, verb II, impf. 1cs); 'and I make clear'
حَمَلَنِي: حَمَلَ + ـنِي — ḥamala, to carry; with ʿalā, to drive, induce (someone) to (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'drove me'
تَكْشِفُ: تَكْشِفُ — kashafa, to uncover, lay bare (verb I, impf. 3fs; here with al-nās as a feminine singular subject); 'uncover'
أَسْتَارَ: أَسْتَار — astār, veils, curtains (pl. of sitr; acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'the veils of'
بَعْضِهَا: بَعْض + ـهَا — baʿḍ, some, part (m., gen.) + 3fs (referring to al-nās); astāra baʿḍihā, 'one another's veils'; here also referring to asnān, 'teeth': ishtabakat asnānuhu fī baʿḍihā, 'his teeth locked into one another'
وَغَيْرَتِي: وَ + غَيْرَة + ـي — wa-, and + ghayra, jealousy, protective zeal (f.; with ʿalā for the one cared for) + 1cs; 'and my zeal (for you)'
وَشَفَقَتِي: وَ + شَفَقَة + ـي — wa-, and + shafaqa, pity, anxious concern (f.; with ʿalā for the one pitied) + 1cs; 'and my pity'
عَسَي: عَسَى — ʿasā, perhaps, it may be that (defective verb of hope; the print writes it with final ي); here followed by an imperfect without an
بُعْدِهِ: بُعْد + ـهِ — buʿd, distance, being far away (m., gen. after baʿda) + 3ms; 'his going far'
لَكَذَّبَنِيْ: لَـ + كَذَّبَ + ـنِي — la-, then surely (opening the answer of law) + kadhdhaba, to call a liar, give the lie to (verb II, perf. 3ms) + 1cs obj.; 'would give me the lie'
دَمْعِيْ: دَمْع + ـي — damʿ, tears (m. collective, nom.) + 1cs; 'my tears'
نَحِيْبِيْ: نَحِيب + ـي — naḥīb, loud weeping, wailing (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my wailing'
اُدَارِيْ: أُدَارِي — udārī, I conceal, dissemble; humour (dārā, verb III, impf. 1cs, defective; the print writes the hamza-less alif with a damma); 'I hide'
مَدْمَعًا: مَدْمَع — madmaʿ, place where tears flow; a flow of tears (m., acc. indef.); 'a tear-flow'
جَرَيَانُهُ: جَرَيَان + ـهُ — jarayān, running, flowing (m., verbal noun of jarā; nom.) + 3ms; 'its running'
صَحْنِ: صَحْن — ṣaḥn, open space, expanse; ṣaḥn al-khadd, the smooth plane of the cheek (m., gen.); 'the expanse of'
خَدِّيْ: خَدّ + ـي — khadd, cheek (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my cheek'
حَبِيْبِيْ: حَبِيب + ـي — ḥabīb, beloved (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'my beloved'
لِلْجَوْهَرِيِّ: لِـ + الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — li-, to (prep.; after qāla it marks the one spoken to) + al-, the + jawharī, jeweller (m., gen.); 'to the jeweller'; here: after khuyyila, li- marks the one to whom it seems: 'it seemed to the jeweller'
أَتَدْرِي: أَ + تَدْرِي — a-, question prefix + tadrī, you know (darā, verb I final-weak, imperf. 2ms); 'do you know?'
سَٰرَّتْنِي: سَارَّ + ـتْ + ـنِي — sārra, to speak secretly to, confide in (verb III, perf. 3fs; the print omits the long ā, marked here with a dagger alif; takes bi- for the thing confided) + -nī, me; 'she confided to me'; the print's سرّتني could also be read sarratnī, 'she gladdened me'
زَعَمَتْ: زَعَمَ + ـتْ — zaʿama, to claim, allege, often of a claim thought untrue (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she claimed'
أَشَرْتُ: أَشَارَ + ـتُ — ashāra, to point out, advise (verb IV hollow, perf. 1cs); ashāra ʿalā X bi-Y, 'advise X to do Y': ʿalā marks the one advised, bi- the course advised; 'I advised'
وَأَنَّنِي: وَ + أَنَّ + ـنِي — wa-, and + anna, that + -nī, I (1cs suffix, with the extra n); 'and that I'
الْمُرَاسَلَةِ: الـ + مُرَاسَلَة — murāsala, exchanging letters, correspondence (f., verbal noun of III rāsala; gen.); 'the correspondence'
وَتُصْغِي: وَ + تُصْغِي — wa-, and + tuṣghī, she lends an ear (aṣghā, verb IV final-weak, imperf. 3fs; takes ilā, 'listen to'); 'and she listened (to)'
وَاطَّلَعْتُ: وَ + اطَّلَعَ + ـتُ — wa-, and + iṭṭalaʿa, to learn of, become acquainted with (verb VIII of ṭalaʿa; takes ʿalā for what one learns of; perf. 1cs); 'and I learned of'
مُرَادِكَ: مُرَاد + ـكَ — murād, what is wished for, desire (m., pass. part. of IV arāda; gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your; 'your desire'
تَنْفِرُ: تَنْفِرُ — nafara, to shy, take fright and bolt (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'she shies away'
كَوَحْشِ: كَـ + وَحْش — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + waḥsh, wild beasts (m. coll., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the wild beasts (of)'
الْفَلَاةِ: الـ + فَلَاة — falāt, open desert, waterless waste (f., gen.); 'the desert'
جُهْدِي: جُهْد + ـي — juhd, effort, utmost (m.) + -ī, my; 'my effort'
مُسَاعَدَتِكَ: مُسَاعَدَة + ـكَ — musāʿada, helping, aid (f., verbal noun of III sāʿada; gen. after fī) + -ka, you (the one helped); 'helping you'
وَاحْتِيَالِي: وَ + احْتِيَال + ـي — wa-, and + iḥtiyāl, contriving, use of stratagem (m., verbal noun of VIII iḥtāla, root of ḥīla) + -ī, my; 'and my contriving'
التَّوَصُّلِ: الـ + تَوَصُّل — tawaṣṣul, finding a way, gaining access (m., verbal noun of V tawaṣṣala; takes ilā; gen. after fī); 'reaching'
سِتْرٍ: سِتْر — sitr, veil, curtain, covering (m., gen. indef.); kashf sitr, 'lifting a veil', exposure
مَضَرَّةٍ: مَضَرَّة — maḍarra, harm, injury (f., gen. indef.); 'harm'
اسْتَأْذَنَهُ: اسْتَأْذَنَ + ـهُ — istaʾdhana, to ask leave of (verb X of adhina, perf. 3ms; fī marks what leave is asked for) + -hu, him (the one asked); 'he asked his leave'
الِانْصِرَافِ: الـ + انْصِرَاف — inṣirāf, going away, departure (m., verbal noun of VII inṣarafa; gen.); 'departing'
الْجَوْهَرِيَّ: الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — al-, the + jawharī, jeweller (m., acc. after anna); 'the jeweller'
إِسْعَافِ: إِسْعَاف — isʿāf, helping, granting someone what he needs (m., verbal noun of IV asʿafa; gen. after fī, first term of iḍāfa); 'the helping of'
عُنْوَانَهَا: عُنْوَان + هَا — ʿunwān, address, superscription of a letter (m., acc., object of naẓara) + -hā, its (f., the waraqa); 'its address'
الْأَصْغَرِ: الـ + أَصْغَر — al-, the + aṣghar, smaller, lesser (elative of ṣaghīr; m., gen., adjective of al-muḥibb); 'the lesser'
يَطْمَعُنِيْ: يَطْمَعُ + نِيْ — yaṭmaʿu, as printed the simple verb ṭamiʿa, to covet, hope for (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; the sense wants yuṭmiʿunī (IV aṭmaʿa), 'making me hope'; verse pointing with sukūn on the long ī
اَكْثَرُ: أَكْثَر — akthar, most, the greater part (elative of kathīr; m., nom., subject of kāna, first term of iḍāfa); printed with bare alif; 'most of'
ظَنّيْ: ظَنّ + ـيْ — ẓann, opinion, belief, supposition (m., gen.) + -ī, my; verse pointing with sukūn on the long ī; 'my belief'
وَهَمَا: وَهَم — waham, for wahm, fancy, delusion (m., acc. indef. as predicate; the h takes a vowel for the metre and the rhyme lengthens the ending to -ā); 'a delusion'
زَادَنِيْ: زَادَ + نِيْ — zāda, to increase (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; takes two objects, the person and what is added) + -nī, me; 'it increased me (in)'
حُزُنًا: حُزُن — ḥuzun, for ḥuzn, grief, sorrow (m., acc. indef., second object of zāda; the extra vowel is for the metre); 'in grief'
عِلْمِيْ: عِلْم + ـيْ — ʿilm, knowing, knowledge (m., nom., subject of zāda; with bi-, knowledge of) + -ī, my; 'my knowing'
رَسُوْلِيْ: رَسُول + ـيْ — rasūl, messenger (m., acc. after anna) + -ī, my; verse pointing with sukūn on the long vowels; 'my messenger'
فَهِمَا: فَهِمَ — fahima, to understand (verb I, perf. 3ms; the rhyme lengthens the final -a to -ā); after lam yakun, 'had understood'
صَدَرَ: صَدَرَ — ṣadara, to issue, come forth (verb I, perf. 3ms); with min, 'to be done by'; 'issued'
الْجَفَاءُ: الـ + جَفَاء — al-, the + jafāʾ, harshness, coldness, estrangement (m., nom.); 'the unkindness'
أُقَابِلُهُ: أُقَابِلُ + هُ — uqābilu, I meet, requite (verb III qābala, imperf. 1cs; with bi- for what it is met with) + -hu, it; 'I meet it'
بِالْوَفَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + وَفَاء — bi-, with (prep.; qābala bi-, 'to meet with, requite with', bi- marking what one answers with) + al-, the + wafāʾ, faithfulness, keeping faith (m., gen.); 'with faithfulness'
الْوِدَادُ: الـ + وِدَاد — al-, the + widād, love, affection (m., nom.); 'the affection'
الْوُدَّ: الـ + وُدّ — al-, the + wudd, love, affection (m., acc.); 'the love'
تِهْ: تِهْ — tih, be haughty! (imperative 2ms of tāha/yatīhu, hollow verb I, to be proud, disdainful)
اَحْتَمِلْ: أَحْتَمِلْ — aḥtamil, I bear, endure (verb VIII iḥtamala, jussive 1cs, answering the preceding imperative); printed with bare alif; 'I will bear it'
وَاسْتَطلْ: وَ + اِسْتَطِلْ — wa-, and + istaṭil, act overbearingly, lord it over (imperative 2ms of X istaṭāla, hollow); the print leaves the ṭāʾ unvowelled; 'and domineer!'
اَصْبِرْ: أَصْبِرْ — aṣbir, I am patient, endure (verb I ṣabara, jussive 1cs, answering the imperative); printed with bare alif; 'I will be patient'
أهُنْ: أَهُنْ — ahun, I am humbled, made lowly (verb I hāna/yahūnu, hollow, jussive 1cs, answering the imperative); the hamza is the print's own; 'I will be lowly'
وَوَلِّ: وَ + وَلِّ — wa-, and + walli, turn away! (imperative 2ms of II wallā, defective); 'and turn your back!'
اَقْبَلْ: أَقْبَلْ — aqbal, jussive 1cs answering the imperative walli (printed with bare alif): as pointed it is from qabila, 'I accept'; IV aqbala, 'I come forward', would be uqbil; 'I come to you / I accept'
اَسْمَعْ: أَسْمَعْ — asmaʿ, I listen, hear (verb I samiʿa, jussive 1cs, answering the imperative); printed with bare alif; 'I will listen'
وَمُرْ: وَ + مُرْ — wa-, and + mur, command! (imperative 2ms of amara/yaʾmuru, which drops its hamza in the imperative); 'and command!'
اُطِعِ: أُطِعِ — uṭiʿi, I obey (verb IV aṭāʿa, hollow, jussive 1cs; the kasra is added for the rhyme); printed with bare alif; 'I will obey'
الْجَوْهَرِيِّ: الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — al-, the + jawharī, jeweller (m., gen.); 'of / to the jeweller'
وَمَشَتِ: وَ + مَشَتِ — wa-, and + mashat, she walked (verb I mashā, perf. 3fs; kasra before the following article); 'and (she) walked'
سَقَطَتْ: سَقَطَتْ — saqaṭat, she/it fell, dropped (verb I saqaṭa, perf. 3fs); with min, 'fell from'
تَخَافِي: تَخَافِي — takhāfī, you fear (verb I khāfa, hollow, jussive 2fs after prohibitive lā); 'do not fear'
وَلَاتَحْزَنِي: وَ + لَا + تَحْزَنِي — wa-, and + lā, not (prohibitive) + taḥzanī, you grieve (verb I ḥazina, jussive 2fs); printed run together; 'and do not grieve'
سَتَّارٌ: سَتَّار — sattār, one who covers much, veiler of faults (intensive faʿʿāl of satara, to cover; m., nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'a coverer'
السَّتْرَ: الـ + سَتْر — al-, the + satr, covering, concealing (m., verbal noun of satara; acc.); 'the covering (of faults)'
كَتُومٌ: كَتُوم — katūm, close, good at keeping secrets (intensive faʿūl of katama, to hide; m., nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'a keeper (of secrets)'
أُحَلِّفُكِ: أُحَلِّفُ + كِ — uḥallifu, I make (someone) swear (verb II ḥallafa, imperf. 1cs) + -ki, you (f.); 'I make you swear'
لَاتُخْفِي: لَا + تُخْفِي — lā, not + tukhfī, you hide (verb IV akhfā, imperf. 2fs, Middle Arabic for tukhfīna); printed run together; 'you will not hide'
يُعِينَنِي: يُعِينَ + نِي — yuʿīna, he helps (verb IV aʿāna, hollow, subj. 3ms after an; with ʿalā for the task) + -nī, me; '(that) he help me'
قَضَاءِ: قَضَاء — qaḍāʾ, accomplishing, fulfilling (m., verbal noun of qaḍā; gen. after ʿalā, first term of iḍāfa); the hamza is the print's own; 'the fulfilling of'
أَغْرَاضِهَا: أَغْرَاض + هَا — aghrāḍ, aims, wishes (pl. of gharaḍ; gen.) + -hā, her; 'her aims'
حَافِظُهُ: حَافِظ + هُ — ḥāfiẓ, keeper, guardian (act. part. of ḥafiẓa; m., nom., predicate) + -hu, it; 'its keeper'
وَلَاخَابَ: وَ + لَا + خَابَ — wa-, and + lā, not (with the perfect, a general denial) + khāba, to fail, come to nothing (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms); printed run together; 'and never fails'
قَضَائِهِ: قَضَاء + هِ — qaḍāʾ, accomplishing, bringing about (m., verbal noun; gen. after fī) + -hi, its; the hamza on its seat is the print's own; 'its accomplishment'; here qaḍāʾ, God's decree (gen. after min) + -hi, His: lā mafarra min qaḍāʾihi, 'no escape from His decree'
وَأَعْطِنِى: وَ + أَعْطِ + نِى — wa-, and + aʿṭi, give! (imperative 2ms of IV aʿṭā) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'and give me'
شَهِيدٌ: شَهِيد — shahīd, witness (m., nom. indef., predicate; with ʿalā, 'witness of'); 'a witness'
بِأَصْلِ: بِـ + أَصْل — bi-, of (prep.; ʿilm bi-, 'knowledge of', bi- marking what is known) + aṣl, root, origin (m., gen.); 'of the origin'
حَدَّثَهَا: حَدَّثَ + هَا — ḥaddatha, to tell, relate to (verb II, perf. 3ms; takes bi- for the tale) + -hā, her; 'he told her'
ضَمِيرَهُ: ضَمِير + هُ — ḍamīr, inmost thought, what one hides in the heart (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his inner mind'
وَتُعْطِيهَا: وَ + تُعْطِي + هَا — wa-, and + tuʿṭī, she gives (verb IV aʿṭā, imperf. 3fs) + -hā, it (the letter); 'and she gives it'
وَبِجَمِيعِ: وَ + بِـ + جَمِيع — wa-, and + bi-, of (prep.; fronted from akhbara bi-, 'tell of', and resumed by bihi) + jamīʿ, all (m., gen.); 'and (of) all'
مَايَجْرِي: مَا + يَجْرِي — mā, what, that which (rel. pron.) + yajrī, it happens (verb I jarā, to run, happen; imperf. 3ms); printed run together; 'what happens'
وَتُخْبِرُهُ: وَ + تُخْبِرُ + هُ — wa-, and + tukhbiru, she tells (verb IV akhbara, imperf. 3fs; takes bi- for what is told) + -hu, him; 'and she tells him'
وَخَتَمَتْهَا: وَ + خَتَمَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + khatamat, she sealed (verb I khatama, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it; 'and she sealed it'
مَخْتُومَةً: مَخْتُومَة — makhtūma, sealed (pass. part. of khatama; f., acc. indef., ḥāl); 'sealed'
جَوَابَهَا: جَوَاب + هَا — jawāb, answer, reply (m., acc.) + -hā, its (the letter's); 'its answer'
وَرَقَةَ: وَرَقَة — waraqa, paper, letter (f., acc., object, first term of iḍāfa); 'a paper of'
وَفَضَّ: وَ + فَضَّ — wa-, and + faḍḍa, to break open (a seal) (verb I geminate, perf. 3ms); 'and he broke'
خَتْمَهَا: خَتْم + هَا — khatm, seal (m., acc.) + -hā, its; 'its seal'
الرَّسُوْلَ: الـ + رَسُول — al-, the + rasūl, messenger (m., acc. after inna; verse spelling with sukūn on the long vowel); 'the messenger'
رَسَائِلُنَا: رَسَائِل + ـنَا — rasāʾil, letters (pl. of risāla, nom., subject of kānat) + -nā, our; 'our letters'
مَكْتُوْمَةٌ: مَكْتُومَة — maktūma, hidden, kept secret (passive participle of katama, f. sg. agreeing with the plural rasāʾil; printed nominative where the predicate of kānat would be acc.); 'kept hidden'
غَضَبَا: غَضِبَ — ghaḍiba, to be angry (verb I, perf. 3ms; printed with fatḥa on the ḍād, ghaḍaba, and the final -ā of the rhyme); 'he has grown angry'
فَاسْتَخْلِصُوْا: فَـ + اسْتَخْلِصُوا — fa-, so + istakhliṣū, pick out, choose (as one's own) (verb X of kh-l-ṣ, imperative 2mp); 'so choose'
الِيْ: إِلَيَّ — ilā, to, for (prep.) + 1cs; printed الِيْ, read ilī, for Classical ilayya; 'for me'
رَسُوْلاً: رَسُول — rasūl, messenger (m., acc. indef., object of istakhliṣū); 'a messenger'
ثِقَةً: ثِقَة — thiqa, trustworthy (person), reliable (noun used as adj., acc. agreeing with rasūlan); 'trustworthy'
يَسْتَحْسِنُ: يَسْتَحْسِنُ — istaḥsana, to find good, approve of (verb X of ḥ-s-n, imperf. 3ms); 'he approves'
الْكَذِبَا: الـ + كَذِب — al-, the + kadhib, lying, falsehood (m., acc.; the final -ā is the lengthened vowel of the rhyme); 'the lie'
بِخِيَانَةٍ: بِـ + خِيَانَة — bi-, with (prep., chosen by atā: atā bi- 'to bring, to commit') + khiyāna, treachery, betrayal (f., gen.); 'a betrayal' (as what is committed)
ضَيَّعْتُ: ضَيَّعَ + تُ — ḍayyaʿa, to lose, waste, let perish (verb II of ḍ-y-ʿ, perf.) + -tu, I; 'I have lost'
يَصْدُرْ: يَصْدُرْ — ṣadara, to issue, proceed (from) (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam); 'it (has not) issued'
جَفَاءٌ: جَفَاء — jafāʾ, harshness, coldness, estrangement (m., nom. indef.); 'harshness'
وَفَاءً: وَفَاء — wafāʾ, faithfulness, keeping faith (m., acc. indef.); 'faithfulness'
