نَقَضْتُ: نَقَضَ + تُ — naqaḍa, to break (a pledge), undo (verb I, perf.) + -tu, I; 'I have broken'
وُدًّا: وُدّ — wudd, love, affection (m., acc. indef.); 'love'
تَلَفًا: تَلَف — talaf, ruin, perdition (m., acc. indef.); 'ruin'
أَصْلًا: أَصْلًا — aṣl, root, origin (m.), in the acc. as an adverb strengthening a negative; 'at all'
أَحْبَبْتُمْ: أَحَبَّ + تُمْ — aḥabba, to love (verb IV of ḥ-b-b, perf.; the doubled root split before the consonant ending) + -tum, you (m. pl.); 'you loved'
عَالِمِ: عَالِم — ʿālim, knower (active participle of ʿalima, m., gen., first term of a construct); 'the Knower of'
وَالنَّجْوَى: وَ + الـ + نَجْوَى — wa-, and + al-, the + najwā, private talk, whispered confidence (f.); 'and the whispered talk'
أَهْوَى: أَهْوَى — hawiya, to love, be passionately fond of (verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'I love'
وَشَأْنِي: وَ + شَأْن + ـي — wa-, and + shaʾn, affair, way, habit (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my way'
أَمْرَضَنِى: أَمْرَضَ + ـنِى — amraḍa, to make ill (verb IV of m-r-ḍ, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'it has made me ill'
تَخْرُجْ: تَخْرُجْ — kharaja, to go out (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive after prohibitive lā); 'do not go out'
تَنْتَظِرُ: تَنْتَظِرُ — intaẓara, to wait for, await (verb VIII of n-ẓ-r, imperf. 3fs); 'she is waiting for'
مُشَوَّشَ: مُشَوَّش — mushawwash, confused, disturbed (passive participle of shawwasha, II; m., acc. as predicate of bāta, first term of a construct); 'troubled (of)'
قُدُومَهَا: قُدُوم + ـهَا — qudūm, arrival, coming (m., verbal noun of qadima, acc.) + -hā, her; 'her arrival'
قَرَأَتْهَا: قَرَأَتْ + ـهَا — qaraʾa, to read (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, it (the note); 'she read it'
مَعْنَاهَا: مَعْنَى + ـهَا — maʿnā, meaning (m., acc.) + -hā, its; 'its meaning'
حَارَتْ: حَارَتْ — ḥāra, to be bewildered, perplexed (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'she was at a loss'
فِكْرِهَا: فِكْر + ـهَا — fikr, thought, mind (m., gen. after fī) + -hā, her; 'her thought'
تَخْشَيْ: تَخْشَيْ — khashiya, to fear (verb I final-weak, imperf. 2fs jussive after prohibitive lā, -īna dropped); 'do not fear'
فَسَادِ: فَسَاد — fasād, spoiling, going wrong, corruption (m., gen. after min, first term of a construct); 'the spoiling of'
وَأَعْلَى: وَ + أَعْلَى — wa-, and + aʿlā, higher (elative of ʿālī/ʿaliya); 'and higher'
تَوَصَّلْتُ: تَوَصَّلَ + تُ — tawaṣṣala, to find one's way, gain access (verb V of w-ṣ-l, with ilā) + -tu, I; 'I made my way'
الرُّقْعَةُ: الـ + رُقْعَة — al-, the + ruqʿa, note, scrap of writing (f., nom., subject); 'the note'
تُؤَكِّدَ: تُؤَكِّدَ — akkada, to confirm, make binding; with ʿalā, to press upon, insist (verb II of ʾ-k-d, imperf. 3fs subjunctive after an); 'that she may make binding'
الْعُهُودِ: الـ + عُهُود — al-, the + ʿuhūd, pledges, covenants (pl. of ʿahd, gen. after min); 'the pledges'
رَأٰةُ: رَأَى + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; printed رأة, with ة for the pronoun ه and the long ā unwritten (for رآه); 'he saw it'
وَخَطَرًا: وَ + خَطَر — wa-, and + khaṭar, danger, peril (m., acc. indef.); 'and a danger'
جَسِيمًا: جَسِيم — jasīm, grave, weighty (adj., m., acc. indef.); 'grave'
التَّهَجُّمُ: الـ + تَهَجُّم — al-, the + tahajjum, rushing in, rash venturing (verbal noun of tahajjama, V; nom., with ʿalā); 'rushing upon'
الْعَوَامِّ: الـ + عَوَامّ — al-, the + ʿawāmm, common people (pl. of ʿāmma; gen.); 'the commoners'
كَأَبِى: كَـ + أَبِى — ka-, like (prep.) + abī, genitive of abū, father (of), in the name Abū al-Ḥasan (printed with ى); 'like Abū (al-Ḥasan)'
رَفِيعَ: رَفِيع — rafīʿ, high, lofty (adj., m., acc. as predicate of kāna, first term of a construct); 'high (of)'
الْمِقْدَارِ: الـ + مِقْدَار — al-, the + miqdār, measure; standing, rank (m., gen.); 'of rank'
بِالِاشْتِهَارِ: بِـ + الـ + اشْتِهَار — bi-, for (prep., marking what one is known for, after maʿrūf) + al-, the + ishtihār, renown, being well known (verbal noun of VIII of sh-h-r, gen.); 'for (his) renown'
مُتَرّدِّدًا: مُتَرَدِّد — mutaraddid, going to and fro, frequenting (active participle of taraddada, V, with ʿalā 'to visit regularly'; m., acc.); printed مترّددا, with the shadda on the rāʾ; 'a regular visitor (at)'
لِاحْتِيَاجِهِمْ: لِـ + احْتِيَاج + ـهِمْ — li-, because of (prep. of cause) + iḥtiyāj, need (verbal noun of VIII of ḥ-w-j, with ilā; gen.) + -him, their; 'because of their need'
بِضَاعَتِهِ: بِضَاعَة + ـهِ — biḍāʿa, goods, wares (f., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his wares'
يُحَدِّثُنِي: يُحَدِّثُ + ـنِي — ḥaddatha, to talk to, tell (verb II, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he talks to me'
أَرْتَعِدُ: أَرْتَعِدُ — irtaʿada, to tremble, shudder (verb VIII of r-ʿ-d, imperf. 1cs); 'I tremble'
سَيِّدَتُكِ: سَيِّدَة + ـكِ — sayyida, mistress (f., nom.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your mistress'
رَغِبَتْ: رَغِبَتْ — raghiba, to desire (with fī) (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she desired'
يُطَاوِعُنِي: يُطَاوِعُ + ـنِي — ṭāwaʿa, to obey, go along with (verb III of ṭ-w-ʿ, imperf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'it goes along with me'
مَاتَقُولِينَ: مَا + تَقُولِينَ — mā, what (rel.) + taqūlīna, you (f.) say (qāla, verb I hollow, imperf. 2fs); printed as one word; 'what you say'
وَلَاتَخْشَ: وَ + لَا + تَخْشَ — wa-, and + lā, do not (prohibitive) + takhsha, khashiya, to fear (verb I final-weak, imperf. 2ms jussive, final vowel shortened); printed as one word; 'and do not dread'
ضَرَرٍ: ضَرَر — ḍarar, harm, injury (m., gen. after min); 'harm'
وَكَرَّرَتْ: وَ + كَرَّرَتْ — wa-, and + karrara, to repeat (verb II of k-r-r, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, to someone); 'and she repeated'
فَهَمَّ: فَـ + هَمَّ — fa-, so + hamma, to be about to, set out to (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; with an); 'so he made to'
فَانْثَنَتْ: فَـ + انْثَنَتْ — fa-, and then + inthanā, to bend, fold, give way (verb VII of th-n-y, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the f. dual rijlāhu); 'and (his legs) gave way'
وَارْتَعَشَتْ: وَ + ارْتَعَشَتْ — wa-, and + irtaʿasha, to tremble, shake (verb VIII of r-ʿ-sh, perf. 3fs); 'and (his hands) shook'
حَاشَ: حَاشَ — ḥāsha, far be it! (particle of exclusion and protest; ḥāsha Allāhi / ḥāsha li-llāhi, 'God forbid')
الْجَارِيَهُ: الـ + جَارِيَة — al-, the + jāriya, slave-girl (f., nom.; printed with ه for ة); 'the slave-girl'
اطْمَئِنَّ: اطْمَئِنَّ — iṭmaʾanna, to be calm, at rest (quadriliteral verb IV, imperative 2ms); 'be at rest'
يَصْعُبُ: يَصْعُبُ — ṣaʿuba, to be hard, difficult (with ʿalā, for someone) (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'it is hard'
وَلَايُمْكِنُكَ: وَ + لَا + يُمْكِنُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + lā, not + yumkinu, it is possible (amkana, verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -ka, for you (2ms obj.); printed as one word; 'and it is not possible for you'
أَجْعَلُهَا: أَجْعَلُ + ـهَا — jaʿala, to make (someone do; with a following imperfect) (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I will make her'
تَسِيرُ: تَسِيرُ — sāra, to go, travel (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs); 'she goes'
فَلَاتَبْرَحْ: فَـ + لَا + تَبْرَحْ — fa-, so + lā, do not (prohibitive) + tabraḥ, bariḥa, to leave, quit (a place) (verb I, imperf. 2ms jussive); printed as one word; 'so do not leave'
كَبِيرَةِ: كَبِيرَة — kabīra, great, big (f. adj., gen., first term of an adjectival iḍāfa); kabīrat al-sinn, 'great of age, old'
تَخْلُ: تَخْلُ — printed so (تخل), joined by مني; no sense as it stands; possibly read takhlu, from khalā, 'to be alone' (verb I, imperf. 3fs, form uncertain); probably a misprint for تَخْدُمُنِي, takhdumunī, 'who serves me'
جَارِيَةِ: جَارِيَة — jāriya, slave-girl, maid (f., gen., first term of iḍāfa); jāriyat al-jawharī, 'the jeweller's slave-woman'
فَأَعْبَقَتِ: فَـ + أَعْبَقَتْ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿbaqa, to fill with fragrance, perfume (verb IV of ʿabiqa, 'to cling, of a scent'; perf. 3fs, with kasra before al-); 'and she filled with fragrance'
مَرْتَبَةً: مَرْتَبَة — martaba, mattress, floor seat (f., acc. indef.); 'a mattress'
وَمِخَدَّةً: وَ + مِخَدَّة — wa-, and + mikhadda, cushion, pillow (f., acc. indef.); 'and a cushion'
فَخُيِّلَ: فَـ + خُيِّلَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + khuyyila, it was made to seem (verb II khayyala, passive perf. 3ms; with li- of the person, 'it seemed to'); 'and it seemed'
وَدُعَاءٍ: وَ + دُعَاء — wa-, and + duʿāʾ, prayer, invocation (m., gen. indef., still governed by the bi- of bi-khayrin); 'and (in) prayer'
حَيَاتِكِ: حَيَاة + ـكِ — ḥayāt, life (f., gen.) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your life'
حَمَلْتَنَا: حَمَلْتَ + ـنَا — ḥamala, to carry; with ʿalā, to bring (someone) to, induce (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -nā, us; 'you induced us'
نُطْلِعَكَ: نُطْلِعَ + ـكَ — aṭlaʿa, to let see, acquaint (verb IV, subjunctive 1pl after an; with ʿalā of the thing shown) + -ka, you; 'that we acquaint you'
سَأَلَتْهُ: سَأَلَتْ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3fs; hamza printed in the edition) + -hu, him; with ʿan of the thing asked about; 'she asked him'
وَعِيَالِهِ: وَ + عِيَال + ـهِ — wa-, and + ʿiyāl, dependants, household (wife and children; coll., gen.) + -hi, his; 'and his household'
فَكَشَفَ: فَـ + كَشَفَ — fa-, and so + kashafa, to uncover (verb I, perf. 3ms); with ʿan, 'reveal, lay open'; 'and he laid open'
جَعَلْتُهَا: جَعَلْتُ + ـهَا — jaʿala, to make, set (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, it (f., the house); with li-, 'set aside for'; 'I made it'
لِلِاجْتِمَاعِ: لِـ + الـ + اِجْتِمَاع — li-, for (prep. of purpose) + al-, the + ijtimāʿ, meeting, gathering (verbal noun VIII of jamaʿa; gen.); 'for meeting'
بِالْأَصْحَابِ: بِـ + الـ + أَصْحَاب — bi-, with (prep.; after ijtimāʿ it marks the people met) + al-, the + aṣḥāb, companions, friends (pl. of ṣāḥib; gen.); 'with the friends'
وَالْإِخْوَانِ: وَ + الـ + إِخْوَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ikhwān, brothers, close friends (pl. of akh; gen.); 'and the brothers'
لِجَارِيَتِكِ: لِـ + جَارِيَة + ـكِ — li-, to (prep.; marks the one spoken to) + jāriya, slave-girl (f., gen.) + -ki, your (2fs); 'to your slave-girl'
كَيْفِيَّةِ: كَيْفِيَّة — kayfiyya, manner, how (f., abstract noun from kayfa, 'how?'; gen. after ʿan, first term of iḍāfa); 'the manner of'
اطِّلَاعِهِ: اطِّلَاع + ـهِ — iṭṭilāʿ, coming to know, being informed (verbal noun VIII of ṭalaʿa; with ʿalā of what is learned; gen.; initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl) + -hi, his; 'his coming to know'
بِمَاخَطَرَ: بِـ + مَا + خَطَرَ — bi-, of (prep.; chosen by akhbara, 'to tell', marking what is told) + mā, what (rel. pron.) + khaṭara, to occur (to the mind) (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'of what occurred'
بِبَالِهِ: بِـ + بَال + ـهِ — bi-, in, at (prep.; chosen by khaṭara, 'to occur to') + bāl, mind (m., gen.) + -hi, his; khaṭara bi-bālihi, 'it came into his mind'
السَّفَرِفَتَأَوَّهَتْ: الـ + سَفَر + فَـ + تَأَوَّهَتْ — al-, the + safar, journey (m., gen. after ʿalā) + fa-, and so + taʾawwaha, to sigh, say 'āh' (verb V, perf. 3fs; the shadda is printed in the edition); printed as one word; 'the journey; and she sighed'
أَرْوَاحَ: أَرْوَاح — arwāḥ, spirits, souls (pl. of rūḥ; acc. after anna, first term of iḍāfa); 'the souls of'
مُتَلَائِمَةٌ: مُتَلَائِمَة — mutalāʾima, agreeing, suited to one another (f. sing. agreeing with a broken plural; act. part. VI of laʾama; nom. indef., predicate of anna; hamza printed in the edition); 'in accord'
الشَّهَوَاتِ: الـ + شَهَوَات — al-, the + shahawāt, desires, appetites (pl. of shahwa; gen. after fī); 'the desires'
لَايَتِمُّ: لَا + يَتِمُّ — lā, not (neg.) + yatimmu, it is completed, comes about (tamma, verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'is not completed'
عَمَلٌ: عَمَل — ʿamal, deed, work, action (m., nom. indef.); 'a deed'
بِسَعْيٍ: بِـ + سَعْي — bi-, by (prep. of means) + saʿy, striving, effort (m., gen. indef.); 'by striving' (the print has بصعي, a misprint, corrected)
وَلَاتَحْصُلُ: وَ + لَا + تَحْصُلُ — wa-, and + lā, not + taḥṣulu, it comes about, is obtained (ḥaṣala, verb I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with rāḥa); printed as one word; 'and does not come about'
نَجَاحٌ: نَجَاح — najāḥ, success (m., nom. indef., subject of yaẓharu); 'success'
مُرُوَّةٍ: مُرُوَّة — murūwa, manliness, chivalry, generous honour (f., gen. indef. after dhī; the shadda is printed); 'manly virtue'
أَطْلَعْتُكَ: أَطْلَعَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — aṭlaʿa ʿalā, to let (someone) see, acquaint (him) with (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + 2ms object; 'I have acquainted you'
هَتْكُنَا: هَتْك + ـنَا — hatk, tearing (of a veil), exposure, disgrace (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'our exposure'
وَسَتْرُنَا: وَ + سَتْر + ـنَا — wa-, and + satr, veiling, covering, keeping hidden (m., nom.) + 1cp; 'and our protection'
زِيَادَةَ: زِيَادَة — ziyāda, increase, addition (f., acc. without tanwīn after the lā that denies a whole class); lā ziyādata li-, 'there is no adding to' Also 'excess', acc. as object in construct: shakā … ziyādata ḥubbihi lahu, 'complained of the excess of his love for him'.
لِسِرِّي: لِـ + سِرّ + ـي — li-, of (marking the object of the participle kātima) + sirr, secret (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'of my secret' (the shadda is printed)
رُتْبَةٌ: رُتْبَة — rutba, rank, standing (f., nom. indef.); 'a rank'
اخْتَصَصْتُهَا: اخْتَصَّ + ـتُ + ـهَا — ikhtaṣṣa li-, to single out, set apart for (verb VIII, perf. 1cs, the doubled ṣād written out before the ending) + 3fs object; 'I have singled her out'
لِمُهِمَّاتِ: لِـ + مُهِمَّات — li-, for (purpose) + muhimmāt, important matters (f. pl. of muhimma, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'for the weighty matters of'
وَأَطْلِعْهَا: وَ + أَطْلِعْ + ـهَا — wa-, and + aṭliʿ, inform, let see (imper. 2ms of aṭlaʿa, verb IV) + 3fs object; 'and acquaint her (with)'
آمِنٌ: آمِن — āmin, safe, secure (act. part. of amina, m., nom. indef.; the madda is printed); 'safe'
جِهَتِنَا: جِهَة + ـنَا — jiha, side, direction, quarter (f., gen.) + 1cp; min jihatinā, 'from our side, from us'
يُسَدُّ: يُسَدُّ — yusaddu, is blocked, stopped up (passive imperf. 3ms of sadda, verb I; the shadda is printed); 'is shut'
وَتَفْتَحُهُ: وَ + تَفْتَحُ + ـهُ — wa-, and (after illā, opening the clause that follows) + taftaḥu, she opens (fataḥa, verb I, imperf. 3fs) + 3ms object; 'but she opens it'
الْوَاسِطَةَ: الـ + وَاسِطَة — wāsiṭa, intermediary, go-between (f., acc., predicate of takūnu); 'the go-between'
التَّبْلِيغِ: الـ + تَبْلِيغ — tablīgh, conveying, delivering a message (verbal noun of ballagha, verb II; m., gen. after fī); 'the conveying'
تَسْتَطِيعُ: تَسْتَطِيعُ — tastaṭīʿu, she is able (istaṭāʿa, verb X hollow, imperf. 3fs); lā tastaṭīʿu, 'she cannot'
بَهَرَهُ: بَهَرَ + ـهُ — bahara, to dazzle, overwhelm (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'dazzled him'
مَقَالِهَا: مَقَال + ـهَا — maqāl, speech, what is said (m., gen. after min) + 3fs; 'her speech'
حَيَّرَ: حَيَّرَ — ḥayyara, to bewilder, perplex (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'bewildered'
وَشَاهَدَ: وَ + شَاهَدَ — wa-, and + shāhada, to witness, behold (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'and he witnessed'
ظَرْفِهَا: ظَرْف + ـهَا — ẓarf, elegance, wit, refinement (m., gen. after min) + 3fs; 'her elegance'
أَدْهَشَهُ: أَدْهَشَ + ـهُ — adhasha, to astonish, amaze (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'astounded him'
شَمَائِلِهَا: شَمَائِل + ـهَا — shamāʾil, qualities, traits, graces (pl. of shimāl / shamīla, gen. after fī; the ئ is printed) + 3fs; 'her qualities, her charms'
تَوَانَتْ: تَوَانَى — tawānā, to be slow, slack, hang back (verb VI, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural ghilmān); mā tawānat, 'they did not hang back'
لَاقَوْهُ: لَاقَى + ـوا + ـهُ — lāqā, to meet (verb III, perf. 3mp) + 3ms object; 'they met him'
أَوْصَلُوهُ: أَوْصَلَ + ـوا + ـهُ — awṣala, to bring (someone) to, convey (verb IV, perf. 3mp) + 3ms object; 'they brought him'
سَيِّدِهِمْ: سَيِّد + ـهِمْ — sayyid, master, lord (m., gen. after ilā) + 3mp; 'their master'
أَبْطَأْتَ: أَبْطَأَ + ـتَ — abṭaʾa, to be slow, tarry (verb IV, perf. 2ms; the medial hamza is printed); abṭaʾta ʿalayya, 'you were slow in coming to me'
فَزِدْتَنِي: فَـ + زِدْ + ـتَ + ـنِي — fa-, and so + zāda, to increase (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms; takes two objects) + 1cs object; 'and you increased me (in)'
أَبْوَابِهِ: أَبْوَاب + ـهِ — abwāb, doors, gates (pl. of bāb, gen.) + 3ms; 'his doors'
غَمَضَتْ: غَمَضَ — ghamaḍa, (of the eye) to close (verb I, perf. 3fs, intransitive, with ʿayn as subject); mā ghamaḍat ʿaynī, 'my eye has not closed'
فَارَقْتَنِي: فَارَقَ + ـتَ + ـنِي — fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, perf. 2ms) + 1cs object; 'you left me'
رُقْعَةٌ: رُقْعَة — ruqʿa, note, slip of paper, short letter (f., nom. indef.); 'a note'
مَخْتُومَةٌ: مَخْتُومَة — makhtūma, sealed (pass. part. of khatama, f., nom. indef.); 'sealed'
أَنِيسًا: أَنِيس — anīs, companion, one whose company cheers (m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'a companion'
اسْتَبْشَرْتُ: اسْتَبْشَرَ + ـتُ — istabshara bi-, to rejoice at, take as good tidings (verb X, perf. 1cs); 'I rejoiced'
وَاتَّخَذْتُكَ: وَ + اتَّخَذَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + ittakhadha, to take (someone) as (something) (verb VIII, perf. 1cs; two objects) + 2ms object; 'and I took you (as)'
تَأَوَّهَ: تَأَوَّهَ — taʾawwaha, to sigh, cry āh (verb V, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed, the hamza supplied); 'he sighed'
وَضَاحِكٍ: وَ + ضَاحِك — wa- of rubba, 'many a' (puts its noun in the genitive) + ḍāḥik, laughing, one who laughs (act. part. of ḍaḥika, m., gen. indef.); 'many a one laughing'
اَبْصَرَنِي: اَبْصَرَ + ـنِي — abṣara, to see, catch sight of (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he saw me' (the print marks no hamza on the alif)
اَبْكَاهُ: اَبْكَى + ـهُ — abkā, to make weep (verb IV of bakā, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'it would have made him weep' (no hamza mark in the print)
يَرْثِ: يَرْثِ — rathā li-, to pity, feel for (verb I, final-weak; jussive 3ms after lam, final -ī dropped); 'he does not pity'
لِلْمُبْتَلِي: لِـ + الـ + مُبْتَلِي — li-, marking the one pitied after rathā + al-, the + mubtalī, afflicted, one put to the test (Form VIII participle of balā, m.; the print points the active form, where Classical would say mubtalā, 'afflicted', but the sense is the same); 'for the afflicted one'
يُكَابِدُهُ: يُكَابِدُ + ـهُ — kābada, to endure, struggle with (verb III, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'he endures it'
شَجٍ: شَجٍ — shajī, grief-stricken, sorrowing (adj. m., nom. indef.; final -ī dropped before tanwīn); 'a grieving one'
بَلْوَاهُ: بَلْوَى + ـهُ — balwā, affliction, trial (f. in form) + -hu, his; 'his affliction'
حَنِينِي: حَنِين + ـي — ḥanīn, yearning, longing (m., verbal noun of ḥanna) + -ī, my; 'my longing'
اَنِينِي: اَنِين + ـي — anīn, moaning, groaning (m., verbal noun of anna) + -ī, my; 'my moaning' (no hamza mark in the print)
فِكْرَتِي: فِكْرَة + ـي — fikra, thought, brooding (f.) + -ī, my; 'my brooding'
مَأْوَاهُ: مَأْوَى + ـهُ — maʾwā, shelter, abode, place of refuge (m.) + -hu, his; 'his abode' (the hamza is the print's own)
لُقْيَاهُ: لُقْيَا + ـهُ — luqyā, meeting, encounter (f., verbal noun of laqiya) + -hu, him; 'meeting him'
خَلِيلٌ: خَلِيل — khalīl, close friend, intimate (m., nom. indef.); 'a friend'
اَرْتَضِي: اَرْتَضِي — irtaḍā, to accept, approve, be content with (verb VIII, impf. 1s); 'I would accept' (no hamza mark in the print)
بَدَلًا: بَدَل — badal, substitute, replacement (m., acc. indef.); 'as a substitute'
اصْطَفَيْتُ: اصْطَفَيْتُ — iṣṭafā, to choose, select as one's own (verb VIII, perf. 1s); 'I have chosen'
وَسَيِّدَتِهَا: وَ + سَيِّدَة + ـهَا — wa-, and + sayyida, mistress, lady (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her mistress'
يُصْغِي: يُصْغِي — aṣghā ilā, to listen to, lend an ear to (verb IV, impf. 3ms); 'listening'
صُفْرَةٍ: صُفْرَة — ṣufra, yellowness, pallor (f., gen. indef. after min); 'yellowness'
احْمِرَارٍ: احْمِرَار — iḥmirār, redness, reddening (m., verbal noun of Form IX iḥmarra; gen. indef. after ilā); 'redness'
وَيَقْوَي: وَ + يَقْوَى — wa-, and + qawiya, to be or grow strong (verb I, impf. 3ms yaqwā; the print spells the final alif maqṣūra with a dotted ي); 'and grows strong'
وَيَضْعُفُ: وَ + يَضْعُفُ — wa-, and + ḍaʿufa, to be or grow weak (verb I, impf. 3ms); 'and grows weak' (corrected from the print's يضغف)
أَرْتَاحُ: أَرْتَاحُ — irtāḥa min, to rest from, be relieved of (verb VIII hollow, impf. 1s); 'I would be at rest'
مُعَاوِنِي: مُعَاوِن + ـي — muʿāwin, helper (act. part. of Form III ʿāwana, m., acc. as predicate of takūna) + -ī, my; 'my helper'
وَمُلَاطِفِي: وَ + مُلَاطِف + ـي — wa-, and + mulāṭif, one who treats kindly, comforts (act. part. of Form III lāṭafa, m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'and my comforter'
يُرِيدَ: يُرِيدَ — arāda, to will, want (verb IV hollow, subj. 3ms after an); 'He wills'
لَاأُخَالِفُ: لَا + أُخَالِفُ — lā, not + khālafa, to oppose, go against, disobey (verb III, impf. 1s); 'I will not go against' (the print sets the two as one word)
شُغِفْتَ: شُغِفْتَ — shughifa bi-, to be smitten with love for, infatuated with (verb I passive, perf. 2ms); 'you have been smitten'
الْخَطِيرِ: الـ + خَطِير — al-, the + khaṭīr, dangerous, perilous (adj. m., gen.); 'the perilous'
وَسَيِّدَتُهَا: وَ + سَيِّدَة + ـهَا — wa-, and + sayyida, mistress (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her mistress'
اخْتَارَتْهُ: اخْتَارَتْ + ـهُ — ikhtāra, to choose (verb VIII hollow, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she chose it'
وَالْمَقْصُودُ: وَ + الـ + مَقْصُود — wa-, and + al-, the + maqṣūd, what is aimed at, purpose (pass. part. of qaṣada, m., nom.); 'and the purpose'
اجْتِمَاعُكُمَا: اجْتِمَاع + ـكُمَا — ijtimāʿ, meeting (m., nom.) + -kumā, your (dual); 'your (two) meeting'
بِبَعْضِكُمَا: بِـ + بَعْض + ـكُمَا — bi-, with (marking the person met, after ijtimāʿ) + baʿḍ, some, one another (m., gen.) + -kumā, of you two; 'with each other'
وَشَكْوَاكُمَا: وَ + شَكْوَى + ـكُمَا — wa-, and + shakwā, complaint, complaining (f., verbal noun of shakā) + -kumā, your (dual); 'and your (two) complaining'
قَاسَيْتُمَا: قَاسَيْتُمَا — qāsā, to suffer, endure (verb III, perf. 2 dual); 'you two have suffered'
فَمَاتَرَى: فَـ + مَا + تَرَى — fa-, so + mā, what(ever) + raʾā, to see, deem (verb I, impf. 2ms); 'so whatever you deem' (the print sets mā tarā as one word)
الْغُصَّةِ: الـ + غُصَّة — al-, the + ghuṣṣa, a choking, lump in the throat; anguish (f., gen.); 'the choking grief'
أُسَامِرُهُ: أُسَامِرُ + ـهُ — sāmara, to keep someone company in talk by night (verb III, impf. 1s) + -hu, him; 'talking with him by night'
اسْتَقَرَّيْتُ: اسْتَقَرَّ + ـيْتُ — istaqarra (Form X of q-r-r), to settle, come to rest + -tu, I, with Middle Arabic -aytu for Classical istaqrartu; 'I settled'
وَحَدَّثْتُهَا: وَ + حَدَّثَ + ـتُ + ـهَا — ḥaddatha (Form II), to tell (with bi- of the thing told) + -tu, I + -hā, her; 'and I told her'
مَجْلِسَنَا: مَجْلِس + ـنَا — majlis, sitting-room, apartment (acc. after anna) + -nā, our; 'our sitting-room'
أَسْتَرُلَنَا: أَسْتَرُ + لَـ + ـنَا — astaru, more concealing (elative of satara, to veil) + la-, for + -nā, us, run together by the print; 'more discreet for us'
كَلَامُكِ: كَلَام + ـكِ — kalām, speech, words + -ki, your (f.); 'what you say'
كَمَنْزِلِي: كَـ + مَنْزِل + ـِي — ka-, like (making the comparison 'is not like') + manzil, house + -ī, my; 'like my house'
وَأَسْتَرُلَنَا: وَ + أَسْتَرُ + لَـ + ـنَا — astaru, more concealing + la-, for + -nā, us, run together by the print; 'and more discreet for us'
ذَاهِبَةٌ: ذَاهِبَة — dhāhiba, going (f. act. part. of dhahaba); 'am going'
لِأُخْبِرَهَا: لِـ + أُخْبِرَ + ـهَا — li-, in order to (purpose, with the subjunctive) + akhbara (Form IV), to inform (with bi- of the news) + -hā, her; 'to tell her'
وَأَعْرِضَ: وَ + أَعْرِضَ — ʿaraḍa, to lay before, submit (with ʿalā) (1 sg. subjunctive, still under li-); 'and lay before'
وَعَرَضَتْ: وَ + عَرَضَ — ʿaraḍa, to lay before (with ʿalā) (3 f. sg. past); 'and she laid before'
فَهَيِّءْ: فَـ + هَيِّءْ — hayyaʾa (Form II), to make ready (imper. m. sg.); 'so make ready'
الْمَحَلَّ: الـ + مَحَلّ — maḥall, place, lodging (m.), acc.; 'the place'
انْتَظِرْنَا: انْتَظِرْ + ـنَا — intaẓara (Form VIII), to wait for (imper. m. sg.) + 'us'; 'wait for us'
فَأَقْسَمْتُ: فَـ + أَقْسَمْتُ — aqsama (Form IV), to swear (perf. 1 sg.); 'but I swore'
دَفَعَهَا: دَفَعَ + ـهَا — dafaʿa, to push, hand over (perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'them'; 'he handed them'
رَوَاحِ: رَوَاح — rawāḥ, going (properly in the evening), departure (m.), gen., first term of an iḍāfa; 'the going of': baʿda rawāḥi al-jāriyati, 'after the girl had gone'; rawāḥ rūḥī, 'the going of my soul', my death
وَحَوَّلْتُ: و + حَوَّلْتُ — ḥawwala (Form II), to shift, transfer (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I moved'
وَالْفُرُشِ: و + الـ + فُرُش — pl. of firāsh, bedding, carpet, things spread (m.), gen.; 'and the spreads'
وَالزُّجَاجِ: و + الـ + زُجَاج — zujāj, glass (m.), gen.; 'and the glass'
وَالذَّهَبِ: و + الـ + ذَهَب — dhahab, gold (m.), gen.; 'and the gold'
حَضَرَتِ: حَضَرَتِ — ḥaḍara, to come, be present (perf. 3 f. sg., helping kasra); 'she came'
أَعْجَبَهَا: أَعْجَبَ + ـهَا — aʿjaba (Form IV), to please (perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'her'; 'it pleased her'
وَأَمَرَتْنِي: و + أَمَرَتْ + ـنِي — amara, to command (perf. 3 f. sg.) + 'me'; 'and she commanded me'
إِلَاّ: إِلَّا — illā, except, but (particle); the print sets its shadda on the alif
وَأَحْضَرْتُهُ: و + أَحْضَرْتُ + ـهُ — aḥḍara (Form IV), to bring (perf. 1 sg.) + 'him'; 'and I brought him'
رَاقَتْ: رَاقَتْ — rāqa, to be clear, limpid, pleasing (perf. 3 f. sg.); 'had grown clear'
فَتَلَقَّيْتُهُ: فَـ + تَلَقَّيْتُ + ـهُ — talaqqā (Form V), to go to meet, receive (perf. 1 sg.) + 'him'; 'so I received him'
وَتَرَحَّبْتُ: و + تَرَحَّبْتُ — taraḥḥaba (Form V) bi-, to bid welcome (perf. 1 sg.); 'and I welcomed'
أَجْلَسْتُهُ: أَجْلَسْتُ + ـهُ — ajlasa (Form IV), to seat (perf. 1 sg.) + 'him'; 'I seated him'
الْمُنَزَّةِ: الـ + مُنَزَّه — munazzah, kept pure, choice (Form II pass. part.), gen.; printed with ة for ه
وَالْبَلُّورِ: و + الـ + بَلُّور — ballūr, crystal (m.), gen.; 'and the crystal'
الْمُلَوَّنَةِ: الـ + مُلَوَّنَة — mulawwan, coloured, many-hued (Form II pass. part., f. with the plural), gen.
رُؤْيَتُهُ: رُؤْيَة + ـهُ — ruʾya, seeing, sight (f.), nom. + 'its'; 'the sight of it' (printed without hamza)
الصَّدْرَ: الـ + صَدْر — ṣadr, breast, chest (m.), acc.; 'the breast'
وَأُسَلِّيهِ: و + أُسَلِّي + ـهِ — sallā (Form II), to divert, console (imperf. 1 sg.) + 'him'; 'and cheering him'
وَوَصِيفَتَانِ: و + وَصِيفَتَانِ — waṣīfa, maid-servant (f.), dual nom.; 'and two maids'
وَاعْتَنَقَهَا: و + اعْتَنَقَ + ـهَا — iʿtanaqa (Form VIII), to embrace (perf. 3 m. sg.) + 'her'; 'and he embraced her'
فَاعْتَنَقَتْهُ: فَـ + اعْتَنَقَتْ + ـهُ — iʿtanaqa (Form VIII), to embrace (perf. 3 f. sg.) + 'him'; 'and she embraced him'
فَسَقَطَا: فَـ + سَقَطَا — saqaṭa, to fall (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two fell'
زَمَانِيَّةٍ: زَمَانِيَّة — zamānī, of time, temporal (rel. adj., f.), indef. gen.; 'of (real) time'
يَتَشَاكَيَانِ: يَتَشَاكَيَانِ — tashākā (Form VI), to complain to one another (imperf. 3 m. dual); 'complaining to each other of'
رَقِيقٍ: رَقِيق — raqīq, delicate, tender, indef. gen.
وَاسْتَعْمَلَا: و + اسْتَعْمَلَا — istaʿmala (Form X), to use, make use of (perf. 3 m. dual); 'and they used'
يَشْكُرَانِ: يَشْكُرَانِ — shakara, to thank (imperf. 3 m. dual); 'thanking'
صُنْعِي: صُنْع + ـِي — ṣunʿ, doing, deed, kindness (m.), gen. + 'my'; 'my doing'
نَقَلْتُهُمَا: نَقَلْ + ـتُ + ـهُمَا — naqala (I), to move, transfer; 'I moved them two'
وَسَكِرَا: وَ + سَكِرَ + ـا — sakira (I), to become drunk; dual; 'and they two grew drunk'
وَمَالَا: وَ + مَالَ + ـا — māla (I), to lean, incline (with ʿalā, on); dual; 'and they two leaned'
كَمِّلْ: كَمَّلَ — kammala (II), to complete; imperative m. sg.; 'complete!'
جَمِيلَكَ: جَمِيل + ـكَ — jamīl, a kindness, favour (m.), acc. + your; 'your kindness'
وَأَحْضِرْ: وَ + أَحْضِرْ — aḥḍara (IV), to bring; imperative m. sg.; 'and bring'
يَكْمُلَ: يَـ + كْمُلَ — kamula (I), to be complete; subjunctive after an; 'it be complete'
سُرُورُنَا: سُرُور + ـنَا — surūr, joy, gladness (m.), nom. + our; 'our joy'
وَضَعَتْهُ: وَضَعَ + ـتْ + ـهُ — waḍaʿa (I), to put, lay; 'she laid it'
هَيَّجَتِ: هَيَّجَ + ـتِ — hayyaja (II), to stir up, rouse; 'she stirred up' (-ti before the article)
الشُّجُونَ: الـ + شُجُون — shujūn, sorrows, cares, pl. of shajan (m.), acc.; 'the sorrows'
وَأَطْرَبَتِ: وَ + أَطْرَبَ + ـتِ — aṭraba (IV), to enrapture, move to ṭarab; 'and she enraptured'
الْمَحْزُونَ: الـ + مَحْزُون — maḥzūn, grieved, sorrowful (pass. part.), acc.; 'the sorrowful one'
غِنَاءِ: غِنَاء — ghināʾ, singing, song (m.), gen. after fī, construct; 'the singing of'; also gen. after ʿalā, marking the music danced to: ʿalā ghināʾi al-ḥādī (Night 182)
حَيَّرَتِ: حَيَّرَ + ـتِ — ḥayyara (II), to bewilder; 'she bewildered' (-ti before the article)
تُغَنِّي: تُـ + غَنِّي — ghannā (II), to sing; imperf. 3 f. sg.; 'she sings', 'singing'
مُخْتَلِفَةٍ: مُخْتَلِفَة — mukhtalifa, varied, differing (VIII act. part.), f. agreeing with the plural; 'varied'
رَائِقَةٍ: رَائِقَة — rāʾiqa, clear, limpid, pleasing (act. part.), f. agreeing with the plural; 'fine'
يَرْقُصَ: يَـ + رْقُصَ — raqaṣa (I), to dance; subjunctive after an; 'to dance'
مَغَانِيهَا: مَغَانِي + ـهَا — maghānī, songs, melodies (pl.) + her; 'her songs'
بِالْعَجَبِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجَب — ʿajab, wonder (m.); bi- is the one atā takes for 'bring', set at the end; 'the wonder (she brought)'
وَلَافِكْرٌ: وَ + لَا + فِكْر — fikr, thought (m.), nom.; printed as one word; 'nor thought'
اسْتَقَرَّ: اِسْتَقَرَّ — istaqarra (X, root q-r-r), to settle, be settled; 'settled'
أَطْرَبَتِ: أَطْرَبَ + ـتِ — aṭraba (IV), to enrapture, delight; 'she delighted' (-ti before the article)
اَرِقْتُ: أَرِقَ + ـتُ — ariqa (I), to be sleepless; 'I lay sleepless'
كَأَنِّيْ: كَأَنَّ + ـي — kaʾanna, as if (conj.) + I; 'as if I'
اَعْشِقُ: أَعْشِقُ — ʿashiqa (I), to love passionately; imperf. 1 sg., printed with kasra (expected aʿshaqu); 'I love'
الْاَرِقَا: الـ + أَرِق — ariq, sleepless (one) (adj.), acc. with the alif of rhyme; sense perhaps araq, 'sleeplessness'
وَذُبْتُ: وَ + ذُبْ + ـتُ — dhāba (I), to melt, waste away; 'and I wasted away'
السُّقْمَ: الـ + سُقْم — suqm, sickness (m.), acc. after kaʾanna; 'the sickness'
خُلقَا: خُلُق — khuluq, inborn character, nature (m.), acc. with the alif of rhyme; 'a nature'
وَفَاضَ: وَ + فَاضَ — fāḍa (I), to overflow, flood; 'and (my tears) overflowed'
فَاَحْرَقَهُ: فَـ + أَحْرَقَ + ـهُ — aḥraqa (IV), to burn; 'and burned it'
لِقَا: لِقَاء — liqāʾ, meeting (m.), hamza dropped for the rhyme; 'a meeting'
وَعَدَ: وَعَدَ — waʿada (I), to promise (with bi-, the thing promised); 'promised'
الْحَبِيْبُ: الـ + حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved (m.), nom.; 'the beloved'
بِوَصْلِهِ: بِـ + وَصْل + ـهِ — waṣl, union, lovers' meeting (m.) + his; bi- marks what is promised (waʿada bi-); 'his union'
سَأُعُدُّهَا: سَـ + أُعُدُّ + ـهَا — ʿadda (I), to count, reckon; sa- future; printed saʾuʿuddu for saʾaʿuddu; 'I shall count it'
بِلَيَالِيْ: بِـ + لَيَالِي — layālī, nights, pl. of layla (f.); bi-, as, in the measure of (prep.); 'as (many) nights'
سَمَحَ: سَمَحَ — samaḥa (I), to grant, be generous (with bi-, the thing granted); 'granted'
غَفْلَةِ: غَفْلَة — ghafla, heedlessness, inattention (f.), gen. after fī, construct; 'the heedlessness of'
الْوَاشِيْنَ: الـ + وَاشِين — wāshūn, slanderers, talebearers, pl. of wāshī (m.), gen.; 'the slanderers'
وَالْعُذَّال: وَ + الـ + عُذَّال — ʿudhdhāl, censurers, blamers, pl. of ʿādhil (m.), gen.; 'and the censurers'
يَضُمُّنِي: يَـ + ضُمُّ + ـنِي — ḍamma (I), to clasp, embrace; imperf. + me; 'clasping me'
بِيَمِيْنِهِ: بِـ + يَمِين + ـهِ — yamīn, right hand (f.) + his; bi-, with (prep., instrument); 'with his right hand'
فَرْحَتِى: فَرْحَة + ـي — farḥa, joy (f.) + my, printed ى; 'my joy'
فَضَمَمْتُهُ: فَـ + ضَمَمْ + ـتُ + ـهُ — ḍamma (I), to clasp; 'and I clasped him'
بِشِمَالِيْ: بِـ + شِمَال + ـي — shimāl, left hand (f.) + my; bi-, with (prep., instrument); 'with my left'
وَرَشَفْتُ: وَ + رَشَفْ + ـتُ — rashafa (I), to sip; 'and I sipped'
خُمْرَةَ: خُمْرَة — khumra, ferment, aroma of wine (f.), acc., construct; prob. for khamra, 'wine'; 'the wine of'
رِيقِهِ: رِيق + ـهِ — rīq, saliva (m.) + his; 'his saliva', i.e. his mouth
وَحَظِيْتُ: وَ + حَظِيْ + ـتُ — ḥaẓiya (I), to win, enjoy (with bi-, the thing won); 'and I won'
بِالْمَعْسُوْلِ: بِـ + الـ + مَعْسُول — maʿsūl, honeyed (pass. part.); bi- is the one ḥaẓiya takes for the thing won; 'the honeyed'
وَالْعُسَّالِ: وَ + الـ + عُسَّال — ʿussāl, as printed pl. of ʿāsil, honey-gatherer (sense uncertain); 'and the honey-gatherers'
غَارِقُونَ: غَارِقُونَ — ghāriqūn, drowning, sunk (act. part. of ghariqa, to drown; m. pl. nom.)
بِوَصِيفَةٍ: بِـ + وَصِيفَة — waṣīfa, young maid-servant (f.); the bi- after idhā only marks what appears; 'a maid-servant'
صَغِيرَةٍ: صَغِيرَة — ṣaghīra, little, young (f. of ṣaghīr); gen. agreeing
تَذْهَبِينَ: تَذْهَبِينَ — tadhhabīna, you (f.) go (imperf., 2 f. sg.; dhahaba, to go)
وَأَدْرَكُوكُمْ: وَ + أَدْرَكُوا + كُمْ — wa-, and + adrakū, they overtook, caught up with (past, 3 m. pl.; adraka, Form IV) + -kum, you (pl.); 'and have overtaken you'
الْبَلَاءُ: الـ + بَلَاء — balāʾ, calamity, affliction (m.); nom.; 'the calamity'
رَحُبَتْ: رَحُبَتْ — raḥubat, it (f.) was wide (past, 3 f. sg.; raḥuba, to be wide, spacious)
مَسْلَكًا: مَسْلَك — maslak, path, way through (m.; from salaka, to pass along); acc.; 'a way out'
الْجِيرَانِ: الـ + جِيرَان — jīrān, neighbours (pl. of jār); gen.; 'of the neighbours'
وَتَخَبَّيْتُ: وَ + تَخَبَّيْتُ — wa-, and + takhabbaytu, I hid myself (past, 1 sg.; Middle Arabic for Classical takhabbaʾtu, Form V of khabaʾa, to hide)
فَاعْتَقَدْتُ: فَـ + اعْتَقَدْتُ — fa-, and/so + iʿtaqadtu, I believed, was convinced (past, 1 sg.; iʿtaqada, Form VIII)
خَبَرَنَا: خَبَر + نَا — khabar, news, report (m.) + -nā, our; acc. after anna; 'our news'
لِيَكْبِسَ: لِـ + يَكْبِسَ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + yakbisa, he raid (subj., 3 m. sg.; kabasa ʿalā, to burst in on, raid); 'to raid'
وَيُحْضِرَنَا: وَ + يُحْضِرَ + نَا — wa-, and + yuḥḍira, he bring (subj., 3 m. sg.; aḥḍara, Form IV, to fetch, bring before) + -nā, us; 'and bring us'
وَأَحَسَّ: وَ + أَحَسَّ — wa-, and + aḥassa, he sensed, perceived (past, 3 m. sg.; aḥassa bi-, Form IV, which takes its object through bi-)
جَارُكَ: جَار + كَ — jār, neighbour (m.) + -ka, your; nom.; 'your neighbour'
فَعَرَفَنِي: فَـ + عَرَفَ + نِي — fa-, and so + ʿarafa, he knew, recognised (past, 3 m. sg.) + -nī, me; 'and he knew me'
بِضَوْءٍ: بِـ + ضَوْء — bi-, with (jāʾa bi-, 'come with', i.e. bring) + ḍawʾ, light, a lamp (m.); 'brought a light'
أَعْلَمِ: أَعْلَمِ — aʿlam(i), (I) know (jussive, 1 sg., of ʿalima; helping i before the article)
اللُّصُوصَ: الـ + لُصُوص — luṣūṣ, thieves, robbers (pl. of liṣṣ); acc. after inna
جِيرَانِنَا: جِيرَان + نَا — jīrān, neighbours (pl. of jār) + -nā, our; gen. after ilā; 'our neighbours'
رَأَوْكَ: رَأَوْا + كَ — raʾaw, they saw (past, 3 m. pl.; raʾā) + -ka, you; 'they saw you'
حَوَائِجَكَ: حَوَائِج + كَ — ḥawāʾij, needs, things, belongings (pl. of ḥāja) + -ka, your; acc.; 'your things'
وَتَأْتِي: وَ + تَأْتِي — wa-, and + taʾtī, you come (imperf., 2 m. sg.; atā; with bi-, 'bring')
فَجَاؤُكَ: فَـ + جَاؤُا + كَ — fa-, so + jāʾū, they came (past, 3 m. pl.; older spelling, the alif lost before the suffix) + -ka, you; 'so they came to you'
ضُيُوفَكَ: ضُيُوف + كَ — ḍuyūf, guests (pl. of ḍayf) + -ka, your; acc.; 'your guests'
وَجَارِي: وَ + جَار + ي — wa-, and + jār, neighbour (m.) + -ī, my; 'and my neighbour'
فَوَجَدْنَاهَا: فَـ + وَجَدْنَا + هَا — fa-, and + wajadnā, we found (past, 1 pl.; wajada) + -hā, it (f., the house); 'and we found it'
خَالِيَةً: خَالِيَة — khāliya, empty (f. act. part. of khalā); acc. of state
الْأَمْتِعَةُ: الـ + أَمْتِعَة — amtiʿa, goods, furnishings (pl. of matāʿ); nom.; 'the goods'
بِضَيَاعِهَا: بِـ + ضَيَاع + هَا — bi-, the preposition bālā takes for its object + ḍayāʿ, loss (verbal noun of ḍāʿa) + -hā, their (the goods); 'about their loss'
اسْتَعَرْتُ: اسْتَعَرْتُ — istaʿartu, I borrowed (past, 1 sg.; istaʿāra, Form X)
الْأَمْتِعَةِ: الـ + أَمْتِعَة — amtiʿa, goods (pl. of matāʿ); gen.; 'of the goods'
وَضَاعَتْ: وَ + ضَاعَتْ — wa-, and + ḍāʿat, they (f.) were lost (past, 3 f. sg. for a non-human pl.; ḍāʿa)
فَلَابَأْسَ: فَـ + لَا + بَأْس — fa-, then + lā, no (denying the whole class) + baʾs, harm (m., acc. without tanwīn); set as one word in the print; 'then there is no harm'
وَنَهْبِ: وَ + نَهْب — wa-, and + nahb, plundering (verbal noun of nahaba); gen.; 'and the plundering (of)'
وَمَحْظِيَّةُ: وَ + مَحْظِيَّة — wa-, and + maḥẓiyya, favourite, favoured concubine (f.); nom.; 'and the favourite (of)'
فَأَخْشَى: فَـ + أَخْشَى — fa-, then (after ammā) + akhshā, I fear (imperf., 1 sg.; khashiya)
يَشْتَهِرَ: يَشْتَهِرَ — yashtahira, it become known, be noised abroad (subj., 3 m. sg.; ishtahara, Form VIII)
وَتَسْتُرُ: وَ + تَسْتُرُ — wa-, and + tasturu, you cover, veil (imperf., 2 m. sg.; satara ʿalā, to cover up for someone)
عَوْرَاتِي: عَوْرَات + ي — ʿawrāt, things to be hidden, shames, weak points (pl. of ʿawra) + -ī, my; acc.
تَتَرَبَّصَ: تَتَرَبَّصَ — tatarabbaṣa, you wait, bide your time (subj., 2 m. sg.; tarabbaṣa, Form V)
مَتَاعَكَ: مَتَاع + كَ — matāʿ, goods, belongings (m.) + -ka, your; acc.
وَأَعْوَانُ: وَ + أَعْوَان — wa-, and + aʿwān, helpers, officers (pl. of ʿawn); nom.
يَدُورُونَ: يَدُورُونَ — yadūrūna, they go round (imperf., 3 m. pl.; dāra ʿalā, to go round after, search for)
فَلَعَلَّهُمْ: فَـ + لَعَلَّ + هُمْ — fa-, so + laʿalla, perhaps + -hum, they; 'so perhaps they'
يَصْدِفُوهُمْ: يَصْدِفُوا + هُمْ — yaṣdifū, they come upon (imperf., 3 m. pl.; colloquial ṣadafa for Classical ṣādafa; Middle Arabic, the indicative -na dropped) + -hum, them
سَاكِنٌ: سَاكِن — sākin, dwelling, living (act. part. of sakana); nom.
نَهْبَ: نَهْب — nahb, plundering, looting (m., verbal noun of nahaba; acc. as noun of inna, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the plundering (of)'
دَارِةِ: دَار + ة (for ـهِ) — dār, house (f., gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'his house'
عَاذِرٌ: عَاذِر — ʿādhir, one who excuses, holds someone blameless (act. part. I of ʿadhara; m., nom. indef., predicate); 'excusing (him)'
وَحَامِلٌ: وَ + حَامِل — wa-, and + ḥāmil, carrying, bearing (act. part. I of ḥamala; m., nom. indef.); ḥāmilun hammahu, 'bearing his care', sharing his trouble
يَشْكُولَهُمْ: يَشْكُو + لَـ + ـهُمْ — yashkū, he complains (shakā, verb I defective, imperf. 3ms) + la-, to (li- before a pronoun; marks the one complained to) + -hum, them; 'he complains to them' (printed as one word)
يَأْكُلْ: يَأْكُلْ — akala, to eat (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam); lam yaʾkul, 'he did not eat'
يَشْرَبْ: يَشْرَبْ — shariba, to drink (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam); lam yashrab, 'he did not drink'
مِمَّابِهِ: مِنْ + مَا + بِـ + ـهِ — min, from, because of + mā, what + bi-, in (prep. of place) + -hi, him; mimmā bihi, 'from what was in him', i.e. from his distress (printed as one word)
مُتَنَدِّمٌ: مُتَنَدِّم — mutanaddim, regretful, full of remorse (act. part. V of nadima; m., nom. indef.); 'regretful'
أَعْرِفْهُ: أَعْرِفْ + ـهُ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam) + -hu, him; lam aʿrifhu, 'I do not know him'
يَعْرِفْهُ: يَعْرِفْ + ـهُ — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, jussive 3ms after lam) + -hu, him; lam yaʿrifhu, 'he did not know him'
مَايُفَرِّجُ: مَا + يُفَرِّجُ — mā, that which (relative) + yufarriju, he relieves (farraja, verb II, imperf. 3ms); farraja hamman ʿan, 'to lift care from'; 'that which (God) will relieve' (printed as one word)
وَلَابَوَّابٍ: وَ + لَا + بَوَّاب — wa-, and + lā, no, not (repeating the negation of bi-ghayri) + bawwāb, doorkeeper (m., gen. indef., still governed by bi-ghayri); 'and no doorkeeper' (printed as one word)
الْقُعُودُ: الـ + قُعُود — quʿūd, sitting, staying (m., verbal noun of qaʿada; nom., subject of yumkinu); 'the sitting'
أَسْأَلْهُ: أَسْأَلْ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam) + -hu, him; lam asʾalhu, 'I did not ask him'
الْفَضَاءِ: الـ + فَضَاء — faḍāʾ, open space, open country (m., gen. after ilā); 'the open ground'
أُهَرْوِلُ: أُهَرْوِلُ — harwala, to trot, go at a jog (quadriliteral verb I, imperf. 1cs indic.); 'I trot'
وَرَاءَةُ: وَرَاءَ + ة (for ـهُ) — warāʾa, behind (adv., acc.) + -hu, him (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'behind him'
وَأُقَوِّي: وَ + أُقَوِّي — wa-, and + qawwā, to strengthen (verb II, defective, imperf. 1cs); qawwā qalbahu ʿalā, 'to nerve oneself for'; 'and I strengthen'
وَقَذَفَ: وَ + قَذَفَ — wa-, and + qadhafa, to throw; of a boatman, to row (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he rowed'
الْمَلَّاحُ: الـ + مَلَّاح — mallāḥ, boatman, sailor (m., nom.); 'the boatman'
عَدَّانَا: عَدَّى + ـنَا — ʿaddā, to take across, ferry over (verb II defective, perf. 3ms; a word of everyday speech) + -nā, us; 'he ferried us over'
بِيَدِى: بِـ + يَد + ي — bi-, by (marks the part taken hold of, after akhadha) + yad, hand (f., gen.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); 'by my hand'
أَدْخُلْهُ: أَدْخُلْ + ـهُ — dakhala, to enter (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam; takes its goal directly) + -hu, it; lam adkhulhu, 'I had not entered it'
عُمْرِى: عُمْر + ي — ʿumr, life, lifetime (m., gen.) + -ī, my (printed with ى); ṭūla ʿumrī, 'all my life'
مَشَي: مَشَى — mashā, to walk (verb I, perf. 3ms; the print spells the final alif maqṣūra with a dotted ي); with bi-, 'walked with, led': mashā bī, 'he led me'
دِهْلِيزِهَا: دِهْلِيز + هَا — dihlīz, vestibule, entrance passage (m., Persian loan; gen. after fī) + -hā, its (the house); 'its entrance passage'
إِخْوَانٌ: إِخْوَان — ikhwān, brothers (m. pl. of akh; nom. indef., predicate); 'brothers'
فَسَلَّمْنَا: فَـ + سَلَّمْنَا — fa-, so + sallama, to greet (verb II, perf. 1cp; with ʿalā of the one greeted); 'so we greeted'
فَرَدُّوا: فَـ + رَدُّوا — fa-, and + radda, to return, give back (verb I doubled, perf. 3mp); radda al-salāma ʿalā, 'to return the greeting to'; 'and they returned'
وَأَمَرُونَا: وَ + أَمَرُوا + نَا — wa-, and + amara, to command (verb I, perf. 3mp; takes bi- of the thing commanded) + -nā, us; 'and they bade us'
وَرَشُّوهُ: وَ + رَشُّوا + هُ — wa-, and + rashsha, to sprinkle (verb I doubled, perf. 3mp) + -hu, it; 'and they sprinkled it'
مُضِرٌّ: مُضِرّ — muḍirr, harmful (act. part. of Form IV aḍarra, to harm; m., nom. indef., adj. agreeing with shayʾun); 'harmful'
يَأْكُلُوا: يَأْكُلُوا — akala, to eat (verb I, impf. 3mp, jussive after lam); lam yaʾkulū, 'they would not have eaten, did not eat'
غَسَلْنَا: غَسَلْنَا — ghasala, to wash (verb I, perf. 1cp); 'we washed'
أَيْدِيَنَا: أَيْدِي + نَا — aydī, hands (pl. of yad, f.; acc. object) + -nā, our; 'our hands'
تَعْرِفُنَا: تَعْرِفُ + نَا — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, impf. 2ms) + -nā, us; 'you know us'
أَحْضَرَنِي: أَحْضَرَ + نِي — aḥḍara, to bring, fetch, cause to be present (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he brought me'
أَطْلِعْنَا: أَطْلِعْ + نَا — aṭliʿ, imperative of aṭlaʿa, to let see, inform (verb IV; with ʿalā of the matter) + -nā, us; 'acquaint us (with)'
وَأَمْرِى: وَ + أَمْر + ى — wa-, and + amr, affair, matter (m.) + -ī, my (printed with ى for ي); 'and my affair'
أَمْتِعَتَكَ: أَمْتِعَة + كَ — amtiʿa, goods, household effects (pl. of matāʿ; acc. object) + -ka, your; 'your goods'
أَسْبَلَ: أَسْبَلَ — asbala, to let down, let hang (a veil, curtain) (verb IV, perf. 3ms, here used as a wish); asbala Allāhu ʿalaykum sitrahu, 'may God let down His veil over you'
فَأَشَارُوا: فَـ + أَشَارُوا — fa-, so + ashāra, to point, make a sign (verb IV hollow, perf. 3mp; ilā of the one signed to or the direction, bi- of the hand); 'so they pointed'
هُهُنَا: هُهُنَا — a form of hāhunā (hā + hunā), here (adv. of place); the print sets a damma on the first letter; 'here'
سِرُّهُمَا: سِرّ + هُمَا — sirr, secret (m., nom., subject) + -humā, their (dual); 'their secret'
نَرَهُمَا: نَرَ + هُمَا — narā, we see (raʾā, verb I, impf. 1cp, jussive after lam, final vowel dropped) + -humā, them (dual); lam narahumā, 'we have not seen them'
نَسْأَلْهُمَا: نَسْأَلْ + هُمَا — saʾala, to ask (verb I, impf. 1cp, jussive after lam; ʿan of the matter) + -humā, them (dual); 'we have not asked them'
وَالْوَقَارِ: وَ + الـ + وَقَار — wa-, and + waqār, gravity, dignity, composure (m., gen., joined to al-hayba after min); 'and dignity'
مَنَعَنَا: مَنَعَ + نَا — manaʿa, to prevent, hold back (verb I, perf. 3ms; ʿan of the thing prevented) + -nā, us; 'it prevented us'
قَتْلِهِمَا: قَتْل + هِمَا — qatl, killing (m., verbal noun of qatala, gen. after ʿan) + -himā, of them (dual, object sense); 'killing them'
فَأَخْبِرْنَا: فَـ + أَخْبِرْ + نَا — fa-, so, then (ties the command to what goes before; after a condition it opens the answer) + akhbir, inform, tell (imper. 2ms of akhbara, Form IV) + -nā, us; 'so tell us', 'then tell us'
وَالْفَزَعِ: وَ + الـ + فَزَع — wa-, and + al-, the + fazaʿ, terror, fright (m., gen.); 'and the terror'
الْمُرُوَّةَ: الـ + مُرُوَّة — muruwwa, manliness, chivalry, honour (f., acc. after anna; softened spelling of muruʾa); 'chivalry'
تُوجَدْ: تُوجَدْ — tūjad, it is found (wujida, passive of wajada, verb I, jussive 3fs after lam); 'it is not found'
سِرٌّأَخَافُ: سِرٌّ + أَخَافُ — sirr, secret (m., nom. indef.) + akhāfu, I fear (khāfa, verb I hollow, impf. 1cs); two words run together in the print; 'a secret (that) I fear'
إِنْشَاءَهُ: إِنْشَاء + هُ — inshāʾ, putting forth, spreading (verbal noun of anshaʾa, Form IV; here probably for ifshāʾ, divulging) (m., acc.) + -hu, it; 'its being spread abroad'
صُدُورُكُمْ: صُدُور + كُمْ — ṣudūr, breasts, hearts (pl. of ṣadr, m., nom.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your breasts'
أُبَالِغُ: أُبَالِغُ — ubālighu, I go to lengths, insist (bālagha fī, Form III, impf. 1cs); 'going to great lengths'
الْمُبَادَرَةَ: الـ + مُبَادَرَة — mubādara, hastening, coming out first (verbal noun of bādara, Form III) (f., acc.); 'the hastening'
أَنْفَعَ: أَنْفَعَ — anfaʿ, more useful (elative of nāfiʿ; acc., second object of wajada); 'more useful'
كِتْمَانِهِ: كِتْمَان + هِ — kitmān, concealing (verbal noun of katama) (m., gen. after min) + -hi, it; 'concealing it'
فَحَدَّثْتُهُمْ: فَـ + حَدَّثْتُ + هُمْ — fa-, so (conj.) + ḥaddathtu, I told (ḥaddatha, Form II, perf. 1cs; ḥaddatha bi-, 'tell of') + -hum, them; 'so I told them'
وَاعْتَذَرُوا: وَ + اعْتَذَرُوا — wa-, and + iʿtadharū, they apologised (iʿtadhara li-, Form VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and they begged pardon'
بَاقِيهِ: بَاقِي + هِ — bāqī, remainder (act. part. of baqiya, m., nom.) + -hi, of it; 'the rest of it'
وَالْتَزَمُوا: وَ + الْتَزَمُوا — wa-, and + iltazamū, they bound themselves, undertook (iltazama, Form VIII, perf. 3mp); 'and they undertook'
يُعِيدُونَهَا: يُعِيدُونَ + هَا — yuʿīdūna, they bring back (aʿāda, Form IV of ʿāda, impf. 3mp) + -hā, them (the goods, f. sg. for a non-human plural); 'they would bring them back'
وَيَرُدُّونَ: وَ + يَرُدُّونَ — wa-, and + yaruddūna, they give back (radda, verb I doubled, impf. 3mp); 'and they would give back'
فَاطْمَأَنَّ: فَـ + اطْمَأَنَّ — fa-, and so (conj.) + iṭmaʾanna, to be at rest, reassured (quadriliteral Form IV, perf. 3ms); 'and (my heart) was at rest'
وَلَكِنَّهُمُ: وَ + لَكِنَّ + هُمُ — wa-, and + lākinna, but (particle) + -hum(u), they (helping -u before a joining alif); 'but they'
انْقَسَمُوا: انْقَسَمُوا — inqasamū, they divided themselves (inqasama, Form VII of qasama, perf. 3mp); 'they split'
قِسْمٌ: قِسْمٌ — qism, part, portion, party (m., nom. indef.); 'a part'
وَقِسْمٌ: وَ + قِسْمٌ — wa-, and + qism, part, party (m., nom. indef.); 'and a part'
وَالْوَصِيفَتَيْنِ: وَ + الـ + وَصِيفَتَيْنِ — wa-, and + al-, the + waṣīfatayni, two maids (dual of waṣīfa, girl in service, gen.); 'and the two maids'
ذَهَبْنَ: ذَهَبْنَ — dhahabna, they (f. pl.) went (dhahaba, verb I, perf. 3fp); 'they went'
السُّمَيْرِيَّةُ: الـ + سُمَيْرِيَّة — sumayriyya, a kind of light river boat used on the Tigris (f., nom.); 'the boat'
فَأَطْلَعُونَا: فَـ + أَطْلَعُوا + نَا — fa-, and (conj.) + aṭlaʿa, to make go up (verb IV of ṭalaʿa, perf. 3mp) + -nā, us; 'and they put us aboard (the boat)'
عَدَّيْنَا: عَدَّى + نَا — ʿaddā, to cross over (a river) (verb II, final-weak, perf. 1pl); 'we crossed'
أَوْصَلَنَا: أَوْصَلَ + نَا — awṣala, to bring to, convey to (verb IV of waṣala, perf. 3ms; the place takes إِلَى) + -nā, us (obj.); 'he brought us'
الثَّانِى: الـ + ثَانٍ — thānin, second; here 'the other, the far (bank)' (m. adj., gen.; the print spells the final -ī with ى); 'the second, the other'
فَأَنْزَلُونَا: فَـ + أَنْزَلُوا + نَا — fa-, and (conj.) + anzala, to make go down, set down (verb IV of nazala, perf. 3mp) + -nā, us; 'and they set us down'
اسْتَرَحْنَا: اسْتَرَاحَ + نَا — istarāḥa, to rest, take one's ease (verb X hollow, perf. 1pl); 'we rested'
وَالْخَيَّالَةُ: وَ + الـ + خَيَّالَة — wa-, and; here circumstantial 'and (meanwhile)' after illā + khayyāla, horsemen, a troop of cavalry (collective, f. in form, nom.); 'when the horsemen …'
الْعِقْبَانِ: الـ + عِقْبَان — ʿiqbān, eagles (pl. of ʿuqāb, f.), gen. after mithla; 'the eagles'
كَالْعُقَابِ: كَـ + الـ + عُقَاب — ka-, like, as (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + ʿuqāb, eagle (f., gen.); 'like the eagle'
وَبَقِينَا: وَ + بَقِيَ + نَا — wa-, and + baqiya, to remain, be left (verb I final-weak, perf. 1pl); 'and we were left'
الْحَرَكَةَ: الـ + حَرَكَة — ḥaraka, movement, motion (f., acc., object of nastaṭīʿu); 'moving'
السُّكُونَ: الـ + سُكُون — sukūn, stillness, rest (m., acc., coordinated object); 'keeping still'
الْخَيَّالَةُ: الـ + خَيَّالَة — khayyāla, horsemen, a troop of cavalry (collective, nom.); 'the horsemen'
فَتَحَيَّرْنَا: فَـ + تَحَيَّرَ + نَا — fa-, and so + taḥayyara, to be perplexed, at a loss (verb V, perf. 1pl); 'and we were at a loss'
رَأَيْتُمُوهُمْ: رَأَى + تُمُو + هُمْ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf.) + -tum(ū), you (m. pl.; -ū- added before a suffix) + -hum, them; 'you saw them' (the hamza is the print's)
عَيَّارِينَ: عَيَّارِين — ʿayyārūn, vagabonds, rogues, members of an underworld gang (m. pl. of ʿayyār; acc., predicate of kānū); 'rogues'
لَانَعْرِفُهُمْ: لَا + نَعْرِفُ + هُمْ — lā, not + naʿrifu, we know (ʿarafa, verb I, impf. 1pl) + -hum, them; 'we do not know them' (printed run together)
فَمُغَنُّونَ: فَـ + مُغَنُّون — fa-, then (opening the predicate after ammā) + mughannūn, singers (m. pl. of mughannī, act. part. of ghannā, verb II; nom.); '(we are) singers'
أَخْذَنَا: أَخْذ + نَا — akhdh, taking, carrying off (m., verbal noun of akhadha; acc., object of arādū) + -nā, us (its object); 'to take us'
لِنُغَنِّيَ: لِـ + نُغَنِّيَ — li-, so that, in order to (with the subjunctive) + nughanniya, we sing (ghannā, verb II final-weak, subj. 1pl); 'so that we should sing'
تَخَلَّصْنَا: تَخَلَّصَ + نَا — takhallaṣa, to get free, escape (verb V; from what takes مِنْ) (perf. 1pl); 'we got free'
بِاللَّطَافَةِ: بِـ + الـ + لَطَافَة — bi-, by, by means of (instrumental) + al-, the + laṭāfa, gentleness, courtesy, tact (f., gen.); 'by courtesy'
وَلِينِ: وَ + لِين — wa-, and + līn, softness, gentleness (m., gen., coordinated after bi-; first term of iḍāfa); 'and softness (of)'
فَأَفْرَجُوا: فَـ + أَفْرَجُوا — fa-, and (conj.) + afraja, to release, set free (verb IV; the one freed takes عَنْ) (perf. 3mp); 'and they released'
وَعَلِيِّ: وَ + عَلِيّ — wa-, and + ʿAlī (m. proper name), gen., coordinated after ilā; 'and ʿAlī'
مَوْضِعُكُمْ: مَوْضِع + كُمْ — mawḍiʿ, place, abode (m., nom., predicate of mā) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your place, where you live'
الْحَارَٰتِ: الـ + حَارَات — ḥārāt, quarters, districts of a town (f. pl. of ḥāra; gen. after ayy); spelt in the print without the second alif, supplied here by a dagger alif; 'the quarters'
سَاكِنُونَ: سَاكِنُون — sākinūn, dwelling, living (m. pl. act. part. of sakana, nom., predicate of antum); 'living'
أَدْرِمَا: أَدْرِ + مَا — adri, I know (darā, verb I final-weak, jussive 1s after lam: the final ī drops) + mā, what (interrog.); 'I knew (not) what' (printed run together)
الْخَيَّالَةِ: الـ + خَيَّالَة — khayyāla, horsemen, a troop of cavalry (collective, gen., second term of iḍāfa or after min); 'of the horsemen'
بِزِمَامِهَا: بِـ + زِمَام + هَا — bi-, governed by akhadha 'take hold of' (akhadha bi-, the thing grasped takes bi-) + zimām, halter, leading-rein (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'took hold of her (mount's) rein'
يَقُودُهَا: يَقُودُ + هَا — yaqūdu, he leads (qāda, verb I hollow, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'leading her'
بِالرَّطَانَةِ: بِـ + الـ + رَطَانَة — bi-, in (the language spoken) + al-, the + raṭāna, speech in a foreign or unintelligible tongue (f., gen.); 'in a foreign tongue'
سُمَيْرِيَّتَانِ: سُمَيْرِيَّتَان — sumayriyyatān, two light river boats (dual of sumayriyya, f., nom.); 'two boats'
فَطَلَّعَنَا: فَـ + طَلَّعَ + نَا — fa-, and (conj.) + ṭallaʿa, to make go up, put aboard (verb II of ṭalaʿa, colloquial causative, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us (obj.); 'and he put us aboard' (the fatḥa on the lām is the print's)
وَقَذَفُوا: وَ + قَذَفُوا — wa-, and + qadhafa, to cast; with bi-, to row (a boat) along with (someone) (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they rowed'
نُكَابِدُ: نُكَابِدُ — nukābidu, we endure, suffer (kābada, verb III, impf. 1pl); 'we suffer'
نَتَوَصَّلُ: نَتَوَصَّلُ — natawaṣṣalu, we make our way, reach (tawaṣṣala, verb V; the goal takes إِلَى) (impf. 1pl); 'we get through (to)'
مَوْضِعِنَا: مَوْضِع + نَا — mawḍiʿ, place, abode (m., gen. after ilā) + -nā, our; 'our place, our house'
يُؤَانِسُونَنَا: يُؤَانِسُونَ + نَا — yuʾānisūna, they keep company with, cheer (ānasa, verb III, impf. 3mp; the hamza is the print's) + -nā, us; 'keeping us company'
دَخَلْنَاهَا: دَخَلْنَا + هَا — dakhalnā, we entered (dakhala, verb I, perf. 1pl) + -hā, it (the house, f.); 'we entered it'
وَدَّعَنَا: وَدَّعَ + نَا — waddaʿa, to bid farewell to (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us; 'bade us farewell'
مَكَانَنَا: مَكَان + نَا — makān, place (m., acc., object of dakhalnā) + -nā, our; 'our place'; here acc. of place after tarakūnā: 'they left us where we were'
لَانَقْدِرُ: لَا + نَقْدِرُ — lā, not + naqdiru, we are able (qadara, verb I, impf. 1pl); 'we cannot' (printed run together)
نَتَحَرَّكَ: نَتَحَرَّكَ — nataḥarraka, we move, stir (taḥarraka, verb V, subj. 1pl after an); 'to move'
مَكَانِنَا: مَكَان + نَا — makān, place (m., gen. after min) + -nā, our; 'our place'
وَلَانَدْرِي: وَ + لَا + نَدْرِي — wa-, and + lā, not + nadrī, we know (darā, verb I final-weak, impf. 1pl); 'and we did not know' (printed run together)
فَجَاؤُنِي: فَـ + جَاؤُوا + نِي — fa-, and (conj.) + jāʾū, they came (jāʾa, verb I, perf. 3mp; printed جاوني, hamza supplied) + -nī, (to) me; 'and they came to me'
وَأَيْقَظُونِي: وَ + أَيْقَظُوا + نِي — wa-, and + ayqaẓa, to wake (someone) (verb IV, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'and they woke me'
اسْمَعُوا: اسْمَعُوا — ismaʿū, hear, listen to (imper. mp of samiʿa, verb I); 'hear'
وَحَمِدْتُهُ: وَ + حَمِدْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥamida, to praise (verb I, perf. 1cs; with ʿalā, 'for') + -hu, Him; 'and I praised Him'
الْوُصُولَ: الـ + وُصُول — wuṣūl, arriving, reaching (verbal noun of waṣala, m., acc.); 'to reach'
حَدَّثَتْنِي: حَدَّثَتْ + ـنِي — ḥaddatha, to speak to, tell (verb II, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'told me'
فَنَهْلِكُ: فَـ + نَهْلِكُ — fa-, and so (conj. of consequence) + nahliku: halaka, to perish (verb I, imperf. 1cp, indicative like yaʾkhudhūna before it); 'and we would perish'
بَالُكِ: بَال + ـكِ — bāl, state, case, mind (m., nom.) + -ki, your (fs); mā bāluki, 'what is the matter with you?'
لَاأَقْدِرُ: لَا + اَقْدِرُ — lā, not + qadara, to be able (verb I, imperf. 1cs; with ʿalā, 'to'); the print joins the two; 'I am not able'
الرَّجُلَانِ: الـ + رَجُلَانِ — rajul, man (dual, nom.); 'the two men'
فَسَلَّيْتُ: فَـ + سَلَّيْتُ — fa-, and so + sallā, to console (verb II, defective, perf. 1cs); 'and I consoled'
أَتَّصِلَ: اَتَّصِلَ — ittaṣala, to reach, get to (verb VIII, subj. 1cs after an; here with a direct object); 'I reach'
أَخْفَيْنَا: أَخْفَيْنَا — akhfā (IV of khafiya), to hide, conceal (perf. 1cp); 'we hid'
وَاسْتَدْعَيْتُ: وَ + اسْتَدْعَيْتُ — wa-, and + istadʿā (X of daʿā), to summon, send for (perf. 1cs; the alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'and I sent for'
يُفِيقُ: يُفِيقُ — afāqa, to come to, recover from a swoon (verb IV hollow, imperf. 3ms); 'he will come to'
أَقْبَحِ: aqbaḥ — ugliest, worst (elative of qabīḥ; gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa); ʿalā aqbaḥi ṣifatin, 'in the sorriest state'
فَتَبِعَتْنِي: فَـ + تَبِعَتْ + ـنِي — fa-, and + tabiʿa, to follow (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -nī, me; 'and she followed me'
سُمَيْرِيَّةً: سُمَيْرِيَّة — sumayriyya, a kind of small river boat used on the Tigris (f.; acc. indef., object; the damma, fatḥa and shadda are the print's own); 'a boat'
فَحَدَّثْتُهَا: فَـ + حَدَّثْتُ + هَا — fa-, so, then; ḥaddathtu: ḥaddatha (II), to tell, relate (perf. 1cs); -hā, her (object: the one told); 'so I told her'
وَرَمَيْنَا: وَ + رَمَيْنَا — wa-, and + ramā, to throw, cast (verb I final-weak, perf. 1cp); 'and we threw'
نَتَقَلَّبُ: نَتَقَلَّبُ — taqallaba (V of qalaba), to turn over, toss (imperf. 1cp, indic.); 'we tossed and turned'
أَسْتَطِعِ: اَسْتَطِعْ — istaṭāʿa, to be able (verb X hollow, jussive 1cs after lam; kasra before the article); 'I was able'
اسْتَكْفَيْتُ: اسْتَكْفَيْتُ — istakfā, to have enough, have one's fill (verb X, defective, perf. 1cs); 'I had had enough'
وَمَنَعَنِي: وَ + مَنَعَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + manaʿa, to prevent (verb I, perf. 3ms; with min, 'from') + -nī, me; 'and prevented me'
فَيَأْخُذُونَنِي: فَـ + يَأْخُذُونَ + نِي — fa-, and so (conj. of consequence); yaʾkhudhūna: akhadha, to take, seize (verb I, imperf. 3mp, indicative where Classical would have the subjunctive yaʾkhudhūnī); -nī, me (obj.); 'and they would take me' (the hamza is the print's)
مَطْرُوحَةٌ: مَطْرُوحَة — maṭrūḥa, thrown down, lying (passive participle of طَرَحَ, f. nom. indef., adj.); 'lying (flung down)'
ائْتُونِي: ائْتُوا + ـنِي — atā, to come; with bi-, to bring (verb I, imper. mp) + -nī, me; 'bring me'
بِعَلِيِّ: بِـ + عَلِيّ — bi- (after idhā of surprise it only marks what appears) + ʿAlī (proper n., gen.); 'ʿAlī'
فَتَأَمَّلْتُهَا: فَـ + تَأَمَّلْتُ + ـهَا — fa-, and + taʾammala, to look at closely (verb V, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and I looked at her closely'
وَيُخْبِرُكُمْ: وَ + يُخْبِرُ + ـكُمْ — wa-, and + akhbara, to tell, inform (verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -kum, you (mp); 'and he will tell you'
أَخْرَجَنَا: أَخْرَجَ + نَا — akhraja (IV of kharaja), to bring out, take out (perf. 3ms) + -nā, us (obj.); 'he took us out'
انْدَهَشْتُ: انْدَهَشْتُ — indahasha (VII of dahisha), to be dazed, beside oneself (perf. 1cs; the alif is hamzat al-waṣl); 'I was beside myself'
يُطْلِقُونِي: يُطْلِقُوا + ـنِي — aṭlaqa, to release, let go (verb IV, subj. 3mp after an) + -nī, me; 'that they release me'
يَاقَوْمُ: يَا + قَوْم — yā, O (vocative particle) + qawm, people, folk (m.; vocative, -u); the print joins the two; 'O people'
الْمَسْجِدَ: الـ + مَسْجِد — masjid, mosque (m., acc., direct object of dakhala); 'the mosque'
فَصَلَّيْتُ: فَـ + صَلَّيْتُ — fa-, and + ṣallā, to pray (verb II, defective, perf. 1cs); 'and I prayed'
يَسْأَلُونَهُ: يَسْأَلُونَ + ـهُ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, imperf. 3mp; with ʿan, 'about') + -hu, him; 'asking him'
خَبَرُكِ: خَبَر + كِ — khabar, news, account (m., nom., predicate of mā) + -ki, your (f. sg.); mā khabaruki, 'what is your news?', 'how is it with you?'
فَسَأَلَتْنِي: فَـ + سَأَلَتْ + ـنِي — fa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3fs; with ʿan, 'about') + -nī, me; 'and she asked me'
شَدَّدْتُ: شَدَّدَ — shaddada, to be firm, press hard (verb II, perf. 1cs; with ʿalā, 'on'); 'I was firm'
اسْكُتُوا: اسْكُتُوا — uskutū, be silent (imper. mp of sakata, verb I); 'be quiet'
الْفَرْحَةِ: الـ + فَرْحَة — farḥa, joy, gladness (f., gen. after min, marking the cause); 'for joy'
وَلِسَانُهُ: وَ + لِسَان + ـهُ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + lisān, tongue (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'while his tongue'
وَانْقَلَبْتُ: وَ + انْقَلَبْتُ — wa-, and + inqalaba, to turn over, toss (verb VII, perf. 1cs); 'and I tossed'
سَبِيلِهِمَا: سَبِيل + ـهِمَا — sabīl, way, road (gen.) + -himā, their (dual); ilā ḥāli sabīlihimā, 'about their business'
فَأَوْمَأْتُ: فَـ + اَوْمَأْتُ — fa-, and so + awmaʾa, to make a sign, beckon (verb IV, perf. 1cs; with ilā, 'to'); 'and I signed'
نَنْظُرْهُ: نَنْظُرْ + ـهُ — naẓara, to see (colloquially with a direct object; verb I, jussive 1cp after lam) + -hu, him; 'we see him'
فَاحْمِلْنِي: فَـ + احْمِلْ + نِي — fa-, so + iḥmil: ḥamala, to carry (verb I, imper. 2ms; the alif is hamzat al-waṣl, silent after fa-) + -nī, me (obj.); 'so carry me, take me'
يَسْتَقِرَّلِي: يَسْتَقِرَّ + لِـ + ـي — istaqarra, to settle, be at rest (verb X, doubled, jussive 3ms after lam) + li-, for (prep.) + -ī, me; the print joins the words; 'settle for me'
أُفِقْ: اُفِقْ — afāqa, to come to, recover (verb IV hollow, jussive 1cs after lam); 'I come to'
وَأُفَتِّشُ: وَ + أُفَتِّشُ — wa-, and + fattasha (II), to search (imperf. 1cs, indicative; the shadda and damma are the print's own); with ʿalā, 'search for'; 'and search'; at Night 194 (P855L22) the print has no marks on the word, and the vowels are editorial
النَّاحِيَةَ: الـ + نَاحِيَة — nāḥiya, quarter, district (f., acc.); 'the quarter'
أَنْظُرُهَا: اَنْظُرُ + ـهَا — naẓara, to look at, see (colloquially with a direct object; verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I look at her'
وَخَوَّفْتُهُمْ: وَ + خَوَّفْتُ + ـهُمْ — wa-, and + khawwafa, to make afraid (verb II, perf. 1cs) + -hum, them; 'and I made them afraid'
وَامْرَأَةٌ: وَ + امْرَأَة — wa-, and; imraʾa, woman (f., nom. indef.; the edition prints the hamza); 'and a woman'
دَهَاكَ: دَهَا + ـكَ — dahā, to befall (as a calamity) (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you (ms); 'befell you'
سَيْرِى: سَيْر + ـى — sayr, going, pace (m., gen.) + -ī, my (spelt with ى); 'my going'
فَجَٰأُوا: فَـ + جَاءُوا — fa-, and so + jāʾa, to come; here colloquially 'to bring', with a direct object (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp; printed فجأوا, the hamza on the alif and the long ā supplied with a dagger alif); 'and they brought'
وَأَوْصَلُونَا: وَ + أَوْصَلُوا + نَا — wa-, and; awṣala (IV of waṣala), to bring, convey to (perf. 3mp; the alif of -ū drops before the suffix) + -nā, us (obj.); 'and they brought us'
فَأَطْلَقُونِي: فَـ + اَطْلَقُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and so + aṭlaqa, to release (verb IV, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'and they let me go'
وَهَرْوَلْتُ: وَ + هَرْوَلْتُ — wa-, and + harwala, to hurry, go at a jog-trot (quadriliteral verb, perf. 1cs); 'and I hurried'
صِفَةٍ: صِفَة — ṣifa, description, quality, state (f.; gen. indef., second term after an elative); 'state'
قُولَ: (اَ)قُولَ — the rest of aqūla, from qāla, to say (verb I hollow, subj. 1cs after li-), split off from its prefix by the print; 'may say'
مَحَلِّي: مَحَلّ + ـي — maḥall, place, spot (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my place'
وَسَبَبُهُ: وَ + سَبَب + ـهُ — wa-, and + sabab, cause, reason (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and the reason for it'
رَشُّوا: رَشَّ — rashsha, to sprinkle (verb I, doubled, perf. 3mp); 'they sprinkled'
وَالْوَصِيفَتَانِ: وَ + الـ + وَصِيفَتَان — wa-, and; waṣīfa, maidservant, slave-girl (f.), dual nom. (joined to anā as co-subject); 'and the two maids'
وَسَيِّدَتِي: وَ + سَيِّدَة + ي — wa-, and; sayyida, lady, mistress (f. of سَيِّد) + 1s suffix; 'and my lady'
اعْتَذَرْتُ: اعْتَذَرْتُ — iʿtadhara, to apologise, make excuses (verb VIII, perf. 1cs; with ilā, 'to'); 'I apologised'
أَتَأَوَّهُ: اَتَأَوَّهُ — taʾawwaha, to sigh, groan, say āh (verb V, imperf. 1cs); 'sighing'
بِالْمَلَّاحِ: بِـ + الـ + مَلَّاح — bi- (marking the one summoned, as after daʿā bi-, 'call for'; istadʿā usually takes a direct object) + mallāḥ, boatman (m., gen.); 'for the boatman'
أَدْفَعَ: أَدْفَعَ — adfaʿa, to pay, hand over (dafaʿa, verb I, imperf. 1cs subj. after an); takes ilā for the one paid: an adfaʿa ilā al-rajuli, 'that I pay the man'
جَاؤَ: جَاؤَ — jāʾa, to come (verb I, hollow with final hamza, perf. 3ms), printed جاو with the hamza unwritten and a stray wāw, here pointed as the hamza's seat; with bi-, 'to bring': jāʾa bihā, 'brought her'
حَمَلْتُهَا: حَمَلْتُ + ـهَا — ḥamaltu, I carried (ḥamala, verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I carried her'
أَلْقَيْنَاهَا: أَلْقَيْنَا + ـهَا — alqaynā, we laid, cast (alqā, verb IV, defective, perf. 1cp) + -hā, her; 'we laid her (down)'
فِرَاشِهَا: فِرَاش + ـهَا — firāsh, bed, bedding (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her bed'
مُكَدَّرَةٍ: مُكَدَّرَة — mukaddara, troubled, made turbid (f. pass. part. of kaddara, verb II; gen. indef., agreeing with ḥāla); 'troubled, wretched'
لِلْجَوَارِى: لِـ + الـ + جَوَارِى — li- (here marking the direct object of manaʿa, a Middle Arabic use) + al-, the + jawārī, slave-girls (pl. of jāriya; printed with final ى); 'the slave-girls'
وَالْوُصُولِ: وَ + الـ + وُصُول — wa-, and + al-, the + wuṣūl, arriving, reaching (verbal noun of waṣala; m., gen.); with ilā, 'getting to (someone)'
مَقْبَرَةٍ: مَقْبَرَة — maqbara, graveyard, burial-ground (f., gen. indef. after min); 'a graveyard'
فَرَشّْتُ: فَـ + رَشّْتُ — fa-, and so + rashshtu, I sprinkled (rashsha, verb I doubled, perf. 1cs, with the doubled letter kept whole as in spoken Arabic; Classical rashashtu); 'and I sprinkled'
وَغَسَّلْتُ: وَ + غَسَّلْتُ — wa-, and + ghassaltu, I washed thoroughly (ghassala, verb II, perf. 1cs); 'and I washed'
أُلَاطِفُهَا: أُلَاطِفُ + ـهَا — ulāṭifu, I treat kindly, coax (lāṭafa, verb III, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I coax her'
أَطْعَمْتُهَا: أَطْعَمْتُ + ـهَا — aṭʿamtu, I fed (aṭʿama, verb IV, perf. 1cs; two objects, the one fed and the food) + -hā, her; 'I fed her'
وَأَسْقَيْتُهَا: وَ + أَسْقَيْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + asqaytu, I gave to drink (asqā, verb IV, defective, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and I gave her to drink'
قَابِلِيَّةٌ: قَابِلِيَّة — qābiliyya, receptiveness; inclination, appetite (f., nom. indef.; post-Classical abstract from qābil, 'accepting'); with fī, 'appetite for'
أُعَاتِبُهَا: أُعَاتِبُ + ـهَا — uʿātibu, I reproach gently, chide (ʿātaba, verb III, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I chide her'
وَارْفُقِي: وَ + ارْفُقِي — wa-, and + urfuqī, be gentle! (rafaqa, verb I, imper. 2fs; takes bi- for the one treated gently); 'and be gentle'
رَأَيْتِ: رَأَيْتِ — raʾayti, you saw (raʾā, verb I, perf. 2fs; the kasra is the print's own); 'you (f.) have seen'
أَشْرَفْتِ: أَشْرَفْتِ — ashrafti, you were on the verge (ashrafa, verb IV, perf. 2fs; with ʿalā, 'to be on the brink of'); 'you were at the brink'
سَأَلُونِي: سَأَلُوا + ـنِي — saʾalū, they asked (saʾala, verb I, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'they asked me'
فَصَدَّقُونِي: فَـ + صَدَّقُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and so + ṣaddaqū, they believed (ṣaddaqa, verb II, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'and they believed me'
عَوَامِّ: عَوَامّ — ʿawāmm, the common people (pl. of ʿāmma; gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); ʿawāmm al-nās, 'the common folk'
مَوْضِعِهِمْ: مَوْضِع + ـهِمْ — mawḍiʿ, place, spot (m., gen. after ilā) + -him, their; 'their place'
نُسْرِعُ: نُسْرِعُ — nusriʿu, we hurry (asraʿa, verb IV, imperf. 1cp); 'we were hurrying'
اسْتَقَرُّوا: اسْتَقَرُّوا — istaqarrū, they settled, came to rest (istaqarra, verb X doubled, perf. 3mp); with bi-, 'to settle (someone) with them': istaqarrū binā, 'they had us settled'
تَأَمَّلُونِي: تَأَمَّلُوا + ـنِي — taʾammalū, they scrutinised (taʾammala, verb V, perf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'they looked me over'
وَالْعُقُودِ: وَ + الـ + عُقُود — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿuqūd, necklaces (pl. of ʿiqd; gen.); 'and the necklaces'
فَأَنْكَرُوا: فَـ + أَنْكَرُوا — fa-, and so + ankarū, they found strange, mistrusted (ankara, verb IV, perf. 3mp); 'and they mistrusted'
الْعُقُودَ: الـ + عُقُود — al-, the + ʿuqūd, necklaces (pl. of ʿiqd; acc. after inna); 'the necklaces'
فَاصْدُقِينَا: فَـ + اصْدُقِي + ـنَا — fa-, so + uṣduqī, be truthful (with)! (ṣadaqa, verb I, imper. 2fs; takes the person told directly) + -nā, us; 'so tell us the truth'
قَضِيَّتُكِ: قَضِيَّة + ـكِ — qaḍiyya, case, affair (f., nom., predicate of mā) + -ki, your (f.; the kasra is the print's own); 'your case'
يَقْتُلُونَنِي: يَقْتُلُونَ + ـنِي — qatala, to kill (verb I, imperf. 3mp) + -nī, me; 'they will kill me'
الْحَلْيِ: الـ + حَلْي — ḥaly, jewellery, ornaments (coll., m., gen. after min); 'the jewellery'
أَنْطِقْ: أَنْطِقْ — naṭaqa, to speak, utter (verb I, jussive 1cs after lam); with bi- of the thing uttered; '(I did not) utter'
الْعَيَّارُونَ: الـ + عَيَّارُونَ — ʿayyārūn, rogues, vagabonds, street-toughs (pl. of ʿayyār; m., nom.); 'the rogues' (the shadda is sometimes the print's own)
رُؤْيَتَكَ: رُؤْيَة + ـكَ — ruʾya, sight, look, appearance (f., acc. after inna; printed with ؤ) + -ka, your; 'your look'
نَكْتُمُ: نَكْتُمُ — katama, to hide, keep secret (verb I, imperf. 1cp); 'we hide'
وَنَبْكِي: وَ + نَبْكِي — wa-, and + bakā, to weep (verb I defective, imperf. 1cp); 'and we weep'
فَحَنَّنَ: فَـ + حَنَّنَ — fa-, and + ḥannana, to make tender, soften (verb II of ḥanna, perf. 3ms; ʿalā, toward); 'and (God) softened'
كُنْتُمَا: كُنْتُمَا — kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 2 dual); 'you two were'
فُلَانٌ: فُلَان — fulān, So-and-so, such a one (m., nom. indef.), standing in for a name not given
وَعَلَيَّ: وَ + عَلَى + ـيَّ — wa-, and + ʿalā, upon (prep.) + 1cs suffix; wa-ʿalayya an …, 'and it is upon me to …', I undertake to
آتِيَكُمْ: آتِيَ + ـكُمْ — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 1cs subjunctive after an; the madda is the print's own) + -kum, you (pl.); with bi-, 'bring': an ātiyakum bihi, 'that I bring him to you'
يَجْعَلُونِي: يَجْعَلُوا + ـنِي — jaʿala, to put, place, make (verb I, subjunctive 3mp after an) + -nī, me; 'that they put me'
اسْتَرِيحَا: اسْتَرِيحَا — istarāḥa, to rest, be at ease (verb X hollow, imperative 2 dual); 'rest, you two'
خَبَرُكُمَا: خَبَر + ـكُمَا — khabar, news, story (m., nom.) + -kumā, your (dual); 'your story'
صَاحِبَهُمْ: صَاحِب + ـهُمْ — ṣāḥib, companion, comrade (m., acc. after inna) + -hum, their; 'their comrade'
أَحْضَرَلَنَا: أَحْضَرَ + لِـ + ـنَا — aḥḍara, to fetch, bring (verb IV of ḥaḍara, perf. 3ms) + li-, for (prep., of benefit) + -nā, us; 'he fetched for us' (printed as one word)
خَيَّالَةٌ: خَيَّالَة — khayyāla, horsemen, a troop of cavalry (collective, f. in form; nom. indef.); 'some horsemen'
الْعَسَسِ: الـ + عَسَس — ʿasas, the night watch, patrol (coll., gen.); 'the night watch'
فَتَكَلَّمْتُ: فَـ + تَكَلَّمْتُ — fa-, so + takallama, to speak (verb V, perf. 1cs; maʿa, with); 'so I spoke' (the final damma is the print's own)
مَعَارِفِي: مَعَارِف + ـي — maʿārif, acquaintances (pl. of maʿrifa; gen.) + -ī, my; 'my acquaintances'
فَأَوْصَلُونِي: فَـ + أَوْصَلُوا + ـنِي — fa-, and + awṣala, to bring, convey (verb IV of waṣala, perf. 3mp; ilā, to) + -nī, me; 'and they brought me'
رَأَوْكُمْ: رَأَوْا + ـكُمْ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3mp; hamza printed) + -kum, you (pl.); 'they saw you'
فَرُّوا: فَرُّوا — farra, to flee (verb I doubled, perf. 3mp; the shadda is printed); 'they fled'
هَارِبِينَ: هَارِبِينَ — hārib, fleeing, running away (act. part. of haraba; m. pl., acc., circumstantial); 'in flight'
قَادِرَةٌ: قَادِرَة — qādira, able, capable (act. part. of qadara; f., nom., predicate; ʿalā, of); 'able (to)'
عَرَفَنِي: عَرَفَ + ـنِي — ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'he knew me'
وَأَرْكَبَنِي: وَ + أَرْكَبَ + ـنِي — wa-, and + arkaba, to make ride, set on a mount (verb IV of rakiba, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he set me on (his mount)'
وَالْجَوْهَرِيِّ: وَ + الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — wa-, and + jawharī, jeweller (m., gen.); 'and the jeweller'
أَجْلِهِمَا: أَجْل + ـهِمَا — ajl, sake, cause (m., gen. after min) + -himā, the two of them; min ajlihimā, 'because of the two of them'
رَفِيقِ: رَفِيق — rafīq, companion, friend (m., gen., in apposition; construct); 'the friend of'
فَامْضِي: فَـ + امْضِي — fa-, so + maḍā, to go (verb I defective, imperative f. sg.); 'so go'
وَاسْتَخْبِرِي: وَ + اسْتَخْبِرِي — wa-, and + istakhbara, to ask for news (verb X of khabara, imperative f. sg.; min of the person asked, the matter as object); 'and ask (him) for news of'
فَكَلَّمْتُهَا: فَـ + كَلَّمْتُ + ـهَا — fa-, so + kallama, to speak to (verb II, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'so I spoke to her'
وَلُمْتُهَا: وَ + لُمْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + lāma, to blame, reproach (verb I hollow, perf. 1cs; ʿalā, for) + -hā, her; 'and I reproached her'
وَحَذَّرْتُهَا: وَ + حَذَّرْتُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥadhdhara, to warn (verb II, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and I warned her'
خَافِي: خَافِي — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, imperative f. sg.; ʿalā, for); 'fear (for)'
وَغَضِبَتْ: وَ + غَضِبَتْ — wa-, and + ghaḍiba, to be angry (verb I, perf. 3fs; min, at); 'and she was angry'
أَجِدْكَ: أَجِدْ + ـكَ — wajada, to find (verb I assimilated, jussive 1cs after lam) + -ka, you; '(I did not) find you'
أَرْتَقِبُكَ: أَرْتَقِبُ + ـكَ — irtaqaba, to watch for, wait for (verb VIII of raqaba, imperf. 1cs) + -ka, you; 'watching for you'
أَسْأَلَكَ: أَسْأَلَ + ـكَ — saʾala, to ask (verb I, subjunctive 1cs after ḥattā; the hamza on the alif seat is printed) + -ka, you; 'that I may ask you'
فَأَسْأَلُكَ: فَـ + أَسْأَلُ + ـكَ — fa-, and + saʾala, to ask, beg (verb I, imperf. 1cs; the hamza on the alif seat is printed) + -ka, you; 'and I beg you'
اسْتَعَرْتَ: اسْتَعَرْتَ — istaʿāra, to borrow (verb X hollow of ʿ-w-r, perf. 2ms); 'you borrowed'
فَتَحْتَاجُ: فَـ + تَحْتَاجُ — fa-, so + iḥtāja, to need (verb VIII hollow, imperf. 2ms; followed by an); 'so you need (to)'
تُعَوِّضَ: تُعَوِّضَ — ʿawwaḍa, to compensate, make good (verb II, subjunctive 2ms after an); here with ʿalā of the persons repaid (Middle Arabic); 'that you make good'
سِيرِي: سِيرِي — sāra, to go, travel (verb I hollow, imperative f. sg.); 'go, lead on'
الْجَوْهَرِىَّ: الـ + جَوْهَرِيّ — jawharī, jeweller (m., acc. as the noun of anna; printed with final ى); 'the jeweller'
وَرَفَعَتْهُ: وَ + رَفَعَتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + rafaʿat, she raised (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; with ilā, 'to hand up to', give over; 'and she handed it over'
وَأَتَحَمَّلُ: وَ + أَتَحَمَّلُ — wa-, and + taḥammala, to take upon oneself, bear (verb V, imperf. 1cs); 'and I shall bear'
الصُّعُوبَةَ: الـ + صُعُوبَة — ṣuʿūba, difficulty, hardship (f., acc.); 'the trouble'
خَاطِرِكِ: خَاطِر + ـكِ — khāṭir, mind, feelings (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); li-ajli khāṭiriki, 'for your sake, to please you'
وَأَتَدَبَّرُ: وَ + أَتَدَبَّرُ — wa-, and + tadabbara, to ponder, think out (verb V, imperf. 1cs); with fī, 'to plan for'; 'and I shall think out'
يُوصِلُكِ: يُوصِلُ + ـكِ — awṣala, to make arrive, bring (verb IV of waṣala, imperf. 3ms) + -ki, you (f.); 'will bring you'
يَتَعَذَّرُ: taʿadhdhara, to be impossible, out of reach (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'it is impossible'
الْوُصُولُ: الـ + وُصُول — wuṣūl, arriving, reaching (verbal noun of waṣala; m., nom.); with ilā, 'getting to'
بِمَحَلٍّ: بِـ + مَحَلّ — bi-, of (prep.; akhbara takes it for the thing told) + maḥall, place (m., gen. indef.); 'of a place'
آتِيكَ: آتِي + ـكَ — atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 1cs; the madda is printed) + -ka, you, as direct object; 'I may come to you'
فَحَمَلْتُ: فَـ + حَمَلْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḥamala, to carry (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I carried'
وَعَدَدْتُ: وَ + عَدَدْتُ — wa-, and + ʿadda, to count (verb I doubled, perf. 1cs, the two dāls kept apart before the ending); 'and I counted'
فَأَعْطَيْتُ: فَـ + أَعْطَيْتُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'and I gave'
بِالْمِعْمَارِينَ: بِـ + الـ + مِعْمَارِين — bi-, with (prep.; after jāʾa, 'come with' = 'bring') + al-, the + miʿmārīn, master-builders (sound pl. of miʿmār, gen.); 'brought the master-builders'
وَالنَّجَّارِينَ: وَ + الـ + نَجَّارِين — wa-, and + al-, the + najjārīn, carpenters (sound pl. of najjār, gen.; the shadda of the jīm is printed); 'and the carpenters'
وَالْبَنَّائِينَ: وَ + الـ + بَنَّائِين — wa-, and + al-, the + bannāʾīn, builders, masons (sound pl. of bannāʾ, gen.; the shadda and hamza are printed); 'and the masons'
فَأَعَادُوهَا: فَـ + أَعَادُوا + ـهَا — fa-, and so + aʿāda, to bring back, restore (verb IV of ʿāda, perf. 3mp) + -hā, it (the house, f.); 'and they restored it'
تَمَشَّيْتُ: tamashshā, to walk, stroll (verb V of mashā, perf. 1cs); 'I walked over'
وَوَعَدَنَا: وَ + وَعَدَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + waʿada, to promise (verb I, perf. 3ms; the fatḥa on the dāl is printed) + -nā, us; 'and he promised us'
وَيُفَتِّشُونَ: وَ + يُفَتِّشُونَ — wa-, and + fattasha, to search (verb II, imperf. 3mp; the shadda is printed); with ʿalā, 'to search for'; 'and they are searching'
عَافِيَتُهُ: عَافِيَة + ـهُ — ʿāfiya, well-being, health (f., nom., subject of rajaʿat) + -hu, his; 'his health'
يَذْكُرُكَ: يَذْكُرُ + ـكَ — dhakara, to mention, remember (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'he speaks of you'
تُحْضِرُوهُ: تُحْضِرُوا + ـهُ — aḥḍara, to bring (verb IV, imperf. 2mp subjunctive after an, the final nūn dropped) + -hu, him; 'that you bring him'
سَكْرَتِهِ: سَكْرَة + ـهِ — sakra, drunkenness, stupor (f., gen. after ilā) + -hi, his; 'his stupor'
أَسْنَدْتُهُ: أَسْنَدْتُ + ـهُ — asnada, to prop up, make lean (verb IV, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I propped him up'
وَأَجْلَسْتُهُ: وَ + أَجْلَسْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ajlasa, to make sit, seat (verb IV of jalasa, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'and I sat him up'
وَضَمَمْتُهُ: وَ + ضَمَمْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḍamma, to press, clasp (verb I doubled, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; with ilā, 'to hold (to one's breast)'; 'and I clasped him'
مُشَاهَدَتِكَ: مُشَاهَدَة + ـكَ — mushāhada, beholding, seeing (verbal noun of shāhada, III; f., gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, you, the one seen; 'the sight of you'
أُسْنِدُهُ: أُسْنِدُ + ـهُ — asnada, to prop up, support (verb IV, imperf. 1cs) + -hu, him; after lam azal, 'I kept supporting him'
أَوْقَفْتُهُ: أَوْقَفْتُ + ـهُ — awqafa, to make stand (verb IV of waqafa, perf. 1cs) + -hu, him; 'I stood him up'
وَمَشَّيْتُهُ: وَ + مَشَّيْتُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + mashshā, to make walk (verb II of mashā, perf. 1cs; the shadda is printed) + -hu, him; 'and I walked him'
يَطِيبَ: ṭāba, to be good, pleasant (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an); with khāṭir as subject, 'to be cheered'
يَسْمَعْنِي: يَسْمَعْ + ـنِي — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam) + -nī, me; lam yasmaʿnī, 'did not hear me'
وَحَيْلَكَ: وَ + حَيْل + ـكَ — wa-, and + ḥayl, strength, power (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your strength'
مَايَسُرُّكَ: مَا + يَسُرُّ + ـكَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + sarra, to gladden (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -ka, you; 'what will gladden you' (printed as one word)
وَنُدَاوِيكَ: وَ + نُدَاوِي + ـكَ — wa-, and + dāwā, to treat, cure (verb III, imperf. 1cp) + -ka, you; 'and we shall cure you'
فَتَفَرَّقُوا: فَـ + تَفَرَّقُوا — fa-, and so + tafarraqa, to disperse, go their ways (verb V, perf. 3mp; the shadda is printed); 'and they dispersed'
وَاعْتَذَرَلِي: وَ + اعْتَذَرَ + لِـ + ـي — wa-, and + iʿtadhara, to apologise (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + li-, to (prep., marking the one apologised to) + -ī, me; 'and he apologised to me' (printed as one word)
بِكَذَا: بِـ + كَذَا — bi- (after the imperative of atā, 'come with' = 'bring', the verb chooses bi-, which marks what is brought) + kadhā, such, so-and-so; 'bring me such'
بِفَرْشٍ: بِـ + فَرْش — bi- (after atā, 'come with' = 'bring', bi- marks what is brought) + farsh, furnishing: rugs, mattresses, cushions (m., gen. indef.); 'they brought … furnishings'
نَفِيسٍ: نَفِيس — nafīs, precious, costly (adj., m., gen. indef.); 'costly'
وَبُسُطٍ: وَ + بُسُط — wa-, and + busuṭ, carpets (pl. of bisāṭ, gen. indef.); 'and carpets'
تَعَالِيقِ: تَعَالِيق — taʿālīq, things hung up: lamps, chains, ornaments (pl. of taʿlīq, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'hangings of'
شَئٍ: شَئ — shayʾ, thing (m., gen. indef.; the print's spelling of شَيْء, with the hamza on a yāʾ-seat and no separate yāʾ); 'thing'
نِهَايَةً: نِهَايَة — nihāya, end, limit (f., acc. indef., noun of anna); 'an end'
الْوِصَالُ: الـ + وِصَال — wiṣāl, union, the lovers' coming together (m., nom.); 'union'
مِتُّ: مِتُّ — mittu, I died (māta, verb I hollow, perf. 1cs, the form with i, beside muttu); after laytanī, 'would that I had died'
لَافْتَضَحْنَا: لَـ + افْتَضَحْنَا — la-, then surely (opening the answer of lawlā) + iftaḍaḥa, to be disgraced, exposed (verb VIII, perf. 1cp); 'we would have been disgraced'
لَعَجَّلْتُ: لَـ + عَجَّلْتُ — la-, then surely (opening the answer of lawlā) + ʿajjala, to hasten (verb II, perf. 1cs; ʿalā the one it falls on, bi- the thing hastened); 'I would have hastened'
هَالِكَةٌ: هَالِكَة — hālika, perishing, doomed (act. part. of halaka, f., nom. indef.); 'perishing'
