الْغُصَصِ: الـ + غُصَص — ghuṣaṣ, chokings, griefs that catch in the throat (pl. of ghuṣṣa, gen.); 'the griefs'
وَأَجَلٌ: وَ + أَجَل — wa-, and + ajal, appointed term, the hour of death (m., nom. indef.); 'and a term'
لِلصَّبِّ: لِـ + الـ + صَبّ — li-, for (prep.; marks the lover for whom his tears have run, and run enough) + ṣabb, ardent lover (m., gen.); 'for the lover'
مَدْمَعُهُ: مَدْمَع + ـهُ — madmaʿ, the place tears flow from, and so the flow of tears (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his tears'
الْاَسَى: الـ + اَسَى — asā, grief, sorrow (m., nom.; printed with bare alif, no hamza); 'grief'
يَرْدَعُهُ: يَرْدَعُ + ـهُ — radaʿa, to restrain, hold back (verb I, imperf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'from') + -hu, him; 'holds him back'
لِلْاَسْرَارِ: لِـ + الـ + اَسْرَار — li-, here marking the object of yajmaʿu, 'gathers' + asrār, secrets (pl. of sirr, gen.; printed with bare alif); '(gathers) the secrets'
كَاتِمُهَا: كَاتِم + ـهَا — kātim, keeper, concealer (act. part. of katama, m., nom.) + -hā, their (the secrets); 'their keeper'
فَفَرَّقَتْ: فَـ + فَرَّقَتْ — fa-, then, and so + farraqa, to scatter, disperse (verb II, perf. 3fs, its subject ʿayn, 'eye', f.); 'then (his eye) scattered'
يَجْمَعُهُ: يَجْمَعُ + ـهُ — jamaʿa, to gather (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, it (taking up mā, 'what'); 'he was gathering it'
بِالْعَوْدِ: بِـ + الـ + عَوْد — bi- (after asraʿa, 'to hurry', bi- marks what one makes haste over) + ʿawd, return (m., verbal noun of ʿāda, gen.); 'hurry with the return', come back quickly
أَسْتَتِمَّ: أَسْتَتِمَّ — istatamma, to complete (verb X doubled, jussive 1cs after lam, with fatḥa); 'I had (not) finished'
الْجُلُوسَ: الـ + جُلُوس — julūs, sitting (m., verbal noun of jalasa, acc. object); 'the sitting (down)'
مُخْتَنِقَةٌ: مُخْتَنِقَة — mukhtaniqa, choking, stifled (act. part. VIII of khanaqa, f., nom. indef.; with bi-, 'choking with'); 'choking'
نَخَافُهُ: نَخَافُ + ـهُ — khāfa, to fear (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cp) + -hu, it; 'we fear it'
صَادَفْتُ: صَادَفْتُ — ṣādafa, to come upon, find (verb III, perf. 1cs); 'I found'
مُغْتَاظَةٌ: مُغْتَاظَة — mughtāẓa, enraged (act. part. VIII of ghāẓa, f., nom. indef.; with ʿalā, 'angry with'); 'enraged'
وَصِيفَةٍ: وَصِيفَة — waṣīfa, maid, young maidservant (f., gen. indef.); 'a maid'
الْوَصِيفَتَيْنِ: الـ + وَصِيفَتَيْن — waṣīfa, maid (f.), dual, gen. after min; 'the two maids'
بِضَرْبِهَا: بِـ + ضَرْب + ـهَا — bi- (amara bi-, 'to order': the verb chooses bi-, which marks the thing ordered) + ḍarb, beating (verbal noun, gen.) + -hā, her (the one beaten); 'ordered her beaten'
فَخَافَتْ: فَـ + خَافَتْ — fa-, and so + khāfa, to be afraid (verb I hollow, perf. 3fs); 'so she took fright'
وَهَرَبَتْ: وَ + هَرَبَتْ — wa-, and + haraba, to flee (verb I, perf. 3fs; with min, 'from'); 'and she fled'
فَلَاقَاهَا: فَـ + لَاقَى + ـهَا — fa-, and then + lāqā, to meet (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and (one) met her'
رَدَّهَا: رَدّ + ـهَا — radd, sending back (verbal noun of radda, acc. object of arāda) + -hā, her (its object); 'to take her back'
فَلَوَّحَتْ: فَـ + لَوَّحَتْ — fa-, and + lawwaḥa, to hint, give a sign (verb II, perf. 3fs; li- the one hinted to, bi- the means); 'and she hinted'
فَلَاطَفَهَا: فَـ + لَاطَفَ + ـهَا — fa-, and so + lāṭafa, to treat kindly, coax (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'so he coaxed her'
وَاسْتَنْطَقَهَا: وَ + اسْتَنْطَقَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + istanṭaqa, to make (someone) speak, question (verb X of naṭaqa, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'about') + -hā, her; 'and he drew her out'
بِنَقْلِ: بِـ + نَقْل — bi- (amara bi-, 'to order': bi- marks the thing ordered) + naql, moving, removal (verbal noun of naqala, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'ordered the moving of'
أَجْتَمِعْ: أَجْتَمِعْ — ijtamaʿa, to meet (verb VIII, jussive 1cs after lam; with bi-, 'meet with'); 'I have (not) met'
أُعْلِمْهَا: أُعْلِمْ + ـهَا — aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, jussive 1cs after lam; with bi-, 'of') + -hā, her; 'I have (not) told her' (the letters also allow aʿlamhā, 'I have (not) learnt it')
وَتَوَهَّمْتُ: وَ + تَوَهَّمْتُ — wa-, and + tawahhama, to suppose, suspect (verb V, perf. 1cs); 'and I supposed'
أَحْتَالُ: أَحْتَالُ — iḥtāla, to contrive, use a ruse (verb VIII hollow, imperf. 1cs); 'I contrive'
وَأَمْرِهِمَا: وَ + أَمْر + ـهِمَا — wa-, and + amr, affair (m., gen., joined to amrī after fī) + -himā, of the two of them; 'and their affair'
وَأَقْرَبُ: وَ + أَقْرَب — wa-, and + aqrab, nearer, fitter (elative of qarīb, nom.; with li-, 'fitter for'); 'and fitter'
وَأَحْفَظُ: وَ + أَحْفَظ — wa-, and + aḥfaẓ, better at keeping, more to be trusted (elative of ḥafiẓa, nom.; with li-, 'for'); 'and better at keeping'
أُهْبَةٍ: أُهْبَة — uhba, readiness, preparedness (f., gen. indef. after ʿalā); ʿalā uhbatin, 'in readiness'
وَحَذَرٍ: وَ + حَذَر — wa-, and + ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., gen. indef., joined to uhba after ʿalā); 'and on guard'
نَتَدَبَّرُ: نَتَدَبَّرُ — tadabbara, to ponder, think out (verb V, imperf. 1cp, indic.; with fī, 'about'); 'we (will) think out'
نَفْعَلُهُ: نَفْعَلُ + ـهُ — faʿala, to do (verb I, imperf. 1cp) + -hu, it (taking up amr); 'that we may do'
هَمٌّ: هَمّ — hamm, care, worry, dread (m., nom. indef.); the print puts a shadda on the م
الْكَوْنُ: الـ + كَوْن — kawn, being, existence; here the world around one (m., nom.); 'the world'
وَهَمَّتِ: وَ + هَمَّتْ — wa-, and + hamma, to set about, be on the point of (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs, linking -i before al-; here with li- + subjunctive); 'and she made to'; the print puts a shadda on the م
لِتَمْضِيَ: لِـ + تَمْضِيَ — li-, to, in order to (governs the subjunctive; after hamma it names what she set about) + maḍā, to go off (verb I defective, subj. 3fs); 'to go'
تُبَادِرَ: تُبَادِرَ — bādara, to hasten (verb III, subj. 2ms after an; with ilā, 'to'); 'that you hasten'
بِتَبْلِيغِ: بِـ + تَبْلِيغ — bi- (ʿalayka bi-, 'it is on you to, see to': bi- marks the thing one is charged with) + tablīgh, conveying, delivering (verbal noun of ballagha, II, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'see to the conveying of'
تُبْعِدِ: تُبْعِدِ — abʿada, to make far, put at a distance (verb IV, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā, linking -i before al-); 'do not make (the distance) far'
الْمَسَافَةَ: الـ + مَسَافَة — masāfa, distance, the way (f., acc., object of tubʿid); 'the distance'
أَتَقَيَّدَ: أَتَقَيَّدَ — taqayyada, to bind oneself, take on as a duty (verb V of qayyada, subj. 1cs after an; with bi-, 'to': bi- marks the duty); 'that I bind myself (to)'
بِاسْتِنْشَاقِ: بِـ + اسْتِنْشَاق — bi- (taqayyada bi-, 'to bind oneself to': the verb chooses bi-, which marks the duty) + istinshāq, sniffing, scenting out (verbal noun of istanshaqa, X, gen., first term of iḍāfa); 'to the scenting out of'
يُمَنِّي: يُمَنِّي — mannā, to fill with hopes (verb II defective, imperf. 3ms; mannā nafsahu bi-, 'to feed oneself with the hope of': bi- marks the thing hoped for); 'he feeds (himself) with hopes'; the print puts a shadda on the ن
وَيُعَلِّلُهَا: وَ + يُعَلِّلُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ʿallala, to divert, soothe, put off (verb II, imperf. 3ms; ʿallala bi-, 'to soothe with': bi- marks the means) + -hā, her, i.e. his nafs, 'self' (f.); 'and soothes it'; the print puts a shadda on the first ل
أَتْصِرْ: أَتْصِرْ — as printed; not a known word. Vocalised on the pattern of aqṣir, 'desist!' (aqṣara, verb IV, imper. 2ms; with ʿan or min, 'from'), the likeliest reading (ق set as ت); iqtaṣir or ikhtaṣir, 'cut it short', are also possible; doubtful
التَّعَلُّقِ: الـ + تَعَلُّق — taʿalluq, attachment, clinging (verbal noun of taʿallaqa, V, gen. after min); 'the attachment'
الْمُطَالِ: الـ + مُطَال — muṭāl, drawn out, prolonged (pass. part. of aṭāla, IV of ṭāla; m., gen., adj.); 'drawn-out'
الِاشْتِغَالِ: الـ + اشْتِغَال — ishtighāl, being busy, preoccupation (verbal noun of ishtaghala, VIII, gen. after min); 'the preoccupation'
حَدَثَ: حَدَثَ — ḥadatha, to happen, occur (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'has happened'
وَمَالِكَ: وَ + مَال + ـكَ — wa-, and + māl, wealth, property (m., gen., joined to nafsika) + -ka, your; 'and your wealth'
وَانْزَعَجَ: وَ + انْزَعَجَ — wa-, and + inzaʿaja, to be alarmed, disturbed (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'and he was alarmed'
تَالِفٌ: تَالِف — tālif, perishing, ruined (act. part. of talifa, m., nom. indef., predicate after anna); 'done for'
تُفَارِقَ: تُفَارِقَ — fāraqa, to part from, leave (verb III, subj. 3fs after an; its subject rūḥ, 'soul', is f.); 'that it leave'
اسْتَرْجَعَ: اسْتَرْجَعَ — istarjaʿa, verb X of rajaʿa, perf. 3ms: to say 'we are God's and to Him we return' (innā li-llāhi wa-innā ilayhi rājiʿūna) at a calamity, and so to collect oneself after a blow; 'he recovered himself'
مَاتَقْدِرُ: مَا + تَقْدِرُ — mā, what (rel.) + qadara, to be able (verb I, imperf. 2ms; with ʿalā, 'to be able for, manage'); run together in the print; 'what you can manage'
غِلْمَانِكَ: غِلْمَان + ـكَ — ghilmān, lads, servants (m. pl. of ghulām, gen. after min) + -ka, your; 'your lads'
مَاتَثِقُ: مَا + تَثِقُ — mā, what (rel.; here used of persons) + wathiqa, to trust (verb I assimilated, imperf. 2ms; with bi-, 'to trust in': the verb chooses bi-, which marks the one trusted); run together in the print; 'whom you trust'
دِيَارٍ: دِيَار — diyār, lands, abodes (pl. of dār; gen. indef. after ilā); 'lands'
مُتَخَبِّلٌ: مُتَخَبِّل — mutakhabbil, distracted, deranged in mind (act. part. of takhabbala, V, from khabl, 'madness'; m., nom. indef.); 'out of his wits'
وَمُتَحَيِّرٌ: وَ + مُتَحَيِّر — wa-, and + mutaḥayyir, perplexed, at a loss (act. part. of taḥayyara, V; m., nom. indef.); 'and bewildered'
فَتَارَةً: فَـ + تَارَةً — fa-, and so + tāra, a time, once (f., acc. of time); tāratan … wa-tāratan, 'now … and now'
بِمَقْصُودِهِ: بِـ + مَقْصُود + ـهِ — bi- (awṣā bi-, 'to charge with, give instructions about': the verb chooses bi-, which marks the matter enjoined) + maqṣūd, intention, purpose (pass. part. of qaṣada, gen.) + -hi, his; 'about what he intended'
دَابَّتَهُ: دَابَّة + ـهُ — dābba, mount, riding beast (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his mount'
مُتَنَكِّرُونَ: مُتَنَكِّرُون — mutanakkir, disguised (act. part. of tanakkara, V; m. pl., nom.); 'in disguise'; the print puts a shadda on the ك
حَطَطْنَا: حَطَطْنَا — ḥaṭṭa, to put down, unload (verb I doubled, perf. 1cp, the two ṭāʾs kept apart before a consonant ending); 'we set down'
حُمُولَنَا: حُمُول + ـنَا — ḥumūl, loads (pl. of ḥiml, acc.) + -nā, our; 'our loads'
وَعَقَلْنَا: وَ + عَقَلْنَا — wa-, and + ʿaqala, to hobble (a camel, by tying up a foreleg) (verb I, perf. 1cp); 'and we hobbled'
جِمَالَنَا: جِمَال + ـنَا — jimāl, camels (pl. of jamal, acc.) + -nā, our; 'our camels'
فَحَلَّ: فَـ + حَلَّ — fa-, and then + ḥalla, to come down, alight (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'upon'); 'and (weariness) came down'; the print puts a shadda on the ل
وَغَفَلْنَا: وَ + غَفَلْنَا — wa-, and + ghafala, to be heedless (verb I, perf. 1cp; with ʿan, 'of'); 'and we were heedless'
بِاللُّصُوصِ: بِـ + الـ + لُصُوص — bi- (after wa-idhā of surprise it only marks what appears) + al-, the + luṣūṣ, thieves, robbers (pl. of liṣṣ, gen.); 'and behold, the robbers'
يَمْنَعُوا: يَمْنَعُوا — manaʿa, to prevent, keep off (verb I, subj. 3mp after an; with ʿan, 'to keep (harm) off', to defend); 'that they defend'
تَرَكُونَا: تَرَكُوا + ـنَا — taraka, to leave (verb I, perf. 3mp; the alif after -ū is not written before a suffix) + -nā, us; 'they left us'
فَدَخَلْنَاهَا: فَـ + دَخَلْنَا + ـهَا — fa-, and + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 1cp) + -hā, it (the town; balad treated as feminine); 'and we entered it'
وَقَصَدْنَا: وَ + قَصَدْنَا — wa-, and + qaṣada, to make for, head to (verb I, perf. 1cp); 'and we made for'
مَسْجِدَهَا: مَسْجِد + ـهَا — masjid, mosque (m., acc.) + -hā, its (the town's); 'its mosque'
عُرْيَانُونَ: عُرْيَانُون — ʿuryān, naked, stripped (adj., m. sound pl., nom.; the regular plural of ʿuryān, which takes no broken plural; ʿurāh is the plural of the synonym ʿārin); 'naked'
صَلَّيْنَا: صَلَّيْنَا — ṣallā, to pray (verb II defective, perf. 1cp); 'we prayed'; the print puts a shadda on the ل
وَعَرَّوْنَا: وَ + عَرَّوْا + ـنَا — wa-, and + ʿarrā, to strip (verb II defective, from ʿariya, 'to be naked'; perf. 3mp) + -nā, us; 'and they stripped us'; the print puts a shadda on the ر
نَعْرِفْ: نَعْرِفْ — ʿarafa, to know (verb I, jussive 1cp after lam); 'we (did not) know'
نَأْوِي: نَأْوِي — awā, to take shelter, take refuge (verb I, hamzated and defective, imperf. 1cp; with ʿinda, 'with (someone)', or ilā, 'in, to (a place)'); 'we (might) shelter'; the hamza is printed
تَقُومُوا: تَقُومُوا — qāma, to rise, get up (verb I hollow, subj. 2mp after an); 'that you get up (and come)'
فَنَنْجُوَ: فَـ + نَنْجُوَ — fa-, so that (fa- of cause after a command, taking the subjunctive) + najā, to escape, be saved (verb I, imperf. subj. 1pl); 'so that we may escape'
نَخْشَي: nakhshā — khashiya, to fear (verb I, imperf. 1pl); printed with ي for final ى; 'we fear'
فَيَعْرِفَنَا: فَـ + يَعْرِفَ + ـنَا — fa-, and so + ʿarafa, to know, recognise (verb I, imperf. subj. 3ms, continuing an yadkhula) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'and recognise us'
فَنَفْتَضِحَ: فَـ + نَفْتَضِحَ — fa-, and so + iftaḍaḥa, to be disgraced, exposed (verb VIII of faḍaḥa, imperf. subj. 1pl); 'and we be exposed'
مَحَلٌّ: مَحَلّ — maḥall, place, lodging (m., nom. indef.); 'a place'
أَطِيعُونِي: أَطِيعُوا + ـنِي — aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV, imper. 2mpl) + 1cs obj. suffix; 'obey me'
وَأَلْبَسَنَا: وَ + أَلْبَسَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + albasa, to clothe (verb IV of labisa, perf. 3ms) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'and he clothed us'
وَلَاطَفَنَا: وَ + لَاطَفَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + lāṭafa, to treat kindly (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'and he was kind to us'
وَشَاشَاتٌ: وَ + شَاشَات — wa-, and + shāshāt, pl. of shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (f. pl., nom. indef.); 'and turban-cloths'
فَأَلْبَسَنَا: فَـ + أَلْبَسَ + ـنَا — fa-, and so + albasa, to clothe (verb IV, perf. 3ms; here with a second object, the garment) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'and he clothed us'
حُلَّتَيْنِ: حُلَّة — ḥulla, a suit of clothes, robe (f.); dual acc.; 'two suits'
وَأَعْطَانَا: وَ + أَعْطَى + ـنَا — wa-, and + aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + 1pl obj. suffix; 'and he gave us'
شَاشَيْنِ: شَاش — shāsh, muslin, turban-cloth (m.); dual acc.; 'two turban-cloths'
فَتَعَمَّمْنَا: فَـ + تَعَمَّمْنَا — fa-, and so + taʿammama, to put on a turban (verb V, from ʿimāma, perf. 1pl; the shadda is printed); 'and we put on turbans'
بِمَائِدَةٍ: بِـ + مَائِدَة — bi-, with (prep.; after aqbala, marking what is brought) + māʾida, table or tray set with food (f., gen. indef.; the hamza is printed); 'with a table'
كُلُوا: kulū — akala, to eat (verb I, imper. 2mpl); 'eat!'
فَتَأَوَّهَ: فَـ + تَأَوَّهَ — fa-, and so + taʾawwaha, to sigh 'āh', moan (verb V, perf. 3ms; hamza and shadda printed); 'and he sighed'
بِوَصِيَّةٍ: بِـ + وَصِيَّة — bi-, with (prep.; awṣā chooses bi- for the thing enjoined) + waṣiyya, charge, last request, testament (f., gen. indef.; the shadda is printed); 'with a charge'
تَأْخُذَ: taʾkhudha — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. subj. 3fs; the hamza is printed); 'she take'
عَزَائِي: عَزَاء + ـِي — ʿazāʾ, condolence, mourning (m.) + 1cs suffix; akhadha al-ʿazāʾ, to receive condolences; 'the condolences for me'
وَتَحْضُرَ: وَ + تَحْضُرَ — wa-, and + ḥaḍara, to be present at, attend (verb I, imperf. subj. 3fs); 'and attend'
غُسْلِي: غُسْل + ـِي — ghusl, washing, esp. the ritual washing of the dead (m.) + 1cs suffix; 'my washing'
صَابِرَةً: صَابِرَة — ṣābira, patient, enduring (act. part. of ṣabara, f. sg., acc. as predicate of kāna); 'patient'
خَرَّ: kharra — to fall down (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed); 'he fell down'
تُغَنِّى: tughannī — ghannā, to sing (verb II, imperf. 3fs; final ي printed as ى; the shadda is printed); 'singing' (could also be read taghannā, verb V perf., 'she sang')
يَسْكَرُ: yaskaru — sakira, to be drunk (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he is drunk'
يَصْحُو: yaṣḥū — ṣaḥā, to become sober, come to oneself (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'he comes sober'
شَجَنًا: شَجَن — shajan, grief, sorrow (m.); acc. indef. of cause; 'out of grief'
عَجَّلَ: ʿajjala — to hasten, bring on quickly (verb II, perf. 3ms; with bi- for what is hastened); 'hastened'
الْبَيْنُ: الـ + بَيْن — bayn, separation, severance (m., nom.); 'the severance'
اِلْفِ: إِلْف — ilf, familiarity, intimacy (m., gen. after baʿda; printed with kasra on bare alif); 'familiarity'
وَجِيْرَة: وَ + جِيرَة — wa-, and + jīra, neighbourliness, being neighbours (f.; printed without a final vowel, metre wants gen. jīratin); 'and neighbourliness'
وَاتِّفَاقِ: وَ + اتِّفَاق — wa-, and + ittifāq, agreement, accord (verbal noun of verb VIII ittafaqa, gen.); 'and accord'
فَرَّقَتْ: farraqat — farraqa, to separate, divide (verb II, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken pl. ṣurūf); 'they divided'
اَمَرَّ: أَمَرَّ — amarra, verb of wonder after mā (mā afʿala) from murr, bitter; mā amarra, 'how bitter is …!' (printed with fatha on bare alif)
الْفِرَاقَ: الـ + فِرَاق — firāq, separation, parting (m.); acc., object of the verb of wonder or of adhāqa; 'the separation'
بِالْعُشَّاقِ: بِـ + الـ + عُشَّاق — bi- (aḍarra bi-, 'to harm': the verb chooses bi-, which marks the one harmed) + al-, the + ʿushshāq, pl. of ʿāshiq, lover (gen.); '(harm) to the lovers'
تَقْضِيْ: taqḍī — qaḍā, here intrans., to be finished, come to an end (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'it ends'
وَفِرَاقُ: وَ + فِرَاق — wa-, and + firāq, separation (m., nom., in construct); 'and the separation of'
الْحَبِيْبِ: الـ + حَبِيب — ḥabīb, beloved (m., gen.); 'the beloved'
بَاقِيْ: بَاقِي — bāqī, remaining, lasting (act. part. of baqiya, m.); 'remaining'
وَجَدْنَا: wajadnā — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 1pl); 'we found'
سَبِيْلًا: سَبِيل — sabīl, way, path (m./f., acc. indef.); 'a way'
لَاَذَقْنَا: لَـ + أَذَقْنَا — la-, then surely (introducing the answer of law) + adhāqa, to make (someone) taste (verb IV of dhāqa, perf. 1pl, two objects); 'we would make (it) taste'
أَوْصَيْتُ: awṣaytu — awṣā ʿalā, to commend (someone) to another's care (verb IV, perf. 1cs); 'I commended'
لِأُخْبِرَ: لِـ + أُخْبِرَ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + akhbara, to inform (verb IV, imperf. subj. 1cs); 'to inform'
لِيُجَهِّزُوهُ: لِـ + يُجَهِّزُوا + ـهُ — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + jahhaza, to equip; of the dead, to prepare for burial (verb II, imperf. subj. 3mpl) + 3ms obj. suffix; 'to prepare him for burial'
وَسَأَلُونِي: وَ + سَأَلُوا + ـنِي — wa-, and + saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 3mpl; the hamza is printed) + 1cs obj. suffix; 'and they asked me'
مُدَبِّرُ: مُدَبِّر — mudabbir, disposer, governor (act. part. of verb II dabbara, to arrange, govern; m., nom., in construct); 'the disposer of'
الْأَنْفَاسِ: الـ + أَنْفَاس — anfās, pl. of nafas, breath (gen.); 'the breaths'
لِنَفْسٍ: لِـ + نَفْس — li-, for (prep.; mā kāna li- … an, 'it is not for … to', not possible for) + nafs, soul, person (f., gen. indef.); 'for a soul'
بِإِذْنِ: بِـ + إِذْن — bi-, by (prep. of means) + idhn, leave, permission (m., gen., in construct); 'by the leave of'
مُؤَجَّلًا: مُؤَجَّل — muʾajjal, given a fixed term (pass. part. of verb II ajjala; m., acc. indef.; hamza and shadda printed); 'with a fixed term'
فَتَوَهَّمَتْ: فَـ + تَوَهَّمَتْ — fa-, and so + tawahhama, to suppose, suspect (verb V, perf. 3fs); 'and she supposed'
أَقْدِرْأَنْ: أَقْدِرْ + أَنْ — aqdir (qadara, to be able, imperf. jussive 1cs after lam) + an, that (subjunctive particle); the print runs the two words together; 'I (could not) that'
الْجَزَعِ: الـ + جَزَع — jazaʿ, anguish, loss of composure (m., gen.); 'the anguish'
انْخَنَقَتْ: inkhanaqat — inkhanaqa, to be choked (verb VII of khanaqa, perf. 3fs; with bi- for the cause); 'she choked'
أَجْرَكِ: أَجْر + ـكِ — ajr, reward, esp. God's recompense (m., acc.) + 2fs suffix (its kasra is printed); 'your reward'
الِابْتِدَاءِ: الـ + ابْتِدَاء — ibtidāʾ, beginning (verbal noun of verb VIII ibtadaʾa, m., gen.); 'the beginning'
الِانْتِهَاءِ: الـ + انْتِهَاء — intihāʾ, ending (verbal noun of verb VIII intahā, m., gen.); 'the ending'
أَوْصَاكَ: أَوْصَى + ـكَ — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with bi- for the thing enjoined) + 2ms obj. suffix; 'he charged you'
أَسْرِعِي: asriʿī — asraʿa, to hasten (verb IV, imper. 2fs); 'hasten'
تَجْهِيزِهِ: تَجْهِيز + ـهِ — tajhīz, preparing (of the dead) for burial (verbal noun of verb II jahhaza, m., gen.) + 3ms suffix; 'his preparing'
أَوْصَيْتُهَا: أَوْصَيْتُ + ـهَا — awṣā, to charge, enjoin (verb IV, perf. 1cs; with bi- for the thing enjoined) + 3fs obj. suffix; 'I charged her'
عَلَاهَا: عَلَا + ـهَا — ʿalā, to rise over, come upon (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her (object); 'came over her'
الِانْكِسَارُ: الـ + انْكِسَار — inkisār, brokenness, dejection (VII verbal noun of kasara, nom., subject of ʿalā); 'the dejection'
بَكَيْنَا: بَكَيْنَا — bakā, to weep (verb I, defective, perf. 1cp); 'we wept'
بِخَبَرِةِ: بِـ + خَبَر + ة (for ـهِ) — bi-, of (prep.; chosen by akhbara, 'to inform of') + khabar, news (m., gen.) + -hi, his, the pronoun spelled with ة, a habit of the print; 'of his news', i.e. what had happened to him (not bi-khibratin, 'with skill')
أُمُورِهَا: أُمُور + ـهَا — umūr, affairs, doings (pl. of amr, gen., second term after jamīʿa) + -hā, her; 'her affairs'
أَتَحَمَّلُكِ: أَتَحَمَّلُ + ـكِ — taḥammala, to bear, put up with, stand by (verb V, imperf. 1cs) + -ki, you (2fs object); 'I bear with you, I stand by you'
أَعْدَائِكِ: أَعْدَاء + ـكِ — aʿdāʾ, enemies (pl. of ʿaduww, gen., second term after raghmi) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your enemies' (the hamza is printed)
بِفَرْشِ: بِـ + فَرْش — bi- (prep.; chosen by amara, 'to order', marking the thing ordered) + farsh, furnishing, spreading with carpets (m., verbal noun, gen.; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the furnishing of'
مُذَهَّبَةٍ: مُذَهَّبَة — mudhahhaba, gilded (Form II passive participle of dhahhaba, f., gen. indef., adj.); 'gilded'
وَحُجْرَةٍ: وَ + حُجْرَة — wa-, and + ḥujra, room, chamber (f., gen. indef.); 'and a room'
وَقَبُولٍ: وَ + قَبُول — wa-, and + qabūl, acceptance, favour (m., verbal noun of qabila, gen. indef. after fī); 'and favour'
لِلشُّرْبِ: لِـ + الـ + شُرْب — li-, for (prep., purpose) + shurb, drinking (m., verbal noun of shariba, gen.); 'for drinking'
الْمَحَاظِي: الـ + مَحَاظِي — maḥāẓī, favourites, favoured women of the harem (pl. of maḥẓiyya, from ḥaẓiya, 'to be in favour'; nom., subject of ḥaḍarat); 'the favourites'
فَأَجْلَسَهُنَّ: فَـ + أَجْلَسَ + ـهُنَّ — fa-, and so + ajlasa, to seat, make sit (verb IV of jalasa, perf. 3ms) + -hunna, them (3fp object); 'and he seated them'
صَبْرَهَا: صَبْر + ـهَا — ṣabr, patience, endurance (m., acc., object of ʿalimtu) + -hā, her; 'her endurance'
تُغَنِّىَ: تُغَنِّى — tughanniya, she sings (ghannā, verb II, subj. 3fs after an; final ي printed as ى); 'that she sing'
دَعَانِيْ: دَعَا + ـنِي — daʿā, to call, summon (verb I, defective, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (object; sukūn on the yāʾ printed); 'called me'
فَاَجَبْتُهُ: فَـ + أَجَبْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, and so + ajāba, to answer (verb IV hollow, perf. 1cs; alif printed with fatḥa and no hamza) + -hu, him; 'and I answered him'
يَخُطُّ: يَخُطُّ — khaṭṭa, to write, trace lines (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms); 'writes, traces'
تُخْبِرُ: تُخْبِرُ — akhbara, to tell, inform (verb IV, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural dumūʿ); 'tell'
فَتُبْدِى: فَـ + تُبْدِي — fa-, and so + abdā, to reveal, show (verb IV, defective, imperf. 3fs; the print has final ى); 'and so they reveal'
اُخْفِي: أُخْفِي — akhfā, to hide (verb IV, defective, imperf. 1cs; alif printed with ḍamma and no hamza); 'I hide'
اُبْدِي: أُبْدِي — abdā, to reveal (verb IV, defective, imperf. 1cs; alif printed with ḍamma and no hamza); 'I reveal'
اَحِبَّتِي: أَحِبَّة + ـي — aḥibba, beloved ones (pl. of ḥabīb, gen., second term after faqdi; alif printed with fatḥa and no hamza) + -ī, my; 'my loved ones'
تَسْتَطِعِ: تَسْتَطِعْ — istaṭāʿa, to be able (verb X, hollow, root ṭ-w-ʿ; imperf. 3fs jussive after لَمْ, the long vowel shortened in the closed syllable; the kasra is a linking vowel before الـ); 'she could (not)'
وَضَجَّتِ: وَ + ضَجَّتْ — wa-, and + ḍajja, to clamour, cry out together (verb I, doubled; perf. 3fs, agreeing with a broken plural; the kasra is a linking vowel before الـ; the shadda is printed); 'and (they) raised an outcry'
وَقَلَّبَهَا: وَ + قَلَّبَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + qallaba, to turn over and over (verb II of qalaba; perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'and he turned her this way and that'
وَحَرَّكَهَا: وَ + حَرَّكَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥarraka, to move, shake (verb II of ḥaraka; perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'and he shook her'
لِمَوْتِهَا: لِـ + مَوْت + ـهَا — li-, for, over (prep.; after ḥazina it gives the cause of the grief) + mawt, death (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'for her death'
بِتَكْسِيرِ: بِـ + تَكْسِير — bi- (prep.; amara bi-, 'to order': the verb chooses bi- for the thing ordered) + taksīr, smashing to pieces (verbal noun of kassara, verb II of kasara; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the smashing of'
وَالْعِيدَانِ: وَ + الـ + عِيدَان — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿīdān, lutes (pl. of ʿūd, m.; gen. after min); 'and the lutes'
جَهَّزَهَا: جَهَّزَ + ـهَا — jahhaza, to equip, make ready; of the dead, to lay out for burial (verb II; perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'he had her made ready for burial'
بِغَسْلِهَا: بِـ + غَسْل + ـهَا — bi- (prep.; amara bi-, 'to order': the verb chooses bi- for the thing ordered) + ghasl, washing (verbal noun of ghasala; here the washing of the dead; m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her washing'
وَتَكْفِينِهَا: وَ + تَكْفِين + ـهَا — wa-, and + takfīn, shrouding (verbal noun of kaffana, verb II, from kafan, shroud; gen., still under bi-) + -hā, her; 'and her shrouding'
وَدَفْنِهَا: وَ + دَفْن + ـهَا — wa-, and + dafn, burial (verbal noun of dafana; m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her burial'
جَنَازَةِ: جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, bier with the corpse on it (f.; gen., second term of an iḍāfa, itself in construct); 'the funeral of'
تَجِدِينِي: تَجِدِي + ـنِي — wajada, to find (verb I, assimilated; imperf. 2fs) + -nī, me; 'you (will) find me'. In the conditional answer it can be the Classical jussive tajidī + -nī; read as an indicative it is the shortened colloquial form of tajidīnanī, one nūn dropped
أَجِدُكِ: أَجِدُ + ـكِ — ajidu, I find (wajada, verb I, assimilated; imperf. 1cs indic.) + -ki, you (f. sg.); 'I (am to) find you'
أَعْتَقَ: أَعْتَقَ — aʿtaqa, to set (a slave) free (verb IV of ʿataqa; perf. 3ms); 'he freed'
جُمْلَتِهِنَّ: جُمْلَة + ـهِنَّ — jumla, sum, whole number (f.; gen. after min) + -hinna, them (f. pl.); min jumlatihinna, 'one of their number'
مُقِيمَاتٌ: مُقِيمَات — muqīmāt, staying, dwelling (act. part. f. pl. of aqāma, verb IV, hollow; nom. indef., predicate of naḥnu); 'staying'
تُرْبَتِهَا: تُرْبَة + ـهَا — turba, earth; grave, tomb (f.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her tomb'
جَنَازَةَ: جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, bier with the corpse on it (f.; acc., object of antaẓiru, in construct); 'the funeral of'
أَشَدُّهُنَّ: أَشَدّ + ـهُنَّ — ashadd, most intense (elative of shadīd; m. form, nom., predicate) + -hunna, of them (f. pl.); with the acc. ḥuznan, 'the most grieving of them'
يَتَّفِقْ: يَتَّفِقْ — ittafaqa, to happen, come about (verb VIII of wafaqa, the wāw assimilated to tāʾ; imperf. 3ms jussive after لَمْ); 'there (never) happened'
جَنَازَةٌ: جَنَازَة — janāza, funeral, funeral procession (f.; nom. indef., subject of yattafiq); 'a funeral'
وَدَفَنَّاهُ: وَ + دَفَنَّا + ـهُ — wa-, and + dafannā, we buried (dafana, verb I; perf. 1pl, the root nūn and the nūn of -nā merged under a shadda) + -hu, him; 'and we buried him'
زِيَارَهِ: زِيَارَه — ziyāra, visit, visiting (verbal noun of zāra; f., gen. after ʿan, first term of an iḍāfa), spelled with ه for the ending ة, a habit of the print; 'the visiting of'
قَبْرِةِ: قَبْر + ةِ — qabr, grave (m.; gen., second term of an iḍāfa) + -hi, his (ة written for the pronoun ه, the print's spelling); 'his grave'
وَقَبْرِ: وَ + قَبْر — wa-, and + qabr, grave (m.; gen., coordinated, first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the grave of'
رَحِمَهُمَا: رَحِمَ + ـهُمَا — raḥima, to have mercy on (verb I; perf. 3ms used as a wish) + -humā, them both (dual); 'may (God) have mercy on them both'
لِلسَّبْعِينَ: لِـ + الـ + سَبْعِين — li-, for (prep.; here marks the count being made up) + sabʿūn, seventy (gen. sabʿīna); 'for the seventy', i.e. making up the seventy
وَأَعْوَانٍ: وَ + أَعْوَان — wa-, and + aʿwān, helpers, retainers (pl. of ʿawn, gen. indef.)
كَبِرَ: كَبِرَ — kabira, to grow old, grow great in age (verb I, perf. 3ms)
سِنُّهُ: سِنّ + ـهُ — sinn, age (f.; also 'tooth'), nom. + 3ms suffix; 'his age'
وَقَلِقَ: وَ + قَلِقَ — wa-, and + qaliqa, to be uneasy, troubled (verb I, perf. 3ms)
يَتَوَلَّاهُ: يَتَوَلَّى + ـهُ — yatawallā, he takes charge of (imperf. 3ms of tawallā, V) + 3ms object (the kingship); 'who will take it over'
فَتَوَكَّلْ: فَـ + تَوَكَّلْ — fa-, so + tawakkal, rely! (imperative 2ms of tawakkala, V; takes ʿalā for the one relied on)
وَابْتَهِلْ: وَ + ابْتَهِلْ — wa-, and + ibtahil, supplicate! (imperative 2ms of ibtahala, VIII, to pray humbly; takes ilā)
بِنِيَّةٍ: بِـ + نِيَّة — bi-, with (prep.; of manner) + niyya, intention, purpose (f., gen. indef.); 'with an intention'
صَادِقَةٍ: صَادِقَة — ṣādiqa, true, sincere (adj., f., gen. indef.)
لِلْفِرَاشِ: لِـ + الـ + فِرَاش — li-, to (prep.; marks where she is called to) + firāsh, bed (m., gen.); 'to the bed'
وَجَامَعَهَا: وَ + جَامَعَ + ـهَا — wa-, and + jāmaʿa, to have intercourse with (verb III, perf. 3ms) + 3fs object; 'and he lay with her'
بِقُدْرَةِ: بِـ + قُدْرَة — bi-, by (prep.; of means) + qudra, power, might (f., gen., in construct); 'by the power of'
قَمَرَ: قَمَر — qamar, moon (m.; acc., first term of the construct name Qamar al-Zamān, 'Moon of the Age'): as the name-object of sammā, fa-sammāhu Qamara al-Zamāni, 'and he named him Qamar al-Zamān'; after yā, yā Qamara al-Zamāni, 'O Qamar al-Zamān'; here: qamara al-samāʾi, 'the moon of the sky', object of istaqbalat; also object of raʾat: lammā raʾat Qamara al-Zamāni, 'when she saw Qamar al-Zamān'; also (Night 202): قَمَر — qamar, moon (m.); acc. as the noun of anna, first term of the name: anna Qamara al-Zamāni, 'that Qamar al-Zamān'
بِالزِّيّنَةِ: بِـ + الـ + زِينَة — bi-, (prep.; after nādā marks the thing proclaimed) + zīna, adornment, public decoration of a city (f., gen.); 'proclaimed the adornment'; the print sets the shadda over the yāʾ
وَرُتِّبَتْ: وَ + رُتِّبَتْ — wa-, and + ruttibat, were arranged, appointed (passive perf. 3fs of rattaba, II)
الْمَرَاضِعُ: الـ + مَرَاضِع — marāḍiʿ, wet-nurses (pl. of murḍiʿ, nom.)
وَالدَّلَالِ: وَ + الـ + دَلَال — wa-, and + dalāl, fond indulgence, pampering (m., gen.); also: the coquetry, airs and graces of a beloved: mina al-tīhi wa-al-dalāli, 'out of pride and coy disdain'
فَائِقًا: فَائِق — fāʾiq, surpassing, excelling (act. part. of fāqa, I; m., acc. indef. as predicate of kāna)
وَالْقَدِّ: وَ + الـ + قَدّ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m., gen.)
وَالِاعْتِدَالِ: وَ + الـ + اِعْتِدَال — wa-, and + iʿtidāl, evenness, good proportion (verbal noun of iʿtadala, VIII; m., gen.)
يُفَارِقَهُ: يُفَارِقَ + ـهُ — yufāriqa, he parts from (subjunctive 3ms of fāraqa, III, after an) + 3ms object; 'to part from him'
قَمَرِ: قَمَر — qamar, moon (m., gen.); first part of the name Qamar al-Zamān, 'Moon of the Age'
طَوَارِقِ: طَوَارِق — ṭawāriq, pl. of ṭāriqa, a thing that comes by night; sudden calamities (gen., in construct); 'the night-strokes of'
وَالْحَدَثَانِ: وَ + الـ + حَدَثَان — ḥadathān, the happenings, the chances of fortune (also 'night and day') (gen.); 'and of the vicissitudes'
أُزَوِّجَهُ: أُزَوِّج + هُ — zawwaja, to give in marriage, marry off (verb II, subj. 1cs, after an) + -hu, him; 'that I marry him off'
تُزَوِّجَ: تُزَوِّجَ — zawwaja, to marry off (verb II, subj. 2ms, after an); 'that you marry off'
تُسَلْطِنَهُ: تُسَلْطِن + هُ — salṭana, to make sultan (quadriliteral verb, from sulṭān; subj. 2ms after an) + -hu, him; 'that you make him sultan'
أُزَوِّجَكَ: أُزَوِّج + كَ — zawwaja, to marry off (verb II, subj. 1cs after an) + -ka, you; 'that I marry you off'
وَنَفْسِي: وَ + نَفْس + ي — nafs, soul, self (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my soul'
مَكْرِهِنَّ: مَكْر + هِنَّ — makr, guile, cunning (m., gen.) + -hinna, their (f. pl.); 'their cunning'
وَغَدْرِهِنَّ: وَ + غَدْر + هِنَّ — ghadr, treachery (m., gen.) + -hinna, their (f. pl.); 'and their treachery'
كُتُبًا: كُتُب — kutub, books (pl. of kitāb; acc. indef., object of wajadtu); 'books'; also object of qaraʾa: qaraʾtu kutuban, 'I have read books'
تَسْأَلُوْنِي: تَسْأَلُوا + نِي — saʾala, to ask (verb I, jussive 2mp tasʾalū after in, 'if') + -nī, me; with bi-, 'ask me about'; 'you ask me'
فَاِنَّنِيْ: فَـ + اِنَّ + نِي — fa-, then (introducing the answer to the condition) + inna, indeed + -nī, I; 'then I (am)'
خَبِيْرٌ: خَبِير — khabīr, expert, well-informed (adj., m., nom. indef.); with bi-, 'expert in'
بِاَحْوَالِ: بِـ + اَحْوَال — bi-, in (prep., after khabīr: 'expert in') + aḥwāl, states, conditions, ways (pl. of ḥāl; gen., in construct); 'in the ways of'
طَبِيْبُ: طَبِيب — ṭabīb, physician (m., nom.; second predicate, rhyme word with nunation dropped); 'a physician'
اَوْقَلَّ: اَوْ + قَلَّ — aw, or + qalla, to become little, run short (verb I, doubled, perf. 3ms); printed run together; 'or grows little'
مَالُهُ: مَال + هُ — māl, wealth (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his wealth'
وُدِّهِنَّ: وُدّ + هِنَّ — wudd, love, affection (m., gen. after min) + -hinna, their (f. pl.); 'their love'
اِعْصِ: اِعْصِ — ʿaṣā, yaʿṣī, to disobey (verb I, III-weak, imper. 2ms; the stem's long ī shortened to i); 'disobey!'
فَتِلْكَ: فَـ + تِلْكَ — fa-, for (giving the reason) + tilka, that (demonstr., f.); 'for that (is)'
الطَّاعَةُ: الـ + طَاعَة — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., nom.); 'the obedience'
الْحَسَنَهْ: الـ + حَسَنَة — ḥasana, good, fine (adj., f., agreeing with ṭāʿa); ة written هْ for the pausal rhyme; 'the good'
يَفُوْزَ: يَفُوزَ — fāza, to win, prosper (verb I, hollow, subj. 3ms after lan); 'will prosper'
يُعْطِى: يُعْطِي — aʿṭā, to give (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, active; printed with ى); 'gives'
النِّسَا: الـ + نِسَا(ء) — nisāʾ, women, shortened to nisā for the metre (indirect object); 'women'
رَسَنَهْ: رَسَن + هُ — rasan, halter, bridle-rope (m., acc.) + -hu, his, read in pause as -ah; 'his halter'
يَعُقْنَهُ: يَعُقْن + هُ — ʿāqa, to hinder (verb I, hollow, imperf. 3fp) + -hu, him; 'they (women) hinder him'
كَمَالٍ: كَمَال — kamāl, perfection, completeness (m., gen. indef. after ʿan); 'perfection'
فَضَائِلِهِ: فَضَائِل + هِ — faḍāʾil, merits, virtues (pl. of faḍīla; gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his merits'
اَلْفَ: اَلْف — alf, thousand (m.; acc. of time, in construct); 'a thousand'; also acc. as object of a verb: banā alfa ḥiṣnin, 'he built a thousand forts'
مُطَاوَعَةِ: مُطَاوَعَة — muṭāwaʿa, compliance, obedience (f., verbal noun of ṭāwaʿa, III), gen. after ʿadam; 'complying'
يُكَرِّرَ: يُكَرِّرَ — yukarrira, to repeat (verb II of ك-ر-ر, subj. 3ms after an); with ʿalā of the person addressed
يُغْضِبْهُ: يُغْضِبْ + ـهُ — yughḍib, to anger (verb IV of غ-ض-ب, jussive 3ms after lam) + 3ms object; '(did not) anger him'
وَلَاطَفَهُ: وَ + لَاطَفَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + lāṭafa, to treat kindly, be gentle with (verb III of ل-ط-ف, perf. 3ms) + 3ms object; 'and he was gentle with him'
وَقَمَرُ: وَ + قَمَر — wa-, and; here introducing a circumstantial clause, 'while' + qamar, moon (m., nom.); first part of the name Qamar al-Zamān
وَظَرْفًا: وَ + ظَرْف — wa-, and + ẓarf, grace, elegance, wit (m., acc. indef. of specification); 'and in grace'
بِالْفَصَاحَةِ: بِـ + الـ + فَصَاحَة — bi-, in (prep.; after kamula it marks the respect in which one is perfect) + faṣāḥa, eloquence (f., gen.); 'in eloquence'
وَيَرْوِى: وَ + يَرْوِى — wa-, and + yarwī, relates, hands on (a report) (verb I rawā, imperf. 3ms; printed with ى); 'and (every breeze) tells of'
لُطْفَهُ: لُطْف + ـهُ — luṭf, grace, gentleness, delicacy (m., acc., object) + 3ms poss.; 'his grace'
نَسِيمٍ: نَسِيم — nasīm, breeze, gentle wind (m., gen. indef. after kull); 'breeze'
سَرَي: سَرَى — sarā, to travel by night (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed سري with ي for alif maqṣūra; 'that blew by night'
لِلْعُشَّاقِ: لِـ + الـ + عُشَّاق — li-, for, to (prep.; marks those affected) + ʿushshāq, lovers (pl. of ʿāshiq, gen.); 'for lovers'
وَرَوْضَةً: وَ + رَوْضَة — wa-, and + rawḍa, garden, meadow (f., acc. indef., predicate of ṣāra); 'and a garden'
لِلْمُشْتَاقِ: لِـ + الـ + مُشْتَاق — li-, for, to (prep.; marks the one it delights) + mushtāq, one who longs (VIII act. part. of ش-و-ق, gen.); 'for the longing one'
عَذْبُ: عَذْب — ʿadhb, sweet (adj., m., nom.; first term of an adjectival iḍāfa); ʿadhbu al-kalāmi, 'sweet of speech'
بَدْرَ: بَدْر — badr, full moon (m., acc., object; first term of an iḍāfa); badr al-tamām, 'the full moon'
وَظَرْفٍ: وَ + ظَرْف — wa-, and + ẓarf, grace, elegance (m., gen. indef. after ṣāḥib); 'and grace'
وَدَلَالٍ: وَ + دَلَال — wa-, and + dalāl, coquetry, playful airs (m., gen. indef. after ṣāḥib); 'and charm'
غُصْنُ: غُصْن — ghuṣn, bough, branch (m., nom.; first term of an iḍāfa, predicate of ka-anna); 'a bough of'
خَيْزُرَانٍ: خَيْزُرَان — khayzurān, rattan, bamboo cane (m., gen. indef.); 'of cane'
يَنُوبُ: يَنُوبُ — yanūbu, takes the place of, stands in for (verb I nāba, hollow, imperf. 3ms); the verb takes ʿan of what is replaced
خَدُّهُ: خَدّ + ـهُ — khadd, cheek (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'his cheek' (the print has خدة, a misprint)
وَشَقَائِقِ: وَ + شَقَائِق — wa-, and + shaqāʾiq, anemones (pl. of shaqīqa, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); shaqāʾiq al-nuʿmān, 'the red anemone'
وَقَدُّهُ: وَ + قَدّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m., nom.) + 3ms poss.; 'and his stature' (the print has وقدة, a misprint)
غُصْنِ: غُصْن — ghuṣn, bough, branch (m., gen. after ʿan; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the bough of'
مَلِيكُ: مَلِيك — malīk, king (m., nom.; intensive form of malik, Qurʾānic; first term of an iḍāfa); 'king of'
قَاطِبَةً: قَاطِبَةً — qāṭibatan, all together, without exception (adverbial acc.)
فَكُلُّهُمْ: فَـ + كُلّ + ـهُمْ — fa-, for, so (conj.) + kull, all (m., nom.) + 3mp suffix; 'for all of them'
اَصْبَحُوْا: اَصْبَحُوْا — aṣbaḥū, they became (verb IV aṣbaḥa, perf. 3mp; lit. 'entered the morning', then 'came to be'); printed with a bare alif for the hamza
شُهْدَةٌ: شُهْدَة — shuhda, a piece of honeycomb, comb honey (f., nom. indef.); 'a honeycomb'
مُذَوَّبَةٌ: مُذَوَّبَة — mudhawwaba, melted, dissolved (II pass. part. of ذ-و-ب, f., nom. indef.); 'melted'
ثَنَايَاهُ: ثَنَايَا + ـهُ — thanāyā, front teeth, incisors (pl. of thaniyya, gen. after fī) + 3ms poss.; 'his front teeth'
مُكَمَّلًا: مُكَمَّل — mukammal, perfected, made complete (II pass. part. of ك-م-ل, m., acc. of state); 'perfected'
بِالْجَمَالِ: بِـ + الـ + جَمَال — bi-, with (prep.; marks what he is perfected in) + jamāl, beauty (m., gen.); 'with beauty'
الْوَرٰى: الـ + وَرٰى — al-warā, mankind, created beings (m., gen. after kull); written with dagger alif in the verse
تَاهُوْا: تَاهُوْا — tāhū, they strayed, were lost, bewildered (verb I tāha, yatīhu, hollow, perf. 3mp); 'have lost their way'
اَشْهَدُ: اَشْهَدُ — ashhadu, I bear witness (verb I shahida, imperf. 1cs); printed with a bare alif for the hamza; the opening of the profession of faith
هُوْ: هُوْ — hū, he (3ms pron., huwa shortened for the rhyme)
لِقَمَرِ: لِـ + قَمَر — li-, for (prep.; here marks whose year is completed, 'for, of the age of') + qamar, moon (m., gen.), first part of the name Qamar al-Zamān; 'for Qamar (al-Zamān)' Also li- of benefit, 'for': naṣabū li-Qamari al-Zamāni … sarīran, 'they set up a bed for Qamar al-Zamān'.; here: after qālat, li- marks the one spoken to, 'to Qamar al-Zamān'
هَيْبَةً: هَيْبَة — hayba, awe, reverence (f., acc. indef.; accusative of cause after waqaʿa); 'out of awe'
بِطَاعَتِكَ: بِـ + طَاعَة + ـكَ — bi-, with (prep.; the verb amara takes bi- for the thing commanded) + ṭāʿa, obedience (f., gen.) + -ka, you (the one obeyed); 'to obey you'
أَعْصِيَكَ: أَعْصِيَ + ـكَ — ʿaṣā, yaʿṣī, to disobey (verb I defective, subj. 1cs after an) + -ka, you; '(that I not) disobey you'
وَأُسَلْطِنَكَ: وَ + أُسَلْطِنَ + ـكَ — wa-, and + salṭana, to make sultan, invest with sovereignty (quadriliteral verb from sulṭān, post-classical; subj. 1cs after an) + -ka, you; 'and (that I) make you sultan'
فَرَضَ: faraḍa, to impose as a duty, make obligatory (verb I, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā for the one bound); 'he has made binding'
طَاعَتَكَ: طَاعَة + ـكَ — ṭāʿa, obedience (f., acc., object of faraḍa) + -ka, you (the one obeyed); 'obedience to you'
تُكَلِّفْنِي: تُكَلِّفْ + ـنِي — kallafa, to lay a burden on, press (someone) to do (verb II, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā) + -nī, me; '(do not) press me'; here with fī for the matter
تَظُنَّ: ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I doubled, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā, the doubling kept with a helping -a); '(do not) think'
وَالْمُتَأَخِّرِينَ: وَ + الـ + مُتَأَخِّرِين — wa-, and + al-, the + mutaʾakhkhir, one who comes later, a modern (act. part. of V taʾakhkhara, m. pl., gen. after li-, coordinated); 'and the later ones'
وَالْآفَاتِ: وَ + الـ + آفَات — wa-, and + al-, the + āfāt, blights, afflictions (pl. of āfa, f., gen.); 'and the afflictions'
كَادَهُ: كَادَ + ـهُ — kāda, yakīdu, to plot against, ensnare (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms used in a conditional clause) + -hu, him; 'plots against him' (not kāda, yakādu, 'to be about to')
الْعَاهِرَاتُ: الـ + عَاهِرَات — ʿāhira, harlot, whore (f. act. part. of ʿahara, pl., nom., subject of kāda); 'the harlots'
مُشَيَّدَةً: مُشَيَّدَة — mushayyada, raised high, solidly built (pass. part. of II shayyada, f. acc. indef., agreeing with the thousand forts as a non-human plural); 'built high'
يُجْدِي: yujdī — ajdā, to avail, be of use (verb IV defective, impf. 3ms); 'avails'
بِنَاهَا: بِنَا + ـهَا — bināʾ, building, construction (m., nom., hamza dropped for the verse) + -hā, their (of the forts); 'their building'
تُفِيْدُ: tufīdu — afāda, to profit, be of use (verb IV hollow, impf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural al-ṣayāṣī; the print sets a sukūn on the long ī); 'profit'
الصَّيَاصِي: الـ + صَيَاصِي — ṣayāṣī, strongholds, fortresses (pl. of ṣīṣiya; Qurʾanic); 'the strongholds'
خَائِنَاتٌ: خَائِنَات — khāʾina, faithless, treacherous (f. act. part. of khāna, pl., nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'treacherous'
دَانٍ: دَانٍ — dānin, near (act. part. of danā, defective, m. gen. indef.); 'near one'
وَقَاصِ: وَ + قَاصِ — wa-, and + qāṣin, far, remote (act. part. of qaṣā, defective, m. gen.; tanwīn dropped at the rhyme); 'and far one'
مُخَضَّبَاتُ: مُخَضَّبَات — mukhaḍḍaba, dyed (with henna) (pass. part. of II khaḍḍaba, f. pl., first term of an 'improper' iḍāfa); 'dyed as to'
مُظَفَّرَاتُ: مُظَفَّرَات — muḍaffara, braided, plaited (pass. part. of II ḍaffara, printed with ẓ for ḍ; f. pl., first term of an 'improper' iḍāfa); 'braided as to'
عِقَاصِ: عِقَاص — ʿiqāṣ, plaited locks, braids (pl. of ʿaqīṣa; gen., tanwīn dropped at the rhyme); 'locks'
مُكَحَّلَاتُ: مُكَحَّلَات — mukaḥḥala, lined with kohl (pass. part. of II kaḥḥala, f. pl., first term of an 'improper' iḍāfa); 'kohl-lined as to'
جُفُونٍ: جُفُون — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of jafn, m., gen. indef.); 'eyelids'
مُجَرَّعَاتُ: مُجَرَّعَات — mujarraʿa, made to gulp down (pass. part. of II jarraʿa, 'to make someone swallow', f. pl., first term of an iḍāfa; as printed; the sense may want the active mujarriʿāt, 'who make (men) gulp'); 'made to gulp'
غِصَاصِ: غِصَاص — ghiṣāṣ, chokings, choking griefs (apparently a plural of ghuṣṣa, 'lump in the throat'; gen., tanwīn dropped at the rhyme; doubtful); 'chokings'
دُعِينَ: duʿīna — daʿā, to call (verb I defective, passive perf. 3fp); 'they (f.) are called'
لِعِفَّةٍ: لِـ + عِفَّة — li-, to (prep.; marks what one is called to, after duʿiya) + ʿiffa, chastity, continence (f., gen. indef.); 'to chastity'
رِمَمٌ: رِمَم — rimam, rotting bones, carrion (pl. of rimma, nom. indef., predicate of inna); 'carrion'
تُقَلِّبُهَا: تُقَلِّبُ + ـهَا — qallaba, to turn over and over (verb II, impf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural al-nusūr) + -hā, it (the carrion); 'turn it over'
النُّسُورُ: الـ + نُسُور — nusūr, vultures (pl. of nasr, m., nom.); 'the vultures'
الْحُوَّمُ: الـ + حُوَّم — ḥuwwam, wheeling, circling (of birds) (pl. of ḥāʾim, act. part. of ḥāma; nom., adjective of al-nusūr); 'the circling'
وَحَدِيثُهَا: وَ + حَدِيث + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥadīth, talk, conversation (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her talk'
وَغَدٍ: وَ + غَدٍ — wa-, and + ghad, tomorrow (m., gen. indef., as if still under the fī of fī al-layli; Classical would use the adverbial acc. ghadan); 'and tomorrow'
سَاقُهَا: سَاق + ـهَا — sāq, leg, shank (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her leg'
وَالْمِعْصَمُ: وَ + الـ + مِعْصَم — wa-, and + al-, the + miʿṣam, wrist (where the bracelet is worn; m., nom.); 'and the wrist'
كَالْخَانِ: كَـ + الـ + خَان — ka-, like, as (prep., governs the genitive) + al-, the + khān, inn, caravanserai (m., gen.); 'like the inn'
تُسْكِنُهُ: تُسْكِنُ + ـهُ — askana, to make dwell, lodge (verb IV, impf. 2ms, as printed; the sense wants Form I sakana, 'to dwell in', taskunuhu) + -hu, it (the inn); 'you lodge in it'
رَاحِلاً: رَاحِل — rāḥil, departing, setting out (act. part. of raḥala, m., acc. indef., predicate of aṣbaḥa); 'departing'; here: clause of state after raʾaytuka: raʾaytuka rāḥilan, 'I saw you departing'
فَيَحُلُّ: فَـ + يَحُلُّ — fa-, then + ḥalla, to alight, put up (at a place) (verb I doubled, impf. 3ms; with fī for the place); 'then alights'
إِنْعَامِهِ: إِنْعَام + ـهِ — inʿām, bestowal of favour, bounty (m., verbal noun of IV anʿama; gen. after partitive min) + -hi, his; 'his bounty'
وَإِكْرَامِهِ: وَ + إِكْرَام + ـهِ — wa-, and + ikrām, showing honour (m., verbal noun of IV akrama; gen., coordinated) + -hi, his; 'and his honouring'
انْفِضَاضِ: انْفِضَاض — infiḍāḍ, breaking up, dispersal (m., verbal noun of VII infaḍḍa; gen. after baʿda); 'the breaking up of'
وَاخْتَلَي: وَ + اخْتَلَي — wa-, and + ikhtalā, to be alone with (verb VIII of khalā, perf. 3ms; printed with ي for ى; with bi- for the companion); 'and was alone'
قَضِيَّةِ: قَضِيَّة — qaḍiyya, case, matter, affair (f., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the matter of'
اسْتَشَرْتُكَ: اسْتَشَارَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — istashāra, to consult, seek advice of (verb X of sh-w-r, hollow, perf. 1s) + -ka, you (object); 'I consulted you'
بِزَوَاجِهِ: بِـ + زَوَاج + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep.; after ashāra ʿalā, bi- marks the thing advised) + zawāj, marriage (m., gen.) + -hi, his; '(advised) his marriage'
أُسَلْطِنَهُ: سَلْطَنَ + ـهُ — salṭana, to make (someone) sultan (quadriliteral verb, from sulṭān; a post-Classical coinage; imperf. 1s, subjunctive after an) + -hu, him; 'I make him sultan'
فَذَكَرْتُ: فَـ + ذَكَرَ + ـتُ — fa-, so + dhakara, to mention (verb I, perf. 1s); 'so I mentioned'
فَخَالَفَنِي: فَـ + خَالَفَ + ـنِي — fa-, and (then) + khālafa, to oppose, go against (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and he opposed me'
فَأَشِرْ: فَـ + أَشِرْ — fa-, so + ashir, advise! (imper. 2ms of ashāra, verb IV, hollow; the long vowel shortened in the closed syllable); 'so advise'
تُكَلِّمَهُ: كَلَّمَ + ـهُ — kallama, to speak to (verb II, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an) + -hu, him; 'that you speak to him'
تُكَلِّمْهُ: كَلَّمَ + ـهُ — kallama, to speak to (verb II, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā) + -hu, him; '(do not) speak to him'
كَلِّمْهُ: كَلِّمْ + ـهُ — kallim, speak to! (imper. 2ms of kallama, verb II) + -hu, him; 'speak to him' (the kasra and shadda are printed)
حُكُومَةٍ: حُكُومَة — ḥukūma, government, the giving of judgement (f., gen. indef., second term); yawm ḥukūma, 'a day of audience, when the king sits in judgement'
حَاضِرِينَ: حَاضِر — ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara; m. pl., acc. as predicate of kāna); 'present'
فَأَرْسِلْ: فَـ + أَرْسِلْ — fa-, then + arsil, send! (imper. 2ms of arsala, verb IV); with khalfa, 'send for'
وَأَحْضِرْهُ: وَ + أَحْضِرْ + هُ — wa-, and + aḥḍir, bring! (imper. 2ms of aḥḍara, verb IV, 'to cause to be present') + -hu, him; 'and have him brought' (the fatḥa on wa- is printed)
يَسْتَحِى: اسْتَحْيَا — istaḥyā, to be ashamed, feel bashful (verb X of ḥ-y-y, imperf. 3ms, shortened form yastaḥī; printed with ى for ي); with min, 'before'; 'he will be ashamed'
يُخَالِفَكَ: خَالَفَ + ـكَ — khālafa, to oppose, go against (verb III, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an) + -ka, you; 'to go against you'
وَاسْتَصْوَبَ: وَ + اسْتَصْوَبَ — wa-, and + istaṣwaba, to judge right, approve (verb X of ṣ-w-b, perf. 3ms); 'and he approved'
رَآيَهُ: رَأْي + ـهُ — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his counsel' (printed رآيه, with madda over the alif; read raʾyahu)
وَبَهْجَةً: وَ + بَهْجَة — wa-, and + bahja, radiance, splendour (f., acc. indef., of specification); 'and in radiance'
وَكَمَالًا: وَ + كَمَال — wa-, and + kamāl, perfection (m., acc. indef., of specification); 'and in perfection'
وَتَوَّجَهُ: وَ + تَوَّجَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + tawwaja, to crown (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he crowned him' (the shadda is printed)
أَسْحَرَ: أَسْحَر — asḥar, more bewitching (elative of sāḥir, 'enchanter'; diptote, acc. as predicate of ṣāra); with min, 'than'
هَارُوتَ: هَارُوت — Hārūt, one of the two angels who taught sorcery at Babylon (Qurʾān 2:102); proper name, diptote, gen. after min
وَغُنْجُ: وَ + غُنْج — wa-, and + ghunj, amorous coquetry (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa)
أَلْحَاظِهِ: أَلْحَاظ + ـهِ — alḥāẓ, glances (pl. of laḥẓ) + -hi, his; 'his glances'
أَضَلَّ: أَضَلّ — aḍall, more misleading, more astray (elative of ḍāll; diptote, acc.); with min, 'than'
الطَّاغُوتِ: الـ + طَّاغُوت — ṭāghūt, idol, false god, power of error (Qurʾānic; gen. after min); 'the Ṭāghūt'
خُدُودُهُ: خُدُود + ـهُ — khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his cheeks'
بِالِاحْمِرَارِ: بِـ + الـ + احْمِرَار — bi-, with (prep., of manner) + al-, the + iḥmirār, redness, reddening (verbal noun of iḥmarra, verb IX); 'with redness'
وَازْدَرَتْ: وَ + ازْدَرَتْ — wa-, and + izdarat, read as izdarā, to despise, make light of (verb VIII of z-r-y, defective, perf. 3fs, agreeing with jufūn; takes bi- of the thing despised); 'and scorned' (reading uncertain)
جُفُونُهُ: جُفُون + ـهُ — jufūn, eyelids (pl. of jafn, nom.) + -hu, his; 'his eyelids'
بِالصَّارِمِ: بِـ + الـ + صَارِم — bi- (prep.; after izdarā it marks the thing scorned) + ṣārim, sharp sword (m., gen.); '(scorned) the sharp sword'
الْبَتَّارِ: الْـ + بَتَّار — battār, sharp, cutting (intensive adj. from بَتَرَ, gen., epithet of al-ṣārim); 'the cutting'
وَبَيَاضُ: وَ + بَيَاض — wa-, and + bayāḍ, whiteness (m., nom., first term of iḍāfa); 'and the whiteness of'
الْعَاكِرُ: الـ + عَاكِر — ʿākir, murky, dark (act. part. of ʿakira, 'to be turbid'; m., nom., adj. of layl; an unusual form, perhaps for the rhyme); 'the murky'
وَخَصْرُهُ: وَ + خَصْر + ـهُ — wa-, and + khaṣr, waist (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his waist'
أَرَقُّ: أَرَقّ — araqq, finer, thinner (elative of raqīq; nom., predicate); with min, 'than' (the shadda is printed)
خَيْطِ: خَيْط — khayṭ, thread, cord (m., gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa); 'the cord of'
هِمْيَانٍ: هِمْيَان — himyān, money-belt, purse-girdle (m., gen. indef.); 'a money-belt'
وَرِدْفُهُ: وَ + رِدْف + ـهُ — wa-, and + ridf, buttock, haunch (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his hips'
أَثْقَلُ: أَثْقَل — athqal, heavier (elative of thaqīl; nom., predicate); with min, 'than'
الْكُثْبَانِ: الـ + كُثْبَان — kuthbān, sand-hills, dunes (pl. of kathīb, gen. after min); 'the dunes'
تَهَيَّجَ: تَهَيَّجَ — tahayyaja, to be stirred up, roused (verb V of h-y-j, perf. 3ms; or imperf. tahayyaju with one ta- dropped); 'were stirred' (the shadda is printed)
الْبَلَابِلُ: الْـ + بَلَابِل — al-balābil, cares, agitations of the heart (pl. of بَلْبَلَة; nom.), with a play on balābil, 'nightingales'; 'the heart's cares'
أَعْطَافِهِ: أَعْطَاف + ـهِ — aʿṭāf, sides, flanks (pl. of ʿiṭf; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his flanks'
وَيَشْكِي: وَ + يَشْكِي — wa-, and + yashkī, he complains (shakā, verb I, imperf. 3ms; Middle Arabic form for Classical yashkū); with min, 'of'
خَصْرُهُ: خَصْر + ـهُ — khaṣr, waist (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his waist' (the print has خصرة, corrected)
أَرْدَافِهِ: أَرْدَاف + ـهِ — ardāf, buttocks, hips (pl. of ridf; gen.) + -hi, his; 'his hips'
وَمَحَاسِنُهُ: وَ + مَحَاسِن + ـهُ — wa-, and + maḥāsin, charms, beauties (pl., no singular in use; nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his charms'
بِوَجْنَتِهِ: بِـ + وَجْنَة + هِ — bi-, by (prep. of oath, after qasaman: 'I swear by') + wajna, cheek (f.), gen. + -hi, his; 'by his cheek'
وَبَاسِمِ: وَ + بَاسِم — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive, as if bi- were repeated) + bāsim, smiling (act. part. of basama), gen., first term of the construct; 'and the smiling of'
وَبِاَسْهُمٍ: وَ + بِـ + اَسْهُم — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + ashum, arrows (pl. of sahm; hamza printed as bare alif with fatḥa), gen. indef.; 'and by arrows'
سِحْرِهِ: سِحْر + هِ — siḥr, magic, enchantment (m.), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his magic'
وَاَسْوَدِ: وَ + اَسْوَد — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive) + aswad, black (colour adj. used as a noun; hamza printed as bare alif with fatḥa), gen., first term of the construct; 'and the black of'
حَجَبَ: حَجَبَ — ḥajaba, to veil, screen off, bar (verb I, perf. 3ms; ḥajaba X ʿan Y, 'to bar X from Y'); here a relative clause on ḥājibin, 'that barred'
وَبِاَمْرِهِ: وَ + بِـ + اَمْر + هِ — wa-, and + bi-, with, by means of (prep., as in bi-nahyihi before it) + amr, command (m.; hamza printed as bare alif with fatḥa) + -hi, his; 'and with his command'
وَعَقَارِبٍ: وَ + عَقَارِب — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive) + ʿaqārib, scorpions (pl. of ʿaqrab; a diptote, given tanwīn here for the metre), gen. indef.; 'and by scorpions'
اُرْسِلَتْ: اُرْسِلَتْ — ursilat, they were sent forth, let loose (arsala, verb IV, perf. passive 3fs, agreeing with a non-human plural; hamza printed as bare alif with ḍamma); 'have been loosed'
صُدْغِهِ: صُدْغ + هِ — ṣudgh, temple (of the head), also the lock that curls there (m.), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his temple'
لِقَتْلِ: لِـ + قَتْل — li-, to, in order to (prep. of purpose) + qatl, killing (m., verbal noun of qatala), gen., first term of the construct; 'to kill'
بِهَجْرِهِ: بِـ + هَجْر + هِ — bi-, with, by means of (prep., instrumental) + hajr, forsaking, shunning (m.) + -hi, his; 'with his forsaking'
وَاسِ: وَ + اس — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive) + ās, myrtle (m.; printed as bare alif without madda), gen., first term of the construct; 'and the myrtle of'
نَكْهَتِهِ: نَكْهَة + هِ — nakha, breath, the smell of the mouth (f.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his breath'
وَسَلْسَالٍ: وَ + سَلْسَال — wa-, and (carrying on the oath genitive) + salsāl, sweet, cool water that slips easily down the throat (m.), gen. indef.; 'and by a limpid water'
يُزْرِي: يُزْرِي — yuzrī, it puts to shame, belittles (azrā, verb IV final-weak, imperf. 3ms; azrā bi-, the verb takes bi- for what it belittles); 'putting to shame'
وَعَصْرِهِ: وَ + عَصْر + هِ — wa-, and + ʿaṣr, pressing, squeezing (of grapes) (m., verbal noun of ʿaṣara), gen., joined to al-raḥīq + -hi, its; 'and its pressing'
الْمُرْتَجِّ: الْـ + مُرْتَجّ — al-, the + murtajj, quivering, shaking (act. part. of irtajja, Form VIII of rajja), gen., adjective of ridf; 'the quivering'
حَرْكَاتِهِ: حَرْكَات + هِ — ḥarkāt, movements (pl. of ḥaraka; printed with sukūn for Classical ḥarakāt), gen. after فِي + -hi, his; 'his movements'
وَبِرِقَّةٍ: وَ + بِـ + رِقَّة — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of oath) + riqqa, slenderness, delicacy (f.), gen. indef.; 'and by a slenderness'
عُنْصُرِهِ: عُنْصُر + هِ — ʿunṣur, origin, stock, lineage (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his stock'
فُضَالَةِ: فُضَالَة — fuḍāla, remnant, leftover (f.), gen. after مِنْ, first term of the construct; 'the leftover of'
خَالِهِ: خَال + هِ — khāl, mole, beauty spot (m.), gen. as second term + -hi, his; 'his beauty spot'
يَرْوِي: يَرْوِي — yarwī, he relates, transmits (rawā, verb I final-weak, imperf. 3ms; rawā ʿan, 'to transmit on the authority of'); 'relates'
رِيحَهُ: رِيح + هُ — rīḥ, scent, smell; also wind (f.), acc. as object + -hu, its; 'its scent'
وَارَى: وَ + اَرَى — wa-, and + arā, I see (raʾā, verb I, imperf. 1cs; the print points neither hamza nor vowel on the alif); with two objects, 'I see X as Y'; 'and I see'. The letters could also be read wārā, 'he concealed' (verb III)
الْهِلَالَ: الـ + هِلَال — al-, the + hilāl, crescent, new moon (m.), acc. as first object of arā; 'the crescent'
قُلَامَةً: قُلَامَة — qulāma, a paring, clipping (of a nail) (f.), acc. indef. as second object of arā; 'a paring'
ظَفْرِهِ: ظَفْر + هِ — ẓufr, fingernail (m.; printed ẓafr, with fatḥa), gen. after مِنْ + -hi, his; 'his fingernail'
مَوْسِمٍ: مَوْسِم — mawsim, season of a festival or fair; a festival (m.; also the season of the pilgrimage), gen. indef. as second term; 'of a festival'
مَجْلِسُ: مَجْلِس — majlis, assembly, court, audience (m., nom., subject of takāmala, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the assembly of'
بِالْأُمَرَاءِ: بِـ + الـ + أُمَرَاء — bi-, with (after takāmala, 'to be filled up, made complete', bi- marks what fills it) + umarāʾ, emirs, commanders (pl. of amīr, gen.); 'with the emirs' (the print has بالامراو, corrected)
مُكَتِّفًا: مُكَتِّف — mukattif, folding, clasping (act. part. of kattafa, Form II, to fold the arms or hands; acc. as ḥāl, taking an object); 'with (his hands) clasped'
حَاضِرُونَ: حَاضِر — ḥāḍir, present (act. part. of ḥaḍara, m. pl. sound ḥāḍirūn, nom.); 'present'
آمُرَكَ: آمُرَ + ـكَ — amara, to command (verb I, impf. 1cs, subj. after an; the hamza and long ā written آ) + 2ms obj.; with bi- for the thing commanded; 'that I command you'
تُخَالِفْنِي: تُخَالِفْ + ـنِي — khālafa, to oppose, disobey (verb III, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā) + 1cs obj.; 'oppose me'
تَتَزَوَّجَ: تَزَوَّجَ — tazawwaja, to marry, take a wife (verb V, impf. 2ms, subj. after an); 'that you marry'
الصِّبَا: الـ + صِبًا — ṣibā, boyhood, the time of youth (m., gen.); 'boyhood'
وَجَهْلُ: وَ + جَهْل — wa-, and + jahl, ignorance, folly (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the folly of'
الشَّبِيبَةِ: الـ + شَبِيبَة — shabība, youth, the prime of youth (f., gen.); 'youth'
كُؤُسَ: كُؤُوس — kuʾūs, cups (pl. of kaʾs, f.; spelled كؤس without the long vowel's waw), acc., second object of suqītu, first term of an iḍāfa; 'the cups of'
فَرَجُلٌ: فَـ + رَجُل — fa-, then (opening the answer to ammā) + rajul, man (m., nom. indef., predicate); '(then you are) a man'
أَلَيْسَ: أَ + لَيْسَ — a-, interrogative particle + laysa, is not (negative verb, 3ms); 'is it not?'
سَأَلْتَنِي: سَأَلَ + ـتَ + ـنِي — saʾala, to ask (verb I, perf. 2ms) + 1cs obj.; 'you asked me'
فَخَجِلَ: فَـ + خَجِلَ — fa-, so (conj. of result) + khajila, to be abashed, embarrassed (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'so he was abashed'
شَهَامَةُ: شَهَامَة — shahāma, high spirit, proud resolve, gallantry (f., nom., subject of laḥiqat, in construct); 'the pride (of)'
فَأَرْعَبَهُ: فَـ + أَرْعَبَ + ـهُ — fa-, and so + arʿaba, to frighten, terrify (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and terrified him'
أَمْسِكُوهُ: أَمْسِكُوا + ـهُ — amsikū, seize! hold! (imper. m. pl. of amsaka, verb IV; the final alif of the plural is dropped before the suffix) + -hu, him; 'seize him!'
فَمَسَكُوهُ: فَـ + مَسَكُوا + ـهُ — fa-, and so + masakū, they seized (masaka, verb I, perf. 3mp; Middle Arabic for Classical Form IV amsaka) + -hu, him; 'and they seized him'
وَأَحْضَرُوهُ: وَ + أَحْضَرُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + aḥḍarū, they brought (aḥḍara, verb IV, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they brought him'
يُكَتِّفُوهُ: يُكَتِّفُوا + ـهُ — yukattifū, they tie the arms of (kattafa, verb II, imperf. subj. 3mp, after an; the nūn dropped) + -hu, him; '(that) they pinion him'
فَكَتَّفُوهُ: فَـ + كَتَّفُوا + ـهُ — fa-, so + kattafū, they pinioned, tied the arms of (kattafa, verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'so they pinioned him'
وَقَدَّمُوهُ: وَ + قَدَّمُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + qaddamū, they brought forward, presented (qaddama, verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they set him before'
وَالْوَجَلِ: وَ + الـ + وَجَل — wa-, and + wajal, dread, fear (m., gen., coordinated after min); 'and dread'
وَتَكَلَّلَ: وَ + تَكَلَّلَ — wa-, and + takallala, to be crowned, wreathed, beaded (verb V of k-l-l, perf. 3ms); 'and was beaded'
جَبِينُهُ: جَبِين + ـهُ — jabīn, brow, forehead (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his brow'
بِالْعَرَقِ: بِـ + الـ + عَرَق — bi-, with (marking what the brow is beaded with, after takallala) + ʿaraq, sweat (m., gen.); 'with sweat'
وَالْخَجَلُ: وَ + الـ + خَجَل — wa-, and + khajal, abashment, embarrassment (m., nom.); 'and confusion'
شَتَمَهُ: شَتَمَ + ـهُ — shatama, to revile, insult (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he reviled him'
وَسَبَّهُ: وَ + سَبَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + sabba, to abuse, curse (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and cursed him'
يَاوَلَدَ: يَا + وَلَدَ — yā, O (vocative; the print runs it together with the noun) + walad, son, child (m., acc. as a vocative in construct); 'O son of'
الْخَنَا: الـ + خَنَا — khanā, obscenity, foul talk, filth (m., gen.); 'of obscenity'
جَوَابَكَ: جَوَاب + ـكَ — jawāb, answer, reply (m., acc., predicate of yakūnu) + -ka, your; 'your answer'
عَسَاكِرِي: عَسَاكِر + ـي — ʿasākir, troops, armies (pl. of ʿaskar, gen. after bayna) + -ī, my; 'my troops'
وَجُيُوشِي: وَ + جُيُوش + ـي — wa-, and + juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh, gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my armies'
أَدَّبَكَ: أَدَّبَ + ـكَ — addaba, to teach manners, discipline, chastise (verb II of ʾ-d-b, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'has disciplined you'
عَامِّيٍّ: عَامِّيّ — ʿāmmī, a commoner, one of the common people (nisba adjective from al-ʿāmma, used as a noun; m., gen. indef. after min); the print has عامي without the shadda; 'a commoner'
قَبِيحًا: قَبِيح — qabīḥ, ugly, shameful, disgraceful (adj., m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'shameful'
يَحُلُّوا: يَحُلُّ + ـوا — ḥalla/yaḥullu, to untie, loosen (verb I doubled, imperf. subj. 3mp after an; the final alif is silent); 'that they untie'
وَيَحْبِسُوهُ: وَ + يَحْبِسُوا + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥabasa/yaḥbisu, to imprison, confine (verb I, imperf. subj. 3mp after an, the silent alif dropped before the suffix) + -hu, him; 'and imprison him'
أَبْرَاجِ: أَبْرَاج — abrāj, towers (pl. of burj; gen. after partitive min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the towers of'
عَتِيقٍ: عَتِيق — ʿatīq, old, ancient (adj., m., gen. indef., agreeing with burjin); 'old'
خَرِبَةٌ: خَرِبَة — kharib, ruined, derelict (adj., f. sg., nom. indef.; agrees with qāʿa, and with biʾr, which is feminine); 'ruined'
عَتِيقَةٌ: عَتِيقَة — ʿatīq, old, ancient (adj., f. sg., nom. indef., agreeing with biʾr, f.); 'old'
فَكَنَسُوهَا: فَـ + كَنَسُوا + ـهَا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + kanasa, to sweep (verb I, perf. 3mp, the silent alif dropped before the suffix) + -hā, it (the hall, f.); 'so they swept it'
وَمَسَحُوا: وَ + مَسَحُوا — wa-, and (conj.) + masaḥa, to wipe, wipe clean (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they wiped'
بَلَاطَهَا: بَلَاط + ـهَا — balāṭ, paving, flagstones, stone floor (m., acc. object) + -hā, its (the hall's); 'its paving'
طَرَّاحَةً: طَرَّاحَة — ṭarrāḥa, mattress, thick quilt laid on a bed or divan (f., acc. indef., object of farashū); 'a mattress'
وَنِطْعًا: وَ + نِطْع — wa-, and (conj.) + niṭʿ, leather mat, leather spread (m., acc. indef., object of farashū); 'and a leather mat'
بِفَانُوسٍ: بِـ + فَانُوس — bi-, with: after atā, 'to come with' = 'to bring', bi- marks the thing brought + fānūs, lantern (m., gen. indef.); 'brought … a lantern'
وَشَمْعَةٍ: وَ + شَمْعَة — wa-, and (conj.) + shamʿa, candle (f., gen. indef., joined to fānūsin under the same bi-); 'and a candle'
مُظْلِمًا: مُظْلِم — muẓlim, dark (act. part. of IV aẓlama; m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'dark'
عَاتَبَ: عَاتَبَ — ʿātaba, to reproach, upbraid (verb III, perf. 3ms); with nafsahu, 'he reproached himself'
لَايَنْفَعُهُ: لَا + يَنْفَعُ + ـهُ — lā, not (negative particle) + nafaʿa/yanfaʿu, to profit, benefit (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + -hu, him; printed as one word; 'does not profit him'
وَالنِّسَاءَ: وَ + الـ + نِسَاء — wa-, and (conj.) + al-, the + nisāʾ, women (pl. used for imraʾa; acc., object of laʿana); 'and the women'
لْوَزِيرِ: لْ + وَزِير — the lām of the article al- (its alif printed with the preceding بِا) + wazīr, vizier (m., gen. after bi-); second half of the printed pair با لوزير, read bi-al-wazīri; after khalā bi-, 'to be alone with', bi- marks the companion: 'with the vizier'
وَأْمُرْهُ: وَ + أْمُرْ + ـهُ — wa-, and (conj.) + amara/yaʾmuru, to command (verb I, imper. 2ms; after wa- the hamza is pronounced, wa-ʾmur, and the print writes it, أ) + -hu, him; 'and command him'
بِالزَّوَاجِ: بِـ + الـ + زَوَاج — bi-, chosen by amara, 'to command', marks the thing commanded + al-, the + zawāj, marriage (m., gen.); 'to marry' (lit. 'with the marriage') Also after raḍiya, 'to be content, consent', bi- marks what is accepted: raḍītu bi-al-zawāji, 'I consent to marriage' (Night 188). Also after mashghūl bi-, bi- marks what the mind is occupied with: mashghūlu al-khāṭiri bi-al-zawāji, 'his mind taken up with marriage' (Night 190).
يُخَالِفُكَ: يُخَالِفُ + ـكَ — khālafa/yukhālifu, to oppose, go against, disobey (verb III, imperf. 3ms indic.) + -ka, you; 'he (will not) go against you'
لِأَنَّ: لِـ + أَنَّ — li-, for, because of (prep., causal) + anna, that; li-anna, 'because' (compound particle)
رَأْيَ: رَأْي — raʾy, opinion, counsel (m., acc., object of qabila, first term of the construct raʾya al-wazīri; the print writes the hamza, رأي); 'the vizier's counsel' ; also: inclination, mind (to do), after lā of absolute denial: lā raʾya lī fī ʿishqi dhāti siwārin, 'I have no mind to love one who wears a bracelet'
يَجِىءْ: يَجِىءْ — yajīʾ, from jāʾa, to come (verb I, hollow and hamzated, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam; the print keeps the long ī, يجىء, where Classical shortens it, lam yajiʾ); 'did not come'
ذِرَاعَهُ: ذِرَاع + ـهُ — dhirāʿ, arm, forearm (f. or m., acc., object of waḍaʿa) + -hu, his; 'his arm'
مُتَشَوِّشَ: مُتَشَوِّش — mutashawwish, troubled, confused (act. part. of Form V tashawwasha, a post-Classical word; m., acc. as predicate of bāta, in construct with al-khāṭir); 'troubled (of mind)'
جَنْبٍ: جَنْب — janb, side, flank (m., gen. indef. after min and ilā); min janbin ilā janbin, 'from side to side'
الْغَضَاةِ: الـ + غَضَاة — al-, the + ghaḍā, a desert shrub whose wood burns long and hot (gen., after jamr; the print spells it with tāʾ marbūṭa, الغضاة, a Middle Arabic spelling of الغضا); jamr al-ghaḍā, 'embers of ghaḍā wood'
يَأْخُذْهُ: يَأْخُذْ + ـهُ — yaʾkhudh, from akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 3ms jussive after lam) + -hu, him; lam yaʾkhudhhu nawmun, 'no sleep took him'
وَذَرَفَتْ: وَ + ذَرَفَتْ — wa-, and + dharafat, from dharafa, to stream, shed tears (verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ʿaynāhu); 'and (his eyes) streamed'
وَالْوُشَاةُ: وَ + الـ + وُشَاة — wa-, while (opening a circumstantial clause) + al-, the + wushāt, talebearers, slanderers (pl. of wāshī; nom., subject); 'while the talebearers'
هُجُوْعُ: هُجُوع — hujūʿ, sleepers (pl. of hājiʿ, sleeping; nom., predicate; the print writes the sukūn on the wāw); '(are) asleep'
وَنَاهِيْكَ: وَ + نَاهِي + ـكَ — wa-, and + nāhī, sufficing, enough (act. part. of nahā, used in praise or wonder) + -ka, you; nāhīka qalban, 'enough for you as a heart', i.e. 'what a heart!'
مَرُوْعُ: مَرُوع — marūʿ, terrified, frightened (pass. part. of rāʿa, to frighten; nom.); 'terrified'
اُقُوْلُ: اُقُوْلُ — aqūlu, from qāla, to say (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs indic.; the print points it uqūlu, with a ḍamma on the alif, where the reading is a-); 'I say'
وَلَيْلِيْ: وَ + لَيْل + ـي — wa-, while (opening a circumstantial clause) + layl, night (m., nom., subject of zāda) + -ī, my; 'while my night'
بِالْهَمِّ: بِـ + الـ + هَمّ — bi-, with, through (prep., the cause) + al-, the + hamm, care, sorrow (m., gen.); 'with care'
طُوْلَهُ: طُول + ـهُ — ṭūl, length (m., acc., object of zāda) + -hu, its; 'its length'
ضُوْءَ: ضُوء — ḍūʾ, light, an old by-form of ḍawʾ (m., acc. after yā, first term of the construct ḍūʾa al-ṣabāḥi); 'O light (of morning)'
رُجُوْعُ: رُجُوع — rujūʿ, return, coming back (m., verbal noun of rajaʿa; nom., subject of the clause amā laka … rujūʿu); 'a return'
النَّجْمَ: الـ + نَجْم — al-, the + najm, star (m., acc., object of raʾaytu); 'the star'
سَاهٍ: سَاهٍ — sāhin, heedless, drowsy (act. part. of sahā, final-weak; the form of nom./gen., where the accusative sāhiyan is expected after raʾaytu, which the metre does not allow; or the fronted predicate of sāhin ṭarfuhu, 'its glance drowsy'); 'drowsy'
وَالْقُطْبَ: وَ + الـ + قُطْب — wa-, and + al-, the + quṭb, the Pole, the pole star (m., acc., second object of raʾaytu); 'and the Pole'
اَلْقٰى: اَلْقٰى — alqā, from Form IV alqā, to throw, cast (perf. 3ms; the print writes the long ā with a small upright alif); 'had cast'
سُبَاتَا: سُبَات — subāt, slumber, deep sleep (m., acc., object of alqā; the final alif is the accusative ending of subātan, read in pause at the rhyme); 'slumber'
وَبَنَاتَ: وَ + بَنَات — wa-, and + banāt, daughters (pl. of bint; acc., object of raʾaytu, first term of the construct Banāt Naʿsh; the print points it banāta, with fatḥa, where Classical has banāti); 'and the Daughters (of the Bier)'
نَعْشٍ: نَعْش — naʿsh, bier (m., gen.); Banāt Naʿsh, 'the Daughters of the Bier', the stars of the Great Bear
الْحِدَادِ: الـ + حِدَاد — al-, the + ḥidād, mourning, mourning dress (m., gen. after fī); 'in mourning'
سَوَافِرًا: سَوَافِر — sawāfir, unveiled (women) (pl. of sāfira; acc. as state; the verse gives it tanwīn); 'unveiled'
اَيْقَنْتُ: اَيْقَنْتُ — ayqantu, from Form IV ayqana, to be certain (perf. 1cs; the print writes the alif bare); 'I was certain'
صَبَاحَهُمْ: صَبَاح + ـهُمْ — ṣabāḥ, morning (m., acc., noun of anna) + -hum, their; 'their morning'
مَاتَا: مَاتَ — māta, to die (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; the final alif lengthens the rhyme); 'had died'
الْفَانُوسَ: الـ + فَانُوس — al-, the + fānūs, lantern (m., acc., object of qaddama); 'the lantern'
لِسَانَ: لِسَان — lisān, tongue (m., acc., noun of anna, first term of the construct lisāna al-ādamiyyi); 'the tongue (of)'
الْآدَمِيِّ: الـ + آدَمِيّ — al-, the + ādamī, son of Adam, human being (m., gen.; relative adjective from Ādam; the print writes the madda); 'of man'
يُوقِعُهُ: يُوقِعُ + ـهُ — yūqiʿu, from Form IV awqaʿa, to make fall, cast (imperf. 3ms indic.) + -hu, him; 'casts him'
الْمَهَالِكِ: الـ + مَهَالِك — al-, the + mahālik, perils, places of ruin (pl. of mahlaka; gen. after fī); 'into ruin'
فُؤَادٍ: فُؤَاد — fuʾād, heart (m., gen. indef. after min; the print writes the hamza, فؤاد); 'a heart'
مَوْجُوعٍ: مَوْجُوع — mawjūʿ, aching, in pain (pass. part. of wajaʿa; m., gen. indef., agreeing with fuʾād); 'aching'
وَقَلْبٍ: وَ + قَلْب — wa-, and + qalb, heart (m., gen. indef., still governed by min); 'and a heart'
مَصْدُوعٍ: مَصْدُوع — maṣdūʿ, split, cracked (pass. part. of ṣadaʿa; m., gen. indef., agreeing with qalb); 'cracked, broken'
عَثْرَةٍ: عَثْرَة — ʿathra, stumble, slip (f., gen. indef. after min); 'a stumble'
عَثْرَةِ: عَثْرَة — ʿathra, stumble, slip (f., gen. after min, first term of the construct ʿathrati al-rijli); 'the stumble (of the foot)'
الرِّجْلِ: الـ + رِجْل — al-, the + rijl, foot, leg (f., gen.); 'the foot'
فَعَثْرَتُهُ: فَـ + عَثْرَة + ـهُ — fa-, for, so (explaining what came before) + ʿathra, stumble (f., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'for his stumble'
وَعَثْرَتُهُ: وَ + عَثْرَة + ـهُ — wa-, and, while (contrasting) + ʿathra, stumble (f., nom., subject) + -hu, his; 'and his stumble'
بِالرِّجْلِ: بِـ + الـ + رِجْل — bi-, with (prep., the part that stumbles) + al-, the + rijl, foot (f., gen.); 'with the foot'
تَبْرِي: تَبْرِي — tabrī, as printed the imperf. 3fs of barā, yabrī, 'to pare, whittle'; the sense wants 'heals', from baraʾa/bariʾa (imperf. 3fs tabraʾu, softened tabrā), agreeing with ʿathra, and it is read so; 'heals'
مَهْلِ: مَهْل — mahl, leisure, slowness (m., gen. after ʿalā; for mahlin, the kasra lengthened for the rhyme); ʿalā mahlin, 'at leisure, slowly'
يَغْسِلَ: يَغْسِلَ — yaghsila, from ghasala, to wash (verb I, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an); 'that he (might) wash'
الْمَغْرِبَ: الـ + مَغْرِب — al-, the + maghrib, sunset, and the sunset prayer (m., acc., object of ṣallā); 'the sunset (prayer)'
وَالْعِشَاءَ: وَ + الـ + عِشَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿishāʾ, nightfall, and the night prayer (m., acc., object of ṣallā); 'and the night (prayer)'
الْبَقَرَةَ: الـ + بَقَرَة — al-, the + baqara, cow (f.); here al-Baqara, 'the Cow', the name of sura 2 (acc., object of qaraʾa)
وَآلَ: وَ + آل — wa-, and + āl, family, house (m., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); here Āl ʿImrān, 'the Family of ʿImrān', sura 3; the madda is printed
وَيَاسِينَ: وَ + يَاسِين — wa-, and + Yā Sīn, the name of sura 36, from the two letters (yāʾ, sīn) that open it, spelt out as one word (acc., object of qaraʾa)
وَالرَّحْمٰنَ: وَ + الـ + رَحْمٰن — wa-, and + al-, the + raḥmān, the Merciful, a name of God; here al-Raḥmān, sura 55 (acc.); written without the long alif, which the dagger alif supplies
وَتَبَارَكَ: وَ + تَبَارَكَ — wa-, and + tabāraka, 'blessed is (He)' (verb VI, perf. 3ms, frozen as a title); with الْمُلْكَ, the name of sura 67, Tabāraka al-Mulk
وَالْإِخْلَاصَ: وَ + الـ + إِخْلَاص — wa-, and + al-, the + ikhlāṣ, sincerity, pure faith (verbal noun of IV akhlaṣa; m., acc.); here al-Ikhlāṣ, sura 112
وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: وَ + الـ + مُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ — wa-, and + al-, the + muʿawwidhatān, 'the two (suras) that give refuge, protect' (f. dual of muʿawwidha, active participle of II ʿawwadha; acc./gen. -ayni), suras 113 and 114
وَتَحَصَّنَ: وَ + تَحَصَّنَ — wa-, and + taḥaṣṣana, to fortify oneself, make oneself safe (verb V of ḥ-ṣ-n, perf. 3ms); 'and he fortified himself'
وَاسْتَعَاذَ: وَ + اسْتَعَاذَ — wa-, and + istaʿādha, to seek refuge (verb X of ʿ-w-dh, perf. 3ms; with bi- of the one in whom refuge is sought); 'and he sought refuge'
طَرَّاحَةٍ: طَرَّاحَة — ṭarrāḥa, mattress, thin quilt spread on a couch (f., gen. after fawqa; from ṭaraḥa, to throw down, spread)
الْمَعْدِنِيِّ: الـ + مَعْدِنِيّ — al-, the + maʿdinī, of the mine, mineral, metallic (nisba adj. of maʿdin, mine; m., gen.); with al-aṭlas, perhaps satin shot with metal thread
وَجْهَانِ: وَجْهَانِ — wajh, face, side (m.), nom. dual; 'two faces', of a fabric faced on both sides
مَحْشُوَّةٌ: مَحْشُوَّة — maḥshuwwa, stuffed, padded (f., nom.; passive participle of ḥashā, to stuff); 'stuffed'
بِالْخَزِّ: بِـ + الـ + خَزّ — bi-, with (prep., marking what something is stuffed with, after maḥshuwwa) + al-, the + khazz, a silk fabric, or silk mixed with wool (m., gen.); 'with silk'
مِخَدَّةٌ: مِخَدَّة — mikhadda, pillow (f., nom., subject; from khadd, cheek)
بِرِيشِ: بِـ + رِيش — bi-, with (prep., marking the stuffing, after maḥshuwwa) + rīsh, feathers (m. coll., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with feathers (of)'
تَجَرَّدَ: تَجَرَّدَ — tajarrada, to strip oneself, undress (verb V of j-r-d, perf. 3ms; with min of what is taken off); 'he stripped'
مُشَمَّعٍ: مُشَمَّع — mushammaʿ, waxed, treated with wax (passive participle of II shammaʿa, from shamʿ, wax; m., gen., agreeing with qamīṣ); of cloth, perhaps glazed or lustrous
مِقْنَعٌ: مِقْنَع — miqnaʿ, head-cloth, veil, a cloth worn over the head (m., nom.)
مَرْوَزِيٌّ: مَرْوَزِيّ — marwazī, of Marw (Merv) in Khurasan, a city known for fine fabrics (irregular nisba adj.; m., nom.)
تَغَطَّى: تَغَطَّى — taghaṭṭā, to cover oneself (verb V of gh-ṭ-y, perf. 3ms; with bi- of the covering); 'he covered himself'
وَالْفَانُوسُ: وَ + الـ + فَانُوس — wa-, and (here opening a circumstantial clause, 'while') + al-, the + fānūs, lantern (m., nom., subject); 'the lantern being'
خُبِئَ: خُبِئَ — khubiʾa, was hidden, stored away (passive of khabaʾa, verb I, perf. 3ms); the hamza is printed
وَالْقَضَاءِ: وَ + الـ + قَضَاء — wa-, and + al-, the + qaḍāʾ, judgement, divine decree (m., gen., joined to bi-al-amri); 'and the decree'
الْمُتَحَتِّمِ: الـ + مُتَحَتِّم — al-, the + mutaḥattim, made binding, inevitable (active participle of V taḥattama, from ḥatm; m., gen.); 'the inescapable'
عَتِيقَيْنِ: عَتِيق — ʿatīq, old, ancient (adj.; acc. dual, predicate of kānā); 'old'
مَهْجُورَيْنِ: مَهْجُور — mahjūr, abandoned, deserted (passive participle of hajara; acc. dual, predicate of kānā); 'deserted'
رُومَانِيٌّ: رُومَانِيّ — rūmānī, Roman, of the ancient builders (nisba adj.; m. nom., though its noun biʾr is feminine)
مَعْمُورَةٌ: مَعْمُورَة — maʿmūra, inhabited, peopled (passive participle of ʿamara; f. nom., agreeing with biʾr; with bi- of who lives there)
بِجِنِّيَّةٍ: بِـ + جِنِّيَّة — bi-, by, with (prep., after maʿmūra, 'peopled with', marking the inhabitant) + jinniyya, a female jinn (f., gen.); 'by a jinniya'
سَاكِنَةٍ: سَاكِنَة — sākina, dwelling, living (active participle of sakana, to dwell; f., gen., agreeing with jinniyya; with fī of the place)
مَيْمُونَةُ: Maymūna, proper name (f., nom., predicate of ismuhā; diptote); 'the fortunate', here a jinniya, daughter of al-Dimiryāṭ; also: nom. as subject: fa-lammā samiʿat Maymūnatu, 'when Maymūna heard'; in apposition to al-ʿifrītatu, subject of qālat (Night 179)
الدِّ: الدِّ — first half of the name al-Dimiryāṭ (al-Di-), which the print splits into two words; see مِرْيَاطِ
مِرْيَاطِ: مِرْيَاطِ — second half of the name al-Dimiryāṭ, a king of the jinn, father of Maymūna (gen., second term of the iḍāfa after ibnatu); the print sets the name as الد مرياط, and the vowels of so rare a name are uncertain
أَحَدِ: أَحَد — aḥad, one (m., gen., in apposition to al-Dimiryāṭ; first term of an iḍāfa); 'one of'
الْمَشْهُورِينَ: الـ + مَشْهُور — al-, the + mashhūr, famous, well known (passive participle of shahara; m. pl. gen., agreeing with mulūk); 'the famous'
الْجِنِّيَّةِ: الـ + جِنِّيَّة — jinniyya, female jinn, jinniya (f., gen. after ism); 'the jinniya'
الدِّمِرْيَاطِ: الدِّمِرْيَاط — al-Dimiryāṭ, name of a jinn king (gen., second term after ibna/bint; vocalisation uncertain); 'al-Dimiryāṭ'
الرُّومَانِيِّ: الـ + رُومَانِيّ — rūmānī, Roman, of the ancient builders (adj., m., gen., loosely agreeing with biʾr); 'the Roman'
لِاسْتِرَاقِ: لِـ + اسْتِرَاق — li-, for, in order to (prep. of purpose) + istirāq, stealing, stealthy taking (verbal noun of VIII istaraqa, from saraqa; gen., first term of an iḍāfa with al-samʿ); 'for the stealing of'
السَّمْعِ: الـ + سَمْع — samʿ, hearing (m., gen.); with istirāq, 'eavesdropping (on heaven)'
خِلَافِ: خِلَاف — khilāf, contrary, opposite (m., gen. after ʿalā; first term of an iḍāfa); ʿalā khilāfi, 'contrary to'
عَهِدْتُ: عَهِدَ + ـتُ — ʿahida, to know by experience, be used to (verb I, perf. 1s); 'I have known'
بِبَالِهَا: بِـ + بَال + ـهَا — bi-, in (prep., with khaṭara: what crosses the mind) + bāl, mind (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'in her mind'
النُّورِ: الـ + نُور — nūr, light (m., gen. after a construct or min); 'the light'
وَجَدَتْ: وَجَدَ + ـتْ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she found'
مَنْصُوبًا: مَنْصُوب — manṣūb, set up, erected (passive participle of naṣaba; m., acc., second object of wajadat); 'set up'
هَيْئَةُ: هَيْئَة — hayʾa, form, shape, figure (f., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa; hamza printed); 'the form of'
نَائِمٍ: نَائِم — nāʾim, sleeping (active participle of nāma; m., gen. indef., agreeing with insān); 'sleeping'
وَشَمْعَةٌ: وَ + شَمْعَة — wa-, and + shamʿa, candle (f., nom. indef.); 'and a candle'
وَفَانُوسٌ: وَ + فَانُوس — wa-, and + fānūs, lantern (m., nom. indef.); 'and a lantern'
الْمُلَاءَةَ: الـ + مُلَاءَة — mulāʾa, sheet, wrap (f., acc., object of kashafat; hamza printed); 'the sheet'
فَبُهِتَتْ: فَـ + بُهِتَتْ — fa-, and + buhita, to be dumbfounded, struck dumb (verb I, passive in form, perf. 3fs; with fī, 'at'); 'and she was dumbstruck'
غَالِبًا: غَالِب — ghālib, overcoming, prevailing (active participle of ghalaba; m., acc., second object of wajadat; with ʿalā, 'over'); 'outshining'
