يَتَلَأْلَأُ: يَتَلَأْلَأُ — talaʾlaʾa, to glitter, sparkle (quadriliteral verb, form II, imperf. 3ms; hamzas printed); 'glittering'
مُقْلَتَاهُ: مُقْلَتَانِ + ـهُ — muqlatān, two eyeballs (dual of muqla, f., nom.; the dark of the eye) + -hu, his; 'his eyeballs'
خَدَّاهُ: خَدَّانِ + ـهُ — khaddān, two cheeks (dual of khadd, m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his cheeks'
وَفَتَرَ: وَ + فَتَرَ — wa-, and + fatara, to grow languid, droop (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and drooped'
جَفْنَاهُ: جَفْنَانِ + ـهُ — jafnān, two eyelids (dual of jafn, m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his eyelids'
وَتَقَوَّسَ: وَ + تَقَوَّسَ — wa-, and + taqawwasa, to be bent like a bow, arch (verb V, from qaws, bow; perf. 3ms); 'and arched'
حَاجِبَاهُ: حَاجِبَانِ + ـهُ — ḥājibān, two eyebrows (dual of ḥājib, m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his eyebrows'
وَفَاحَ: وَ + فَاحَ — wa-, and + fāḥa, to spread, waft (of scent) (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and (his musk) spread'
مِسْكُهُ: مِسْك + ـهُ — misk, musk (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his musk', the scent of him
الْعَاطِرُ: الـ + عَاطِر — ʿāṭir, fragrant (adj., m., nom., agreeing with misk); 'fragrant'
قَبَّلْتُهُ: قَبَّلَ + ـتُ + ـهُ — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 1s) + -hu, him; 'I kissed him'
فَاسْوَدَّتِ: فَـ + اسْوَدَّتْ (+ ـِ linking vowel) — fa-, and then + iswadda, to grow dark (verb IX, perf. 3fs, before a plural of things); 'and grew dark'
الْمُقلُ: الـ + مُقَل — muqal, eyeballs, eyes (pl. of muqla; nom.; the print leaves the qāf unpointed); 'the eyes'
فِتْنَتِي: فِتْنَة + ـِي — fitna, temptation, enthralment (f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my undoing'
وَاحْمَرَّتِ: وَ + احْمَرَّتْ (+ ـِ linking vowel) — wa-, and + iḥmarra, to grow red (verb IX, perf. 3fs, before a plural of things); 'and grew red'
الْوَجَنَاتُ: الـ + وَجَنَات — wajanāt, cheeks (pl. of wajna, f., nom.); 'the cheeks'
الْعَوَاذِلُ: الـ + عَوَاذِل — ʿawādhil, censurers, blamers (pl. of ʿādhil/ʿādhila; nom., subject of zaʿama), the stock critics of the lover in love poetry; 'the censurers'
يُوْجَدُ: يُوجَدُ — wujida, to be found, exist (verb I, passive, imperf. 3ms; the print sets sukūn on the wāw); 'is found'
هَاتُوْا: هَاتُوا — hāti, give! bring! (defective imperative, 2mp; the print sets sukūn on the wāw); 'bring (him)!'
سَبَّحَتِ: سَبَّحَ + ـَتْ (+ ـِ linking vowel) — sabbaḥa, to glorify God, say subḥāna allāh (verb II, perf. 3fs; shadda printed); 'she glorified'
فَاسْتَمَرَّتْ: فَـ + اسْتَمَرَّتْ — fa-, and + istamarra, to continue, remain (verb X, perf. 3fs; shadda printed); 'and she remained'
وَتُوَحِّدُ: وَ + تُوَحِّدُ — wa-, and + waḥḥada, to profess the oneness (of God) (verb II, imperf. 3fs; damma and shadda printed); 'and professing the oneness of'
وَتَغْبِطُهُ: وَ + تَغْبِطُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ghabaṭa, to envy without malice, wish oneself another's lot (verb I, imperf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'for') + -hu, him; 'and envying him'
أَضُرَّهُ: أَضُرَّ + ـهُ — ḍarra, to harm (verb I, doubled, jussive 1s after lam; shadda printed) + -hu, him; '(I will not) harm him'
أَفْدِيهِ: أَفْدِي + ـهِ — fadā, to ransom, give oneself for (verb I, defective, imperf. 1s) + -hi, him; 'I will ransom him (with my life)'
وَالتَّسْبِيحَ: وَ + الـ + تَسْبِيح — wa-, and + tasbīḥ, glorifying God (verbal noun of II sabbaḥa; m., acc.); 'and the glorifying (of God)'
حَطُّوهُ: حَطُّوا + ـهُ — ḥaṭṭa, to put, set down (verb I, doubled, perf. 3mp; shadda printed; the alif of -ū drops before the suffix) + -hu, him; 'they put him'
الْخَرَابِ: الـ + خَرَاب — kharāb, ruin (m. noun, gen., used as an adjective of al-makān); 'ruined'
مَرَدَتِنَا: مَرَدَة + ـنَا — marada, rebels, rebellious jinn (pl. of mārid; gen. after min; the print points it) + -nā, our; 'our rebels'
لَعَطِبَهُ: لَـ + عَطِبَ + ـهُ — la-, surely (the lām that marks the answer of law) + ʿaṭiba, to perish; here used transitively, 'to ruin, destroy' + -hu, him; 'he would surely have destroyed him'
دَوْرِ: دَوْر — dawr, storey, floor of a building (m., gen. after min; the sense here not quite certain); 'the storey (of)'
طَائِرَةً: طَائِرَة — ṭāʾira, flying (act. part. of ṭāra, f. sg., acc. as predicate of lam tazal); 'flying'
وَصَاعِدَةً: وَ + صَاعِدَة — wa-, and + ṣāʿida, rising, climbing (act. part. of ṣaʿida, f. sg., acc., second predicate of lam tazal); 'and rising'
خَفْقَ: خَفْق — khafq, beating, flapping (of wings) (m., acc. object, first term of iḍāfa); 'the beating (of)'
أَجْنِحَةٍ: أَجْنِحَة — ajniḥa, wings (pl. of janāḥ, indef. gen.); 'of wings'
طَائِرَةٍ: طَائِرَة — ṭāʾira, flying (act. part. of ṭāra, f. sg., indef. gen., agreeing with the plural ajniḥa); 'flying'
فَقَصَدَتْ: فَـ + قَصَدَ + ـَتْ — fa-, so + qaṣada, to make for, head towards (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'so she made for'
الْأَجْنِحَةِ: الـ + أَجْنِحَة — al-, the + ajniḥa, wings (pl. of janāḥ, gen.); 'the wings'
دَهْنَشُ: دَهْنَش — Dahnash, name of an ʿifrīt (proper name, treated as diptote; nom.); 'Dahnash'
فَانْقَضَّتْ: فَـ + انْقَضَّ + ـَتْ — fa-, and + inqaḍḍa, to swoop down (verb VII, perf. 3fs); with ʿalā, 'and she swooped on'
انْقِضَاضَ: انْقِضَاض — inqiḍāḍ, a swooping (verbal noun of VII inqaḍḍa, acc. as absolute object); 'the swoop (of)', i.e. 'as … swoops'
الْبَاشِقِ: الـ + بَاشِق — al-, the + bāshiq, sparrowhawk, small hawk (m., gen.); 'the sparrowhawk'
فَاسْتَجَارَبِهَا: فَـ + اسْتَجَارَ + بِـ + ـهَا — fa-, and so + istajāra, to seek protection (verb X of j-w-r, perf. 3ms) + bi-, with (the verb takes the one appealed to with bi-) + -hā, her; 'and he begged her protection' (the print runs فاستجار بها together as one word)
الْمُكَرَّمِ: الـ + مُكَرَّم — al-, the + mukarram, honoured (pass. part. of II karrama, m., gen.); 'the honoured'
وَالطِّلَسْمِ: وَ + الـ + طِلَسْم — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭilasm (also ṭillasm), talisman (m., gen., still governed by the bi- of the oath); 'and (by) the talisman'
الْأَكْرَمِ: الـ + أَكْرَم — al-, the + akram, most noble (elative of karīm, m., gen.); 'the most noble'
تَرْفُقِي: تَرْفُقِي — rafaqa, yarfuqu, to be gentle, kind (verb I, subj. 2fs after an, -na dropped; takes its object with bi-); 'that you be gentle'
تُؤْذِينِي: تُؤْذِي + ـنِي — ādhā, to harm (verb IV, subj. 2fs after an, -na dropped) + -nī, me; 'and (that you) not harm me' (the ؤ is printed)
دَهْنَشَ: دَهْنَش — Dahnash, name of the ʿifrīt (diptote, gen. in -a after min); 'Dahnash'; also: acc. in apposition to al-ʿifrīta after inna, printed without the alif of -an (Night 179)
أَقْسَمْتَ: أَقْسَمَ + ـْتَ — aqsama, to swear, adjure (verb IV, perf. 2ms); with ʿalā, 'you have adjured (me)'
بِقَسَمٍ: بِـ + قَسَم — bi-, by, with (prep., marking what the oath is made with) + qasam, oath (m., indef. gen.); 'by an oath'
مَجِيئُكَ: مَجِيء + ـكَ — majīʾ, coming (verbal noun of jāʾa, m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your coming' (the ئ is printed)
وَأُخْبِرُكِ: وَ + أُخْبِرُ + ـكِ — wa-, and + akhbara, to tell (verb IV, imperf. 1s; takes what is told with bi-) + -ki, you (f.); 'and I (will) tell you'
بِأُعْجُوبَةٍ: بِـ + أُعْجُوبَة — bi-, of, about (prep.; akhbara bi-, 'tell of') + uʿjūba, wonder, marvel (f., indef. gen.); 'of a wonder'
وَجَدْتِ: وَجَدَ + ـْتِ — wajada, to find (verb I, perf. 2fs; perfect after in, present sense); with a second acc., 'you find (it to be)'
فَاتْرُكِينِي: فَـ + اتْرُكِي + ـنِي — fa-, then (answer of the condition) + taraka, to leave, let (verb I, imper. 2fs; waṣl alif) + -nī, me; 'then let me'
وَاكْتُبِي: وَ + اكْتُبِي — wa-, and + kataba, to write (verb I, imper. 2fs; waṣl alif); 'and write!'
بِخَطِّكِ: بِـ + خَطّ + ـكِ — bi-, in, with (prep. of the instrument) + khaṭṭ, handwriting (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'in your own hand'
وَثِيقَةً: وَثِيقَة — wathīqa, deed, written warrant (f., indef. acc. object); 'a deed'
عَتِيقُكِ: عَتِيق + ـكِ — ʿatīq, freed slave, freedman (m., nom. predicate) + -ki, your (f.); 'your freedman'
يُعَارِضَنِي: يُعَارِضَ + ـنِي — ʿāraḍa, to oppose, stand in the way of (verb III, subj. 3ms after ḥattā lā) + -nī, me; 'oppose me'
أَرْهَاطِ: أَرْهَاط — arhāṭ, bands, clans (pl. of rahṭ, gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa); 'the bands (of)'
وَالسُّفْلِيَّةِ: وَ + الـ + سُفْلِيَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + sufliyya, lower, of the depths (relative adj. from sufl, f. sg., gen.); 'and the lower'
وَالْغَوَّاصَةِ: وَ + الـ + غَوَّاصَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ghawwāṣa, diving ones (intensive adj. from ghāṣa, to dive, f. sg., gen.); 'and the divers'
رَأَيْتَهُ: رَأَيْتَ + ـهُ — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hu, it (resumptive pronoun pointing back to alladhī); 'you saw' (the أ is printed)
تَنْفَلِتَ: تَنْفَلِتَ — infalata, to slip away, get loose (verb VII of f-l-t, subj. 2ms after an); with min, 'to slip away from'
بِكَذِبِكَ: بِـ + كَذِب + ـكَ — bi-, by (prep. of the means) + kadhib, lying, lies (verbal noun of kadhaba, m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your lies'
دَاؤُدَ: دَاؤُد — Dāwūd, David (proper name, diptote, gen. in -a; the print spells it with ؤ); 'David'
نَتَفْتُ: نَتَفَ + ـْتُ — natafa, to pluck out (verb I, perf. 1s; future sense in the answer of a condition); 'I will pluck'
رِيشَكَ: رِيش + ـكَ — rīsh, feathers (collective, m., acc. object) + -ka, your; 'your feathers'
وَمَزَّقْتُ: وَ + مَزَّقَ + ـْتُ — wa-, and + mazzaqa, to tear to shreds (verb II, perf. 1s; future sense); 'and I will tear' (the shadda is printed)
وَكَسَّرْتُ: وَ + كَسَّرَ + ـْتُ — wa-, and + kassara, to smash, break to pieces (verb II, perf. 1s; future sense); 'and I will break' (the shadda is printed)
عَظْمَكَ: عَظْم + ـكَ — ʿaẓm, bone (m., acc. object; singular for the collective) + -ka, your; 'your bones'
شَمْهُورَشَ: شَمْهُورَش — Shamhūrash, a jinn name (proper name, diptote, gen. in -a; vocalisation uncertain); 'Shamhūrash'
الطَّيَّارُ: الـ + طَيَّار — al-, the + ṭayyār, great flyer (intensive of ṭāra, m., nom. in apposition); 'the flyer' (the shadda on the ي is printed)
دَهْنَشًا: دَهْنَش — Dahnash, name of the ʿifrīt (proper n., acc. after anna, printed with the alif of the indefinite accusative, -an); 'Dahnash'
لِمَيْمُونَةَ: لِـ + مَيْمُونَة — li-, to (prep., marking the one spoken to after qāla) + Maymūna, the jinniya's name (f. proper n., diptote, gen. in -a); 'to Maymūna'
الدَّاخِلَةِ: الـ + دَاخِلَة — dākhila, entering, lying within (act. part. of dakhala, f., gen., agreeing with al-jazāʾir; with fī, 'within'); 'that lie within'
الْغَيُورِ: الـ + غَيُور — al-Ghayūr, 'the Jealous', name or epithet of the king (intensive adj. from ghayra, jealousy; gen., in apposition to al-malik)
وَالْبُحُورِ: و + الـ + بُحُور — wa-, and + buḥūr, seas (pl. of baḥr, m., gen.); 'and the seas'
وَالسَّبْعَةِ: و + الـ + سَبْعَة — wa-, and + sabʿa, seven (numeral, f. form with a m. counted noun; gen.; the article on the numeral is Middle Arabic); 'and the seven'
قُصُورٍ: قُصُور — quṣūr, palaces (pl. of qaṣr, m., gen. indef., counted noun after al-sabʿa); 'palaces'; also: after sabʿata and al-sabʿi: sabʿata quṣūrin, 'seven palaces' (Night 179)
يَخْلُقِ: يَخْلُقْ — yakhluq, he creates (khalaqa, verb I, jussive after lam, with helping kasra -i before the article); '(did not) create'
أَصِفُهَا: أَصِفُ + ـهَا — aṣifu, I describe (waṣafa, verb I, assimilated; impf. 1cs, indicative, chained to lam aqdir without an) + -hā, her; 'describe her'
كَمَايَنْبَغِي: كَـ + مَا + يَنْبَغِي — ka-, as (prep. of comparison) + mā, that which + yanbaghī, it is fitting (inbaghā, verb VII, impf. 3ms); 'as is fitting' (printed run together)
أَذْكُرُلَكَ: أَذْكُرُ + لِـ + ـكَ — adhkuru, I mention, tell (dhakara, verb I, impf. 1cs) + li-, to (prep., marking the one told) + -ka, you; 'I tell you' (printed run together)
صِفَاتِهَا: صِفَات + ـهَا — ṣifāt, qualities, attributes (pl. of ṣifa, f., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her qualities, her charms'
التَّقْرِيبِ: الـ + تَقْرِيب — taqrīb, bringing near, approximation (verbal noun of II qarraba; m., gen.); ʿalā sabīli al-taqrībi, 'by way of approximation'
شَعْرُهَا: شَعْر + ـهَا — shaʿr, hair (m., nom., after ammā) + -hā, her; 'her hair'
فَكَلَيَالِي: فَـ + كَـ + لَيَالِي — fa-, then (opening the answer to ammā) + ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + layālī, nights (pl. of layla, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); '(it is) like the nights of'
الْهَجْرِ: الـ + هَجْر — hajr, forsaking, estrangement of lovers (verbal noun of hajara; m., gen.); 'the estrangement'
وَالِانْفِصَالِ: و + الـ + اِنْفِصَال — wa-, and + infiṣāl, separation, parting (verbal noun of VII infaṣala; m., gen.); 'and the parting'
فَكَأَيَّامِ: فَـ + كَـ + أَيَّام — fa-, then (answer to ammā) + ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + ayyām, days (pl. of yawm, gen., first term of an iḍāfa); '(it is) like the days of'
ذَوائِبِ: ذَوَائِب — dhawāʾib, locks, tresses (pl. of dhuʾāba; gen. as counted noun after thalth; printed with kasra and no tanwīn, and with its ئ; see note); 'tresses'
فَاَرَتْ: فَـ + أَرَتْ — fa-, and so + arat, she showed (arā, verb IV of raʾā, perf. 3fs; printed with fatḥa on bare alif); 'and she showed'
اَرْبَعًا: أَرْبَع — arbaʿ, four (numeral, acc. indef., after its noun layāliya; printed with fatḥa on bare alif); 'four'
وَاسْتَقْبَلَتْ: وَ + اسْتَقْبَلَتْ — wa-, and + istaqbalat, she faced, turned towards (istaqbala, verb X, perf. 3fs); 'and she faced'
فَاَرَتْنِيَ: فَـ + أَرَتْ + ـنِيَ — fa-, and so + arat, she showed (IV of raʾā, perf. 3fs) + -niya, me (1s obj., the older form with fatḥa, for the metre); 'and she showed me'
مَعًا: maʿan — together, at once (adv., acc. indef.)
أَنْفٌ: أَنْف — anf, nose (m., nom. indef.); 'a nose'
الْمَصْقُولِ: الـ + مَصْقُول — maṣqūl, polished, burnished (pass. part. of ṣaqala; m., gen.); 'the polished'
وَجْنَتَانِ: وَجْنَتَان — wajnatān, two cheeks (dual of wajna, the upper cheek, f., nom.); 'two cheeks'
كَرَحِيقِ: كَـ + رَحِيق — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + raḥīq, pure, choice wine (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'like the wine of'
الْأُرْجُوَانِ: الـ + أُرْجُوَان — urjuwān, purple, red-purple (a Persian loan; m., gen.); 'the purple'
كَشَقَائِقِ: كَـ + شَقَائِق — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + shaqāʾiq, anemones (pl., gen., first term of shaqāʾiq al-nuʿmān; the ئ is printed); 'like the anemones'
وَشَفَتَاهَا: وَ + شَفَتَا + ـهَا — wa-, and + shafatā, two lips (dual of shafa, f., nom., the -n dropped before the suffix) + -hā, her; 'and her lips'
وَالْعَقِيقِ: و + الـ + عَقِيق — wa-, and + ʿaqīq, carnelian (m., gen., joined to al-marjān under ka-); 'and the carnelian'
وَرِيقُهَا: وَ + رِيق + ـهَا — wa-, and + rīq, saliva, the moisture of the mouth (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her saliva'
أَشْهَى: أَشْهَى — ashhā, more desirable, more delicious (elative of shahiya, 'to desire'; with min, 'than'); 'more delicious'
مَذَاقُهُ: مَذَاق + ـهُ — madhāq, taste (m., nom., subject of yuṭfiʾu) + -hu, its; 'its taste'
وَلِسَانُهَا: وَ + لِسَان + ـهَا — wa-, and + lisān, tongue (m., nom., topic) + -hā, her; 'and her tongue'
يُحَرِّكُهُ: يُحَرِّكُ + ـهُ — yuḥarriku, moves, sets in motion (ḥarraka, verb II, impf. 3ms; shadda printed) + -hu, it; 'moves it'
وَافِرٌ: وَافِر — wāfir, abundant, ample (act. part. of wafara; m., nom. indef.); 'abundant'
وَجَوَابٌ: وَ + جَوَاب — wa-, and + jawāb, answer, reply (m., nom. indef.); jawābun ḥāḍirun, 'a ready answer' (printed وجراب, corrected)
صَدْرٌ: صَدْر — ṣadr, breast, bosom (m., nom. indef.); 'a bosom'
عَضُدَانِ: عَضُدَان — ʿaḍudān, two upper arms (dual of ʿaḍud, m., nom., subject of muttaṣil); 'two upper arms'
مُدَمْلَجَانِ: مُدَمْلَجَان — mudamlaj, rounded, smooth, well-turned, as if shaped for a dumluj, armlet (pass. part. of the quadriliteral damlaja; m. dual nom.); 'rounded'
الْوَلْهَانُ: الـ + وَلْهَان — walhān, distraught with love, love-crazed (adj. from waliha; m., nom.); 'the love-crazed'
وَزَنْدَانِ: وَ + زَنْدَان — wa-, and + zandān, two forearms (dual of zand, m., nom.); 'and two forearms'
اُمْسِكَ: أُمْسِكَ — umsika, was held back (amsaka, verb IV, perf. passive 3ms; printed with ḍamma on bare alif; see note on the metre); 'were held'
بِاَسَاوِرٍ: بِـ + أَسَاوِر — bi-, with, by means of (prep., marking what holds) + asāwir, bracelets (pl. of siwār; with tanwīn by poetic licence; printed with fatḥa on bare alif); 'by bracelets'
لَسَالَ: لَـ + سَالَ — la-, (then) surely (particle opening the answer of law) + sāla, it flowed (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms); 'it would have flowed'
الْاَكْمَامِ: الـ + أَكْمَام — akmām, sleeves (pl. of kumm, m., gen. after min; printed with fatḥa on bare alif); 'the sleeves'
سَيْلَ: سَيْل — sayl, flowing, torrent (verbal noun of sāla, acc. as cognate object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the flowing of'
الْجَدَاوِلِ: الـ + جَدَاوِل — jadāwil, streams, brooks (pl. of jadwal, gen.); 'the streams'
حُقَّانِ: حُقَّان — ḥuqqān, two small round lidded boxes, caskets (dual of ḥuqq, m., nom., predicate of ka-anna; shadda printed); 'two caskets'
يَسْتَمِدُّ: يَسْتَمِدُّ — yastamiddu, seeks supply, draws (istamadda, verb X of madda, impf. 3ms; with min, 'from'; shadda printed); 'draws'
إِشْرَاقِهِمَا: إِشْرَاق + ـهِمَا — ishrāq, shining, radiance (verbal noun of IV ashraqa; m., gen. after min) + -himā, of the two; 'their radiance'
الْقَمَرَانِ: الـ + قَمَرَان — al-qamarān, the two moons, i.e. the sun and the moon (dual of qamar, nom.); 'the sun and the moon'
بِأَعْكَانٍ: بِـ + أَعْكَان — bi-, with (prep. of accompaniment, 'having') + aʿkān, folds of the belly (pl. of ʿukna, gen.); 'with folds'
مَطْوِيَّةٍ: مَطْوِيَّة — maṭwiyya, folded (pass. part. of ṭawā; f. sg. agreeing with the plural aʿkān; gen.; shadda printed); 'folded'
كَطَيِّ: كَـ + طَيّ — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + ṭayy, folding (verbal noun of ṭawā; m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa; shadda printed); 'like the folding of'
الْقَبَاطِى: الـ + قَبَاطِي — qabāṭī, fine Egyptian linens (pl. of qubṭiyya, Coptic cloth; gen.; printed with final ى); 'the Coptic linens'
الْمُدَبَّجَةِ: الـ + مُدَبَّجَة — mudabbaja, figured, ornamented as with brocade (pass. part. of II dabbaja, from dībāj; f. gen., agreeing with al-qabāṭī); 'the figured'
بِطَيَّاتٍ: بِـ + طَيَّات — bi-, with (prep., 'figured with, having') + ṭayyāt, folds, pleats (pl. of ṭayya; gen.; shadda printed); 'with pleats'
كَالْقَرَاطِيسِ: كَـ + الـ + قَرَاطِيس — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + qarāṭīs, sheets of paper or papyrus (pl. of qirṭās, gen.); 'like the papers'
الْمُدْرَجَةِ: الـ + مُدْرَجَة — mudraja, rolled up, folded (pass. part. of IV adraja; f. gen.); 'the rolled-up'
وَيَنْتَهِي: وَ + يَنْتَهِي — wa-, and + yantahī, it ends, comes to an end (intahā, verb VIII, impf. 3ms; with ilā, 'at'); 'and it ends'
خَصْرٍ: خَصْر — khaṣr, waist (m., gen. after ilā); 'a waist'
مُخْتَصَرٍ: مُخْتَصَر — mukhtaṣar, abridged, made short or slight (pass. part. of VIII ikhtaṣara, from the root of khaṣr; m., gen.); 'abridged, slender'
وَهْمِ: وَهْم — wahm, fancy, imagining, conjecture (m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the fancy of'
الْخَيَّالِ: الـ + خَيَّال — khayyāl, as printed with shadda: 'horseman', or an intensive 'one given to imagining' (m., gen.); the sense wanted is probably khayāl, phantom, figment; see note
رِدْفٍ: رِدْف — ridf, rump, haunches (m., gen. after fawqa); 'haunches'
كَكَثِيبٍ: كَـ + كَثِيب — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + kathīb, heap, dune of sand (m., gen. indef.); 'like a dune'
رِمَالٍ: رِمَال — rimāl, sands (pl. of raml, gen. after min); 'of sands'
يُقْعِدُهَا: يُقْعِدُ + ـهَا — yuqʿidu, makes sit (aqʿada, verb IV of qaʿada, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'it seats her'
وَيُوقِظُهَا: وَ + يُوقِظُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + yūqiẓu, wakes, rouses (ayqaẓa, verb IV, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and it wakes her'
الْمَنَامَ: الـ + مَنَام — manām, sleeping, sleep (verbal noun of nāma; m., acc., object of arādat); 'sleep'
وَأَجَادَ: وَ + أَجَادَ — wa-, and + ajāda, he did it excellently (verb IV of jāda, hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and did it well'
كَفَلٌ: كَفَل — kafal, buttocks, rump (m., nom. indef.); 'a buttock'
ضَعِيْفِ: ضَعِيف — ḍaʿīf, weak, frail; here a weak thing, the waist (gen. after fī; printed with kasra and no tanwīn, and a sukūn on the long vowel); 'a frail one'
الرِّدْفُ: الـ + رِدْف — ridf, rump, haunches (m., nom., in apposition to dhāka); 'the rump'
ظَلُوْمُ: ظَلُوم — ẓalūm, very unjust, a wrongdoer (intensive adj. of ẓalama, for m. and f.; nom., predicate); 'a wrongdoer'
فَيُوْقِفُنِيْ: فَـ + يُوقِفُ + ـنِي — fa-, for, so + yūqifu, makes stand (awqafa, verb IV of waqafa, impf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'it makes me stand'
وَيُقْعِدُهَا: وَ + يُقْعِدُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + yuqʿidu, makes sit (IV of qaʿada, impf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and it sits her down'
هَمَّتْ: هَمَّتْ — hammat, she was minded, about to (hamma, verb I, doubled, perf. 3fs; here with a bare imperfect after it); 'she is about to'
تَقُوْمُ: تَقُومُ — taqūmu, she rises (qāma, verb I, hollow, impf. 3fs, indicative); 'rise'
وَيَحْمِلُ: وَ + يَحْمِلُ — wa-, and + yaḥmilu, carries, bears (ḥamala, verb I, impf. 3ms, singular before a dual subject); 'and carry'
الْكَفَلَ: الـ + كَفَل — kafal, buttocks, rump (m., acc., object, in apposition to dhālika); 'the buttock'
فَخِذَانِ: فَخِذَان — fakhidhān, two thighs (dual of fakhidh, f., nom.); 'two thighs'
وَسَاقَانِ: وَ + سَاقَان — wa-, and + sāqān, two shanks, legs (dual of sāq, f., nom.); 'and two legs'
قَدَمَانِ: قَدَمَان — qadamān, two feet (dual of qadam, usually f., nom.); 'two feet'
لَطِيفَانِ: لَطِيفَان — laṭīf, dainty, delicate (adj., m. dual nom., where Classical wants f. laṭīfatāni with qadam); 'dainty'
مُحَدَّدَانِ: مُحَدَّدَان — muḥaddad, sharpened, tapering (pass. part. of II ḥaddada; m. dual nom.; first shadda printed); 'tapered'
الْمُهَيْمِنِ: الـ + مُهَيْمِن — al-Muhaymin, the Guardian, the One who watches over all (a name of God; gen.); 'the All-Watching'
لِصِغَرِهِمَا: لِـ + صِغَر + ـهِمَا — li-, at (prep.; after ʿajiba it marks the cause of wonder) + ṣigar, smallness (m., gen.) + -himā, of the two; 'at their smallness'
يَحْمِلَانِ: يَحْمِلَانِ — yaḥmilāni, they two carry (ḥamala, verb I, impf. 3 m. dual); 'they carry'
فَوْقَهُمَا: فَوْقَ + ـهُمَا — fawqa, above (prep., acc.) + -humā, the two; 'above them'
اخْتَصَرْتُ: اخْتَصَرْتُ — ikhtaṣartu, I abridged, was brief (ikhtaṣara, verb VIII, perf. 1cs; with fī, 'in'); 'I have been brief'
الْإِطَالَةِ: الـ + إِطَالَة — iṭāla, lengthening, going on at length (verbal noun of IV aṭāla; f., gen.); 'length'
فَتَرَكْتُهُ: فَـ + تَرَكْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, and so + taraktu, I left (taraka, verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it (the description); 'and so I left it'
وَصْفَ: وَصْف — waṣf, description, describing (verbal noun of waṣafa; m., acc., object of samiʿat, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the description of'
جَبَّارٌ: جَبَّار — jabbār, mighty, overbearing, tyrant (intensive adj., m., nom. indef.); 'mighty, overbearing'
خَوَّاضُ: خَوَّاض — khawwāḍ, one who wades or plunges into (intensive of khāḍa, to wade; m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'a wader into'
الْمَعَامِعِ: الـ + مَعَامِع — maʿāmiʿ, the din and press of battle (pl. of maʿmaʿa; gen.); 'the thick of battles'
يَهَابُ: يَهَابُ — hāba/yahābu, to fear, stand in awe of (verb I hollow, impf. 3ms); 'he fears'
الْفَوْتَ: الـ + فَوْت — fawt, a passing out of reach, missing, loss (verbal noun of fāta; m., acc.); 'loss, what slips away'
جَائِرٌ: جَائِر — jāʾir, unjust, oppressive (act. part. of jāra; m., nom. indef.; the ئ is printed); 'unjust'
ظَلُومٌ: ظَلُوم — ẓalūm, very unjust, oppressive (intensive adj. of ẓalama; nom. indef.); 'oppressive'
وَقَاهِرٌ: وَ + قَاهِر — wa-, and + qāhir, subduing, overpowering (act. part. of qahara; m., nom. indef.); 'and a subduer'
غَشُومٌ: غَشُوم — ghashūm, tyrannous, one who wrongs blindly (intensive adj. of ghashama; nom. indef.); 'tyrannous'
جُيُوشٍ: جُيُوش — juyūsh, armies (pl. of jaysh, m., gen. indef. after ṣāḥibu); 'armies'
وَأَقَالِيمَ: وَ + أَقَالِيم — wa-, and + aqālīm, provinces, regions (pl. of iqlīm; diptote, gen. in -a); 'and provinces'
وَجَزَائِرَ: وَ + جَزَائِر — wa-, and + jazāʾir, islands (pl. of jazīra; diptote, gen. in -a; the ئ is printed); 'and islands'
وَمُدُنٍ: وَ + مُدُن — wa-, and + mudun, cities (pl. of madīna; gen. indef.; the print marks the damma of the mīm); 'and cities'
وَدُورٍ: وَ + دُور — wa-, and + dūr, houses, dwellings (pl. of dār, f.; gen. indef.); 'and dwellings'
الْغَيُورُ: الـ + غَيُور — al-Ghayūr, 'the Jealous', name or epithet of the king (intensive adj. from ghayra, jealousy; nom., in apposition to al-malik)
وَصَفْتُهَالَكِ: وَصَفْتُ + هَا + لَـ + كِ — waṣafa, to describe (verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hā, her + la-/li-, to (prep.; the one told) + -ki, you (f. sg.); 'I described her to you'; the print runs وصفتها and لك together as one word
وَبَنَى: وَ + بَنَى — wa-, and + banā, to build (verb I defective, perf. 3ms); 'and he built'
جِنْسٍ: جِنْس — jins, kind, sort (m., gen. indef. after min); 'a kind'
مَخْصُوصٍ: مَخْصُوص — makhṣūṣ, particular, special, set apart (pass. part. of khaṣṣa; m., gen. indef.); 'particular'
الْخَزَفِ: الـ + خَزَف — khazaf, fired and glazed earthenware, pottery (m., gen. after min); 'glazed ware'
وَالْجَزْعِ: وَ + الـ + جَزْع — wa-, and + jazʿ, onyx, banded stone (m., gen.); 'and the onyx'
وَالْفُصُوصِ: وَ + الـ + فُصُوص — wa-, and + fuṣūṣ, gemstones, cut stones as set in rings (pl. of faṣṣ; gen.); 'and the gemstones'
السَّابِعُ: الـ + سَابِع — sābiʿ, seventh (ordinal adj., m., nom.); 'the seventh'
السَّبْعَةَ: الـ + سَبْعَة — sabʿa, seven (numeral, f. form with the m. quṣūr; acc., object of malaʾa; the article on the numeral is Middle Arabic); 'the seven'
وَأَوَانِي: وَ + أَوَانِي — wa-, and + awānī, vessels, utensils (pl. of āniya; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and vessels of'
تَسْكُنَ: تَسْكُنَ — sakana/yaskunu, to dwell, live (verb I, impf. 3fs subjunctive after an); 'that she live'
تَنْتَقِلَ: تَنْتَقِلَ — intaqala, to move, remove (verb VIII, impf. 3fs subjunctive, still after an); 'that she move'
بُدُورُ: بُدُور — Budūr, the princess's name, 'full moons' (pl. of badr, full moon; nom.); 'Budūr'
يَخْطُبُونَهَا: يَخْطُبُونَ + هَا — khaṭaba/yakhṭubu, to ask for (a woman) in marriage (verb I, impf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'asking for her hand'
فَشَاوَرَهَا: فَـ + شَاوَرَ + هَا — fa-, so (conj.) + shāwara, to consult (verb III, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'so he consulted her'
وَرَاوَدَهَا: وَ + رَاوَدَ + هَا — wa-, and + rāwada, to try to win over, coax (verb III, perf. 3ms; fī, about) + -hā, her; 'and he pressed her'
فَكَرِهَتْ: فَـ + كَرِهَتْ — fa-, and (then) + kariha, to dislike, loathe (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'but she disliked'
وَمَلِكَةٌ: وَ + مَلِكَة — wa-, and + malika, queen (f., nom. indef.); 'and a queen'
أَحْكُمُ: أَحْكُمُ — ḥakama/yaḥkumu, to rule (verb I, impf. 1cs; ʿalā, over); 'I rule'
رَغْبَةُ: رَغْبَة — raghba, desire (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa; fī, for); 'the desire of'
الْخُطَّابِ: الـ + خُطَّاب — khuṭṭāb, suitors (pl. of khāṭib; gen.; the print marks the shadda); 'the suitors'
الْجَوَّانِيَّةِ: الـ + جَوَّانِيَّة — jawwāniyya, inner (post-classical nisba adj. from jawwa, inside; f., gen., agreeing with jazāʾir; the print marks the shadda of the wāw); 'the inner'; at P861L03 (Night 198) the print has it bare, الجوانية, and the shadda is supplied
وَكَاتَبُوهُ: وَ + كَاتَبُوا + هُ — wa-, and + kātaba, to write to, correspond with (verb III, perf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'and they wrote to him'
زَوَاجِهَا: زَوَاج + هَا — zawāj, marriage (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her marriage'
فَكَرَّرَ: فَـ + كَرَّرَ — fa-, so (conj.) + karrara, to repeat (verb II, perf. 3ms; ʿalā, to someone); 'so he repeated'
الْمُشَاوَرَةَ: الـ + مُشَاوَرَة — mushāwara, consulting, consultation (verbal noun of III shāwara; f., acc.); 'the consulting'
فَخَالَفَتْهُ: فَـ + خَالَفَتْ + هُ — fa-, and (then) + khālafa, to oppose, defy (verb III, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she defied him'
وَسَفِهَتْ: وَ + سَفِهَتْ — wa-, and + safiha, to be foolish (verb I, perf. 3fs); with ʿalā, 'to behave insolently towards'; 'and she was insolent'
وَغَرَزْتُ: وَ + غَرَزْتُ — wa-, and + gharaza, to stick, plant (something) in (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'and I planted'
وَأَدْخَلْتُ: وَ + أَدْخَلْتُ — wa-, and + adkhala, to put in, make enter (verb IV, perf. 1cs; fī, into); 'and I put'
وَأَتَّكِئُ: وَ + أَتَّكِئُ — wa-, and + ittakaʾa, to lean (verb VIII, impf. 1cs; ʿalā, on; the ئ is printed); 'and I lean'
وَاحْتَرَقَ: وَ + احْتَرَقَ — wa-, and + iḥtaraqa, to burn, be burned (verb VIII, perf. 3ms; ʿalā, for, over someone); 'and burned'
الِاحْتِرَاقِ: الـ + اِحْتِرَاق — iḥtirāq, burning (verbal noun of VIII iḥtaraqa; m., gen.); 'the burning'
خَطَبُوهَا: خَطَبُوا + هَا — khaṭaba, to ask for (a woman) in marriage (verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'who asked for her hand'
زَوَاجِكِ: زَوَاج + كِ — zawāj, marriage (m., gen.) + -ki, your (f. sg.); 'your marrying'
فَامْتَنِعِي: فَـ + امْتَنِعِي — fa-, then (introducing the answer of a condition) + imtanaʿa, to hold back, refrain (verb VIII, imperative 2fs; min, from); 'then refrain'
وَالْخُرُوجِ: وَ + الـ + خُرُوج — wa-, and + khurūj, going out (verbal noun of kharaja; m., gen.); 'and the going out'
وَحَجَبَهَا: وَ + حَجَبَ + هَا — wa-, and + ḥajaba, to veil, seclude, shut away (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'and he secluded her'
عَجَائِزَ: عَجَائِز — ʿajāʾiz, old women (pl. of ʿajūz, f.; diptote, gen. in -a after the numeral; the ئ is printed); 'old women'
قَهْرَمَانَاتٍ: قَهْرَمَانَات — qahramānāt, stewardesses, duennas of a great household (pl. of qahramāna, from Persian; gen. indef., in apposition); 'stewardesses'
وَمَنَعَهَا: وَ + مَنَعَ + هَا — wa-, and + manaʿa, to prevent, forbid (verb I, perf. 3ms; min, from) + -hā, her; 'and he kept her'
تَظْهَرَ: تَظْهَرَ — ẓahara/yaẓharu, to appear, come out (verb I, impf. 3fs subjunctive after an; ilā, into); 'that she come out'
كَاتَبَ: كَاتَبَ — kātaba, to write to, correspond with (verb III, perf. 3ms), here set beside arsala with no 'and'; 'he wrote to'
أُصِيبَتْ: أُصِيبَتْ — uṣība, to be struck, afflicted (verb IV aṣāba, passive perf. 3fs; bi-, with); 'she was struck'
بِجُنُونٍ: بِـ + جُنُون — bi-, with (prep.; after uṣība it marks the affliction) + junūn, madness (m., gen. indef.); 'with madness'
فَأَنْظُرُهَا: فَـ + أَنْظُرُ + ـهَا — fa-, and (then) + naẓara, to look at (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and I look at her'
وَأَتَمَلَّى: وَ + أَتَمَلَّى — wa-, and + tamallā, to enjoy at length, take one's fill (verb V, imperf. 1cs; with bi- of what is enjoyed); 'and I feast (my eyes)'
وَأُقَبِّلُهَا: وَ + أُقَبِّلُ + ـهَا — wa-, and + qabbala, to kiss (verb II, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'and I kiss her'
أَضُرُّهَا: أَضُرُّ + ـهَا — ḍarra, to harm (verb I doubled, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I harm her'
أُوذِيهَا: أُوذِي + ـهَا — ādhā, to hurt, injure (verb IV, root ʾ-dh-y, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, her; 'I hurt her'
شَبَابَهَا: شَبَاب + ـهَا — shabāb, youth, youthfulness (m., acc. as the noun of li-anna) + -hā, her; 'her youth'
بَارِعٌ: بَارِع — bāriʿ, surpassing, excelling (act. part. of baraʿa, m., nom. indef.); 'surpassing'
يَغَارُ: يَغَارُ — ghāra, to be jealous (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms; with ʿalā of the woman one is jealous over, min of the one feared as rival); 'he is jealous'
وَأَقْسَمْتُ: وَ + أَقْسَمْتُ — wa-, and + aqsama, to swear (verb IV, perf. 1cs); aqsamtu ʿalayka (to a woman, ʿalayki) an, 'I adjure you to'; 'and I adjure'
تَرْجِعِي: تَرْجِعِي — rajaʿa, to return, come back (verb I, subj. 2fs after an); 'that you come back'
وَقَدَّهَا: وَ + قَدّ + ـهَا — wa-, and + qadd, stature, figure (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'and her figure'
وَاعْتِدَالَهَا: وَ + اعْتِدَال + ـهَا — wa-, and + iʿtidāl, straightness, symmetry of form (verbal noun of VIII iʿtadala; m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'and her shapeliness'
تُعَاتِبِينِي: تُعَاتِبِي + ـنِي — ʿātaba, to reproach, upbraid (verb III, subj. 2fs after an) + -nī, me; 'that you reproach me'
أَوْتَأْسِرِينِي: أَوْ + تَأْسِرِي + ـنِي — aw, or + asara, to take captive, bind (verb I, subj. 2fs) + -nī, me; printed as one word: 'or take me captive'
أَمْرُكِ: أَمْر + ـكِ — amr, command (m., nom., predicate) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your command'
وَالنَّهْيَ: وَ + الـ + نَهْي — wa-, and + al-, the + nahy, forbidding, prohibition (m., acc., noun of inna); 'and the forbidding'
نَهْيُكِ: نَهْي + ـكِ — nahy, forbidding, prohibition (m., nom., predicate) + -ki, your (2fs); 'your forbidding'
وَخَفَضَ: وَ + خَفَضَ — wa-, and + khafaḍa, to lower (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he lowered'
ضِحِكَتْ: ضِحِكَتْ — ḍaḥika, to laugh (verb I, perf. 3fs), here with the printed kasra of the spoken pronunciation ḍiḥikat; 'she laughed'
وَبَصَقَتْ: وَ + بَصَقَتْ — wa-, and + baṣaqa, to spit (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she spat'
قَوَّارَةُ: قَوَّارَة — qawwāra, flask, jar (f., nom., first term of construct); apparently a spoken form of qārūra, the physician's urine flask; vocalisation uncertain; qawwāratu al-bawli, 'a piss-pot'
حَسِبْتُ: حَسِبْتُ — ḥasiba, to think, suppose (verb I, perf. 1cs); 'I thought'
مَعْشُوقَتِي: مَعْشُوقَة + ـي — maʿshūqa, beloved (f.; pass. part. of ʿashiqa, to love passionately) + -ī, my; 'my beloved'
لَانْفَلَجْتَ: لَـ + انْفَلَجْتَ — la-, surely (opening the answer to law) + infalaja, to be struck with palsy (verb VII, Middle Arabic, perf. 2ms); 'you would surely be palsied'
رِيَالَتُكَ: رِيَالَة + ـكَ — riyāla, slaver, drool (f., nom.; spoken form of Classical riyāl) + -ka, your; 'your drool' (the print has ربالتك, a misprint)
لِمَعْشُوقَتِكَ: لِـ + مَعْشُوقَة + ـكَ — li-, to (after jarā, marking the one it befalls) + maʿshūqa, beloved (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'to your beloved'
أَرِينِي: أَرِي + ـنِي — arā, to show (verb IV of raʾā, imper. 2fs) + -nī, me; 'show me'
بُدُورَ: بُدُور — Budūr, 'full moons' (pl. of badr), name of the princess (f., diptote, gen. in -a in apposition); 'Budūr'; here: acc. after anna
أَنْحَسَ: أَنْحَس — anḥas, most ill-omened, most wretched (elative of naḥs; acc., heading a vocative phrase); yā anḥasa, 'O most ill-starred'
الْمَرَدَةِ: الـ + مَرَدَة — al-, the + marada, rebel jinn, demons (pl. of mārid; gen.); 'the rebel jinn'
وَأَحْقَرَ: وَ + أَحْقَر — wa-, and + aḥqar, most contemptible (elative of ḥaqīr; acc., in a vocative phrase); 'and most contemptible'
الشَّيَاطِينِ: الـ + شَيَاطِين — al-, the + shayāṭīn, devils (pl. of shayṭān; gen.); 'the devils'
لِمَعْشُوقِي: لِـ + مَعْشُوق + ـي — li-, for (marking the one who would have an equal) + maʿshūq, beloved (m., gen.; pass. part. of ʿashiqa) + -ī, my; 'for my beloved'
فَأَبَي: فَـ + أَبَي — fa-, and (then) + abā, to refuse (verb I, perf. 3ms; the print spells the final alif maqṣūra with ي); 'and he refused' (the print has فلبي, a misprint)
لِلثَّمَانِينَ: لِـ + الـ + ثَمَانُونَ — li-, for, of (marking the number completed) + al-, the + thamānūn, eighty (gen. -īna); 'completing the eighty' after al-mūfiya
نَقِيسَ: قَاسَ — qāsa, to measure, compare (verb I hollow, subj. 1pl after ḥattā; takes bi- for the thing compared with); 'that we should measure'
مَعْشُوقَتَكَ: مَعْشُوقَة + ـكَ — maʿshūqa, beloved (f., acc.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your beloved'
بِمَعْشُوقِي: بِـ + مَعْشُوق + ـي — bi-, against (after qāsa, 'measure X against Y') + maʿshūq, beloved (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'against my beloved'; also: bi- marks the object of a passion: mina al-walahi bi-maʿshūqī, 'out of love-madness for my beloved'
مَعْشُوقَكِ: مَعْشُوق + ـكِ — maʿshūq, beloved (m., acc.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your beloved'
أَجِئُ: جَاءَ — jāʾa, to come (verb I, imperf. 1s, printed اجئ without the yāʾ of ajīʾu); 'I come'
تَجِئُ: جَاءَ — jāʾa, to come (verb I, imperf. 2ms, printed تجئ without the yāʾ of tajīʾu); 'you come'
بِرَهْنٍ: بِـ + رَهْن — bi-, with (accompaniment) + rahn, pledge, stake, wager (m., gen. indef.); 'with a stake'
وَشَرْطٍ: وَ + شَرْط — wa-, and + sharṭ, condition, terms (m., gen. indef.); 'and terms'
مَعْشُوقَتُكَ: مَعْشُوقَة + ـكَ — maʿshūqa, beloved (f., nom.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your beloved'
تُحِبُّهَا: أَحَبَّ + ـهَا — aḥabba, to love (verb IV doubled, imperf. 2ms or 3fs) + -hā, her; 'you love her'
وَتَتَغَالَى: وَ + تَغَالَى — wa-, and + taghālā fī, to go to extremes over, prize beyond measure (verb VI, imperf. 2ms); 'and you praise beyond all bounds'
وَأُحِبُّهُ: وَ + أَحَبَّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aḥabba, to love (verb IV, imperf. 1s) + -hu, him; 'and I love him'
وَأَتَغَالَى: وَ + تَغَالَى — wa-, and + taghālā fī, to prize beyond measure (verb VI, imperf. 1s); 'and I praise beyond all bounds'
الرَّهْنَ: الـ + رَهْن — rahn, pledge, stake (m., acc. after inna); 'the stake'
وَالشَّرْطَ: وَ + الـ + شَرْط — wa-, and + sharṭ, condition, terms (m., acc.); 'and the terms'
تَعَالَيْ: تَعَالَ — taʿāla, come! (imperative, f. sg. taʿālay); 'come'
مَعْشُوقَتِكَ: مَعْشُوقَة + ـكَ — maʿshūqa, beloved (f., gen.) + -ka, your (m.); 'your beloved'
تَحْتَنَا: تَحْتَ + ـنَا — taḥta, beneath (adv./prep.) + -nā, us; 'beneath us'
فَانْحَدِرْ: فَـ + انْحَدَرَ — fa-, so + inḥadara, to go down, descend (verb VII, imperative 2ms); 'so come down'
لِتَنْظُرَ: لِـ + نَظَرَ — li-, so that (with the subjunctive, purpose) + naẓara, to look at (imperf. subj. 2ms); 'so that you may look at'
وَنَرُوحَ: وَ + رَاحَ — wa-, and + rāḥa, to go (verb I hollow, subj. 1pl, continuing li-tanẓura); 'and (that) we go'
انْحَدَرَا: انْحَدَرَ — inḥadara, to go down, descend (verb VII, perf. 3 dual); 'the two went down'
وَأَوْقَفَتْ: وَ + أَوْقَفَ — wa-, and + awqafa, to make stand, set standing (verb IV, perf. 3fs); 'and she set (him) standing'
بِجَنْبِ: بِـ + جَنْب — bi-, at (prep. of place) + janb, side (m., gen.); 'beside'
وَشَالَتْ: وَ + شَالَ — wa-, and + shāla, to lift, take up (colloquial verb, hollow, perf. 3fs); 'and she lifted'
مُلَاءَةَ: مُلَاءَة — mulāʾa, sheet, wrapper (f., acc., construct); 'the sheet (of)'
فَسَطَعَ: فَـ + سَطَعَ — fa-, and then + saṭaʿa, to shine out, spread (of light) (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and (it) blazed out'
وَزَهَى: وَ + زَهَا — wa-, and + zahā, to shine, be bright (verb I, perf. 3ms, written with ى); 'and it glowed'
وَالْتَفَتَتْ: وَ + الْتَفَتَ — wa-, and + iltafata ilā, to turn towards (verb VIII, perf. 3fs); 'and she turned'
مَجْنُونٍ: مَجْنُون — majnūn, madman (m., gen. indef., after the elative aqbaḥa); 'of madmen'
مَفْتُونَاتٌ: مَفْتُونَة — maftūna, bewitched, infatuated (pass. part. of fatana, f. pl., nom. indef.); 'enchanted (ones)'
بِتَأَمُّلٍ: بِـ + تَأَمُّل — bi-, in, with (after istamarra, marking what one keeps on at) + taʾammul, contemplation, gazing (verbal noun of V taʾammala; gen. indef.); 'in gazing'
مَعْذُورَةٌ: مَعْذُورَة — maʿdhūra, excused, not to be blamed (pass. part. of ʿadhara, f., nom. indef.); 'excused'
وَالْبَهْجَةِ: وَ + الـ + بَهْجَة — wa-, and + bahja, radiance, splendour, delight (f., gen.); 'and the radiance'
قَدْأُ: قَدْ + أُ — qad, already (particle with the perfect) + the initial u- of ufrighā, run on by the print (قد افرغا set as قدا فرغا); 'had'
فْرِغَا: أُفْرِغَ — the rest of ufrighā, passive of afragha (IV), to pour (molten metal), perf. 3 dual, its initial alif printed on the word before; 'the two were poured'
وَلَطَمَتْهُ: وَ + لَطَمَ + ـتْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + laṭama, to slap, strike (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she struck him'
بِجَنَاحِهَا: بِـ + جَنَاح + ـهَا — bi-, with (instrument) + janāḥ, wing (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her wing'
تَقْضِىَ: قَضَى — qaḍā ʿalā, to finish off, kill (verb I, imperf. subj. 3fs after an; printed with ى for ي); '(that) it finish off'
شِدَّتِهَا: شِدَّة + ـهَا — shidda, force, violence (f., gen. after min) + -hā, its; 'from its force'
بِنُورِ: بِـ + نُور — bi-, by (of an oath) + nūr, light (m., gen., construct); 'by the light of'; also bi- of what fills: lam takmul bi-nūri, 'it is not filled with light' (indef. gen.; the rhyme drops the tanwīn) (Night 194, verse)
جَلَالِهِ: جَلَال + ـهِ — jalāl, majesty, glory (m., gen.) + -hi, His (God's); 'His majesty'
وَتَحْمِلَ: وَ + حَمَلَ — wa-, and + ḥamala, to carry (verb I, imperf. subj. 2ms); 'and (that) you carry'
وَتَأْتِيَ: وَ + أَتَى — wa-, and + atā, to come (verb I, imperf. subj. 2ms); with bi-, 'to bring'; 'and (that) you bring'
نَجْمَعَ: جَمَعَ — jamaʿa, to gather; with bayna, to bring together (verb I, imperf. subj. 1pl after ḥattā); 'that we bring together'
وَنَنْظُرَ: وَ + نَظَرَ — wa-, and + naẓara fī, to look into, examine (verb I, imperf. subj. 1pl); 'and (that) we look at'
فَيَظْهَرَ: فَـ + ظَهَرَ — fa-, and so + ẓahara, to appear, become clear (verb I, imperf. subj. 3ms in a chain of purpose); 'and so it may appear'
أَمْلَحُ: أَمْلَح — amlaḥ, prettier (elative of malīḥ, nom.); 'prettier'
السَّاعَهِ: الـ + سَاعَة — sāʿa, hour (f., gen.; printed with ه for ة); 'the hour'
أَحْرَقْتُكَ: أَحْرَقَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — aḥraqa, to burn (verb IV, perf. 1s, future sense after in) + -ka, you; 'I shall burn you'
بِنَارِي: بِـ + نَار + ـي — bi-, with (instrument) + nār, fire (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my fire'
شَرَارِي: شَرَار + ـي — sharār, sparks (collective, m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my sparks'
وَمَزَّقْتُكَ: وَ + مَزَّقَ + ـتُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + mazzaqa, to tear to pieces (verb II, perf. 1s, future sense) + -ka, you; 'and I shall tear you'
وَأَرْمِيكَ: وَ + رَمَى + ـكَ — wa-, and + ramā, to throw, fling (verb I, imperf. 1s) + -ka, you; 'and I shall fling you'
وَأَجْعَلُكَ: وَ + جَعَلَ + ـكَ — wa-, and + jaʿala, to make (verb I, imperf. 1s; two objects) + -ka, you; 'and I shall make you'
لِلْمُقِيمِ: لِـ + الـ + مُقِيم — li-, for (the one a lesson is meant for) + muqīm, one who stays, the settled (act. part. of IV aqāma, gen.); 'for the one who stays at home'
وَالسَّارِي: وَ + الـ + سَارِي — wa-, and + sārī, night-traveller (act. part. of sarā, to travel by night, gen.); 'and the night-traveller'
الْمُحَافَظَةِ: الـ + مُحَافَظَة — muḥāfaẓa, guarding, keeping watch (verbal noun of III ḥāfaẓa ʿalā, f., gen.); 'keeping watch (over)'
فَغَابَا: فَـ + غَابَ — fa-, and + ghāba, to be absent, stay away (verb I hollow, perf. 3 dual); 'and the two were gone'
حَامِلَانِ: حَامِل — ḥāmil, carrying (act. part. of ḥamala, m. dual nom.); 'carrying (the two)'
قَمِيصٌ: قَمِيص — qamīṣ, shift, long shirt (m., nom. indef.); 'a shift'
بُنْدُ: بُنْدُ قِيٌّ — the first part of bunduqī, Venetian (from al-Bunduqiyya, Venice), printed as two words بند قي; 'Vene-'
قِيٌّ: بُنْدُ قِيٌّ — the second part of bunduqī, Venetian (rel. adj., m., nom. indef.), printed as two words بند قي; '-tian'
بِطِرَازَيْنِ: بِـ + طِرَاز — bi-, with (of what a garment has) + ṭirāz, embroidered band, border (m., gen. dual -ayni); 'with two embroidered bands'
بِبَدَائِعِ: بِـ + بَدَائِع — bi-, with (after muzarkash, what it is worked with) + badāʾiʿ, marvels, rare wonders (pl. of badīʿa, gen., construct); 'with marvels of'
التَّطْرِيزَاتِ: الـ + تَطْرِيزَات — taṭrīzāt, embroideries (pl. of taṭrīz, verbal noun of II ṭarraza, f. pl., gen.); 'the embroideries'
وَرَأْسُ: وَ + رَأْس — wa-, and + raʾs, head, end (m., nom., construct); 'and the end (of)'; here: raʾs, head (m., nom., construct): wa-raʾsu waladihi, 'and his son's head'; the hamza is printed
الْكُمَّيْنِ: الـ + كُمّ — kumm, sleeve (m., gen. dual -ayni); 'the two sleeves'
ثَلَثَةٌ: ثَلَاثَة — thalātha, three (with a m. counted noun understood, nom. indef.; spelled ثلثة without the long alif); 'three (things)'
زِيَارَتِنَا: زِيَارَة + ـنَا — ziyāra, visit, visiting (f., gen.) + -nā, us; 'visiting us'
وَخَوْفُ: وَ + خَوْف — wa-, and + khawf, fear (m., nom., construct); 'and fear (of)'
الْخَنِقِ: الـ + خَنِق — khaniq, choking (with rage), choked (adj. from khaniqa, gen.); 'the choking with rage'; perhaps for الحَنِق, al-ḥaniq, 'rancorous'
الْجَبِينِ: الـ + جَبِين — jabīn, brow, forehead (m., gen.); 'the brow'
وَوَسْوَاسُ: وَ + وَسْوَاس — wa-, and + waswās, whisper, faint rustle or tinkle (m., nom., construct); 'and the whisper (of)'
مَعَاطِفُهَا: مَعَاطِف + ـهَا — maʿāṭif, sides, folds of a garment (pl. of maʿṭif, nom.) + -hā, her; 'her folds'
عَبِقِ: عَبِق — ʿabiq, fragrant, clinging (of scent) (adj., gen. indef. in pause at the rhyme); 'fragrant'
هَبِ: وَهَبَ — wahaba, to give (imperative 2ms hab, with a linking kasra); 'grant (that), suppose'
الْجَبِينَ: الـ + جَبِين — jabīn, brow, forehead (m., acc., object put first); 'the brow'
الْكُمِّ: الـ + كُمّ — kumm, sleeve (m., gen.); 'the sleeve'
تَسْتُرُهُ: سَتَرَ + ـهُ — satara, to veil, cover (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she veils it'
وَالْحَلْيُ: وَ + الـ + حَلْي — wa-, and + ḥaly, ornament, jewellery (m., nom., put first); 'and the ornament'
تَنْزِعُهُ: نَزَعَ + ـهُ — nazaʿa, to take off, strip off (verb I, imperf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'she takes it off'
وَمَيْمُونَةُ: وَ + مَيْمُونَة — wa-, and + Maymūna, proper name of the she-ifrit (f., nom., diptote); 'and Maymūna'
حَامِلَيْنِ: حَامِل — ḥāmil, carrying (act. part. of ḥamala, m. dual acc., predicate of lam yazal); 'carrying'
وَضَعَاهَا: وَضَعَ + ـا + ـهَا — waḍaʿa, to put, set down (verb I, perf. 3 dual) + -hā, her; 'the two set her down'
وَمَدَّاهَا: وَ + مَدَّ + ـا + ـهَا — wa-, and + madda, to stretch out, lay at full length (verb I doubled, perf. 3 dual) + -hā, her; 'and the two laid her out'
وَالْعِفْرِيتَةَ: وَ + الـ + عِفْرِيتَة — wa-, and + al-, the + ʿifrīta, she-ifrit, female jinn (f., acc., coordinated with the noun of anna); 'and the she-ifrit'
وَكَشَفَا: وَ + كَشَفَ + ـا — wa-, and + kashafa, to uncover, lay bare (verb I, perf. 3 m. dual; takes ʿan for what is uncovered); 'and the two uncovered'
أَشْبَهَ: أَشْبَه — ashbah, more/most alike (elative of shabīh; acc. predicate of kāna, first term of iḍāfa; takes bi- for the one resembled); 'the most alike'
فَكَأَنَّهُمَا: فَـ + كَأَنَّ + ـهُمَا — fa-, so (conj.) + kaʾanna, as if (particle) + -humā, the two of them; 'so it was as if the two of them (were)'
أَوْأَخَوَانِ: أَوْ + أَخَوَانِ — aw, or + akhawāni, two brothers (dual of akh, nom.); set solid in the print as one word; 'or two brothers'
مُنْفَرِدَانِ: مُنْفَرِد — munfarid, alone, standing apart, matchless (act. part. of VII infarada; m. dual nom.); 'set apart, without peer'
لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: لِـ + الـ + مُتَّقِين — li-, for (prep., marking the ones tempted) + al-, the + muttaqūn, the God-fearing (act. part. of VIII ittaqā, m. pl. gen.); 'for the God-fearing'
تَعْشَقْ: عَشِقَ — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (verb I, imperf. jussive 2ms, after prohibitive lā); 'do not love'
تَحْتَارُ: اِحْتَارَ — iḥtāra, to be perplexed, at a loss (verb VIII hollow, imperf. 2ms); 'you are at a loss'
تَذَلُّلًا: تَذَلُّل — tadhallul, abasement, self-humbling (verbal noun of V tadhallala; acc. indef.); 'abasement'
وَاهْوِ: وَ + اهْوِ — wa-, and + ihwi, love! (imperative 2ms, pointed in the print as if from hawā, yahwī; the verb 'to love' is hawiya, yahwā, imper. ihwa); 'and love'
تَلْقَاهُمُ: تَلْقَى + ـهُمُ — talqā, you meet, find (laqiya, verb I defective, imperf. 2ms) + -humu, them (with the long form of the suffix for the metre); 'you will meet them'
صَدَّ: صَدَّ — ṣadda, to turn away, shun (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms); 'turned away'
يَرْقُدَانِ: رَقَدَ — raqada, to lie down, sleep (verb I, imperf. 3 m. dual indic.); 'the two would lie'
تُفَرِّقُ: فَرَّقَ — farraqa, to distinguish, tell apart (verb II, imperf. 2ms; with bayna, 'between'); 'you distinguish'
الْغَثِّ: الـ + غَثّ — al-, the + ghathth, lean, meagre, worthless (adj./noun, m., gen. after bayna; the shadda is printed); 'the lean'
وَالسَّمِينِ: وَ + الـ + سَمِين — wa-, and + al-, the + samīn, fat (adj./noun, m., gen.); 'and the fat'; with al-ghathth, 'the worthless and the good'
تُخْفِى: أَخْفَى — akhfā, to hide, conceal (verb IV defective, imperf. 2ms tukhfī; the print writes final ى for ي); 'you hide'
تَعْشَقُهَا: تَعْشَقُ + ـهَا — taʿshaqu, you love passionately (ʿashiqa, verb I, imperf. 2ms) + -hā, her; 'you love her'
قُبَلاً: قُبَل — qubal, kisses (pl. of qubla; acc. indef., inner object of qabbalat; the ḍamma and tanwīn are printed); 'kisses'
تَنْفُثُ: نَفَثَ — nafatha, to breathe out, blow (as a sorcerer blows on knots) (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'breathes out'
سِحْرَهَا: سِحْر + ـهَا — siḥr, magic, enchantment (m., acc. object) + -hā, its (the eye's); 'its magic'
بِالْحَشَا: بِـ + الـ + حَشَا — bi-, to (prep.; after faʿala, 'do to', bi- marks the one acted on) + al-, the + ḥashā, the inward parts, entrails (m., gen.); 'to the entrails'
حَمَّلْتَنِي: حَمَّلَ + ـتَ + ـنِي — ḥammala, to load, make to carry (verb II, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'you have laden me'
وَاِنَّنِيْ: وَ + اِنَّ + ـنِيْ — wa-, and (here circumstantial) + inna, indeed (printed without the hamza sign) + -nī, I (with the verse spelling of the long -ī); 'while I indeed'
بِالْعَجْزِ: بِـ + الـ + عَجْز — bi-, in, with (prep., marking the state or quality one is characterised by) + al-, the + ʿajz, incapacity, inability (m., gen.; with ʿan, 'inability to'); 'in my incapacity'
وَلَوْعَتِيْ: وَ + لَوْعَة + ـِيْ — wa-, and + lawʿa, burning pain of love (f.) + -ī, my; 'and my burning'
طَبْعٌ: طَبْع — ṭabʿ, innate nature, natural disposition (m., nom. indef., predicate); 'nature'
وَعِشْقِيْ: وَ + عِشْق + ـِيْ — wa-, and + ʿishq, passionate love (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'and my love'
تَكَلُّفُ: تَكَلُّف — takalluf, affectation, forced effort (verbal noun of V takallafa; m., nom., predicate); 'pretence'
اَبِتْ: بَاتَ — bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow, imperf. jussive 1s abit after lam; printed without the hamza sign); 'I would not spend the night'
خَصْرِكَ: خَصْر + ـكَ — khaṣr, waist (m., gen. after mithla) + -ka, your; 'your waist'
مُنْحِفُ: مُنْحِف — munḥif, as printed an act. part. of IV anḥafa, 'to make or become lean' (m., nom.; munḥaf, 'made thin', might be expected); 'wasted'
مَلَاحَةٍ: مَلَاحَة — malāḥa, grace, comeliness (f., gen. indef. after kull); 'grace'
الْاَنَامِ: الـ + اَنَام — al-, the + anām, mankind, all creatures (m. coll., gen. after bayna; printed with a fatḥa on the alif and no hamza sign); 'mankind'
الْكَئِيبُ: الـ + كَئِيب — al-, the + kaʾīb, sad, grieving (adj., m., nom., predicate; with bi-, 'grieving over'; the ئ is printed); 'the grieving one'
صِفُوا: وَصَفَ — waṣafa, to describe (verb I assimilated, imperative 2 m. pl. ṣifū); 'describe!'
تَعَلَّمْ: تَعَلَّمَ — taʿallama, to learn (verb V, imperative 2ms); 'learn!'
عِطْفَةً: عِطْفَة — ʿiṭfa, a bend, a turn, a sway (f., acc. indef., object); playing on ʿaṭafa, 'to incline in kindness'; 'a bending'
قَدِّهِ: قَدّ + ـهِ — qadd, stature, figure (m., gen. after min) + -hi, his; 'his figure'
يَرِقُّ: رَقَّ — raqqa, to grow soft, tender (of the heart) (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms); 'it softens'
وَيَعْطِفُ: وَ + عَطَفَ — wa-, and + ʿaṭafa, to bend, incline in kindness (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and inclines'
اَمِيرِيْ: اَمِير + ـِيْ — amīr, prince, emir (m.; after yā, vocative) + -ī, my (printed without the hamza sign, with the verse spelling of the long -ī); 'my prince'
الْمَلَاحَةَ: الـ + مَلَاحَة — al-, the + malāḥa, beauty, comeliness (f., acc., first object of ẓanna); 'the beauty'
اَلْجِنُّ: الـ + جِنّ — al-, the + jinn, the jinn (coll., nom., subject; treated as f. in takhshānī; the print points the alif of the article with a fatḥa); 'the jinn'
تَخْشَانِيْ: تَخْشَى + ـنِيْ — takhshā, (they) fear (khashiya, verb I defective, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the collective al-jinn) + -nī, me; 'they fear me'
قَابَلْتُهَا: قَابَلَ + ـتُ + ـهَا — qābala, to face, meet face to face (verb III, perf. 1s) + -hā, them (the jinn); 'I face them'
اَلْقَاكَ: اَلْقَى + ـكَ — alqā, I meet (laqiya, verb I defective, imperf. 1s; printed without the hamza sign) + -ka, you; 'I meet you'
يَرْجُفُ: رَجَفَ — rajafa, to tremble, quake (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'trembles'
مَهَابَةً: مَهَابَة — mahāba, awe, reverence (f., acc. indef., accusative of reason); 'out of awe'
اَصْبُو: صَبَا — ṣabā, to yearn, incline with love (verb I defective, imperf. 1s; with ilā, 'yearn toward'; printed without the hamza sign); 'I yearn'
وَالشَّعْرُ: وَ + الـ + شَعْر — wa-, and + al-, the + shaʿr, hair (m., nom.); 'and the hair'
اَسْوَدُ: اَسْوَد — aswad, black (adj., m., nom., diptote; printed without the hamza sign); 'black'
وَالْجَبِينُ: وَ + الـ + جَبِين — wa-, and + al-, the + jabīn, brow, forehead (m., nom.); 'and the brow'
مُشَعْشَعٌ: مُشَعْشَع — mushaʿshaʿ, radiant, shining (pass. part. of quadriliteral shaʿshaʿa, to spread rays; m., nom. indef.); 'radiant'
وَالطَّرْفُ: وَ + الـ + طَرْف — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭarf, eye, glance (m., nom.); 'and the eye'
اَحْوَرُ: اَحْوَر — aḥwar, having ḥawar, the deep black of the iris against clear white (adj., m., nom., diptote; printed without the hamza sign); 'dark-and-lustrous-eyed'
وَالْقِوَامُ: وَ + الـ + قِوَام — wa-, and + al-, the + qiwām, stature, figure (m., nom.); 'and the stature'
مُهَفْهَفُ: مُهَفْهَف — muhafhaf, slender, light of waist (pass. part. of quadriliteral hafhafa; m., nom.); 'slender'
وَتَدَلُّلَا: وَ + تَدَلُّل — wa-, and + tadallul, coquetry, coy airs (verbal noun of V tadallala; acc., -an read -ā at the rhyme); 'and coquetry' (the print has وتذللا, a misprint)
أَنْشَدْتِ: أَنْشَدَ + ـتِ — anshada, to recite (verse) (verb IV, perf. 2fs); 'you (f.) recited'
تَعْشَقِينَهُ: تَعْشَقِينَ + ـهُ — ʿashiqa, to love passionately (verb I, imperf. 2fs) + -hu, him (pointing back to man); 'you (f.) love him'
وَأَحْسَنْتِ: وَ + أَحْسَنْتِ — wa-, and + aḥsana, to do well (verb IV, perf. 2fs; aḥsana fī, 'to do well at'); 'and you (f.) did well'
لَابُدَّأَنِّي: لَا + بُدَّ + أَنَّ + ـي — lā, no + budd, escape (lā budda, 'there is no escape, it must be') + anna, that + -ī, I; 'I must', the print setting the three words solid as one
الْجَهْدَ: الـ + جَهْد — jahd, effort, utmost exertion (m., acc., object of abdhulu; the fatha is printed); 'the effort'
بِلَاشُعُورٍ: بِـ + لَا + شُعُور — bi-, with + lā, no + shuʿūr, awareness, consciousness (m., gen.); 'without awareness', i.e. beside himself (set solid in the print)
لَامُوا: لَامَ — lāma, to blame, reproach (verb I hollow, perf. 3mp); 'they blamed'
وَعَنَّفُوا: وَ + عَنَّفُوا — wa-, and + ʿannafa, to chide harshly (verb II, perf. 3mp); 'and they chided'
انْصَفُوا: انْصَفُوا — anṣafa, to deal fairly, do justice (verb IV, perf. 3mp; printed with no hamza on the alif, read anṣafū); 'they were fair'
جَهْلِهِمْ: جَهْل + ـهِمْ — jahl, ignorance (m., gen. after min, which gives the cause) + -him, their; 'their ignorance'
جُوْدِيْ: جُودِي — jāda, to be generous (verb I hollow, imperative 2fs; jāda bi-, 'to bestow'); 'be generous!' (the sukūn on wāw and yāʾ is the print's)
لِلْمُتَيَّمِ: لِـ + الـ + مُتَيَّم — li-, to (marking the one who receives) + mutayyam, enslaved by love (pass. part. of tayyama, verb II); 'to the love-enslaved'
هَجْرُكَ: هَجْر + ـكَ — hajr, desertion, forsaking (m.; printed nominative, though the object of dhāqa is meant) + -ka, your (m. as printed; the addressee is a woman); 'your desertion'
بِالتَّخَلُّفِ: بِـ + الـ + تَخَلُّف — bi-, by (prep., the means) + takhalluf, staying behind, keeping away (verbal noun of verb V takhallafa); 'by the staying away'
صَبَابَةً: صَبَابَة — ṣabāba, ardent love, passionate longing (f., acc. indef., specifying the affliction); 'in passion'
بِمَدَامِعِي: بِـ + مَدَامِع + ـي — bi-, with (marking what he is afflicted with) + madāmiʿ, tears, tear-ducts (pl. of madmaʿ) + -ī, my; 'with my tears'
تَحْكِى: تَحْكِى — ḥakā, to resemble, imitate (verb I defective, imperf. 3fs; spelt with ى for final ي); 'they resemble'
تَذْرُفُ: تَذْرُفُ — dharafa, to flow, shed (of tears) (verb I, imperf. 3fs); 'shedding'
اُلَاقِي: اُلَاقِي — lāqā, to meet, encounter, suffer (verb III defective, imperf. 1s; bare alif with damma for hamza, as the verse prints it); 'I meet, I suffer'
وَعَجِبْتُ: وَ + عَجِبْتُ — wa-, and + ʿajiba, to marvel (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I marvelled'
بُعْدِكَ: بُعْد + ـكَ — buʿd, distance, being far away (m., gen. after baʿda) + -ka, your; 'your being far'; also: gen. after bi-sababi: bi-sababi buʿdika, 'because of your being far' (Night 192)
حُرِمْتُ: حُرِمْتُ — ḥarama, to deny, deprive (verb I passive, perf. 1s, here as an oath-curse); 'may I be denied'
وَصْلَكِ: وَصْل + ـكِ — waṣl, union with the beloved (m., acc., second object of ḥurimtu) + -ki, your (f.); 'your union'
بِرِيبَةٍ: بِـ + رِيبَة — bi-, (marking what is intended: hamma bi-, 'to intend') + rība, suspicion, a suspect thing (f., gen. indef.); '(intended) something shameful'
يَتَكَلَّفُ: يَتَكَلَّفُ — takallafa, to force oneself, affect, feign (verb V, imperf. 3ms); 'it feigns'
اَقْوَتْ: اَقْوَتْ — aqwā, to become empty of people, desolate (verb IV defective, perf. 3fs; bare alif with fatha as the verse prints it); 'it became desolate'
مَعَاهِدُهُمْ: مَعَاهِد + ـهُمْ — maʿāhid, haunts, familiar places (pl. of maʿhad, nom.) + -hum, their; 'their haunts'
بِشَطِّ: بِـ + شَطّ — bi-, at (prep., place) + shaṭṭ, bank, shore (m., gen.); 'at the bank of'
مَقْتُولاً: مَقْتُول — maqtūl, slain (pass. part. of qatala, acc. indef., predicate of baqītu); 'slain'
وَشَطَّ: وَ + شَطَّ — wa-, and + shaṭṭa, to be far, remote (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms); 'and it went far'
وَسَكِرْتُ: وَ + سَكِرْتُ — wa-, and + sakira, to become drunk (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I grew drunk'
خَمْرِ: خَمْر — khamr, wine (f./m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the wine of'
وَرَقَّصَتْ: وَ + رَقَّصَتْ — wa-, and + raqqaṣa, to make dance, set dancing (verb II, perf. 3fs); 'and (it) set dancing'
اَسْعَى: اَسْعَى — saʿā, to strive, run (verb I defective, imperf. 1s; bare alif as the verse prints it); 'I strive'
لِاَسْعَدَ: لِـ + اَسْعَدَ — li-, so that (with the subjunctive) + saʿida, to be happy (verb I, imperf. 1s subj.); 'so that I may be happy'
بُدُورِ: بُدُور — budūr, full moons (pl. of badr; gen., first term of an iḍāfa), and also the name of the princess Budūr; 'the full moons of'
سُعَادِ: سُعَاد — Suʿād, a woman's name, the stock beloved of Arabic love poetry (gen.; the -i is the rhyme for the diptote -a); 'Suʿād'
اَدْرِ: اَدْرِ — darā, to know (verb I defective, jussive 1s after lam); 'I (do not) know'
اَيِّ: اَيّ — ayy, which? (gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'which (of)'
اَشْتَكِي: اَشْتَكِي — ishtakā, to complain (verb VIII defective, imperf. 1s; ishtakā min, 'to complain of'); 'I complain'
عَدَدْتُ: عَدَدْتُ — ʿadda, to count (verb I doubled, perf. 1s); 'I have counted'
فَاَصْغِ: فَـ + اَصْغِ — fa-, so (conj.) + aṣghā, to lend an ear, listen (verb IV defective, imperative 2ms; aṣghā li-, 'listen to'); 'so listen'
لِلْاِعْدَادِ: لِـ + الـ + اِعْدَاد — li-, to (marking what is listened to, after aṣghā) + iʿdād, making ready (verbal noun of verb IV aʿadda), here 'the count' for the rhyme; 'to the count'
لَحْظِهَا: لَحْظ + ـهَا — laḥẓ, glance (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her glance'
الرَّمَّاحِ: الـ + رَمَّاح — rammāḥ, lancer, spearman (intensive form from rumḥ, lance; gen.); 'the lancer'
صُدْغِهَا: صُدْغ + ـهَا — ṣudgh, temple, and the lock of hair curling on it (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her temple-curl'
الزَّرَّادِ: الـ + زَرَّاد — zarrād, maker of chain mail, armourer (intensive form from zarad, mail; gen.); 'the mail-maker'
فَتَّشْتُ: فَتَّشْتُ — fattasha, to search (verb II, perf. 1s; fattasha ʿan, 'to search for'); 'I searched'
لَاقَيْتُهُ: لَاقَيْتُ + ـهُ — lāqā, to meet (verb III defective, perf. 1s) + -hu, him (pointing back to man); 'I met him'
بَادِيْ: بَادِي — bādī, desert-dweller, nomad (act. part. of badā; Classical indef. gen. bādin, the -ī kept for the rhyme); 'a desert-dweller'
فُؤَادِكَ: فُؤَاد + ـكَ — fuʾād, heart (m., gen. after fī; printed with ؤ) + -ka, your; 'your heart'
طَرْفَكَ: طَرْف + ـكَ — ṭarf, glance, eye (m., acc., object of irmi) + -ka, your; 'your glance'
تَرْنِيْ: تَرَ + ـنِي — raʾā, to see (verb I, jussive 2ms tara, answering the imperative) + -nī, me; printed tarnī for the metre (regular taranī); 'you will see me'
يَادَهْنَشُ: يَا + دَهْنَشُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Dahnash, name of the ifrit (nom. as vocative); printed as one word; 'O Dahnash'
يُعَارِضَانِ: يُعَارِضَانِ — ʿāraḍa, to oppose, contradict (verb III, imperf. 3 m. dual, indic.); 'the two contradicting (each other)'
تَبْطِشَ: تَبْطِشَ — baṭasha, to seize violently, attack (verb I, imperf. 3fs, subj. after an); takes bi- for the victim; 'that she fall upon'
فَذَلَّ: فَـ + ذَلَّ — fa-, so, at that + dhalla, to be humbled, humble oneself (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms); with li-, 'before'; 'so he humbled himself'
وَرَقَّقَ: وَ + رَقَّقَ — wa-, and + raqqaqa, to make soft, gentle (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he softened'
يَصْعُبْ: يَصْعُبْ — ṣaʿuba, to be hard, difficult (verb I, imperf. 3ms, jussive after prohibitive lā); with ʿalā, 'be hard on'; 'let (it) not be hard'
فَأَبْطِلِي: فَـ + أَبْطِلِي — fa-, so + abṭala, to annul, make void, set aside (verb IV, imper. 2fs); 'so set aside'
قَوْلَكِ: قَوْل + ـكِ — qawl, word, saying, claim (m., acc.) + -ki, your (f.); 'your claim'
وَقَوْلِي: وَ + قَوْل + ـِي — wa-, and + qawl, word, claim (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'and my claim'
كُلًّا: كُلًّا — kull, each, every one (m., acc. indef., noun of inna; followed by minnā, 'each of us'); 'each'
يَشْهَدُ: يَشْهَدُ — shahida, to bear witness, testify (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with li-, 'for, in favour of'; 'bears witness'
لِمَعْشُوقِهِ: لِـ + مَعْشُوق + ـهِ — li-, for, in favour of (prep.; after shahida it marks the one the testimony favours) + maʿshūq, beloved (pass. part. of ʿashiqa, m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'for his beloved'
فَيُعْرِضُ: فَـ + يُعْرِضُ — fa-, so + aʿraḍa, to turn away (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); with ʿan, 'turn from, give up'; 'so let (each) turn away'
يَفْصِلُ: يَفْصِلُ — faṣala, to separate, decide (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with al-ḥukm, 'to settle the case'; 'decides'
الْحُكْمَ: الـ + حُكْم — ḥukm, judgement, decision (m., acc.); 'the judgement'
وَنَعْتَمِدُ: وَ + نَعْتَمِدُ — wa-, and + iʿtamada, to rely, depend (verb VIII, imperf. 1pl); with ʿalā, 'on'; 'and we rely'
دَقَّتْ: دَقَّتْ — daqqa, to knock, strike, pound (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs); 'she struck'
أَجْرَبُ: أَجْرَبُ — ajrab, mangy, scabby (adj. of the afʿal pattern for bodily defects, m., nom., diptote); 'mangy'
وَعَيْنَاةُ: وَ + عَيْنَا + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿaynān, two eyes (f. dual, nom.; the nūn drops before the pronoun) + -hu, his, written with ة by the print; 'and his two eyes'
مَشْقُوقَتَانِ: مَشْقُوقَتَانِ — mashqūq, split, slit (pass. part. of shaqqa, f. dual, nom.); 'slit (the two)'
بِالطُّولِ: بِـ + الـ + طُول — bi-, by, along (prep.; gives the manner) + ṭūl, length (m., gen.); 'lengthwise'
قُرُونٍ: قُرُون — qurūn, horns (pl. of qarn, m.; gen. indef. after a number); 'horns'
ذَوَائِبَ: ذَوَائِب — dhawāʾib, locks, braids of hair (pl. of dhuʾāba; diptote, gen. in -a after a number); 'locks'
مُسْتَرْسِلَةٌ: مُسْتَرْسِلَة — mustarsil, hanging loose, flowing (act. part. of X istarsala; f. sg., nom., agreeing with a plural of things); 'hanging loose'
كَعْبَيْهِ: كَعْبَيْ + ـهِ — kaʿb, ankle (m.; dual gen., the nūn dropped) + -hi, his; 'his two ankles'
وَيَدَاةُ: وَ + يَدَا + ـهُ — wa-, and + yad, hand (f., dual nom., the nūn dropped) + -hu, his, written with ة by the print; 'and his two hands'
الْمَدَارِي: الـ + مَدَارِي — madārī, plural of midrā/midrāt, a long-toothed comb or pin (old lexicons); in later Egyptian use a wooden winnowing fork; 'the pitchforks'
وَرِجْلَاةُ: وَ + رِجْلَا + ـهُ — wa-, and + rijl, foot, leg (f., dual nom., the nūn dropped) + -hu, his, written with ة by the print; 'and his two legs'
الصَّوَارِي: الـ + صَوَارِي — ṣawārī, masts (pl. of ṣārī, ship's mast); 'the masts'
أَظْفَارٌ: أَظْفَار — aẓfār, nails, claws (pl. of ẓufr; nom. indef.); 'claws'
أَظْفَارِ: أَظْفَار — aẓfār, nails, claws (pl. of ẓufr; gen., first term of an iḍāfa after mithl); 'the claws of'
وَحَوَافِرُ: وَ + حَوَافِرُ — wa-, and + ḥawāfir, hooves (pl. of ḥāfir; diptote, nom.); 'and hooves'
الْوَحْشِيِّ: الـ + وَحْشِيّ — waḥshī, wild, untamed (nisba adj. of waḥsh, wild beast; m., gen.); al-ḥimār al-waḥshī, 'the wild ass, onager'
يَاقَشْقَشُ: يَا + قَشْقَشُ — yā, O (vocative particle) + Qashqash, name of an ifrit (nom. as vocative); printed as one word; 'O Qashqash'
تَحْكُمَ: تَحْكُمَ — ḥakama, to judge (verb I, imperf. 2ms, subj. after an); with bayna … wa-bayna, 'between … and'; 'that you judge'
قَشْقَشُ: قَشْقَش — Qashqash, name of the ifrit summoned to judge (proper name, diptote; nom., in apposition to al-ʿifrīt / al-mārid); 'Qashqash'
قَشْقَشَ: قَشْقَش — Qashqash, name of an ifrit (proper name, diptote; acc., in apposition to al-ʿifrīta after inna); 'Qashqash'; also: gen. after ilā: iltafatat ilā Qashqasha, 'she turned to Qashqash'
وَوَجْهِ: وَ + وَجْه — wa-, and + wajh, face (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the face of'
فَرَآهُمَا: فَـ + رَآ + ـهُمَا — fa-, and so + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 3ms; the print's madda alif) + -humā, the two of them; 'and he saw them both'
وَمِعْصَمُ: وَ + مِعْصَم — wa-, and + miʿṣam, wrist (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the wrist of'
مُتَشَابِهَانِ: مُتَشَابِهَانِ — mutashābih, resembling one another (act. part. of VI tashābaha; m. dual, nom.); 'alike (the two)'
مُتَسَاوِيَانِ: مُتَسَاوِيَانِ — mutasāwī, equal to one another (act. part. of VI tasāwā; m. dual, nom.); 'equal (the two)'
لِهِمَا: لِهِمَا — the second part of جَمَالِهِمَا jamālihimā, 'their loveliness', split by the print into جما + لهما: -li- ends jamāl, -himā, of the two of them; read with the word before: wa-jamālihimā, 'and their loveliness'
وَدَهْنَشَ: وَ + دَهْنَش — wa-, and + Dahnash, name of the ifrit (diptote; gen. in -a, after ilā); 'and Dahnash'
وَالصَّبِيَّةِ: وَ + الـ + صَبِيَّة — wa-, and + ṣabiyya, girl, maiden (f., gen.); 'and the girl'
الِالْتِفَاتَ: الـ + الْتِفَات — iltifāt, turning (to look), gazing (verbal noun of VIII iltafata; m., acc., object of aṭāla); 'the looking'
حَاسِدِ: حَاسِد — ḥāsid, envier, envious one (act. part. of ḥasada; m., gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa; -i at the rhyme); 'an envier'
الْحَسُوْدُ: الـ + حَسُود — ḥasūd, envious, the envious one (intensive adj., m., nom.; the print sets a sukūn on the long vowel's wāw); 'the envious one'
الرَّحْمٰنُ: الـ + رَحْمٰن — al-Raḥmān, the Merciful, a name of God (nom.; dagger alif as the print has it); 'the Merciful'
الْمُرَادُ: الـ + مُرَاد — murād, what is wished for, the desired (pass. part. of IV arāda; m., nom.); 'the desired one'
الْقُلُوْبُ: الـ + قُلُوب — qulūb, hearts (pl. of qalb; nom.; the print sets a sukūn on the long vowel's wāw); 'the hearts'
حَدِيْدٍ: حَدِيد — ḥadīd, iron (m., gen. indef. after fī; the print sets a sukūn on the long vowel's yāʾ); 'iron'
يَلُوْمُ: يَلُومُ — lāma, to blame, reproach (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms; the print sets a sukūn on the long vowel's wāw); with ʿalā, 'for'; 'blames'
تَسْتَطِيْعُ: تَسْتَطِيعُ — istaṭāʿa, to be able (verb X hollow, imperf. 2ms; the print sets a sukūn on the long vowel's yāʾ); 'you are able, can you'
رَحْمٰنُ: رَحْمٰن — Raḥmān, Merciful One, as a name of God (nom., vocative after yā, without the article); 'O Merciful'
أَرَدْتُمَا: أَرَدْتُمَا — arāda, to want (verb IV hollow, perf. 2 dual); 'you two want'
الِا: الِا — the first part of الِاثْنَيْنِ al-ithnayni, 'the two', split by the print into الا + ثنين; read with the next word
ثْنَيْنِ: ثْنَيْنِ — the second part of الِاثْنَيْنِ al-ithnayni, 'the two' (dual of ithnān, oblique), split by the print into الا + ثنين; read with the word before
يُفَرَّقُ: يُفَرَّقُ — farraqa, to separate, tell apart (verb II, imperf. passive 3ms, impersonal); with bayna, 'no distinction is made between'; 'is distinguished'
بِالتَّذْكِيرِ: بِـ + الـ + تَذْكِير — bi-, by (prep.; gives the ground of the distinction) + tadhkīr, masculinity, the masculine gender (verbal noun of II dhakkara); 'by the masculine'
وَالتَّأْنِيثِ: وَ + الـ + تَأْنِيث — wa-, and + taʾnīth, femininity, the feminine gender (verbal noun of II annatha; hamza supplied, the print has bare alif); 'and the feminine'
نُنَبِّهُ: نُنَبِّهُ — nabbaha, to wake, rouse (verb II, imperf. 1pl); 'we wake'
وَقَرَصَ: وَ + قَرَصَ — wa-, and + qaraṣa, to pinch, nip; of a flea, to bite (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he bit'
وَهَرَشَ: وَ + هَرَشَ — wa-, and + harasha, to scratch (an itch) (verb I, perf. 3ms; everyday word); 'and he scratched'
الْقَرْصَةِ: الـ + قَرْصَة — al-, the + qarṣa, a nip, a bite (f., gen.; noun of a single act from qaraṣa, 'to nip'); 'the bite'
أَحْرَقَتْهُ: أَحْرَقَ + ـتْ + ـهُ — aḥraqa, to burn (verb IV, perf. 3fs, the subject being the qarṣa, 'bite') + -hu, him; 'it burned him'
وَنَفَسُهُ: وَ + نَفَس + ـهُ — wa-, and + nafas, breath (m., nom.; the fatha on ف is printed, distinguishing it from nafs, 'self') + -hu, its/his; 'and its breath'
أَزْكَى: azkā — elative of zakā, 'to be pure', of a scent 'sweet' (indecl.); with min, 'purer, sweeter than'
الْأَذْفَرِ: الـ + أَذْفَر — al-, the + adhfar, of sharp, strong scent (adj., m., gen.; said of musk); 'the pungent'
وَجِسْمُهُ: وَ + جِسْم + ـهُ — wa-, and + jism, body (m., nom.) + -hu, its/his; 'and its body'
أَلْيَنُ: alyanu — elative of layyin, 'soft' (diptote, nom.); with min, 'softer than'
الشَّخْصِ: الـ + شَخْص — al-, the + shakhṣ, person, figure (m., gen. after ilā); 'the figure'
الرَّاقِدِ: الـ + رَاقِد — al-, the + rāqid, lying asleep (act. part. of raqada; m., gen., adj.); 'sleeping'
الْمَبْنِيَّةِ: الـ + مَبْنِيَّة — al-, the + mabniyya, built (pass. part. of banā; f., gen.; the shadda is printed); 'the well-built'
بِقَامَةِ: بِـ + قَامَة — bi-, with (prep., of the quality possessed) + qāma, stature, figure (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'with a stature (of)'
بَارِزَةَ: بَارِزَة — bāriza, jutting, prominent (act. part. of baraza; f., acc., annexed to al-nahd); bārizat al-nahd, 'full-breasted'
مُوَرَّدَةَ: مُوَرَّدَة — muwarrada, rose-tinted (pass. part. of II warrada; f., acc., annexed to al-khadd; the shadda is printed); 'rosy (of cheek)'
اجْتَمَعْنَ: ijtamaʿna — ijtamaʿa, to come together (verb VIII, perf. 3fpl, of things); 'they came together'
اَذَى: adhā — harm, hurt (m., gen. after ʿalā, first term of an iḍāfa; printed with bare alif and fatha); 'the harm of'
وَسَفْكِ: وَ + سَفْك — wa-, and + safk, shedding (verbal noun of safaka, to shed blood; m., gen.); 'and the shedding of'
جَبِيْنٍ: jabīn — brow, forehead (m., gen. indef.; the print sets a sukūn on the long ī); 'a brow'
وَلَيْلُ: وَ + لَيْل — wa-, and + layl, night (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the night of'
سَالِفَةٍ: sālifa — the lock of hair at the temple (f., gen. indef.); 'a temple-lock'
مُبْتَسِمِ: mubtasim — smiling (act. part. of VIII ibtasama; gen.); here the smiling mouth, the smile
عَنْبَرًا: ʿanbar — ambergris (m., acc. indef.; ḥāl after fāḥat, 'breathed as ambergris')
وَرَنَتْ: وَ + رَنَتْ — wa-, and + ranā, to gaze fixedly (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she gazed'
غِزَالًا: ghizālan — the print's pointing of ghazāl, gazelle (m., acc. indef.; ḥāl after ranat, 'gazed as a gazelle')
مَشْغُوفٌ: mashghūf — smitten, passionately in love (pass. part. of shaghafa; m., nom.); with bi-, 'smitten with'
فَسَاعَةُ: فَـ + سَاعَة — fa-, so + sāʿa, hour (f.; printed nom., standing as topic, first term of an iḍāfa); 'so the hour of'
هَجْرِهَا: هَجْر + هَا — hajr, desertion, forsaking (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her desertion'
الْوِصَالَا: الـ + وِصَال — al-, the + wiṣāl, union with the beloved (m., acc.; the final alif lengthens the rhyme vowel); 'union'
نَائِمَهْ: نَائِمَه — nāʾima, asleep (act. part. of nāma; f.; printed with ه for ة and read pausally, nāʾimah; the ئ is printed); 'asleep'
بُنْدُقِيًّا: bunduqī — Venetian (rel. adj. from al-Bunduqiyya, Venice; m., acc. indef.); 'Venetian'
حَلَقٍ: ḥalaq — earrings (collective, m., gen. after zawj); 'earrings'
الْكَوْكَبِ: الـ + كَوْكَب — al-, the + kawkab, star (m., gen.); 'the star'
الْيَتِيمِ: الـ + يَتِيم — al-, the + yatīm, orphan; of a pearl, single in its shell and so peerless (adj., gen.); 'matchless'
مَدْهُوشَ: madhūsh — bewildered, dazed (pass. part. of dahasha; m., acc. as predicate of ṣāra, annexed to al-ʿaql); 'dazed (of mind)'
الْغَرِيزِيَّةُ: الـ + غَرِيزِيَّة — al-, the + gharīziyya, innate, natural (rel. adj. from gharīza, instinct; f., nom.); al-ḥarāra al-gharīziyya, 'the innate (vital) heat'
شَهْوَةَ: shahwa — lust, appetite, desire (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the lust of'
الْجِمَاعِ: الـ + جِمَاع — al-, the + jimāʿ, sexual intercourse (m., gen.; verbal noun of III jāmaʿa); 'coupling'
مَاشَاءَ: مَا + شَاءَ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + shāʾa, to will (perf. 3ms; the ء is printed); set solid in the print; 'whatever (God) willed'
يَشَأْ: yashaʾ — shāʾa, to will (verb I hollow, jussive 3ms after lam; the أ is printed); 'he (has not) willed'
نُهُودَهَا: نُهُود + هَا — nuhūd, breasts (pl. of nahd; acc., object of raʾā) + -hā, her; 'her breasts'
حُقَّيْنِ: ḥuqqayni — dual of ḥuqq, a small round box, casket (m., gen. after mithla); 'two caskets'
رَغْبَةً: raghba — desire (f., acc., absolute object of raghiba); 'a desire'
يُنَبِّهُهَا: يُنَبِّهُ + هَا — nabbaha, to wake, rouse someone (verb II, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'he rouses her'
تَنْتَبِهُ: tantabihu — intabaha, to wake up (verb VIII, imperf. 3fs); 'she wakes'
ثَقَّلَ: thaqqala — to make heavy (verb II, perf. 3ms; unpointed in the print); 'he made heavy'
نَوْمَهَا: نَوْم + هَا — nawm, sleep (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her sleep'
يَهُزُّهَا: يَهُزُّ + هَا — hazza, to shake (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'shaking her'
وَيُحَرِّكُهَا: وَ + يُحَرِّكُ + هَا — wa-, and + ḥarraka, to move (verb II, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'and moving her'
اسْتَيْقِظِي: istayqiẓī — istayqaẓa, to wake up (verb X, imperative 2fs); 'wake up!'
تَسْتَيْقِظْ: tastayqiẓ — istayqaẓa, to wake up (verb X, jussive 3fs after lam); 'she (did not) wake' ; also: after prohibitive lā: lā tastayqiẓ sarīʿan, 'she is not to wake quickly'
تُحَرِّكْ: tuḥarrik — ḥarraka, to move (verb II, jussive 3fs after lam); 'she (did not) move'
حَذْرِي: حَذْر + ـي — doubtful: read as ḥazr, guess, conjecture, spelt with ذ for ز (the sounds merge in everyday speech), or as ḥadhar, wariness, misgiving (m., nom.) + -ī, my; in ṣadaqa ḥadhrī, 'if my guess is right'
فَهٰذِهِ: فَـ + هٰذِهِ — fa-, then (introducing the answer of a condition) + hādhihi, this (demonstrative, f.); 'then this'
أَمْتَنِعُ: amtaniʿu — imtanaʿa, to refuse, hold back (verb VIII, imperf. 1s); with min, 'refuse (it)'
زَوِّجْنِى: زَوِّجْ + نِى — zawwaja, to give in marriage (verb II, imperative 2ms; the shadda is printed) + -nī, me (printed with ى for ي); with bi-, which marks the bride: zawwijnī bihā, 'marry me to her'
تَمَلَّى: تَمَلَّى — (a)tamallā, the rest of li-atamallā split by the print: tamallā, to take one's fill of, enjoy to the full (verb V, imperf. 1s subjunctive, defective; with bi- of what is enjoyed); li-atamallā bihā, 'that I may take my fill of her' (doubtful reading of لا تملى)
بِجَانِبِى: بِـ + جَانِب + ى — bi-, at (prep. of place) + jānib, side (m., gen.) + -ī, my (printed with ى for ي); 'at my side, beside me' (the print has بجابنى, a misprint, corrected)
وَقَرَصَتْهَا: وَ + قَرَصَتْ + هَا — wa-, and + qaraṣa, to pinch, nip; of a flea, to bite (verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, her; 'and she nipped her' (the print has وفرصتها, a misprint, corrected)
أُصْبِحُ: أُصْبِحُ — aṣbaḥa, to be (or do a thing) in the morning (verb IV, imperf. 1s); 'I shall rise in the morning (and …)'
يَفُوتُ: يَفُوتُ — fāta, to pass, go by (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); after atruku niṣfa al-nahāri, 'I let half the day go by'
أَفُوزَ: أَفُوزَ — fāza, to win, attain (verb I hollow, subjunctive 1s after ḥattā); with bi- of the prize: afūza bi-wiṣālihā, 'I win union with her'
وَخَجِلَتْ: وَ + خَجِلَتْ — wa-, and + khajila, to be abashed, ashamed (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she was put to shame'
يُقَبِّلَهَا: يُقَبِّلَ + هَا — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, subjunctive 3ms after an; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; 'to kiss her'
وَأَلْفَتَ: وَ + أَلْفَتَ — wa-, and + alfata, read as a Form IV of lafata, to turn (aside) (perf. 3ms); doubtful: the print's والفت may be lafata with a stray alif, or iltafata, to turn, with a tāʾ dropped; with wajhahu, 'and he turned his face away'
لِقَلْبِهِ: لِـ + قَلْب + هِ — li-, to (prep., marks the one addressed) + qalb, heart (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'to his heart'
وَحَبَسَنِى: وَ + حَبَسَ + نِى — wa-, and + ḥabasa, to shut up, imprison (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى for ي); 'and he shut me up'
بِهٰذِهِ: بِـ + هٰذِهِ — bi-, with + hādhihi, this (f.): after jāʾa, 'came with' = 'brought' (jāʾa lī bi-hādhihi al-ṣabiyyati, 'brought me this girl'); after faʿala, 'to': mā afʿaluhu bi-hādhihi al-ṣabiyyati, 'what I do to this girl'; also of the means, 'by': nablughu bi-hādhihi al-ḥīlati, 'we shall attain by this ruse' (Night 201)
لِيَمْتَحِنَنِي: لِـ + يَمْتَحِنَ + نِي — li-, in order to (with the subjunctive) + imtaḥana, to test, try (verb VIII, subjunctive 3ms) + -nī, me; 'to put me to the test'
نَبَّهْتُهَا: نَبَّهْتُ + هَا — nabbaha, to rouse, wake (verb II, perf. 1s; the shadda is printed) + -hā, her; after idhā, 'when I rouse her'
فَأَعْلِمِينِي: فَـ + أَعْلِمِي + نِي — fa-, then (bringing in the answer to a condition) + aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, imperative 2fs) + -nī, me; with bi- of the news: fa-aʿlimīnī bihi, 'then let me know of it'
أَنْظُرُهُ: أَنْظُرُ + هُ — naẓara, to look, see (verb I, imperf. 1s) + -hu, him; taking its object directly, as in everyday speech (Classical naẓara ilā); 'I see him'
فَيُصْبِحُ: فَـ + يُصْبِحُ — fa-, and then + aṣbaḥa, to be (doing) in the morning (verb IV, imperf. 3ms); with a following imperfect: fa-yuṣbiḥu yuwabbikhunī, 'and in the morning he will be scolding me'
يُوَبِّخُنِى: يُوَبِّخُ + نِى — wabbakha, to reproach, scold (verb II, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -nī, me (printed with ى for ي); 'he scolds me'
قَبَّلْتَ: قَبَّلْتَ — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, perf. 2ms); 'you kissed'
وَعَانَقْتَهَا: وَ + عَانَقْتَ + هَا — wa-, and + ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 2ms) + -hā, her; 'and you embraced her'
أَكُفُّ: أَكُفُّ — kaffa, to hold back, restrain (verb I doubled, imperf. 1s; the shadda is printed); kaffa nafsahu ʿan, 'to restrain oneself from'; 'I restrain'
أَلْمِسُ: أَلْمِسُ — lamasa, to touch (verb I, imperf. 1s; also almusu); 'I touch'
أَمَارَةً: أَمَارَة — amāra, sign, token (f., acc. indef., predicate of yakūnu); 'a token'
وَتَذْكِرَةً: وَ + تَذْكِرَة — wa-, and + tadhkira, reminder, keepsake (f., acc. indef.); 'and a remembrance'
كَفَّ: كَفّ — kaff, palm, hand (f., acc., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the hand of'
خِنْصِرِهَا: خِنْصِر + هَا — khinṣir, little finger (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her little finger'
فَصَّهُ: فَصّ + هُ — faṣṣ, the stone or bezel of a ring (m., acc. after anna) + -hu, its; 'its stone'
نَفِيسِ: نَفِيس — nafīs, precious, costly (adj., gen., first term of an iḍāfa with its noun: nafīsi al-jawāhiri, 'the costliest of jewels')
وَمَنْقُوشٌ: وَ + مَنْقُوش — wa-, and + manqūsh, engraved (pass. part. of naqasha; m., nom. indef., predicate set before its subject hādhihi al-abyātu); 'and engraved (are)'; also: second predicate of saqfuhu, 'figured, worked': wa-manqūshun bi-al-dhahabi, 'and worked with gold' (Night 192)
دَائِرَتِهِ: دَائِرَة + هِ — dāʾira, circle, ring (f., gen.; the ئ is printed) + -hi, its; here the hoop of the ring; 'its band'
تَحْسِبُوْا: تَحْسِبُوْا — ḥasiba, to think, reckon (verb I, jussive 2mp after prohibitive lā; the sukūn on the wāw is printed, marking the long vowel); lā taḥsibū, 'do not think'
عُهُودَكُمْ: عُهُود + كُمْ — ʿuhūd, pledges, compacts (pl. of ʿahd; acc.) + -kum, your; 'your pledges'
اَطَلْتُمْ: اَطَلْتُمْ — aṭāla, to prolong, make long (verb IV hollow, perf. 2mp; the edition prints alif with fatha); 'you have prolonged'
صُدُودَكُمْ: صُدُود + كُمْ — ṣudūd, turning away, aversion (verbal noun of ṣadda; acc.) + -kum, your; 'your turning away'
جُودُوْا: جُودُوْا — jāda, to be generous (verb I hollow, imperative 2mp; the sukūn on the wāw is printed); with ʿalā, 'be generous to'
وَاَعْطِفُوْا: وَ + اَعْطِفُوْا — wa-, and + aʿṭifū, be kind, incline with favour (imperative 2mp, pointed in the print as a Form IV, as the metre requires; ʿaṭafa is ordinarily Form I); 'and be kind'
ثَغْرَكُمْ: ثَغْر + كُمْ — thaghr, mouth, properly the front teeth (m., acc.) + -kum, your; 'your mouth'
وَخُدُودَكُمْ: وَ + خُدُود + كُمْ — wa-, and + khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd; acc.) + -kum, your; 'and your cheeks'
اَبْرَحُ: اَبْرَحُ — bariḥa, to leave, quit (verb I, imperf. 1s; the edition prints alif with fatha); with ʿan, 'to depart from'; lastu abraḥu ʿankumu, 'I am not leaving you'
اعْتَدَيْتُمْ: اعْتَدَيْتُمْ — iʿtadā, to transgress, overstep (verb VIII defective, perf. 2mp); with ḥudūdakum, 'you overstep your bounds'
