حُدُودَكُمْ: حُدُود + كُمْ — ḥudūd, bounds, limits (pl. of ḥadd; acc.) + -kum, your; 'your bounds'
الْخَاتَمَ: الـ + خَاتَم — al-, the + khātam, ring, seal-ring (m., acc.); 'the ring'
خِنْصِرِ: خِنْصِر — khinṣir, little finger (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the little finger of'
وَلَبِسَهُ: وَ + لَبِسَ + هُ — wa-, and + labisa, to put on, wear (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and he put it on'
خِنْصِرِهِ: خِنْصِر + هِ — khinṣir, little finger (f., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his little finger'
لِدَهْنَشَ: لِـ + دَهْنَش — li-, to (prep., marks the one addressed) + Dahnash, name of the ʿifrīt (diptote, gen. in -a); 'to Dahnash'
وَقَشْقَشَ: وَ + قَشْقَش — wa-, and + Qashqash, name of the ʿifrīt (diptote, gen. in -a, still governed by li-); 'and (to) Qashqash'
رَأَيْتُمَا: رَأَيْتُمَا — raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 2 dual; the أ is printed); 'you two saw'
وَمَافَعَلَهُ: وَ + مَا + فَعَلَ + هُ — wa-, and + mā, what (rel. pron.) + faʿala, to do (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it; set solid in the print; 'and what he did'
الْعِفَّةِ: الـ + عِفَّة — al-, the + ʿiffa, chastity, abstinence (f., gen.); with ʿan, 'abstaining from'
مَحَاسِنِهِ: مَحَاسِن + هِ — maḥāsin, good qualities, charms (pl. without a singular in use; gen.) + -hi, his; 'his virtues'
فَانْظُرَا: فَـ + انْظُرَا — fa-, so + naẓara, to look (verb I, imperative dual); 'so look, you two'
يُعَانِقْهَا: يُعَانِقْ + هَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, jussive 3ms after lam) + -hā, her; '(he did not) embrace her'
يُقَبِّلْهَا: يُقَبِّلْ + هَا — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, jussive 3ms after lam) + -hā, her; '(he did not) kiss her'
أَدَارَ: أَدَارَ — adāra, to turn round (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms); adāra ẓahrahu ilā, 'he turned his back on'
بُرْغُوثًا: بُرْغُوث — burghūth, flea (m., acc. indef., second object of jaʿala); 'a flea'
سَاقِهَا: سَاق + هَا — sāq, shank, leg below the knee (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her leg'
فَخِذِهَا: فَخِذ + هَا — fakhidh, thigh (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her thigh'
قَرَارِيطَ: قَرَارِيط — qarārīṭ, pl. of qīrāṭ, a twenty-fourth part; here probably of the cubit, so a measure of length (diptote, gen. in -a after arbaʿati); 'qīrāṭs'
وَاسْتَوَتْ: وَ + اسْتَوَتْ — wa-, and + istawā, to straighten up, sit upright (verb VIII defective, perf. 3fs); 'and she sat up'
يَغِطُّ: يَغِطُّ — ghaṭṭa, to snore, breathe heavily in sleep (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms); 'he snores'
لَوَاحِظُ: لَوَاحِظ — lawāḥiẓ, glances; properly the outer corners of the eyes (pl. of lāḥiẓ; diptote, nom.); 'glances'
الْحُورَ: الـ + حُور — al-, the + ḥūr, houris, the dark-eyed maidens of Paradise (pl. of ḥawrāʾ; acc., object of tukhjilu); 'the houris'
الْحِسَانَ: الـ + حِسَان — al-, the + ḥisān, beautiful (pl. of ḥasan/ḥasana; acc., agreeing with al-ḥūr); 'the lovely'
وَرِيقُهُ: وَ + رِيق + هُ — wa-, and + rīq, saliva, spittle (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'and his spittle'
وَأَنْفَعُ: وَ + أَنْفَع — wa-, and + anfaʿ, more beneficial (elative of nāfiʿ; nom.); with min, 'more healing than'
التِّرْيَاقِ: الـ + تِرْيَاق — al-, the + tiryāq, theriac, the antidote to poison (m., gen. after min, 'than'); 'theriac'
وَفَمٌ: وَ + فَم — wa-, and + fam, mouth (m., nom. indef., still governed by wa-lahu, 'he had'); 'and a mouth'
وَشَفَتَانِ: وَ + شَفَتَانِ — wa-, and + shafatāni, two lips (dual of shafa, f., nom.); 'and two lips'
لَوْنِ: لَوْن — lawn, colour (m., gen., after mithla, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the colour of'
الْمَرْجَانِ: الـ + مَرْجَان — al-, the + marjān, coral (m., gen.); 'coral'
وَخُدُودٌ: وَ + خُدُود — wa-, and + khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd; nom. indef.); 'and cheeks'
سَلَى: سَلَى — salā, to be consoled for, forget (verb I, perf. 3ms; spelt with ى); with ʿan, 'to forget (someone)', and bi- of the consolation
زَيْنَبٍ: زَيْنَب — Zaynab, a woman's name (gen. after ʿan; given tanwīn in the verse); 'Zaynab'
وَنَوَارِي: وَ + نَوَار — wa-, and + Nawār, a woman's name (gen., with the rhyme vowel -ī); 'and Nawār'
بِوَرْدَةِ: بِـ + وَرْدَة — bi-, by (prep., marks that by which he is consoled, after salā) + warda, rose (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'by the rose of'
آسِ: آس — ās, myrtle (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa; the آ is printed); 'the myrtle of'
عِذَارِ: عِذَار — ʿidhār, the line of first down on a youth's cheek (m., gen., with the rhyme vowel); 'a cheek-down'
وَاَصْبَحْتُ: وَ + اَصْبَحْتُ — wa-, and + aṣbaḥa, to become (verb IV, perf. 1s; the edition prints alif with fatha); 'and I have become'
الْمُقَرْطَقِ: الـ + مُقَرْطَق — al-, the + muqarṭaq, wearing a qurṭaq, the short tunic of youths and pages (pass. part., gen., agreeing with al-ẓaby); 'the tunic-clad'
سِوَارِ: سِوَار — siwār, bracelet (m., gen., with the rhyme vowel); dhātu siwārin, 'one who wears a bracelet', a woman
النَّادِي: الـ + نَادِي — al-, the + nādī, gathering, assembly of men (m., gen.); 'the gathering'
قَرَارَةِ: قَرَارَة — qarāra, the bottom, inmost part (f., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); qarārat al-dār, 'the depths of the house'
لَائِمِي: لَائِم + ي — lāʾim, blamer, reproacher (act. part. of lāma; the ئ is printed) + -ī, my; after yā, 'O you who blame me'
هَجْرِ: هَجْر — hajr, forsaking, leaving (verbal noun of hajara; gen. after fī, 'for'); 'the forsaking of'
هِنْدٍ: هِنْد — Hind, a woman's name (gen.; given tanwīn in the verse); 'Hind'
وَزَيْنَبٍ: وَ + زَيْنَب — wa-, and + Zaynab, a woman's name (gen.); 'and Zaynab'
كَالصَّبَاحِ: كَـ + الـ + صَبَاح — ka-, like (prep. of comparison) + al-, the + ṣabāḥ, morning (m., gen.); 'like the morning'
لِسَارِ: لِـ + سَار — li-, to, for (prep., marks the one it shines for) + sārin, one who travels by night (act. part. of sarā, defective; gen. indef., with the rhyme vowel); 'to a night-traveller'
اَتَرْضَى: اَ + تَرْضَى — a-, (question particle) + raḍiya, to be content (verb I, imperf. 2ms); with bi- of what is accepted; 'are you content?'
بِاَنْ: بِـ + اَنْ — bi-, with (prep. chosen by raḍiya, marking what one accepts) + an, that (with the subjunctive); 'with (the idea) that'
اَسِيْرَةٍ: اَسِيْرَة — asīra, captive woman (f. of asīr; gen. indef.; the print sets a sukūn on the yā, marking the long vowel); 'a captive'
مُحَصَّنَةٍ: مُحَصَّنَة — muḥaṣṣana, guarded, kept close (pass. part. of ḥaṣṣana, II; f., gen., agreeing with asīra); 'kept guarded'
جِدَارِ: جِدَار — jidār, wall (m., gen., with the rhyme vowel); 'a wall'
بِالنِّيَامِ: بِـ + الـ + نِيَام — bi-, (prep. chosen by amara, marking the thing ordered) + al-, the + niyām, sleeping, sleep (verbal noun of nāma, beside the commoner nawm; m., gen.); amarahā bi-al-niyāmi, 'he ordered her to sleep'
هٰذَ: هٰذَ — hādhā, this (demonstrative, m.), printed without its final alif, which the print sets at the head of the next word (هذ اشاب for هذا شاب); 'this'
اشَابٌّ: ا + شَابّ — the final alif of hādhā, printed at the head of this word + shābb, young man (m., nom. indef., predicate after inna hādhā); 'a young man'
مَابَالُهُ: مَا + بَال + هُ — mā, what (interrog.) + bāl, state, concern (m., nom.) + -hu, his; printed as one word; 'what is the matter with him?'
بِجَنْبِي: بِـ + جَنْب + ي — bi-, at, beside (prep. of place) + janb, side (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'at my side'
حُسْنَهُ: حُسْن + هُ — ḥusn, beauty (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his beauty'
تَكَادُ: كَادَ — kāda, to be on the point of, almost (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs); here followed by an and the subjunctive; 'is about to'
تَتَمَزَّقَ: تَمَزَّقَ — tamazzaqa, to be torn to pieces (verb V, imperf. 3fs, subjunctive after an); 'to be torn apart'
خَطَبَنِي: خَطَبَ + نِي — khaṭaba, to ask for (a woman) in marriage (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; with min of the one asked: khaṭabanī min abī, 'asked my father for my hand'
رَدَدْتُهُ: رَدَّ + تُ + هُ — radda, to turn back, refuse (verb I doubled, perf. 1s, the doubled letter split before the ending) + -hu, him; 'I refused him'
أَتَزَوَّجُهُ: تَزَوَّجَ + هُ — tazawwaja, to marry (verb V, imperf. 1s) + -hu, him; after kuntu answering law, 'I would have married him'
وَتَمَتَّعْ: وَ + تَمَتَّعْ — wa-, and + tamattaʿ, enjoy! (tamattaʿa, verb V, imperative 2ms; with bi- of what is enjoyed); 'and enjoy'
بِحُسْنِي: بِـ + حُسْن + ي — bi-, marking what is enjoyed (tamattaʿa bi-, 'to enjoy') + ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.) + -ī, my; '(enjoy) my beauty'
وَثَقُلَتْ: وَ + ثَقُلَتْ — wa-, and + thaqulat (thaqula, to be heavy; verb I, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'to lie heavy upon'); 'and she lay heavy (on)'
يَسْتَيْقِظْ: اسْتَيْقَظَ — istayqaẓa, to wake up (verb X, imperf. 3ms, jussive after lam); '(did not) wake'
تَهُزُّهُ: هَزَّ + هُ — hazza, to shake (verb I doubled, imperf. 3fs) + -hu, him; after ṣārat, 'she began shaking him'
بِحَيٰوتِي: بِـ + حَيٰوة + ي — bi-, by (of adjuring) + ḥayāt, life (f., gen.; the older spelling with wāw, as حيوة) + -ī, my; with ʿalayka, bi-ḥayātī ʿalayka, 'by my life, I adjure you'
تُطِيعَنِي: أَطَاعَ + نِي — aṭāʿa, to obey (verb IV hollow, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after an) + -nī, me; 'that you obey me'
فَانْتَبِهْ: فَـ + انْتَبِهْ — fa-, so + intabih, wake up! (intabaha, verb VIII, imperative 2ms); 'so wake up'
وَانْظُرْإِلَى: وَ + انْظُرْ + إِلَى — wa-, and + unẓur, look! (naẓara, verb I, imperative 2ms) + ilā, at (the preposition naẓara takes for what is looked at); printed as one word; 'and look at'
النَّرْجِسِ: الـ + نَرْجِس — narjis, narcissus (m., gen. after ilā); in love poetry the languid eye; 'the narcissus'
بِبَطْنِي: بِـ + بَطْن + ي — bi-, marking what is enjoyed (after tamattaʿa bi-) + baṭn, belly (m., gen.) + -ī, my; '(enjoy) my belly'
وَالسُّرَّةِ: وَ + الـ + سُرَّة — wa-, and + al-, the + surra, navel (f., gen., still governed by bi-); 'and the navel'
وَهَارِشْنِي: وَ + هَارِشْ + نِي — wa-, and + hārish, imperative 2ms of hārasha (verb III; properly of dogs snapping at one another; in later usage, to romp or play roughly with someone) + -nī, me; 'and romp with me' (sense uncertain)
وَنَاغِشْنِى: وَ + نَاغِشْ + نِى — wa-, and + nāghish, imperative 2ms of nāghasha (verb III, later Arabic: to tease, flirt with, tickle) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'and play with me'
بُكْرَةْ: بُكْرَة — bukra, tomorrow (the everyday sense of Classical bukra, 'early morning'; after ilā, pointed in pause without case); 'tomorrow'
وَاتَّكِئْ: وَ + اتَّكِئْ — wa-, and + ittakiʾ, recline, lean! (ittakaʾa, verb VIII, imperative 2ms; with ʿalā of what one leans on; ئ printed); 'and lean'
غَطَّ: غَطَّ — ghaṭṭa, to snore, to be sunk in sleep (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; ghaṭṭa fī al-nawmi); 'he snored'
تَغْتَرُّ: اغْتَرَّ — ightarra, to be deluded, to be vain (verb VIII doubled, imperf. 2ms; with bi- of what one is vain of); 'you are vain'
بِحُسْنِكَ: بِـ + حُسْن + كَ — bi-, of (after ightarra bi-, 'to be vain of', marking the cause of the vanity) + ḥusn, beauty (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'of your beauty'
وَجَمَالِكَ: وَ + جَمَال + كَ — wa-, and + jamāl, loveliness (m., gen., still after bi-) + -ka, your; 'and your loveliness'
وَظَرْفِكَ: وَ + ظَرْف + كَ — wa-, and + ẓarf, elegance, grace, wit (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'and your elegance'
وَدَلَالِكَ: وَ + دَلَال + كَ — wa-, and + dalāl, coquetry, the airs of a beloved (m., gen.) + -ka, your; 'and your airs'
فَكَمَا: فَـ + كَـ + مَا — fa-, so + ka-, like, as (prep.) + mā, what (together a conjunction, 'just as'); 'so just as'
عَلَّمُوكَ: عَلَّمَ + وا + كَ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, perf. 3mp) + -ka, you; 'they taught you'
الصَّدَّ: الـ + صَدّ — ṣadd, turning away, aloofness (m., acc., second object of ʿallama; with ʿan of the one shunned); 'turning away'
وَمَنَعَكَ: وَ + مَنَعَ + كَ — wa-, and + manaʿa, to forbid, prevent (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'and forbade you'
وَحَلَّفَكَ: وَ + حَلَّفَ + كَ — wa-, and + ḥallafa, to make (someone) swear (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'and made you swear'
تُكَلِّمُنِى: كَلَّمَ + نِى — kallama, to speak to (verb II, imperf. 2ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'you speak to me'
فَمْ: فَم — fam, mouth (m.); object of fataḥa, printed without the alif of the accusative and pointed here without case; 'a mouth'
مَحَبَّتَهُ: مَحَبَّة + هُ — maḥabba, love (f., acc., object of alqā) + -hu, him (the one loved); 'love of him'
أَعْقَبَتْهَا: أَعْقَبَ + تْ + هَا — aʿqaba, to follow, come after (verb IV, perf. 3fs, feminine by attraction to ḥasra) + -hā, it (the look); 'came after it'
وَاضْطَرَبَتْ: وَ + اضْطَرَبَتْ — wa-, and + iḍṭarabat (iḍṭaraba, to be agitated, to tremble; verb VIII, perf. 3fs, with a broken plural as subject); 'and trembled'
جَوَارِحُهَا: جَوَارِح + هَا — jawāriḥ, limbs (pl. of jāriḥa; nom.) + -hā, her; 'her limbs'
كَلِّمْنِى: كَلِّمْ + نِى — kallim, speak! (kallama, verb II, imperative 2ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'speak to me'
حَدِّثْنِى: حَدِّثْ + نِى — ḥaddith, talk! (ḥaddatha, verb II, imperative 2ms) + -nī, me (printed with ى); 'talk to me'
سَلَبْتَ: سَلَبَ — salaba, to rob, snatch away (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'you have robbed'
فَتَأَوَّهَتِ: فَـ + تَأَوَّهَتِ — fa-, and so + taʾawwahat, she sighed, said 'āh' (taʾawwaha, verb V, perf. 3fs, linking vowel -i before al-; hamza printed); 'and she sighed'
مُعْجَبًا: مُعْجَب — muʿjab, pleased, taken (with) (pass. part. of IV aʿjaba; m., acc. indef., circumstantial; with bi- of what one admires); 'pleased'
هَزَّتْهُ: هَزَّ + تْ + هُ — hazza, to shake (verb I doubled, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'she shook him'
وَقَلَّبَتْ: وَ + قَلَّبَتْ — wa-, and + qallabat (qallaba, to turn over; verb II, perf. 3fs); 'and turned over'
خَاتَمَهَا: خَاتَم + هَا — khātam, signet ring (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her ring'
الْخِنْصَرِ: الـ + خِنْصَر — khinṣir, little finger (gen., in apposition to iṣbaʿ); 'the little finger'
فَشَهَقَتْ: فَـ + شَهَقَتْ — fa-, and + shahaqat (shahaqa, to gasp; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she gasped'
وَتُحِبُّنِي: وَ + تُحِبُّ + نِي — wa-, and + tuḥibbu (aḥabba, to love; verb IV doubled, imperf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'and you love me'
تُعْرِضُ: أَعْرَضَ — aʿraḍa, to turn away (verb IV, imperf. 2ms; with ʿan of the one shunned); 'you turn away'
دَلَالًا: دَلَال — dalāl, coquetry, the airs of a beloved (m., acc. indef., of cause); 'out of coquetry'
جِئْتَنِي: جَاءَ + تَ + نِي — jāʾa, to come (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms) + -nī, me (the one come to, as direct object; ئ printed); 'you came to me'
وَأَخَذْتَ: وَ + أَخَذْتَ — wa-, and + akhadhta (akhadha, to take; verb I, perf. 2ms); 'and you took'
خَاتَمِي: خَاتَم + ي — khātam, signet ring (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'my ring'; also gen. after ʿan: ʿiwaḍan ʿan khātamī, 'in place of my ring' (Night 194)
قَالِعَةٌ: قَالِعَة — qāliʿa, taking off (act. part. f. of qalaʿa, to pull out, uproot; in later Arabic the usual verb for taking off a garment or ring; nom., predicate after mā anā); 'taking off, going to take off'
إِصْبَعِكَ: إِصْبَع + كَ — iṣbaʿ, finger (gen., after min) + -ka, your; 'your finger'
جَيْبَ: جَيْب — jayb, neck-opening, breast-slit of a garment (m., acc., first term of iḍāfa); 'the neck-opening of'
قَمِيصِهِ: قَمِيص + هِ — qamīṣ, shirt, shift (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'his shirt'
تُفَتِّشُهُ: فَتَّشَ + هُ — fattasha, to search (verb II, imperf. 3fs, circumstantial) + -hu, him; 'searching him'
يَدُهَا: يَد + هَا — yad, hand (f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her hand'
نُعُومَةِ: نُعُومَة — nuʿūma, softness, smoothness (f., gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa); 'the smoothness of'
أَيْرِهِ: أَيْر + هِ — ayr, penis (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his penis'
فَانْصَدَعَ: فَـ + انْصَدَعَ — fa-, and + inṣadaʿa, to be cracked, split (verb VII, perf. 3ms); 'and was split'
شَهْوَةِ: شَهْوَة — shahwa, desire, lust (f., gen. after min, first term of iḍāfa); 'the desire of'
فَخَجِلَتْ: فَـ + خَجِلَتْ — fa-, and + khajilat (khajila, to be abashed, ashamed; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she was abashed'
نَزَعَتْ: نَزَعَ — nazaʿa, to pull off, draw out (verb I, perf. 3fs); 'she drew off'
خَاتَمَهُ: خَاتَم + هُ — khātam, signet ring (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his ring'
وَوَضَعَتْهُ: وَ + وَضَعَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + waḍaʿat (waḍaʿa, to put, place; verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it; 'and put it'
خَاتَمِهَا: خَاتَم + هَا — khātam, signet ring (m., gen. after ʿan) + -hā, her; 'her ring'
كَفَّيْهِ: كَفَّيْ + هِ — kaff, palm of the hand (f.; dual acc., the -n dropped before the suffix) + -hi, his; 'his two palms'
قَبَّلَتْهُ: قَبَّلَتْ + هُ — qabbalat (qabbala, to kiss; verb II, perf. 3fs) + -hu, it/him; 'she kissed it'
التِّيهِ: الـ + تِيه — tīh, haughtiness, pride, disdain (m., gen.); faʿala mina al-tīhi, 'acted out of pride'
الْوَلَهِ: الـ + وَلَه — walah, distraction, love-madness (m., gen.); mina al-walahi bi-, 'out of love-madness for' (bi- marks the one loved to distraction)
مَعْشُوقَتَهُ: مَعْشُوقَة + ـهُ — maʿshūqa, beloved (f., acc., object; pass. part. of ʿashiqa) + -hu, his; 'his beloved'
وَسَاعِدْهُ: وَ + سَاعِدْ + ـهُ — wa-, and + sāʿid, help! (imperative m. sg. of sāʿada, verb III; with ʿalā, 'help with') + -hu, him; 'and help him'
وُصُولِهَا: وُصُول + ـهَا — wuṣūl, arriving, arrival (verbal noun of waṣala; m., gen. after ʿalā) + -hā, her; 'her reaching (her place)'
قَدْمَضَى: قَدْ + مَضَى — qad, already (particle with the perfect) + maḍā, to pass, go by (verb I final-weak, perf. 3ms); 'has passed' (the print joins the two words as one)
وَدَهْنَشُ: وَ + دَهْنَش — wa-, and + Dahnash, name of the ʿifrīt (diptote, nom., second subject after taqaddama Qashqashu); 'and Dahnash'
وَحَمَلَاهَا: وَ + حَمَلَا + ـهَا — wa-, and + ḥamala, to carry, lift (verb I, perf. 3 m. dual) + -hā, her; 'and the two carried her'
وَطَارَابِهَا: وَ + طَارَا + بِـ + ـهَا — wa-, and + ṭāra, to fly (verb I hollow, perf. 3 m. dual) + bi-, with (prep.; ṭāra bi-, 'fly off with', bi- of accompaniment) + -hā, her; 'and the two flew off with her' (the print joins طارا and بها as one word)
وَأَوْصَلَاهَا: وَ + أَوْصَلَا + ـهَا — wa-, and + awṣala, to bring, convey (someone) to (verb IV, perf. 3 m. dual) + -hā, her; 'and the two brought her'
وَأَرْقَدَاهَا: وَ + أَرْقَدَا + ـهَا — wa-, and + arqada, to lay down to sleep, put to bed (verb IV, perf. 3 m. dual) + -hā, her; 'and the two laid her down'
وَاخْتَلَتْ: وَ + اخْتَلَتْ — wa-, and + ikhtalā, to be alone, withdraw in private (verb VIII of خ ل و, perf. 3fs; with bi-, 'be alone with'); 'and she stayed alone'
مَاهٰذَا: مَا + هٰذَا — mā, what? (interrog.) + hādhā, this (m.); 'what is this?' (the print joins the two words as one)
يُرَغِّبُنِي: يُرَغِّبُ + ـنِي — raghghaba, to make (someone) desire (verb II, imperf. 3ms; with fī, what is to be desired) + -nī, me; 'he is making me want'
تَزْدَادَ: تَزْدَادَ — izdāda, to increase, grow (verb VIII of zāda, imperf. 3fs, subjunctive after an); 'that it may grow'
رَغْبَتِي: رَغْبَة + ـي — raghba, desire, wish (f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my desire'
حَيْلِكَ: حَيْل + ـكَ — ḥayl, strength, power (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ka, your; qum ʿalā ḥaylika, 'get up on your feet'
طَائِشُ: طَائِش — ṭāʾish, light-headed, giddy, scattered (act. part. of ṭāsha; m., nom.; first term of an adjectival construct: ṭāʾishu al-ʿaqli, 'giddy of mind'); the edition prints the ئ
وَالْإِبْرِيقَ: وَ + الـ + إِبْرِيق — wa-, and + ibrīq, ewer, water-jug with a spout (m., acc.; Persian loan); 'and the ewer'
الْمُسْتَرَاحَ: الـ + مُسْتَرَاح — mustarāḥ, place of rest, (euphemism) privy (m., acc.; noun of place of istarāḥa, verb X); 'the privy'
يُسَبِّحُ: يُسَبِّحُ — sabbaḥa, to glorify, praise (God), say subḥāna Allāh (verb II, imperf. 3ms); 'glorifying'
صَوَابُ: صَوَاب — Ṣawāb, 'rightness', name of Qamar al-Zamān's servant (m., nom., after the vocative yā)
جَنْبِي: جَنْب + ـي — janb, side (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; min janbī, 'from my side'
وَلَاغَيْرُهَا: وَ + لَا + غَيْر + ـهَا — wa-, and + lā, not, nor + ghayr, other than (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'nor anyone other than her' (the print joins the words as one)
مَادَخَلَ: مَا + دَخَلَ — mā, not (negative particle) + dakhala, to enter (verb I, perf. 3ms; dakhala ʿalā, 'come in to (someone)'); 'did not enter' (the print joins the two words as one)
أُنْثَي: أُنْثَى — unthā, female (f.); dhakarun wa-lā unthā, 'neither male nor female'; the print writes the final alif maqṣūra with dotted ي, انثي
يَاعَبْدَ: يَا + عَبْد — yā, O (vocative particle) + ʿabd, slave (m., acc. as the first term of a construct after yā); yā ʿabda al-naḥsi, 'you slave of ill omen' (the print joins the two words as one)
وَلَاتُخْبِرُنِى: وَ + لَا + تُخْبِرُ + ـنِى — wa-, and + lā, not + akhbara, to tell, inform (verb IV, imperf. 2ms indic.) + -nī, me; 'and do not tell me' (the print joins لا to the verb and writes final ى for ي)
ذَهَبَتِ: ذَهَبَتْ — dhahaba, to go, go away (verb I, perf. 3fs, helping kasra before al-); 'she went'
بِأَطْوَاقِهِ: بِـ + أَطْوَاق + ـهِ — bi-, by (prep.; the verb chooses it: masaka bi-, 'take hold of') + aṭwāq, collars, neck-rings (pl. of ṭawq; m., gen.), here the collar of his garment + -hi, his; 'by his collar'
فَضَرَطَ: فَـ + ضَرَطَ — fa-, and so + ḍaraṭa, to fart, break wind (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he farted'
بَرَكَ: بَرَكَ — baraka, to kneel (properly of a camel couching); with ʿalā, 'kneel on, pin down' (verb I, perf. 3ms)
وَخَنَقَهُ: وَ + خَنَقَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + khanaqa, to throttle, strangle (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and choked him'
وَشَالَهُ: وَ + شَالَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + shāla, to lift, carry (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; the everyday verb of later Arabic) + -hu, him; 'and he lifted him'
سَلَبَةِ: سَلَبَة — salaba, rope, esp. of palm fibre (f., gen. after fī; first term of a construct; a word of later, chiefly Egyptian, Arabic, vowels uncertain); salabatu al-biʾri, 'the well rope'
وَأَدْلَاهُ: وَ + أَدْلَى + ـهُ — wa-, and + adlā, to let down (a bucket) into a well (verb IV final-weak, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and let him down'
وَأَرْخَاهُ: وَ + أَرْخَى + ـهُ — wa-, and + arkhā, to slacken, let go, let down (verb IV final-weak, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and let him go slack, let him down'
وَشِتَاءٍ: وَ + شِتَاء — wa-, and + shitāʾ, winter (m., gen. indef., second term of a construct with ayyām); 'and of winter'
قَاطِعٍ: قَاطِع — qāṭiʿ, cutting, sharp, biting (act. part. of qaṭaʿa; m., gen. indef., adj. of shitāʾ); 'biting'
فَغَطَسَ: فَـ + غَطَسَ — fa-, and so + ghaṭasa, to plunge, sink, go under (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he went under'
نَشَلَهُ: نَشَلَ + ـهُ — nashala, to snatch out, pull out (as meat from a pot) (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he pulled him out'
يُغَطِّسُ: يُغَطِّسُ — ghaṭṭasa, to dunk, plunge (someone) under (verb II, imperf. 3ms; read so because it takes an object); after lā zāla, 'kept dunking'
وَيَنْشُلُهُ: وَ + يَنْشُلُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + nashala, to pull out (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and pulling him out'
وَيَصْرُخُ: وَ + يَصْرُخُ — wa-, and + ṣarakha, to shriek, scream (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and shrieking'
أُطْلِعُكَ: أُطْلِعُ + ـكَ — aṭlaʿa, to bring up, cause to come up (verb IV, imperf. 1cs; in Classical 'to let see, inform', here the everyday sense) + -ka, you; mā uṭliʿuka, 'I will not bring you up'
تُعْلِمَنِي: تُعْلِمَ + ـنِي — aʿlama, to inform, let know (verb IV, imperf. 2ms, subjunctive after ḥattā) + -nī, me; 'until you inform me'
وَقَضِيَّتِهَا: وَ + قَضِيَّة + ـهَا — wa-, and + qaḍiyya, affair, case (f., gen., joined to khabar after bi-) + -hā, her; 'and her affair'
وَالْغِطَاسِ: وَ + الـ + غِطَاس — ghiṭās, dunking, immersion (later verbal noun of ghaṭasa, to plunge under water; m., gen. in a list after min; vowels uncertain); 'and the dunking'
وَالْخَوْفِ: وَ + الـ + خَوْف — khawf, fear (m., gen. in a list after min); 'and the fear'
وَابْتَلَّتْ: وَ + ابْتَلَّتْ — ibtalla, to become wet (verb VIII of balla, perf. 3fs, agreeing with thiyābuhu); 'and (they) were soaked'
ثِيَابُهُ: ثِيَاب + ـهُ — thiyāb, clothes (pl. of thawb; nom.) + -hu, his; 'his clothes'
وَتَلَوَّثَ: وَ + تَلَوَّثَ — talawwatha, to be soiled, smeared with filth (verb V, perf. 3ms); 'and (it) was smeared'
وَتَشَطَّبَ: وَ + تَشَطَّبَ — tashaṭṭaba, to be scored, scratched (verb V of shaṭaba, to cut in stripes; perf. 3ms; reading somewhat uncertain); 'and he was grazed'
حِيطَانِ: حِيطَان — ḥīṭān, walls (pl. of ḥāʾiṭ; gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the walls of'
شَنِيعَةٍ: شَنِيعَة — shanīʿ, hideous, shocking (adj., f., gen. indef., agreeing with ḥālatin); 'shocking'
وَأَعْصِرُهَا: وَ + أَعْصِرُ + ـهَا — ʿaṣara, to squeeze, wring out (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, them (the clothes, f. as a non-human plural); 'and I wring them out'
وَأَنْشُرُهَا: وَ + أَنْشُرُ + ـهَا — nashara, to spread out (verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -hā, them (the clothes); 'and I spread them out'
أَقْرَرْتَ: أَقْرَرْتَ — aqarra, to confess, own to (verb IV, doubled root, perf. 2ms; takes its object with bi-); in the answer to lawlā, 'you would have confessed'
وَعُدْ: وَ + عُدْ — ʿāda, to return, come back (verb I hollow, imper. 2ms); 'and come back'
لَايُصَدِّقُ: لَا + يُصَدِّقُ — lā, not + ṣaddaqa, to believe (verb II, imperf. 3ms; takes what is believed with bi-); printed as one word; 'not believing'
أَنَمْ: أَنَمْ — nāma, to sleep (verb I hollow, jussive 1cs after lam, the long vowel shortened); lam anam, 'I have not slept'
اشْتِغَالِ: اشْتِغَال — ishtighāl, preoccupation, being taken up (verbal noun of VIII ishtaghala; gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); ishtighāl qalbī ʿalā, 'my heart's being taken up with, my anxiety for'
ضَرَرٌ: ضَرَر — ḍarar, harm, injury (m., nom. indef., subject of yaḥṣula); 'harm'
سَجْنِهِ: سَجْن + ـهِ — sajn, imprisoning (verbal noun of sajana; gen. after fī) + -hi, him; 'in imprisoning him' (the letters also allow sijnihi, 'his prison')
يُصِيبُهُ: يُصِيبُ + ـهُ — aṣāba, to strike, befall (verb IV hollow, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'befalls him'
تَلِينَ: تَلِينَ — lāna, to become soft, pliant (verb I hollow, subj. 3fs after ḥattā); 'softens'
عَرِيكَتُهُ: عَرِيكَة + ـهُ — ʿarīka, natural temper, grain of character (f., nom., subject of talīna) + -hu, his; 'his temper' (layyin al-ʿarīka, 'docile')
وَتَنْكَسِرَ: وَ + تَنْكَسِرَ — inkasara, to be broken (verb VII, subj. 3fs after ḥattā); 'and (it) is broken'
وَيَهْدِيَ: وَ + يَهْدِيَ — the print's يهدي for yahdaʾa, hadaʾa, to grow calm (verb I, hamza lost, spelled as from a weak root as in later speech; subj. 3ms after ḥattā); 'and (it) grows calm'
خُلْقُهُ: خُلْق + ـهُ — khulq, character, temper (m., nom., subject of yahdiya) + -hu, his; 'his temper'
مَجْنُونًا: مَجْنُون — majnūn, mad, possessed (pass. part. of junna; m., acc. indef., predicate of ṣāra); 'mad'
بِخُفْيَةٍ: بِـ + خُفْيَة — bi-, in (prep. of manner) + khufya, secrecy (f., gen. indef.); 'in secret, stealthily'
وَيُكَلِّفُنِى: وَ + يُكَلِّفُ + ـنِى — kallafa, to charge, press (someone) to a task (verb II, imperf. 3ms; here followed by annī and an imperfect) + -nī, me (with the print's final ى); 'and he presses me'
وَبِمَنْ: وَ + بِـ + مَنْ — wa-, and + bi-, of, about (prep. continuing akhbara bi-, 'tell of') + man, who; 'and of who' (bi-man akhadhahā, 'and who it was that took her'; reading uncertain)
لَارَأَيْتُ: لَا + رَأَيْتُ — lā, not (with a perfect, repeated by wa-lā: 'neither … nor') + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 1cs; hamza printed); printed as one word; 'I saw neither'
وَالْمِفْتَاحُ: وَ + الـ + مِفْتَاح — miftāḥ, key (m., nom., subject of a circumstantial clause); 'and the key'
وَاوَلَدَاهْ: وَا + وَلَد + ا + هْ — wā, alas (particle of lament, nudba) + walad, son + -ā, the long vowel of lament (standing for 'my') + -h, pausal hā; 'alas, my son!'
وَغَضِبَ: وَ + غَضِبَ — ghaḍiba, to be angry (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes the one at whom with ʿalā); 'and he was angry'
اكْشِفْ: اكْشِفْ — kashafa, to uncover, find out (verb I, imper. 2ms, hamzat waṣl); 'find out'
يَتَعَثَّرُ: يَتَعَثَّرُ — taʿaththara, to stumble (verb V, imperf. 3ms); taʿaththara fī adhyālihi, 'he tripped over his skirts'
شَوَّشَ: شَوَّشَ — shawwasha, to confuse, upset (verb II, perf. 3ms; takes the one upset with ʿalā); 'it upset, he upset'
وَأَزْعَجَنَا: وَ + أَزْعَجَ + ـنَا — azʿaja, to alarm, disquiet (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nā, us; 'and alarmed us'
بِحَالَةٍ: بِـ + حَالَة — bi-, in (prep. of accompanying circumstance) + ḥāla, state, condition (f., gen. indef.); 'in a state'
مُنْكَرَةٍ: مُنْكَرَة — munkar, shocking, disapproved of (pass. part. of IV ankara; f., gen. indef., agreeing with ḥālatin); 'dreadful'
وَكَذَبَ: وَ + كَذَبَ — kadhaba, to lie (verb I, perf. 3ms; kadhaba ʿalā, 'to lie to, lie against'); 'and he lied'
يُذْكَرَ: يُذْكَرَ — dhakara, to mention (verb I, passive imperf. 3ms, subj. after an); 'that it be mentioned'
فَسَلَامَةُ: فَـ + سَلَامَة — fa-, so (conj.) + salāma, safety, soundness (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa; a wish, 'may (your youth) be kept safe'); 'so (God keep) the soundness of'
الرَّجِيحِ: الـ + رَجِيح — rajīḥ, weighty, sound (of judgement) (adj., m., gen., agreeing with ʿaqlika); 'weighty' Also of a figure, 'full, well rounded', agreeing with qadd: al-qaddi al-rajīḥi, 'the shapely figure' (Night 188).
وَلِسَانِكَ: وَ + لِسَان + ـكَ — lisān, tongue (m., gen., joined to ʿaqlika under salāmatu) + -ka, your; 'and your tongue'
الْفَصِيحِ: الـ + فَصِيح — faṣīḥ, eloquent (adj., m., gen., agreeing with lisānika); 'eloquent'; also (Night 202): الـ + فَصِيح — al-, the + faṣīḥ, eloquent (adj., m., gen., agreeing with al-lisāni); 'eloquent'
وَكَلَّفْتَهُ: وَ + كَلَّفْتَ + ـهُ — kallafa, to charge, press (someone) to a task (verb II, perf. 2ms; here followed by annahu and an imperfect) + -hu, him; 'and you pressed him'
وَعَذَّبْتَهُ: وَ + عَذَّبْتَ + ـهُ — ʿadhdhaba, to torment (verb II, perf. 2ms; ʿalā gives the grounds) + -hu, him; 'and you tormented him'
عَلَّمْتُمُ: عَلَّمْتُمْ — ʿallama, to teach (verb II, perf. 2mpl, with two objects, the one taught and the thing taught; helping vowel -u before al-); 'you taught'
وَمَنَعْتُمُوهُ: وَ + مَنَعْتُمُو + هُ — wa-, and + manaʿa, to prevent, hold back (verb I, perf. 2mpl; -tum lengthens to -tumū before a suffix) + -hu, him; with min, 'prevent from'; 'and you prevented him'
يُخْبِرَنِي: يُخْبِرَ + نِي — akhbara, to inform, tell (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an) + -nī, me; with bi-, 'tell (someone) of'; 'that he tell me'
حِضْنِي: حِضْن + ي — ḥiḍn, bosom, embrace (m., gen.) + -ī, my; fī ḥiḍnī, 'in my arms'
فَأَنْتُمُ: فَـ + أَنْتُمْ — fa-, for (conj., giving the reason) + antum, you (m. pl.), with a helping -u before the joining alif of alladhīna; 'for you (are)'
أَرْسَلْتُمُوهَا: أَرْسَلْتُمُو + هَا — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 2mpl; -tumū before a suffix) + -hā, her; 'you sent her'
وَأَمَرْتُمُوهَا: وَ + أَمَرْتُمُو + هَا — wa-, and + amara, to order, command (verb I, perf. 2mpl; -tumū before a suffix) + -hā, her; with an + subjunctive, 'ordered her to'; 'and you ordered her'
أَرْسَلْنَالَكَ: أَرْسَلْنَا + لِـ + كَ — arsala, to send (verb IV, perf. 1pl) + li-, to (prep., marks the one sent to; لَـ before a suffix) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'we sent to you'
فَثَبِّتْ: فَـ + ثَبِّتْ — fa-, so + thabbata, to make firm, steady (verb II, imperative 2ms); thabbit ʿaqlaka, 'steady your mind'
وَلَاتَشْغَلْ: وَ + لَا + تَشْغَلْ — wa-, and + lā, not (prohibition, with the jussive) + shaghala, to occupy, trouble (verb I, jussive 2ms); printed as one word; 'and do not trouble'
خَاطِرَكَ: خَاطِر + كَ — khāṭir, mind, thoughts, feelings (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'your mind'
الْمَلِيحَةُ: الـ + مَلِيحَة — malīḥa, lovely, beautiful (adj. used as a noun, f., nom.); 'the lovely one'
وَالْخُدُودِ: وَ + الـ + خُدُود — wa-, and + al-, the + khudūd, cheeks (pl. of khadd, m., gen.); 'and the cheeks'
الْحُمْرِ: الـ + حُمْر — ḥumr, red (pl. of aḥmar, adj., gen., agreeing with khudūd); 'the red'
عَانَقْتُهَا: عَانَقْتُ + هَا — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 1s) + -hā, her; 'I embraced her'
أَتَظُنُّ: أَ + تَظُنُّ — a-, question particle + ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I doubled, imperf. 2ms); 'do you think?'
بِأُذُنِي: بِـ + أُذُن + ي — bi-, with (prep., instrument) + udhun, ear (f., gen.) + -ī, my; 'with my ear'
وَقَلَّبْتُهَا: وَ + قَلَّبْتُ + هَا — wa-, and + qallaba, to turn over and over, look over (verb II, perf. 1s) + -hā, her; 'and I turned her this way and that'
وَظَرْفِهَا: وَ + ظَرْف + هَا — wa-, and + ẓarf, grace, elegance, charm (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her grace'
وَدَلَالِهَا: وَ + دَلَال + هَا — wa-, and + dalāl, coquetry, a beloved's teasing airs (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her coquetry'
عَلَّمْتُمُوهَا: عَلَّمْتُمُو + هَا — ʿallama, to teach, coach (verb II, perf. 2mpl; -tumū before a suffix) + -hā, her; 'you coached her'
وَأَوْصَيْتُمُوهَا: وَ + أَوْصَيْتُمُو + هَا — wa-, and + awṣā, to charge, instruct (verb IV, perf. 2mpl; -tumū before a suffix) + -hā, her; 'and you instructed her'
فَتَنَبَّهْتُ: فَـ + تَنَبَّهْتُ — fa-, and then + tanabbaha, to wake, come to (verb V, perf. 1s); 'and I woke'
أَضْغَاثَ: أَضْغَاث — aḍghāth, bundles, confused mixtures (pl. of ḍighth; acc. as predicate of yakūnu, construct); with aḥlām, 'a jumble of dreams' (Qurʾān 12:44); in Night 188 (P842L13) the print has اضعاث, a misprint, corrected
تَخَيُّلَاتٍ: تَخَيُّلَات — takhayyulāt, imaginings, fancies (pl. of takhayyul, verbal noun of V takhayyala; acc. indef., with -in as the f. pl. accusative); 'fancies'
مُخْتَلِفِ: مُخْتَلِف — mukhtalif, varied, assorted (act. part. of VIII ikhtalafa; gen., construct); mukhtalif al-ṭaʿām, 'varied food'
وَسْوَسَةً: وَسْوَسَة — waswasa, whispering, evil prompting (of the devil) (f., acc. indef.); 'a whispering'
تَهْزَأُبِي: تَهْزَأُ + بِـ + ي — hazaʾa, to mock (verb I, imperf. 2ms; the verb takes its object with bi-) + -ī, me; printed as one word; 'you mock me'
أَقَرَّ: أَقَرَّ — aqarra, to confess, admit (verb IV doubled, perf. 3ms); aqarra li- … bi-, 'to admit (something, bi-) to (someone, li-)'; 'he admitted'
بِقِصَّتِهَا: بِـ + قِصَّة + هَا — bi-, of (prep.; the verb chooses it: akhbara bi-, 'tell of') + qiṣṣa, story (f., gen.) + -hā, her; 'of her story'
وَلَفَّهَا: وَ + لَفَّ + هَا — wa-, and + laffa, to wind, wrap (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms) + -hā, it (the beard); with ʿalā, 'round'; 'and he wound it'
فَرَمَاةُ: فَـ + رَمَى + ـهُ — fa-, and then + ramā, to throw (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; the print writes ة for the pronoun -hu; 'and he threw him'
نَتْفِ: نَتْف — natf, plucking, tearing out (of hair) (verbal noun of natafa, m., gen., construct); 'the tearing of'
يَرْفُصُ: يَرْفُصُ — rafasa, to kick (verb I, imperf. 3ms), spelled with ṣ for s as in later speech; after lā zāla, 'kept kicking'
أَضْلَاعِهِ: أَضْلَاع + هِ — aḍlāʿ, ribs (pl. of ḍilʿ, gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his ribs'
وَيَصْفَعُهُ: وَ + يَصْفَعُ + هُ — wa-, and + ṣafaʿa, to slap (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and slapping him'
يُهْلِكَهُ: يُهْلِكَ + هُ — ahlaka, to destroy, kill (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, subjunctive after an) + -hu, him; kāda an yuhlikahu, 'he all but killed him'
الْمَجْنُونِ: الـ + مَجْنُون — majnūn, mad, possessed (pass. part. of junna, m., gen.); 'the mad'
بِكَذِبِهِ: بِـ + كَذِب + هِ — bi-, by (prep., means) + kadhib, lying, a lie (m. verbal noun, gen.) + -hi, his; 'by his lie'
وَأُخَلِّصُ: وَ + أُخَلِّصُ — wa-, and + khallaṣa, to save, deliver (verb II, imperf. 1s); 'and I will save'
بِكَذْبَةٍ: بِـ + كَذْبَة — bi-, by, with (prep., means) + kadhba, a (single) lie (f., gen. indef.); 'with a lie'
يُهْلِكُنِي: يُهْلِكُ + نِي — ahlaka, to destroy, kill (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, indicative after wa-illā where Classical Arabic has the jussive) + -nī, me; 'he will kill me'
قَدْأَوْصَانِي: قَدْ + أَوْصَى + نِي — qad, already (with the perfect) + awṣā, to charge, instruct (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'he has charged me'
أَكْتُمُ: أَكْتُمُ — katama, to hide, keep secret (verb I, imperf. 1s); with ʿan, 'hide from'; 'I hide'
وَكَلَّيْتُ: وَ + كَلَّيْتُ — wa-, and + kalla, to grow weary (verb I doubled, perf. 1s, in the later form kallaytu for Classical kalaltu); 'and I have grown weary'
وَتَأَلَّمْتُ: وَ + تَأَلَّمْتُ — wa-, and + taʾallama, to feel pain, ache (verb V, perf. 1s; the print gives no hamza); 'and I am in pain'
وَلَاقُوَّةٌ: وَ + لَا + قُوَّة — wa-lā, nor + quwwa, strength (f., nom. indef., coordinated with jalad after laysa); printed as one word; 'nor strength'
تَحَمُّلِ: تَحَمُّل — taḥammul, bearing, enduring (verbal noun of V taḥammala, m., gen., construct); 'bearing'
فَتَمَهَّلْ: فَـ + تَمَهَّلْ — fa-, so + tamahhala, to go slowly, be patient (verb V, imperative 2ms); with ʿalā, 'bear with (someone)'; 'so bear with'
أُحَدِّ: أُحَدِّ — first part of uḥaddithaka, 'I tell you' (ḥaddatha, verb II, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after ḥattā), which the print splits across a space as احد ثك; read with the next word
ثَكَ: ثَكَ — second part of uḥaddithaka, 'I tell you': the last root letter th with the subjunctive -a, + -ka, you; see أُحَدِّ
مَاسَمِعَ: مَا + سَمِعَ — mā, making a clause of the verb after ʿinda, so ʿinda mā, 'when' + samiʿa, he heard (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'when he heard'
بَطَّلَ: بَطَّلَ — baṭṭala, to stop, leave off (doing) (verb II, perf. 3ms; later usage); baṭṭala ʿanhu al-ḍarba, 'he left off beating him'
الْإِهَانَةِ: الـ + إِهَانَة — ihāna, humiliation, insult (verbal noun of IV ahāna, f., gen.); 'the humiliation'
مَهًا: مَهًا — mahan, wild cows, oryxes (collective, pl. of mahāt), to which poets liken lovely women for their large dark eyes (indef.); a doubtful reading in wa-anā mahan bi-jānibī, probably a slip for مَعَهَا, maʿahā, 'with her'
جَانِبِي: جَانِب + ي — jānib, side (m., gen. after min) + -ī, my; min jānibī, 'from my side'; also gen. after ilā: naẓartu ilā jānibī, 'I looked to my side' (Night 194)
وَامْتَحَنَنِي: وَ + امْتَحَنَ + نِي — wa-, and + imtaḥana, to test, try (verb VIII, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; with bi-, 'test with'; 'and he tested me'
وَأُرِيحَ: وَ + أُرِيحَ — wa-, and + arāḥa, to give rest, relieve (verb IV hollow, imperf. 1s, subjunctive after an); arāḥa nafsahu min, 'spare oneself'; 'and (that I) relieve'
مْرَكُلَّهُ: مْرَ + كُلَّ + هُ — the rest of al-amra, 'the matter' (amr, m., acc.), which the print splits after its alif as الا مركلّه, run into kull, all (acc., in apposition) + -hu, of it; with الْأَ, al-amra kullahu, 'the whole matter'
امْتِنَاعِي: امْتِنَاع + ي — imtināʿ, refusal, holding back (verbal noun of VIII imtanaʿa, m., gen.) + -ī, my; with min, 'refusal of'; 'my refusing'
فَأَعْلِمْ: فَـ + أَعْلِمْ — fa-, so + aʿlama, to inform (verb IV, imperative 2ms); with bi-, 'inform of'; 'so inform'
وَأَشِرْ: وَ + أَشِرْ — wa-, and + ashāra, to point, signal; to propose (verb IV hollow, imperative 2ms); with ilā, 'put it to (someone)'; with bi-, 'propose (something)'; 'and suggest'
لَاأُرِيدُ: لَا + أُرِيدُ — lā, not + arāda, to want (verb IV hollow, imperf. 1s); printed as one word; 'I do not want'
لَايُحِبُّ: لَا + يُحِبُّ — lā, not + aḥabba, to love (verb IV doubled, imperf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'does not love'
بِتَعْجِيلِ: بِـ + تَعْجِيل — bi-, (prep.; the verb chooses it: ashāra bi-, 'propose, urge (something)', marks what is proposed) + taʿjīl, hastening (verbal noun of II ʿajjala, m., gen., construct); 'the hastening of'
يَخْلُصُ: يَخْلُصُ — khalaṣa, to get free, escape (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with min, 'from'; 'he gets free'
وَيَعْثُرُ: وَ + يَعْثُرُ — wa-, and + ʿathara, to stumble (verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'and stumbling'
بِشَرِّةِ: بِـ + شَرّ + ة (for ـهِ) — bi-, with (prep. of the instrument, chosen by ramā, 'to strike with') + sharr, evil, malice (m., gen.) + -hi, his (the print writes the pronoun with ة; the shadda and the kasra under the ة are printed); 'with his evil'
ارْتِبَاكٍ: ارْتِبَاك — irtibāk, confusion, perplexity, being in a tangle (verbal noun of VIII irtabaka; m., gen. indef. after fī); 'confusion'
بِبِشَارَةٍ: بِـ + بِشَارَة — bi-, with (prep.; chosen by jāʾa, 'come with' = 'bring') + bishāra, tidings, properly good news (f., gen. indef.); 'with tidings'
أَوْضِحْ: أَوْضِحْ — awḍiḥ, make clear, explain (imper. 2ms of IV awḍaḥa, root و-ض-ح; hamza supplied, printed bare as اوضح); 'make plain'
وَأَخْبَرَةُ: وَ + أَخْبَرَ + ة (for ـهُ) — wa-, and + akhbara, to tell, inform (verb IV, perf. 3ms; with bi- of the thing told) + -hu, him (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'and he told him'
أَبْشْرْ: أَبْشِرْ — abshir, rejoice, take the good news (imper. 2ms of IV abshara); the print sets its sukūn on the shīn, ابشْر, kept as printed; here bitterly ironic: 'rejoice!'
بِشَارَتِكَ: بِشَارَة + كَ — bishāra, bringing of good news, glad tidings (f., verbal noun; gen. after naẓīr) + -ka, your (here the doer of the verbal noun); fī naẓīri bishāratika iyyāya, 'in return for your bringing me the news'
إِيَّايَ: إِيَّا + ـيَ — iyyā-, carrier of a free object pronoun + -ya, me; 'me' (object of the verbal noun bishāra, whose own suffix is taken by the doer); the shadda is printed
بِجُنُونِ: بِـ + جُنُون — bi-, of, about (prep.; marks what the news is of) + junūn, madness (m., gen., first term of annexation); 'of the madness of'
وَزَوَالَ: وَ + زَوَال — wa-, and + zawāl, passing away, loss (verbal noun of zāla, m., acc., second object of uʿṭī, first term of annexation); 'and the loss of'
وَأَنْجَسَ: وَ + أَنْجَس — wa-, and + anjas, most unclean, foulest (elative of najis; acc. after yā, first term of annexation); 'and foulest of'
جُنُونِ: جُنُون — junūn, madness (m., gen., first term of annexation); 'the madness of'
بِمَشُورَتِكَ: بِـ + مَشُورَة + كَ — bi-, by (prep. of the means) + mashūra, counsel, advice (f., gen.) + -ka, your; 'by your counsel'
وَرَأْيِكَ: وَ + رَأْي + كَ — wa-, and + raʾy, opinion, advice (m., gen., joined to the preceding bi-mashūratika; hamza printed) + -ka, your; 'and (by) your advice'
التَّعِيسِ: الـ + تَعِيس — al-, the + taʿīs, wretched, ill-fated (adj., m., gen.); 'the wretched'
الْجُنُونِ: الـ + جُنُون — al-, the + junūn, madness (m., gen. after min or aw); 'the madness'
لَأَسْمُرَّنَّكَ: لَـ + أَسْمُرَ + ـنَّ + كَ — la-, surely (the lām answering an oath) + asmuru, I nail (samara, verb I, 'to nail', = II sammara; impf. 1s) + -anna, energetic ending + -ka, you; 'I will surely nail you' (the print sets the shadda on the rā, لاسمرّنك, kept as printed)
وَأُذِيقُكَ: وَ + أُذِيقُ + كَ — wa-, and + udhīqu, I make taste (adhāqa, verb IV hollow, impf. 1s; plain imperfect after an oath, where Classical would keep the energetic) + -ka, you; 'and I will make you taste'
النَّكْبَةَ: الـ + نَكْبَة — al-, the + nakba, calamity, disaster (f., acc., second object of udhīqu); 'the calamity'
أَقْدَامِهِ: أَقْدَام + ـهِ — aqdām, feet (pl. of qadam, f.; gen. after ʿalā) + -hi, his; 'his feet'
وَالِدِةِ: وَالِد + ة (for ـهِ) — wālid, father (m., gen.) + -hi, his (the print writes the pronoun with ة); 'his father'
سَالِفًا: سَالِف — sālif, past, former (act. part. of salafa, m., acc. indef., adj. of dhanban); 'a past (sin)'
حَقِّكُمْ: حَقّ + كُمْ — ḥaqq, right, due (m., gen. after fī) + -kum, your (pl., honorific); fī ḥaqqikum, 'with regard to you, against your due'
وَاَتَيْتُ: وَ + اَتَيْتُ — wa-, and + ataytu, I did, committed (atā, verb I final-weak, perf. 1s, with an object 'to do (a thing)'; verse spelling with the fatḥa on bare alif, as printed); 'and I did'
مُنْكَرًا: مُنْكَر — munkar, disapproved, reprehensible (pass. part. of IV ankara; m., acc. indef., adj. of shayʾan); 'a reprehensible (thing)'
مُسْتَغْفِرًا: مُسْتَغْفِر — mustaghfir, asking forgiveness (act. part. of X istaghfara; m., acc. indef., ḥāl after atā); 'seeking pardon'
وَتَرْعَبُ: وَ + تَرْعَبُ — wa-, and + tarʿabu, you frighten (raʿaba, verb I, 'to frighten', impf. 2ms; with ʿalā of the one feared for); 'and you frighten'
الْأَحَدِ: الـ + أَحَد — al-, the + aḥad, one, the first (m., gen. after yawm); yawm al-aḥad, 'Sunday' (the first day)
الثُّلٰثَاءُ: الـ + ثُلٰثَاء — al-, the + thulāthāʾ, Tuesday (the third day; m., nom.); the print spells it الثلثاء, without the long ā, which the dagger alif supplies
الْأَرْبِعَاءُ: الـ + أَرْبِعَاء — al-, the + arbiʿāʾ, Wednesday (the fourth day; m., nom.); 'Wednesday'
الْخَمِيسُ: الـ + خَمِيس — al-, the + khamīs, Thursday (the fifth day; m., nom.); 'Thursday'
الْجُمُعَةُ: الـ + جُمُعَة — al-, the + jumuʿa, Friday, the day of congregation (f., nom.); 'Friday'
سَلَامَةِ: سَلَامَة — salāma, soundness, safety (f., gen. after ʿalā, first term of annexation); ʿalā salāmati ʿaqlika, 'for the soundness of your mind'
ذُوالْقَعْدَةِ: ذُو + الـ + قَعْدَة — dhū, possessor of, 'the one of' (m., nom., construct) + al-, the + qaʿda, sitting (f., gen.); Dhū al-Qaʿda, the eleventh month of the lunar year (printed as one word)
وَيَلِيهِ: وَ + يَلِي + ـهِ — wa-, and + yalī, follows, comes next to (waliya, verb I, assimilated and final-weak, impf. 3ms) + -hi, it; 'and there follows it'
ذُوالْحِجَّةِ: ذُو + الـ + حِجَّة — dhū, 'the one of' (m., nom., construct) + al-, the + ḥijja, pilgrimage (f., gen.); Dhū al-Ḥijja, the twelfth month, of the pilgrimage (printed as one word)
الْمُحَرَّمُ: الـ + مُحَرَّم — al-, the + muḥarram, sacred, forbidden (pass. part. of II ḥarrama; m., nom.); al-Muḥarram, the first month of the lunar year (shadda printed)
صَفَرٌ: صَفَر — Ṣafar, the second month of the lunar year (m., nom. indef., triptote)
رَبِيعٍ: رَبِيع — rabīʿ, spring (m., gen. indef. after shahr); shahru rabīʿin al-awwali / al-ākhiri, 'the month of Rabīʿ the First / the Second', the third and fourth lunar months
جُمَادَي: جُمَادَى — Jumādā, name of the fifth and sixth lunar months (f., indecl.; the print writes the final ى as dotted ي); Jumādā al-ūlā, al-ukhrā, 'Jumādā the First, the Second'
رَجَبٌ: رَجَب — Rajab, the seventh month of the lunar year (m., nom. indef., triptote)
شَعْبَانُ: شَعْبَان — Shaʿbān, the eighth month of the lunar year (m., nom., diptote)
رَمَضَانُ: رَمَضَان — Ramaḍān, the ninth month, the month of fasting (m., nom., diptote)
شَوَّالٌ: شَوَّال — Shawwāl, the tenth month of the lunar year (m., nom. indef., triptote)
وَبَصَقَ: وَ + بَصَقَ — wa-, and + baṣaqa, to spit (verb I, perf. 3ms; with fī, 'in (the face)'); 'and he spat'
قَدْجُنَّ: قَدْ + جُنَّ — qad, particle of completion before the perfect + junna, he went mad, lit. 'was possessed' (passive of janna, verb I geminate, 3ms; the shadda is printed); 'has gone mad' (printed as one word)
مَاجُنَّ: مَا + جُنَّ — mā, not (neg. before the perfect) + junna, he went mad (passive of janna, 3ms; the shadda is printed); mā junna illā anta, 'none has gone mad but you' (printed as one word)
يَتَمَهَّلَ: يَتَمَهَّلَ — yatamahhala, to take one's time, wait, go slowly (tamahhala, verb V, impf. subj. 3ms after an; the shadda is printed); 'that he wait'
صَبِيَّةٍ: صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., gen. indef. after maʿa; the shadda is printed); 'a girl'
السُّخْرِيَّةَ: الـ + سُخْرِيَّة — al-, the + sukhriyya, mockery, ridicule (f., acc., object of tataḥammalu); 'mockery'
تَزِيدُوا: تَزِيدُوا — tazīdū, you (pl.) add (zāda, verb I hollow, jussive 2mp after prohibitive lā; with ʿalā, 'add to (someone's load)'); lā tazīdū, 'do not add'
خُلْقِي: خُلْق + ـي — khulq, character, temper, patience (m., nom.) + -ī, my; ḍāqa khulqī, 'my patience has run short'
تَفْعَلُونَهُ: تَفْعَلُونَ + ـهُ — tafʿalūna, you (pl.) do (faʿala, verb I, impf. 2mp; with maʿa, 'do to') + -hu, it (taking up mā); 'what you are doing'
تُزَوِّجَنِى: تُزَوِّجَ + ـنِى — tuzawwija, you marry (someone to) (zawwaja, verb II, impf. subj. 2ms after an; here with two objects, the man and the bride; the shadda is printed) + -nī, me (printed with ى for ي); 'that you marry me (to)'
وَشَوَّفْتَنِى: وَ + شَوَّفْتَ + ـنِى — wa-, and + shawwafta, you made see, showed (shawwafa, verb II of shāfa, 'to see', a later word; perf. 2ms; the shadda and the fatḥa of the tāʾ are printed) + -nī, me (printed with ى); with ilayhā, 'you made me look to her'; doubtful, perhaps for وشوّقتنى, 'you made me long (for her)'
أَرْسَلْتَ: أَرْسَلْتَ — arsalta, you sent (arsala, verb IV, perf. 2ms; hamza supplied, printed bare as ارسلت); arsala ilā, 'to send to (someone), send for'
وَأَخَذْتَهَا: وَ + أَخَذْتَ + هَا — wa-, and + akhadhta, you took (akhadha, verb I, perf. 2ms) + -hā, her; 'and you took her'
آخُذُهَا: آخُذُ + ـهَا — akhadha, to take (verb I, imperf. 1s ākhudhu: the prefix ʾa- plus the root's ʾ, written as one alif with madda) + -hā, her; 'I take her' (here of purpose, 'to take her')
تَخَيُّلَاتُ: تَخَيُّلَات — takhayyulāt, pl. of takhayyul (V verbal noun), fancy, imagining (nom., construct); 'fancies (of)'
بِتَّ: بَاتَ — bāta, to pass the night (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms bit-ta); 'you passed the night'
مَشْغُولُ: مَشْغُول — mashghūl, occupied, busy (pass. part. of shaghala, nom., construct); 'occupied (of)'
وَمُوَسْوِسٌ: وَ + مُوَسْوِس — wa-, and + muwaswis, obsessed, prey to whispering thoughts (quadriliteral act. part. of waswasa, nom.); 'and obsessed'
وَسَاعَتَهُ: وَ + سَاعَة + ـهُ — wa-, and + sāʿa, hour (f., acc.) + -hu, its; 'and its hour'
رَيْبَ: رَيْب — rayb, doubt, uncertainty (m., acc. after lā of absolute negation); 'no uncertainty'
مُتَكَدِّرُ: مُتَكَدِّر — mutakaddir, troubled, muddied (V act. part. of takaddara, nom., construct); 'troubled (of)'
الْمِزَاجِ: الـ + مِزَاج — mizāj, temperament, humour (m., gen.); 'the temper'
فَرَأَيْتَ: فَـ + رَأَى + ـتَ — fa-, so + raʾā, to see (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'so you saw'
تُعَانِقُكَ: عَانَقَ + ـكَ — ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, imperf. 3fs) + -ka, you; 'she embraces you'
تَعْتَقِدُ: اعْتَقَدَ — iʿtaqada, to believe firmly (verb VIII, imperf. 2ms); 'you believe'
الْيَقْظَةِ: الـ + يَقْظَة — yaqẓa, wakefulness, waking (f., gen.); 'the waking'
وَاحْلِفْ: وَ + احْلِفْ — wa-, and + iḥlif, swear (imperative of ḥalafa, verb I); 'and swear'
الْخَالِقِ: الـ + خَالِق — khāliq, creator (act. part., gen., in apposition to God); 'the Creator'
الْعَلَّامِ: الـ + عَلَّام — ʿallām, all-knowing (intensive adj., gen.); 'the All-Knowing'
قَاصِمِ: قَاصِم — qāṣim, breaker (act. part. of qaṣama, gen., construct); 'breaker (of)'
وَمُبِيدِ: وَ + مُبِيد — wa-, and + mubīd, destroyer (IV act. part. of abāda, gen., construct); 'and destroyer (of)'
كَاسِرَةِ: …كَاسِرَة (printed apart from الا) — al-akāsira, pl. of Kisrā, Chosroes, the Persian kings (gen.); 'the Chosroes kings'
وَمَحَلِّهَا: وَ + مَحَلّ + ـهَا — wa-, and + maḥall, place, whereabouts (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'and her place'
إِلَٰهِ: إِلٰه — ilāh, god (m., gen., construct, in apposition to God); '(the) God (of)'
وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ: وَ + إِبْرَاهِيم — wa-, and + Ibrāhīm, Abraham (proper name, diptote, gen. in -a); 'and Abraham'
وَلَاعِنْدِي: وَ + لَا + عِنْد + ـِي (printed as one word) — wa-, and + lā, not + ʿind, with (prep.) + -ī, me; 'nor with me (is)'
يُبَيِّنُ: بَيَّنَ — bayyana, to make clear (verb II, imperf. 3ms); '(that) makes clear'
قَاتَلَ: قَاتَلَ — qātala, to fight (verb III, perf. 3ms); 'he fought'
مُلَوَّثًا: مُلَوَّث — mulawwath, smeared, stained (pass. part. II of lawwatha; m., acc. indef., describing sayfan); 'stained'
بِالدَّمِ: بِـ + الـ + دَم — bi-, with (prep., of what a thing is smeared with) + al-, the + dam, blood (m., gen.); 'with blood'
كَأَنِّي: كَأَنَّ + ي — kaʾanna, as though (particle taking an acc. subject) + -ī, I; 'as though I'; after raʾaytu, the usual way of telling a dream: 'I dreamed that I'
كَقَدِّي: كَـ + قَدّ + ي — ka-, like (prep. of comparison, governing the gen.) + qadd, stature, figure (m.) + -ī, my; 'like my figure'
وَشَكْلُهَا: وَ + شَكْل + هَا — wa-, and + shakl, form, looks (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'and her looks'
كَشَكْلِي: كَـ + شَكْل + ي — ka-, like (prep. of comparison, governing the gen.) + shakl, form, looks (m.) + -ī, my; 'like my looks'
فَعَانَقْتُهَا: فَـ + عَانَقْتُ + هَا — fa-, so, and then + ʿānaqa, to embrace (verb III, perf. 1s) + -hā, her; 'so I embraced her'
وَلَبِسْتُهُ: وَ + لَبِسْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + labisa, to put on, wear (verb I, perf. 1s) + -hu, it; 'and I put it on'
إِصْبَعِي: إِصْبَع + ي — iṣbaʿ, finger (f. or m., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my finger'
وَقَلَعْتُ: وَ + قَلَعْتُ — wa-, and + qalaʿa, to pull out, pull off (verb I, perf. 1s); 'and I pulled off'
وَأَلْبَسْتُهُ: وَ + أَلْبَسْتُ + هُ — wa-, and + albasa, to clothe, put (a thing) on (someone) (verb IV, causative of labisa, perf. 1s) + -hu, it; 'and I put it on (her)'
بِجَنْبِهَا: بِـ + جَنْب + هَا — bi-, at, beside (prep. of place) + janb, side (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'at her side'
وَامْتَنَعْتُ: وَ + امْتَنَعْتُ — wa-, and + imtanaʿa, to refrain, hold back (verb VIII of manaʿa, perf. 1s; with ʿan, from); 'and I held back'
تَمْتَحِنُنِي: تَمْتَحِنُ + نِي — imtaḥana, to test, try (verb VIII, imperf. 2ms) + -nī, me; 'you test me'
أُقَبِّلَهَا: أُقَبِّلَ + هَا — qabbala, to kiss (verb II, imperf. subj. 1s after an) + -hā, her; '(that) I kiss her'
تُرَغِّبُنِي: تُرَغِّبُ + نِي — raghghaba, to make (someone) desire (fī, something) (verb II of raghiba, imperf. 2ms; the print sets no shadda) + -nī, me; 'you make me desire'
وَكَذِبًا: وَ + كَذِب — wa-, and + kadhib, lie, falsehood (m., acc. indef., predicate of yakūnu); 'and a lie'
وَأَمْرُ: وَ + أَمْر — wa-, and; here 'while' (introducing a circumstantial clause) + amr, matter, affair (m., nom., first term of a construct); 'while the matter of'
الْخَاتَمِ: الـ + خَاتَم — al-, the + khātam, ring, seal-ring (m., gen.); 'the ring'
الْخَاتَمُ: الـ + خَاتَم — al-, the + khātam, ring, seal-ring (m., nom.; after lawlā, 'were it not for'); 'the ring'
خَاتَمُهَا: خَاتَم + هَا — khātam, ring (m., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her ring'
خِنْصِرِي: خِنْصِر + ي — khinṣir (also khinṣar), little finger (m., gen. after fī) + -ī, my; 'my little finger'
نَبَأً: نَبَأ — nabaʾ, tidings, news of weight (m., acc. indef., the delayed subject of inna); 'tidings, a tale'
وَخَبَرًا: وَ + خَبَر — wa-, and + khabar, news, story (m., acc. indef.); 'and a story'
الدَّخِيلُ: الـ + دَخِيل — al-, the + dakhīl, one who comes in, intruder, stranger (m., nom.; from dakhala, to enter); 'the intruder'
الْكُرْبَةَ: الـ + كُرْبَة — al-, the + kurba, distress, grief (f., acc., object of yufarrija); 'the distress'
وَيَأْتِيَكَ: وَ + يَأْتِيَ + كَ — wa-, and + atā, to come (verb I, imperf. subj. 3ms, sharing the subjunctive of ḥattā) + -ka, you; with bi-, atā bi- 'bring': 'and (until He) bring you'. The print has the misprint ويأنيك
بِالْفَرَجِ: بِـ + الـ + فَرَج — bi-, with (prep. chosen by atā, which with bi- means 'bring') + al-, the + faraj, relief, release from distress (m., gen.); 'relief'
وَيَأْتِي: وَ + يَأْتِي — wa-, and + atā, to come (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with bi-, 'to bring'; 'and brings'
غَيُورُ: غَيُور — ghayūr, jealous (intensive adj., m., nom.; without tanwīn at the line's end); 'jealous'
وَتُسْعِدُ: وَ + تُسْعِدُ — wa-, and + asʿada, to make happy, favour, help (verb IV, imperf. 3fs or 2ms); 'and favours'
آمَالِي: آمَال + ي — āmāl, hopes (pl. of amal) + -ī, my (acc., object); 'my hopes'
وَتَقْضِي: وَ + تَقْضِي — wa-, and + qaḍā, to settle, fulfil (with ḥāja, 'to meet a need') (verb I, imperf. 3fs or 2ms); 'and fulfils'
وَتَحْدُثُ: وَ + تَحْدُثُ — wa-, and + ḥadatha, to happen, come about (verb I, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with a broken plural); 'and there happen'
اُمُوْرُ: أُمُور — umūr, affairs, things (m. broken pl. of amr, nom., subject of taḥduthu; without tanwīn at the line's end; the print sets a damma on bare alif for the hamza and a sukūn on the long ū); 'affairs, other things'
يُجَلِّيهَا: يُجَلِّي + هَا — jallā, to clear up, clear away (verb II, imperf. 3ms; with ʿan, from someone) + -hā, it (f.); 'clears it away'
وَتَفْحَصُ: وَ + تَفْحَصُ — wa-, and + faḥaṣa, to search, inquire (verb I, imperf. 2ms; with ʿan, after); 'and (you) search'
وَتُعَجِّلُ: وَ + تُعَجِّلُ — wa-, and + ʿajjala, to hasten (verb II, imperf. 2ms; with bi-, the thing hastened); 'and (you) hasten'
بِقُدُومِهَا: بِـ + قُدُوم + هَا — bi- (prep. chosen by ʿajjala, marking what is hastened) + qudūm, arrival, coming (m., verbal noun of qadima) + -hā, her; 'her coming'
وَإِلَّامُتُّ: وَ + إِلَّا + مُتُّ — wa-, and + illā (in + lā), if not, otherwise + muttu, I die (māta, verb I hollow, perf. 1s, future sense after the condition); set solid in the print; 'or else I die'
كَمَدًا: كَمَد — kamad, hidden grief, sorrow that wears one down (m., acc. indef. of cause); 'of grief'
بِمَوْتِي: بِـ + مَوْت + ي — bi- (prep. chosen by darā, 'to know of') + mawt, death (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'of my death'
وَعْدُكُمْ: وَعْد + كُمْ — waʿd, promise (m., nom., noun of kāna) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your promise'
بِالْوَصْلِ: بِـ + الـ + وَصْل — bi-, of (prep. marking what is promised) + al-, the + waṣl, union, meeting of lovers (m., gen.); 'of union'
تَزْوِيرُ: تَزْوِير — tazwīr, forgery, falsehood (m., verbal noun of zawwara, Form II of z-w-r; nom. as printed, where the predicate of kāna would be acc. tazwīran); 'a sham'
وَاصِلُوا: وَاصِلُوا — wāṣala, to be united with, join (a lover) (verb III, imperative 2mp); 'join, come to'
الْمُشْتَاقَ: الـ + مُشْتَاق — al-, the + mushtāq, one who longs (act. part. VIII of shāqa; m., acc. object); 'the one who longs'
يَزُورُ: يَزُورُ — zāra, to visit (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); 'visits'
الطَّيْفُ: الـ + طَيْف — al-, the + ṭayf, phantom, the image of the beloved that visits in dreams (m., nom.); 'the phantom'
جَفْنَ: جَفْن — jafn, eyelid (m., acc., first term of a construct); 'the eyelid of'
مَنَامُهُ: مَنَام + هُ — manām, sleep (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'his sleep'
وَمَحْجُورُ: وَ + مَحْجُور — wa-, and + maḥjūr, barred, forbidden (pass. part. I of ḥajara; m., nom., without tanwīn at the line's end); 'and barred'
بِخُضُوعٍ: بِـ + خُضُوع — bi-, with (prep. of manner) + khuḍūʿ, humility, submission (m., gen. indef.); 'humbly'
وَانْكِسَارٍ: وَ + انْكِسَار — wa-, and + inkisār, brokenness, a crushed spirit (m., verbal noun VII of kasara, gen. indef.); 'and brokenly'
مَجْرُوحٍ: مَجْرُوح — majrūḥ, wounded (pass. part. of jaraḥa; m., gen. indef., agreeing with kabidin though kabid is usually f.); 'wounded'
مُنَعَّمَةٌ: مُنَعَّمَة — munaʿʿama, delicately reared, pampered (pass. part. of Form II naʿʿama; f., nom. indef., predicate with 'she is' understood); 'delicately reared'
لَامَسَ: لَامَسَ — lāmasa, to touch (Form III, perf. 3ms); 'touched'
الْوَرْدُ: الـ + وَرْد — ward, roses, the rose (m., collective; nom., subject of lāmasa); 'the rose'
خَدَّهَا: خَدّ + هَا — khadd, cheek (m., acc., object of lāmasa) + -hā, her; 'her cheek'
مُقْلَتَيْهِ: مُقْلَتَيْ + هِ — muqla, eyeball, eye (f.), dual gen. muqlatay (after min, its nūn dropped in construct) + -hi, his/its; 'its two eyes' (the rose's; perhaps a slip for muqlatayhā, 'her eyes')
الْمَوَاطِرُ: الـ + مَوَاطِر — mawāṭir, rains, pouring showers (pl., nom., subject of jarat; from maṭar, rain); here tears
بِاَرْضِهَا: بِـ + اَرْض + هَا — bi-, by (marking what is passed by, after marra) + arḍ, land, country (f., gen.; the print sets the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif) + -hā, her; 'by her land'
اَرْضِهَا: اَرْض + هَا — arḍ, land, country (f., gen. after min; the print sets the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif) + -hā, her; 'her land'
قَلَائِدُهَا: قَلَائِد + هَا — qalāʾid, necklaces (pl. of qilāda; nom., subject of tashkū) + -hā, her; 'her necklaces'
رَنِينَ: رَنِين — ranīn, ringing, chiming (m., acc., object of tashkū, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the ringing of'
وِشَاحِهَا: وِشَاح + هَا — wishāḥ, a jewelled band or sash worn across the body (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'her sash'
خَرَّسَتْ: خَرَّسَتْ — kharrasat, (they) have been struck dumb, fallen silent (Form II, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural al-asāwir; the shadda printed for the metre, where the usual verb is Form I kharisa, 'to be dumb'); 'have gone dumb'
مِعْصَمَيْهَا: مِعْصَمَيْ + هَا — miʿṣam, wrist (m.), dual gen. miʿṣamay (after min) + -hā, her; 'her two wrists'
الْاَسَاوِرُ: الـ + اَسَاوِر — asāwir, bracelets (pl. of siwār; nom., subject of kharrasat; the print sets the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'the bracelets'
عَذُولِي: عَذُول + ي — ʿadhūl, reproacher, censurer (m., the stock figure who blames the lover; vocative without yā) + -ī, my; 'my reproacher'
لَحَاكَ: لَحَا + كَ — laḥā, to strip (bark from a stick), to revile (verb I defective, perf. 3ms, used as a curse) + -ka, you; laḥāka Allāhu, 'may God strip you, God confound you'
تُثْنَى: تُثْنَى — tuthnā, are turned back, bent back (passive imperf. 3fs of thanā, agreeing with the broken plural al-nawāẓir); 'are turned back'
النَّوَاظِرُ: الـ + نَوَاظِر — nawāẓir, eyes, gazes (pl. of nāẓir/nāẓira; nom., subject of tuthnā); 'the eyes'
مَتَي: مَتَي — matā, when? (interrog.; the print spells it with a dotted ي for the usual ى); ilā matā, 'until when, how long'
مَحْجُوبٌ: مَحْجُوب — maḥjūb, veiled, screened off, kept out of sight (pass. part. of ḥajaba; m., nom. indef., predicate of anta); with ʿan, 'hidden from'
يَنْفَسِدُ: يَنْفَسِدُ — yanfasidu, to go bad, fall into disorder (Form VII of fasada, imperf. 3ms indic.; a Middle Arabic form beside Classical yafsudu); with ʿalā, 'to the harm of'; 'falls apart'
نِظَامُ: نِظَام — niẓām, order, arrangement, system (m., nom., subject; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the order of'
دَوْلَتِكَ: دَوْلَة + كَ — dawla, state, dynasty (f., gen.) + -ka, your; arbābu dawlatika, 'the lords of your state'
وَالْعَاقِلُ: و + الـ + عَاقِل — wa-, and + ʿāqil, sensible, wise man (act. part. of ʿaqala; m., nom., set at the head of the sentence as its topic); 'and the sensible man'
بِجِسْمِهِ: بِـ + جِسْم + هِ — bi-, in, on (prep., of where the wounds are) + jism, body (m., gen.) + -hi, his; 'on his body'
جِرَاحَاتٌ: جِرَاحَات — jirāḥāt, wounds (pl. of jirāḥa; f., nom. indef., subject of kāna); 'wounds'
مُخْتَلِفَاتٌ: مُخْتَلِفَات — mukhtalifāt, various, of different kinds (act. part. of Form VIII ikhtalafa; f. pl., nom. indef., agreeing with jirāḥāt); 'various'
فَلْيُدَاوِي: فَـ + لْـ + يُدَاوِي — fa-, then (opening the answer to idhā) + li-, let (lām of command, vowel dropped after fa-) + yudāwī, to treat, doctor (Form III dāwā, 3ms; Classical jussive yudāwi, the print keeps the long ī, a Middle Arabic form); 'let him treat'
الْأَخْطَرَ: الـ + أَخْطَر — akhṭar, most dangerous (elative of khaṭīr; m., acc., object of yudāwī); 'the most dangerous'
تَنْقُلَ: تَنْقُلَ — tanqula, you move, transfer (verb I naqala, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'that you move'
السَّرَايَةِ: الـ + سَرَايَة — sarāya, palace, the royal compound (f., gen. after fī; from Turkish saray, 'palace'); 'the seraglio'
وَتَنْقَطِعَ: وَ + تَنْقَطِعَ — wa-, and + tanqaṭiʿa, to cut oneself off, withdraw (Form VII of qaṭaʿa, imperf. 2ms subjunctive after an); 'and that you withdraw'
وَالْمَوْكِبِ: وَ + الـ + مَوْكِب — wa-, and + mawkib, procession, the ruler's formal public appearance or audience (m., gen.); 'and the audience'
وَيَوْمَ: وَ + يَوْمَ — wa-, and + yawm, day (m., acc., in apposition to yawmayni; first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the day of'
وَالرَّعِيَّةُ: وَ + الـ + رَعِيَّة — wa-, and + raʿiyya, subjects, the common people (f. collective, 'the flock'; nom.); 'and the subjects'
وَيَعْرِضُونَ: وَ + يَعْرِضُونَ — wa-, and + yaʿriḍūna, they lay before, present (verb I ʿaraḍa, imperf. 3mp); with ʿalā, 'lay before (someone)'
أَحْوَالَهُمْ: أَحْوَال + هُمْ — aḥwāl, conditions, affairs (pl. of ḥāl; acc., object of yaʿriḍūna) + -hum, their; 'their affairs'
فَتَقْضِي: فَـ + تَقْضِي — fa-, and so + taqḍī, you settle, fulfil (verb I defective qaḍā, imperf. 2ms); qaḍā ḥājatan li-, 'to fulfil someone's need'; 'and you fulfil'
وَاحْكُمْ: وَ + احْكُمْ — wa-, and + uḥkum, judge! (imper. 2ms of ḥakama); with bayna, 'judge between'
وَأَعْطِ: وَ + أَعْطِ — wa-, and + aʿṭi, give! (imper. 2ms of Form IV aʿṭā, final letter dropped); khudh wa-aʿṭi maʿa, 'take and give with', have dealings with
وَانْهِ: وَ + انْهِ — wa-, and + inhi, forbid! (imper. 2ms of nahā, final letter dropped; the kasra is printed); 'and forbid'
وَبَقِيَّةَ: وَ + بَقِيَّة — wa-, and + baqiyya, remainder, rest (f., acc. of time, first term of an iḍāfa); baqiyyata al-jumʿati, 'for the rest of the week'
وَعَنْهُ: وَ + عَنْ + هُ — wa-, and + ʿan, from (prep., after farraja, marking the one relieved) + -hu, him; 'and (from) him'
وَلَاتَأْمَنْ: وَ + لَا + تَأْمَنْ — wa-, and + lā, do not (prohibition) + taʾman, feel safe (verb I amina, jussive 2ms; the hamza is printed); with min, 'feel safe from'; the print runs the words together
وَطَوَارِقِ: وَ + طَوَارِق — wa-, and + ṭawāriq, things that come knocking by night, sudden misfortunes (pl. of ṭāriqa; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); ṭawāriqu al-ḥadathān, 'the sudden strokes of fortune'
حَسَّنْتَ: حَسَّنْتَ — ḥassanta, you made good (Form II of ḥasuna, perf. 2ms); ḥassana ẓannahu bi-, 'to think well of'
الْكَدَرُ: الـ + كَدَر — kadar, muddiness, turbidity (of water); trouble, vexation (m., nom., subject of yaḥduthu); the opposite of ṣafw
مَعْشَرَ: مَعْشَر — maʿshar, company, community (m., acc. after yā, in construct); yā maʿshara al-nāsi, 'O company of men, O people'
مُسَاعِدًا: مُسَاعِد — musāʿid, helper, ally (act. part. of Form III sāʿada; m., acc. indef., predicate of kāna); 'a helper'
رَأْيه: رَأْي + ه — raʾy, judgment, opinion, counsel (m., gen. after min; the print leaves the final ه bare, read -hi) + -hi, his; min raʾyihi, 'part of his counsel'
الحَذَرُ: الـ + حَذَر — ḥadhar, caution, wariness (m., nom., subject of fa-l-yakun; the print marks only the fatḥa of ḥa-); 'caution'
مَصْلَحَتِهِ: مَصْلَحَة + هِ — maṣlaḥa, interest, welfare, advantage (f., gen. after fī) + -hi, his; 'his welfare'
فَأَثَّرَ: فَـ + أَثَّرَ — fa-, and so + aththara, to make an impression (Form II, perf. 3ms); with ʿinda, 'it weighed with him'
يَنْفَسِدَ: يَنْفَسِدَ — yanfasida, to go bad, fall into disorder (Form VII of fasada, imperf. 3ms subjunctive after an; Middle Arabic beside Classical yafsuda); 'that (it) fall apart'
بِتَحْوِيلِ: بِـ + تَحْوِيل — bi- (after amara, 'to command', bi- marks what is ordered) + taḥwīl, moving, transferring (verbal noun of Form II ḥawwala; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'ordered the moving of'
مَمْشَاةٍ: مَمْشَاة — mamshāt, walkway, causeway (f., place-noun from mashā, 'to walk'; gen. indef. after ʿalā); 'a causeway'
عَرْضُهَا: عَرْض + هَا — ʿarḍ, width, breadth (m., nom.) + -hā, its (the causeway's); 'its width'
ذِرَاعًا: ذِرَاع — dhirāʿ, cubit, forearm (f./m.; acc. sg. as the counted noun after ʿishrūna); 'cubits'
وَأَرْضُهُ: وَ + أَرْض + هُ — wa-, and + arḍ, ground, floor (f., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and its floor'
وَسَقْفُهُ: وَ + سَقْف + هُ — wa-, and + saqf, ceiling, roof (m., nom.) + -hu, its; 'and its ceiling'
مَدْهُونٌ: مَدْهُون — madhūn, painted, varnished (pass. part. of dahana; m., nom. indef., predicate); with bi-, 'painted with'
الدِّهَانَاتِ: الـ + دِهَانَات — dihānāt, paints, varnishes (pl. of dihān; gen.); 'the paints'
وَأَفْخَرِهَا: وَ + أَفْخَر + هَا — wa-, and + afkhar, finest, most splendid (elative of fākhir; gen., joined to anwāʿi) + -hā, of them; 'and the finest of them'
فَفَرَشُوا: فَـ + فَرَشُوا — fa-, so + farashū, they spread (verb I farasha, perf. 3mp); with li-, 'spread for (someone)'
الْفِرَاشَ: الـ + فِرَاش — firāsh, bedding, bed (m., acc., object of farashū); 'the bedding'
الْفَاخِرَ: الـ + فَاخِر — fākhir, splendid, sumptuous (adj., m., acc., agreeing with al-firāsh); 'the splendid'
الْمُطَرَّزَ: الـ + مُطَرَّز — muṭarraz, embroidered (pass. part. of Form II ṭarraza; m. sg., acc., agreeing loosely with the plural al-busuṭ); 'the embroidered'
السِّتَارَاتِ: الـ + سِتَارَات — sitārāt, curtains (pl. of sitāra; acc., object of arkhaw); 'the curtains'
الْمُكَلَّلَةَ: الـ + مُكَلَّلَة — mukallala, crowned, set round (pass. part. of Form II kallala, from iklīl, 'crown'; f., acc., agreeing with the plural sitārāt); with bi-, 'set with'
وَأَجْلَسُوا: وَ + أَجْلَسُوا — wa-, and + ajlasū, they seated (Form IV of jalasa, causative, perf. 3mp); 'and they seated'
مُكَلَّلٍ: مُكَلَّل — mukallal, crowned, set round (pass. part. of Form II kallala; m., gen. indef., agreeing with sarīrin); with bi-, 'set with'
اشْتِغَالِهِ: اشْتِغَال + هِ — ishtighāl, being taken up, preoccupation (verbal noun of Form VIII ishtaghala; gen.) + -hi, his; with bi-, 'his being taken up with'
وَعِشْقِهِ: وَ + عِشْق + هِ — wa-, and + ʿishq, passionate love (m., gen.) + -hi, his; with li-, 'his passion for'
وَلَايَشْرَبُ: وَ + لَا + يَشْرَبُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yashrabu, he drinks (verb I shariba, imperf. 3ms); the print runs the words together; 'nor drink'
وَلَايَنَامُ: وَ + لَا + يَنَامُ — wa-, and + lā, not + yanāmu, he sleeps (verb I hollow nāma, imperf. 3ms); the print runs the words together; 'nor sleep'
كَالْمَرِيضِ: كَـ + الـ + مَرِيض — ka-, like (prep. of likeness) + marīḍ, sick man (m., gen.); 'like the sick man'
وَالِدُةُ: وَالِد + ةُ — wālid, father (m., nom.) + -hu, his (the print writes the pronoun with ة, as in its spelling والدة); 'his father'
يَأْذَنُ: يَأْذَنُ — yaʾdhanu, he permits (verb I adhina, imperf. 3ms; the hamza is printed); adhina bi-, 'to permit (something)'
بِدُخُولِ: بِـ + دُخُول — bi- (after adhina, 'to permit', bi- marks what is permitted) + dukhūl, entering, entry (verbal noun of dakhala; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'leave for the entry of'
وَالرَّعِيَّةِ: وَ + الـ + رَعِيَّة — wa-, and + raʿiyya, subjects, the common people (f. collective; gen.); 'and the subjects'
وَيُؤَدُّونَ: وَ + يُؤَدُّونَ — wa-, and + yuʾaddūna, they perform, discharge (Form II addā, imperf. 3mp; the hamza and shadda are printed); 'and they perform'
وَظَائِفَ: وَظَائِف — waẓāʾif, duties, offices (pl. of waẓīfa; acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa; the hamza is printed); waẓāʾif al-khidma, 'the duties of service'
يَنْصَرِفُونَ: يَنْصَرِفُونَ — yanṣarifūna, they go off, depart (Form VII inṣarafa, imperf. 3mp); ilā ḥāli sabīlihim, 'on their way'
وَلَيَالِي: وَ + لَيَالِي — wa-, and + layālī, nights (pl. of layla; gen. indef., where Classical grammar has layālin; the print keeps the ي, a Middle Arabic form); 'and nights'
وَالْقَهْرَمَانَاتُ: وَ + الـ + قَهْرَمَانَات — wa-, and + qahramānāt, stewardesses, housekeepers (pl. of qahramāna, a word of Persian origin; nom.); 'and the stewardesses'
كَبِيرَتُهُنَّ: كَبِيرَة + هُنَّ — kabīra, eldest, senior (f., nom., subject of taqaddamat) + -hunna, their (f. pl.); 'the eldest of them'
الْقَهْرَمَانَةُ: الـ + قَهْرَمَانَة — qahramāna, stewardess, housekeeper of a great household (f., nom., subject of samiʿat; Persian origin); 'the stewardess'
بَأْسِهَا: بَأْس + هَا — baʾs, might, violence, wrath (m., gen. after min; printed باسها without the hamza, a spelling of the print) + -hā, her; 'her wrath'
الصَّبِيحِ: الـ + صَبِيح — ṣabīḥ, bright, fair (of a face) (adj., m., gen., agreeing with al-wajh); 'the fair'
وَالْعُيُونِ: وَ + الـ + عُيُون — wa-, and + ʿuyūn, eyes (pl. of ʿayn; gen., after ṣāḥib); 'and the eyes'
تَمْزَحِي: تَمْزَحِي — tamzaḥī, you (f.) jest (verb I mazaḥa, jussive 2fs after lā of prohibition); 'do not jest'
الْمِزَاحَ: الـ + مِزَاح — mizāḥ, jesting, a jest (m., acc., object of its own verb tamzaḥī); 'the jesting'
الْخَارِجَ: الـ + خَارِج — khārij, going out, exceeding (act. part. of kharaja; m., acc., agreeing with al-mizāḥ); with ʿan al-ḥadd, 'beyond bounds'
الْحَدِّ: الـ + حَدّ — ḥadd, limit, bound (m., gen. after ʿan); 'the limit'
يَبْلُغُ: يَبْلُغُ — yablughu, it reaches (verb I balagha, imperf. 3ms, taking the person reached as direct object); 'reaches'
الْمِزَاحُ: الـ + مِزَاح — mizāḥ, jesting, a jest (m., nom., subject of yablughu); 'the jest'
الْقَهْرَمَانَةَ: الـ + قَهْرَمَانَة — qahramāna, stewardess, housekeeper of a great household (f., acc., noun of anna; Persian origin); 'the stewardess'
لَاتَمْزَحِي: لَا + تَمْزَحِي — lā, not (prohibitive) + tamzaḥī (mazaḥa, to jest; verb I, jussive 2fs); printed as one word; 'do not jest'
عَقْلِكِ: عَقْل + ـكِ — ʿaql, mind, reason (m., gen., second term of salāmatu) + -ki, your (f.); 'your mind'
لِلْقَهْرَمَانَةِ: لِـ + الـ + قَهْرَمَانَة — li-, to (marks the one spoken to, after qāla) + al-, the + qahramāna, stewardess (f., gen.); 'to the stewardess'
أَتَكْذِبِينَ: أَ + تَكْذِبِينَ — a-, question prefix + takdhibīna (kadhaba, to lie; verb I, imperf. 2fs); with ʿalā, 'lie to, against'; 'do you lie?'
وَتَقُولِينَ: وَ + تَقُولِينَ — wa-, and + taqūlīna (qāla, to say; verb I hollow, imperf. 2fs); 'and you say'
وَتَحْلِفِينَ: وَ + تَحْلِفِينَ — wa-, and + taḥlifīna (ḥalafa, to swear; verb I, imperf. 2fs); with li- for the one sworn to and bi- for what one swears by; 'and you swear'
بَاطِلًا: بَاطِل — bāṭil, false, vain (m., acc. adverbial); 'falsely'
مَاكَذَبْتُ: مَا + كَذَبْتُ — mā, not (negative) + kadhabtu (kadhaba, to lie; verb I, perf. 1cs); printed as one word; 'I did not lie'
وَسَحَبَتْ: وَ + سَحَبَتْ — wa-, and + saḥabat (saḥaba, to drag, draw out; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she drew (a sword)'
وَالسَّرَارِي: وَ + الـ + سَرَارِي — wa-, and + al-, the + sarārī, concubines (pl. of surriyya, f.; nom.); 'and the concubines'
دِمَاغِهَا: دِمَاغ + هَا — dimāgh, brain (m., gen. after min) + -hā, her; 'her brain'
ذَيْلِهَا: ذَيْل + هَا — dhayl, hem, skirt of a garment (m., gen. after ilā) + -hā, its/her; 'its hem'
يُمْسِكُوهَا: يُمْسِكُوا + هَا — yumsikū (amsaka, to seize, hold; verb IV, subj. 3mp after an; masc. plural used of the slave girls, Middle Arabic) + -hā, her; 'that they hold her'
فَمَسَكُوهَا: فَـ + مَسَكُوا + هَا — fa-, so + masakū (masaka, to seize, hold; verb I, colloquial beside IV amsaka; perf. 3mp, masc. for the women, Middle Arabic) + -hā, her; 'so they seized her'
وَقَيَّدُوهَا: وَ + قَيَّدُوا + هَا — wa-, and + qayyadū (qayyada, to fetter, bind; verb II, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they bound her'
سِلْسِلَةً: سِلْسِلَة — silsila, chain (f., acc., object of jaʿalū); 'a chain'
وَرَبَطُوهَا: وَ + رَبَطُوا + هَا — wa-, and + rabaṭū (rabaṭa, to tie, bind; verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they tied her'
وَتَرَكُوهَا: وَ + تَرَكُوا + هَا — wa-, and + tarakū (taraka, to leave; verb I, perf. 3mp) + -hā, her; 'and they left her'
وَمَاهَانَ: وَ + مَا + هَانَ — wa-, and + mā, not + hāna (to be light, of small account; verb I hollow, perf. 3ms; with ʿalā, 'to be light to someone'); printed as one word; 'and (it) was not light (to him)'
وَالْمُنَجِّمِينَ: وَ + الـ + مُنَجِّمِين — wa-, and + al-, the + munajjimīn, astrologers (sound m. pl. of munajjim, II participle of najjama; acc.); 'and the astrologers'
وَأَصْحَابَ: وَ + أَصْحَاب — wa-, and + aṣḥāb, companions, masters, people of (pl. of ṣāḥib; acc., first term of an iḍāfa); aṣḥāb al-aqlām, 'masters of the pens'
أَبْرَأَ: أَبْرَأَ — abraʾa, to cure, heal (verb IV, perf. 3ms, of future sense in a condition; the edition prints the final hamza); 'cures'
يُبْرِئْهَا: يُبْرِئْ + هَا — yubriʾ (abraʾa, to cure; verb IV, jussive 3ms after lam; the edition prints the ئ) + -hā, her; 'cure her'
أَضْرِبْ: أَضْرِبْ — aḍrib (ḍaraba, to strike; verb I, jussive 1cs, answer of the condition after man); ḍaraba ʿunuqahu, 'to strike off his head'; 'I will strike'
وَأُعَلِّقْ: وَ + أُعَلِّقْ — wa-, and + uʿalliq (ʿallaqa, to hang up; verb II, jussive 1cs, answer of the condition); 'and I will hang'
وَيُعَلَّقُ: وَ + يُعَلَّقُ — wa-, and + yuʿallaqu (ʿallaqa, to hang up; verb II, passive imperf. 3ms); 'and is hung'
وَصَلَبَ: وَ + صَلَبَ — wa-, and + ṣalaba (to crucify, gibbet; verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he crucified'
فَتَوَقَّفَتْ: فَـ + تَوَقَّفَتْ — fa-, so + tawaqqafat (tawaqqafa, to hold back, hesitate; verb V, perf. 3fs, agreeing with jamīʿ al-nās; with ʿan, 'from'); 'so (all) held back'
وَعَجَزَتْ: وَ + عَجَزَتْ — wa-, and + ʿajazat (ʿajaza, to be unable, fall short; verb I, perf. 3fs, agreeing in sense with the plural after jamīʿ; with ʿan, 'unable to'); 'and (all) were unable'
دَوَائِهَا: دَوَاء + هَا — dawāʾ, remedy, cure (m., gen. after ʿan or ʿalā; the edition prints the ئ) + -hā, her; 'her cure, curing her'
حِكَايَتُهَا: حِكَايَة + هَا — ḥikāya, story, tale, case (f., nom., subject of ashkalat) + -hā, her; 'her case'
وَأَضَرَّبِهَا: وَ + أَضَرَّ + بِـ + هَا — wa-, and + aḍarra (to harm; verb IV doubled, perf. 3ms) + bi-, chosen by aḍarra, marking the one harmed + -hā, her; printed as one word; 'and (love) harmed her'
أَجْرَتِ: أَجْرَتِ — ajrat (ajrā, to make flow; verb IV, perf. 3fs, with linking -i before al-); 'she made flow, shed (tears)'
فِيْكَ: فِي + ـكَ — fī, in (prep.) + -ka, you (m.); printed with sukūn on the long ī; here of the object of love, gharāmī fīka, 'my passion for you'
قَمَرِيْ: قَمَر + ـي — qamar, moon (m.) + -ī, my; printed with sukūn on the ī; 'my moon', vocative after yā, glancing at the name Qamar al-Zamān
غَرِيْمِيْ: غَرِيم + ـي — gharīm, creditor (or debtor), one who clings and dunns (m., nom., predicate) + -ī, my; 'my creditor'
دُجَى: دُجَى — dujā, darkness (of night) (f./m. coll., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the darkness of'
لَيْلِيْ: لَيْل + ـي — layl, night (m., gen.) + -ī, my; printed with sukūn on the ī; 'my night'
نَدِيْمِيْ: نَدِيم + ـي — nadīm, boon companion at wine and talk (m., nom., predicate) + -ī, my; 'my companion'
اَبِيْتُ: أَبِيتُ — abītu (bāta, to spend the night; verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs); the hamza is printed as a fatḥa on bare alif; 'I pass the night'
وَاَضْلُعِيْ: وَ + أَضْلُع + ـي — wa-, and (here 'while', introducing a circumstantial clause) + aḍluʿ, ribs (pl. of ḍilʿ) + -ī, my; 'while my ribs …'
لَهِيْبُ: لَهِيب — lahīb, flame, blaze (m., nom., subject of a nominal clause; printed without tanwīn); 'a flame'
يُحَاكِيْ: يُحَاكِي — yuḥākī (ḥākā, to resemble, imitate; verb III, imperf. 3ms); 'resembles'
حَرُّهُ: حَرّ + ـهُ — ḥarr, heat (m., nom., subject) + -hu, its; 'its heat'
الْجَحِيْمِ: الـ + جَحِيم — al-jaḥīm, Hell, the blazing fire (f./m., gen., second term of nāra); 'of Hell'
بُلِيْتُ: بُلِيتُ — bulītu (balā, to try, afflict; verb I, passive perf. 1cs; with bi- marking the affliction); 'I have been afflicted'
وَاحْتِرَاقٍ: وَ + احْتِرَاق — wa-, and + iḥtirāq, burning (verbal noun of VIII iḥtaraqa; m., gen. indef.); 'and burning'
عَذَابِيْ: عَذَاب + ـي — ʿadhāb, torment (m., nom., subject) + -ī, my; 'my torment'
اَلِيْمِيْ: أَلِيم + ـي — alīm, painful; also one in pain (adj./noun) + -ī, my (forced by the rhyme); predicate of aḍḥā; 'my anguish, painful to me'
نَحْوِ: نَحْو — naḥw, direction (m., gen. after ilā); ilā naḥwi, 'toward'
اُرِيْدُ: أُرِيدُ — urīdu (arāda, to want; verb IV hollow, imperf. 1cs); the hamza printed as a ḍamma on bare alif; 'I want'
مُوَدِّعٍ: مُوَدِّع — muwaddiʿ, one bidding farewell (II active participle of waddaʿa; m., gen. indef., second term of salāma); 'of one taking leave'
كَثِيْرٌ: كَثِير — kathīr, much, abundant (adj., m., nom. indef.); 'abundant'
يَزِيْدُ: يَزِيدُ — yazīdu (zāda, to increase; verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms); 'increases'
لَاَهْوَاكُمْ: لَـ + أَهْوَى + كُمْ — la-, truly (emphatic, after inna) + ahwā (hawiya, to love, desire; verb I, imperf. 1cs) + -kum, you (pl.); 'I do love you'
وَاَهْوَى: وَ + أَهْوَى — wa-, and + ahwā (hawiya, to love; verb I, imperf. 1cs); 'and I love'
دِيَارَكُمْ: دِيَار + كُمْ — diyār, dwellings, abodes (pl. of dār; acc.) + -kum, your (pl.); 'your dwellings'
بَعِيْدُ: بَعِيد — baʿīd, far, distant (adj., m., nom., predicate of lākinna); 'far'
وَجَنَاتُهَا: وَجَنَات + هَا — wajanāt, cheeks (pl. of wajna; f., nom.) + -hā, her; 'her cheeks'
اسْتَمَرَّتْ: اسْتَمَرَّتْ — istamarrat (istamarra, to continue; verb X doubled, perf. 3fs; with ʿalā, 'to remain in'); 'she continued'
مَرْزَوَانَ: مَرْزَوَان — Marzawān, Budūr's foster brother (Persian name, diptote; acc., as second object of yusammā or in apposition); 'Marzawān' Also (Night 196): مَرْزَوَان — Marzawān, Budūr's foster brother (Persian name, diptote; gen. with -a after maʿa and ilā); 'Marzawān'; here: acc. as the noun of anna: anna Marzawāna lammā naẓara, 'that Marzawān, when he looked'
مَرْزَوَانُ: مَرْزَوَان — Marzawān, Budūr's foster brother (Persian name, diptote; nom., subject); 'Marzawān'
أَقْصَي: أَقْصَى — aqṣā, farthest (elative of qaṣiya; first term of an iḍāfa); the edition spells it with dotted ي, اقصي; ilā aqṣā al-bilādi, 'to the farthest lands'
الْإِخْوَةِ: الـ + إِخْوَة — al-, the + ikhwa, brothers (pl. of akh; gen.); 'the brothers'
أُخْتَكَ: أُخْت + ـكَ — ukht, sister (f., acc., noun of inna) + -ka, your (m.); 'your sister' (corrected from the print's اخيك)
سِلْسِلَةٌ: سِلْسِلَة — silsila, chain (f., nom. indef., subject of a fronted-predicate clause); 'a chain'
الْمُوَكَّلِ: الـ + مُوَكَّل — al-, the + muwakkal, put in charge (II passive participle of wakkala; m., gen., agreeing with al-khādim); with bi-, 'in charge of'; 'the one in charge'
وَأَهْدَتْ: وَ + أَهْدَتْ — wa-, and + ahdat (ahdā, to give as a gift; verb IV, perf. 3fs; with li- for the recipient); 'and she presented'
