وَلَمَّاجَرَى: وَ + لَمَّا + جَرَى — wa-, and + lammā, when, since + jarā (to happen; verb I, perf. 3ms; with li-, 'happen to'); printed as one word; 'and when (it) happened'
أَقْصِدُ: أَقْصِدُ — aqṣidu (qaṣada, to aim at, ask; verb I, imperf. 1cs); qaṣada min faḍlika, 'to ask of your kindness'; 'I ask'
لِتَنْظُرَهَا: لِـ + تَنْظُرَ + هَا — li-, so that (of purpose, with the subjunctive) + tanẓura (naẓara, to look at; verb I, subj. 3fs) + -hā, her; 'to see her'
وَلَايَعْلَمُ: وَ + لَا + يَعْلَمُ — wa-, and (circumstantial) + lā, not + yaʿlamu (ʿalima, to know; verb I, imperf. 3ms; with bi-, 'know of'); printed as one word; 'with no one knowing'
فَبَعْدَأَنْ: فَـ + بَعْدَ + أَنْ — fa-, so + baʿda, after + an, that (with the subjunctive); printed as one word; 'so after'
فَادْخُلِي: فَـ + ادْخُلِي — fa-, then + udkhulī (dakhala, to enter; verb I, imperative 2fs); 'then enter'
وَابْنَتُكِ: وَ + ابْنَة + ـكِ — wa-, and + ibna, daughter (f., nom., joined to the subject anti) + -ki, your (f.); 'and your daughter'
فَصَبَرَتْ: فَـ + صَبَرَتْ — fa-, so + ṣabarat (ṣabara, to wait patiently; verb I, perf. 3fs); 'and she waited'
وَأَدْخَلَتْهُ: وَ + أَدْخَلَتْ + هُ — wa-, and + adkhalat (adkhala, to bring in; verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'and she brought him in'
أَوْصَلَتْهُ: أَوْصَلَتْ + هُ — awṣalat (awṣala, to bring to, deliver; verb IV, perf. 3fs) + -hu, him; 'she brought him'
تُطِيلِى: تُطِيلِي — tuṭīlī (aṭāla, to make long, prolong; verb IV hollow, jussive 2fs after prohibitive lā); the edition ends it with ى; 'prolong'
الْقُعُودَ: الـ + قُعُود — al-, the + quʿūd, sitting, staying (verbal noun of qaʿada; m., acc.); 'the sitting, (your) stay'
بِوَلَدِهَا: بِـ + وَلَد + هَا — bi-, with (after dakhala, marking the one brought in) + walad, son (m., gen.) + -hā, her; 'with her son'
شَمْعَتَهُ: شَمْعَة + ـهُ — shamʿa, candle (f., acc.) + -hu, his; 'his candle'
وَانْقَطَعَتْ: وَ + انْقَطَعَتْ — wa-, and + inqaṭaʿat (inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off; verb VII, perf. 3fs, agreeing with the broken plural akhbār); 'and were cut off'
أَخْبَارُكَ: أَخْبَار + ـكَ — akhbār, news, tidings (pl. of khabar; nom.) + -ka, your (m.); 'news of you'
رَدَّنِي: رَدَّ + ـنِي — radda (to bring back; with ʿan, to turn back from; verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; the edition prints the shadda) + -nī, me; 'he brought me back; turned me back'
أُخَلِّصَكِ: أُخَلِّصَ + ـكِ — ukhalliṣa (khallaṣa, to free, rescue; verb II, subj. 1cs after an) + -ki, you (f.); 'that I may free you'
اعْتَرَانِي: اعْتَرَى + ـنِي — iʿtarā (to come upon, befall; verb VIII defective, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'came upon me'
جُنِنْتَ: جُنِنْتَ — juninta (janna, to be maddened, possessed; passive perf. 2ms, written unassimilated); with bi-, 'mad for'; 'you have gone mad'
لَذَّةُ: لَذَّة — ladhdha, pleasure, delight (f., nom., subject after mā); 'the sweetness'
لِلْمَجَانِيْنِ: لِـ + الـ + مَجَانِين — li-, for, belonging to (marks the possessor of the pleasure) + al-, the + majānīn, madmen (pl. of majnūn; gen.); 'for the mad'
اَلْعِشْقُ: الـ + عِشْق — al-ʿishq, passionate love (m., nom., topic of the sentence; the edition puts a fatḥa on the article's alif at the head of the line); 'love'
لَايَسْتَفِيقُ: لَا + يَسْتَفِيقُ — lā, not + yastafīqu (istafāqa, to recover, come to oneself; verb X hollow, imperf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'does not recover'
يَصْرَعُ: يَصْرَعُ — yaṣraʿu (ṣaraʿa, to fell, throw down; of madness or a fit; verb I, imperf. 3ms); 'fells'
الْمَجْنُوْنَ: الـ + مَجْنُون — al-majnūn, the madman, one possessed by the jinn (passive participle of janna; acc., object of yaṣraʿu); 'the madman'
الْحِيْنِ: الـ + حِين — al-ḥīn, time, a while (m., gen. after fī); fī al-ḥīn, 'at times, at a given time'
جُنِنْتُ: جُنِنْتُ — junintu (janna, to be maddened; passive perf. 1cs); with bi-, 'mad for'; 'I have gone mad'
فَهَاتُوْا: فَـ + هَاتُوا — fa-, then + hātū, bring! (defective imperative, m. pl.); 'so bring'
لَاتَلُوْمُوْنِي: لَا + تَلُومُوا + ـنِي — lā, do not (prohibitive) + talūmū (lāma, to blame; verb I hollow, jussive 2mp) + -nī, me; printed as one word; 'do not blame me'
قِصَّتِكِ: قِصَّة + ـكِ — qiṣṣa, story (f., gen. after ʿalā) + -ki, your (f.); 'your story'
خَلَاصُكِ: خَلَاص + ـكِ — khalāṣ, deliverance, release (m., nom., subject of yakūnu) + -ki, your (f.); 'your deliverance'
بِقِصَّتِكِ: بِـ + قِصَّة + كِ — bi-, of (prep., marking the news after akhbara, 'to inform of') + qiṣṣa, story (f., gen.) + -ki, your (f.); 'of your story'. The shadda is printed in the related قصّتي.
يُطْلِعَنِي: يُطْلِعَ + نِي — aṭlaʿa, to let (someone) see, acquaint (verb IV, subj. 3ms after an; with ʿalā, 'with, onto') + -nī, me; 'that He let me see'
الثُّلُثِ: الـ + ثُلُث — thuluth, a third (m., gen. after fī); 'the third (part)'
الْأَخِيرِ: الـ + أَخِير — akhīr, last (adj., m., gen.); 'the last'
أَمَرَةُ: أَمَرَ + ة — amara, to order (verb I, perf. 3ms; takes the thing ordered with bi-) + -hu, him, the pronoun spelled ة in the print; 'he ordered him'
رَاوَدَنِي: رَاوَدَ + نِي — rāwada, to try to talk (someone) into, press (verb III, perf. 3ms; with ʿan, 'about') + -nī, me; 'he pressed me'
خَطَبَنِى: خَطَبَ + نِى — khaṭaba, to ask (a woman) in marriage (verb I, perf. 3ms; the sg. verb before its plural subject al-mulūk) + -nī, me, spelled with ى; 'asked for my hand'
فَأَبَيْتُ: فَـ + أَبَيْتُ — fa-, and so + abā, to refuse (verb I, defective, perf. 1s); 'and I refused'
الظَّنُّ: الـ + ظَنّ — ẓann, thought, suspicion (m., nom.); 'the suspicion'
أُنَبِّهَهُ: أُنَبِّهَ + هُ — nabbaha, to wake, rouse (verb II, subj. 1s after an) + -hu, him; 'that I wake him'
إِعَانَتَةُ: إِعَانَة + ة — iʿāna, help, aid (f., verbal noun of aʿāna, verb IV; acc., as a second object of ʿamiltu) + -hu, him, spelled ة; 'helping him'. Doubtful: perhaps a misprint for اعانقه, uʿāniquhu, 'I embrace him'
أَخَذَةُ: أَخَذَ + ة — akhadha, to take (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -hu, it, the pronoun spelled ة in the print; 'he took it'
فَهٰذِةِ: فَـ + هٰذِهِ — fa-, so + hādhihi, this (f. demonstrative), spelled with ة in the print; 'so this'
وَأَنَايَا: وَ + أَنَا + يَا — wa-, and + anā, I (pron.) + yā, O (vocative particle), run together in the print; 'and I, O …'
عِشْقِي: عِشْق + ي — ʿishq, passionate love (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'my love'
وَالْبُكَاءِ: وَ + الـ + بُكَاء — wa-, and + bukāʾ, weeping (m., verbal noun of bakā, gen.); 'and the weeping'. The ء is printed.
وَإِنْشَادِ: وَ + إِنْشَاد — wa-, and + inshād, reciting (of verse) (m., verbal noun of anshada, verb IV; gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'and the reciting of'
أَفَاضَتِ: أَفَاضَ — afāḍa, to pour out, make overflow (verb IV, hollow, perf. 3fs; -i is the helping vowel before al-); 'she poured out'
اَبَعْدَ: اَ + بَعْدَ — a-, question prefix (printed as a fatḥa on bare alif) + baʿda, after (prep.); 'is it after …?'
الْحِبِّ: الـ + حِبّ — ḥibb, beloved (m., gen. after baʿda); 'the beloved'
لَذَّاتِي: لَذَّات + ي — ladhdhāt, pleasures (pl. of ladhdha, f., nom.) + -ī, my; 'my pleasures'
تَطِيبُ: طَابَ — ṭāba, to be sweet, pleasant (verb I, hollow, impf. 3fs, agreeing with ladhdhāt); 'are sweet'; also (Night 202): طَابَ — ṭāba, of the sick, to get well (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs, subject hiya); wa-hiya taṭību, 'and she will be well'
مَرْتَعُهُ: مَرْتَع + هُ — martaʿ, pasture, grazing ground (m., nom.) + -hu, its (the gazelle's); 'its pasture'
دَمُ: دَم — dam, blood (m., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the blood of'
اَهْوَنُ: اَهْوَن — ahwan, lighter, slighter (elative of hayyin, nom.; hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'the lightest (of)'
عَلَيْه: عَلَى + ه — ʿalā, upon + -h(i), him, printed without its vowel at the end of the hemistich; ahwanu mā ʿalayh, 'the lightest thing upon him', what he cares least about
مُهْجَةُ: مُهْجَة — muhja, heart's blood, life (f., nom., first term of an iḍāfa); 'the heart's blood of'
الْمُضْنَى: الـ + مُضْنَى — muḍnā, wasted, worn out (by love or sickness) (passive participle of aḍnā, verb IV; gen.); 'the wasted one'
تَذُوبُ: ذَابَ — dhāba, to melt (verb I, hollow, impf. 3fs, agreeing with muhja); 'melts'
وَفِكْرِي: وَ + فِكْر + ي — wa-, and + fikr, thought (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'and my thought'
بَعْضِي: بَعْض + ي — baʿḍ, part (m., gen.) + -ī, my; 'part of me'
رَقِيبُ: رَقِيب — raqīb, watcher, guardian (m., nom.; the rhyme drops the tanwīn); 'a watcher'
وَاَجْفَانٍ: وَ + اَجْفَان — wa-, the wāw of rubba, 'and many a' (with the gen.) + ajfān, eyelids (pl. of jafn, gen.; hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'and many an eyelid'
سِهَامًا: سِهَام — sihām, arrows (pl. of sahm, acc. indef., object of tarmī); 'arrows'
فَوَاتِكَ: فَوَاتِك — fawātik, deadly, murderous (pl. of fātik; diptote, acc., agreeing with sihāman); 'deadly ones'
تُصِيبُ: أَصَابَ — aṣāba, to hit (the mark), strike (verb IV, hollow, impf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural fawātik); 'they hit'
اَرَاةُ: اَرَى + ة — raʾā, to see (verb I, impf. 1s arā, subj. after an; hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif) + -hu, him, the pronoun spelled ة; 'that I see him'
قُبَيْلَ: قُبَيْلَ — qubayla, a little before (diminutive of qabla, prep.); 'just before'
نَصِيبُ: نَصِيب — naṣīb, share, portion, lot (m., nom.; the rhyme drops the tanwīn); 'a portion'
وَاَكْتُمُ: وَ + اَكْتُمُ — wa-, and + katama, to hide, keep secret (verb I, impf. 1s; hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'and I hide'
فَيَنِمُّ: فَـ + يَنِمُّ — fa-, but then + namma, to tell tales, betray (verb I, doubled, impf. 3ms; with bi-, 'to betray, tell of'); 'but (my tears) betray'
وَيَعْلَمُهُ: وَ + يَعْلَمُ + هُ — wa-, and + ʿalima, to know (verb I, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'and (the watcher) knows it'
الرَّقِيبُ: الـ + رَقِيب — raqīb, watcher, the spy who guards the beloved (m., nom.); 'the watcher'
وَصْلُهُ: وَصْل + هُ — waṣl, union (with the beloved) (m., nom.) + -hu, his; 'union with him'
لِمَرْزَوَانَ: لِـ + مَرْزَوَان — li-, to (prep., marking the one addressed) + Marzawān (diptote, gen. in -a); 'to Marzawān'; also after daʿā, li- marks the one prayed for: yadʿū li-Marzawāna, 'praying for Marzawān' (Night 198)
أَعْيَتْ: أَعْيَا — aʿyā, to tire out, baffle (verb IV, defective, perf. 3fs, agreeing with ḥikāya); 'has baffled'
دَوَائِكِ: دَوَاء + كِ — dawāʾ, remedy, cure (m., gen. after ʿalā) + -ki, your (f.); 'your remedy'. The ئ is printed.
يَجْعَلُهُ: يَجْعَلُ + هُ — jaʿala, to make, cause (verb I, impf. 3ms) + -hu, it; 'makes it'
اصْبِرِى: اصْبِرِى — ṣabara, to be patient (verb I, imperative 2fs), the ending written ى in the print; 'be patient'
وَلَاتَجْزَعِى: وَ + لَا + تَجْزَعِى — wa-, and + lā, do not (prohibition) + jaziʿa, to grieve, despair (verb I, juss. 2fs; ending written ى), run together in the print; 'and do not despair'
وَدَّعَهَا: وَدَّعَ + هَا — waddaʿa, to bid farewell (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -hā, her; 'he bade her farewell'. The shadda is printed.
بِالثَّبَاتِ: بِـ + الـ + ثَبَات — bi-, for (prep., marking what is prayed for after daʿā li- … bi-) + thabāt, steadfastness, firmness (m., gen.); 'for steadfastness'
وَيَخْطُو: وَ + يَخْطُو — wa-, and + khaṭā, to step, stride (verb I, defective, impf. 3ms); 'and (your phantom) steps'
خُطَى: خُطًى — khuṭā, steps, strides (pl. of khuṭwa; acc. of manner, 'with the steps of'); 'the steps of'
مَزُورِ: مَزُور — mazūr, visited (passive participle of zāra, 'to visit'; gen., the rhyme drops the tanwīn); 'of one visited'
وَتُدْنِيكَ: وَ + تُدْنِي + كَ — wa-, and + adnā, to bring near (verb IV, defective, impf. 3fs, agreeing with al-amānī) + -ka, you; 'and (hopes) bring you near'
الْاَمَانِي: الـ + اَمَانِي — amānī, hopes, wishes (pl. of umniyya, nom.; hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'the hopes'
الْبَصِيرِ: الـ + بَصِير — baṣīr, seeing, sharp-sighted (adj., m., gen.); 'the seeing (eye, one)'
تَبْعُدْ: بَعُدَ — baʿuda, to be far, go far (verb I, juss. 2ms after lā of prohibition); 'do not go far'; also the old wish over the dead, 'may you not perish'
لِاَنَّكَ: لِـ + اَنَّ + كَ — li-, because of (prep.) + anna, that (hamza printed as a fatḥa on bare alif) + -ka, you; 'because you'
تَكْمُلْ: كَمُلَ — kamula, to be complete, full (verb I, juss. 3fs after lam, agreeing with ʿayn, eye); 'it is not filled'
تَمَشَّي: تَمَشَّى — tamashshā, to walk, make one's way (verb V, defective, perf. 3ms), the final alif maqṣūra written with dotted ي in the print; 'he walked'
الطَّيْرَبُ: الـ + طَيْرَب — al-Ṭayrab, name of a city (nom., after yuqālu lahā, 'which is called'); the print does not point it, and the vowels are a guess
يَسْتَنْشِقُ: اسْتَنْشَقَ — istanshaqa, to sniff, breathe in (verb X, impf. 3ms); with al-akhbār, 'to nose out the news'
دَوَاءَ: دَوَاء — dawāʾ, remedy, cure (m., acc., object of yajidu, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the remedy of'. The ء is printed.
الطَّيْرَبِ: الـ + طَيْرَب — al-Ṭayrab, name of a city (gen., after madīnat); the vowels are a guess
اعْتَرَاةُ: اعْتَرَى + ة — iʿtarā, to come upon, befall (verb VIII, defective, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him, the pronoun spelled ة in the print; 'came upon him'
وَسْوَاسٌ: وَسْوَاس — waswās, whispering (of the devil), obsession, melancholy fancy (m., nom. indef.); 'obsession'
وَجُنُونٌ: وَ + جُنُون — wa-, and + junūn, madness (m., nom. indef.); 'and madness'
خَالِدَانَ: خَالِدَان — Khālidān, name of King Shahramān's islands (diptote, gen. in -a, second term of an iḍāfa); 'of Khālidān'
الْبَرِّفَسِتَّةُ: الـ + بَرّ + فَـ + سِتَّة — al-barr, the land (m., gen. after fī) + fa-, then (answering ammā) + sitta, six (nom.; with the gen. pl. ashhur), run together in the print; 'the land, then six'
مُتَوَجِّهَةً: مُتَوَجِّهَة — mutawajjiha, heading, bound (active participle of tawajjaha, verb V, f. acc., predicate of kānat; with ilā, 'for'); 'heading (for)'
فَأَشْرَفُوا: فَـ + أَشْرَفُوا — fa-, and so + ashrafa, to look down on, come in sight of (verb IV, perf. 3mp; with ʿalā); 'and they came in sight of'
عَاصِفٍ: عَاصِف — ʿāṣif, violent, stormy (of wind; adj., gen. indef., used for both genders); 'storming'
الصَّوَارِيَ: الـ + صَوَارِي — ṣawārī, masts (pl. of ṣārī, acc., object of ramā); 'the masts'
وَمَزَّقَ: وَ + مَزَّقَ — wa-, and + mazzaqa, to tear to pieces (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and tore'
الْقُلُوعُ: الـ + قُلُوع — qulūʿ, sails (pl. of qilʿ, nom.); 'the sails'
الْمَوْجَ: الـ + مَوْج — mawj, waves (m., collective, acc. as the subject of inna); 'the waves'
قَذَفَهُ: قَذَفَ + ـهُ — qadhafa, to throw, cast, hurl (verb I, perf. 3ms) + 3ms obj.; 'it threw him'
الْمُقَدَّرِكَانَ: الـ + مُقَدَّر + كَانَ — muqaddar, decreed, foreordained (pass. part. II of قدر; m., gen., agreeing with al-amr) + kāna, to be (verb I hollow, perf. 3ms), taking up the sentence's opening kāna; printed as one word; 'the decreed (one): was'
لِلْخِدْمَةِ: لِـ + الـ + خِدْمَة — li-, for (prep. of purpose) + khidma, service, attendance on a ruler (f., gen.); 'for service, to attend (him)'
وَخَادِمٌ: وَ + خَادِم — wa-, and + khādim, servant (act. part. I of خدم; m., nom. indef., subject of a verbless clause); 'and a servant'
يَنُشُّ: يَنُشُّ — nashsha, to whisk away, drive off (flies) (verb I doubled, impf. 3ms; with ʿalā, over the one fanned); 'whisking (the flies) off'; the shadda is printed
وَلَاشَرِبَ: وَ + لَا + شَرِبَ — wa-, and + lā, not (carrying on a denial made with mā) + shariba, to drink (verb I, perf. 3ms); printed as one word; 'nor drank'
أَنْحَفَ: أَنْحَف — anḥaf, thinner (elative of naḥīf, thin; acc. as predicate of ṣāra; diptote); with min, 'thinner than'
الْمِغْزَلِ: الـ + مِغْزَل — mighzal, spindle (m., gen. after min); 'the spindle', a byword for thinness
التَّيَّارِ: الـ + تَيَّار — tayyār, current, rushing stream of the sea (m., gen. after min, of cause); 'the current'; the shadda on the yāʾ is printed
أَسْتَأْذِنُكَ: أَسْتَأْذِنُ + ـكَ — istaʾdhana, to ask permission of (verb X of أذن, impf. 1cs; with fī, the thing asked) + 2ms obj.; 'I ask your leave'; the medial hamza with its sukūn is printed
سَاحَةِ: سَاحَة — sāḥa, open court, courtyard (f., gen. after ilā, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the courtyard of'
وَأَفْتَحَ: وَ + أَفْتَحَ — wa-, and + fataḥa, to open (verb I, impf. 1cs subj., still governed by an); 'and (that I) open'
نْقُلَ: نْقُلَ — the rest of anqula, naqala, to carry, convey, bring (verb I, impf. 1cs subj.), whose first syllable a- the print writes with the preceding لا as a separate word; with لِأَ, li-anqula, 'so that I may bring (in)'
وَأُطْلِعَهُ: وَ + أُطْلِعَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + aṭlaʿa, to bring up, make come up (verb IV of طلع, impf. 1cs subj., after li- of purpose) + 3ms obj.; 'and (that I may) bring him up'
يُخَلِّصُ: يُخَلِّصُ — khallaṣa, to free, deliver, rescue (verb II of خلص, impf. 3ms; with min, from what); 'he will deliver'
وَبِسَبَبِكَ: وَ + بِـ + سَبَب + ـكَ — wa-, and + bi-, by (prep. of cause) + sabab, cause (m., gen.) + 2ms; 'and because of you'
أَطْلَعْتَ: أَطْلَعْتَ — aṭlaʿa, to bring up (verb IV of طلع, perf. 2ms, after idhā with future sense); 'you bring up'
الْغَرِيقَ: الـ + غَرِيق — gharīq, one drowning, one drowned (m., acc. as object); 'the drowning man'
يَطَّلَّعُ: يَطَّلَّعُ — taṭallaʿa, to look into, pry into (verb V of طلع, impf. 3ms, the t of the form merged into the ṭ, as in iṭṭahhara for taṭahhara; with ʿalā, what is looked into); 'he will pry'; the shadda on the lām is printed
أَحْوَالِنَا: أَحْوَال + ـنَا — aḥwāl, states, affairs, circumstances (pl. of ḥāl; gen. after ʿalā) + 1pl suffix; 'our affairs'
فَيَشْمَتُ: فَـ + يَشْمَتُ — fa-, and so + shamita, to gloat, rejoice at another's misfortune (verb I, impf. 3ms; with bi-, the one gloated over); 'and he will gloat'
الْغَرِيقُ: الـ + غَرِيق — gharīq, one drowning, one drowned (m., nom. as subject); 'the drowning man'
بِأَسْرَارِنَا: بِـ + أَسْرَار + ـنَا — bi-, of, about (after taḥaddatha, 'to talk', bi- marks what is talked of) + asrār, secrets (pl. of sirr; gen.) + 1pl suffix; 'of our secrets'
لَأَضْرِبَنَّ: لَـ + أَضْرِبَنَّ — la-, the oath's lām ('surely') + ḍaraba, to strike (verb I, impf. 1cs with the energetic -anna); 'I will surely strike'; the shadda is printed
النَّافِذَ: الـ + نَافِذ — nāfidh, leading through, giving onto (act. part. I of نفذ; m., acc., agreeing with bāb; with ilā, where it leads); 'that leads through'
الْمَمْشَاةِ: الـ + مَمْشَاة — mamshāt (al-mamshāti), the print's spelling of mamshā, walk, passage (noun of place of مشى; gen. after fī) with a final ة; 'the passage'
خُطْوَةً: خُطْوَة — khuṭwa, step, pace (f., acc. sg. indef. after the numeral ʿishrūn); 'paces'
امْتَلأَ: امْتَلأَ — imtalaʾa, to be filled, become full (verb VIII of ملأ, perf. 3ms; with an acc. of what fills); 'was filled'; the hamza is printed
وَعَمَّمَهُ: وَ + عَمَّمَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ʿammama, to put a turban on (someone) (verb II of عمّ, perf. 3ms; with bi-, the turban put on) + 3ms obj.; 'and he turbaned him'; the shadda is printed
بِعِمَامَةٍ: بِـ + عِمَامَة — bi-, with (after ʿammama, bi- marks the turban put on) + ʿimāma, turban (f., gen. indef.); 'with a turban'
عَمَائِمِ: عَمَائِم — ʿamāʾim, turbans (pl. of ʿimāma; gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the turbans of'; the ئ is printed
لِنَجَاتِكَ: لِـ + نَجَاة + ـكَ — li-, of, for (after sabab, li- marks what is caused) + najāh, rescue, escape (f., gen.) + 2ms; 'of your rescue'
لِمَوْتِي: لِـ + مَوْت + ـي — li-, of, for (after sabab, li- marks what is caused) + mawt, death (m., gen.) + 1cs; 'of my death'
وَمَوْتِكَ: وَ + مَوْت + ـكَ — wa-, and + mawt, death (m., gen., still after li-) + 2ms; 'and your death'
لِأَنَّكَ: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـكَ — li-, because of (prep., here giving the reason) + anna, that + 2ms; 'because you'
وَتَشُقُّ: وَ + شَقَّ — wa-, and + shaqqa, to split, cleave (verb I doubled, imperf. 2ms indic.); with bayna, 'to make one's way through'; 'and you will pass through'
وَوُزَرَاءَ: وَ + وُزَرَاء — wa-, and + wuzarāʾ, viziers (broken pl. of wazīr; diptote, gen. with -a after bayna); 'and viziers'
سَاكِتُونَ: سَاكِت — sākit, silent (act. part. of sakata; m. sound pl., nom.); 'silent'
لَايَتَكَلَّمُونَ: لَا + يَتَكَلَّمُونَ — lā, not + takallama, to speak (verb V, imperf. 3mp indic.), the print joining the two as one word; 'not speaking'
تَجَاهَلَ: تَجَاهَلَ — tajāhala, to feign ignorance (verb VI of jahila, perf. 3ms); 'he pretended not to know'
وَيَئِسْنَا: وَ + يَئِسَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + yaʾisa, to despair (verb I; with min, 'of'; perf. 1cp; the hamza is printed); 'and we have despaired'
حَيٰوتِهِ: حَيٰوة + ـهِ — ḥayāh, life (f., gen.; printed with dagger alif and wāw, the old spelling of حياة) + 3ms; 'his life'
وَأَيْقَنَّا: وَ + أَيْقَنَ + ـنَا — wa-, and + ayqana, to be certain (verb IV; the verb chooses bi-, 'certain of'; perf. 1cp; the shadda is printed); 'and we are certain'
بِوَفَاتِهِ: بِـ + وَفَاة + ـهِ — bi-, of (ayqana bi- 'be certain of': the verb chooses bi-) + wafāh, death, passing (f., gen.) + 3ms; 'of his passing'
تُطِيلَ: أَطَالَ — aṭāla, to lengthen, prolong (verb IV hollow, imperf. 2ms subj. after an); 'that you prolong'
تَحُطُّ: حَطَّ — ḥaṭṭa, to set down, put down (verb I doubled, imperf. 2ms indic.; the shadda is printed); 'you set down'
وَإِلَّافَتَرُوحُ: وَ + إِنْ + لَا + فَـ + تَرُوحُ — wa-, and + in, if + lā, not (illā, 'if not') + fa-, then + rāḥa, to go (verb I hollow, imperf. 3fs indic., agreeing with rūḥ), the print setting all as one word; 'and otherwise, (then) goes'
صَبِيَّةً: صَبِيَّة — ṣabiyya, girl, young woman (f., acc. indef., object of raʾā; the shadda is printed); 'a girl'
بَارِعَةَ: بَارِعَة — bāriʿa, surpassing, excelling (act. part. of baraʿa, f., acc., in construct with al-jamāl); 'surpassing in'
بَاطِنَ: بَاطِن — bāṭin, inside, hidden truth (m., acc., object, first term of an iḍāfa); 'the inner truth of'
فَبِاللّٰهِ: فَـ + بِـ + اللّٰه — fa-, so + bi-, by (bi- of the oath) + Allāh, God (gen.); 'so, by God'
رِجْلَيْ: رِجْلَيْ — rijlay, two feet (dual of rijl, f.; gen. after taḥta, in construct, the dual nūn dropped); 'the feet of'
دَأْبٌ: دَأْب — daʾb, habit, constant business (m., nom. indef., subject of yakun; the hamza is printed); 'concern'
وَيَغْمِزُهُ: وَ + غَمَزَ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ghamaza, to wink at, signal to with the eye (verb I, imperf. 3ms indic.) + 3ms object; 'and signalling to him'
لِيَرُوحَ: لِـ + يَرُوحَ — li-, so that (li- of purpose, with the subjunctive) + rāḥa, to go (verb I hollow, imperf. 3ms subj.); 'that he should go'
وَمَرْزَوَانُ: وَ + مَرْزَوَان — wa-, and, while + Marzawān (proper name, nom., subject of a circumstantial clause); 'while Marzawān' Also simply 'and Marzawān', the second of two subjects: kharaja Qamaru al-Zamāni wa-Marzawānu, 'Qamar al-Zamān and Marzawān went out'.
وَخَدَّهُ: وَ + خَدّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + khadd, cheek (m., acc., coordinated with the first object of jaʿala) + -hu, his; 'and his cheek'
كَخَدِّهَا: كَـ + خَدّ + ـهَا — ka-, like (prep. of comparison; its noun is gen.) + khadd, cheek (m.) + -hā, her; 'like her cheek'
وَلَوْنَهُ: وَ + لَوْن + ـهُ — wa-, and + lawn, colour, complexion (m., acc., coordinated with the first object of jaʿala) + -hu, his; 'and his colouring'
كَلَوْنِهَا: كَـ + لَوْن + ـهَا — ka-, like (prep. of comparison; its noun is gen.) + lawn, colour, complexion (m.) + -hā, her; 'like her colouring'
وَصَغَى: وَ + صَغَى — wa-, and + ṣaghā, to incline, give ear (verb I, perf. 3ms; with ilā, 'to listen to'; the print spells it with ى); 'and he gave ear'
بِأُذُنَيْهِ: بِـ + أُذُن (dual) + ـهِ — bi-, with (prep. of the means: he listened with his ears) + udhun, ear (f.; dual udhunayn, gen., the nūn dropped before the suffix) + -hi, his; 'with his two ears' (hamza supplied; the print has bare alif)
صَاغِيًا: صَاغٍ — ṣāghin, listening, giving ear (act. part. of ṣaghā, m., acc. indef., clause of state after raʾāhu); 'listening'
يُلْقِيهِ: يُلْقِي + ـهِ — yulqī, he casts, utters (alqā, verb IV, imperf. 3ms) + -hi, it (resumptive, referring back to mā, 'what'); 'what he was uttering'
طَرُوْبًا: طَرُوب — ṭarūb, much moved by emotion, joy or grief (intensive adj., m., acc. indef., second object of arāka; the print sets a sukūn on the long ū); 'moved'
ذَاشَجِي: ذَا + شَجِي — dhā, possessor of (acc. of dhū, in construct) + shajī, as printed the adj. 'grieved, sorrowful', read here for the noun shajā, grief (gen.; printed with kasra and yā); the print runs the two words together; 'full of grief'
وَتَرَنُّمٍ: وَ + تَرَنُّم — wa-, and + tarannum, singing, chanting (verbal noun of Form V, m., gen. indef., coordinated with shajī after dhā); 'and of singing'
تَمِيْلُ: تَمِيلُ — tamīlu, you incline (māla, verb I hollow, imperf. 2ms, with ilā, 'to'; the print sets a sukūn on the long ī); 'inclining'
المَحَاسِنِ: الـ + مَحَاسِن — al-, the + maḥāsin, beauties, charms (broken pl. of ḥusn, gen. after dhikr); 'the charms'
بِالْفَمِ: بِـ + الـ + فَم — bi-, with (prep. of the means) + al-, the + fam, mouth (m., gen.); 'with the mouth'
اَصَابَكَ: أَصَابَ + ـكَ — aṣāba, to strike, befall (verb IV hollow, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'has (it) struck you' (the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif)
رُمِيْْتَ: رُمِيتَ — rumīta, you were shot (ramā, to throw, shoot, verb I defective, perf. passive 2ms; the print sets two sukūns on the yā); 'you have been shot'
بِاَسْهُمٍ: بِـ + أَسْهُم — bi-, with (prep. of the instrument) + ashum, arrows (broken pl. of sahm, m., gen. indef.; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'with arrows'
سَجِيَّةُ: سَجِيَّة — sajiyya, nature, natural disposition, way (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'the way of'
رُمِي: رُمِيَ — rumiya, he was shot (ramā, verb I defective, perf. passive 3ms), cut to rumī at the rhyme; 'who has been shot'
فَاسْقِنِي: فَـ + اسْقِ + ـنِي — fa-, so, then + isqi, pour for, give to drink (saqā, verb I defective, imper. 2ms, final vowel dropped) + -nī, me; 'so pour me'
كَاسَاتِ: كَاسَات — kāsāt, cups (f. sound pl. of kaʾs, cup, spelled without its hamza; acc., object of isqinī, first term of a construct); 'cups of'
وَغَنِّ: وَ + غَنِّ — wa-, and + ghanni, sing! (ghannā, verb II defective, imper. 2ms, final vowel dropped; with bi-, 'sing of'); 'and sing'
سُلَيْمَى: سُلَيْمَى — Sulaymā, a woman's name, a stock beloved of old Arabic love poetry (indeclinable in -ā, gen. after dhikr); 'Sulaymā'
وَالرَّبَابِ: وَ + الـ + رَبَاب — wa-, and + al-Rabāb, a woman's name, another stock beloved of the poets (f., gen., coordinated with Sulaymā); 'and al-Rabāb'
وَتَنْعَمِ: وَ + تَنْعَمُ — wa-, and + tanʿam, you live in ease, take delight (naʿima, verb I, imperf. 2ms; kasra given for the rhyme); 'and take delight'
وَشَمْسَةَ: وَ + شَمْسَة — wa-, and + shamsa, a sun (f., acc., coordinated with kāsāti after isqinī; here the wine pictured as a sun); 'and a sun of'
كَرْمٍ: كَرْم — karm, vine, vineyard (m., gen. indef., second term of a construct); 'of the vine'
بُرْجُهَا: بُرْج + ـهَا — burj, zodiacal sign, the house a star dwells in; also tower (m., nom.) + -hā, its (the wine-sun's); 'its mansion in the sky'
قَاعُ: قَاع — qāʿ, bottom, floor (m., nom., predicate, first term of a construct); 'the bottom of'
دَنِّهَا: دَنّ + ـهَا — dann, wine-jar, large earthen jar (m., gen.) + -hā, its; 'its jar'
وَمَشْرِقُهَا: وَ + مَشْرِق + ـهَا — wa-, and + mashriq, place of rising, east (m., nom.) + -hā, its; 'and its rising-place'
السَّاقِي: الـ + سَاقِي — al-, the + sāqī, cupbearer (act. part. of saqā, m., nom., predicate); 'the cupbearer'
وَمَغْرِبُهَا: وَ + مَغْرِب + ـهَا — wa-, and + maghrib, place of setting, west (m., nom.) + -hā, its; 'and its setting-place'
اَعْطَافِهَا: أَعْطَاف + ـهَا — aʿṭāf, sides, flanks, the swaying figure (broken pl. of ʿiṭf, m., gen. after ʿalā; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif) + -hā, her; 'her slender sides'
لَبِسَتْهَا: لَبِسَتْ + ـهَا — labisat, she put on, wore (labisa, verb I, perf. 3fs) + -hā, them (the clothes); 'she puts them on'
جِسْمٍ: جِسْم — jism, body (m., gen. indef. after fawqa); 'a body'
مُنَعَّمِ: مُنَعَّم — munaʿʿam, delicately reared, tender (pass. part. of Form II naʿʿama, m., gen. indef., adj. of jism; kasra at the rhyme); 'tender'
وَاَحْسُدُ: وَ + أَحْسُدُ — wa-, and + aḥsudu, I envy (ḥasada, verb I, imperf. 1cs; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'and I envy'
كَاسَاتٍ: كَاسَات — kāsāt, cups (f. sound pl. of kaʾs, spelled without its hamza; acc. indef., object of aḥsudu); 'cups'
تُقَبِّلُ: تُقَبِّلُ — tuqabbilu, it kisses (qabbala, verb II, imperf. 3fs, agreeing with the plural kāsāt); 'that kiss'
ثَغْرَهَا: ثَغْر + ـهَا — thaghr, front teeth, and so the mouth (m., acc.) + -hā, her; 'her mouth, her lips'
اللَّثْمِ: الـ + لَثْم — al-, the + lathm, kissing (verbal noun of lathama, m., gen., second term of a construct); 'of kissing'
الفَمِ: الـ + فَم — al-, the + fam, mouth (m., gen. after fī); 'the mouth'
تَحْسَبُوْا: تَحْسَبُوا — taḥsabū, you (pl.) reckon, think (ḥasiba, verb I, imperf. 2mp jussive after lā of prohibition; the print sets a sukūn on the long ū); 'do not think'
قُتِلْتُ: قُتِلْتُ — qutiltu, I was killed (qatala, verb I, perf. passive 1cs); 'I was slain'
لِحَاظُ: لِحَاظ — liḥāẓ, glances, side-glances (pl. of laḥẓ; nom. without tanwīn in the print, where lākinna would want liḥāẓan); 'glances'
بِاَسْهُمِ: بِـ + أَسْهُم — bi-, with (prep. of the instrument) + ashum, arrows (broken pl. of sahm, m., gen.; no tanwīn, at the rhyme; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'with arrows'
تَلَاقَيْنَا: تَلَاقَيْنَا — talāqaynā, we met one another (talāqā, verb VI defective, perf. 1cp; Form VI of mutual action); 'we met'
بَنَانَهَا: بَنَان + ـهَا — banān, fingertips (collective, treated as f.; acc., object of wajadtu) + -hā, her; 'her fingertips'
مُخَضَّبَةً: مُخَضَّبَة — mukhaḍḍaba, dyed, stained (with henna) (pass. part. of Form II khaḍḍaba, f., acc. indef.; second object of wajadtu, or clause of state); 'dyed'
عُصَارَةَ: عُصَارَة — ʿuṣāra, pressed juice, what is squeezed out (f., acc., object of taḥkī, first term of a construct); 'the pressed juice of'
عَنْدَمِ: عَنْدَم — ʿandam, a red dye, said to be dragon's blood (a resin) or brazil-wood (m., gen.; kasra at the rhyme); 'ʿandam'
خَضَبْتِ: خَضَبْتِ — khaḍabti, you (f.) dyed (khaḍaba, verb I, perf. 2fs); 'you dyed'
الكَفَّ: الـ + كَفّ — al-, the + kaff, palm, hand (f., acc., object of khaḍabti); 'the hand'
المُسْتَهَامِ: الـ + مُسْتَهَام — al-, the + mustahām, love-crazed, driven to distraction by love (pass. part. of Form X istahāma, m., gen., second term of a construct); 'the lovesick'
المُتَيَّمِ: الـ + مُتَيَّم — al-, the + mutayyam, enthralled, enslaved by love (pass. part. of Form II tayyama, m., gen., in apposition; kasra at the rhyme); 'the enthralled'
وَاَلْقَتْ: وَ + أَلْقَتْ — wa-, and + alqat, she cast, threw (alqā, verb IV defective, perf. 3fs; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'and she cast'
لَاعِجَ: لَاعِج — lāʿij, burning, a burning pang (act. part. of laʿaja, m., acc., object of alqat, first term of a construct); 'the burning of'
لِلْحُبِّ: لِـ + الـ + حُبّ — li-, as to, about (prep. marking the matter kept secret, after lam yatakattam) + al-, the + ḥubb, love (m., gen.); 'about love'
يَتَكَتَّمِ: يَتَكَتَّمْ — yatakattam, he keeps (a thing) secret, is close (takattama, verb V, jussive 3ms after lam; kasra at the rhyme); 'did not keep secret'
خِضَابُ: خِضَاب — khiḍāb, dye, henna (m., nom., printed without tanwīn after mā, 'not'); 'dye'
خَضَبْتُهُ: خَضَبْتُ + ـهُ — khaḍabtu, I dyed (khaḍaba, verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it (resumptive, referring back to khiḍāb); 'that I dyed'
تَكُ: تَكُ — taku, be (kāna, shortened jussive 2ms, after lā of prohibition: lā taku, 'do not be'); 'be'
بِالْبُهْتَانِ: بِـ + الـ + بُهْتَان — bi-, of (prep. marking the charge: the verb of accusing, ittahama, takes bi- for what one is accused of) + al-, the + buhtān, calumny, slanderous lie (m., gen.); 'of calumny'
وَالزُّوْرِ: وَ + الـ + زُور — wa-, and + al-, the + zūr, falsehood (m., gen., coordinated with al-buhtān; the print sets a sukūn on the long ū); 'and falsehood'
مُتَّهِمِي: مُتَّهِم + ـِي — muttahim, accuser, one who accuses (act. part. of Form VIII ittahama, m., acc., predicate of lā taku) + -ī, me; 'accusing me'
زَنْدِي: زَنْد + ـِي — zand, forearm, the bone of the forearm (m., acc., predicate of kunta) + -ī, my; 'my arm'
وَكَفِّي: وَ + كَفّ + ـِي — wa-, and + kaff, palm, hand (f., acc.) + -ī, my; 'and my hand'
وَمِعْصَمِي: وَ + مِعْصَم + ـِي — wa-, and + miʿṣam, wrist (m., acc.) + -ī, my; 'and my wrist'
فَمَسَحْتُهُ: فَـ + مَسَحْتُ + ـهُ — fa-, and so + masaḥtu, I wiped (masaḥa, verb I, perf. 1cs) + -hu, it (the blood); 'and I wiped it'
بِكَفِّى: بِـ + كَفّ + ـِي — bi-, with (prep. of the instrument) + kaff, palm, hand (f., gen.) + -ī, my (the print writes the yā as ى); 'with my hand'
فَاحْمَرَّتْ: فَـ + احْمَرَّتْ — fa-, and so + iḥmarrat, it became red (iḥmarra, verb IX of colours, perf. 3fs, agreeing with banān); 'and turned red'
بَنَانِي: بَنَان + ـِي — banān, fingertips (collective, f.; nom., subject of iḥmarrat) + -ī, my; 'my fingertips'
مَبْكَاهَا: مَبْكَى + ـهَا — mabkā, weeping (verbal noun of bakā, m., gen. after qabla) + -hā, her; 'her weeping'
التَّنَدُّمِ: الـ + تَنَدُّم — al-, the + tanaddum, regret, repenting (verbal noun of Form V tanaddama, m., gen. after qabla); 'regret'
فَهَيَّجَنِي: فَـ + هَيَّجَ + ـنِي — fa-, and so + hayyaja, to stir up, rouse (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -nī, me; 'and (it) stirred me'
لِلْمُتَقَدِّمِ: لِـ + الـ + مُتَقَدِّم — li-, to, belonging to (prep. marking the one to whom the merit belongs) + al-, the + mutaqaddim, the one who goes first, precedes (act. part. of Form V taqaddama, m., gen.); 'to the one who went first'
تَعْذِلُونِي: تَعْذِلُوا + ـنِي — taʿdhilū, you (pl.) blame (ʿadhala, verb I, jussive 2mp after lā of prohibition) + -nī, me (with the nūn of protection); 'do not blame me'
لِاَنَّنِي: لِـ + أَنَّ + ـنِي — li-, because of (prep. of cause: li-anna, 'because') + anna, that + -nī, I (with the nūn of protection); 'because I' (the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif)
التَّأَلُّمِ: الـ + تَأَلُّم — al-, the + taʾallum, suffering, feeling pain (verbal noun of Form V taʾallama, m., gen., second term of a construct after kathīr); 'of suffering' (hamza printed)
زَيَّنَ: زَيَّنَ — zayyana, to adorn (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'adorned'
مِثْلٌ: مِثْل — mithl, a like, an equal (m., nom. indef., noun of laysa); 'an equal'
بِعُرْبٍ: بِـ + عُرْب — bi-, among (prep., locative) + ʿurb, Arabs (collective, gen. indef.); 'among Arabs'
وَاعْجَمِ: وَ + أَعْجَم — wa-, and + aʿjam, non-Arab, foreigner (m., gen.; a diptote given kasra at the rhyme; the print leaves its alif unmarked); 'and non-Arabs'
لُقْمَانٍ: لُقْمَان — Luqmān, the sage of the Qurʾān, byword for wisdom (proper name, gen.; given tanwīn in verse); 'of Luqmān'
وَصُورَةُ: وَ + صُورَة — wa-, and + ṣūra, form, face, beauty of form (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the form of'
وَنَغْمَةُ: وَ + نَغْمَة — wa-, and + naghma, tone, melody, voice in song (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the voice of'
دَاوُدٍ: دَاوُد — Dāwūd, David, byword for his voice in singing the Psalms (proper name, gen.; given tanwīn in verse); 'of David'
وَعِفَّةُ: وَ + عِفَّة — wa-, and + ʿiffa, chastity, continence (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the chastity of'
مَرْيَمِ: مَرْيَم — Maryam, Mary (proper name, diptote, gen.; kasra at the rhyme); 'of Mary'
حُزْنُ: حُزْن — ḥuzn, grief (m., nom., first term of a construct); 'the grief of'
يَعْقُوبٍ: يَعْقُوب — Yaʿqūb, Jacob, byword for grief at the loss of Joseph (proper name, gen.; given tanwīn in verse); 'of Jacob'
وَحَسْرَةُ: وَ + حَسْرَة — wa-, and + ḥasra, anguish, bitter regret (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the anguish of'
يُونُسٍ: يُونُس — Yūnus, Jonah (proper name, gen.; given tanwīn in verse); 'of Jonah'
وَبَلْوَةُ: وَ + بَلْوَة — wa-, and + balwa, trial, affliction (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the affliction of'
اَيُّوبٍ: أَيُّوب — Ayyūb, Job, byword for patience under affliction (proper name, gen.; given tanwīn in verse; the print writes the hamza as a fatḥa on bare alif); 'of Job'
وَقِصَّةُ: وَ + قِصَّة — wa-, and + qiṣṣa, story, case, fate (f., nom., first term of a construct); 'and the story of'
آدَمِ: آدَم — Ādam, Adam (proper name, diptote, gen.; kasra at the rhyme; madda printed); 'of Adam'
تَقْتُلُوهَا: تَقْتُلُوا + ـهَا — taqtulū, you (pl.) kill (qatala, verb I, jussive 2mp after lā of prohibition) + -hā, her; 'do not kill her'
فَاسْأَلُوهَا: فَـ + اسْأَلُوا + ـهَا — fa-, so, rather + isʾalū, ask! (saʾala, verb I, imper. 2mp) + -hā, her; 'ask her' (hamza printed)
قَمَرِالزَّمَانِ: قَمَر + الـ + زَمَان — Qamar al-Zamān, 'Moon of the Age', the prince's name (gen., second term of a construct after qalb), which the print here sets as one word; 'of Qamar al-Zamān'
وَيَجْلِسُ: وَ + يَجْلِسُ — wa-, and + yajlisu, he sits (jalasa, verb I, imperf. 3ms; indicative where Classical Arabic would want the jussive after an imperative); 'and sit'
يَرْمِىَ: رَمَى — ramā, to throw, cast (verb I, defective, imperf. 3ms, subj. after an; the print spells it with ى); ramā raqabatahu, 'to strike off his head'
مَابِهِ: مَا + بِـ + ـهِ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + bi-, in (prep., marking what afflicts) + him; 'what was in him', set as one word in the print
قُدُومُكَ: قُدُوم + ـكَ — qudūm, arrival, coming (m., nom.) + your (m.); 'your coming'
وَيُنَجِّيَهُ: وَ + نَجَّى + ـهُ — wa-, and + najjā, to rescue, deliver (verb II, defective, imperf. 3ms, subj., still after an) + him; 'and (that) He deliver him'
وَقَرَّعَيْنَكَ: وَ + قَرَّ + عَيْن + ـكَ — wa-, and + qarra, to be cool, be at rest (verb I, doubled, imperative 2ms) + ʿayn, eye (f., acc. of specification) + your; 'and be comforted', lit. 'be cool of your eye'; set as one word in the print
فَضَعُفْتَ: فَـ + ضَعُفَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḍaʿufa, to grow weak (verb I, perf. 2ms); 'and so you grew weak'
جُنَّتْ: جُنَّ — junna, to be possessed by jinn, go mad (verb I, doubled, passive perf. 3fs); 'she was mad'
مَسْجُونَةٌ: مَسْجُون — masjūn, imprisoned (pass. part. of sajana, f., nom. indef.); 'imprisoned'
أَسْوَ: أَسْوَأ — aswaʾ, worse, worst (elative of sayyiʾ, 'bad'; printed اسو, the final hamza dropped), in construct with an indefinite noun, 'the worst of'
دَوَاؤُكُمَا: دَوَاء + ـكُمَا — dawāʾ, remedy, cure (m., nom.) + your (dual); 'the cure of you two'
قَمَرُالزَّمَانِ: قَمَر + الـ + زَمَان — Qamar al-Zamān, 'Moon of the Age', the prince's name (nom.), which the print here sets as one word
نَشَاطٌ: نَشَاط — nashāṭ, liveliness, vigour (m., nom. indef.); 'vigour'
يُجْلِسَهُ: أَجْلَسَ + ـهُ — ajlasa, to seat, sit up (verb IV, imperf. 3ms, subj. after an) + him; 'that he sit him up'
فَكَادَ: فَـ + كَادَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + kāda, to be on the point of, almost (verb I, hollow, perf. 3ms); 'and almost'
فَنَفَضَ: فَـ + نَفَضَ — fa-, and then (conj.) + nafaḍa, to shake out (verb I, perf. 3ms); 'and he shook out'
مِخَدَّتَيْنِ: مِخَدَّة — mikhadda, cushion, pillow (f., dual, acc.); 'two cushions'
يُطَيَّبَ: طَيَّبَ — ṭayyaba, to perfume, scent (verb II, passive imperf. 3ms, subj. after an); 'that (it) be perfumed'
بِزِينَةِ: بِـ + زِينَة — bi- (prep., marking the thing commanded after amara) + zīna, adornment, decorating (f., gen., construct); 'the decorating of'
سَعِيدَةٌ: سَعِيد — saʿīd, fortunate, auspicious (adj., f., nom. indef.); 'fortunate'
أَكْرَمَهُ: أَكْرَمَ + ـهُ — akrama, to honour, treat generously (verb IV, perf. 3ms) + him; 'he honoured him'
فَقَدَّمُوهُ: فَـ + قَدَّمَ + ـُوهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + qaddama, to bring forward, serve (verb II, perf. 3mp) + it; 'and they set it before (him)'
فَطَاوَعَهُ: فَـ + طَاوَعَ + ـهُ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ṭāwaʿa, to comply with, obey (verb III, perf. 3ms) + him; 'and he obeyed him' (the print has نطاوعه, a misprint)
فَضُرِبَتِ: فَـ + ضَرَبَ — fa-, and so (conj.) + ḍaraba, to strike, beat (verb I, passive perf. 3fs, -i before al-); 'and were beaten'
لِسَلَامَةِ: لِـ + سَلَامَة — li-, for (prep., giving the reason) + salāma, safety, recovery (f., gen., construct); 'for the safety of'
بِالزِّينَةِ: بِـ + الـ + زِينَة — bi- (prep., marking what is proclaimed after nādā) + zīna, adornment, decorating (f., gen.); 'the decorating'
اَلَّفْتُ: أَلَّفَ + ـتُ — allafa, to join, bring together in friendship (verb II, root ʾ-l-f, perf. 1cs; the print gives the alif a fatḥa but no hamza sign); 'I joined'
اِعْرَاضِ: إِعْرَاض — iʿrāḍ, turning away, aversion (verbal noun of IV aʿraḍa; m., gen., second term of the iḍāfa farṭi iʿrāḍi; printed without the hamza sign); 'aversion'
اِلْفِهِ: إِلْف + ـهِ — ilf, intimate, familiar friend (m., gen. after ʿan; root ʾ-l-f; printed without the hamza sign) + -hi, his; 'his intimate'
أَبْدَانَهُمَا: أَبْدَان + ـهُمَا — abdān, bodies (pl. of badan; acc., object of ghasalā) + -humā, of the two of them (dual suffix); 'their bodies'
أُوصِلُكَ: أُوصِلُ + ـكَ — awṣala, to bring (someone) to, make reach (verb IV of waṣala, imperf. 1cs) + -ka, you (obj.); 'I bring you'
بِشِفَاءِ: بِـ + شِفَاء — bi-, at, over (prep., after farḥa: bi- marks what the joy is over) + shifāʾ, healing, recovery (m., gen., first term of an iḍāfa); 'at the healing of'
بِقَمَرِ: بِـ + قَمَر — bi-, with (prep., chosen by khalā, 'to be alone with': bi- marks the companion) + qamar, moon (gen.), first term of the name Qamar al-Zamān; 'with Qamar al-Zamān'
حَبِيبَتُكَ: حَبِيبَة + ـكَ — ḥabība, beloved (f., nom., predicate) + -ka, your; 'your beloved'
حَبِيبُهَا: حَبِيب + ـهَا — ḥabīb, beloved (m., nom., predicate) + -hā, her; 'her beloved'
شَخْصَيْهِمَا: شَخْصَيْ + ـهِمَا — shakhṣ, person, figure (m.; dual, gen. after bayna, its nūn dropped before the suffix) + -himā, of the two of them; 'their two persons'
صَدِيْق: صَدِيق — ṣadīq, friend (m.; nom., subject placed before ṣadda after idhā; the print marks no tanwīn, the metre reads ṣadīqun); 'a friend'
فَغَسَلَا: فَـ + غَسَلَا — fa-, and then + ghasala, to wash (verb I, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two washed'
كَأَنَّنِي: كَأَنَّ + ـنِي — ka-anna, as though (ka-, like, compares + anna, that) + -nī, me (with the nūn of protection); 'as though I (were)'
مِسْمَارُ: مِسْمَار — mismār, nail, pin, rivet (m., nom., predicate of ka-anna; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the pin of'
مِقْرَاضِ: مِقْرَاض — miqrāḍ, shears, scissors (m., gen.; instrument noun from q-r-ḍ, 'to cut'); 'scissors'
وَالْحِكَايَاتِ: وَ + الـ + حِكَايَات — wa-, and + ḥikāyāt, tales, stories (pl. of ḥikāya; gen., joined to bi-al-ashʿāri); 'and the tales'
وَأَجْمَعُ: وَ + أَجْمَعُ — wa-, and + jamaʿa, to bring together (verb I, imperf. 1cs); jamaʿa bayna … wa-bayna, 'to unite … with'; 'and I bring together'
وَتَنَظَّفَا: وَ + تَنَظَّفَا — wa-, and + tanaẓẓafa, to clean oneself (verb V, perf. 3 m. dual); 'and the two cleaned themselves'
وَرُدَّتْ: وَ + رُدَّتْ — wa-, and + ruddat, was returned, given back (passive of radda, verb I doubled, perf. 3fs; the subject is rūḥ, f.); 'and was given back'
وَصْلًا: وَصْل — waṣl, union, joining; in love poetry the lovers' meeting (m., acc., object of allaftu); 'a union'
وَيَحُثُّهُ: وَ + يَحُثُّ + ـهُ — wa-, and + ḥaththa, to urge (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms; ḥaththa ʿalā, 'urge to') + -hu, him; 'and urging him'
وَيُسَلِّيهِ: وَ + يُسَلِّي + ـهِ — wa-, and + sallā, to console, cheer (verb II, imperf. 3ms) + -hi, him; 'and consoling him'
وَيُشَجِّعُهُ: وَ + يُشَجِّعُ + ـهُ — wa-, and + shajjaʿa, to encourage, embolden (verb II, imperf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and encouraging him'
يُقَوِّي: يُقَوِّي — qawwā, to strengthen (verb II, final-weak, imperf. 3ms, after lam yazal: 'kept strengthening'); 'strengthening'
لِلْمِائَتَيْنِ: لِـ + الـ + مِائَتَيْنِ — li-, for, of (prep.; after al-mūfiya, 'completing', it marks the number completed) + al-, the + miʾatayni, two hundred (dual of miʾa, 'hundred', spelled with the old silent alif, مائة; gen. after li-); 'for the two hundred', in al-laylatu al-mūfiyatu li-al-miʾatayni, 'the two hundredth night'
الْمَحَابِيسِ: الـ + مَحَابِيس — maḥābīs, prisoners (pl. of maḥbūs, pass. part. of ḥabasa, to imprison; gen., second term of an iḍāfa); 'the prisoners'
وَتَصَدَّقَ: وَ + تَصَدَّقَ — wa-, and + taṣaddaqa, to give alms (verb V, perf. 3ms); with ʿalā of those who receive: taṣaddaqa ʿalā al-fuqarāʾi, 'he gave alms to the poor'; 'and he gave alms'
أُخَلِّصَهَا: أُخَلِّصَ + هَا — khallaṣa, to set free, deliver, rescue (verb II, imperf. 1cs subj. after an) + -hā, her; with min of what one is freed from; 'that I may deliver her'
نُدَبِّرُ: نُدَبِّرُ — dabbara, to contrive, devise, arrange (verb II, imperf. 1pl; indicative after anna, where Classical prose has an with the subjunctive); dabbara ḥīlatan, 'to devise a ruse'; 'we devise'
ذَهَابِنَا: ذَهَاب + نَا — dhahāb, going (verbal noun of dhahaba, m., gen. after fī) + -nā, our; 'our going'
مَلْآنًا: مَلْآن — malʾān, full (adj., m., acc. indef., agreeing with khurjan; the madda is printed); with min of the contents: malʾānan mina al-māli, 'full of money'
وَارْكَبِ: وَ + ارْكَبْ — wa-, and + irkab, rakiba, to ride, mount (verb I, imperative 2ms; the kasra joins it to the following article); 'and ride!'
جَنِيبًا: جَنِيب — janīb, a led horse, a spare mount led alongside (m., acc. indef., object of khudh); 'a led horse'
أَتَفَرَّجَ: أَتَفَرَّجَ — tafarraja, to divert oneself, look about for pleasure, take in the sights (verb V, imperf. 1cs subj. after an); 'that I take my pleasure'
وَأَتَصَيَّدَ: وَ + أَتَصَيَّدَ — wa-, and + taṣayyada, to go hunting (verb V of ṣāda, imperf. 1cs subj., still under an); 'and hunt'
الْفَضَاءَ: الـ + فَضَاء — faḍāʾ, open space, the wide open country (m., acc., object of anẓura); 'the open space'
وَأَبِيتَ: وَ + أَبِيتَ — wa-, and + bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs subj., under an); 'and spend the night'
ذَهَبْنَا: ذَهَبْنَا — dhahaba, to go (verb I, perf. 1pl; after idhā, of the future); dhahabnā ilā ḥālinā, spoken 'we will go our own way'; 'we go'
تُخَلِّي: تُخَلِّي — khallā, to leave, let, allow (verb II, final-weak, imperf. 2ms); after lā of prohibition the print keeps the final yāʾ where Classical Arabic has the jussive tukhalli, the spoken form; with an object and a following verb, 'let (someone) do'; 'you let'
يَتْبَعُنَا: يَتْبَعُ + نَا — tabiʿa, to follow (verb I, imperf. 3ms) + -nā, us; describing aḥadan, '(anyone) following us'
مُبَارَكٍ: مُبَارَك — mubārak, blessed (pass. part. of bāraka, verb III; m., gen. indef., agreeing with yawmin); 'blessed'
قَوَّاكَ: قَوَّى + كَ — qawwā, to strengthen (verb II, final-weak, perf. 3ms) + -ka, you; 'who strengthened you'
لَاتَبِتْ: لَا + تَبِتْ — lā, not (lā of prohibition, with the jussive) + tabit, bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow, juss. 2ms, the long vowel shortened); printed as one word; 'do not spend the night'
إِلَّالَيْلَةً: إِلَّا + لَيْلَةً — illā, except + laylatan, a night (f., acc. indef., of time); printed as one word; 'except one night'
غَدٍتَأْتِي: غَدٍ + تَأْتِي — ghadin, tomorrow (m., gen. after fī, in fī ghadin) + taʾtī, atā, to come (verb I, final-weak, imperf. 2ms, standing for a command; the hamza is printed); printed as one word; 'tomorrow you come'
وَتَحْضُرُ: وَ + تَحْضُرُ — wa-, and + ḥaḍara, to be present, appear (verb I, imperf. 2ms, standing for a command); with ʿinda, 'to present oneself before (someone)'; 'and you present yourself'
عَيْشٌ: عَيْش — ʿaysh, life, living (m., nom. indef., subject of yaṭību); 'life'
إِلَّابِكَ: إِلَّا + بِـ + كَ — illā, except + bi-, with, in the company of (prep.) + -ka, you; printed as one word; 'except with you'
شُفِيتَ: شُفِيتَ — shafā, to heal (verb I, final-weak; passive perf. 2ms); 'you were healed'
بِسَاطُ: بِسَاط — bisāṭ, carpet (m.; nom. as the verse prints it, where after anna lī the accusative bisāṭa is expected; first term of an iḍāfa); bisāṭ Sulaymān, Solomon's flying carpet of legend; 'the carpet of'
سُلَيْمَانِ: سُلَيْمَان — Sulaymān, Solomon, king and prophet (proper name, diptote; gen., second term of an iḍāfa, printed with a kasra where the fatḥa is expected); 'of Solomon'
الْاَكَاسِرَةْ: الـ + اَكَاسِرَة — akāsira, the Chosroes, the Persian kings (pl. of Kisrā; gen., second term of an iḍāfa; in pause, -ah; printed with a fatḥa on the bare alif); 'the Chosroes'
سُوِّيَا: سُوِّيَا — sawwā, to make equal, reckon at (verb II, final-weak; passive perf. 3m. dual); after la-mā, 'the two would not be reckoned at', with the measure in the accusative: janāḥa baʿūḍatin, 'a gnat's wing'
بَعُوْضَةٍ: بَعُوضَة — baʿūḍa, gnat, mosquito (f., unit noun of baʿūḍ; gen. indef., second term of an iḍāfa; the verse prints a sukūn on the wāw of the long ū); 'of a gnat'
نَاظِرَةْ: نَاظِرَة — nāẓira, looking, gazing (act. part. of naẓara, f., agreeing with ʿaynī; acc. predicate of takun, nāẓiratan, read in pause, -ah); with li- of what is looked on; 'looking'
يُهَيِّئَ: يُهَيِّئَ — hayyaʾa, to make ready, prepare (verb II, imperf. 3ms subj. after an, with no subject named; the shadda and ئ are printed); 'that (one) make ready'
أَرْبَعَةً: أَرْبَعَة — arbaʿa, four (numeral, acc. indef., object of yuhayyiʾa); with min of the kind: arbaʿatan mina al-khayli, 'four horses'
وَهَجِينًا: وَ + هَجِين — wa-, and + hajīn, a swift riding-camel, dromedary (m., acc. indef.); 'and a dromedary'
وَجَمَلًا: وَ + جَمَل — wa-, and + jamal, camel (m., acc. indef.); 'and a camel'
وَمَنَعَ: وَ + مَنَعَ — wa-, and + manaʿa, to prevent, forbid (verb I, perf. 3ms); with an and the subjunctive for what is forbidden; 'and he forbade'
وَضَمَّهُ: وَ + ضَمَّ + هُ — wa-, and + ḍamma, to press, clasp (verb I doubled, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hu, him; with ilā, 'to clasp to (one's breast)'; 'and he pressed him'
وَحَرَامٌ: وَ + حَرَام — wa-, and + ḥarām, forbidden, unlawful (adj./noun, nom. indef., predicate set first); with ʿalā of the one it is forbidden to; 'and forbidden'
وِصَالُكَ: وِصَال + كَ — wiṣāl, union, the lovers' meeting (verbal noun of wāṣala, verb III; m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'union with you'
نَعِيمْ: نَعِيم — naʿīm, bliss, delight (m.; the word said again, naʿīmun naʿīm, 'bliss upon bliss', in pause with sukūn for the rhyme); 'bliss'
وَصَبْرِيَ: وَ + صَبْر + ـيَ — wa-, and + ṣabr, patience, endurance (m., nom.) + -iya, my (the fatḥa added for the metre); with ʿan, 'patience without, doing without'; 'and my patience'
اَلِيمٌ: اَلِيم — alīm, painful, grievous (adj., m., nom. indef.; printed with a fatḥa on the bare alif, no hamza sign); 'painful'
اَلِيمْ: اَلِيم — alīm, painful (the word said again, alīmun alīm, in pause for the rhyme; printed with a fatḥa on the bare alif); 'painful'
فَدَيْتُكُ: فَدَيْتُ + كُ — fadā, to ransom (verb I, final-weak, perf. 1cs) + -ka, you (the print points the kāf with a ḍamma, -ku; read fadaytuka); 'I ransom you', i.e. 'my life for yours', an endearment
اَلَيْكَ: اِلَى + كَ — ilā, to, toward (prep.) + -ka, you; 'toward you'; after al-hawā, 'passion', ilā marks the beloved (the print sets a fatḥa on the alif; read ilayka)
فَذَنْبِي: فَـ + ذَنْب + ي — fa-, then (opening the answer to in, 'if') + dhanb, sin, fault (m., nom.) + -ī, my; 'then my sin'
عَظِيمْ: عَظِيم — ʿaẓīm, great (adj., m.; the word said again, ʿaẓīmun ʿaẓīm, in pause for the rhyme); 'great'
اَعِنْدَكَ: اَ + عِنْدَ + كَ — a-, question particle + ʿinda, at, with + -ka, you; 'is there with you …?' (printed with a fatḥa on the bare alif)
مِثْلِيَ: مِثْل + ـيَ — mithl, the like of (adverbial acc., 'like') + -iya, me (the fatḥa added for the metre); 'like me'
فَاصْلَى: فَـ + اَصْلَى — fa-, so that (after a question, with the subjunctive) + aṣlā, ṣaliya, to roast in, suffer the heat of (verb I, final-weak, imperf. 1cs subj.; takes the fire as its object; printed without hamza); 'so that I roast'
عَذَاب: عَذَاب — ʿadhāb, torment, punishment (m.; printed without a final vowel, read ʿadhāba, acc., object of aṣlā; first term of an iḍāfa); 'the torment of'
الْجَحِيمْ: الـ + جَحِيم — jaḥīm, Hellfire, blazing fire (gen., second term of an iḍāfa, in pause); 'the Hellfire'
أَبِيتُ: أَبِيتُ — bāta, to spend the night (verb I hollow, imperf. 1cs; after lā, of the future, 'I will not spend the night'); 'I spend the night'
وَرَكِبَا: وَ + رَكِبَا — wa-, and + rakiba, to ride, mount (verb I, perf. 3m. dual); 'and the two mounted'
الْهَجِينُ: الـ + هَجِين — hajīn, dromedary, swift riding-camel (m., nom., subject of a verbless clause of state); 'the dromedary'
وَالْجَمَلُ: وَ + الـ + جَمَل — wa-, and + al-, the + jamal, camel (m., nom., subject of a verbless clause of state); 'and the camel'
وَالزَّادُ: وَ + الـ + زَاد — wa-, and + al-, the + zād, provisions (m., nom.); 'and the provisions'
وَاسْتَقْبَلَا: وَ + اسْتَقْبَلَا — wa-, and + istaqbala, to face, turn toward, set out toward (verb X, perf. 3m. dual); 'and the two faced'
الْمِائَتَيْنِ: الـ + مِائَتَيْنِ — al-, the + miʾatayni, two hundred (dual of miʾa, 'a hundred', gen.; the ئ is printed); baʿda al-miʾatayni, 'after the two hundred'
وَمَرْزَوَانَ: وَ + مَرْزَوَان — wa-, and + Marzawān, Budūr's foster brother (Persian name, diptote; acc., joined to Qamara al-Zamāni after anna); 'and Marzawān'
وَأَطْعَمَا: وَ + أَطْعَمَا — wa-, and + aṭʿama, to feed (verb IV, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two fed'
دَوَابَّهُمَا: دَوَابّ + ـهُمَا — dawābb, beasts, mounts (pl. of dābba, acc., object) + -humā, their (dual); 'their two beasts'
وَاسْتَرَاحَا: وَ + اسْتَرَاحَا — wa-, and + istarāḥa, to rest (verb X hollow, perf. 3m dual); 'and the two rested'
رَابِعِ: رَابِع — rābiʿ, fourth (ordinal, gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa with an indefinite noun); rābiʿi yawmin, 'the fourth day'
غَابٌ: غَاب — ghāb, thicket, wood (collective; single ghāba; nom. indef., subject of a clause with no verb); fīhi ghābun, 'with a thicket in it'
وَفَرَسًا: وَ + فَرَس — wa-, and + faras, horse (acc. indef., object); 'and a horse'
وَذَبَحَهُمَا: وَ + ذَبَحَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + dhabaḥa, to slaughter (verb I, perf. 3ms) + -humā, the two of them (object); 'and he slaughtered them both'
وَقَطَّعَ: وَ + قَطَّعَ — wa-, and + qaṭṭaʿa, to cut up, cut to pieces (verb II, perf. 3ms); 'and he cut up'
لَحْمَهُمَا: لَحْم + ـهُمَا — laḥm, flesh, meat (m., acc., object) + -humā, of the two of them; 'their flesh'
وَنَجَرَ: وَ + نَجَرَ — wa-, and + najara, to hew, plane (wood) (verb I, perf. 3ms); of bones here, 'hacked, chopped'; 'and he hacked'
عَظْمَهُمَا: عَظْم + ـهُمَا — ʿaẓm, bone (m., acc., object; singular for the bones as a whole) + -humā, of the two of them; 'their bones'. The print has عظهما, a misprint, corrected here
وَلِبَاسَهُ: وَ + لِبَاس + ـهُ — wa-, and + libās, clothing; in the Nights usually drawers, loose trousers (m., acc.) + -hu, his; 'and his drawers'
وَقَطَّعَهُمَا: وَ + قَطَّعَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + qaṭṭaʿa, to cut to pieces (verb II, perf. 3ms) + -humā, the two of them (object); 'and he cut them both up'
وَلَوَّثَهُمَا: وَ + لَوَّثَ + هُمَا — wa-, and + lawwatha, to soil, smear (verb II, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -humā, the two of them (object); 'and he smeared them both'
وَمَزَّقَهَا: وَ + مَزَّقَ + هَا — wa-, and + mazzaqa, to tear to shreds (verb II, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, it (f., the cloak); 'and he tore it'
وَلَوَّثَهَا: وَ + لَوَّثَ + هَا — wa-, and + lawwatha, to soil, smear (verb II, perf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + -hā, it (f., the cloak); 'and he smeared it'
مَفْرِقِ: مَفْرِق — mafriq (also mafraq), parting, fork (of a road) (m., gen. after fī, first term of an iḍāfa); mafriqi al-ṭarīqi, 'where the road divides'
غِبْنَا: غِبْنَا — ghāba, to be absent, stay away (verb I hollow, perf. 1p, with ʿan for the one left); 'we are away'
نَحْضُرْ: نَحْضُرْ — ḥaḍara, to be present, come, appear (verb I, imperf. 1p, jussive after lam); lam naḥḍur, 'we did not come'
أَثَرِنَا: أَثَر + ـنَا — athar, track, trace (m., gen. after fī) + -nā, our; fī atharinā, 'on our track, after us'
قَمِيصَكَ: قَمِيص + ـكَ — qamīṣ, shirt (m., acc., object) + -ka, your; 'your shirt'
وَلِبَاسَكَ: وَ + لِبَاس + ـكَ — wa-, and + libās, clothing; here drawers (m., acc.) + -ka, your; 'and your drawers'
مُقَطَّعًا: مُقَطَّع — muqaṭṭaʿ, cut to pieces (pass. part. of qaṭṭaʿa, II; acc. of state; the shadda is printed; singular though it describes two garments); 'cut to pieces'
فَيَظُنُّ: فَـ + يَظُنُّ — fa-, then (introducing the answer to idhā) + ẓanna, to think, suppose (verb I doubled, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed); 'then he will think'
وُحُوشِ: وُحُوش — wuḥūsh, wild beasts (pl. of waḥsh, gen., joined to quṭṭāʿi by aw, first term of an iḍāfa); wuḥūshi al-barri, 'the wild beasts of the open country'
فَيَنْقَطِعُ: فَـ + يَنْقَطِعُ — fa-, so + inqaṭaʿa, to be cut off (verb VII, imperf. 3ms); 'so is cut off'
رَجَاؤُهُ: رَجَاء + ـهُ — rajāʾ, hope (m., nom., subject; the ؤ is printed) + -hu, his; 'his hope'
وَنَبْلُغُ: وَ + نَبْلُغُ — wa-, and + balagha, to reach, attain (verb I, imperf. 1p); 'and we shall reach'
مَانُرِيدُ: مَا + نُرِيدُ — mā, what (rel. pron.) + nurīdu, we want (arāda, IV hollow, imperf. 1p); printed as one word; 'what we want'
يَشْتَكِي: يَشْتَكِي — ishtakā, to complain, lament (verb VIII defective, imperf. 3ms); 'he laments'
اسْتَبْشَرَ: اسْتَبْشَرَ — istabshara, to rejoice at good tidings, take heart (verb X, perf. 3ms; with bi- for the cause of joy); 'he took heart'
اَتَجْفُو: اَ + تَجْفُو — a-, question particle (printed alif without hamza) + jafā, to treat harshly, shun (verb I defective, imperf. 2ms); 'do you shun?'
مَاسَلَا: مَا + سَلَا — mā, not + salā, to be consoled, forget (verb I defective, perf. 3ms; with ʿan for what is forgotten); printed as one word; 'who has not been consoled'
وَتَزْهَدُ: وَ + تَزْهَدُ — wa-, and + zahida, to lose desire for, renounce (verb I, imperf. 2ms; with fī for what one turns from); 'and you turn away'
بَعْدَمَا: بَعْدَ + مَا — baʿda, after + mā (making a conjunction of it); 'after, once' (printed as one word, as usual)
خُنْتُكَ: خُنْتُ + ـكَ — khāna, to betray (verb I hollow, perf. 1s) + -ka, you (object); 'I betrayed you'
وَعُوقِبْتُ: وَ + عُوقِبْتُ — wa-, and + ʿūqibtu, passive of ʿāqaba, to punish (verb III, perf. 1s, here as a self-curse); 'and may I be punished'
بِالْهِجْرَانِ: بِـ + الـ + هِجْرَان — bi-, with (marking the punishment) + al-, the + hijrān, forsaking, separation (m., gen.); 'with being forsaken'
كَاذِبًا: كَاذِب — kādhib, lying, a liar (act. part. of kadhaba; acc., predicate of kāna; final -ā of the rhyme); 'lying'
فَاسْتَوْجِبُ: فَـ + أَسْتَوْجِبُ — fa-, so (that) + istawjaba, to deserve, merit (verb X, imperf. 1s; printed with ḍamma, indicative, and with bare alif); 'so I deserve' (the grammar would want 'that I should deserve')
تَائِبًا: تَائِب — tāʾib, repenting, penitent (act. part. of tāba; acc. of state; the ئ is printed); 'repenting'
عَجَبِ: عَجَب — ʿajab, wonder, marvel (m., gen. after min, first term of an iḍāfa); min ʿajabi al-ayyāmi, 'among the wonders of the days'
الْاَيَّامِ: الـ + أَيَّام — al-, the + ayyām, days (pl. of yawm, gen.; printed with bare alif); 'the days'
هَاجِرِيْ: هَاجِر + ـِي — hājir, one who forsakes (act. part. of hajara; nom., predicate of anna) + -ī, me; 'my forsaker'; the print sets a sukūn on the yāʾ
وَمَازَالَتِ: وَ + مَا + زَالَتِ — wa-, and + mā, not + zālat, ceased (zāla, perf. 3fs, linking -i before al-); printed as one word; 'and (the days) have not ceased'
الْعَجَائِبَا: الـ + عَجَائِب — al-, the + ʿajāʾib, wonders (pl. of ʿajība, acc., object; final -ā of the rhyme; the ئ is printed); 'the wonders'
تَخْتَ: تَخْت — takht, board, tablet (m., acc., object of ʿamila, first term of a construct); takhta ramlin, 'a board of sand', the geomancer's sand-tray on which figures are traced
أَسْطُرْلَابًا: أَسْطُرْلَاب — asṭurlāb, astrolabe (m., from Greek; acc. indef., object of ʿamila; hamza supplied, printed bare); 'an astrolabe'
مَطْلِى: مَطْلِيّ — maṭliyy (read here as the spoken maṭlī), coated, plated (pass. part. of ṭalā, to smear, coat); printed مطلى with ى and without a case ending, where Classical would have maṭliyyan agreeing with asṭurlāban; with bi- of the coating, maṭlī bi-al-dhahabi, 'plated with gold'
الْحَاسِبُ: الـ + حَاسِب — al-, the + ḥāsib, reckoner, calculator (act. part. of ḥasaba, to reckon; m., nom.); 'the reckoner'
الْكَاتِبُ: الـ + كَاتِب — al-, the + kātib, scribe, writer (act. part. of kataba; m., nom.); 'the scribe'
وَالطَّالِبَ: وَ + الـ + طَالِب — wa-, and + al-, the + ṭālib, seeker, one who asks (act. part. of ṭalaba; m., acc.); 'and the seeker'
الْبَاهِرُ: الـ + بَاهِر — al-, the + bāhir, dazzling, surpassing (act. part. of bahara, to dazzle, outshine; m., nom.); 'the dazzling one'
الطَّالِبُ: الـ + طَالِب — al-, the + ṭālib, seeker, one who asks (act. part. of ṭalaba; m., nom.); fa-ayna al-ṭālibu, 'so where is the seeker?'
سَمِعَكَ: سَمِعَ + ـكَ — samiʿa, to hear (verb I, perf. 3ms, future sense after idhā) + 2ms object; 'he hears you'
مُهْلَةً: مُهْلَة — muhla, respite, delay, grace (f., acc. indef., object of aʿṭinī); 'a respite'
بِالَّذِينَ: بِـ + الَّذِينَ — bi-, to (faʿala bi-, 'to do to': the verb chooses bi- for the one acted on) + alladhīna, those who (rel. pron., m. pl.); 'to those who'
يَقْبَلُ: يَقْبَلُ — qabila, to accept (verb I, imperf. 3ms); with min of the one offering; 'he accepts'
عَرِّفْهَا: عَرِّفْ + ـهَا — ʿarrafa, to make known, acquaint (verb II, imper. 2ms; the shadda is printed) + 3fs object; ʿarrafa … bi-, 'to acquaint someone with'; 'acquaint her'
تَشْتَدُّ: اِشْتَدَّ — ishtadda, to grow strong, gather strength (verb VIII doubled, imperf. 3fs; the shadda is printed); 'she grows strong'
تَرَاكَ: تَرَى + ـكَ — raʾā, to see (verb I, imperf. 3fs tarā, without the hamza as always in this verb's imperfect) + 2ms object; 'she sees you'
فَأَطْعِمْهَا: فَـ + أَطْعِمْ + ـهَا — fa-, so, then (conj.) + aṭʿim, feed! (verb IV imper. 2ms of aṭʿama; hamza supplied, printed bare) + 3fs object; 'so feed her'
وَاسْقِهَا: وَ + اسْقِ + ـهَا — wa-, and + isqi, give to drink! (verb I defective, imper. 2ms of saqā, hamzat waṣl, the final vowel shortened) + 3fs object; 'and give her to drink'
وَيُزَوِّجُكَ: وَ + يُزَوِّجُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + zawwaja, to marry (someone) to (verb II, imperf. 3ms; the shadda is printed) + 2ms object; with bi- of the bride (bihā); 'and he will marry you (to her)'
وَيُقَاسِمُكَ: وَ + يُقَاسِمُ + ـكَ — wa-, and + qāsama, to share with, go halves with (verb III, imperf. 3ms) + 2ms object; fī marks what is shared: yuqāsimuka fī mulkihi, 'he will share his kingdom with you'
لَابِسُ: لَابِس — lābis, wearing, dressed in (act. part. of labisa; m., nom., predicate of a clause of state, in construct with what is worn); 'wearing'
الْبَدْلَةِ: الـ + بَدْلَة — al-, the + badla, suit of clothes, outfit (f., gen. after lābisu; a later word); 'the suit'
ذَكَرْنَاهَا: ذَكَرْنَا + ـهَا — dhakara, to mention (verb I, perf. 1pl, the storyteller speaking) + 3fs object resuming allatī; 'which we have mentioned'
وَأَحْسُبُ: وَ + أَحْسُبُ — wa-, and + ḥasaba/yaḥsubu, to reckon, count (verb I, imperf. 1s; hamza supplied); 'and I reckon'
الْحِسَابَ: الـ + حِسَاب — al-, the + ḥisāb, reckoning, calculation (m., acc., inner object of aḥsubu); 'the reckoning'
وَأُفَسِّرُ: وَ + أُفَسِّرُ — wa-, and + fassara, to explain, interpret (verb II, imperf. 1s; the shadda is printed, the hamza supplied); 'and I interpret'
الْأَحْلَامَ: الـ + أَحْلَام — al-, the + aḥlām, pl. of ḥulm, dream (acc.); 'the dreams'
وَأَخُطُّ: وَ + أَخُطُّ — wa-, and + khaṭṭa, to draw lines, write (verb I doubled, imperf. 1s; the shadda is printed); used of the geomancer tracing figures; 'and I trace'
بِأَقْلَامِ: بِـ + أَقْلَام — bi-, with (prep., the tool used) + aqlām, pl. of qalam, reed pen (gen., first term of a construct); 'with the pens of'
الْمَطَالِبِ: الـ + مَطَالِب — al-, the + maṭālib, pl. of maṭlab, thing sought, wish, quest (gen.); later also 'hidden treasures'; 'the things sought'
مَارَأَوْا: مَا + رَأَوْا — mā, not (neg. particle) + raʾaw, they saw (raʾā, verb I, perf. 3mp; the hamza is printed); printed solid as مارأوا; 'they had not seen'
كَاتِبًا: كَاتِب — kātib, scribe, writer (act. part. of kataba; m., acc. indef., object of raʾaw); 'a scribe'
مُنَجِّمًا: مُنَجِّم — munajjim, astrologer (act. part. of II najjama, from najm, star; m., acc. indef.; the shadda is printed); 'an astrologer'
فَوَقَفُوا: فَـ + وَقَفُوا — fa-, and so (conj.) + waqafa, to stand, stop (verb I, perf. 3mp); 'and they stood'
يَتَأَمَّلُونَهُ: يَتَأَمَّلُونَ + ـهُ — taʾammala, to gaze at, look closely at (verb V, imperf. 3mp; hamza and shadda printed) + 3ms object; 'gazing at him'
وَاللُّطْفِ: وَ + الـ + لُطْف — wa-, and + al-, the + luṭf, delicacy, charm, gentleness (m., gen. after min); 'and the charm'
تُخَاطِرْ: تُخَاطِرْ — khāṭara, to risk, hazard (verb III, jussive 2ms after prohibitive lā); khāṭara bi-, the verb takes bi- for what is staked; lā tukhāṭir bi-nafsika, 'do not risk your life'
الرُّؤُسِ: الـ + رُؤُوس — al-, the + ruʾūs, pl. of raʾs, head (gen. after ilā); printed الرؤس, one wāw short of الرؤوس, the hamza printed; 'the heads'
الْمُعَلَّقَةِ: الـ + مُعَلَّقَة — al-, the + muʿallaqa, hung up, suspended (pass. part. of II ʿallaqa; f. sg. agreeing with the plural ruʾūs; gen.; the shadda is printed); 'hung up'
الشَّوْقَ: الـ + شَوْق — al-, the + shawq, longing, yearning (m., acc., object of yaʿlamu); 'longing'
تَطِبِ: طَابَ — ṭāba, of the sick, to get well, recover (verb I hollow, jussive 3fs after lam, the long vowel shortened; helping vowel -i before the waṣl of ifʿal); lam taṭibi, 'she does not recover'
بَلِيدٌ: balīd — dull, slow-witted (adj., m., nom. indef.); 'dull'
مُكَابِرٌ: mukābir — stubborn, one who persists against reason (act. part. of III kābara, to defy; m., nom. indef.); 'headstrong'
ارْحَمْ: irḥam — raḥima, to have mercy on, pity (verb I, imper. 2ms; the alif is the helping alif, sounded i-); 'have pity on'
وَحُسْنَكَ: وَ + حُسْن + كَ — wa-, and + ḥusn, beauty (m., acc., object of irḥam) + -ka, your; 'and your beauty'
وَالْحَاسِبُ: وَ + الـ + حَاسِب — wa-, and + al-, the + ḥāsib, reckoner (act. part. of ḥasaba, to reckon; m., nom.); 'and the reckoner'
طَالِبٍ: طَالِب — ṭālib, seeker, one who asks (act. part. of ṭalaba, to seek; m., gen. indef. after min); hal min ṭālibin, 'is there any seeker?' (min after hal marks 'any at all')
يَنْهَوْنَهُ: يَنْهَوْنَ + هُ — nahā, to forbid, try to stop (verb I final-weak, imperf. 3mp) + -hu, him; 'they were trying to stop him'
انْزِلِ: inzili — nazala, to go down (verb I, imper. 2ms; the helping alif, and a linking kasra before the next word); 'go down'
أْتِنَا: أْتِ + نَا — iʾti, imper. 2ms of atā, to come (final-weak, the final vowel cut short; the print sets its opening alif apart as أ) + -nā, us; with bi-, 'bring': iʾtinā bi-, 'bring us'
الْمُنَجِّمِ: الـ + مُنَجِّم — al-, the + munajjim, astrologer (act. part. of II najjama, from najm, star; m., gen. after bi-); 'the astrologer'
حُزْتَ: ḥuzta — ḥāza, to win, gain possession of (verb I hollow, perf. 2ms); 'you have won'
جَمِيْعَهَا: جَمِيع + هَا — jamīʿ, all, the whole of (acc., object of ḥuzta) + -hā, them (f., the eight); 'all of them'; the print sets a sukūn on the yāʾ
خُدَّامًا: khuddām — servants (pl. of khādim; acc. indef., predicate of zāla); 'servants'
يَقِيْنُكَ: يَقِين + كَ — yaqīn, certainty, sure faith (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'your certainty'; the print sets a sukūn on the yāʾ
وَمَجْدُكَ: وَ + مَجْد + كَ — wa-, and + majd, glory (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your glory'
وَالنَّدَى: وَ + الـ + نَدَى — wa-, and + al-, the + nadā, dew; generosity, liberality (m., nom.); 'and generosity'
وَلَفْظُكَ: وَ + لَفْظ + كَ — wa-, and + lafẓ, utterance, wording (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your speech'
وَالْمَعْنِي: وَ + الـ + مَعْنَى — wa-, and + al-, the + maʿnā, meaning, sense (m., nom.); printed with kasra and yāʾ, al-maʿnī, where the usual form is al-maʿnā; 'and the meaning'
وَعِزُّكَ: وَ + عِزّ + كَ — wa-, and + ʿizz, might, honour (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your might'
وَالنَّصْرُ: وَ + الـ + نَصْر — wa-, and + al-, the + naṣr, victory, help (m., nom.); 'and victory'
أَجْلَسَهُ: أَجْلَسَ + هُ — ajlasa, to seat (verb IV of jalasa, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'he seated him'
شَرَطْتُ: sharaṭtu — sharaṭa, to stipulate, lay down a condition (verb I, perf. 1cs); sharaṭtu ʿalā nafsī, 'I have bound myself' (ʿalā marks the one bound)
أَبْرَأَهَا: أَبْرَأَ + هَا — abraʾa, to cure (verb IV, perf. 3ms; the hamza of the root is printed, the opening one is not) + -hā, her; 'cured her'
حُسْنُكَ: حُسْن + كَ — ḥusn, beauty (m., nom., subject of yaghurrannaka) + -ka, your; 'your beauty'
وَجَمَالُكَ: وَ + جَمَال + كَ — wa-, and + jamāl, grace, loveliness (m., nom.) + -ka, your; 'and your grace'
تُبْرِئْهَا: تُبْرِئْ + هَا — tubriʾ (abraʾa, to cure; verb IV, jussive 2ms after lam; the edition prints the ئ) + -hā, her; 'cure her'
رَاضٍ: rāḍin — rāḍī, content, consenting (act. part. of raḍiya; m., nom. indef., the final yāʾ dropped before the tanwīn); 'content'
فَأَشْهَدَ: فَـ + أَشْهَدَ — fa-, then + ashhada, to call to witness, make someone a witness (verb IV of shahida, perf. 3ms); ashhada ʿalayhi al-quḍāta, 'he made the judges witnesses against him'
أَوْصِلْ: awṣil — awṣala, to bring to, convey (verb IV of waṣala, imper. 2ms); 'take, convey'
فَمَسَكَهُ: فَـ + مَسَكَ + هُ — fa-, then + masaka, to take hold of (verb I, perf. 3ms; the spoken form of Classical amsaka, IV) + -hu, him; 'and he took hold of him'
فَسَابَقَهُ: فَـ + سَابَقَ + هُ — fa-, but + sābaqa, to race, try to get ahead of (verb III of sabaqa, perf. 3ms) + -hu, him; 'and he raced ahead of him'
يَسْتَعْجِلُ: yastaʿjilu — istaʿjala, to hurry, be in haste (verb X, imperf. 3ms indic.); with ʿalā, 'to hurry toward' (later usage)
فَأَعْرَضَ: فَـ + أَعْرَضَ — fa-, but + aʿraḍa, to turn away (verb IV, perf. 3ms); aʿraḍa ʿan, 'to turn away from'
أ: first piece of iʾtinā as the print sets it apart: the alif that opens the imperative of atā, drawn with a hamza in the print; silent after inzili, so left without a vowel; see أْتِنَا
